1751: Ise teen baar, paanch baar ya -zaroorat mahsoos ho to- isse adhik baar paani tatha beri ke patton se nahla do aur antim baar kaafoor -ya thora sa kaafoor- daal do. Snaan dene ka kaary poora ho jaye, to mujhe soochna do.

Umm-e-atiyya radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki ek beti ki mrityu hui, to Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam baahar aye aur farmaya : "Ise teen baar, paanch baar ya -zaroorat mahsoos ho to- isse adhik baar paani tatha beri ke patton se nahla do aur antim baar kaafoor -ya thora sa kaafoor- daal do. Snaan dene ka kaary poora ho jaye, to mujhe soochna do." Woh kahti hain : Jab hamne snaan karaane ka kaam poora kar liya, to aapko soochna di. Aapne hamen apna tahband diya aur farmaya : "Ise uske shareer par lapet do." Woh kahti hain : Hamne unke sir ke baalon ki teen chotiyaan bana di theen.

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki beti zainab ki mrityu hui, to aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- un mahilaaon ke paas aye jo unhen ghusl dene waali theen aur unse farmaya : "Use beri ke patte daale hue paani se wisham sankhya mein teen, paanch athva aawashyakta hone par usse adhik baar snaan karaao tatha antim baar ke snaan mein thora-sa kapoor mila do. Jab tum log snaan kara chuko, to mujhe khabar dena. Jab we unhen ghusl de chukeen aur aapko soochit kiya, to aapne ghusl dene waali mahilaaon ko apna tahband diya aur farmaya : 'Use ismen lapet do aur ise hi woh kapra banaao jo uske shareer se sata rahe', phir unke baalon ki teen chotiyaan bana di gaeen.

Musalmaan mritak ko ghusl dena waajib hai aur yeh farz-e-kifaya hai.
Mahila ko kewal mahilayen hi snaan dengi aur purush ko kewal purush hi snaan denge, siway patni aur uske pati ke, tatha baandi aur uske maalik ke, kyonki in donon mein se har ek apne saathi ko snaan de sakta hai.
Teen baar ghusl diya jaye, yadi yeh kaafi na ho to paanch baar, aur yadi yeh bhi kaafi na ho to hit aur aawashyakta ke anusaar isse adhik baar ghusl diya jaye. Iske baad, yadi shareer se koi gandgi baahar nikle, to gandgi nikalne waale sthaan ko band kar diya jaye.
Snaan karaane waala snaan ko wisham sankhya par samaapt kare, teen, paanch, ya saat ki sankhya par.
Allaama sindhi kahte hain : Is hadees se pata chalta hai ki murde ko snaan dene ki koi sankhya nirdhaarit nahin hai, balki asal maqsad safaai-suthraai hai. Lekin wisham sankhya ka dhyaan rakhna zaroori hai.
Jal ke saath beri ke patte hon; kyonki yeh svachchh aur maiyat ke shareer ko sakht karta hai.
Maiyat ko aakhiri ghusl ke saath khushbu lagaai jaye, taaki paani se khushbu chali na jaye, aur khushbu kapoor ki ho, kyonki woh apni achchhi mahak ke saath-saath shareer ko sakht karta hai, jisse usmen jaldi saran paida nahin hoti.
Sammaanit angon ko dhone se aaranbh karna. Arthaat: Daahine angon, tatha wuzu ke angon se.
Mritak mahila ke baalon ko sanwaare jaane ka mustahab hai. Unhen teen chotiyon mein goontha jaye aur unhen uske peechhe daal diya jaye.
Maiyat ko ghusl dene mein sahyog jayaz hai, lekin kewal wahi upasthit ho jiski aawashyakta ho.
Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke aasaar (avsheshon), jaise aapke wastron se barkat haasil karna jayaj hai. Lekin, yeh cheez aapke saath khaas hai. Aisa aapke atirikt aalim ya sadaachaari vyakti ke saath nahin kiya ja sakta. Kyonki ye cheezen tauqeefi hain aur sahaaba ne aapke siwa kisi aur ke saath aisa kabhi nahin kiya. Aisa karna isliye bhi jayaz nahin hai ki aapke siwa doosron ke saath aisa karna shirk ka ek maadhyam aur us vyakti ke liye ek fitna hai, jisse barkat haasil ki jaye.
Jab kisi ko koi kaam saunpa gaya ho, to woh kisi doosre yogy vyakti ko woh kaam saunp sakta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2750: Mujhe hajjatul wada ke avsar par Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath Hajj karaya gaya, jabki us samay meri ayu saat saal thi.
Saaib bin yazeed- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki mujhe hajjatul wada ke avsar par Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath Hajj karaya gaya, jabki us samay meri ayu saat saal thi).
2751: Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek oont par baithkar Hajj kiya, jismen aapke khaane ke saamaan tatha any wastuen rakhi theen.
Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek oont par baithkar Hajj kiya, jismen aapke khaane ke saamaan tatha any wastuen rakhi theen.
2752: Allah ke raaste mein - ek din evn ek raat ki pahredaari maheena bhar ke roza aur tahajjud se uttam hai. Agar woh mar gaya, to uska woh amal jaari rahega, jo woh kya karta tha tatha uski rozi jaari kar di jayegi evn woh qabr ki pareeksha se surakshit rahega.

Salmaan faarsi- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "- Allah ke raaste mein- ek din evn ek raat ki pahredaari maheena bhar ke roza aur tahajjud se uttam hai. Agar woh mar gaya, to uska woh amal jaari rahega, jo woh kya karta tha tatha uski rozi jaari kar di jayegi evn woh qabr ki pareeksha se surakshit rahega."
2753: Jab Ramzan aye, to tum Umrah kar lo. Kyonki Ramzan mein kiya gaya Umrah Hajj ke baraabar hai.

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ek ansaari mahila se, jiska naam abdullah bin abbaas ne bataya tha, lekin main uska naam bhool gaya hoon, poochha : "Tujhe hamaare saath Hajj karne se kis cheez ne roka?" Usne uttar diya : Hamaare paas kewal do hi oont the. Ek par sawaar hokar mere bachchon ke pita aur mere bete ne Hajj kiya, jabki doosra oont hamaare paas paani laane ke liye chhor gae. Uski baat sun Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jab Ramzan aye, to tum Umrah kar lo. Kyonki Ramzan mein kiya gaya Umrah Hajj ke baraabar hai."

Jab Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam hajjatulavda se laute, to ek ansaari mahila se, jisne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath Hajj nahin kiya tha, poochha : Tujhe hamaare saath Hajj karne se kis cheez ne roka?

Usne kaaran dete hue uttar diya ki unke ghar mein do oont hain. Ek par sawaar hokar uske pati evn bete ne Hajj kiya, jabki doosra kune se paani laane ke liye chhor gae.

Atah Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne use bataya ki Ramzan mein Umrah karna sawaab mein Hajj ke samaan hai.

Ramzan maheene mein Umrah ki fazeelat.
Ramzan mein kiya gaya Umrah sawaab mein Hajj ke baraabar hai. Lekin isse Hajj ki aniwaaryata khatm nahin hoti.
Samay ki shreshthata ke kaaran kaaryon ka sawaab barh jaata hai. Iska ek udaahan Ramzan maheene mein kiye gae kaary hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2754: Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- pratyek Ramzan mein das din etekaaf karte the. Parantu jab mrityu ka warsh aya, to bees din etekaaf kiya.
Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- pratyek Ramzan mein das din etekaaf karte the. Parantu jab mrityu ka warsh aya, to bees din etekaaf kiya.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- har Ramzan maheene ke das din duniya ke jhamelon se alag hokar Allah ki ibaadat karne ke uddeshy se masjid mein guzaarte the, jise etikaaf kahte hain. Aap pahle sammaanit raatri (lailtul qadr) ko paane ki aasha mein beech ke das dinon mein etikaaf karte the. Lekin jab yeh maaloom ho gaya ki lailtul qadr antim das dinon mein hoti hai, to unheen mein etikaaf karne lage. Phir, jis warsh aapki mrityu hui, us warsh aapne bees din etikaaf kiya, taaki Allah ki adhik ibaadat ki ja sake aur uski adhik nikatta praapt ki ja sake.
2755: Ukaaz, majinna aur zul-majaaz jaahiliyat kaal ke baazaar the. Par sahaaba ne Hajj ke dinon mein vyaapaar karne ko paap samjha, to yeh ayat utreeh "ليس عليكم جناح أن تبتغوا فضلاً من ربكم" (Arthaatah tumpar ismen koi gunaah nahin hai ki apne paalanhaar ki anukanpa talaash karo.)

Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki ukaaz, majinna aur zul-majaaz jaahiliyat kaal ke baazaar the. Par sahaaba ne Hajj ke dinon mein vyaapaar karne ko paap samjha, to yeh ayat utreeh "ليس عليكم جناح أن تبتغوا فضلاً من ربكم" (Arthaatah tumpar ismen koi gunaah nahin hai ki apne paalanhaar ki anukanpa- aajeewika- talaash karo.) (soora al-baqraah 198) hajj ke dinon mein.
2756: Pratyek marne waale ka amal mrityu ke baad band ho jaata hai. Haan, magar Allah ki raah mein pahredaari karne waale ki baat alag hai. Uska amal qayaamat ke din tak barhta rahta hai aur woh qabr ki pareeksha se surakshit rahta hai.

Fazaala bin ubaid, salmaan faarsi aur uqba bin aamir juhni- radiyallahu anhum- kahte hain ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Pratyek marne waale ka amal mrityu ke baad band ho jaata hai. Haan, magar Allah ki raah mein pahredaari karne waale ki baat alag hai. Uska amal qayaamat ke din tak barhta rahta hai aur woh qabr ki pareeksha se surakshit rahta hai."
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2758: “Jisne Hajj kiya tatha Hajj ke dinon mein buri baat evn bure kaaryon se bacha evn awajna se door raha, woh us din ki tarah lautega, jis din uski maan ne use janm diya tha.”

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki maiैnneे Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko yeh kahte hue suna hai : “Jisne Hajj kiya tatha Hajj ke dinon mein buri baat evn bure kaaryon se bacha evn awajna se door raha, woh us din ki tarah lautega, jis din uski maan ne use janm diya tha.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jis vyakti ne Allah ke liye Hajj kiya aur sanbhog tatha uski bhoomikaaon, jaise chunban aur nirvastr hokar shareer ke angon ko ek doosre ke saath milaana aadi se bacha  raha, gandi baaton se bacha aur gunaah ke kaamon se door raha, ehraam ki awastha mein jo bhi kaary karna warjit hain woh saare kaary phusooq arthaat gunaah ke kaary hain. Jo in kaaryon se bacha raha woh apne Hajj se is tarah gunaahon se paak-saaf hokar niklega, jis tarah bachcha gunaahon se paak-saaf paida hota hai.

Awajna aur gunaah ke kaam agarche har haalat mein mana hain, lekin Hajj ke dauraan Hajj ke kaaryon ke sammaan ke kaaran unki manaahi aur barh jaati hai.
Insaan jab paida hota hai, to uske sar par gunaahon ka bojh nahin hota, kyonki woh doosre ke gunaah ka bojh nahin uthaata.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2759: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Ham zihaad ko sabse uttam kaary samajhte hain, to kya ham jihaad na karen? Aapne uttar diya : "Nahin! Tumhaare liye sabse uttam jihaad woh Hajj hai, jo har gunaah se paak evn Allah ke nikat grahanyogy ho.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai ki unhonne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Ham zihaad ko sabse uttam kaary samajhte hain, to kya ham jihaad na karen? Aapne uttar diya : "Nahin! Tumhaare liye sabse uttam jihaad woh Hajj hai, jo har gunaah se paak evn Allah ke nikat grahanyogy ho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saathi Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karne aur dushmanon se larne ko sarvashreshth kaaryon mein se ek samajhte the. Atah aaisha radiyallahu anha ne jihaad mein shareek hone ki anumti maangi,

To aapne aurton ka maargadarshan ek aise amal ki or kiya, jo unke haq mein sabse achchha jihaad hai. Woh amal hai, pawitr Qur'an evn sunnat ke anuroop kiya gaya tatha gunaah evn riyaakaari se surakshit Hajj.

Jihaad purushon ke liye sarvashreshth kaaryon mein se ek hai.
Hajj mahilaaon ke liye jihaad se uttam hai. Hajj aurton ke liye sarvashreshth kaaryon mein se ek hai.
Kaaryon ki shreshthata mein kaary karne waalon ke anusaar bhinnata paai jaati hai.
Hajj ko Hajj isliye kaha gaya hai ki Hajj karne waale ko aatma se larna parta hai. Ismen dhan kharch hota hai aur shareerik bal ka prayog karna parta hai. Hajj bhi Allah ke maarg mein jihaad ki tarah shaareerik evn aarthik ibaadat hai.
2932: Ai abbaas, ai Allah ke Rasool ke chacha, Allah se duniya evn aakhirat mein aafiyat (salaamti) maangiye.

Abbaas bin abdul muttalib radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, mujhe koi aisi wastu sikhaaiye, jo main sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah se maangoon. Aapne farmaya : "Allah se aafiyat (salaamti) maangiye." Jab kuchh din beet gae, to phir main pahuncha aur kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, koi aisi wastu sikhaaiye, jo main Allah se maangoon. To farmaya : "Ai abbaas, ai Allah ke Rasool ke chacha, Allah se duniya evn aakhirat mein aafiyat (salaamti) maangiye."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke chacha abbaas bin abdul muttalib ne aapse koi aisi dua sikhaane ka aagrah kiya, jo woh Allah se maanga karen. To aapne sikhaya ki woh Allah se wipattiyon tatha deen, duniya aur aakhirat ki kamiyon se suraksha maanga karen. Abbaas radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki kuchh dinon baad woh dobaara upasthit hue aur koi aisi dua sikhaane ka anurodh kiya, jo Allah se maanga karen, to Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unse apnaapan dikhaate hue farmaya : Ai abbaas! Ai Allah ke Rasool ke chacha jaan! Allah se har buraai se chhutkaare, har achchhaai ki praapti aur duniya evn aakhirat ke fayde ke liye aafiyat maanga karen.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka abbaas radiyallahu anhu se dobaara sawaal karne par usi jawaab ko dohraana yeh saabit karta hai ki aafiyat sabse behatreen cheez hai, jo banda apne rab se maanga kare.
Aafiyat ki fazeelat aur is baat ka bayaan ki aafiyat duniya evn aakhirat ki tamaam bhalaaiyon ka srot hai.
Sahaaba adhik se adhik jnaan evn bhalaai praapt karne ke ichchhuk hua karte the.
[saheeh li-ghairihi (any sandon athva riwayton se milkar saheeh)]
[ise tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
2933: Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- masjid mein the ki ek musalmaan aapke paas aya aur bolaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Main vyabhichaar mein lipt ho gaya hoon.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain kih Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- masjid mein the ki ek musalmaan aapke paas aya aur bolaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Main vyabhichaar mein lipt ho gaya hoon. Uski baat sunkar aapne apna chehra pher liya. Lekin usne phir aapke saamne aakar kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Main vyabhichaar mein lipt ho gaya hoon. Aapne phir munh pher liya. Yahaan tak ki usne yahi baat aapke saamne chaar baar dohraai.
Jab usne chaar baar apne wiruddh gawaahi de di, to Allah ke Rasool ne use bulaakar poochhaah "Kya tu paagal hai?" Kahaah nahin. Farmayaah "Shaadeeshuda hai?" Kahaah haan. To Allah ke Rasool ne farmayaah "Ise le jaakar sangsaar kar do."
Ibne shihaab kahte hainh mujhe abu salma bin abdur rahmaan ne bataya ki unhonne jaabir bin abdullah ko kahte suna haih patthar maarne waalon mein main bhi shaamil tha. Hamne use eedgaah mein patthar maarna aaranbh kiya, jab use patthar ki khoob chot lagi, to woh bhaag khara hua. Fir hamne use harra mein pakarkar patthar maar-maarkar khatm kar diya).

Maaiz bin maalik aslami -Allah unse prasann ho- Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aakar apne hi wiprit zena karne ka saakshy diya -us samey aap masjid mein the-, to aap ne un se mukh mor liya, taaki woh waapas chale jayen, aur Allah se kshama yaachna kar len. Kintu woh apne oopar krodhit aur apne upar had qayem karke pawitr karne ke kathor wichaar ke saath aye the, is liye phir aap ke sammukh aakar dobaara iqraar kiya. To bhi Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne un se mukh mor liya, yahaan tak ki unhon ne apne wirodh chaar baar saakshy dekar zena ka iqraar kar liya, tab aap ne un se poochhaah kya tum paagal ho? Kahaah nahin. Unke ghar waalon so bhi unke dimaag ke baare mein poochha, to unhon ne achchha hi kaha. Phir poochhaah tum shaadi kar chuke ho ya nahin, kyonki gair shaadi shuda ko rajm nahin kiya jaata? Kahaah haan, shaadi kar chuka hun. Aap ne un se poochha, ki shayad unhonne had ko aniwaary karnewaala karm na kiya ho, arthaat kewal chhua ya chunban kiya ho, to unhon ne zena ki pushti kar di. Jab aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne in baaton ki pushti kar li aur had laagu karna aniwaary ho gaya, to sahaaba ko sangsaaाr karne ka aadesh diya. Chunaanche sahaaba unhen baqeeul-gharqad -masjid e nabli ke sameep sthit ek janaaza gaah ka naam- le gae, aur unhen patthar maarna aaranbh kar diya, jab patthar ki chot lagne lagi, to bhaagna chaaha, is liye ki manushy ise sah nahin sakta aur bhaag gae, lekin logon ne unhen pakar kar maar daala,Allah un par daya kare tatha un se prasann ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2934: Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne wishesh roop se taiyaar kiye gae ghoron ke beech (jinhen khoob khilaya jaata hai phir us ki khoraak kam kar di jaati hai taaki use shakti mile aur tez ho) hafya se saneeytul wada tak ghurdaur karaai.

Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam-ne yuddh ke liye wishesh roop se taiyaar kiye gae ghoron ke beech hafya se saneeytul wada tak ghurdaur karaai aur bina taiyaar kiye gae ghoron ke beech saneeya se banu zuraiq ki masjid tak ghurdaur karaai. Abdullah bin umar kahte hainh main bhi is ghurdaur mein bhaag lene waalon mein tha. Sufyaan kahte hainh hafya se saneeytul wada ki doori paanch ya chhah meel hai, jabki saneeya se banu zuraiq ki masjid ki doori ek meel hai.

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jihaad ke liye taiyaar rahte, uske maadhyamon tatha asbaab ko taiyaar rakhte the, Allah ke is qaul par amal karte hue kih (jitna ho sake, unke mukaable ke liye bhar poor taaqat aur ghore taiyaar karo, jis se tum Allah ke shatruon aur tumhaare shatruon ke dilon mein bhay paida kar do) isi kaaran aap ghoron ko khila pila kar shaktishaali banaate tatha sahaaba ko ghor sawaari ki shiksha ke liye, us par muqaabla karaate the, tatha taiyyaar shuda ghoron ki alag seemaaain aur dusre ghoron ki alag seemaaain hoti theen, taaki ghore shikshit hon aur sahaaba jihaad ki sthiti mein rahen. Isi kaaran taiyaar kiye gae ghoron ke beech chhe meel tatha saadhaaran ghoron ke beech ek meel tak ghor daur ki partiyogita karvaai. Abdullah bin umar is mein shaamil hone waale naujvaan sahaaba mein the.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2935: Jab tum mein se koi khaana kha chuke, to apna haath chaate athva chatvaye bina saaf kiye.
Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmayaah "Jab tum mein se koi khaana kha chuke, to apna haath chaate athva chatvaye bina saaf kiye."

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne khaane waale ko aadesh diya ki khaane ke pashchaat haath chaate athva chatvaye bina dhoe. Iska kaaran kai hadeeson mein hai ki use jnaan nahin hai ki kis khaane mein barkat hai. Isi kaaran Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ungliyon ko chaatne ka aadesh diya, hosakta hai barkat ungliyon mein lage khaane ke kisi ansh mein ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2936: Jab qayaamat ke din Allah pahle ke aur baad ke tamaam logon ko ekatr karega, to har wishvaasghaat karne waale ke liye ek-ek jhanda ooncha kiya jayega. Kaha jayega : Yeh amuk ke putr amuk ka wishvaasghaat hai.

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jab qayaamat ke din Allah pahle ke aur baad ke tamaam logon ko ekatr karega, to har wishvaasghaat karne waale ke liye ek-ek jhanda ooncha kiya jayega. Kaha jayega : Yeh amuk ke putr amuk ka wishvaasghaat hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki jab Allah qayaamat ke din hisaab ke liye agle tatha pichhle tamaam logon ko ekatr karega, to Allah khud apne saath ya logon ke saath kiye hue kisi waade ko poora na karne waale har wishvaasghaati ke liye ek-ek chihn bana dega, jisse uske wishvaasghaat par uski rusvaai ho sake. Us din uske khilaaph yeh pukaara jayega : Yeh amuk ke bete amuk ka wishvaasghaat hai. Aisa uske kukarmon se hashr ke maidaan mein ekatr tamaam logon avgat karne ke liye kiya jayega.

Wishvaasghaat karna haraam tatha kabeera gunaah hai. Kyonki is prakaar ke vyakti ko bari sakht chetaavni di gai hai.
Jis khayaanat se yahaan chetaya gaya hai, usmen har wo vyakti daakhil hai, jisne apne rakt, izzat-aabru, bhed ya dhan ke baare mein aapko ameen banaya aur aapne uske wishvaas ke wipreet kaam karte hue uske saath khayaanat kar daali.
Qurtubi kahte hain : Yeh baat Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne arbon ki pratha ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue kahi hai. Kyonki arab waada poora karne par safed jhanda ooncha karte the aur dhokha dene par kaala jhanda ooncha karte the, taaki log dhokha dene waale ki bhartsana tatha ninda karen. Atah is hadees mein bataya gaya hai ki dhokha dene waale ke saath aisa hi hoga, taaki hashr ke maidaan mein ekatr log uske is kukrity se bhali-bhaanti avgat ho jayen aur uski ninda karen.
Ibn-e-hajar karte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki qayaamat ke din logon ko unke pita ke naam ke saath pukaara jayega. Is hadees ke shabd hain : "Yeh amuk putr amuk ka wishvaasghaat hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2937: Umar bin khattaab- radiyallahu anhu- ne logon se, kisi atyaachaar ke nateeje mein garbhapaat ke baare mein paraamarsh kiya

Umar bin khattaab- radiyallahu anh- ne logon se, kisi atyaachaar ke nateeje mein garbhapaat ke baare mein paraamarsh kiya, to mugheera bin shoba ne kahaah mainne Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko is maamle mein, diyat ke taur par ek daas athva daasi dene ka nirnay karte dekha hai. Unki baat sunkar umar- radiyallahu anh- ne kaha ki koi gawaah laao, jo tumhaare saath gawaahi de, to Muhammad bin masalma ne unke saath gawaahi di.

Kisi mahila ne us par hue atyaachaar ke kaaran janm ke samay se purv hi apne bachche ko janm diya jis ki pet hi mein mrityu ho chuki thi . Hazrat umar -jo ek insaaph tatha nyay karne waale khaleefa the- sahaaba tatha buddhimaan ulma se samasyaaon tatha muddon ke baare paraamarsh kiya karte the. Jab is mahila ne mara hua bachcha janm diya, to uski diyat ka hukm un ki samajh mein na aya, chunaanche unhon ne sahaaba se paraamarsh kiya, to mugheera ne batayaah ki unhon ne aise hi ek maamle mein Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko ek daas athva daasi ko daasatv mukt karne ka nirnay karte hue dekha hai. Umar ne is hukm ko adhik sidhd karna chaaha, is liye ki yeh nirnay qayaamat tak ke liye widhi -qaanoon- banega, isi liye mugheera se kaha kih woh apne kathan ki sachchaai tatha hadees ki sateekta par saakshi le ayen. To Muhammad bin masalma ne unki baaton ki pushti ki.

2938: Saad bin ubaada ne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam-se poochha ki unki maan ne ek mannat maani thi, parantu use poora karne se pahle hi guzar gai. Ab unhen kya karna hai? Aapne farmayaah use tum poora kar do.

Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki saad bin ubaada ne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha ki unki maan ne ek mannat maani thi, parantu use poora karne se pahle hi guzar gai. Ab unhen kya karna hai? Aapne farmayaah use tum poora kar do.

Saad ki maata ki mrityu hui aur woh apni nazar poori nahin kar paaeen, to unke bete saad ne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam - se unki or se us nazar ko poora karne ki anumti maangi, to aap ne unhen anumti de di, aur farmayaah unki taraf se ada kar do.

2939: Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ek yaatra mein the ki aapke paas mushrikon ka ek jaasoos aya.

Salma bin akva- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ek yaatra mein the ki aapke paas mushrikon ka ek jaasoos aya. Usne sahaaba ke saath baithkar baat ki, phir bari tezi se nikal gaya. To Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Use dhoondhkar qatl kar do." Chunaanche, mainne use qatl kar diya, to usse chhina hua saamaan mujhe de diya.
Ek riwayat mein haih aapne farmaya ki is vyakti ko kisne maara? Logon ne kahaah akva ke bete ne. To aapne farmayaah "Isse chheena hua saara saamaan usi ka hai."

Is hadees mein musalmaanon ke wirudhd jaasoosi karne waale kaafiron ke baare Islam ka aadesh bataya gaya hai. Salmah bin akva kahte hain ki: ((Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas ek mushrik jaasoos aya)) jaasoos ko ain is liye kaha gaya hai kyonki uska kaam aankh se hi hota hai, athva is kaaran ki bahut adhik dekhne ki cheshta karta hai, goyaaki us ka saara jism hi aankh hai. Aur yeh ghatna safar ki haalat mein hui. Jaasoos aakar sahaaba ke saath baith kar baaten karke bari tezi se bhaag khara hua, to Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah use dhoondh kar katal kar do, to main ne use dhoondh kar qatal kiya. Atah aap ne mujhe nafal (ghaneemat ka ek wishesh ansh jo yoddha ko us ke hisse ke atirikt diya jaata hai) ke taur par diya. "سَلَبه" Arthaat uske kapre tatha hathyaar. Ise salab kaha gaya kyonki yeh chheena jaata hai. Salab mein jo kuchh bhi saamaan jaise aujaar, ya dhan daulat jaise maal, sona chaandi aadi maqtool ke saath hai , sab shaamil hai.

2940: Huzail ki do maheelaaain aapas mein lar pareen , to ek ne dusri ko patthar se maara , jis kaaran woh mar gai aur uske pet mein bachcha bhi mar gaya.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki huzail qabeele ki do striyaan aapas mein lar pareen aur unmen se ek ne doosre ko patthar maarkar, uski tatha uske garbh mein palne waale bachche ki hatya kar di. Phir we Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas nirnay ke liye pahunche, to Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne nirnay diya ki bachche ki diyat ke taur par ek daas athva daasi deni hai. Aapne yeh bhi nirnay diya ki hatya mein sanlipt mahila ki or se diyat uske rishte-naate waale ada karenge, jabki nihat mahila ke waaris uske bachche evn any uttaraadhikaari honge. Yeh sunkar hamal bin naabigha huzli khara hokar kahne lagaah ai Allah ke Rasool, main uska taawaan kaise bharoon, jis ne na khaya na piya, na bola na cheekha! To aapne uski tukbandi dekhkar farmayaah "Yeh to kaahinon ka bhaai lagta hai."

Huzail gotr ki do sauknon ne aapas mein jhagra kiya, to ek ne dusre ko ek chhote patthar se maar diya, jo prayah qatal nahin karta, kintu is se woh mar gai aur uske garbh ke bachche ki bhi maut ho gai. To, Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne nirnay diya ki bachche ki diyat daas athva daasi hogi, chaahe bhroon purush ho ya stri aur diyat qatl karne waali par hogi. Evn marne waali mahila ke liye diyat ka faisla kiya, is liye ki uska qatl shibhe amad (jaan boojh kar hatya karne jaisa) hai aur diyat katal karne waali mahila ke rishtedaaron par hogi, is liye ki aaqilah (jin rishtedaaron par diyat ada karne ki zimmewaari ho) ki bunyaad aapsi sahayta par hai (yaani rishtedaaron mein wahi diyat denge jo sahayta karne ki kshamta rakhte hon, isi liye bachche aur aurten aadi aaghilah mein shaamil nahin hain) aur is liye ki qatl bhool se hua hai. Aur choon ki diyat -khoon baha- maqtoolah ke baad bapauti hai.Atah uske larke tatha dusre waaris le lenge, rishtedaaron (aaqilah) ke liye kuchh nahin hoga. To hamal bin naabegha -katal karne waali ke pita ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, kyon ham par us bhroon ka jurmaana daala ja raha hai, jo mara hua paida hua hai, na khaya hai aur na hi piya hai aur na hi kuchh bola hai ki uske praan dhaaran ka jnaat ho? Yeh baat unhon ne bhaashan aur kaafiya bandi ke andaaj mein kahi. To Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko uski baat pasand na aai, kyonki usmen logon ke dhanon ko awaidh tareeke se khaane waale kaahinon ki baaton se milte julte andaaz mein sharai widhaan ka inkaar hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2941: Kya main tumhen sabse bare gunaahon ke baare mein na bataaoon?

Abu bakra radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, unhonne kaha :  Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farnaya : "Kya main tumhen sabse bare gunaahon ke baare mein na bataaoon?" Aapne yeh baat teen baar dohraai. Hamne kaha : Awashy, ai Allah ke Rasool! To aapne farmaya : "Allah ka saajhi banaana aur maata-pita ki baat na maanna." Yeh kahte samay aap tek lagaye hue the, lekin seedhe baith gae aur farmaya : "Sun lo, jhoothi baat kahna (bhi bara gunaah hai)." Yeh baat aap itni baar dohraate rahe ki hamne kaha ki kaash aap khaamosh ho jaate.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne saathiyon ke saamne sabse bare gunaahon ka warnan karte hue in teen gunaahon ka ullekh kiya :

1- Allah ka saajhi thahraana : Yaani koi bhi ibaadat 
Allah ke atirikt ke liye karna aur Allah ke atirikt ko Allah ki tarah poojy tatha rab banaana aur use Allah ke naam tatha gun de dena.

2- maata-pita ki awajna karna : Yaani maata-pita ko apni baat tatha kaary dvaara ya unke saath achchha vyavhaar na karke kisi bhi prakaar ka kasht dena.

3- jhooth bolna, jiska ek roop jhoothi gawaahi dena hai : Yaani har woh garhi hui aur jhoothi baat hai, jiska uddeshy kisi ka maal harapna ya kisi ka apmaan karna aadi ho.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne jhooth bolne se baar-baar saavdhaan yeh bataane ke liye kiya ki yeh ek buri cheez hai aur samaaj par iske bare bure prabhaav parte hain. Aapne jhooth bolne se itni baar saavdhaan kiya ki sahaaba ne aapki pareshaani ko dekhkar kaha ki kaash aap khaamosh ho jaate.

Sabse bara gunaah Allah ka saajhi thahraana hai, kyonki aapne iska warnan sabse pahle kiya hai, aur iski pushti is ayat se bhi hoti hai : "Nihsandeh, Allah yeh kshama nahin karega ki uska saajhi banaya jaye aur iske atirikt jiske liye jo chaahega kshama kar dega."
Maata-pita ke adhikaar ka mahatv, kyonki Allah ne unke adhikaar ko apne adhikaar ke saath milaakar bayaan kiya hai.
Gunaahon ke do prakaar hain. Kabeera (bare) gunaah aur sagheera (chhote) gunaah. Kabeera gunaah har woh gunaah hai, jiski koi duniyaawi saza nirdhaarit ho, jaise  hudood evn laanat aadi. Ya phir jispar koi aakhirat ki chetaavni di gai ho, jaise Jahannam mein prawesh karne ki chetaavni. Kabeera gunaah kai shreniyon ke hote hain, kuchh kabeera gunaah any kuchh ke muqaable mein adhik sakht haraam hote hain. Sagheera gunaah kabeera gunaahon ko chhor any gunaahon ko kahte hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2943: Ek bachchi ka sar do pattharon ke beech rakhkar kuchla hua paya gayaah

Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki ek bachchi ka sir do pattharon ke beech rakhkar kuchla hua paya gaya, to usse kaha gaya ki kisne tere saath aisa kiya hai? Kya amuk ne kiya hai? Kya amuk ne kiya hai? Yahaan tak ki jab ek yahoodi ka naam aya, to usne sir se ishaara kiya ki haan. Atah, us yahoodi ko pakar liya gaya aur usne jurm sveekaar bhi kar liya. Chunaanche Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne aadesh diya ki uske sir ko do pattharon ke beech rakhkar kuchal diya jaye.
Muslim tatha nasai mein hai kih ek yahoodi ne ek bachchi ki (athva ek daasi ki) hatya chaandi ke zevron ke kaaran kar di, jo woh pahni hui thi. Atah Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne us se kisaas lene ka aadesh diya).

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke zamaane mein ek bachchi mili, jiska sar do pathtaron ke beech kuchal diya gaya tha, kintu abhi saansen baaki theen, to logon ne us se hatyaare ke baare poochha aur jo hatyaara samjhe ja rahe the, unka naam lene lage yahaan tak ki ek yahoodi ka naam aya, to us ne sar se ishaara kiya ki haan, yahi. Atah yahoodi ko pakar liya gaya aur usne jurm sveekaar kar liya ki chaandi ke zewar ke kaaran use katal kiya hai. Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne aadesh diya ki us ke saath bhi wahi kiya jaye jo usne kiya hai, chunaanche uska sar bhi do pattharon ke beech kuchal diya gaya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2944: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne hamen saat baaton ka aadesh diya hai aur saat jeechon se roka hai

Bara bin aazib -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne hamen saat baaton ka aadesh diya hai aur saat jeechon se roka hai. Hamen aadesh diya hai: Rogi ka haal jaanne ke liye jaane ka, janaaza ke peechhe chalne ka, chheenkne waale ka uttar dena ka, qasam poori karne mein ya qasam khaane waale ki qasam poori karne mein sahyog karna ka, atyaachaar se peerit vyakti ki sahayta karne ka, nimantran dene waale ka nimantran sveekaar karne ka aur salaam ko aam karne ka. Tatha hamen roka hai sone ki angoothi se, chaandi ke bartan mein peene se, reshmi zeenposh (malmal ke bichhaune) ke istemaal aur misr ke qass naami gaanv ke bane hue reshmi wastr, saamaany reshmi wastr, mote reshmi wastr evn baareek reshmi wastr ke istemaal se.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne musalmaanon ko saat kaamon ka aadesh diya hai aur saat kaamon se roka hai. Aapne nimnalikhit  saat kaamon ka aadesh kiya hai : 1- beemaar vyakti ka haal-chaal jaanne ke liye jaana. 2- janaaze ke peechhe chalna, mayyit par namaaze janaaza parhne aur use dafan karne mein shaamil hona tatha uske liye dua karna. 3- jab koi vyakti chheenkne ke baad alhamdulillah kahe (yaani Allah ki prashansa kare), to uske liye yarahmukallah kahna chahiye (yaani uske liye rahmat ki dua karna chahiye). 4- qasam khaane waale ko apni qasam par qayam rahne mein madad karna. Yaani agar kisi ne koi kaam karne ki qasam khaai aur tum use apni qasam par qayam rahne mein madad kar sakte ho, to madad zaroor karo, taaki use qasam ka prayashchit na karna pare. 5- peerit ki madad karna. Yaani uske saath khare hona aur use jahaan tak ho sake, atyaachaar se bachaana. 6- koi nimantran, jaise waleeme ya aqeeqe aadi ka nimantran dene waale ka nimantran sveekaar karna. 7- salaam karne aur salaam ka uttar dene ka prachlan aam karna. Aapne jin kaaryon se mana kiya hai, wo is prakaar hain : 1- sone ki angothi ko pahanna tatha khud ko usse sajaana. 2- chaandi ke bartan mein kuchh peena. 3- ghore ki kaathi tatha oont ke kajaawe par rakhe hue resham ke gadde par baithna. 4- resham mishrit soot se bana hua kapra, jise arbi mein 'al-qasi' kaha jaata hai, pahanna. 5- resham pahanna. 6- istabraq yaani mota resham pahanna. 7- deebaaj pahanna, yeh resham ka sabse barhiya aur sabse keemti prakaar hai.

Ek Muslim ko doosre Muslim par praapt kuchh adhikaaron ka wivran.
Waastav mein, sabhi sharai aadesh aur nishedh purushon aur mahilaaon donon ke liye hain. Iske apvaad kewal wahi aadesh aur nishedh hain, jo wishesh roop se purushon ya mahilaaon ke liye aye hue hon.
Doosri hadeeson se yeh baat maaloom hoti hai ki janaaze ke saath mahilayen nahin chalengi.
Doosri hadeeson se yeh baat bhi maaloom hoti hai ki mahila ka sona aur resham pahanna jayaz hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2945: Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah tumhen is baat se rokta hai ki tum apne baap-daadaaon ki qasam khaao

Umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah tumhen is baat se rokta hai ki tum apne baap-daadaaon ki qasam khaao." Umar radiyallahu anhu kahte hain : Allah ki qasam, jis din se mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se yeh hadees suni hai, mainne kabhi baap-daadaaon ki qasam nahin khaai. Na jaan-boojhkar aur na kisi ki qasam naqal karte hue.

Allah ke Nabi salllalaahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki Allah taaala ne baap-daadaaon ki qasam khaane se mana kiya hai. Atah jise qasam khaani ho, woh Allah ki qasam khaye. Kisi aur ki nahin. Uske baad umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhu ne bataya ki jis din se unhonne Allah ke Rasool sallahu alaihi wa sallam ko baap-daadaaon ki qasam khaane se mana karte hue suna hai, unhonne baap-daadaaon ki qasam nahin khaai hai. Na jaan-boojhkar aur na kisi doosre ke dvaara ghairullah ki khaai gai qasam ko naqal karte hue.

Allah ke atirikt kisi aur ki qamas khaana haraam hai. Aapne yahaan baap-daadaaon ka ullekh isliye kiya hai ki ajnaanta kaal mein baap-daadaaon ki qasam khaana ek aam baat thi.
Arbi shabd "الحَلِف" Ka arth hai, kisi baat ki pushti ke liye Allah, uske naamon ya gunon ki qasam khaana.
Umar radiyallahu anhu ki yeh fazeelat ki woh Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke aadeshon ka awilanb paalan karte the, shareeyat ke rahasyon ko khoob samajhte the aur dharmaprayanta ka atuly the.

2946: Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas ek vyakti ko laya gaya, jisne sharaab pi rakhi thi. Aapne use ek khajoor ki shaakh se lagbhag chaalees kore lagvaye.

Anas bin maalik - radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas ek vyakti ko laya gaya, jisne sharaab pi rakhi thi.Aapne use ek khajoor ki shaakh se lagbhag chaalees kore lagvaye).

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke yug mein ek vyakti ne madira paan kiya, to aap ne unhen khajoor ki tahni se chaalis kore lagaye. Abu bakar ne bhi apni khilaaphat mein chaalis kore lagaye, lekin jab umar ki khilaaphat aai aur wijay adhik hone lage tatha Muslim gair muslimon se mishrit hone lage, to madira ka prayog adhik hone laga. Atah umar ne sahaaba ke jnaani ulma se unhen madira se rokne waali had ke sanbandh mein paraamarsh kiya , to abdur rahmaan bin auf ne kahaah sab se kam had yaani assi kar den, jo jhoothe aarop ki had hai. Chunaanche umar ne assi kore tai kar diye. Koron ki sankhya mein jo wriddhi ki gai woh adab sikhaane ke taur par hai (sharai had se kam) jo imaam ke nirnay par nirbhar hogi.

2947: Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallm- ne teen dirham keemat waali dhaal chori karne ke jurm mein haath kaata.
Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallm- ne teen dirham keemat waali dhaal chori karne ke jurm mein haath kaata.

Allah ne musalmaanon ke lahu unki izzat aur dhan ki raksha pratyek un maadhyamon se ki hai, jo upadrawi ko rok sake. Isi kaaran us ne chor -jo chhipa kar hifaazat se rakhe hue dhan churaye- ka dand rakha hai ki uska woh ang kaat liya jaye, jis se us ne chori ki, taaki yeh uske paap ka kaffaara ho aur sawany woh tatha doosre log bhi galat tareeqon se baaz a jayen aur uchit evn waidh tareeke se kamayen. To kaam bhi adhik hoga tatha laabh bhi adhik hoga, is tarah duniya bhi aabaad hogi aur log bhi sammaanit honge.
Allah ki hikmat hai ki us ne chori ke kaaran haath kaate jaane ka nisaab teen dirham arthaat sone ke ek deenaar ka chaturthaansh rakha hai, taaki musalmaanon ke maal aur unka jeewan surakshit rahe aur shaanti qayam rahe aur log apne dhanon ko kamaane tatha barhaane mein istemaal karen.
Yeh ek graam aur ek graam ke solahven hisse (1.0625) ke samaan hai, kyonki ek deenaar 4.25 graam ka hota hai.
