2948: Yahoodiyon ne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aakar kaha ki unmen se ek purush evn ek stri ne vyabhichaar kiya hai.

Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki yahoodiyon ne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aakar kaha ki unmen se ek purush evn ek stri ne vyabhichaar kiya hai. Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unse kaha ki tum tauraat mein sangsaar ke baare mein kya likha paate ho? Unhonne kahaah ham aise logon ko apmaanit karte hain aur kore lagaate hain. Unki baat sunkar abdullah bin salaam ne kahaah tum jhooth bolte ho. Usmen sangsaar ka aadesh maujood hai. Atah, we tauraat le aye aur use kholkar rakh diya. Phir unmen se ek vyakti ne sangsaar ki ayat par apna haath rakhkar aage-peechhe ki ayten parhkar suna diya. Yeh dekh, abdullah bin salaam ne kahaah apna haath uthaao. Usne haath uthaya, to sangsaar ki ayat maujood thi. Ab usne kahaah ai Muhammad, abdullah bin salaam ki baat sahi hai. Atah, Nabi- sallallahu alaihi sallam- ne un donon ko sangsaar karne ka aadesh diya aur unhen sangsaar kar diya gaya. Warnankarta kahte hain ki mainne dekha ki woh vyakti us stri par gir-girkar use patthar se bacha raha tha.

Ek baar Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke zamaane mein ek yahoodi mard aur mahila ne (zina) awaidh sanbhog kiya, to woh log aap ke paas nirnay ke liye aye, is soch ke saath ki ho sakta hai aap ki yahaan tauraat ke wipreet koi aasaan aadesh mil jaye. Atah Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne un se tauraat mein maujood hukm ke baare poochha, taaki unhen rusva kiya jaye, na ki us par amal kiya jaye, to un logon ne aap ko jhuthlaya aur kahaah hamaare yahaan donon ka apmaan kiya jaata hai, to abdullah bin salaam ne unhen jhuthlaya aur jab tauraat kholi gai, to shaadi shuda zaani ka hu्kam sangsaar paya gaya, phir Nabi sallallahu alai wa sallam ke aadesh anusaar unhen sangsaar kar diya gaya. Hamaari shareeyat doosri shariaton par haakim tatha use nirast karti hai, lekin Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne tauraat mein rajm ke baare poochha, taaki un ki hi pustak se un par daleel qayam karen aur yeh batayen ki Allah ki saari pustaken is sadaiv rahne waale aadesh par ekmat hain, jis ke maadhyam se upadrav machaane waalon ko roka jaata hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2949: Ek aurat Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke zamaane mein hone waale kisi yuddh mein nihat paai gai, to Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aurton evn bachchon ki hatya ka khandan kiya.

Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ek aurat Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke zamaane mein hone waale kisi yuddh mein nihat paai gai, to Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aurton evn bachchon ki hatya ka khandan kiya.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kisi yuddh mein ek nihat aurat ko dekha, to aurton aur chhote bachchon ki hatya ka khandan kiya.

Yuddh mein shaamil na hone waale log, jaise aurton, bachchon aur shareeyat ki nazar mein unke jaise doosre logon,jaise boorhon aur duniya se kate hue logon ko qatl nahin kiya jayega, jab tak ye log musalmaanon se jang mein apni ray ya kisi aur tareeqe se madad na karte hon. Agar madad karte hon, to unko bhi qatl kiya jayega.
Aurton aur bachchon ki hatya ki manaahi, kyonki ye log musalmaanon se yuddh nahin karte. Daraasal Allah ki raah mein yuddh ka uddeshy yuddharat logon ke dabadbe ko torna hai, taaki Islam ki aawaaz tamaam logon tak pahunch sake.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki daya ki jhalkiyaan yuddh mein bhi dekhne ko milti hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2950: Koi apne bhaai ko aise daant se kaatta hai, jaise saanr kaatta hai. Tere liye koi diyat nahin hai.

Imraan bin husain- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki ek aadmi ne daant se ek aadmi ka haath kaat liya. Usne apna haath kaatne waale ke munh se kheencha, to uske saamne ke daant gir gae. Aise mein, donon Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas nirnay ke liye aye. Aapne farmayaah "Koi apne bhaai ko aise daant se kaatta hai, jaise saanr kaatta hai. Tujhe koi diyat nahin milegi."

Ek aadmi ne doosre aadmi par atyaachaar karte hue uska haath daanton se kaat liya, jab us ne haath kaatne waale ke mukh se jor se haath nikaala to uske saamne ke do daant gir gae, chunaanche donon maamla lekar Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aye. Kaatne waala apne gire hue donon daanton ka qisaas maang raha tha aur dusra vyakti bachaav karte hue kah raha tha ki woh apna haath bachaana chaahta tha. Atah Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kaatne waale ko daantte hue farmayaah kaise koi woh kaary karta hai, jo kaary bare bhaari bharkam jaanvar karte hain? Aur farmayaah tum mein se kuchh log apne bhaai ka haath chiba jaate hain phir jurm karne waale daanton ki diyat maangne aate hain? Tumhaari koi diyat nahin, kyonki aaranbh karne waala hi atyaachaari hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2951: Allah ke Rasool- sallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne sone ki ek angoothi banvaai.

Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne sone ki ek angoothi banvaai. Jab use pahante, to uske nageene ko hatheli ke bheetri bhaag mein rakhte. Logon ne bhi aisa karna shuru kar diya. Phir ek din aap minbar par baithe aur use nikaalte hue kahaah "Main is angoothi ko pahanta tha aur iske nageene ko andar ki or rakhta tha." Phir use phenkte hue pharmayaah "Allah ki qasam, main ise kabhi nahin pahnoonga." Atah, logon ne bhi apni angoothiyaan phenk deen.
Ek riwayat mein hai kih use apne daahine haath mein pahne the.

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne aadesh diya ki aap ke liye sone ki ek angoothi banaai jaye. Jab aap use pahante the, to uska nageena daahini hatheli ke bheetar kar lete. Sahaaba ne bhi aap ki tarah angoothiyaan banva leen. Kuchh dinon ke pashchaat Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- minbar par baithe, taaki log aap ko dekh saken. Uske baad farmayaah main yeh angoothi pahanta tha aur uska nageena bheetar ki or rakha tha. Yeh pharmaakar -use phenk diya aur farmayaah Allah ki saugandh! Kadaapi main use nahin pahnoonga. Aisa aap ne angoothi ke haraam hone ke baad kiya, to sahaaba ne bhi Allah ke Rasool ka anusran karte hue apni angoothiyaan phenk deen.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2952: Har woh pey padaarth haraam hai, jismen nasha ho.
Aysha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam-se madhu ki nabeez ke baare poochha gaya, to farmayaah "Har woh pey padaarth haraam hai, jismen nasha ho."

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se bita (بتْع) -madhu ki nabeez- peene ke baare poochha gaya, to aap ne ek saadhaaran jawaab diya, jiska abhipray yeh hai ki naamon ke bhinnata ka koi aitbaar nahin, yadi haqeekat ek ho.
Pratyek woh dravy, jo nasheela ho, woh madira hai tatha haraam hai, chaahe kisi prakaar ka ho. Yeh aap ka jaame (arthaat wishay ke saare pahluोn ko shaamil) tatha apne rab ki shareeyat ke warnan ka achchha andaaz hai, isi kaaran aapki paigambari ki avdhi mein itna jnaan aya hai, jis se lok tatha pralok mein maanavta ko saubhaagy praapt ho sakta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2953: Logo, dushman se muthbher ki kaamna na karo, balki Allah se aafiyat (salaamti) talab karo

Abdullah bin abu aufa- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool-sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ek yuddh mein, jismen shatru ka saamna tha, prateeksha mein rahe, yahaan tak ki jab soory dhal gaya, to apne saathiyon ke beech khare hue aur kahaah "Logo, dushman se muthbher ki kaamna na karo, balki Allah se aafiyat talab karo. Parantu jab muthbher ho jaye, to datkar muqaabla karo aur jaan lo ki Jannat talvaaron ki chhaanv mein hai." Phir yeh dua farmaaeeh "Ai Allah, kitaab utaarne waale, baadlon ko chalaane waale aur girohon ko paraajit karne waale, inhen paraajay ka munh dikha aur hamen inpar wijay pradaan kar."

Abdullah bin abi aufa -Allah un se prasann ho- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ek jang mein suraj dhalne tak pratiksha karne ke baad logon ke samaksh khare hue -aur aam aadat ke anusaar zuhar ki namaz ke baad hi khare hue honge- to unhen shatruon se jang ki kaamna karne se manaahi ki, kyonki is mein abhimaan hai aur Allah se aafiyat (salaamti) maangne ka aadesh diya. Phir farmayaah yadi tumhaari shatruon se jang ho jaye, to date raho, adheer na bano aur yaqeen karlo ki do uttam wastuon mein se ek awashy milegi, Allah tumhaari shatru ke khilaaf sahayta karega aur tumhaari jeet hogi, tatha duniya mein dushamnon par jeet aur pralay mein neki donon se Allah tumhen sammaanit karega athva jihaat ke dauraan apni kshamta ka poorn istemaal ke baavjood tum haaroge, to tumhen aakhirat ka sawaab milega. Aap ka yeh kahna ki Jannat talvaaron ki chhaya mein hai, iska abhipray yeh hai ki jihaad Jannat ka raasta hai. Uske baad Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne rab se uski utaari hui shareeyat aur poorn kshamta ke waseele se praarthana ki ki woh musalmaanon ki shatruon par sahayta kare aur Allah hi saamarthy dene waala hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2954: Sharaab haraam ki gai, woh paanch wastuon se banti theeh angoor, khajoor, madhu, gehoon aur jau se.

Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma kahte hain ki umar- radiyallahu anhu- ne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke minbar par khare hokar kahaah ai logo, sharaab haraam ki gai hai, woh paanch wastuon se banti haih angoor, khajoor, madhu, gehoon aur jau se. Sharaab woh hai, jo aql ko dhaanp le. Teen masle aise hain, jinke baare mein main chaahta tha ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hamen koi spasht nirdesh dekar jaate; daada ki meeraas ka masla. Aise vyakti ki meeraas ka masla jiski na santaan athva pota ho na baap-daada tatha sood se sanbandhit kuchh baaten).

Umar bin khattaab ne masjide nabvi mein khutba dete huai farmaya ki madira woh hai jo matvaala kar de, madira angoor ke saath khaas nahin hai, balki khajoor, madhu athva genhoon se bana hua dravy bhi madira hai. Umar -Allah unse prasann ho- ne bayaan kiya ki teen wishay mein kuchh samasya hoti hai, kaash Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ummat ke liye unhen wistaar se bayaan kar diya hotaah daada ki bapauti, pratyek us vyakti ki wiraasat, jiska koi larka na ho aur na uska pita ho, aur sood ke kuchh wishay. Allah ki prashansa hai ki in teenon masaail ka hukm jnaat hai. Iska abhipray yeh nahin ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne nahin bataya hai, aap ne to sampoorn tareeqe se sandesh pahuncha diya hai, amaanat ada kar di hai tatha Allah ki or se pratyek chhoti se chhoti wastu pahuncha di hai. Lekin umar -Allah un se prasann ho- chaahte the ki koi aisi spasht baat hoti, jismen ijtehaad ka koi ihtemaal (gunjaaish) na hota.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2955: Ek makhzoomi stri ka maamla kuraish ki chinta ka kaaran bana, jisne chori ki thi.

Aysha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki kuraish ko ek makhzoomi stri ke maamle ne chintit kiya, jisne chori ki thi. Unhonne kaha ki iske baare mein kaun Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se baat kar sakta hai? Phir unhonne kaha ki is kaary ki jurrat Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke priy usaama bin zaid (radiyallahu anhuma) ke siwa koi nahin kar sakta. Anttah usaama ne aapse baat ki, to aap ne farmayaah "Kya tum Allah ki or se ek nirdhaarit dand ke baare mein sifaarish karne aye ho?" Phir khare hue aur khutba dete hue farmayaah "Tumse pahle ke logon ka winaash kewal is baat ne kiya ki jab unmen se koi pratishthit vyakti chori karta, to chhor dete aur jab koi ashay vyakti chori karta, to use dand dete. Allah ki qasam, agar Muhammad ki beti faatima bhi chori karti, to main uska bhi haath kaatta."
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih ek aurat saamaan maangkar leti aur dene se inkaar kar deti thi. Athah, Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne uska haath kaatne ka aadesh diya.

Ek makhzoomi mahila logon se unke saamaan bahaana banaakar leti thi, phir inkaar kar jaati. Ek baar us ne ek zewar liya aur inkaar kar diya, lekin khoj ke baad usi ke paas paya gaya aur yeh baat Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko pahunchi, to aapne had laagu karne ka pukhta iraada kar liya. Woh mahila shareef gharaane ki thi, is liye quraish ko uski aur us par laagu hone waali had ki chinta sataane lagi aur soch wichaar mein lag gae ki kaun Allah ke Nabi se ise kshama kar dene ke maamle mein baat karega, to unhen Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke pyaare usaama bin zaid ke siwa koi nahin dikha, chunaanche usaam ne aap se baat ki, to aap ghusse ke maare laal ho gae aur famayaah kya tum Allah ki seema ke baare anushansa karne aye ho))? Phir aap ne logon ko seemaaon ko naakaarah karne waale anushansa ki sangeeni samjhaai aur kyonki yeh maamla un mein se bahut se logon ke liye mahatvapoorn tha , is liye unhen bataya ki pahle ke logon ka deen tatha duniya ke maamle mein winaash hua, kyonki woh log kamzoron par nirdisht dand laagu karte aur taaqtavron tatha dhani ko chhor dete the, jis kaaran upadrav aur ashaasan phail jaata tha, to un par Allah ka krodh utarta tha. Phir aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne qasam khaai -jabki aap to sachche hain hi- aur farmayaah yadi saari duniya ki mahilaaon ki sardaar aap ki beti faatima bhi aisa karm karti, to aap us par bhi Allah ka aadesh laagu karke rahte.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2956: Mainne Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aakar kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, ham ahle kitaab ki dharti mein rahte hain, kya ham unke baratnon mein kha sakte hain?

Abu saalba khushni (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aakar kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, ham ahle kitaab ki dharti mein rahte hain, kya ham unke baratnon mein kha sakte hain? Tatha ham shikaar waale kshetr mein rahte hain aur main apne teer tatha sadhaye hue evn bina sadhaye hue kutte se shikaar karta hoon. Ismen se kaun-sa mere liye uchit hai? Aapne farmayaah jahaan tak ahle kitaab ke baratnon ki baat hai, yadi tumhen doosre bartan mil saken, to unmen na khaao, aur yadi na mil saken, to unhen dhokar kha liya karo. Aur jiska shikaar teer athva sadhaye hue kutte se karo aur uspar Allah ka naam le liya ho, use khaao aur jiska shikaar bina sadhaye hue kutte se karo tatha zibah karne ka avsar mil jaye, use bhi khaao.

Abu saalba khushni -Allah unse prasann ho- ne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko bataya ki we ahle kitaab -yahoodiyon tatha isaaiyon- ke paros mein rahte hain, to kya unke liye ahle kitaab ke baratnon mein khaana-khaana jayaz hoga, jabki is baat ki sanbhaavna rahti hai ki unke bartan naapaak hon? To aapne unke baratnon mein do sharton ke saath khaane ki anumti pradaan ki :
1- koi doosra bartan na mil sake.
2- use dhone ke baad upyog mein laya jaye.
Unhonne yeh bhi bataya ki we shikaar ke ilaaqe mein rahte hain, aur teer tatha prashikshit evn aprashikshit kutton ke maadhyam se shikaar karte hain. Aise mein inmen se kaun-sa shikaar unke liye halaal hai? Uttar mein aapne bataya ki teer ke zariye kiya hua shikaar, yadi use chalaate samay Allah ka naam le liya gaya ho, to halaal hai. Rahi baat kutte ki, to kutta yadi sadhaya hua ho aur use dauraate samay Allah ka naam liya gaya ho, to uska kiya hua shikaar halaal hai. Lekin, agar sadhaya hua na ho, to uska kiya hua shikaar halaal nahin hai. Haan, yadi shikaar jeewit mil jaye aur use sharai tareeqe se zabah kar liya jaye, to use khaya ja sakta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2957: Allah ne uski raah mein jihaad karne waale ki zimmewaari li hai ki yadi woh mar gaya, to use Jannat mein daakhil karega ya phir puny athva ghaneemat ke dhan ke saath surakshit waapas layega.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Allah ne us vyakti ki zimmewaari li hai, jo uske raaste mein jihaad ki liye nikla. Allah kahta hai ki yadi use mere raaste mein jihaad, mujhpar eemaan tatha mere Rasool ki pushti ki bhaavna hi ne nikaala, to meri zimmewaari hai ki main use Jannat mein daakhil karoon athva neki ya ghaneemat ke saath, jo use praapt hogi, ghar waapas le aaoon."
Tatha Muslim ki riwayat mein haih "Allah ke raaste mein jihaad karne waale ki misaal, (aur Allah achchhi tarah jaanta hai ki kaun uski raah mein jihaad karta hai) lagaataar roza rakhne waale aur namaz parhne waale ki tarah hai. Allah ne uski raah mein jihaad karne waale ki zimmewaari li hai ki yadi woh mar gaya, to use Jannat mein daakhil karega ya phir puny athva ghaneemat ke dhan ke saath surakshit waapas layega."

Is hadees mein Allah ki or se teen cheezon ki zamaanat hai, us ke liye jo nishthaapoorn eemaan ke saath Allah ke raaste mein jihaad ke liye nikla ho. Yadi shaheed ho jaye, to Jannat mein prawesh karega. Yadi jeewit raha, to neki athva maale ganeemat ke sang waapas hoga, arthaat bina ganeemat sirf neki ke saath ya neki aur ganeemat donon ke saath.
Jahaan tak doosri riwayat ki baat hai, jise umda ke lekhak ne Muslim ki taraf mansoob kiya hai, haalaanki woh bukhaari mein bhi hai, us mein hai ki Allah ke raaste mein jihaad ki shreshthata us vyakti ki tarah hai, jo masjid mein daakhil hokar sada namaz parhta rahta ho, athva rozedaar jo hamesha roza rakhta ho, aur aisa karna manushy ke bas se baahar hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne tamaam riwayton ke saath naqal kiya hai.]
2958: Hamne marruz zahraan mein ek khargosh ka peechha kiya. Bhi log uske peechhe daure, lekin thak gae.

Anas (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki hamne marruz zahraan mein ek khargosh ka peechha kiya. Aur log bhi uske peechhe daure, lekin thak gae. Albatta, mainne pakar liya. Use lekar abu talha ke paas aya, to unhonne zibah kiya aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko uska nitanb evn donon raan bhej diye. Aapne use grahan kar liya.

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aur aapke sahaaba ek yaatra mein the. Is dauraan shayad marruz zahraan naami ek sthaan mein ruke. Yeh wahi sthaan hai, jahaan Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apne saathiyon ke saath makka wijay ke saal ruke the. Isi beech unhonne ek khargosh ka peechha kiya. Bari sankhya mein log uske peechhe daure, lekin thak haarkar waapas ho gae. Anas bin maalik -Allah unse prasann ho-, jinhonne un dinon yauwan ki dahleez mein qadam rakha hi tha, ne use pakar liya aur apni maata ke pati abu talha -Allah unse prasannan ho- ke paas le gae. Chunaanche, unhonne use zabah karke Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko donon raan tatha koolha bheja, to aapne use sveekar kar liya aur shayad khaya bhi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2959: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apne kamre ke dvaar par jhagarne waalon ki aawaaz suni

Umme salma (radiyallahu anha) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apne kamre ke dvaar par kuchh jhagarne waalon ki aawaaz suni, to nikalkar unke paas aye aur farmayaah "Suno, main bhi ek insaan hoon. Mere paas jhagarne waale aate hain. Sanbhav hai ki tum mein se koi doosre ke muqaable apni baat adhik safaai se rakhta ho aur use sachcha samajhkar main uske haq mein faisla kar doon. Atah, jise mainne kisi musalmaan ka haq de diya, woh daraasal ek aag ka tukra hai. Chaahe to use utha le ya chaahe to chhor de."

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne kamre ke dvaar par kuchh logon ka shor aur kolaahal suna, jo aapas mein jhagar rahe the. Atah jhagre ka niptaara karne ke liye baahar aye aur farmaya : Dekho, main bhi tumhaari hi tarah ek insaan hoon. Na to mujhe paroksh ka jnaan hai aur na mujhe gupt baaten bataai jaati hain ki jaan sakoon ki kaun sachcha hai aur kaun jhootha. Mere paas log, apne jhagron ke niptaare ke liye aate hain aur mera faisla donon pakshon ke pramaanon aur qasmon par aadhaarit hota hai. Aise mein sanbhav hai ki tummen se koi any ki tulna mein spashtata se baat rakhne ki kshamta adhik rakhta ho aur main use sachcha samajhkar usi ke haq mein nirnay kar doon, jabki waastawik maamla kuchh aur ho. Atah, jaan lo ki mera nirnay kewal zaahiri maamlon mein hota hai, baatini maamlon mein nahin aur mera faisla kadaapi kisi haraam ko halaal nahin karta. Isliye, jise main kisi doosre ka adhikaar de doon aur use pata ho ki woh uska adhikaar nahin hai, to use main aag ka ek tukra nikaalkar de raha hoon. Ab yadi chaahe, to use la jaye aur chaahe to chhor de. Yaani kisi ka adhikaar harapne ka anjaam svayn harne waale ko bhugatna parega aur Allah atyaachaariyon ke ghaat mein hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2960: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne mannat maanne se mana kiya hai aur kaha hai : "Mannat koi bhalaai nahin laati. Iske dvaara kewal kanjoos ka dhan nikaala jaata hai.

Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne mannat maanne se mana kiya hai aur kaha hai : "Mannat koi bhalaai nahin laati. Iske dvaara kewal kanjoos ka dhan nikaala jaata hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne mannat maanne se mana kiya hai. Mannat yeh hai ki insaan apne oopar aisi koi cheez waajib kar le, jise Allah ne uspar waajib na kiya ho. Aapne aage farmaya ki mannat na kisi cheez ko aage karti hai, na peechhe. Uske dvaara to kewal kanjoos vyakti se, jo bas aniwaary kaary hi par kharch karta ho, kuchh bhalaai nikaali jaati hai. Mannat koi aisi cheez nahin laati, jo taqdeer mein na likhi ho.

Mannat maanna shareeyat sammat nahin hai. Lekin jab koi vyakti mannat maan le aur usmen koi gunaah na paya jaye, to use poora uspar karna waajib hoga.
Mannat maanne se manaahi ka kaaran yeh bataya gaya hai ki mannat koi bhalaai nahin laati. Yaani Allah ke kisi nirnay ko badalti nahin hai. Saath hi yeh ki mannat maanne waala yeh na samjhe ki uski muraad mannat ke kaaran hi poori hui, jabki Allah isse nisprih hai.
Qurtubi kahte hain : Aisa karna us samay mana hai jab koi vyakti kahe : Agar Allah ne mere rogi ko svasth kar diya, to main itna sadqa karoonga. Iske naapsandeeda hone ka kaaran yeh hai ki kisi neki ke kaam ko kisi uddeshy ki poorti ke saath jorna yeh darshaata hai ki neki ke kaary ka uddeshy wishuddh roop se Allah ki prasannata ki praapti nahin hai. Yahaan maamla muaavze ka ho jaata hai. Maamla aur adhik spasht isse ho jaata hai ki yadi rogi svasth nahin hua, to sadqa bhi nahin kiya jayega. Zaahir si baat hai ki yeh rawaiya kanjoos vyakti ka hua karta hai, jo apna dhan usi samay kharch karta hai, jab use uske badle mein kuchh mile, jo aam taur par kharch kiye hue dhan se adhik hua karta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2961: Jahaan tak meri baat hai, to Allah ki qasam, agar Allah ne chaaha, to jab bhi main kisi baat ki qasam khaaoonga aur doosri baat ko usse behtar dekhoonga, to apni qasam ka kaffaara ada kar doonga aur wahi karoonga, jo behtar ho.

Abu moosa ashaari radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Main Allah ke Rasool salllahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas ashaar qabeele ke kuchh logon ke saath pahuncha. Mainne aapse sawaari maangi, to aapne kaha : "Allah ki qasam, main tumhen sawaari nahin de sakta aur na mere paas koi sawaari hai, jo tumhen de sakoon." Phir ham wahaan jitni der Allah ne chaaha, utni der ruke. Isi beech aapke paas kuchh oont a gae, to aapne hamen teen oont dene ka aadesh diya. Jab ham chal pare, to hamaare beech ke kuchh logon ne any logon se kaha : Allah hamaare liye barkat na de. Hamne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aakar sawaari maangi aur aapne qasam khaakar bataya ki hamen sawaari de nahin sakenge aur phir de di. Abu moosa kahte hain : Chunaanche ham Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aye aur aapke saamne iska zikr kiya, to aapne kaha : "Sawaari mainne tumhen nahin di hai. Sawaari to tumhen Allah ne di hai. Jahaan tak meri baat hai, to Allah ki qasam, agar Allah ne chaaha, to jab bhi main kisi baat ki qasam khaaoonga aur doosri baat ko usse behtar dekhoonga, to apni qasam ka kaffaara ada kar doonga aur wahi karoonga, jo behtar ho."

Abu moosa ashaari radiyallahu anhu bata rahe hain ki woh Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aye. Unke saath unke qabeele ke kuchh aur log bhi maujood the. Uddeshy yeh tha ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam unhen sawaari ke liye kuchh oont den, taaki we jihaad mein shareek ho saken. Lekin Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne qasam khaakar bata diya ki aap unhen sawaari nahin de sakte. Aapke paas unhen dene ke liye sawaari ki vyawastha nahin hai. Atah waapas ho gae. Kuchh samay ruke. Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas teen oont aye, to unki or bhej diye. Yeh dekh ashaar qabeele ke un logon ne ek-doosre se kaha : Allah hamaare liye in oonton mein barkat na de. Kyonki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne hamen sawaari na dene ki qasam kha li thi. Atah woh aapke paas aye aur poochha, to aapne kaha : Tumhen sawaari to daraasal Allah ne di hai. Kyonki prabandh usi ne kiya hai aur suyog usi ne pradaan kiya hai. Main to bas ek maadhyam hoon ki yeh kaam mere dvaara sanpann hua. Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aage farmaya : Jahaan tak meri baat hai, to Allah ki qasam, jab bhi main kisi kaam ke karne ya na karne ki qasam khaaoonga aur baad mein dekhoonga ki mainne jis kaam ke karne ya na karne ki qasam khaai thi, usse behtar kaam doosra hai, to qasam khaye hue kaam ko chhorkar doosra kaam, jo behtar hai, use karoonga aur apni qasam ka kaffaara de doonga.

Kisi soochna ki pushti ke liye, chaahe woh bhawishy kaal se juri hui hi kyon na ho, qasam ke mutaalbe ke bina bhi qasam khaana jayaz hai.
Qasam khaane ke baad "Agar Allah ne chaaha" Kahkar kuchh cheezon ko qasam ke dayre se baahar rakhna jayaz hai. Kuchh cheezon ko alag karne ka yeh kaam agar qasam ke saath hi kar diya jaye, to woh cheezen qasam ke dayre ke andar nahin ayengi.
Is baat ki prerna ki jab koi vyakti kisi cheez ki qasam kha le aur uske baad doosri cheez ko usse uttam dekhe, to apni qasam tor de aur qasam ka kaffaara ada kare.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2962: Qayaamat ke din logon ke beech sabse pahle rakt ke baare mein nirnay kiya jayega.

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Qayaamat ke din logon ke beech sabse pahle rakt ke baare mein nirnay kiya jayega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki qayaamat ke din logon ke ek-doosre par atyaachaar karne se sanbandhit jis cheez ke baare mein sabse pahle nirnay liya jayega, woh rakt ka wishay hai. Jaise qatl karna aur zakhmi karna.

Rakt ke wishay ka mahatv. Kyonki aaranbh mahatvapoorn cheezon se kiya jaata hai.
Paap unke dvaara hui haani aur bigaar ki mahaanta ke anusaar bare ho jaate hain. Aur yeh bataane ki zaroorat nahin hai ki kisi begunaah insaan ki hatya karna ek bahut bari haani aur bigaar hai. Aur isse bara bigaar  Allah ke prati awishvaas aur uska saajhi thahraane ke siwa aur kuchh nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2963: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne najd ki or ek sainyadal bheja. Usmen abdullah bin umar bhi shaamil the.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne najd ki or ek sainyadal bheja. Usmen main bhi shaamil tha. Hamen oont aur bakriyaan praapt hueen. Hamaare hisse mein baarah-baarah oont aye tatha Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen ek-ek oont adhik diya.

Abdullah bin umar -Allah unse prasann ho- bata rahe hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unhen najd ki or ek yuddh mein bheja aur unhonne oont tatha bakriyon ke roop mein bahut-se ghaneemat ke dhan praapt kiye.Atah, pratyek vyakti ko baarah-baarah oont mile aur aapne har vyakti ko uske hisse ke atirikt ek-ek oont adhik diya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2964: Chor ka haath ek chauthaai deenaar ya usse adhik mein  kaata jayega.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Chor ka haath ek chauthaai deenaar ya usse adhik mein  kaata jayega."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki chor ka haath ek chauthaai deenaar ya usse adhik sona churaane par kaata jayega. Ek chauthaai deenaar ki qeemat 1.06 graam sone ke baraabar hoti hai.

Chori karna kabeera gunaah hai.
Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne chori karne ka dand nirdhaarit kar diya hai. Chori karne ka dand yeh hai ki chor ka haath kaat diya jaye. Iska zikr pawitr Qur'an ki is ayat mein hai : "Tatha chor aur chorni donon ke haath kaat do." [soora maaida : 38] sunnat ke andar bata diya gaya hai ki haath kaatne ki kya-kya sharten hain.
Is ayat mein haath kaatne se muraad hatheli ko, hatheli aur kalaai ke beech ke jor se kaat dena hai.
Chor ka haath kaatne ki ek hikmat logon ke dhan ki suraksha aur doosre logon ko is bure kaam se rokna hai.
Deenaar sone ka ek mishqaal hai. Wartamaan mein yeh 24 kairet sone ke 4.25 graam ke baraabar hai. Ek chauthaai deenaar ek graam se kuchh adhik hota hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2965: Tum uske dhan mein se utna lo, jo saadhaarantah tumhaare aur tumhaare bachchon ke liye kaafi ho.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Abu sufyaan ki patni hind bint utba Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aaeen aur kahne lageen : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Abu sufyaan ek kanjoos vyakti hain. Woh mujhe itna kharch nahin dete, jo mere tatha mere bachchon ke liye kaafi ho. Atah, main unhen bataye bina unke dhan mein se kuchh le leti hoon. Kya isse mujhe koi gunaah hoga? Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Tum uske dhan mein se utna lo, jo saadhaarantah tumhaare aur tumhaare bachchon ke liye kaafi ho."

Hind bint utba ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se apne pati abu sufyaan radiyallahu anhu ke baare mein fatva poochha. Unhonne bataya ki abu sufyaan ek kanjoos vyakti hain. Woh unko aur unke bachchon ko paryaapt kharch nahin dete. Yahi kaaran hai ki unko abu sufyaan ko bataye bina unke dhan mein se kuchh chhupaakar le lena parta hai. Aise mein kya unpar koi gunaah hoga? Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne uttar diya : Tum apne aur apne bachchon ke liye abu sufyaan ke dhan mein se itna le liya karo, jo yahaan aam jeewan-shaili ke anusaar paryaapt ho. Abu sufyaan ko iski jaankaari na bhi rahe, to koi harj nahin hai.

Patni aur bachchon par kharch karna aniwaary hai.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne "Tum uske dhan mein se utna lo, jo aam prachlan ke ansaar tumhaare aur tumhaare bachchon ke liye kaafi ho." Kahkar aise maamlon ko aam prachlan ke hawaale kar diya, jinke baare mein shareeyat dvaara kuchh nirdhaaran na ho.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki fatva lene ya shikayat karne aadi ke liye insaan ki aisi baaton ka zikr kiya ja sakta hai, jo use pasand na hon. Yeh un sthaanon mein se ek hai, jahaan gheebat jayaz hai.
Qurtubi kahte hain : Hind ka uddeshy yeh nahin tha ki abu sufyaan har jagah kanjoosi se kaam lete hain. Woh bas itna bataana chaahti theen ki abu sufyaan unpar tatha unke bachchon par kharch karne ke maamle mein kanjoos hain, jiska yeh matlab lena uchit nahin hoga ki abu sufyaan har maamle mein kanjoos hain. Kyonki bahut-se dhanvaan apne bachchon par kharch karne ke maamle mein kanjoosi se kaam lete hain, lekin doosron ka dil rakhne ke liye unpar khoob kharch karte hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2966: Ek ansaari ne apne daas se kah diya ki tum mere marne ke baad aazaad ho.

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki ek ansaari ne apne daas se kah diya ki tum mere marne ke baad aazaad ho. Tatha ek riwayat mein hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko pata chala ki ek sahaabi ne apne daas se kah diya hai ki tum mere marne ke baad aazaad ho. Haalaanki uske paas koi any dhan bhi nahin hai. Atah, aapne use aath sau dirham mein bech diya aur qeemat us sahaabi ko bhej di.

Ek ansaari vyakti ne apne daas ko apni mrityu ke baad mukti ka wachan de diya, jabki uske paas uske siwa koi dhan nahin tha. Jab Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko iski soochna mili, to aapne unke is kaam ko sahamti dene ke bajay nakaar diya aur daas ko aath sau dirham mein bechkar uski keemat use bhijva di. Kyonki insaan ka apni tatha apne pariwaar ki zaroorton ko poora karne ka mahatv daas mukt karne se kaheen adhik hai. Aapne aisa isliye bhi kiya ki kaheen use iske baad logon ko saamne haath na phailaana pare.
Is prakaar ki hadeeson ke andar kai aise ahkaam hain, jinka jnaan insaan ko rakhna chahiye, yadyapi unpar amal karne ki zaroorat na pare. In hadeeson ko seekhne tatha samajhne se yeh kahkar doori nahin banaai ja sakti ki aaj daas pratha ka chalan samaapt ho chuka hai. Kyonki aaj bhi aphreeka ke kuchh bhaagon mein daas pratha ka chalan hai aur yeh bhi sanbhav hai ki baad mein phir kabhi yeh prachlit ho jaye. Daas pratha ka chalan puraane zamaane se raha hai, Islam ke daur mein bhi tha aur uske baad bhi. Yeh aur baat hai ki Islam ek svatantrata priy dharm hai aur daas ko mukt karne ki prerna deta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2967: Allah ke maarg mein ek din ki pahredaari duniya aur uski tamaam cheezon se behtar hai

Sahl bin saad saaidi -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : Allah ke maarg mein ek din ki pahredaari duniya aur uski tamaam cheezon se behtar hai Jannat mein tum mein se kisi ek ke kora ke rakhne ke baraabar sthaan duniya aur uski saari wastuon se behtar hai tatha ek shaam evn ek subah jo banda Allah ke raaste mein nikle duniya tatha uski saari wastuon se behtar hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki musalmaanon ki raksha ke liye musalmaanon evn kaafiron ke beech ke sarahdi kshetr mein Allah ke prasannata ki praapti ke liye ek din pahredaari karna duniya aur uski tamaam cheezon se behtar hai. Jannat mein aise kore ke baraabar sthaan, jisse Allah ke maarg mein jihaad kiya gaya ho, duniya aur uski tamaam cheezon se behtar hai. Din aaranbh se zuhar ke samay ke aaranbh tak ya zuhar se raat tak ke beech ek baar Allah ke maarg mein chalne ka pratiphal duniya aur uski tamaam cheezon se behtar hai.

Allah ki raah mein pahredaari karna bare puny ka kaam hai, kyonki iske liye jaan ko zokhim mein daalna parta hai aur iske nateeje mein Allah ke deen ka warchasv sthaapit hota hai. Inheen baaton ke maddenzar ek din pahredaari ka sawaab duniya aur uski tamaam cheezon se behtar hai.
Aakhirat ki tulna mein duniya ka koi  mahatv nahin hai, kyonki Jannat ke andar ek kora rakhne ke baraabar sthaan duniya aur uski tamaam cheezon se behtar hai.
Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karne ka pratiphal aur uska bara sawaab. Is raah mein ek subah ya ek shaam nikalne ka sawaab duniya aur uski tamaam cheezon se behtar hai.
Hadees ke shabd "Fi sabeelillah" Kewal Allah ki prasannata ki praapti ke liye kaam karne ka mahatv siddh karte aur bataate hain ki pratiphal isi ke kaaran milta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2968: Nabi (salllahu alaihi wa sallam) se us daasi ke baare mein poochha gaya, jo vyabhichaar mein lipt ho gai ho aur shaadeeshuda na ho?

Abu huraira aur zaid bin khaalid juhni (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Nabi (salllahu alaihi wa sallam) se us daasi ke baare mein poochha gaya, jo vyabhichaar mein lipt ho gai aur shaadeeshuda na ho? Toaap ne farmayaah yadi woh vyabhichaar kare, to use kore lagaao. Phir vyabhichaar kare, to phir kore lagaao. Phir vyabhichaar kare, to kore lagaao phir use bech do, kisi rassi ke badle hi sahi. Ibne shihaab kahte hainh main nahin jaanta ki aapne bechne ki baat teesri baar ke baad kahi ya chauthi baar ke baad.

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se vyabhichaar mein lipt awiwaahit daasi ke sharai dand ke baare mein poochha gaya, to aapne farmaya ki use kore lagaye jayenge. Jnaato hoki daasi ke liye aazaad striyon ka aadha dand hai, isliye unhen pachaas kore hi lagaye jayenge. Allah taaala ka farmaan hai : {فَإِذَا أُحْصِنَّ فَإِنْ أَتَيْنَ بِفَاحِشَةٍ فَعَلَيْهِنَّ نِصْفُ مَا عَلَى الْمُحْصَنَاتِ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ} (phir jab woh wiwaahit ho jayen, to yadi vyabhichaar kar jayen, to unpar uska aadha dand hai, jo svatantr striyon par hai.) phir yadi vyabhichaar kar baithe, to dobaara pachaas kore lagaye jayenge, taaki is ashleel kaary se ruk jaye. Lekin yadi use dand se koi farq na pare, woh tauba na kare, badnaami ka bhay bhi na rakhe aur teesri baar vyabhichaar mein lipt ho jaye, to aisi paristhiti mein use pachaas kore lagaane ke baad bet daalo. Chaahe kori ke bhaav hi kyon na bechna pare. Kyonki, uske andar na to koi bhalaai hai aur na uske sudharne ki ummeed bachi hai. Atah uska door ho jaana hi behtar hai, taaki woh us ghar ke liye kisi fitne ka sabab na ban jaye, jismen rah rahi hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2969: Jisne yuddh Allah ke shabd ko ooncha karne ke liye kiya, uska yuddh Allah ki raah mein hai.

Abu moosa radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se us vyakti ke baare mein poochha gaya, jo bahaaduri dikhaane ke liye larta ho, tatha us vyakti ke baare mein poochha gaya jo apni qaum ya desh ke bachaav ke liye larta ho evn us vyakti ke baare mein poochha gaya jo dikhaawe ke liye larta ho, inmen se kiski laraai Allah ki raah mein hai? Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne uttar diya : "Jisne yuddh Allah ke shabd ko ooncha karne ke liye kiya, uska yuddh Allah ki raah mein hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se jang karne waalon ke alag-alag uddeshyon ke baare mein poochha gaya ki ek vyakti bahaaduri dikhaane ke liye jang karta hai, ek vyakti svaabhimaan ke liye jang karta hai aur ek vyakti logon ke beech apni alag pahchaan banaane ke liye yuddh karta hai, to unmen se kiski jang Allah ke maarg mein ki jaane waali jang shumaar hogi? Jawaab mein Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya : Allah ke maarg mein jang karne waala woh shumaar hoga, jisne Allah ke kalima ko ooncha karne ke liye yuddh kiya.

Aamaal ke shuddh aur ashuddh hone ki nirbharta neeyat aur Allah ke prati nishtha par hai.
Jab jihaad ka uddeshy Allah ke kalima (waani) ko ooncha karna ho aur koi doosra jayaz uddeshy, jaise maal-e-ghaneemat ki praapti aadi usse jur jaye, to usse asal neeyat ka koi nuqsaan nahin hoga.
Watan (desh) evn maan-sammaan ki raksha ke liye dushmanon se larna bhi Allah ke maarg mein ki jaane waali jihaad ke  antargat hai.
Mujaahidon se sanbandhit fazeelat ka haqdaar wahi vyakti hai, jo Allah ke kalima (waani) ko ooncha karne ke liye jihaad kare.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2970: Abdur rahmaan bin auf aur zubair bin avvaam (radiyallahu anhuma) ne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se kisi yuddh ke dauraan joon ki peera ki shikayat ki

Anas bin maalik se warnit hai ki abdur rahmaan bin auf aur zubair bin avvaam (radiyallahu anhuma) ne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se kisi yuddh ke dauraan joon ki peera ki shikayat ki, to aapne donon ko reshmi kurta pahanne ki ijaazat di aur mainne un donon ke shareer par reshmi kurta dekha bhi.

Islam ek aasaan dharm hai, iska ek udaahran yeh hai ki woh aawashyak kaarnon se haraam wastu ke prayog ki bhi anumti deta hai. Yahaan Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne zubair tatha abdur rahmaan bin auf -radiyallahu anhuma- ko reshmi kurta pahanne ki anuti di hai, jabki purushon ke liye reshmi wastr warjit hai. Is anumti ka kaaran yeh hai ki Allah ne resham ke andar aisi khaasiyat rakhi hai ki woh joon ki pareshaani ko khatm karta hai aur khujli ka bhi ilaaj karta hai. In donon ke alaawa any logon ko bhi yadi aisi beemaari ho, to woh bhi reshmi wastr ka prayog kar sakte hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2971: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne do chitkabre, seeng waale merhon ki qurbaani ki. Donon ko apne haath se zabah kiya, bismillah kaha, Allahu akbar kaha aur apna paanv donon ki garadnon par rakha.

Anas radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne do chitkabre, seeng waale merhon ki qurbaani ki. Donon ko apne haath se zabah kiya, bismillah kaha, Allahu akbar kaha aur apna paanv donon ki garadnon par rakha.

Anas radiyallahu anhu bayaan karte hain ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne eed al-azha ke din seengon waale do chitkabre menrhe zabah kiye aur farmaya : Allah ke naam se jabah karta hoon aur Allah sabse bara hai. Zabah karte samay aapne apna paanv menrhe ki gardan par rakh diya.

Qurbaani karna ek sharai kaary hai. Ispar tamaam musalmaan ekmat bhi hain.
Behtar yeh hai ki qurbaani ka jaanvar usi tarah ka ho, jis tarah ka jaanvar Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne zabah kiya hai. Kyonki yeh dekhne mein achchha hota hai, ismen charbi hua karti hai aur iska maans svaadisht hua karta hai.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees ke aalok mein qurbaani ka jaanvar kisi aur se zabah karvaane ke bajay khud apne hi haath se zabah karna musathab hai. Albatta, koi majboori ho to baat alag hai. Lekin, use aisi sthiti mein bhi khud maujood rahna chahiye. Waise, kisi aur se zabah karvaana bhi jayaz hai. Ismen sarvasammati hai.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hua ki zabah karte samay bismillah kahne ke saath-saath Allahu akbar kahna aur jaanvar ki gardan ke dayen bhaag par apna paanv rakhna musathab hai. Ulema is baat par ekmat hain ki jaanvar ko bayen pahlu ke bal litaakar uski gardan par paanv rakh diya jayega, taaki zabah karne waale ko dayen haath se chhuri pakarne aur bayen haath se sar ko pakre rahne mein aasaani ho.
Seeng waale jaanvar ki qurbaani musathab hai. Waise, bina seeng waale jaanvar ki qurbaani bhi ki ja sakti hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2972: Mujhe uhud yuddh ke avsar par Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saamne laya gaya. Us samay meri ayu chaudah saal thi. Atah, aapne mujhe anumti nahin di.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki mujhe uhud yuddh ke avsar par Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saamne laya gaya. Us samay meri ayu chaudah saal thi. Atah, aapne mujhe anumti nahin di. Phir khandaq ke avsar par aapke saamne laya gaya. Us samay meri ayu pandrah saal thi. Atah, aapne mujhe anumti de di.

Abdullah bin umar -Allah donon se prasann ho- bata rahe hain ki jis prakaar sena pramukh ke saamne sena ko pesh kiya jaata hai, usi prakaar uhud ki jang ke samay mujhe Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke sammukh yuddh mein jaane ke liye laya gaya. Yeh hijrat ke teesre saal ki baat hai. Us samay unki ayu chaudah saal thi. Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallallam- ne unhen waapas kar diya, isliye ki woh chhote the. Phir khandaq yuddh ke samay saal laye gae. Yeh paanchvi hijri ki baat hai aur us samay unki ayu pandrah saal thi. Abki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallallam- ne unhen yuddh mein shaamil hone ki anumti de di. Shayad woh uhud yuddh ke samay chaudahveen warsh ke aaranbh mein rahe honge aur khandaq yuddh ke samay pandrahveen warsh ke ant mein.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2973: Allah ke raaste mein ek subh athva ek shaam nikalna un saari wastuon se behtar hai, jinpar sooraj nikalta tatha doobta hai

Abu ayyoob ansaari (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah Allah ke raaste mein ek subh athva ek shaam nikalna un saari wastuon se behtar hai, jinpar sooraj nikalta tatha doobta hai.
Anas (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah Allah ke raaste mein ek subh athva ek shaam nikalna duniya aur uski saari wastuon se behtar hai.

In do hadeeson se Allah ke raaste mein jihaad ki shreshthata prakat hoti hai, yadyapi woh kewal shaam athva sawera ke baraabar thore-se samay ke liye hi kyon na ho. Aise mein us jihaad ki fazeelat ka andaaza lagaana kuchh mushkil nahin hai, jismen lanbe samay tak shatruon ka datkar muqaabla kiya jaye! Yahi asal matlab hai Allah ke raaste mein nikalne athva kaam karne ki. Yaani kaafiron se sashreer jihaad karna.
Lekin yahaan yeh baat bhi jaan leni chahiye ki Islam ka jnaan praapt karna bhi Allah ke raaste mein ek prakaar ka mahaan jihaad hai. Saty ke paksh mein khara hona tatha adharmiyon evn pashchimi mishanriyon ke pramaanon ki kaat nikaalna bhi, jo Islam se yuddharat hain aur uska naam wa nishaan tak mita dena chaahte hain, Allah ke raaste mein jihaad karne ka ek mahatvapoorn roop hai.
Is tarah, choonki jihaad ka uddeshy Islam ki sahayta karna aur uska warchasv sthaapit karna hai, isliye in logon ke prayoson ko naakaam banaana bhi bahut bara jihaad hai. Ai Allah, musalmaanon ko apne dharm ki sahayta aur tere shabd ko ooncha karne ka saamarthy de. Nishchay tu sameep aur praarthana sveekaar karne waala hai.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2974: Mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya yeh haraam hai? Farmayaah nahin, parantu yeh hamaare yahaan nahin hua karta hai. Atah, mujhe isse ghin mahsoos hoti hai. Khaalid (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hainh mainne use kheenchkar apne saamne kar liya aur khaana shuru kar diya aur Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) dekhte rahe

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hainh main tatha khaalid bin waleed (radiyallahu anhu) Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath maimoona ke ghar gae. Wahaan ek bhuna hua saanda laya gaya. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne haath barhaya, to maimoona ke ghar mein upasthit kisi stri ne kahaah Allah ke Rasool ko bata do ki aap kya khaane ja rahe hain. Yeh sunkar aapne apna haath kheench liya. Mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya yeh haraam hai? Farmayaah nahin, parantu yeh hamaare yahaan nahin hua karta hai. Atah, mujhe isse ghin mahsoos hoti hai. Khaalid kahte hainh mainne use kheenchkar apne saamne kar liya aur khaana shuru kar diya aur Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) dekhte rahe.

Umme hafeed bint haaris arthaat huzaila bint haaris -radiyallahu anha- apni bahan maimoona -radiyallahu anha- ke paas kuchh saugaat lekar unke darshan ko aaeen, jismen ek saanda bhi shaamil tha. Khaane mein maimoona -radiyallahu anha- ke bhaanje log shareek hue. Khaalid unki bahan ke bete the aur maimoona -radiyallahu anha- unki khaala theen. Isi tarah woh abdullah bin abbaas aur fazl bin abbaas ki bhi khaala theen.
Jab khaana lagaya gaya aur Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne maans ki or haath barhaya, to ghar mein upasthit kuchh mahilaaon ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko bata do ki yeh kya hai. Chunaanche aapse kaha gaya ki yeh saanre ka maans hai, to aapne haath utha liya aur nahin khaya. Yeh dekh khaalid -radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, kya yeh haraam hai? Aapne uttar diya : Nahin, parantu yeh meri jaati ki dharti mein nahin hota. Atah, mujhe isse ghin aati hai. Khaalid -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain : Ispar mainne use apni or kheencha aur kha liya aur Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- sab kuchh dekhte rahe.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2975: Ham log abu moosa ashaari (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas the. Unhonne bhojanpat mangvaya, jismen murgi ka maans bhi tha

Zahdam bin muzarrib jarmi kahte hain ki ham log abu moosa ashaari (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas the. Unhonne dastarkhaan (bhojanpat) mangvaya, jismen murgi ka maans tha. Isi beech ek vyakti andar aya, jo bani taimullah se tha, jiska rang laal tha tatha gair- arab ki bhaanti dikhaai par raha tha. Use dekhkar abu moosa ashaari ne kahaah aao, shaamil ho jaao. Lekin woh hichkichaane laga, to kahaah aao, shaamil ho jaao, mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko ise khaate dekha hai.

Zahdam bin mujarrib jarmi kahte hain ki woh aur kuchh log abu moosa ashaari -radiyallahu anhu- ke paas baithe hue the. Isi beech unhonne dastarkhaan mangvaya. Dastarkhaan laya gaya, to usmen murgi ka maans tha. Itne mein bani taimullah ka ek vyakti andar aya, jo laal rang ka tha aur ghairaarab ki tarah dikh raha tha. Abu moosa -radiyallahu anhu- ne use khaane ke liye bulaya, to woh hichkichaya aur shareek hone se inkaar kar diya. Yeh dekh abu moosa -radiyallahu anhu- ne usse kaha : Mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko ise khaate hue dekha hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2976: Allah yahoodiyon ka winaash kare, unpar charbi haraam ki gai, to unhonne use pighla kar becha

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki umar (radiyallahu anhu) ko maaloom hua ki ek vyakti ne sharaab bechi hai, to farmayaah Allah uska winaash kare, kya woh nahin jaanta ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya haih Allah yahoodiyon ka winaash kare, unpar charbi haraam ki gai, to unhonne use pighla kar becha.

Umar bin khattaab -radiyallahu anhu- ko maaloom hua ki ek vyakti ne madira se laabh uthaane ke liye heela-bahaana se kaam liya hai aur use peene ke bajay bech liya hai. Yeh ek spasht chhal evn haraam kaary tha. Isliye umar -radiyallahu anhu- ne uspar bad dua ki, jis prakaar Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne chhal karne waale yahoodiyon par bad dua ki thi. Unhonne kaha : Allah uska winaash kare, kya use nahin maaloom ki is prakaar ka bahaana haraam hai? Isliye ki yeh ek prakaar se Allah evn uske Rasool ko dhokha dena hai aur Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : Allah yahoodiyon ko halaak kare. Jab Allah ne unpar charbi ko haraam kar diya, to heele-bahaane se usse laabh uthaane lage. Charbi ko pighlaakar bechne lage aur uske mooly ko khaane lage aur aankh mein dhool jhonkne ke iraade se kahne lage : Hamne warjit charbi nahin khaai hai. Sachchaai yeh hai ki we Allah ko dhokha de rahe the aur Allah unhen dhokha de raha tha.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2977: Sulaimaan bin daaood (alaihimassalaam) ne farmayaah aaj raat main sattar striyon ke paas jaaoonga, unmen se har stri se ek-ek larka hoga, jo Allah ke raaste mein jihaad karega

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Sulaimaan bin daaood (alaihimassalaam) ne farmayaah aaj raat main sattar striyon ke paas jaaoonga, unmen se har stri se ek-ek larka hoga, jo Allah ke raaste mein jihaad karega. Unse kaha gaya ki 'in sha Allah' boliye, lekin we nahin bole. Atah, sab patniyon ke paas gae to sahi, parantu ek ke siwa kisi ne santaan nahin diya, ek ne diya bhi to adhoora. Warnankarta ka kahna hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah yadi unhonne 'in sha Allah' kaha hota, to unki qasam na tootti aur unki zarurat bhi poori ho jaati.

Allah ke Nabi sulaimaan -alaihissalaam- ne apne saath baithe ek aadmi se farmaya ki woh ek hi raat mein apni sattar patniyon se sahvaas karenge. Yaad rahe ki itni sankhya mein shaadi ya to unki shariyat mein jayaz thi ya phir yeh unki wisheshta thi. Neeyat yeh thi ki saari patniyon se ek-ek bachcha hoga, jo Allah ke raaste mein jihaad karega. Yeh sun unke saath baithe aadmi ne kaha ki in sha Allah kah len. Lekin woh in sha Allah kahna bhool gae aur saari patniyon se sahvaas kiya. Lekin kewal ek patni ke siwa kisi ne bachche ka janm nahin diya. Usne bhi janm diya to ek adhoore bachche ko. Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya ki yadi sulaimaan -alaihissalaam- ne in sha Allah kah diya hota, to unki qasam bhi nahin tootti aur unki chaahat bhi poori ho jaati.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2978: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ghaneemat ke maal se ghore ke liye do aur aadmi ke liye ek bhaag diya
Hajrat abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ghaneemat ke maal se ghore ke liye do aur aadmi ke liye ek bhaag diya.

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- bata rahe hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne maal-e-ganeemat se ghore ko do aur paidal jihaad karne waale ko ek bhaag diya. Arthaat jo ghora ke saath jihaad karega, woh paidal jihaad karne waale ki tulna mein teen guna adhik bhaag payega. Aisa isliye ki ghora jihaad mein jo kaam karta hai tatha uske maadhyam se shatru ko jo kshati pahunchti hai, woh paidal jihaad karne se kaheen adhik hai. Isi ki or ishaara karte hue hue pawitr Qur'an mein kaha gaya hai : {phir subah ke samay dhaawa bolne waalon ki qasam, jo dhool uraate hain, phir sena ke beech ghus jaate hain.} [soora al-aadiyaat, ayat sankhya : 3-5] ismen ghore ki prashansa ki gai hai aur jang mein uska laabh bataya gaya hai. Isi tarah, Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Ghore ki peshaaniyon mein bhalaai qayaamat tak ke liye hai." Ise bukhaari (hadees sankhya : 2849) tatha Muslim (hadees sankhya : 1871) ne riwayat kiya hai aur shabd Bukhari ke hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2979: Apne paas kuchh maal jama rakho, yeh tumhaare hit mein behtar hai

Kaab bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Main apni tauba qabool hone ki khushi mein apna saara dhan Allah aur uske Rasool ki prasannata praapt karne ke liye sadqa karta hoon. Unki baat sunkar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah apna kuchh maal rakhe raho, yeh tumhaare liye behtar hai.

Kaab bin maalik -Allah unse prasann ho- un teen sahaaba mein se ek hain, jo bina kisi uchit kaaran aur bina nifaaq ke tabook yuddh se peechhe rah gae the. Jab Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- yuddh se waapas aye, to unka bahishkaar kiya tatha logon ko bhi unke bahishkaar ka aadesh diya. Is tarah, we alag-thalag pare rahe, yahaan tak ki unki kshama se sanbandhit ayat awatrit hui aur Allah unse prasann ho gaya. Phir, Rasool aur sahaaba bhi unse santusht ho gae. Chunaanche kaab -radiyallahu anhu- Allah ke prasann hone aur unki tauba sveekaar hone se itna utsaahit hue ki apna saara dhan Allah ki prasannata ki praapti ke liye sadqa kar dene ki ichchha vyakt ki. Lekin Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unki rahnumaai karte hue farmaya ki kuchh dhan apne paas rakh lo. Kyonki Allah ne unki sachchi neeyat evn poori nishtha ke saath kshama yaachna ke kaaran unhen kshama kar diya tha aur ab iski aawashyakta nahin rah gai thi. Saath hi Allah kisi par uski taaqat se adhik bojh bhi nahin daalta. Iske baad unhonne apna kuchh dhan Allah ki prasannata se santusht hokar aur aakhirat ke liye jama rakhne ke iraade se kharch kar diya aur kuchh apne paas rakha, taaki apni aur apne pariwaar ki aawashyaktaaon ko poora kar saken. Allah apne bandon par bara dayaalu hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2980: Jisne kisi musalmaan ka maal harapne ke liye jhoothi qasam khaai, woh Allah se is haal mein milega ki Allah usse sakht krodhit hoga.

Abdullah bin masaood -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jisne kisi musalmaan ka maal harapne ke liye jhoothi qasam khaai, woh Allah se is haal mein milega ki Allah usse sakht krodhit hoga." Warnankarta kahte hain ki ashaas -radiyallahu anhu- ne farmaya : Yeh baat daraasal mere hi baare mein kahi gai thi. Hua yeh ki mere evn ek yahoodi ke beech ek zameen ko lekar jhagra tha. Usne mujhe zameen dene se inkaar kar diya, to main maamle ko Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas lekar gaya. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne mujhse poochha : "Kya tere paas koi pramaan hai?" Mainne uttar diya : Nahin. Aapne yahoodi se kaha : "Tum qasam khaao." Woh kahte hain ki mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aisa hai to yeh qasam kha lega aur mera dhan lekar chala jayega. To Allah ne yeh ayat utaari : (Nihsandeh jo log Allah ke wachan tatha apni qasmon ke badle tanik mooly praapt karte hain.) ayat ke ant tak.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kisi ka dhan harapne ke liye jaan-boojhkar jhoothi qasam khaane se saavdhaan kiya hai aur bataya hai ki aisa vyakti jab Allah se milega, to Allah usse sakht krodhit hoga. Ashaas bin qais radiyallahu anhu ne is hadees ka pariprekshy bayaan karte hue bataya ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne yeh baat isliye farmaai ki unke aur ek yahoodi ke beech ek zameen ke maalikaana adhikaar ko lekar jhagra tha. Donon nirnay ke liye Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas pahunche, to aapne ashaas se kaha : Tum apne daawa ke paksh mein pramaan prastut karo. Agar tum pramaan nahin de sake, to tumhaara wirodhi qasam khaakar bari ho jayega. Yeh sun ashaas ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Agar aisa hai, to yahoodi Allah ka khauf khaye bina qasam kha lega aur mera dhan lekar nikal jayega. Chunaanche isi ki pushti ke liye Allah ne yeh ayat utaari : Nihsandeh jo log Allah ke wachan (tatha amaanat ki adaygi se sanbandhit eemaan waalon ko diye gae uske aadesh) tatha (Allah ke naam ki) apni (jhoothi) qasmon ke badle tanik mooly praapt karte hain, unka aakhirat mein koi hissa nahin. Na Allah unse baat karega aur na qayaamat ke din (daya tatha upkaar ki drishti se) unki or dekhega aur na unki prashansa karke unke saaf-suthre hone ki ghoshna karega aur na unhen (gunaahon tatha gandgiyon se) pawitr karega. Tatha (unke karmon ke kaaran) unke liye duhkhdayi yaatna hai.

Ghalat tareeqe se doosre ka dhan apne liye halaal kar lene ki manaahi.
Musalmaanon ka haq maarna bahut bara paap hai. Haq chhota ho ya bara.
Pramaan muddai ko prastut karna hai. Agar woh inkaar kar de, to jiske wiruddh daawa kiya gaya hai, use qasam khaani hai.
Haq do gawaahon se saabit hota hai. Agar muddai ke paas pramaan na ho, to jiske wiruddh daawa kiy gaya hai, use qasam khaani hogi.
Kisi ka haq chheenne ke liye jhoothi qasam khaana haraam tatha kabeera gunaah hai, jisse insaan Allah ke krodh tatha dand ka haqdaar ban jaata hai.
Shaasak ko doosre fareeq ko samjhaana chahiye, khaas taur par jab woh qasam khaane ja raha ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2981: Tumse pahle ek vyakti ko zakhm laga, to woh vyathit  ho gaya aur ek chaaqu se apna haath kaat daala. Rakt band na hua, yahaan tak ki woh mar gaya. Atah, Allah taaala ne farmaya : Mere bande ne apni jaan khatm karne mein jaldabaazi se kaam liya, atah mainne uspar Jannat haraam kar di.

Hasan se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Hamse jundub bin abdullah radiyallahu ne isi masjid mein bayaan kiya hai aur jab se unhonne bayaan kiya hai, ham bhoole nahin hain aur hamen is baat ki bhi aashanka nahin hai ki jundub ne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke sanbandh mein jhooth bola hai. Unka kahna hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Tumse pahle ek vyakti ko zakhm laga, to woh vyathit  ho gaya aur ek chaaqu se apna haath kaat daala. Rakt band na hua, yahaan tak ki woh mar gaya. Atah, Allah taaala ne farmaya : Mere bande ne apni jaan khatm karne mein jaldabaazi se kaam liya, atah mainne uspar Jannat haraam kar di."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki poorvawarti jaatiyon mein ek vyakti ke shareer mein ek zakhm lag gaya, jo sabr se kaam na le saka aur adheer hokar ek chaaqu liya aur marne ke iraade se usse apna haath kaat daala. Kate hue sthaan se rakt itna bahne laga ki anttah woh mar gaya. Chunaanche is paridrishy mein uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha : Mere bande ne apni jaan khatm karne mein jaldabaazi se kaam liya, atah mainne uspar Jannat haraam kar di.

Wipatti ke samay dhairy rakhne tatha adheer na hone ki fazeelat, kyonki dhairy khone se insaan aur bari wipatti mein par sakta hai.
Pichhli ummaton ki achchhi aur updeshaatmak baaton ka warnan karna.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki insaan ko Allah ki nirdhaarit seemaaon ka paalan karna chahiye. Saath hi yeh ki Allah apni srishti par bara dayaawaan hai ki usne aatm hatya ko haraam qaraar diya hai. Au yeh ki jeewan Allah ka diya hua hai aur wahi uska maalik hai.
Aatm hatya ki or le jaane waali cheezen haraam hain. Aatm hatya karne waale ko bari sakht chetaavni di gai hai.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Yeh is baat ki daleel hai ki usne marne ke iraade se ungli kaati thi, ilaaj ki neeyat se nahin ki jisse laabh hone ki aasha rahti hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2982: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jin logon ko jangon mein bhejte the, un mein se kuchh logon ko wishesh rup se kuchh ghaneemat ka maal dete the. Yeh sena ke aam sadasyon ke bhaag se alag hota tha

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jin logon ko jangon mein bhejte the, unmen se kuchh logon ko wishesh rup se kuchh ghaneemat ka maal dete the. Yeh sena ke aam sadasyon ke bhaag se alag hota tha.

Abdullah bin umar -Allah un donon se prasann ho- bata rahe hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jin logon ko jangon mein bhejte the, unmen se kuchh logon ko wishesh roop se kuchh ganeemat ka maal dete the, jo sena ke aam sipaahiyon ko milne waale hisson se alag hota tha. Aisa isliye karte the, taaki unki himmat barhaai ja sake aur jihaad ke prati unka utsaah barhaya ja sake.

2983: Banu najeer se praapt dhan Allah ne apne Rasool (sallallahu alaihe wa sallam) ko bina kisi yuddh ke pradaan kiya tha aur uske liye musalmaanon ne ghore aur oont nahin dauraye the

Umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki banu najeer se praapt dhan Allah ne apne Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko bina kisi yuddh ke pradaan kiya tha aur uske liye musalmaanon ne ghore aur oont nahin dauraye the. Atah, woh Allah ke Rasool ke liye khaas tha. Usmen aap apne pariwaar ke liye ek warsh ka kharch alag kar lete aur baaki jo bach jaata, use Allah ke raaste (jihaad) ki taiyaari ke liye ghoron aur hathiyaaron mein kharch karte.

Jab Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) madeene aye, to uske chaaron or yahoodiyon ke kuchh girohon ko dekha. Atah, unse is baat par shaanti-sandhi kar li ki we apne dharm par bane rahen, aapse yuddh na karen aur aapke wiruddh kisi shatru ki sahayta na karen. Is sandhi ke pashchaat aapke saathiyon mein se ek vyakti, jiska naam amr bin umayya zamri tha, ne bani aamir ke do logon ki yeh sochkar hatya kar di ki we musalmaanon ke shatru hain. Aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne un donon vyaktiyon ki diyat ada karne ka nirnay liya aur unki diyat ada karne mein sahyog ki aasha ke saath banu nazeer ki or nikle. Isi kram mein aap unke ek baazaar mein sahyog ki prateeksha mein baithe the ki un logo ne waada tor diya aur aapki hatya ka man bana liya. Lekin, aapke paas unki ghaddaari ke sanbandh wahy a gai. Phir aap unhen aur apne upasthit saathiyon ko yeh sanket dekar unki basti se nikal aye ki aap shauch ke liye ja rahe hain. Aap seedhe madeene ki or chal pare. Udhar, jab aapke aane mein der hui, to log aapki talaash mein nikle. Aapne unhen yahoodiyon (Allah unhen nasht kare) ki ghaddaari ki baat sunaai aur chhah dinon tak unki basti ka gheraav jaari rakha, yahaan tak ki is baat par sahamti ban gai ki we shaam, hiyra aur khaibar ki or nikal jayen. Is prakaar, unka dhan 'fay' ka dhan tha, jo musalmaanon ko kisi sangharsh ke bina praapt hua tha aur uske liye unhen koi yuddh nahin karna para tha. Isliye, unka dhan Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye tha. Usse Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne pariwaar ke ek saal ke khaane-peene ka kharch rakh lete aur baaki musalmaanon ki bhalaai ke kaamon mein kharch kar dete. Daraasal, us samay sabse pratham kaam yuddh ke liye hathiyaar aur ghore ki taiyaari ka tha. Waise, pratyek samay ke anusaar aam bhalaai mein kharch karne ka apna ek uchit sthaan hota hai.

2984: Ye chaupaye bhi jangli jaanavron ki tarah bhaag khare hote hain. Inmen se jinpar tumhaara bas na chale unke saath aisa hi karo.

Raafe bin khadeej -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain : Ham log Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath zul hulaipha naami sthaan mein the. Logon ko atyadhik bhookh lagi. Aur unhen ghaneemat mein oont aur bakriyaan mileen. Warnankarta ka kahna hai ki us samay Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- peechhe the. Atah unhonne jaldabaazi se kaam liya, jaanvar zabah kar diye aur haandiyaan choolhon par charha deen. Parantu Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke aadesh par haandiyon ko ulat diya gaya. Phir aapne ghaneemat ka maal baanta aur das bakriyon ko ek oont ke baraabar thahraya. Isi beech unmen se ek oont bidak kar bhaag khara hua. Logon ne uska peechha kiya, lekin usne unhen wiwash kar diya. Logon ke paas ghore bahut kam the. Ant mein unmen se ek vyakti ne teer chalaya aur Allah ne use rok diya. Ab aapne farmaya : "Ye chaupaye bhi jangli jaanavron ki tarah bhaag khare hote hain. Inmen se jinpar tumhaara bas na chale unke saath aisa hi karo." Chunaanche raafe ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Kal hamaara saamna shatruon se hone waala hai aur hamaare paas chhuriyaan nahin hain. Aise mein kya ham baans ki phaank se zabah kar len? Farmaya : "Jo cheez rakt baha de aur usse zabah karte samay jispar Allah ka naam liya gaya ho, use khaao. Haan, magar daant aur naakhoon se nahin. Main tumhen iska kaaran bhi bata deta hoon. Jahaan tak daant ki baat hai, to yeh haddi hai aur jahaan tak naakhoon ki baat hai, to yeh habshiyon ki chhuri hai."

Raafe bin khadeej radiyallahu anhu bayaan kar rahe hain ki sahaaba Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath zul-hulaifa mein ruke. Logon ko bhookh lagi hui thi aur mushrikon se maal-e-ghaneemat ke taur par oont evn bakriyaan praapt hui theen. Atah unhonne maal-e-ghaneemat ke witran ki prateeksha kiye bina hi kuchh jaanvar zabah kar diye aur haandiyaan charha deen. Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se anumti bhi nahin li gai. Aapki aadat yeh thi ki sena ke pichhle bhaag mein chala karte the. Aapko pata chala to haandiyon ko pak rahe gosht samet ulat dene ka aadesh diya. Phir maal-e-ghaneemat ka witran kiya. Witran ke samay das bakriyon ko ek oont ke baraabar rakha. Isi beech hua yeh ki ek oont bhaag nikla aur sahaaba use pakar nahin sake. Ghoron ki kami thi. Atah ek vyakti ne teer chalaya aur Allah ne use rok diya. Ispar Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : In paaltu jaanavron ke andar bhi jangli jaanavron jaisa svabhaav paya jaata hai. Isliye jo jaanvar tumhaare wash se baahar ho jaye aur pakar mein na aye, uske saath yahi kiya karo. Iske baad raafe ne kaha : Aisa lagta hai ki kal dushman se hamaara muqaabla hone waala hai, aur is baat ka dar hai ki ham jin hathiyaaron se jaanvar zabah karte hain, unki dhaar kshatigrast ho jaye. Jabki hamen jaanvar zabah to karna hi hoga aur hamaare paas chaaqu bhi nahin hai. Aise mein kya baans se zabah kar sakte hain? Aapne uttar diya : Jo cheez bari maatra mein rakt baha de aur usse zabah karte samay Allah ka naam le liya jaye, to tum zabah kiye hue jaanvar ka maans kha sakte ho. Bas daant aur naakhoon se zabah kiya hua nahin. Main tumhen iska kaaran bhi bata deta hoon. Jahaan tak daant ki baat hai, to woh haddi hai aur jahaan tak naakhoon ki baat hai, to habsha ke rahne waale awishvaasi uska prayog karte hain.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki winamrata ki aap sena ke pichhle bhaag mein chalte, sipaahiyon ki dekh-bhaal karte aur logon ke praamarshon ko sveekaar karte the.
Shaasak apni praja tatha sena ko anushaasan ke dayre mein rakhe. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne jab dekha ki kuchh sahaaba ne jaldabaazi se kaam liya hai aur aapse anumti liye bina hi jaanvar zabah kar diye hain, to unhen dand dete hue jaanavron ka maans khaane se wanchit kar diya.
Sahaaba Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke aadeshon ka paalan karne mein zara bhi der nahin karte the.
Ghaneemat ka dhan witran se pahle lena mana hai.
Nyay se kaam lena chahiye. Wishesh roop se dushmanon evn awishvaasiyon se jihaad ke samay to aur zyaada. Kyonki yeh wijay praapti ka ek kaaran hai.
Navvi kahte hain : Jab koi paaltu jaanvar jangli jaanavron jaisa vyavhaar karne lage, maslan koi oont, gay, ghora ya bakri bidak jaye aur wash mein na aye, to woh shikaar ke samaan hai. Teer maarne se halaal ho jaata hai.
Jaanvar ka maans khaana halaal ho, iske liye use zabah karna zaroori hai. Waise, jaanvar ke andar nimnalikhit sharton ka paya jaana zaroori hai : 1- jaanvar aisa ho ki uska maans khaana jayaz ho. 2- woh wash mein ho. Agar wash mein  na ho, to woh shikaar ke samaan maana jayega. 3- jaanvar thaleey ho. Jaleey jaanvar ko zabah karna zaroori nahin hai.
Zabah sahi hone ki sharten : 1- zabah karne waale ke andar zabah karne ki yogyata ho. Yaani aqmand, bhale-bure ka jnaan rakhne waala, musalmaan ya kisi poorvawarti aakaasheey granth ko maanne waala ho. 2- zabah aaranbh karte samay Allah ka naam le. 3- zabah karne ke liye upyog kiya jaane waala upakran upyukt ho. Yaani woh bana hua kisi bhi cheez ka ho, lekin dhaardaar ho. Haan, daant aur naakhoon ka na ho. 4- jaanvar agar wash mein ho, to zabah, zabah ya nahr ke sthaan par kiya jaye. Yaani graasanli, gardan ki do moti rakt waahikaaon tatha shvaas nali ko kaat diya jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2985: Na resham pahno aur na deebaaj (mote reshmi wastr). Na sone-chaandi ke bartan mein piyo aur na unki thaali mein khaao. Kyonki yeh wastuen duniya mein un (kaafiron) ke liye hain aur aakhirat mein hamaare liye.

Abdur rahmaan bin abu laila se riwayat hai ki woh huzaifa radiyallahu anhu ke paas maujood the ki usi dauraan unhonne peene ke liye paani maanga to  ek majoosi ne paani prastut kiya. Jab usne paani ka pyaala unke haath mein rakha, to unhonne use usi pyaale se maar diya aur farmaya : Agar mainne ise ek-do baar (sone evn chaandi ke bartan ke prayog se) mana na kiya hota, to main aisa na karta. Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko farmaate hue suna hai : "Na resham pahno aur na deebaaj (mote reshmi wastr). Na sone-chaandi ke bartan mein piyo aur na unki thaali mein khaao. Kyonki yeh wastuen duniya mein un (kaafiron) ke liye hain aur aakhirat mein hamaare liye."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne purushon ko har prakaar ke reshmi wastr pahanne se mana kiya hai. Isi tarah purushon evn striyon donon ko sone aur chaandi ke bartanon mein khaane aur peene se mana kiya hai. Saath hi bataya ki yeh cheezen qayaamat ke din wishesh roop se eemaan waalon ko naseeb hongi. Kyonki we duniya mein unse Allah ke aadesh ka paalan karte hue bachte rahe hain. Jabki awishvaasiyon ko aakhirat mein yeh cheezen naseeb nahin hongi. Kyonki we saansaarik jeewan mein Allah ke aadesh ki avhelna karte hue in cheezon ka upbhog kar lete hain.

Purushon par resham aur deebaaj ke kapre haraam hain aur inke wastr pahanne waalon ko bari sakht chetaavni di gai hai.
Striyon ke liye resham aur deebaaj ke kapre halaal hain.
Sone aur chaandi ki pleton aur bartanon mein khaana aur peena mardon aur aurton donon par haraam hai.
Yahaan huzaifa radiyallahu anhu ne bari teevr pratikriya di aur kaaran yeh bataya ki unhonne ek se adhik baar sone evn chaandi ke bartan ke prayog se mana kiya tha, lekin woh apni harkat se baaz nahin aya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2986: Jisne duniya mein reshmi wastr pahna, woh use aakhirat mein nahin pahnega.
Umar radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne duniya mein reshmi wastr pahna, woh use aakhirat mein nahin pahnega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jis purush vyakti ne duniya mein reshmi wastr pahna aur tauba kiye bina mar gaya, woh dand svaroop aakhirat mein use pahanne se wanchit rakha jayega.

Resham se muraad shuddh praakritik resham hai. Kritim resham ismen shaamil nahin hai.
Purushon ke liye reshmi wastr haraam hai.
Resham pahanne ki manaahi mein use pahanna aur bichhaana donon shaamil hai.
Purushon ke liye kapre mein thore-bahut resham ki anumti hai, jiski chauraai do se chaar ungliyon se adhik na ho aur jo kapre mein naqsh wa nigaar ya haashiya ke taur par prayukt hua hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2987: Allah ki seemaaon ke ullanghan ke atirikt kisi aur apraadh par kisi ko  das koron se adhik nahin lagaya jayega.

Abu buraad ansaari -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : "Allah ki seemaaon ke ullanghan ke atirikt kisi aur apraadh par kisi ko  das koron se adhik nahin lagaya jayega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kuchh wishesh gunaahon ke atirikt any gunaahon mein kisi ko das kore se adhik maarne se mana kiya hai. Yahaan muraad kore lagaane ya maarne ki woh nirdhaarit sankhya wishesh dand ya wishesh dand nahin hai, jo sharai taur par saabit hai. Is hadees ka matlab bas itna hai ki kisi ko shishtaachaar ke dayre mein rakhne ke liye maarna ho, to adhik se adhik das kore laga sakte hain, usse zyaada nahin. Jaise ki patni ya bete ko sudhaar ke liye maarna."

Allah ki nirdhaarit seemayen, jinke paalan ka Allah ne aadesh diya hai ya jinke ullanghan se usne roka hai, unke kuchh dand hain, jo unke ullanghan se rokte hain. Ye dand ya to shareeyat dvaara nirdhaarit hain ya masalhat par nirdhaarit hain jo shaasak ke wiwek par nirbhar karte hain.
Anushaasan ke taur par diya jaane waala dand halka aur bas itna hona chahiye ki nirdesh dene aur daraane ka kaam ho jaye. Agar dand dena hi pare, to das koron se adhik na ho. Behtar yeh hai ki anushaasan ke liye maar-peet ki bajay nirdesh tatha shiksha dene evn prerit karne ke raaste apnaye jayen. Isse baat maanne ki sanbhaavna barh jaati hai, aur sikhlaane mein dayaaluta bhi hai. Waise, is wishay mein paristhitiyaan bari bhinn-bhinn hoti hain, isliye jahaan jo tareeqa adhik sudhaaraatmak lage, wahaan use apnaana chahiye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2988: Koi bhi vyakti gusse ki haalat mein do vyaktiyon ke beech nirnay nahin karega

Abdurrahmaan bin abu bakra kahte hain ki mere pita ne apne bete (athva khud mainne unki or se unke bete) ubaidullah bin abu bakra ko, jo seestaan ke qaazi the, likha ki gusse ki haalat mein do vyaktiyon ke beech nirnay na karna; kyonki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte suna haih koi bhi vyakti ghusse ki haalat mein do aadmiyon ke beech nirnay na kare.

Prabuddh widhi banaane waale ne nirnay karne waale ko krodh ki awastha mein logon ke beech nirnay karne se mana kiya hai. Isliye ki krodh insaan ki vyaktigat santulan ko prabhaawit karta hai aur is baat ki sanbhaavna rahti hai ki woh krodhaawastha mein atyaachaar kar baithe ya ghalat nirnay de daale, jo pratiwaadi par zulm ho tatha nirnay karne waale ke liye khed evn gunaah ka kaaran.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2989: Yadi koi vyakti tumhaari anumti ke bina tumhen jhaanke aur tum kankar maarkar uski aankh phor do, to tumhen koi gunaah na hoga
Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se marfooan warnit hai ki yadi koi vyakti tumhaari anumti ke bina tumhen jhaanke aur tum kankar maarkar uski aankh phor do, to tumhen koi gunaah na hoga.

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne bataya hai ki yadi koi insaan kisi ko uski anumti ke bina, uske ghar ke dvaar se athva deewaar aadi ke oopar se jhaanke aur woh uski or kankar phenkkar uski aankh phor de ya kisi lohe se uski aankh ko zakhmi kar de, to is phorne tatha zakhmi karne waale par na gunaah hai aur na pratikaar. Kyonki asal qasoor jhaankne waale ka hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2990: Mainne kisi lanbe baal waale laal jora pahne vyakti ko Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se sundar nahin dekha

Bara bin aazib (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki mainne kisi lanbe baal waale laal jora pahne vyakti ko Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se adhik sundar nahin dekha. Aapke baal kandhon ko chhu rahe hote the. Aapke do kandhon ke beech faasla tha. Aap na chhote qad ke the, na adhik lanbe qad ke.

Bara bin aazib (radiyallahu anhuma) ne is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki ek aisi wisheshta bayaan ki hai, jo aapke saundary ka pramaan prastut karti hai. Unka kahna hai ki unhonne kisi aise vyakti ko nahin dekha, jiske baal uski karnapaali tak pahunche hue hon aur woh laal jore mein Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se adhik sundar dikhta ho. Phir aapki kuchh wisheshtayen bataate hue bole ki aapke donon kandhon ke beech mein (sundarta anusaar uchit) doori thi. Aap na adhik lanbe the ki bedhab dikhen aur na itne naate ki aib shumaar ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2991: Jo vyakti Allah ke raaste mein zakhmi ho jaye, woh qayaamat ke din is haal mein ayega ki uske zakhm se rakt bah raha hoga. Uska rang to rakt ka hoga, lekin sugandh kastoori jaisi hogi

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jo vyakti Allah ke raaste mein zakhmi ho jaye, woh qayaamat ke din is haal mein ayega ki uske zakhm se rakt bah raha hoga. Uska rang to rakt ka hoga, lekin sugandh kastoori jaisi hogi.

Is hadees mein Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne Allah ke raaste mein jihaad ki fazeelat tatha usmen shareek hone waale vyakti ko milne waale shaandaar pratiphal ka ullekh karte hue kaha hai ki jo vyakti Allah ke raaste mein zakhmi hota hai aur phir mar jaata hai ya theek ho jaata hai, woh qayaamat ke din saari srishtiyon ke saamne jihaad mein shaamil hone aur iske kaaran kasht uthaane ki nishaani ke saath upasthit hoga. Kyonki uska zakhm taaja hoga aur usse aisi cheez bah rahi hogi, jiska rang rakt jaisa hoga, lekin usse kastoori jaisi khushbu phoot rahi hogi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2992: Jisne kisi gulaam mein apna bhaag mukt kiya tatha uske paas itna dhan ho, jo uski poori qeemat ko pahunchta ho, to gulaam ki nyaysangat qeemat lagaai jaye aur any saajhedaaron ko uski or se unke hisson ki qeemat ada kar diye jaye, tabhi uski or se poora gulaam mukt hoga, anyatha uski or se jitna mukt hua, so hua

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se warnan karte hain ki aapne farmayaah jisne kisi gulaam mein apna bhaag mukt kiya tatha uske paas itna dhan ho, jo uski poori qeemat ko pahunchta ho, to uski nyaysangat qeemat lagaai jaye aur any saajhedaaron ko unke hisson ki qeemat ada kar di jaye, tabhi uski or se poora gulaam mukt kiya jaana samjha jayega. Anyatha, uski or se jitna mukt hua, so hua.

Jis vyakti ki kisi daas athva daasi mein hissedaari ho, chaahe hissedaari kam ho ya zyaada, yadi woh us daas ka ek bhaag mukt kar deta hai, to uska hissa mukt ho jayega. Ab agar woh sanpann hai aur apne saajheedaar ke hisse ki qeemat bhi de sakta hai, to poora daas mukt ho jayega. Mukt karne waale ka bhaag bhi aur uske saajheedaar ka bhaag bhi. Woh apne saajheedaar ke bhaag ki qeemat ka andaaza baazaar ke anusaar karke apne saajheedaar ko de dega. Aur agar woh apne saajheedaar ke hisse ki qeemat dene mein saksham na ho, to uske kaaran uske saathi ka nuqsaan hone nahin diya jayega. Mukt kewal usi ka bhaag hoga aur uske saajheedaar ke bhaag ki daasta baraqraar rahegi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2993: Jisne kisi daas mein apna bhaag mukt kar diya, use apne dhan se poora daas mukt karna hoga. Parantu, yadi uske paas paryaapt dhan na ho, to us daas ki nyaysangat qeemat lagaai jayegi aur us daas se prayaas karne ko kaha jayega. Haan, magar use tang nahin kiya jayega

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jisne kisi daas mein apna bhaag mukt kar diya, use apne dhan se poora daas mukt karna hoga. Parantu, yadi uske paas paryaapt dhan na ho, to us daas ki nyaysangat qeemat lagaai jayegi aur us daas se apni qeemat chukaane ka prayaas karne ko kaha jayega. Haan, magar use tang nahin kiya jayega.

Jo kisi saajhe ke daas mein se apna bhaag mukt kar de, yadi uske paas itna dhan ho ki sabhi saajheedaaron ko unke hisson ki qeemat de sakta hai, to use poora daas mukt karna hoga. Lekin yadi uske paas dhan na ho athva saare bhaageedaaron ke bhaag chukaane ke samaan dhan na ho, athva aisa karne se use kshati hoti ho, to is dasha mein daas ko do akhtayaar hongeh pratham, svayn ko utna aazaad rakhe, jitna hua hai. Is dasha mein woh kuchh mukt aur kuchh daas rahega. Doosraah jisne aazaad nahin kiya hai, uska bhaag dene ke liye parishram kare. Aisa mooly tay karne ke pashchaat karega. Isi ko 'istisaa' kaha jaata hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
