2994: Jisne shikaar tatha jaanavron ki rakhvaali ke liye paale jaane waale kutta ke atirikt koi aur kutta paala, har din uski neki se do qeeraat ghata diye jayenge.

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jisne shikaar tatha jaanavron ki rakhvaali ke liye paale jaane waale kutta ke atirikt koi aur kutta paala, har din uski neki se do qeeraat ghata diye jayenge." Saalim kahte hain ki abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- yeh bhi kaha karte the : "Ya kheti ki rakhvaali ke kutte ke siwa." Aur woh khud kheteebaari kiya karte the.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kutta paalne se saavdhaan kiya hai. Bas us kutta ko chhorkar jo shikaar karne ya jaanvar tatha khet ki dekhbhaal ke liye paala jaye. Jisne iske atirikt koi kutta paala, uske amal ke sawaab se har din do-do qeeraat ghata diye jayenge. Qeeraat kitne ka hota hai, iski jaankaari Allah ke paas hai.

Kisi musalmaan ke liye kutta paalna jayaz nahin hai, siway un kutton ko chhorkar jinka zikr is hadees mein kiya ja chuka hai.
Kutta paalna mana hai, kyonki ismen anek buraaiyaan aur haaniyaan nihit hain. Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se saabit hai ki jis ghar mein kutta hota hai, usmen farishte prawesh nahin karte. Saath hi, ismen ek atyant apvitrata paai jaati hai, jise door karne ke liye baar-baar paani aur mitti se dhona aawashyak hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2995: Jisne kisi baat par jaan-boojhkar Islam ke atirikt kisi any dharm ki jhoothi qasam khaai, to woh waisa hi hoga, jaisa usne kaha

Saabit bin zahhaak (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se per ke neeche baiat ki thi aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne kaha thaah jisne kisi baat par jaan-boojhkar Islam ke atirikt kisi any dharm ki jhoothi qasam khaai, to woh waisa hi hoga, jaisa usne kaha. Aur jisne kisi wastu se apni hatya kar li, use qayaamat ke din usi ke dvaara yaatna di jayegi. Tatha kisi vyakti ke liye aisi mannat ko poora karna aawashyak nahin hai, jiska woh maalik nahin hai.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih momin par laanat karna uski hatya samaan hai. Ek any riwayat mein haih jisne dhan barhaane ke liye jhootha daawa kiya, Allah uski tangi ko aur barha deta hai.

Saabit bin zahhaak ansaari -radiyallahu anhu- (jo hudaibiya ke din per ke neeche baiat karne waalon mein shaamil the) Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se warnan karte hain ki aapne kai baaten kaheen hain, jinmen ek yeh hai ki jo Islam ke siwa kisi doosre dharm ki qasam khaye, jaise jaan-boojhkar jhoothi qasam khaate hue kahe ki agar aisa aur aisa hai, to woh yahoodi, eesaai, majoosi, kaafir athva Allah tatha uske Rasool se bari hai, to woh sachmuch un kaafir dharmon mein se kisi ek ka maanne waala thahrega, jinki or apni nisbat ki hai.
Isi tarah jo talvaar, chhuri, goli athva kisi any hathiyaar se aatmahatya karega, use qayaamat ke din usi ke dvaara yaatna di jayegi.
Jo aisi wastu ki mannat maane, jiska woh maalik nahin hai, jaise kisi aur ke daas ko mukt karne ki mannat maane athva kisi doosre ke dhan se sadqa karne ki mannat maane, uski mannat sahi nahin hogi, isliye ki uska mannat maanna hi uchit nahin tha.
Jo kisi momin par laanat karta hai, maano woh uski hatya karta hai. Isliye ki laanat karne waala aur hatya karne waala donon Allah ki pawitrata ko paamaal karne waale tatha paapi aur yaatna ke haqdaar hain.
Jo jhoothe daawe karta hai, jaise dhan, jnaan, wansh athva mansab ka jhootha daawa karke abhimaan karta hai, Allah use rusva tatha apmaanit karega. Isliye ki usne svayn ko aisi wastu dvaara ooncha karna chaaha, jo uske paas nahin hai, isliye uska badla bhi usi ke anusaar hoga.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2996: Jisne kisi musalmaan vyakti ka maal harapne ke liye akaaty evn jhoothi qasam khaai, woh Allah se is awastha mein milega ki woh usse sakht krodhit hoga

Abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se marfooan warnan karte hain ki jisne kisi musalmaan vyakti ka maal harapne ke liye akaaty evn jhoothi qasam khaai, woh Allah se is awastha mein milega ki woh usse sakht krodhit hoga. Isi ke baare mein yeh ayat utreeh "إن الذين يشترون بعهد الله وأيمانهم ثمنا قليلا" (Arthaath jo log Allah ke wachan aur apni qasmon ke badle mein tanik mooly khareedte hain) se aakhir tak.

Is hadees mein un logon ko bari sakht dhamki di gai hai, jo ghalat tareeqe se lar-jhagarkar aur jhoothi qasmen khaakar kisi ka dhan harap lete hain. Aisa vyakti Allah se is haal mein milega ki woh usse naaraaz hoga.Aur jisse Allah naaraaz ho gaya, uska winaash tay hai. Phir Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne is sakht dhamki ki pushti ke liye Qur'an ek ayat parhkar sunaai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2997: Jisne hampar hathiyaar uthaya, woh hammen se nahin hai.
Abu moosa ashaari radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne hampar hathiyaar uthaya, woh hammen se nahin hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam musalmaanon ko bhaybheet karne athva unko lootne ke liye unpar hathiyaar uthaane se saavdhaan kar rahe hain.Kyonki jisne naahaq aisa kiya, usne bahut bara apraadh tatha kabeera gunaah kiya aur woh is ganbheer dhamki ka hakdaar ho gaya.

Is baat par kathor chetaavni ki koi musalmaan apne musalmaan bhaaiyon se laraai kare.
Musalmaanon par hathiyaar uthaana tatha unki hatya karna ek bahut bara anuchit kaary tatha dharti mein fasaad phailaana hai.
Is hadees mein di gai chetaavni ke andar haq ke saath kiya jaane waala yuddh, jaise baaghiyon aur fasaad phailaane waalon se kiya jaane waala yuddh shaamil nahin hai.
Musalmaan ko hathiyaar aadi dikhaakar bhaybheet karna haraam hai, chaahe mazaaq ke taur par hi kyon na ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
2998: Jisne kisi ko qatl kiya aur uske paas uska pramaan bhi ho, to use usse chheena hua saara saamaan milega

Abu qataada ansaari (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ham log Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath hunain gae. (Phir unhonne ek ghatna sunaai.) to aapne farmayaah jisne kisi ko qatl kiya aur uske paas uska pramaan bhi ho, to use usse chheena hua saara saamaan milega. Aapne yeh baat teen baar kahi.

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hunain ke din farmayaah jo vyakti kisi ko yuddh ke maidaan mein katl karta hai evn uske paas iska saakshy tatha pramaan bhi hai, to use maare gae vyakti ka saara saamaan arthaat uske hathiyaar, kapre aur woh sawaari, jispar sawaar hokar woh lar raha tha, sab kuchh de diya jayega. Abu qataada (radiyallahu anhu) ne ek vyakti ko qatl kiya, to aas-paas ke logon ko bataya ki mainne ek vyakti ko qatl kiya hai aur jin logon ko iski jaankaari hai, unhen qasam deta hoon ki mere haq mein gawaahi den. Unhonne yeh baat teen baar kahi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
2999: Ham Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath saat yuddhon mein shaamil hue aur ham unke dauraan tiddi khaate the
Abdullah bin abu aufa (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ham Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath saat yuddhon mein shareek hue aur unke dauraan ham tiddi khaate the.

Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne apne Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saathiyon ko saat yuddhon mein khaane-peene ki cheezen na hone ke kaaran khaane ko tiddiyaan pradaan keen. Isi tarah ek yuddh mein samudr se nikalne waali anbar machhli se sahayta farmaai, jise unhonne khaya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3000: Hamne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke jeewankaal mein ek ghora zibah kiya aur use khaya

Asma bint abu bakr (radiyallahu anhuma) kahti hain ki hamne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke jeewankaal mein ek ghora zibah kiya aur use khaya. Ek riwayat mein hai ki us samay ham madeene mein the.

Asma bint abu bakr (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki logon ne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke zamaane mein ek ghora zabah kiya aur use khaya. Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki ghore ka maans khaana jayaz hai. Koi yeh na samjhe ki choonki Qur'an ki is ayat mein ghore ka zikr gadha tatha khachchar ke saath kiya gaya hai, isliye ise khaana jayaz nahin hai. Allah ka farmaan haih {ghore, khachchar aur gadhon ko (hamne isliye paida kiya hai) taaki tum inpar sawaari karo aur ye shobha ka saamaan bhi hain aur woh aisi wastu srishti karta hai, jo tum nahin jaante.} [seera an-nahlah 8]
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3001: Meri bahan ne yeh mannat maani ki woh nange paanv paidal Allah ke pawitr ghar ki yaatra karegi. Phir mujhse kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se poochhkar aaoon. Mainne aapse poochha to farmayaah woh chale bhi aur sawaar bhi ho.

Uqba bin aamir (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki meri bahan ne yeh mannat maani ki woh nange paanv paidal Allah ke pawitr ghar ki yaatra karegi. Phir mujhse kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se poochhkar aaoon. Mainne aapse poochha to farmayaah woh chale bhi aur sawaar bhi ho.

Insaan ki prawritti hai ki woh bhaavnaaon mein bahkar kabhi-kabhi apne oopar aise kaaryon ko aniwaary kar leta hai, jo uspar bhaari parte hain. Lekin hamaari shareeyat ne santulan banaye rakhne ka aadesh diya hai tatha ibaadat ke maamle mein apne oopar adhik bojh daalne se mana kiya hai, taaki use jaari rakha ja sake. Is hadees mein uqba ki bahan ne unse maang ki ki woh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se poochhen ki unhonne Allah ke pawitr ghar kaaba ki yaatra khaali pair paidal chalkar karne ki mannat maani hai. Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne dekha ki yeh mahila kuchh chalne ki shakti rakhti hai, isliye unhen shakti anusaar chalne aur wiwash hone ki dasha mein sawaar hone ka aadesh diya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3002: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne do athva teen athva chaar angul samaan resham pahanne ki anumti di hai

Umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne resham pahanne se mana kiya hai, parantu itna-sa. Tatha Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen shahaadat ki aur beech waali do anguliyaan uthaakar dikhaaeen.
Tatha Muslim ki riwayat mein hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) resham pahanne se mana kiya hai. Yeh aur baat hai ki do, teen ya chaar angul ke baraabar ho.

Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne mardon ko reshmi kapre ke prayog se mana kiya hai, siway uske jise apvaad ghoshit kiya gaya hai. Waise Bukhari tatha Muslim ki riwayat mein do oongli tak ki chhoot di gai hai, jabki Muslim ki riwayat mein teen ya chaar ungli ki chhoot di gai hai. Aise mein adhiktar ko liya jayega. Isliye wastr mein chaar ungli tak resham hone mein koi nuqsaan nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3003: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne gharelu gadhon ka maans khaane se mana farmaya hai aur ghore ka maans khaane ki anumti di hai

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne paaltu gadhon ka maans khaane se mana farmaya hai aur ghore ka maans khaane ki anumti di hai.
Tatha kewal Muslim ki riwayat mein hai ki warnankarta kahte hainh hamne khaibar ke dinon mein ghore tatha neelgay ka maans khaya aur Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne paaltu gadhon ka maans khaane se mana kiya hai.
Abdullah bin abu aufa (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki khaibar ke yuddh ke dinon mein hamen sakht bhookh ka saamna tha. Jab khaibar wijay ka din aya, to hamne gharelu gadhon ko lekar zibah kar daala. Jab haandiyaan ubalne lageen, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki or se ek vyakti ne elaan kiya ki haandiyon ko ulat do. Tatha warnankarta kabhi- kabhi yeh bhi kahte the ki gharelu gadhon ka maans bilkul na khaao.
Abu saalba (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne gharelu gadhon ka maans haraam kiya hai.

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) bata rahe hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne gharelu gadhon ka maans khaane se mana kiya hai tatha ghore aur jangli gadhon ka maans khaane ki anumti di hai. Isi tarah abdullah bin abu aufa (radiyallahu anhuma) bata rahe hain ki khaibar yuddh ke dinon mein unhen bari bhookh ka saamna karna para. Jab khaibar jeet liya gaya, to unhonne wahaan se praapt gadhon ko zabah kiya aur pakaana shuru kar diya. Lekin jab maans pak gaya, to Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne aadesh diya ki use na khaya jaye aur haandiyon ko ulat diya jaye.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3004: Ai abdurrahmaan bin samura! Satta na maango, kyonki yadi maangne par satta diye gae, to tum usi ke hawaale kar diye jaaoge

Abdurrahmaan bin samura (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah ai abdul rahmaan bin samura! Satta na maango, kyonki yadi maangne par satta diye gae, to tum usi ke hawaale kar diye jaaoge, tatha yadi bina maange satta diye gae, to uske nirvaahan mein tumhaari sahayta ki jayegi. Tatha jab tum kisi baat ki qasam khaao aur any baat ko usse uttam dekho, to qasam ka kaffaara do aur woh karo, jo uttam ho.

Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne koi prashaasnik pad maangkar lene se mana farmaya hai, isliye ki yadi kisi ko maangne ke kaaran pad milta hai, to uski sahayta nahin ki jaati aur use ashay chhor diya jaata hai, kyonki woh duniya chaahta hai aur use aakhirat par tarjeeh deta hai. Jabki jo bina maange pad praapt karta hai, Allah use sanbhaalne ke sanbandh mein uski sahayta karta hai. Is hadees mein yeh bhi bataya gaya hai ki qasam kisi achchhe kaary se rok nahin sakti. Yadi qasam khaane waaleे ko lage ki bhalaai qasam ko torneे hi mein hai, to uske liye jayaz hai ki kaffaara dekar qasam se chhutkaara praapt kar le aur woh kaary kare, jo achchha hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3005: Kya main tumhen un teen vyaktiyon ke baare mein na bataaoon? Unmen se ek ne Allah ki sharan li, to Allah ne use apni sharan de di. Doosra sharmaya, to Allah ne bhi uski laaj rakh li. Teesre ne munh phera, to Allah ne bhi usse munh pher liya

Abu waaqid haaris bin auf (radiyallahu anhu) seे riwayat hai ki ek baar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) masjid mein logon ke saath baithe the ki itne mein teen aadmi aye. Unmen se do log Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aye aur ek waapas chala gaya. Jo do vyakti Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aye, unmen se ek majlis mein ek khaali sthaan dekhkar baith gaya aur doosra logon ke peechhe jaakar baitha. Rahi baat teesre ki, to woh ulte paanv waapas ho gaya. Jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki vyastata samaapt hui, to farmayaah kya main tumhen un teen vyaktiyon ke baare mein na bataaoon? Unmen se ek ne Allah ki sharan li, to Allah ne use apni sharan de di. Doosra sharmaya, to Allah ne bhi uski laaj rakh li. Teesre ne munh phera, to Allah ne bhi usse munh pher liya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3006: Aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya ki kah liya karoh اللهم فاطِرَ السماوات والأرض عالم الغيبِ والشهادة، ربَّ كُلِّ شَيءٍ ومَلِيكَه، أَشْهد أن لا إله إلا أنت، أعوذ بك من شرِّ نفسي وشرِّ الشيطان وشِرْكِهِ

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki abu bakr siddeek (radiyallahu anhu) ne kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe kuchh aise shabd bataaiye, jo main subh- shaam kaha karoon. Aapne farmayaah kah liya karoh اللهم فاطِرَ السماوات والأرض عالم الغيبِ والشهادة، ربَّ كُلِّ شَيءٍ ومَلِيكَه، أَشْهد أن لا إله إلا أنت، أعوذ بك من شرِّ نفسي وشرِّ الشيطان وشِرْكِهِ وأن أقترف على نفسي سوءًا أو أجرُّه إلى مسلم" (Arthaath ai Allah, ai aakaashon evn dharti ke rachyita, chhipe tatha khule ko jaanne waale, pratyek wastu ka rab aur prabhu! Main gawaahi deta hoon ki tere siwa koi poojy nahin hai. Main apni aatma ki buraai, shaitaan ki buraai evn uski saajhedaari se teri sharan maangta hoon, tatha is baat se bhi teri sharan maangta hoon ki apna tatha kisi muslaaman ka kuchh bura karoon.) ise subh- shaam aur sote samay kaha karo.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3007: Main tumse qasam isliye nahin le raha hoon ki tumpar koi aarop lagaana chaahta hoon. Daraasal baat yeh hai ki jibreel alaihissalaam mere paas aye aur bataya ki sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah farishton ke nikat tum logon par garv kar raha hai.

Abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu bayaan karte hain ki muaawiya radiyallahu anhu masjid mein logon ki ek sabha ke paas aye aur poochha : Tum yahaan kisliye baithe ho? Logon ne jawaab diya : Ham Allah ka zikr karne ke liye baithe hain. Muaawiya radiyallahu anhu ne kaha : Qasam khaakar bataao ki kya tum kewal isi uddeshy se baithe ho? Logon ne kaha : Allah ki qasam, ham kewal isi uddeshy se baithe hain. Ispar muaawiya radiyallahu anhu ne kaha ki mainne tumse qasam is kaaran nahin uthvaai ki mujhe tumpar sandeh tha. Koi vyakti aisa nahin hai, meri tarah Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se nikat raha ho aur aapse itni kam hadeesen riwayat karta ho. Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apne saathiyon ki ek sabha mein gae aur pharmaya : "Tum log kyon baithe hue ho?" Un logon ne kaha : Ham log isliye baithe hain, taaki Allah ko yaad karen aur is baat par uski prashansa karen ki usne hamen Islam ka raasta dikhaya aur Islam jaisa dharm pradaan kiya. Aapne kaha : "Allah ki qasam tum log isi ke liye baithe ho?" Un logon ne kaha : Allah ki qasam ham isi liye baithe hain. Aapne pharmaya: "Main tumse qasam isliye nahin le raha hoon ki tumpar koi aarop lagaana chaahta hoon. Daraasal baat yeh hai ki jibreel alaihissalaam mere paas aye aur bataya ki sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah farishton ke nikat tum logon par garv kar raha hai."

Muaawiya bin abu sufyaan radiyallahu anhuma masjid mein maujood logon ki ek sabha ke paas pahunche aur sabha mein maujood logon se poochha ki woh kis uddeshy se baithe hue hain? Logon ne jawaab diya : Ham Allah ka zikr karne ke liye baithe hue hain. Tab unhonne unko qasam khaane ko kaha ki kya waaqai unke baithne aur ekatr hone ka uddeshy Allah ke zikr ke siwa kuchh aur nahin hai? Jab unhonne qasam kha li, to farmaya : Mainne tum logon ko qasam khaane ko isliye nahin kaha ki main tumhen jhootha samajhta hoon aur tumhaare sachche hone mein mujhe sandeh hai. Phir unhonne bataya ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke yahaan unko kya sthaan praapt tha. Bataya ki unko aapse jo nikatta praapt thi, woh kisi aur ko nahin thi. Kyonki unki bahan umm-e-habeeba radiyallahu anha Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki patni theen aur khud woh wahy likhne waale sahaaba mein shaamil the. Iske baavjood unhonne aapse bahut kam hadeesen naqal ki hain. Phir unhonne bataya ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ek din ghar se nikle, to dekha ki kuchh sahaaba masjid mein baithkar Allah ka zikr aur Islam ki raah dikhaane par uski prashansa kar rahe hain. Tab aapne unse baithne ka uddeshy poochha aur qasam bhi khaane ko kaha, jaisa ki muaawiya radiyallahu anhu ne kiya tha. Phir aapne apne saathiyon ko baithne ka sabab poochhne aur qasam khaane ko kahne ka kaaran bhi bata diya. Bataya ki aapke paas jibreel alaihissalaam aye the aur bata rahe the ki Allah farishton ke saamne unpar abhimaan ev fakhr kar raha hai, unki fazeelat bata raha hai, unki prashansa kar raha hai aur farishton ko unka achchha amal dikha raha hai.

Muaawiya radiyallahu anhu ki fazeelat aur Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke padchihnon par chalte hue unka jnaan ke praachar-prasaar ka prayaas karna.
Jhooth ka sandeh na hone par bhi is uddeshy se qasam khilaana jayaz hai ki soochna ka mahatv spasht ho jaye.
Zikr evn jnaan par aadhaarit sabhaaon ki fazeelat. Allah is tarah ki sabhaaon se mohabbat rakhta hai aur farishton ke saamne inpar abhimaan karta hai.
3008: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) shaam ke samay yeh dua parhteh "أمسينا وأمسى الملك لله، والحمد لله، لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له

Abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) shaam ke samay yeh dua parhteh "أمسينا وأمسى الملك لله، والحمد لله، لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له" (Arthaath hamne shaam ki aur Allah ke aadesh se desh ne shaam ki. Saari prashansa Allah ki hai. Allah ke siwa koi poojy nahin hai. Woh akela hai. Uska koi saajhi nahin hai.)
Warnankarta kahte hainh mujhe lagta hai ki aap ukt shabdon ke saath yeh bhi kaha karte theh "له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير، ربِّ أسألك خير ما في هذه الليلة وخير ما بعدها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما في هذه الليلة وشر ما بعدها، رب أعوذ بك من الكسل، وسُوءِ الكِبَرِ، رب أعوذ بك من عذاب في النار، وعذاب في القبر" (Arthaath usi ka raajy hai, usi ki prashansa hai evn woh har cheez ki shakti rakhta hai. Mere prabhu! Main tujhse is raat mein jo kuchh hai tatha iske baad jo kuchh hai, uski bhalaai maangta hoon, tatha is raat mein jo kuchh hai evn iske baad jo kuchh hai, uski buraai se teri sharan maangta hoon. Mere prabhu! Main susti evn abhimaan ki buraai se teri sharan maangta hoon. Mere prabhu! Main Jahannam aur qabr ki yaatna se teri sharan maangta hoon.) tatha jab subh karte, to kahteh "أصبحنا وأصبح الملك لله" (Arthaath hamne subh ki aur Allah ke liye desh ne bhi subh ki.)
3009: Log quba mein abhi subh ki namaz parh hi rahe the ki achaanak ek vyakti unke paas aakar bolaah aaj raat Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) par Qur'an ki ayat utri hai aur aapko qibla badalne ka aadesh diya gaya hai, atah tum kaabe ki or munh kar lo

Abdullah bin umar (razillahu anhu) kahte hainh log quba mein abhi subh ki namaz parh hi rahe the ki achaanak ek vyakti unke paas aakar bolaah aaj raat Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) par Qur'an ki ayat utri hai aur aapko qibla badalne ka aadesh diya gaya hai, atah tum kaabe ki or munh kar lo. Us samay logon ka munh shaam ki or tha, parantu elaan sunte hi sabhi ne kaabe ki or munh kar liya.

Ek sahaabi madeene se nikalkar madeene ke baahri kshetr mein sthit quba masjid pahunche, to dekha ki wahaan ke logon ko qibla badal jaane ki soochna nahin mili hai aur we abhi tak pahle qible ki or munh karke namaz parh rahe hain. Atah, unhen qibla badalkar kaaba ke qibla hone ki baat kahi aur bataya ki is sanbandh mein Qur'an ki ayat bhi utri hai. Unka ishaara is ayat ki or thaah {ham dekh rahe hain ki tum aakaash ki or apna chehra kar rahe ho. Ham nishchay hi tumhen ek aise qible ki or pher denge, jisse tum prasann ho jaaoge. To apna munh masjid-e-haraam ki or kar lo aur jahaan bhi raho, usi ki or munh karo aur nishchay jo log pustak waale hain, jaante hain ki yahi unke rab ki or se hai aur saty hai, aur Allah tumhaare karmon se achet nahin hai.} [soora al-baqraah 144] unhonne yeh bhi bataya ki aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne kaaba ki or munh kar liya hai. Chunaanche sahaaba ki soojhboojh aur samajhdaari dekhiye ki unhonne bina samay ganwaye pahle qibla baitul maqdis ki or se munh pherkar doosre qabla kaaba ki or munh kar liya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3010: In donon ko yaatna di ja rahi hai, aur woh bhi yaatna kisi bare paap ke kaaran nahin di ja rahi hai. Donon mein se ek peshaab se nahin bachta tha, aur doosra lagaai- bujhaai karta phirta tha.

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma se warnit hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam do qabron ke paas se guzre, to farmaya : "In donon ko yaatna di ja rahi hai, aur woh bhi yaatna kisi bare paap ke kaaran nahin di ja rahi hai. Donon mein se ek peshaab se nahin bachta tha, aur doosra lagaai- bujhaai karta phirta tha." Phir aapne ek taaza shaakha li, use aadha-aadha phaara aur har ek qabr mein ek-ek bhaag ko gaar diya. Sahaaba ne poochha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapne aisa kyon kiya? To aapne jawaab diya : "Shayad in donon ki yaatna ko us samay tak ke liye halka kar diya jaye, jab tak yeh donon shaakhayen sookh na jayen."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam do qabron ke paas se guzre aur farmaya  : In qabron mein dafan donon log yaatna jhel rahe hain aur ye yaatna aisi cheezon ke kaaran jhel rahe hain, jo tumhaari nazar mein bari cheezen nahin hain. Yeh aur baat hai ki ye Allah ki nazar mein bari cheezen hain. In donon mein se ek vyakti peshaab-paakhaane ke samay apne shareer tatha kapron ko peshaab se bachaane par dhyaan nahin deta tha. Jabki doosra vyakti logon ke beech lagaai-bujhaai karta phirta tha. Woh ek vyakti ki baat doosre vyakti ko nuqsaan pahunchaane evn matbhed paida karne ke uddeshy se pahunchaya karta tha.

Lagaai-bujhaai karna aur peshaab se bachne par dhyaan na dena kabeera gunaah aur qabr ki yaatna ka sabab hai.
Allah ne apne Nabi ke saamne kuchh ghaib ki cheezen, jaise qabr ki yaatna, khol deen, taaki yeh aapke Nabi hone ki ek nishaani ban sake.
Ek shaakh lene aur use phaarkar qabr par rakhne ka yeh amal Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath khaas hai. Kyonki Allah ne aapko un donon qabron mein dafan logon ka haal bata diya tha. Is masle mein aappar kisi ko qayaas isliye nahin kiya ja sakta ki koi qabr mein dafan logon ka haal jaan nahin sakta.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3011: Jab Allah taaala, shaasak ya adhikaari ke saath bhalaai ka iraada karta hai, to use sachcha sahayak pradaan karta hai, jo bhoolne par yaad dilaata hai aur yaad rahne par sahayta karta hai. Parantu, jab iske wipreet iraada karta hai, to use bura sahayak pradaan karta hai, jo na bhoolne par yaad dilaata hai, na yaad rahne par sahayta karta hai

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se marfooan warnan karte hue kahti hain ki jab Allah taaala kisi shaasak ya adhikaari ke saath bhalaai ka iraada karta hai, to use sachcha sahayak pradaan karta hai, jo bhoolne par yaad dilaata hai aur yaad rahne par sahayta karta hai. Parantu, jab iske wipreet iraada karta hai, to use bura sahayak pradaan karta hai, jo na bhoolne par yaad dilaata hai, na yaad rahne par sahayta karta hai.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3012: Allah ne jitne bhi Nabi bheje aur jitne bhi shaasak banaye, sabke do prakaar ke salaahkaar hote hain; ek woh salaahkaar jo bhalaai ka aadesh deta hai aur uski prerna deta hai. Doosra woh salaahkaar jo buraai ka aadesh deta hai aur usi ka protsaahan deta hai

Abu saeed khudri aur abu huraira (radiyallahu anhuma) Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se warnan karte hue kahte hainh Allah ne jitne bhi Nabi bheje aur jitne bhi shaasak banaye, sabke do prakaar ke salaahkaar hote hain; ek woh salaahkaar jo bhalaai ka aadesh deta hai aur uski prerna deta hai. Doosra woh salaahkaar jo buraai ka aadesh deta hai aur usi ka protsaahan bhi deta hai. Bach wahi paata hai, jise Allah bacha le.
3013: Jab tum azaan suno, to tum uske samaan kaho, jo muazzin kahta hai.
Abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jab tum azaan suno, to tum uske samaan kaho, jo muazzin kahta hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam azaan sunte samay muazzin ke shabdon ka jawaab dene ki prerna de rahe hain. Yaani yeh ki ham ek-ek waaky karke waise hi kahte jayen, jaise muazzin kahta hai. Chunaanche jab woh takbeer kahega, to ham takbeer kahenge. Jab woh donon gawaabiyaan dega, to ham donon gawaahiyaan denge. Albatta, "حي على الصلاة" Tatha "حي على الفلاح" Ka maamla isse alag hai. In donon waakyon ke baad "لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله" Kaha jayega.

Pahle muazzin ke baad doosre muazzin ke shabdon ka bhi jawaab diya jayega. Chaahe muazzin ek se adhik hi kyon na hon. Kyonki hadees ke shabd aam hain.
Muazzin ka jawaab insaan har paristhiti mein dega, jab tak ki shauchaalay mein na ho ya mal tyaag mein vyast ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3014: Inhen rahne do; kyonki mainne inhen wazu ki haalat mein pahne the.

Mugheera radiyallahu anhu kahte hain : Main ek yaatra mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath tha. Mainne aapke moze utaarne ke liye haath barhaye, to aapne farmaya : "Inhen rahne do; kyonki mainne inhen wazu ki haalat mein pahne the." Phir aapne unpar masah kiya.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ek safar mein the. Safar ke dauraan aapne wazu kiya. Wazu karte hue jab paanv dhone ki baari aai, to mugheera bin shoba radiyallahu anhu ne aapke mozon ko utaarne ke liye haath barhaya, taaki aap pairon ko dho saken. Yeh dekh Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : In mozon ko chhor do. Inko mat utaaro. Kyonki jab mainne moze pahne the, us samay main baavzu tha. Chunaanche Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne pairon ko dhone ke bajay unpar masah kiya.

Mozon par masah ki anumti kewal wazu ke samay chhoti naapaaki door karne ke liye hai. Rahi baat bari naapaaki ki, jismen snaan waajib hota hai, to usmen donon pairon ko dhona zaroori hai.
Masah karte samay bheege haathon ko moze ke oopri bhaag mein ek baar pher dena hai. Haathon ko mozon ke nichle bhaag mein nahin pherna hai.
Mozon par masah karne ke liye shart hai ki mozon ko sanpoorn wazu, jismen qadmon ko dhoya gaya ho, ke baad pahna gaya ho, moze paak hon, qadam ke us bhaag ko chhupaate hon jise wazu karte samay dhona farz hai, masah bari naapaaki nahin, balki chhoti naapaaki door karne ke liye kiya jaye aur shareeyat dvaara nirdhaarit samay ke andar kiya jaye. Shareeyat ne thahre hue vyakti ko ek din aur ek raat masah karne ki anumti di hai, jabki musaafir ko teen din aur teen raat ki anumti di hai.
"الخفين" Yaani chamre ke mozon par doosri cheezon se bane hue mozon ko bhi qayaas kiya jayega aur unpar masah karna bhi jayaz hoga.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka uttam aachran tatha shiksha dene ka behatreen tareeqa ki aapne mugheera radiyallahu anhu ko moze utaarne se mana kiya, to saath mein uska kaaran bhi bata diya ki moze wazu ki awastha mein pahne gae hain, taaki woh santusht ho jayen aur masla bhi maaloom ho jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3015: Bilaal raat rahte hi azaan dete hain, atah tum ibne umme maktoom ki azaan sunne tak khaate- peete raho

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) riwayat karte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah bilaal raat rahte hi azaan dete hain, atah tum ibne umme maktoom ki azaan sunne tak khaate- peete raho.

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke do muazzin the; bilaal bin abu rabaah aur abdullah bin umme maktoom, jo ki drishtiheen the (radiyallahu anhuma). Bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) fajr ki azaan, fajr ke samay se pahle hi dete the. Iska kaaran yeh tha ki yeh sone ka samay hai(yaani log phajr ki namaz se pahle neend mein hote hain) aur logon ko namaz ka nirdhaarit samay aane se pahle se taiyaari ki aawashyakta hoti hai. Atah, Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne saathiyon ko soochit karte the ki bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) raat rahte hi azaan dete hain. So, fajr tulu (phajr ka samay aane tak, jis mein phajr ki namaz ada ki jaati hai) hone tak khaate-peete raho, yahaan tak ki doosre muazzin yaani abdullah bin umme maktoom (radiyallahu anhu) azaan de den, jo ki dviteey fajr toolu hone par azaan diya karte hain. Yeh aadesh us vyakti ke liye hai, jo roza rakhna chaahe. Kyonki yahi woh samay hai, jab use khaana-peena chhorna hai aur namaz ka samay daakhil ho jaata hai. Yeh aadesh fajr ki naamaz ke saath khaas hai. Uske atirikt kisi any namaz ki azaan samay prawesh karne se pahle dena jayaz nahin hai. Phir fajr ki namaz ki pahli azaan ke baare mein matbhed hai ki kya fajr ki namaz ke liye wahi kaafi hai ya samay daakhil hone par doosri azaan dena zaroori hogi? Adhiktar ulma ke nikat woh azaan dena sahi to hai, parantu usi par bas nahin kiya jayega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3016: Aadmi ek neend soega aur uske dil se amaanat utha li jayegi. Kewal aska dhundhla- sa nishaan rah jayega. Phir aur ek neend lega, jiske saath uske dil se amaanat samaapt kar di jayegi. Kewal phaphole ki tarah uska nishaan baaqi rah jayega

Huzaifa bin yamaan (radiyallahu ahu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen do baaten bataai theen. Ek mainne dekh li hai aur doosri ki prateeksha mein hoon. Aapne hamen bataya ki amaanat logon ke dilon ki jar mein utri. Phir Qur'an utra aur logon ne use Qur'an aur sunnat se seekha aur jaana. Phir hamen amaanat ke uth jaane ke baare mein bataate hue kahaah "Aadmi ek neend soega aur uske dil se amaanat utha li jayegi. Kewal aska dhundhla- sa nishaan rah jayega. Phir aur ek neend lega, jiske saath uske dil se amaanat samaapt kar di jayegi. Kewal phaphole ki tarah uska nishaan baaqi rah jayega, jaise tum apne paanv par koi angaara lurhka do aur usmen chhaala par jaye, jiske kaaran tumhen ubhaar dikhaai dene lage, haalaanki uske andar kuchh nahin hota." Phir aapne dikhaane ke liye ek kankar liya aur use apne paanv par lurhka diya. "Phir haal yeh hoga ki log kray-wikray karenge, lekin koi amaanat ka paalan nahin karega. Yahaan tak ki kaha jayega ki amuk qabeele mein ek amaanatdaar vyakti hai. Ek vyakti ke baare mein kaha jayega ki woh kitna saahsi, shisht aur hoshiyaar hai! Lekin uske dil mein raai ke daane baraabar bhi eemaan na hoga." Ek samay tha, jab mujhe koi chinta nahin hoti thi ki main tummen se kisse kray- wikray kar raha hoon. Agar musalmaan hoga, to uska dharm use meri or waapas karega aur agar yahoodi ya nasraani hoga, to uska shaasak use meri or waapas karega. Parantu, aaj yeh haalat hai ki main tummen se amuk aur amuk ke siwa kisi se maamla nahin karta.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3017: Jab koi apne bhaai se mohabbat rakhe, to use bata de ki woh usse mohabbat rakhta hai.

Miqdaam bin maadeekrib radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jab koi apne bhaai se mohabbat rakhe, to use bata de ki woh usse mohabbat rakhta hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam is hadees mein eemaan waalon ke aapsi sanbandh ko mazboot karne waali aur unke andar paraspar prem ka maahaul banaane waali ek baat bata rahe hain. Woh baat yeh hai ki jab koi vyakti kisi se mohabbat rakhe to use bata de ki woh usse mohabbat rakhta hai.

Aisi wishuddh mohabbat ki fazeelat jo Allah ke liye rakhi jaye aur usse koi saansaarik hit jura hua na ho.
Jo vyakti kisi se Allah ke liye mohabbat rakhe, musathab yeh hai ki woh use bata de, taaki mohabbat aur barh jaye.
Eemaan waalon ke beech mohabbat ka maahaul banne se eemaani bhaaeechaara mazboot hogi aur samaaj bikhraav se surakshit rahega.
[ise abu daawood ne, tirmizi ne tatha nasai ne al-sunan al-kubra mein evn ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3018: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam joota pahanna, kanghi karna, pawitrata praapt karna tatha apne sabhi kaaryon ko dayen se karna pasand karte the.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam joota pahanna, kanghi karna, pawitrata praapt karna tatha apne sabhi kaaryon ko dayen se karna pasand karte the.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam sammaan yogy kaaryon ko dayen jaanib se aaranbh karna pasand karte the. Maslan : Joota pahante samay pahle dayen paanv mein pahanna, sar evn daarhi ke baalon ko kanghi karte, sanwaarte aur tel lagaate samay dayen jaanib se shuru karna, wazu karte samay dayen haath evn dayen paanv ko bayen haath evn bayen paanv se pahle dhona.

Imaam navvi kahte hain : Shareeyat ka ek saadhaaran siddhaant yeh hai ki har sammaan yogy kaary jaise kapra aur joota pahanna, masjid mein prawesh karna, misvaak karna, surma lagaana, naakhoon kaatna, monchhen taraashna, baal mein kanghi karna, bagal ke baal ukhaarna, sar munrvaana, namaz se salaam pherna, tahaarat ke angon ko dhona, shauchaalay se nikalna, khaana aur peena, musaafha karna evn hajar-e-asvad ko bosa dena aadi ko dayen haath se dayen jaanib se karna musathab hai. Jabki iske wipreet kaaryon, jaise shauchaalay mein prawesh karna, masjid se nikalna, naak saaf karna, istinja karna evn kapra tatha moza utaarna aadi ko bayen haath se ya bayen jaanbi se shuru karna musathab hai. Yeh sab kuchh daraasal dayen ke sammaan evn pratishtha ke kaaran hai.
Hadees ke shabdon "Dayen se karna pasand karte the" Ke andar: Kaaryon ka aaranbh dayen haath se, dayen paanv aur dayen jaanib se karna tatha kisi cheez ka lenden dayen haath se karna, sab shaamil hai.
Imaam navvi kahte hain : Jaan len ki wazu ke kuchh angon ke baare mein dayen se aaranbh musathab nahin hain. Ye ang hain, donon kaan, donon hatheliyaan aur donon gaal. In angon ko ek saath paak kiya jayega. Agar aisa karna sanbhav na ho, to dayen ko praathmikta di jayegi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3019: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka dayaan haath pawitrata praapt karne aur khaane ke liye tha. Jabki bayaan haath istinja karne (peshaab evn shoch karne ke baad, angon ko dhone) evn any safaai ke kaamon ke liye hota tha

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hainh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka dayaan haath pawitrata praapt karne aur khaane ke liye tha. Jabki bayaan haath istinja karne evn any safaai ke kaamon ke liye hota tha.
Hafsa (radiyallahu anha) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne dayen haath ko khaane-peene aur kapre pahanne ke liye istemaal karte the, jabki bayen haath ko any kaaryon ke liye rakhte the.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3020: Jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur aapke sahaaba makka aye, to bahudevvaadiyon ne kahaah tumhaare yahaan aise log a rahe hain, jinhen yasrib ke bukhaar ne durbal bana diya hai! Yeh sunkar Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apne sahaabiyon ko aadesh diya ki shuru ke teen chakkaron mein dulki chaal se chalen, kintu kaaba ke yamni rukn aur hajar-e- asvad waale rukn ke beech saadhaaran chaal se chalen

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hainh jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur aapke saathi makka aye, to bahudevvaadiyon ne kahaah tumhaare yahaan aise log a rahe hain, jinhen yasrib ke bukhaar ne durbal bana diya hai! Yeh sunkar Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apne saathiyon ko aadesh diya ki shuru ke teen chakkaron mein dulki chaal se chalen, kintu kaaba ke yamni rukn aur hajar-e- asvad waale rukn ke beech saadhaaran chaal se chalen. Unhen sabhi chakkaron mein dulki chaal se chalne ka aadesh kewal isliye nahin diya gaya ki unke saath aasaani barti jaye.

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) san chhah hijri mein Umrah ke iraade se makka aye. Saath mein bahut-se sahaabi bhi the. Udhar makka ke kaafir aapse yuddh karne tatha aapko Allah ke ghar kaaba se rokne ke liye nikal pare. Phir anttah, sulah ho gai. Jiske anusaar aapko us saal waapas jaana tha aur aane waale saal Umrah ke liye aana tha. We makka mein kewal teen din ruk sakte the. Atah, aap san saat hijri mein pichhle saal ka baaki Umrah ada karne ke liye aye. Aise mein mushrikon ne apne dilon ko sukoon pahunchaate aur musalmaanon ki haalat pe khush hote hue ek-doosre se kahaah dekho, tumhaare yahaan aise log a rahe hain, jinhen yasrib ke bukhaar ne durbal bana diya hai.
Jab Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko iski soochna mili, to unhen jawaab dene aur unke krodh ko aur barhaane ka man bana liya. Apne saathiyon ko aadesh diya ki tawaaf ke samay shuru ke teen chakkaron mein tez-tez qadmon se chalen. Haan, yamni rukn aur hajre asvad waale rukn ke beech saadhaaran chaal hi chalen. Saadhaaran chaal chalne ka aadesh aap ne musalmaanon ka khayaal rakhte hue diya. Waise bhi, jab we ukt donon rukn ke beech hote, to bahudevvaadiyon ki nazron se ojhal ho jaate the, jo musalmaanon ko tawaaf karte hue dekhne ke liye 'quaiqiaan' pahaari par charh gae the. Jab bahudevvaadiyon ne musalmaanon ko tez-tez kadmon se tawaaf karte hue dekha, to unke dvesh ki bhaavna aur tez ho gai. Kahne lageh yeh log to hiran ke bachchon jaise phurteele dikhaai parte hain! Baad mein, ise makka aane waalon ke liye tawaaf ke samay, sunnat bana diya gaya. Taaki ham apne guzre hue logon ko yaad rakhen aur wipreet paristhitiyon mein unke dhairy tatha Islam ke liye pesh ki jaane waali unki qurbaaniyon aur kaarnaamon ko aadarsh maante hue unke padchihnon par chalen. Allah hamen unke anusran tatha unke padchihnon par chalne ki saamarthy pradaan kare.
Yaad rahe ki donon ruknon ke beech tez chalne ke bajay saadhaaran chaal chalne ka aadesh mansookh (nirast) ho chuka hai. Kyonki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) 'hajjatul wada' ke avsar par hajre asvad se hajre asvad tak tez-tez kadmon se chale. Imaam Muslim ne jaabir aur ibne umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat kiya hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hajre asvad se hajre asvad tak teen chakkar tez-tez kadmon se chale aur chaar chakkaron mein saadhaaran chaal chale.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3021: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya hammen se koi janaabat (naapaaki) ki awastha mein so sakta hai? Aapne farmayaah haan, jab tummen se koi wazu kar le, to so sakta hai.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhuma) ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya hammen se koi janaabat (weery patan se hone waali naapaaki) ki awastha mein so sakta hai? Aapne farmayaah haan, jab tummen se koi wazu kar le, to so sakta hai.

Umar bin khattaab -radiyallahu anhu- ne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha ki yadi koi raat ke pratham bhaag mein apni stri se sanbhog kar le, yadyapi weery skhalan na hua ho, ya phir use svapnadosh ho jaye, to kya woh janaabat ki awastha mein so sakta hai? To aapne unhen iski anumti yeh kahte hue de di ki is bari naapaaki ko sharai wazu ke dvaara halka karna hoga. Uske baad yadi janaabat ki awastha mein so jaata hai, to koi baat nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3022: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) makka mein kada ki or se, batha ki oonchi ghaati se hote hue daakhil hue aur neechi ghaati se nikle

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) warnan karte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) makka mein kada ki or se, batha ki oonchi ghaati se hote hue daakhil hue aur neechi ghaati se nikle.

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab 'hajjatul wada' ke liye nikle, to chaar zil-hijja ki raat 'zi tuwa' naami sthaan mein guzaari. Agli subah oonchi ghaati se hote hue makka mein daakhil hue. Kyonki aap madeene se aye the aur aapke liye idhar se prawesh karna adhik aasaan tha. Phir jab Hajj ke saare kaary poore kar chuke, to makka ke nichle bhaag se madeene ki or nikle. Yeh wahi raasta hai, jo 'jarval' se hokar guzarta hai. Shayad raasta badalne ke peechhe yeh uddeshy raha ho ki adhik se adhik sthaanon mein ibaadat ke avsar praapt hon. Aisa aapne 'arfa' jaate-aate samay bhi kiya tha. Eedgaah jaate-aate samay bhi aap raasta badal liya karte the aur nafal namaz ke liye bhi farz namaz ke sthaan se hatkar khare hote the. Taaki dharti us din un ke amal ki gawaahi de, jis din woh apne seene mein dafan saari baaten saamne rakh degi. Aur aisa bhi ho sakta hai ki aapne aane-jaane ke liye wahi raaste chune hon, jo yaatra ke liye uchit the. Baaki, Allah adhik jaanta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3023: Ek din main hafsa ke ghar ki chhat par charha, to dekha ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) shaam (praant) ki or munh karke tatha kaaba ki or peeth karke shauch kar rahe hain.

Abdullah bin umar (raziyalllahu anhuma) se warnit hai, kahte hainh ek din main hafsa ke ghar ki chhat par charha, to dekha ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) shaam (praant) ki or munh karke tatha kaaba ki or peeth karke shauch kar rahe hain.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih aap baitul maqdis ki or peeth kiye hue the.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) bayaan karte hain ki ek din woh apni bahan tatha Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki patni hafsa (radiyallahu anha) ke yahaan aye aur unke ghar ke oopar charhe, to dekha ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) shauch kar rahe hain aur aapka chehra shaam ki or tatha peeth kaaba ki or hai. Daraasal, abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) ne yeh baat un logon ka khandan karte hue kahi thi, jinka kahna tha ki baitul makdis ki or chehra karke shauch karna sahi nahin hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki is kitaab ke sanklankarta ne iske pashchaat doosri riwayat ka ullekh kiya hai, jismen hai ki aapka chehra baitul maqdis ki or tha.
Atah, yadi koi shauchaalay ke andar qibla ki or munh karke shauch kare, to koi baat nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3024: Main achchhi tarah jaanta hoon ki tu ek patthar hai. Na haani pahuncha sakta hai aur na laabh de sakta hai. Yadi mainne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko tujhe choomte na dekha hota, to main tujhe na choomta.

Umar -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai ki woh hajar-e-asvad ke paas aye, use chooma aur farmaya : Main achchhi tarah jaanta hoon ki tu ek patthar hai. Na haani pahuncha sakta hai aur na laabh de sakta hai. Yadi mainne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko tujhe choomte na dekha hota, to main tujhe na choomta.

Ameerul momineen umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhu kaaba ke ek kinaare mein lage, hajar-e-asvad ke paas aye, use chooma aur phir kaha : Main bhali-bhaanti jaanta hoon ki tum ek patthar ho, na to haani pahuncha sakte ho aur na hi laabh, yadi mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko tumhen choomte hue na dekha hota, to main tumhen na choomta.

Tawaaf ke samay agar aasaani se sanbhav ho, to hajar-e-asvad ke saamne pahunchne par use choomna shareeyat sammat hai.
Hajar-e-asvad ko choomne ka uddeshy Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka anusran hai.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees ka arth yeh hai ki hajar-e-asvad ke andar kisi ka bhala ya bura karne ki shakti nahin hai. Any srishtiyon ki tarah, jinmen laabh ya haani pahunchaane ki shakti nahin hoti, yeh bhi ek srishti hai. Umar radiyallahu anhu ne Hajj ke dauraan yeh baat isliye kahi, taaki wibhinn kshetron aur shahron se aye hue log ise sunen aur apne man-mastishk mein basa len.
Saari ibaadten 'taukeefiya' hain (arthaat ye Allah ke aadeshon par ruki hui hain); kewal wahi ibaadat shareeyat sammat maani jayegi, jiski anumti Allah aur uske Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne di ho.
Jab koi ibaadat saabit ho, to uspar amal kiya jayega, yadyapi uski hikmat maaloom na bhi ho. Kyonki aadesh ka paalan tatha anusran karna bhi apekshit hikamton mein se ek hai.
Ibaadat ke taur par pattharon aadi, jinko choomna shareeyat se saabit na ho, ko choomna mana hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3025: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hajjatul wada ke avsar par oont par sawaar hokar tawaaf kiya. Aap mure hue kinaare waali chhari se hajre asvad ko chhu rahe the.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai, kahte hainh Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hajjatul wada ke avsar par oont par sawaar hokar tawaaf kiya. Aap mure hue kinaare waali chhari se hajre asvad ko chhu rahe the.

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hajjatul wada ke avsar par kaaba ka tawaaf kiya. Logon ki bari bheer thi. Kuchh log aapko tawaaf karte hue dekhna chaahte the aur kuchh log aapko ek nazar dekhne ke liye betaab the. Is tarah har taraf log hi log the. Aise mein aap apni ummat par kripa karte hue aur unke beech samaanta ka dhyaan rakhte hue oont par sawaar hokar tawaaf karne lage; taaki sab log baraabar roop se aap ko dekh saken. Aapke saath ek chhari bhi thi, jiska ek sira mura hua tha. Aap useese rukn ko chhu lete aur chhari ko bosa dete. Jaisa ki isi hadees ki Muslim ki riwayat mein hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3026: Mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko, kaaba ke do yamni ruknon ke atirikt kisi aur bhaag ko chhoote hue nahin dekha.
Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se warnit hai, kahte hainh mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko, kaaba ke do yamni ruknon ke atirikt kisi aur bhaag ko chhoote nahin dekha.

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kaaba ke chaaron ruknon mein se kewal hajre asvad waale rukn aur yamni rukn ko chhoote the. Chaaron ruknon mein poorbi rukn ki do wisheshtayen (fazeelten) hainh
1. Woh ibraaheem (alaihissalaam) ki rakhi hui neenv par qayam hai.
2. Usmen hajre asvad laga hua hai.
Jabki yamni rukn ki ek hi wisheshta hai. Woh ibraaheem (alaihissalaam) ki rakhi hui neenv par qayam hai.
Lekin shaami aur iraaqi rukn ko is tarah ki koi wisheshta praapt nahin hai. Kyonki unki buniyaad ibraaheem (alaihissalaam) ki rakhi hui neenv par nahin hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki hajre asvad ko chhoona aur bosa dena aur yamni rukn ko bosa dena to nahin, lekin chhoona sharai kaam hai. Lekin shesh do ruknon ko chhoona aur bosa dena sharai kaam nahin hai. Yahaan yeh dhyaan mein rahe ki shareeyat ki buniyaad anusran par hai. Yahaan apni or se koi nai cheez riwaaj dene ki anumti nahin hai. Waise Allah ke har sharai nirnay mein bahut-si hikamten chhipi hui hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3028: Main tumse kewal Allah ke liye mohabbat karta hoon. To usne kahaah woh bhi tumse mohabbat kare, jiske liye tumhen mujhse mohabbat hai.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ek vyakti Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas baitha hua tha ki ek aur vyakti uske paas se guzra. To usne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, main isse mohabbat karta hoon. Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Kya tumne use bataya hai?" Kahaah nahin. Farmayaah "Use bata do." Chunaanche, woh gaya aur usse kahaah main tumse kewal Allah ke liye mohabbat karta hoon. To usne kahaah woh bhi tumse mohabbat kare, jiske liye tumhen mujhse mohabbat hai.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3029: Yeh ek rag ka rakt hai. Kewal utne hi din namaz chhoro, jitne din isse pahle maahvaari aya karti thi. Phir snaan kar lo aur namaz parho.

Mominon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai ki faatima bint abu hubaish radiyallahu anha ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se fatva poochha. Unhonne kaha : Main ati rajasraav ki shikaar hoon tatha kabhi paak nahin ho paati. Aise mein kya main namaz chhor doon? Aapne kaha : "Nahin, yeh ek rag ka rakt hai. Kewal utne hi din namaz chhoro, jitne din isse pahle maahvaari aya karti thi. Phir snaan kar lo aur namaz parho."

Faatima bint hubaish radiyallahu anha ne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochha ki unka rakt band nahin hota aur maahvaari ke atirikt any dinon mein bhi rakt jaari rahta hai, to kya yeh rakt maahvaari ka rakt maana jayega aur woh namaz chhor sakti hain? Atah Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unse kaha ki yeh maahvaari ka nahin, balki istihaaza ka rakt hai. Beemaari ka yeh rakt garbhaashay ki nas phat jaane ke kaaran nikalta hai. Atah jab maahvaari ke woh din ayen, jin dinon mein istihaaza ki shikaar hone se pahle tumko niymit roop se maahvaari aya karti thi, to namaz evn roza aadi woh cheezen chhor do, jo maahvaari ke dinon mein mana hain. Phir jab maahvaari ki avdhi ke baraabar samay beet jaye, to tum maahvaari se paak ho gai. Isliye rakt ke sthaan ko dho daalo aur maahvaari se paaki ka snaan sanpoorn tareeqe se kar lo aur phir namaz parho.

Maahvaari ke din samaapt hone ke baad stri par snaan waajib hai.
Istihaaza ki shikaar aurat par snaan waajib hai.
Maahvaari : Ek praakritik rakt, jo ek wayask mahila ki yoni ke maadhyam se garbhaashay dvaara chhora jaata hai aur nirdisht dinon mein nikalta hai.
Istihaaza :  Garbhaashay ke garhe se nahin, balki uske upri bhaag se asaamyik rakt prawaah ko kahte hain.
Maahvaari ke rakt evn istihaaza ke rakt ke beech antar yeh hai ki maahvaari ka rakt kaala, gaarha aur badboodaar hota hai, jabki istihaaza ka rakt laal, patla aur badbu se khaali hota hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3030: Allah ke Rasool (salllalaahu alaihi wa sallam) shauch ke liye jaate, to main aur mere jaisa ek aur larka paani ka bartan aur ek chhoti-si barchhi lekar saath ho jaate. Tab aap us paani se istinja (pawitrata praapt) karte.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hainh Allah ke Rasool (salllalaahu alaihi wa sallam) shauch ke liye jaate, to main aur mere jaisa ek aur larka paani ka bartan aur ek chhoti-si barchhi lekar saath ho jaate. Chunaanche aap us paani se istinja (pawitrata praapt) karte.

Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke sewak anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) bayaan karte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab shauch ke sthaan par jaate, to woh aur unke saath ek aur larka aapke liye chamre ke bartan mein istinja ka paani lekar jaate, isi tarah ek chhoti-si barchhi bhi lekar jaate, jise zameen par gaar dete aur uspar chaadar ya is tarah ki koi or cheez daal dete, jo guzarne waalon ki nazar se bachaane ka kaam karti. Saath hi yadi namaz parhne ka iraada hota, to woh sutra ka bhi kaam deti.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3031: Apni safen seedhi kar liya karo; kyonki safon ko seedha karne ka sanbandh namaz ki poornata se hai.

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Apni safen seedhi kar liya karo; kyonki safon ko seedha karne ka sanbandh namaz ki poornata se hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam namaaziyon ko is baat ka aadesh de rahe hain ki apni safen baraabar kar liya karen. Koi kisi se aage rahe, na peechhe. Safon ko baraabar karna namaz ko sanpoorn banaane waali cheezon mein se hai, jabki unka terha rah jaana namaz mein kami paida karta hai.

Insaan ko un sabhi cheezon par dhyaan dena chahiye, jo namaz ko sanpoorn banayen aur use kamiyon se bachayen.
Yahaan shiksha ke sanbandh mein allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki hikmat saamne aati hai ki aapne aadesh ke saath uska nihit kaaran bhi bata diya, taaki aadesh ki hikmat spasht ho jaye aur insaan ke andar aajnaapaalan ka jazba paida ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3032: Allah taaala ke sammaan mein yeh baat bhi sammilit hai ki safed baal waale musalmaan ka tatha us kurvaan waale ka, jo na usmen atishyokti karta ho aur na usse bevfaai karta ho evn us prashaasak ka sammaan kiya jaye, jo nyayapriy ho.

Abu moosa ashaari (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Allah taaala ke sammaan mein yeh baat bhi sammilit hai ki safed baal waale musalmaan ka tatha us kurvaan waale ka, jo na usmen atishyokti karta ho aur na usse bevfaai karta ho evn us prashaasak ka sammaan kiya jaye, jo nyayapriy ho."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3033: Jab tummen se koi wazu kare, to apni naak mein paani daalkar naak jhaare, aur jo dhelon se istinja (shauch ya mootr se pawitrata arjan) kare, woh bejor (wisham) sankhya prayog kare

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jab tummen se koi wazu kare, to apni naak mein paani daalkar naak jhaare, aur jo dhelon se istinja (shauch ya mootr se pawitrata arjan) kare, woh bejor (wisham) sankhya prayog kare, aur jab tummen se koi neend se jaage, to apne haathon ko bartan mein daalne se pahle dho le, kyonki tummen se kisi ko nahin pata ki raat ke samay uska haath kahaan-kahaan gaya hai." Saheeh Muslim ke shabd hain : "Jab tummen se koi neend se jaage, to apne haath ko bartan mein us samay tak na duboe, jab tak use teen baar na dho le. Kyonki use nahin pata ki raat ke samay uska haath kahaan-kahaan gaya hai."

Yahaan Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne pawitrata praapt karne ke kuchh masayal bayaan kiye hain. Jaise : 1- wazu karne waala apni naak mein saans ke saath paani charhaye aur phir use saans ke saath nikaal de. 2- jo vyakti peshaab-paakhaane ke baad paani ki bajay kisi aur cheez, jaise patthar aadi ke zariye svachchhata praapt karna chaahe, woh patthaar aadi wisham sankhya mein prayog kare. Kam se kam sankhya teen ho aur adhik se adhik utni, jisse peshaab-paakhaana aadi khatm ho jaye aur sthaan paak ho jaye. 3- jo vyakti raat ko sokar uthe, woh wazu ke liye apna haath bartan ke andar us samay tak na daale, jab tak use bartan se baahar teen baar dho na le. Kyonki use nahin pata ki uska haath raat mein kahaan-kahaan gaya hoga. Aise mein uske ganda hone ki sanbhaavna rahti hai. Aisa bhi ho sakta hai ki uske haath ke saath shaitaan ne khela ho aur usmen koi aisi cheez laga di ho, jo insaan ke liye haanikaarak ho ya paani ko kharaab karne waali ho.

Wazu karte samay saans ke maadhyam se naak mein paani charhaana aur isi tarah saans ke maadhyam se paani baahar nikaalna waajib hai.
Istinja ke liye patthar wisham sankhya mein prayog karna musathab hai.
Raat mein sokar uthne ke baad donon haathon ko teen baar dhona shareeyat sammat kaary hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3034: Ai logo, shaanti banaye rakho, kyonki neki tez chalne hi se nahin milti.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) arfa ke din wahaan se muzadlifa ki or chale, to apne peechhe oont ko bahut zyaada daantne, maarne tatha oont ke cheekhne-chillaane ki aawaaz suni. Yeh dekh, apne kore se unki or ishaara kiya aur farmayaah "Ai logo, shaanti banaye rakho, kyonki neki tez chalne hi se nahin milti."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3035: Main isliye nahin ro rahi hoon ki mujhe yeh maaloom nahin ki Allah ke paas jo kuchh hai, woh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke liye uttam hai, balki isliye ro rahi hoon ki aakaash se wahy utarne ka silsila band ho gaya hai. Is tarah, unhonne donon ko rone par wiwash kar diya aur woh bhi unke saath rone lage.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki mrityu ke baad abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ne umar (radiyallahu anhu) se kahaah aao, ham umme aiman ke paas chalen. Unhen dekhne jayen, jaise Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) unhen dekhne jaya karte the. Jab donon unke paas pahunche, to woh ro pareen. Donon ne unse poochha ki aap kyon ro rahi hain? Kya aapko maaloom nahin ki Allah ke paas jo kuchh hai, woh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke liye uttam hai? To unhonne kahaah main isliye nahin ro rahi hoon ki mujhe yeh maaloom nahin ki Allah ke paas jo kuchh hai, woh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke liye uttam hai, balki isliye ro rahi hoon ki aakaash se wahy utarne ka silsila band ho gaya hai. Is tarah, unhonne donon ko rone par wiwash kar diya aur woh bhi unke saath rone lage.
3036: Ek dehaati aya aur masjid ke ek kinaare mein peshaab karne laga

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hainh ek dehaati aya aur masjid ke ek kinaare mein peshaab karne laga. Yeh dekh, log use daantne lage, to Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne logon ko isse roka. Phir jab woh peshaab kar chuka, to Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek baalti paani laane ka aadesh diya aur use peshaab ke oopar baha diya gaya.

Dehaat ke log choonki Allah ki or se Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) par utarne waali shareeyat ko seekh nahin sake the, isliye unke andar ajnaanta aur uddandta jaisi cheezen maujood theen.
Ek din Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne saathiyon ke saath masjide nabvi mein baithe the ki ek dehaati aya aur use ek saadhaaran sthaan samajhkar uske ek kinaare mein peshaab karne laga. Sahaaba ke dil mein choonki masjid ka bara sammaan tha, isliye uska yeh kaam unpar bhaari para. Atah, unhonne use peshaab karte dekh daantna shuru kar diya. Lekin, Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne, jo aadarsh vyavhaar ke svaroop the aur khushkhabri dene waale tatha aasaani paida karne waale ke roop mein aye the, unhen daantne se mana kiya. Kyonki aap arbon ka svabhaav jaante the. Saath hi daantne se uska shareer athva kapra ganda ho sakta tha aur achaanak peshaab rukne ke kaaran use nuksaan bhi pahunch sakta tha. Yeh bhi uddeshy saamne tha ki daantne ke bajay baad mein Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab use samjhayen to woh aap ki baat qabool kare. Aapne aadesh diya ki uske peshaab ke sthaan ko ek baalti paani bahaakar saaph kar liya jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3037: Jab aadmi apne ghar mein prawesh karta hai aur prawesh karte samay evn khaana khaate samay Allah ka naam leta hai, to shaitaan apne saathiyon se kahta hai : Yahaan na tumhaare liye raat bitaane ka sthaan hai aur na raat ke khaane ka prabandh

Jaabir bin abdullah radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki unhonne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Jab aadmi apne ghar mein prawesh karta hai aur prawesh karte samay evn khaana khaate samay Allah ka naam leta hai, to shaitaan apne saathiyon se kahta hai : Yahaan na tumhaare liye raat bitaane ka sthaan hai aur na raat ke khaane ka prabandh. Aur jab woh ghar mein prawesh karta hai tatha prawesh karte samay Allah ka naam nahin leta, to shaitaan kahta hai : Tumne raat bitaane ka sthaan pa liya aur jab khaana khaate samay Allah ka naam nahin leta, to kahta hai : Tumne raat bitaane ki jagah tatha raat ka khaana donon pa liya."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ghar mein prawesh karte samay aur khaana khaane se pahle Allah ka naam lene ka aadesh diya hai. Jab koi vyakti ghar mein prawesh karte aur khaana khaate samay bismillah kahta hai, to shaitaan apne sahyogiyon se kahta hai ki tumhaare liye is ghar mein raat guzaarne ka sthaan aur raat ke khaane ka prabandh nahin hai, kyonki ghar ke maalik ne tumse Allah ki sharan le li hai. Iske wipreet jab koi vyakti ghar mein daakhil hota hai aur ghar mein daakhil hote tatha khaana khaate samay Allah ka naam nahin leta, to shaitaan apne sahyogiyon se kahta hai ki is ghar mein unke raat guzaarne tatha khaane ka prabandh ho gaya hai.

Ghar mein daakhil hote tatha khaana khaate samay Allah ka naam lena musathab hai. Kyonki Allah ka naam na lene par shaitaan ghar mein raat guzaarta hai aur khaane mein shareek ho jaata hai.
Shaitaan insaan ke har kaam ko dhyaan se dekhta rahta hai aur jaise hi insaan Allah ke naam se ghaafil hota hai, uski muraad poori ho jaati hai.
Allah ka zikr shaitaan ko bhagaata hai.
Har shaitaan ke kuchh anusrankaari tatha sahyogi hote hain, jo uski baat se khush hote aur uske aadesh ka paalan karte hain.
3038: Aap hamaare paas jitni baar aate hain, usse adhik kyon nahin aate?

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne jibreel se kaha ki aap hamaare paas jitni baar aate hain, usse adhik kyon nahin aate? To yeh ayat utreeh "وَمَا نَتَنَزَّل إِلاَّ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنا وَمَا بَينَ ذَلِك" (Ham kewal tere rab ke aadesh se hi utarte hain. Jo kuchh hamaare saamne tatha jo kuchh hamaare peechhe tatha jo kuchh iske beech hai, sab usi ka hai.)
3039: Mainne dekha ki aap qible ke atirikt kisi aur disha ki or munh karke namaz parh rahe hain? To unhonne jawaab diyaah yadi mainne Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko aisa karte na dekha hota, to aisa na karta.

Anas bin seereen kahte hain ki anas (radiyallahu anhu) ki shaam praant se waapsi ke avsar par hamne unka svaagat kiya. Ham unse ain-at-tamar naami sthaan mein mile. Mainne unko dekha ki gadhe par sawaar hokar namaz parh rahe hain aur unka chehra is or (arthaat qible ke daahini or) hai. Mainne unse kahaah mainne dekha ki aap qible ke atirikt kisi aur disha ki or munh karke namaz parh rahe hain? To unhonne jawaab diyaah yadi mainne Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko aisa karte na dekha hota, to aisa na karta.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) shaam aye. Choonki woh ek pratishthit evn jnaanvaan sahaabi the, isliye log unke svaagat ke liye nikle. Saheeh Muslim ki riwayat mein yahi hai ki "Shaam aye", lekin uska arth haih "Jab woh shaam aye the, to waapsi ke samay ham unke svaagat ke liye nikle." Yahaan waapsi ki baat ka ullekh maaloom hone ke kaaran nahin kiya gaya. Kyonki jab woh shaam se a rahe the, to we unse milne ke liye basra se nikle the.
Warnankarta, (jo khud bhi svaagat karne waalon mein shaamil the), kahte hain ki unhonne anas bin maalik ko dekha ki we gadhe par sawaar hokar namaz parh rahe hain aur qibla unki daaeen jaanib hai. Atah is wishay mein unse poochh hi daala. Chunaanche woh bole ki unhonne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko aisa karte dekha hai. Yadi unhonne aapko aisa karte na dekha hota, to aisa na karte.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3040: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) (madeene se) al-shajra ke raaste se nikalte aur al-muarras ke raaste se andar aate. Aur jab makka mein prawesh karte, to oonchi ghaati se prawesh karte aur nichli ghaati se nikalte.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) farmaate hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) (madeene se) al-shajra ke raaste se nikalte aur al-muarras ke raaste se andar aate. Aur jab makka mein prawesh karte, to oonchi ghaati se prawesh karte aur nichli ghaati se nikalte.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3042: Jo Allah par tatha qayaamat ke din par eemaan rakhta ho, woh atithi ka sammaan karne ke maamle mein uska haq ada kare. Sahaaba ne kahaah uska haq kya hai, ai Allah ke Rasool? To farmayaah ek din aur ek raat tatha atithi satkaar teen din hai. Jo isse adhik ho woh atithi ke oopar sadqa hai.

Abu shuraih khuwailid bin amr khuzaai kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayah "Jo Allah par tatha qayaamat ke din par eemaan rakhta ho, woh atithi ka sammaan karne ke maamle mein uska haq ada kare. Sahaaba ne kahaah uska haq kya hai, ai Allah ke Rasool? To farmayaah ek din aur ek raat tatha atithi satkaar teen din hai. Jo isse adhik ho woh atithi ke oopar sadqa hai."
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih "Kisi musalmaan ke liye jayaz nahin ki apne bhaai ke paas itne din rahe ki use paapi bana de. Sahaaba ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, woh use paapi kaise bana sakta hai? To aapne farmayaah "Woh uske paas thahra rahe, jabki uske paas uske satkaar ke liye kuchh na ho."
[ise donon riwayton ke saath Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3043: Mainne ansaariyon ko Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath ek aisa aadarpoorn vyavhaar karte dekha hai ki mainne qasam kha li hai ki jab bhi unmen se kisi ke saath rahoonga, to uski sewa karoonga.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki main jareer bin abdullah bajli (radiyallahu anhu) ke saath ek yaatra mein nikla, to woh meri sewa karne lage. Mainne unse kaha ki aisa na karen, to unhonne kahaah mainne ansaariyon ko Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath ek aisa aadarpoorn vyavhaar karte dekha hai ki mainne qasam kha li hai ki jab bhi unmen se kisi ke saath rahoonga, to uski sewa karoonga.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3044: Bare gunaah hain, Allah ka saajhi banaana, maata-pita ki awajna karna, kisi ki hatya karna aur jhoothi qasam khaana.

Abdullah bin amr bin aas radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Bare gunaah hain, Allah ka saajhi banaana, maata-pita ki awajna karna, kisi ki hatya karna aur jhoothi qasam khaana."

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bare gunaah bayaan kar rahe hain. Daraasal bare gunaah se muraad woh gunaah hain, jinmen lipt hone waale ko duniya ya aakhirat ki koi sakht chetaavni di gai ho.

Chunaanche sabse pahla bara gunaah hai Allah ka saajhi thahraana : Yaani koi bhi ibaadat Allah ke atirikt kisi aur ke liye karna aur Allah ke atirikt ko Allah ki wisheshtaaon mein alaah ke baraabar kar dena, arthaath rab hone, poojy hone aur Allah ke naamon tatha gunon mein kisi ko Allah ke baraabar la khara karna.

Doosra bara gunaah hai maata-pita ki awajna karna : Yaani koi aisa kaam karna, baat kahna ya unke saath achchha vyavhaar karna chhor dena, jisse unko kasht ho.

Teesra bara gunaah hai ki kisi ki awaidh hatya karna : Jaise atyaachaar karke kisi ko maar daalna.

Chautha bara gunaah hai jhoothi qasam khaana : Yaani jaan-boojhkar jhoothi qasam khaana. Ise arbi mein "Yameen-e-ghamoos" Isliye kaha jaata hai ki yeh kaam insaan ko gunaah ya aag ke samudr mein duba deta hai.

Jhoothi qasam itna bara gunaah aur bhayaawah apraadh hai ki iska kaffaara  (prayashchit) nahin hai. Iski maafi ke liye tauba zaroori hai.
Is hadees mein in chaar kabeera gunaahon ka zikr inki sangeeni ko saamne rakhte hue kiya gaya hai. Yeh bataane ke liye nahin ki kabeera gunaah bas chaar hi hain.
Gunaahon ke do prakaar hain. Kabeera gunaah aur sagheera gunaah. Kabeera gunaah har woh gunaah hai, jiski koi duniyaawi saza nirdhaarit ho. Jaise  hudood evn laanat aadi. Ya phir jispar koi aakhirat ki chetaavni di gai ho. Jaise Jahannam mein prawesh karne ki chetaavni. Kabeera gunaah kai shreniyon ke hote hain. Kuchh kabeera gunaah any kuchh ke muqaable mein adhik sakht haraam hote hain. Sagheera gunaah kabeera gunaahon ko chhor any gunaahon ko kahte hain.
3045: Jihaad ka ek bahut bara roop kisi atyaachaari shaasak ke saamne nyay ki baat karna hai.
Abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jihaad ka ek bahut bara roop kisi atyaachaari shaasak ke saamne nyay ki baat karna hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki Allah ki raah mein jihaad ka ek mahatvapoorn evn laabhdayak roop kisi atyaachaari shaasak ke saamne sachchi evn nyay ki baat karna hai. Kyonki yeh achchhe kaary ka aadesh dene aur bure kaary se rokne ke dayre mein aata hai. Yeh kaary chaahe kathan dvaara kiya jaye, kaary dvaara kiya jaye, likhit roop se kiya jaye ya kisi any tareeqe se, jisse uddeshy poora ho jaye aur buraai door ho jaye.

Achchhi baat ka aadesh dena aur buri baat se rokna bhi jihaad hai.
Shaasak ko naseehat karna bahut bara jihaad hai. Lekin yeh kaary jnaan, doordarshita (hikmat) aur nishchitta  ke saath hona chahiye.
Khattaabi kahte hain : Yeh sabse utkrisht jihaad isliye hai ki dushman se jihaad karne waala bhay evn aasha donon rakhta hai. Use jeet haar ka pata nahin hota. Jabki shaasak ke saamne haq baat bolne waala khud ko khatre ke munh mein daal raha hota hai. Ek tarah se woh khud ko winaash ke saamne la khara kar deta hai. Isi paridrishy mein ise sabse utkrisht jihaad kaha gaya hai. Kuchh logon ke anusaar ise sabse utkrisht jihaad isliye kaha gaya hai ki yadi shaasak ne baat maan li, to bahut bari sankhya mein log laabhaanvit ho sakte hain.
[hasan li-ghairihi (any sandon athva riwayton ke saath milkar hasan)]
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3046: Umme habeeba (radiyallahu anha) saat saal tak istihaaza (woh rakt jo stri ko maahvaari ke atirikt beemaari ke kaaran aata hai) ka shikaar raheen. Atah, rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se uske baare mein poochha, to aapne unhen aadesh diya ki snaan kar len.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se riwayat hai, woh kahti hainh umme habeeba (radiyallahu anha) saat saal tak istihaaza (woh rakt jo stri ko maahvaari ke atirikt beemaari ke kaaran aata hai.) ki shikaar raheen. Atah, rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se uske baare mein poochha, to aapne unhen aadesh diya ki snaan kar len. Aaisha radiyallahu anha kahti hainh iske baad woh pratyek namaz ke liye snaan kiya karti theen.

Umme habeeba (radiyallahu anha) ne jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se poochha ki un ko maahvaari ke dinon ke atirikt bhi baraabar khoon aata hai, aise mein unhen kya karna chahiye? To aapne jawaab diya ki woh snaan kar len. Atah, woh har namaz ke liye snaan karti theen. Unhen yeh beemaari, jise arbi mein istihaaza kaha jaata hai, saat saal tak rahi. Istihaaza se striyon ko kabhi-kabhi joojhna parta hai. Saadhaarnatya striyon ko har maheene mein kuchh din ritu ka rakt aata hai, jise we uske lakshanon se pahchaan leti hain.
Daraasal, umme habeeba (radiyallahu anha) har namaz ke liye snaan nafli taur par karti theen.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3047: Tummen se koi thahre hue paani mein, jo bahta na ho, peshaab na kare ki phir usse nahaye bhi.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Tummen se koi thahre hue paani mein, jo bahta na ho, peshaab na kare ki phir usse nahaye bhi."
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih "Tummen se koi janaabat ki haalat mein thahre hue paani mein snaan na kare."

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne thahre hue paani mein, jo bahta na ho, peshaab karne se mana kiya hai. Kyonki isse paani ganda hota hai aur kabhi-kabhi peshaab ke maadhyam se usmen kuchh beemaariyaan prawesh kar jaati hain, jo paani ka prayog karne waale har vyakti ko haani pahuncha sakti hain. Balki aisa bhi sanbhav hai khud peshaab karne waale ko us paani se nahaana pare. To aadmi us paani mein peshaab kaise kar sakta hai, jisse baad mein khud useeko pawitrata praapt karni ho?
Isi tarah, thahre hue paani se janaabat ka snaan karne se mana kiya hai. Kyonki isse paani mein janaabat ki gandgiyaan prawesh kar jaati hain.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3049: Striyon ke saath achchha vyavhaar karo, kyonki stri pasli se paida ki gai hai aur pasli ka sabse terha bhaag uska oopri bhaag hai. Yadi tum use seedha karne jaaoge, to use tor doge aur yadi use chhor doge, to hamesha terhi hi rahegi. Atah, striyon ke saath achchha vyavhaar karo.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Striyon ke saath achchha vyavhaar karo, kyonki stri pasli se paida ki gai hai aur pasli ka sabse terha bhaag uska oopri bhaag hai. Yadi tum use seedha karne jaaoge, to use tor doge aur yadi use chhor doge, to hamesha terhi hi rahegi. Atah, striyon ke saath achchha vyavhaar karo."
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih "Stri pasli ki tarah hai, yadi use seedha karne jaaoge, to use tor doge aur yadi usse laabh uthaate rahoge, to uske terhepan ke saath laabh uthaate rahoge."
Ek aur riwayat mein haih "Stri pasli se paida ki gai hai, jo kabhi seedhi nahin ho sakti. Yadi usse laabh uthaate rahe, to usek terhepan ke saath laag uthaate rahoge aur yadi seedha karne gae, to tor doge. Use torne ka arth talaaq dena hai."
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise donon riwayton ke saath Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3051: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek aadmi ko dekha, jisne logon ke saath namaz nahin parhi thi aur sabse alag tha. Aapne farmayaah "Ai amuk, aakhir kya baat hai ki toone logon ke saath namaz nahin parhi?" Usne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, main junbi (naapaak) ho gaya hoon aur paani bhi na mil saka. Aapne farmayaah "Tum mitti ka prayog karo. Woh tumhaare liye kaafi hai."

Imraan bin husain (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek aadmi ko dekha, jisne logon ke saath namaz nahin parhi thi aur sabse alag tha. Aapne farmayaah "Ai amuk, aakhir kya baat hai ki toone logon ke saath namaz nahin parhi?" Usne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, main junbi (naapaak) ho gaya hoon aur paani bhi na mil saka. To aapne farmayaah "Tum mitti ka prayog karo. Woh tumhaare liye kaafi hai."

Ek din Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apne saathiyon ko fajr ki namaz parhaai. Namaz parh chuke to dekha ki ek aadmi ne unke saath namaz nahin parhi. Choonki aap bare dayaalu the tatha Allah ki or bulaane ka kaary kaise kiya jaye, iska poorn jnaan rakhte the, isliye use daantne ke bajay usse jamaaat mein shareek na hone ka kaaran jaanna chaaha. Farmayaah ai amuk, tum ne logon ke saath namaz kyon nahin parhi? Usne (apni samajh ke anusaar) kaaran yeh bataya ki woh junbi (use naapaaki pahunchi hai) hai aur uske paas paani nahin hai, atah usne paani milne tatha pawitrata praapt karne tak namaz ko wilanb karne ka nirnay liya hai. Yeh sunkar Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah Allah ne tumhen (apni kripa se) pawitrata praapt karne ke liye paani ke sthaan par ek aur wastu pradaan ki hai. Arthaat matti di hai. Tum uska prayog kar lo. Woh tumhaare liye paani ke sthaan par paryaapt hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3052: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) mina aye, to jamra pahunchkar kankri maari, phir mina mein apne thaharne ke sthaan par aye aur qurbaani ki tatha sar ke baal moonrne waale se kahaah "Sar ke baal moonr do." Saath hi aapne pahle sar ke dayen bhaag ki or ishaara kiya aur phir bayen bhaag ki or ishaara kiya. Phir munre hue baal logon ko dene lage.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) mina aye, to jamra pahunchkar kankri maari, phir mina mein apne thaharne ke sthaan par aye aur qurbaani ki tatha sar ke baal moonrne waale se kahaah "Sar ke baal moonr do." Saath hi aapne pahle sar ke dayen bhaag ki or ishaara kiya aur phir bayen bhaag ki or ishaara kiya.Phir munre hue baal logon ko dene lage.
Ek aur riwayat mein haih jab jamra mein kankar phenk chuke aur qurbaani ka jaanvar zabah kar chuke, to sar ke baal moonrne waale ko sar ka dayaan bhaag barhaya. Usne baal moonr diye to abu talha ansaari (radiyallahu anhu) ko bulaya aur baal unko de diye. Phir use sar ka bayaan bhaag barhaya aur kahaah "Moonr do." Usne moonr diya to baal abu talha ko de diye aur farmayaah "Inhen logon ke beech baant do."
[ise imaam Muslim ne donon riwayton ke saath naqal kiya hai.]
3053: Nishchay hi duniya meethi aur hari-bhari hai aur Allah tumhen usmen uttaraadhikaari banaane waala hai, taaki dekh sake ki tum kis tarah ke kaam karte ho. Atah, duniya se bacho evn striyon se bacho

Abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Nishchay hi duniya meethi aur hari-bhari hai aur Allah tumhen usmen uttaraadhikaari banaane waala hai, taaki dekh sake ki tum kis tarah ke kaam karte ho. Atah, duniya se bacho evn striyon se bacho. Kyonki banu israaeel ki pahli pareeksha striyon hi ke wishay mein thi."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki duniya ka svaad meetha hai aur woh dekhne mein hari-bhari hai, jiske kaaran log uske dhokhe mein a jaate hain aur ismen itna leen ho jaate hain ki use hi apne dhyaan ka kendr bana lete hain. Jabki Allah ne is saansaarik jeewan mein hamen ek-doosre ka uttaraadhikaari banaya hai, taaki yeh dekhe ki hamaara amal kaisa rahta hai? Ham uske bataye hue tareeqe ke anusaar jeewan guzaarte hain ya uske aadeshon ka ullanghan karte hain? Uske baad farmaya : Is baat se saavdhaan rahna ki duniya  ki sukh-suwidhayen aur uski chamak-damak tumko dhokhe mein daal de aur Allah ki aadeshit cheezon ko chhorne aur uski mana ki hui cheezon mein parne par aamaada kar len. Duniya ke jin fitnon se sabse zyaada bachna zaroori hai, unmen se ek fitna aurton ka fitna hai. Bani israaeel ka pahla fitna aurton hi se sanbandhit tha.

Parhezgaari (dharmaprayanta) ke maarg par chalne aur duniya ki zaahiri chamak-damak ke shikaar na hone ki prerna.
Ismen aurton ke fitne mein parne, jaise ajanbi aurton ko dekhne aur unke saath ekaant mein rahne aadi se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai.
Aurton ka fitna duniya ke bare fitnon mein se ek hai.
Pichhli ummaton se naseehat aur sabak lene chahiye. Kyonki jo kuchh bani israaeel ke saath hua, woh doosron ke saath bhi ho sakta hai.
Aurat ke fitne ke wibhinn roop hain. Jab woh patni hoti hai, to kabhi-kabhi mard ko itna kharch karne par majboor karti hai, jo uski kshamta se baahar hota hai, jiski wajah se woh deen ke kaamon mein samay nahin de paata aur khud ko duniya ki talab mein laga deta hai. Aur jab woh ajanbi aurat hoti hai aur ghar se saj-dhajkar beparda hokar baahar nikalti tatha mardon ke saath ghulti-milti hai, to wibhinn shreniyon ke vyabhichaar ke dvaar khulte hain. Isliye ek momin ko aurton ke fitne se suraksha ke liye Allah ki sharan leni chahiye.
3054: Jo kisi baat par qasam kha le, phir usse adhik parhezgaari waali baat dekhe, to parhezgaari waala kaary kare.

Abu tareef adi bin haatim (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh "Jo kisi baat par qasam kha le, phir usse adhik parhezgaari waali baat dekhe, to parhezgaari waala kaary kare."
3055: Haya kewal bhalaai hi laati hai.
