Imraan bin husain (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke rasu (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Haya kewal bhalaai hi laati hai."
Ek aur riwayat mein haih "Haya bhalaai hi bhalaai hai." Ya phir farmayaah "Haya sanpoorn roop se bhalaai hai."

Haya insaan ka aisa gun hai, jo insaan ko apne vyaktitv ko suroop evn sushobhit banaane waale kaaryon ko karne tatha kuroop evn ashobhit karne waale kaaryon se door rahne par aamaada karti hai. Yahi kaaran hai haya kewal bhalaai hi laati hai. Is hadees ka paridrishy yeh hai ki ek vyakti apne bhaai ko haya ke baare samjha-bujha raha tha aur use haya karne se rok raha tha. Aise mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne yeh baat kahi.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3056: “Ai Allah! Mainne apne aapko tere saamne samarpit kar diya, tujhpar eemaan laya, tujhpar bharosa kiya, teri or lauta aur teri madad se dushmanon se jhagra kiya. Ai Allah! Main tere prabhutv ki sharan mein aata hoon ki tere siwa koi saty poojy nahin, is baat se ki tu mujhe gumraah kare. Tu jeewant hai, jise kabhi maut nahin aati, jabki jinn aur insaan marte hain.”

Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : “Ai Allah! Mainne apne aapko tere saamne samarpit kar diya, tujhpar eemaan laya, tujhpar bharosa kiya, teri or lauta aur teri madad se dushmanon se jhagra kiya. Ai Allah! Main tere prabhutv ki sharan mein aata hoon ki tere siwa koi saty poojy nahin, is baat se ki tu mujhe gumraah kare. Tu jeewant hai, jise kabhi maut nahin aati, jabki jinn aur insaan marte hain.”

Nabi ﷺ ki yeh dua thi: (Allahumma laka aslamtu) yaani ai Allah! Main tera aajnaakaari ban gaya, (wa bika aamantu) tujhpar eemaan laya, teri pushti ki aur tere prati apni sveekaarokti vyakt ki, (wa alaika tawakkaltu) tujhpar bharosa kiya aur apne saare maamlaat tere hawaale kar diye, (wa ilaika anabtu) teri or laut aya, (wa bika khaasamtu) tatha teri madad se tere dushmanon se waad-wiwaad kiya. (Allahumma inni aooju biizzatika) ai Allah! Main tere sammaan, shakti aur prabhutv ke sharan mein aata hoon, (la ilaah illa anat) ki tere siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai, (an tuzillani) is baat se ki tu mujhe saty evn apni prasannata ke maarg se hata de. (Antal hayyul lazi la yamootu) tu hi sada jeewit rahne waali hasti hai, jise kabhi maut nahin a sakti aur jo kabhi fana nahin ho sakti. (Wal jinnu wal insu yamootoon)  jabki jinnon evn insaanon ko marna hai.

Allah se kuchh maangne se pahle uski stuti gaan karna chahiye.
Kewal Allah hi par bharosa karna chahiye aur usi se suraksha maangni chahiye. Kyonki woh har etbaar se sanpoorn evn paripoorn hai, isliye kewal usi par bharoosa kiya ja sakta hai. Jabki saari srishtiyaan asmarth, wiwash tatha nashvar hain. Atah unpar bharosa karne ka koi matlab nahin banta.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke padchihnon par chalte hue in saargarbhit shabdon dvaara dua karni chahiye, jo sachche eemaan evn drirh wishvaas ko vyakt karte hain.
Sindhi kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke shabd "Tu hi jeewit hai" Ka arth hai: Isliye kewal tujh hi se sharan maangni chahiye, kisi aur se nahin.
[Bukhari evn Muslim ne ise riwayat kiya hai, tatha uprokt shabd Muslim dvaara warnit hain aur Bukhari ne ise sankshep mein riwayat kiya hai]
3058: Main tere dharm, teri amaanat aur tere antim karmon ko Allah ke hawaale karta hoon.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) yaatra par nikalne waale vyakti se kahte theh mere paas aao, taaki main tumhen usi tarah wida karoon, jaise Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hamen wida karte the. Aap farmaate theh "Main tere dharm, teri amaanat aur tere antim karmon ko Allah ke hawaale karta hoon."
Tatha abdullah bin yazeed khatmi (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab sena ko wida karte, to farmaateh "Main tumhaare dharm, tumhaari amaanat aur tumhaare antim karmon ko Allah ke hawaale karta hoon."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3059: Apne pariwaar or waapas jaao, unke beech raho, unhen shiksha pradaan karo, aadesh do aur amuk namaz amuk samay mein tatha amuk namaz amuk samay mein parho. Jab namaz ka samay a jaye, to tummen se ek vyakti tumhaare liye azaan de aur tummen sabse adhik ayu waala vyakti tumhaari imaamat kare.

Abu sulaimaan maalik bin huwairis (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ham log Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aye. Ham log us samay lagbhag samaan ayu waale jawaan the. Ham aapke paas bees din thahre. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) bahut hi dayaalu aur naram svabhaav ke maalik the. Aapko laga ki ham log apne pariwaar ki or lautne ki ichchha rakhte hain, isliye hamse hamaare pariwaar ke baare mein poochha, to hamne aapko bataya. Ispar aapne farmayaah "Apne pariwaar or waapas jaao, unke beech raho, unhen shiksha pradaan karo, aadesh do aur amuk namaz amuk samay mein tatha amuk namaz amuk samay mein parho. Jab namaz ka samay a jaye, to tummen se ek vyakti tumhaare liye azaan de aur tummen sabse adhik ayu waala vyakti tumhaari imaamat kare."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3060: Mainne kabhi Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko is tarah khil-khilaakar hanste hue nahin dekha ki aapke gale ka kaua nazar aane lage. Aap kewal muskuraya karte the.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Mainne kabhi Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko is tarah khil-khilaakar hanste hue nahin dekha ki aapke gale ka kaua nazar aane lage. Aap kewal muskuraya karte the.

Aaisha radiyallahu anha bataati hain ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam is tarah khilkhilaakar nahin hanste the ki kaua yaani gale ke oopri bhaag mein latka maans ka tukra, nazar a jaye. Aap kewal muskuraya karte the.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab kisi cheez ko pasand karte ya kisi cheez se khush hote, to bas muskura diya karte the.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko is tarah khilkhilaakar hanste hue nahin dekha ki aapka poora shareer hansne mein laga ho.
Bahut zyaada hansna aur thahaake lagaana Allah ke nek bandon ka tareeqa nahin hai.
Atyadhik hansi vyakti ki garima aur logon ke beech uske bhay ko nasht kar deti hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3061: Hamne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se kathinaai aur aasaani mein, chusti aur susti mein aur hamaare oopar tarjeeh diye jaane ki awastha mein bhi sunenge aur anusran karenge

Ubaada bin saamit radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Hamne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se kathinaai aur aasaani mein, chusti aur susti mein aur hamaare oopar tarjeeh diye jaane ki awastha mein bhi sunenge aur anusran karenge. Aur is baat par baiat ki ki ham shaaskon se shaasan ke maamle mein nahin jhagrenge aur jahaan kaheen bhi honge, haq baat kahenge aur is wishay mein kisi ninda karne waale ki ninda ki parvaah nahin karenge.

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne saathiyon se is baat ki pratijna li ki we aasaan tatha kathin haalat aur dhanvaan tatha nirdhan hone ki awastha mein, shaaskon ke aadesh unko pasand hon ya na hon, yahaan tak ki shaasak saarvajnik dhan evn padon aadi ke maamle mein unpar kisi aur ko tarjeeh hi kyon na dete hon, unki baat maankar chalenge aur unke wiruddh baghaawat nahin karenge. Kyonki unse larne ke neteeje mein jo fitna wa fasaad machega, woh unke atyaachaar ke nateeje mein hone waale fitna wa fasaad se adhik bara hai. Aapne unse is baat ki bhi pratijna li ki jahaan bhi rahenge Allah ke liye saty hi kahenge aur kisi ki ninda ki parvaah nahin karenge.

Shaaskon ki sunne aur unka anusran ka parinaam yeh hoga ki musalmaan ekjut rahenge aur unke beech phoot nahin paregi.
Shaaskon ki baaton ko, jab tak we Allah ki naafarmaani ka aadesh na den, sunna aur maanna zaroori hai. Aasaan paristhiti mein bhi aur kathin paristhiti mein bhi. Pasand ho tab bhi aur naapsand ho tab bhi tatha kisi aur ko tarjeeh di jaye, tab bhi.
Ham jahaan bhi rahen, kisi ki ninda ki parvaah kiye bina saty kahna waajib hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3062: Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se das rakaat seekhi hain

Abdullah bin umar  radiyallahu anhuma se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se das rakaat seekhi hain. Zohar se pahle do rakaat, uske baad do rakaat, magrib ke baad ghar mein do rakaat, isha ke baad ghar mein do rakaat aur subah ki namaz se pahle do rakaat. Daraasal yeh aisa samay tha, jab Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke yahaan koi jaata nahin tha. Mujhe hafsa ne bataya ki jab muazzin azaan deta aur fajr namoodaar ho jaata, to aap do rakaat parhte. Jabki ek sthaan mein hai : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam juma ke baad do rakaat parhte the.

Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma bata rahe hain ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se jo nafal namaazen seekhi hain, unki sankhya das rakaat hai. In nawaafil ko sunan-e-rawaatib kaha jaata hai. Do rakaat zohar se pahle aur do rakaat zohar ke baad. Do rakaat maghrib ke baad ghar mein. Do rakaat isha ke baad ghar mein. Do rakaat fajr se pahle. Is tarah kul das rakaat hueen. Rahi baat jume ki namaz ki, to uske baad aap do rakaat parha karte the.

Farz namaazon se pahle aur unke baad ki in nafal namaazon ko parhna aur inki paabandi karna sunnat hai.
Sunnat namaz ghar mein parhna shareeyat sammat hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne tamaam riwayton ke saath naqal kiya hai]
3063: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab raat mein  sokar uthte, to apne munh ko misvaak se ragarkar saaf karte.
Huzaifa radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab raat mein  sokar uthte, to apne munh ko misvaak se ragarkar saaf karte.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam misvaak bahut zyaada karte aur uska aadesh diya karte the. Kuchh-kuchh samyon mein misvaak ka mahatv aur adhik ho jaata hai. Masnal, raat ko sokar uthte samay misvaak karna. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab sokar uthte, to apne munh ko misvaak se ragarkar saaf karte the.

Raat ki neend se jaagne ke baad misvaak ka mahatv kuchh zyaada hi hai. Kyonki sone ke kaaran munh ka svaad badal jaata hai aur misvaak se safaai ho jaati hai.
Pichhle arth ke aadhaar par, munh ke andar bad-bu paida ho jaane se,  misvaak upyog karne ka mahatv barh jaata hai.
Svachchhata saamaany roop se waanchhit hai. Yeh Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki sunnat ka hissa aur uchch koti ke shishtaachaaron mein se hai.
Poore munh ka misvaak karne mein daant, masoorhe aur zabaan bhi shaamil hain.
Misvaak kahte hain peelu aadi ki lakri ko, jise kaatkar munh evn daanton ki safaai ke liye prayog kiya jaata hai. Isse munh saaf hota hai aur durgandh door hoti hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3064: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saamne yeh baat rakhi gai ki kabhi-kabhi aadmi ko aisa lagta hai ki woh namaz mein kuchh mahsoos kar raha hai, (aise mein woh kya kare?) to farmayaah "Woh namaz se na phire, jab tak aawaaz na sune ya durgandh mahsoos na kare."

Abdullah bin zaid bin aasim maazini (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saamne yeh baat rakhi gai ki kabhi-kabhi aadmi ko aisa lagta hai ki woh namaz mein kuchh mahsoos kar raha hai, (aise mein woh kya kare?) to farmayaah "Woh namaz se na phire, jab tak aawaaz na sune ya durgandh na mahsoos kare."

Yeh hadees, jaisa ki imaam navvi ka kahna hai, Islam ke un saadhaaran niymon mein se hai, jo bahut-se bare-bare sharai aadeshon evn nirdeshon ke aadhaar ki haisiyat rakhte hain. Isse ek mahatvapoorn niyam yeh praapt hota hai ki yakeeni cheezen apne hukm par baaki rahengi aur kewal shak evn sandeh ke kaaran unhen us se alag nahin kiya jayega. Chaahe shak prabal ho ya kamzor. Haan, yadi shak gaalib gumaan ya yakeen mein badal jaye, to baat alag hai. Iske bahut saare udaahran maujood hain, jo sabko maaloom hain. Ek udaahran khud yeh hadees hai. Atah, yadi aadmi ko wazu ki haalat mein hone ka yakeen raha ho aur phir wazu tootne ka shak hone lage, to asal yahi hai ki uska wazu baaki hai. Iske wipreet jise bevzu hone ka yakeen ho, phir wazu ke baare mein shak ho, to asal yahi hai ki woh wazu ki haalat mein nahin hai. Yahi haal kapron aur sthaanon ka hai. Asal yahi hai ki woh paak hain. Haan, naapaak hone ka yakeen ho jaye, to unhen naapaak samjha jayega. Isi tarah namaz mein rakaaton ki sankhya ko le sakte hain. Jise yakeen ho ki usne udaahran svaroop teen rakaat parhi hai aur chauthi rakaat ke baare mein sandeh hai, to uski chauthi rakaat shumaar nahin ki jayegi aur use chauthi rakaat parhni paregi. Isi tarah jise apni patni ko talaak dene ke baare mein sandeh ho, to nikaah ko baaki samjha jayega. Is tarah iske bahut-se udaahran diye ja sakte hain, jo spasht bhi hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3065: Mujhe Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne aadesh diya ki main aapki kurbaani ke jaanavron ki dekhrekh karoon tatha unke maans, khaalon (chamron) aur jhoolon ko sadqa kar doon aur kasaai ko unmen se kuchh bhi na doon.

Ali bin abu taalib (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai, kahte hainh mujhe Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne aadesh diya ki main aapki kurbaani ke jaanavron ki dekhrekh karoon tatha unke maans, khaalon (chamron) aur jhoolon ko sadqa kar doon aur kasaai ko unmen se kuchh bhi na doon.

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) 'hajjatul wada' ke avsar par makka aye. Saath mein kurbaani ke jaanvar the. Ali bin abu taalib (radiyallahu anhu) yaman se aye. Unke saath bhi kurbaani ke jaanvar the. Choonki kurbaani fakeeron aur miskeenon ke liye sadka hai, atah kurbaani karne waale ka yeh haq nahin banta ki uska kuchh bhaag muaavza ke taur par kisi ko de. Yahi kaaran hai ki aapne kasaai ko uske kaary ke badle mein usmen se kuchh dene se mana kiya hai. Haan, use maans, khaal aur jhool aadi ke siway aur koi cheez dena chaahe, to de sakta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3066: Jab namaz khari ho jaye aur raat ka khaana haazir ho, to pahle khaana kha lo.

Aaisha, abdullah bin umar aur anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhum) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jab namaz khari ho jaye aur raat ka khaana haazir ho, to pahle khaana kha lo."

Jab namaz khari ho jaye aur khaane ya peene ki cheez saamne upasthit ho, to pahle khaane-peene se faarig ho jaana chahiye. Taaki bhookh-pyaas ki shiddat khatm ho jaye aur namaz parhte samay namaazi ka dhyaan khaane ki or na jaye, balki woh ekaagr hokar namaz parh sake. Lekin iske liye shart yeh hai ki namaz ka wakt tang na ho tatha bhookh lagi hui ho. Is hadees se pata chalta hai ki hamaari shareeyat ek sanpoorn shareeyat hai aur usne aasaani tatha udaarta ke saath-saath praan ke adhikaar ka bhi khayaal rakha hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne tamaam riwayton ke saath naqal kiya hai.]
3067: 'Tamatto' (arthaat Hajj ke avsar par Umrah karke ehraam khol dene aur nae sire se ehraam baandhkar Hajj karne) ki ayat utri aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen uspar amal karne ka aadesh bhi diya. Baad mein koi aisi ayat nahin utri, jo is ayat ke aadesh ko nirast karti ho tatha Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apne jeewan kaal mein kabhi isse mana nahin kiya.

Imraan bin husain (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hainh Allah ki kitaab mein 'tamatto' ki ayat utri aur hamne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath uspar amal bhi kiya. Na to kuraaan ki koi ayat utri hai, jo use haraam bataye aur na Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apne jeewankaal mein usse mana kiya hai. Haan, ek vyakti ne apne mat se jo chaaha, kaha. Imaam Bukhari kahte hainh kaha jaata hai ki imraan bin husain ka ishaara umar (radiyallahu anhu) ki or tha.
Ek any riwayat mein haih 'tamatto' (arthaat Hajj ke avsar par Umrah karke ehraam khol dene aur nae sire se ehraam baandhkar Hajj karne) ki ayat utri aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen uspar amal karne ka aadesh bhi diya. Baad mein koi aisi ayat nahin utri, jo is ayat ke aadesh ko nirast karti ho tatha Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apne jeewankaal mein kabhi isse mana nahin kiya. Bukhari aur Muslim mein isi arth ki riwayat maujood hai.

Imraan bin husain (radiyallahu anhuma) ne Umrah ke baad ehraam khol lene aur Hajj ke liye nae sire se ehraam baandhne ka zikr karte hue kahaah yeh Allah ki kitaab aur Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki hadees donon se saabit hai. Allah ki kitaab mein haih {فمن تمتع بالعمرة إلى الحج فما استيسر من الهدي} (to jo vyakti umre se le kar hajj tak tamatto kare, woh jo kurbaani uplabdh ho, pesh kare.) rahi baat sunnat ki, to khud Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne uspar amal kiya aur apne saathiyon ke karne par sahamti jataai. Na kuraaan ki kisi ayat mein usse mana kiya gaya hai aur na Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne usse mana kiya hai. Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki mrityu ke samay tak ismen koi pariwartan nahin hua tha. Aise mein, koi apne mat se usse kaise rok sakta hai? Unka ishaara umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) ki or tha, jinhonne apne ijtihaad ki buniyaad par Hajj ke maheenon mein isse mana kiya tha, taaki saal bhar kaaba ki ziyaarat karne waalon ki sankhya adhik ho. Kyonki jab log Hajj ke mausam hi mein Umrah kar lenge, to any maheenon mein dobaara nahin ayenge. Daraasal, umar (radiyallahu anhu) ki or se yeh manaahi haraam thahraane ke taur par ya kitaab wa sunnat par amal karne se rokne ke liye nahin thi, balki saadhaaran hit ke tahat yeh ek saamyik nishedh tha.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3069: To kya tum mujhse arab qabeelon ke baare mein poochh rahe ho? Unmen se jo log jaahiliyat kaal mein shreshth the, we islaam mein bhi shreshth hain, jab islaam ka jnaan praapt kar len.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki kisi ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, sabse uttam vyakti kaun hai? Aapne farmayaah "Jo sabse adhik Allah ka bhay khaane waala ho." Logon ne kahaah ham aapse iske baare mein nahin poochh rahe rahain. Aapne farmayaah to yoosuf (alaihissalaam) hain, jo Allah ke Nabi, Allah ke Nabi ke bete, Allah ke Nabi ke pote aur Allah ke priy mitr ke parpote hain." Unhonne kahaah ham aapse iske baare mein bhi nahin poochh rahe hain. Farmayaah "To kya tum mujhse arab qabeelon ke baare mein poochh rahe ho? Unmen se jo log jaahiliyat kaal mein shreshth the, we islaam mein bhi shreshth hain, jab islaam ka jnaan praapt kar len."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3070: Tummen se koi uthta hai aur apni patni ko daas ki tarah maarta hai. Jabki ho sakta hai ki woh usi din ke antim bhaag mein usse sanbhog bhi kare.

Abdullah bin zamaa (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki unhonne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko khutba dete hue suna. Aapne (khutbe ke dauraan saaleh alaihissalaam ke) oont tatha uska wadh karne waale ka zikr karte hue farmayaah (Qur'an ki ayat) 'jab unka sabse abhaaga vyakti utha' ka arth yeh hai ki use maarne ke liye ek shaktishaali, duraachaari aur apni qaum ka mazboot vyakti khara hua." Phir striyon ke baare mein bataya aur unke baare mein samjhaate hue farmayaah "Tummen se koi uthta hai aur apni patni ko daas ki tarah maarta hai. Jabki ho sakta hai ki woh usi din ke antim bhaag mein usse sanbhog bhi kare." Phir maladvaar se nikalne waali hawa par hansne ke baare mein samjhaate hue farmayaah "Tummen se koi aise kaam par kyon hansta hai, jo woh khud bhi karta hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3071: Koi momin purush kisi momin stri se nafrat na kare. Yadi woh uske kisi kaam ko naapsand karta hai, to uske kisi doosre (athva any) kaam ko pasand karega.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, unhonne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Koi momin purush kisi momin stri se nafrat na kare. Yadi woh uske kisi kaam ko naapsand karta hai, to uske kisi doosre (athva any) kaam ko pasand karega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne pati ko apni patni se is tarah nafrat karne se mana kiya hai ki uspar atyaachaar karne, use chhor rakhne   tatha use bhula dene ki naubat a jaye. Kyonki har insaan ke andar praakritik roop se kamiyaan maujood hain. Agar uski koi baat naapsand hogi, to koi baat pasand zaroor hogi. Atah jo baat pasand ho, uspar prasann rahe aur jo baat pasand na ho, uspar sabr kare. Isse khushagvaar waataavran banega aur naapsandeedgi is had tak nahin pahunchegi ki algaav ki sthiti a jaye.

Is hadees mein momin ko nyay karne, patni ke saath hone waale har jhagre mein wiwek se kaam lene aur bhaavnaaon mein bahkar koi kaam na karne ki prerna di gai hai.
Ek momin ki shaan yeh honi chahiye ki woh apni patni se is tarah nafrat na kare ki alagva ki naubat a jaye. Uski naapsand baaton mein nazar bachaakar un baaton par dhyaan dena chahiye, jo pasand hon.
Sundar daampaty jeewan bitaane ki prerna.
Eemaan achchhe aachran dhaaran karne ki prerna deta hai. Momin purush evn momin stri achchhe aachran rahit nahin ho sakte. Agar eemaan hai, to aachran achchha zaroor hoga.
3072: Mainne abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) se 'hajje tamatto' ke baare mein poochha, to unhonne mujhe uska aadesh diya. Phir mainne unse qurbaani ke baare mein poochha, to batayaah usmen oont, gay, bakri ya jaanvar ka ek hissa zabah karna hai. Woh kahte hainh lekin aisa laga ki kuchh log use naapsand kar rahe hain.

Abu jamra (nasr bin imraan zubai) kahte hainh mainne abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) se 'hajje tamatto' ke baare mein poochha, to unhonne mujhe uska aadesh diya. Phir mainne unse qurbaani ke baare mein poochha, to batayaah usmen oont, gay, bakri ya jaanvar ka ek hissa zabah karna hai. Woh kahte hainh lekin aisa laga ki kuchh log use naapsand kar rahe hain. Aise mein main soya, to svapn mein dekha ki goya ek aadmi pukaar raha haih tera Hajj shareeyat ke anuroop hai aur tera 'tamatto' grahan yogy hai. Atah mainne abdullah bin abbaas ke paas aakar svapn ke baare mein bataya, to woh boleh Allah sabse bara hai. Yeh abul qaasim (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki sunnat hai.

Abu jamra ne ibne abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) se, umre se lekar Hajj tak laabhaanvit hone ke baare mein poochha, to unhonne iski anumti di. Phir kurbaani ke baare mein poochha, jo useeke saath is ayat mein ullikhit haih "فمن تمتع بالعمرة إلى الحج فما استيسر من الهدي", to bataya ki usmen oont, jo sabse uttam hai, phir gay, phir bakri ko zabah karna hai. Ya phir oont ya gay ka saatvaan bhaag kurbaani karna hai. Yaani us oont ya gay ki kurbaani mein shareek ho sakta hai, jismen kul saat aadmi shareek hon.
Lekin aisa laga ki kisi ne abu jamra ke tamatto karne par etraaz jataya, to unhonne svapn mein dekha ki koi ghaib se unhen aawaaz de raha haih "Tera Hajj shareeyat ke anuroop hai aur tera tamatto grahan yogy hai." Phir kya tha, we ibne abbaas (razyallahu anhuma) ke paas aye aur unhen is sundar svapn ki khushkhabri di. Choonki achchha svapn nuboowat ka ek ang hota hai, isliye ibne abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) isse prasann hue aur apne fatve ke sahi hone par khushi prakat karte hue kahaah Allah bahut bara hai. Yeh abul kaasim (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki sunnat hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3073: Mainne apne man mein socha ki aaj main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka dvaarpaal banne ka saubhaagy praapt karoonga. Itne mein abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) aye aur darvaaza khatakhtaya. Mainne kahaah kaun hain? To farmayaah abu bakr. Mainne kahaah tanik rukiye. Phir main aapke paas gaya aur kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) anumti maang rahe hain. Aapne farmayaah "Unhen anumti do tatha Jannat ki shubh soochna bhi do."

Abu moosa ashaari (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki unhonne apne ghar mein wazu kiya aur phir yeh kahte hue nikle ki main aaj din bhar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath rahoonga. Chunaanche masjid aye aur Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke baare mein poochha, to logon ne kaha ki aap udhar gae hain. Woh kahte hainh main aapke baare mein poochhte hue aapki talaash mein nikal para, yahaan tak ki aap arees naami kuen ke paas gae. Main kuen waale baagh ke dvaar par baith gaya. Jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apni haajat poori kar chuke aur wazu kar liya, to main aapke paas aya. Dekha ki aap arees kuen ki munder ke beech me baithe hain aur apni pindliyon ko kholkar kuen mein paanv latkaye hue hain. Main aapko salaam karke waapas a gaya aur dvaar ke paas baith gaya. Mainne apne man mein socha ki aaj main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka dvaarpaal banne ka saubhaagy praapt karoonga. Itne mein abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) aye aur darvaaza khatakhtaya. Mainne kahaah kaun hain? To farmayaah abu bakr. Mainne kahaah tanik rukiye. Phir main aapke paas gaya aur kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) anumti maang rahe hain. Aapne farmayaah "Unhen anumti do tatha Jannat ki shubh soochna bhi do." Main aya aur abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) se kahaah ai abu bakr, andar jaaeeye tatha Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne aapko Jannat ki shubh soochna di hai. Chunaanche abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) andar gae aur aapke saath munder par aapki dayen or baith gae aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hi ki tarah donon pindliyon ko kholkar donon paanv kuen mein latka diye. Phir main waapas aakar baith gaya. Choonki main apne bhaai ko wazu karte hue chhor aya tha aur use bhi mere peechhe aana tha, isliye dil mein socha ki yadi Allah amuk (unka aashay apne bhaai se tha) ke saath bhalaai chaahta hai, to use le ayega. Isi beech kisi ne dvaar khatakhtaya. Mainne kahaah kaun hain? Kahaah umar bin khattaab. Mainne kahaah zara rukiye. Phir main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas gaya, salaam kiya aur kahaah umar (radiyallahu anhu) anumti maang rahe hain. Aapne farmayaah anumti do aur Jannat ki shubh soochna suna do. Mainne umar (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas waapas aakar kahaah anumti di hai tatha Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aapko Jannat ki shubh soochna de rahe hain. Chunaanche umar (radiyallahu anhu) andar gae aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath munder par aapki bayen jaanib baith gae aur donon paanv kuen mein latka diye. Phir main waapas aakar baith gaya aur socha ki yadi Allah amuk (unka aashay apne bhaai se tha) ke saath bhalaai ka iraada kare, to use le ayega. Itne mein ek aadmi aye aur dvaar hilaya. Mainne kahaah kaun hain? Uttar milaah usmaan bin affaan. Mainne kahaah zara rukiye. Phir main Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas gaya aur bataya, to farmayaah anumti do aur unhen Jannat ki shubh soochna suna do, magar ek aazmaaish ke saath, jiska saamna unko karna parega. Main aya aur bolaah andar jaaeeye aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aapko Jannat ki shubh soochna de rahe hain, ek aazmaaish ke saath, jiska saamna aapko karna parega. Woh andar gae, to dekha ki munder bhar gai hai. Atah, unke saamne doosre kinaare par baith gae.
Saeed bin musayyib kahte hain ki mainne iska arth unki qabron se liya.
Ek any riwayat mein yeh izaafa haih Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne mujhe dvaar ki suraksha karne ka aadesh diya. Tatha usi riwayat mein haih usmaan (radiyallahu anhu) ko jab Jannat ki shubh soochna di, to Allah (taaala) ki prashansa ki aur phir farmayaah Allah hi sahayak hai.
[ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3074: Aadmi usi ke saadh hoga, jisse woh mohabbat karta hai.

Abu moosa ashaari (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Aadmi usi ke saadh hoga, jisse woh mohabbat karta hai."
Ek aur riwayat mein haih Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se poochha gaya ki ek aadmi kuchh logon se mohabbat karta hai, lekin woh un logon tak pahunch nahin paata? To aapne farmayaah "Aadmi usi ke saadh hoga, jisse woh mohabbat karta hai."
Abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ek aadmi Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya aur kahne lagaah ai Allah ke Rasool, aap us vyakti ke baare mein kya kahte hain, jo kuchh logon se mohabbat karta hai, lekin un logon tak pahunch nahin paata? To Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Aadmi usi ke saadh hoga, jisse woh mohabbat karta hai."
[ise donon riwayton ke saath Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3075: Main Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath maujood tha. Aap ek aisi jagah pahunche, jahaan log koora-karkat phenka karte hain aur aapne khare hokar peshaab kiya.

Huzaifa radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Main Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath maujood tha. Aap ek aisi jagah pahunche, jahaan log koora-karkat phenka karte hain aur aapne khare hokar peshaab kiya. Main zara door hatkar khara ho gaya, to farmaya : "Kareeb a jaao." Tab main qareeb aakar aapki donon eriyon ke paas khara ho gaya. Iske baad aapne wazu kiya aur donon mozon par masah kiya.

Huzaifa bin yamaan radiyallahu anhuma kahte hain ki woh Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath the. To aapne peshaab karne ka iraada kiya, atah ek jagah gae, jahaan log kachra aur dhool phenka karte the aur wahaan khare hokar peshaab kiya. Jabki aam taur par peshaab baithkar hi kiya karte the.

Yeh dekhkar huzaif radiyallahu anhu aapse door hatne lage, to aapne paas aane ko kaha. Tab bilkul paas jaakar aapke peechhe eriyon ke nikat khare ho gae, taaki aar ban jayen aur koi aapko dekh na sake.

Uske baad aapne wazu kiya aur jab paanv dhone ki baari aai, to mozon ko utaarne ke bajay unpar masah kar liya. Mozon se muraad patle chamre aadi se bane hue pairon mein pahni jaane waali aisi cheezen hain, jo qadmon ko dhaanp kar rakhti hon.

Mozon par masah karna shareeyat sammat hai.
Khare hokar peshaab karna jayaz hai. Shart yeh hai ki peshaab ke chheente shareer ya kapre par na paren.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kachra phenkne ke sthaan ka chayan isliye kiya ki aam taur par woh jagah narm hoti hai aur peshaab ke chheente shareer par parne ki sanbhvaana nahin rahti.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3076: Main junbi -apvitr- tha. Atah mujhe achchha nahin laga ki apvitrata ki awastha mein aapke paas baithoon! To aapne pharmayaah subhaanallah! Momin naapaak -apvitr- nahin hota.

Abu huraira- raziyallah anhu- ka warnan hai kih Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- unhen madeene ke kisi raaste mein mil gae, jabki woh us samay junbi- apvitr- the. Woh kahte hainh so main chupke se nikal liya aur jaakar snaan kar aya. Aap boleh abu huraira! Tum itni der kahaan the? Unhonne jawaab diyaah main junbi tha. Atah mujhe achchha na laga ki naapaaki- apvitrata- ki awastha mein aapke paas baithoon! Aapne pharmayaah "Subhaanallah! Momin naapaak nahin hota."

Madeene ke kisi raaste mein abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ki bhent Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se ho gai. Ittefaak se us samay woh janaabat ki awastha mein the. Choonki unke dil mein Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka bara sammaan tha, isliye is awastha mein aapke paas baithne evn aapse baat karne ko, unka dil gawaara na kiya. Atah, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko bataye bina chupke se nikal liye aur snaan kar aye.
Jab aye, to aapne poochha ki kahaan gae the? Unhonne sab kuchh bataya aur kaha ki naapaaki ki awastha mein aapke paas baithna gawaara na hua.
Choonki abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) junbi ko naapaak samajhte the, isliye aapne un par aashchary prakat kiya aur unhen bataya ki momin kisi bhi haal mein apvitr nahin hota.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3078: ''Jab tum shauch ke liye jaao, to peshaab tatha paakhaana karte samay na qibla ki or munh karo, na uski or peeth hi karo; balki poorab athva pashchim ki or munh kar lo.''

Abu ayyoob ansaari radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : ''Jab tum shauch ke liye jaao, to peshaab tatha paakhaana karte samay na qibla ki or munh karo, na uski or peeth hi karo; balki poorab athva pashchim ki or munh kar lo.'' abu ayyoob kahte hain : Jab ham shaam gae, to dekha ki wahaan shauchaalay kaaba ki disha mein bane hue hain. So ham wahaan tirchhe hokar baithte aur Allah se kshama yaachna karte.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne peshaab aur paakhaana karne ka iraada rakhne waale ko qibla aur kaaba ki or munh ya peeth karke baithne se mana kiya hai. Agar uske qible ki disha wahi hai, jo madeene waalon ki hai, to use poorab ya pashchim ki or tirchha hokar baithna chahiye. Phir abu ayyoob radiyallahu anhu ne bataya ki jab woh shaam pahunche, to dekha ki wahaan shauchaalay kaaba ki disha mein bane hue hain. Isliye woh shauchaalay jaate samay tirchhe hokar baith jaate, taaki seedhe kaaba ki or munh ya peeth na ho aur uske baad Allah se kshama yaachna kar liya karte.

Is manaahi ka kaaran kaaba ka sammaan hai.
Shauchaalay se nikalne ke baad kshama yaachna karni chahiye.
Is hadees se Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke shiksha dene ka sundar tareeqa saamne aata hai ki jab awaidh tareeqe ka ullekh kiya, to waidh tareeqe ka bhi zikr kar diya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3079: Tummen se koi vyakti peshaab karte samay apne ling ko dayen haath se na pakre tatha dayen haath se istinja (peshaab-paakhaana se pawitrata praapt) na kare evn kuchh peete samay bartan mein saans na le.

Abu qataada radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, unhonne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Tummen se koi vyakti peshaab karte samay apne ling ko dayen haath se na pakre tatha dayen haath se istinja (peshaab-paakhaana se pawitrata praapt) na kare evn kuchh peete samay bartan mein saans na le."

Yahaan Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kuchh aadaab bayaan kiye hain. Peshaab karte samay dayen haath se ling ko pakarne aur dayen haath se ling ya maladvaar par lagi gandgi ko saaf karne se mana farmaya hai, kyonki daya haath achchhe kaamon ke liye hai. Isi tarah jis bartan se kuchh piya ja raha ho, usmen saans lene se mana farmaya hai.

Shishtaachaar evn svachchhata ke maamle mein Islam sabse aage hai.
Gandi cheezon se bachna zaroori hai. Agar haath lagaana zaroori ho, to bayaan haath lagaya jaye.
Dayaan haath bayaan haath se shreshth hai.
Islaami shareeyat ek sanpoorn shareeyat hai aur uski shikshayen bari vyaapak hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3080: Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kankar phenkne se mana kiya hai (jo do ungliyon ke beech rakh kar phenka jaata hai) aur farmaya haih yeh na shikaar ko maarta hai, na shatru ko zakhmi karta hai, bas aankh phorta aur daant torta hai.

Abdullah bin mughaffal- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kankar phenkne se mana kiya hai (jo aam taur se do ungliyon ke beech rakh kar phenka jaata hai) aur farmaya haih "Yeh na shikaar ko maarta hai, na shatru ko zakhmi karta hai. Parantu aankh phorta aur daant torta hai."
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih abdullah bin mughaffal ke ek nikatvarti ne do ungli kankar phenka, to use mana kiya aur kaha ki Allah ke Rasool - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne isse mana kiya hai aur kaha hai ki yeh shikaar mein kaam nahin aata. Parantu usne dobaara yeh kaary kiya to kahaah main tujhe hadees suna raha hoon ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne isse mana kiya hai, lekin iske baavjood tu dobaara kankar phenk raha hai! Main tujh se kabhi baat nahin karoonga.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3081: Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne fajr ki namaz ke baad sooraj nikalne tak tatha asr ki namaz ke baad sooraj doobne tak namaz parhne se mana kiya hai.

Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hainh mere paas kuchh wishvast logon ne gawaahi di hai (jinmen sabse wishvast vyakti mere nikat umar radiyallahu anhu hain) ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne fajr ki namaz ke baad sooraj nikalne tak tatha asr ki namaz ke baad sooraj doobne tak namaz parhne se mana kiya hai.
Aur abu saeed- radiyallahu anhu- Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se riwayat karte hain ki aapne farmayaah ''fajr ki namaz ke baad sooraj buland hone tak koi namaz nahin hai aur asr ki namaz ke baad sooraj ast hone tak koi namaz nahin hai.''

In donon hadeeson mein Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne fajr ki namaz ke baad namaz parhne se mana kiya hai, yahaan tak ki sooraj nikal aye aur dekhne waale ko kshitij rekha se ek neja oopar dikhaai de. Ismen kuchh minat laget hain. Ulema iska samay nishchit karne mein ekmat nahin hain, inke wibhinn maton ke anusaar ismen paanch se pandrah minat lagte hain.
Isi tarah asr ki namaz ke baad sooraj doobne arthaat magrib ki azaan se chand minat pahle namaz parhne se mana kiya hai. Kyonki in donon samyon mein namaz parhna ek tarah se bahu-eeshvarvaadiyon ki samaanta apnaana hai, jo sooraj nikalte aur doobte samay uski pooja karte hain. Jabki hamen unki samaanta grahan karne se mana kiya hai. Kyonki jo kisi jaati ki samaanta grahan karta hai, woh useemen se shumaar hota hai.
[ise donon riwayton ke saath Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3082: Abdullah bin masaood- razillah anhu- pratyek guroowaar ko hamen updesh diya karte the.

Shaqeeq bin salma- rahimhullah (arthaat Allah unpar daya kare)- kahte hain ki abdullah bin masaood- razillah anhu- pratyek guroowaar ko hamen updesh diya karte the. Isi kram mein ek vyakti ne unse kahaah ai abu abdur rahmaan, main chaahta hoon ki aap hamen pratyek din updesh diya karen. To unhonne kahaah main aisa isliye nahin kar sakta ki main nahin chaahta ki tum ukta jaao. Lekin, main tumhen usi prakaar samay-samay par updesh diya karta hoon, jaise Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hamen samay-samay par updesh diya karte the, taaki ham ukta na jayen.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3083: Jo hamaare chhoton par daya na kare aur hamaare baron ka sammaan na jaane woh ham mein se nahin hai.

Abdullah bin amr bin aas- radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Jo hamaare chhoton par daya na kare aur hamaare baron ka aadar na jaane woh ham mein se nahin hai."
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3084: Ek din Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- makka aur madeena ke beech sthit khumm naami ek jal-srot ke paas hamaare beech bhaashan dene ke liye khare hue,to Allah ki prashansa evn taareef ki, updesh diye aur naseehat ki

Yazeed bin hayyaan kahte hainh main, husain bin sabra aur amr bin Muslim zaid bin arqam- radiyallahu anhu- ke paas aye. Ham unke paas baithe, to husain ne unse kahaah zaid, aapke hisse mein bahut- si bhalaaiyaan aai hain. Aapne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko dekha, aapki baaten suneen, aapke saath yuddh kiya aur aapke peechhe namaz parhi. Is tarah aapko bahut- si bhalaaiyaan praapt raheen. Atah hamen Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki koi hadees sunaaiye. Unhonne kahaah ai bhateeje, Allah ki qasam, meri ayu adhik ho chuki hai, Allah ke Rasool ke saath rahe bahut din guzar chuke hain aur Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se yaad ki hui bahut-si baaten bhool chuka hoon. Atah jitna suna doon, use grahan kar lo aur jo na suna sakoon, use sunaane ki zimmewaari mujh pe na daalo. Phir kahaah ek din Rasool - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- makka aur madeena ke beech sthit khumm naami ek jal-srot ke paas hamaare beech bhaashan dene ke liye khare hue, Allah ki prashansa evn taareef ki, updesh diye, naseehat ki aur kahaah "Iske baad, ai logo, sun lo, main kewal ek insaan hoon, sameep hai ki mere prabhu ka sandeshvaahak (maut ka pharishta) a jaye aur main tum se juda ho jaaoon. Main tumhaare beech do bhaari wastuen chhore ja raha hoon. Ek Allah ki kitaab, jismen hidayat aur prakaash hai. Atah Allah ki kitaab ko pakar lo aur use mazbooti se thaam lo." Aapne Allah ki kitaab ko thaame rahne par ubhaara tatha uski shikshaaon par amal karne ki prerna di. Phir kahaah "Mere pariwaar ke logon ka khayaal rakhna. Main tumhen apne pariwaar ke logon ke baare mein Allah ke aajnaapaalan ki naseehat karta hoon." To husain ne unse kahaah ai zaid, aapke pariwaar ke log kaun hain? Kya aapki patniyaan aapke pariwaar ke logon mein shaamil nahin hain? Unhonne kahaah haan, aapki patniyaan aapke pariwaar ke logon mein shaamil hain, lekin aapke pariwaar ke log we hain, jinpar aapke baad sadqa haraam hai. Unhonne kaha ki we kaun hain? To kahaah we hain, ali ki santaan, aqeel ki santaan, jaafar ki santaan aur abbaas ki santaan. Unhonne poochha ki in sabhi logon par sadqa haraam hai? To kahaah haan.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih "Sun lo, main tumhaare beech do bhaari wastuen chhore ja raha hoon. Ek Allah ki kitaab, jo Allah ki rassi hai, jo uska anusran karega, woh hidayat par hoga aur jo use chhor dega,koopathgaami hoga."
3085: Tum apni safon ko zaroor seedhi karo, anyatha Allah tumhaare beech matbhed daal dega (doosra arthah tumhaare chehron ko bigaar dega).

Nomaan bin basheer- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah ''tum apni safon ko zaroor seedhi karo, anyatha Allah tumhaare chehron ko bigaar dega (doosra arthah tumhaare dilon mein matbhed daal dega).''
Aur ek riwayat me haih ''rasoolullah (salllahu alaihi wa sallam) hamaari safen seedhi karvaya karte the, yahaan tak ki yeh maaloom hota ki goya aap unse teer seedha kar rahe hain. Yahaan tak ki aap ko anubhav hua ki hamne aapse yeh masla samajh liya hai. Phir ek din aap namaz ke liye aye aur khare hue. Phir takbeer kahne hi waale the ki ek aadmi ko dekha, ki uska seena saf se baahar nikla hua hai. To aapne farmayaah "Allah ke bando, tum apni safon zaroor seedhi karo, anyatha Allah tumhaare chehron ko bigaar dega."

Is hadees mein Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne is baat ki taakeed ki hai ki agar safon ko baraabar nahin kiya gaya, to Allah un logon ke mato mein wibhed daal dega, jinki safen terhi rah gaeen aur unko seedhi karne par dhyaan nahin diya. Atah, saf mein koi aage raha to koi peechhe aur namaaziyon ke beech mein khaali sthaan bhi chhor diye.
Pyaare Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jahaan apne saathiyon ko bataakar sikhaate the, waheen amli taur par bhi unhen prashikshan dete the. Chunaanche aap har namaz ke samay unki safen khud apne haathon se seedhi karte rahe, yahaan tak ki jab aapko laga ki we achchhi tarah se samajh gae hain, to is silsile ko band kar diya. Phir ek din namaz ke samay apne ek saathi ko dekha ki unka seena saf se baahar nikla hua hai, to naaraaz hue aur kahaah "Tum apni safen zaroor seedhi rakho, anyatha Allah tumhaare maton mein wibhed paida kar dega."
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3086: Kya tummen se koi vyakti, jo imaam se pahle apna sar uthaata hai, is baat se nahin darta ki Allah uske sar ko gadhe ka sar bana de athva uski aakriti ko gadhe ki aakriti mein badal de?

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Kya tummen se koi vyakti, jo imaam se pahle apna sar uthaata hai, is baat se nahin darta ki Allah uske sar ko gadhe ka sar bana de athva uski aakriti ko gadhe ki aakriti mein badal de?"

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne imaam se pahle apna sar uthaane waale vyakti ko yeh sakht chetaavni di hai ki Allah uske sar ko gadhe ka sar bana de ya uski aakriti ko gadhe ki aakriti  bana de.

Imaam ke saath muqatdiyon ki chaar haalten ho sakti hain, jinmen se teen haalten mana hain. Yaani imaam se aage barh jaana, uske saath-saath chalna aur usse peechhe rah jaana. Jabki hona yeh chahiye ki muqatdi imaam ka anusran kare.
Muqatdi par namaz mein imaam ka anusran karna waajib hai.
Imaam se pahle apna sar uthaane waale ka sar gadhe ke sar mein badal jaye, aisa sanbhav hai. Yeh ek prakaar ki wikriti hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3087: Ek vyakti ne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se qayaamat ke baare mein poochha. Usne kaha : Qayaamat kab ayegi? Aapne kaha : "Tumne uske liye kya taiyaari ki hai?

Anas radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ek vyakti ne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se qayaamat ke baare mein poochha. Usne kaha : Qayaamat kab ayegi? Aapne kaha : "Tumne uske liye kya taiyaari ki hai?" Usne kaha : Taiyaari to waise kuchh nahin ki hai, lekin itna zaroor hai ki main Allah aur uske Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se mohabbat rakhta hoon. Ispar aapne kaha : "Tumhen uske saath rahne ka saubhaagy praapt hoga, jisse tumhen mohabbat hai." Anas radiyallahu anhu kahte hain : Ham kisi cheez se utna khush nahin hue, jitna Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke is kathan se hue ki tumhen uske saath rahne ka saubhaagy praapt hoga, jisse tumhen mohabbat hai. Anas radiyallahu anhu kahte hain : Main Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam tatha abu bakr evn umar radiyallahu anhuma se mohabbat rakhta hoon aur aasha karta hoon ki unse is mohabbat ke kaaran mujhe unke saath rahne ka saubhaagy praapt hoga, yadyapi main unke jaisa amal na bhi kar sakoon.

Registaan mein rahne waale ek dehaati vyakti ne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se qayaamat ke din ke samay ke baare mein prashn kiya,

To aapne uttar dene ke bajay usi se poochh liya ki tumne uski taiyaari ke taur par kaun-kaun se achchhe kaam kiye hain?

Usne uttar diya : Mainne uski taiyaari ke taur par kuchh bara to nahin kiya hai, lekin itna zaroor hai ki main Allah aur uske Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se mohabbat rakhta hoon. Unhonne kisi doosri haardik, shaareerik evn aarthik ibaadat ka zikr nahin kiya. Kyonki yeh saari ibaadten usi mohabbat ki shaakhayen hain aur usi ke nateeje mein saamne aati hain. Doosri baat yeh hai ki sachchi mohabbat insaan ko achchha kaary karne ki prerna deti hai.

Yeh sun Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne usse kaha : Nishchit roop se tum Jannat mein uske saath rahoge, jisse tumhen mohabbat hai.

Is susmaachaar se Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke sahaaba ko bari khushi hui.

Phir anas radiyallahu anhu ne bataya ki woh Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam tatha abu bakr evn umar radiyallahu anhuma se mohabbat rakhte hain aur aasha karte hain ki Jannat mein unke saath rahne ka saubhaagy praapt hoga, chaahe unka apna amal un logon ke jaisa na bhi rahe.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam prashn karne waale ko jawaab dene mein hikmat se kaam lete the. Yahi kaaran hai ki yahaan sawaal karne waale ka maargadarshan ek aisi cheez ki or kar di, jo uske liye mahatvapoorn thi aur jo use mukti dila sakti hai. Yaani aakhirat ke din ki taiyaari ke liye satkarm karna.
Qayaamat kab hogi, is baat ki jaankaari Allah ne bandon ko nahin di hai, taaki insaan Allah se milne ke liye hamesha taiyaar rahe aur poori taiyaari rakhe.
Allah, uske Rasool aur sadaachaari mominon se muhabbat rakhne ki fazeelat bataana aur mushrikon se muhabbat rakhne se saavdhaan karna.
Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke kathan "Tumhen uska saath naseeb hoga, jisse tumhen muhabbat hai" Ka matlab yeh nahin hai ki donon ko samaan shreni ke sthaan praapt honge, balki matlab yeh hai ki donon Jannat mein is tarah rahenge ki ek-doosre ko dekh sakenge, yadyapi jagah door hi kyon na ho.
Ek musalmaan ko is baat ka nirdesh diya gaya hai ki woh us cheez par dhyaan de, jo uske liye zyaada achchha aur laabhkaari ho. Woh aisi cheezon ke baare mein prashn na kare, jo uske liye laabhkaari na hon.

3088: Khaane ki maujoodgi mein namaz na parhi jaye aur na us samay jab insaan ko peshaab-paakhaana ki haajat sakht ho.

Aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Khaane ki maujoodgi mein namaz na parhi jaye aur na us samay jab insaan ko peshaab-paakhaana ki haajat sakht ho."

Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne khaane ki upasthiti mein namaz parhne se mana kiya hai ki insaan khaane par atka hua rahe aur woh poori ekaagrata ke saath namaz na parh sake.

Isi tarah jab bahut zoron ke saath peshaab-paakhaana laga hua ho, to us samay bhi namaz parhne se mana kiya hai, kyonki aadmi ka dhyaan bata hua rahta hai.
Insaan ko namaz mein daakhil hone se pahle un tamaam cheezon se door ho jaana chahiye, jo uska dhyaan baantne ka kaam karti hain.
3089: Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- unhen zuhar ki namaz parhaate samay do rakaaton ke baad baithne ke bajay khare ho gae, to log bhi aapke saath khare ho gae, yahaan tak ki jab namaz poori kar li aur log aapke salaam pherne ki prateeksha karne lage, to baithkar hi "Allahu akbar" Kaha aur salaam pherne se pahle do sajde kiye, phir salaam phera.

Abdullah bin buhaina- radiyallahu anhu- jo Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke sahaabi the ka warnan hai ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- unhen zuhar ki namaz parhaate samay do raaton ke baad baithne ke bajay khare ho gae, to log bhi aapke saaाth khare ho gae, yahaan tak ki jab namaz poori kar li aur log aapke salaam pherne ki prateeksha karne lage, to baithkar hi "Allahu akbar" Kaha aur salaam pherne se pahle do sajde kiye, phir salaam phera ).

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apne saathiyon ko zohar ki namaz parhaai. Jab pahli do rakaaten parh chuke, to pahle tashahhud ke liye baithne ke bajay khare ho gae. Muqatdi bhi aapke saath-saath khare ho gae.
Yahaan tak ki jab baad ki do rakaaten parh chuke tatha aakhiri tashahhud ke liye baith gae aur usse bhi faarig ho gae evn log aapke salaam pherne ki prateeksha karne lage, to baithe-baithe hi aap ne 'Allahu akbar' kaha aur salaam pherne se pahle namaz ke sajdon ke jaise do sajde kiye, jo 'sahv ke sajde' kahlaate hain, phir salaam pher diya. Daraasal yeh sajde chhoote hue tashahhud ki bharpaai ke liye the.

3090: Main ek gadhi par sawaar hokar aya. Un dinon main baaligh hone ko tha. Rasoolullah - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- mina mein logon ko namaz parha rahe the, saamne koi deewaar nahin thi.

Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hainh main ek gadhi par sawaar hokar aya. Un dinon main baaligh hone ko tha. Rasoolullah- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- mina mein logon ko namaz parha rahe the. Saamne koi deewaar nahin thi. Main saf- pankti- ke kuchh bhaag ke aage se guzarkar utar gaya, gadhi ko charne ke liye chhor diya evn saf mein daakhil ho gaya. Kintu ispar kisi ne mujhe nahin toka.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhu) bataate hain ki hajjatul wada ke avsar par jab woh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath mina mein the, usi beech ki baat hai ki ek baar woh ek gadhi par sawaar hokar aye. Aur saf ke kuchh bhaag ke aage se guzreे. Us samay Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne saathiyon ko namaz parha rahe the. Aapke saamne koi deewaar bhi nahin thi. Woh gadhi se utre aur use charne ke liye chhor diya aur khud saf mein daakhil ho gae.
Unka bayaan hai ki woh us samay vyask hone ke the. Arthaat ayu itni ho chuki thi ki yadi koi tokne ke layak kaam karte aur logon ki namaz mein khalal paida hota, to zaroor toke jaate. Lekin iske baavjood kisi ne kuchh nahin kaha. Na Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne, na aapke kisi saathi ne.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3095: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab namaz shuru karte aur jab ruku ke liye "Allahu akbar" Kahte, to apne donon haathon ko apne donon kandho ke baraarab uthaate.

Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab namaz shuru karte aur jab ruku ke liye "Allahu akbar" Kahte, to apne donon haathon ko apne donon kandho ke baraarab uthaate. Rooku se sir uthaate samay bhi isi tarah donon haathon ko uthaate aur kahte : "سَمِعَ الله لمن حَمِدَهُ رَبَّنَا ولك الحمد" (Allah ne uski sun li, jisne uski prashansa ki. Ai hamaare rab, teri hi prashansa hai.) lekin sajde mein donon haathon ko uthaate nahin the.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam namaz mein teen sthaanon par apne haathon ko kandhe ke baraabar uthaya karte the.

Pahla sthaan : Namaz ke aaranbh mein takbeer-e-tahreema ke samay.

Doosra sthaan : Ruku ke liye takbeer kahte samay.

Teesra sthaan : Ruku se sar uthaate evn "سمع الله لمن حمده ربنا ولك الحمد" Kahte samay.

Aap sajde mein jaate aur sajde se uthte samay haath nahin uthaate the.

Donon haathon ko uthaane ki ek hikmat yeh hai ki yeh namaz ki shobha aur Allah ka sammaan hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se ek chauthe sthaan mein bhi haath uthaana saabit hai. Uska ullekh sunan abu daaood aadi mein abu humaid saaidi ki ek riwayat mein hai. Yeh sthaan hai teen aur chaar rakaat waali maazon mein pahle tashahhud se khare hone ka sthaan.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se yeh baat bhi saabit hai ki aap donon haathon ko, donon kaanon ke nichle bhaag tak, unko chhooe baghair, uthaya karte the. Saheeh Bukhari evn saheeh Muslim ki ek riwayat mein maalik bin huwairis radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab takbeer kahte, to donon haathon ko uthaakar donon kaanon ke nichle bhaag tak le jaate.
"سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ" Aur "رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ" Donon kewal imaam aur akele namaz parhne waala kahenge. Muqatdi kewal "رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ" Kahega.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se ruku ke baad "رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ" Ke shabd chaar tarah se aye hain. Behtar yeh hai ki insaan chaaron ko parhne ka prayaas kare. Kabhi ise to kabhi use.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3096: Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne mujhe usi tarah tashahhud sikhaya, jaise Qur'an ki soora sikhaate the. Us samay meri hatheli aapki donon hatheliyon ke beech mein thi

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne mujhe usi tarah tashahhud sikhaya, jaise Qur'an ki soora sikhaate the. Us samay meri hatheli aapki donon hatheliyon ke beech mein thi. (Tashahhud ke shabd kuchh is tarah the :) التَّحِيَّاتُ للَّه, وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السلام عليك أيها النبي ورحمة الله وبركاته، السلام علينا وعلى عباد الله الصالحين، أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وأشهد أن محمدا عبده ورسوله (saare sammaan soochak kathan evn kaary, namaazen aur saare pawitr kathan, kaary evn gun Allah ke liye hain. Ai Nabi! Aapke liye shaanti tatha suraksha ho, Allah ki kripa ho aur uski barakten hon. Hamaare tatha Allah ke sadaachaari bandon ke liye bhi shaanti tatha suraksha ho. Main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke atirikt koi saty poojy nahin hai, aur main gawaahi deta hoon ki Muhammad Allah ke bande aur uske Rasool hain.) Bukhari evn Muslim ki ek any riwayat mein hai : "Beshak Allah hi shaanti ka srot hai. Jab tummen se koi namaz mein baithe, to kahe : " التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللهِ الصَّالِحِينَ" (Saare sammaan soochak kathan evn kaary, namaazen aur saare pawitr kathan, kaary evn gun Allah ke liye hain. Ai Nabi! Aapke liye shaanti tatha suraksha ho, Allah ki kripa ho aur uski barakten hon. Hamaare tatha Allah ke sadaachaari bandon ke liye bhi shaanti tatha suraksha ho.) "Jab kisi ne is waaky ko kaha, to aakaash aur dharti ka har sadaachaari banda ismen shaamil ho gaya." "أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ" (Main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke atirikt koi saty poojy nahin hai, aur main gawaahi deta hoon ki Muhammad Allah ke bande aur uske Rasool hain.) phir jo dua chaahe kare.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ko tashahhud sikhaya, jise namaz mein parha jaata hai. Us samay abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka haath aapke donon haathon ke beech mein tha, taaki unka poora dhyaan aappar kendrit rahe. Aapne unko tashahhud is tarah sikhaya, jis tarah unko Qur'an ki soora sikhaya karte the, jo is baat ka pramaan hai ki aapko is tashahhud ke shabdon evn arth donon ka khyaal tha. Atah aapne kaha : "التَّحِيَّات لله" : Har sammaan soochak kathan evn kaary ka haqdaar sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah hai. "الصَّلَوَاتُ" : Farz evn nafal namaazen Allah ke liye hain. "الطَّيِّبَاتُ" : Pawitr tatha sanpoornata ke parichayak kathnon, kaaryon evn gunon ka haqdaar Allah hai. "السلام عليك أيها النبي ورحمة الله وبركاته" : Yeh Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke liye har aafat evn apriy wastu se suraksha tatha har prakaar ki bhalaai mein wriddhi evn praachury ki dua hai. "السلام علينا وعلى عباد الله الصالحين" : Namaazi tatha aakaash evn dharti ke har sadaachaari bande ke liye suraksha ki dua. "أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله" : Main poori drirhta se is baat ka iqraar karta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai. "وأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ ورسولُهُ" : Main aapke liye bandgi aur antim dootatv ka iqraar karta hoon.

Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is baat ki prerna di ki jo dua chaahe kare.

Is tashahhud ka sthaan har namaz ke antim sajde ke baad ki baithak aur teen evn chaar rakaat waali namaazon mein doosri rakaat ke baad ki baithak hai.
Tashahhud mein 'al-tahiyyaat' parhna waajib hai. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se saabit shabdon mein se kisi bhi shabd dvaara tashahhud parhna jayaz hai.
Namaz mein insaan jo dua chaahe maang sakta hai, jab tak usmen koi gunaah ki baat na ho.
Dua ke aaranbh mein apne liye dua karna musathab hai.

3097: Agar namaazi ke saamne se guzarne waala jaan le ki uspar kitna gunaah hai, to namaazi ke saamne se guzarne ki tulna mein, chaalees tak thahre rahna uske liye uttam ho.

Abu juhaim bin haaris bin simma ansaari- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah " Yadi namaazi ke saamne se guzarne waala jaan le ki uspar kitna hai, to namaazi ke saamne se guzarne ki tulna mein, chaalees tak thahre rahna uske liye uttam ho."
Abu nazr kahte hainh mujhe nahin pata ki aapne chaalees din kaha hai ya maheena ya saal.

Namaazi apne rab ke saamne khara usse waartaalaap karta aur use pukaarta hai. Atah, jab namaz ki awastha mein koi uske saamne se guzarta hai, to is waartaalaap ko bhang karta hai aur uski ibaadat mein khalal daalta hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki jo vyakti namaazi ke saamne se guzarkar uski ibaadat mein khalal daale, woh bare paap ka hakdaar ban jaata hai.
Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne yahaan bataya hai ki agar namaazi ke samaane se guzarne waaाla yeh jaan le ki woh apne is kaary ke kaaran kitne bare paap ka bhaageedaar banega, to uske saamne se guzarne ki tulna mein lanbe samay tak apne sthaan mein khare rahna pasand karega.

3098: Jab tum mein se koi sutra saamne rakhkar namaz parhe aur koi uske saamne se guzarna chaahe, to use roke. Agar woh na ruke, to usse laraai kare, isliye ki woh shaitaan hai.

Abu saeed khudri- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Jab tum mein se koi sutra saamne rakhkar namaz parhe aur koi uske saamne se guzarna chaahe, to use roke. Agar woh na ruke, to usse laraai kare, isliye ki woh shaitaan hai."

Waise to shareeyat hamen apne sabhi kaamon mein saavdhaani baratne aur satark rahne ka aadesh deti hai, lekin choonki namaz deen aur duniya ka sabse mahatvapoorn kaary hai, isliye shareeyat ne uska khaas khyaal rakhne aur namaz shuru karne se pahle saamne sutra rakhne ka aadesh diya hai, taaki koi uske saamne se guzarkar namaz mein khalal na daal sake aur woh poori tanmayta se apne rab se waartaalaap kar sake. Lekin yadi koi uske saamne se guzarna chaahe, to pahle aasaani se rokne ka prayaas kare, yadi woh aasaani se rukne ko taiyaar na ho, to usne apna sammaan khodiya tatha woh zyaadti karne waala hai aur use haath se roka jayega, kyonki uska yeh kaam shaitaan ka kaam hai, jo logon ki ibaadton mein khalal daalne aur khaas taur se namaz ko bigaarne ke phiraak mein rahta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3099: Ehraam baandhe vyakti ka aise shikaar ka maans khaana, jise uske liye shikaar na kiya gaya ho aur usne shikaar karne mein madad bhi na ki ho.

Abu qataada- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- Hajj ke liye nikle. Aapke saath aur log bhi the. Isi beech aapne kuchh logon ka raasta badla diya, jinmen abu qataada bhi shaamil the. Aapne unse kaha ki saagar ke kinaare-kinaare chalte raho, yahaan tak ki ham dobaara mil jayen. So, we saagar ke kinaare ka raasta pakarkar chal pare. Phir jab we Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se milne ke liye mure, to sab logon ne ehraam baandh liya. Albatta abu qataada ne ehraam nahin baandha. We chal hi rahe the ki unhen kuchh jangli gadhe nazar aye aur abu qataada- radiyallahu anhu- ne unpar waar kar diya tatha ek gadhi ko pakar bhi liya. Phir ham ne paraav daala aur us gadhi ka maans khaya. Phir hamne kahaah kya ham ehraam ki haalat mein shikaar ka maans kha sakte hain? So hamne bacha hua maans rakh liya aur Rasool - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas pahunchkar is baare mein poochha. Aapne farmayaah kya tum mein se kisi ne us par waar karne ko kaha tha ya uski or ishaara kiya tha? Logon ne uttar diya ki nahin. To farmayaah tum bacha hua maans kha sakte ho. Aur ek riwayat mein hai ki aapne farmayaah kya tumhaare paas kuchh bacha hua hai? Atah, mainne aapko ek baazu diya aur aapne usmen se khaya.

Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hudaibiya ke saal Umrah ke iraade se nikle. Lekin, madeena waalon ke liye ehraam baandhne ke nirdhaarit sthaan yaani zul-hulaifa, jo uske nikat hi hai, tak pahunchne se pahle hi aapko soochna mili ki saagar tat ki or se kuchh dushman aapki or a rahe hain. Aise mein, apne kuchh saathiyon ko, jinmen abu qataada bhi shaamil the, aadesh diya ki dayen or hokar saagar tat ka raasta pakarkar chal paren, taaki shatruon ko roka ja sake. So, we chal pare. Jab nirdhaarit samay par Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka saath pakarne ke liye mure, to abu qataada ko chhorkar baaki logon ne ehraam baandh liya. We chal hi rahe the ki kuchh jangli gadhe nazar aye aur unke dil mein yeh khyaal aya ki kaash abu qataada unhen dekh lete, kyonki unhonne ehraam nahin baandha tha. Hua bhi waisa hi. Abu qataada ne unhen dekh liya aur hamla kar diya tatha ek jangli gadhi ko pakar bhi liya. Phir sabne uska maans khaya.
Lekin baad mein yeh sandeh paida ho gaya ki kya we ehraam ki awastha mein uska maans kha sakte the ya nahin? So, unhonne bacha hua maans rakh liya. Jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se mile, to aapse iske baare mein poochha. Aapne pahle yeh pata kiya ki kya unmen se kisi ne jaanvar ko maarne ka aadesh diya tha ya is kaary mein uski sahayta ki thi, jaise chihnit karna athva ishaara karna aadi? To unhonne jawaab diya ki unse is prakaar ka koi kaam nahin hua hai.
Itna jaan lene ke baad aapne unhen yeh itmeenaan dilaane ke liye ki yeh halaal hai, baaki maans ko khaane ka aadesh diya aur khud usmen se khaya.

3101: Sooraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaaniyaan hain. Allah unke dvaara apne bandon ko daraata hai. Unhen kisi ke jeene ya marne se grahan nahin lagta. Atah jab is tarah ka kuchh dekho, to namaz parho aur dua karo, yahaan tak ki grahan khatm ho jaye.

Abu masaood uqba bin amr ansaari badri- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Sooraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaaniyaan hain. Allah unke dvaara apne bandon ko daraata hai. Unhen kisi ke jeene ya marne se grahan nahin lagta. Atah jab is tarah ka kuchh dekho, to namaz parho aur dua karo, yahaan tak ki grahan khatm ho jaye."

Is hadees mein Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne bataya hai ki sooraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se hain, jo uski saamarthy aur hikmat ka pramaan prastut karte hain. Unki vyawastha mein praakritik pariwartan ka sanbandh bare logon ke jeewan-maran se nahin hai tatha dharti ki ghatnayen unpar asar andaaz nahin hoteen. Yeh kewal bandon ko unke gunaahon se bhaybheet karne ke liye saamne aate hain, taaki we nae sire se tauba karke Allah ki nikatta praapt kar len.
Yahi kaaran hai ki logon ko grahan samaapt hone tak namaz evn dua mein vyast rahne ka aadesh diya gaya hai. Is brahmaand mein Allah ke beshumaar rahasy aur tadbeeren hain!
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3102: Nishchay yeh nishaaniyaan, jinhen Allah bhejta hai, kisi ke marne ya jeene se saamne nahin aateen. Balki unhen woh apne bandon ko daraane ke liye bhejta hai. Atah jab unmen se koi cheez dekho, to Allah ke zikr, dua aur kshama yaachna ki or bhaago.

Abu moosa ashaari- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hainh Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke samay mein soory grahan hua, to aap ghabra uthe, dar rahe the ki kaheen qayaamat na a jaye, yahaan tak ki masjid aye aur sab se lanbe qayaam tatha sajde ke saath namaz parhaai. Mainne aapko itni lanbi namaz parhaate kabhi nahin dekha tha. Phir farmayaah "Nishchay yeh nishaaniyaan, jinhen Allah bhejta hai, kisi ke marne ya jeene se saamne nahin aateen. Balki unhen woh apne bandon ko daraane ke liye bhejta hai. Atah jab unmen se koi cheez dekho, to Allah ke zikr, dua aur kshama yaachna ki or bhaago."

Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke kaal mein jab soory grahan hua, to ghabraye hue khare hue kyonki aapki apne rab se poorn aagaahi yeh aniwaary karti thi ki aap insaanon ki gumraahi evn sarakshi ke kaaran Allah se had darja bhaybheet rahen. Bhaybheet hone ka ek kaaran yeh bhi tha ki shayad soor mein phoonk maarne ka samay nikat a gaya ho. Atah aap masjid gae aur logon ko soory grahan ki namaz parhaai. Tauba aur kshama yaachna ke izhaar ke liye itni lanbi namaz parhi ki jo pahle dekhi nahin gai thi. Phir jab apne rab se munaajaat aur fariyaad se faarigh ho gae, to logon ki or mutvajje hue aur unhen naseehat ki tatha yeh spasht kar diya ki in nishaaniyon ko Allah, apne bandon ki shiksha, yaad dihaani aur chetaavni ke taur par bhejta hai, taaki log dua, kshama yaachna aur namaz mein jut jayen.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3103: Ai Allah! Main teri sharan maangta hoon qabr ki yaatna se, Jahannam ki yaatna se, jeewan aur mrityu ke fitne se aur maseeh-e-dajjaal ke fitne se

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam in shabdon dvaara dua karte the : "Ai Allah! Main teri sharan maangta hoon qabr ki yaatna se, Jahannam ki yaatna se, jeewan aur mrityu ke fitne se aur maseeh-e-dajjaal ke fitne se." Aur Muslim ki ek riwayat mein hai : "Jab tummen se koi tashahhud parh chuke, to chaar cheezon se Allah ki sharan maange : Jahannam ki yaatna se, qabr ki yaatna se, jeewan aur mrityu ke fitne se aur maseeh-e-dajjaal ke fitne se."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam namaz mein antim tashahhud ke baad aur salaam se pahle chaar cheezon se Allah ki sharan maangte the aur hamen bhi unse Allah ki sharan maangne ka aadesh diya hai.

1- qabr ki yaatna se.

2- Jahannam ki yaatna se. Yaani qayaamat ke din.

3- jeewan ke fitne, jaise uski haraam aakaankshaaon aur pathabhrasht kar dene waale sandehon se tatha maut ke fitne, yaani maut ke samay Islam ya sunnat se bhatak jaane ya phir qabr ke fitne, jaise do farishton ke sawaal se.

4- kaana dajjaal ke fitne se, jo antim zamaane mein niklega aur jiske zariye Allah apne bandon ki pareeksha lega. Uska wishesh roop se ullekh isliye kiya gaya hai ki uska fitna bara bhayaanak fitna hoga aur woh logon ko bare paimaane par gumraah karega.

Yeh ek saargarbhit tatha mahatvapoorn dua hai, kyonki ismen duniya aur aakhirat ki buraaiyon se Allah ki sharan maangi gai hai.
Qabr ki yaatna ka saboot tatha uska haq hona.
Fitnon ki bhayaawahta aur Allah ki sahayta maangne aur unse mukti ki dua karne ka mahatv.
Dajjaal ke nikalne ka saboot aur uske fitne ki bhayaawahta.
Antim tashahhud ke baad is dua ko parhna musathab hai.
Achchhe kaam ke baad dua karna musathab hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3104: Main kahta hoon : Ai Allah, mere tatha mere gunaahon ke beech utni doori paida kar de, jitni doori poorab aur pashchim ke beech rakhi hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab namaz ki takbeer kahte, to (soora faatiha) parhne se pahle kuchh der khaamosh rahte. So, mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, aappar mere maan-baap fida hon, aap takbeer aur (soora faatiha) parhne ke beech jo khaamosh rahte hain, usmen kya parhte hain? Farmaya : Main kahta hoon : Ai Allah, mere tatha mere gunaahon ke beech utni doori paida kar de, jitni doori poorab aur pashchim ke beech rakhi hai. Ai Allah, mujhe gunaahon se saaf kar de, jaise ujle kapre ko mail-kuchail se saaf kiya jaata hai. Ai Allah, mujhe mere gunaahon se paani, barph aur ole se dho de."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab namaz ki takbeer kahte, to soora faatiha parhne se pahle zara der rukte. Is antraal mein kuchh duaaon dvaara namaz ka aaghaaz karte. Unmen se ek dua yeh hai : "Ai Allah! Mere tatha mere gunaahon ke beech utni doori paida kar de, jitni doori toone poorab aur pashchim ke beech rakhi hai. Ai Allah! Mujhe gunaahon se saaf kar de, jaise ujle kapre ko mail-kuchail se saaf kiya jaata hai. Ai Allah! Mujhe mere gunaahon se paani, barph aur ole se dho de." Aap sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah se dua karte ki woh aapko gunaahon mein sanlipt hone se bachaane ke liye aapke aur gunaahon ke beech itni doori bana de ki donon ek-doosre se mil na saken. Jaise ki sooraj ke nikalne aur doobne ke sthaan kabhi aapas mein mil nahin sakte. Agar gunaahon mein sanlipt ho bhi jayen, to unse aapko aise svachchh kar de ki jaise safed kapre se mail-kuchail ko dhokar saaf-suthra kar diya jaata hai. Isi tarah aapko paani, barf aur ole jaisi thandi cheezon dvaara gunaahon se dho de aur gunaahon ki tapish aur garmi ko thanda kar de.

Namaz ke aaranbh ki dua dheemi parhi jayegi, namaz chaahe jahri (oonchi aawaaz mein qiraat waali) hi kyon na ho.
Sahaaba Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki ek-ek baat ko jaanne ka prayaas karte the.
Namaz ke aaranbh mein parhne ki aur bhi duayen aai hui hain. Behtar yeh hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se warnit evn saabit sabhi duaaon ko yaad kar liya jaye aur kabhi ise to kabhi use parha jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3105: Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab namaz ka iraada karte, to khare hote samay "Allahu akbar" Kahte, phir ruku mein jaate samay "Allahu akbar" Kahte, phir ruku se uthte samay kahte "Samiallahu li-man hamidah".

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, kahte hainh Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab namaz ka iraada karte, to khare hote samay "Allahu akbar" Kahte, phir ruku mein jaate samay "Allahu akbar" Kahte, phir ruku se uthte samay kahte "Samiallahu li-man hamidah" Fir khare hokar kahte "Rabbana wa lakal-hamd", phir sajde ke liye jhukte samay "Allahu akbar" Kahte, phir sajde se sir uthaate samay "Allahu akbar" Kahte, phir doosre sajde mein jaate samay "Allahu akbar" Kahte, phir sir uthaate samay "Allahu akbar" Kahte. Phir aisa ant tak poori namaz mein karte. Do rakaaton ke baad baithkar uthte samay bhi "Allahu akbar" Kahte. (Poori hadees sunaane ke baad) abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain: Meri namaz tum logon mein Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki namaz se sabse adhik milti-julti hai.

Poori ki poori namaz daraasal bande ke kriyaaklaap evn kathan ke dvaara Allah ki gaurav gaatha hai. Is hadees mein namaz ki us cheez ka zikr hai, jo uski asal pahchaan hai. Allah ki mahima ka warnan. Allah ne takbeer ko namaz ki asal pahchaan kewal isliye banaya hai, taaki uski mahaanta aur gaurav ko siddh kiya ja sake. Chunaanche banda Allahu akbar kahte hue seedha khara ho jaata hai. Phir jab qiraaat se faarigh hokar ruku ke liye jhukta hai, to Allahu akbar kahta hai. Phir jab ruku se uthta hai, to samiallahu liman hamidah kahta hai aur bilkul seedhe khara ho jaata hai. Phir khare-khare Allah ki prashansa karta hai.
Phir sajde ke liye jhukte samay Allahu akbar kahta hai. Phir sajde se sir uthaate samay Allahu akbar kahta hai. Phir ant tak poori namaz mein aisa hi karta hai. Do tashahhud waali namaz mein jab pahle tashahhud se khara hota hai, to khare hote samay Allahu akbar kahta hai. Is tarah se dekha jaye to shareeyat ne ruku se uthne ko chhorkar har sthiti pariwartan ke samay Allahu akbar kahne ka aadesh diya hai.

3106: Jab garmi adhik tez ho, to zuhar ki namaz zara thand parne par parha karo, kyonki garmi ki bheeshanta Jahannam ki lapat ka ek bhaag hai.

Abdullah bin umar, abu huraira aur aboozar- radiyallahu amhum- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne faramyaah jab garmi adhik tez ho, to zuhar ki namaz zara thand parne par parha karo, kyonki garmi ki bheeshanta Jahannam ki lapat ka ek bhaag hai.

Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne bheeshan garmi (jo ki Jahannam ke saans lene aur uski lapat ke kaaran hoti hai) ke samay zara der karke, thanda hone par namaz parhne ka aadesh diya hai. Taaki aisa na ho ki garmi aur pareshaani ke kaaran insaan sukoon se namaz na parh sake.

3107: Jab juma ke din imaam khutba de raha ho aur tum apne paas baithe hue aadmi se kaho ki khaamosh ho jaao, to (aisa kahkar) tumne khud ek vyarth kaary kiya.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jab juma ke din imaam khutba de raha ho aur tum apne paas baithe hue aadmi se kaho ki khaamosh ho jaao, to (aisa kahkar) tumne khud ek vyarth kaary kiya."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jume ke khutbe mein upasthit vyakti ke liye ek aniwaary shishtaachaar yeh hai ki woh khaamoshi ke saath khateeb ki baaten sune, taaki unpar ghaur kar sake. Aage aapne yeh bataya ki jisne khutbe ke beech koi chhoti se chhoti se baat bhi kahi, jaise kisi doosre vyakti se chup raho ya dhyaan se suno aadi kaha, woh jume ki namaz ki fazeelat se wanchit ho gaya.

Khutba sunte samay baat karna haraam hai. Yahaan tak ki kisi ghalat kaam se rokne, salaam ka jawaab dene aur chheenkne ke baad al-hamdu lillah kahne waale ke jawaab mein yarahmukallah kahne ke liye baat karna bhi.
Is manaahi ke dayre se woh vyakti alag hai, jo imaam ko sanbodhit karke koi baat kahe ya imaam usko sanbodhit karke koi baat kahe.
Zaroorat ke samay do khutbon ke beech mein baat karna jayaz hai.
Jab khutbe ke dauraan Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka naam aye, to aappar darood wa salaam aahista se bheja jayega. Yahi haal dua par aameen kahne ka bhi hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3108: Abbaas bin abdul muttalib ne rasoolullah- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se mina mein tharahne ke dinon mein haajiyon ko paani pilaane ke liye makka mein raat bitaane ki anumti maangi, to aapne anumti de di.

Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki abbaas bin abdul muttalib ne rasoolullah- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se mina mein thaharne ke dinon mein haajiyon ko paani pilaane ke liye makka mein raat bitaane ki anumti maangi, to aapne anumti de di.

Tashreeq' ki raaton mein mina mein raat guzaarna Hajj ka ek aniwaary aur pramukh kaary hai, jo Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne kiya hai,kyonki tashreeq ke dino aur raato mein mina mein rahna Allah ki aajnaakaarita aur Hajj ke prateekon mein se hai.. Lekin choonki haajiyon ko paani pilaana bhi neki ka kaam hai aur Allah ke atithiyon ki sewa hai, isliye aapne apne chacha abbaas (radiyallahu anhu) ko haajiyon ko paani pilaane ke uddeshy se mina mein raat na guzaarne ki anumti di hai. Is hadees se pata chalta hai ki yadi koi us tarah ke kaary mein vyast na ho aur uske paas mina mein na thaharne ka koi uchit kaaran na ho, to uske haq mein yeh anumti nahin hai.

3109: Janaaze ko jaldi le chalo. Kyonki yadi woh nek hai, to tum use bhalaai ki or barha rahe ho aur yadi bura hai, to ek buri cheez ko tum apne kandhon se utaar doge.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Janaaze ko jaldi le chalo. Kyonki yadi woh nek hai, to tum use bhalaai ki or barha rahe ho aur yadi bura hai, to ek buri cheez ko tum apne kandhon se utaar doge."

Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne janaaze ko taiyaar karne, uspar namaz parhne aur use dafan karne mein jaldi karne ka aadesh diya hai tatha kaha hai ki agar janaaza kisi achchhe insaan ka hai, to tum use bhalaai yaani qabr ki nemton ki or le ja rahe ho aur agar achchhe aadmi ka nahin hai, to apne kandhe se ek buri cheez ko utaar doge.

Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Tez chalna musathab hai. Lekin itna bhi nahin ki maiyat ka kuchh nuqsaan ho jaye ya kandhon par uthaye hue logon athva saath chal rahe logon ko pareshaani ho jaye.
Kafan-dafan mein jaldi us samay nahin ki jayegi, jab mrityu achaanak ho jaye tatha behoshi ki aashanka ho. Aisi awastha mein mrityu ho gai hai, yeh baat nishchit ho jaye, tabhi kafan-dafan kiya jayega. Isi prakaar kuchh wishesh kaarnon, jaise namaaziyon ki adhik sankhya ya rishtedaaron ke upasthit hone aadi, ke liye thori-bahut der ki ja sakti hai, jab mrit shareer ke kharaab hone ka bhay na ho.
Janaaza agar kisi sadaachaari vyakti ka hai, to uske kafan-dafan mein jaldi karne ki prerna khud uske hit mein hai aur agar kisi duraachaari vyakti ka hai, to phir yeh kafan dafan mein lage hue logon ke hit mein hai.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki insaan ko duraachaari logon ki sangat se bachna chahiye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3110: Kya main tumhen dajjaal ke baare mein woh baat na bataaoon, jo kisi Nabi ne apni jaati ko nahin bataai? Woh kaana hoga aur woh apne saath Jannat aur Jahannam se milti-julti cheezen layega

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Kya main tumhen dajjaal ke baare mein woh baat na bataaoon, jo kisi Nabi ne apni jaati ko nahin bataai? Woh kaana hoga aur woh apne saath Jannat aur Jahannam se milti-julti cheezen layega aur jise Jannat kahega, waastav mein woh Jahannam hogi. Main tumhen usse usi tarah saavdhaan karta hoon, jis tarah nooh alaihissalaam ne apni jaati ko saavdhaan kiya tha."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne saathiyon ko dajjaal, uski wisheshtaaon aur alaamton se sanbandhit aisi-aisi baaten bata rahe hain, jo pahle kisi Nabi ne nahin bataai theen. Udaahran :

Woh kaana hoga.

Allah uske saath do cheezen rakh dega, jo logon ko Jannat aur Jahannam ki tarah nazar ayengi.

Lekin haqeeqat mein uski Jannat Jahannam hogi aur uski Jahannam Jannat. Jo uski baat maanega, use woh Jannat jaisi dikhne waali jagah mein daakhil karega, jo haqeeqat mein Jahannam hogi. Jo uski baat nahin maanega, use woh Jahannam jaisi dikhne waali jagah mein daakhil karega, jo haqeeqat mein Jannat hogi. Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne hamen uske fitne se saavdhaan kiya hai, jis tarah nooh alaihissalaam ne apni qaum ko saavdhaan kiya tha.

Dajjaal ka fitna bahut bara fitna hoga.
Dajjaal ke fitne se mukti ka zariya sachcha eemaan, antim tashahhud mein usse Allah ki sharan maangna aur soora al-kahf ke aaranbh ki das ayton ko yaad karna hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko apni ummat se bepnaah mohabbat thi. Yahi kaaran hai ki musmaanon ko dajjaal ki aisi wisheshtayen bata deen, jo kisi Nabi ne nahin bataai theen.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3111: Sajde mein santulit raho aur tum mein se koi apne baazuon ko kutte ki tarah na bichhaye.

Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Sajde mein santulit raho aur tum mein se koi apne baazuon ko kutte ki tarah na bichhaye."
