Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne aadesh diya hai ki aadmi sajde ki awastha mein santulit rahe. Woh is tarah ki sajde ki awastha mein achchha aasan apnaye. So donon hatheliyon ko dharti par rakhe aur baazuon ko uthaakar pahluon se alag rakhe. Yeh aasan insaan ki chusti aur abhiruchi ko darshaati hai, jo namaz mein waanchhneey hain. Saath hi, is behatreen aasan mein sajde ke sabhi angon ko ibaadat mein shaamil hone ka avsar bhi milta hai.
Sajde ke samay donon baazuon ko bichhaane se mana kiya gaya hai. Kyonki isse susti aur uktaahat jhalakti hai. Saath hi ismen kutte se mushaabhat bhi paai jaati hai, jo ek buri mushaabhat hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3112: Main ne anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- se poochhaah kya Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apne donon jooton samet namaz parhte the? Unhonne kahaah haan.

Masalma saeed bin yazeed kahte hain ki mainne anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- se poochhaah kya Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne donon jooton samet namaz parhte the? Unhonne kahaah haan.

Shareeyat ke uddeshyon mein, kitaab waalon ki mukhaalfat tatha musalmaanon ke liye pareshaani ka kaaran banne waali har wastu ko hataana bhi shaamil hai. Saeed bin zaid, jo ek wishvasneey 'taabii' hain, unhonne anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- se, pyaare Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke baare mein poochha ki kya aap joote pahankar namaz parhte the, taaki woh bhi aapko aadarsh banaakar aisa kar saken? Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki woh is cheez ko asanbhav samajhte rahe hon, kyonki jooton mein aam taur par gandgi rahti hi hai. So anas -radiyallahu anhu- ne unhen jawaab diya ki haan, aap joote pahankar namaz parha karte the. Yeh aapki sunnat hai, jo kisi nirdhaarit sthaan athva nirdhaarit samay ke saath khaas nahin hai.
3114: Us Allah ki qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, yeh duniya fana nahin hogi, yahaan tak ki yeh sthiti paida ho jaye ki aadmi qabr ke paas se guzre, to uspar lotne lage aur kahe ki kaash main is qabr mein dafan vyakti ke sthaan par hota! Haalaanki uske andar deendaari nahin hogi, kewal museebton se tang a kar aisa karega.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Us Allah ki qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, yeh duniya fana nahin hogi, yahaan tak ki yeh sthiti paida ho jaye ki aadmi qabr ke paas se guzre, to us par lotne lage aur kahe ki kaash main is qabr mein dafan vyakti ke sthaan par hota! Haalaanki uske andar deendaari nahin hogi, kewal museebton se tang a kar aisa karega."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3115: Qayaamat kayam nahin hogi, yahaan tak ki furaat nadi se sone ka pahaar nikal aye, phir uspar laraai hogi aur pratyek sau mein se ninyaanve log maare jayenge.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Qayaamat kayam nahin hogi, yahaan tak ki furaat nadi se sone ka pahaar nikal aye, phir uspar laraai hogi aur pratyek sau mein se ninyaanve log maare jayenge. Unmen se har aadmi sochega ki shayad main hi bach jaaoon."
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih "Nikat hai ki furaat nadi se sone ka khazaana nikal aye. Atah, jo us samay upasthit ho, woh us mein se kuchh na le."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3116: Log madeena ko, us ke behtar awastha mein hone ke baavjood, chhor jayenge. Us samay uska rukh wahshi darindon aur parindon ke siwa koi nahin karega.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna haih "Log madeena ko, us ke behtar awastha mein hone ke baavjood, chhor jayenge. Us samay uska rukh wahshi darindon aur parindon ke siwa koi nahin karega. Ant mein jin par qayaamat qayam hogi, woh muzaina qabeele ke do charvaahe honge. Donon apni bakriyon ko haankte hue madeena ja rahe honge. Parantu, use jangli jaanavron se bhara hua payenge. Yahaan tak ki jab saneeytul wada tak pahunchenge, to apne munh ke bal gir parenge."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3117: Antim zamaane mein tumhaare beech ek aisa khaleefa hoga, jo lap bhar-bharkar dhan dega aur uski ganna bhi nahin karega.

Abu saeed khudri- radiyallahu anhu- Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se riwayat karte hainh "Antim zamaane mein tumhaare beech ek aisa khaleefa hoga, jo lap bhar-bharkar dhan dega aur uski ganna bhi nahin karega."
3118: Logon par ek aisa zamaana awashy ayega ki us samay aadmi sone ka sadqa nikaalkar ghoom raha hoga, lekin koi lene waala nahin payega aur dekha jayega ki ek purush ke antargat chaalees striyaan hongi, jo uski sharan li hui hongi. Aisa purush ki kami aur striyon ki adhikta ke kaaran hoga.

Abu moosa ashaari- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Logon par ek aisa zamaana awashy ayega ki us samay aadmi sone ka sadqa nikaalkar ghoom raha hoga, lekin koi lene waala nahin payega aur dekha jayega ki ek purush ke antargat chaalees striyaan (betiyaansh bahnen aadi) hongi, jo uski sharan li hui hongi. Aisa purush ki kami aur striyon ki adhikta ke kaaran hoga."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3119: Ek vyakti ne doosre vyakti se jaydaad khareedi. Phir khareedne waale ne usmen ek sone ka ghara paya.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se riwayat karte hain ki aapne farmayaah "Ek vyakti ne doosre vyakti se jaydaad khareedi. Phir khareedne waale ne usmen ek sone ka ghara paya. Atah usne bechne waale se kaha ki apna sona le lo. Main ne tum se kewal zameen khareedi hai, sona nahin. Lekin bechne waale ne kahaah mainne tumhen zameen, usmen jo kuchh hai, uske saath bech di hai. Ant mein donon nirnay ke liye ek vyakti ke paas gae. Us ne kaha ki kya tumhaari koi santaan hai? Ek ne uttar diya ki mujhe ek beta hai aur doosre ne kaha ki meri ek beti hai. Usne kahaah donon ka nikaah kar do aur is dhan ka kuchh bhaag donon par kharch karo aur kuchh bhaag sadqa kar do."
[iski wibhinn riwayton ko Bukhari evn Muslim ne naqal kiya hai.]
3120: Do aurten theen. Saath mein unke bachche bhi the. Itne mein bheriya aya aur unmen se ek ke bachche ko le bhaaga.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki unhonne Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue sunaah "Do aurten theen. Saath mein unke bete bhi the. Itne mein bheriya aya aur unmen se ek ke bachche ko le bhaaga. Aiेse mein ek ne doosri se kaha ki bheriya tere bachche ko lekar gaya hai, jabki doosri ne kaha ki tere bachche ko lekar gaya hai. Anttah, donon maamla lekar daaood- alaihissalaam- ke paas pahuncheen aur unhonne bari aurat ke haq mein nirnay diya. Phir donon sulaimaan bin daaood- alaihissalaam- ke paas gaeen aur ghatna sunaaeen. Unhonne kahaah chhuri laao, main bachche ko kaat kar donon mein baant deta hoon. Ispar chhoti ne kahaah aisa na karen, Allah aap par daya kare, yeh usi ka beta hai. Yeh sunkar sulaimaan- alaihissalaam- ne chhoti aurat ke haq mein nirnay de diya."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3121: Sadaachaari log, ek-ek karke guzar jayenge aur jau athva khajoor ke bhoose ki bhaanti raddi qism ke log shesh rah jayenge, jinki Allah ki yahaan koi haisiyat na hogi.

Mirdaas asalmi- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Sadaachaari log, ek-ek karke guzar jayenge aur jau athva khajoor ke bhoose ki bhaanti raddi qism ke log shesh rah jayenge, jinki Allah ke yahaan koi haisiyat na hogi."
3122: “Aadmi apne mitr ke deen par chalta hai. Atah, tummen se har vyakti dekh le ki woh kise mitr bana raha hai.”

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : “Aadmi apne mitr ke deen par chalta hai. Atah, tummen se har vyakti dekh le ki woh kise mitr bana raha hai.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki ek insaan ka jeewan evn vyavhaar waisa hi hua karta hai, jaisa uske saathi evn dost hua karte hain. Dosti ka prabhaav charitr, vyavhaar aur kaam-kaaj par parta hi hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki aapne achchhe dost ka chunaav karne ka nirdesh diya hai. Kyonki achchha dost eemaan, saty aur bhalaai ka raasta dikhaata hai aur in cheezon mein madad karta hai.

Achchhe logon ka chayan karne aur unke saath rahne ka aadesh aur bure logon ke saath rahne ki manaahi.
Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne yahaan dosta ka zikr kiya hai, rishtedaar ka nahin, kyonki dost ka chayan insaan khud karta hai, jabki bhaai aur  rishtedaar ke chayan mein uski apni koi bhoomika nahin hoti.
Kisi se dosti soch samajh kar karni chahiye.
Insaan eemaan waalon ki sangti se apne deen ko sabal karta hai aur gunaahgaaron ki sangti se use nirbal karta hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3123: Agar bahrain ka dhan aya, to main tumhen is tarah, is tarah aur is tarah doonga.

Jaabir- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne mujhse kaha thaah "Agar bahrain ka dhan aya, to main tumhen is tarah, is tarah aur is tarah doonga." Parantu, bahrain ka dhan aane se pahle hi Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki mrityu ho gai. Baad mein jab bahrain ka dhan aya, to abu bakr- radiyallahu anhu- ke aadesh se yeh elaan karaya gaya ki jise Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne koi wachan de rakha ho athva jiske paas aapka koi qarz ho, woh hamaare paas aye. Atah, mainne unke paas upasthit hokar kaha ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne mujhe aisa aur aisa kaha tha, to unhonne mujhe ek lap bharkar diya. Mainne gina, to woh paanch sau the. Phir unhonne mujhse kahaah iska doguna aur le lo.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3124: Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek baar haram- makka- mein kurbaani ke liye bakri bheji.
Aysha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek baar haram- makka- mein kurbaani ke liye bakri bheji.

Yahaan aaisha (radiyallahu anha) Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki 'hadi' ke baare mein bata rahi hain. 'Hadi' us jaanvar ko kahte hain, jise Allah ki nikatta praapt karne ke uddeshy se, haram mein zabah karne ke liye, makka bheja jaye. Yeh sunnat tatha neki ka kaary hai. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne bakri bhi bheji hai aur oont bhi bheja hai. Sunnat tareeka yeh hai ki use Allah ki nikatta praapt karne ke liye haram mein zabah kiya jaye aur uska maans haram ke phaqeeron evn miskeenon mein baant diya jaye. Rahi baat us 'hadi' ki, jo 'tamatto' aur 'qiraan' mein waajib hota hai ya Hajj ke kisi waajib kaary ko chhorne athva koi haraam kaary kar guzarne ke kaaran waajib hota hai, to woh waajib hai aur use 'fidya' kaha jaata hai. Lekin yeh 'hadi', jiska ullekh aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kar rahi hain, use ek musalmaan apni ichchha se, apne nagar se ya raaste mein khareedkar, Allah ke ghar ki or bhejta hai, taaki Allah ki nikatta praapt kar sake.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3125: Amaanatdaar, musalmaan koshaadhikaari, jo khushi-khushi aksharshah uska paalan karta ho, jiska aadesh use mila ho aur waheen kharch karta ho, jahaan kharch karne ka aadesh use diya gaya ho, woh bhi ek sadqa karne waala hai.

Abu moosa ashaari- radiyallahu anhu- Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se riwayat karte hain ki aapne farmayaah "Amaanatdaar, musalmaan koshaadhikaari, jo khushi-khushi aksharshah uska paalan karta ho, jiska aadesh use mila ho aur waheen kharch karta ho, jahaan kharch karne ka aadesh use diya gaya ho, woh bhi ek sadqa karne waala hai."
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih "Jo woh deta ho, jiska use aadesh diya gaya ho."
[ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai aur shabd Bukhari ke hain.]
3126: Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke zamaane mein do bhaai the. Ek Allah ke Rasool-sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aya karta tha aur doosra kaam kiya karta tha. Atah kaam karne waale ne Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas apne bhaai ki shikayat ki, to aap ne farmayaah shayad tujhe rozi usi ke kaaran milti hai.

Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke zamaane mein do bhaai the. Ek Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aya karta tha aur doosra kaam kiya karta tha. Atah kaam karne waale ne Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas apne bhaai ki shikayat ki, to farmayaah "Shayad tujhe rozi usi ke kaaran milti hai."
3127: Achchhe aur bure saathi ki misaal aisi hai, jaise kastoori waala aur aag ki bhatti dhaunkne waala.

Abu moosa radiyallahu anhu Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se riwayat karte hain ki aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Achchhe aur bure saathi ki misaal aisi hai, jaise kastoori waala aur aag ki bhatti dhaunkne waala. Kastoori waala ya to tujhe bhent mein khushbu dega, ya tu usse khareed lega ya tu uski sugandh payega. Jabki aag ki bhatti dhaunkne waala ya to tere kapre jala dega ya tu uski durgandh payega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne do prakaar ke logon ki misaal dekar samjhaya hai :

Pahla prakaar : Sadaachaari saath baithne waala tatha mitr, jo Allah aur uski prasannata ki praapti ke kaamon ki raah dikhaye aur neki ke kaamon mein sahoyag kare. Uski misaal khushbu bechne waale ki tarah hai. Woh ya to tumko bhent ke roop mein dega ya tum usse khareedoge ya kam se kam jitni der uske saath rahoge, uski khushbu tumko milti rahegi.

Doosra prakaar : Bura mitr evn saath baithne waala, jo Allah ki raah se roke, gunaah ke kaamon mein madad kare, tum uske bure kaam dekho aur uski mitrata evn uske saath rahne se tumhaar vyaktitv par aanch aye. Aise mitr ki misaal lohaar ki tarah hai, jo bhatti phoonkta rahta ho. Woh ya to urti hui chingaariyon se tumhaare kapre jala dega ya phir uski bhatti ke dargandh se tumhaari tabeeyat bechain rahegi.

Sunne waale ko samjhaane ke liye misaal dena jayaz hai.
Nek aur sadaachaari logon ke saath rahne tatha bigre hue aur duraachaariyon se door rahne ki prerna.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3128: Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apni sawaari ki peeth par nafal namaz parh liya karte the, chaahe aapka munh jidhar bhi hota. Aap apne sir se ishaara karte the. Tatha ibne umar - radiyallahu anhuma- bhi aisa karte the.

Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apni sawaari ki peeth par nafal namaz parh liya karte the, chaahe aapka munh jidhar bhi hota. Aap apne sir se ishaara karte the. Tatha ibne umar- radiyallahu anhuma- bhi aisa karte the.
Aur ek riwayat mein haih aap apne oont par witr parh liya karte the.
Muslim ki riwayat mein haih albatta uspar farz namaz nahin parhte the.
Aur Bukhari ki riwayat mein haih farz namaz ko chhorkar.

Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) nafal namaazen sawaari par baithkar parh liya karte the, chaahe sawaari jidhar bhi ja rahi ho aur uska munh qibla ki or bhi na ho. Ruku aur sajda ishaare se karte the. Rooku, sajda aur qibla ki or munh karne ke liye neeche utarne ki aawashyakta mahsoos nahin karte the. Ismen saamaany naflon, farz namaazon ke aage-peechhe parhi jaane waali naflon aur sabab waali naflon ke beech koi antar nahin karte the. Lekin yeh kewal nafal namaazon ki baat hai, farz namaazon ki nahin. Unhen sawaari par nahin parhte the. Haan, witr bhi sawaari par parh lete the.
[ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3130: Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke samay mein main chhota chcha tha, aur mujhe Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki kuchh baaten yaad hoti theen, parantu, unhen bayaan karne se mujhe kewal yeh baat rokti thi ki mujhse adhik ayu waale log bhi maujood hote the.

Samura bin jundub- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki main Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke zamaane mein kamsin- chhota- tha. Main aapki baaten yaad kar liya karta tha. Parantu, unhen bayaan karne se mujhe kewal yeh baat rokti thi ki mujhse adhik ayu waale log bhi maujood hote the.
3131: Mainne svapn dekha ki main misvaak kar raha hoon. Itne mein mere paas do vyakti aye. Unmen se ek doosre se bara tha. Mainne misvaak chhote ko de di, to mujhse kaha gaya ki bare ko do. Atah mainne misvaak unmen se bare ko de di.

Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Mainne svapn dekha ki main misvaak kar raha hoon. Itne mein mere paas do vyakti aye. Unmen se ek doosre se bara tha. Mainne misvaak chhote ko de di, to mujhse kaha gaya ki bare ko do. Atah mainne misvaak unmen se bare ko de di."
[ise Bukhari ne taaleeqan yaqeen ke seghe ke saath riwayat kiya hai. - ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3132: Mainne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki kurbaani ke liye apne haathon se haar taiyaar kiye, phir hadi ke jaanavron par nishaan lagaye aur aapne unhen haar pahnaye- athva mainne haar pahnaye-, phir unhen kaaba ki or bhej diya aur khud madeena mein hi rahe. Isse aap par koi cheez haraam nahin hui, jo pahle halaal thi.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hainh mainne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki kurbaani ke liye apne haathon se haar taiyaar kiye, phir un (kurbaani ke jaanavron) par nishaan lagaye aur aapne unhen haar pahnaye (athva mainne haar pahnaye), phir unhen kaaba ki or bhej diya aur khud madeena mein hi rahe. Isse aap par koi cheez haraam nahin hui, jo pahle halaal thi ).

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) Allah ke sabse puraane ghar kaaba ka bara sammaan karte the. Jab khud wahaan pahunch nahin paate, to uske sammaan mein tatha uske aap-paas basne waalon ke satkaar ke liye kurbaani ke jaanvar bhej dete. Jab jaanvar bhejte, to un par nishaan laga dete aur haar pahna dete, taaki aam log yeh jaan jayen ki yeh pawitr ghar kaaba ki or jaane waale kurbaani ke jaanvar hain, atah unka sammaan karen aur unhen nuksaan pahunchaane se bachen. Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) isi baat ki pushti karte hue kahti hain ki woh jaanavron ke liye haar taiyaar karti theen. Jab aap khud madeene mein rahkar kurbaani ke jaanvar bhejte, to un cheezon se nahin bachte the, jinse aadmi ehraam ki awastha mein bachta hai. Jaise stri ke paas jaana, khushbu lagaana aur sile hue kapre pahanna aadi. Aap aam haalton ki tarah halaal hi rahte.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3133: Allah ne uske is kaary ke kaaran uske liye Jannat aniwaary kar di hai athva uske is kaary ke kaaran use Jahannam se mukti de di hai.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hainh mere paas ek nirdhan stri aai. Uske saath uski do betiyaan bhi theen. Mainne use teen khajooren deen. Usne donon bachchiyon ko ek-ek khajoor di aur ek khajoor svayn khaane ke liye munh ki or le ja rahi thi ki donon bachchiyon ne usse khaane ko kuchh aur maang liya. Atah, usne jo khajoor khud khaana chaahti thi, uske do tukre karke donon ko de diye. Mujhe uske is kaary se bara taajjub- aashchary- hua (aur bara pasand aya). Atah, uske is kaary ka zikr- warnan- Allah ke Rasool-sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se kiya, to aapne farmayaah "Allah ne uske liye, is kaary ke kaaran, Jannat aniwaary kar di athva uske liye is kaary ke kaaran Jahannam se mukti pradaan kar di."
3135: Widhvaaon aur nirdhanon ke liye daur-dhoop karne waala Allah ke raaste mein jihaad karne waale ki tarah hai, ya raat mein uthkar namaz parhne waale, din mein roza rakhne waale ki tarah hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Widhvaaon aur nirdhanon ke liye daur-dhoop karne waala Allah ke raaste mein jihaad karne waale ki tarah hai, ya raat mein uthkar namaz parhne waale, din mein roza rakhne waale ki tarah hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jo vyakti kisi aisi widhva stri ke hiton ki raksha ke liye khara ho, jiski dekh-rekh karne waala koi na ho, isi tarah kisi zarooratmand nirdhan ki madad ke liye aage aye aur is tarah ke logon par is wishvaas ke saath kharch kare ki iska badla Allah ke yahaan milne waala hai, to woh pratiphal ke maamle mein Allah ke maarg mein yuddh karne waale ya thake bina tahajjud ki namaz parhne waale evn nirantar roza rakhne waale ki tarah hai jo kabhi roza na chhore.

Paraspar sahyog, ek-doosre ki madad karne aur zarooratmandon ki zaroorten poori karne ki prerna.
Ibaadat ke andar har achchha kaam shaamil hai. Widhvaaon evn nirdhanon ki madad karna bhi ibaadat hai.
Ibn-e-hubaira kahte hain : Iska matlab yeh hai ki Allah use ek saath roza rakhne waale, tahajjud parhne waale aur Allah ke maarg mein yuddh karne waale ka pratiphal pradaan karta hai. Iska kaaran yeh hai ki usne widhvaaon ki dekh-bhaal unke pati ki tarah ki tatha apna kharch chalaane mein asmarth nirdhan par apna bacha hua dhan kharch kiya evn shram daan kiya, isliye uska laabh roze, tahajjud aur Allah ke maarg mein yuddh ke baraabar hoga.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3136: Main tere paas Allah ka sandesh lekar aya hoon ki Allah tumse muhabbat karta hai, jaise tum Allah ke liye usse muhabbat rakhte ho.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- se marfooan warnit hai ki( ek vyakti apne bhaai se doosre gaanv mein milne gaya, to Allah ne uski suraksha ke liye raaste mein ek farishta niyukt kar diya. Jab woh farishte ke paas aya, to farishte ne poochhaah tum kahaan ja rahe ho? Usne kahaah main is gaanv mein apne ek bhaai ke paas ja raha hoon. Farishte ne poochhaah kya tumhaara uske oopar koi ehsaan hai, jise tum barhaane ja rahe ho (jis ki tum raksha karne ja rahe ho)? Usne kahaah nahin, baat kewal itni hai ki main usse Allah ke liye mohabbat rakhta hoon. Farishte ne kahaah main tumhaare paas Allah ka sandesh lekar aya hoon ki Allah tumse mohabbat rakhta hai, jaise tum Allah ke liye usse mohabbat rakhte ho."
3138: Achchhe kaaryon ki or jaldi karo, un fitnon se pahle, jo andheri raat ke wibhinn tukron ki tarah saamne ayenge.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Achchhe kaaryon ki or jaldi karo, un fitnon se pahle, jo andheri raat ke wibhinn tukron ki tarah saamne ayenge. Aadmi subah ko momin hoga, to shaam ko kaafir athva shaam ko momin hoga, to subah ko kaafir, duniya ki kisi wastu ke badle mein apne dharm ka sauda kar lega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam momin ko isse pahle ki achchhe kaamon se rok dene waale fitnon aur sandehon ke saamne a jaane ke kaaran unhen karna kathin ho jaye aur insaan ke haath se avsar nikal jaye, achchhe kaamon ki or tezi se barhne aur zyaada se zyaada se achchhe kaam karne ki prerna de rahe hain. Ye fitne andhyaaron ke roop mein saamne ayenge. Maano raat ke tukre hon. Unke aane ke kaaran saty evn asaty is tarah aap mein mil jayenge ki donon ke beech antar karna kathin ho jayega. Haalat yeh hogi ki insaan bad-hawaasi ka shikaar ho jayega. Subah momin rahega, to shaam ko kaafir ho jayeg. Shaam ko momin rahega, to subah kaafir ban jayega. Duniya ki chaar din ki chaandni ke kaaran apne deen ka sauda kar lega.

Deen ko mazbooti se pakre rahne aur achchhe karm ki or tezi se barhne ki zaroorat, isse pahle ki baadhayen raasta rok len.
Is baat ki or ishaara ki antim zamaane mein ek ke baad ek gumraah kar dene waale fitne saamne aate rahenge. Sthiti yeh hogi ki ek fitna jayega, to doosra fitna a jayega.
Jab insaan ka deen kamzor ho jaata hai aur woh duniya ke moh maya mein parkar deen ko chhor deta hai, to iske nateeje mein woh deen se wichlit, door aur fitnon ka shikaar ho jaata hai.
Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki achchhe karm insaan ko fitnon se bachaate hain.
Fitnon ki do qismen hain : Sandehon ke roop mein aane waala fitna, jiska ilaaj jnaan hai. Aur ichchhaaon tatha abhilaashaaon ke roop mein aane waala fitna, jiska ilaaj eemaan evn sabr hai.
Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki jis vyakti ke paas achchhe karm ki poonji kam hogi, uski or fitne zyaada tezi se ayenge aur jiske paas karm ki poonji adhik ho, use apne karm ke dhokhe mein aane ke bajay adhik achchhe karm karne chahiye.
3139: Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki patniyaan aapke paas maujood theen. Itne mein faatima- radiyallahu anha- chalti hui aaeen. Unke chalne ka andaaz Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke chalne ke andaaz se kuchh bhi alag nahin tha.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki patniyaan aapke paas maujood theen. Itne mein faatima- radiyallahu anha- chalti hui aaeen. Unke chalne ka andaaz Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke chalne ke andaaz se kuchh bhi alag nahin tha. Aapne unhen dekha, to unka abhinandan karte hue kahaah "Meri beti ka svaagat hai." Phir unhen apne dayen ya bayen bitha liya aur raazdaari se koi baat kahi, jisse woh atyadhik rone lageen. Jab aapne unki vyaakulta dekhi, to dobaara raazdaari se koi baat kahi aur woh hans pareen. Yeh dekhkar mainne unse kahaah Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apni patniyon ke beech se aapse raazdaari ke saath koi baat kahi aur phir bhi aap ro rahi hain! Jab Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- wahaan, to mainne unse poochhaah Rasool - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne aapse kya kuchh kaha? Unhonne kahaah main Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke raaz ko khol nahin sakti. Parantu, jab Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki mrityu ho gai, to mainne kahaah mera aappar jo adhikaar hai, uska waasta dekar kahti hoon ki aap awashy batayengi ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kya kuchh kaha tha? Unhonne kahaah haan, ab main bata sakti hoon. Jab pahli baar aapne mujhse raazdaari se baat ki thi, to kaha tha ki Jibreel mujhse har saal Qur'an ka ek ya do daur karte the aur is baar do daur kiya hai. Mujhe yahi lagta hai ki meri mrityu ka samay nikat a gaya hai. Atah, Allah se daro aur dhairy se kaam lo. Kyonki main tumhaara uttam salaf- aage jaane waala- hoon. Yeh sunkar main ro pari, jaisa ki aapne dekha tha. Phir jab aapne meri vyaakulta dekhi, to doosri baar raazaadaari se baat ki aur kahaah "Ai faatima, kya tu is baat se santusht nahin hai ki momin striyon ki sardaar bane athva is ummat ki tamaam striyon ki sardaar bane?" Phir main hans pari.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3140: Mujhe Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki kisi patni par utni ghairat nahin aai, jitni khadeeja- radiyallahu anha- par aai. Haalaanki mainne unhen kabhi dekha nahin tha. Lekin aap unhen bahut zyaada yaad karte the.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hainh mujhe Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki kisi patni par utni ghairat nahin aai, jitni khadeeja- radiyallahu anha- par aai. Haalaanki mainne unhen kabhi dekha nahin tha. Lekin aap unhen bahut zyaada yaad karte the. Kabhi aisa bhi hota ki bakri zabah karte, uske tukre banaate aur khadeeja- radiyallahu anha- ki saheliyon ko bhej dete. Yeh sab dekhkar main kabhi-kabhaar aapse kah deteeh aisa lagta hai ki duniya mein khadeeja ke siwa koi hai hi nahin! To aap kahteh "Woh aisi theen, aisi theen aur mujhe unse bachche bhi hue."
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih aap bakri zabah karte aur usmen se unki saheliyon ko utna bhej dete, jo unke liye kaafi ho.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih jab bakri zabah karte, to kahteh "Ise khadeeja ki saheliyon ko bhej do."
Tatha ek aur riwayat mein haih woh kahti hainh khadeeja bint khuwailid ki bahan haala bint khuwailid Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aane ki anumti talab ki, to aap ko khadeeja ke anumti talab karne ka andaaz yaad a gaya aur prasann ho uthe tatha kahaah "Allah, yeh to haala bint khuwailid hain!"
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne tamaam riwayton ke saath naqal kiya hai.]
3141: Nirdhan woh nahin, jo ek ya do khajoor tatha ek ya do niwaala pa kar laut jaye. Asal nirdhan woh hai, jo maangne se bachta ho.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah nirdhan woh nahin, jo ek ya do khajoor tatha ek ya do niwaala pa kar laut jaye. Asal nirdhan woh hai, jo maangne se bachta ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3142: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aksar yeh dua parha karte the : "يَا مُقَلِّبَ القُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ" (Ai dilon ko palatne waale, mere dil ko apne deen par jamaye rakh.)

Anas radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aksar yeh dua parha karte the : "يَا مُقَلِّبَ القُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ" (Ai dilon ko palatne waale, mere dil ko apne deen par jamaye rakh.) mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, ham aappar aur aapke laye hue deen par eemaan le aye hain. Phir bhi kya aapko hamaare baare mein dar hai? Aapne kaha : "Haan, nihsandeh dil Allah ki ungliyon mein se do ungliyon ke beech mein hain. Allah jaise chaahta hai, unko palatta hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aksar is baat ki dua kiya karte the ki Allah aapko deen par sudrirhta pradaan kare aur gumraahi tatha bahkaawe se surakshit rakhe. Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ko aashchary hua ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam yeh dua itni zyaada kyon karte hain, isliye aapne unko bata diya ki insaan ke dil Allah ki ungliyon mein se do ungliyon ke beech mein hain. Woh unko jaise chaahta hai, palatta rahta hai. Dil hi eemaan tatha kufr ka awatran sthaan hai. Dil ko arbi mein "Qalb" Kaha jaata hai, kyonki bahut zyaada ulatta-palatta rahta hai. Dil haandi mein maujood us paani se bhi zyaada ulatta-palatta rahta hai, jo tez aanch ke kaaran khaul raha ho. Aise mein Allah jis vyakti ko chaahta hai, apne maarg par sudrirh rakhta hai aur jiske dil ko chaahta hai, apne maarg se wichlit kar deta hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apne rab ke saamne jhukte the, apni saari muraaden usi se maangte the aur ummat ko bhi iski shiksha dete the.
Deen par mazbooti se jame rahne ka mahatv aur yeh ki kisi bhi cheez ka ant hi asal mayne rakhta hai.
Insaan ek kshan ke liye bhi Islam par qayam rakhne hetu Allah ki kripa se beniyaaz nahin ho sakta.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke padchihnon par chalte hue insaan ko adhik se adhik yeh dua parhni chahiye.
Islam par sudrirh rahna sabse bari nemat hai, jise praapt karne ka prayaas karna aur uspar apne paalanhaar ka shukr ada karna har insaan ka kartavy hai.
[ise tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3143: Jab tummen se kisi ke bartan mein se kutta pi le, to woh use saat baar dhoe.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jab tummen se kisi ke bartan mein se kutta pi le, to woh use saat baar dhoe." Muslim ki riwayat mein hai : "Pahli baar mitti se dhoe."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aadesh diya hai ki jab kutta bartan mein munh daal de, to use saat baar dhoya jaye. Saat mein se pahli baar mitti se dhoya jaye, taaki uske baad jab paani se dhoya jaye, to bartan poori tarah saaf ho jaye aur gandgi tatha haanikaarak cheez baaqi na rahe.

Kutte ka mukhasraav bare hi sakht prakaar ka naapaak wastu hai.
Kisi bartan mein kutte ke munh daal dene se woh bartan aur usmen maujood paani ganda ho jaata hai.
Mitti se paak karne aur saat baar dhone ka aadesh kutte ke munh daale hue bartan ko saaf karne ke liye hai. Uske peshaab, paakhaana aur uske dvaara any tareeqon se gande ki gai cheezon ko saaf karne ke liye nahin.
Bartan ko mitti se dhone ka tareeqa yeh hai ki bartan mein paani daalkar usmen us mitti ko mila diya jaye aur us mishran se bartan ko dhoya jaye.
Hadees ka zaahir yeh kahta hai ki yeh aadesh sabhi kutton ke liye hai. Un kutton ke liye bhi, jinhen shareeyat ne apne ghar mein rakhne ki anumti di hai. Jaise shikaar ke liye aur ghar evn maweshiyon ki suraksha ke liye paale jaane waale kutte.
Saabun evn is prakaar ki any cheezen mitti ka sthaan nahin le sakteen. Kyonki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne spasht roop se mitti ka zikr kiya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3144: Paanch cheezen (maanav) prakriti (ka hissa) hain ; khatna karna, naabhi ke neeche ke baal moondna, moonchhen chhoti karna, naakhoon kaatna aur baghal ke baal ukhaarna.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko yeh kahte hue suna hai : "Paanch cheezen (maanav) prakriti (ka hissa) hain ; khatna karna, naabhi ke neeche ke baal moondna, moonchhen chhoti karna, naakhoon kaatna aur baghal ke baal ukhaarna."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki paanch kaam deen-e-Islam aur rasoolon ki sunnaton ka hissa hain :

1- khatna karna. Yaani ling ki supaari ke oopar ki atirikt chamri ko kaat dena. Isi tarah stri ki yoni mein ling prawesh ke sthaan ke oopar ki chamri ke sir ko kaat dena.

2- agli sharmagaah ke aas-paas ke baalon ko moondna.

3- moonchh chhoti karna. Yaani purush ke oopri honth par uge hue baalon ko is tarah kaatna ki honth zaahir ho jaye.

4- naakhoonon ko kaatna.

5- bagal ke baal ukhaarna.

Nabiyon ki woh sunnaten, jo Allah ko priy evn pasand hain aur jinka woh aadesh deta hai aur jo kamaal, safaai aur sundarta ka kaaran hain.
In baaton ka dhyaan rakhna chahiye aur inse beparvaah nahin hona chahiye.
In kaaryon ke kuchh laukik evn dhaarmik fayde hain. Maslan dekhne mein achchha lagna, badan ki safaai, paaki mein ehtiyaat, awishvaasiyon ki mukhaalfat aur Allah ke aadesh ka paalan.
Any hadeeson mein in paanch kaaryon ke alaawa bhi kuchh kaaryon ko maanav prakriti ke kaary bataya gaya hai. Jaise daarhi barhaana aur misvaak karna aadi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3145: Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin, arbon ka winaash us buraai se hona hai, jo nikat a gai hai. Aaj yaajooj aur maajooj ki deewaar mein itna chhed ho gaya hai.

Zainab bint jahash radiyallahu anha se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ghabraye hue unke paas aye aur kahne lage : "Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin, arbon ka winaash us buraai se hona hai, jo nikat a gai hai. Aaj yaajooj aur maajooj ki deewaar mein itna chhed ho gaya hai." Tatha aapne angoothe aur usse sati hui ungli ka gola banaakar dikhaya. Mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, kya ham halaak kar diye jayenge, jabki hamaare beech sadaachaari log bhi honge? Farmaya : "Haan, jab paap barh jayega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ghabraye hue aur dare hue zainab bint jahash radiyallahu anha ke paas pahunche. Aapki zabaan par ye shabd the : "La ilaah illallah" Jo bata raha tha ki koi apriy ghatna ghatne ki sanbhaavna hai, jisse bachne ka raasta Allah ka aashray lene ke siwa kuchh nahin hai. Phir Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Arab ka winaash us buri ghatna se hone waala hai, jiske ghatit hone ka samay nikat a gaya hai. Aaj yaajooj aur maajooj ki deewaar mein itni daraar a gai hai. Yeh kahte samay aapne angoothe aur tarjani dvaara ghera banaakar dikhaya". Yaad rahe ki yaajooj maajooj ki deewaar se muraad woh baandh hai, jo zul-qarnain ne banaya tha. Yeh sun zainab radiyallahu anha ne kaha : Bhala Allah hamen halaak kaise kar dega, jabki hamaare beech eemaan waale sadaachaari log bhi maujood rahenge? Jawaab mein aapne kaha : Jab gande kaam, jaise duraachaar, awajna, vyabhichaar, madira paan aadi adhik ho jayenge, to vyaapak winaash ayega.

Ghabraahat momin ke dil ko Allah ki yaad se ghaafil nahin karti, kyonki Allah ke zikr se dilon ko sukoon milta hai.
Ghalat cheezon ka khandan karne aur unhen rokne ki prerna.
Vyaapak winaash us samay ghatit hoga, jab gunaah barh jayenge aur aam ho jayenge tatha rok-tok karne waala koi nahin rahega, chaahe nek log bari sankhya mein maujood hi kyon na rahen.
Aapdayen achchhe evn bure sabhi logon par aati hain. Lekin kiyaamat mein apni neeyton ke anusaar uthaye jayenge.
Aapne apne kathan : "Arab ka winaash us buri ghatna se hone waala hai, jiske ghatit hone ka samay nikat a gaya hai" Mein arab ka zikr khaas taur se isliye kiya ki us samay tak musalmaan hone waale adhiktar log arab hi the.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3148: Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- kaaba ke andar gae. Usaama bin zaid, bilaal aur usmaan bin talha- radiyallahu anhum- saath the.

Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hainh Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- kaaba ke andar gae. Usaama bin zaid, bilaal aur usmaan bin talha saath the. Unhonne dvaar band kar liya. Jab dvaar khole, to sabse pahle main hi daakhil hua. Main bilaal se mila aur poochha ki kya Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne andar namaz parhi? Jawaab diyaah haan, do yamni khanbon ke beech.

Jab san aath hijri mein Allah taaala ne makka par wijay dila di aur apne ghar ko buton se pawitr kar diya, to Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kaaba mein daakhil hue. Aapke saath aapke donon sewak bilaal aur usaama tatha kaaba ke mutvalli usmaan bin talha (radiyallahu anhum) bhi the. Daakhil hone ke baad andar se dvaar band kar liye, taaki log yeh dekhne ke liye bheer na laga den ki aap ibaadat kaise karte hain, jo aapke asal uddeshy yaani apne rab se munaajaat (praarthana) aur uski nemton ka shukr ada karne ki raah mein baadha ban jaye. Phir bari der baad dvaar khole.
Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma), jo Nabi (salllalaahu alaihi wa sallam) ke ek-ek kaary ko dhyaan se dekhte aur us par amal karne ke prayaas mein rahte the, dvaar khulne ke baad sabse pahle andar gae aur bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) se poochha ki kya Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne andar namaz parhi hai? To unhonne jawaab diya ki haan, do yamni khanbon ke beech mein khare hokar namaz parhi hai. Un dinon pawitr kaaba chhah khanbon par khara tha. Namaz parhte samay teen khanbe aapke peechhe the tatha do dayen aur ek bayen. Aapke aur deewaar ke beech teen haath ki doori thi. Aapne wahaan do rakaat namaz parhi aur uske chaaron bhaagon mein duayen keen.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3150: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab shauchaalay jaate, to kahte : "اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الخُبُثِ وَالخَبَائِثِ" (Ai Allah! Main naapaak jinnon aur naapaak jinniyon se teri sharan maangta hoon.)

Anas radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab shauchaalay jaate, to kahte : "اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الخُبُثِ وَالخَبَائِثِ" (Ai Allah! Main naapaak jinnon aur naapaak jinniyon se teri sharan maangta hoon.)

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab us jagah prawesh karne ka iraada karte, jahaan peshaab karna hota ya mal tyaag karna hota , to is baat se Allah ki sharan maangte ki woh aapko purush evn stri shaitaanon ki buraai se bachaye. Is dua mein aye hue "الخبث" Evn "الخبائث" Ki vyaakhya buraai tatha naapaakiyon se bhi ki gai hai.

Shauchaalan mein prawesh karte samay is dua ko parhna musathab hai.
Saari srishtiyaan kashtadayak ya nuqsaandeh cheezon se bachne ke liye Allah ki mohtaaj hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3152: Allah ke Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek vyakti ko kurbaani ka oont haankkar le jaate dekha, to kaha ki uspar sawaar ho ja. Usne kahaah yeh to kurbaani ka jaanvar hai. Aap ne kahaah sawaar ho ja.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek vyakti ko kurbaani ka oont haankkar le jaate dekha, to farmayaah "Uspar sawaar ho ja." Usne kahaah yeh to kurbaani ka jaanvar hai. Aap ne kahaah "Sawaar ho ja." Chunaanche mainne dekha ki woh uspar sawaar hokar Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath chal raha tha.
Ek riwayat mein haih aapne teesri ya chauthi baar kahaah "Hay afsos! Uspar sawaar ho ja."

Jab Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek vyakti ko dekha ki woh kurbaani ka oont haankkar le ja raha hai, jabki use us par sawaar hone ki aawashyakta bhi thi, to usse farmayaah "Is par sawaar ho ja." Lekin choonki qurbaani ka jaanvar logon ki nazron mein sammaanit tha aur use koi kasht nahin diya ja sakta tha, isliye sahaabi ne kaha ki yeh to kurbaani ka oont hai, jo kaaba ki or le jaya ja raha hai? To unhen sakhti se sanbodhit karte hue aur is par sawaar hone ki waidhta ko spasht karte hue kaha ki is par sawaar ho ja, yadyapi yeh kurbaani ka jaanvar hi kyon na ho. Chunaanche itna sunne ke baad woh oont par sawaar ho gae.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3153: Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam pardaansheen awiwaahit larki se bhi adhik haya waale the. Parantu, jab koi aisi cheez dekhte, jise naapsand karte, to ham use aapke chehre par pahchaan lete.

Tatha abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam pardaansheen awiwaahit larki se bhi adhik haya waale the. Parantu, jab koi aisi cheez dekhte, jise naapsand karte, to ham use aapke chehre par pahchaan lete.

Abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu bata rahe hain ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam kunwaari larki, jo mardon ke saath na rahi ho aur ghar ki chahaardiwaari ke andar hi rahti ho, se bhi zyaada haya waale the. Aapke prachand haya waale hone ki ek misaal yeh hai ki jab aap kisi cheez ko naapsand karte the, to kuchh bolte nahin the. Bas aapke chehre ka rang badal jaata tha. Aapka chehra dekhkar sahaaba samajh jaate the ki aap is cheez ko naapsand kar rahe hain.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki haya ka bayaan. Yeh haya bhi aapke uchch aachran evn charitr ka ek bhaag thi.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam haya se us samay kaam lete the, jab tak Allah ki hurmaton ko paamaal na kiya jaata. Jab Allah ki hurmaton ko paamaal kiya jaata, to aapka ghussa saamne a jaata aur fauran apne sahaaba ko aadesh de dete ya mana kar dete.
Haya dhaaran karne ki prerna. Kyonki haya insaan ko achchhe kaam karne aur bure kaamon se door rahne par ubhaarti hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3154: Ek Allah ki ibaadat karo, kisi cheez ko uska saajhi na banaao tatha un baaton ko chhor do jo tumhaare baap-daada kahte hain. Tatha hamen namaz evn saty ka aadesh dete hain.

Abu sufyaan bin sakhr bin harb se riwayat hai ki hiraql ne kahaah woh- arthaat, Nabi - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- tumhen kin baaton ka aadesh dete hain? Abu sufyaan ne kaha ki main bolaah woh kahte hain ki ek Allah ki ibaadat karo, kisi cheez ko uska saajhi na banaao tatha un baaton ko chhor do jo tumhaare baap-daada kahte hain. Tatha hamen namaz, saty, paakbaazi tatha naatedaaron ke saath achchhe vyavhaar ka aadesh dete hain.

Yahaan abu sufyaan sakhr bin harb ki hiraql ke saath hone waali mashhoor waartaalaap ka kuchh ansh diya gaya hai. Abu sufyaan un dinon mushrik the. Kyonki woh musalmaan bahut baad mein hue the. Yeh waartaalaap hudaibiya ki sandhi evn makka wijay ke beech ke samaykhand mein shaam desh mein hui thi. Unke saath quraish ke kuchh any log bhi the. Hiraql un dinon eesaaiyon ka baadshaah tha. Usne tauraat, injeel, evn poorvawarti aasmaani kitaaben parh rakhi theen. Woh ek chatur baadshaah tha. Jab usne suna ki hijaaz se abu sufyaan kuchh logon ke saath aye hain, to unhen bula bheja aur unse Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki haalat, kul, saathiyon, saathiyon ki or se unhen praapt hone waale sammaan aur aapki wachanbaddhata ke baare mein poochhne laga. Jab woh koi baat poochhta aur yeh log uttar dete, to woh jaan jaata ki yeh wahi Nabi hai, jiski bhawishyawaani pichhli kitaabon ne ki hai. Lekin raajy ka lobh uske paanv ki beri ban gaya aur woh musalmaan nahin hua.
Usne abu sufyaan se jo baaten poochhi theen, unmen se ek yeh thi ki Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- kin baaton ka aadesh dete hain? Abu sufyaan ne uttar diya tha : Woh aadesh dete hain ki log kewal ek Allah ki ibaadat karen aur kisi ko uska saajhi na banayen. Allah ke atirikt na kisi farishte ki upaasna karen, na Rasool ki. Kisi per ko poojen na patthar ko. Soory ko na chaand ko. Na kisi aur wastu ko. Ibaadat kewal Allah ki ho!! Daraasal yahi saare rasoolon ka sandesh raha hai. Atah Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- bhi wahi sandesh laye the, jo aapse pahle any rasoolgan la chuke the.
Abu sufyaan ne aage kaha ki aap kahte hain : "Un saari baaton ko chhor do, jo tumhaare poorvaj maante aye hain." Yeh baat saty se pare thi. Kyonki unke poorvaj buton ki pooja tatha is prakaar ke jo kaam karte aye the, aapne unhen chhorne ka aadesh diya tha, lekin we jin uchch charitron evn uttam aadarshon ka paalan karte aye the, unhen chhorne ka aadesh nahin diya tha.
Unka kathan : "Woh hamen namaz ka aadesh dete hain." Namaz bande aur uske rab ke beech ek sanbandh aur moolbhoot do gawaahiyon ke baad Islam ka sabse zaroori kaary hai. Isi se momin evn kaafir ki pahchaan hoti hai aur yahi ham musalmaanon ko mushrikon evn kaafiron se prithak karne waali cheez hai. Svayn Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Hamen awishvaasiyon se prithak karne waali cheez namaz hai. Jisne namaz chhor di, usne awishvaas dikhaya."
Unhonne iske baad kaha : "Tatha sach kahne ka aadesh dete hain." Yaani Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apne maanne waalon ko sach kahne ka aadesh dete the. Allah taaala ka kathan hai : "Ai eemaan waalo! Allah ka bhay rakho aur sachche logon ke saath raho." Sachchaai insaan ka ek utkrisht gun hai. Uske do prakaar hain :
Ek Allah ke saath sachchaai tatha doosra uske bandon ke saath sachchaai. Donon hi utkrisht aachran mein shumaar hote hain.
Uske baad unhonne kaha : "Woh paakdaamni ka aadesh dete hain." Paakdaamni ke bhi do prakaar hain. Sharmagaah ki shahvat ki paakdaamni aur pet ki shahvat ki paakdaamni. Sharmagaah ki shahvat ki paakdaamni yeh hai ki insaan vyabhichaar aur uski or le jaane waali sabhi cheezon se door rahe, jabki pet ki shahvat ki paakdaamni yeh hai ki insaan kisi ke saamne haath phailaane aur kisi se kuchh maangne se bache. Kyonki kisi se kuchh maangna apmaan ka kaaran hua karta hai aur maangne waale ka haath neeche, jabki dene waale ka haath oopar hota hai. Lihaaza anaawashyak kisi se kuchh maangna jayaz nahin hai.
Uske baad unhonne kaha : "Naatedaaron ke saath achchhe vyavhaar ka aadesh dete hain." Yaani Allah ne jin naatedaaron ke saath achchhe vyavhaar ka aadesh diya hai, unke saath, nikatta ke aadhaar par wareeyta ka khayaal rakhte hue, achchha vyavhaar kiya jaye. Yaad rahe ki rishtedaaron ki soochi mein sabse ooncha sthaan maata-pita ka hai. Maata-pita ke saath achchha vyavhaar karna neki bhi hai aur rishta nibhaana bhi. Phir, rishdedaaron mein jo jitna qareeb hai, woh achchhe vyavhaar ka utna hi haqdaar hai. Maslan bhaai chacha se adhik haqdaar hai aur chacha pita ke chacha se adhik. Yaad rahe ki rishtedaari nibhaane ka kartavy paalan har us cheez se ho sakta hai, jo jansaadhaaran mein prachlit ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3155: Ai ameerul momeneen, Allah taaala ne apne Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se kaha haih "خذ العفو وأمر بالعرف وأعرض عن الجاهلين" (Arthaat, kshama karte rahen, bhali baat ka aadesh den aur ajnaaniyon se munh pher len.) aur yeh ajnaaniyon mein hain.

Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hainh uyayna bin hisn aya aur apne bhateeje hurr bin qais ke paas thahre. Hurr bin qais un logon mein shaamil the, jinhen umar- radiyallahu anhu- apne nikat rakha karte the. Umar- radiyallahu anhu- ke paas baithne waale ulma hi hua karte the; adher hon ya jawaan. Chunaanche uyayna ne hurr bin qais se kahaah ai bhateeje, tumhaara khaleefa ke paas ek wishesh sthaan hai. Atah mujhe unse milne ki anumti lekar do. So unhonne anumti maangi aur umar- radiyallahu anhu- ne unhen amumti de di. Jab we unke paas aye, to kahaah ai khattaab ke bete, Allah ki qasam, tum hamen adhik nahin dete aur hamaare beech nyay ke saath nirnay nahin karte. Ispar umar- radiyallahu anhu- gusse mein a gae, yahaan tak unhen maarne ka iraada kar liya. Yeh dekhkar hurr ne kahaah 'ai ameerul momeneen, Allah taaala ne apne Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se kaha haih "خذ العفو وأمر بالعرف وأعرض عن الجاهلين" (Arthaat, kshama karte rahen, bhali baat ka aadesh den aur ajnaaniyon se munh pher len.) aur yeh ajnaaniyon mein hain.' Allah ki qasam, umar - radiyallahu anhu- yeh ayat sunne ke baad isse zara bhi aage na barhe. Daraasal, we Allah ki kitaab ke nikat bahut zyaada thaharne waale the.
3156: Aane waale samay mein wareeyta diye jaane ke maamle aur aisi baaten saamne ayengi, jo tumhen buri lagengi." Sahaaba ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! To aap hamen kya aadesh dete hain? Farmaya : "Tum apni zimmewaariyaan ada karte rahna aur apna haq Allah se maangna.

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Aane waale samay mein wareeyta diye jaane ke maamle aur aisi baaten saamne ayengi, jo tumhen buri lagengi." Sahaaba ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! To aap hamen kya aadesh dete hain? Farmaya : "Tum apni zimmewaariyaan ada karte rahna aur apna haq Allah se maangna."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki aane waale dinon mein musalmaanon ke shaasak aise log ban jayenge, jo musalmaanon ke dhan aadi ko apni marzi ke mutaabiq kharch karenge aur musalmaanon ko unke adhikaar se wanchit rakhenge. Isi tarah unki or se deen se sanbandhit kai aisi cheezen saamne ayengi, jo tumhen pasand nahin hongi. Tab Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saathiyon ne aapse poochha : Aisi paristhiti mein unko kya karna chahiye? Aapne bataya ki unka saarvajnik dhan ko harap lena tumko is baat par na ubhaare ki tum unki baat sunne tatha maanne ke apne kartavy ka paalan karne se door ho jaao. Tum sabr se kaam lena, unki baat sunna aur maanna, unse ulajhne ki koshish mat karna, apna haq Allah se maangna aur is baat ki dua karna ki Allah unko sudhaar de aur unki buraai aur atyaachaar se tumko bachaye.

Yeh hadees Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke Nabi hone ka ek mahatvapoorn pramaan hai, kyonki ismen aapne apni ummat ke andar ek baat saamne aane ki khabar di aur woh baat bilkul usi tarah saamne a bhi gai.
Jis vyakti par koi museebat aane waali ho, use us museebat ke baare mein pahle hi bata dena jayaz hai, taaki woh uske liye taiyaar rahe aur jab woh museebat aye, to sabr se kaam le aur use sawaab ka zariya samjhe.
Allah ki kitaab aur Rasool ki sunnat ko mazbooti se pakarna fitnon aur wibhed se nikalne ka raasta hai.
Shaaskon ke aadeshon ka bhale tareeqe se paalan karne aur unke wiruddh widroh na karne ki prerna, agarche unki or se kuchh atyaachaar ho.
Fitnon ke samay sunnat ka anusran karna aur hikmat se kaam lena chahiye.
Insaan ko apne kartavyon ka paalan karna chahiye, chaahe uspar thora-bahut atyaachaar bhi hua ho.
Is hadees mein is siddhaant ka pramaan hai ki jab do buraaiyaan saamne hon, to unmen se zyaada halki buraai ka chayan kiya jayega. Ya phir jab do  haanikaarak cheezen saamne hon, to unmen se kam haanikaarak cheez ka chayan kiya jayega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3157: Jisne sachche dil se Allah se shahaadat maangi, Allah use shaheedon ke martabon tak pahunchayega, yadyapi uski mrityu bistar par hui ho.

Sahl bin hunaif radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne sachche dil se Allah se shahaadat maangi, Allah use shaheedon ke martabon tak pahunchayega, yadyapi uski mrityu bistar par hui ho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jis vyakti ne shahaadat aur Allah ke maarg mein larte hue praapt hone waali maut talab ki, agar woh apni is neeyat mein sachcha aur sarvashaktimaan Allah ki prasannata praapt karne waala raha, to use Allah uski sachchi neeyat ki bina par shaheedon ka darja pradaan karega, chaahe uski maut bistar par hi kyon na ho.

Sachchi neeyat evn saamarthy ke anusaar prayaas ho, to sawaab mil hi jaata hai. Bhale hi waanchhit kaary poora na kiya gaya ho.
Jihaad tatha Allah ke maarg mein shahaadat talab karne ki prerna.
Is ummat ko Allah ka yeh sammaan ki woh ise thore-se kaary ke badle mein Jannat ke oonche darje pradaan karta hai.
3159: ''Momin purush evn momin stri ke saath pareekshayen sada lagi rahti hain; uski jaan, uski santaan aur uske maal mein. Taaki woh Allah se mile aur uspar koi gunaah na ho.''

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : ''Momin purush evn momin stri ke saath pareekshayen sada lagi rahti hain; uski jaan, uski santaan aur uske maal mein. Taaki woh Allah se mile aur uspar koi gunaah na ho.''

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki pareekshayen kabhi momin purush evn momin stri ka saath nahin chhorteen. Pareeksha kabhi uski jaan se juri hui hoti hai, jaise tabeeyat kharaab ho gai shareer theek nahin raha. Kabhi baal-bachchon se juri hui hoti hai, jaise koi beemaar ho gaya, kisi mrityu ho gai, koi naafarmaan nikal gaya waghairah waghairah. Kabhi dhan se juri hui hoti hai, jaise nirdhanta ka saamna karna para, vyavsay baith gaya, chori ho gai, mandi shuru ho gai aur rozi mein tangi ka saamna hone laga. Phir in pareekshaaon ke nateeje mein Allah uske tamaam gunaahon ko mita deta hai aur ant mein jab woh Allah se milta hai, to apne kiye hue tamaam gunaahon se paak-saaf ho chuka hota hai.

Momin bandon par Allah ki daya ka ek drishy yeh hai ki woh duniya ki museebton evn wipattiyon dvaara duniya mein kiye hue unke gunaahon ko mita deta hai.
Museebat gunaahon ko mitaane ka kaam karti hai. Bas shart yeh hai ki insaan ke paas eemaan ho. Banda dhairy rakhe aur Allah ke nirnay se wikshubdh na ho, to use sawaab mil hi jaata hai.
Insaan ko priy evn apriy sabhi paristhitiyon mein dhairy rakhna chahiye. Dhairy ke saath Allah ke dvaara aniwaary kiye gae kaaryon ko kare aur dhairy ke saath uski haraam ki hui cheezon se door rahe. Allah ke sawaab ki aasha rakhe aur uske dand se darta rahe.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke shabd "Bil momini wal mominah" Mein "Al mominah" Shabd ki wriddhi, mahila ke haq mein taakeed laane ke liye ki gai hai. Warna kewal "Al momin" Kahte, tab bhi usmen mahila daakhil ho jaati. Kyonki momin shabd purush ke saath khaas nahin hai. Yadi koi stri kisi wipatti se peerit hai, to use bhi paapon aur apraadhon ko mitaane ke dvaara samaan puraskaar dene ka waada kiya gaya hai.
Museebton ke nateeje mein milne waale sawaab ka waada insaan ke liye museebton ka saamna karna aasaan kar deta hai.
[ise tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3160: Agar tum chaaho, to sabr karo, tumhen Jannat milegi aur agar chaaho, to main Allah se tumhaare liye svaasthy laabh ki dua kar doon.

Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki unhonne ata bin abu rabaah se kahaah kya main tumhen jannati striyon mein se ek stri na dikhaaoon? Ata kahte hain ki mainne kahaah awashy dikhayen. Unhonne kahaah yeh kaali-kaloti stri, Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aai aur kahne lageeh mujhpar mirgi ka daura parta hai aur mera shareer khul jaata hai. Atah Allah se mere liye dua farmayen. Aapne kahaah "Agar tum chaaho, to sabr karo, tumhen Jannat milegi aur agar chaaho, to main Allah se tumhaare liye svaasthy laabh ki dua kar doon." Yeh sunkar usne kahaah main sabr karoongi. Phir usne kahaah mera shareer khul jaata hai. Atah, Allah se dua karen ki mera shareer na khule. Chunaanche aapne uske liye dua farmaai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3161: Atah, jo bhi banda pleg se grast ho jay aur dhairy ke saath tatha sawaab ki aasha mein apne nagar mein thahra rahe, tatha yeh wishvaas rakhe ki use wahi pahunch sakta hai, jo Allah ne uske liye likh diya hai, use shaheed ke baraabar neki milegi.

Aaisha- radiyallahu annaan- ka warnan hai ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se pleg ke baare mein poochha, to aap ne bataya kih yeh azaab tha, jise Allah jisar chaahta, bhejta. Parantu, Allah ne ise eemaan waalon ke liye anukanpa bana diya hai. Atah, jo bhi banda pleg se grast ho jay aur dhairy ke saath tatha sawaab ki aasha mein apne nagar mein thahra rahe, tatha yeh wishvaas rakhe ki use wahi pahunch sakta hai, jo Allah ne uske liye likh diya hai, use shaheed ke baraabar neki milegi."
3162: Allah -taaala- kahta haih jab main apne momin bande se duniya waalon mein se uske kisi priy ko utha leta hoon, phir woh sawaab ki aasha mein dhairyawaan rahta hai, uske liye Jannat ke siwa kuchh aur nahin hai.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se riwayat karte hain ki Allah -taaala- kahta haih jab main apne momin bande se duniya waalon mein se uske kisi priy ko utha leta hoon, phir woh sawaab ki aasha mein dhairyawaan rahta hai, uske liye Jannat ke siwa koi aur badla nahin hai.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is hadees-e-qudsi mein bataya hai ki Allah ki or se jis vyakti ki pareeksha is prakaar li jaye ki uske kisi priy, jaise santaan, bhaai, chacha, pita, maata ya mitr ki mrityu ho jaye aur woh Allah ke yahaan pratiphal praapt hone ki aasha mein uski judaai par sabr kar le, to uska pratiphal Jannat ke siwa kuchh aur nahin hai.
3165: Meri ummat ka nirdhan woh vyakti hai, jo qayaamat ke din namaz, roza aur zakat ke saath aye, lekin is awastha mein upasthit ho ki kisi ko gaali de rakhi ho, kisi par dushkarm ka aarop laga rakha ho, kisi ka rakt baha rakha ho aur kisi ko maar rakha ho, atah ise uski kuchh nekiyaan de di jayengi aur ise kuchh nekiyaan de di jayengi.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se riwayat karte hain ki aapne farmayaah "Kya tum jaante ho ki nirdhan kaun hai?" Sahaaba ne kahaah hamaare nikat nirdhan woh hai, jiske paas na dirham ho na saamaan. Aapne kahaah "Meri ummat ka nirdhan woh vyakti hai, jo qayaamat ke din namaz, roza aur zakat ke saath aye, lekin is awastha mein upasthit ho ki kisi ko gaali de rakhi ho, kisi par dushkarm ka aarop laga rakha ho, kisi ka rakt bahaya ho aur kisi ko maara ho, atah ise uski kuchh nekiyaan de di jayengi aur ise kuchh nekiyaan de di jayengi. Phir agar uske oopar jo haq hain, unhen ada karne se pahle uski nekiyaan samaapt ho jayen, to haq waalon ke kuchh gunaah uske oopar daal diye jayenge, phir use aag mein phenk diya jayega."
3167: Yeh dua sada parhte raha karo 'يَاذا الجَلاَلِ والإكْرامِ' (arthaat, ai prataapi evn upkaari).

Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Yeh dua sada parhte raha karo 'يَاذا الجَلاَلِ والإكْرامِ' (arthaat, ai prataapi evn upkaari)."
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3173: Jab tummen se koi sabha mein aye, to salaam kare aur jab sabha se nikalna chaahe to salaam kare, kyonki pahla salaam doosre se adhik haqdaar nahin hai.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jab tummen se koi sabha mein aye, to salaam kare aur jab sabha se nikalna chaahe to salaam kare, kyonki pahla salaam doosre se adhik haqdaar nahin hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne nirdesh diya hai ki jo vyakti kisi sabha mein pahunche, woh wahaan upasthit logon ko salaam kare aur jab wahaan se jaana chaahe, to salaam karke wida ho. Kyonki aagman ke samay salaam karna wida hote samay salaam karne se adhik mahatvapoorn nahin hai.

Salaam aam karne ki prerna.
Sabha mein pahunchte aur sabha se nikalte samay sabha mein maujood logon ko salaam karne ki prerna.
Sindhi kahte hain : Hadees ke shabdon "وإذا أراد أن يقوم" Ka arth hai : Jab sabha se khara hona chaahe. Isi prakaar Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke shabdon "فليس الأول بأحق" Ka arth hai : In donon sthaanon par salaam karna sunnat hai aur ispar amal hona chahiye. Atah ek jagah salaam karne aur doosri jagah na karne ka koi auchity nahin hai.
[ise abu daawood ne, tirmizi ne tatha nasai ne al-sunan al-kubra mein evn ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3174: Ai Allah ke Rasool, maal-maweshi halaak ho gae aur raaste avruddh ho gae. Allah se dua karen ki hamen warsha pradaan kare

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai : Ek vyakti juma ke din umar (radiyallahu anhu) ke ghar, jo unki mrityu ke baad unke karz ki adaygi ke liye bik gaya tha, ki disha waale dvaar se masjid ke andar aya. Rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam us samay khare ho kar khutba de rahe the. Woh aapki or munh karke khara ho gaya, phir bola : Ai Allah ke Rasool, maal-maweshi halaak ho gae aur raaste avruddh ho gae. Allah se dua karen ki hamen warsha pradaan kare. To rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne donon haath uthaye, phir kaha : "Ai Allah, hamen warsha pradaan kar. Ai Allah hamen warsha pradaan kar. Ai Allah, hamen warsha pradaan kar." Anas (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain : Qasam Allah ki, hamen aakaash mein koi chhota-bara baadal ka tukra dikh nahin raha tha, hamaare aur sala़ pahaari ke beech na koi chhota ghar tha, na bara. Unka kahna hai ki achaanak sala़ pahaari ke peechhe se dhaal ki tarah ek baadal ka tukra prakat hua. Phir aakaash ke beechon-beech aakar phail gaya aur barasne laga. Qasam Allah ki, hamne chhah din tak sooraj nahin dekha.
Phir agle jume ko ek aadmi usi darvaaze se andar aya. Rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam khare hokar khutba de rahe the. Woh aapki or munh karke khara hua aur kahne laga : Ai Allah ke Rasool, maal-maweshi halaak ho gae aur raaste avruddh ho gae. Allah se dua karen ki hamse warsha rok le. Anas (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne donon haath uthaye aur kahne lage : "Ai Allah, ab hamaare oopar nahin, hamaare aas-paas warsha pradaan kar. Ai Allah, teelon, pahaariyon, waadiyon aur peron ke ugne ke sthaanon par baarish utaar." Woh kahte hain ki phir dekhte hi dekhte baarish tham gai aur ham baahar nikle to dhoop khili hui thi. Shareek kahte hain : Mainne anas bin maalik se poochha ki kya woh (doosri baar aane waala) pahla vyakti hi tha? To unhonne kaha : "Mujhe nahin maaloom."

Ek dehaati juma ke din umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhu ke ghar ki disha waale masjid ke pashchimi dvaar se Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki masjid mein daakhil huaai. Us samay Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam khare khutba de rahe the. Us vyakti ne Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki or munh kiya, aur kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, maweshi halaak ho gae, aur sawaari ke jaanavron ke marne ya bhookh se kamzor ho jaane ke kaaran raaste avruddh ho gae hain, atah Allah se dua karen ki woh hamen warsha pradaan kare. Phir aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne donon haath uthaakar pharmaya : Ai Allah! Ham par baarish barsa, ai Allah! Ham par baarish barsa, ai Allah! Ham par baarish barsa. Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ne kaha : Allah ki qasam, hamen aakaash mein baadal ka koi tukra nahin dikh raha tha, aur hamaare (jo masjid mein the) tatha masjid ke pashchim mein sthit sala pahaari, jahaan se baadal aate hain, ke beech koi aisa chhota ya bara ghar nahin tha, jo hamen use dekhne se rokta. Anas radiyallahu anhu kahte hain: Achaanak uske peechhe se chhoti chapti dhaal ki tarah ek gol baadal ka tukra prakat hua. Phir jab woh madeena ke aakaash ke beechon-beech aya, to phail gaya aur barasne laga. Qasam Allah ki, hamne agle jume tak sooraj nahin dekha. Phir agle jume ko wahi aadmi usi darvaaze se daakhil hua, jab aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam khare hokar khutba de rahe the. Woh aapke saamne aakar khara ho gaya aur kahne laga : Ai Allah ke Rasool, maal barbaad ho gaya aur raaste band ho gaye hain. Aap Allah se dua karen ki woh hamse baarish rok le. Woh kahte hain : Atah aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne haath uthaye, phir pharmaya : Ai Allah! Baarish ko hamaare aas-paas pher de, ham par nahin. Ai Allah! Use oonchi zameenon jaise teelon par, chhoti pahaariyon par, ghaatiyon mein aur peron ke ugne ki jaghon par barsa. Anas radiyallahu anhu kahte hain : Chunaanche phauran baarish waala baadal chhant gaya aur ham dhoop mein chalne phirne lage.

Jeewika ki talaash ke liye saadhnon ko apnaana, jaise dua karna aur dharti mein bhaag-daur karna, Allah taaala par poorn bharose ke khilaaph baat nahin hai.
Baarish talab karne ke liye is nabvi dua ko parhna musathab hai.
Jab baarish se nuqsaan ho to istisha -yaani saaf mausam aur baarish ke rukne ki dua karna- jayaz hai. Baarish ko teelon, chhoti pahaariyon aur ghaatiyon ke nichle hisson tak seemit rakhne ki praarthana ki gai hai, kyonki ye sthaan kheti-baari aur charaagaah ke liye zyaada upyukt hain.
Zinda tatha upasthit logon mein se aise logon se dua ke liye kahna jayaz hai, jinke nek aur parhezgaar hone ka gumaan ho, aur yeh jayaz tawassul hai. Raha kisi makhlooq ki jaah (haisiyat) ka waseela banaana, chaahe woh zinda ho ya murda, to yeh jayaz nahin hai; kyonki yeh shirk ke saadhnon mein se hai.
Aagrahpoorvak aur baar-baar dua karna shareeyat sammat hai.
Juma ke din zaroorat parne par khateeb se baat karna jayaz hai.
Baarish barsaane aur use rok lene mein Allah ki adbhut kshamta ka prakat hona.
Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki hikmat ki baarish ko nuqsaandeh jaghon se to roka jaye, lekin jahaan nuqsaan na ho, wahaan se na roka jaye.
Khutbe mein istisqa (baarish ki dua) karna shareeyat sammat hai.
Dua mein donon haathon ko uthaana; kyonki ismen mohtaaji ka bhaav hai, aur in donon (haathon) mein pradaan kiye jaane ke arth ki apeksha hai. Is avsar par donon haath uthaane par widvaanon ki sarvasammati hai.
Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki nubuvvat ki nishaaniyon mein se ek yeh hai ki baarish laane aur use rokne ke wishay mein aapki dua turant sveekaar kar li gai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3175: Mainne Muhammad- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki namaz ko dhyaan se dekha, to paya ki aapka qayaam, ruku, ruku ke baad seedhe khara hona, sajda, do sajdon ke beech baithna, uske baad ka sajda aur salaam evn namaz ke sthaan se nikalne ke beech ka antraal, yeh sab lagbhag baraabar hote the.

Bara bin aazib- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki mainne Muhammad- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki namaz ko dhyaan se dekha, to paya ki aapka qayaam, ruku, ruku ke baad seedhe khara hona, sajda, do sajdon ke beech baithna, uske baad ka sajda aur salaam evn namaz ke sthaan se nikalne ke beech ka antraal, yeh sab lagbhag baraabar hote the.
Ek riwayat mein hai ki qayaam aur tashahhud ke siwa saare kaary lagbhag baraabar hote the.

Bara bin aazib (radiyallahu anhu) jo Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dhyaan se dekhte rahte the, taaki aapki namaz ko seekh saken aur usi jaisi namaz parh saken, kahte hain ki aapki namaz ke sabhi ang tulnaatmak drishti se munaasib aur ek-doosre ke kareeb hote the. Aapka qiraaat ke liye qayaam aur tashahhud ke liye baithna, donon ruku, uske baad ke qayaam aur sajde ke anuroop hote the. Aisa nahin hota tha ki qayaam lanba karen aur ruku halka, ya sajda lanba karen aur qayaam ya baithak halki. Balki har rukn doosre rukn ke anuroop hota. Iska matlab yeh nahin hai ki qayaam aur tashahhud ki baithak ruku aur sajde ke baraabar hote the. Balki iska arth yeh hai ki aap ek rukn ko lanba aur doosre ko halka nahin karte the.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3177: Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ek saphar mein the. Isha ki namaz parhi, to ek rakaat mein soora wat-teeni waz-zaitoon ki tilaawat ki. Mainne aapse uttam aawaaz athva uttam qiraaat kisi ki nahin suni.

Bara bin aazib- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hainh Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ek saphar mein the. Isha ki namaz parhi, to ek rakaat mein soora wat-teeni waz-zaitoon ki tilaawat ki. Mainne aapse uttam aawaaz athva uttam qiraaat kisi ki nahin suni.

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne isha ki namaz ki pahli rakaat mein soora 'wat-teen waz़्-zaitoon' parhi; kyonki aap safar mein the aur safar ki pareshaani evn takaan zyaada lanbi qiraat ki anumti nahin deti. Lekin safar mein hone ke baavjood namaz ke andar achchhi aawaaz mein Qur'an parhne se nahin ruke, jo kuraan sunte samay, wineet hone ka kaaran banta hai aur jis kaaran dil ke na bhatakne ki kaifiyat paida hoti hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3180: Ek vyakti arfa mein thahra hua tha ki achaanak apne oont se gir para aur us ki gardan toot gai. Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kahaah "Ise paani aur ber ke patton se snaan karaao aur use useeke do kapron ka kafan pahna do. Use na khushbu lagaao aur na uska sir dhaanpo. Kyonki use qayaamat ke din is haal mein uthaya jayega ki woh 'talbiya' kah raha hoga."

Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki ek vyakti arfa mein thahra hua tha ki achaanak apne oont se gir para aur us ki gardan toot gai. Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kahaah "Ise paani aur ber ke patton se snaan karaao aur use useeke do kapron ka kafan pahna do. Use na khushbu lagaao aur na uska sir dhaanpo. Kyonki use qayaamat ke din is haal mein uthaya jayega ki woh 'talbiya' kah raha hoga."

Hajjatul wada ke avsar par ek sahaabi arfa mein apni sawaari par ehraam ki awastha mein khare the ki usse gir pareे aur unki gardan toot gai tatha woh mar gae. To Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen aadesh diya ki any murdon ki tarah unhen paani aur ber ke patton se snaan karaya jaye aur unki ehraam ki lungi tatha chaadar mein kafan de diya jaye.
Choonki woh Hajj ka ehraam baandhe hue the aur unke shareer par ibaadat ke aasaar baaqi the, isliye Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen khushbu lagaane aur unke sir ko dhaanpne se mana kar diya.
Saath hi apne saathiyon ko iski hikmat bhi bata di. Hikmat yeh hai ki Allah unhen usi awastha mein jeewit karke uthayega, jis awastha mein unki mrityu hui hai. Woh talbiya pukaar rahe honge, jo Hajj ka khaas chihn hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3184: Mainne Jannat mein jhaanka, to dekha ki wahaan sthaan paane waale adhiktar log nirdhan hain aur Jahannam mein jhaanka, to dekha ki wahaan sthaan paane waale adhiktar log striyaan hain.

Abdullah bin abbaas aur imraan bin husain- radiyallahu anhum- kahte hain ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Mainne Jannat mein jhaanka, to dekha ki wahaan sthaan paane waale adhiktar log nirdhan hain aur Jahannam mein jhaanka, to dekha ki wahaan sthaan paane waale adhiktar log striyaan hain."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3185: Waapas jaakar phir se namaz parho, kyonki tumne namaz parhi hi nahin.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki : Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- masjid mein daakhil hue. Isi beech ek aadmi ne masjid mein prawesh kiya, namaz parhi aur Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aakar salaam kiya, to aapne uske salaam ka jawaab diya aur farmaya : "Waapas jaakar phir se namaz parho, kyonki tumne namaz parhi hi nahin." Chunaanche woh waapas gaya, pahle hi ki tarah dobaara namaz parhi aur Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aakar salaam kiya. Dobaara aapne kaha : "Waapas jaakar phir se namaz parho, kyonki tumne namaz parhi hi nahin." (Aisa teen baar hua.) anttah usne kaha : Us Allah ki qasam jisne aapko saty ke saath bheja hai, mujhe isse achchhi namaz nahin aati! Atah mujhe sikha deejiye. Ispar aapne kaha : "Jab tum namaz ke liye khare ho, to 'Allahu akbar' kaho. Phir jitna ho sake, kuraaan parho. Phir itmeenaan ke saath ruku karo. Phir utho aur santulit hokar khare ho jaao. Phir itmeenaan ke saath sajda karo. Phir utho aur itmeenaan se baitho. Aur aisa apni poori namaz mein karo."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- masjid mein daakhil hue. Aapke baad ek vyakti daakhil hua aur jaldi-jaldi do rakaat namaz parh li. Na kiyaam itmeenaan se kiya, na ruku aur na sajda. Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- use namaz parhte hue dekh rahe the. Aap us samay masjid ke ek kinaare mein baithe hue the. Woh vyakti aapke paas aya aur salaam kiya, to aapne salaam ka jawaab dene ke baad farmaya : Waapas jaao aur dobaara namaz parho, kyonki tumne namaz parhi hi nahin hai. Woh waapas gaya, pahle hi ki tarah dobaara jaldi-jaldi namaz parhi, waapas aya aur aapko salaam kiya, to aapne kaha : Tum waapas jaao aur dobaara namaz parho. Kyonki tumne namaz parhi hi nahin hai. Aapne aisa teen baar kiya. Tab us vyakti ne kaha : Us Allah ki qasam jisne aapko saty ke saath bheja hai, mujhe isse behtar namaz parhna nahin aata. Atah aap mujhe namaz sikha den. Tab aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne usse kaha : Jab namaz ke liye khare ho jaao, to takbeer-e-tahreema kaho, phir faatiha aur jo Allah chaahe parho, phir is tarah itmeenaan se ruku karo ki donon hatheliyon ko donon ghutnon par rakh lo, apni peeth phaila lo aur itmeenaan se ruku karo, phir uth jaao aur apni peeth is tarah seedhi kar lo ki saari haddiyaan apne-apne joron tak pahunch jayen aur seedhe khare ho jaao, phir itmeenaan se sajda karo aur peshaani tatha naak evn donon haathon, ghutnon aur pairon ki ungliyon ke kinaaron ko zameen par rakho, phir utho aur itmeenaan se donon sajdon ke beech baitho aur uske baad aisa hi apni namaz ki har rakaat mein karo.

Namaz ke ye stanbh ghalti se ya anjaane mein chhoot jaane se kshama nahin hote. Pramaan yeh hai ki aapne apne saamne namaz parh rahe is vyakti ko ise dohraane ka aadesh diya. Sikha dene maatr par bas nahin kiya.
Itmeenaan se namaz parhna namaz ka ek stanbh hai.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki jisne namaz ke kisi aniwaary kaary ko sahi se ada nahin kiya, uski namaz sahi nahin hogi.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki widyaarthi evn ajnaan vyakti ke saath winamrataapoorn vyavhaar karna chahiye, samasya ko samjhaana chahiye aur uddeshyon ka saaraansh prastut karna chahiye. Kewal mahatvapoorn baaten sikhaane par dhyaan dena chahiye aur aisi anupoorkon mein nahin jaana chahiye, jinhen yaad rakhna ya unpar amal karna asanbhav ho.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki jab mufti se kisi cheez ke baare mein poochha jaye aur koi doosra wishay bhi ho, jiske baare mein prashnakarta ne na poochha ho, lekin uske liye uski jaankaari rakhna aawashyak ho, to use bata dena waanchhit hai. Aisa karna shubhchintan ki shreni mein aata hai. Ghair-zaroori baat karne ki shreni mein nahin.
Apni kotaahi evn kami ko sveekaar karne ki fazeelat. Kyonki is hadees mein ullikhit vyakti ne kaha hai : "Main isse behtar namaz nahin parh sakta. Isliye mujhe sikha den."
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki insaan ko bhalaai ka aadesh dena chahiye aur buraai se rokna chahiye, aur seekhne waale ko widvaan se maargadarshan maangna chahiye.
Mulaaqaat ke samay salaam karna musathab aur uska uttar dena waajib hai. Mulaaqaat baar-baar ho to donon mulaakaaton ke beech ka antraal kam hone par bhi baar-baar salaam karna chahiye. Har baar salaam ka uttar dena bhi waajib hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3194: Uhud ke din ek aadmi ne Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se kahaah aap kya kahte hain ki agar main shaheed ho gaya, to kahaan rahoonga? Aapne kahaah "Jannat mein." Yeh sunkar usne woh khajooren phenk deen, jo uske haath mein theen aur larne laga, yahaan tak ki shaheed ho gaya.

Jaabir bin abdullah- radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki uhud ke din ek aadmi ne Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se kahaah aap kya kahte hain ki agar main shaheed ho gaya, to kahaan rahoonga? Aapne kahaah "Jannat mein." Yeh sunkar usne woh khajooren phenk deen, jo uske haath mein theen aur larne laga, yahaan tak ki shaheed ho gaya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3219: Musalmaan ki, apne bhaai ke haq mein, uski anupasthiti mein ki gai dua qabool hoti hai. Uske sir ke nikat ek farishta niyukt hota hai. Woh jab bhi apne bhaai ke liye koi achchhi dua karta hai, woh niyukt farishta kahta hai ki Allah ise grahan kare tatha tujhe bhi aisi hi bhalaai mile.

Umme darda- radiyallahu anha- se riwayat hai ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah musalmaan ki, apne bhaai ke haq mein, uski anupasthiti mein ki gai dua qabool hoti hai. Uske sir ke nikat ek farishta niyukt hota hai. Woh jab bhi apne bhaai ke liye koi achchhi dua karta hai, woh niyukt farishta kahta hai ki Allah ise grahan kare tatha tujhe bhi aisi hi bhalaai mile.
3220: Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab namaz parhte, to (sajde ki awastha mein) apne donon baazuon ko itna hataakar rakhte ki aapki baglon ka ujlaapan prakat ho jaata.

Abdullah bin maalik bin buhaina radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab namaz parhte, to (sajde ki awastha mein) apne donon baazuon ko itna hataakar rakhte ki aapki baglon ka ujlaapan prakat ho jaata.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab sajda karte, to sajde ke dauraan donon haathon ko pahluon se itna zyaada alag rakhte ki donon baglon ki chamri ki safedi nazar a jaati. Yeh daraasal donon baazuon ko donon pahluon se alag rakhne mein atishyokti hai.

Sajde ki haalat mein donon baazuon ko donon pahluon se alag rakhna musathab (waanchhneey)  hai.
Jab muqatdi ko donon baazuon ko adhik kholne ke kaaran uske bagal waale insaan ko kasht hone lage, to aisa karna shareeyat sammat nahin hoga.
Sajde ki haalat mein baazuon ko pahluon se alag rakhne ke peechhe bahut-si hikamten aur uske bahut-se fayde hain. Jaise is baat ka i़zahaar ki insaan poore phurteelepan aur chaahat ke saath namaz parh raha hai. Saath hi yeh ki jab insaan sajde ke saare angon ko zameen par rakh deta hai, har ang ibaadat mein vyast ho jaata hai. Kuchh log iski hikmat yeh bataate hain ki yeh awastha winaysheelta ka pradarshan adhik karne waali aur chehre evn naak ko achchhe se zameen par rakhne mein adhik madadgaar hai. Isse insaan ke shareer ka har ang alag-alag bhi nazar aata hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3226: Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- umaama bint zainab (apni naatin) ko uthaye hue namaz parh lete the.

Abu qataada- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- umaama bint zainab (apni naatin) ko uthaye hue namaz parh lete the.
Aur abul-aas bin rabi bin abde shams- radiyallahu anhu- ki riwayat mein hai ki jab sajde mein jaate to unhen rakh dete aur jab khare hote to utha lete.

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apni nawaasi umaama bint zainab ko namaz ki haalat mein utha lete the. Jab khare hote to apne kandhe par utha lete aur jab ruku ya sajda karte to zameen mein rakh dete.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3227: Main is maamle mein koi kotaahi nahin karoonga ki tumhen waisi hi namaz parhaaoon, jaisi Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hamen namaz parhaya karte the.

Anas- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki unhonne kahaah main is maamle mein koi kotaahi nahin karoonga ki tumhen waisi hi namaz parhaaoon, jaisi Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hamen namaz parhaya karte the. (Is hadees ke warnankarta saabit kahte hainh) chunaanche anas- radiyallahu anhu- ek aisa kaary karte the, jo tum karte hue nazar nahin aate. Jab ruku se sir uthaate, to itni der tak seedhe khare rahte ki kahne waala kahtaah aap bhool gae hain. Aur jab sajde se sir uthaate, to eetni der thaharte ki kahne waala kahtaah aap bhool gae hain.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kaha karte the ki main poori koshish karoonga ki tumhen usi tarah namaz parhaaoon, jaise rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hamen parhaya karte the. Taaki tum uska anusran karte hue usi jaisi namaz parh sako.
Saabit bunaani kahte hainh anas (radiyallahu anhu) namaz ko sanpoorn evn sundar banaane ke liye ek aisa kaam karte the, jo main tumhen karte hue nahin dekhta hoon. Woh ruku ke baad der tak khare rahte aur sajde ke baad der tak baithe rahte. Jab ruku se sir uthaate, to seedhe khare rahte, yahaan tak ki der tak khare rahna dekhkar kahne waala kahtaah aap bhool gae hain ki ruku tatha sajde ke beech qayaam ki haalat mein hain. Aur jab sajde se sir uthaate, to itni der baithe rahte ki lanbi baithak ko dekhkar kahne waala kahtaah aap bhool gae hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3228: Hamen janaaze ke peechhe chalne se mana kiya gaya hai, lekin is maamle mein hampar sakhti nahin barti gai hai.
Umme atiyya- radiyallahu anha- se riwayat hai, woh kahti hainh hamen janaaze ke peechhe chalne se mana kiya gaya hai, lekin is maamle mein hampar sakhti nahin barti gai hai.

Umme atiyya ansaari ek warishth sahaabiya hain. Unka kahna hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne striyon ko janaaze ke saath chalne se mana kiya hai. Iska kaaran yeh hai ki unka dil bara narm hota hai. Unke paas purushon jaisa dhairy aur sahan shakti nahin hoti. Atah, unke nikalne se rone-dhone aur fitne ka dar rahta hai.
