Parantu, iske baavjood unhonne qareenon se yeh samjha hai ki yeh manaahi taakeed waali nahin hai aur isse uska haraam hona saabit nahin hota. Lekin sahi yeh hai ki striyaan janaaze ke peechhe chal nahin sakteen. Ibne daqeeq al-eed kahte hainh striyon ke janaaze ke peechhe chalne se manaahi ke baare mein kai hadeesen maujood hain, jo is hadees se adhik sakhti par dalaalat karti hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3229: Logon ko aadesh diya gaya hai ki unka antim kaary kaaba ka tawaaf ho. Haan, magar maahvaari ke dinon waali stri ke liye aasaani rakhi gai hai.

Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai. We kahte hainh logon ko aadesh diya gaya hai ki unka antim kaary kaaba ka tawaaf ho. Haan, magar maahvaari ke dinon waali stri ke liye aasaani rakhi gai hai.

Pawitr kaaba bara sammaanit ghar hai. Woh Allah ki ibaadat aur uske saamne winaypoorvak khare hone ka nishaan hai. Logon ke dilon mein uska aadar, usse sanbandh aur prem rakh diya gaya hai.
Yahi kaaran hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne Hajj karne waale ko aadesh diya ki waapsi se pahle uska aakhiri kaary kaaba ka tawaaf ho. Is antim tawaaf ko 'tawaaf-e-wada' kaha jaata hai. Albatta, maahvaari waali stri ko tawaaf bhi nahin karna hai aur fidya bhi nahin dena hai; kyonki uske prawesh karne se masjid gandi ho sakti hai. Lekin yeh hadees Hajj ke baare mein hai. Ismen Umrah shaamil nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3231: Tum apne liye baddua na karo, apni santaan ke liye baddua na karo tatha apni dhan-daulat ke liye dushkaamna na karo. Kaheen aisa na ho ki tum Allah ki or se us ghari ko pa lo, jismen usse kuchh maanga jay, to woh tumhaari dua qabool kar le.

Jaabir bin abdullah- radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Tum apne liye baddua na karo, apni santaan ke liye bahdua na karo tatha apni dhan-daulat ke liye dushkaamna na karo. Kaheen aisa na ho ki tum Allah ki or se us ghari ko pa lo, jismen usse kuchh maanga jaye, to woh tumhaari dua qabool kar le."

Is hadees mein Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- svayn apne, apni santaan tatha apne dhan par baddua karne se mana kar rahe hain. Kyonki dua ek bahut bari cheez hai aur kabhi-kabhi Allah use bandon ke haq mein prabhaawi bhi bana deta hai. Aise mein yadi woh grahan ho jaye, to uska nuqsaan khud baddua karne waale ko hi, uski jaan, maal evn santaan ki kshati ke roop mein uthaana parega.
3232: Tummen se kisi ki dua us samay tak qabool hoti hai, jab tak woh jaldabaaji na kare. Arthaat aisa na kahe ki mainne apne rab ko pukaara, parantu, meri dua qabool nahin hui.

Abu huraira (raji़yallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah tummen se kisi ki dua us samay tak qabool hoti hai, jab tak woh jaldabaaji na kare, arthaat aisa na kahe ki mainne apne rab ko pukaara, parantu, meri dua qabool na hui.
Tatha Muslim ki riwayat mein haih "Bande ki dua us samay tak qabool hoti hai, jab tak gunaah ya rishta-naata torne ki dua na kare, jab tak jaldabaaji na kare." Prashan kiya gaya ki ai Allah ke Rasool, jaldabaaji karne ka kya arth hai? Aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah "Aisa kahe ki mainne dua ki, phir dua ki, parantu meri dua qabool nahin hui aur iske baad thak haar kar baith jaye aur dua karna chhor de."

Is hadees mein Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- bata rahe hain ki bande ki dua us samay tak grahan hoti hai, jab tak woh kisi gunaah ke kaam ya sanbandh wichchhed ki dua na kare aur jaldabaazi na dikhaye. Yeh sun kisi ne kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Jaldabaazi se kya muraad hai, jiske kaaran dua grahan hone se rah jaati hai? To farmaya : Banda yeh kahe ki mainne baar-baar dua ki, lekin meri dua grahan nahin hui aur phir jaldabaazi dikhaate hue dua karna band kar de.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3236: Allah apne bande se sabse nikat raat ke antim bhaag mein hota hai.

Abu umaama radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki mujhe amr bin absa radiyallahu anhu ne bataya hai ki unhonne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Allah apne bande se sabse nikat raat ke antim bhaag mein hota hai. Atah yadi us samay Allah ka smaran karne waalon mein shaamil ho sako, to ho jaao."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki banda apne rab se sabse zyaada nikat raat ke antim tihaai bhaag mein hua karta hai. Isliye har vyakti ka prayaas hona chahiye ki raat ke us bhaag mein jaagkar Allah ki ibaadat kare, namaz parhe, zikr mein vyast rahe aur tauba kare.

Raat ke antim bhaag mein zikr karne ki prerna.
Zikr, dua aur namaazon ke samyon ki fazeelat mein kami-beshi hua karti hai.
Meerak do hadeeson ke do waakyon, "Paak rab apne bande se sabse zyaada nikat raat ke antim tihaai bhaag mein hua karta hai" Aur "Banda apne paak rab se sabse zyaada nikat sajde ki awastha mein hua karta hai" Ka antar bataate hue likhte hain : Pahli hadees mein uddeshy yeh bayaan karna hai ki paak rab apne bande se sabse nikat kab hota hai. Iska uttar hai, raat ka antim bhaag. Jabki doosri hadees mein uddeshy yeh bayaan karna hai ki banda apne paak rab se sabse nikat kis awastha mein hua karta hai. Iska uttar hai, sajde ki awastha.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi aur nasai ne riwayat kiya hai]
3253: Jab ham log Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aate, to jisko majlis ke ant mein jahaan sthaan milta, waheen baith jaata.

Jaabir bin samura (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh pharmaate hainh jab ham log Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aate, to jisko majlis ke ant mein jahaan sthaan milta, waheen baith jaata.
[saheeh li-ghairihi (any sandon athva riwayton se milkar saheeh)]
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3260: Apne maata-pita ke paas laut jaao tatha unke saath achchha vyavhaar karo.

Abdullah bin amr (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ki ek vyakti Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya tatha kaha kih main aapse hijrat karne tatha jihaad karne par Allah (taaala) se pratiphal ki ummeed karte hue baia़t karta hoon. Aapne farmayaah kya tumhaare maata-pita mein se koi jeewit hai? Unhonne kahaah haan, balki donon jeewit hain. Aapne poochhaah kya tum Allah se pratiphal chaahte ho? Unhonne kahaah haan. Aapne farmayaah tab tum apne maata-pita ke paas laut jaao tatha unke saath achchha vyavhaar karo.
Bukhari tatha Muslim ki ek riwayat mein hai ki ek vyakti Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya tatha jihaad mein sammilit hone ki aajna maangi, to aapne farmayaah kya tumhaare maata-pita jeewit hain? Unhonne kahaah haan. To aapne pharmayaah unke prati jihaad karo.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas ek vyakti aya aur aapse Allah ke maarg mein jihaad tatha hijrat ki ichchha prakat ki. Woh apne peechhe apne maata-pita ko chhor aya tha aur abu daaood ki riwayat mein hai ki donon uske maare jaane ki aashanka se roe ja rahe the. Atah Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne usse poochha : "Kya tere maata-pita mein se koi jeewit hai?" Usne kaha ki ek nahin, balki donon jeewit hain. Aapne poochha : "Kya tum Allah se pratiphal chaahte ho?" Usne kaha ki haan, to aapne farmaya : "Apne maata-pita ke paas laut jaao aur unki achchhi tarah sewa karo." Jabki abu daaood ki ek riwayat mein hai : "Unke paas laut jaao aur jis tarah unko rulaya hai, usi tarah unko hansaao." Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne us vyakti ko us kaam ki or lauta diya, jo uske haq mein behtar tatha adhik zaroori tha. Yaani maata-ki or laut jaana aur unki achchhi tarah sewa karna. Kyonki yeh, unki sewa, unki santushti aur unke aadesh ke anupaalan mein apne nafs se jihaad karna hai. Bukhari evn Muslim ki ek riwayat mein hai : "Atah tum un donon ke sanbandh mein jihaad karo."
Ek any hadees mein spasht roop se bata diya gaya hai ki maata-pita ki sewa karna, unki baat maanna aur unke saath achchha vyavhaar karna Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karne se uttam hai. Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ki ek riwayat mein hai ki ek vyakti Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aya aur aapse sabse achchha karm jaanna chaaha, to aapne farmaya : "Sabse achchha karm namaaza hai." Usne poochha ki uske baad sabse achchha karm kaun-sa hai? To farmaya : "Uske baad jihaad hai." Usne kaha ki mere maata-pita jeewit hain, to aapne farmaya : "Tumhaara apne maata-pita ki sewa karna isse achchha hai." Lekin haan, yadi jihaad vyaktigat roop se aniwaary ho, to use maata-pita ki sewa par praathmikta praapt hogi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3261: Jannat tatha Jahannam ne ek doosre se jhagra kiya. Jahannam ne kahaah mere andar abhimaani tatha ghamandi log prawesh karenge. Jabki Jannat ne kahaah mere andar kamzor tatha ghareeb log prawesh karenge.

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jannat tatha Jahannam ne ek doosre se jhagra kiya. Jahannam ne kahaah mere andar abhimaani tatha ghamandi log prawesh karenge. Jabki Jannat ne kahaah mere andar kamzor tatha ghareeb log prawesh karenge. Atah, Allah ne unke beech faisla karte hue kahaah ai Jannat, tu meri rahmat hai. Main jispar chaahunga tere duwaara raham karunga tatha ai Jahannam, tu mera azaab hai. Main jisko chaahunga tere zariye azaab doonnga tatha tum donon ko bharne ki zimmewaari meri hai."
3262: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas ek vyakti laya gaya, jisne madira paan kar rakha tha, to aapne pharmayaah "Isko maaro."

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas ek vyakti laya gaya, jisne madira paan kar rakha tha, to aapne pharmayaah "Isko maaro."
Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hainh chunaanche hammen se kisi ne use haath se maara, kisi ne joote se, to kisi ne kapre se. Phir jab waapas hua, to kisi ne kah diyaah Allah tujhe zaleel kare. Atah, aapne pharmayaah "Is tarah ki baat na kaho. Uske wiruddh shaitaan ki madad na karo."
3265: Main woh kuchh dekhta hoon, jo tum nahin dekhte. Aakaash charachraata hai aur uska charachraana uchit bhi hai. Usmen chaar ungli ki bhi koi aisi jagah nahin hai, jahaan koi farishta peshaani rakhkar Allah taaana ko sajda na kar raha ho.

Aboozar (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh "Main woh kuchh dekhta hoon, jo tum nahin dekhte. Aakaash charachraata hai aur uska charachraana uchit bhi hai. Usmen chaar ungli ki bhi koi aisi jagah nahin hai, jahaan koi farishta peshaani rakhkar Allah taaana ko sajda na kar raha ho. Allah ki qasam, agar tum woh kuchh jaan lo, jo main jaanta hoon, to tum hanso kam aur ru adhik tatha bisatron par striyon ke saath aanand na le sako evn Allah se fariyaad karte hue raaston ki or nikal jaao."
[hasan li-ghairihi (any sandon athva riwayton ke saath milkar hasan)]
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3267: Sabse uttam deenaar jise insaan kharch karta hai, woh deenaar hai jise woh apne pariwaar par kharch karta hai, phir woh deenaar hai jo woh Allah ki raah mein jihaad karne ke liye khaas kiye hue jaanvar par kharch karta hai, aur phir woh deenaar hai jise woh Allah ke raaste mein apne saathiyon par kharch karta hai.

Saubaan radiyallahu anhu se warnanit hai, woh bayaan karte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Sabse uttam deenaar jise insaan kharch karta hai, woh deenaar hai jise woh apne pariwaar par kharch karta hai, phir woh deenaar hai jo woh Allah ki raah mein jihaad karne ke liye khaas kiye hue jaanvar par kharch karta hai, aur phir woh deenaar hai jise woh Allah ke raaste mein apne saathiyon par kharch karta hai." Abu qilaaba kahte hain ki shurooaat pariwaar se ki. Phir abu qilaaba ne kaha ki bhala kaun vyakti, us aadmi se puny mein barh sakta hai, jo apne chhote-chhote bachchon par kharch karta hai, taaki we doosron ke saamne haath phailaane par majboor na hon ya Allah taaala unhen uske dvaara laabh pahunchaye tatha unko nisprih kar de.

Yahaan Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kharch karne ke kuchh roop bayaan kiye hain aur bataya hai ki jab kharch karne ke kai avsar aapas mein takraane lagen, to kramaanusaar jo jitna mahatvapoorn ho, use mahatv diya jaana chahiye. Aapne bataya ki ek musalmaan dvaara kharch kiya gaya sabse adhik sawaab waala dhan woh hai, jise un logon par kharch kiya jaye, jinka bharan-poshan uspar aniwaary hai. Jaise patni aur bachche aadi. Uske baad nambar aata hai Allah ki raah mein jihaad ke liye taiyaar rakhe gae sawaari par kharch karne ka. Uske baad nambar aata hai apne doston aur saathiyon par kharch karne ka, jo Allah ki raah mein jang kar rahe hon.

Mahatv ki drishti se kharch karne ka kram wahi hai, jo is hadees mein ullikhit hai. Takraav ki awastha mein is kram ka khayaal rakha jayega.
Baal-bachchon par kharch karna any logon par kharch kane ki tulna mein adhik mahatv rakhta hai.
Allah ki raah mein jihaad par, jaise hathiyaaron aur mujaahidon ko taiyaar karne mein kiya jaane waala kharch, kharch karne ka ek bahut bara roop hai.
Kuchh logon ka kahna hai ki Allah ke maarg se muraad har neki ka kaam, jaise Hajj aadi hai.
3270: Sabse adhik majlis woh hai, jo zyaada kushaada arthaat chaura ho.
Abu saeed khudri se riwayat hai ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko pharmaate hue sunaah "Sabse achchhi majlis woh hai, jo zyaada kushaada ho."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3272: Qasam hai us zaat ki jiske haath mein mohammad ki jaan hai, mere wishay mein is ummat ka jo vyakti bhi sune, chaahe woh yahoodi ho ya eesaai, phir woh us cheez par eemaan na laye, jiske saath main bheja gaya hoon, to woh jahannami hoga.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Qasam hai us zaat ki jiske haath mein mohammad ki jaan hai, mere wishay mein is ummat ka jo vyakti bhi sune, chaahe woh yahoodi ho ya eesaai, phir woh us cheez par eemaan na laye, jiske saath main bheja gaya hoon, to woh jahannami hoga."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ki qasam khaakar bata rahe hain ki is ummat ka jo bhi vyakti aapke baare mein sunega, chaahe woh yahoodi ho ya eesaai ya koi aur, phir woh aappar eemaan laye bina hi mar jayega, to woh jahannami hoga aur usmen hamesha rahega.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam saare sansaar ke logon ke liye Nabi banaakar bheje gae the. Sab par aapka anusran waajib hai. Aapki shareeyat ne pichhli saari shareeyton ko nirast kar diya hai.
Jisne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka inkaar kar diya, any nabiyon par eemaan rakhne ka uska daawa use koi laabh na dega.
Jisne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke baare mein nahin suna aur uske paas aapka aahvaan nahin pahuncha, to uska uzr maany hai aur aakhirat mein uska maamla Allah ke haath mein hoga.
Insaan ko Islam grahan karne ka laabh milega, chaahe sakht beemaari mein aur maut se kuchh der pahle hi Islam grahan kyon na kare, jab tak ki rooh gale tak na pahunch jaye.
Awishvaasiyon, jinmen yahoodi evn eesaai bhi shaamil hain, ke deen ko sahi samajhna Islam ke prati awishvaas hai.
Is hadees mein yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon ka ullekh inke atirikt any samudayon ke baare mein chetaane ke liye kiya gaya hai. Kyonki in do samudayon ke paas (aasmaani) kitaaben maujood theen aur jab iske baavjood inka yeh haal hai, to doosre samudayon ka kya haal ho sakta hai, iska andaaza lagaana kuchh mushkil nahin. Sachchaai yeh hai ki saare samudayon par aapke deen ko grahan karna aur aapka anusran karna waajib hai.
3276: Eemaan ki sattar se kuchh adhik shaakhayen hain, jinmen sarvashreshth shaakha 'la ilaaha illallah' kahna hai, jabki sabse chhoti shaakha raaste kashtadayak wastu ko hataana hai tatha haya bhi eemaan ki ek shaakha hai.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Eemaan ki sattar se kuchh adhik shaakhayen hain, jinmen sarvashreshth shaakha 'la ilaaha illallah' kahna hai, jabki sabse chhoti shaakha raaste kashtadayak wastu ko hataana hai tatha haya bhi eemaan ki ek shaakha hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3279: Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Moonchhen katarvaao aur daarhi barhaao."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aadesh de rahe hain ki moonchhon ko na chhor diya jaye, balki unko kaata jaye aur achchhi tarah kaata jaye.

Jabki iske muqaable mein daarhi ko barhaane aur bharpoor andaaz mein chhor dene ka aadesh de rahe hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3284: Jab koi Muslim ya momin banda wazu karta hai aur apna chehra dhota hai, to uske chehre se woh saare gunaah paani ke saath ya paani ki antim boond ke saath nikal jaate hain, jo usne apni aankhon se dekhne ke kram mein kiye the.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jab koi Muslim ya momin banda wazu karta hai aur apna chehra dhota hai, to uske chehre se woh saare gunaah paani ke saath ya paani ki antim boond ke saath nikal jaate hain, jo usne apni aankhon se dekhne ke kram mein kiye the. Phir jab woh apne haathon ko dhota hai, to paani ke saath ya paani ki antim boond ke saath uske haath ke woh saare gunaah nikal jaate hain, jo uske haathon ke pakarne se hue the. Phir jab woh apne pairon ko dhota hai, to paani ke saath ya paani ki antim boond ke saath uske pairon se woh saare gunaah nikal jaate hain, jinki or uske paanv chalkar gae the. Is tarah woh gunaahon se pawitr hokar nikal jaata hai.''

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki jab koi musalmaan ya momin wazu karta hai aur wazu karte samay apne chehre ko dhota hai, to uske chehre se woh saare chhote gunaah dhone ke baad girte hue paani ke saath ya paani ki antim boond ke saath nikal jaate hain, jo usne apni aankh se dekhne ke kram mein kiye the. Jab apne donon haathon ko dhota hai, to uske donon haathon se woh saare chhote gunaah paani ke saath ya paani ki antim boond ke saath nikal jaate hain, jo uske haath se hue the. Jab donon pairon ko dhota hai, to uske pairon se woh saare chhote gunaah paani ke saath ya paani ki antim poond ke saath nikal jaate hain, jo uske pairon se chalne ke kram mein hue the. Phalasvaroop jab wazu poora hota hai, to chhote gunaahon se saaf-suthra hokar nikal jaata hai.

Wazu mein rahne ki fazeelat. Wazu gunaahon ka kaffaara banta hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam neki ke kaamon aur ibaadton ka pratiphal bayaan karke unke liye prerit kiya karte the.
Insaan ke shareer ke har ang se kuchh na kuchh gunaah ho jaya karte hain aur ye gunaah un angon se lage rahte hain tatha tauba kar lene ke baad unse nikal jaate hain.
Wazu karte samay, shareer ke angon ko dhone se indriyon ki shuddhi hoti hai aur saath hi wibhinn angon ke maadhyam se kiye gae paapon se aadhyaatmik shuddhi bhi praapt hoti hai.
3285: Jab tummen se koi vyakti aisa sapna dekhe, jo use achchha lage, to (jaan le ki) yeh sapna Allah ki or se hai. Atah uspar Allah ki prashansa kare aur use (laagon ko) bataye. Aur jab iske wipreet aisa sapna dekhe, jo use bura lage, to (jaan le ki) yeh shaitaan ki or se hai. Atah usse Allah ki sharan maange aur kisi ko na bataye. Isse use koi haani nahin hone waali.

Abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Jab tummen se koi vyakti aisa sapna dekhe, jo use achchha lage, to (jaan le ki) yeh sapna Allah ki or se hai. Atah uspar Allah ki prashansa kare aur use (laagon ko) bataye. Aur jab iske wipreet aisa sapna dekhe, jo use bura lage, to (jaan le ki) yeh shaitaan ki or se hai. Atah usse Allah ki sharan maange aur kisi ko na bataye. Isse use koi haani nahin hone waali."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki neend ki awastha mein dekha jaane waala achchha harshit karne waala svapn Allah ki or se hota hai. Atah uspar Allah ki prashansa karni chahiye aur use bataana bhi chahiye. Iske wipreet jab insaan ko pasand na aane waala aur dukhi karne waala svapn nazar aye, to jaan le ki yeh shaitaan ki or se hai. Atah uski buraai se Allah ki sharan maange aur kisi ko na bataye. Itna kar lene ke baad use koi haani nahin hogi. Kyonki Allah ne uparyukt wastuon ko svapn ke nateeje mein saamne aane waali buraai se suraksha ka zariya banaya hai.

Svapn ke prakaar : 1- achchha svapn. Yeh sachcha svapn Allah ki or se milne waala susmaachaar hota hai, jo insaan dekhta hai ya use dikhaya jaata hai. 2- bikhre hue khyaalaat, jinke baare mein insaan jaagrit awastha mein sochta rahta hai. 3- shaitaan dvaara kisi vyakti mein duhkh tatha bhay utpann karne ka prayaas.
Yahaan achchhe svapn ke baare mein jo kuchh bataya gaya hai usse teen baaten nikalkar saamne aati hain : Achchha svapn dekhne ke baad Allah ki prashansa ki jaye, usse prasann hua jaye aur use bataya jaye. Lekin bataya usi ko jaye, jisse mohabbat ho. Use nahin, jisse nafrat ho.
Isi tarah yahaan bure svapn ke baare mein jo kuchh bataya gaya, usse paanch baaten nikalkar aati hain : Uski buraai se Allah ki sharan maangi jaye, shaitaan ki buraai se Allah ki sharan maangi jaye, neend se uthne ke baad teen baar baaeen or thutkaara jaye, uska zikr kisi ke saamne na kiya jaye aur jab sone ka iraada ho, to pahlu badalkar soya jaye. Itna kar lene ke baad use koi nuqsaan nahin hoga.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Iske andar yeh hikmat chhupi hui hai ki jab insaan achchhe svapn ka zikr kisi aise vyakti ke saamne karega, jo usse mohabbat na rakhta ho, to woh dvesh evn eershya ke kaaran uska anuchit arth nikaalega. Aise mein ho sakta hai ki svapn ka wahi arth saamne a jaye aur aisa na bhi ho to insaan dukhi zaroor hoga. Isi baat ke maddenzar kisi aise vyakti ke saamne achchhe svapn ka zikr karne se mana kiya gaya hai, jo priy na ho.
Nemten (kripayen/anugrah) praapt hone par aur nae-nae ehsaanon ke milne par alhamdulillah (sabhi prashansa Allah ke liye hai) kahna, kyonki yeh kahna un nemton ki nirantarta ka kaaran hai.
3287: Jisne apne krodh par niyantran rakha, jabki woh use charitaarth karne mein saksham tha, to qayaamat ke din Allah use saari srishtiyon ke saamne bulayega aur yeh akhtiyaar dega ki bari-bari aankhon waali hooron mein se jise chaahe, chun le.

Muaaz bin anas (raji़yallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jisne apne krodh par niyantran rakha, jabki woh use charitaarth karne mein saksham tha, to qayaamat ke din Allah use saari srishtiyon ke saamne bulayega aur yeh akhtiyaar dega ki bari-bari aankhon waali hooron mein se jise chaahe, chun le."
[hasan li-ghairihi (any sandon athva riwayton ke saath milkar hasan)]
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3288: Daraasal, hamse pahle kisi samuday ke liye ghaneemat ka dhan halaal nahin kiya gaya tha. Phir Allah ne jab hamaari durbalta tatha asmarthata dekhi, to use hamaare liye halaal kar diya.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se marphooan riwayat hai kih "Nabiyon mein se kisi Nabi (Allah ka darud wa salaam unpar naazil ho) ne jihaad kiya, to apni qaum se kahaah mere saath koi aisa vyakti na aye, jisne abhi wiwaah kiya hai tatha woh apni patni se milna chaah raha hai, lekin abhi tak mila nahin hai. Na hi woh vyakti aye, jisne ghar banaya hai, kintu ab tak uspar chhat nahin daali hai. Na hi aisa vyakti nikle, jisne gaabhin bakri ya oontni khareedi hai evn woh uske bachcha janne ki prateeksha kar raha hai. Chanaanche, woh yuddh ke liye nikle tatha ek gaanv ke paas asr ki namaz ke samay ya uske sameep pahunche, to soory se kahaah tu bhi aadesh ka paaband hai tatha mujhe bhi aadesh diya gaya hai. Ai Allah, tu isko hamaare oopar rok le. So woh rok liya gaya, yahaan tak ki Allah ne unko wijay pradaan ki. Phir unhonne ghaneemat dhan ikattha kiya tatha aag aai, taaki usko jala daale, parantu usko jalaai nahin. Aisa dekh, Nabi ne kahaah tummen se kisi ne ghaneemat ka dhan chhipaya hai. Atah, pratyek qabeele ka ek vyakti mere haath mein haath rakhkar baiat kare. Chunaanche, ek vyakti ka haath unke haath se chipak gaya. Tab Nabi ne kahaah tumhaare qabeele hi mein khayaanat hai. Atah, tumhaare qabeele ka pratyek vyakti mere haath mein haath rakhkar baiat kare. Chunaanche us qabeele ke do ya teen vyaktiyon ke haath unke haath se chipak gae. Tab Nabi ne kahaah tumne khayaanat ki hai. Atah woh gay ke sar ke jaisa ek sone ka sar lekar aye aur use rakh diya. Tab aag aai aur use kha gai. Daraasal, hamse pahle kisi samuday ke liye ghaneemat ka dhan halaal nahin kiya gaya tha. Phir Allah ne jab hamaari durbalta tatha asmarthata dekhi, to use hamaare liye halaal kar diya."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3290: Beshak Allah hi ke liye hai, jo usne le liya aur usi ka hai, jo usne diya. Uske sameep pratyek wastu ka samay nishchit hai. Atah ab tu sabr kar tatha Allah se pratiphal ki ummeed rakh.

Usaama bin zaid bin haaris (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki ek beti ne aapke paas sandesh bheja ki mera beta mrityu ke sameep hai. Atah aap padhaaren. Chunaanche aapne unko salaam bheja tatha pharmayaah "Beshak Allah hi ke liye hai, jo usne le liya aur usi ka hai, jo usne diya. Uske sameep pratyek wastu ka samay nishchit hai. Atah ab tu sabr kar tatha Allah se pratiphal ki ummeed rakh." Parantu aapki beti ne phir qasam dete hue sandesh bheja ki aap awashy ayen. So aap uthe. Aapke saath saad bin ubaada, muaaz bin jabal, ubay bin kaab, zaid bin saabit tatha kuchh aur log (radiyallahu anhum) bhi the. Aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki or bachche ko barhaya gaya aur aapne usko apni god mein bithaya, to uski saansen ukhar rahi theen. Yeh dekh, aapki aankhon mein aansu a gae. Ispar saad (radiyallahu anhu) ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, yeh kya hai? Aapne pharmayaah "Yeh rahmat hai, jise Allah ne apne bandon ke dilon mein daal diya hai." Tatha ek riwayat mein haih "Apne jis bande ke dil mein chaaha, daal diya. Tatha Allah apne unheen bandon par raham karta hai, jo doosron par raham karte hain."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3293: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hamen sabhi kaamon ke liye usi prakaar istikhaara sikhaate the, jis prakaar hamen Qur'an ki soora sikhaate the.

Jaabir bin abdullah -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hamen sabhi kaamon ke liye usi prakaar istikhaara sikhaate the, jis prakaar hamen Qur'an ki soora sikhaate the. Aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- pharmaate : "Jab tummen se koi vyakti kisi kaam ka iraada kare, to farz namaz ke alaawa do rakaat namaz parhe. Phir yeh dua parhe : Ai Allah! Main tere jnaan ke hawaale se tujhse bhalaai maangta hoon, tatha tere saamarthy ke hawaale se tujhse saamarthy maangta hoon, aur tujhse tere wishaal anugrah ka kuchh ansh maangta hoon. Kyonki tu saamarthyawaan hai, main saamarthy nahin rakhta aur tu jaanta hai, main nahin jaanta. Ai Allah! Yadi tu jaanta hai ki yeh kaary mere deen, meri duniya aur meri aakhirat ke liye behtar hai, (ya yoon kahe ki meri is duniya aur us duniya ke liye behar hai) to tu use mere liye niyat kar de aur use mere liye saral kar de. Phir mere liye usmen barkat pradaan kar aur yadi tu jaanta hai ki yeh kaary mere deen, meri duniya aur meri aakhirat ke liye behtar nahin hai, (ya yoon kahe ki meri is duniya aur us duniya ke liye behtar nahin hai) to use mujhse aur mujhe usse door kar de aur mere liye bhalaai niyat kar de, jahaan kaheen bhi ho, phir uspar mujhe santushti pradaan kar." Aap pharmaate hain : "Iske baad apni zaroorat ka naam le."

Jab koi musalmaan koi kaam karna chaahe aur use maaloom na ho ki woh kaam uske liye behtar hoga ya nahin, to use istikhaara ki namaz parhni chahiye. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apne saathiyon ko istikhaara ki namaz usi tarah sikhaate the, jis tarah unko Qur'an ki koi soora sikhaate the. Aap farz namaz se alag do rakaat namaz parhte aur uske baad in shabdon mein dua farmaate : "Ai Allah, main tujhse behatri ki dua maangta hoon." Yaani ai Allah! Main tujhse do kaamon mein se behtar kaam ka suyog maangta hoon aur tujhse tere aseem jnaan, jismen saari cheezen samaai hui hain, ke aadhaar par maangta hoon. Aur teri sarvavyaapi shakti ke aadhaar par aur is aadhaar par  ki koi tujhe wiwash nahin kar sakta tujhse is baat ka sawaal karta hoon ki mujhe saksham bana de, kyonki tere bina mere paas na koi saamarthy hai aur na shakti. Evn main tujhse tera aseem anugrah evn daya maangta hoon ki tu jo kuchh deta hai, apne anugrah se deta hai, kisi ka tere oopar kisi nemat ka koi adhikaar nahin hai. Nishchay hi tu har kaam ki kshamta rakhta hai aur main nirbal wa wiwash hoon. Teri madad ke bina mujhse kuchh nahin ho sakta. Tu pratyaksh evn apratyaksh ka aseem jnaan rakhne ke kaaran sab kuchh jaanta hai. Jabki tera diya hua suyog evn maargadarshan na ho, to main kuchh nahin jaanta. Tu ghaib ki baaton se avgat hai. Saaraansh yeh ki tere paas aseem jnaan hai aur sab kuchh karne ki kshamta hai. Jabki doosre ke paas in sab mein se bas wahi hai, jo tere anugrah se mil jaye. Phir musalmaan apne rab se dua kare aur naam lekar apni zaroorat ka ullekh kare. Woh kahe : Ai Allah! Mainne apne maamle ko tere hawaale kar diya. Atah agar tu jaanta hai ki yeh kaam yaani us kaam ka naam lekar ullekh kare, jaise ghar khareedna, gaari khareedna ya kisi mahila se shaadi karna ityaadi.... Agar yeh kaam tere poorv jnaan ke anusaar mere deen ke liye behtar hai, jo mere jeewan ki poonji hai, meri duniya ke liye behtar hai, tatha parinaam ke drishtikon se mere liye behtar hai, ya phir in shabdon ka prayog kare : Meri duniya aur aakhirat ke liye behtar hai, to use mere liye sunishchit kar de aur mujhe use poora karne ka suyog pradaan kar, tatha mere liye use aasaan bhi kar de, phir, mere liye usmen bahut saari bhalaaiyaan rakh de. Ai Allah! Agar tere jnaan ke mutaabiq yeh kaam, jiska main istikhaara kar raha hoon, mere deen, duniya aur parinaam ke drishtikon se bura hai, ya phir in shabdon ka prayog kare : Meri duniya aur meri aakhirat ke liye bura hai, to use mujhse pher de tatha mujhe usse pher de aur mere liye bhalaai sunishchit kar de jahaan kaheen bhi ho, aur mujhe usse tatha apne tamaam nirnayon se santusht kar de, mujhe pasand hon ya na hon.

Is namaz ke laabh aur ismen nihit bhalaai ke kaaran Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ise apne sahaaba ko sikhaane ke liye utsuk dikhaai dete the.
Istikhaare ki namaz parhna aur uske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki sikhaai hui dua parhna musathab hai.
Istikhaara aise jayaz kaamon mein musathab hai, jinke baare mein sankoch ho. Waajib evn musathab kaamon mein nahin. Kyonki asal yeh hai ki waajib tatha musathab kaaryon ko kiya jaye. Albatta, unse sannbandhit cheezon, jaise Umrah ya Hajj yaatra ke liye saathiyon ka chayan aadi, ke baare mein istikhaara kiya ja sakta hai.
Waajib tatha musathab kaaryon ko karne tatha haraam evn makrooh kaaryon se bachne ke sanbandh mein istikhaara nahin kiya jayega.
Dua namaz ke baad ki jayegi. Kyonki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke shabd hain : "Phir yeh dua parhe..." Lekin salaam se pahle karne mein bhi koi harj nahin hai.
Banda par aniwaary hai ki apne tamaam maamlaat ko Allah ke hawaale kar de aur apni shakti evn saamarthy ke nashe mein na rahe. Kyonki Allah ki madad ke bina uski apni shkti evn saamarthy se kuchh nahin ho sakta.
3295: Sabr to museebat ke shuru mein karna hota hai.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ek stri ke paas se gu़jare, jo qabr ke paas baithkar ro rahi thi. Aapne pharmayaah "Allah ka taqva akhtiyaar kar tatha sabr kar." Usne oottar diyaah aap mujhse door rahen, mujh jaisi museebat ka saamna na to aapne kiya hai aur na aap use jaante hain! Uske baad usko bataya gaya ki yeh Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hain, to woh Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke dvaar par aai aur wahaan use darbaan nahin mile, (jo use aapke paas jaane se rokte. Atah, woh aapke paas aai aur) boleeh main aapko pahchaan nahin paai thi. Aapne pharmayaah "Sabr to museebat ke shuru mein karna hota hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3298: Momin ka maamla bhi bara ajeeb hai. Uske har kaam mein uske liye bhalaai hai. Jabki yeh baat momin ke siwa kisi aur ke saath nahin hai.

Suhaib radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Momin ka maamla bhi bara ajeeb hai. Uske har kaam mein uske liye bhalaai hai. Jabki yeh baat momin ke siwa kisi aur ke saath nahin hai. Yadi use khushhaali praapt hoti hai aur woh shukr karta hai, to yeh bhi uske liye behtar hai aur agar use takleef pahunchti hai aur sabr karta hai. To yeh bhi uske liye behtar hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam momin ke haalaat ko pasand karte hue unpar aashchary vyakt kar rahe hain. Kyonki uske saare haalaat achchhe hain. Jabki yeh baat momin ke siwa kisi aur ke saath nahin hai. Agar use khushiyaan milti hain aur woh Allah ka shukr karta hai, to use shukr karne ka sawaab milta hai. Jabki use kasht ka saamna hota hai aur use Allah ke yahaan achchhe pratiphal ka zariya samajhta hai, to use sabr ka sawaab milta hai. Is tarah uska daaman har haal mein sawaab se bhara rahta hai.

Sukh ke samay shukr aur dukh ke samay sabr karne ki fazeelat. Jisne yeh donon kaam kar liye, use donon jahaanon ki bhalaai praapt ho gai. Iske wipreet jisne nemat par shukr ada nahin kiya aur museebat par sabr nahin kiya, woh pratiphal se wanchit aur gunaah ka haqdaar ban gaya.
Eemaan ki fazeelat. Har awastha mein pratiphal kewal eemaan waalon ko hi praapt hota hai.
Sukh ke samay shukr aur dukh ke samay sabr karna eemaan waalon ka tareeqa hai.
Taqdeer par eemaan ek momin ko sabhi paristhitiyon par santusht rakhta hai. Jabki ghair-momin ki haalat isse bhinn hoti hai. Koi nuqsaan ho jaye, to wichlit aur nemat mil jaye, to mast hokar Allah ki ibaadat se door ho jaata hai, aur use Allah ki awajna mein lagaane lagta hai.
3303: Raaja, jaadoogar tatha raahib ke saath larke ki kahaani

Suhaib bin sinaan roomi (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh "Tumse pahle ke logon mein ek raaja tha, jiske paas ek jaadoogar tha. Jab jaadoogar boorha ho gaya, to usne raaja se kaha ki main ab boorha ho gaya hoon, isliye mere paas ek baalak bhejiye, jisko main jaadu sikha doon. Raaja ne uske paas ek baalak bheja, jise woh jaadu sikha sake. Baalak jab jaadoogar ki or chala, to raaste mein use ek raahib mila. Woh uske paas baitha aur uski baaten suna, to use achchhi lageen. Ab, jab bhi woh jaadoogar ke paas jaata, raahib ke yahaan aata aur uske paas baith jaata. Parantu, jab jaadoogar ke paas jaata, to woh use maarta. Usne iski shikayat raahib se ki, to usne kahaah jab jaadoogar se dar lage, to kah dena ki ghar waalon ne rok liya tha tatha jab ghar waalon se dar lage, to kah dena ki jaadoogar ne rok liya tha.
Woh aisa hi kar raha tha ki achaanak usne ek wishaal pashu dekha, jisne logon ki aawaajaahi rok rakhi thi. Atah, usne kahaah aaj mujhe pata chal jayega ki jaadoogar behtar hai ya raahib? Chunaanche, usne ek patthar uthaya aur kaha ki ai Allah, yadi raahib ka maamla tere paas jaadoogar ke maamle se adhik pasandeeda hai, to is pashu ko maar de, taaki log a-ja saken. Chunaanche, usne ek patthar phenka, jisne pashu ka wadh kar diya tatha logon ka raasta khul gaya. Ab woh larka raahib ke paas aya tatha is wishay mein usko bataya, to raahib ne usse kahaah ai mere pyaare putr, aaj tu mujhse bhi behtar hai. Aaj main dekh raha hoon ki tumhaara maamla kahaan pahunch chuka hai. Ab tumko aazmaaish mein daala jayega. Kintu, jab tumko aazmaya jaye, to mera pata mat bataana. Woh larka janmajaat andhe tatha safed daag waalo ko theek kar deta tha tatha wibhinn prakaar ki aushdhiyon se logon ka upchaar karta tha. Iski charcha raaja ke ek nikatvarti ne bhi suni, jo andha ho chuka tha. Atah, woh uske paas bahut saare uphaar lekar aya tatha bolaah yadi tumne mujhe theek kar diya, to yahaan jo kuchh bhi hai, sab tera hai. Baalak bolaah main kisi ko theek nahin karta, balki theek karne waala kewal Allah hai. Yadi tu Allah par eemaan le aye, to main tere liye Allah se dua karoonga ki woh tujhe changa kar de. So, woh Allah par eemaan le aya tatha Allah ne use theek kar diya. Phir woh raaja ke paas aakar usi prakaar baitha, jis prakaar pratyek din baitha karta tha. Raaja ne usse poochhaah teri aankhen kisne theek kar deen? Usne uttar diyaah mere rab ne. Raaja bolaah kya mere siwa bhi tera koi rab hai? Usne uttar diyaah mera tatha tera rab kewal Allah hai. Yeh sun, raaja ne use pakar liya tatha yaatnayen deta raha, yahaan tak ki usne raaja ko baalak ka pata bata diya. Tab baalak ko bulaya gaya tatha raaja ne usse kahaah ai putr, toone jaadu mein itni kushalta paida kar li hai ki tu janmajaat andhe tatha safed daag waale ko bhi theek karne laga hai tatha aisa aur aisa karne laga hai? Baalak bolaah main kisi ko theek nahin karta, balki theek karne waala kewal Allah hai. Yeh sun, raaja usko pakarkar yaatnayen dene laga, yahaan tak ki usne raaja ko raahib ka pata bata diya. Raahib ko pakarkar laya gaya tatha kaha gaya ki apna dharm chhor do. Parantu, usne inkaar kar diya. Tab ek aari mangvaai gai aur use uski maang par rakhkar uske do tukre kar diye gae. Phir raaja ke nikatvarti ko bulaya gaya tatha usse bhi kaha gaya ki apna dharm chhor do. Usne bhi inkaar kar diya, to ek aari laai gai aur uski maang par rakhkar use bhi cheer diya gaya. Phir baalak ko bulaya gaya tatha kaha gaya ki apna dharm chhor do, lekin usne inkaar kar diya, to raaja ne use apne logon ke hawaale karte hue kahaah isko amuk pahaar par le jaao aur jab tum pahaar ki choti par charh jaao, to dekho, yadi woh apna dharm chhor deta hai, to theek, anyatha ise wahaan se lurhka dena. Chunaanche, jab we pahaar par charhe, to baalak ne dua ki ki ai Allah, tu jaise chaahe mujhe inse bacha le. So, achaanak pahaar mein kanpan paida hui, jisse saare log gir gae aur baalak chalte hue raaja ke paas a gaya. Raaja ne poochhaah tere saathiyon ka kya hua? Baalak ne jawaab diyaah Allah ne mujhe unse bacha liya. Raaja ne use punah apne logon ke haawaale karte hue kahaah isko jahaaz mein lekar beech samudr mein chale jaao. Yadi woh apna dharm tyaag de, to theek, anyatha ise wahaan phenk dena. Woh log usko lekar chale gae. Tab baalak ne dua ki ki ai Allah, tu jaise chaahe mujhe inse bacha le. Chunaanche, jahaaz sawaaron samet palat gaya evn sabhi log doob gae, lekin baalak chalte hue raaja ke paas a gaya. Raaja ne poochhaah tere saathiyon ka kya hua? Baalak ne jawaab diya ki Allah ne mujhe unse bacha liya. Phir usne raaja se kahaah jab tak tu waisa na kare, jaisa main kahoon, tu mujhe maar nahin sakta. Usne poochhaah woh kya hai? Baalak ne kaha ki logon ko ek maidaan mein ikattha karo. Tatpashchaat mujhe ek per ke tane se baandh do, phir mere tarkash se ek teer lo aur us teer ko kamaan ke beech mein rakho aur kahoh "Allah ke naam se, jo is baalak ka rab hai." Phir meri or teer chalaao. Yadi tum aisa karoge, to mujhe maar sakte ho. Chunaanche raaja ne logon ko ek maidaan mein ikattha kiya. Phir baalak ko ek per ke tane se baandha. Phir uske tarkash se ek teer lekar use kamaan ke beech mein rakha aur yeh kaha ki "Allah ke naam se, jo is baalak ka rab hai." Phir baalak par teer chalaya, jo uski kanpatti mein laga. Baalak ne kanpatti par apna haath rakha tatha mar gaya. Yeh dekh, sab logon ne kahaah ham is baalak ke rab (paalanhaar) par eemaan le aye. Chunaanche, raaja aya, to usse kaha gaya ki Allah ki qasam, wahi hua, jiska aapko bhay tha. Log eemaan le aye. Chunaanche, raaja ne galiyon ke muhaanon par lanbe-chaure gaddhe khodne ka aadesh diya. Gaddhe khode gae tatha unmen agni dahkaai gai, to raaja neh jo apna dharm na chhore, use is agnikund mein daal do ya usse kaha jaye ki ismen kood jaao. Unhonne aisa hi kiya. Yahaan tak ki ek stri aai, jiske paas ek bachcha tha. Woh usmen koodne se thora hichkichaai, to bachche ne kahaah he maata, sabr se kaam le, kyonki tu haq par hai."
3305: Tum log mere baad bhedbhaav ka saamna karoge. Atah, sabr se kaam lena, yahaan tak ki hauz par mujhse milo.

Usaid bin hu़zair tatha anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ki ek ansaari ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, aap mujhe koi prashaasnik zimmewaari nahin denge, jaisa ki aapne amuk ko diya hai? To aapne pharmayaah "Tum log mere baad bhedbhaav ka saamna karoge. Atah, sabr se kaam lena, yahaan tak ki hauz par mujhse milo."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3306: Aaj ke baad tere pita ko koi bechaini nahin hogi.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki jab Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki beemaari adhik barh gai, to aappar bechaini chhaane lagi. Yeh dekh, faatima (radiyallahu anha) ne kahaah hay mere pita ki bechaini! To aapne farmayaah "Aaj ke baad tere pita ko koi bechaini nahin hogi." Phir jab aapka svargawaas ho gaya, to unhonne kahaah hay mere pita! Mere pita ne rab ki pukaar sveekaar kar li, jab usne aapko pukaara! Hay mere pita! Jannatul phirdaus aapka thikaana hai! Ham jibreel ko aapki mrityu ki soochna denge! Jab aapko dafan kar diya gaya, to faatima (raji़yallahu anha) ne kahaah tum logon ko yeh kaise achchha laga ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) par mitti daalo?

Yeh hadees, mrityu ke samay hamaare Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke dhairy ko chitrit karti hai. Mrityu ke samay jab beemaari adhik barh gai, to aapki pareshaani itni zyaada thi ki baar-baar behosh hone lage. Iske andar ek bari hikmat bhi chhipi hui thi. Hikmat yeh thi ki aapko sabr ke badle mein Allah ke yahaan oonche darje praapt hon. Jab aap behosh ho jaate, to faatima -raziyallah anha- jo stri hone ke naate sabr ki shakti kuchh kam rakhti theen, aapki pareshaani se aahat hokar kahteen : "Hay mere pita ki bechaini!"
Yeh sun Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Aaj ke baad tere pita ko kisi bechaini ka saamna nahin karna parega." Kyonki aap uske baad sabse oonche mitron waale sthaan mein pahunch gae, jaisa ki aapne mrityu ke samay ghar ki chhat ki or dekhte hue kai baar kaha tha : "Ai Allah! Sabse oonche mitron waale sthaan mein pahuncha de. Ai Allah! Sabse oonche mitron waale sthaan mein pahuncha de."
Jab Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki mrityu ho gai, to faatima -radiyallahu anha- aapki kuchh wisheshtaaon ko bayaan karte hue thora bahut rone lageen, jo ki Allah ke nirnay se naaraazgi ka dyotak nahin tha.
Faatima -radiyallahu anha- ne kaha : "Aapne apne prabhu ka aamantran grahan kar liya." Kyonki Allah hi ke haath mein har wastu ka niyantran aur saari srishtiyon ka jeewan-maran hai.
Aapne Allah ke pukaarne waale ki baat sun li.Arthaat , aapki mrityu ke baad any mominon ke samaan aapki aatma ko oopar le jaya gaya, yahaan tak ki saatven aakaash ke oopar Allah ke saamne upasthit kiya gaya.
Faatima -radiyallahu anha- ne aage kaha : "Hay mere pita! Jannat al-firdaus mein aapka thikaana hai!" Kyonki aapko Jannat ka uchchatam sthaan praapt hoga. Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Allah se mere liye 'waseela' maanga karo. Kyonki waseela Jannat ka ek sthaan hai, jo Allah ke kewal ek bande ke liye uchit hai. Mujhe aasha hai ki woh banda main hi hoon." Yeh baat sandeh se pare hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko Jannat al-firdaus praapt hogi, jo ki Jannat ki uchchatam shreni hai aur jiske oopar ki chhat svayn sarvashaktimaan Allah ka arsh hoga. Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko uska sabse ooncha sthaan praapt hoga.
Uske baad unhonne kaha : "Hay mere pita! Ham jibreel ko aapki mrityu ki soochna denge!" Kyonki aapke jeewankaal mein jibreel aapke paas aate aur wahy ke punarpathan mein sahyog karte the. Wahy Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke jeewankaal se hi juri hui thi.
Phir jab aapko uthaakar le jaya gaya aur dafan kiya gaya, to unhonne kaha : "Kya tum logon ko yeh achchha laga ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- par mitti daal do?" Yeh prashn unhonne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki judaai ke nitaant shok se shokaakul hokar aur is jaankaari ke aadhaar par kiya tha ki Allah ne sahaaba ke dilon ko apne Rasool ke prem se labaalab bhar rakha hai. Lekin sachchaai yeh hai ki saara nirnay Allah ke haath mein hai aur saare logon ko usi ki or lautkar jaana hai. Allah ne apni kitaab mein apne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se kaha hai : "Nishchay hi aapko bhi marna hai aur in logon ko bhi marna hai."
3307: Bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) ko aadesh diya gaya tha ki woh azaan ke shabd do-do baar kahen aur iqaamat ke shabd ek-ek baar.
Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai, woh kahte hainh bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) ko aadesh diya gaya tha ki woh azaan ke shabd do-do baar kahen aur iqaamat ke shabd ek-ek baar.

Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apne muazzin bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) ko aadesh diya ki azaan ke waakyon ko do-do baar kahen. Kyonki azaan anupasthit logon ko soochna dene ke liye hai. Lekin do-do baar kahne ka yeh aadesh shuru ki takbeer aur ant ke 'kalima-e- tauheed' ko chhorkar hai. Kyonki yeh saabit hai ki shuru mein takbeer chaar baar kahi jayegi aur ant mein 'kalima-e-tauheed' ek baar. Isi tarah unhen aadesh diya ki iqaamat ke waakyon ko ek-ek baar kahen. Kyonki iqaamat upasthit logon ko soochit karne ke liye hai. Lekin yahaan ek-ek baar kahne ka aadesh bhi takbeer aur 'qad qaamtissalaat' ko chhorkar hai. Kyonki un donon ko do-do baar kahna saabit hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3309: Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dekha ki jab makka aate aur (tawaaf shuru karte samay) hajre asvad ko chhoote, to teen chakkar dulki chaal se chalte.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hajjatul wada ke avsar par, Hajj ke saath Umrah kiya aur kurbaani ki. Aap zul-hulaifa se apne saath qurbaani ke jaanvar laye the. Allah ke Rasool (salllahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pahle Umrah ka talbiya pukaara aur phir Hajj ka talbiya pukaara. Chunaanche logon ne bhi Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath Hajj ke saath Umrah kiya. Albatta, kuchh log zul-hulaifa se qurbaani ke jaanvar saath laye the aur kuchh log nahin bhi laye the. Atah, jab aap makka pahunche, to logon se kahaah "Jo log qurbaani saath laye hain, we Hajj se faarigh hone tak kisi cheez ko halaal na samjhen, jo ehraam ke kaaran haraam ho chuki hai. Magar jo log qurbaani saath nahin laye hain, we kaaba ka tawaaf kar len aur safa-marva ka chakkar laga len tatha baal chhote karvaane ke baad halaal ho jayen. Phir uske baad Hajj ka ehraam baandhen aur qurbaani karen. Phir, jo qurbaani na kar sake, woh Hajj ke dinon mein teen aur ghar jaane ke baad saat roze rakhe." Chunaanche Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne makka pahunchne ke baad tawaaf kiya, to sabse pahle apne haath se rukn ka sparsh kiya, phir saat mein se teen chakkar dulki chaal se aur chaar chakkar saadhaaran chaal se chale. Phir, tawaaf poora karne ke baad maqaame ibraaheem ke paas do rakaat namaz parhi. Phir murkar safa aye aur safa-marva ke saat chakkar lagaye. Phir ehraam hi ki awastha mein rahe, yahaan tak ki Hajj kar liya, qurbaani ke din qurbaani ki aur kaaba ka antim tawaaf kiya. Phir woh saari cheezen aapke liye halaal ho gaeen, jo ehraam ke kaaran haraam ho gai theen. Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne jo kuchh kiya, woh un saare logon ne bhi kiya, jo apne saath kurbaani laye tha.
Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dekha ki jab makka aate aur (tawaaf shuru karte samay) hajre asvad ko chhoote, to teen chakkar dulki chaal se chalte.

Jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) us Hajj ke liye nikle, jismen pawitr kaaba aur Hajj ke pramukh sthaanon sahit aam logon ko alvida kaha, unhen Allah ka sandesh pahuchaanya aur unhen iska gawaah bhi banaya, to aapne Hajj aur Umrah ka ehraam baandha. Is tarah aap qiraan Hajj kar rahe the. Aur qiraan bhi tamatto kahlaata hai. Atah, logon ne bhi aapke saath tamatto kiya. Kuchh logon ne Hajj aur Umrah donon ka ehraam baandha, to kuchh logon ne kewal Umrah ka ehraam baandha aur use poora karne ke baad Hajj ki neeyat kar li. Jabki kuchh logon ne kewal Hajj ka ehraa्m baandha. Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen Hajj ki teen kismon mein se jo koi bhi karne ka ekhtiyaar diya tha. Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur aapke kuchh saathiyon ne zul-hulaifa se qurbaani ke jaanvar saath le liye the aur kuchh saathiyon ne nahin bhi liye the. Jab we makka ke nikat pahunch gae, to kurbaani na le jaane waale mufrad aur qiraan Hajj karne waale saathiyon se kaha ki Hajj ki neeyat torkar Umrah ki neeyat kar len. Jab we tawaaf aur safa marva ke beech sai kar chuke, to unhen aadesh diya ki apne baal chhote karke Umrah se halaal ho jayen aur baad mein Hajj ka ehraam baandhen tatha qurbaani karen, kyonki unhonne ek hi yaatra mein Umrah aur Hajj donon kiya hai. Jo kurbaani na kar sake, use das roze rakhne hain. Teen Hajj ke dinon mein, jiska samay Umrah ka ehraam baandhne se shuru hota hai aur saat ghar waalon ki or lautne ke baad.
Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab makka pahunche, to rukn ko chhua aur saat tawaaf kiye. Teen chakkaron mein dulki chaal se chale, kyonki yeh makka aane ke baad ka tawaaf hai. Baaki chaar chakkaron mein saadhaaran chaal se chale. Phir maqaame ibraaheem ke paas do rakaat namaz parhi. Phir safa pahaari ke paas aye aur uske tatha marva ke beech saat chakkar lagaye. Do nishaanon ke beech dorte the aur baaqi saadhaaran chaal se chalte the. Phir ehraam hi mein rahe, yahaan tak ki Hajj kar liya aur qurbaani ke din qurbaani karke sir mundva liye. Yahi pratham baar halaal hona hai. Phir chaasht ke samay kaaba ke paas gae aur uska tawaaf kiya. Phir woh saari cheezen aapke liye halaal ho gaeen, jo Hajj ke dinon mein haraam theen, yahaan tak striyaan bhi. Aisa hi un saare logon ne kiya, jo aapke saath qurbaani ka jaanvar laye the.
[ise donon riwayton ke saath Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3310: Janaabat (svapnadosh, sahvaas ya kisi bhi kaaranvash weeryaskhalan ho jaane se hone waali apvitrata se pawitr hone) ka snaan karne ka tareeqa

Musalmaanon ki maata maimoona radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke liye snaan ka paani rakha aur kapre se parda kiya, to aapne apne donon haathon par paani undel kar unko dhoya, phir apne dayen haath se bayen haath par paani undela aur apni sharmagaah ko dhoya, phir apne haath ko dharti par maara, use ragra aur dhoya. Phir kulli ki aur naak mein paani charhaya, phir apne chehre aur donon haathon ko dhoya, phir apne sar par paani bahaya, phir poore badan ko dhoya, phir apne sthaan se hatkar khare hue aur apne donon pairon ko dhoya. Uske baad main aapke paas ek kapra lekar aai, to use nahin liya aur apne haath se paani jhaarne lage.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki patni maimoona radiyallahu anha aapke janaabat ke snaan ka tareeqa bayaan kar rahi hain. Unka bayaan hai ki unhonne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke liye snaan ka paani rakha aur ek kapre se aapka parda kiya, jiske baad aapne nimnalikhit kaary kiye :

1- haathon ko bartan mein daalne se pahle unpar paani undelkar unko dhoya.

2- dayen haath se bayen haath par paani undela aur apni sharmagaah ko dhoya, taaki uspar janaabat ka koi prabhaav na rahe.

3- apna haath zameen par maara, ragra aur gandgi door karne ke liye dhoya.

4- kulli ki. Yaani munh mein paani daala, use hilaya, ghumaya aur phenk diya. Phir naak jhaari. Yaani saans ke saath naak ke andar paani le gae aur baahar nikaal diya, taaki naak ki safaai ho jaye.

5- chehre aur donon haathon ko dhoya.

6- sar par paani daala.

7- shesh shareer par paani daala.

8- apni jagah se hatkar khare hue aur donon pairon ko dhoya, kyonki unko pahle nahin dhoya tha.

Phir maimoona radiyallahu anha ne shareer ko sukhaane ke liye ek kapra diya, to use liya nahin, balki apne haath se shareer ka paani ponchhne lage aur use jhaarne lage.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki patniyon ne logon ko sikhaane ke liye aapke jeewan se juri hui chhoti-chhoti baaten bhi bayaan kar deen.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se saabit janaabat ke snaan ke sanpoorn tareeqon mein se yeh ek tareeqa hai. Jabki snaan karte samay bas itna bhi kaafi hai ki poore shareer par paani baha le, kulli kar le aur naak jhaar le.
Snaan ya wazu ke baad shareer ko kapre se ponchhna athva chhor dena donon mubaah hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3311: Ai aboozar, mein tumko kamzor samajhta hoon, tatha tumhaare liye bhi wahi baat pasand karta hoon, jo main apne liye pasand karta hoon; do vyaktiyon ka bhi ameer na banna aur na kisi anaath ke dhan ka waali (sanrakshak) banna.

Aboozar (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne mujhse pharmayaah "Ai aboozar, mein tumko kamzor samajhta hoon, tatha tumhaare liye bhi wahi baat pasand karta hoon, jo main apne liye pasand karta hoon; do vyaktiyon ka bhi ameer na banna aur na kisi anaath ke dhan ka waali (sanrakshak) banna."
3313: Jisne mere is wazu ki tarah wazu kiya aur uske baad do rakaat namaz parhi, jismen usne apne ji mein koi baat na ki, Allah uske pichhle saare gunaah maaf kar deta hai.

Usmaan bin affaan radiyallahu anhu ke aazaad kiye hue ghulaam humraan se riwayat hai, unhonne dekha ki usmaan bin affaan radiyallahu anhu ne wazu ka paani mangvaya, donon haathon par bartan se teen baar paani undela, unko teen baar dhoya, phir wazu ke paani mein dayaan haath daakhil kiya, phir kulli ki, naak mein paani charhaya aur naak jhaara, phir chehre ko teen baar aur donon haathon ko teen baar kohniyon samet dhoya, phir sar ka masah kiya, phir donon pairon ko teen-teen baar dhoya aur uske baad farmaya : Mainne dekha ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne mere is wazu ki tarah wazu kiya aur uske baad farmaya : "Jisne mere is wazu ki tarah wazu kiya aur uske baad do rakaat namaz parhi, jismen usne apne ji mein koi baat na ki, Allah uske pichhle saare gunaah maaf kar deta hai."

Usmaan radiyallahu anhu ne vyavhaarik roop se Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke wazu ka tareeqa sikhaya, taaki use adhik spasht roop se bataya ja sake. Unhonne ek bartan mein paani mangvaya, phir usse donon haathon par teen baar paani undela, phir apna dayaan haath bartan mein daala, usse paani lekar apne munh mein daala, use andar ghumaya aur baahar nikaal diya, phir saans ke saath naak ke andar paani kheencha, phir use nikaalkar naak jhaara, phir apne chehre ko teen baar dhoya, phir apne haathon ko kohniyon samet teen baar dhoya, phir paani se bheege hue haathon ko ek baar sar par phera, phir apne pairon ko teen baar takhnon samet dhoya.

Jab wazu kar chuke, to bataya ki unhonne dekha ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne isi tarah wazu kiya aur uske baad yeh khushkhabri di ki jisne aapke wazu ki tarah wazu kiya aur apne rab ke saamne winaysheelta evn ekaagrata ke saath upasthit hokar do rakaat namaz parhi, uske is sanpoorn wazu aur is wishuddh namaz ke badle mein Allah uske pichhle gunaah maaf kar dega.

Wazu ke aaranbh mein bartan mein haath daalne se pahle donon haathon ko dho lena  mustahab hai. Neend se na utha ho, tab bhi. Agar neend se utha ho, to unko dhona waajib hai.
Shikshak ko aisa tareeqa apnaana chahiye ki baat aasaani se samajh mein a jaye aur seekhne waale ke dil mein baith jaye. Iska ek roop yeh hai ki shiksha vyavhaarik roop se di jaye.
Namaazi ko chahiye ki dil se duniya se sannbandhit aane waale khyaalon ko door hataane ka prayaas kare. Kyonki namaz ki sanpoornata is baat mein nihit hai ki use kitna man ko upasthit rakhkar parha gaya hai. Aisa bahut mushkil hai ki khyaal aye hi nahin. Isliye insaan ko chahiye ki apne nafs se lare aur khyaalaat mein gum na ho jaye.
Wazu dayen taraf se karna sunnat hai.
Kulli karne, naak mein paani charhaane aur naak jhaarne ke beech tarteeb (kram) ka khyaal rakha jaana chahiye.
Chehre, haathon aur pairon ko teen-teen baar dhona mustahab hai. Jabki waajib ek hi baar dhona hai.
Allah ki or se pichhle gunaah us samay maaf kiye jaate hain, jab do kaary ek saath hon ; hadees mein bayaan kiye gae tareeqe ke mutaabiq wazu kiya jaye aur do rakaat namaz parhi jaye.
Wazu ke andar dhoe jaane waale har ang ki seemayen hain. Chunaanche chehre ki seemayen lanbaai mein sar ke baal ugne ke svabhaawik sthaan se thuddi tak daarhi ke baalon tak evn ek kaan se doosre kaan tak hai. Haath ki seema ungliyon ke kinaaron se kohni tak hai. Sar ki seema chehre ke chaaron or se sar ke baal ugne ke sthaanon se gardan ke oopri bhaag tak hai. Donon kaanon ka masah sar ke masah mein daakhil hai. Jabki pair ki seema poora qadam hai, qadam aur pindli ke beech ke jor ke saath.

3316: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab janaabat ka snaan karte, to apne donon haathon ko dhote, phir namaz ke wazu ki tarah wazu karte, phir snaan karte

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab janaabat ka snaan karte, to apne donon haathon ko dhote, phir namaz ke wazu ki tarah wazu karte, phir snaan karte, phir apne haath se baalon ka khilaal karte, yahaan tak ki jab nishchit ho jaate ki tvacha bheeg gai hai, to apne oopar teen baar paani bahaate, phir poore shareer ko dhote. Woh kahti hain : Main aur Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ek hi bartan se ek saath haath daalkar paani lekar snaan kar liya karte the.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab janaabat se snaan karna chaahte, to sabse pahle apne donon haathon ko dhote. Phir namaz ke wazu ki tarah wazu karte. Phir apne shareer par paani bahaate. Phir apne donon haathon se apne sar ke baalon ka khilaal karte. Yahaan tak ki jab yaqeen ho jaata ki baal ki jaron tak paani pahunch chuka hai aur sar ki chamri bheeg chuki hai, to teen baar apne sar par paani daalte aur uske baad shesh shareer ko dhote. Aage aaisha radiyallahu anha kahti hain : Main aur Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ek hi bartan se snaan karte the aur ham donon hi isse chullu dvaara paani lete the.

Snaan ke do prakaar hain. Prayaapt snaan evn sanpoorn snaan. Prayaapt snaan yeh hai ki insaan tahaarat (pawitrata arjan karne) ki neeyat kare aur poore shareer par paani baha de. Saath hi kulli bhi kar le aur naak bhi jhaar le. Jabki sanpoorn snaan yeh hai ki snaan usi tarah kiya jaye, jis tarah Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is hadees mein karke dikhaya hai.
Janaabat shabd ka prayog har us vyakti ke liye kiya jaata hai, jisne weery skhalit kiya ho ya phir sanbhog kiya ho, chaahe weery skhalit na bhi hua ho.
Pati-patni ek-doosre ke shareer ke chhupaane yogy bhaagon ko dekh sakte hain aur ek hi bartan se naha sakte hain.
3317: Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab chheenkte, to apna haath ya kapra apne munh par rakh lete aur apni aawaaz dheemi (ya neechi) rakhte.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab chheenkte, to apna haath ya kapra apne munh par rakh lete aur apni aawaaz dheemi (ya neechi) rakhte.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab chheenkte, to nimnalikhit kaam karte :

1- munh par apna haath ya kapra rakhte, taaki munh ya naak se koi aisi cheez na nikle, jisse paas baithe hue vyakti ko kasht ho.

2- aawaaz dheemi kar lete.

Chheenkte samay Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke tareeqe ka bayaan aur usmen aapka anusran.
Chheenkte samay munh ya naak par kapra ya roomaal aadi rakh lena musathab hai, taaki usse koi aisi cheez na nikle, jisse paas baithe hue insaan ko kasht ho.
Chheenkte samay aawaaz dheemi kar leni chahiye. Yeh adab evn achchhe aachran ka hissa hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3321: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki baat itni spasht aur do-took hoti ki har sunne waala samajh jaata.
Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki baat itni spasht aur do-took hoti ki har sunne waala samajh jaata.

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ki is hadees mein hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sall- ki baat spasht hoti thi. Yaani woh itni saaf hoti thi ki koi akshar doosre akshar mein aur koi shabd doosre shabd mein ghusta nahin tha. Har sunne waala use aasaani se samajh sakta tha. Na usmen uljhaav hota tha aur na anaawashyak wistaar. Aap itna thahar-thahar ke baat karte the ki yadi koi aapke shabdon ko ginna chaahta, to gin sakta tha. Daraasal baat yeh hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko saargarbhit andaaz mein baat karne ki adbhut kshamta di gai thi. Saargarbhit andaaz mein baat karne ka matlab yeh hai ki kam shabdon mein adhik baaten kah di jayen.
Isi tarah insaan ko is prakaar baat nahin karni chahiye ki uske shabd ek-doosre mein ghuse hue hon aur sunne waale ko spasht roop se samajh mein na aye. Kyonki baat karne ka uddeshy saamne waale tak apni baat pahunchaana hota hai. Atah baat jitni spasht roop se samajh mein a jaye, utna hi achchha hai.
Phir, jab insaan spasht roop se baat kare aur yadi kisi ne na samjha ho, to uske liye teen baar dohraakar bole, to dil mein yeh ehsaas rakhe ki woh aisa Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki sunnat ke anusran mein kar raha hai. Taaki apne bhaai ko samjhaane ka uddeshy poora hone ke saath-saath sawaab bhi mil jaye.
Yahi haal tamaam sunnaton ka hai. Unpar amal karte samay yeh baat dil mein rahe ki aap Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki sunnat ka anusran kar rahe hain, taaki anusran ke saath-saath sawaab bhi milta rahe.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3324: Khare ho jaao, main tumhen namaz parhaata hoon.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki unki daadi mulaika ne khaana taiyaar karke Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko khaane ke liye bulaya. Chunaanche aapne usmen se kuchh khaya aur pharmayaah "Khare ho jaao, main tumhen namaz parhaata hoon." Anas kahte hainh main ek chataai ke paas gaya, jo bahut dinon se prayog mein rahne ke kaaran kaali par chuki thi. Mainne use paani daalkar dho diya. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) uspar khare ho gae. Mainne aur yateem ne aapke peechhe saf bana li aur boorhi (daadi) hamaare peechhe khari ho gai. Aapne hamen do rakaat namaz parhaai aur waapas chale gae.
Tatha Muslim shareef mein haih Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen aur unki maan ko namaz parhaai. (Woh kahte hain ki) aapne mujhe apne dayen aur mahila ko hamaare peechhe khara kiya.

Mulaika (radiyallahu anha) ne khaana taiyaar karke Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko khaane par bulaya. Allah taaala ne choonki aapko aadarsh charitr aur uttam vyavhaar ka maalik banaya tha, jiske kaaran aapne bari winaysheel tabeeyat paai thi, atah har ek ka aamantran sveekaar kar lete the, chaahe woh chhota ho ya bara, stri ho ya purush evn dhani ho ya nirdhan. Isse aapke saamne, dukhi dilon ki dhaaras bandhaana, nirdhanon ko winamrata dikhaana aur na jaanne waalon ko shiksha pradaan karna jaise mahatvapoorn evn prashansneey uddeshy hote the. Chunaanche aap is aamantran dene waali stri ka ghar gae, unke yahaan khaana khaya aur phir is avsar ka sadaupyog karte hue in kamzor logon ko namaz sikhaane lage, jo sanbhav hai ki baron ke saath aapki majlis mein baith na paate hon. Aapne unhen namaz ke liye khare hone ka aadesh diya, taaki unhen namaz parhayen aur we aapse namaz ka poora tareeqa seekh len. Atah, anas (radiyallahu anhu) ne ek puraani chataai ko, jo bahut dinon se prayog mein rahne ke kaaran kaali par chuki thi, paani se dhoya aur aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) namaz parhaane ke liye uspar khare ho gae. Anas (radiyallahu anhu) aur unke saath ek yadeem ne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke peechhe ek saf bana li tatha aamantran dene waali boorhi stri un donon ke peechhe akeli ek saf mein khari ho gai. Aapne unhen do rakaat namaz parhaai aur phir nimantran tatha shiksha ka haq ada karke waapas ho gae. Allah hamen aapke sukarmon evn charitr ke anusran ki taufeeq de.

3325: Jab tummen se kisi ki patni usse masjid jaane ki anumti maange, to woh use na roke.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jab tummen se kisi ki patni usse masjid jaane ki anumti maange, to woh use na roke." Warnankarta kahte hain ki yeh sun, bilaal bin abdullah ne kahaah Allah ki qasam, ham unhen awashy rokenge. Warnankarta kahte hain ki abdullah ne unki or munh karke unhen itna bura-bhala kaha ki mainne unhen is tarah bura-bhala kahte kabhi nahin suna tha. Saath hi farmayaah main tumhen Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki hadees suna raha hoon aur tum kahte ho ki ham unhen awashy rokenge?
Tatha ek riwayat ke shabd hainh Allah ki bandiyon ko Allah ki masjidon se na roko.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) ne ek hadees sunaai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya hai ki yadi kisi ki patni usse masjid jaane ki anumti maange, to use na roke; taaki woh masjid mein jamaaat ke saath namaz parhne ki phazeelat se wanchit na ho. Isse pata chalta hai ki mahila ka masjid jaana jayaz hai. Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) ne jab yeh hadees sunaai, to us samay wahaan unka ek beta upasthit tha. Unhen lag raha tha ab haalaat Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke samay jaise nahin rahe aur striyon ne pahle ki tulna mein adhik banaav-singaar shuru kar diya hai. Atah, striyon ki suraksha ke jazbe se ot-prot hokar kah uthe ki Allah ki qasam, ham unhen zaroor rokenge. (Jnaat ho ki unka uddeshy Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki baat par aapatti karna nahin tha.) lekin, unke is rawaiye se unke pita yeh samajh baithe ki woh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki hadees par aapatti jata rahe hain. Isliye Allah aur uske Rasool ke wirodh ke krodh se prabhaawit hokar unhonne apne bete ko bahut zyaada bura-bhala kaha aur farmayaah main tumhen Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki hadees suna raha hoon aur tum kahte ho ki Allah ki qasam, ham unhen awashy rokenge?
[ise donon riwayton ke saath Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3327: Mainne abu bakr, umar tatha usmaan ke saath namaz parhi, lekin unmen se kisi ko "بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم" Parhte nahin suna.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam), abu bakr aur umar (radiyallahu anhuma) namaz "الحمد لله رب العالمين" Se aaranbh karte the.
Ek riwayat mein hai ki mainne abu bakr, umar tatha usmaan ke saath namaz parhi, lekin unmen se kisi ko "بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم" Parhte nahin suna.
Tatha Muslim mein hai ki mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam), abu bakr, umar tatha usmaan (radiyallahu anhum) ke peechhe namaz parhi hai. We "الحمد لله رب العالمين" Se namaz aaranbh karte the. Na tilaawat se pahle "بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم" Parhte the aur na baad meेn.

Anas (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Nabi (salallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur aapke khaleefon ke saath lanbe samay tak rahne ke baavjood unhonne unmen se kisi ko namaz mein "بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم" Parhte hue nahin suna. Na soora faatiha parhne se pahle na baad mein. Balki, we namaz "الحمد لله رب العالمين" Se shuru karte the. Jnaat ho ki bismillah parhne aur oonchi aawaaz se parhne ke baare mein ulema ke kai mat hain. Lekin, sabse sahi mat yeh hai ki namaazi pratyek rakaat mein soora faatiha se pahle dheemi aawaaz mein bismillah kahega, chaahe namaz dheemi aawaaz mein qiraaat waali ho ya oonchi aawaaz mein qiraaat waali.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3328: Qayaamat ke din Allah ke nikat sabse bure logon mein woh purush bhi shaamil hoga, jo apni patni ke paas jaye aur uski patni uske paas aye, phir woh andar ki baaton ko baahar phailaata phire.

Abu saeed khadri (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh "Qayaamat ke din Allah ke nikat sabse bure logon mein woh purush bhi shaamil hoga, jo apni patni ke paas jaye aur uski patni uske paas aye, phir woh andar ki baaton ko baahar phailaata phire."
3330: Yahoodiyon aur eesaaiyon par Allah ki laanat ho, unhonne apne nabiyon ki qabron ko masjid bana liya.

Aaisha aur abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhum se riwayat hai, donon kahte hain : Jab Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki mrityu ka samay aya, to aap apni ek chaadar apne chehre par daalne lage aur jab usse munh dhak jaane ki wajah se dam ghutne lagta, to use apne chehre se hata dete. Isi (bechaini ki) haalat mein aapne farmaya : "Yahoodiyon aur eesaaiyon par Allah ki laanat ho, unhonne apne nabiyon ki qabron ko masjid bana liya." (Warnankarta kahte hain ki) aap apni ummat ko yahoodiyon aur eesaaiyon ke amal se saavdhaan kar rahe the.

Aaisha aur abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhum hamen bata rahe hain ki jab Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki mrityu ka samay aya, to aap apne chehre par kapre ka ek tukra rakhne lage. Phir jab mrityu ke samay hone waale kasht ke kaaran saans lene mein kathinaai hone lagi, to use apne chehre se hata diya. Isi kathin paristhiti mein aapne farmaya : Allah ki laanat ho yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon par. Allah unko apni rahmat se door rakhe. Aisa isliye ki unhonne apne nabiyon ki qabron ke oopar masjiden bana daaleen. Yahaan yeh dhyaan rakhna zaroori hai ki yeh kaam kitna khatarnaak hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is kathin paristhiti mein bhi iska zikr karna zaroori samjha. Aapne is kaam se mana isliye kiya ki ek to yeh yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon ka kaam hai aur doosra yeh Allah ka saajhi thahraane ka zariya hai.

Nabiyon aur Allah ke nek bandon ki qabron ko masjid banaakar unke andar Allah ke liye namaz parhna mana hai, kyonki isse shirk ke dvaar khulte hain.
Ekeshvarvaad par Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka poora dhyaan aur qabron ke sammaan se aapka bhay, kyonki isse shirk ke dvaar khulte hain.
Yahoodiyon, eesaaiyon tatha unke padchihnon par chalte hue qabron par bhawan nirmaan karne aur unko masjid banaane waale par laanat karna jayaz hai.
Qabron ke oopar bhawan banaana yahoodiyon aur eesaaiyon ka taur-tareeqa hai aur hadees mein isse mana kiya gaya hai.
Qabron ko masjid banaane ka ek roop unke paas tatha unki or munh karke namaz parhna bhi hai, chaahe bhawan na bhi banaya jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3331: Tum log saat winaashkaari wastuon se bacho

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Tum log saat winaashkaari wastuon se bacho." Logon ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Woh kya-kya hain? Aapne farmaya : "Allah ka saajhi banaana, jaadu, Allah ke haraam kiye hue praani ko auchity na hone ke baavjood qatl karna, byaaj khaana, yateem ka maal khaana, yuddh ke maidaan se peeth dikhaakar bhaagna aur nirdosh bholi-bhaali momin striyon par vyabhichaar ka aarop lagaana."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apni ummat ko saat winaashkaari apraadhon evn gunaahon se bachne ka aadesh de rahe hain. Jab aapse poochha gaya ki yeh saat gunaah kya-kya hain, to aapne unko bayaan karte hue farmaya :

1- Allah ka saajhi thahraana. Yaani kisi bhi prakaar se kisi ko Allah ka samaan thahraana aur koi bhi ibaadat Allah ke atirikt kisi aur ke liye karna. Aapne sabse pahle shirk ka zikr isliye kiya ki shirk sabse bara gunaah hai.

2- jaadu karna. Jaadu se muraad hai dhaaga aadi par is tarah girah lagaana, mantr parhna aur dawaaon tatha nasha laane waali cheezon ka istemaal karna, jo jaadu kiye hue vyakti ke shareer ko prabhaawit karte hue use beemaar kar de ya uski jaan le le ya pati-patni ke beech mein judaai daal de. Yeh ek shaitaani kaary hai. Adhiktar samay jaadu usi samay kaam karta hai, jab shirk waale kaam kiye jayen aur dusht roohon ko khush karne ke liye unke man ke anusaar kuchh kiya jaye.

3- kisi aise vyakti ki hatya kar dena, jiski jaan lene se Allah ne mana kiya ho. Jaane lene ki anumti kewal usi samay hai, jab koi sharai kaaran paya jaye aur yeh kaam shaasak ke dvaara kiya jaye.

4- sood lena ya dena. Chaahe use khaya jaye ya usse kisi any prakaar ka laabh uthaya jaye.

5- kisi bachche ke maal par haath saaf karna, jo naabaaligh ho aur uska baap mar gaya ho.

6- kaafiron ke saath ho rahe yuddh ke maidaan se bhaag khara hona.

7- paakdaaman aazaad aurton par vyabhichaar ka aarop lagaana. Isi tarah paakdaaman aazaad mardon par vyabhichaar ka jhootha aarop lagaana bhi winaashkaari gunaah hai.

Bare gunaah kewal saat hi nahin hain. Lekin wishesh roop se inka ullekh  isliye kiya gaya hai ki yeh saat gunaah kuchh zyaada hi khatarnaak hain.
Agar koi sharai kaaran, jaise qisaas, Islam ka parityaag aur shaadeeshuda hone ke baavjood vyabhichaar mein lipt hona aadi paya jaye, to kisi ki jaan lena jayaz hai. Lekin yeh kaam sharai shaasak ka hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3332: Jab Allah apne bande ke saath bhalaai ka iraada karta hai, to use duniya hi mein jaldi saza de deta hai aur jab apne bande ke saath buraai ka iraada karta hai, to uske gunaahon ki saza ko roke rakhta hai, yahaan tak ki woh qayaamat ke din apne saare gunaahon ke saath upasthit hoga.

Anas (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah "Jab Allah apne bande ke saath bhalaai ka iraada karta hai, to use duniya hi mein jaldi saza de deta hai aur jab apne bande ke saath buraai ka iraada karta hai, to uske gunaahon ki saza ko roke rakhta hai, yahaan tak ki woh qayaamat ke din apne saare gunaahon ke saath upasthit hoga."

Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) soochit kar rahe hain ki bande se Allah ke bhalaai ke iraade ki nishaani yeh hai ki woh uske gunaahon ki saza duniya hi mein sheeghr de de; taaki woh duniya se is awastha mein jaye ki uske sir par gunaah ka bojh na ho, jise qayaamat ke din lekar haazir ho, kyonki jiske amal ka badla duniya hi mein de diya gaya, aakhirat mein uska hisaab halka hoga. Tatha bande ke saath Allah ke buraai ke iraade ki nishaani yeh hai ki duniya mein uske gunaahon ka badla na diya jaye, taaki qayaamat ke din woh apne gunaahon ka bojh laadkar aye aur uchit badla paye.
3333: "Kya main tumhen woh baat na batla doon, jiska mujhe tumhaare baare mein kaana dajjaal se bhi adhik bhay hai? Sahaaba (radiyallahu anhum) ne kahaah awashy, ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapne kahaah "Chhipa hua shirk; aadmi namaaj ke liye khara hota hai aur yeh sochkar achchhi tarah namaz parhta hai ki koi use dekh raha hai."

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah "Kya main tumhen woh baat na batla doon, jiska mujhe tumhaare baare mein kaana dajjaal se bhi adhik bhay hai? Sahaaba (radiyallahu anhum) ne kahaah awashy, ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapne kahaah "Chhipa hua shirk; aadmi namaaj ke liye khara hota hai aur yeh sochkar achchhi tarah namaz parhta hai ki koi use dekh raha hai."

Sahaaba -radiyallahu anhum- kaana dajjaal ke phitne ko yaad karte aur uska bhay khaate the. Atah, Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unhen bataya ki ek kaam aisa hai, jiska bhay unke baare mein aapko kaana dajjaal ke phitne se bhi adhik hai. Woh hai, neeyat aur iraade ka shirk, jo logon ke saamne prakat nahin hota. Phir uski vyaakhya karte hue kaha ki aisa kaary jise Allah ki prasannata praapt karne ke liye kiya jaana chahiye, use aadmi logon ko dikhaane ke liye achchhe dhang se kare. Yahi neeyat ka shirk hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai .]
3337: Allah ne mere liye dharti ko samet diya, to mainne uske sooryoday ke sthaanon aur sooryaast ke sthaanon ko dekha. Nishchay hi musalmaanon ka raajy wahaan tak pahunchega, jahaan tak mere aage samet kar laya gaya hai. Mujhe laal tatha safed do khazaane diye gae hain.

Saubaan (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah "Allah ne mere liye dharti ko samet diya, to mainne uske sooryoday ke sthaanon aur sooryaast ke sthaanon ko dekha. Nishchay hi meri ummat ka raajy wahaan tak pahunchega, jahaan tak mere aage sametkar laya gaya hai. Mujhe laal tatha safed do khazaane diye gae hain. Mainne apne rab se dua ki hai ki meri ummat ko sarvavyaapi akaal ke jariye halaak na kare aur unpar kisi baahri shatru ko haawi na kare, jo unke adhikaansh logon ka saphaya kar de. Mere rab ne kaha: Ai Muhammad, jab main koi nirnay kar lita hoon, to woh hokar rahta hai. Mainne tumhaari ummat ke baare mein tumhaari dua kaabool karli hai. Unko sarvavyaapi akaal ke zariye halaak nahin karoonga aur unpar kisi baahri shatru ko haawi na karoonga, jo unke adhikaansh logon ka saphaya kar de, yadyapi unke wiruddh dharti ke sabhi bhaagon ke log ekatr ho jayen, yahaan tak ki khud wahi ek-doosre ka winaash karne lagen tatha ek-doosre ko bandi banaane lagen."
Ise burqaani ne apni saheeh mein bhi riwayat kiya hai. Usmen aage haih "Mujhe apni ummat ke baare mein bhay kewal pathabhrasht aguwaaon ka hai. Jab unke beech talvaar chal paregi, to qayaamat ke din tak thamne ka naam nahin legi. Tatha qayaamat us samay tak nahin ayegi, jab tak meri ummat ka ek qabeela shirk karne waalon se na mil jaye tatha meri ummat ke kuchh giroh buton ki pooja na karne lagen. Meri ummat mein tees jhoothe paida honge. Unmen se har vyakti Nabi hone ka daawa karega. Jabki main antim Nabi hoon. Mere baad koi Nabi nahin hoga. Tatha meri ummat ka ek giroh sada saty par data rahega. Us giroh mein shaamil log sahyog ke paatr honge. Unka saath chhorne waale unka kuchh nuqsaan na kar sakenge, yahaan tak ki barkat waale aur uchch Allah ka aadesh a jayega."

Is hadees ke andar kai mahatvapoorn baaten hain aur sachchi soochnayen di gai hain. Ismen aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne bataya hai ki Allah ne aapke liye dharti ko samet diya aur aapne dharti ke un antim poorvi evn pashchimi kshetron ko dekh liya, jo aapki ummat ke adheen aane waale the. Aapki yeh soochna bilkul saty saabit hui, kyonki aapki ummat ke raajy ka wistaar dharti ke antim poorvi chhor se antim pashchimi chhor tak ho gaya. Aage bataya ki aapko do khazaane diye gae, jo hua bhi. Khusru aur qaisar (seezar) ke raajy, unke sone chaandi aur heere moti ke khazaanon ke saath aapki ummat ke haath lag gae. Yeh bhi bataya ki aapne Allah se dua ki hai ki aapki ummat ko sarvavyaapi akaal ke dvaara halaak na kare aur unpar kisi kaaphir shatru ko haawi na kar de, jo unke raajy mein ghuskar unki jamaat ka winaash kar de. Allah ne aapki pahli dua grahan kar li. Lekin doosri dua usi samay tak grahanyogy hogi, jab tak ummat aapsi matbhed aur maar-kaat se door rahe. Agar ismen par gai, to Allah uspar kisi kaaphir shatru ko haawi kar dega. Iska drishy dekhne ka bhi mila. Jab-jab ummat mein bikhraav aya, any log uspar haawi ho gae. Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apni ummat par pathabhrasht shaaskon aur ulemaaon ka bhay prakat kiya hai, kyonki log unhen dekhkar gumraahi ki or chal parenge. Aage bataya ki jab is ummat ke andar fitne aur aapsi laraai-jhagre ka silsila shuru ho jayega to qayaamat tak rukne ka naam nahin lega. Aisa hua bhi. Usmaan (radiyallahu anhu) ke qatl se jo fitne ka dvaar khula, woh aaj tak band nahin hua.
Phir bataya ki aapki ummat ke kuchh log rahan-sahan aur dharm ke maamle mein shirk karne waalon se mil jayenge aur kuchh log shirk ko bhi apna lenge. Yeh soochna bhi sach saabit hui aur Islam ke daawedaar qabron, peron aur pattharon ki pooja mein lipt ho gae.
Ant mein bataya ki bahut-se nuboowat ke daawedaar saamne ayenge aur yeh ki nuboowat ka daawa karne waala har vyakti jhootha hoga, kyonki aapke Nabi hone ke saath hi nuboowat ka silsila band ho gaya hai. Phir yeh khushkhabri di ki in saari ghatnaaon aur winaashkaariyon ke baavjood aapki ummat ka ek giroh Islam par kayam rahega tatha sankhyaabal ke drishtikon se durbal hone ke baavjood is giroh ko uske dushman aur wirodhi kuchh nuksaan nahin pahuncha senkenge.
