[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3339: Nishchay hi bara badla bari pareeksha ke saath hai. Jab Allah kisi samuday se prem karta hai, to uski pareeksha leta hai. Atah, jo Allah ke nirnay se santusht rahega, usse Allah prasann hoga aur jo asantushti dikhayega, usse Allah naaraaj rahega

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) riwayat karte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmaya : Nishchay hi bara badla bari pareeksha ke saath hai. Jab Allah kisi samuday se prem karta hai, to uski pareeksha leta hai. Atah, jo Allah ke nirnay se santusht rahega, usse Allah prasann hoga aur jo asantosh prakat karega, usse Allah naaraaz hoga.

Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) is hadees mein hamen bata rahe hain ki momin ko kabhi-kabhi shaareerik, aarthik athva any pareshaaniyaan aati hain. Aise mein yadi woh dhairy se kaam leta hai, to Allah use un pareshaaniyon ka achchha badla dega. Sankat jitna bara aur peeraadayak hoga, uska badla bhi utna hi bara milega. Phir bataya ki yeh pareshaaniyaan bande se Allah ke prem ki nishaani hain aur Allah ka nirnay har haal mein laagu hokar rahta hai. Lekin jo dhairy se kaam lega aur santusht rahega, to badle ke taur par Allah usse prasann hoga aur use yathesht badla pradaan karega. Tatha jo asantosh prakat karega aur Allah ke nirnay ko naapsand karega, Allah usse naaraaz hoga aur yathesht saza dega.

Yadi museebton ke samay kisi waajib kaam, jaise dhairy rakhna aur sanyam se kaam lena aadi na chhora jaye ya koi haraam kaam, jaise gareebaan phaarna aur gaalon ko nochna na kiya jaye, to museebten gunaahon ka kaffaara (parayashchit) ban jaati hain.
Isse Allah taaala ka apni shaan ke anusaar, apne bandon se prem karne ka gun saabit hota hai.
Momin ki aazmaaish, eemaan ki nishaaniyon mein se ek hai.
Isse Allah taaala ka apni shaan ke anusaar, apne bandon se prasann aur naaraaz hone ka gun saabit hota hai.
Allah taaala ke likhe bhaagy evn taqdeer par raazi aur khush rahna, punyakaari hai.
Allah taaala ke likhe bhaagy evn taqdeer par naaraaz aur naakhush rahna, haraam hai.
Ismen museebton ke samay dhairy evn sanyam rakhne par ubhaara gaya hai.
Kabhi-kabhi insaan kisi cheez ko naapsand karta hai, jabki woh uske liye behtar hoti hai.
Isse Allah taaala ki, apne sabhi kaamon mein hikmat saabit hoti hai.
Badla, karm hi ke warg ka hoga.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3341: Allah ki seemaaon par rukne waale tatha unka ullanghan karne waale ka udaahran aisa hai, jaise kuchh logon ne ek kashti mein baithne ke liye ku़raa nikaala aur kuchh log oopri manzil mein sawaar hue aur kuchh log nichli manzil mein

Nomaan bin basheer radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Allah ki seemaaon par rukne waale tatha unka ullanghan karne waale ka udaahran aisa hai, jaise kuchh logon ne ek kashti mein baithne ke liye ku़raa nikaala aur kuchh log oopri manzil mein sawaar hue aur kuchh log nichli manzil mein. Neeche waalon ko jab paani ki zaroorat parti, to oopar waalon ke paas se guzarte. So, un logon ne socha ki yadi ham apne bhaag mein chhed kar len tatha apne oopar waalon ko takleeph na den (to behtar ho). Aise mein, yadi oopar waalon ne neeche waalon ko aisa karne diya, to sabhi ka winaash ho jayega aur yadi unka haath pakarkar unko rok diya, to yeh bhi aur woh bhi donon bach jayenge."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne Allah ki nirdhaarit seemaaon par rukne waalon, uske aadeshon ka paalan karne waalon, achchhi baaton ka aadesh dene waalon aur buri baaton se rokne waalon tatha Allah ki nirdhaarit seemaaon ka ullanghan karne waalon, achchhe kaamon se door rahne waalon aur bure kaam karne waalon ka ek udaahran diya hai aur samaaj par parne waale iske prabhaav ko samjhaya hai. Aapne udaahran dete hue samjhaya ki maan lo kuchh log ek kashti par sawaar hue aur is baat ke liye quraa nikaala ki kaun kashti ki oopri manzil par baithega aur kaun nichli manzil mein. Chunaanche kuchh logon ke hisse mein oopri manzil aai aur kuchh logon ke hisse mein nilchi manzil. (Choonki paani ka prabandh oopri manzil mein tha, isliye) nichli manzil waalon ko paani ke liye jaate samay oopri manzil waalon se hokar guzarna parta tha. Aise mein nichli manzil waalon ne socha ki agar ham paani praapt karne ke liye nichli manzil mein ek chhed kar len, to achchha hoga. Is tarah se ham oopri manzil waalon ko kasht pahunchaane se bach sakte hain. Is paristhiti mein oopri manzil waalon ne agar nichli manzil waalon ka haath na pakra aur unko chhed karne se na roka, to kashti doob jayegi aur sab log halaak ho jayenge. Jabki agar unka haath pakar liya, to sab log bach jayenge.

Samaaj ki suraksha aur mukti ke liye achchhi baat ka aadesh dene aur buri baat se rokne ka mahatv.
Shiksha dene ka ek tareeqa udaahran prastut karna hai. Isse amoort cheezon ko moort cheezon ka roop dekar aasaani se samjhaya ja sakta hai.
Spasht shareeat wiruddh kaam hota hua dekhna aur uska khandan na karna aisi buraai hai, jiska nuqsaan poore samaaj ko hoga.
Shareeat wiruddh kaam karne waalon ko ghalat karne dena samaaj ko winaash ki or le jaata hai.
Kaam ghalat karna aur neeyat achchhi rakhna kaam ke sahi hone ke liye paryaapt nahin hai.
Muslim samaaj ke sudhaar ki zimmedaari sab logon ki hai, kisi ek vyakti ki nahin.
Khaas logon ke gunaah ki yaatna aam logon ko bhi jhelni par sakti hai, agar unko gunaah se roka na jaye.
Ghalat kaam karne waale aisa dikhaane ka prayaas karte hain ki unke ghalat kaam samaaj ke liye behtar hain. Aisa munaafiq bhi karte hain.
3342: Main tamaam saajhedaaron ki tulna mein saajhedaari se adhik beniyaaz hoon. Jisne koi kaary kiya aur usmen kisi ko mera saajhi thahraya, main uske saath hi uske saajhi banaane ke is kaary se bhi kinaara kar leta hoon

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne farmaya : Main tamaam saajhedaaron ki tulna mein saajhedaari se adhik beniyaaz hoon. Jisne koi kaary kiya aur usmen kisi ko mera saajhi thahraya, main uske saath hi uske saajhi banaane ke is kaary se bhi kinaara kar leta hoon."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : Main tamaam saajhedaaron ki tulna mein saajhedaari se adhik beniyaaz hoon. Chunaanche Allah har cheez se beniyaaz hai. Insaan jab neki ka koi kaam karta hai aur use Allah ke saath-saath ghairullah ke liye bhi karta hai, to Allah uske us amal ko chhor deta hai. Use qabool nahin karta. Use uske  karne waale ke munh par maar deta hai. Atah neki ke kaam wishuddh roop se Allah ke liye karne chaahiyen. Kyonki Allah usi kaam ko grahan karta hai, jo wishuddh roop se usi ke liye kiya jaye.

Is hadees mein tamaam tarah ke shirk se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai aur bataya gaya hai ki shirk insaan ke kisi bhi amal ko Allah ke nikat grahan hone nahin deta.
Allah ki beniyaazi aur mahaanta ka ehsaas amal ke andar wishuddhata laane mein madad karta hai.
3344: Logon se wahi baat karo, jo we samajh sakte hain. Kya tum chaahte ho ki Allah tatha uske Rasool ko jhuthlaya jaye?
Ali bin abu taalib (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hainh "Logon se wahi baat karo, jo we samajh sakte hain. Kya tum chaahte ho ki Allah evn uske Rasool ko jhuthlaya jaye?"

Ameerul momineen ali bin abi taalib -radiyallahu anhu- ka nirdesh hai ki aam logon se wahi baat karni chahiye, jo unke samajhne yogy ho tatha unke liye laabhdayak ho. Jaise tauheed evn halaal evn haraam aadi Islam ki buniyaadi baaten tatha aadesh-nirdesh. Koi aisi baat nahin karni chahiye, jo logon ke liye aawashyak na ho ya unki samajh se oopar hone ki wajah se saty ko thukraane ka kaaran ban jaye.
3345: Qayaamat ke din ek vyakti laya jayega tatha use Jahannam mein phenk diya jayega, jisse uske pet ki antriyaan baahar nikal ayengi aur woh unhen lekar aise ghoom raha hoga, jaise gadha chakki ke chaaron or ghoomta hai.

Usaama bin zaid radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Unse kaha gaya ki aap usmaan radiyallahu anhu ke paas jaakar unse baat kyon nahin karte? Ispar usaama bin zaid radiyallahu anhu ne kaha : Kya tum log yeh samajhte ho ki main unse tumhaare saamne hi baat karoonga? Main unse ekaant mein baat karta hoon, taaki kisi prakaar ke fasaad ka dvaar na khule. Main yeh bhi nahin chaahta ki sabse pahle main hi fitne ka dvaar kholoon. Main Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se yeh hadees sunne ke baad yeh bhi nahin kahta ki jo vyakti mera shaasak hai, woh sab logon se behtar hai : "Qayaamat ke din ek vyakti laya jayega tatha use Jahannam mein phenk diya jayega, jisse uske pet ki antriyaan baahar nikal ayengi aur woh unhen lekar aise ghoom raha hoga, jaise gadha chakki ke chaaron or ghoomta hai. Aise mein, saare jahannami uske paas ekatr ho jayenge aur kahenge : Ai amuk, tere saath aisa kaise hua? Kya aisa nahin hai ki tu bhalaai ka aadesh deta tha aur buraai se rokta tha? Woh uttar dega : Haan, main doosron ko bhalaai ka aadesh to deta tha, kintu svayn uspar amal nahin karta tha tatha doosron ko buraai se rokta tha, kintu svayn usmen lipt ho jaata tha."

Kisi ne usaama bin zaid radiyallahu anhu se poochha ki aap usmaan bin affaan radiyallahu anhu ke paas jaakar unse logon ke beech prakat hone waale fitne ke baare mein baat kyon nahin karte aur is aag ko bujhaane ka prayaas kyon nahin karte? Jawaab mein unhonne kaha ki unhonne unse baat to ki hai, lekin raazdaari ke saath. Taaki uddeshy bhi poora ho jaye aur koi fitna bhi sar na uthaye. Woh kahna daraasal yeh chaahte the ki woh khulkar sabke saamne shaaskon ka khandan karna nahin chaahte. Kyonki isse khaleefa ka apmaan hoga aur fitne ka dvaara khulega. Woh nahin chaahte ki yeh dvaar sabse pahle unke haath se khule.

Uske baad usaama radiyallahu anhu ne bataya ki woh shaaskon ko ekaant mein naseehat karte hain aur kisi ki chaaploosi nahin karte ki munh par prashansa kar den. Chaahe shaasak hi kyon na ho. Yeh tareeqa daraasal unhonne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se yeh hadees sunne ke baad apnaya hai ki qayaamat ke din ek vyakti ko laakar Jahannam mein daal diya jayega. Jahannam ki aag itni tez hogi ki girne ke saath hi uske pet ki antriyaan nikalkar baahar a jayengi. Phir woh apni antriyon ke saath chaaron or aise ghoom raha hoga, jaise gadha chakki ke chaaron or ghoomta hai. Yeh drishy dekh jahannami uske aaspaas golaakaar mein ekatr ho jayenge aur usse poochhenge ki ai amuk vyakti, kya tum hamen achchhi baat ka aadesh dete aur buri baat se roka nahin karte the?

Woh jawaab dega : Yeh sach hai ki main tumhen achchhi baat ka aadesh deta tha, lekin khud uspar amal nahin karta tha. Buri baat se tumhen rokta tha, lekin usmen khud sanlipt ho jaya tarta tha.

Shaaskon ko naseehat ekaant mein karni chahiye aur uski charcha aam logon ke saamne nahin karna chahiye.
Aise vyakti ke liye bari sakht chetaavni, jiska kathan uske karm ke wipreet ho.
Shaaskon ke adab evn sammaan ka khyaal rakhna chahiye aur unko achchhe baat ka aadesh dena aur buri baat se rokna chahiye.
Shaaskon ki chaaploosi karna aur dil mein kuchh rakhna aur unke saamne kuchh aur kahna nindneey kaary hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3347: Main Allah ke nikat is baat se bari hone ka elaan karta hoon ki tummen se koi mera 'khaleel' (anany mitr) ho. Kyonki Allah ne jaise ibraaheem ko 'khaleel' banaya tha, waise mujhe bhi 'khaleel' bana liya hai

Jundub radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Mainne Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko mrityu se paanch din pahle kahte suna hai : "Main Allah ke nikat is baat se bari hone ka elaan karta hoon ki tummen se koi mera 'khaleel' (anany mitr) ho. Kyonki Allah ne jaise ibraaheem ko 'khaleel' banaya tha, waise mujhe bhi 'khaleel' bana liya hai. Haan, agar main apni ummat ke kisi vyakti ko 'khaleel' banaata, to abu bakr ko banaata. Sun lo, tumse pahle ke log apne nabiyon ki kabron ko masjid bana liya karte the. Sun lo, tum kabron ko masjid na banaana. Main tumhen isse mana karta hoon."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne Allah ke yahaan apna sthaan spasht kiya hai. Aapne bataya hai ki Allah ke nikat aap prem ke uchchatam sthaan par wiraajmaan hain, jo sthaan kewal ibraaheem alaihissalaam ko praapt tha. Isi kaaran, spasht kar diya ki Allah ke siwa aapka koi 'khaleel' (anany mitr) nahin hai, kyonki aapke dil ka gaagar uske prem, sammaan aur uske jnaan se paripoorn hai. Atah usmen ab koi khaali sthaan nahin hai. Haan, yadi makhlook mein se koi aapka khaleel hota, to abu bakr radiyallahu anhu hote. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne mohabbat ke baare mein jayaz seema se aage barhne se mana kiya hai, jisse aage barhne ka kaam yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon ne apne nabiyon ki qabron tatha apne mein se nek logon ki qabron ke silsile mein kiya tha. Unhonne to un qabron ko poojy banaakar Allah ke saath unki pooja shuru kar di thi aur unke oopar masjiden tatha ibaadatkhaane bana daale the. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apni ummat ko unke jaisa kaam karne se mana kiya hai.

Abu bakr radiyallahu anhu ki fazeelat, unka sabse uttam sahaabi tatha Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki mrityu ke baad aapki khilaafat ka sabse adhik haqdaar hona.
Qabron par masjid banaana pichhle samudayon dvaara kiye gae ghalat kaamon mein se ek hai.
Qabron ko ibaadat ki jagah banaane ki manaahi ki unke paas ya unki or munh karke namaz parhi jaye tatha unke oopar masjid ya gunbad banaye jayen, kyonki iske nateeje mein shirk ke dvaar khulne ki aashanka rahti hai.
Nek logon ke baare mein atishyokti karne se mana kiya gaya hai, kyonki isse shirk ke dvaar khulte hain.
Yahaan Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne jis cheez se mana kiya hai, uski khatarnaaki isse samajh mein aati hai ki mrityu se paanch din pahle usse saavdhaan kiya hai.
3348: Main ek aisa vyakti tha, jise bahut zyaada mazi (chipchipa safed taral jo peshaab ke raaste se) aati thi. Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke daamaad hone ke naate mujhe sharmindgi mahsoos ho rahi thi ki main aapse is baare mein poochhoon. Atah mainne miqdaad bin asvad ko poochhne ka aadesh diya (aur unhon ne poochha) to aapne kaha : "Aisa vyakti apna ling dhone ke baad waju karega.

Ali radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Main ek aisa vyakti tha, jise bahut zyaada mazi (chipchipa safed taral jo peshaab ke raaste se) aati thi. Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke daamaad hone ke naate mujhe sharmindgi mahsoos ho rahi thi ki main aapse is baare mein poochhoon. Atah mainne miqdaad bin asvad ko poochhne ka aadesh diya (aur unhon ne poochha) to aapne kaha : "Aisa vyakti apna ling dhone ke baad waju karega." Bukhaari mein hai : "Wazu karo aur apna ling dhu."

Ali bin abu taalib radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki unko aksar mazi nikal jaya karti thi. Daraasal mazi ek prakaar ka patla, chipchipa, safed paani hai, jo waasna ke samay ya sanbhog se pahle ling se nikalta hai. Aur unko pata bhi nahin tha ki mazi nikalne ke baad kya karna chahiye. Parantu Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochhne mein lajja baadha ban rahi thi, kyonki aapki beti faatima radiyallahu anha unke nikaah mein theen. Atah miqdaad radiyallahu anhu se kaha ki woh Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se iske baare mein poochhen. Tab Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kaha ki woh pahle apna ling dho len aur uske baad wazu kar len.

Ali bin abu taalib radiyallahu anhu ki fazeelat ki lajja unke liye kisi maadhyam dvaara poochhne mein baadha nahin bani.
Fatva poochhne ke liye kisi ko apna pratinidhi banaana jayaz hai.
Kisi masalhat ki bina par insaan woh baaten bata sakta hai, jinko bataane se lajja baadha banti hai.
Mazi naapaak hai aur use shareer evn kapre se dhona waajib hai.
Mazi nikalne se wazu toot jaata hai.
Ling ke saath andkosh ko dhona bhi zaroori hai, kyonki iska ullekh ek any hadees mein hua hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3350: Apne gharon ko qabristaan na banaao aur na meri qabr ko mela sthal banaao. Haan, mujhpar durood bhejte raho, kyonki tum jahaan bhi raho, tumhaara durood mujhe pahunch jayega.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu bayaan karte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Apne gharon ko qabristaan na banaao aur na meri qabr ko mela sthal banaao. Haan, mujhpar durood bhejte raho, kyonki tum jahaan bhi raho, tumhaara durood mujhe pahunch jayega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne gharon ko namaz se khaali rakhne se mana kiya hai ki we qabristaan ki tarah ho jayen, jahaan namaz nahin parhi jaati. Isi tarah baar-baar aapki qabr ki ziyaarat karne aur niymit roop se wahaan ekatr hone se mana kiya, kyonki isse shirk ka dvaar khulta hai. Aapne apne oopar dharti ke kisi bhi bhaag se darood bhejne ka aaadesh diya hai, kyonki door tatha nikat har jagah se darood samaan roop se aap tak pahunch jaati hai. Isliye baar-baar aapki qabr ke paas aane ki zaroorat nahin hai.

Gharon ko Allah ki ibaadat se khaali chhorne ki manaahi.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki qabr ki ziyaarat ke liye safar karne ki manaahi, kyonki aapne apne oopar darood bhejne ka aadesh diya hai aur bataya hai ki use aap tak pahuncha diya jaata hai. Safar masjid-e-nabvi ke iraade se aur usmen namaz parhne ke liye kiya ja sakta hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki qabr ki ziyaarat ko jashn ke roop mein lena yaani ek khaas tareeqe se ek khaas samay mein baar-baar ziyaarat karna, haraam hai. Yahi haal pratyek qabr ki ziyaarat ka hai.
Allah ke paas Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka sammaan ki har daur tatha har sthaan mein aap par darood ko shareeyat sammat ghoshit kiya.
Choonki qabron ke paas namaz na parhne ki baat sahaaba ke yahaan sthaapit thi, isliye Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki gharon ko qabristaan ki tarah na banaao ki wahaan namaz parhna chhor do.
[ise abu daawood ne riwayat kiya hai]
3351: Ai Allah ke Rasool, Allah haq baat se sharmaata nahin hai. Yadi stri ka svapnadosh ho jaye, to kya uspar snaan hai? Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah haan, yadi use paani (weery) dikhaai de.

Umme salma (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki abu talha (radiyallahu anhu) ki patni umme sulaim (radiyallahu anha) Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aakar kahne lageenh ai Allah ke Rasool, Allah haq baat se sharmaata nahin hai. Yadi stri ko svapnadosh ho jaye, to kya uspar snaan hai? Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Haan, yadi use paani (weery) dikhaai de."

Umme sulaim ansaari Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se ek masla poochhne aaeen. Choonki unka prashn guptaang se sanbandhit tha aur aam taur par uska naam lene mein haya mahsoos ki jaati hai, isliye unhonne prashn karne se pahle prashn ki bhoomika baandh li, taaki sunne waalon par uska adhik prabhaav na pare.
Unhonne kahaah nishchay Allah taaala jo ki saty hai, saty ke zikr mein, yadi uske zikr mein koi fayda ho, sharm nahin karta. Is bhoomika ke pashchaat mool wishay shuru karte hue kahti hainh yadi mahila sapne mein dekhe ki woh kisi se sanbhog kar rahi hai, to kya uspar snaan aniwaary hai? Uttar dete hue Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah haan, uspar snaan waajib hai, jab weery dekh le.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3352: 'Jo Allah chaahe evn amuk chaahe' na kaho, balki 'jo Allah chaahe phir amuk chaahe' kaho.
Huzaifa radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : 'Jo Allah chaahe evn amuk chaahe' na kaho, balki 'jo Allah chaahe phir amuk chaahe' kaho.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is baat se mana kiya hai ki koi baat-cheet karte samay "Jo Allah chaahe aur amuk chaahe" Kahe. Ya isi tarah koi "Jo Allah aur amuk chaahe" Kahe. Kyonki Allah ki chaahat aur uski ichchha mutlaq (nirpeksh) hai aur ismen uska koi shareek nahin hai. Jabki yahaan "Aur" Shabd ka prayog yeh bataata hai ki koi Allah ke saath shareek hai aur donon baraabar hain. Isliye insaan ko "Jo Allah chaahe, phir jo amuk chaahe" Kahna chahiye. Is tarah "Phir" Shabd dvaara bande ki chaahat Allah ki chaahat ke adheen ho jayegi. Jabki "Aur" Shabd mein yeh baat nahin hai.

"Jo Allah chaahe aur amuk chaahe" Tatha is tarah ke waakyon ka prayog haraam hai, jismen do waakyaanshon ko jorne ke liye "Aur" Shabd ka prayog hua ho. Kyonki  yeh shabdon aur waakyon mein bahudevvaad (shirk) ka ek roop hai.
"Jo Allah chaahe, phir tum chaaho" Tatha is tarah ke any waakyon ka prayog jayaz hai, jismen do waakyaanshon ko jorne ke liye "Phir" Shabd ka prayog hua ho. Kyonki ismen koi kharaabi nahin hai.
Allah ki chaahat ka saboot tatha bande ki chaahat ka saboot. Saath hi yeh ki bande ki chaahat Allah ki chaahat ke adheen hai.
Allah ki chaahat mein bande ko saajhi banaane ki manaahi, chaahe shaabdik roop se hi kyon na ho.
Agar is tarah ka waaky kahne waale ne is baat ka wishvaas rakha ki bande ki chaahat sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ki chaahat ki tarah aseem evn wistrit hai, ya phir bande ke paas Allah ki chaahat se hatkar apni alag chaahat hoti hai, to yeh maha shirk hai. Lekin agar is tarah ka wishvaas na rakha to chhota shirk hai.
[ise abu daawood ne tatha nasai ne al-kubra mein evn ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3354: Beshak Allah ko ghairat (svaabhimaan) aati hai aur momin ko bhi ghairat aati hai. Allah ko ghairat is baat par aati hai ki momin woh kaary kare, jise Allah ne haraam (warjit) kiya hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu bayaan karte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Beshak Allah ko ghairat (svaabhimaan) aati hai aur momin ko bhi ghairat aati hai. Allah ko ghairat is baat par aati hai ki momin woh kaary kare, jise Allah ne haraam (warjit) kiya hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki beshak Allah ko ghairat aati hai tatha woh nafrat evn naapsand karta hai, jis tarah ki momin ko ghairat aati hai aur woh nafrat evn naapsand karta hai. Allah ko ghairat is baat par aati hai ki momin vyabhichaar, samlaingikta, chori aur sharaab peena jaise gunaah ke kaam kare, jinko Allah ne haraam qaraar diya hai.
Jab Allah ki haraam ki hui cheezon mein sanliptata saamne aye, to Allah ka krodh evn dand jhelne ke liye taiyaar rahna chahiye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3355: Tum apne se pahle samudayon ka bitta-bitta aur haath-haath anusran karoge.

Abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Tum apne se pahle samudayon ka bitta-bitta aur haath-haath anusran karoge. Yahaan tak ki agar we saanda ke bil mein ghuse hain, to tum bhi usmen ghusoge." Sahaaba ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, kya aapka aashay yahoodi aur eesaai hain? To aapne pharmaya : "Phir aur kaun?"

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki aapke zamaane ke baad aapki ummat ke kuchh logon ka kya haal hone waala hai. Yeh log wishvaason, kaaryon, aadton evn rasmon mein yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon ki hoobhu naqqaali karne lagenge. Haal yeh hoga ki agar woh saanda ke bil mein ghuse honge, to yeh log bhi unke peechhe-peechh ghus jayenge.

Yeh hadees Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke sachche Nabi hone ki ek nishaani hai ki hoobhu wahi hua, jo aapne bataya tha.
Musalmaanon ko kaaphiron ki mushaabat akhtiyaar karne se mana kiya gaya hai. Samaanta chaahe wishvaas mein ho, ibaadton mein ho, tevhaaron mein ho ya unke khaas weshbhoosha mein.
Islam mein shiksha dene ka ek tareeqa ghair-mahsoos cheezon ko mahsoos misaalon dvaara spasht karna bhi hai.
Saanda : Ek jaanvar hai, jiska bil bahut andhere mein aur atyant  badboodaar hota hai. Yeh rengne waala jaanvar hai, jo registaanon mein bari sankhya mein paya jaata hai. Yahaan wishesh roop se saande ke bil ka zikr isliye hua hai ki saande ka bil bahut hi tang aur bedhab hota hai. Lekin iske baavjood agar musalmaanon ka ek warg yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon ke padchihnon par chalte hue is tang aur bedhab bil mein ghus jaata hai, to iska matlab yeh hai ki yeh warg unka hi anusran karne waala hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3356: Jab tum wastr dhaaran karo athva wazu karo to daahine or se praaranbh karo
Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jab tum wastr dhaaran karo athva wazu karo, to daahine or se praaranbh karo."

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ki yeh hadees sabhi achchhe kaaryon ko dayen haath se karne par zor deti hai. Unka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya :
"Jab tum wastradhaaran karo" Yaani jab kapra pahanne ka iraada karo.
"Tatha jab tum wazu karo" Yaani jab wazu karne ka iraada karo.
"To daahine or se praaranbh karo." Is hadees mein aya hua shabd 'أيامن' bahuvchan hai 'أيمن' ka. Yeh bayen ke wipreet ko kahte hain. Is hadees ka aashay yeh hai ki kurta aadi pahante samay dayen haath ko pahle ghusaya jayega aur wazu karte samay dayen haath evn paanv ko bayen haath evn paanv se pahle dhoya jayega. Yaad rahe ki wazu ke kuchh ang aise bhi hain, jinmen dayen-bayen ka khayaal rakhna musathab nahin hai. Woh hain, donon kaan, donon hatheliyaan aur donon gaal. Inhen ek saath paak kiya jayega. Yadi aisa sanbhav na ho, maslan kisi ka ek haath kata hua ho, to woh dayen ang se aaranbh karega.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3358: Jo in putriyon ke dvaara kuchh aazmaya jaye, phir woh unke saath achchha vyavhaar kare, to we unke liye Jahannam ki aag se bachaav ka maadhyam ban jayengi.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki mere paas ek stri aai, jiske saath uski do betiyaan theen. Woh mujhse kuchh maang rahi thi, lekin mere paas use ek hi khajoor mil saka. Mainne woh khajoor use diya, to usne use donon betiyon ke beech baant diya aur khud kuchh nahin khaya. Phir woh uthkar chal pari. Jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hamaare paas aye aur hamne aapko yeh ghatna sunaai, to farmayaah "Jo in putriyon ke dvaara kuchh aazmaya jaye, phir woh unke saath achchha vyavhaar kare, to we unke liye Jahannam ki aag se bachaav ka maadhyam ban jayengi."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai aur shabd Bukhari ke hain.]
3359: Jisne Allah ke atirikt kisi aur ki qasam khaai, usne qufr athva shirk kiya.

Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki unhonne ek vyakti ko "Nahin, kaaba ki qasam" Kahte hue suna, unhonne kaha : Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki qasam nahin khaai jayegi, kyonki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko farmaate hue suna hai : "Jisne Allah ke atirikt kisi aur ki qasam khaai, usne qufr athva shirk kiya."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is hadees mein bataya hai ki jisne Allah ke siwa kisi srishti ki kasam khaai, usne us srishti ko Allah ka saajhi thahraya aur Allah ke saath kuphr kiya, kyonki kisi wastu ki kasam khaane ka arth hai use mahaan samajhna, jabki waastawikta yeh hai ki saari mahaanta Allah ke liye hai. Atah, qasam Allah uske naamon aur gunon  ki khaai jayegi. Allah ke atirikt kisi aur ki kasam khaana chhota shirk hai. Lekin agar qasam khaane waala us cheez ko, jiski woh qasam kha raha hai, Allah ki tarah ya usse adhik sammaan de, to yeh bara shirk ban jayega.

Kasam ke dvaara sammaan diya jaana kewal Allah ka adhikaar hai, isliye kasam kewal Allah ya uske naamon tatha gunon ki khaai jayegi.
Bhalaai ka aadesh dene tatha buraai se rokne ke prati sahaaba ki tatparta, khaas taur se jab buraai ka sanbandh shirk ya kufr se ho.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3360: Jisne do larkiyon ka laalan-paalan kiya, yahaan tak ki woh bari ho gaeen, to qayaamat ke din woh tatha main is tarah ayenge." Phir aapne apni oongliyon ko milaya.

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jisne do larkiyon ka laalan-paalan kiya, yahaan tak ki woh bari ho gaeen, to qayaamat ke din woh tatha main is tarah ayenge." Phir aapne apni oongliyon ko milaya.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki jisne do betiyaan ya do bahnen di gaeen aur usne unka kharch uthaya, unki tarbiyat ki, achchhaai sikhaai aur buraai se sachet kiya, phir donon bari aur wayask ho gaeen, to woh aur Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam qayaamat ke din kuchh is tarah ayenge. Yeh kahte samay aapne apni shahaadat ki ungli aur beech waali ungli ko milaakar dikhaya.

Betiyon ke wiwaah ya yuwaawastha tak ka kharch uthaana tatha unki tarbiyat ki vyawastha karna bahut bari neki aur sawaab ka kaam hai. Yahi haal bahnon ka bhi hai.
Larkiyon ke paalan-poshan ka sawaab larkon ke paalan-poshan se adhik hai. Kyonki yahaan larkiyon ke baare mein jo baaten kahi gai hain, woh larkon ke baare mein nahin kahi gai hain. Aisa isliye hai kyonki larkiyon ka kharcha aur unke maamlon mein dhyaan dena larkon ke maamlon se zyaada (bara) hai, tatha adhik dekhbhaal ki aawashyakta hoti hai, kyonki we 'chhupaane yogy' (parde aur hiphaazat ke layak) hoti hain, we apne maamlon ko khud seedhe taur par anjaam nahin de sakteen, saath hi, pita unse yeh apeksha nahin karta ki apne beton ki tarah shatru ka saamna karte samay woh unse shakti praapt karega, uska naam amar rahega aur inse uska wansh aage barhega. Isliye, unke paalan-poshan aur dekhbhaal ke liye dhairy tatha nishtha ki aawashyakta hoti hai. Isliye ismen sawaab bhi adhik hai aur aise vyakti ko qayaamat ke din Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka saath naseeb hoga.
Mahila ke wayask hone ki nishaaniyaan : Pandrah warsh poore ho jaana, maahvaari a jaana pandrah warsh se pahle hi kyon na ho, jaghan baal ug aana ya svapnadosh hona yaani neend ka awastha mein weery ka nikal jaana.
Qurtubi kahte hain : Donon ke wayask hone ka arth hai aisi sthiti tak pahunchna, jahaan donon apne aap mein mazboot ho jayen. Aur mahilayen tabhi apne aapmen mazboot hoti hain jab we wiwaahit ho jaati hain. Isliye, wayask hone ka matlab maahvaari aana ya sharai zimmewaariyon ke nirvahan ka paaband ho jaana nahin hai. Kyonki yeh bhi sanbhav hai ki wiwaah wayask hone se pahle hi ho jaye aur bharan-poshan ki jimmedaari pati par a jaye. Iske wipreet, aisa bhi hota hai ki maahvaari shuru ho gai ho, lekin woh apne baare mein sochne aur apne hiton ke baare mein nirnay lene mein saksham na ho saki ho. Aise mein agar use akela chhor diya gaya to yeh barbaad ho jayegi aur uski sthiti kharaab ho jayegi. Atah aisi sthiti mein use adhik suraksha aur dekhbhaal ki aawashyakta hoti hai, taaki log usse wiwaah karne ke liye ichchhuk hon. Inheen baaton ke maddenzar ulema ne kaha hai ki larki ke bharan-poshan ki jimmedaari uske wayask hone par pita se samaapt nahin ho jaati, balki uske jeewan mein uske pati ke aane ke baad samaapt hoti hai.
3361: Tum Jannat mein us samay tak prawesh nahin kar sakte, jab tak eemaan na laao, aur tum us samay tak momin nahin ho sakte, jab tak ek-doosre se prem na karne lago. Kya main tumhaara path pardashan aise kaary ki or na kar doon, jise yadi tum karoge, to ek-doosre se prem karne lagoge? Apne beech mein salaam ko aam karo.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Tum Jannat mein us samay tak prawesh nahin kar sakte, jab tak eemaan na laao, aur tum us samay tak momin nahin ho sakte, jab tak ek-doosre se prem na karne lago. Kya main tumhaara path pardashan aise kaary ki or na kar doon, jise yadi tum karoge, to ek-doosre se prem karne lagoge? Apne beech mein salaam ko aam karo."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki Jannat mein kewal eemaan waale hi prawesh karenge, jabki eemaan ke sanpoorn hone aur Muslim samaaj ke satheek hone ke liye zaroori hai ki log ek-doosre se mohabbat rakhen. Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne mohabbat aam karne waali sabse uttam cheez bataai. Woh cheez yeh hai ki musalmaanon ke beech salaam aam kiya jaye.

Jannat mein prawesh ke liye eemaan zaroori hai.
Sanpoorn eemaan ki ek nishaani yeh hai ki musalmaan apne bhaai ke liye wahi pasand kare, jo apne liye pasand karta ho.
Salaam aam karna aur musalmaanon ko salaam dena musathab hai. Kyonki isse logon ke beech mohabbat evn shaanti phailti hai.
Salaam kewal musalmaan hi ko diya jayega. Kyonki hadees mein "Tumhaare beech" Ke shabd aye hain.
Salaam karne se sanbandh wichchhed, algaav aur dushmani jaisi cheezen khatm hoti hain.
Musalmaanon ke beech mohabbat ka mahatv aur iska eemaan ke sanpoorn hone ke liye zaroori hona.
Ek any hadees mein aya hai ki salaam ke sanpoorn shabd "السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته" Hain, jabki "السلام عليكم" Kahna bhi kaafi hai.
3362: Allah taaala ne farmayaah "Meri mohabbat un logon ke liye waajib ho gai, jo mere liye aapas mein ek-doosre se mohabbat karte hain, mere liye ek-doosre ke saath baithte hain, mere liye ek-doosre se milte hain aur mere liye ek-doosre par kharch karte hain."

Abu idrees khaulaani (rahimhullah) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki main dimashq ki masjid mein daakhil hua, to dekha ki ek yuwa wahaan maujood hai, jiske agle daant chamak rahe hain aur uske saath aur log bhi upasthit hain. Jab un logon ka kisi baat mein wibhed hota hai, to usse poochhte hain aur uske mat ko sveekaar karte hain. Mainne uske baare mein poochha, to kaha gaya ki yeh muaaz bin jabal (radiyallahu anhu) hain. Doosre din main jaldi masjid aya, lekin paya ki woh jaldi aane ke maamle mein mujhse baazi le gae hain. Mainne unhen namaz parhte hue paya. Atah, namaz poori hone tak unki prateeksha ki. Phir main unke saamne se unke paas aya aur salaam karne ke baad kahaah Allah ki qasam, main aapse Allah ke liye mohabbat karta hoon. Unhonne kahaah Allah ki qasam? Mainne kahaah Allah ki qasam. Unhonne phir kahaah Allah ki qasam? Mainne kahaah Allah ki qasam. Ispar unhonne meri chaadar ka kinaara pakarkar mujhe apni or kheencha aur farmayaah khush ho jaao. Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue suna hai ki Allah taaala ne farmayaah "Meri mohabbat un logon ke liye waajib ho gai, jo mere liye aapas mein ek-doosre se mohabbat karte hain, mere liye ek-doosre ke saath baithte hain, mere liye ek-doosre se milte hain aur mere liye ek-doosre par kharch karte hain."
[ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise maalik ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3364: Yadi musalmaanon par -ya : Meri ummat par- kathin na hota, to main unhen aadesh deta ki pratyek namaz ke samay misvaak kar liya karen.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Yadi musalmaanon par -ya : Meri ummat par- kathin na hota, to main unhen aadesh deta ki pratyek namaz ke samay misvaak kar liya karen."
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki agar aapko apni ummat ke mashaqqat mein parne ka bhay na hota, to unpar har namaz ke samay misvaak ko aniwaary kar dete.

Apni ummat par Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki daya aur is baat ka dar ki kaheen unhen kathinaai ka saamna na karna pare.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka aadesh mooltah aniwaaryata ko batlaata hai, jab tak ki uske nafal hone ka koi pramaan na a jaye.
Har namaz ke samay misvaak karne ka musathab hona aur uski fazeelat.
Ibn-e-daqeeq al-eed kahte hain : Namaz ke samay misvaak ko musathab qaraar diye jaane ke peechhe hikmat yeh hai ki namaz daraasal Allah ki nikatta praapt karne ki awastha hai. Isliye is mahatvoorn ibaadat ke sammaan mein insaan ko poori saaf-safaai ke saath upasthit hona chahiye.
Is hadees ki vyaapakta mein roza rakhe hue vyakti ka misvaak karna bhi shaamil hai, sooraj dhalne ke baad hi kyon na ho. Jaise zuhar tatha asr ki namaz ke liye misvaak karna.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3365: Allah ke nikat sabse adhik kaun-sa karm priy hai? Aapne uttar diya : "Samay par namaz parhna." Mainne poochha : Fir kaaैn-sa? Farmaya : "Maan-baap ke saath achchha vyavhaar karna." Mainne poochha : Fir kaun-sa? Farmaya : "Allah ke raaste mein jihaad karna.

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Mainne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam se poochha ki Allah ke nikat sabse adhik kaun-sa karm priy hai? Aapne uttar diya : "Samay par namaz parhna." Mainne poochha : Fir kaaैn-sa? Farmaya : "Maan-baap ke saath achchha vyavhaar karna." Mainne poochha : Fir kaun-sa? Farmaya : "Allah ke raaste mein jihaad karna." Abdullah bin masaood kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne mujhe yeh baaten bataaeen. Yadi main aur poochhta, to aap aur bataate.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi  wa sallam se poochha gaya ki Allah ke nikat kaun-sa amal sabse zyaada priy hai? To aapne uttar diya : Farz namaz ko uske shareeyat dvaara nirdhaarit samay par parhna. Phir maata-pita ka aajnaapaalan karte hue unke saath achchha vyavhaar karna, unko unka adhikaar dena aur unki naafarmaani na karna. Phir Allah ke pataaka ko ooncha karne, Islam tatha musalmaanon ki raksha aur islaami prateekon ka warchasv sthaapit karne ke liye tan evn dhan ke saath Allah ke maarg mein yuddh karna.

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne mere poochhne par yeh kaary bataye aur agar mein aage poochhta, to aap aur bhi bataate.

Aamaal (kaaryon) ki pradhaanta mein, Allah ke unse prem ke anusaar kami-beshi paai jaati hai.
Pradhaanta ke kram ka khyaal rakhte hue achchhe kaamon mein aage barhne ki prerna.
Sabse achchha amal (kaary) kya hai, is prashn ke uttar mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne alag-alag baaten vyaktiyon evn paristhitiyon ko dekhte hue kahi hain. Jiske liye jo amal adhik laabhkaari tha, uske liye use sabse achchha amal bataya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3366: Munaafiqon par sabse bhaari namaz isha aur fajr ki namaz hai aur agar unhen in namaazon ke sawaab ka andaaza ho jaye, to ghutnon ko bal chalkar ayen

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu bayaan karte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Munaafiqon par sabse bhaari namaz isha aur fajr ki namaz hai aur agar unhen in namaazon ke sawaab ka andaaza ho jaye, to ghutnon ko bal chalkar ayen. Mainne to (ek baar) iraada kar liya tha ki kisi ko namaz parhaane ka aadesh doon aur woh namaz parhaye, phir kuchh logon ko saath lekar, jo lakri gatthar liye hue hon, aise logon ke yahaan jaaoon, jo namaz ke liye nahin aate aur unko unke gharon ke saath jala daaloon."

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam munaafiqon tatha namaz mein aur khaas taur se isha tatha fajr ki namaz mein unki susti ke baare mein bata rahe hain. Aap yeh bhi bata rahe hain ki agar munaafiqon ko pata ho jaye ki in do namaazon ko musalmaanon ke saath jamaat mein shareek hokar parhne par kitni bari maatra mein neki milni hai, to we usi tarah ghutnon tatha haathon ke bal chalkar in do namaazon mein shareek hon, jis tarah chalna seekhne se pahle bachcha ghutnon tatha haathon ke bal par aage barhta hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ek baar is baat ka iraada kar liya tha ki kisi ko apni jagah par namaz parhaane ka aadesh de den, phir kuchh logon ko saath lekar, jo lakriyon ke gatthar liye hue hon, un logon ke paas jayen, jo namaz parhne ke liye jamaat mein shaamil nahin hote aur unke samet unke gharon ko jala daalen. Kyonki unhonne jamaat mein shaamil na hokar jo gunaah kiya hai, woh bahut bara hai. Lekin aapne aisa nahin kiya, kyonki gharon mein maasoom aurten, bachche aur maazoor (aksham) log bhi hote hain, jinka koi gunaah nahin hai.

Masjid mein upasthit hokar jamaat ke saath namaz na parhne ki bhayaanakta.
Munaafiq ibaadat kewal dikhaawe ke taur par karte hain. Yahi kaaran hai ki woh masjid usi samay jaate hain, jab log dekh rahe hon.
Isha tatha fajr ki namaz jamaat ke saath parhne ka bara sawaab, aur is baat ka ullekh ki yeh donon namaazen is layaq hain ki insaan inmen awashy aye chaahe use ghutnon ke bal chalkar aana pare.
Isha tatha fajr ki namaz ki paabandi munaaphikat se surakshit hone ki nishaani hai aur in do namaazon mein shaamil na hona munaafiqon ki wisheshta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3367: Tumhaare kamzor logon ke kaaran hi tumhaari sahayta ki jaati hai aur tumhen rozi di jaati hai.

Musab bin saad kahte hain : Saad -radiyallahu anhu- ke man mein aya ki unhen apne se kamtar logon par kuchh shreshthata praapt hai. Atah Nabi salllahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Tumhaare kamzor logon ke kaaran hi tumhaari sahayta ki jaati hai aur tumhen rozi di jaati hai."

Saad bin abu waqqaas radiyallahu anhu ne soch rakha tha ki choonki woh ek bahaadur insaan hain, isliye unhen doosre kamzor logon par utkrishtata praapt hai. Atah Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kaha : Tumhen jo sahayta evn rozi milti hai, woh tumhaare andar maujood kamzar logon ki duaaon, namaazon evn Allah ke prati nishtha ke kaaran milti hai. Kyonki kamjor logon ke hriday sansaar ki chamak-damak mein uljhe nahin hote, iseeliye unki duaaon mein aam taur par adhik sachchaai aur unki ibaadton mein adhik winamrata hoti hai.

Winamr rahne tatha abhimaan se bachne ki prerna.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Balvaan vyakti jahaan apni weerta ke maamle mein shreshth hota hai, waheen kamzor vyakti apni dua aur Allah ke prati nishtha ke maamle mein shreshth hota hai.
Nirdhanon ke saath achchha vyavhaar karne aur unhen unke adhikaar dene ki prerna. Kyonki isse Allah ki daya evn sahayta milti hai.
3368: Qayaamat ke din momin ka zewar wahaan tak pahunchega, jahaan tak wazu ka paani ka pahunchega.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Meri ummat ko qayaamat ke din is awastha mein pukaara jayega ki wazu ke nishaanon ke kaaran unke chehre aur haath-paanv chamak rahe honge." Atah, tummen se jo apni is chamak ko barha sakta hai, woh aisa zaroor kare.
Tatha Muslim ki ek riwayat ke shabd hainh mainne abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ko wazu karte hue dekha. Unhonne apne chehre tatha donon haathon ko dhoya, to lag raha tha ki (haathon ko dhote hue) kandhon tak pahunch jayenge. Phir apne pairon ko dhoya aur pindli tak chale gae. Uske baad kahaah mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue suna haih "Meri ummat ke log qayaamat ke din is awastha mein pukaare jayenge ki wazu ke nishaanon ke kaaran unke chehre tatha haath-paanv chamak rahe honge." Atah, tummen se jo apni is chamak tatha zewar ko barha sakta hai, woh aisa zaroor kare."
Tatha Muslim hi ki ek riwayat ke shabd hainh mainne apne priy mitr (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte suna haih "Qayaamat ke din momin ka zewar wahaan tak pahunchega, jahaan tak wazu ka paani ka pahunchega."

Is hadees mein Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apni ummat ko khushkhabri di hai ki Allah taaala qayaamat ke din unhen any ummaton ke beech ek sammaansoochak nishaani pradaan karega. Jab unhen us din pukaara jayega aur woh saari srishtiyon ke saamne upasthit honge, to unke chehre, haath aur paanv chamak rahe honge. Yeh chamak unhen wuzu jaisi mahatvapoorn ibaadat ke kaaran praapt hogi, jiske maadhyam se we apne shareer ke in angon ko Allah ki prasannata praapt karne ke liye aur uske pratiphal ki ummeed mein baar-baar dhoya karte the. Isi ke badle mein unhen yeh prashansnaaीy wisheshta praapt hogi. Phir abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hainh "Jo is chamak ko barha sakta hai, woh ise zaroor barhaye." Isliye ki wuzu ke samay dhoe jaane waale angon ke jitne adhik bhaag ko dhoya jayega, utni hi adhik chamak praapt hogi. Lekin jayaz sirf itna hai ki wuzu mein donon haathon ko kohniyon samet, baazu ke kuchh bhaag ko lete hue dhoe. Isi tarah donon pairon ko takhnon samet pindliyon ke kuchh bhaagon ko lete hue dhoe. Wuzu mein baazu tatha pindli ko na dhoya jaye. Doosri riwayat mein Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat kiya gaya hai ki qayaamat ke din momin ka gahna wahaan tak hoga, jahaan tak wuzu ka paani pahunchta hai.
[ise imaam Muslim ne donon riwayton ke saath naqal kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3369: Allah taaala qayaamat ke din kahegaah mere prataap ke kaaran ek-doosre se prem karne waale kahaan hain? Aaj main unhen apni chhaya mein jagah doonga, jabki meri chhaya ke atirikt koi chhaya nahin hai.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Allah taaala qayaamat ke din kahegaah mere prataap ke kaaran ek-doosre se prem karne waale kahaan hain? Aaj main unhen apni chhaya mein jagah doonga, jabki meri chhaya ke atirikt koi chhaya nahin hai."
3370: Yeh ek patthar hai, jo sattar saal pahle Jahannam mein phenka gaya tha. Woh ab tak girta raha aur ab jaakar uski gahraai mein ja pahuncha hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ham Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath the ki achaanak kuchh girne ki aawaaz sunaai di. Chunaanche aapne pharmaya : "Kya tum jaante ho ki yeh kya hai?" Hamne kaha : Allah evn uska Rasool behtar jaante hain. Farmaya : "Yeh ek patthar hai, jo sattar saal pahle Jahannam mein phenka gaya tha. Woh ab tak girta raha aur ab jaakar uski gahraai mein ja pahuncha hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ek bhayaawah aawaaz suni. Aisa laga ki koi cheez oopar se neeche giri ho. Apne paas maujood sahaaba se us aawaaz ke baare mein poochha, to unhonne jawaab diya ki Allah aur uske Rasool ko behtar maaloom hai.

Atah aapne unse kaha : Jo aawaaz tumne suni, daraasal woh ek patthar ke girne ki aawaaz hai, jo sattar saal pahle Jahannam ke kinaare se uske andar daala gaya tha aur ab jaakar uski tah tak pahuncha hai, jiski aawaaz tumhen sunaai di.

Achchhe kaam dvaara aakhirat ke din ki taiyaari karne ki prerna aur Jahannam se saavdhaan karna.
Jin wishyon ke baare mein manushy ko koi jaankaari nahin hai, un wishyon ka jnaan sarvashaktimaan Allah ke hawaale karna waanchhneey hai.
Koi baat bayaan karne se pahle shikshak ko uski or dhyaan kendrit karaana chahiye, taaki achchhe se samajh mein a jaye.
3372: Ek vyakti ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas bayen haath se khaana khaya, to aapne kaha : "Dayen haath se kha." Woh bola : Main iski taaqat nahin rakhta. Chunaanche aapne pharmaya : "Toojhe iski taaqat na ho

Salma bin akva radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki ek vyakti ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas bayen haath se khaana khaya, to aapne kaha : "Dayen haath se kha." Woh bola : Main iski taaqat nahin rakhta. Chunaanche aapne pharmaya : "Toojhe iski taaqat na ho ." Daraasal, use ahankaar ne aisa karne se roka tha. Warnankaari ne kaha : Phir woh apna haath kabhi apne munh tak na le ja saka.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ek vyakti ko bayen haath se khaana khaate hue dekha aur use dayen haath se khaana khaane ka aadesh diya, to usne abhimaan ke kaaran yeh jhoothi baat kahi ki woh daahine haath se khaane ke shakti nahin rakhta. Atah Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne uske haq mein bad-dua kar di ki woh kabhi dayen haath se khaana kha na sake aur Allah ne apne Nabi ki bad-dua qabool kar li aur uska dayaan haath bekaar ho gaya. Chunaanche woh vyakti phir kabhi apna haath khaane ya peene ke liye apne munh tak le na ja saka.

Dayen haath se khaana waajib aur bayen haath se khaana haraam hai.
Sharai aadeshon ke paalan se abhimaan insaan ko dand ka adhikaari bana deta hai.
Allah ke dvaara apne Nabi Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka yeh sammaan ki woh aapki dua grahan karta tha.
Achchhe kaam ka aadesh dene aur bure kaam se rokne ka kaam har awastha mein karna hai. Khaane ki awastha mein bhi.
3373: Jisne kisi hidayat ki or bulaya, use bhi utna  sawaab milega, jitna uska anusran karne waalon ko milega. Lekin isse un logon ke sawaab mein koi kami nahin hogi

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne kisi hidayat ki or bulaya, use bhi utna  sawaab milega, jitna uska anusran karne waalon ko milega. Lekin isse un logon ke sawaab mein koi kami nahin hogi. Tatha jisne gumraahi ki or bulaya, use bhi utna gunaah hoga, jitna gunaah uska anuran karne waalon ko haaga. Parantu isse un logon ke gunaah mein koi kami nahin hogi."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jisne apne kathan evn kaary dvaara logon ko saty evn bhalaai ka maarg dikhaya, use uske baad us maarg par chalne waale tamaam logon ke samaan pratiphal milega aur isse baad mein chalne waalon ke pratiphal mein koi katauti bhi nahin hogi. Iske wipreet jisne apne kathan evn kaary dvaara logon ko kisi buraai, gunaah ya haraam kaary ka maarg dikhaya, use uske baad us maarg par chalne waale tamaam logon ke baraabar gunaah hoga aur isse baad mein us maarg par chalne waale logon ke gunaah mein koi katauti bhi nahin hogi.

Achchhe kaam ki or bulaane ki fazeelat, kaam chaahe chhota ho ya bara. Achchhe kaam ki or bulaane waale ko achchha kaam karne waale ke samaan pratiphal milta hai. Yeh bande par Allah ka bahut bara anugrah evn daya hai.
Buraai ki or bulaane ki bhayaawahta. Buraai chaahe chhoti ho ya bari. Buraai ki or bulaane waale ko buraai karne waale ke baraabar gunaah hota hai.
Insaan ko pratiphal usi koti ka milta hai, jis koti ka uska amal (kaary) rahta hai. Isliye jo kisi achchhe kaam ki or bulayega, use achchha kaam karne waale ke baraabar sawaab milega aur jo kisi bure kaam ki or bulayega, use bura kaam karne waale ke baraabar gunaah hoga.
Ek musalmaan ko is baat se saavdhaan rahna chahiye ki uske logon ke saamne khuleaam gunaah karne ki wajah se kaheen doosre log use dekhkar woh gunaah karne na lagen. Kyonki use dekhkar woh ghalat kaam karne waale doosre logon ke gunaah ka bojh bhi use uthaana parega, chaahe usne unko prerit kiya ho ya na kiya ho.
3377: Umar (radiyallahu anhu) mujhe badr yuddh mein shareek hone waale bare-boorhe sahaaba ki majlis mein shaamil karte the. Isse aisa laga ki unmen se kisi ke man mein kuchh naaraazgi paai gai.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki umar (radiyallahu anhu) mujhe badr yuddh mein shareek hone waale bare-boorhe sahaaba ki majlis mein shaamil karte the. Isse aisa laga ki unmen se kisi ke man mein kuchh naaraazgi paai gai. Kisi ne kahaah ise woh hamaare saath kyon shaamil karte hain, jabki uske baraabar hamaare bachche hain? Yeh sun umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne kahaah woh kahaan se hain, yeh to tum jaante hi ho. Chunaanche ek din mujhe bulaya aur unke saath praamarsh mein shareek kiya. Mujhe lagta hai ki unhonne us din mujhe kewal isliye bulaya tha, taaki unhen waastawikta se avgat kara saken. Unhonne kahaah aap log Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein kya kahte hainh "إذا جاء نصر الله والفتح" (Soora al-fathah 1)? Unmen se kisi ne kaha ki Allah ne hamen aadesh diya hai ki jab Allah ne hamaari sahayta kar di aur hamen wijay pradaan kar diya, to ham uski prashansa karen aur usse kshama yaachna karen. Jabki kuchh log khaamosh rahe aur kuchh nahin bole.Yeh dekh umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne mujhse kahaah ai abbaas ke bete, kya tum bhi aisa hi kahte ho? Mainne kahaah nahin. Farmayaah phir tum kya kahte ho? Mainne kahaah yeh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka mrityu-sandesh hai, jisse Allah ne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko avgat karaya hai. Allah ne kahaah "إذا جاء نصر الله والفتح" (Jab Allah ki madad aur wijay a gaya) yeh aapki mrityu ki nishaani hai, "فسبح بحمد ربك واستغفره إنه كان توابا" (To aap apne rab ki prashansa ke saath uski pawitrata bayaan karen aur usse kshama yaachna karen. Nishchay woh bahut zyaada tauba qabool karne waala hai.) yeh sun umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne kahaah main bhi is soora ke baare mein wahi jaanat hoon, jo tum kah rahe ho.
3379: Jis din bhi bande subah karte hain, do farishte utarte hain; ek kahta hai : Ai Allah kharch karne waale ko uttam pratiphal pradaan kar. Jabki doosra kahta hai : Ai Allah, rokne waale (kanjoos) ka winaash kar.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jis din bhi bande subah karte hain, do farishte utarte hain; ek kahta hai : Ai Allah kharch karne waale ko uttam pratiphal pradaan kar. Jabki doosra kahta hai : Ai Allah, rokne waale (kanjoos) ka winaash kar."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki har din, jismen sooraj nikalta hai, do farishte utarkar pukaarte hain. Ek kahta hai :

Ai Allah! Neki ke kaamon mein, baal-bachchon par aur atithiyon par kharch karne waalon ko behtar badla pradaan kar aur uske dhan mein barkat de.

Jabki doosra kahta hai : Ai Allah! Kharch karne se haath rok kar rakhne waale ke maal ko, jise usne haqdaaron ko dene se rok rakha hai, nasht kar de.

Yeh dua karna jayaz hai ki daansheel vyakti ko adhik pratidaan diya jaye aur jo kuchh usne kharch kiya hai uske badle mein use behtar cheez di jaye. Isi tarah yeh bad-dua bhi jayaz hai ki kanjoos vyakti ka woh dhan nasht ho jaye, jismen usne kanjoosi ki hai Allah ki aniwaary ki hui jaghon mein kharch karne se bachta raha hai.
Farishte un nek momin bandon ke liye bhalaai aur barkat ki dua karte hain, jo kharch karte hain. Yaad rahe ki farishton ki dua qabool hoti hai.
Waajib evn nafli kaaryon, jaise baal-bachchon par, rishtedaaron par aur any neki ke kaamon mein mein kharch karne ki prerna.
Neki ke kaamon mein kharch karne waale ki fazeelat ke saath-saath is baat ka bayaan ki aisa karne waale vyakti ko Allah behtar badla deta hai. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : "Tum jo kuchh bhi Allah ki raah mein kharch karoge, Allah uska (poora-poora) badla dega aur woh sabse behtar rozi dene waala hai." [soora saba : 39]
Yeh bad-dua daraasal un jaghon mein kharch na karne waale ke haq mein hai, jahaan kharch karna zaroori ho. Musathab jaghon mein kharch karne se gurez karne waale ke haq mein nahin. Kyonki aisa karne waala is bad-dua ka haqdaar nahin hai.
Kanjoosi aur laalach ka haraam hona.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3380: Isne aisi tauba ki hai ki yadi use madeene ke sattar (70) logon ke beech baant diya jaye, to sabko kaafi ho jaye. Kya usne isse uttam bhi kuchh paya ki (sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan) Allah ke liye apna praan tyaag de?

Abu nujaid imraan bin husain khuzaai (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki (qabeela) juhaina ki ek stri Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aai, jo zina (vyabhichaar) ke kaaran garbhavti thi. Woh boleeh ai Allah ke Rasool, main had ki haqdaar ho chuki hoon, atah mujhpar had jaari keejiye. Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne uske wali (abhibhaawak) ko bulaya aur farmayaah "Iske saath achchha vyavhaar karo aur jab yeh bachche ko janm de, to mere paas le aao." Usne aisa hi kiya. Chunaanche Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke aadesh ke mutaabiq uske kapron ko uske shareer par baandh diya gaya aur fir aapne uske baare mein aadesh diya aur uska sangsaar kar diya gaya. Phir aapne uske janaaze ki namaz parhi. Aise mein umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne aapse kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, woh vyabhichaarini hai, iske baavjood aap uske janaaze ki namaz parh rahe hain? To farmayaah "Isne aisi tauba ki hai ki yadi use madeene ke sattar (70) logon ke beech baant diya jaye, to sabko kaafi ho jaye. Kya usne isse uttam bhi kuchh paya ki (sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan) Allah ke liye apna praan tyaag de?"
3383: Apashgun lena shirk hai. Apashgun lena shirk hai. Apashgun lena shirk hai. -aapne yeh baat teen baar kahi.- tatha hammen se har vyakti ke dil mein is tarah ki baat aati hai, lekin sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah use apne oopar bharose ke zariye door kar deta hai.

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Apashgun lena shirk hai. Apashgun lena shirk hai. Apashgun lena shirk hai. -aapne yeh baat teen baar kahi.- tatha hammen se har vyakti ke dil mein is tarah ki baat aati hai, lekin sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah use apne oopar bharose ke zariye door kar deta hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kisi suni jaane waali ya dekhi jaane waali cheez, jaise pakshiyon, jaanavron, aksham logon, sankhyaaon ya dinon aadi ka apashgun lene se saavdhaan kiya hai. Lekin yahaan pakshi ka ullekh isliye kiya ki ajnaanta kaal mein usse apashgun lena ek aam baat thi. Hota yeh tha ki arab ke log jab koi kaam, jaise yaatra ya vyaapaar aadi shuru karne ka iraada karte, to ek pakshi uraate. Yadi pakshi dayen or urta, to achchha shagun lete aur us kaam mein qadam aage barha dete. Lekin agar bayen or urta, to apashgun lete aur qadam waapas peechhe kheench lete. Aapne ise shirk bataya. Shirk isliye ki bhalaai laane waala aur buraai se bachaane waala Allah ke siwa koi nahin hai.

Aage abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ne bataya ki kabhi-kabhi musalmaan ke dil mein thora-bahut apashgun a jaata hai. Aise mein use Allah par bharosa rakhte hue, asbaab ko apnaakar, ise khatam kar dena chahiye.

Apashgun shirk hai. Kyonki ismen dil ka sanbandh Allah ke atirikt kisi aur se jur jaata hai.
Aham baaton ko dohraane ka mahatv, taaki yaad kar liye jayen aur dil mein baith jayen.
Apashgun Allah par bharose se khatm ho jaata hai.
Kewal Allah par bharosa rakhne aur dil ko usi se jore rakhne ka aadesh.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3384: Kya aisa nahin hai ki we Allah ki halaal ki hui wastuon ko haraam thahraate hain, to tum unhen haraam maan lete ho tatha Allah ki haraam ki hui wastuon ko halaal thahraate hain, to tum unhen halaal maan lete ho? Mainne kahaah haan, aisa hota hai. Aapne kahaah yahi to unki ibaadat hai.

Adi bin haatim (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki unhonne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko yeh ayat parhte sunaah "اتَّخَذُوا أَحْبَارَهُمْ وَرُهْبَانَهُمْ أَرْبَابًا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَالْمَسِيحَ ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا أُمِرُوا إِلاَّ لِيَعْبُدُوا إِلَهًا وَاحِدًا لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ" (Arthaat unhonne apne widvaanon tatha dharmaachaariyon ko Allah ke siwa poojy bana liya. Tatha maryam ke putr maseeh ko bhi. Jabki unhen jo aadesh diya gaya tha, woh iske siwa kuchh na tha ki ek Allah ki ibaadat karen. Koi poojy nahin hai, parantu wahi. Woh usse pawitr hai, jise uska saajhi bana rahe hain.) to kahaah ham unki ibaadat to nahin karte. Aapne farmayaah "Kya aisa nahin hai ki we Allah ki halaal ki hui wastuon ko haraam thahraate hain, to tum unhen haraam maan lete ho tatha Allah ki haraam ki hui wastuon ko halaal thahraate hain, to tum unhen halaal maan lete ho?" Mainne kahaah haan, aisa hota hai. Aapne kahaah "Yahi to unki ibaadat hai."

Jab is sammaanit sahaabi ne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko yeh ayat parhte suna, jismen yahoodiyon aur eesaaiyon ke baare mein kaha gaya hai ki unhonne apne dharm guruon aur sanyaasiyon ko upaasy bana liya aur yeh adhikaar de diya ki Allah ke aadesh-nishedh ke wiruddh apne aadesh-nishedh jaari karen, to unhen uska arth samajhne mein kathinaai hui, kyonki woh samajhte the ki ibaadat kewal sajda aadi hi ka naam hai. Atah, Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne spasht kar diya ki dharm guruon aur paadriyon ki ibaadat ka ek roop yeh bhi hai ki Allah aur uske Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke aadesh ke wiruddh, unki haraam ki hui halaal cheez ko haraam maan liya jaye aur unki halaal ki hui haraam cheez ko halaal maan liya jaye.

Ulema aur doosri kisi srishti ka Allah ke aadeshon ko badalne mein anusran karna, yadi anusrankarta ko maaloom ho ki we Allah ki shareeyat ka spasht wirodh kar rahe hain, mahaashirk hai.
Kisi cheej ko halaal ya haraam karaar dene ka adhikaar kewal Allah ko praapt hai.
Ismen shirk ki bahut saari kismon mein se ek kism yaani anusran mein shirk ka bayaan hua hai.
Isse pata chalta hai ki ajnaan ko jnaan dena, dharm sammat hai.
Yeh bhi maaloom hota hai ki ibaadat ke mayne bahut hi vyaapak hain. Ismen har woh nihit evn widit kathan tatha kaam shaamil hai, jise Allah pasand karta hai aur jisse woh khush hota hai.
Ismen paadriyon aur sanyaasiyon ki gumraahi ka bayaan hua hai.
Yahoodiyon aur eesaaiyon ke shirk ko saabit kiya gaya hai.
Bataya gaya hai ki samast rasoolon ka mool dharm ek hi hai aur woh hai ekeshvarvaad.
Rachyita ki awajna karte hue, kisi srishti ki aajna ka paalan karna daraasal uski ibaadat karna hai.
Bataya gaya hai ki yadi kisi dharm sanbandhi baat ka bhaav samajh mein na aye, to jnaaniyon se poochh kar maaloom kar lena aniwaary hai.
Isse sahaabiyon ka jnaan se aseem prem maaloom hota hai.
3386: Ek yahoodi dharmaguru Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aakar kahne lagaah ai Muhammad, ham apni kitaabon mein paate hain ki Allah aakaashon ko ek ugli par aur dhartiyon ko ek ugli par rakhega.

Abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ek yahoodi dharmaguru Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aakar kahne lagaah ai Muhammad, ham apni kitaabon mein paate hain ki Allah aakaashon ko ek ugli par, dhartiyon ko ek ugli par, peron ko ek ungli par, paani ko ek ungli par, keechar ko ek ungli par aur shesh saari srishtiyon ko ek ungli par rakhkar kahegaah main hi baadshaah hoon. Uski baat par sahamti jataate hue Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hans pare, yahaan tak ki aapke daarh prakat ho gae. Phir yeh ayat parheeh (وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَالأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ) (un logon ne Allah ka sammaan karne ki tarah sammaan nahin kiya aur saari dharti qayaamat ke din Allah ki mutthi mein hogi.)
Muslim ki ek riwayat mein haih "Parvat evn per ko ek ungli par rakhkar unhen hilayega aur kahegaah main hi baadshaah hoon. Main hi Allah hoon."
Tatha Bukhari ki ek riwayat mein haih "Aakaashon ko ek oongli par, paani aur keechar ko ek ungli par aur shesh saari saari srishtiyon ko ek ungli par rakhega."

Abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ek yahoodi dharm guru Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aakar kahne laga ki ham apni kitaabon mein likha paate hain ki Allah qayaamat ke din saat aakaashon ko ek oongli par, saat dhartiyon ko ek ungli par, peron ko ek ungli par aur keechar ko ek ungli par rakhega. Tatha ek riwayat mein hai ki paani ko ek ungli par aur shesh saari srishtiyon ko ek ungli par rakhega. Yahaan yeh bata den ki Allah ki ungliyaan paanch hain, jaisa ki saheeh hadeeson mein aya hai, lekin jeewon ki ungliyon ki bhaanti nahin. Phir, Allah apni saamarthy aur mahaanta ko darshaane ke liye unhen hilaate hue elaan karega ki wahi waastawik baadshaah hai, usi ke haath mein saari shaktiyaan hain aur wahi param poojy hai. Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne yahoodi widvaan ki baat se sahamti jataate hue hans diya, yahaan tak ke aapke daarh ke daant tak prakat ho gae. Phir yeh ayat parheeh {وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَالأَرْضُ جَمِيعاً قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ}.(Un logon ne Allah ki jaisi qadradaani karni chahiye thi uski (kuchh bhi) qadr na ki haalaanki (woh aisa mahaan hai ki) qayaamat ke din saari zameen uski muththi mein hogi).
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3387: Allah qayaamat ke din aakaashon ko lapetkar apne dayen haath mein kar lega aur kahegaah main hi baadshaah hoon. Kahaan hain sarakshi karne waale log? Kahaan hain ahankaar karne waale log? Phir saaton dhartiyon ko lapetkar apne bayen haath mein kar lega aur kahegaah main hi baadshaah hoon. Kahaan hain sarakshi karne waale log? Kahaan hain ahankaar dikhaane waale log?

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hain ki aapne farmayaah "Allah qayaamat ke din aakaashon ko lapetkar apne dayen haath mein kar lega aur kahegaah main hi baadshaah hoon. Kahaan hain sarakshi karne waale log? Kahaan hain ahankaar karne waale log? Phir saaton dhartiyon ko lapetkar apne bayen haath mein kar lega aur kahegaah main hi baadshaah hoon. Kahaan hain sarakshi karne waale log? Kahaan hain ahankaar dikhaane waale log?"

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) warnan karte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne batayaah sarvashaktimaan Allah qayaamat ke din saaton aakaashon ko lapetkar apne dayen haath mein kar lega aur saaton dhartiyon ko lapetkar apne bayen haath mein kar lega. Tatha aakaashon evn dhartiyon ko lapette samay uddandata karne waalon aur ahankaar dikhaane waalon ko unki auqaat bataane ke liye pukaarega aur elaan karega ki wahi waastawik evn sarvashaktimaan baadshaah hai, jo na kabhi kamzor hoga, na fana hoga. Jabki uske siwa saare raaja wa praja, nyaykaari wa atyaachaari fana ho jayenge. Sab uske saamne mahatvaheen hain. Allah apne kisi kaam ka jawaabdeh nahin, jabki any log jawaabdeh hain.
3388: Main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ke kapre se janaabat ko dho deti, phir aap namaz ke liye nakal jaate, jabki paani ka nishaan aapke kapre par dikhaai parta.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ke kapre se janaabat ko dho deti, phir aap namaz ke liye nakal jaate, jabki paani ka nishaan aapke kapre par dikhaai parta.
Tatha ek riwayat mein hai ki main aapke kapre se weery ko khurach deti, phir aap usi mein namaz parh lete.

Aaisha (razi Allahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ke kapron mein janaabat ke kaaran weery lag jaata. Kabhi weery geela hota, to use woh paani se dho deteen aur aap bheege hue kapre hi mein namaz ke liye chal dete aur kabhi weery sookha hota, to use aapke kapre se khurach deteen aur aap usi kapre mein namaz parh lete.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3389: Wahaan pahunchkar hamne kaha : Aap hamaare 'saiyyid' (adhipti) hain. To aapne kaha : 'Saiyyid' (adhipti) to Allah hai." Hamne kaha : Aap hamaare beech sabse uttam aur sabse upkaar karne waale vyakti hain. To aapne kaha : "Tum mujhe apne saadhaaran shabdon se sanbodhit karo athva kuchh saadhaaran shabdon se sanbodhit karo aur dekho kaheen shaitaan tumhen apna prawakta na bana le.

Abdullah bin shikhkheer radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Main banu aamir ke ek pratinidh mandal ke saath Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas gaya. Wahaan pahunchkar hamne kaha : Aap hamaare 'saiyyid' (adhipti) hain. To aapne kaha : 'Saiyyid' (adhipti) to Allah hai." Hamne kaha : Aap hamaare beech sabse uttam aur sabse upkaar karne waale vyakti hain. To aapne kaha : "Tum mujhe apne saadhaaran shabdon se sanbodhit karo athva kuchh saadhaaran shabdon se sanbodhit karo aur dekho kaheen shaitaan tumhen apna prawakta na bana le."

Ek pratinidhi mandal Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya. Pahunchne ke baad unhonne aapki prashansa mein kuchh baaten kaheen, jin mein se kuchh baaten aapko pasand nahin aaeen. Unhonne kaha : "Aap hamaare 'saiyyid' (adhipti) hain." Atah aapne unse kaha : "'Saiyyid' (adhipti) to Allah hai." Srishti par usi ka sanpoorn aadhipaty hai. Aur saari srishti  uske bande hain. Iske baad unhonne kaha : "Aap hamaare beech sabse uttam" Aur sabse oonchi shreni, sabse adhik pratishtha waale evn sabse adhik wishisht vyakti hain. "Aur sabse adhik upkaar karne waale" Yaani sabse adhik dene waale evn oonchaai par wiraajmaan vyakti hain. Iske Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unko nirdesh diya ke we aapko saadhaaran shabdon dvaara sanbodhit karen. Or dhoondh-dhoondhkar bhaari-bharkam shabd na layen. Kaheen aisa na ho ki shaitaan unko atishyokti ke maarg par daal de, jo shirk aur uske saadhnon ki or le jaata hai.

Sahaaba ke dilon mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka bara sammaan.
Shabdon ke chayan mein takalluf se kaam lene ki manaahi aur baatcheet mein beech ki raah apnaane ki shiksha.
Tauheed ko un kathnon evn kaaryon se surakshit rakhna, jo use kamzor karne ka kaam karte hain.
Prashansa mein atishyokti ki manaahi, kyonki yeh shaitaan ka prawesh dvaar hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aadam ki santaan ke sardaar hain aur is hadees mein jo baat kahi gai hai, woh winamrata ke kaaran aur is bhay se kahi gai hai ki kaheen log aapke baare mein atishyokti na karne lagen.
[is hadees ko abu daawood aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3390: Tum ek aise samuday ke paas ja rahe ho, jise isse pahle kitaab di ja chuki hai. Atah, pahunchne ke baad sabse pahel unhen is baat ki gawaahi dene ki or bulaana ki Allah ke siwa koi saty  poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma se warnit hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne jab muaaz bin jabal radiyallahu anhu ko yaman ki or bheja, to unse farmaya : "Tum ek aise samuday ke paas ja rahe ho, jise isse pahle kitaab di ja chuki hai. Atah, pahunchne ke baad sabse pahel unhen is baat ki gawaahi dene ki or bulaana ki Allah ke siwa koi saty  poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain. Agar we tumhaari baat maan len, to unhen bataana ki Allah ne unpar pratyek din evn raat mein paanch waqt ki namaajen farz ki hain. Agar we tumhaari yeh baat maan len, to bataana ki Allah ne unpar zakat farz ki hai, jo unke dhani logon se li jayegi aur unke nirdhanon ko lauta di jayegi. Agar we tumhaari is baat ko bhi maan len, to unke utkrisht dhanon se bache rahna. Tatha mazloom ki baddua se bachna. Kyonki uske tatha Allah ke beech koi aar nahin hoti."

Jab Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne muaaz bin jabal radiyallahu anhu ko Islam ke prachaarak evn aahvaankarta ke roop mein yaman desh ki or bheja, to unko bataya ki unka saamna eesaai samuday ke logon se hoga, taaki woh apni taiyaari rakhen. Phir unko bayaata ki unko Islam ki or bulaate samay kramvaar jo cheez zyaada mahatvapoorn ho, uski or pahle bulayen. Chunaanche sabse pahle aqeeda sudhaarne ke liye is baat ki gawaahi dene ke aahvaan karen ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke Rasool hain. Kyonki isi gawaahi ke raaste se woh Islam ke dayre mein prawesh karenge. Jab we yeh gawaahi de den, to unko namaz qayam karne ka aadesh den. Kyonki yeh tauheed ke baad sabse bara kartavy hai. Jab we namaz qayam kar lenn, to unko apne dhan ki zakat apne nirdhan logon ko dene ka aadesh den. Phir aapne muaaz radiyallahu anhu ko is baat se saavdhaan kiya ki woh zakat ke roop mein logon ke sabse uttam dhan ko na len. Kyonki madhyam star ka dhan hi lena waajib hai. Phir unko atyaachaar se bachne ka aadesh diya. Taaki unko kisi mazloom ki baddua ka saamna na karna pare. Kyonki mazloom ki baddua kabool ho jaati hai.

Allah ke ekmaatr poojy hone ki gawaahi dene ka matlab hai, kewal ek Allah ki ibaadat karna aur doosron ki ibaadat chhor dena.
Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke Allah ke Rasool hone ki gawaahi dene ka matlab hai, aap par tatha aapki shikshaaon par wishvaas rakhna, aapki pushti karna aur aapko insaanon ki or bheja jaane waala antim Rasool maanna.
Kisi aalim tatha sandeh rakhne waale vyakti ko sanbodhit karna ajnaan vyakti ko sanbodhit karne ki tarah nahin hai. Isi liye aapne muaaz radiyallahu anhu ko sachet karte hue kaha : "Tum ek aise samuday ke paas ja rahe ho, jise isse pahle kitaab di ja chuki hai."
Musalmaan ke paas apne dharm ke baare mein jaankaari honi chahiye, taaki sandeh paida karne waalon ke sandehon se bach sake. Dharm ki jaankaari ke liye jnaan arjit karna hota hai.
Jis samay Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko Nabi banaya gaya, us samay yahoodiyon tatha eesaaiyon ka dharm nirast ho chuka tha aur unke liye Islam grahan kiye bina aur Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par eemaan laye bina qayaamat ke din mukti ka koi raasta nahin tha.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3393: Tum apna sar uthaao aur kaho; tumhaari baat suni jayegi, maango; tumhen diya jayega tatha sifaarish karo; tumhaari sifaarish grahan ki jayegi.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne bataya ki aap (qayaamat ke din) ayenge aur apne rab ke aage sajde mein girkar uski prashansa karenge. (Pahle hi sifaarish karna shuru nahin karenge.) phir aapse kaha jayegaah tum apna sar uthaao aur kaho; tumhaari baat suni jayegi, maango; tumhen diya jayega tatha sifaarish karo; tumhaari sifaarish grahan ki jayegi).

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- qayaamat ke din ayenge aur Allah ke aage sajde mein girkar dua karne lagenge. Phir Allah aapko sabse bari sifaarish ki anumti dega aur kahega : Maango; tumhen diya jayega aur sifaarish karo; tumhaari sifaarish qabool ki jayegi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3395: Logo, deen mein atishyokti se bacho. Kyonki deen mein isi atishyokti ne tumse pahle logon ka winaash kiya hai.

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma se warnit hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aqba ki subah, jabki aap apni oontni par sawaar the, farmaya : "Mere liye kuchh kankri chuno." Chunaanche mainne aapke liye saat kankri chune, jo chane ke daane ke baraabar the. Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam unhen apni hatheli mein rakhkar jhaarne lage aur kahne lage : "Isi tarah ke kankri maara karo." Phir farmaya :  "Logo, deen mein atishyokti se bacho. Kyonki deen mein isi atishyokti ne tumse pahle logon ka winaash kiya hai."

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma bata rahe hain ki woh hajjatul wada ke avsar par, qurbaani ke din, jamra aqba mein kankri maarne ki subah Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath the. Isi dauraan aapne unko kuchh kankri chunne ka aadesh diya. Chunaanche unhonne aapke liye saat kankri chune. Har kankar chane ke daane ke baraabar tha. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne un kankreeyon ko apni hatheli par rakhkar hilaya aur farmaya : Isi aakaar ke kankri  maara karo. Uske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne dhaarmik maamlon mein atishyokti se kaam lene aur seema ka ullanghan karne se mana kiya. Kyonki isi atishyokti aur seema ke ullanghan ne pichhli ummaton ka winaash kiya hai.

Deen mein atishyokti ki manaahi, uske bure anjaam aur is baat ka bayaan ki deen mein atishyokti winaash ka kaaran hai.
Pichhli ummaton ki ghaltiyon se bachne ke liye unse shiksha grahan karna chahiye.
Sunnat ke anusran ki prerna.
[ise ibn-e-maajah, nasai aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3396: Main saeed bin jubair ke paas baitha tha ki unhonne kahaah kisne aaj raat taara tootte dekha hai? Mainne kahaah mainne dekha hai. Phir mainne kahaah us samay main namaz mein nahin tha, balki mujhe kisi cheez ne das liya tha.

Husain bin abdurrahmaan kahte hainh main saeed bin jubair ke paas baitha tha ki unhonne kahaah kisne aaj raat taara tootte dekha hai? Mainne kahaah mainne dekha hai. Phir mainne kahaah us samay main namaz mein nahin tha, balki mujhe kisi cheez ne das liya tha. Unhonne kahaah phir tumne kya kiya? Mainne kahaah mainne dam kiya. Unhonne kahaah tumne aisa kyon kya? Mainne kahaah ek hadees, jo hamne shaabi se suni hai. Unhonne kahaah shaabi ne tumhen kaun-si hadees sunaai hai? Mainne kahaah unhonne hamen buraida bin husaib (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit ek hadees sunaai hai ki "Buri nazar lagne athva kisi zahreele keere ke kaatne ke atirikt kisi aur maamle mein dam karna uchit nahin hai." Unhonne kahaah suni hui hadees par amal karna bari achchhi baat hai. Parantu hamen abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke hawaale se bataya hai ki aapne farmayaah "Mere saamne bahut-si ummaten laai gaeen. Mainne dekha ki kisi Nabi ke saath bahut bara samooh hai, kisi Nabi ke saath ek-do log hain aur kisi Nabi ke saath ek bhi aadmi nahin hai. Isi beech mere saamne ek wishaal janasmooh prakat hua. Mainne samjha ki yeh meri ummat ke log hain. Lekin mujhse kaha gaya ki yeh moosa aur unki ummat ke log hain. Phir mainne dekha to aur ek bara janasmooh tha. Mujhse kaha gaya ki yeh aapki ummat ke log hain. Inmen sattar hazaar log aise hain, jo bina kisi hisaab aur azaab ke Jannat mein prawesh karenge." Itna kahne ke baad aap uthe aur apne ghar ke andar chale gae. Idhar, log un sattar hazaar logon ke baare mein baaten karne lage ki we kaun ho sakte hain? Kisi ne kaha ki shayad woh log honge, jo Muslim gharaane mein paida hue aur kabhi kisi ko Allah ka saajhi nahin banaya. Unke andar isi tarah ki baaten chal rahi theen ki Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) baahar aye. Logon ne aapko us charche se avgat karaya, to farmayaah "Yeh woh log hain, jo na dam karvaate hain, na apne shareer daagte hain aur na apashgun lete hain, balki apne rab par bharosa rakhte hain." Itna sunne ke baad ukkaasha bin mehsan (radiyallahu anhu) khare ho gae aur kahaah Allah se dua keejiye ki mujhe un logon mein se bana de. To aapne farmayaah "Tum un logon mein se ho." Phir ek any vyakti khara hokar kahne laga ki mere baare mein bhi dua karen ki Allah mujhe un logon mein se bana de. Parantu aapne farmayaah "Is maamle mein tumpar ukkaasha baazi le gaya."

Husain bin abdur rahmaan -Allah ki rahmat ho unpar- ne dam karne se sanbandhit ek waartaalaap ke baare mein bataya hai, jo unke aur saeed bin jubair -unpar Allah ki rahmat ho- ke beech hui thi. Wivran is prakaar hai ki husain ko ek bichchhu ne das liya tha, jispar unhonne shareeyat ke anusaar dam kiya. Jab saeed -Allah ki rahmat ho unpar- ne unse pramaan maanga, to shaabi ki hadees prastut ki, jo buri nazar lagne tatha kisi zahreele keere ke dasne par dam karne ko jayaz thahraati hai. Ispar saeed ne unki prashansa ki, lekin saath hi unhen ek hadees sunaai, jo dam na karne ki prashansa karti hai. Woh abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- ki hadees hai, jismen hai ki jis bande ke andar chaar wisheshtayen hongi, woh bina kisi hisaab aur azaab ke Jannat ka haqdaar hoga. Wo chaar wisheshtayen hain : Dam na karvaana, daagne se bachna, apashgun na lena tatha Allah ke oopar poorn wishvaas rakhna. Phir, jab ukaasha -radiyallahu anhu- ne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se anurodh kiya ki Allah se unhen aise logon mein shaamil karne ki dua karen, to farmaya ki woh un logon mein se hain. Lekin jab ek any vyakti ne khare hokar yahi anurodh kiya, to unhen pyaar se mana kar diya, taaki yeh silsila aur aage na barhe.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3402: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se jaadu dvaara jaadu ke upchaar ke baare mein poochha gaya, to farmayaah "Yeh shaitaani kaary hai."
Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se jaadu dvaara jaadu ke upchaar ke baare mein poochha gaya, to farmayaah "Yeh shaitaani kaary hai."

Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se jaadu kiye hue vyakti ka upchaar jaahiliyat ke zamaane mein prachlit wishesh paddhati, jaise jaadu dvaara jaadu ka ilaaj, se karne ke baare mein poochha gaya, to aapne uttar diya : Yeh shaitaani kaary hai ya shaitaan dvaara sanpann hone waala kaary hai, kyonki is upchaar ke liye wibhinn jaadooi paddhatiyaan apnaai jaati hain tatha shaitaani sewayen praapt ki jaati hain. Atah yeh shirk evn haraam hai. Jahaan tak jayaz tareeke se jaadu ke upchaar ki baat hai, to aisa dam karke, jaadu ki hui wastuon ko dhoondh nikaalne ke baad Qur'an parhte hue haath se kholkar athva jayaz dawaaon ke dvaara ho sakta hai.

Yadi warjit karm mein phans jaane ka dar ho, to har us kaam ke baare mein jiska jayaz ya naajayaz hona samajh mein na aye, ulema se poochh lena dharm sammat hai.
Jaahiliyat mein jis paddhati se jaadu ka upchaar kiya jaata tha, usse upchaar karne ki manaahi aai hai, kyonki woh jaadu par aadhaarit tha aur jaadu karna ya karaana kuphr hai.
Jitne bhi shaitaani karm hain, sab haraam hain.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3406: Tum log mere prati prashansa aur taareef mein us prakaar atishyokti na karo, jis prakaar eesaaiyon ne maryam ke putr ke baare kiya. Main kewal Allah ka banda hoon. Atah mujhe Allah ka banda aur uska Rasool kaho.

Umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Tum log mere prati prashansa aur taareef mein us prakaar atishyokti na karo, jis prakaar eesaaiyon ne maryam ke putr ke baare kiya. Main kewal Allah ka banda hoon. Atah mujhe Allah ka banda aur uska Rasool kaho."
