Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apni prashansa mein sharai seema se aage barhne, aapko Allah ki wisheshtaaon se wisheshit karne, aapke baare mein ghaib ki baat jaanne ka daawa karne aur aapko Allah ke saath pukaarne se mana kiya hai, jaisa ki eesaaiyon ne eesa bin maryam ke saath kiya. Phir bataya ki aap Allah ke bandon mein se ek bande hain. Isliye aadesh diya ki ham aapko Allah ka banda aur uka Rasool kahen.

Ismen prashansa karte samay sharai seema se aage barhne se mana kiya gaya hai. Kyonki isse shirk ke dvaar khulte hain.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne jin baaton se saavdhaan kiya tha, aaj woh baaten is ummat ke andar dikhaai parti hain. Kuchh logon ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke baare mein atishyokti ki, kuchh logon ne aapke pariwaar ke baare mein atishyokti ki aur kuchh logon ne Allah ke waliyon ke baare mein atishyokti ki aur is tarah gumraahi ke maarg par chal pare.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne khud ko Allah ka banda bataya hai, taaki yeh spasht ho jaye ki aap Allah ke bande hain aur aapki saari zaroorten Allah hi poori karta hai aur aapko Allah ki kisi bhi  wisheshta se wisheshit  karna jayaz nahin hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne khud ko Allah ka Rasool bataya hai, taaki spasht ho jaye ki aapko Allah ki or se bheja gaya hai aur aapki pushti tatha anusran karna zaroori hai.
3407: Koi sankraamakta nahin, apashgunta nahin, ullu ka koi kuprabhaav nahin aur safar maas mein koi dosh nahin. Korh ke rogi se waise hi bhaago, jaise sher se bhaagte ho.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Koi sankraamakta nahin, apashgunta nahin, ullu ka koi kuprabhaav nahin aur safar maas mein koi dosh nahin. Korh ke rogi se waise hi bhaago, jaise sher se bhaagte ho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ajnaanta kaal ki kuchh cheezon ka zikr unse saavdhaan karne aur yeh bataane ke liye kiya hai ki sab kuchh Allah ke haath mein hai, aur kuchh bhi uski marzi aur nirnay se hatkar nahin hota. Yeh cheezen hain :

1- ajnaanta kaal ke log samajhte the ki beemaariyaan apne aapmen sankraamak hua karti hain. Atah Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is prakaar ka wishvaas rakhne se mana kar diya, ki koi beemaari svabhaawik roop se ek beemaar vyakti se doosre vyakti tak jaati hai. Is kaynaat ka sanchaalak ekmaatr Allah hai, wahi beemaari deta aur theek karta hai, yeh sab kuchh uske iraade evn faisle ke anusaar hua karta hai.

2- ajnaanta kaal ke log jab kisi yaatra mein ya vyavsay ke liye nikalte, to kisi chiriya ko bhagaate. Woh urkar daaeen or jaati, to khush ho jaate. Lekin agar baaeen or jaati, to bura shagun lekar laut jaate. Atah Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is tarah chiriya uraakar bura shagun lene se mana farmaya aur bataya ki yeh ek ghalat dhaarna hai.

3- ajnaanta kaal ke log kahte the : Kisi ghar par ullu baith jaye, to ghar waale museebat mein par jaate hain. Lekin Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is prakaar ka bura shagun lene se bhi mana farma diya.

4- aapne safar maheene se bure shagun lene se bhi mana farmaya. Safar chaand ke maheenon mein doosra maheena hai. Jabki kuchh logon ka kahna hai ki safar ek keera hai, jo jaanvar ya insaan ke pet mein paida ho jaata hai. Arbon ka maanna tha ki yeh keera khujli se bhi adhik sankramit hota hai. Atah aapne is prakaar ki dhaarna ka khandan kar diya.

5- aapne korh ki beemaari waale insaan se usi tarah bhaagne ka aadesh diya hai, jis tarah sher se bhaaga jaata hai. Yeh hadees saavdhaani baratne, surakshit rahne ka prayaas karne aur Allah ke bataye hue saadhnon ka prayog karne ki prerna deti hai. Korh daraasal ek beemaari hai, jiska shikaar ho jaane ke baad insaan ke shareer ke ang galne lagte hain.

Allah par tawakkul aur bharosa karna aniwaary hai tatha iske saath hi shareeyat sammat saadhnon ka upyog karna bhi zaroori hai.
Is baat par eemaan rakhna zaroori hai ki is kaynaat mein jo kuchh hota hai, Allah ki taqdeer aur uske nirnay ke anusaar hota hai, aur duniya ke saare saadhan Allah ke haath mein hain. Wahi unko prabhaavkaari banaata hai ya unko prabhaav rahit banaata hai.
Jo log kaale evn laal aadi rangon, kuchh sankhyaaon, naamon, vyaktiyon evn wiklaang logon se bura shagun lete hain, unka aisa karna ghalat hai.
Kushth rog aur is tarah ki any sankraamak beemaariyon se peerit logon ke paas jaane ki manaahi daraasal un kaarnon mein se ek hai, jinki kokh se aam taur par Allah ke aadesh se nateeje saamne aya karte hain. Dekha jaye to kaarnon ka apna koi sthayi astitv nahin hota, balki yadi Allah chaahe to unki prabhaavsheelta ko samaapt kar unhen aprabhaawi bana sakta hai aur yadi chaahe to unka prabhaav baaqi rakhkar unhen prabhaawi rahne de sakta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3409: Allah ki qasam, Allah tumhaare dvaara yadi ek bhi vyakti ko hidayat de de, to yeh tumhaare liye laal oonton se uttam hai.

Sahl bin saad radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne khaibar ke din farmaya : "Kal main jhanda ek aise aadmi ko doonga, jiske haath par Allah wijay pradaan karega. Use Allah tatha uske Rasool se prem hai tatha Allah evn uske Rasool ko bhi usse prem hai." Sahaaba raat bhar yeh anumaan lagaate rahe ki jhanra kise diya ja sakta hai? Subah sab log Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas pahunche. Har vyakti aashaanvit tha ki jhanda use hi diya jayega. Lekin aapke munh se nikla : "Ali bin abu taalib kahaan hain?" Kaha gaya ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Unki aankhen dukh rahi hain. Aapne kaha : "Use bula bhejo." Unhen upasthit kiya gaya, to aapne unki aankhon mein apna mukhasraav daal diya aur dua kar di. Nateeje mein woh aise theek ho gae, jaise unhen koi pareshaani thi hi nahin. Aapne unhen jhanda thama diya. Aise mein ali radiyallahu anhu ne kaha : Kya main unse us samay tak laroon, jab tak we ham jaise na ho jayen? Aapne kaha : "Aaraam se chal paro. Jab khaibar ke maidaan mein pahunch jaao, to unhen Islam grahan karne ka aamantran dena aur unpar Allah ke jo adhikaar hain, unhen unse avgat karna. Allah ki qasam, Allah tumhaare dvaara yadi ek bhi vyakti ko hidayat de de, to yeh tumhaare liye laal oonton se uttam hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne sahaaba ko bataya ki aane waale kal musalmaanon ko khaibar ke yahoodiyon par wijay praapt hogi. Wijay ek aise vyakti ke haathon praapt hogi, jise aap jhanda thamayenge. Yahaan aye hue arbi shabd "Ar-rayah" Se muraad woh jhanda hai, jiska upyog sena prateek ke taur par karti hai. Jhanda praapt karne waale vyakti ki wisheshtayen bataate hue aapne farmaya ki woh Allah aur uske Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se muhabbat rakhta hai, aur Allah tatha uska Rasool usse muhabbat rakhte hain. Tab sahaaba ne raat is baat par sochte hue guzaari ki subah jhanda kise milega? Har vyakti chaahta tha ki yeh gaurav use praapt ho. Subah hui to sab log Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas apne-apne man mein yeh laalsa liye hue pahunche ki yeh sammaan praapt ho jaye.

Lekin Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ali bin abu taalib ke baare mein poochh daala.

Bataya gaya ki woh beemaar hain aur unki aankhon mein pareshaani hai.

Aapne unko bula bheja. Woh laye gae, to unki aankhon par apne munh ki raal laga di, tatha unke liye dua kar di. Phir aise theek ho gae, jaise koi pareshaani thi hi nahin. Ab unko jhanda de diya aur aadesh diya ki aaraam se chalte jayen. Jab dushman ke qile ke nikat pahunch jayen, to unke saamne Islam grahan kar lene ka prastaav rakhen. Agar grahan kar lete hain, to Islam ke aniwaary kaary sikhayen.

Uske baad Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ali bin abu taalib radiyallahu anhu ko Allah ki or bulaane ki mahatta samjhaai aur bataya ki kisi ke dvaara ek vyakti bhi sachche maarg par chalne waala ban jaye, to laal oonton se behtar hai, jinka maalik banne ke baad insaan chaahe to unhen apne paas rakhe aur chaahe to sadqa kar de. Yahaan yeh yaad rahe ki arbon ke yahaan laal oonton ka shumaar moolyawaan dhanon mein hota hai.

Ali bin abu taalib radiyallahu anhu ki fazeelat aur unke baare mein Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki yeh gawaahi ki Allah aur uske Rasool ko unse muhabbat hai aur unko Allah aur uske Rasool se muhabbat hai.
Sahaaba achchhe kaamon ke ichchhuk raha karte the aur use praapt karne ke liye ek-doosre se aage barhne ka prayaas karte the.
Yuddh ke samay shishtaachaar ka khyaal rakhna chahiye, aur anaawashyak krodh prakat karne aur pareshaan karne waali aawaazen nikaalne se bachna chahiye.
Aapke sachche Nabi hone ka ek pramaan yeh bhi hai ki aapne yahoodiyon par wijay laabh karne ki soochna pahle hi de di, aur aapke haath se Allah ki anumti se ali bin abu taalib radiyallahu anhu ki aankhen theek ho gaeen.
Jihaad ka sabse bara uddeshy hai, Islam ke dayre ko wistaar dena.
Allah ki or bulaane ka kaam marhalaawaar kiya jayega. Sabse pahle donon gawaahiyon ke maadhyam se Islam grahan karne kaha jayega, aur uske baad Islam ke aniwaary kaaryon ke paalan ka aadesh diya jayega.
Islam ki or bulaane ki fazeelat aur yeh ki usmen bulaane waale aur saamne waale vyakti donon ke liye bhalaai nihit hai. Is baat ki sanbhaavna se inkaar nahin kiya ja sakta ki saamne waale vyakti ko sachcha maarg mil jaye aur bulaane waale ko bahut bara pratiphal praapt ho jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3410: Ai chacha jaan, aap 'la ilaaha illallah' kah den, main is kalima ko Allah ke paas pramaan svaroop prastut karoonga.

Saeed bin musayyib apne pita se riwayat karte hain, woh kahte hain : Jab abu taalib ki mrityu ka samay nikat aya, to Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam unke paas aye. Us samay aapne unke paas abdullah bin abu umayya bin mugheera aur abu jahl ko paya. Aapne kaha : "Ai chacha jaan, aap 'la ilaaha illallah' kah den, main is kalima ko Allah ke paas pramaan svaroop prastut karoonga." Yeh sun abu jahl aur abdullah bin abu umayya ne kaha : Kya tum abdul muttalib ka dharm chhor doge? Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam baar-baar niwedan karte rahe aur donon rokne ke prayaas mein lage rahe. Anttah abu taalib ne yahi kaha ki woh abdul muttalib ke dharm par kayam hain. Is tarah 'la ilaaha illallah' kahne se inkaar kar diya. Warnankarta kahte hain : Parantu, Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jab tak mujhe roka na jaye, main aapke liye kshama maangta rahoonga." Chunaanche Allah ne yeh ayat utaari : {مَا كَانَ لِلنَّبِيِّ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرُوا لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَلَوْ كَانُوا أُولِي قربى...} (Nabi aur eemaan laane waalon ke liye uchit nahin ki we bahudevvaadiyon ke liye kshama ki praparthana karen, yadyapi we naatedaar hi kyon na honn) [at-tauba : 113] tatha abu taalib ke baare mein yeh ayat utaari : {إِنَّكَ لا تَهْدِي مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ} (tum jise chaaho supath par nahin la sakte, kintu Allah jise chaahta hai raah dikhaata hai, aur woh raah paane waalon ko bhali-bhaanti jaanta hai.) [al-qasas : 56]

Abu taalib ki mrityu ka samay nikat aya, to Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam unke paas aye aur unse farmaya : Chacha jaan! Aap la ilaaha illallah kah den. Is ek waaky ke aadhaar par main Allah ke yahaan aapke liye gawaahi doonga. Yeh sun abu jahn aur abdullah bin abu umayya ne kaha : Abu taalib! Aap apne pita abdul muttalib ka dharm chhor denge? Woh dharm daraasal moorti pooja ka dharm tha. Donon unse baat karte rahe, yahaan tak ki unhonne unse jo antim baat kahi, woh is prakaar thi : Main abdul muttalib ke dharm par rahte hue duniya se ja raha hoon. Yaani shirk aur moorti pooja ke dharm par. Yeh sun Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Main aapke liye us samay tak kshama yaachna karta rahoonga, jab tak mera rab mujhe mana na kar de. Chunaanche isi paridrishy mein Qur'an ki yeh ayat utri : "Kisi Nabi ke liye tatha unke liye jo eemaan laye hon, yogy nahin hai ki mushrikon (mishranvaadiyon) ke liye kshama ki praarthana karen. Yadyapi we sameepvarti hon, jab ye spasht ho gaya ki waastav mein woh jahannami hain." [at-tauba : 113] abu taalib ke baare mein yeh ayat utri : "(He Nabi!) aap jise chaahen use supath nahin darsha sakte, parantu Allah jise chaahe supath darshaata hai, aur woh bhali-bhaanti jaanta hai supath praapt karne waalon ko." [al-qasas : 56] aap jise saty ke maarg par chalaana chaahen, use saty ke maarg par chala nahin sakte. Aapka kaam kewal pahuncha dena hai. Allah jise chaahta hai, saty ke maarg par chalaata hai.

Bahudevvaadiyon ke liye Allah se kshama ki praarthan karna jayaz nahin hai, chaahe woh kitne hi qareebi rishtedaar kyon na hon aur unka amal evn upkaar kitna hi bara kyon na ho.
Poorvajon evn bare logon ka kora anusran ajnaanta kaal ka kaam hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki karuna ki poornata aur logon aur logon ko aamantrit karne aur unka maargadarshan karne ki unki utsukta.
Is baat ka daawa karne waalon ka khandan ki abu taalib musalmaan ho gae the.
Karmon ka daaromdaar ant par hai.
Laabh praapt karne ya nuqsaan se bachne ke liye Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se lau lagaana ghalat hai.
Jisne jnaan, yaqeen aur wishvaas ke saath la ilaaha illallah kah diya, woh musalmaan ho gaya.
Bure saathiyon ka nuqsaan.
La ilaaha illallah ka arth hai, buton, auliya aur Allah ke sadaachaari bandon ki ibaadat se daaman bachaana aur kewal ek Allah ki ibaadat karna. Bahudevvaadi bhi kalima-e-tauheed ke is arth ko samajhte the.
Bahudevvaadi rogi ko dekhne ke liye jaana jayaz hai, jab uske musalmaan ho jaane ki aasha ho.
Supath par chalne ka suyog dena Allah ka kaam hai. Rasool ka kaam kewal raah bata dena aur sandesh pahuncha dena hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3414: Qayaamat ke din meri sifaarish praapt karne ki sabse bari khush naseebi us vyakti ko haasil hogi, jisne apne dil ya saaf neeyat se “La ilaaha illallah” kaha ho.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Kaha gaya ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Qayaamat ke din aapki sifaarish se kaun zyaada hissa payega, to aapne farmaya : "Abu huraira! Mera khyaal tha ki tumse pahle koi mujhse yeh baat nahin poochhega, kyonki main dekhta hoon ki tumhen hadees se bahut lagaav hai. Qayaamat ke din meri sifaarish praapt karne ki sabse bari khush naseebi us vyakti ko haasil hogi, jisne apne dil ya saaf neeyat se “La ilaaha illallah” kaha ho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki qayaamat ke din aapki sifaarish praapt karne ki sabse bari khush naseebi us vyakti ko haasil hogi, jisne apne dil ya saaf neeyat se “La ilaaha illallah” kaha ho." Yaani is baat ka iqraar kiya ho ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur shirk tatha riyaakaari jaisi cheezon se paak-saaf raha ho.

Is baat ka saboot ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aakhirat mein sifaarish karenge aur aapki sifaarish kewal ekeshvarvaadi logon ko praapt hogi.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki sifaarish ka matlab hai, aapka Jahannam ka haqdaar ban chuke ekeshvarvaadiyon ke baare mein yeh sifaarish karna ki unko Allah Jahannam mein na daale tatha Jahannam mein ja chuke logon ke baare mein yeh sifaarish karna ki unko Jahannam se nikaal de.
Wishuddh roop se Allah ke liye kalima-e-tauheed ka iqraar karne ki fazeelat aur uska mahatvapoorn prabhaav.
Kalima-e-tauheed ko sanpoornaroop maanne ka matlab hai, uske mayne ko jaanna aur uske taqaazon (maang) par amal karna.
Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ki fazeelat tatha unka jnaan arjit karne ka shauq.
3415: Yeh kaun hota hai mujhpar qasam uthaane waala ki main amuk vyakti ko kshama nahin karoonga? Mainne use kshama kar diya aur tere karmon ko vyarth kar diya.

Jundub bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Ek vyakti ne kahaah Allah ki qasam, Allah amuk vyakti ko kshama nahin karega, to Allah ne kahaah yeh kaun hota hai mujhpar qasam uthaane waala ki main amuk vyakti ko kshama nahin karoonga? Mainne use kshama kar diya aur tere karmon ko vyarth kar diya."
Tatha ek hadees mein hai ki aisa kahne waala ek sadaachaari banda tha. Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki usne ek baat aisi kah di ki uski duniya evn aakhirat chaupat ho gai.

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne zabaan ki winaashta evn widhvansta se saavdhaan karte hue bataya hai ki ek vyakti ne qasam khaakar kaha ki Allah amuk paapi vyakti ko kshama nahin karega. Daraasal, uske dil mein yeh baat baithi hui thi ki Allah ke nikat use ek wishesh sthaan praapt hai aur is paapi ki koi haisiyat nahin hai. Isliye, ek tarah se usne Allah ke chaaron or apne aadesh ka ghera daal diya aur use apni baat ka paaband banaane ka prayaas kiya. Choonki yeh Allah ko raah dikhaane ka prayaas aur uske saath ashishtata thi, isliye Allah ne us aadmi ke haq mein duniya evn aakhirat ki naakaami aur naamuraadi likh di.
3417: , aise vyakti ko Allah Jannat mein daakhil karega, chaahe uska amal jaisa bhi raha ho.

Ubaada bin saamit radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne is baat ki gawaahi di ki kewal Allah hi saty poojy hai, uska koi saajhi nahin hai, evn Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke bande aur uske Rasool hain, aur eesa bhi Allah ke bande, uske Rasool tatha uska shabd hain, jise usne maryam ki or daala tha aur uski or se bheji hui aatma hain, tatha Jannat aur Jahannam saty hain, aise vyakti ko Allah Jannat mein daakhil karega, chaahe uska amal jaisa bhi raha ho."

Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jisne kalima-e-tauheed ke arth ko jaante hue aur uske taqaazon (maangon) par amal karte hue uska uchchaaran apni zabaan se kiya, Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke baare mein Allah ke banda aur uske Rasool hone ki gawaahi di, eesa alaihissalaam ke baare mein Allah ke banda tatha Rasool hone ko sveekaar kiya, aur is baat ko bhi sveekaar kiya ki Allah ne unko "كن" Shabd se paida kiya hai aur woh Allah ki or se bheji gai aur uski paida ki hui ek aatma hain, unki maata ko yahoodiyon dvaara lagaye gae aaropon se bari maana, aur is baat par wishvaas rakha ki Jannat tatha Jahannam donon saty hain, donon ke astitv par wishvaas rakha aur unko Allah ki nemton tatha yaatnaaon ka sthaan maana aur isi awastha mein mrityu ko praapt hua, to uska thikaana Jannat hoga, yadyapi usse Allah ki ibaadat mein kuchh trutiyaan hui hon aur uske kuchh gunaah bhi rahe hon.

Allah ne maryam ke putr eesa ko bina pita ke "كُنْ" Shabd se paida kiya.
Eesa alaihissalaam tatha Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam donon Allah ke bande tatha Rasool the. Atah donon Rasool the, is liye inhen jhutlaya nahin ja sakta, aur yeh donon Allah ke bande the, isliye unki ibaadat nahin ki jaasakti.
Tauheed (ekeshvarvaad) ki fazeelat tatha uska gunaahon ko mitna dena. Saath hi yeh ki ekeshvarvaadi ka thikaana Jannat hai, chaahe usse kuchh gunaah kyon na ho gae hon.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3418: Jo Allah se is awastha mein milega ki kisi ko uska saajhi na banaya hoga, woh Jannat mein prawesh karega aur jo usse is awastha mein milega ki kisi ko uska saajhi thahraya hoga, woh Jahannam mein prawesh karega.

Jaabir bin abdullah radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki main ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko yeh pharmaate hue suna : "Jo Allah se is awastha mein milega ki kisi ko uska saajhi na banaya hoga, woh Jannat mein prawesh karega aur jo usse is awastha mein milega ki kisi ko uska saajhi thahraya hoga, woh Jahannam mein prawesh karega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jo vyakti is haal mein mara ki kisi ko Allah ka saajhi nahin banaya, uska thikaana Jannat hai, agarche uske kuchh gunaahon ke kaaran use kuchh yaatnaaon ka saamna karna pare. Isi prakaar jo vyakti is haal mein mara ki kisi ko Allah ka saajhi banaata raha, woh Jahannam mein hamesha rahega.

Tauheed ki fazeelat tatha yeh ki isse hamesha Jahannam mein rahne se mukti mil jaati hai.
Jannat tatha Jahannam donon bande se nikat hain. Bande tatha Jannat evn Jahannam ke beech aar kewal maut ki hai.
Ismen chhote-bare har prakaar ke shirk se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai. Kyonki isse bachna hi Jahannam se mukti ka maarg hai.
Karmon ka daaromdaar ant par hai.
3419: Jis vyakti ki mrityu is awastha mein hui ki woh kisi ko Allah ka samkaksh banaakar pukaar raha tha, woh Jahannam mein prawesh karega.

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ek baat kahi hai aur mainne ek baat kahi hai. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jis vyakti ki mrityu is awastha mein hui ki woh kisi ko Allah ka samkaksh banaakar pukaar raha tha, woh Jahannam mein prawesh karega." Jabki mainne kaha hai : Jis vyakti ki mrityu is awastha mein hui ki usne kisi ko Allah ka samkaksh banaakar nahin pukaara, woh Jannat mein prawesh karega.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jisne aisa koi kaam Allah ke atirikt kisi aur ke liye kiya, jise kewal Allah ke liye kiya jaana zaroori hai, jaise Allah ke alaawa kisi aur se kuchh maanga ya maseebat ke samay faryaad (praarthana) ki aur woh isi awastha mein mar gaya, to woh Jahannam jaane waalon mein shaamil hoga. Jabki abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ne aage kaha hai ki jiski mrityu is awastha mein hui ki usne kisi ko Allah ka saajhi nahin thahraya, to Jannat mein prawesh karega.

Dua ibaadat hai aur Allah ke atirikt kisi se dua karna jayaz nahin hai.
Tauheed (ekeshvarvaad) ki fazeelat tatha is baat ka bayaan ki jo ekeshvarvaad par qayam rahkar mara, woh Jannat mein prawesh karega. Haalaanki aisa bhi ho sakta hai ki apne kuchh gunaahon ki buniyaad par use kuchh azaab bhi diya jaye.
Shirk ki bhayaawahta tatha is baat ka bayaan ki jo shirk karta hua marega, woh Jahannam mein jayega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3420: Atishyokti karne waale halaak ho gae
Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Atishyokti karne waale halaak ho gae." Aapne yeh baat teen baar kahi.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki bina jnaan aur pramaan ke apne deen aur duniya tatha kathan evn karm mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki bataai hui sharai seema se aage barhne waale naakaam wa naamuraad honge.

Saare hi kaamon mein baal ki khaal nikaalna aur atishyokti karna haraam hai, atah isse bachna chahiye. Khaas taur se ibaadton aur nek logon ke sammaan mein.
Ibaadat aadi mein adhik uttam cheez karna achchhi baat hai aur iske liye shareeyat ka anusran zaroori hai.
Kisi mahatvapoorn baat ki taakeed karna musathab hai, kyonki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is waaky ko teen baar dohraya hai.
Islam ek aasaan tatha udaar dharm hai.
3421: Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhu) Allah taaala ke farmaanah (وَقَالُوا لا تَذَرُنَّ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَلا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلا سُوَاعًا وَلا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا) (aur unhonne kaha, apne isht-poojyon ko kadaapi na chhoro aur na wadd ko chhoro aur na suwa ko aur na yaghoos aur na yaooq aur nasr ko) ke baare mein kahte hainh is ayat mein jo naam aye hain, woh daraasal nooh (alaihissalaam) ke samuday ke kuchh sadaachaari bandon ke naam hain.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhum) Allah taaala ke farmaanah (وَقَالُوا لا تَذَرُنَّ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَلا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلا سُوَاعًا وَلا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا) (aur unhonne kaha, apne isht-poojyon ko kadaapi na chhoro aur na wadd ko chhoro aur na suwa ko aur na yaghoos aur na yaooq aur nasr ko) ke baare mein kahte hainh is ayat mein jo naam aye hain, woh daraasal nooh (alaihissalaam) ke samuday ke kuchh sadaachaari bandon ke naam hain. Jab unki mrityu ho gai, to shaitaan ne unke samuday ke dil mein daala ki jahaan we baitha karte the, wahaan unka but banaakar khara kar diya jaye tatha in buton ko unheen ka naam de diya jaye. Chunaanche unhonne uski baat maan li. Magar abhi upaasna ka aaranbh nahin hua tha. Lekin jab but khara karne waale log duniya se chal base aur waastawikta ko jaanne waale na rahe, to unki pooja shuru ho gai.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) is ayat ki vyaakhya karte hue kahte hain ki yeh poojit pratimayen, jinke baare mein Allah taaala ne bataya hai ki nooh (alaihisallaam) ke dvaara apni qaum ko is baat se mana kiye jaane ke baad bhi ki kisi ko Allah ka saajhi na thahraana, unki qaum ke logon ne aapas mein ek-doosre ko unki ibaadat jaari rakhne ki taakeed ki thi, daraasal unke kuchh sadaachaari logon ke naam hain. Hua yeh ki nooh alaihissalaam ki qaum ne shaitaan ke bahkaawe mein aakar unke baare mein atishyokti ki aur unka chitr laga liya. Phir ek din aisa aya ki in chitron ko but mein badal diya gaya aur unki pooja aaranbh ho gai.

Nek logon ke baare mein atishyokti, Allah ko chhorkar khud unki ibaadat karne lag jaane ka aur phir dharm ko poornaroopen chhor dene ka kaaran ban jaati hai.
Chhawi banaane aur chhawi ko latkaye rakhne, wisheshkar bare logon ki chhawi ke saath aisa karne se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai.
Shaitaan ki chaalbaazi aur asaty ko saty ki soorat mein prastut karne ke uske hunar se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai.
Bidaaton se, chaahe unko aawishkaar karne waale ya anjaam dene waale ki neeyat saaph hi kyon na rahi ho, saavdhaan kiya gaya hai.
Chhawi un saadhnon mein se ek hai jo insaan ko shirk tak pahunchaate hain. Atah jaandaar cheejon ki tasveer banaane ya rakhne se bachna waajib hai.
Jnaan ki sanpatti saath hone ke mahatv ki pahchaan aur usse wanchit rahne ka nuksaan samajh mein aata hai.
Beshak jnaan ke lupt hone ka kaaran ulema ki maut hai.
Bina soche-samjhe kore anusran se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai, kyonki woh dheere-dheere islaam ke dayre se nikal jaane ka kaaran ban jaata hai.
Pahle ki ummaton mein bhi shirk ke maujood rahne ka pata chalta hai.
Yeh bhi maaloom hota hai ki uparyukt paanchon naam nooh (alaihissalaam) ki kaum ke paanch poojyon ke naam hain.
Ismen bayaan kiya gaya hai ki asatyakarmi apne asaty maarg par ek-doosre ke kandhe se kandha milaakar chalte aur ek-doosre ka sahyog karte hain.
Ismen saamaany roop se tamaam kaaphiron par laanat bhejne ka auchity bhi vyaapt hai.
3422: Koi sankraamakta nahin aur na koi apashgunta. Haan, mujhe faal (shagun) achchha lagta hai." Sahaaba ne poochha : Shagun kya hai? Farmaya : "Achchhi baat.

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Koi sankraamakta nahin aur na koi apashgunta. Haan, mujhe faal (shagun) achchha lagta hai." Sahaaba ne poochha : Shagun kya hai? Farmaya : "Achchhi baat."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki ajnaanta kaal ke logon ka yeh wishvaas asaty hai ki beemaari Allah ke nirnay aur faisle ke bina hi apne aap ek vyakti se doosre vyakti ki or hastaantrit ho jaati hai. Isi tarah parindon, jaanavron, wiklaangon , ankon ya dinon aadi ka apashgun lena ghalat hai. Is hadees mein "At-tiyarto  الطيرة-arthaat; apashgun lena" Shabd ka prayog isliye hua hai ki ajnaanta kaal mein apashgun lene ka yeh tareeqa bahut mashhoor tha; ki arab ke log jab yaatra ya vyaapaar aadi koi kaam shuru karna chaahte, to parinda uraakar dekhte, agar parinda dayen urta, to ise shagun samajhkar kaam aage barhaate aur agar bayen urta, to apashgun samajhkar qadam peechhe waapas kheench lete. Phir Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki aapko shagun pasand hai. Daraasal shagun se muraad woh khushi aur prasannata hai, jo insaan ko koi achchhi baat sunkar praapt hoti hai aur use apne paalanhaar ke baare mein achchha gumaan rakhne par aamaada karti hai.

Bharosa Allah par rakhna chahiye. Kyonki bhalaai wahi laata hai aur buraai se wahi bachaata hai.
Apashgun lene ki manaahi. Apashgun lene ka matlab yeh hai ki kisi cheez ka bura shagun lekar insaan kisi kaam ko rok de.
Achchha shagun lena mana nahin hai. Yeh Allah se achchha gumaan rakhne ke dayre mein aata hai.
Har cheez Allah, jo akela hai aur uska koi saajhi nahin hai, ke nirnay evn likhe ke anusaar hoti hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3433: Jab tummen se koi chheenke, to 'al-hamdu lillah' (saari prashansa Allah ki hain) kahe aur uska bhaai athva uska saathi 'yarahmukallah' (Allah tujhpar daya kare) kahe. Phir jab uska saathi 'yarahmukallah' kahe, to woh 'yahdeekumullah wa yuslihu baalkum' (Allah tumhen hidayat de aur tumhaara haal sahi kar de) kahe.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jab tummen se koi chheenke, to 'al-hamdu lillah' (saari prashansa Allah ki hain) kahe aur uska bhaai athva uska saathi 'yarahmukallah' (Allah tujhpar daya kare) kahe. Phir jab uska saathi 'yarahmukallah' kahe, to woh 'yahdeekumullah wa yuslihu baalkum' (Allah tumhen hidayat de aur tumhaara haal sahi kar de) kahe."
3435: Aadmi ko jamaat ke saath namaz parhne se ghar tatha baazaar mein namaz parhne ki tulna mein pachchees guna adhik sawaab milta hai.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Aadmi ko jamaat ke saath namaz parhne se ghar tatha baazaar mein namaz parhne ki tulna mein pachchees guna adhik sawaab milta hai. Woh isliye ki jab achchhi tarah wazu karta hai, fir masjid sirph namaz ke liye hi nikalta hai, to pratyek qadam par uski ek shreni oonchi ki jaati hai tatha uska ek paap mitaya jaata hai. Phir jab namaaj khatm ho jaati hai, to farishte uske liye praarthana karte rahte hain, jab tak woh masjid mein hota hai. We kahte rahte hainh ai Allah, uspar daya kar. Ai Allah, use kshama kar de. Ai allah, uspar raham kar. Tatha woh jab tak namaz ki prateeksha mein rahta hai, us samay tak namaz hi mein hota hai."

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne bataya hai ki aadmi jab jamaaat ke saath namaz parhta hai, use uski ghar athva baazaar mein akele parhi gai namaz ki tulna mein pachchees guna adhik neki milti hai. Yahaan jamaaat mein namaz parhne se tulna yahi bataati hai ki ghar mein parhi gai namaz se aashay ghar mein akele parhi gai namaz hai. Waise bhi, ghar aur baazaar mein namaz aam taur par akele hi parhi jaati hai. Shabd (وذلك) se yadi jamaaat waali namaz ki akele parhi jaane waali namaz se uttam hona muraad hai, to iska abhipray yeh hai ki yeh masjid ki jamaaat ke saath khaas hai. Aur shabd (أنه) se aashay ya to paristhiti hai ya woh aadmi, jo achchhi tarah, arthaat sunnaton ka khayaal rakhte hue poore taur par wuzu karke kewal namaz parhne ke uddeshy se masjid ke liye nikalta hai, (yadi woh kisi aur uddeshy se nikalta hai ya koi aur uddeshy bhi shaamil hota hai, to woh us fazeelat se wanchit rahega, jiska zikr aage a raha hai) to uske har qadam ke badle mein use ek shreni ooncha kar diya jaata hai aur uska ek gunaah mita diya jaata hai. Waise, yahaan gunaah se aashay Allah ke haq se sanbandhit chhote gunaah hain. Phir jab woh namaz parhta hai, to farishte uske liye daya ki dua tatha kshama yaachna karte rahte hain. Yeh silsila us samay tak jaari rahta hai, jab tak woh namaz ke sthaan mein baitha rahta hai aur uska wuzu toot nahin jaata. Yeh bhi sanbhav hai ki yahaan kewal namaz ke sthaan mein hona muraad ho, chaahe leta hua hi kyon na ho. Tatha woh jab tak woh namaz ki prateeksha mein rahta hai, namaz hi mein hota hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3436: Umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas jab bhi yaman se sahayak sainyadal aate, to woh poochhte the ki kya tumhaare beech uwais bin aamir hain?

Usair bin amr tatha kuchh logon ke anusaar usair bin jaabir ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas jab bhi yaman se sahayak sainyadal aate, to woh poochhte the ki kya tumhaare beech uwais bin aamir hain? Yahaan tak ek sainyadal ke saath uwais bin aamir a gae. Chunaanche unse kahaah kya aap uwais bin aamir hain? Uttar diyaah haan! Farmayaah aap muraad qabeele ki qarn shaakha se hain? Kahaah haan! Farmayaah aapke shareer par safed daagh the, jo ek dirham ke baraabar sthaan ko chhorkar theek ho gae hain? Farmayaah haan! Farmayaah aapki maata jeewit hain? Kahaah haan! Farmayaah mainne Allah Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue suna haih "Tumhaare paas yaman se aane waale sahayak sainyadlon ke saath muraad qabeele ki qarn shaakha ka ek vyakti uwais bin aamir ayega. Uske shareer par safed daag rahe honge, jo ek dirham ke baraabar sthaan ko chhorkar theek ho gae honge. Uski maata jeewit hogi, jiske saath woh achchha vyavhaar kar raha hoga. Agar woh Allah par qasam kha le, to Allah uski qasam ko poora karega. Agar yeh ho sake ki woh tumhaare liye kshama yaachna kare, to usse aisa karvaana." Atah, aap mere liye kshama yaachna karen. Chunaanche uwais bin aamir ne umar (radiyallahu anhu) ke liye kshama yaachna ki. Uske baad umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne unse kahaah aap kahaan jaana chaahte hain? Unhonne uttar diyaah koofa. Farmayaah kya main aapke liye koofa ke shaasak ke naam ek patr likh doon? Unhonne uttar diyaah mujhe ghareeb tatha gumnaam logon ke beech rahna adhik pasand hai. Jab agle saal koofa ke sammaanit logon mein se ek vyakti Hajj ke liye aya, to umar (radiyallahu anhu) se uski mulaaqaat ho gai. Umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne usse uwais ke baare mein poochha, to usne batayaah mainne unhen is haal mein chhora hai ki unka jeewan bahut saada hai aur woh saamaan bhi bahut kam rakhte hain. To farmayaah mainne Allah Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue suna haih "Tumhaare paas yaman se aane waale sahayak sainyadlon ke saath muraad qabeele ki qarn shaakha ka ek vyakti uwais bin aamir ayega. Uske shareer par safed daag rahe honge, jo ek dirham ke baraabar sthaan ko chhorkar theek ho gae honge. Uski maata jeewit hogi, jiske saath woh achchha vyavhaar kar raha hoga. Agar woh Allah par qasam kha le, to Allah uski qasam ko poora karega. Agar yeh ho sake ki woh tumhaare liye kshama yaachna kare, to usse aisa karvaana." Chunaanche yeh yamni vyakti Hajj ke baad uwais ke paas gaya aur unse kaha ki mere liye kshama yaachna keejiye. Parantu, unhonne uttar diyaah tum ek mubaarak safar se nae-nae aye ho, isliye khud tum mere liye kshama yaachna karo. Phir (maamle ko bhaanpte hue) kahaah kya tumko umar (radiyallahu anhu) mile the? Usne kahaah haan! To phir uske liye kshama yaachna ki. Isse log unhen pahchaan gae aur woh wahaan se kaheen chal diye.
Usair bin jaabir hi ki ek riwayat mein hai ki koofa ke logon ka ek pratinidhi mandal umar (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas aya. Unke andar ek vyakti aisa bhi tha, jo uwais ka uphaas karne waalon mein shaamil tha. Chunaanche umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne kahaah kya yahaan qarn qabeele ka koi vyakti hai? To wahi vyakti aya. Chunaanche, umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne kahaah Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmaya haih "Tumhaare paas ek yamni vyakti ayega, jise uwais kaha jayega. Woh yaman mein kewal apni maan ko chhorkar aya hoga. Uske shareer par saphed daag rahe honge, lekin Allah se dua karne ke kaaran ek deenaar ya dirham ke baraabar sthaan ko chhorkar theek ho gae honge. Tummen se jo usse mile, woh usse tumhaare liye kshama yaachna zaroor karvaye."
Tatha unheen ki ek riwayat mein haih "Umar (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue suna haih "Sabse uttam taabei ek vyakti hai, jo uwais kaha jayega. Uski maan jeewit hogi aur uske shareer par safed daag honge. Usse kahna ki woh tumhaare liye kshama yaachna kare."
3437: Jisne Allah ke raaste mein yuddh karne waale kisi vyakti ko yuddh ke saamaan dekar taiyaar kiya, usne yuddh kiya aur jisne kisi yuddh par gae hue vyakti ke ghar waalon ki achchhi tarah dekh-rekh ki, usne yuddh kiya.

Zaid bin khaalid juhni radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jisne Allah ke raaste mein yuddh karne waale kisi vyakti ko yuddh ke saamaan dekar taiyaar kiya, usne yuddh kiya aur jisne kisi yuddh par gae hue vyakti ke ghar waalon ki achchhi tarah dekh-rekh ki, usne yuddh kiya."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki jisne Allah ki raah mein lar rahe yoddha ke liye yuddh ka aawashyak saadhnon, jaise hathiyaar, sawaari evn rasad aadi ka prabandh kiya, woh yoddha ke samaan hai aur use bhi yuddh karne ka sawaab milega.

Isi tarah jisne yoddha ki anupasthiti mein uske ghar waalon ki behtar andaaz mein dekhbhaal ki, woh bhi yoddha ke samaan hai.

Neki ke kaaryon mein ek-doosre ki madad karne ki prerna.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Yahaan is baat ki prerna di gai hai ki Muslim hit mein kaam karne waale ya musalmaanon ke kisi mishan mein lage hue vyakti ka upkaar kiya jaye.
Ek saamaany siddhaant yeh hai ki; jo vyakti kisi neki ke kaam mein kisi ki madad karta hai, use bhi us neki ko karne waale ke baraabar sawaab milta hai. Saath hi isse kaam karne waale vyakti ke sawaab mein katauti nahin hoti.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3438: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ansaar ke baare mein farmaya : "Unse wahi prem karega, jo momin hoga aur unse wahi dvesh rakhega, jo munaafiq hoga. Jo unse prem karega, Allah usse prem karega aur jo unse dvesh rakhega, Allah usse dvesh rakhega.

Bara radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ansaar ke baare mein farmaya : "Unse wahi prem karega, jo momin hoga aur unse wahi dvesh rakhega, jo munaafiq hoga. Jo unse prem karega, Allah usse prem karega aur jo unse dvesh rakhega, Allah usse dvesh rakhega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki madeene mein rahne waale ansaar logon se prem karna eemaan ki sanpoornata ki nishaani hai. Aisa isliye ki ansaari Islam aur Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke sahyog mein aage rahe hain, musalmaanon ko sharan di hai aur Allah ke maarg mein apna dhan evn jaan kharch kiya hai. Isi tarah ansaar se dvesh rakhna nifaaq ki nishaani hai. Phir Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jo ansaar se mohabbat rakhega, Allah usse mohabbat rakhega aur jo ansaar se dvesh rakhega, Allah usse dvesh rakhega.

Is hadees mein ansaar ki ek bari fazeelat bayaan ki gai hai ki unse mohabbat nifaaq se bari hone aur momin hone ki nishaani hai.
Allah ke waliyon se mohabbat aur unke sahyog se Allah ki mohabbat praapt hoti hai.
Islam mein daakhil hone mein pahal karne waale logon ki fazeelat.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3439: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne khadeeja (radiyallahu anha) ko Jannat mein moti ke ek aise ghar ki shubh soochna di hai, jismen na koi shor hoga aur thakaan hogi.

Abdullah bin abu aufa (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne khadeeja (radiyallahu anha) ko Jannat mein moti ke ek aise ghar ki shubh soochna di hai, jismen na koi shor hoga aur thakaan hogi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3440: Nabi (sallaallahu alaihi wasallam) kisi nafal namaz ki utni paabandi nahin karte the, jitni fajr ki do rakaaton ki karte the.

Aaisha bint abu bakr siddeeq (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Nabi (sallaallahu alaihi wasallam) kisi nafal namaz ki utni paabandi nahin karte the, jitni fajr ki do rakaaton ki karte the.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih "Fajr ki do rakaat sunnaten duniya aur uski tamaam cheezon se uttam hain."

Is hadees mein fajr ki do rakaat sunnat ka mahatv aur uski taakeed ka ullekh hai. Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) warn karti hain ki Nabi (sallaallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne in do rakaaton ko apne kaary dvaara mahatv dete hue inhen paabandi se parha hai tatha apne munh se inke mahatv ka ullekh karte hue kaha hai ki yeh duniya tatha uski tamaam wastuon se behtar hain.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3441: Jamaat ke saath parhi gai namaz akele parhi gai namaz ke muqaable mein sattaaees darja shreshth hai.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jamaat ke saath parhi gai namaz akele parhi gai namaz ke muqaable mein sattaaees darja shreshth hai."

Yeh hadees jamaaat ke saath parhi gai namaz ke akele parhi gai namaz se uttam hone ka ullekh karte hue kahti hai ki jamaaat waali namaz (any mahatvapoorn faydon aur laabhon ke atirikt) akele ki namaz se sattaaees guna adhik sawaab rakhti hai. Kyonki donon namaazon ke beech uddeshy ki poorti ke maamle mein zameen aasmaan ka antar hai tatha is baat mein kisi sandeh ki gunjaaish nahin hai ki jisne is bare laabh ko nasht kar diya, wahi waastav mein wanchit vyakti hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3442: Jo kisi beemaar vyakti ka haal jaanne jaata hai ya apne kisi bhaai se Allah ke liye milne jaata hai, to ek pukaarne waala use yeh kahkar pukaarta hai ki tujhe mubaarak ho, tera chalkar jaana mubaarak ho aur tujhe Jannat mein thikaana naseeb ho.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jo kisi beemaar vyakti ka haal jaanne jaata hai ya apne kisi bhaai se Allah ke liye milne jaata hai, to ek pukaarne waala use yeh kahkar pukaarta hai ki tujhe mubaarak ho, tera chalkar jaana mubaarak ho aur tujhe Jannat mein thikaana naseeb ho."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3443: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) sawaar hokar evn paidal chalkar quba jaate aur wahaan do rakaat namaz parhte the.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) sawaar hokar evn paidal chalkar quba jaate aur wahaan do rakaat namaz parhte the.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) pratyek shaniwaar ko sawaar hokar evn paidal chalkar quba masjid jaate tatha abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) bhi aisa karte the.

Quba naami basti, jahaan Islam ki pahli masjid ka nirmaan hua tha, madeena ke nikat hi mein sthit ek basti hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- paidal tatha sawaari par use dekhne jaya karte the.
Warnankarta ke shabd "Har shaniwaar ko" Se pata chalta hai ki aapne dekhne jaane ke liye ek din nirdhaarit kar rakha tha. Har saptaah shaniwaar ke hi din Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke quba jaane ke peechhe hikmat yeh thi ki aapka ansaar se sanbandh sthaapit rahe aur unka haal-chaal jaan saken, wishesh roop se un logon ka, jo juma ke din aapke saath juma ki namaz parh nahin sake hain. Wishesh roop se shaniwaar ko jaane ke peechh yahi kaaran tha.
[ise donon riwayton ke saath Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3444: Unhen Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki tarah wazu karke dikhaya

Yahya bin umaara maazini se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Mainne amr bin abu hasan ko dekha ki unhonne abdullah bin zaid radiyallahu anhu se Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke wazu ke baare mein poochha, to unhonne ek bartan paani mangvaya aur unhen Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki tarah wazu karke dikhaya. Chunaanche sabse pahle donon hatheliyon par bartan se paani undela aur unhen teen baar dhoya. Phir bartan mein haath daalkar paani liya aur kulli ki, naak mein paani daala aur naak jhaara. Teen chullu paani se teen baar aisa kiya. Phir bartan mein haath daalkar paani liya aur teen baar apne chehre ko dhoya. Phir bartan mein haath daalkar paani liya aur apne donon haathon ko kohniyon samet do baar dhoya. Phir bartan mein haath daalkar paani liya aur apne sar ka masah kiya; pahle donon haathon ko aage se peechhe le gae, phir peechhe se aage le aye. Aisa ek hi baar kiya. Phir apne donon pairon ko takhnon samet dhoya.

Yahaan abdullah bin zaid radiyallahu anhu ne vyavhaarik roop se Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke wazu ka tareeqa bayaan kiya hai. Atah unhonne paani ka ek chhota-sa bartan mangvaya. Sabse pahle apni donon hatheliyon ko dhoya. Woh is tarah ki bartan ko jhuka kar donon hatheliyon par paani daala aur unko teen baar bartan se baahar dhoya. Phir apna haath bartan mein daalkar teen chullu paani liya aur har chullu se kulli ki, naak mein paani charhaya aur naak jhaari. Phir bartan se teen chullu paani lekar teen baar apne chehre ko dhoya, phir usse paani lekar apne haathon ko kohniyo samet do-do baar dhoya. Phir bartan mein haath daala aur donon haathon se apne sar ka masah (sparsh) kiya. Masah karne ka aaranbh apne sar ke agle bhaag se kiya aur haathon ko gardan ki oopri bhaag mein sthit guddi tak pahunchaya. Phir donon haathon ko waapas waheen le aye, jahaan se aaranbh kiya tha. Phir donon pairon ko takhnon samet dhoya.

Shikshak ka vyavhaar baat ko samjhaane aur zehan mein utaarne ka sabse upyukt saadhan hai. Ismen kaary karke sikhaana bhi shaamil hai.
Wazu ke kuchh angon ko teen-teen baar aur kuchh ko do-do baar dhona jayaz hai. Waise aniwaary ek-ek baar dhona hai.
Wazu ke angon ke beech usi kram ka dhyaan rakhna zaroori hai, jiska ullekh is hadees mein hua hai.
Chehre ki seema lanbaai mein sar ke baal ugne ke saamaany sthaan se daarhi aur thuddi ke nichle bhaag tak aur chauraai mein ek kaan se doosre kaan tak hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3445: Jo bhi praani atyaachaarpoorn tareeqe se maara jaata hai, uske qatl ke gunaah ka ek bhaag aadam ke pahle bete ke hisse mein jaata hai. Kyonki useene sabse pahle naahaq katl ka tareeqa jaari kiya.

Abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) riwayat karte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jo bhi praani atyaachaarpoorn tareeqe se maara jaata hai, uske qatl ke gunaah ka ek bhaag aadam ke pahle bete ke hisse mein jaata hai. Kyonki useene sabse pahle naahaq katl ka tareeqa jaari kiya."

Yeh hadees bata rahi hai ki kyon aadam ke ek bete ko, uske baad bahaye jaane waale har rakt ke gunaah ka ek bhaag uthaana parta hai? Kaha jaata hai ki qaabeel ne apne bhaai haabeel ka dveshpoorn tareeqe se wadh kar diya tha aur wahi donon bhaai aadam ki santaan ke pahle hatyaare aur pahle hatya ki bhent charhne waale the. Choonki qaabeel ne hi kisi ki jaan lene ki pratha ki shurooaat ki thi, isliye woh apne baad bahaye jaane waale har rakt ke gunaah ke ek bhaag ka bhaageedaar hoga. Kyonki uske baad rakt bahaane waala har vyakti usi ka anusran kar raha hota hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3446: Kya tum nahin jaante ki islaam pahle ke gunaahon ko khatm kar deta hai, hijrat pahle ke gunaahon ko khatm kar deti hai aur Hajj pahle ke gunaahon ko khatm kar deta hai?

Bin shumaasa mahri kahte hain ki ham log amr bin aas (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas us samay pahunche, jab woh mrityushayya par the. Woh der tak rote rahe aur apna chehra deewaar ki or pher liya. Yeh dekh unka beta kahne lagaah ai mere pita jaan, kya Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne aapko yeh khushkhabri nahin di thi? Kya Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne aapko yeh khushkhabri nahin di thi? To unhonne apna chehra uski or phera aur farmayaah ham apne jis amal ko sarvashreshth maante hain, woh is baat ki gawaahi dena hai ki Allah ke siwa koi poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) Allah ke Rasool hain. Daraasal, main ab tak teen paristhitiyon se guzra hoon; mainne khud ko us paristhiti mein bhi dekha hai, jab mere nikat koi Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se adhik ghrinit nahin tha. Us samay mere nikat sabse priy baat yeh thi ki main aappar qaabu pa loon aur aapka wadh kar doon. Agar main us paristhiti mein mar gaya hota, to Jahannam mein hota. Phir jab Allah ne mere dil mein islaam ko daal diya, to main Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya aur kahaah aap apna daahina haath barhayen, taaki main aapki baiat karoon. Chunaanche aapne apna daahina haath barhaya, to mainne apna haath kheench liya. Aapne farmayaah "Tumne aisa kyon kiya ai amr?" Mainne kahaah main ek shart rakhna chaahta hoon. Farmayaah "Tum kaun-si shart rakhna chaahte ho?" Mainne kahaah yeh ki mujhe kshama kar diya jaye. Farmayaah "Kya tum nahin jaante ki islaam pahle ke gunaahon ko khatm kar deta hai, hijrat pahle ke gunaahon ko khatm kar deti hai aur Hajj pahle ke gunaahon ko khatm kar deta hai?" Us samay mere nikat na koi Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se priy tha aur na meri aankhon mein koi aapse adhik sammaanit tha. Aapke prataap tatha sammaan ke kaaran main kabhi aapko aankh bharkar dekh bhi nahin sakta tha. Yadi mujhe aapka huliya bayaan karne ko kaha jaye, to main bayaan nahin kar sakta. Isliye ki mainne kabhi aapko aankh bharkar dekha hi nahin. Yadi meri mrityu usi haal mein ho gai hoti, to aasha karta hoon ki main Jannat mein prawesh kar jaata. Phir hamne kuchh zimmewaariyaan sanbhaaleen. Main nahin jaanta ki un maamlon mein mera kya haal raha. Dekho, jab main mar jaaoon, to mere saath na koi nauha-maatam karne waali stri jaye aur na aag. Phir jab mujhe dafan kar do, to mujhpar thori-thori karke mitti daalna aur meri qabr ke aas-paas utni der rukna, jitni der mein ek oont zabah karke uske maans ko baanta jaaske, taaki main tumse ghula-mila rahoon aur dekhoon ki apne rab ke bheje hue farishton ko kya uttar deta hoon.

Susmaachaar tatha badhaai dene ke wishay par aadhaarit amr bin aas -radiyallahu anhu- ki is hadees se ek kahaani juri hui hai. Is mahatvapoorn kahaani ka saar yeh hai ki amr -radiyallahu anhu- mrityushaiya par the aur duniya chhor jaane hi waale the ki unke paas unke kuchh saathi aye, to woh bahut zyaada rone lage aur apna munh deewaar ki or kar liya. Yeh dekh unke bete ne unse kaha : Aakhir aap ro kyon rahe hain, jabki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne aapko Jannat ka susmaachaar sunaya hai? Unhonne uttar diya : Ai mere bete! Main ab tak teen paristhitiyon se guzar chuka hoon. Phir teenon paristhitiyon ko bayaan karte hue kaha ki pahle woh Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se bahut zyaada nafrat karte the. Unko dharti ke oopar rahne waale kisi vyakti se utni nafrat nahin thi, jitni aapse thi. Unki chaahat to yeh thi ki yadi bas chalta, to aapka wadh kar dete. Yeh sabse parle darje ka kufr tha. Yahaan tak ki yeh paristhiti badli aur Allah ne unke dil mein Islam ko daal diya. Phir woh Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aye aur kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Aap apna haath barhaaiye, main Islam par aapse baiat karna chaahta hoon. Choonki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- sarvottam charitr ke maalak the, isliye apna haath barha diya. Lekin amr bin aas -radiyallahu anhu- ne apna haath kheench liya. Unhonne aisa abhimaan ke taur par nahin, balki apni aashankaaon ko door karne ke liye kiya tha. Chunaanche aapne unse poochha ki unhonne aisa kyon kiya, to uttar diya ki main ek shart ke saath musalmaan hona chaahta hoon. Aapne poochha ki tumhaari shart kiya hai, to unhonne jawaab diya ki Allah mere ab tak ke awishvaas evn gunaahon ko maaf kar de. Unki sabse bari chinta yahi thi ki unke gunaah maaf ho jayen, kyonki unhen lagta tha ki unhonne itne bare-bare paap kiye hain ki Allah unhen maaf nahin karega. Atah Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unse farmaya : "Kya tum nahin jaante ki Islam pahle ke gunaahon ko khatm kar deta hai, hijrat pahle ke gunaahon ko khatm kar deti hai aur Hajj pahle ke gunaahon ko khatm kar deta hai?" Is tarah aapne teen baaton ka zikr kiya.
Islam pahle ke gunaahon ko nasht kar deta hai, iska ullekh khud pawitr Qur'an mein bhi hua hai. Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne farmaya : "(He Nabi!) in kaafiron se kah do ki yadi we ruk gae, to jo kuchh ho gaya hai, woh unse kshama kar diya jayega aur yadi pahle jaisa hi karenge, to agli jaatiyon ki durgat ho chuki hai."
Isi tarah jab koi vyakti apna nagar, jahaan woh rah raha tha aur jo kufr ka nagar tha, tyaag kar nikal jaata hai, to uske pahle ke gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain.
Isi prakaar Hajj bhi pahle ke gunaahon ko nasht kar deta hai. Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek any hadees mein farmaya hai : "Jisne Hajj kiya aur is dauraan koi gandi baat ya gunaah ka kaam nahin kiya, woh us din ki tarah gunaahon se pawitr hokar lautega, jis din uski maan ne use janm diya hai."
Iske baad unhonne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke haath par baiat ki aur aapse itna adhik prem kiya ki aap unke yahaan duniya ke sabse priy vyakti ban gae aur unke dil mein aapka itna sammaan paida ho gaya ki woh kabhi aapko aankh bhar kar dekh nahin sake. Woh paak prabhu kitna mahaan hai, jo dilon ko pherta hai. Kal tak woh Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se ashesh nafrat karte the aur avsar milne par aapka wadh karne tak ki ichchha rakhte the aur aaj dil mein aapka itna sammaan uthaye phirte hain ki aapko aankh bhar kar dekh bhi nahin sakte aur baad mein aapka huliya isliye bayaan nahin kar paate the ki aapke prabhaav ke kaaran woh aapko theek se dekh nahin sake the.
Unka kahna hai ki yadi woh pahli awastha mein mar jaate, to jahannami hote. Jabki agar doosri awastha mein marte, to unhen aasha hai ki unhen Jannat mil jaati. Unki saavdhaani dekhiye. Woh wishvaas ke saath kahte hain ki yadi pahli awastha mein mar jaate, to jahannami hote, lekin doosri awastha ke baare mein aisa nahin kahte. Yahaan woh bhay mahsoos karte hain aur kahte hain ki aasha karta hoon ki Jannat mil jaati. Kyonki Jannat ke baare mein wishvaas ke saath kuchh kahna bahut mushkil hai.
Phir uske baad unke jeewan mein teesri paristhiti aai. Woh kai kshetron ke ameer tatha kai yuddhon ke sena nayak bane. Muaawiya -radiyallahu anhu-wagaira waali yuddh ke dauraan kai ghatnayen ghateen. Phir, woh arab ke ek chatur vyakti ke roop mein bhi prasiddh the. Woh kahte hain ki beech ki awastha ke baad jo ghatnayen ghateen, unhen dekhte hue dar lagta hai ki kaheen unke kaaran mere saare achchhe kaary daanv par na lag jayen.
Phir unhonne waseeyat ki ki jab woh mar jayen, to unke saath koi nauha-maatam karne waali na jaye. Uske baad aadesh diya ki jab unko dafan kar diya jaye, to we unki qabr ke paas ek oont zabah kar uska maans baantne ke baraabar samay tak ruke rahen. Taaki woh itni der mein un farishton ka uttar de len, jo murde ko dafan kar diye jaane ke baad uske paas aate hain. Kyonki murde ko dafan kar diye jaane ke baad uske paas do farishte aate hain aur use uski qabr mein bithaane ke baad usse teen prashn karte hain. Usse poochhte hain ki tera rab kaun hai, tera dharm kya hai aur tera Nabi kaun hai?
Yahaan amr bin aas -radiyallahu anhu- ne apne pariwaar ke logon ko aadesh diya ki unko dafan karne ke baad unki qabr ke paas ek oont zabah karke uska maans baantne ke baraabar samay tak ruke rahen, taaki woh unse itni der ghule-mile rahen. Isse maaloom hota hai ki mara hua vyakti apne pariwaar ki upasthiti ko mahsoos karta hai. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki ek any hadees mein aya hai ki mara hua vyakti dafne ke baad lautne waale logon ke jooton ki chaap sunta hai.
Ek hasan hadees se saabit hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab mare hue vyakti ko dafan kar dete, to uski qabr ke paas khare ho jaate aur kahte : "Apne bhaai ke liye kshamayaachna karo aur sudrirh rahne ki dua karo, kyonki is samay usse prashn ho rahe hain." Atah musathab yeh hai ki murde ko dafan karne ke baad aadmi uski qabr ke paas khara ho jaye aur kahe : "Ai Allah! Ise sudrirh rakh, ai Allah! Ise sudrirh rakh, ai Allah! Ise sudrirh rakh, ai Allah! Ise kshama kar de, ai Allah! Ise kshama kar de, ai Allah! Ise kshama kar de." Kyonki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab salaam karte, to teen baar salaam karte the aur jab dua karte, to teen baar dua karte the.
Saaraansh yeh ki amr bin aas -radiyallahu anhu- ke bete ne unse kaha ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne aapko Jannat ka susmaachaar sunaya hai, jo achchhi baat ki khushkhabri dene aur mubaarakbaad pesh karne ke dayre mein aata hai.
3447: Allah par bharosa rakhne ke aniwaary hone tatha is baat ka ullekh ki Allah apne nabiyon tatha auliya ka khaas khayaal rakhta hai.

Abu bakar siddeeq (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki jab ham ghaar mein the aur mushrik hamen dhoondhte hue hamaare sar ke oopar pahunch chuke the, to mainne unke paanv dekh liye. Aise mein, mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, agar unmen se kisi ne apne paanv ke neeche nazar daali, to hamen dekh lega. Yeh sun aapne farmayaah "Ai abu bakr, un do logon ke baare mein tumhaara kya khayaal hai, jinka teesra Allah hai?"
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3448: Lekin main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke bhed ko saamne laana nahin chaahta tha. Yadi Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) use chhor dete, to main sveekaar kar leta.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ki jab umar (radiyallahu anhu) ki beti hafsa widhva ho gai, to umar (radiyallahu anhu) ka kahna hai ki mainne usmaan bin affaan (radiyallahu anhu) se bhent karke hafsa ka paighaam diya aur kahaah yadi, aap chaahen, to main aapki shaadi apni beti hafsa se kar doon? Lekin unhonne kahaah main is maamle sochoonga. Kuchh dinon ke pashchaat woh mujhse mile aur kahaah mera iraada hai ki in dinon shaadi na ki jaye. Phir mainne abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) se bhent ki aur kahaah yadi aap chaahen, to main aapki shaadi apni beti hafsa se kar doon? Lekin abu bakr chup rahe aur koi uttar nahin diya. Mujhe unpar usmaan se bhi adhik ghussa aya. Kuchh hi dinon baad Nabi (salllahu alaihi wa sallam) ne use nikaah ka paigaam bheja, to mainne aapse uski shaadi kar di. Phir mujhe abu bakr mile aur kaha ki shayad tum mujhpar us samay naaraaz hue the, jab tumne mujhse hafsa se shaadi karne ki baat kahi thi aur mainne koi uttar nahin diya tha? Mainne kahaah haan. Unhonne kahaah mujhe kewal ek hi baat ne uttar dene se roka tha, woh yeh thi ki mujhe pata tha ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne uska zikr kiya hai. Lekin main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke bhed ko saamne laana nahin chaahta tha. Yadi Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) use chhor dete, to main sveekaar kar leta.
3449: Kya baat hai ki maahvaari waali stri chhoote hue roze baad mein rakh leti hai, lekin chhooti hui namaazen baad mein nahin parhti? Unhonne kahaah kya tu harooriya hai? Mainne kahaah nahin, main harooriya to nahin hoon, lekin poochhna chaahti hoon. Tab unhonne kahaah hamen is sthiti se guzarna parta, to hamen chhoote hue rozon ko baad rakh lene ka aadesh diya jaata, lekin chhooti hui namaazon ko baad mein parhne ka aadesh nahin diya jaata tha.

Muaaza kahti hain ki mainne aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se poochhaah kya baat hai ki maahvaari waali stri chhoote hue roze baad mein rakh leti hai, lekin chhooti hui namaazen baad mein nahin parhti? Unhonne kahaah kya tu harooriya hai? Mainne kahaah nahin, main harooriya to nahin hoon, lekin poochhna chaahti hoon. Tab unhonne kahaah hamen is sthiti se guzarna parta, to hamen chhoote hue rozon ko baad rakh lene ka aadesh diya jaata, lekin chhooti hui namaazon ko baad mein parhne ka aadesh nahin diya jaata tha.

Muaaza ne aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se poochha ki aakhir kya kaaran hai ki Allah ne maasik dharm ke dinon mein chhoote hue rozon ko baad mein rakh lene aadesh diya hai, lekin is avdhi mein chhooti hui namaazon ko baad mein parhne ka aadesh nahin diya, jabki donon farz ibaadten hain, balki namaz roze ki tulna mein adhik bari ibaadat hai? Choonki donon ke beech antar na karne ka kathinta par aadhaarit nirnay khvaarij ka hai, isliye aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne unse kaha ki kya tum haroori arthaat khaariji ho ki unheen jaisi aastha rakhti ho aur unheen jaisi ugrata dikha rahi ho? Unhonne kahaah main haroori nahin hoon, main kewal jaanne aur maargadarshan praapt karne ke liye poochh rahi hoon. Yeh sun, aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne kahaah Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke zamaane mein ham maahvaari ke dinon se guzarte, to roza aur namaz donon chhor dete, phir aap hamen baad mein roza rakh lene ka aadesh dete, lekin namaz parhne ka aadesh nahin dete. Agar aisa karna zaroori hota, to aap hamen zaroor aadesh dete aur khaamosh nahin rahte. Ek tarah se woh kahna chaahti theen ki hikmat aur hidayat ki baat yahi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke aadeshon ka paalan kiya jaye aur aapki or se nirdhaarit seemaaon ko paar na kiya jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3450: Ai Allah ke Rasool, aisa lag raha tha ki main asr ki namaz nahin parha sakoonga, yahaan tak sooraj doobne laga, to Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah Allah ki qasmah mainne to abhi tak asr ki namaz nahin parhi hai. Warnankarta kahte hain ki phir ham log buthaan ki or nikle, aapne namaz ke wazu kiya, hamne bhi wazu kiya, phir sooraj doobne ke baad asr ki namaz parhi aur uske baad maghrib ki namaz parhi.

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki khandaq ke din sooraj doobne ke baad umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) aye aur quraish ke kaafiron ko bura-bhala kahne lage tatha kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, aisa lag raha tha ki main asr ki namaz nahin parha sakoonga, yahaan tak sooraj doobne laga, to Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah Allah ki qasmah mainne to abhi tak asr ki namaz nahin parhi hai. Warnankarta kahte hain ki phir ham log buthaan ki or nikle, aapne namaz ke wazu kiya, hamne bhi wazu kiya, phir sooraj doobne ke baad asr ki namaz parhi aur uske baad maghrib ki namaz parhi.

Umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) khandaq ki din Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas sooraj doobne ke baad quraish ke kaafiron ko bura-bhala kahte hue aye, kyonki unhonne unko asr ki namaz parhne ka koi avsar nahin diya tha aur woh sooraj doobne ke nikat ho jaane tak asr ki namaz nahin parh sake the. Unki baat sun, Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne qasam khaakar farmaya ki mainne bhi abhi tak asr ki namaz nahin parhi hai, taaki umar (radiyallahu anhu) ko kuchh tasalli mil jaye, jinhen namaz parhne mein der hone se bari takleef hui thi.
Phir Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne uthkar wuzu kiya aur saare sahaaba ne bhi aapke saath wuzu kiya aur sooraj doobne ke baad asr ki namaz parhi aur uske baad maghrib ki namaz parhi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3455: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne sar par teen baar paani daalte the.

Abu jaafar Muhammad bin ali bin husain bin ali bin abu taalib kahte hain ki woh aur unke pita jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas the. Us samay unke paas kuchh aur log bhi the. Chunaanche un logon ne unse snaan ke baare mein poochha, to unhonne bataya ki tumhaare liye ek sa (ek maap jo lagbhag dhaai kilo ka hota hai) kaafi hai. Yeh sun ek vyakti ne kahaah lekin mere liye kaafi nahin hai. Ispar jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) ne kahaah parantu, unke liye kaafi tha, jo tujhse adhik baal waale aur tujhse adhik uttam the. (Unka ishaara Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki or tha) phir unhonne ek hi kapra pahankar hamen namaz parhaai.
Tatha ek riwayat mein hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne sar par teen baar paani daalte the.

Abu jaafar Muhammad bin ali aur unke pita mahaan sahaabi jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) ke paas the. Unke yahaan kuchh aur log bhi maujood the. Isi beech ek vyakti ne jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) se poochha ki janaabat se snaan ke liye kitna paani kaafi hai? Unhonne kahaah tere liye ek saa kaafi hai.
Us samay jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas any logon ke saath hasan bin Muhammad bin hanfiya bhi baithe the. Unhonne kahaah itna-sa paani janaabat ke snaan mein mere liye paryaapt nahin hai.
Yeh sun jaabir ne kahaah parantu, unke liye kaafi tha, jo tujhse adhik tatha ghane baal waale the aur tujhse uttam bhi the, atah unhen tumse adhik svachchhata tatha Islam ke anupaalan ka khayaal tha. (Unki muraad Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se thi.) yeh daraasal, sunnat ke anusran aur wuzu ke samay aawashyakta se adhik paani na bahaane ki or prerit karne ka ek tareeka tha. Phir, jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) ne imaam bankar unhen namaz parhaai.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3456: Main Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas us samay pahuncha, jab aap ek taaza misvaak se daant saaf kar rahe the. Woh kahte hainh misvaak ka ek kinaara aapki zubaan par tha aur aap use munh mein lekar o, o kar rahe the. Aisa prateet ho raha tha, jaise aap ulti kar rahe hon.

Abu moosa ashaari (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki main Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas us samay pahuncha, jab aap ek taaza misvaak se daant saaf kar rahe the. Woh kahte hainh misvaak ka ek kinaara aapki zubaan par tha aur aap use munh mein lekar o, o kar rahe the. Aisa prateet ho raha tha, jaise aap ulti kar rahe hon.

Abu moosa ashaari kahte hain ki woh Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aye, to dekha ki aap taaza misvaak se daant saaf kar rahe hain, kyonki isse safaai adhik hoti hai. Woh munh ke bheetar tootti bhi nahin hai ki kisi prakaar ka kasht ho. Aap misvaak ko jeebh par rakhkar is tarah misvaak karne mein atyukti kar rahe the ki lag raha tha ki jaise ulti kar rahe hon.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3461: Tumhaare liye kaafi tha ki tum apne haathon se is tarah kar lete." Phir aapne apne donon haathon ko zameen par ek baar maara, uske baad bayen haath ko dayen haath par phera tatha donon hatheliyon ke baahri bhaag evn chehre ka masah kiya.

Ammaar bin yaasir radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne mujhe kisi kaam se bheja, to main junbi ho gaya aur paani na mil saka, isliye main zameen par lotne laga, jis tarah jaanvar lotta hai. Phir main Allah ke Nabi llallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya aur yeh kahaani bataai, to farmaya : "Tumhaare liye kaafi tha ki tum apne haathon se is tarah kar lete." Phir aapne apne donon haathon ko zameen par ek baar maara, uske baad bayen haath ko dayen haath par phera tatha donon hatheliyon ke baahri bhaag evn chehre ka masah kiya.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ammaar bin yaasir radiyallahu anhu ko kisi kaam se ek yaatra mein bheja. Yaatra ke dauraan unpar sanbhog ya phir kaamveg ke saath weery skhalan hone ke kaaran snaan karna aniwaary ho gaya. To unhen snaan ke liye paani na mil saka. Us samay unko maaloom bhi nahin tha ki is tarah ki paristhiti mein tayammum kiya ja sakta hai. Unko bas itna pata tha ki tayammum ki anumti chhoti naapaaki ke baad hai. Atah ijtihaad se kaam liya. Samjha ki jis tarah chhoti naapaaki se paaki praapt karne ke liye wazu ke kuchh angon ka mitti se masah kiya jaata hai,  atah paani par kayaas karat hue, bari naapaaki ke tayammum ke liye poore shareer par mitti lagaana zaroori hoga. Atah mitti mein lot-pot gae, poore shareer mein mitti laga li aur uske baad namaz parhi. Baad mein jab Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas pahunche, to yeh jaanne ke liye ki unhonne jo kiya tha, woh sahi thi ya nahin, Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saamne is ghatna ka ullekh kiya. Tab Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unko chhoti aur bari donon naapaakiyon se (mitti ke dvaara) paaki haasil karne ka tareeqa bata diya. Tareeqa yeh hai ki donon haathon ko ek baar zameen par maara jaye aur uske baad apne bayen haath se dayen haath, donon hatheliyon ke oopri bhaag aur chehre ka masah kiya jaye.

Tayammum se pahle paani talaash kar lena aniwaary hai.
Junbi (sanbhog athva svapnadosh ke kaaran apvitr hone waale) vyakti ko paani na mile, to tayammum kar sakta hai.
Bari naapaaki aur chhoti naapaaki donon ka tayammum ek jaisa hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3462: Jab uhud yuddh ka samay a gaya, to mere pita ne mujhe bulaakar kahaah mujhe lagta hai ki main Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke un saathiyon ke saath qatl kar diya jaaoonga, jo shooru mein hi shaheed honge.

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki jab uhud yuddh ka samay a gaya, to mere pita ne mujhe bulaakar kahaah mujhe lagta hai ki main Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke un saathiyon ke saath qatl kar diya jaaoonga, jo shooru mein hi shaheed honge. Main apne baad Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke siwa kisi aise vyakti ko chhorkar nahin ja raha hoon, jo mujhe tumse adhik priy ho. Dekho, mujhpar kuchh qarz hai, tum use utaar dena tatha apni bahnon ke saath achchhe vyavhaar ki waseeyat ko qabool karna. (Jaabir kahte hain ki) hamne subah ki, to sabse pahle wahi shaheed hue aur mainne unke saath ek aur vyakti ko ek hi qabr mein dafan kar diya. Phir mere dil ko is baat par santushti nahin mili ki main unhen kisi aur ke saath rahne doon. Atah, chhah maheene baad mainne unhen nikaala, to dekha ki kaan ke siwa unka poora shareer waisa hi tha, jaisa mainne unhen dafan karte samay rakha tha. Phir mainne unhen alag qabr mein dafan kar diya.
3463: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab koi baat kahte, to teen baar kahte, taaki aapki baat ko theek se samajh liya jaye aur jab kisi samooh ke paas jaate aur unhen salaam karte, to teen baar salaam karte.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab koi baat kahte, to teen baar kahte, taaki aapki baat ko theek se samajh liya jaye aur jab kisi samooh ke paas jaate aur unhen salaam karte, to teen baar salaam karte.
3464: Mainne abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) ko dekha ki woh ek vyakti ke paas se guzre, jo apni oontni ko bithaakar zabah kar raha tha, to farmayaah use khara karke (tatha uski baaeen taang ko) baandhkar zabah karo. Yahi Muhammad( sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki sunnat hai.

Ziyaad bin jubair kahte hain ki mainne abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) ko dekha ki woh ek vyakti ke paas se guzre, jo apni oontni ko bithaakar zabah kar raha tha, to farmayaah use khara karke (tatha uski baaeen taang ko) baandhkar zabah karo. Yahi Muhammad( sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki sunnat hai.

Gay tatha bakri ityaadi ko zabah karne ka sunnat tareeqa yeh hai ki unhen bayen pahlu ke bal, qibla ki or munh karke litaakar unke gale ko kaata jaye. Jabki oont ko zabah karne ka sunnat tareeqa yeh hai ki use khare karke, agle bayen paanv ko baandhkar, uske seene mein chhuri daali jaye. Kyonki isse jaldi jaan nikalne ke kaaran kasht kam hota hai. Isi kaaran jab abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) ek vyakti ke paas se guzre, jo ek oont ko litaakar zabah karna chaahta tha, to farmaya ki ise khara karke agli baaeen taang ko baandhkar zabah karo. Yahi Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka tareeqa hai, jiska ullekh Qur'an ki is aat mein haih "فإذا وجبت جنوبها" (Arthaat, phir jab unke pahlu gir jayen). Kyonki girne ki baat usi samay ayegi, jab khara ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3466: Do sahaabi Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas se andheri raat mein nikle, to unke saath aage-aage do chiraag jaise chalne lage.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki do sahaabi Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas se andheri raat mein nikle, to unke saath aage-aage do chiraag jaise chalne lage. Phir jab donon alag ho gae, to donon mein se har ek ke saath ek-ek roshni chalti rahi, yahaan tak ki har ek apna ghar pahunch gaya.
3467: Ai aboozar, tum ek durbal vyakti ho aur yeh pad ek amaanat hai aur yeh qayaamat ke din apmaan tatha sharmindgi ka saamaan bhi hai. Yeh aur baat hai ki koi use uske haq ke saath praapt kare aur uske baare mein uske oopar jo zimmewaariyaan aati hain, unhen ada kare.

Aboozar (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, kya aap mujhe koi prashaasnik pad nahin denge? To aapne apna haath mere kandhon par maarkar farmayaah "Ai aboozar, tum ek durbal vyakti ho aur yeh pad ek amaanat hai aur yeh qayaamat ke din apmaan tatha sharmindgi ka saamaan bhi hai. Yeh aur baat hai ki koi use uske haq ke saath praapt kare aur uske baare mein uske oopar jo zimmewaariyaan aati hain, unhen ada kare."
3468: Ai Allah, main logon ko do kamzoron ke haq ko nasht karne se daraata hoon; yateem tatha stri.

Abu shuraih khuwailid bin amr aur abu huraira (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Ai Allah, main logon ko do kamzoron ke haq ko nasht karne se daraata hoon; yateem tatha stri."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3469: Santulit raha karo aur seedhe chala karo. Jaan lo ki tummen se koi hargiz apne amal se mukti nahin pa sakta." Sahaaba ne kaha : Aap bhi nahin, ai Allah ke Rasool? To farmaya : "Main bhi nahin! Yeh aur baat hai ki Allah mujhe apni daya evn kripa mein dhaanp le.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Santulit raha karo aur seedhe chala karo. Jaan lo ki tummen se koi hargiz apne amal se mukti nahin pa sakta." Sahaaba ne kaha : Aap bhi nahin, ai Allah ke Rasool? To farmaya : "Main bhi nahin! Yeh aur baat hai ki Allah mujhe apni daya evn kripa mein dhaanp le."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne sahaaba ko is baat ki prerna di ki amal karte rahen, atishyokti evn kotaahi se bachte hue jahaan tak ho sake Allah se darte rahen aur Allah ke prati nishthaawaan hokar tatha Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki sunnat ka paalan karte hue amal karte rahen, unka amal grahan hoga aur unpar Allah ki daya utregi.

Uske baad Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki kewal tummen se kisi ka amal hi use mukti nahin dila sakta. Allah ki daya drishti bhi zaroori hai.

Sahaaba ne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapke aamaal bhi aapko mukti nahin dila sakte, jabki wo to bare moolyawaan hain?

Jawaab diya : Mere aamaal bhi nahin, jab tak Allah apne anugrah ki chaadar mujhpar na phaila de.

Navvi kahte hain : Har kaam durust tareeqe se karne ka prayaas karo. Agar aisa na kar sako, to usse nikat raha karo. "Al-sidaad" Shabd ka arth durust hai. Yaani beech ka raasta, jismen na atishyokti ho aur na kotaahi, atah na kotaahi karo na atishyokti.
Ibn-e-baaz kahte hain : Jis tarah achchhe kaam Jannat mein daakhil hone ka sabab hain, usi tarah bure kaam Jahannam mein daakhil hone ka sabab hain. Yeh hadees bataati hai ki Jannat mein daakhila kewal amal ke aadhaar par naseeb nahin ho sakta, balki Allah ki kshama aur uski daya zaroori hai. Log Jannat mein daakhil to apne karmon ki wajah se honge, lekin is daakhile ko Allah ki daya aur uski kshama aniwaary karegi.
Bande ko apne karm par abhimaan nahin karna chahiye, karm kitna hi bara kyon na ho. Kyonki Allah ka haq uske karm se kaheen barhkar hai. Isliye bande ke dil mein bhay evn aasha donon ka mishran hona chahiye.
Allah ka fazl (anugrah) aur uski rahmat (daya) uske bandon ke karmon se adhik wishaal hai.
Achchhe karm Jannat mein daakhil hone ka sabab hain aur Jannat mein prawesh paane ka saubhaagy kewal Allah ke anugrah evn daya se praapt hota hai.
Kirmaani kahte hain : Jab saare log Allah ki daya ki badaulat hi Jannat mein daakhila pa sakte hain, to Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka zikr wishesh roop se yeh bataane ke liye kiya gaya hai ki jab aapka Jannat mein daakhil hona yaqeeni hai aur iske baavjood aap Allah ki daya ke bina Jannat mein daakhil nahin ho sakte, to doosre log kis shumaar mein hain?
Navvi kahte hain : Allah ka kathan "Apne un karmon ke sabab Jannat mein daakhil ho jaao, jo tum duniya mein kiya karte the." [soora nahl : 32], ek aur kathan "Ye wo Jannat jiska tum waaris apne kiye hue karmon ke sabab  banaye gae ho." [soora zukhruf : 72] aur is prakaar ki any ayten jo yeh bataati hain ki karmon ki badaulat Jannat mein daakhila naseeb hoga, unke aur in hadeeson ke beech koi takraav nahin hai. Kyonki ayton ka arth bas itna hai ki Jannat mein daakhil karmon ke kaaran naseeb hoga. Lekin karm ka suyog, kewal Allah ki prasannata praapt karne ke liye kaam karne ka jazba aur unki qabooliyat Allah ke anugrah evn daya se naseeb hoti hai. Yahi in hadeeson ka uddeshy hai. Atah yeh sahi hai ki Jannat karm ke sabab milega, lekin yeh bhi sahi hai ki karm ka suyog Allah ki daya se praapt hota hai.
Ibn al-jauzi kahte hain : Isse chaar uttar nikalkar saamne aate hain : 1- karm ka suyog Allah ki daya se milta hai. Sachchaai yeh hai ki yadi Allah ki daya na ho, to na eemaan ki daulat naseeb ho aur na anukran ka saubhaagy. 2- daas ka arjit kiya hua laabh uske maalik ka hua karta hai. Aise mein maalik apne daas ko jo bhi inaam de, use uska anugrah hi kaha jayega. 3- kuchh hadeeson mein aya hai ki Jannat mein prawesh to Allah ki daya se milega, lekin shreniyon ka batvaara karmon ke aadhaar par hoga. 4- neki ke kaam karne mein thora-sa samay lagta hai, lekin usek nateeje mein milne waala sawaab khatm hone waala nahin hai. Isliye khatm ho jaane waale karm ke badle mein na khatm hone waala  inaam anugrah hi kahlayega. Badla nahin.
Raafei kahte hain : Kisi bhi vyakti ke liye uchit nahin hai ki mukti evn Jannat ki oonchi shreniyon ki praapti ke sanbandh mein apne karm par bharosa kare. Kyonki uske paas jo karm hain, woh Allah dvaara pradaan kiye gae suyog ke kaaran hain. Woh gunaahon se bhi surakshit raha hai, to use surakshit Allah ne rakha hai. Atah yeh sab kuchh Allah ke anugrah evn uski daya ka nateeja hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3470: Jab log kisi ko atyaachaar karte hue dekhen aur uska haath na pakren, to sanbhav hai ki Allah un tamaam logon par apna azaab utaar de.

Abu bakr siddeeq radiyallahu anhu farmaate hain : Ai logo, tum log yeh ayat parhte ho : "Ai eemaan waalo, tum apni fikr karo. Yadi tum supath par rahe, to kupath hone waale tumhen kshati nahin pahuncha sakte" (Al-maaida : 105) jabki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko farmaate hue suna hai : "Jab log kisi ko atyaachaar karte hue dekhen aur uska haath na pakren, to sanbhav hai ki Allah un tamaam logon par apna azaab utaar de."

Abu bakr siddeeq radiyallahu anhu bata rahe hain ki log is ayat ko parhte hain :

"Ai eemaan waalo, tum apni fikr karo. Yadi tum supath par rahe, to kupath hone waale tumhen kshati nahin pahuncha sakte." [soora al-maaida : 105]

Aur isse yeh samajhte hain ki insaan ki zimmewaari kewal apne sudhaar ka prayaas karna hai. Agar koi ghalat raaste par ja raha hai, to jaya kare. Isse uska kuchh nahin bigarne waala. Unpar achchhi baaton ka aadesh dene aur buri baaton se rokne ki zimmewaari nahin hai.

Unhonne bataya ki yeh soch ghalat hai. Unhonne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko farmaate hue suna hai : Log jab kisi atyaachaari ko atyaachaar karte hue dekhkar shakti hone ke baavjood na roken, to is baat ki sanbhaavna ban jaati hai ki Allah un sab par apni or se aam yaatna bhej de. Ghalat karne waale par bhi aur khaamosh rahne waale par bhi.

Shubhchintan, achchhe kaam ka aadesh dena aur buri baat se rokna har musalmaan ki zimmewaari hai.
Allah ke dand ka saamna atyaachaar karne waale atyaachaari ko bhi karna parega aur saamarthy hote hue uske wiruddh aawaaz na uthaane waale khaamosh tamaashaai ko bhi.
Aam logon ko Qur'an ke uddharan samjhaane ka kaam sahi tareeqe se hona chahiye.
Allah ki kitaab ko samajhne par khaas dhyaan dena chahiye, taaki aisa na ho ki insaan samjhe kuchh aur Allah ki muraad kuchh aur ho.
Koi vyakti bhalaai ka aadesh diye aur buraai se roke baghair Allah ke maarg par chalne waala insaan ban nahin sakta.
Is ayat ki sahi vyaakhya is prakaar hai : Apne aapko gunaahon se bachaye rakho. Jab tumne apne aapko gunaahon se bachaye rakha, to achchhe kaam ka aadesh dene aur buraai se rokne ka saamarthy na rakhne ki sthiti mein gunaah mein parkar gumraah hone waalon ki gumraahi tumhaare liye haanikaarak nahin hogi.
[ise abu daawood ne, tirmizi ne tatha nasai ne al-kubra mein isi prakaar ibn-e-maajah ne aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3473: Mainne umar (radiyallahu anhu) ko jab bhi kisi cheez ke baare mein 'main samajhta hoon ki yeh aisi hai' kahte suna, to woh waisi hi nikli.
Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki mainne umar (radiyallahu anhu) ko jab bhi kisi cheez ke baare mein 'main samajhta hoon ki yeh aisi hai' kahte suna, to woh waisi hi nikli.
3474: Tum kewal eemaan waale ke saath raho aur tumhaara khaana kewal sadaachaari vyakti khaye.
Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Tum kewal eemaan waale ke saath raho aur tumhaara khaana kewal sadaachaari vyakti khaye."
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
