3475: Jo mujhe donon daarhon ke beech tatha donon pairon ke beech (ke angon) ki gaaranti de de, main use Jannat ki gaaranti deta hoon.

Sahl bin saad radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jo mujhe donon daarhon ke beech tatha donon pairon ke beech (ke angon) ki gaaranti de de, main use Jannat ki gaaranti deta hoon."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne do baaten bataai hain, jinka khyaal rakhne waala Jannat mein prawesh karega.

1- zabaan ko aisi baaton se surakshit rakhna, jinse Allah naaraaz hota hai.

2- sharmagaah ko vyabhichaar se surakshit rakhna.

Kyonki shareer ke in donon angon se hi adhiktar gunaah hote hain.

Zabaan tatha sharmagaar ki raksha karna, Jannat mein prawesh dilaata hai.
Aapne wishesh roop se zabaan tatha sharmagaah ka ullekh isliye kiya hai, kyonki yeh donon ang duniya evn aakhirat ki aazmaaish ke sabse bare srot hain.
3476: Main tatha Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam junbi hote aur ek hi bartan se snaan kar lete the. Main maahvaari mein hoti aur aapke aadesh se langota baandh leti, phir aap mujhse mubaashirat karte.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Main tatha Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam junbi hote aur ek hi bartan se snaan kar lete the. Main maahvaari mein hoti aur aapke aadesh se langota baandh leti, phir aap mujhse mubaashirat karte. Isi tarah, aap aitikaaf mein hote aur apna sar meri or nikaal dete evn main use dho deti, jabki main maahvaari mein hoti thi.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath ki apni kuchh wishesh paristhitiyon ka ullekh kar rahi hain, ek yeh ki woh Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath janaabat (sanbhog athva svapnadosh ke kaaran apvitr hone ke baad) ka snaan kiya karteen to donon ek hi bartan se paani lekar snaan kiya karte the. Doosri yeh ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab unke saath unki maahvaari ki awastha mein apna shareer milaane ka iraada karte, to unko apne shareer par naabhi se ghutnon tak kapra lapet lene ka aadesh dete aur uske baad unke shareer se apna shareer milaate. Is dauraan aap sanbhog chhor sab kuchh karte the. Teesri yeh ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam masjid mein etikaaf kar rahe hote aur is dauraan apna sar aaisha radiyallahu anha ke ghar ki or nikaal dete tatha woh maahvaari ki awastha mein apne ghar se aapka sar dhoteen.

Pati-patni ka ek hi bartan se ek saath snaan karna jayaz hai.
Maahvaari ki awastha mein aurat ki sharmagaah ko chhor shesh shareer ke saath shareer milaana jayaz hai. Uska shareer paak hai.
Shareer se shareer milaate samay maahvaari waali stri ke liye sharmagaah par kapra baandh lena musathab hai.
Haraam kaary mein sanliptata se rokne ke saadhan ekhtiyaar karna.
Mahila maahvaari ki awastha mein masjid mein ruk nahin sakti.
Mahila maahvaari ki awastha mein sookhi tatha geeli donon tarah ki cheezon ko chhu sakti hai. Maslan kisi ke baal dho sakti hai aur kanghi kar sakti hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka sundar daampaty jeewan.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3477: Jise Allah ne donon daarhon ke beech aur donon pairon ke beech ki buraai se bacha liya, woh Jannat mein prawesh karega.

Abu huैraira- radiyallahu annhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jise Allah ne donon daarhon ke beech aur donon pairon ke beech (ke angon) ki buraai se bacha liya, woh Jannat mein prawesh karega.
3478: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) meri god mein tek lagaakar Qur'an parha karte the, jabki main maasik dharm ke samay mein hoti thi.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) meri god mein tek lagaakar Qur'an parha karte the, jabki main maasik-dharm ke samay mein hoti thi.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) bataati hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) unki god mein sar rakhkar Qur'an parha karte, jabki woh maasik dharm me hoteen. Yeh is baat ka pramaan hai ki maasikdharm waali mahila ka shareer paak hai, naapaak nahin.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3479: Koi banda ek baat karta hai aur usmen soch-wichaar nahin karta, jiske kaaran woh Jahannam ke garhe mein usse kaheen adhik door ja girta hai, jitni doori poorab aur pashchim ke beech mein hai.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki unhonne Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue sunaah banda ek baat karta hai aur usmen soch-wichaar nahin karta, jiske kaaran woh Jahannam ke garhe mein usse kaheen adhik door ja girta hai, jitni doori poorab aur pashchim ke beech mein hai.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne hamen bataya hai ki kuchh log aise bhi hain, jo koi baat karte samay yeh nahin sochte ki jo baat woh karne ja rahe hain, achchhi hai ya buri?
Iska nateeja yeh hota hai ki is tarah bina soche-sajhte baat karne waale awaidh gatiwidhiyon mein par jaate hain aur svayn ko Jahannam ki yaatna ke bhaageedaar bana lete hain aur kabhi-kabhi Jahannam ki itna gahraai mein chale jaate hain, jo sooryonday tatha sooryaast ke beech ki doori se bhi adhik hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3480: Mujhse pahle Allah ne jitne Nabi bheje, unke liye unki ummat mein kuchh sahyogi evn saathi hua karte the, jo unki sunnat par amal aur unke aadesh ka paalan karte the.

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Mujhse pahle Allah ne jitne Nabi bheje, unke liye unki ummat mein kuchh sahyogi evn saathi hua karte the, jo unki sunnat par amal aur unke aadesh ka paalan karte the. Phir unke baad aise ayogy log paida ho gae, jo aisi baaten kahte, jo we karte nahin the aur karte woh kaam the, jinka unhen aadesh nahin diya jaata tha. Atah jisne unse apne haath se jihaad kiya woh momin hai, jisne unse apne hriday se jihaad kiya woh momin hai aur jisne unse apni zubaan se jihaad kiya, woh momin hai. Aur iske atirikt  raai ke daane ke baraabar bhi eemaan nahin hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne yahaan bataya hai ki Allah ne aapse pahle kisi bhi ummat ke andar jo bhi Rasool bheja, uske saath khare hone ke liye kuchh priy mitr, sahyogi aur nishthaawaan mujaahid hua karte the, jo uske uttaraadhikaari hone ke sachmuch haqdaar the, uski sunnat ka anusran karte aur uske aadeshon ka paalan karte the. Lekin un sadaachaari poorvajon ke baad aise nikamme log a jaate the, jo kahte woh the, jispar khud amal nahin karte the aur karte woh the, jiska aadesh unko diya nahin gaya tha. Atah jisne aise logon se apne haath se jihaad kiya, woh momin hai. Jisne unse apni zabaan se jihaad kiya, woh momin hai. Jisne unse apne dil se jihaad kiya, woh momin hai.Iske pare ek raai ke daane ke baraabar bhi eemaan nahin hai.

Apne kaary tatha waktavy dvaara shareeyat wirodhi kaary karne waalon se jihaad karne ki prerna.
Ghalat ko dil se ghalat na jaanna eemaan ki kamzori ya khatm hone ka pramaan hai.
Allah apne nabiyon ke liye aise log uplabdh kar deta hai, jo unka sandesh unke baad waalon tak pahuncha dete hain.
Jise mukti chahiye, woh nabiyon ke bataye hue maarg par chale. Kyonki unke maarg ko chhorkar har maarg gumraahi evn winaash ka maarg hai.
Nabi sallallaaाhu alaihi wa sallam aur aapke sahaaba ka daur jitna door hota jayega, utna hi log sunnaton ko chhorte chale jayenge, ichchhaaon evn aakaankshaaon ke peechhe  bhaagne lagenge aur deen ke naam par nai-nai cheezen aawishkaar karte jayenge.
Jihaad ke wibhinn staron ka bayaan. Daraasal agar haalaat ko badalne ki shakti ho, to jihaad haath se hona chahiye. Yeh kaary daraasal shaasan-prashaasan ka hai. Waktavy dvaara jihaad se muraad sach bolna aur uska aahvaan karna hai. Jabki dil se jihaad karne se muraad ghalat ko ghalat samajhna, use naapsand karna aur usse asantusht rahna hai.
Bhalaai ka aadesh dena aur buraai rokna zaroori hai.
3481: Tumpar aise shaasak niyukt ho jayenge, jinke kuchh kaam tumhen achchhe lagenge aur kuchh bure. Aise mein jo (unke bure kaamon ko) bura jaanenge, woh bari ho jayenge aur jo khandan karenge, woh surakshit rahenge. Parantu jo unko theek jaanenge aur shaaskon ki haan mein haan milayenge (woh winaash ke shikaar honge).

Musalmaanon ki maata umm-e-salma radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Tumpar aise shaasak niyukt ho jayenge, jinke kuchh kaam tumhen achchhe lagenge aur kuchh bure. Aise mein jo (unke bure kaamon ko) bura jaanenge, woh bari ho jayenge aur jo khandan karenge, woh surakshit rahenge. Parantu jo unko theek jaanenge aur shaaskon ki haan mein haan milayenge (woh winaash ke shikaar honge)." Sahaaba ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya ham unse yuddh na karen? Farmaya : "Nahin! Jab tak we namaz parhte rahen."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki hamaare shaasak aise log ban jayenge, jinke kuchh kaam shareeyat ke anusaar hone ke kaaran hamko sahi lagenge aur kuchh shareeyat wirodhi hone ke kaaran hamkon ghalat lagenge. Aise mein jo unke ghalat kaamon ko apne dil se bura jaanega aur is sthiti mein nahin hoga ki unka khandan kar sake, to woh gunaah evn munaafikat se bari maane jayega. Isi tarah jiske paas haath se rokne ya zabaan se khandan karne ki shakti hogi aur woh is shakti ka upyog karega, woh gunaah tatha usmen shareek hone se surakshit rahega. Iske wipreet jo unke in bure kaamon ko achchha jaanega aur unke padchihnon par chalega, woh unki hi tarah winaash ka shikaar ho jayega.

Phir sahaaba ne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochha kiya kya ham is tarah ke shaaskon se yuddh na karen, to aapne unko isse mana kiya aur farmaya ki nahin, aisa us samay tak na karna, jab tak we namaz qayam karte rahen.

Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke Allah ke Nabi hone ka ek pramaan yeh hai ki aapne aane waale samay mein ghatne waali kuchh ghatnaaon ki bhawishyawaani ki aur woh ghatnayen usi tarah saamne bhi a gaeen, jis tarah aapne bhawishyawaani ki thi.
Ghalat kaam ke prati sahamti vyakt karna aur usmen shareek hona jayaz nahin, balki uska khandan zaroori hai.
Jab shaasak shareeyat wirodhi kaam karne lagen, to in kaamon mein unka anusran jayaz nahin hai.
Muslim shaaskon ke wiruddh baghaawat karna jayaz nahin hai. Kyonki iske nateeje mein fasaad barpa hoga, raktapaat hoga aur  shaanti bhang hogi. Isliye naafarmaan shaaskon ke nindneey vyavhaar ko sahna aur unke durvyavhaar par sabr karna isse aasaan hai.
Namaz bare mahatv waali cheez hai. Namaz hi kufr evn Islam ke beech antar karne waali cheez hai.
3483: Mujhe yaad aya ki hamaare paas sone ka ek tukra rakha hua hai. Atah, mujhe yeh achchha nahin laga ki mera dhyaan usi mein atka rahe. So, mainne use baantne ka aadesh de diya.

Uqba bin haaris- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne madeene mein Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke peechhe asr ki namaz parhi. Jab aapne salaam phera to jaldabaazi mein khare hue aur logon ki gardanen phalaangte hue apni kisi patni ke kamre mein gae. Aapki jaldi dekhkar log ghabra gae. Phir thori hi der mein aap nikalkar unke paas aye to dekha ki aapki jaldi se log aashcharyachkit hain. Atah, farmayaah mujhe yaad aya ki hamaare paas sone ka ek tukra rakha hua hai. Atah, mujhe yeh achchha nahin laga ki mera dhyaan usi mein atka rahe. Isliye mainne use baantne ka aadesh de diya.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih "Mainne ghar mein sone ka ek tukra chhor diya tha, jo sadqe ke maal ka tha. Atah, mujhe achchha na laga ki raat mein use apne paas rakhoon."
3484: Abdur rahmaan bin abu bakr siddeeq- radiyallahu anhuma- Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke kamre mein daakhil hue. Us samay mainne aapko apne seene se sahaara de rakha tha. Abdur rahmaan ek hari misvaak se daant saaf kar rahe the. Aap der tak uski or dekhte rahe.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki abdur rahmaan bin abu bakr siddeeq- radiyallahu anhuma- Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke kamre mein daakhil hue. Us samay mainne aapko apne seene se sahaara de rakha tha. Abdur rahmaan, ek hari misvaak se daant saaf kar rahe the. Aap der tak uski or dekhte rahe to mainne misvaak le li, use chabaya, stemaal karne ke yogy banaya aur Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko diya to aapne usse is tarah daant saaf kiya ki mainne aapko usse achchhi tarah misvaak karte kabhi nahin dekha tha. Jaise hi daant ki safaai ka kaary poora hua, apna haath uthaya (athva ungli uthaai), phir (teen baar) kahaah ai Allah! Mujhe sabse oonche sthaan waale mitron mein pahuncha de. Phir duniya se chal base. Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- kaha karti theen ki aapki mrityu hui to aapka sir mere seene aur thuddi ke beech tha.

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ne ek ghatna sunaai hai, jo Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke misvaak se prem ko spasht karti hai. Ghatna yeh hai ki aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ke bhaai abdurrahmaan bin abu bakr Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas ek taaza misvaak se daant ragarte hue us samay aye, jab aap mrityushayya par the.
Jab Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne abduुुुrrahmaan ke haath mein misvaak dekha, to beemaari tatha mrityu ke kasht ke baavjood uska prem haawi ho gaya. Uski or aise dekhne lage, jaise uski chaahat rakhte hon. Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- is baat ko samajh gaeen. Unhonne apne bhaai se misvaak lekar uske sire ko apne daanton se kaatkar saaf evn narm banaya. Phir Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko de diya aur aapne misvaak kiya.
Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki unhonne aapko isse achchhe andaaz mein misvaak karte hue kabhi nahin dekha tha.
Jab aap misvaak kar chuke, to Allah ke ek hone ka elaan karte hue aur apne rab ki or prasthaan ko chunte hue apni ungli uthaai aur chal base.
Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ko is baat par garv tha ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unke seene par sar rakhkar antim saans li aur sachchaai yeh hai ki unhen is baat ka adhikaar bhi hai.
3485: Ek vyakti ne Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se us wakt poochha jab aap ghore ki kaathi ke paavdaan mein paanv rakh chuke the ki kaun-sa jihaad sabse uttam hai? Aapne farmayaah atyaachaari baadshaah ke saamne saty wachan bolna.

Taariq bin shihaab bajli ahamsi- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki ek vyakti ne Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se us wakt poochha jab aap ghore ki kaathi ke paavdaan mein paanv rakh chuke the ki kaun-sa jihaad sabse uttam hai? Aapne farmayaah atyaachaari baadshaah ke saamne saty wachan ka udghosh karna.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- yaatra ke liye taiyaar ho chuke the ki ek vyakti ne aapse poochha : Kaun-sa jihaad sabse adhik sawaab waala hai? To aapne bataya ki sabse adhik sawaab waala jihaad kisi atyaachaari shaasak ko bhalaai ka aadesh dena ya buraai se rokna hai. Isse maaloom hua ki jihaad kewal awishvaasiyon se yuddh karne ka naam nahin hai. Uski bahut-si shreniyaan hain aur uska sabse adhik sawaab waala roop kisi atyaachaari shaasak ke saamne saty ka udghosh karna hai. Kyonki yahaan maare jaane athva qaid kar liye jaane ki aashanka rahti hai. Kyonki ek to shaasak atyaachaari hai aur doosre uske saamne koi bachaane ka saahas bhi nahin kar paata.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3492: Ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aakar bola ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Main yaatra par nikalna chaahta hoon. Atah, mujhe kuchh paathey pradaan keejiye. Aapne kahaah Allah tujhe dharmaprayanta ka paathey pradaan kare.

Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aakar bola ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Main yaatra par nikalna chaahta hoon. Atah, mujhe kuchh paathey pradaan keejiye. Aapne kahaah Allah tujhe dharmaprayanta (taqva) ka paathey pradaan kare. Usne kahaah kuchh aur pradaan karen. To farmayaah tere gunaah maaf kar de. Usne kahaah aur kuchh pradaan karen. To farmayaah tu jahaan bhi rahe, Allah tere liye bhalaai ki raah aasaan kar de.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3493: Sabse bari bhalaai yeh hai ki aadmi apne pita ke doston ke saath achchha vyavhaar kare.

Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki makka ke raaste mein unhen ek dehaat ka rahne waala mila. Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- ne use saalam kiya, khud jis gadhe ki sawaari karte the, uspar sawaar kiya aur khud jo pagri baandha karte the, woh use pradaan kar di. Ibne deenaar ka kahna hai ki yeh dekhkar hamne unse kahaah Allah aapka bhala kare. Yeh to dehaat ke rahne waale log hain. Thora kuchh milne par santusht ho jaate hain! To abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- ne kahaah waastav mein, iska pita umar bin khattaab- radiyallahu anhu- ka dost tha aur mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue suna haih sabse bari bhalaai yeh hai ki aadmi apne pita ke doston ke saath achchha vyavhaar kare.
Tatha ek riwayat mein ibne deenaar, abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- ke baare mein kahte hain ki jab woh makka nikalte to unke saath ek gadha hota tha. Jab oont ki sawaari se thak jaate to uspar baithte, tatha ek pagri hoti, jise sir par baandhte. Ek din woh gadhe par sawaar the ki unke nikat se ek dehaati guzra. Unhonne kahaah kya tum amuk ke bete amuk nahin ho? Usne kahaah haan, hoon to zaroor. Atah, use gadha dete hue kaha ki uspar sawaar ho jaao tatha pagri dete hue kaha ki ise baandh lo. Yeh dekhkar unke kuchh saathiyon ne kahaah Allah aapko kshama kare! Aapne is dehaati ko woh gadha de diya, jispar thakaawat door karne ke liye sawaar hote the aur woh pagri de di, jise sir par baandha karte the? Unhonne kahaah mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue suna haih sabse bari bhalaaiyon mein se ek yeh hai ki aadmi apne pita ki mrityu ke baad uske doston ke saath achchha vyavhaar kare. Tatha iska pita umar- radiyallahu anhu- ka dost tha.
3496: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya baat hai ki logon ne Umrah karne ke baad ehraam khol diya hai aur aapne Umrah ke baad ehraam nahin khola? To aapne farmayaah mainne apne baal jama liye the aur qurbaani ke jaanavron ko nishaan laga diye the. Atah, jab tak kurbaani na kar loon, ehraam nahin khol sakta.

Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki patni hafsa- raziyallah anha- ka warnan hai ki unhonne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya baat hai ki logon ne Umrah karne ke baad ehraam khol diya hai aur aapne Umrah ke baad bhi ehraam nahin khola? To aapne farmayaah mainne apne baal jama liye the aur qurbaani ke jaanavron ko nishaan laga diye the. Atah, jab tak kurbaani na kar loon, ehraam nahin khol sakta.

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hajjatul-wada ke avsar par Umrah tatha Hajj donon ka ehraam baandha tha, qurbaani ka jaanvar bhi saath le aye the tatha yeh dekhte hue ki lanbe samay tak ehraam ki haalat mein rahna hai, apne sar ke baalon ko kisi wastu se chipka liya tha, taaki we bikharne na payen. Aapke kuchh saathiyon ne aap hi ki tarah ehraam baandha tha, to kuchh ne kewal Umrah ka ehraam baandha tha, taaki Umrah aur Hajj ke beech mein kuchh laabh utha saken. Adhiktar log qurbaani ka jaanvar saath nahin laye the, jabki kuchh log laye bhi the. Jab makka pahunche aur tawaaf tatha safa evn marva ke beech daurne ka kaary sanpann kar liya, to aapne qurbaani ka jaanvar saath na laane waale logon ko, jo Hajj-e-ifraad aur Hajj-e-qiraan karna chaahte the, aadesh diya ki we Hajj ke iraade ko nirast karke use Umrah ke iraade mein badal den aur halaal ho jayen. Lekin jahaan tak khud aapki aur aapke un saathiyon ki baat hai, jo qurbaani ka jaanvar saath laye the, unhonne apna ehraam baraqraar rakha aur halaal nahin hue. Yeh dekh aapki patni hafsa (radiyallahu anha) ne aapse poochha : Kya baat hai ki log halaal ho gae aur aap halaal nahin hue? To aapne uttar diya : Mainne sar ke baalon ko lesdaar wastu se chipka liya hai, qurbaani ke jaanavron par patte daal diye hain aur unhen saath le aya hoon, isliye main qurbaani ke jaanavron ke, unke sthaan tak pahunchne, yaani qurbaani ke din Hajj poora hone se pahle ehraam utaar nahin sakta.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3502: Anas- radiyallahu anhu- ki maan ne kahaah dekho, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka bhed kisi ke saamne na kholna. Anas- radiyallahu anhu- ne kahaah Allah ki qasam, yadi main kisi ko woh raaz ki baat bataata to saabit! Tujhe awashy bataata.

Saabit riwayat karte hain ki anas- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hainh main bachchon ke saath khel raha tha ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) mere paas aye aur hamen salaam kiya tatha mujhe apne ek kaam se bhej diya. Atah, mujhe apni maan ke paas jaane mein der hui. Jab main unke paas pahuncha to unhonne kaha ki kis cheez ne tujhe rok rakha tha? Mainne kahaah mujhe Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek kaam se bheja tha. Unhonne poochha ki woh kaam tha kya? Mainne kahaah woh ek bhed hai. Unhonne kahaah dekho, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka bhed kisi ke saamne na kholna. Anas- radiyallahu anhu- ne kahaah Allah ki qasam! Yadi main kisi ko woh bhed ki baat bataata, to ai saabit! Tujhe awashy bataata.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3503: Mujhe paanch cheezen aisi di gai hain, jo mujhse pahle kisi Nabi ko di nahin gai theen.

Jaabir bin abdullah radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Mujhe paanch cheezen aisi di gai hain, jo mujhse pahle kisi Nabi ko di nahin gai theen. Ek maheene ki masaafat tak jaane waale prataap dvaara mera sahyog kiya gaya hai. Mere liye dharti ko namaz parhne ka sthaan evn pawitrata praapt  karne ka saadhan banaya gaya hai. Lihaaza meri ummat ka jo vyakti jahaan namaz ka samay paye, woh waheen namaz ada kar le. Mere liye ghaneemat ka dhan halaal kiya gaya hai. Mujhse pahle kisi ke liye ghaneemat ka dhan halaal na tha. Mujhe sifaarish karne ka adhikaar diya gaya hai. Doosre Nabi apne-apne samudayon ki or Nabi banaakar bheje jaate the. Lekin mujhe tamaam insaanon ki or Nabi banaakar bheja gaya hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki Allah ne aapko paanch cheezen di hain, jo pahle kisi Nabi ko di nahin gai theen.

1- mere samarthan ke taur par prataap diya gaya hai, jo mere dushmanon ke dilon mein daal diya jaata hai, yadyapi mere aur unke beech ek maheene ki doori hi kyon na maujood ho.

2- hamaare liye poori dharti ko namaz parhne ka sthaan banaya gaya hai ki ham jahaan chaahen, namaz parh len. Isi darah paani ke istemaal ki shakti na hone par mitti ko pawitrata praapt karne ka saadhan bhi banaya gaya hai.

3- hamaare liye yuddh se praapt hone waale ghaneemat ke dhan ko halaal kiya gaya hai. Ghaneemat ke dhan se muraad woh dhan hai, jo awishvaasiyon se yuddh ke dauraan musalmaanon ko praapt hota hai.

4- mujhe qayaamat ke din bhayaawahta se logon ko mukti dilaane ki sifaarish di gayi hai.

5- mujhe tamaam insaanon aur jinnaat ki or Nabi banaakar bheja gaya hai. Jabki mujhse pahle aane waale Nabi apne-apne samudayon ki or Nabi banaakar bheje jaate the.

Insaan kisi ko bataane ya Allah ka shukr ada karne ke liye Allah ki di hui nemton ko ginva sakta hai.
Is ummat tatha uske Nabi par Allah ka upkaar ki usne uparyukt cheezen di hain.
Namaz har haal mein samay par parhna zaroori hai. Ek vyakti namaz ki sharton, stanbhon evn aniwaary kaaryon mein jitne ka paalan kar sakega, karega.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko wishesh roop se jis sifaarish ka adhikaar diya gaya hai, uske wibhinn prakaar hain. Jaise- bandon ke liye is baat ki sifaarish ki Allah unke baare mein nirnay kar de aur Jannat waalon ko Jannat mein daakhil karne ki sifaarish aadi. Aapke chacha abu taalib ke azaab ko halka karne ki sifaarish bhi iska ek udaahran hai. Yaad rahe ki aap apne chacha abu taalib ko Jahannam se nikaalne ki sifaarish nahin karenge, kyonki unki mrityu awishvaas ke saath hui thi.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki aur bhi bahut-si wishisht wisheshtayen hain, jinka ullekh is hadees mein nahin hua hai. Jaise- aapko saargarbhit shabdon mein baat rakhne ki kshamta pradaan ki gai thi, aap nabiyon ke silsile ki antim kari the aur aapki ummat ki safon ko farishton ki safon ke samaan banaya gaya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3504: Jisne ( ghar se nikalte samay) kahaah 'بِسم الله تَوَكَّلتُ على اللهِ، وَلاَ حول ولا قُوَّة إِلَّا بالله' (arthaat, Allah ke naam se, mainne Allah par bharosa kiya tatha Allah ke siwa koi shakti aur koi taaqat nahin hai.) usse kaha jaata haih tujhe maarg dikha diya gaya, tujhe raahat de di gai tatha tujhe surakshit kar diya gaya tatha shaitaan usse door hat jaata hai.

Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jisne (ghar se nikalte samay) kahaah 'بِسم الله تَوَكَّلتُ على اللهِ، وَلاَ حول ولا قُوَّة إِلَّا بالله' (arthaat, Allah ke naam se, mainne Allah par bharosa kiya tatha Allah ke siwa koi shakti aur koi taaqat nahin hai.) usse kaha jaata haih tujhe maarg dikha diya gaya, tujhe raahat de di gai tatha tujhe surakshit kar diya gaya aur shaitaan usse door hat jaata hai.
Abu daaood mein itna adhik hai ki to ek shaitaan doosre shaitaan se kahta haih bhala, tum us aadmi par dore kaise daal sakoge, jise maarg dikha diya gay, raahat de di gai aur suraksha pradaan kar di gai?

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is hadees mein bataya hai ki jab koi vyakti ghar se nikalte samay kahta hai : "باسم الله، توكلت على الله، لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله" To ek farishta use pukaar kar kahta hai ki ai Allah ke bande! Tujhe saty ka maarg dikha diya gaya, tujhe chinta se mukt kar diya gaya aur tujhe shatruon se surakshit kar diya gaya. Yeh sun uske saath lagaya hua farishta usse door ho jaata hai. Atah ek doosra shaitaan us shaitaan se kahta hai : Tum bhala ek aise vyakti ko pathabhrasht kaise kar sakte ho, jise saty ka maarg dikha diya gaya, chintaaon se mukt kar diya gaya aur sabhi shaitaanon se surakshit kar diya gaya? Uske in shabdon ko parh lene ke baad tumhaari ab daal nahin galne waali.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3506: Jisne Islam mein koi achchha tareeka jaari kiya, use khud apni neki tatha baad mein uspar amal karne waale tamaam logon ki neki milegi. Haan, magar unki nekiyaan tanik bhi ghataai nahin jayengi. Aur jisne Islam mein koi bura tareeka prachlit kiya, uspar uska gunaah hoga tatha baad mein uspar amal karne waale tamaam logon ka gunaah hoga aur uske gunaah kuchh bhi ghataye nahin jayenge.

Jareer bin abdullah- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki ham pahle din ki pahli pahar ko Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas the ki kuchh log aapke paas aye, jo nange shareer the. Apne oopar dhaareedaar chaadren ya choge daale hue the. Talvaar latkaye hue the. Adhiktar log muzar qabeele se the, balki sabhi muzar qabeele se hi the. Unki bhukhamri dekhkar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke chehre ka rang badal gaya. Atah, aap andar gae, phir baahar aye. Uske baad bilaal- radiyallahu anhu- ko aadesh diya to unhonne azaan di aur iqaamat kahi. Phir aapne namaz parhaai, khutba diya aur yeh ayat parheeh "يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالاً كَثِيراً وَنِسَاءً وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي تَسَاءَلُونَ بِهِ وَالْأَرْحَامَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيباً" (Arthaat, ai logo! Apne us paalanhaar se daro, jisne tumhen ek jaan se paida kiya aur usse uska jora paida kiya aur donon se bahut-se nar-naari phaila diye. Tatha us Allah se daro, jiske dvaara tum ek-doosre se (adhikaar) maangte ho. Tatha rakt-sanbandhon ko torne se daro, nissandeh Allah tumhaara nireekshak hai.) phir soora hashr ke ant se yeh ayat parheeh "يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلْتَنْظُرْ نَفْسٌ مَا قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدٍ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ" (Arthaat, ai eemaan waalo! Allah se daro aur pratyek praani ko dekhna chahiye ki usne kal ke liye kya bheja hai. Tatha Allah se daro, nishchay hi Allah tum jo kuchh karte ho, use dekh raha hai.) (phir farmayaah) har aadmi ko chahiye ki apne deenaar, dirham, kapron, gehoon ke saa aur khujoor ka sadka kare (yahaan tak kaha ki) yadyapi khujoor ka ek tukra hi kyon na ho. Yeh sunkar ek ansaari sahaabi ek thaili lekar aya. Kareeb tha ki uska haath use uthaane se wiwash ho jaye, balki wiwash ho hi chuka tha. Phir log ek-doosre ke baad kuchh na kuchh laate rahe, yahaan tak ki mainne khaady padaarthon aur kapron ke do dher dekhe. Phir kya tha, mainne dekha ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka chehra sone ki tarah chamak raha tha. Phir aapne kahaah jisne Islam mein koi achchha tareeka jaari kiya, use khud apni neki tatha baad mein uspar amal karne waale tamaam logon ki neki milegi. Haan, magar unki nekiyaan tanik bhi ghataai nahin jayengi. Aur jisne Islam mein koi bura tareeka prachlit kiya, uspar uska gunaah hoga tatha baad mein uspar amal karne waale tamaam logon ka gunaah hoga aur unke gunaah kuchh bhi ghataye nahin jayenge.
3507: Jab khaate samay Allah ka naam na liya jaye to us khaane mein shaitaan shaamil ho jaata hai. Wahi is bachchi ko laya tha, taaki iske maadhyam se khaane mein shareek ho jaye. Atah, mainne uska haath pakar liya. Phir is dehaati ko le aya taaki uske bahaane shareek ho jaye, parantu mainne uska haath bhi pakar liya. Us Allah ki qasam! Jiske haath mein mere praan hain, shaitaan ka haath in donon ke haathon ke saath mere haath mein hai.

Huzaifa bin yamaan- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki ham jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath khaane mein shareek hote to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se pahle khaane ko haath nahin lagaate the. Ek baar ham aapke saath khaane baithe the ki achaanak ek larki aai. Aisa lag raha tha ki use dhakela ja raha hai. Woh khaane mein haath daal hi rahi thi ki aapne uska haath pakar liya. Phir ek dehaat ka rahne waala vyakti aya. Use bhi dekhkar aisa lag raha tha ki use dhakela ja raha hai. Aapne uska bhi haath pakar liya. Phir Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jab khaate samay Allah ka naam na liya jaye to us khaane mein shaitaan shaamil ho jaata hai. Wahi is bachchi ko laya tha, taaki iske maadhyam se khaane mein shaamil ho jaye. Atah, mainne uska haath pakar liya. Phir is dehaati ko le aya, taaki uske bahaane shaamil ho jaye, parantu mainne uska haath bhi pakar liya. Us Allah ki qasam, jiske haath mein mere praan hain, shaitaan ka haath in donon ke haathon ke saath mere haath mein hai. Phir aapne Allah ka naam liya aur khaana khaya.
3508: Allah taaala ne kahaah mere prataap ke kaaran ek-doosre se prem karne waalon ke liye noor ke minbar honge tatha unpar Nabi evn shaheed bhi rashk karenge.

Muaaz bin jabal- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya ki Allah taaala ne kahaah mere prataap ke kaaran ek-doosre se prem karne waalon ke liye noor ke minbar honge tatha unpar Nabi evn shaheed bhi rashk karenge.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3512: Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se Allah ke atirikt kisi ke saty poojy na hone aur Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke Allah ke Rasool hone, namaz parhne, zakat dene, sunne tatha maanne aur har musalmaan ka bhala chaahne (ke iqraar) par baiat ki.

Jareer bin abdullah radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se Allah ke atirikt kisi ke saty poojy na hone aur Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke Allah ke Rasool hone, namaz parhne, zakat dene, sunne tatha maanne aur har musalmaan ka bhala chaahne (ke iqraar) par baiat ki.

Sahaabi jareer bin abdullah radiyallahu anhu bataate hain ki unhonne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko ekeshvarvaad par qayam rahne, din aur raat mein paanch namaazen unki sharton, stanbhon, aniwaary kaaryon evn sunnaton ke saath ada karne, farz zakat dene jo ki ek maali ibaadat hai aur jise maaldaaron se lekar haqdaar nirdhanon aadi mein baanta jaata hai, shaaskon ki baat maanne aur har musalmaan ka shubhchintan karne ka wachan diya. Har musalmaan ka shubhchintan karne ka tareeqa yeh hai ki apne kathan evn kaary dvaara har musalmaan ka bhala karne aur use buraai se bachaane ka prayaas kiya jaye.

Namaz evn zakat ka mahatv. Donon Islam ke stanbh hain.
Musalmaanon ke shubhchintan ka mahatv itna adhik hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne saathiyon se iska wachan liya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3516: Aap (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) zuhar ki namaz tez dhoop mein parhte the, asr ki namaz aise samay parhte the jab sooraj saaf aur raushan rahta tha, magrib ki namaaj sooraj doobne ke baad parhte the.

Jaabir bin abdullah ansaari kahte hain ki aap (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) zuhar ki namaz tez dhoop mein parhte the, asr ki namaz aise samay parhte the jab sooraj saaf aur raushan rahta tha, magrib ki namaaj sooraj doobne ke baad parhte the, isha ki namaz kabhi jaldi to kabhi der se parhte the; jab dekhte the ki log ekatr ho gae hain to jaldi parh lete aur jab dekhte ki log wilanb kar rahe hain to der se parhte aur subh ki namaz andhera rahte parhte the).

Is hadees mein paanch wakt ki namaz parhne ke uttam samay ka warnan hai.
Zuhar : Zuhar ki namaz us samay parhi jaye, jab sooraj beech aakaash se dhal jaye. Yahi sooraj ke dhalne ka samay hai tatha yaheen se zuhar ka samay shuru hota hai. Lekin, yadi dhoop tez ho aur namaaziyon ko pareshaani ho rahi ho, to behtar yeh hai ki namaz kuchh der se parhi jaye, taaki mausam kuchh thanda ho jaye. Is baat ka ullekh any hadeeson mein maujood hai.
Asrah asr ki namaz us samay parhi jaye, jab sooraj saaf ho aur usmen peelaapan na aya ho. Iska nirdhaaran is prakaar kiya jayega ki pratyek wastu ki chhaya us wastu ke baraabar ho jaye. Widit ho ki ismen us chhaya ko jora nahin jayega, jo sooraj beech aakaash mein rahte samay hoti hai.
Magribah maghrib ki namaz us samay parhi jaye, jab sooraj ast ho jaye.
Ishaah is namaz ke sanbandh namaaziyon ka dhyaan rakha jaye. Yadi we samay shuru hote hi, yaani kshitij ki laali ghayab hote hi pahunch jayen, to usi samay parh li jaye aur yadi na pahunchen, to kamobesh raat ke pratham aadhe bhaag tak der ki jaye. Kyonki, yadi pareshaani na ho, to yahi uska uttam samay hai.
Subah : Subah ki namaz us samay parhi jaye, jab raat ke andhere mein din ke ujaale ka ghulna aaranbh hua ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3517: Allah ki qasam! Ham yeh kaary kisi aise vyakti ko nahin saunpte, jo maangkar lena chaahe athva kisi aise vyakti ko nahin saunpte, jo uski laalsa rakhe.

Abu moosa ashaari -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki main aur mere chacha ke beton mein se do vyakti Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas pahunche. Unmen se ek ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Allah ne aapko jo kuchh saunpa hai, uske kuchh bhaag ka hamen shaasak bana deejiye. Doosre ne bhi kuchh isi tarah ki baat ki. Atah, aapne farmayaah Allah ki qasam! Ham yeh kaary kisi aise vyakti ko nahin saunpte, jo maangkar lena chaahe athva kisi aise vyakti ko nahin saunpte, jo uski laalsa rakhe.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3518: Main tumko waseeyat karta hoon ki har namaz ke baad yeh dua parhna hargiz na chhorna : Ai Allah! Apne zikr karne, shukr karne aur behtar andaaz mein apni ibaadat karne mein meri madad farma.

Muaaz bin jabal radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai ki : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unka haath pakra aur farmaya : "Ai muaaz! Allah ki qasam, main tumse mohabbat rakhta hoon." Aage farmaya : "Ai muaaz! Main tumko waseeyat karta hoon ki har namaz ke baad yeh dua parhna hargiz na chhorna : Ai Allah! Apne zikr karne, shukr karne aur behtar andaaz mein apni ibaadat karne mein meri madad farma."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne muaaz bin jabal radiyallahu anhu ka haath pakra aur unse farmaya : Allah ki qasam, main tumse mohabbat rakhta hoon aur tumko waseeyat karta hoon ki har namaz ke aakhir mein yeh dua hargiz na chhorna : "اللهم أَعِنّي على ذكرك" Yaani ai Allah! Aajnaapaalan se qareeb karne waale har kathan evn kaary mein tera zikr karne, "وشُكْرِك" Nemten praapt hone aur aapdaaon se bache rahne par tera shukr karne, "وحُسْن عبادتك" Aur ikhlaas ke saath tatha Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke bataye hue tareeqe ke mutaabiq behtar andaaz mein apni ibaadat karne par.

Kisi insaan se yeh bataana shareeyat sammat hai ki woh usse Allah ki khaatir mohabbat rakhta hai.
Har farz namaz ke ant mein yeh dua parhna musathab hai.
In chand shabdon mein jo dua sikhaai gai hai, usmen duniya evn aakhirat ki tamaam waanchhit cheezen simat aai hain.
Mohabbat jab Allah ke liye ho, to insaan ek-doosre ko sach par qayam rahne ki waseeyat karta hai, ek-doosre ka shubhchintan karta hai aur achchhe kaamon mein ek-doosre ka sahyog karta hai.
Teebi kahte hain : Allah ka zikr aantrik praphullata ki bhoomika, Allah ka shukr nemton ki praapti ka saadhan aur ibaadat ki sundarta se muraad un tamaam cheezon se khud ko alag kar lena hai, jo insaan ko Allah se door karke kaheen aur vyast kar den.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, nasai aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3520: Allah se daro jo tumhaara rab hai, paanch waqt ki namaazen parho, apne maheene (arthaath Ramzan maheene) ke roze rakho, apne dhan ki zakat do tatha apne shaaskon ki baat maano, tum apne rab ki Jannat mein daakhil ho jaaoge.

Abu umaama radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko hajjatul wada ke avsar par khutba dete samay kahte hue suna hai : "Allah se daro jo tumhaara rab hai, paanch waqt ki namaazen parho, apne maheene (arthaath Ramzan maheene) ke roze rakho, apne dhan ki zakat do tatha apne shaaskon ki baat maano, tum apne rab ki Jannat mein daakhil ho jaaoge."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne 10 hijri ko hajjatulavda ke avsar par arfa ke din khutba diya. Is Hajj ko hajjatulavda isliye kaha jaata hai ki is avsar par Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne logon ko alavda kaha. Is avsar par aapne tamaam logon ko aadesh diya ki apne rab se daren, jiska tareeqa yeh hai ki uske aadeshon ka paalan kiya jaye aur uski mana ki hui cheezon se door raha jaye. Paanch waqt ki namaaze parhen, jinhen Allah ne din evn raat mein farz kiya hai. Ramzan maheene ke roze rakhen. Apne dhan ki zakat haqdaaron ko den aur usmen kanjoosi na karen. Apne shaaskon ki baat maanen, jab tak unka aadesh Allah ki awajna par aadhaarit na ho. Jisne in kaamon ko kiya, uska pratiphal Jannat mein prawesh ki praapti hai.
Ye kaary svarg mein prawesh paane ke kaarnon mein se hain.
[ise tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3528: Mainne apni khaala maimoona ke paas raat bitaai. Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) raat ki namaz ke liye khare hue to main aapki bayen or khara ho gaya. Aise mein, aapne mera sir pakra aur apni daahini or khara kar diya.

Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki mainne apni khaala maimoona ke paas raat bitaai. Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) raat ki namaz ke liye khare hue to main aapki bayen or khara ho gaya. Aise mein, aapne mera sir pakra aur apni daahini or khara kar diya.

Paraakrami sahaabi abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki ek baar unhonne apni khaala tatha Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki patni maimoona (radiyallahu anha) ke yahaan ek bitaai, taaki svayn Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki raat ki namaz ka haal jaan saken. Atah, jab aap raat mein namaz ke liye khare hue, to abdullah bhi aapke saath namaz parhne ke liye aapki baaeen or khare ho gae. Lekin, choonki daahini or khara hona uttam hai aur yadi imaam ke saath ek hi muqatdi ho, to use idhar hi khara hona chahiye, isliye aapne unhen ghumaakar daahini jaanib khara kar diya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3529: Woh rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas apna chhota bachcha lekar ayeen jo abhi khaana nahin khaata tha. Rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne use apni god mein bitha liya to usne aapke kapre par peshaab kar diya. Aapne paani mangvaakar us par chhirak diya, lekin use dhoya nahin.

Umme qais bint mehsan -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki : Woh rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas apna chhota bachcha lekar ayeen jo abhi khaana nahin khaata tha. Rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne use apni god mein bitha liya to usne aapke kapre par peshaab kar diya. Aapne paani mangvaakar us par chhirak diya, lekin use dhoya nahin.

Umme qais bint mehsan radiyallahu anha Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas apna bachcha lekar ayeen, jo apni kam umri ke kaaran abhi khaana nahin khaata tha. Aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne use apni god mein bitha liya, to bachche ne aapke kapre par peshaab kar diya. Is par aapne paani mangvaya aur use apne kapre par chhirak diya aur use dhoya nahin.

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka uttam aachran evn aapki atyadhik winamrata.
Achchhe vyavhaar, winamrata aur chhoton ke saath narmi baratne, tatha bachchon ka sammaan karke evn unhen god mein bithaakar unke baron ke dilon ko saantvana dene, ityaadi ke liye protsaahan.
Baalak ka mootr naapaak hota hai, yadyapi usne abhi tak apni ichchha se bhojan karna aaranbh na kiya ho.
Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke is kaary ko nazh (paani chhirakna) kaha jaata hai. Yeh us chhote larke ke liye khaas hai, jo abhi khaana na khaata ho. Albatta larki ke peshaab ko dhona zaroori hai, bhale hi woh chhoti ho.
Maan ka doodh peene waale larke ke paakhaane ko any sabhi naapaak cheezon ki tarah dhona aawashyak hai.
Snaan mein paani pahunchaane ke atirikt kuchh aur cheez bhi aawashyak hai.
Behtar yeh hai ki naapaaki ki jagah ko paak karne mein jaldi ki jaye; taaki naapaaki se pawitrata jaldi praapt ho jaye aur insaan bhoole nahin.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3530: Main Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya. Us samay aap chamre se bane hue laal khemen mein the. Unka kahna hai ki isi beech bilaal- radiyallahu anhu- wazu ka paani lekar nikle to koi aapke shareer ke angon se girne waale paani ko apne oopar chhirak raha tha aur koi le raha tha.

Abu juhaifa wahb bin abdullah suwaai- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki main Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya. Us samay aap chamre se bane hue laal khemen mein the. Unka kahna hai ki isi beech bilaal- radiyallahu anhu- wazu ka bacha hua paani lekar nikle to koi aapke shareer ke angon se girne waale paani ko apne oopar chhirak raha tha aur koi le raha tha. Woh kahte hain ki phir Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) laal jore mein nikle. Aisa mahsoos ho raha hai ki main aapki pindliyon ki safedi ko dekh raha hoon. Kahte hainh aap ne wazu kiya aur bilaal ne azaan di. Woh kahte hainh main bilaal- radiyallahu anhu- ke mukh ko حَيَّ على الصَّلاة؛ حيَّ عَلَى الفَلاَح. Kahte samay dayen tatha bayen or murte hue dekhne laga. Phir aapke liye ek neza gaar diya gaya aur aapne aage barhkar do rakaat zuhar ki namaz parhi. Phir madeena waapas aane tak do-do rakaat hi padhte rahe.

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) makka ke oopri bhaag ke abtah naami sthaan mein ruke hue the ki bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) aapke wazu ke bache hue paani lekar nikle aur log usse barkat lene lage. Phir bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) ne azaan di. Abu juhaifa kahte hain : Jab bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) "حي على الصلاة حي على الفلاح" Kahte samay dayen-bayen mur rahe the, to main unke munh ko dekhta raha.. Woh aisa isliye kar rahe the, taaki log achchhi tarah sun saken. Kyonki in donon waakyon mein namaz ki or aane ki prerna di gai hai. Phir Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke liye sutra ke taur par ek chhota-sa neza gaara gaya aur aapne zuhar ki namaz do rakaat parhi. Choonki aap musaafir the, isliye baad mein madeena aane tak chaar rakaat waali namaazon ko do-do rakaat parhte rahe.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3531: Uski qasam, jiske haath mein mere praan hain, tum awashy hi bhalaai ka aadesh dete rahoge tatha buraai se rokte rahoge, warna Allah apni or se tumpar koi saza bhej dega. Phir tum use pukaaroge, lekin tumhaari pukaar suni nahin jayegi.

Huzaifa bin yamaan- radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah uski qasam, jiske haath mein mere praan hain, tum awashy hi bhalaai ka aadesh dete rahoge tatha buraai se rokte rahoge, warna Allah apni or se tumpar koi saza bhej dega. Phir tum use pukaaroge, lekin tumhaari pukaar suni nahin jayegi.

Yahaan Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kaha hai ki "Uski qasam, jiske haath mein mere praan hain." Yahaan aapne Allah ki qasam khaai hai. Kyonki, usi balshaali evn uchch Allah ke haath mein saare bandon ki aatmayen hain. Woh chaahe to unhen seedha maarg dikhaye aur chaahe to bhatka de, chaahe to maut de de aur chaahe to jeewit rakhe. Unhen saty ka maarg dikhaana, pathabhrasht karna, jeewit rakhna aur maarna sab usi ke haath mein hai. Wahi asal sanchaalak hai. Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ka farmaan hai : "Aur jeev ki saugandh, tatha uski jisne use theek theek sudhaara. Phir use duraachaar tatha sadaachaar ka wiwek diya." Atah saare praan kewal Allah ke haath mein hain. Yahi kaaran hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aksar yeh qasam khaya karte the : "Uski qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai." Jabki kabhi-kabhi kahte : "Uski qasam, jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai." Choonki Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki aatma sabse utkrisht aatma hai. Atah aapne usi ki qasam khaai hai.
Iske baad us baat ka ullekh hai, jiske liye qasam khaai gai hai. Woh baat yeh hai ki ya to ham bhalaai ka aadesh denge aur buraai se rokenge, ya phir Allah hamaare liye ek aam yaatna utaarega. Phir ham usse dua maangenge aur woh hamaari dua grahan nahin karega. Yeh daraasal, bhale kaamon jaise namaz, zakat evn adhikaaron ki aadaygi aadi ka aadesh dene tatha bure kaamon jaise vyabhichaar, sood evn saari haraam cheezon aadi se rokne ke mahatv ka ullekh hai. Yeh kaam, adhikaar waale logon jaise pita, prashaasan evn pulis wibhaag ke logon ko vyavhaarik roop se, any sabhi logon ko achchhi waani dvaara tatha yadi vyavhaarik roop se evn kathan ke dvaara rokne ki shakti na ho, to ghalat kaary ke sthaan ka parityaag karte hue dil se karna chahiye.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3532: Ai bete! Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue suna haih sabse bure shaasak, jansaadhaaran par atyaachaar karne waale hain. Atah, tum aise logon mein shaamil na hona.

Aaiz bin amr- radiyallahu anhu- ubaidullah bin ziyaad ke paas gae aur kaha ki ai bete! Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue suna haih sabse bure shaasak jansaadhaaran par atyaachaar karne waale hain. Atah, tum aise logon mein shaamil na hona. Yeh sunkar ubaidullah bin ziyaad ne unse kahaah baith jaaiye. Aapki haisiyat to Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saathiyon mein wahi hai, jo aate mein chokar (doosre shreni ke log) ki hoti hai. Unhonne kahaah kya unke andar bhi chokar hua karta tha? Chokar to unke baad ke log tatha unke siwa any log hain.
3533: Jab purush, stri ki chaar shaakhaaon ke beech baith jaye aur usko bhainche to snaan aawashyak ho jaata hai.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jab purush, stri ki chaar shaakhaaon ke beech baith jaye aur usko bhainche to snaan aawashyak ho jaata hai.
Ek riwayat mein haih " Weery ka skhalan na hua ho, tab bhi.

Jab pati patni ke donon haathon tatha donon pairon ke beech baith jaye aur apna jannendriy patni ki yoni mein daakhil kar de, to donon par janaab ka snaan aniwaary ho jaata hai; chaahe weery ka patan hua ho ya na hua ho. Kyonki daakhil karne maatr hi snaan aniwaary ho jaata hai.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3534: Jab tummen se kisi ka wazu toot jaye, to jab tak wazu na kar le, Allah uski namaz grahan nahin karta.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jab tummen se kisi ka wazu toot jaye, to jab tak wazu na kar le, Allah uski namaz grahan nahin karta."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki namaz ke sateek hone ki ek shart tahaarat (pawitrata) hai. Atah jis vyakti ka peshaab, paakhaana evn neend aadi ke kaaran wazu toot jaye aur woh namaz parhna chaahe, to uspar wazu karna waajib hoga.

Naapaaki ki haalat mein namaz grahan nahin hoti, jab tak ki bari naapaaki ki awastha mein snaan aur chhoti naapaaki ki awastha mein wazu na kar liya jaye.
Wazu naam hai munh mein paani daalkar use munh ke andar ghumaane, phir saans ke saath naak mein paani charhaane, phir use nikaal baahar karne aur naak jhaarne, phir chehre ko teen baar dhone, phir donon haathon ko kohniyon sahit teen baar dhone, phir poore sar ka ek baar masah (arthaat paani ke saath sparsh) karne aur phir donon pairon ko takhnon samet teen baar dhone ka.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3535: Kharaabi hai uske liye jiske takhnon ko agni ka dand ho.
Abu huraira, abdullah bin amr aur aaisha- rajiyallahu anhum- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ne farmayaah kharaabi hai uske liye jiske takhnon ko agni ka dand ho.

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne wazu ke maamle mein kisi prakaar ki susti baratne se mana kiya hai aur khoob achchhi tarah wazu karne ki prerna di hai. Choonki aam taur par wazu ka paani takhnon tak pahunch nahin paata aur usse tahaarat tatha namaz mein vyavdhaan paida hota hai, isliye aapne bataya ki sookhi eriyon tatha sookhi eri waalon ko, jo sharai tahaarat ke maamle mein laaparvaahi se kaam lete hain, azaab ka saamna karna parega.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise donon riwayton ke saath Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3537: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ne isha ki namaz mein let kiya to umar nikal kar aye aur kahne lageh ai Allah ke Rasool! Maheelaaain evn bachche so gaai hain.Atah aap ghar se nakle, is haal mein ki aap ke sir se paani tapak raha tha aur farmayaah yadi meri ummat par kathin nahi hot to main isi samay is namaz ka aadesh deta.

Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- se warnit hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne isha ki namaz mein let kiya to umar nikal kar aye aur kahne lageh ai Allah ke Rasool! Maheelaaain evn bachche so gaai hain.Atah aap ghar se nakle, is haal mein ki aap ke sar se paani tapak raha tha aur farmayaah yadi meri ummat par kathin nahi hota to main isi samay is namaz ka aadesh deta.

Ek baar Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne isha ki namaz mein wilanb kiya, yahaan tak ki raat ka adhiktar bhaag beet gaya tatha mahilayen evn bachche, jo adhik prateeksha nahin kar sakte the, so gae. Yeh dekh umar bin khattaab -radiyallahu anhu- aapke paas aye aur kahne lage : Namaz parh leni chahiye, kyonki mahilayen evn bachche so gae hain. Tab aap ghar se masjid ki or aye. Us samay aapke sar se snaan ka paani tapak raha tha. Phir aapne yeh spasht karte hue ki yadi namaz ki prateeksha karne waalon ko kathinaai na ho, to isha ki namaz ko der se parhna hi uttam hai, farmaya : Yadi meri ummat par kathin nahi hota, to main is namaz ko isi samay parhne ka aadesh deta.

3538: Allah unki qabron tatha gharon ko aag se bhar de, unhonne hamen asr ki namaz se vyast rakha , yahaan tak ki sooraj doob gaya.

Ali bin abi taalib- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne khandaq ki jang ke din farmaya ki Allah unki qabron tatha gharon ko agni se bhar de,jaise unhonne hamen sooraj doobne tak asr ki namaz se vyast rakha.
Muslim ke shabdon mein ik prakaar hai ki unhonne hamen beech ki namaz -asr ki namaz se- vyast rakha. Fir use magrib tatha isha ke beech mein parha. Muslim hi mein abdullah bin masaood se warnit hai, kahte hain ki mushrekon ne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko asr ki namaz parhne ka samay nahin diya ,yahaan tak ki sooraj laal athva peela ho gaya to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah unhonne hamen beech ki namaz- asr ki namaz- se vyast rakha.Allah unki qabron tatha gharon ko agni se bhar de, athva farmayaah unke peton tatha qabron ko aag se bhar do.

Mushrikon ne khandaq yuddh ke avsar par ek din Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) aur aapke sahaaba ko pahredaari aur madeene ki nigraani mein itna vyast rakha ki we asr ki namaz nahin parh sake aur sooraj doob gaya. Atah, aap aur aapke saathi sooraj doobne ke baad hi asr ki namaz parh paye. Yahi kaaran hai ki aapne unke haq mein baddua ki ki Allah unke peton, gharon tatha qabron ko aag se bhar de. Kyonki unhonne asr ki namaz se rokne ke saath-saath, jo sabse uttam namaz hai, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur aapke saathiyon ko kasht bhi diya tha.

3539: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) phajr ki namaz parhte to aap ke saath momin maheelayen, chaadar orh kar namaz ke liye aati theen. Phir jab waapas jaateen to koi bhi andhera hone ke kaaran unhen nahin pahchaan paata tha.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) phajr ki namaz parhte , to aap ke saath momin maheelayen, chaadar orh kar namaz ke liye aati theen. Phir jab waapas jaateen to koi bhi andhera hone ke kaaran unhen nahin pahchaan paata tha.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke zamaane mein striyaan Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath fajr ki namaz parhne ke liye chaadren orhkar aati theen. Jab we namaz parhne ke baad ghar waapas jaateen, to raat ke andhere mein din ka ujaala ghul chuka hota, lekin abhi andhera itna baaqi hota ki dekhne waala unhen pahchaan nahin paata. Is hadees se pata chalta hai ki fajr ki namaz ko uska samay praaranbh hone ke baad hi parh lena chahiye.

3546: Allah kahta hai : Aadam ki santaan ka har amal uske liye hai, siway roze ke ki roza kewal mere liye hai aur main hi uska badla doonga.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Allah kahta hai : Aadam ki santaan ka har amal uske liye hai, siway roze ke ki roza kewal mere liye hai aur main hi uska badla doonga. Roza dhaal hai. Jab tummen se kisi ke roze ka din ho, to ashleel baaten na kare aur shor na machaye. Agar koi vyakti use gaali-galauj kare ya larne par utaaru ho jaye, to kah de ki main roze se hoon. Qasam hai us hasti ki jiske haath mein Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki jaan hai, rozedaar ke munh ki bu Allah ke yahaan kastoori ki khushbu se adhik sangundhit hai. Rozedaar ke liye do khushi ke avsar hain : Jab woh iftaar karta hai, to khush hota hai aur jab apne paalanhaar se milega, to (uska pratiphal dekhar) apne roze se khush hoga."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki uchch evn mahaan Allah ek hadees-e-qudsi mein kahta hai :

Aadam ki santaan ke har amal ko das guna se saat sau guna tak barhaya jaata hai. Siway roze ke. Kyonki roza mere liye hai. Usmen dikhaawa nahin hota. Uska badla bhi main hi doonga aur mujhe hi pata hai ki use kitna sawaab milna hai aur uski nekiyon ko kitna guna barhaya jaana hai.

Phir farmaya : "Roza dhaal hai." Yaani roza Jahannam ki aag se suraksha ka saadhan, usse banne waala aar aur ek mazboot qila hai. Kyonki roza insaan ko ichchhaaon evn aakaankshaaon ke peechhe chalne aur gunaahon mein parne se rokta hai. Jabki Jahannam ichchhaaon evn aakaankshaaon se ghiri hui hai.

"Jab tummen se kisi ke roze ka din ho, to ashleel baaten na kare." Yaani yaun sanbandh aur uski bhoomikaaon se sanbandhit koi baat na kare. Saath hi kisi any prakaar ki bhi koi ashleel baat na kare.

"Aur shor na machaye." Yaani zor-zor se shor aur laraai-jhagra na kare.

"Agar koi vyakti (Ramzan maheene mein) use gaali-galauj kare ya larne par utaaru ho jaye" To kah de ki main rozedaar hoon. Ho sakta hai ki woh apni harakton se baaz a jaye. Lekin agar woh har haal mein larne par aamaada ho, to jahaan tak ho sake, kam se kam shakti ka prayog karke usse bach nikle.

Uske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne us hasti ki qasam khaakar bataya jiske haath mein aapki jaan thi ki roze ke kaaran rozedaar ke munh ki badli hui gandh Allah ke yahaan usse kaheen zyaada paakeeza hai, jitna insaan ke yahaan kastoori ki gandh. Insaan ko juma aur zikr ki sabhaaon mein kastoori lagaane ka jitna sawaab milta hai, usse kaheen adhik sawaab is gandh mein mila karta hai.

Rozedaar ke liye khushi ke do avsar hain : Iftaar ke samay iftaar ki khushi, ki bhookh-pyaas khatm ho gai, roza poora hua, ibaadat poori hui, Allah ne roza rakhna aasaan kar diya aur agle kal roza rakhne ka hausla paida hua.

"Aur jab apne paalanhaar se milega, to apne roze se khush hoga." Uske badle mein milne waala pratiphal aur sawaab dekhkar.

Roze ki fazeelat tatha yeh ki roza insaan ko duniya mein waasnaaon se aur aakhirat mein Jahannam ke azaab se surakshit rakhta hai.
Roze ke aadaab mein ashleel baaton aur shor machaane se bachna, logon ke dvaara diye jaane waale kasht par sabr karna tatha buraai ke badle mein achchhaai karna aadi shaamil hain.
Rozaadaar ya ibaadatguzaar jab apni ibaadat ke poora hone par khush hota hai, to isse aakhirat mein milne waale uske pratiphal mein koi kami nahin hoti.
Insaan ko sanpoorn khushi Allah se mulaaqaat ke samay milegi, jab sabr karne waalon aur rozedaaron ko bina hisaab wa kitaab pratiphal praapt hoga.
Aawashyakta parne par ya kisi masalhat ke bina par logon ko apni ibaadat se avgat karna riyaakaari mein daakhil nahin hai. Kyonki is hadees mein aapne "Main rozedaar hoon" Kahne ka aadesh diya hai.
Sanpoorn roza rakhne waala rozedaar woh hai, jiske shareer ke ang gunaahon se bache rahen, zabaan jhooth tatha ashleel baaton se door rahe aur pet khaane-peene se bache rahe.
Waise to roza na rakhe hue vyakti ke liye bhi cheekhna, chillaana aur larna-jhagarna mana hai, lekin rozedaar ke liye manaahi mein aur teevrata a jaati hai.
Yeh hadees un hadeeson mein se ek hai, jinko Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne pawitr paalanhaar se riwayat kiya hai. Is prakaar ki hadees ko hadees-e-qudsi ya hadees-e-ilaahi kaha jaata hai. Isse muraad aisi hadees hai, jiske shabd evn arth donon Allah paak ke hon. Albatta, hadees-e-qudsi ke andar quraan ki wisheshtayen, jaise uski tilaawat ka ibaadat hona, uske liye pawitrata praapt karne ki zaroorat aur uska chamatkaar hona aadi paai nahin jaateen.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3552: Jab tummen se koi apne bhaai se mile, to use salaam kare. Phir, agar donon ke beech per, deewaar ya patthar a jaye aur woh usse (dobaara) mile, to phir use salaam kare.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jab tummen se koi apne bhaai se mile, to use salaam kare. Phir, agar donon ke beech per, deewaar ya patthar a jaye aur woh usse (dobaara) mile, to phir use salaam kare."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam is baat ki prerna de rahe hain ki ek musalmaan jab bhi apne bhaai se mile to use salaam kare. Yahaan tak ki agar donon saath chal rahe hon aur isi dauraan beech mein per, deewaar ya koi bara patthar a jaye, to dobaara milte samay phir se use salaam kare.

Salaam ko aam karna aur har sthiti pariwartan ke baad phir se salaam karna musathab hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam musalmaanon ke beech salaam ki sunnat ko aam karne ke liye prayaasrat raha karte the, kyonki isse musalmaanon ke beech prem paida hota hai.
Salaam karne se muraad "Assalaamu alaikum" Ya "Assalaamu alaikum wa rahamtullahi wa barkaatuhu" Kahna hai. Iske andar musaafha shaamil nahin hai, jo pahli baar milte samay kiya jaata hai.
Salaam dua hai aur zaroorat is baat ki hai ki musalmaan ek-doosre ke liye baar-baar dua karen.
[ise abu daawood ne riwayat kiya hai]
3553: Jab banda beemaar hota hai ya yaatra mein nikalta hai, to uske liye usi tarah ki ibaadton ka sawaab likha jaata hai, jo woh ghar mein rahte tatha svasth rahte samay kiya karta tha.

Abu moosa ashaari radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai,, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jab banda beemaar hota hai ya yaatra mein nikalta hai, to uske liye usi tarah ki ibaadton ka sawaab likha jaata hai, jo woh ghar mein rahte tatha svasth rahte samay kiya karta tha."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam yahaan Allah ke ek anugrah ka ullekh kar rahe hain. Bata rahe hain ki jab koi musalmaan svasth rahte hue aur ghar mein rahne ki awastha mein niymit roop se koi kaam karta raha ho aur phir beemaari ke kaaran woh us kaam ko kar na paye ya safar mein nikalne ki wajah se use chhorna pare ya kisi bhi majboori ke kaaran use na kar sake, to uske liye utna hi sawaab likha jayega, jitna svasth hone ya ghar rahne par us kaam ko karne se milta.

Allah, bandon par bara anugrahsheel hai.
Neki ke kaam adhik se adhik karne aur svaasthy tatha fursat ko ghaneemat jaanne ki prerna.
3554: Jab janaaza rakh diya jaata hai aur log use apne kandhon par utha lete hain, to yadi woh sadaachaari hota hai to kahta hai ki mujhe le chalo.

Abu saeed -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jab janaaza rakh diya jaata hai aur log use apne kandhon par utha lete hain, to yadi woh sadaachaari hota hai to kahta hai ki mujhe le chalo. Aur agar sadaachaari nahin hota, to kahta hai ki hay mera winaash, log mujhe kahaan le ja rahe hain? Uski aawaaz insaan ko chhorkar har cheez sunti hai. Insaan agar sun le, to behosh ho jaye."

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- bata rahe hain ki jab janaaze ko chaarpaai par rakh diya jaata hai aur log use apne kandhon par utha lete hain, aise mein agar woh sadaachaari hota hai to kahta hai; mujhe aage le chalo us nemat ki or jise woh apne saamne dekh raha hai. Lekin agar sadaachaari nahin hota, to bhayaanak aawaaz mein kahta hai ki hay mera minaash, ye log mujhe kahaan le ja rahe hain? Kyonki use saamne yaatna dikh rahi hoti hai. Uski is aawaaz ko insaan ko chhor har koi sunta hai. Uski aawaaz itni bhayaanak hoti hai ki agar insaan sun le, to behosh ho jaye.

Sadaachaari mritak ko dafnaane se pahle hi sukhad cheejen dikhaai dene lagti hain, jabki awishvaasi ko aane waale charnon ki bhayaawahta ka ehsaas hone lagta hai aur woh ghabraane lagta hai.
Kuchh aawaazen aisi bhi hoti hain, jinhen insaan to sun nahin sakta, lekin doosre sun sakte hain.
Sunnat yeh hai ki janaaze ko purushon ke kandhe par uthaya jaye. Mahilaaon ke kandhon par nahin. Kyonki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne mahilaaon ko janaaze ke saath chalne se mana kiya hai.
3556: Jab Allah ne aadam (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko paida kiya to kaha ki jaao aur un (baithe hue farishton) ko salaam karo aur suno ki we kya uttar dete hain, kyonki wahi tumhaara aur tumhaari santaan ka salaam hoga.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jab Allah ne aadam (alaihissalaam) ko paida kiya to kaha ki jaao aur un (baithe hue farishton) ko salaam karo aur suno ki we kya uttar dete hain, kyonki wahi tumhaara aur tumhaari santaan ka salaam hoga. Aadam- alaihislaam- ne kahaah 'السلام عليكم' aur farishton ne uttar mein kahaah 'السلام عليك ورحمة الله' is tarah unhonne unke uttar mein 'ورحمة الله' barhaakar kaha.

3557: Ek vyakti Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya aur bolaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Zara yeh batayen ki yadi koi vyakti mera dhan chheenna chaahe to main kya karoon? Farmayaah use apna dhan na do.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki ek vyakti Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya aur bolaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Zara yeh batayen ki yadi koi vyakti mera dhan chheenna chaahe to main kya karoon? Farmayaah use apna dhan na do. Usne kahaah agar mujhse lar pare to kya karoon? Farmayaah usse laro. Usne kahaah yadi mujhe maar daale to kya hoga? Farmayaah tum shaheed samjhe jaaoge. Usne kahaah yadi main use maar daaloon? Farmayaah woh Jahannam jayega.
3558: Chaalees achchhe kaary hain; jinmen sabse uttam kaary kisi ko doodh peene ke liye bakri dena hai. Jo banda, pratiphal ki aasha mein tatha unke baare mein Allah ke wachan par wishvaas karte hue, unmen se koi ek kaary bhi karega, use Allah uske kaaran Jannat mein daakhil karega.

Abu Muhammad abdullah bin amr bin aas- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah chaalees achchhe kaary hain; jinmen sabse uttam kaary kisi ko doodh peene ke liye bakri dena hai. Jo banda, pratiphal ki aasha mein tatha unke baare mein Allah ke wachan par wishvaas karte hue, unmen se koi ek kaary bhi karega, use Allah uske kaaran Jannat mein daakhil karega.
3559: Ai ismaaeel ki santaan! Teerandaazi karo; kyonki tumhaare pita ismaaeel teerandaaz the.

Salma bin akva- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kuchh logon ke paas se guzre, jo teerandaazi ka mukaabla kar rahe the. Yeh dekhkar aapne farmayaah ai ismaaeel ki santaan! Teerandaazi karo; kyonki tumhaare pita ismaaeel teerandaaz the.
3561: Nishchay hi toone jis pratiphal ki aasha rakhi hai, woh tujhe milega.

Ubai bin kaab- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki meri jaankaari ke anusaar ek ansaari ka ghar masjid se sabse zyaada door tha, parantu unki koi namaz nahin chhootti thi. So, unse kaha gaya ki yadi aap ek gadha khareed len aur andhere tatha dhoop ki garmi ke samay uspar sawaar hokar ayen to achchha ho. Unhonne kahaah mujhe yeh pasand nahin hai ki mera ghar masjid ke bagal mein ho. Main chaahta hoon ki main jab masjid aaoon to mera aana aur jab ghar waapas jaaoon to mera jaana likha jaye. Ispar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah Allah ne tere liye in sab baaton ko jama kar diya hai.
3563: Sifaarish karo, pratiphal praapt karoge tatha Allah apne Nabi ki zabaan se woh nirnay dega, jo unhe pasand hoga.

Abu moosa ashaari- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas jab koi zarooratmand vyakti aata to apne paas baithe logon ki or murte aur kahteh sifaarish karo, pratiphal praapt karoge tatha Allah apne Nabi ki zabaan se woh nirnay dega, jo unhen pasand hoga. Tatha ek riwayat mein haih jo woh chaahega.

3564: Jab duniya ki samaapti ka samay nikat a jayega to momin ka svapn mushkil hi se jhootha niklega. Tatha momin ka svapn nabuvvat (eeshdauty) ke chhayaalees bhaagon mein se ek bhaag hai.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jab duniya ki samaapti ka samay nikat a jayega to momin ka svapn mushkil hi se jhootha niklega. Tatha momin ka svapn nabuvvat ke chhayaalees bhaagon mein se ek bhaag hai.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih tummen se us vyakti ka svapn sabse sachcha hoga, jo sabse zyaada sach bolta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3565: Ai aaisha! Utho aur witr parho.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) raat ko tahajjud ki namaz parhte aur woh aapke aage soi hui hoteen. Jab witr baaki rah jaati to unhen jagaate aur woh witr parhteen.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih jab witr baaki rahti to kahteh ai aaisha! Utho aur witr parho.

Is hadees ka arth yeh hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- tahajjud ki namaz parhte aur aaisha -radiyallahu anha- aapke saamne soi rahteen. Bukhari evn Muslim ki ek any riwayat mein aaisha -radiyallahu anha- kahti hain : "Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- raat ko tahajjud ki namaz parhte aur main aapke tatha qibla ke beech usi tarah soi rahti, jaise janaaza rakha rahta hai."
Jab aap tahajjud ki namaz poori kar lete aur witr parhna chaahte, to unko jagaate ki woh bhi witr parh len. Muslim ki ek riwayat mein hai : "Jab witr baaqi rah jaati, to farmaate : Aaisha! Utho aur witr parh lo." Jabki abu daaood ki ek riwayat mein hai : "Jab aapko witr parhna hota, to unhen jagaate aur woh bhi witr parhteen."
Is hadees ka arth yeh hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- raat ke pratham bhaag mein aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ko chhor dete aur jagaate nahin the. Yahaan tak ki jab tahajjud poori kar lete aur witr hi shesh rah jaati, to unhen witr parhne ke liye jagaate aur jaldi witr parhne ko kahte, taaki kaheen aisa na ho ki dobaara neend ka ghalba ho jaye aur witr chhoot jaye.

Tatha ek riwayat mein haih mera haath aapke kadmon ke bheetri bhaag par para, jabki aap masjid mein the, donon qadam khare the aur aap kah rahe theh (ai Allah! Mainne dhoondhna shuru kiya, to mere haath aapke pairon ke talvon se ja lage. Daraasal aap masjid mein (sajde ki haalat mein) the aur aapke donon qadam khare the. Aap farma rahe the :  (Ai Allah! Tu pawitr evn prashansneey hai. Tere siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai). Tatha ek riwayat mein haih mera haath aapke kadmon ke bheetri bhaag par para, jabki aap masjid mein the, donon qadam khare the aur aap kah rahe theh (ai Allah!  Main tere krodh se teri prasannata ki sharan maangta hoon, teri saza se tere kshamaadaan ki sharan maangta hoon aur tujhse teri sharan mein aata hoon. Main teri prashansa adhikaar anusaar nahin kar sakta. Tu waisa hi hai, jaisa toone apne baare mein kaha hai).

Aaisha radiyallahu anha kahti hain ki main Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke bagal mein soi hui thi ki raat mein aap bistar par nahin mile. Mainne donon haathon se kamre ki us jagah ko tatola, jahaan Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam namaz parha karte the, to paya ki aap sajde ki haalat mein hain, aapke donon qadam khare hain aur aap kah rahe hain :

Jiska arth hai :  Ai Allah! Main tere krodh se teri  sharan maangta hoon, aur teri prasannata ko iske liye saadhan banaata hoon. Teri saza se teri apaar kshama aur  aapatti se tere door rakhne ki sharan maangta hoon. Main tujh se teri aur tere prataapi gunon se tere sundar gunon ki sharan maangta hoon. Kyonki tujhse sharan kewal tu hi de sakta hai. Allah ke darbaar ko chhor na koi bach nikalne ka sthaan hai aur na koi sharan sthal. Main hazaar prayaason ke baavjood teri un nemton evn upkaaron ko sahi se gin nahin sakta, jo toone mujhpar kiye hain. (Tu waisa hi hain jaisa toone svayn apni prashansa ki hai) tu hi hai jisne apne astitv ki aisi prashansa ki hai jo tere layaq hai, to kaun teri prashansa ka haq ada kar sakta hai?!

Sajde mein in duaaon ko parhna musathab hai.
Meerak kahte hain : Nasaai ki ek riwayat mein hai : Aap yeh dua us samay parhte, jab namaz parh lete aur bistar par chale jaate.
Allah ke gunon dvaara uski prashansa karna aur kitaab wa sunnat se saabit Allah ke naamon dvaara dua karna musathab hai.
Ruku evn sajde mein Allah ki mahaanta bayaan ki jayegi.
Jis prakaar khud Allah ki sharan maangna jayaz hai, usi prakaar uske gunon ki sharan maangna bhi jayaz hai.
Khattaabi kahte hain : Is dua mein ek baareek nukta hai. Nukta yeh hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne Allah se uski naaraazgi se uski raza ki sharan maangi hai, aur uski pakar se uski kshama ki sharan maangi hai. Raza aur naaraazgi donon ek-doosre ke wipreetaarthak shabd hain. Isi prakaar kshama evn pakar bhi ek-doosre ke wipreetaarthak shabd hain. Lekin jab aapne ek aisi hasti ka zikr kiya, jiske wipreet koi nahin hai, to kewal usi ki sharan maangi, kisi aur ki nahin. Matlab yeh hai ki Allah ki bakhoobi ibaadat aur prashansa mein hone waali kotaahi se kshama maangi gai hai. Dua ke shabdon "Main teri prashansa ko shumaar aur gin nahin kar sakta." Ka arth hai : Main iski kshamta nahin rakhta aur yeh mere wash ka kaam nahin hai.
3567: Sabse uttam zikr 'la ilaaha illallah' aur sabse uttam dua 'al-hamdu lillah' hai.

Jaabir bin abdullah radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki main ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko yeh pharmaate hue suna : "Sabse uttam zikr 'la ilaaha illallah' aur sabse uttam dua 'al-hamdu lillah' hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki sabse uttam zikr "La ilaaha illallah" Hai, jiska arth hai, Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai. Jabki sabse uttam dua "Al-hamdu lillah" Hai, jo is baat ka etraaf hai ki saari nemten (anugrah) pradaan karne waala Allah hai, jo sanpoorn sundar gungaan ka haqdaar hai.
Kalima-e-tauheed ke dvaara adhik se adhik Allah ka zikr aur Allah ki prashansa ke dvaara adhik se adhik usse dua karne ki prerna.
[ise tirmizi ne tatha nasai ne al-sunan al-kubra mein evn ibn-e-maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
3568: Sabse uttam daan, Allah ki raah mein tent ki chhaya uplabdh karaana, Allah ki raah mein sewak pradaan karna ya Allah ki raah mein jawaan maada oontni dena hai.

Abu umaama- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Sabse uttam daan Allah ki raah mein tent ki chhaya uplabdh karaana, Allah ki raah mein sewak pradaan karna ya Allah ki raah mein jawaan maada oontni dena hai".
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3569: Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha gaya ki kaun-si namaz sabse uttam hai? To farmayaah- der tak khara rahna.
Jaabir- razyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha gaya ki kaun si namaz sabse uttam hai? To farmayaah "Der tak khara rahna".

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saathiyon ne aapse poochha ki kaun-si namaz sabse uttam hai? Unki or se aksar is prakaar ke prashn isliye hua karte the, kyonki we adhik se adhik maatra mein neki praapt karna chaahte the. Phir, unke is prashn ka matlab hai, kis prakaar ki namaz sabse uttam hai? Ya phir yeh ki namaz ka kaun-sa kaary sabse uttam hai? Qayaam, ruku ya sajda? Aapne uttar diya ki usmen lanbe samay tak khara rahna.
3570: Isne kaary thora kiya aur pratiphal bara pradaan kiya gaya.

Bara bin aazib- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas lohe ka kawach pahna hua ek vyakti aya aur bolaah ai Allah ke Rasool, main yuddh karoon ya Islam grahan karoon? Farmayaah "Islam grahan karo, phir yuddh karo." Atah, woh musalmaan ho gaya aur uske baad yuddh mein shaamil hua aur maara gaya. Aise mein Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Isne kaary thora kiya aur pratiphal bara pradaan kiya gaya."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3571: Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne mujh se pharmaya : “Mujhe Qur'an sunaao”

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne mujh se pharmaya : “Mujhe Qur'an sunaao”, mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Main aapko kuraaan sunaaoon, jabki khud aap par hi Qur'an utra hai? Aapne pharmaya : “Haan”, phir mainne soora nisa parhi, yahaan tak ki jab main is ayat par pahuncha : {فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جِئْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ بِشَهِيدٍ، وَجِئْنَا بِكَ عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ شَهِيدًا} (to kya dasha hogi, jab ham pratyek ummat (samuday) se ek saakshi layenge) [النساء: 41], to aapne pharmaya : “Ab bas karo.” mainne aapki or dekha to paya ki aapki donon aankhon se aansu bah rahe the.

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu se Qur'an mein se kuchh sunaane ko kaha. Unhonne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, main aapko kaise sunaaoon, jabki yeh aap hi par utra hai?! To aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Main chaahta hoon ki ise apne siwa kisi aur se sunoon. Atah, unhonne soora nisa ka kuchh bhaag parha, yahaan tak ki jab Allah taaala ke is kathan par pahunche : {فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جِئْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ بِشَهِيدٍ، وَجِئْنَا بِكَ عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ شَهِيدًا}. Arthaat, aapka aur aapki ummat ka kya haal hoga, jab ham aapko aapki ummat par is baat ka gawaah banaakar layenge ki aapne un tak apne rab ka sandesh pahuncha diya tha. To Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Ab parhna rok do. Ibne masaood radiyallahu anhu ne kaha : Mainne aapki or dekha, to paya ki us sthiti ke bhay aur apni ummat par daya ke kaaran aapki donon aankhon se aansu bah rahe the.

Navvi kahte hain : Tilaawat sunna, poori ekaagrata ke saath uski or kaan lagaana, use sunkar rona aur us par chintan-manan karna musathab hai. Tatha kisi aur se tilaawat karne ke liye kahna taaki use suna ja sake, yeh bhi musathab hai, kyonki yeh svayn tilaawat karne ki tulna mein samajhne aur chintan-manan karne mein adhik prabhaavshaali hai.
Qur'an ki tilaawat karne ki hi tarah, use sunne mein bhi sawaab hai.
Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ki fazeelat yeh hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam unke munh se Qur'an sunna pasand karte the, aur yeh abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ke Qur'an ki talab, use kanthasth karne tatha usmen nipunta praapt karne ke prati tatparta ko darshaata hai.
Allah ki ayton ko sunte samay Allah ke bhay se rone ki fazeelat, kintu shaanti ka paalan, achchhi khaamoshi aur cheekh-pukaar se parhez ke saath.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3572: Mainne tumhen misvaak ke prati bahut zyaada kaha hai.
Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Mainne tumhen misvaak ke prati bahut zyaada kaha hai."
3573: Kya main tumhen Jannat jaane waalon ke wishay mein na bataaoon? Pratyek kamazro evn winamr vyakti, jo Allah par qasam utha le, to Allah uski qasam ki laaj rakh le. Kya main tumhen Jahannam jaane waalon ke wishay mein na bataaoon? Pratyek kroor ashisht, kanjoos evn abhimaani vyakti.

Haarisa bin wahb khuzaai radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Kya main tumhen Jannat jaane waalon ke wishay mein na bataaoon? Pratyek kamazro evn winamr vyakti, jo Allah par qasam utha le, to Allah uski qasam ki laaj rakh le. Kya main tumhen Jahannam jaane waalon ke wishay mein na bataaoon? Pratyek kroor ashisht, kanjoos evn abhimaani vyakti."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne jannatiyon evn jahannamiyon ki kuchh wisheshtayen bataai hain.

Jannat waasiyon mein adhik sankhya aise logon ki hogi, jo winamr, Allah ke aage jhukne waale aur uske saamne deenta prakat karne waale honge. Yahi kaaran hai ki kuchh log unhen kamzor tatha kamtar samajhne lagenge. Lekin Allah ke yahaan unka mahatv itna hoga ki agar Allah ke anugrah ki aasha mein koi qasam kha le, to Allah unki qasam ki laaj rakh le aur unki muraad aur dua poori kar de.

Jabki Jahannam mein adhik sankhya aise logon ki hogi, jo «utull» arthaat: Asabhy, kathor svabhaav waale aur ashleel honge, jo koi achchhi baat nahin maanenge. «javvaaz» yaani ghamandi, pet ke pujaari, bhaari bharkam shareer waale, akarkar chalne waale aur ashisht honge. «mustakbir» yaani saty ko thukraane waale aur doosron ko tuchchh samajhne waale honge.

Jannatvaasiyon ki wisheshtaaon se wisheshit hone ki prerna aur jahannamvaasiyon ki wisheshtaaon se door rahne ki shiksha.
Winamrata ka izhaar Allah ke saamne hota hai, uske aadeshon evn nishedhon tatha unpar amal karne ke sanbandh mein hota hai aur bandon ke saamne bhi is taur par hota hai ki insaan kisi ko heen drishti se na dekhe.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Adhiktar jannati yahi log honge, jaise ki adhiktar jahannami doosre prakaar ke log honge. Yeh bataana uddeshy nahin hai ki donon or bas yahi log honge.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3574: ''Kya main tumhen aisi baaten na bataaoon, jinke zariye Allah gunaahon ko mita deta hai aur darje oonche kar deta hai?

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : ''Kya main tumhen aisi baaten na bataaoon, jinke zariye Allah gunaahon ko mita deta hai aur darje oonche kar deta hai?" Sahaaba ne kaha : Awashy ai Allah ke Rasool! Farmaya : "Pareshaaniyon ke baavjood achchhi tarah wazu karna, insaan ka adhik se adhik masjid jaana aur namaz ke baad agli namaz ki prateeksha karna. Yahi pahredaari hai.''

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne sahaaba se poochha ki kya woh chaahte hain ki aap unko kuchh aise kaaryon ke baare mein batayen, jo gunaahon ki kshama, unhen insaan ke karm likhne waale farishton ke rajistar se mita diye jaane aur Jannat mein oonche sthaan ke sabab bante hon.

Sahaaba ne kaha : Awashy hi batayen. Aapne farmaya :
