1- pareshaani, jaise thandi, paani ki kami shaareerik kasht evn paani garm hone ke baavjood poore taur par aur achchhi tarah wazu karna.

2- masjidon ki or zyaada qadam chalna. Iski do soorten ho sakti hain. Masjid se ghar door ho ya masjid aana-jaana zyaada ho. Hadees mein aye hue shabd "Al-khuta" Ke mayne do qadmon ke beech ki doori ke hain.

3- namaz ke samay ki prateeksha karna, usmen dil ka atka rahna, uski taiyaari karna aur jamaat ke saath namaz parhne ki prateeksha mein masjid ke andar baithe rahna. Ek namaz parh lene ke baad masjid mein baithkar doosri namaz ki prateeksha karna.

Uske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki daraasal yahi kaary haqeeqi muraabta yaani dushman se raksha ke liye sarhad ki pahredaari hai. Kyonki yeh antraatma ki or aane waale shaitaani raaston ko band karte hain, anuchit aakaankshaaon ko dabaate hain aur hriday ko shaitaan dvaara daale gae bure khyaalaat ko grahan karne se rokte hain. Is prakaar, Allah ki sena ko shaitaan ki sena par wijay praapt hoti hai. Yeh sabse bara jihaad hai isi liye  yeh dushman se seema ki raksha karne jaisa hai.

Masjid jaakar jamaat ke saath paabandi se namaz parhne, namaazon ki paabandi karne aur ghaflat na baratne ki fazeelat wa ahmiyat.
Apni baat rakhne aur sahaaba ko prerit karne ka Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka adbhut tareeqa ki baat rakhte samay sabse pahle ek bahut bare sawaab ke baare mein poochha. Daraasal shiksha dene ki yeh ek bahut hi prabhaawi paddhati hai.
Kisi masle ko prashn evn uttar ke roop mein prastut karne ka laabh yeh hai ki kisi baat ko pahle aspasht taur par rakhne aur uske baad use spasht karne se baat dil mein baith jaati hai.
Navvi -Allah unpar daya kare- kahte hain : "Yahi rabaat hai" Ka matlab yeh hai ki yahi woh rabaat hai, jiski prerna di gai hai. Rabaat ke asal mayne kisi cheez par roke rakhne ke hain. Ullikhit prakaar ke insaan ne ek tarah khud ko neki aur bandgi par rok liya. Is baat ki bhi gunjaaish hai ki muraad sabse uttam rabaat liya jaye. Kaha jaata hai : Jihaad naam hai aatma se jihaad karne ka. Yaani sabse uttam jihaad aatma se jihaad karna hai. Is baat ki bhi sanbhaavna hai ki yahaan muraad uplabdh rabaat ho. Yaani yeh bhi ek prakaar ka rabaat hai.
Yahaan rabaat shabd ka prayog ek se adhik baar kiya gaya hai aur uspar nishchitta ko ingit karne waala "Al" Laga hua hai, taaki in kaaryon ke mahatv ko saamne laya ja sake.
3575: Kya main tumhen tumhaara sabse uttam kaary na bataaoon, jo tumhaare rab ke nikat sabse zyaada saraahneey, tumhaare darje ko sabse ooncha karne waala

Abu darda radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Kya main tumhen tumhaara sabse uttam kaary na bataaoon, jo tumhaare rab ke nikat sabse zyaada saraahneey, tumhaare darje ko sabse ooncha karne waala, tumhaare liye sona evn chaandi daan karne se behtar tatha is baat se bhi behtar hai ki tum apne shatru se bhir jaao aur tum unki gardan maar do aur woh tumhaari gardan maar den?" Sahaaba ne kaha : Awashy ai Allah ke Rasool! To farmaya : "Uchch evn mahaanaallah ka zikr karna."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne saathiyon se poochha :

Kya tum chaahte ho ki main tumhen bata doon aur sikha doon   ki tumhaare sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ke yahaan
Tumhaara kaun-sa kaary sarvottam, sarvaadhik sammaanneey, sarvaadhik wiksit, sarvaadhik pawitraaur sarvaadhik svachchh hai?

Jannat mein tumhaare sthaan ko sabse adhik ooncha karne waala hai?

Tumhaare liye sona evn chaandi sadqa karne se behtar hai?

Is baat se bhi uttam hai ki tum awishvaasiyon se yuddh karo, phir tum unki gardan maaro aur woh tumhaari gardan maaren?

Sahaaba ne uttar diya : Ham awashy hi chaahenge ki aap hamen is prakaar ka kaam batayen.

Tab aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Sabhi samyon evn sabhi paristhitiyon mein Allah ka zikr karna.

Aantrik evn baahy roop se hamesha Allah ka zikr karte rahna ek bahut bara neki ka kaam aur Allah ke yahaan bara hi laabhkaari amal hai.
Saare sharai kaary Allah ke zikr ke liye nirdhaarit kiye gae hain. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : "Tum namaz mere zikr ke  liye sthaapit karo." Isi tarah Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kaha hai : "Allah ke ghar kaaba ka tawaaf, safa evn marva ke beech tez chalna aur shaitaan ko patthar maarna, yeh sab Allah ke zikr ke liye nirdhaarit kiye gae hain." Is hadees ko imaam abu daaood evn tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai.
Iz bin abdus salaam apni kitaab "Qawaaid al-ahkaam" Mein kahte hain : Yeh hadees un sharai pramaanon mein se ek hai, jo bataate hain ki sawaab tamaam ibaadton mein thakaan ke anupaat mein hi mila nahin karta. Kabhi-kabhi Allah thore kaary ka badla adhik kaary se bhi zyaada de diya karta hai. Baat asal mein yeh hai ki amal ka sawaab uske mahatv ke anusaar mila karte hain.
Munaawi apni kitaab "Faizul qadeer" Mein kahte hain : Is hadees ka matlab yeh hai ki zikr un logon ke haq mein utkrisht tha, jo us samay aapke saamne upasthit the. Saamne agar aise bahaadur log maujood hote, jo jang ke maidaan mein pahunchkar Islam aur musalmaanon ke liye laabhkaari saabit hote, to unko jihaad utkrisht kaary bataya jaata. Agar aise maaldaar log maujood hote, jinke dhan se ghareebon ko fayda hota, unko utkrisht amal sadqa bataya jaata. Hajj karne ka saamaarthy rakhne waale log maujood hote, to unko utkrisht amal Hajj bataya jaata. Agar aise log hote, jinke maata-pita maujood hote, to unhen unki sewa karna utkrisht amal bataya jaata. Is sanbandh mein aai hui wibhinn hadeeson ko milaakar dekhne se yahi matlab nikalta hai.
Sabse sanpoorn zikr woh hai, jo zabaan se kiya jaye aur saath mein hriday chintan mein laga rahe. Phir us zikr ka darja aata hai, jo kewal hriday se kiya jaye. Jaise ghaur wa fikr. Phir us zikr ka darja aata hai, jo kewal zabaan se kiya jaye. Waise, kisi bhi tarah ho, zikr karna neki ka kaam hai.
Ek musalmaan ko wibhinn samyon ke azkaar, jaise subah evn shaam ke azkaar aur masjid, ghar evn shauchaalay mein prawesh karne aur nikalne ke azkaar ki paabandi karni chahiye. In azkaar ki paabandi insaan ko Allah ko bahut zyaada yaad karne waale logon ki pankti mein la khara kar deti hai.
[ise tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3576: Ai haarisa ki maata, Jannat mein bahut- si shreniyaan hain aur tumhaare bete ne uski sabse oonchi shreni al-firdaus praapt kar li hai.

Anas- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki umme rubaiyi bint bara jo haarisa bin suraaqa ki maan hain, Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aaeen aur boleenh ai Allah ke Rasool, kya aap mujhe haarisa ke baare mein- jo badr ke din maare gae the- nahin batayenge? Yadi woh Jannat mein hai, to sabr kar loongi aur yadi kaheen aur hai, to uspar khoob roungi. Aapne farmayaah "Ai haarisa ki maata, Jannat mein bahut- si shreniyaan hain aur tumhaare bete ne uski sabse oonchi shreni al-firdaus praapt kar li hai."
3578: Mujhe ek aisa waaky maaloom hai ki agar yeh vyakti use parh le, to iska ghussa thanda ho jaye. Agar isne kaha : Main shaitaan se Allah ki sharan mein aata hoon. To iska ghussa thanda ho jayega.

Sulaimaan bin surad radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Main Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath baitha hua tha aur (nikat hi) do vyakti ek-doosre ko gaali galauj kar rahe the. Unmen ek vyakti ka chehra ghusse ke kaaran laal ho gaya tha aur uski ragen phool gai theen. Yeh dekh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Mujhe ek aisa waaky maaloom hai ki agar yeh vyakti use parh le, to iska ghussa thanda ho jaye. Agar isne kaha : Main shaitaan se Allah ki sharan mein aata hoon. To iska ghussa thanda ho jayega." Atah logon ne usse kaha ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Shaitaan se Allah ki sharan maang." To usne uttar diya : Kya main paagal hoon?

Do vyakti Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saamne ek-doosre ko gaali-galauj kar rahe the. Ek ki haalat to yeh thi ki uska chehra laal ho chuka tha aur uski gardan ki ragen phool chuki theen.

Yeh drishy dekh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : Mujhe ek aisa waaky maaloom hai ki agar is ghusse waale vyakti ne use kah liya, to uska ghussa door ho jayega. Use "Main shaitaan se Allah ki sharan mein aata hoon." Kah lena chahiye.

Chunaanche sahaaba ne usse kaha ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne tujhe "Main shaitaan se Allah ki sharan mein aata hoon" Parhne ke liye kaha hai.

Lekin usne uttar diya : Kya main paagal hoon? Use lagta tha ki Allah ki sharan wahi maangta hai, jo paagalpan ka shikaar ho.

Jab koi baat saamne aati, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- uske baare mein uchit maargadarshan dene ke liye taiyaar rahte the.
Ghussa ke peechhe shaitaan ka haath hua karta hai.
Yahaan ghussa aane par dhutkaare hue shaitaan se Allah ki sharan maangne ka aadesh diya gaya hai. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ka farmaan hai : "Agar aapke dil mein shaitaan dvaara koi bura khyaal daala jaye, to Allah ki sharan maang liya keejiye."
Is hadees mein gaali galauj evn laanat karne se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai tatha unse nafrat dilaai gai hai. Kyonki in donon se sanbandh kharaab hota hai.
Jo vyakti updesh na sun sake, us tak updesh pahuncha deni chahiye, taaki usse laabhaanvit ho sake.
Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ghussa se saavdhaan kiya hai, kyonki ghussa buraai aur winaash ka kaaran banta hai. Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko ghussa kewal usi samay aata tha, jab Allah ke aadeshon evn nirdeshon ki avhelna ki jaye. Yeh prashansneey ghussa hai.
Navvi is hadees mein aye hue vyakti ke shabdon "Kya main paagal hoon?" Ke baare mein kahte hain : Ho sakta hai ki yeh baat kahne waala vyakti munaafiq tha ya dehaat ka rahne waala koi ashisht vyakti.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3579: Jab aadam ki santaan subah karti hai, to uske shareer ke saare ang zabaan se winamrataapoorvak kahte hainh hamaare baare mein Allah se dar. Ham to tujhse hi sanbaddh hain; tu seedhi rahi, to ham seedhe rahenge aur tu terhi ho gai to ham bhi terhe ho jayenge.

Abu saeed khudri- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Jab aadam ki santaan subah karti hai, to uske shareer ke saare ang zabaan se winamrataapoorvak kahte hainh hamaare baare mein Allah se dar. Ham to tujhse hi sanbaddh hain; tu seedhi rahi, to ham seedhe rahenge aur tu terhi ho gai to ham bhi terhe ho jayenge."
3580: Koi wastu maangne mein had se jyaada aagrah mat karo. Kyonki tummen se koi vyakti jab mujhse koi cheez maangta hai aur mujhe pasand na hoेne ke baavjood uska sawaal mujhes koi wastu nikaal leta hai, to meri di hui cheez mein barkat nahin di jaati.

Muaawiya bin abu sufyaan- radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Koi wastu maangte hue had se jyaada aagrah mat karo, kyonki tummen se koi vyakti jab mujhse koi cheez maangta hai aur mujhe pasand na hoेne ke baavjood uska sawaal mujhes koi wastu nikaal leta hai, to meri di hui cheez mein barkat nahin di jaati."
3581: Jannat, tummen se kisi vyakti se uske joote ke pheete se bhi adhik nikat hai tatha nark ka bhi yahi haal hai.

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jannat, tummen se kisi vyakti se uske joote ke pheete se bhi adhik nikat hai tatha nark ka bhi yahi haal hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki Jannat evn Jahannam insaan se usi prakaar nikat hain, jis prakaar ki joote ka pheeta nikat hota hai, jo paanv ke oopri bhaag mein hota hai. Kyonki kabhi-kabhi insaan Allah ko khush karne waale ek neki ke kaam ke kaaran Jannat mein daakhil ho jaata hai aur Allah ko naaraaz karne waale ek gunaah ke kaam ki wajah se Jahannam mein dhakel diya jaata hai.

Neki ke kaam ki prerna, chaahe thora hi kyon na ho aur gunaah ke kaam se door rahne ki chetaavni, chaahe kam hi kyon na ho.
Insaan ko jeewan mein bhay tatha aasha donon cheezen rakhni chahiye aur Allah se hamesha saty par qayam rahne ka suyog maangna chahiye, taaki apni haalat par dhokha na khaye.
3583: Ghore ke maathe ki lat se qayaamat ke din tak bhalaai baandh di gai hai

Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Ghore ke maathe ki lat se qayaamat ke din tak bhalaai baandh di gai hai."
Tatha urva al- baariqi- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Ghore ke maathe ki lat par qayaamat ke din tak bhalaai likh di gai haih sawaab tatha ghaneemat ka maal."
[ise donon riwayton ke saath Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3584: Duniya momin ke liye kaaraagaar aur kaafir ke liye Jannat hai
Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Duniya momin ke liye kaaraagaar aur kaafir ke liye Jannat hai."
3585: Ai abu batn, ham kewal shaanti sthaapit karne ke liye jaate hain aur isi liye har milne waale ko salaam karte hain.

Tufail bin ubai bin kaab ka warnan hai ki woh abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- ke paas aate aur unke saath baazaar jaate the. Woh kahte hainh jab ham baazaar jaate, to abdullah bin umar jab kisi raddi saamaan bechne waale, dukaandaar, nirdhan tatha any vyakti se hokar guzarte, use salaam karte. Tuphail kahte hainh ek din main abdullah bin umar ke paas aya aur unhonne mujhe apne saath baazaar jaane ko kaha. Mainne kahaah aap baazaar mein karte kya hain, jabki aap na to kisi bikne waale saamaan ke paas rukte hain, na kisi wastu ke baare mein poochhte hain, na uska mol-tol karte hain aur na baazaar ki baithkon mein baithte hain? Main to aapse kahta hoon ki yahaan hamaare saath baith jayen, taaki kuchh baaten kar saken. Unhonne kahaah ai abu batn, (waastav mein, tufail ka batn arthaat pet barha hua tha, isliye unhen is upnaam se sanbodhit kiya) ham kewal salaam karne ke liye jaate hain aur har milne waale ko salaam karte hain.
3586: Achchha sapna Allah ki or se hai aur bura sapna shaitaan ki or se. Atah jab tum mein se koi vyakti daraavna sapna dekhe, to teen baar bayen or thutkaare aur us sapne ki buraai se Allah ki sharan maange,(aisa karne se) yeh uski haani nahin karega.

Abu qataada radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Achchha sapna Allah ki or se hai aur bura sapna shaitaan ki or se. Atah jab tum mein se koi vyakti daraavna sapna dekhe, to teen baar bayen or thutkaare aur us sapne ki buraai se Allah ki sharan maange,(aisa karne se) yeh uski haani nahin karega."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya ki achchha aur khushi dene waala svapn Allah ki or se hai. Jabki apriy evn chintit karne waala svapn shaitaan ki or se hai.

Atah jo vyakti apriy svapn dekhe, woh baaeen or thutkaare aur uski buraai se Allah ki sharan maange. Kyonki Allah ne ukt kaary ko bure svapn ke nateeje mein saamne aane waali apriy ghatna se suraksha ka saadhan banaya hai.

Arbi shabd "Al-rooa्ya" Evn "Al-hulmu" Se muraad aisi cheezen hain, jinhen insaan sone ki awastha mein dekhta hai. Lekin pahle shabd ka istemaal aam taur se un achchhi aur bhali cheezon ke liye hota hai jinhen woh svapn mein dekhta hai aur doosre shabd ka istemaal aam taur se un buri aur kharaab cheezon ke liye hota hai jinhen woh apne svapn mein dekhta hai. Waise, donon shabdon ka istemaal ek-doosre ke sthaan par bhi hota hai.
Sapnon ke prakaar : 1- achchha sapna : Yeh daraasal Allah ki or se milne waala susmaachaar hua karta hai, jo insaan dekhta hai ya use dikhaya jaata hai. 2- bikhre hue khyaalaat : Yaani aisi baaten jo insaan jage hue awastha mein sochta rahta hai. 3- shaitaan dvaara insaan ko dukhi evn bhaybheet karne ke prayaas mein dikhaai jaane waali cheezen.
Yahaan achchhe sapne ke baare mein jo kuchh bataya gaya hai, usse teen baaten nikalkar saamne aati hain : Achchha sapna dekhne ke baad Allah ki prashansa ki jaye, usse khush hua jaye aur use bata diya jaye, lekin bataya usi ko jaye, jisse prem ho, use nahin, jisse nafrat ho.
Isi tarah bure sapne ke baare mein jo kuchh bataya gaya hai, usse paanch baaten nikalkar saamne aati hain : Uski buraai se Allah ki sharan maangi jaye, shaitaan ki buraai se Allah ki sharan maangi jaye, neend se uthne ke baad teen baar baaeen or thutkaara jaye, uska zikr kisi ke saamne katai na kiya jaye aur jab dobaara sone ka iraada ho to karvat badalkar soya jaye. Itna kar lene ke baad koi nuqsaan nahin hoga.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3587: Ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aya aur kaha : 'Assalaamu alaikum' (aappar shaanti awatrit ho). Aapne uske salaam ka uttar diya aur woh baith gaya. Phir aapne kaha : "Iske liye das nekiyaan likhi gaeen.

Imraan bin husain -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aya aur kaha : 'Assalaamu alaikum' (aappar shaanti awatrit ho). Aapne uske salaam ka uttar diya aur woh baith gaya. Phir aapne kaha : "Iske liye das nekiyaan likhi gaeen." Phir doosra vyakti aya aur bola : 'Assalaamu alaikum wa rahamtullah' (aap par shaanti evn Allah ki daya awatrit ho). To aapne kaha : "Iske liye bees nekiyaan likhi gaeen." Phir teesra vyakti aya aur bola : 'Assalaamu alaikum wa rahamtullahi wa barkaatuh' (aap par shaanti, Allah ki daya aur uski barakten awatrit hon.) to aapne kaha : "Iske liye tees nekiyaan likhi gaeen."

Ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aya aur bola : "Assalaamu alaikum" Aapne uska uttar de diya aur woh baith gaya, to aapne kaha :  Iske liye das nekiyaan likh di gaeen. Phir doosra vyakti aya aur bola : "Assalaamu alaikum wa rahamtullah" Aapne uska uttar de diya aur woh baith gaya, to aapne kaha : Iske liye bees nekiyaan likh di gaeen. Phir ek any vyakti aya aur bola : "Assalaamu alaikul wa rahamtullahi wa barkaatuh" Aapne uska bhi uttar diya aur woh baith gaya, to farmaya : Iske liye tees nekiyaan likh di gaeen. Yaani ek-ek shabd par das-das nekiyaan.

Aane waala vyakti baithe hue logon ko salaam karega.
Salaam ke shabdon mein wriddhi hone se sawaab mein wriddhi ho jaati hai.
Salaam karne ke sabse sanpoorn shabd hain : "Assalaamu alaikum wa rahamtullahi wa barkaatuh" Jabki salaam ka uttar dene ke sabse sanpoorn shabd hain : "Wa alaikumussalaam wa rahamtullahi wa barkaatuh."
Salaam karne aur salaam ka jawaab dene ke star alag-alag hote hain, aur pratiphal bhi alag-alag hote hain.
Logon ko bhalaai ki shiksha dena aur utkrisht ko praapt karne ke liye prerit karna.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Agar salaam karne waala "ورحمة الله" Barhaye, to "وبركاته" Barhaakar jawaab dena musathab hai. Agar woh "وبركاته" Ki wriddhi kare, to uttar mein kuchh aur wriddhi karna shareeyat sammat hoga ya nahin? Isi tarah agar salaam karne waala "وبركاته" Ke aage kuchh aur jorkar salaam karna chaahe, to jayaz hoga ya nahin? (Is sawaal ka jawaab yeh hai ki) imaam maalik ne muwatta mein abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anuma ka yeh kathan naqal kiya hai : Salaam "وبركاته" Par samaapt ho jaata hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, ahmad aur daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai]
3588: Misvaak (daatoon) munh ko saaf karne waali aur Allah ko prasann karne waali wastu hai.

Aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Misvaak (daatoon) munh ko saaf karne waali aur Allah ko prasann karne waali wastu hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki peelu ke per aadi ki shaakha se daanton ko saaf karna, munh ko gandgiyon tatha durgandh se bachaata hai aur isse bande ko Allah ki prasannata praapt hoti hai. Kyonki yeh ek to Allah ke aadesh ka anupaalan hai aur doosra isse svachchhata praapt hoti hai jo Allah ko pasand hai.

Misvaak karne ki fazeelat tatha Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam dvaara ummat ko adhik se adhik misvaak karne ki prerna.
Behtar yeh hai ki misvaak peelu per ki shaakha se kiya jaye. Uske sthaan par brash tatha tooth pest ka istemaal bhi paryaapt hai.
[ise nasai aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3589: Allah, shaheed ke har gunaah ko, qarz ke siwa, kshama kar dega

Abdullah bin amr bin aas- radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Allah, shaheed ke har gunaah ko, qarz ke siwa, kshama kar dega."
Tatha unheen ki ek riwayat mein haih "Allah ke raaste mein maare jaane se, qarz ke siwa har gunaah maaf ho jaata hai."
3591: Paanch namaazen, ek juma doosre jume tak tatha ek Ramzan doosre Ramzan tak, inke beech mein hone waale gunaahon ka kaffaara- prayashchit- ban jaate hain, yadi bare gunaahon se bacha jaye.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam farmaya karte the : "Paanch namaazen, ek juma doosre jume tak tatha ek Ramzan doosre Ramzan tak, inke beech mein hone waale gunaahon ka kaffaara- prayashchit- ban jaate hain, yadi bare gunaahon se bacha jaye."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki din evn raat mein parhi jaane waali paanch farz namaazen, hafte mein ek baar parhi jaane waali jume ki namaz aur saal mein ek baar rakhne jaane waale Ramzan ke roze is dauraan kiye jaane waale chhote gunaahon ka kaffaara (prayashchit) ban jaate hain, shart yeh hai ki bare gunaahon se bacha jaye. Bare gunaah, jaise vyabhichaar aur sharba peena aadi tauba ke bina maaf nahin hote.

Kuchh gunaah chhote hote hain aur kuchh bare.
Chhote gunaah maaf usi samay honge, jab bare gunaahon se bacha jaye.
Bare gunaah se muraad woh gunaah hain, jinka duniya mein koi sharai dand nirdhaarit ho, ya unke karne par aakhirat mein saza ya Allah ki naaraazgi ki baat kahi gai ho, ya unko karne par koi dhamki di gai ho ,ya unke karne waale par laanat ki gai ho. Jaise vyabhichaar evn sharaab peena aadi.
3592: Danga–fasaad ke samay ibaadat karna, meri or hijrat karne ki tarah hai
Maaqil bin yasaar- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain kih Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah " Danga–fasaad ke samay ibaadat karna meri or hijrat karne ki tarah hai."
3594: Ai Allah, mere samuday ke logon ko kshama kar de, kyonki we jaante nahin hain

Abu abdurrahmaan abdullah bin masaood- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki aisa mahsoos hota hai ki main Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko dekh raha hoon ki aap ek Nabi ki ghatna suna rahe hain, jise uske samuday ke logon ne maar- maar kar lahooluhaan kar diya tha aur woh apne chehre se rakt ponchh raha tha tatha kah raha thaah "Ai Allah, mere samuday ke logon ko kshama kar de, kyonki we jaante nahin hain."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3596: Ai Allah! Main tujhse maargadarshan, dharmanishtha, pawitraachaar aur beniyaazi (nisprihta) maangta hoon.

Abdullah bin masaood -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- farmaya karte the : "Ai Allah! Main tujhse maargadarshan, dharmanishtha, pawitraachaar aur beniyaazi (nisprihta) maangta hoon."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jo duayen kiya karte the, unmen se ek dua yeh hai : «allahumma inni asaalukal huda» yaani ai Allah! Main tujhse seedha raasta yaani saty ki pahchaan aur uspar amal karne ka suyog, «wat-tuqa» aadeshon tatha nishedhon ke anupaalan ka jazba, «wal-afaaf» awaidh evn anuchit baaton tatha kaaryon se bachne ki shakti, «wal-ghina» aur srishtiyon se nisprihta ki dua karta hoon, ki tere dvaar ke atirikt kisi aur ke dvaar par jaane ki aawashyakta na ho.

Maargadarshan, dharmaprayanta, pawitrata aur nisvaarthata ki fazeelat, aur unse sushobhit hone ke liye protsaahan.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi apne liye kisi laabh evn haani ke maalik nahin the. Laabh evn haani ka maalik bas Allah hai.
Laabh, haani tatha maargadarshan ka maalik bas Allah hai. Na koi nikatvarti farishta, na Allah ka bheja hua koi Rasool.
3597: Kuchh log Allah ke Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aye aur kaha ki hamaare saath kuchh logon ko bhejen, jo hamen Qur'an aur sunnat sikhayen. Atah aapne unki or sattar ansaariyon ko bheja, jinhen 'al-qurra' (Qur'an parhne waale) kaha jaata tha. Unmen mere maama haraam bhi shaamil the.

Anas- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hainh kuchh log Allah ke Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aye aur kaha ki hamaare saath kuchh logon ko bhejen, jo hamen Qur'an aur sunnat sikhayen. Atah aapne unki or sattar ansaariyon ko bheja, jinhen 'al-qurra' (Qur'an parhne waale) kaha jaata tha. Unmen mere maama haraam bhi shaamil the. We Qur'an parhte, raat ko saamoohik roop se uske arth ke baare mein charcha karke seekhte aur din mein paani laakar masjid mein rakhte, lakri chunkar bechte aur usse suffa (chabootra) waalon aur nirdhanon ke liye bhojan khareed kar laate the. Allah ke Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne in qaariyon ko unke saath bhej to diya, parantu unhonne nirdhaarit sthaan tak pahunchne se pahle hi unpar aakraman karke unhen maar daala. Aise mein, unhonne kahaah ai Allah, hamaari or se apne Nabi ko yeh sandesh pahuncha dena ki ham tujhse a mile hain tatha ham tujhse prasann hain aur tu hamse prasann hai. Isi kram mein ek vyakti ne anas ke maama haraam ke paas peechhe se aakar neza maara, jo unke shareer mein dhans gaya aur aar-paar ho gaya to haraam ne kahaah kaabe ke rab ki qasam, main saphal ho gaya. Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Tumhaare bhaai qatl kar diye gae hain aur unhonne kaha haih ai Allah, hamaari or se apne Nabi ko yeh sandesh pahuncha dena ki ham tujhse a mile hain tatha ham tujhse prasann hain aur tu hamse prasann hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3598: Ai Allah, mainne tere liye Islam grahan kiya, tujhpar eemaan laya, tujhpar bharosa kiya, teri or lauta aur teri sahayta se bahas ki. Ai Allah, tere siwa koi saty poojy nahin. Main is baat se teri sharan mein aata hoon ki tu mujhe pathabhrasht kar de. Tu sada jeewit rahne waala hai, jise kabhi maut nahin a sakti, jabki jinn aur insaan sab mar jayenge.

Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- kaha karte theh "اللَّهُمَّ لك أَسْلَمْتُ، وبِكَ آمَنتُ، وعَلَيكَ تَوَكَّلْت، وإِلَيكَ أَنَبْتُ، وبك خَاصَمْتُ، اللهم أعُوذ بِعزَّتك؛ لا إله إلا أنت أن تُضلَّني، أنت الحَيُّ الذي لا تموت، والجِنُّ والإنْسُ يَمُوتُونَ" Arthaat, ai Allah, mainne tere liye Islam grahan kiya, tujhpar eemaan laya, tujhpar bharosa kiya, teri or lauta aur teri sahayta se bahas ki. Ai Allah, tere siwa koi saty poojy nahin. Main is baat se teri sharan mein aata hoon ki tu mujhe pathabhrasht kar de. Tu sada jeewit rahne waala hai, jise kabhi maut nahin a sakti, jabki jinn aur insaan sab mar jayenge.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3599: Oopar waala haath neeche waale haath se behtar hai. Oopar waala haath kharch karne waala haath hai aur neeche waala haath maangne waala haath hai

Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne minbar par khare hokar daan karne tatha maangne se bachne ka zikr karte hue farmayaah "Oopar waala haath neeche waale haath se behtar hai. Oopar waala haath kharch karne waala haath hai aur neeche waala haath maangne waala haath hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3600: Agar tumne use apne maama logon ko de diya hota, to adhik sawaab milta

Musalmaanon ki maata maimoona bint haaris- radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki unhonne Allah ke Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko bataye bina apni ek daasi ko mukt kar diya. Phir jab unki baari ka din aya, jab aap unke paas aate the, to kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool, kya aapko pata hai ki mainne apni daasi ko mukt kar diya hai? Aapne kahaah "Kya sachmuch tumne aisa kar diya hai?" Unhonne kaha ki haan, to aapne ne kahaah "Agar tumne use apne maama logon ko de diya hota, to adhik sawaab milta."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3601: Allah taaala ne mujhe aadesh diya hai ki tere saamne 'لم يكن الذين كفروا...' parhoon.

Anas bin maalik - radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ubai bin kaab- radiyallahu anhu- se kahaah Allah taaala ne mujhe aadesh diya hai ki tere saamne 'لم يكن الذين كفروا...' parhoon. Unhonne poochha ki kya Allah ne mera naam bhi liya hai?" Farmayaah "Haan!" Yeh sunkar ubai- radiyallahu anhu- ro pare. Tatha ek riwayat mein haih ubai- radiyallahu anhu- rone lage.
[ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3602: Mainne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mukti kya hai? Aapne uttar diya : "Apni zabaan par niyantran rakho, apne ghar ke andar hi raha karo aur apne gunaahon par roya karo.

Uqba bin aamir juhni radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Mainne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mukti kya hai? Aapne uttar diya : "Apni zabaan par niyantran rakho, apne ghar ke andar hi raha karo aur apne gunaahon par roya karo."

Uqba bin aamir radiyallahu anhu ne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha ki woh kaun-kaun si cheezen haiैn, jo ek momin ke liye duniya evn aakhirat mein mukti ka sabab banti hain?

Chunaanche Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unse kaha ki teen baaton ka khyaal rakha karo :

1- sabhi prakaar ki buri evn vyarth baaton se apni zabaan ki raksha karo aur kewal achchhi baaton ke liye hi munh khola karo.

2- apne ghar mein raha karo taaki tanhaai mein Allah ki ibaadat kar sako, uski bandgi mein lage raho aur fitnon se alag raha karo.

3- apne gunaahon par roya karo, sharminda raho aur Allah ke saamne tauba karo.

Sahaaba ki bharpoor koshish raha karti thi ki mukti ke raaste jaan saken.
Duniya wa aakhirat mein mukti dilaane waali cheezon ka bayaan.
Jab doosre ka bhala karna sanbhav na ho ya logon se mel-jol rakhne ki awastha mein apne deen evn khud ka nuqsaan hone ka bhay ho to insaan ko svayn ko apne aap tak seemit kar lena chahiye.
Ghar ko laazim pakarne ki or ishaara, khaaskar fitne ke samay, kyonki yeh dharm ko bachaane ka ek tareeka hai.
[ise tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3607: Koi daas jab apne maalik ka shubhchintak rahe aur achchhi tarah Allah ki ibaadat kare, use doguna pratikaar milega

Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Koi daas jab apne maalik ka shubhchintak rahe aur achchhi tarah Allah ki ibaadat kare, use doguna pratikaar milega."
Abu moosa ashaari- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Jo ghulaam achchhi tarah apne paalanhaar ki ibaadat kare aur apne maalik ke adhikaar ada kare, uska shubhchintak rahe tatha uski baat maankar chale, use doguna pratikaar milega."
[ise donon riwayton ke saath Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3608: Banda Allah taaala ko prasann karne waali koi baat karta hai aur use koi mahatv nahin deta, parantu uske kaaran Allah uski shreniyon ko barha deta hai. Isi tarah, banda Allah taaala ko naaraaz karne waali koi baat karta hai aur use koi mahatv nahin deta, parantu uske kaaran Jahannam mein gir jaata hai.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Banda Allah taaala ko prasann karne waali koi baat karta hai aur use koi mahatv nahin deta, parantu uske kaaran Allah uski shreniyon ko barha deta hai. Isi tarah, banda Allah taaala ko naaraaz karne waali koi baat karta hai aur use koi mahatv nahin deta, parantu uske kaaran Jahannam mein gir jaata hai."
Tatha abu abdur rahmaan bilaal bin haaris muzni- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Banda Allah taaala ko prasann karne waali koi baat munh se nikaalta hai, woh nahin samajhta ki woh baat utni mahatvapoorn hai, jitni ki waastawik roop se hai, Allah uske kaaran apne us bande ke liye milne ke din tak apni prasannata likh deta hai. Isi tarah, banda Allah ko naaraaz karne waali koi baat kah deta hai, use andaaza nahin hota ki woh baat wahaan tak pahunch sakti hai, jahaan tak sachmuch pahunch chuki hai, Allah uske kaaran apne us bande ke liye milne ke din tak apni naaraazgi likh deta hai."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise maalik ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3621: Logon mein Allah se sabse nikat woh vyakti hai, jo unhen salaam karne mein pahal kare

Abu umaama- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Logon mein Allah se sabse nikat woh vyakti hai, jo unhen salaam karne mein pahal kare."
Tatha tirmizi ki ek riwayat mein haih kaha gaya ki ai Allah ke Rasool, do vyakti jab milen, to kaun pahle salaam kare? Farmayaah "Woh, jo Allah taaala se adhik nikat hai."
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3624: Jannat mein ek sau shreniyaan hain, jinhen Allah ne apne maarg mein jihaad karne waalon ke liye taiyaar kar rakha hai. Do shreniyon ke beech utna faasila hai, jitna aakaash aur dharti ke beech mein hai.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Jannat mein ek sau shreniyaan hain, jinhen Allah ne apne maarg mein jihaad karne waalon ke liye taiyaar kar rakha hai. Do shreniyon ke beech utna faasila hai, jitna aakaash aur dharti ke beech mein hai."

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne Allah ke maarg mein yuddh karne waale logon ki fazeelat bataai hai aur is baat ka ullekh kiya hai ki Allah ne Jannat mein unke liye sau darje taiyaar kar rakhe hain, jinmen se har do darjon ke beech mein utna faasla hai, jitna faasla aakaash tatha dharti ke beech mein hai.
3625: Raat mein ek samay hota hai ki jo musalmaan usmen Allah se duniya evn aakhirat se sanbandhit koi bhalaai maangta hua paya jayega, Allah use zaroor pradaan karega. Yeh ghari har raat aati hai

Jaabir- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko farmaate hue sunaah "Raat mein ek samay hota hai ki jo musalmaan usmen Allah se duniya evn aakhirat se sanbandhit koi bhalaai maangta hua paya jayega, Allah use zaroor pradaan karega. Yeh ghari har raat aati hai."
3628: Use de do, kyonki tumhaare andar sabse uttam vyakti woh hai, jo sabse achchhe tareeke se udhaar chukaane waala ho

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas apne qarz ka takaaja karne ke liye aya aur aapke saath ashisht vyavhaar kar daala. Uska vyavhaar dekh sahaaba ne use maarne ka iraada kar liya. Parantu, Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Use chhor do, adhikaar waale ko bolne ka haq hai." Phir farmayaah "Use usi ayu ka oont do, jis ayu ka oont usne mujhe diya tha." Sahaaba ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, hamen usse adhik ayu ka oont hi mil pa raha hai. To farmayaah "Use de do, kyonki tummen sabse uttam vyakti woh hai, jo sabse achchhe tareeke se udhaar chukaane waala ho."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3633: Sabse bari jhoothi baaton mein se yeh hai ki aadmi apne pita ke alaawa kisi aur se sanbandh jore ya apni aankh ko woh dikhaye jo usne dekha na ho ya Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se sanbaddh woh baat kahe, jo aapne na kahi ho

Waasila bin asqa- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Sabse bari jhoothi baaton mein se yeh hai ki aadmi apne pita ke alaawa kisi aur se sanbandh jore ya apni aankh ko woh dikhaye jo usne dekha na ho ya Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se sanbaddh woh baat kahe, jo aapne na kahi ho."
3636: Main apne baare mein apne bande ki soch ke nikat hota hoon tatha main uske saath hota hoon, woh jab bhi mujhe yaad kare.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Uchch evn mahaan Allah kahta hai : Main apne baare mein apne bande ki soch ke nikat hota hoon tatha main uske saath hota hoon, woh jab bhi mujhe yaad kare. Agar woh apne man mein mujhe yaad karta hai, to main bhi use apne man mein yaad karta hoon. Agar woh kisi sabha mein mera zikr karta hai, to main uska zikr aisi sabha mein karta hoon, jo uski sabha se behtar hoti hai. Agar woh meri or ek bitta aata hai, main uski or ek haath jaata hoon, aur agar meri or ek haath aata hai, main uski or do haath jaata hoon tatha agar meri or chalkar aata hai, main uski or daurkar jaata hoon."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya ki uchch evn mahaan Allah farmaata hai :

Main waisa hi hoon jaisa mera sewak mere baare mein sochta hai, chunaanche main apne sewak ke saath uski ummeed ke hisaab se pesh aata hoon, arthaat maafi aur bhalaai ki ummeed ke saath , aur main uske liye wahi karta hoon jo woh mujhse ummeed karta hai, chaahe achchha ho ya bura, aur jab woh mujhe yaad karta hai to main daya, taufeeq, maargadarshan, dekhbhaal aur sahaare ke saath uske saath hota hoon.

Agar woh ekaant mein subhaan Allah evn la ilaaha illallah aadi kahkar mujhe yaad karta hai, to main use ekaant mein yaad karta hoon.

Agar woh mujhko logon ke samooh mein yaad karta hai, to main use kaheen bare aur pawitr samooh ke saamne yaad karta hoon.

Jo Allah ki or ek bitta aage barhta hai, Allah uski or ek haath aage barhta hai.

Jo Allah ki or ek haath aage barhta hai, Allah uski or do haath aage barhta hai.

Jo Allah ki or chalkar aata hai, Allah uski or daurkar jaata hai.

Saaraansh yeh ki jab banda apne paalanhaar ki or uski ibaadat evn bandgi ke saath aage barhta hai, to Allah use apne se aur qareeb kar leta hai, badle ke taur jo uske kaary hi ki tarah hota hai.

Bande ki bandgi jitni sanpoorn hogi, Allah usse utna hi nikat hoga. Allah bande ko sawaab aur badla uske amal aur koshish se kaheen barhkar deta hai. Kul milaakar, gunvatta aur parimaan ke maamle mein, Allah ka inaam bande ke dvaara kiye gae kaam se zyaada hota hai.

Ek momin ki shaan yeh hai ki woh Allah se achchha gumaan rakhe, amal karta rahe, neki ke kaamon mein tezi se aage barhta rahe aur adhik se adhik achchhe kaam karta rahe. Yeh silsila Allah se milne tak jaari rakhe.

Yeh hadees un hadeeson mein se hai, jo Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne rab se riwayat karke kaha hai. Is tarah ki hadees ko hadees-e-qudsi ya hadees-e-ilaahi kaha jaata hai. Isse muraad woh hadees hai, jiske shabd tatha arth donon Allah ke hon. Albatta iske andar Qur'an ki wisheshtayen, jaise uski tilaawat ka ibaadat hona, uske liye tahaarat praapt karna tatha uska chamatkaar hona aadi, nahin paai jaati.
Aajurri kahte hain : "Satyawaadi sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ke wahi gun bayaan karte hain, jo khud Allah ne bayaan kiye hain, uske Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bayaan kiye hain aur sahaaba radiyallahu anhum ne bayaan kiye hain. Yahi sunnat ke anusrankaari evn bidaat se daaman bachaane waale ulema ka tareeqa hai." Atah ahl-e-sunnat sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ke unheen gunon ko saabit karte hain, jinhen khud Allah ne apne liye saabit kiya hai. We in gunon ko batlaane waale shabdon ke saath na chher-chhaar karte hain, na unhen arthaheen banaate hain, na un gunon ki misaal dete hain aur na unki kaifiyat bataate hain. Isi tarah we Allah ko un gunon se paak maante hain, jinse usne khud ko paak ghoshit kiya hai. We un maamlon par chup rahte hain jinke baare mein na to koi pushti hoti hai aur na hi koi khandan. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : "Uske jaisi koi cheez nahin hai aur woh sab kuchh sunne waala, sab kuchh dekhne waala hai."
Allah ke baare mein achchha gumaan rakhne ke saath-saath amal ki bhi laazmi hai. Hasan basri kahte hain : Ek momin apne paalanhaar ke baare mein achchha gumaan rakhta hai aur achchha amal karta hai, jabki ek gunaahgaar apne paalanhaar ke baare mein bura gumaan rakhta hai aur bura amal karta hai.
Qurtubi kahte hain : Kuchh log kahte hain : "Main apne bande ke gumaan ke anusaar kaam karta hoon" Se muraad, Allah ke waade par sampoorn wishvaas rakhte hue, dua ke samay jholi bhar diye jaane ka gumaan, tauba karte samay tauba ke qabool hone ka gumaan, kshama maangte samay kshama daan ka gumaan aur sharton ko poora karte hue ibaadat karte samay pratiphal evn sawaab milne ka gumaan hai. Isliye bande ko apni zimmewaariyaan poori tanmayta evn is wishvaas ke saath ada karni chahiye ki Allah grahan karega aur kshama karega. Kyonki yeh uska waada hai aur woh apna kiya hua waada nahin torta. Iske wipreet yadi kisi ko wishvaas ho ya lagta ho ki Allah uski ibaadat qabool nahin karega ya use ibaadat ka koi fayda nahin hoga, to yeh Allah ki daya se niraasha evn maha paap hai. Is niraasha ke saath marne waale ke saath uske gumaan ke anusaar hi vyavhaar kiya jayega, jaisa ki is hadees ki kuchh riwayton mein aya hai : "Atah mera banda mere baare mein jo gumaan rakhna chaahe, rakhe." Woh kahte hain : Jahaan tak gunaah par qayam rahne ke baavjood kshama ka gumaan rakhne ki baat hai, to yeh moorkhata evn dhokha mein rahna hai.
Zabaan evn dil donon se adhik se adhik Allah ka zikr karne ki prerna. Insaan ke dil mein Allah ka bhay rahe, uski mahaanta evn adhikaar ka ehsaas rahe, usse aasha rahe, prem rahe, achchha gumaan rahe, wishuddh roop se usi ke liye amal karne ki bhaavna rahe aur zabaan par subhaan Allah, al-hamdu lillah, la ilaaha illallah, Allahu akbar aur la haula wa la quvvata illa billah jaise azkaar rahen.
Ibn abu jamra kahte hain : Jo bhayaakraant hokar Allah ko yaad karega, Allah use shaanti dega aur jo ghabraye hue awastha mein Allah ko yaad karega, Allah uski ghabraahat door karega.
Ash- shibru: Ise hindi mein bitta kahte hain. Isse muraad hai hatheli ko phaila dene ke baad kanishtha ke kinaare se angoothe ke kinaare tak ki doori. Al-ziraau: Beech waali ungli ke kinaare se kohni ki haddi ke beech ki doori. Al-baau : Donon haathon, donon baazuon aur seene ki chauraai ke beech ki doori. Sab milaakar kul chaar haath hua karte hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3645: Suffa waalon tatha aam sahaaba ki duniya se nisprihta

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hainh mainne sattar suffa waalon ko dekha. Unmen se kisi ke paas choga nahin hota tha. Ya to lungi hoti thi ya phir chaadar, jise we apne gale se baandh lete the, jo kabhi aadhi pindliyon tak pahunchti thi, to kabhi takhnon tak. Use we apne haathon se pakre rahte the, taaki unke guptaang khulne na payen.
3652: Mainne aaisha radiyallahu anha se poochha ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab ghar aate, to sabse pahle kaun-sa kaam karte the? Unhonne uttar diya : Aap sabse pahle misvaak kiya karte the.

Shuraih bin haani se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Mainne aaisha radiyallahu anha se poochha ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab ghar aate, to sabse pahle kaun-sa kaam karte the? Unhonne uttar diya : Aap sabse pahle misvaak kiya karte the.
Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka maamool tha ki ghar mein prawesh karne ke baad sabse pahle misvaak karte. Samay chaahe jo bhi ho. Raat ho ki din.

Waise to misvaak karna sabhi samyon mein waanchhit hai, lekin kuchh samyon mein uski taakeed hai, jinmen shareeyat ne misvaak karne ki taakeed ki hai. Jaise ghar mein prawesh karte samay, namaz ke samay, wazu ke samay, neend se jaagte samay aur munh ka gandh badal jaane par.
Taabeeen Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke haalaat aur sunnaton ko jaanne ki bari jijnaasa rakhte the, taaki aapka anusran kar saken.
Jnaan tatha apne se adhik jaankaari rakhne waalon se jnaan arjit karne ki prerna. Yahaan aaisha radiyallahu anha se poochha gaya hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ghar mein prawesh karte samay kis awastha mein hote the?
Ghar waalon ke saath jeewan bitaane ka Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka sundar tareeqa ki ghar mein prawesh karte samay munh saaf kar liya karte the.
3653: To suno, uska dhan woh hai, jo usne aage bhej diya aur uske waaris ka dhan woh hai, jo usne peechhe chhor diya

Abdullah bin masaood- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Tummen se kise apne dhan ki tulna mein apne waaris ka dhan adhik priy hai?" Sahaaba ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, hammen se har vyakti ko apna dhan adhik priy hai. Yeh sunkar aapne farmayaah "To suno, uska dhan woh hai, jo usne aage bhej diya aur uske waaris ka dhan woh hai, jo usne peechhe chhor diya."
3655: Subah se pahle witr parhne mein jaldi karo
Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Subah hone se pahle witr parhne mein jaldi karo."
3656: Ek vyakti ne ek stri ko bosa dekar Allah ke Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko aakar bataya, to Allah taaala ne yeh ayat utaareeh "وأقم الصلاة طَرَفَيِ النَّهَار وزُلَفًا مِنَ اللَّيلِ إِنَّ الحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبنَ السَّيِئَات" (Din ke donon kinaaron aur raat ke kuchh bhaagon mein namaz kayam karo. Nishchay hi nekiyaan gunaahon ko mita deti hain.) (soora hoodah 114) us vyakti ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, kya yeh mere saath khaas hai? Aapne kahaah nahin, balki meri ummat ke tamaam logon ke liye hai.

Abdullah bin masaood- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki ek vyakti ne ek stri ko bosa dekar Allah ke Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko aakar bataya, to Allah taaala ne yeh ayat utaareeh "وأقم الصلاة طَرَفَيِ النَّهَار وزُلَفًا مِنَ اللَّيلِ إِنَّ الحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبنَ السَّيِئَات" (Din ke donon kinaaron aur raat ke kuchh bhaagon mein namaz kayam karo. Nishchay hi nekiyaan gunaahon ko mita deti hain.) (soora hoodah 114) us vyakti ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, kya yeh mere saath khaas hai? Aapne kahaah "Nahin, balki meri ummat ke tamaam logon ke liye hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3658: Ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aakar bolaah ai Allah ke Rasool, main had (dhaarmik dand) ka adhikaari ho gaya hoon. Atah, mujhpar had jaari kar den.

Anas- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aakar bolaah ai Allah ke Rasool, main had (dhaarmik dand) ka adhikaari ho gaya hoon. Atah, mujhpar had jaari kar den. Isi beech namaz ka samay a gaya aur woh Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath namaz mein shaamil ho gaya. Jab namaz poori ho gai, to phir bola ki ai Allah ke Rasool, main had ka haqdaar ho gaya hoon, atah mujhpar Allah ki kitaab ka nirnay laagu kar den. Ispar aapne kahaah "Kya tu hamaare saath namaz mein shareek tha?" Usne kahaah ji haan! To aapne kahaah "Ja, tujhe kshama kar diya gaya hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3667: Jab Allah kisi samuday par anugrah karna chaahta hai, to usse pahle hi uske Nabi ko utha leta hai aur use uska agradoot aur sifaarishi bana deta hai

Abu moosa ashaari- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Jab Allah kisi samuday par anugrah karna chaahta hai, to usse pahle hi uske Nabi ko utha leta hai aur use uska agradoot aur sifaarishi bana deta hai. Tatha jab kisi samuday ka winaash chaahta hai, to use Nabi ke jeete ji azaab deta hai aur uski aankhon ke saamne winasht kar deta hai. Is tarah, uski halaakat se Nabi ki aankhon ki thandak ka saamaan karta hai, jab samuday ke log use jhuthlaane lagte hain aur uske aadesh ka ullanghan shuru kar dete hain."
3686: Meri or se mili waani doosron tak pahuncha do, chaahe ek ayat hi ho, tatha israaeeli wansh ke logon ki ghatnaaon ka warnan karo, ismen koi harj nahin hai, tatha jisne mujhpar jaan-boojhkar jhooth bola, woh apna thikaana Jahannam mein bana le.

Abdullah bin amr radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Meri or se mili waani doosron tak pahuncha do, chaahe ek ayat hi ho, tatha israaeeli wansh ke logon ki ghatnaaon ka warnan karo, ismen koi harj nahin hai, tatha jisne mujhpar jaan-boojhkar jhooth bola, woh apna thikaana Jahannam mein bana le."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aapki or se jnaan pahunchaane ka aadesh de rahe hain, jo Qur'an ke roop mein ho ya hadees ke roop mein, chaahe woh jnaan thora-sa maslan Qur'an ki ek ayat ya ek hadees hi kyon na ho. Shart yeh hai ki pahunchaane waala us cheez ko jaanta ho, jise woh pahunchaana chaahta hai. Phir aapne bataya ki bani israaeel ki un ghatnaaon ko bayaan karne mein koi harj nahin hai, jo hamaari shareeyat ke saath takraati na hon. Phir aapne apne oopar jhooth baandhne se saavdhaan kiya hai aur bataya hai ki jo aap par jaan-boojhkar jhooth baandhega, woh apna thikaana Jahannam mein bana le.

Allah ki shareeyat ko doosron tak pahunchaane ki prerna aur is baat ka protsaahan ki insaan ko deen ki un baaton ko doosron tak pahuncha dena chahiye, jinko usne yaad kiya aur samjha hai, chaahe woh thori hi kyon na hon.
Sharai jnaan arjit karna waajib hai, taaki insaan Allah ki ibaadat karne aur uski shareeyat ko doosron tak pahunchaane ka kaam sahi tareeqe se kar sake.
Kisi hadees ko doosre tak pahunchaane ya use phailaane se pahle uske sahi hone ki pushti kar leni chahiye, taaki insaan is chetaavni ke dayre mein na a jaye.
Aam baatcheet ke dauraan sach bolne aur hadees bayaan karte samay sachet rahne ki prerna, taaki insaan jhooth mein parne se bach sake. Khaas taur se Allah ki shareeyat ke baare mein saavdhaan rahne ki adhik aawashyakta hai.
3688: Ek vyakti ne Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aane ki anumti maangi, to farmayaah use aane do, woh apne qabeele ka bahut bura vyakti hai

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki ek vyakti ne Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aane ki anumti maangi, to farmayaah "Use aane do, woh apne qabeele ka bahut bura vyakti hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3689: Mujhe koi aisa karm batayen ki use karoon, to Jannat mein daakhil ho jaaoon. Farmaya : "Allah ki ibaadat karo, kisi ko uska saajhi na banaao, farz namaz kayam karo, farz zakat ada karo aur Ramzan ke roze rakho.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai : Ek dehaati Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya aur kaha : Mujhe koi aisa karm batayen ki use karoon, to Jannat mein daakhil ho jaaoon. Farmaya : "Allah ki ibaadat karo, kisi ko uska saajhi na banaao, farz namaz kayam karo, farz zakat ada karo aur Ramzan ke roze rakho." Usne kaha : Uski qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main isse zyaada kuchh nahin karoonga. Jab woh waapas hua, to Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jo kisi jannati vyakti ko dekhna chaahe, woh ise dekh le."

Dehaat ka rahne waala ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya, taaki aap use Jannat mein daakhil karne waala koi amal bata den. Atah aapne use bataya ki Jannat mein prawesh aur Jahannam se mukti Islam ke stanbhon ke anupaalan par nirbhar hai, jo is prakaar hain : Ek Allah ki ibaadat karna aur kisi ko uska saajhi na banaana. Paanch waqt ki namaz qayam karna, jinhen Allah ne raat aur din mein apne bandon par farz kiya hai. Dhan ki zakat, jo aniwaary hai, nikaal kar haqdaaron ko dena. Ramzan maheene ke roze samay par paabandi se rakhna. Itna sunne ke baad us vyakti ne kaha : Us hasti ki qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main aapse sune hue aniwaary kaaryon se na zyaada karoonga, na kam. Atah jab woh vyakti jaane laga, to Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Jise koi jannati insaan dekhna ho, woh is dehaati vyakti ko dekh le.

Allah ki or bulaane ke kaam ka aaranbh ek Allah ki ibaadat se hona chahiye.
Nae-nae musalmaan hone waale insaan ko pahle kewal aniwaary cheezen sikhaani chahiye.
Yeh zaroori hai ki Allah ki or bulaane ka kaary kramik kiya jaye.
Insaan ko apne deen ki baat seekhne ka utsuk hona chahiye.
Kewal aniwaary kaaryon ke paalan se bhi Muslim vyakti saphal ho jayega. Lekin iska matlab yeh nahin hai ki insaan nafal ibaadton ki adaygi mein susti se kaam le. Kyonki nafal ibaadton dvaara farz ibaadton mein rah jaane waali kamiyaan door hoti hain.
Kuchh ibaadton ka hi kewal ullekh unka mahatv evn aniwaaryata bataata hai. Iska matlab yeh nahin hai ki doosri ibaadten aniwaary nahin hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3695: Agar duniya, Allah ke nikat machchhar ke par ke baraabar bhi mahatv rakhti, to Allah kisi kaafir ko uska ek ghoont paani tak nahin deta

Sahl bin saad saaidi- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Agar duniya, Allah ke nikat machchhar ke par ke baraabar bhi mahatv rakhti, to Allah kisi kaafir ko uska ek ghoont paani tak nahin deta."

Is hadees mein bayaan kiya gaya hai ki duniya Allah ke nikat ek tuchchh evn moolyaheen wastu hai. Yadi Allah ke nikat uska zara bhi mooly hota, to kisi kaafir ko uski nemton se laabhaanvit hone ka avsar dena to door, ek ghoont paani tak na deta. Jabki iske wipreet aakhirat kabhi na khatm hone waali nemton ka ghar hai, jo wishesh roop se mominon ke liye taiyaar ki gai hai aur usmen kaafiron ko prawesh ki anumti nahin hogi. Atah eemaan waalon ko is tathy se avgat hona chahiye aur duniya ki or jhukaav se bachna chahiye, kyonki yeh insaan ki yaatra ka ek paraav hai hamesha rahne ki jagah nahin hai. Unhen duniya se kewal itni cheezen praapt karni chahiye ki aakhirat mein, jo ki hamesha rahne ka ghar hai, unke kaam a saken. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ka farmaan hai : "Tatha jo kuchh tum diye gaye ho, woh saansaarik jeewan ka saamaan tatha uski shobha hai aur jo Allah ke paas hai uttam tatha sthayi hai, to kya tum samajhte nahin ho? To kya jise hamne wachan diya hai ek achchha wachan aur woh paane waala ho use, uske jaisa ho sakta hai, jise hamne de rakha hai (tuchchh) saansaarik jeewan ka saamaan, phir woh pralay ke din upasthit kiye logon mein hoga?"
3696: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab tabook yuddh se waapas aye, to logon ne aapki agvaani ki aur mainne bachchon ke saath saneeytul wada par aapki agvaani ki

Saaib bin yazeed- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab tabook yuddh se waapas aye, to logon ne aapki agvaani ki aur mainne bachchon ke saath saneeytul wada par aapki agvaani ki.
Tatha bukhaari ki riwayat mein haih woh kahte hain ki ham Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki agvaani ke liye bachchon ke saath saneeytul wada tak gae.
[ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3697: Teen aadmi aise hain, jinko doguna sawaab milega. Ek woh ahle kitaab jo apne Nabi par eemaan laya aur phir Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) par eemaan laya, doosra woh ghulaam jo Allah ka aur apne maalikon ka haq ada karta raha aur teesra woh vyakti, jiske paas koi daasi ho, phir woh use shishtaachaar sikhaye aur achchhi tarah sikhaye tatha shiksha de aur achchhi se achchhi shiksha de aur aazaad karke shaadi kar le, to uske liye bhi doguna sawaab hai.

Abu moosa ashaari- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: "Teen aadmi aise hain, jinko doguna sawaab milega. Ek woh ahle kitaab (yahoodi aur eesaai) jo apne Nabi par eemaan laya aur phir Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) par eemaan laya. Doosra woh ghulaam jo Allah ka aur apne maalikon ka haq ada karta raha aur teesra woh vyakti jiske paas koi daasi ho, phir woh use sadaachaar sikhaye aur achchhi tarah sikhaye tatha shiksha de aur achchhi se achchhi shiksha de aur aazaad karke shaadi kar le, to uske liye bhi doguna sawaab hai."
3698: Hamen duniya ki woh saari wastuen pradaan ki gaeen, jo tum dekh rahe ho. Hamen to kabhi-kabhi bhay lagta hai ki kaheen hamaare achchhe karmon ka badla duniya hi mein na de diya gaya ho.

Ibraaheem bin abdurrahmaan bin auf ka warnan hai ki abdurrahmaan bin auf - radiyallahu anhu- roze se the, jab unke saamne (iftaar ke samay) khaana parosa gaya, to kahaah musaab bin umair, jo ki mujhse behtar the, shaheed hue, to kaphan ke liye ek chaadar ke siwa kuchh na mil saka. Woh bhi aisi ki sir dhaanpa jaata to donon paanv khul jaate aur paanv dhaanpe jaate to sir khul jaata. Phir hamaare liye duniya ko phaila diya gaya, jo tum dekh rahe ho. Ya unhonne kahaah hamen duniya ki woh saari wastuen pradaan ki gaeen, jo tum dekh rahe ho. Hamen to kabhi-kabhi bhay lagta hai ki kaheen hamaare achchhe karmon ka badla duniya hi mein na de diya gaya ho. Phir ro pare aur khaane ko haath bhi na lagaya.
3700: “Agar yeh sach kah raha hai, to kaamyaab ho gaya.”

Talha bin ubaidullah radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Najd ka ek vyakti Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya. Uske baal bikhre hue the. Ham uski aawaaz ka gunjan to sun rahe the, magar yeh nahin samajh pa rahe the ki woh kah kya raha hai? Yahaan tak ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke nikat a gaya. Phir hamne dekha ki woh Islam ke baare mein poochh raha hai. Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : “ Din-raat mein paanch namaazen parhna.” usne kaha : Inke alaawa bhi mujhpar koi namaz farz hai? Aapne farmaya : “Nahin, magar yeh ki tu apni khu़shi se parhe.” phir Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : “Aur Ramzan ke roze rakhna.” usne kaha : Aur to koi roza mujhpar farz nahin hai? Aapne farmaya : "Nahin, magar yeh ki tu apni khushi se rakhe." Phir Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne usse zakat ka bhi zikr kiya. Usne kaha : Mujhpar iske alaawa bhi kuchh dena farz hai? Aapne farmaya : “ Nahin, magar yeh ki tu apni khushi se sadqa de.” phir woh vyakti yeh kahta hua waapas chala gaya ki Allah ki qasam, na main isse zyaada karoonga aur na kam. Atah Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : “Agar yeh sach kah raha hai, to kaamyaab ho gaya.”

Najd ka rahne waala ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya. Uske baal bikhre hue aur aawaaz oonchi thi. Lekin yeh samajh mein nahin a raha tha ki woh kah kya raha hai? Woh Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke nikat a gaya aur Islam ke aniwaary kaaryon ke baare mein poochhne laga.

Jawaab mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aaranbh namaz se kiya aur bataya ki Allah ne uspar din aur raat mein paanch samay ki namaazen farz ki hain.

Itna sunne ke baad usne poochha ki kya in paanch namaazon ke itirikt bhi mujhpar koi namaz farz hai?

Aapne uttar diya : Nahin, parantu tum nafal namaazen jitni chaaho, parh sakte ho.

Iske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Tumpar Ramzan maheene ke roze bhi farz hain.

Usne poochha : Kya Ramzan maheene ke roze ke alaawa bhi koi roza mujhpar farz hai?

Aapne jawaab diya : Nahin, parantu tum nafal roza rakhna chaaho, to rakh sakte ho.

Phir aapne uske saamne zakat ka zikr kiya.

Atah usne poochha : Kya farz zakat ke baad bhi koi sadqa zaroori hai?

Aapne uttar diya : Nahin, parantu nafli sadqe karna chaaho, to kar sakte ho.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se in aniwaary kaaryon ko sunne ke baad woh vyakti chala gaya. Jaate hue usne Allah ki qasam khaakar bataya ki woh koi kami-beshi kiye bina in aniwaary kaaryon ka paalan karega. Uski baat sunkar Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaaा : Yeh aadmi agar apni qasam par khara utra, to saphal ho jayega.

Islaami shareeyat ek udaar evn aasaan shareeyat hai.
Is vyakti ke saath Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka achchha vyavhaar ki use nikat aane tatha prashn karne ka avsar diya.
Allah ki or bulaane ka kaary ati mahatvapoorn wastu se mahatvapoorn wastu ki or jaate hue marhalaawaar kiya jaana chahiye.
Islam aqeeda evn amal ka naam hai. Na eemaan ke bina amal laabhkaari hai, aur na amal ke bina eemaan.
In kaaryon ka mahatv. Ye kaary Islam ke stanbhon mein shaamil hain.
Jume ki namaz paanch samay ki farz namaazon mein daakhil hai. Kyonki jume ki namaz jispar waajib hai, use yeh namaz us din ke zuhar ki namaz ke badle mein parhni hoti hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne shiksha dene ka aaranbh namaz se kiya, jo ki donon gawaahiyon ke baad Islam ka sabse mahatvapoorn aniwaary kaary hai. Donon gawaahiyon ka zikr isliye nahin kiya ki poochhne waala vyakti musalmaan tha. Isi tarah Hajj ka zikr isliye nahin kiya ki yeh ghatna Hajj farz hone se pahle ka hai ya phir uska samay nahin aya tha.
Shareeyat dvaara aniwaary kiye gae kaaryon ka anupaalan hi uski saphalta ke liye kaafi hai. Lekin iska arth yeh nahin hai ki nafal kaaryon ko karna sunnat nahin hai. Kyonki qayaamat ke din naflon dvaara aniwaary kaaryon mein rah jaane waali kamiyon ko poora kiya jayega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3701: Musalmaan ko jo bhi rog, thakaan, dukh, gam, kasht aur wipatti pahunchti hai, yahaan tak ki ek kaanta bhi chubhta hai, to uske zariye Allah uske gunaahon ko mita deta hai.

Abu saeed khudri tatha abu huraira radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Musalmaan ko jo bhi rog, thakaan, dukh, gam, kasht aur wipatti pahunchti hai, yahaan tak ki ek kaanta bhi chubhta hai, to uske zariye Allah uske gunaahon ko mita deta hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki musalmaan ko jo bhi beemaariyaan, gham, duhkh, pareshaaniyaan, museebten, kathinaaiyaan, bhay aur aarthik wipattiyaan aati hain, yahaan tak ki use ek kaanta bhi chubhta hai, jo uske liye kashtakaarak hota hai, to yeh saari cheezen uske liye gunaahon ka kaffaara (prayashchit) ban jaati hain.

Bandon par Allah ka anugrah evn daya ki unko hone waale chhote-chhote kasht ke kaaran unke gunaahon ko maaf kar deta hai.
Musalmaan ko museebton ko Allah ke yahaan milne waale pratiphal ka saadhan samajhna aur har chhoti-bari museebat par sabr karna chahiye, taaki uske darje (shreni) oonche hon aur uske gunaah mita diye jayen.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3702: Jahannam ko abhilaashaaon se gher diya gaya hai aur Jannat ko apriy cheezon se gher diya gaya hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jahannam ko abhilaashaaon se gher diya gaya hai aur Jannat ko apriy cheezon se gher diya gaya hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki Jahannam ko aisi cheezon se gher diya gaya hai, jo insaan ke man ko achchhi lagti hain, jaise haraam kaamon ko karna aur kartavyon ke anupaalan mein susti karna aadi. Isliye jo apne nafs ko khvaahishon ke peechhe daurayega, woh Jahannam ka haqdaar ban jayega. Jabki Jannat ko aisi cheezon se gher diya gaya hai, jo man ko apriy hain. Jaise paabandi se Allah ke aadeshon ka paalan karna, haraam kaamon se door rahna aur is raah mein aane waali har pareshaani ka saamna karna. Jab insaan apne nafs se larte hue in kaamon ko karta hai, to woh Jannat ka haqdaar ban jaata hai.

Man ki kaamnaaon mein parne ka ek sabab yeh hai ki shaitaan buraai tatha ghalat kaam ko sundar banaakar prastut karta hai, jiske kaaran insaan ka man use achchha samajhta hai aur uski or jhukne lagta hai.
Ismen haraam khvaahishon ke peechhe bhaagne se mana kiya gaya hai, kyonki yeh Jahannam ka maarg hai. Jabki apriy cheezon ko sahan karne ki prerna di gai hai, kyonki yeh Jannat ka maarg hai.
Apne nafs se larne, adhik se adhik ibaadat karne aur ibaadton ke saath juri hui apriy cheezon ko sahan karne ki prerna.
3703: Ai hakeem! Yeh dhan dekhne mein suhaana aur khaane mein meetha hota hai. Jo ise bina kisi lobh ke leta hai, use usmen barkat di jaati hai, aur jo ise lobh ke saath leta hai, use usmen barkat nahin di jaati tatha uska haal us vyakti ki tarah ho jaata hai jo khaata to hai, lekin santusht nahin hota. Tatha oopar waala haath neeche waale haath se uttam hai.

Hakeem bin hizaam- radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se maanga, to mujhe diya, phir maanga to diya, phir maanga to diya, phir farmayaah "Ai hakeem! Yeh dhan dekhne mein suhaana aur khaane mein meetha hota hai. Jo ise bina kisi lobh ke leta hai, use usmen barkat di jaati hai aur jo ise lobh ke saath leta hai, use usmen barkat nahin di jaati tatha uska haal us vyakti ki tarah ho jaata hai jo khaata to hai, lekin santusht nahin hota. Tatha oopar waala haath neeche waale haath se uttam hai." Hakeem kahte hain ki mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Uski qasam jisne aapko saty ke saath bheja hai, main jab tak jeewit rahoonga, aapke baad kisi se kuchh nahin maangoonga. Isliye, baad mein abu bakr- radiyallahu anhu- hakeem- radiyallahu anhu- ko unka bhaag dene ke liye bulaate the, parantu woh kuchh bhi lene se inkaar kar dete the. Phir umar- radiyallahu anhu- unhen unka bhaag dene ke liye bulaate the, parantu woh grahan karne se inkaar kar dete the. Atah umar- radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha thaah musalmaano! Main tumhen is baat ka gawaah banaata hoon ki mainne hakeem ko yuddh ke maal mein unka haq lene ki peshkash ki hai, parantu unhonne lene se inkaar kar diya hai. Is tarah, hakeem- radiyallahu anhu- ne Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke baad marte dam tak kisi se kuchh nahin maanga.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3704: Ham Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath ek yuddh mein nikle. Ham chhah logon ko saamoohik roop se ek oont diya gaya tha, jispar ham baari-baari sawaar hote the. Paidal chalne se hamaare paanv zakhmi ho gae the. Svayn mere paanv bhi zakhmi ho gae the

Abu moosa- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hainh ham Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath ek yuddh mein nikle. Ham chhah logon ko saamoohik roop se ek oont diya gaya tha, jispar ham baari-baari sawaar hote the. Paidal chalne se hamaare paanv zakhmi ho gae the. Svayn mere paanv bhi zakhmi ho gae the. Mere nakh tak gir gae the. Atah ham apne paanv par phate-puraane kapre lapet liya karte the. Pairon par phate-puraane kapre lapetne ke kaaran is yuddh ka naam 'gazva zaatur riqa' (cheethron waali jang) par gaya tha. Abu burda kahte hainh abu moosa ne yeh hadees bayaan to kar di, parantu phir ise naapsand kiya aur kahaah mujhe ise bayaan karna nahin chahiye tha. Abu burda kahte hainh matlab yeh hai ki unhonne is baat ko naapsand kiya ki apne kisi karm ko prakat kar diya jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3705: Tumne ek aisi baat kah di hai ki yadi use samudr ke paani se mila diya jaye, to use nasht kar daale.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Mainne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se kaha : Aapke liye safiya ka aisa aur aisa hona kaafi hai. -ek warnankarta ka kahna hai ki unka ishaara unke naata hone ki or tha- yeh sun aapne kaha : "Tumne ek aisi baat kah di hai ki yadi use samudr ke paani se mila diya jaye, to use nasht kar daale." Woh kahti hain : Mainne aapke saamne ek vyakti ki naqal utaari, to aapne kaha : "Mujhe yeh baat pasand nahin hai ki main kisi insaan ki naqal utaaroon aur uske badle mein mujhe itna aur itna mil jaye."

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se kaha ki  aapke liye safiya -yaani musalmaanon ki maata saphiyya-radiyallahu anha- ka bas ek hi shaareerik aib kaafi hai ki woh naati hain. Unki yeh baat sun aapne kaha : Tumne ek aisi baat kahi hai ki agar use samudr ke paani mein bhi mila diya jaye, to us par haawi ho jaye, use badal de, aur use kharaab karde. Woh bataati hain ki mainne ek baar ek vyakti ki kami dikhaane ke liye uski naqal utaari, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : Mujhe yeh baat pasand nahin hai ki main kisi ki kami ko ujaagar karne ke liye uska koi aib bayaan karoon, uski naqal utaaroon ya uski tarah baat karke dikhaaoon, chaahe uske badle mein mujhe duniya ki bahut saari cheezen de di jayen.

Is hadees mein geebat karne, arthaat; kisi ki anupasthiti mein uski buraai bayaan karne, se saavdhaan kiya evn daraya gaya hai.
Kisi ko apmaanit karne aur neecha dikhaane ke roop mein uski sthitiyon ki aur any kisi prakaar se uski naqal karna bhi nishiddh chugli mein daakhil hai.
Shaareerik doshon ko bayaan karna gheebat mein daakhil hai.
Qaazi kahte hain : Is hadees mein aye hue shabd "المزج" Ka arth hai : Kisi wastu ko uske saath doosri wastu milaakar badal dena. Is prakaar is hadees ka arth yeh hai ki agar yeh gheebat koi aisi wastu hoti ki use samudr ke paani mein mila diya jaye, to woh samudr ke wishaal jal bhandaar ko bhi uski asal awastha se hata deti. Atah un thore-more karmon ka kya, jinke saath gheebat ko mila diya jaye.
Patniyon ke beech prakat hone waale svaabhimaan ke kuchh drishy.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam koi ghalat kaam hota hua dekhkar khaamosh nahin rahte the.
Allah ki prasannata evn aprasannata ki tulna mein is duniya aur usmen maujood wastuon ka koi mahatv nahin hai.
Islam uchch naitik moolyon ka dharm hai. Yeh shabdon ya kaaryon dvaara kisi ke sammaan ko thes pahunchaane se mana karta hai, kyonki isse musalmaanon ke beech shatruta aur nafrat paida hoti hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
3706: Ek musalmaan ke doosre musalmaan par paanch adhikaar hain; salaam ka uttar dena, beemaar vyakti ka haal jaanne ke liye jaana, janaaze ke peechhe chalna, nimantran sveekaar karna aur chheenkne waale ka uttar dena.

3711: Sabse uttam din jismen sooraj nikla, juma ka din hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Sabse uttam din jismen sooraj nikla, juma ka din hai. Isi din aadam paida hue, isi din Jannat mein daakhil hue aur isi din wahaan se nikaale gae. Qayaamat bhi juma ke din hi qayam hogi."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki sabse utkrisht din, jismen sooraj nikalta hai, jume ka din hai. Us din ki kuchh wisheshtayen is prakaar hain : Usi din Allah ne aadam alaihissalaam ko paida kiya, usi din unko Jannat mein daakhil kiya, usi din unko Jannat se nikaalkar zameen par utaara, aur qayaamat bhi jume ke din hi qayam hogi.

Saptaah ke tamaam dinon par jume ke din ki fazeelat.
Jume ke din zyaada se zyaada neki ke kaam karne aur Allah ki daya praapt karne aur uski saza se bachne ki taiyaari ki prerna.
Is hadees mein jume ke din ki jin wisheshtaaon ka ullekh kiya gaya hai, unke baare mein kuchh logon ka kahna hai ki unhen bayaan karne ka uddeshy jume ke din ki fazeelat bayaan karna nahin hai. Kyonki aadam alaihissalaam ko Jannat se nikaalne aur qayaamat qayam hone ko fazeelat shumaar nahin kiya ja sakta. Jabki kuchh logon ka kahna hai ki yeh saari wisheshtayen fazeelton ke dayre mein aati hain. Kyonki aadam ke nikalne ke phalasvaroop unki nasl saamne aai, jismen Nabi, Rasool aur sadaachaari log sabhi shaamil hain. Isi tarah qayaamat qayam hone ke nateeje mein Allah ke nek bandon ko jaldi unke karmon ka pratiphal milega aur unko Allah ki or se wibhinn prakaar ki nemten di jayengi.
Is riwayat mein jin wisheshtaaon ka zikr hai, unke atirikt jume ke din ki aur bhi wisheshtayen hain. Jaise, usi din aadam alaihissalaam ki tauba qabool hui, usi din unki maut hui aur jume ke din ek kshan aisa aata hai ki jo bhi momin banda use namaz ki haalat mein payega aur Allah se kuchh maangega, uski manokaamna zaroor poori hogi.
Saal ka sabse utkrisht din arfa ka din hai. Jabki kuchh logon ne qurbaani ke din ko saal ka sabse utkrisht din kaha hai. Waise, saal ki sabse utkrisht raat qadr ki raat hai aur saptaah ka sabse utkrisht din jume ka din hai.
3713: Banu salma! Tum apne asl gharon hi mein raho, tumhaare qadmon ke nishaan likhe jayenge. Tum apne asl gharon hi mein raho, tumhaare qadmon ke nishaan likhe jayenge.

Jaabir- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki banu salma ne apne rahne ka sthaan badalkar masjide nabvi ke nikat a jaane ka iraada kar liya. Iski soochna Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko mili, to farmayaah "Mujhe yeh soochna mili hai ki tum masjid ke nikat a jaana chaahte ho." Unhonne kahaah haan, ai Allah ke Rasool! Hamne yeh iraada kar liya hai. Aapne farmayaah "Banu salma! Tum apne asl gharon hi mein raho, tumhaare qadmon ke nishaan likhe jayenge. Tum apne asl gharon hi mein raho, tumhaare qadmon ke nishaan likhe jayenge."

3714: Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke yahaan ek vyakti ke baare mein bataya gaya ki woh raat ko subah hone tak soya raha. Yeh sunkar aapne kaha : "Woh ek aisa vyakti hai ki shaitaan ne peshaab kar diya  jiske donon kaanon mein, ya farmaya: Jiske kaan mein.

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke yahaan ek vyakti ke baare mein bataya gaya ki woh raat ko subah hone tak soya raha. Yeh sunkar aapne kaha : "Woh ek aisa vyakti hai ki shaitaan ne peshaab kar diya  jiske donon kaanon mein, ya farmaya: Jiske kaan mein."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke yahaan ek vyakti ka zikr hua ki woh sooraj nikalne tak soya raha aur farz namaz ke liye utha hi nahin. Atah aapne farmaya : Daraasal woh aisa vyakti hai ki shaitaan ne jiske kaan mein peshaab kar diya hai.

Tahajjud ki namaz chhorna makrooh hai. Insaan aisa shaitaan ke bahkaawe mein aakar karta hai.
Shaitaan se saavdhaan rahna chahiye, jo insaan ke har raaste mein baithkar use neki ke raaste se rokne ke prayaas mein laga rahta hai.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Hadees ke shabdon "Namaz ke liye khara nahin hua" Se muraad sabhi namaazen hain. Lekin is baat ki bhi sanbhaawan hai ki yahaan alif laam man mein maujood kisi khaas namaz ke liye hon aur muraad tahajjud ki namaz ho ya pharz namaz.
Teebi kahte hain : Yahaan kaan ka wishesh roop se ullekh kiya gaya hai, haalaanki neend ki gahraai ko darshaane ke liye aankh ka ullekh neend ke sandarbh mein adhik upyukt lagta hai, iska kaaran yeh hai ki kaan dhyaan ka srot hai, aur, peshaab ka wishesh roop se ullekh kiya gaya hai kyonki yeh aasaani se pet mein prawesh karta hai, nason mein tezi se prawesh karta hai, aur sabhi angon ko sust bana deta hai.

3715: Bahut-se bikhre hue baalon waale aur darvaazon se bhaga diye jaane waale log aise hain ki yadi Allah par qasam kha len, to Allah unki qasmon ki laaj rakh le.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Bahut-se bikhre hue baalon waale aur darvaazon se bhaga diye jaane waale log aise hain ki yadi Allah par qasam kha len, to Allah unki qasmon ki laaj rakh le."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki kuchh logon ke baal bikhre aur dhool bhare hote hain. We apne baalon mein tel nahin lagaate aur na hi unhen niymit roop se dhote hain. Log unhen mahatv nahin dete tatha tiraskaarpoorvak apne darvaaze se lauta dete hain. Lekin Allah ki nazar mein unka darja itna ooncha hai ki agar we kisi kaam ko karne ki qasam kha len, to Allah unki qasam ki laaj rakhte hue use poora kar de.

Allah bande ka roop nahin, balki uska dil tatha uska karm dekhta hai.
Bande ko apne shareer evn wastr se adhik apne karm tatha hriday ki shuddhata par dhyaan dena chahiye.
Allah ke liye winamrata dhaaran karna dua qabool hone ka ek kaaran hai. Isi liye Allah apne gumnaam parhezgaar bandon ki qasam ki laaj rakh leta hai.
Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki tarbiyat karne ka ek achchha udaahran dekhne ko milta hai. Aapne yeh shiksha isliye di ki koi kisi ko tuchchh na jaane.
3716: Allah us vyakti par daya kare, jo bechte, khareedte aur qarj ka takaaza karte samay narmi se kaam le.

Jaabir radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Allah us vyakti par daya kare, jo bechte, khareedte aur qarj ka takaaza karte samay narmi se kaam le."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne har us vyakti ke liye rahmat ki dua ki hai, jo kray-wikray ke samay bara dil dikhaye. Chunaanche khareedne waale par bhaav ke wishay mein sakhti se kaam na le aur achchhe aachran ka pradarshan kare. Isi tarah khareedte samay bara dil dikhaye aur saamaan ka daam kam na de. Saath hi qarz ka taqaaza karte samay bhi bara dil dikhaye aur kisi zarooratmand tatha nirdhan par sakhti na kare, narmi ke saath adaygi ko kahe aur diwaaliye ko chhoot bhi de.

Shareeyat ka ek uddeshy logon ke sanbandhon ko achchha rakhne waale kaamon ki shiksha dena hai.
Logon ke beech len‍-den, jaise kray-wikray aadi mein achchhe aachran ke pradarshan ki prerna.
