Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Woh vyakti apmaanit ho, phir woh vyakti apmaanit ho, phir woh vyakti apmaanit ho." Kisi ne poochha : Kaun ai Allah ke Rasool? Farmaya : "Jisne apne maata-pita ko burhaape mein paya, chaahe donon mein se ek ko paya ho ya donon ko, parantu (unki sewa karke) Jannat mein daakhil nahin hua."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kisi ke liye apmaan evn tiraskaar ki bad-dua karte hue naak mitti mein milne tak ki baat kah daali aur woh bhi yeh baat teen baar kahi. Kisi ne poochha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Yeh bad-dua aap kiske wiruddh farma rahe hain?

Aapne kaha : Jisne apne maata-pita ya donon mein se ek ko burhaape mein paya aur donon ki sewa karke Jannat mein daakhil hone ka saamaan na kar saka. Na unke saath achchha vyavhaar kiya aur na unka aajnaakaari bana.

Maata-pita ke saath achchha vyavhaar karna zaroori hai. Unki aajna ka paalan Jannat mein prawesh dilayega. Khaas taur se unke burhaape evn nirbalta ki awastha mein.
Maata-pita ki awajna bara gunaah hai.
3719: Atuly wisheshta waale log aage ho gae.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam makka ke raaste mein chal rahe the ki jumdaan naami ek parvat ke paas se guzre. Atah farmaya : "Chalte raho, yeh jumdaan hai. Atuly wisheshta waale log aage ho gae." Sahaaba ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Yeh atuly wisheshta waale log kaun hain? Farmaya : "Allah ko bahut zyaada yaad karne waale purush aur Allah ko bahut-zyaada yaad karne waali striyaan."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne Allah ka bahut zyaada zikr karne waalon ka sthaan bayaan farmaya hai aur bataya hai ki unko yeh wishishtata praapt ho gai ki we doosron se aage barhkar Jannat ke oonche darje praapt karne mein kaamyaab ho gae. Aapne unki samaanta jumdaan pahaar se di hai, jo doosre pahaaron se alag pahchaan rakhta hai.

Allah ka bahut zyaada zikr karna aur is kaary mein vyast rahna musathab hai. Kyonki aakhirat mein aage rahne ka gaurav neki ke kaamon ki prachurta evn ibaadton ko kewal Allah ke liye karne ke jazbe ke aadhaar par praapt hoga.
Allah ka zikr kewal zabaan se bhi hota hai, kewal dil se bhi hota hai tatha zabaan evn dil donon se bhi hota hai, jo ki zikr ka sabse ooncha darja hai.
Zikr ka ek prakaar woh azkaar hain, jo wibhinn samyon se jure hue hain. Jaise subah aur shaam ke azkaar tatha farz namaazon ke baad ke azkaar aadi.
Navvi kahte hain : Yaad rakhen ki zikr ki fazeelat Allah ki paaki bayaan karne, uske ekmaatr poojy hone ka iqraar karne, uski prashansa karne aur baraai bayaan karne tak hi seemit nahin hai, balki Allah ki prasannata praapt karne ke liye neki ka kaam karne waala har vyakti Allah ka zikr kar raha hota hai.
Allah ka zikr deen par sudrirh rahne ka ek bahut bara saadhan hai. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ka farmaan hai : "Ai eemaal waalo! Jab tum kisi (mukhaalif) fauj se bhir jaao, to sudrirh raho aur Allah ko bahut zyaada yaad karte raho, taaki tumhen saphalta mil sake." [soora al-anfaal : 45]
Allah ka zikr karne waalon aur jumdaan pahaar ke beech samaanta is baat ke kaaran di gai hai ki donon akele aur doosron se alag hain. Jis prakaar jumdaan pahaar any pahaaron se alag sthit hai, usi prakaar Allah ka zikr karne waale log, yadyapi logon ki bheer mein hote hain, lekin unke dil aur zabaanen sabse alag-thalag Allah ke zikr mein vyast hua karti hain, ekaant ko pasand karti hain aur logon se adhik milne-julne se ghabraati hain. Samaanta ka kaaran yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki jis prakaar pahaar dharti ko sthaapit evn mazboot rakhte hain, usi prakaar zikr insaan ko deen par sudrirh rakhta hai. Samaanta ka kaaran duniya evn aakhirat ki bhalaaiyon ki or aage barhna bhi ho sakta hai jis prakaar madeene se makka ki yaatra par nikle hue vyakti ka jumdaan pahaar tak pahunchna uske makka pahunchne ki nishaani hua karta hai, aur jumdaan pahunchne waale ko aage barh jaane waala samjha jaata hai, usi prakaar Allah ka zikr karne waala Allah ko bahut zyaada yaad karne ke kaaran doosron se aage barhne waala shumaar hota hai.
3720: Tumhen bahut se kshetron mein wijay praapt hogi aur Allah tumhaare liye kaafi hoga. Atah tummen se koi teeron se khelne se ghaafil na ho

3727: Ek raat mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath namaz parhi jismen aapne soora baqra parhna shuru kiya.

Huzaifa bin yamaan- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki ek raat mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath namaz parhi. Aapne soora baqra parhna shuru kiya. Mainne socha, shayad sau ayton ke baad ruku karenge, lekin parhna jaari rakha. Mainne socha, shayad ise ek rakaat mein parhenge, parantu parhna jaari rakha. Mainne socha, shayad ise samaapt karne ke baad ruku karenge, lekin soora an-nisa parhna shuru kiya aur poori soora parh daali. Phir aale-imraan parhna shuru kiya aur use bhi parh daala. Aap dheere-dheere parh rahe the. Jab kisi tasbeeh ki ayat se guzarte, to tasbeeh kahte, jab kisi maangne ki ayat se guzarte to maangte aur jab kisi sharan maangne ki ayat se guzarte, to sharan maangte. Phir ruku kiya aur 'سبحان ربي العظيم' kahne lage. Aapka ruku aapke qayaam (khara rahne) ke anuroop tha. Phir kahaah 'سمع الله لمن حمده، ربنا لك الحمد', phir der tak lagbhag ruku ke samaan khare rahe. Phir sajda kiya aur kahaah 'سبحان ربي الأعلى' aapka sajda lagbhag aapke qayaam (khara rahne) ke baraabar tha.
3728: Kahaan hai Allah ki qasam khaane waala ki bhala kaary nahin karega?

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne darvaaze par jhagarne ki aawaaz suni. Donon jhagarne waalon ki aawaazen bari tez theen. Yeh sunkar aap donon ke paas aye aur farmayaah "Kahaan hai Allah ki qasam khaane waala ki bhala kaary nahin karega?" Usne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! 3729: Allah ki qasam, main kisi ko deta hoon aur kisi ko nahin bhi deta hoon, jabki jise nahin deta, woh usse kaheen adhik priy hota hai, jise deta hoon

Amr bin taghlib- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas kuchh dhan athva kuchh bandi laye gae. Aapne unhen baant diya. Kuchh logon ko diya aur kuchh logon ko nahin diya. Phir aapko yeh soochna mili ki jin logon ko nahin diya tha, unhonne isse apni niraasha jataai hai. Aapne sarvapratham, Allah ki prashansa ki, uska gungaan kiya aur kahaah "Allah ki qasam! Main kisi ko deta hoon aur kisi ko nahin bhi deta hoon, jabki jise nahin deta, woh usse kaheen adhik priy hota hai, jise deta hoon. Main kuchh logon ko kewal unke dilon ki bechaini aur lobh ko dekhte hue deta hoon aur kuchh logon ko us nisprihta aur bhalaai ke hawaale kar deta hoon, jo Allah ne unke dilon mein rakh di hai. Aise logon mein amr bin taghlib bhi shaamil hai." Amr bin taghlib kahte hainh Allah ki qasam! Mujhe yeh pasand nahin hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke is waaky ke badle mein mujhe laal rang ke oont mil jayen.
3730: Das kaary praakritik hain; moonchh kaatna, daarhi barhaana, misvaak karna, naak mein paani charhaana, naakhoon kaatna, joron ko dhona, bagal ke baal ukherna, peru ke baal saaf karna aur paani se peshaab evn shoch karne ke baad saphaai karna

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Das kaary praakritik hain; moonchh kaatna, daarhi barhaana, misvaak karna, naak mein paani charhaana, naakhoon kaatna, joron ko dhona, bagal ke baal ukherna, peru ke baal saaf karna aur paani se istinja arthaat peshaab evn shoch karne ke baad saphaai, karna."
Warnankarta kahte hain ki main dasvaan kaary bhool gaya, parantu yeh ki woh ku्lli karna ho sakta hai. Is hadees ke ek warnankarta waki ne 'انْتِقَاص الماء' ka arth istinja bataya hai.

Is hadees mein aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke hawaale se maanav prakriti se juri hui kuchh baaten bayaan ki hain.
Daraasal "Prakriti" Se muraad insaan ki woh sanrachna hai, jo Allah ki banaai hui hai aur jo shubh evn mangal hua karti hai. Yaad rahe ki yahaan muraad bigri hui prakriti nahin, balki svachchh prakriti hai. Kyonki bigri hui prakriti ka koi etbaar nahin hai. Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka farmaan hai : "Har janm lene waala bachcha mool prakriti par janm leta hai. Phir uske maata-pita use yahoodi, eesaai ya majoosi bana dete hain."
Inmen se pahli cheez hai "Moonchh kaatna" Ki honth dikhta ho. Ismen svachchhata bhi hai aur naak se nikalne waali cheezon se bachaav bhi. Kyonki moonchh ke baal jab honth par latakne lagte hain, to usse khaane-peene ki cheezen lag jaati hain. Isi tarah moonchh barhaana daraasal Allah ki sanrachna ko bigaarna bhi hai. Yeh sahi hai ki kuchh log ise achchha bhi samajhte hain, lekin is prakaar ke log kisi ginti mein nahin aate. Atah musalmaan ko apni moonchh ko kaatte athva moonrte rahna chahiye aur chaalees din se adhik samay tak rahne nahin dena chahiye. Kyonki anas -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit saheeh Muslim ki ek riwayat mein hai : "Hamaare liye moonchh tatha naakhoon kaatne, bagal ke baal ukhaarne aur peru ke baal saaf karne ka samay nirdhaarit kar diya gaya hai ki ham chaalees din se adhik na chhoren."
"Daarhi barhaana" Daarhi un baalon ko kahte hain, jo thuddi evn donon daarhon par ugte hain. Yahaan barhaane se aashay yeh hai ki unhen poora ka poora chhor diya jaye. Na moonra jaye aur na kaata jaye. Na kam na zyaada. Kyonki is aashay ko bataane ke liye prayukt arbi shabd "الإعفاء" Adhik karne tatha poora dene ke mayne mein aata hai. Atah aapke shabdon ka arth hai, daarhi ko adhik karo aur poora rahne do. Jaisa ki Allah taaala ka farmaan hai : "حتى عَفَوا" Yaani jab we sukhi ho gae.
Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki buhat-si hadeeson mein wibhinn shabdon dvaara daarhi barhaane ka aadesh aya hai. Kaheen "وفروا" Ka shabd aya hai, to kaheen "أرخوا" Ka aur kaheen "أعفوا" Ka. Ye saare shabd daarhi ko baaqi rakhne, barhne dene aur usse chherchhaar na karne ko pramaanit karte hain. Atah kisi musalmaan ke liye daarhi moonrna kisi bhi awastha mein waidh nahin hai. Agar kisi ne yeh krity kiya, to usne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke tareeqe ki mukhaalfat ki, aapke aadesh ki avhelna ki aur mushrikon jaisa kaam kiya.
"Misvaak karna" Yaani misvaak karna un maanav prakriti ka pata dene waale kaaryon mein se ek hai, jinki prerna shareeyat ne di hai. Kyonki misvaak munh svachchh rakhne waali aur Allah ko prasann rakhne waali cheez hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki misvaak kisi bhi samay ki ja sakti hai. Lekin wishesh roop se wazu ke samay, namaz se pahle, neend se jaagne ke baad, munh ka svaad kharaab hone par aur daanton ke peele ho jaane aadi par uspar adhik zor diya gaya hai.
"Naak mein paani charhaana" Yaani naak mein paani charhaana bhi maanav prakriti se nikle hue kaaryon mein se ek hai. Kyonki yeh svachchhata praapt karne aur naak ke andar ki un gandgiyon ko hataane ka saadhan hai, jo haanikaarak siddh ho sakti hain.
Naak mein paani charhaane ka kaam wazu ke andar bhi ho sakta hai aur uske baahar bhi. Jab bhi naak saaf karne ki aawashyakta mahsoos ho, usmen paani charhaaiye aur uski safaai keejiye. Iski zaroorat alag-alag logon ko alag-alag hua karti hai. Kuchh logon ko iski zaroorat kewal wazu ke samay parti hai aur kuchh logon ko uske atirikt bhi bahut baar parti hai.
Maanav prakriti se nikle hue kaaryon mein se ek kaary kulli karna bhi hai. Kyonki munh evn naak mein bahut-se mailkuchail ekatr hote rahte hain. Atah unki safaai par dhyaan dena bhi maanav prakriti ko moort roop dene waale kaaryon mein se ek hai.
"Naakhoon kaatna" Yaani naakhoon kaatna bhi maanav prakriti ko saamne laane waale kaaryon mein se hai. Yahaan muraad haath evn paanv ki ungliyon ke naakhoon hain. Atah unhen chaalees din se adhik nahin rahne dena chahiye. Chaalees din ka pramaan woh hadees hai, jo isse pahle guzar chuki hai.
"Joron ko dhona" Yaani ungliyon ke joron ke androoni evn baahri bhaagon ko dhona. Kyonki in sthaanon ke sikuran evn sankuchan ke kaaran unke andar mail jama ho jaata hai, jiski wajah se tvacha tak paani pahunch nahin paata. Lekin jab unka khayaal rakhte hue unhen ragar diya jaye aur unpar doosri baar haath pher diya jaye, to paani pahunch jaata hai. Atah maanav prakriti ka taqaaza hai ki insaan inhen dhone par wishesh dhyaan de.
Ungliyon ke joron ke hi hukm mein shareer ka har woh ang hoga, jismen mail jama ho jaata ho, jaise kaanon ke chhidr aur raanon ke bheetri bhaag, jo aam taur par chhipe rahte hain.
"Bagal ke baal ukhaarna" In baalon ko jar se ukhaar phenkne ki baat isliye kahi gai hai ki ye baal aise sthaan mein hote hain, jahaan atyadhik maatra mein paseena aata hai, mail jama ho jaata hai tatha badbu paida ho jaati hai. In baalon ko chaaleese din se adhik rahne nahin dena chahiye. Iska pramaan anas -radiyallahu anhu- ki woh hadees hai, jo peechhe guzar chuki hai. Agar ho sake to in baalon ko ukhaar dena hi uttam hai. Lekin yadi ukhaarna kathin ho, to moondne athva anaawashyak baal hataane waale kreem aadi ka prayog karne mein koi harj nahin hai. Kyonki asal uddeshy unhen hataana aur us sthaan ko saaf karna hai aur isse bhi uddeshy poora ho jaata hai.
"Peru ke baal saaf karna" Yaani peru ke baal saaf karna bhi maanav prakriti ko ujaagar karne waale kaaryon mein se ek hai. Jnaat ho ki peru ke baal se muraad woh khuradre baal hain, jo purush tatha stri ki agli sharmagaah ke aaspaas ugte hain. In baalon ko saaf karte rahna chahiye. Iske liye inhen moora bhi ja sakta hai, ukhaara bhi ja sakta hai, kaata bhi ja sakta hai aur aadhunik aawishkaaron ka prayog bhi kiya ja sakta hai. Kyonki uddeshy safaai karna hai aur in saare tareeqon se uddeshy poora ho jaata hai. In baalon ko bhi anas -radiyallahu anhu- ki ukt hadees mein aye nirdesh ke kaaran chaalees dinon se adhik chhora nahin ja sakta.
Fitrat ke kaaryon mein se ek kaary hai "انْتِقَاصُ الماء". Iska arth istinja bataya gaya hai, jiski pushti abu daaood evn ibn-e-maaja mein ammaar bin yaasir -radiyallahu anhuma- se warnit us hadees se hoti hai, jismen hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Fitrat ke kaary hain, kulli karna, naak mein paani charhaana... Aur istinja karna." Yaad rahe ki istinja naam hai peshaab athva paakhaana ke raaston mein se kisi raaste se nikalne waali kisi cheez ko paani, patthar, kapra evn roomaal aadi aisi cheezon se saaf karne ka, jinke andar saaf karne ka gun paya jaata ho.
Warnankarta kahte hain ki main dasveen wastu bhool gaya. Ho sakta hai ki woh kulli karna ho. Yeh daraasal ek warnankarta ka sandeh hai, jo yahaan bayaan kiya gaya hai.
3731: Shaitaan tummen se har vyakti ke sar ke peechh raat mein sote samay teen gaanth laga deta hai aur har gaanth par yeh kahkar phoonk maarta hai ki so ja, abhi raat bahut baaqi hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Shaitaan tummen se har vyakti ke sar ke peechh raat mein sote samay teen gaanth laga deta hai aur har gaanth par yeh kahkar phoonk maarta hai ki so ja, abhi raat bahut baaqi hai. Phir agar aadmi jaagkar Allah ko yaad karne lage, to ek gaanth khul jaati hai. Phir agar wazu kar le to ek aur gaanth khul jaati hai. Phir agar namaz parh le to ek aur gaanth bhi khul jaati hai. Is tarah subah ke samay aadmi chust aur praphullit rahta hai. Warna, udaas aur sust rahta hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jab insaan tahajjud ya fajr ki namaz ke liye uthna chaahta hai, to kis tarah shaitaan use rokne ka prayaas karta hai.

Ek momin jab sota hai, to shaitaan uske sar ke pichhle bhaag mein teen gaanth laga deta hai.

Aise mein jab woh jaag kar Allah ko yaad karta hai aur shaitaan dvaara daale gae khyaalon ko raasta rokne nahin deta, to ek gaanth khul jaati hai.

Uske baad agar wazu karta hai, to doosri gaanth khul jaati hai.

Phir agar uthkar namaz parhta hai, to teesri gaanth bhi khul jaati hai. Phalasvaroop insaan bharpoor oorja ke saath aur prasannachit hokar subah karta hai ki use Allah ki or se ibaadat ka suyog praapt hua, woh pratiphal evn kshama ke Allah ke kiye hue waada aur is baat se khush rahta hai ki shaitaan dvaara use ibaadat se rokne ke prayaas naakaam ho gae. Iske wipreet agar woh ibaadat ke liye khara nahin hua, to uski subah udaasi evn susti ke saath hoti hai. Achchhe kaamon mein uska man nahin lagta. Kyonki daraasal woh shaitaani ki zanjeer mein jakra hua hai aur kripaawaan Allah ki daya se door ho jaata hai.

Shaitaan ka prayaas hamesha yeh rahta hai ki Allah ki ibaadat ki raah mein rukaawat khari ki jaye. Aur banda shaitaan ke hathkandon se usi samay bach sakta hai, jab Allah se madad maange aur suraksha saadhaanon ko apnaye.
Allah ka zikr aur uski ibaadat insaan ke andar chusti evn prasannata laati hai, use haardik khushi deti hai, susti aur aalasy ko door karti hai tatha chinta aur aakrosh ko khatm karti hai. Kyonki zikr aur ibaadat shaitaan ko door bhagaate hain, jabki uparyukt baaten shaitaan ke  prayaason ka nateeja hua karti hain.
Momin Allah ki or se ibaadat ka suyog milne par khush aur woh sadgun aur poornata ki praapti mein apni kamiyon ke kaaran udaas ho jaata hai.
Neki ke kaamon se doori aur unse achetna mein shaitaan ka haath hota hai.
Yeh teen cheezen -Allah ka zikr, wazu aur namaz- shaitaan ko door bhagaane ka kaam karti hain.
Shaitaan dvaara sar ke pichhle bhaag hi mein gaanthen isliye lagaai jaati hain ki wahi saari shaktiyon ka kendr hai aur waheen se poore shareer ki vyawastha sanchaalit hoti hai. Atah wahaan gaanth laga dene ke baad insaan ki aatma par qabza jamaana aur uspar neend thonpna aasaan ho jaata hai.
Ibn-e-hazar asaqlaani kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke shabdon "Alaika lailun" Mein raat ka zikr bazaahir yeh batlaata hai ki yeh baat raat ki neend ke saath khaas hai.
Ibn-e-hajar asaqlaani kahte hain : Zikr ke liye koi cheez is tarah nishchit nahin hai ki doosri cheez prayaapt na ho. Har woh cheez kaafi hai, jo "Allah ke zikr" Ke dayre mein aati ho. Ismen quraan ki tilaawat, Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki hadees parhna aur sharai jnaan praapt karne mein vyast rahna bhi shaamil hain. Albatta sabse achchha yeh hai ki Allah ka zikr us hadees mein aye hue shabdon dvaara kiya jaye, jiske shabd is prakaar hain : "Jo vyakti raat mein jaag jaye aur yeh dua parhe : Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ka haqdaar nahin hai, woh akela hai, uska koi saajhi nahin hai, raajy usi ka hai, saari prashansa usi ki hai aur woh har baat ki kshamta rakhta hai. Saari prashansa Allah hi ki hai, Allah ki hasti pawitr hai, Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur Allah sabse bara hai. Allah ki madad ke bina na kisi ke paas gunaah se bachne ki shakti hai aur na neki karne ki kshamta.) phir kahe : Ai Allah! Mujhe kshama kar de. Ya koi aur dua kare, to uski dua qabool hoti hai. Phir agar woh wazu kare (aur namaz parhe), to namaz bhi qabool hoti hai." Is hadees ko imaam Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3732: ''Adhik se adhik Allah ke liye sajda karo, isliye ki tumhaare har ek sajde ke badle Allah tumhaara ek darja ooncha karta hai aur tumhaare ek gunaah ko mita deta hai.''

Maadaan bin abu talha yaamuri se warnit hai, woh kahte hain : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke aazaad kiye hue daas saubaan se mulaaqaat ki aur kaha : Mujhe kisi aise kaary ke baare mein bataaiye, jise karoon, to Allah mujhe Jannat mein prawesh kara de. Unka kahna hai ki ya mainne yeh kaha tha : Mujhe koi aisa kaam bataaiye, jo Allah ke nikat sabse mahboob ho. Meri baat sunkar woh chup rahe. Mainne phir prashn kiya, to woh chup rahe. Mainne teesri baar prashn dohraya, to unhonne kaha : Mainne iske baare mein Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochha, to aapne kaha : ''Adhik se adhik Allah ke liye sajda karo, isliye ki tumhaare har ek sajde ke badle Allah tumhaara ek darja ooncha karta hai aur tumhaare ek gunaah ko mita deta hai.'' maadaan kahte hain : Phir main abu darda se mila aur unse poochha, to unhonne bhi usi tarah kaha, jis tarah saubaan ne kaha tha.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se koi aisa amal poochha gaya, jo Jannat mein prawesh ka sabab ban jaye ya phir jo Allah ko sabse priy ho.

To jawaab mein aapne poochhne waale se kaha : Tum bahut zyaada namaz mein sajde kiya karo. Kyonki jab tum Allah ke liye ek sajda karoge, to uske badle mein Allah tumhaara sthaan ek darja ooncha kar dega aur tumhaara ek gunaah mita dega.

Farz tatha nafal namaazon ki prerna, kyonki namaz mein sajde hua karte hain.
Sahaaba ke fikh (nyayshaastr) ka wivran aur unka jnaan ki svarg - Allah  ki daya ke baad - bina amal ke praapt nahin kiya ja sakta.
Namaz ke sajde Jannat mein uchch sthaanon ki praapti ka ek mahatvapoorn saadhan hain.
3733: Do aankhon ko Jahannam ki aag chhu bhi nahin sakti; ek woh aankh jo Allah ke dar se roe aur doosri woh aankh jo Allah ke maarg mein pahredaari karte hue jaage

Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Do aankhon ko Jahannam ki aag chhu bhi nahin sakti; ek woh aankh jo Allah ke dar se roe aur doosri woh aankh jo Allah ke maarg mein pahredaari karte hue jaage."

Is hadees ka arth yeh hai ki aag aisi aankh ko nahin chhooegi, jo Allah ke bhay se roe. Jab banda Allah ki mahaanta evn saamarthy tatha apni wiwashta evn Allah ka haq ada karne mein kotaahi ko yaad karta hai, to uski daya ki aasha mein evn uske dand evn naaraazgi ke bhay se ro parta hai. Is prakaar ke vyakti ko aag se mukti ka wachan diya gaya hai.
Doosri aankh jise aag nahin chhooegi, woh aankh hai, jo Allah ke maarg mein seemaaon evn yuddh ke maidaanon mein jaagkar raat guzaare, taaki musalmaanon ki jaan ki suraksha ho sake.
Aapke shabd "Donon aankhon ko aag nahin chhoonegi" Mein shareer ke ek ang ka naam lekar poora shareer muraad liya gaya hai. Aashay yeh hai ki jo vyakti Allah ke bhay se roya aur jisne Allah ke maarg mein pahredaari karte hue raat guzaari, Allah donon ke shareer ko aag par haraam kar dega.
3734: Jab tummen se koi raat ko namaz parhne ke liye uthe aur uski zabaan par Qur'an theek se na a raha ho aur use pata na chal raha ho ki kya kuchh parh raha hai, to so jaye

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jab tummen se koi raat ko namaz parhe aur uski zabaan par Qur'an theek se na a raha ho aur use pata na chal raha ho ki kya kuchh parh raha hai, to so jaye."
3736: Har ummat ke liye ek aazmaaish hoti hai aur meri ummat ke liye woh aazmaaish dhan hai

Kaab bin iyaaz- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte suna haih "Har ummat ke liye ek aazmaaish hoti hai aur meri ummat ke liye woh aazmaaish dhan hai."

Kaab bin ayaaz -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : "Har sanpraday ke liye ek pareeksha ki wastu hoti hai" Hadees mein prayukt shabd fitna se muraad woh cheezen hain, jinke dvaara pareeksha evn aazmaaish hoti hai.
"Aur meri ummat ke liye pareeksha ki wastu dhan hai." Kyonki dhan insaan ke adhikaar ko sanwaarne mein utpann karta hai. Chunaanche dhan mein sanliptata insaan ke dil ko gaafil karti aur aakhirat ki taiyaari se door kar deti hai.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3737: Poora wazan karke aur dandi jhukaakar de

Abu safvaan suwaid bin qais- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki main aur makharma abdi ne hajar- ek sthaan ka naam- se kapra mangvaya to Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hamaare paas aye aur kuchh paajaamon ka mol-tol kiya. Mere paas ek wazan karne waala tha, jo mazdoori lekar wazan karta tha. Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne usse kahaah "Poora wazan kar aur (dandi) jhukaakar de."
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3738: Jannat mein ek dvaar hai, jise rayyaan kaha jaata hai. Qayaamat ke din usse rozedaar prawesh karenge. Unke siwa koi us dvaar se prawesh nahin karega.

Sahl -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jannat mein ek dvaar hai, jise rayyaan kaha jaata hai. Qayaamat ke din usse rozedaar prawesh karenge. Unke siwa koi us dvaar se prawesh nahin karega. Kaha jayega : Rozedaar kahaan hain? Atah, we uth khare honge. Unke siwa koi usse prawesh nahin karega. Jab we daakhil ho jayenge, to dvaar band kar diya jayega aur usse koi andar nahin jayega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki Jannat ke dvaaron mein se ek dvaar ka naam raiyaan hai, jisse qayaamat ke din rozedaar prawesh karenge, doosre log nahin. Us din pukaara jayega ki rozedaar kahaan hain? Tab rozedaar khare honge aur andar jayenge. Doosre log us dvaar se prawesh nahin karenge. Jab antim rozedaar prawesh kar jayega, to dvaar ko band kar diya jayega aur baad mein koi prawesh nahin karega.

Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees mein roze ke mahatv tatha rozedaar ke sammaan ka ullekh hai.
Allah ne Jannat ke aath dvaaron mein se ek dvaar rozedaaron ke liye khaas kar diya hai. Jab wo prawesh kar jayenge, to use band kar diya jayega.
Jannat ke wibhinn dvaar hain.
Sindhi kahte hain : Hadees ke shabdon "أين الصائمون" Ka arth hai : Bahut zyaada roze rakhne waale kahaan hain? Waise hi, jaise 'aadil' evn 'zaalim' shabdon ka prayog aise logon ke liye kiya jaata hai, jinke svabhaav mein ye donon gun hote hain. Aise logon ke liye nahin, jinke andar ekaadh baar ye gun nazar a jayen.
'Al-raiyaan' shabd ka arth hai : Pyaas bujhaane waala. Choonki rozedaaron ko pyaas lagti hai, khaas taur se garmi ke lambe tatha garm dinon mein, isliye pratiphal ke taur par Jannat ke ek dvaar ka naam pyaas bujhaane waala dvaar rakha jayega. Jabki kuchh logon ka kahna hai ki 'al-raiyaan' shabd 'phaalaan' ke wazan par hai aur iska arth hai, bahut achchhi tarah pyaas bujha dena. Choonki rozedaar bhookhe evn pyaase rahte hain, isliye pratiphal ke taur par Jannat ke ek dvaar ka naam 'baab al-raiyaan' rakha jayega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3741: Bareera- radiyallahu anha- aur unke pati ki ghatna par aadhaarit hadees

Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- bareera- razyallahu anha- aur unke pati ki ghatna ke sanbandh mein kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unse kahaah "Yadi tu uske yahaan laut jaye, to tujhe uska sawaab milega." Unhonne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap mujhe aadesh de rahe hain? Farmayaah "Main kewal sifaarish kar raha hoon." Unhonne kahaah "Mujhe uski koi zaroorat nahin hai."
3743: Allah moosa par daya kare, unhen isse bhi adhik kasht diya gaya, parantu sabr se kaam liya

Abdullah bin masaood- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki hunain ke din Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ghaneemat ke dhan ke bantvaare ke samay kuchh logon ko wareeyta di. Isi kram mein aqra bin haabis ko sau oont diye, uyayna bin hisn ko bhi itne hi oont diye aur inke alaawa kai arab sardaaron ko bhi ghaneemat ka dhan pradaan karne mein wareeyta di aur bahut kuchh diya. Yeh dekh ek vyakti ne kahaah Allah ki qasam! Is bantvaare mein nyay se kaam nahin liya gaya hai aur Allah ki prasannata ko dhyaan mein nahin rakha gaya hai. Mainne apne man mein kahaah Allah ki qasam! Iski soochna main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko zaroor doonga. Ataeb, main aapke paas aya aur uski baat sunaai to aapke chehre ka rang badalkar laal ho gaya. Phir farmayaah "Agar Allah aur uska Rasool nyay na karen to bhala kaun nyay karega?" Phir farmayaah "Allah moosa (alaihissalaam) par daya kare, unhen isse bhi adhik kasht diya gaya, parantu sabr se kaam liya." Yeh dekh mainne kahaah iske baad main aap tak koi baat nahin pahunchaaoonga.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3745: Main Jannat ke dvaar par khara hua to dekha ki usmen prayah nirdhan log daakhil ho rahe the aur dhani log rok diye ja rahe the

Usaama bin zaid- radiyallahu anhu- Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hain ki aapne farmayaah "Main Jannat ke dvaar par khara hua to dekha ki usmen prayah nirdhan log daakhil ho rahe the aur dhani log rok diye ja rahe the, parantu Jahannam waalon ko Jahannam ki or le jaane ka aadesh diya ja raha tha. Main Jahannam ke dvaar par khara hua to dekha ki usmen prayah striyaan daakhil ho rahi theen."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3752: Kisi ne koi bhojan grahan nahin kiya, jo uske haath ki kamaai ke bhojan se uttam ho tatha Allah ke Nabi daaood (alaihissalaam) apne haath ki kamaai se khaate the

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hain ki aapne farmayaah "Daaood (alaihissalaam) apne haath ki kamaai hi se khaate the."
Tatha miqdaam bin maadeekrib- radiyallahu anhu- Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hain ki aapne farmayaah "Kisi ne koi bhojan grahan nahin kiya, jo uske haath ki kamaai ke bhojan se uttam ho tatha Allah ke Nabi daaood (alaihissalaam) apne haath ki kamaai se khaate the."
3753: Ek vyakti logon ko qarz deta aur apne sevkon se kaha karta ki jab kisi rin chukaane mein asmarth vyakti ke paas jaao to uske qarz ki andekhi karo. Ho sakta hai ki Allah hamaare gunaahon ki andekhi kare

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Ek vyakti logon ko qarz deta aur apne sevkon se kaha karta ki jab kisi rin chukaane mein asmarth vyakti ke paas jaao to uske qarz ki andekhi karo. Ho sakta hai ki Allah hamaare gunaahon ki andekhi kare. To jab woh marne ke baad, Allah se mila to Allah ne use kshama kar diya."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ek vyakti ke baare mein bata rahe hain, jo logon ko qarz deta tha ya saamaan udhaar bechta tha tatha apne gulaam se, jo logon ke paas qarz wasoolne jaya karta tha, kahta tha : Jab tum kisi qarzadaar ke paas jaao aur uske paas qarz ada karne ke liye kuchh na ho, to uske karz ki andekhi karo. Yaani ya to use kuchh samay de do ya phir bahut zor dekar na maango ya phir uske paas jo kuchh ho, use le lo chaahe woh kitna bhi kam ho. Aisa woh is ummeed mein kaha karta tha ki ho sakta hai ki isi ke kaaran use Allah kshama kar de. Chunaanche jab us vyakti ki mrityu hui to Allah ne use maaf kar diya.

Logon ke saath len-den karte samay upkaar karna, kshama karna aur aksham evn diwaaliye ko maaf karna qayaamat ke din mukti ki praapti ka ek kaaran aur maadhyam hai.
Srishti par upkaar karna, Allah ke prati nishthaawaan rahna aur uski rahmat ki aasha rakhna gunaahon ki kshama ka ek kaaran hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3754: Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah zakriyya (alaihissalaam) barhai the.
3755: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- Ramzan maheene ke antim das dinon mein doosre dinon ki tulna mein kaheen adhik ibaadat mein leen raha karte the.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai ki : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- Ramzan maheene ke antim das dinon mein doosre dinon ki tulna mein kaheen adhik ibaadat mein leen raha karte the.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka maamool yeh tha ki jab Ramzan ke antim das din aate, to any dinon ki tulna mein kaheen zyaada ibaadat aur wibhinn prakaar ke neki ke kaamon mein vyast ho jaate the. Aap aisa un raaton ke mahatv ko saamne rakhte hue aur lailtul qadr ki talaash mein kiya karte the.

Saamaany roop se Ramzan ke maheene mein aur wishesh roop se iske antim das dinon mein neki aur wibhinn achchhe kaam prachur maatra mein karne ke liye protsaahan.
Ramzan maheene ke antim das din ikkeesveen raat se shuru hokar maheene ke ant tak rahte hain.
Fazeelat waale samyon ko neki ke kaamon mein lagaana musathab hai.
3756: Meri ummat ke sabhi logon ko maaf kar diya jayega, siway unke jo khulam-khulla gunaah karte hain.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Meri ummat ke sabhi logon ko maaf kar diya jayega, siway unke jo khulam-khulla gunaah karte hain. Tatha khulam-khulla gunaah karne ka ek roop yeh hai ki aadmi raat ko koi gunaah kare aur subah aye to woh kahta phire ki ai amuk! Mainne raat ko aisa aur aisa kiya hai, haalaanki Allah ne use logon se chhupa rakha tha. Uske rab ne raat bhar uske gunaah ko chhipa rakha, lekin usne subah ko Allah ke daale hue parde ko utha diya."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki is baat ki aasha rahti hai ki Allah gunaah karne waale musalmaan ko kshama kar de. Lekin aisa abhimaan evn nirlajjata ke saath gunaah karne waale ke saath nahin hota. Woh vyakti kshama ka haqdaar nahin hai jo raat mein gunaah kare aur subah logon ko bataata phire ki usne beeti raat amuk gunaah kiya hai, jabki Allah ne uske gunaah par parda daal rakha tha. Poori raat Allah ne uspar parda daale rakha aur subah uthkar usne Allah ke daale hue parde ko utha diya.

Allah ki or se parda daal diye jaane ke baad gunaah ka elaan karne ki buraai.
Gunaah ka elaan karna bhi eemaan waalon ke beech buraai ka prachaar karna hai.
Allah jiski kamiyon par duniya mein parda daalega, aakhirat mein bhi daalega. Yeh daraasal bandon par Allah ka bahut bara anugrah hai.
Jisse koi gunaah ho jaye, woh apne gunaah ko chhupaye aur Allah se tauba kare.
Jo jaanboojhkar gunaahon ka elaan karte phirte hain unka gunaah bahut bara hota hai aur is tarah svayn ko Allah ki kshama se wanchit kar lete hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
3757: Ham doodh mein se Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka hissa uthaakar rakh lete the. Aap raat ko aate aur dheere se salaam karte taaki sone waala to na jaage, parantu jaagne waala sun le.

Miqdaad- radiyallahu anhu- apni warnit ek lanbi hadees mein kahte hainh ham doodh mein se Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka bhaag uthaakar rakh lete the. Aap raat ko aate aur dheere se salaam karte taaki sone waala to na jaage, parantu jaagne waala sun le. Atah, Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aye aur waise hi salaam kiya, jaise salaam kiya karte the.
3758: Ham Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke liye misvaak aur wuzu ka paani taiyaar rakhte the. Phir Allah jitni raat ko chaahta aapko jagaata. To aap uthte, wazu karte aur namaz parhte the.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anhuा- kahti hain ki ham Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke liye misvaak aur wazu ka paani taiyaar rakhte the. Phir Allah jitni raat ko chaahta aapko jagaata. To aap uthte, wazu karte aur namaz parhte the.

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki woh Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke liye misvaak evn wazu ka paani taiyaar rakhteen, phir sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah raat ko jab chaahta, aapko jaga deta. Jab jaag jaate, to sabse pahle apne daanton ko misvaak se ragar-ragar kar saaf karte, taaki saamaanyatah neend ke kaaran paida hone waali durgandh door ho jaye. Phir namaz ke liye wazu karte aur uske baad raat ki namaz parhte.
3762: Kya tummen se koi is baat se wiwash hai ki pratyek din ek hazaar nekiyaan praapt kare? Aapke paas baithe logon mein se ek vyakti ne poochhaah aadmi ek hazaar nekiyaan kaise praapt kar sakta hai? Aapne farmayaah sau baar 'subhaanallah' kahne se uske liye ek hazaar nekiyaan likhi jayengi athva uske ek hazaar gunaah mitaye jayenge.

Saad bin abu waqqaas- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki ham Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas the ki aapne farmayaah kya tummen se koi is baat se wiwash hai ki pratyek din ek hazaar nekiyaan praapt kare? Aapke paas baithe logon mein se ek vyakti ne poochhaah aadmi ek hazaar nekiyaan kaise praapt kar sakta hai? Aapne farmayaah sau baar 'subhaanallah' kahne se uske liye ek hazaar nekiyaan likhi jayengi athva uske ek hazaar gunaah mitaye jayenge.
3768: Mujhe lagta hai ki tum logon ne abu ubaida ke bahrain se kuchh dhan lekar aane ki baat suni hai.

Amr bin auf ansaari- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne abu ubaida bin jarraah- radiyallahu anhu- ko bahrain bheja taaki wahaan ka jizya- taiks- lekar ayen. Atah, woh wahaan se kuchh dhan lekar aye. Ansaariyon ko unke aane ki soochna mili to fajr ki namaz mein Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke yahaan upasthit ho gae. Jab aap namaz parh chuke aur palatkar baithe to we ishaaron mein aapse sawaal kar baithe. Unhen dekh aap muskuraye aur boleh mujhe lagta hai ki tum logon ne abu ubaida ke bahrain se kuchh dhan lekar aane ki baat suni hai. Unhonne kahaah haan, ai Allah ke Rasool. Farmayaah prasann ho jaao aur us baat ki aasha rakho jo tumhen khush kar de. Allah ki qasam! Mujhe tumhaari ghareebi ka bhay nahin hai, balki mujhe is baat ka bhay hai ki tumpar duniya usi tarah phaila di jaye, jaise tumse pahle ke logon par phaila di gai thi aur tum uski pratispardha mein lag jaao, jaise we lag gae the tatha woh tumhen bhi halaak kar de, jaise un logon ko halaak kar chuki hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3769: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kisi maheene mein roza na rakhte, yahaan tak ki ham sochne lagte ki is maheene mein roza rakhenge hi nahin aur kisi maheene mein roza rakhte jaate, yahaan tak ki hamen lagne lagta ki is maheene mein roza chhorenge hi nahin. Tatha tum unko raat mein namaz parhte hue dekhna chaahte to dekh lete aur sote hue dekhna chaahte to bhi dekh lete.

Anas- raziyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kisi maheene mein roza na rakhte, yahaan tak ki hamen lagne lagta ki is maheene mein roza rakhenge hi nahin aur kisi maheene mein roza rakhte jaate, yahaan tak ki hamen lagne lagta ki is maheene mein roza chhorenge hi nahin. Tatha tum unko raat mein namaz parhte hue dekhna chaahte to dekh lete aur sote hue dekhna chaahte to bhi dekh lete.
3770: Alaikassalaam na kaho, kyonki alaikassalaam mare hue logon ka salaam hai.

Abu jurai hujaimi- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya aur bolaah 'alaikassalaamu ya rasoolallah!' to farmayaah alaikassalaam na kaho kyonki alaikassalaam mare hue logon ka salaam hai.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3772: Eershya, kewal do prakaar ke logon se rakhna jayaz hai; ek woh vyakti, jise Allah ne dhan pradaan kiya ho tatha usne us dhan ko saty ke maarg mein kharch karne par laga diya ho tatha doosra woh vyakti, jise Allah ne antarjnaan pradaan kiya ho aur woh usi ke anusaar nirnay karta ho aur uski shiksha deta ho.

Abdullah bin masaood- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah eershya kewal do prakaar ke logon se rakhna jayaz hai; ek woh vyakti, jise Allah ne dhan pradaan kiya ho tatha usne us dhan ko saty ke maarg mein kharch karne par laga diya ho tatha doosra woh vyakti, jise Allah ne hikmat (antarjnaan) pradaan ki ho aur woh usi ke anusaar nirnay karta ho aur uski shiksha deta ho.
Tatha abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se riwayat karte hain ki aapne farmayaah "Eershya kewal do maamlon mein jayaz hai; ek woh vyakti, jise Allah ne Qur'an diya ho aur woh raat din parhne mein laga ho aur ek woh vyakti, jise Allah ne dhan diya ho aur woh raat din use- Allah ke raaste mein- kharch karne mein laga ho."
[ise donon riwayton ke saath Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3773: Ai Allah! Asl jeewan to kewal aakhirat ka jeewan hai.
Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah ai Allah! Asl jeewan to kewal aakhirat ka jeewan hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3775: Koi santaan apne pita ka badla chuka nahin sakti, siway iske ki use gulaami ki awastha mein paye aur khareedkar aazaad kar de.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah koi santaan apne pita ka badla chuka nahin sakti, siway iske ki use gulaami ki awastha mein paye aur khareedkar aazaad kar de.
3776: Qayaamat ke din ek mota wishaalkay vyakti ayega, parantu Allah ki nazar mein ek machchhar ke par ke baraabar bhi wazan na rakhega.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah qayaamat ke din ek mota wishaalkay vyakti ayega, parantu Allah ki nazar mein ek machchhar ke par ke baraabar bhi wazan na rakhega.

Aisa vyakti, jo shaareerik roop se mazboot ho, duniya mein logon ko abhimaan dikhaata phirta ho aur uske har karm evn kathan se ghamand tapakta ho, woh qayaamat ke din Allah ke nikat machchhar ke par ke baraabar mein wazan nahin rakhega aur uska koi mooly evn sammaan nahin hoga.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3777: Jo vyakti duniya mein kisi par parda daalega, Allah qayaamat ke din uspar parda daalega.
Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jo vyakti duniya mein kisi par parda daalega, Allah qayaamat ke din uspar parda daalega."

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai ki jab koi musalmaan apne musalmaan bhaai ki kisi kami evn kotaahi par parda daalta hai, to Allah taaala qayaamat ke din uspar parda daalega. Kyonki insaan ko uske kiye gae karmon ke anusaar hi pratiphal milta hai. Allah ke parda daalne ka matlab hai ki woh qayaamat ke din hashr ke maidaan mein jama hone waale logon ke saamne uski kamiyon, trutiyon aur gunaahon ko aane nahin dega. Iska matlab yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki woh bande ki kamiyon evn kotaahiyon par uski pakar hi nahin, balki uske saamne unka zikr bhi na kare.

Ek musalmaan se jab koi gunaah ho jaye, to use tokne, naseehat karne aur Allah ka dar dikhaane ke saath-saath uspar parda bhi daalna chahiye. Lekin agar woh dusht aur bigaar ke raaste par chalne waala insaan hai aur khuleaam anaitik kaam karta rahta hai, to uspar parda nahin daalna chahiye. Kyonki, yahaan parda daalne ka matlab hai use paap karne ke liye jurratmand banaana. Aise vyakti ke baare mein prashaasan ko soochit kiya jayega. Bhale hi isse use prasiddhi mil jaye, kyonki woh khuleaam buraaiyaan karta hai.
Doosron ki kamiyon ko chhupaane ki prerna.
Parda daalne ka ek fayda yeh hai; ki isse gunaah karne waale ko aatmachintan aur tauba karne ka avsar mil jaata hai. Kyonki logon ki galtiyon aur chhipi hui baaton ko ujaagar karne ka matlab waastav mein buraai ko prachaarit karna, saamaajik maahaul ko bigaarna aur logon ko buraai karne ke liye protsaahit karna hai.
3778: Allah ke bhay se rone waala vyakti usi prakaar Jahannam mein prawesh nahin kar sakta, jis prakaar doodh than mein laut nahin sakta.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah Allah ke bhay se rone waala vyakti usi prakaar Jahannam mein prawesh nahin kar sakta, jis prakaar doodh than mein laut nahin sakta. Tatha Allah ke maarg ki dhool aur Jahannam ka dhuaan ekatrit nahin ho sakte.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3779: Tummen se har vyakti ki mrityu is awastha mein aani chahiye ki woh Allah se achchha gumaan rakhta ho.

Jaabir radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko farmaate hue suna hai : "Tummen se har vyakti ki mrityu is awastha mein aani chahiye ki woh Allah se achchha gumaan rakhta ho."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- is baat ki prerna de rahe hain ki ek musalmaan ki mrityu Allah se achchha gumaan rakhte hue hi honi chahiye. Marte waqt ummeed ka pahlu prabal hona chahiye aur dil mein yeh ummeed honi chahiye ki Allah uspar raham karega aur use maaf kar dega. Kyonki asal mein, dar ki zaroorat karmon ko behtar banaane ke liye hoti hai aur woh samay karm ka hota nahin hai. Isliye, wahaan ummeed ka pahlu prabal hona chahiye.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko apni ummat se bara pyaar tha, isliye paristhiti jo bhi ho, uska maargadarshan karne se chookte nahin the. Yahaan tak ki jis beemaari mein aapki mrityu ho gai usmen bhi apni ummat ko naseehat karne evn mukti ke maarg bataane mein koi kami nahin ki.
Teebi kahte hain : Abhi se apne karmon ko sudhaar lo, taaki marte samay Allah se achchha gumaan rakh sako. Kyonki jisne marne se pahle bure karm kiye honge, woh marne ke samay Allah se achchha gumaan nahin rakh payega.
Ek bande ke liye sabse uttam awastha aasha aur bhay ke beech santulan aur prem ki pradhaanta hai. Prem waahan hai, aasha pathapradarshak hai, bhay chaalak hai, aur Allah apni kripa aur daya se use uski manzil tak pahunchaata hai.
Jab kisi ki mrityu ka samay aye, to uske aas-paas  upasthit logon ko chahiye ki woh beemaar ke man mein Allah se aasha aur Allah ke prati achchhe wichaar ko prabal kare. Kyonki is hadees mein warnan hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apni mrityu se teen din pahle yeh baat kahi thi.
3785: Tummen se koi apni rassiyaan lekar parvat ki or jaye aur apni peeth par lakriyon ka gatthar laadkar le aye tatha use beche aur is tarah Allah uske chehre ko (maangne ke apmaan se) bacha le to yeh uske liye is baat se behtar hai ki logon se maange aur log use den ya dene se mana kar den.

Zubair bin avvaam- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah tummen se koi apni rassiyaan lekar parvat ki or jaye aur apni peeth par lakriyon ka gatthar laadkar le aye tatha use beche aur is tarah Allah uske chehre ko (maangne ke apmaan se) bacha le to yeh uske liye is baat se behtar hai ki logon se maange aur log use den ya dene se mana kar den.
3788: Sun lo! Duniya dhikkaaryogy hai aur jo kuchh usmen hai sab dhikkaaryogy hai, siway Allah ke zikr aur usse sanbandhit wastuon ke tatha jnaani evn jnaanaarjan karne waale vyakti ke.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki maiैnneे Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : "Sun lo! Duniya dhikkaaryogy hai aur jo kuchh usmen hai sab dhikkaaryogy hai, siway Allah ke zikr aur usse sanbandhit wastuon ke tatha jnaani evn jnaanaarjan karne waale vyakti ke."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki duniya aur uski saari cheezen Allah ke nikat ghrinit, nindit, tiraskaarit evn aprashansit hain. Kyonki duniya aur uski saari cheezen Allah ke atirikt any cheezon mein vyast tatha Allah se door karne ka kaam karti hain. Isse apvaad hain to bas Allah ka zikr aur usse milti-julti any cheezen jo Allah ko priy hain, sharai jnaan rakhne waala vyakti jo use logon mein baantne ka kaam karta ho ya phir sharai jnaan arjit karne waala shakhs.

Duniya par aam andaaz mein laanat karna jayaz nahin hai. Kai hadeeson mein isse mana kiya gaya hai. Albatta duniya ki un cheezon par laanat karna jayaz hai, jo Allah se aur uski bandgi se hataane waali ho.
Allah ke zikr tatha usmen sahayak cheezon ko chhorkar duniya ki saari cheezen khel-tamaashe mein daakhil hain.
Jnaan, jnaanvaan logon tatha jnaan arjit karne waalon ki fazeelat ka bayaan.
Ibn-e-taimiya kahte hain : Duniya ki woh cheezen nindneey hain, jo kisi any kaaran se haraam hon ya halaal to hon lekin adhik se adhik ekatr karne ki laalsa ya abhimaan ka jazba paya jaye. Jo cheezen abhimaan ya lar-jhagarne ke liye ekatr ki jayen, wo samajhdaar logon ke yahaan ghrinit hua karti hain.
[is hadees ko tirmizi aur ibn-e-maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
3791: Jis raat mujhe meraaj karaai gai, us raat main ibraaheem alaihissalaam se mila. To ibraaheem alaihissalaam ne mujhse kaha : Ai Muhammad! Apni ummat ko mera salaam kahna aur bata dena ki Jannat ki mitti bari achchhi hai aur uska paani bara meetha hai.

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne pharmaya : "Jis raat mujhe meraaj karaai gai, us raat main ibraaheem alaihissalaam se mila. To ibraaheem alaihissalaam ne mujhse kaha : Ai Muhammad! Apni ummat ko mera salaam kahna aur bata dena ki Jannat ki mitti bari achchhi hai aur uska paani bara meetha hai. Jannat ek chatiyal maidaan hai aur usmen per lagaane ka kaam "Subhaan Allah, al-hamdu lillah, la ilaaha illallah evn Allahu akbar" Dvaara hota hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki isra evn meraaj ki raat aapki mulaaqaat Allah ke param mitr ibraaheem alaihissalaam se hui, to unhonne kaha : Ai Muhammad! Apni ummat ko mera salaam kah dena aur bata dena ki Jannat ki mitti bahut achchhi hai aur uska paani bara meetha hai. Khaarepan ka naam wa nishaan tak nahin hai. Jannat ek samtal, per-paudhon se khaali aur bahut bara maidaan hai, jismen per lagaane ka kaam kuchh pawitr shabdon dvaara hota hai. In pawitr shabdon ko "Al-baaqiyaat al-saalihaat" Yaani baaqi rah jaani waali nekiyaan bhi kaha jaata hai. Ye shabd hain : "Subhaanallah, al-hamdu lillah, la ilaaha illallah evn Allahu akbar", jab jab koi musalmaan in shabdon ko kahta hai aur duhraata hai, to uske liye Jannat mein per laga diya jaata hai.

Jannat mein adhik se adhik per lagen, iske liye Allah ka zikr karne ki prerna.
Islaami ummat ki yeh fazeelat ki ibraaheem alaihissalaam ne use salaam pahunchaya.
Ibraaheem alaihissalaam ne ummat-e-muhammadi ko adhik se adhik Allah ka zikr karne ki prerna di hai.
Teebi kahte hain : Jannat ek chatiyal maidaan hai. Usmen Allah apne anugrah se bandon ke karmon ke anusaar peron evn mahlon ki vyawastha kar deta hai. Har bande ko yeh donon cheezen uske karm ke anusaar milengi. Waise, Allah har bande ko un kaaryon ka suyog pradaan karta hai, jinke liye use paida kiya gaya hai, taaki woh karmon ka pratiphal per lagaane waale ki tarah praapt kar sake.
3795: Nubuvvat mein se kewal shubh soochnayen baaki rah gai hain.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue sunaah nubuvvat mein se kewal shubh soochnayen baaki rah gai hain. Sahaaba ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Shubh soochnayen kya hain? Farmayaah achchha svapn.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is hadees mein bataya hai ki achchhe svapn shubh soochna dene waali cheezen aur wahy ka silsila band hone ke baad shesh rahne waale naboowat ke aasaar mein se hai. Ab aane waale samay mein kya kuchh hone waala hai, use jaanne ka ekmaatr saadhan achchhe svapn hain.
3850: Yadi mere paas uhud parvat ke baraabar sona ho jaye to mujhe yeh achchha nahin lagega ki uska kuchh bhi bhaag mere paas teen din tak baaki rahe, siway uske jise mainne qarz chukaane ke liye bacha rakha ho.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah yadi mere paas uhud parvat ke baraabar sona ho jaye to mujhe yeh achchha nahin lagega ki uska kuchh bhi bhaag mere paas teen din tak baaki rahe, siway uske jise mainne qarz chukaane ke liye bacha rakha ho.

Yadi main uhud parvat ke baraabar bhi shuddh sone ka maalik ban jaaoon, to main poore ko Allah ke maarg mein kharch kar doonga aur uska maatr utna bhaag hi bachaakar rakhoonga, jitne ki zaroorat adhikaaron ki adaygi evn karzon ko chukaane ke liye ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai aur shabd Bukhari ke hain.]
3852: Waastawik maaldaari ka bayaan aur Allah ne jo kuchh diya hai, usse santusht rahne ki or prerit karna.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Maaldaari dhan-daulat ki prachurta ka naam nahin hai, balki waastawik maaldaari, dil ki maaldaari hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3853: Jhootha woh nahin hai jo logon ke beech sudhaar ka prayaas kare evn bhali baat pahunchaye athva achchhi baat kahe.

Umme kulsoom bint uqba bin abu moait- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue suna haih jhootha woh nahin hai, jo logon ke beech sudhaar ka prayaas kare evn bhali baat pahunchaye athva achchhi baat kahe.
Tatha saheeh Muslim ki riwayat mein itna adhik haih woh kahti hainh mainne nahin suna hai ki aapne teen sthaanon ke siwa kaheen aur jhooth bolne ki anumti di ho. Yaani yuddh mein, logon ke bigre sanbandhon ko behtar banaane ke liye tatha pati ke apni patni se baat karte samay evn patni ke apne pati se baat karte samay.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3854: Rishton-naaton ko nibhaane waala woh nahin hai jo ehsaan ke badle ehsaan kare, balki asal rishton-naaton ko nibhaane waala woh hai jo usse sanbandh wichchhed kiye jaane ke baavjood use jore.

Abdullah bin amr radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Rishton-naaton ko nibhaane waala woh nahin hai jo ehsaan ke badle ehsaan kare, balki asal rishton-naaton ko nibhaane waala woh hai jo usse sanbandh wichchhed kiye jaane ke baavjood use jore."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki rishton-naaton ko mibhaane ke maamle mein ek aadarsh vyakti woh nahin hai, jo upaakar ke badle mein upkaar karta ho. Is maamle mein ek aadarsh vyakti woh hai, jo doosri or se rishte-naate ko tore jaane ke baavjood rishta jore aur bura karne ke baavjood bhala kare.

Shareeyat ki drishti mein rishte-naaton ko nibhaane ka amal usi samay maany hai, jab rishta torne waale ke saath rishta jora jaye, atyaachaar karne waale ko kshama kiya jaye aur wanchit rakhne waale ko diya jaye. Wo rishta nibhaana nahin, jo badle ke taur par ho.
Rishta nibhaana dhan, dua, bhalaai ke aadesh aur buraai se manaahi aadi dvaara jahaan tak sanbhav ho bhala karne aur buraai se bachaane ke naam hai.
3855: Ai saad bin muaaz! Kaaba ke rab ki qasam, mujhe uhud parvat ke nikat se Jannat ki sugandh a rahi hai.

Anas- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mere chacha anas bin nazr- radiyallahu anhu- badr ke yuddh mein shareek nahin ho sake the. Atah, unhonne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Main aapke dvaara mushrikon se lare gae pratham yuddh mein shaamil nahin ho saka. Yadi Allah ne mujhe unse larne ka avsar diya to Allah dikha dega ki main kis bahaaduri se larta hoon. Phir jab uhud ke din musalmaanon ne apne sthaan chhor diye aur paraajit ho gae to unhonne kahaah ai Allah! Inhonne- arthaat unke saathiyon ne- jo kuchh kiya, main usse maafi maangta hoon aur unhonne (arthaat mushrikon ne) jo kuchh kiya, usse apni vyatha prakat karta hoon. Phir aage barhe to saad bin muaaz mile. Unse kahaah ai saad bin muaaz, kaabe ke rab ki qasam! Mujhe uhud parvat ke peechhe se Jannat ki sugandh a rahi hai. Saad- radiyallahu anhu- ne Allah ke Rasool se kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, usne jo kar dikhaya hai, woh mujhse nahin ho sakta. Anas- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hainh hamne unke shareer par assi se adhik talvaar, neza aur teer ke zakhm paye. Hamne dekha ki unhen shaheed kar diya gaya hai aur unke shareer ke angon ko kaat diya gaya hai. Sthiti yeh thi ki unki bahan ke atirikt koi unhen pahchaan na saka. Unhonne pahchaana bhi, to ungliyon se. Anas- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hainh ham samajhte the ki Qur'an ki yeh ayat unke tatha un jaise logon ke baare mein utri haih "Eemaan waalon mein kuchh aise log bhi hain, jinhonne Allah se kiye apne wachan ko sach kar dikhaya. Yahi kaaran hai ki unmen se kuchh ne apna wachan poora kar diya aur unmen se kuchh prateeksha mein hain. Aur unhonne tanik bhi pariwartan nahin kiya." (Soora al-ahzaabah 23)
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3861: Ham ek safar mein Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath ek aisi yaatra par gae jismen logon ko bari mushkilen jhelna pareen.

Zaid bin arqam- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki ham ek safar mein Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath ek aisi yaatra par nikle jismen logon ko bahut kathinaaiyaan jhelna pareen. Aise mein abdullah bin ubai ne kahaah tum Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas jo log hain, unpar kharch na karo, yahaan tak ki we ast-vyast ho jayen. Usne yeh bhi kahaah agar ham madeena lautkar gae to wahaan se sammaanit log apmaanit logon ko khader denge. Atah, main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya aur sab kuchh bata diya. Aapne abdullah bin ubai ko bula bheja. Parantu, usne qasam kha li ki uski or se is tarah ki koi baat kahi nahin gai hai. Atah, log kahne lage ki zaid ne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se jhooth bola hai. Unki is baat se mujhe bara kasht hua. Yahaan tak ki Allah ne meri pushti karte hue kah diyaah "إذا جاءك المنافقون" Phir Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen bulaya, taaki unke liye kshama yaachna kar saken. Parantu unhonne apne siron ko (inkaar ke taur par) mor liya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3863: Agar tumhaari baaten sahi hain, jo tum kah rahe ho, to maano tum unke munh mein garam raakh thoons rahe ho. Tum jab tak ise jaari rakhoge, Allah ki or se tumhaare saath unke wiruddh ek sahayak maujood rahega.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki ek vyakti ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mere kuchh rishtedaar hain, main unse rishta nibhaata hoon aur we mujhse rishta kaatte hain. Main unse achchha vyavhaar karta hoon aur we mere saath bura bartaav karte hain. Main unhen sahansheelta dikhaata hoon aur we ashishtata ka pradarshan karte hain. To aapne kaha : "Agar tumhaari baaten sahi hain, jo tum kah rahe ho, to maano tum unke munh mein garam raakh thoons rahe ho. Tum jab tak ise jaari rakhoge, Allah ki or se tumhaare saath unke wiruddh ek sahayak maujood rahega."

Ek vyakti ne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke yahaan aakar shikayat ki ki uske kuchh rishtedaar hain, jinke saath woh achchha vyavhaar karta hai, lekin we uske saath bura vyavhaar karte hain. Woh rishta jorta hai unke paas aata jaata hai  lekin we uska saath rishta kaatte hain. Woh unke saath pyaar aur eemaandaari se pesh aata hai hai lekin we uske saath anyay aur berahmi ka bartaav karte hain. Woh sahansheelta dikhaata hai tatha kshama karta hai lekin we uske saath naasamjhi ki wajah se bure shabdon aur kaamon se pesh aate hain. Aise mein uski or se unke saath rishte-naaton ka lihaaz rakhne ka silsila jaari rahna chahiye ya nahin?

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya: Agar tumhaari baat sach hai, to tum unhen unki hi nazron mein apmaanit aur zaleel kar rahe ho. Unki ghalat harakton ke baavjood un par dher saara  upkaar karke, goya tum unhen garm raakh khila rahe ho. Jab tak tum unke prati apna upkaar jaari rakhoge aur we tumhaare prati apna bura vyavhaar jaari rakhenge, Allah ki or se tumhaare saath ek sahayak niyukt hoga, jo unke wiruddh tumhaari sahayta karega aur tumhen unke atyaachaar se bachayega.

Durvyavhaar ke badle mein agar upkaar kiya jaye, to ghalti karne waale ke sudharne ki sanbhaavna rahti hai, jaisa ki uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : "Aap door karen (buraai ko) uske dvaara, jo sarvottam ho. To sahsa aapke tatha jiske beech bair ho, maano woh haardik mitr ho gaya."
Allah ke aadesh ka paalan karna, bhale hi raaste mein kuchh kathinaaiyaan ayen, ek momin ke liye Allah ki madad praapt karne ka ek saadhan hai.
Rishtedaaron se rishte torne se is duniya mein peera aur kasht hota hai aur aakhirat mein paap aur kathor dand milta hai.
Ek musalmaan ko Allah ki prasannata paane ke liye achchhe karm karna chahiye aur logon ke utpeeran aur unke rishta-naata kaatne ki wajah se apni achchhi aadton ko nahin chhorna chahiye.
Sachcha rishta-naata nibhaane waala woh nahin hai jo achchha vyavhaar karne waale rishtedaar ke saath achchha vyavhaar kare. Sachcha rishta-naata nibhaane waala woh hai jo durvyavhaar karne waale rishtedaaron se achchha vyavhaar karta ho.
3864: Koi vyakti aisa nahin hai jo Jannat mein prawesh karne ke baad duniya ki or lautna chaahega, chaahe use dharti ki saari wastuen mil jayen. Haan, magar shaheed ki baat aur hai. Woh (shahaadat ka) sammaan dekhkar kaamna karega ki dobaara duniya ki or waapas jaye aur das baar qatl kiya jaye.

Anas- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah koi vyakti aisa nahin hai jo Jannat mein prawesh karne ke baad duniya ki or lautna chaahega, chaahe use dharti ki saari wastuen mil jayen. Haan, magar shaheed ki baat aur hai. Woh (shahaadat ka) sammaan dekhkar kaamna karega ki dobaara duniya ki or waapas jaye aur das baar qatl kiya jay.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih "Shahaadat ki fazeelat dekhkar woh is tarah ki kaamna karega."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3866: Main nahin samajhta ki amuk evn amuk hamaare dharm ke baare mein kuchh jaante hain.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah main nahin samajhta ki amuk evn amuk hamaare dharm ke baare mein kuchh jaante hain.
Lais bin saad, is hadees ke ek warnankarta, kahte hainh yeh donon vyakti munaafikon mein se the.
3868: Jis bande ke qadam Allah ke raaste mein dhool dhoosrit ho gae, use (Jahannam ki) aag nahin chhooegi.

Abu abs abdur rahmaan bin jabr radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jis bande ke qadam Allah ke raaste mein dhool dhoosrit ho gae, use (Jahannam ki) aag nahin chhooegi."
Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne khushkhabri di hai ki Jahannam ki aag us vyakti ko nahin chhu sakti jiske pair Allah ke maarg mein larte hue dhool se san gae.

Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karne waale mujaahid ke liye susmaachaar ki use Jahannam ki aag chhu nahin sakti.
Dhool agarche poore shareer par lagti hai, parantu pairon ka ullekh wishesh roop se isliye kiya gaya hai ki us samay adhikaansh mujaahideen (yoddha) paidal hi larte the tatha sabhi paristhitiyon mein dhool pairon mein lagti hi hai.
Ibne hajar ka kathan hai; jab dhool lagne maatr se Jahannam haraam ho jaati hai, to us vyakti ke kya kahne, jo poori taaqat aur chhamta se yuddh mein shaamil ho.
3876: Aakhirat ki tulna mein duniya aisi hai, jaise tummen se koi apni ungli samudr mein daale (aur uthaye). Use dekhna chahiye ki ungli ke saath kitna paani aya.

Mustaurid bin shaddaad- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah aakhirat ki tulna mein duniya aisi hai, jaise tummen se koi apni ungli samudr mein daale (aur uthaye). Use dekhna chahiye ki ungli ke saath kitna paani aya.

Hadees ka arth : Yadi tum aakhirat ki tulna mein duniya ki haqeeqat jaanna chaaho, to pahle samudr mein apni ungli dubaao aur uske baad uthaakar dekho ki usmen kitna paani lagkar aata hai?
Zaahir si baat hai ki uske saath jo paani lagkar ayega, woh samudr ki tulna mein kaheen nahin thahrega. Bilkul yahi haalat hai aakhirat ki tulna mein duniya ka. Ek taraf duniya ki ayu chhoti hai aur uski sukh-suwidhayen naashvaan hain, to doosri or aakhirat sadaiv rahne waali hai aur uski nemten evn sukh-suwidhayen hamesha rahne waali. In tamaam baaton mein donon ke beech wahi tulna hai, jo ungli se lagkar aane waale paani aur samudr ke beech hai. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ka farmaan hai : {فما متاع الحياة الدنيا في الآخرة إلا قليل} (jabki parlok ki tulna mein saansaarik jeewan ke laabh bahut thore hain.)
Atah insaan ko jis qadar sukh-suwidhayen evn aanand praapt hain, unse banda thore-se samay ke liye, woh bhi beshumaar tees aur anginat kachot ke saath, laabhaanvit hoga. Unpar abhimaan aur unki numaaish ki ayu bahut chhoti hai. Bahut jald sab kuchh chhin jaana hai aur uske baad afsos evn pachhtaawe ke atirikt kuchh haath nahin aana hai : {وما أوتيتم من شيء فمتاع الحياة الدنيا وزينتها وما عند الله خير وأبقى أفلا تعقلون} (jo kuchh tum diye gae ho, woh saansaarik jeewan ka saamaan tatha uski shobha hai aur jo Allah ke paas hai woh uttam tatha sthayi hai. Kya tum samajhte nahin ho?)
Atah Allah ke paas jo sukh-suwidhayen, aanandmay jeewan, mahal evn khushiyaan praapt hongi, woh gun evn maatra mein adhik uttam evn adhik tikaau hongi aur kabhi khatm nahin hongi.
3880: Yeh vyakti us tarah ke dharti bhar logon se uttam hai.

Sahl bin saad saaidi- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke nikat se ek vyakti guzra to aapne apne paas baithe ek any vyakti se kahaah is aadmi ke baare mein teri kya ray hai? Usne kahaah yeh ek sajjan vyakti hai. Is layak hai ki yadi nikaah ka paigaam de to sveekaar kar liya jaye aur sifaarish kare to uski sifaarish grahan kar li jaye. Yeh sunkar aap khaamosh rahe. Phir ek aur vyakti guzra to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne usse poochhaah iske baare mein teri kya ray hai? Usne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Yeh ek nirdhan musalmaan hai. Is layaq hai ki yadi nikaah ka paighaam de to sveekaar na kiya jaye, sifaarish kare to na maani jaye tatha kuchh kahe to uski baat suni na jaye. Aapne farmayaah yeh vyakti us tarah ke dharti bhar logon se uttam hai.
3885: Kabhi aisa nahin hua ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se kuchh maanga gaya aur aapne na kah di.

Jaabir bin abdullah- radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki kabhi aisa nahin hua ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se kuchh maanga gaya aur aapne na kah di.
Tatha anas- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se jab Islam ke waaste se kuchh maanga jaata to zaroor dete. Ek baar aapke paas ek vyakti aya to use do pahaaron ke beech ki ghaati mein jitni bakriyaan theen, sab de deen. Usne apni jaati ke paas aakar kahaah ai meri jaati ke logo! Islam grahan kar lo, kyonki Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aise vyakti ki tarah dete hain jo nirdhanta ka bhay nahin rakhta. Aisa bhi hota ki ek vyakti kewal duniya haasil karne ke iraade se musalmaan hota aur kuchh hi dinon mein Islam uske nikat duniya aur uski tamaam wastuon se adhik priy ho jaata.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3908: Agar momin jaan leta ki Allah ke paas kaisi-kaisi saza hai to woh uski Jannat ki laalach na karta aur agar kaafir jaan leta ki Allah ke paas kitni daya hai to woh uski Jannat se niraash nahin hota.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah agar momin jaan leta ki Allah ke paas kaisi-kaisi saza hai to woh uski Jannat ki laalach nahin karta aur agar kaafir jaan leta ki Allah ke paas kitni daya hai to koi uski Jannat se niraash nahin hota.
3910: Jo log kisi sabha se Allah ka zikr kiye bina uth jaate hain, we waise hain jaise mare hue gadhe ke paas se uthte hain, aur yeh unke liye pachhtaawe ka kaaran banega.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jo log kisi sabha se Allah ka zikr kiye bina uth jaate hain, we waise hain jaise mare hue gadhe ke paas se uthte hain, aur yeh unke liye pachhtaawe ka kaaran banega."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki jab kuchh log kisi jagah mein baithte hain aur Allah ka zikr kiye bina wahaan se uth khare hote hain, to woh un logon ki tarah hote hain, jo kisi mare hue gande aur badboodaar gadhe ke shav ke paas jama hue hon. Kaaran yeh hai ki we baat mein vyast hokar Allah ke zikr se ghaafil ho gae. Aisi sabha qayaamat ke din unke liye afsos, khed aur haani ka kaaran siddh hogi.

Allah ke zikr ko nazraandaaz karne ke khilaaf chetaavni kewal sabhaaon tak hi seemit nahin hai, balki doosri jaghen bhi iske dayre mein aati hain. Imaam navvi kahte hain : "Kisi bhi jagah baithne waale ke liye yeh apriy kaary hai ki woh Allah ka zikr kiye bina us jagah ko chhor de."
Qayaamat ke din pachhtaawa aur sharmindgi ya to Allah ki ibaadat mein samay na bitaane ke kaaran sawaab aur pratiphal se wanchit hone ke kaaran hoga, ya Allah ki awajna ke kaaryon mein samay bitaane ke kaaran hone waale gunaah aur dand ke kaaran hoga.
Agar jayaz kaamon mein vyast hokar Allah ke zikr se ghaafil hone ki wajah se yeh chetaavni hai, to un haraam sabhaaon ka kya, jinmen gheebat aur chughalkhori hoti hai.
[ise abu daawood ne riwayat kiya hai]
3911: Jo musalmaan koi per lagaata hai to usse jo kuchh khaya jayega woh uske liye sadqa hoga, jo kuchh churaya jayega woh uske liye sadqa hoga aur jo kuchh kisi ke dvaara liya jayega woh uske liye sadqa hoga.

Jaabir- raziyallalaahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jo musalmaan koi per lagaata hai to usse jo kuchh khaya jayega woh uske liye sadqa hoga, jo kuchh churaya jayega woh uske liye sadqa hoga aur jo kuchh kisi ke dvaara liya jayega woh bhi uske liye sadqa hoga.
Tatha ek anay riwayat mein hai ki jo musalmaan koi per lagaata hai aur usse koi insaan, chaupaya aur pakshi kuchh khaata hai to woh uske liye sadqa hota hai.
Tatha ek aur riwayat mein hai ki jab koi musalmaan per lagaata hai aur kheti karta hai tatha usse koi insaan, chaupaya athva koi aur kuchh khaata hai to woh uske liye sadqa hota hai.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3914: Shaheed qatl ka dard kewal utna hi mahsoos karta hai, jitna tummen se koi cheenti ke dank maarne se mahsoos karta hai.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah shaheed qatl ki vyatha kewal utni hi mahsoos karta hai, jitni tummen se koi cheenti ke dank maarne se mahsoos karta hai.

Hadees : Jab koi insaan Allah ke maarg mein shaheed hota hai, to use wadh kiye jaane ki vyatha kewal utni hi hoti hai, jitni hammen se kisi ko cheenti ke kaatne se hoti hai. Daarimi ki riwayat mein "من ألم القتل" Aur "من ألم القرصة" Ke shabd aye hain.
Yaani shaheed ko any logon ki bhaanti mrityu ki kathinaaiyon aur pareshaaniyon ka saamna karna nahin parta. Use mrity ke samay adhik se adhik wahi kasht hota hai, jo hamen cheenti ke kaatne se hota hai, jo kuchh hi kshanon mein door ho jaata hai aur phir lagta hi nahin ki kaheen kuchh hua tha. Yeh daraasal shaheed par Allah ki anukanpa hai. Jab usne uchch evn mahaan Allah ke maarg mein apne praan ko prastut kar diya, to Allah ne uske liye mrityu ke kasht ko aasaan kar diya.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3915: Agar main apne in khujooron ko khaane tak jeewit raha to yeh bara lanba jeewan hoga. Atah, apne paas maujood khujooron ko phenk diya aur mushrikon se larne lage, yahaan tak ki maare gae.

Anas- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur aapke saathi chale, yahaan tak ki mushrikon se pahle hi badr pahunch gae. Uske baad mushrikjan bhi a gae. Aise mein, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah tummen se koi mujhse pahle kisi wastu ki or na barhe. Phir mushrikjan nikat a gae to farmayaah us Jannat ki or barh chalo, jiski chauraai aakaashon aur dharti ke baraabar hai. Warnankarta kahte hainh us samay umair bin humaam ansaari - radiyallahu anhu- kahne lageh ai Allah ke Rasool! Aisi Jannat jiski chauraai aakaashon aur dharti ke baraabar hai? Aapne kahaah "Haan!" Unhonne kahaah waah waah! Aapne kahaah "Tere waah waah kahne ka kaaran?" Unhonne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Allah ki qasam, is aasha ke siwa kuchh aur nahin ki mujhe bhi usmen prawesh ka saubhaagy praapt ho jaye. Aapne kahaah "Tu usmen prawesh karne waalon mein se hai." Yeh sunkar unhonne apne tarkash se kuchh khujoor nikaale aur unhen khaane lage. Lekin, phir kahaah agar main apne in khujooron ko khaane tak jeewit raha to yeh bara lanba jeewan hoga. Atah, apne paas maujood khujooron ko phenk diya aur mushrikon se larne lage, yahaan tak ki maare gae.
3916: Mujhe yeh pasand nahin hai ki mere paas is uhud parvat ke baraabar sona ho aur teen dinon ke baad mere paas uska ek deenaar bhi shesh rah jaye, siway uske jise main qarz ada karne ke liye bacha rakhoon. Baaqi poora ka poora Allah ke bandon ke beech is tarah, is tarah aur is tarah baant doon.

Abu zar- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki main Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath madeena ke harra (kaale patthar waali bhoomi) mein chal raha tha ki hamaare saamne uhud parvat a gaya. Aapne kahaah ai abu zar! Mainne kahaah main upasthit hoon, ai Allah ke Rasool! Farmayaah mujhe yeh pasand nahin hai ki mere paas is uhud parvat ke baraabar sona ho aur teen dinon ke baad mere paas uska ek deenaar bhi shesh rah jaye, siway uske jise main qarz ada karne ke liye bacha rakhoon. Baaqi poora ka poora Allah ke bandon ke beech is tarah, is tarah aur is tarah baant doon. Yeh kahte samay aapne dayen, bayen aur peechhe ki or ishaara kiya. Phir mujhse kahaah aaj adhik dhan-sanpatti waale qayaamat ke din kam se kam satkarm waale honge, siway uske jisne aise, aise aur aise kharch kiya. Yeh kahte samay bhi aapne dayen, bayen aur peechhe ki or ishaara kiya. Haan, magar aise log bahut kam honge. Phir mujhse kahaah mere aane tak tum yaheen ruke raho. Phir raat ke andhere mein chal diye, yahaan tak ki chhip gae. Isi beech mainne ek tez aawaaz suni aur dar mahsoos kiya ki kisi ne Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se chherchhaar na ki ho. Mainne aapke paas jaane ka iraada bhi kar liya, lekin aapki yeh baat yaad a gai ki mere aane tak yaheen ruke rahna, atah, waheen ruka raha. Aap aye to mainne kaha ki mainne ek aawaaz suni aur dar mahsoos kiya tatha aage ki poori baat sunaai to poochha: Kya tumne sachmuch woh aawaaz suni hai? Mainne kahaah ji haan! To farmayaah daraasl, mere paas jibreel aye the. Unhonne kahaah aapki ummat ka jo vyakti is awastha mein mar jaye ki kisi ko Allah ka saajhi na banaata ho, woh Jannat mein jayega. Mainne kahaah chaahe woh vyabhichaar aur chori mein lipt ho? Farmayaah haan, chaahe woh vyabhichaar aur chori mein lipt ho.

Hadees ka arth : Aboozar -radiyallahu anhu- bata rahe hain ki woh Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath madeene ke harra yaani kaale pattharon waali bhoomi mein chal rahe the ki prakhyaat uhud parvat saamne a gaya. Use dekh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : Mujhe is baat se khushi nahin hogi ki mere paas is uhud parvat ke baraabar sona ho aur teen dinon ke baad uska koi bhi bhaag, yahaan tak ki ek deenaar bhi mere paas shesh rah jaye, siway uske jise main qarz ada karne ke liye bachaakar rakhoon. Yaani yadi mere paas uhud parvat ke baraabar bhi shuddh sona a jaye, to main use poora ka poora Allah ke maarg mein kharch kar doonga aur uska kewal utna bhaag bachaakar rakhoonga, jiski zaroorat adhikaaron ki adaygi aur qarz chukaane ke liye ho. Mujhe is baat se khushi nahin hogi ki teen din ke baad isse adhik ek deenaar bhi mere paas shesh rahe.
Yeh hadees is baat ka pramaan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- maanav samaaj mein duniya ke moh se sabse adhik wirakt vyakti the. Kyonki aapko usse adhik dhan apne paas bachaye rakhne mein koi dilchaspi nahin thi, jitna qarz ki adaygi ke liye paryaapt hota. Jab aapki mrityu hui, to aapka kawach thore-se jau ke badle mein ek yahoodi ke paas rakha hua tha, jise aapne apne pariwaar ke liye liya tha.
Yadi sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ko duniya priy hoti, to woh apne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko usse wanchit na rakhta. Sachchaai yeh hai ki duniya dhikkaaryogy hai aur uski saari cheezen dhikkaaryogy hain, siway Allah ke zikr, usse sanbandhit cheezon, dharm ka jnaan rakhne waale aur use arjan karne waale aur Allah ki ibaadat ke kaaryon ke.
Phir aapne farmaya : "Aaj adhik dhan-sanpatti waale qayaamat ke din kam se kam satkarm waale honge" Kyonki aam taur par jiske paas duniya mein dhan adhik hota hai, woh abhimaan ka shikaar ho jaata hai aur Allah ki ibaadat se wichlit ho jaata hai. Kyonki duniya use ghaflat mein daal deti hai aur phalasvaroop woh duniya mein adhik dhyaan dene lagta hai aur aakhirat se dhyaan kam kar leta hai.
"Siway uske jisne aise, aise aur aise dhan kharch kiya" Yaani sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ke maarg mein dhan kharch kiya. Uske baad farmaya : "Magar aise log bahut kam hain." Yaani Allah ke maarg mein dhan kharch karne waalon ki sankhya bahut kam hai.
Phir farmaya : "Jis vyakti ki mrityu is awastha mein hui ki usne kisi ko Allah ka saajhi nahin banaya, woh Jannat mein prawesh karega. Chaahe usne vyabhichaar evn chori hi kyon na ki ho." Iska matlab yeh nahin hai ki vyabhichaar evn chori chhote gunaah hain, balki donon to bare gunaah hain hi. Yahi kaaran hai ki aboozar -radiyallahu anhu- ne ispar aashchary prakat karte hue kaha ki usne vyabhichaar evn chori ki ho, tab bhi Jannat mein prawesh karega? To aapne uttar diya ki haan, vyabhichaar evn chori ki ho, tab bhi.
Iska kaaran yeh hai ki jis vyakti ki mrityu eemaan ki awastha mein hui aur usne bare gunaah bhi kiye hon, to Allah kahta hai : "Nihsandeh Allah yeh nahin kshama karega ki uska saajhi banaya jaye aur uske siwa jise chaahe, kshama kar dega." Atah Allah use kshama bhi kar sakta hai aur saza bhi de sakta hai. Lekin yadi saza deta bhi hai, tab bhi use ant mein Jannat jaane ka saubhaagy praapt hoga. Kyonki Allah ka saajhi na banaane waale aur insaan ko kaafir ghoshit karne waala koi kaary na karne waale har bande ko anttah Jannat jaane ka saubhaagy praapt hoga. Lekin jisne kaafir ghoshit karne waala koi kaary kiya aur usi par mar gaya, use hamesha Jahannam mein rahna parega aur uske saare satkarm nasht ho jayenge. Kyonki munaafiq log Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se kaha karte the ki {ham gawaahi dete hain ki aap Allah ke Rasool hain} aur thore hi sahi lekin Allah ko yaad bhi karte the. Isi tarah susti ke saath hi sahi, lekin namaz bhi parhte the. Lekin iske baavjood we Jahannam ki sabse nichli shreni mein honge.
Is hadees se maaloom hua ki insaan ko duniya ke moh mein nahin parna chahiye. Duniya insaan ke dil mein nahin balki haath mein honi chahiye. Dil se kewal sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ki or mutvajjeh rahna chahiye. Yahi duniya ke moh se mukti ka asal arth hai. Iska arth hargiz yeh nahin hai ki tum duniya ka koi bhi bhaag dhaaran na karo. Balki iska arth yeh hai ki uski halaal cheezon ko lo aur usmen se apna hissa lena hargiz na bhoolo. Lekin use apne dil mein nahin, balki apne haath mein rakho. Is mahatvoorn bindu ko dhyaan mein rakhna chahiye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
3917: Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karne waale ki misaal us vyakti ki tarah hai, jo uske Allah ke maarg mein jihaad se waapas aane tak lagaataar roza rakhe, namaz parhe aur Qur'an parhta rahe tatha roza evn namaz se thakaawat mahsoos na kare.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki kisi ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Kaun sa kaam Allah ke maarg mein jihaad ke baraabar hai? Farmayaah tum use kar nahin sakoge. Usne do ya teen baar wahi baat dohraai aur aapne har baar kahaah tum kar nahin sakoge. Phir farmayaah Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karne waale ki misaal us vyakti ki tarah hai, jo uske Allah ke maarg mein jihaad se waapas aane tak lagaataar roza rakhe, namaz parhe aur Qur'an parhta rahe tatha roza evn namaz se thakaawat mahsoos na kare.
Tatha Bukhari ki riwayat mein hai ki ek vyakti ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, mujhe koi aisa kaary batayen, jo jihaad ke baraabar ho. Aapne uttar diyaah main koi aisa kaary nahin paata. Phir farmayaah kya tumse yeh ho sakta hai ki jab mujaahid jihaad ke liye nikle to tum apni masjid ke andar chale jaao aur bina thake namaz parhte raho evn bina chhore lagaataar roza rakho? Phir farmayaah iski shakti bhala kiske paas hai?
[ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4176: Lekin kis baat par baiat karen? Farmaya : "Is baat par ki kewal Allah ki ibaadat karoge, kisi ko uska saajhi nahin banaaoge, paanch wakt ki namaazen parhoge aur Allah ka anusran karoge. -tatha dheere se ek baat kahi- aur logon se kuchh nahin maangoge.

Abu Muslim khaulaani se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Mujhe dost aur amaanatdaar ne bataya hai, woh mere nikat dost bhi hai aur amaanatdaar bhi, yaani auf bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ne mujhe bataya hai : "Ham nau, aath ya saat log Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas the ki isi beech aapne kaha : "Kya tum Allah ke Rasool se baiat (arthaat; nishtha ki pratijna) nahin karoge?" Choonki hamne kuchh din pahle hi aapse baiat ki thi, isliye uttar diya : Ai Allah ke Rasool, ham to aapse baiat kar chuke hain. Aapne phir kaha : "Kya tum Allah ke Rasool se baiat nahin karoge?" Hamne uttar diya : Ai Allah ke Rasool, ham to aapse baiat kar chuke hain. Lekin, aapne phir kaha : "Kya tum Allah ke Rasool se baiat nahin karoge?"
