Atah, hamne haath phaila diye aur kaha : Hamne aapse baiat kar li, lekin kis baat par baiat karen? Farmaya : "Is baat par ki kewal Allah ki ibaadat karoge, kisi ko uska saajhi nahin banaaoge, paanch wakt ki namaazen parhoge aur Allah ka anusran karoge. -tatha dheere se ek baat kahi- aur logon se kuchh nahin maangoge." Chunaanche mainne unmen se kuchh logon ko dekha ki unka kora gir jaata to kisi se uthaakar dene tak nahin kahte the.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam kuchh sahaaba ke saath maujood the ki isi beech aap ne unse teen baar baiat karne aur kuchh baaton ka wachan dene ko kaha, jo is prakaar hain :

1- ek Allah ki ibaadat karna aur kisi ko uska saajhi na banaana. Ibaadat ka matlab Allah ke aadeshon ka paalan karna aur uski mana ki hui cheezon se door rahna hai.

2- din evn raat mein paanch farz namaazen ada karna.

3- musalmaanon ke shaaskon ke aise aadeshon ka paalan karna, jo islaami shikshaaon se na takraate hon.

4- zaroorat ki saari cheezen Allah se maangna aur logon ke saamne haath phailaane se bachna. Yeh baat Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne dheemi aawaaz mein kahi.

Sahaaba ne jin baaton par Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se baiat ki thi, unpar is tarah amal karke dikhaya ki hadees ke warnankarta ka kahna hai : Un sahaaba mein se kuchh logon ka haal mainne yeh dekha ki unka kora gir jaata, to use bhi kisi se uthaakar dene ke liye na kahte. Khud sawaari se utarkar utha lete.

Logon se kuchh maangne se bachne, maangne ke dayre mein aane waali sabhi cheezon se door rahne aur chhoti-moti baaton mein bhi logon se nisprih rahne ki prerna.
Yahaan jis sawaal se mana kiya gaya hai, uska sanbandh saansaarik cheezon se hai. Uske dayre mein jnaan evn deeni baaten nahin aateen.
4177: Us vyakti ki misaal jo apne rab ko yaad karta hai aur uski misaal jo apne rab ko yaad nahin karta, jeewit aur mrit ki si hai.

Tatha abu moosa radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Us vyakti ki misaal jo apne rab ko yaad karta hai aur uski misaal jo apne rab ko yaad nahin karta, jeewit aur mrit ki si hai." Sahi Muslim ke shabd hain : "Us ghar ki misaal jismen Allah ko yaad kiya jaata hai aur us ghar ki misaal jismen Allah ko yaad nahin kiya jaata, jeewit aur mrit jaisi hai."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne yahaan Allah ka zikr karne waale aur na karne waale ka antar bayaan farmaya hai. Laabh evn saundary ke maamle mein donon ke beech mein wahi antar hai, jo jeewit evn mrit ke beech hai. Jo apne rab ko yaad karta hai, woh ek jeewit praani ki tarah hai, jiska baahri roop jeewan se susajjit aur jiska aantrik roop jnaan ke prakaash se susajjit hai, uske andar laabh pradaan karne ki kshamta hoti hai. Jabki jo Allah ko yaad nahin karta, uski misaal ek mrit praani ki tarah hai, jiska baahri roop jeewan se rahit hai aur jiska aantrik roop bekaar hai, uske andar laabh dene ki kshamta nahin hoti.

Isi tarah jab ghar mein rahne waale log Allah ka zikr karte hain, to woh ghar jeewit hai aur jab Allah ke zikr ki andekhi karte hain, to woh ghar mrit hai. Waise, yahaan jeewit evn mrit yadyapi ghar ke logon ko kaha gaya hai, lekin muraad ghar mein rahne waale log hain.

Allah ke zikr ki prerna aur zikr se ghaflat par chetaavni.
Jis prakaar aatma shareer ka jeewan hai, usi prakaar zikr aatma ka jeewan hai.
Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apni baat samjhaane ke liye udaahran diya karte the.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki ghar mein Allah ka zikr karte rahna chahiye aur ghar ko Allah ke zikr se khaali nahin hone dena chahiye.
Navvi kahte hain : Agarche ek mrit momin bhi bhalaai ki or ja chuka hota hai, lekin Allah ki bandgi ke suyog ke saath lanbi umr milna fazeelat ki baat hai. Kyonki jeewit vyakti ki nekiyon ka khazaana uske dvaara kiye ja rahe achchhe kaamon se samriddh hota jaata hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4178: Allah ki qasam! Allah ke nikat duniya usse kaheen adhik mahatvaheen hai, jitna tumhaare nikat yeh bakri ka bachcha.

Jaabir- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) logon ke saath baazaar se guzre. Isi beech ek bakri ke mare hue chhote kaan waale bachche ke paas se guzre to aapne uska kaan pakarkar kahaah tummen se kaun ise ek dirham ke badle mein lena pasand karega? Sahaaba ne kahaah ham use kisi bhi cheez ke badle mein lena nahin chaahte. Woh hamaare hai bhi kis kaam ka? Phir farmayaah kya tum use lena nahin chaahte? Unhonne kahaah Allah ki qasam, woh zinda bhi hota to bhi doshi tha, woh to kankatta- athva chhota- tha, ab jabki mar chuka hai to kya haal ho sakta hai? Yeh sunkar farmayaah Allah ki qasam, Allah ke nikat duniya usse kaheen adhik mahatvaheen hai, jitna tumhaare nikat yeh bakri ka bachcha.
4179: Abu bakr se kaho ki logon ko namaz parhayen.

Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki beemaari adhik barh gai aur aapse namaz ke baare mein kaha gaya to farmayaah abu bakr se kaho ki logon ko namaz parhayen. Ispar aaisha - radiyallahu anha- ne kahaah abu bakr ek narm dil vyakti hain, jab Qur'an parhte hain to ro dete hain. Lekin aapne phir kahaah unheen se kaho ki namaz parhayen.
Tatha ek riwayat mein hai ki aaisha- radiyallahu anha- ne kaha thaah abu bakr jab aapke sthaan par khare honge to unke rone ke kaaran logon ko unki aawaaz sunaai nahin degi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4180: Main apne baad tumhaare baare mein jin cheezon se darta hoon, unmen se ek duniya ki chamak-damak aur uski maya ke darvaazon ka khulna hai.

Tatha abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ek din Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- minbar par baithe aur ham bhi aapke aas-paas baith gae. Is beech aapne farmaya : "Main apne baad tumhaare baare mein jin cheezon se darta hoon, unmen se ek duniya ki chamak-damak aur uski maya ke darvaazon ka khulna hai." Yeh sun ek vyakti ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya bhalaai bhi buraai laati hai? Yeh sun kar Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- khaamosh ho gae. Yeh dekh unse kaha gaya : Kya baat hai ki tum Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se baat kar rahe ho aur woh tumse baat nahin kar rahe hain? Is beech hamne dekha ki aappar wahy utar rahi hai. Phir aapne peshaani se paseena ponchha aur uske baad farmaya : "Prashn karne waala kahaan hai?" Ek tarah se aapne uski prashansa ki aur uske baad farmaya : "Bhalaai buraai nahin laati. Daraasal jo ghaas mausam-e-bahaar mein paida hoti hai, woh jaan le leti hai ya winaash ke nikat pahuncha deti hai. Albatta, us jaanvar ka nuqsaan nahin hota, jo ghaas khaata hai aur jab uski donon kokh bhar jaati hai, to sooraj ki or munh karke jugaali karna shuru kar deta hai, phir leed aur peshaab karta hai aur uske baad dobaara khaata hai. Nissandeh yeh dhan hara-bhara aur meetha hai. Ek musalmaan ke liye woh dhan bahut achchha hai, jo usne nirdhan, yateem aur yaatri ko diya. (Ya phir isi tarah ki koi baat Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kahi.) lekin jisne use awaidh roop se liya, woh us vyakti ki tarah hai, jo khaata to hai, lekin uska pet nahin bharta. Is tarah ka dhan qayaamat ke din insaan ke wiruddh gawaahi dega."

Ek din Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- minbar par baithkar apne saathiyon se baat karne lage. Isi dauraan aapne farmaya :

Mere baad tumhaare baare mein mujhe sabse adhik bhay is baat ka hai ki prithvi ki nemton, sansaar ke sukh-suwidhaaon,  uske waibhav aur uske wibhinn upkarnon, wastron aur kheton ke dvaar tumhaare liye khol diye jayen, jo hain to nashvar, parantu jinke aadhaar par log ek-doosre par abhimaan karte hain.

Ek vyakti ne kaha : Saansaarik sukh-suwidhayen bhi to Allah ka wardaan hain. To kya yeh nemat abhishaap aur dand mein badal jayegi?!

Uski baat sun kar Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- khaamosh ho gae aur logon ko laga ki aap naaraaz ho gae hain, atah log use bura-bhala kahne lage.

Lekin kuchh hi kshanon mein spasht ho gaya ki aappar wahy utar rahi thi. Chunaanche aap apni peshaani se paseena ponchhne lage aur farmaya : Prashn karne waala kahaan hai?

Prashn karne waale ne uttar diya : Main yahaan hoon.

Chunaanche aapne Allah ki prashansa ki aur uske baad farmaya : Waastawik bhalaai to bhalaai hi laati hai. Lekin ye sukh-suwidhayen wishuddh roop se bhalaai nahin hain, kyonki yeh fitna evn pratispardha ka kaaran banti hain aur aakhirat par poorn roop se dhyaan kendrit karne nahin deteen. Phir uski ek misaal bayaan karte hue farmaya : Basant ritu mein ugne waali hariyaali pashu ko aakarshit karti hai aur atibhojan se hone waali beemaari ka shikaar banaakar uski jaan le leti hai tatha use mrityu ke kareeb pahuncha deti hai. Lekin aisa jaanvar surakshit rahta hai, jo khaata hai aur jab uski donon kokh bhar jaati hain, to apna chehra sooraj ki or kar leta hai, shauch ya peshaab karta hai, phir apne pet mein maujood ghaas ko apne munh mein laata hai, use chabaata hai, phir use nigal jaata hai aur phir waapas khaane lagta hai.

Nissandeh, yeh dhan us hari aur svaadisht ghaas ke samaan hai, jise adhik khaane se mrityu ho jaati hai ya mrityu nikat a jaati hai. Lekin jab koi vyakti halaal tareeke se praapt dhan ke ek chhote se hisse se, jo jeewan-yaapan ke liye paryaapt ho, santusht ho jaata hai, to yeh dhan uske liye haanikaarak nahin hota. Ek musalmaan ka dhan prashansneey hai, jiska kuchh hissa woh gareebon, yateemon aur musaaphiron ko deta hai. Jo vyakti uchit tareeqe se dhan arjit karta hai, uske liye usmen barkat di jaati hai aur jo anuchit tareeqe se dhan arjit karta hai, uski misaal us vyakti ki tarah hai, jo kha to le, magar tript na ho. Yeh dhan qayaamat ke din uske wiruddh gawaahi dega.

Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees mein us vyakti ki fazeelat bayaan ki gai hai, jo sahi tareeqe se dhan arjit kare aur achchhe kaamon mein use kharch kare.
Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apni ummat ka haal aur uske liye duniya ki shobhaaon evn fitnon ke dvaar khol diye jaane ki bhawishtawaani ki hai.
Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apni baat samjhaane ke liye udaahran diya karte the.
Sadqa karne tatha neki ke kaamon mein dhan kharch karne ki prerna evn dhan ko roke rakhne ki manaahi.
Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke kathan "Bhalaai buraai nahin laati" Se maaloom hota hai ki aajeewika, yadyapit adhik hi kyon na ho, bhalaai hai. Woh buraai us samay shumaar hogi, jab use haqdaaron par kharch na kiya jaye aur naajayaz kaamon mein andhaadhundh kharch jaye. Jis cheez ke baare mein Allah ka nirnay bhali hone ka hai, woh buri nahin ho sakti aur jis cheez ke baare mein Allah ka nirnay buri hone ka hai, woh bhali nahin ho sakti. Lekin, bhay is baat ka hai ki jise bhali cheez di gai ho, woh uska prayog kuchh aise tareeqe se kare ki buraai saamne a jaye.
Jab chintan-manan ki zaroorat ho, to jawaab dene mein jaldi nahin karni chahiye.
Teebi kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki jaanvar chaar tarah ke hua karte hain : Ek woh jaanvar jo aanandit hokar khaata hi chala jaye, yahaan tak ki pasliyaan phool jayen, lekin phir bhi na ruke aur halaak ho jaye. Doosra woh jaanvar jo aanandit hokar khaye aur beemaar ho jaye. Jab beemaari barh jaye to bachne ki kuchh tadbeer kare, lekin der ho jaane ke kaaran bach na sake. Teesra woh jaanvar jo aanandit hokar khaye to sahi, lekin usse hone waale nuqsaan ko door karne ka prayaas shuru kar de, chunaanche khaya hua sab kuchh hazam ho jaye aur bach jaye. Chautha woh jaanvar jo santulan ke saath khaye. Bas itna khaye ki bhookh mit jaye aur oorja baaqi rahe. Pahli misaal awishvaasi ki hai. Doosri misaal aise awajnaakaari ki hai, jo gunaah chhorkar tauba us samay kare, jab samay haath se nikal chuka ho. Teesri misaal aise vyakti ki hai, jisse gunaah to ho jaye, lekin fauran tauba kar le. Aise vyakti ki tauba qabool hoti hai. Chauthi misaal aise tyaagi evn duniya ke moh maya se door vyakti ki hai, jiska dhyaan aakhirat par kendrit rahe.
Ibn-e-munayyir kahte hain : Is hadees mein kai sundar upmayen maujood hain. Pahli upma : Dhan tatha uski wriddhi ki upma paudhe tatha uske prakat hone se di gai hai. Doosri upma : Dhan kamaane aur bhautik saadhnon mein kho jaane waale ki upma ghaas khaane mein poori tarah vyast ho jaane waale jaanavron se di gai hai. Teesri upma : Adhik se adhik maal kamaane aur ekatr karne ki hawas ki upma khaane aur usse pet bharne ki hawas se di gai hai. Chauthi upma : Dhan se praapt hone waala woh ansh, jo logon ke hriday mein atyadhik moolyawaan hua karta hai aur jise dene mein we atyant kanjoosi karte hain, uski upma pashuon dvaara tyaage jaane waale gobar se di gai hai. Yeh shareeyat ki nazar mein uske gande hone ka ek sundar sanket hai. Paanchveen upma : Dhan jama karne aur use sametne par dhyaan na dene waale ki upma bakri se di gai hai, jab woh aaraam karne lage aur sooraj ki or munh karke apna pahlu zameen par tika de. Yeh bakri ki sabse aaraam waali aur sukoon bhari awastha hoti hai. Yeh daraasal uske hiton ki poorti ka sanket hai. Chhathi upma : Maal jama karne aur use kharch na karne waale ki maut ki upma us jaanvar ki maut se di gai hai, jo haanikaarak cheezon ke maamle mein laaparvaahi barte. Saatveen upma : Dhan ki upma us saathi se di gai hai, jispar bharosa nahin kiya ja sakta ki woh dushman nahin ban jayega. Kyonki dhan ka svabhaav prem ke kaaran use poori suraksha ke saath surakshit sthaan par rakhna hota hai aur yahi svaabhaawik prawritti use uske asli haqdaaron ko dene se rokti hai, jisse insaan dand ka haqdaar ban jaata hai. Saatveen upma:  Galat tareeke se dhan arjit karne waale ki upma usse di gayi hai jo khaata to hai lekin kabhi santusht nahin hota.
Sindhi kahte hain : Dhan ke andar do baaton ka hona zaroori hai. Ek to yeh ki use uchit tareeke se arjit kiya jaye aur doosra yeh ki use uchit sthaanon par kharch kiya jaye. Agar inmen se kisi ek cheez ki bhi kami ho, to yeh nuksaan ka kaaran ban jaata hai.... Yeh bhi kaha ja sakta hai ki ismen donon sharton ke ek-doosre se aniwaary roop se jure hone ki or ishaara hai. Yaani insaan ko dhan uchit sthaanon mein kharch karne ka suyog tabhi milta hai, jab usne use uchit tareeqe se arjit kiya ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4181: Jisne Allah ke maarg mein jihaad ke liye ek ghora surakshit rakha tatha aisa Allah par eemaan aur uske wachan ko sach maante hue kiya to qayaamat ke din use uske khaane, peene aur peshaab tatha gobar, har cheez ka pratiphal milega.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jisne Allah ke maarg mein jihaad ke liye ek ghora surakshit rakha tatha aisa Allah par eemaan aur uske wachan ko sach maante hue kiya to qayaamat ke din use uske khaane, peene aur peshaab tatha gobar, har cheez ka pratiphal milega.
4182: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Achchhe vyavhaar ka sabse adhik haqdaar kaun hai? Farmayaah teri maan, phir teri maan, phir teri maan, phir tera baap, phir kramshah tera sabse nikat ka rishtedaar.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki ek vyakti Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya aur kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Logon ke andar kaun mere achchhe vyavhaar ka sabse adhik haqdaar hai? Aapne kahaah teri maan. Usne kahaah phir kaun? Farmayaah teri maan. Usne kahaah phir kaun? Farmayaah teri maan. Usne kahaah phir kaun? Farmayaah tera baap. (Bukhari evn Muslim) tatha ek riwayat mein haih ai Allah ke Rasool! Achchhe vyavhaar ka sabse haqdaar kaun hai? Farmayaah teri maan, phir teri maan, phir teri maan, phir tera baap, phir kramshah tera sabse nikat ka rishtedaar.

Is hadees se maaloom hua ki maata evn pita donon ka adhikaar hai ki bachche unke saath achchha vyavhaar karen aur poorn roop se unki dekhbhaal karen. Allah taaala ka farmaan hai : "Tatha duniya mein unke saath achchha vyavhaar karo." Lekin maata ka adhikaar pita ki tulna mein kai guna adhik hai. Kyonki is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pita ke adhikaar ka ullekh maata ke adhikaar ko achchhi tarah ujaagar karne ke liye uska zikr teen baar karne ke baad kiya hai. Haalaanki bachche ke paalan-poshan mein maata evn pita donon ki bhoomika hoti hai. Pita uske liye dhan jutaata hai aur uski dekhbhaal karta hai to maata use khilaane, pilaane, kapra pahnaane aur uske liye bistar lagaane aadi kaamon mein svayn ko vyast rakhti hai. Lekin iske baavjood maata ka pad adhik ooncha isliye hai ki maata bachche ke liye jis prakaar ka kasht uthaati hai, pita nahin uthaata. Woh nau maheene tak kasht jhelte hue use apne pet mein rakhti hai, use janm dete samay is qadar kasht ka samaana karti hai ki use maut saamne dikhaai dene lagti hai, do saalon tak use doodh pilaati hai, uske aaraam ke liye raaton ki neend qurbaan karti hai aur uske hit ke liye jo kuchh kiya ja sakta hai, karti hai, chaahe use jitni bhi pareshaaniyon ka saamna karna para. Inheen baat ka ullekh karte hue Allah taaala ne kaha hai : "Aur hamne nirdesh diya hai manushy ko, apne maata-pita ke saath upkaar karne ka. Use garbh mein rakha hai uski maan ne duhkh jhelkar tatha janm diya use duhkh jhelkar tatha uske garbh mein rakhne tatha doodh chhuraane ki avdhi tees maheene rahi." Aap dekh sakte ki Allah ne is ayat mein insaan ko apne maata-pita ke saath upkaar karne ka nirdesh diya hai aur iske liye kaaran wahi bataye hain, jinka saamna maata ko karna parta hai, jo uske adhikaar ke mahatv ko darshaata hai.
Maata-pita ke saath achchhe vyavhaar ka ek paksh yeh hai ki yadi we kangaal hon to unke khaane-peene, rahne-sahne aur wastr aadi ke liye dhan kharch kiya jaye. Balki yadi we nimn athva madhyam star ka jeewan vyateet kar rahe hon aur tum uchch star ka jeewan guzaar rahe ho, to unhen apni shreni mein le aao ya apne se bhi unchi shreni pradaan karo, yeh baat bhi unke saath achchha vyavhaar karne mein sammilit hai. Yaad keejiye ki jab yoosuf alaihissalaam ko raajy praapt ho gaya, to apne maata-pita ke saath kya kiya? Unhen dehaat se laane ke baad sinhaasan par bithaya.
Maata-pita ke saath achchhe vyavhaar ka ek paksh, balki sabse mahatvapoorn paksh woh hai, jiska ullekh Allah taaala ne apne is farmaan mein kiya hai : "Aur (he manushy!) tere paalanhaar ne aadesh diya hai ki uske siwa kisi ki ibaadat (wandna) na karo tatha maata-pita ke saath upkaar karo, yadi tere paas donon mein se ek wriddhaawastha ko pahunch jaye athva donon, to unhen uf tak na kaho aur na jhirko aur unse saadar baat bolo. Aur unke liye winamrata ka baazu daya se jhuka do aur praarthana karo : He mere paalanhaar! Un donon par daya kar, jaise un donon ne baalyaawastha mein, mera laalan-paalan kiya hai." Atah unke saath badzubaani na karo, unhen koi kasht hone na do, unke saath narmi se baat karo, unke liye apna baazu jhukaye rakho, unke aajnaapaalan ke saamne apne astitv ko kamtar jaano aur dil ki garhaai se unke liye dua karte raho ki ai mere paalanhaar, jis tarah in donon ne bachpan mein laalan-paalan kiya hai, usi tarah tu in donon par daya kar, aur phir hamesha maata ka khayaal adhik rakha karo ki ayat mein isi ki or ishaara kiya gaya hai aur hadees mein bhi to spasht roop se iska ullekh kar diya gaya hai.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4183: Jise nirdhanta ka saamna ho aur use logon ke saamne rakhe, uski nirdhanta kabhi door nahin hogi aur jo use Allah ke saamne rakhe, use Allah ki or se rozi pradaan ki jayegi, chaahe jaldi ho ya der se.

Abdullah bin masaood- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jise nirdhanta ka saamna ho aur use logon ke saamne rakhe, uski nirdhanta kabhi door na hogi aur jo use Allah ke saamne rakhe, use Allah ki or se rozi pradaan ki jayegi, chaahe jaldi ho ya der se.

Abdullah bin masaood -radiyallahu anhu- bata rahe hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Jise nirdhanta ka saamna ho" Hadees mein prayukt shabd "فاقة" Ka arth hai atyadhik aawashyakta. Lekin iska adhiktar prayog nirdhanta aur aarthik tangi ke liye hota hai.
"Aur use logon ke saamne rakhe" Yaani use logon se bayaan kare, shikaatay ke taur par unke saamne rakhe aur unse apni is nirdhanta ko door karne ka niwedan kare, to uska parinaam yeh niklega ki "Uski nirdhanta kabhi door na hogi." Yaani daridrata kabhi uska peechha nahin chhoregi. Jaise hi ek zaroorat poori hogi, doosri usse bhi bari zaroorat uske saamne a khari hogi.
Lekin iske wipreet "Jo use Allah ke saamne rakhega" Yaani apne paak prabhu par bharosa karega "Use Allah ki or se rozi pradaan ki jayegi. Ya to jaldi" Woh is taur par ki use dhan pradaan kar dhanvaan bana de, "Ya der se" Yaani aakhirat mein.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4186: Jisne kisi abhaawagrast vyakti ko mohlat di ya use maaf kar diya, use Allah qayaamat ke din apne arsh ki chhaya ke neeche jagah dega, jis din uske (arsh ke) chhaya ke siwa koi chhaya nahin hogi.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne kisi abhaawagrast vyakti ko mohlat di ya use maaf kar diya, use Allah qayaamat ke din apne arsh ki chhaya ke neeche jagah dega, jis din uske (arsh ke) chhaya ke siwa koi chhaya nahin hogi."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jisne kisi qarzadaar ko mohlat di ya use qarz ka kuchh bhaag maaf kar diya, uska pratiphal yeh hai ki qayaamat ke din, jab sooraj bandon ke saron ke nikat a jayega aur garmi bari sakht hogi, Allah use apni arsh ki chhaya ke neeche jagah dega. Us din haalat yeh hogi ki chhaya usi ko naseeb hogi, jise Allah pradaan karega.

Allah ke bandon ke saath aasaani karne ki fazeelat aur iska qayaamat ke din ki bhayaawahta se najaat ka sabab hona.
Allah bande ko pratiphal usi koti ka deta hai, jis koti ka uska amal rahta hai.
[ise tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
4187: Jisne Allah ke maarg mein do cheezen kharch keen, use Jannat ke darvaazon se pukaara jayega ki ai Allah ke bande! Yeh behtar hai. Phir to namaaziyon ko namaz ke dvaar se pukaara jayega, jihaad karne waalon ko jihaad ke dvaar se aawaaz di jayegi.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jisne Allah ke maarg mein do cheezen kharch keen, use Jannat ke dvaaron se pukaara jayega ki ai Allah ke bande! Yeh behtar hai. Phir to namaaziyon ko namaz ke dvaar se pukaara jayega, jihaad karne waalon ko jihaad ke dvaar se aawaaz di jayegi, rozedaaron ko rayyaan naami dvaar se bulaya jayega aur sadqa karne waalon ko sadqa ke dvaar se andar aane ko kaha jayega. Abu bakr- radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Aap par mere maata-pita qurbaan hon, jo vyakti in dvaaron se pukaara jayega, use koi zaroorat nahin hogi, to kya koi aisa bhi hoga, jise in sabhi dvaaron se pukaara jayega? Farmayaah haan, tatha mujhe ummeed hai ki tum un logon mein se hoge.

Jisne Allah ki prasannata ki praapti ke uddeshy se kisi bhi cheez, jaise khaane, pahanne, sawaar hone ki wastuon athva naqdiyon mein se do wastuen sadqa keen, use farishte Jannat ke dvaaron se unke aagman ka svaagat karte hue pukaar kar kahte hain : Tum duniya se bahut-se puny ke kaary kar aye ho, jinka aaj tumhen bahut zyaada pratiphal diya jayega.
Adhik namaz parhne waalon ko namaz ke dvaar se pukaara jayega aur we usi se andar prawesh kareng, adhik sadqa karne waalon ko sadqa ke dvaar se pukaara jayega aur we usi se andar prawesh karenge, adhik roza rakhne waalon ka svaagat farishte ar-rayyaan naami dvaar ke paas karenge aur unhen usi se andar jaane ka aagrah karenge. Jnaat ho ki "الرَّيَّان" Shabd ka arth hai woh cheez jo pyaas mitaane ka kaary kare. Choonki rozaadaar paani peene se bachne ke kaaran pyaas jhelta hai, wishesh roop se lanbe garmi ke dinon mein to aur adhik, to badle mein unhen Jannat mein daymi sairaabi pradaan ki jayegi, jismen we "Al-rayyaan" Naami dvaar se prawesh karenge.
Jab abu bakr -radiyallahu anhu- ne yeh hadees suni, to unhonne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! "Mere maata-pita aappar qurbaan hon" Jo vyakti in dvaaron se andar jayega, use na kisi kami ka saamna karna parega aur na koi ghaata uthaana parega. "Bhala koi vyakti aisa bhi hoga, jise in tamaam dvaaron se pukaara jayega?" To aapne farmaya : "Haan, aise log bhi honge aur main aasha karta hoon ki tum un logon mein shaamil rahoge."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4188: Jisne Allah ke maarg mein kuchh kharch kiya, uske liye uska saat sau guna tak barha kar likha jayega.

Abu yahya khuraim bin faatik- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jisne Allah ke maarg mein kuchh kharch kiya, uske liye uska saat sau guna barha kar likha jayega.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4189: Kaun mujhe is baat ki gaaranti dega ki logon se kuchh nahin maangega aur main use Jannat ki gaaranti de doon?

Saubaan- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah kaun hai jo mujhe is baat ki gaaranti dega ki logon se kuchh nahin maangega aur main use Jannat ki gaaranti de doon? Mainne kaha ki main aisa karoonga. Us din ke baad unhonne kabhi kisi se kuchh nahin maanga.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4191: Jo jnaan praapt karne ke liye nikla, woh waapas aane tak Allah ke maarg mein hai.
Anas- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jo jnaan haasil karne ke liye nikla, woh waapas aane tak Allah ke maarg mein hai.

Hadees ka arth yeh hai ki jo vyakti apne ghar ya nagar se dhaarmik jnaan praapt karne ke liye nikla, woh waapas aane tak Allah ke maarg mein jihaad ke liye nikle hue vyakti ke samaan hai. Kyonki woh dharm ke punroddhaar, shaitaan ko naakaam karne aur nafs ko thakaane ke maamle mein jihaad karne waale hi ki tarah hai.

Jnaan praapt karna bhi Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karna hai.
Jnaan praapt karne waale ko yuddh ke maidaanon mein jihaad karne waale ke samaan pratiphal milega, kyonki donon aise kaary karte hain, jo Allah ki shareeyat ko shakti pradaan karte hain aur usse un cheezon ko door karte hain, jo uska ansh nahin hain.
Isse maaloom hota hai ki jnaan praapt karne ke liye nikalne waale ko, ghar waapas aane tak, jaane aur aane ke kram mein chalne ki bhi neki milegi.
4192: Jisne svapn mein mujhe dekha, woh jaagte hue bhi mujhe dekhega ya kaha ki usne maano, mujhe jaagte mein dekha kyonke shaitaan mera roop dhaaran nahin kar sakta.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jisne svapn mein mujhe dekha, woh jaagte hue bhi mujhe dekhega ya kaha ki maano, usne mujhe jaagte mein dekha, kyonki shaitaan mera roop dhaaran nahin kar sakta.

Ulema ne is hadees ke kai arth bayaan kiye hain :
Pahla : Isse muraad Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke zamaane ke log hain aur matlab yeh hai ki jisne aapko svapn mein dekha aur usne abhi tak hijrat nahin ki thi, use Allah hijrat aur aapke paas upasthit hokar jaagne ki awastha mein aapko dekhne ka suyog pradaan karega.
Doosra : Svapn mein jo nazar aata hai, woh sachmuch Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hi hote hain. Yaani aatma ke jagat mein. Insaan ka is prakaar ka svapn sachcha hota hai. Bas shart yeh hai ki usne aapko usi rang-roop ke saath dekha ho, jo hadees ki kitaabon mein bayaan kiye gae hain.
Teesra : Use us svapn ka moort roop aakhirat mein jaagne ki awastha mein nazar ayega, jab use aapki nikatta evn sifaarish aadi praapt hogi.
"Ya phir kaha ki maano, usne mujhe jaagte mein dekha" Yeh Muslim ki riwayat hai, jismen is baat mein sandeh vyakt kiya gaya hai ki aapne woh jaagte hue bhi mujhe dekhega kaha tha ya maano usne mujhe jaagte mein dekha kaha tha.
Iska arth yeh hai ki jisne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko svapn mein aapki asal shakl-soorat mein dekha, goya usne aapko jaagte mein dekha. Is prakaar aapka yeh waaky aapki ek any hadees ki tarah hai, jo saheeh Bukhari evn saheeh Muslim mein hai : "Jisne mujhe svapn mein dekha, usne mujhe hi dekha." Isi tarah saheeh Bukhari evn saheeh Muslim ki ek any riwayat mein hai : "Jisne mujhe svapn mein dekha, usne sachmuch mujhe hi dekha."
Aage aapne kaha : "Shaitaan mera roop dhaaran nahin kar sakta." Jabki ek riwayat ke shabd hain : "Jisne mujhe svapn mein dekha, usne mujhe hi dekha. Shaitaan ke wash mein nahin hai ki woh mera roop dhaaran kar saamne aye."
Yaani shaitaan ke liye Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki asal roop dhaaran karna sanbhav nahin hai. Warna kabhi-kabhi shaitaan aata hai aur kahta hai ki woh Allah ka Rasool hai. Lekin uski shakl wa soorat Allah ke Rasool jaisi nahin hoti. Atah woh Allah ka Rasool nahin hota. Isliye jab insaan svapn mein kisi vyakti ko dekhe aur uske dil mein aye ki woh Allah ka Nabi hai, to yeh jaanne ka prayaas kare ki uske svapn mein aane waale vyakti ki wishashtayen Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki wisheshtaaon ke anuroop hain ya nahin?
Yadi anuroop hain, to usne sachmuch Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko dekha hai aur agar anuroop nahin hain, to woh Allah ka Rasool nahin ho sakta. Daraasal hota yeh hai ki shaitaan soe hue vyakti ke dil mein yeh bhram daalta hai ki yeh Allah ka Rasool hai. Haalaanki woh Rasool hota nahin hai. Imaam ahmad ne musnad aur imaam tirmizi ash-shamaail mein yazeed al-faarsi se riwayat kiya hai ki woh kahte hain : Mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko svapn mein dekha, to abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- se kaha ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko svapn mein dekha hai, to unhonne bataya ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- farmaya karte the : "Shaitaan mera roop dhaaran nahin kar sakta. Atah jisne mujhe svapn mein dekha, usne sachmuch mujhe hi dekha." Atah tumne jis vyakti ko dekha hai, kya tum uska rang-roop bayaan kar sakte ho? Mainne kaha ki awashy. Phir mainne uska huliya bayaan kiya, to unhonne kaha : Yadi tumne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko jaagte mein dekha hota, tab bhi aapka huliya isse adhik bayaan nahin kar paate. Yaani unhonne sachmuch Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko dekha tha.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4193: Ai abu saeed!  Jo Allah ke rab hone, Islam ke dharm hone aur Muhammad ke Rasool hone se santusht ho gaya, uske liye Jannat aniwaary ho gai.

Abu saeed -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Ai abu saeed!  Jo Allah ke rab hone, Islam ke dharm hone aur Muhammad ke Rasool hone se santusht ho gaya, uske liye Jannat aniwaary ho gai." Aapki is baat se abu saeed -radiyallahu anhu- ko aashchary hua. Atah bole : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Ise zara dohra den. Atah aapne is waaky ko dohra diya aur farmaya : "Ek aur kaary hai, jiske zariye Jannat mein bande ki ek sau shreniyaan oonchi kar di jaati hain, jabki uski har do shreniyon ke beech utna faasla hai, jitna aakaash aur dharti ke beech hai." Unhonne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Woh kaary hai kaun-sa? Farmaya : "Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karna, Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karna."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu ko bataya ki jo vyakti Allah par eemaan laya aur uske paalanhaar, poojy, maalik, prabhu aur aadeshkarta hone par santusht ho gaya, Islam ko deen maankar tatha uske aadeshon evn nishedhon ke anupaalan se santusht ho gaya, Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke Nabi hone aur aapki tamaam shikshaaon se santusht ho gaya, uske liye Jannat waajib ho gai. Ispar abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu ko bara aashchary hua. Chunaanche unhonne anurodh kiya : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Zara is baat ko dohra den. Aapne unke anurodh ko sveekaar karte hue use dohraya aur uske baad farmaya : Mere paas ek aur amal ka jnaan hai, jiske dvaara Allah Jannat mein bande ke sau darje oonche kar deta hai, jinmen se har do darjon ke beech aakaash evn dharti ki doori ke baraabar faasla hai. Abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu ne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Woh amal kaun-sa hai? Aapne jawaab diya : Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karna. Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karna.

Allah ko rab maankar, Islam ko deen maankar aur Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko Nabi maankar santusht rahna Jannat ka haqdaar bana dene waali cheezon mein se ek hai.
Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karne ka mahatv.
Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karne waale ka uchch sthaan.
Jannat ke anginat darje hain aur mujaahidon ke liye unmen se sau darje hain.
Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saathiyon ka achchhi cheezon aur unke dvaar tatha kaarnon ko jaanne ka jazba.
4194: Jisne Allah ke maarg mein ek teer chalaya, woh uske liye ek gulaam aajaad karne ke baraabar hai.

Amr bin absa- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue sunaah jisne Allah ke maarg mein ek teer chalaya, woh uske liye ek gulaam aazaad karne ke baraabar hai.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4195: Jise yeh pasand ho ki Allah use qayaamat ke din ki pareshaaniyon se mukt kar de, use chahiye ki kisi abhaawagrast vyakti ko mohlat de ya uska qarz maaf kar de.

Abu qataada radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki woh apne ek qarzadaar ki talaash mein the. Aur woh chhupte phir raha tha. Ek baar mil gaya, to bola ki main abhaav ka shikaar hoon. Unhonne Allah ki qasam khaane ko kaha, to usne Allah ki qasam kha li. Tab abu qataada radiyallahu anhu ne kaha : Mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : "Jise yeh pasand ho ki Allah use qayaamat ke din ki pareshaaniyon se mukt kar de, use chahiye ki kisi abhaawagrast vyakti ko mohlat de ya uska qarz maaf kar de."

Abu qataada ansaari radiyallahu anhu ek vyakti ki talaash mein the, jisne unse qarz liya tha aur unse chhupta phirta tha. Anttah unhonne use dhoondh hi liya. Lekin usne kaha : Main is samay kathin paristhitiyon se guzar raha hoon aur aapka qarz chukaane ke liye mere paas koi saadhan nahin hai.

Chunaanche abu qataada radiyallahu anhu ne use Allah ki qasam khaane ko kaha ki kya sach-much uske paas qarz chukaane ka koi saadhan nahin hai?

Usne Allah ki qasam khaakar bataya ki woh sach bol raha hai.

Ispar abu qataada radiyallahu anhu ne bataya ki unhonne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai :

Jise yeh baat prasann karti ho ki Allah use qayaamat ke din ki pareshaaniyon, kathinaaiyon aur bhayaawahtaaon se mukti pradaan kare, use chahiye ki kathinaai mein pare hue vyakti ke saath udaarta barte. Yaani qarz ada karne ke liye kuchh samay de, adaygi ka mutaalba kuchh samay ke liye rok de athva qarz ka kuchh bhaag ya poora qarz hi maaf kar de.

Abhaawagrast vyakti ko abhaav door hone tak mohalta dena athva uske sar par lade hue qarz ke bojh ko poorn roop se ya aanshik taur par halka karna musathab hai.
Jo vyakti kisi momin se duniya ka koi kasht door karega, Allah usse qayaamat ke din ki kathinaaiyon ko door karega. Kyonki insaan ko pratiphal usi koti ka diya jaata hai, jis koti ka uska karm raha hota hai.
Siddhaant : Farz ibaadten nafal ibaadton se uttam hain. Lekin kabhi-kabhi neki ka nafal kaam farz kaam se uttam ho jaata hai. Jaise kisi abhvaagrast vyakti ko diye hue qarz ko maaf kar dena nafal hai aur uske baare mein dhairy se kaam lena, abhaav door hone ki prateeksha karna aur use mutaalba karke pareshaan na karna farz hai. Lekin yahaan nafal farz se uttam hai.
Yeh hadees abhaawagrast ke baare mein hai, jo ki majboor hai, jahaan tak aise taal-matol karne waale vyakti ki baat hai, jiske paas dhan ho, to uske baare mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Dhan waale ka taal-matol karna atyaachaar hai."
4196: Jisne eemaan ke saath aur neki ki aasha man mein liye hue, Ramzan ke roze rakhe, uske pichhle saare gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne eemaan ke saath aur neki ki aasha man mein liye hue, Ramzan ke roze rakhe, uske pichhle saare gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jisne Allah par wishvaas rakhte hue, roze ke farz hone tatha rozedaaron ko milne waale wishaal pratiphal ki pushti karte hue, Allah ki prasannata ki praapti ke liye aur dikhaawe se bachte hue Ramzan ke roze rakhe, uske gunaah kshama kar diye jaate hain.
Ramzan ke roze tatha any sabhi neki ke kaaryon mein man mein kewal Allah ki prasannata ki praapti ki neeyat rakhne ka mahatv.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4198: Jisne do thande samay ki namaazen parheen, woh Jannat mein jayega.
Abu moosa ashaari radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne do thande samay ki namaazen parheen, woh Jannat mein jayega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne do thande samyon mein parhi jaane waali namaazon yaani fajr aur asr ka khaas dhyaan rakhne ki prerna di hai, aur unko suchaaru roop se yaani samay par aur jamaat ke saath parhne waale ko susmaachaar diya hai ki yeh donon namaazen uske liye Jannat mein prawesh ka sabab banengi.

Fajr evn asr ki namaz paabandi se parhne ki fazeelat, kyonki fajr ki namaz meethi neend ke samay parhi jaati hai aur asr ki namaz kaam-kaaj ke samay. Zaahir si baat hai ki jo in donon namaazon ko paabandi se parhega, usse any namaazen chhoot nahin sakteen.
Fajr evn asr ki namaz ko thandi namaazon ka naam isliye diya gaya hai ki fajr ki namaz ke samay raat ki thandak hua karti hai aur asr ki namaz ke samay din ki thandak. Waise to asr ki namaz garmi ke samay parhi jaati hai, lekin us samay garmi pahle se kam ho jaya karti hai. Aisa bhi ho sakta hai ki yeh naam ek ko doosre par haawi karte hue diya gaya ho, jaisa ki arbon ke yahaan sooraj aur chaand ko al-qamraan yaani do chaand kaha jaata hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4200: Jis musalmaan ne Allah ke maarg mein tanik samay tak bhi Allah ke maarg mein jihaad kiya, uske liye Jannat aniwaary ho gai aur jo Allah ki raah mein zakhmi hua ya chot khaai, uske zakhm se qayaamat ke din bhaari maatra mein raktasraav ho raha hoga, jiska rang kesar ke jaisa hoga aur sugandh kastoori jaisi.

Muaaz- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jis musalmaan ne tanik samay tak bhi Allah ke maarg mein jihaad kiya, uske liye Jannat aniwaary ho gai aur jo Allah ki raah mein zakhmi hua ya chot khaai, uske zakhm se qayaamat ke din bhaari maatra mein raktasraav ho raha hoga, jiska rang kesar ke jaisa hoga aur sugandh kastoori jaisi.

[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4201: Jisne kaha : "Main Allah ki pawitrata bayaan karta hoon uski prashansa ke saath", uske liye Jannat mein ek khajoor ka per laga diya jaata hai.

Jaabir -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jisne kaha : "Main Allah ki pawitrata bayaan karta hoon uski prashansa ke saath", uske liye Jannat mein ek khajoor ka per laga diya jaata hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki jisne kaha :
(Subhaan Allah, arthaat, main Allah ki paaki bayaan karta hoon) aur Allah ki pawitrata ka gungaan kiya, (al-azeem, arthaat : Jo mahaan hai) svayn tatha apne gunon evn kaaryon mein mahaan hai, (wabi-hamdihi) is haal mein ki yeh paakeezgi uski prashansa ke saath juri hui hai; jab bhi vyakti yeh kahta hai tab Jannat ki zameen mein uske liye khajoor ka ek per laga diya jaata hai.

Adhik se adhik Allah ka zikr karne ki prerna. Allah ke zikr mein "Al-hamdu lillah" Ke saath  'subhaan Allah' bhi kahna hain.
Jannat ek wishaal evn wistrit sthaan hai aur Allah ki pawitrata tatha prashansa gaan se usmen per lagte hain. Yeh daraasal Allah ka anugrah evn kripa hai.
Yahaan hadees mein any peron ki bajay khajoor ke per ka zikr isliye kiya gaya hai ki yeh ek bahut hi laabhkaari per hai aur iska phal bahut achchha hota hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki Allah ne kuraan mein momin aur uske eemaan ki misaal isi per se di hai.
4202: Jo eemaan ke saath aur neki ki aasha man mein liye hue, lailtul qadr (sammaanit raatri) mein kayaam karta hai, uske pichhle saare gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jo eemaan ke saath aur neki ki aasha man mein liye hue, lailtul qadr (sammaanit raatri) mein kayaam karta hai, uske pichhle saare gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Ramzan maas ki antim das raaton mein se kisi ek raat mein widyamaan lailtul qadr (sammaanit raatri) ki fazeelat bata rahe hain. Aap bata rahe hain ki jisne is raat tatha iski fazeelat par wishvaas rakhte hue, Allah ki or se milne waale pratiphal ki aasha rakhte hue aur dikhaawe se bachte hue is raat mein jaag kar ibaadat ki, maslan namaz parhi, dua ki, Qur'an ki tilaawat ki aur azkaar parhe, uske pichhle gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain.

Lailtul qadr (sammaanit raatri) ki fazeelat tatha us raat mein jaag kar ibaadat karne ki prerna.
Neki ke kaary usi samay Allah ke yahaan sveekaar kiye jaate hain, jab unko sachchi neeyat ke saath kiya jaye.
Allah ka anugrah tatha uski kripa ki lailtul qadr (sammaanit raatri) mein eemaan aur neki ki aasha man mein liye hue ibaadat karne se pichhle gunaah maaf kar deta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4204: Jiske saath Allah bhalaai ka iraada karta hai, use museebton mein daalkar aazmaata hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jiske saath Allah bhalaai ka iraada karta hai, use museebton mein daalkar aazmaata hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki Allah jab apne kisi momin bande ke saath bhalaai ka iraada karta hai, to use uski jaan, maal aur pariwaar se sanbandhit kisi pareshaani mein daalkar aazmaata hai, kyonki iske nateeje mein banda Allah se girgiraakar dua karta hai, bande ke gunaah maaf ho jaate hain aur uske darje oonche kar diye jaate hain.

Momin ko tarah-tarah ki aazmaaishon ka saamna karna parta hai.
Aazmaaish kabhi-kabhi bande se Allah ke prem ki nishaani hoti hai. Allah bande ko is uddeshy se aazmaata hai ki uska darja ooncha kar de aur uske gunaah maaf kar de.
Kathinaaiyon evn pareeksha ke samay dhairy rakhne aur na ghabraane ki prerna.
4205: Ham apni jhopri theek kar rahe the ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) wahaan se guzre.

Abdullah bin amr bin aas- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki ham apni ek jhopri theek kar rahe the ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) wahaan se guzre. Aapne poochhaah yeh kya ho raho hai? Hamne kahaah jhopri kamzor ho gai hai, isliye ham ise theek kar rahe hain. Aapne kahaah main dekhta hoon ki maamla- maut- isse bhi kaheen jaldi ka hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4206: Musalmaan se jab qabr mein sawaal hoga to woh gawaahi dega ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain.

Bara bin aazib radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Musalmaan se jab qabr mein sawaal hoga to woh gawaahi dega ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain." Isi ko prabhutvashaali Allah ke is farmaan mein bayaan kiya gaya hai : (يُثَبِّتُ اللهُ الذِينَ آمَنُوا بالقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ في الحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وفي الآخِرَةِ). [soora ibraaheem : 27]

Har momin se qabr ke andar kuchh prashn kiye jayenge. Prashn, is kaary par niyukt do farishte karenge, jinka naam kai hadeeson mein munkar aur nakeer aya hai. Tab momin is baat ki gawaahi dega ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke Rasool hain. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya ki yahi woh pakki baat hai, jiske baare mein Allah ne kaha hai : “Allah eemaandaaron ko pakki baat par drirh rakhta hai saansaarik jeewan mein bhi tatha aakhirat ke jeewan mein bhi.” [soora ibraaheem : 27]

Qabr ke andar kuchh prashn honge, is baat mein kaheen koi sandeh nahin hai.
Eemaan waalon par duniya evn aakhirat mein Allah ka anugrah ki unko pakki baat par sudrirh rakhega.
Tauheed ki gawaahi dene aur isi gawaahi ke saath duniya se jaane ki mahatta.
Allah eemaan waale ko is duniya mein eemaan par drirh rahne aur seedhe raaste par chalne ke dvaara, mrityu ke samay ekeshvarvaad par marne ke dvaara, aur kabr mein farishton ke prashn karne ke samay sudrirh rahne ke dvaara, sthir karta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4209: Dekho, yadi isne bismillah kaha hota to yeh khaana tumhaare liye kaafi hota.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne kuchh saathiyon ke saath khaana kha rahe the ki ek dehaati aya aur use do niwaalon mein chat kar gaya. Yeh dekh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah dekho, yadi isne bismillah kaha hota to yeh khaana tumhaare liye kaafi hota.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4211: Mujhe aadesh diya gaya hai ki logon se yuddh karoon, yahaan tak ki we is baat ki gawaahi den ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain, namaz qayam karen aur zakat ada karen

Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Mujhe aadesh diya gaya hai ki logon se yuddh karoon, yahaan tak ki we is baat ki gawaahi den ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain, namaz qayam karen aur zakat ada karen. Agar unhonne itna kar liya to apni jaan tatha maal ko Islam ke adhikaar ke siwa hamse surakshit kar liya aur unka hisaab Allah par hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki Allah ne aapko mushrikon se us samay tak yuddh karne ka aadesh diya hai, jab tak woh is baat ki gawaahi na de den ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke Rasool hain. Saath hi is gawaahi ke taqaazon par amal karte hue din aur raat mein paanch waqt ki farz namaazen na ada karne lagen aur farz zakat haqdaaron ko na dene lagen. Jab woh itna kar lenge, to Allah unki jaan aur unke maal ko suraksha pradaan kar dega aur unka qatl halaal nahin rah jayega. Haan, agar aisa apraadh kar baithen ki islaami dand sanhita ke aalok mein qatl ke haqdaar thahar jayen, to baat alag hai. Phir, Allah qayaamat ke din unka hisaab lega, jo unke dilon ki baat jaanta hai.

Sharai aadesh zaahir ke aadhaar par laagu hote hain. Dil mein chhupi baaton ka hisaab Allah lega.
Ekeshvarvaad ke aahvaan ka mahatv. Aahvaan ka aaranbh usi se kiya jayega.
Iska matlab yeh nahin hai ki mushrikon ko Islam grahan karne par majboor kiya jaye. Daraasal unke saamne do raaste hua karte hain. Islam grahan kar len ya jizya (wishesh kar) ada karen. Donon manzoor na hon, to islaami nirdeshon ke anusaar jang ki raah hi bach jaati hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4212: Ek saath jama hokar khaao aur Allah ka naam lo, tumhaare khaane mein barkat di jayegi.

Wahshi bin harb- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke kuchh saathiyon ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Ham khaate hain lekin santusht nahin hote? Aapne kahaah shayad tum alag-alag khaate ho? Unhonne kahaah haan! Farmayaah ek saath jama hokar khaao aur Allah ka naam lo, tumhaare khaane mein barkat di jayegi.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4216: Allah ne mere liye, meri ummat ke galti se tatha bhoolvash kiye hue aur zabardasti karaye gae kaaryon ko kshama kar diya hai.

Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Allah ne mere liye, meri ummat ke galti se tatha bhoolvash kiye hue aur zabardasti karaye gae kaaryon ko kshama kar diya hai."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- bata rahe hain ki Allah ne aapki ummat se nimnalikhit teen paristhitiyon mein hone waale gunaahon ko maaf kar diya hai : 1- ghalti se hone waale gunaah : Yaani aise gunaah jo jaan-boojhkar na kiye gae hon. Maslan koi musalmaan iraada to kisi kaam ka kare, lekin usse ho kuchh aur jaye. 2- bhoolvash hone waale gunaah : Yaani kisi musalmaan ko koi baat yaad to ho, lekin jab karne ka samay aye, to bhool jaye. Aisa hone par use koi gunaah nahin hoga. 3- zor-zabardasti se karaye gae gunaah : Kabhi-kabhi aisa hota hai ki insaan koi aisa kaam karne par majboor kar diya jaata hai, jise woh karna nahin chaahta aur uske paas paristhiti ka muqaabla karne ki shakti bhi nahin hoti. Is tarah ki paristhiti mein use koi gunaah nahin hoga. Yahaan yeh yaad rakhna zaroori hai ki yeh hadees un gunaahon se juri hai jo bande aur uske rab se jure hain. Jahaan tak bhool jaane ke kaaran kisi aadeshit kaary ko chhor dene ki baat hai, to isse us kaary ki aniwaaryata samaapt nahin ho jaati. Isi prakaar agar kisi ke bhoolvash koi kaam kar dene se kisi srishti ka kuchh nuqsaan ho jaye, to uski bharpaai ki aniwaaryata khatm nahin ho jaati. Maslan koi ghalti se kisi insaan ka qatl kar de, to diyat deni hogi. Isi tarah kisi ki gaari ka nuqsaan kar de, to harjaana dena hoga.

Yeh Allah ki apne bandon par aseem kripa aur daya hai ki usne uprokt teenon paristhitiyon mein kiye gae gunaahon ko kshama kar diya hai.
Antim Nabi Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aur aapki ummat par Allah ka anugrah.
Gunaah na hone ka matlab yeh nahin ki hukm laagu nahin hoga aur koi muaavza nahin dena parega. Misaal ke taur par, agar koi wazu karna bhool jaye aur yeh sochkar namaz parhe ki usne wazu kar liya hai, to use koi gunaah nahin hoga, lekin use wazu karke dobaara namaz parhni hogi.
Zor-zabardasti ki awastha mein gunaah na hone ke liye uski sharton ka paya jaana zaroori hai. Maslan yeh ki zabardasti karne waala woh kaam karne ki shakti bhi rakhta ho, jiski woh dhamki de raha hai.
[allaama navvi rahimhullah kahte hain : Hadees hasan hai.]
[ise ibn-e-maajah aur baihqi aadi ne riwayat kiya hai]
4217: Prabhutvashaali evn mahaan Allah ne Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki mrityu se pahle lagaataar wahy utaari, yahaan tak ki jab aapne antim saans li to wahy (prakaashna) utarne ka silsila charam par tha.

Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah prabhutvashaali evn mahaan Allah ne Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki mrityu se pahle lagaataar wahy utaari, yahaan tak ki jab aapne antim saans li to wahy (prakaashna) utarne ka silsila charam par tha.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4219: Do khujooron ko ek saath munh mein na daalo, kyonki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne do khujooron ko ek saath munh mein daalne se mana kiya hai. Phir kahne lageh haan, yadi saath mein khaane waala apne bhaai ko anumti de de to koi baat nahin hai.

Jabla bin suhaim kahte hain ki ek baar hamen abdullah bin zubair ke saath akaal ka saamna karna para. Isi beech hamen khaane ko kuchh khujooren di gaeen. Ham khaane lage to abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- hamaare aas-paas tahalne lage aur kahne lageh do khujooron ko ek saath munh mein na daalo, kyonki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne do khujooron ko ek saath munh mein daalne se mana kiya hai. Phir kahne lageh haan, yadi saath mein khaane waala apne bhaai ko anumti de de to koi baat nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4220: Qayaamat ke din jahannamiyon mein se sabse kam azaab us vyakti ko ho raha hoga, jiske paas aag ki do pattiyaan aur aag hi ke do joote honge, jinke kaaran uska mastishk khaul raha hoga. Woh samjhega ki usse zyaada sakht azaab kisi ko nahin ho raha hai. Haalaanki use sabse halka azaab diya ja raha hoga.

Nomaan bin basheer radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Qayaamat ke din jahannamiyon mein se sabse kam azaab us vyakti ko ho raha hoga, jiske paas aag ki do pattiyaan aur aag hi ke do joote honge, jinke kaaran uska mastishk khaul raha hoga. Woh samjhega ki usse zyaada sakht azaab kisi ko nahin ho raha hai. Haalaanki use sabse halka azaab diya ja raha hoga."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki qayaamat ke din sabse halke azaab waala vyakti woh hoga, jiske pairon mein aag ke do joote honge aur aag hi ki do pattiyaan hongi , jinki garmi se uska dimaagh peetal ki haandi ki tarah ubal raha hoga. Woh samajhta hoga ki usse sakht azaab kisi ko nahin ho raha hoga, haalaanki use sabse halka azaab ho raha hoga. Aisa isliye hoga taaki use shaareerik aur maansik donon tarah ki takleef ho.

Awishvaasiyon evn awajnaakaariyon ko Jahannam ke is khatarnaak azaab ki chetaavni, taaki wo Jahannam tak le jaane waali cheezon se door rahen.
Jahannam jaane waale log apne bure karmon ke anusaar alag-alag shreniyon ke hua karenge.
Jahannam ke azaab ki sakhti. Allah hamen usse surakshit rakhe.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4221: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko doodh pesh kiya gaya, jismen paani mila hua tha. Us samay aapke dayen ek dehaati aur bayen abu bakr- radiyallahu anhum- baithe hue the. Aapne doodh piya aur uske baad dehaati ko dete hue kahaah dayen waale se shuru kiya karo.

Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko doodh pesh kiya gaya, jismen paani mila hua tha. Us samay aapke dayen ek dehaati aur bayen abu bakr- radiyallahu anhum- baithe hue the. Aapne doodh piya aur uske baad dehaati ko dete hue kahaah dayen waale se shuru kiya karo.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4222: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) makka wijay ke din kaale rang ki pagri baandhkar daakhil hue.

Jaabir- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) makka wijay ke din kaale rang ka saapha arthaat pagri baandhkar daakhil hue.
Abu saeed amr bin hurais- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hainh goya ki main Allah ke Rasool - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko dekh raha hoon. Aap kaale rang ka saapha baandhe hue the aur uske donon kinaare aapke donon kandhon ke beech latak rahe the.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kaale rang ka saapha baandhkar khutba diya.
[ise imaam Muslim ne donon riwayton ke saath naqal kiya hai.]
4223: Abdullah achchha aadmi hai agar woh raat ko namaz parhta.

Saalim bin abdullah bin umar bin khattaab- radiyallahu anhum- apne pita se riwayat karte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah abdullah achchha aadmi hai, yadi woh raat ko namaz parhta.
Saalim kahte hainh iske baad (mere pita) abdullah raat ko kam hi soya karte the.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4224: Yeh jibreel hain, tujhe salaam kah rahe hain.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne mujhse kahaah yeh jibreel hain, tujhe salaam kah rahe hain. Unka kahna hai ki mainne kahaah unpar salaamti ho, Allah ki kripa ho aur uski barakten hon.
Bukhari aur Muslim ki kuchh riwayton mein "وبركاته" Shabd aya hua hai, jabki kuchh riwayton mein nahin bhi hai. Albatta, wishvast warnankarta ka izaafa grahanyogy hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4225: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) koi peene ki wastu teen saans mein peete the.
Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) koi peene ki wastu teen saans mein peete the.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4226: Mainne ek raat Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath tahajjud ki namaz parhi. Aap itni der tak khare rahe ki meri neeyat bigar gai. Unse poochha gaya ki aapne kya iraada kiya tha? To boleh sochne laga tha ki aapko chhorkar baith jaaoon.

Abdullah bin masaood- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne ek raat Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath tahajjud ki namaz parhi. Aap itni der tak khare rahe ki meri neeyat bigar gai. Unse poochha gaya ki aapne kya iraada kiya tha? To boleh sochne laga tha ki aapko chhorkar baith jaaoon.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4227: Aapka kya khayaal hai ki yadi main Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karte hue maara jaaoon to mere gunaah maaf ho jayenge?

Abu qataada haaris bin ribai- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) unke beech khare hue aur bataya ki Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karna aur Allah par eemaan laana sabse uttam kaary hain. Yeh sun ek vyakti khara hua aur kahne laga ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapka kya khyaal hai ki yadi main Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karte hue maara jaaoon to kya mere gunaah maaf ho jayenge? Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne jawaab diyaah haan, yadi tum Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karte hue maare jaao aur sabr se kaam lo, neki ki aas rakho, aage barhte raho aur peeth dikhaakar na bhaago to tumhaare gunaah maaf ho jayenge. Haan, qarz maaf nahin hoga. Jibreel- alaihissalaam- ne mujhse aisa kaha hai.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apne saathiyon ke beech unhen sanbodhit karne ke liye khare hue aur bataya ki Allah ke pataaka ko ooncha karne ke liye jihaad karna aur Allah par eemaan rakhna sabse uttam kaary hain. Yeh sun ek vyakti khara hua aur Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha : Mujhe zara yeh batayen ki yadi Allah ke pataaka ko ooncha karne ke liye yuddh karte hue mera wadh hojaye, to kya mere gunaah maaf kar diye jayenge? Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne uttar diya : Haan, lekin shart yeh hai ki tum dhairyawaan raho, kasht ke samay sahan karo, Allah ke prati nishthaawaan raho aur yuddh ke maidaan se bhaagne ki bajay datkar muqaabla karo. Phir Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek aur cheez yaani qarz ka zikr kiya, yeh darshaane ke liye ki Allah ke maarg mein yuddh karne aur praan ki aahuti dene se bhi any insaanon ke adhikaar maaf nahin hote.
4228: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko koi kaam pasand hota, iske baavjood use is dar se chhor dete ki log uspar amal karne lagen aur unpar farz kar diya jaye.

Mominon ki maata aaisha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko koi kaam pasand hota, iske baavjood use is dar se chhor dete ki log uspar amal karne lagen aur unpar farz kar diya jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4229: Meraaj ki raat, main aise logon ke paas se guzra, jinke naakhoon taanbe ke the aur we apne chehron aur seenon ko noch rahe the. Mainne kaha ki jibreel! Yeh kaun log hain? To bataya ki yeh wahi log hain, jo logon ka maans khaate the aur unki izzaton par hamla karte the.

Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah meraaj ki raat, main aise logon ke paas se guzra, jinke naakhoon taanbe ke the aur we apne chehron aur seenon ko noch rahe the. Mainne kaha ki jibreel! Yeh kaun log hain? To bataya ki yeh wahi log hain, jo logon ka maans khaate the aur unki izzaton par hamla karte the.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4230: Agar tere paas mashk mein rakha hua raat ka paani hai to theek hai, warna ham munh lagaakar pi lenge.

Jaabir bin abdullah- radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne ek saathi ke saath ek ansaari ke yahaan gae aur usse kahaah agar tere paas mashk mein rakha hua raat ka paani hai to theek hai, warna ham munh lagaakar pi lenge.
4231: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unse ek oont khareeda aur unhen qeemat naapkar dete samay kuchh adhik diya.
Jaabir- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unse ek oont khareeda aur unhen qeemat naapkar dete samay kuchh adhik diya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4232: Main is baat ka tumse kaheen adhik haqdaar hoon. Chalo, mere is bande ko maaf kar do.

Huzaifa- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki qayaamat ke din ek vyakti ko laya jayega, jise Allah ne dhan pradaan kiya tha. Allah usse kahegaah toone duniya mein kya kuchh kiya? (Huzaifa kahte hain ki us din log Allah se koi baat chhipa nahin sakenge) woh kahegaah mere paalanhaar! Toone mujhe apni or se dhan diya tha. Atah, main logon se kray-wikray karta tha aur narmi se kaam leta tha; khushhaal ke saath aasaani karta aur tanghaal ko mohlat deta tha. Yeh sun (prabhvaashaali) Allah kahegaah main is baat ka tumse kaheen adhik haqdaar hoon. Chalo, mere is bande ko maaf kar do.
4233: Allah taaala ne jo hidayat aur jnaan dekar mujhe bheja hai, uski misaal tez baarish ki si hai, jo zameen par barasti hai. Phir dharti ka kuchh bhaag upjaau hota hai. Woh paani ko sokh leta hai aur bari maatra mein ghaas tatha hariyaali uga deta hai. Jabki dharti ka kuchh bhaag paidaawaar ke layak nahin hota. Woh paani ko rok leta hai aur uske dvaara Allah logon ko fayda pahunchaata hai. To log woh paani peete hain, apne jaanavron ko pilaate hain aur usse kheti-baari ki sinchaai karte hain.

Abu moosa ashaari- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se bayaan karte hain ki aapne farmayaah Allah taaala ne jo hidayat aur jnaan dekar mujhe bheja hai, uski misaal tez baarish ki si hai, jo zameen par barasti hai. Phir dharti ka kuchh bhaag upjaau hota hai. Woh paani ko sokh leta hai aur bari maatra mein ghaas tatha hariyaali uga deta hai. Jabki dharti ka kuchh bhaag paidaawaar ke layak nahin hota. Woh paani ko rok leta hai aur uske dvaara Allah logon ko fayda pahunchaata hai. To log woh paani peete hain, apne jaanavron ko pilaate hain aur usse kheti-baari karte hain. Saath hi baarish dharti ke kuchh aise bhaag par bhi barasti hai, jo teelon ki shakl mein hota hai. Na paani ko jama rakhta hai aur na hariyaali ugaata hai. Yahi misaal us aadmi ki hai, jisne Allah ke dharm ki samajh haasil ki aur jo shiksha dekar Allah taaala ne mujhe bheja hai, usse fayda uthaya. Usne use khud seekha aur doosron ko sikhaya tatha yeh us aadmi ki misaal bhi hai, jisne ispar tawajjo nahin di aur Allah ki hidayat ko, jo main lekar aya hoon, sveekaar nahin kiya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4234: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke zamaane mein kuchh logon ki pakar wahy (prakaashna) dvaara ho jaati thi. Parantu, ab wahy ka silsila band ho chuka hai. Ab ham tumhaari pakar tumhaare un karmon ke aadhaar par karenge, jo hamen nazar ayenge. Atah, jo hamen achchhaai dikhayega, ham uspar wishvaas karenge aur apne kareeb karenge. Uske dil mein kya hai, hamen isse koi matlab nahin hai. Uske dil ke andar chhipi baaton ka hisaab Allah lega. Tatha jo hamen buraai dikhayega, ham uspar wishvaas nahin karenge aur uski baaton ki pushti nahin karenge.

Abdullah bin utba bin masaood- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne umar bin khattaab- radiyallahu anhuma- ko kahte hue suna, we kah rahe the ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke zamaane mein kuchh logon ki pakar wahy (prakaashna) se ho jaati thi. Parantu, ab wahy ka silsila band ho chuka hai. Ab ham tumhaari pakar tumhaare un karmon ke aadhaar par karenge, jo hamen nazar ayenge. Atah, jo hamen achchhaai dikhayega, ham uspar wishvaas karenge aur apne kareeb karenge. Uske dil mein kya hai, hamen isse koi matlab nahin hai. Uske dil ke andar chhipi baaton ka hisaab Allah lega. Tatha jo hamen buraai dikhayega, ham uspar wishvaas nahin karenge aur uski baaton ki pushti nahin karenge, chaahe woh kahta ho ki uski neeyat theek hai.
4235: Yeh aag tumhaari dushman hai. Atah, jab sone lago, to use bujha diya karo.

Abu moosa ashaari- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki madeena mein raat ke samay ek ghar, ghar waalon samet, jal gaya. Jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko unke baare mein bataya gaya, to farmayaah yeh aag tumhaari dushman hai. Atah, jab sone lago, to use bujha diya karo.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4236: Apne bhaai ki madad karo, woh zaalim ho ya mazloom.

Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah apne bhaai ki madad karo, woh zaalim ho ya mazloom. Ek vyakti ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Jab woh mazloom ho to uski madad karoonga. Parantu, jab woh zaalim ho to uski madad bhala kaise karoon? Farmayaah use atyaachaar se roko. Yahi uski madad hai.
4237: Reshmi wastr wahi pahanta hai, jiska koi hissa nahin hai.

Umar bin khattaab- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah reshmi wastr na pahno; kyonki jo duniya mein use pahnega, woh aakhirat mein use nahin pahnega.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih reshmi wastr wahi pahanta hai, jiska koi hissa nahin hai.
Tatha Bukhari ki ek riwayat mein haih jiska aakhirat mein koi hissa nahin hai.
[ise donon riwayton ke saath Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4238: Kadaapi nahin, mainne use ek dhaareedaar kapre athva choge ke kaaran Jahannam ki aag mein jalte hue dekha hai, jise usne ghaneemat ke dhan se, bantvaare se pahle le liya tha.

Umar bin khattaab- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki jab khaibar ke din Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke kuchh saathi aakar kahne lage ki amuk shaheed hai aur amuk shaheed hai, yahaan tak ki ek aadmi ke nikat se guzre aur uske baare mein kah diya ki amuk shaheed hai to Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah kadaachit nahin, mainne use ek dhaareedaar kapre athva choge ke kaaran Jahannam ki aag mein jalte hue dekha hai, jise usne ghaneemat ke dhan se, bantvaare se pahle, le liya tha.
4239: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki mrityu hui to mere ghar mein kuchh nahin tha, jise koi jaandaar khaata. Haan, mere paas ek taak mein thora-sa jau rakha hua tha, jise main lanbe samay tak khaati rahi. (Ant mein ek din) mainne use naapa to woh samaapt ho gaya.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki mrityu hui to mere ghar mein kuchh nahin tha, jise koi jaandaar khaata. Haan, mere paas ek taak mein thora-sa jau rakha hua tha, jise main lanbe samay tak khaati rahi. (Ant mein ek din) mainne use naapa to woh samaapt ho gaya.

Is hadees mein aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ne bataya hai ki jab Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki mrityu hui, to unke ghar mein thore-se jau ke atirikt kuchh nahin tha. Is hadees mein prayukt shabd "شَطْرُ شَعير" Ka arth hai thora-sa jau hai, jaisa ki imaam tirmizi ne bataya hai. Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke chhore hue is thore-se jau ko woh ek avdhi tak khaati raheen. Lekin jab unhonne use naap liya, to woh khatm ho gaya. Yeh hadees pramaan hai us thori-si khaane ki wastu mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa salmal- ki barkat jaari rahne ka, jab tak use naapa nahin gaya tha, jo ki Allah par bharosa ka pramaan hai. Yaad rahe ki kray-wikray ke samay naapna waanchhneey hai, kyonki usse khareedne evn bechne waalon ke adhikaar jure hue hote hain. Lekin kharch karte samay naapna pasandeeda nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4240: Mritak ke saath teen cheezen jaati hain; uske ghar ke log, uska dhan aur uska karm. Phir do cheezen laut aati hain aur ek saath rah jaati hai. Uske ghar ke log aur dhan waapas a jaate hain aur uska karm uske saath rah jaata hai.

Anas- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah mritak ke saath teen cheezen jaati hain; uske ghar ke log, uska dhan aur uska karm. Phir do cheezen laut aati hain aur ek saath rah jaati hai. Uske ghar ke log aur dhan waapas a jaate hain aur uska karm uske saath rah jaata hai.

Is hadees ka arth yeh hai ki jab insaan mar jaata hai, to uske saath use wida karne waale jaate hain. Uske ghar waale qabr ke paas tak uske saath jaate hain, uska dhan yaani uske daas bhi uske saath jaate hain aur uska karm bhi uske saath jaata hai. Phir uske ghar waale aur uska dhan donon waapas a jaate hain aur uska karm uske saath rah jaata hai. Ab agar woh achchha hai, to sab kuchh achchha hai aur woh bura hai, to sab kuchh bura hi bura hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4242: Momin ko qayaamat ke din uske sarvashaktimaan paalanhaar ke saamne laya jayega, yahaan tak ki uspar apni or se parda daal dega aur usse uske gunaahon ka iqraar karaate hue poochhega

Safvaan bin muhriz se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Ek vyakti ne abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma se poochha ki aapne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se (Allah ki apne bandon se hone waali) sargoshi ke baare mein kya kuchh kahte hue suna hai? Unhonne uttar diya ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : "Momin ko qayaamat ke din uske sarvashaktimaan paalanhaar ke saamne laya jayega, yahaan tak ki uspar apni or se parda daal dega aur usse uske gunaahon ka iqraar karaate hue poochhega : Kya tum is gunaah ko jaan rahe ho? Kya tum (is gunaah ko) jaan rahe ho? Woh kahega : Ai mere paalanhaar! Main jaan raha hoon. Chunaanche Allah farmayega ki mainne duniya mein tumhaare is gunaah par parda daal rakha tha aur aaj main use tumhaare liye maaf karta hoon. Phir use uski nekiyon ka rajistar diya jayega. Rahi baat awishvaasiyon evn munaafiqon ki, to unke baare mein saari srishti ke saamne is baat ki ghoshna kar di jayegi ki in logon ne Allah par jhooth baandha tha."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne Allah ki apne momin bande se hone waali sargoshi  ke baare mein baat karte hue farmaya hai :

Qayaamat ke din momin ko uske paalanhaar ke nikat laya jayega, to Allah uspar parda daal dega ki uske chhipe hue gunaahon se hashr ke maidaan mein ekatr log avgat na ho saken. Phir Allah usse poochhega :

Kya tum amuk aur amuk gunaah ko jaante ho? Daraasal Allah usse un gunaahon ka iqraar karvayega, jo banda aur uske rab se sanbandhit the.

Chunaanche banda uttar dega : Haan, ai mere paalanhaar! Main in gunaahon ko jaanta hoon.

Jab banda bhaybheet ho jayega, to pawitr evn mahaan Allah usse kahega : Mainne tumhaare in gunaahon par duniya mein parda daal rakha tha aur aaj unhen maaf karta hoon. Iske baad use uska karm patr diya jayega.

Rahi baat awishvaasi evn munaafiq ki, to unke baare mein saarvajnik roop se yeh elaan kiya jayega : Yahi we log hain, jinhonne apne paalanhaar par jhooth baandha tha. Sun lo, Allah ki laanat hai, in zaalimon par.

Eemaan waalon par Allah ka yeh anugrah hai ki unke gunaahon par duniya evn aakhirat mein parda daal diya jaata hai.
Momin ki kamiyon par har sanbhav parda daalne ki prerna.
Bandon ke sabhi karm bandon ke paalanhaar ke yahaan shumaar hote hain. Atah jise achchhaai mile, woh Allah ki prashansa kare aur jisko kuchh aur mile, woh apne aapko kose.Aur woh Allah ki ichchha ke adheen hai.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : In tamaam hadeeson ka saaraansh yeh hai ki qayaamat ke din mominon ke do prakaar honge : Pahla prakaar : Aise log jinke gunaah unke tatha unke paalanhaar se sanbandhit honge. Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ki yeh hadees bataati hai ki is prakaar ke logon ke bhi do prakaar hain : Ek aise log jinke gunaah par duniya mein parda para rah gaya. Is prakaar ke logon ke gunaah par qayaamat ke din bhi parda daalkar rakh diya jayega. Yeh baat is hadees se spasht hai. Jabki doosre aise log honge, jo khuleaam gunaah karte the. Is hadees se yeh baat nikalkar saamne aati hai ki aise logon ke gunaahon par parda daala nahin jayega. Doosra prakaar : Aise log jinke gunaah unke tatha bandon se sanbandhit honge. Is prakaar ke logon ke bhi do prakaar hain. Ek aise log jinke gunaahon ka palra nekiyon ke palre par bhaari hoga. Aise log Jahannam jayenge aur sifaarish ke baad baahar niklenge. Doosre aise log jinke gunaahon aur nekiyon ke palre baraabar honge. Aise log us samay tak jahann nahin jayenge, jab tak peerit logon ko unse badla na dilva diya jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4243: Sawaar paidal chalne waale ko salaam karega, paidal chalne waala baithe hue ko salaam karega aur chhota samooh bare samooh ko salaam karega.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, unhonne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Sawaar paidal chalne waale ko salaam karega, paidal chalne waala baithe hue ko salaam karega aur chhota samooh bare samooh ko salaam karega." Jabki saheeh Bukhari mein hai : "Chhota bare ko salaam karega, guzarne waala baithe hue ko salaam karega aur chhota samooh bare samooh ko salaam karega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne salaam karne ke kuchh aadaab sikhaye hain. Salaam ke shabd is prakaar hain : "Assalaamu alaikum wa rahamtullahi wa barkaatuhu" Aapne bataya hai ki chhota bare ko salaam kare, sawaar paidal ko salaam kare, paidal baithe hue ko salaam kare aur kam sankhya adhik sankhya ko salaam kare.

Is hadees mein bataye gae tareeqe ke anusaar hi salaam karna musathab hai. Lekin agar isse hatkar paidal chalne waala sawaar vyakti ko salaam kar de, tab bhi jayaz hai. Lekin yeh uttam nahin hai.
Is hadees mein bataye hue tareeqe ke anusaar salaam karne se samaaj mein prem evn sadbhaav aam hota hai.
Jab log is hadees mein diye gae nirdeshon ke anusaar samaan hon, to salaam karne mein pahal karne waala vyakti uttam vyakti hoga.
Islam ek sanpoorn dharm hai, jisne zaroorat ki tamaam cheezen bayaan kar di hain.
Salaam ke aadaab sikhaana aur har haq waale ko uska haq dena.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4244: Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dekha ki bhookh ke kaaran saara din pet par jhuke rahte the (taaki bhookh ki kathorta kam mahsoos ho). Aapko raddi khujoor bhi nahin milti tha, jisse apna pet bhar paate.

Noomaan bin basheer- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki umar bin khattaab- radiyallahu anhu- ne logon ko jo duniya praapt ho chuki thi, uska zikr kiya aur farmayaah mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dekha ki bhookh ke kaaran saara din pet par jhuke rahte the (taaki bhookh ki kathorta kam mahsoos ho). Aapko raddi khujoor bhi nahin milti thi, jisse apna pet bhar paate.
4245: Jab sadqe ka mahatv bayaan karne waali ayat utri to ham apni peeth par bojh uthaate (aur usse praapt mazdoori ko daan karte the). Phir ek vyakti aya aur bahut-sa dhan daan kiya to munaafikon ne kahaah yeh riyaakaar hai tatha ek any vyakti aya aur ek saa daan kiya to kahne lage ki Allah ko iske ek saa ki zaroorat nahin hai. Aisi paristhiti mein yeh ayat utreeh "الذين يلمزون المطوعين من المؤمنين في الصدقات والذين لا يجدون إلا جهدهم" (Arthaat, jo log svechchha se dene waale mominon par unke daan ke wishay mein choten karte hain aur un logon ka uphaas karte hain, jinke paas uske siwa kuchh nahin, jo we mashakkat uthaakar dete hain, unka uphaas Allah ne kiya aur unke liye dukhdayi yaatna hai.)

Abu masaood uqba bin amr ansaari badri- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki jab sadqe ka mahatv bayaan karne waali ayat utri to ham apni peeth par bojh uthaate (aur usse praapt mazdoori ko daan karte the). Phir ek vyakti aya aur bahut sa dhan daan kiya to munaafikon ne kahaah yeh riyaakaar hai tatha ek any vyakti aya aur ek saa daan kiya to kahne lage ki Allah ko iske ek saa ki zaroorat nahin hai. Aisi paristhiti mein yeh ayat utreeh "الذين يلمزون المطوعين من المؤمنين في الصدقات والذين لا يجدون إلا جهدهم" (Arthaat, jo log svechchha se dene waale mominon par unke daan ke wishay mein choten karte hain aur un logon ka uphaas karte hain, jinke paas uske siwa kuchh nahin, jo we mashakkat uthaakar dete hain, unka uphaas Allah ne kiya aur unke liye dukhdayi yaatna hai.)
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4246: Tumse pahle aisa bhi hota tha ki ek vyakti ko pakar liya jaata, phir uske liye zameen mein garha khoda jaata aur use usmen daal diya jaata, uske baad aara laya jaata, use uske sir par rakha jaata aur cheerkar uske do tukre kar diye jaate tatha uske shareer par lohe ki kanghiyaan chalaai jaateen, jo uske maans ko paar karke haddiyon tak pahunch jaateen, lekin yeh sab yaatnayen use Allah ke dharm se rok nahin paateen theen.

Abu abdullah khabbaab bin aratt- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kaabe ki chhaanv mein chaadar ka takiya banaakar aaraam kar rahe the ki hamne aapse (kaafiron ke dvaara di jaane waali peeraaon ki) shikayat ki aur kaha ki kya aap hamaare liye Allah se sahayta nahin maangeng? Kya aap hamaare liye Allah se dua nahin karenge? Aapne kahaah tumse pahle aisa bhi hota tha ki ek vyakti ko pakar liya jaata, phir uske liye zameen mein garha khoda jaata aur use usmen daal diya jaata, uske baad aara laya jaata, use uske sir par rakha jaata aur cheerkar uske do tukre kar diye jaate tatha uske shareer par lohe ki kanghiyaan chalaai jaateen, jo uske maans ko paar karke haddiyon tak pahunch jaateen, lekin yeh sab yaatnayen use Allah ke dharm se rok nahin paateen theen. Allah ki qasam! Allah is dharm ko mukammal karke rahega, yahaan tak ki ek sawaar sanaa se hazarmoot tak jayega aur use Allah evn bakriyon par bheriye ke siwa kisi ka bhay nahin hoga, lekin tum jaldabaazi se kaam le rahe ho. Tatha ek riwayat mein haih aap ek chaadar ka takiya banaakar aaraam kar rahe the aur- is dasha mein ki us samay- ham mushrikon ki or se bari kathinaaiyon ka saamna kar rahe the.
4247: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) raat ke pratham bhaag mein sote aur antim bhaag mein uthkar namaz parhte the.
Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) raat ke pratham bhaag mein sote aur antim bhaag mein uthkar namaz parhte the.

Is hadees mein aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ne bataya hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- isha ki namaz ke baad raat ke pratham bhaag mein sote the aur antim bhaag yaani raat ke doosre tihaai bhaag mein uthkar namaz parhte the. Phir jab namaz parh lete, to dobaara sone ke liye bistar mein chale jaate the. Dobaara sone ke liye bistar mein jaane ka yeh kaary raat ke antim chhathe bhaag mein karte the. Taaki raat ki namaz ki thakaan se shareer ko aaraam mil jaye. Iske andar kai aur hikamten bhi hain. Maslan yeh ki isse poori chusti aur tawajjo ke saath fajr ki namaz aur din ke azkaar ka svaagat kiya ja sakta hai aur yeh dikhaawe se bachne ka bhi ek saadhan hai. Kyonki jo vyakti raat ke antim chhathe bhaag mein so jayega, subah uska chehra khila hua aur uska shareer chust-durust rahega. Atah isse uski raat ki ibaadat se parda bhi nahin uthega.
Isi ke maddenzar ek hadees mein kaha gaya hai ki pahli azaan isliye di jaati hai, taaki soe hue log jaag jayen aur namaz mein vyast log so jayen. Taaki namaz mein vyast vyakti ke shareer ko chusti aur shakti praapt ho jaye aur soya hua vyakti jaagkar namaz ke liye taiyaari karne lage aur yadi raat ke pratham bhaag mein witr nahin parhi hai, to use parh le.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4248: Jannat ki hamesha baaki rahne waali nemton ki or prerit karna aur jahann ki dukhdayi yaatna se saavdhaan karna.

Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) farmayaah qayaamat ke din duniya mein sabse adhik nemton mein rahne waale jahannami ko laya jayega aur use Jahannam mein ek baar dubaane ke baad uthaakar kaha jayegaah ai aadam ki santaan! Kya toone kabhi koi bhalaai dekhi hai? Kya kabhi koi nemat tere paas se guzri hai? Woh uttar degaah nahin, ai mere prabhu, Allah ki qasam! Phir duniya mein sabse badhaal jeewan vyateet karne waale jannati ko laya jayega aur Jannat mein ek baar dubaane ke baad uthaakar kaha jayegaah ai aadam ki santaan! Kya toone kabhi koi pareshaani dekhi hai? Kya tere nikat se kabhi kisi kathinaai ka guzar hua hai?
