Woh kahegaah nahin, Allah ki qasam, na mere nikat se kabhi koi pareshaani guzri hai aur na mainne kabhi koi kathinaai dekhi hai.
4249: Main lanbi namaz parhne ke iraade se khara hota hoon, lekin kisi bachche ke rone ki aawaaz sunkar is dar se apni namaz halki kar deta hoon ki kaheen uski maan ko takleef mein na daal doon.

Abu kataada aur anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah main lanbi namaz parhne ke iraade se khara hota hoon, lekin kisi bachche ke rone ki aawaaz sunkar is dar se apni namaz halki kar deta hoon ki kaheen uski maan ko takleef mein na daal doon.
[ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4250: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mere do parosi hain. Main donon mein se kise koi wastu bhent ke roop mein doon? Aapne kahaah jiska dvaar tere dvaar se adhik nikat ho.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki unhonne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Mere do parosi hain. Main donon mein se kise koi wastu bhent- ke roop mein doon? Aapne kahaah jiska dvaar tere dvaar se adhik nikat ho.

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha ki mere do parosi hain aur mujhe parosi ke sammaan ka aam aadesh diya gaya hai. Lekin main donon ko ek saath uphaar nahin de sakti. Atah main kise uphaar doon ki parosi ka sammaan karne waale logon mein shaamil ho jaaoon? Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Jiska dvaar tumhaare dvaar se adhik nikat ho."
4251: Bachchon ko bosa dena aur unse sneh aur daya karna.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki dehaat ke rahne waale kuchh log Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aye aur poochhaah kya aap apne bachchon ko bosa dete hain? Aapne kahaah haan! Un logon ne kahaah lekin Allah ki qasam! Ham bosa nahin denge. Ispar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah yadi Allah ne tumhaare dilon se daya ko nikaal diya hai to main kya kar sakta hoon?
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4252: Sabse bara pratiphal waala sadqa kaun-sa hai? Aapne pharmayaah woh sadqa, jo tum us samay karo, jab tum sehatmand evn lobhi ho; tumhen nirdhan ho jaane ka dar sataye aur maaldaari ki aasha rakho. Dekho, itni der na karo ki jab praan gale tak pahunch jayen to kahne lago ki umuk ke liye itna hai aur amuk ke liye itna hai. Haalaanki woh amuk ka ho hi chuka hai.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas ek aadmi aya aur kahne laga: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Sabse bara pratiphal waala sadqa kaun-sa hai? Aapne pharmayaah woh sadqa, jo tum us samay karo, jab tum sehatmand evn lobhi ho; tumhen nirdhan ho jaane ka dar sataye aur maaldaari ki aasha rakho. Dekho, itni der na karo ki jab praan gale tak pahunch jayen to kahne lago ki umuk ke liye itna hai aur amuk ke liye itna hai. Haalaanki woh amuk ka ho hi chuka hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4289: ''Qayaamat ke din sooraj ko srishti se itna nikat kar diya jayega ki woh ek meel ki doori par hoga.''

Miqdaad bin asvad -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko yeh farmaate hue suna hai : ''Qayaamat ke din sooraj ko srishti se itna nikat kar diya jayega ki woh ek meel ki doori par hoga.'' sulaim bin aamir kahte hain : Allah ki qasam! Mujhe nahin maaloom, meel ka kya matlab hai? Zameen ki doori ya woh lakri jisse aankhon mein surma lagaya jata hai? Aap aage farmaate hain : ''Log apne amal ke anusaar paseene mein doobe honge. Kuchh log apne takhnon tak paseena mein doobe honge, kuchh log apne ghutnon tak paseena mein doobe honge, kuchh log apni kamar tak paseena mein doobe honge to kuchh logon ko paseena lagaam lagaye hue hoga.'' warnankarta kahte hain : Yeh baat kahte samay Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne munh ki or ishaara karke dikhaya.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki qayaamat ke din sooraj ko srishti se itna nikat kar diya jayega ki woh unke saron se ek meel ki doori par hoga. Taabei saleem bin aamir kahte hain : Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahin pata ki yahaan meel se taatpary jameen par tay ki gai doori se hai ya aankhon mein surma lagaane ke liye istemaal kiye jaane waale upakran meel se. Farmaya : Log us din apne-apne karmon ke anusaar paseene mein doobe hue honge. Kisi ka paseena takhnon tak hoga, kisi ka paseena ghutnon tak hoga, kisi ka paseena kamar tak hoga aur kisi ka paseena munh tak hoga, jo use baat karne nahin dega. Warnankarta kahte hain : Munh tak paseena hone ki baat kahte samay Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne munh ki or ishaara karke dikhaya.

Qayaamat ke din ki bhayaawah paristhitiyon ka bayaan.
Qayaamat ke din hashr ke maidaan mein log apne-apne karmon ke anusaar kathinaaiyon ka saamna kar rahe honge.
Achchhe karmon ki prerna aur bure karmon se daraana.
4290: Bahut khoob, yeh to bahut laabhdayak maal hai. Yeh to waakai laabhdayak dhan hai. Jo kuchh tumne kaha, use mainne sun liya. Meri ray yeh hai ki tum ise apne rishtedaaron mein baant do.

Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki abu talha- radiyallahu anhu- madeene mein tamaam ansaar se zyaada khujoor ke baag waale maaldaar vyakti the tatha unka sabse priy dhan bairooha naami baag tha, jo masjid nabvi ke saamne tha. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) wahaan jaate aur aur uska meetha paani peete the. Anas- radiyallahu anhu- pharmaate hain ki jab yeh ayat naazil hui ki “Tum neki nahin praapt kar sakte, jab tak apni pasandeeda cheezon mein se kharch na karo.” to abu talha-radiyallahu anhu- ne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saamne khare hokar kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Allah taaala pharmaata hai ki "Tum neki ko nahin pahunch sakte, jab tak apni pasandeeda cheezen (Allah ki raah mein) kharch na karo" Aur mera sabse priy dhan 'bairooha' hai. Isliye main use Allah ke liye sadqa karta hoon aur Allah ke yahaan use sawaab ka zariya tatha aakhirat mein uske zakheera hone ka ummeedvaar hoon. Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aap ise Allah ki mansha ke anusaar kharch karen. Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah "Bahut khoob, yeh to bahut phaydemand maal hai. Yeh to waakai laabhdayak dhan hai. Jo kuchh tumne kaha, use mainne sun liya. Meri ray yeh hai ki tum ise apne rishtedaaron mein baant do." Abu talha- radiyallahu anhu- ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Main aapke aadesh ka paalan karoonga. At: Abu talha- radiyallahu anhu- ne use apne rishtedaaron aur chachere bhaaiyon mein baant diya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4291: Allah taaala ne kripa ko ek sau bhaagon mein baantkar apne paas ninyaanve bhaag rakh liye aur dharti mein ek bhaag utaara. Usi ek bhaag ke kaaran saari srishtiyaan ek-doosre par daya karti hain, yahaan tak ki ek chaupaya is dar se paanv ko uthaye rahta hai ki kaheen uske bachche ko chot na lag jaye.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue sunaah Allah taaala ne kripa ko sau bhaagon mein baantkar apne paas ninyaanve bhaag rakh liye aur dharti par ek bhaag utaara. Usi ek bhaag ke kaaran saari srishtiyaan ek-doosre par daya karti hain, yahaan tak ki ek chaupaya is dar se paanv ko uthaye rahta hai ki kaheen uske bachche ko chot na lag jaye.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih Allah ke paas sau rahamten hain, jinmen se kewal ek rahmat ko jinnon, insaanon, jaanavron aur keere-makoron ke beech utaara hai aur usi ke prabhaav se we ek-doosre se prem karte hain, ek-doosre par daya karte hain aur usi ke kaaran jangli jaanvar apne bachchon ko sneh evn pyaar karte hain. Jabki Allah ne ninyaanve rahamten apne paas rakh li hain, jiske nateeje mein woh qayaamat ke din apne bandon par daya karega.
Tatha salmaan faarsi- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah Allah taaala ke paas sau rahamten hain. Unmen se ek rahmat ke kaaran saari srishtiyaan aapas mein ek-doosre par daya karti hain, jabki ninyaanve rahamten qayaamat ke din ke liye hain.
Tatha ek aur riwayat mein haih Allah taaala ne jis din aakaashon evn dharti ki rachna ki, usi din sau rahamten paida keen. Har rahmat aakaash aur dharti ke beech ke khaali sthaan ke baraabar hai. Unmen se ek rahmat dharti mein rakh di, jiske nateeje mein maan apne bachche se sneh karti hai aur jangli jaanvar tatha pakshi ek-doosre se pyaar karte hain. Jab qayaamat ka din ayega to Allah use is rahmat ke saath poora kar dega.

Barkat waale evn uchch Allah ne daya ko ek sau bhaag mein baantkar ek bhaag duniya mein utaara aur ninyaanve bhaag qayaamat ke din ke liye apne paas rakh liya. Atah daya ke isi ek bhaag ke kaaran insaan, jinnata, chopaye evn keere-makore aadi saari srishtiyaan ek-doosre par daya karti hain. Yahaan tak ki ghora, jo apne halkepan aur daur-bhaag ke liye jaana jaata hai, apne bachche ko haani pahunchaane se bachta hai aur is bhay se apne paanv ko uthaye rakhta hai ki kaheen bachcha pair ke neeche na a jaye. Isi tarah isi ek bhaag ke kaaran jangli jaanvar apne bachche se prem karte hain. Jabki uske ninyaanve bhaag Allah ne apne paas rakh chhore hain, taaki qayaamat ke din apne bandon par daya kar sake.
Dasoori hadees :
Uchch evn mahaan Allah ne jis din aakaashon evn dharti ki rachna ki, usi din sau rahamten paida keen. Har rahmat itni bari hai ki aakaash evn dharti ke beech ke sthaan ko bhar de. Phir ek rahmat duniya mein rakh di, jiske kaaran maata apni santaan se pyaar karti hai aur pashu-pakshi ek-doosre se pyaar karte hain. Qayaamat ke din Allah, jo saare sansaar ka paalanhaar hai, is ek rahmat ko ninyaanve rahamton ke saath milaakar use sanpoornata pradaan kar dega. Zara sochiye ki jab kewal ek rahmat ke kaaran is duniya mein insaan ko itni bari-bari nemten praapt hain, to aakhirat mein, jo ki hamesha rahne ka sthaan hai, sau rahamten praapt ho jaane ke baad kitna kuchh mil sakta hai?
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4292: Yeh donon wastuen meri ummat ke purushon par haraam aur striyon ke liye halaal hain.

Ali bin abu taalib radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne dayen haath mein resham aur bayen haath mein sona liya, unhen lekar donon haathon ko uthaya aur phir farmaya : "Yeh donon wastuen meri ummat ke purushon par haraam aur striyon ke liye halaal hain."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne dayen haath mein resham ya reshmi kapre ka ek tukra aur dayen haath mein sona ya sona jaisa zewar aadi liya aur uske baad farmaya : Nissandeh resham aur sona pahanna purushon par haraam hai. Albatta aurton ke liye halaal hai.

Sindhi kahte hain : (Haraam hai) ka matlab yeh hai in donon cheezon ka pahanna haraam hai. Warna unka len-den karna, kharch karna, khareedna aur bechna purush aur stri donon ke liye halaal hai. Sone ka bartan banaakar rakhna aur uska istemaal karna purush aur stri donon ke liye haraam hai.
Islaami shareeyat ne aurton ke liye sajne-sanwarne (shrringaar karne) aur uske jaisi any cheezon ke liye gunjaaish rakhi hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, nasai aur ibn-e-maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
4293: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ek di praat: Ko nikle aur aapke shareer par kaale baalon se bani ek chaadar thi, jispar kajaawe ke chitr bane the.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ek din subh ko nikle aur aapke shareer par kaale baalon se bani ek chaadar thi, jispar kajaawe ke chitr bane the.
4294: Yeh vyakti hamaare peechhe-peechhe a gaya hai. Tum use anumti do to theek hai, warna waapas ho jayega. Usne kahaah Allah ke Rasool! Balki main use anumti deta hoon.

Abu masaood badri- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki ek vyakti ne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko any chaar aadmiyon ke saath khaane ko bulaya. (Jaate samay) ek aadmi unke peechhe ho liya. Jab darvaaze tak pahunche, to aapne farmayaah yeh vyakti hamaare peechhe-peechhe a gaya hai. Tum use anumti do to theek hai, warna waapas ho jayega. Usne kahaah Allah ke Rasool! Balki main use anumti deta hoon.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4295: Jo baaten main tumhen bataana chhor doon, unke baare mein tum mujhe mere haal par rahne do, kyonki tumse pahle ke logon ko kewal isi baat ne winasht kiya ki we atyadhik prashn karte aur apne nabiyon se matbhed karte the.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jo baaten main tumhen bataana chhor doon, unke baare mein tum mujhe mere haal par rahne do, kyonki tumse pahle ke logon ko kewal isi baat ne winasht kiya ki we atyadhik prashn karte aur apne nabiyon se matbhed karte the. Atah, jab main kisi cheez se mana karoon to usse bachte raho aur jab kisi cheez ka aadesh doon to jahaan tak ho sake, uska paalan karo."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya ki shareeyat ke widhaan teen prakaar ke hain : Wo widhaan jinke baare mein khaamoshi barti gai hai, wo widhaan jo manaahi ke roop mein hain aur wo widhaan jo aadesh ke roop mein hain.

Pahla prakaar : Wo widhaan jinke baare mein shareeyat khaamosh hai. Koi nirdesh nahin deti. Is prakaar ke widhaanon ke baare mein Islam ka yeh usool yaad rakhna chahiye ki aslan koi bhi cheez waajib nahin hua karti. Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke daur mein is shanka ke kaaran ki kaheen aakaash se waajib ya haraam hone se sanbandhit aadesh na utar aye, kisi aisi cheez ke baare mein prashn karne se bachna zaroori tha, jo saamne na aai ho. Kyonki Allah ne use bandon par daya ke taur par chhore rakha hai. Lekin aapki mrityu ke baad prashn agar fatva lene ya deen ke aawashyak masayal ka jnaan praapt karne ke iraade se kiya jaye, to na kewal jayaz hai, balki iska aadesh diya gaya hai. Lekin prashn agar baal ki khaal nikaalne ke iraade se kiya jaye, to is hadees ke aalok mein is tarah se prashn karna mana hoga. Kyonki is prakaar ka prashn anttah usi prakaar ki paristhiti saamne la sakta hai, jo bani israaeel ke liye utpann ho gai thi. Hua yeh tha ki unko ek gay zabah karne ka aadesh diya gaya tha. Aise mein agar koi bhi gay zabah kar dete, to aadesh ka paalan ho jaata, lekin unhonne baal ki khaal nikaalni shuru ki, to unki pareshaani barhti chali gai.

Doosra : Wo widhi-widhaan, jinse mana kiya gaya hai. Inse door rahne waale ko sawaab milega aur inmen sanlipt hone waale ko dand. Atah is prakaar ki tamaam cheezon se bachna zaroori hai.

Teera prakaar : Wo widhi-widhaan jinka aadesh diya gaya hai. Inka paalan karne waale ko sawaab milega, aur inhen chhorne waale ko dand. Atah inhen kshamta anusaar karna zaroori hai.

Insaan ko dhyaan aise kaamon par dena chahiye, jo zyaada aham aur aawashyak hon. Aise kaamon se bachna chahiye, jo fil-haal zaroori na hon. Aisi cheezon ke baare mein prashn karne se bachna chahiye, jo abhi saamne nahin aai hain.
Aise prashn poochhne se mana kiya gaya hai, jo masayal ko jatil banaate hain, sandehon ka dvaar kholte hain, aur atyadhik matbhed ka kaaran bante hain.
Yahaan mana ki gai cheezon ko chhorne ka aadesh diya gaya hai. Kyonki unhen chhorna koi mushkil kaam nahin hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki manaahi ko aam rakha gaya hai.
Jin kaamon ko karne ka aadesh diya gaya hai, unhen karne ka aadesh saamarthy ke saath jura hua hai. Kyonki kabhi-kabhi aisa bhi hota hai ki unhen karna mashaqqat bhara hota hai, ya phir insaan ke wash mein hota hi nahin.
Is hadees mein bahut zyaada sawaal karne se mana kiya gaya hai. Daraasal ulema ne prashn ke do prakaar bataye hain : Pahle prakaar mein deen ke zaroori masayal se jure hue aise prashn aate hain, jinka uddesh seekhna ho, is prakaar ka prashn karne ka aadesh diya gaya hai, aur sahaaba ke prashn isi prakaar ke hua karte the. Doosre prakaar mein aise prashn aate hain, jo baal ki khaal nikaalne ke liye kiye jaate hain. Is prakaar ka sawaal karna mana hai.
Is ummat ko saavdhaan kiya gaya hai ki woh pichhli ummaton ki tarah apne Nabi ki mukhaalfat na kare.
Anaawashyak bahut zyaada prashn aur nabiyon ki mukhaalfat winaash ka sabab hai. Jaise un baaton ke baare mein prashn, jinki jaankaari lena sanbhav na ho. Jaise ghaib ke masayal, jinhen Allah ke atirikt koi nahin jaanta aur qayaamat ke din ke haalaat.
Kathin masayal ke baare mein poochhne ki manaahi. Auzaai kahte hain : Jab Allah bande ko jnaan ki barkat se wanchit karna chaahta hai, to uski zabaan par bahut saari ghalat baaten daal deta hai. Is prakaar ke log sabse alp jnaani hote hain. Ibn wahb kahte hain : Mainne maalik ko kahte hue suna hai : Jnaan mein wiwaad insaan ke dil se jnaan ka noor  khatam kar deta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4296: Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko apne nitanb ko dharti se milaakar aur donon pindliyon ko khara karke baithkar khajoor khaate hue dekha hai.

Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko apne nitanb ko dharti se milaakar aur donon pindliyon ko khara karke baithkar khujoor khaate hue dekha hai.
4297: Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko do hare rang ke kapron mein dekha hai.
Abu rimsa taimi -radiyallahu anha- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko do hare rang ke kapron mein dekha hai.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4298: Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dekha ki teen ungliyon se khaana kha rahe the. Jab khaana kha chuke to ungliyon ko chaat liya.
Kaab bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dekha ki teen ungliyon se khaana kha rahe the. Jab khaana kha chuke to ungliyon ko chaat liya.
4301: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) mere yahaan aye aur ek latke hue mashk ke munh se khare-khare paani pi liya. Yeh dekh, mainne jaakar mashk ka munh kaat liya.

Hassaan bin saabit- radiyallahu anhuma- ki bahan umme saabit kabsha bint saabit- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) mere yahaan aye aur ek latke hue mashk ke munh se khare-khare paani pi liya. Yeh dekh, mainne jaakar mashk ka munh kaat liya.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4302: “Jahaan kaheen bhi raho, Allah se darte raho, bure karm ke baad achchhe karm kar liya karo, achchhe karm bure karm ko mita denge tatha logon ke saath uttam aachran waala vyavhaar karo.”

Abu zar jundub bin junaada tatha abu abdur rahmaan muaaz bin jabal radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne farmaya hai : “Jahaan kaheen bhi raho, Allah se darte raho, bure karm ke baad achchhe karm kar liya karo, achchhe karm bure karm ko mita denge tatha logon ke saath uttam aachran waala vyavhaar karo.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam teen baaton ka aadesh de rahe hain : Pahli baat : Taqva dhaaran karna. Taqva dhaaran karne ka matlab hai, aniwaary kaaryon ko karna aur haraam cheezon se bachna. Sthaan, samay aur paristhiti chaahe jo bhi ho. Gupt tatha vyakt donon roop se. Sukh evn dukh donon awasthaaon mein. Doosri baat : Agar koi bura kaam ho jaye, to uske baad koi achchha kaam, jaise namaz parhna, sadqa karna, upkaar karna, rishtedaaron ke saath achchha vyavhaar karna tatha tauba karna aadi kar lo. Yeh cheezen bure kaam ko mita dengi. Teesri baat : Logon ke saath achchhe aachran waala vyavhaar karo. Maslan unse muskuraakar milna, winamrata dhaaran karna, bhala karna aur bura karne se bachna aadi.

Allah ki daya, kshama aur maafi ke roop mein apne bandon par uska anugrah.
Is hadees mein teen adhikaar bayaan hue hain : Allah ka adhikaar, jo ki taqva dhaaran karna hai, svayn ka adhikaar, jo ki bure karmon ke baad achchhe karm karna hai aur logon ka adhikaar, jo ki unke saath aachran theek rakhna hai.
Is hadees mein bure karmon ke baad achchhe karm karne ki prerna di gai hai. Waise, achchha aachran dhaaran karna bhi taqva ke dayre mein aata hai, lekin yahaan use alag se bayaan isliye kiya gaya hai ki use bayaan karne ki zaroorat thi.
[imaam tirmizi kahte hain ki : Yeh hadees hasan hai.]
4303: “Tumne ek ganbheer prashn poochha hai, parantu yeh uske liye aasaan hai, jiske liye Allah aasaan bana de

Muaaz bin jabal radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain : Ek yaatra mein main Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath tha. Chalte hue ek din main aapse nikat ho gaya, to mainne kaha : He Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe aisa kaary bataaiye jo mujhe Jannat mein prawesh dilaye tatha Jahannam se door kar de. Aap sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne farmaya : “Tumne ek ganbheer prashn poochha hai, parantu yeh uske liye aasaan hai, jiske liye Allah aasaan bana de : Allah ki ibaadat karo aur uske saath kisi ko saajhi na banaao, namaz sthaapit karo, zakat do, Ramzan ke roze rakho aur Allah ke ghar ka Hajj karo." Phir aap sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne farmaya : "Kya main tumhen bhalaai ke dvaaron ke baare mein na bataaoon? Roza dhaal hai, aur daan paapon ko bujha deta hai, jaise paani aag ko bujha deta hai, tatha vyakti ki raat mein ada ki gai namaz (bhi bhalaai ke dvaaron mein se ek hai)." Tatpashchaat aap sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne yeh ayat parhi : تَتجَافَى جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ, (unke pahlu bistaron se alag rahte hain, apne rab ko bhay evn aasha ke saath pukaarte hain aur jo kuchh hamne unhen de rakha hai, woh kharch karte hain. Koi vyakti nahin jaanta jo kuchh hamne aankhon ki thandak unke liye chhupa rakhi hai. Jo usi ka badla hai, jo kiya karte the.) phir aap ne farmaya : "Kya main tumhen deen ki buniyaad, uska stanbh aur uski choti na bata doon? Mainne kaha : Awashy, he Allah ke Rasool! Aapne farmaya : Deen ki buniyaad Islam hai, iska stanbh namaz hai aur iski choti jihaad hai." Iske baad aap sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne unse kaha : "Kya main tumhen iska saar na bataaoon?" Mainne kaha : Awashy, he Allah ke Rasool. To aapne apni jeebh pakri aur kaha : “Ise roke rakho." Mainne kaha : He Allah ke Nabi ! Kya ham jo bolte hain, uspar bhi hamaari pakar hogi? To aapne farmaya : "Tumhaari maan tumhen kho de! Logon ko unke chehron ke bal ya unki naakon ke bal (Jahannam mein) unki jeebhon ki kamaai ke kaaran hi to giraya jayega.”

Muaaz radiyallahu anhu kahte hain : Main Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath ek yaatra mein tha. Ek din subah ke samay chalte hue main aapke nikat pahunch gaya, to mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe ek aisa kaary bata deejiye, jo mujhe Jannat mein daakhil kar de aur Jahannam se door kar de. Aap sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne farmaya : Tumne mujhse ek bare kaary ke baare mein poochha hai, jiska paalan karna logon par bara bhaari hai, kintu yeh uspar aasaan hai jiske liye Allah ise aasaan bana de. Islam ke aniwaary kartavyon ka paalan karo :

Pahla kartavy : Kewal Allah ki ibaadat karo aur uske saath kisi ko bhi saajheedaar na banaao.

Doosra kartavy : Din aur raat mein paanch farz namaazen sthaapit karo. Yaani fajr, zuhar, asr, maghrib tatha isha ki namaz parho. In paanch namaazon ko inki sharton, stanbhon aur aniwaary kaaryon ke saath ada karo.

Teesra kartavy : Farz zakat nikaalo. Zakat ek aarthik ibaadat hai, jo shareeyat dvaara dhan ki ek nirdhaarit maatra par waajib hoti hai aur jise uske haqdaaron ko diya jaata hai.

Chautha kartavy  : Ramzan ke roze rakho. Roza naam hai khaane, peene aur is tarah ki any roza torne waali cheezon se fajr prakat hone se lekar sooraj doobne tak Allah ki ibaadat ki neeyat se ruke rahne ka.

Paanchvaan kartavy : Allah ki ibaadat ke liye makka jaakar hajj ke kaary sanpann karo.

Phir Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne farmaya : Kya main tumhen us maarg ke baare mein na bataaoon, jo bhalaai ke dvaaron tak pahunchaata hai? Woh hai, aniwaary kartavyon ke pashchaat nafal ibaadten karna, jo is prakaar hain :

Pahli nafal ibaadat : Nafal roza, jo paapon mein parne se rokta hai, kyonki roza ichchhaaon ko niyantrit karta hai tatha bal ko kamzor karta hai.

Doosri nafal ibaadat : Nafal sadqa, jo paap ko mita deta hai, use samaapt kar deta hai tatha uske prabhaav ko khatm kar deta hai.

Teesri nafal ibaadat : Raat ke antim tihaai bhaag mein raat ki namaz parhna. Uske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne yeh ayat parhi : (Unke pahlu door rahte hain sone ke sthaanon se. Woh apne rab  ko pukaarte hain) namaz, zikr, tilaawat aur dua dvaara (bhay evn aasha ke saath aur jo kuchh hamne unhen de rakha hai, usmen se kharch karte hain. Koi praani nahin jaanta ki hamne kis prakaar ki aankhon ki thandak unke liye chhupa rakhi hai), yaani log yeh nahin jaante ki hamne unke karmon ke badle mein qayaamat ke din aankhon ko thandi karne waali kya-kya cheejen aur Jannat mein kya-kya nemten paida kar rakhi hain  (yeh daraasal badla hai un karmon ka, jo we kiya karte the).

Iske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne poochha : Kya main tumko deen ki buniyaad, uska stanbh aur uska sheersh na bata doon?

Muaaz radiyallahu anhu ne uttar diya : Awashy, ai Allah ke Rasool!

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Deen ki buniya Islam yaani donon gawaahiyaan hain. Inke maadhyam se insaan ke haath mein deen ka mool aadhaar a jaata hai. Uska mool stanbh namaz hai. Namaz ke bina Islam ka koi astitv nahin hai. Bilkul waise hi, jaise stanbh ke bina kisi ghar ka astitv nahin hota. Jo namaz ka paaband hai, uska deen mazboot tatha buland hai. 
Jabki Islam ka jhanda buland karne ka saadhan jihaad aur Allah ke shabd ko ooncha karne ke liye deen ke dushmanon se larna hai.

Iske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne poochha : Kya main tumko ek aisi cheez na bataaoon, jisse ukt saari cheezen sudrirh aur sashakt ho jaati hain? Aapne apni zabaan pakar li aur farmaya : Ispar niyantran rakho aur anaawashyak baaten na karo. Muaaz radiyallahu anhu ne poochha : Kya hamaara paalanhaar hamaare dvaara kahi gai baaton par bhi hamaari pakar karega, hisaab lega aur saza dega?

Aapne uttar diya : Tumhaari maan tumko gum paye. Yaad rahe ki is waaky se muraad bad-dua nahin hoti. Arab ke log is waaky ka istemaal kisi vyakti ko kisi aisi baat ki soochna dete samay karte, jisse use avgat hona hi chahiye tha. Phir aapne farmaya: Logon ko unke munh ke bal kewal isliye ghaseeta jayega ki we apni zabaan se awishvaas par aadhaarit shabd nikaalte, gaali-galauj, chughli evn doshaaropan karte hain.

Sahaaba jnaan praapt karne ke bare utsuk hua karte the. Yahi kaaran hai ki woh aapse bahut zyaada prashn kiya karte the.
Sahaaba ki deeni samajh. Unko pata tha ki karm Jannat mein prawesh ka saadhan hai.
Muaaz radiyallahu anhu ne jo sawaal kiya tha, woh bahut bara sawaal hai. Kyonki wahi jeewan evn astitv ka rahasy hai. Isliye ki is duniya mein maujood har insaan aur jinn ka thikaana ya to Jannat hai ya phir Jahannam. Isi se is prashn ka mahatv spasht ho jaata hai.
Islam ke paanch stanbhon ka ada karne ka phal Jannat mein prawesh ke roop mein milega. Islam ke paanch stanbh hain : Donon gawaahiyaan, namaz, zakat, roza aur Hajj.
Islam ka mool aadhaar, sabse moolyawaan kaary aur sabse mahatvoorn kartavy yeh hai ki ek Allah ki ibaadat ki jaye aur kisi ko uska saajhi na banaya jaye.
Bandon par Allah ka ek anugrah yeh hai ki usne unke liye nekiyon ke dvaar khol diye, taaki achchhe pratiphal ki praapti aur gunaahon ki kshama ka kaam adhik se adhik kar saken.
Aniwaary kartavyon ka paalan karne ke baad nafal ibaadton dvaara Allah ki nikatta praapt karne ki fazeelat.
Islam mein namaz ka wahi mahatv hai, jo ek tanbu ke liye  khanbhe ka hai. Jis tarah  khanbha hat jaane se tanbu gir jaata hai, usi tarah namaz ghayab ho jaane se Islam rukhsat ho jaata hai.
Deen ko nuqsaan pahunchaane waali tamaam cheezon se zabaan ko surakshit rakhna zaroori hai.
Zabaan par niyantran rakhna har bhalaai ka mool aadhaar hai.
[ise tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
4304: Jab do musalmaan apni-apni talvaaren lekar aapas mein bhir jayen to marne waala aur maarne waala donon jahannami hain

Abu bakra radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Jab do musalmaan apni-apni talvaaren lekar aapas mein bhir jayen to marne waala aur maarne waala donon jahannami hain." Mainne saadar kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Yeh to maarne waala hai, (jiska jahannami hona to samajh mein aata hai) lekin marne waala kyon jahannami hoga? Aapne farmaya : "Uski neeyat bhi doosre saathi ko maarne ki thi."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jab do musalmaan apni-apni talvaaren lekar lar jaate hain aur donon ek-doosre ki hatya karna chaahte hain, to hatya karne waala apne saathi ki hatya karne ki wajah se Jahannam jayega. Lekin aage Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke dvaara kahi gai yeh baat sahaaba ko samajh mein nahin aai ki jiski hatya hui hai, woh bhi Jahannam mein jayega. Bhala aisa kaise ho sakta hai. Chunaanche iska uttar dete hue aapne bataya ki use bhi Jahannam mein isliye jaana parega ki woh bhi saamne waale ki hatya karna chaahta tha. Yeh aur baat hai ki woh apne iraade mein saphal nahin ho saka aur saamne waala usse tez nikal gaya.

Aise vyakti ke yaatna ka haqdaar hona, jisne apne dil se gunaah ka iraada kar liya aur uske saadhnon ka bhi upyog kar liya.
Musalmaanon ko aapsi laraai se door rahne ki sakht taakeed aur ispar Jahannam ki chetaavni.
Musalmaanon ke beech hone waali uchit laraai, jaise widrohiyon aur fasaad phailaane waalon se ki jaane waali laraai, is chetaavni ke dayre mein nahin aati.
Bara gunaah karne waala, kewal bara gunaah karne hi ki wajah se kaafir nahin ho jaata. Kyonki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aapas mein larne waale do vyaktiyon ko musalmaan kaha hai.
Jab do musalmaan kisi aise saadhan ke saath, jisse hatya ki ja sakti ho, aamne-saamne ho jayen aur unmen se ek doosre ki hatya kar de, to hatya karne waala aur hatya ka shikaar hone waala, donon Jahannam jayenge. Is hadees mein talvaar ka zikr kewal udaahran ke taur par hua hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4307: Duniya ke moh se aazaad raho, Allah ka pyaara ban jaaoge aur logon ke paas jo kuchh hai, uska lobh na karo, log bhi tumhen pyaar denge.

Abul abbaas sahl bin saad saaidi -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki ek vyakti Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aya aur bola : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe koi aisa kaary bataaiye ki main use karoon, to Allah ka pyaara ho jaaoon aur logon ka bhi pyaara ho jaaoon. Aapne kaha : "Duniya ke moh se aazaad raho, Allah ka pyaara ban jaaoge aur logon ke paas jo kuchh hai, uska lobh na karo, log bhi tumhen pyaar denge."

Ek vyakti ne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha ki use kuchh aisa kaary bata den, jisse use Allah aur logon ka pyaar mile, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne usse kaha : Allah ka prem us samay milega, jab tum duniya ki atirikt aur aakhirat mein laabhdayak na hone waali cheezon ko tatha un cheezon ko chhor do jinse deen ka nuqsaan ho sakta ho. Jabki logon ka prem us samay milega, jab tum unke paas maujood duniya ka lobh na karo. Kyonki we svabhaav se hi apne paas maujood duniya se prem karte hain. Atah jo iske liye unse pratispardha karega, we usse ghrina karenge, aur jo use unke liye chhor dega, we usse prem karenge.

Zuhd ki fazeelat. Zuhd yeh hai ki un tamaam cheezon ko chhor de, jo aakhirat mein laabhdayak na hon.
'Zuhd' ka sthaan 'wara़' se ooncha hai. Kyonki 'wara़' naam hai haanikaarak cheezon ko chhorne ka, jabki 'zuhd' naam hai un tamaam cheezon ko chhor dene ka jo aakhirat mein laabhdayak na hon.
Sindhi kahte hain : Duniya logon ko priy hai. Isliye, jo ismen unse pratispardha karega, usse uski pratispardha ke anusaar ghrina ki jayegi, aur jo logon ko unke priy cheez mein vyast chhor dega, usse log is tyaag ke anusaar prem karenge.
[allaama navvi rahimhullah kahte hain : Hadees hasan hai.]
[ise ibne maajah aadi ne hasan sandon ke saath riwayat kiya hai]
4308: Neki to achchha vyavhaar hai aur gunaah woh hai jo tere dil mein khatke aur tujhe yeh bura lage ki log use jaan jayen.

Navvaas bin samaaan ansaari radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se neki aur gunaah ke baare mein poochha, to aapne uttar diya : "Neki to achchha vyavhaar hai aur gunaah woh hai jo tere dil mein khatke aur tujhe yeh bura lage ki log use jaan jayen."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se neki aur gunaah ke baare mein poochha gaya, to aapne farmaya :

Sabse bari neki achchha vyavhaar hai. Achchha vyavhaar Allah ke saath bhi aur achchha vyavhaar uski srishti ke saath bhi. Allah ke saath achchha vyavhaar yeh hai ki uska taqva rakha jaye aur srishti ke saath achchha vyavhaar yeh hai ki unki or se diye gae kasht ko sahan kiya jaye, krodh kam kiya jaye, hanskar mila jaye, achchhi baat ki jaye, rishte-naaton ka dhyaan rakha jaye, baat maani jaye, narmi barti jaye, upkaar kiya jaye aur mil-julkar raha jaye.

Jabki gunaah aisi sandigdh cheez hai, jo dil mein khatke, usse dil santusht na ho aur baar-baar yeh khyaal dil mein aata rahe ki kaheen yeh gunaah to nahin hai aur tum usse achchhe evn nek logon ko avgat na honne dena chaaho. Kyonki svaabhaawik roop se, maanav aatma chaahti hai ki log uske baare mein kewal achchhi baaten hi jaanen. Isliye yadi tum kisi cheez se logon ke avgat hone ko naapsand karte ho, to iska matlab hai ki woh gunaah hai aur usmen koi achchhaai nahin hai.

Uchch naitikta se sushobhit hone ke liye protsaahan, kyonki achchha charitr sabse bare achchhaai ke kaaryon mein se ek maana jaata hai.
Ek momin ko saty aur asaty ke beech antar karne mein koi kathinaai nahin hoti. Kyonki woh apne hriday mein maujood prakaash ke kaaran saty ko pahchaanta hai aur jhooth se ghutan mahsoos karta tatha usse ghrina karta hai.
Gunaah ka ek lakshan yeh hai ki hriday bechain aur pareshaan rahe aur yeh achchha na lage ki log use jaan jayen.
Sindhi kahte hain : Is hadees mein jo baat kahi gai hai, uska sanbandh un aspasht cheezon se hai, jinke baare mein spasht pramaan na hone ke kaaran log nishchati roop se yeh nahin jaante ki woh neki ke kaam hain ya gunaah ke. Warna, sachchaai yeh hai ki shareeyat mein jin kaamon ka aadesh diya gaya hai, wo neki ke kaam hain aur jin kaamon se roka gaya hai, wo gunaah ke kaam hain. In donon ke baare mein dil se salaah lene aur aashvast hone ki aawashyakta nahin haiै.
Is hadees mein sanbodhan aise logon se hai, jo svachchh prakriti ke maali hon, wo log nahin, jinke hriday wikrit ho gae hon aur jo apni aakaankshaaon ke peechh bhaagte hon. Bhale-bure mein antar karne ki kshamta kho chuke hon.
Teebi kahte hain : Kaha gaya hai : Is hadees mein aye hue shabd 'al-birr' ki kai vyaakhyayen ki gai hain. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam dvaara ki gai ek vyaakhya ke anusaar 'al-birr' se muraad aisa kaam hai, jisse antraatma santusht rahe. Doosri vyaakhya ke anusaar muraad eemaan hai. Teesri vyaakhya ke anusaar muraad aisi cheez hai, jo insaan ko Allah ke nikat le jaye aur chauthi vyaakhya ke anusaar muraad uttam aachran hai. Jabki uchchatam aachran ki vyaakhya sahansheelta, kam ghussa karne, muskura kar milne aur madhur waani se ki gai hai.  Waise, sachchaai yeh hai ki yeh saari vyaakhyayen ek-doosre se nikat hi hain.
4309: Tameem daari radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Dharm, shubhchintan ka naam hai." Hamne kaha : Kiska? To farmaya : "Allah, uski kitaab, uske Rasool, musalmaanon ke maargadarshakon aur aam logon ka."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki deen ka aadhaar nishtha aur saty par hai. Har kaam usi tarah hona chahiye, jis tarah Allah ne waajib kiya hai. Koi kotaahi ya dhokha nahin hona chahiye.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se kisi ne poochha ki shubhchintan kiska hona chahiye? To aapne uttar diya :

1- pawitr evn mahaan Allah ka shubhchintan : Iska matlab yeh hai ki ham wishuddh roop se usi ki prasannata praapt karne ke liye kaam karen, kisi ko uska saajhi na banayen, uske rab tatha poojy hone aur uske naamon tatha gunon par wishvaas rakhen, uske aadeshon ko sammaan den aur uske prati wishvaas rakhne ka aahvaan karen.

2- Allah ki kitaab pawitr Qur'an ka shubhchintan : Iska matlab yeh hai ki ham is baat par wishvaas rakhen ki Qur'an Allah ki waani tatha uska utaara hua antim granth hai aur isne pichhli tamaam shareeyton ko nirast kar diya hai. Saath hi ham is kitaab ko sammaan den, uski uchit roop se tilaawat karen, uski muhkam (spasht arth waali) ayton par amal karen aur mutshaabeh (aspasht arth waali) ayton ko sveekaar karen, use aarthik chher-chhaar karne waalon ke haathon se bachayen, uski naseehton se shiksha grahan karen, uske jnaan ko phailayen aur uski or logon ko bulayen.

3- Allah ke Rasool Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka shubhchintan : Yaani ham is baat ka wishvaas rakhen ki aap antim Rasool hain, aapki laai hui shikshaaon ko sach maanen, aapke aadeshon ka paalan karen, aapki mana ki hui cheezon se door rahen, aapke bataye hue tareeqon se hi Allah ki ibaadat karen, aapko sammaan den, aapke aahvaan ko phailayen, aapki shareeyat ko aam karen aur aappar koi aarop lagaya jaye, to uska khandan karen.

4- Muslim shaaskon ka shubhchintan : Iska matlab yeh hai ki haq par unka sahyog kiya jaye, unke wiruddh widroh na kiya jaye aur jab tak we Allah ki aajna anusaar kaam kar rahe hon, to unki baat suni aur maani jaye.

5- aam musalmaanon ka shubhchintan : Iska matlab hai unke saath achchha bartaav karna aur unpar  upkaar karna, unko achchhe kaam ka aahvaan karna, unko kasht se bachaana, unki bhalaai chaahna aur neki tatha parhezgaari mein unke sahyog se kaam karna.

Sabhi ke liye shubhchintan ka aadesh.
Deen mein shubhchintan ka mahatv.
Deen ka aasthaaon, kathnon aur karmon par aadhaarit hona.
Shubhchintan ke andar nafs (man) ko apne bhaai ke saath dhokhe se paak karna aur uska bhala chaahna bhi shaamil hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke shiksha dene ki uttam paddhati ki pahle kisi cheez ko sankshipt roop mein bayaan karte hain aur uske baad uski vyaakhya karte hain.
Baat mahatv ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue kramvaar karni chahiye. Ham yahaan dekhte hain ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam pahle Allah ke shubhchintan ki baat karte hain, phir Allah ke Rasool, phir Muslim shaaskon aur phir aam musalmaanon ke shubhchintan ki.
4310: Tumse pahle logon mein ek vyakti tha, jisne ninyaanve logon ka wadh kiya tha. Usne logon se dharti ke sabse bare jnaani ka pata lagaya to use ek sanyaasi ke baare mein bataya gaya. Woh uske paas jaakar bola ki usne sau aadmiyon ka wadh kiya hai. Kya ab uski tauba qabool ho sakti hai? Usne kahaah nahin! Yeh sun usne sanyaasi ko bhi maar daala.

Abu saeed khudri- radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah tumse pahle ke logon mein ek vyakti tha, jisne ninyaanve logon ka wadh kiya tha. Usne logon se dharti ke sabse bare jnaani ka pata lagaya to use ek sanyaasi ke baare mein bataya gaya. Woh uske paas jaakar bola ki usne sau aadmiyon ka wadh kiya hai. Kya ab uski tauba qabool ho sakti hai? Usne kahaah nahin! Yeh sun usne sanyaasi ko bhi maar kar sau ki ginti poori kar li. Phir dharti ke sabse bare jnaani ke baare mein poochha to ek dhaarmik jnaan rakhne waale vyakti ke baare mein bataya gaya. Woh uske paas gaya aur bola ki usne sau logon ko maar daala hai. Aise mein, kya uski tauba qabool ho sakti hai? Usne kahaah awashy, bhala uske aur tauba ke beech kaun-si wastu deewaar ban sakti hai? Amuk sthaan par chale jaao. Wahaan Allah ki ibaadat karne waale bahut se log rahte hain. Unke saath Allah ki ibaadat karte rahna aur kabhi apne desh na aana. Yeh bahut bura sthaan hai. Atah, woh chal para. Yahaan tak ki jab aadhe raaste tak pahuncha to uski maut a gai. Ab, uske baare mein rahmat ke farishte aur azaab ke farishte aapas mein bahas karne lage. Rahmat ke farishton ka kahna thaah yeh tauba karke poori nishtha ke saath mahaan Allah ki or laut chuka tha. Jabki azaab ke farishton ka kahna thaah usne kabhi koi satkarm nahin kiya hai. Aise mein, unke paas insaan ke bhes mein ek farishta aya, jise unhonne apna nirnayak maan liya. Usne kahaah donon taraf ki zameenon ki doori naapo, woh jidhar se adhik nikat hoga, udhar waalon mein se maana jayega. Farishton ne naapkar paya ki woh jidhar ja raha tha, udhar se hi zyaada nikat tha. Atah, rahmat ke farishton ne uske praan nikaale.
Tatha saheeh ki ek riwayat mein haih woh nek logon ki basti se ek bitta nikat tha, atah use un logon mein shaamil kar diya gaya.
Tatha saheeh ki ek any riwayat mein haih mahaan Allah ne dharti ke is bhaag ko aadesh diya ki phail jaao aur us bhaag ko aadesh diya ki simat jaao. Tatha kaha ki donon bhaagon ki doori naapo. Phir aisa hua ki use is bhaag se nikat paya gaya aur is tarah kshama kar diya gaya.
Tatha ek aur riwayat mein haih woh apne seene ke sahaare bure logon ki basti se achchhe logon ki basti ki or thora sa sarak gaya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4311: ‎“‎doodh peene se woh rishte haraam ho jaate hain, jo janm ke kaaran se haraam hote hain.‎”‎
Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : ‎“‎doodh peene se woh rishte haraam ho jaate hain, jo janm ke kaaran se haraam hote hain.‎”‎

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki razaaat (bachpan mein apni maan ke atirikt kisi aur stri ka doodh peene) se woh saare rishte haraam ho jaate hain, jo janm evn nasab ke aadhaar par haraam hote hain. Jaise chacha, maama aur bhaai aadi. Isi tarah razaaat se woh saari cheezen halaal ho jaya karti hain, jo janm ke aadhaar par halaal hua karti hain.

Yeh hadees razaaat (doodh pilaane) se sanbandhit aadeshon evn nirdeshon ke baare mein ek (mahatvapoorn) siddhaant hai.
Ibn-e-hajar Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke shabdon “‎doodh peene se woh rishte haraam ho jaate hain, jo janm ke kaaran se haraam hote hain.‎” ke baare mein kahte hain : Yaani doodh peene ke kaaran woh sabhi cheezen halaal bhi hoti hain, jo nasab ke kaaran halaal hoti hain. Is baat par ijma hai ki doodh peene ke kaaran nikaah aur usse sanbandhit cheezen haraam ho jaati hain, doodh peene waale aur doodh pilaane waali ke bachchon ke beech hurmat sthaapit ho jaati hai aur unhen rishtedaaron ka sthaan mil jaata hai, jiske kaaran unhen dekhna, unke saath ekaant mein rahna aur yaatra karna halaal ho jaata hai. Lekin isse maan se sanbandhit shesh ahkaam, jaise donon ka ek doosre ka waaris banna, naan wa nafqa waajib hona, milkeeyat paye jaane par aazaadi, gawaahi,  deeyat aur qisaas ko khatm karna aadi saabit nahin hote.
Doodh pilaane ke kaaran nikaah hamesha ke liye haraam ho jaata hai.
Doosri hadeeson se yeh baat pramaanit hoti hai ki doodh peene ke kaaran hurmat  paanch baar jo spasht hon doodh pilaane se hi sthaapit hoti hai. Woh bhi jab doodh shuru ke do saalon ke andar pilaya jaye.
Nasab ke aadhaar par nimnalikhit mahilaaon se hurmat sthaapit hoti hai : Mayen, inmen daadiyaan- naaniyaan bhi shaamil hain, chaahe jitne oopar ki hon; betiyaan, inmen betiyon aur beton ki betiyaan bhi shaamil hain, chaahe jitne neeche ki hon; bahnen, chaahe sagi hon ya baap shareek hon ya phir maan shareek; phoophiyaan, inmen pita ki tamaam sagi aur baap shareek tatha maan shareek bahnen shaamil hain, daadon ki bahnen bhi inmen shaamil hain, chaahe jitne oopar ki hon; khaalayen, inmen maan ki sabhi sagi, baap shareek aur maan shareek bahnen shaamil hain, isi tarah daadiyon-naaniyaan ki sabhi bahnen bhi shaamil hain, baap shareek hon ya maan shareek, chaahe jitne oopar ki hon; bhaai ki betiyaan aur bahan ki betiyaan, inke andar inki betiyaan bhi shaamil hain, chaahe jitne neeche ki hon.
Rahi baat razaaat ki to isse un sabhi mahilaaon se hurmat sthaapit ho jaati hai, jinse nasab ke aadhaar par hoti hai. Bas isse doodh bhaai ki maan aur doodh bete ki bahan se hurmat sthaapit nahin hoti.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4313: Allah apne bande ki tauba se us vyakti se kaheen adhik prasann hota hai, jisne kisi marubhoomi mein apna oont gum karke phir pa liya ho.

Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah Allah apne bande ki tauba se us vyakti se kaheen adhik prasann hota hai, jisne kisi marusthal mein apna oont gum karke phir pa liya ho.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih Allah apne bande ki tauba se, jab woh uske aage tauba karta hai, us aadmi se bhi adhik prasann hota hai jo kisi marusthal mein apni sawaari par ho, uspar uske khaane-peene ka saamaan bhi ho ki woh sawaari usse chhoot jaye aur woh usse niraash hokar ek per ki chhaya mein let jaye. Isi niraasha ki haalat mein woh sawaari achaanak uske saamne a khari ho aur woh uski muhaar pakarkar khushi ki shiddat mein kah daaleh 'ai Allah, tu mera banda hai aur main tera rab!' atyadhik prasannata ke kaaran is tarah ki galti kar baithe.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is hadees mein bayaan kiya hai ki Allah bande ke sachche man se uski or lautte hue uske aadeshon ka paalan karne se usse kaheen adhik prasann hota hai, jitna tummen se koi achaanak apni khoi hui sawaari mil jaane se hota hai, jo yaatra ke dauraan kisi biyaabaan (marubhoomi) mein ho aur uske paas na paani ho, na khaana ho aur na aas-paas koi vyakti ho. Phir is awastha mein uski sawaari ka oont gum ho jaye aur dhoondhne ke baavjood bhi na mil sake. Aise mein woh ek per ke paas jaakar uske neeche so jaye aur mrityu ki prateeksha karne lage. Use na oont milne ki aasha ho aur na jeewit bach paane ki ummeed, kyonki khaane-peene ka saamaan oont par hi tha. Isi dayneey awastha mein woh achaanak dekhe ki uska oont saamne khara hai aur uski muhaar us per mein phansi hui hai, jiske neeche woh soya hua hai. Kya uski is khushi ka andaaza lagaya ja sakta hai? Is khushi ki kalpana kewal wahi kar sakta hai, jo is prakaar ki paristhiti se guzra ho. Yeh bahut bari khushi hai. Mrityu ke pashchaat jeewan ki khushi. Yahi kaaran hai ki usne oont ki muhaar pakarkar kaha : "Ai Allah! Tu mera banda hai aur main tera prabhu!" Woh daraasal Allah ki prashansa karna aur yeh kahna chaahta tha ki ai Allah! Tu mera prabhu hai aur main tera banda, lekin ashesh prasannata ke kaaran kuchh aur kah gaya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4314: Nissandeh, halaal spasht hai aur haraam bhi spasht hai

Nomaan bin basheer radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, unhonne kaha : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai - yeh kahte samay nomaan ne apni do ungliyon ko apne donon kaanon ki or barhaya- : "Nissandeh, halaal spasht hai aur haraam bhi spasht hai tatha donon ke beech kuchh cheezen aspasht hain, jinhen bahut se log nahin jaante. Atah, jo aspasht cheezon se bacha, usne apne dharm aur pratishtha ki raksha kar li tatha jo aspasht cheezon mein par gaya, woh haraam mein par gaya. Jaise ek charvaaha surakshit charaagaah (pashuon ke charne ka sthaan) ke aas-paas jaanvar charaye, to sanbhaavna rahti hai ki jaanvar uske andar chale jayen. Sun lo, har baadshaah ki surakshit charaagaah hoti hai. Sun lo, Allah ki surakshit charaagaah uski haraam ki hui cheezen hain. Sun lo, shareer ke andar maans ka ek tukra hai, jab woh sahi rahega, to poora shareer sahi rahega aur jab woh bigrega to poora shareer bigrega. Sun lo, maans ka woh tukra, dil hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam cheezon ke baare mein ek saadhaaran siddhaant bata rahe hain. Siddhaant yeh hai ki cheezon ke teen prakaar hain. Spasht halaal cheezen, spasht haraam cheezen aur aisi cheezen jinka halaal ya haraam hona spasht na ho tatha wo halaal hain ya haraam is baat ko bahut-se log jaante na hon.

Aise mein, jisne aspasht cheezon ko chhor diya, to haraam cheezon mein parne se bachne ke kaaran uska deen surakshit rahega aur aspasht cheez mein lipt hone ki wajah se uspar jo logon ki ungliyaan uth sakti theen, usse uska sammaan bhi surakshit rahega. Iske wipreet jo aspasht cheezon se door nahin raha, usne khud ko ya to haraam mein parne ke liye ya logon ke laanchhan ka saamna karne ke liye aage kar diya. Iske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aspasht cheezon mein parne waale ka ek udaahran diya. Farmaya ki aspasht cheezon mein parne waala us charvaahe ki tarah hai, jo apne jaanvar kisi surakshit charaagaah ke paas chara raha ho. Yahaan is baat ki sanbhaavna bani rahti hai ki uske jaanvar nikat hi mein sthit surakshit charaagaah mein jaakar charne lagen. Bilkul yahi haal sandeh waale kaam karne waale ka hai. Kyonki isse woh haraam kaam ke nikat pahunch jaata hai aur is baat ki sanbhaavna ban jaati hai ki woh haraam mein par jaye. Phir ant mein yeh bataya hai ki insaan ke shareer mein maans ka ek tukra hai. Jab woh sahi rahta hai, to poora shareer sahi rahta hai aur jab woh bigar jaata hai, to poora shareer bigar jaata hai. Maans ka woh tukra dil hai.
Aspasht cheez, jiska halaal ya haraam hona spasht na ho, chhor dene ki prerna.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4315: Nishchay hi, Allah taaala bande ki tauba us samay tak kabool karta hai, jab tak uski jaan gale mein na a jaye.

Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah nishchay hi, Allah bande ki tauba us samay tak kabool karta hai, jab tak uski jaan gale mein na a jaye.

Allah bande ki tauba us samay tak grahan karta hai, jab tak praan kanth tak na pahunch jaye. Jab praan kanth tak pahunch jaata hai, to tauba grahan nahin hoti. Allah taaala ka farmaan hai : "Aur unki tauba (kshama yaachna) sveekaary nahin, jo buraaeeyaan karte rahte hain, yahaan tak ki jab unmen se kisi ki maut ka samay a jaata hai, to kahta haih ab mainne tauba kar li." [soora an-nisa, ayat sankhya : 18]
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4316: “Nissandeh, Allah pawitr hai aur kewal pawitr cheezon ko hi sveekaar karta hai. Allah ne eemaan waalon ko wahi aadesh diya hai, jo usne rasoolon ko diya tha.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : “Nissandeh, Allah pawitr hai aur kewal pawitr cheezon ko hi sveekaar karta hai. Allah ne eemaan waalon ko wahi aadesh diya hai, jo usne rasoolon ko diya tha. Allah ne farmaya hai : يَا أَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُوا مِنْ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَاعْمَلُوا صَالِحًا [soora al-mominoon : 51] (he rasoolo! Pawitr cheezen khaao aur achchhe karm karo.) aur farmaya hai : يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُلُوا مِنْ طَيِّبَاتِ مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ, [soora al-baqra : 172] (he eemaan waalo! Hamne tumhen jo pawitr cheezen di hain, unmen se khaao.) phir ek vyakti ka ullekh kiya, jo lanbi yaatra karta hai, jiske baal bikhre hue tatha shareer dhool-dhoosrit hai, woh apne haath aakaash ki or uthaata hai aur kahta hai : ‘he mere rab! He mere rab!’ jabki uska bhojan haraam ka hai, uska pey haraam ka hai, uska wastr haraam ka hai aur uska poshan haraam se hua hai, aise mein uski dua kaise sveekaar ki jayegi?”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki Allah paak evn puneet hai, kamiyon evn doshon se mukt tatha har etbaar se paripoorn hai. Woh kewal unheen kaaryon, shabdon aur wishvaason ko sveekaar karta hai jo shuddh hon aur jo kewal Allah ki prasannata ke liye aur uske paiganbar ke tareeqe ke anusaar kiye gae hon. Allah ki nikatta kewal isi prakaar ki ibaadton ke dvaara praapt kiya jaana chahiye. Yaad rakhen ki apne karmon ko shuddh karne ka sabse mahatvapoorn saadhan halaal bhojan khaana hai. Halaal bhojan khaane se vyakti ke karm shuddh hote hain. Iseeliye jis prakaar Allah ne rasoolon ko halaal bhojan khaane aur achchhe karm karne ka aadesh diya, usi prakaar usne eemaan waalon ko bhi iska aadesh diya hai. Uska kathan hai : (Ai rasoolo! Halaal cheezen khaao aur nek amal karo. Nihsandeh main woh sab jaanta hoon jo tum karte ho.) [soora mominoon : 51] ek any sthaan mein usne kaha hai : (Ai eemaan waalo! Hamaari di hui halaal cheezen khaao.) [soora baqra : 172]

Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne haraam bhojan karne se saavdhaan kiya. Kyonki haraam bhojan karm ko nasht kar deta hai aur use Allah ke yahaan qabool hone nahin deta. Chaahe qabool hone ke zaahiri sabab jitne bhi paye jayen. Maslan :

1- kisi nek kaam, jaise Hajj, jihaad aur rishte ka haq ada karne aadi ke liye lanba safar karna.

2- insaan ka pareshaan haal hona. Jaise uske baal bikhre hue hon aur dhool mitti lagne ke kaaran uske shareer aur kapre ka rang badla hua ho. Yeh sab kuchh is baat ka pramaan hai ki aadmi bahut pareshaan hai.

3- dua ke liye aakaash ki or haath uthaana.

4- Allah ke naamon ko waseela banaana aur girgiraakar dua karna. Masnal ai mere rab ! Ai mere rab! Kahna.

Dua qabool hone ke in kaarnon ke paye jaane ke baavjood uski dua qabool nahin hoti. Kyonki uska khaana haraam ka, uska peena haraam ka, uska wastr haraam ka hai aur uska paalan-poshan haraam bhojan se hua hai. Aise mein uski dua qabool ho bhi to ho kaise?

Sarvashaktimaan Allah apni zaat, gunon, kaaryon aur aadeshon mein paripoorn hai.
Kewal Allah ki prasannata ki praapti ke liye tatha uske Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam dvaara bataye gae tareeqe ke anusaar kaary karne ka aadesh.
Aisi shaili apnaana jo amal ke liye utsaah aur prerna paida kare. Iska pramaan Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka yeh kathan hai : "Allah ne eemaan waalon ko usi baat ka aadesh diya hai, jiska aadesh rasoolon ko diya hai." Kyonki jab eemaan waale ko yeh ehsaas hoga ki jo kaam woh karne ja raha hai, uska aadesh rasoolon ko bhi diya gaya tha, to uske man mein rasoolon ke padchinhon par chalte hue yeh kaam karne ki parbal ichchha paida hogi.
Dua ki sveekriti mein baadha daalne waali cheejon mein se ek hai haraam bhojan khaana.
Is hadees mein paanch cheezon ka zikr hai, jo dua ke qabool hone ka kaaran banti hain : 1- lanbi yaatra. Kyonki isse winamrata paida hoti hai, jo dua sveekaar hone ka ek pramukh kaaran hai. 2- pareshaani ki haalat. 3- haathon ko aasmaan ki or uthaana. 4. Baar-baar Allah ki rububeeyat (uske srashta, svaami aur prabandhak hone) ka hawaala dete hue aagrah ke saath dua karna. Dua ke qabool hone ka yeh bhi ek bara kaaran hai. 5- halaal cheezen khaana aur peena.
Halaal bhojan khaane se nek kaamon mein madad milti hai.
Qaazi kahte hain : Arbi shabd 'taiyib' isi bhaasha ke ek aur shabd 'khabees' ke wipreet hai. Jab shabd 'taiyib' Allah ki wisheshta ke roop mein aata hai, to iska arth yeh hai ki Allah sabhi kamiyon se paak hai aur sabhi buraaiyon se svachchh hai. Jab yeh kisi vyakti ke gun ke roop mein aata hai, to iska matlab yeh hai ki woh bure aachran aur bure karmon se door hai tatha achchhe aachran aur karmon se yukt hai. Jab yeh dhan ke roop mein aye, to iska arth yeh hota hai ki dhan waidh aur utkrisht hai.
4318: ''Mahaan Allah raat mein haath phailaata hai, taaki din mein gunaah karne waala tauba kar le aur din mein haath phailaata hai, taaki raat mein gunaah karne waala tauba kar le, yahaan tak ki sooraj apne doobne ke sthaan se nikal aye.''

Abu moosa radiyallahu anhu Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se riwayat karte hain ki aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : ''Mahaan Allah raat mein haath phailaata hai, taaki din mein gunaah karne waala tauba kar le aur din mein haath phailaata hai, taaki raat mein gunaah karne waala tauba kar le, yahaan tak ki sooraj apne doobne ke sthaan se nikal aye.''

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki Allah bande ki tauba qabool karta hai. Jab banda din mein gunaah karne ke baad raat mein tauba karta hai, to Allah uski tauba qabool kar leta hai. Isi tarah jab raat mein gunaah karne ke baad din mein tauba karta hai, to uski tauba qabool kar leta hai. Allah bande ke is amal se khush hokar uski tauba qabool karne ke liye apna haath phailaata hai. Tauba ka dvaara us samay tak khula rahega, jab tak duniya ki samaapti ki ek nishaani ke taur par sooraj pashchim se nikal na aye. Jab sooraj pashchim se nikal jayega, to tauba ka dvaar band ho jayega.

Bande ki tauba us samay tak qabool hogi, jab tak tauba ka dvaar khula rahe. Yaad rahe ki tauba ka dvaar pashchim se sooraj nikalne ke baad band ho jayega. Isi tarah tauba qabool hone ke liye zaroori hai ki banda aatma ke gale tak pahunchne se pahle tak tauba kar le.
Insaan ko gunaah ke kaaran mayoos nahin hona chahiye. Kyonki Allah bara kshama karne waala evn dayaalu hai, aur tauba ka dvaar khula hua hai.
Tauba ki sharten : 1- gunaah se khud ko door kar lena. 2- usmen sanlipt hone par sharminda hona. 3- is baat ka pakka iraada kar lena ki woh gunaah phir kabhi nahin karega. Ullikhit teenon sharten us samay hain, jab gunaah ka sanbandh Allah ke kisi adhikaar ke hanan se ho. Agar gunaah ka sanbandh bande ke kisi adhikaar ke hanan se ho, to tauba ke sahi hone ke liye adhikaar waale ko uska adhikaar lautaana ya usse kshama praapt karna zaroori hai.
4319: Allah ne har cheez ke saath achchhe bartaav ko aniwaary kiya hai

Shaddaad bin aus radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Do baaten mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se yaad ki hain. Aapne farmaya hai : "Allah ne har cheez ke saath achchhe bartaav ko aniwaary kiya hai. Atah jab tum (mrityu dand aadi ke liye) kisi ka wadh karo to achchhe dhang se wadh karo aur jab (pashuon ko) zabah karo to achchhe dhang se zabah karo. Tum apni chhuri ki dhaar ko tez kar lo aur apne zabeeha -zabah kiye jaane waale pashu- ko aaraam pahunchaao."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki Allah ham par har kaam mein ehsaan ko farz kiya hai. Ehsaan ka arth hai, apne har kaary mein sadaiv Allah ka dhyaan rakhna. Allah ki ibaadat (upaasna) mein, bhala kaam karte samay, aur logon ko kasht se bachaate samay bhi. Wadh aur zabah karte samay ehsaan bhi isi ke sandarbh mein aata hai.

Atah qisaas (pratishodh) ke taur par wadh karte samay ehsaan yeh hai ki wadh karne ka sabse aasaan, halka aur jaldi jaan lene waala tareeqa apnaya jaye.

Jabki zabah karte samay ehsaan yeh hai ki jaanvar par raham karte hue hathiyaar ko tez kar liya jaye, jaanvar ki nazron ke saamne hathiyaar ko tez na kiya jaye aur doosre jaanavron ke saamne is tarah zabah na kiya jaye ki woh dekh rahe hon.

Srishti par sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ki daya tatha kripa.
Wadh aur zabah mein ehsaan yeh hai ki donon kaam sharai tareeqe se kiye jayen.
Shareeyat ki sanpoornata aur apne andar har bhalaai ko samete rakhna. Yahi kaaran hai ki woh jaanavron ke saath bhi daya karne ka aadesh deta hai.
Insaan ka wadh karne ke baad uske shareer ke angon ko kaatna mana hai.
Har woh kaam haraam hai, jo jaanvar ki yaatna ka kaaran bane.
4322: Nihsandeh Allah ne nekiyon aur gunaahon ko likh liya hai. Phir uska wistaar karte hue farmaya : Jisne kisi satkarm ka iraada kiya aur use kar nahin saka, Allah uske badle apne yahaan ek poori neki likh leta hai aur agar iraade ke anusaar use kar bhi liya, to uske badle mein apne paas das se saat sau, balki usse bhi adhik nekiyaan likh deta hai. Aur agar kisi bure kaam ka iraada kiya, lekin use kiya nahin, to Allah uske badle mein bhi ek poori neki likh deta hai aur agar iraade ke anusaar use kar liya, to uske badle mein kewal ek hi gunaah likhta hai.

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne sarvashaktimaan aur mahaan rab se riwayat karte hue farmaya : "Nihsandeh Allah ne nekiyon aur gunaahon ko likh liya hai. Phir uska wistaar karte hue farmaya : Jisne kisi satkarm ka iraada kiya aur use kar nahin saka, Allah uske badle apne yahaan ek poori neki likh leta hai aur agar iraade ke anusaar use kar bhi liya, to uske badle mein apne paas das se saat sau, balki usse bhi adhik nekiyaan likh deta hai. Aur agar kisi bure kaam ka iraada kiya, lekin use kiya nahin, to Allah uske badle mein bhi ek poori neki likh deta hai aur agar iraade ke anusaar use kar liya, to uske badle mein kewal ek hi gunaah likhta hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki Allah ne achchhe kaamon aur bure kaamon ka nirdhaaran kiya aur uske baad do farishton ko bataya ki unko kaise likhen :

Jisne koi achchha kaam karne ka iraada kiya aur use kar na saka, tab bhi uske liye ek neki likhi jaati hai. Agar use kar liya, to uske liye das se saat sau, balki usse bhi adhik nekiyaan likhi jaati hain. Neki mein yeh wri्ddhi dil ke andar maujood ekhlaas (nishtha) aur us kaary se doosron ko hone waale laabh aadi ke anusaar hoti hai.

Iske wipreet jisne koi bura kaam karne ka iraada kiya aur phir use Allah ke liye chhor diya, uske liye ek neki likhi jaati hai. Lekin agar use dilchaspi na hone ke kaaran chhora aur uske saadhnon par bhi haath na lagaya, to kuchh nahin likha jaata. Jabki agar saamarthy na hone ki wajah se chhora, to uski neeyat ko uske wiruddh likha jaata hai. Aur agar use kar liya, to uska ek gunaah likha jaata hai.

Is ummat par Allah ka bahut bara anugrah ki woh achchhe kaamon ka badla barhaakar deta aur apne paas likh rakhta hai. Jabki bure kaam ka badla barhaakar nahin likhta.
Insaan ke dvaara kiye gae kaaryon mein neeyat ka mahatv aur uska prabhaav.
Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ka anugrah tatha upkaar ki woh aise vyakti ke liye, jisne kisi achchhe kaam ka iraada kiya aur use na kiya ho, uske liye ek neki likh deta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4436: Jo Allah ke path mein ek din roza rakhega, uske chehre ko Allah (Jahannam ki) aag se sattar saal door kar dega.

Abu saeed khudri -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : "Jo Allah ke path mein ek din roza rakhega, uske chehre ko Allah (Jahannam ki) aag se sattar saal door kar dega."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki jo vyakti jihaad ke dauraan ya phir kuchh logon ke anusaar doosre dinon mein bhi kewal Allah ki prasannata evn pratiphal ki praapti ke liye ek din ka roza rakhega, Allah apne anugrah se uske aur Jahannam ke beech sattar saal ki doori paida farma dega.

Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees se jihaad ke dauraan roza rakhne ki fazeelat saabit hoti hai. Lekin isse abhipray woh vyakti hai, jo roza rakhne ke kaaran kamzor na ho jaye, kisi zimmewaari ki adaygi mein rukaawat na khari ho aur yuddh evn use sonpa gaya yuddh ka koi doosra kaam baadhit na ho.
Nafal roza rakhne ki prerna.
Roze mein kewal ek Allah ki prasannata ki praapti ki neeyat hona zaroori hai. Dikhaawa, shohrat tatha doosre uddeshy na hon.
Sindhi kahte hain : "Fi sabeelillah" Ka ek arth yeh ho sakta hai ki neeyat ki shuddhi ho, jabki doosra arth yeh ho sakta hai ki roza yuddh ke dauraan rakha gaya ho. Doosra arth hi fauran samajh mein aata hai.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Jahaan tak hadees ke shabdon "Sabaeen khareephann" Ki baat hai, to waise to khareef saal ka ek khaas mausam hai, lekin yahaan muraad saal hi hai. Yahaan saal ke any mausmon, jaise garmi, jaara aur bahaar aadi ko chhorkar wishesh roop se khareef ka zikr isliye kiya gaya hai ki khareef is drishtikon se sabse utkrisht mausam hai ki usmen phal tore jaate hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4438: Log us samay tak bhalaai mein rahenge, jab tak iftaar karne mein jaldi karte rahenge.

Sahl bin saad -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Log us samay tak bhalaai mein rahenge, jab tak iftaar karne mein jaldi karte rahenge."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya haiै ki log us samay tak bhalaai mein rahenge, jab tak sooraj doobne ka yaqeen ho jaane ke baad fauran iftaar kar liya karenge. Aisa karna is baat ki nishaani hai ki insaan sunnat ka aksharshah paalan karta hai aur uski or se nirdhaarit seema par ruk jaata hai.

Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees mein sooraj doobne ka yaqeen ho jaane ke baad jaldi iftaar karne ki prerna di gai hai. Is hadees ka arth yeh hai ki is ummat ke andar us samay tak anushaasan bahla rahega aur is ummat ke log us samay tak bhalaai aur barkat se laabhaanvit hote rahenge, jab tak is sunnat par amal karte rahenge. Der se iftaar karna is baat ki nishaani hogi ki woh bigaar ke maarg par chalne lagi hai.
Logon ke andar bhalaai sunnat ke anusran ke kaaran baaqi rahegi. Jaise hi sunnat ke saath chher-chhaar shuru hogi, bigaar ki raahen khulne lagengi.
Poorvawarti kitaab waalon aur bidaatiyon ka wirodh, jo der se iftaar kiya karte hain.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Is hadees ke andar iftaar mein der na karne ka kaaran bayaan kar diya gaya hai. Muhallab kahte hain : Iske andar hikmat yeh hai ki raat ke samay ko din mein jorne se bacha jaye, yeh rozedaar ke liye adhik aaraamdayak hai aur isse uske andar roze ki taaqat adhik baaqi rahti hai. Lekin iske saath hi ulema ka is baat par bhi ittefaaq hai ki jaldi uske baad hi ki jayegi, jab apni aankh se dekh lene ya do wishvasneey logon ki gawaahi ke baad is baat ka yaqeen ho jaye ki sooraj doob chuka hai. Waise, zyaada pukhta mat ke anusaar ek wishvasneey vyakti ki gawaahi bhi kaafi hai.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Chetaavni : Aaj ke samay prakat hone waali ek bahut hi ghalat bidaat yeh hai ki Ramzan maheene mein fajr se lagbhag bees minat pahle doosri azaan de di jaati hai aur yeh bataane ke liye ki ab roza rakhne ka iraada rakhne waale ke liye khaana-peena haraam ho chuka haiै, charaagh bujha diye jaate hain. Yeh sab kuchh ehtiyaat ke naam par kiya jaata hai. Isi ehtiyaat ke kaaran we sooraj doob jaane ke kuchh der baad azaan dete hain. Is tarah iftaar mein der aur sahri mein jaldi karte hain aur sunnat ki mukhaalfat ke shikaar ho jaate hain. Atah unmen bhalaai kam ho gai aur buraai barh gai. Aur Allah hi hai jisse sahayta maangi jaati hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4439: Aaj roza na rakhne waale neki le gae.

Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki ham log Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ke saath ek yaatra mein the. Koi roze se tha, to koi bina roze ka. Woh kahte hain ki isi dauraan ek din, jab dhoop bari tez thi, ham ek jagah ruke. Hamaare beech sabse chhaya waala vyakti woh tha, jiske paas chaadar thi. (Sthiti yeh thi ki) hammen se kuchh log apne haath se dhoop se bachne ka prayaas kar rahe the. Unka kahna hai ki is beech rozedaaron ne (bhookh-pyaas se betaab hokar) zameen pakar li aur roza na rakhne waalon ne uthkar kheme lagaye aur jaanavron ko paani pilaya. Yeh dekh, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ne farmayaah aaj roza na rakhne waale neki le gae.

Sahaaba Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath ek yaatra mein the. Sannbhavtah woh yaatra makka wijay ki rahi hogi. Kuchh sahaaba roze se nahin the aur kuchh roze se the. Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne donon ko apne-apne haal par rahne diya. Ek din garmi bari sakht thi. Sab log yaatra ki thakaawat aur dophar ki garmi se trast hokar aaraam ke liye ek jagah ruke. Garmi sakht thi, isliye garmi aur pyaas se nidhaal hokar rozedaar gir pare aur koi kaam na kar sake. Jabki jo log roze se nahin the, we uthe aur kheme lagaye, oonton ko paani pilaya aur apne rozedaar bhaaiyon ki sewa ki. Jab Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unke kaary aur sena ki sewa ko dekha, to unki himmat barhaai aur unki fazeelat tatha adhik pratiphal praapt karne ka bakhaan karte hue kaha ki aaj roza na rakhne waale hi neki le gae.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4440: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) makka wijay ke warsh makka mein daakhil hue to aapke sir par lohe ki topi thi. Jab use utaara to ek vyakti ne aapke paas aakar kaha ki khatal ka beta kaaba ke pardon se chimta hua hai. So, aapne farmayaah uska wadh kar do.

Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ne makka wijay ke warsh makka mein prawesh kiya to aapke sir par lohe ki topi thi. Jab use utaara to ek vyakti ne aapke paas aakar kaha ki khatal ka beta kaabe ke pardon se chimta hua hai. So, aapne farmayaah uska wadh kar do.

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur quraish ke kaafiron ke beech samjhauta tha tatha aapne kuchh mushrikon ke rakt ko halaal kar diya tha aur unko qatl karne ka aadesh de diya tha. Jab makka wijay ho gaya, to aap usmen saavdhaani ke saath daakhil hue. Aapke sar par phaulaadi topi thi. Kuchh sahaaba ne khatal ke bete ko kaaba ke pardon se chimta hua paya. Usne qatl se bachne ke liye kaaba ki hurmat ki sharan le rakhi thi. Kyonki use apne kukarmon ke baare mein pata tha. Sahaaba ne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se sanpark kiye bina use wadh karne ko munaasib na jaana. Jab aapse poochha, to farmaya ki use qatl kar do. Chunaanche use hajar-e-asvad aur maqaam-e-ibraaheem ke beech qatl kar diya gaya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4448: Abdullah bin masaood- radiyallahu anhu- kaabe ko bayen aur mina ko dayen karke khare hue aur farmayaah yahi woh sthaan hai, jahaan Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) par soora al-baqra utri thi.

Abdur rahmaan bin yazeed nakhai ka warnan hai ki unhonne abdullah bin masaood- radiyallahu anhu- ke saath Hajj kiya aur unhen jamra kubra ko saat kankar maarte hue dekha. Us samay woh kaabe ko bayen aur mina ko dayen karke khare hue aur farmayaah yahi woh sthaan hai, jahaan Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) par soora al-baqra utri thi.

Qurbaani aur tashreeq ke dinon mein kankar maarna ek bari ibaadat hai. Ismen Allah ke sammukh winamr hone, uske aadeshon ka paalan karne aur ibraaheem (alaihissalaam) ka anusran karne ka sandesh hai. Qurbaani ke din haaji sabse pahle bare jamra ko kankar maare, taaki iseese us din ke mahatvapoorn kaamon ka shubhaaranbh ho. Kankar maarte samay usi tarah khara ho, jaise Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) khare hue the. Yaani pawitr kaaba baaeen jaanib ho aur mina saamne ho. Phir jamra kubra ko saamne karke saat kankar maare aur har baar kankar maarte samay Allahu akbar kahe. Abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) ne aise hi khare hokar dikhaya tha aur bataya tha ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) yaheen aur isi tarah khare the ki aappar soora baqra utri.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4449: Tummen se koi vyakti juma ke din hargiz roza na rakhe, magar yeh ki usse pahle ya uske baad bhi ek din rakh le.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaih wa sallam) ko farmaate hue sunaah tummen se koi vyakti juma ke din hargiz roza na rakhe, magar yeh ki usse pahle ya uske baad bhi ek din roza rakh le.

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne juma ke din roza rakhne se mana kiya hai. Lekin, yadi usse pahle ya uske baad ek din roza rakh le athva kisi ka niymit nafli roza usi din par jaye, to rakh sakta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4450: Ai umar! Kya aapko pata nahin ki aadmi ka chacha uske baap ke samaan hota hai?

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne umar- radiyallahu anhu- ko zakat ka maal wasool karne ke liye bheja. Isi beech kaha gaya ki bin jameel, khaalid bin waleed aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke chacha abbaas ne zaqaat ada karne ne se mana kar diya hai. Atah Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah bin jameel kewal is wajah se inkaar kar raha hai ki woh nirdhan tha to Allah ne use dhani bana diya. Rahi baat khaalid ki to tum unpar atyaachaar kar rahe ho. Unhonne apne kavchon aur yuddh ke saamaanon ko Allah ke maarg mein nyochhaawar kar rakha hai aur rahi baat abbaas ki to unki zakat tatha uske baraabar aur bhi mujhpar hai. Phir farmayaah ai umar! Kya aapko pata nahin ki aadmi ka chacha uske baap ke samaan hota hai?

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) ko zakat ikattha karne ke liye bheja. Jab woh zakat wasool karne ke liye abbaas bin abdul muttalib (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas gae, to unhonne zakat rok li. Yahi kaam khaalid bin waleed aur ibn-e-jameel ne bhi kiya.
Umar (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aye aur teenon ki shikayat ki, to aapne kaha : Ibn-e-jameel ke paas zakat na dene ka koi uchit kaaran nahin hai. Sachchaai yeh hai ki woh nirdhan tha aur Allah ne use dhani bana diya. Atah, hona to yeh chahiye tha ki woh sabse pahle zakat deta!
Tatha jahaan tak khaalid ki baat hai, to tum yeh kahkar ki usne zakat dene se mana kar diya hai, uspar atyaachaar kar rahe ho. Usne apne kavchon aur yuddh ke saamaanon ko Allah ki raah mein waqf kar rakha hai. Bhala aisa kaise ho sakta hai ki ek vyakti jo aniwaary na ho woh de aur jo aniwaary ho use rok le?
Aur jahaan tak abbaas ki baat hai, to unki zakat ki jimmeेेेwaari svayn Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne le li.
Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki aapne aisa unke wishisht sthaan ke kaaran kiya. Iska pramaan aapka yeh kahna hai : "Kya tumhen pata nahin ki aadmi ka chacha uske pita samaan hota hai?"
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4454: Ham Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke zamaane mein sadqa-e-fitr, har chhote-bare, aazaad ya ghulaam ki or se ek sa khaane ki cheez, ya ek sa paneer, ya ek sa jau, ya ek sa khajoor ya ek sa kishmish nikaalte the.

Tatha abu saeed khudri -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ham Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke zamaane mein sadqa-e-fitr, har chhote-bare, aazaad ya ghulaam ki or se ek sa khaane ki cheez, ya ek sa paneer, ya ek sa jau, ya ek sa khajoor ya ek sa kishmish nikaalte the. Yeh silsila jaari raha, yahaan tak ki jab muaawiya bin abu sufyaan radiyallahu anhu hamaare yahaan Hajj ya Umrah ke iraade se aye aur minbar par baithkar logon se baat ki, to ek baat yeh bhi kahi ki main samajhta hoon ki shaam ki do mud gehoon ek sa khajoor ke baraabar hai. Atah logon ne ispar amal karna shuru kar diya. Lekin abu saeed -radiyallahu anhu- ne farmaya : Jahaan tak meri baat hai, to main jab tak jeewit rahoonga, sadqa-e-fitr usi parimaan mein nikaalta rahoonga, jis parimaan mein Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke daur mein nikaala karta tha.

Musalmaan Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aur aapke supathgaami khaleefaagan ke daur mein zakat-e-fitr ke roop mein har chhote-bare vyakti ki or se ek-ek sa khaane ki cheez nikaala karte the. Un dinon unke khaane ki cheezen theen : Jau, kishmish, paneer aur khajoor. Yahaan yeh yaad rahe ki ek sa chaar mud ka hota hai aur ek mud ek ausat shareer waale vyakti ke ek lap ke baraabar hota hai. Lekin jab muaawiya -radiyallahu anhu- khaleefa ki haisiyat se madeena aye aur shaam ke gehoon ka istemaal adhik hone laga, to unhonne khutba diya aur farmaya: Main samajhta hoon ki shaam waala do mud gehoon ek sa khajoor ke baraabar hai. Chunaanche logon ne unke is kathan par amal karna shuru kar diya. Lekin abu saeed khudri -radiyallahu anhu- ne farmaya : Jahaan tak meri baat hai, to main jeewan bhar use usi tarah nikaalta rahoonga, jis tarah Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke daur mein nikaala karta tha.

Is hadees ke andar bataya gaya hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke daur mein sadqa-e-fitr kitna nikaala jaata tha. Daraasal aapke zamaane mein khaane ki wastu ka ek sa nikaala jaata tha. Wastu evn mooly kuchh bhi ho.
Insaan ke khaane ki har wastu fitra mein nikaali ja sakti hai. Hadees mein chaar wastuon ka zikr wishesh roop se isliye aya hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke zamaane mein yahi wastuen logon ke khaane ke kaam aati theen.
Fitra mein khaane ki wastuon ke sthaan par rupya aur naqad nikaalna jayaz nahin hai.
Navvi sharh saheeh Muslim mein kahte hain : Jab sahaaba ke andar matbhed ho jaye, to unmen se kisi ka kathan kisi se behtar nahin ho sakta. Aise mein hamen koi doosra pramaan talaash karna hoga. Aur hamne paya ki hadeeson ka spasht arth aur qayaas khaane ki doosri cheezon ki tarah gehoon ka bhi ek sa hone par sahmat hain, isliye is par bharosa karna aawashyak hai.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Abu saeed khudri -radiyallahu anhu- ki yeh hadees bataati hai ki sahaaba -radiyallahu anhum- ke andar sunnat ke anusran, hadees ko mazbooti se pakre rahne aur Qur'an ya hadees se spasht pramaan hote hue ijtihaad karne se gurez karne ka jazba kitna maujood tha. Yahaan yeh yaad rahe ki muaawiya -radiyallahu anhu- ka ijtihaad aur logon ka unse sahmat hona is baat ka pramaan hai ki ijtihaad karna jayaz aur prashansneey hai, lekin agar Qur'an evn hadees ka spasht nirdesh maujood ho, to uska koi etbaar nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4457: Hamne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath sahri ka khaana khaya, phir namaaj ke liye chale gae. Anas kahte hain : Mainne poochha : Azaan aur sahri ke beech kitna samay tha? Unhonne jawaab diya : Pachaas ayten parhne ke baraabar samay.

Zaid bin saabit -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : "Hamne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath sahri ka khaana khaya, phir namaaj ke liye chale gae. Anas kahte hain : Mainne poochha : Azaan aur sahri ke beech kitna samay tha? Unhonne jawaab diya : Pachaas ayten parhne ke baraabar samay."

Kuchh sahaaba ne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath sahri ki aur uske baad aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- namaz ke liye khare ho gae. Anas ne zaid bin saabit -radiyallahu anhu- se poochha : Azaan aur sahri ki samaapti ke beech kitna samay tha? Zaid -radiyallahu anhu- ne uttar diya : Qur'an ki pachaas madhyam ayten, jo na lambi hon na chhoti, parhne ke baraabar samay. Parhne ka andaaz bahut dheema bhi na ho, na bahut tez.

Sahri fajr se kuchh pahle karna behtar hai. Kyonki yeh shareer ke liye adhik laabhdayak hai aur dinbhar ke liye adhik faydemand.
Sahaaba ka prayaas rahta tha ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath baith saken, taaki aapse jnaan praapt kar saken.
Sahaaba ke saath Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka uttam vyavhaar ki unke saath baithkar khaana kha liya karte the.
Roza torne waali cheezen chhorne (roza aaranbh) ka samay fajr prakat hone se shuru hota hai.
Hadees ke shabdon "Sahri evn azaan ke beech kitna antraal hota tha?" Se muraad sahri evn iqaamat ke beech ka samay hai. Kyonki doosri hadees mein hai : "Un donon ke sahri samaapt karne aur namaz mein daakhil hone ke beech kitna samay rahta tha?" Zaahir si baat hai ki ek hadees doosri hadees ki vyaakhya karti hai (is liye azaan se muraad yahaan iqaamat hogi).
Muhallab kahte hain : Is hadees mein samay maapne ka kaam shaareerik kaaryon dvaara kiya gaya hai. Arbon ke andar  shaareerik kaaryon dvaara samay maapne ka prachlan raha hai. Kaha karte the : Bakri ka doodh duhne ke baraabar samay aur oont zabah karne ke baraabar samay. Zaid bin saabit ne is hadees mein samay maapne ka kaam Qur'an ki tilaawat se kiya hai, jo is baat ki or ishaara karta hai ki yeh Qur'an ki tilaawat ka samay hua karta tha. Agar kaary ke atirikt kisi aur cheez se samay maapte, to misaal ke taur par kahte : Ek darje ke samaan ya ek ghante ke teesre ya paanchven bhaag ke samaan.
Ibn-e-abu jamra kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- dekhte ki kaun-si cheez aapki ummat ke liye adhik aasaan hai aur uske baad usi par amal karte. Kyonki agar aap sahri nahin karte to aapka anusran karte hue log bhi sahri nahin karte aur is tarah kuchh log kathinaai mein par jaate. Isi tarah agar aap raat ke beech waale bhaag mein sahri karte, tab bhi aise log kathinaai mein par jaate, jinpar neend haawi ho jaati, kyonki sanbhav tha ki iske kaaran unki fajr ki namaz chhoot jaati ya raat jaagne ke kasht se guzarna parta.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4458: Ai ansaariyo! Kya mainne tumhen saty ki raah se bhatka hua nahin paya to Allah ne tumhen mere dvaara seedha raasta dikhaya? Tum bikhre hue nahin the ki Allah ne tumhen mere dvaara aapas mein jor diya? Tum kangaal nahin the ki Allah ne tumhen mere dvaara dhani banaya?

Abdullah bin zaid bin aasim kahte hain ki jab hunain ke din Allah ne apne Rasool ko ganeemat ka dhan pradaan kiya to use logon aur nae-nae Islam grahan karne waalon ke beech baant diya aur ansaar ko kuchh nahin diya. Isse ansaar ne apne dilon mein kuchh naaraazgi mahsoos ki; kyonki logon ko jo kuchh mila tha, usmen se unhen kuchh bhi nahin mila tha.
