Aise mein, aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen sanbodhit karte hue kahaah ai ansaariyo! Kya mainne tumhen saty ki raah se bhatka hua nahin paya to Allah ne tumhen mere dvaara seedha raasta dikhaya? Tum bikhre hue nahin the to Allah ne tumhen mere dvaara aapas mein jor diya? Tum kangaal nahin the ki Allah ne tumhen mere dvaara dhani banaya? Jab bhi aap kuchh kahte, we uttar mein kahte ki Allah aur uska Rasool adhik upkaari hain. Aapne aage kahaah kaun-si baat tumhen Allah ke Rasool ka uttar dene se rokti hai? Unhonne phir kahaah Allah aur uska Rasool adhik upkaari hain. Aage farmayaah yadi tum chaaho, to kah sakte ho ki aap hamaare paas aisi aur aisi awastha mein aye the. Kya tum is baat se santusht nahin ho ki log bakriyaan aur oont le jayen aur tum Allah ke Rasool ko apne ghar le jaao? Agar hijrat na hoti to main ek ansaari vyakti hota. Agar log kisi ghaati mein chalen (aur ansaar doosri ghaati mein) to main ansaar ki ghaati mein chaloonga. Log baahar ke wastr ke samaan hain aur ansaar andar ke wastr ke samaan. Dekho, tum mere baad bhed-bhaav ka saamna karoge. Us samay dhairy rakhna yahaan tak ki hauz mein mujhse milne ka saubhaagy praapt ho jaye.

Jab uchch evn mahaan Allah ne apne Nabi ko hunain yuddh mein wijay dilaai, bahut-sa maal-e-ghaneemat diya aur aap taaif ka muhaasra chhorne ke baad maal-e-ghaneemat ke paas aye tatha aise logon ko usmen se diya, jo nae-nae musalmaan hue the, taaki unhen qareeb laya ja sake, to kuchh ansaar ne ispar aapatti jataai. Jabki bare ansaari sahaaba ko pata tha ki aapne jo kuchh kiya hai, sahi kiya hai. Jab aapko unki is aapatti ki soochna mili, jaisa ki kisi ne yeh bhi kah diya tha ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) maal-e-ghaneemat hamen chhorkar aise logon ko de rahe hain, jinka khoon hamaari talvaaron se abhi bhi tapak raha hai! To aapne unhen ek chabootre mein jama hone ka aadesh diya. Jab sab log ekatr ho gae, to aapne yahaan se baat shuru ki ki yeh kaisi baat hai, jo tumhaare baare mein mujh tak pahunch rahi hai? Phir woh saari baaten kaheen, jiska zikr is hadees mein hai. Aapne apne sanbodhan mein unhen phatkaarne ke saath-saath unke us sahyog ki khoob saraahna ki, jo unki or se aapko aur aapke laye hue dharm islaam ko diya gaya tha. Za़ाhir hai, isse we prasann ho gae aur achchhi tarah jaan gae ki Allah ne apne Rasool ki sangit aur aapko apne saath apne ghar le jaane ke saubhaagy ke roop mein unhen kitni bari nemat pradaan ki hai aur saath hi unki in sewaaon aur qurbaaniyon ke badle mein aakhirat mein unke liye kya kuchh taiyaar kar rakha hai. Phir Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne aane waale dinon mein unhen jis bhedbhaav ka saamna karna hai, uspar sabr se kaam lene ka aadesh diya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4459: Jisne mere saath ab tak aitikaaf kiya , woh antim das dinon ka bhi aitikaaf kare, kyonki mujhe yeh raat dikhaai gai aur fir bhula di gai. Mainne us raat ki subh ko dekha ki main paani aur mitti par sajda kar raha hoon. Atah, use antim das raaton mein talaash karo.

Abu saeed khudri- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) Ramzan ke beech ke das dinon mein aitikaaf karte the. Aise hi ek saal aitikaaf kiya, yahaan tak ki jab ikkeesven roze ki raat aai, (jiski subh aapko aitikaaf se nikalna tha) to farmayaah jisne mere saath ab tak aitikaaf kiya, woh antim das dinon ka bhi aitikaaf kare, kyonki mujhe yeh raat dikhaai gai aur fir bhula di gai. Mainne us raat ki subh ko dekha ki main paani aur mitti par sajda kar raha hoon. Atah, use antim das raaton mein talaash karo tatha use pratyek bejor raat mein talaash karo. So, us raat baarish hui. Choonki masjid ki chhat khujoor ki tahniyon se bani thi, isliye woh tapakne lagi. Phir to meri aankhon ne ikkeesven Ramzan ki subh ko dekha ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki peshaani par paani aur keechar ke nishaan the.

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) qadr ki raat ki talaash mein Ramzan ke beech ke das dinon mein aitikaaf karte the. Ek saal apni aadat ke mutaabiq aitikaaf mein the ki jab ikkeesven Ramzan ki raat aai, jiski subah aap aitikaaf se nikal jaya karte the, to aapko maaloom hua ki qadr ki raat anti das dinon mein hai. Atah, apne saathiyon se kaha : Jisne mere saath beech ke das dinon mein aitikaaf kiya hai, woh apna aitikaaf jaari rakhe aur antim das dinon mein bhi aitikaaf kare.
Saath hi bataya ki sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne aapko woh raat sapne mein dikha di thi, lekin phir use smriti se ghayab kar diya. Parantu, aapne sapne mein uski kuchh nishaaniyaan dekhi theen, jinmen se ek yeh hai ki aap fajr ki namaz mein paani tatha keechar par sajda kar rahe hain.
Chunaanche Allah ne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke is sapne ko sach kar dikhaya. Ikkeesven Ramzan ki raat ko baarish hui. Aapki masjid choonki jhonpre ki tarah thi. Uske khanbe khajoor ke tanon ke the aur chhat uski shaakhaaon ki. Isliye baarish hone par masjid tapakne lagi aur aapne ikkeesven Ramzan ki subah ko paani aur keechar par sajda kiya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4491: Allah ne apne Rasool ko anumti di thi, tumhen anumti nahin di hai. Waise bhi, mujhe kewal din ki ek ghari ke liye anumti di thi. Aaj woh usi tarah haraam hai, jaise kal thi. Atah, jo upasthit hai, woh use pahuncha de, jo upasthit nahin hai.

Abu shuraih- khuwailid bin amr khuzaai advi -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki unhonne amr bin saeed bin aas se, (jab woh makka ki or sainyadal bhej raha tha) kahaah ai saalaar! Mujhe ek hadees sunaane ki anumti deejiye, jo Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne makka wijay ke doosre din subh khare hokar kahi thi aur use mere kaanon ne suna tha, mere dil ne yaad kar liya tha aur meri aankhon ne woh drishy dekha tha, jab aapne ise bayaan karte samay Allah ki prashansa karne ke baad kaha thaah makka ko Allah ne haraam qaraar diya hai, logon ne haraam karaar nahin diya hai. Atah, kisi vyakti ke liye, jo Allah aur aakhirat par eemaan rakhta ho, halaal nahin hai ki yahaan raktapaat kare aur iska koi per kaate. Phir yadi koi Allah ke Rasool (sallallah alaihi wa sallam) ke yuddh ko misaal banaakar use uchit thahraane ka prayaas kare to usse kah dena ki Allah ne apne Rasool ko anumti di thi, tumhen anumti nahin di hai. Waise bhi, mujhe kewal din ki ek ghari ke liye anumti di thi. Aaj woh usi tarah haraam hai, jaise kal thi. Atah, jo upasthit hai, woh use pahuncha de, jo upasthit nahin hai.
Abu shuraih se poochha gaya ki usne aapko kya uttar diya? To unka kahna tha ki usne kahaah ai abu shuraih! Main yeh baat aapse adhik jaanta hoon. Haram kisi awajnaakaari, raktapaat karke aur fasaad machaakar bhaagne waale ko sharan nahin deta.

Jab yazeed bin muaawiya ki or se niyukt madeene ke ameer amr bin saeed bin aas ne, jo ashdaq ke naam se prasiddh tha, abdullah bin zubair (radiyallahu anhuma) se yuddh ke liye makka ki or sena bhejne ka iraada kiya, to use samjhaane-bujhaane ke liye uske paas abu shuraih khuwailid bin amr khuzaai (radiyallahu anhu) aye.
Choonki saamne waala vyakti khud ko ek bara aadmi samajhta tha, isliye abu shuraih (radiyallahu anhu) ne hikmat aur samajhdaari se kaam lete hue usse bari narmi se baat ki, taaki baat maanne ki sanbhaavna adhik ban sake aur koi apriy ghatna bhi na ghate. Unhonne sabse pahle amr bin saeed jo sena bhejna chaahta tha, uske baare mein baat karne ki anumti maangi aur bataya ki woh jo hadees sunaane ja rahe hain, uske sahi hone par unhen poorn wishvaas hai, kyonki unke kaanon ne use suna hai, dil ne surakshit rakha hai aur Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab yeh baat kah rahe the, us samay unki aankhon ne aapko dekha hai. Itna sunne ke baad amr bin saeed ne unko baat karne ki anumti de di.
Chunaanche abu shuraih ne kaha : Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne makka wijay ke din subah ke samay Allah ki stuti evn prashansa karne ke baad farmaya : Makka ko Allah ne usi din haraam qaraar diya hai, jis din aakaash evn dharti ki rachna ki hai. Isliye woh sada sammaan evn aadar ka paatr raha hai. Use logon ne charaagaahon aur ghaaton ki tarah asthayi roop se haraam qaraar nahin diya hai. Ab, jab yeh pata chal gaya ki woh hamesha se sammaan evn aadar ka paatr raha hai aur use yeh darja khud Allah ne diya hai, to kisi insaan ke liye, jo Allah aur aakhirat ke din par wishvaas rakhta ho aur apne eemaan ko surakshit rakhna chaahta ho, halaal na hoga ki wahaan khoon bahaye aur uske per kaate.
Haan, yadi koi makka wijay ke din mere yuddh ko pramaan maankar khud wahaan yuddh karne ki yojna banaye, to usse kah do ki tumhaara maamla Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jaisa nahin hai. Allah ne aapko anumti di thi, tumhen nahin di hai.
Ek baat aur bhi hai. Wahaan sada ke liye yuddh ki anumti nahin di gai thi. Zaroorat ke anusaar bas kuchh der ke liye anumti di gai thi aur phir woh dobaara pahle ki tarah haraam ho gaya. Atah, jo log upasthit hain, we un logon ko meri baat pahuncha den, jo upasthit nahin hain.
Choonki main us din maujood tha aur aap maujood nahin the, isliye mainne aapko Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka sandesh pahuncha diya. Itna sunne ke baad logon ne abu shuraih se poochha ki amr ne aapko kya uttar diya? To unhonne kaha ki usne uttar diya : Ai abu shuraih main is maamle ko aapse adhik samajhta hoon. Haram kisi awajnaakaari aur ghaddaari karke bhaagne waale ko sharan nahin deta.
Is tarah, usne hadees ke muqaable mein apna mat pesh kar diya aur abdullah bin zubair (radiyallahu anhuma) se yuddh ke liye sena bhejne ki yojna se peechhe hatne ki bajay uspar data raha.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4494: Makka wijay ke baad hijrat nahin rahi, lekin jihaad aur neeyat baaqi hain. Tatha jab jihaad ke liye nikalne ko kaha jaye to awilanb nikal paro.

Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne makka wijay ke din farmayaah makka wijay ke baad hijrat nahin rahi, lekin jihaad aur neeyat baaqi hain. Tatha jab jihaad ke liye nikalne ko kaha jaye to awilanb nikal paro. Tatha makka wijay ke din hi farmayaah is nagri ko Allah ne aakaash evn dharti ki srishti ke din haram banaya hai. Atah, yeh qayaamat ke din tak haram hi rahega. Mujhse pahle kisi ko ismen yuddh ki anumti nahin di gai thi aur mujhe bhi kuchh samay ke liye hi di gai thi. Yeh Allah ke nirnay ke anusaar qayaamat ke din tak haram hi rahega. Yahaan ke kaanton ko kaata nahin jayega, shikaar ka peechha nahin kiya jayega, giri hui cheez ko uthaya nahin jayega, yeh aur baat hai ki koi uska elaan karna chaahe aur hari ghaas ko bhi kaata nahin jayega. Yeh sunkar abbaas- radiyallahu anhu- ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Izkhir (ek prakaar ki sugandhit ghaas) ko chhor kar, kyonki yeh lohaaron tatha gharon ke kaam aati hai? Aapne farmayaah haan, izkhir ko chhorkar.

Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- makka wijay ke din sanbodhan ke liye khare hue, to farmaya : Ab makka se hijrat nahin rahi. Kyonki yeh ab islaami nagar ban chuka hai. Haan, Allah ki raah mein jihaad baaqi hai. Atah, jise jihaad ke liye nikalne ko kaha jaye, woh Allah tatha uske Rasool aur ameer ki baat maante hue jihaad ke liye zaroor nikle. Phir aapne makke ke sammaan evn aadar ka ullekh kiya aur bataya ki iska yeh aadar evn sammaan usi din se hai, jis din Allah ne aakaashon evn dharti ki rachna ki thi. Yeh bhi bataya ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se pahle kisi ke liye yahaan yuddh karna halaal nahin kiya gaya tha aur aapke baad bhi kisi ke liye halaal nahin kiya jayega. Balki, aapke liye bhi kuchh der ke liye hi halaal hua tha aur phir uski hurmat laut aai hai. Phir aapne makka ke sammaan ka ullekh karte hue bataya ki haram ke kaante kaate nahin jayenge, uskeे jaanavron ka shikaar nahin kiya jayega, wahaan giri hui cheez us vyakti ke siwa koi utha nahin sakta, jo uska ailaan karna chaahta ho aur uski ghaas ukhaari nahin ja sakti. Albatta, makka waalon ke hit ke maddenzar izkhir ko is aadesh se alag rakha gaya hai, kyonki lohaar log bhatti jalaane ke liye uska istemaal karte hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4495: Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- mrityu tak Ramzan ke antim das dinon mein etikaaf karte rahe. Aapke baad aapki patniyon ne bhi etikaaf kiya.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki patni musalmaanon ki maata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki : Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- mrityu tak Ramzan ke antim das dinon mein etikaaf karte rahe. Aapke baad aapki patniyon ne bhi etikaaf kiya.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- bataati hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- lailtul qadr (sammaanit raatri) ki talaash mein Ramzan ke antim das dinon mein paabandi ke saath etikaaf karte the. Mrityu tak aap aisa hi karte rahe. Aapke baad aapki patniyon ne bhi etikaaf kiya.

Etikaaf masjid mein karna hai. Aurten bhi sharai nirdeshon ka paalan karte hue masjid mein etikaaf karengi, jab fitne ka bhay na ho.
Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- paabandi ke saath etikaaf karte the, isliye Ramzan ke antim das dinon mein etikaaf karna taakeedi baat hai.
Etikaaf ek nirantar roop se jaari rahne waali sunnat hai, jo nirast nahin hui hai, kyonki aapke baad aapki patniyon ne bhi etikaaf kiya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4498: Tum log sahri khaya karo, kyonki sahri mein barkat hai.
Anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Tum log sahri khaya karo, kyonki sahri mein barkat hai."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne sahri karne ke liye prerit kiya hai. Sahri kahte hain roze ki taiyaari ke taur par raat ke antim bhaag mein khaane ko. Prerit karne ka kaaran yeh hai ki usmen bara pratiphal tatha sawaab, raat ke antim bhaag mein dua ke liye jaagne, roza rakhne ki shakti praapt karne, apne andar roze ke liye chusti paida karne aur roze ki mashaqqat ko kam karne jaisi cheezen paai jaati hain.

Sharai nirdesh ka paalan karte hue sahri karna musathab hai.
Ibn-e-hajar fath al-baari mein likhte hain : Sahri ki barkat wibhinn dishaaon se praapt hoti hai. Sahri karna sunnat ka anupaalan hai, ahl-e-kitaab ki mukhaalfat hai, isse ibaadat ki shakti praapt hoti hai, shareer ke andar chusti aati hai, bhookh se paida hone waala duraachaar door hota hai, yeh sahri ke samay maangne waale ya aapke saath sahri khaane aane waale ko daan dene ka kaaran banti hai, dua ki sveekriti ke samay zikr evn dua ka sabab hai aur jisne sone se pahle roze ki neeyat nahin ki, use neeyat karne ka ek avsar pradaan karti hai.
Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke shiksha dene ka sundar tareeqa ki aap aadesh ke saath uski hikmat bhi bayaan kar dete the, taaki dil santusht ho jaye aur shareeyat ki bulandi samajh mein aye.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Khaan-paan ki koi bhi thori-si cheez kha-pi lene se sahri ho jaati hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4503: Yaatra mein roza rakhna puny ka kaary nahin hai

Jaabir bin abdullah -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ek yaatra par the, ki ek bheer dekhi, jahaan ek vyakti ke liye chhaanv ka prabandh kiya gaya tha. Aapne poochha ki : "Yeh kya hai?" To logon ne bataya ki yeh rozedaar hai. Aapne farmaya : "Yaatra mein roza rakhna puny ka kaary nahin hai", tatha saheeh Muslim ki ek riwayat mein hai : "Tum Allah ki or se mili hui chhoot ko sahriday sveekaar karo."

Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ek yaatra par the. Yaatra ke dauraan aapne ek vyakti ke paas logon ki bheer dekhi, jispar sooraj ki garmi aur atyadhik pyaas ke kaaran chhaya kiya gaya tha. Aapne poochha : Ise kya hua hai? Logon ne kaha : Yeh rozedaar hai. To aapne farmaya : Yaatra mein roza rakhna puny ka kaary nahin hai, tum Allah ki us chhoot ko sveekaar karo jo usne tumhen di hai.

Islaami shareeyat ki saralta ka warnan.
Yaatra mein roza rakhne aur roza chhorkar chhoot par amal karne donon ki anumti.
Safar mein roza rakhna makrooh hai, agar usmen kathinaai ho, lekin agar kathinaai jaanlewa hone ki had tak pahunch jaye, to yeh haraam ho jaata hai.
Navvi kahte hain : "Yaatra mein roza rakhna puny ka kaary nahin hai" Ka arth yeh hai ki jab tumhen kathinaai ho aur haani ka bhay ho. Hadees ka sandarbh isi vyaakhya ki maang karta hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apne sahaaba ka khyaal rakha karte the tatha unke haalaat maaloom karte rahte the.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4505: Ham log Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath Ramzan ke maheene mein sakht garmi ke samay ek yaatra par nikle. Sthiti yeh thi ki sakht garmi ke kaaran, ham apne sir par apna haath rakh liya karte the. Us samay, hamaare beech Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur abdullah bin rawaaha- radiyallahu anhu- ke siwa koi roze se nahin tha.

Abu darda- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, kahte hain ki ham log Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath Ramzan ke maheene mein sakht garmi ke samay ek yaatra par nikle. Sthiti yeh thi ki sakht garmi ke kaaran, ham apne sir par apna haath rakh liya karte the. Us samay, hamaare beech Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur abdullah bin rawaaha- radiyallahu anhu- ke siwa koi roze se nahin tha.

Abu darda -radiyallahu anhu- bayaan karte hain ki we Ramzan ke maheene mein ek yaatra mein nikle. Yeh sakht garmi ka samay tha. Garmi itni sakht thi ki log garmi se bachne ke liye apne saron par apne haath rakh liya karte the. Us yaatra mein (Ramzan ka maheena hone ke baavjood) kewal Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aur abdullah bin rawaaha -radiyallahu anhu- ne roza rakha tha. Un donon ne takleef uthaakar rakha tha. Isse pramaan milta hai ki yaatra ke dauraan aisi kathinaai ke saath roza rakhne ki anumti hai, jisse jaan ka khatra na ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4507: Ek vyakti ne Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se yaatra ke dauraan roza rakhne ke sanbandh mein prashn kiya to aapne farmaya: Yadi chaaho to roza rakho aur agar chaaho to na rakho.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- bayaan karti hain ki hamza bin amr asalmi ne- jo ki ek bahut roza rakhne waale vyakti the- Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se poochha ki kya main safar mein roza rakhoon? To aapne farmaya: Yadi chaaho to roza rakho aur yadi chaaho to na rakho.

Aaisha -Allah unse prasann ho- bataati hain ki hamza bin amr asalmi -Allah unse prasann ho- ne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se yaatra ke dauraan roza rakhne ke sanbandh mein poochha, to Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unhen roza rakhne aur chhorne ka wikalp dete hue farmaya : "Chaaho to roza rakho aur chaaho to roza tor do."
Yaad rahe ki yahaan roze se muraad farz roza hai. Kyonki aapka farmaan hai : "Yeh Allah ki or se chhoot hai."
Isse yeh bhi pata chalta hai ki unhonne farz roze ke baare mein hi poochha tha. Iski pushti abu daaood ki riwayat se bhi hoti hai, jismen hai ki unhonne kaha : "Ai Allah ke Rasool, mere paas ek sawaari hai. Main usi se rozi roti ka bandobast karta hoon. Usi par yaatra karta hoon aur logon ka saamaan dhota hoon. Kabhi-kabhi yaatra ke dauraan Ramzan ka maheena a jaata hai aur main roza rakhne ki kshamta bhi rakhta hoon ...."
Lekin is baat ki bhi sanbhaavna hai ki unhonne mutlak roze ke baare mein poochha ho, chaahe farz ho ya nafal. Kyonki aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ne kaha hai : "Woh ek bahut roza rakhne waale vyakti the."
Isse yeh saaf ho jaata hai ki yaatra mein roza na rakhna Allah ki or se mili hui ek chhoot hai. Jisne use grahan kiya, usne achchha kiya aur jisne roza rakha, uska roza rakhna jayaz hai aur woh waajib ada karne waala samjha jayega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4508: Ramzan se ek ya do din pahle roze na rakho. Parantu jo vyakti (pahle se) roze rakh raha ho, woh rakh sakta hai.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Ramzan se ek ya do din pahle roze na rakho. Parantu jo vyakti (pahle se) roze rakh raha ho, woh rakh sakta hai."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne saavdhaani ke taur par Ramzan ke ek ya do din pahle se roza shuru kar dene se mana kiya hai. Iska kaaran yeh hai ki Ramzan ke roze ki aniwaaryata chaand dekhne se juri hui hai aur takalluf ki koi aawashyakta nahin hai. Albatta agar kisi ne pahle se roza rakhne ka koi maamool bana rakha ho, jaise ek din roza rakhna aur ek din naagha karna, ya phir somvaar ya brihaspatiwaar ke roze rakhna aur maamool ka din Ramzan se ek-do din pahle par jaye, to woh us din roza rakh sakta hai. Kyonki yeh Ramzan ka svaagat nahin hai. Isi tarah, waajib roze jaise- qaza evn mannat ke roze bhi Ramzan se ek-do din pahle rakhe ja sakte hain.

Anpe oopar shakti se adhik bojh daalne ki manaahi tatha koi kami-beshi kiye bina Allah ke bataye hue tareeqe ke mutaabiq ibaadat karne ki aawashyakta.
Is manaahi ke peechhe hikmat yeh hai -aur behtar Allah hi janta hai- ki farz ibaadton ko nafal ibaadton se alag rakha jaye, utsaah tatha josh ke saath Ramzan ke liye taiyaar raha jaye aur roze ko is phazeelat waale maheene ki khaas nishaani banaya jaye jo isi se pahchaana jaata hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4519: Musalmaan ko uske ghore aur gulaam ki zakat nahin deni hai.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- warnan karte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Musalmaan ko uske ghore aur gulaam ki zakat nahin deni hai.
Ek any riwayat mein ye shabd bhi aye hain: Parantu gulaam ki or se fitra dena hai.

Zakat ki buniyaad baraabri aur nyay par hai. Iseeliye Allah ne zakat dhanvaanon ke aise dhan par aniwaary ki hai, jo barhne waale hon aur barhne ke liye rakhe gae hon, jaise zameen ki paidaawaar aur vyaapaar ke saamaan. Jahaan tak un dhanon ka sanbandh hai, jinke andar wriddhi nahin hoti, yaani aise dhan jo apne dakhal mein tatha vyaktigat upyog ke liye hon, to unpar zakat nahin hai, kyonki yeh svayn uske prayog ke liye hote hain.
Iske udaaharnasvaroop ham kisi ki sawaari, jaise ghora, oont, gaari aadi aur uski sewa karne waale daas, bistar aur prayog ke liye rakhe gae bartan aadi ko le sakte hain.
Lekin daas ka fitra dena hoga, chaahe woh vyaapaar ka na bhi ho, kyonki fitra ka sanbandh dhan se nahin, balki shareer se hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4520: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne sadqa-e-fitr musalmaan ghulaam aur aazaad, mard aur aurat, chhote aur bare (sab par) ek saaa् khajoor ya ek saaa् jau farz qaraar diya hai aur aadesh diya hai ki use namaz ke liye logon ke nikalne se pahle-pahle ada kar diya jaye.

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne sadqa-e-fitr musalmaan ghulaam aur aazaad, mard aur aurat, chhote aur bare (sab par) ek saaa् khajoor ya ek saaa् jau farz qaraar diya hai aur aadesh diya hai ki use namaz ke liye logon ke nikalne se pahle-pahle ada kar diya jaye.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne Ramzan ke baad zakat al-fitr waajib ki hai, jo ek saaa् yaani chaar mud hai. Mud daraasal ek ausat qad-kaathi ke insaan ke lap bhar ko kahte hain. Zakat-e-fitr har aise musalmaan par waajib hai, jiske paas ek din tatha ek raat ke khaane se adhik wastu maujood ho. Ghulaam ho ki aazaad, purush ho ki mahila aur chhota ho ki bara. Insaan zakat-e-fitr apni or se tatha aise sabhi logon ki or se ada karega, jinka bharan-poshan woh karta ho. Saath hi yeh bhi aadesh diya ki fitra logon ke eed ki namaz ke liye nikalne se pahle-pahle ada kar diya jaye.

Zakat-e-fitr chhote wa bare aur aazaad tatha ghulaam har musalmaan ki or se dena waajib hai. Dene ka kaam abhibhaawak tatha maalik karega. Insaan zakat-e-fitr apni or se, apne baal-bachchon ki or se aur un tamaam logon ki oेr se ada karega, jinka bharan-poshan uspar waajib hai.
Maan ke pet mein pal rahe bachche ki or se zakat-e-fitr nikaalna waajib nahin, balki musathab hai.
Is baat ka bayaan ki zakat-e-fitr mein kaun-kaun si cheezen nikaalni hain. Daraasal zakat-e-fitr mein logon ki saamaany khaane ki cheezen nikaali jayengi.
Zakat-e-fitr eed ki namaz se pahle-pahle nikaal dena waajib hai. Behtar yeh hai ki eed ke din subah nikaali jaye. Ek-do din pahle nikaalna bhi jayaz hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4521: Kisi musalmaan aurat ke liye jayaz nahin ki ek din evn ek raat ki yaatra kisi mahram ke bina kare.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Kisi musalmaan aurat ke liye jayaz nahin ki ek din evn ek raat ki yaatra kisi mahram ke bina kare."
Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki kisi musalmaan stri ke liye kisi mahram vyakti ko saath liye bina ek raat ki doori ka safar karna haraam hai.

Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Stri ke liye kisi mahram ko saath liye bina yaatra karna jayaz nahin hai, is baat par poori ummat ekmat hai. Albatta Hajj, Umrah ke liye aur shirk waale kshetr se nikalne ke liye ki jaane waali yaatra ke baare mein ekmat nahin hai. Kuchh log mahram ke saath ko bhi Hajj ki shart qaraar dete hain.
Islam ek sanpoorn shareeyat hai aur mahila suraksha ka pakshadhar hai.
Allah aur aakhirat ke din par eemaan ka taqaaza hai ki shareeyat ke prati samarpan aur uski seemaaon ka paalan ho.
Stri ka mahram uska pati ya aisa vyakti hai, jisse khoon ke rishte ya doodh ke rishte ya sasuraali rishte ke kaaran daymi taur par nikaah haraam ho tatha woh Muslim, wayask, samajhdaar aur bharose ke layaq ho. Kyonki mahram ka kaam stri ki raksha aur uski dekh-bhaal karna hai.
Us yaatra ki muddat, jise aurat sirf mahram ke saath tai kar sakti hai, ke wishay mein aai hui riwayton ke baare mein baihqi kahte hain : "Saaraansh yeh hai ki jis masaafat ko bhi safar kaha jaye, stri ke liye use pati ya mahram ke bina tay karna mana hoga. Masaafat chaahe teen din ki ho, do din ki ho, ek din ki ho ya ek bareed (ek khaas masaafat) aadi ki. Iska pramaan abdullah bin abbaas ki woh saamaany riwayat hai, jo saheeh Muslim ki guzri hui riwayton mein se sabse antim riwayat hai aur jiske shabd is prakaar hain : "Koi stri kisi mahram ke bina yaatra na kare." Ismen har us doori ko tay karna shaamil hai, jise safar kaha jaye." Abhi hamaare saamne jo hadees hai, woh daraasal poochhne waale tatha uski paristhitiyon ke anusaar aai hui hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4522: Kabhi-kabhi is haal mein fajr ki namaz ka samay a jaata ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apni patniyon se sanbhog ke kaaran naapaaki ki awastha mein hote. Iske baad snaan karte aur roza rakhte.

Aaisha aur umme salma- radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki kabhi-kabhi is haal mein fajr ki namaz ka samay a jaata ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apni patniyon se sanbhog ke kaaran naapaaki ki awastha mein hote. Phir iske baad snaan karte aur roza rakhte.

Aaisha aur umm-e-salma -Allah un donon se prasann ho- bataati hain ki kabhi-kabhi aisa hota ki Allah ke -Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- raat ko hambistari (sanbhog) karte aur snaan kiye bina janaabat ki awastha hi mein fazr ho jaati. Lekin iske baavjood aap roza poora karte aur uski qaza nahin karte the. Daraasal yeh baat donon ne us samay kahi thi, jab marvaan bin hakam ne unke paas aadmi bhejkar is sanbandh mein poochha tha.
Yeh hukm Ramzan tatha gair-Ramzan donon ke liye hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4523: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne do din, arthaat eed al-fitr evn eedul-azha ke din roza rakhne, ek kapre ko saare badan par is tarah lapetne ki haath aadi kuchh bhi baahar na nikal sake, pindliyon ko khara karke ek hi kapra lapetkar chootar ke bal baithne aur fajr evn asr ke baad namaz parhne se mana kiya hai.

Abu saeed khudri- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne do din, arthaat eed al-fitr evn eedul-azha ke din roza rakhne, ek kapre ko saare badan par is tarah lapetne ki haath aadi kuchh bhi baahar na nikal sake, pindliyon ko khara karke ek hi kapra lapetkar chootar ke bal baithne aur fajr evn asr ke baad namaz parhne se mana kiya hai.

Is hadees mein Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne do dinon ke rojon, do tarah se kapra pahanne aur do namaazon se mana kiya hai.
Jin do dinon mein roza rakhna haraam hai, unse muraad eed al-fitr aur eed al-azha ke din hain. In do dinon mein roza rakhne ki manaahi ki hikmat yeh hai ki yeh khaane-peene aur khushi manaane ke din hain aur is tarah ke dinon mein roza rakhna uchit nahin hai.
Rahi baat do tarah se kapra pahanne ki manaahi ki, to unmen se ek yeh hai ki aadmi apne donon chootron ke bal par baithe aur donon pindliyon ko khara rakhe aur unhen apne haathon se mazbooti se pakre rahe ya ek kapre se baandh le. Jabki doosra yeh hai ki aadmi ek kapre ko is tarah se orh le ki shareer ka koi ang baahar nikaalne ki gunjaaish baaqi na rahe. Jabki bukhaari ki riwayat mein yeh shart lagaai gai hai ki "Uske guptaang par koi kapra na ho."
Jahaan tak do namaazon ki baat hai, to unse muraad fajr ki namaz ke baad evn asr ki namaz ke baad parhi jaane waali namaazen hain. Yeh manaahi daraasal un kaaphiron ke saath samaanta grahan karne ke raaston ko band karne ke liye hai, jo sooryoday evn sooryaast ke samay sooraj ko sajda karte hain. Parantu, yadi kisi ne farz namaz na parhi ho, use in do samyon mein ada karna aur isi tarah sabab waali namaazon ko ada karna jayaz hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4524: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne nirantar roza rakhne se mana kiya hai. Logon ne kaha ki aap to nirantar roze rakhte hain? Aapne farmaya: Main tumhare jaisa nahin hoon. Mujhe khilaya aur pilaya jaata hai.

Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne nirantar roza rakhne se mana kiya. Logon ne kaha ki aap to nirantar roze rakhte hain? Aapne farmaya: Main tumhare jaisa nahin hoon. Mujhe khilaya aur pilaya jaata hai.
Abu saeed khudri- razillahu anhu- ki riwayat mein haih "Tummen se jo nirantar roze rakhna chaahe, woh sehri ke samay tak rakhe."

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne saathiyon ko, unpar daya tatha kripa karte hue, iftaar kiye bina nirantar roze rakhne se mana kiya hai. Parantu sahaaba puny-prem aur Allah ki nikatta pradaan karne waale kaaryon ki chaahat ke kaaran, Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke padchihnon par chalte hue, nirantar roza rakhne ki raghbat rakhte the. Yahi kaaran hai ki unhonne kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool, aap to lagaataar roza rakhte hain? Jiska uttar aapne yeh diya ki Allah aapke andar khaane-peene ke nateeje mein paida hone waali shakti ki tarah aisi shakti pradaan kar deta hai ki aapko khaane-peene ki aawashyakta nahin rahti. Haan, yadi tummen se koi nirantar roza rakhna hi chaahe, to fajr se pahle tak rakhe.
Shareeyat-e-islaami ek udaar evn aasaan shareeyat hai. Ismen na kathinaai hai na mashaqqat, na atishyokti hai na atiwaad. Kyonki yeh ek tarah se nafs ko yantrana dena aur uspar atyaachaar karna hai, jabki Allah kisi par uski shakti se adhik bojh nahin daalta.
Iska ek aur kaaran bhi hai. Jahaan aasaani hogi, wahaan amal adhik samay tak jaari rah sakega aur uktaahat ke kaaran amal se peechhe hat jaane ka dar bhi kam rahega. Saath hi ismen woh nyay bhi hai jo Allah ne dharti mein rakha hai. Yaani Allah ko uska haq dete hue uski ibaadat karna aur nafs ko woh cheezen dena, jo use prabal rakhne ke liye aawashyak hon.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4525: Jo roza rakh kar bhool kar kha le athva pi le, woh apna roza poora kare, kyonki use Allah ne khilaya evn pilaya hai.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jo roza rakh kar bhool kar kha le athva pi le, woh apna roza poora kare, kyonki use Allah ne khilaya evn pilaya hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jisne farz ya nafal roza ki haalat mein bhoolkar kuchh kha ya pi liya, woh apna roza poora kare. Use na tor. Kyonki usne jaan-boojhkar khaya ya piya nahin hai. Balki khud Allah ne use khilaya aur pilaya hai.

Jisne bhoolkar kuchh kha-pi liya, uska roza sahi ho jayega.
Bhoolkar kha-pi lene par koi gunaah nahin hai, kyonki ismen insaan ka apna iraada shaamil nahin hai.
Allah ka apne bandon par anugrah aur kripa, Allah dvaara unhen pradaan ki gai suwidha, tatha unhen kathinaai aur pareshaani se bachaane ke upay.
Roza torne waali cheezon ke kaaran kisi bhi rozedaar ka roza usi samay tootega, jab uske andar teen sharten paai jayen : 1. Usne roza torne waala kaam jnaan rakhte hue kiya ho, agar jnaan na ho, to roza nahin tootega. 2- yaad rahte hue kiya ho, agar bhoolkar kiya ho, to roza sahi ho jayega aur qaza karni nahin hogi. 3- roza torne waala kaam apni marzi se kiya ho, uspar koi zabardasti na hui ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4526: Kya Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne wishesh roop se shukrawaar ke din ka roza rakhne se mana kiya hai? To farmayaah haan.

Muhammad bin abbaad bin jaaphar kahte hain kih mainne jaabir bin abdullah- radiyallahu anhu- se poochha ki kya Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne wishesh roop se shukrawaar ke din ka roza rakhne se mana kiya hai? To farmayaah haan.
Ek riwayat mein haih "Kaaba ke rab ki qasam!"

Choonki juma ka din musalmaanon ke liye eed ka din hai, isliye Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne us din wishesh roop se roza rakhne athva namaz parhne se mana farmaya hai. Haan, yadi usse pahle athva uske baad ek din rakh liya jaye ya kisi ke maamool ke rozon mein jume ka din a jaye, to koi harj nahin hai. Isse mana isliye kiya gaya hai, taaki jansaadhaaran mein yeh sandesh na jaye ki us din any dinon ke muqaable mein adhik ibaadat karna waajib hai.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4527: Mainne umar bin khattaab -radiyallahu anhu- ke saath eed ki namaz ada ki. Unhonne farmaya ki yeh do din aise hain, jinmen roza rakhne se Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne mana kiya hai. Ek (Ramzan ke) rozon ke baad iftaar (eed al-fitr) ka din, aur doosra woh din, jismen tum apni qurbaani ka maans khaate ho (yaani eed al-azha ka din).

Ibn-e-azhar ke aazaad kiye hue ghulaam abu ubaid se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Mainne umar bin khattaab -radiyallahu anhu- ke saath eed ki namaz ada ki. Unhonne farmaya ki yeh do din aise hain, jinmen roza rakhne se Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne mana kiya hai. Ek (Ramzan ke) rozon ke baad iftaar (eed al-fitr) ka din, aur doosra woh din, jismen tum apni qurbaani ka maans khaate ho (yaani eed al-azha ka din).

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne eed al-fitr ke din evn eed al-azha ke din roza rakhne se mana kiya hai. Eed al-fitr ke din isliye ki us din maheena bhar roza rakhne ke baad roza torne ka din hai aur eed al-azha ke din isliye ki woh qurbaani ka maans khaane ka din hai.

Eed al-fitr ke din, eed al-azha ke din aur tashreeq ke dinon mein roza rakhna haraam hai. Tashreeq ke dinon mein isliye ki ye eed al-azha ke din ke adheen hain. Haan, yadi kisi (hajj karne waale) ke paas hady (qurbaani ka jaanvar) na ho, to woh tashreeq ke dinon mein roza rakh sakta hai.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Kaha gaya hai : In do dinon ke ullekh ka uddeshy daraasal in donon dinon mein roza rakhne ki manaahi ke kaaran ki or ishaara karna hai. Pahle din roza rakhne ki manaahi ka kaaran, roze se alag karna, roze ke poora ho jaane ko darshaana hai, jo uske baad roza na rahne se spasht hota hai. Jabki doosre din roza rakhne ki manaahi ka kaaran qurbaani karna hai, jo ek ibaadat hai aur jiska maans khaya jaata hai.
Musathab yeh hai ki khateeb apne khutbe mein samay evn paristhitiyon ke anusaar sharai aadesh evn nirdesh bayaan kare.
Qurbaani ka maans khaana ek shareeyat sammat kaary hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4528: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ehraam ki awastha mein kaise apna sir dhote the?

Abdullah bin hunain kahte hain ki abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- aur misvar bin makharma- radiyallahu anhu- ke beech abva naami sthaan mein ek baat ke baare mein matbhed ho gaya.
Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- ka kahna tha ki aadmi, ehraam ki awastha mein apna sir dho sakta hai, jabki misvar- radiyallahu anhu- ka kahna tha ki dho nahin sakta.
Abdullah bin hunain kahte hainh aise mein, abdullah bin abbaas ne mujhe abu ayyoob ansaari- radiyallahu anhu- ke paas bheja. Mainne paya ki woh do khoonton ke beech snaan kar rahe the aur kapre se aar kiye hue the. Mainne unhen salaam kiya to poochhaah kaun? Mainne kahaah main abdullah bin hunain hoon. Mujhe abdullah bin abbaas ne aapke paas yeh poochhne ke liye bheja hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ehraam ki awastha mein kaise apna sir dhote the? Yeh sunkar abu ayyoob ne kapre par haath rakhkar use jhukaya, taaki unka sir dikhne lage. Phir ek vyakti se, jo unke shareer par paani daal raha tha, apne sir par paani daalne ko kaha. Usne paani daala to apne donon haathon se sir ke baalon ko hilaya, unhen aage se peechhe le gae aur peechhe se aage le aye aur uske baad farmayaah mainne aap (sallallahu alaihi wallam) ko isi tarah snaan karte dekha hai.
Doosri riwayat mein hai ki misvar ne abdullah bin abbaas se kahaah main kabhi aapse tark-witark nahin karunga.

Abdullah bin abbaas aur misvar bin makharma -radiyallahu anhum- ke beech ehraam ki awastha mein sar dhone athva na dhone ke baare mein baat chal pari. Sandeh is baat par tha ki yadi aadmi ehraam ki haalat mein apne sar ke baalon ko hilaye, to isse kuchh baalon ke jharne ki sanbhaavna rahti hai. Chunaanche donon ne abdullah bin hunain ko abu ayyoob -radiyallahu anhu- ke paas bheja. Woh pahunche to abu ayyoob -radiyallahu anhu- snaan kar rah the.Abdullah bin hunain ne kaha ki mujhe abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- ne aapke paas bheja hai. Woh aapse jaanna chaahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ehraam ki awastha mein kaise snaan karte the? Yeh sun, unhonne parda ke taur par latke hue kapre ko thor-sa neeche kiya ki unka sar dikh jaye aur phir paani daalne waale se kaha ki paani daalo.Phir donon haathon se sar ke baalon ko is tarah hilaya ki haathon ko aage se peechhe le gae aur peechhe se aage le aye aur phir kaha : Mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko aisa hi karte dekha hai. Jab abdullah bin hunain waapas aye aur donon ko bataya ki abdullah bin masaood ka mat hi sahi hai, to choonki we sada saty ke talabgaar rahte the, isliye misvar ne apni baat waapas le li aur abdullah bin abbaas ki shreshthata ko sveekaar karte hue kaha ki main kabhi aapse bahas nahin karoonga.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4529: Ham log Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath Hajj ke liye talbiya pukaarte hue aye to aapne hamen aadesh diya aur hamne use Umrah mein badal diya.

Jaabir- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki ham log Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath Hajj ke liye talbiya pukaarte hue aye to aapne hamen aadesh diya aur hamne use Umrah mein badal diya.

Jaabir -Allah unse prasann ho- bata rahe hain ki sahaaba kiraam Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath hajjatul wada ke avsar par aye, to adhiktar log Hajj ka talbiya pukaar rahe the. Yaani unhonne Hajj-e-ifraad ka iraada kiya tha.
Aise mein Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne saath mein qurbaani ka jaanvar na laane waalon se kaha ki Hajj ka iraada badalkar Umrah ka iraada kar len, taaki Umrah ke baad se lekar Hajj tak halaal rahkar laabh uthaane ka avsar mil jaye. Chunaanche logon ne aisa hi kiya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4530: Jo roza baaqi chhorkar mar jaye, uska wali (abhibhaawak ya kareebi rishtedaar) uski or se roza rakhega.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jo roza baaqi chhorkar mar jaye, uska wali (abhibhaawak ya kareebi rishtedaar) uski or se roza rakhega.

Aaisha -Allah unse prasann ho- kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne us vyakti ke abhibhaawak ko, jo apne zimme farz roza, jaise kaffaara, mannat ya Ramzan ka roza chhorkar mar jaye, aadesh diya hai ki uski or se roza rakhe, kyonki yeh mritak par qarz hai. Yaad rahe ki mritak ke qareebi rishtedaar uski or se roza rakhne ke sabse haqdaar hain, kyonki yeh uspar upkaar aur uske naate ka haq ada karna hai. Waise, yeh aadesh istehbaab ke liye hai aur iska anupaalan waajib nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4531: Meri maan mar gai hai aur uspar ek maheene ka roza hai, aise mein kya main uski taraf se roza rakh loon? Aapne farmayaah yadi teri maan par qarj hota to kya tu uski or se use ada karta? Usne kahaah zaroor! To farmayaah phir to Allah ka qarj is baat ka adhik haqdaar hai ki use ada kiya jaye.

Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki ek vyakti, Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya aur bolaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Meri maan mar gai hai aur uspar ek maheene ka roza hai, aise mein kya main uski taraf se roza rakh loon? Aapne farmayaah yadi teri maan par qarj hota, to kya tu uski or se use ada karta? Usne kahaah zaroor! To farmayaah phir to Allah ka karj is baat ka adhik haqdaar hai ki use ada kiya jaye.
Ek doosri riwayat mein haih ek aurat Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aakar kahne lagi ki ai Allah ke Rasool, meri maata ki mrityu ho gai hai aur uspar mannat ka roza hai. Aise mein, kya main uski or se roza rakh sakti hoon? Aapne farmayaah "Yadi teri maan par qarj hota, to kya tu use ada karti?" Usne kahaah awashy! To farmayaah "Phir apni maan ki or se roza rakh le."

Is hadees mein do riwayten hain aur hadees ke prasang se lagta hai ki donon ek nahin, balki alag-alag ghatnayen hain.
Pahli riwayat mein hai ki ek vyakti Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa salm- ke paas aya aur bataya ki uski maan ki mrityu ho gai hai aur uske ek maheene ke roze baaqi hain, to kya woh uski or se qaja kar sakta hai?
Jabki doosri riwayat mein hai ki ek mahila aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aakar aapko bataati hai ki uski maan mar gai hai aur uspar mannat ka roza baaqi hai, to kya woh uski or se roza rakhegi?
Aapne donon ko fatva diya ki unki maataaon par jo roze hain, woh unki or se unhen ada karen aur phir is baat ko samjhaane tatha spasht karne ke liye ek udaahran diya.
Unse poochha ki yadi unke maata-pita par kisi vyakti ka qarz hota, to kya we use ada karte? Jab donon ne haan mein jawaab diya, to bataya ki yeh roza bhi daraasal unke maata-pita ke oopar Allah qarz hai. Atah jab insaan ka qarz ada kiya jayega, to Allah ka qarz to is baat ka adhik haq rakhta hai ki use ada kiya jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4532: Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko arfaat mein pravchan dene ke dauraan (ehraam waale vyakti ke baare mein) kahte hue sunaah jo joota na paye, woh moza pahan le aur jo tahband na paye, woh paazaama pahan le.

Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko arfaat mein pravchan dene ke dauraan (ehraam waale vyakti ke baare mein) kahte hue sunaah jo joota na paye, woh moza pahan le aur jo tahband na paye, woh paazaama pahan le.

Abdullah bin abbaas -Allah unse prasann ho- bata rahe hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne arfaat ke maidaan mein logon sanbodhit kiya, to joote na hone ki soorat mein moze pahanne ki anumti di aur neeche se kaatne ka zikr nahin kiya tatha tahband na milne ki awastha mein pajaama pahanne ki anumti di aur use faarne ki shart nahin lagaai. Daraasal yeh hikmat waale evn pawitr Allah ki or se bojh halka karne ka udaahran hai.
4533: Jaanavron se hone waali kshati ki kshatipoorti nahin hai, kuen mein girne se hone waali kshati ki kshitpoorti nahin hai, khaan mein kaam karte samay hone waali kshati ki kshatipoorti nahin hai tatha zameen mein dafan khazaane ka paanchaawaan bhaag dena hai.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jaanavron se hone waali kshati ki kshatipoorti nahin hai, kuen mein girne se hone waali kshati ki kshitpoorti nahin hai, khaan mein kaam karte samay hone waali kshati ki kshatipoorti nahin hai tatha zameen mein dafan khazaane ka paanchaawaan bhaag dena hai.

Yahaan abu huraira -Allah unse prasann ho- Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se jaanvar, kuen mein girne tatha khaan se hone waali kshati ki kshatipoorti ka hukm naqal kar rahe hain. Aapne bataya hai ki jaanvar ke maadhyam se jo kshati ho, usmen kisi par koi kshatipoorti nahin hai. Isi tarah kuen mein utarne ke kaaran yadi koi mar jaye ya khaan ke andar ghusne ke baad koi mar jaye, to usmen bhi koi kshatipoorti nahin hai. Kyonki jaanvar, kuen aur khaan par kshatipoorti ka dayitv daala nahin jo sakta aur na uske maalik par daala ja sakta hai, jab tak uski or se koi atyaachaar ya laaparvaahi na ho. Phir bataya ki jise zameen mein dhafan khazaana mile, chaahe kam ho adhik, use uska paanchva bhaag ada karna hai. Kyonki yeh bina mashakkat aur mehnat ke praapt hone waala dhan hai. Paanchvaan bhaag ada kar dene ke baad jo bach jaye, woh usi ka hai.
4534: Shaitaan aadam ki santaan ki ragon mein lahu ki tarah daurta hai. Isliye mujhe dar hua ki shaitaan tumhaare dilon mein koi galat khyaal na daal de.

Safiyya bint huyay- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aitikaaf ki haalat mein the ki main raat ke samay aapse milne gai. Aapse baat karne ke baad jab waapas hone ke liye khari hui, to aap bhi mujhe chhorne ke liye khare hue. (Un dinon safiyya ka niwaas usaama bin zaid ke ghar mein tha.) isi beech wahaan se do ansaari vyakti guzre. Jab unhonne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dekha to tez chalne lage. Unhen aisa karte dekh Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen rukne ko kaha aur farmayaah yeh safiyya bint huyay hain. Donon ne kahaah subhaanallah! Ai Allah ke Rasool (kya ham aapke baare mein koi sandeh kar sakte hain?) to aapne farmayaah shaitaan aadam ki santaan ki ragon mein lahu ki tarah daurta hai. Isliye mujhe dar hua ki shaitaan tumhaare dilon mein koi galat khayaal na daal de.
Ek aur riwayat mein hai ki woh Ramzan ke antim das dinon mein aitikaaf ke dauraan masjid mein milne aaeen aur aapke saath kuchh samay baat karne ke baad jaane ke liye khari hueen, to aap bhi unhen chhorne ke liye khare ho gae, yahaan tak ki jab umme salma ke darvaaze tak pahunchi... Uske baad shesh usi arth ki riwayat bayaan ki.

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- Ramzan ke aakhiri das dinon mein etekaaf mein the. Isi beech aapki patni safiyya -radiyallahu anha- aapse milne aaeen aur kuchh der baat karne ke baad ghar waapas jaane ke liye khari hueen, to aap khare hue aur kuchh door tak unke saath chalne lage. Itne mein wahaan se do ansaari vyakti guzre aur Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath aapki patni ko dekhkar lajaate hue tez chalne lage. Yeh dekh, aapne un donon se kaha ki zara thahro. Dekho, yeh meri patni safiyya hai. Donon ne kaha : Subhaan Allah, kya aapke baare mein galat socha ja sakta hai? To aapne unhen bataya ki shaitaan insaan ko gumraah karne ke liye tatpar rahta hai aur uske paas iski bari kshamta bhi hai. Kyonki woh aadam ki santaan ki ragon mein lahu ki tarah daurta hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki aapko dar mahsoos hua ki kaheen shaitaan unke dilon mein koi ghalat khayaal na daal de.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4535: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke talbiya mein yeh shabd hua karte the: (Ai Allah! Main upasthi hoon. Main upasthit hoon. Main upasthit hoon, tera koi saajhi nahin hai, main upasthit hoon, nissandeh har prashansa aur nemat teri hai aur teri hi baadshaahat hai, tera koi saajhi nahin hai.)

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke talbiya mein yeh shabd hua karte the: (Ai Allah! Main upasthi hoon. Main upasthit hoon. Main upasthit hoon, tera koi saajhi nahin hai, main upasthit hoon, nissandeh har prashansa aur nemat teri hai aur teri hi baadshaahat hai, tera koi saajhi nahin hai.) warnankarta kahte hain ki abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ismen in shabdon ki wriddhi kar liya karte the : (Main upasthit hoon. Main upasthit hoon. Mera saubhaagy hai tere paas aana. Bhalaai tere hi haath mein hai. Chaahat teri hi hai aur amal bhi tere hi liye hai.)

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab Hajj ya Umrah mein prawesh karna chaahte, to yeh talbiya kahte : (Main upasthit hoon ai Allah, main poornatah upasthit hoon) ai Allah! Main nishtha, ekeshvarvaad evn Hajj aadi ke aahvaan par aniwaary roop se upasthit hoon. (Main upasthit hoon, tera koi saajhi nahin, main upasthit hoon) kyonki tu hi akela ibaadat ka haqdaar hai. Tere paalanhaar evn poojy hone tatha tere naamon evn gunon mein tera koi saajhi nahin hai. (Nissandeh prashansa), aabhaar evn stuti teri hi hai. (Evn nemat) teri hi or se praapt hoti hai aur yeh cheezen tu hi pradaan karta hai, aur ye sab (tere hi liye hain.) in sabhi cheezon par har haal mein tera hi adhikaar hai. (Evn baadshaahat) bhi teri hi hai. (Tera koi saajhi nahin hai.) atah yeh saari cheezen tere hi liye hain. Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ismen in shabdon ki wriddhi karte the : (Main upasthit hoon, aur yeh mera saubhaagy hai ki main upasthit hoon.) main tere darbaar mein upasthi hoon. Mujhe baar-baar yeh saubhaagy pradaan kar. Evn saari ki saari (bhalaai tere haath mein hai.) aur tere anugrah se hi praapt hoti hai. (Main upasthit hoon, aur meri samast aashayen aur ichchhayen kewal tujhi se hain.) maanga usi se jaata hai, jiske haath mein bhalaai hoti hai. (Evn saare amal) bhi tere liye hain ki tu hi ibaadat ka haqdaar hai.

Hajj tatha Umrah mein talbiya pukaarna ek shareeyat sammat kaary hai. Uski taakeed isliye aai hai ki yeh Hajj tatha Umrah ki khaas pahchaan hai, jis tarah takbeer namaz ki khaas pahchaan hai.
Ibn-e-munaiyir kahte hain : Talbiya pukaarne ki shiksha Allah ke apnebandon ka sammaan karne ki or ishaara karta hai ki Allah ke jo bande uske ghar ki ziyaarat ke liye pahunchte hain, wo daraasal Allah ke bulaane par pahunchte hain.
Behtar yeh hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke sikhaye hue talbiya hi ko pukaara jaye. Lekin, kuchh wriddhi kar lene mein koi harj nahin hai, kyonki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aisa hota hua dekhkar khaamoshi barti hai. Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Yahi sabse uttam tareeqa hai. Chunaanche Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se saabit shabdon ko alag se parhe. Uske baad agar kisi sahaabi se saabit shabdon ko parhna chaahe ya apni or se kuchh munaasib shabdon ko jorna chaahe, to unhen alag se parhe, taaki yeh shabd Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se saabit shabdon ke saath mishrit na ho jayen. Iska haal daraasal tashahhud ki dua jaisa hai. Kyonki uske baare mein Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : Phir uske baad prashansa evn stuti ke jo shabd chaahe, chun le. Yaani Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se saabit shabdon ko parh lene ke baad.
Purushon ke liye oonchi aawaaz mein talbiya kahna musathab hai. Lekin aurat dheemi aawaaz mein talbiya kahegi, taaki fitne ka kaaran na ban jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4536: Mujhe Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas laya gaya to jooen mere chehre par jhar-jharkar gir rahi theen. Yeh dekh aapne kahaah main nahin samajhta tha ki tumhaari takleef is had tak pahunch chuki hai, jo abhi main dekh raha hoon. (Athva main nahin samajhta tha ki tumhaari pareshaani is had tak pahunch chuki hai, jo main dekh raha hoon) kya tumhen ek bakri mil sakti hai? Usne kahaah nahin. To farmayaah teen roze rakho ya chhah nirdhanon ko khaana khilaao.

Abdullah bin maaqil kahte hain ki mainne kaab bin ujra ke paas baithkar unse fidya ke baare poochha to bataya ki yeh ayat wishesh rup se mere baare mein utri thi, lekin tum sabhi ke liye aam hai. Hua yoon ki mujhe Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas laya gaya to jooen mere chehre par jhar-jharkar gir rahi theen. Yeh dekh aapne kahaah main nahin samajhta tha ki tumhaari takleef is had tak pahunch chuki hai, jo abhi main dekh raha hoon. (Athva main nahin samajhta tha ki tumhaari pareshaani is had tak pahunch chuki hai, jo main dekh raha hoon) kya tumhen ek bakri mil sakti hai? Usne kahaah nahin. To farmayaah teen roze rakho ya chhah nirdhanon ko khaana khilaao (pratyek nirdhan ko aadha saa khaane ki wastu dena).
Ek doosri riwayat mein haih Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unhen aadesh diya ki chhah logon ko teen sa khaana khilayen athva ek bakri zabah karen athva teen roze rakhen.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne hudaibiya mein kaab bin ujra -radiyallahu anhu- ko dekha, jo ehraam ki awastha mein the aur beemaari ke kaaran joon unke chehre par jhar-jharkar gir rahi theen. Yeh dekh Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko unke haal par taras a gaya aur farmaya : Main nahin samajhta tha ki tumhaari pareshaani us had tak barh chuki hai, jo main ab dekh raha hoon. Phir poochha : Kya tum bakri fidya mein de sakte ho? Kaha : Nahi. To barkat waale evn mahaan Allah ne yeh ayat utaari : {فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْكُم مَرِيضَاً أوْ به أذَىً مِنْ رَأسِه فَفِدْية مِنْ صِيَامٍ أوْ صَدَقَةٍ أوْ نُسُكٍ} الآية (yadi tummen se koi vyakti rogi ho ya uske sar mein koi peera ho (aur sar ka mundan kara le) to uske badle mein roza rakhna ya daan dena athva qurbaani karna hai.)
Us samay Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unhen teen roze rakhne ya chhah nirdhanon ko khaana khilaane ke beech ekhtiyaar diya. Yaad rahe ki pratyek nirdhan ko aadha saa gehoon aadi dena hai. Yeh sar ke munndan ka kaffaara hoga, jo joon aadi ke kaaran majboori mein use karaana para tha. Jabki ek any riwayat mein hai ki aapne unhen teen wikalpon mein se kisi ek ko chunne ka adhikaar diya tha.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4537: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur aapke sahaaba chaar zil-hijja ki subh ko makka pahunche to aapne unhen aadesh diya ki Hajj ke ehraam ko Umrah ka ehraam bana len (aur Umrah ke baad halaal ho jayen). Aise mein unhonne poochha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Hamaare liye kaun-kaun si wastuen halaal hongi? To aapne uttar diyaah tamaam wastuen halaal hain.

Abdullah bin abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur aapke sahaaba chaar zil-hijja ki subh ko makka pahunche to aapne unhen aadesh diya ki Hajj ke ehraam ko Umrah ka ehraam bana len (aur Umrah ke baad halaal ho jayen). Aise mein unhonne poochha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Hamaare liye kaun-kaun si wastuen halaal hongi? To aapne uttar diyaah tamaam wastuen.

Abdullah bin abbaas -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aur aapke saathi hajjatul wada ke avsar par jul hijja ki chauthi taareekh ki subah makka pahunche. Kuchh logon ne sirph Hajj ki neeyat ki thi aur kuchh logon ne Hajj tatha Umrah donon ki neeyat ki thi. Aapne in donon prakaar ke logon mein se jo log qurbaani ka jaanvar saath nahin laye the, unhen aadesh diya ki Hajj se halaal ho jayen aur apne ehraam ko Umrah se badal len. Lekin logon par yeh aadesh bhaari par raha tha. Unhen yeh baat bari bhaari lag rahi thi ki is tarah poore taur par halaal ho jayen ki sanbhog tak halaal ho jaye aur uske baad phir Hajj ka ehraam baandhen. Yahi kaaran hai ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha ki ham kis had tak halaal hon? To aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne uttar diya ki poore taur par halaal ho jaao, jisse tumhaare liye ehraam pahle halaal saari wastuen halaal ho jayengi. Phir sahaaba ne aapke aadesh ka paalan kiya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4538: Mujhe mere dost (Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne teen cheezon ki waseeyat ki hai : Har maheena teen din roza rakhne, chaasht ki do rakaat namaz parhne aur sone se pahle witr parhne ki.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Mujhe mere dost (Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne teen cheezon ki waseeyat ki hai : Har maheena teen din roza rakhne, chaasht ki do rakaat namaz parhne aur sone se pahle witr parhne ki.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu bata rahe hain ki unke dost aur saathi yaani Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unko teen baaton ki waseeyat ki hai :

1- har maheene teen din roza rakhne ki.

2- har roz chaasht ki do rakaat namaz parhne ki.

3- sone se pahle witr ki namaz parhne ki. Yeh waseeyat wishesh roop se us vyakti ke liye hai, jise andesha ho ki raat ke antim bhaag mein jaag nahin sakega.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne alag-alag saathiyon ko alag-alag tarah ki waseeyten isliye ki theen ki aap unke haalaat se avgat the aur jaante the ki kiske liye kya munaasib hai. Maslan shaareerik roop se mazboot ke liye jihaad, ibaadatguzaar ke liye ibaadat aur aalim ke liye ilm munaasib hai.
Ibn-e-hajar asqalaani har maheene teen din ke roze ki waseeyat ke baare mein kahte hain : Bazaahir aisa lagta hai ki in rozon se muraad hijri maheene ke terahveen, chaudahveen aur pandraween din ke rozen hain.
Ibn-e-hajar asqalaani kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki witr ki namaz sone se pahle parh lena musathab hai. Lekin yeh uske haq mein hai, jise jaag paane ka bharosa na ho.
In teenon kaaryon ka mahatv. Kyonki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne kai saathiyon ko inki waseeyat ki hai.
Ibn-e- daqeek al-eed chaasht ki do rakaaton ke baare mein kahte hain : Yahaan shayad aapne kam se kam rakaaton ka zikr kiya hai, jinhen parhne ki taakeed aai hai. Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki chaasht ki namaz musathab hai aur uski kam se kam rakaat do hain.
Chaasht ki namaz ka samay : Chaasht ki namaz ka samay sooraj nikalne ke lagbhag pandrah minat baad se shuru hota hai aur zuhar ki namaz se lagbhag das minat pahle tak rahta hai. Yeh namaz kam se kam do rakaat hai. Jabki zyaada se zyaada kitni parhi ja sakti hai, iske baare mein matbhed hai. Kuchh logon ne aath rakaat kaha hai aur kuchh logon ne kaha hai ki zyaada ki koi seema nahin hai.
Witr ki namaz ka samay : Witr ki namaz ka samay isha ki namaz ke baad se fajr hone tak rahta hai. Yeh namaz kam se kam ek rakaat aur zyaada se zyaada gyaarah rakaat hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4539: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab arfa se muzadlifa ki or chale to kis gati se chal rahe the? Unhonne uttar diyaah madhyam gati se chal rahe the, lekin jab khaali jagah milti thi to tez chal lete the.

Urva bin zubair kahte hain ki (meri upasthiti mein) usaama bin zaid se poochha gaya ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab arfa se muzadlifa ki or chale to kis gati se chal rahe the? Unhonne uttar diyaah madhyam gati se chal rahe the, lekin jab khaali jagah milti to tez bhi chal lete the.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab arfa se muzadlifa ki or ja rahe the, to usaama bin zaid -radiyallahu anhuma- aapke peechhe sawaar the. Lihaaza, woh any logon ki tulna mein aapke chalne ke andaaz se adhik avgat the. Yahi kaaran hai ki unse aapke chalne ki gati ke baare mein poochha gaya, to farmaya : Jab bheer-bhaar hoti to aap madhyam gati se chalte the, taaki kisi ko kasht na ho. Lekin, jab raasta khaali milta aur kisi ko kasht hone ka bhay na hota, to gati thori tez kar lete the.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4540: Shab-e-qadr ko (Ramzan ke) antim das dinon ki wisham raaton mein talaash karo.
Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Shab-e-qadr ko (Ramzan ke) antim das dinon ki wisham raaton mein talaash karo."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne adhik se adhik neki ke kaamon ke saath lailtul qadr (sammaanit raatri) ko talaash karne ki koshish karne ki prerna di hai. Lailtul qadr ke baare mein iski zyaada aasha hai ki woh Ramzan ke antim das dinon ki wisham raaton yaani ikkeesveen, teeesveen, pachcheesveen, sattaaeesveen aur unteesveen raaton mein se kisi ek raat mein hua karti hai.

Shab-e-qadr ki fazeelat aur use talaash karne ki prerna.
Allah ki hikmat evn daya ka taqaaza yeh hua ki is raat ko chhupaakar rakha, taaki iski talaash mein log khoob ibaadat kiya karen aur unhen bara pratiphal praapt ho sake.
Shab-e-qadr Ramzan ki antim das raaton mein se koi ek raat hua karti hai. Is baat ki aasha adhik hai ki antim das raaton mein se koi wisham raat ho.
Shab-e-qadr Ramzan ki antim das raaton mein se koi ek raat hai. Isi raat mein Allah ne apne Nabi Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- par Qur'an utaara aur use barkat, sammaan aur usmen kiye gae achchhe kaaryon ke pratiphal ke maamle mein ek hazaar raaton se behtar qaraar diya.
Is raat ko lailtul qadr ya to iski fazeelat evn pratishtha ki bina par kaha gaya hai. Arbi mein kaha jaata hai : "Phulaanun azeemul qadri" Yaani amuk bari pratishthit vyakti hai. Is hisaab se yahaan "Allailtu" Ka sanbandh "Alqadri" Ke saath wisheshy tatha wisheshan waala sanbandh hai. Yaani pratishthi raatri. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : "Hamne ise ek mubaarak raat main awatrit kiya hai." [soora dukhaan : 3] yaani hamne is qaraaan ko ek barkat waali raat mein utaara hai. Aisa bhi ho sakta hai ki lailtul qadr mein aya hua qadr shabd taqdeer ke arth mein ho. Is paristhiti mein lailtul qadr ke donon shabdon ka sanbandh ek samay ka usmen ghatit hone waali cheezon ke saath hai. Yaani ek aisi raat hai, jismen saal bhar hone waali ghatnaaon ka nirdhaaran kar diya jaata hai. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : "Ismen har sudrirh kaary ka nirnay kiya jaata hai" [soora dukhaan : 4]
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4541: Allah ke nikat sabse priy roza daaood- alaihissalaam- ka roza aur sabse priy namaz daaood- alaihissalaam- ki namaz hai. Aap aadhi raat sote, phir ek tihaai raat namaz parhte aur shesh chhatha bhaag sote the. Isi tarah ek din roza rakhte aur ek din bina roze ke rahte the.

Abdullah bin amr bin aas- radiyallahu anhuma-kahte hain ki allallah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah Allah ke nikat sabse priy roza daaood- alaihissalaam- ka roza aur sabse priy namaz daaood- alaihissalaam- ki namaz hai. Woh aadhi raat sote, phir ek tihaai raat namaz parhte aur shesh chhatha bhaag sote the. Isi tarah ek din roza rakhte aur ek din bina roze ke rahte the.

Is hadees mein abdullah bin amr -radiyallahu anhuma- Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke hawaale se bayaan karte hain ki Allah ke nikat sabse priy roza aur sabse priy raat ki namaz, uske Nabi daaood -alaihissalaam- ka roza aur unki raat ki namaz hai. Kyonki woh ek din roza rakhte the aur ek din bina roze ke rahte the, jisse ibaadat bhi ho jaati aur shareer ko aaraam bhi mil jaata tha. Isi tarah, woh raat ke pahle aadhe bhaag mein so jaate, taaki ibaadat ke liye poori chusti ke saath khare ho saken, phir ek tihaai bhaag namaz parhte aur antim chhatha bhaag sote the, taaki din ke pratham bhaag ki ibaadat ke liye chusti praapt kar len. Yahi woh kaifiyat hai, jiski Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne prerna di hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4542: Mere bhaai daaood ke roze (aadhe saal ke roze) se barhkar koi roza nahin hai. Ek din roza rakho aur ek din bina roze ke raho.

Abdullah bin amr bin aas- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hainh kisi ne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko bataya ki main kahta hoonh Allah ki qasam! Jab tak jeewit rahoonga, hamesha din mein roza rakhoonga aur raat ko namaz parhoonga. Atah, aapne mujhse kahaah kya tumne hi yeh baat kahi hai? Mainne kahaah haan, - mere maata-pita aap par qurbaan hon- mainne sachmuch yeh baat kahi hai. Aapne kahaah tum aisa kar nahin paaoge. Isliye roza bhi rakho aur bina roze ke bhi raho. Raat ko namaz bhi parho aur so bhi liya karo. Maheene mein teen roze rakho, kyonki neki ka badla das guna milta hai aur is tarah yeh hamesha roza rakhne hi ki tarah hua. Mainne kahaah lekin, main isse adhik ki kshamta rakhta hoon. Aapne farmayaah phir ek din roza rakho aur do din bina roze ke raho. Mainne kahaah main isse behtar kar sakta hoon. Farmayaah phir ek din roza rakho aur ek din bina roze ke raho. Yeh daaood- alaihissalaam- ki tarah roza hua aur yeh sarvashreshth roza hai. Mainne kahaah main isse bhi adhik kar sakta hoon. To aapne farmayaah isse behtar kuchh nahin hai. Ek any riwayat mein haih mere bhaai daaood ke roze (aadhe saal ke roze) se barhkar koi roza nahin hai. Ek din roza rakho aur ek din bina roze ke raho.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko bataya gaya ki abdullah bin amr bin aas -radiyallahu anhuma- ne qasam khaai hai ki woh umr bhar lagaataar roza rakhenge evn kabhi roza nahin chhorenge aur hamesha raat ko namaz parhenge evn kabhi soenge nahin. Aapne unse poochha ki sachmuch unhonne aisa kaha hai? To uttar diya ki haan. Ispar aapne kaha ki yeh tumhaare liye kathin hoga aur tum is qasam ko nibha nahin paaoge. Phir unka maargadarshan kiya ki woh roza bhi rakhen aur chhoren bhi aur raat ki namaz bhi parhen tatha soen bhi. Bas, har maheene mein teen roze rakh liya karen, taaki unhen hamesha roza rakhne ka sawaab mil jaye. Lekin unhonne bataya ki woh isse adhik roze rakh sakte hain. Phir, isi tarah woh lagaataar adhik roze rakhne ki anumti maangte gae, yahaan tak sarvashreshth roze yaani daaood alaihissalaam ke roze tak pahunch gae, jiske anusaar ek din roza rakhna aur ek bina roze ke rahna hota hai. Choonki woh neki ke kaamon ki bari chaahat rakhte the, isliye isse bhi adhik roze rakhne ki anumit maangi, lekin Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya ki isse uttam koi roza nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4543: Paanch prakaar ke jeev-jantu haanikaarak hain, unhen haram ke andar bhi maara jayega, kaua, cheel, bichchhu, chooha aur kaatne waala kutta.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah paanch prakaar ke jeev-jantu haanikaarak hain, unhen haram ke andar bhi maara jayega, kaua, cheel, bichchhu, chooha aur kaatne waala kutta.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih chaar ke prakaar haanikaarak jeewon ko haram ke baahar tatha haram mein sabhi jaghon mein maara jayega.

Is hadees mein aaisha -radiyallahu anha- bataati hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne paanch prakaar ke jaandaaron ko, jo sabke sab haanikaarak hain, maarne ka aaेdash diya hai aur is maamle mein haram ka andar tatha baahar sab baraabar hai. Phir bataya ki yeh paanch jaandaar hain, kaua, cheel, bichchhu, chooha aur kaatne waala kutta.
In paanch prakaar ke jaandaaron ke baare mein bataya gaya hai ki ye aam jaandaaron se is mayne mein alag hain ki ye haanikaarik evn kashtadayak hote hain.
Inhen sankhya ke saath isliye spasht kiya gaya hai, kyonki inki haani alag-alag tarah ki hai aur haani ke maamle mein inke jaise jo bhi jaanvar honge, woh inke hukm mein honge aur unhen bhi unki haani ke maddenzar maar diya jayega. Na to haram kshetr mein we bach sakte hain aur na ehraam ki awastha mein unke liye koi raahat hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4544: Na kameej pahne, na saafe baandhe, na paajaame pahne, na sarposh waala jaama pahne aur na moza pahne. Haan, yadi kisi ke paas joote na hon to moze pahan sakta hai, lekin unhen takhnon ke neeche tak kaat le.

Abdullah bin umar- radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki ek vyakti ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Aadmi ehraam ki awastha mein kaun-se kapre pahan sakta hai? To Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah na kameej pahne, na saafe baandhe, na paajaame pahne, na sarposh waala jaama pahne aur na moza pahne. Haan, yadi kisi ke paas joote na hon to moze pahan sakta hai, lekin unhen takhnon ke neeche tak kaat le, tatha aisa koi kapra na pahne jismen kesar athva wars (ek prakaar ki sugandh) laga ho. Tatha bukhaari ki riwayat mein haih stri niqaab na pahne aur na dastaane pahne.

Sahaaba -radiyallahu anhum- ko maaloom tha ki ehraam ki wesh-bhoosha saamaany sthitiyon se alag hoti hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki ek vyakti ne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha ki ehraam ki awastha mein kaun-kaun se wastr pahne ja sakte hain.
Lekin choonki uchit yeh tha ki un wastron ke baare mein poochha jaata, jinse ehraam ki awastha mein bachna hota hai, kyonki woh ginti ki chand cheezen hain aur phir Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko saargarbhit shabdon mein baat rakhne ki kshamta pradaan ki gai thi, isliye uttar mein un wastron ka ullekh kar diya, jinse ehraam ki awastha mein bachna hota hai aur shesh cheezen apni asal awastha par rahte hue halaal maani jayengi. Is tarah dekha jaye to aapka yeh uttar bara jnaawardhak hai.
Aapne prashn karne waale ko woh wastr gina diye, jo ehraam ki awastha mein haraam hain, yeh ingit karte hue ki inmen se har kapre ke hukm mein us jaise any kapre bhi a jayenge. Aapne kaha :
Aadmi ehraam ki awastha mein kurta nahin pahnega aur isi tarah har us kapre se bachega, jise kaatne ke baad shareer ke maap ke hisaab se silvaya jaye. Pagri aur burnus (ek wastr jo shareer ke saath-saath sar ko bhi dhaanp leta hai) nahin pahnega. Yahi hukm har us kapre ka hai, jo sar dhaanpne ka kaam kare aur sar se sata hua ho. Paajaama nahin pahnega aur isi tarah dastaana aadi har us wastr se bachega, jo shareer ya uske kisi ek ang ko dhaanpta ho. Chaahe woh sila hua ho ya chaaron or se gherkar dhaanpne waala. Moze aadi bhi nahin pahnega, jo pairon ko eriyon tak dhaanpte hon, chaahe sooti ke hon ya oon ke ya phir chamre aadi ke.
Haan, yadi kisi ko ehraam baandhte samay joote na mil saken, to moze pahan sakta hai, lekin unhen eriyon ke neeche se kaatkar jooton ki tarah bana lega.
Phir aapne kuchh laabh ki baaten bata deen, jo sawaal mein nahin theen, lekin us samay unhen bataya jaana aawashyak tha. Aapne bata diya ki kaun-si cheez stri tatha purush donon ke liye samaan roop se haraam hai. Farmaya : Aadmi koi aisa sila hua ya bina sila hua wastr aadi nahin pahnega, jismen zaafraan athva wars laga hua ho. Daraasal iske zariye aapne har tarah ki khushbu se bachne ka aadesh de diya. Phir is baat ka ullekh karte hue ki striyon ke liye chehra dhaanpna tatha apne haathon ko kisi cheez mein ghusaakar chhupaana jayaz nahin hai, farmaya : "Aurat na naqaab lagayegi aur na hi dastaana pahnegi."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4545: Main dekh raha hoon ki tum sab ke svapn antim saat raaton par ekmat ho gae hain. Isliye jise is raat ki talaash ho, woh antim saat raaton mein talaash kare.

Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki : Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke kuchh sahaaba ko svapn mein dikhaai diya ki shab-e-qadr (Ramzan ki) antim saat raaton mein hai. Ispar aapne farmaya : "Main dekh raha hoon ki tum sab ke svapn antim saat raaton par ekmat ho gae hain. Isliye jise is raat ki talaash ho, woh antim saat raaton mein talaash kare."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke kuchh saathiyon ne sapna dekha ki shab-e-qadr Ramzan maheene ki antim saat raaton mein hua karti hai. Atah Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Main dekh raha hoon ki tumhaare svapn Ramzan ki antim das tithiyon ke baare mein sahmat hain. Isliye jiske andar is raat ko paane ki ichchha tatha chaahat ho, woh adhik se adhik achchhe karm ke saath is raat ko dhoondhne ka prayaas kare. Kyonki iske antim saat tithiyon mein hone ki sanbhaavna adhik hai. Jnaat ho ki antim saat raaten Ramzan maheene ke tees din ke hone ki sthiti mein chaubeesveen raat se shuru hoti hain aur unteesav din ke hone ki sthiti mein teeesveen raat se shuru hoti hain.

Shab-e-qadr ki fazeelat aur use talaash karne ki prerna.
Allah ki hikmat evn daya ka taqaaza yeh hua ki is raat ko chhupaakar rakha jaye, taaki iski talab mein log khoob ibaadat kiya karen aur unhen bara pratiphal praapt ho sake.
Shab-e-qadr Ramzan ki antim das raaton mein se koi ek raat hua karti hai. Is baat ki aasha adhik hai ki antim saat raaton mein se koi ek raat ho.
Shab-e-qadr Ramzan ki antim das raaton mein se koi ek raat hai. Isi raat mein Allah ne apne Nabi Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- par Qur'an utaara aur use barkat, sammaan aur usmen kiye gae achchhe kaaryon ke pratiphal ke maamle mein ek hazaar raaton se behtar qaraar diya.
Is raat ko lailtul qadr ya to iski fazeelat evn pratishtha ki bina par kaha gaya hai. Arbi mein kaha jaata hai : "فلان عظيم القدر" Yaani amuk bari pratishthit vyakti hai. Is hisaab se yahaan "الليلة" Ka sanbandh "القدْر" Ke saath wisheshy tatha wisheshan waala sanbandh hai. Yaani pratishthi raatri.Uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : "إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مُبَارَكَةٍ" [soora dukhaan : 3] yaani hamne ise ek barkat waali raat mein utaara hai. Aisa bhi ho sakta hai ki lailtul qadr mein aya hua qadr shabd taqdeer ke arth mein ho. Is paristhiti mein lailtul qadr ke donon shabdon ka sanbandh ek samay ka usmen ghatit hone waali cheezon ke saath sanbandh hai. Yaani ek aisi raat hai, jismen saal bhar hone waali ghatnaaon ka nirdhaaran kar diya jaata hai. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : "فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ" [soora dukhaan : 4] yaani is raat har sudrirh kaary ka nirnay kar diya jaata hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4546: Jab raat idhar se a jaye aur din udhar se chala jaye, to roza kholne ka samay ho gaya.

Umar bin khattaab- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jab raatri idhar se a jaye aur din udhar se chala jaye, to jaan lo ki iftaar ka samay ho gaya.

Shareeyat ke anusaar roze ka samay fajr nikalne se sooraj doobne tak hai.
Yahi kaaran hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apni ummat ko bataya ki jab poorab ki or raat a jaye aur pashchim ki or se din wida ho jaye, yaani sooraj doob jaye, jaisa ki ek riwayat mein hai : "Jab idhar se raat a jaye aur udhar se din wida ho jaye aur sooraj doob jaye, to roza torne ka samay ho jaata hai." To rozaadaar iftaar ke samay mein prawesh kar jaata hai, jisse wilanb na kewal yeh ki uchit nahin hai, balki doshpoorn bhi hai. Iftaar mein jaldi karna chahiye, taaki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke aadesh ka paalan ho sake, sanpoorn roop se aapka anusran ho sake, ibaadat ke samay tatha bina ibaadat ke samay ke beech antar ho sake aur nafs ko uska haq yaani halaal wastuon ko bhog karne ka avsar diya ja sake.
Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke shabd "فقد أفطر الصائم" Ke do arth ho sakte hain :
Ka- ya to iska matlab yeh hai ki samay ho jaane ke kaaran rozedaar ne iftaar kar liya, yadyapi usne kuchh khaya-piya na ho. Aise mein kuchh hadeeson mein iftaar jaldi karne ki jo prerna aai hai, uska arth hai amli roop se roza iftaar karne mein jaldi karna, taaki sharai arth ke muwaafiq ho jaye.
Kha- ya phir iska arth yeh hai ki rozaadaar iftaar ke samay ke andar prawesh kar gaya. Is soorat mein bhi iftaar jaldi karne ki prerna ka arth wahi hoga. Yahi arth behtar maaloom hota hai aur iski pushti Bukhari ki is riwayat se bhi hoti hai : "Iftaar halaal ho gaya."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4547: Paanch oqiya se kam (chaandi) mein zakat nahin hai, paanch se kam oont mein zakat nahin hai aur paanch wasaq se kam (ann) mein zakat nahin hai.

Abu saeed khudri- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah paanch oqiya se kam (chaandi) mein zakat nahin hai, paanch se kam oont mein zakat nahin hai aur paanch wasaq se kam (ann) mein zakat nahin hai.

Zakat daraasal dhanvaanon ki or se nirdhanon ko diya jaane waala ek sahaara aur sahyog hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki zakat aise logon se nahin li jaati, jinke paas thora bahut dhan ho aur jo dhani na samjhe jaate hon.
Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne zakat waajib hone ke liye dhan ki nimn seema nirdhaarit kar di hai. Jo usse kam dhan ka maalik ho, woh nirdhan hai aur usse kuchh nahin liya jayega.
Sone ke maalik par us samay tak zakat waajib nahin hogi, jab tak uske paas paanch ooqiya sona na ho. Yaad rahe ki ek ooqiya chaalees dirham ka hota hai. Is tarah, sone ka nisaab do sau dirham hua, jo paanch sau navve graam ke baraabar hota hai.
Oont ke maalik par us samay tak zakat waajib nahin hai, jab tak uske paas paanch ya usse adhik oont na hon. Isse kam oonton mein zakat nahin hai.
Jabki anaaj tatha phal ke maalik par us samay tak zakat waajib nahin hai, jab tak paanch wasaq anaaj athva phal na ho. Ek wasaq saath saa ka hota hai. Is tarah galla evn phal ka nisaab teen sau saa hua.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4548: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mainne jaahileeyat ke zamaane mein mannat maani thi ki main masjide haraam mein ek raat (ek riwayat ke mutaabik ek divseey) aitikaaf karunga, iske baare mein aap kya kahte hain? Aapne farmayaah apni mannat poori karo.

Umar bin khattaab- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Mainne jaahileeyat ke zamaane mein mannat maani thi ki main masjide haraam mein ek raat (ek riwayat ke mutaabik ek divseey) aitikaaf karunga, iske baare mein aap kya kahte hain? Aapne farmayaah apni mannat poori karo.

Umar bin khattaab -radiyallahu anhu- ne jaahiliyat ke yug mein masjide haraam mein ek raat etekaaf karne ki mannat maani thi. Unhonne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se is mannat ke hukm ke baare poochha, to aapne mannat poori karne ka aadesh diya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4549: Jab tum (Ramzan ka) chaand dekho, to roza rakho aur jab (shavvaal ka) chaand dakho, to roza rakhna band kar do. (Aur) agar aakaash baadal se dhaka hua ho, to uska andaaza laga lo. (Yaani maheene ke tees deen poore kar lo.

Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Jab tum (Ramzan ka) chaand dekho, to roza rakho aur jab (shavvaal ka) chaand dakho, to roza rakhna band kar do. (Aur) agar aakaash baadal se dhaka hua ho, to uska andaaza laga lo. (Yaani maheene ke tees deen poore kar lo."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne Ramzan maheena daakhil hone aur uske nikalne ki nishaani bayaan karte hue farmaya hai : Jab tum Ramzan maheene ka chaand dekh lo, to roza rakho. Agar baadal chhaye rahne ya beech mein koi rukaawat hone ke kaaran chaand nazar na a sake, to shaabaan maheene ke tees din poore kar lo. Isi tarah jab shavvaal ka chaand dekho, to roza rakhna band kar do. Agar baadal chhaye rahne ya beech mein koi rukaawat hone ke kaaran chaand nazar na a sake, to Ramzan maheene ke tees din poore kar lo.

Maheene ke aaranbh hone ke sanbandh mein chaand dekhne par bharosa kiya jayega, hisaab par nahin.
Ibn-e-munzir ne ijma naqal kiya hai ki agar chaand na dikhe, to kewal hisaab ke aadhaar par roza rakhna waajib nahin hoga.
Baadal aadi ke kaaran chaand nazar na aane par shaabaan ke tees din poore karna zaroori hai.
Chaand ka maheena 29 ya 30 din ka hi hota hai.
Agar baadal aadi ke kaaran shavvaal ka chaand dekha na ja sake, to Ramzan ke tees roze poore karna waajib hai.
Kisi aise sthaan par maujood vyakti ko, jahaan roze ke sanbandh musalmaanon ko sahi soochna pradaan karne waala koi na ho, khud jaagruk rahna chahiye aur svayn apne chaand dekhne ya kisi wishvast vyakti ke dekhne par bharosa karke roza rakhna aur torna chahiye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4550: Agar mujhe pahle woh baat maaloom ho gai hoti, jo baad mein maaloom hui, to main saath mein qurbaani ka jaanvar na laata tatha yadi main qurbaani ka jaanvar na laya hota, to halaal ho jaata.

Jaabir bin abdullah- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur aapke sahaaba ne Hajj ka ehraam baandha. Haalaanki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur talha- radiyallahu anhu- ko chhorkar kisi ke paas qurbaani ka jaanvar nahin tha. Isi beech ali- radiyallahu anhu- yaman se aye aur bole ki main bhi usi ka ehraam baandhta hoon, jiska ehraam Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne baandha hai.
