Phir Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apne saathiyon ko aadesh diya ki jiske paas qurbaani ka jaanvar na ho woh apne Hajj ke ehraam ko Umrah ke ehraam mein badal den aur tawaaf karke baal chhote kar len evn halaal ho jayen. Aise mein logon ne kahaah kya ham sanbhog ke fauran baad mina chale jayen?
Iski soochna Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko mili, to farmayaah agar mujhe pahle woh baat maaloom ho gai hoti, jo baad mein maaloom hui to main saath mein qurbaani ka jaanvar na laata tatha yadi main qurbaani ka jaanvar na laya hota to halaal ho jaata.
Tatha aaisha- radiyallahu anhuma- ko maasik dharm a gaya, to kaabe ke tawaaf ko chhorkar Hajj ke saare kaary kar liye. Phir jab paak ho gaeen aur kaabe ka tawaaf kar chukeen to kahne lageen ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Aap yahaan se Hajj aur Umrah karke waapas honge aur main kewal Hajj karke lautoongi? To abdur rahmaan bin abu bakr ko aadesh diya ki unhen tanaeem naami sthaan tak le jaao. Is tarah unhonne Hajj ke baad Umrah kar liya.

Jaabir bin abdullah -radiyallahu anhuma- Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke Hajj ka wivran prastut karte hue karte hain ki aap tatha aapke saathiyon ne Hajj ka talbiya pukaara. Haalaanki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aur talha bin ubaidullah ke atirikt kisi ke saath qurbaani ka jaanvar nahin tha. Isi beech, ali -radiyallahu anhu-, jo yaman mein the, a gae. Woh shareeyat ki bari achchhi samajh rakhte the. Iska ek udaahran yeh hai ki unhonne apne ehraam ko Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke ehraam ke saath lanbit rakh diya tha.
Jab sab log makka pahunche, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unhen aadesh diya ki Hajj ke ehraam ko Umrah ke liye badal len. Phir Umrah hi ke liye tawaaf tatha sai karen aur uske baad baal chhote karva len aur poore taur par halaal ho jayen. Yeh aadesh un logon ke liye tha, jo saath mein qurbaani ka jaanvar nahin laye the.
Jahaan tak un logon ki baat hai, jo saath mein qurbaani ka jaanvar laye the aur jinmen khud Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- shaamil the, to we tawaaf evn sai ke baad apne ehraam par baaqi rahe.
Aise mein, jin logon ko Hajj ka ehraam badalkar Umrah ka karne ko kaha gaya tha, unhonne aashchary vyakt karte hue kaha ki yeh kaise ho sakta hai ki ham halaal ho jayen aur apni patniyon se sanbhog karen aur phir uske kuchh hi baad Hajj ka talbiya kahte hue mina ki or jayen?
Jab Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko unki is baat ki soochna mili aur pata chala ki ehraam torna unpar bhaari par raha hai, to unhen itmeenaan dilaate hue farmaya :
Agar mujhe pahle woh baat maaloom ho gai hoti, jo baad mein maaloom hui, to main bhi saath mein qurbaani ka jaanvar na laata, jiske kaaran main tum logon ke saath halaal na ho saka aur aaj main bhi tumhaare saath halaal ho jaata. Aapki is baat se log santusht ho gae aur unki bechaini jaati rahi.
Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ko makka mein prawesh karte samay maahvaari a gai thi, isliye unhonne Hajj-e-qiraan kiya. Kyonki, maahvaari ke kaaran woh kaaba ka tawaaf nahin kar sakeen. Magar haan, tawaaf evn sai ke atirikt Hajj ke saare kaary unhonne kiye.
Phir jab woh paak hueen aur kaaba ka tawaaf kar chukeen, jo ki Hajj ka ek bhaag hai, to unke man mein asantushti ki bhaavna paida hui. Kyonki adhiktar sahaaba ne, jinmen Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki patniyaan bhi shaamil theen, Hajj ke kaary alag se aur Umrah ke kaary alag se kiye the, jabki unka Umrah Hajj mein daakhil ho chuka tha. Anttah unhonne kah hi diya ki ai Allah ke Rasool, aap Hajj evn Umrah ke saath waapas honge aur main kewal Hajj ke saath waapas hoongi?
Yeh sun aapne unka dil rakhte hue unke bhaai abdur rahmaan ko aadesh diya ki unko tanaeem le jayen. Is tarah, unhonne Hajj ke baad Umrah kiya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4555: Allah tumhaare roop aur tumhaare dhanon ko nahin dekhta, balki tumhaare dilon aur karmon ko dekhta hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Allah tumhaare roop aur tumhaare dhanon ko nahin dekhta, balki tumhaare dilon aur karmon ko dekhta hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki Allah bandon ke roop-rang aur unke shareer ko nahin dekhta ki khoobsoorat hai ya badsoorat? Svasth hai ya beemaar? Unke dhan ko bhi nahin dekhta ki kam hai ya zyaada? Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah in cheezon tatha inmen unke kam evn adhik hone par unki pakar nahin karta aur inke aadhaar par unka hisaab nahin leta. Allah unke dilon aur unmen maujood taqva, wishvaas, sachchaai aur nishtha ya phir dikhaawa aur prasiddh hone ke iraade ko dekhta hai. Isi tarah unke karmon ko dekhta hai ki sahi hain ya ghalat aur inheen baaton ke aadhaar par unko sawaab ya dand deta hai.

Dil ke sudhaar tatha use har bure gun se paak-saaf karne par dhyaan.
Dil achchha hota hai nishtha se aur amal achchha hota hai Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke anusran se. Allah ke yahaan yahi donon cheezen dekhi jaati hain aur inheen ka etbaar hai.
Insaan ko apne dhan, sundarta, shareer aur is duniya ki kisi bhi cheez ke dhokhe mein nahin aana chahiye.
Ismen antraatma ke sudhaar ki bajay zaahir ki or jhukne se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai.
4556: Nihsandeh Allah aur uske Rasool ne sharaab, mare hue jaanvar, suar aur moortiyon ko haraam kiya hai.

Jareer bin abdullah ka warnan hai ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko makka wijay ke saal makka mein kahte hue suna hai : "Nihsandeh Allah aur uske Rasool ne sharaab, mare hue jaanvar, suar aur moortiyon ko haraam kiya hai." Kisi ne kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Mare hue jaanvar ki charbi ke baare mein aapka kya aadesh hai, jise log kashtiyon par malte hain, khaalon par lagaate hain aur usse chiraag bhi jalaate hain? Aapne farmaya : "Nahin, woh bhi haraam hai." Iske baad farmaya : "Allah, yahoodiyon ko halaak kare, Allah ne unpar unki (arthaath; jaanavron ki) charbiyon ko haraam kiya, to use pighlaya, fir becha aur uska paisa khaya."

Jaabir bin abdullah radiyallahu anhuma ne makka wijay ke saal Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko makka ki dharti par kahte hue suna : Nissandeh Allah aur uske Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne sharaab, mare hue jaanvar, suar aur buton ke kray-wikray ko haraam qaraar diya hai. Poochha gaya : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya mare hue jaanvar ki charbi ko bechna halaal hai? Kyonki use kashtiyon par mala jaata hai, khaalon par uska tel lagaya jaata hai aur log uses charaagh jalaate hain. Aapne uttar diya : Yeh jayaz nahin hai. Mare hue jaanvar ki charbi ko bechna bhi haraam hai. Uske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Allah yahoodiyon ka winaash kare aur unko apni daya se door rakhe. Allah ne jab unpar charbi haraam ki, to use pighlaakar uska tel bechne lage aur uski qeemat khaane lage.

Navvi kahte hain : Mare hue jaanvar, sharaab aur suar mein se har ek ka kray-wikray haraam hai, is baat par tamaam musalmaan ekmat hain.
Qaazi kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki jis cheez ka khaana aur usse laabh uthaana jayaz nahin hai, use bechna aur uski qeemat khaana bhi jayaz nahin hai. Is hadees mein aye hue charbi ke udaahran se yeh baat spasht hai.
Ibn hajarkahte hain: Is hadees ka sandarbh is baat ki prabalta ko ingit karta hai jise adhikaansh widvaanon ne is arth mein vyaakhyayit kiya hai ki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke kathan, "Yeh haraam (nishiddh) hai" Se muraad kray-wikray hai, laabh nahin.
Kisi nishiddh wastu ko waidh banaane ke liye apnaai gai pratyek chaal awaidh hai.
Navvi kahte hain : Widvaanon ka kahna hai : Mare hue jaanavron ke vyaapaar ke saamaany nishedh mein yeh bhi shaamil hai ki yadi hamne kisi kaafir ko maara tatha kuffaar uski laash khareedna chaahen ya uske badle mein kuchh dena chaahen, to is tarah ka maamla karna bhi haraam hai. Hadees mein aya hai ki naufal bin abdullah al-makhzoomi ko musalmaanon ne khandaq ke din qatl kiya tha, aur kaaphiron ne uske shareer ke badle das hajaar dirham Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ko dene ki peshkash ki, kintu aapne ise sveekaar nahin kiya aur unhen uska shareer lauta diya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4557: Madeene mein kuchh log hain ki tumne jo bhi yaatra ki aur ghaati paar ki, woh tumhaare saath rahe. Unhen beemaari ne rok diya tha.

Abu abdullah jaabir bin abdullah ansaari- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki ham ek yuddh mein Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath the. Isi beech aapne farmayaah madeene mein kuchh log hain ki tumne jo bhi yaatra ki aur ghaati paar ki, woh tumhaare saath rahe. Unhen beemaari ne rok diya tha.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih we neki mein tumhaare saath shaamil rahe.
Tatha anas- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hainh ham Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath tabook yuddh se waapas hue to aapne kahaah madeene mein kuchh log hamaare peechhe hain. Hamne jo bhi ghaati aur waadi paar ki, we hamaare saath rahe. We daraasl kisi majboori ke kaaran hamaare saath ja nahin sake.
[ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4558: “‎kya Allah ne tumhaare liye woh cheezen nahin banaai hain, jinse tum sadqa kar sakte ho? Har tasbeeh (subhaanallah kahna) sadqa hai, har takbeer (Allahu akbar kahna) sadqa hai, har tahmeed (alhamdu lillah kahna) sadqa hai, har tahleel (la ilaaha illallah kahna) sadqa hai, bhalaai ka aadesh dena sadqa hai, buraai se rokna sadqa hai, aur tumhaare kisi ke saath waiwaahik sanbandh banaana bhi sadqa hai.‎”

Abu zar radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ke kuchh sahaaba ne Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam se kaha : He Allah ke Rasool, dhanvaan log sawaab (puny) le gae; we hamaari tarah namaz parhte hain, hamaari tarah roza rakhte hain, aur apni atirikt sanpatti se sadqa (daan) karte hain. Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne farmaya : ‎“‎kya Allah ne tumhaare liye woh cheezen nahin banaai hain, jinse tum sadqa kar sakte ho? Har tasbeeh (subhaanallah kahna) sadqa hai, har takbeer (Allahu akbar kahna) sadqa hai, har tahmeed (alhamdu lillah kahna) sadqa hai, har tahleel (la ilaaha illallah kahna) sadqa hai, bhalaai ka aadesh dena sadqa hai, buraai se rokna sadqa hai, aur tumhaare kisi ke saath waiwaahik sanbandh banaana bhi sadqa hai.‎”‎ sahaaba ne poochha : He Allah ke Rasool, kya ham apni kaamvaasna poori karte hain to usmen bhi sawaab (puny) milta hai? Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kaha : “Tumhaara kya wichaar hai yadi woh is kaamvaasna ko haraam (awaidh) roop se poori karta hai, to kya use is par gunaah nahin hota? To isi tarah, jab woh is kaamvaasna ko halaal (waidh) roop se poori kartaata hai, to use us par puny milta hai."

Kuchh nirdhan sahaaba ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aakar apni ghareebi aur apne maaldaar bhaaiyon ki tarah sadqa karke bara sawaab praapt na kar paane aur neki ke kaamon mein unke baraabar na ho paane ki shikayat ki aur kaha ki ham namaz parhte hain to woh bhi namaz parhte hain aur ham roza rakhte hain to woh bhi roza rakhte hain, lekin iske saath hi woh apne atirikt dhan mein se sadqa karke ham se aage barh jaate hain, jabki hamaare paas sadqa karne ke liye kuchh nahin hota. Atah Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unko sadqe ke kuchh aise roop bata diye, jo we kar sakte the. Farmaya : Kya Allah ne tumhaare liye sadqa karne ki raahen nikaal nahin rakhi hain? 'Subhaanallah' kahna sadqa hai, 'Allahu akbar' kahna sadqa hai, 'al-hamdu lillah' kahna sadqa hai, 'la ilaaha illallah' kahna sadqa hai, bhalaai ka aadesh dena sadqa hai, buraai se rokna sadqa hai, balki apni patni se sanbhog karna bhi sadqa hai. Sahaaba ko bara aashchary hua. Kahne lage : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Hamen apni waasna poori karne ka bhi sawaab mileg? Aapne uttar diya : Achchha yeh bataao ki agar woh haraam jagah se waasna poori kare, jaise vyabhichaar aadi mein lipt ho jaye, to gunaah hoga ya nahin? Bas isi tarah agar waasna halaal jagah se poori karta hai, to sawaab milega.

Sahaaba achchhe kaamon mein pratispardha kiya karte the aur Allah ke yahaan bara pratiphal tatha uska anugrah praapt karne ke liye utsuk raha karte the.
Satkarmon ke anek roop hote hain tatha ye pratyek us kaary ko sammilit hain jo ek musalmaan nek neeyat tatha achchhe uddeshy se karta hai.
Islam ki saralta aur sahajta yeh hai ki pratyek musalmaan ko aisa kaary mil jaata hai jisse woh Allah ki aajna ka paalan kar sake.
Navvi kahte hain : Ismen yeh pramaan hai ki waidh kaary bhi sachchi neeyton ke kaaran ibaadat ban jaate hain. Iseeliye, yadi koi vyakti apni patni ke saath shaareerik sanbandh bhi patni ka haq ada karne, Allah ke aadesh anusaar uske saath achchha jeewan bitaane, nek santaan ki kaamna karne, svayn ko ya patni ko paap se bachaane ya any kisi nek uddeshy se karta hai, to yeh bhi ibaadat ban jaata hai.
Shrota ke liye baat ko adhik spasht aur prabhaawi banaane ke liye udaahran evn tulna ka upyog karna.
4559: Poorv ke nabiyon ki waaniyon mein se jo baaten logon ko praapt hueen, unmen se ek yeh hai ki jab tere andar sharm wa haya na rahe, to jo chaahe, kar.

Abu masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Poorv ke nabiyon ki waaniyon mein se jo baaten logon ko praapt hueen, unmen se ek yeh hai ki jab tere andar sharm wa haya na rahe, to jo chaahe, kar."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki pichhle nabiyon ki ki hui jo waseeyten logon mein prachlit rahi hain aur nasl dar nasl hastaantrit hoti hui is ummat ki pahli nasl tak pahunchi hain, unmen se ek yeh hai ki jo kaam tum karna chaahte ho, use pahle dekh lo, kaam agar aisa ho ki use karne mein haya na ki jaati hai, to kar daalo. Lekin kaam agar aisa ho ki use karte hue haya ki jaati hai, to chhor do. Kyonki bure kaamon se rokne waali cheez haya hi hai. Jiske andar haya na ho, woh har ashleel aur ghalat kaam mein sanlipt ho jayega.

Haya achchhe aachran ki buniyaad hai.
Haya nabiyon ki wisheshta hai aur unheen se hastaantrit hokar aai hai.
Haya ek aisi cheez hai, jo ek musalmaan ko uske vyaktitv ko sundar banaane waale kaaryon par aamaada karti aur use kuroop banaane waali cheezon se door karti hai.
Navvi kahte hain : Yahaan jo aadesh aya hai, woh waidhta ka dyotak hai. Yaani jab tum koi kaam karne ka iraada karo, to kaam agar aisa ho ki use karte samay Allah aur logon se haya na aati ho, to kar daalo. Lekin agar haya aati ho, to mat karo. Isi par Islam ka daaromdaar hai. Is tarah samjhen ki jin waajib aur musathab kaamon ka aadesh aya ho, unhen chhorne mein haya ki jaati hai aur jin haraam aur makrooh cheezon se mana kiya gaya ho, unhen karne mein haya ki jaati hai. Jabki jayaz kaam ko karne mein haya karna bhi jayaz hai chhorne mein haya karna bhi jayaz hai. Is tarah is hadees ke dayre mein paanchon sharai praavdhaan a gae. Jabki kuchh log kahte hain ki is hadees mein diya gaya aadesh dhamki bhara hai aur iska arth yeh hai ki jab haya ki daulat tumse chheen li jaye to jo bhi tumhaare man mein aye, karo; Allah tumhen iski saza jaroor dega. Kuchh log yeh bhi kahte hain ki yahaan aadesh ka matlab soochna dena hai, arthaat jise haya na roke, woh jo chaahe, karta phirta hai.
4560: Sabhi kaaryon ka aadhaar neeyton par hai aur pratyek vyakti ko uski neeyat ke anuroop hi pratiphal milega

Umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Sabhi kaaryon ka aadhaar neeyton par hai aur insaan ko uski neeyat ke anuroop hi pratiphal milega. Atah, jiski hijrat Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye hogi, uski hijrat Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye hogi aur jiski hijrat duniya praapt karne ya kisi stri se shaadi rachaane ke liye hogi, uski hijrat usi kaam ke liye hogi, jiske liye usne hijrat ki hogi." Saheeh Bukhari ki ek riwayat ke shabd hain : "Sabhi kaaryon ka aadhaar neeyton par hai aur pratyek vyakti ko uski neeyat ke anuroop hi pratiphal milega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki saare karmon ka etbaar neeyat par hai. Yeh hukm ibaadaat tatha maamlaat roopi sabhi aamaal ke liye aam hai. Jo vyakti apne amal se kisi laabh ka iraada rakhega, use kewal woh laabh praapt hoga, sawaab nahin. Iske wipreet jo apne amal se Allah ki nikatta praapt karne ka iraada karega, use apne amal ka sawaab milega, chaahe woh amal khaane aur peene jaisa ek saadhaaram amal hi kyon na ho.

Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aamaal par neeyat ke prabhaav ko bayaan karne ke liye ek udaahran diya, jismen ham dekhte hain ki amal ka zaahiri roop ek hone ke baavjood pratiphal alag-alag hai. Aapne bataya ki jisne apni hijrat tatha maatribhoomi chhorne ke peechhe neeyat Allah ki prasannata ki praapti rakhi, uski hijrat (desh tyaag) dhaarmik hijrat hai aur use uski sahi neeyat ki wajah se sawaab milega. Iske wipreet jisne apni hijrat se saansaarik laabh jaise dhan, pad, vyavpaar aur shaadi aadi ka iraada rakha, use kewal wahi laabh praapt hoga, jise praapt karne ki usne neeyat ki thi. Achchha pratiphal tatha neki uske hisse mein nahin ayegi.

Ekhlaas ki prerna, kyonki Allah kewal usi amal ko grahan karta hai, jise uski prasannata praapt karne ke uddeshy se kiya gaya ho.
Jin aamaal ke dvaara sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ki nikatta praapt ki jaati hai, unko agar koi vyakti aadat ke taur par karta hai, use unka koi sawaab nahin milega. Unka sawaab usi samay milega, jab unko Allah ki nikatta praapt karne ke liye kiya jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4563: Islam yeh hai ki tum is baat ki gawaahi do ki Allah ke atirikt koi poojy nahin hai tatha Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke Rasool hain, namaz sthaapit karo, zakat do, ramjaan ke roze rakho tatha yadi saamarthy ho (arthaat sawaari aur raaste ka kharch uplabdh ho) to Allah ke ghar kaaba ka Hajj karo

Umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Ek din ham log Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas baithe hue the ki achaanak ek vyakti prakat hua. Uske wastr ati safed evn baal bahut kaale the. Uske shareer mein yaatra ka koi prabhaav bhi nahin dikh raha tha aur hammen se koi use pahchaan bhi nahin raha tha l woh Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saamne baith gaya aur apne donon ghutne aapke ghutnon se mila liye aur donon hatheliyaan apne donon raanon par rakh leen. Phir bola : Ai Muhammad! Mujhe bataaiye ki Islam kya hai? Aapne uttar diya : "Islam yeh hai ki tum is baat ki gawaahi do ki Allah ke atirikt koi poojy nahin hai tatha Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke Rasool hain, namaz sthaapit karo, zakat do, ramjaan ke roze rakho tatha yadi saamarthy ho (arthaat sawaari aur raaste ka kharch uplabdh ho) to Allah ke ghar kaaba ka Hajj karo." Usne kaha : Aapne sahi bataya. Umar radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki hamen aashchary hua ki yeh kaisa vyakti hai, jo poochh bhi raha hai aur phir svayn uski pushti bhi kar raha hai?! Usne phir kaha : Mujhe bataaiye ki eemaan kya kya hai? Aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne pharmaya : "Eemaan yeh hai ki tum wishvaas rakho Allah, uske pharishton, uski pustakon, uske rasoolon, antim din tatha wishvaas rakho bhaagy par achchhi ho ya buri." Us vyakti ne kaha : Aapne sahi farmaya. Iske baad usne kaha ki mujhe bataaiye ki ehsaan kya hai? Aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne uttar diya : "Allah ki ibaadat is tarah karo, jaise tum use dekh rahe ho. Yadi Allah ko dekhne ki kalpana utpann na ho sake to (kam-se-kam yeh dhyaan rahe) ki woh tumhen dekh raha hail" Usne phir poochha : Mujhe bataaiye ki qayaamat kab ayegi? Aapne farmaya : "Jisse prashn kiya gaya hai woh (is wishay mein) prashn karne waale se adhik nahin jaanta." Usne kaha : To phir mujhe qayaamat ki nishaaniyaan hi bata deejiye? Aapne kaha : "Qayaamat ki nishaani yeh hai ki daasiyaan apne maalik ko janm dene lagen aur nange pair, nange badan, nirdhan aur bakriyon ke charvaahe, apne oonche-oonche mahlon par garv karne lagen." (Umar radiyallahu anhu kahte hainn ki) phir woh vyakti chala gaya. Jab kuchh kshan beet gae to Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne poochha : "Ai umar! Kya tum jaante ho ki yeh sawaal karne waala vyakti kaun tha?" Mainne kaha : Allah aur uske Rasool hi bhali-bhaanti jaante hain. To aapne pharmaya : "Yeh jibreel (alaihissalaam) the, jo tumhen tumhaara dharm sikhaane aye the."

Umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhu bata rahe hain ki jibreel alaihissalaam sahaaba ke paas ek anjaan vyakti ka roop dhaaran karke aye. Unki kuchh wisheshtayen is prakaar theen ki unke wastr ati safed evn baal bahut kaale the. Unke shareer par yaatra ka koi prabhaav, jaise thakaawat, dhool-mitti, baalon ka bikhra hua hona aur kapron ka maila-kuchaila hona aadi nahin dikh raha tha. Wahaan upasthit koi vyakti unko pahchaan bhi nahin pa raha tha. Us samay sahaaba Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas baithe hue the. Woh aapke saamaane ek widyaarthi ki tarah baith gae aur iske baad aapse Islam ke baare mein poochha, to aapne jo jawaab diya, usmen donon gawaahiyon ka iqraar, paanch waqton ki namaazon ki sthaapna, zakat uske haqdaaron ko dena, Ramzan maas ke roze rakhna aur saamarthy rakhne waale ke liye Allah ke ghar kaaba ka Hajj karna shaamil tha.

Jawaab sun poochhne waale ne kaha : Aapne sach kaha hai. Ispar sahaaba ko aashchary hua ki inka poochhna yeh darsha raha hai ki woh jaante nahin hain, lekin phir woh aapki baat ki pushti bhi kar rahe hain.

Phir unhonne aapse eemaan ke baare mein poochha, to aapne jo jawaab diya, usmen eemaan ke chhah stanbhon par wishvaas rakhna shaamil hai, jo is prakaar hain : Allah ke astitv aur uske gunon par wishvaas rakhna, use apne kaaryon jaise srishti karna aadi mein akela maanna aur ekmaatr usi ko ibaadat ka haqdaar jaanna, is baat par wishvaas rakhna ki farishte, jinko Allah ne noor se paida kiya hai, uske sammaanit bande hain, jo Allah ki awajna nahin karte tatha uske aadeshon ka paalan karte hain, Allah ki or se rasoolon par utarne waali kitaabon, jaise Qur'an, tauraat aur injeel aadi par wishvaas rakhna, insaanon ko Allah ka deen pahunchaane waale rasoolon, jaise nooh, ibraaheem, moosa, eesa aur antim Nabi Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam, par wishvaas rakhna, aakhirat ke din par wishvaas rakhna, jismen maut ke baad ki barazkhi zindgi ke saath-saath is baat par wishvaas bhi shaamil hai ki insaan ko maut ke baad dobaara jeewit karke uthaya jayega aur uska hisaab wa kitaab hoga, jiske baad uska thikaana ya to Jannat hoga ya phir Jahannam tatha is baat par wishvaas rakhna ki Allah ne apne poorv jnaan aur apni hikmat ke anusaar saari cheezon ka andaaza karke unko likh rakha hai aur baad mein woh saari cheezen uske iraade se uske andaaze ke mutaabiq hi saamne aati hain aur wahi unki rachna bhi karta hai. Phir unhonne aapse ehsaan ke baare mein poochha, to aapne bataya ki ehsaan yeh hai ki insaan Allah ki ibaadat is tarah kare, goya woh Allah ko dekh raha hai. Agar woh is sthaan tak pahunch na sake, to Allah ki ibaadat yeh sochkar kare ki Allah use dekh raha hai. Pahla sthaan darshan ka hai. Yeh sabse ooncha sthaan hai. Jabki doosra sthaan dhyaan mein rakhne ka hai.

Phir unhonne aapse poochha ki qayaamat kab ayegi, to Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki qayaamat kab ayegi, yeh baat un baaton mein se hai, jinko Allah ne kisi ko nahin bataya hai. Atah iski jaankaari kisi ke paas nahin hai. Na jisse poochha gaya hai, uske paas aur na poochhne waale ke paas.

Phir unhonne aapse qayaamat ki nishaaniyon ke baare mein poochha, to aapne bataya ki uski ek nishaani yeh hai ki daasiyon tatha unki santaanon ki bahulta hogi ya phir yeh ki bachche apni maataaon ki bahut zyaada awajna karne lagenge aur unke saath daasiyon jaisa vyavhaar karenge. Doosri nishaani yeh hai ki aakhiri zamaane mein bakriyon ke charvaahon tatha nirdhan logon ko bari maatra mein dhan pradaan kiye jayenge aur we sundar tatha mazboot bhavnon ke maale mein ek-doosre par abhimaan karenge.

Ant mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki poochhne waale jibreel the, jo sahaaba ko Islam sikhaane ke liye aye the.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka aadarsh aachran ki aap apne saathiyon ke saath ghul-mil kar baithte the.
Kuchh poochhne waale ke saath narmi bhara vyavhaar karna aur use apne paas bithaana chahiye, taaki woh bina kisi bhay evn bina sankoch ke jo kuchh poochhna chaahe, poochh sake.
Shikshak ke saath shisht vyavhaar ka khayaal rakhna chahiye. Ham yahaan dekhte hain ki jibreel alaihissalaam Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saamne adab ke saath beth gae, taaki aapse jnaan praapt kar saken.
Islam ke paanch aur eemaan ke chhah stanbh hain.
Jab Islam tatha eemaan donon shabd ek saath ayen, to Islam ki vyaakhya zaahiri cheezon se ki jayegi aur eemaan ki vyaakhya aantrik cheezon se.
Deen ke alag-alag star athva shreniyaan hain. Pahla star Islam hai, doosra eemaan hai aur teesra star ehsaan hai. Ehsaan ka darja sabse ooncha hai.
Svabhaawik yeh hai ki prashn karne waale ke paas jaankaari nahin hoti aur woh ajnaanta ke kaaran hi prashn karta hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki sahaaba ko unke prashn aur phir uttar ki pushti karne par aashchary hua.
Wibhinn cheezon ka warnan karte samay kram adhik mahatvapoorn se kam mahatvapoorn ki or jaane ka hona chahiye. Kyonki aapne Islam ki vyaakhya karte samay aaranbh donon gawaahiyon se kiya hai aur eemaan ki vyaakhya karte samay aaranbh Allah par wishvaas se kiya hai.
Deen ka jnaan rakhne waalon se aisi cheezon ke baare mein bhi poochha ja sakta hai, jinko poochhne waala jaanta ho, taaki doosre log bhi un cheezon ko jaan jayen.
Qayaamat kab ayegi, is baat ki jaankaari Allah ne apne paas rakhi hai.
4564: Jo cheez tumhen sandeh mein daale, use chhorkar woh akhtiyaar karo, jo sandeh mein na daale. Kyonki sachchaai itmeenaan hai aur jhooth shak wa shubah hai.

Abul haura saadi kahte hain : Mainne hasan bin ali radiyallahu anhuma se poochha : Aapne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se kya yaad kiya hai? Unhonne uttar diya : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se yeh yaad kiya hai : "Jo cheez tumhen sandeh mein daale, use chhorkar woh akhtiyaar karo, jo sandeh mein na daale. Kyonki sachchaai itmeenaan hai aur jhooth shak wa shubah hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aise kaaryon evn kathnon se door rahne ka aadesh diya hai, jinke baare mein sandeh ho ki warjit hain ya nahin? Halaal hain ya haraam? Insaan ko aisi cheezen apnaani chahiye, jinke achchhe evn halaal hone ka yaqeen ho. Kyonki unse insaan ka dil santusht rahta hai. Jabki sandeh waali cheezen insaan ke dil ko bechain aur pareshaan rakhti hain.

Musalmaan par laazim hai ki apne tamaam maamlaat ki buniyaad yaqeen par rakhe aur soojh-boojh evn aaghi ke saath deen par amal kare.
Sandigdh cheezon mein parne ki manaahi.
Agar aap itmeenaan aur sukoon chaahte hain, to sandigdh cheezon se bachen.
Allah sarvashaktimaan apne bandon ke prati dayaalu aur kripaalu hai, kyonki usne unhen aise kaam karne ka aadesh diya hai jo man aur dil ko shaanti pradaan karte hain aur unhen aise kaam karne se mana kiya hai jo bechaini aur bhram ka kaaran bante hain.
[ise tirmizi, nasai aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
4565: Aap hamen aadesh dete ki jab ham safar mein hon to teen din aur teen raat peshaab, paakhaana aur neend ke baad apne moze na utaaren, magar janaabat ki baat doosri hai.

Zirr bin hubaish se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Main mozon par masah ke wishay mein poochhne ke liye safvaan bin assaal muraadi ke paas gaya. Unhonne aane ka kaaran jaanna chaaha to mainne bataya ki jnaan praapt karne ke liye aya hoon. Ispar woh bole : Jnaan praapt karne waale se prasann hokar farishte uske sammaan mein apne pankh bichha dete hain. Mainne kaha : Mere dil mein peshaab aur paakhaane ke baad mozon par masah ke baare mein sandeh paida ho gaya hai. Choonki aap Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke sahaaba mein se hain, isliye aapke paas yeh poochhne ke liye aya hoon ki kya aapne is baare mein Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kuchh kahte hue suna hai? Kaha : Haan, aap hamen aadesh dete ki jab ham safar mein hon to teen din aur teen raat peshaab, paakhaana aur neend ke baad apne moze na utaaren, magar janaabat ki baat doosri hai. Mainne kaha ki kya aapne Nabi ko prem ke baare mein kuchh kahte suna hai? Kaha : Haan, ham Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath ek safar mein the. Ham aapke paas hi the ki ek dehaati ne oonchi aawaaz mein aapse kaha ki 'ai Muhammad!' Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bhi use usi jaisi aawaaz mein uttar diya ki 'haan, bolo.' hamne usse kaha : Tera bura ho, zara dheemi aawaaz mein baat kar le, tu Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas hai aur tujhe isse mana kiya gaya hai. Us dehaati ne kaha : Allah ki qasam! Main dheemi aawaaz mein baat nahin karoonga. Dehaati ne kaha : Aadmi kuchh logon se prem karta hai aur (karm ke maamle mein) unke nikat pahunch nahin paata? To Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kaha : Aadmi qayaamat ke din usi ke saath hoga, jisse prem karta hai. Is tarah, woh hamen hadees sunaate gae, yahaan tak ki unhonne pashchim ki or sthit ek dvaar ka zikr kiya, jiski chauraai itni hai ki ek sawaar uski chauraai mein chaalees ya sattar saal chalta rahe.

Zirr bin hubaish, safvaan bin assaal radiyallahu anhu ke paas mozon par masah ke baare mein poochhne ke liye aye. To safvaan radiyallahu anhu ne kaha : Ai zirr, tum kis liye aye ho? Zirr ne kaha : Jnaan praapt karne ke liye. Unhonne kaha : Farishte jnaan praapt karne waale se prasann hokar aur uske kaam ka sammaan karte hue, uske liye apne pankh bichha dete hain. Zirr ne kaha : Mere dil mein paakhaane aur peshaab ke baad mozon par masah ke baare mein sandeh paida ho gaya hai, aur aap Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saathiyon mein se hain, isliye main aapse yeh poochhne aya hoon ki kya aapne Nabi ko is baare mein kuchh kahte hue suna hai? Safvaan ne kaha : Haan, aap hamen aadesh dete the ki jab ham safar mein hon to teen din aur teen raat peshaab, paakhaana aur neend ke baad apne moze na utaaren. Haan, magar janaabat ki baat doosri hai kyonki janaabat ke baad isko utaarna aniwaary hai. Mainne kaha ki kya aapne unhen prem ke baare mein kuchh kahte suna hai? Unhonne kaha : Haan, ham Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath ek safar mein the. Ham aapke paas hi the ki ek dehaati ne aapko buland aawaaz se pukaara : Ai Muhammad! To aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bhi usi ki aawaaz ke qareeb buland aawaaz mein jawaab diya : Idhar aao. Hamne usse kaha : Teri kharaabi ho! Apni aawaaz dheemi rakh, kyonki tu Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas hai aur tujhe aapke paas aawaaz buland karne se mana kiya gaya hai. To usne akkharta dikhaate hue kaha : Allah ki qasam, main apni aawaaz dheemi nahin karoonga. Dehaati ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aadmi nek logon se prem karta hai, lekin unke jaise karm nahin kar paata? To Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kaha : Aadmi qayaamat ke din usi ke saath hoga, jisse woh prem karta hai. Zirr ne kaha : Phir safvaan hamen hadees sunaate rahe, yahaan tak ki unhonne shaam ki disha mein sthit tauba ke ek dvaar ka zikr kiya, jise Allah ne usi din banaya tha, jis din aakaashon aur dharti ko banaya tha, jiski chauraai mein ek sawaar ko chaalees ya sattar saal chalna par jaye, aur jo us samay tak band nahin hoga, jab tak ki sooraj pashchim se na nikal aye.

Jnaan praapt karne ki fazeelat, jnaan arjit karne waale ki mahaan pratishtha aur farishton ka uska sammaan karna.
Taabeeen rahimhumullah sahaaba radiyallahu anhum se jnaan praapt karne ke bare utsuk hua karte the.
Mozon par masah jayaz hai. Uski avdhi musaafir ke liye teen din evn teen raaten, tatha thahre hue vyakti ke liye ek din evn ek raat hai.
Mozon par masah kewal chhoti naapaaki ke samay hoga.
Koi poochhne waala vyakti aalim (jaankaar) se yeh poochh sakta hai ki uski daleel koi nass (Qur'an evn hadees ka uddharan) hai athva uska apna tark evn ijtihaad aur jaankaar ko is par koi harj ya bura nahin mahsoos karna chahiye.
Widvaanon tatha sadaachaariyon ke saath adab evn shishtata ka vyavhaar karna, tatha jnaan ki sabhaaon mein aawaaz dheemi rakhna.
Ajnaan vyakti ko uttam shishtaachaar tatha aachran ke niymon ki shiksha dena.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki sahansheelta, achchhe aachran, tatha logon ko unke jnaan aur buddhi ke anusaar sanbodhit karne ki neeti ka anusran karne ki prerna.
Mubaarakpuri kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kewal us par daya ke kaaran apni aawaaz buland ki, taaki Allah taaala ke is farmaan : {apni aawaazon ko Nabi ki aawaaz se oonchi na karo} ke kaaran uska karm nasht na ho jaye. Atah, aapne uski ajnaanta ke kaaran use kshama kar diya, aur uspar apni atyadhik karuna ke kaaran apni aawaaz itni buland kar di ki uski aawaaz ke baraabar ya usse bhi oonchi ho gai.
Nek logon ke saath rahne, unka nikatta praapt karne aur unse prem karne ka ichchhuk hona.
Navvi kahte hain : Unke saath hone se yeh aawashyak nahin ho jaata hai ki uska darja aur badla har lihaaz se unke jaisa ho.
Aasha aur ummeed ka dvaar kholna, najaat ka shubh samaachaar dena aur updesh mein komalta.
Allah ki daya ki wishaalta evn tauba ka dvaar kholna.
Tauba karne mein jaldi karne, apna muhaasba (aatm-nireekshan) karne aur Allah ki or laut aane ki prerna.
[ise tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
4566: Aadmi ka jamaat ke saath namaz parhna baazaar ya ghar mein namaz parhne ki tulna mein (puny ke maamle mein) bees se adhik darja barha hua hota hai

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, unhonne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Aadmi ka jamaat ke saath namaz parhna baazaar ya ghar mein namaz parhne ki tulna mein (puny ke maamle mein) bees se adhik darja barha hua hota hai. Iska kaaran yeh hai ki jab tummen se koi achchhi tarah wazu karta hai, phir namaz ke iraade se masjid aata hai aur namaz ke siwa koi cheez use ghar se nahin nikaalti, to masjid pahunchne tak woh jo bhi qadam uthaata hai, uske badle mein uska ek darja ooncha hota hai aur ek gunaah mitaya jaata hai. Phir jab masjid mein prawesh karta hai to jab tak namaz use roke rakhti hai, woh namaz mein hota hai. Tatha farishte tummen se kisi ke liye rahmat ki dua karte rahte hain, jab tak woh us jagah mein hota hai, jahaan namaz parhi hai. We kahte rahte hain : Ai Allah! Ispar daya kar, ai Allah! Ise kshama kar de aur ai Allah! Iski tauba kabool kar. Yeh silsila us samay tak jaari rahta hai, jab tak wahaan kisi ko kasht na de, jab tak wahaan uska wazu toot na jaye."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jab ek musalmaan jamaat ke saath namaz parhta hai, to uski woh namaz ghar ya baazaar mein parhi gai namaz se teees (23) se adhik guna uttam shumaar hoti hai. Phir aapne sabab bayaan farmaya. Aapne bataya ki jab insaan sanpoorn tareeqe se aur achchhi tarah wazu karta hai, phir masjid ki or chal parta hai, jiska uddeshy namaz parhne ke siwa kuchh aur nahin hota, to uske badle mein uska sthaan ek darja ooncha kar diya jaata hai aur uska ek gunaah mita diya jaata hai. Phir jab woh masjid mein prawesh karta hai aur namaz ki prateeksha mein baith jaata hai, to prateeksha ke dauraan bhi use namaz ka pratiphal milta rahta hai. Saath hi farishte uske liye us samay tak dua karte rahte hain, jab tak woh namaz ke sthaan mein baitha rahta hai. Farishte kahte hain : "Ai Allah! Ise kshama kar de ,ai Allah! Ispar daya kar, aur ai Allah! Iski tauba kabool kar." Yeh silsila us samay tak jaari rahta hai, jab tak uska wazu toot na jaye ya koi aisa kaam na kare, jisse insaanon ya farishton ko kasht ho.

Apne ghar ya baazaar mein akele parhi gai namaz bhi sahi hai, parantu kisi uchit kaaran ke bina jamaat chhorne ka gunaah hoga.
Masjid ke andar jamaat ke saath parhi gai namaz akele parhi gai namaz se 25, 26 ya 27 guna behtar hai.
Farishton ka ek kaam mominon ke liye dua karna bhi hai.
Wazu karke masjid jaane ka mahatv.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4568: Aadmi ke har ek jor par, har roz jismen sooraj nikalta hai, sadqa hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Aadmi ke har ek jor par, har roz jismen sooraj nikalta hai, sadqa hai. Do vyaktiyon ke beech nyay karna sadqa hai. Kisi ko uske jaanvar par sawaar hone mein ya us par uska saamaan laadne mein madad karna sadqa hai, achchhi baat sadqa hai, namaz ki or uthne waala har qadam sadqa hai aur raaste se kashtadayak wastu ko hataana bhi sadqa hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki shareeyat ka paalan karne par baadhy har musalmaan ko pratyek din uski haddi ke har jor ke badle mein ek ek nafli sadqa is baat ke shukr ke taur par karna hai ki usne use svasth aakaar diya aur uski haddiyon ke jor banaye, jinke kaaran shareer ke angon ko phailaana aur sametna sanbhav ho saka. Yeh sadqa sabhi prakaar ke naki ke kaamon se ada ho sakta hai. Zaroori nahin hai ki dhan hi kharch kiya jaye. Jaise : Do jhagar rahe vyaktiyon ke beech nyay ke saath nirnay karna aur sulah kara dena sadqa hai. Kisi aise vyakti ko, jo sawaari par charh na pa raha ho, sawaari par charha dena ya uska saamaan laad dena sadqa hai. Achchhi baat, jaise zikr, dua aur salaam aadi sadqa hain. Namaz ke liye jaate samay uthne waala har qadam sadqa hai. Raaste se kisi kasht dene waali wastu ko hata dena sadqa hai.

Insaan ki haddiyon ka juraav aur unka svasth hona Allah ki ek bahut bari nemat hai. Isliye is nemat ke shukraane ke taur par har haddi ki or se wishesh sadqa kiya jaana chahiye.
Ye nemten nirantar roop se praapt rahen, iske liye har roz Allah ka shukr ada karne ki prerna.
Nirantar roop se har roz nafal kaary evn sadqe karte rahne ki prerna.
Logon ke beech sulah karaane ki mahatta.
Apne bhaai ki madad karne ki prerna. Kyonki apne bhaai ki madad karna bhi sadqa hai.
Jamaat ke saath namaz parhne, iske liye chalkar jaane aur masjid ko aabaad karne ki prerna.
Musalmaanon ke raaston ka sammaan zaroori hai. Raaston par koi aisa kaam na kiya jaye, jisse unko kasht ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4704: ‎“‎is sansaar mein aise raho jaise ki tum ek ajanbi ho ya ek musaafir.”

Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne mere kandhe ko pakra aur farmaya : ‎“‎is sansaar mein aise raho jaise ki tum ek ajanbi ho ya ek musaafir.” tatha ibn -e- umar radiyallahu anhuma kaha karte the : “‎jab tum shaam karo to subah ki prateeksha na karo, aur jab tum subah karo to shaam ki prateeksha na karo, apne svaasthy se apne rog ke samay ke liye aur apne jeewan se apni mrityu ke samay ke liye kuchh taiyaari kar lo.‎”‎

Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma bayaan karte hain ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu  alaihi wa sallam ne unke kandhe ko pakra aur farmaya : Duniya mein aise raho jaise tum ek ajanbi aadmi ho, jo ek aisi jagah pahunch chuka ho, jahaan na rahne ka ghar ho aur na dil bahlaane ke liye aadmi. Na pariwaar ke log hon aur na rishtedaar. Kyonki yahi cheezen insaan ko uske paida karne waale se vyast rakhti hain. Balki ajanbi se bhi barhkar apne watan ki talaash mein nikla hua yaatri ban jaao. Ajanbi vyakti to kabhi-kabhi kisi ajanbi sthaan mein thahar bhi jaata hai, lekin apne watan ki or jaata hua yaatri chalta hi rahta hai. Kaheen thaharta nahin hai. Uski nazar manzil par rahti hai. Atah jis prakaar ek yaatri utni hi cheezen saath le jaana zaroori samajhta hai, jo manzil tak pahuncha den, usi prakaar ek momin duniya ke utne saadhan ekatr karna zaroori samajhta hai, jo use manzil yaani Jannat tak pahuncha den.

Chunaanche abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ne is naseehat par sanpoorn roop se amal kiya. Woh kaha karte the : Subah aye, to shaam ka intzaar mat karo aur shaam aye, to subah ka intzaar mat karo. Khud ko qabr mein dafan logon mein shumaar karo. Kyonki insaan ya to svasth rahta hai ya beemaar. Isliye beemaari ke din aane se pahle svaasthy ke dinon mein neki ke kaam kar liya karo. Svaasthy ke dinon mein neki ke kaam karte jaao ki kaheen beemaari raah na rok le. Duniya ke jeewan ka laabh uthaate hue aisi cheezen ekatr kar lo, jo maut ke baad kaam ayen.

Shiksha dete samay apnaapan dikhaane aur sachet karne ke liye guru apne shishy ke kandhe par haath rakh sakta hai.
Anurodh ke bina bhi naseehat tatha maargadarshan kiya ja sakta hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki shikshan paddhati ki ek sundarta yeh hai ki aap santoshajnak udaahran prastut kiya karte the. Maslan yahaan farmaya :  ‎“‎is sansaar mein aise raho jaise ki tum ek ajanbi ho ya ek musaafir.”
Aakhirat ke maarg par chalne waale logon ke star alag-alag hua karte hain. Tyaag ke maamle mein yaatri ka darja ajanbi se ooncha hai.
Aashayen kam rakhne aur maut ki taiyaari karne ka bayaan.
Yeh hadees aajeewika ke wichaar ko tyaagne aur saansaarik sukhon ko chhorne ka sanket nahin deti hai. Yeh hamen bas sansaar ke peechhe bhaagne se bachne ke liye protsaahit karti hai.
Achchhe karm isse pahle kar lene chahiye ki beemaari ya mrityu raasta rok de aur vyakti kuchh bhi karne mein asmarth ho jaye.
Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ki fazeelat ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki is naseehat se bahut prabhaawit hue.
Eemaan waalon ka watan Jannat hai. Isliye we is duniya mein ajanbi hain. We aakhirat ki yaatra par hain. Isliye ajanbi shahar ki kisi cheez se unhen dil nahin lagaana chahiye. Unke dil apne watan mein atke rahte hain. Is sansaar mein uska jeena kewal apni aawashyaktaaon ki poorti aur apne watan lautne ki taiyaari ke liye hona chahiye.
4706: “Aapas mein eershya mat karo, kray-wikray mein ek doosre se chhal mat karo, ek-doosre se ghrina mat karo, ek-doosre se mukh mat phero tatha kisi ke vyaapaar par vyaapaar mat karo. Allah ke bandon, aapas mein bhraatritv bhaav (bhaai-chaare) se raho.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : “Aapas mein eershya mat karo, kray-wikray mein ek doosre se chhal mat karo, ek-doosre se ghrina mat karo, ek-doosre se mukh mat phero tatha kisi ke vyaapaar par vyaapaar mat karo. Allah ke bandon, aapas mein bhraatritv bhaav (bhaai-chaare) se raho. Musalmaan, musalmaan ka bhaai hai. Woh na to us par atyaachaar karta hai, na use apmaanit karta hai, na use tuchchh samajhta hai. Taqva yahaan hai (yeh kahte samay aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne seene ki or teen baar ishaara kiya). Kisi vyakti ke bura hone ke liye yeh paryaapt hai ki woh apne Muslim bhaai ko tuchchh samjhe. Pratyek musalmaan ka rakt, sanpatti evn maan-sammaan doosre musalmaan par haraam hai.”

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne musalmaan ko apne Muslim bhaai ke saath bhalaai karne ki waseeyat ki hai aur unke prati uske kuchh kartavyon evn shishtaachaaron ko bayaan kiya hai. Jaise : Pahli waseeyat : Ek doosre se eershya na karo, arthaat tum ek-doosre ki nemat ke chhin jaane ki kaamna na karo. Doosri waseeyat : Ek doosre ke saath najash (dalaali) mat karo, arthaat tum mein se koi aisa vyakti wastu ka mooly na barhaye jo use khareedna nahin chaahta ho; balki uska uddeshy kewal wikreta ko laabh pahunchaana athva kreta ko haani pahunchaana ho. Teesri waseeyat : Aapas mein dvesh na rakho, kyonki yeh haani pahunchaane ki ichchha ka prateek tatha prem ke wiruddh hai. Haan, yeh dvesh Allah ke liye ho, to yeh waajib evn aawashyak hai. Chauthi waseeyat : Paraspar mukh pherkar ek-doosre se wilag na raho ki pratyek vyakti apne bandhu ko peeth dikhaakar use taj de aur uska bahishkaar kar de. Paanchveen waseeyat : Paraspar ek doosre ke wikray par wikray na karo ki koi vyakti jo wastu khareed chuka hai, usse kahne lage ki mere paas isse sasti ya isi qeemat mein isse uttam wastu hai. Phir paighanbar sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ek samagr updesh diya aur kaha : Ullikhit nishedhon ko chhorkar bhaaiyon ki bhaanti raho, aur sneh, narmi, karoona, maadhury, evn bhalaai ke kaaryon mein sahyog ke saath, hriday ki shuddhata tatha har sthiti mein shubhchintan karne ka prayaas karo. Is bandhutv ka taqaaza yeh hai ki : Koi apne musalmaan bhaai par atyaachaar na kare aur uska haq na maare. Koi apne musalmaan bhaai ko beshaara na chhore, jab uski madad kar sakta ho aur uspar ho rahe atyaachaar ko rok sakta ho. Isi tarah use tuchchh na jaane, chhota na samjhe ya ghrina aur tiraskaar ki drishti se na dekhe, jo hriday mein ahankaar ka parinaam hai. Iske baad Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne teen baar yeh spasht kiya ki taqva (dharmaprayanta) antarman mein sthit hota hai. Jiske hriday mein taqva hota hai, woh utkrisht aachran, Allah ke prati bhay aur satarkata ka paalan karta hai tatha woh kisi Muslim ka apmaan nahin karta. Ek musalmaan bhaai ko tuchchh jaanna hriday ke ahankaar ka parinaam hai aur yeh bure tatha nikrisht aachran ki nishaani hai. Phir paiganbar sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne zor dekar bataya ki pratyek Muslim ke liye doosre Muslim ka rakt bahaana haraam hai. Jaise koi usko jaan se maar de, zakhmi kar de ya uske saath maarpeet kare. Yahi baat uske dhan par bhi laagu hoti hai. Jaise koi awaidh roop se uska dhan harap le. Isi prakaar se uske maan-sammaan par prahaar karna bhi haraam hai. Jaise koi svayn uski athva uske wansh ki ya uske pariwaar ki ninda kare.

Eemaani bandhutv ki sabhi aawashyaktaaon ka paalan karna aur un kathnon evn kaaryon se bachna jo iske wipreet hain.
Taqva ka mool aadhaar dil mein Allah ki pahchaan, uske bhay aur uski nigraani ka samaawesh hai. Isi taqva ka parinaam sadkarm hote hain.
Pratyaksh wimukhta hriday mein taqva ki kami ka sanket deta hai.
Kisi Muslim ko kisi bhi prakaar ki haani pahunchaane se rukne ka aadesh, chaahe woh shabdon se ho ya kaaryon se.
Yeh eershya nahin hai ki ek Muslim doosre ki tarah banne ki kaamna kare, yeh chaahe bina ki woh nemat doosre se chhin jaye. Isko (arbi bhaasha mein) ghibta kahte hain, aur yeh jayaz hai, kyonki yeh nek kaaryon mein pratispardha ke liye prerit karti hai.
Manushy svabhaavtah yeh pasand nahin karta ki koi use achchhi cheezon mein peechhe chhor de. Aise mein agar woh is baat ki kaamna karta hai ki doosre ke paas maujood achchhi cheezen khatm ho jayen, to yeh eershya hai aur isse mana kiya gaya hai. Lekin yadi woh in sab mein pratispardha pasand karta hai, to yeh rashk hai aur yeh jayaz hai.
Kisi Muslim ke liye uske bhaai ke saude par sauda karne mein yeh baat daakhil nahin hai ki woh khareedaar ko bataye ki use maamla tay karte samay bara dhokha diya gaya hai. Yeh to shubhchintan hai. Shart yeh hai ki neeyat khareedne waale bhaai ka shubhchintan ho, bechne waale ko nuqsaan pahunchaana nahin. Sachchaai yeh hai ki sabhi kaary neeyton par aadhaarit hain.
Kisi Muslim ka apne Muslim bhaai ke saude par sauda karna us samay tak nahin maana jayega, jab tak wikreta aur kreta donon bechne tatha khareedne par sahmat na ho jayen aur qeemat nirdhaarit na ho jaye.
Allah ke liye ki gai ghrina, is hadees mein mana kiye gae paraspar dvesh mein shaamil nahin hai, balki aisa karna aniwaary hai aur eemaan ki sabse majboot kariyon mein se ek hai.
4709: Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai : Ek vyakti ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se kaha ki mujhe waseeyat keejiye, to aapne farmaya : "Gussa mat kiya karo." Usne kai baar apni baat dohraai aur aapne har baar yahi kaha ki "Gussa mat kiya karo."

Ek sahaabi ne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se aagrah kiya ki unko koi aisi baat batayen, jo unke liye laabhkaari ho. Atah aapne unse kaha ki woh ghussa na kiya karen. Yaani ek to ghussa dilaane waali cheezon se bachen aur doosra jab ghussa a jaye, to apne oopar niyantran rakhen. Aisa na ho ki krodh mein aakar hatya kar den, maar de ya gaali-galauj aadi kar den.

Us sahaabi ne apni baat kai baar dohraai aur aapne har baar isse adhik kuchh nahin kaha ki ghussa na kiya karo.

Is hadees mein krodh aur uska kaaran banne waali cheezon se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai. Kyonki krodh saari buraaiyon ki jar hai aur usse bachna tamaam bhalaaiyon ka srot hai.
Allah ke liye krodh, jaise Allah ki hurmaton (warjit kaam) ki avhelna par krodh, prashansneey krodh ka ek bhaag hai.
Zaroorat parne par baat ko dohraana chahiye, taaki sunne waala samajh jaye aur baat ka mahatv zehan mein baith jaye.
Widvaan vyakti se waseeyat ka aagrah karne ki fazeelat.
4714: “Kisi Muslim vyakti ka rakt bahaana kewal teen paristhitiyon mein waidh hai

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne pharmaya hai : “Kisi Muslim vyakti ka rakt bahaana kewal teen paristhitiyon mein waidh hai : Woh wiwaahit vyabhichaari ho, jaan ke badle jaan lene ki naubat a jaye aur koi apne dharm ko tyaag de tatha jamaat se alag ho jaye.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne farmaya hai ki musalmaan ka rakt bahaana haraam hai. Iski anumit kewal usi samay di ja sakti hai, jab woh nimnalikhit teen kaamon mein se koi ek kaam kar daale : Pahla kaam : Usne waidh wiwaah kar lene ke baad vyabhichaar kar daala ho. Is paristhiti mein use sangsaar karke maar dena halaal ho jaata hai. Doosra kaam : Usne jaanboojhkar evn anyaypoorvak kisi nirdosh vyakti ki jaan le li ho. Aise vyakti ko kuchh sharton ke saath qatl kar diya jayega. Teesra kaam : Woh musalmaanon ki jamaat se alag ho gaya ho. Chaahe woh poore taur par Islam dharm ko tyaag kar murtad ho jaye ya murtad to na ho, lekin Islam ke kuchh bhaag ko chhorkar jamaat se alag ho jaye, jaise widrohi, raaste mein lootpaat karne waale aur musalmaanon se yuddh karne waale jo ki khvaarij aadi hain.

In teenon kaamon ko karna haraam hai. Jo inmen se koi kaam kare, woh mrityudand ka haqdaar ban jaata hai. Mrityudand ka haqdaar ya to kufr ke kaaran banta hai, jaise Islam ka parityaag karne waala ya phir sharai dand ke taur par, jaise shaadeeshuda vyabhichaari evn jaanboojhkar kisi ki hatya karne waala.
Izzat wa aabru ki raksha karna aur apne charitr ko paak-saaf rakhna zaroori hai.
Musalmaan ka sammaan karna tatha yeh maanna ki uska rakt pawitr evn surakshit hai, aniwaary hai.
Musalmaanon ki jamaat ke saath jure rahne evn unse alag na hone ki prerna.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ke shiksha dene ki utkrisht shaili ki kabhi-kabhi aap apni baat wibhaajan ke andaaz mein rakhte the. Kyonki ek to isse saare masayal dayre mein simat aate hain aur doosra yaad karna bhi aasaan ho jaata hai.
Allah ne sharai dand apraadh rokne, samaaj ko suraksha dene aur use apraadhon se paak-saaf karne ke liye nirdhaarit kiye hain.
Sharai dand laagu karna shaasak ke adhikaar chhetr mein aata hai.
Oopar bataye gae teen kaarnon ke alaawa bhi hatya ke any kaaran hain. Haalaanki, we in teen kaarnon ke dayre se baahar nahin hain. Ibn-e-arbi maaliki kahte hain : Baaki kaaran kisi bhi tarah se in teen kaarnon se baahar nahin hain. Kyonki jo vyakti jaadu karta hai aur Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko gaali deta hai, woh us vyakti ki shreni mein aata hai jisne apna dharm tyaag diya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4716: Tumhaari zabaan hamesha Allah ke zikr se tar rahe.

Abdullah bin busr radiyallahu anhuma farmaate hain ki ek vyakti ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Islam ke praavdhaan (aadesh evn nirdesh ) mere liye bahut zyaada ho gae hain. Atah mujhe koi aisi cheez batayen, jise main mazbooti se pakar loon. Aapne farmaya : "Tumhaari zabaan hamesha Allah ke zikr se tar rahe."

Ek vyakti ne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saamne shikay ki ki uske samaane nafal ibaadten itni zyaada maujood hain ki apni durbalta ke kaaran woh unhen kar nahin sakta. Phir anurodh kiya ki aap use koi chhota-sa amal bata den, jisse bahut saare sawaab praapt ho jayen aur jise woh mazbooti se pakre rahe.

Atah Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne use nirdesh diya ki hamesha uski zabaan Allah ke zikr se tar rahe aur har samay tatha har paristhiti mein Allah ke zikr, jaise subhaanallah, al-hamdu lillah, astaghfirullah aur dua aadi mein vyast rahe.

Paabandi se Allah ka zikr karne ki fazeelat.
Allah ka ek bahut bara upkaar yeh hai ki usne pratiphal dilaane waali cheezon ko aasaan kar diya hai.
Achchhe aur neki ke kaamon mein bande alag-alag star ke hua karte hain.
Jeebh dvaara, manoyog ke saath, bahut zyaada Allah ka zikr karna, jaise- subhaanallah, al-hamdu lillah, la ilaaha illallah aur Allahu akbar aadi kahna bahut-si nafal ibaadton ke baraabar hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam sawaal karne waalon ko saamne rakhte hue har sawaal karne waale ko wahi jawaab dete, jo uske liye upyukt hota.
[ise tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
4717: ''Tummen se koi vyakti us samay tak momin nahin ho sakta, jab tak ki apne bhaai ke liye wahi pasand na kare, jo apne liye pasand karta hai.''

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : ''Tummen se koi vyakti us samay tak momin nahin ho sakta, jab tak ki apne bhaai ke liye wahi pasand na kare, jo apne liye pasand karta hai.''

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki kisi vyakti ko sanpoorn eemaan ki daulat us samay tak naseeb nahin ho sakti, jab tak apne bhaai ke liye deen evn duniya ki wahi cheezen pasand na kare, jo apne liye pasand karta ho aur uske liye unheen cheezon ko naapsand na kare, jinhen apne liye naapsand karta ho. Agar apne bhaai ke andar deen ki koi kami dekhe, to use door karne ka prayaas kare aur koi achchhaai dekhe, to use aur barhaawa de aur usmen madad kare. Deen evn duniya se sanbandhit sabhi baaton mein uska shubhchintan kare.

Insaan par aniwaary hai ki apne bhaai ke liye wahi pasand kare, jo apne liye pasand karta ho. Kyonki jo  vyakit apne bhaai ke liye wahi pasand na karta ho jo apne liye pasand karta ho, usse eemaan ka inkaar karna, is baat ke aniwaary hone ki pushti karta hai.
Deeni bhaaichaara nasbi (rakt-sanbandhi) bhaaichaare se oopar hai, isliye iska adhikaar bhi adhik aniwaary hai.
Aise sabhi kathan evn kaary, jaise dhokha, gheebat, hasad aur musalmaanon ki jaan, maal ya izzat-aabru par aakraman aadi haraam hain, jo is bhaai-chaare ke wipreet hon.
Kisi kaary par ubhaarne waale shabdon ka prayog. Kyonki aapne "Apne bhaai ke liye" Shabd ka prayog kiya hai.
Kirmaani kahte hain : Eemaan ka taqaaza yeh bhi hai ki insaan apne bhaai ke liye wahi naapsand kare, jo apne liye naapsand karta ho. Lekin iska zikr aapne nahin kiya. Kyonki kisi cheez se muhabbat se uske wipreet se nafrat laazim aati hai. Isliye ise alag se bataane ki zaroorat nahin pari.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4719: Ai yazeed! Tere liye wahi hai, jiski toone neeyat ki aur ai maan! Tere liye woh hai, jo toone liya.

Maan bin yazeed bin akhnas- radiyallahu anhum- kahte hain ki mere pita yazeed ne daan karne ke uddeshy se kuchh deenaar nikaalkar masjid mein ek vyakti ke paas rakha. Sanyogvash, main wahaan gaya aur deenaaron ko le liya. Phir apne pita ke paas aya to woh boेleh Allah ki qasam! Mera tujhe dene ka iraada nahin tha. Aise mein, main unhen nirnay ke liye Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas le gaya. Aapne farmayaah ai yazeed! Tere liye woh hai, jiski toone neeyat ki aur ai maan! Tere liye woh hai, jo toone liya.
4721: Agar tum Allah par waisa hi bharosa karne lago, jaisa bharosa uspar hona chahiye, to woh tumhen usi tarah rozi de, jaise chiriyon ko rozi deta hai; woh subah ko khaali pet nikalti hain aur shaam ko pet bharkar lotti hain.

Umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha ki unhonne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko yeh kahte hue suna : "Agar tum Allah par waisa hi bharosa karne lago, jaisa bharosa uspar hona chahiye, to woh tumhen usi tarah rozi de, jaise chiriyon ko rozi deta hai; woh subah ko khaali pet nikalti hain aur shaam ko pet bharkar lotti hain."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam hamen is baat ki prerna de rahe hain ki ham duniya aur deen se sanbandhit tamaam kaamon mein laabh praapt karne aur haani se bachne ke maamle mein Allah par bharosa karen. Kyonki dene waala aur rokne waala tatha nuqsaan karne waala aur laabh dene waala kewal Allah hai. Isi tarah hamen Allah par sachche bharose ke saath-saath aise kaam karne chaahiyen, jinse laabh praapt ho aur haani se bacha ja sake. Jab ham aisa karenge, to Allah hamen usi tarah rozi dega, jaise pakshiyon ko rozi deta hai, jo subah bhookhe pet nikalte hain aur shaam ko pet bharkar waapas hote hain. Daraasal pakshiyon ka subah aur shaam nikalna rozi talaash karne ke liye kiya jaane waala kaam hi to hai. Aisa nahin hota ki woh Allah par bharosa karke baith jayen ya susti se kaam len aur unko rozi mil jaye.

Allah par bharosa karne ki fazeelat tatha yeh ki Allah par bharosa rozi praapt karne ka ek bahut bara sabab hai.
Allah par bharosa saadhnon ko apnaane ke wiruddh nahin hai, kyonki aapne bataya ki jeewika ki khoj mein subah aur shaam ko nikalna Allah par waastawik bharose ke wiruddh nahin hai.
Shareeyat dil ke kaaryon par bhi dhiyaan deta hai, kyonki Allah par bharosa karna dil ka kaary hai.
Kewal saadhnon par bharosa karna deen ki kami ko darshaata hai, jabki Allah par bharosa karne ke naam par saadhnon ko chhor dena buddhi ki kami ko darshaata hai.
[ise tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
4723: ‎“‎kisi aadmi ne apne pet se bura bartan koi nahin bhara. Aadam ki santaan ke liye khaane ke kuchhek luqme kaafi hain, jo uski peeth khari rakhen. Agar adhik khaana zaroori ho to pet ka ek tihaai bhaag khaane ke liye, ek tihaai bhaag peene ke liye aur ek tihaai bhaag saans lene ke liye ho.‎”‎

Miqdaam bin maadeekrib -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : ‎“‎kisi aadmi ne apne pet se bura bartan koi nahin bhara. Aadam ki santaan ke liye khaane ke kuchhek luqme kaafi hain, jo uski peeth khari rakhen. Agar adhik khaana zaroori ho to pet ka ek tihaai bhaag khaane ke liye, ek tihaai bhaag peene ke liye aur ek tihaai bhaag saans lene ke liye ho.‎”‎

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hamaara maargadarshan chikitsa se sanbandhit ek mahatvapoorn siddhaant yaani parhez ki or kar rahe hain, jiske dvaara insaan apne svaasthy ki raksha kar sakta hai. Isse muraad adhik bhojan karne se bachne balki kewal utna hi khaane ki salaah hai, jo hamaari bhookh ko mita sake aur aawashyak kaaryon ke liye hamen taakat de sake. Aur sabse kharaab bartan jise bhara gaya ho pet hai, kyonki tripti ke kaaran, der-sawer, aantrik ya baahy roop se, anginat ghaatak beemaariyaan utpann ho jaati hain. Phir rasoolullah -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : Yadi kisi vyakti ko bharpet khaana hi hai, to use chahiye ki pet ka ek tihaai hissa khaane ke liye, ek tihaai peene ke liye aur ek tihaai saans lene ke liye chhor de, taaki use kisi bhi tarah ki takleef evn haani na ho, ya dharm aur duniya ke aniwaary kaaryon ki adaygi mein susti na ho.

Adhik khaane peene se bachna chahiye. Yeh chikitsa ke sabhi mool siddhaanton ka ek samagr aadhaar hai, kyonki bharpet khaane se wibhinn rog aur beemaariyaan utpann hoti hain.
Bhojan ka uddeshy svaasthy aur shakti ko banaye rakhna hai, jo ki jeewan ke aadhaar hain.
Bharpet khaane ke bahut-se shaareerik aur dhaarmik nuksaan hain. Umar -radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha hai : "Bharpet khaane se bacho, kyonki yeh shareer ko kharaab karta hai aur namaz ke prati sust bana deta hai."
Sharai ahkaam ke drishtikon se khaane ke kai prakaar hua karte hain; itna khaana waajib hai, jisse jaan bachi rahe aur jise chhorna haanikaarak ho. Aniwaary parimaan se adhik itna khaana jayaz hai ki nuqsaan ka andesha na ho. Itna khaana makrooh hai ki usse haani hone ka bhay ho. Itna khaana haraam hai ki usse nuqsaan ho jaane ka yaqeen ho. Itna khaana musathab hai ki usse Allah ki ibaadat aur neki ke kaamon mein sahyog mile. Ullikhit hadees mein in tamaam baaton ko nimnalikhit teen shreniyon mein bayaan kar diya gaya hai : 1-pet bharkar khaana khaana. 2- itna khaana khaana ki peeth khari rah sake. 3- teesri shreni ko in shabdon mein bayaan kiya gaya hai : "Pet ka ek tihaai bhaag khaane ke liye, ek tihaai bhaag peene ke liye aur ek tihaai bhaag saans lene ke liye ho.‎" Lekin yeh saari baaten us samay hain, jab bhojan halaal ho.
Yeh hadees chikitsa ka ek buniyaadi siddhaant hai. Kyonki chikitsa ke teen buniyaadi siddhaant hain : Shakti ki raksha, saavdhaani baratna aur ilaaj karna. Jabki is hadees mein pahle do siddhaant shaamil hain. Isi prakaar uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : "Khaao, piyo aur fizoolkharchi na karo. Beshak Allah fizoolkharchi karne waale ko pasand nahin karta hai." [soora aaraaf : 31]
Islaami shariyat ek sanpoorn shareeyat hai, jismen insaan ke saansaarik evn dhaarmik donon tarah ke hiton ka khyaal rakha gaya hai.
Chikitsa wijnaan se sannbandhit mool baaten sharai jnaan-wijnaan ka hi ek hissa hain. Yahi kaaran hai ki shahad evn kalaunji ke baare mein kai baaten kahi gai hain.
Sharai aadeshon evn nirdeshon ke andar bari hikamten maujood hain.Tatha sabhi sharai aadesh evn nirdesh nuqsaan rokne evn laabh praapt karne par aadhaarit hain.
[ise imaam ahmad, tirmizi, nasai aur ibn-e-maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
4725: Main tumhen jis cheez se rokoon, usse bachte raho aur jis cheej ka aadesh doon, use jahaan tak ho sake kiye jaao, kyonki tumse pahle ke logon ko unke adhik prashnon aur nabiyon ke wirodh ne halaak kiya hai.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue sunaah main tumhen jis cheez se rokoon, usse bachte raho aur jis cheej ka aadesh doon, use jahaan tak ho sake kiye jaao, kyonki tumse pahle ke logon ko unke adhik prashnon aur nabiyon ke wirodh ne halaak kiya hai.

Is hadees mein Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne hamen bataya hai ki jab woh hamen kisi cheez se mana kare, to usse bina kisi apvaad ke bachna parega aur jab kisi baat ka aadesh de, to use shakti bhar karna parega.
Phir hamen is baat se saavdhaan kiya ki ham un pichhle samudayon ki tarah na ho jayen, jo apne nabiyon par sawaal par sawaav daagte gae aur unka wirodh bhi karte rahe. Parinaamasvaroop Allah ne unhen saza ke taur par tarah-tarah ki halaakton mein daal diya. Atah, hamen unki tarah nahin hona chahiye, taaki usi tarah ki halaakton ka saamna na karna pare.

Aadeshon ka paalan karne tatha nishedhon se bachne ka aadesh.
Mana ki hui cheezon se bachne ke maamle mein koi chhoot nahin hai. Jabki jin cheezon ko karne ka aadesh hai, unke paalan ke saath shakti ki qaid lagi hui hai. Kyonki bachna insaan ki kshamta ke andar ki cheez hai, jabki karne ke liye aadeshit kaary ko karne ki shakti ki aawashyakta hoti hai.
Adhik prashn karne ki manaahi. Ulema ne prashn ke do prakaar bataye hain : Pahla woh prashn jo dharm se sanbandhit maamlon mein jaankaari praapt karne ke liye kiya gaya ho. Is tarah ke prashn ka aadesh diya gaya hai aur sahaaba -radiyallahu anhum- ke prashn isi prakaar ke dayre mein aate the. Doosra woh prashn jo baal ki khaal nikaalne ke liye kiya gaya ho. Isi prakaar ke prashn se mana kiya gaya hai.
Is ummat ko apne Nabi ki mukhaalifat se mana kiya gaya hai, jaisa ki pichhli ummaton mein hota aya hai.
Nishedh ke andar kam aur adhik donon shaamil hain. Kyonki usse bachne ke aadesh ka paalan usi samay ho payega, jab uske kam evn adhik donon se bacha jaye. Misaal ke taur par sood (byaaj) se jab mana kar diya gaya, to usmen kam aur adhik donon shaamil hain.
Haraam kaamon ki or le jaane waale asbaab ko chhorna. Kyonki yeh bachne ke arth ka ek ansh hai.
Insaan ke paas kshamta evn saamarthy hota hai, kyonki aapka farmaan hai : "Jahaan tak tumhaari shakti ho." Is tarah, ismen jabriya sanpraday ka khandan hai, jo kahte hain ki insaan ki koi kshamta nahin hoti aur woh apne amal par majboor hota hai. Yahaan tak ki insaan baat karte samay apna haath bhi hilaata hai, to apni marzi se nahin hilaata, balki uspar majboor hota hai. Sachchaai yeh hai ki yeh ek asaty mat hai, jiske andar bahut-se dosh maujood hain.
Insaan jab Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka aadesh sune, to use kya yeh waajib hai ya musathab hai, nahin kahna chahiye, kyonki aapne kaha hai : "فَأْتُوا مِنْهُ مَا استَطَعْتُمْ" Yaani jahaan tak ho sake, uska paalan karo.
Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne jis baat ka aadesh diya hai ya jisse roka hai, woh shareeyat hai. Chaahe woh Qur'an mein maujood ho ya na ho. Isliye Qur'an ke atirikt sunnat ka bhi paalan kiya jayega, chaahe woh aadesh ke roop mein ho ya nishedh ke roop mein.
Adhik prashn karna winaash ka kaaran hai. Wishesh roop se un baaton ke baare mein jinki jaankaari praapt karna sanbhav nahin hai. Jaise paroksh ki baaten, Allah ke naam evn gun qayaamat ke din ke haalaat aadi. In maamlon mein adhik sawaal halaakat ka kaaran hai aur is tarah ka vyakti baal ki khaal nikaalne waala samjha jayega.
Pichhli ummaten adhik prashn karne tatha apne nabiyon se adhik matbhed ke kaaran halaak ho gaeen.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4792: Jisne hamaare is deen mein koi aisi nai cheez banaali, jo uska hissa nahin hai, to woh grahanyogy nahin hai

Aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne hamaare is deen mein koi aisi nai cheez banaali, jo uska hissa nahin hai, to woh grahanyogy nahin hai." (Saheeh Bukhari evn saheeh Muslim) saheeh Muslim ki ek riwayat mein hai : "Jisne koi aisa kaary kiya, jiske sanbandh mein hamaara aadesh nahin hai, to woh grahanyogy nahin hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jisne deen ke andar koi nai cheez banaai ya aisa koi kaam kiya, jo Qur'an evn hadees se pramaanit na ho, to use usi ke munh par maar diya jayega aur woh Allah ke yahaan qabool nahin kiya jayega.

Ibaadton ka aadhaar Qur'an evn hadees hai. Atah ham Allah ki ibaadat Qur'an evn hadees ke bataye hue tareeqe ke mutaabiq hi karenge. Bidaaton aur ibaadat ke nit-nae roopon se har haal mein door rahenge.
Deen ka aadhaar mat evn achchha lagna nahin hai. Iska aadhaar Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka anusran hai.
Yeh hadees deen ke sanpoorn hone ki daleel hai.
Bidaat har us aastha, kathan ya amal ko kahte hain, jise deen ke ek ang ke roop mein banaya gaya ho aur woh Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aur aapke sahaaba ke zamaane mein maujood na raha ho.
Yeh hadees Islam ka ek mahatvapoorn siddhaant prastut karti hai. Yeh daraasal karmon ki kasauti ki haisiyat rakhti hai. Jis tarah jab kisi amal ka uddeshy Allah ki prasannata ki praapti na ho, to karne waale ko uska koi sawaab nahin milta, usi tarah jo amal Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki shikshaaon ke anusaar na kiya jaye, use karne waale ke munh par maar diya jaata hai.
Mana kewal un nai cheezon se kiya gaya hai, jinka sanbandh deen se ho, unse nahin, jinka sanbandh duniya se ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4797: Jisne soory ke pashchim se uday hone se pahle tauba kar li, Allah uski tauba ko grahan karega.
Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jisne soory ke pashchim se uday hone se pahle tauba kar li, Allah uski tauba ko grahan karega.

Is hadees se maaloom hua ki pawitr evn uchch Allah apne paapi bande ki tauba us samay tak grahan karega, jab tak sooraj apne ast hone ke sthaan uday na ho jaye. Kyonki yahi tauba grahan hone ke samay ka antim samay hai aur yeh qayaamat ki bari nishaaniyon mein se ek hai.
4801: Jisne kisi momin se duniya ki pareshaaniyon mein se  koi pareshaani door ki, Allah usse qayaamat ke din ki pareshaaniyon mein se kisi pareshaani ko door karega.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jisne kisi momin se duniya ki pareshaaniyon mein se  koi pareshaani door ki, Allah usse qayaamat ke din ki pareshaaniyon mein se kisi pareshaani ko door karega. Jisne tangi mein pare hue kisi vyakti ke saath aasaani barti, Allah duniya evn aakhirat mein uske saath aasaani karega. Jisne kisi musalmaan ki kami evn avgun ko chhupaya, Allah duniya aur aakhirat mein uske avgun evn kamiyon ko chhupayega. Allah apne bande ki madad mein rahta hai, jab tak banda apne bhaai ki madad mein rahta hai. Jo jnaan arjit karne ke liye kisi maarg par chalta hai, Allah iske badle mein uske liye Jannat ka maarg aasaan kar deta hai. Jab kuchh log Allah ke kisi ghar mein ekatr hokar Allah ki kitaab ki tilaawat hain aur use aapas mein samajhne evn samjhaane ka kaary karte hain, to unpar shaanti awatrit hoti hai, unhen Allah ki kripa dhaanp leti hai, farishte ghere rahte hain aur Allah unki charcha unke beech karta hai, jo uske paas hain (arfathaat: Rishton ke saamne). Jiska karm use peechhe chhor de, uska kul use aage nahin le ja sakta."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne bataya hai ki Allah ke yahaan musalmaan ko usi ke anuroop pratiphal milta hai, jo woh musalmaanon ke saath karta hai. Jisne is sansaar ki kathinaaiyon aur sankton mein se kisi bhi kathinaai aur sankat ko kisi Muslim se door kiya, badle mein Allah use qayaamat ke din ki kathinaaiyon mein se kisi kathinaai se mukti pradaan karega. Jo vyakti tangi mein pare hue kisi vyakti ko sahoolat pradaan karta hai aur uski kathinaai ko door karta hai, Allah uske liye is duniya aur aakhirat donon jagah mein sahoolat paida karega. Jo vyakti kisi musalmaan ki galtiyon aur trutiyon ko chhupaata hai, Allah uski kamiyon evn trutiyon par is duniya aur aakhirat mein parda daalega. Allah apne bande ki madad karta rahta hai, jab tak banda apne bhaai ki dhaarmik aur saansaarik hiton mein sahayta karta hai. Yeh sahayta dua, shaareerik shram, dhan aur any tareekon se ki ja sakti hai. Jo vyakti Allah ki prasannata ke uddeshy se sharai jnaan praapt karne ke maarg mein nikalta hai, Allah uske liye is kaary ke maadhyam se Jannat ka maarg aasaan kar deta hai. Jab bhi koi samooh Allah ke gharon mein se kisi ek ghar mein ekatr hota hai, Allah ki kitaab ka paath karta hai tatha aapas mein uska adhyayan karta hai, tab unpar shaanti aur sukoon utarta hai, Allah ki daya unhen dhaanp leti hai, pharishte unhen ghere rahte hain, Allah apne nikatvarti logon (pharishton) mein unki prashansa karta hai. Zara sochiye ki Allah ke dvaara nikatvartiyon ke beech kisi ki prashansa ho jaana kitne bare saubhaagy ki baat hai. Jiska karm apoorn ho uska wansh use karmasheel samkakshon ki shreni mein nahin la sakta. Is liye use apne wansh evn poorvajon ki pratishtha par nirbhar nahin hona chahiye tatha kartavyon ke paalan mein kami nahin karni chahiye.

Ibn-e-daqeeq al-eed kahte hain : Yeh ek mahaan hadees hai, jo wibhinn prakaar ke jnaan, niymon evn shishtaachaar ko apne andar samaahit ki hui hai. Ismen musalmaanon ki aawashyaktaaon ko poora karne aur unki madad karne ka gungaan kiya gaya hai. Chaahe woh jnaan, dhan, sahyog, salaah ya any kisi bhi tareeqe se ho.
Tangi mein phanse logon ko sahoolat pradaan karne ka protsaahan.
Muslim bhaai ki sahayta karne ko prerit karna tatha is baat par zor dena ki Allah sahayta karne waale ki waisi hi madad karta hai, jaisi madad woh apne bhaai ki karta hai.
Muslim ke doshon par parda daalne mein uske doshon ki khoj-been na karna bhi shaamil hai. Kisi sadaachaari poorvaj (salaf) ne kaha hai : Mainne aise logon ko dekha hai jinke andar pratyaksh roop se koi dosh nahin tha. Parantu jab unhonne doosron ke doshon ka zikr kiya, to logon ne bhi unke doshon ko saamne la diya. Jabki mainne aise logon ko bhi paya hai jinmen dosh tha. Kintu jab unhonne doosron ke doshon ki charcha nahin ki, to unke apne dosh bhi bhula diye gae.
Kisi vyakti ke doshon ko chhupaane ka kadaapi yeh arth nahin hai ki buraai ko jas ka tas chhor diya jaye ya use badalne ka prayaas na kiya jaye. Balki, buraai ko badalna aur uspar parda daalna donon aawashyak hain. Yahaan baat un logon ki ho rahi hai, jinka bura hona tatha bara atyaachaari hona prasiddh na ho. Jo is maamle mein prasiddh ho chuke hon, unke dosh chhupaana uchit nahin hai. Aise logon ka maamla prashaasan tak pahunchaana chahiye, basharte ki isse koi buraai janm lene ka bhay na ho. Kyonki aise logon ki buraai ko chhupaane se unka manobal barhega aur bigaar ke maarg par aur adhik chal parenge, doosre logon ka ahit karenge aur unke andar buraai karne ka dussaahas paida karenge.
Jnaan ki praapti, kuraaan ka paath aur uska adhyayan karne ke liye protsaahan.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees mein masjid ke andar kuraaan ka paath karne ke liye ekatr hone ka mahatv bataya gaya hai... Is puny ki praapti ke liye, masjid ke atirikt, madarsa ya rabaat ityaadi mein ekatr hona bhi isi shreni mein aata hai.
Pratiphal ko Allah ne karmon par nirdhaarit kiya hai, na ki wansh par.
4808: Allah ki qasam! Main din mein sattar baar se adhik Allah se kshama maangta hoon aur uske saamne tauba karta hoon.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue sunaah Allah ki qasam! Main din mein sattar baar se adhik Allah se kshama maangta hoon aur uske saamne tauba karta hoon.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jinke agle-pichhle saare gunaah maaf the, qasam khaakar kah rahe hain ki woh din mein sattar baar se adhik Allah se kshamayaachna aur uske saamne tauba karte hain. Yaad rahe ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki kshamayaachna isliye nahin hua karti thi ki aapse kuchh gunaah ho jaya karte the, balki yeh Allah ki sanpoorn daasta, uske zikr se aapke lagaav, uske wishaal adhikaar ke ehsaas aur bande ki kotaahi, chaahe woh uski nemton ka shukr ada karne ke liye jitna bhi kaam kare, ka prateek hai. Yeh daraasal apne baad ummat ke liye aadarsh prastut karne ka ek udaahran hai. Iske andar is prakaar ke any kai hikamten hain.
4809: Ai logo! Allah ke saamne tauba karo, kyonki khud main din mein sau baar tauba karta hoon.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke ek sahaabi agharr -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Ai logo! Allah ke saamne tauba karo, kyonki khud main din mein sau baar tauba karta hoon."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam logon ko adhik se adhik tauba evn kshama yaachna karne ka aadesh de rahe hain aur khud apne baare mein bata rahe hain ki aap din mein sau baar se adhik tauba evn kshama yaachna karte hain. Jabki aapke agle evn pichhle tamaam gunaah maaf the. Yeh daraasal Allah ke saamne mein apni bandgi evn heenta ke izhaar ka paraakaashtha hai.

Pratyek vyakti ko, chaahe uske eemaan ka star kuchh bhi ho, sarvashaktimaan Allah ki or lautne aur tauba ke maadhyam se svayn ko paripoorn banaane ki aawashyakta hoti hai. Pratyek vyakti se Allah ke adhikaaron ki adaygi mein kotaahi ho hi jaya karti hai. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : "Ai momino! Tum sab Allah ke saamne tauba karo."
Tauba ka yeh aadesh aam hai. Tauba chaahe haraam kaamon aur gunaah karne ki ho ya aniwaary kaary karne mein kotaahi ki.
Tauba ke qabool hone ke liye dil mein Allah ki prasannata ki praapti ki neeyat karna shart hai. Jisne Allah ki prasannata ki praapti ke atirikt kisi aur uddeshy se gunaah chhora, woh tauba karne waala shumaar nahin hoga.
Navvi kahte hain : Tauba ki teen sharten hain : 1- gunaah ko chhor dena. 2- gunaah mein sanlipt hone par sharminda hona. 3- is baat ki pratijna kar lena ki dobaara woh gunaah nahin karega. Uparyukt teen sharten us samay hain, jab gunaah ka sanbandh Allah ke kisi adhikaar ke hanan se ho. Agar gunaah ka sanbandh bandon ke adhikaaron mein se kisi adhikaar ke hanan se ho, to tauba ke sahi hone ke liye adhikaar waale ko uska adhikaar lautaana ya maafi-talaafi kara lena chauthi shart hogi.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke kshama yaachna karne ka yeh arth nahin hai ki gunaah hone ke kaaran hi aap kshama yaachna kiya karte the. Daraasal aap aisa Allah ki ibaadat mein poori tarah samarpit hone, Allah ke zikr se haardik sanbandh, Allah ke mahaan adhikaar se avgat hone aur Allah ka shukr ada karne mein ho jaane waali kamiyon ka ehsaas rakhne ke kaaran kiya karte the. Iska ek uddeshy apni ummat ke liye udaahran prastut karna bhi tha.
4810: Ai mere bando! Mainne atyaachaar ko apne oopar haraam kar liya hai aur use tumhaare beech haraam kiya hai, atah tum ek-doosre par atyaachaar na karo

Aboozar radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apne barkat waale aur mahaan rab se riwayat karte hain ki usne kaha hai : "Ai mere bando! Mainne atyaachaar ko apne oopar haraam kar liya hai aur use tumhaare beech haraam kiya hai, atah tum ek-doosre par atyaachaar na karo. Ai mere bando! Tum sab log pathabhrasht ho, siway uske jise mein maarg dikha doon, atah mujhse maargadarshan maango karo, main tumhen seedhi raah dikhaaoonga. Ai mere bando! Tum sab log bhookhe ho, siway uske jise main khaana khilaaoon, atah mujhse bhojan maango, main tumhen khaane ko doonga. Ai mere bando! Tum sab log nange ho, siway uske jise main kapra pahnaaoon, atah mujhse pahanne ko kapre maango, main tumhen pahnaaoonga. Ai mere bando! Tum raat-din trutiyaan karte ho aur main tamaam gunaahon ko maaf karta hoon, atah mujhse kshama maango, main tumhen kshama karoonga. Ai mere bando! Tum mujhe nuqsaan pahunchaane ke paatr nahin ho sakte ki mujhe nuqsaan pahunchaao aur mujhe nafa pahunchaane ke paatr bhi nahin ho sakte ki mujhe nafa pahunchaao. Ai mere bando! Agar tumhaare pahle aur baad ke log tatha insaan aur jinn tumhaare andar maujood sabse aajnaakaari insaan ke dil par jama ho jayen, to isse meri baadshaahat mein tanik bhi wriddhi nahin hogi. Ai mere bando! Agar tumhaare pahle aur baad ke log tatha tumhaare insaan aur jinn tumhaare andar maujood sabse paapi insaan ke dil par jama ho jayen, to bhi isse meri baadshaahat mein koi kami nahin ayegi. Ai mere bando! Agar tumhaare pahle aur baad ke log tatha insaan aur jinn ek hi maidaan mein khare hokar mujhse maangen aur main pratyek ko uski maangi hui wastu de doon, to aisa karne se mere khazaane mein usse adhik kami nahin hogi, jitna samudr mein sooi daalkar nikaalne se hoti hai. Ai mere bando! Yeh tumhaare karm hi hain, jinhen main ginkar rakhta hoon aur phir tumhen unka badla bhi deta hoon. Atah, jo achchha paye, woh Allah ki prashansa kare aur jo kuchh aur paye, woh kewal apne aapko kose."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki pawitr evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai ki usne apne oopar atyaachaar ko haraam kar liya hai aur use apni srishtiyon ke liye bhi haraam kar diya hai, atah koi kisi par atyaachaar na kare. Allah ne kaha hai ki saare insaan saty ke maarg se bhatke hue hain, siway uske jise woh saty ka maarg dikhaye aur saty ke raaste par chalne ka suyog pradaan kare. Jo Allah se saty ke maarg par chalne ka suyog maangta hai, use Allah yeh suyog pradaan karta hai. Allah ne kaha hai ki saare insaan apni tamaam zaroorton ke liye Allah ke mohtaaj hain aur jo Allah se zaroorten poori karne ki dua karta hai, Allah uski zaroorten poori kar deta hai. Allah ne kaha hai ki saare insaan din-raat gunaah karte hain aur Allah unke gunaahon par parda daalta hai tatha kshama maangne par kshama bhi karta hai. Allah ne kaha hai ki insaan Allah ko na to haani pahuncha sakte hain aur na use laabh pahuncha sakte hain. Allah ne kaha hai ki saare insaan agar unke andar maujood sabse dharmasheel vyakti ke dil par ekatr ho jayen, to unki is dharmasheelta se Allah ki baadshaahat mein koi wriddhi nahin hogi. Isi tarah agar saare insaan unke andar maujood sabse gunahgaar vyakti ke dil par ekatr ho jayen, to unke gunahgaar ho jaane se Allah ki baadshaahat mein koi kami nahin ayegi. Kyonki insaan kamzor tatha har haal, har zamaane aur har sthaan mein Allah ke mohtaaj hain, jabki Allah paak beniyaaz aur nisprih hai. Allah ne kaha hai ki agar saare insaan aur saare jinn, pahle ke bhi aur baad ke bhi, ek hi sthaan mein jama ho jayen aur Allah se maangne lagen aur Allah har ek ki jholi bhar de, to isse Allah ke khazaane mein koi kami nahin ayegi. Bilkul usi tarah, jis tarah samudr mein ek sooi daalkar nikaal lene se samudr ke paani mein koi kami nahin hoti. Aisa isliye ki Allah nisprih hai.

Allah ne kaha hai ki woh bandon ke karmon ko surakshit tatha unke liye ginkar rakhta hai aur woh qayaamat ke din unko unke karmon ka pratiphal dega.
