Aise mein jo apne karmon ka pratiphal achchha paye, woh Allah ka shukr ada kare ki usne use neki ke kaam karne ka suyog pradaan kiya aur jo apne karmon ka pratiphal isse bhinn paye, woh apne buraai ka aadesh dene waale nafs ko kose, jo use naakaami ki or le gaya.

Yeh hadees un hadeeson mein se hai, jo Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne rab se riwayat karke kaha hai. Is tarah ki hadees ko hadees-e-qudsi ya hadees-e-ilaahi kaha jaata hai. Isse muraad woh hadees hai, jiske shabd tatha arth donon Allah ke hon. Albatta iske andar Qur'an ki wisheshtayen, jaise uski tilaawat ka ibaadat hona, uske liye tahaarat praapt karna tatha uska chamatkaar hona aadi, nahin paai jaati.
Insaan ko jo bhi jnaan tatha maargadarshan praapt hota hai, woh Allah ke maarg dikhaane aur uski shiksha se praapt hota hai.
Insaan ko jo bhalaai milti hai, woh Allah ke anugrah se milti hai aur jo buraai milti hai, woh uski aatma aur khud uski buraaiyon ki chaahat or se hoti hai.
Jisne achchha kaam kiya, usne Allah ke suyog pradaan karne ke kaaran kiya aur uska pratiphal Allah ka anugrah hai, atah saari prashansa Allah ki hai. Iske wipreet jisne bura kaam kiya, woh kewal apne aapko kose.
4811: Ai bachche! Main tumhen kuchh baaten sikhaana chaahta hoon. Allah (ke aadeshon aur nishedhon) ki raksha karo, Allah tumhaari raksha karega. Allah (ke aadeshon aur nishedhon) ki raksha karo, tum use apne saamne paaoge. Jab maango, to Allah se maango aur jab madad talab karo, to Allah se talab karo

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Main ek din Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke peechhe sawaar tha ki isi beech aapne kaha : "Ai bachche! Main tumhen kuchh baaten sikhaana chaahta hoon. Allah (ke aadeshon aur nishedhon) ki raksha karo, Allah tumhaari raksha karega. Allah (ke aadeshon aur nishedhon) ki raksha karo, tum use apne saamne paaoge. Jab maango, to Allah se maango aur jab madad talab karo, to Allah se talab karo. Tatha jaan lo, yadi poori ummat tumhen kuchh laabh pahunchaane ke liye ekatr ho jaye, to tumhen usse adhik laabh nahin pahuncha sakti, jitna Allah ne tumhaare liye likh diya hai. Tatha yadi sab log tumhaari kuchh haani karne ke liye ekatr ho jayen, to usse adhik haani nahin kar sakte, jitni Allah ne tumhaare bhaagy mein likha hai. Qalam utha li gai hai aur pustaken sookh chuki hain."

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma bata rahe hain ki woh chhote the aur ek din Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke peechhe sawaari par baithe hue the ki aapne kaha : Main tumhen kuchh baaten sikhaaoonga, jinse Allah tumhen fayda pahunchayega :

Allah ke aadeshon ki raksha karke aur uski mana ki hui cheezon se door rahkar is tarah Allah ki raksha karo ki woh tumko neki aur Allah se nikat karne waale kaamon mein paye, awajnaakaariyon aur gunaahon mein na paye. Agar tum aisa karoge, to badle mein Allah duniya evn aakhirat ki apriy cheezon se tumhaari raksha karega aur tum jahaan bhi jaaoge, har kaam mein tumhaari madad karega.

Jab kuchh maangna ho, to kewal Allah se maango. Kyonki wahi maangne waalon ki muraaden poori karta hai.

Jab madad talab karni ho, to kewal Allah se talab karo.

Tumhaare dil mein is baat ka wishvaas hona chahiye ki agar dharti ke oopar maujood saare log tumhaara bhala karna chaahen, to utna hi kar sakte hain, jitna Allah ne tumhaare bhaagy mein likh rakha hai aur dharti par basne waale saare log tumhaara bura karna chaahen, to usse zyaada nahin kar sakte, jitna Allah ne tumhaare bhaagy mein likh rakha hai.

In saari baaton ko Allah ne apni hikmat tatha jnaan ke taqaaze ke anusaar likh rakha hai aur Allah ke likhe mein koi badlaav sanbhav nahin hai.

Chhote bachchon ko tauheed tatha aadaab evn is prakaar ki deen ki any baaten sikhaane ka mahatv.
Allah bande ko pratiphal usi koti ka deta hai, jis koti ka uska amal rahta hai.
Kewal Allah par bharosa karne ka aadesh, kyonki wahi kaam banaane waala hai.
Allah ke nirnay tatha taqdeer par eemaan aur usse raazi rahna tatha is baat ka ullekh ki Allah ne saari cheezon ka nirnay pahle se le rakha hai.
Jo Allah ke aadeshon ko nasht karega, Allah use nasht kar dega aur uski raksha nahin karega.
4812: Ek sainyadal kaabe par aakraman karne ke iraade se niklega. Jab woh ek chatiyal maidaan mein pahunchega, to uske shuru se aakhir tak ke sab log dharti mein dhansa diye jayenge.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah ek sainyadal kaabe par aakraman karne ke iraade se niklega. Jab woh ek chatiyal maidaan mein pahunchega to uske shuru se aakhir tak ke sab log dharti mein dhansa diye jayenge. Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Uske shuru se aakhir tak ke sab hi log kaise dhansa diye jayenge, jabki usmen baazaar ke log bhi honge aur aise log bhi honge, jo usmen shaamil nahin honge? To aapne farmayaah uske shuru se aakhir tak sab log dhansa diye jayenge aur phir we apni-apni neeyton ke anusaar uthaye jayenge.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4813: Mere aage meri ummat ke achchhe aur bure sab karm pesh kiye gae. To mainne uske achchhe karmon se raaste se kashtadayak wastu ka hataana bhi paya aur uske bure karmon mein woh thook bhi paya, jo masjid mein phenka gaya ho aur use saaf na kiya gaya ho.

Abu zarr- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah mere aage meri ummat ke achchhe aur bure sab karm pesh kiye gae. To mainne uske achchhe karmon mein raaste se kashtadayak wastu ka hataana bhi paya aur uske bure karmon mein woh thook bhi paya, jo masjid mein phenka gaya ho aur use saaf na kiya gaya ho.
4814: Mere saamne Jannat evn Jahannam ko pesh kiya gaya, to main ne bhalaai evn buraai ke maamle mein aaj ke jaisa din nahin dekha. Agar tum woh baaten jaan lo, jo main jaanta hoon to awashy hansna kam kar do aur adhik rone lago.

Anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko apne saathiyon ke baare mein koi baat pahunchi, to aap ne bhaashan diya aur is dauraan farmaya : "Mere saamne Jannat evn Jahannam ko pesh kiya gaya, to main ne bhalaai evn buraai ke maamle mein aaj ke jaisa din nahin dekha. Agar tum woh baaten jaan lo, jo main jaanta hoon to awashy hansna kam kar do aur adhik rone lago." Warnankarta kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saathiyon ke saamne usse zyaada kathin din kabhi nahin aya. Woh kahte hain : We apne saron ko chhipaakar phoot-phootkar rone lage. Warnankarta kahte hain : Yeh dekh umar -radiyallahu anhu- khare hue aur kahne lage : Ham Allah ko apna paalanhaar maankar, Islam ko apna deen maankar aur Muhammad ko apna Nabi maankar santusht hain. Warnankarta kahta hai : Iske baad woh vyakti khara hua aur poochha : Mera pita kaun hai? Aapne uttar diya : "Tera pita amuk hai." Is pariprekshy mein yeh ayat utri : (Ai logo jo eemaan laye ho! Un wastuon ke baare mein jijnaasa na karo jo yadi tumhaare saamne spasht kar di jayen to tumhen buri lagne lagen.) [soora maaida : 101]

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko apne saathiyon ke baare mein ek baat pahunchi. Baat yeh thi ki unhonne aapse bahut zyaada maanga. Atah aap krodhit hue aur waktavy diya tatha farmaya : Mere saamne Jannat evn Jahannam ko laya gaya, to mainne Jannat mein aaj se adhik bhalaai nahin dekhi tatha Jahannam mein aaj se adhik buraai nahin dekhi. Mainne jo kuchh dekha hai, agar tum dekh lo, aur aaj tatha isse pahle dekhi hui cheezon mein se main jo kuchh jaanta hoon agar tum jaan lo, to tum bahut zyaada dar jaao, tumhaara hansna kam ho jaye aur rona zyaada ho jaye. Anas radiyallahu anhu ne farmaya : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saathiyon ke saamne usse kathin din kabhi nahin aya tha. Unhonne apne sar dhaanp liye aur rone lage, jiski aawaaz unki naak se nikal rahi thi. Atah umar radiyallahu anhu khare hue aur kahne lage : "Ham is baat se santusht hain ki Allah hamaara paalanhaar hai, Islam hamaara deen hai tatha Muhammad hamaare Nabi hain." Warnankarta ka kahna hai ki woh vyakti khara hua aur poochha : Mera pita kaun hai?

Aapne uttar diya : "Tera pita amuk hai." Chunaanche yeh ayat utri : "Ai eemaan waalo! Aisi bahut-si cheezon ke wishay mein prashn na karo, jo yadi tumhen bata di jayen, to tumhen bura lag jaye." [soora maaida : 101]

Allah ke dand ke bhay se rona tatha adhik na hansna musathab hai, kyonki adhik hansna achetna tatha hriday ke kathor hone ka pramaan hai.
Sahaaba ka updesh se prabhaawit hona tatha unke andar paya jaane waala sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ke dand ka teevr bhay.
Rote samay chehra dhaanpna musathab hai.
Khattaabi kahte hain : Yeh hadees us vyakti ke baare mein hai, jo  apna warchasv sthaapit karne ya saamne waale ko neecha dikhaane ke liye kisi aisi cheez ke baare mein poochhe, jiski use aawashyakta na ho. Jahaan tak us vyakti ki baat hai jo saamne koi samasya aane par majboori mein  uske baare mein poochhta ho, to uspar koi paap ya dosh nahin hai.
Allah ke aajnaapaalan ke maarg par chalte rahne, uski awajna se door rahne aur uski or se nirdhaarit seemaaon par ruk jaane ki prerna.
Updesh tatha shiksha dete samay krodhit hona jayaz hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4815: Use qatl na karo. Agar tum use qatl kar doge, to woh us sthaan par a jayega, jispar uska qatl karne se pahle tum the aur tum us sthaan par chale jaaoge, jispar woh is waaky ko kahne se pahle tha.

Miqdaad bin amr kindi razyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki: Unhonne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe bataaiye ki agar mera kisi kaafir se saamna ho jaye aur ham ek-doosre se laraai shuru kar den tatha woh mere ek haath par talvaar maarkar use kaat de evn uske baad mujhse bachne ke liye ek per ki aar mein chhup jaye aur kahne lage ki mainne Allah ke liye Islam qabool kar liya, to kya main aisa kahne ke baad uska qalt kar doon? Aapne farmaya : "Use qatm mat karo." Mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Usne to mera ek haath kaat diya aur haath kaatne ke baad aisa kaha? (Kya phir bhi use qatl nahin karna chahiye?) aapne farmaya : "Use qatl na karo. Agar tum use qatl kar doge, to woh us sthaan par a jayega, jispar uska qatl karne se pahle tum the aur tum us sthaan par chale jaaoge, jispar woh is waaky ko kahne se pahle tha."

Miqdaad bin asvad radiyallahu anhu ne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochha ki jab jang ke maidaan mein unka saamna kisi kaafir se ho jaye, donon apni-apni talvaar lekar ek-doosre se bhir jayen, kaafir unke ek haath par talvaar maarkar use kaat de, phir bhaagkar ek per ki aar le le aur is baat ki gawaahi dene ke liye ki Allah ke atirikt koi ibaadat ke layaq nahin hai, to kya mere liye uska qatl halaal hoga, jabki usne mera haath kaat diya hai?

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unse kaha : Tum uska qatl mat karo.

Uttar sunkar unhonne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Usne mera ek haath kaat diya, iske baavjood main uska qatl na karoon?

Aapne kaha : Tum uska qatl mat karo. Kyonki ab uska rakt bahaana haraam ho chuka hai. Agar musalmaan ho jaane ke baad bhi tum uska qatl kar doge, to musalmaan ho jaane ke kaaran maasoom thahra, jabki usqa qatl karne ke kaaran qisaas ke taur par khud tumhaara khoon halaal ho gaya.

Jis vyakti ki or se Islam grahan kar lene ka sanket dene waala koi kaary ya kathan saamne aye, uski hatya haraam hai.
Jab yuddh ke dauraan koi kaafir musalmaan ban jaye to uska khoon surakshit ho jaata hai aur use maarne se bachna aawashyak ho jaata hai. Haan, yadi yeh spasht ho ki maamla iske wipreet hai, to yeh alag baat hai.
Ek musalmaan ke liye yeh aniwaary hai ki woh apni ichchhaaon ko shareeyat ke adheen rakhe, na ki ghrina aur badle ki bhaavna ke adheen.
Ibn hajar kahte hain : Is baat ko maddenzar rakhte hue ki is hadees mein jis ghatna ke baare mein poochha gaya hai, woh ghatit nahin hui thi, is hadees se yeh tark liya jaata hai ki kisi ghatna ke ghatit hone se pahle uske baare mein poochha ja sakta hai aur kuchh salaf (sadaachaari poorvajon) ke ise naapsand karne ko aisi ghatnaaon ke sandarbh mein dekha ja sakta hai, jo kabhi-kabhaar hi saamne aati hain. Jo ghatnayen aam taur par saamne a jaati hon, unke baare mein sharai drishtikon jaanne ke liye poochha ja sakta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4816: Ai usaama! Tumne use 'la ilaaha illallah' kahne ke baad bhi maar diya?

Usaama bin zaid- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen juhaina qabeele ki hurqa shaakha ki or bheja. Ham subh ke samay unke jalasroton par ja pahunche aur main tatha ek ansaari sahaabi unke ek aadmi se ja mile. Jab hamne use apne qabze mein le liya to usne 'la ilaaha illallah' kah diya. Yeh sun ansaari sahaabi ne usse apna haath rok liya, lekin mainne uspar apne neze se aakraman kiya aur use maar daala. Jab ham madeena pahunche aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko iski soochna mili to mujhse kahaah ai usaama, tumne use 'la ilaaha illallah' kahne ke baad bhi maar diya? Yeh baat aapne itni baar dohraai ki main kaamna karne laga ki kaash! Us din se pahle musalmaan na hua hota.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah kya usne 'la ilaaha illallah' kaha aur tumne use maar daala? Mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Usne kewal hathiyaar ke dar se kaha tha. To farmayaah tumne uska seena cheerkar kyon nahin dekha, taaki jaan lete ki usne dil se kaha tha ya nahin? Aapne yeh baat itni baar dohraai ki main kaamna karne laga ki kaash usi din musalmaan hua hota!
Tatha jundub bin abdullah- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek mushrik qabeele ki or ek Muslim sainyadal bheja aur donon dalon ki muthbher ho gai. Mushrikon mein ek vyakti tha, jab woh kisi musalmaan ko qatl karna chaahta to use mauqa paakar qatl kar deta. Yeh dekh musalmaanon mein se ek vyakti uski ghaflat ki taak mein rahne laga. Ham aapas mein baat karte the ki yeh usaama bin zaid hain. To jab mauqa paakar unhonne uspar talvaar uthaai, to usne 'la ilaaha illallah' kah diya. Lekin, unhonne use qatl kar diya. Phir, jab (yuddh mein wijay praapt hone ke baad) shubh soochna deेne waala Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya aur aapne usse haalaat poochhe to usne sab kuchh bataya. Yahaan tak ki us vyakti ki baat bhi suna di ki unhonne kya kuchh kiya tha. Yeh sunkar aapne unhen bulaya aur is ghatna ke sanbandh mein poochha. Farmayaah tumne uska qatl kyon kiya? Unhonne kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool, usne musalmaanon ko bara kasht diya tha aur hamaare amuk evn amuk vyakti ko maar daala tha. Unhonne kuchh logon ke naam bhi ginaye aur kaha ki isliye mainne uspar aakraman kar diya. Jab usne talvaar dekhi, to 'la ilaaha illallah' parh diya. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah kya toone use maar daala? Unhonne kahaah haan! Aapne farmayaah jab 'la ilaaha illallah' qayaamat ke din ayega, to tum uska kya karoge? Unhonne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, mere liye kshama yaachna keejiye. To farmayaah jab 'la ilaaha illallah' qayaamat ke din ayega, to tum uska kya karoge? Aap baar-baar itna hi kahe ja rahe the ki jab 'la ilaaha illallah' qayaamat ke din ayega, to tum uska kya karoge?

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne usaama bin zaid -radiyallahu anhu- ko ek sainyadal ke saath juhaina qabeele ki hurqa shaakha ki or bheja. Jab yeh log hurqa waalon ke paas pahunch gae aur unpar haawi ho gae, to ek mushrik bhaagne laga. Usaama evn ek ansaari vyakti uska wadh karne ke iraade se uske peechhe daure aur uske paas pahunch gae. Jab use pakar liya gaya, to usne la ilaaha illallah kah diya. Yeh dekh ansaari ne use chhor diya, lekin usaama ne uska wadh kar diya. Jab sab log madeena waapas aye aur iski soochna Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko mili, to usaama se kaha : "Tumne use 'la ilaaha illallah' kahne ke baad bhi maar diya?" Unhonne uttar diya ki haan ai Allah ke Rasool, mainne aisa kiya hai, kyonki usne la ilaaha illallah wadh kiye jaane ke bhay se kaha tha. Uska uddeshy ise dhaal banaakar qatl se bachna tha. Lekin aapne phir se yahi kaha : "Tumne use 'la ilaaha illallah' kahne ke baad bhi maar diya?" Unhonne phir se uttar diya ki usne la ilaaha illallah maare jaane se bachne ke liye kaha tha, usne musalmaanon ko kasht pahunchaya tha aur amuk-amuk musalmaanon ko maar diya tha. Yeh sun Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unse kaha : Tumne sachchaai se avgat hone ke liye uske seene ko cheer kar kyon nahin dekha? Jab qayaamat ke din la ilaaha illallah saamne a khara hoga, to tum uska kya karoge? Kaun tumhaare liye sifaarish karega? Us samay tumhaari or se kaun uttar dega, jab kalima-e-tauheed ko laya jayega aur tumse kaha jayega ki ise kahne waale vyakti ko tumne kaise maar daala?
Usaama -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain : Yeh sab sun main kaamna karne laga ki kaash aaj se pahle main musalmaan na hua hota! Unhonne aisi kaamna isliye ki, kyonki yadi kaafir hote aur phir Islam grahan karte, to Allah maaf kar deta. Lekin unse yeh kaam musalmaan hone ki awastha mein hua tha.
[ise imaam Muslim ne donon riwayton ke saath naqal kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4817: Ek bande ne ek gunaah kiya aur uske baad kaha : Ai Allah, mujhe mere gunaah kshama kar de

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apne sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan rab se riwayat karte hue kahte hain : "Ek bande ne ek gunaah kiya aur uske baad kaha : Ai Allah, mujhe mere gunaah kshama kar de! To barkat waale evn mahaan Allah ne kaha : Mere bande ne ek gunaah kiya, phir usne jaana ki uska rab gunaah maaf karta hai aur gunaah ke kaaran pakarta bhi hai. Phir usne dobaara gunaah kiya aur kaha : Ai mere rab, mujhe mere gunaah maaf kar de! To barkat waale evn mahaan Allah ne kaha : Mere bande ne gunaah kiya aur jaana ki uska rab gunaah maaf karta hai aur uske kaaran pakarta bhi hai. Mainne apne bande ko maaf kar diya. Ab woh jo chaahe, kare."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apne rab se riwayat karte hue kahte hain ki banda jab koi gunaah kar baithta hai aur uske baad kahta hai ki ai mere Allah! Mujhe kshama kar de! To Allah kahta hai : Mere bande ne gunaah kiya aur uska wishvaas hai ki uska rab hai, jo gunaah maaf karta hai ya uska dand deta hai. Atah mainne use maaf kar diya. Phir jab banda dobaara gunaah karta hai aur kahta hai ki ai mere rab! Mujhe kshama kar de, to Allah kahta hai ki mere bande ne gunaah kiya aur uska wishvaas hai ki uska rab hai, jo gunaah maaf karta hai ya uski saza deta hai, atah mainne apne bande ko maaf kar diya. Jab banda phir gunaah karta hai aur kahta hai ki ai mere rab! Mujhe kshama kar de, to Allah kahta hai ki mere bande ne gunaah kiya aur uska wishvaas hai ki uska rab hai, jo gunaah maaf karta hai ya uski saza deta hai, atah mainne apne bande ko maaf kar diya. Ab woh jo chaahe kare, jab tak sthiti yeh ho ki har baar gunaah karne ke baad woh fauran gunaah ko chhor de, sharminda ho aur dobaara gunaah na karne ka iraada kar le, lekin nafs ke bahkaawe mein aakar phir gunaah kar baithe. Jab tak yeh sthiti bani rahe, yaani gunaah kare aur tauba kare, to main use maaf karta rahoonga. Kyonki tauba pahle kiye hue gunaahon ko khatm kar deti hai.

Allah ka wishaal anugrah ki insaan jo bhi ghalti kare aur jo bhi kaam kare, jab Allah ki or lautta hai aur uske saamne tauba karta hai, to Allah uski tauba ko grahan karta hai.
Allah par eemaan rakhne waala vyakti uski kshama ki aasha rakhta hai aur uske dand se darta hai, isliye woh gunaah karte jaane ki bajay jaldi se tauba kar leta hai.
Sahi tauba ki sharten : Jo gunaah kar raha tha use chhor dena, uspar sharminda hona aur dobaara use na karne ka pakka iraada karna. Agar tauba ka sanbandh bande ke kisi adhikaar, maslan maal, izzat-aabru aur jaan se ho, to ek chauthi shart barh jaati hai. Woh shart hai, haq waale ko uska haq de dena ya usse maafi kara lena.
Allah ka jnaan rakhne ka mahatv, jo bande ko deeni masayal ka jaankaar banaata hai aur jiske nateeje mein banda har baar ghalti karne ke baad tauba kar leta hai. Woh na to Allah ki daya se niraash hota hai aur na gunaah mein aage barhta jaata hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4820: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne jitne yuddh kiye, main unmen se kisi yuddh mein bhi shareek hone se peechhe nahin raha. Main kewal tabook yuddh mein peechhe rah gaya tha. Waise to badr yuddh mein bhi saath nahin tha, lekin badr yuddh mein peechhe rah jaane par aapne kisi par naaraazgi vyakt nahin ki thi.

Abdullah bin kaab bin maalik riwayat karte hain. Yaad rahe ki jab kaab bin maalik ki aankhon ki roshni chali gai, to unke beton mein se abdullah hi unhen jahaan jaana-aana hota le jaate. Woh kahte hain ki mainne kaab bin maalik se tabook yuddh mein unke Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se peechhe rah jaane ki ghatna suni. Kaab bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- ne batayaah Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne jitne yuddh kiye, main unmen se kisi yuddh mein bhi shareek hone se peechhe nahin raha. Main kewal tabook yuddh mein peechhe rah gaya tha. Waise to badr yuddh mein bhi saath nahin tha, lekin badr yuddh mein peechhe rah jaane par aapne kisi par naaraazgi vyakt nahin ki thi, kyonki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) quraish ke ek qaafile ko dabochne ka iraada karke nikle the aur Allah ne pahle se samay nirdhaarit kiye bina hi musalmaanon ka saamna shatru se kara diya tha. Main to aqba ki raat bhi Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath maujood tha, jahaan hamne Islam par qayam rahne ki pratijna li thi. Yadyapi logon mein badr yuddh ki charcha adhik hai, lekin main yeh baat pasand nahin karta ki mujhe aqba ki raat ke badle badr yuddh mein saath rahne ka avsar mila hota.
Tabook yuddh mein Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se peechhe rahne ki ghatna is prakaar hai ki main jis zamaane mein tabook yuddh se peechhe raha, us samay itna shaktishaali aur sanpann tha ki pahle kabhi nahin hua tha. Allah ki qasam! Usse pahle mere paas do oontniyaan kabhi ekatr nahin hui theen, jabki is avsar par mere paas do oontniyaan maujood theen. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka siddhaant yeh tha ki jab kisi yuddh mein jaane ka iraada karte, to use poore taur par zaahir na hone dete the balki kisi doosre sthaan ka naam lete. Parantu, yeh yuddh choonki prachand garmi mein hua aur yaatra lanbi tatha marubhoomi ki thi aur shatru ki bhaari sankhya ka saamna tha, isliye aapne musalmaanon ke saamne maamla spasht kar diya, taaki we achchhi tarah yuddh ki taiyaari kar len. Unhen woh disha bhi bata di, jidhar aapko jaana tha. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath musalmaan bari sankhya mein the aur koi panji nahin thi, jo unke naamon ko surakshit rakhti. Kaab (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hainh sthiti aisi thi ki yadi koi vyakti yuddh se anupasthit rahna chaahta, woh yeh soch sakta tha ki yadi wahy ke dvaara aapko soochna na di gai to kisi ko meri anupasthiti ka pata na chal sakega. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne us yuddh ka iraada aise samay mein kiya tha, jab phal pak chuke the aur peron ke saye bare manoram lag rahe the tatha main unki or khinchaav mahsoos kar raha tha. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne aur aapke saath musalmaanon ne taiyaari shuru kar di. Meri haalat yeh thi ki main subh ko is iraade se nikalta ki main bhi aapke saath milkar taiyaari karoonga, lekin shaam ko waapas aata to koi nirnay na liya hota. Phir main apne dil mein kahta ki main jab chaahoon, taiyaari kar sakta hoon. Isi tarah mera samay beetta gaya aur log poori tanmayta se taiyaari mein lage rahe. Phir ek din subh ke samay Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur aapke saath musalmaan nikal pare, jabki main apni taiyaari ke baare mein koi nirnay na le saka. Main subh ko aya aur waapas ho gaya, koi faisla na kar saka. Mere saath yahi asmanjas ki sthiti bani rahi, yahaan tak ki log tezi se nikal gae aur yuddh mein shaamil hone ka samay haath se nikal gaya. Phir mainne yeh iraada kiya ki main bhi chal paroon aur unse ja miloon. Kaash, aisa bhi kar liya hota. Lekin yeh saubhaagy bhi praapt na kar saka. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke jaane ke baad jab main logon ke beech nikalta to jo baat mere duhkh ka kaaran banti, yeh thi ki mujhe apna koi aadarsh nazar nahin a raha tha, siwaye us vyakti ke jispar munaafiq hone ka laanchhan laga hua tha ya aise kamzor logon ke jinhen Allah ne asmarth ghoshit kar rakha tha. Udhar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne tabook pahunchne se pahle raaste mein mujhe kaheen yaad nahin kiya, yahaan tak ki jab tabook pahunch gae, to wahaan logon ke saath baithkar kahaah kaab bin maalik ne kya kiya? Banu salma ke ek vyakti ne kahaah Allah ke Rasool! Use uski do chaadron ne rok rakha hai aur woh apne donon pahluon ko dekhne mein vyast hoga. Yeh sun muaaz bin jabal- radiyallahu anhu- ne kahaah tumne bahut buri baat kahi hai. Allah ke Rasool! Hamne uske andar bhalaai ke siwa kuchh nahin dekha. Yeh baat-cheet sunkar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) khaamosh ho gae. Yeh baaten ho rahi theen ki aapne ek safedposh vyakti ko mareechika ko cheerte hue aate dekha aur farmayaah abu khaisma ho ja. Dekha gaya ki woh abu khaisma ansaari hi the. Yeh wahi sahaabi hain, jinke ek saa khajoor daan karne par munaafiqon ne kataaksh kiya tha.
Kaab- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hainh jab mujhe yeh soochna mili ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) tabook se waapsi ke liye nikal pare hain to main dukh se ghir gaya aur jhoothe bahaane banaane ka sochne laga aur man hi man kahne laga ki main kal aapki naaraazgi se kaise bach sakta hoon? Is sanbandh mein apne pariwaar ke pratyek samajhdaar vyakti se madad maangne laga. Phir jab yeh kaha gaya ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aane hi waale hain, to mujhse sab jhooth jaata raha aur main samajh gaya ki aapki naaraazgi se main kisi tarah bach nahin sakta. Mainne aapse sach bolne ka pakka iraada kar liya. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) subh ke samay aye. Aapka siddhaant tha ki jab yaatra se waapas aate to pahle masjid jaate, do rakaat namaz parhte aur logon se milne ke liye baith jaate. Jab aapne aisa kiya to peechhe rah jaane waale log aakar bahaane pesh karne aur qasmen khaane lage. Is tarah ke log assi se kuchh adhik the. Aapne, unhonne jo kuchh zaahir kiya, use maan liya, unse baiat li aur unke liye kshama yaachna ki aur unke dil mein chhipi baaton ko Allah ke hawaale kar diya. Phir main upasthit hua. Mainne salaam kiya to naaraaz vyakti ke andaaz mein muskuraye aur farmayaah a jaao. Main aakar aapke saamne baith gaya to mujhse farmayaah tum kyon peechhe rah gae the? Kya tumne apni sawaari nahin khareedi thi? Kaab (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne kahaah Allah ke Rasool, Allah ki qasam, agar main aapke siwa duniya ke kisi aur vyakti ke saamne baitha hota, to main samajhta hoon ki koi bahaana banaakar uski naaraazgi se bach sakta tha, kyonki main baat karne ke maamle mein nipun hoon. Lekin Allah ki qasam, mujhe pata hai ki yadi aaj mainne aapse jhoothi baat bayaan ki jisse aap mujhse raazi ho jayen, to kuchh door nahin ki Allah aapko mujhse naaraaz kar de. Aur agar aapse sachchi baat bayaan ki, jisse aap mujhse naaraaz ho jayen, lekin usmen main shaktishaali evn mahaan Allah ki or se achchhe parinaam ki aasha rakhta hoon. Allah ki qasam, mere saath koi asmarthata nahin thi. Allah ki qasam, main shakti aur sanpannata ke maamle mein, aapse peechhe rahne ke samay se behtar kabhi nahin raha. Kaab (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki yeh sun Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah isne sab kuchh sach-sach bata diya hai. Ab jaao, prateeksha karo, yahaan tak ki Allah tumhaare baare mein koi nirnay kar de. Banu salma ke kuchh log chal pare. Woh mere peechhe-peechhe chal rahe the aur kahe ja rahe theh Allah ki qasam, hamen nahin pata ki tumne isse pahle koi gunaah kiya ho. Tumse to itna bhi na ho saka ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saamne us tarah ka koi bahaana pesh kar dete, jo aur peechhe rahne waalon ne pesh kiye hain. Tumhaare liye Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki kshama yaachna kaafi ho jaati. Kaab- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki unhonne mujhe itna kosa ki mainne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas waapas jaakar khud ko jhuthla dene ka iraada kar liya. Phir mainne un logon se poochha ki kya mere atirikt bhi kisi ko is paristhiti ka saamna hai? Unhonne kahaah haan, tumhaare saath aur do logon ko is paristhiti ka saamna hai. Unhonne bhi usi tarah ki baat kahi hai, jo tumne kahi hai aur unhen bhi usi tarah ka uttar mila hai, jo tumhen mila hai. Woh kahte hain ki mainne poochhaah woh donon vyakti kaun hain? Unhonne jawaab diyaah muraara bin rabi amri aur hilaal bin umayya waaqifi hain. Unhonne mere saamne do aise aadmiyon ke naam liye, jo satkarmi the aur badr yuddh mein shareek ho chuke the tatha woh mere liye aadarsh ho sakte the. Jab un logon ne mujhse un donon ka zikr kiya, to main (iraada badalne ke bajay) apne poorv ke iraade par qayam raha. Uske baad Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne peechhe rahne waalon mein se ham teen logon se baat karne se mana kar diya. Atah log hamse bachne lage (ya kaha ki log hamaare liye badal gae). Yahaan tak ki dharti mere liye paraai ban gai. Yeh woh dharti nahin rah gai thi, jise main jaanta tha. Isi awastha mein ham pachaas din rahe. Mere donon saathi to nidhaal ho gae aur ghar baithkar rote rahe, lekin main un logon se jawaan aur mazboot tha. Main baahar nikalta, musalmaanon ke saath namaz mein shaamil hota aur baazaaron mein ghoomta, lekin koi mujhse baat nahin karta. Jab Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- namaz ke baad masjid mein baithe hote, to main aapke paas jaakar salaam karta aur man hi man yeh sochta rahta ki aapne salaam ke uttar mein hont hilaye ya nahin? Phir main aapke nikat hi namaz parhne lagta aur nazar bachaakar aapko dekhta rahta. Jab main namaz par dhyaan de deta, to aap meri or dekhte aur jab main aapki or dekhta, to nazar pher lete. Jab mujhse musalmaanon ki berukhi ka maamla khinchta chala gaya, to ek din main abu qataada ke baag ki deewaar phalaangkar andar chala gaya. Woh mere chachere bhaai aur sabse priy dost the. Mainne use salaam kiya to Allah ki qasam khaakar kahta hoon ki usne mere salaam ka uttar nahin diya. Mainne usse kaha ki abu qataada, main tujhe Allah ka waasta dekar poochhta hoon, kya tu jaanta hai ki main Allah aur uske Rasool - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se pyaar karta hoon. Usne koi uttar nahin diya. Mainne dobaara poochha, lekin woh khaamosh raha. Mainne phir poochha, to usne kahaah Allah aur uske Rasool hi behtar jaante hain. Uska uttar sun meri aankhen bhar aaeen. Main deewaar phaandkar waapas a gaya. Ek din main madeene ke baazaar se guzar raha tha ki shaam ka ek nabti, jo galla bechne ke liye madeena aya tha, kah raha tha ki mujhe kaab bin maalik ka pata kaun bata sakta hai? Aise mein, log meri or ishaara karke use bataane lage. Woh mere paas aya aur mujhe ghassaan ke raaja ka ek patr diya. Mujhe parhna-likhna aata tha. Use parha, to usmen likha thaah "Amma baad, mujhe khabar mili hai ki tumhaare saathi ne tumpar atyaachaar kiya hai. Haalaanki Allah ne tumhen apmaan aur barbaadi ka paatr nahin banaya hai. Tum hamaare paas chale aao, ham tumhaara duhkh-dard baant lenge." Use parhne ke baad mainne kahaah yeh bhi ek pareeksha hai. Main woh patr lekar tannoor ke paas gaya aur use usmen jhonk diya. Phir jab pachaas mein se chaalees dil beet gae aur wahy ke awatran ka silsila band ho gaya, to achaanak ek din mere paas Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka sandeshvaahak aya aur kahaah Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne aapko apni patni se alag rahne ka aadesh diya hai. Mainne kahaah main use talaak de doon ya kya karoon? Usne kahaah talaak na do, sirf usse alag raho aur uske nikat na jaao. Mere donon saathiyon ko bhi isi tarah ka aadesh diya gaya tha. Mainne apni patni se kahaah tum maike chali jaao aur is maamle mein koi nirnay aane tak waheen raho. Phir hilaal bin umayya ki patni Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aai aur kahne lageeh ai Allah ke Rasool, hilaal bin umayya ek bahut boorhe aur kamzor vyakti hain. Unke paas sewa ke liye koi naukar bhi nahin hai. Kya aap naapsand karenge ki main unki sewa karoon? Aapne farmayaah "Nahin, lekin woh tere nikat na aye." Usne kahaah Allah ki qasam, unhen to kisi baat ka hosh bhi nahin hai. Jis din yeh ghatna ghati hai, us din se aaj tak nirantar roe ja rahe hain. Yeh sun mere pariwaar ke kuchh logon ne mujhse kaha ki agar tum bhi Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sall- se apni patni ke baare mein anumti le lo to kya buraai hai? Aapne to hilaal bin umayya ki patni ko unki sewa karne ki anumti de di hai. Mainne kahaah main Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se uske baare mein anumti nahin maangoonga. Pata nahin mere anumti maangne par aap kya jawaab denge, jabki main ek jawaan vyakti hoon. Isi awastha mein das din beet gae aur hamse baat-cheet band kiye jaane ko pachaas din poore ho gae. Pachaasveen raat ki subah ko main apne ek ghar ki chhat par fajr ki namaz parhkar baitha hua tha aur meri haalat hoobhu wahi thi jo Allah ne bayaan ki hai ki main apni jaan se tang tha dharti apne wistaar ke baavjood mujhpar tang ho chuki thi ki achaanak mainne kisi pukaarne waale ki aawaaz suni, jo sila parvat ke oopar charhkar apni poori aawaaz mein pukaar raha thaah kaab bin maalik khush ho jaao. Main yeh sunte hi sajde mein gir gaya aur samajh gaya ki pareeksha ka samay samaapt ho gaya hai. Daraasal Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne fazr ki namaz ke baad hamaari tauba kabool hone ka ailaan kar diya tha. Atah log hamen shubh soochna dene ke liye daur pare. Kuchh log shoobh soochna dene ke liye mere donon saathiyon ki or chal diye aur ek aadmi meri or ghore par sawaar hokar chal para. Isi beech aslam qabeele ka ek vyakti daurta hua meri or nikla aur pahaar par charhkar awaaz laga di. Aawaaz ghore se tez nikli. Jiski aawaaz mainne suni thi, jab woh mujhe khushkhabri dene ke liye aya, to mainne apne donon kapre utaarkar khushkhabri sunaane ke badle mein use pahna diye. Allah ki qasam, us din mere paas un donon kapron ke alaawa aur koi kapra nahin tha. Mainne do kapre udhaar lekar pahne aur Allah ke Rasool - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke iraade se chal para. Log dalon mein mujhse mil rahe the aur tauba kabool hone ki mubaarakbaad dete hue kah rahe theh tumhen mubaarak ho ki Allah ne tumhaari tauba kabool kar li. Main masjid mein gaya to dekha ki Allah ke Rasool - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- logon ke saath baithe hue hain. Mujhe dekh talha bin ubaidullah daurte hue aye, mujhse haath milaya aur mubaarakbaad di. Allah ki qasam unke siwa koi muhaajir khara nahin hua. Kaab- radiyallahu anhu- talha - radiyallahu anhu- ki is garmajoshi ko kabhi na bhoolte the. Kaab- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki jab mainne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko salaam kiya, to aapne khushi se damakte hue chehre ke saath farmayaah "Tumhen yeh din mubaarak ho, jo tumhaare jeewan ka, jabse tumhaari maan ne tumhen jana hai, sabse uttam din hai." Mainne kahaah Allah ke Rasool, yeh aapki or se hai ya Allah ki or se? Farmayaah "Meri or se nahin, balki sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ki or se." Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- prasann hote, to aapka chehra aise damak uthta, jaise chaand ka tukra ho. Ham aapke cherhe se aapki prasannata ko bhaanp lete the. Jab main aapke aage baith gaya, to kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool, is tauba ki khushi mein main chaahta hoon ki apna saara maal Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye daan kar doon. Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Sab nahin, apna kuchh dhan apne paas bhi rakho. Yeh tumhaare liye behtar hai." Mainne kahaah main khaibar ka apna hissa apne paas rakhta hoon. Tatha mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, Allah ne mujhe saty ke kaaran mukti di hai aur main apni tauba ki khushi mein yeh pratijna karta hoon ki jab tak jeewit rahoonga, kabhi jhooth nahin boloonga. Allah ki qasam, jabse mainne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se is pratijna ka zikr kiya, main kisi musalmaan ko nahin jaanta, jispar Allah ne sach kahne kar kaaran utna upkaar kiya ho, jitna mujhpar kiya hai. Allah ki qasam, jabse mainne Allah ke Rasool - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se yeh baat kahi, us din se aaj tak mainne jhooth nahin bola aur aasha hai ki Allah jeewan ke baaki bache hue dinon mein bhi mujhe isse surakshit rakhega. Woh kahte hain ki iske baad Allah ne yeh ayten utaareenh "Allah ne Nabi tatha muhaajireen aur ansaar par daya ki, jinhonne tangi ke samay aapka saath diya, iske pashchaat ki unmen se kuchh logon ke dil kutil hone lage the. Phir unpar daya ki. Nishchay woh unke liye karunaamay dayaawaan hai. Tatha un teenon par, jinka maamla wilanbit kar diya gaya tha aur jinpar dharti apne wistaar ke baavjood tang ho gai aur unpar unke praan sankeern ho gae aur unhen wishvaas tha ki Allah ke siwa unke liye koi sharnaagaar nahin hai, parantu usi ki or. Phir unpar daya ki, taaki tauba kar len. Waastav mein Allah ati kshamaasheel dayaawaan hai. Ai eemaan waalo, Allah se daro, tatha sachchon ke saath ho jaao." (Soora at-taubaah 177-119) kaab - radiyallahu anhu- kahte hainh Allah ki qasam, jabse Allah ne mujh Islam ki raah dikhaai hai, uske baad se Allah ne mujhe jo nemten pradaan ki hain, unmen meri nazar mein, sabse bari nemat yeh hai ki mujhe Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke aage sach bolne ki saamarthy pradaan ki gai aur main jhooth bolkar halaak na hua, jaise doosre woh log halaak ho gae, jinhonne jhooth bola tha. Kyonki Allah taaala ne wahy utaarte samay jhooth bolne waalon ke baare mein aise bure shabd prayog kiye hain, jo kisi aur ke baare mein prayog nahin kiye. Allah taaala ne farmayaah "Woh tumhaare saamne Allah ki qasam khayenge, jab tum unki or waapas aaoge, taaki tum unse wimukh ho jaao, to tum unse wimukh ho jaao, waastav mein we maleen hain aur unka aawaas narak hai, un karmon ke badle jo we kya karte the. We tumhaare saamne qasmen khayenge, taaki tum unse raazi ho jaao, agar tum unse raazi ho bhi gae, to Allah awajnaakaari logon se raazi nahin hota." (Soora at-taubaah 95-96) kaab - radiyallahu anhu- kahte hainh daraasal Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ham teen logon ke maamle un logon se alag karke wilanbit kar diya tha, jinhonne aapke saamne jhoothi qasmen khaai theen. Aapne unse baiat le li thi aur unke haq mein maafi ki dua kar di thi. Jabki aapne hamaare maamle ko lanbit rakh diya, yahaan tak ki khud Allah ne nirnay kar diya. Farmayaah "وعلى الثلاثة الذين خلفوا" (Arthaat, un teen logon ki tauba bhi qabool kar li, jo peechhe kar diye gae the.) yahaan Allah ne jis peechhe karne ka zikr kiya hai, usse muraad hamaara yuddh se peechhe rahna nahin hai, balki jhoothi qasmen khaane waalon aur bahaane pesh karne waalon se hamaare maamle ko peechhe karke unki baat sveekaar kar lena hai. (Bukhari evn Muslim)
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- tabook yuddh ke liye wrihaspatiwaar ko nikle aur aapko wrihaspatiwaar ko nikalna pasand tha.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih aap yaatra se hamesha din mein chaasht ke samay waapas aate. Jab waapas aate to pahle masjid jaakar do rakaat namaz parhte aur uske baad waheen baith jaate.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4827: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka sabse priy wastr kurta tha.
Umme salma- radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka sabse priy wastr, kurta tha.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4828: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab dastarakhvaan uthaate to kahteh "الحَمْدُ للهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ، وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا". Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab dastarakhvaan uthaate to kahteh "الحَمْدُ للهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ، وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا".

Abu umaama- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab dastarakhvaan uthaate to kahteh "الحَمْدُ للهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ، وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا" (Arthaat, saari prashansayen Allah ki hain, bahut zyaada, svachchh aur barkat waali prashansa, woh sabke liye kaafi hai, use chhora nahin ja sakta, aur na hi koi teri prashansa se nisprih ho sakta hai).
4829: Jab kisi beemaari aadi ke kaaran, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki raat ki namaz chhoot jaati to din mein baarah rakaat parh lete the.
Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki jab kisi beemaari aadi ke kaaran, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki raat ki namaz chhoot jaati to din mein baarah rakaat parh lete the.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki aadat yeh thi jab kisi beemaari aadi ke kaaran aapki raat ki namaz chhoot jaati, to din mein baarah rakaat parh lete. Daraasal baat yeh hai ki aap raat mein gyaarah rakaat namaz parha karte the. Lekin jab raat guzar jaati aur neend ya is tarah ke kisi aur kaaran se raat ki maaz parh nahin paate, to uski qaza karte the. Lekin jab witr ka samay guzar gaya, to use jora parhna widhisammat ho gaya.
4830: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) raat mein itni der tak namaz mein khare rahte ki aapke donon paanv sooj jaate the.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- aur mugheera bin shoba- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) raat mein itni der tak namaz mein khare rahte ki aapke donon paanv sooj jaate the. Mainne aapse kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Aap aisa kyon karte hain, jabki Allah ne aapke agle-pichhle saare gunaah maaf kar diye hain? To farmayaah kya mujhe yeh achchha nahin legga ki main shukraguzaar banda banoon?
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4849: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne museebat ke samay cheekh-cheekh kar rone waali, baal mundvaane waali aur kapre phaarne waali aurton se apne bari hone ka elaan kiya hai.

Abu burda bin abu moosa se -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Abu moosa -radiyallahu anhu- bahut zyaada beemaar ho gae. Aur (beemaari itni sakht thi ki) behosh ho gae. Unka sar unke ghar ki ek aurat ki god mein tha, (jo oonchi aawaaz mein ro rahi thi) aur woh (behoshi ke kaaran) use koi jawaab na de sake. Atah jab hosh mein aye, to farmaya : Main un tamaam logon se apne bari hone ka elaan karta hoon, jinse Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bari hone ka elaan kiya hai. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne museebat ke samay cheekh-cheekh kar rone waali, baal mundvaane waali aur kapre phaarne waali aurton se apne bari hone ka elaan kiya hai.

Abu burda radiyallahu anhu bayaan karte hain ki unke pita abu moosa ash'ari radiyallahu anhu ek baar bahut beemaar ho gae. Beemaari itni sakht thi ki woh behosh ho gae. Us samay unka sar unke ghar ki kisi mahila ki god mein tha, jo unki beemaari dekhkar cheekh-cheekhkar rone lagi. Lekin, behoshi ke kaaran woh use kuchh kah nahin sake. Jab hosh mein aye, to farmaya : Main un tamaam logon se bari hone ka ailaan karta hoon, jinse khud Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bari hone ki baat kahi hai. Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne nimnalikhit striyon se bari hone ka izhaar kiya hai : Saaliqa : Museebat ke samay cheekh-cheekhkar rone waali stri. Haaliqa : Museebat ke masay baal murvaane waali stri. Shaaqqa : Museebat ke samay kapre phaarne waali stri. Kaaran yeh hai ki ye ajnaanta kaal ke kaary hain. Islam ka aadesh yeh hai ki museebton ke samay sabr se kaam liya jaye aur Allah se pratiphal ki aasha rakhi jaye.

Museebat ke samay kapra phaarne, baal mundvaane aur oonchi aawaaz mein rone ki manaahi. Ye bare gunaah hain.
Duhkh prakat karna aur rona haraam nahin hai, jab tak aawaaz oonchi na ho aur wilaap na ho. Yeh Allah ke nirnay ko dhairy ke saath sahan karne ke wipreet nahin hai. Yeh daraasal daya hai.
Allah ke kashtadayak nirnayon par kathan athva kaary dvaara asantosh aur krodh vyakt karna haraam hai.
Museebat ke samay sabr se kaam lena zaroori hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4850: Jisne lahsun ya pyaaz khaya ho woh hamse door rahe - ya farmaya : - hamaari masjid se door rahe aur apne ghar mein baitha rahe.

Jaabir bin abdullah radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne lahsun ya pyaaz khaya ho woh hamse door rahe - ya farmaya : - hamaari masjid se door rahe aur apne ghar mein baitha rahe." Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas ek haandi laai gai, jismen kuchh sabziyaan theen. Aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko unki gandh aai, to unke baare mein poochha. Tab aapko usmen maujood sabziyon ke baare mein bataya gaya, to aapne unhen apne kisi sahaabi ke qareeb kar dene ko kaha, jo us samay aapke saath maujood the. Jab us sahaabi ne (jinhen ye sabziyaan di gai theen) unhen dekha, to unhonne bhi unhen khaane ko naapsand kiya. Ispar aapne kaha : "Tum kha lo. Kyonki main us hasti se baat karta hoon, jisse tum nahin karte." Saheeh Muslim ki ek riwayat mein jaabir radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne yeh sabzi yaani lahsun khaai ho -ek baar farmaya : Jisne pyaaz, lahsun ya gandna khaai ho, woh hamaari masjid ke qareeb na aye. Kyonki farishton ko bhi un cheezon se kasht hota hai, jinse insaanon ko kasht hota hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne pyaaj ya lahsun khaane waale vyakti ko masjid mein aane se mana kiya hai, taaki in donon cheejon ki durgandh se masjid mein namaz parhne aye any bhaaiyon ko pareshaani na ho. Yaad rahe ki yeh manaahi khaaskar masjid jaane ki hai. Khaane ki nahin. Kyonki in donon cheezon ka khaana jayaz hai. Ek baar aisa hua ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke samaane sabziyon ki ek haandi rakhi gai. Jab aapne sabzi ke andar gandh mahsoos ki aur aapko bataya gaya ki usmen kya hai, to unhen khaya nahin aur apne kisi sahaabi ki or barha diya ki woh kha len. Jab aapka anusran karte hue unhonne bhi khaana pasand nahin kiya aur aapne yeh drishy dekha to unse kaha ki tum kha lo. Main isliye nahin kha raha hoon ki mujhe farishton se baat karna hota hai.

Aapne bataya ki insaanon ki tarah farishton ko bhi badboodaar cheezon se kasht hota hai.

Aise vyakti ke liye masjid aane ki manaahi, jisne lahsun, pyaaz ya gandna khaai ho.
In cheezon ke saath sigret evn tanbaaku aadi un tamaam badboodaar cheezon ko bhi mila diya jayega, jo namaaziyon ke liye kasht ka kaaran banti hain.
Manaahi ka kaaran badbu hai. Agar achchhe se pakaane ya any kisi kaaran se badbu door ho jaye, to karaahat khatm ho jayegi.
Jis vyakti par masjid mein aakar namaz parhna aniwaary hai, uske liye in cheezon ko khaana makrooh hai, taaki masjid mein parhi jaane waali baajmaat namaz usse  chhoot na jaye. Haalaanki, agar woh upasthit hone se bachne ke liye in cheejon ko khaata hai, to uske liye inhen khaana haraam hoga.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam in cheezon ko khaane se parhez isliye nahin karte the ki yeh cheezen haraam hain. Parhez isliye karte the ki aap Jibreel alaihissalaam se baat kiya karte the.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ki utkrisht shikshan shaili ki aap aadesh ke saath-saath uska kaaran bhi samjha dete the, taaki hikmat samajh lene ke baad saamne waala poori tarah aashvast ho jaye.
Qaazi kahte hain : Ulema ne namaz parhne ki doosri jaghon, jaise eedgaah aur janaaza gaah tatha ibaadat ke any saamoohik sthaanon ko bhi ispar qayaas kiya hai. Isi tarah jnaan, zikr aur waleeme aadi ki sabhaaon ko bhi isi par qayaas kiya jayega. Lekin baazaaron aadi ko nahin.
Ulema kahte hain : Yeh hadees is baat ka pramaan hai ki lahsun aadi khaane waale ko khaali masjid mein jaane se bhi roka jayega. Kyonki masjid mein farishte rahte hain aur hadeeson ki vyaapakta bhi yahi kahti hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4851: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne najjaashi ke zanaaze ki namaz parhi aur main doosri athva teesri pankti mein tha.
Jaabir bin abdullah- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne najjaashi ke zanaaze ki namaz parhi aur main doosri athva teesri pankti mein tha.

Jaabir bin abdullah -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne najjaashi ki gaybaana namaz-e-janaaza parhi aur woh khud bhi namaz parhne waalon mein shaamil the, kintu unhen yaad nahin raha ki woh doosri pankti mein the athva teesri pankti mein? Lekin yeh us samay kaha jayega, jab sandeh svayn unhonne hi vyakt kiya ho, kisi warnankarta ne nahin.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4853: Sajda sahv ke baare mein zul yadain ki hadees.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen zuhar athva asr ki namaz parhaai. (Ibne seereen kahte hain ki abu huraira ne namaz ka naam lekar bataya tha, lekin mujhe yaad nahin raha) woh kahte hain ki aapne hamen do rakaat parhaakar salaam pher diya. Uske baad masjid ke andar pari hui ek lakri ke paas ja kar, naaraaz vyakti ke andaaz mein usse tek laga liya, apne dayen haath ko bayen haath par rakha aur donon haathon ki ungliyon ko ek-doosri mein ghusa diya. Udhar, jaldabaaz log masjid se nikal gae aur kahna shuru kiya ki namaz kam ho gai hai. (Us samay wahaan abu bakr aur umar bhi maujood the), lekin unhonne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se baat karne mein bhay mahsoos kiya. Logon ke andar ek lanbe haath waala vyakti bhi tha, jise "Zul yadain"- do haathon waala- kaha jaata tha. Usne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya aapse bhool hui hai ya namaz kam kar di gai hai? Aapne uttar diyaah na mujhse bhool hui hai aur na namaz kam ki gai hai. Phir farmayaah qya zul yadain ki baat sahi hai? Logon ne kahaah haan. Atah, aap aage barhe, chhooti hui namaz parhi, phir salaam phera, phir takbeer kahi aur apne sajde ki tarah ya usse lanba sajda kiya, phir sir uthaya aur takbeer kahi, phir takbeer kahi aur apne sajde ki tarah ya usse lanba sajda kiya, phir sir uthaya aur takbeer kahi. Kabhi-kabhi log poochh lete ki kya uske baad aapne salaam phera? To kahteh mujhe bataya gaya hai ki imraan bin husain ne kahaah phir salaam phera.

Rasoolgan, maanav jaati ke sabse wiweki, sthir dil wa dimaag ke maalik, sahansheel aur sabse adhik Allah ka haq ada karne waale log hote hain. Lekin, in sab baaton ke baavjood we hote to insaan hi hain. Antim Rasool Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- in gunon mein any rasoolon ki tulna mein adhik paripoorn the, lekin iske baavjood insaan hone ke naate kai baar namaz ki kuchh cheezen bhoole bhi hain. Aisa isliye, taaki Allah bandon ke liye sahv ke ahkaam (bhoolne se sanbandhit widhi-widhaan) jaari kar sake. Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki ek baar Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne saathiyon ko zohar athva asr ki namaz parhaai. Yahaan abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ne nishchit roop se bata diya tha ki namaz kaun-si thi, lekin ibn-e-seereen bhool gae. Namaz ke dauraan hua yeh ki aapne pahli do rakaaten parhne ke baad salaam pher diya. Choonki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ek sanpoorn vyaktitv ke maalik insaan the aur aadhe-adhoore amal se aapka hriday santusht nahin hota tha, isliye aapko kuchh kami mahsoos hui. Magar yeh pata na chal saka ki woh hai kya? Aap masjid ke andar rakhi hui ek lakri ke paas gae, uspar vyaakul man se tek lagaya aur apne ek haath ki ungliyon ko doosre haath ki ungliyon mein ghusa diya.
Is beech jaldabaaz kism ke namaazeegan masjid ke wibhinn dvaaron se baahar nikal gae. We aapas mein chupke-chupke baat kar rahe the ki zaroor kuchh naya aadesh aya hoga. Daraasal we namaz aadhi ho jaane ki baat kar rahe the. Ek tarah se we Allah ke Nabi ko isse pare samajh rahe the ki aap bhi kuchh bhool sakte hain. Unke dilon mein aapka is qadar ruaab tha ki koi is mahatvapoorn wishay mein bhi aapse baat karne ki jurrat na kar saka. Haalaanki wahaan abu bakr aur umar -radiyallahu anhuma- bhi maujood the aur unhonne aapke andar asantushti aur beitmeenaani ke bhaav bhi dekhe the.
Itne mein ek sahaabi ne, jise zul-yadain kaha jaata tha, is khaamoshi ko torte hue kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool, kya aap bhool rahe hain ya namaz kam ho gai hai? Unhonne yaqeen ke saath koi ek baat nahin kahi, kyonki us samay donon baaton ki sanbhaavna thi. Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool -sallallah alaihi wa sallam- ne apne gumaan ke aadhaar par uttar diya ki na to main kuchh bhoola hoon aur na namaz kam hui hai. Ab zul-yadain aashvast ho gae ki namaz kam nahin hui hai. Choonki unhen is baat ka bhi yaqeen tha ki aapne do rakaat hi parhi hai, isliye yeh nateeja nikaal liya ki aap bhoole zaroor hain. Atah unhonne kaha : Waastawikta yeh hai ki aap bhoole hain. Choonki zul-yadain ka yeh daawa aapke is khayaal ke wipreet tha ki aapne namaz poori parhi hai, isliye aap uski pushti kar lena chaahte the. Atah, apne aas-paas maujood saathiyon se poochha ki kya zul-yadain ki yeh baat sahi hai ki mainne do hi rakaat parhi hai? Jab sabne haan mein uttar diya, to aap aage barhe aur chhooti hui namaz parhi.
Phir tashahhud ke baad salaam phera, phir baithe-baithe hi takbeer kahi aur namaz ke sajde jaisa ya usse zara lanba ek sajda kiya, phir sajde se sar uthaya aur takbeer kahi, phir takbeer kahi aur aam sajdon ki tarah ya unse zara lanba sajda kiya, phir sar uthaya aur takbeer kahi, phir tashahhud parhe bina salaam pher diya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4925: Jibreel (alaihissalaam), Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aakar bole ki aap log badr ke yuddh mein shaamil rahne waale sahaaba ko apne andar kaisa maante hain? Aapne uttar diyaah ham unhen sabse uttam musalmaanon mein shumaar karte hain.

Rifaaa bin raaphe zurqi- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki jibreel (alaihissalaam), Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aakar bole ki aap log badr ke yuddh mein shaamil rahne waale sahaaba ko apne andar kaisa maante hain? Aapne uttar diyaah ham unhen sabse uttam musalmaanon mein shumaar karte hain. Ya isi tarah ki koi baat kahi. Jibreel (alaihissalaam) ne kahaah yahi haal badr ke yuddh mein shaamil hone waale farishton ka hai.
4927: Ek khujoor ka tana tha, jispar khare hokar Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) juma ka pravchan dete the. Phir jab minbar rakha gaya to hamne us tane se das maah ki garbhavti oontni ke bilbilaane jaisi aawaaz suni. Yahaan tak ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) utre aur uspar apna haath rakha to woh shaant ho gaya.

Jaabir bin abdullah- radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki ek khujoor ka tana tha, jispar khare hokar Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam khutba (juma ka pravchan) dete the. Phir jab minbar rakha gaya to hamne us tane se das maah ki garbhavti oontni ke bilbilaane jaisi aawaaz suni. Yahaan tak ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) utre aur uspar apna haath rakha to woh shaant ho gaya. Tatha ek riwayat mein haih jab juma ka din aya aur Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) minbar par baithe to woh khujoor ka tana cheekhne laga, jiske nikat khare hokar khutba diya karte the. Aisa lag raha tha ki phat parega. Tatha ek riwayat mein haih woh bachche ki tarah cheekhne laga. Atah Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) minbar se utre aur use pakarkar seene se laga liya to woh us bachche ki tarah karaahne laga, jise chup karaya jaye, yahaan tak ki shaant ho gaya. Warnankarta kahte hainh woh tana us zikr se wanchit hone ke kaaran ro raha tha, jo use sunne ko milta tha.
4928: Momin ek hi bil se do baar dasa nahin jaata.
Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah momin ek hi bil se do baar dasa nahin jaata.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4929: Do phoonk maarne ke beech chaalees ka antraal hoga. Logon ne kahaah ai abu huraira! Kya chaalees se taatpary chaalees din hain? Unhonne kahaah main aisa nahin kahta. Logon ne kahaah chaalees saal muraad hain? Unhonne kahaah main aisa nahin kahta. Logon ne kahaah chaalees maheene muraad hain? Unhonne kahaah main aisa bhi nahin kahta.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah do phoonk maarne ke beech chaalees ka antraal hoga. Logon ne kahaah ai abu huraira! Kya chaalees se taatpary chaalees din hain? Unhonne kahaah main aisa nahin kahta. Logon ne kahaah chaalees saal muraad hain? Unhonne kahaah main aisa nahin kahta. Logon ne kahaah chaalees maheene muraad hain? Unhonne kahaah main aisa bhi nahin kahta. Tatha insaan ki poonchh ki haddi ke siwa saara shareer sar-gal jayega. Phir Allah aakaash se paani utaarega aur log ug ayenge, jaise hariyaali ug aati hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4931: We tumhen namaz parhayenge; ab yadi sahi-sahi parhayenge to tumhaare liye hogi aur yadi ghalti karenge to tumhaare liye sahi aur unke wiruddh hogi.

Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah we tumhen namaz parhayenge; ab yadi sahi-sahi parhayenge to tumhaare liye hogi aur yadi ghalti karenge to tumhaare liye sahi aur unke wiruddh hogi.

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki kuchh imaam yaani shaasak honge, jo tumhen namaz parhayenge. Ab yadi achchhi tarah namaz parhayenge, to tumhen aur unko donon ko pratiphal milega aur agar bigaarkar parhayenge, to tumhen namaz ka pratiphal mil jayega aur unko use bigaarne ka gunaah hoga. Yeh baat yadyapi shaaskon ke baare mein kahi gai hai, lekin ismen masjidon ke imaam bhi shaamil hain. Har imaam ko namaz sahi roop se parhne ke anupaat mein puny milega aur use bigaarkar parhne ke anupaat mein gunaah hoga. Is hadees mein is baat ki or ishaara hai ki shaaskon ke maamle mein dhairy se kaam lena aniwaary hai, yadyapi we galat tareeqe se tatha der se namaz parhayen. Is tarah ki paristhiti mein hamaare oopar waajib hoga ki ham unse alag na hon, balki unke saath der se hi namaz parhen. Is haalat mein hamaara namaz ko uske aaranbhik samay se wilanb karke parhna uchit sharai kaaran par aadhaarit hoga. Woh kaaran hai, jamaat ke saath rahna aur usse alag hokar baahar nikal na jaana. Lekin hamen is wilanb ke baavjood aaranbhik samay mein namaz parhne ka pratiphal milega. Haan, namaz mein wilanb karne ki bhi ek seema hai aur woh yeh hai ki namaz ka samay nikal na jaye. Yahaan yeh yaad rahe ki logon tatha shaaskon se alag hokar nikal jaana, unse doori bana lena, unke khilaaf logon ko bharkaana aur unki buraaiyon ko phailaana, yeh saari baaten Islam dharm ke wipreet hain.
4933: Allah ke nikat sabse priy sthaan masjiden aur sabse apriy sthaan, baazaar hain.
Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah Allah ke nikat sabse priy sthaan masjiden aur sabse apriy sthaan, baazaar hain.
4935: Nyay karne waale sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan dayaawaan (Allah) ke dayen jaanib, aur uske donon haath dayen hain

Abdullah bin amr bin aas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Nyay karne waale sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan dayaawaan (Allah) ke dayen jaanib, aur uske donon haath dayen hain, prakaash ke minbron par honge, jo apne nirnay mein, ghar waalon ke beech aur un kaamon mein jo unhen sonpe jayen, nyay karte hain."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jo log apne maathat (adheen) logon tatha ghar waalon ke beech evn apne faislon mein nyay aur saty ke saath nirnay karte hain, wa qayaamat ke din baithne ke aise oonche sthaanon mein baithe honge, jo noor (prakaash) se bane honge. Ye sthaan unko unke sammaan mein diye jayenge. Ye oonche sthaan dayaawaan Allah ke dayen or honge. Jnaat rahe ki Allah ke donon haath dayen hain.

Nyay ki fazeelat tatha nyay karne ki prerna.
Yahaan nyay ka zikr vyaapak roop mein hua hai, jiske dayre mein tamaam tarah ke shaasan aur logon ke beech ke nirnay a jaate hain. Yahaan tak ki patniyon aur bachchon ke beech nyay karna bhi.
Qayaamat ke din nyaykaariyon ke sthaan ka bayaan.
Qayaamat ke din eemaan waalon ko milne waale sthaan unke karmon ke anusaar bhinn-bhinn honge.
Prerna paddhati aahvaan ki ek paddhati hai, jo saamne waale vyakti ko neki ke kaam karne ke liye prerit karti hai.
4936: Bani israaeel ka maargadarshan nabeegan kiya karte the. Jab ek Nabi mrityu ko praapt ho jaata, to uske sthaan par doosra Nabi a jaata. Magar mere baad koi Nabi nahin hoga. Albatta, mere baad bahut saare uttaraadhikaari honge.

Abu haazim se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Mujhe paanch saal tak abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ke saath baithne ka mauqa mila. Mainne unse suna hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Bani israaeel ka maargadarshan nabeegan kiya karte the. Jab ek Nabi mrityu ko praapt ho jaata, to uske sthaan par doosra Nabi a jaata. Magar mere baad koi Nabi nahin hoga. Albatta, mere baad bahut saare uttaraadhikaari honge." Sahaaba ne kaha : Ai alla ke Rasool! Aap unke baare mein kya aadesh dete hain? Aapne farmaya : "Pahle waale  ki baiat poori karna, phir agle waali ki baiat ko. Unhen unka adhikaar dete rahna. Nishchay hi Allah unse un logon ke baare menpoochhega, jinka unhen shaasak banaya hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki bani israaeel ka netritv Allah ke bheje hue Nabi karte the. Nabi unke saare kaary usi prakaar karte the, jis prakaar shaasak apni janta ke kaary karte hain. Jab bani israaeel ke andar koi bigaar paida hota, Allah ek Nabi bhej deta, jo is bigaar ko sudhaar deta. Meri meri ummat mein yeh kaam karne ke liye mere baad koi Nabi nahin ayega. Mere baad khaleefa honge, jo bari sankhya mein honge aur unke beech matbhed evn jhagre mein saamne ayenge. Chunaanche sahaaba ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochha : Is tarah ke haalaat mein aap hamen kya aadesh dete hain. Aapne jawaab diya : Jab ek khaleefa ke baad doosre khaleefa se baiat kar li jaye, to pahle khaleefa ki baiat sahi hai aur use nibhaana parega, jabki doosre khaleefa ki baiat baatil (awaidh) hai. Is tarah ki baiat karvaana haraam hai. Dekho, khaleefa-gan ko unka haq do, unka anusran karo aur unki jo baat Qur'an wa hadees ke wiruddh na ho, use maano. Kyonki woh tumhaare saath jo kuchh kar rahe hain, uske baare mein Allah unse poochhega aur hisaab lega.

Logon ka ek Nabi ya khaleefa hona chahiye, jo unke maamlaat dekhe aur unko seedha maarg dikhaye.
Hamaare Nabi Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke baad koi Nabi nahin ayega.
Yeh hadees kisi aise vyakti ke khilaaph widroh karne ke khilaaph chetaavni deti hai jiska shaasan shareeyat ke tareeqe se siddh ho chuka hai.
Ek hi samay mein do khaleefa se baiat karna jayaz nahin hai.
Imaam ki zimmedaari bahut bari hai, kyonki Allah taaala usse uski praja ke baare mein sawaal karega.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Dhaarmik maamlon ko saansaarik maamlon par praathmikta di jayegi. Kyonki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne shaasak ke adhikaaron ko poora karne ka aadesh is baat ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue diya hai ki isse dharm ka pataaka ooncha hota hai aur fitna tatha buraai ka daman hota hai. Yahaan yeh yaad rakhna chahiye ki kisi adhikaar ki maanng ko sthagit karne ka matlab yeh nahin hai ki woh adhikaar khatm ho gaya hai, kyonki Allah ne svayn use uska poora adhikaar dene ka waada kiya hai, aakhirat ke jeewan hi mein sahi.
Yeh hadees Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke sachche Nabi hone ki ek bari nishaani hai. Kyonki aapke baad beshumaar khaleefa-gan hue. Bahut-se achchhe bhi aur bahut-se bure bhi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4938: Ai Allah! Jo vyakti meri ummat ke kisi maamle ka zimmawaar bane aur unhen kathinaai mein daale, tu bhi use kathinaai mein daal tatha jo vyakti meri ummat ke kisi maamle ka zimmedaar bane aur unke saath narmi kare, tu bhi uske saath narmi kar.

Aaisha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue sunaah "Ai Allah! Jo vyakti meri ummat ke kisi maamle ka zimmadaar bane aur unhen kathinaai mein daale, tu bhi use kathinaai mein daal tatha jo vyakti meri ummat ke kisi maamle ka zimmedaar bane aur unke saath narmi kare, tu bhi uske saath narmi kar."

Is hadees mein satta ke mahatv ko bataya gaya hai. Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne dua ki hai ki jise kisi bhi prakaar ki satta praapt ho aur woh logon ko kathinaai mein daale to Allah uske saath usi prakaar ka vyavhaar kare. Isi tarah jo unke saath nyay, daya evn narmi ka vyavhaar kare, Allah use iska badla de. Daraasal Allah ki or se insaan ko usi prakaar ka badla diya jaata hai, jis prakaar ka uska amal hota hai.
4939: Jise narmi se wanchit kar diya gaya, use saari bhalaai se wanchit kar diya gaya.
Jareer radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jise narmi se wanchit kar diya gaya, use saari bhalaai se wanchit kar diya gaya."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jise narmi se wanchit kar diya gaya, deen evn duniya se sanbandhit maamlaat aur doosron ke saath maamlaat mein narmi uske vyaktitv ka hissa nahin rahi, use poore taur par bhalaai se wanchit kar diya gaya.

Narmi ki fazeelat, usse sushobhit hone ki prerna aur sakhti ki ninda.
Narmi se donon jahaanon ke maamle mein bhalaai aati hai aur donon jaghon mein kushaadgi paida hoti hai. Jabki sakhti ka maamla iske wipreet hai.
Narmi achchhe aachran aur achchhe vyavhaar ka pratibinb hai, jabki kathorta krodh aur karvaahat ka pratibinb hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne narmi ki prashansa ki hai aur uska mahatv bataya hai.
Sufyaan sauri rahimhullah ne apne saathiyon se poochha : Kya tum jaante ho ki narmi kya hai? Narmi yeh hai ki tum har cheez ko uski uchit jagah par rakho. Sakhti ko uski jagah par, narmi ko uski jagah par, talvaar ko uski jagah par aur kore ko uski jagah par.
4940: Main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath ja raha tha aur aapke shareer par ek mote kinaare waali najraani chaadar thi. Isi beech, aapko ek dehaati mila aur bare zor se chaadar pakarkar kheencha.

Anas- radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath ja raha tha aur aapke shareer par ek mote kinaare waali najraani chaadar thi. Isi beech, aapko ek dehaati mila aur bare zor se chaadar pakarkar kheencha. Mainne dekha to aapke kandhe par zor se kheenchne ke kaaran chaadar ke kinaare ka nishaan par chuka tha. Phir usne kahaah ai Muhammad, Allah ka jo dhan tumhaare paas hai, usmen se mujhe dene ka aadesh do. Aapne uski or dekha, muskuraye aur use kuchh dene ka aadesh diya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4943: Kya main tumhen us aadmi ke baare mein na bataaoon, jise Jahannam par haraam kar diya jayega ya kaha ki jispar Jahannam haraam kar di jayegi? Jahannam ko har aasaani karne waale, narmi karne waale aur saral-svabhaav vyakti par haraam kar diya jayega.

Abdullah bin masaood- radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah kya main tumhen us aadmi ke baare mein na bataaoon, jise Jahannam par haraam kar diya jayega ya kaha ki jispar Jahannam haraam kar di jayegi? Jahannam ko har aasaani karne waale, narmi karne waale aur saral-svabhaav vyakti par haraam kar diya jayega.

Kya main tumhen aise vyakti ke baare mein na bataaoon, jise Jahannam se bacha liya jayega ya jisse Jahannam ko door rakha jayega? Jahannam ko har us vyakti se door rakha jayega, jo logon ke nikat rahta ho, neki ki jaghon mein unke saath bethta ho, shakti anusaar unke saath dayaapoorn vyavhaar karta ho, sahansheel ho aur logon ke saath udaar vyavhaar karta ho.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4944: Jab Ramzan ke antim das din aate, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- raaton ko jaagte, apne ghar ke logon ko jagaate, khoob ibaadten karte aur kamar kas lete.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Jab Ramzan ke antim das din aate, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- raaton ko jaagte, apne ghar ke logon ko jagaate, khoob ibaadten karte aur kamar kas lete.

Jab Ramzan ki antim das raaten aateen, to Nabi sallallahu alaihi raat-raat bhar wibhinn prakaar ki ibaadten karte rahte aur apne ghar waalon ko bhi namaz ke liye jagaate, aam dinon ki tulna mein ibaadat mein apne aap ko adhik lagaate atha khud ko uske liye samarpit kar dete aur apni patniyon se alag rahte.

Achchhe samay ko achchhe karmon mein bitaakar usse laabh uthaane ki prerna.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki Ramzan ke antim das dinon mein adhik ibaadat karna aur unki raaton mein jaagkar ibaadat karna musathab hai.
Ek bande ko apne pariwaar ke baare mein chintit hona chahiye, unhen ibaadat karne ki aajna deni chahiye aur unke baare mein dhairy se kaam lena chahiye.
Achchhe karm karne ke liye drirh nishchay, dhairy aur drirhta ki aawashyakta hoti hai.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees mein aye hue shabd "شدّ المِئزر" Ka arth kya hai, is wishay mein ulema ke beech matbhed hai. Kisi ne kaha hai : Isse muraad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka doosre dinon ke muqaable mein apni aadat se zyaada ibaadat karna hai. Is tarah in shabdon ka arth hai : Ibaadat ke liye kamar kas lena. Arbi mein kaha jaata hai : "شَدَدْتُ لهذا الأمر مِئزري" Yaani mainne is kaam ke liye kamar kas li hai aur khud ko samarpit kar diya hai. Jabki kuchh logon ne kaha hai : Ye shabd upaasna mein sanlagn hone ke liye mahilaaon se alag hone ka sanket hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4945: Woh Jahannam mein hai. Atah, log use dekhne gae, to paya ki usne ghaneemat ke maaाl ka ek kaali dhaariyon waala kapra chura rakha tha.

Abdullah bin amr (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne kirkira naami ek vyakti ko saamaan ki dekh-bhaal ke liye rakha tha. Jab woh mar gaya, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya ki woh Jahannam mein hai. Atah, log use dekhne gae, to paya ki usne ghaneemat ke maaाl ka ek kaali dhaariyon waala kapra chura rakha tha.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saamaanon ke dekhbhaal ka dayitv kirkira naami ek vyakti ke paas tha. Jab uski mrityu ho gai, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya ki woh Jahannam mein hai aur apne gunaah ki yaatna jhel raha hai. Ya phir matlab yeh hai ki yadi Allah ne maaf nahin kiya, to use Jahannam jaana parega. Yeh sun sahaaba ne iska kaaran khojna shuru kiya, to pata chala ki usne ghaneemat ke dhan se ek kaali dhaariyon waala kapra chura rakha tha.
4946: Nishchay Allah ne mujhe ek shareef banda banaya hai. Mujhe abhimaani aur widveshi nahin banaya hai.

Abdullah bin busr (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas ek pyaala tha, jise 'gharra' kaha jaata tha. Use chaar aadmi milkar uthaate the. Jab chaasht ka samay hota aur sahaaba chaasht ki namaz parh lete, to us pyaale ko (usmen sareed taiyaar karke) uthaakar laya jaata aur log use gherkar baith jaate. Jab log adhik ho jaate, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ghutnon ke bal baith jaate. Yeh dekh ek dehaati ne kahaah yeh baithne ka kaun-sa tareeqa hai? To Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Nishchay Allah ne mujhe ek shareef banda banaya hai. Mujhe abhimaani aur widveshi nahin banaya hai." Phir Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Iske kinaaron se khaao tatha iske beech waale oonche bhaag ko chhor do. Usmen barkat di jayegi."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4947: Meri ummat ke saare log Jannat mein prawesh karenge, siway uske, jo inkaar karega

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Meri ummat ke saare log Jannat mein prawesh karenge, siway uske, jo inkaar karega." Kaha gaya ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Bhala inkaar kaun karega? To farmaya : "Jo mere aadeshon ka paalan karega, woh Jannat mein prawesh karega aur jo meri awajna karega, wahi inkaar karne waala hoga."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki aapki poori ummat Jannat mein jayegi, siway uske jo khud mana kar de.

Yeh sun sahaaba ne kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Bhala mana kaun karega?!

Iska uttar dete hue Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Jisne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka anusran kiya, woh Jannat mein jayega aur jisne awajna ki tatha shareeyat ka paalan karne se bhaaga, usne apne bure karm dvaara Jannat mein jaane se inkaar kar diya.

Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka aajnaapaalan Allah ka aajnaapaalan hai aur Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki awajna Allah ki awajna hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka anusran Jannat waajib karta hai aur aapki awajna Jahannam waajib karti hai.
Is ummat ke aajnaakaari logon ke liye Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki khushkhabri aur is baat ka spasht ullekh ki Allah aur uske Rasool ki awajna karne waalon ko chhorkar is ummat ke sabhi log Jannat mein jayenge.
Ummat par Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki daya tatha unko Allah ke maarg par chalaane ki aapki laalsa.
4948: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke zamaane mein ham log chalte-phirte kha lete the aur khare hokar pi lete the.
Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke zamaane mein ham log chalte-phirte kha lete the aur khare hokar pi lete the.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4949: Bhala mujhe chain kaise mil sakta hai, jabki soor mein phoonk maarne par niyukt farishte ne soor ko apne munh se laga rakha hai aur anumti ki prateeksha mein hai. Jaise hi phoonk maarne ki anumti praapt hogi, woh phoonk maar denge.

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Bhala mujhe chain kaise mil sakta hai, jabki soor mein phoonk maarne par niyukt farishte ne soor ko apne munh se laga rakha hai aur anumti ki prateeksha mein hai. Jaise hi phoonk maarne ki anumti praapt hogi, woh phoonk maar denge." Aisa prateet ho raha tha ki yeh baat Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saathiyon ko bari bhaari lagi, isliye aapne unse farmayaah "Tum kah liya karoh hamaare liye Allah hi kaafi hai aur woh sabse achchha kaam banaane waala hai."
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4950: Qayaamat ke din kisi bande ke paanv us samay tak nahin hilenge, jab tak uski ayu ke baare mein na poochh liya jaye ki use kis kaam mein lagaya aur uske jnaan ke baare mein na poochh liya jaye ki usse kya kiya tatha uske dhan ke baare mein na poochh liya jaye ki use kahaan se kamaya aur kahaan kharch kiya aur uske shareer ke baare mein na poochh liya jaye ki use kahaan khapaya?

Abu barza asalmi radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Qayaamat ke din kisi bande ke paanv us samay tak nahin hilenge, jab tak uski ayu ke baare mein na poochh liya jaye ki use kis kaam mein lagaya aur uske jnaan ke baare mein na poochh liya jaye ki usse kya kiya tatha uske dhan ke baare mein na poochh liya jaye ki use kahaan se kamaya aur kahaan kharch kiya aur uske shareer ke baare mein na poochh liya jaye ki use kahaan khapaya?"

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki qayaamat ke din koi bhi vyakti hisaab ke sthaan se Jannat ya Jahannam ki or us samay tak barh nahin sakega, jab tak usse nimnalikhit baaten poochh na li jayen :

1- usne apna jeewan kin kaaryon mein bitaya hai?

2- usne jo jnaan praapt kiya tha, kya use Allah ke liye praapt kiya tha, kya uspar amal kiya tha aur kya use uske haqdaar tak pahunchaya tha?

3- uske paas jo dhan tha, use kahaan se kamaya tha? Kamaai ke raaste halaal the ya haraam? Saath hi use kahaan kharch kiya tha? Allah ki prasannata ke kaamon mein ya aprasannata ke kaamon mein?

4- use jo shareer, shakti, svaasthy aur jawaani mili thi, use kin kaamon mein kharch kiya tha?

Jeewan ko Allah ki prasannata ke kaaryon mein lagaane ki prerna.
Bandon ko Allah ki beshumaar nemten mili hui hain aur har bande ko Allah ke saamne in nemton ke baare mein jawaab dena hoga. Isliye insaan ko chahiye ki Allah ki di hui nemton ko uski prasannata ke kaamon mein lagaye.
4952: "عليك السلام" Na kaho, kyonki "عليك السلام" Mare hue logon ka salaam hai. Balki "السلام عليك" Kaho.

Abu jurai jaabir bin sulaim (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne ek vyakti ko dekha, log uski baaton ko sveekaar kar rahe the. Woh jo bhi kahta, log use maante ja rahe the. Mainne kahaah yeh kaun hai? Logon ne kahaah yeh Allah ke Rasool hain. Atah mainne do baar kahaah "عليك السلام يا رسول الله" (Arthaat aappar salaamti ho ai Allah ke Rasool) to aapne farmayaah "عليك السلام" Na kaho, kyonki "عليك السلام" Mare hue logon ka salaam hai. Balki "السلام عليك" Kaho. Woh kahte hain ki mainne kahaah kya aap Allah ke Rasool hain? To farmayaah "Haan, main us Allah ka Rasool hoon ki jise tum museebat ke samay pukaaro to tumhaari museebat door kar de aur akaal tatha anaawrishti ke samay pukaaro to dharti ko tumhaare liye hariyaali ki chaadar urha de aur jab kisi biyaabaan mein tumhaari sawaari gum ho jaye aur use pukaaro to tumhen tumhaari sawaari lauta de." Woh kahte hain ki mainne kahaah mujhe kuchh naseehat farmayen. To farmayaah "Kisi ko hargiz gaali na dena." So, mainne uske baad na kisi aazaad ko gaali di, na kisi ghulaam ko, na kisi oont ko aur na kisi bakri ko. (Tatha aage farmayaah) "Kisi bhi achchhe kaam ko kamtar na jaanna tatha apne bhaai se hanskar baat karna, kyonki yeh bhi bhale kaamon mein se hai. Tatha tahband aadhi pindli tak pahanna. Yadi na maano to takhnon tak pahanna aur lungi ko latkaakar pahanne se bachna, kyonki yeh bhi abhimaan ka ek roop hai aur Allah abhimaan ko pasand nahin karta. Yadi koi tumhen gaali de tatha tumhaari kisi baat par, jo woh jaanta ho, tumhen sharm dilaye, to uski kisi baat par, jo tum jaante ho, use sharm na dilaao, kyonki iska paap uske sar jayega.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4953: Sabr se kaam lo. Kyonki har baad mein aane waala samay pahle waale ke muqaable mein bura hoga, yahaan tak ki tum apne rab se ja milo.

Zubair bin adi kahte hain ki ham log anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas aye aur unse hajjaaj ke atyaachaar ki shikayat ki, to farmayaah "Sabr se kaam lo. Kyonki har baad mein aane waala samay pahle waale ke muqaable mein bura hoga, yahaan tak ki tum apne rab se ja milo." Yeh baat mainne khud tumhaare Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se suni hai.

Zubair bin adi kuchh logon ke saath Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke sewak anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- ke paas aye aur umvi kaal ke ek kroor gawarnar hajjaaj bin yoosuf ke atyaachaar ki shikayat ki, jo atyaachaar evn raktapaat ke liye jaana jaata tha, to anas -radiyallahu anhu- ne unko shaaskon ke atyaachaar par dhairy rakhne ka aadesh diya aur bataya ki logon par guzarne waale kisi bhi samay se uske baad ka samay adhik bura hoga, yahaan tak we apne rab se ja milen. Saath hi yeh bhi bataya ki unhonne yeh baat Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se suni hai.
Yaad rahe ki yahaan bura se muraad saamaany evn aam bura nahin hai, kyonki kabhi aisa bhi hota hai ki kuchh sthaanon mein bura ho aur kuchh any sthaanon mein achchha.
4955: Tabook yuddh ke samay jab logon ko akaal ka saamna karna para, to we kahne lageh ai Allah ke Rasool, yadi aap anumti den, to ham apne oonton ko zabah karke unka maans khayen aur unki charbi ko tel ke roop mein istemaal karen.
