Abu huraira athva abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhuma) (warnankarta ko sandeh hai) kahte hain ki tabook yuddh ke samay jab logon ko akaal ka saamna karna para, to we kahne lageh ai Allah ke Rasool, yadi aap anumti den, to ham apne oonton ko zabah karke unka maans khayen aur unki charbi ko tel ke roop mein istemaal karen. Chunaanche Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Theek hai, karo." Lekin itne mein umar (radiyallahu anhu) a gae aur kahne lageh ai Allah ke Rasool, yadi aapne aisa kiya, to sawaariyaan kam jo jayengi. Balki aap unse kahen ki apne bache hue khaane ke saamaan le ayen. Phir unke liye Allah se un cheezon mein barkat ki dua kar den. Ho sakta hai ki Allah usmen barkat de de. Atah, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Haan!" Phir chamre ki ek chataai mangvaakar use bichha diya aur logon ko apne bache hue khaane ke saamaan laane ko kaha. Chunaanche koi ek mutthi makai le aya, koi ek mutthi khajoor le aya aur koi ek tukra roti le aya. Is tarah chataai par thori-bahut cheezen ekatr ho gaeen, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne barkat ki dua kar di aur farmayaah "Apne-apne baratnon mein lete jaao." Atah, logon ne apne baratnon mein le liya, yahaan tak ki sena mein koi aisa bartan na bacha, jise bhar na liya gaya ho. Saath hi sab logon ne pet bharkar khaya aur iske baad kuchh bach bhi gaya. Phir Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur main Allah ka Rasool hoon. In do gawaahiyon ke saath jo bhi banda Allah se milega aur unke baare mein uske man mein koi sandeh na hoga, to use Jannat se roka nahin jayega."
4956: Abu huraira aur jaabir (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Yuddh dhokha hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4958: Main yeh jhanda ek aise vyakti ko doonga, jo Allah aur uske Rasool se pyaar karta ho aur Allah uske haathon wijay pradaan karega.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Main yeh jhanda ek aise vyakti ko doonga, jo Allah aur uske Rasool se pyaar karta ho aur Allah uske haathon wijay pradaan karega." Umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mujhe us din ke siwa kabhi ameer banne ki ichchha nahin hui. Unka kahna hai ki main is ummeed mein apne aap ko ooncha  ka raha tha ki shayad bula liya jaaoon. Lekin, Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ali bin abu taalib radiyallahu anhu ko bulaakar jhanda unke haath mein diya aur farmayaah "Chal paro aur us samay tak na muro, jab tak Allah tumhaare haathon wijay pradaan na kar de." Chunaanche, ali radiyallahu anhu thora-sa chale aur uske baad ruk gae, lekin mure nahin, balki oonchi aawaaz mein bole : Ai Allah ke Rasool, main kis baat par logon se yuddh karoon? Aapne farmaya : "Unse yuddh karte raho, yahaan tak we is baat ki gawaahi de den Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain. Yadi unhonne aisa kiya, to apne rakt tatha dhan ko tumse surakshit kar liya. Yeh aur baat hai ki unpar is gawaahi ka koi adhikaar siddh ho jaye. Tatha unka hisaab Allah ke hawaale hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne saathiyon se kaha ki agle din musalmaan madeena ke paas sthit shahar khaibar ke yahoodiyon par wijyi honge. Yeh wijay us vyakti ke haath par hogi jise aap jhanda pradaan karenge, jhanda se muraad woh dhvaj hai jise  sena prateek ke roop mein apnaati hai. Is vyakti ki ek wisheshta yeh hogi ki woh Allah aur uske Rasool se prem karta hai aur Allah aur uske Rasool usse prem karte hain.

Umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki ek wahi din tha, jab unke andar sardaari paane ki ichchha jaagi thi aur dil mein bulaye jaane ki khvaahish is aasha mein paida hui thi ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam dvaara ullikhit Allah aur uske Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki mohabbat praapt karne ka saubhaagy unko mil jaye. Unhonne apne shareer ko is aasha mein eriyon ke sahaare ooncha kiya ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam unko dekh len, unko bula len aur jhanda pradaan kar den.

Lekin Allah ke Nabi salllalaahu alaihi wa sallam ne ali bin abu taalib radiyallahu anhu ko bula bheja, unhen jhanda pradaan kiya aur aadesh diya ki sena ke saath chal paren aur dushman se milne ke baad unke qilon par warchasv praapt karne tak na aaraam karen, na peechhe haten aur na hi yuddhawiraam karen.

Chunaanche ali radiyallahu anhu chal pare. Ek baar ruke bhi to Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke aadesh ke ullanghan se bachne ke liye peechhe mure nahin, khaibar ki or munh karke hi oonchi aawaaz mein poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Main logon se kis baat par jang karoon?

Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne uttar diya : Unse us samay tak jang karo, jab tak is baat ki gawaahi na de den ki Allah ke siwa koi saty pooje nahin hai aur Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke Rasool hain. Agar unhonne tumhaare is aahvaan ko qabool kar liya aur Islam mein daakhil ho gae, to unhonne apne rakt evn apne dhan ko tumse surakshit kar liya. Haan, agar we aisa apraadh kar baithen ki Islam ke praavdhaanon ke aalok mein qatl ke haqdaar ban jayen, to baat alag hai. Baaqi, unka hisaab lena Allah ka kaam hai.

Sahaaba imaarat (hukmaraani aur netritv paane ) ko naapsand karte the, kyonki yeh bari zimmewaari ka kaam hota hai.
Kisi aise kaary ke prati apni ichchha zaahir karna jayaz hai, jismen bhalaai paye jaane ki prabal sanbhaavna hai.
Shaasak senaapti ka yuddh ke maidaan mein apnaai jaane waali ranneeti ke baare mein maargadarshan karega.
Sahaaba Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki waseeyton ka barh-charhkar paalan karte the.
Jis vyakti ko use saunpi gai zimmedaariyaan samajh mein na ayen, use unke baare mein poochh lena chahiye.
Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke Allah ke Nabi hone ke anginat pramaanon mein se ek pramaan yeh hai ki aapne khaibar ke yahoodiyon par wijyi hone ki baat kahi aur wijyi hue bhi.
Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke aadesh par awilanb amal karne ki prerna.
Jo vyakti donon gawaahiyaan de de, use qatl karna jayaz nahin hai. Haan, agar usse qatl ko aniwaary karne waala koi kaam ho jaye, to baat aur hai.
Islaami niyam logon ke zaahiri kaaryon ke anusaar jaari kiye jayenge. Unke andar chhipe rahasyon ka maalik Allah hai.
Jihaad ka sabse bara uddeshy logon ka Islam mein daakhil hona hai.
4959: Ai Allah ke Rasool, yadi main abu salma ke beton par kharch karoon, to kya mujhe uska pratiphal milega, jabki main unhen is awastha mein chhor bhi nahin sakti, kyonki woh mere bete hi hain? To farmayaah "Haan, tum jo kuchh unpar kharch karogi, tumhen uska pratiphal milega.

Umme salma (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, yadi main abu salma ke beton par kharch karoon, to kya mujhe uska pratiphal milega, jabki main unhen is awastha mein chhor bhi nahin sakti, kyonki woh mere bete hi hain? To farmayaah "Haan, tum jo kuchh unpar kharch karogi, tumhen uska pratiphal milega."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4960: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke zamaane mein hamen is tarah ka khaana kam hi mila karta tha. Jab hamen is tarah ka khaana milta, to hamaare paas roomaal nahin hote, atah apni hatheliyon, baazuon aur qadmon mein ponchh lete aur phir wazu kiye bina hi namaz parh lete.

Saeed bin haaris kahte hain ki unhonne jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) se aag se paki hui wastu khaane ke baad wazu ke baare mein poochha, to farmayaah iski zaroorat nahin hai. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke zamaane mein hamen is tarah ka khaana kam hi mila karta tha. Jab hamen is tarah ka khaana milta, to hamaare paas roomaal nahin hote, atah apni hatheliyon, baazuon aur qadmon mein ponchh lete aur phir wazu kiye bina hi namaz parh lete.
4961: Allah ne jab makhlooq ki srishti ki, to ek kitaab mein, jo uske paas arsh par hai, likh diyaah meri rahmat mere krodh par haawi rahegi.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh "Allah ne jab makhlooq ki srishti ki, to ek kitaab mein, jo uske paas arsh par hai, likh diyaah meri rahmat mere krodh par haawi rahegi."
Ek riwayat ke shabd hainh "Meri rahmat mere krodh par haawi ho gai."
Jabki ek riwayat mein haih "Meri rahmat mere krodh se aage rahi."

Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne jab saari srishtiyon ko paida kiya, to ek kitaab mein likh diya, jo uske paas arsh par hai : Nishchay hi meri rahmat mere krodh se adhik tatha uspar haawi rahegi. Uchch Allah ka farmaan hai : "Tatha meri daya pratyek wastu ko samoe hue hai." Yeh hadees Muslim ko niraash na hone ki prerna deti hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4963: Yadi aadam ki santaan ko sone ki ek ghaati mil jaye, to woh chaahega ki use do ghaatiyaan mil jayen. Kewal mitti hi uske munh ko bhar sakti hai tatha jo tauba karega, Allah uski tauba qabool karega.

Abdullah bin abbaas, anas bin maalik aur abu moosa ashaari (radiyallahu anhum) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Yadi aadam ki santaan ko sone ki ek ghaati mil jaye, to woh chaahega ki use do ghaatiyaan mil jayen. Kewal mitti hi uske munh ko bhar sakti hai tatha jo tauba karega, Allah uski tauba qabool karega."
[ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise donon riwayton ke saath Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4964: Musalmaan ka tahband aadhi pindli tak hona chahiye aur yadi aadhi pindli evn takhne ke beech ho, to bhi koi harj (athva gunaah) nahin hai. Haan, jo donon takhnon se neeche hoga, woh Jahannam mein hoga, tatha jo apna tahband abhimaan ke taur par latkayega, Allah uspar apni nazar nahin daalega.

Abu saeed khudri -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Musalmaan ka tahband aadhi pindli tak hona chahiye aur yadi aadhi pindli evn takhne ke beech ho, to bhi koi harj (athva gunaah) nahin hai. Haan, jo donon takhnon se neeche hoga, woh Jahannam mein hoga, tatha jo apna tahband abhimaan ke taur par latkayega, Allah uspar apni nazar nahin daalega."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne yahaan bataya hai ki ek musalmaan ki lungi yaani purushon ke shareer ke nichle aadhe bhaag ko dhaankne waale kapre ki teen haalten hua karti hain : 1- lungi ko aadhi pindli tak rakhna musathab hai. 2- aadhi pindli se takhnon yaani pindli aur qadam ke jor ke paas ki do ubhri hui haddiyon ke beech rakhna jayaz hai aur ismen koi karaahat nahin hai. 3- takhnon se neeche latkaana haraam hai. Dar is baat ka hai ki use aag ki yaatna ka saamna karna pare. Aisa agar abhimaan evn sarakshi mein kiya jaata hai, to Allah uski or dekhega tak nahin.

Yeh chetaavni kewal purushon ke saath khaas hai. Mahilayen iske dayre mein nahin aateen, kyonki unko poora shareer chhupaakar rakhne ka aadesh hai.
Purushon ke shareer ke nichle aadhe bhaag ko dhaankne waale har kapre, jaise paajaamaam aur uski tarah ke any kapron ko izaar kaha jayega aur ye saare kapre is hadees mein bayaan kiye gae sharai nirdesh ke dayre mein ayenge.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
4965: Jibreel mujhe baraabar parosi ke baare mein taakeed karte rahe, yahaan tak ki mujhe lagne laga ki woh use waaris bana denge.

Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma se warnit hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jibreel mujhe baraabar parosi ke baare mein taakeed karte rahe, yahaan tak ki mujhe lagne laga ki woh use waaris bana denge."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jibreel parosi ka dhyaan rakhne ki baat nirantar roop se dohraate rahe aur baar-baar iska aadesh dete rahe. Dhyaan rahe ki parosi use kahte hain, jiska darvaaza aapke darvaaze se qareeb ho, musalmaan ho ya ghairmuslim, rishtedaar ho ya ghairrishtedaar. Parosi ka dhyaan rakhne ka matlab hai, uske adhikaaron ki raksha karna, use kasht na dena, uska upkaar karna aur uski or se aane waale kasht par sabr karna. Jibreel ke dvaara parosi ke adhikaar ko mahatv diye jaane aur unke dvaara baar-baar iska ullekh kiye jaane se Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko yeh lagne laga ki kaheen is prakaar ki koi wahy ne utar aye ki insaan ki mrityu ke baad uske chhore hue dhan mein se uske parosi ko bhi hissa milega.

Parosi ke adhikaar ka mahatv aur iske dhyaan rakhne ka waajib hona.
Parosi ke adhikaar ki taakeed ke saath waseeyat yeh darshaati hai ki usko sammaan dena, usse prem rakhna, uska bhala karna, use buraai se bachaana, beemaar hone par uska haal jaanne ke liye jaana, khushi ke avsar par use mubaarakbaad dena aur duhkh ke samay saantvana dena zaroori hai.
Parosi ka darvaaza jitna qareeb hoga, uska adhikaar utna adhik hoga.
Islaami shareeyat ek paripoorn shareeyat hai, jismen parosiyon ka bhala karna aur unko buraaiyon se bachaana aadi samaaj sudhaar ki saari baaten maujood hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4966: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne kabhi kisi khaane mein aib nahin nikaala. Yadi ichchha hui, to khaya aur yadi ichchha nahin hui, to chhor diya.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne kabhi kisi khaane mein aib nahin nikaala. Yadi ichchha hui, to khaya aur yadi ichchha nahin hui, to chhor diya.
Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kabhi bhi kisi khaane mein aib nahin nikaala. Balki yadi ichchha hui to khaya aur yadi ichchha nahin hui, to chhor diya. Aib nahin nikaala.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4967: Mere paas jo maal hoga, use tum logon se bachaakar nahin rakhoonga. Lekin yaad rakho, jo maangne se bachega, Allah use maangne se bachayega, jo beniyaazi dikhayega, Allah use beniyaaz rakhega aur jo sabr karega, Allah use sahansheel bana dega aur kisi vyakti ko koi aisi wastu nahin di gai, jo sabr se behtar evn vyaapak ho.

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki ansaar mein se kuchh logon ne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se (maal ka) sawaal kiya, to aapne de diya. Unhonne dobaara maanga, to aapne phir de diya. Yahaan tak ki aapke paas jo kuchh tha, sab khatm ho gaya. Anttah, aapne pharmayaah "Mere paas jo maal hoga, use tum logon se bachaakar nahin rakhoonga. Lekin yaad rakho, jo maangne se bachega, Allah use maangne se bachayega, jo beniyaazi dikhayega, Allah use beniyaaz rakhega aur jo sabr karega, Allah use sahansheel bana dega aur kisi vyakti ko koi aisi wastu nahin di gai, jo sabr se behtar evn vyaapak ho."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4968: Tumhaara kya wichaar hai ki yadi tummen se kisi ke dvaar par nahar prawaahit ho aur woh usmen pratyek din paanch baar snaan karta ho, to kya uske shareer mein mail ka koi ansh bachega?

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Tumhaara kya wichaar hai ki yadi tummen se kisi ke dvaar par nahar prawaahit ho aur woh usmen pratyek din paanch baar snaan karta ho, to kya uske shareer mein mail ka koi ansh bachega?" Sahaaba ne kaha : Uske shareer mein mail ka koi ansh nahin bachega. To farmaya : "Yahi udaahran hai paanch namaazon ka. Inke zariye Allah gunaahon ko mita deta hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne chhote-chhote gunaahon ko mitaye jaane ke sanbandh mein din aur raat mein paanch baar parhi jaane waali namaazon ki misaal insaan ke darvaaze se bahne waali us nadi se di hai, jismen woh har din paanch baar snaan karta ho aur phalasvaroop uske shareer mein zara bhi mail-kuchail baaqi na rahe.

Namaz se insaan ke kewal chhote gunaah hi maaf hote hain. Bari gunaahon ki maafi ke liye tauba zaroori hai.
Paanch waqt ki namaazen unki sharton, stanbhon, aniwaary kaaryon evn sunnaton ke saath ada karne ki mahatta.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4969: Eemaan waalon ka udaahran, unke ek-doosre se prem, daya aur karuna mein, shareer ki tarah hai, ki jab uska koi ang kasht mein hota hai, to poora shareer jaagne evn bukhaar ke kasht mein uske saath hota hai.

Nomaan bin basheer radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Eemaan waalon ka udaahran, unke ek-doosre se prem, daya aur karuna mein, shareer ki tarah hai, ki jab uska koi ang kasht mein hota hai, to poora shareer jaagne evn bukhaar ke kasht mein uske saath hota hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bayaan farmaya hai ki shubhchintan, daya, paraspar sahyog, madad aur kisi bhi haani se hone waale kasht ki anubhooti ki drishti se musalmaanon ka haal ek shareer ke jaisa hona chahiye ki jab shareer ka ek ang beemaar hota hai, uske saath poora shareer raat jaagta aur bukhaar se tapta rahta hai.

Musalmaanon ke adhikaaron ko mahatv dena chahiye aur unko ek-doosre ki madad karne aur narmi bhara vyavhaar karne ki prerna deni chahiye.
Eemaan waalon ke beech prem evn sahyog ki bhaavna rahni chahiye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
4970: Mera aur tumhaar udaahran us vyakti ki tarah hai, jisne aag jalaai, to tidde tatha patinge usmen girne lage aur woh unhen usse rokne lage. (Bilkul usi tarah) main tumhaari kamar pakarkar tumhen Jahannam ki aag se rok raha hoon aur tum mere haathon se phisle ja rahe ho.

Jaabir bin abdullah aur abu huraira (radiyallahu anhuma) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh "Mera aur tumhaar udaahran us vyakti ki tarah hai, jisne aag jalaai, to tidde tatha patinge usmen girne lage aur woh unhen usse rokne lage. (Bilkul usi tarah) main tumhaari kamar pakarkar tumhen Jahannam ki aag se rok raha hoon aur tum mere haathon se phisle ja rahe ho."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is hadees mein bataya hai ki aapki ummat ke saath aapki haalat yoon samjho jaise ek vyakti kisi jangal mein rahta ho aur usne wahaan aag jalaai, to tidde aur patinge usmen girne lage. Hota bhi yahi hai ki jab insaan kaheen aag jalaata hai to patinge, tidde aur chhote-chhote keere prakaash ki or bhaag-bhaagkar aate hain. Main tumhen us aag mein girne se rokne ka poora prayaas kar raha hoon, lekin tum mere haath se phisle ja rahe ho. Yaani log Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki mukhaalfat aur aapki sunnat ko chhor kar aapke dvaara kiye jaane waale unhen aag se bachaane ke prayaason ko wiphal bana rahe hain.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
4971: Shaheed paanch hain; taaoon (pleg) se marne waala, pet ki beemaari se marne waala, doobkar marne waala, kisi girne waali wastu ke neeche dabkar marne waala aur Allah ke raaste mein shaheed hone waala.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Shaheed paanch hain; taaoon (pleg) se marne waala, pet ki beemaari se marne waala, doobkar marne waala, kisi girne waali wastu ke neeche dabkar marne waala aur Allah ke raaste mein shaheed hone waala."
Ek aur riwayat mein haih "Tum log kise shaheed maante ho?" Logon ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, jo Allah ke raaste mein maara jaye, woh shaheed hai. To aapne farmayaah "Tab to meri ummat mein shaheed bahut kam honge." Sahaaba ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, phir kaun log shaheed hain? To farmayaah "Jo Allah ke raaste mein maara gaya woh shaheed hai, jo Allah ki raah mein nikalkar mar gaya woh shaheed hai, jo taaoon (pleg) mein mara woh shaheed hai, jo pet ki beemaari mein mara woh shaheed hai aur jo doobkar mara woh shaheed hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5001: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne das logon ka ke ek sainy dal jasoosi ke liye bheja aur aasim bin saabit ansaari (radiyallahu anhu) ko uska pramukh banaya.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne das logon ka ke ek sainy dal jasoosi ke liye bheja aur aasim bin saabit ansaari (radiyallahu anhu) ko uska pramukh banaya. Jab woh log usfaan evn makka ke beech hadaa naami sthaan tak pahoonche, to unke pahunchne ki soochna huzail qabeele ki shaakha banu lehyaan ko mil gai aur unke lagbhag sau teerandaaz unpar aakraman karne ke uddeshy se nikal pare tatha unka peechha karne lage. Jab aasim aur unke saathiyon ko iski bhanak mili, to unhonne ek sthaan mein sharan le li. Tab shatruon ne unhen chaaron or se gher liya aur kaha ki tum utarkar khud ko hamaare hawaale kar do, ham tumhen wachan dete hain ki ham tummen se kisi ka wadh nahin karenge. Magar aasim (radiyallahu anhu) ne kahaah ai mere saathiyo, jahaan tak meri baat hai, main kisi kaafir ki suraksha par neeche nahin utroonga. Ai Allah, hamaari is durdhatna ki soochna apne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko de dena. Chunaanche un logon ne teer barsaya aur aasim (radiyallahu anhu) ko shaheed kar diya. Jabki teen log unke wachan par bharosa karte hue neeche utar aye, jinmen khubais, zaid bin dasinna aur ek any vyakti shaamil the. Jab yeh teen log unke qaabu mein a gae, to unhonne unke dhanush ki pratyancha torkar unhen usse baandh diya. Yeh dekh teesre vyakti ne kahaah yeh pahla dhokha hai. Allah ki qasam, main tumhaare saath nahin jaaoonga. Mere liye yeh shaheed hone waale log aadarsh ki haisiyat rakhte hain. Chunaanche, un logon ne unko kheencha aur muqaabla kiya, lekin unhonne saath jaane se inkaar kar diya. Anttah unhonne unko maar daala. Phir we khubaib tatha zaid bin dasinna ko le gae aur badr yuddh ke baad donon ko makka mein bech diya. Khubaib (radiyallahu anhu) ko banu haaris bin aamir bin naufal bin abde munaaf ne khareed liya. Daraasal, khubaib (radiyallahu anhu) ne badr yuddh ke din haaris ka katl kiya tha. Khubaib unke yahaan qaidi ki haisiyat se rahe, yahaan tak ki un logon unko shaheed karne ka nishchay kar liya. Phir aisa hua ki khubaib ne haaris ki ek beti se safaai ke liye ustara maanga aur usne unko ustara laakar diya. Isi beech uski bekhabri mein uska ek chhota-sa bachcha unke paas a gaya. Bachche ki maan ne jaise hi dekha ki bachcha unki raan par baitha hai aur ustara unke haath mein hai, to woh buri tarah ghabra gai, jise khubaib (radiyallahu anhu) ne mahsoos kar liya. Chunaanche woh boleh kya tum darti ho ki main use maar doonga? Main aisa nahin kar sakta. Woh kahti haih Allah ki qasam, mainne khubaib se achchha qaidi nahin dekha. Allah ki qasam, mainne unhen ek din dekha ki woh haath mein angoor ka guchchha liye angoor kha rahe hain, haalaanki unhen lohe ki zanjeeron se jakarkar rakha gaya tha aur makka mein us samay koi phal nahin tha. Woh kaha karti theeh daraasal, yeh Allah ki or se praapt rozi thi, jo khubaib ko di gai thi. Jab log unhen lekar haram se nikle, taaki haram kshetr ke baahar qatl kar den, to khubaib ne unse kahaah mujhe do rakaat namaz parhne do. Un logon ne unko kuchh der ke liye chhora, to do rakaat namaz parhi aur farmayaah Allah ki qasam, agar tum yeh na samajhte ki main ghabra gaya hoon, to main aur adhik namaz parhta. Ai Allah, inhen achchhi tarah se gin le aur inhen ek-ek karke maut ke ghaat utaar de aur inmen se kisi ko jeewit na chhor. Tatha farmayaah mujhe koi parvaah nahin, jab main islaam ki awastha mein qatl kiya jaaoon ki Allah ke liye kis pahlu ke bal girta hoon. Yeh sab kuchh us Allah ke liye hai, jo agar chaahe to woh kate hue alag-alag tukron mein barkat de de. Daraasal, khubaib (radiyallahu anhu) hi the, jinhonne har musalmaan ke liye, jo baandhkar qatl kiya jaye, namaz parhne ka tareeqa jaari kiya tha. Udhar, jis din yeh durghatna hui, usi din Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne sahaaba ko iski soochna de di. Quraish ko jab pata chala ki aasim bin saabit shaheed kar diye gae hain, to kuchh logon ko bheja ki unke shareer ka koi ang kaatkar le ayen, jo pahchaan liya jaye. Daraasal, aasim (radiyallahu anhu) ne unke ek pramukh vyakti ko maar diya tha. So, Allah ne aasim (radiyallahu anhu) ki suraksha ke liye baadal ki tarah (bari sankhya mein) madhumakkhiyon ko bhej diya, jisne unhen kuraish ke bheje hue logon se bacha liya aur we unke shareer ka koi ang kaat na sake.
5020: Fitna ke samay ibaadat meri or hijrat karne ki tarah hai.
Maaqil bin yasaar -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Fitna ke samay ibaadat meri or hijrat karne ki tarah hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne hamen fitna wa fasaad, hatya, winaash aur araajakta ke samay mein Allah ki ibaadat ke liye khud ko samarpit karne ka maargadarshan kiya hai, aur kaha hai ki iska sawaab Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki or hijrat karne ke sawaab ke baraabar hai. Iska kaaran yeh hai ki log is tarah ke samay mein Allah ki ibaadat se door ho jaate hain aur isse kuchh hi log jure hote hain.

Fitnon ke dinon fitna wa fasaad se surakshit rahne ke liye ibaadat mein vyast ho jaane aur Allah se apna rishta jor lene ki prerna.
Fitnon tatha achetna ke samyon mein ibaadat karne ki fazeelat ka bayaan.
Ek musalmaan ko fitnon evn achetna ke sthaanon se door rahna chahiye.
5021: Ai Allah, hamaare jeewit tatha mrit, chhote tatha bare, purush tatha stri aur upasthit tatha anupasthit sabko kshama kar de. Ai Allah, hammen se jise jeewit rakhna ho, islaam par jeewit rakh aur hammen se jise maarna ho, use eemaan ki awastha mein maut de.Ai Allah, hamen uske pratiphal se wanchit na kar aur hamen uske baad aazmaaish mein na daal.

Abu huraira, abu qataada aur abu ibraaheem ashahli apne pita (jo ki sahaabi the) se riwayat karte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne janaaze ki namaz parhi aur yeh dua keeh "Ai Allah, hamaare jeewit tatha mrit, chhote tatha bare, purush tatha stri aur upasthit tatha anupasthit sabko kshama kar de. Ai Allah, hammen se jise jeewit rakhna ho, islaam par jeewit rakh aur hammen se jise maarna ho, use eemaan ki awastha mein maut de.Ai Allah, hamen uske pratiphal se wanchit na kar aur hamen uske baad aazmaaish mein na daal."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5022: Ai Allah, amuk putr amuk teri sharan tatha teri suraksha mein hai. Atah use qabr ki aazmaaish aur aag ke azaab se bacha. Tu daata aur prashansayogy hai. Ai Allah, ise kshama kar de aur ispar daya kar. Nishchay hi tu ati kshamaasheel aur dayaawaan hai.

Waasila bin asqa (radiyallahu anhu) warnan karte hue kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen ek musalmaan ki namaz-e-janaaza parhaai, to mainne aapko kahte hue sunaah "Ai Allah, amuk putr amuk teri sharan tatha teri suraksha mein hai. Atah use qabr ki aazmaaish aur aag ke azaab se bacha. Tu daata aur prashansayogy hai. Ai Allah, ise kshama kar de aur ispar daya kar. Nishchay hi tu ati kshamaasheel aur dayaawaan hai."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5024: Ai Allah tu hi mera baazu aur sahayak hai. Tere hi sahaare main sthaan badalta hoon, teri hi madad se shatru par aakraman karta hoon aur teri sahayta se yuddh karta hoon.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab yuddh shuru karte, to yeh dua farmaateh "Ai Allah tu hi mera baazu aur sahayak hai. Tere hi sahaare main sthaan badalta hoon, teri hi madad se shatru par aakraman karta hoon aur teri sahayta se yuddh karta hoon."
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5026: Aankhen aansu baha rahi hain aur dil shokaakuुl hai, lekin ham wahi kahte hain, jo hamaare rab ko pasand ho aur ai ibraaheem, ham teri judaai se dukhi hain.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne bete ibraaheem ke paas us samay aye, jab woh praan tyaag rahe the. Atah, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki aankhon se aansu jaari ho gae. Yeh dekh abdurrahmaan bin auf ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, aap bhi aansu baha rahe hain? To aapne farmayaah "Ai auf ke bete, yeh daya hai." Phir aage farmayaah "Aankhen aansu baha rahi hain aur dil shokaakuुl hai, lekin ham wahi kahte hain, jo hamaare rab ko pasand ho aur ai ibraaheem, ham teri judaai se dukhi hain."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5033: Meri ummat ka bhraman (sarvashaktimaan evn prabhutvashaali) Allah ke maarg mein jihaad hai.

Abu umaama (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki ek vyakti ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, mujhe bhraman ki anumti deejiye. To Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Meri ummat ka bhraman (sarvashaktimaan evn prabhutvashaali) Allah ke maarg mein jihaad hai."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5035: Do duayen lautaai nahin jaateen ya kam hi lautaai jaati hain; azaan ke samay ki dua aur yuddh ke samay ki dua, jab log ek-doosre se guth jayen.

Sahl bin saad (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh "Do duayen lautaai nahin jaateen ya kam hi lautaai jaati hain; azaan ke samay ki dua aur yuddh ke samay ki dua, jab log ek-doosre se guth jayen."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5036: Tere liye iske badle mein qayaamat ke din saat sau nakel lagi hui oontniyaan hain.

Abu masaood (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ek vyakti Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas ek nakel lagi hui oontni lekar aya aur bola ki yeh Allah ke maarg mein hai, to Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Tere liye iske badle mein qayaamat ke din saat sau nakel lagi hui oontniyaan hain."
5037: Suno aur anusran karo. Unpar us baat ki zimmewaari hai, jo unke oopar daali gai hai aur tumpar us baat ki zimmewaari hai, jo tumpar daali gai hai.

Waail hazarmi kahte hain ki salma bin yazeed jofi radiyallahu anhu ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Agar hamaare shaasak aise log ban jayen, jo apna haq to hamse wasool karen, lekin hamaara haq hamen na den, to aap is wishay mein hamen kya nirdesh dete hain? Aapne unki baat par dhyaan heen diya. Unhonne dobaara sawaal kiya, aapne is baar bhi dhyaan nahin diya. Unhonne phir doosri ya teesri baat sawaal kiya, to ashaas bin qais radiyallahu anhu ne unko kheench liya. Ab aapne farmaya : "Suno aur anusran karo. Unpar us baat ki zimmewaari hai, jo unke oopar daali gai hai aur tumpar us baat ki zimmewaari hai, jo tumpar daali gai hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se aise shaaskon ke baare mein poochha gaya, jo logon ko unki baat maanne aur unka anusran karne ko kahte hain, lekin nyay karne, ghaneemat ke dhan ka uchit batvaara karne, atyaachaar se bachaane aur sab ko samaan drishti se dekhne aadi apne kartavyon ka paalan nahin karte. Aise shaaskon ke prati kis prakaar ka rawaiya hona chahiye?

Yeh sawaal sunne ke baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne sawaal karne waale se munh pher liya. Aisa laga ki aapne is sawaal ko pasand nahin kiya. Lekin sawaal karne waala apna sawaal doosri baar aur phir teesri baar dohraata raha. Yeh dekh ashaas bin qais radiyallahu anhu ne unko khaamosh karne ke liye kheench liya.

Yeh sab kuchh hone ke baad Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne sawaal ka jawaab de diya. Farmaya : Tum shaaskon ki baat maano aur unke aadeshon ka paalan karo. Kyonki unko nyay sthaapit karne aur aam logon ko unka adhikaar dene jaisi zimmewaariyon ka jawaab dena hai, jo unke sar par daali gai hain aur tumko unke aadeshon ka paalan karne, unke adhikaar dene aur pareeksha ke samay dhairy se kaam lene jaisi zimmewaariyon ka jawaab dena hoga, jo tumhaare sar par daali gai hain.

Allah ki prasannata waale kaamon mein shaaskon ki baat har haal mein suni jayegi aur unka anusran har haal mein kiya jayega, chaahe woh aam logon ke adhikaar na bhi dete hon.
Shaaskon ki or se aam logon ke adhikaar ki adaygi mein hone waali kotaahi is baat ki anumti nahin deti ki aam log bhi apni zimmewaariyon ki adaygi mein kotaahi baratne lagen. Kyonki har insaan se khud uske amal ke baare mein poochha jayega aur khud uski kotaahiyon par use pakra jayega.
Deen ka aadhaar jaise ko taisa ke siddhaant par nahin balki apni zimmewaariyaan ada karne par rakha gaya hai. Chaahe saamne waala vyakti apni zimmewaariyon ki adaygi mein kotaahi hi kyon na karta ho. Yahi baat is hadees mein kahi gai hai.
5141: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- pareshaani ke samay yeh dua parha karte the : (Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai, jo mahaan evn sahishnu hai. Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai, jo mahaan sinhaasan ka rab hai. Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai, jo aakaashon, dharti evn sammaanit sinhaasan ka rab hai.)

Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- pareshaani ke samay yeh dua parha karte the : (Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai, jo mahaan evn sahishnu hai. Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai, jo mahaan sinhaasan ka rab hai. Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai, jo aakaashon, dharti evn sammaanit sinhaasan ka rab hai.)

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bare sankat tatha pareshaani ke samay yeh dua parha karte the : Allah ke siwa koi sachcha poojy nahin hai. Woh apni zaat, gunon aur kaaryon mein oonche martabe aur bari shaan waala hai. Woh sahansheel hai, jo kisi awajnaakaari bande ko fauran saza nahin deta. Saza dene mein der karta hai. Kabhi-kabhi to maaf bhi kar deta hai. Jabki woh saza dene ki poori shakti rakhta hai. Uske paas har cheez ki kshamta hai. Allah ke siwa koi sachcha poojy nahin hai, jo mahaan sinhaasan ka maalik hai. Allah ke siwa koi sachcha poojy nahin hai, jo aakaashon evn dharti ka maalik evn srishtikarta tatha unke andar maujood tamaam cheezon ka srishtikarta, maalik, sudhaarak evn sanchaalankarta hai. Woh sammaanit sinhaasan ka maalik tatha srishtikarta hai.

Museebten evn pareshaaniyaan aane par Allah ke saamne girgiraane aur dua karne ki zaroorat.
Pareshaani ke samay yeh dua karna musathab hai.
Rahmaan (dayaawaan Allah) ka arsh, jispar woh musvi (wiraajmaan) hai, sabse oonchi, sabse bari aur sabse mahaan srishti hai. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne use mahaan evn sammaanit kaha hai.
Yahaan wishesh roop se aakaashon evn dharti ka zikr isliye kiya gaya hai ki yeh donon hamen nazar aane waali mahaantam srishtiyon mein se hain.
Allaama teebi kahte hain: "Is stuti ki shuruaat paalanhaar ke zikr se ki gai hai taaki yeh wipatti aur kasht ko door karne ke anukool ho; kyonki yeh 'tarbiyat' (paalan-poshan) ka takaaza hai. Aur ismen 'tahleel' (la ilaaha illallah) shaamil hai jo 'tauheed' (ekeshvarvaad) ko samete hue hai, aur yahi Allah ki mahaanta se juri tanzeeh (Allah ko har kami se paak maanne) ka mool hai. 'Azmat' poorn saamarthy ko darshaati hai, aur 'hilm' (sahansheelta) jnaan ko darshaata hai, kyonki ek ajnaani vyakti se sahansheelta aur udaarta ki kalpana bhi nahin ki ja sakti, aur ye donon hi sammaanajnak gunon ki jar hain."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5142: Tumse poorv ke samudayon mein kuchh log aise hote the, jinhen ilhaam hota tha. Yadi meri ummat mein koi aisa hai, to woh umar hain.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Tumse poorv ke samudayon mein kuchh log aise hote the, jinhen ilhaam hota tha. Yadi meri ummat mein koi aisa hai, to woh umar hain."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5204: Ham namaz mein baat kar liya karte the. Aadmi apne saathi se, jo uske bagal mein namaz parh raha hota, baat kar leta tha. Yahaan tak ki Qur'an ki yeh aytah "وقوموا لله قانتين" Awatrit hui, to hamen chup rahne ka aadesh diya gaya tatha baat karne se mana kar diya gaya.

Zaid bin arqam (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ham namaz mein baat kar liya karte the. Aadmi apne saathi se, jo uske bagal mein namaz parh raha hota, baat kar leta tha. Yahaan tak ki Qur'an ki yeh aytah "وقوموا لله قانتين" Awatrit hui, to hamen chup rahne ka aadesh diya gaya tatha baat karne se mana kar diya gaya.

Namaz rab se bandon ko jorne ka maadhyam hai. Atah kisi namaazi ko Allah se munaajaat ke alaawa kisi aur cheez mein vyast nahin hona chahiye. Zaid bin arqam -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki shuru-shuru mein musalmaan namaz ke andar aawashyakta ke mutaabik baat kar liya karte the. Ek aadmi apne bagle mein khare vyakti se zaroorat ki baat kar leta tha. Yeh sab Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki upasthiti mein hota tha aur aapne kabhi kisi ko mana bhi nahin kiya.
Lekin choonki namaz mein banda Allah se munaajaat karta hai aur yahaan kisi srishti se baat karne ki gunjaaish nahin hoti, isliye uchch evn mahaan Allah ne unhen namaz ki suraksha karne, khaamosh rahne aur baat karne se bachne ka aadesh diya aur yeh ayat awatrit ki : {حَافِظُوا عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ وَالصّلاةِ الوُسطى وَقُومُوا لله قَانِتِينَ} (namaazon ki aur wishesh roop se beech waali namaz ki suraksha karo aur Allah ke sammukh winaypoorvak khare raho.) iske baad sahaaba samajh gae ki unhen namaz mein baat karne se mana kiya gaya hai, isliye is silsile ko band kar diya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5205: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) juma ke din khutba de rahe the ki ek vyakti andar aya. Aapne kahaah "Ai amuk kya toone namaz parh li hai?" Usne kahaah nahin. Farmayaah "Khare ho jaao aur do rakaat parh lo."

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) juma ke din khutba de rahe the ki ek vyakti andar aya. Aapne kahaah "Ai amuk kya toone namaz parh li hai?" Usne kahaah nahin. Farmayaah "Khare ho jaao aur do rakaat parh lo."
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih "Do rakaat parh lo."

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- masjid-e-nabvi mein khutba de rahe the ki sulaik al-ghatfaani -radiyallahu anhu- masjid mein daakhil hue aur tahiyyatul masjid parhe bina hi baith gae. Tahiyyatul masjid na parhne ka karaan ya to yeh raha ho ki woh uske hukm se anbhijn the ya phir unko aisa laga hoga ki khutba sunne ka mahatv usse adhik hai. Khair kaaran jo bhi raha ho, lekin Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- khutbe mein vyast hone ke baavjood unko shiksha dena nahin bhoole. Farmaya : Ai amuk, kya tumne meri nazar parne se pahle masjid ke kisi kinaare mein namaz parhi hai? Unhonne nahin mein uttar diya, to farmaya : Utho aur do rakaat parh lo. Saheeh Muslim ki ek riwayat me nhai ki aapne unko do rakaat halke andaaz mein parhne ka aadesh diya hai. Aapne yeh baat ek bari sabha ke andar kahi, taaki ek to yeh ki unko zarurat ke samay hi shiksha mil jaye aur doosra yeh ki yeh shiksha sabhi upasthit logon ke liye aam ho.
Atah, jo vyakti is haal mein masjid mein daakhil ho ki imaam khutba de raha ho, use do rakaat parh leni chahiye. Iski ek daleel yahi hadees hai aur doosri daleel Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka yeh farmaan hai : "Jab tummen se koi juma ke din masjid aye aur imaam khutba de raha ho, to do rakaat parh le."
Yahi kaaran hai ki navvi ne saheeh Muslim ki sharh mein Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke farmaan : "Jab tummen se koi juma ke din masjid aye aur imaam khutba de raha ho, to do rakaat parh le aur un do rakaaton ko halke andaaz mein parhe." Ki vyaakhya karte hue likha hai : Yeh aise shabd hain, jinki kuchh aur vyaakhya karne ki gunjaaish nahin hai aur mujhe nahin lagta ki kisi aalim ko yeh shabd pahunch jayen aur woh is hadees ko saheeh maanta ho aur phir bhi iski mukhaalfat karega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5206: Zaatur-riqa yuddh mein parhi gai bhay ki namaz ki tareeqa

Saaleh bin khavvaat bin jubair (radiyallahu anhu) ne ek aise vyakti se riwayat kiya hai, jisne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath zaatur-riqa yuddh mein bhay ki namaz parhi thi ki ek giroh ne aapke saath saf baandh liya aur ek giroh shatru ke saamne khara raha. Chunaanche jo log aapke saath the, unhen aapne ek rakaat parhaai. Phir aap khare rahe aur unhonne apni namaz poori kar li tatha dushman ke aage morchaaband ho gae. Phir dusra giroh aya, to aap unhen shesh ek rakaat parhaakar baithe rahe aur unhonne apni namaz poori kar li. Phir aapne unke saath salaam phera.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apne saathiyon ke saath ek yuddh mein nikle. Adhiktar log paidal the, isliye paidal chalte-chalte paanv ghis gae. Haalat yeh thi ki logon ne bachne ke liye qadmon par puraane kapre lapet liye the. Is yuddh mein dushman se mulaaqaat to hui, lekin yuddh nahin hua. Albatta, musalmaan dushmanon ko bhaybheet karne mein saphal rahe. Is hadees mein jis ghatna ka ullekh hai, usmen musalmaanon ke saamne jo dushman the, we qible ki or nahin the. Kyonki unke ghar madeene se poorab ki or the. Atah, Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne Muslim sainikon ko do bhaagon mein baant diya. Ek bhaag aapke saath namaz ke liye panktibaddh ho gaya aur doosra bhaag dushmanon ke saamne khara raha, jo namaaziyon ke peechhe the.
Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne saath khare logon ko ek rakaat parhaai aur unke saath doosri rakaat ke liye khare ho gae. Phir aap khare rah gae. Jabki peechhe ke logon ne ek aur rakaat parh apni namaz poori kar li aur salaam pherkar dushman ke saamne ja khare hue. Ab doosra giroh aya, to aapne unko shesh ek rakaat parhaai aur uske baad baithe rahe. Jab peechhe ke logon ne khare hokar ek rakaat poori kar li, to aapne unke saath salaam phera. Is tarah, pahle giroh ko aapke saath takbeer-e-tahreema mein shaamil hone ka avsar mila, to doosre giroh ko salaam pherne ka. Donon girohon ko imaam ke saath namaz parhne ki fazeelat bhi mil gai aur musalmaanon ko dushman ke aakraman se bacha bhi liya gaya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5207: Mujhe Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath rahne ka saubhaagy praapt hua. Chunaanche aap safar mein do rakaat se adhik nahin parhte the tatha abu bakr, umar aur usmaan bhi aisa hi karte the.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mujhe Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath rahne ka saubhaagy praapt hua. Chunaanche aap safar mein do rakaat se adhik nahin parhte the tatha abu bakr, umar aur usmaan bhi aisa hi karte the.

Abdullah bin umar -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki woh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath yaatra mein rahe. Isi tarah abu bakr, umar aur usmaan (radiyallahu anhum) ke saath bhi safar mein rahe. Unhonne dekha ki yeh saare log chaar rakaat waali namaazon ko do rakta parhte the aur usse adhik nahin parhte the. Saath hi farz namaazon se pahle aur baad ki sunnaten bhi nahin parhte the. Unhonne abu bakr, umar aur usmaan ka naam yeh bataane ke liye liya ki yeh hukm mansookh (nirast) nahin hai, balki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki mrityu ke pashchaat bhi saabit hai aur uske wirodh mein koi mazboot daleel nahin hai. Safar mein poori namaz parhna jayaj hai, kintu qasr (chaar rakaat waali namaazon ko do rakaat parhna) behtar hai. Isliye ki Allah ka farmaan hai : {to namaz qasr karke parhne mein tumpar koi dosh nahin hai.} yahaan dosh na hone ki baat karna is baat ka sanket hai ki yeh aniwaary nahin, balki chhoot hai. Aniwaary isliye bhi nahin hai, kyonki asal poori namaz parhna hai aur qasr (sankshipteekran) kisi adhik lanbi cheez ko chhota karne ka naam hai. Yaatri ke liye behtar yeh hai ki poori namaz parhne ke bajay qasr kare, kyonki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hamesha qasr karte the aur Allah bhi is baat ko pasand karta hai ki uski chhoot ko grahan kiya jaye. Phir, isse waajib kahne waalon ki mukhaalfat bhi nahin hoti aur yahi jamhoor ulema ke nikat behtar bhi hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5208: Yeh baanjh ho tatha iska gala dukhe, kya isne qurbaani ke din tawaaf kar liya hai?" Kaha gaya ki haan! To farmayaah "Phir chalo chalen."

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki hamne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath Hajj kiya. Chunaanche hamne qurbaani ke din hi tawaaf-e-ifaaza kar liya. Isi beech safeeya (radiyallahu anha) ko maahvaari a gai. Phir Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unse woh karna chaaha, jo aadmi apni patni se karta hai, to mainne kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool, woh maahvaari mein hai. Yeh sun aapne farmayaah "Kya yeh hamen rok legi?" Logon ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, unhonne qurbaani ke din tawaf-e-ifaaza kar liya tha. To pharmayaah "Phir ab nikal paro."
Tatha ek riwayat mein hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Yeh baanjh ho tatha iska gala dukhe, kya isne qurbaani ke din tawaaf kar liya hai?" Kaha gaya ki haan! To farmayaah "Phir chalo chalen."

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki sahaaba -radiyallahu anhum- ne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath hajjatul wada ke avsar par Hajj kiya.
Jab we Hajj ke kaam kar chuke, to tawaaf-e-ifaaza kar liya. Logon ke saath Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki patni safiyya -radiyallahu anha- bhi theen.
Jab rawaangi ki raat aai, to safiyya -radiyallahu anha- ko maahvaari a gai. Isi beech Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- unke paas woh karne ke liye aye, jo aadmi apni patni ke saath karta hai, to aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ne bataya ki unko maahvaari a gai hai. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne samjha ki unko maahvaari pahle hi a gai thi aur woh tawaaf-e-ifaaza nahin kar saki hai.
Phir, choonki tawaaf-e-ifaaza Hajj ka ek rukn hai aur uske bina Hajj poora nahin ho sakta. Atah, unke pawitr hone tatha tawaaf karne se pahle log makka se nikal nahin payenge, isliye aapne woh prasiddh waaky kah diya, jo zabaan par a jaata hai aur uske asli mayne muraad nahin hote. Yaani yeh ki woh baanjh ho tatha uska gala dukhe. Phir aage farmaya ki kya woh maahvaari se pawitr hone aur tawaaf karne tak hamen rok legi? Lekin jab logon ne bataya ki woh maahvaari aaranbh hone se pahle hi tawaaf-e-ifaaza kar chuki hain to farmaya : Tab to woh chal de. Kyonki ab unka kewal tawaaf-e-wada baaqi hai, jise chhorne ka unke paas uchit kaaran hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5209: Mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke peechhe ek aisi stri ki namaz-e-janaaza parhi, jo nifaas (woh praakritik rakt, jo prasav ke baad nikalta hai) ki avdhi mein mar gai thi, to aap uske beech mein khare hue.

Samura bin jundub (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke peechhe ek aisi stri ki namaz-e-janaaza parhi, jo nifaas (woh praakritik rakt, jo prasav ke baad nikalta hai) ki avdhi mein mar gai thi, to aap uske beech mein khare hue.

Mritak par namaz pratyek marne waale musalmaan ka adhikaar hai. Chaahe woh nar ho ya naari aur chhota ho ya bara. Yahaan samura bin jundub -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke peechhe ek stri ki namaz-e-janaaza parhi, jo nifaas (woh praakritik rakt, jo prasav ke baad nikalta hai) ki avdhi mein mar gai thi. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- namaz parhaane ke liye uske shareer ke beech ke saamne khare hue.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5210: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek qabr par murde ko dafnaye jaane ke baad namaz parhi aur chaar takbeeren kaheen.
Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) farmaate hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek qabr par murde ko dafnaye jaane ke baad namaz parhi aur chaar takbeeren kaheen.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki srishti hi achchhe aachran ke saath hui thi aur aapke hisse mein daya evn karuna ka bahut bara bhaag aya tha. Yahi kaaran hai ki jab bhi aapko apna koi saathi nazar na aata, uske baare mein poochhte aur uska haal jaanne ka prayaas karte.
Isi tarah, aapne is qabr mein dafan vyakti ke baare mein poochha, to bataya gaya ki uski mrityu ho chuki hai. Ispar aapne ichchha vyakt ki ki yadi logon ne aapko bataya hota, to uski namaz mein shareek hote, kyonki aapki namaz mritak ke liye sukoon ka kaaran hoti hai aur isse woh andhkaar samaapt ho jaata hai, jismen woh hota hai. Phir aapne uski qabr par usi tarah namaz parhi, jis tarah upasthit janaaze par namaz parhi jaati hai.
Yaad rahe ki qabr par aapke namaz parhne ka matlab yeh nahin hai ki aapne uske oopar charhkar namaz parhi hogi, balki iska matlab yeh hai ki aap uske paas khare hue, uski or munh kiya aur uspar janaaze ki namaz parhi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5212: Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne soora nasr utarne ke baad jab bhi koi namaz parhi, uske andar yeh dua zaroor parhi : (Ai Allah, ai hamaare rab, tu apni prashansa ke saath paak hai. Ai Allah, tu mujhe maaph kar de.)

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne soora nasr utarne ke baad jab bhi koi namaz parhi, uske andar yeh dua zaroor parhi : (Ai Allah, ai hamaare rab, tu apni prashansa ke saath paak hai. Ai Allah, tu mujhe maaph kar de.)  unheen se riwayat hai, woh kahti hain : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ruku tatha sajde mein yeh dua bahut zyaada parha karte the : (Ai Allah, ai hamaare rab, tu apni prashansa ke saath paak hai. Ai Allah, tu mujhe maaph kar de.) daraasal aisa karke aap Qur'an ke andar diye gae aadesh ka paalan karte the.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha bayaan farma rahi hain ki jab uchch evn mahaan Allah ne Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par {إذا جاء نصر الله والفتح}  arthaat "Jab Allah ki madad aur wijay a jaye" Utaara, to aapne fauran Allah ke aadesh {فسبح بحمد ربك واستغفره} "To apne paalanhaar ki prashansa ke saath uski pawitrata ka warnan karo aur usse kshama maango." Ka paalan karna shuru kar diya. Chunaanche aap namaz ke andar ruku aur sajde mein bahut zyaada "سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي" Parhte the. «سبحانك» yaani ai Allah! Main teri paaki bayaan karta hoon aur tujhko har kami se shuddh qaraar deta hoon, jo teri mahima ke yogy nahin hai. «اللهم ربنا وبحمدك» ai Allah, hamaare paalanhaar! Teri sarvottam stuti evn aaraadhna ki teri zaat, tere gun aur tere karm sabhi poornatam ke uchchatam star par hain. «اللهم اغفر لي» ai Allah! Mere gunaahon ko mita de aur unhen kshama kar de.

Ruku aur sajde mein yeh dua adhik se adhik parhna jaahiye.
Antim ayu mein! Kshama yaachna karne mein yeh sanket chhupa hua hai ki ibaadton aur isi tarah wishesh roop se namaz ka ant kshama yaachna par hona chahiye, taaki unke andar rah jaane waali kamiyon ko door kiya ja sake.
Dua sveekaar ho jaye, iska sabse behtar saadhan yeh hai ki Allah ki prashansa ki jaye, uski paaki bayaan ki jaye aur kamiyon evn doshon se use paak qaraar diya jaye.
Kshama yaachna ki phazeelat aur har haal mein kshama yaachna karna.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bandgi aur sarvashaktimaan Allah ke aadeshon ko poora karne ke maamle mein uchchatam sthaan par wiraajmaan the.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5213: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek vyakti ko ek sainyadal ka ameer banaakar bheja. Woh apne saathiyon ko namaz parhaate samay kuraaan parhta, to ant mein "قل هو الله أحد" Parhta.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek vyakti ko ek sainyadal ka ameer banaakar bheja. Woh apne saathiyon ko namaz parhaate samay kuraaan parhta, to ant mein "قل هو الله أحد" Parhta. Chunaannche jab log waapas aye, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saamne iski charcha ki. So, aapne farmayaah "Usse poochho ki usne aisa kyon kiya?" Logon ne usse poochha, to batayaah kyonki yeh soora Allah ki wisheshtaaon par aadhaarit hai aur mujhe is soora ko parhna pasand hai. Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Use bata do ki Allah usse prem karta hai."

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne ek saathi ko kisi yuddh ka ameer banaya, taaki prabandh dekhne tatha nirnay lene ka kaam kar saken aur vyawastha mein koi garabri na aane paye. Ameer ke taur par aap kisi aise vyakti ka chayan karte the, jo deendaari, jnaan evn prabandh ke maamle mein sabse sateek hota. Yahi kaaran hai ki ameer hi namaz parhaate aur wahi fatva dete the. Us vyakti se juri hui ek khaas baat yeh thi ki woh har namaz ki doosri rakaat mein soora "Qul huwallahu ahad" Parhte the. Kaaran yeh tha ki unko Allah, uske naamon evn gunon se prem tha aur jise kisi cheez se prem hota hai, woh uska zikr zyaada se zyaada karta hai.
Jab sab log yuddh se lautkar Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aye aur aapke saamne iska zikr kiya, to aapne kaha : Usse poochho ki woh aisa kyon karta tha?
Jab logon ne poochha to unhonne bataya ki main aisa isliye karta tha, kyonki us soora mein sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ke sadgunon ka zikr hai aur mujhe unko dohraana achchha lagta hai.
Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : Use bata do ki jis tarah use Allah ke mahaan gunon par aadhaarit hone ke kaaran is soora se prem hai, usi tarah Allah ko bhi usse prem hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5214: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke zamaane mein soory grahan hua, to aapne ek vyakti ko aawaaz lagaane ke liye bheja ki namaz khari hone waali hai. Atah log ekatr ho gae. Phir aap aage barhe, takbeer kahi aur do rakaat mein chaar ruku aur chaar sajde kiye.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke zamaane mein soory grahan hua, to aapne ek vyakti ko aawaaz lagaane ke liye bheja ki namaz khari hone waali hai. Atah log ekatr ho gae. Phir aap aage barhe, takbeer kahi aur do rakaat mein chaar ruku aur chaar sajde kiye.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke zamaane mein sooraj grahan hua, to aapne ek pukaarne waale ko sarkon aur baazaaron ki or logon ko yeh kahkar bulaane ke liye bheja ki namaz hone waali hai. Uddeshy yeh tha ki log namaz parhen aur Allah se praarthana karen ki woh unhen kshama kare, unpar daya kare aur apni khuli evn gupt nemton ko jaari rakhe.
Log aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki masjid mein ekatr hue, to aap us sthaan ki or barhe jahaan khare hokar namaz parhaya karte the. Phir ek aisi namaz parhaai ki us tarah ki namaz logon ne isse pahle kabhi nahin dekhi thi. Namaz bina iqaamat ke parhaai. Takbeer kahi aur do rakaat namaz is tarah parhaai ki har rakaat mein do-do ruku aur do-do sajde the.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5215: Sooraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se do nishaaniyaan hain. Unhen grahan kisi vyakti ki maut aur jeewan ke liye nahin lagta. Atah, jab tum aisa hota dekho to Allah se dua karo, takbeer kaho, namaz parho aur sadqa karo.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke zamaane mein sooraj ko grahan laga, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne logon ko namaz padhaai. Aapne lanba qayaam kiya, phir ruku kiya aur der tak ruku mein rahe, phir khare hue aur der tak khare rahe, (parantu, is baar pahli baar ki tulna mein kuchh kam khare rahe) phir ruku kiya aur der tak ruku mein rahe, (parantu pahle ruku ki tulna mein kuchh kam) phir sar uthaya aur der tak khare rahe (lekin pahli baar ke muqaable mein kuchh kam) phir sajda kiya aur der tak sajde mein rahe. Phir doosri rakaat mein usi tarah kiya jaisa pahli rakaat mein kiya tha. Phir namaz se nikle, to sooraj poore taur par khul chuka tha. Uske baad logon ke saamne khutba diya aur Allah ki prashansa evn stuti ke baad farmayaah "Sooraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se do nishaaniyaan hain. Unhen grahan kisi vyakti ki maut aur jeewan ke liye nahin lagta. Atah, jab tum aisa hota dekho to Allah se dua karo, takbeer kaho, namaz parho aur sadqa karo."
Phir farmaya: Ai Muhammad ki ummat, Allah ki qasam, Allah se adhik kisi ko is baat par ghairat nahin aati ki uska daas athva uski daasi vyabhichaar mein lipt ho. Ai Muhammad ki ummat, yadi tum woh jaan lete, jo main jaanta hoon to tum kam hanste aur adhik rote.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih aapne chaar ruku aur chaar sajde kiye.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke zamaane mein sooraj grahan hua. Choonki yeh ek asmaany ghatna thi, isliye Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek aisi namaz parhaai jo apne aakaar evn maatra mein anokhi thi. Aap khare hue aur logon ko is tarah namaz parhaai ki takbeer-e-tahreema ke pashchaat bara lanba qayaam kiya, phir ruku kiya aur lanba ruku kiya, phir khare hue aur lanbi qiraat ki, jo pahli qiraat ki tulna mein kuchh sankshipt thi, phir ruku kiya aur lanba ruku kiya, parantu woh pahle ruku ki tulna mein halka tha, phir ruku se sar uthaya aur "Samiallahu liman hamidah" Dua parhi aur qiraat nahin ki, phir sajda kiyl aur lanba sajda kiya. Phir doosri rakaat mein wahi kuchh kiya jo pahli rakaat mein kiya tha, lekin yeh rakaat pahli rakaat ke muqaable mein zara halki thi aur uska har rukn apne se pahle rukn se zara halka tha. Is tarah do rakaat mein kul chaar ruku aur chaar sajde kiye. Phir aapne namaz se salaam phera, to sooraj saaf hokar nikal chuka tha. Phir khutba diya, jaisa ki wibhinn awasron par khutba diya karte the. Usmen Allah ki prashansa tatha stuti ki aur logon ko naseehat ki. Ittefaaq se jis din sooraj grahan hua tha, usi din aapke bete ibraaheem -Allah unse prasann ho- ki mrityu bhi hui thi. Isliye jaahiliyat kaal ki is dhaarna ke anusaar ki sooraj grahan kisi bare aadmi ki maut athva kisi bare aadmi ki paidaaish ke kaaran hota hai, kuchh log kahne lage ki aaj ki yeh ghatna ibraaheem ki mrityu ke kaaran ghatit hui hai. Aise mein, Nabi -sallallahu alaihe wa sallam- ne uchit jaana ki logon ko samjhaya jaye, apna wishuddh sandesh pahuncha diya jaye aur logon ke zehn mein baithe hue is mithak ko hataane ke saath-saath, jiska na Qur'an wa hadees se koi saboot hai aur na svachchh wiwek hi use sahi maanta hai, sooraj tatha chaand grahan ki asal hikmat bayaan kar di jaye. Chunaanche aapne khutbe mein farmaya : Waastav mein soory evn chaand Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se do nishaaniyaan hain. Unmen kisi vyakti ke jeewan aur maut se grahan nahin lagta. Daasal is tarah ki ghatnayen Allah apni shakti se ghatit karta hai, taaki unse apne bandon ko bhaybheet kare tatha unhen apni nemton ki yaad dilaye.
Isliye jab tum aisa kuchh dekho, to Allah ki or tauba karte aur ruju karte hue bhaago, dua karo, takbeer kaho, namaz parho aur sadqa karo, isliye ki usse sanbhaawit aapda evn aane waali yaatna door ho sakti hai.
Phir aap -sallallahu alaihe wa sallam- unke saamne kuchh bare gunaahon ko wistrit roop se bayaan karne lage. Jaise ki vyabhichaar, jo samaaj evn maanav vyavhaar ko bigaarne ka kaam karta hai aur Allah ke krodh tatha dand ko aniwaary kar deta hai. Is khutbe mein aapne, jo sachche bhi hain aur jinko sachcha maana bhi gaya hai, yeh kahte hue qasam khaai ki ai Muhammad ki ummat, Allah ki saugandh, Allah se adhik is baat se kisi ko ghairat nahin aati ki uska daas athva uski daasi vyabhichaar mein lipt ho. Phir bataya ki logon ko Allah ki saza ke sanbandh mein bahut thori jaankaari hai. Yadi we wo baaten jaan lete jo aap -sallallahu alaihe wa sallam- jaante hain, to bhayaakraant ho jaate aur hanste bahut kam evn rote tatha dukhi adhik rahte. Parantu Allah ne apni hikmat se is unse chhupa rakha hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5216: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) namaz takbeer se aur qiraat "Al-hamdu lillahi rabbil aalmeen" Se aaranbh karte the. Jab ruku karte, to na apne sar ko uthaye rakhte aur na bahut zyaada jhukaate, balki in donon ke beech rakhte.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) namaz takbeer se aur qiraat "Al-hamdu lillahi rabbil aalmeen" Se aaranbh karte the. Jab ruku karte, to na apne sar ko uthaye rakhte aur na bahut zyaada jhukaate, balki in donon ke beech rakhte. Jab ruku se apna sar uthaate, to us samay tak sajde mein nahin jaate, jab tak seedhe khare na ho jaate. Jab sajde se sar uthaate, to doosra sajda us samay tak nahin karte, jab tak seedhe baith na jaate. Har do rakaat par 'at-tahiyyaat' parhte aur apne bayen pair ko bichhaakar tatha dayen pair ko khara karke baithte. Aap namaz mein shaitaan ki tarah baithne se mana karte aur is baat se bhi mana karte the ki aadmi sajde mein darinde ki tarah apne donon baazu ko phaila de. Aap namaz ka ant salaam se karte.

Aaisha -Allah unse prasann ho- is mahatvapoorn hadees ke maadhyam se Nabi -sallallahu alaihe wa sallam- ki namaz ka warnan, sunnat ke prachaar evn jnaan ke prasaar hetu kar rahi hain. Woh bata rahi hain ki aap namaz ki shuruaat takbeer-e-tahreema se karte hue "Allahu akbar" Kahte.
Jabki qiraat ka aaranbh soora phaatiha se karte, jiske praaranbh mein "Al hamdu lillahi rabbil aalmeen" Hai.
Jab qayaam ke baad ruku karte, to na sar ko bahut jhukaate aur na uthaye rakhte, balki bilkul seedha rakhte.
Jab ruku se sar uthaate, to sajde mein jaane se pahle seedhe khare ho jaate.Jab sajde se sar uthaate, to us samay tak doosra sajda nahin karte, jab tak theek se baith na jaate.
Phir jab har do rakaat ke baad baithte, to "At-tahiyyaat lillahi was-salaawaatu wat-tayyibaatu…." Parhte.
Jab baithte, to apne bayen paanv ko bichha dete aur uspar baith jaate aur apne dayen paanv ko khara rakhte. Aap namaazi ko apni namaz mein shaitaan ki tarah baithne se mana karte the. Shaitaan ki tarah baithne ka matlab yeh hai ki aadmi apne donon qadmon ko zameen par bichha de aur apni donon eriyon par baithe ya phir donon qadmon ko khara rakhe aur apne donon nitanbon ko un donon ke darmiyaan zameen par rakhe. In donon tareeqon se mana kiya gaya hai. Isi prakaar aapne namaazi ko sajde ki haalat mein apne baazuon ko bichha dene tatha unhen darindon ki phailaane se mana farmaya hai. Phir, jis tarah aap namaz ki shuruaat Allah ke sammaan evn baraai se karte, uska ant upasthit pharishton, namaajiyon, phir Allah ke sabhi nek bandon, poorvajon aur baad mein aane waalon ke liye shaanti ki dua ke saath karte the. Namaazi ka kartavy hai ki apni dua mein is aam paridrishy ko zehan mein rakhe.
5217: Main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihe wa sallam) ke saamne soe rahti aur mere donon pair aapke kible ki or hote. Jab aap sajde mein jaate, to dheere se mere shareer par oongli chubhaate aur main apne pair samet leti. Phir jab khare hote, to main pair phailaate leti. Un dinon gharon mein diye nahin hote the.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihe wa sallam) ke saamne soe rahti aur mere donon pair aapke kible ki or hote. Jab aap sajde mein jaate, to dheere se mere shareer par oongli chubhaate aur main apne pair samet leti. Phir jab khare hote, to main pair phailaate leti. Un dinon gharon mein diye nahin hote the.

Aaisha -Allah unse prasann ho- kahti hain ki raat ke samay jab Nabi -sallallahu alaihe wa sallam- namaz parhte hote, main aapke saamne hi so jaya karti. Choonki hamaare ghar bahut tang hote the, isliye mere donon paanv aapke qabile ki or yaani aapke tatha aapke sajde ke sthaan ke beech mein hote the. Jab tak aap qayaam mein rahte, main unhen phailaye rakhti aur jab sajde mein jaate to mere shareer mein ungli ka kinaara chubhokar ishaara karte aur main unhen samet leti ki aap sajda kar saken.
Yadi main aapko sajde ke samay dekh paati, to ungli ka kinaara chubhone ki zaroorat na parti aur main svayn apne pair samet leti, parantu un dinon hamaare gharon mein diye nahin hote the ki unke prakaash mein Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko dekh sakti aur paanv samet leti.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5218: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) raat ke har bhaag mein witr parhte the. Shuru mein bhi, beech mein bhi aur ant mein bhi. Aapke witr parhne antim samay sahar tak hota tha.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) raat ke har bhaag mein witr parhte the. Shuru mein bhi, beech mein bhi aur ant mein bhi. Aapke witr parhne antim samay sahar tak hota tha.

Mominon ki maata aaisha -Allah unse prasann ho- yahaan bata rahi hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- raat mein witr kis waqt parha karte the. Unka kahna hai ki ismen kisi wishesh samay ki kaid nahin thi. Aap raat ke har bhaag mein witr parhte the. Kabhi shuru mein parh lete, jab isha ki namaz parhte ya uske kuchh der baad. Kabhi raat ke beech mein pratham tihaai gujarne ke pashchaat aur kabhi raat ke antim bhaag mein uska do tihaai guzar jaane ke baad se lekar antim kshanon tak.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5219: Koofa waalon ne umar (radiyallahu anhu) ke yahaan saad bin abu waqqaas (radiyallahu anhu) ki shikayat ki, to umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne unko hataakar ammaar bin yaasir (radiyallahu anhuma) ko unka haakim bana diya.

Jaabir bin samura (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ki koofa waalon ne umar (radiyallahu anhu) ke yahaan saad bin abu waqqaas (radiyallahu anhu) ki shikayat ki, to umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne unko hataakar ammaar bin yaasir (radiyallahu anhuma) ko unka haakim bana diya. Un logon ne saad (radiyallahu anhu) ki shikayat karte hue yahaan tak kaha tha ki unhen achchhi tarah namaz parhna bhi nahin aata. Ispar umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne unhen bulvaya aur kahaah ai abu ishaaq! Yeh log kahte hain ki aap achchhi tarah namaz nahin parhte? Unhonne kahaah jahaan tak meri baat hai, Allah ki qasam ! Main unhen allallah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki jaisi namaz parhaata tha aur ismen tanik bhi kotaahi nahin karta tha. Isha ki namaz parhaata, to pahli do rakaaten lanbi karta tha aur baad ki do rakaaten halki. Umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne kahaah ai abu ishaaq! Aapke baare mein hamaara yahi gumaan hai. Phir umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne unke saath ek aadmi (ya kuchh logon) ko koofa bheja, toki koofa waalon se unke baare mein poochha ja sake. Chunaanche unhonne ek bhi masjid nahin chhori, jahaan unke baare mein na poochha ho. Sab log unki prashansa karte rahe. Anttah, woh banu abas ki ek masjid mein gae, jahaan usaama bin qataada naami aadmi khara hua, jiski kunniyat abu saada thi. Usne kahaah jab tumne hamen qasam dilaai hai, to suno! Saad jihaad mein sena ke saath khud nahin jaate the aur ghaneemat ka dhan baraabar taqseem nahin karte the aur nirnay dete samay nyay se kaam bhi nahin lete the. Yeh sunkar saad (radiyallahu anhu) ne kahaah Allah ki qasam! Main tujhe teen badduayen deta hoon; ai Allah yadi tera yeh banda jhootha hai aur dikhaawe tatha khyaati praapt karne ke liye khara hua hai, to ise lanbi ayu pradaan kar, iski daridrata barha de aur ise aazmaaishon ka shikaar bana de. Iske baad sthiti yeh hui ki jab usse uska haal poochha jaata, to kahtaah main aazmaaishon se ghira hua ek lanbi ayu waala boorha hoon. Mujhe saad ki baddua lag gai hai. Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) se warnan karne waale warnankarta abdul milak bin umair kahte hainh mainne use baad mein dekha tha. Burhaape ke kaaran uski bhrikutiyaan latakkar aankhon ke oopar a chuki theen. Iske baavjood woh raah chalti larkiyon ko chherta aur aankh maarta phirta tha.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5271: Ali bin abu taalib (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas ek sawaari laai gai, taaki uspar sawaar hon. Jab unhonne paydaan par paanv rakha, to 'bismillah' kaha.

Ali bin rabeea kahte hain ki mainne dekha ki ali bin abu taalib (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas ek sawaari laai gai, taaki uspar sawaar hon. Jab unhonne paydaan par paanv rakha, to 'bismillah' kaha. Phir jab theek se baith gae, to kahaah "Saari prashansa allah ki hai, jisne ise hamaare wash mein kar diya, warna ham ise apne qaabu mein la nahin sakte the tatha ham apne prabhu ki or lautne waale hain." Phir teen baar 'al-hamdu lillah' kaha aur teen baar 'Allahu akbar' kaha. Phir farmayaah "Ai Allah, tu paak hai. Mainne apne oopar atyaachaar kiya hai. Atah, mujhe maaf kar de. Tere siwa koi gunaahon ko maaf nahin kar sakta." Phir hans diye. Kaha gaya ki ai ameerul momeneen, aap kis baat par hanse? To farmayaah mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dekha ki aapne waisa hi kiya, jaisa mainne kiya, phir hans pare. Mainne poochhaah ai Allah ke Rasool, aap kis baat par hanse? To farmayaah "Tumhaare rab ko aashchary hota hai, jab koi banda kahta hai ki mere paapon ko kshama kar de. Woh jaanta hai ki mere siwa koi gunaahon ko maaf nahin kar sakta."
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5272: Apne bachchon ko namaz ka aadesh do, jab unki ayu saat saal ho jaye, aur unhen uske liye maaro, jab unki ayu das saal ho jaye tatha unke bistar alag kar do.

Amr bin shoaib apne pita ke maadhyam se apne daada se warnan karte hain, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Apne bachchon ko namaz ka aadesh do, jab unki ayu saat saal ho jaye, aur unhen uske liye maaro, jab unki ayu das saal ho jaye tatha unke bistar alag kar do."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bayaan farma rahe hain ki pita ki zimmewaari hai ki bachche evn bachchiyaan jab saat saal ke ho jayen, to unko namaz parhne ka aadesh de aur namaz ke zaroori masayal ki shiksha de. Phir jab das saal ke ho jayen, to aadesh dene ke saath-saath namaz mein kotaahi karne par maare aur unka bistar alag kar de.

Bachchon ko wayask hone se pahle hi deeni baaten sikha di jayen, jinka ek mahatvapoorn ang namaz hai.
Maar adab ke liye honi chahiye. Yaatna ke liye nahin. Maarte samay bachche ki stithi ko dhyaan mein rakha jaye.
Islam ne maan-sammaan ki raksha aur use thes pahunchaane ke sabhi raaston ko band karne par poora dhyaan diya hai.
[ise abu daawood ne riwayat kiya hai]
5273: Nishchay hi jhaar-phoonk karna, taaweez gande baandhna aur pati-patni ke beech prem paida karne ke liye jaadooi amal karna shirk hai.

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, unhonne kaha : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Nishchay hi jhaar-phoonk karna, taaweez gande baandhna aur pati-patni ke beech prem paida karne ke liye jaadooi amal karna shirk hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kuchh cheezen bayaan ki hain, jinmen sanlipt hona shirk hain. Unmen se kuchh cheezen is prakaar hain :

1- jhaar-phoonk karna : Yaani shirk par aadhaarit aisi baaten jinko parhkar ajnaanta kaal (jaahiliyat kaal) ke log beemaari se shifa paane ke liye dam kiya karte the.

2- mankon aadi se bane hue taaweez, jinko buri nazar lagne se bachaav ke liye bachchon aur jaanavron ke shareer mein baandha jaata hai.

3- aise jaadooi amal jo pati-patni mein sa kisi ek ko doosre ke nikat priy banaane ke liye kiye jaate hain.

Yeh saari cheezen shirk hain. Kyonki inke dvaara aisi cheezon ko sabab bana diya jaata hai, jinka sabab hona kisi sharai daleel aur kisi bhautik tajurba se pramaanit nahin hai. Jahaan tak sharai saadhan, jaise Qur'an paath karna ya bhautik saadhan, jaise aisi dawayen jinka laabhkaari hona anubhav ya pareekshan se pramaanit hai, to ye is aqeede (aastha) ke saath jayaz hain ki ye kewal saadhan hain tatha laabh evn haani Allah ke haath mein hai.

Tauheed tatha aqeede ko un tamaam cheezon se surakshit rakhna, jo use dooshit karte hain.
Jhaar-phoonk karne ke shirk par aadhaarit saare roop, taaweez-gande aur pati-patni ke beech prem paida kiye jaane waale jaadooi kaary haraam hain.
In teen cheezon ko saadhan samajhna chhota shirk hai, kyonki yeh aisi cheezon ko saadhan maanna hai, jo waastav mein saadhan hain hi nahin. Lekin agar in teen cheezon ko apne aapmen laabhaakri tatha haanikaarak maan liya jaye, to yeh bara shirk hai.
Is hadees mein shirk par aadhaarit tatha haraam saadhnon ko apnaane se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai.
Jhaar-phoonk karna bhi shirk tatha haraam hota hai. Yeh alag baat hai ki iske kuchh jayaz roop bhi hain.
Dil ka sanbandh kewal Allah se hona chahiye. Wahi laabh tatha haani ka maalik hai. Uska koi saajhi nahin hai. Jo bhi achchhi cheez milti hai, usi ke paas se milti hai aur wahi buraai se bachaata hai.
Jhaar-phoonk karne ka jayaz roop woh hai, jismen teen sharten paai jayen : 1- is baat ka wishvaas rakha jaye ki yeh kewal saadhan hai aur Allah ki anumti ke bina laabhkaari nahin hota. 2- jhaar-phoonk Qur'an, Allah ke naamon, gunon, Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki sikhaai hui duaaon aur jayaz duaaon ke dvaara kiya jaye. 3- jo shabd kahe jayen, wo samjhe jaane waale hon. Unmen jaadu-tona na ho.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5274: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) wrishti maangne ke liye namaz parhne ko nikle, to qible ki or munh karke dua ki, apni chaadar palti aur phir do rakaat namaz parhi, jismen oonchi aawaaz mein tilaawat ki.

Abdullah bin zaid bin aasim maazini (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) wrishti maangne ke liye namaz parhne ko nikle, to qible ki or munh karke dua ki, apni chaadar palti aur phir do rakaat namaz parhi, jismen oonchi aawaaz mein tilaawat ki.
Tatha ek riwayat mein hai ki aap 'musalla' (namaazgaah) ki or nikle.

Allah taaala apne bandon ko wibhinn tareeqon se aazmaata hai, taaki we kewal usi ko pukaaren aur use yaad karen. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke zamaane mein jab baarish na hone ke kaaran akaal para, to aap, Allah se baarish maangne ke liye, logon ko aabaadi se baahar awasthit eedgaah ki or le gae. Aabaadi se baahar isliye le gae, taaki apni wiwashta evn laachaari ka izhaar adhik ho sake. Wahaan aapne qible ki or munh kiya, jisse dua qabool hone ki aasha adhik rahti hai, phir Allah se musalmaanon ki fariyaad sunne aur akaal door karne ki dua karne lage.
Phir, yeh shagun lete hue ki ab sukhaar ke baad hariyaali ayegi aur badhaali ke baad khushhaali ayegi, aapne apni chaadar ko palatkar ek or ki chaadar ki doosri or kar diya. Phir, logon ko do rakaat istisqa ki namaz parhaai. Namaz mein qiraat oonchi aawaaz se ki, kyonki use jamaat ke saath parha gaya tha.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5275: Main aur imraan bin husain ne ali bin abu taalib (radiyallahu anhum) ke peechhe namaz parhi. Jab woh sajde mein jaate, to takbeer kahte, jab sar uthaate, to takbeer kahte aur jab doosri rakaat ke baad khare hote, to takbeer kahte.

Mutarrif bin abdullah kahte hain ki main aur imraan bin husain ne ali bin abu taalib (radiyallahu anhum) ke peechhe namaz parhi. Jab woh sajde mein jaate, to takbeer kahte, jab sar uthaate, to takbeer kahte aur jab doosri rakaat ke baad khare hote, to takbeer kahte. Jab unhonne namaz poori kar li, to imraan bin husain ne mere donon haathon ko pakarkar kahaah inhonne mujhe Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki namaz yaad dila di. Ya phir yeh kaha ki inhonne hamen Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki jaisi namaz parhaai.

Is hadees mein namaz ke ek mahatvapoorn chihn yaani "Allahu akbar" Ke maadhyam se uchch evn mahaan Allah ki baraai tatha mahaanta ke izhaar ka warnan hai.
Mutarrif warnan karte hain ki unhonne aur imraan bin husain ne ek baar ali bin abu taalib -radiyallahu anhu- ke peechhe namaz parhi. Woh sajde mein jaate samay takbeer kahte the, sajde se sar uthaate samay takbeer kahte the aur jab do tashahhud waali namaz ke pahle tashahhud se khare hote, tab bhi takbeer kahte the. Aaj, bahut-se logon ne in sthaanon mein zor se tabeer kahna chhor diya hai. Phir, jab namaz khatam hui, to imraan ne mutarrif ka haath pakra aur bataya ki aaj ali -Allah unse prasann ho- ne unhen Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki namaz yaad dila di. Isliye ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- bhi in sthaanon mein takbeer kaha karte the.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5280: Jab tummen se kisi ko jamaahi aye, to apna haath munh par rakhkar use roke. Kyonki shaitaan andar daakhil ho jaata hai.

Abu saeed khudri -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jab tummen se kisi ko jamaahi aye, to apna haath munh par rakhkar use roke. Kyonki shaitaan andar daakhil ho jaata hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne nirdesh diya hai ki yadi koi vyakti aalasy ya pet bhare hone ke kaaran jamhaai le aur apna munh khole, to use apne munh par haath rakhkar use band kar lena chahiye. Aisa isliye ki munh khula chhor dene par shaitaan andar daakhil ho jaata hai aur haath rakh dene ke baad uske liye yeh sanbhav nahin rah jaata.

Jise jamhaai aye, woh jahaan tak ho sake, rokne ka prayaas kare, apne munh ko band rakhe aur khulne na de. Lekin agar band na rakh sake, to munh par apne haath rakh le aur use apne haath se dhaanp le.
Sabhi paristhitiyon mein islaami shishtaachaar ka paalan karna chahiye, kyonki yeh poornata aur naitikta ka prateek hai.
Hamen un sabhi raaston ke baare mein saavdhaan rahna chahiye, jinse shaitaan kisi vyakti mein prawesh kar sakta hai.
5319: Allah kersool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko safed yamni kapron mein kafnaya gaya. Unmen na kurta tha aur na pagri thi.
Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah kersool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko safed yamni kapron mein kafnaya gaya. Unmen na kurta tha aur na pagri thi.

Aaisha -Allah unse prasann ho- yahaan Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke kafan, uske rang tatha kapron ki sankhya ke baare bata rahi hain. Unka kahna hai ki aapko yaman mein bani hui teen safed chaadron mein kafnaya gaya. Aapko na kurta diya gaya, na pagri. Yaad rahe ki mritak ko kafnaane mein adhik kapron ka prayog isliye hota hai, kyonki mritak ka parda jeewit vyakti ke parde se adhik mahatv rakhta hai aur uspar adhik dhyaan diya jaana chahiye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5320: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) juma ke din fajr ki namaz mein "الم تَنْزِيلُ السَّجْدَةَ" Aur هَلْ أتى" على الإنسان" Parhte the.
Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) juma ke din fajr ki namaz mein "الم تَنْزِيلُ السَّجْدَةَ" Aur هَلْ أتى" على الإنسان" Parhte the.

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- juma ke din fajr ki namaz mein pahli rakaat mein sura faatiha ke baad poori soora sajda aur doosri rakaat mein poori soora insaan parha karte the. In donon soorton ko parhne ka uddeshy inke andar bayaan ki gai un mahatvapoorn ghatnaaon ko yaad dilaana hota tha, jo ya to is din ghatit hui hain ya phir ghatit hone waali hain. Jaise aadam -alaihissalaam- ko paida karna, srishtiyon ko dobaara jeewit karke uthaana, saare insaanon ko ekatr karna aur qayaamat ke din ke haalaat aadi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5321: Mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko maghrib ki namaz mein soora-e-toor parhte suna.
Joobair bin mutaim (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko maghrib ki namaz mein soora-e-toor parhte suna.

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- saamaany rup se fajr ki namaz mein tilaawat lanbi karte the aur maghrib ki namaz mein halki, jabki inke siwa any namaazon mein darmiyaani tilaawat karte the.
Lekin kabhi-kabhi yeh bataane ke liye aisa aniwaary nahin hai, is aadat ko chhor bhi dete the. Jaisa ki is hadees mein aya hai ki aapne maghrib ki namaz mein soora "Wat-toor" Parhi, jo tiwaal-e-muphassal ki soorton mein shaamil hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5322: Nabi (sallallahu alaihe wa sallam), abu bakr evn umar (radiyallahu anhuma) donon ki eed ki namaazen khatbe se pahle parhte the.
Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se warnit hai, kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihe wa sallam), abu bakr evn umar (radiyallahu anhuma) donon ki eed ki namaazen khatbe se pahle parhte the.

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- tatha aapke satyanishth khaleekhon ki aadat thi ki logon ko khud eed al-fitr tatha eed al-azha ki namaz parhaate aur khutba dete the tatha namaz khutba se pahle parhte the. Yeh tareeqa chalta raha, yahaan tak ki marvaan ka yug aya, to usne namaz se poorv hi khutba diya. Logon ne sunnat ki mukhaalphat ke kaaran iska wirodh kiya, kintu banu umayya ke daur mein isi par amal hota raha, yahaan tak ki banu abbaas ka daur aya, to unhonne daabaara tareeqe ko riwaaj diya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5323: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) yaatra ke dauraan jab chal rahe hote, to johar aur asr ki namaazon ko ek saath parhte tatha maghrib aur isha ki namaazon ko ek saath parhte.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) yaatra ke dauraan jab chal rahe hote, to johar aur asr ki namaazon ko ek saath parhte tatha maghrib aur isha ki namaazon ko ek saath parhte.
