Hamaare Nabi Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki shareeyat doosri aasmaani shareeyton se is mayne mein bhinn hai ki ismen udaarta evn aasaani ka khayaal rakha gaya hai aur bandon ki har kathinaai ko ya to door kiya gaya hai aur kam karne ka prayaas kiya gaya hai. Iska ek udaahran yeh hai ki shareeyat ne mushtarak samay waali do namaazon ko safar mein ek saath parhne ki anumit di hai.
Asal to yeh hai ki pratyek namaz ko uske samay par hi parha jaye, kintu Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki aadat thi ki jab yaatra mein hote aur lagaataar chal rahe hote, to zohar aur asr ko, zohar athva asr ke samay mein ek saath parhte aur isi prakaar maghrib tatha isha ko magharbi athva isha ke samay mein ek saath parhte the. Aap, aage athva peechhe parhne ke maamle mein apni tatha apne saathiyon ki aasaani ka khayaal rakhte the. Is tarah, yaatra do namaazon ko, unmen se kisi ek namaz ke samay mein, ek saath parhne ka uchit kaaran hai. Kyonki, ek to yeh ki yaatra mein donon namaazon ka samay ek ho jaata hai, saath hi safar kathinaai ka kaaran hua karta hai chaahe aadmi chal raha ho ya ruka hua ho aur do namaazon ko ek saath parhne ki chhoot aasaani paida karne ke liye di gai hai.
5326: Kya tum jaante ho ki gheebat (chughalkhori-pishunta) kya hai?" Sahaaba ne kaha : Allah aur uska Rasool adhik jaante hain. Farmaya : "Tera apne bhaai ki charcha aisi baat se karna, jo use pasand na ho

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Kya tum jaante ho ki gheebat (chughalkhori-pishunta) kya hai?" Sahaaba ne kaha : Allah aur uska Rasool adhik jaante hain. Farmaya : "Tera apne bhaai ki charcha aisi baat se karna, jo use pasand na ho." Sahaaba ne poochha : Aapka kya wichaar hai, yadi woh baat jo main kahta hoon, sach-much mere bhaai mein ho? Farmaya : "Yadi woh baat usmen hai, jo tum kahte ho, to tumne uski chughalkhori ki aur yadi nahin hai, to tumne uspar jhootha aarop lagaya."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam gheebat ki, jo ki haraam hai, paribhaasha bata rahe hain. Gheebat ki paribhaasha hai : Kisi musalmaan ki anupasthiti mein uske baare mein aisi baat kahna, jo use pasand na ho. Chaahe kahi gai baat ka sanbandh uske aachran se ho ya sharaareerik banaawat se. Jaise bhenga, dhokhebaaz aur jhootha aadi aise gun, jinka sanbandh apmaan ya ninda se ho. Chaahe woh wisheshta uske andar maujood hi kyon na ho.

Agar uske andar woh wisheshta maujood na ho, to yeh jhootha aarop hai, jise arbi mein buhtaan (arthaath: Jhootha abhiyog) kahte hain aur jo gheebat se bhi bara gunaah hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke shiksha dene ki uttam paddhati ki aap masayal ko sawaal ke roop mein prastut karte hain.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saamne sahaaba dvaara uttam shishtaachaar ka pradarshan karte hue yeh kahna : Ki Allah tatha uske Rasool adhik jaante hain.
Jisse koi baat poochhi jaye aur woh na jaanta ho, to use Allah behtar jaanta hai, kahna chahiye.
Islaami shareeyat ne adhikaaron ki raksha karke aur logon ke beech bhaaeechaara sthaapit karke ek saaf-suthra samaaj banaane ka kaam kiya hai.
Gheebat haraam hai, albatta kuchh haalton mein kuchh maslahton ko saamne rakhte hue iski anumti di gai hai. Inmen se ek masalhat hai, atyaachaar se bachaav. Udaaharnasvaroop yeh ki peerit vyakti kisi aise vyakti ke saamne atyaachaar karne waale ki charcha kare, jo use uska adhikaar dila sake. Woh kahe ki mujhpar amuk vyakti ne atyaachaar kiya hai ya mere saath amuk vyakti ne aisa vyavhaar kiya hai. Shaadi karne aur saajheedaar tatha parosi banne aadi ke baare mein paraamarsh karna bhi is tarah ki maslahton mein shaamil hai.
5328: Atyaachaar qayaamat ke din andhera hi andhera hoga.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh "Atyaachaar qayaamat ke din andhera hi andhera hoga."
Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh "Atyaachaar se bacho, kyonki atyaachaar qayaamat ke din andhera hi andhera hoga. Tatha kanjoosi se bacho, kyonki iseene tumhaare poorvajon ka winaash kiya hai."

Yeh donon hadeesen atyaachaar ke haraam hone ke pramaanon mein se do pramaan hain. Iske andar atyaachaar ke saare roop samaahit hain, jiska ek roop Allah ka saajhi banaana bhi hai. Donon hadeeson mein aapke shabdon : "Atyaachaar qayaamat ke din ka andhera hai." Ka arth hai, atyaachaar qayaamat ke din atyaachaar karne waale ke liye is prakaar nirantar andhera hoga ki use raasta sujhaai nahin dega.
Jabki doosri hadees mein aapke shabdon : "Laalach (kanjoosi) se bacho, kyonki iseene tumhaare poorvajon ka winaash kiya hai" Dvaara kanjoosi se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai aur yeh bataya gaya hai ki jab samaaj ke andar laalach vyaapak roop se phail jaye, to yeh uske winaash ki nishaani hai. Kyonki isi ke kaaran atyaachaar, sarakshi, dvesh tatha raktapaat ka baazaar garm hota hai.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5329: Ai Allah, mujhe bure vyavhaar, karmon, aakaankshaaon aur beemaariyon se bacha.
Qutba bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) yeh dua karte theh "Ai Allah, mujhe bure vyavhaar, karmon, aakaankshaaon aur beemaariyon se bacha."
5330: Ai Allah! Jo vyakti meri ummat ki koi zimmewaari haath mein le, phir woh unhen kathinaai mein daale, to tu use kathinaai mein daal. Aur jo meri ummat ki koi zimmewaari haath mein le, phir unke saath narmi ka maamla kare, to tu uske saath narmi ka maamla kar.

Aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko apne is ghar mein kahte hue suna hai : "Ai Allah! Jo vyakti meri ummat ki koi zimmewaari haath mein le, phir woh unhen kathinaai mein daale, to tu use kathinaai mein daal. Aur jo meri ummat ki koi zimmewaari haath mein le, phir unke saath narmi ka maamla kare, to tu uske saath narmi ka maamla kar."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne har us vyakti ke liye baddua ki hai, jo musalmaanon ki koi zimmewaari haath mein le, woh zimmewaari chhoti ho ki bari, woh zimmewaari aam ho ya khaas, phir logon ke saath narmi bhara vyavhaar karne ki bajay unko kathinaai mein daale. Is prakaar ke vyakti ke haq mein aapne baddua yeh ki hai ki uske karm ki koti ka pratiphal dete hue Allah use bhi kathinaai mein daale.

Jabki zimmewaari milne ke baad logon ke saath narmi bhara vyavhaar karne waale aur unke saath aasaani karne waale ke haq mein yeh dua ki hai ki Allah uske saath narmi bhara vyavhaar kare aur uske kaam aasaan kar de.

Musalmaanon ki koi zimmewaari haath mein lene waale par jahaan tak ho sake musalmaanon  ke saath narmi bhara vyavhaar karna waajib hai.
Allah bande ko pratiphal usi koti ka deta hai, jis koti ka uska amal hota hai.
Narmi evn sakhti ki kasauti Qur'an evn hadees hai.
5331: Kuchh log Allah ke dhan ko naahaq kharch karte hain. Unheen logon ke liye qayaamat ke din Jahannam hai.

Khaula ansaariya radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Kuchh log Allah ke dhan ko naahaq kharch karte hain. Unheen logon ke liye qayaamat ke din Jahannam hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki kuchh log musalmaanon ke dhan ka ghalat istemaal karte hain aur uspar ghalat tareeqe se qabza jama lete hain. Yeh dhan ke sanbandh mein ek aam baat kahi ja rahi hai, jismen naajayaz tareeqe se use kamaana aur ghalat jaghon mein use kharch karna donon shaamil hai. Iske andar yateemon ka dhan khaana, waqf ke dhan ko harap lena, amaanton ka inkaar karna aur bina kisi adhikaar ke saarvajnik dhan par haath saaf karna aadi bhi daakhil hai.

Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki qayaamat ke din aise logon ka badla Jahannam hai.

Logon ke haathon mein jo dhan hai, woh Allah ka dhan hai. Allah ne logon ko is dhan ka uttaraadhikaari banaya hai, taaki log sahi tareeqe se uska prayog karen aur ghalat prayog se bachen. Iske andar shaasak tatha jan-saadhaaran sabhi log shaamil hain.
Saarvajnik dhan ke baare mein shareeyat ka sakht rawaiya aur is baat ka spasht ullekh ki jise saarvajnik dhan ki zimmedaari mile, use qayaamat ke din dhan wasool karne aur kharch karne ke baare mein hisaab dena hoga.
Is chetaavni ke andar dhan ka ghair-sharai upyog karne waala har vyakti shaamil hai. Dhan chaahe apna ho ya doosre ka.
5332: Bure gumaan se bacho, kyonki bura gumaan sabse jhoothi baat hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Bure gumaan se bacho, kyonki bura gumaan sabse jhoothi baat hai. Kisi ki chhupi hui baaton ko dekhne aur sunne ka prayaas mat karo, kisi ki kamiyon-kotaahiyon ke peechhe na paro, ek-doosre se eershya mat karo, ek-doosre se munh na phero, ek-doosre se keena-kapat na rakho aur Allah ke bando! Bhaai-bhaai bankar raho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam kuchh aisi cheezon se mana kar rahe hain, jo musalmaanon ke beech algaav evn dushmani ka kaaran banti hain. Is tarah ki kuchh cheezen is prakaar hain :

"الظن" (Atkal evn anumaan) yaani dil mein aane waala aisa aarop jiska koi pramaan na ho. Aapne bataya hai ki yeh sabse bari jhoothi baaton mein se ek baat hai.

"التَّحَسُّس" Yaani aankh ya kaan dvaara logon ki chhupi hui baaten talaash karna.

"التَّجَسُّس" Yaani chhupi hui baaten talaash karna. Aksar is shabd ka prayog buraai talaash karne mein hota hai.

"الحسد" Yaani doosre ki nemat ko dekhkar kunthit hona.

"التدابر" Yaani log ek-doosre se milen aur munh pherkar nikal jayen. Na salaam ho na milna ho.

"التباغض" Yaani ek-doosre ko naapsand karna aur ek-doosre se nafrat karna. Maslan doosron ko kasht dena, kisi ko dekhkar munh banaana aur achchhe se na milna.

Ant mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ek aisi saargarbhit baat kahi, jisse musalmaanon ke aapsi sanbandh behtar ho sakte hain. Farmaya : "Allah ke bando! Bhaai-bhaai bankar raho." Daraasal bhaaeechaara ek aisa sanbandh hai, jisse logon ke sannbandh behtar ho sakte hain aur pyaar-mohabbat mein wriddhi ho sakti hai.

Kisi aise vyakti ke baare mein bura gumaan rakhna haanikar nahin hai, jiske andar uski alaamten dikhaai parti hon. Momin ko chetansheel aur saavdhaan rahna chahiye ki dusht evn duraachaari logon se dhokha na khaye.
Yahaan uddeshy us bure gumaan se saavdhaan karna hai, jo dil mein baith jaye aur nikalne ka naam na le. Jahaan tak aise bure gumaan ki baat hai, jo dil mein aye aur thahre bina nikal jaye, to uspar koi gunaah nahin hoga.
Kisi ki buraai ki khoj mein rahna evn eershya aadi woh saari cheezen haraam hain, jo Muslim samaaj ke sadasyon ke beech aapsi nafrat evn sanbandh wichchhed ka kaaran banti hain.
Is baat ka aadesh ki ek musalmaan ke saath bhaai jaisa vyavhaar karte hue uska shubhchintan karna chahiye aur usse prem rakhna chahiye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5333: Musalmaan ko gaali dena fisq (ghor paap) hai, aur usse laraai karna kufr hai.
Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Musalmaan ko gaali dena fisq (ghor paap) hai, aur usse laraai karna kufr hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is baat se mana kiya hai ki koi musalmaan apne kisi musalmaan bhaai ko gaali-galauj kare. Aapne ise 'fisq' yaani Allah aur uske Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke anusran ke dayre se baahar nikalna kaha hai. Aapne yeh bhi bataya hai ki ek musalmaan ka apne kisi musalmaan bhaai se larna 'kufr' ka kaary bataya hai. Lekin yeh chhota kufr hai.

Musalmaan ke khoon aur uske sammaan evn garima ka sammaan karna zaroori hai.
Kisi musalmaan ko naahaq gaali dene ka bhayaanak anjaam ki aapne aisa karne waale ko faasiq kaha hai.
Kisi musalmaan ko gaali dena aur usse larna aise kaary hain, jo eemaan ko kamzor aur kam karte hain.
Kuchh aise bhi kaaryon ko kufr kaha gaya hai, jo Islam se nikaal baahar karne waala kufr-e-akbar nahin hua karte.
Yahaan kufr se muraad chhota kufr hai, jo insaan ko Islam ke dayre se baahar nahin nikaalta. Is baat par ahl-e-sunnat ka mataiky hai. Kyonki khud sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne laraai-jhagre ke samay bhi eemaani bhaaichaara baaqi rahne ki baat kahi hai. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ka farmaan hai : "Aur yadi eemaan waalon ke do giroh lar paren, to unke beech sandhi kara do. Phir donon mein se ek yadi doosre par atyaachaar kare, to usse laro jo atyaachaar kar raha hai, yahaan tak ki woh Allah ke aadesh ki or phir jaye. Phir, yadi woh phir aye, to unke beech nyay ke saath sandhi kara do tatha nyay karo, waastav mein Allah nyay karne waalon se prem karta hai. Sabhi musalmaan bhaai-bhaai hain."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5335: Jis bande ko Allah janta ki rakhvaali ka kaam sonpe aur woh jis din mare to unhen dhokha dete hue mar jaye, to uspar Allah Jannat haraam kar deta hai.

Maaqil bin yasaar muzni radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Jis bande ko Allah janta ki rakhvaali ka kaam sonpe aur woh jis din mare to unhen dhokha dete hue mar jaye, to uspar Allah Jannat haraam kar deta hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki har vyakti ko Allah ne logon ka sanrakshak banaya hai. Sanrakshan chaahe aam ho, jaise shaasak ka sanrakshan ya khaas, jaise ghar mein ek purush ka sanrakshan ya ghar mein ek stri ka sanrakshan. Aise mein jisne apne adheen logon ke haq mein kotaahi ki, dhokha kiya aur unke saansaarik evn dhaarmik adhikaaron ko nasht kar diya, woh is sakht dand ka haqdaar ban gaya.

Yeh chetaavni islaami raajy ke sabse bare shaasak aur uske pratinidhiyon ke liye khaas nahin hai, balki ismen har woh aadmi shaamil hai, jiske adheen Allah ne kuchh log rakhe hon.
Musalmaanon ki koi bhi saarvajnik zimmewaari sanbhaalne waale har vyakti par dayitv hai ki woh unke baare mein bhala soche, amaanat ada karne ki koshis kare aur wishvaasghaat se saavdhaan rahe.
Saarvajnik ya niji, bari ya chhoti koi bhi zimmewaari sanbhaalne waale ke uttardayitv ka mahatv.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5336: ''Ai aboozar! Jab shorba pakaao, to usmen paani zyaada daal do aur parosiyon ka bhi khyaal rakh lo.''

Abu zar -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : ''Ai aboozar! Jab shorba pakaao, to usmen paani zyaada daal do aur parosiyon ka bhi khyaal rakh lo.''

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aboozar ghifaari radiyallahu anhu ko is baat ke liye protsaahit kiya hai ki jab sabzi banayen, to usmen adhik paani daalkar shorba adhik bana len aur apne parosiyon ka haal maaloom karke unko kuchh bhej diya karen.

Parosiyon ke saath achchha vyavhaar karne ki prerna.
Parosiyon ko bhent dena musathab hai. Kyonki isse paraspar prem barhta hai. Bhent dene ka yeh aadesh us samay aur prabal ho jaata hai, jab khaane se khushbu nikle aur parosiyon ko uski jaankaari ho jaye.
Apni haisiyat ke anusaar kam hi sahi, kuchh na kuchh dene aur musalmaanon ko khush hone ka avsar pradaan karne ka mahatv.
5338: Jab tum teen vyakti ek saath raho, to do log alag se kaanaaphoosi na karen, yahaan tak ki tum any logon se ghul-mil jaao.

Abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jab tum teen vyakti ek saath raho, to do log alag se kaanaaphoosi na karen, yahaan tak ki tum any logon se ghul-mil jaao."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5341: Use dekho, jo tumse neeche hai tatha use na dekho, jo tumse oopar hai. Kyonki isse is baat ki sanbhaavna kam ho jaati hai ki tum Allah ki nemton ka anaadar karo.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Use dekho, jo tumse neeche hai tatha use na dekho, jo tumse oopar hai. Kyonki isse is baat ki sanbhaavna kam ho jaati hai ki tum Allah ki nemton ka anaadar karo."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aadesh diya hai ki saansaarik maamlon, jaise pad, dhan tatha yash aadi mein, apne se kamtar logon ki or dekhna chahiye aur shreshth logon ki or dekhne se mana kiya hai. Kyonki in maamlon mein shreshth logon ki or dekhne se sanbhav hai ki vyakti Allah ki nemton ko kam samajhne lage.

Santushti momin ki ek bahut bari wisheshta hai, jo Allah ki likhi taqdeer se mutmain hone ki nishaani hai.
Ibn-e-jareer kahte hain : Is hadees mein kai achchhi baaten kahi gai hain. Kyonki jab koi vyakti saansaarik drishti se apne se shreshth logon ko dekhta rahta hai, to uske man mein aisi nemton ki laalsa utpann ho jaati hai, aur uski aatma Allah ki un nemton ko kam aankne lagti hai jo use praapt hain. Aise mein woh adhik se adhik duniya praapt karna chaahta hai, taaki unke saath ya unke paas khara ho sake. Yahi baat adhiktar logon ke andar paai jaati hai. Lekin jab woh iske wipreet saansaarik drishti se apne se kamtar logon ko dekhta hai, to use apne paas maujood nemton ka mahatv samajh mein aata hai. Atah unka shukr ada karta hai, winamr rahta hai aur unka upyog achchhe kaamon mein karta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5343: Ek musalman ke doosre musalmaan par chhah adhikaar hain." Poochha gaya : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Wo kya hain? Farmaya : "Jab usse milo to salaam karo, jab woh aamantran de to uska aamantran sveekaar karo, jab tumse shubhchintan ki aasha rakhe to uska shubhchintak bano, jab chheenkne ke baad Allah ki prashansa kare to 'yarahmukallah' kaho, jab beemaar ho to uska haal jaanne jaao aur jab mar jaye to uske janaaze mein shaamil ho.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Ek musalman ke doosre musalmaan par chhah adhikaar hain." Poochha gaya : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Wo kya hain? Farmaya : "Jab usse milo to salaam karo, jab woh aamantran de to uska aamantran sveekaar karo, jab tumse shubhchintan ki aasha rakhe to uska shubhchintak bano, jab chheenkne ke baad Allah ki prashansa kare to 'yarahmukallah' kaho, jab beemaar ho to uska haal jaanne jaao aur jab mar jaye to uske janaaze mein shaamil ho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bayaan farmaya hai ki ek musalmaan ke doosre musalmaan par jo adhikaar hain, unmen nimnalikhit chhah cheezen shaamil hain : 1- mulaaqaat hone par assalaamu alaikum kahkar salaam karna. Uttar mein saamne waala vyakti wa alaikumussalaam kahega. 2- waleema aadi daawat mein shaamil hone ka nimantran milne par use grahan karna. 3- salaah maange jaane par uchit salaah dena. Chaaploosi evn dhokha na karna. 4- jab koi chheenke aur al-hamdu lillah kahe, to uske uttar mein yarahmukallah kahna. Iske baad chheenkne waala vyakti yahdeekumullah wa yuslih baalkum kahe. 5- beemaar hone par uska haal jaanne ke liye jaana. 6- mrityu ho jaane par uske janaaze ki namaz parhna aur dafan ka kaary sampoorn ho jaane tak uske janaaze ke saath rahna.

Shaukaani kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke shabd "حق المسلم" Se muraad yeh hai ki in kaaryon ko chhora nahin jaana chahiye aur inka karna ya to waajib hai ya phir waajib se nikat ka musathab, jinhen chhorne ka koi auchity nahin banta.
Salaam jab kisi khaas vyakti ko kiya jaye to jawaab dena zaroori hai aur jab kisi samooh ko salaam kiya jaye to ek vyakti ka jawaab dena kaafi hai. Haalaanki, salaam karna sunnat hai.
Beemaar vyakti ka haal jaanne ke liye jaana musalmaan bhaaiyon ke aniwaary adhikaaron mein se ek hai, kyonki isse beemaar vyakti ko khushi aur aaraam milta hai. Yeh ek farz-e-kifaya hai.
Nimantran grahan karna waajib hai, jab tak wahaan koi gunaah ka kaam na ho raha ho. Nimantran agar waleeme ka ho, to jamhoor ke yahaan use qabool karna waajib hai. Haan, koi sharai majboori ho, to baat alag hai. Nimantran agar waleeme ke atirikt kisi aur ayojan ka ho, to jamhoor ke yahaan use grahan karna musathab hai.
Chheenkne waala jab al-hamdu lillah kahe to sunne waale par yarahmukallah kahna waajib hai.
Islaami shareeyat ek sampoorn shareeyat hai, jisne saamaajik bandhnon ko majboot karne tatha samaaj ke sabhi logon ke beech prem aur sneh ka nirmaan karne ka har sanbhav prayaas kiya hai.
Kuchh sanskarnon mein "فَسَمِّتْهُ" Ke sthaan par "فَشمّتهُ" Hai. Donon ka arth hai : Bhalaai aur barkat ki dua karna. Kuchh log kahte hain ki "تشميت" Ka arth hai : Allah aapko jag-hansaai se door rakhe aur har us cheez se bachaye jo dushman ko hansne ka mauka deti hai. Jabki "تسميت" Ka arth hai : Allah aapko sahi raaste par le jaye.
5344: Aadam ki pratyek santaan ghalti karne waali hai aur ghalti karne waalon mein sabse uttam vyakti woh hai, jo atyadhik tauba karne waala ho.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) se hi riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah "Aadam ki pratyek santaan ghalti karne waali hai aur ghalti karne waalon mein sabse uttam vyakti woh hai, jo atyadhik tauba karne waala ho."

Koi bhi insaan galti se khaali nahin hai. Kyonki uske andar kamzori aur apne prabhu ke aadeshon ka paalan karne aur uski mana ki hui baaton se door rahne ke wishay mein apne prabhu ki avhelna ka jazba praakritik rup se paya jaata hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki pawitr evn mahaan Allah ne apne bandon ke liye tauba ka darvaaza khol rakha hai aur bata diya hai ki sabse achchhe ghalti karne waale log woh hain, jo bahut zyaada tauba karne waale hain.
Aadam ki santaan se ghalti hona aur uske gunaah ka shikaar hona koi bari baat nahin hai. Lekin ek musalmaan par waajib hai ki jaise hi kisi gunaah mein lipt ho, phauran tauba kar le.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5345: Tatha jo kisi imaam ki baiat kare aur use apna haath tatha apne dil ka phal de de, use chahiye ki jahaan tak ho sake, uska anusran kare. Phir agar koi doosra use apne maathat karne ke liye usse jhagra kare, to uski gardan ura do.

Abdullah bin amr (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki ham log Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath ek safar mein the. Hamne ek sthaan mein paraav daala, to koi khema theek kar raha tha, koi teerandaazi ka muqaabla kar raha tha aur koi apne jaanavron ke saath tha. Isi beech Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki taraf se pukaarne waale ne pukaara ki namaz khari hone waali hai. Chunaanche, ham log Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas ekatr hue, to aapne farmayaah "Mujhse poorv jo bhi Nabi aya, uspar aniwaary tha ki apni ummat ko har us khair ki raah dikha de, jise woh unke liye achchha jaanta hai aur har us cheez se daraye, jise woh unke liye bura jaanta hai. Aur tumhaari is ummat ki aafiyat (kushalta) uske aaranbhik bhaag mein rakh di gai hai. Jabki uske antim bhaag mein aazmaaishen aur aisi baaten saamne ayengi, jinhen tum naapsand karoge. Aise fitne saamne ayenge, jo ek-doosre ko halka kar denge. Ek fitna saamne ayega, to momin kahegaah yeh mera winaash ka dega. Lekin woh door ho jayega. Phir doosra fitna ayega, to momin kahegaah yahi sabse bara fitna hai. Atah, jo yeh pasand karta ho ki use Jahannam se door kar diya jaye aur Jannat mein daakhil kar diya jaye, uski maut is awastha mein aye ki woh Allah tatha antim diwas par eemaan rakhta ho. Tatha logon ke saath wahi vyavhaar kare, jo apne saath kiye jaane ko pasand karta ho. Tatha jo kisi imaam ki baiat kare aur use apna haath tatha apne dil ka phal de de, use chahiye ki jahaan tak ho sake, uska anusran kare. Phir agar koi doosra use apne maathat karne ke liye usse jhagra kare, to uski gardan ura do."

Is hadees se maaloom hua ki nabiyon ki tarah aahvaankartaaon par bhi bhalaai ko spasht karna, uski prerna dena, uski or logon ka maargadarshan karna tatha isi tarah buraai ko spasht karna aur usse saavdhaan karna aniwaary hai. Is hadees mein ek any baat yeh bataai gai hai ki is ummat ke aaranbhik kaal ke log aazmaaishon se surakshit rahe, jabki iske antim kaal ke logon ko aisi buraaiyon evn pareekshaaon ka saamna rahega ki baad mein aane waale fitnon ke saamne pahle aane waale fitne baune dikhaai denge. Aage bataya gaya hai ki in fitnon se mukti ekeshvarvaad, sunnat ke anusran, logon ke saath achchhe vyavhaar, shaaskon se ki gai baiat ki paabandi, uske wiruddh baghaawat se gurez tatha musalmaanon ki ekta ko bhang karne waalon se yuddh ke dvaara mil sakti hai.
5346: Bhalaai ka pratyek kaary sadqa hai.
Jaabir bin abdullah radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Bhalaai ka pratyek kaary sadqa hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki har prakaar ka upkaar tatha doosron ko laabhaanvit karne ka prayaas, chaahe kathan ke roop mein ho ya kaary ke roop mein, sadqa hai aur uska pratiphal milega.

Sadqa kewal dhan ka ek bhaag nikaalne ka hi naam nahin hai, balki uske andar apne kathan tatha kaary dvaara doosre ka kiya jaane waala har bhala kaam shaamil hai.
Is hadees mein doosron ka bhala karne aur laabh pahunchaane ki prerna di gai hai.
Kisi bhi achchhe kaam ko hey drishti se nahin dekhna chahiye, chaahe woh thora hi kyon na ho.
[ise Bukhari ne jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) se aur Muslim ne huzaifa (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat kiya hai]
5347: Yahoodiyon tatha isaaiyon ko pahle salaam na karo aur jab raaste mein unse bhent ho jaye, to unhen tang raasta akhtiyaar karne par wiwash kar do.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Yahoodiyon tatha isaaiyon ko pahle salaam na karo aur jab raaste mein unse bhent ho jaye, to unhen tang raasta akhtiyaar karne par wiwash kar do."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam yahoodiyon tatha eesaaiyon ko salaam karne mein pahle karne se mana kar rahe hain, chaahe we zimmi hi kyon na hon, any kaafiron ko to rahne deejiye. Aapne aage bataya ki jab unmen se kisi se hamaari bhent raaste mein ho jaye, to ham use raaste ke tang bhaag ki or jaane par majboor kar den. Kyonki beech raaste se momin hi chalega aur kaafir kinaare-kinaare chalega. Momin kisi bhi haal mein beizzat nahin ho sakta.

Kisi musalmaan ke liye kisi yahoodi evn eesaai aadi kaafir ko salaam karne mein pahal karna jayaz nahin hai.
Yadi we salaam kar den, to unhen "Wa alaikum" Kahkar jawaab dena jayaz hai.
Kisi musalmaan ke liye kisi gair-Muslim ko bina kaaran jaan-boojhkar kasht dena aur use tang raaste ki or dhakelna jayaz nahin hai. Lekin agar raasta tang ya bheerbhaar waala ho to musalmaan ko uspar chalne ka adhik adhikaar hai. Aisi sthiti mein kaafir use chhorkar kinaare ho jayega.
Musalmaanon ki pratishtha ka izhaar aur doosron ki tuchchhata ko darshaana. Lekin, atyaachaar evn ashisht bhaasha ki kaheen koi gunjaaish nahin hai.
Awishvaasiyon par Allah ke prati unke awishvaas ke kaaran kuchh pratibandh lagaana ho sakta hai ki unke Islam grahan karne ka sabab ban jaye aur is tarah unko Jahannam se mukti mil jaye. Yadi yeh vyavhaar unhen kaaran jaanne ka utsukabna de.
Zaroorat parne ek musalmaan kisi awishvaasi se, pahal karte hue, aap kaise hain, aapne subah kaise ki tatha aapne shaam kaise ki, aadi kah sakta hai. Kyonki mana kewal salaam karne se kiya gaya hai.
Teebi kahte hain : Kisi bidaati ko salaam nahin kiya jayega yahi behtar ray hai. Agar kisi anjaan vyakti ko salaam karne ke baad pata chal jaye ki woh bidaati ya zimmi hai, to  usko tuchchh darshaane ke liye kahe ga: Mainne apna salaam waapas le liya.
5348: Kisi bhi neki ke kaam ko kadaapi kamtar na jaano, chaahe itna hi kyon na ho ki tum apne bhaai se muskuraate hue milo.

Aboozar radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Kisi bhi neki ke kaam ko kadaapi kamtar na jaano, chaahe itna hi kyon na ho ki tum apne bhaai se muskuraate hue milo."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne neki ke kaam ke prati utsaah jagaane ke saath-saath is baat ki prerna di hai ki neki ke kisi chhot-se chhote kaam ko bhi hey drishti se na dekha jaye. Iska ek udaahran yeh hai ki milte samay muskura kar mila jaye. Atah har musalmaan ko ispar dhyaan dena chahiye, kyonki isse prem-bhaav paida hota hai.

Musalmaanon ke beech paraspar prem aur milte samay muskura kar milne ki fazeelat.
Islaami shareeyat ek sanpoorn tatha vyaapak shareeyat hai. Iske andar har woh baat maujood hai, jo musalmaanon aur unki ekjutta ke liye uttam hai.
Neki ka kaam karne ki prerna, chaahe kaam chhota hi kyon na ho.
Musalmaanon ke dil mein khushi daalna musathab (waanchhit) hai. Kyonki isse aapsi prem ka maahaul banta hai.
5349: Tummen se koi hargi़z khare hokar na piye.
Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Tummen se koi hargi़z khare hokar na piye."
5350: Koi aadmi doosre aadmi ko uske sthaan se uthaakar na baithe. Balki (apne bhaai ke liye) jagah banaao aur gunjaaish paida karo.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Koi aadmi doosre aadmi ko uske sthaan se uthaakar na baithe. Balki (apne bhaai ke liye) jagah banaao aur gunjaaish paida karo."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5351: Balvaan woh nahin hai, jo kisi ko pachhaar de, balvaan to woh hai, jo krodh ke samay apne aap ko niyantran mein rakhe.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Balvaan woh nahin hai, jo kisi ko pachhaar de, balvaan to woh hai, jo krodh ke samay apne aap ko niyantran mein rakhe."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki waastawik shakti shaareerik shakti nahin hai, aur na hi doosre ko kushti mein pachhaar dene waala asal bahaadur hai. Asal bahaadur woh hai, jo krodh ke samay apne nafs (antraatma) se lare aur usko pachhaar de. Kyonki yeh apni antraatma par mazboot niyantran aur shaitaan par haawi hone ka pramaan hai.

Krodh ke samay sanymit rahne aur apni antraatma par niyantran rakhne ki fazeelat tatha iska un achchhe kaaryon mein se ek hona, jinki Islam ne prerna di hai.
Krodh ke samay apni antraatma se larna dushman se larne se zyaada bara kaam hai.
Islam ne shakti ke prati ajnaanta kaal (jaahileeyat kaal) ki dhaarna ko badalkar ek aadarsh dhaarna pradaan kiya hai. Islam ki nazar mein sabse shaktishaali vyakti woh hai, jo apne oopar niyantran rakhta ho.
Krodh se door rahna, kyonki yeh vyakti tatha samaaj donon ke liye  ek haanikaarak wastu hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5352: Chhota bare ko, guzarne waala baithe hue ko aur chhota samooh bare samooh ko salaam kare.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh "Chhote bare ko, guzarne waala baithe hue ko aur chhota samooh bare samooh ko salaam kare."
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih "Tatha sawaar paidal chalne waale ko salaam kare."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5353: Jo kisi samuday se anuroopta grahan kare, woh usi mein se hai.
Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jo kisi samuday se anuroopta grahan kare, woh usi mein se hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jo kisi awishvaasi, awajnaakaari athva satkarmi samuday ki samroopta dhaaran karega, yaani aqayad (aasthaaon), ibaadton ya reeti-riwaajon se sanbandhit unki kisi wishishtata ko apnayega, uski ginti usi mein hogi. Kyonki pratyaksh samroopta aantrik samroopta ka kaaran banti hai. Ismen koi sandeh nahin hai ki kisi samuday ki samroopta dhaaran karna us samuday ke maansik prabhaav ka nateeja hua karta hai aur yeh cheez unse prem, unke sammaan aur unki or jhukaav ka kaaran bhi ban sakti hai. Chunaanche iske nateeje mein kabhi-kabhi aantrik aur ibaadat tak mein unki samroopta tak baat bahunch jaati hai.

Is hadees mein awishvaasiyon tatha awajnaakaariyon se anuroopta grahan karne se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai.
Nek logon ki anuroopta grahan karne aur unka anusran karne ki prerna.
Zaahiri (pratyaksh) anuroopta aantrik prem ka kaaran banti hai.
Insaan samroopta tatha uske prakaar ke anusaar is chetaavni ka haqdaar banega.
Wishisht aadton tatha dharm ke maamle mein awishvaasiyon ki samroopta dhaaran karne ki manaahi. Any cheezon jaise hunar seekhne aadi mein unki samroopta dhaaran karna is chetaavni ke dayre mein nahin aata.
[is hadees ko abu daawood aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5354: Jisne kisi achchhe kaam ka maarg dikhaya, use uske karne waale ke baraabar pratiphal milega

Abu masood ansaari radiyallahu anhu ka warnan, unhonne kaha : Ek vyakti Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya aur kahne laga : Meri sawaari halaak ho chuki hai, atah mujhe sawaari ke liye ek jaanvar deejiye. Chunaanche Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Mere paas jaanvar nahin hai." Yeh sun ek vyakti ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Main ise ek vyakti ke baare mein bata sakta hoon, jo ise sawaari ke liye jaanvar de sakta hai. Ispar Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne kisi achchhe kaam ka maarg dikhaya, use uske karne waale ke baraabar pratiphal milega."

Ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya aur kahne laga ki uski sawaari halaak ho gai hai, isliye aap use sawaari ke liye jaanvar den, jispar sawaar hokar woh apni yaatra poori kar sake. Chunaanche Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kah diya ki use dene ke liye aapke paas koi sawaari nahin hai. Yeh sun wahaan upasthit ek vyakti ne kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Main use ek vyakti ke baare mein bata sakta hoon, jo use sawaari ke liye jaanvar de sakta hai. Ispar Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki is vyakti ko bhi sawaari dene waale ke baraabar pratiphal milega. Kyonki isne ek zarooratmand vyakti ka uchit maargadarshan kiya hai.

Achchhe kaam ke maargadarshan ki prerna.
Neki ke kaamon ke liye prerit karna ek aisa saadhan hai jo Muslim samaaj ko ek sashakt evn sanpoorn samaaj banaata hai.
Allah ka wishaal anugrah.
Yeh hadees ek vyaapak siddhaant ki haisiyat rakhti hai aur iske andar saare neki ke kaam daakhil honge.
Insaan jab maangne waale ki zaroorat poori na kar sake, to uska uchit maargadarshan kar de.
5355: Jab log samooh mein ja rahe hon, to yeh kaafi hai ki unki or se unmen se ek aadmi salaam kare tatha yeh bhi kaafi hai ki samooh ki or se ek vyakti salaam ka uttar de.

Ali bin abu taalib (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh "Jab log samooh mein ja rahe hon, to yeh kaafi hai ki unki or se unmen se ek aadmi salaam kare tatha yeh bhi kaafi hai ki samooh ki or se ek vyakti salaam ka uttar de."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5357: Jab tummen se koi joota pahne, to dayen paanv se shuru kare aur jab joota utaare, to bayen paanv se shuru kare. Dayen paanv mein pahle joota pahna jaye aur baad mein utaara jaye.

Ali bin abu taalib (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh "Jab tummen se koi joota pahne, to dayen paanv se shuru kare aur jab joota utaare, to bayen paanv se shuru kare. Dayen paanv mein pahle joota pahna jaye aur baad mein utaara jaye."

Joota pahanne ka musathab tareeqa yeh hai ki pahle dayen paanv mein pahna jaye aur joota utaarne ka musathab tareeqa yeh hai ki pahle bayen paanv ka joota utaara jaye. Kyonki ismen dayen paanv ke sammaan ka paksh nihit hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5359: Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochha ki sabse bara gunaah kya hai? To farmaya : "Yeh hai ki tum Allah ka saajhi banaao, haalaanki usi ne tum ko paida kiya hai

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochha ki sabse bara gunaah kya hai? To farmaya : "Yeh hai ki tum Allah ka saajhi banaao, haalaanki usi ne tum ko paida kiya hai." Mainne kaha : Nissandeh yeh ek bahut bara gunaah hai. Mainne kaha : Phir kaun-sa? Farmaya : "Phir yeh ki tum apni santaan ko is bhay se maar daalo ki woh tumhaare saath khayegi." Mainne kaha : Phir kaun-sa? To farmaya : "Phir yeh ki tum apne parosi ki patni se dushkarm karo."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochha gaya ki sabse bara gunaah kya hai? To aapne kaha : Sabse bara gunaah sabse bara shirk hai. Shirk naam hai kisi ko poojy evn rab maanne ya naamon evn gunon mein Allah ke samaan ya samkaksh banaane ka. Is gunaah ko Allah tauba ke bina maaf nahin karega. Agar koi vyakti shirk mein sanlipt hokar mar gaya to hamesha Jahannam mein rahega. Uske baad doosra bara gunaah hai apni santaan ka is bhay se qatl karna ki woh saath mein khayegi. Waise to kisi ki awaidh hatya bahut bara paap hai. Lekin paap us samay aur bara ho jaata hai, jab marne waale ka maarne waale se rishta ho. Phir, yeh gunaah us samay aur bhi wishaal ho jaata hai, jab hatya is bhay se ki jaye ki yadi woh jeewit raha, to hatyaara ke saath Allah ki di hui rozi khayega. Is hadees mein bataya gaya teesra bara gunaah yeh hai ki aadmi apne parosi ki patni ko bahla-phuslaakar raazi kar le aur uske saath dushkarm kare. Waise to vyabhichaar haraam hai, lekin iska gunaah us samay aur barh jaata hai, jab vyabhichaar parosi jiske saath achchha vyavhaar karne ka aadesh diya gaya hai uski patni ke saath kiya jaye.

Gunaah bhi chhote-bare hote hain, jaise ki neki ke kaamon mein bhinnata paai jaati hai.
Sabse bara gunaah Allah ka saajhi banaana, phir saath mein khaane ke bhay se santaan ki hatya karna aur phir parosi ki patni ke saath vyabhichaar karna hai.
Rozi Allah ke haath mein hai aur usne saari srishtiyon ko rozi dene ka kaam apne zimme le rakha hai.
Parosi ke adhikaar ka mahatv aur is baat ka bayaan ki parosi ko kasht dena any vyakti ko kasht dene se adhik bara gunaah hai.
Kewal srishtikarta hi ibaadat ka haqdaar hai aur ismen uska koi saajhi nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5361: Alallah ki prasannata maata-pita ki prasannata mein hai aur Allah ki aprasannata maata-pita ki aprasannata mein hai.

Abdullah bin amr (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Alallah ki prasannata maata-pita ki prasannata mein hai aur Allah ki aprasannata maata-pita ki aprasannata mein hai."
[hasan li-ghairihi (any sandon athva riwayton ke saath milkar hasan)]
5363: Khaao, piyo aur daan karo. Haan, magar ghamand aur fizoolkharchi ko raah na do.
Abdullah bin amr bin aas (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh "Khaao, piyo aur daan karo. Haan, magar ghamand aur fizoolkharchi ko raah na do."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise Bukhari ne taaleeqan yaqeen ke seghe ke saath riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5364: Mare hue logon ko bura-bhala na kaho, kyonki we uski or ja chuke hain, jo karm unhonne aage bheje hain.

Aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Mare hue logon ko bura-bhala na kaho, kyonki we uski or ja chuke hain, jo karm unhonne aage bheje hain."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki mare hue logon ko gaali dena aur unke maan-sammaan ke saath khelna haraam hai aur yeh ashishtata evn asabhyata hai. Kyonki woh apne aage bheje hue achchhe ya bure karmon tak pahunch chuke hain. Doosri baat yeh hai ki yeh gaali unko to pahunchne se rahi. Isse kewal jeewit logon ko kasht hoga.

Yeh hadees mare hue logon ko gaali dene ke haraam hone ki daleel hai.
Mare hue logon ko gaali dene se bachna jeewit logon ko kasht se bachaane aur samaaj ko aapsi dushmani evn dvesh se surakshit rakhne ke liye karna chahiye.
Mare hue logon ko gaali dene ki manaahi ki hikmat yeh hai ki mare hue log to apne aage bheje hue karmon tak pahunch chuke hain aur unko gaali dene ka koi fayda nahin hota, jabki isse unke jeewit rishtedaaron ko kasht hota hai.
Insaan ko aisi koi baat nahin karni chahiye, jo bhalaai ya hit se khaali ho.
5365: Kisi musalmaan ke liye halaal nahin hai ki apne bhaai se teen din se adhik baat-cheet band rakhe, is prakaar ki donon milen, lekin yeh bhi munh pher le aur woh bhi munh pher le. Un donon mein uttam woh hai, jo pahle salaam kare.

Abu aiyoob ansaari radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Kisi musalmaan ke liye halaal nahin hai ki apne bhaai se teen din se adhik baat-cheet band rakhe, is prakaar ki donon milen, lekin yeh bhi munh pher le aur woh bhi munh pher le. Un donon mein uttam woh hai, jo pahle salaam kare."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is baat se mana kiya hai ki koi musalmaan apne bhaai se teen din se adhik samay tak baatcheet band rakhe. Sthiti yeh ho ki donon ek-doosre mein milen to, lekin salaam-kalaam kuchh na ho.

In donon logon mein uttam vyakti woh hai, jo baat-cheet bandi ke is nirantarta ko tore aur aage barhkar salaam kare. Maaloom rahe ki yahaan baat-cheet band rakhne se muraad niji hiton ke kaaran baatcheet band rakhna hai. Rahi baat Allah ke haq ke liye baatcheet band rakhne ki, jaise awajnaakaariyon, bidaatiyon aur bure logon se baatcheet band rakhne ki, to yeh kisi samay seema ke saath bandhi hui nahin hai. Yeh daraasal baatcheet band rakhne ki masalhat se sanbandhit hai.

Maanav svabhaav ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue teen din ya usse kam samay tak baatcheet band rakhna jayaz hai.
Salaam karne ka mahatv, yeh dilon ke dvesh ko mitaane ka ek saadhan hai aur prem ki nishaani hai.
Islam apne maanne waalon ke beech bhaaeechaara aur prem ko parvaan charhaane ke prati tatpar hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5367: Jannat mein woh vyakti prawesh nahin karega, jo rishte-naaton ko kaatta ho.
Jubair bin mutaim radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki unhonne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna : "Jannat mein woh vyakti prawesh nahin karega, jo rishte-naaton ko kaatta ho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jisne apne rishtedaaron ko unke waajib adhikaaron se wanchit rakha, unko kasht diya ya unke saath bura vyavhaar kiya, woh is baat ka haqdaar hai ki Jannat mein prawesh na kare.

Rishtedaaron se sanbandh torna kabeera gunaah hai.
Rishte-naaton ko nibhaane ka kaam aam prachlan ke anusaar kiya jayega. Ismen sthaanon, samyon aur vyaktiyon ke anusaar bhinnata paai jaati hai.
Rishte-naaton ko nibhaane ka kaam rishtedaaron ka haal jaanne ke liye jaana, unko sadqa dena, unke saath achchha vyavhaar karna, we beemaar ho jayen to haal jaanne ke liye jaana, unko bhalaai ka aadesh dena tatha buraai se rokna aadi se hota hai.
Rishta jitne qareebi rishtedaar ka tora jayega, gunaah utna zyaada hoga.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5368: Jannat mein lagaai-bujhaai karne waala vyakti prawesh nahin karega.
Huzaifa radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Mainne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Jannat mein lagaai-bujhaai karne waala vyakti prawesh nahin karega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki lagaai-bujhaai karne waala, jo logon ke rishte kharaab karne ke iraade se yahaan ki baat wahaan pahunchaata rahta ho, is saza ka haqdaar ban jaata hai ki woh Jannat mein prawesh na kare.

Lagaai-bujhaai karna kabeera gunaah hai.
Lagaai-bujhaai karne ki manaahi, kyonki isse rishte kharaab hote hain tatha ye vyaktiyon tatha samoohon ke liyehaanikaarak hota hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5369: Tummen se koi ek joota pahankar na chale. Ya to donon pahankar chale ya donon utaar de.
Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah "Tummen se koi ek joota pahankar na chale. Ya to donon pahankar chale ya donon utaar de."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek joota pahankar chalne se mana kiya hai. Insaan ya to donon joota pahankar chale ya phir donon ko utaarkar paidal chale. Yeh shishtaachaar is baat ka pramaan hai ki islaami shareeyat ne chhoti-chhoti baaton ka bhi khayaal rakha hai, aur usne jeewan ke sabhi bhaagon par prakaash daala hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5370: Allah us vyakti ki or nahin dekhega, jo abhimaan ke kaaran apna kapra latkaakar chalta ho.

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Allah us vyakti ki or nahin dekhega, jo abhimaan ke kaaran apna kapra latkaakar chalta ho."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne abhimaan ke taur par kapre ya lungi ko takhnon ke neeche latkaye rakhne se saavdhaan kiya hai aur bataya hai ki aisa karne waala bhayaanak chetaavni ka haqdaar hai ki Allah qayaamat ke din uspar daya ki nazar nahin daalega.

Hadees mein ullikhit shabd "الثوب" (Wastr) mein payjaama aur lungi jaise sabhi kapre shaamil hain, jo shareer ke nichle hisse ko dhakte hain.
Takhnon se neeche kapre latkaane ki manaahi sirf purushon ke liye hai. Navvi kahte hain : Mahilaaon ke liye kapre latkaane ki anumti par widvaanon mein aam sahamti hai. Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki ek praamaanik hadees mein unhen ek haath ke baraabar kapre latkaane ki anumti di gai hai.
Ibn-e-baaz kahte hain : "Aam hadeeson ke aadhaar par purushon ke liye takhnon se neeche latakte hue kapre pahanna warjit aur haraam hai. Lekin iski saza zaroori nahin ki ek jaisi hi ho. Yeh alag-alag ho sakti hai. Kyonki jo ghamand se latkaata hai, woh aur jo ghamand ke bina latkaata hai, woh ek jaise nahin ho sakte."
Ibn-e-baaz kahte hain : Mahila ke poore shareer ko chhupaana zaroori hai. Atah uske liye ek bitta latkaane mein koi harj nahin hai. Agar kaafi na ho, to takhnon ke neeche ek haath latka legi.
Qaazi kahte hain : Ulema ne kaha hai : Zaroorat evn aadat ke adhik lamba-chaura har wastr naapsandeeda hai.
Navvi kahte hain : Waise to kameez evn lungi ke kinaare ko aadhi pindli tak rakhna musathab hai. Lekin, pindli evn takhnon ke beech kaheen bhi rakhne mein koi harj nahin hai. Agar usse neeche rakha jaata hai, to shareer ka woh bhaag aag mein daakhil hoga. Is tarah aadhi pindli par rakhna musathab, usse neeche takhnon tak rakhna bina karaahat ke jayaz aur takhnon ke neeche utaarna mana hai.
Ibn-e-usaimeen kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke shabd "Allah uski or nahin dekhega" Ka arth hai : Allah uski or daya evn anugrah ki nazar se nahin dekhega. Yahaan muraad aam dekhna nahin hai. Kyonki Allah ki nazar se koi cheez chhupi aur ojhal nahin rahti. Matlab bas itna hai ki Allah daya evn anugrah ki nazar se nahin dekhta.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5371: Koi bhi wastu taraazu mein achchhe aachran se zyaada bhaari nahin hogi aur Allah aise vyakti se nafrat karta hai, jo badzubaan aur anargal bakne waala ho.

Abu darda radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Koi bhi wastu taraazu mein achchhe aachran se zyaada bhaari nahin hogi aur Allah aise vyakti se nafrat karta hai, jo badzubaan aur anargal bakne waala ho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki qayaamat ke din momin ke palre mein uske kathnon evn karmon mein sabse zyaada wazni wastu hogi, achchha aachran. Achchhe aachran ka arth hai, hanskar milna,  takleeph dene se bachna aur bhala karna. Allah bura kaam karne waale, buri baat kahne waale aur bad-zabaani karne waale insaan se nafrat karta hai.
Achchhe aachran ka mahatv, kyonki achchhe aachran se Allah evn uske bandon ka prem praapt hot hai. Saath hi achchha aachran qayaamat ke din wazan ki jaane waali sabse bhaari cheez hogi.
[is hadees ko abu daawood aur tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai]
5372: Jo chaahta ho ki uski rozi phaila di jaye aur uski ayu barha di jaye, woh apne rishtedaaron ke saath achchha vyavhaar kare.

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jo chaahta ho ki uski rozi phaila di jaye aur uski ayu barha di jaye, woh apne rishtedaaron ke saath achchha vyavhaar kare."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam rishton ko jore rakhne ki prerna de rahe hain. Maslan yeh ki unka haal jaanne ke liye jaya jaye aur unki shaareerik evn aarthit sahayta ki jaye. Isse rozi phaila di jaati hai aur ayu lanbi ho jaati hai.

Arbi shabd "الرَّحِم" Se muraad pita aur maata donon paksh ke rishtedaar hain. Rishta jitna nikat ka hoga, woh achchhe vyavhaar ka utna hi haqdaar hoga.
Insaan ko pratiphal usi koti ka diya jaata hai, jis koti ka uska amal hota hai. Atah jo bhalaai tatha upkaar dvaara rishte-naate ko jorne ka kaam karta hai, Allah uski ayu aur rozi mein barkat de deta hai.
Rishte-naaton ko nibhaana rozi mein wriddhi aur lanbi ayu ka saadhan hai. Yadyapi wais to rozi aur ayu donon nirdhaarit hain, lekin kabhi-kabhi inmen barkat ho jaati hai aur insaan apne jeewan mein usse kaheen zyaada aur laabhkaari kaam kar jaata hai, jitna kaam utni hi ayu paane waale doosre log kar paarte hain. Jabki kuchh logon ka kahna hai ki rozi aur ayu mein wriddhi waastawik hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5373: "Bare paapon mein se ek yeh hai ki aadmi apne maata-pita ko gaali de." Kaha gaya ki kya aadmi apne maata-pita ko gaali de sakta hai? To farmayaah "Haan, aadmi kisi ke baap ko gaali de, to woh uske baap ko gaali de aur aadmi kisi ki maan ko gaali de, to woh uski maan ko gaali de."

Abdullah bin amr bin aas (radiyallahu anhuma) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Bare paapon mein se ek yeh hai ki aadmi apne maata-pita ko gaali de." Kaha gaya ki kya aadmi apne maata-pita ko gaali de sakta hai? To farmayaah "Haan, aadmi kisi ke baap ko gaali de, to woh uske baap ko gaali de aur aadmi kisi ki maan ko gaali de, to woh uski maan ko gaali de."

Yeh hadees maata-pita ke adhikaar ke mahatv ka pramaan hai. Isi tarah unke kasht evn unhen bhala-bura kahne ka kaaran banna maha paap hai. Phir jab unhen gaali dilvaane tatha unki laanat ka kaaran banna maha paap hai, to unhen pratyaksh roop se laanat karna adhik ghrinit hai.
Jab aapne yeh bataya ki unhen bura-bhala kahna maha paap hai, to upasthit logon ne ispar aashchary vyakt kiya. Kyonki unhen yeh samajh mein nahin a raha tha ki koi pratyaksh roop se apne maata-pita ko kaise gaali de sakta hai? To aapne spasht kiya ki aisa maata-pita ko gaali dene ka kaaran banne ke dvaara hoga ki jab koi kisi ke pita athva maata ko gaali dega, to woh uske pita athva maata ko gaali dega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5374: Jo logon ki baat kaan lagaakar sune, jabki unhen yeh pasand na ho, to qayaamat ke din uske kaanon mein seesa pighlaakar daala jayega.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jo logon ki baat kaan lagaakar sune, jabki unhen yeh pasand na ho, to qayaamat ke din uske kaanon mein seesa pighlaakar daala jayega."

Is hadees mein us vyakti ko bari kathor chetaavni di gai hai, jo logon ki baat chupke se sune aur we is baat ko pasand na karte hon ki unki baat suni jaye. Daraasal yeh insaan ke andar paya jaane waala ek bura aachran hai, jo ki maha paap hai. Phir, qayaamat ke din insaan ko usi prakaar ka badla milega, jis prakaar ka uska karm raha ho. Yahi kaaran hai ki uske kaanon mein seesa pighlaakar daala jayega. Phir is baat se koi farq nahin parta ki sunne waala sahi uddeshy se sune ya bina kisi uddeshy ke. Kyonki kuchh logon ko yeh baat pasand nahin hoti ki unki baat koi sune. Yadyapi unki baat mein koi dosh, kharaabi ya kisi ke prati koi badzubaani na ho.
[ise bukhaari ne inheen jaise shabdon ke saath riwayat kiya hai .]
5375: Jo kisi ko haani pahunchayega, Allah usko haani pahunchayega aur jo kisi ko kathinaai mein daalega, Allah use kathinaai mein daalega.

Abu sirma radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jo kisi ko haani pahunchayega, Allah usko haani pahunchayega aur jo kisi ko kathinaai mein daalega, Allah use kathinaai mein daalega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kisi musalmaan ko haani pahunchaane aur use kisi bhi tarah ki kathinaai mein daalne se mana kiya hai. Haani tatha kathinaai ka sanbandh uski jaan se ho, dhan se ho ya pariwaar se. Aapne bataya hai ki aisa karne waale ko Allah usi koti ka pratiphal dega, jis koti ka uska karm hai.

Musalmaan ko haani pahunchaana aur use kathinaai mein daalna haraam hai.
Allah apne bandon ke liye pratishodh leta hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5377: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam hamaare paas aye, to hamne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, ham yeh to jaan gae hain ki ham aap par salaam kaise bhejen, lekin ham aap par darood kaise bhejen?

Abdur rahmaan bin abu laila kahte hain ki kaab bin ujra mujhse mile aur kahne lage : Kya main tumhen koi tohfa na doon? Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam hamaare paas aye, to hamne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, ham yeh to jaan gae hain ki ham aap par salaam kaise bhejen, lekin ham aap par darood kaise bhejen? To aapne farmaya : "Kaho : «اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ» (ai Allah! Muhammad aur Muhammad ke pariwaar-parijan par rahmat naazil pharma, jaise toone ibraaheem ke pariwaar-parijan par rahmat naazil ki thi. Beshak tu prashansa ke yogy aur mahimaawaan hai. Ai Allah! Muhammad aur Muhammad ke pariwaar-parijan par barkat naazil pharma, jaise toone ibraaheem ke pariwaar-parijan par barkat naazil ki thi. Beshak tu prashansa ke yogy aur mahimaawaan hai.)

Sahaaba radiyallahu anhum ko jab pata ho gaya ki "At-tahiyyaat" Mein "السلام عليك أيها النبي ورحمة الله وبركاته..." Kahkar Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par salaam bheja jayega, to aapse poochha ki aap par darood kaise bheja jaye? Jawaab mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unko aap par darood bhejne ke shabd bata diye, jo is prakaar hain : "اللهم صلِّ على محمدٍ وعلى آل محمد" (Allahumma salli ala muhammadin wa ala aali Muhammad) yaani ai Allah! Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam, aapke deen ka paalan karne waalon aur aapke eemaan waale rishtedaaron ki prashansa nikatvarteey farishton ke saamne farma. "كما صلَّيتَ على آل إبراهيم" (Kama sallaita ala aali ibraaheem) jis prakaar tu ne ibraaheem alaihissalaam ki aal ko sammaan diya hai, usi prakaar Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko bhi yeh sammaan pradaan kar. Ibraaheem ki aal se taatpary; khud ibraaheem, tatha  ismaaeel, ishaaq, unki santaan-santti aur unke momin anusrankaari hain. "إنك حميد مجيد" (Innaka hameedun majeed) yaani to apni hasti, gunon evn kaaryon mein prashansit tatha bara mahaan, adhikaar waala aur daansheel hai. "اللهم بارك على محمدٍ وعلى آل محمد كما باركتَ على آل إبراهيم" (Allahumma baarik ala muhammadin wa ala aali Muhammad, kama baarakta ala aali ibraaheem) yaani aapko bari bhalaai evn sammaan pradaan kar, use barhaata ja aur nirantar roop se jaari rakh.

Salaf ek-doosre ko ilmi masayal ka bhent diya karte the.
Namaz ke antim tashahhud mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par darood bhejna waajib (aniwaary) hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne sahaaba ko aappar darood evn salaam bhejne ki shiksha di hai.
Darood ke ye shabdaavli Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par darood bhejne ke sabse sanpoorn shabdaavli hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5378: Jisne soora-e-faatiha nahin parhi, uski namaz hi nahin.
Ubaada bin saamit radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne soora-e-faatiha nahin parhi, uski namaz hi nahin."
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki soora faatiha parhe bina namaz sahi nahin hoti. Har rakaat mein soora faatiha parhna namaz ka ek stanbh hai.

Soora faatiha parhne ki shakti ho, to koi doosri cheez uska sthaan nahin le sakti.
Jaan-boojh kar, ajnaanta ke kaaran ya bhoolvash kisi rakaat mein soora faatiha na parhi jaye, to woh rakaat baatil ho jaati hai. Kyonki soora faatiha parhna namaz ka ek stanbh hai aur namaz ke stanbh kisi bhi sthiti mein chhore nahin ja sakte.
Muqatdi imaam ko ruku ki awastha mein paye, to use soora faatiha parhne ki zaroorat nahin rahti.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5379: Yahoodiyon tatha eesaaiyon par Allah ki dhikkaar ho. Un logon ne nabiyon ki qabron ko masjid bana liya.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne us beemaari ke dauraan, jisse aap theek na ho sake, farmaya : "Yahoodiyon tatha eesaaiyon par Allah ki dhikkaar ho. Un logon ne nabiyon ki qabron ko masjid bana liya." Woh kahti hain : Yadi aisa na hota, to aapko baahar dafan kiya jaata. Kintu yeh bhay laga raha ki kaheen aapki qabr ko masjid na bana liya jaye.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- bataati hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apni us beemaari mein, jo wikat roop dhaaran kar chuki thi aur jismen aapki mrityu ho gai, farmaya : Allah ki dhikkaar ho yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon par tatha Allah unhen apni daya se door rakhe, kyonki unhonne apne nabiyon ki qabron ko masjid bana liya. Yahaan yeh yaad rahe ki masjid banaane ka matlab ek to qabr ke oopar masjid ka nirmaan kar lena hai aur doosra unke paas ya unki or munh karke namaz parhna hai. Iske baad aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ne kaha : Yadi Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is tarah se mana evn saavdhaan na kiya hota aur sahaaba ko is baat ki aashanka na hoti ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki qabr ke saath bhi wahi kuchh ho sakta hai, jo yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon ne apne nabiyon ki qabron ke saath kiya, to aapko baahar dafan kiya jaata.

Yeh Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki antim waseeyton mein se ek hai, jo iske aur is par dhyaan dene ke mahatv ko batlaane ke liye kaafi hai.
Qabron ko masjid banaane aur unke paas janaaze ki namaz ke atirikt any koi namaz parhne ki sakht manaahi. Kyonki yeh mritak ke seema se baahar sammaan, uski qabr ke tawaaf, use aadar ke saath chhoone aur mritak se fariyaad karne ka prawesh dvaar hai, jabki yeh saari cheezen shirk aur shirk ke saadhnon mein se hain.
Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka poora dhyaan ekeshvarvaad par rahta tha aur aap qabron ke sammaan se darte the, kyonki yeh shirk ka dvaar hai.
Allah ne apne Nabi ki qabr sharki par aadhaarit kaaryon se surakshit rakha aur aapke sahaaba tatha unke baad ke logon ke dilon mein yeh baat daal di ki aapki qabr ko baahar rakhne se bachaya jaye.
Sahaaba ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki waseeyat par amal kiya aur tauheed par qayam rahe.
Yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon ke jaise kaam karne ki sakht manaahi. Qabron par bhawan banaana unheen ka tareeqa raha hai.
Qabron ko masjid banaane mein unke paas aur unki or munh karke namaz parhna bhi aata hai, chaahe bhawan na bhi banaya jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5380: Woh vyakti hammen se nahin, jo gaalon par thappar maare, girebaan phaare aur jaahiliyat ka koi bol bole.

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Woh vyakti hammen se nahin, jo gaalon par thappar maare, girebaan phaare aur jaahiliyat ka koi bol bole."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ajnaanta kaal ke logon dvaara kiye jaane waale kuchh kaaryon se mana aur saavdhaan kiya hai. Aapne farmaya ki nimnalikhit kaam karne waale log ham mein se nahin hain :

1- gaal peetne waala. Waise to chehre ke any bhaagon ko peetna bhi manaahi ke dayre mein aata hai, lekin chehre ka zikr khaas taur se isliye kiya gaya hai ki aam taur se gaal hi peeta jaata hai.

2- atyadhik vyaakulta ke kaaran wastr ka woh bhaag (girebaan) phaar dena jahaan se sir prawisht hota hai.

3- ajnaanta (jaahiliyat) ke yug ke logon ki tarah wilaap karna, jaise 'hay-hay' aur 'barbaadi' ki pukaar lagaana, aur rona-dhona tatha shok geet gaana.

Is hadees mein di gai dhamki yeh bataati hai ki ye kaary kabeera gunaahon ke dayre mein aate hain.
Museebat par sabr karna zaroori aur Allah ke kashtadayak nirnayon par naaraazgi dikhaana aur iska izhaar rone-dhone, maatam, baal mundvaane aur girebaan faarne aadi dvaara karna haraam hai.
Islam-poorv yug ki un prathaaon ka anukran karna nishiddh hai, jinhen shareeyat dvaara maanyata nahin di gai hai.
Dukhi hone aur rone mein koi harj nahin hai. Yeh Allah ke faisle ke prati sabr karne ke wipreet nahin hai. Balki yeh daya hai, jise Allah ne rishtedaaron aur doston ke dilon mein rakh diya hai.
Ek musalmaan par waajib hai ki Allah ke faisle se khush rahe. Agar khush nahin rah paata hai, to sabr waajib hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5381: Mainne kisi imaam ke peechhe namaz nahin parhi, jo Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se adhik halki aur sanpoorn namaz parhaata ho.
Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne kisi imaam ke peechhe namaz nahin parhi, jo Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se adhik halki aur sanpoorn namaz parhaata ho.

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aasaani paida karne ka aadesh dete the aur zabaan tatha karm dvaara uski or bulaate bhi the. Aasaani paida karne ka ek roop yeh hai ki namaz parhaate samay halki namaz parhaai jaye. Lekin isse namaz ki sanpoornata mein koi kami nahin aani chahiye. Anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki unhonne jitne bhi imaamon ke peechhe namaz parhi hai, unmen sabse halki namaz sabse bare imaam yaani Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki hoti thi. Aapki namaz, kabhi peechhe namaz parhne waalon ko bhaari nahin lagti aur jab woh namaz se nikalte to unke andar namaz ki chaahat baaqi hoti thi. Saath hi, unka yeh bhi kahna hai ki unhonne aapse se adhik sanpoorn namaz kisi ke peechhe nahin parhi. Aap namaz hamesha waajib evn musathab cheezon ka khayaal rakhte hue sanpoorn dhang se parhaate aur usmen koi kami nahin rahne dete the. Ise daraasal aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki barkat ka ek namoona hi kaha ja sakta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5382: Banda apne rab se sabse adhik nikat us samay hota hai, jab woh sajde mein hota hai. Atah tum usmen khoob duayen kiya karo.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Banda apne rab se sabse adhik nikat us samay hota hai, jab woh sajde mein hota hai. Atah tum usmen khoob duayen kiya karo."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki banda apne rab se sabse zyaada nikat us samay hota hai, jab woh sajde mein hota hai. Iska kaaran yeh hai ki sajde ki haalat mein banda apne shareer ke sabse utkrisht ang ko Allah ke liye winamrata dhaaran karke zameen par rakh deta hai.

Aapne sajde ki haalat mein adhik se adhik dua karne ka aadesh diya hai, taaki Allah ke liye dhaaran ki jaane waali is winamrata aur winaysheelta mein kaary ke saath-saath kathan bhi shaamil ho jaye.

Neki ke kaam bande ko pawitr evn mahaan Allah se nikat le jaate hain.
Sajde ki haalat mein prachur maatra mein dua karna musathab hai. Kyonki sajda dua qabool hone ki jaghon mein se ek jagah hai.
5383: Qur'an parho; kyonki Qur'an qayaamat ke din apne parhne waalon ke liye sifaarishi bankar ayega.

Abu umaama (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue sunaah "Qur'an parho; kyonki Qur'an qayaamat ke din apne parhne waalon ke liye sifaarishi bankar ayega."
5384: Mainne anas (radiyallahu anhu) se poochhaah kya Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke sahaaba mein musaafhe (mulaaqaat ke samay haath milaane) ka chalan tha? To farmayaah haan!

Abu khattaab qataada kahte hain ki mainne anas (radiyallahu anhu) se poochhaah kya Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke sahaaba mein musaafhe (mulaaqaat ke samay haath milaane) ka chalan tha? To farmayaah haan!

"Kya Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke sahaaba mein musaafhe ka chalan tha?" Yaani jab we mulaaqaat ke samay salaam karte the, to kya uske baad prem mein wriddhi ke liye tatha sammaanasvaroop ek-doosre se musaafha bhi karte the? Yaad rahe ki musaafha daahine haath se hota hai aur jab do vyakti musaafha karte hain, to alag hone se pahle donon ko kshama kar diya jaata hai. Yeh hadees mulaaqaat ke samay musaafha ki fazeelat bataati hai. Yaad rahe ki musaafha ki fazeelat us samay hai, jab insaan ek-doosre se baat karne ya phir is tarah ke kisi aur uddeshy se mile. Jahaan tak baazaar mein chalte hue hone waali mulaaqaat ki baat hai, to sahaaba us samay musaafha nahin karte the. Yaani jab koi baazaar mein kisi ke paas se guzre, to use salaam kar dena hi kaafi hai.
5391: Main tumhen namaz padhaaoonga. Haalaanki mera namaz parhne ka iraada nahin tha. Main daraasal, namaz parhke dikhaana chaahta hoon ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kaise namaz parhte dekha hai.

Abu qilaaba abdullah bin zaid jarmi basri kahte hain ki hamaari masjid mein maalik bin huwairis (radiyallahu anhu) aye aur farmayaah main tumhen namaz padhaaoonga. Haalaanki mera namaz parhne ka iraada nahin tha. Main daraasal, namaz parhke dikhaana chaahta hoon ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kaise namaz parhte dekha hai. Abu qilaaba ke ek shishy ka kahna hai ki mainne abu qilaaba se poochhaah maalik bin huwairis (radiyallahu anhu) ki namaz kaisi hoti thi? To unhonne kahaah hamaare is shaikh (amr bin salma jarmi) ki namaz ki tarah. Tatha jab woh sajde se sar uthaate, to khare hone se pahle baithte the.
Yahaan shaikh se abhipray abu buraid amr bin salma jarmi hain.

Abu qilaaba kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saathi maalik bin huwairis -Allah unse prasann ho- hamaari masjid mein aye aur farmaya ki main tumhaare paas isliye aya hoon, taaki tumhen namaz parhkar namaz-e-nabvi amli tareeqe se sikhaaoon, taaki amli andaaz mein di gai shiksha zehan wa dimaagh mein adhik baaqi rahe aur samajh mein bhi adhik aye.
Abu qilaaba se warnan karne waale warnankarta ne unse poochha maalik bin huwairis, jinhonne aapko namaz-e-nabvi sikhaai thi, unki namaz kaisi thi? Abu qilaaba ne uttar diya ki hamaare shaikh abu yazeed (kuchh logon ne abu buraid bhi kaha hai) amr bin salma jarmi ki namaz ki tarah. Aap sajde se sar uthaakar khare hone se poorv thori der baithte the.
5392: Tum namaz mein سَبِّحِ اسم ربك الأعلى' ,'والشمس وَضُحَاهَا' aur 'والليل إذا يغشى' jaisi soorten kyon nahin parhte, kyonki tumhaare peechhe bare-boorhe, kamzor aur zarooratmand, har tarah ke log namaz parhte hain?

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) se warnit hai ki muaaz bin jabal (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath isha ki namaz padhte, phir apni basti waalon ke paas aakar unhen wahi namaz parhaate the.
Ek riwayat mein hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne muaaz (radiyallahu anhu) se farmayaah "Tum namaz mein سَبِّحِ اسم ربك الأعلى' ,'والشمس وَضُحَاهَا' aur 'والليل إذا يغشى' jaisi soorten kyon nahin parhte, kyonki tumhaare peechhe bare-boorhe, kamzor aur zarooratmand, har tarah ke log namaz parhte hain?"

Banu salima, jisse muaaz bin jabal -radiyallahu anhu- ka sanbandh tha, ke ghar madeena ke ek kinaare mein awasthit the. Muaaz -radiyallahu anhu- neki ke kaamon bari raghbat rakhte the. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu se prem aur dharm seekhne ki chaahat mein woh aapke saath namaz mein shareek hote aur phir aapke peechhe farz namaz parh lene ke baad apne gaanv waalon ke paas jaakar unhen wahi namaz parhaate the, jo unke haq mein nafal aur gaanv waalon ke haq mein farz hoti thi. Svayn Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko bhi iska jnaan tha aur aapne khaamosh sahamti jataai thi. Lekin ek baar unhonne lanbi qiraat kar di, jabki Islam udaarta evn aasaani ka dharm hai aur usmen mushkil evn kathinaai paida karne jaisi cheezon, jinke nateeje mein chhitkaane aur bidkaane ka maahaul banta hai, ka koi sthaan nahin hai.
Jab Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko maaloom hua ki muaaj -radiyallahu anhu- lanbi qiraat karte hain, to unhen bataya ki jab imaam rahen to halki qiraat karen aur udaaharnasvaroop ausaat-e-mufassal ki soorten, jaise "سبح اسم ربك الأعلى", "والشمس وضحاها" Aur "والليل إذا يغشى" Aadi parhne ka nirdesh diya. Kyonki unke peechhe namaz parhne waalon mein boorhe, kamzor aur zarooratmand log bhi shaamil hote hain, jinhen lanbi qiraat se pareshaani hoti hai. Atah, unke saath narmi karte hue aur unka khayaal rakhte hue halki qiraat karni chahiye. Haan, yadi koi akele namaz parh raha ho, to jitni chaahe, lanbi qiraat kar sakta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5393: Jisne jume ke din janaabat (sahvaas ke baad) ka snaan kiya, phir pahli ghari mein masjid ki or chal para, usne goya ek oont ki qurbaani di;

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne jume ke din janaabat (sahvaas ke baad) ka snaan kiya, phir pahli ghari mein masjid ki or chal para, usne goya ek oont ki qurbaani di; jo doosri ghari mein gaya, usne goya ek gay ki qurbaani di; jo teesri ghari mein gaya, usne goya ek mendhe ki qarbaani di; jo chauthi ghari mein gaya, usne goya ek murgi daan ki aur jo paanchveen ghari mein nikla, usne goya ek anda daan kiya. Phir jab imaam nikal aata hai, to farishte upasthit hokar khutba sunne lagte hain."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jume ki namaz ke liye jaldi jaane ki fazeelat bayaan kar rahe hain. Jume ki namaz ke liye jaane ka yeh fazeelat waala samay sooraj nikalne se lekar imaam ke minbar par aane tak rahta hai. Is avdhi ke paanch bhaag hain. Daraasal sooraj nikalne se lekar imaam ke minbar par aane ke beech ki is avdhi ko paanch bhaagon mein baanta jayega.

1- jisne janaabat ke snaan ki tarah sanpoorn snaan kiya aur uske baad pahle bhaag mein juma masjid chala gaya, usne goya ek oont sadqa kiya.

2- jo doosre bhaag mein masjid pahuncha, usne goya ek gay sadqa kiya.

3- jo teesre bhaag mein masjid pahuncha, usne goya seeng waala ek nar mendha sadqa kiya.

4- jo chauthe bhaag mein masjid pahuncha, usne goya ek murgi sadqa kiya.

5- jo paanchven bhaag mein masjid pahuncha, usne goya ek anda sadqa kiya.

Uske baad jab imaam khutbe ke liye nikal jaata hai, to masjid ke dvaar par baithkar kramvaar prawesh karne waalon ka naam likhne waale farishte likhne ka kaam band kar dete hain aur khutba sunne mein vyast ho jaate hain.

Jume ke din snaan karne ki prerna. Snaan namaz ke liye nikalne se pahle kiya jaana chahiye.
Jume ki namaz ke liye,  din ke pahle ghante se hi, jaldi jaane ki fazeelat.
Neki ke kaamon ki jaanib jaldi karne aur ek-doosre se aage barhne ki prerna.
Farishte bhi jume ki namaz mein maujood rahte hain aur jume ka khutba sunte hain.
Farishte masjid ke dvaaron par maujood rahte hain aur kramvaar juma ke liye aane waalon ka naam darj karte hain.
Ibn-e-rajab kahte hain : Hadees mein aye hue shabd "Jume ke deen jis ne snaan kiya, phir gaya" Is baat ko batlaate hain ki: Jume ke liye musathab snaan ka samay fajr nikalne ke baad shuru hota hai aur jume ki namaz ke liye jaane tak rahta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5394: Tummen se jo jume ki namaz ke liye aye, woh snaan kar le.

Abdullah bin amar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko farmaate hue suna hai : "Tummen se jo jume ki namaz ke liye aye, woh snaan kar le."
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam zor dekar farma rahe hain ki jo vyakti jume ki namaz ke liye aana chaahe, uske liye janaabat ke snaan ki tarah snaan karna musathab hai.

Jume ke din snaan karne ki taakeed. Momin ke liye jume ke din snaan karna sunnat hai. Behtar yeh hai ki snaan namaz ke liye jaate samay kiya jaye.
Saaf-suthra rahna aur khushbu lagaana ek musalmaan ke aachran ka hissa hai. Logon se mulaaqaat karte aur unke saath uthte-baithte samay iska mahatv aur barh jaata hai. Khaas taur se sabhaaon evn jamaaton mein.
Is hadees mein sanbodhan un logon se hai, jinpar jume ki namaz waajib hai. Kyonki wahi jume ki namaz parhne ke liye jaata hai.
Jume mein shaamil hone ke liye saaf-suthra hokar jaana musathab hai. Shareer se koi badbu na aane paye, iske liye snaan kar le aur khushbu laga le. Waise, wazu kar lena bhi kaafi hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5396: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne usi dan najaashi ki mrityu ki soochna di, jis din unki mrityu hui thi. Aap logon ke saath eedgaah ki or nikle, unhen saf mein khara kiya aur chaar takbeeren kaheen.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne usi dan najaashi ki mrityu ki soochna di, jis din unki mrityu hui thi. Aap logon ke saath eedgaah ki or nikle, unhen saf mein khara kiya aur chaar takbeeren kaheen.

Habsha ke baadshaah najjaashi ka, habsha ki or hijrat karne waale sahaaba par bara ehsaan tha. Yeh us samay ki baat hai jab quraish ne makka ke andar musalmaanon par zameen tang kar di thi aur abhi madeene waale bhi musalmaan nahin hue the. Unhonne musalmaanon ko sammaan diya aur apni nekneeyti, saty-prem aur sahajta ke kaaran musalmaan bhi ho gae. Phir, habsha hi mein mrityu paai aur Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko dekhne ka gaurav praapt nahin kar sake.
Choonki unka musalmaanon par bara ehsaan tha, oonchi shakhsiyat ke maalik the aur aisi jagah rahte the, jahaan unpar janaaze ki namaz bhi nahin parhi ja saki thi, isliye jis din unki mrityu hui, usi din aapne apne saathiyon ko unki mrityu ki soochna di aur unhen eedgaah le gae, taaki najjaashi ki mahaanta ko darshaya ja sake, unke Islam ko charche mein laya ja sake aur adhik se adhik logon ko janaaze ki namaz mein shareek kiya ja sake. Wahaan pahunchne ke baad safbandi ki aur namaz parhi, jismen Allah ke nikat unki sifaarish ke liye chaar takbeer kahi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5397: "Jo janaaze mein namaz sanpann hone tak shaamil raha, uske liye ek qeeraat neki hai aur jo dafnaye jaane tak shareek raha, uske liye do qeeraat neki hai." Kaha gaya ki do qeeraat kya hain? To farmayaah "Do bare-bare pahaaro ke baraabar."

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jo janaaze mein namaz sanpann hone tak shaamil raha, uske liye ek qeeraat neki hai aur jo dafnaye jaane tak shareek raha, uske liye do qeeraat neki hai." Kaha gaya ki do qeeraat kya hain? To farmayaah "Do bare-bare pahaaro ke baraabar."

Allah apne bandon ke prati bara dayaalu hai aur unhen kshama karne ke saadhan jutaana chaahta hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki janaaze ki namaz mein shaamil hone aur uske kafan-dafan mein sammilit hone ki prerna di gai hai. Kyonki yeh sifaarish hai aur daya ka kaaran banti hai.
Allah ne janaaze ki namaz parhne waale ke liye ek qeeraat sawaab rakha hai aur dafan tak saath rahne waale ke liye ek aur qeeraat. Qeeraat daraasal pratiphal ki ek bahut bari maatra hai, jiska parimaan Allah jaanta hai.
Choonki sahaaba uska parimaan nahin jaante the, isliye Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unhen samjhaane ke liye bataya ki har qeeraat ek bahut bare parvat ke baraabar hai. Daraasal itna bara pratiphal isliye milta hai ki janaaze mein shirkat se musalmaan bhaai ka haq ada hota hai, is avsar par uske liye dua ki jaati hai, insaan ko uska parinaam yaad aata hai, mrit vyakti ke parijnon ka dhaaras bandhta hai, aur iske atirikt bhi kai laabh hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5398: Ham Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath juma ki namaz parhkar lautte, to deewaaron ki itni chhaanv nahin hoti ki ham uska aashray le paate.

Salma bin akaa (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai, jo un logon mein shaamil the, jinhonne per ke neeche Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke haath par baiat ki thi, ki ham Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath juma ki namaz parhkar lautte, to deewaaron ki itni chhaanv nahin hoti ki ham uska aashray le paate.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih ham log Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath sooraj dhalne ke baad jume ki namaz parhte, phir ham lautte, to chhaya ki talaash kar rahe hote.

Salma bin akva -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki woh log Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath juma ki namaz mein shareek hote aur itni jaldi namaz parh lete ki donon khutbon tatha juma ki namaz sanpann karne ke baad jab ghar lautte, to deewaaron ki itni chhaya nahin hoti ki uske neeche khud ko chhupa paate.
Doosri riwayat mein bataya gaya hai ki we Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath juma ki namaz sooraj dhalne ke baad parhkar ghar lautte the.
Ulema is baat par ekmat hain ki juma ka antim samay wahi hai, jo zohar ka antim samay hai. Albatta, behtar yeh hai ki use sooraj dhalne ke baad parh liya jaye, kyonki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aksar aisa hi kiya karte the aur is samay ke baare mein ulema ke beech koi matbhed nahin hai. Parantu yadi koi aawashyakta ho, jaise tez garmi par rahi ho aur chhaya karne ke liye kuchh na ho ya phir sooraj dhalne se pahle yuddh mein nikalna ho, to sooraj dhalne se kuchh der pahle parh lene mein koi harj nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5399: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) khare hokar do khutbe dete the aur donon ke beech mein baithkar antar karte the.

Abdullah bin umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) do khutbe dete the aur donon ke beech mein baithte the.
Tatha jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) ki ek riwayat mein hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) khare hokar do khutbe dete the aur donon ke beech mein baithkar antar karte the.

Jume ke din ek bara majma hota hai, jismen poore shahar ke log shaamil hote hain. Yahi wajah hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam-, jinka har kaam hikmat se bhara hota tha, us din logon ke samaane do sanbodhan rakhte aur unhen bhalaai ka raasta bataane tatha buraai se rokne ka kaam karte the. Donon khutbe aap minbar par khare hokar diya karte the, taaki logon ko samjhaane aur sikhaane ka kaary adhik achchhe dhang se ho sake. Saath hi khare hokar khutba dene se Islam ki shaan wa shaukat aur shakti bhi jhalakti hai.
Jab pahla khutba sanpann ho jaata, to kshanik der aaraam ke liye baith jaate aur pahle khu़tabe ko doosre se alag kar dete. Uske baad phir khare hote aur doosra khutba dete, taaki na khutba dene waale ko thakaan mahsoos ho aur na sunne waale uktayen.
[ise baihqi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5400: Jisne namaz parhne se pahle qurbaani kar li, woh uske sthaan par doosri qurbaani kare aur jisne qurbaani nahin ki, woh Allah ke naam se qurbaani kare.

Jundub bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne qurbaani ke din namaz ke pashchaat khutba diya, phir qurbaani ki aur farmayaah "Jisne namaz parhne se pahle qurbaani kar li, woh uske sthaan par doosri qurbaani kare aur jisne qurbaani nahin ki, woh Allah ke naam se qurbaani kare."

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne qurbaani ke din ka aaranbh namaz se kiya, phir waktavy diya aur uske baad jaanvar zabah kiya. Aap apni qurbaani ke jaanvar ke saath eedgaah jaate the, taaki Islam ki dhaarmik nishaaniyon ka izhaar ho sake, adhik se adhik logon ka laabh ho sake aur logon ko qurbaani ka tareeqa sikhaya ja sake. Aapne logon ko qurbaani ki shart tatha uska hukm bataate hue farmaya : Jisne eed ki namaz se pahle hi jaanvar zabah kar diya, uski qurbaani sahi nahin hui. Atah, woh uske sthaan par doosri qurbaani kare. Parantu, jisne ab tak jaanvar zabah nahin kiya hai, woh ab zabah kare aur zabah karte samay Allah ka naam le, taaki zabah sahi ho aur zabah kiya hua jaanvar halaal ho. Isse saabit hota hai ki qurbaani ke din isi kram se kaam hona chahiye aur ismen aage-peechh karne ki gunjaaish nahin hai.
Yeh hadees is baat ka bhi pramaan hai ki qurbaani ka jaanvar jabah karne ka samay namaz samaapt hone se aaranbh hota hai, namaz ke samay aur imaam ke zabah karne se nahin. Haan, yadi kisi par eed ki namaz waajib na ho, jaise musaafir aadi, to uski baat alag hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
