5401: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne qurbaani ke din namaz ke pashchaat khutba dete hue farmayaah "Jisne hamaari tarah namaz parhi tatha hamaari tarah qurbaani ki, uski qurbaani sahi hai aur jisne namaz se pahle qurbaani ki, uski qurbaani sahi nahin hai."

Bara bin aazib (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne qurbaani ke din namaz ke pashchaat khutba dete hue farmayaah "Jisne hamaari tarah namaz parhi tatha hamaari tarah qurbaani ki, uski qurbaani sahi hai aur jisne namaz se pahle qurbaani ki, uski qurbaani sahi nahin hai." Yeh sun (bara bin aazib ke maama) abu burda bin niyaar ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, mainne apni bakri to namaz se pahle hi zabah kar di hai! Daraasal mujhe laga ki aaj khaane-peene ka din hai aur meri khvaahish hui ki meri bakri sabse pahle zabah ho. Isliye mainne apni bakri zabah kar di aur namaz ke liye jaane se pahle hi kha liya! To aapne kahaah "Teri yeh bakri kewal maans ki bakri hai." Unhonne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, mere paas ek bakri ka bachcha hai, jo mujhe do bakriyon se adhik pyaara hai. Kya woh meri or se kaafi hoga? Aapne farmayaah "Haan, lekin tumhaare pashchaat kisi doosre ke liye kaafi nahin hoga."

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne qurbaani ke din namaz ke pashchaat khutba dete hue zabah ke widhaan aur us din uske samay ka wivran prastut karte hue farmaya ki jisne hamaari is namaz ki tarah namaz parhi tatha hamaare bataye hue tareeqe ke anusaar qurbaani ki, usne sharai tareeqe ka paalan kiya.
Lekin, jahaan tak us vyakti ki baat hai, jisne eed ki namaz se pahle hi zabah kar diya, to usne zabah ka samay prawesh karne se pahle hi zabah kar diya. Atah, uski qurbaani sharai evn sveekaary nahin hogi, balki uska kewal maans khaana hoga. Jab abu burda -radiyallahu anhu- ne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka khutba suna, to bole : Ai Allah ke Rasool, mainne apni bakri namaz se pahle hi zabah kar di thi. Daraasal main jaanta tha ki aaj ka din khaane-peene ka din hai. Isliye mainne socha ki ghar mein sabse pahle meri hi bakri zabah ho. So, mainne apni bakri zabah kar di aur aur namaz ke liye aane se pahle hi kha liya.
Yeh sun aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : Tumhaari qurbaani sharai drishtikon se sahi nahi hai. Woh to bas maans ki bakri hai. Abu burda ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, mere paas ghar ka paala hua bakri ka ek bachcha hai, jo mere nikat bahut moolyawaan hai aur mujhe do bakriyon se zyaada priy hai. Yadi main use Allah ki raah mein zabah kar doon, to kya woh kaafi hoga? Aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah haan, kintu yeh hukm kewal tumhaare saath khaas hoga. Tumhaare siwa kisi aur vyakti ko ek warsh se kam ayu ke bakri ke bachche ko zabah karne ki anumti nahin hogi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5402: Kya main tumhen woh shabd na bataaoon, jo Allah ke nikat sabse priy hai? Allah ke nikat sabse priy shabd haih 'سبحان اللهِ وبحمدِهِ' (arthaat Allah pawitr hai apni prashansa ke saath.)

Aboozar gifaari (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Kya main tumhen woh shabd na bataaoon, jo Allah ke nikat sabse priy hai? Allah ke nikat sabse priy shabd haih 'سبحان اللهِ وبحمدِهِ' (arthaat Allah pawitr hai apni prashansa ke saath.)"

Yeh hadees is baat ka pramaan hai ki tasbeeh sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ke nikat sabse priy waani hai, kyonki tasbeeh ka arth hai Allah ko un tamaam upmaaon, samaantaaon, kamiyon evn anuchit baaton se pawitr ghoshit karna, jo uske yogy nahin hain. Kahne waale ka yeh kahna "Apni prashansa ke saath" Daraasal is baat ka etraaf hai ki tasbeeh bhi pawitr Allah ki prashansa ke kaaran sanbhav ho saki, atah yeh bhi usi ka ehsaan hai. Iska ek any arth ho sakta hai : Main uski pawitrata uski prashansa ke saath bayaan karta hoon, kyonki usi ne mujhe pawitrata bayaan karne ka suyog pradaan kiya hai. Atah (سبحان الله وبحمده) Allah ke nikat sabse priy waani hai, kyonki uske andar Allah ki paaki ka bhi bayaan hai aur uski prashansa bhi hai.
5403: Kanjoos woh vyakti hai, jiske saamne mera naam liya jaye aur woh mujhpar darood na bheje.

Husain bin ali bin abu taalib radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Kanjoos woh vyakti hai, jiske saamne mera naam liya jaye aur woh mujhpar darood na bheje."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is baat se saavdhaan kiya hai ki kisi ke saamne aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka naam, kunyat ya zikr aye aur woh aappar darood na bheje. Aapne kaha : Woh vyakti poorn roop se kanjoos hai, jiske saamne mera zikr ho aur woh mujhpar darood na bheje. Iske kai kaaran hain :

1- usne ek aisi cheez kharch karne mein kanjoosi dikhaai, jismen zara bhi ghaata nahin hai. Usmen na maal kharch hota hai aur na mehnat lagti hai.

2- usne khud ko Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par darood bhejne ke pratiphal se wanchit kar liya. Usne aappar darood na bhejkar ek aise haq ki adaygi mein kanjoosi dikhaai, jo is sanbandh mein aye hue aadesh ke anupaalan aur pratiphal ki praapti ke liye use ada karna tha.

3- Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par darood bhejna hamaare oopar aapke adhikaaron mein se ek adhikaar ki adaygi hai. Kyonki aapne hamen shiksha di, hamaara maargadarshan kiya, hamen Allah ki or bulaya aur hamaare liye wahy (prakaashna) aur ek bhavy shareeyat le aye. Atah Allah ke pashchaat aap hi hamaare maargadarshan ka sabab hain. Atah jo aappar darood nahin bhejta, woh aapke prati kanjoosi kar raha hai aur Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka ek chhota sa hak ada karne mein bhi kanjoosi kar raha hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par darood na bhejna kanjoosi ki nishaani hai.
Waise to Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par darood bhejna har samay neki ka ek utkrisht kaary hai, lekin jab aapka ullekh ho, to iska mahatv barh jaata hai.
Navvi kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par darood bhejte samay darood wa salaam donon bheje. Kisi ek par bas na kare. Na kewal (sallallahu alaihi) kahe aur na kewal (alaihissalaam) kahe.
Abul aaliya, Allah ke kathan "Nihsandeh Allah evn uske farishte Nabi par salaat (darood) bhejte hain." Ke baare mein kahte hain : 'Salaat' shabd jab Allah ki or se Nabi ke haq mein istemaal ho, to uska arth hai prashansa karna tatha jab farishton evn insaanon ki or se istemaal ho, to uska arth hota hai dua karna.
Haleemi kahte hain : Is tarah "Allahumma salli ala Muhammad" Ka arth hua : Ai Allah! Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko duniya mein mahaanta pradaan kar, aapke zikr ko ooncha karke, aapke deen ko prabhutv pradaan karke aur aapki shareeyat ko baaqi rakh kar. Aakhirat mein bhi mahaanta pradaan kar, ummat ke baare mein aapki sifaarish ko qabool farmaakar, aap ko bara pratiphal pradaan karke, aap ko maqaam-e- mahmood se sammaanit karke, baad ke tamaam logon par aapki shreshthata vyakt karke, aur upasthit nikatvartiyon par aapko tarjeeh dekar.
[ise tirmizi ne tatha nasai ne al-sunan al-kubra mein evn ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5404: Safar azaab ka ek hissa hai.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh "Safar azaab ka ek hissa hai, jo tumhen khaane, peene aur sone se rokta hai. Isliye jab tummen se kisi ki safar ki zaroorat poori ho jaye, to jaldi ghar waapas a jaye."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5412: Tummen se jise main kisi prashaasnik kaam ki zimmewaari doon, phir usne hamse ek sooi ya usse bhi chhoti cheez chhipaai, to woh khayaanat mein shumaar hoga, jise lekar woh qayaamat ke din upasthit hoga.

Adi bin umair kindi (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh "Tummen se jise main kisi prashaasnik kaam ki zimmewaari doon, phir usne hamse ek sooi ya usse bhi chhoti cheez chhipaai, to woh khayaanat mein shumaar hoga, jise lekar woh qayaamat ke din upasthit hoga." Yeh sun ek kaala-kalauta ansaari aadmi aapke paas aya. Aisa lag raha hai ki main use aaj bhi dekh raha hoon. Woh kahne lagaah ai Allah ke Rasool, aapne jo kaam mujhe diya tha, use mujhse waapas le len. Aapne kahaah "Aisa kyon?" Usne kahaah mainne aapko is is tarah ki baat kahte suna hai. Farmayaah "Wahi baat main ab bhi kah raha hoon; jise main kisi prashaasnik kaam ka zimmewaar banaaoon, to woh kam tatha zyaada sab kuchh laakar rakh de. Phir usmen se jo kuchh use diya jaye, use le le aur jisse mana kiya jaye, usse door rahe."

Jise ham zakat athva ghaneemat ka dhan ada karne ya is prakaar ki koi zimmewaari den aur woh ek sooi ya usse bhi koi chhoti cheez chhupa le, to yeh amaanat mein khayaanat hai, aur woh qayaamat ke din use lekar upasthit hoga. Yeh sun ek ansaari vyakti khara hua aur aapse aapki or se sonpi hui zimmewaari se khud ko alag kar lene ki anumti maangi, to aapne usse poochha ki tum aisa kyon karna chaahte ho? Jab usne kaha ki iska kaaran woh chetaavni hai, jo mainne aapko dete hue suna hai, to aapne farmaya : Main ab bhi wahi kahta hoon; ham jise koi zimmewaari den, woh thora ho ki zyaada, sab kuchh laakar saamne rakh de. Phir paarishramik ke taur par use jitna diya jaye, use le le aur jise lene se mana kiya jaye aur jiska woh adhikaar na rakhta ho, use na le.
5430: Jisne apni (jhoothi) qasam se kisi musalmaan ka haq maara, uske liye Allah ne Jahannam ko waajib aur Jannat ko haraam kar diya." Ek vyakti ne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Chaahe woh cheez thori-si kyon na ho? Aapne uttar diya : "Yadyapi peelu per ki ek chhoti-si shaakha hi kyon na ho.

Abu umaama iyaas bin saalba haarisi -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jisne apni (jhoothi) qasam se kisi musalmaan ka haq maara, uske liye Allah ne Jahannam ko waajib aur Jannat ko haraam kar diya." Ek vyakti ne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Chaahe woh cheez thori-si kyon na ho? Aapne uttar diya : "Yadyapi peelu per ki ek chhoti-si shaakha hi kyon na ho."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kisi musalmaan ka haq chheenne ke liye jaan boojhkar Allah ki jhoothi qasam khaane se mana kiya hai aur bataya hai ki isse insaan Jahannam ka haqdaar ban jaata hai tatha Jannat se wanchit ho jaata hai. Yeh daraasal ek kabeera gunaah hai. Aapki baat sunne ke baad ek vyakti ne kaha ki ai Allah Rasool! Jis cheez ke liye qasam khaai gai hai, woh thori ho, tab bhi yahi saza hai? Aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne uttar diya : Woh misvaak ke liye istemaal mein aane waali peelu ke per ki ek lakri ho, tab bhi yahi saza hai.

Is hadees mein doosre ka haq maarne se mana kiya gaya hai aur haq waale ko uska haq dene ki prerna di gai hai. Haq chaahe chhota hi kyon na ho. Saath hi yeh spasht kar diya gaya hai ki shaasak ka ghalat nirnay kisi insaan ke liye aisi cheez ko jayaz nahin kar deta, jo uski na ho.
Navvi kahte hain : Musalmaanon ka haq maar lena bara sakht haraam hai aur is maamle mein chhote aur bare haq ke beech koi antar nahin hai. Kyonki, Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Yadyapi peelu per ki ek chhoti-si shaakha hi kyon na ho."
Navvi kahte hain : Yeh saza us vyakti ke liye hai, jo kisi musalmaan ka haq maare aur tauba karne se pahle mar jaye. Agar kisi ne tauba kar li, apne kiye par sharminda hua, haq waale ko uska haq lauta diya, maafi-talaafi kara li aur dobaar us gunaah ko na karne ka drirh sankalp le liya, to uska gunaah khatm ho jayega.
Qaazi kahte hain : Yahaan musalmaanon ka zikr khaas taur se isliye hua hai ki wahi Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saamne the aur aam taur par wahi shareeyat par amal bhi karte hain. Iska matlab hargiz yeh nahin haiै ki ghair-muslimon ka haq chheena ja sakta hai. Ek musalmaan ki tarah ek ghair-Muslim ka haq bhi chheena nahin ja sakta.
Navvi kahte hain : Jhooth kisi cheez ke baare mein uski waastawikta se hatkar jaankaari dene ka naam hai. Jaan-boojhkar ho ya ghalti se. Us cheez ka sanbandh bhootkaal se ho ya bhawishy kaal se.
5431: Jisne khaana khaane ke baad yeh dua parheeh 'الحمدُ للهِ الذي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقْنِيهِ مِنْ غَيرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ' (arthaat - saari prashansa Allah ki hai, jisne mujhe yeh khaana khilaya tatha yeh rozi di, jabki ismen meri shakti tatha saamarthy ka koi dakhal nahin hai) uske pichhle saare gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain.

Sahl bin muaaz apne pita se riwayat karte hain, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jisne khaana khaane ke baad yeh dua parheeh 'الحمدُ للهِ الذي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقْنِيهِ مِنْ غَيرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ' (arthaat - saari prashansa Allah ki hai, jisne mujhe yeh khaana khilaya tatha yeh rozi di, jabki ismen meri shakti tatha saamarthy ka koi dakhal nahin hai) uske pichhle saare gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam khaana khaane waale ko Allah ki prashansa karne ki prerna de rahe hain. Kyonki Allah ke diye hue suyog evn madad ke bina insaan ke paas na bhojan praapt karne ki shakti hai aur na khaane ki kshamta. Uske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne yeh dua karne waale ko susmaachaar sunaya hai ki Allah uske pichhle chhote gunaahon ko maaf kar deta hai.

Khaana khaane ke baad Allah ki prashansa karna musathab hai.
Allah ke nitaant anugrah ka bayaan ki usne bandon ko rozi di, rozi ke saadhan uplabdh kiye aur usmen gunaahon ki kshama ka saamaan bhi paida kar diya.
Bando ke saare maamlaat ki baagdor Allah ke haath mein hai. Unki shakti evn saamarthy ke aadhaar par kuchh nahin hota. Jabki bande ko aadesh diya gaya hai ki woh saadhnon ko apnaye.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5432: Jisne Allah ke liye winamrata dikhaate hue aisa wastr pahanne se gurez kiya, jise pahanne ki woh shakti rakhta hai, Allah qayaamat ke din use saari srishtiyon ke saamne bulayega aur akhtiyaar dega ki eemaan ka jo jora woh pahanne chaahe, pahan le.

Muaaz bin anas (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jisne Allah ke liye winamrata dikhaate hue aisa wastr pahanne se gurez kiya, jise pahanne ki woh shakti rakhta hai, Allah qayaamat ke din use saari srishtiyon ke saamne bulayega aur akhtiyaar dega ki eemaan ka jo jora woh pahanne chaahe, pahan le."
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5433: Jisne achchhi tarah wazu kiya, phir jume ki namaz ke liye aya aur dhyaanpoorvak khutba suna tatha khaamosh raha, uske do jume ke beech tatha teen din adhik ke saare paap kshama kar diye jaate hain.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jisne achchhi tarah wazu kiya, phir jume ki namaz ke liye aya aur dhyaanpoorvak khutba suna tatha khaamosh raha, uske do jume ke beech tatha teen din adhik ke saare paap kshama kar diye jaate hain. Tatha jisne (juma ke khutba ke samay) kankriyon se khela, usne vyarth kaam kiya."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jisne wazu kiya aur wazu ke aniwaary kaaryon, sunnaton aur aadaab ka paalan karte hue khoob achchhi tarah wazu kiya, phir jume ki namaz ke liye upasthit hua, khaamoshi se aur kaan lagaakar khateeb ki baaten suneen, Allah uske das dinon ke chhote gunaah maaf kar deta hai. Yaani ek jume ki namaz se doosre jume ki namaz tak aur atirikt teen dinon ke gunaah. Kyonki Allah ke yahaan ek neki ko barhaakar das bana diya jaata hai. Uske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne khutbe ke dauraan kahi jaane waali baaton ko poore dhyaan se na sunne aur shareer ke angon ko bina matlab ke kaaryon, jaise kankar chhoone aadi mein vyast rakhne se saavdhaan kiya hai aur farmaya hai ki is tarah ka kaam karne waala vyarth kaary karta hai aur vyarth kaary karne waale ko jume ke pratiphal se wanchit kar diya jaata hai.

Wazu karne, sanpoorn roop se wazu karne aur paabandi ke saath jume ki namaz ada karne ki prerna.
Jume ki namaz ki fazeelat.
Juma ka khutba khaamoshi ke saath sunna aur khutbe ke dauraan baat aadi karne se bachna zaroori hai.
Jisne khutbe ke dauraan koi vyarth kaary kiya, uski jume ki namaz ho to jaati hai aur aniwaaryata bhi khatm ho jaati hai, lekin sawaab ghat jaata hai.
5434: Jo dara, woh raat ke pratham bhaag mein chal para aur jo raat ke pratham bhaag mein chala, woh manzil tak pahunch gaya. Sun lo, Allah ka saamaan bara mahanga hai. Sun lo, Allah ka saamaan Jannat hai.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jo dara, woh raat ke pratham bhaag mein chal para aur jo raat ke pratham bhaag mein chala, woh manzil tak pahunch gaya. Sun lo, Allah ka saamaan bara mahanga hai. Sun lo, Allah ka saamaan Jannat hai."

Jise Allah ka bhay ho, woh gunaahon se door rahe aur Allah ki ibaadat mein laga rahe. Kyonki Allah ke paas jo saamaan hai, woh bara mahanga hai. Woh saamaan daraasal Jannat hai, jiska mooly jaan tatha dhan kharch karna hi ho sakta hai.
5435: Jisne subah ki namaz parhi, woh Allah ki raksha mein hota hai

Jundub bin abdullah qasri radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne subah ki namaz parhi, woh Allah ki raksha mein hota hai. Atah, (aisa kam karo ki) Allah tumko apni raksha mein kisi bhi cheez ke aadhaar par hargiz talab na kare. Kyonki jise Allah apni raksha mein se kisi cheez ke aadhaar par talab karega, use pa lega, phir use aundhe munh Jahannam ki aag mein daal dega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jisne fajr ki namaz parh li, woh Allah ke sanrakshan mein hota hai. Allah uski raksha tatha madad karta hai.

Phir aapne is sanrakshan ko bhang karne se saavdhaan kar diya. Is sanrakshan ko bhang karne ka ek roop fajr ki namaz chhor dena hai aur doosra roop fajr ki namaz parhne waale ke saath chher-chhaar tatha uspar atyaachaar karna hai. Jisne aisa kiya, usne is sanrakshan ko bhang kar diya aur is chetaavni ka haqdaar ban gaya ki Allah use apne haq mein kotaahi karne ki wajah se talab karega. Zaahir-si baat hai ki jise Allah talab karega, use pa hi lega. Phir use chehre ke bal Jahannam mein daal dega.

Fajr ki namaz ka mahatv tatha fazeelat.
Fajr ki namaz parhne waale ke saath chher-chhaar karne par kathor chetaavni.
Allah aise logon se pratishodh leta hai, jo uske nek bandon ke saath chher-chhaar karte hain.
5436: Jo subah ke samay ya shaam ke samay masjid ki or jaata hai, to woh subah ya shaam ko jab bhi jaata hai, uske badle Allah uske liye Jannat mein satkaar ka saamaan taiyaar karta hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jo subah ke samay ya shaam ke samay masjid ki or jaata hai, to woh subah ya shaam ko jab bhi jaata hai, uske badle Allah uske liye Jannat mein satkaar ka saamaan taiyaar karta hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ibaadat, jnaan arjit karne ya is tarah ke kisi nek uddeshy ki khaatir kisi bhi samay, din ke pahle bhaag mein ho ki antim bhaag mein, masjid aane waale ko susmaachaar sunaya hai ki woh raat ya din ke samay jab bhi masjid aata hai, to Allah uske liye Jannat mein sthaan evn aatithy taiyaar kar deta hai.

Masjid jaane ki fazeelat tatha wahaan paabandi se farz namaz parhne ki prerna. Masjidon se door rahne waala vyakti anginat bhalaaiyon, fazeelton, pratiphal aur Allah ki or se taiyaar aatithy se wanchit ho jaata hai.
Jab ham insaan apne ghar aye hue atithi ka satkaar karte hain aur use khaana khilaate hain, to Allah to apne bandon ki tulna mein kaheen bara daata evn sammaan dene waala hai. Woh bhi apne ghar aane waale atithi ka satkaar karta hai aur uske liye ek mahaan aur bhavy aatithy taiyaar karta hai.
Masjid jaana khushi aur rashk ka kaam hai. Kyonki insaan jitni baar masjid jaata hai, utni baar uske liye mehmaani taiyaar ki jaati hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5437: Jo Allah evn antim diwas par eemaan rakhta ho, woh achchhi baat kare ya chup rahe

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jo Allah evn antim diwas par eemaan rakhta ho, woh achchhi baat kare ya chup rahe, jo Allah tatha antim diwas par eemaan rakhta ho, woh apne parosi ko sammaan de evn jo Allah tatha antim diwas par eemaan rakhta ho, woh apne atithi ka satkaar kare."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jo momin banda Allah aur aakhirat ke din par eemaan rakhta hai, uska eemaan use in kaamon ko karne ki prerna deta hai :

1- achchhi baat karna : Jaise subhaanallah aur la ilaaha illallah jaise azkaar parhna, bhalaai ka aadesh dena, buraai se rokna aur logon ke beech sulah karaana. Agar woh aisa na kar sakta ho, to chup rahe, kisi ko kasht dene se bache aur apni zabaan ki raksha kare.

2- parosi ko sammaan dena : Yaani uske saath ehsaan aur achchha vyavhaar karna karna aur use kasht na dena.

3- milne ke liye aane waale atithi ka satkaar karna : Yaani usse achchhe andaaz se baat karna aur use khaana khilaana aadi.

Allah aur aakhirat ke din par eemaan har bhalaai ki jar hai aur isse achchhe kaam karne ki prerna milti hai.
Ismen insaan ko zabaan ki  kleshon se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai.
Islam prem tatha sammaan ka dharm hai.
Ye teen kaam eemaan ki shaakhaaon aur achchhe shishtaachaaron mein se hain.
Adhik bolna kabhi-kabhi makrooh tatha haraam ki or le jaata hai, isliye bhalaai kewal usi samay bolne mein hai, jab koi achchhi baat karni ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5438: Jiske paas uske bhaai ka, izzat wa aabru ya kisi aur cheez se sanbandhit koi haq ho, woh aaj hi usse gardan chhura le, isse pahle ki woh din a jaye, jab uske paas na deenaar honge na dirham.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jiske paas uske bhaai ka, izzat wa aabru ya kisi aur cheez se sanbandhit koi haq ho, woh aaj hi usse gardan chhura le, isse pahle ki woh din a jaye, jab uske paas na deenaar honge na dirham. Yadi uske paas achchhe karm honge, to uske atyaachaar ke baraabar le liye jayenge aur agar nekiyaan nahin hongi, to uske saathi ke gunaah lekar uspar laad diye jayenge."
5439: Jo logon par daya nahin karta, uspar sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah bhi daya nahin karta.

Jareer bin abdullah radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jo logon par daya nahin karta, uspar sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah bhi daya nahin karta."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jo logon par daya nahin karta, uspar sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah daya nahin karta. Is tarah dekha jaye to Allah ki srishti par daya karna Allah ki daya praapt karne ka ek bahut bara saadhan hai.

Saari srishtiyon par daya waanchhit hai, lekin yahaan khaas taur par 'logon' ka zikr unpar dhyaan dilaane ke liye hai.
Allah dayaawaan hai aur apne daya karne waale bande par daya karta hai. Yeh daraasal bande ko usi koti ka badla dene ka ek udaahran hai, jis koti ka uska karm hai.
Logon par daya karne ke antargat unka bhala karna, unko buraai se bachaana aur unke saath achchha vyavhaar karna bhi shaamil hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5440: Jo daya nahin karta, uspar daya nahin ki jaati.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hasan bin ali (radiyallahu anhuma) ka chunban liya. Us samay aapke paas aqra bin haabis baithe hue the. Unhonne kahaah mujhe das putr hain, lekin mainne aaj tak unmen se kisi ka chunban nahin liya hai. Yeh sun aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unki or dekha aur pharmayaah “Jo daya nahin karta, uspar daya nahin ki jaati.”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5442: Jo vyakti hamaari masjidon ya baazaaron se guzre tatha uske haath mein teer ho to uske phal ko achchhi tarah pakar le ya uske phal ko apni muththi mein daba le, taaki aisa na ho ki kisi musalmaan ko uski nok lag jaye.

Abu moosa ashaari (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah “Jo vyakti hamaari masjidon ya baazaaron se guzre tatha uske haath mein teer ho to uske phal ko achchhi tarah pakar le ya uske phal ko apni muththi mein daba le, taaki aisa na ho ki kisi musalmaan ko uski nok lag jaye.”

Jo masjidon, baazaaron tatha musalmaanon ke ekatr hone ke sthaanon se guzre aur uske paas koi hathiyaar jaise teer aadi ho, to use achchhi tarah pakar kar rakhe, taaki usse kisi musalmaan ko koi aaghaat na ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5443: Jo vyakti apni raat ki poori namaz ya uska kuchh bhaag parhe bina so jaye, phir praatah uthkar phajr tatha zuhar ke beech parh le, use aisa likha jayega, jaise usne use raat hi mein parhi ho.

Umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka farmaan haih “Jo vyakti apni raat ki poori namaz ya uska kuchh bhaag parhe bina so jaye, phir praatah uthkar phajr tatha zuhar ke beech parh le, use aisa likha jayega, jaise usne use raat hi mein parhi ho.”
5445: Unmen se kuchh aise honge jinke takhnon tak aag pahoonchegi, to kuchh logon ke ghutnon tak aur kuchh ke kamar tak. Waheen kuchh log aise bhi honge, jinki hansli tak ag pahunch rahi hogi.

Samura bin jundub (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah "Unmen se kuchh aise honge jinke takhnon tak aag pahoonchegi, to kuchh logon ke ghutnon tak aur kuchh ke kamar tak. Waheen kuchh log aise bhi honge, jinki hansli tak ag pahunch rahi hogi."

Yeh hadees qayaamat ke din tatha Jahannam ki yaatna se bhay karna sikhaati hai. Ismen bataya gaya hai ki qayaamat ke din aag kuchh logon ke takhnon tak pahunchegi, kuchh logon ke ghutnon tak pahunchegi, kuchh logon ki kamar tak pahunchegi aur kuchh logon ki gardan tak pahunchegi. Daraasal, log duniya mein kiye hue apne karm ke anusaar alag-alag shreni ki yaatna ka saamna kar rahe honge.
5446: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne paani ka ek bartan mangvaya, to aapke paas ek bara pyaala laya gaya, jismen thora-sa paani tha. So, aapne usmen apni oongliyaan daal deen.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki ek baar namaz ka samay hua, to jin logon ke ghar nikat the, we (wazu karne ke liye) apne gharon ki or chal diye aur kuchh log rah gae. Aapke paas patthar ka ek bartan laya gaya, jo itna chhota tha ki usmen aap apni hatheli bhi nahin phaila sakte the. (Lekin phir bhi) usse sab logon ne wazu kar liya. Prashn kiya gaya ki (us samay) aap kitne log the? Pharmayaah assi (80) se kuchh zyaada.
Aur doosri riwayat mein hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne paani ka ek bartan mangvaya, to aapke paas ek bara pyaala laya gaya, jismen thora-sa paani tha. So, aapne usmen apni oongliyaan daal deen. Anas (radiyallahu anhu) pharmaate hain main paani ki or dekhne laga, jo aapki ungliyon ke beech se nikal raha tha aur mere anumaan ke anusaar us (ek pyaala paani) se sattar se assi logon ne wazu kiya.
[iski wibhinn riwayton ko Bukhari evn Muslim ne naqal kiya hai.]
5447: Kya hi achchha saalan sirka hai! Kya hi achchha saalan sirka hai!

Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apne ghar waalon se saalan maanga, to unhonne kaha ki hamaare paas sirka ke siwa kuchh nahin hai. Aapne use hi mangva liya. Aap usse khaane lage aur kahne lageh “Kya hi achchha saalan sirka hai! Kya hi achchha saalan sirka hai!”
5449: Do nemten aisi hain ki unmen bahut-se log ghaata uthaate hain : Svaasthy tatha phursat ke kshan.

Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Do nemten aisi hain ki unmen bahut-se log ghaata uthaate hain : Svaasthy tatha phursat ke kshan."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is hadees mein insaan ko mili hui Allah ki do mahatvapoorn nemton ke baare mein baat ki hai, jinke ghalat istemaal ke kaaran adhiktar log unke baare mein ghaate mein rahte hain. Kyonki jab insaan ke paas svaasthy evn khaali samay donon rahte hain, to uspar neki ke kaamon mein susti haawi ho jaati hai aur is tarah woh ghaata uthaane waala siddh hota hai. Aksar yahi dekhne ko milta hai. Lekin, agar donon ka prayog neki ke kaamon mein kar leta hai, to laabh uthaane waala siddh hota hai. Kyonki duniya aakhirat ki kheti hai. Duniya mein jo tijaarat hoti hai, uska laabh aakhirat mein dekhne ko milta hai. Khaali samay ke baad vyastata a jaati hai aur svaasthy ke baad beemaari. Agar aisa na bhi ho, to burhaapa a jaata hai aur uske baad zyaada kuchh baaqi nahin rah jaata.

Yahaan shareeyat ka paalan karne mein saksham vyakti ko vyaavsayik tatha svaasthy evn khaali samay ko poonji ka samaan kaha gaya hai. Atah jo vyakti apni poonji ka behtar prayog karta hai, woh fayde mein rahta hai aur jo vyakti poonji ko nasht kar deta hai, woh ghaate mein rahta hai aur sharmindgi ka saamna karta hai.
Ibne khaazin ne kaha hai:  Nemat (Allah ka anugrah) woh hai jiska manushy aanand leta hai aur jisse use sukh praapt hota hai. Waheen, 'ghabn' (vyaapaarik ghaata) yeh hai ki koi vyakti kisi wastu ko uski asli keemat se kai guna adhik mein khareede, ya use uske uchit mooly se kam par bech de. Isliye, jis vyakti ka shareer svasth hai aur jo saansaarik ulajhnon se mukt hone ke baavjood apni aakhirat sanwaarne ka prayaas nahin karta, to woh us vyakti ke samaan hai jisne len-den (vyaapaar) mein bhaari ghaata uthaya ho.
Svaasthy ev khaali samay ko ghaneemat jaankar Allah ki nikatta praapt karne aur neki ke kaam karne ka prayaas karna chahiye.
Allah ki nemton ka shukr yeh hai ki unhen Allah ke bandgi mein istemaal kiya jaye.
Qaazi aur abu bakr ibn-e-arbi kahte hain : Bande par Allah ki pahli nemat kaun-si hai, is wishay mein wibhinn mat paye jaate hain. Kuchh logon ke anusaar pahli nemat eemaan hai, kuchh logon ke anusaar jeewan hai aur kuchh logon ke anusaar svaasthy. Waise, pahla mat adhik uttam hai. Kyonki eemaan ek aam nemat hai, jabki jeewan evn svaasthy saansaarik nemten hain aur ye donon haqeeqi nemat usi samay ban sakti hain, jab eemaan se juri hui hon. Sachchaai yeh hai ki in donon nemton ke wishay mein bahut-se log ghaate mein rahte hain. Yaani ye donon nemten ya to laabh wiheen ho jaati hain ya inka laabh ghat jaata hai. Jisne buraai ka aadesh dene waale aur aaraam wa raahat ki or jhukaav rakhne waale nafs ka anusran kiya, Allah ki or se nirdhaarit seemaaon ka paalan nahin kiya aur neki ke kaamon mein susti ki, woh ghaate mein raha. Isi tarah, jab fursat ke pal uplabdh rahe aur unka laabh nahin uthaya, to nuqsaan mein raha. Kyonki vyast vyakti ke paas vyastata ka bahaana hota hai, jiske aadhaar par use aksham samjha ja sakta hai. Lekin khaali samay waale ko to aksham nahin samjha ja sakta, isliye uspar daleel qayam ho jayegi.
5450: Tummen se koi bhi khare hokar na piye, jo bhoolvash aisa kar baithe, woh ulti kar de.

Anas (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne khare hokar peene se mana kiya hai.
Qataada kahte hainh hamne anas (radiyallahu anhu) se prashn kiya ki khare hokar khaana khaana kaisa hai? To unhonne uttar diyaah yeh to aur bura hai ya aur gandi baat hai.
Ek riwayat mein hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne khare hokar peene se daanta hai.
Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh “Tummen se koi khare hokar (paani) na piye. Jo bhoolvash aisa kar baithe, woh ulti kar de.”
[ise imaam Muslim ne donon riwayton ke saath naqal kiya hai.]
5451: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne mashak ya ghare mein munh lagaakar paani peene se mana kiya hai.
Abu huraira evn abdullah bin abbaas (raziyallaaु anhuma) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne mashak ya ghare mein munh lagaakar paani peene se mana kiya hai.”
[ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5452: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne mashkon ka munh morkar unse paani peene se mana kiya hai.
Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne mashkon ka munh morkar unse paani peene se mana kiya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5453: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pi jaane waali wastu mein phoonk maarne se mana kiya hai.

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pi jaane waali wastu mein phoonk maarne se mana kiya hai. Ek vyakti ne kaha ki yadi main bartan mein koi tinka dekhoon to kya karoon? Aapne farmayaah "Usko baha do." Usne kahaah main ek saans mein tript nahin ho paata? To aapne farmayaah "To phir bartan ko apne munh se door kar lo."
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise maalik ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5454: Us zaat (Allah) ki qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, yadi tum log gunaah na karo, to Allah tumhaara winaash karke aise logon ko le aye, jo gunaah karen aur uske baad Allah se maafi maangen, to Allah unhen maaf kare.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh “Us zaat (Allah) ki qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, yadi tum log gunaah na karo, to Allah tumhaara winaash karke aise logon ko le aye, jo gunaah karen aur uske baad Allah se maafi maangen, to Allah unhen maaf kare.”

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne paalanhaar ki qasam khaate hue kaha hai ki yadi tum log gunaah na karo, to Allah tumhaara winaash kar de aur aise logon ko le aye, jo gunaah karne ke baad sachchi neeyat aur poore wishvaas ke saath Allah se kshama maangen, taaki Allah unhen maaf kar de.
5456: He aadam ke putr! Jab tak tu mujhe pukaarta rahega tatha mujhse aasha rakhega, main tere paapon ko kshama karta rahoonga, chaahe woh jitne bhi hon, main uski parvaah nahin karoonga.

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain: Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko farmaate hue suna : “Uchch evn barkat waala Allah pharmaata hai : He aadam ke putr! Jab tak tu mujhe pukaarta rahega tatha mujhse aasha rakhega, main tere paapon ko kshama karta rahoonga, chaahe woh jitne bhi hon, main uski parvaah nahin karoonga. He aadam ke putr! Yadi tere paap aakaash ki oonchaaiyon ke samaan ho jayen, phir tu mujhse kshama yaachna kare, to main tujhe kshama kar doonga aur mujhe iski koi parvaah nahin hai. He aadam ke putr! Yadi tu mere paas dharti ke samaan paap lekar is haal mein aye ki tumne mere saath kisi ko saajhi nahin kiya tha, to main tere paas dharti ke samaan kshama lekar aaunga."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki Allah ne ek hadees-e-qudsi mein kaha hai : Ai aadam ki santaan, jab tak tu mujhe pukaarta rahega, meri daya ki aasha lagaye rahega aur niraash nahin hoga, main kisi baat ki parvaah kiye bina tere gunaah par parda daalta rahoonga aur use mitaata rahoonga. Chaahe yeh gunaah kabeera gunaah hi kyon na ho. Ai aadam ki santaan, agar tere gunaah itne zyaada bhi ho jayen ki aakaash evn dharti ke beech ke khaali sthaan ko bhar dete hon aur uske baad bhi tu mujhse kshama praarthi ho jaye, to main gunaahon ki prachurta ki koi parvaah kiye bina tujhe kshama kar doonga.

Ai aadam ki santaan, agar tu maut ke baad mere paas is awastha mein aye ki tere gunaahon evn awajnaaon se dharti bhari hui ho aur tu ekeshvarvaadi bankar mrityu ko praapt hua ho, to main un gunaahon evn awajnaaon ke muqaable mein dharti bharkar kshama lekar upasthit rahoonga. Kyonki meri kshama bari wrihad hai. Main shirk ko chhorkar saare gunaahon ko kshama kar doonga.

Rvashaktimaan Allah ki daya, kshama aur anugrah ki wishaalta.
Tauheed ki fazeelat aur yeh ki Allah tauheed ki raah par chalne waalon ke gunaah maaf kar deta hai.
Shirk ki haani aur yeh ki Allah shirk karne waalon ko kshama nahin karega.
Ibn-e-rajab kahte hain : Is hadees mein gunaahon ki kshama ke teen sabab bayaan kiye gae hain. Pahla- aasha ke saath dua. Doosra- kshama maangna aur tauba karna. Teesra- tauheed ke maarg par chalte hue marna.
Yeh hadees un hadeeson mein se hai, jo Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne rab se riwayat karke kaha hai. Is tarah ki hadees ko hadees-e-qudsi ya hadees-e-ilaahi kaha jaata hai. Isse muraad woh hadees hai, jiske shabd tatha arth donon Allah ke hon. Albatta iske andar Qur'an ki wisheshtayen, jaise uski tilaawat ka ibaadat hona, uske liye tahaarat praapt karna tatha uska chamatkaar hona aadi, nahin paai jaati.
Gunaahon ke teen prakaar hain : 1- Allah ka shareek (saajhi) thahraana. Ise Allah kshama nahin karega. Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : "Jo kisi ko Allah ka shareek thahrayega, Allah ne uspar Jannat haraam kar di hai." 2- banda koi aisa gunaah kare, jiska sanbandh usse aur uske rab se ho. Allah chaahe to is tarah ke gunaahon ko maaf kar dega. 3- aise gunaah jinmen se Allah kuchh nahin chhorta. Yaani bandon ka ek doosre par atyaachaar karna. Yahaan qisaas (badla) zaroori hai.
5457: Ai jibreel, Muhammad ke paas jaao aur bata do ki ham aapko aapki ummat ke baare mein prasann kar denge aur aapko naaraaz nahin hone denge.

Abdullah bin amr (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ibraaheem (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke wishay mein Allah taaala ke is farmaan ki tilaawat keeh {mere rab! Inhonne (in murtiyon ne) bahut se logon ko pathabhrasht kiya hai. Atah jis kisi ne mera anusran kiya, woh mera hai aur jisne meri awajna ki, to nishchay hi tu bara kshamaasheel, atyant dayaawaan hai.} [soora ibraaheemah 36] tatha eesa (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke is kathan ki tilaawat keeh {yadi tu unhen yaatna de, to we to tere bande hi hain aur yadi tu unhen kshama kar de, to nihsandeh tu atyanat prabhutvashaali, tatvadarshi hai.} [soora al-maaidaah 118] phir aapne apna haath uthaya aur dua keeh "Ai Allah, meri ummat! Meri ummat!" Phir rone lage. Tab Allah taaala farmayaah “Ai jibri, Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas jaao aur unse poochho ki aapko kaun-si baat rula rahi hai? (Haalaanki Allah usse bhali-bhaanti avgat hai.) chunaanche jibreel aapke paas aye, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen woh baat bata di, jo aapne kahi thi (aur Allah bhi usse bhali-bhaanti avgat hai). Tab Allah taaala ne farmayaah “Ai jibreel, Muhammad ke paas jaao aur bata do ki ham aapko aapki ummat ke baare mein prasann kar denge aur aapko naaraaz nahin hone denge.”
5458: Main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas se gujra. Us samay meri lungi rheeli hokar neeche latak chuki thi. Atah, aapne farmayaah ai abdullah, apni lungi oopar uthaao. Mainne use oopar uthaya, to aapne phir farmayaah aur uthaao. Chunaanche mainne aur utha liya. Uske pashchaat main sarvada iska dhyaan rakhta hoon. Kisi ne poochha ki aapko kahaan tak lungi uthaane ka aadesh mila tha? To kahaah aadhi pindliyon tak.

Ibne umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas se gujra. Us samay meri lungi rheeli hokar neeche latak chuki thi. Atah, aapne farmayaah ai abdullah, apni lungi oopar uthaao. Mainne use oopar uthaya, to aapne phir farmayaah aur uthaao. Chunaanche mainne aur utha liya. Uske pashchaat main sarvada iska dhyaan rakhta hoon. Kisi ne poochha ki aapko kahaan tak lungi uthaane ka aadesh mila tha? To kahaah aadhi pindliyon tak.
5459: Pratyek banda (mutyu pashchaat) usi awastha mein uthaya jayega, jismen uski mrityu hui thi.

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Pratyek banda (mutyu pashchaat) usi awastha mein uthaya jayega, jismen uski mrityu hui thi.”
Qayaamat ke din har insaan ko usi awastha mein uthaya jayega, jis awastha mein uski mrityu hui thi.
5460: Log qayaamat (maha pralay) ke din nange paanv, nange shareer tatha bina khatna kiye hue uthaye jayenge.

Mominon ki maata aaisha (raziyallaaु anha) se riwayat hai, woh kahti hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue sunaah “Log qayaamat (maha pralay) ke din nange paanv, nange shareer tatha bina khatna kiye hue uthaye jayenge.” mainne prashn kiyaah he Allah ke Rasool, mahila tatha puroosh ek saath honge, to ek-doosre ko dekhenge? Aapne farmayaah “Ai aaisha, maamla isse kaheen sangeen hoga ki log ek-doosre ko dekhen.”
Ek riwayat mein is prakaar haih “Maamla ek-doosre ko dekhne se adhik sangeen hoga.”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5461: Pawitr evn sarvashaktimaan Allah aise do aadmiyon ko dekhkar hansta hai, jinmen se ek vyakti doosre ko qatl karta hai aur (phir bhi) donon Jannat mein prawesh kar jaate hain. Unmen se ek to Allah ki raah mein larta hua shaheed hota hai tatha qaatil ko Allah tauba ki taufeeq deta hai aur woh musalmaan ho jaata hai tatha (baad mein) shaheed ho jaata hai.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Pawitr evn sarvashaktimaan Allah aise do aadmiyon ko dekhkar hansta hai, jinmen se ek vyakti doosre ko qatl karta hai aur (phir bhi) donon Jannat mein prawesh kar jaate hain. Unmen se ek to Allah ki raah mein larta hua shaheed hota hai tatha qaatil ko Allah tauba ki taufeeq deta hai aur woh musalmaan ho jaata hai tatha (baad mein) shaheed ho jaata hai.”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5462: Log saare sansaar ke paalanhaar ke samaksh khare honge, yahaan tak ki unmen se kuchh log apne aadhe kaanon tak paseene mein doobe hue honge.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah “Log saare sansaar ke paalanhaar ke samaksh khare honge, yahaan tak ki unmen se kuchh log apne aadhe kaanon tak paseene mein doobe hue honge.”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5463: Us din Jahannam laai jayegi, jiski sattar hazaar lagaamen hongi aur pratyek lagaam ko sattar hazaar pharishte kheench rahe honge.

Abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh “Us din Jahannam laai jayegi, jiski sattar hazaar lagaamen hongi aur pratyek lagaam ko sattar hazaar pharishte kheench rahe honge.”
Qayaamat ke din Jahannam ko laya jayega, to use sattar hazaar rassiyon se baandhkar rakha gaya hoga aur har rassi ko sattar-sattar hazaar farishte pakre hue honge.
5469: Ai Allah, tu saad ko rog mukt kar de! Ai Allah, tu saad ko rog mukt kar de!

Saad bin abu wakkaas (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) mera haal jaanne aye aur farmayaah “Ai Allah, tu saad ko rog mukt kar de! Ai Allah, tu saad ko rog mukt kar de!”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai aur shabd Muslim ke hain.]
5470: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- sajde ki haalat mein yeh dua kiya karte the : “He Allah, tu mere samast paapon ko kshama kar de; chhote-bare, agle-pichhle tatha spasht-aspasht sabhi ko.”

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- sajde ki haalat mein yeh dua kiya karte the : “He Allah, tu mere samast paapon ko kshama kar de; chhote-bare, agle-pichhle tatha spasht-aspasht sabhi ko.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam sajde mein yeh dua kiya karte the : "اللهم اغفر لي ذنبي" Yaani ai Allah! Mere saare gunaahon ko kshama kar de, unpar parda daal de aur mujhe unke kuprabhaawon se bachaye rakh. "كله" Saare gunaah, "دِقّه" Chhote aur kam gunaah "وجِلّه" Tatha bare aur adhik gunaah "وأوله" Pahle gunaah, "وآخره" Antim gunaah aur beech ke saare gunaah "علانيته وسره" Khule aur chhupe gunaah, jinhen tere siwa koi nahin jaanta.

Ibn-e-qaiyim kahte hain : Chhote aur bare, kam aur zyaada, pahle aur baad ke tatha chhupe aur khule tamaam gunaahon se vyaapak andaaz mein kshama isliye maangi gai hai, taaki sabhi gunaahon se tauba ho jaye. Banda jinhen jaanta hai unse bhi aur jinhen nahin jaanta unse bhi.
Kaha gaya hai : Aapne 'الجِلّ' se pahle 'الدِّق' ka zikr isliye kiya hai ki maangne waala maangte samay darja-ba-darja aage barhta hai. Doosri baat yeh hai ki bare gunaah aam taur par chhote gunaahon par aagrah evn unke baare mein laaparvaahi ke nateeje hi mein saamne aate hain. Isliye ham kah sakte hain ki chhote paap hi bare paapon ka zariya hain aur zariya ka zikr pahle kiya jaana chahiye.
Insaan ko winamrata ke saath Allah se chhote-bare sabhi paapon ke liye kshama maangni chahiye.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees mein baar-baar dua karne aur dua ke shabdon ka adhik se adhik istemaal karne ki prerna di gai hai, yadyapi uske kuchh shabd kuchh se beniyaaz kar dete hon.
5471: He Allah, tu mere paapon ko kshama kar de, jo kuchh bhi mainne pahle kiya ya baad mein kiya, chhipaakar kiya ya dikhaakar kiya.

Ali bin abu taalib (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab namaz ke liye khare hote, to sabse ant mein tashahhud aur salaam ke beech mein yeh dua parhte theh “He Allah, tu mere paapon ko kshama kar de, jo kuchh bhi mainne pahle kiya ya baad mein kiya, chhipaakar kiya ya dikhaakar kiya, jo kuchh mainne zyaadti ki aur jo tu mujhse bhi behtar jaanta hai. Tu hi aage karne waala aur tu hi peechhe karne waala hai. Tere siwa koi poojy nahin”.
5472: Ai Allah, tu mujhe maaph kar de aur mujhpar daya kar tatha mujhe rafeeq-e- aala (nabiyon, shaheedon, siddeeqon tatha nek logon) se mila de.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) farmaati hain ki mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko us samay yeh dua parhte hue suna, jab aap mere shareer par tek lagaye hue theh “Ai Allah, tu mujhe maaf kar de aur mujhpar daya kar tatha mujhe rafeeq-e-aala (nabiyon, shaheedon, siddeeqon tatha nek logon) se mila de.”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5473: Ai Allah, ham tujhe unke muqaable mein pesh karte hain aur unki badmaashiyon se teri panaah chaahte hain.

Abu moosa ashaari (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab kisi qaum se bhay khaate, to yeh dua parhteh “Ai Allah, ham tujhe unke muqaable mein pesh karte hain aur unki badmaashiyon se teri panaah chaahte hain.”
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5474: ”Allah ke paas sabse ghrinit vyakti woh hai, jo atyadhik jhagraalu tatha hamesha wiwaad mein rahne waala ho.”

Aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : ”Allah ke paas sabse ghrinit vyakti woh hai, jo atyadhik jhagraalu tatha hamesha wiwaad mein rahne waala ho.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alauैhi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah bahut zyaada jhagra karne waale vyakti se ghrina karta hai, jo sach se sahmat na hota ho aur use apni baat se nakaarne ka prayaas karta ho, ya phir jhagarta to saty ke liye ho, lekin jhagra karte samay saari seemayen laangh jaata ho, aur kisi wishay mein jnaan na hone par bhi waad-wiwaad kare.

Peerit vyakti ka sharai tareeqe se adaalat mein jaakar apna adhikaar maangna nindneey jhagre ke dayre mein nahin aata.
Waad-wiwaad aur jhagra zabaan ki  kleshon mein se ek hai, jo musalmaanon ke beech wibhaajan aur rishton ke kharaab hone ka kaaran banta hai.
Jhagra agar saty ke liye kiya jaye aur uska tareeqa achchha ho, to achchhi cheez hai. Lekin agar saty ko nakaarne aur asaty ko sthaapit karne ke liye kiya jaye athva bina kisi pramaan ke kiya jaye, to nindneey hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5475: “Allah ke nikat sabse priy waaky chaar hain : Subhaan Allah (Allah paak hai), al-hamdu lillah (samast prakaar ki prashansa Allah hi ke liye hain), la ilaaha illallah (Allah ke atirikt koi sachcha poojy nahin hai) aur Allahu akbar (Allah sabse bara hai). Inmen se jis se chaaho aaranbh karo, haani ki koi baat nahin hai ”

Samura bin jundub radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : “Allah ke nikat sabse priy waaky chaar hain : Subhaan Allah (Allah paak hai), al-hamdu lillah (samast prakaar ki prashansa Allah hi ke liye hain), la ilaaha illallah (Allah ke atirikt koi sachcha poojy nahin hai) aur Allahu akbar (Allah sabse bara hai). Inmen se jis se chaaho aaranbh karo, haani ki koi baat nahin hai ”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki Allah ke nikat sabse priy waaky chaar hain :

Subhaan Allah : Iska arth hai Allah ko har kami se pawitr ghoshit karna.

Al-hamdu lillah : Iska matlab hai Allah ko har etbaar se sanpoorn bataana, usse prem rakhna aur uska sammaan karna.

La ilaaha illallah : Iska arth yeh hai ki Allah ke atirikt koi sachcha poojy nahin hai.

Allahu akbar : Allah sabse shaktishaali, sabse mahaan aur sabse saamarthyawaan hai.

In waakyon ki fazeelat tatha inke sawaab ki praapti ke liye inko hadees mein ullikhit karm ke anusaar kahna aniwaary nahin hai.
Islaami shareeyat ek aasaan shareeyat hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki is baat ki anumti di gai hai ki in chaar shabdon mein se jisse chaahen aaranbh kar sakte hain.
5476: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochha gaya ki kaun-si cheez logon ko Jannat mein sabse adhik prawesh karayegi, to aapne kaha : “Allah ka dar aur achchha vyavhaar

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochha gaya ki kaun-si cheez logon ko Jannat mein sabse adhik prawesh karayegi, to aapne kaha : “Allah ka dar aur achchha vyavhaar.” isi tarah aapse poochha gaya ki kaun-si cheez logon ko Jahannam mein sabse adhik prawesh karayegi, to aapne kaha : “Munh aur guptaang.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki Jannat mein prawesh milne ke sabse bare kaaran do hain. Yeh donon kaaran hain :

Allah ka bhay aur achchha vyavhaar.

Hadees ke shabd "تقوى الله" Ka arth yeh hai ki aap apne tatha Allah ke azaab ke beech aar bana len. Yeh aar Allah ke aadeshon ka paalan karne aur uski mana ki hui cheezon se bachne se banti hai.

Jabki achchhe vyavhaar ka matlab hai, hanskar milna, bhala karna aur kasht na hone dena.

Iske wipreet insaan ke Jahannam jaane ke sabse bare kaaran do hain. Yeh donon kaaran hain :

Zabaan aur guptaang.

Zabaan se jhooth, gheebat aur chugli jaise gunaah hote hain.

Jabki guptaang se vyabhichaar aur samlaingik sanbandh aadi gunaah hote hain.

Jannat mein prawesh ki praapti ke kuchh saadhan Allah se jure hue hain, jinmen se ek Allah ka bhay hai, jabki kuchh kaaran logon se jure hue hain, jinmen se ek achchha vyavhaar hai.
Insaan ke liye zabaan ka khatra aur uska Jahannam jaane ka ek kaaran hona.
Insaan ke liye waasnaaon aur nirlajjata ka khatra aur unka Jahannam jaane ka ek bara kaaran hona.
[ise tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5477: Shesh rahne waali nek cheezen hainh la ilaaha illallah (Allah ke siwa koi sachcha poojy nahin hai), subhaan Allah (Allah paak hai), Allahu akbar (Allah sabse bara hai) al-hamdulillah (samast prakaar ki prashansa Allah hi ke liye hai) tatha la haula wa la quvvata illa billah (Allah ki madad bina na haalaat badalne ki taaqat hai aur na kuchh karne ka saahas).

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Shesh rahne waali nek cheezen hainh la ilaaha illallah (Allah ke siwa koi sachcha poojy nahin hai), subhaan Allah (Allah paak hai), Allahu akbar (Allah sabse bara hai) al-hamdulillah (samast prakaar ki prashansa Allah hi ke liye hai) tatha la haula wa la quvvata illa billah (Allah ki madad bina na haalaat badalne ki taaqat hai aur na kuchh karne ka saahas).”
[ise ibne hibbaan ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise haakim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5478: Lajja eemaan ka ek ansh hai

Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ek vyakti ko apne bhaai ko lajja ke baare mein samjhaate hue suna, to farmaya : "Lajja eemaan ka ek ansh hai.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ek vyakti ko apne bhaai ko adhik lajja na karne ki naseehat karte hue suna, to use bataya lajja eemaan ka ek ang hai aur is se bhala hi hota hai.

Lajja ek maanav vyavhaar hai, jo sundar kaary karne aur galat kaary ko chhorne ki prerna deta hai.

Jo svabhaav achchhe kaam se roke, use lajja nahin, apitu sharmeelaapan, wiwashta, kamzori aur kayarta kaha jayega.
Lajja sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ki or se praapt hone waali ek cheez hai, jo Allah ke aadeshon ka paalan karne aur uski mana ki hui cheezon se door rahne mein sahayak hoti hai.
Logon se haya karne ka matlab hai, unko sammaan tatha uchit sthaan dena aur aam taur par jo cheezen buri samjhi jaati hain, unse door rahna.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5479: Azaan tatha iqaamat ke beech ki jaane waali dua radd nahin hoti.
Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Azaan tatha iqaamat ke beech ki jaane waali dua radd nahin hoti."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne azaan aur iqaamat ke beech ki jaane waali dua ki fazeelat bayaan ki hai aur bataya hai ki is samay ki jaane waali dua is layaq hai ki qabool ho jaye. Atah is samay Allah se dua kiya karo.

Is samay dua karne ki fazeelat.
Dua karne waala jab dua ke aadaab ka paalan kare, dua qabool hone ke sthaanon evn samyon ka lihaaz karte hue dua kare, Allah ki awajna se door rahe, sandeh mein daalne waali jaghon mein qadam rakhne se bache aur Allah ke prati achchha gumaan rakhe, to yadi eeshvar ki ichchha ho to   uski dua qabool kar liye jaane ke layeq hoti hai.
Munaawi dua qabool hone ke baare mein kahte hain : Dua us samay qabool hoti hai, jab uski sharton, stanbhon aur aadaab ka khyaal rakha jaye. Agar inmen se kisi cheez ka khyaal nahin rakha gaya, to insaan khud apne aapko kose.
Dua qabool hone ka matlab yeh hai ki ya to insaan ko uski maangi hui cheez de di jaye ya usse uske samaan buraai door kar di jaye ya phir use uski aakhirat ke liye jama karke rakh diya jaye. Yeh sab kuchh Allah ki hikmat aur uski kripa ke anusaar hota hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi aur nasai ne riwayat kiya hai]
5482: Ai Allah! Mere liye mere dharm ko sudhaar de, jo mere maamle ka sanrakshan hai

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Ai Allah! Mere liye mere dharm ko sudhaar de, jo mere maamle ka sanrakshan hai aur mere liye meri duniya ko sudhaar de, jiske andar meri jeewika hai, aur mere liye meri aakhirat ko sudhaar de, jahaan mujhe lautna hai. Tatha mere liye jeewan ko pratyek bhalaai mein wriddhi ka kaaran bana de aur mrityu ko mere liye pratyek buraai se moksh ka kaaran bana de."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ek dua farmaai, jismen un tamaam naitik moolyon ko ekatr kar diya gaya, jinko sanpoorn roop dene ke liye aapko bheja gaya tha. Ye naitik mooly hain, deen, duniya evn aakhirat teenon ka durust ho jaana. Aapne sankshipt shabdon mein teenon mein sudhaar ki dua maangne ka tareeqa sikha diya. Usmen bhi aaranbh deen se kiya, kyonki usi se donon jahaanon ki sudhaar evn saphalta juri hui hai. Aapne kaha :

"Ai Allah! Mere liye mere dharm ko sudhaar de." Wo is prakaar ki mujhe islaami aadaab ka paalan karne ka  sampoorn tareeke se suyog pradaan kar.

"Jisse meri har prakaar ki suraksha juri hui hai."  Kyonki mera deen nasht ho gaya to maano mera sab kuchh nasht ho gaya aur main naakaam wa naamuraad ho gaya. Saath hi yeh ki deen ki waanchhit durustagi bhi duniya ki durustagi ke bina sanbhav nahin hai. Isliye aapne farmaya :

"Mere liye meri duniya ko durust kar de." Is tarah ki mujhe svaasthy, shaanti, rozi, nek patni, sadaachaari santaan aur zaroorat bhar halaal cheezen pradaan kar, jinse teri ibaadat mein madad mile. Phir duniya ki durustagi ki dua maangne ki wajah bayaan karte hue farmaya :

"Wahi duniya jis mein mera jeewan hai." Jismen mujhe jeena hai aur jeewan kaal bitaana hai.

"Mere liye meri aakhirat ko durust kar de." Jahaan lautkar mujhe jaana hai aur tujhse milna hai. Lekin yeh usi samay sanbhav ho payega, jab karm achchhe hon aur Allah ki or se bande ko ibaadat, nishtha aur achchhe ant ka suyog praapt ho.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aakhirat ka zikr duniya ke baad isliye kiya ki duniya ka durust ho jaana aakhirat ke durust ho jaane ka maadhyam hai. Jisne duniya ka jeewan Allah ki marzi ke anusaar ji liya, uski aakhirat sanwar gai.

(Aur tu sabab bana duniya ke jeewan ko) aur umr ki lambaai ko (mere liye har bhalaai mein wriddhi ka) ki main usmen adhik se adhik neki ke kaam kar sakoon. (Aur tu saadhan bana maut ko) aur us mein jaldi ko (mere liye har buraai se chhutkaara paane ka) yaani fitna, pareeksha, awajna tatha achetna se raahat, shaanti ki praapti tatha duniya aur uski ulajhnon se chhutkaare ka saadhan bana de.

Deen sabse mahatvapoorn cheez hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apni dua isi se shuru ki.
Deen insaan ke liye suraksha kawach hai. Jo use har buraai se rokta hai.
Deen evn aakhirat ke hit mein saansaarik cheezon ki dua ki ja sakti hai.
Deen ke sanbandh mein kisi fitne mein par jaane ke dar se maut ki tamanna karna ya shahaadat ki maut naapsandeeda nahin hai.
5483: Ai Allah! Mere gunaah, meri ajnaanta, apne sabhi kaaryon mein mere seema ka ullanghan karne ko aur har us baat ko, jise tu mujhse zyaada jaanta hai, kshama kar de. Ai Allah! Mere gunaahon, mujhse jaan-boojhkar hone waali kotaahiyon, anjaane mein hone waali ghaltiyon aur hansi-mazaaq mein hone waali trutiyon ko kshama kar de. Inmen se har prakaar ki trutiyaan mujhse hui hain. Ai Allah! Mere agle aur pichhle, chhipaakar hone waale aur dikhaakar hone waale gunaahon ko kshama kar de. Tu hi aage karne waala hai, tu hi peechhe karne waala hai aur tu har baat ki kshamta rakhne waala hai.

Abu moosa radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam yeh dua kiya karte the : "Ai Allah! Mere gunaah, meri ajnaanta, apne sabhi kaaryon mein mere seema ka ullanghan karne ko aur har us baat ko, jise tu mujhse zyaada jaanta hai, kshama kar de. Ai Allah! Mere gunaahon, mujhse jaan-boojhkar hone waali kotaahiyon, anjaane mein hone waali ghaltiyon aur hansi-mazaaq mein hone waali trutiyon ko kshama kar de. Inmen se har prakaar ki trutiyaan mujhse hui hain. Ai Allah! Mere agle aur pichhle, chhipaakar hone waale aur dikhaakar hone waale gunaahon ko kshama kar de. Tu hi aage karne waala hai, tu hi peechhe karne waala hai aur tu har baat ki kshamta rakhne waala hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki ek bahut hi saargarbhit dua is prakaar hai :

Yaani ai Allah! Mere gunaahon aur mujhse ajnaanta mein hone waali trutiyon ko kshama kar de.

Aur mere sabhi maamlon mein meri laaparvaahi aur mere dvaara kiye gae seema ke ullanghan kshama kar de.

Aur ai Allah! Mere un gunaahon ko bhi kshama kar de, jinhen tu mujh se zyaada jaanta hai, ai Allah! Jinhen tu jaanta hai aur main bhool chuka hoon.

Aur ai Allah! Meri ghaltiyon ko kshama kar de aur  un gunaahon ko bhi ko kshama kar de, jo mainne jaan-boojhkar ki hain.

Aur mere un gunaahon ko bhi ko kshama kar de jo mainne sanjeegdi se ya hansi-mazaaq mein kiye hain.

Yahaan bayaan kiye gae tamaam tarah ke gunaah aur trutiyaan mere andar maujood hain.

Ai Allah! Mere un gunaahon ko kshama kar de, jo mainne ab tak kiye hain aur un gunaahon ko bhi jo mujh se  aane waale dinon mein hone waale hain.

Unko bhi jo main ne chhupaakar kiye hain aur jo khuleaam kiye hain.

"Tu hi aage karne waala hai aur tu hi peechhe karne waala hai." Yaani tu apne jis bande ko chaahe apni priy cheezon ka suyog pradaan karke apni kripa ki or aage kar deta hai aur jis bande ko chaahe akela chhorkar isse peechhe kar deta hai. Tu jise peechhe kar de use koi aage nahin le ja sakta aur jise aage le jaye use koi peechhe nahin la sakta.

"Tu har cheez par saamarthy rakhta hai" Yaani tu sanpoorn prabhutv  ka maalik aur sanpoorn iraade waala hai. Jo chaahe kar sakta hai.

Is dua ki bari fazeelat hai aur Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka anusran karte hue ise parhte rahna chahiye.
Seema ka ullanghan karna mana hai aur seema ka ullanghan karne waale ko dand ka saamna karna par sakta hai.
Allah insaan ke baare mein khud usse bhi zyaada jaanta hai. Isliye insaan ko chahiye ki apne maamlaat Allah ke hawaale kar de, kyonki insaan kabhi-kabhi anjaane mein bhi ghaltiyaan kar daalta hai.
Jis tarah insaan ko sanjeedgi se kiye gae gunaahon ka jawaabdeh thahraya jayega, usi tarah use mazaaq mein kiye gae gunaahon ka bhi jawaabdeh thahraya ja sakta hai. Isliye insaan ko hansi-mazaaq mein bhi saavdhaani baratne ki zaroorat hai.
Ibn-e-hajar asaqlaani kahte hain : Mainne is hadees ke kisi bhi tareeq mein is dua ka sthaan nahin dekha hai. Beshtar tareeqon ke ant mein hai ki aap yeh dua raat ki namaz mein parhte the. Yeh bhi aya hai ki aap ise namaz ke ant mein parhte the. Albatta is baat ko lekar riwayten alag-alag hain ki aap ise salaam se pahle parhte the ya baad mein.
Kya Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam kshama maangne ke liye galti kiya karte the? Kuchh logon ka kahna hai ki aapne yeh baat winamrata ke aadhaar par kahi hai. Aisa bhi ho sakta hai ki aapne poornata praapt na kar paane aur behtar par amal na kar paane ko gunaah maan liya ho. Aisa bhi ho sakta hai ki yahaan muraad aisi cheezen hon, jo bhool ki buniyaad par hui hon ya aapse Nabi banne se pahle hui hon. Kuchh logon ka kahna hai ki Allah se kshama maangna ek ibaadat hai, jise karna waajib hai. Kshama isliye nahin maangi jaati ki kshama praapt hi ki jaye, balki isliye maangi jaati hai ki yeh ek ibaadat hai. Jabki kuchh logon ka kahna hai ki yeh daraasal shiksha dene ka ek tareeqa hai, taaki log kshama maangna chhor na den.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5485: Ai Allah! Main tujhse duniya evn aakhirat mein suraksha maangta hoon.

Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam subah aur shaam ke samay in duaaon ko parhna nahin chhorte the :  "Ai Allah! Main tujhse duniya evn aakhirat mein suraksha maangta hoon. Ai Allah! Main tujhse apne dharm, apne sansaar, apne pariwaar aur apne dhan ke sanbandh mein kshama evn suraksha maangta hoon. Ai Allah! Meri trutiyon ko chhupa de aur mujhe bhay se suraksha pradaan kar. Ai Allah! Tu meri, mere aage, mere peechhe, mere dayen, mere bayen aur mere oopar se raksha kar. Main is baat se teri mahaanta ki sharan mein aata hoon ki mujhe neeche se dhar dabocha jaye."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam subah evn shaam ke samay in duaaon ko parhna nahin bhoolte the :

"Ai Allah! Main tujhse aaphiyat maangta hoon" Evn suraksha maangta hoon buraaiyon, wipattiyon, saansaarik kathinaaiyon, buri aakaankshaaon tatha deeni fitnon se. "Duniya mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi" Yaani is jeewan mein aur aakhirat mein arthaat baad mein.

Ai Allah! Main tujhse gunaahon ko mita diye jaane, maaf kar dene tatha kamiyon evn kotaahiyon se bachaye rakhne ki dua karta hoon. Kamiyaan deen se sanbandhit hon, jaise shirk, bidaat evn gunaah aadi ya duniya se sanbandhit hon, jaise wipattiyaan, kasht evn buraaiyaan. Pariwaar yaani patni, baal bachchon evn rishtedaaron se sannbandhit hon ya dhan evn karm se.

Ai Allah! Meri chhoopi hui baaton, mere aibon, kamiyon aur kotaahiyon par parda daal de aur mere gunaah mita de. Mujhe bhaymukt banaye rakh.

(Ai Allah! Meri raksha kar) aur sabhi kashtadayak cheezon aur wipattiyon ko mujhse door rakh (mere aage se aur peechhe se, mere dayen se aur bayen se, aur mere oopar se), aapne Allah se sabhi dishaaon se apni  raksha karne ke liye dua ki; kyonki museebten aur wipattiyaan vyakti par in dishaaon mein se ek se us tak aati hain.

Aur main is baat se teri mahaanta ki sharan maangta hoon ki neeche ki or se achaanak meri pakar ho jaye aur achetna ki awastha mein winasht ho jaaoon aur anttah main zameen mein dhansa diya jaaoon.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka anukran karte hue in shabdon ko paabandi ke saath kahna chahiye.
Insaan ko jis tarah deen ke baare mein shaanti evn suraksha maangne ki dua karne ka aadesh diya gaya hai, usi prakaar duniya ke baare mein bhi shaanti evn suraksha ki dua karne ka aadesh diya gaya hai.
Teebi kahte hain : Aapne chhah dishaaon ka zikr isliye kiya ki wipattiyaan inheen dishaaon se aati hain. Phir neeche ki disha par adhik zor isliye daala gaya hai ki is or se aane waali wipatti badatreen wipatti hua karti hai.
In azkaar ko parhne ka sabse behtar samay din ke pahle bhaag mein fajr prakat hone se lekar sooraj doobne tak hai aur din ke antim bhaag mein asr ke baad se lekar sooraj doobne tak hai. Agar koi baad mein, yaani subah sooraj ooncha hone ke baad parhta hai, tab bhi kaafi hai. Zuhar ke baad parhta hai, tab bhi kaafi hai aur maghrib ke baad parhta hai, tab bhi kaafi hai. Yahi zikr ka samay hai.
Jab kisi zikr ke baare mein is baat ki daleel maujood ho ki uska samay raat hi mein nirdhaarit hai, jaise soora baqra ki antim do ayton ko parhna, to aise zikr ko raat mein sooraj doobne ke baad hi parha jayega.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, nasai, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5486: Isne Allah se uske aise naam ke dvaara maanga hai ki jiske dvaara jab maanga jaye to Allah deta hai, aur jab pukaara jaye to Allah qabool karta hai.

Buraida (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek vyakti ko yeh dua karte hue sunaah "Ai Allah, main tujhse apni is gawaahi ke waseele se maangta hoon ki tu hi Allah hai, tere siwa koi poojy nahin, tu akela aur beniyaaz hai, jiski na koi santaan hai aur na woh kisi ki santaan hai, aur na koi uska samkaksh hai."
To aapne pharmayaah “Isne Allah se uske aise naam ke dvaara maanga hai ki jiske dvaara jab maanga jaye to Allah deta hai, aur jab pukaara jaye to Allah qabool karta hai.”
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5487: “Ai Allah! Main tujhse jald tatha der se milne waali har prakaar ki bhalaai maangta hoon, jo main jaanta hoon aur jo nahin jaanta. Aur main jald tatha der se aane waali har prakaar ki buraai se teri sharan chaahta hoon, jo main jaanta hoon aur jo nahin jaanta.

Aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unko yeh dua sikhaai thi : “Ai Allah! Main tujhse jald tatha der se milne waali har prakaar ki bhalaai maangta hoon, jo main jaanta hoon aur jo nahin jaanta. Aur main jald tatha der se aane waali har prakaar ki buraai se teri sharan chaahta hoon, jo main jaanta hoon aur jo nahin jaanta. Ai Allah! Main tujhse woh bhalaai maangta hoon, jo tere bande aur tere Nabi Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne tujhse maangi hai, aur main us buraai se teri sharan chaahta hoon jisse tere bande aur tere Nabi ne sharan chaahi hai. Ai Allah! Main tujhse Jannat tatha usse nikat karne waale kaary evn kathan ka sawaal karta hoon, tatha main Jahannam aur usse nikat kar dene waale kaary evn kathan se teri sharan chaahta hoon. Aur main tujhse sawaal karta hoon ki toone mere liye jo bhi phaisla kiya hai, use behtar kar de.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aaisha radiyallahu anha ko kuchh saargarbhit duayen sikhaai hain. Yeh chaar duayen haiैn :

Pahli dua : Sabhi achchhaaiyon ke liye aam dua hai, (yaani): Ai Allah! Main tujhse saari aur tamaam bhalaaiyaan maangta hoon, jo nikat samay se sanbandh rakhne waali hain aur door samay se sanbandh rakhne waali hain, jo mujhko maaloom hain tere sikhaane ki wajah se,  aur jo mujhe nahin maaloom hain, jinhen bas tu hi jaanta hai. Aur is dua mein sabhi maamlon ko Allah ke hawaale kar diya gaya hai, jo aseem jnaan waala, sabse adhik jaankaar aur kripaalu hai. Atah, Allah taaala us musalmaan ke liye sabse behtar aur sabse uttam cheez chunta hai. (Aur main panaah maangta hoon), aur main sahaara leta hoon, aur main (aapki sharan mein raksha chaahta hoon, tamaam buraaeeyon se—chaahe woh jald aane waali hon ya der se aane waali hon, un tamaam se jinhen main jaanta hoon aur jinhen main nahin jaanta).

Doosri dua : Aisi dua jo musalmaan ko dua mein seema ka ullanghan karne se bachaati hai: Yaani ai Allah! Main tujhse woh bhalaai maangta hoon, jo tere bande aur tere Nabi ne maangi hai, aur main us buraai se teri sharan maangta hoon, jisse tere bande aur tere Nabi ne sharan maangi hai. Ismen Allah se winti ki gai hai ki woh dua karne waale ko woh bhalaaiyaan pradaan kare, jo antim Nabi Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne khud apne liye maangi hain. Aapke dvaara maangi gai cheezon ko ginvaya nahin gaya hai.

Teesri dua : Jannat mein prawesh aur Jahannam se mukti ki dua, jo musalmaan ke jeewan ka uddeshya aur uske karmon ka maqsad hai: Ai Allah! Main tujhse Jannat maangta hoon aur tujhe raazi karne waala har woh kathan evn kaary bhi, jo Jannat se qareeb karta ho. Main Jahannam se teri sharan maangta hoon kyonki teri dayaadrishti na ho, to koi vyakti bure karmon se bach nahin sakta aur tujhe naaraaz karne waale har us gunaah waale kathan evn kaary se bhi, jo Jahannam se qareeb le jaata hai.

Chauthi dua : Allah ke har nirnay se santusht rahne ki dua : Main tujhse winti karta hoon ki apne har nirnay ko mere haq mein behtar bana de aur har baat jisko tu ne mere liye nirdhaarit kar diya hai mere haq mein behtar bana de. Yeh daraasal Allah ke nirnayon se santusht rahne ki dua hai.

Har vyakti apne ghar ke logon ko deen evn duniya ki aisi baaten sikhaye, jo unke liye laabhdayak hon, jis prakaar Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aaisha radiyallahu anha ko sikhaya hai.
Behtar yeh hai ki har musalmaan Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki sikhaai hui duaaon ko yaad karke unko parha kare. Kyonki yeh duayen bari saargarbhit hua karti hain.
Is hadees ke baare mein ulema ne kaha hai ki yeh Allah se bhalaai maangne aur buraai se uski sharan maangne ke silsile mein sabse saargarbhit dua hai. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko saargarbhit shabdon ke chayan ki jo shakti di gai thi, uska yeh ek behatreen namoona hai.
Allah ki daya ke baad Jannat mein prawesh ka ek sabab achchhe kaary evn kathan hain.
[is hadees ko ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5488: Ai Allah! Main teri nemat ke chhin ke jaane, (wipatti mein) teri pradaan ki hui suraksha ke badal jaane, teri achaanak aapda tatha tere har prakaar ke krodh se teri sharan chaahta hoon.

Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jo duayen kiya karte the, unmen se ek yeh hai : "Ai Allah! Main teri nemat ke chhin ke jaane, (wipatti mein) teri pradaan ki hui suraksha ke badal jaane, teri achaanak aapda tatha tere har prakaar ke krodh se teri sharan chaahta hoon."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne chaar cheezon se Allah ki sharan maanhi hai :

Pahli cheez : Ai Allah! Main teri sharan maangta hoon teri di hui deen evn duniya se sanbandhit nemton ke samaapt hone se. Tujhse dua hai ki main Islam par jama rahoon aur aise gunaahon mein sanlipt hone se door rahoon, jo nemton ko khatm kar dete hain.

Doosri cheez : Is baat se bhi ki teri or se mili hui shaanti evn suraksha pareeksha mein badal jaye.Isliye meri dua hai ki mujhe daymi shaanti tatha dukhon evn beemaariyon se suraksha pradaan kar.

Teesri cheez : Is baat se bhi ki achaanak koi wipatti ya pareshaani a jaye. Kyonki aisa ho jaane par insaan ko tauba evn apne aapko sudhaarne ka avsar nahin mil paata. Atah wipatti adhik bari evn adhik sakht ho jaati hai.

Chauthi cheez : Tere karodh aur teri naaraazgi ka kaaran banne waali tamaam cheezon se. Kyonki jisse tu naaraaz ho gaya, uski qismat phoot gai.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne yahaan "Jameea् (arthaat: Tamaam)" Shabd ka prayog isliye kiya hai ki iske dayre mein Allah ki naaraazgi ka sabab banne waale sabhi kathan, kaary evn dhaarnayen a jayen.

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke mohtaaj the.
Sharan maangne ke in shabdon dvaara Allah ki nemton ka shukr ada kiya jaata hai aur gunaahon mein parne se suraksha maangi jaati hai, kyonki gunaahon mein parne ke baad nemten chhin jaati hain.
Insaan ki koshish rahni chahiye ki Allah ko naaraaz karne waali cheezon se door raha jaye.
Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne achaanak koi wipatti a jaane se Allah ki sharan maangi hai. Kyonki jab Allah kisi bande se badla lena chaah leta hai, to uspar aisi wipatti daal deta hai, jise woh akele to kya saari srishtiyon ko saath lekar bhi hata nahin sakta.
Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is baat se Allah ki sharan maangi hai ki uski pradaan ki hui shaanti evn suraksha chhin jaye. Kyonki Allah ki pradaan ki hui shaanti evn suraksha praapt rahne ka matlab yeh hai ki insaan ke paas duniya evn aakhirat donon ki bhalaai maujood hai aur uske chhin jaane ka matlab yeh hai ki uske saamne donon jaghon ki buraai baahen phailaai khari hain. Daraasal shaanti evn suraksha hi se duniya evn aakhirat mein sab kuchh theek-thaak rahta hai.
5489: Ai Allah! Main teri sharan maangta hoon qarz ke bojh tatha shatruon ke haawi hone aur dushmanon ke hansne se.

Abdullah bin amr bin aas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam in shabdon dvaara dua kiya karte the : "Ai Allah! Main teri sharan maangta hoon qarz ke bojh tatha shatruon ke haawi hone aur dushmanon ke hansne se."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne nimnalikhit cheezon se Allah ki sharan maanhi hai :

1- yaani ai Allah! Main kewal teri sharan maangta hoon aur teri panaah mein aata hoon kisi aur ke sharan aur panaah mein nahin, qarz ke dabaav, bojh, shok evn bechaini se. Aur main tujhse apne qarz ke chukaane mein sahayta maangta hoon.

2- shatru ke prabhutv aur uske haawi hone se teri sharan maangta hoon. Mujhe uske atyaachaar se bacha aur uspar wijyi bana.

3- tatha is baat se teri sharan maangta hoon ki muslaamaanon par aisi koi wipatti aye ki dushmanon ko hansne ka avsar mile.

Qarj aadi un tamaam cheezon se Allah ki sharan maangne ki prerna, jo neki ka kaam karne nahin deteen aur chinta evn shok ka kaaran banti hain.
Saamaany qarz mein koi buraai nahin hai. Buraai us samay hai, jab insaan ke paas qarz chukaane ki shakti na ho. Isi qarz ka zikr is hadees mein hai.
Insaan ko aisi cheezon se door rahna chahiye, jinse uski jag hansaai ho aur uspar ungli uthe.
Is baat ka zikr ki awishvaasi eemaan waalon se dushmani rakhte hain aur unpar koi wipatti aane se khush hote hain.
Museebat ke samay dushmanon ki hansi museebat ka dard aur barha deti hai.
[ise nasai aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5490: Ai Allah! Hamne tere (anugrah ke) saath subah ki aur tere hi (anugrah ke) saath shaam ki aur ham tere hi (naam) se jeete hain aur tere hi (naam) se marte hain, aur hamen teri hi or uthkar jaana hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab subah karte, to yeh dua parhte :  "Ai Allah! Hamne tere (anugrah ke) saath subah ki aur tere hi (anugrah ke) saath shaam ki aur ham tere hi (naam) se jeete hain aur tere hi (naam) se marte hain, aur hamen teri hi or uthkar jaana hai." Aur jab shaam karte, to yeh dua parhte : “Ai Allah! Hamne tere (anugrah ke) saath shaam ki aur tere hi (anugrah ke) saath subah ki aur ham tere hi (naam) se jeete hain aur tere hi (naam) se marte hain, aur hamen teri hi or uthkar jaana hai. Farmaya : Aur doosri baar (kaha:) "Teri hi or lautkar jaana hai.”

Jab subah hoti yaani fajr ke prakat hone ke saath din ka pahla bhaag prawesh karta to Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam yeh dua parhte :

Ai Allah! Hamne teri pradaan ki hui suraksha mein, teri di hui nemton se laabhaanvit hote hue, tere zikr mein vyast rahkar, tere naam se madad maangte hue, tere suyog ke saye mein aur teri di hui shakti evn saamarthy se gatimaan rahkar subah ki. Aur ham ne teri (nemton ke) saath shaam kiya, ham tere jeewandaata naam ke saath jeete hain aur tere mrityu dene waale naam ke saath marte hain. Hamen teri hi or uthkar jaana hai. Is dua mein aye hue shabd "Al-nushoor" Ka arth hai maut ke baad dobaara uthaya jaana tatha ekatr hone ke baad alag-alag hona. Hamaara haal tamaam paristhitiyon aur samyon mein yahi rahta hai. Main na isse alag hoon aur na juda.

Isi prakaar jab aapke saamne shaam aati, jo asr ke baad shuru hota hai, to kahte :(He Allah! Ham ne teri (nemton) ke saath subah kiya, ham tere (jeewandaata) naam ke saath jeete hain aur tere (mrityu dene waale) naam ke saath marte hain, aur teri or hi lautna hai) arthaat: Duniya mein lautna teri or hi hai tatha aakhirat mein thikaana bhi teri or hai. Atah tu hi hamen jeewan deta hai aur tu hi hamen maut deta hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka anusran karte hue is dua ko subah-shaam parhna musathab hai.
Banda har pal aur har awastha mein Allah ka mohtaaj hai.
In azkaar ko parhne ka sabse uttam samay din ke pahle bhaag mein fajr hone se sooraj nikalne tak aur din ke antim bhaag mein asr ke baad se sooraj doobne tak hai. Agar koi baad mein bhi parhta hai, yaani subah sooraj ooncha ho jaane ke baad parhta hai tab bhi kaafi hai, zuhar ke baad parhta hai tab bhi kaafi hai aur maghrib ke baad parhta hai tab bhi kaafi hai.
Dua ke shabdon "Wa ilaik al-nushoor" Ka subah ke samay se bara sanbandh hai. Ye shabd insaan ko qayaamat ke din ke us drishy ki yaad dilaate hain, jab insaan ko maut ke baad dobaara jeewit kiya jayega. Yeh ek nai zindgi hogi. Ek naya din hoga, jab praanon ko shareer mein lautaya jayega. Log har taraf bikhre hue honge. Jabki ab Allah ki paida ki hui yeh nai subah bhi isliye saamne a rahi hai ki insaan par gawaah rahe aur uska ek-ek kshan evn ek-ek pal hamaare karmon ke khazaane banen.
Isi prakaar dua ke shabdon "Wa ilaik al-maseer" Ka bhi shaam ke samay se bara sanbandh hai. Shaam ke samay log apne kaamon, kaarobaaron aur jeewin ki daur-dhoop ke baad waapas hote hain. Apne-apne gharon ko lautte hain. Bikhar jaane ke baad  (kaam-kaaj se waapas aakar) aaraam karte hain. Is prakaar, ye shabd uchch evn mahaan Allah ki or lautne ki yaad dilaate hain aur yeh ki antim thikaana aur paraav usi ke paas hai.
[ise abu daawood ne, tirmizi ne tatha nasai ne al-sunan al-kubra mein evn ibn-e-maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
5492: Woh momin jo logon se mel-jol rakhta hai tatha unki or se milne waali yaatnaaon par sabr karta hai, us momin se achchha hai, jo logon se mel-jol nahin rakhta tatha unki yaatnaaon par sabr nahin karta.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se warnit hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayah “Woh momin jo logon se mel-jol rakhta hai tatha unki or se milne waali yaatnaaon par sabr karta hai, us momin se achchha hai, jo logon se mel-jol nahin rakhta tatha unki yaatnaaon par sabr nahin karta.”
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5493: “Shaktishaali momin kamzor momin ke mukaable mein Allah ke sameep adhik behtar tatha priy hai, kintu pratyek ke andar bhalaai hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : “Shaktishaali momin kamzor momin ke mukaable mein Allah ke sameep adhik behtar tatha priy hai, kintu pratyek ke andar bhalaai hai. Jo cheej tumhaare liye laabhdayak ho, uske liye tatpar raho aur Allah ki madad maango tatha asmarthata na dikhaao. Phir yadi tumhen koi wipatti pahunche, to yeh na kaho ki yadi mainne aisa kiya hota, to aisa aur aisa hota. Balki yeh kaho ki "قدر الله وما شاء فعل" (Arthaat Allah taaala ne aisa hi bhaagy mein likh rakha tha aur woh jo chaahta hai, karta hai.) kyonki ‘agar’ shabd shaitaan ke kaary ka dvaar kholta hai.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki waise to har momin ke andar kuchh na kuchh bhalaai zaroor hoti hai, lekin eemaan, pratijna evn dhan aadi shakti ke sroton mein mazboot momin Allah ki nazar mein kamzor momin se achchha evn priy hai. Uske baad Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne momin ko aise saadhan apnaane ki waseeyat farmaai, jinse yadi Allah par bharosa ho aur usse madad maangi jaye, to duniya evn aakhirat ki bhalaai praapt ho sakti hai.
