Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne wiwashta, susti aur donon jahaanon mein laabhkaari saabit hone waali cheezon se peechhe hatne se mana farmaya hai. Atah ek momin ka tareeqa yeh ho ki jab woh kisi kaam mein jo mehnat honi chahiye, woh kar le, uske saadhan apna le, Allah se madad maang le aur khair talab kar le, to uske baad sab kuchh Allah ke hawaale kar de aur wishvaas rakhe ki Allah jo karega, achchha hi hoga. Iske baad agar koi wipatti a jaye, to yeh na kahe ki : "Agar main aisa kar leta, to aisa aur aisa hota." Kyonki yeh "Agar" Shabd shaitaan ke kaary ke dvaar khol deta hai. Yaani insaan taqdeer par etraaz aur haath na lagne waali cheez par afsos shuru kar deta hai. Insaan ko Allah ke faisle par raazi aur sab kuchh usi ke hawaale karte hue bas itna kahna chahiye ki yeh Allah ka faisla hai aur Allah ne jo chaaha kiya. Atah jo kuchh hua Allah ke iraade se hua. Kyonki woh jo chaahta hai, karta hi hai. Uske faisle ko koi taal nahin sakta, aur uske aadesh ko koi rok nahin sakta.

Eemaan ke maamle mein logon ki alag-alag shreniyaan hoti hain.
Kaaryon mein shakti dikhna musathab hai. Kyonki shakti se woh laabh praapt ho sakte hain, jo nirbalta se praapt ho nahin sakte.
Insaan ko laabhkaari cheezon par dhyaan dena chahiye aur haanikaarak cheezon se bachna chahiye.
Yeh zaroori hai ki momin apne tamaam kaamon mein Allah se madad maange aur apne oopar bharosa na kare.
Taqdeer ka saboot. Taqdeer saadhan apnaane aur mehnat evn prayaas karne ke wipreet nahin hai.
Wipattiyon ke samay naaraaz hokar "Agar" Kahne ki manaahi tatha yeh ki taqdeer par aapatti karna haraam hai.
5494: Ek momin apne doosre momin bhaai ka aaeena hai.
Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah“Ek momin apne doosre momin bhaai ka aaeena hai.”
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5495: Bahut zyaada laanat karne waale qayaamat ke din gawaahi dene waale aur sifaarish karne waale nahin honge.

Abu darda -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : "Bahut zyaada laanat karne waale qayaamat ke din gawaahi dene waale aur sifaarish karne waale nahin honge."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki aise vyakti par laanat karne waala, jo laanat ka haqdaar nahin hai, do sazaaon ka haqdaar hai : Pahli : Woh apne is gunaah ke kaaran qayaamat ke din is baat ki gawaahi nahin dega ki pichhli ummaton ko unke rasoolon ne Allah ka sandesh pahunchaya tha, duniya mein bhi uski gawaahi sveekaar nahin ki jayegi aur use Allah ki raah mein shahaadat bhi naseeb nahin hogi. Doosri : Qayaamat ke din, jab doosre momin Jahannam ke haqdaar ban chuke apne momin bhaaiyon ke baare mein sifaarish karenge, woh sifaarish nahin kar sakega.

Laanat karna haraam aur bahut zyaada laanat kabeera gunaah hai.
Is hadees mein bayaan kiya gaya dand us vyakti ke baare mein hai, jo bahut zyaada laanat karta ho. Ek-do baar laanat karne waale ke baare mein nahin. Phir laanat karna kabhi-kabhi jayaz bhi ho sakta hai. Yaani kisi nirdhaarit vyakti ki bajay bure gunon waale logon par laanat karna, jinpar shareeyat mein laanat ki gai hai. Jaise yeh kahna ki yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon par Allah ki laanat ho, atyaachaariyon par Allah ki laanat ho, tasveer banaane waalon par Allah ki laanat ho, loot jaati waale kaary mein sanlipt vyaktiyon par Allah ki laanat ho, Allah ke atirikt kisi aur ke liye jaanvar zabah karne waale par Allah ki laanat ho, striyon ki mushaabhat apnaane waale purushon aur purushon ki mushaabhat apnaane waali striyon par Allah ki laanat ho.
Qayaamat ke din mominon ki sifaarish ka saboot.
5496: Nomaan bin basheer radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : “Dua hi ibaadat hai.” phir yeh ayat parhi : "Tatha tumhaare rab ne kaha hai : Tum mujhe pukaaro, main tumhaari praarthana sveekaar karoonga. Nihsandeh jo log meri ibaadat se ahankaar karte hain, we sheeghr hi apmaanit hokar Jahannam mein prawesh karenge." [soora ghaafir : 60]

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki dua hi ibaadat hai. Isliye dua Allah hi se ki jaani chahiye. Chaahe dua aisi ho ki usmen Allah se kuchh maanga jaye, jaise Allah se duniya aur aakhirat ki aisi cheezen maangna jo bande ke liye laabhkaari hon aur aisi cheezon se suraksha maangna jo uske liye donon jahaanon mein haanikaarak hon, ya phir dua aisi ho ki ibaadat ke taur par ki jaye, jaise har woh zaahiri evn baatini kaary tatha baat jo Allah ko priy evn pasand ho tatha haardik, shaareerik ya aarthik ibaadat.

Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne iska ek pramaan prastut karte hue farmaya : Allah ne kaha hai : "Tatha tumhaare rab ne kaha hai : Tum mujhe pukaaro. Main tumhaari praarthana sveekaar karoonga. Nihsandeh jo log meri ibaadat se ahankaar karte hain, we sheeghr hi apmaanit hokar Jahannam mein prawesh karenge."

Dua hi mool ibaadat hai, isliye Allah ke atirikt kisi aur se dua karna jayaz nahin hai.
Dua ke andar waastawik bandgi tatha Allah ke nisprih evn shaktishaali hone evn bande ke uske adheen hone ki sveekrit paai jaati hai.
Allah ki ibaadat se abhimaan karne aur usse dua karne se rukne waale ke liye bari sakht chetaavni, aur is baat ka spasht ullekh ki jo Allah se dua karne se abhimaan karte hain, we apmaan ke saath Jahannam mein prawesh karenge.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5497: Allah taaala ne meri or wahy ki hai ki tum log winamrata dhaaran karo, yahaan tak ki koi kisi par atyaachaar na kare aur na koi kisi ko ghamand dikhaye.

Ayaaz bin himaar (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Allah taaala ne meri or wahy ki hai ki tum log winamrata dhaaran karo, yahaan tak ki koi kisi par atyaachaar na kare aur na koi kisi ko ghamand dikhaye.”
5499: Tumhaara rab bara hi haya waala tatha daansheel hai. Jab koi banda uske aage apne haathon ko phailaata hai, to use unko khaali lautaane mein sharm aati hai.

Salmaan -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Tumhaara rab bara hi haya waala tatha daansheel hai. Jab koi banda uske aage apne haathon ko phailaata hai, to use unko khaali lautaane mein sharm aati hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam dua ke dauraan donon haathon ko uthaane ki prerna de rahe hain aur bata rahe hain ki Allah atyadhik haya waala hai. Woh dene se gurez nahin karta. Woh bande ka daaman khushiyon se bhar deta hai aur use haaniyon se bachaata hai. Woh daata hai aur bin maange bhi deta hai, to bhala maangne ke baad kaise nahin dega? Use is baat se haya aati hai ki jab koi momin banda usse kuchh maangne ke liye haath uthaye, to uske haathon ko khaali wa naamuraad waapas kar de.

Jitna adhik koi vyakti Allah ke saamne apni laachaari aur bandgi vyakt karta hai, utni hi adhik aasha hoti hai ki uski dua sveekaar ki jayegi.
Dua ki prerna. Dua ke samay donon haathon ko uthaana musathab hai aur yeh dua qabool hone ka ek sabab hai.
Bandon par Allah ki aseem kripa tatha daya.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi aur ibn-e-maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
5501: “Yadi aisa karna zaroori ho, to raaste ko uska haq do." Logon ne poochhaah uska haq kya hai? Aapne farmayaah "Nazar neeche rakhna, kashtadayak wastuon ko raaste se hataana, salaam ka uttar dena, bhalaai ka aadesh dena tatha buraai se rokna.”

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Tum log raaston mein baithne se bacho." Logon ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, hamen to baithna hi parta hai. (Wahaan baithkar) ham baat-cheet karte hain. Aapne farmayaah “Yadi aisa karna zaroori ho, to raaste ko uska haq do." Logon ne poochhaah uska haq kya hai? Aapne farmayaah "Nazar neeche rakhna, kashtadayak wastuon ko raaste se hataana, salaam ka uttar dena, bhalaai ka aadesh dena tatha buraai se rokna.”

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne saathiyon ko raaston mein baithne se saavdhaan kiya, to unhonne kaha ki hamen raaston mein baithna hi parta hai. Ispar aapne kaha : Yadi tum na maano aur tumhen raaston mein baithna hi pare, to raaste ka haq ada karna zaroori hai. Sahaaba ne raaste ke haq ke baare mein poochha, to bataya ki saamne se jo striyaan guzren unhen taakne ki bajay nazar neechi rakho, guzarne waali striyon ko apni baat athva karm dvaara kasht dene se bacho, jo salaam kare uska uttar do, bhalaai ka aadesh do aur jab koi galat kaam hota hua dekho, to uska khandan karo.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5502: Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam sarvaadhik jo dua karte the woh yeh hai : “He Allah, hamaare rab, hamen duniya mein bhi achchhi dasha pradaan kar aur aakhirat mein bhi achchhi dasha pradaan kar aur hamen Jahannam ki yaatna se bacha le.”

Anas radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam sarvaadhik jo dua karte the woh yeh hai : “He Allah, hamaare rab, hamen duniya mein bhi achchhi dasha pradaan kar aur aakhirat mein bhi achchhi dasha pradaan kar aur hamen Jahannam ki yaatna se bacha le.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aksar saargarbhit shabdon mein dua kiya karte the. Maslan ek dua dekhen : "Ai Allah,  hamaare rab, hamen duniya mein bhi bhalaai pradaan kar aur aakhirat mein bhi bhalaai pradaan kar aur hamen Jahannam ke azaab se bacha." Is dua mein jahaan duniya ki bhalaai, jaise prachur maatra mein halaal rozi, nek patni, aankh ki thandak banne waali aulaad, sukoon, laabhkaari jnaan evn satkarm jaisi priy evn halaal cheezen shaamil hain, waheen aakhirat ki bhalaai jaise qabr, hashr ke maidaan aur Jahannam ki yaatnaaon se suraksha, Allah ki prasannata ki praapti, anant nemton ki praapti evn dayaawaan Allah ki nikatta aadi cheezen bhi shaamil hain.

Dua karne ke liye Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke padchihnon par chalte hue saargarbhit shabdon ka chayan karna musathab (waanchhit) hai.
Sabse sanpoorn tareeqa yeh hai ki insaan dua karte samay duniya aur aakhirat donon ki bhalaai maange.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5503: Shaddaad bin aus radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : “Sayyadul istighphaar (sarvashreshth kshamayaachna) yeh hai ki banda is prakaar kahe : Ai Allah, tu hi mera rab hai. Tere siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai. Tu ne hi meri rachna ki hai aur main tera banda hoon. Main tujhse ki hui pratijna evn waade ko har sanbhav poora karne ka prayatn karoonga. Main apne karm ki buraai se teri sharan chaahta hoon. Main teri or se di jaane waali nemton (anugrahon) ka tatha apni or se kiye jaane waale paapon ka iqraar karta hoon. Tu mujhe maaph kar de, kyonki tere siwa paapon ko kshama karne waala koi nahin.” aapne kaha : "Jisne ise wishvaas ke saath din mein kaha aur usi din shaam se pahle mar gaya, woh jannatvaasi hai. Aur jisne ise wishvaas ke saath raat mein kaha aur subah hone se pahle mar gaya, woh jannatvaasi hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki kshama yaachna ke kuchh shabd nirdhaarit hain aur iske sabse uttam evn mahaan shabd yeh hain : "Ai Allah, tu hi mera rab hai. Tere siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai. Tu ne hi meri rachna ki hai aur main tera banda hoon. Main tujhse ki hui pratijna evn waade ko har sanbhav poora karne ka prayatn karoonga. Main apne har us krity se teri sharan chaahta hoon, jiske kaaran main teri rahmat se door ho jaaoon. Main teri or se di jaane waali nemton (anugrahon) ka  iqraar karta hoon tatha apni or se kiye jaane waale paapon ko bhi sveekaar karta hoon. Atah tu mujhe maaph kar de, kyonki tere siwa paapon ko kshama karne waala koi nahin.” in shabdon dvaara banda Allah ke ek hone ke saath-saath is baat ka iqraar karta hai ki Allah uska srashta aur poojy hai. Uska koi saajhi nahin hai. Woh Allah se kiye hue eemaan aur aajnaapaalan ke waade par jahaan tak ho sakega, qayam rahega. Kyonki banda jitni bhi ibaadat kar le, Allah ke tamaam aadeshon ka paalan aur uski nemton ka shukriya us tarah nahin kar sakta, jis tarah kiya jaana chahiye. Woh Allah ke yahaan sharan leta hai aur uski rassi ko mazbooti se thaam leta hai, kyonki bande ko unke dvaara kiye giye bure kaamon se sharan wahi deta hai. Woh Allah ki di hui nemton ka iqraar bhi karta hai aur apne gunaahon evn awajnaakaariyon ka etraaf bhi. Iske baad banda apne rab se dua karta hai ki uske gunaahon par parda daal de, kshama, anugrah evn daya se kaam lete hue use uske gunaahon ke bure parinaamon se bacha le. Kyonki gunaahon ko kshama karne ka kaam sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ke siwa koi nahin kar sakta. Phir aapne bataya ki yeh subah-shaam ke azkaar mein se hai. Jisne ise yaqeen ke saath, iske arth ko zehan mein rakhte hue aur ispar wishvaas rakhte din ke aaranbh mein yaani sooraj nikalne se dhalne tak ke beech kaha aur phir mar gaya, woh Jannat mein prawesh karega. Isi tarah jisne ise raat mein yaani sooraj doobne ke samay se fajr hone ke samay ke beech kaha aur subah hone se pahle mar gaya, woh bhi Jannat mein daakhil hoga.

Kshama yaachna ke alag-alag shabdaavli sikhaye gae hain, jinmen se kuchh any ke tulna mein shreshth hain.
Is dua dvaara Allah se dua karne ka prayaas karna chahiye, kyonki yeh dua sayyadul-istigphaar hai (arthaat; yeh dua kshama yaachna ke liye agrani dua hai).
5504: “Sachchaai ko mazbooti se thaam lo, kyonki sachchaai neki (sukarm) ki raah dikhaati hai aur neki Jannat ki or le jaati hai.

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : “Sachchaai ko mazbooti se thaam lo, kyonki sachchaai neki (sukarm) ki raah dikhaati hai aur neki Jannat ki or le jaati hai. Aadmi sarvada saty bolta hai tatha saty ki khoj mein laga rahta hai, yahaan tak ki Allah ke nikat satyawaadi likh liya jaata hai. Tum jhooth bolne se bacho, kyonki jhooth buraai ki or le jaata hai aur buraai Jahannam ki or le jaati hai. Aadmi sada jhooth bolta rahta hai tatha jhooth hi ki khoj mein laga rahta hai, yahaan tak ki Allah ke yahaan jhootha likh liya jaata hai.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne sach bolne ka aadesh diya hai aur bataya hai ki sach bolne ki neeti insaan ko nirantar roop se achchhe kaary karne ka aadi bana deti hai aur nirantar roop se achchhe kaary karne ki aadat Jannat pahuncha deti hai. Insaan jab khule aur chhupe nirantar roop se sach bolte rahta hai, to siddeeq naam ka haqdaar ban jaata hai, jiska arth hai, bahut zyaada sach bolne waala. Iske baad Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne jhooth se saavdhaan kiya hai. Kyonki jhooth insaan ko deen par sudrirh rahne nahin deta aur buraai, bigaar evn gunaahon ki or le jaata hai tatha is tarah use Jahannam pahuncha deta hai. Insaan jab lagaataar jhooth bolta rahta hai, to Allah ke yahaan jhoothon mein likh diya jaata hai.

Sach bolna ek utkrisht gun hai jo seekhne aur prayaas karne se praapt hota hai. Kyonki jab koi insaan lagaataar sach bolta hai aur sach ki khoj karta hai to sach bolna uski phitrat ban jaata hai aur woh Allah ke paas sachche aur nek logon mein likha jaata hai.
Jhooth bolna ek buri aadat hai jo lanbe samay tak jhooth bolne aur ise maukhik aur shaareerik roop se apni aadat bana lene ke kaaran panapti hai. Phir ek samay aisa aata hai jab vyakti iska aadi ho jaata hai aur Allah ke nikat jhooth bolne waalon mein gin liya jaata hai.
Sidq shabd ka arth zabaan se sach bolna bhi hai, jo jhooth ke wipreet hai, aur neeyat ki sachchaai bhi, jise nishtha kaha jaata hai. Isi tarah kisi achchhe kaam ke iraade mein drirh sankalp aur kaaryon mein sachchaai bhi, jiska sabse nichla star andar aur baahar ka baraabar hona hai. Iska ek arth sthaanon ki sachchaai bhi hai. Jaise dar aur ichchha aadi  ki sachchaai. In sabhi gunon ko rakhne waale vyakti ko siddeeq kaha jayega aur kuchh gunon se yukt vyakti ko saadiq kaha jayega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5507: Do shabd rahmaan (Allah) ko bare priy hain

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : Do shabd rahmaan (Allah) ko bare priy hain, zubaan par bare halke hain aur taraazu mein bare bhaari honge : Subhaanallahil azeem, subhaanallahi wa bihamdihi (Allah paak hai apni prashansa samet, paak hai Allah jo bara mahaan hai).”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki do waaky hain, jinko insaan aasaani ke saath kisi bhi haal mein bol sakta hai, taraazu mein inka pratiphal bahut bhaari saabit hoga aur hamaara rab in donon waakyon se mohabbat rakhta hai. Yeh donon waaky hain :

Subhaanallahil azeem, subhaanallahi wa bihamdihi (paak hai Allah jo bara mahaan hai, Allah paak hai apni prashansa samet). In donon waakyon ka itna mahatv isliye hai ki inke andar Allah ki mahima aur sanpoornata bayaan ki gai hai aur use tamaam kamiyon se paak ghoshit kiya gaya hai.

Sabse bara zikr woh hai, jiske andar Allah ki paaki bayaan ki jaye aur uski prashansa ki jaye.
Bandon par Allah ka vyaapak anugrah ki woh chhote-chhote kaary par bhi bare-bare badle de diya karta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5508: Mainne tumhaare paas se jaane ke baad chaar shabd teen baar kahe hain. Yadi unhen aaj tumne jo azkaar parhe hain, unse taula jaye, to we chaar shabd bhaari saabit honge.

Musalmaanon ki maata juwairiya -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki : Woh namaz parhne ke baad usi jagah baithi theen ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- unke paas se subah ke samay fajr ki namaz parhne ke baad nikle. Phir sooraj oopar charh jaane ke baad laute, to woh usi jagah baithi theen. Yeh dekh aapne kaha : "Main tumhen jis haal par chhor gaya tha, abhi tak tum usi haal par hoॽ" Unhonne haan mein jawaab diya, to Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kaha : "Mainne tumhaare paas se jaane ke baad chaar shabd teen baar kahe hain. Yadi unhen aaj tumne jo azkaar parhe hain, unse taula jaye, to we chaar shabd bhaari saabit honge. We chaar shabd hain : (Main Allah ki pawitrata bayaan karta hoon uski prashansa ke saath, uski rachnaaon ki sankhya ke baraabar, uski prasannata ke baraabar, uske sinhaasan ke wazan ke baraabar aur uske shabdon ko likhne ki roshnaai ke baraabar.)

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apni patni tatha musalmaanon ki maata juwairiya -radiyallahu anha- ke yahaan se subah fajr ki namaz parhkar nikle. Us samay woh namaz ke sthaan hi mein baithi hui theen. Jab aap dophar ke samay waapas aye, to dekha ki woh usi jagah baithi hui hain. Atah farmaya : Tum abhi tak usi awastha mein ho jispar main tumko chhor gaya tha? Unhonne uttar diya : Ji haan. Unka uttar sun aapne kaha : Mainne tumhaare paas se nikaalne ke baad chaar shabd kahe hain aur unhen teen-teen baar dohraya hai. Yadi sawaab ke maamle mein unki tulna tumhaare kahe hue un shabdon se kiya jaye jinhen tumne yahaan baithkar poore samay mein kaha hai, to mere kahe hue shabd bhaari saabit hon. Wo shabd is prakaar hain : (Subhaanallah) aur woh sabhi kamiyon se pawitr hai, (wa bihamdihi) choonki usi ke liye sundar prashansa hai jisne iski prerna di, (adad khalqihi) jinki ganna Allah ke siwa koi nahin kar sakta, (wa riza nafsihi) us had tak jo uske un bandon se use prasann karta hai jinse Allah prasann hua aur yeh aisi cheez hai jiska gheraav nahin kiya ja sakta, (wa zinat arshihi) jo ki tamaam makhlooqaat (srishti) mein sabse mahaan aur sabse bhaari hai, (wa midaad kalimaatihi) aur Allah ke shabd na seemit kiye ja sakte hain aur na samaapt hote hain; aur yeh teenon wibhaagon ko shaamil karta hai aur unka ihaata (gheraav) karta hai; kyonki uske shabdon ki syaahi (midaad) ki maatra, uske gunon aur uski sankhya ki koi ant nahin hai, lekin yahaan iska uddeshy atishyokti (bahutayat mein bayaan) ke saath bahulta ko darshaana hai; kyonki usne pahle aisi cheez ka ullekh kiya jise bahut bari sankhya (srishti ki sankhya) ginti mein laati hai, phir usse bhi mahaan cheez ki or barha aur use "Apni raza (prasannata)" Se vyakt kiya, aur phir sabse bari rachna yaani "Arsh" Ke wazan ka zikr kiya; atah pahla bhaag sankhya aur maatra ke liye hai, doosra gun aur kaifiyat ke liye, aur teesra mahaanta aur bhaareepan ke liye.

In shabdon ki fazeelat ka bayaan aur inhen kahne ki prerna.
Azkaar ki fazeelat mein bhi antar hota hai aur kuchh azkaar any ki tulna mein shreshth hote hain.
Navvi Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke shabdon "سبحان الله وبحمده مداد كلماته" Ke baare mein kahte hain : In shabdon ko laane ka uddeshy adhikta mein atishyokti paida karna hai. Kyonki aapne sabse pahle bahut bari sankhya mein maujood srishtiyon ki sankhya ka zikr kiya, phir arsh ke wazan ka zikr kiya aur phir usse aage barhte hue in shabdon ka zikr kiya. Yaani jis prakaar Allah ki prashansa ke shabd gine nahin ja sakte, usi prakaar main Allah ki beshumaar paaki bayaan karta hoon.
Ibn-e-qaiyim kahte hain : 'Subhaanallah wa bihamdihi, adad khalqihi... Kahte samay insaan ke hriday mein Allah ki pahchaan, pawitrata aur shraddha ki jo bhaavnayen utpann hoti hain, we kewal "Subhaanallah" Kahne se utpann hone waali bhaavnaaon se kaheen adhik hoti hain.
Saargarbhit shabdon dvaara dua karne ka nirdesh, jo shabd kam rakhte hon bara pratiphal dilaate hon.
5509: “Allah ke nikat dua se adhik sammaanit koi cheej nahin hai.”
Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : “Allah ke nikat dua se adhik sammaanit koi cheej nahin hai.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki Allah ke nikat koi bhi cheez dua se uttam nahin hai. Kyonki ismen ek taraf Allah ki nisprihta ka etraaf hai, to doosri taraf bande ki wiwashta tatha zarooratmandi ka iqraar.

Dua ki fazeelat tatha yeh ki Allah se dua karne waala waastav mein Allah ka sammaan kar raha hota hai; woh is baat ka iqraar kar raha hota hai ki Allah dhanvaan hai,  kyonki nirdhan se kuchh maanga nahin ja sakta; Allah sunta hai, kyonki bahre ko pukaara nahin jaata; Allah daata hai, kyonki kanjoos ke saamne haath phailaya nahin jaata aur Allah nikat hai, kyonki door waala sunta nahin hai. Is hadees se Allah ke ye tatha is prakaar ke any gun saabit hote hain.
[ise tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5510: Aadam ki santaan ne koi aisa kaary nahin kiya, jo use Allah ke zikr ki tulna mein Allah ke azaab se adhik bachaane waala ho.

Muaaz bin jabal (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah “Aadam ki santaan ne koi aisa kaary nahin kiya, jo use Allah ke zikr ki tulna mein Allah ke azaab se adhik bachaane waala ho.”
[saheeh li-ghairihi (any sandon athva riwayton se milkar saheeh)]
[ise ibne abi shaiba ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise tabraani ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise maalik ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5511: Jo log kisi sabha mein baithte hain aur wahaan Allah ko yaad nahin karte tatha apne Nabi par darood nahin bhejte, to unka woh baithna unke liye pachhtaawe ka kaaran banega. Ab yadi Allah chaahega, to unhen yaatna dega aur chaahega to maaf karega.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jo log kisi sabha mein baithte hain aur wahaan Allah ko yaad nahin karte tatha apne Nabi par darood nahin bhejte, to unka woh baithna unke liye pachhtaawe ka kaaran banega. Ab yadi Allah chaahega, to unhen yaatna dega aur chaahega to maaf karega."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne Allah ke zikr mein kotaahi karne se mana kiya hai aur bataya hai ki jab log kisi sabha mein baithe aur phir  wahaan se Allah ka zikr kiye aur uske Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- par darood bheje bina uth gae, to woh sabha qayaamat ke din unke liye khed, afsos, haani aur nuqsaan ka kaaran banegi. Aise mein agar Allah chaahega, to unko unke pichhle gunaahon aur baad mein hone waali kotaahiyon ke kaaran azaab dega aur agar chaahega to apne anugrah se kshama kar dega.

Zikr ki prerna aur uski fazeelat ka bayaan.
Aisi sabhaaon ki fazeelat, jinmen Allah ka zikr aur uske Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka zikr kiya jaye. Jo sabhayen in donon baaton se khaali hon, woh qayaamat ke din wahaan baithne waalon ke liye haanikaarak siddh hongi.
Allah ke zikr ko nazraandaaz karne ke khilaaf chetaavni sirf sabhaaon tak hi seemit nahin hai, balki doosri jaghon par bhi laagu hoti hai. Imaam navvi (Allah un par raham kare) ne kaha hai : Kisi vyakti ke liye kisi jagah par baithkar Allah ka zikr kiye bina use chhor dena naapsand hai.
Qayaamat ke din unhen jo pachhtaawa hoga woh ya to Allah ki aajnaakaarita mein apna samay na bitaane ke kaaran puraskaar aur pratiphal se wanchit rahne ke kaaran hoga, ya Allah ki awajna mein apna samay barbaad karne ke kaaran paap aur dand ki wajah se hoga.
Jab jayaz kaaryon mein vyast hokar Allah ke zikr ka andekha karne waalon ke liye yeh chetaavni hai, to un haraam sabhaaon ka kya haal hoga, jinmen gheebat aur chughli aadi hoti hai.
[ise abu daawood ne, tirmizi ne tatha nasai ne al-sunan al-kubra mein riwayat kiya hai]
5512: “Sadqa karne se kisi ka maal kam nahin hota hai, bando ko kshama karne se Allah maaf karne waale ke aadar-sammaan ko aur barha deta hai aur jo vyakti Allah ke liye winamrata dhaaran karta hai, Allah uska sthaan ooncha kar deta hai.”

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : “Sadqa karne se kisi ka maal kam nahin hota hai, bando ko kshama karne se Allah maaf karne waale ke aadar-sammaan ko aur barha deta hai aur jo vyakti Allah ke liye winamrata dhaaran karta hai, Allah uska sthaan ooncha kar deta hai.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki sadqa dhan ko ghataata nahin hai, balki ek taraf insaan ko wipattiyon se bachaata hai to doosri or badle mein bahut bari bhalaai pradaan karta hai. Isliye yeh dhan mein wriddhi hui kami nahin.

Badla lene ki kshamta hote hue jab maaf kar diya jaata hai, to isse insaan ka sammaan barhta hai.

Jab koi vyakti Allah ke liye winamrata dhaaran karta hai, kisi ke bhay se, kisi ko khush karne ke liye aur kisi se laabh praapt karne ke liye nahin, to badle mein Allah use ooncha sthaan pradaan karta hai.
Bhalaai tatha kaamyaabi shareeyat ke anupaalan aur achchha kaam karne mein hai, chaahe kuchh log ise iske wipreet samajhte hon.
5514: “Jo apne bhaai ki maan-sammaan ki raksha karega, qayaamat ke din Allah Jahannam ki agni se uski raksha karega.”

Abu darda radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : “Jo apne bhaai ki maan-sammaan ki raksha karega, qayaamat ke din Allah Jahannam ki agni se uski raksha karega.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jo apne musalmaan bhaai ki anupasthiti mein kisi ko uski ninda karne aur uske saath bura vyavhaar karne se rok kar uski maan-sammaan ki raksha karega, Allah qayaamat ke din usse azaab ko door rakhega.

Musalmaan ke maan-sammaan ki haani karne waali baat karne ki manaahi.
Insaan ko usi koti ka pratiphal diya jaata hai, jis koti ka uska karm hota hai. Isliye jo apne bhaai ke maan-sammaan ki raksha karega, Allah Jahannam ki aag se uski raksha karega.
Islam bhaaeechaara aur paraspar sahyog ka dharm hai.
[ise tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5516: “Jisne din bhar mein sau baar 'subhaanallahi wa bihamdihi' (Allah ke liye pawitrata hai uski prashansa ke saath) kaha, uske saare paap kshama kar diye jayenge, yadyapi we samudr ke jhaag ke baraabar hi kyon na hon.”

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : “Jisne din bhar mein sau baar 'subhaanallahi wa bihamdihi' (Allah ke liye pawitrata hai uski prashansa ke saath) kaha, uske saare paap kshama kar diye jayenge, yadyapi we samudr ke jhaag ke baraabar hi kyon na hon.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jisne din evn raat mein sau baar 'subhaanallahi wa bihamdihi' (Allah ke liye pawitrata hai uski prashansa ke saath) kaha, uske gunaah mita tatha kshama kar diye jaate hain, yadyapi uske gunaah itne adhik hon ki samudr ke jhaag ke baraabar maaloom hote hon.

Yeh sawaab lagaataar tatha antraal ke saath donon tarah kahne se praapt hoga.
Tasbeeh ka maltab hai Allah ko sabhi kamiyon se pawitr kahna aur hamd (prashansa) ka arth hai use prem tatha sammaan ke saath har prakaar se sanpoorn maanna.
Is hadees se muraad chhote gunaahon ka maaf hona hai. Bare gunaah tauba ke bina maaf nahin hote.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5517: “Jisne das baar 'la ilaaha illallahu wahadhu la shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa ala kulli shaiin qadeer' (arthaat, Allah ke siwa koi waastawik poojy nahin, woh akela hai, uska koi saajhi nahin hai, poora raajy usi ka hai aur sab prashansa usi ki hai aur uske paas har cheez ka saamarthy hai.) kaha

Abu ayyoob radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : “Jisne das baar 'la ilaaha illallahu wahadhu la shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa ala kulli shaiin qadeer' (arthaat, Allah ke siwa koi waastawik poojy nahin, woh akela hai, uska koi saajhi nahin hai, poora raajy usi ka hai aur sab prashansa usi ki hai aur uske paas har cheez ka saamarthy hai.) kaha, woh us vyakti ke samaan hai, jisne ismaaeel (alaihissalaam) ki santaan mein se chaar daason ko mukt kiya.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jisne is zikr ko din mein das baar parha : "La ilaaha illallahu wahadhu la shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa ala kulli shaiin qadeer." Yaani Allah ko chhorkar koi sachcha poojy nahin hai. Woh akela hai. Uska koi saajhi nahin hai. Usi ke paas sanpoorn raajy hai. Kewal wahi prem tatha sammaan ke saath prashansa ka haqdaar hai. Uske siwa koi is baat ka haqdaar nahin hai. Woh bara kshamtaawaan hai. Use koi wiwash nahin kar sakta. Jisne is zikr ko din mein das baar parha, use us vyakti ke samaan sawaab milega, jisne ismaaeel bin ibraaheem alaihimassalaam ki nasl ke das daason ko mukt kiya ho. Yahaan wishesh roop se ismaaeel alaihissalaam ki nasl ka ullekh isliye kiya gaya hai ki unki nasl ke log any logon se shreshth hain.

Is zikr ki fazeelat, jismen ekmaatr Allah ko ibaadat evn prashansa ka haqdaar tatha sanpoorn raajy evn saamarthy ka maalik bataya gaya hai.
Is zikr ka sawaab lagaataar tatha antraal ke saath donon tarah se parhne waale ko milega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5518: Allah taaala jiske saath bhalaai ka iraada karta hai, use deen ki samajh pradaan karta hai

Muaawiya radiyallahu anhu se warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Mainne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Allah taaala jiske saath bhalaai ka iraada karta hai, use deen ki samajh pradaan karta hai. Main kewal baantne waala hoon, deta to Allah hai. Yeh ummat Allah ke aadesh par qayam rahegi, use uska wirodh karne waale nuqsaan nahin pahuncha sakenge, yahaan tak ki qayaamat a jaye."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki Allah jiske saath bhalaai ka iraada karta hai, use apne deen ki samajh pradaan karta hai. Saath hi yeh ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam kewal baantne waale hain, jo Allah ki di hui jeewika evn jnaan aadi ko baantte hain. Asal dene waala Allah hai. Uske siwa sab bas saadhan hain, jo Allah ki anumti ke bina laabh nahin de sakte. Aapne aage bataya ki yeh ummat Allah ke aadesh par qayam rahegi, use uska wirodh karne waale nuqsaan nahin pahuncha sakenge, yahaan tak ki qayaamat a jaye.

Sharai jnaan tatha use seekhne ki fazeelat aur prerna.
Is ummat ke andar hamesha saty paya jayega. Ek giroh ke andar nahin to doosre giroh ke andar hi sahi.
Deen ki samajh is baat ki nishaani hai ki Allah bande ke saath bhalaai ka iraada rakhta hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke aadesh tatha uske iraade se dete hain. Aap kisi cheez ke maalik nahin hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5519: Barbaadi hai us vyakti ke liye, jo logon se baat karta hai aur unhen hansaane ke liye jhooth bolta hai. Barbaadi hai uske liye. Phir barbaadi hai uske liye.

Muaawiya bin hiyda (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Barbaadi hai us vyakti ke liye, jo logon se baat karta hai aur unhen hansaane ke liye jhooth bolta hai. Barbaadi hai uske liye. Phir barbaadi hai uske liye.”

Is hadees mein jhooth se bahut zyaada saavdhaan kiya gaya hai aur un logon ko winaash ki chetaavni di gai hai, jo logon ko hansaane ke liye jhooth bolte hain. Yeh ek bahut buri baat, sakht haraam kaam aur bura aachran hai, jisse musalmaan ko bachna evn door rahna chahiye aur uski zabaan ko jhooth se pawitr honi chahiye, chaahe paristhiti jo bhi ho. Haan, jahaan shareeyat ne anumti di hai, wahaan baat alag hai.
Phir, jis tarah logon ko hansaane ke liye jhooth bolna haraam hai, usi tarah shrotaaon ke liye sunna bhi haraam hai, yadi we uske jhooth hone se avgat hon. Balki, aisi paristhiti mein uska khandan bhi zaroori hai.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5520: He logon, salaam phailaao (prachaarit karo), logon ko khaana khilaao, rishtedaariyon ko joro, raatri mein jab log so rahe hote hain, to uth kar namaz parho, (aisa karne par) surakshit roop se Jannat mein prawesh pa jaaoge.

Abdullah bin salaam radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Jab Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam madeena aye, to log aapki or daur pare aur kaha jaane laga ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam a gae hain. Allah ke Rasool a gae hain. Allah ke Rasool a gae hain. Teen baar. Dekhne ke liye main bhi logon ke saath pahuncha. Jab dhyaan se aapka chehra dekha, to pata lag gaya ki yeh kisi jhoothe ka chehra nahin hai. Is dauraan mainne aapko jo pahli baat kahte hue suna woh yeh thi : "He logon, salaam phailaao (prachaarit karo), logon ko khaana khilaao, rishtedaariyon ko joro, raatri mein jab log so rahe hote hain, to uth kar namaz parho, (aisa karne par) surakshit roop se Jannat mein prawesh pa jaaoge."

Jab Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam madeena aye aur logon ne aapko dekha, to aapki or daur pare. Aapki or daurkar jaane waalon mein abdullah bin salaam bhi shaamil the. Woh yahoodi the. Aapko dekhkar unhonne pahchaan liya tha ki yeh kisi jhoothe ka chehra nahin ho sakta. Kyonki unke chehre par noor (divy prakaash), sundarta aur sachchi garima jhalak rahi thi. Is dauraan unhonne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se jo pahli baat suni, woh yeh thi ki aapne logon ko kuchh aise kaaryon ki prerna di, jo Jannat mein prawesh ka maadhyam hain. Jaise :

1- salaam ko phailaana, aam karna aur zyaada se zyaada karna. Jaan-pahchaan waale ko bhi aur anjaan ko bhi.

2- khaana khilaana. Sadqe ke roop mein ho, bhent ke roop mein aur nimantran ke roop mein.

3- rishtedaaron se rishta nibhaana. Rishta pita ki or ka ho ya maata ki or ka.

4- raat ke samay, jab log so rahe hon, jaagkar nafal namaz arthaat tahajjud parhna.
Musalmaanon ke beech salaam aam karna musathab hai. Lekin ghair-Muslim ko salaam nahin kiya jayega. Agar woh assalaamu alaikum kahkar salaam kar de, to jawaab mein bas alaikum kaha jayega.
[ise tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5522: Allah taaala farmaata haih main apne bande ke saath hota hoon, jab woh mera smaran karta hai tatha mujhe yaad karne ke liye apne honthon ko harkat deta hai.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Allah taaala farmaata haih main apne bande ke saath hota hoon jab woh mera smaran karta hai tatha mujhe yaad karne ke liye apne honthon ko harkat deta hai.”

Yeh hadees is baat ka pramaan hai ki jo Allah ka zikr karta hai, Allah usse nikat hota hai aur har kaam mein uske saath hota hai. Woh use suyog pradaan karta hai, uska maargadarshan karta hai, uski sahayta karta hai aur uski pukaar sunta hai.
Is hadees mein jo baat kahi gai hai, wahi baat ek any hadees mein bhi aai hai. Saheeh Bukhari mein hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Main apne bande ki us dhaarna ke nikat hota hoon, jo woh mere baare mein rakhta hai tatha jab woh mujhe yaad karta hai to main uske saath hota hoon. Yadi woh mujhe apne dil mein yaad karta hai to main use apne dil mein yaad karta hoon aur agar woh mujhe kisi samooh mein yaad karta hai to main use usse behtar samooh mein yaad karta hoon."
[saheeh li-ghairihi (any sandon athva riwayton se milkar saheeh)]
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise Bukhari ne taaleeqan yaqeen ke seghe ke saath riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5541: Ai logon ke rab (paalanhaar), takleephon tatha rogon ko door karne waale, rog se mukti pradaan kar. Tere siwa koi shipha dene waala nahin hai. Rog se aisa chhutkaara pradaan kar ki phir koi rog shesh na rahe.

Anas (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki unhonne saabit (rahimhullah) se farmayaah kya main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke shabdon ke dvaara tumhara ilaaj na karoon? Unhonne kahaah awashy keejiye. Tab unhonne yeh dua parheeh “Ai logon ke rab (paalanhaar), takleephon tatha rogon ko door karne waale, rog se mukti pradaan kar. Tere siwa koi shipha dene waala nahin hai. Rog se aisa chhutkaara pradaan kar ki phir koi rog shesh na rahe.”
5542: Kasht door kar de ai logon ke rab! Tatha rog se mukti pradaan kar, tu hi rog se mukti pradaan karne waala  hai. Tere siwa koi rog se mukti pradaan karne waala nahin hai. Rog se aisa chhutkaara pradaan kar ki phir koi rog shesh na rahe.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab kisi rogi ke paas jaakar uske liye dua karte, to farmaate : "Kasht door kar de ai logon ke rab! Tatha rog se mukti pradaan kar, tu hi rog se mukti pradaan karne waala  hai. Tere siwa koi rog se mukti pradaan karne waala nahin hai. Rog se aisa chhutkaara pradaan kar ki phir koi rog shesh na rahe."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab kisi beemaar vyakti ke haal jaanne jaate, to uske liye in shabdon mein dua karte : He Allah! (Door kar de) aur mita de (takleef) aur beemaari ki shiddat ko, (ai insaanon ke rab) aur unke paida karne waale tatha paalanhaar, (aur shifa de) is mareez ko, (tu hi) paak hai (shifa dene waala hai) aur main tere shifa dene waale naam ke zariye tujhse waseela (dua) maangta hoon, (koi shifa haasil nahin hai) mareez ke liye (siway teri shifa ke) aur teri aafiyat ke, (aisi shifa) mukammal taur par (jo na chhore) aur baaqi na rakhe (koi beemaari) aur na hi koi doosri takleef.

Shifa dene waala Allah hai. Doktar evn dawa donon saadhan maatr hain. Laabh evn haani kewal Allah ki anumti se kar sakte hain.
Beemaar vyakti ka haal jaanne jaana musalmaanon ka ek saajha adhikaar hai. Yadi rogi rishtedaar ho to yeh adhikaar aur bhi adhik mahatvapoorn ho jaata hai.
Rogi ka haal jaanne jaane waale ko uske liye Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se saabit in mubaarak shabdon dvaara dua karne ki prerna.
Qur'an ki ayten aur duayen parhkar ilaaj karna bhi Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki shikshaaon ka hissa hai. Aap khud beemaar hote, to ilaaj ke liye Qur'an ki ayton aur duaaon ka sahaara lete aur pariwaar ya baahar ka koi vyakti beemaar hota, to yahi paddhati apnaate.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Ek prashn yeh uthta hai ki jab beemaari gunaahon ka prayashchit banti hai aur usse sawaab bhi milta hai, jaisa ki bahut-si hadeeson se pata chalta hai, to phir beemaar vyakti ke liye svaasthy ki dua kyon ki jaye? Iska uttar yeh hai ki dua ibaadat hai aur yeh sawaab tatha prayashchit ke wiruddh nahin hai. Kyonki sawaab tatha prayashchit beemaari ke aaranbh tatha uspar sabr se haasil hote hain, jabki dua karne waale ko do achchhi cheezon mein se ek zaroor milti hai. Ya to uska koi uddeshy poora ho jaata hai ya phir badle mein use koi bhalaai mil jaati hai ya buraai se suraksha praapt ho jaati hai. Aur yeh sab kuchh Allah ka anugrah evn daya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5543: Ashaari log jab yuddh mein khaane-peene ki cheezon ki kami ka saamna karte hain ya shahar mein unke baal bachchon ka khaana kam parne lagta hai,

Abu moosa ashaari (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Ashaari log jab yuddh mein khaane-peene ki cheezon ki kami ka saamna karte hain ya shahar mein unke baal bachchon ka khaana kam parne lagta hai, to sab log jo kuchh paas mein hota hai, ek kapre mein jama kar dete hain aur phir ek bartan se aapas mein baraabar baant lete hain. Atah, we mujhse hain aur main unse hoon.”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5544: Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah qayaamat ke din kahegaah ai aadam ke putr, main beemaar tha, to tu mera haal jaanne nahin aya.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah qayaamat ke din kahegaah ai aadam ke putr, main beemaar tha, to tu mera haal jaanne nahin aya. Woh kahegaah ai mere rab, main kaise tera haal jaanne jaata, jabki tu samast sansaar ka rab hai? Allah kahegaah kya tu nahin jaanta ki mera amuk banda beemaar tha aur tu uska haal jaanne nahin gaya? Kya tujhe nahin maaloom ki yadi tu uska haal jaanne uske paas jaata, to mujhe uske paas paata? Ai aadam ke putr, mainne tujhse bhojan maanga, lekin toone mujhe bhojan nahin karaya. Woh kahegaah ai mere rab, main tujhe kaise bhojan karaata, jabki tu samast sansaar ka rab hai? Allah kahegaah kya tujhe nahin pata ki mere amuk bande ne tujhse bhojan maanga tha, lekin toone use bhojan nahin karaya? Kya tujhe nahin pata ki yadi toone use bhojan karaya hota, to mujhe uske paas paata? Ai aadam ke putr, mainne tujhse paani maanga, to toone mujhe paani nahin pilaya. Woh kahega, ai mere rab, main kaise tujhko paani pilaata, jabki tu samast sansaar ka rab hai? Allah kahegaah kya tujhe nahin pata ki mere amuk bande ne tujhse paani maanga tha, lekin toone use paani nahin pilaya? Kya tu nahin jaanta ki yadi toone use paani pilaya hota, to tu mujhe uske paas paata?

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah qayaamat ke din kahegaah ai aadam ke putr, main beemaar tha, to tu mera haal jaanne nahin aya. Woh kahegaah ai mere rab, main kaise tera haal jaanne jaata, jabki tu samast sansaar ka rab hai?" Yaani tujhe to iski zaroorat hi nahin hai ki main tera haal jaanne jaaoon. "Allah kahega : Kya tu nahin jaanta ki mera amuk banda beemaar tha aur tu uska haal jaanne nahin gaya? Kya tujhe nahin maaloom ki yadi tu uska haal jaanne uske paas jaata, to mujhe uske paas paata?" Is hadees ke andar Allah taaala ke is kathan mein hai ki main beemaar hua aur tu mera haal jaanne nahin aya, yeh aapatti utpann nahin hoti ki Allah ka beemaar hona to asanbhav hai ki rog hona dosh waala gun hai aur Allah har dosh se pawitr hai. Kyonki yahaan beemaar hone se muraad uske kisi sadaachaari bande ka beemaar hona hai aur Allah ke sadaachaari bande uske khaas log hua karte hain. Yahi kaaran hai Allah ne kaha : Yadi tu use dekhne ke liye jaata, to tu mujhe uske paas paata aur yeh nahin kaha ki tu apne is kaam ka pratiphal mere paas paata, jaisa ki khaane aur peene ke baare mein kaha hai. Yeh daraasal rogi ke sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah se nikat hone ka pramaan hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki ulema ne kaha hai : Rogi jab kisi ke liye dua karta hai ya kisi par baddua karta hai, to is baat ki poori aasha hoti hai ki uski dua grahan ho jaye. Allah ka kathan : "Ai aadam ke putr, mainne tujhse bhojan maanga, lekin toone mujhe bhojan nahin karaya." Yeh baat sab log jaante hain ki Allah apne liye khaana nahin maangta, kyonki uska farmaan hai : "Woh sabko khilaata hai aur use koi nahin khilaata." [soora al-anaaam : 14] woh har cheez se nisprih hai aur use khaane-peene ki aawashyakta nahin hoti. Lekin Allah ka ek banda bhookha tha aur ek vyakti ko pata bhi tha, lekin usne use khaana nahin diya. Allah taaala ne farmaya : "Kya tujhe nahin pata ki yadi toone use bhojan karaya hota, to uska pratiphal mere paas paata?" Yaani uska pratiphal mere paas is tarah paata ki ek neki ka badla das guna se saat sau guna tak aur usse beshumaar guna tak barha hua hota. Allah ka kathan : "Ai aadam ke putr, mainne tujhse paani maanga, to toone mujhe paani nahin pilaya. Woh kahega : Ai mere rab, main kaise tujhko paani pilaata, jabki tu samast sansaar ka rab hai?" Yaani tujhe khaane aur peene ki zaroorat hi nahin hai. "Allah kahega : Kya tujhe nahin pata ki mere amuk bande ne tujhse paani maanga tha, lekin toone use paani nahin pilaya? Kya tu nahin jaanta ki yadi toone use paani pilaya hota, to uska pratiphal mere paas paata?"
5545: “Nishchay Allah aise bande se prem karta hai, jo dharmasheel, dil ka dhani aur dikhaawe se bachne waala ho.”

Saad bin abu waqqaas radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Mainne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : “Nishchay Allah aise bande se prem karta hai, jo dharmasheel, dil ka dhani aur dikhaawe se bachne waala ho.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah apne kuchh bandon se prem karta hai,

Jinmen se ek Allah ke aadeshon ka paalan karne waala aur uski mana ki hui cheezon se bachne waala hai.

Aur doosra dil ka dhani insaan hai, jo Allah ke siwa kisi ke saamne haath na phailaata ho aur apni zaroorton ka izhaar na karta ho.

Allah aise saadhaaran evn saral vyakti se bhi prem karta hai, jo apne rab ki ibaadat karta ho, apne faadye ke kaamon mein laga rahta ho aur is baat ka prayaas na karta ho ki log use jaanen tatha uski prashansa karen.
Kuchh aise gunon ka bayaan, jinse bandon ko Allah ka prem praapt hota hai. Yeh gun hain, Allah ka bhay, winamrata aur Allah ki di hui cheezon par santusht rahna.
5647: Jab koi musalmaan apne beemaar bhaai ka haal jaanne jaata hai, to waapas lautne tak woh Jannat ke phalon ko chunne mein laga hota hai.

Saubaan (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Jab koi musalmaan apne beemaar bhaai ka haal jaanne jaata hai, to waapas lautne tak woh Jannat ke phalon ko chunne mein laga hota hai." Logon ne poochhaah ai Allah ke Rasool, (aapke shabd) "Khuraftul jannah" Se kya abhipray hai? Aapne pharmayaah "Jannat ke phal.”
5648: Ek mahila Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas ek buni hui dhaareedaar chaadar lekar aaeen

Sahl bin saad (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki ek mahila Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas ek buni hui dhaareedaar chaadar lekar aai aur kahne lagi ki mainne ise apne haathon se is iraade se buna hai, taaki aapko pahna sakoon. Nabi (salllalaahu alaihi wa sallam) ne use le liya. Aapko uski aawashyakta bhi thi. Aap use tahband ke roop mein pahankar baahar aye, to amuk vyakti ne kahaah yeh to bari achchhi chaadar hai. Ise aap mujhe pahna den. Aapne kahaah "Awashy!" Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) sabha mein baithe. Phir uthkar andar gae. Chaadar ko lapeta aur maangne waale ko bhej diya. Yeh dekh logon ne usse kahaah tumne achchha nahin kiya. Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne use pahan liya tha aur aapko uski zaroorat bhi thi. Phir bhi tumne use maang liya, jabki tum jaante ho ki aap kisi maangne waale ko waapas nahin karte. Ispar usne uttar diyaah Allah ki qasam, mainne use pahanne ke liye nahin maanga hai, balki isliye maanga hai ki woh mere kafan ke kaam aye. Sahl kahte hainh chunaanche wahi chaadar unka kafan bani tha.
[ise bukhaari ne inheen jaise shabdon ke saath riwayat kiya hai .]
5649: Juhaina naamak qabeele ki ek stri Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aai, jo vyabhichaar ke kaaran garbhavti thi.

Imraan bin husain (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki juhaina naamak qabeele ki ek stri Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aai, jo vyabhichaar ke kaaran garbhavti thi, tatha boleeh ai Allah ke rasoolah main had (dand) ki paatr hoon. Atah aap mere oopar had jaari keejiye. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne uske wali (abhibhaawak) ko bulaya aur farmayaah "Iske saath achchha vyavhaar karna aur jab prasav ho jaye, to ise mere paas le aana." Unhonne aisa hi kiya. Phir Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke aadesh se uske kapre kaskar baandh diye gae. Phir aapke aadesh se use sangsaar kar diya gaya. Phir aapne uske janaaze ki namaz parhaai.
5650: Allah ka naam lekar main aapka ilaaj karta hoon, pratyek us cheez se jo aapko kasht de, pratyek praani ki buraai athva eershya karne waali aankh se. Allah aapko shifa de. Allah ka naam lekar main aaka ilaaj karta hoon.

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki jibreel (alaihissalaam) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aye aur boleh ai Muhammad, kya aapko takleef hai? Aapne kahaah haan, to unhonne yeh dua parheeh “Allah ka naam lekar main aapka ilaaj karta hoon, pratyek us cheez se jo aapko kasht de, pratyek praani ki buraai athva eershya karne waali aankh se. Allah aapko shifa de. Allah ka naam lekar main aaka ilaaj karta hoon.”
5651: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas koi peene ki wastu laai gai, to aapne usmen se piya. Us samay aapki dayen or ek baalak tha.

Sahl bin saad (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas koi peene ki wastu laai gai, to aapne usmen se piya. Us samay aapki dayen or ek baalak tha tatha bayen or bare-buzurg. Aapne baalak se kahaah "Kya tumhaari or se ijaazat hai ki main (tumse pahle) in logon ko doon?" Baalak ne uttar diyaah nahin! Ai Allah ke Rasool, main aapse milne waale apne hisse par kisi aur ko wareeyta nahin de sakta. Atah, rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne use uske haath mein de diya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5652: Tummen se koi hargiz mrityu ki tamanna na kare. Yadi woh nek hai, to sanbhav hai ki woh aur nekiyaan kare. Aur yadi gunahgaar hai, to sanbhav hai ki tauba kar le.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Tummen se koi hargiz mrityu ki tamanna na kare. Yadi woh nek hai, to sanbhav hai ki woh aur nekiyaan kare. Aur yadi gunahgaar hai, to sanbhav hai ki tauba kar le.”
Ek riwayat mein is prakaar hai ki rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Tummen se koi hargiz mrityu ki tamanna na kare aur na uske aane se pahle uski dua kare. Jab woh mar jayega, to uske karmon ka silsila ruk jayega. Tatha ek momin ki ayu uski bhalaaiyon hi mein izaafa karti hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5653: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab khaana khaate, to apni teenon ungliyon ko chaat lete.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) se warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab khaana khaate, to apni teenon ungliyon ko chaat lete. Woh kahte hain ki aapne farmayaah "Jab tummen se kisi ka koi luqma gir jaye, to use uthaakar gandgi saaph karke kha le tatha usko shaitaan ke liye na chhore." Aapne yeh bhi aadesh diya ki pyaale ko ungli se ponchhkar saaph kar liya jaye farmaya: "Tum nahin jaante ki khaane ke kis bhaag mein barkat hai."
Tatha jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Tumhaare pratyek kaary ke samay shaitaan haazir rahta hai. Yahaan tak ki khaane ke samay bhi maujood hota hai. Atah jab tummen se kisi ka koi luqma gir jaye, to use uthaakar gandgi saaf karke kha le aur usko shaitaan ke liye na chhore. Phir jab khaana samaapt kar le, to apni ungliyon ko chaat le. Kyonki woh nahin jaanta ki khaane kis bhaag mein barkat hai."
[ise imaam Muslim ne donon riwayton ke saath naqal kiya hai.]
5654: Umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) ne pahle hijrat karne waale muhaajiron ke liye penshan ki raashi nirdhaarit ki.

Naaphe se warnit hai ki umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) ne pahle hijrat karne waale muhaajiron ke liye penshan ki raashi chaar hazaar nirdhaarit ki, to apne bete ke liye teen hazaar paanch sau. Aise mein unse kaha gaya ki jab woh ek muhaajir hain, to aapne unke liye kam raashi kyon nirdhaarit ki? Ispar unhonne uttar diyaah unhonne hijrat apne pita ke saath ki thi. Atah, woh un logon ke jaise nahin ho sakte, jinhonne svayn hijrat ki hai.
5655: Madeene ki daasiyon mein se koi daasi Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka haath pakar leti aur aapko jahaan chaahti, le jaati.
Anas (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki madeene ki daasiyon mein se koi daasi Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka haath pakar leti aur aapko jahaan chaahti, le jaati.
5656: Main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas pahuncha, to us samay aap khutba de rahe the.

Abu rifaaa tameem bin usaid (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas pahuncha, to us samay aap khutba de rahe the. Mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, main ek ajanbi aadmi hoon, jo apne dharm ke wishay mein jnaan arjit karne aya hai. Woh nahin jaanta hai ki uska dharm kya hai. Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) meri or mutvajjeh hue aur apna khutba chhor diya, yahaan tak ki mere nikat a gae. Chunaanche ek kursi laai gai aur aap uspar baithkar mujhe woh baaten sikhaane lage, jo Allah ne aapko sikhaai hain. Phir aakar khutba diya aur uske shesh bhaag ko poora kiya.
5657: Beshak tum apne rab ko usi tarah dekhoge, jaise is chaand ko dekh rahe ho. Use dekhne mein tumhen koi diqqat nahin hogi

Jareer bin abdullah se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Ham Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas the ki aapne ek raat -chaudahveen ki raat- chaand ki taraf dekhkar farmaya : "Beshak tum apne rab ko usi tarah dekhoge, jaise is chaand ko dekh rahe ho. Use dekhne mein tumhen koi diqqat nahin hogi. Atah yadi tumse ho sake ki sooraj nikalne aur doobne se pahle ki namaazon par kisi cheez ko haawi (prabhaawit) na hone do, to aisa zaroor karo." Phir aapne yeh ayat parhi : {وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ الْغُرُوبِ} (tatha sooryoday se pahle aur sooryaast se pahle apne rab ki prashansa ke saath pawitrata bayaan kar.)

Ek din raat ke samay sahaaba Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath the. Isi beech aapne chaudahveen ki raat ko chaand ki or dekha aur farmaya : Eemaam waale apne rab ko apni aankhon se dekh sakenge aur unko use dekhne mein koi pareshaani evn kathinaai nahin hogi. Phir Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Agar tum fajr evn asr ki namaz se rokne waali cheezon ko khatm kar sako, to unko khatm kar do aur in donon namaazon ko samay par sanpoorn tareeqe se parha karo, kyonki yeh Allah ke chehre ko dekhne ka saubhaagy pradaan karne waali cheezon mein se ek hai. Phir aapne yeh ayat parhi : {وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ الْغُرُوبِ} (tatha sooryoday se pahle aur sooryaast se pahle apne rab ki prashansa ke saath pawitrata bayaan kar.)

Eemaan waalon ke liye yeh khushkhabri ki unko Jannat mein Allah ka deedaar naseeb hoga.
Taakeed paida karna, prerna dena aur udaahran prastut karna aahvaan ki paddhatiyaan hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5658: “Nishchay hi quraan waale ka udaahran rassi se bandhe hue oonton ke maalik ke samaan hai. Yadi woh unki theek se dekhbhaal karega, to unhen apne paas rakhne mein saphal hoga aur agar unhen chhor dega, to we bhaag khare honge.”

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : “Nishchay hi quraan waale ka udaahran rassi se bandhe hue oonton ke maalik ke samaan hai. Yadi woh unki theek se dekhbhaal karega, to unhen apne paas rakhne mein saphal hoga aur agar unhen chhor dega, to we bhaag khare honge.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne Qur'an parhne aur uski tilaawat karne waale -tilaawat chaahe mushaf ko dekhkar kare ya yaad hone ke kaaran zubaani- ko aise vyakti ke samaan bataya hai, jisne rassi se oont baandh rakha ho. Agar wo uski dekhbhaal karta rahega, to oont ko apne paas rakhe rahne mein saphal rahega aur agar rassi khol dega, to oont bhaag jayega. Isi tarah Qur'an parhne waala jab use parhta rahega, to yaad rakhne mein saphal rahega aur jab parhna band kar dega, to bhool baithega. Matlab yeh ki jab tak dekhbhaal hai, to suraksha hai.

Qur'an se jure rahne tatha uski tilaawat karne ki prerna evn use bhoolne dene se satark rahne ki chetaavni.
Kuraan ko niymit roop se parhne se zubaan uski aadi ban jaati hai aur uska paath karna aasaan ho jaata hai. Agar use chhor diya jaye to parhna mushkil aur bojhil ho jaata hai.
Qaazi kahte hain : Is hadees mein aye hue shabd 'صاحب القرآن' ka arth hai : Qur'an ko chaahne waala. Arbi ke shabd 'المصاحبة' ka arth hai : Chaahat. Isi aadhaar par arbi mein kaha jaata hai : 'فلان صاحب فلان' (amuk amuk ka chaahne waala hai) tatha 'أصحاب الجنة' (Jannat ki chaahat rakhne waale log) evn 'أصحاب النار' (Jahannam ki chaahat rakhne waale log).
Aahvaan ka ek tareeqa yeh hai ki udaahran prastut kiye jayen.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Yahaan wishesh roop se oont ka ullekh isliye kiya gaya hai ki oont paaltu jaanavron mein sabse zyaada bidakne waala jaanvar hai. Ek baar bidak jaye, to pakarna aasaan nahin rahta.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5659: Woh kuchh bachchon ke paas se guzre, to unko salaam kiya aur kaha ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aisa kiya karte the.
Anas (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki woh kuchh bachchon ke paas se guzre, to unko salaam kiya aur kaha ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aisa kiya karte the.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5731: Jahaan tak is vyakti ki baat hai, to isne abul qaasim (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki awajna ki.

Abu shaasa kahte hain ki ham log abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ke saag masjid mein baithe hue the ki isi beech moazzin ne azaan di. Itne mein ek vyakti khara hokar masjid se jaane laga, to abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) use lagaataar dekhte rahe, yahaan tak ki jab woh masjid se nikal gaya, to farmayaah jahaan tak is vyakti ki baat hai, to isne abul qaasim (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki awajna ki.
5732: Jise khushbu bhent ki jaye, woh use na lautaye. Kyonki woh uthaane mein halki tatha sugandhit hoti hai.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jise khushbu bhent ki jaye, woh use na lautaye. Kyonki woh uthaane mein halki tatha sugandhit hoti hai."
Jise khushbu bhent ki jaye ya khushbu lagaane ki peshkash ki jaye, use grahan kar lena chahiye. Kyonki ek to use saath rakhna kuchh kathin nahin hai aur phir uska gandh bhi achchha hota hai.
5733: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam khushbu (pushpasaar) waapas nahin karte the.
Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam khushbu (pushpasaar) waapas nahin karte the.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki aadat yeh thi ki koi khushbu de, to grahan kar lete the. Waapas nahin karte the. Kyonki ise saath rakhna aasaan hai aur yeh sugandhit hoti hai.

Khushbu ka bhent sveekaar karna musathab hai. Kyonki ise saath rakhna kathin nahin hai aur ise sveekaar karne se kisi ke upkaar ke bojh tale dabna nahin parta.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke aachran ki sanpoornata tatha sundarta is baat se bhi jhalakti hai ki aap khushbu waapas nahin karte the aur bhent karne waale ke bhent ko sveekaar kar liya karte the.
Khushbu istemaal karne ki prerna.
5734: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek vyakti ko kisi ki prashansa karte hue suna, jo uski prashansa karne mein atishyokti kar raha tha, to aapne pharmayaah "Tumne use halaak kar diya." Athva "Tumne uski peeth kaat di."

Abu moosa ashaari (radiyallahu anhu) se warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek vyakti ko kisi ki prashansa karte hue suna, jo uski prashansa karne mein atishyokti kar raha tha, to aapne pharmayaah "Tumne use halaak kar diya." Athva "Tumne uski peeth kaat di."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5735: Tera naash ho, toone apne saathi ki gardan kaat di.

Abu bakra (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas ek vyakti ka ullekh hua, to doosre vyakti ne uski bari prashansa ki. Aise mein Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Tera naash ho, toone apne saathi ki gardan kaat di." Yeh baat aapne baar-baar kahi. (Phir aage kahaah) "Yadi tummen se kisi ko prashansa karni hi ho, to kaheh main aisa-aisa gumaan rakhta hoon, yadi woh usko waisa hi samajhta ho, aur uska hisaab lene waala Allah hai tatha Allah ke wiruddh kisi ke dosharhit hone ki gawaahi nahin di jayegi."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5736: Jab tum (kisi ke saamne uski) prashansa karne waalon ko dekho, to unke munh par mitti daal do.

Miqdaad (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ek vyakti usmaan (radiyallahu anhu) ki prashansa karne laga, to miqdaad apne ghutne ke bal baith gae tatha apni mutthi mein kankar uthaakar unke mukh par phenkne lage. Yeh dekh usmaan (radiyallahu anhu) ne kahaah yeh tum kya kar rahe ho? Unhonne uttar diyaah mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue suna haih “Jab tum (kisi ke saamne uski) prashansa karne waalon ko dekho, to unke munh par mitti daal do.”
5737: Jab tumhen dharti ke kisi bhaag mein taaoon (pleg) phailne ka samaachaar mile, to wahaan na jaao aur yadi aisi jagah phaile jahaan tum (pahle se) upasthit ho, to phir wahaan se na bhaago.

Usaama bin zaid (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Jab tumhen dharti ke kisi bhaag mein taaoon (pleg) phailne ka samaachaar mile, to wahaan na jaao aur yadi aisi jagah phaile jahaan tum (pahle se) upasthit ho, to phir wahaan se na bhaago.”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5738: Rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne is baat se mana farmaya ki shatru ki dharti ki or Qur'an lekar safar kiya jaye.
Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ki rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne is baat se mana farmaya ki shatru ki dharti ki or Qur'an lekar safar kiya jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5771: Main dekh raha hoon ki tujhe bakri tatha dehaat pasand hai. Atah, jab tum bakriyon ke saath raho

Abdullah bin abdur rahmaan bin abu saasaa se warnit hai ki abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) ne unse farmayaah main dekh raha hoon ki tujhe bakri tatha dehaat pasand hai. Atah, jab tum bakriyon ke saath raho (athva dehaat mein raho) aur namaz ke liye azaan do, to aawaaz oonchi karna. Kyonki muazzin ki aawaaz, jo bhi jinn athva insaan aur jo bhi wastu sunegi, woh qayaamaat ke din uske liेe mein gawaahi degi. Abu saeed (radiyallahu anhu) ne farmayaah yeh baat mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se suni hai.
5772: Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko ek jangli gadha bhent kiya

Saab bin jassaama (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko ek jangli gadha bhent kiya, to mujhe waapas kar diya. Lekin jab mere chehre par gham ke nishaan dekhe, to farmaya : "Hamne ise kewal isliye tumhen waapas kiya hai, kyonki ham ehraam ki awastha mein hain."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5773: Sabse adhik achchha vyakti kaun hai ai Allah ke Rasool?

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se marfooan warnit hai ki ek vyakti ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Sabse adhik achchha vyakti kaun hai? Aapne farmayaah "Woh momin, jo praan tatha dhan ke saath Allah ke raaste mein jihaad karta hai." Usne kahaah phir kaun? Farmayaah "Phir woh vyakti, jo ekaant mein kisi ghaati mein apne rab ki wandna karta hai aur logon ko apni buraai se bachaata hai."
Ek riwayat mein hai : "Allah se bhay khaata hai tatha logon ko apni buraai se bachaata hai."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha gaya ki kaun-sa vyakti sabse achchha hai? To bataya ki sabse achchha vyakti woh hai, jo apne dhan evn praan ke saath Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karta hai. Phir poochha gaya ki uske baad sabse achchha vyakti kaun hai? To bataya ki woh vyakti jo kisi ghaati mein rahkar ekaant mein apne rab ki ibaadat karta hai aur logon ko apni buraai se surakshit rakhta hai. Yaani woh logon se alag hokar Allah ki ibaadat karta hai aur yeh nahin chaahta ki kisi ko usse koi kasht ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai aur shabd Muslim ke hain.]
5774: Ek baar ayyoob (alaihissalaam) nagn hokar snaan kar rahe the ki unpar sone ki tiddi girne lagi.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Ek baar ayyoob (alaihissalaam) nagn hokar snaan kar rahe the ki unpar sone ki tiddi girne lagi aur ayyoob (alaihissalaam) unhen apne kapre mein sametne lage. Usi samay uchch evn mahaan Allah ne aawaaz di : Ai ayyoob! Jo tum dekh rahe ho, kya mainne tumhen unse beniyaaz nahin kiya tha? Ayyoob (alaihissalaam) ne kaha : Teri izzat ki qasam! Kyon nahin, lekin main teri daya se beniyaaz nahin ho sakta."
5775: Jibreel (alaihissalaam) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas baithe hue the ki oopar se ek aawaaz suni.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki jibreel (alaihissalaam) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas baithe hue the ki oopar se ek aawaaz suni, to apna sir uthaya aur farmayaah yeh aakaash ka ek dvaar hai, jo aaj khola gaya hai aur isse poorv kabhi khola nahin gaya tha aur usse ek farishta utra. Tatha (jibreel ne aage) kaha : Yeh dharti par utarne waala ek pharishta hai, jo isse poorv kabhi nahin utra tha. Usne salaam kiya aur kahaah do noor ki shubhsoochna leejiye, jo aapko diye gae hain aapse poorv kisi Nabi ko nahin diye gae the. Donon noor hain, soora faatiha aur soora baqra ki antim ayten. Inka jo bhi shabd aap parhenge, unke andar maangi gai cheezen aapko di jayengi.
5776: Ek vyakti ek sunsaan maidaan mein chal raha tha ki usne baadal se ek aawaaz suni.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Ek vyakti ek sunsaan maidaan mein chal raha tha ki usne baadal se ek aawaaz suni ki amuk vyakti ke baag ki sinchaai kar do. Chunaanche baadal wahaan se hat gaya aur ek kaale patthar waali dharti mein baras gaya aur ek naali ne uska saara paani apne andar samet liya. Us aadmi ne paani ka peechha karna aaranbh kiya, to dekha ki ek vyakti apne baagheecha ke paas khara kudaal se paani idhar-udhar kar raha hai. Usne kaha : Ai Allah ke bande, tera naam kya hai? Kahaah amuk! Yeh wahi naam tha, jo usne baadal mein suna tha. Usne kaha : Ai Allah ke bande, tum mujhse mera naam kyon poochh rahe ho? Usne kaha : Mainne usi baadal se, jiska yeh paani hai, ek aawaaz suni hai ki amuk vyakti ke baagheeche ki sinchaai kar do, jo ki daraasal tumhaara hi naam tha. Aakhir tum ismen karte kya ho? Usne uttar diya : Jab tumne yeh baat chher hi di hai, to main bata deta hoon. Baat daraasal yeh hai ki main dekhta hoon ki iski upaj kitni hai, phir uske teen bhaag ka ek bhaag daan kar deta hoon tatha main aur mera pariwaar ek bhaag ka upbhog karte hain aur ek bhaag isi bhoomi par kharch kar deta hoon."
5787: Atyaachaar se bacho, kyonki atyaachaar qayaamat ke din andheron ke roop mein saamne ayega. Ati kanjoosi se bacho, kyonki ati kanjoosi ne tumse poorv ke logon ka winaash kiya hai.

Jaabir bin abdullah radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Atyaachaar se bacho, kyonki atyaachaar qayaamat ke din andheron ke roop mein saamne ayega. Ati kanjoosi se bacho, kyonki ati kanjoosi ne tumse poorv ke logon ka winaash kiya hai. Isi ne unhen rakt bahaane tatha mahram aurton ko halaal bana lene par ubhaara."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne zulm (atyaachaar) se saavdhaan kiya hai. Zulm logon par bhi hota hai, apne oopar bhi hota hai aur Allah ke adhikaar mein bhi hota hai. Zulm naam hai haqdaar ko uska haq na dene ka. Atyaachaar qayaamat ke din atyaachaariyon par andhkaar banega. Yaani uske kaaran kathinaaiyon evn bhayaawah paristhitiyon ka saamna karna parega. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne laalachyukt atyadhik kanjoosi se bhi mana farmaya hai. Iske dayre mein aarthik adhikaaron ki adaygi mein kami aur prabal saansaarik moh bhi daakhil hai. Zulm ke isi prakaar ne hamse pahle ki ummaton ka winaash kiya hai. Kyonki isne unhen ek-doosre ki jaan lene aur Allah ki haraam ki hui cheezon ko halaal karne par uksaya.

Kharch karne aur sukh-dukh mein saath dene ke nateeje mein muhabbat aur aapas mein juraav paida hota hai.
Kanjoosi aur laalach awajnaakaariyon, behyaaiyon aur gunaahon ka sabab banta hai.
Hamen pichhli ummaton ke haalaat se shiksha grahan karna chahiye.
5788: Jab pati apni patni ko sahvaas ke liye bulaye, to woh awashy aye, yadyapi woh choolhe ke paas hi kyon na ho.

Abu ali talq bin ali (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Jab pati apni patni ko sahvaas ke liye bulaye, to woh awashy aye, yadyapi woh choolhe ke paas hi kyon na ho."

Jab koi vyakti apni stri ko sahvaas ke liye bulaye, to woh uske paas zaroor jaye, yadyapi woh kisi aise kaam mein vyast ho, jo uske siwa koi aur na kar sakta ho. Maslan roti paka rahi ho ya khaana bana rahi ho.
5789: Jab tummen se kisi ko namaz parhne ki dasha mein neend aye, to so jaye, yahaan tak neend khatm ho jaye.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Jab tummen se kisi ko namaz parhne ki dasha mein neend aye, to so jaye, yahaan tak neend khatm ho jaye. Kyonki oonghte hue jab koi namaz parhta hai, to woh nahin jaan paata ki apne liye kshama ki dua kar raha hai ya apne haq mein baddua kar raha hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5790: Mujhe meri chaadar la do. Dekho, yadi mere paas is kaantedaar per ke samaan bhi jaanvar hote, to main unhen tumhaare beech baant deta. Phir tum mujhe kanjoos evn jhootha tatha kayar nahin paate.

Jubair bin mutaim (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki we hunain se lautte hue Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath chal rahe the ki kuchh dehaati aapse maangne lage aur aise lipat gae ki aapko keekar ke ek per tak lekar chale gae, jismen aapki chaadar atak gai. Atah, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) khare ho gae aur farmaya : "Mujhe meri chaadar la do. Dekho, yadi mere paas is kaantedaar per ke samaan bhi jaanvar hote, to main unhen tumhaare beech baant deta. Phir tum mujhe kanjoos evn jhootha tatha kayar nahin paate."
5791: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek azdi vyakti, jise ibn al-lutbiya kaha jaata tha, ko zakat ka dhan ikattha karne ka zimmewaar banaya. Jab woh waapas aya, to bola : Yeh aap logon ka hai aur yeh mujhe bhent svaroop diya gaya hai. Yeh dekh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) minbar par khare hue tatha Allah ki baraai wa prashansa ki

Abu humaid saaidi (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek azdi vyakti, jise ibn al-lutbiya kaha jaata tha, ko zakat ka dhan ikattha karne ka zimmewaar banaya. Jab woh waapas aya, to bola : Yeh aap logon ka hai aur yeh mujhe bhent svaroop diya gaya hai. Yeh dekh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) minbar par khare hue tatha Allah ki baraai wa prashansa ki aur farmaya : "Main tummen se kisi vyakti ko unmen se kisi kaary ka zimmewaar banaata hoon, jinki zimmewaari Allah ne mujhe di hai aur woh aakar kahta hai ki yeh aapka hai aur yeh mujhe bhent svaroop mila hai. Yadi woh sachcha hai, to woh kyon apne maata-pita ke ghar baitha nahin raha ki uske paas (ghar baithe hi) bhent a jaate!! Allah ki qasam, jo bhi vyakti kisi wastu ko bina adhikaar lega, woh qayaamat ke din Allah ke sammukh use uthaye hue ayega. Atah, main tummen se kisi aise vyakti ko hargiz nahin pahchaanoonga, jo Allah se is awastha mein milega ki oont uthaye hoga, jo bilbila raha hoga, gay uthaye hue hoga, jo raanbh rahi hogi ya bakri uthaye hue hoga, jo mimya rahi hogi." Phir aapne donon haath uthaye, yahaan tak ki aapke bagal ki safedi dikhaai dene lagi. Phir farmaya : "Ai Allah, kya mainne pahuncha diya?"
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5792: Sabse sampoorn eemaan waala vyakti woh hai, jo sabse achchhe aachran waala ho aur tumhaare andar sabse uttam vyakti woh hai, jo apni patniyon ke haq mein sabse achchha ho.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Sabse sampoorn eemaan waala vyakti woh hai, jo sabse achchhe aachran waala ho aur tumhaare andar sabse uttam vyakti woh hai, jo apni patniyon ke haq mein sabse achchha ho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki sabse sanpoorn aachran waala vyakti woh hai, jiska aachran sabse achchha ho. Aachran achchha hone ka matlab yeh hai ki hanskar mila jaye, logon ka bhala kiya jaye, achchhe dhang se baat ki jaye aur kisi ko kasht dene se bacha jaye.

Jabki sabse uttam eemaan waala vyakti woh hai, jo apne ghar ki  aurton, maslan, patni, betiyon, bahnon aur any rishtedaar mahilaaon ke saath achchha vyavhaar karta ho. Kyonki yeh aurten achchhe aachran ki sabse adhik haqdaar hain.

Achchhe aachran ki fazeelat tatha uska eemaan ka ang hona.
Amal bhi eemaan ka ang hai aur eemaan ghatta tatha barhta hai.
Islam ka aurat ko sammaan dena tatha uske saath achchha vyavhaar karna ki prerna.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5793: Kya tum nahin sunte? Kya tum nahin sunte? Nishchay hi saadgi aur saralta eemaan ki nishaani hai. Nishchay hi saadgi aur saralta eemaan ki pahchaan hai.

Abu umaama iyaas bin saalba ansaari haarisi (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ek din Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saathiyon ne aapke saamne duniya ki charcha ki, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Kya tum nahin sunte? Kya tum nahin sunte? Nishchay hi saadgi aur saralta eemaan ki nishaani hai. Nishchay hi saadgi aur saralta eemaan ki pahchaan hai."
[hasan li-ghairihi (any sandon athva riwayton ke saath milkar hasan)]
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5794: Duniya ek kshanik upbhog ki wastu hai aur uski sarvashreth wastu nek stri hai.
Abdullah bin amr radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Duniya ek kshanik upbhog ki wastu hai aur uski sarvashreth wastu nek stri hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki duniya aur usmen jo kuchh bhi hai, daraasal kshanik upbhog ki wastu hai, jiske baad use khatm ho jaana hai tatha is naashvaan duniya ki sabse uttam wastu aisi nek patni hai ki jab uska pati uski or dekhe to use prasann kar de, jab use aadesh de to uska paalan kare aur jab use chhorkar kaheen jaye to woh apne aap ki tatha apne pati ke dhan ki raksha kare.

Duniya ki pawitr cheezon se jinhen Allah ne apne bandon ke liye halaal kiya hai, laabhaanvit hona jayaz hai. Bas shart yeh hai ki phizoolkharchi aur abhimaan na ho.
Nek patni ke chayan ki prerna, kyonki woh Allah ke aajnaapaalan mein apne pati ki sahayta karti hai.
Duniya ka sabse achchha saamaan woh hai, jo Allah ke aajnaapaalan mein kaam aye ya usmen sahyog kare.
5795: Dharm aasaan evn saral hai aur dharm ke maamle mein jo bhi ugrata dikhayega, woh paraast hoga. Atah, beech ka raasta apnaao, achchha karne ki cheshta karo,

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Dharm aasaan evn saral hai aur dharm ke maamle mein jo bhi ugrata dikhayega, woh paraast hoga. Atah, beech ka raasta apnaao, achchha karne ki cheshta karo, neki ki aasha rakho tatha praatah evn shaam aur raat ke andhere mein ibaadat karke sahayta praapt karo."

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne bayaan farmaya ki Islam dharm apne sabhi maamlon mein aasaani aur saralta par aadhaarit hai. Aur yeh aasaani us samay aur bhi pukhta ho jaati hai jab kamjori (asmarthata) aur zaroorat ka koi kaaran maujood ho. Aur kyonki dhaarmik kaaryon mein gahraai (bahut sakhti) apnaane aur narmi chhor dene ka parinaam asmarthata aur poore kaam ya uske kuchh hisse se ruk jaana hai. Uske baad Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne santulit rahne ki prerna di hai. Banda sharai aadeshon ke anupaalan mein na to kotaahi se kaam le aur na apne oopar aisi cheezen laade, jinhen uthaane ki shakti na rakhta ho. Agar sanpoornatam par amal na kar sake, to uske nikattam par amal kare.

Uske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aise vyakti ko bare pratiphal ka susmaachaar sunaya hai, jo sanpoornatam par amal na kar paane ke kaaran thora-sa amal hi karta ho, usmen nirantarta rakhta ho. Kyonki jab wiwashta mein bande ka koi haath na ho, to usse pratiphal mein kami nahin hoti.

Phir choonki duniya yaatra ka sthaan hai aur yaheen se aakhirat ka maarg tay hota hai, isliye Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne chusti ke teen samyon mein nirantarta ke saath ibaadat dvaara sahyog praapt karne ka aadesh diya hai. Ye teen samay is prakaar hain :

1- din ke pahle bhaag mein chalna. Din ke pahle bhaag mein chalne se muraad fajr ki namaz se lekar sooraj nikalne ke beech ka samay hai.

2- sooraj dhalne ke baad chalna.

3- poori raat ya raat ke kuchh bhaag mein chalna. Choonki raat mein kaam karna din mein kaam karne ki tulna mein kaheen adhik kathin hota hai, isliye "Raat ke kuchh bhaag mein" Kahkar uske kuchh bhaag mein kaam karne ka aadesh diya hai.

Islam ek aasaan, udaar evn santulit dharm hai. Ismen na  ati durust hai, na kotaahi.
Insaan ko koi bhi kaam apne saamarthy ke anusaar karna chahiye. Na susti dikhe, na ati.
Insaan ko ibaadat ke liye aise samyon ka chayan karna chahiye, jab tabeeyat mein chusti ho. Uparyukt teen samay aise hain ki unmen shareer ibaadat ke liye sabse adhik tatpar rahta hai.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Yahaan ek tarah se Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kisi gantavy ki or yaatra kar rahe vyakti ko sanbodhit kiya hai. Choonki is hadees ke andar bayaan kiye gae teen samay yaatra ke liye sabse upyukt samay hain, isliye Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne inhen chihnit kar diya. Kyonki yadi yaatri raat-din chalta hi rah jaye, to kuchh doori tay karne ke baad thak haarkar baith jayega. Iske wipreet agar in anukool samyon mein chale aur uske baad aaraam kar le, to yaatra ko jaari rakhna aasaan ho jayega.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Is hadees mein rukhsat (sharai chhoot) par amal karne ki or sanket hai. Kyonki jahaan chhoot ho, wahaan usse fayda na uthaana atiwaad hai. Maslan kisi ke liye paani ka prayog warjit ho aur woh tayammum ki bajay wazu karne ki zid par ara hua ho aur iski wajah se uska nuqsaan ho jaye, to yahi atiwaad hai.
Ibn al-munaiyir kahte hain : Yeh hadees Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke sachche Nabi hone ki ek bahut bari nishaani hai. Khud hamne aur hamse pahle ke logon ne bhi dekha hai ki shakti se adhik amal ka bojh uthaane ki koshish karne waala har vyakti thak-haar kar baith jaata hai. Lekin yeh bhi yaad rahe ki yahaan ibaadat ki sanpoornatam paddhati apnaane se mana nahin kiya gaya hai. Yeh to ek saraahneey baat hai. Mana atiwaad se kiya gaya hai, jo thak-haar kar baith jaane ka sabab banta hai. Jaise koi vyakti raat bhar tahajjud parhkar so jaye aur fajr ki namaz jamaat ke saath ada na kar sake ya phir sooraj nikalne tak soya hi rah jaye.
5796: Dayaaluta jismen bhi hoti hai, use sundar bana deti hai aur jisse nikaal li jaati hai, use kuroop kar deti hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki patni aaisha radiyallahu anha se warnit hai ki aapne farmaya : "Dayaaluta jismen bhi hoti hai, use sundar bana deti hai aur jisse nikaal li jaati hai, use kuroop kar deti hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki narmi aur baat tatha kaary mein sanyam rakhna cheezon ki sundar tatha sanpoornata mein wriddhi kar deti hai aur isse is baat ki sanbhaavna barh jaati hai ki insaan ki zaroorat poori ho jaye.
