Jabki narmi ka na hona cheezon ko doshpoorn tatha kuroop bana deti hai aur insaan ki zaroorat ki poorti ke maarg mein rukaawat khari kar deti hai. Zaroorat poori ho bhi jaye, to kathinaai ke saath poori hoti hai.

Narmi apnaane ki prerna.
Narmi insaan ke vyaktitv ko sundar banaati hai aur yeh deen tatha duniya ki har bhalaai ka sabab hai.
5797: Nishchay hi Allah dayaalu hai aur woh pratyek wastu mein dayaaluta ko pasand karta hai.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Nishchay hi Allah dayaalu hai aur woh pratyek wastu mein dayaaluta ko pasand karta hai."
Unhi se warnit hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Nishchay hi Allah dayaalu hai aur woh dayaaluta ko pasand karta hai tatha dayaaluta ke kaaran woh cheez deta hai, jo kroorta evn uske siwa doosri cheez par nahin deta."
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5798: Nishchay Allah bande ki is baat se khush hota hai ki banda kuchh khaye to uspar Allah ki prashansa kare aur kuchh piye to uspar Allah ki prashansa kare.

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Nishchay Allah bande ki is baat se khush hota hai ki banda kuchh khaye to uspar Allah ki prashansa kare aur kuchh piye to uspar Allah ki prashansa kare."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki Allah ke anugrah tatha uski nemton par bande ke dvaara ki gai Allah ki preshansa se Allah prasann hota hai. Jab banda khaana khaata hai aur al-hamdu lillah (saari preshansa Allah ki hai) kahta hai tatha koi cheez peeta hai aur al-hamdu lillah (saari prashansa Allah ki hai) kahta hai, to Allah prasannat hota hai.

Allah ka anugrah ki wahi rozi bhi deta hai aur prashansa se prasann bhi hota hai.
Allah ki prasannata khaane tatha peene ke baad uski prashansa karne jaise chhote-chhote se kaam se bhi praapt hoti hai.
Khaane tatha peene ke niymon mein se yeh hai ki khaane tatha peene ke baad Allah ki prashansa ki jaye.
5799: Momin apne achchhe aachran ke kaaran rozedaar aur tahajjud guzaar ka darja praapt kar leta hai.

Aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Mainne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko farmaate hue soona : "Momin apne achchhe aachran ke kaaran rozedaar aur tahajjud guzaar ka darja praapt kar leta hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki achchha aachran insaan ko nirantar roop se roza rakhne waale aur tahajjud parhne waale vyakti ke sthaan par laakar khara kar deta hai. Yaad rahe ki achchha aachran naam hai, bhala karne, achchhi baat kahne, hanskar milne, kisi ko kasht na dene aur koi kasht de, to sabr karne ka.

Islam ne maanav aachran ko wishuddh evn sanpoorn banaane par bahut zyaada dhyaan diya hai.
Achchhe aachran ka mahatv itna hai ki insaan iske zariye nirantar roop se roza rakhne aur bina thake tahajjud parhne waale ka sthaan praapt kar leta hai.
Din mein roza rakhna aur raat mein tahajjud parhna, donon bare-bare amal hain aur donon ko karte samay insaan ko kasht hota hai. Lekin achchhe aachran waala insaan inka sthaan isliye praapt kar leta hai ki iske liye insaan ko apne aapse larna parta hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5800: Tumhaare svabhaav mein do aisi baaten hain, jinhen Allah pasand karta hai : Sahansheelta aur dhairy.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallm) ne abdul qais ke ashajj naami vyakti se farmaya : "Tumhaare svabhaav mein do aisi baaten hain, jinhen Allah pasand karta hai : Sahansheelta aur dhairy."
5801: Nishchay hi tumpar tumhaare rab ka adhikaar hai. Nishchay hi tumpar svany tumhaare shareer tatha tumhaari patni ka adhikaar hai. Atah pratyek adhikaar waale ko uska adhikaar do.

Abu juhaipha wahab bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne salmaan (radiyallahu anhu) aur abu darda (radiyallahu anhu) ko aapas bhaai banaya tha. Chunaanche ek din salmaan (radiyallahu anhu) abu darda (radiyallahu anhu) se milne gae, to unhonne umm-e-darda (radiyallahu anha) ko bahut hi astavyast awastha mein dekha. Atah, unse poochha : Tumhaari yeh haalat kyon hai? Ispar woh boleen ki tumhaare bhaai abu darda ko duniya se koi lena-dena nahin hai. Itne mein abu darda (radiyallahu anhu) bhi a gae. Unhonne salmaan (radiyallahu anhu) ke liye khaana taiyaar karvaya, phir unse kaha : Tum khaao, main roze se hoon. Salmaan (radiyallahu anhu) ne kaha : Jab tak tum nahin khaaoge, main bhi nahin khaaoonga. Aakhirkaar abu darda (radiyallahu anhu) ne khaana kha liya. Phir jab raat hui to abu darda (radiyallahu anhu) namaz ke liye jaane lage. Yeh dekh salmaan (radiyallahu anhu) ne unse kaha : So jaao. Chunaanche woh so gae. Thori der baad phir uthne lage, to salmaan (radiyallahu anhu) ne kaha : Abhi soe raho. Chunaanche jab raat ka antim bhaag aaranbh haa, to salmaan (radiyallahu anhu) ne kaha : Ab utho. Chunaanche donon ne namaz parhi aur uske baad salmaan (radiyallahu anhu) ne abu darda (radiyallahu anhu) se kaha : Nishchay hi tumpar tumhaare rab ka adhikaar hai. Nishchay hi tumpar svany tumhaare shareer tatha tumhaari patni ka adhikaar hai. Atah pratyek adhikaar waale ko uska adhikaar do. Phir abu darda (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aye aur aapko saari ghatna sunaai, to aapne farmaya : "Salmaan ne sahi kaha hai."
5802: Tummen se meri nazar mein sabse pyaare aur qayaamat ke din mere sabse adhik kareeb baithne ka saubhaagy praapt karne waale log woh honge, jo aachran ke aitbaar se tummen sabse achchhe hain.

Jaabir -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Tummen se meri nazar mein sabse pyaare aur qayaamat ke din mere sabse adhik kareeb baithne ka saubhaagy praapt karne waale log woh honge, jo aachran ke aitbaar se tummen sabse achchhe hain. Aur meri nazar mein sabse adhik ghrinit aur qayaamat ke din mujhse sabse adhik door baithne waale log, bahut adhik bakabkaane waale, apni baaton se ahankaar darshaane waale aur 'mutfaihiqoon' honge." Sahaaba ne kaha : "Ham bakabkaane waalon aur apni baaton se ahankaar darshaane waalon ko to samajh gae, parantu 'mutfaihiqoon' shabd samajh mein nahin aya. Aapne kaha : "Ghamandi evn ahankaari."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki logon ke andar duniya mein aapke sabse priy aur qayaamat ke din sabse nikat baithne waale logon mein woh log bhi shaamil honge, jinka vyavhaar sabse achchha hoga. "Sarsaaroon" Ka arth hai : Banaawat ke saath bahut zyaada baat karne waale. "Mutshaddiqoon" Ka arth hai : Bina kisi ehtiyaat ke aur apne munh miyaan mitthu bante hue bahut zyaada baat karne waale. Sahaaba ne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Ham is hadees mein aye hue do shabdon "Sarsaaroon" Tatha "Mutshaddiqoon" Ka arth samajh gae, lekin yeh "Mutfaihiqoon" Kaun log hain? Aapne uttar diya : Logon ka mazaaq uraane waale aise log, jo bahut zyaada baatooni hote hain.

Achchhe aachran se Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka prem aur qayaamat ke din aapki nikatta praapt hogi. Jabki bura aachran in donon se wanchit karta hai.
Achchhe aachran se paraspar prem barhta hai, jabki bure aachran se nafrat barhti hai.
Achchhe aachran evn winamrata se sushobhit hone aur bure aachran se door rahne ki prerna.
Bahut zyaada baat karne, abhimaan ke saath baat karne, apni baraai pradarshit karte hue baat karne banaawat ke saath baat karne ki manaahi.
5803: Tumhaare andar sabse achchha vyakti woh hai, jiska aachran sabse achchha hai.

Abdullah bin amr radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam na to ashleel the aur na gandi baaten aur gande kaary kiya karte the. Aap farmaya karte the : "Tumhaare andar sabse achchha vyakti woh hai, jiska aachran sabse achchha hai."

Buri baat karna ya bura kaary karna Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke aachran ka hissa nahin tha. Aap aisa karne ka ya kahne ka sochte bhi nahin the. Aap mahaan aachran ke maalik the.

Aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam kaha karte the : Allah ke nikat tummen se sabse achchha vyakti woh hai, jo sabse achchhe aachran ka maalik ho. Yaani woh logon ka bhala karta ho, hanskar milta ho, kisi ko kasht na deta ho, koi kasht de to sahan kar leta ho aur logon se achchhi tarah mel-jol rakhta ho.

Momin par buri baat tatha bure kaary se door rahna zaroori hai.
Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aadarsh aachran ke maalik the. Aap kewal achchhe kaary karte aur achchhi baat hi kahte the.
Insaan ko achchhe aachran ke maamle mein ek-doosre se aage barhne ka prayaas karna chahiye. Jo is maidaan mein aage barh gaya, woh sabse uttam tatha sabse eemaan waala momin ban gaya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5804: Main us vyakti ke liye Jannat ke andar ek ghar ki gaaranti leta hoon, jo saty par hone ke baavjood vyarth tark karna chhor de.

Abu umaama baahili (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Main us vyakti ke liye Jannat ke andar ek ghar ki gaaranti leta hoon, jo saty par hone ke baavjood vyarth tark karna chhor de. Aur jo mazaaq mein bhi jhooth bolna chhor de, uske liye Jannat ke beech mein ek ghar ki gaaranti deta hoon. Evn jo vyakti apna aachran theek kar le, uske liye Jannat ke uchchatam bhaag mein ek ghar ki zamaanat leta hoon."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki aap us vyakti ko Jannat ke baahar, uske aas-paas ya uske kinaaron mein ek ghar ki gaaranti dete hain, jo haq par hote hue bhi bahas na kare, jisse ek to samay nasht hota hai aur phir dvesh bhi paida hota hai. Isi tarah us vyakti ko Jannat ke beech mein ek ghar ki gaaranti dete hain, jo jhooth bolna aur waastawikta se hatkar baat karna chhor de, chaahe mazaaq hi mein kyon na ho. Isi prakaar us vyakti ko Jannat ke uchchatam sthaan mein ek ghar ki gaaranti dete hain, jiska aachran achchha ho. Chaahe iske liye nafs ko abhyast hi kyon na karna pare.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5805: Allah farmaata hai : Ai aadam ki santaan! Vyay (kharch) karo, tumpar vyay kiya jayega.
Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Allah farmaata hai : Ai aadam ki santaan! Vyay (kharch) karo, tumpar vyay kiya jayega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam farmaate hain ki uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : Ai aadam ki santaan! Tum un jaghon mein kharch karo, jahaan kharch karna waajib ya musathab (waanchhit) ho, main tumhen iska badla donga, tumhaari rozi mein barkat doonga aur tumhen khushhaali pradaan karoonga.

Sadqa karne tatha Allah ke maarg mein kharch karne ki prerna.
Neki ke kaamon mein kharch karna rozi mein barkat ka ek bahut bara kaaran hai aur Allah bande ko iska badla pradaan karta hai.
Yeh hadees un hadeeson mein se hai, jo Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne rab se riwayat karke kaha hai. Is tarah ki hadees ko hadees-e-qudsi ya hadees-e-ilaahi kaha jaata hai. Isse muraad woh hadees hai, jiske shabd tatha arth donon Allah ke hon. Albatta iske andar Qur'an ki wisheshtayen, jaise uski tilaawat ka ibaadat hona, uske liye tahaarat praapt karna tatha uska chamatkaar hona aadi, nahin paai jaati.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5806: Use chhor do aur uske peshaab par ek dol paani baha do. Kyonki tum aasaani paida karne ke liye bheje gae ho. Tumhen sakhti karne ke liye nahin bheja gaya hai.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, unhonne farmaya ki ek dehaati masjid mein peshaab karne laga, to log use daantne ke uddeshy se uski or barhe. Lekin, Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Use chhor do aur uske peshaab par ek dol paani baha do. Kyonki tum aasaani paida karne ke liye bheje gae ho. Tumhen sakhti karne ke liye nahin bheja gaya hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai aur shabd Bukhari ke hain.]
5807: In logon ne mujhe do hi wikalp diye : Ya to we zid aur hath ke saath maangte rahen ya phir mujhe kanjoos kahen. Jabki main kanjoos nahin hoon.

Umar (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne koi cheez baanti, to mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, inke muqaable mein doosre log iske adhik haqdaar the? Aapne ne farmaya : "In logon ne mujhe do hi wikalp diye : Ya to we zid aur hath ke saath maangte rahen ya phir mujhe kanjoos kahen. Jabki main kanjoos nahin hoon."
5808: Ek aadmi ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochha ki Islam ka kaun-sa kaary sabse achchha hai? Aapne uttar diya : "Yeh ki tum khaana khilaao aur jaane-pahchaane tatha anjaan sabko salaam karo.

Abdullah bin amr radiyallahu anhuma se riwayat hai ki ek aadmi ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochha ki Islam ka kaun-sa kaary sabse achchha hai? Aapne uttar diya : "Yeh ki tum khaana khilaao aur jaane-pahchaane tatha anjaan sabko salaam karo."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochha gaya ki Islam ka kaun-sa kaam sabse achchha hai, to aapne do kaamon ka zikr kiya :

1- ghareebon ko zyaada se zyaada khaana khilaana. Ismen sadqa, bhent, nimantran aur waleema sab shaamil hai. Khaana khilaane ka mahatv us samay aur barh jaata hai, jab bhukhamri aur mahangaai ho.

2- har musalmaan ko salaam karna. Chaahe parichit ho ya aprichit.

Sahaaba aise kaaryon ko jaanne ke ichchhuk raha karte the, jo duniya aur aakhirat mein laabhdayak hon.
Khaana khilaana aur salaam karna Islam ki nazar mein sabse achchhe kaamon mein se do kaam hain. Kyonki ek to yeh sawaab ke kaam hain aur doosre insaan ko har samay inki zaroorat rahti hai.
In donon mein kaary mein ehsaan evn kathan mein ehsaan donon ekatr ho jaate hain, jo ki ehsaan ka sabse sanpoorn roop hai.
Ye woh kaam hain, jinka sanbandh musalmaanon ke aapsi bartaav se hai. Jabki kuchh kaary aise bhi hain, jinka sanbandh bande ke apne rab ke saath bartaav se hai.
Salaam karne mein pahal karne ki baat musalmaanon tak seemit hai. Kaafiron (adharmiyon) ko salaam karne mein pahal nahin ki jayegi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5810: "Uska kitna bhaag kitna bhaag bacha hua hai?" Logon ne uttar diya : Kewal uska kandha bacha hua hai. Aapne kaha : "Kandhe ke siwa poora bacha hua hai."

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki logon ne ek bakri zabah kiya, to Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne poochha : "Uska kitna bhaag kitna bhaag bacha hua hai?" Logon ne uttar diya : Kewal uska kandha bacha hua hai. Aapne kaha : "Kandhe ke siwa poora bacha hua hai."
5811: Nishchay hi Allah atyaachaari ko chhoot deta rahta hai aur jab pakarta hai, to chhorta nahin hai

Abu moosa ashaari radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Nishchay hi Allah atyaachaari ko chhoot deta rahta hai aur jab pakarta hai, to chhorta nahin hai." Phir aapne yeh ayat parhi : {isi prakaar tumhaare rab ki pakar hoti hai jab woh atyaachri basti ko pakarta hai, aur nishchay hi uski pakar bahut sakht wa dukhad hai.} [soora hood : 102]

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam gunaah tatha shirk evn logon ke adhikaaron ke hanan ke roop mein atyaachaar ke maarg mein aage barhte jaane se saavdhaan kar rahe hain. Kyonki Allah atyaachaari ko mohlat tatha dheel deta hai aur uski ayu tatha dhan mein wriddhi karta jaata hai. Use fauran dand nahin de deta. Aise mein agar woh tauba nahin karta, to use pakar leta hai aur chhorta nahin hai. Kyonki uske gunaah bahut zyaada ho chuke hote hain.

Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne yeh ayat parhi : {isi prakaar tumhaare rab ki pakar hoti hai jab woh atyaachri basti ko pakarta hai, aur nishchay hi uski pakar bahut sakht wa dukhad hai.} [soora hood : 102]

Wiweki vyakti ko sheeghr hi tauba kar leni chahiye aur atyaachaar ke maarg par qayam rahte hue Allah ki dhilaai aur pakar mein bilanb se nishchint nahin hona chahiye.
Allah atyaachaariyon ko fauran dand dene ki bajay mohlat deta hai, taaki unko tauba karne ka mauqa mil sake aur tauba na karne ki sthiti mein unki yaatna ko barha diya jaye.
Atyaachaar Allah ke dand dene ke kaarnon mein se ek kaaran hai.
Jab Allah kisi basti ko winasht karta hai, to usmen kuchh nek log bhi ho sakte hain. Aise nek log qayaamat ke din apni neki ke saath uthaye jayenge aur is baat se unko koi nuqsaan heen hoga ki sabke saath unko yaatna ka saamna karna para.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5812: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se poochha gaya ki kaun-si cheez logon ko sabse zyaada Jannat mein daakhil karegi? To aapne uttar diya : "Allah ka bhay aur achchha aachran." Saath hi poochha gaya ki kaun-si cheez sabse zyaada Jahannam mein daakhil karegi? To uttar diya : "Munh aur sharmagaah."

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se poochha gaya ki kaun-si cheez logon ko sabse zyaada Jannat mein daakhil karegi? To aapne uttar diya : "Allah ka bhay aur achchha aachran." Saath hi poochha gaya ki kaun-si cheez sabse zyaada Jahannam mein daakhil karegi? To uttar diya : "Munh aur sharmagaah."

Insaan ko Jannat mein sabse zyaada daakhil karne waali cheez Allah ka bhay aur achchha vyavhaar hai. Allah ke bhay ka izhaar is prakaar hota hai ki insaan tamaam tarah ki haraam cheezon se doori bana le aur achchhe vyavhaar ka sanbandh Allah ki srishti se hota hai aur uska nimnatam star yeh hai ki insaan kisi ko kasht na de, jabki uska uchchatam star yeh hai ki insaan bura karne waale ke saath achchha kare.
Iske wipreet insaan ko Jahannam mein sabse zyaada daakhil karne waali cheezen hain insaan ka munh aur uski sharmagaah. Kyonki inheen do cheezon ke kaaran insaan aam taur par Allah ke aadeshon ki awajna karta hai aur logon ke saath durvyavhaar karta hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5813: Ek deenaar jo tumne Allah ke raaste mein kharch kiya, ek deenaar jo tumne kisi daas ko mukt karne ke liye kharch kiya, ek deenaar jo tumne kisi nirdhan ko daan kiya aur ek deenaar jo tumne baal-bachchon par kharch kiya, unmen sabse adhik neki waala deenaar woh hai, jise tumne apne pariwaar par kharch kiya.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Ek deenaar jo tumne Allah ke raaste mein kharch kiya, ek deenaar jo tumne kisi daas ko mukt karne ke liye kharch kiya, ek deenaar jo tumne kisi nirdhan ko daan kiya aur ek deenaar jo tumne baal-bachchon par kharch kiya, unmen sabse adhik neki waala deenaar woh hai, jise tumne apne pariwaar par kharch kiya."

Allah ke Nabi ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pahle kharch karne ki kuchh jaghon ko bayaan kiya. Farmaya ki ek deenaar jise tum Allah ke maarg mein jihaad ke liye kharch karte ho, ek deenaar jise tum kisi ghulaam ko ghulaami ke bandhan se aazaad karne ke liye kharch karte ho, ek deenaar jise tum kisi zarooratmand nirdhan ko daan karte ho aur ek deenaar jise tum apne beewi-bachchon par kharch karte ho. Phir aapne bataya ki Allah ke yahaan inmen sabse adhik sawaab waala deenaar woh hai, jise tum apne beewi-bachchon aur aise logon par kharch karte ho, jinka kharch uthaana tumpar waajib hai.

Allah ki prasannata ki praapti ke liye kharch karne ke bahut-se raaste hain.
Jab kharch karne ke kai wikalp saamne hon, to adhik behtar wikalp ko praathmikta di jayegi. Jab saare sthaanon par kharch karna sanbhav na ho, baal-bachchon par kharch kiya jayega.
Navvi saheeh Muslim ki vyaakhya mein kahte hain : Apne maatahton par kharch karne ki prerna aur usse milne waale pratiphal ka bayaan. Kyonki maatahton par kharch karna kabhi unse rishtedaari ke kaaran waajib, musathab tatha sadqa hota hai, to kabhi nikaah ya daasta ke kaaran maalikaana adhikaar ki wajah se waajib hota hai. In sabhi logon par kharch karna neki ka kaam hai aur shareeyat ne iski prerna di hai. Inpar kharch karna nafal sadqe se behtar hai.
Sindhi kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke shabdon "Woh deenaar jo woh apne parijnon par kharch karta hai" Ka arth hai : Jise kharch karte samay Allah ki prasannata saamne ho aur paariwaarik kartavy ko poora karna uddeshy ho.
Abu qilaaba kahte hain : Us vyakti se barhkar pratiphal ka haqdaar kaun ho sakta hai, jo apne chhote-chhote bachchon par kharch karke unko kisi ke saamne haath phailaane se bachaye rakhe ya Allah uske dvaara unhen laabhaanvit kare tatha beniyaaz rakhe.
5814: Woh vyakti saphal ho gaya, jisne Islam grahan kar liya tatha use zaroorat bhar rozi mil gai aur Allah ne jo kuchh use diya hai, usse santusht raha.

Abdullah bin amr -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Woh vyakti saphal ho gaya, jisne Islam grahan kar liya tatha use zaroorat bhar rozi mil gai aur Allah ne jo kuchh use diya hai, usse santusht raha."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki woh vyakti saphal ho gaya, jo apne paalanhaar ka aajnaakaari ban gaya, use Islam dharm ka paalan karne ka suyog mila, aawashyakta anusaar halaal rozi mil gai tatha Allah ke anugrah se uski di hui nemton par santusht raha.

Kisi vyakti ki khushi is baat mein nihit hai ki uska dharm paripoorn ho, uski aajeewika paryaapt ho aur woh Allah dvaara di hui cheezon se santusht rahe.
Islam ka paalan tatha sunnat ka anusran karne ke saath-saath Allah ki di hui cheezon se santusht rahne ki prerna.
5817: Main Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath namaz parha karta tha, to aapki namaz bhi santulit hua karti thi aur aapka khutba bhi.

Abu abdullah bin jaabir bin samura (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki main Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath namaz parha karta tha, to aapki namaz bhi santulit hua karti thi aur aapka khutba bhi.
5818: Ham log khandaq ke din gaddha khod rahe the ki ek mazboot chattaan nikal aai. Saare log Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aye aur kahne lage ki khandaq mein ek chattaan saamne a gai hai. Aapne farmaya : "Main utarta hoon."

Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ham log khandaq ke din gaddha khod rahe the ki ek mazboot chattaan nikal aai. Saare log Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aye aur kahne lage ki khandaq mein ek chattaan saamne a gai hai. Aapne farmaya : "Main utarta hoon." Phir aap khare hue. Us samay aapke pet se patthar bandha hua tha. Ham logon ne teen dinon se kuchh bhi nahin chakha tha. Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne kudaal liya. Jab kudaal chalaya, to woh chattaan bilkul ret ban gai. Mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, mujhe ghar jaane ki anumti deejiye. Mainne apni patni se kahaah mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko is haal mein dekha ki mujhse raha nahin gaya. Kya tumhaare paas kuchh hai? Usne kahaah mere paas kuchh jau aur ek bakri ka bachcha hai. Atah usne bakri ke bachche ko zabah kiya aur jau ko peesa aur hamne maans ko haandi mein rakh diya. Phir jab aata taiyaar ho gaya aur choolhe ke oopar haandi mein maanse pakne laga, to main Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas gaya aur kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, mainne thora sa khaana taiyaar kiya hai, isliye aap aur ek-do aadmi chalen. Aapne poochha ki khaana kitna hai? Jab mainne uska parimaan bata diya, to farmaya : "Bahut hai aur achchha hai. Apni patni se kah do ki haandi na utaare aur roti bhi tannoor se na nikaale, yahaan tak ki main a jaaoon." Saath hi farmaya : "Sab log chalo." Atah, saare muhaajir tatha ansaar khare ho gae. Yeh dekh main apni patni ke paas aya aur kahaah tera naash ho, Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur saare muhaajir evn ansaar a rahe hain. Usne kahaah kya aapne tumse kuchh poochha tha? Mainne kahaah haan. Phir aapne logon se kaha : "Andar aao aur bheer na lagaao." Aap roti torte, usmen maans daal dete aur haandi tatha tannoor ko dhaanp dete, phir sahaaba ko prastut karte aur kheench lete. Isi prakaar karte rahe, yahaan tak ki saare log pet bhar kha chuke aur kuchh khaana bach bhi gaya.Atah, farmaya : "Ise khaao aur logon ko do, kyonki log bhookhe hain."
Ek riwayat mein hai ki jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain : Jab khandaq khodi ja rahi thi, to mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko bhookhe pet dekha. Atah, daurkar apni patni ke paas aya aur kahaah tumhaare paas kuchh hai? Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallamah ko sakht bhookh ki haalat mein dekha hai. Usne jau ki ek thaili nikaali aur hamaare paas ek bakri ka bachcha bhi tha. Mainne use zabah kiya aur ek saa jau ka aata goontha aur woh bhi mere saath saath kaam mein lah gai. Mainne use tukre-tukre karke haandi mein daal diya. Phir Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas jaane laga, to woh boleen : "Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur aapke sahaaba ke saamne mera apmaan na karna. Chunaanche mainne chupke se kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, hamne bakri ka ek bachcha zabah kiya hai aur ek saa jau ka aata peesa hai. Isliye aap aur aapke saath kuchh log hamaare yahaan chalen. Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne tez aawaaj lagaai aur farmaya : "Ai khandaq waalon, jaabir ne tumhaare liye daawat ka khaana taiyaar kiya hai. Atah, sab log chale chalo." L tatha Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne mujhse farmaya : "Haandi mat utaarna aur na hi roti banaana, yahaan tak ki main a jaaoon." Main aur Nabi (sallallahu alaihi sallam) logon ke aage-aage aye. Main apni patni ke paas aya , to usne kaha : Tumhaara naash ho. Mainnne kahaah mainne waisa hi kiya tha, jaisa ki tumne kaha tha. Phir usne aata nikaala aur aapne usmen apna thook milaya tatha barkat ki dua kar di. Phir hamaari haandi ke paas aye aur usmen bhi apna thook milaya tatha barkat ki dua ki aur farmaya : "Ek roti pakaane waali ko bulaao, woh tumhaare saath roti pakayegi aur maans ko haandi se pyaali ke dvaara nikaalo aur use mat utaaro." Sahaaba ek hazaar ki sankhya mein the. Main Allah ki qasam khaakar kahta hoon ki saare logon ne khaya aur bacha hua khaana chhor bhi gae. Us samay bhi hamaari haandi pahle ki bhaanti ubalti rahi aur aate se roti pahle ki bhaanti banti rahi.

5819: Tum sab rakshak ho aur tum sab se tumhaare maatahton ke baare mein poochha jayega.

Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Tum sab rakshak ho aur tum sab se tumhaare maatahton ke baare mein poochha jayega. Logon ka shaasak rakshak hai aur usse uske adheenasthon ke baare mein poochha jayega. Ek vyakti apne pariwaar ka rakshak hai aur usse uske maatahton ke baare mein prashn hoga aur ek stri apne pati ke ghar aur uske bachchon ki rakshak hai aur usse unke baare mein prashn hoga. Is tarah, tummen se har vyakti rakshak hai aur tummen se har vyakti se uske maatahton ke baare mein poochha jayega." Tatha ek daas apne maalik ke dhan ka rakshak hai aur usse uske baare mein poochha jayega. Sun log, tummen se har vyakti rakshak hai aur usse uske adheenasthon ke baare mein poochha jayega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki samaaj mein rahne waale har musalmaan ki kuchh zimmewaariyaan hain, jo use uthaani hi hongi. Atah imaam aur ameer apne maathat logon ka zimmewaar hai. Uska kaam unke deen wa shareeyat ki suraksha karna, atyaachaariyon se unki raksha karna, unke dushmanon se jihaad karna aur unke adhikaaron ko nasht hone se bachaana hai. Har vyakti apne pariwaar ke logon par kharch karne, unke saath achchhe vyavhaar karne, unko shiksha dene evn shishtaachaar sikhaane ka zimmewaar hai. Ek aurat ke kandhon par yeh zimmewaari hai ki apne pati ke ghar ko achchhe se sanbhaale aur bachchon ki uttam prashikshan ka prabandh kare. Aur usse is zimmewaari ke baare mein poochha joega, sewak evn mazdoor ki zimmewaari hai ki apne paas maujood apne maalik ke dhan ki hifaazat kare aur uski sewa kare. Aur usse is zimmewaari ke baare mein poochha joega, is prakaar, har vyakti apne maathat maujood logon evn cheezon ka zimmewaar hai, aur usse unke baare mein poochha jayega.

Muslim samaaj ke har vyakti ko apni shakti evn kshamta ke anusaar zimmewaari ka bojh uthaana parta hai.
Aurat ke sar par bari zimmewaari hai. Use apne pati ka ghar bhi sanbhaalan hai aur bachchon ke baare mein apni zimmewaariyaan bhi ada karni hain.

5821: Muhammad ki patniyon ke paas bahut-si mahilayen aakar apne patiyon ki shikayat kar gai hain. Daraasal we tumhaare achchhe log nahin hain.

Iyaas bin abdullah bin abu jubaab (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Allah ki daasiyon ko mat maaro." Iske baad bahut-si striyaan Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki patniyon ke paas aakar apne patiyon ki shikayat karne lageen, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Muhammad ki patniyon ke paas bahut-si mahilayen aakar apne patiyon ki shikayat kar gai hain. Asma bint abu bakr siddeeq (radiyallahu anhuma) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne mujhse farmaya : "Baandhe mat rakho, nahin to tumse bhi baandhkar rakha jayega."

5825: Yadi tumhen maaloom ho jaata ki mahaan Allah ke nikat tumhaare liye kya rakha hai, to tum chaahte ki tumhaari nirdhanta tatha haajatmandi aur barh jaye.

Fazaala bin ubaid (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab logon ko namaz parhaate, to kuchh log (jo daraasal suffa waale the) bhookh ke kaaran gir parte, yahaan tak ki dehaat waale kahne lagte : Ye paagal log hain. Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) ne apni patni ko maasik dharm ki haalat mein talaaq de di, to umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saamne iski charcha ki. Ispar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko krodh mein a gae aur farmaya : "Woh use lauta le, phir pawitr hone tak roke rakhe, phir use maasik dharm aye aur pawitr ho jaye. Ab yadi use talaaq dena chaahe, to pawitr haalat mein sanbhog se pahle talaaq de. Yahi iddat hai, jaisa ki sarvashaktimaan evn Allah ne aadesh diya hai."
Doosre shabdon ke anusaar : "Yahaan tak ki dobaara maasik dharm aaranbh ho, us maasik ke siwa, jismen usne talaaq di hai."
Ek aur shabd mein hai : "To use talaaq maan li gai aur abdullah ne use lauta liya, jaisa ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen aadesh diya tha."

Abdullah bin umar -Allah unse prasann ho- ne apni patni ko maasik dharm ki dasha mein talaaq de diya aur unke pita ne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko iski soochna di, to aap bahut naaraaz hue, kyonki unhonne apni patni ko haraam tareeqe se talaaq diya tha, jo ki sunnat se mel nahin khaata.
Phir aapne unhen aadesh diya ki apni patni ko lautaakar apne paas rakhe, yahaan tak ki us maasik dharm se pawitr ho jaye, phir uske pashchaat doosra maasik dharm aye aur usse bhi pawitr ho jaye. Iske baad yadi use talaaq dena chaahe, to sahvaas karne se poorv hi talaaq de. Yahi woh iddat hai, jismen Allah ne talaaq dene ka aadesh diya hai, yadi koi talaaq dena chaahe.
Ulema ka is baat mein matbhed hai ki maasik dharm ki avdhi mein talaak paregi athva nahin, baavjood iske ki maasik dharm mein talaaq dena haraam hai aur sunnat ke anusaar nahin hai. Is masle mein fatva abu daaood ki riwayat ke anusaar diya jaata hai, jis mein hai : "Aapne use amaany ghoshit kar diya aur kuchh nahin maana" Jabki is hadees ke shabd talaaq parne ke sanbandh mein spasht nahin hain aur na hi yeh spasht hai ki Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne hi use maana tha. Iske wipreet ek any spasht hadees mein hai : "Jo vyakti koi aisa kaary kare, jo hamaari shareeyat ke anusaar na ho, woh asveekaary hai." Saheeh Bukhari tatha Muslim.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5828: Jab tak chusti baaqi rahe, namaz parho aur chusti khatm ho jaye, to so jaao.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) pharmaate hain ki ek baar Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) masjid mein daakhil hue, to dekha ki do stanbh ke beech ek rassi latak rahi hai. Aapne pharmaya : "Yeh rassi kaisi hai?" Logon ne kaha ki yeh rassi zainab (radiyallahu anha) ke dvaara latkaai hui hai. Jab woh namaz mein khari-khari thak jaati hain, to isse latak jaati hain . Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmaya : "Ise khol do. Jab tak chusti baaqi rahe, namaz parho aur chusti khatm ho jaye, to so jaao."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5829: Ham log hajjatul wada ke baare mein baat kar rahe the aur Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hamaare beech maujood the, lekin hamen pata nahin tha ki hajjatul wada kya hai.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki ham log hajjatul wada ke baare mein baat kar rahe the aur Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hamaare beech maujood the, lekin hamen pata nahin tha ki hajjatul wada kya hai, yahaan tak ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne Allah ki prashansa ki, phir dajjaal ka bahut der tak zikr karte hue farmaya : "Allah ne jis Nabi ko bhi bheja hai, usne apni ummat ko isse daraya hai. Nooh aur unke pashchaat aane waale saare nabiyon ne isse daraya hai. Yadi woh tumhaare beech nikalta hai, to woh apni nishaaniyon ke kaaran tumse chhup nahin sakta, kyonki tumhaara rab kaana nahin hai aur woh dayen aankh ka kaana hoga. Goya ki uski aankhen ubhre hue angoor ki tarah hongi. Sun lo, tumpar tumhaara rakt aur tumhaare dhan ek doosre par usi prakaar haraam hain, jis prakaar tumhaare is din ki hurmat hai, tumhaare is shahar aur is maheene mein. Kya mainne pahooncha diya?" Logon ne kaha : Haan. Phir aapne teen baar farmaya : "Ai Allah, tu gawaah rah." Phir farmaya : "Tumhaara naash ho, dekho mere baad kaafir na ban jaana ki ek-doosre ki gardan uraane lago."

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke jeewan kaal hi mein ham kaha karte the ki hajjatul wada kya hai? Ham jaante hi nahin the ki hajjatul wada kya hai. Yaad rahe ki hajjatul wada woh Hajj hai, jo Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne san 10 hijri mein kiya tha aur jismen logon ko al-wada kahne ke saath-saath kaana dajjaal ka ullekh kiya tha, uske fitne ki bhayaawahta se avgat kiya tha, usse bahut zyaada daraya tha aur bataya tha ki saare nabeegan apni jaatiyon ko dajjaal se saavdhaan karte aye hain, usse daraate rahe hain aur uski bhayaawahta ka ullekh karte aye hain.
Use pahchaanna tumhaare liye kathin nahin hoga. Kyonki tumhaara prabhu kaana nahin hai aur woh dayen aankh ka kaana hoga. Uski aankh ubhre hue angoor ki tarah hogi.
Iske baad Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : Allah ne tumpar apne kisi bhaai ka rakt bahaane aur naahaq kisi musalmaan ka dhan le lene ko usi prakaar haraam kiya hai, jis prakaar qurbaani ka din hurmat waala hai, makka nagar hurmat waala hai aur zul-hijja maheena hurmat waala hai.
Phir aapne poochha : Kya mainne tumhen woh sandesh pahuncha diya, jise tumhen pahunchaane ka aadesh mujhe diya gaya tha? Logon ne uttar diya : Haan, aapne pahuncha diya hai. Yeh uttar sun aapne teen baar kaha : Ai Allah! In logon ne unke paas tera sandesh pahuncha dene ki jo gawaahi di hai, uspar tu gawaah rah. Phir aapne logon se kaha ki dekho, mere baad kaafiron ke samaan na ho jaana ki ek-doosre ka wadh karte raho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5830: Mainne apne baad koi aisa fitna nahin chhora, jo purushon ke haq mein striyon se adhik haanikaarak ho.

Usaama bin zaid radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Mainne apne baad koi aisa fitna nahin chhora, jo purushon ke haq mein striyon se adhik haanikaarak ho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki aapne apne baad aisi koi aazmaaish nahin chhori, jo purushon ke hit mein striyon se adhik haanikaarak ho. Stri agar uske ghar ki hai, to uske dvaara ki jaane waali shareeyat ki avhelna ke kaaran purush ko haani hoti hai aur agar uske pariwaar ki na ho, to uske saath milne-julne aur ekaant mein rahne tatha iske nateeje mein paida hone waali buraaiyon ke kaaran purush ko haani hoti hai.

Musalmaan ko aurat ke fitne se saavdhaan rahna chahiye aur is fitne ki or le jaane waale har raaste ko band karna chahiye.
Fitnon se suraksha ke liye momin ko Allah se apna rishta mazboot rakhna chahiye aur Allah mein dil lagaana chahiye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5831: Kisi musalmaan ke liye uchit nahin hai ki uske paas koi wastu ho, jiski woh waseeyat karna chaahta ho aur woh waseeyatnaama likhe bina do raat bhi guzaare.

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Kisi musalmaan ke liye uchit nahin hai ki uske paas koi wastu ho, jiski woh waseeyat karna chaahta ho aur woh waseeyatnaama likhe bina do raat bhi guzaare." Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- farmaate hain : "Jabse mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko yeh farmaate hue sana hai, meri koi raatri waseeyatnaama likhe bina nahin guzri."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jis musalmaan ke paas waseeyat karne layaq koi dhan ya adhikaar aadi ho, chaahe maamooli hi kyon na ho, uski teen raaten is awastha mein nahin guzarni chaahiyen ki uske paas waseeyat likhi hui na ho. Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma kahte hain : Jabse mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se yeh hadees suni hai, tabse meri ek raat bhi aisi nahin guzri ki waseeyat mere paas likhi hui na ho.

Insaan ko waseeyat karni chahiye aur ismen der nahin karni chahiye, isse pahle ki koi baadha use is kaary se rok de. Taaki sab ko pata rahe ki uspar kiska kya adhikaar hai, sharai aadesh ka anupaalan ho jaye, maut ki taiyaari rahe aur insaan waseeyat tatha waseeyat ke sthaanon avgat rahe.
Waseeyat ka arth hai wachan. Yaani woh wachan, jiske tahat koi vyakti apni mrityu ke baad kisi ko apni kuchh sanpatti ka prabandhan karne, apne chhote bachchon ki dekh-bhaal karne ya apni mrityu ke baad apne svaamitv waale kisi bhi kaary ka prabandhan karne ka zimma saunpta hai.
Waseeyat ke teen prakaar hain : 1- musathab waseeyat. Yaani is baat ki waseeyat karna ki uske dhan ka kuchh bhaag neki tatha paropkaar ke kaaryon mein kharch kiya jaye, taaki maut ke baad use sawaab milta rahe. 2- waajib waseeyat. Yaani apne oopar aniwaary adhikaaron ke baare mein waseeyat karna. Adhikaar chaahe Allah ke hon, jaise zakat jo ada nahin ki gai ya kaffaara jo diya nahin gaya, ya phir insaan ke hon, jaise qarz tatha amaanton ki adaygi. 3- haraam waseeyat. Jab insaan apne ek tihaai se adhik dhan ke baare mein waseeyat kar de aur kisi waaris ke haq mein waseeyat kar de, to is prakaar ki waseeyat karna haraam hai.
Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ki fazeelat tatha bina der kiye neki ka kaam evn sharai aadesh ke anupaalan ka unka jazba.
Ibn-e-daqeek al-eed kahte hain : Do ya teen dinon ki chhoot daraasal diqqat evn pareshaani se bachaane ke liye di gai hai.
Mahatvapoorn baaton ko likhkar rakhna chahiye, kyonki isse adhikaaron ke nasht hone ki sanbhaavna kam ho jaati hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5832: Pratyek Nabi ne apni qaum ko jhoothe kaana se daraya hai

Anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Pratyek Nabi ne apni qaum ko jhoothe kaana se daraya hai. Sun lo, woh kaana hoga aur yaqeenan tumhaara -sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan- rab kaana nahin hai. Uski aankhon ke saamne kaaf-fa-ra likha hoga."

Allah ke bheje hue tamaam nabiyon ne apni ummaton ko maseeh dajjaal se daraya aur saavdhaan kiya hai, kyonki unke paas uske nikalne tatha uske fitne ki bhayaawahta ki jaankaari thi. Saath hi unhonne uski kuchh wisheshtayen bhi bayaan ki hain. Is hadees mein bayaan kiya gaya hai ki woh kaana hoga, jabki Allah is tarah ki tamaam baaton se pawitr hai. Isi tarah uski ek pahchaan yeh hogi ki uski donon aankhon ke beech mein "ك ف ر" (Ka fa ra) likha hua hoga.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5833: Kisi bande ka dhan sadqa karne se kam nahin hota, jis bande par atyaachaar hota hai, phir woh uspar dhairy rakhta hai, to Allah uska sammaan barha deta hai aur jo banda maangne ka darvaaza kholta hai, Allah uske liye nirdhanta ka darvaaza khol deta hai.

Abu kabsha amr bin saad anmaari -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai ki aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Main teen cheezon par qasam khaata hoon aur ek hadees bataata hoon, use yaad kar lo. Kisi bande ka dhan sadqa karne se kam nahin hota, jis bande par atyaachaar hota hai, phir woh uspar dhairy rakhta hai, to Allah uska sammaan barha deta hai aur jo banda maangne ka darvaaza kholta hai, Allah uske liye nirdhanta ka darvaaza khol deta hai -athva isi tarah ka koi shabd farmaya-. Ek hadees sunaata hoon, use yaad kar lo." Farmaya : "Duniya chaar prakaar ke logon ke liye hai : Ek woh banda, jise Allah ne dhan evn jnaan pradaan kiya hai aur woh uske prati apne rab se bhay khaata hai aur uske dvaara apne nikatvartiyon ka haq ada karta hai tatha usmen Allah ke adhikaar ko jaanta hai. Yeh sabse uttam darja hai. Doosra woh banda hai, jise Allah ne jnaan pradaan kiya hai aur dhan se wanchit rakha hai, lekin uski neeyat sachchi hai. Woh kahta hai : Yadi mere paas dhan hota, to main amuk vyakti ki tarah kaam karta. Atah, use uski neeyat ke anuroop pratiphal milega aur donon ka sawaab baraabar hoga. Teesra woh banda hai, jise Allah ne dhan diya hai, lekin jnaan nahin diya hai. Atah, woh apna dhan jnaan ke bina kharch karta hai. Dhan ke baare mein na Allah se darta hai, na nikatvartiyon ka haq ada karta hai aur na usmen Allah ke adhikaar ko jaanta hai. Yeh sabse bura darja hai. Jabki chautha vyakti woh hai, jise Allah ne na dhan diya hai aur na hi jnaan diya hai. Woh kahta haih yadi mere paas dhan hota, main amuk vyakti (arthaat is hadees mein ullikhit teesre vyakti) ki tarah kaary karta. Atah, uski neeyat ka etbaar hoga aur in donon ka paap baraabar hoga."
5834: Kanjoos aur kharch karne waale ka udaahran un do vyaktiyon ki tarah hai, jinpar chhaati se lekar hansli tak lohe ke do kawach hon.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Kanjoos aur kharch karne waale ka udaahran un do vyaktiyon ki tarah hai, jinpar chhaati se lekar hansli tak lohe ke do kawach hon. Jahaan tak kharch karne waale ki baat hai, woh jab kharch karta hai, to uska kawach barhta chala jaata hai, yahaan tak ki pair ki ungliyon ko chhupa leta hai aur uske pair ke nishaan mita deta hai. Raha bakheel, to woh jab kuchh kharch karna chaahta hai, to kawach ki har kari apne sthaan par chipak jaati hai. Phir woh use failaana chaahta hai, lekin failta nahin hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5835: Usse kaho ki baat kare, chhaya mein jaye, baithe aur apna roza poora kare.

Ibne abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- khutba de hi rahe the ki aapne ek vyakti ko khara dekha, to logon se uske baare mein poochha. Logon ne kaha : Woh abu israaeel hai. Usne mannat maani hai ki woh dhoop mein khara rahega. Na baithega, na chhaya lega aur na bolega tatha roza rakhega. Yeh sun Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Usse kaho ki baat kare, chhaya mein jaye, baithe aur apna roza poora kare."
5838: Jo apna dhan kisi aise vyakti ke paas paye, jo diwaaliya ho gaya ho, to woh doosre ke muqaable mein uska adhik haqdaar hai.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Jo apna dhan kisi aise vyakti ke paas paye, jo diwaaliya ho gaya ho, to woh doosre ke muqaable mein uska adhik haqdaar hai."

Jisne apna saamaan kisi se becha, amaanat rakha ya qarz diya aur woh vyakti diwaaliya ghoshit ho gaya, yaani uske poore dhan se uske qarz ki adaygi sanbhav na ho pa rahi ho, to aisi awastha mein ukt bechne, amaanat rakhne ya qarz dene waala yadi hu-ba-hu apna saamaan uske paas paye, to use le sakta hai, kyonki woh any logon ki tulna mein uska adhik haq rakhta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5840: Tummen se jo vyakti is awastha mein subah kare ki woh shaareerik roop se svasth ho, uski jaan surakshit ho  aur uske paas din bhar ke khaane ki wastu ho, to yeh aisa hai, jaise use poori duniya de di gai ho.

Abdullah bin mihsan ansaari -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Tummen se jo vyakti is awastha mein subah kare ki woh shaareerik roop se svasth ho, uski jaan surakshit ho  aur uske paas din bhar ke khaane ki wastu ho, to yeh aisa hai, jaise use poori duniya de di gai ho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne musalmaanon ko sanbodhit karte hue kaha hai ki ai musalmaano! Tummen se jisne svasth awastha mein, beemaariyon se surakshit rahkar tatha apni jaan, ghar-pariwaar aur raaste ke baare mein har prakaar ke bhay se mukt hokar subah ki, tatha uske paas din bhar ke baraabar halaal bhojan maujood ho, to samjho use poori duniya mil gai.

Insaan ko svaasthy, suraksha evn paryaapt bhojan ki zaroorat hua karti hai.
Bande ko in nemton par Allah ki prashansa evn shukr ada karna chahiye.
Santosh evn tyaag ki prerna.
[is hadees ko tirmizi aur ibn-e-maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
5842: Jisne khajoor ka aisa per becha, jiska paraagan kiya ja chuka ho, to uska phal bechne waale ka hoga. Haan, yadi khareedne waale ne shart laga di ho, to uska hoga.

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Jisne khajoor ka aisa per becha, jiska paraagan kiya ja chuka ho, to uska phal bechne waale ka hoga. Haan, yadi khareedne waale ne shart laga di ho, to uska hoga."
Ek aur riwayat mein hai : "Jisne koi daas khareeda, to uska maal bechne waale ka hoga. Haan, yadi khareedne waale ne shart laga di ho, to uska hoga."

Paraagan ka laabh bechne waale ko milna chahiye. Choonki phal bhi paraagan ke nateeje mein lagte hain, isliye unpar adhikaar bechne waale ka hoga. Haan, yadi khareedne waala shart laga de ki phal usi ke honge aur bechne waala uski shart maan le, to yeh shart maany hogi.
Isi tarah, yadi kisi daas ko uske maalik ne kuchh dhan de rakha ho, phir woh us daas ko bechna chaahe, to uska dhan uske maalik yaani bechne waale ke paas rah jayega, kyonki kray-wikray ke anubandh ke dayre mein woh nahin ayega. Lekin, yadi khareedne waala us poore dhan athva uske kuchh bhaag ko lene ki shart laga de, to woh anubandh ke dayre mein a jayega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5843: Jo ek bitta samaan bhi zameen harpega, uski gardan mein saat zameenon ka tauk daala jayega.
Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Jo ek bitta samaan bhi zameen harpega, uski gardan mein saat zameenon ka tauk daala jayega."

Ek insaan ka dhan doosre insaan par haraam hai. Kisi ke liye doosre vyakti ke adhikaar ki koi wastu uski razaamandi ke bina lena jayaz nahin hai. Phir, any dhanon ki tulna mein kisi ki zameen harap lena aur bhi bara paap hai. Kyonki zameen par awaidh qabza lanbi avdhi tak qayam rahta hai.
Yahi kaaran hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki jisne kisi bhi zameen par qabza kar liya, chaahe kam ho ya zyaada, woh qayaamat ke din bahut bari yaatna ke saath upasthit hoga. Us din uski gardan moti evn lanbi kar di jayegi aur usmen uske dvaara awaidh roop se qabza ki hui zameen ka, uski saat parton samet, tauq (haar) banaakar daal diya jayega. Yeh uske dvaara zameen ke maalik par kiye gae atyaachaar ka pratiphal hoga, jiski zameen usne hathiya li thi.
Yaad rahe ki is chetaavni ke andar aam zameen ka, uska maalik bane aur uspar qabza kiye bina istemaal karna daakhil nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5844: Jab imaam aameen kahe, to tum aameen kaho. Kyonki jiska aameen kahna farishton ke aameen ke saath hoga, uske pichhle saare paap kshama kar diye jayenge.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Jab imaam aameen kahe, to tum aameen kaho. Kyonki jiska aameen kahna farishton ke aameen ke saath hoga, uske pichhle saare paap kshama kar diye jayenge."

Hamen Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne aadesh diya hai ki jab imaam aameen kahe, to ham aameen kahen. Kyonki yahi farishton ke aameen kahne ka samay hai, aur jiska aameen kahna farishton ke aameen kahne ke saath hoga, uske pichhle saare paap kshama kar diye jayenge.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5845: Thahro! Tum utna hi amal karo, jitne ki kshamta rakhte ho. Allah ki saugandh, Allah nahin uktayega, yahaan tak ki tum hi ukta jaaoge. Tatha aapki nazar mein wahi amal sabse priy tha, jise karne waala hamesha karta rahe.

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- se riwayat hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ek baar unke paas tashreef laye. Wahaan ek aurat baithi thi. Aapne poochhaah "Yeh kaun hai?" Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ne kaha ki yeh amuk aurat hai, jo apni namaz ka haal bayaan kar rahi hai. Aapne farmaya : "Thahro! Tum utna hi amal karo, jitne ki kshamta rakhte ho. Allah ki saugandh, Allah nahin uktayega, yahaan tak ki tum hi ukta jaaoge." Tatha aapki nazar mein wahi amal sabse priy tha, jise karne waala hamesha karta rahe.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5846: Us zaat ki qasam, jiske haathon mein mera praan hai, yadi tum log usi haalat mein hamesha raho, jis haalat mein mer paas hote ho tatha usi prakaar zikr karte raho, to farishte tumse tumhaare bistaron aur tumhaare raaston mein musaafha karenge. Leki ai hanzla, kabhi Allah ko yaad karo, to kabhi ghar pariwaar ki dekhbhaal karo.

Abu ribai hanzla bin rabi usaidi Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke lekhak kahte hain ki abu bakr -radiyallahu anhu- ki mujhse bhent hui, to farmaya : Ai hanzla, kaise ho? Mainne kahaah hanzla munaafiq ho gaya hai! Kahaah subhaanallah! Kya kah rahe ho? Mainne kahaah jab ham Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke nikat hote hain aur aap hamen Jannat tatha Jahannam ki yaad dilaate hain, to aisa lagta hai ki ham log apni aankhon se dekh rahe hain aur jab Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke yahaan se nikal jaate hain, to patniyon tatha bachchon evn jaydaadon mein magn ho jaate hain aur anek cheezen bhool jaate hain. Abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ne kaha : Mere saath bhi aisa hi hota hai. Atah main aur abu bakr donon Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas gae. Mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, hanzla munaafiq ho gaya hai! Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne poochha : "Iska kya matlab hai?" Mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Jab ham aapke paas hote hain aur aap hamen Jannat tatha Jahannam ki yaad dilaate hain, to aisa lagta hai ki ham log apni aankhon se dekh rahe hain aur jab aapke yahaan se nikal jaate hain, to patniyon tatha bachchon aur jaydaadon mein magn ho jaate hain aur anek cheezen bhool jaate hain. Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Us zaat ki qasam, jiske haathon mein mera praan hai, yadi tum log usi haalat mein hamesha raho, jis haalat mein mer paas hote ho tatha usi prakaar zikr karte raho, to farishte tumse tumhaare bistaron aur tumhaare raaston mein musaafha karenge. Leki ai hanzla, kabhi Allah ko yaad karo, to kabhi ghar pariwaar ki dekhbhaal karo."
5847: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne vyavsayik kaafilon se aage jaakar milne aur dehaat waale ki or se nagar waasi ke bechne se mana kiya hai.

Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne vyavsayik kaafilon se aage jaakar milne aur dehaat waale ki or se nagar waasi ke bechne se mana kiya hai. Warnankarta kahte hain ki mainne ibne abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- se poochha ki dehaat waale ki or se nagar waasi ke bechne ka matlab kya hai? Unhonne uttar diya : Nagar waasi dehaat waale ka dalaal na bane.

Is hadees mein Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kray-wikray ke kuchh warjit praaroopon se mana kiya hai, jinke andar ya to bechne waale, ya khareedne waale ya unke alaawa kisi aur ka nuqsaan chhupa hota hai.
Aapne is baat se mana kiya hai ki jo log apne saamaan jaise anaaj aur jaanvar aadi baazaar ki or la rahe hon, unke baazaar pahunchne se pahle hi unse jaakar mil liya jaye aur unka saamaan khareed liya jaye. Mana karne ka kaaran yeh hai ki aise log baazaar ke bhaav se anbhijn hote hain aur is baat ki sanbhaavna rahti hai ki unse saste daamon mein saamaan khareedkar unhen us mooly se wanchit kar diya jaye, jiske liye we door-daraaz ke kshetron se yaatra karke aye hain aur kathinaaiyaan jheli hain. Jabki kuchh log bina kisi mehnat ke baithe-bithaye bhaari munaafa kama len.
Doosri cheez jisse aapne mana kiya hai, yeh hai ki dehaat ya gaanv ka rahne koi vyakti apna saamaan nagar le jaye, taaki use us din ke bhaav se ya us bhaav se jiski use aawashyakta ho, bech sake, lekin koi nagarvaasi uske paas aye aur kahe ki tum use mere paas rakh do, main use dheere-dheere mahange daamon mein bech doonga. Isse mana karne ka kaaran yeh hai ki ismen nagarvaasiyon ki haani chhupi hoti hai.
Is tarah dekha jaye, to shareeyat ne shahar se door rahne waale mooly se anbhijn bechne waale ke adhikaar ki bhi suraksha ki hai aur nagarvaasiyon ke adhikaar ki bhi suraksha ki hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5848: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne muzaabna yaani is baat se mana farmaya hai ki baag mein lage hue phal yadi khajoor hon, to unhen sookhi khajooron ke badle mein naapkar becha jaye, aur agar angoor hon to unhen kishmish ke badle mein naapkar becha jaye ya phir kheti ko galle ke badle mein naapkar bechkar jaye. Aapne in sab se mana kiya hai.

Abdallah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne muzaabna yaani is baat se mana farmaya hai ki baag mein lage hue phal yadi khajoor hon, to unhen sookhi khajooron ke badle mein naapkar becha jaye, aur agar angoor hon to unhen kishmish ke badle mein naapkar becha jaye ya phir kheti ko galle ke badle mein naapkar bechkar jaye. Aapne in sab se mana kiya hai.

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne muzaabna se mana kiya hai. Muzaabna naam hai jnaat wastu ko usi jins ki ajnaat wastu ke badle mein bechne ka. Mana karne ka kaaran yeh hai ki is kray-wikray mein donon pakshon mein se kisi ek ke nuqsaan ke saath-saath donon wastuon ke baraabar hone ki jaankaari ka bhi abhaav hai, jo sood ka kaaran ban sakta hai. Is kray-wikray ko spasht karne ke liye iski kai misaalen di gai hain. Jaise khajoor ke baag mein lage hue phal ko sookhi khajoor ke badle naapkar bechna, angoor ke baag mein lage hue angoor ko kishmish ke badle naapkar bechna aur khet mein lagi hui phasal ke anaaj ko usi jins ke anaaj se naapkar bechna aadi. Aapne kray-wikray ki in saari shaklon se mana kiya hai, kyonki inke andar kai kharaabiyaan aur nuqsaan hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5849: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne shighaar wiwaah se mana kiya hai. (Shighaar wiwaah yeh hai ki aadmi apni beti ka wiwaah is shart par karaye ki doosra bhi apni beti ka nikaah usse karayega aur donon mein se kisi ko bhi mahar nahin dena hoga.)

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne shighaar wiwaah se mana kiya hai. (Shighaar wiwaah yeh hai ki aadmi apni beti ka wiwaah is shart par karaye ki doosra bhi apni beti ka nikaah usse karayega aur donon mein se kisi ko bhi mahar nahin dena hoga.)

Nikaah ke anubandh mein asal yeh hai ki stri ko apne nafs ke badle mahar milna chahiye aur iske bina yeh anubandh sanpann nahin hoga.
Yahi kaaran hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne jaahiliyat kaal mein prachlit is nikaah se mana kiya hai, jismen abhibhaawakgan apne maathat striyon par atyaachaar karte the. Kyonki we unka nikaah bina mahar ke, kewal apni abhilaashaaon tatha waasnaaon ko saamne rakhte hue kar dete the. We unka wiwaah is shart par kar dete the ki unse wiwaah karne waale bhi apne maatah striyon ka nikaah unse bina mahar ke kar denge.
Yeh saraasar atyaachaar aur striyon ke saath Allah ki utaari hui shareeyat ki andekhi karte hue kiya jaane waala vyavhaar hai. Isliye yeh haraam aur amaany hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5850: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne munaabza se mana kiya hai. Woh yeh hai ki bechne waala apna kapra khareedne waale ki or bechne ke liye phenk de aur use ulatne palatne ya dekhne ka avsar na mile. Isi tarah aapne mulaamsa se bhi mana kiya hai. Woh yeh hai ki khareedne waala kapre ko kewal chhu le aur use dekhe nahin.

Abu saeed khudri -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne munaabza se mana kiya hai. Woh yeh hai ki bechne waala apna kapra khareedne waale ki or bechne ke liye phenk de aur use ulatne palatne ya dekhne ka avsar na mile. Isi tarah aapne mulaamsa se bhi mana kiya hai. Woh yeh hai ki khareedne waala kapre ko kewal chhu le aur use dekhe nahin.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne dhokhayukt kray-wikray se mana kiya hai, kyonki usmen khareedne tatha bechne waale mein se kisi ek ka nuqsaan chhupa hota hai aur use khareedne athva bechne mein dhokhe ka shikaar hokar nuqasna uthaana parta hai.
Ise aap yoon samajh sakte hain ki jaise bechi jaane waali wastu bechne waale, khareedne waale ya donon ke liye naamaaloom ho.
Iska ek roop munaabza naami kray-wikray hai, jo bechne waale ke khareedaar ki or bechi jaane waali wastu, jaise kapra aadi ke phenk dene maatr se laagu ho jaata hai, aur khareedaar ko use ulatne-palatne tatha dekhne ka tak ka avsar nahin diya jaata hai.
Iska doosra roop mulaamsa naami kray-wikray hai, jo saamaan jaise kapra aadi ke chhu lene maatr se laagu ho jaata hai aur khareedaar ko dekhne tatha palatne ka avsar nahin milta.
Kray-wikray ke yeh donon roop, saamaan ke sanbandh mein jaankaari ke abhva aur dhokhe ka kaaran bante hain. Khareedne tatha bechne waale mein se koi ek khatre mein rahta hai ki ya to fayde mein rahega ya nuqsaan mein par jayega. Isliye donon jue ke hukm mein honge, jisse ki mana kiya gaya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5851: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne (per par lage hue) phal ko rang pakarne se pahle bechne se mana kiya hai. Poochha gaya ki rang pakarne ka kya matlab hai? To farmaya : Woh laal ho jayen. Farmaya : "Bhala bataao ki yadi Allah ne phal rok liye, to bechne waala kis cheez ke badle apne bhaai ke dhan ko halaal banayega?"

Anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne (per par lage hue) phal ko rang pakarne se pahle bechne se mana kiya hai. Poochha gaya ki rang pakarne ka kya matlab hai? To farmaya : Woh laal ho jayen. Farmaya : "Bhala bataao ki yadi Allah ne phal rok liye, to bechne waala kis cheez ke badle apne bhaai ke dhan ko halaal banayega?"

Phal pakne se poorv, us par adhikaansh aapdayen aati rahti hain aur uske bechne mein us samay khareedaar ka koi hit nahin hai. Atah Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne khareedaar tatha bechne waale donon ko laal hone tak bechne se mana farmaya. Phir widhi widhaan karne waale ne bikri se manaahi ka karan bataya ki yadi poore athva kuchchh phalon par koi aapda aajaye, to kaise kisi badle ke bina tum apne bhaai ka maal loge?
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5852: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne phalon ko prayog ke layaq hone se pahle bechne se mana kiya hai. Aapne bechne waale aur khareedne waale donon ko mana kiya hai.

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne phalon ko prayog ke layaq hone se pahle bechne se mana kiya hai. Aapne bechne waale aur khareedne waale donon ko mana kiya hai.

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne phalon ko us samay tak bechne se mana pharmaya hai, jab tak unke pakne ke lakshan dikhne na lagen. Aapne isse bechne tatha khareedne waale donon ko mana kiya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5853: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne 'wala' (aisa adhikaar jiske kaaran daas ko mukt karne waala apne mukt kiye daas ke marne ke baad uski sanpatti mein se nirdisht hisson waalon ke baad shesh bhaag ka waaris banta hai) ko bechne tatha use uphaarasvaroop dene se mana farmaya hai.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne 'wala' (aisa adhikaar jiske kaaran daas ko mukt karne waala apne mukt kiye daas ke marne ke baad uski sanpatti mein se nirdisht hisson waalon ke baad shesh bhaag ka waaris banta hai) ko bechne tatha use uphaarasvaroop dene se mana farmaya hai.

Wala' nasab hi ki tarah ek aatmeey sanbandh hai aur donon ko kray-wikray evn daan ke maadhyam se praapt nahin kiya ja sakta. Yahi kaaran hai ki 'wala' ko becha evn daan nahin kiya ja sakta. Daraasal yeh mukti pradaan karne waale aur mukti praapt karne waale ke beech ek sanbandh hai, jiske aadhaar par pahla vyakti doosre vyakti ki meeraas ka uttaraadhikaari banta hai. Ise bechne tatha daan karne se mana isliye kiya gaya hai, kyonki yeh nasab hi ki tarah hastaantrit karne se hastaantrit hota nahin hai. Udaaharnasvaroop yadi koi vyakti apne bhaai, apne bete ya apne bhateeje se apne sanbandh ko bechna chaahe, to aisa kiya nahin ja sakta. Nasab so becha nahin ja sakta aur yahi haal wala ka bhi hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5854: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne garbh ke garbh ko bechne se mana farmaya hai.

Abdullahu bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne garbh ke garbh ko bechne se mana farmaya hai, jo ki jaahiliyyatkaal mein prachlit tha. Hota yeh tha ki ek vyakti oontni khareedta aur mooly us samay dene ka wachan deta, jab woh oontni bachcha jane aur phir us bachche ke pet se bachcha paida ho. Yeh bhi kaha jaata hai ki aadmi boorhi oontni ko doosri oontni ke pet mein pal rahe bachche ke bachche ke badle mein bechta tha.

Yeh ek haraam kray-wikray hai aur iski do vyaakhyayen ki gai hain :
1- iska arth latkaye rakhne ka ho. Iski tafseel yeh hai ki koi vyakti kisi ko apna saamaan udhaar beche aur qeemat ada karne ki samay seema yeh tay kare ki uski oontni bachcha de aur phir us bachche ke pet se bachcha paida ho jaye. Is kray-wikray se mana karne ka kaaran yeh hai ki yahaan qeemat ada karne ka samay nishchit nahin hai, jabki adaygi ke samay ke lanba athva chhota hone se qeemat ka prabhaawit hona sarvawidit hai.
2- iska arth ho gairmaujood tatha naamaaloom wastu ko bechna. Iski tafseel yeh hai ki koi aadmi kisi ko kisi jaanvar ke pet mein palne waale pachche ke pet se paida hone waale bachche ko beche. Is tarah ki khareed-farokht se mana karne ka kaaran yeh hai ki iske andar bahut bara nuqsaan tatha ghaata chhupa hua hai. Kyonki koi nahin jaanta ki jaanvar ke pet se nar paida hoga ya maada, ek hoga ya do, jeewit hoga ya mrit? Saath hi ismen wastu ki praapti ka samay bhi anishchit hai aur is tarah ke anishchit kray-wikray ke bahut-se nuksaan saamne aate hain, jo wiwaadon ka kaaran bante hain.
Is tarah se dekha jaye to is masse ke chaar roop bante hain :
Pahla roop : Oontni ke garbh ko bechna.
Doosra roop : Oontni ke garbh ke garbh ko bechna. Yahaan bechi jaane waali wastu naamaaloom aur anishchit hai.
Teesra roop : Bechi jaane waali wastu ko baad mein dene ki baat karna. Yaani saamaan ko us samay khareedaar ke halaale karne ki baat kahna, jab oontni ka bachcha paida ho ya uske garbh mein pal rahe bachche ka bachcha paida ho.
Chautha roop : Saamaan to hawaale kar diya jaye, lekin qeemat ko anishchit samay tak ke liye udhaar rakha jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5855: Meri patni ne kaala bachcha jana hai! Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Kya tumhaare paas oont hai?" Kaha : Haan. Farmaya : "Uska rang kaisa hai?" Kaha : Laal. Farmaya : "Usmen koi khaaki rang ka oont hai?" Kaha : Haan. Farmaya : "Woh kahaan se aya?" Kahaah sanbhvat : Aisa anuwanshik kaarnon se hua ho. Farmaya : "Ho sakta hai ki tere bete ka rang bhi anuwanshik kaarnon se kaala hua ho."

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se warnati hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas ek dehaati aya aur kahne laga : Ai Allah ke Rasool, meri patni ne kaala bachcha jana hai! Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Kya tumhaare paas oont hai?" Kaha : Haan. Farmaya : "Uska rang kaisa hai?" Kaha : Laal. Farmaya : "Usmen koi khaaki rang ka oont hai?" Kaha : Haan. Farmaya : "Woh kahaan se aya?" Kahaah sanbhvat : Aisa anuwanshik kaarnon se hua ho. Farmaya : "Ho sakta hai ki tere bete ka rang bhi anuwanshik kaarnon se kaala hua ho."

Fazaara qabeele ke ek vyakti ke yahaan ek bachcha paida hua, jiska rang uske maata-pita ke rang se alag tha. Atah, uske dil mein kuchh shanka paida hui. Woh Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas apni patni par laanchhan lagaane ke uddeshy se aya aur bataya ki uske ek kaalaakloota pachcha paida hua hai. Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- uski mansha samajh gae. Isliye, uski santushti evn uske bhram ko door karne ke liye ek udaahran diya, jo usko achchhi tarah samajh mein a sakta tha. Unse kaha : Kya tumhaare paas oont hain? Usne kaha : Haan. Farmaya : Unka rang kaisa hai? Kaha : Laal. Farmaya : Kya unmen se kisi oont ka rang aam oonton se alag khaaki bhi hai? Kaha : Haan. Farmaya : Phir yeh alag rang kahaan se a gaya? Usne kaha : Sanbhavtah aisa anuwaanshik kaarnon so hua hoga. Aapne khaha : Shayad tumhaara beta bhi anuwaanshik kaarnon se kaalaakloota paida hua hoga. Ho sakta hai ki tumhaare baap-daadon mein se koi kaala raha ho aur usi ke kaaran tumhaara beta kaala hua ho.
Is upyukt udaahran se woh santusht ho gaya aur uska bhram bhi door ho gaya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5856: "Woh aajeewika thi, jise Allah ne tum logon ke liye nikaala tha. Kya tumhaare paas uska kuchh maans hai ki hamen bhi khila sako?" Hamne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko uska kuchh maans bheja aur aapne us se khaya.

Abu abdullah jaabir bin abdullah -radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne hamen abu ubaida- radiyallahu anhu- ki aguwaai mein quraish ke ek vyaapaari kaafile ki talaash mein bheja aur hamen ek thaili khajoor di. Aapke paas uske siwa kuchh nahi tha. Abu ubaida hamen ek-ek khajoor diya karte the. Unse poochha gaya ki aap log uska kya karte the? Unhonne uttar diya : Ham use bachchon ki tarah choos lete aur uske baad paani paan pi lete the. Is tarah woh ek khajoor din bhar aur raat tak ke liye kaafi ho jaati. Ham apni laathi se per ke patte jhaarte aur phir unhen paani mein bhigokar khaate the. Woh kahte hain : Ham log samudr ke kinaare-kinaare chal rahe the ki samudr ke kinaare bahut bare teele ke roop mein hamaare liye kuchh prakat hua. Jab ham uske paas pahoonche, to dekha ki woh anbar naami ek jaanvar hai. Use dekh abu ubaida ne kaha : Yeh mara hua jaanvar hai. Lekin phir kahaah nahin, ham log to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke hue log hain aur Allah ke raaste mein nikle hue hain aur tum majboori ki haalat mein bhi ho. Atah, khaao. Chunaanche ham log, jo teen sau ki sankhya mein the, use ek maheene tak khaate rahe, yahaan tak ki mote ho gae. Hamne uski aankhon ke garhe se gharon mein bhar-barkar charbi nikaali. Ham usse maans ke tukre kaatkar alag karte, jo bail ke baraabar hote. Abu ubaida ne terah logon ko le jaakar uski aankh ke garhe mein bitha diya. Isi tarah uski ek pasli ko khara kiya aur hamaare kaafile ke sabse oonche oont ko kajaawa pahna diya, to woh uske neeche se guzar gaya. Hamne uske maans ke kuchh sookhe hue tukre apne paas rasad ke taur par rakh liye. Jab ham madeena pahunche, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aye aur iska zikr kiya, to aapne farmaya : "Woh aajeewika thi, jise Allah ne tum logon ke liye nikaala tha. Kya tumhaare paas uska kuchh maans hai ki hamen bhi khila sako?" Hamne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko uska kuchh maans bheja aur aapne us se khaya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5860: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- lagaataar kai-kai raat bhookhe pet guzaar dete aur aapke ghar waalon ko bhi raat ka khaana naseeb nahin hota. Unki roti adhiktar jau ki roti hua karti thi.

Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- lagaataar kai-kai raat bhookhe pet guzaar dete aur aapke ghar waalon ko bhi raat ka khaana naseeb nahin hota. Unki roti adhiktar jau ki roti hua karti thi.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- lagaataar kai raaten bina kuchh khaye so jaya karte the. Aisa hi haal aapki striyon evn bachchon ka bhi hua karta tha. Kyonki unke paas raat ko khaane ke liye kuchh nahin hota tha. Waise, un dinon unke yahaan roti aksar jau ki banti thi, jo gehoon aadi ki tulna mein kam mahanga hota hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5861: Tumhaara wiwaah kaise sahi ho sakta hai, jabki uska daawa hai ki usne tum donon ko stanpaan karaya hai?

Uqba bin haaris -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki unhonne umm-e-yahya bint abu ihaab se shaadi ki, to sauda ki daasi aai aur kahne lagi ki mainne tum donon ko stanpaan karaya hai. Yeh baat mainne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko bataai, to aapne mujhse munh pher liya. Mainnen thora-sa hatkar dobaara aapke saamne baat rakhi, to farmaya : "Tumhaara wiwaah kaise sahi ho sakta hai, jabki uska daawa hai ki usne tum donon ko stanpaan karaya hai?"

Uqba bin haaris -radiyallahu anhu- ne umm-e-yahya bint abu ihaab se shaadi ki, to ek kaaleeklooti daasi aai aur kahne lagi ki usne unko aur unki patni donon ko doodh pilaya hai. Uqba -radiyallahu anhu- ne us daasi ke daawe ka zikr Allah ke Rasool ke saamne kiya aur kaha ki woh apne daawe mein jhoothi hai, to aapne us daasi ki gawaahi ke baavjood uqba ki apni patni ke saath rahne ki chaahat ka khandan karte hue kaha : Tumhaari yeh ichchha kaise poori ho sakti hai, jabki us daasi ne is tarah ka daawa kar diya hai aur jo kuchh jaanti hai, uski gawaahi de di hai?
5862: Jo vyakti halaal ki kamaai se khajoor ke baraabar bhi koi wastu sadqa karta hai aur waise bhi Allah kewal halaal wastu hi ko sveekaar karta hai, to Allah use apne daahine haath se grahan karta hai aur phir use sadqa karne waale ke liye usi prakaar barhaata jaata hai, jis prakaar tummen koi ghore ke bachche ki paravrish karta hai, yahaan tak ki woh pahaar ke samaan ho jaata hai.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Jo vyakti halaal ki kamaai se khajoor ke baraabar bhi koi wastu sadqa karta hai aur waise bhi Allah kewal halaal wastu hi ko sveekaar karta hai, to Allah use apne daahine haath se grahan karta hai aur phir use sadqa karne waale ke liye usi prakaar barhaata jaata hai, jis prakaar tummen koi ghore ke bachche ki paravrish karta hai, yahaan tak ki woh pahaar ke samaan ho jaata hai."

Jisne khajoor ke mooly ke baraabar bhi koi halaal cheez daan ki, jo milaawat evn dhokhaadhri se pawitr ho, haalaanki Allah kewal svachchh evn halaal wastu hi ko grahan karta hai, to use Allah apne dayen haath se grahan karta hai. Jnaat ho ki dayen haath se grahan karne ki baat usi tarah maan li jayegi, jaise bayaan hui hai. Pawitr evn mahaan Allah yeh kaam apne prataap evn mahima ke anuroop karega. Ham hadees ke in shabdon tatha inke arth se koi chherchhaar nahin karenge. Jnaat ho ki yahaan grahan karne se muraad daan karne waale se lena hai, jaisa ki Muslim ki riwayat mein hai. Phir use Allah usi prakaar barhaata aur uske pratiphal ko guna dar guna barhaata rahta hai, jaisa tummen se koi apne ghore ka laalan-paalan karta hai, yahaan tak ki woh bara ho jaata hai.
