5864: Zubair bin avvaam -radiyallahu anhu- ki mrityu aur unka qarz ada karne ka qissa.

Abu khubaib abdullah bin zubair -radiyallahu anhuma- se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki jab jang-e-jamal ke din zubair -radiyallahu anhu- khare hue, to mujhe bulaya. Jab main unke paas khara ho gaya, to farmaya : Ai mere bete, aaj ya to zaalim maara jayega ya mazloom. Jabki mujhe lagta hai ki aaj main mazloom ki haisiyat se maara jaaoonga. Mujhe jis cheez ki chinta sabse adhik hai, woh mera qarz hai. Kya tumhen andaaza hai ki mera qarz ada karne ke baad mera kuchh dhan bach sakega? Phir pharmaya : Ai mere bete! Mera maal bechkar mera karz ada dena. Phir unhonne ek tihaai dhan ki waseeyat ki aur us ek tihaai ke ek tihaai ki waseeyat abdullah bin zubair ke beton ke liye ki. Farmaya : Yadi karz ada karne ke pashchaat kuchh maal bach jaye, to uski ek tihaai ka ek tihaai bhaag tere beton ke liye hai. Hishaam kahte hain ki abdullah ke kuchh bete zubair ke beton ke hamaumr the, jaise khubaib aur abbaad. Us samay unko nau larke aur nau larkiyaan theen. Abdullah kahte hain : Woh mujhe nirantar apne qarj ke baare mein waseeyat karte rahe aur kahte rahe ki ai mere bete, yadi qarz ka kuchh bhaag ada karne se wiwash ho jaao, to mere maalik se sahayta maangna. Abdullah kahte hain : Allah ki qasam, main unka iraada samajh na saka. Yahi kaaran hai ki mainne unse poochh daala ki aapka maalik kaun hai? Unhonne uttar diya : Allah! Woh kahte hain ki Allah ki qasam, main unke qarz ke sanbandh mein jab bhi kisi pareshaani mein parta, to dua karta ki ai zubaire ke maalik! Uski or se uska qarz utaar de. Chunaanche Allah qarz utaarne ka raasta bana deta. Abdullah kahte hain : Phir zubair shaheed kar diye gae. Unhonne dirham aur deenaar nahin chhore the. Kewal kuchh bhoomi chhori thi, jis mein 'al-ghaaba' ki bhoomi bhi shaamil thi. Iske atirikt madeene mein gyaarah, basra mein do ghar tatha koofa wa misr mein ek-ek ghar bhi chhore the. Abdullah kahte hain : Unka karz is prakaar ka tha ki log unke paas maal amaanat rakhne ke liye aate, to woh kah dete : Use amaanat nahin, balki qarz ke taur par rahne do. Mujhe dar hai ki woh nasht na ho jaye. Woh na kabhi ameer bane the, na kar tatha kharaaj wasool karne ki zimmadewaari li thi aur na is tarah ka koi doosra pad liya tha. Haan, unhonne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- tatha abu bakr, umar evn usmaan -radiyallahu anhum- ke saath yuddh mein bhaag zaroor liya tha. Abdullah kahte hain : Mainne unke qarz ka hisaab lagya, to woh 22 laakh ho raha tha. Isi beech hakeem bin hizaam abdullah bin zubair se mile aur unse poochha : Ai mere bhateeje, mere bhaai par kitna qarz hai? Abdullah kahte hain ki mainne unse chhupaate hue kaha : Ek laakh. Yeh sun unhonne kaha : Allah ki qasam, main nahin samajhta ki tumhaare paas itna qarz chukaane ke liye paryaapt dhan hoga. Ispar abdullah ne kaha : Yadi yeh 22 laakh ho to aap kya kahenge? Unhonne kaha : Tum bhugtaan nahin kar sakoge. Dekho, yadi tum uske kuchh bhaag ke bhugtaan se wiwash raho, to mujhse sahayta maang lena. Warnankarta kahte hain : Zubair ne al-ghaaba ko ek laakh sattar hazaar mein khareed rakha tha, jise abdullah ne 16 laakh mein bech diya aur khare hokar kaha : Zubair se jo bhi kuchh payega, woh hamse al-ghaaba mein aakar mile. Chunaanche abdullah bin jaafar aye, jo unse chaar laakh paate the. Unhonne abdullah se kaha : Yadi tum chaaho, main tumhaare liye use chhor deta hoon? Abdullah ne kaha : Aisa nahin ho sakta. Unhonne kaha kaha : Yadi chaaho, to ise baad mein ada kar sakte ho. Abdullah ne kaha : Aisa bhi nahin ho sakta. Unhonne kaha : Tab al-ghaaba ka ek bhaag mujhe de do. Abdullah ne kaha : Yahaan se wahaan tak tumhaara hai. Is tarah, abdullah ne unki jaydaadon ka kuchh bhaag bechkar unka poora qarz chuka diya aur 'al-ghaaba' ke (kul 16 bhaagon mein se) saarhe chaar bhaag shesh bhi rah gae. Iske baad woh muaawiya ke paas aye. Us samay unke paas amr bin usmaan, munzir bin zubair aur ibne zamaaा maujood the. Muaawiya ne unse poochha : 'Al-ghaaba' ki qeemat kya rakhi gai hai? Unhonne uttar diya : Pratyek bhaag ka ek laakh. Unhonne poochha : Kitne bhaag bach gae hain? Jawaab diya : Saarhe chaar bhaag. Yeh sun munzir bin zubair ne kaha : Mainne ek bhaag ek laakh mein le liya. Tab amr bin usmaan ne kaha : Mainne bhi ek bhaag ek laakh mein le liya. Phir ibne zamaah ne kaha : Mainne bhi ek bhaag ek laakh mein le liya. Ant mein muaawiya ne poochha : Ab kitna bach gaya hai? Unhonne uttar diya : Derh hissa. Muaawiya ne kaha : Mainne use derh laakh mein khareed liya. Warnankarta ka kahna hai ki baad mein abdullah bin jaafar ne apna bhaag muaawiya se chhah laakh mein bech diya tha. Jab abdullah bin zubair qarz ada karne ka kaam poora kar chuke, to zubair ke any beton ne kaha : Ab hamaare beech meeraas ka wibhaajan kar deejiye. Ispar abdullah ne kaha : Allah ki qasam, main chaar saal tak Hajj ke avsar par yeh ailaan karne ke baad hi meeraas taqseem karoonga ki jiska bhi zubair ke oopar qarz ho, woh hamaare paas aye, ham uska qarz ada kar denge. Phir woh har saal Hajj ke avsar par ailaan karne lage. Jab chaar saal guzar gae, to meeraas taqseem kar diya aur ek tihaai bhaag de diya. Zubair ki chaar patniyaan theen aur har patni ke hisse mein baarah-baarah laakh ki raashi aai. Is tarah, unki kul sanpatti paanch karor do laakh ki thi.
5865: Huzaifa bin yamaan tatha abu huraira -radiyallahu anhuma- se warnit hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Allah taaala logon ko ekatr karega, to momin khare honge aur Jannat unse sameep kar di jayegi. Aise mein log aadam -alaihissalaam- ke paas jayenge aur kahenge : Ai hamaare pita, hamaare liye Jannat khulva den. Woh kahenge : Tumhen to tumhaare pita ke paap ne hi Jannat se nikaala hai! Main iske liye upyukt nahin hoon. Mere bete ibraaheem, jo Allah ke mitr hain, ke paas jaao. Farmaya : Chunaanche log ibraaheem ke paas jayenge. Lekin woh kahenge : Main iske liye upyukt nahin hoon. Main Allah ka mitr door-door se tha. Tum log moosa ke paas jaao, jinse Allah ne baat ki hai. Log moosa ke paas jayenge, to moosa kahenge ki main iske yogy nahin hoon. Tum eesa ke paas jaao, jo Allah ke shabd aur uski rooh hain. Log unke paas jayenge, to eesa farmayenge : Main iske yogy nahin hoon. Aise mein log Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas jayenge, to aap khare honge aur aapko anumti bhi de di jayegi aur amaanat tatha rakt-sanbandh bheje jayenge. Donon pulsiraat ke dayen tatha bayen khare ho jayenge, to tumhaara pahla giroh bijli ki tarah guzar jayega." Mainne kaha : Mere maata-pita aappar qurbaan hon, kaun-si wastu bijli ki tarah guzar sakti hai? Farmaya : "Kya tum nahin dekhte ki woh kaise palak jhapakte aati aur jaati hai? Phir ek giroh hawa ki tarah guzrega, phir ek giroh chiriya ki tarah guzrega, phir ek giroh paidal tez daurne waale purushon ki tarah guzrega. Log apne-apne karm ke anusaar guzar rahe honge. Jabki tumhaare Nabi siraat par khare hokar kah rahe honge : Ai mere rab, inhen bacha le, inhen bacha le. Yahaan tak ki bandon ke karm wiwash dikhaai parne lagenge. Ek aadmi ayega aur chal na paane ke kaaran ghisat raha hoga. Siraat ke donon kinaaron par ankure lage honge, jo un logon ko pakar lenge, jinhen pakarne ka aadesh hoga. Chunaanche, koi kharonch ke saath bach niklega, to kisi ko Jahannam mein phenk diya jayega." Us zaat ki qasam, jiske haathon mein abu huraira ke praan hain, Jahannam ki gahraai sattar warsh ki doori ke baraabar hai.

Allah logon ko qayaamat ke din hisaab evn pratiphal ke liye ekatr karega, to eemaan waale khare honge aur Jannat ko unke nikat kar diya jayega. Lekin unke liye Jannat ke dvaar khole nahin jayenge, kyonki qayaamat ke din logon ko lanbe samay tak khara rahna parega. Atah log aadam -alaihissalaam- ke paas jayenge aur unse kahenge ki Allah se unke liye Jannat kholne ka anurodh karen. Lekin woh unhen yeh kahkar lauta denge ki woh is kaary ke yogy nahin hain. Aisa woh apne us gunaah ke kaaran kahenge, jo tamaam logon ke Jannat se nikalne ka kaaran bana tha. Woh unhen ibraaheem -alaihissalaam- ke paas bhej denge, jo Allah ke 'khaleel' hain aur 'khaleel hona' prem ki sabse uchch shreni hai. Chunaanche log ibraaheem -alaihissalaam- ke paas jayenge, to woh unse kahenge ki mujhe itna ooncha pad praapt nahin hai. Tum log moosa -alaihissalaam- ke paas chale jaao. Allah ne unse bina kisi maadhyam ke pratyaksh roop se baat ki thi. Log moosa -alaihissalaam- ke paas jayenge, to woh unse kahenge ki main is kaary ke liye upyukt vyakti nahin hoon. Tum log eesa -alaihissalaam- ke paas chale jaao. Allah ne unki rachna apne ek shabd dvaara ki thi. Chunaanche saare log eesa -alaihissalaam- ke paas jayenge, to woh bhi kah denge ki main is kaary ke liye upyukt vyakti nahin hoon. Chunaanche sab log hamaare Nabi Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas jayenge aur unse kahenge ki Allah se anurodh keejiye ki hamaare beech nirnay kar de, aur hamaare liye Jannat ke dvaar khol de. Aap unki baat maan lenge aur Allah se sifaarish ki anumti maangenge, to aapko anumti de di jayegi. Phir amaanat evn rakt-sanbandh donon ayenge aur pul-siraat ke dayen-bayen khare ho jayenge. Pul-siraat daraasal Jannat ke oopar bana hua ek pul hai. Uspar se log apne-apne karm ke anusaar guzrenge. Jo duniya mein satkarm ki or tezi se jaata tha, woh is pul se tez gati se guzar jayega aur jo iske wipreet tha, uska haal iske wipreet hoga. Koi usse sahi-salaamat guzar jayega aur koi Jahannam mein ja girega. Jabki Jahannam ek aisi gahri khaai hai, jahaan insaan sattar warsh baad hi pahunch sakega. Allah hamen usse bachaye.
5866: Aasaani paida karo aur kathinaai mein na daalo tatha susmaachaar sunaao evn ghrina mat dilaao.

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Aasaani paida karo aur kathinaai mein na daalo tatha susmaachaar sunaao evn ghrina mat dilaao."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam deen tatha duniya se sanbandhit sabhi maamlon mein, sharai dayre mein rahkar, logon ka bojh halka karne, unko aasaani praadan karne aur unko kathinaai mein na daalne ka aadesh de rahe hain.

Saath hi aap bhalaai ka susmaachaar sunaane aur logon ko deen se ghrina na dilaane ki prerna de rahe hain.

Ek momin ka kartavy yeh hai ki woh logon ke andar Allah ki mohabbat daale aur unhen achchhe kaam ki prerna de.
Allah ki or bulaane waale ko chahiye ki woh hikmat ke saath logon ko islaam ka sandesh pahunchaane ke tareeqe par drishti rakhe.
Susmaachaar sunaane ke nateeje mein aahvaankarta tatha uske aahvaan ke prati logon ke andar ullaas, sveekriti aur santosh ki bhaavna paida hoti hai.
Kathinaai mein daalne se aahvaankarta ki baat ke prati doori, sandeh tatha shanka ki bhaavna janm leti hai.
Bandon par Allah ki aseem daya kyonki usne unke liye ek udaarta par aadhaarit dharm aur aasaan shareeyat ka chayan kiya hai.
Aasaani karne se muraad wahi aasaani hai, jo sharai shikshaaon ke anukool ho.

5878: Ai Allah, main teri sharan maangta hoon, wiwashta tatha susti se, kanjoosi aur burhaape se evn qabr ki yaatna se.

Zaid bin arqam -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Ai Allah, main teri sharan maangta hoon, wiwashta tatha susti se, kanjoosi aur burhaape se evn qabr ki yaatna se. Ai Allah, mujhe taqva pradaan karo aur pawitr kar de. Tu hi mujhe sabse behtar pawitr karne waala hai. Tu hi mera maalik aur prabhu hai. Ai Allah, main teri sharan chaahta hoon, aise jnaan se jo laabhdayak na ho, aise dil se jo tera bhay na rakhta ho, aisi aatma se jo santusht na ho aur aisi dua se jo qabool na ho."
5879: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab sone lagte, to apne donon haathon mein phoonkte aur soora al-ikhlaas, soora al-falaq aur soora an-naas parhkar donon haathon ko shareer par pherte.

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab sone lagte, to apne donon haathon mein phoonkte aur soora al-ikhlaas, soora al-falaq aur soora an-naas parhkar donon haathon ko shareer par pherte.

Aaranbh sir tatha chehre aur shareer ke agle bhaag se karte the. Aisa teen baar karte the.

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- jo Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki duniya mein bhi patni theen aur aakhirat mein bhi hongi, hamen aapki ek sunnat bataati hain ki aap har raat sote samay apne donon haathon ko mila lete aur unmen halke se is tarah phoonk maarte ki thook na nikle aur soora al-ikhlaas, soora al-falaq aur soora an-naas parhte the. Aadmi is sunnat par amal karte samay chaahe to pahle phoonk maare aur uske baad in sooron ko parhe ya phir pahle in sooron ko parhe aur uske baad phoonk maare. Kyonki yeh hadees tarteeb evn donon kaaryon mein se kisi ko pahle aur kisi ko baad mein karne ka pramaan prastut nahin karti. Uske baad aap donon haathon ko jahaan tak ho paata apne shareer par pherte. Aaranbh sar evn chehre tatha shareer ke agle bhaag se karte. Teenon sooron ko parhne, phoonk maarne aur haath pherne ka yeh kaam teen baar karte the.

Kitne aise log hain, jinko na koi paryaapti pradaan karne waala hai, na sharan dene waala."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab bistar mein jaate, to yeh dua parhte the : "الحمد لله الذي أطعمنا وسقانا وكفانا وآوانا فكم ممن لا كافي له ولا مؤوي" (Saari prashansa us Allah ki hai, jisne hamen khilaya, pilaya, paryaapti pradaan ki tatha sharan di. Kitne aise log hain, jinko na koi paryaapti pradaan karne waala hai, na sharan dene waala.) aapne ismen sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ki prashansa ki hai, jisne yadi tumhaare liye is bhojan evn is pey ka prabandh na kiya hota, to tumhen na khaane ko milta aur na peene ko. Atah us Allah ki prashansa honi chahiye jisne tumhen khaane evn peene ko diya. Aapke shabd "Paryaapti pradaan ki" Ka arth hai, yaani hamaare liye saare kaamon ko aasaan kar diya aur hamen rozi-roti ke maamle mein paryaapti pradaan ki. Jabki "Sharan di" Ka arth hai, hamaare liye thikaana banaya, jahaan ham sharan le saken. Na jaane kitne aise log hain, jinhen na koi prayaapti pradaan karne waala hai, na unke paas koi thikaana hai aur na unhen koi thikaana pradaan karne waala hai. Atah bistar mein jaate samay is dua ko parhna chahiye.
5883: Ai Allah, main teri panaah maangta hoon bhookh se, kyonki woh bura saathi hai. Teri panaah maangta hoon khayaanat se, kyonki woh bura raazdaar hai.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Ai Allah, main teri panaah maangta hoon bhookh se, kyonki woh bura saathi hai. Teri panaah maangta hoon khayaanat se, kyonki woh bura raazdaar hai."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5884: Kya main tumhen kuchh shabd na sikha doon, jo Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne mujhe sikhaye the ki yadi tumhaare oopar pahaar ke baraabar bhi qarz ho, to use Allah ada kar de? Tum kahoh ai Allah, mujhe halaal dekar haraam se bacha le aur mujhe apne anugrah se apne siwa doosron se beniyaaz kar de.

Ali -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki unke paas ek daas aya, jiska apne maalik se yeh unubandh tha ki woh use qistawaar kuchh dhan dekar khud ko mukt kar lega. Woh kahne laga ki main nirdhaarit dhanraashi ada karne se wiwash ho chuka hoon. Atah aap meri sahayta karen. Yeh sun ali (radiyallahu anhu) ne farmaya : Kya main tumhen kuchh shabd na sikha doon, jo Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne mujhe sikhaye the ki yadi tumhaare oopar pahaar ke baraabar bhi qarz ho, to use Allah ada kar de? Tum kahoh ai Allah, mujhe halaal dekar haraam se bacha le aur mujhe apne anugrah se apne siwa doosron se beniyaaz kar de.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5885: Yadi tum peechhe rahkar bhi Allah ki prasannata praapt karne ke liye achchhe karm karoge, to tumhaare darje oonche honge. Yeh bhi sanbhav hai ki tum abhi jeewit raho aur bahut-se logon ko tumse laabh ho aur bahut-se logon ko haani.

Saad bin abi waqqaas -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hajjatul-wada ke avsar par mujhe dekhne aye, jab main bahut zyaada beemaar tha. Mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, aap to dekh hi rahe hain ki meri beemaari kitni barh chuki hai. Main ek dhani vyakti hun aur mera uttaraadhikaari kewal ek beti hai. Aise mein kya main apne do tihaai dhan daan kar dun? Aapne farmaya : Nahin. Main ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, to kya aadhe ki anumti hai? Farmaya : Nahin. Mainne kaha : To phir ek tihaai ki? Farmaya : Haan, ek tihaai kar sakte ho, lekin ek tihaai bhi bahut hai. Dekho, yadi tum apne uttaraadhikaariyon ko dhani chhor jaate ho, to yeh is baat se achchha hai ki tum unhen nirdhan chhor jaao aur we logon ke saamne haath phailaate phiren. Yaad rakho, tum jo kuchh bhi Allah ki prasannata praapt karne ke liye kharch karoge, tumhen uski neki milegi. Yahaan tak ki jo niwaala tum apni patni ke muhn mein daaloge, uska bhi.
Unka kahna hai ki mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, kya main peechhe rah jaaoonga aur mere saathi madeena chale jayenge? Farmayaah yadi tum peechhe rahkar bhi Allah ki prasannata praapt karne ke liye achchhe karm karoge, to tumhaare darje oonche honge. Yeh bhi sanbhav hai ki tum abhi jeewit raho aur bahut-se logon ko tumse laabh ho aur bahut-se logon ko haani.
Ai Allah , mere saathiyon ki hijrat ko baaqi rakhna aur unhen ulte paavn waapas na karna. Lekin bechaara saad bin khaula! Daasal Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- is baat par shok vyakt kar rahe the ki unki mrityu makka mein ho gai.

Saad bin abu waqqaas -radiyallahu anhu- hajjatul wada ke avsar par itna zyaada beemaar ho gae ki unhen laga ki kaheen maut na a jaye. Choonki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki aadat thi ki aap apne saathiyon ka haalchaal jaanne tatha duhkh baantne jaya karte the, isliye unka bhi haal jaanne pahunche. Aise mein, saad -radiyallahu anhu- ne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saamne kai aise kaaran rakhe, jinke aadhaar par unke khayaal se unke adhiktar dhan ko daan kar dene ki anumti mil sakti thi. Unhonne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, meri beemaari itni barh chuki hai ki mujhe uske kaaran maut ka dar sataane laga hai. Main ek dhani vyakti hoon. Mere kamzor uttaraadhikaari bhi nahin hain ki mujhe unki nirdhanta evn nasht ho jaane ka dar ho. Uttaraadhikaari ke naam par bas ek beti hai. Aise mein, kya main aakhirat ke liye apna do tihaai dhan daan kar sakta hoon? Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : Nahin. Unhonne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, to kya aadha kar sakta hoon? Farmaya : Nahin. Poochha : To phir ek tihaai? Farmaya : Haan, do tihaai daan kiya ja sakta hai, lekin yeh bhi bahut hai. Isliye usse kam yaani ek chauthaai ya paanchvaan bhaag sadqa karna hi uttam hai. Phir Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unhen adhiktar dhan sadqa karne ke bajay kam sadqa karne ki hikmat do tarah se samjhaai :
1- agar woh mar gae aur apne uttaraadhikaariyon ko maaldaar apne dhan se laabh uthaane ki awastha mein chhor gae, to yeh isse kaheen behtar hai ki apna dhan doosron ke hawaale karke duniya se jayen aur unke bachche doosron ke ehsaan par jeewan vyateet karne ko majboor hon.
2- agar woh jeewit rah gae aur unka dhan bacha raha, to use sharai tareeqon par kharch karke neki kama sakte hain. Yahaan tak ki yadi apni patni par kharch karenge, jo ki unka kartavy bhi hai, to uska bhi unko sawaab milega.
Phir saad bin abu waqqaas -radiyallahu anhu- ke man mein is baat ka bhay paida hua ki kaheen woh makka hi mein na mar jayen, jahaan se woh hijrat karke chale gae the aur jise Allah ki prasannata praapt karne ke liye chhor gae the tatha isse unke hijrat ke sawaab mein koi kami na a jaye. Atah, Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unhen bataya ki yadi unhen na chaahte hue bhi makka mein rahna parta hai, jahaan se woh hijrat karke chale gae the, phir yahaan Allah ki prasannata ki praapti ke liye koi kaam karte hain, to isse unka darja aur ooncha hoga. Phir Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unhen ek susmaachaar sunaya, jo is baat ka pramaan tha ki woh svasth ho jayenge aur Allah unke zariye eemaan waalon ko fayda pahunchayega aur kaafiron ka haani. Baad mein hua bhi yahi. Woh svasth ho gae aur faarsiyon se lare jaane waale yuddh ke sarvochch kamaandar bane. Allah ne unse Islam tatha musalmaanon ko bara fayda pahunchaya ki unhonne kai wijay praapt kiye aur shirk tatha mushrikon ko zabardast haani pahunchaai. Phir Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne tamaam saathiyon ke liye dua ki ki Allah unko unka uchit sthaan pradaan kare, unki hijrat ko grahan kare aur unhen unke dharm se waapas na lautaye ya phir unko un sthaanon ki or waapas na kare, jahaan se we hijrat karke aye hain. Chunaanche Allah ne aapki is dua ko grahan kar liya. Saari prashansa aur upkaar Allah hai, jisne sahaaba ke maadhyam se islama ko shaktishaali banaya.
Phir aapne saad bin khaula ka zikr kiya, jo makka se madeena ki or hijrat karne waalon mein shaamil the, lekin Allah ka nirnay yeh hua ki woh makka mein aakar mar jayen. Aapne unke makka mein aakar marne par duhkh tatha khed prakat kiya. Aam taur par sahaaba is baat ko naapsand karte the ki koi usi sthaan ko jaakar mare, jahaan se usne hijrat ki thi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5886: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- saargarbhit duaaon ko pasand karte the aur isse itar duaaon ko chhor dete the.
Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : "Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- saargarbhit duaaon ko pasand karte the aur isse itar duaaon ko chhor dete the."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aisi saargarbhit duayen pasand karte the, jo duniya evn aakhirat ki bhalaaiyon par sammilit hon, kam shabdon mein adhik arthon ko samete hue hon tatha unke andar Allah ki preshansa aur sahi uddeshy nihit hon. Jin duaaon ke andar ye wisheshtayen na hon, unse aap gurez karte the.

Duayen chhoti lekin vyaapak aur achchhe arth waale shabdon mein karna musathab hai. Ismen banaawat se kaam lena makrooh hai. Yeh Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke tareeqe ke wiruddh bhi hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko saargarbhit shabdon mein baat rakhne ki kshamta pradaan ki gai thi.
Koshish yeh ho ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se saabit duaaon ko parha jaye, chaahe lambi aur adhik shabdon waali hi kyon na ho. Is prakaar saari duayen saargarbhit duaaon ke dayre mein aati hain.
[is hadees ko abu daawood aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5887: Nirdhaarit hisse unke haqdaaron tak pahuncha do aur nirdhaarit hisson ke baad jo shesh bach jaye, woh marne waale ke nikattam purush sanbandhi ke liye hai.

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Nirdhaarit hisse unke haqdaaron tak pahuncha do aur nirdhaarit hisson ke baad jo shesh bach jaye, woh marne waale ke nikattam purush sanbandhi ke liye hai."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne meeraas (uttaraadhikaar) baantne waalon ko aadesh diya hai ki we use nyay ke saath shareeyat ke bataye hue tareeqe ke anusaar taqseem karen. Atah sabse pahle un logon ko unka bhaag den, jinke bhaag Allah ki kitaab mein nirdhaarit kar diye gae hain. Ye nirdhaarit bhaag hain : Do tihaai, ek tihaai, chhatha bhaag, aadha bhaag, ek chauthaai bhaag aur aathvaan bhaag. Phir iske baad jo bach jaye, woh mritak ke nikattam purush vyakti ko de diya jaye. Is tarah ke logon ko (arbi bhaasha mein) 'asba' kaha jaata hai.

Yeh hadees wiraasat ke wibhaajan ke sanbandh mein ek mahatvapoorn siddhaant ki haisiyat rakhti hai.
Meeraas ki taqseem nirdhaarit hisse paane waalon se shuru hogi.
Nirdhaarit hisson ke baad jo bach jaye, woh asba (nikattam purush sanbandhiyon) ke liye hota hai.
Nikattam purush sanbandhiyon mein bhi adhik nikatvarti ko praathmikta praapt hogi. Atah koi door ka purush rishtedaar jaise chacha, nikat ke purush ke rishtedaar jaise pita ke hote hue waaris nahin banega.
Jab nirdhaarit hisse waalon ko dene ke baad dhan samaapt ho jaye aur kuchh na bache, to asba ke taur par bache hue rishtedaaron ko kuchh nahin milega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5888: Tum log aurton ke yahaan prawesh karne se bacho." Yeh sun ek ansaari vyakti ne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Pati ke nikat ke rishtedaar (pati ke bhaai evn chachere bhaai aadi) ke baare mein aap kya farmaate hain? Aapne farmaya : "Pati ka nikat ka rishtedaar to maut hai.

Uqba bin aamir juhni radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Tum log aurton ke yahaan prawesh karne se bacho." Yeh sun ek ansaari vyakti ne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Pati ke nikat ke rishtedaar (pati ke bhaai evn chachere bhaai aadi) ke baare mein aap kya farmaate hain? Aapne farmaya : "Pati ka nikat ka rishtedaar to maut hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ajanbi aurton ke saath ghulne-milne se mana farmaya hai. Farmaya ki khud ko is baat se bachaao ki aurton ke paas jaao aur aurten tumhaare paas ayen.

Yeh sun ek ansaari vyakti ne poochha : Pati ke rishtedaaron, jaise uske bhaai, bhateeje, chacha, chachere bhaai,  bhaanje aadi, jinse shaadeeshuda na hone ki awastha mein uski shaadi jayaz hoti, ke baare mein aapka kya khyaal hai?

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne uttar diya : Unse usi tarah saavdhaan raho, jis tarah maut se saavdhaan rahte ho. Kyonki pati ke rishtedaaron ke saath tanhaai mein milna-julna deeni fitne evn winaash ka sabab banta hai. Atah pati ke pita aur beton ko chhor uske any rishtedaar ajanbi purushon ki tulna mein is baat ke adhik haqdaar hain ki unse ghulne-milne se mana kiya jaye. Kyonki ajanbiyon ki tulna mein unke saath ekaant mein rahne ke avsar adhik praapt hote hain aur unse buraai evn fitne ki sanbhaavna bhi adhik rahti hai. Aisa isliye ki aurat tak unki pahunch aasaani se ho jaati hai, kabhi-kabhi unke saath ekaant mein rahna zaroori ho jaata hai, aur unhen stri ke paas aane se roka bhi nahin ja sakta, kyonki is baare mein narmi baratne ka riwaaj hai. Isliye kai baar dewar evn bhaabhi ekaant mein rah jaate hain, isliye ise maut jaisi buri evn nasht kar dene waali cheez bataya gaya hai. Jabki ajanbi purush ka maamla alag hai, usse aam taur par saavdhaan hi raha jaata hai.

Ajanbi mahilaaon ke yahaan prawesh karne aur unke saath ekaant mein rahne ki manaahi. Yeh manaahi daraasal kukarm ke dvaaron ko band karne ke liye hai.
Yeh ek vyaapak aadesh hai tamaam ajanbi parooshon ke baare mein hai, jismen pati ke bhaai evn aise tamaam rishtedaar sammilit hain, jo mahram nahin hain. Lekin manaahi usi samay hai, jab ekaant ho.
Insaan ko aisi jaghon se bachna chahiye, jismen phisalne ki sanbhaavna ho, buraai mein parne ke dar se.
Navvi kahte hain : Bhaashaawid is baat par ekmat hain ki "Ahma" (Dewar) se muraad pati ke rishtedaar, jaise uska pita, chacha, bhaai, bhateeja aur chachera bhaai aadi daakhil hain, "Akhtaan" Se muraad patni ke rishtedaar hain, jabki "Ashaar" Ke andar donon prakaar ke rishtedaar a jaate hain.
Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pati ke rishtedaaron ko maut ke samaan kaha hai. Is sanbandh mein ibn-e-hajar asaqlaani kahte hain : Arab apriy wastu ko maut kaha karte hain. Kaaran yeh hai ki agar gunaah ho gaya, to deen ki maut hai, gunaah ke kaaran sangsaar aniwaary ho jaye to ekaant mein rahne waale ki maut hai aur agar gunaah ho jaye aur pati svaabhimaan ke maddenzar talaaq de de, to aurat ka winaash hai ki use apne pati se alag hona hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5889: Chaandi sone ke badle mein agar naqad na ho to sood ho jaata hai. Gehoon, gehoon ke badle mein agar naqad na ho to sood ho jaata hai. Jau, jau ke badle mein agar naqad na ho, to sood ho jaata hai. Khajoor, khajoor ke badle mein agar naqad na ho, to sood ho jaata hai.

Maalik bin aus bin hadsaan se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Main yeh kahte hue aya ki hamen deenaar se dirham badalkar kaun dega? Chunaanche talha bin ubaidullah ne, jo umar bin khattaab -radiyallahu anhu- ke paas maujood the, kaha : Mujhe apna sona dikhaao aur uske baad aao, jab hamaara sewak a jayega, to ham tumhen tumhaari chaandi de denge. Yeh sunkar umar bin khattaab -radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha : Allah ki qasam, aisa nahin ho sakta, ya to tum use uski chaandi de do ya phir uska sona waapas kar do. Kyonki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Chaandi sone ke badle mein agar naqad na ho to sood ho jaata hai. Gehoon, gehoon ke badle mein agar naqad na ho to sood ho jaata hai. Jau, jau ke badle mein agar naqad na ho, to sood ho jaata hai. Khajoor, khajoor ke badle mein agar naqad na ho, to sood ho jaata hai."

Taabei maalik bin aus bata rahe hain ki unke paas kuchh sone ke deenaar the, jinhen woh chaandi ke dirham se badalna chaahte the. Atah talha bin ubaidullah ne unse kaha ki aap zara mujhe apne deenaar den ki main unhen dekh loon. Phir khareedne ka iraada ban gaya, to farmaya ki jab hamaare sewak aye, to aap a jayen, ham aapko chaandi ke dirham de denge. Wahaan umar bin khattaab -radiyallahu anhu- bhi maujood the. Chunaanche unhonne is tarah ke len-den ko ghalat bataya aur talha se Allah ki qasam dekar kaha ki woh ya to chaandi abhi de den ya phir liya hua sona waapas kar den. Unhonne iska kaaran yeh bataya ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : Sone ko chaandi se ya chaandi ko sone se bechna ho to len-den haathon haath hona chahiye, warna len-den sood waala ho jayega, jiski wajah se khareed-farokht haraam ho jayegi. Sone ko chaandi ke badle mein ya chaandi ko sone ke badle mein bechna usi samay theek hoga, jab lenden haathon-haath ho aur donon or se qabza ho jaye. Isi tarah gehoon ko gehoon ke badle, jau ko jau ke badle aur khajoor ko khajoor ke badle bechna usi samay durust hoga, jab wazan evn maap baraabar ho aur usi samay donon apne-apne saamaanon par qabza kar len. In cheezon mein na to ek taraf naqad aur ek taraf udhaar ko jayaz kaha ja sakta hai aur na qabze se pahle ek-doosre se alag ho jaane ki anumti di ja sakti hai.

Is hadees mein paanch prakaar ki cheezon ka ullekh kiya gaya hai : Sona, chaandi, gehoon, jau aur khajoor. Jab khareed-bikri ke samay donon or ek hi prakaar ki cheez ho, to uske sahi hone ke liye do sharton ka paya jaana zaroori hai. Ek yeh ki jahaan maamla tay ho usi jagah donon apne-apne saamaan par qabza kar len aur doosri yeh ki wazan baraabar ho jaise ki sona ke badle sona. Agar aisa nahin hota, to yeh sood hoga aur is prakaar ke sood ko riba al-fazl kaha jaata hai. Lekin agar donon cheezen alag-alag prakaar ki hon jaise ki gehoon ke badle chaandi to khareed-bikri ke sahi hone ke liye ek hi shart hogi. Woh shart hai, khareed-bikri ke sthaan par hi qeemat par qabza kar lena. Agar yeh shart poori nahin hoti, to ismen bhi sood a jayega, is prakaar ke sood ko riba al-naseeya kahte hain.
Khareed - bikri ke sthaan se muraad woh sthaan hai jahaan khareed-bikri hui ho. Isse farq nahin parta ki donon baithe hon, chal rahe hon ya sawaar hon. Isi tarah alag hone se muraad wahi hai, jise saamaany prachlan mein alag hona maana jaye.
Is hadees mein aai hui manaahi ke dayre mein har prakaar ka sona a jaata hai, dhala hua ho ki bina dhala hua. Aise hi har tarah ki chaandi bhi a jaati hai, dhali hui ho ki bina dhali hui.
Aadhunik mudraaon ka aadaan-pradaan karte samay, wahi baat dhyaan mein rakhna zaroori hai jo sone ke badle chaandi ka aadaan-pradaan karte samay dhyaan mein rakhna zaroori hai. Yaani agar paartiyon ki aapsi sahamti se kami ya barhotri hoti hai, to yeh jayaz hai, lekin jahaan bikri ka maamla tay ho usi jagah donon pakshon ka kabza kar lena zaroori hai. Agar aisa nahin hota hai, to ismen sood a jayega aur bikri amaany hogi.
Soodi len-den jayaz nahin hai aur aisa anubandh awaidh hai, bhale hi donon pakshon ki sahamti ho. Kyonki Islam maanavta aur samaaj ke adhikaaron ki raksha karta hai, bhale hi we apne adhikaaron ko chhorna chaahen.
Shakti hone par ghalat kaam hota hua dikhne par mana karna aur rokna zaroori hai.
Ghalat kaam se mana karte samay pramaan bhi prastut karna chahiye. Jaise ki umar -radiyallahu anhu- ne kiya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5905: Abhimaan tatha ahankaar ka haraam hona aur iska bura ant

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Ek vyakti khoobsoorat wastr dhaaran karke, abhimaani hokar apne sir mein kanghi karte hue chal hi raha tha ki Allah ne use zameen mein dhansa diya, to woh pralay ke din tak zameen mein dhansta rahega."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5906: Ham log kisi safar mein Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath the ki isi beech ek vyakti sawaar hokar aya.

Abu saeed khudri -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki ham log kisi safar mein Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath the ki isi beech ek vyakti sawaar hokar aya aur dayen-bayen dekhne laga. Yeh dekh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Jiske paas sawaari adhik hai, woh use sadqa kare jiske paas nahin hai aur jiske paas adhik rasad ho, woh use de de, jiske paas nahin hai." Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne paanch prakaar ki khareed-bikri se mana farmaya, jo haraam hain. Inse mana karne ka kaaran yeh hai ki inse khareedne waale, bechne waale ya kisi aur ko nuqsaan hota hai.
1. Aapne is baat se mana kiya hai ki jo log khaane-peene ki wastu ya pashu aadi ko bechne ke liye baazaar la rahe hon, unke baazaar pahunchne se pahle hi koi aage barhkar unse mile aur unka saamaan khareed le. Isse mana karne ka kaaran yeh hai ki bechne waale ko bhaav ka pata nahin hota. Atah sanbhav hai ki dhokhe mein kam qeemat dekar unse saamaan khareed liya jaye aur baazaar aakar adhik daam paane ka unka prayaas nishphal ho jaye.
2. Isi tarah kisi ke bechne par bechne aur kisi ke khareedne par khareedne se mana kiya hai. Iski soorat yeh hai ki koi khareedne waale se khareed-bikri ki majlis mein ya saamaan rakhne athva lautaane ke adhikaar ki avdhi mein kaheh main tumhen isse achchha saamaan doonga ya isse kam daam mein doonga. Ya phir bechne waale se kahe ki main tumse isse adhik daam mein khareed loonga. Uddeshy yeh ho ki uh maamle ko nirast karke usse maamla kar le. Isi tarah baad mein is tarah ki baat karne se bhi mana kiya hai. Kyonki is tarah ke uksaawe se aapsi dvesh aur shatruta paida hoti hai. Iske saath hi yeh kisi ko uski rozi se wanchit karne ka sabab bhi hai.
3. Isi tarah khareedne ka iraada na hone ke baavjood, bechne waale ko laabh pahunchaane athva khareedne waale ka nuqsaan karne ke uddeshy se saamaan ka bhaav barhaane se mana kiya hai. Kyonki yeh khareedne waale ko jhooth bolne aur uske saath dhokha karne tatha fareb ke sahaare saamaan ka daam barhaane ka zariya hai.

Isi tarah is baat se bhi mana kiya hai ki koi nagar ka rahne waala kisi dehaati ka saamaan beche, kyonki woh saamaan ka poora-poora bhaav wasool lega aur usmen koi kami nahin rahne dega ki khareedne waalon ko kuchh laabh ho. Isi sandarbh mein Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya haih "Logon ko apne haal par chhor do ki Allah unmen se kisi ko kisi ke zariye rozi de."

5919: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne is baat se mana kiya hai ki koi nagar ka rahne waala kisi dehaat mein rahne waale ka saamaan beche (tatha farmaya ki) tum aapas mein daam na barhaao tatha koi apne bhaai ke saude par sauda na kare aur na uske wiwaah-sandesh par apna wiwaah-sandesh bheje.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne is baat se mana kiya hai ki koi nagar ka rahne waala kisi dehaat mein rahne waale ka saamaan beche (tatha farmaya ki) tum aapas mein daam na barhaao tatha koi apne bhaai ke saude par sauda na kare aur na uske wiwaah-sandesh par apna wiwaah-sandesh bheje evn koi stri apni bahan ki talaaq na maange ki uski thaali mein jo kuchh hai, use undel le.

Islaam har us cheez ko khatm karna chaahta hai, jo Muslim samaaj mein shatruta aur dvesh ki bhaavna barhaati hai. Islaam ki yeh ichchha is hadees se bhi spasht hokar saamne aati hai. Is hadees mein khareedne ke iraade nahin, balki bechne waale ko laabh athva khareedne waale ko haani pahunchaane ke uddeshy se saamaan ka bhaav barhaane se mana kiya gaya hai. Iska kaaran yeh hai ki iska aadhaar jhooth, khareedne waalon ke saath dhokha tatha anaitik tareeqe se saamaan ka daam barhaane par hai.
Isi tarah is baat se mana kiya hai ki nagar ka rahne waala dehaat mein rahne waale ka saamaan beche; kyon ki woh saamaan ka poora daam le lega aur koi kami nahin rahne dega ki khareedne waalon ko kuchh fayda ho. Jabki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya haih "Logon ko apne haal par chhor do ki Allah unmen se kisi ko kisi se rozi de." Sachchaai yeh hai ki jab khud saamaan ka maalik use bechega, to apne hisaab se daam lega aur khareedne waalon ko kuchh na kuchh raahat milegi.
Yeh bhi haraam hai ki aadmi apne bhaai ke wiwaah-sandesh par wiwaah-sandesh de, jab tak yeh na jaan le ki sandesh bhejne waale ke sandesh ko nakaar diya gaya hai. Kyonki isse bhi shatruta aur dvesh ki bhaavna barhti hai aur yeh ek tarah se kisi ko uski rozi se wanchit karne ka prayaas bhi hai.
Isi tarah ek stri ke liye jayaz nahin hai ki woh apne pati se, apni sautan ko talaaq dene ka mutaalba kare, use uske wiruddh bharkaye ya donon ke beech katuta paida karne ka prayaas kare ki donon ek-doosre se alag ho jayen. Yeh ek haraam kaary hai. Kyonki ismen bahut-si buraaiyaan hain, jaise dushmani ka beej bona, eershya ka waataawarn banaana aur apni bahan ko uski rozi se mahroom karna, jiski or ishaara 'uske hisse ki bhalaai ko undel lene' ke waaky ke maadhyam se kiya gaya hai aur jo nikaah ke nateeje mein khilaane-pilaane, pahnaane aur any waiwaahik adhikaaron ke roop mein praapt hoti hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5920: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne sone ko chaandi ke badle mein udhaar bechne se mana farmaya hai.

Abu minhaal kahte hain ki mainne bara bin aazib aur zaid bin arqam se sone ko chaandi ke badle mein bechne ke sanbandh mein poochha to donon mein se har ek doosre ke baare mein yeh kahne lage ki woh mujhse behtar hain tatha donon kah rahe the ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne sone ko chaandi ke badle mein udhaar bechne se mana farmaya hai.

Abu minhaal ne bara bin aazib aur zaid bin arqam -radiyallahu anhuma- se 'sarf' arthaat naqad ko naqad ke badle bechne ke baare mein poochha. Lekin donon sahaaba ki parhezgaari dekhiye ki donon fatva dene ka kaam ek-doosre par taalte rahe aur khud ko doosre ki tulna mein kamtar bataate rahe. Haan, donon ek baat par ekmat the ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne sone ko chaandi ke badle mein udhaar bechne se mana kiya hai. Kyonki donon soodi wastuen hain. Atah, maamla jis baithak mein tay hua hai, usi baithak mein qabza ho jaana zaroori hai. Warna, maamla shareeyat ki nazar mein waidh nahin hoga aur udhaar ke kaaran sood ka maamla qaraar payega.
Jnaat ho ki sood (byaaj), dhan sanbandhi ek haraam lenden hai. Aur iske do prakaar hain;
Prathmah udhaar ka byaajah isse aashay yeh hai ki qarz ke parimaan ko, jise pahle ada karna tha, uski avdhi mein izaafe ke badle mein barha diya jaye.
Dviteeyah kray-bikray ka byaajah isse aashay hai wishesh wastuon ki khareed-bikri ke samay, jinhen soodi wastu kaha jaata hai, jaise gehoon ke badle gehoon aur jau ke badle jau, ek ko adhik dena ya der se ada karna.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5921: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne chaandi ko chaandi ke badal mein aur sone ko sone ke badal mein bechne mana farmaya hai. Haan, yadi baraabar ho to koi baat nahin hai. Aur hamen aadesh diya hai ki ham chaandi ko sone ke badle, jis tarah chaahen khareeden aur sone ko chaandi ke badle jis tarah chaahen, khareeden.

Abu bakra (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne chaandi ko chaandi ke badle mein aur sone ko sone ke badle mein bechne se mana farmaya hai. Haan, yadi baraabar ho to koi baat nahin hai. Aur hamen aadesh diya hai ki ham chaandi ko sone ke badle, jis tarah chaahen khareeden aur sone ko chaandi ke badle jis tarah chaahen, khareeden. Warnankarta kahte hain ki ek vyakti ne poochhaah kya haathon haath? To farmayaah mainne aisa hi suna hai.

Choonki sone ko sone ke badle aur chaandi ko chaandi ke badle kami-beshi ke saath bechna sood hai, isliye aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne isse mana farmaya hai. Haan, yadi donon baraabar hon, to koi baat nahin hai. Rahi baat sone ko chaandi ke badle ya chaandi ko sone ke badle bechne ki, to ismen koi harj nahin hai, yadyapi kami-beshi ke saath ho. Albatta, is maamle ke sahi hone ke liye aniwaary hai ki jis baithak mein maamla tay hua hai, usi baithak mein donon or se qabza bhi ho jaye. Warna, yeh udhaar ka sood qaraar payega, jo ki haraam hai. Kyonki jab jins alag-alag ho, to kami-beshi jayaz hogi aur qabze ki shart baaqi rahegi. Kyonki donon ke andar sood ka sabab ek hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5922: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne khaibar ke din nikaahe-mutaah (asthayi nikaah) tatha gharelu gadhe ka maans khaane se mana kiya tha.
Ali bin abu taalib (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne khaibar ke din nikaahe-mutaah (asthayi nikaah) tatha gharelu gadhe ke maans se mana kiya tha.

Shareeyat nikaah ke zariye sada ke liye ek dori mein baandhna, prem paida karna aur pariwaar ka nirmaan karna chaahti hai tatha usne nikaah ki kai aisi soorton ko haraam qaraar diya hai, jo uske uddeshy se mel nahin khaateen. Yahi kaaran hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne khaibar ke zamaane mein nikaah-e-mutaah ko haraam ghoshit kiya hai. Nikaah-e-mutaah yeh hai ki aadmi kisi stri se kuchh samay ke liye nikaah kare. Waise shuru-shuru mein ise, kuchh maslahton ke tahat, jayaz rakha gaya tha. Isi tarah aapne gharelu gadhe, jo paale jaate hain, unka maans khaane se bhi mana kiya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5926: Bani israaeel mein teen vyakti the; ek safed daag waala, doosra ganja aur teesra andha. Allah ne unki pareeksha ke uddeshy se unke paas ek farishta bheja.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki unhonne Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte sunaah bani israaeel mein teen vyakti the; ek safed daag waala, doosra ganja aur teesra andha. Allah ne unki pareeksha ke uddeshy se unke paas ek farishta bheja. Farishta sabse pahle safed daag waale ke paas aya aur bolaah tumhaare nikat sabse priy wastu kya hai?
Usne uttar diyaah sundar rang aur sundar tvacha. Saath hi is rog se mukti, jiske kaaran log mujhse ghin karte hain.
Aap farmaate hainh uski baat sunkar farishte ne uske shareer par haath rakha, jisse woh rogmukt ho gaya tatha use achchha rang evn achchhi tvacha mil gai.
Uske baad farishte ne kahaah ab bataao ki tumhen kaun-sa dhan adhik pasand hai?
Usne kahaah oont athva gay. (Hadees ke warnankarta ishaaq ko sandeh hai ki donon mein se kya kaha tha). Phir use ek das maheene ki gaabhin oontni de di gai. Saath hi farishte ne kahaah Allah tumhen is oontni mein barkat de.
Aap farmaate hainh farishta uske baad ganje ke paas aya aur bolaah tumhaare nikat sabse priy wastu kya hai?
Ganje ne kahaah sundar baal tatha is ganjepan se mukti, jiske kaaran log mujhse ghin karte hain. Atah, farishte ne uske shareer par haath rakha aur uska ganjaapan door ho gaya tatha use sundar baal mil gae.
Tatpashchaat, farishte ne usse kahaah kaun-sa dhan tumhen sabse priy hai?
Usne kahaah gay athva oont. To use ek gaabhin gay de di gai. Saath hi farishte ne kahaah Allah tumhaari is gay mein barkat de.
Phir andhe ke paas aya aur bolaah tumhen kaun-si wastu sabse pasand hai? Usne kahaah bas yeh ki mujhe meri aankhen waapas mil jayen aur main logon ko dekh sakoon. Isliye farishte ne uske shareer par haath rakha aur use aankhen mil gaeen.
Ab farishte ne kahaah tum kaun-sa maal sabse pasand karte ho?
Usne kahaah bakri. So, use ek gaabhin bakri de di gai.
Phir oontni aur gay ne khoob bachche diye aur bakri ne bhi khoob bachche jane. So, pahle ke paas waadi bhar oont ho gae, doosre ke paas waadi bhar gayen ho gaeen aur teesre ke paas waadi bhar bakriyaan ho gaeen.
Aap farmaate hainh phir woh farishta apni usi shakl wa soorat evn wesh-bhoosha mein safed daag waale ke paas aya aur bolaah main ek nirdhan vyakti hoon. Beech yaatra mein mera yaatra-kharch samaapt ho gaya hai. Aaj main Allah aur uske baad tumhaari sahayta ke bina apne gantavy tak nahin pahunch sakta. Main tumse us Allah ke naam par, jisne tumko sundar rang evn achchhi tvacha pradaan ki, ek oontni maangta hoon, jisse main apni yaatra poori kar sakoon.
Usne uttar diyaah meri apni zimmewaariyaan hi atyadhik hain.
To farishte ne kahaah aisa lagta hai ki main tumhen pahchaanta hoon. Kya tum safed daagh se grasit nahin the, jiske kaaran log tumse ghrina karte the? Aur haan, tum nirdhan bhi to the, phir Allah ne tumko dhani bana diya?
Usne uttar diyaah aisa kuchh nahin hai. Mujhe yeh dhan apne poorvajon se praapt hua hai.
Uska yeh jawaab sunkar farishte ne kahaah yadi teri baat asaty hai to Allah tujhe pratham awastha mein lauta de.
Phir usi shakl wa soorat mein ganje ke paas aya aur usse bhi usi prakaar ki baat kahi, jo safed daag se grasit vyakti se kahi thi. Tatha yahaan bhi wahi uttar mila, jo pahle mila tha.
Atah yahaan bhi kahaah yadi teri baat asaty hai to Allah tujhe pahle jaisa kar de.
Aap farmaate hainh uske baad apni usi awastha mein andhe ke paas aya aur bolaah main ek nirdhan yaatri hoon. Beech yaatra mein mera yaatra-kharch samaapt ho gaya hai. Atah aaj Allah ki sahayta aur uske baad tumhaari madad ke bina main yaatra poori nahin kar sakta. Main tumse us Allah ke naam par, jisne tumhaari aankhen lauta deen theen, ek bakri maangta hoon, jisse main apni yaatra poori kar sakoon.
Usne kahaah main drishtiheen tha. Allah ne mujhe aankhen lauta deen. Tum jitna chaaho le lo aur jitna chaaho chhor do. Allah ki qasam! Aaj tum Allah ke liye jitna bhi lena chaaho, main tumhen use lautaane ka paaband nahin banaaoonga.
Farishte ne kahaah apna dhan rakho. Daraasl, tumhaari pareeksha leni thi. Allah tumse prasann ho gaya aur tumhaare donon saathiyon se aprasann.

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne bani israaeel ke teen vyaktiyon ke baare mein bataya hai, jin mein se har ek kisi na kisi rog se grasit aur nirdhanta ka shikaar tha. Unmen se ek safed daag ki beemaari waala, doosra ganja aur teesra andha tha. Atah, Allah ne unke eemaan aur kritajnata ki pareeksha lene ka nirnay liya aur unke paas insaan ki shakl mein ek farishta bheja.
Is kaaryakram ke tahat, farishta safed daag ki beemaari waale shakhs ke paas aya. Sab se pahle safed daag ki beemaari waale ke paas aane ka kaaran yeh hai ki woh jis rog se grasit tha, woh sabse bara aur sabse bura tha. Phir usse poochha ki tumhaare nikat sabse priy wastu kya hai? Usne kahaah sundar rang aur sundar tvacha, saath hi yeh ki Allah us rog se mukti pradaan kar de, jiske kaaran log mujhse door bhaagte hain. Usne kewal sundar rang maangne par bas nahin kiya, kyonki saphed daag ke kaaran tvacha mein sikuran aur khuradraapan paida ho jaata hai, jisse tvacha dekhne mein aur kharaab lagti hai. Uske baad farishte ne kahaah ab bataao ki tumhaare nikat kaun-sa dhan adhik priy hai? Uttar mein usne oont kaha tha ya gay, warnankarta ko ismen sandeh hai. Lekin lagta yahi hai ki oont kaha hoga, kyonki aage hai ki farishte ne use das maah ki ek gaabhin oontni pradaan ki, jo ki sabse utkrisht oont hota hai. Oontni dene ke baad farishte ne kahaah Allah teri is oontni mein barkat de. Uski yeh dua grahan bhi hui, jaisa ki hadees ke ant mein aya hai.
Aapne farmayaah uske baad farishta ganja ke paas aakar bolaah tumhen kaun-si cheez sabse priy hai? Usne kahaah sundar baal tatha is rog se mukti jiske kaaran log mujhse ghrina karte hain. Aap kahte hain ki farishte ne uske shareer par haath phera. Haath ya to kewal sir par phera tha, jiski sanbhaavna adhik hai ya poore badan mein, taaki poore shareer ko barkat mil jaye. Itna karte hi uska rog door ho gaya aur use sundar baal mil gae. Ab farishte ne kahaah tumhaare nikat kaun-sa dhan adhik priy hai? Usne kahaah gay. Uski ichchha ke anusaar, use ek gaabhin gay de di gai. Phir farishte ne kahaah Allah tumhaari is gay mein barkat de. Uski yeh dua bhi grahan hui, jaisa ki hadees mein aage aata hai.
Aap farmaate hainh uske baad andhe ke paas aakar bolaah tumhaare nikat kaun-si wastu sabse priy hai? Usne kahaah mere nikat sabse priy wastu yeh hai ki Allah meri aankhen lauta de aur main logon ko dekh sakoon. Aap kahte hain ki farishte ne uski aankhon par haath pher diya. Yeh bhi sanbhav hai ki haath poore shareer par phera hoga. Lekin pahli baat ki sanbhaavna adhik hai. Farishte ke haath pherte hi use aankhen waapas mil gaeen. Uske baad kaha ki tumhen kaun-sa dhan adhik priy hai? Usne kahaah bakri. Uski maang ke mutaabiq, use ek bachche waali bakri de di gai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ki bakri gaabhin thi. Ab oont aur gay waalon ne unki dekhbhaal ki aur unke bachche hote gae. Isi tarah bakri waale ne bakri ki dekhbhaal ki aur uske bhi bachche hote gae. Is tarah, ek ki oont se poori ek ghaati bhar gai, doosre ki gay se poori ek ghaati bhar gai aur teesre ki bakri se poori ek ghaati bhar gai.
Aap farmaate hainh kuchh dinon ke baad, dobaara farishta apni usi shakl-soorat aur wesh-bhoosha mein safed daag waale ke paas aya, jo ab bhala-changa ho chuka tha. Abki baar bolaah main ek nirdhan aur mohtaaj vyakti hoon. Yaatra ke dauraan meri rozi-roti ke saadhan samaapt ho chuke hain. Atah, aaj main apne gantavy tak pahunchne ke liye Allah ke sahaare ka aur uske baad tumhaari sahayta ka mohtaaj hoon. Waise, tum ek dhanvaan aur daani lagte ho. Farishte ki yeh baat daraasal 'tauriya' (arthaat kuchh kahna aur aashay kuchh aur muraad lena) thi, jiska uddeshy apni baat samjhaana hota hai, shabdon ke asal arth muraad nahin hote. Aage kahaah main tumse us Allah ke naam par, jisne tumhen nirdhanta aur rog dvara aazmaane ke baad achchha rang, sundar tvacha tatha dhan pradaan kiya, ek oont maangta hoon, jisse main apni yaatra poori kar sakoon. Safed daagh waale ne kahaah mere oopar bahut-si zimmewaariyaan hain. Mere paas aawashyakta se adhik dhan nahin hai ki tumko kuchh de sakoon. Atah kaheen aur dekho. Farishte ne kahaah aisa lagta hai ki main tumhen pahchaanta hoon. Kya aisa nahin hai ki tum saphed daag se grasit the, log tumse ghrina karte the, phir Allah ne tumhen rogmukt kiya aur dhanvaan banaya? Usne kahaah mujhe yeh dhan apne poorvajon se mila hai. Kul milaakar, usne apne bure din ka inkaar kar diya aur yeh daawa kar baitha ki apne poorvaj kaal se hi khushhaal raha hai tatha yeh khushhaali baad mein praapt nahin hui hai. Yeh, neemton ka inkaar aur upkaar karne waale ki naashukri hai, jo usne kanjoosi ke chalte kiya. Uski baat sunkar farishte ne kahaah yadi tera yeh daawa asaty hai, to Allah tujhe waisa hi kar de, jaisa pahle tha.
Aap farmaate hainh phir woh aisi shakl banaakar jisse ghin aati ho aur aisi wesh-bhoosha mein, jo dekhne mein kharaab lagti ho, ganje ke paas aya. Haalaanki woh isi shakl-soorat evn wesh-bhoosha mein pahle bhi a chuka tha aur use rog se mukt karke ek gay bhi de chuka tha, lekin iske baavjood usne pahchaanne se inkaar kar diya aur yeh abhimaan dikhaya ki woh apne poorvaj kaal se hi dhanvaan hai. Is tarah usne jhooth to bola hi, lekin uske saath- saath apni bevqoofi aur badbakhti ka bhi parichay de diya. Ant mein farishte ne usse kahaah agar tum jhoothe ho, to Allah tumhen pahle hi ki tarah ganja aur nirdhan bana de.
Aap farmaate hainh phir woh pharishta andhe ke paas ek andha vyakti aur uski pahle ki wesh-bhoosha mein aya aur bolaah main ek nirdhan yaatri hoon. Yaatra ke dauraan rozi-roti ke saadhan samaapt ho chuke hain. Aaj mere liye apne gantavy tak pahunchna sanbhav nahin hai. Haan, yadi Allah ka sahaara mil jaye aur phir aapki sahayta ho jaye, to aisa sanbhav ho sakta hai. Main tumse us Allah ke naam par, jisne tumhaari aankhen waapas kar deen, ek bakri maangta hoon, jisse apna safar poora kar sakoon. Usne Allah ke upkaaron ko yaad karte hue kahaah main andha tha. Allah ne meri aankhen lauta deen. Atah aap mere dhan mein se jitna chaahen, le len aur jitna chaahen, chhor den. Aaj aap jo kuchh le lenge, use lautaane ka aapko paaband nahin banaaoonga. Uski baat sunkar farishte ne kahaah apna dhan apne paas rakhe raho. Daraasal, yeh tumhaari pareeksha thi. Tumhaare saath Allah ne, jo tamaam baaton ko jaanta hai, ek pareekshak ka bartaav kiya, taaki tumhaare karm par uska prabhaav pare, kyonki Allah ka nirnay hai ki badla insaan ke dikhne waale kaary ke aadhaar par dega, khud apne jnaan ke aadhaar par nahin, jo pahle se uske paas mojood hai. Allah tumse raazi ho gaya aur tumhaare donon saathiyon, safed daag waale aur ganje se naaraaz ho gaya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5927: Sun lo, tum log bhi pahle samudayon ke padchihnon par chal paroge.

Abu waaqid laisi radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab hunain yuddh ke liye nikle, to mushrikon (bahudevvaadiyon) ki or se pooje jaane waale ek per ke paas se guzre, jise 'zaat-e-anvaat' kaha jaata tha. We usmen apne hathiyaar latkaya karte the. Chunaanche logon ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Unki tarah hamaare liye bhi ek 'zaat-e-anvaat' bana deejiye. Unki baat sun Allah ke rasoolsallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Subhaanallah (Allah pawitr hai)! Tum log theek waisa hi kah rahe ho, jaisa moosa ki qaum ne kaha tha. Unhonne moosa (alaihissalaam) se kaha tha : "اجْعَلْ لَنَا إِلَهًا كَمَا لَهُمْ آَلِهَةٌ" (Hamaare liye bhi koi poojy bana deejiye, jaisa ki mushrikon ke bahut-se poojy hain.) [al-aaraaf: 138] sun lo, tum log bhi pahle samudayon ke padchihnon par chal paroge."

Alla ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam tayaf evn makka ke beech mein sthit ek waadi hunain ki or nikle. Aapke saath kuchh sahaaba aise bhi the, jo abhi-abhi musalmaan hue the. Jab woh zaat-e-anvaat ,arthaat; latkaane ka thaan,   naami ek per ke paas se guzre, jiska bahudevvaadi sammaan kiya karte the aur barkat paane ke liye uspar apna hathiyaar aadi latkaya karte the, to Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se kahne lage ki unke liye bhi isi prakaar ka ek per nirdhaarit kar den, jismen woh apne hathiyaar barkat paane ke liye latka saken. Daraasal woh samajhte the ki aisa karna jayaz hai. Chunaanche Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unke is anurodh ke prati apni apriyta vyakt karte hue aur Allah ki mahaanta bayaan karte hue subhaanallah kaha aur farmaya ki unki yeh baat moosa Allah ki jaati ke is kathan ke jaisi hai : {hamaare liye bhi ek poojy bana deejiye, jis tarah un (bahudevvaadiyon) ke poojy hain}. Jab unhonne kuchh logon ko buton ki pooja karte hue dekha tha, to is baat ka mutaalba kiya tha ki mushrikon ki tarah unke bhi kuchh but hon. Aapne bataya ki aapke sahaaba ka yeh mutaalba bhi daraasal unka anusran hai. Phir aapne bataya ki yeh ummat bhi yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon ke padchihnon par chalegi aur unke jaise kaam karegi. Aapka uddeshy is prakaar ke kaamon se saavdhaan karna tha.

Insaan kabhi-kabhi kisi kaam ko Allah ke nikat karne waala kaam maankar achchha samajhta hai, lekin woh waastav mein Allah se door karne waala kaam hota hai.
Insaan jab kisi ko deen ke baare mein koi anuchit baat karte hue sune ya kisi baat par aashchary kare, to subhaanallah ya Allahu akbar kahe.
Peron evn pattharon aadi se barkat lena bhi shirk ke dayre mein aata hai. Barkat kewal Allah se maangi jayegi.
Buton ki pooja ka kaaran unka sammaan karna, unke paas baithna aur unse barkat lena hai.
Shirk ke darvaazon evn raaston ko band karne ki zaroorat.
Yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon ki bhartsana mein aane waale sharai uddharan hamen sachet karne ka kaam karte hain.
Jaahileeyat (ajnaanta) kaal ke logon tatha yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon ki samaanta apnaane ki manaahi.Haan agar kisi cheez ke baare mein pramaanit ho jaye ki woh hamaare deen ka bhi ang hai, to baat aur hai.
[ise tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5928: Ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya, kisi wishay mein aapse baat ki aur isi dauraan kaha : Wahi hoga jo Allah chaahega aur aap chaahenge. Uski yeh baat sun aapne kaha : "Kya tumne mujhe Allah ke samaan bana diya? Kaho ki jo kewal Allah chaahega, wahi hoga.

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki : Ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya, kisi wishay mein aapse baat ki aur isi dauraan kaha : Wahi hoga jo Allah chaahega aur aap chaahenge. Uski yeh baat sun aapne kaha : "Kya tumne mujhe Allah ke samaan bana diya? Kaho ki jo kewal Allah chaahega, wahi hoga."

Ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya, aapse kisi wishay mein baatcheet ki aur uske baad kaha : "Hoga wahi, jo Allah chaahe aur aap chaahen." Tab Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne uski is baat ka khandan kiya aur bataya ki bande ki ichchha ko Allah ki ichchha se "واو" (Aur) shabd dvaara jorna chhota shirk hai. Kisi musalmaan ke liye is prakaar ka waaky bolna jayaz nahin hai. Iske baad unko bata diya ki kahna kya chahiye. Kahna chahiye : "Hoga wahi, jo kewal Allah chaahe." Baat kewal Allah ki ichchha ki honi chahiye. Uske saath kisi ki ichchh ko kisi harf-e-atf dvaara jorna sahi nahin hai.

"Hoga wahi, jo Allah chaahe tatha aap chaahen" Evn is prakaar ka koi doosra waaky bolna mana hai, jismen bande ki ichchha ko Allah ki ichchha se "واو" (Aur) shabd dvaara jora gaya ho. Kyonki yeh chhota shirk hai.
Ghalat kaam ka khandan zaroori hai.
Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne tauheed ki suraksha aur shirk ke raaston ko band karne ki poori vyawastha ki hai.
Ghalat kaam ka khandan karte samay behtar hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke padchihnon par chalte hue kisi waidh wikalp ka sujhaav de diya jaye.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is hadees mein "Hoga wahi, jo bas Allah chaahe" Kahne ka nirdesh diya hai. Jabki doosri hadees mein farmaya hai : "Tum kaho : Jo Allah chaahe, phir aap chaahen." Donon hadeeson ke beech saamanjasy is tarah bithaya jayega ki "Jo Allah chaahe, phir aap chaahen" Kahna jayaz hai aur  "Hoga wahi, jo bas Allah chaahe" Kahna uttam hai.
"Hoga wahi, jo Allah chaahe, phir aap chaahen" Kahna jayaz to hai, lekin behtar yeh hai ki "Hoga wahi, jo bas Allah chaahe" Kaha jaye.
[ise nasai ne al-kubra mein tatha ibn-e-maajah ne evn ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5930: Allah ke nikat sabse ghatiya aur tuchchh vyakti woh hai, jo shahanshaah kahalvaye. Waastawik baadshaah to bas Allah hai.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah Allah ke nikat sabse ghatiya aur tuchchh vyakti woh hai, jo shahanshaah kahalvaye.Waastawik baadshaah to bas Allah hai.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih qayaamat ke din Allah ke krodh ka sabse adhik paatr aur sabse neech woh vyakti hoga, jo duniya mein shahanshaah kahalvaata tha. Waastawik baadsha bas Allah hi hai.
Sufyaan sauri ne "ملك الأملاك" Ka arth "Shahanshaah" Bataya hai aur ahmad bin hanbal kahte hain ki mainne abu amr se "أَخْنَع" Ka arth poochha to unhonne bataya ki sabse ghatiya.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is hadees mein bataya hai ki Allah ke nikat sabse tuchchh aur ghatiya vyakti woh hai, jo apna aisa naam rakhe ki usse aisi mahaanta evn shreshthata jhalakti ho, jo Allah ke siwa kisi ke liye uchit nahin hai, jaise shahanshaah ka shabd hai, ismen ek tarah se Allah ki baraabri aur hamasri (samaanta) ka daawa hai. Isliye is naam ka insaan Allah ke nikat sabse apriy aur ghatiya hai. Hadees ke is tukre ka ek arth yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki woh allalaah ke nikat sabse naapsandeeda logon mein se ek hai.
Phir aapne yeh spasht kar diya ki is dharti aur uske saare raajaaon evn prajaaon ka waastawik svaami Allah hai. Is hadees mein un logon ke liye bhi shiksha evn naseehat hai, jo logon ko upaadhiyaan, unka arth jaane bina hi baantte rahte hain, ki kaheen we bhi us cheez mein na par jayen, jisse is hadees mein saavdhaan kiya gaya hai. Allah ham sab ko isse bachaye.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5931: Qayaamat ke din sabse adhik kathor yaatna un logon ko hogi, jo Allah ki srishti ki samaanta prakat karte hain.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam mere yahaan aye, to dekha ki mainne apne ek taak par ek kapra daal rakha tha, jispar tasveeren theen, uspar nazar parte hi use kheenchkar hata daala aur aapke chehre ka rang badal gaya tatha farmaya : "Ai aaisha! Qayaamat ke din sabse adhik kathor yaatna un logon ko hogi, jo Allah ki srishti ki samaanta prakat karte hain." Aaisha radiyallahu anha kahti hain : Atah hamne use phaarkar usse ek ya do takiye bana liye.

Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne anpi patni aaisha razyallahu anha ke ghar mein prawesh kiya, to dekha ki unhonne apne ek taak par ek kapra daal rakha hai, jispar praan waali cheezon ki tasveeren hain. Use dekhkar ghusse se aapke chehre ka rang badal gaya, aapne use kheenchkar hata diya aur farmaya : Qayaamat ke din sabse kathor yaatna ka saamna un logon ko karna parega, jo apni tasveeron dvaara Allah ki srishti ki samaanta prakat karte hain. Aaisha radiyallahu anha kahti hain : Chunaanche hamne usse ek ya do takiye bana liye.

Ghalat kaam dekhte hi der kiye bina uska khandan karna chahiye, jab isse tulnaatmak roop se bari buraai saamne na aye.
Qayaamat ke din gunaah ke bare ya chhote hone ke anusaar yaatna mein bhinnata hogi.
Praan waali cheezon ki tasveer banaana ya rakhna bara gunaah hai.
Tasveer banaane ko awaidh thahraane mein nihit ek hikmat yeh hai ki yeh amal rachna mein khud ko Allah ke sadrishy  banaane jaisa hai. Chaahe yeh baat tasveer banaane waale ke dil mein ho ya na ho.
Shareeyat ki koshish hai ki dhan ke awaidh prayog se bachte hue usse fayda uthaya jaye, aur is tarah uski suraksha ki jaye.
Jaandaar cheejon ki tasveer banaana, bhale hi we tuchchh hon, mana hai, chaahe chitrakaari kisi bhi prakaar se ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5932: Jo kisi sthaan mein utarte samay kahe : 'Main Allah ki paida ki hui cheezon ki buraai se uske sanpoorn shabdon ke dvaara (uski) sharan maangta hoon', use koi cheez woh sthaan chhorne tak nuqsaan nahin pahuncha sakti.

Khaula bint hakeem sulmiya radiyallahu anha se warnit hai, unhonne kaha : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Jo kisi sthaan mein utarte samay kahe : 'Main Allah ki paida ki hui cheezon ki buraai se uske sanpoorn shabdon ke dvaara (uski) sharan maangta hoon', use koi cheez woh sthaan chhorne tak nuqsaan nahin pahuncha sakti."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apni ummat ko yaatra ya sair wa tafreeh ke dauraan kisi sthaan mein utarte samay, Allah ki sharan lene ka nirdesh de rahe hain, jisse insaan har us buraai se surakshit rah sakta hai, jiska use dar ho. Aapne bataya ki banda jab kisi sthaan mein utarte samay har buraai waali srishti ki buraai se Allah ke aise shabdon ke dvaara sharan le leta hai, jo fazeelat, barkat tatha laabh ke drishtikon se sanpoorn hain aur har aib tatha kami se paak hain, to wahaan jab tak ruka rahta hai, tab tak har kashtadayak wastu se surakshit rahta hai.

Sharan lena bhi ibaadat hai. Yaani Allah ya uske naamon ki sharan lena ya uske gunon dvaara uski sharan lena.
Allah ki waani ke dvaara sharan lena jayaz hai. Kyonki yeh Allah ke gunon mein se ek gun hai. Jabki kisi srishti ki sharan lena na siraf yeh ki jayaz nahin hai, balki shirk hai.
Is dua ki fazeelat tatha barkat.
Apni suraksha ke liye azkaar parhne se Allah bande ko buraaiyon se surakshit rakhta hai.
Allah ko chhor kar kisi aur ki, maslan jinnon, jaadoogron aur kartab dikhaane waalon ki sharan lene ka khandan.
Yaatra ke dauraan ya bina yaatra ke kaheen utarte samay is dua ko parhna chahiye.
5933: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab kisi vyakti ko kisi sena athva uski chhoti tukri ka netritv pradaan karte to use Allah ke bhay tatha musalmaan saathiyon ke saath achchha vyavhaar karne ka aadesh dete the.

Buraida bin husaib asalmi (radiyallahu anhu) warnan karte hue kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab kisi vyakti ko kisi sena athva uski chhoti tukri ka netritv pradaan karte to use Allah ke bhay tatha musalmaan saathiyon ke saath achchha vyavhaar karne ka aadesh dete hue kahteh Allah ka naam lekar uski raah mein yuddh karna. Allah ka inkaar karne waalon se yuddh karna. Dekho, yuddh karna, parantu ghaneemat ke dhan ko na chhipaana, dhokha na dena, yuddh mein mare hue vyakti ke shareer ke ang na kaatna aur kisi bachche ko na maarna. Jab tumhaara saamna mushrik shatruon se ho to unhen teen baaton ki or bulaana. Unmen se koi bhi maan len to use unki or se sveekaar kar lena aur unse yuddh karne se baaz a jaana. Sabse pahle unhen Islam ki or bulaana. Yadi we maan len to unka raasta chhor dena.
Saath hi unhen apna kshetr chhorkar islaami kshetr ki or hijrat karne ka aadesh dena. Unhen bataana ki yadi we aisa karenge to unhen wo saare adhikaar praapt honge, jo any muhaajiron ko praapt hain, tatha unhen un zimmewaariyon ka paalan karna hoga, jinka paalan muhaajiron ko karna hota hai. Agar we hijrat karne se inkaar kar den to bataana ki we dehaat mein rahne waale musalmaanon ke samaan honge. Unpar Allah taaala ke aadesh laagu honge, parantu ghaneemat aur fay ke dhan mein unka bhaag nahin hoga. Haan, yadi we musalmaanon ke saath yuddh mein bhaag len to baat alag hai. Agar we Islam grahan karne se mana kar den to unse jizya maangna. Maan len to theek hai. Haath utha lena. Parantu yadi na maanen to Allah se madad maangna aur unse yuddh karna.
Aur jab kisi durg mein chhipe logon ki gheraabandi kar lo aur woh tumse Allah tatha uske Rasool ki suraksha maangen to unhen Allah evn uske Rasool ki suraksha na dena, balki apni tatha apne saathiyon ki suraksha dena, kyonki tumhen apni tatha apne saathiyon ki or se di gai suraksha bhang karni pare to yeh is baat se saral hai ki Allah tatha uske Rasool ki or se di gai suraksha bhang karni pare. Isi tarah jab kisi durg mein chhipe logon ki gheraabandi kar lo aur we chaahen ki tum unhen Allah ke aadesh par utaaro to aisa na karna. Unhen apne aadesh par utaarna, kyonki tumhen kya pata ki tum unke baare mein Allah ke uchit aadesh tak pahunch pa rahe ho ki nahin?

Buraida -radiyallahu anhu- bataate hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab kaafiron se yuddh ke liye kisi sena athva sainy dal ki tukri ko bhejte, to ek vyakti ko unka ameer banaate, jo unki dekh-rekh ke saath-saath unki ekta ko banaye rakhe. Phir use Allah ka bhay rakhne tatha apne saathiyon ke saath achchha vyavhaar karne ki taakeed karte aur bataate ki shatruon ke saath kaisa vyavhaar hona chahiye. Unhen ghaneemat ke dhan ko chhipaane, dhokha dene aur mare hue vyakti ke shareer ke angon ko kaatne evn 'ghairmukallaf' -jin par dhaarmik widhaan evn aadesh laagu na hon,- ko maarne se mana karte tatha bataate ki logon ko sabse pahle Islam ki or bulayen. Yadi we maan len, to unhen hijrat karke madeena a jaane ko kahen aur batayen ki unhen woh saare adhikaar praapt honge, jo pahle hijrat karke aane waale musalmaanon ko praapt hain aur unhen un zimmewaariyon ka nirvaah karna parega, jo unhen karne parte hain. Yadi hijrat karne se mana kar den, to unke saath dehaaton mein basne waale muslaanon ka sa bartaav kiya jayega. Parantu yadi we Islam grahan karne se mana kar den, to unse jaziya kar maangen. Yadi woh jaziya dene par taiyaar na hon, to Allah se sahayta maangen aur unse yuddh karen. Tatha jab kisi durg ki gheraabandi kar len, to usmen maujood logon ko Allah aur uske Rasool ka wachan dene ke bajay apna wachan den, kyonki apna wachan torne mein Allah tatha uske Rasool ka wachan torne ki tulna mein kam gunaah hai. Tatha yadi we apne baare mein Allah ka nirnay karne ko kahen, to koi nirnay karke use Allah ka nirnay na batayen, kyonki is baat ki bhi sanbhaavna hai ki we unke baare mein Allah ke nirnay tak na pahunch saken. Atah unse apne nirnay aur ijtihaad ke anusaar bartaav karen.
5934: Kya main tumhen us muhim par na bhejoon, jispar Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne mujhe bheja tha? Aapne mujhe aadesh diya tha ki tumhen jo bhi chitr mile, use mita daalo aur jo bhi oonchi qabr mile, use baraabar kar do.

Abul hayyaaj asdi kahte hain ki mujhse ali bin abu taalib radiyallahu anhu ne farmaya : Kya main tumhen us muhim par na bhejoon, jispar Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne mujhe bheja tha? Aapne mujhe aadesh diya tha ki tumhen jo bhi chitr mile, use mita daalo aur jo bhi oonchi qabr mile, use baraabar kar do.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apne saathiyon ko yeh kahkar bhejte the ki tumhen jo bhi pratima mile, use nasht kar do ya mita do. Hadees mein "تمثالًا" Shabd aya hai, jiske mayne praan waali wastu ka chitr hai, chaahe woh aakaar waala ho ya bina aakaar waala.

Isi tarah jo bhi oonchi qabr mile, use zameen ke baraabar kar do aur uspar bane hue bhawan aadi ko gira do ya phir use is tarah zameen ke baraabar kar do ki zyaada uthi hui na ho. Lagbhag ek bitta oonchi ho. Usse zyaada nahin.

Praan waali cheezon ka chitr aankna haraam hai. Kyonki yeh shirk ki or le jaane waali cheez hai.
Islaami shaasak ya saamarthy rakhne waala ghalat cheez ko haath se hata sakta hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam poori tatparta ke saath jaahiliyat kaal ki har nishaani, jaise chitr, pratima aur qabr par bane hue bhavnon aadi ko hata diya karte the.
5935: In bezubaan chaupayon ke sanbandh mein Allah se daro. Unki sawaari karo, jab we svasth hon aur unhen khaao, jab we svasth hon.

Sahl bin amr (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ek aise oont ke paas se gazre, jiska pet (bhookh ke kaaran) peeth se laga hua tha to aapne farmayaah in bezubaan chaupayon ke sanbandh mein Allah se daro. Unki sawaari karo, jab we svasth hon aur unhen khaao, jab we svasth hon.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5936: Qasam saamaan ko maarket mein chalaane ka maadhyam to hai, lekin kamaai ki barkat khatm kar deti hai.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : "Qasam saamaan ko maarket mein chalaane ka maadhyam to hai, lekin kamaai ki barkat khatm kar deti hai."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne khareedte bechte samay qasam khaane aur qasam ka bahut zyaada prayog karne se mana farmaya hai. Qasam chaahe sachchi hi kyon na ho. Aapne bataya ki isse saamaan to bik jaata hai, lekin kray-wikray evn kamaai ki barkat  kam aur khatm ho jaati hai. Allah uske nasht ho jaane ki raahen khol deta hai, chori dvaara, ya jalne, ya doobne, ya harapne, ya lootpaat dvaara, ya any doosri ghatnaaon dvaara jinse uski sanpatti nasht ho jaati hai.

Allah ki qasam khaana bahut bari baat hai. Bina zaroorat iska istemaal nahin hona chahiye.
Haraam ki kamaai chaahe jitni zyaada nazar aye, usmen barkat aur bhalaai nahin hoti.
Qaari kahte hain : Kamaai ki barkat khatm ho jaane ka matlab ya to dhan ke kisi bhaag ka nasht ho jaana hai ya phir use aise kaamon mein kharch karna hai, jinka na duniya mein koi laabh ho aur na aakhirat mein sawaab. Aisa bhi ho sakta hai ki dhan to baaqi rahe, lekin insaan uske laabh se wanchit ho jaye ya phir dhan ka waaris aisa vyakti ban jaye, jo use pasand na ho.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees mein khareed-bikri ke samay atyadhik qasam khaane se mana kiya gaya hai. Anaawashyak qasam khaana makrooh hai. Ismen saamaan ka prachaar bhi shaamil hai. Kyonki, kabhi-kabhi khareedne waala qasam se dhokha kha jaata hai.
Bahut zyaada qasam khaana eemaan ki kami aur ekeshvarvaad mein dosh ka sanket hai. Kyonki bahut zyaada qasam khaane se do cheezen hoti hain : 1- insaan qasam khaane ko ek maamooli kaam samajhne lagta hai. 2- woh jhooth bolne lagta hai. Daraasal, jo vyakti bahut zyaada qasam khaata hai, woh jhooth bolne mein zaroor shaamil hota hai. Isliye, insaan ko bahut kam qasam khaani chahiye. Yahi kaaran hai ki Allah taaala ne farmaya hai : {وَاحْفَظُوا أَيْمَانَكُمْ} [soora al-maaida : 89] (apni kasmon ki hifaazat karo.)
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5937: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab kisi yaatra par nikalte to yaatra ki kathinaai, apriy waapsi, banaav ke baad bigaar, mazloom ki baddua aur pariwaar tatha dhan-maal mein buri drishti se Allah ki sharan maangte the.

Abdullah bin sarjis (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab kisi yaatra par nikalte to yaatra ki kathinaai, apriy waapsi, banaav ke baad bigaar, mazloom ki baddua aur pariwaar tatha dhan-maal mein buri drishti se Allah ki sharan maangte the.
5938: Ek (akela) sawaar shaitaan hai, do sawaar shaitaan hain aur teen sawaar qaafila hain.

Abdullah bin amr bin aas (radiyallahu anhuma) Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se warnan karte hain ki aapne farmayaah ek (akela) sawaar shaitaan hai, do sawaar shaitaan hain aur teen sawaar qaafila hain.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise maalik ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5940: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) fajr ki antim rakaat mein, ruku se sir uthaane aur 'سَمِعَ الله لمن حَمِدَه رَبَّنا ولك الحَمْدُ' kahne ke baad kahteh ai Allah, amuk, amuk aur amuk par laanat kar. Isi par Allah taaala ne yeh ayat utaareeh (لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ الأَمْرِ شَيْءٌ) (ai Rasool! Aapka ismen kuchh bas nahin).

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki unhonne Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko fajr ki antim rakaat mein, ruku se sir uthaane aur 'سَمِعَ الله لمن حَمِدَه رَبَّنا ولك الحَمْدُ' kahne ke baad kahte hue sunaah ai Allah! Amuk, amuk aur amuk par laanat kar. Isi par Allah taaala ne yeh ayat utaareeh (لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ الأَمْرِ شَيْءٌ) (ai Rasool! Aapka ismen kuchh bas nahin).
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih aap safvaan bin umayya, suhail bin amr aur haaris bin hishaam par baddua kar rahe the. Phir yeh ayat utreeh (لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ الأَمْرِ شَيْءٌ) (ai Rasool! Aapka ismen kuchh bas nahin).

Is hadees mein abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) bata rahe hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab fajr ki antim rakaat mein ruku se sir uthaate, to "سمِع اللهُ لمن حَمِده" Kahne ke baad kuchh mushrik sardaaron ke wiruddh dua-e- qunoot parhte, jinhonne uhud yuddh ke din aapko kasht pahunchaya tha. Kabhi-kabhi unka naam lekar bhi laanat karte the. Aise mein Allah ne isse rokne ke liye yeh ayat utaareeh "ليس لك من الأمر شيء" Iska kaaran yeh hai ki Allah ko pata tha ki we ek din eemaan le ayenge aur achchhe musalmaan ban jayenge.
5941: Ai Allah! Meri ummat ke liye uske subh ke samay mein barkat pradaan kar.

Sakhr bin wadaaa ghaamidi (radiyallahu anhu) Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hain ki aapne farmayaah ai Allah! Meri ummat ke liye uske subh ke samay mein barkat pradaan kar. Tatha aap jab koi chhota ya bara sainy-dal bhejte to din ke pratham bhaag mein bhejte. Khud sakhr (radiyallahu anhu) ek vyavsayi the aur vyapaar ka dhan din ke pratham bhaag mein bhejte the. Iska laabh yeh hua ki woh maaldaar ho gae aur unke paas bahut-sa dhan a gaya.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5942: Kya tum jaante ho ki jhooth tatha mithyaaropan kya hai? Yeh logon ke beech lagaai-bujhaai ki baaten karte phirna hai.

Abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah kya tum jaante ho ki jhooth tatha mithyaaropan kya hai? Yeh logon ke beech lagaai-bujhaai ki baaten karte phirna hai.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apni ummat ko logon ke beech chugli karte phirne aur bigaar paida karne ke liye ek ki baat doosre tak pahunchaane se saavdhaan karna chaahte the. Atah, apni baat ko prashn se shuru kiya, taaki dil mein achchhi tarah baith jaye aur log adhik dhyaanpoorvak sunen. Yahi kaaran hai ki sahaaba se poochha ki «العَضْهُ» arthaat jhooth aur doshaaropan kya hai? Waise, kuchh logon ne uska arth jaadu bhi bataya hai.
Phir prashn ka uttar khud hi dete hue kaha ki «العَضْهُ» se abhipray hai logon ke beech lagaai-bujhaai karna, kyonki anubhav yeh kahta hai ki isse bigaar, logon ko haani pahunchaane, prem rakhne waalon ke dilon ko baantne, rishtedaaron ke beech doori paida karne tatha dilon ko maila karne ka wahi kaam hota hai, jo jaadu se hota hai.
5948: Tumhaara in ghaatiyon aur waadiyon mein alag-alag phail jaana shaitaan ki or se hai.

Abu saalba khushni (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki log jab yaatra ke dauraan kisi sthaan par utarte to pahaar ki ghaatiyon aur waadiyon mein phail jaate the. Atah, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah tumhaara in ghaatiyon aur waadiyon mein alag-alag phail jaana shaitaan ki or se hai. Iske baad sahaaba jahaan bhi utarte, ek-doosre ke saath milkar rahte.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5949: Deenaar ke bande ka winaash ho. Dirham ke bande ka sarvanaash ho. Reshmi kapre ke bande ka winaash ho. Ruendaar kapre ke bande ka winaash ho. Agar diya gaya to prasann aur na diya gaya to aprasann. Woh halaak ho aur naakaam ho. Agar kisi pareshaani mein pare to koi use sahaara dene waala na ho.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah deenaar ke bande ka winaash ho. Dirham ke bande ka winaash ho. Reshmi kapre ke bande ka winaash ho. Ruendaar kapre ke bande ka winaash ho. Agar diya gaya to prasann aur na diya gaya to aprasann. Woh halaak ho aur naakaam ho. Agar kisi pareshaani mein pare to koi use sahaara dene waala na ho. Tatha aise bande ke liye khushkhabri hai, jo Allah ki raah mein apne ghore ki lagaam pakre hua ho. Uske sir ke baal bikhre, paanv dhool se ate hon. Yadi use pahredaari par laga diya jaye to pahredaari karta rahe aur yadi sena ke peechhe rakha jaye to peechhe hi rahe. Yadi kisi ke yahaan prawesh karne ki anumti maange to anumti na mile aur yadi kisi ki sifaarish kare to uski sifaarish grahan na ki jaye.

Is hadees mein Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki kuchh log aise hote hain, jinki daur-bhaag ka kendr bindu, jnaan ka shikhar tatha pratham evn antim lakshy, duniya hai. Tatha yeh ki jiski haalat yeh ho, uska anjaam winaash aur asphalta ke siwa kuchh nahin hai. Is prakaar ke logon ki nishaani yeh hai ki we duniya ke atyant lobhi hote hain. Yadi mil gai, to theek. Na mili, to pareshaan.
Jabki kuchh logon ki nazar Allah ki prasannata ki praapti evn aakhirat par rahti hai. We pad evn khyaati ke peechhe nahin bhaagte. Unka ekmaatr uddeshy Allah evn uske Rasool ka anusran karna hota hai. Is prakaar ke logon ki pahchaan yeh hai ki we dikhaawe par dhyaan nahin dete, jo jagah mil jaye usse prasann rahte hain, logon ke nikat mahatvaheen hote hain tatha pad-pratishtha waalon se door rahte hain. Yadi we unke paas jaane ki anumti maangen, to na mile aur yadi unke yahaan sifaarish karen, to unki sifaarish grahan na ho. Lekin unka thikaana Jannat hai, jo prashansneey pratikaar hai.
[ise bukhaari ne inheen jaise shabdon ke saath riwayat kiya hai .]
5953: Tummen se koi us samay tak momin nahin ho sakta, jab tak main uske nikat, uske pita, uski santaan aur tamaam logon se adhik pyaara na ho jaaoon.

Anas radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Tummen se koi us samay tak momin nahin ho sakta, jab tak main uske nikat, uske pita, uski santaan aur tamaam logon se adhik pyaara na ho jaaoon."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki koi musalmaan sanpoorn eemaan waala usi samay ho sakta hai, jab woh Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke prem ko apni maata, pita, beta, beti aur any sabhi logon ke prem se aage rakhe. Yeh prem bande se chaahta hai ki woh uske aadeshon ka paalan kare, uske paksh mein khara ho aur uski awajna se door rahe.

Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se prem ka aniwaary hona aur use saari srishti ke prem se aage rakhna.
