Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se sanpoorn prem ki ek nishaani yeh hai ki aadmi aapki sunnat ke paksh mein khara ho aur iske liye jaan evn maal kharch kare.
Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se prem ka taqaaza yeh hai ki aapke aadeshon ka paalan kiya jaye, aapki bataai hui baaton ki pushti ki jaye, aapki mana ki hui cheezon se door raha jaye, aapka anusran kiya jaye aur bidaaton se apne aapko bachaakar rakha jaye.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka adhikaar sabhi logon ke adhikaaron se bara hai. Kyonki aap hi Islam ke maarg ki praapti, Jahannam se mukti aur Jannat mein prawesh ka maadhyam hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5954: Agar tum uhud parvat ke baraabar bhi sona kharch kar do to Allah use grahan nahin karega, jab tak taqdeer par eemaan na rakho aur is baat par wishvaas na rakho ki jo cheez tumhen milne waali hai, woh tumhaare haath se nikal nahin sakti aur jo tumhen nahin milne waali, woh tumhaare haath lag nahin sakti. Agar tum iske siwa kisi aur aastha par maroge to Jahannam mein prawesh karne waalon mein shaamil ho jaaoge.

Ibne dailmi kahte hainh main ubai bin kaab ke paas aakar bola ki mere dil mein taqdeer ke baare mein thori-si khatak hai. Mujhe koi hadees sunaaiye ki Allah is khatak ko mere dil se nikaal de. Unhonne kahaah agar tum uhud parvat ke baraabar bhi sona kharch kar do to Allah use grahan nahin karega, jab tak taqdeer par eemaan na rakho aur is baat par wishvaas na rakho ki jo cheez tumhen milne waali hai, woh tumhaare haath se nikal nahin sakti aur jo tumhen milne waali nahin hai, woh tumhaare haath lag nahin sakti. Agar tum iske siwa kisi aur aastha par maroge to Jahannam mein prawesh karne waalon mein shaamil ho jaaoge.
Woh kahte hainh main iske baad abdullah bin masaood, huzaifa bin yamaan aur zaid bin saabit ke paas gaya to har ek ne mujhe Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke hawaale se is tarah ki hadees sunaai.

Abdullah bin phairoz dailmi -unpar Allah ki kripa ho- kahte hain ki unke dil mein taqdeer ke sanbandh mein kuchh aashankayen paida hueen, to unhen bhay hua ki kaheen maamla iske inkaar tak na pahunch jaye, atah Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke jnaani sahaaba -radiyallahu anhum- ke paas jaakar is sandeh ke niwaaran ke baare mein poochha. Waise, eemaan waalon ka yahi tareeka hona chahiye ki jahaan koi sandeh paida ho, jaankaar logon se sanpark karen. Yahi Allah ka aadesh bhi haih "فاسألوا أهل الذكر إن كنتم لا تعلمون" (Agar tum nahin jaante, to jaanne waalon se poochh liya karo) tab un sabhi sahaaba ne unhen bataya ki Allah ke nirnay tatha taqdeer par eemaan laana awashyanbhaawi hai. Taqdeer par eemaan na rakhne waala bari se bari wastu bhi kharch kar de, to grahan nahin ki jayegi tatha taqdeer par eemaan rakhe bina marne waala jahannami hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5956: Sabse achchhe saathi chaar hain, sabse achchha sainy-dal chaar sau ka hai aur sabse achchhi sena chaar hazaar ki hai aur baarah hazaar ki sena kam sankhya ke kaaran paraajit nahin ho sakti.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah sabse achchhe saathi chaar hain, sabse achchha sainy-dal chaar sau ka hai aur sabse achchhi sena chaar hazaar ki hai aur baarah hazaar ki sena kam sankhya ke kaaran paraajit nahin ho sakti.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5961: Jab tum hariyaali ke dinon mein yaatra karo to oont ko dharti mein charne ka uska haq pradaan karo aur jab sukhaar ke dinon mein yaatra karo to uspar sawaar hokar tez-tez chalo tatha uski shakti khatm hone se pahle manzil tak pahunch jaao.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jab tum hariyaali ke dinon mein yaatra karo to oont ko dharti mein charne ka uska haq pradaan karo aur jab sukhaar ke dinon mein yaatra karo to uspar sawaar hokar tez-tez chalo tatha uski shakti khatm hone se pahle manzil tak pahunch jaao. Tatha jab raat ke samay kaheen thaharna ho to raaste se hatkar thahro, kyonki yeh raat mein chaupayon ka raasta aur keere-makoron ka thikaana hota hai.
5966: Tum raat ko safar kiya karo, kyonki raat ke samay zameen lapet di jaati hai.
Anas (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah tum raat ko safar kiya karo, kyonki raat ke samay zameen lapet di jaati hai.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5968: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab yaatra mein hote aur raat ko thaharte to dayen karvat par lette aur jab subh se kuchh pahle thaharte to apna daahina baazu khara kar lete aur apna sar apni hatheli par rakh lete.

Abu qataada ansaari (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab yaatra mein hote aur raat ko thaharte to dayen karvat par lette aur jab subh se kuchh pahle thaharte to apna daahina baazu khara kar lete aur apna sar apni hatheli par rakh lete.
5970: Jab teen vyakti kisi yaatra mein niklen to apne mein kisi ko sardaar bana len.

Abu saeed aur abu huraira (radiyallahu anhuma) Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallamal) se warnan karte hain ki aapne farmayaah jab teen vyakti kisi yaatra mein niklen to apne mein se kisi ko sardaar bana len.

Is hadees mein Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne yaatra karne waale logon aadesh diya hai ki apne mein se kisi vyakti ko apna ameer bana len, jo unmen sabse uttam aur sabse achchhe wichaar ka maalik ho, taaki woh unke maamlon ko hal kar sake, kyonki ameer na hone ki sthiti mein bikhraav paida ho sakta hai.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5971: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) yaatra mein sabse peechhe chalte tatha kamzor ko haankte, use apne peechhe sawaar kar lete aur uske liye dua karte.

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) yaatra mein sabse peechhe chalte tatha kamzor ko haankte, use apne peechhe sawaar kar lete aur uske liye dua karte.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5976: Wayu ko gaali mat do. Yadi koi aisi baat dekho, jo pasand na ho to kaho : Ai Allah! Ham tujhse maangte hain is wayu ki bhalaai, ismen jo kuchh hai uski bhalaai aur ise jiska aadesh diya gaya hai uski bhalaai. Tatha ai Allah! Ham tujhse sharan maangte hain is wayu ki buraai se, ismen jo kuchh hai uski buraai se aur ise jiska aadesh diya gaya hai uski buraai se.

Ubai bin kaab -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Wayu ko gaali mat do. Yadi koi aisi baat dekho, jo pasand na ho to kaho : Ai Allah! Ham tujhse maangte hain is wayu ki bhalaai, ismen jo kuchh hai uski bhalaai aur ise jiska aadesh diya gaya hai uski bhalaai. Tatha ai Allah! Ham tujhse sharan maangte hain is wayu ki buraai se, ismen jo kuchh hai uski buraai se aur ise jiska aadesh diya gaya hai uski buraai se."

Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne hamen hawa ko gaali dene ya uspar laanat karne se mana kiya hai. Kyonki hawa apne rachyita ke aadesh se chalti hai. Kabhi rahmat bankar aati hai to kabhi saza bankar. Ise gaali dena daraasal iske rachyita ko gaali dena aur uske faisle par gussa zaahir karna hai. Iske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne hawa ke rachyita yaani pawitr evn mahaan Allah se lau lagaate hue hawa ki bhalaai, hawa ke andar maujood cheezon ki bhalaai aur hawa ke saath aane waali cheezon ki bhalaai, jaise baarish tatha achchhi fasal aadi maangne aur Allah se uski buraai, uske andar maujood cheezon ki buraai aur uske saath aane waali cheezon ki buraai jaise phaslon evn peron ke nuqsaan, maweshiyon ke winaash evn gharon ke dhah jaane aadi se sharan maangne ka nirdesh diya hai. Daraasal Allah se yeh cheezen maangna bhi uski bandgi hi ka ek bhaag hai.

Hawa ko bura kahne ki manaahi. Kyonki hawa Allah ke aadesh se chalne waali ek srishti hai. Atah use gaali dena daraasal use paida karne aur chalaane waale ko gaali dena hai, jo ekeshvarvaad mein kami ko darshaata hai.
Allah ki or lautna aur uski srishti ki buraai se uski sharan maangna.
Hawa Allah ke aadesh se kabhi achchha laati hai aur kabhi bura.
Ibn-e-baaz kahte hain : Hawa ko gaali dena gunaah ka kaam hai. Kyonki hawa ek srishti hai, jo Allah ke aadesh se achchhe evn bure ke saath aati hai. Atah use gaali dena jayaz nahin hai. Hawa par Allah ki laanat ho, Allah hawa ka satyaanaash kare ya Allah hawa mein barkat na de aadi kahna sahi nahin hai. Ek momin ko Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka  paalan karna chahiye.
Hawa par qayaas karte hue sardi, garmi, dhoop aur dhool aadi Allah ki any srishtiyon ko bhi gaali dena jayaz nahin hai, jo Allah ke aadesh ke adheen hain.
5978: Tummen se koi vyakti yeh na kahe : Ai Allah! Yadi tu chaahe to mujhe kshama pradaan kar, ai Allah! Yadi tu chaahe to mujhpar daya kar. Use chahiye ki yaqeen ke saath maange. Isliye ki Allah jo chaahta hai karta hai. Use majboor kar sake, aisi koi hasti nahin hai.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Tummen se koi vyakti yeh na kahe : Ai Allah! Yadi tu chaahe to mujhe kshama pradaan kar, ai Allah! Yadi tu chaahe to mujhpar daya kar. Use chahiye ki yaqeen ke saath maange. Isliye ki Allah jo chaahta hai karta hai. Use majboor kar sake, aisi koi hasti nahin hai." Muslim ki riwayat mein hai : "Allah se wishvaas ke saath maange aur poori chaahat dikhaye. Isliye ki Allah ke liye kuchh bhi dena bhaari nahin hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kisi cheez se, yahaan tak ki Allah ki ichchha se bhi, jorkar dua karne se mana kiya hai. Kyonki yeh ek jnaat baat hai ki Allah kshama usi samay karega, jab kshama karna chaahega. Ichchha ki shart rakhna isliye bhi arthaheen hai ki ichchha ki shart uske baare mein rakhi jaati hai, jisse bina ichchha ke bhi koi ho sakta ho. Jaise zor-zabardasti koi kaam karva liya jaana. Lekin Allah ke saath aisi koi baat nahin hai. Khud Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bhi is hadees ke ant mein is bindu ko spasht karte hue kah diya hai ki Allah ko koi majboor nahin kar sakta. Koi bhi cheez dena uske liye kathin nahin hai aur kuchh bhi uske wash se baahar nahin hai. Doosri baat yeh hai ki ichchha ki shart lagaakar kshama yaachna karna daraasal yeh bataana hai ki mujhe Allah ki kshama ki zaroorat nahin hai. Isliye 'agar tu dena chaahe to de' kahna daraasal yeh bataana hai ki use ya to lene ki zaroorat nahin hai ya phir jisse maang raha hai woh bebas hai. Jahaan saamne waala saksham ho aur maangne waala zarooratmand, wahaan wishvaas ke saath maanga jaata hai. Isliye Allah se aise maangna chahiye, jaise ek nirdhan wa zarooratmand ek daata wa zaroorat poori karne waale se maang raha ho. Kyonki Allah dhanvaan, nisprih aur kshamtaawaan hai.

Ichchha ki shart lagaakar dua karna mana hai.
Allah un tamaam cheezon se paak hai, jo uski mahaanta, apaar anugrah, sanpoorn nisprihta evn daansheelta ke anuroop nahin hai.
Sarvashaktimaan Allah sanpoorn hai.
Allah ke paas maujood cheezon ki chaahat rakhne aur Allah ke baare mein achchha gumaan rakhne ka mahatv.
Kuchh log anjaane mein bhi dua ke saath ichchha ki shart laga dete hain. Jaise kah dete hain : 'Allah chaahe to tumhen achchha pratiphal de' tatha 'Allah chaahe to tumpar daya kare' aadi. Is prakaar ke waakyon ka prayog sahi nahin hai aur sahi na hone ka pramaan yahi hadees hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
5979: Allah ne sabse pahle qalam ko paida kiya. Phir use likhne ka aadesh diya to usne kahaah ai mere rab! Main kya likhoon? Allah ne kahaah qayaamat tak paida hone waali saari cheezon ki taqdeer likho.

Ubaada bin saamit (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki unhonne kahaah ai mere bete! Tum us samay tak eemaan ki mithaas mahsoos nahin kar sakte, jab tak is baat ka wishvaas na rakho ki jo kuchh tumhen pahunchne waala hai, woh tumse tal nahin sakta aur jo kuchh tumhen nahin pahunchne waala hai, woh tumhen pahunch nahin sakta. Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte suna haih Allah ne sabse pahle qalam ko paida kiya. Phir use likhne ka aadesh diya to usne kahaah ai mere rab! Main kya likhoon? Allah ne kahaah qayaamat tak paida hone waali saari cheezon ki taqdeer likho. Ai mere bete! Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte suna haih jo vyakti is wishvaas ke bina mara, woh meri ummat mein se nahin hai.
Tatha ahmad ki ek riwayat mein haih Allah ne sabse pahle qalam ko paida kiya aur use likhne ko kaha to woh usi kshan qayaamat tak hone waali saari ghatnaaon ko likhne mein lag gai.
Tatha ibne bahb ki ek riwayat mein hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jo vyakti bhali-buri taqdeer par eemaan nahin layega, Allah use aag mein jalayega.

Ubaada bin saamit -radiyallahu anhu- ne apne bete waleed ko waseeyat ki hai ki bhali-buri taqdeer par wishvaas rakhe, tatha yeh spasht kiya hai ki duniya evn aakhirat mein taqdeer par eemaan ke kya kuchh achchhe parinaam evn use na maanne ke kya kuchh bure parinaam saamne aate hain. Unhonne apni baat ke pramaan ke taur par Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki ek hadees pesh ki hai, jo yeh bataati hai Allah ne srishtiyon ko paida karne se pahle hi taqdeeron ka nirdhaaran kar diya tha tatha qalam ko unhen likhne ka aadesh de diya tha. Atah ab qayaamat tak is duniya mein jo kuchh hoga, woh usi likhi hui taqdeer keanusaar hoga.
[ise ibne wahb ne 'al-qadar' mein riwayat kiya hai. - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
5986: Jo vyakti kisi ghaib ki baat bataane waale ke paas jaakar usse kuchh poochhe, uski chaalees din ki namaz qabool nahin hoti.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki ek patni ka warnan hai ki aapne farmaya : "Jo vyakti kisi ghaib ki baat bataane waale ke paas jaakar usse kuchh poochhe, uski chaalees din ki namaz qabool nahin hoti."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ghaib ki baat bataane waalon ke paas jaane se saavdhaan kar rahe hain. Hadees mein aye hue shabd "العرّاف" Ke andar ojha, jyotishi aur ret par rekha kheenchkar bhawishyawaani karne waale aadi sabhi log shaamil hain, jo kuchh bhoomkiाon ke sahaare ghaib ki baat jaanne ka daawa karte hain. In logon ko ghaib ki koi baat poochhne maatr se Allah insaan ko chaalees din ki namaz ke pratiphal se wanchit kar deta hai. Yeh daraasal is bare paap ki saza hai.

Ojha ka kaam karna, ojhaaon ke paas jaana aur unse ghaib ki baaten poochhna haraam hai.
Kabhi-kabhi insaan kisi gunaah ke kaaran neki ke kaam ke sawaab se wanchit kar diya jaata hai.
Is hadees ke dayre mein nakshatron ko dekhna tatha hatheli evn pyaali ko parhna bhi aata hai, chaahe yeh sab kewal jaankaari lene ke liye hi kyon na kiya jaye. Kyonki yeh sab ojha ke ghaib ki baat jaanne ke daawe ke alag-alag roop hain.
Jab ghaib ki baat bataane waale ke paas jaane ki saza itni bari hai, to khud ghaib ki baat bataane waale ko kitni bari saza mil sakti hai?
Chaalees din ki namaazen ada ho jayengi aur unki qaza waajib nahin hogi, lekin inka sawaab nahin milega.
5989: Jisne nakshatr ke jnaan ka kuchh ansh praapt kiya, usne jaadu ka kuchh ansh praapt kiya. Woh aage nakshatr ke baare mein jitna jnaan praapt karta jayega, jaadu ke baare mein utna hi jnaan barhaata jayega.

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne nakshatr ke jnaan ka kuchh ansh praapt kiya, usne jaadu ka kuchh ansh praapt kiya. Woh aage nakshatr ke baare mein jitna jnaan praapt karta jayega, jaadu ke baare mein utna hi jnaan barhaata jayega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki jisne sitaaron tatha nakshatron ka jnaan evn unki gatiyon, prawesh karne tatha nikalne ke  dvaara dharti mein bhawishy mein ghatne waali ghatnaaon, jaise jeewan, maran evn beemaari aadi ke jaanne ka jnaan praapt kiya, usne jaadu ka ek bhaag seekha. Insaan yeh jnaan jitna zyaada praapt karta jayega, woh jaadu ka utna zyaada jnaan praapt karta jayega.

Nakshatron ki gatiwidhiyon ko dekhkar bhawishyawaani karne ka haraam hona, kyonki yeh bhi ghaib ka daawa karne mein shaamil hai.
Nakshatron ko dekhkar bhawishyawaani karna bhi ek prakaar ka jaadu hai, jo tauheed ke wiruddh hai. Jabki disha, qibla, mausam evn maheena jaanne ke liye sitaaron ko dekhna jayaz hai.
Insaan nakshatron ko dekhkar bhawishyawaani karne ka jnaan jitna zyaada praapt karta jayega, woh jaadu ka jnaan utna zyaada praapt karta jayega.
Sitaaron ke teen faydon ka warnan Allah ne Qur'an mein kiya hai; aakaash ki shobha, raasta maaloom karne ke nishaan aur shaitaanon ko maar bhagaane ka saadhan.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
5999: Jab ham kisi manzil par utarte to paalaan utaarne se pahle nafl namaz nahi parhte the.
Anas (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki jab ham kisi manzil par utarte to paalaan utaarne se pahle nafl namaz nahi parhte the.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6003: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab safar mein nikalte samay apne oont par theek se baith jaate to teen baar 'Allahu akbar' kahte aur phir farmaateh «سبحان الذي سخَّر لنا هذا وما كنا له مُقْرِنِينَ وإنا إلى ربنا لـمُنْقَلِبُون» "Paak hai woh hasti, jisne is jaanvar ko hamaare wash mein kar diya, anyatha ham use apne qaabu mein karne mein saksham nahin the tatha nishchay hi ham apne rab ki or lautkar jaane waale hain.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab safar mein nikalte samay apne oont par theek se baith jaate to teen baar 'Allahu akbar' kahte aur phir farmaateh «سبحان الذي سخَّر لنا هذا وما كُنَّا له مُقْرِنِينَ وإنَّا إلى ربِّنا لـمُنْقَلِبُون، اللهم إنَّا نَسْأَلُك في سفرنا هذا البِرَّ والتَّقْوَى، ومن العمل ما تَرْضَى، اللهم هَوِّنْ علينا سفرنا هذا واطْوِ عنا بُعْدَه، اللهم أنت الصاحب في السفر، والخليفة في الأهل، اللهم إني أعوذ بك مِن وَعْثَاء السفر، وكآبة الـمَنْظر، وسوء الـمُنْقَلَب في المال والأهل والولد». وإذا رجع قالهن. وزاد فيهن «آيبون تائبون عابدون لِربنا حامدون» arthaat, paak hai woh hasti, jisne is jaanvar ko hamaare wash mein kar diya, anyatha ham use apne qaabu mein karne par saksham nahin the tatha nishchay hi ham apne rab ki or lautkar jaane waale hain. Ai Allah! Ham tujhse apne is safar mein neki, parhezgaari aur aisa amal maangte hain, jo tujhe pasand ho. Ai Allah! Hamaare is safar ko hamaare liye aasaan kar de tatha uski doori ko lapet de. Ai Allah! Tu hi safar mein saathi aur ghar waalon ko sanbhaalne waala hai. Ai Allah! Main safar ki kathinaai, dukhdayi drishy aur waapsi par maal, pariwaar aur santaan mein bure pariwartan se teri sharan maangta hoon. Isi tarah, jab yaatra se lautte to in shabdon ko kahne ke baad yeh izaafa bhi karteh «آيبون تائبون عابدون لِربنا حامدون», arthaat, ham yaatra se lautne waale hain, tauba karne waale hain, ibaadat karne waale hain aur apne prabhu ki prashansa karne waale hain.
Tatha ek riwayat me haih Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) Hajj ya Umrah se lautte samay jab bhi kisi pahaari ya oonche sthaan par charhte to teen baar 'Allahu akbar' kahte, phir farmaateh «لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد، وهو على كل شيء قدير، آيِبون، تائبون، عابدون، ساجدون، لربنا حامدون، صدَق الله وَعْدَه، ونصَر عَبْدَه، وهزَم الأحزابَ وحده», arthaat, Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin. Woh akela hai. Uska koi saajhi nahin hai. Usi ka raajy hai aur usi ki prashansa hai tatha woh har cheez ki shakti rakhta hai. Ham lautne waale hain, tauba karne waale hain, ibaadat karne waale hain, sajda karne waale hain aur apne rab ki prashansa karne waale hain. Allah ne apna waada sach kar dikhaya, apne bande ki madad ki aur akele saare samoohon ko paraajit kar diya. Tatha ek riwayat mein haih jab kisi bari sena, chhote sainy-dal, Hajj ya Umrah se lautte (to yeh dua parhte).
6005: Ai muhaajiro aur ansaariyo! Tumhaare kuchh bhaai aise hain, jo na dhan rakhte hain na kunba. Atah, tummen se har vyakti apne saath do ya teen logon ko mila le.

Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne yuddh mein nikalne ka iraada kiya to farmayaah ai muhaajiro aur ansaariyo! Tumhaare kuchh bhaai aise hain, jo na dhan rakhte hain na kunba. Atah, tummen se har vyakti apne saath do ya teen logon ko mila le. Ispar, hammen se jiske paas sawaari thi, woh uspar baari-baari se sawaar hota tha. Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hainh mainne bhi apne saath do ya teen logon ko mila liya tha. Mere oont par meri baari usi tarah thi, jis tarah unmen se kisi ek ki thi.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6007: Jab ham chhote the to log gawaahi aur wachan dene par hamaari pitaai karte the.
Ibraaheem nakhai kahte hain ki jab ham chhote the to log gawaahi aur wachan dene par hamaari pitaai karte the.

Is taabai ke kathan se yeh pramaan milta hai ki kuchh 'salaf' apne bachchon kon baar-baar wachan dene se mana karte the, taaki kaheen aisa na ho ki wachan torne ke kaaran gunaah ka haqdaar banna pare. Yahi haal gawaahi dene ka hai, taaki we gawaahi dene ko aasaan na samajh len.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6009: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab kisi beemaar vyakti ko dekhne ke liye jaate to farmaateh لا بأس طهور إن شاء الله, arthaat, koi chinta ki baat nahin hai, yeh beemaari gunaahon se paak karne waali hai.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ek beemaar dehaati se milne gae aur aapki aadat thi ki jab kisi beemaar vyakti ko dekhne ke liye jaate to farmaateh لا بأس طهور إن شاء الله "Koi chinta ki baat nahin hai, yeh beemaari gunaahon se paak karne waali hai."

Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ek dehaati ka haal jaanne ke liye gae, jo beemaar tha. Unhonne doosri baat yeh bataai ki aapki aadat thi ki jab kisi beemaar vyakti ka haal jaanne jaate, to kahte : "Koi chinta ki baat nahin hai. Yeh beemaari gunaahon se paak karne waali hai." Yaani koi kathinaai aur kasht ki baat nahin hai. Tumhaari yeh beemaari tumhen gunaahon se pawitr bana degi, tumhaare aibon ko mita degi aur aakhirat mein pad mein wriddhi ka sabab banegi.
6010: Main Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya to aapko bukhaar tha. Mainne aapke shareer par haath rakha.

Abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki main Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya to aapko bukhaar tha. Mainne aapke shareer par haath rakha aur kahaah aapko to bara teevr bukhaar hai. To farmayaah mujhe tumhaare jaise do vyaktiyon ke baraabar bukhaar aata hai.

Abdullah bin masaood -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki woh Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas us samay pahunche jab aapki beemaari barh chuki thi aur aap kasht mein the. Unhonne apna haath barhaya aur aapse kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapki beemaari to kaafi barh chuki hai. To aapne bataya ki aapko beemaari ki utni bheeshanta ka saamna hota hai, jitne ka saamna hammen se do vyaktiyon ko hota hai. Aisa isliye, taaki aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko sabr ke sabse oonche darje praapt hon.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6011: Ham khabbaab bin aratt (radiyallahu anhu) ka haal jaanne ke liye gae to dekha ki unke shareer ko saat jaghon se daaga gaya tha.

Qais bin abu haazim kahte hain ki ham log khabbaab bin aratt (radiyallahu anhu) ka haal jaanne ke liye pahunche to dekha ki unke shareer ko saat jaghon se daaga gaya tha. Baat-cheet ke dauraan unhonne farmayaah hamaare guzre hue saathi is awastha mein duniya se gae ki duniya (unki neki) ko ghata nahin saki thi. Jabki hamne itna dhan praapt kar liya hai ki hamen use rakhne ke liye bhawan ki aawashyakta par rahi hai. Yadi Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen maut ki dua karne se mana na kiya hota to main Allah se maut maang leta. Phir ham doosri baar unke paas aye to woh apni ek deewaar theek kar rahe the. Woh kahne lageh musalmaan ko uske har kharch karne ka sawaab diya jayega, siwaye us kharch ke, jo ghar banaane mein kare.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai aur shabd Bukhari ke hain.]
6013: Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke do sahaabi aise hain jo neki ke kaam mein kotaahi nahin karte.

Abu atiyya kahte hain ki main aur masrooq, ummul momineen aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ke paas pahunche to masruq ne unse kahaah Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke do sahaabi aise hain, jo neki ke kaam mein kotaahi nahin karte, lekin ek maghrib ki namaz parhne aur iftaar karne mein jaldi karte hain aur doosre maghrib ki namaz der se parhte tatha iftaar der se karte hain. Unhonne poochhaah kaun maghrib ki namaz parhne aur iftaar karne mein jaldi karta hai? Masruq ne kahaah abdullah (bin masaood). Unhonne kahaah Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aisa hi karte the.
6014: Us vyakti ki naak mitti mein mil jaye jiske saamne mera zikr kiya jaye aur woh mujhpar darood na parhe, us vyakti ki naak mitti mein mil jaye jiske saamne Ramzan maheena aye evn nikal jaye aur woh kshama praapti ka saamaan na kar sake aur us vyakti ki naak bhi mitti mein mil jaye jo apne maata-pita ko burhaape ki awastha mein paye aur donon use Jannat mein daakhil na kar saken.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Us vyakti ki naak mitti mein mil jaye jiske saamne mera zikr kiya jaye aur woh mujhpar darood na parhe, us vyakti ki naak mitti mein mil jaye jiske saamne Ramzan maheena aye evn nikal jaye aur woh kshama praapti ka saamaan na kar sake aur us vyakti ki naak bhi mitti mein mil jaye jo apne maata-pita ko burhaape ki awastha mein paye aur donon use Jannat mein daakhil na kar saken."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne nimnalikhit teen prakaar ke logon ke liye bad-dua ki hai ki we itne apmaanit hon aur nuqsaan uthayen ki unki naak mitti mein mil jaye : Pahla prakaar : Aise log jinke saamne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka zikr aye aur woh 'sallallahu alaihi wa sallam' kahkar ya is prakaar ke doosre shabdon dvaara Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par darood na bhejen. Doosra prakaar : Aise log jinke saamne Ramzan ka maheena aya aur guzar bhi gaya, lekin wo neki ke kaam karke kshama ka saadhan na juta sake. Teesra prakaar : Aisa vyakti jisne apne maata-pita ko burhaape ki awastha mein paya aur unki awajna athva unki sewa mein kotaahi ke kaaran Jannat mein prawesh ki vyawastha na kar saka.

Sindhi kahte hain : Saaraansh yeh ki inmen se har vyakti ko aise avsar mile ki kotaahi se kaam na leta to bahut kuchh praapt kar sakta tha. Inmen se har vyakti ko apni kotaahiyon ke kaaran nuqsaan uthaana para.
Jab-jab Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka naam aye, aappar darood bhejne ki prerna.
Ramzan maheene mein ibaadat ke liye kamar kas lene aur khoob ibaadat karne ki prerna.
Maata-pita ki sewa aur sammaan karne ki prerna. Wishesh roop se burhaape mein.
[ise tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
6015: Ai Allah! Tu pawitr evn paak hai tatha farishton evn jibreel ka rab hai.
Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne ruku aur sajde mein kaha karte theh ai Allah! Tu pawitr evn paak hai tatha farishton evn jibreel ka rab hai.
6017: Jisne hamesha roza rakha, usne daraasal roza rakha hi nahin. Maheene ke teen roze saal bhar roza rakhne ki tarah hain.

Abdullah bin amr bin aas -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Kya tum din mein hamesha roza rakhte ho aur raat mein hamesha jaagkar ibaadat karte ho?" Mainne haan mein uttar diya, to farmaya : "Aisa karne se aankh thak jayegi aur shareer durbal ho jayega. Jisne hamesha roza rakha, usne daraasal roza rakha hi nahin. Maheene ke teen roze saal bhar roza rakhne ki tarah hain." Mainne kaha : Mere paas isse adhik roza rakhne ki shakti hai. Aapne kaha : "Tab daaood -alaihissalaam- ka roza rakho. Woh ek din roza rakhte aur ek din bina roza ke rahte the aur dushman se muqaable ke samay bhaagte nahin the."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko yeh soochna mili ki abdullah bin amr -radiyallahu anhuma- saal bhar lagaataar roza rakhte hain aur ek din bhi roza chhorte nahin hain. Isi tarah raat-raat bhar namaz parhte rahte hain aur sote hi nahin hain. Atah unhen isse mana kar diya aur farmaya : Roza bhi rakho aur bina roze ke bhi raho. Raat mein tahajjud ki namaz bhi parho aur so bhi liya karo. Isi tarah unko lagaataar roza rakhne aur raat-raat bhar tahajjud ki namaz parhne se mana kiya aur farmaya : Aisa karoge, to tumhaari aankh kamzor ho jayegi aur andar dhans jayegi. Tumhaara shareer jawaab de jayega. Jisne saal bhar roza rakha, usne roza hi nahin rakha. Kyonki manaahi ke wirodh ke kaaran sawaab se wanchit raha aur roza rakhne ke kaaran kuchh khaya-piya bhi nahin. Iske baad unko maheene mein teen din roza rakhne ka nirdesh diya ki yeh saal bhar roza rakhne ke samaan hai. Kyonki ek din ka sawaab das din ke baraabar milega, jo ki nekiyon mein wriddhi ki nimnatam sankhya hai. Aapke is nirdesh ke baad abdullah ne kaha : Mere andar isse zyaada karne ki shakti hai. Uttar mein Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : Agar aisa hai to tum daaood alaihissalaam ka roza rakho, jo sabse uttam roza hai. Woh ek din roza rakhte the aur ek din bina roze ke rahte the aur dushman se muqaable ke samay bhaagte nahin the, kyonki unke roza rakhne ka tareeqa unko durbal hone nahin deta tha.

Har maheene ke teen roze saal bhar ke roze ki tarah hain. Kyonki har neki ka sawaab das guna diya jaata hai. Is tarah teen roze tees din ke roze hue. Isliye jisne har maheene teen roze rakhe, usne goya saal bhar roza rakha.
Allah ki or bulaane ka ek tareeqa yeh hai ki amal ki prerna di jaye aur paabandi ke saath amal karne ka sawaab bayaan kiya jaye.
Khattaabi kahte hain : Abdullah bin amr ke qisse ka saaraansh yeh hai ki Allah ki ibaadat kewal roze tak seemit nahin hai, balki aur bhi kai prakaar ki ibaadten hain. Aise mein, yadi koi vyakti apni saari oorja roze mein laga de, to woh any ibaadton mein kotaahi karega. Isliye, yahaan santulan banaye rakhna chahiye, taaki any ibaadton ke liye shakti bachi rahe. Antim Nabi Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wasallam dvaara daaood alaihissalaam ke baare mein kahe gae shabdon se yahi baat spasht hoti hai: "Woh shatru ka saamna karte samay bhaagte nahin the." Kyonki woh roza na rakhkar jihaad ke liye shakti praapt karte the.
Apne oopar shakti se adhik ibaadat ka bojh daalne ki manaahi. Sunnat ka anupaalan hi sahi tareeqa hai.
Jamhoor ulema ke yahaan naagha kiye bana hamesha roza rakhna makrooh hai. Lekin agar koi vyakti svayn ko kasht de, apni haani kare aur apne oopar saamarthy se adhik bojh daale, Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki sunnat se munh phere aur ghair-sunnat ko sunnat se behtar jaane, haraam hoga.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
6018: Shareer ke jis bhaag mein kasht ho, uspar apna haath rakho aur teen baar bismillah (Allah ke naam se) kaho aur saat baar " أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ" (Main Allah ki aur uski shakti ki sharan mein aata hoon us wastu ki buraai se, jo main mahsoos karta hoon aur jiska mujhe andesha hai.) parho.

Usmaan bin abul aas saqfi radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saamne apne shareer mein Islam grahan karne ke samay se hi mahsoos hone waale ek kasht ki shikayat ki, to Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Shareer ke jis bhaag mein kasht ho, uspar apna haath rakho aur teen baar bismillah (Allah ke naam se) kaho aur saat baar " أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ" (Main Allah ki aur uski shakti ki sharan mein aata hoon us wastu ki buraai se, jo main mahsoos karta hoon aur jiska mujhe andesha hai.) parho."

Usmaan bin abul aas -radiyallahu anhu- ke shareer mein ek kasht tha, jisse unki mrityu ho jayegi, aisa prateet ho raha tha. Atah Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- unhen dekhne gae aur ek dua sikhaai, jisse Allah unka kasht door kar de. Aapne unhen bataya ki kasht waale sthaan par apni ungli rakhen, phir teen baar bismillah kahen aur uske baad saat baar yeh dua parhen : Main Allah aur uske saamarthy ki sharan maangta hoon us kasht aur dard ki buraai se jo main is samay mahsoos karta hoon aur jiski chinta ya bhay aane waale samay mein mujhe apne changul mein le sakta hai. Ya phir main is baat se Allah ki sharan maangta hoon ki yeh beemaari bhawishy mein sthayi ho jaye aur poora shareer usse prabhaawit ho jaye.

Insaan ka khud par dam karna musathab hai, jaisa ki is hadees mein aya hua hai.
Shikayat karna dhairy aur tawakkul ke wipreet nahin hai, jab tak uske saath wichlit hone aur taqdeer par aapatti karne jaisi koi baat na ho.
Dua bhi saadhnon ke upyog ke dayre mein aata hai. Isliye dua unheen shabdon ke saath honi chahiye, jo sikhaye gae hain aur nirdeshit sankhya ka bhi paalan karna chahiye.
Yeh dua shareer mein kaheen bhi koi kasht hone par parhi ja sakti hai.
Is dua ko parhte samay haath ko kasht waale sthaan par rakhna chahiye.
6020: Woh tumhaare bharan-poshan ka uttardayi nahin hai.

Fatima bint qais (radiyallahu anha) se warnit hai ki abu amr bin hafs ne unhen teen talaaqon mein se antim talaaq de diya, jabki us samay woh ghar se baahar the. (Ek doosri riwayat mein hai unhonne unko teen talaaq de diya.) phir unke pratinidhi ne faatima (radiyallahu anha) ko kuchh jau bheja to woh abu amr par bigar gaeen. Yeh dekh, abu amr ne kahaah Allah ki qasam! Tumhaara hamaare oopar koi adhikaar nahin hai. Isliye, woh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aaeen aur aapke saamne iska zikr kiya to farmayaah woh tumhaare bharan-poshan ka uttardayi nahin hai. (Tatha ek riwayat mein hai ki woh tumhen iddat ke dinon mein rahne ke liye niwaasasthaan dene ka bhi uttadayi nahin hai.) atah, unhen umme shareek ke ghar mein iddat guzaarne ka aadesh diya aur phir farmayaah woh ek aisi stri hai ki uske yahaan mere sahaabiyon ka aana-jaana rahta hai, isliye abdullah bin umme maktoom ke yahaan iddat guzaaro. Woh ek drishtiheen vyakti hai. Tum wahaan kapre utaar sakti ho. Phir jab halaal ho jaao to mujhe bataana.
Woh kahti hain ki jab main halaal ho gai to aapko bataya ki muaawiya bin abu sufyaan aur abu jahm ne mujhe shaadi ka sandesh diya hai. Atah, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah abu jahm to kabhi apni gardan se laathi neeche rakhta hi nahin aur muaawiya ek nirdhan vyakti hai, uske paas maal nahin hai. Tum usaama bin zaid se shaadi kar lo. Lekin mainne unhen pasand nahin kiya to aapne phir farmayaah usaama bin zaid se shaadi kar lo. So, mainne unse shaadi kar li aur Allah ne unke andar bhalaai rakh di aur mainne unpar rashk kiya.

Abu amr bin hafs (radiyallahu anhu) ne apni patni faatima bint qais (radiyallahu anha) ko teen talaaqon mein se antim talaaq de diya. Waise to teen talaaq praapt stri ko uske pati ki or se 'nafqa' nahin milta, lekin unhonne unko kuchh jau bheje. Faatima (radiyallahu anha) ko laga ki jab tak woh 'iddat' mein hain, unke pati par 'nafqa' waajib hai, isliye unhonne is jau ko naakaafi samajhkar thukra diya. Ispar, abu amr ne qasam khaakar bataya ki unke oopar kuchh dene ki koi zimmewaari nahin hai.
Faatima (radiyallahu anha) ne iski shikayat Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se ki, to aapne unhen bataya ki unko na 'nafqa' milna hai, na rahne ke liye makaan. Tatha aapne unhen aadesh diya ki umme shareek ke ghar mein 'iddat' guzaaren.
Phir, jab aapko bataya gaya ki umme shareek ke yahaan sahaaba ka aana-jaana laga rahta hai, to unhen aadesh diya ki abdullah bin umme maktoom ke yahaan 'iddat' guzaaren. Kyonki woh ek drishtiheen vyakti hain. Jab woh kapre utaarengi, to woh unhen dekh nahin sakte. Aapne unko yeh aadesh bhi diya ki jab 'iddat' samaapt ho jaye, to aapko batayen.
Jab woh 'iddat' guzaar chukeen, to muaawiya aur abu jahm (radiyallahu anhuma) ne unhen wiwaah-sandesh bheja. Atah, unhonne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se praamaarsh liya. Choonki saamne koi bhi ho, uska bhala chaahna zaroori hai, (wishesh roop se uska to kuchh adhik hi, jo praamarsh maange) atah, Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unko donon mein se kisi se shaadi karne ka aadesh nahin diya; kyonki abu jahm ke tewar striyon ke prati kare rahte the aur muaawiya ek nirdhan vyakti the. Aapne unhen usaama se nikaah karne ka aadesh diya, lekin woh choonki ek mukt kiye hue daas the, isliye faatima woh nahin bhaye. Lekin Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke aadesh ka paalan karte hue unse shaadi kar li aur baad mein unke oopar naaz kiya tatha Allah ne unke andar bahut-si bhalaai rakhi.
6021: Woh shart, jo is baat ki sabse zyaada haqdaar hai ki use poora kiya jaye, woh shart hai, jiske dvaara (shaadi ke samay) tum (striyon  ke) guptaang (arthaat: Yoni) ko halaal karte ho.

Uqba bin aamir juhni radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Woh shart, jo is baat ki sabse zyaada haqdaar hai ki use poora kiya jaye, woh shart hai, jiske dvaara (shaadi ke samay) tum (striyon  ke) guptaang (arthaat: Yoni) ko halaal karte ho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki poora kiye jaane ki sabse zyaada haqdaar shart woh shart hai, jo aurat ki guptaang (yoni) ko halaal karne ka maadhyam hai. Isse muraad daraasal woh jayaz sharten hain, jo nikaah ke samay patni rakhti hain.

Nikaah ke samay pati ya patni jo sharten rakhe, un sharton ko poora karna waajib hai. Haan, agar woh shart kisi halaal ko haraam ya kisi haraam ko halaal kar de, to uska poora karna waajib nahin hoga.
Nikaah ki sharton ko poora karna any sharton ko poora karne ki tulna mein adhik zaroori hai, kyonki inke zariye sharmagaahon ko halaal kiya jaata hai.
Islam mein shaadi ka mahatv ki usne shaadi ki sharton ko poora karne ki taakeed ki hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
6022: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne safiyya (radiyallahu anha) ko gulaami se mukt kiya aur unki mukti ko unka mahar banaya.
Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne safiyya (radiyallahu anha) ko gulaami se mukt kiya aur unki mukti ko unka mahar banaya.

Banu nazeer ke sardaar huyay ki putri safeeya, kinaana bin abul huqaiq ke wiwaah mein theen. Woh khaibar ke din maara gaya aur Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne khaibar ko fath karke striyon aur bachchon ko qaid kar liya, jinmen safeeya bhi shaamil theen. Woh dehya khaleefa kalbi ke hisse mein aaeen, to aapne dehya kalbi ko unke badle ek daasi di aur unka dil rakhne ke liye tatha unpar daya karte hue unhen apne liye chun liya.
Aapke sadavyavhaar ka ek namoona yeh hai ki aapne unhen daasi ke taur par rakhne ki bajay sammaan diya aur mukt karke wiwaah kar liya tatha unki mukti ko hi unka mahar banaya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6023: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne khaibar waalon se phal tatha anaaj aadi wahaan ki paidaawaaron ke aadhe bhaag par maamla tay kiya.
Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne khaibar waalon se phal tatha anaaj aadi wahaan ki paidaawaaron ke aadhe bhaag par maamla tay kiya.

Khaibar ka ilaaqa kheti-baari ka ilaaqa tha aur wahaan kuchh yahoodi raha karte the. Jab Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ne hijrat ke saatven saal use fath kiya, to uski zameenon ko yuddh mein shaamil sahaaba ke beech baant diya. Lekin choonki sahaaba Allah ke maarg mein jihaad aur uski or bulaane ke mahatvapoorn kaary mein vyast the aur unke paas kheti-baari ke liye samay nahin tha tatha khaibar ke yahoodi lanbe samay se kheti-baari se jure hone ke kaaran, is maamle mein unse adhik jaankaari rakhte the, isliye Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen aadhi paidaawaar ke badle bataai par de diya. Wahaan paida hone waali faslon aur phalon ka aadha bhaag unko, unki mehnat ke badle milta aur aadha bhaag musmaanon ko milta tha, kyonki wahi zameen ke maalik the.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6024: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke jeewankaal mein ek vyakti ne apni patni par vyabhichaar ka aarop lagaya aur uske bachche ko apni santaan maanne se inkaar kar diya. Atah, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke aadesh par, donon ne Qur'an ke bataye hue tareeqe ke mutaabiq ek-doosre par laanat ki. Phir aapne bachche ko aurat ke hawaale kar diya aur donon ko alag-alag kar diya.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke jeewankaal mein ek vyakti ne apni patni par vyabhichaar ka aarop lagaya aur uske bachche ko apni santaan maanne se inkaar kar diya. Atah, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke aadesh par, donon ne Qur'an ke bataye hue tareeqe ke mutaabiq ek-doosre par laanat ki. Phir aapne bachche ko aurat ke hawaale kar diya aur donon ko alag-alag kar diya.

Is hadees mein abdullah bin umar warnan karte hain ki ek vyakti ne apni patni par vyabhichaar ka aarop lagaya aur uske bachche ko apna bachcha maanne se inkaar kar diya. Lekin uski patni ne uske daawe ka khandan kiya aur use maanne se inkaar kar diya.
Aise mein, donon ne 'leaan' kiya. Arthaat pahle pati ne chaar baar Allah ki qasam khaakar gawaahi di ki woh apni patni par vyabhichaar ka aarop lagaane ke maamle mein sachcha hai aur paanchveen baar apne oopar laanat ki.
Phir chaar baar patni ne Allah ki qasam khaakar gawaahi di ki uska pati jhootha hai aur paanchveen baar apne oopar Allah ke krodh ki baddua ki.
Jab unke beech 'leaan' sanpann ho gaya, to Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne donon ko sada ke liye ek-doosre se alag kar diya aur bachche ko pati ki bajay patni ki or mansoob karke usi ke hawaale kar diya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6025: "Ab uspar tumhaara koi adhikaar nahin raha." Us purush ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Mera dhan? Aapne farmayaah "Tumhen (mahar ke roop mein diya hua) tumhaara dhan waapas nahin milega. Yadi tumne uske baare mein sach kaha hai to tumne us dhan se uski sharmagaah (guptaang) ko halaal kiya tha aur yadi jhooth kaha hai to woh tumse, usse bhi kaheen adhik door hai."

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se marphooan warnit hai ki amuk ke bete amuk ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Is maamle mein aapka kya khayaal hai ki yadi ham mein se koi apni patni ko vyabhichaar karte hue paye to woh kya kare? Yadi kuchh kahta hai to bahut bari baat kahta hai aur yadi khaamosh rahta hai to usi tarah ka jaghany krity dekhte hue bhi khaamosh rahta hai.
Warnankarta kahte hainh Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) chup rahe aur koi uttar nahin diya.
Phir jab woh uske baad aya to kahne lagaah jo prashn mainne aapse kiya tha, woh mere saath ho chuka hai. To Allah ne soora noor ki yeh ayten awatrit keenh والذين يرمون أزواجهم...? "Aur jo log apni patniyon par vyabhichaar ka aarop lagaate hain..." To aapne in ayton ko parhkar sunaya aur naseehat ki tatha bataya ki duniya ki saza aakhirat ke azaab se kaheen halki hai. Lekin usne kahaah nahin, us zaat ki qasam, jisne aapko saty ke saath bheja hai, mainne uske baare jhooth nahin bola hai. Phir aapne us stri ko bulaakar farmaya ki duniya ki saza aakhirat ki yaatna se kaheen aasaan hai. Lekin usne bhi kahaah nahin, us zaat ki qasam, jisne aapko saty ke saath bheja hai, woh nishchay hi jhootha hai. Ab aapne purush se aaranbh kiya. Isliye usne Allah ko saakshi banaakar chaar baar kaha ki woh nishchay hi sachcha hai aur paanchvi baar kaha ki yadi woh jhootha hai to uspar Allah ki laanat (dhikkaar) ho. Phir us stri se bhi qasam khaane ko kaha to usne bhi chaar baar Allah ko saakshi banaate hue kaha ki woh (arthaat uska pati) jhootha hai aur paanchveen baar kaha ki yadi woh sachcha hai, to us (arthaat svany us stri) par Allah ka ghazab (prakop) ho. Phir aapne donon ke beech judaai kara di aur farmayaah Allah nishchay hi jaanta hai ki tum donon mein se ek jhootha hai to kya tummen se koi tauba karna chaahta hai? Tatha ek riwayat mein haih ab uspar tumhaara koi adhikaar nahin raha. Us purush ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Mera dhan? Aapne farmayaah tumhen (mahar ke roop mein diya hua) tumhaara dhan waapas nahin milega. Yadi tumne uske baare mein sach kaha hai to tumne us dhan se uski sharmagaah (guptaang) ko halaal kiya tha aur yadi jhooth kaha hai to woh tumse, usse bhi kaheen adhik door hai.

Islaam ne ek saamaajik samasya hal karne ke liye 'leaan' ka aadesh diya hai. Daraasal, jab pati apni patni ke saath kisi ko vyabhichaar mein lipt dekhe aur uske paas gawaah na ho, to woh 'leaan' ka sahaara lega. Lekin kewal sandeh ke aadhaar par iski anumti nahin hai. Iski ijaazat kewal us sthiti mein di gai hai, jab woh apni aankh se dekh le. Kyonki 'leaan' ke baare mein jo dhamki di gai hai, woh bahut bari hai. Yahaan jis vyakti ki ghatna ka ullekh hai, use ek tarah se apni patni par sandeh tha aur use dar tha ki kaheen woh kukarm mein lipt na ho jaye. Aise mein woh dvidha mein par gaya. Yadi apni patni par aarop lagaata hai aur pramaan prastut nahin kar paata hai, to khud usi par had jaari hogi aur agar khaamosh rahta hai, to yeh bhi bari sharm aur aar ki baat hai. Unhonne in baaton ko Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saamne rakha bhi, lekin aapne unka koi jawaab nahin diya. Iske kai kaaran the. Ek to yeh ki unhonne maamla saamne aane se pahle hi uske baare mein poochha tha, jo aapko pasand nahin tha. Doosri baat yeh hai ki woh ek buri cheez ke baare mein poochhne mein jaldi dikha rahe the aur antim baat yeh ki is masle mein aappar koi wahy bhi nahin utri thi.
Lekin iske baad, poochhne waale ko jis baat ka dar tha, use apni aankhon se dekh liya, to Allah ne us danpti ke baare mein soora noor ki yeh ayten utaareenh "وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أزواجهم" (Soora noorah 6)
Chunaanche Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne use yeh ayten parhkar sunaaeen aur samjhaya ki agar usne apni patni par jhootha aarop lagaya hai, to duniya ka azaab (jhootha aarop lagaane ki had) aakhirat ke azaab se halka hai.
Lekin usne qasam khaakar kaha ki usne apni patni par vyabhichaar ka jo aarop lagaya hai, woh jhootha nahin hai.
Phir aapne isi tarah uski patni ko samjhaya aur bataya ki duniya ka azaab (vyabhichaar ki had arthaat sangsaar) aakhirat ke azaab se halka hai.
Lekin usne bhi qasam khaakar bataya ki uska pati jhootha hai.
Iske baad Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne usi se aaranbh kiya, jisse Allah ne aaranbh kiya tha. Yaani pati se. Chunaanche usne chaar baar Allah ki qasam khaakar gawaahi di ki woh apni patni par aarop lagaane ke maamle mein sachcha hai aur paanchveen baar kaha ki yadi woh jhootha hai, to uspar Allah ki laanat ho.
Phir stri se kaha aur usne bhi chaar baar Allah ki qasam khaakar gawaahi di ki uska pati jhootha hai aur paanchveen baar kaha ki yadi uska pati apne daawe mein sachcha hai, to uspar Allah ka krodh ho. Phir aapne donon ko sada ke liye ek-doosre se alag kar diya.
Choonki donon mein se ek nishchit rup se jhootha tha, isliye Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne donon se tauba karne ko kaha.
Uske baad pati ne mahar waapsi ka mutaalba kiya, to aapne farmayaah tujhe mahar nahin milna hai. Toone uspar vyabhichaar ko jo aarop lagaya hai, agar woh sachcha hai, to mahar ke badle toone uski sharmagaah ko halaal rakha hai. Kyonki sanbhog se mahar saabit ho jaata hai. Aur agar toone uspar jhootha aarop lagaya hai, to itna sangeen aarop lagaane ke baad tum hargiz uske haqdaar nahin rah jaate.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6027: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) mere paas aye. Us samay mere paas ek vyakti tha. Atah, aapne poochha ki ai aaisha! Yeh kaun hai? Mainne kahaah yeh mera doodh-shareek bhaai hai (arthaat ham donon ne ek hi mahila se stanpaan kiya tha). To aapne farmayaah ai aaisha! Theek se dekh lo ki kaun tumhaara bhaai hai? Kyonki usi doodh se razaaat saabit hoti hai, jo bhookh mitaye.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) mere paas aye. Us samay mere paas ek vyakti tha. Atah, aapne poochha ki ai aaisha! Yeh kaun hai? Mainne kahaah yeh mera doodh-shareek bhaai hai (arthaat ham donon ne ek hi mahila se stanpaan kiya tha). To aapne farmayaah ai aaisha! Theek se dekh lo ki kaun tumhaara bhaai hai? Kyonki usi doodh se razaaat (doodh-shareek rishta) saabit hoti hai, jo bhookh mitaye.

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ke paas gae, to unke paas unke doodh ke rishte ke bhaai ko dekha. (Choonki aap unko pahchaante nahin the) isliye yahaan unke upasthit hone ko naapsand kiya aur aapke chehre ka rang badal gaya.
Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) maamle ko bhaanp gaeen aur bataya ki woh unke doodh ke rishte ka bhaai hai.
Ispar aapne kahaah ai aaisha, theek se dekhbhaal lo aur doodh ke rishte ki achchhe se chhaanbeen kar lo. Kyonki kabhi-kabhi yeh rishta hurmat ko saabit nahin bhi karta hai. Doodh se rishta saabit hone ke liye zaroori hai ki woh bhookh mitaane ka kaam kare, us samay pila jaye jab bachche ko doodh ki zaroorat ho aur woh uske siwa kuchh na khaata ho tatha usi se uska maans banta ho aur haddiyaan mazboot hoti hon. Aisa hone par bachcha doodh pilaane waali stri ke ek ansh aur uske ek bachche ke samaan ho jaata hai. Isliye hurmat ki chhaanbeen kar lo. Widit ho ki hurmat doodh pilaane waali stri aur uske pariwaar ke liye saabit hoti hai. Doodh pilaane waali usse parda nahin karegi. Woh uske saath akele mein rah sakti hai aur uska woh larka uske saath yaatra mein mahram ke taur par chal sakta hai. Ismen doodh pilaane waali, uska pati jiske kaaran doodh aya hai, un donon ke bachche, un donon ke bhaai, pita aur maata sab shaamil hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6029: Imaam is liye banaya gaya hai, taaki uska anusran kiya jaye. Us se matbhed na karo. Jab woh takbeer kahe to tum log takbeer kaho aur jab ruku kare to tum log ruku karo aur jabah سمع الله لمن حمده (sami Allahu leman hamedhu) kahe to ربنا ولك الحمد (rabbana wa lakal hamd) kaho. Aur jab sajda kare to sajda karo aur jab woh baith kar namaz parhe to tum log bhi baith kar namaz parho.

Abu huraira - radiyallahu anhu- se marfooan warnit hai ki imaam is liye banaya gaya hai, taaki uska anusran kiya jaye. Us se matbhed na karo. Jab woh takbeer kahe to tum log takbeer kaho aur jab ruku kare to tum log bhi ruku karo aur jabah سمع الله لمن حمده (sami Allahu leman hamedhu) kahe to ربنا ولك الحمد (rabbana wa lakal hamd) kaho. Aur jab sajda kare to sajda karo aur jab woh baith kar namaz parhe to tum sab log bhi baith kar namaz parho.

Is hadees mein Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne imaam ke peechhe namaz parhne waalon ko imaam banaye jaane ke uddeshy se avgat karaya hai. Uddeshy yeh hai ki peechhe namaz parhne waale namaz mein uska anusran karen aur namaz ke kisi bhi kaam mein usse bhinnata na apnayen, balki vyawasthit roop se uski gatiwidhiyon ka anukran karen. Chunaanche jab woh namaz shuru karne ke liye takbeer kahe, to tum bhi takbeer kaho, jab woh ruku kare to tum uske baad ruku karo, jab tumhen 'سمع الله لمن حمده' kahkar yeh yaad dilaye ki Allah apni prashansa karne waale ki sunta hai, to tum 'ربنا لك الحمد' kahkar uski prashansa karo. Iske kuchh any shabd bhi aye hain, jaise 'ربنا ولك الحمد', 'اللهم ربنا ولك الحمد' aur 'اللهم ربنا لك الحمد', jab woh sajda kare , to uska anusran karte hue tum bhi sajda karo aur jab woh khare na ho paane ke kaaran baithkar namaz parhe to tum bhi (uska poornatah anusran karte hue) baithkar namaz parho, yadyapi tumhaare paas khare hokar namaz parhne ki shakti ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6030: Jab kisi mahila ka pati mrityu ko praapt ho jaata to mahila chhote se ghar mein bahut hi kharaab wastr pahan kar rahti, na khushbu lagaati na kuchh aur, yahaan tak ki ek saal beet jaata. Phir ek jaanvar- gadha athva chirya athva bakri- laya jaata aur us se apne jism ko ragarti.

Umme salma- radiyallahu anha- se marfooan warnit haih ek mahila Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aai aur kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Meri beti ka pati mar gaya hai aur uski aankh bhi aai hui hai, to kya main uski aakhon mein surma laga doon? To Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ne pharmayaah nahin- do ya teen baar kahne ke baad farmayaah aisa hi chaar maas das din tak karna hoga. Jaahiliyyat mein tum mein se kuchh mahila apne oopar saal poora hone ke pashchaat mengni phenka karti thi. To zainab ne kahaah jab kisi mahila ka pati mrityu ko praapt ho jaata to mahila chhote se ghar mein bahut hi kharaab wastr pahan kar rahti, na khushbu lagaati na kuchh aur, yahaan tak ki ek saal beet jaata. Phir ek jaanvar- gadha athva chirya athva bakri- laya jaata aur us se apne jism ko ragarti, kam hi aisa hota ki jis jeev se woh apne shareer ko ragarti, woh jeewit rahta. Phir woh nikalti to use mengni di jaati , jise apne sir par daal kar phenkti, uske pashchaat jo sugandh lagaana chaahti, lagaati.

Islaam ne logon aur wishesh roop se striyon ke kandhon se jaahiliyat ka bojh utaara hai. Jaahiliyat ke zamaane mein log stri jaati ke saath bura bartaav tatha uspar atyaachaar karte the. Islaam ne hi uske adhikaar ki raksha ki.
Chunaanche is hadees mein hai ki ek stri Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas yeh bataane ke liye aai ki uski beti ke pati ka nidhan ho gaya hai aur woh uska sog mana rahi hai. Sog manaane waali stri ko singaar se bachna hota hai, lekin uski aankhon mein takleef hai. Aise mein, kya woh aankhon mein surma laga sakti hai? Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah nahin! Aapne taakeed ke taur par is shabd ko kai baar dohraya.
Phir aapne chaar maheena das din ki is avdhi ko, jo ek stri apne pati ke sog mein guzaarti hai, bahut kam bataate hue kaha ki kya woh is thori-si avdhi mein sabr nahin kar sakti, jismen kuchh aasaaniyaan bhi rakhi gai hain?
Jaahiliyat ke zamaane mein to striyon ka haal yeh tha ki sog manaane waali stri ek chhote-se ghar mein prawesh kar jaati aur singaar, khushbu, paani tatha logon se logon se mel-jol se door rahti aur ek saal tak is haal mein rahne ke kaaran uske shareer par gandgiyaan jam jaateen.
Jab woh ek saal guzaar leti, to uske haath mein ek mengni di jaati, jise woh is baat ke sanket ke taur phenk deti ki usne ek saal tak jis pareshaani ka saamna kiya hai, woh (uske pati ka adhikaar ada karne ki tulna mein) is mengni ke baraabar bhi nahin hai.
Islaam ne is mashaqqat ko nemat aur is tangi ko aasaani mein badal diya. Iske baavjood bhi kya woh aankh mein surma lagaane se bach nahin sakti? Use iski anumti nahin hai. Taaki yeh sog manaane waali stri ke liye singaar ka chor darvaaza na saabit ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6031: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe khai़bar mein ek zameen mili hai, is se adhik moolyawaan wastu kabhi nahin mili, aap mujhe is ke baare kya aadesh dete hain? To aap ne farmayaah chaaho to mool ko roke rakho aur uski upaj ka sadqa karo.

Abdullah bin umar - raziyallah anhuma- kahte hain ki umar ko khai़bar mein ek zameen mili to woh Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas is silsile mein paraamarsh karne aye aur kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe khai़bar mein ek zameen mili hai, is se adhik moolyawaan wastu kabhi nahin mili, aap mujhe is ke baare mein kya aadesh dete hain? To aap ne farmayaah chaaho to mool ko roke rakho aur uski upaj ka sadqa karo. Kahte hainh to unhon ne use sadqa kar diya, is shart ke saath ki uske mool ko na becha jaye aur na hi hiba kiya (uphaar svaroop diya) jaye aur na hi wiraasat mein diya jaye. Kahte hainh to umar ne nirdhanon, rishtedaaron, gulaamon ki mukti, Allah ke raaste mein aur yaatriyon ke liye sadqa kar diya. Jo uska sanrakshak ho, us par koi paap nahin, yadi woh sahi tareeqe wa uchit roop se usmen se kuchh khaye athva dost ko khilaye, lekin us se dhan ekatrit na kare aur ek shabd mein hai( aur na dhani banne ke liye.

Umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) ko khaibar mein sau teer ke baraabar ek zameen mili, jo itni achchhi aur uttam thi ki unke nikat sabse moolyawaan dhan ki haisiyat rakhti thi. Sahaaba ki baat aisi thi ki we nek kaary mein ek-doosre se aage barhne ke prayaas rahte the. Chunaanche umar (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas, us neki ke lobh mein aye, jiska ullekh Allah taaala ke is farmaan mein haih 'لَنْ تَنَالوا البِرً حَتًى تُنْفِقُوا مِمًا تُحِبونَ' (tum neki us samay tak praapt nahin kar sakte, jab tak apni pyaari cheezon mein kharch na karo.) tatha aapse us zameen ko Allah ki prasannata praapt karne ke liye sadqa karne ke baare mein praamarsh karne lage.
Atah, aapne unhen sadqa ka sabse uttam tareeqa bataya. Aapne bataya ki woh asal zameen ko apne paas rakhte hue use waqf kar den. Chunaanche umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne use waqf kar diya. Ab na woh use bech sakte the, na kisi ko de sakte the, na uttaraadhikaari bana sakte the aur na koi any maamla kar sakte the, jisse maalikaana adhikaar ek haath se doosre haath mein jaata ho ya hastaantran ka kaaran banta ho. Unhonne use nirdhanon, ghareebon, nikatvartiyon, rishtedaaron, daason ki mukti, diyat ada karne, Allah ke dharm ke warchasv ke liye uski raah mein jihaad karne waalon ki madad karne, yaatra mein nikle hue laachaar yaatriyon ki sahayta karne, atithiyon ke satkaar, jo ki eemaan ka ek ang hai, ke liye waqf kar diya.
Choonki us zameen ko ek aise vyakti ki bhi aawashyakta thi, jo uski dekhbhaal karta, isliye uski nigraani karne waale ko yeh anumti di gai hai ki zaroorat ke anusaar aam reeti-riwaaj ke mutaabiq uski paidaawaar ko khud kha sakta hai aur apne kisi dost ko khila sakta hai. Lekin, zaroorat se adhik apne paas jama nahin kar sakta. Kyonki woh zameen bhalaai ke raaston mein kharch karne ke liye waqf hai, use kamaai ka zariya nahin banaya ja sakta.
Tippaneeh wakf yeh hai ki koi musalmaan apne kisi dhan ko kisi bhi bhalaai ke raaste mein is tarah sadqa kare ki uska laabh us bhalaai ke raaste mein kharch ho aur asal dhan uske svaamitv rahe. Udaaharnasvaroop koi apna khet nirdhanon ke liye waqf kar de, to khet se nikalne waale phal aur paidaawaar nirdhanon ke liye hogi aur khet usi ke svaamitv mein rahega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6032: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Main ne shaadi kar li hai. Farmayaah uska mahar kya hai?, kahaah githli samaan sona. Farmayaah Allah barkat de, waleema karo, chaahe ek bakri hi kyon na ho.

Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- se warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne abdurrahmaan bin auf par zaaphraan (kesar) ka rang dekha to farmayaah kya baat hai? To unhonne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Main ne shaadi kar li hai. Farmayaah uska mahar kya hai? Kahaah githli samaan sona. Farmayaah Allah barkat de, waleema karo, chaahe ek bakri se hi kyon na ho.

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne abdurrahmaan bin auf (radiyallahu anhu) ke shareer par zaafraan ka koi dhabba dekha. Choonki purushon ko aisi khushbu lagaani chahiye, jismen sugandh ho aur dhabba na ho, isliye aapne inkaar ke andaaz mein unke shareer par lage is dhabbe ka kaaran poochha, to unhonne bataya ki unki nai-nai shaadi hui hai. Sanbhavtah yeh unki patni se laga ho. Ispar aapne unhen iski chhoot di.
Choonki aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) sahaaba ki khabar rakhte the aur unse prem karte the, isliye unke haalaat poochhte rahte the, taaki koi achchhi baat dekhen, to use sveekaaryata pradaan kare aur buri baat dekhen, to usse mana karen. Yahi kaaran hai ki aapne mahar ke baare mein poochha. Unhonne kahaah ek guthli ke baraabar sona diya hai. Ispar aapne barkat ki dua di aur nikaah ke baad waleema karne ka aadesh diya, chaahe ek bakri hi kyon na ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6033: Oh, oh yahi to sood hai. Yahi to sood hai. Aisa na karo, lekin jab tum khareedna chaaho to apne paas maujood khujoor ko bech do aur uske paise se khareedo.

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki bilaal (radiyallahu anhu), Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas barni khujoor (madeene ki ek uttam prakaar ki khujoor) lekar aye to Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unse farmayaah tumhen yeh kahaan se mila? Bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) ne kahaah hamaare paas raddi khujoor thi. Mainne usmen se do saaa़ (saaa़ ek prakaar ka maap hai) dekar ek saaa़ liya taaki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) khayen. Yeh sunkar, Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah oho, yahi to sood hai. Yahi to sood hai. Aisa na karo, lekin jab tum khareedna chaaho to apne paas maujood khujoor ko bech do aur uske paise se khareedo.

Bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas madeene ki uttam koti ki barni khajoor lekar aye, to Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne uski utkrishtata par aashchary prakat kiya aur poochha ki ise khajoor kahaan se le aye?
Bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) ne uttar diyaah hamaare paas aam khajoor thi. Hamne do sa raddi khajoor dekar ek sa achchhi khajoor le li, taaki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) khila saken. Unki yeh baat Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) par bahut bhaari pari aur aapke munh se niklaah 'oh!' kyonki aapke nikat gunaah hi sabse bari museebat tha.
Phir farmayaah tumhaara bilkul sood hai, jo ki haraam hai. Aisa na karo. Yadi raddi khajoor badalna chaahte ho, to raddi khajoor ko dirham se becho. Phir dirham se achchhi khajoor khareed lo. Yeh jayaz tareeqa hai. Haraam se bachne ke liye ispar amal karna hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6034: Tum mein se koi jab sone ke liye bistar mein jaye to apni lungi ke androoni bhaag se apne bistar ko jhaare, kyonki woh nahin jaanta ki uske baad wahaan kaun-si cheez aai hai.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se warnan karte hain ki aapne farmayaah tummen se koi jab sone ke liye bistar par jaye to apni lungi ke androoni bhaag se apne bistar ko jhaare, kyonki woh nahin jaanta ki uske baad wahaan kaun-si cheez aai hai. Phir woh yeh dua parheh باسمك ربي وضعت جنبي، وبك أرفعه، إن أمسكت نفسي فارحمها، وإن أرسلتها، فاحفظها بما تحفظ به عبادك الصالحين», ai mere rab! Mainne tere naam se apna pahlu rakha aur tere hi naam se use uthaaoonga. Yadi toone mere praan ko rok liya to uspar daya karna aur yadi use bhej diya to uski usi tarah suraksha karna, jaise tu apne nek bandon ki suraksha karta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6035: Tab tum mujhe gawaah mat banaao. Kyonki main kisi anyay ka gawaah nahin banta.

Naumaan bin basheer -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Unki maan rawaaha ki beti ne unke pita se kaha ki woh unke bete ko kuchh bhent karen. Unke pita ek saal tak taalte rahe. Phir unka man hua, to unki (naumaan ki) maan ne kaha : Main us samay tak santusht nahin ho sakti, jab tak aap Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko mere bete ko diye gae is bhent par gawaah na bana len. Chunaanche mere pita ne mera haath pakra ki main us samay bachcha tha, Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas pahunche aur kahne lage : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Is bachche ki maan rawaaha ki beti ki ichchha hai ki mainne apne bete ko jo bhent diya hai, uspar aapko gawaah bana loon. Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne poochha : "Ai basheer! Kya tumhaare aur bhi bachche hain?" Unhonne uttar diya : Ji haan, hain. Aapne poochha : "Kya tumne sab ko isi tarah ka bhent diya hai?" Unhonne uttar diya : Ji nahin. Farmaya : "Tab tum mujhe gawaah mat banaao. Kyonki main kisi anyay ka gawaah nahin banta." Saheeh Muslim ki ek riwayat mein hai : "Iska gawaah mujhe chhorkar kisi aur ko bana lo."

Naumaan bin bashreer -radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki unki maan amra bint rawaaha ne unke pita basheer se aagrah kiya ki woh apne dhan se amra ke bete (naumaan) ko koi bhent de den. Basheer unke is aagrah ko ek saal tak taalte rahe aur uske baad unko laga ki is aagrah ko sveekaar kar lena chahiye aur naumaan ko koi uphaar dena chahiye. Lekin ab amra ne kah diya : Main us samay tak santusht nahin ho sakti, jab tak aap mere bete ko diye gae is uphaar ka gawaah Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko na bana len. Choonki main us samay chhota bachcha tha, isliye mere pita ne mera haath pakra, Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas pahunche aur kahne lage : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Is bachche ki maan rawaaha ki beti ki ichchha hai ki main apne bete ko diye gae uphaar ka gawaah aapko banaaoon. Unki baat sun Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne poochha : Ai basheer! Kya tumhaare aur bhi bachche hain? Jawaab diya : Ji haan (hain). Poochha : Kya tumne un sab ko bhi isi prakaar ka uphaar diya hai? Uttar diya : Ji nahin. Farmaya : Tab tum mujhe iska gawaah mat banaao. Kyonki main kisi anyay evn atyaachaar ka gawaah nahin banta. Saheeh Muslim ki ek riwayat mein hai ki aapne unhen daantte hue farmaya : Tum is anyay ka gawaah kisi aur ko bana lo.

Uphaar evn bhent mein beton evn betiyon ke beech nyay karna zaroori hai. Jahaan tak kharch ki baat hai, to kharch harek par  uski zaroorat ke anusaar kiya jayega.
Ek bachche ko doosre bachche par praathmikta dena anyay evn atyaachaar hai. Iska na gawaah banna jayaz hai aur na gawaahi dena.
Navvi kahte hain : Apne bachchon ko bhent svaroop kuchh dete samay baraabar dena chahiye. Kami-beshi nahin honi chahiye. Larkon evn larkiyon ke beech bhi baraabri ka khayaal rakhna chahiye. Waise to hamaare kuchh widvaanon ne kaha hai ki ek larke ko do larkiyon ke baraabar dena chahiye, lekin sahi evn wikhyaat mat yeh hai ki donon ko baraabar dena chahiye, jiski daleel yahi hadees hai.
Shareeyat ke wiruddh liye gae nirnay shareeyat ki nazar mein laagu nahin hote.
Shaasak tatha mufti ko sanbhaawit wivran poochh lene chahiye, kyonki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne naumaan bin basheer radiyallahu anhu se poochha tha : "Kya tumne apne sabhi bachchon ko isi prakaar bhent kiya hai?"
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki pita apni santaan ko bhent svaroop di hui cheez waapas le sakta hai.
Islam un kaaryon ka aadesh deta hai jo logon ke beech ekta aur prem paida karte hain aur un kaaryon se rokta hai jo shatruta paida karte hain aur pita ki awajna ka kaaran bante hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai tatha iske anek shabd hain]
6036: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne kutte ki qeemat, weshya ki kamaai aur kaahin (bhawishy wakta, jyotishi) ke paarishramik se mana farmaya hai.

Abu masaood (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne kutte ki qeemat, weshya ki kamaai aur kaahin (bhawishy wakta, jyotishi) ke paarishramik se mana farmaya hai.

Rozi kamaane ke bahut-se jayaz aur pawitr raaste hain, jinke hote hue naajayaz aur apvitr raaston ki zaroorat nahin hai.
Choonki rozi kamaane ke jayaz raaste hi kaafi hain aur naajayaz raaston mein bahut-si bari-bari buraaiyaan hain, jinki tulna mein unke andar maujood faydon ka koi mahatv nahin hai, isliye shareeyat ne tamaam apvitr raaston ki kamaai ko haraam qaraar diya hai, jinke nimnalikhat teen raaste shaamil hainh
1. Kutte ko bechnaah kyonki kutta ganda aur naapaak jaanvar hai.
2. Vyabhichaarini ki kamaai, jo vyabhichaar se praapt ho, jisse insaan ka dharm aur duniya donon tabaah ho jaate hain.
3. Isi tarah un chhal aur dhokha karne waalon ki kamaai, jo ghaib jaanne tatha kaynaat ko chalaane mein akhtiyaar rakhne ka daawa karte hain aur logon se unka dhan nikaalkar haraam tareeqe se khaane ke liye nazarbandi ka khel khelte hain.
Dhan arjit karne ke yeh saare tareeqe ashuddh aur haraam hain. Inke zariye dhan arjit karna jayaz nahin hai. Allah ne inke badle bahut-se halaal aur pawitr raaste khol rakhe hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6037: Kutte ki qeemat naapaak hai, weshya ki kamaai naapaak hai aur singi lagaane waale ki kamaai naapaak hai.

Raafe bin khadeej (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah kutte ki qeemat naapaak hai, weshya ki kamaai naapaak hai aur singi lagaane waale ki kamaai naapaak hai.

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen kuchh haraam tatha apvitr kamaaiyon ke baare mein bataya hai, taaki ham unke sthaan par pawitr aur jayaz kamaaiyon ko akhtiyaar karen. In naapaak kamaaiyon mein kutte ki qeemat, vyabhichaarini ki kamaai jo vyabhichaar se praapt ho aur singi lagaane waale ki kamaai shaamil hai.
6038: Kya tum samajhte ho ki mainne tumhaara oont lene ke liye uska mooly kam lagaya hai? Tum apna oont aur apne dirham le lo. Sab tumhaara hai.

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki woh ek oont par sawaar hokar chal rahe the ki oont thak gaya aur unhonne use chhor dene ka man bana liya. Parantu, isi beech Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) mujhse a mile aur mere liye dua ki tatha us oont ko maara. So, woh aise chalne laga ki us tarah kabhi nahin chala tha. Phir aapne farmayaah ise mujhse ek oqiya (taul mein ek wishesh bhaar ko ingit karne waala ek prakaar ka batakhra) mein bech do. Mainne kahaah nahin. Phir aapne farmayaah ise mujhse bech do. Atah, mainne use ek oqiya mein bech diya, lekin yeh shart rakhi ki mujhe ghar jaane tak us par sawaar hone ka adhikaar praapt hoga. Jab main ghar pahunchne ke baad oont lekar upasthit hua to aapne mujhe uski qeemat de di. Phir, jab main chal para to mere peechhe ek vyakti ko bheja aur farmayaah kya tum samajhte ho ki mainne tumhaara oont lene ke liye uska mooly kam lagaya hai? Tum apna oont aur apne dirham le lo. Sab tumhaara hai.

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) ek yuddh mein Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath the. Woh ek oont par sawaar the, jo itna thak chuka tha ki sena ke saath chal nahin pa raha tha. Naubat yahaan tak pahunch chuki thi ki unhonne use kisi kaam ka na samajhkar aazaad chhor dene ka iraada kar liya tha. Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko choonki apne saathiyon aur apni ummat se bara prem tha, isliye aap sena ke peechhe-peechhe chalte the ki nirbal, wiwash aur pichhar jaane waale ki sahayta kar saken. Isi beech aap jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) se mile, jo apne durbal oont par sawaar the. Atah, aapne unke liye dua ki aur unke oont ko maara. Aapki yeh maar unke durbal oont ke liye shaktisrot ban gai aur woh itna tez chalne laga ki kabhi us tarah chalte nahin dekha gaya tha. Phir Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam), jo sadavyavhaar aur uttam charitr ke putle the, jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) ka dil bahlaane aur unse baat karne lage ki aasaani se raasta kat jaye. Aapne kahaah mujhes yeh oont ek ooqiya mein bech do. Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) ne Allah ke anugrah ki ummeed ki. Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) jaante the ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se bechne se mana karne par unke dharm mein koi kami nahin ayegi, kyonki aapka yeh aadesh koi aisa aadesh nahin hai, jiska anupaalan zaroori ho. Lekin iske baavjood jab aapne dobaara bechne ko kaha, to use ek ooqiya mein bech diya. Albatta, yeh shart rakhi ki woh uspar sawaar hokar madeene mein sthit apne ghar tak jayenge. Aapne unki shart manzoor kar li. Jab sab log madeena pahunch gae, to jaabar (radiyallahu anhu) oont lekar aapke paas aye aur Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen daam bhi de diya. Jab woh jaane lage, to aapne unhen bula bheja. Jab woh aye, to aapne kahaah kya tum samajhte ho ki mainne tumse maamla tumhaare oont ke laalach mein aur use praapt karne ke liye kiya tha? Apna oont aur apne dirham donon le jaao. Donon tumhaare hain. Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki dariyaadili tatha dayaaluta ke saamne yeh koi achanbhe ki baat bhi nahin hai; kyonki aapke jeewan mein iske bahut-se udaahran milte hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6039: Mainne raafe bin khadeej se sone-chaandi (arthaat nakdi) ke badle bhoomi kiraye par lene ke baare mein poochha to farmayaah ismen koi harj nahin hai.

Hanzla bin qais kahte hain ki mainne raafe bin khadeej se sone-chaandi (arthaat nakdi) ke badle bhoomi theke par lene ke baare mein poochha to farmayaah ismen koi harj nahin hai. Asl mein, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke zamaane mein log nahron ke kinaaron mein hone waali aur paani ke naalon ke saamne hone waali paidaawaar tatha kuchh wishesh paidaawaar ke badle bhoomi theke par dete the. Aise mein, kabhi is bhaag ki kheti nasht ho jaati aur us bhaag ki kheti surakshit rah jaati. Iske siwa logon ke andar zameen theke par dene ka aur koi tareeqa prachlit nahin tha. Isi liye, aapne isse mana kar diya. Jahaan tak kisi nishchit evn hawaale ki gai wastu ke badle zameen theke par dene ki baat hai to ismen koi harj nahin hai.

Raafe bin khadeej (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki madeene mein unke pariwaar sabse adhik khet tatha baagh the.
Chunaanche we jaahiliyat ke zamaane mein prachlit tareeqe ke anusaar kheti kiya karte the.We kheti ke liye zameen is shart par dete ki ek bhaag ki paidaawaar unki hogi aur doosre bhaag ki paidaawaar kheti karne waale ki. Lekin kabhi-kabhi is bhaag ki paidaawaar achchhi rahti aur bhaag ki nasht ho jaati.
Kabhi-kabhi we zameen maalik ke liye zameen ke uttam bhaag ki paidaawaar nishchit kar dete the. Jaise nahar aur naalon ke kinaaron ke bhaag. Aise mein, is bhaag ki kheti nasht ho jaati aur us bhaag ki surakshit rahti ya iske wipreet hota.
Inheen kaarnon se Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen is tarah maamla tay karne se mana kar diya. Kyonki yeh dhokha, anishchitta aur atyaachaar par aadhaarit maamla hai. Jabki kisi bhi maamle mein ewaz ka nishchit hona aur nafa-nuqsaan mein baraabar ka bhaageedaar hona zaroori hai.
Agar zameen uski paidaawaar ke ek bhaag ke badle mein di jaye, to yeh saajhedaari hai, jiska aadhaar nyay tatha nafa-nuqsaan mein baraabri par hona chahiye tatha usmen zameen maalik ka bhaag jaise chaathaai evn aadha aadi bhi nishchit hona chahiye.
Aur agar ewaz ke badle mein di jaye, to yeh kiraye par dena hai aur ismen ewaz ka nishchiti hona zaroori hai.
Jo kuchh bayaan hua uska saar yeh hai ki zameen ko sona-chaandi ke badle mein diya ja sakta hai aur zameen ki paidaawaar ke badle bhi diya ja sakta hai. Chaahe woh usi zameen se nikalti ho ya usi jins se ho ya kisi aur jins se. Kyonki yeh soorten ya to zameen ko kiraye par dene ke antargat aati hain ya bataai ke antargat. Tatha isliye bhi ki yeh is hadees ke vyaapak arth ke antargat a jaati hainh "Jahaan tak kisi nishchit evn hawaale ki gai wastu ke badle zameen theke par dene ki baat hai, to ismen koi harj nahin hai."
6040: Allah se, aazmaaish ki kathinaai, durbhaagy ka shikaar hone, taqdeer ke apriy nirnay aur kathinaai mein dekhkar shatruon ke khush hone se Allah ki sharan maanga karo.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se warnan karte hain ki aapne farmayaah Allah se aazmaaish ki kathinaai, durbhaagy ka shikaar hone, taqdeer ke apriy nirnay aur kathinaai mein dekhkar shatruon ke khush hone se Allah ki sharan maanga karo. Ek riwayat mein hai ki sufyaan kahte hainh mujhe is baat mein sandeh hai ki mainne inmen se koi ek baat adhik bayaan ki hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6041: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko azl (sanbhog ke samay weery-skhalan se pahle ling ko baahar nikaal lena taaki andar skhalan na ho) ke baare mein bataya gaya to farmayaah tummen se koi aisa kyon karta hai? Kyonki, jo bhi jaan paida hone waali hai, Allah use paida karke rahega.

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko azl (sanbhog ke samay weery-skhalan se pahle ling ko baahar nikaal lena taaki andar skhalan na ho) ke baare mein bataya gaya to farmayaah tummen se koi aisa kyon karta hai? (Aapne yeh nahin farmaya ki tummen se koi aisa na kare) kyonki, jo bhi jaan paida hone waali hai, Allah use paida karke rahega.

Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saamne azl ka zikr kiya gaya aur yeh bataya gaya ki kuchh log apni patniyon tatha daasiyon ke saath aisa karte hain, to Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne khandan ke andaaz mein unse iska kaaran jaanna chaaha.
Phir aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unke aisa karne ke peechhe chhipe uddeshy ka aisa santoshajnak uttar diya, jo unhen isse rokne ke liye kaafi hai. Farmaya ki Allah taaala ne taqdeeren nirdisht kar di hain, isliye tumhaara yeh amal us jaan ko rok nahin sakta, jise Allah ne rachne ka nirnay kar liya hai. Kyonki wahi asbaab ko tay karta hai aur unke prabhaawon ko bhi. Atah, jab woh purush ke weery se insaan ki rachna ka iraada karta hai, to use is tarah uske surakshit sthaan mein pahuncha deta hai ki use ehsaas bhi nahin hota.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6042:
Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne paanch wasaq ya usse kam mein a़raya kray-wikray arthaat sookhi khujooron ke badle mein per par lage hue taaza khujooron ko anumaan lagaakar khareedne ki anumti di hai.
(Wasaq, tolne mein ek wishesh bhaar ko ingit karne waala ek wishesh prakaar ka maap hai, jo takreeban 130.56 kilograam ka hota hai, is prakaar paanch wasaq ka wazan hoga, chhah kvintal tirpan (653) kilograam lagbhag).

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne paanch wasaq ya usse kam mein a़raya kray-wikray arthaat sookhi khujooron ke badle mein per par lagi hui taaza khujooron ko anumaan lagaakar khareedne ki anumti di hai.
(Wasaq, taulne mein ek wishesh bhaar ko ingit karne waala ek wishesh prakaar ka maap hai, jo takreeban 130.56 kilograam ka hota hai, is prakaar paanch wasaq ka wazan hoga, chhah kvintal tirpan (653) kilograam lagbhag).

Araya', 'ariyya' ka bahuvchan hai. Iska arth yeh hai ki jab taaza khajoor ka samay ho aur kisi ko use khaane ki ichchha ho, parantu nirdhanta ke kaaran praapt na kar sake, albatta uske paas sookhi khajoor ho aur woh sookhi khajoor ke badle per par lagi hui taaza khajoor ko khareed le. Lekin iske liye shart yeh hai ki taaza khajooron ka anumaanit wazan adhik se adhik paanch wasaq ho. Kyonki waastawik roop se yeh bikri haraam hai aur zarurat ke maddenzar halaal ki gai hai, atah ise utne parimaan tak seemit rakha gaya hai, jo svabhaawik roop se kaafi ho. Yahi kaaran hai ki paanch wasaq ya isse kam ki anumti di gai hai. Kyonki itni taaza khajooren, taaza khajooron ki chaahat poori karne ke liye kaafi hain. Waise, asal yeh hai ki ek hi warg ki do cheezon ki khareed-bikri ke samay kisi ek ko adhik tatha doosri ko kam rakhna haraam hai. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se jab sookhi khazooron ke badle taaza khajooron ko bechne ke baare mein poochha gaya, to aapne poochhaah "Kya taaza khajoor sookhne ke baad kam ho jaati hai?" Sahaaba ne kahaah haan! To farmayaah "Tab yeh maamla sahi nahin hai." Yeh hadees saheeh hai. Ise imaam ahmad, tirmizi, abu daaood, nasai aur ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6043: Zaid bin saabit kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne a़riyya karne waale arthaat sookhi khujoor ke badle mein taaza khujoor khareedne waale ko anumaan lagaakar sauda karne ki anumti di hai.

Zaid bin saabit kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne a़riyya karne waale arthaat sookhi khujoor ke badle mein taaza khujoor khareedne waale ko anumaan lagaakar sauda karne ki anumti di hai.
Tatha Muslim ki riwayat mein haih taaza khujoor khaane ke liye sookhi khujoor ke badle anumaan lagaakar sauda karne ki anumti di hai.

Per par lagi taaza khajooron ko sookhi khajooron ke badle bechna, jise 'muzaabna' kaha jaata hai, haraam hai; kyonki yahaan ek hi shreni ki do wastuon ke baraabar hone ki jaankaari nahin hai, jo ki aawashyak hai. Lekin is aam niyam se 'araya' apvaad hai. Araya, arthaat per par lagi taaza khajooron ko kuchh khaas sharton ke saath sookhi khajooron ke badle mein bechna. Unheen sharton mein se ek yeh hai ki khareed-bikri paanch wasaq se kam mein ho. Kyonki pahle zamaane mein naqad, jaise deenaar aur dirham kam hua karte the. Aise mein, taaza khajoor aur uske svaad ke aanand lene ka samay aata aur logon ko uski aawashyakta bhi hoti, lekin unke paas khareedne ke liye naqad nahin hote.
