Yahi kaaran hai ki unhen taaza khajooron ke svaad ka aanand lene ke liye sookhi khajooron ke badle taaza khajooren khareedne ki chhoot di. Lekin is baat ka khayaal rakha ki donon baraabar hon aur iske liye yeh andaaza lagaya jaye ki per par lagi khajooron ka wazan sookhne ke baad kitna ho sakta hai. Is tarah 'araya', 'muzaabna' se apvaad hai, jo ki haraam hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6044: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne usmaan bin mazaoon ke wiwaahit jeewan se alag hokar ibaadat mein lage rahne ke iraade ko nakaar diya tha. Yadi unhen anumti de dete to ham poore taur par wiwaahit jeewan se alag hokar ibaadat mein lag jaate.

Saad bin abu wakkaas (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne usmaan bin mazaoon ke wiwaahit jeewan se alag hokar ibaadat mein lage rahne ke iraade ko nakaar diya tha. Yadi unhen anumti de dete to ham poore taur par wiwaahit jeewan se alag hokar ibaadat mein lag jaate.

Saad bin abu waqqaas (radiyallahu anhu) warnan karte hain ki usmaan bin mazaoon (radiyallahu anhu) ko Allah ki ibaadat se itna lagaav tha ki duniya ke saare sukh aur aanand ko tyaagkar poore taur par usi mein lag jaane ka iraada kar liya.
Atah, Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se is baat ki anumti maangi ki woh waiwaahik jeewan se alag hokar ekaagrata ke saath Allah ki ibaadat mein lag jayen. Lekin aapne unhen iski anumti nahin di. Kyonki jeewan ke aanandon aur sukhon ko tyaagkar kewal ibaadat mein lag jaana dharm ke maamle mein atishyokti evn mazmoom rahbaaniyat hai.
Jabki sahi dharm yeh hai ki insaan Allah ki ibaadat ke saath-saath un svachchh wastuon se bhi laabh uthaye, jo uske liye halaal ki gai hain. Yahi kaaran hai ki yadi Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne usmaan (radiyallahu anhu) ko anumti de di hoti, to bahut-se ibaadat mein tatpar sahaaba unki raah par chal parte.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6045: Tumhen Qur'an ka jo kuchh yaad hai, uske badle mein mainne usse tumhaara wiwaah kar diya.

Sahl bin saad as-saaa़di (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas ek mahila aai aur boli: Main khud ko aapke hawaale karti hoon. Iske baad woh der tak khari raheen. Itne mein ek vyakti ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Yadi aapko aawashyakta na ho to usse mera wiwaah kar deejiye. Aapne poochhaah kya tumhaare paas mahar ke roop mein dene ke liye kuchh hai? Usne uttar diyaah is tahband ke siwa mere paas kuchh nahin hai. Yeh sunkar, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah apni lungi use de doge to tumhaare paas koi lungi nahin rah jayegi, isliye kuchh dhoondho. Usne kahaah mujhe kuchh nahin mil raha hai. To farmayaah "Dhoondho, chaahe lohe ki ek angoothi hi sahi. So, unhonne dhoondha, lekin kuchh na mil saka. Atah, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah kya tumhen Qur'an ka kuchh bhaag yaad hai? Uttar diya ki haan! To farmayaah tumhen Qur'an ka jo kuchh yaad hai, uske badle mein mainne usse tumhaara wiwaah kar diya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6046: Iddat ke baare mein subaia asalmi ki hadees.

Subaia asalmiyya (radiyallahu anha) ka warnan hai ki woh saad bin khaula ke nikaah mein theen (jo ki banu aamir bin luway qabeele se sanbandh rakhte the aur badr yuddh mein shaamil ho chuke the). Woh garbhaawastha mein theen ki hajjatul wada mein unke pati ka nidhan ho gaya aur unki mrityu ko kuchh zyaada samay nahin beeta tha ki unka prasav ho gaya.
Jab nifaas (prasuti) ki avdhi samaapt ho gai aur unhonne shaadi ka sandesh bhejne waalon ke liye banaav-shrringaar shuru kar diya to unke yahaan (banu abdud-daar qabeele ka ek vyakti) abus-sanaabil bin baakak aye aur unse boleh kya baat hai, main tumhen banaav-shrringaar mein dekh raha hoon? Kya tum shaadi karna chaahti ho? Allah ki qasam! Tum chaar maheene das din beetne se pahle shaadi nahin kar sakti.
Subaia kahti hainh jab usne yeh baat kahi to main shaam ke samay Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas gai aur aapse iske baare mein prashn kiya to aapne mujhe fatva diya ki main prasvopraant hi halaal ho gai thi aur mujhe aadesh diya gaya ki yadi mera dil chaahe to main nikaah kar loon.
Ibne shihaab kahte hain ki main ismen koi harj mahsoos nahin karta ki prasav ke baad woh nikaah kar le (chaahe prasav ke baad jaari rakt hi mein kyon na ho). Haan, magar pawitr hone se pahle uska pati uske nikat na jaye.

Saad bin khaula (radiyallahu anhu) apni garbhavti patni subaia aslaamiya (radiyallahu anha) ko chhorkar mar gae aur kuchh hi dinon ke pashchaat unka prasav ho gaya.
Jab subaia (radiyallahu anha) nifaas (prasav ke baad kuchh dinon tak jaari rahne waale rakt) se pawitr hueen, to banaav-singaar karne lageen; kyonki woh jaanti theen ki prasav ke baad woh iddat se nikal gai hain aur unke liye shaadi karna halaal ho gaya hai.
Ek din woh banaav-singaar ki hui theen ki unke yahaan abu sanaabil ka aana hua. Subaia (radiyallahu anha) ko dekhkar woh samajh gae ki woh shaadi ke liye taiyaar hain. Atah, unhonne yeh samajhkar ki unki iddat abhi samaapt nahin hui hai, unke is kaary ka khandan kiya aur qasam khaakar bataya ki chaar maah das din guzarne se pahle unke liye nikaah karna jayaz nahin hai. Daraasal unke zehan mein Allah taaala ka yeh farmaan thaah "والذِين يُتَوَفوْن منكم ويذرون أزْواجاً يتَرَبصْنَ بِأنفُسِهن أربعة أشهُر وعشراً" (Tummen se jo log mar jayen aur patniyaan chhor jayen, unhen apne baare mein chaar maheena das din prateeksha karni hai.) choonki subaia (radiyallahu anha) ke paas jo jaankaari thi, uspar unhen poora yaqeen nahin tha aur abu sanaabil ne qasam khaakar apni baat rakhi thi, isliye unhonne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aakar is baare mein poochha, to aapne bataya ki woh prasav ke baad wiwaah ke liye halaal ho chuki hain. Yadi woh shaadi karna chaahen, to kar sakti hain. Kyonki Allah taaala ka farmaan haih "وَأولاتُ الأحمال أجلُهُن أن يضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُن" (Garbhavti striyon ki iddat yeh hai ki prasav ho jaye).
Atah, jis stri ke pati ke nidhan ho jaye, yadi woh garbhavti ho, to uski iddat prasav ke baad samaapt ho jaati hai. Parantu, yadi garbhavti na ho, to uski iddat chaar maheena das din hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6047: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) yeh dua parha karte the: Ai Allah! Main safed daagh, paagalpan, korh aur buri beemaariyon se teri sharan maangta hoon.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kaha karte theh «اللهم إني أعوذ بك من البَرَصِ، والجُنُونِ، والجُذَامِ، وَسَيِّئِ الأسْقَامِ», "Ai Allah! Main safed daagh, paagalpan, korh aur buri beemaariyon se teri sharan maangta hoon.

Is hadees mein hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- kuchh wishesh rogon se Allah ki sharan maangte the, jo unke khatre evn bare kuprabhaav ko pradarshit karta hai. Uske baad saamaany roop se sabhi bure rogon se Allah se suraksha evn salaamti maangi. Daraasal is dua mein wibhedeekran evn sankshepan donon baaten paai jaati hain. Pahle to kaha : "Ai Allah! Main teri sharan mein aata hoon safed daag se" Yaani aisi safedi se jo insaan ke shareer mein prakat hoti hai aur uske nateeje mein log is vyakti se nafrat karne lagte hain aur aise mein woh logon se alag-thalag rahne lagta hai, jo kabhi-kabhi niraasha ka kaaran ban jaata hai. Ham in cheezon se Allah ki sharan mein aate hain.
"Tatha paagalpan se" Yaani aql se wanchit ho jaane se. Daraasal aql hi ke kaaran insaan par sharai ahkaam ki paabandi laazim hoti hai, usi ke sahaare woh apne paak prabhu ki ibaadat karta hai tatha usi se woh Allah ki srishtiyon aur uski waani par chintansheel rahta hai. Atah aql ke chale jaana insaan hi ka chale jaana hai.
"Tatha korh se" Yeh ek aisi beemaari hai, jisse shareer ke ang sar-galkar girne lagte hain. Ham isse Allah ki sharan mein aate hain.
"Tatha sabhi buri beemaariyon se." Isse muraad woh shaareerik apangtayen hain, jinke kaaran insaan logon ki nazar mein tuchchh evn samaaj mein ghrina ka paatr ban jaata hai, jaise laqva, drishtiheenta aur kensar aadi. Kyonki yeh aisi jatil beemaariyaan hain, jinka ilaaj kharcheela hota hai aur insaan ke dhairy ki pareeksha leta hai, jismen khara kewal wahi vyakti utar paata hai, jise Allah ne sabr diya ho aur uske dil ko mazbooti di ho. In baaton se Islam ki mahaanta spasht hoti hai, jo insaan ke shareer evn dharm donon ka khyaal rakhta hai.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6048: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se gire hue sona-chaandi ke baare mein poochha gaya to aapne farmayaah uske bandhan tatha thaili ko achchhi tarah pahchaan lo. Phir ek saal tak uska ailaan karo. Iske baad bhi yadi maaloom na ho to use kharch karo, lekin yeh tumhaare paas amaanat hogi. Yadi kisi bhi din use talaash karne waala a jaye to use uske hawaale kar do.

Zaid bin khaalid juhni kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se gire hue sona-chaandi ke baare mein poochha gaya to aapne farmayaah uske bandhan tatha thaili ko achchhi tarah pahchaan lo. Phir ek saal tak uska ailaan karo. Iske baad bhi yadi maaloom na ho to use kharch karo, lekin yeh tumhaare paas amaanat hogi. Yadi kisi bhi din use talaash karne waala a jaye to use uske hawaale kar do.
Aur aapse khoe hue oont ke baare mein poochha gaya to farmayaah tumhen usse kya matlab? Use jaane do. Uske paas joota bhi hai aur paani ka bartan bhi. Woh ghaat se paani peeta rahe aur peron ke patte khaata rahe, yahaan tak ki uska maalik use pa le.
Tatha aapse bakri ke baare mein poochha gaya to pharmayaah use le lo. Kyonki woh tumhaari hai athva tumhaare bhaai ki hai athva bheriye ki.

Ek vyakti ne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se khoe hue dhan jaise sona, chaandi, oont aur bakri ke baare mein poochha, to aapne use in wastuon ka hukm bata diya, taaki yeh cheezen in jaisi aur khoi hui wastuon ke liye udaahran ban saken aur inse aur cheezon ka hukm maaloom kiya ja sake.
Chunaanche aapne sona aur chaandi ke baare mein farmaya ki us thaili ko pahchaan lo, jismen use rakha gaya hai aur us bandhan ko pahchaan lo, jisse use baandha gaya hai. Taaki use tum apne dhan se alag kar sako aur jo uske baare mein daawa pesh kare, use uske sanbandh mein jaankaari de sako. Yadi woh uski wisheshtayen sahi-sahi bayaan kare, to theek hai, warna tum samajh jaaoge ki uska daawa sahi nahin hai.
Use is baat ka bhi aadesh diya ki use uthaane ke baad poore ek saal tak uska elaan karta rahe. Yeh elaan saarvajnik sthaanon jaise baazaaron, masjidon ke dvaaron, aam sabhaaon aur saamaan uthaane ke sthaan mein kiya jayega.
Yadi ek saal tak elaan karne ke baad bhi uske maalik ka pata na lage, to uthaane waala use kharch kar sakta hai. Lekin jab bhi uska maalik aye, use waapas karna hoga.
Jahaan tak khoe hue oont athva aise jaanavron ki baat hai, jo apni raksha kar sakte hain, to unhen pakarne se mana farmaya; kyonki unhen suraksha ki aawashyakta nahin hai. Svayn unke paas ni itni kshamta hai ki woh chhote jaanavron se apni raksha kar sakte hain. Woh qadmon se chalkar bari se bari doori tay kar sakte hain, apni gardan ke dvaara per ke patton aur paani tak pahunch bana sakte hain auk apne pet mein khaane ki wastuen jama kar sakte hain. Is tarah, woh us samay tak svayn apni suraksha kar sakte hain, jab tak unka maalik unhen na pa le, jo unki talaash mein lage hota hai.
Jahaan tak khoe hue chhote jaanavron jaise bakri aadi ki baat hai, to unhen nasht hone tatha darindon ke aakraman se bachaane ke liye unhen pakarne ka aadesh diya. Iske baad yadi uska maalik aata hai, to le jayega ya elaan ki avdhi ek saal guzar jaane ke baad woh pakarne waale ke ho jayenge.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6050: Bhay ki namaz ka tareeqa, jaisa ki jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai.

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath bhay ki namaz parhi to ham rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke peechhe is tarah do pankti mein khare ho gae ki shatru hamaare aur qible ke beech tha. Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne takbeer kahi aur hamne bhi takbeer kahi, aapne ruku kiya aur hamne bhi ruku kiya, aapne ruku se sir uthaya aur hamne bhi sir uthaya, aapne sajda kiya aur aapse nikat waali qataar ke logon ne sajda kiya, jabki pichhli qataar ke log shatru ke saamne khare rahe. Jab Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne sajda poora kar liya aur sajda karne waali qataar ke log khare ho gae to doosri pankti ke logon ne sajda kiya aur khare ho gae. Ab, pichhli qataar ke log aage a gae aur agli qataar ke log peechhe chale gae. Phir Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ruku kiya aur hamne bhi ruku kiya, aapne ruku se sar uthaya aur ham ne bhi sar uthaya. Phir aap aur aapse nikat waali pankti ke log, jo pahli rakaat mein peechhe the, sajde mein chale gae aur doosri pankti shatru ke saamne khari rahi. Jab Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur aapke peechhe waali pankti ne sajda poora kar liya to pichhli pankti ke logon ne sajda kiya. Phir aapne salaam phera aur ham sabne salaam phera. Jaabir kahte hainh jis prakaar tumhaare gaard sultaanon (haakimon) ke saath karte hain.
Bukhaari ne uska ek hissa bayaan kiya hai ki unhonne Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath saatven yuddh arthaat ghazva zaaturriqa mein bhay ki namaz parhi.

Is hadees mein bhay ki namaz ka jo tareeqa bayaan kiya gaya hai, woh us samay ke liye hai, jab shatru qible ki disha mein ho. Aapne sena ko do bhaagon mein wibhaajit kar diya. Ek bhaag agli saf mein khara hua, to doosra bhaag pichhli pankti mein. Phir donon ko namaz parhaana shuru kiya. Aapne sabko lekar takbeer kahi, sabne qiraat ki, sabne ruku kiya aur sab log ruku se khare hue. Uske baad aapne sajda kiya, to aapke saath aapke peechhe ki saf ne sajda kiya. Phir jab aap doosri rakaat ke liye khare hue, to doosri saf ne jo shatru par nazar rakhi hui thi, sajda kiya. Phir jab we khare hue, to nyay ke taqaaze ke anusaar pichhli saf aage a gai aur agli saf peechhe chali gai, taaki kewal agli saf ke logon ko hi poori namaz mein aage rahne ka saubhaagy praapt na ho. Uske baad aapne doosri rakaat mein wahi kuchh kiya, jo pahli rakaat mein kiya tha. Phir sab ke saath tashahhud mein baithe aur sab ke saath salaam phera.
Is hadees mein warnit bhay ki namaz ka yeh wistrit wivran us paristhiti ke anukool tha, jisse us samay Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur aapke sahaaba do chaar the. Dushman qible ki dish mein the aur unhen we qayaam aur ruku ki haalat mein dekh sakte the tatha peechhe se shatru ke aakraman ka bhi bhay nahin tha.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6057: Do aadmi ka khaana teen aadmi ke liye kaafi hai aur teen aadmi ka khaana chaar aadmi ke liye kaafi hai.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah do aadmi ka khaana, teen aadmi ke liye kaafi hai aur teen aadmi ka khaana chaar aadmi ke liye kaafi hai.
Tatha Muslim ki ek riwayat mein jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah ek aadmi ka khaana do aadmi ke liye kaafi hai, do aadmi ka khaana chaar aadmi ke liye kaafi hai aur chaar aadmi ka khaana aath aadmi ke liye kaafi hai.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6072: Ai Allah! Main aag (Jahannam) ke fitne, aag (Jahannam) ki yaatna aur maaldaari tatha nirdhanta ki buraai se teri sharan maangta hoon.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) in shabdon ke dvaara dua karte theh «اللهم إني أعوذ بك من فتنة النار، وعذاب النار، ومن شر الغنى والفقر» arthaat, ai Allah! Main aag (Jahannam) ke fitne, aag (Jahannam) ki yaatna aur maaldaari tatha nirdhanta ki buraai se teri sharan maangta hoon.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6073: Use na khareedo aur sadqa kiya hua saamaan waapas na lo, yaddhapi woh tumhen ek dirham hi mein kyon na de, kyonki hiba (hadiya, uphaar) kiye hue saamaan ko lautaane waala vyakti waisa hi hai, jaise ulti ko khaane waala.

Umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne ek vyakti ko Allah ke raaste mein ek ghora diya. Parantu, jiske paas woh tha, usne use nasht kar diya. Isliye mainne use khareedne ka nirnay le liya. Mujhe aisa laga ki woh mujhe saste daamon bech dega. Atah, mainne Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se poochha to aapne farmayaah use na khareedo aur sadqa kiya hua saamaan waapas na lo, yaddhapi woh tumhen ek dirham hi mein kyon na de, kyonki hiba (hadiya, uphaar) kiye hue saamaan ko lautaane waala vyakti waisa hi hai, jaise ulti ko khaane waala.

Umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne Allah ke raaste mein jihaad ke liye ek vyakti ki sahayta ki aur use yuddh karne ke liye ek ghora diya. Lekin us vyakti ne ghore ko sahi se khaane nahin diya aur uski sahi dekhbhaal bhi nahin ki. Saath hi usse uski shakti se adhik kaam bhi liya. Jiske kaaran woh kamzor tatha durbal ho gaya. Isliye umar (raziyallah anhu) ne use us vyakti se khareed lena chaaha. Unhen yeh bhi laga ki kamzor tatha durbal hone ke kaaran woh kam daam mein mil jayega. Lekin is baare mein woh santusht nahin the, isliye koi qadam uthaane se pahle Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko poochh lena zaroori samjha. Lekin Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen us ghore ko khareedne se mana kar diya, yadyapi kaam daam hi mein kyon na mile. Aapne samjhaya ki jo wastu Allah ke liye nikal chuki hai, usse dil mat atka ke rakho aur uske peechhe mat paro. Doosri baat yeh hai ki ho sakta hai ki woh muravvat ke kaaran kuchh kam daam mein de de. Is tarah tum apne sadqe ke kuchh bhaag ko lautaane waala qaraar pa jaaoge, jo ki mana hai. Ek baat yeh bhi hai ki woh tumhaare paas se nikal chuka hai tatha tumhaare gunaahon ko mitaane aur tumhaari naapaakiyon aur apvitrataaon ko nikaalne ka kaaran bana hai, isliye uska tumhaare paas waapas aana uchit nahin hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki use uchit daam dekar khareedne ko bhi 'daan ki hui wastu ko waapas lene' ka naam diya gaya hai. Isi tarah use ulti karke use dobaara khaane ke samaan bataya gaya hai. Yeh daraasal, is kaam ki buraai bataane aur isse nafrat dilaane ke liye hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6074: Hiba kiye hue saamaan ko lautaane waala waisa hi hai, jaise ulti ko khaane waala.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah hiba kiye hue saamaan ko lautaane waala waisa hi hai, jaise apni hi ulti ko khaane waala.
Aur ek riwayat mein haih jo apne daan kiye hue saamaan ko waapas leta hai, woh us kutte ki tarah hai, jo ulti karta hai aur phir use kha leta hai.

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne is hadees mein daan ki hui wastu ko waapas lene se nafrat dilaane ke liye ek aisa udaahran diya hai, jisse har insaan ko ghin ayegi. Aapne bataya ki daan ki hui wastu ko waapas lene waala vyakti us kutte ke samaan hai, to ulti kare aur use dobaara kha le. Yeh udaahran yeh batlaane ke liye kaafi hai ki yeh atyant ghrinit kaary hai aur ise karne waala vyakti ek ghatiya insaan hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6075: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne beemaari ki awastha mein ghar mein namaz parhi.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne beemaari ki awastha mein ghar mein namaz parhi. Aap baithkar namaz parha rahe the aur log aapke peechhe khare hokar namaz parh rahe the. Isi beech unhen ishaara kiya ki baith jaao. Jab namaz parh chuke to farmayaah imaam isliye banaya gaya hai taaki uski pairvi ki jaye. Atah, jab woh ruku kare to tum bhi ruku karo aur jab sar uthaye to sar uthaao aur jab 'سمع الله لمن حمده' kahe to kahoh 'ربنا لك الحمد' kaho tatha jab woh baithkar namaz parhe to tum log bhi baithkar namaz parho.

Is hadees mein hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) beemaar hone ke kaaran baithkar namaz parhi. Saath hi ismen yeh bhi bataya gaya hai ki muqatdiyon ko imaam ka anusran tatha uske peechhe-peechhe har kaam karna chahiye.
Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne imaam ki niyukti ke uddeshy se muqatdiyon ko avgat karaya. Uddeshy yeh hai ki muqatdi uska anusran kare aur uske peechhe-peechhe namaz ke saare kaary karta jaye. Namaz ke kisi bhi kaary se usse bhinnata na dikhaye aur vyawasthit roop se uske saare kriya-kalaapon ka anukran kare. Aapne farmaya ki jab imaam neeyat baandhne ke liye takbeer kahe to tum log takbeer kaho, jab woh ruku kare to tum uske baad ruku karo, jab woh "سمع الله لمن حمده" Kahkar tumhen yeh yaad dilaye ki Allah uski prashansa karne waale ki dua qabool karta hai, to "ربنا لك الحمد" Ke maadhyam se uski prashansa karo, jab woh sajda kare to uska anukran karte hue sajda karo aur jab woh khare hone mein aksham hone ke kaaran baithkar namaz parhe to (poornatyah uske anusran ke maddenzar) tum bhi baithkar namaz parho, yadyapi tumhaare paas khare hokar namaz parhne ki shakti ho. Kyonki aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne spasht kar diya hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) beemaari ke kaaran baithkar namaz parh rahe the. Lekin sahaaba yeh samajh rahe ki choonki we khare hokar namaz parhne ki kshamta rakhte hain, isliye unhen khare hokar namaz parhna hai. Isliye we aapke peechhe khare hokar namaz parhne lage, to aapne unhen baithkar namaz parhne ka ishaara kiya.
Phir jab namaz khatm hui, to logon ko yeh nirdesh diya ki imaam se bhinnata nahin balki samroopta dikhaani chahiye, taaki poore taur par uska anusran ho sake. Yahi kaaran hai ki yadi imaam khare hone mein aksham hone ke kaaran baithkar namaz parhe, to muqatdi bhi baithkar namaz parhen. Lekin yeh us samay hai, jab imaam shuru se baithkar namaz parhe. Parantu yadi nirdhaarit imaam khare hokar namaz shuru kare aur uske baad koi pareshaani a jaye aur woh baith jaye, to log aniwaary roop se uske peechhe khare hokar hi namaz parhenge. Iska pramaan woh hadees hai, jismen hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apni antim beemaari mein abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) tatha aam logon ko baithkar namaz parhaai thi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6076: Kya main tum donon ko usse behtar cheez na bataaoon, jo tumne maanga hai? Jab tum apne bistar mein jaao (athva sone ka sthaan grahan karo) to taintees baar 'subhaanallah' kaho, taintees baar 'al-hamdu lillah' kaho aur chauntees baar 'Allahu akbar' kaho. Yeh tum donon ke liye sewak se behtar hai.

Ali radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Faatima razyallahu anha Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas chakki peesne ke kaaran haath mein pare hue chhaalon ko dikhaane ke liye aaeen. Daraasal unhen soochna mili thi ki aapke paas kuchh gulaam aye hue hain. Aapse mulaaqaat nahin ho saki, to aaisha raziyallahu anha ke saamne apni baat rakh gaeen. Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aye, to aaisha radiyallahu anha ne iska zikr aapke samaane kar diya. Ali radiyallahu anhu aage kahte hain : Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam hamaare paas aye. Us samay ham donon bistar par ja chuke the. Aapko dekh ham khare hone lage, to farmaya : "Donon apni-apni jagah raho." Phir aap aag barhe aur ham donon ke beech baith gae. Yahaan tak ki mainne aapke donon qadmon ki thandak apne pet mein mahsoos ki. Iske baad farmaya : "Kya main tum donon ko usse behtar cheez na bataaoon, jo tumne maanga hai? Jab tum apne bistar mein jaao (athva sone ka sthaan grahan karo) to taintees baar 'subhaanallah' kaho, taintees baar 'al-hamdu lillah' kaho aur chauntees baar 'Allahu akbar' kaho. Yeh tum donon ke liye sewak se behtar hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki beti faatima radiyallahu anha ne apne pita ke saamne chakki peesne ke kaaran apne haath mein pare hue chhaale ki shikayat ki aur phir jab Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas kuchh qaidi aye, to unmen se ek qaidi maangne ke liye aapke yahaan pahuncheen, taaki ghar ke kaam-kaaj mein kuchh aasaani ho. Lekin choonki aap ghar mein nahin the, isliye jo kahna tha, aaisha radiyallahu anha se kahkar waapas ho gaeen. Aap ghar aye, to aaisha radiyallahu anha ne bataya ki faatima radiyallahu anha ek sewak ka anurodh karne ke liye aai theen. Yeh sun Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam faatima aur ali radiyallahu anhuma ke ghar pahunch gae. Us samay donon bistar mein the aur sone ki taiyaari kar rahe the. Chunaanche aap donon ke beech is tarah baith gae ki ali radiyallahu anhu ne aapke qadmon ki thandak apne pet mein mahsoos ki. Baith jaane ke baad aapne poochha : Tum donon ne mujhse sewak ka jo aagrah kiya hai, kya main tum donon ko usse behtar cheez na bata doon? Donon ne uttar diya : Awashy batayen. Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Jab tum donon raat mein sone ke liye bistar par jaao, to 34 baar Allahu akbar kaho, 33 baar subhaan Allah kaho, 33 baar al-hamdu lillah kaho; yeh zikr tum donon ke liye sewak se behtar hai.

Is zikr ko paabandi se parhna musathab hai. Kyonki is baat ka ullekh maujood hai ki ali radiyallahu anhu ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki is waseeyat ko kabhi nahin chhora. Siffeen yuddh ki raat bhi nahin.
Is zikr ko sote samay hi parha jayega. Kyonki saheeh Muslim ki ek riwayat ke shabd hain : "Jab tum raat ko bistar par chale jaao."
Jab koi musalmaan is zikr ko raat ke pahle bhaag mein bolna bhool jaye aur raat ke antim bhaag mein yaad aye, to us samay kah lene mein koi harj nahin hai. Kyonki is hadees ke warnankarta ali radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki woh siffeen yuddh ki raat ise kahna bhool gae, to yaad aane par unhonne subah se pahle kah liya.
Muhallab kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki jis  prakaar ek insaan khud apne jeewan mein aakhirat ko duniya par praathmikta dene ke maarg par chalta hai, usi prakaar use apne ghar ke logon ko bhi iske liye protsaahit karna chahiye, agar unke andar iski shakti ho.
Ibn-e-hajar asaqlaani kahte hain : Is zikr ki paabandi kar lene ke baad insaan ke liye adhik kaam karna mushkil nahin rah jaata aur use iska nuqsaan bhi nahin hota. Thakaawat ho tab bhi.
Aini kahte hain : Is zikr ki paabandi ke sewak se behtar hone ka ek paksh yeh ho sakta hai ki zikr ka sanbandh aakhirat se hai aur ghulaam ka sanbandh duniya se. Zaahir si baat hai ki aakhirat duniya se zyaada behtar aur baaqi rahne waali hai. Doosra pahlu yeh ho sakta hai ki in azkaar ke nateeje mein insaan ke andar kaam karne ki aisi shakti paida ho jaati hai ki woh sewak se bhi zyaada kaam kar sakta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
6077: Yadi woh meri god mein paravrish na bhi paai hoti, to bhi mere liye halaal na hoti. Isliye ki woh mere doodh-shareek bhaai ki beti hai. Mujhe aur abu salma ko suwaiba ne stanpaan karaya hai. Atah apni betiyon aur bahnon ko mujhpar pesh na karo.

Umme habeeba bint abu sufyaan (radiyallahu anhuma) kahti hain ki mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Aap meri bahan arthaat abu sufyaan ki beti se nikaah kar len. Aapne farmayaah kya tum ise pasand karti ho? Mainne kahaah haan. Aisa to hai nahin ki kewal main hi aapki patni hoon! Mujhe yeh achchha lagega ki bhalaai mein meri saajheedaar meri bahan rahe. Yeh sunkar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah yeh mere liye halaal nahin hai.' umme habeeba (radiyallahu anha) ne kahaah ham sun rahe hain ki aap abu salma ki beti se shaadi karna chaahte hain? Aapne farmayaah abu salma ki beti? Unhonne kahaah haan. Aapne farmayaah yadi woh meri god mein paravrish na bhi paai hoti to bhi mere liye halaal na hoti. Isliye ki woh mere doodh-shareek bhaai ki beti hai. Mujhe aur abu salma ko suwaiba ne stanpaan karaya hai. Atah apni betiyon aur bahnon ko mujhpar pesh na karo.
Urva kahte hainh suwaiba, jo abu lahab ki daasi theen, abu lahab ne unhen mukt kar diya aur unhonne Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko stanpaan karaya. Phir jab abu lahab mara to uske ghar ke kisi ne use svapn mein bahut bure haal mein dekha, atah usse poochha ki toone kya kuchh paya? Abu lahab ne uttar diyaah tum logon se juda hone ke baad mainne koi bhalaai nahin dekhi. Haan, bas suwaiba ko mukt karne ke kaaran mujhe kuchh jal peene ko diya gaya hai.

Umme habeeba bint abu sufyaan Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki patni theen tatha woh apne is saubhaagy se santusht aur khush theen. Yahi kaaran hai ki unhonne aapse aagrah kiya ki aap unki bahan se shaadi kar len. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko is baat par bara taajjub hua ki unhonne saukan laane ki anumti kaise de di, jabki striyaan is maamle mein bari svabhimaani hoti hain? Yahi kaaran hai ki aapne aashchary prakat karte hue unse poochha ki kya tumhen yeh pasand hai? Unhonne uttar diya ki haan, mujhe yeh pasand hai. Phir apni bahan se shaadi ki anumti dene ke kaaran ki vyaakhya karte hue kaha ki waise bhi woh akeli aapke wiwaah mein nahin hain, balki aapki aur bhi patniyaan hain, atah is saubhaagy mein unki bahan bhi kyon na shareek ho jaye?
Lekin unhen yeh pata nahin tha ki ek saath do bahnon ko wiwaah mein nahin rakha ja sakta. Isliye aapne unhen bata diya ki unki bahan unke liye halaal nahin hai.
Ispar umme habeeba (radiyallahu anha) ne kahaah unhen pata chala hai ki aap abu salma ki beti se shaadi karne waale hain. Yeh sun, aapne spashtikran ke andaaz mein poochha ki kya tum abu salma ki beti hi ke baare mein kah rahi ho? Unhonne kahaah haan! To aapne is afvaah ko ghalat bataate hue farmayaah umme salma ki beti aapke liye do kaarnon se halaal nahin hainh
Ek yeh ki woh meri patni ki beti aur mere hi yahaan uska laalan-paalan hua hai.
Doosra yeh ki woh mere doodh ke rishte ke bhaai ki beti hai. Mujhe aur uske pita abu salma ko abu lahab ki mukt ki hui daasi suwaiba ne doodh pilaya tha. Is tarah main uska chacha bhi hoon. Atah, tum apni betiyon aur bahnon se nikaah ki baat mujhse na karo. Main tumse adhik jaanta hoon ki is tarah ke maamlon mein mujhe kya karna chahiye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6078: Kuchh logon ko kya ho gaya hai ki woh is prakaar ki baat karne lage hain. Main to namaz bhi parhta hoon aur sota bhi hoon. Kabhi roza rakhta hoon, kabhi nahin bhi rakhta. Aurton se shaadi bhi karta hoon. Jisne meri sunnat se munh mora, uska mujhse koi sanbandh nahin hai.

Anas -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke sahaaba mein se kuchh logon ne aapki patniyon se ekaant mein aapke dvaara kiye jaane waale kaaryon ke baare mein poochha aur uske baad unmen se kisi ne kaha ki main aurton se shaadi nahin karoonga, kisi ne kaha ki main maans nahin khaaoonga aur kisi ne kaha ki main bastar par nahin sooonga. (Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- tak jab yeh baat pahunchi) to aapne Allah ki prashansa ki aur uske baad farmaya : "Kuchh logon ko kya ho gaya hai ki woh is prakaar ki baat karne lage hain. Main to namaz bhi parhta hoon aur sota bhi hoon. Kabhi roza rakhta hoon, kabhi nahin bhi rakhta. Aurton se shaadi bhi karta hoon. Jisne meri sunnat se munh mora, uska mujhse koi sanbandh nahin hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke kuchh sahaaba aapki patniyon ke gharon tak aye. Unka uddeshy yeh jaanna tha ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ghar ke andar kis tarah ibaadat karte hain. Jab unko aapki ibaadat ke baare mein bataya gaya, to goya unhonne use kam samjha aur kahne lage : Kahaan Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aur kahaan ham? Aapke to agle evn pichhle saare gunaah maaf kar diye gae hain. Iske wipreet jise maaloom na ho ki use kshama kiya jayega ya nahin, use zyaada se zyaada ibaadat ki zaroorat hai, is ummeed mein ki kshama praapt ho jaye. Uske baad unmen se kisi ne kaha : Main shaadi nahin karoonga. Kisi ne kaha : Main maans nahin khaaoonga. Jabki kisi ne kaha : Main bistar par nahin sooonga. Iski soochna jab Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko mili, to aapne naaraazgi vyakt ki. Logonn ko sanbodhit kiya. Allah ki prashansa ki aur farmaya : Kuchh logon ko kya ho gaya hai ki is aur is prakaar ki baat kar rahe hain? Allah ki qasam, tumhaare beech Allah se sabse adhik darne waala aur uska sabse adhik bhay rakhne waala vyakti main hoon. Lekin iske baavjood main sota hoon, taaki poori chusti ke saath tahajjud ki namaz parh sakoon, roze ke bina rahta hoon, taaki roze ki shakti praapt kar sakoon aur aurton se shaadi bhi karta hoon. Atah jisne mere tareeqe se munh mora, kisi aur tareeqe ko sanpoorn jaana aur uspar amal kiya, woh mujhmen se nahin hai.

Sahaaba -radiyallahu anhum- achchhe kaamon se prem karte the tatha unki aur Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke anusran ki chaahat rakhte the.
Islaami shareeyat ki sahansheelta aur aasaani. Uski yeh khoobi uske Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke amal evn tareeqe se spasht hai.
Bhalaai tatha barkat Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aur aap ke tamaam haalaat ke anusran mein nihit hai.
Apne oopar shakti se adhik ibaadat ka bojh daalne ki manaahi aur is baat ka ullekh ki yeh bidaatiyon ka tareeqa hai.
Ibaadat ke prati atiwaadi rawaiya se uktaahat paida hoti hai, jisse ibaadat se wimukhta aati hai. Iske wipreet kewal farz ibaadton par bas kar lene aur nafal ibaadton se bachne se aalasy aata hai. Beech ka maarg hi behtar maarg hai.
Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki buzurgon ke haalaat, unke padchihnon par chalne ke liye, maaloom kiye ja sakte hain. Agar purushon se maaloom karna kathin ho, to mahilaaon se bhi pata kiye ja sakte hain.
Is hadees se shiksha dene, jnaan-wijnaan se sanbandhit tatha sharai masayal bayaan karne aur sharai jnaan mein daksh logon ke sandehon ko door karne ki shiksha milti hai.
Ibaadat, wishesh roop se farz evn nafal ibaadton ki paabandi ke saath santulit maarg par chalna chahiye, taaki doosron ko bhi unke adhikaar diye ja saken.
Yeh hadees nikaah ki fazeelat aur uske protsaahan ko ingit karti hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
6079: Jo bai-e-salam (ek prakaar ki khareed-bikri ki widhi wa pranaali) karna chaahe to woh jnaat naap aur jnaat wazan mein evn jnaat avdhi tak ke liye kare.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jis samay madeena aye, us samay madeene waale phalon mein ek, do aur teen saalon ke liye bai-e-salam (aisa sauda jismen qeemat pahle de di jaye aur saamaan baad mein liya jaye) karte the. Atah aapne farmayaah jo bai-e-salam karna chaahe, woh jnaat naap aur jnaat wazan mein evn jnaat avdhi tak ke liye kare.

Yeh bataane ki zaroorat nahin ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) makka se madeena hijrat karke aye the. Jab aap yahaan aye, to dekha ki madeene waale (jo ki anaaj aur phal ugaya karte the) baie-salaf karte hain. Baie-salaf yeh hai ki pahle aadmi qeemat de de aur saamaan jaise phal aadi ek, do ya teen saal ya phir isse kam athva adhik avdhi ke baad le. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unki is khareed-bikri ko sahi maana aur use jo saamaan insaan ke paas na ho use bechne ke dayre mein nahin rakha, jo ki dhokhe ka kaaran banta hai. Kyonki baie-salaf ka sanbandh nirdhaarit wastuon se na hokar zimmewaariyon se hota hai. Lekin aapne logon ke liye is khareed-bikri ke kuchh niyam bhi bayaan kar diye, taaki logon ko jhagron se bachaya ja sake, jo kabhi-kabhi iski lanbi avdhi ke kaaran bhi paida ho jaya karte hain. Aapne farmayaah jo baie-salaf kare, woh wastu ki maap aur wazan nirdhaarit kar le aur avdhi bhi tay kar de. Taaki parimaan aur samay nirdhaarit ho jaane ke baad kisi jhagre ki gunjaaish baaqi na rahe aur khareedne aur bechne waale donon ke adhikaar surakshit rahen.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6080: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne kisi ko jeewan bhar ke liye di gai wastu ke baare mein nirnay diya ki woh usi ki hai, jise di gai hai.

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne kisi ko jeewan bhar ke liye di gai wastu ke baare mein nirnay diya ki woh usi ki hai, jise di gai hai.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih jise koi wastu uske jeewan bhar tatha uske uttaraadhikaariyon ke liye di gai to woh usi ki hai, jise woh di gai hai. Woh dene waale ki or nahin lautegi, kyonki usne aisi wastu di hai, jismen wiraasat siddh ho gai hai.
Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne jeewan bhar ke liye diye gae usi daan ko jayaz qaraar diya hai, jismen dene waala kahe ki yeh tere tatha tere uttaraadhikaariyon ke liye hai. Lekin, yadi yeh kahe ki yeh tere liye tere jeewan bhar tak hai to woh (uske mrityu pashchaat) dene waale ki or laut jayega.
Tatha Muslim ke shabd hainh apne dhan ko roke rakho aur use barbaad na karo, kyonki jisne jeewan bhar ke liye koi daan diya to woh uska hai, jise jeewan bhar ke liye diya gaya hai, uske jeewan mein bhi aur marne ke baad bhi tatha uske uttaraadhikaariyon ka hai.

Umrah' aur isi tarah 'ruqba' do tarah ke daan hain, jo log jaahiliyat ke zamaane mein kiya karte the. Us samay ek vyakti doosre vyakti ko ghar aadi yeh kahte hue dete the ki mainne tujhe yeh ghar jeewan bhar ke liye diya, athva mainne tujh yeh ghar tumhaare jeewan bhar athva mere jeewan bhar ke liye diya. Is tarah ka daan karne ke baad log daan praapt karne waale vyakti ki mrityu ki prateeksha mein rahte the, taaki daan ki hui wastu ko waapas le saken. Aise mein, shareeyat ne daan ko to baraqraar rakha, lekin aam taur par lagaai jaane waali shart arthaat waapas lene ko khaarij kar diya. Kyonki daan ki hui wastu ko waapas lene waala vyakti us kutte ke samaan hai, jo ulti karke dobaara use kha le. Yahi kaaran hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne jeewan bhar ke liye di hui wastu ke baare mein yeh nirnay diya ki woh wastu usi ki hai, jise daan ki gai hai aur uske baad uske uttaraadhikaariyon ki hai.
Tatha aapne logon ko apne dhan ki suraksha karne ka aadesh dete hue farmayaah "Apne dhan ko roke rakho aur use barbaad na karo, kyonki jisne jeewan bhar ke liye koi daan diya, to woh uska hai, jise jeewan bhar ke liye diya gaya hai, uske jeewan mein bhi aur marne ke baad bhi tatha uske uttaraadhikaariyon ka hai."
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6081: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne har us wastu mein shufaaa़ (saanjhe ki sanpatti mein ek saajheedaar ke apna hissa bech dene ki sthiti mein doosre saajheedaar athva saajheedaaron ke liye khareedne waale ko uski qeemat dekar use praapt karne ka adhikaar) rakha hai (tatha ek riwayat ke anusaar shufaaa़ ka nirnay diya hai), jo baanti na gai ho. Parantu jab seemayen sthaapit ho jayen aur raaste nikaal diye jayen to shufaaa़ nahin hai.

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne har us wastu mein shufaaa़ (saajhe ki sanpatti mein ek saajheedaar ke apna hissa bech dene ki sthiti mein doosre saajheedaar athva saajheedaaron ke liye khareedne waale ko uski qeemat dekar use praapt karne ka adhikaar) rakha hai (tatha ek riwayat ke anusaar shufaaa़ ka nirnay diya hai), jo baanti na gai ho. Parantu jab seemayen sthaapit ho jayen aur raaste nikaal diye jayen to shufaaa़ nahin hai.

Yeh buddhimattaapoorn shareeyat aai hi isliye hai ki saty aur nyay ka bolbaala ho tatha buraai evn atyaachaar ka khaatma ho. Yahi kaaran hai ki choonki jaydaadon mein saajhedaari ke kai nuqsaan saamne aate hain tatha uska jhamela lanbe samay tak baraqraar rahta hai aur bantvaara kar lena bhi kuchh aasaan nahin hota, isliye shareeyat ne saajhedaar ko shufa ka haq diya hai.
Yaani jab kisi saajhe ki sanpatti ka ek saajhedaar apna hissa bech de, to doosre saajhedaar ko use uski wahi qeemat dekar khareedaar se lene ka adhikaar hai, taaki saajhedaari ki sanbhaawit kshati se bacha ja sake.
Lekin saajhedaar ko yeh adhikaar us samay tak praapt hoga, jab tak saajhe ki sanpatti ka bataawaara na ho jaye, seemayen na tay kar di gai hon aur raaste na nikaal diye gae hon.
Agar seemayen nirdhaarit kar di gai hon, donon bhaagon ko alag kar diya gaya ho aur raaste nikaal diye gae hon, to shufa ka adhikaar praapt na heen hoga. Kyonki ab saajhedaari ki us sanbhaawit kshati ka bhay nahin raha, jiske kaaran bechi hui santti ko khareedne waale se lekar saajhedaar ko dene ka hukm diya gaya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6082: Tum subah-shaam teen baar 'qul huwallahu ahad', 'qul aoozu bi-rabbil falaq' aur 'qul aoozu bi-rabbinnaas' parh liya karo. Yeh teen soorten tumhaare liye har cheez se kaafi hongi.

Abdullah bin khubaib radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ham ek baarish waali tatha andheri raat mein Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko namaz parhaane ke liye dhoondhne nikle. Unka kahna hai ki hamne jab aapko paya to aapne kaha : "Tum kaho." Lekin mainne kuchh nahin kaha, to aapne dobaara kaha : "Tum kaho." Mainne phir bhi kuchh nahin kaha, to aapne teesri baar kaha : "Tum kaho." Is baar mainne poochha ki main kya kahoon? Aapne uttar diya : "Tum subah-shaam teen baar 'qul huwallahu ahad', 'qul aoozu bi-rabbil falaq' aur 'qul aoozu bi-rabbinnaas' parh liya karo. Yeh teen soorten tumhaare liye har cheez se kaafi hongi."

Warishth sahaabi abdullah bin khubaib radiyallahu anhu bata rahe hain ki we ek tez baarish waali aur andheri raat mein Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko dhoondhne nikle. Taaki aap unko namaz parhayen. Jab aapko dekha, to aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne abdullah se farmaya : Tum parho. Jab unhonne kuchh nahin parha, to dobaara parhne ko kaha. Is baar abdullah ne poochh liya : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Main kya parhoon? Jawaab mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Tum shaam evn subah ke samay soora ikhlaas yaani {قل هو الله أحد} aur sharan maangne par aadhaarit donon soorten soora al-falaq {قل أعوذ برب الفلق} tatha soora an-naas {قل أعوذ برب الناس} teen-teen baar parho, yeh teenon soorten tumhen har buraai se bachayengi.

Subah tatha shaam ke samay soora ikhlaas, soora falaq tatha soora naas parhna musathab hai. Yeh soorten insaan ko har buraai se surakshit rakhti hain.
Soora ikhlaas, soora falaq evn soora naas parhne ka mahatv.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi aur nasai ne riwayat kiya hai]
6083: Ham ansaar mein sabse adhik kheti waale the tatha ham zameen is shart par kiraye par dete the ki uske is bhaag ki paidaawaar hamaari hai aur us bhaag ki paidaawaar kiraye par lene waale ki.Lekin kabhi yeh bhaag to paidaawaar deti, parantu woh bhaag paidaawaar nahin deti thi. Atah, aapne hamen isse mana kar diya. Rahi baat chaandi ke badle kiraye par dene ki, to aapne hamen isse mana nahin kiya hai.

Raafe bin khadeej (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ham ansaar mein sabse adhik kheti waale the tatha ham zameen is shart par kiraye par dete the ki uske is bhaag ki paidaawaar hamaari hai aur us bhaag ki paidaawaar kiraye par lene waale ki. Lekin kabhi yeh bhaag to paidaawaar deti, parantu woh bhaag paidaawaar nahin deti thi. Atah, aapne hamen isse mana kar diya. Rahi baat chaandi ke badle kiraye par dene ki to aapne hamen isse mana nahin kiya hai.

Is hadees mein is baat ka wivran hai ki zameen ko kaise bataai par dena sahi hai aur kaise nahin. Raafe bin khadeej (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki unke ghar waalon ke paas madeene mein sabse adhik khet aur baagh the aur we jaahiliyat ke daur mein prachlit tareeqe se khet bataai par dete the. We yeh tay karke khet dete the ki we khet ke ek bhaag ki paidaawaar lenge aur kiraye par lene waala doosre bhaag ki. Lekin kabhi-kabhi ek bhaag ki paidaawaar theek-thaak hoti, parantu doosre bhaag ki nahin.
Atah, Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen is tarah maamla tay karne se mana kar diya. Kyonki ismen dhokha aur anishchitta hai. Jabki ewaz ka jnaan hona zaroori hone ke saath-saath donon ka laabh tatha haani mein baraabar ka bhaageedaar hona bhi aawashyak hai. Chunaanche agar ewaz zameen ki paidaawaar to woh arbi mein 'muzaaraat' ya 'musaaqaat' (bataai) kahlaata hai, jiska aadhaar nafa-nuqsaan mein nyay aur baraabri hona chahiye. Yaani donon mein se har ek ko paidaawaar ka ek nishchit bhaag milna chahiye, jaise ek chauthaai ya aadha aadi.
Aur agar ewaz naqad ho, to ise arbi mein 'ijaara' (kiraye par dena athva theke par dena) kahte hain aur ismen ewaz ka nishchit hona zaroori hai. Shareeyat ne ise jayaz qaraar diya hai, chaahe sone ke badle mein ho ya chaandi ke badle mein. Isi tarah 'muzaaraat' yaani bataai ko bhi jayaz qaraar diya hai. Kyonki hadees mein haih "أما شيء معلوم مضمون، فلا بأس به"
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6084: Ham azl (sanbhog ke dauraan weeryaskhalan se pahle ling ko baahar nikaal lena, taaki andar weeryaskhalan na ho) karte the, jabki Qur'an utar raha tha. Sufyaan kahte hain ki yadi yeh koi mana karne yogy kaam hota to Qur'an hamen isse rok deta.

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ham azl (sanbhog ke dauraan weeryaskhalan se pahle ling ko baahar nikaal lena, taaki andar weeryaskhalan na ho) karte the, jabki Qur'an utar raha tha. Sufyaan kahte hain ki yadi yeh koi mana karne yogy kaam hota to Qur'an hamen isse rok deta.

Jaabir bin abdullah (ziyallahu anhu) bata rahe hain ki we Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke yug mein apni patniyon tatha daasiyon ke saath azl karte the aur aapne ise sveekaaryata pradaan ki thi, haalaanki yadi woh jayaz na hota, to aap use sveekaaryata pradaan na karte.
Phir shayad unse kaha gaya ki sanbhav hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko tumhaare is kaary ka pata hi na chala ho?
To farmayaah agar aapko pata na chala ho, to Allah ko to pata tha. Woh Qur'an utarne ka samay tha. Aise mein agar azl karna mana hota, to Qur'an hi usse mana kar deta aur Allah hamen uski sveekaaryata pradaan na karta.
Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) ki yeh hadees is baat ka pramaan hai ki azl jayaz hai. Jabki kai any hadeeson se pata chalta hai ki jayaz nahin hai. Jaise saheeh Muslim me juzaama bint bahb ki hadees mein hai ki woh kuchh logon ke saath Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aaeen aur un logon ne aapse azl ke baare mein poochha, to aapne farmayaah "Yeh gupt hatya hai." Aise mein prashn uthta hai ki in hadeeson ki ek saath vyaakhya kaise ki jayegi? To uska uttar is prakaar haih
Asal mein yeh jayaz hai, jaisa ki jaabir aur abu saeed (radiyallahu anhuma) ki hadees se pata chalta hai. Albatta, juzaama (radiyallahu anha) ki hadees us sthiti ke liye hai, jab azl ka uddeshy santaan se bachna ho. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke kathan 'yeh gupt hatya hai' se bhi isi ka ishaara milta hai. Ya phir yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki azl haraam nahin balki makrooh ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6086: Koi stri mritak par teen dinon se adhik sog nahin manayegi. Haan, apne pati par chaar maheene das din sog manayegi. Woh asab naami yamni wastr chhorkar koi ranga hua kapra nahin pahnegi tatha surma evn khushbu nahin lagayegi. Haan, jab paak ho jaye to ku़st ya azfaar aadi khushbooen laga sakti hai.

Umme atiyya (radiyallahu anha) Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karti hain ki koi stri mritak par teen dinon se adhik sog nahin manayegi. Haan, apne pati par chaar maheene das din sog manayegi. Woh asb naami yamni wastr chhorkar koi ranga hua kapra nahin pahnegi tatha surma evn khushbu nahin lagayegi. Haan, jab paak ho jaye to ku़st ya azfaar aadi khushbooen laga sakti hai.

Is hadees mein Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne stri ko kisi bhi mrit vyakti par teen din se adhik sog manaane se mana kiya hai; isliye ki kisi rishtedaar ka haq ada karne tatha shok ke maahaul se nikalne ke liye teen din paryaapt hain. Lekin yadi mrit vyakti uska pati ho, to uske mahatvapoorn haq ko ada karne ke liye aur uski iddat ke dinon ko bachaye rakhne ke liye chaar maah das din tak sog manayegi.
Sog manaane ka arth yeh hai ki jis stri ke pati ka dehaant ho jaye, woh sugandh, surma, gahne aur sundar kapre aadi shringaar ki wastuon ko tyaag de aur inmen se kisi cheez ka prayog na kare. Lekin pati ke atirikt kisi aur mrit vyakti ka sog manaana aniwaary nahin hai. Haan, pati ke atirikt kisi aur ke liye yadi chaahe, to teen din sog mana sakti hai.
Jahaan tak sog manaane waali stri ke shringaar ke uddeshy ke bina rangeen kapra pahanne ki baat hai, to ismen koi baat nahin hai, chaahe kapra kisi bhi rang ka ho.
Isi tarah pawitr hone ke pashchaat apne guptaang mein koi bhi badbu door karne waali wastu thori-thori laga sakti hai, kyonki yeh shringaar ka sthaan nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6087: Sona sone ke badle na becho, magar baraabar-baraabar. Ek ko doosre se adhik na karo. Usi tarah, chaandi ko chaandi ke badle na becho, magar baraabar-baraabar. Ek ko doosre se adhik na karo. Tatha inmen se upasthit ko anupasthit ke badle na becho.

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah sona, sone ke badle na becho, magar baraabar-baraabar. Ek ko doosre se adhik na karo. Usi tarah, chaandi ko chaandi ke badle na becho, magar baraabar-baraabar. Ek ko doosre se adhik na karo. Tatha inmen se upasthit ko anupasthit ke badle na becho.
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih parantu, yeh ki haathon-haath ho.
Evn ek riwayat mein haih parantu yeh ki wazan baraabar ho aur donon ek samaan tatha baraabar hon.

Is hadees mein Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne sood ke donon prakaaron; donon mein se ek wastu ko adhik dene athva baad mein ada karne, se mana kiya hai.
Chunaanche aapne sone ko sone ke badle, chaahe donon dhale hue hon ya gair dhale hue, bechne ki anumti usi samay di hai, jab donon wazan mein baraabar mein hon aur jis majlis mein maamla tay hua hai, usi majlis mein donon par qabza ho jaye; kyonki yadi donon mein se ek upasthit ho aur doosra anupasthit to maamla jayaz nahin hoga.
Isi prakaar chaandi ko chaandi ke badle, woh dhala hua ho ya ghair dhala hua, usi samay bechna jayaz hai, jab wazan baraabar ho aur maamla tay hone ki baithak mein hi donon pakshon ka qabza ho jaye. Ismen kami-beshi jayaz nahin hai aur donon pakshon ki or se qabza hone se pahle alag hona bhi jayaz nahin hai.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6088: Widhva stri ki shaadi nahin ho sakti, jab tak usse mashvira na kar liya jaye tatha kunwaari stri ki shaadi nahin ho sakti, jab tak uski anumti na le li jaye. Sahaaba ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Uski anumti kaise li jaye? To farmayaah uski anumti yeh hai ki woh khaamosh rahe.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah widhva stri ki shaadi nahin ho sakti, jab tak usse mashvira na kar liya jaye tatha kunwaari stri ki shaadi nahin ho sakti, jab tak uski anumti na le li jaye. Sahaaba ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Uski anumti kaise li jaye? To farmayaah uski anumti yeh hai ki woh khaamosh rahe.

Nikaah ka anubandh bara hi mahatvapoorn anubandh hai. Uske maadhyam se pati stri ke us ang ko halaal karta hai, jiski raksha mein woh sabse adhik tatpar rahti hai aur isi anubandh ke kaaran stri apne pati ke maathat ho jaati hai. Yahi wajah hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne stri ko yeh adhikaar diya hai ki woh apne jeewan saathi ko chune aur apni aankhon se dekhkar uska chayan kare, kyonki wahi uske saath rahegi aur woh khud apni ruchiyon aur pasand-naapsand se adhik avgat hai.
Isi ke maddenzar Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is baat se mana kiya hai ki sayyiba stri (jiski ek baar shaadi ho chuki ho) ka wiwaah usse aadesh liye bina kar diya jaye.
Isi prakaar is baat se bhi mana kiya hai ki kunwaari larki ki shaadi uski anumti praapt kiye bina kar di jaye.
Choonki kunwaari larki sharmaati adhik hai, isliye uske maamle mein anumti lene ko paryaapt samjha gaya hai, balki uski khaamoshi ko bhi, uski sahamti ka pramaan maankar, kaafi samjha gaya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6089: Kya tum rifaaa ke paas lautkar jaana chaahti ho? Nahin, aisa us samay tak nahin ho sakta, jab tak tum uska shahad na chakh lo aur woh tumhaara shahad na chakh le.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) farmaati hain ki rifaaa qurzi ki patni Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aai aur kahne lageeh main rifaaa qurzi ke nikaah mein thi. Parantu usne mujhe teen talaaqen de di hain. Phir mainne abdurrahmaan bin zubair se shaadi kar li hai. Lekin uske paas kapre ke kinaaron par bune hue dhaagon ke guchchhe ke siwa kuchh nahin hai. Yeh sunkar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) muskuraye aur farmayaah kya tum rifaaa ke paas lautkar jaana chaahti ho? Nahin, aisa us samay tak nahin ho sakta, jab tak tum uska shahad na chakh lo aur woh tumhaara shahad na chakh le. Woh kahti hainh us samay aapke paas abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) baithe hue the aur khaalid bin saeed (radiyallahu anhu) dvaar par anumti ki prateeksha kar rahe the. Isliye, khaalid bin saeed ne aawaaz deeh ai abu bakr! Kya aap nahin sunte ki yeh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas kya-kya kahe ja rahi hai?

Rifaaa kurzi ki patni Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko apni aapbeeti sunaane aaeen aur kahne lageen ki woh rifaaa ke wiwaah mein theen, lekin unhonne unko teen talaaq de di. Uske baad unhonne abdurrahmaan bin zubair se shaadi kar li, lekin unka kahna tha ki woh unko chhu bhi nahin sake; kyonki unka jannendriy asmarth aur dheela-dhaala hai aur usmen karaapan aata hi nahin hai.
Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) unke bina laag-lapet ke baat karne aur jo baaten striyaan aam taur par karne mein sharmaati hain, unko khulkar bolne ki shaili par muskuraye aur samajh gae ki unka uddeshy apne pratham pati rifaaa ke paas waapas jaane ki anumti praapt karna hai. Kyonki woh samajh rahi theen ki kewal abdurrahmaan se nikaah kar lene se hi woh apne pahle pati ke liye halaal ho jayengi.
Lekin Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unke is khayaal ka khandan kiya aur unhen bata diya ki rifaaa ke paas waapas jaane ke liye zaroori hai ki baad waala pati unke saath sahvaas kare.
Us samay Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) upasthit the aur khaalid bin saeed (radiyallahu anhu) dvaar par andar aane ki anumti ki prateeksha kar rahe the. Itne mein khaalid (radiyallahu anhu) ne is stri se naaraaz hokar, jo Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saamne is tarah ki baat kar rahi thi, abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ko aawaaz di. Daraasal, khaalid (radiyallahu anhu) yeh kaary us sammaan aur pratishtha ka prateek tha, jo Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke prati unke dilon mein rachi-basi thi. Allah un tamaam logon se raazi ho aur unhen bhi prasann kare tatha hamen bhi Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka sammaan tatha anusran karne ki saamarthy pradaan kare.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6090: Kisi stri tatha uski phoophi ko wiwaah ke bandhan mein ek saath nahin rakha ja sakta aur na kisi stri tatha uski khaala ko.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hain ki aapne farmayaah kisi stri tatha uski phoophi ko wiwaah ke bandhan mein ek saath nahin rakha ja sakta aur na kisi stri tatha uski khaala ko.

Is pawitr shareeyat mein pratyek prakaar ki bhalaai nihit hai aur isne pratyek nuqsaan tatha bigaar se yuddh kiya hai. Yahi kaaran hai isne prem, mohabbat aur dosti ki prerna di hai tatha ek doosre se doori banaane, rishton-naaton ko kaatne tatha dvesh ki bhaavna rakhne se mana kiya hai.
Jab shareeyat ne, kuchh maslahton ke maddenzar jo kabhi-kabhi ek se adhik patni rakhne ka kaaran banti hain, bahuwiwaah ki anumti di aur aam taur par ek vyakti ke yahaan ek se adhik patniyon ka rahna shatruta aur dvesh ka kaaran banta hai, isliye kuchh nikat ke rishtedaaron ko ek saath jama karne se mana kar diya, taaki nikatvartiyon ke beech rishta kharaab hone ki naubat na aane paye.
Aapne ek bahan ke hote hue doosri bahan, bhateeji ke hote hue phoophi, khaala ke hote hue bhaanji aadi se nikaah karne se mana kiya hai, jinmen se ek ko yadi purush aur doosre ko stri maan liya jaye, to nasbi rishte ke kaaran nikaah sahi na ho.Daraasal, yeh hadees Allah taaala ke is farmaan ki vyaapakta ko seemit kar deti haih "وأحِلَّ لكم ما وَرَاءَ ذلِكم" (Inke atirikt any striyon ko tumhaare liye halaal kiya gaya hai.)
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6091: Jo stri Allah aur aakhirat ke din par eemaan rakhti hai, uske liye uchit nahin hai ki kisi mrit vyakti par teen din se adhik sog manaye, siwaye pati ke; uspar chaar maah das din sog mana sakti hai.

Zainab bint abu salma (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki umme habeeba (radiyallahu anha) ke ek qareebi rishtedaar ki mrityu ho gai to unhonne peele rang ki khushbu mangvaakar apne donon haathon par laga liya aur kahaah main aisa isliye kar rahi hoon, kyonki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue suna haih jo stri Allah aur aakhirat ke din par eemaan rakhti hai, uske liye uchit nahin hai ki kisi mrit vyakti par teen din se adhik sog manaye, siwaye pati ke; uspar chaar maah das din sog mana sakti hai.

Umme habeeba (radiyallahu anha) ke pita ki mrityu hui aur unhonne sun rakha tha ki pati ke siwa kisi ki maut par teen din se adhik sog manaana jayaz nahin hai, isliye unhonne iska paalan karke dikhaane ka iraada kiya. Chunaanche zardi mili hui khushbu mangvaakar haathon se mal liya aur iska kaaran yeh bataya ki unhonne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue suna haih jo stri Allah aur qayaamat ke din par eemaan rakhti ho, uske liye halaal nahin hai ki kisi mrit par teen din se adhik sog manaye, siway pati ke ki uspar chaar maah das din sog manayegi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6093: Jisne teen baar yeh dua parhi : Us Allah ke naam ke saath, jiske naam ke saath zameen wa aasmaan mein koi cheez nuqsaan nahin pahunchaati aur woh sab kuchh sunne waala sab kuchh jaanne waala hai. Uspar subah tak achaanak koi museebat nahin ayegi.

Abaan bin usmaan se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne usmaan bin affaan radiyallahu anhu ko kahte hue suna hai ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Jisne teen baar yeh dua parhi : Us Allah ke naam ke saath, jiske naam ke saath zameen wa aasmaan mein koi cheez nuqsaan nahin pahunchaati aur woh sab kuchh sunne waala sab kuchh jaanne waala hai. Uspar subah tak achaanak koi museebat nahin ayegi. Isi tarah jisne ise subah ke samay teen baar parh liya, uspar shaam hone tak achaanak koi museebat nahin  ayegi." Warnankarta ka kahna hai ki baad mein abaan bin usmaan par faalij ka hamla ho gaya, to unse yeh hadees sunne waala vyakti unki or dekhne laga. To abaan ne unse poochha : Baat kya hai ki tum meri or dekhe ja rahe ho? Allah ki qasam, na mainne usmaan ki or mansoob karke jhoothi baat kahi hai aur na usmaan ne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki or mansoob karke jhoothi baat kahi hai. Daraasal baat yeh hai ki jis din mujhpar faalij ka hamla hua, us din ghusse ka shikaar hokar is dua ko parhna bhool gaya tha.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki jisne har roz subah fajr hone ke baad aur har roz shaam ko sooraj doobne se pahle yeh dua parhi : Main us Allah ki madad leta aur har kashtadayak wastu se uski suraksha mein jaata hoon, jiska naam le lene ke baad koi bari se bari cheez, zameen se nikalne waali bala ho ki aasmaan se utarne waali museebat, nuqsaan nahin pahunchaati, woh hamaari baaton ko sunne waala aur hamaare haalaat ki khabar rakhne waala hai.

To yeh dua shaam ke samay parh lene ki sthiti mein use subah tak koi cheez achaanak nuqsaan nahin pahunchayegi aur subah ke samay parhne ki sthiti mein koi cheez shaam tak achaanak nuqsaan nahin pahuncha sakti.

Baad mein is hadees ke warnankarta abaan bin usmaan par faalij ka hamla ho gaya. Yaad rahe ki faalij ek beemaari hai, jisse shareer ka ek bhaag kaam karna band kar deta hai. Atah unse hadees sunne waala vyakti aashcharyachkit hokar unki or dekhne laga., to unhonne us vyakti se kaha : Baat kya hai ki tum meri or dekhe ja rahe ho? Allah ki qasam! Na mainne usmaan ki or mansoob karke jhoothi hadees sunaai hai aur na  usmaan ne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki or mansoob karke jhoothi hadees sunaai hai. Daraasal jis din mujhpar faalij ka hamla hua, us din main yeh dua parh nahin saka tha. Main us din ghusse ka shikaar ho gaya tha aur ukt dua ko parhna bhool gaya tha.

Is zikr ko subah-shaam parhna musathab hai. Taaki insaan ise parh lene ke baad  kisi bala evn museebat ke achaanak hamle se surakshit rahe.
Pahle daur ke salaf ka Allah par mazboot wishvaas aur Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki baaton ki pushti.
Subah wa shaam zikr karne ka ek fayda yeh hai ki insaan ki achetna door ho jaati hai aur hamesha zehan mein rahta hai ki woh Allah ka banda hai.
Zikr ka asar utna hi dikhta hai, jitna zikr karne waale ke andar Allah par eemaan, winaysheelta, talleenta, Allah ke prati nishtha evn wishvaas ho.
[ise abu daawood ne, tirmizi ne tatha nasai ne al-kubra mein isi prakaar ibn-e-maajah ne aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
6094: "Koi parosi apne parosi ko apni deewaar mein lakri gaarne se na roke." Phir abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) farmaateh kya baat hai kiे main tumhen is aadesh se munh pherte hue dekhta hoon? Allah ki qasam! Main is aadesh ko tumhaare beech aam karke rahoonga.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah koi parosi apne parosi ko apni deewaar mein lakri gaarne se na roke. Phir abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) farmaateh kya baat hai kiे main tumhen is aadesh se munh pherte hue dekhta hoon? Allah ki qasam! Main is aadesh ko tumhaare beech aam karke rahoonga.

Parosi par parosi ke kuchh adhikaar hain, jinhen ada karna aniwaary hai. Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne parosi ke saath achchhe vyavhaar ka aadesh diya aur farmaya ki jibreel aapko parosi ke baare mein lagaataar waseeyat karte rahe, yahaan tak ki aapko lagne laga ki parosi ka haq itna mahatvapoorn hai aur uske saath achchha vyavhaar itna zaroori hai ki jibreel ek parosi ko doosre parosi ka waaris bana denge. Parosiyon ke saath achchha bartaav, achchhe aachran aur parosiyon ke adhikaaron ka khayaal rakhna tatha unka ek-doosre ko apni bhaasha evn kaary dvaara kasht dene se bachna zaroori hai.
Parosi ke saath achchhe vyavhaar aur uske adhikaar ka khayaal rakhne ki ek soorat yeh hai ki we ek-doosre ke hiton ka dhyaan rakhen, jab tak khud unhen usse koi bara nuqsaan na ho. Udaahran ke taur par yadi koi parosi apne parosi ki deewaar mein lakri gaarna chaahe aur lakri gaarne waale ko iski zaroorat ho tatha deewaar waale ko isse koi nuqsaan bhi na ho, to deewaar waale ke liye zaroori hoga ki use yeh laabh uthaane ki anumti de, jisse uske parosi ki aawashyakta poori ho jayegi aur uska koi nuqsaan bhi nahin ho raha hai. Yadi woh anumti na de, to prashaasan use ispar baadhy karega.
Lekin yadi use kshati ho athva iski koi aawashyakta na ho, to kshati ko usi tarah ki kshati se door nahin kiya jayega. Isliye ki muslaaman ke haq mein asal yeh hai ki use koi nuqsaan na pahunchaya jaye. Atah, uspar anumti dena aniwaary na hoga.
Yahi kaaran hai ki jab abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ko Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki is mahatvapoorn hadees ka aashay samajh mein aya, to iska anupaalan na karne waalon par naaraaz hue aur unhen ispar majboor karne ki dhamki di; kyonki Allah ne parosi ke kuchh adhikaar diye hain, jinka dhyaan rakhna aur poora karna aniwaary hai.
Ulema is baat par ek mat hain ki parosi ki deewaar mein lakri lagaane se yadi use kshati ho, to uski anumti ke bina nahin laga sakte, isliye ki aapka farmaan haih "Na akaaran nuqsaan pahunchaana sahi hai aur na badle mein nuqsaan pahunchaana sahi hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6097: Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab 'سمع الله لمن حمده' (samiallahu liman hamidhu) kahte to hammen se koi apni peeth nahin jhukaata, yahaan tak ki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam sajde mein chale jaate, phir ham aapke baad hi sajde mein jaate the.

Abdullah bin yazeed khatmi kahte hain : Mujhse bara ne hadees bayaan ki -aur woh jhoothe nahin hain- unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab 'سمع الله لمن حمده' (samiallahu liman hamidhu) kahte to hammen se koi apni peeth nahin jhukaata, yahaan tak ki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam sajde mein chale jaate, phir ham aapke baad hi sajde mein jaate the.

Bara bin aazib radiyallahu anhu, jo ki sachche hain, bataate hain ki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab ruku se apna sar uthaate aur 'سمع الله لمن حمده' (samiallahu liman hamidhu) kahte, to aapke peechhe khare log khare hi rahte the aur koi bhi sajde ke liye apni peeth us waqt tak nahin jhukaata tha, jab tak ki aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apni peshaani zameen par na rakh dete. Aapke zameen par peshaani rakhne ke baad hi log sajde mein jaate the.

Sahaaba namaz mein Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka anusran is prakaar karte the ki we qiyaam se sajde mein tab tak nahin jaate the, jab tak ki aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam sajda na kar lete.
Allaama ibn -e- daqeeq al-eed kahte hain : Ismen Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke bharpoor itmeenaan ka pramaan hai.
Anusran ke lihaaz se imaam ke saath muqatdi ki chaar haalten hain : 1- aage barh jaana : Yaani kisi kaam ko apne imaam se pahle shuru kar dena, is taur par ki muqtadi imaam ke kisi rukn tak pahunchne se pahle hi wahaan pahunch jaye. Jaise : Imaam ke ruku karne se pahle ruku kar lena, ya imaam ke sajda karne se pahle sajda kar lena. Yeh haraam hai, aur yadi manaahi ka jnaan hone ke baavjood jaan-boojhkar aage barhta hai, to namaz baatil ho jayegi, chaahe ek rukn mein imaam se aage barh jaye ya kisi rukn tak pahunchne mein usse pahle pahunch jaye. Aur yadi yeh takbeer-e-ihraam mein ho, to uski namaz shuru hi nahin hogi aur uspar nae sire se namaz parhna waajib hoga. 2- saath-saath chalna : Yaani imaam ke saath-saath rahna, uske ruku ke saath ruku karna, uske sajde ke saath sajda karna aur uske uthne ke saath uthna. Iski nyoontam sthiti makrooh hone ki hai, aur pramaanon se spasht hai ki yeh bhi haraam hai. Yadi takbeer-e-ihraam mein imaam ke saath-saath takbeer kahta hai, to namaz shuru hi nahin hogi aur use dobaara parhna hoga. 3- anusran karna : Yaani namaz ke kaaryon ko apne imaam ke baad bina kisi deri ke karna. Yahi dharm-sammat aur sunnat ke anusaar hai. 4- peechhe rah jaana : Yaani apne imaam se itna peechhe rah jaana ki anusran ki seema se baahar ho jaye. Jaise imaam ruku kar le aur muqtadi tab tak khara rahe jab tak ki imaam ruku se uthne ke kareeb na ho jaye. Yeh dharm-sammat kaary ke wiruddh aur haraam hai, siway iske ki koi uchit kaaran ho, jaise beemaari ya burhaapa aadi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
6102: Hardam Allah ka bhay rakho aur har oonchaai par charhte samay 'Allahu akbar' kah liya karo.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki ek vyakti ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Main yaatra mein nikalna chaahta hoon, atah aap mujhe waseeyat karen. Aapne kahaah Allah ka bhay hardam rakho aur har oonchaai par charhte samay 'Allahu akbar' kah liya karo.Jab woh vyakti jaane laga to aapne farmayaah "Ai Allah! Uske liye doori ko samet de aur uski yaatra ko aasaan kar de.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6103: Bhookhe ko khaana khilaao, beemaar ki dekhbhaal karo aur qaidi ko riha karaao.

Abu moosa ashaari radiyallahu anhu Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se riwayat karte hain ki aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Bhookhe ko khaana khilaao, beemaar ki dekhbhaal karo aur qaidi ko riha karaao."
Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bayaan kiya hai ki ek musalmaan ka doosre musalmaan par ek adhikaar yeh hai ki woh bhookhe ko khaana khilaye, beemaar ki dekhbhaal kare aur qaidi ko riha karaye.

Musalmaanon ke beech aapsi sahyog ki prerna.
Bhookhe aur bhojan ke zarooratmand ko khaana khilaane ka protsaahan, kyonki use khilaane ka aadesh diya gaya hai.
Rogi ka haal jaanne jaana chahiye, taaki use hausla mile, uske liye dua ho aur puny praapt ho, aadi.
Kaafiron dvaara bandi banaye gae vyakti ko chhuraane ka poora prayaas karna, jo ya to unhen use chhuraane ke liye koi badla dekar kiya jaata hai, ya kaafiron ke kisi bandi se uski adla-badli karke.
6105: Hamaare aur ahle kitaab ke rozon mein antar, sahri khaana hai.
Amr bin aas (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah hamaare aur ahle kitaab (yahoodi aur eesaai) ke rozon mein antar sahri khaana hai.

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne hamaare aur yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon ke rozon ka ek spasht antar bataya hai. Yeh antar hai woh khaana, jo musalmaan sahri ke samay khaate hain. Kyonki ahl-e-kitaab sahri nahin karte aur musalmaanon ke liye ahl-e-kitaab ki mukhaalfat aur sunnat ke anupaalan mein sahri karna musathab hai. Ismen barkat evn bhalaai bhi hai, jaisa ki sunnat se saabit hai. Ahl-e-kitaab roze ka aaranbh aadhi raat se karte hain. We aadhi raat se pahle kha lete hain aur sahri ke samay kuchh nahin khaate. Jnaat ho ki musalmaanon evn kaafiron ke beech antar shareeyat mein ek waanchhit wastu hai.
6106: Aalim ko aabid ke muqaable mein wahi shreshthata praapt hai, jo mujhe tumhaare ek saadhaaran vyakti ke muqaable mein praapt hai.

Abu umaama baahili (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah aalim ko aabid ke muqaable mein wahi shreshthata praapt hai, jo mujhe tumhaare ek saadhaaran vyakti ke muqaable mein praapt hai. Phir Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah Allah, uske farishte, aakaashon aur dharti waale, yahaan tak ki cheentiyaan apne bilon mein aur machhliyon bhi un logon ke haq mein rahmat ki dua karte hain, jo logon ko bhalaai ki taaleem dete hain.
[hasan li-ghairihi (any sandon athva riwayton ke saath milkar hasan)]
6107: Allah taaala pharmaata haih pratishtha mera tahband aur abhimaan meri chaadar hai. Atah, jo un donon mein se koi bhi cheez mujhse kheenchega, main use yaatna mein daaloonga.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah pratishtha mera tahband aur abhimaan meri chaadar hai. Atah, jo un donon mein se koi bhi cheez mujhse kheenchega, main use yaatna mein daaloonga.

Pratishtha evn abhimaan do aise gun hain, jo Allah ke saath khaas hain aur in gunon mein uska koi saajhi evn shareek nahin hai. Bilkul waise hi, jaise insaan apni chaadar evn tahband jaise wastron mein kisi ko saajhi banaana gawaara nahin karta. Atah ye donon gun usi ke saath laazim hain aur ye Allah ki un wisheshtaaon mein se hain, jinmen uska koi saajhi nahin hai. Aise mein, jisne pratishtha evn abhimaan ka daawa kiya, usne Allah ki baadshaahat mein usse kheenchtaan ki. Aur jo Allah se kheenchtaan karega, use woh yaatna dega.
6108: Ek vyakti ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya hammen se koi apne bhaai athva apne dost se milte samay uske liye jhuk jaye? Farmayaah nahin. Usne kahaah kya use gale se laga le aur bosa de? Farmayaah nahin. Usne kahaah phir kya uska haath pakre aur usse musaafha kare? Farmayaah haan.

Anas (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki ek vyakti ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya hammen se koi apne bhaai athva apne dost se milte samay uske liye jhuk jaye? Farmayaah nahin. Usne kahaah kya use gale se laga le aur bosa de? Farmayaah nahin. Usne kahaah phir kya uska haath pakre aur usse musaafha kare? Farmayaah haan.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha gaya ki kya koi vyakti apne bhaai se mulaaqaat ke samay uske liye jhuk jaye? : Aapne uttar diya : Woh uske liye na jhuke. Poochhne waale ne phir poochha ki kya uske liye jhukne ki bajay use baanhon mein lekar gale se laga le? To aapne uttar diya : Nahin! Poochhne waale ne phir kaha : Kya usse musaafha kare? Farmaya : Haan!
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6112: Tum kahte raha karo : لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، الله أكبر كبيرًا، والحمد لله كثيرًا، وسبحان الله رب العالمين، ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله العزيز الحكيم" (Arthaat, Allah ke atirikt koi waastawik poojy nahin hai. Woh akela hai. Uska koi saajhi nahin hai. Allah sabse bara hai. Us Allah ke liye atyaadhik prashansa hai. Pawitr hai woh Allah, jo saare jahaanon ka rab hai. Paap se door rahne ki shakti evn neki ka saamarthy kewal usi shaktishaali evn hikmat waale Allah se praapt hoti hai.)

Saad radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ek dehaati, Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya aur bola : Mujhe koi aisi baat sikha deejiye, jo main kahta rahoon. Aapne farmaya : Tum kahte raha karo : لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، الله أكبر كبيرًا، والحمد لله كثيرًا، وسبحان الله رب العالمين، ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله العزيز الحكيم" (Arthaat, Allah ke atirikt koi waastawik poojy nahin hai. Woh akela hai. Uska koi saajhi nahin hai. Allah sabse bara hai. Us Allah ke liye atyaadhik prashansa hai. Pawitr hai woh Allah, jo saare jahaanon ka rab hai. Paap se door rahne ki shakti evn neki ka saamarthy kewal usi shaktishaali evn hikmat waale Allah se praapt hoti hai.) usne kaha : Yeh shabd to mere rab ke liye hain, mere liye kya hai? Aapne farmaya : Tum kaha karo : اللهم اغفر لي وارحمني واهدني وارزقني" (Arthaat, ai Allah! Mujhe kshama kar de, mujhpar daya kar, mujhe seedha raasta dikha aur mujhe rozi pradaan kar.)

Dehaat se aye hue ek vyakti ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se anurodh kiya ki use ek zikr sikha den, jise woh parha kare. Atah Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne usse kaha : Tum kaha karo : "لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له" Aaranbh ekeshvarvaad ki gawaahi se kiya. Iska arth yeh hai ki Allah ke atirikt koi sachcha poojy nahin hai. "الله أكبر كبيرًا" (Allahu akbar kabeera) yaani Allah saari cheezon se bara evn mahaan hai. "والحمد لله كثيرًا" (Wal-hamdu lillahi kaseera) yaani Allah ki atyadhik prashansa hai. Uske gunon evn kaaryon tatha anginat nemton par. "سبحان الله رب العالمين" (Subhaanallahi rabbil aalmeen) yaani Allah kamiyon se paak evn pawitr hai. "لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله العزيز الحكيم" (La haula wa la quvvata illa billahil aliyyil azeem) yaani ek awastha se doosri awastha mein jaana Allah, uske sahyog aur suyog ke bina sanbhav nahin hai. Us vyakti ne kaha : Ye shabd mere rab ke liye hain. Yaani uske zikr evn sammaan ke liye hain. Mujhe khud apne liye maangna ho, to kin shabdon dvaara maangoon? Chunaanche Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unse kaha : Tum kaho : "اللهم اغفر لي" (Allahummaghphirli) ai Allah! Mere gunaahon ko mitaakar tatha unpar parda daalkar mujhe kshama kar de. "وارحمني" (Warhamni) mere dhaarmik evn saansaarik hiton ki raksha karte hue, mujhpar daya karat. "واهدني" (Wahdini) mujhe uttam paristhitiyon ki raah dikha aur seedhe maarg par chala. "وارزقني" (Warzuqni) mujhe halaal dhan, svaasthy aur har bhalaai evn suraksha pradaan kar.

La ilaaha illallah, Allahu akbar, al-hamdu lillah aur subhaanallah dvaara Allah ka zikr karne ki prerna.
Dua karne se pahle Allah ka zikr aur prashansa karna musathab hai.
Musathab yeh hai ki insaan behatreen duaaon dvaara Allah se dua maange. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se warnit aisi saargarbhit duaaon ka chayan kare, jo apne andar duniya evn aakhirat ki bhalaaiyaan sameti hui hon. Insaan ko akhtiyaar hai ki woh jo dua chaahe, kare.
Bande ko aisi cheezen seekhne ki koshish karni chahiye, jo duniya evn aakhirat mein uske haq mein laabhkaari hon.
Kshama, daya evn aajeewika maangne ki prerna, kyonki inheen cheezon se bhalaai ke srot phootte hain.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki yeh koshish ki ummat ko aisi baaten sikhaai jayen, jo uske haq mein laabhkaari hon.
Daya ka zikr kshama ke baad isliye hua hai ki insaan poore taur par svachchh ho jaye. Kyonki "المغفرة" (Al-maghfirah) gunaahon par parda daal dene, unko mita dene aur Jahannam se bacha lene ka naam hai, jabki daya wibhinn prakaar ki bhalaai pradaan karne aur Jannat mein daakhil karne ka naam hai aur yahi sabse bari saphalta hai.
6113: Allah ke naam se, hamaari dharti ki mitti, hammen se kisi ke munh ke thook se milkar, hamaare rab ke aadesh se, hamaare mareez ke rogmukt hone ka zariya hogi.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki jab koi vyakti Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko apni beemaari ke baare mein bataata ya use koi phora athva zakhm hota, to aap apni ungli se is tarah karte (sufyaan bin uyaina jo ki is hadees ke warnankarta hain ne apni ungli ko zameen par rakhne ke baad uthaakar dikhaya) aur farmaateh "بِسمِ اللهِ، تُرْبَةُ أرْضِنَا، بِرِيقَةِ بَعْضِنَا، يُشْفَى بِهِ سَقِيمُنَا، بإذْنِ رَبِّنَا" Arthaat, Allah ke naam se, hamaari dharti ki mitti, hammen se kisi ke munh ke thook se milkar, hamaare rab ke aadesh se, hamaare rogi ke rogmukt hone ka zariya hogi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6141: Maaldaar vyakti ka karz ada karne mein taal-matol karna zulm hai aur agar tummen se kisi ko kisi maaldaar ke peechhe laga diya jaye to woh peechhe lag jaye.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah maaldaar vyakti ka karz ada karne mein taal-matol karna zulm hai aur agar tummen se kisi ko kisi maaldaar ke peechhe laga diya jaye to woh peechhe lag jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6144: Jis aadmi ne (apne pita ko jaante hue) yeh daawa kiya ki uska pita koi aur hai, woh kaafir ho gaya tatha jisne kisi aisi cheez ka daawa kiya jo uski nahin hai, woh hammen se nahin hai tatha woh apna thikaana Jahannam mein bana le aur jisne kisi vyakti ko kaafir kahkar pukaara ya Allah ka dushman kaha, haalaanki woh waisa nahin hai to uski yeh baat usi ki or laut ayegi.

Abu zarr (radiyallahu anhu) Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hain ki jis aadmi ne (apne pita ko jaante hue) yeh daawa kiya ki uska pita koi aur hai, woh kaafir ho gaya tatha jisne kisi aisi cheez ka daawa kiya jo uski nahin hai, woh hammen se nahin hai tatha woh apna thikaana Jahannam mein bana le aur jisne kisi vyakti ko kaafir kahkar pukaara ya Allah ka dushman kaha, haalaanki woh waisa nahin hai to uski yeh baat usi ki or laut ayegi.

Is hadees mein us vyakti ke liye bhayaanak chetaavni aur bari zordaar dhamki hai, jo nimnalikhit kaaryon mein se koi ek kaary kare. Aise mein us vyakti ke baare mein aap kya kahenge, jo teenon kaam karta ho?
Pahla : Koi apne pita ko jaanta ho aur uska nasab saabit ho, isse baavjood use pita na maane aur jaante hue anjaan ban jaye tatha kisi aur ko pita kahne lage ya apne kul ke atirikt kisi aur kul se apna sanbandh jore.
Doosra : Koi jaan-boojhkar kisi aise nasab, dhan, adhikaar, kaary ya jnaan ka daawa kare, jo uska ya uske paas na ho ya phir apne andar koi aisa gun hone ka jhootha daawa kare, jiske dvaara woh logon ke aakarshan ka kendr ban sake. Is vyakti ke liye bari bhayaanak yaatna hai. Kyonki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is prakaar ke vyakti se apna koi sanbandh na hone ki baat kahi hai aur usse kaha hai ki woh Jahannam ke andar apna thikaana grahan kar le, jiska woh haqdaar hai.
Teesra : Koi kisi nirdosh ko kaafir, yahoodi, eesaai ya Allah ka dushman kahe. Is tarah ke vyakti ki kahi hui baat usi ki or laut jaati hai. Kyonki woh khud hi in buri wisheshtaaon ka ek aise musalmaan ki tulna mein adhik haqdaar hai, jo bure kaamon se gaafil ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6145: Sunnat yeh hai ki jab aadmi patni rahte hue kisi kunwaari larki se wiwaah kare to uske paas saat din rahe aur uske baad baari lagaye tatha jab kisi raand stri se wiwaah kare to uske paas teen din rahe aur uske baad baari lagaye.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hainh sunnat yeh hai ki jab aadmi patni rahte hue kisi kunwaari larki se wiwaah kare to uske paas saat din rahe aur uske baad baari lagaye tatha jab kisi raand stri se wiwaah kare to uske paas teen din rahe aur uske baad baari lagaye.
Abu qilaaba kahte hainh yadi main chaahoon to kah sakta hoon ki anas (radiyallahu anhu) ne is hadees ko Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se nakal kiya hai.
