Sunnat yeh hai ki jab koi aadmi patni rahte hue kisi kunwaari se shaadi kare, to uske paas lagaataar saat din rahe, taaki woh use apne se nikat kar sake tatha nawavyaahta hone ke kaaran uske andar jo ghabraahat aur sharm hai, use door kar sake. Uske baad apni patniyon ke liye baraabar baari baante.
Lekin jab kisi ghairkunwaari se shaadi kare, to uske paas teen din rahe. Kyonki pahli ki tulna mein ise iski aawashyakta kam hoti hai.
Is hadees mein jo wiwekpoorn baat kahi gai hai, use Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke farmaan ka darja haasil hai, kyonki warnankarta jab kahen ki 'yeh kaam sunnat mein se hai', to unka aashay Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki sunnat hi hota hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki anas (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat karne waale abu qilaaba kahte hain ki 'agar main chaahoon, to kah doon ki anas (radiyallahu anhu) ne is hadees ko Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat kiya hai.' kyonki yeh hadees mere nikat 'sunnat mein se hai' ke shabd ke kaaran Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se warnit hai.
Widit ho ki 'marfu' hadees se aashay woh hadees hai, jo Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki or mansoob ho, jaise koi warnankarta kahe ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne is tarah ki baat kahi hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6159: Aazaad kiye hue ghulaam ki mrityu ke pashchaat, uska uttaraadhikaari na hone ki sthiti mein, uske uttaraadhikaari hone ka adhikaar use praapt hoga, jisne use aazaad kiya hai.

Aaisha bint abu bakr (radiyallahu anhuma) kahti hainh bareera (radiyallahu anha) ke kaaran Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki or se teen tareeke saamne ayeh
Jab woh aazaad ho gaeen to aapne unhen apne pati ke saath rahne ya na rahne ka akhtiyaar diya.
Unhen kaheen se maans bheja gaya. Maans ki handi choolhe par thi ki aap mere yahaan aye aur khaana maanga. Saamne roti aur ghar mein maujood saalan rakha gaya to farmayaah kya mainne choolhe par maans ki haandi nahin dekhi hai? Sabne kahaah haan, ai Allah ke Rasool! Lekin woh maans to bareera ko sadke mein mila hai. Iseeliye hamne use aapko khilaana gawaara nahin kiya. Ispar aapne farmayaah woh uske liye sadqa hai, lekin uski or se hamaare liye bhent hai.
Tatha Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unheen ke baare mein farmayaah aazaad kiye hue ghulaam ki mrityu ke pashchaat, uska uttaraadhikaari na hone ki sthiti mein, uska uttaraadhikaari hone ka adhikaar use praapt hoga, jisne use aazaad kiya hai.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) us barkat waale saude ko yaad karte hue, jo bareera (radiyallahu anha) ko unse qareeb laya tha, apni is mukt ki hui daasi ki kuchh barakton ko yaad karti hain. Kyonki Allah ne unse sanbandhit chaar aise mahatvapoorn aadesh diye hain, jo aam aadesh ke roop mein hamesha ke liye baaqi rah gae.
Pahla aadeshah woh apne daas pati mughees (radiyallahu anhu) ke wiwaah mein theen ki mukt ho gaeen, jiske baad unhen apne pahle pati ke nikaah mein rahne ya use chhorkar alag ho jaane ki anumti de di gai, kyonki ab woh aazaad theen aur unka pati ghulaam. Is tarah woh apne pati ke samkaksh nahin rah gai theen, jabki yahaan samkakshata ka etbaar hoga. Yahi kaaran hai ki woh nikaah radd karke unse alag ho gaeen aur any striyon ke liye ekaaadarsh ke roop mein saamne aaeen.
Doosra aadeshah woh aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ke ghar mein theen aur unko maans daan kiya gaya. Maans handi mein pak hi raha tha ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ke yahaan aye aur khaana maanga. Aapko roti aur ghar mein maujood saalan diya gaya aur bareera (radiyallahu anha) ko sadqe mein milne waala maans nahin diya gaya, kyonki sab ko pata tha ki aap sadqa nahin khaate. Lekin aapne kahaah kya mainne choolhe par maans ki handi nahin dekhi hai? Ghar ke logon ne kahaah haan, dekha to hai, lekin lekin woh bareera ko sadqe mein mila hai aur ham nahin chaahte ki aap use khayen. Ispar aapne kahaah woh use sadqe mein mila hai, lekin uski or se hamaare liye uphaar hai.
Teesra aadeshah unke maalikon ne jab unko aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se bechna chaaha, to yeh shart laga di ki 'wala' unko praapt hoga, taaki jab mukt hone ke baad woh apni nisbat unki or karen, to unhen gaurav ka anubhav ho tatha ho sakta hai ki unhen meeraas aur sahayta aadi bhautik laabh bhi milen. Aise mein Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah " 'Wala' uske liye hai, jisne aazaad kiya ho." Bechne waale ya kisi aur ke liye nahin.
'Wala' woh sanbandh hai, jo mukti praapt karne ke baad, kisi mukt daas aur uske mukt karne waale maalik ke beech mein ho. Chunaanche mukti praapt karne waala daas yadi mar jaye aur uska koi uttaraadhikaari na ho ya phir sabhi nirdhaarit bhaag waalon ke apna-apna bhaag le lene ke baad kuchh bach jaye, to woh use milega, jisne use aazaad kiya ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6160: Bachcha bistar waale ka hai aur vyabhichaari ke liye patthar hai.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki saad bin abu waqqaas aur abd bin zamaa (radiyallahu anhuma) ek baalak ko lekar jhagar pare. Saad (radiyallahu anhu) ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Yeh mere bhaai utba bin abu waqqaas ka beta hai. Usne mujhe bataya hai ki yeh uska beta hai . Jabki abd bin zamaa (radiyallahu anhu) ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Yeh mera bhaai hai. Mere pita ke bistar par aur uski daasi ke pet se paida hua hai. Atah, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne uski shakl wa soorat par nazar daali to dekha ki uski shakl wa soorat utba se spasht roop se milti-julti hai. Atah, farmayaah yeh tera bhaai hai, ai abd bin zamaa! Bachcha bistar waale ka hai aur vyabhichaari ke liye patthar hai. Tatha ai sauda! Tum usse parda kiya karo. Uske baad sauda (radiyallahu anha) ne unhen kabhi nahin dekha.

Jaahiliyat kaal mein log apni daasiyon par kuchh raashi nishchit kar dete the, jo we vyabhichaar se kamaakar diya karti theen aur log bachcha vyabhichaari ke hawaale kar dete, jab woh uska daawa karta. Chunaanche utba bin abu waqqaas ne zamaa bin asvad ki ek daasi se vyabhichaar kiya aur use ek bachcha paida hua. Phir utba ne apne bhaai saad (radiyallahu anhu) ko waseeyat ki ki is bachche ka nasab usse jor diya jaye. Jab makka wijay ka warsh aya aur aur saad (radiyallahu anhu) ne us bachche ko dekha, to uski shakl-soorat se pahchaan gae aur use apne bhaai se milaane ka iraada kar liya. Lekin is masle mein unka aur abd bin zamaa ka jhagra ho gaya. Saad (radiyallahu anhu) ne daleel di ki unke bhaai ne iqraar kiya hai ki yeh unka beta hai aur donon ki shakl-soorat milti-julti bhi hai. Jabki abd bin zamaa ne kaha ki woh mera bhaai hai aur mere pita ki daasi ke pet se paida hua hai. Aise mein Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne bachche ki or dekha, to uski shakl spasht roop se utba ki jaisi nazar aai. Lekin uska nirnay zamaa ke haq mein diya aur farmayaah bachcha bistar waale ka hai aur vyabhichaari ke liye naamuraadi aur ghaata hai. Woh larke se wanchit hoga. Kyonki niyam yeh hai ki bachcha daasi ke maalik ke maathat hoga, jisne waidh tareeqe se usse sanbhog kiya tha. Lekin choonki bachche ki shakl utba se milti-julti thi, isliye Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne use ukt nasab ke aadhaar par uski bahan sauda bint zamaa ko dekhne ki anumti dena gawaara nahin kiya aur ehtiyaat ke taur par unko usse parda karne ka aadesh diya. Isse pata chala ki bistar ke muqaable mein shakl wa soorat ki samaanta aur any sanketon ka koi mahatv nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6162: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamza (radiyallahu anhu) ki beti ke baare mein farmayaah woh mere liye halaal nahin hai. Stanpaan se bhi woh rishte haraam ho jaate hain, jo nasab (wansh) se haraam hote hain. Woh mere doodh shareek- bhaai ki beti hai.

Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamza (radiyallahu anhu) ki beti ke baare mein farmayaah woh mere liye halaal nahin hai. Stanpaan se bhi woh rishte haraam ho jaate hain, jo nasab (wansh) se haraam hote hain. Woh mere doodh- shareek bhaai ki beti hai.

Ali bin abu taalib (radiyallahu anhu) ne ichchha jataai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) unke tatha aapke chacha hamza (radiyallahu anhu) ki beti se shaadi kar len. Parantu, aapne unhen bataya ki woh aapke liye halaal nahin hai; kyonki woh aapke doodh shareek bhaai ki beti hai. Aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur aapke chacha hamza (radiyallahu anhu) ne abu lahab ki mukt ki hui daasi suwaiba ka doodh piya tha. Is tarah hamza (radiyallahu anhu) aapke doodh shareek bhaai hue aur unki putri aapki bhateeji hui. Kyonki doodh se bhi woh rishte haraam ho jaate hain, jo nasab se haraam hote hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6163: Mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe koi dua sikha deejiye. Aapne farmayaah kahoh اللهم إني أعوذ بك من شر سمعي، ومن شر بصري، ومن شر لساني، ومن شر قلبي، ومن شر مَنِيِّي" Arthaat, ai Allah! Main apne kaan, aankh, zubaan, dil aur weery ki buraai se teri sharan maangta hoon.

Shakl bin humaid (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe koi dua sikha deejiye. Aapne farmayaah kahoh اللهم إني أعوذ بك من شر سمعي، ومن شر بصري، ومن شر لساني، ومن شر قلبي، ومن شر مَنِيِّي" Arthaat, ai Allah! Main apne kaan, aankh, zubaan, dil aur weery ki buraai se teri sharan maangta hoon.

Is hadees mein hai ki shakl bin humaid -radiyallahu anhu- Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aye aur duniya evn aakhirat ki bhalaaiyon ke baare mein poochha. Unhonne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se na duniya maangi, na dhan maanga aur khaane ki cheez maangi, balki ek dua sikhaane ka niwedan kiya. Woh chaahte the ki aap unhen koi aisi dua sikha den, jisse woh apne dharm evn sansaar ka laabh arjit kar saken. Daraasal yahi haal tha Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saathiyon ka. We sada Allah ke anugrah tatha uski prasannata ki khoj mein rahte the. Unke niwedan par aapne unka maargadarshan is mahatvapoorn dua ki or kiya. Aapne unse kaha ki "Kaho : Ai Allah!" Yahaan Allah ko uske naam 'Allah' se pukaara gaya hai, jo uske saare sundar naamon ka saar evn sangrahit roop hai. "Main teer sharan mein aata hoon apne kaan ki buraai se", yahaan kaan ki buraai se muraad woh awaidh baaten hain, jo insaan ko sunni parti hain, jaise jhoothi gawaahi tatha kufr ki baat, kisi par lagaya jaane waala jhootha aakshep, dharm ki ninda aur is tarah ki any haraam baaten jo insaan ke kaan mein parti hain. "Tatha apni aankh ki buraai se", aankh ki buraai se muraad insaan ka apni aankh ko ashleel philmon aur gande drishyon ko dekhne mein istemaal karna hai. "Tatha apni zubaan ki buraai se", isse muraad munh se nikalne waali har awaidh baat, jaise jhoothi gawaahi, gaali-galauj, dhikkaar aur dharm tatha uska paalan karne waalon ki ninda evn vyarth baaten kahna ya kaam ki baat na bolna aadi hai. "Tatha apne dil mein buraai se", isse muraad yeh hai ki insaan apne dil ko Allah ki ibaadat ke atirikt kisi aur cheez se aabaad rakhe, hriday ki ibaadton jaise aasha, bhay, dar evn sammaan aadi ko Allah ke atirikt kisi aur ke liye kharch kare ya phir hriday ki ibaadton ko Allah ke liye kharch karne se gurez kare aadi. "Tatha apne weery ki buraai se", yaani apni sharmagaah ki buraai se. Sharmagaah ki buraai yeh hai ki woh haraam kaam mein lipt ho jaye aur vyabhichaar ki bhoomika ki haisiyat rakhne waale kaaryon, jaise dekhna, chhoona, chalna aur iraada karna aadi mein insaan ko daal de. Is shubh dua mein shaareerik angon ki suraksha maangi gai hai, jo daraasal bandon par Allah ki ek bahut bari nemat ki haisiyat rakhti hain. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unko in nemton ki buraai se Allah ki sharan maangne ka aadesh diya aur in nemton se sharan maangne aur yeh kahne ka aadesh nahin diya ki "Ai Allah, main apne kaan se tari sharan maangta hoon", kyonki shareer ke yeh saare ang Allah ki nemat hain aur inke zariye banda uchch evn mahaan Allah ki ibaadat bhi karta hai. Atah ye svayn buri cheezen nahin hain ki inse panaah sharan maangi jaye, balki inse utpann hone waali buraai se sharan maangne ki aawashyakta hai. Jnaat ho in angon ki suraksha ka tareeqa yeh hai ki inhen jin kaamon ke liye paida kiya gaya hai inse wahi kaam liya jaye, inse Allah ki awajna na ki jaye aur inke zariye koi buraai na phailaai jaye. Kyonki insaan se qayaamat ke din uske in angon ke baare mein poochha jayega. Jaisa ki uchch Allah ka farmaan hai : "Aur aisi baat ke peechhe na paro, jiska tumhen koi jnaan na ho, nishchay kaan tatha aankh aur dil, in sabke baare mein (qayaamat ke din) prashn kiya jayega" [soora al-isra : 36]

6178: Ek vyakti soora kahf parh raha tha aur uske nikat hi ek ghora rassiyon se bandha hua tha.

Bara bin aazib (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai, woh kahte hainh ek vyakti soora kahf parh raha tha aur uske nikat hi ek ghora rassiyon se bandha hua tha. 6179: Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam sab logon se zyaada daani the. Khaaskar Ramzan mein jab jibreel alaihissalaam se aapki mulaaqaat hoti to aur adhik daani ho jaate.

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam sab logon se zyaada daani the. Khaaskar Ramzan mein jab jibreel alaihissalaam se aapki mulaaqaat hoti to aur adhik daani ho jaate. Jibreel alaihissalaam Ramzan mein har raat aapse mulaaqaat karte aur aap ko Qur'an majeed ka daur farmaate. Aise mein, Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam sadqa karne mein aandhi se bhi zyaada drutgaami ho jaate the.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam duniya ke sabse daansheel insaan the aur aapki daansheelta Ramzan maheene mein aur zyaada barh jaati thi. Jisko jo diya jaana chahiye, is maah mein aap khoob dete the. Waise, iske do kaaran the :

1- Jibreel se aap ki mulaaqaat hote rahna.

2- Qur'an ka daur karna. Yaani use zabaani parhna.

Jibreel aapke saath Qur'an ke utre hue poore bhaag ko dohraya karte the aur is dauraan Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam logon ko dene, daan karne, neki ke kaam karne aur logon ka upkaar karne mein us sukhad wayu se bhi adhik tez hua karte the, jise Allah baarish aur daya ke saath bhejta hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki daansheelta ka bayaan, khaas taur se Ramzan maheene mein, kyonki yeh neki ka maheena aur achchhe karmon ka mausam hai.
Har samay daan karne ki prerna. Lekin Ramzan maheene ke andar adhik daan karna musathab hai.
Ramzan maheene mein adhik se adhik kharch karna, logon ko dena, doosron ka bhala karna aur Qur'an parhna musathab hai.
Jnaan ke sanrakshan ka ek pramukh saadhan jnaanaarthiyon evn jnaanvaan logon ke saath paricharcha karna hai.

6180: Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam sabse uttam charitr ke insaan the.
Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain: Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam sabse uttam charitr ke insaan the.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam sabse sanpoorn aachran waale insaan the aur naitikta ke sabhi maankon, jaise achchhi baat karna, bhala karna, hanskar milna, kasht dene se bachna aur koi kasht de to sahan karna aadi mein sabse aage the.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka adbhut aachran.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam achchhe aachran ke maamle mein sanpoorn aadarsh hain.
Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke aadarshon par chalte hue apne aap ko achchhe aachran se susajjit karne ki prerna.

6181: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka ek nityakaary yeh tha ki jab ek tihaai raat guzar jaati to khare hote aur kahteh ai logo! Allah ko yaad karo.

Ubai bin kaab (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka ek nityakaary yeh tha ki jab ek tihaai raat guzar jaati to khare hote aur kahteh ai logo! Allah ko yaad karo. Pahli baar soor phoonkne ka samay a gaya hai. Uske baad doosri baar soor mein phoonk maari jayegi. Mrityu apni kathinaaiyon ke saath a chuki hai. Mrityu apni kathinaaiyon ke saath a chuki hai. Mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Main aap par atyadhik darood bheja karta hoon. Main yeh jaanna chaahta hoon ki apni dua ka kitna bhaag aapke liye khaas karoon? Farmayaah jitna chaaho. Mainne kahaah ek chauthaai? Farmayaah jitna chaaho, karo. Yadi isse adhik karte ho to woh tumhaare liye achchha hai. Mainne kahaah aadha? To farmayaah jitna chaaho, karo. Agar isse zyaada karte ho to woh tumhaare liye behtar hai. Mainne kahaah do tihaai? Farmayaah jitna chaaho, karo. Agar isse bhi adhit karte ho to woh tumhaare haq mein uttam hai. Mainne kahaah main apni saari duaaon ko aapke liye khaas kar doon? To farmayaah agar aisa karoge to tumhaari saari chintayen samaapt ho jayengi aur tumhaare saare gunaah maaf ho jayenge.

6183: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka prayaas rahta tha ki somvaar aur brihaspatiwaar ko roza rakha jaye.

6186: Ek yahoodi larka Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki sewa kiya karta tha.

Anas (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, unhonne pharmaya ki ek yahoodi larka Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki sewa kiya karta tha. Isi beech woh beemaar ho gaya to Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) uska haal jaanne pahunche aur uske sirhaane baithkar pharmayaah tu musalmaan ho ja. Usne apne baap ki taraph dekha, jo uske paas baitha tha to uske baap ne kahaah abul-qaasim (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki baat maan lo. Phir woh musalmaan ho gaya. Tab Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) yeh pharmaate hue baahar baahar ayeh saari prashansa Allah ki hai, jisne use aag se bacha liya.
6187: Abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas ek gulaam tha, jo unhen pratyek din apni kamaai ka kuchh bhaag de diya karta tha aur abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) usmen se khaya karte the.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas ek gulaam tha, jo unhen pratyek din apni kamaai ka kuchh bhaag de deta tha aur abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) usmen se khaate the. Ek din woh koi wastu laya aur abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ne usmen se kha liya. Itne mein usne kahaah kya aap jaante hain ki yeh kya hai? Abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ne kahaah yeh kya hai? Usne kahaah mainne jaahiliyyat kaal mein ek vyakti ke liye kahaanat (svayn ko bhawishy ka jnaata zaahir karte hue bhawishyawaani ityaadi karna) ki thi. Haalaanki, mujhe kahaanat aati nahin thi. Bas mainne uski aankh mein dhool jhonkne ka kaam kiya tha. Ab woh vyakti mujhe mil gaya aur uske badle mujhe woh cheez di, jo aapne khaai. Yeh sunkar abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ne apne munh mein haath daala aur pet mein jo kuchh tha, use ulti (waman) kar ke baahar nikaal diya.
6203: Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam pratyek namaz ke baad inheen shabdon ke dvaara tahleel (Allah ka gungaan) karte the.

Abu al-zubair se warnit hai, unhonne kaha : Abdullah bin zubair radiyallahu anhuma pratyek namaz ka salaam pherne ke baad kaha karte the : " لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريكَ له، له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيءٍ قديرٌ، لا حولَ ولا قوةَ إلا بالله، لا إله إلا الله، ولا نعبد إلا إيَّاه، له النِّعمة وله الفضل، وله الثَّناء الحَسَن، لا إله إلا الله مخلصين له الدِّين ولو كَرِه الكافرون" (Allah ke atirikti koi sachcha poojy nahin hai. Woh akela hai. Uska koi saajhi nahin hai. Usi ki baadshaahat hai aur usi ki sabhi prakaar ki uchch koti ki prashansa hai aur woh har cheez mein saksham hai. Allah ke pradaan kiye hue suyog ke bina na kisi ke paas gunaah se bachne ki kshamta hai aur na neki ka kaam karne ka saamarthy. Allah ke atirikt koi sachcha upaasy nahin hai. Ham kewal usi ki upaasna karte hain. Usi ki sab nemten hain aur usi ka sab par upkaar hai. Usi ki samast achchhi prashansayen hain. Allah ke atirikt koi sachcha poojy nahin hai. Ham usi ke liye dharm ko khaalis wa shuddh karte hain, chaahe yeh baat kaaphiron ko naagvaar lagti ho.) unhonne aage kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam pratyek namaz ke baad inheen shabdon ke dvaara tahleel (Allah ka gungaan) karte the.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam har farz namaz se  salaam pherne ke baad in mahatvapoorn zikr dvaara Allah ka gungaan karte the. Is zikr ka arth hai :

Allah ke siwa koi sachcha poojy nahin hai.

Uske poojy tatha rab hone aur uske naamon tatha gunon mein uska koi saajhi nahin hai.

Usi ki sanpoorn tatha samagr baadshaahat hai. Wahi aakaashon, dharti tatha donon ke beech ki saari cheezon ka maalik hai.

Woh har etbaar se sanpoorn hai. Uski sanpoornata har haal mein prem tatha sammaan ke saath bayaan ki jayegi. Khushi mein bhi aur gham mein bhi.

Uski shakti evn saamarthy har etbaar se sanpoorn hai. Koi kaam uske wash se baahar ka nahin hai. Aisa koi kaam nahin hai, jo woh kar na sake.

Ek awastha se doosri awastha mein jaane aur Allah ki awajna ki raah ko chhorkar uske aajnaapaalan ki raah apnaane ki shakti Allah ke suyog pradaan kiye bina kisi ke paas nahin hai. Wahi asal madadgaar hai aur usi par saara bharosa hai.

Iske baad dobaara "Allah ke atirikt koi sachcha upaasy nahin hai. Ham kewal usi ki upaasna karte hain" Kahkar is baat ki taakeed ki gai hai ki Allah hi ekmaatr saty poojy hai uska koi saajhi nahi hai aur uske atirikt koi ibaadat ka haqdaar nahin hai.

Wahi sab nemton ko paida karta hai, wahi unka maalik hai aur apne jis bande ko chaahta hai, nemten pradaan karta hai.

Usi ki utkrisht prashansa hai, uski zaat, gunon, kaaryon, nemton tatha har awastha par.

Uske atirikt koi sachcha poojy nahin hai. Ham wishuddh roop se usi ki ibaadat karte hain. Apni ibaadat mein riyaakaari aur dikhaawa ko daakhil hone nahin dete.

Ham poori dridhta ke saath Allah ko ek maante aur uski ibaadat karte hain, chaahe yeh baat kaafiron ko buri hi kyon na lage.

Is zikr ko har farz namaz ke baad paabandi ke saath parhna musathab hai.
Ek musalmaan apne deen par abhimaan karta hai aur uske prateekon ka khulkar paalan karta hai, chaahe kaafiron ko bura hi kyon na lage.
Hadees mein jab "دُبر الصلاة" (Namaz ke baad) ke shabd ayen aur hadees mein jis cheez ka ullekh hua hai, woh zikr ho, to aslan usse muraad salaam ke baad hoga, iske bajay agar dua ho, to muraad salaam se pahle hoga.
6204: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki oontni a़zaba se koi aage nahin ja sakta tha

Anas (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, unhonne kaha ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki ek oontni thi, jise a़zaba kaha jaata tha . Koi oontni uske aage nahin barh sakti thi. Aakhir ek dehaati naujvaan oont par sawaar hokar aya aur usse aage nikal gaya . Musalmaanon ko yeh baat aruchikar lagi yahaan tak ki aapne unki naagvaari pahchaan li aur farmaya ki Allah par haq hai, duniya ki jo cheez oonchi ho, use neechi kar de.
[ise bukhaari ne inheen jaise shabdon ke saath riwayat kiya hai .]
6206: Jab ham kisi oonche sthaan par charhte , to Allahu akbar kahte aur jab dhalaan par aate to subhaanallah kaha karte the

Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki jab ham kisi oonche sthaan par charhte, to Allahu akbar kahte aur jab dhalaan se utarte, to subhaanallah kaha karte the. Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur aap ki sena jab teelon par charhte, to takbeer (Allahu akbar) kahte aur jab utarte, to tasbeeh (subhaanallah) parhte the.
[ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6207: Ai logo! Svany apne aap par daya karo. Tum kisi bahre tatha ghayab ko nahin bula rahe ho, woh tumhaare saath hai aur woh bahut hi sunne waala aur sameep hai

Abu moosa ashaari (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki ham Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath kisi yaatra mein the. Saphar ke dauraan, jab ham kisi ghaati mein pahunchte to “La ilaaha illallah” aur “Allahu akbar” kahte hue hamaari aawaazen buland hueen to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah ai logo! Apne aap par daya karo, tum kisi bahre tatha ghayab ko nahin pukaar rahe ho. Tum jise pukaar rahe ho, woh tumhaare saath hai aur woh beshak bahut hi sunne waala aur sameep hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai aur shabd Bukhari ke hain.]
6208: Apne gharon ko qabristaan mat banne do. Shaitaan us ghar se bhaag jaata hai, jis ghar mein soora baqra parhi jaati hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Apne gharon ko qabristaan mat banne do. Shaitaan us ghar se bhaag jaata hai, jis ghar mein soora baqra parhi jaati hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne gharon ko namaz se khaali rakhne se mana kiya hai ki we qabristaan ki tarah ho jayen, jahaan namaz nahin parhi jaati.

Phir bataya ki shaitaan us ghar se door bhaagta hai, jismen soora baqra parhi jaati hai.

Gharon mein zyaada se zyaada ibaadten karna aur nafal namaz parhna musathab hai.
Qabristaanon mein namaz parhna jayaz nahin hai. Kyonki yeh shirk tatha qabron mein dafan logon ke baare mein atishyokti ka zariya hai. Lekin janaaze ki namaz ki baat isse alag hai.
Choonki qabron ke paas namaz na parhne ki baat sahaaba ke yahaan sthaapit thi, isliye Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki gharon ko qabristaan ki tarah na banaao ki wahaan namaz parhna chhor do.
6209: Woh vyakti Jannat mein prawesh nahin karega, jis ke dil mein ratti baraabar bhi ahankaar hoga

Abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah woh vyakti Jannat mein prawesh nahin karega, jis ke dil mein ratti baraabar bhi ghamand hoga. Yeh sunkar ek vyakti ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Ek vyakti achchha kapra tatha achchha joota pahanna pasand karta hai (to kya ise bhi ghamand samjha jayega)? Pharmayaah nishchay hi Allah atyant khoobsoorat hai tatha khoobsoorti ko pasand karta hai. Ghamand kaha jaata hai saty ka inkaar karne aur logon ko tuchchh samajhne ko.

Abdullah bin masaood -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Woh vyakti Jannat mein prawesh nahin karega, jis ke dil mein ratti baraabar bhi ghamand hoga." Yeh, un hadeeson mein se ek hai, jinmen gunaah karne waale ko chetaavni di gai hai aur jinki sharai pramaanon ko saamne rakhte hue vyaakhya karne ki aawashyakta hai. Daraasal apne dil mein abhimaan rakhne waala vyakti agar saty se abhimaan dikhaata hai aur use naapsand karta hai, to is prakaar ka vyakti kaafir hai aur hamesha Jahannam mein rahega aur kabhi Jannat mein prawesh nahin karega. Kyonki Allah taaala ka farmaan hai : "Ye isliye ki unhonne bura maana use, jo Allah ne utaara aur usne unke karm vyarth kar diye." Lekin yadi woh srishti ko abhimaan dikhaata hai aur Allah ki ibaadat se abhimaan nahin karta, to aise vyakti ke baare mein is hadees mein chetaavni di gai hai aur bataya gaya hai ki woh pahle Jannat mein daakhil hone waalon ke saath Jannat nahin jayega.
Jab Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne yeh hadees sunaai, to ek vyakti ne kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Insaan ki ichchha hoti hai ki uske kapre achchhe hon aur uske joote achchhe hon, to kya ise bhi abhimaan maana jayega? Aapne uttar diya : "Nishchay hi Allah atyant khoobsoorat hai tatha khoobsoorti ko pasand karta hai." Woh svayn sundar hai, uske saare gun sundar hain, uske saare kaary sundar hain aur usse juri hui har cheez sundar hai. Usse sanbandhit koi baat kuroop nahin hai.
Aapke shabd : "Woh khoobsoorti ko pasand karta hai" Ka arth hai, woh is baat ko pasand karta hai ki bande sundar kapre pahnen, sundar joote pahnen, shaareerik roop se sundar dikhen aur unke saare kaam sundar hon. Kyonki sundarta insaan ki or logon ko aakarshit karti hai aur use sabki nazar mein priy banaati hai, jabki jab insaan ke baal, uske kapre aur uska wastr kuroop hota hai, to log usse ghrina karte hain.
6211: Subhaanallah, al-hamdu lillah, la ilaaha illallah aur Allahu akbar kahna, mere nikat un saari chaazon ki tulna mein adhik uttam hai, jinpar sooraj nikalta hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Subhaanallah, al-hamdu lillah, la ilaaha illallah aur Allahu akbar kahna, mere nikat un saari chaazon ki tulna mein adhik uttam hai, jinpar sooraj nikalta hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki in mahatvapoorn shabdon dvaara Allah ka zikr karna duniya aur uski saari cheezon se behtar hai. Ye shabd is prakaar hain :

"Subhaanallah" : In shabdon dvaara tamaam kamiyon se Allah ki paaki bayaan ki jaati hai.

"Al-hamdu lillah" : Allah ki yeh prashansa ki woh apne saare gunon mein sanpoorn hai. Saath mein usse mohabbat tatha uska sammaan bhi ho.

"La ilaaha illallah" : Allah ke siwa koi sachcha poojy nahin hai.

"Allahu akbar" : Allah har cheez se bara tatha shaktishaali hai.

Allah ke zikr ki prerna aur is baat ka ullekh ki Allah ka zikr un sabhi cheezon se priy hai, jinpar sooraj nikalta hai.
Adhik se adhik zikr karne ki prerna, kyonki iska bahut bara pratiphal hai.
Duniya ke aanand ki cheezen thori hain aur sab khatm ho jayengi.
6212: Tujhe daaood wansh ki baansuriyon mein ek baansuri di gai hai

Abu moosa ashaari (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah tujhe daaood wansh ki baansuriyon mein se ek baansuri di gai hai. Muslim ki ek riwayat mein hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unse farmayaah kaash! Tum ne mujhe us samay dekha hota, jab main pichhli raat tumhaari tilaawat sun raha tha.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6213: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kisi maheene mein shaabaan se adhik roza (upvaas) nahin rakhte the

Aaisha (radiyallahu anhu) kahti hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kisi maheene mein shaabaan se adhik roza (upvaas) nahin rakhte the. Aap poore shaabaan maheene ka roza rakhte the. Ek riwayat mein haih shaabaan ke kuchh hi dinon ka roza nahin rakhte the.

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- se warnit hai, woh kahti hain : Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- kisi maheene mein shaabaan se adhik roza nahin rakhte the. Aap shaabaan ka poora maheena roza rakhte the. Ek riwayat mein hai : Thora bahut chhor den, to aap shaabaan ka poora maheena roza rakhte the. Jnaan ho ki yahaan doosri riwayat pahli riwayat ki vyaakhya prastut karti hai aur yeh bataati hai ki poore maheene se muraad uska adhiktar bhaag hai. Jabki kuchh logon ne kaha hai ki aap kisi saal poora maheena roza rakhte the aur kisi saal uska kuchh bhaag. Jabki kuchh logon ka kahna hai ki aap kabhi is maheene ke pratham bhaag mein roza rakhte, kabhi antim bhaag mein roza rakhte aur kabhi darmiyaani bhaag mein rakhte the aur iska koi bhi bhaag bina roze ke nahin chhorte the. Lekin kabhi-kabhi saalon mein aisa karte the. Atah insaan ko chahiye ki shaabaan maheene mein any maheenon ki tulna mein adhik roza rakhe, kyonki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aisa hi kiya karte the. Iski hikmat yeh hai ki Ramzan se pahle is maheene ka roza farz namaazon se pahle ki sunnat namaazon ki tarah hai. Jabki kuchh logon ka kahna hai ki wishesh roop se shaabaan mein adhik roze isliye rakha karte the ki is maheene mein bandon ke karm oopar le jaye jaate hain, jaisa ki sunnat se saabit hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6214: Jab yaman se kuchh log aye, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah yaman waale tumhaare paas aye hain

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki jab yaman waale aye, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah yaman waale aye hain. Yahi woh log hain, jinhonne sabse pahle musaafha (haath milaana) ka aaranbh kiya.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6215: Woh vyakti Jahannam mein prawesh nahin karega, jisne sooraj nikalne aur sooraj doobne se pahle namaz parhi.

Abu zuhair umaara bin ruaiba radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Woh vyakti Jahannam mein prawesh nahin karega, jisne sooraj nikalne aur sooraj doobne se pahle namaz parhi."

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- bata rahe hain ki woh vyakti hargiz Jahannam mein prawesh nahin karega, jisne fajr aur asr ki namaz paabaandi se parhi. In donon namaazon ka ullekh wishesh roop se isliye kiya gaya hai ki ye sabse bhaari namaazen hain. Subah ka samay neend ka aanand lene ka samay hota hai aur asr ka samay din ke kaamon aur kaarobaar mein vyast rahne ka samay. Zaahir si baat hai ki jo in kathin samyon mein parhi jaane waali namaazon ki paabandi karega, woh baaqi samyon mein parhi jaane waali namaazon ki paabandi to karega hi.

Fajr aur asr ki namaazon ki fazeelat. Atah in donon ki paabandi karni chahiye.
Jo vyakti in donon namaazon ki paabandi karta hai, woh aam taur par susti evn dikhaawa jaisi cheezon se door hota hai evn ibaadat se mohabbat rakhta hai.
6216: Yadi mujhe bakri ke paye tatha baanh ka gosht khaane ke liye bulaya jaye to sveekaar kar loonga

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se marfooan warnit haih yadi mujhe bakri ke paye tatha baanh ka goshat khaane ke liye bulaya jaye to sveekaar kar loonga aur yadi mujhe bakri ka paya tatha baanh ka gosht bhent kiya jaye, to main sveekaar kar loonga.
6217: Yadi agle saal tak jeewit raha, to muharram maheene ki nauween taareekh ko roza rakhoonga

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah yadi agle saal tak jeewit raha, to muharram maheene ki nauween taareekh ka roza rakhoonga.

"لئن بقيت" Yaani agar mein jeewit raha. "إلى قابل" Yaani aane waale muharram tak. "لأصومنّ التاسِع" To dasven din ke saath nawaan din bhi roza rakhoonga, taaki yahoodiyon ki mukhaalfat ho sake. Lekin aane waale muharram se pahle hi aapki mrityu ho gai. Atah us din roza rakhna sunnat hai, yadyapi aapne roza na rakha ho. Kyonki aapne jis kaam ka iraada kar liya, woh bhi sunnat hai. Yahaan dasven din ke saath nawen din roza rakhne ka sabab yeh hai ki yahoodiyon ki mushaabhat na ho, jo kewal dasven din ka roza rakhte hain. Jabki kuchh logon ka kahna hai ki iska sabab hai dasven din ko praapt karne mein ehtiyaat se kaam lena. Lekin pahla mat adhik uchit hai, kyonki uska ullekh saheeh hadees mein maujood hai.
6218: Allah ne apne Nabi ko aawaaz ko sureeli banaane ki jis prakaar anumti di hai kisi aur wastu ki nahin di

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah Allah ne apne Nabi ko aawaaz ko sureeli banaane ki jis prakaar anumti di hai, kisi aur wastu ki nahin di. Aap Qur'an parhte samay aawaaz ko sureeli banaate aur oonchi aawaaz se parhte the.

Is hadees mein namaz ke andar tatha namaz ke baahar achchhi aawaaz mein Qur'an parhne ki prerna di gai hai. Insaan ko chahiye ki jab Qur'an parhe, to dhvani ke saath، achchhi aawaaz mein, dard se bhari hui lay ke saath, any waaniyon ki ichchha se mukt hokar, uske dvaara antraatma ki beniyaazi talab karte hue aur bhautik beniyaazi ki aasha rakhte hue use parhe. Jnaat ho ki is hadees mein Qur'an ko sureeli aawaaz mein parhne se muraad use sundar aawaaz mein parhna hai, is tarah parhna nahin ki sangeet waale gaanon ki dhun par aadhaarit jaan parta ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6219: Allah ne jitne bhi Nabi bheje, sabhon ne bakri charaai hai

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) farmayaah Allah taaala ne koi Nabi aisa nahin bheja jisne bakriyaan na charaai hon. Sahaaba (radiyallahu anhum) ne poochhaah kya aapne bhi? Pharmayaah haan. Main bhi kuchh qeeraat (roopye) ke parishraamik par makka ke kai logon ki bakriyaan charaya karta tha.

Saare nabiyon ne apne jeewankaal mein bakriyaan charaai hain. Is hadees ka zaahir bataata hai ki aisa Nabi banne se pahle hua karta tha. Yahi kaaran hai ki ulema ne kaha hai : Iski hikmat yeh hai ki insaan logon ke netritv aur duniya evn aakhirat ki bhalaai ki or unka maargadarshan karne ke liye prashikshit ho jaye. Kyonki bakri charaane waala kabhi to bakriyon ko charaagaah ki or le jaata hai, kabhi unhen khara rakhta hai aur kabhi baara ki or le jaata hai. Daraasal Nabi ko achchhi charaagaahon ki jaankaari rakhne waale, bakriyon ke hiton ko samajhne waale, unki bhaalaai tatha uske chaara-paani ka dhyaan rakhne waale ek charvaahe ki tarah jnaan, hidayat aur samajh-boojh ke saath ummat ka netritv karna hota hai aur use bhalaai ki or le jaana hota hai.
Phir nabiyon ko bakriyaan hi charaane ka kaary isliye sonpa gaya ki unhen charaane waale ke andar dheeraj, sanjeegdi aur sthirta hoti hai. Jabki iske wipreet oont charaane waale ke andar aam taur par sakhti aur rookhaapan hota hai. Kyonki oont ke svabhaav mein bhi sakhti evn rookhaapan hota hai. Atah Allah apne rasoolon ke liye bakri charaane ke kaam ka chayan kiya, taaki we insaan ko netritv pradaan karne ke abhyast ho jayen.
6220: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ghar mein kya karte the? Unhonne kaha ki aap apne ghar waalon ki sewa mein lage rahte aur jab namaz ka samay aata, to namaz ke liye chale jaate

Asvad bin yazeed kahte hain ki aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se prashn kiya gaya ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ghar mein kya karte the? Unhonne kahaah aap apne ghar waalon ki sewa mein lage rahte aur jab namaz ka samay a jaata, to namaz ke liye chale jaate the.
6221: Mainne kisi mote aur maheen resham ko nahin chhua hai, jo Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke haath se adhik mulayam ho

Anas (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne kisi aise mote aur maheen resham ko nahin chhua hai, jo Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki hatheli se adhik mulayam ho aur na hi aisi khushbu soonghi hai, jo Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke shareer ki khushbu se adhik sugandhit ho. Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki das saal tak sewa ki hai lekin kadaapi aap ne mujhe oh tak nahin kaha aur na hi mainne koi kaam kiya, to us par farmaya ki tum ne amuk kaam kyon kiya? Aur mere kisi kaary ke na karne par yeh nahin kaha ki tum ne aisa kyon nahin kiya?
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6222: Jab koi banda mujhpar salaam parhta hai, Allah mujhe meri aatma lauta deta hai, taaki main use salaam ka uttar de doon.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jab koi banda mujhpar salaam parhta hai, Allah mujhe meri aatma lauta deta hai, taaki main use salaam ka uttar de doon."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- bata rahe hain ki salaam karne waale ko uske salaam ka jawaab dene ke liye aapki aatma ko aapke shareer mein lauta diya jaata hai. Isse koi farq nahin parta ki salaam karne waala door hai ki nikat. Yaad rahe ki barzakh evn qabr ke jeewan ka sanbandh ghaib ki duniya se hai, jiski haqeeqat us Allah ke siwa koi nahin jaanta, jo har cheez ki kshamta rakhta hai.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- par adhik se adhik darood wa salaam bhejne ki prerna.
Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki apni kabr mein zindgi, woh sabse shreshth aur poorn zindgi hai jo kisi insaan ko barzakh (mrityu ke baad ki sthiti) mein mil sakti hai; aur is zindgi ki asal hakeekat  ko Allah ke alaawa koi nahin jaanta.
Is hadees mein un logon ke liye koi daleel nahin hai, jo qabr ke andar Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke hamaare is saansaarik jeewan ki tarah sanpoorn roop se jeewit hone ka daawa karte hain. Atah shirk karne waalon ka ise aapse madad maangne ke liye saboot ke taur par istemaal karna durust nahin hai. Sachchi baat yeh hai ki aap is samay barzakh ka jeewan ji rahe hain.
[is hadees ko abu daawood aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
6254: Jab kisi musalmaan ke saamne farz namaz ka samay aata hai aur woh achchhi tarah wazu karke, poori winaysheelta ke saath aur achchhe andaaz mein ruku karke namaz parhta hai, to woh namaz uske pichhle gunaahon ka kaffaara ban jaati hai, jab tak koi bara gunaah na kare. Aisa hamesha hota rahega.

Usmaan radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Jab kisi musalmaan ke saamne farz namaz ka samay aata hai aur woh achchhi tarah wazu karke, poori winaysheelta ke saath aur achchhe andaaz mein ruku karke namaz parhta hai, to woh namaz uske pichhle gunaahon ka kaffaara ban jaati hai, jab tak koi bara gunaah na kare. Aisa hamesha hota rahega."

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jab kisi musalmaan ke saamne farz namaz ka samay upasthit hota hai aur woh uske liye achchhi tarah aur poore taur par wazu karta hai, is tarah winaysheelta ke saath namaz parhta hai ki uska dil aur uske shareer ke ang Allah ki or mutvajjeh hon aur uski mahaanta ko dhyaan mein rakhe hue hon tatha namaz ke saare kaary jaise ruku evn sajde aadi poore taur par karta hai, to yeh namaz uske pichhle chhote-chhote gunaahon ka kaffaara ban jaati hai, jab tak woh kisi bare gunaah mein sanlipt na ho. Allah ka yeh anugrah kisi kaal khand ke saath seemit na hokar har daur aur har namaz mein vyaapt hai.

Gunaahon ka kaffaara wahi namaz banti hai, jiske liye banda achchhi tarah wazu kare aur use poori winaysheelta ke saath Allah ki prasannata praapt karne ke liye ada kare.
Paabandi se ibaadat karne ki fazeelat. Ibaadat se insaan ke chhote gunaah maaf ho jaate hain.
Achchhi tarah wazu karne tatha achchhi tarah evn winaysheel hokar namaz parhne ki fazeelat.
Chhote gunaahon ki kshama ke liye bare gunaahon se door rahne ka mahatv.
Bare gunaahon ki kshama ke liye tauba zaroori hai.
6255: Aise koi din nahin hain, jinmen neki ke kaam karna Allah ke nikat in (das) dinon mein neki ke kaam karne se adhik priy hon." Aapki muraad zul-hijja maheene ke shuru ke das din hain

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Aise koi din nahin hain, jinmen neki ke kaam karna Allah ke nikat in (das) dinon mein neki ke kaam karne se adhik priy hon." Aapki muraad zul-hijja maheene ke shuru ke das din hain. Sahaaba ne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karna bhi nahin? Aapne uttar diya : "Nahin, Allah ke raaste mein jihaad bhi nahin, siway us vyakti ke, jo jaan tatha maal ke saath nikalta ho aur phir unmen se kuchh bhi lekar waapas na aata ho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki zul-hijja maheene ke shuru ke das dinon mein neki ke kaam karna saal ke any dinon mein karne se behtar hai.

Sahaaba ne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se in das dinon ke atirikt any dinon mein Allah ke maarg mein jihaad karne ke baare mein poochha ki woh behtar hai ya in das dinon mein neki ke kaam karna? Kyonki unko pata tha ki jihaad sabse achchhe kaamon mein se ek kaam hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne uttar yeh diya ki in dinon mein neki ke kaam karna any dinon mein jihaad karne se bhi behtar hai. Haan, us vyakti ki baat alag hai, jo apni jaan tatha maal ko saath lekar Allah ke raaste mein jihaad ke liye nikal para aur sab kuchh Allah ke maarg mein nyochhaawar kar diya. Is vyakti ka yeh amal in das shreshth dinon mein neki ke kaam karne se behtar hai.

Zul-hijja maheene ke shuru ke das dinon mein neki ke kaam karne ki fazeelat. Musalmaan ko in das dinon ko ghaneemat jaante hue inmen khoob neki ke kaam, jaise Allah ki baraai bayaan karna, uske ekmaatr poojy hone ka elaan karna, uski prashansa karna, namaz parhna, roza rakhna aur any saare neki ke kaam karne chahiye.
[is hadees ko Bukhari aur abu daawood ne riwayat kiya hai, tatha shabd abu daawood ke hain]
6256: Jab koi Muslim praatah kisi beemaar Muslim ki iyaadat (kushal- mangal lena) karta hai, to sattar hazaar farishte us ke liye rahmat ki praarthana karte hain

Ali (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue sunaah jab koi Muslim praatah kisi Muslim vyakti ki iyaadat (beemaarpursi) karta hai, to sattar hazaar farishte shaam tak us ke liye rahmat ki praarthana karte hain. Isi prakaar, jab koi shaam ko iyaadat karta hai, to praatah tak farishte uske liye rahmat ki dua karte rahte hain tatha aise vyakti ke liye Jannat mein chuna hua phal hai (arthaat woh jannati hai).
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6257: Jab do musalmaan aapas mein milte hain aur musaafha karte hain, to unke alag hone se pahle-pahle unko kshama kar diya jaata hai.

Bara bin aazib -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jab do musalmaan aapas mein milte hain aur musaafha karte hain, to unke alag hone se pahle-pahle unko kshama kar diya jaata hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki jab do musalmaan kisi raaste aadi mein milte hain aur ek-doosre ko salaam tatha musaafha karte hain, to donon ke alag hone se pahle unke gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain. Yaad rahe ki yahaan alag hone se muraad shaareerik roop se alag hona bhi ho sakta hai aur musaafha sampann karna bhi.

Mulaaqaat ke samay musaafha karna musathab hai aur iski prerna di gai hai.
Munaawi kahte hain : Sunnat yeh hai ki agar koi majboori na ho to dayen haath ko dayen haath par rakha jaye.
Salaam ko aam karne ki prerna aur ek musalmaan ke doosre musalmaan bhaai se musaafha karne ke bare pratiphal ka bayaan.
Is hadees ke dayre mein haraam musaafha baahar hai. Jaise kisi ajanbi mahila se musaafha karna.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
6258: Qur'an parhne waale momin ka udaahran, us turanj phal ke jaisa hai, jiski gandh achchhi aur jiska svaad achchha hota hai. Qur'an na parhne waale momin ka udaahran us khajoor ke jaisa hai, jismen koi khushbu to nahin hoti, lekin uska svaad meetha hota hai

Abu moosa ashaari radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Qur'an parhne waale momin ka udaahran, us turanj phal ke jaisa hai, jiski gandh achchhi aur jiska svaad achchha hota hai. Qur'an na parhne waale momin ka udaahran us khajoor ke jaisa hai, jismen koi khushbu to nahin hoti, lekin uska svaad meetha hota hai. Qur'an parhne waale munaafiq ka udaahran us tulsi ke jaisa hai, jiski gandh to achchhi hoti hai lekin svaad karva hota hai aur Qur'an na parhne waale munaafiq ka udaahran us indrayan phal ke jaisa hai, jiske andar sugandh nahin hoti aur jiska svaad bahut hi karva hota hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne Qur'an parhne aur usse laabhaanvit hone ki drishti se logon ke wibhinn prakaar bayaan kiye hain :

Pahla prakaar : Qur'an parhne aur usse laabhaanvit hone waala momin. Uski misaal meethi naarangi jaisi hai. Meetha bhi, khushboodaar bhi aur achchhe rang waala bhi. Usmen fayde bhi bahut hain. Woh jo kuchh parhta hai, uspar khud amal karta hai aur Allah ke bandon ko fayda pahunchaata hai.

Doosra prakaar : Qur'an na parhne waala momin. Woh khajoor jaisa hai. Meetha to hai, lekin khushbu nadaarad. Jis tarah khajoor ke andar meethaapan hota hai, us tarah uske andar eemaan hota hai aur jis tarah khajoor khushbu se khaali hota hai, usi tarah uska daaman Qur'an ki tilaawat se khaali hai ki log use sunkar aanand evn sukoon haasil karen.

Teesra prakaar : Qur'an parhne waala munaafiq. Uski misaal raihaana (tulsi) jaisi hai. Uski khushbu to bari achchhi hoti hai, lekin svaad karva. Kyonki munaafiq eemaan se apne hriday ko parishkrit nahin karta, Qur'an par amal nahin karta, lekin logon ko dikhaane ka prayaas karta hai ki pakka momin hai. Raihaana ki khushbu munaafiq ki Qur'an paath ki tarah hai aur uska karva svaad munaafiq ke awishvaas ki tarah.

Chautha prakaar : Qur'an na parhne waala munaafiq. Uski misaal indrayan jaisi hoti hai. Khushbu se khaali aur karva svaad. Indrayan ka khushbu se khaali hona munaafiq ke Qur'an ki tilaawat se door rahne ki tarah hai, jabki uska karvaapan munaafiq ke awishvaas ke karvepan ki tarah hai, jiska hriday eemaan se khaali hota hai aur zaahir laabharhit, balki haanikaarak.

Qur'an ka jnaan rakhne waale aur uspar amal karne waale ki fazeelat.
Shiksha dene ka ek tareeqa apni baat samjhaane ke liye udaahran prastut karna bhi hai.
Musalmaan ko pratyek din Allah ki kitaab ka ek nishchit bhaag parhna chahiye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
6259: Pratyek farj namaz ke pashchaat kahi jaane waali tasbeehon ko kahne waale -ya unka paalan karne waale- naakaam nahin honge. Arthaat 33 baar subhaanallah, 33 baar al-hamdu lillah aur 34 baar Allahu akbar.

Kaab bin ujra radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Pratyek farj namaz ke pashchaat kahi jaane waali tasbeehon ko kahne waale -ya unka paalan karne waale- naakaam nahin honge. Arthaat 33 baar subhaanallah, 33 baar al-hamdu lillah aur 34 baar Allahu akbar."

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kuchh azkaar ke baare mein baat ki hai, jinhen parhne waala ghaate mein nahin rahta aur sharminda nahin hota. Use unka sawaab zaroor milta hai. Ye aise shabd hain, jo ek-doosre ke baad aate aur farz namaazon ke baad parhe jaate hain. Ye shabd hain :

"Subhaanallah" Taintees baar. Iska arth yeh hai ki Allah har kami evn aib se paak hai.

"Al-hamdu lillah" Taintees baar. Yaani is baat ki ghoshna ki Allah har drishtikon se paripoorn hai, saath hi usse mohabbat karna aur uska sammaan karna.

"Allahu akbar" Chauntees baar. Yaani Allah duniya ki saari cheezon se bara, mahaan aur shaktishaali hai.
Allah ki paaki, prashansa aur baraai bayaan karne ka mahatv. Aur inko baaqi rahne waale nek aamaal kaha gaya hai.
6260: Qur'an mein ek soorat hai, jismen tees ayten hain, woh apne parhne waale vyakti ke liye sifaarish karti rahegi yahaan tak ki use kshama kar diya jayega

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah Qur'an mein ek aisi soorat hai jismen tees ayten hain. Woh kisi vyakti ke liye sifaarish karti rahegi yahaan tak ki use kshama kar diya jayega aur woh تبارك الذي بيده الملك hai . Abu daaood ki ek riwayat mein haih to uski sifaarish sveekaar ki jayegi.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6261: Jisne asr ki namaz chhor di, uske sabhi karm vyarth ho gae.

Buraida bin husaib radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain : Asr ki namaz jaldi parha karo. Kyonki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jisne asr ki namaz chhor di, uske sabhi karm vyarth ho gae."
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne asr ki namaz ko jaan-boojhkar uske samay se wilanb karke parhne se saavdhaan kiya hai, aur bataya hai ki aisa karne waale ka amal vyarth ho jaata hai.

Asr ki namaz ko uske pratham samay mein parhne ki prerna.
Yahaan asr ki namaz chhorne waale ko bari sakht chetaavni di gai hai. Asr ki namaz ko samay par na parhna any namaazon ko samay par na parhne se adhik bara gunaah hai. Kyonki yahi woh beech ki namaz hai, jiska wishesh roop se aadesh Qur'an ki is ayat mein diya gaya hai : "Sab namaazon ka aur (wisheshkar) beech ki namaz (asr) ka dhyaan rakho." [soora al-baqra : 238]
6262: Jisne aisa jnaan praapt kiya, jisse Allah ki khushi praapt ki jaati hai

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jisne aisa jnaan praapt kiya, jisse Allah ki khushi praapt ki jaati hai aur woh ise kewal duniya praapt karne ke liye seekhta hai, to woh qayaamat ke din Jannat ki khushbu tak nahin payega.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6263: Jo achchhi tarah wazu karta hai, uske jism se paap nikal jaate hain, yahaan tak ki naakhoon ke neeche se bhi nikal jaate hain.

Usmaan bin affaan radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jo achchhi tarah wazu karta hai, uske jism se paap nikal jaate hain, yahaan tak ki naakhoon ke neeche se bhi nikal jaate hain."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jo wazu ki sunnaton aur aadaab ka khyaal rakhte hue wazu karta hai, to iske nateeje mein uske gunaah dho diye jaate hain. Yahaan tak ki uske haath tatha pairon ke naakhoonon ke neeche se bhi gunaah nikal jaate hain.

Wazu, uski sunnaton aur aadaab ko seekhne tatha unpar amal karne ki prerna.
Wazu ki fazeelat tatha uska chhote gunaahon ko mita diye jaane ka sabab hona. Rahi baat bare gunaahon ki, to unke liye tauba zaroori hai.
Gunaahon ke nikalne ke liye shart yeh hai ki wazu ko Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke bataye hue tareeqe ke mutaabiq sanpoorn tareeqe se kiya jaye aur usmen koi kami rahne na diya jaye.
Is hadees mein gunaahon ki maafi ki baat kabeera gunaahon se bachne aur unse tauba karne ke saath juri hui hai. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : "Yadi tum, un bare paapon se bachte rahe, jinse tumhen roka ja raha hai, to ham tumhaare (chhote) gunaahon ko kshama kar denge." [soora al-nisa : 31]
6264: Jis ne is prakaar wazu kiya, uske pichhle saare gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain

Usmaan bin affaan (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko meri tarah wazu karte hue dekha phir aapne farmayaah jisne is prakaar wazu kiya, uske pichhle saare gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain aur uski namaz tatha masjid chal kar jaane ka sawaab uske alaawa hai.
6265: Jisne soora kahf ke aaranbh ki das ayten kanthasth kar leen, woh dajjaal se surakshit rahega." Ek riwayat mein hai : "Soora kahf ke ant ki.

Abu darda -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jisne soora kahf ke aaranbh ki das ayten kanthasth kar leen, woh dajjaal se surakshit rahega." Ek riwayat mein hai : "Soora kahf ke ant ki."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jisne soora kahf ke shuru ki das ayten zabaani yaad kar leen, woh dajjaal ke fitne se surakshit rahega, jo antim kaal mein niklega aur poojy hone ka daawa karega. Uska fitna is dharti par aadam ki srishti se lekar qayaamat tak ki avdhi mein saamne aane waala sabse bara fitna hoga. Kyonki Allah use kuchh aisi asaadhaaran cheezen pradaan karega, jinke dvaara woh logon ko fitne mein daalega. Soora kahf ke shuru ki das ayten yaad kar lene se dajjaal ke fitne se suraksha isliye milegi ki in ayton ke andar kuchh aisi ajeeb wa ghareeb aur asaadhaaran cheezon ka zikr hua hai, jo dajjaal ke haathon zaahir hone waali asaadhaaran cheezon se kaheen barhkar hain. Atah jo unpar ghaur wa fikr kar lega, woh dajjaal ke fitne ka shikaar nahin hoga. Ek riwayat mein hai : Soora ke ant ki das ayten, jo {أفحسب الذين كفروا أن يتخذوا…} se shuru hoti hain.

Soora kahf ki fazeelat. Iski aaranbhik evn antim ayten dajjaal ke fitne se surakshit rakhti hain.
Is hadees mein dajjaal ke prakat hone ki soochna di gai hai aur usse suraksha ka tareeqa bataya gaya hai.
Poori soora kahf ko yaad kar lene ki prerna. Koi poori soora yaad na kar sake, to shuru aur ant ki das-das ayten yaad kar le.
Qurtubi iska kaaran bataate hue kahte hain : Kaha gaya hai : Choonki kahf waalon ke qisse mein bahut-si aashcharyajnak ghatnayen aur nishaaniyaan bayaan hui hain, isliye jo vyakti is qisse se avgat hoga, woh na dajjaal ke fitne se aashcharyachkit hoga, na darega aur na uska shikaar hoga. Isi tarah kaha gaya hai : Iska kaaran Allah ka yeh kathan hai : {لينذر بأسًا شديدًا من لدنه} (arthaat, taaki apne paas ke kathor dand se hoshiyaar kar de.) kyonki yahaan dand ke kathor tatha Allah ki or se hone ki baat kahi gai hai, jo ki dajjaal ke poojy hone ke daawe, prabhutv tatha mahaan fitne se munaasbat rakhti hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaiैhi wa sallam ne dajjaal ke fitne ko ek bara fitna bataya hai, usse daraya hai aur Allah ki sharan maangi haiै. Is tarah is hadees ka arth hoga : Jisne in ayton ko parha, inpar ghaur wa fikr kiya tatha inke arth se avgat hua, woh dajjaal se saavdhaan aur phalasvaroop surakshit bhi rahega.
6266: Sabse behtar jeewan us vyakti ka hai, jo Allah ke raaste mein ghore ki lagaam pakre rahta hai

Abu huraira (raziyallah anhu) se warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah sabse behtar jeewan us vyakti ka hai, jo Allah ke raaste mein ghore ki lagaam pakre rahta hai aur jab bhi koi shor athva jang ka bigul sunta hai, uski peeth par qatl karne athva shaheed hone ke liye tezi se daur jaata hai. Athva woh vyakti jo pahaar ki oonchaai athva ghaati mein rah kar namaz parhta tatha zakat deta hai aur apne rab ki ibaadat karta rahta hai, yahaan tak ki uski mrityu ho jaati hai. Aise logon mein bhalaai hi bhalaai hai.
6267: Jo jnaan praapt karne ke path par chalta hai, Allah uske liye Jannat ka raasta aasaan kar deta hai

Abu darda (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jo jnaan praapti ke ek path par chalta hai, Allah uske liye Jannat ka ek raasta aasaan kar deta hai aur farishte uske kaary se apni khushi ka pradarshan karte hue, us ke liye apne paron ko bichha dete hain. Nishchay hi, aakaash tatha dharti mein jo kuchh bhi hai, yahaan tak ki paani ki machhliyaan bhi jnaani ke liye kshama ki praarthana karti hain. Jnaani ko upaasak par wahi shreshthata praapt hai, jo chaand ko sitaaron par haasil hai. Ulema, nabiyon ke waaris hain aur Nabi deenaar tatha dirham wiraasat mein nahin chhorte balki jnaan ko wiraasat mein chhorkar gae hain. To jis ne ise praapt kar liya, usne bara bhaag praapt kar liya.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6268: Jisse jnaan se sanbandhit kuchh poochha gaya aur us ne use chhipa liya, to use qayaamat ke din aag ki lagaam pahnaai jayegi

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jisse kisi jnaan se sanbandhit kuchh poochha gaya aur usne use chhipa liya, to use qayaamat ke din aag ki lagaam pahnaai jayegi.

Is hadees mein jnaan chhupaane se sakht saavdhaan kiya gaya hai, aur yeh bataya gaya hai ki jis vyakti se dharm se sanbandhit koi jaankaari maangi gai, jiski poochhne waale ko zaroorat ho aur poochhe gae vyakti ke liye use bayaan karna zaroori bhi ho, lekin iske baavjood use jaankaari na de aur prashn ka uttar na de ya phir likhkar dene se mana kar de, to Allah qayaamat ke din iske dand ke taur par uske munh mein aag ki lagaam laga dega. Daraasal yeh badla hai is baat ka ki usne duniya mein apne munh mein khaamoshi ki lagaam laga li thi. Hota bhi yahi hai ki Allah insaan ko usi prakaar ka dand deta hai, jis prakaar ka uska karm hota hai. Yahaan yeh yaad rahe ki is hadees mein jo chetaavni di gai hai uske dayre mein woh vyakti aata hai, jise pata ho ki poochhne waala maargadarshan praapt karne ke liye poochh raha hai. Lekin iske wipreet yadi woh jaanta ho ki poochhne waala maargadarshan praapt karne ke liye nahin, balki uske jnaan ki thaah lene ke liye poochh raha hai, to aise mein use ekhtiyaar hai ki chaahe to jawaab de aur chaahe to na de. Woh is hadees mein di gai chetaavni ke dayre mein nahin ayega.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6269: Jo subh ki namaz parhta hai, woh Allah ki suraksha mein rahta hai

Jundub bin sufyaan bajli (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jo subh ki namaz parhta hai, woh Allah ki suraksha mein rahta hai. To ai aadam ki santaan! Soch lo. Allah taaala ko apni suraksha ke sanbandh mein tumse kuchh poochhna na par jaye.
[ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6270: Jo kisi aise rogi ka haal jaanne ke liye jaata hai, jiski maut ka abhi samay nahin aya hai aur uske paas saat baar yeh dua parhta hai : (Main mahaan Allah, jo mahaan sinhaasan ka rab hai, se dua karta hoon ki tumko svasth kar de.) to use Allah us rog se mukti de hi deta hai.

Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jo kisi aise rogi ka haal jaanne ke liye jaata hai, jiski maut ka abhi samay nahin aya hai aur uske paas saat baar yeh dua parhta hai : (Main mahaan Allah, jo mahaan sinhaasan ka rab hai, se dua karta hoon ki tumko svasth kar de.) to use Allah us rog se mukti de hi deta hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jab koi musalmaan kisi musalmaan ka haal jaanne aisi beemaari ke samay jaata hai, jismen uski mrityu na likhi ho, phir uske liye yeh dua parhta hai : "أسأل الله العظيم" Arthaat, main Allah se, jo apni zaat, gunon evn kaaryon mein mahaan hai, "رب العرش العظيم أن يشفيك" Tatha mahaan arsh (sinhaasan) ka maalik hai, dua karta hoon ki tumhen rogmukt kar de, saath hi is dua ko saat baar doharta hai, to Allah use us beemaari se svasth kar deta hai.

Rogi ke liye yeh dua karna aur ise saat baar dohraana musathab hai.
Jiske liye yeh dua ki jaye, use Allah ki anumti se svasth laabh hoga, basharteki dua sachchi neeyat aur nishtha ke saath ki jaye.
Yeh dua dheeme aur zor se donon tarah se karna jayaz hai. Lekin rogi ko sunaakar karna uttam aur waanchhit hai,  kyonki, isse use khushi milegi.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
6271: Jo kisi rozedaar ko iftaar karvaata hai, use bhi roza rakhne waale ke samaan puny milta hai

Zaid bin khaalid juhni (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jo kisi rozedaar ko iftaar karvaata hai, use bhi roza rakhne waale ke samaan neki milti hai aur rozedaar ki neki mein koi kami nahin ki jaati hai.

Is hadees mein rozedaar ko iftaar karaane ki fazeelat bayaan ki gai hai, is kaary ki prerna di gai hai aur yeh bataya gay hai ki jisne kisi rozedaar ko iftaar karaya, uske liye rozedaar ke baraabar neki likhi jaati hai, lekin isse rozedaar ki neki mein koi katauti nahin hoti. Yeh daraasal Allah ka apne bandon par ek bara anugrah hai, kyonki ismen neki evn dharmaprayanta ke kaamon mein paraspar sahyog aur musalmaanon ke beech prem tatha sahjeewan ki bhaavna nihit hai. Is hadees ke zaahir se maaloom hota hai ki kisi rozedaar ko iftaar karaane maatr se, chaahe ek khajoor ke dvaara hi kyon na ho, rozedaar ke baraabar sawaab mil jaata hai. Isliye insaan ko chahiye ki jahaan tak ho sake, rozedaaron ko iftaar karaane ka prayaas kare, wishesh roop se us samay jab rozedaaron ko iski zaroorat ho aur we nirdhan hon ya phir rozedaar ke paas iftaar ka saamaan taiyaar karne ke liye aadmi na ho.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6272: Jo muazzin ko azaan dete hue sunkar kahta hai : أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له وأنَّ محمداً عبده ورسولُه، رضيتُ بالله رباً وبمحمدٍ رسولاً وبالإسلام دِينا, (arthaat main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur is baat ki bhi gawaahi deta hoon ki Muhammad uske bande aur Rasool hain. Main Allah ko apna rab maankar, Muhammad ko Rasool maankar aur Islam ko apne dharm ke taur par sveekaar kar khush aur santusht hoon), uske saare gunaah kshama kar diye jaate hain.

Saad bin abu waqkaas radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jo muazzin ko azaan dete hue sunkar kahta hai : أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له وأنَّ محمداً عبده ورسولُه، رضيتُ بالله رباً وبمحمدٍ رسولاً وبالإسلام دِينا, (arthaat main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur is baat ki bhi gawaahi deta hoon ki Muhammad uske bande aur Rasool hain. Main Allah ko apna rab maankar, Muhammad ko Rasool maankar aur Islam ko apne dharm ke taur par sveekaar kar khush aur santusht hoon), uske saare gunaah kshama kar diye jaate hain."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jisne muazzin ki azaan sunkar yeh dua parhi : "أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له" Yaani main is baat ka iqraar, etraaf aur ailaan karta hoon ki Allah hi saty poojy hai aur uske atirikt pooji jaane waali saari cheezen baatil hain. "وأن محمدًا عبده ورسوله" Tatha Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke bande hain, lihaaza unki bandgi nahin ho sakti aur uske Rasool hain, isliye woh jhooth bol nahin sakte. "رضيت بالله ربًّا" Yaani main Allah ke rab hone, ibaadat ka ekmaatr haqdaar hone aur uske naamon evn gunon se santusht hoon. "وبمحمد رسولًا" Yaani jin shikshaaon ke saath aap bheje gae hain aur jinhen aapne ham tak pahunchaya hai, main unse bhi santusht hain. "وبالإسلام" Yaani aadeshon evn nishedhon ke roop mein paye jaane waale Islam ki tamaam shikshaaon se santusht hoon. "دينًا" Yaani etqaad evn aajnaapaalan ke roop mein. "غفر له ذنبه" Uske tamaam chhote gunaah maaf kar diye jayenge.
Azaan ki aawaaz sunte samay is dua ko parhne se gunaah maaf ho jaate hain.
6273: Jo la ilaaha illalaah wallahu akbar kahta hai, Allah uski pushti karta hai aur kahta haih mere siwa koi saty pujy nahin aur main hi sabse mahaan hoon

Abu saeed khudri tatha abu huraira (radiyallahu anhuma) ne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko saakshi thahraate hue kaha ki aapne farmayaah jo (لا إله إلا الله والله أكبر) kahta hai to Allah kahta haih mere siwa koi saty poojy nahin aur main hi sabse mahaan hoon) aur jab (لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له) kahta hai, to kahta haih mere siwa koi poojy nahin aur mera saajhi bhi koi nahin. Aur jab (لا إله إلا الله له الملك وله الحمد) kahta hai, to Allah kahta haih mere siwa koi saty poojy nahin aur meri hi baadshaahat hai tatha saari prashansa bhi mere liye hai aur jab لا إله إلا الله ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله kahta hai, to Allah kahta haih mere siwa koi saty poojy nahin aur meri anumti ke bina koi kshamta aur taaqat bhi nahin. Aap kaha karte the kih jo rogagrast haalat mein kah kar marta hai, use aag jala nahin sakti.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6274: Jisne soora baqra ki antim do ayten raat mein parh leen, woh uske liye kaafi ho jaati hain.

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne soora baqra ki antim do ayten raat mein parh leen, woh uske liye kaafi ho jaati hain."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jisne raat mein soora baqra ki antim do ayten parh leen, to Allah use buraai tatha apriy cheezon se bachaane ke liye kaafi ho jaata hai. Kuchh logon ka kahna hai ki yeh donon ayten uske liye tahajjud ki namaz ke badle mein kaafi ho jaati hain. Kuchh logon ka kahna hai ki any azkaar ke badle mein kaafi ho jaati hain. Jabki kuchh logon ka kahna hai ki raat ki namaz mein kam se kam in do ayton ko parh lena hi kaafi hai. Kuchh aur bhi baaten kahi gai hain. Ho sakta hai ki oopar kahi gai saari baaten sahi hon aur sab hadees ke shabdon ke dayre mein a jaati hon.

Soora baqra ki antim ayton ki fazeelat ka bayaan. Yeh ayten is tarah hain : {ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيۡنَ أَحَدٖ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦۚ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعۡنَا وَأَطَعۡنَاۖ غُفۡرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ. لا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَاۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتۡ وَعَلَيۡهَا مَا ٱكۡتَسَبَتۡۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوۡ أَخۡطَأۡنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحۡمِلۡ عَلَيۡنَآ إِصۡرٗا كَمَا حَمَلۡتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلۡنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦۖ وَٱعۡفُ عَنَّا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَآۚ أَنتَ مَوۡلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ.} (Rasool us cheez par eemaan laye, jo unki taraf unke rab ki or se utaari gai tatha sab eemaan waale bhi. Har ek Allah aur uske farishton aur uski pustakon aur uske rasoolon par eemaan laya. (We kahte hain) ham uske rasoolon mein se kisi ek ke beech antar nahin karte. Aur unhonne kaha hamne suna aur hamne aajnaapaalan kiya. Ham teri kshama chaahte hain ai hamaare rab! Aur teri hi or lautkar jaana hai. Allah kisi praani par bhaar nahin daalta parantu uski kshamta ke anusaar. Usi ke liye hai jo usne (neki) kamaai aur usi par hai jo usne (paap) kamaya. Ai hamaare rab! Hamaari pakar na kar yadi ham bhool jayen ya hamse chook ho jaye. Ai hamaare rab! Aur hampar koi bhaari bojh na daal, jaise toone use un logon par daala jo hamse pahle the. Ai hamaare rab! Aur hampar uska bojh na daal jiske (uthaane) ki ham mein shakti na ho. Tatha hamen maaf kar aur hamen kshama kar de aur hampar daya kar. Tu hi hamaara svaami (sanrakshak) hai, isliye kaafiron ke muqaable mein hamaari madad kar.)
Soora baqra ki antim ayton ko raat mein parhne se insaan buraai tatha shaitaan se surakshit rahta hai.
Raat sooraj doobne ke baad se shuru hoti hai aur fajr prakat hone tak rahti hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
6275: Jo Allah ki kitaab ka koi ek akshar parhega, use ek neki milegi aur neki das guna tak di jaati hai

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jo Allah ki kitaab ka koi ek akshar parhega, use ek neki milegi aur neki das guna tak di jaati hai. Main yeh nahin kahta ki alif laam meem mil kar ek akshar hai, balki alif ek akshar, laam ek akshar aur meem ek alag akshar hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jab koi musalmaan Allah ki kitaab ka ek akshar parhta hai, to uske badle mein use ek neki milti hai aur uske is pratiphal ko das guna tak barhaya jaata hai.

Phir is baat ko spasht karte hue farmaya : "Main yeh nahin kahta ki alif laam meem mil kar ek akshar hai, balki alif ek akshar, laam ek akshar aur meem ek alag akshar hai." Is tarah teen aksharon ki nekiyaan tees banti hain.

Adhik se adhik Qur'an tilaawat karne ki prerna.
Qur'an parhne waale ko uske dvaara parhe gae har akshar ke badle mein ek neki milti hai, jise das guna barhaakar tees neki kar diya jaata hai.
Allah ke wishaal anugrah tatha uski daya ki ek baangi yeh hai ki woh neki ke kaamon ka pratiphal barhaakar deta hai.
Any waaniyon par Qur'an ki fazeelat aur uski tilaawat ka ibaadat hona. Aisa isliye ki Qur'an Allah ki waani hai.
6276: Jo Qur'an ko madhur aawaaz se na parhe, woh ham mein se nahin hai
Abu lubaaba basheer bin abdul munzir (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah jo Qur'an ko madhur aawaaz se na parhe, woh ham mein se nahin hai.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is hadees mein madhur aawaaz mein Qur'an parhne ki prerna di hai. Daraasal hadees mein aye hue shabd "مَن لَم يَتَغنَّ بِالقُرآنِ" Ke do arth hain : Ek, jo madhur aawaaz mein Qur'an na parhe aur dusra, jo Qur'an se santusht hokar any sthaanon mein maargadarshan dhoondhna na chhore, woh ham mein se nahin hai. Daraasal yeh bari sakht chetaavni hai, jo is baat ko pramaanit karti hai ki yeh ek bara gunaah hai, jo chetaavni evn dhamki ka haqdaar hai. Is baat mein koi sandeh hai bhi nahin ki jo Qur'an ko chhor kaheen aur maargadarshan dhoondhe, use Allah gumraah kar dega. Ham is tarah ke paapon se Allah ki sharan maangte hain. Is hadees se maaloom hua ki insaan ko madhur aawaaz mein Qur'an parhna chahiye aur usi se santusht rahna chahiye.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6326: Allah muhsin arthaat paropkaari hai, isi liye woh pratyek wastu ke saath ehsaan kiye jaane ko pasand karta hai. Atah jab tum us vyakti ko qatl karo, jisko islaami dand- sanhita ke anusaar qatl karna aniwaary to achchhe andaaz mein qatl karo aur jab zibah karo, to achchhe andaaz mein zibah karo. Tum apni chhuri ko tez kar lo aur apne zabeehe ko aaraam pahunchaao.

Shaddaad bin aus (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se do cheezen yaad ki hain. Aapne farmaya tha ki Allah muhsin arthaat paropkaari hai, isi liye woh pratyek wastu ke saath ehsaan aur shishtaachaar kiye jaane ko pasand karta hai. Atah jab tum us vyakti ko qatl karo, jisko qatl karna islaami dand- sanhita ke anusaar aniwaary ho to achchhe andaaz mein qatl karo aur jab zibah karo, to achchhe andaaz mein zibah karo. Tum apni chhuri ko tez kar lo aur zibah kiye jaane waale jaanvar ko aaraam pahunchaao.
[ise abdur razzaaq ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6327: Aadam ki santaan ne mujhe jhuthlaya, haalaanki use aisa karne ka hak nahin tha. Mujhe gaali di, haalaanki aisa karne ka use koi adhikaar nahin tha

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Allah kahta hai : Aadam ki santaan ne mujhe jhuthlaya, haalaanki use aisa karne ka hak nahin tha. Mujhe gaali di, haalaanki aisa karne ka use koi adhikaar nahin tha. Uska mujhe jhuthlaana uska yeh kahna hai ki usne mujhe jis prakaar pahli baar paida kiya hai, us prakaar dobaara paida nahin karega, jabki pahli baar paida karna mere liye doosri baar paida karne se adhik aasaan nahin tha. Uska mujhe gaali dena,uska yeh kahna hai ki Allah ne putr bana liya hai, haalaanki main ek hun tatha tamaam sanpoorn gunon mein sampoornata se wesheshit hoon, na mainne jana hai aur na hi jana gaya hoon aur koi meri baraabri ka nahin hai."

Is hadees-e-qudsi mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne awishvaasiyon evn anekeshvarvaadiyon ke baare mein bataya hai ki woh use jhuthlaate aur kamiyon, aibon tatha anuchit wisheshnon se wisheshit karte hain, jo unko shobha nahin deta.

Jahaan tak unke dvaara Allah ko jhuthlaye jaane ki baat hai, to yeh daraasal unki yeh dhaarna hai ki Allah maut ke baad unko dobaara jeewit nahin karega, jis prakaar pahli baar anastitv se astitv pradaan kiya tha. Chunaanche Allah ne unka khandan karte hue kaha hai ki jisne unko anastitv se astitv pradaan kiya, woh unko dobaar jeewit karke utha bhi sakta hai. Balki yeh kaam unke liye kaheen zyaada aasaan hai. Yadyapi (waastawik drishtikon se dekha jaye to) Allah ke liye pahli baar aur dobaara paida karna donon baraabar hain, kyonki woh sab kuchh karne ki kshamta rakhta hai.

Jabki unke gaali dene se muraad unka yeh kahna hai ki Allah ki santaan hai. Lihaaza Allah ne unka khandan karte hue kaha hai ki woh akela hai, apne naamon, gunon aur kaaryo mein sanpoorn evn paripoorn hai, har kami evn aib se paak hai aur nisprih hai, sab uske mohtaaj hain aur woh kisi ka mohtaaj nahin hai, woh kisi ka pita nahin hai, kisi ki santaan nahin hai tatha koi uska samkaksh evn sadrishy bhi nahin hai.

Sarvashaktimaan Allah ke liye shakti ki paripoornata ko siddh karna.
Maut ke baad dobaara uthaya jaana hai.
Dobaara uthaye jaane ka inkaar karne ya Allah ki aulaad hone ka daawa karne waala kaafir hai.
Allah ke jaisa aur uska samtuly koi nahin hai.
Allah bara sahansheel hai. Awishvaasiyon ko tauba karke uski or laut aane ka avsar deta hai.
6328: Allah ne garbhaashay ke saath ek farishta laga rakha hai, woh kahta haih ai rab! Yeh abhi weery hai. Ai rab! Yeh abhi jame hue khoon ki shakl mein hai. Ai rab! Yeh abhi gosht ka lothra bana hua. Phir Allah jab use poorn roop se paida karna chaahta hai, to woh kahta haih ai rab! Yeh nar hoga ya naari, abhaaga hoga ya bhaagyawaan, aajeewika kitni milegi? Maut kab hogi? Is prakaar, yeh baaten maan ke pet mein hi likh di jaati hain

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) se marfooan warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Allah ne garbhaashay ke saath ek farishta laga rakha hai, woh kahta haih ai rab! Yeh abhi weery hai. Ai rab! Yeh abhi jame hue khoon ki shakl mein hai. Ai rab! Yeh abhi gosht ka lothra bana hua. Phir Allah jab use poorn roop se paida karna chaahta hai, to woh kahta haih ai rab! Yeh nar hoga ya naari, abhaaga hoga ya bhaagyawaan, aajeewika kitni milegi? Maut kab hogi? Is prakaar, yeh baaten maan ke pet mein hi likh di jaati hain.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Allah ne garbhaashay ke saath ek farishta laga rakha hai." Yaani Allah ne garbhaashay se sanbandhit kaaryon ke niptaara ke liye ek farishta niyukt kar rakha hai. Jnaat ho ki garbhaashay maata ke pet ka woh sthaan hai, jahaan shishu palta hai. "Woh kahta hai : "أي ربّ نطفة" Yaani ai mere paalanhaar! Abhi yeh weery hai. Arbi shabd nutfa se muraad purush ka weery hai. Isi tarah baad mein aane waale waaky : "أي ربّ علقة" Ka arth hai, ai mere paalanhaar! Abhi yeh jama hua rakt hai, tatha "أي ربّ مضغة" Ka arth hai, ai mere paalanhaar! Abhi yeh maans ka tukra hai. Ek any hadees mein spasht kar diya gaya hai ki inmen se har marahle ki avdhi chaalees din hai. Phir Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Phir Allah jab use" Yaani maans ke tukre ko, jo is silsile ka antim marahla hai, "Poorn roop se paida karna chaahta hai" Yaani usmen rooh phoonk kar use sanpoorn rachna ka roop dena chaahta hai, jaisa ki ek any riwayat mein iska ullekh hai. Jnaat ho ki aisa ek sau bees din ke baad hota hai. Tab farishta kahta hai : "Ai mere rab! Yeh nar hoga ya naari?" Yaani ai mere rab! Yeh purush hoga ki purush likh loon ya stri hoga ki main stri likh loon? "Abhaaga hoga ya bhaagyawaan?" Yaani yeh abhaaga tatha phalasvaroop jahannami hoga ki main abhaaga evn jahannami likh loon ya bhaagyawaan evn phalasvaru jannati hoga ki main bhaagyawaan evn jannati likh loon? "Iski aajeewika kitni hogi?" Thori ya zyaada? Tatha kis parimaan mein? "Ayu kitni hogi?" Lanbi athva chhoti? "Chunaanche, yeh baaten maan ke pet hi mein likh di jaati hain." Yaani ukt baaten Allah ke nirdesh anusaar usi samay likh di jaati hain, jab bachcha maan ke pet mein hota hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6329: Jab Allah kisi samuday ko azaab mein lipt karna chaahta hai, to pratyek vyakti ko us yaatna se grast karta hai, phir har ek apne karmon ke anusaar uthaya jayega

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue sunaah jab Allah kisi samuday ko azaab mein lipt karna chaahta hai, to pratyek vyakti ko us azaab se grast karta hai, phir har ek apne karmon ke anusaar uthaya jayega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6331: Samast insaanon ke dil, rahmaan (Allah) ki do ungliyon ke beech ek dil ki tarah hain ki woh use jis prakaar chaahta hai, ulatta-palatta rahta hai.

Abdullah bin amr -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : "Samast insaanon ke dil, rahmaan (Allah) ki do ungliyon ke beech ek dil ki tarah hain ki woh use jis prakaar chaahta hai, ulatta-palatta rahta hai." Phir Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne yeh dua parhi : "Ai Allah, ai dilon ko ulatne-palatne waale! Hamaare dilon ko apne aajnaapaalan ki or pher de."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki aadam ki santaanon ke dil dayaawaan Allah ki ungliyon mein se do ungliyon ke beech ek hi dil ki tarah hain. Woh unhen jaise chaahta hai, pherta hai. Agar chaahe to saty par qayam rakhta hai aur chaahe to saty se door hata deta hai. Uske liye tamaam dilon ko ulatna-palatna ek hi dil ko ulatne-palatne jaisa hai. Uske liye koi vyastata doosri vyastata se baadha nahin banti. Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne dua farmaate hue kaha : Ai Allah! Dilon ko kabhi bhalaai ki or, kabhi buraai ki or aur kabhi zikr aur kabhi ghaphlat ki or pherne waale! Hamaare dilon ko apne aajnaapaalan ki or pher de.

Taqdeer ka saboot. Allah bandon ke dilon ko unki likhi hui taqdeer ke anusaar alag-alag dishaaon mein laga deta hai.
Ek musalmaan ko sada apne paalanhaar se saty ke maarg par qayam rakhne ki dua karte rahna chahiye.
Kewal ek Allah se darna chahiye aur usi se aasha rakhni chahiye.
Aajurri kahte hain : Satyawaadi musalmaan sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ke wahi gun bayaan karte hain, jo khud Allah ne, uske Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aur sahaaba ne bayaan kiye hain. Yahi sunnat ka anusran karne aur bidaat se door rahne waale Muslim widvaanon ka maarg haiै. Ahl-e-sunnat Allah ke un naamon tatha gunon ko, unke saath chherchhaar kiye bina, unhen arthaheen kiye bina, unki kaifiyat bataye bina aur misaal diye bina, siddh karte hain, jinhen khud Allah ne siddh kiye hain.
