Is wishay mein un baaton ka inkaar karte hain, jinka inkaar khud Allah ne kiya hai aur jin cheezon ke baare mein shareeyat mein koi ullekh na ho, unke baare mein khaamosh rahte hain. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : {لَيْسَ ‌كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ} (Allah ke jaisi koi cheez nahin hai. Woh sab kuchh sunne waala, dekhne waala hai.)
6332: Ai Allah! Main tujhse neki ke kaam karne ki kshamta maangta hoon, buraaiyon ko chhorne ka suyog maangta hoon, adheenon se prem karne ka manobal maangta hoon aur is baat ka praarthi hoon ki tu mere saare gunaahon ko maaph kar de aur mujhpar daya kar. Jab tu kisi samuday ko wipda grast karna chaahe to mujhe us wipda mein lipt karne se pahle hi utha lene ka tujhse anunay- winay karta hoon aur tujhse main tera prem aur tujhse prem karne waale ka prem maangta hoon aur us karm ka prem maangta hoon jo tere prem se kareeb kar de

Muaaz bin jabal (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ek din Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne fajr ki namaz ke liye aane mein wilanb kiya, yahaan tak ki sury nikalne laga, to bari tezi se aye aur namaz ke liye iqaamat kahi gai aur aap ne sankshipt namaz parhaai. Salaam pherne ke pashchaat oonchi aawaaz se farmayaah apni pankti mein usi tarah khare raho. Phir hamaari or mukh karke farmayaah main tumhen bataaoonga ki kis ne mujhe roke rakhaah main ne raat ko uth kar wazu karke suyog ke anusaar namaz parhi aur mujhe namaz hi mein gahri neend a gai. To kya dekhta hoon ki main Allah taaala ke sammukh hoon jo apni sabse sundar roop mein hai. Allah ne kahaah ai Muhammad! Mainne kahaah ai mere rab! Upasthit hoon. Kahaah sabse uchch koti ke farishte kis baat par waad- wiwaad kar rahe hain? Mainne kahaah mujhe pata nahi ai mere rab! Aisa teen baar kaha. Farmaate hainh mainne use mere donon kandhon ke beech apna haath rakhte hue dekha yahaan tak ki uski ungliyon ki thandak seene mein mahsoos ki aur pratyek wastu mere liye prakat ho gai aur main ne jaan liya. Kahaah ai mohammad! Mainne kahaah ai mere rab! Upasthit hoon. Kahaah kis baare mein farishte jhagar rahe hain? Mainne kahaah prayashchit ke saadhnon ke prati. Kahaah woh kya hain? Mainne kahaah jamaaat ke saath namaz parhne ke liye chal kar jaana, namaz ke pashchaat masjid mein baithe rahna, naagvaari ke baavjood achchhi tarah wazu karna. Kahaah kis baare mein? Mainne kahaah khaana khilaane, komalta se baat karne aur raat mein us wakt namaz parhne ke baare mein jabki log so rahe hon. Kahaah maango. Mainne kaha: Ai Allah! Main tujhse neki ke kaam karne ki kshamta maangta hoon, buraaiyon ko chhorne ka suyog maangta hoon, adheenon se prem karne ka manobal maangta hoon aur is baat ka praarthi hoon ki tu mere saare gunaahon ko maaph kar de aur mujhpar daya kar. Jab tu kisi samuday ko wipda grast karna chaahe to mujhe us wipda mein lipt karne se pahle hi utha lene ka tujhse anunay- winay karta hoon aur tujhse main tera prem aur tujhse prem karne waale ka prem maangta hoon aur us karm ka prem maangta hoon jo tere prem se kareeb kar de. Phir Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya ki yeh hak aur sach hai. Ise parho aur achchhi tarah seekh lo.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6333: Ek yahoodi ne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aakar kahaah ai Muhammad, Allah (qayaamat ke din) aakaashon ko ek ungli par, dhartiyon ko ek ungli par, pahaaron ko ek ungli par, peron ko ek ungli par aur saari srishtiyon ko ek ungli par thaam lega aur phir kahega : Main hi baadshaah hoon.

Abdullah bin masaood -radiyallahu anhu- farmaate hain ki ek yahoodi ne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aakar kahaah ai Muhammad, Allah (qayaamat ke din) aakaashon ko ek ungli par, dhartiyon ko ek ungli par, pahaaron ko ek ungli par, peron ko ek ungli par aur saari srishtiyon ko ek ungli par thaam lega aur phir kahega : Main hi baadshaah hoon. Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hans pare, yahaan tak ki aapke saamne ke daant dikh gae. Phir aapne yeh ayat parhi : {وما قدروا اللهَ حقَّ قَدْرِه} (in logon ne Allah ka jaisa sammaan hona chahiye, waisa sammaan nahin kiya).

Is hadees se uchch evn mahaan Allah ki mahaanta ka pata chalta hai. Kyonki ismen bataya gaya hai ki Allah saare aakaashon ko apne wishaal evn sammaanit haath ki ek ungli par rakh lega, phir aapne kai wishaalkay srishtiyon ka naam ginaya aur bataya ki inmen se har kisi ko ek-ek ungli par rakh lega. Yaad rahe ki yadi sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah chaahe, to aakaashon evn dhartiyon ko tatha unmen maujood saari srishtiyon ko apne haath ki ek hi ungli par rakh le.
Choonki ukt jaankaari nabiyon se nasl dar nasl naqal hokar aai thi, jo unhen wahy ke maadhyam se sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah se praapt hui thi, isliye Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne yahoodi ki baat ki pushti ki aur uski baat se prasannata vyakt ki. Aap uski baat sun, uski pushti ke taur par, is tarah hans pare ki aapke saamne ke daant dikh gae. Iska ullekh abdullah bin masaood -radiyallahu anhu- ne ek any hadees mein kiya hai. Phir aapne yahoodi ke wichaar ki pushti aur uski siddhi ke liye Allah ke is kathan ko parha, jismen uske haathon ka ullekh hai : "Tatha unhonne Allah ka waisa sammaan nahin kiya, jaise uska sammaan karna chahiye tha aur dharti poori uski ek mutthi mein hogi, qayaamat ke din tatha aakaash lapete hue honge uske haath mein. Woh pawitr tatha uchch hai us shirk se, jo we kar rahe hain."
In pramaanon ke hote hue un logon ki baat par dhyaan nahin diya jayega, jo is shabd ko arthaheen bana dete hain aur Allah ke ungli hone ka inkaar karte hain tatha daawa yeh karte hain ki Allah ke liye ungli siddh karna use srishti ke samaan siddh karna hai. Jabki is prakaar ke logon ko pata hi nahin hai ki Allah ke liye ungli siddh karne se use srishti ke samaan siddh karna laazim nahin aata, kyonki ham Allah ke liye jeewan, saamarthy, shakti, sunaane tatha dekhne ki baat kahte hain aur isse uske srishti ke samaan hona laazim nahin aata. Kyonki pawitr Allah ki shaan yeh hai ki "Uske jaisi koi cheez nahin hai aur woh sunne waala dekhne waala hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6334: Jahannam tatha Jannat mein tark-witark hua, to Jannat ne kaha : Mere bheetar kewal durbal evn nirdhan log hi prawesh karenge. Jabki Jahannam ne kaha : Mere bheetar zaalim aur ghamandi log prawesh karenge. Yeh sun Allah ne Jahannam se kaha : Tum meri yaatna ho, tumhaare maadhyam se main jisse chaahta hoon, inteqaam leta hoon, jabki Jannat se kaha : Tum meri daya ho, tumhaare maadhyam se main jispar chaahta hoon, daya karta hoon.

Abu huraira -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Jahannam tatha Jannat mein tark-witark hua, to Jannat ne kaha : Mere bheetar kewal durbal evn nirdhan log hi prawesh karenge. Jabki Jahannam ne kaha : Mere bheetar zaalim aur ghamandi log prawesh karenge. Yeh sun Allah ne Jahannam se kaha : Tum meri yaatna ho, tumhaare maadhyam se main jisse chaahta hoon, inteqaam leta hoon, jabki Jannat se kaha : Tum meri daya ho, tumhaare maadhyam se main jispar chaahta hoon, daya karta hoon."
[is arth ki hadees Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat ki hai.]
6335: Abu saaleh hamen aadesh diya karte the ki jab hammen se koi sone ka iraada kare, daahine karvat par soe.

Suhail kahte hain ki abu saaleh hamen aadesh diya karte the ki jab hammen se koi sone ka iraada kare, daahine karvat par soe aur phir kahe : "Ai aakaashon ke rab, dharti ke rab aur mahaan arsh ke rab! Hamaare aur pratyek wastu ke rab! Daanon aur guthliyon ko cheerne waale! Tauraat, injeel tatha furqaan utaarne waale! Main aisi pratyek wastu se teri sharan maangta hoon, jiski peshaani tere haath mein hai. Ai Allah! Tu hi pratham hai, tujhse poorv kuchh nahin tha. Tu hi antim hai, tere pashchaat kuchh nahin hoga. Tu hi zaahir hai, tere oopar kuchh nahin hai. Tu hi baatin hai, tere baad kuchh nahin hai. Hamaara qarz ada kar de aur hamse nirdhanta ko door kar de." Woh is hadees ko abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ke waaste se Nabi-sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se riwayat karte the.
6336: Jab koi Muslim vyakti namaz evn zikr ke liye masjidon mein aniwaary roop se upasthit hone lagta hai, to Allah usse usi prakaar prasann hota hai, jis prakaar kisi khoe hue vyakti ke ghar aane par uske ghar waale prasann hote hain.

Abu huraira -Allah unse prasann ho- se warnit hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Jab koi Muslim vyakti namaz evn zikr ke liye masjidon mein aniwaary roop se upasthit hone lagta hai, to Allah usse usi prakaar prasann hota hai, jis prakaar kisi khoe hue vyakti ke ghar aane par uske ghar waale prasann hote hain."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6337: Jo mere kisi wali (mitr) se shatruta ka raasta apnayega, main uske saath jang ka elaan karta hoon. Mera banda jin kaamon ke dvaara meri nikatta praapt karna chaahta hai, unmen mere nikat sabse pyaari cheez mere farz kiye hue kaam hain

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne pharmaya : "Allah kahta hai : Jo mere kisi wali (mitr) se shatruta ka raasta apnayega, main uske saath jang ka elaan karta hoon. Mera banda jin kaamon ke dvaara meri nikatta praapt karna chaahta hai, unmen mere nikat sabse pyaari cheez mere farz kiye hue kaam hain. Jabki mera banda naflon ke maadhyam se mujhse nikatta praapt karta jaata hai, yahaan tak ki main usse mohabbat karne lagta hoon aur jab main usse mohabbat karta hoon, to uska kaan ban jaata hoon, jisse woh sunta hai; uski aankh ban jaata hoon, jisse woh dekhta hai; uska haath ban jaata hoon, jisse woh pakarta hai aur uska paanv ban jaata hoon, jisse woh chalta hai. Ab agar woh mujhse maangta hai, to main use deta hoon aur agar mujhse panaah maangta hai, to main use panaah deta hoon. Mujhe kisi kaam mein, jise main karna chaahta hoon, utna sankoch nahin hota, jitna apne momin bande ki jaan nikaalne mein hota haim, jab ki woh maut ko naapsand karta ho aur mujhe bhi use takleeph dena achchha nahin lagta."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is hadees-e-qudsi mein bataya hai ki sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : Jisne mere kisi wali (param mitr) ko kasht diya, naaraaz kiya aur usse dvesh rakha, main use bhali bhaanti jaanta hoon aur usse meri or se dushmani ka ailaan hai.

Waali se muraad Allah se darne waala aur uske deen ka paalan karne waala momin hai. Jiske daaman mein eemaan, Allah ke bhay aur uske deen ke anupaalan ka jitna bhaag hoga, use Allah se dosti ka utna bhaag naseeb hoga. Ek musalmaan ko jin cheezon se Allah ki nikatta praapt hoti hai, Allah ke yahaan unmen sabse priy cheezen woh hain, jo Allah ne uspar farz ki hain. Ismen Allah ke bataye hue nek kaamon ko karna aur uski haraam ki hui cheezon se door rahna donon shaamil hain. Ek musalmaan farz cheezon ke saath-saath nafal cheezon dvaara Allah ki nikatta praapt karta jaata hai aur ek samay aata hai,jab use Allah ki mohabbat haasil ho jaati hai. Phir, jab Allah usse mohabbat karne lagta hai, to uske shareer ke nimnalikhit chaar angon ko sahi disha par laga deta hai :

Uske kaan ko sahi disha par laga deta hai. To woh wahi sunta hai, jo Allah ko pasand ho.

Uski drishti ko sahi disha par laga deta hai. Atah woh wahi dekhta hai, jise dekhna Allah ko pasand ho.

Uske haath ko sahi disha par laga deta hai. Woh apne haath se wahi kaam karta hai, jo Allah ko pasand ho.

Uske paanv ki sahi disha tay kar deta hai. Woh usi disha mein barhta hai, jo Allah ko pasand ho aur wahi kaam karta hai, jismen bhalaai ho.

Saath hi agar Allah ke aage haath phailaata hai, to uski jholi bhar deta hai. Uski dua qabool hoti hai. Agar woh Allah se sharan maangta hai, to Allah use bhay se mukti pradaan karta hai.

Ant mein uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : Mujhe koi kaam karte hue utni hichkichaahat nahin hoti, jitni hichkichaahat momin ki rooh qabz karte hue uspar daya ke kaaran hoti hai. Kyonki maut ke kasht ke kaaran use maut naapsand hoti hai aur Allah aisi cheezon ko naapsand karta ho, jo momin ke liye kashtakar hon.

Yeh hadees un hadeeson mein se ek hai, jinhen Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne paak rab se riwayat kiya hai. Is tarah ki hadeeson ko hadees-e-qudsi ya hadees-e-ilaahi kaha jaata hai. Isse muraad woh hadees hai, jiske shabd evn arth donon Allah ke hon. Albatta, iske andar Qur'an ki wisheshtayen, jaise uski tilaawat ka ibaadat hona, uske liye tahaarat haasil karna, uska chamatkaar hona aur us jaisi waani prastut karne ki chunauti dena, aadi nahin paai jaateen.
Allah ke waliyon ko kasht dene ki manaahi tatha unse mohabbat rakhne aur unki fazeelat ko sveekaar karne ki prerna.
Allah ke dushmanon se dushmani rakhne ka aadesh aur unse dosti rakhne ki manaahi.
Jisne Allah ki shareeyat ka anusran kiye baghair uske wali hone ka daawa kiya, woh apne daawe mein jhootha hai.
Allah ke wali banne ka saubhaagy uske dvaara aniwaary kiye gae kaamon ko karne aur uski haraam ki hui cheezon ko chhorne ke baad praapt hota hai.
Allah ki mohabbat ki praapti aur uske yahaan dua grahan hone ka ek sabab Allah ke aniwaary kiye hue kaaryon ko karne aur uski haraam ki hui cheezon ko chhorne ke baad nafal ibaadten karna hai.
Waliyon ki shrashthata evn uchch sthaan ka ullekh.
6338: Jab Allah ne Jannat mein aadam ka chitr banaya, to jab tak chaaha, use usi dasha mein chhore rakha. Is beech iblees uske choron or chakkar lagaane laga aur dekhne laga ki yeh kya hai! Jab dekha ki woh andar se khaali hai, to samajh gaya ki Allah ne koi aisi makhlooq banaai hai, jise apne oopar niyantran nahin hoga.

Anas bin maalik -Allah unse prasann ho- se warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Jab Allah ne Jannat mein aadam ka chitr banaya, to jab tak chaaha, use usi dasha mein chhore rakha. Is beech iblees uske choron or chakkar lagaane laga aur dekhne laga ki yeh kya hai! Jab dekha ki woh andar se khaali hai, to samajh gaya ki Allah ne koi aisi makhlooq banaai hai, jise apne oopar niyantran nahin hoga."
6361: Logon ke andar kufr ki do baaten paai jaati rahengi : Kisi ke kul par kataaksh karna, tatha mare hue vyakti par wilaap karna.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, unhonne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Logon ke andar kufr ki do baaten paai jaati rahengi : Kisi ke kul par kataaksh karna, tatha mare hue vyakti par wilaap karna."

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- logon ke andar paai jaane waali do baaton ka zikr kar rahe hain ki woh daraasal awishvaaspoorn kaary evn ajnaanta kaal ke charitr hain. Ye donon kaary hain :

1- logon ke nasab par taana kasna, unhen neecha dikhaana aur unke prati ghamandi hona.

2- museebat ke samay Allah ke nirnay se naaraaz hokar zor-zor se rona aur vyaakul hokar kapre phaarna.

Winamr rahne aur abhimaan se bachne ki prerna.
Museebat ke samay sabr se kaam lena aur Allah ke nirnay se naaraaz na hona aniwaary hai.
Oopar bayaan kiye gae kaaryon ka sanbandh chhote awishvaas (kufr) se hai. Kisi ke andar chhote awishvaas waali koi baat paai jaye, to woh Islam ke dayre se baahar nikal nahin jaata. Aadmi Islam ke dayre se baahar usi samay nikalta hai, jab bare awishvaas (kufr) waala koi kaary kare.
Islam ne nasab par taana kasne aur is prakaar ke tamaam kaaryon se roka hai, jo musalmaanon ke andar bikhraav paida karte hain.
6362: Ise nikaal do, kyonki yeh tumhaari beemaari ko barhaane hi ka kaam karega. Tatha yadi tum ise pahankar maroge, to kabhi saphal nahin ho sakoge.

Imraan bin husain (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek vyakti ke haath mein peetal ka ek kara dekha, to usse kahaah "Yeh kya hai?" Usne uttar diyaah waahina (ek beemaari) ke kaaran ise pahne hua hoon. Aapne farmayaah "Ise nikaal do, kyonki yeh tumhaari beemaari ko barhaane hi ka kaam karega. Tatha yadi tum ise pahankar maroge, to kabhi saphal nahin ho sakoge."

Imraan bin husain -radiyallahu anhuma- ne yahaan Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki shirk se laraai aur logon ko usse mukti dilaane se sanbandhit ek ghatna ka ullekh kiya hai. Ghatna is tarah hai ki aapne ek vyakti ko taanba ka ek kara pahna hua dekha, to usese pahanne ka kaaran poochha. Usne bataya ki kasht se bachne ke liye aisa kiya hai, to use awilanb kare ko nikaal phenkne ka aadesh diya aur bataya ki yeh laabhdayak nahin, haanikaarak hai, tatha jis beemaari ke kaaran use pahna hai, isse woh aur barh jayegi. Isse bhi bari baat yeh hai ki yadi woh use pahankar mara, to aakhirat ki saphalta se bhi wanchit ho jayega.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6365: Main apne pita ke saath abu barza asalmi ke paas gaya. Mere pita ne unse poochha ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- farz namaz kaise parhte the?

Abul minhaal sayyaar bin salaama kahte hain ki main apne pita ke saath abu barza asalmi ke paas gaya. Mere pita ne unse poochha ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- farz namaz kaise parhte the? To farmayaah aap zohar ki namaz sooraj dhalne ke baad parhte aur asr ki namaz aise samay mein parhte ki uske pashchaat log madeene ke antim chhor mein sthit apne gharon tak pahunch jaate aur sooraj chamak raha hota. Unhonne maghrib ke baare mein jo kuchh kaha tha, use main bhool gaya hoon. Aap isha ki namaz, jise tum 'atma' kahte ho, der se parhna pasand karte aur usse pahle sona tatha uske baad baat karna naapsand karte. Fazr ki namaz se us samay nikalte, jab aadmi apne paas baithe hue vyakti ko pahchaan leta tatha ismen saath se sau ayten parhte.

Abu barza (radiyallahu anhu) farz namaazon ke samay ka wivran prastut karte hue kahte hain ki aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) zohar ki namaz soory ke beech aakaash se dhalne ke pashchaat parhte the aur yahi uska pahla waqt hai.
Asr ki namaz aise samay parhte ki ek namaazi namaz parhkar madeene ke antim chhor par sthit apna ghar waapas chala jaata aur sooraj chamakdaar hi rahta. Yeh bhi is namaz ka prathas samay hai.
Rahi baat maghrib ki, to iske baare mein unhonne kya kuchh kaha tha, warnankarta ko yaad nahin raha. Parantu any hadeeson aur ulema ke ijma se yeh pramaanit hai ki iska samay sooryaast se shuru hota hai.
Aap isha ki namaz der se parhna uttam jaante the. Kyonki uska sabse achchha samay yeh hai ki use uske upyukt samay ke ant mein parha jaye. Aap isha se pahle sona pasand nahin karte the, taaki woh upyukt samay se dar na ho jaye ya uski jamaat chhoot na jaye ya phir itni gahri neend na a jaye ki raat ki namaz chhoot jaye. Isi tarah aap isha ki namaz ke baad baat karna bura jaante the ki kaheen aisa na ho ki sasmay fajr ki namaz na parh saken ya jamaat chhoot jaye tatha fajr ki namaz parhkar us samay nikalte, jab aadmi apne paas baithe hue vyakti ko pahchaan leta, jabki aap usmen saath se sau ayten parhte the, jo is baat ka pramaan hai ki aap fajr ki namaz andhere mein parhte the.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6366: Tummen se jo bhi (jihaad mein) jaane waale ke ghar waalon tatha uske maal ki achchhi tarah zimmewaari nibhayega, use (jihaad mein) nikalne waale ke baraabar neki milegi.

Abu saeed khudri -Allah unse prasann ho- se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne banu lehyaan ki or ek sena bheji aur farmaya : "Har do vyaktiyon mein se ek vyakti uthe aur neki donon ko milegi."
Ek riwayat mein hai : "Pratyek do vyaktiyon mein se ek vyakti nikle." Phir ghar mein rahne waale ke liye farmaya : "Tummen se jo bhi (jihaad mein) jaane waale ke ghar waalon tatha uske maal ki achchhi tarah zimmewaari nibhayega, use (jihaad mein) nikalne waale ke baraabar neki milegi."
6367: Log sone chaandi ke khadaan ki tarah khadaan hain. Jo log jaahiliyat mein behtar the, we Islam mein bhi behtar hain, yadi Islam ki samajh praapt kar len. Saare praan ekatr sena the; jis-jis ne wahaan ek-doosre ko pahchaana, woh duniya mein ek-doosre se prem rakhte hain, aur jis-jis ne wahaan ek-doosre ki pahchaan na ki, woh yahaan ek-doosre se begaana rahte hain.

Abu huraira -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Log sone chaandi ke khadaan ki tarah khadaan hain. Jo log jaahiliyat mein behtar the, we Islam mein bhi behtar hain, yadi Islam ki samajh praapt kar len. Saare praan ekatr sena the; jis-jis ne wahaan ek-doosre ko pahchaana, woh duniya mein ek-doosre se prem rakhte hain, aur jis-jis ne wahaan ek-doosre ki pahchaan na ki, woh yahaan ek-doosre se begaana rahte hain."
Tatha abu huraira -Allah unse prasann ho- hi se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Tum, logon ko khadaan ke samaan paaoge. Unmen jo jaahiliyat mein behtar the, we Islam mein bhi behtar hain, yadi deen ki samajh praapt kar len. Tum shaasan ke maamle sabse achchha un logon ko paaoge, jo use sabse adhik naapsand karne waale hon tatha tum sabse bura aadmi use paaoge, jo domunha ho. Inke paas ek chehre ke saath aata ho aur unke paas doosre chehre ke saath aata ho."
[ise donon riwayton ke saath Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6368: Tum (apne shaaskon ki baat) suno aur anusran karo, kathin paristhiti mein bhi tatha aasaan paristhiti mein bhi, chaahte hue bhi tatha na chaahte hue bhi evn us samay bhi jab tumpar kisi aur ko tarjeeh di jaye.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Tum (apne shaaskon ki baat) suno aur anusran karo, kathin paristhiti mein bhi tatha aasaan paristhiti mein bhi, chaahte hue bhi tatha na chaahte hue bhi evn us samay bhi jab tumpar kisi aur ko tarjeeh di jaye."

Is hadees mein bataya gaya hai ki ek musalmaan par har haal mein shaaskon ki baat maanna aur unke adeshon ka paalan karna zaroori hai, jab tak use kisi gunaah ya aisi baat ka paaband na banaya jaye, jiske paalan ki woh kshamta na rakhta ho, yadyapi use ismen kabhi-kabhi kathinaai ka bhi saamna karna pare ya uske kuchh adhikaar nasht ho jayen. Daraasal aisa use saadhaaran hit ko vyaktigat hit par aage rakhte hue karna chahiye.
6369: Jab ham Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke haath par sunne tatha aajna ka paalan par baiat karte, to aap hamse farmaate : "Jahaan tak ho sake, iska paalan karna..”

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai, unhonne pharmaya ki jab ham Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke haath par sunne tatha aajna ka paalan par baiat karte, to aap hamse farmaate : "Jahaan tak ho sake, iska paalan karna..”

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- bata rahe hain ki sahaaba jab Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke haath par baiat karte, to aap unhen shaasak ki baat sunne tatha uski aajna ka paalan karne ka aadesh dete tatha aajnaapaalan ke saath saamarthy rakhne ki bandish laga dete the. Iska matlab yeh hua ki yadi kisi musalmaan ko shaasak ki or se aisi baat ka paaband banaya jaye, jo uski shakti se baahar ho, to uspar uski aajna ka paalan karna zaroori nahin hai. Allah taaala ka farmaan hai : "Allah kisi praani par uski shakti se adhik bojh nahin daalta."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6370: Ek Muslim vyakti par zaroori hai ki woh sune aur aajna ka paanal kare. Chaahe use pasand ho ya naapsand. Yeh aur baat hai ki use kisi gunaah ka aadesh diya jaye. Yadi use kisi gunaah ka aadesh diya jaata hai, to sunna aur aajna ka paalan karna zaroori nahin hai.

Ibne umar -Allah unse prasann ho- se marfooan warnit hai : "Ek Muslim vyakti par zaroori hai ki woh sune aur aajna ka paanal kare. Chaahe use pasand ho ya naapsand. Yeh aur baat hai ki use kisi gunaah ka aadesh diya jaye. Yadi use kisi gunaah ka aadesh diya jaata hai, to sunna aur aajna ka paalan karna zaroori nahin hai."

Is hadees mein bataya gaya hai ki shaasak ke aadeshon ka paalan karna aniwaary hai, chaahe uska aadesh hamen pasand ho ya naapsand. Haan, yadi kisi gunaah ka aadesh diya jaye, to baat alag hai. Kyonki gunaah ke kaam mein uske aadesh ka anupaalan nahin kiya jayega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6371: Jo sultaan ka apmaan karta hai, woh Allah ka apmaan karta hai.
Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko farmaate hue suna hai : "Jo sultaan ka apmaan karta hai, woh Allah ka apmaan karta hai."

Is hadees se saabit hota hai ki sultaan ke aadeshon ka anaadar karna haraam hai. Kyonki aisa karne waale ko kari chetaavni dete hue kaha gaya hai ki use Allah duniya evn aakhirat mein apmaanit karega. Kyonki insaan ko pratiphal bhi usi prakaar ka diya jaata hai, jis prakaar ka uska karm hota hai.
6373: Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is baat se mana farmaya hai ki koi mard zaaphraani (kesriya) rang ka istemaal kare.
Anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is baat se mana farmaya hai ki koi mard zaaphraani (kesriya) rang ka istemaal kare.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6374: Wayask ho jaane ke baad aadmi anaath nahin rahta aur raat hone tak din bhar khaamosh rahne ka koi auchity nahin hai.
Ali bin abu taalib -Allah unse prasann ho- se marfooan warnit hai : "Wayask ho jaane ke baad aadmi anaath nahin rahta aur raat hone tak din bhar khaamosh rahne ka koi auchity nahin hai."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6375: Abu bakar siddeeq -Allah unse prasann ho- ahmas samuday ki zainab naami ek mahila ke paas gae, to dekha ki woh baat nahin kar rahi hai.

Qais bin abu haazim kahte hain ki abu bakar siddeeq -Allah unse prasann ho- ahmas samuday ki zainab naami ek mahila ke paas gae, to dekha ki woh baat nahin kar rahi hai. Jab poochha ki baat kya hai ki yeh kuchh bol nahin rahi hai, to logon ne kaha : Usne khaamosh rahkar Hajj karne ki mannat maani hai. Yeh sun usse kaha : Tum baat karna shuru kar do. Kyonki tumhaara aisa karna halaal nahin hai. Yeh jaahiliyat kaal ka amal hai. Yeh sun woh baat karne lagi.
6376: Jisne apne pita ke siwa kisi ki or apne aapko mansoob kiya, jabki woh jaanta hai ki woh uska pita nahin hai, to uspar Jannat haraam hai.

Saad bin abu waqkaas -Allah unse prasann ho- se marfooan warnit hai : "Jisne apne pita ke siwa kisi ki or apne aapko mansoob kiya, jabki woh jaanta hai ki woh uska pita nahin hai, to uspar Jannat haraam hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6377: Apne pita se wimukh na ho, kyonki apne pita se wimukh hona kufr hai.
Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmaya : "Apne pita se wimukh na ho, kyonki apne pita se wimukh hona kufr hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6379: Jisne yeh kahkar qasam khaai ki laat tatha uzza ki qasam, woh 'la ilaaha illallah' kahe aur jisne apne saathi se kaha ki aao ham jua khelen, woh sadqa kare.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jisne yeh kahkar qasam khaai ki laat tatha uzza ki qasam, woh 'la ilaaha illallah' kahe aur jisne apne saathi se kaha ki aao ham jua khelen, woh sadqa kare."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam, Allah ko chhorkar kisi aur ki qasam khaane se saavdhaan kar rahe hain. Kyonki momin qasam kewal Allah ki khaata hai. Aap bata rahe hain ki jisne Allah ko chhorkar kisi aur, jaise laat evn uzza (ajnaanta kaal mein pooje jaane waale do but) ki qasam khaai, use qasam khaane ke baad apne is krity se khud ko alag karne aur qasam ka kaffaara ada karne ke liye la ilaaha illallah kahna chahiye.

Uske baad aapne bataya ki jisne apne saathi se kaha ki aao jua khelen, -jua naam hai do ya do se adhik logon ka is shart ke saath muqaable mein shaamil hone ka ki beech mein kuchh dhan rakha jaye, jise muqaabla jeetne waala le jayega. Jua mein insaan ya to jeetta hai ya phir haarta hai.-  uske liye kuchh na kuchh sadqa karna musathab hai, taaki jua ki or bulaane ke kaaran hone waale gunaah ka prayashchit ho jaye.

Qasam bas Allah aur uske naamon evn gunon ki khaana jayaz hai.
Allah ko chhor kisi aur ki qasam khaana haraam hai. Qasam chaahe buton, jaise laat evn uzza ki khaai jaye, amaanat ki khaai jaye, Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki khaai jaye ya kisi aur ki.
Khattaabi kahte hain : Qasam kewal sammaanit poojy Allah ki khaana jayaz hai. Atah agar kisi ne laat aadi ki qasam khaai, to usne awishvaasiyon jaisa kaam kiya. Isliye use iske prayashchit ke liye kalima-e-tauheed parhna chahiye.
Allah ko chhor kisi aur ki qasam khaane waale ko qasam waala kaffaara nahin dena hai. Use Allah ke saamne tauba karna aur kshama maangna hai. Kyonki yeh gunaah itna bara hai ki ise tauba ko chhor koi cheez mita nahin sakti.
Jua ke saare roop haraam hain. Jua ko Allah ne haraam qaraar dene ke saath-saath sharaab aur buton ke saath bayaan kiya hai.
Gunaah ho jaane ki sthiti mein usse waapas lautna zaroori hai.
Jis vyakti se koi gunaah ho jaye, use chahiye ki uske baad koi neki ka kaam kar le. Kyonki nekiyaan gunaahon ko khatm kar deti hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
6380: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek din subah ko dajjaal ka zikr kiya. Aapne use itna tuchchh bataya aur uske fitne ko itna bhayaanak dikhaya ki hamen lagne laga ki woh yaheen kaheen khajoor ke baagon ke paas maujood hoga.

Navvaas bin samaaan -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek din subah ko dajjaal ka zikr kiya. Aapne use itna tuchchh bataya aur uske fitne ko itna bhayaanak dikhaya ki hamen lagne laga ki woh yaheen kaheen khajoor ke baagon ke paas maujood hoga. Jab ham baad mein aapke paas aye, to aapne hamaare oopar uska spasht prabhaav mahsoos kiya. Atah, farmaya : “Baat kya hai?” hamne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, aapne dajjaal ka zikr kiya aur use itna tuchchh bataya aur uske fitne ko itna bhayaanak dikhaya ki ham samajhne lage ki woh yaheen kaheen khajoor ke baagh ke paas maujood hoga. Yeh sun aapne kaha : “Main tumhaare baare mein dajjaal ki tulna mein any baaton se adhik darta hoon. Yadi woh mere jeewankaal mein nikalta hai, to tumhaare sthaan par main svayn usse nimat loonga aur yadi woh mere jaane ke baad nikalta hai, to har vyakti svayn usse apna bachaav kar lega. Waise bhi Allah har musalmaan par mera jaansheen hai. Woh ghunghraale baalon waala ek jawaan hoga aur uski ek aankh ubhri hui hogi. Maano, main use abdul uzza bin qatan jaisa kah raha hoon. Jo use paye, uspar soora kahaf ke aaranbh ki ayten parhe. Woh iraaq tatha shaam ke beech se niklega aur chaaron or upadrav machayega. Atah, ai Allah ke bando, us samay tum jame rahna." Hamne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, woh dharti par kitne dinon tak rahega? Farmaya : "Chaalees dinon tak; jinmen se ek din ek saal, ek din ek maheene aur ek din ek saptaah ke baraabar hoga, jabki baaqi ke din saadhaaran dinon ki tarah honge." Hamne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, jo din ek saal ke baraabar hoga, us din kya ek din ki namaz kaafi hogi? Farmaya : "Nahin, balki tum anumaan lagaakar namaz parh lena." Hamne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, dharti par woh kitni tezi se chalega? Farmaya : "Us baarish ki tarah, jiske baad hawa aakar use sukha de. Woh logon ke paas ayega aur unhen apne oopar eemaan laane ko kahega. Jab log eemaan le ayenge, to woh aakaash ko baarish barsaane ka aadesh dega. Chunaanche baarish barasne lagegi tatha dharti se hariyaali nikal ayegi. Haal yeh hoga ki jab logon ke jaanvar charkar waapas ayenge, to unke kohaan oonche honge, than bahut lanbe honge aur pet bhare hue honge. Phir woh kuchh any logon ke paas ayega aur unhen bhi apni or bulayega, lekin we uska aahvaan sveekaar nahin karenge. Jab woh wahaan se waapas hoga, to wahaan baarish ruk jayegi, dharti sookh jayegi aur logon ke haath dhan-daulat se khaali ho jayenge. Woh kisi weeraan sthaan se guzrega aur usse kahega : Apna khazaana nikaal de. So, uske khazaane nar madhumakkhiyon ki tarah uske peechhe-peechhe chal parenge. Phir woh ek bharpoor jawaan vyakti ko bulayega aur use talvaar se sateek waar karke do tukre kar dega aur uske baad use bulayega, to woh hansta hua a jayega aur uska chehra chamak raha hoga. Dajjaal isi tarah upadrav nachaata phirega ki Allah taaala maseeh bin maryam -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko bhejega, jo poorvi dimashq ke safed meenaar ke paas utrenge. Woh peele rang ka jora pahne hue honge aur apni donon hatheliyaan do pharishton ke paron ke oopar rakhe hue honge. Jab apna sir jhukaenge, to paani tapkega aur jab uthayenge, to moti ki tarah chaandi ke daane jhar rahe honge. Jo bhi kaafir unki saans ki bu payega, mar jayega. Unki saans wahaan tak pahoonchegi, jahaan tak unki nigaah jaati hogi. Chunaanche maseeh dajjaal ko dhoondhte hue aage barhenge, yahaan tak ki baab-e-ludd mein use pa lenge aur qatl kar denge. Phir eesa un logon ke paas jayenge, jinhen Allah ne dajjaal se bacha rakha hoga. Unke chehre par haath pherenge aur unhen Jannat mein praapt hone waale unke darjon ki soochna denge. Isi haal mein honge ki Allah eesa –sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko wahy karega ki mainne kuchh aise bande nikaale hain, jinka saamna koi nahin kar sakta. Isliye tum mere bandon ko toor parvat le jaao. Phir Allah taaala yaajooj maajooj ko bhejega, jo chaaron or se tezi se nikalkar saamne ayenge. Haal yeh hoga ki unka pahla jattha tabriya saagar se guzrega, to uska saara paani pi jayega aur antim jattha wahaan pahunchne ke baad kahega ki yahaan kabhi paani hua karta tha. Eesa -alaihissalaam- aur aapke saathiyon ko gher liya jayega, yahaan tak ki bail ka ek sar bhi unke nikat usse kaheen adhik moolyawaan hoga, jitna aaj tumhaare yahaan sau deenaar ka mahatv hai. Aise mein, Allah ke Nabi eesa -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aur aapke saathi Allah se praarthana karenge. Chunaanche Allah unki gardanon mein ek keera paida kar dega, jisse we ek jaan ki tarah dher ho jayenge. Phir Allah ke Nabi eesa aur aapke saathi toor parvat se dharti par utrenge, to dharti mein ek bitta baraabar bhi jagah nahin payenge, jo unki laashon ke durgandh aur badbu khaali ho. Aise mein, phir Allah ke Nabi eesa –sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aur unke saathi -radiyallahu anhum- Allah se praarthana karenge, to Allah oonton ki gardanon ke samaan bari-bari pakshiyon ko bhejega, jo unhen uthaakar wahaan daal dengi, jahaan Allah chaahega. Phir sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah aisi baarish barsayega, jisse saare ghar wa shiwir gir jayenge aur dharti darpan ki tarah saaf-shaffaaf ho jayegi. Phir dharti se kaha jayega ki apne phal ugaao aur barkat waapas karo. So, aisi barkat hogi ki us samay ek anaar ko ek samooh milkar khayega aur uske chhilke se kshaya praapt karega. Doodh mein itni barkat hogi ki ek doodh waali oontni ek jamaat ko kaafi hogi, ek doodh waali gay ek qabeele ko paryaapt hogi aur ek doodh dene waali bakri ek pariwaar ki zaroorat poori karegi. Log isi dasha mein honge ki Allah ek khushboodaar hawa bhejega, jo unke baglon ke neeche lagegi aur jisse pratyek momin mard tatha mahila ko maut a jayegi aur kewal bure log shesh rah jayenge, jo gadhon ki tarah khule aam vyabhichaar karte phirenge. Aise hi logon par qayaamat ayegi."
6381: Madeena eer se lekar saur tak haram hai. Ismen jo vyakti dharm ke naam par koi naya kaam karega ya is tarah ka kaam karne waale kisi vyakti ko sharan dega, uspar Allah, farishton evn saare logon ki laanat hai. Qayaamat ke din Allah na uski tauba qabool karega, na fidya.

Yazeed bin taariq kahte hain ki mainne ali -Allah unse prasann ho- ko minbar par khutba ke dauraan kahte hue suna hai : Allah ki qasam, hamaare paas koi aisi pustak nahin hai, jise ham parhte hon, siway Allah ki kitaab ke aur uske jo kuchh is saheefe mein likha hai. Phir unhonne use khola, to usmen diyat mein diye jaane waale oonton ki ayu aur kuchh zakhmon ki diyat se sanbandhit dharmaadesh darj the. Saath hi, usmen yeh bhi likha tha ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Madeena eer se lekar saur tak haram hai. Ismen jo vyakti dharm ke naam par koi naya kaam karega ya is tarah ka kaam karne waale kisi vyakti ko sharan dega, uspar Allah, farishton evn saare logon ki laanat hai. Qayaamat ke din Allah na uski tauba qabool karega, na fidya.
Musalmaanon ka wachan ek hi hota hai aur unka chhote se chhota vyakti bhi wachan de sakta hai. Jo kisi Muslim ka diya hua wachan torega, uspar Allah, farishton evn saare logon ki laanat hai. Qayaamat ke din Allah na uski tauba qabool karega, na fidya.
Jo vyakti apne pita ko chhorkar kisi doosre ki or nisbat karega athva apne mukt karne waale ko chhorkar doosre ki or apni nisbat karega, uspar Allah, farishton evn saare logon ki laanat hai. Qayaamat ke din Allah na uski tauba qabool karega, na fidya."

Ali -radiyallahu anhu- ne minbar par khutba dete hue kaha : Allah ki qasam, Allah ki kitaab ke atirikt hamaare paas parhne ke liye koi kitaab nahin hai. Yadi kuchh hai, to bas yeh saheefa. Phir unhonne use kholkar dikhaya, to usmen diyat mein diye jaane waale oonton ki ayu aur zakhmon se sanbandhit masayal evn ahkaam lakhe hue the. Saath hi usmen yeh bhi likha tha ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki madeena, makka ki tarah hi haram hai,aur madeene mein yeh chhetr air parvat se saur parvat tak hai . Atah ismen jo vyakti dharm ke naam par koi naya kaam karega ya koi apraadh athva atyaachaar kar musalmaanon ko kasht pahunchaane ka sabab banega ya dharm ke naam par koi naya kaam karne waale ko sharan dega, uspar Allah ki laanat hai ki woh use apni daya se wanchit kar dega, farishte tatha saare log use Allah ki daya se door kiye jaane ki dua karenge aur Allah qayaamat ke din na uski farz ibaadat grahan karega, na nafal ibaadat grahan karega, na tauba grahan karega aur na fidya grahan karega.
Jahaan tak kisi musalmaan dvaara kisi kaafir ko suraksha dene ki baat hai, to yeh kuchh sharton ke saath sahi hai, jo prasiddh hain. Jab ye sharten paai jayen, to suraksha praapt kaafir se chher-chhaar haraam hogi. Atah jo kisi musalmaan dvaara di gai suraksha ka hanan karte hue suraksha praapt kaafir se chher-chhaar karega, uspar Allah ki laanat hai ki woh use apni daya se wanchit kar dega, farishte tatha saare log use Allah ki daya se door kiye jaane ki dua karenge aur Allah qayaamat ke din na uski farz ibaadat grahan karega, na nafal ibaadat grahan karega, na tauba grahan karega aur na fidya grahan karega.
Isi tarah jo apne pita ke atirikt kisi aur se apna sanbandh jorega ya jo aazaad kiya hua daas apne maalikon ke atirikt kisi aur ki or svayn ko sansoob karega, uspar Allah ki laanat hai ki woh use apni daya se wanchit kar dega, farishte tatha saare log use Allah ki daya se door kiye jaane ki dua karenge aur Allah qayaamat ke din na uski farz ibaadat grahan karega, na nafal ibaadat grahan karega, na tauba grahan karega aur na fidya grahan karega. Kyonki usne nemat ki naashukri ki, meeraas tatha wali banne ke haq aur diyat aadi se sanbandhit adhikaaron ka hanan kiya tatha rishta torne aur sanbandh wichchhed karne ka kaam kiya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6382: Baat suno aur anusran karo, yadyapi tumhaara shaasak kisi habshi daas hi ko kyon na bana diya jaye, jiska sar kishmish ki tarah ho.

Anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmaya : "Baat suno aur anusran karo, yadyapi tumhaara shaasak kisi habshi daas hi ko kyon na bana diya jaye, jiska sar kishmish ki tarah ho."

Aniwaary roop se apne shaaskon ki baat suno aur unka anusran karo. Yahaan tak ki yadi kisi habshi ghulaam ko bhi tumhaara shaasak bana diya jaye, jo ya to mool roop se habshi ho ya aanshik roop se habshi ho ya shaareerik banaawat ke roop se habshi ho aur uska sar kishmish ki tarah dikhta ho, tab bhi uski baat sunne aur uska anusran karne se gurez na karo. Aapne uska sar kishmish ki tarah dikhta ho, kahkar uske mool roop se athva aanshik roop se habshi hone ki baat mein zor paida kiya hai. Aapke shabd : "وإن استعمل" Mein sultaan ka ameer bhi shaamil hai aur svayn sultaan bhi. Udaaharnasvaroop yadi koi sultaan logon par taaqat ke bal par adhikaar praapt kar le aur sattaaseen ho jaye tatha woh arab na ho, balki habshi daas ho, tab bhi hamen uski baat sunni paregi aur uska anusran karna hoga.
Yeh hadees gunaah ke kaamon ko chhor tamaam maamlon mein shaaskon ke aajnaapaalan ke aniwaary hone ko pramaanit karti hai. Kyonki unke aajnaapaalan mein bhalaai, shaanti aur sthirta hai. Isse bikhraav se mukt waataavran banta hai aur manmaaniyon ke raaste band hote hain. Iske wipreet jahaan shaaskon ka aajnaapaalan zaroori ho aur unka aajnaapaalan na kiya jaye, to isse bikhraav paida hota hai, har vyakti manmaani par utar aata hai, ashaanti phail jaati hai, sistam chaupat ho jaata hai aur bahut-se fitne sar ubhaarne lagte hain.
6383: Jisne meri aajna ka paanal kiya, usne Allah ki aajna ka paalan kiya aur jisne meri awajna ki, usne Allah ki awajna ki. Jo ameer ki aajna ka paalan karta hai, woh meri aajna ka paalan karta hai aur jo ameer ki awajna karta, woh meri awajna karta hai.

Abu huraira -Allah unse prasann ho- se marfooan warnit hai : "Jisne meri aajna ka paanal kiya, usne Allah ki aajna ka paalan kiya aur jisne meri awajna ki, usne Allah ki awajna ki. Jo ameer ki aajna ka paalan karta hai, woh meri aajna ka paalan karta hai aur jo ameer ki awajna karta, woh meri awajna karta hai."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is hadees mein bataya hai ki aapka aajnaapaalan Allah ke aajnaapaalan mein daakhil hai. Kyonki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- unheen baaton ka aadesh dete the, jinhen Allah ne aapke tatha aapki ummat ke liye dhaarmik kaary ke roop mein prastut kiya hai. Atah, jab aap kisi baat ka aadesh den, to woh pawitr evn mahaan Allah ki shareeyat ka hissa hai. Isliye jisne aapki aajna ka paalan kiya, usne Allah ki aajna ka paalan kiya aur jisne aapki awajna ki usne Allah ki awajna ki.
Isi tarah, jab kisi ne ameer ka anusran kiya, usne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka anusran kiya aur jisne ameer ki awajna ki usne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki awajna ki. Kyonki ek se adhik hadeeson mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne iska aadesh diya hai. Haan, yadi ameer gunaah ka aadesh de, to baat alag hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6384: Tumhaare sabse achchhe shaasak woh hain, jinhen tum pasand karte ho aur we tumhen pasand karte hain. Isi tarah, we tumhaare liye daya ki praarthana karte hain aur tum unke liye daya ki praarthana karte ho. Jabki tumhaare sabse bure shaasak woh hain, jinhen tum naapsand karte ho aur we tumhen naapsand karte hain. Isi tarah, tum unpar laanat bhejte ho aur we tumpar laanat bhejte hain.

Auph bin maalik -Allah unse prasann ho- se marphooan warnit hai : "Tumhaare sabse achchhe shaasak woh hain, jinhen tum pasand karte ho aur we tumhen pasand karte hain. Isi tarah, we tumhaare liye daya ki praarthana karte hain aur tum unke liye daya ki praarthana karte ho. Jabki tumhaare sabse bure shaasak woh hain, jinhen tum naapsand karte ho aur we tumhen naapsand karte hain. Isi tarah, tum unpar laanat bhejte ho aur we tumpar laanat bhejte hain." Hamne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, kya ham unke wiruddh khare na ho jayen? Farmaya : "Nahin, jab tak we namaz qayam karte rahen. Nahin, jab tak we namaz qayam karte rahen."

Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki kuchh shaasak nek hote hain aur kuchh shaasak awajnaakaari evn kam deendaar hote hain. Lekin iske baavjood jab tak we Islam ke dhaarmik prateekon, jinmen sabse oopar namaz hai, ka paalan karte rahen, unse baghaawat karna jayaz nahin hai.
6386: Ham Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki agvaani ke liye bachchon ke saath saniyyatul wada tak gae.

Saaib bin yazeed -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab tabook yuddh se waapas aye, to logon ne aapki agvaani ki aur mainne bachchon ke saath saniyyatul wada par aapki agvaani ki.
Tatha bukhaari ki riwayat mein hai : Woh kahte hain ki ham Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki agvaani ke liye bachchon ke saath saniyyatul wada tak gae.
[ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6387: Yuddh se waapsi bhi yuddh ke samaan hai.
Abdullah bin amr bin aas -radiyallahu anhuma- se marphooan warnit hai : "Yuddh se waapsi bhi yuddh ke samaan hai."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6388: Kartavyanishth daas ke liye doguna pratiphal hai.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Kartavyanishth daas ke liye doguna pratiphal hai." Us hasti ki qasam, jiske haath mein abu huraira ki jaan hai, yadi Allah ke maarg mein jihaad, Hajj tatha maan ki dekh-rekh ki zimmewaari na hoti, to main is baat ko pasand karta ki daasta ki awastha mein maroon.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6389: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko jab bhi do cheezon mein se kisi ek ka chayan karna hota, to aap hamesha donon mein se adhik aasaan ka chayan karte, jab tak ki woh aasaan kaam paap na hota. Yadi woh paap hota, to aap usse sabse zyaada door rahte.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko jab bhi do cheezon mein se kisi ek ka chayan karna hota, to aap hamesha donon mein se adhik aasaan ka chayan karte, jab tak ki woh aasaan kaam paap na hota. Yadi woh paap hota, to aap usse sabse zyaada door rahte. (Isi tarah) Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kabhi apne liye badla nahin liya. Aap badla kewal us samay lete, jab Allah ki seemaaon ka ullanghan kiya jaata. Jab aisa hota, to Allah ke liye badla lete.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke aachran se juri hui kuchh baaten bayaan kar rahi hain. Woh bata rahi hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko jab bhi do cheezon mein se kisi ek ko chunne ka wikalp diya jaata, to aap adhik aasaan ko chunte, basharteki adhik aasaan cheez gunaah ka kaaran na ho. Agar aisa  hota to aap usse doosre logon ki tulna mein kaheen zyaada door bhaagte aur adhik kathin ka chayan karte. Isi tarah Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne khud apne liye kabhi kisi se badla nahin liya. Apna haq maaf kar dete aur kshama se kaam lete the. Haan, agar Allah ki seemaaon ka ullanghan kiya jaata, to Allah ke liye badla lete. Allah ke liye aapko doosron ki tulna mein kaheen adhik ghussa aata tha.

Adhik aasaan wastu ka chayan karna musathab hai, jab tak ki usmen gunaah ka pahlu na ho.
Islam ek aasaan dharm hai.
Allah ke liye krodhit hona ek shareeyat sammat kaary hai.
Sharai dandon ko laagu karne ke silsile mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki ganbheerta, dhairy aur drirh sankalp.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki kathin wastu ko chhorkar aasaan ko chunna chahiye.
Jab tak Allah ke adhikaaron ka ullanghan na ho, tab tak kshama aur sahansheelta ke saath kaary karne ke liye protsaahan.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
6390: Farishte abhi tak unpar apne paron se chhaya kiye hue hain.

Jaabir bin abdullah -radiyallahu anhuma- farmaate hain ki mere pita ko, jinke shareer ko kshat-wikshat kar diya gaya tha, Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas laya gaya aur aapke saamne rakha gaya. Jab main unke chehre se kapra hataane ke liye aage barha, to logon ne mujhe mana kiya. Ispar Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Farishte abhi tak unpar apne paron se chhaya kiye hue hain."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6391: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kabhi kisi ko apne haath se nahin maara. Isi tarah kisi mahila tatha daas par bhi haath nahin uthaya. Yeh aur baat hai ki Allah ke raaste mein jihaad kar rahe hon.

Aaisha -radiyallahu aुnha- se marfooan warnit hai : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kabhi kisi ko apne haath se nahin maara. Isi tarah kisi mahila tatha daas par bhi haath nahin uthaya. Yeh aur baat hai ki Allah ke raaste mein jihaad kar rahe hon. Isi tarah kabhi aisa nahin hua ki aapko koi kasht diya gaya aur aapne uska badla liya ho. Haan, yadi Allah ki seemaaon ka ullanghan kiya jaata, to Allah ke liye badla lete.
6392: Jo sena jihaad karte hue maale-ghaneemat praapt karti hai aur maut se surakshit rahti hai, use do tihaai pratiphal mil jaata hai aur jo sena maale-ghaneemat se wanchit rahti hai aur shaheed ho jaati hai, use poora-poora pratiphal mil jaata hai.

Abdullah bin amr bin aas -Allah unse prasann ho- se marfooan warnit hai : "Jo sena jihaad karte hue maale-ghaneemat praapt karti hai aur maut se surakshit rahti hai, use do tihaai pratiphal mil jaata hai aur jo sena maale-ghaneemat se wanchit rahti hai aur shaheed ho jaati hai, use poora-poora pratiphal mil jaata hai."
6396: Jo kisi Muslim daas ko mukt karta hai, Allah uske ek-ek ang ke badle mein iske ek-ek ang ko Jahannam se mukt kar deta hai, yahaan ki uski sharmagaah ke badle iski sharmagaah ko mukt kar deta hai.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se marfooan warnit hai : "Jo kisi Muslim daas ko mukt karta hai, Allah uske ek-ek ang ke badle mein iske ek-ek ang ko Jahannam se mukt kar deta hai, yahaan ki uski sharmagaah ke badle iski sharmagaah ko mukt kar deta hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6399: Jisne Allah ke maarg mein ek din roza rakha, Allah uske tatha Jahannam ki aag ke beech ek khaai bana deta hai, jiska faasla aakaash aur dharti ke beech ki doori ke baraabar hai.

Abu umaama -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Jisne Allah ke maarg mein ek din roza rakha, Allah uske tatha Jahannam ki aag ke beech ek khaai bana deta hai, jiska faasla aakaash aur dharti ke beech ki doori ke baraabar hai."
6401: Jisne teer andaazi seekhi, phir use chhor diya, woh hammen se nahin hai ya usne naafarmaani ki.
Uqba bin aamir -radiyallahu anhu- se marfooan warnit hai : "Jisne teer andaazi seekhi, phir use chhor diya, woh hammen se nahin hai ya usne naafarmaani ki."

Jisne teer chalaana seekha aur isi tarah jihaad ke aadhunik upkarnon ka chalaana jaise ki goli chalaana seekha, phir use chhor diya aur uski upeksha ki, to usne khud ko paap ka bhaagi banaya aur apne aapko Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke tareeq se door kar diya. "Woh hammen se nahin hai" Yeh ek ganbheer chetaavni hai, jo ingit karti hai ki yeh awajna ek bara paap hai, jo dhamki aur daant-phatkaar ka paatr hai. "Ya usne awajna ki" Yeh warnankarta ki or se ek sandeh hai ki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ''woh hammen se nahin hai'' kaha tha, ya aapne ''usne awajna ki'' kaha tha.
6403: Jisne jihaad nahin kiya athva kisi mujaahid ko taiyaar nahin kiya athva kisi mujaahid ke pashchaat uske ghar waalon ki dekh-rekh nahin ki, Allah use qayaamat se pahle hi kisi na kasi aapda mein grast kar dega.

Abu umaama -radiyallahu anhu- se marfooan warnit hai : "Jisne jihaad nahin kiya athva kisi mujaahid ko taiyaar nahin kiya athva kisi mujaahid ke pashchaat uske ghar waalon ki dekh-rekh nahin ki, Allah use qayaamat se pahle hi kisi na kasi aapda mein grast kar dega."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6404: Jo jihaad kiye bina athva jihaad ke iraade ke bina hi mar gaya, woh munaafiq hi awastha mein mara.
Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se marfooan warnit hai : "Jo jihaad kiye bina athva jihaad ke iraade ke bina hi mar gaya, woh munaafiq hi awastha mein mara."

Har woh vyakti jo jihaad karne mein saksham hai aur is awastha mein mar jaye ki usne na to jihaad kiya ho aur na hi uske baare mein apne dil mein socha ho, arthaat usne apne dil mein jihaad karne ke baare mein baat nahin ki. Iska matlab yeh ki usne jihaad ka sankalp nahin kiya, to uske andar kuchh na kuchh nifaaq (paakhand) hai. Jihaad ke sankalp ki ek zaahiri nishaani yuddh ke hathiyaar ki taiyaari hai. Allah taaala ka farmaan hai : (ولو أرادوا الخروج لأعدوا له عدة) "Yadi we nikalna chaahte, to awashy hi uske liye kuchh taiyaari karte."
Aapke shabd : "مات على شُعْبَةٍ من نِفَاقٍ" (Woh nifaaq ki ek shaakha par mar gaya) : Arthaat : Ek prakaar ke nifaaq ki awastha mein mara. Matlab yeh ki : Jo is awastha mein mara, woh munaafiqon tatha jihaad se peechhe rahne waalon ke samaan ho gaya. Tatha jo kisi jaati ki samaanta apnaye, woh unheen mein se hai. Atah har musalmaan ko jihaad ki neeyat rakhni chahiye.
Jihaad karne se abhipray : Jihaad ki sharton ke saath jihaad karna hai. Yadi we (sharten) paai jayen, to jihaad kiya jayega, anyatha uski neeyat baaqi rahegi yahaan tak ki jihaad ke kaaran paye jayen.
6405: Yeh daya hai, jise Allah -taaala- ne apne bandon ke dilon mein rakha hai aur Allah apne un bandon par daya karta hai, jo doosron par daya karte hain.

Usaama bin zaid -radiyallahu anhuma- farmaate hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke sammukh aapke nawaase ko laya gaya, jo maut ki dasha mein the, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki aankhen bah pareen. Yeh dekh saad (razyallahu anhu) ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, yeh kya hai?! To aapne uttar diya : "Yeh daya hai, jise Allah -taaala- ne apne bandon ke dilon mein rakha hai aur Allah apne un bandon par daya karta hai, jo doosron par daya karte hain."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6406: Kya aappar koi aisa din beeta hai, jo uhad ke din se adhik kathor raha ho? To aapne uttar diya : Tumhaari qaum ki or se mujhe isse bhi kathor din ka saamna karna para hai. Waise, unki or se mujhe jo sabse kathor din jhelna para, woh aqba ka din tha.

Aaisha -Allah unse prasann ho- ka warnan hai ki unhonne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha : Kya aappar koi aisa din beeta hai, jo uhad ke din se adhik kathor raha ho? To aapne uttar diya : "Tumhaari qaum ki or se mujhe isse bhi kathor din ka saamna karna para hai. Waise, unki or se mujhe jo sabse kathor din jhelna para, woh aqba ka din tha. Jab mainne apne aapko abd-e-yaaleel bin abd-e-kulaal ke beton ke saamne pesh kiya, to un logon ne meri baat nahin suni. Atah, main wahaan se vyathit hokar waapas ho gaya. Phir jab mein qarn-e-saaalib pahuncha, to mujhe hosh aya. Mainne apna sar uthaya, to dekha ki baadal ka ek tukra mujhpar chhaya kiye hua hai. Usmen dekha, to Jibreel -alaihis salaam- the. Unhonne mujhe aawaaz di aur kaha : Allah taaala ne aapke samuday ke logon ki baat sun li hai aur unka uttar bhi sun liya hai. Usne aapke paas pahaaron ke farishte ko bheja hai, taaki aap unke baare mein jo chaahen, aadesh den. Phir pahaaron ke farishte ne salaam karne ke pashchaat kaha : Ai Muhammad, Allah ne aapki jaati ki baat sun li hai. Main pahaaron ka farishta hoon. Mujhe mere rab ne aapke paas bheja hai, taaki aap mujhe jo chaahen, aadesh karen. Yadi aap chaahen, to main inhen do pahaaron ke beech dabochkar rakh doon."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6407: Tum ek aise vyakti ho, jiske andar jaahilyat ki kuchh baaten paai jaati hain. We tumhaare bhaai aur daas hain. Unhen Allah ne tumhaare niyantran mein rakha hai. Atah, jiske maathat uska koi bhaai ho, woh use wahi khilaye jo svayn khaye, wahi pahnaye jo svayn pahne aur unhen aise kaary karne ko na kaho, jo we kar na saken aur agar karne ko kah bhi do, to unki sahayta karo.

Maaroor bin suwaid kahte hain ki mainne aboozar -radiyallahu anhu- ko jis kapre mein dekha, usi prakaar ka kapra unke daas ke shareer mein bhi dekha. Mainne unse is ke baare mein poochha, to bataya ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke zamaane ek vyakti ko maan ki gaali di thi, jispar Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya tha : "Tum ek aise vyakti ho, jiske andar jaahilyat ki kuchh baaten paai jaati hain. We tumhaare bhaai aur daas hain. Unhen Allah ne tumhaare niyantran mein rakha hai. Atah, jiske maathat uska koi bhaai ho, woh use wahi khilaye jo svayn khaye, wahi pahnaye jo svayn pahne aur unhen aise kaary karne ko na kaho, jo we kar na saken aur agar karne ko kah bhi do, to unki sahayta karo."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6454: Kya tum jaante ho ki nirdhan kaun hai?

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Kya tum jaante ho ki nirdhan kaun hai?" Sahaaba ne kaha : Hamaare yahaan nirdhan woh hai, jiske paas na dirham ho na saamaan. Aapne kaha : "Meri ummat ka nirdhan woh vyakti hai, jo qayaamat ke din namaz, roza aur zakat ke saath ayega, lekin is awastha mein upasthit hoga ki kisi ko gaali di hogi, kisi par dushkarm ka aarop laga rakha hoga, kisi ka rakt baha rakha hoga aur kisi ko maar rakha hoga. Atah uski kuchh nekiyaan ise de di jayengi aur kuchh nekiyaan use de di jayengi. Phir agar uske oopar jo adhikaar hain, unke bhugtaan se pahle hi uski nekiyaan samaapt ho jayengi, to haq waalon ke gunaah lekar uske oopar daal diye jayenge aur phir use aag mein phenk diya jayega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne sahaaba se poochha : Kya tum jaante ho ki kangaal kaun hai? Sahaaba ne uttar diya : Hamaare yahaan kangaal woh hai, jiske paas dhan evn sanpatti na ho. Uttar sunkar aapne kaha : Qayaamat ke din meri ummat ka kangaal vyakti woh hoga, jo achchhe karm jaise namaz, roza aur zakat ke saath ayega, lekin duniya mein kisi ko gaali de rakhi hogi, kisi ke maan-sammaan par aakraman karke aya hoga, kisi ka maal khaakar inkaar kar diya hoga tatha kisi ko maara aur zaleel kiya hoga. Atah uski nekiyaan lekar peeriton ke darmiyaan baantna shuru kar diya jayega. Agar uske dvaara kiye gae atyaachaaron ka haq dilaane ka kaary poora hone se pahle uski nekiyaan khatm ho gaeen, to peeriton ke gunaah lekar uske karm patron mein darj kar diya jayega aur choonki uske paas nekiyaan baaqi nahin rah jayengi, isliye use Jahannam mein daal diya jayega.

Is hadees mein haraam kaaryon mein sanlipt hone se aur wishesh roop se bandon ke bhautik evn naitik adhikaaron ka hanan karne se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai.
Bando ke aapsi adhikaar ek-doosre se unhen praapt karne ke prayaas par aadhaarit hua karte hain, jabki Allah ke adhikaar kshama par aadhaarit hua karte hain. Bas shirk iske dayre se baahar hai.
Aisi sanwaad shaili ka prayog, jo shrota ko aakarshit kare, unka dhyaan aakarshit kare tatha unki roochi barhaye. Wisheshkar prashikshan aur maargadarshan ke sandarbh mein.
Yahaan kangaal ka sahi arth samjhaya gaya hai. Sachcha kangaal woh hai, jiske karjadaar qayaamat ke din uske achchhe karm chheen lenge.
Aisa bhi ho sakta hai ki badle ki kaarvaai insaan ke sabhi achchhe karmon ko samet de aur uski jholi mein koi bhi achchha karm rahne na de.
Srishti ke saath Allah ka bartaav nyay evn sachchaai par aadhaarit hota hai.
6455: Us Allah ki qasam, jiske haath mein Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki jaan hai, mujhe aasha hai ki Jannat mein tumhaari sankhya aadhi hogi. Iska kaaran yeh hai ki Jannat mein kewal musalmaan hi prawesh karenge. Jabki bahudevvaadiyon ki tulna mein tumhaara anupaat aise hai, jaise kaale bail ki khaal mein safed baal hon.

Abdullah bin masaood -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hainh ham Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath ek shiwir mein the aur hamaari sankhya lagbhag chaalees thi. Isi beech aapne kahaah "Kya tum chauthaai Jannat waale hone par santusht ho?" Hamne kahaah haan. Farmayaah "Kya tum is baat se santusht ho ki Jannat waalon mein tumhaari sankhya ek tihaai ho?" Hamne kahaah awashy. Farmayaah "Us Allah ki qasam, jiske haath mein Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki jaan hai, mujhe aasha hai ki Jannat mein tumhaari sankhya aadhi hogi. Iska kaaran yeh hai ki Jannat mein kewal musalmaan hi prawesh karenge. Jabki bahudevvaadiyon ki tulna mein tumhaara anupaat aise hai, jaise kaale bail ki khaal mein safed baal hon athva laal bail ki khaal mein kaale baal hon."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6458: Jab uchch evn mahaan Allah kisi bande se mohabbat karta hai, to Jibreel ko pukaarkar kahta hai ki Allah amuk bande se mohabbat karta hai, to tum bhi usse mohabbat karo. Chunaanche Jibreel usse mohabbat karne lagte hain. Phir woh aakaash waalon mein elaan karte hain ki Allah amuk bande se mohabbat karta hai, to tum log bhi us se mohabbat karo. Chunaanche aakaash waale bhi usse mohabbat karne lagte hain. Phir dharti par upasthit logon ke dilon mein uski mohabbat paida kar di jaati hai.

Abu huraira -Allah unse prasann ho- se marfooan warnit hai : "Jab uchch evn mahaan Allah kisi bande se mohabbat karta hai, to Jibreel ko pukaarkar kahta hai ki Allah amuk bande se mohabbat karta hai, to tum bhi usse mohabbat karo. Chunaanche Jibreel usse mohabbat karne lagte hain. Phir woh aakaash waalon mein elaan karte hain ki Allah amuk bande se mohabbat karta hai, to tum log bhi us se mohabbat karo. Chunaanche aakaash waale bhi usse mohabbat karne lagte hain. Phir dharti par upasthit logon ke dilon mein uski mohabbat paida kar di jaati hai."
Muslim ki ek riwayat mein hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Jab uchch evn mahaan Allah kisi bande se mohabbat karta hai, to Jibreel ko pukaarkar kahta hai ki Allah amuk bande se mohabbat karta hai, to tum bhi usse mohabbat karo. So Jibreel usse mohabbat karne lagte hain. Phir aakaash waalon mein aawaaz lagaai jaati hai ki nishchay hi Allah amuk bande se mohabbat karta hai, to tum log bhi usse mohabbat karo. Atah, aakaash waale bhi usse mohabbat karne lagte hain. Phir dharti par upasthit logon ke dilon mein uski mohabbat paida kar di jaati hai. Aur jab Allah kisi bande se nafrat karta hai, to Jibreel ko bulaakar kahta hai ki main amuk bande se nafrat karta hoon. Atah, tum bhi usse nafrat karo. Chunaanche, Jibreel bhi usse nafrat karne lagte hain. Phir woh aakaash waalon mein aawaaz lagaate hain ki Allah amuk bande se nafrat karta hai, atah tum log bhi usse nafrat karo. Atah dharti par upasthit logon ke dilon mein uske prati nafrat bhar di jaati hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6460: Jab koi aadmi apne ghar waalon par, neki wa sawaab ki ummeed rakhte hue kharch karta hai, to yeh uske liye sadqa hota hai.

Abu masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jab koi aadmi apne ghar waalon par, neki wa sawaab ki ummeed rakhte hue kharch karta hai, to yeh uske liye sadqa hota hai."

Jab koi vyakti apne ghar ke logon, jaise patni, maata-pita aur bachchon aadi par, jinpar kharch karna uspar aniwaary hai, Allah ki prasannata praapt karne ke liye aur sawaab ki neeyat se kharch kare, to use sadqe ka sawaab milega.

Pariwaar par kharch karne ka bhi pratiphal milega.
Momin apna har kaam Allah ki prasannata praapt karne aur uske yahaan sawaab haasil karne ke liye karta hai.
Har kaam karte samay, jismen apne pariwaar par kharch karna bhi shaamil hai, dil mein achchhi neeyat rakhni chahiye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
6461: Jab banda mujhse ek bitta qareeb aata hai, to main usse ek haath qareeb aata, jab woh mujhse ek haath qareeb aata hai, to main usse donon haathon ko phailaakar jitni doori banti hai, utna qareeb aata hoon aur jab woh mere paas chalkar aata hai, to main uske paas daur kar aata hoon.

Anas bin maalik aur abu huraira -Allah un donon se prasann ho- se riwayat hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apne rab se riwayat karte hue kahte hain ki Allah taaala pharmaata hai : "Jab banda mujhse ek bitta qareeb aata hai, to main usse ek haath qareeb aata, jab woh mujhse ek haath qareeb aata hai, to main usse donon haathon ko phailaakar jitni doori banti hai, utna qareeb aata hoon aur jab woh mere paas chalkar aata hai, to main uske paas daur kar aata hoon."
[ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6462: Jab qayaamat ka din hoga, to Allah pratyek Muslim ke hawaale ek yahoodi athva eesaai ko karega aur kahega : Yeh Jahannam se tumhaari chhuraai hai.

Abu moosa ashaari -Allah unse prasann ho- se marphooan warnit hai : "Jab qayaamat ka din hoga, to Allah pratyek Muslim ke hawaale ek yahoodi athva eesaai ko karega aur kahega : Yeh Jahannam se tumhaari chhuraai hai."
Jabki ek riwayat mein hai : "Qayaamat ke din kuchh Muslim pahaar samaan paap lekar ayenge, to bhi Allah unhen kshama kar dega."
6468: Eemaan ki sattar se kuchh adhik athva saath se kuchh adhik shaakhayen hain. Jinmen sarvashreshth shaakha 'la ilaaha illallah' kahna hai. Jabki sabse chhoti shaakha raaste se kashtadayak wastu ko hataana hai

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Eemaan ki sattar se kuchh adhik athva saath se kuchh adhik shaakhayen hain. Jinmen sarvashreshth shaakha 'la ilaaha illallah' kahna hai. Jabki sabse chhoti shaakha raaste se kashtadayak wastu ko hataana hai. Haya bhi eemaan ki ek shaakha hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki eemaan ki bahut-si shaakhayen hain, jinmen se kuchh kaary hain, kuchh aasthayen aur kuchh kathan.

Jabki eemaan ki sabse uttam evn utkrisht shaakha la ilaaha illallah kahna hai, uske arth ko jaante hue aur uske taqaazon par amal karte hue. Yaani kewal Allah hi ekmaatr ibaadat ke layaq hai. Uske siwa koi ibaadat ke layaq nahin hai.

Jabki eemaan ka sabse kam rutbe waala kaam yeh hai ki raaston se logon ko kasht dene waali cheezon ko hataya jaye.

Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki haya bhi eemaan ki ek shaakha hai. Yaad rahe ki haya insaan ka ek aachran hai, jo use achchha kaam karne aur bure kaam se bache rahne ki prerna deta hai.

Eemaan ki bahut-si shreniyaan hain, jinmen se kuchh any se utkrisht hain.
Eemaan kathan, karm aur aastha ka naam hai.
Allah se haya ka taqaaza yeh hai ki Allah tumhen wahaan na dekhe, jahaan jaane se usne mana kiya hai aur us jagah anupasthit na paye, jahaan rahne ka usne aadesh diya hai.
Yahaan sankhya ka ullekh seemit karne ke liye nahin, balki eemaan ke kaaryon ki baahulyata ko batlaane ke liye hai. Kyonki arab ke log kabhi-kabhi koi sankhya bol dete hain, lekin unka matlab yeh nahin hota ki isse adhik nahin ho sakta.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
6469: Ek vyakti raaste mein ja raha tha ki usne raaste mein kaantedaar tahni dekhi, to usne use hata diya. Allah ne uske is kaam ko pasand kiya aur use maaph kar diya.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Ek vyakti raaste mein ja raha tha ki usne raaste mein kaantedaar tahni dekhi, to usne use hata diya. Allah ne uske is kaam ko pasand kiya aur use maaph kar diya."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki ek vyakti raaste se ja raha tha. Isi beech dekha ki ek kaantedaar per ki ek shaakha raaste mein hai aur musalmaanon ko kasht de rahi hai. Atah use raaste se hata diya, to Allah ne uske is kaary ka sammaan karte hue use kshama kar diya.

Raaste se kashtadayak wastu ko hataane ki fazeelat tatha yeh ki yeh kaam Allah ki kshama milne ka kaaran banta hai.
Neki ke kaamon ko hey drishti se nahin dekhna chahiye, chaahe thore hi kyon na hon.
Islam svachchhata, surakshit waataavran tatha saarvajnik suraksha ka pairokaar dharm hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
6604: Kya tummen se kisi ne koi sapna dekha hai? Phir Allah jise chaahta, woh aapke saamne apne svapn bayaan karta. Ek din subah ke samay aapne hamse kaha : Aaj raat mere paas do vyakti (farishte) aye aur bole : Chalo. Chunaanche main unke saath chal para.

Samura bin jundub -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- prayah apne sahaaba se farmaya karte the ki kya tummen se kisi ne koi sapna dekha hai? Phir Allah jise chaahta, woh aapke saamne apna svapn bayaan karta. Ek din subah ke samay aapne hamse kaha : “Aaj raat mere paas do vyakti (farishte) aye aur bole : Chalo. Chunaanche main unke saath chal para. Ham ek aise sthaan par pahunche, jahaan ek vyakti leta hua tha aur doosra vyakti ek bara-sa patthar lekar uske paas khara tha. Woh patthaar lekar uski or barhta aur uske sir ko phar deta. Jab patthar lurhakkar door chala jaata, to woh patthar ke paas jaakar use utha laata aur us vyakti ke paas aata. Itne mein uska sir daabaara pahle jaisa ho chuka hota tha. Chunaanche, woh jo kuchh pahle kiya tha, use phir se dohraata tha." Nabi –sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- farmaate hain ki mainne un donon se poochha : "Allah ki zaat pawitr hai! Yeh donon kaun hain?" Farishton ne kaha : Abhi aage chol, abhi aage chalo. "Chunaanche ham chal diye. Phir ham ek ese vyakti ke paas pahunche, jo guddi ke bal chit leta hua tha aur ek vyakti lohe ka ankura lekar uske paas khara tha. Woh uske chehre ke ek bhaag mein ankura rakhta aur uske jabre ko guddi tak phaar deta. Phir uske nathne ko guddi tak tatha uski aankh ko guddi tak phaar deta. Phir chehre ke doosre bhaag ki or jaata aur uske saath bhi wahi karta, jo pahle bhaag ke saath kiya tha. Woh jab tak is bhaag ka kaam sanpann karta, pahla bhaag poorv ki bhaanti sahi ho jaata. Atah, woh phir se use phaarna shuru kar deta." Aap –sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- farmaate hain : Yeh dekh mainne kaha : "Allah ki zaat pawitr hai! Yeh donon kaun hain?" Farishton ne kaha : Abhi aage chalo, abhi aage chalo. "Chunaanche, ham chal diye. Phir ham tandoor jaisi ek wastu ke paas pahunche." Warnankarta kahte hain : Mujhe lagta hai ki aapne farmaya tha : "Wahaan se hamen bari cheekh aur pukaar sunaai di. Hamne jhaankkar dekha, to usmen nagn puroosh aur mahilayen theen. Jab unke neeche se aag ki lapten aati theen, to we sahayta ke liye fariyaad karne lagte. Mainne kaha : Yeh kaun log hain? Donon ne mujhse kaha : Abhi aage chalo, abhi aage chalo. Chunaanche ham chal pare. Yahaan tak ki ek nahar ke paas pahunche." Warnankarta kahte hain : Mujhe lagta hai ki aapne farmaya tha: “Nahar lahu ki tarah laal thi aur usmen ek vyakti tair raha tha aur ek vyakti nahar ke kinaare baitha tha, jiske paas bahut-se patthar jama the. Jab tairaak tairkar uske paas aata, to apna munh khol deta aur kinaare mein khara vyakti uske mukh mein ek patthar daal deta. Phir woh tairne lagta. Phir lautkar uske paas aata aur munh khol deta, to pattharon ke paas khara vyakti uske munh mein ek patthar daal deta. Mainne farishton se kaha : Yeh donon kaun hain? Donon ne kaha : Abhi aur aage chalo, abhi aur aage chalo. Phir ham chal pare aur ek aise vyakti ke paas pahunche, jo atyant badsoorat tha. Tumne usse adhik badsoorat vyakti nahin dekhe hoga. Mainne dekha ki uske paas aag jal rahi hai, jise woh jala raha hai aur uske chaaron or chakkar laga raha hai. Mainne poochha : Yeh kaun hai? Dono farishton ne uttar diya : Abhi aur aage chalo, abhi aur aage chalo. Phir ham chalne lage, yahaan tak ki ek gahre hare rang ki ghani wanaspatiyon waale baag ke paas pahunche, jismen basant ke pratyek prakaar ke phool the aur baag ke saamne ek bara lanba vyakti khara tha, jiska sir mujhe bamushkil dikhaai par raha tha aur uske aas-paas itni bari sankhya mein bachche maujood the ki mainne kabhi nahin dekha hoga. Mainne kaha : Yeh kaun hain? Unhonne uttar diya : Abhi aur aage chalo, abhi aur aage chalo. Phir ham chalne lage, yahaan tak ki ek bahut bare per ke paas pahunche. Usse bara aur usse sundar per mainne kabhi nahin dekha tha. Yahaan donon ne mujhse kaha : Uspar charho. Ham charhte hue ek aise shahar mein pahunche, jo sone aur chaandi ki eenton se bana tha. Ham shahar ke dvaar par pahunche, to hamne dvaar kholne ko kaha. Dvaar khola gaya aur ham usmen prawesh kar gae. Hamne wahaan kuchh aise aadmi dekhe, jinka aadha bhaag bahut hi khoobsoorat aur aadha bhaag bahut badsoorat tha. Donon farishton ne un logon se kaha : Jaao us nahar mein dubki lagaao. Wahaan nagar ke beech se ek aisi nahar bah rahi thi, jiska paani khaalis safed tha. We gae aur usmen dubki lagaakar waapas aye, to unki badsoorti khatm ho chuki thi aur we ati sundar ban chuke the." Nabi –sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- farmaate hain : "Donon farishton ne mujhse kaha : Yeh adn naami Jannat hai aur yeh aapka sthaan hai. Meri nigaah oopar ki or uthi, to dekha ki ek mahal hai, jo safed baadal ki tarah hai. Donon farishton ne kaha : Yahi aapka makaan hai. Mainne donon se kaha : Allah tumhen barkat de! Mujhe ismen prawesh karne do. Donon ne kaha : Abhi nahin. Haan, aap uske andar prawesh zaroor karenge. Mainne unse kaha : Aaj raat mainne kai aashcharyajnak cheezen dekhi hain! Ab bataao ki meri dekhi hui yeh cheezen kya hain? Donon ne kaha : Ab ham aapko unke baare mein bataate hain. Jahaan tak pahle vyakti ki baat hai, jiske paas aap gae the aur jiske sir ko patthar se phora ja raha tha, to woh aisa vyakti tha, jo Qur'an ki shiksha praapt karta tha, lekin use nakaar deta tha aur farz namaz chhorkar soya rahta tha. Jahaan tak us vyakti ki baat hai, jiske paas aap gae aur jiske jabre ko guddi tak, nathne ko guddi tak aur aankh ko guddi tak cheera ja raha tha, to woh aisa wayakti tha, jo jab ghar se nikalta, to aisa jhuth bolta, jo chaaron or phail jaata tha. Jahaan tak un purushon tatha mahilaaon ki baat hai, jo tandoor jaisi cheez mein nange maujood the, to we vyabhichaari tatha vyabhichaarini the. Jahaan tak us vyakti ki baat hai, jiske paas aap aye aur jo nahar mein tair raha tha aur patthar nigal raha tha, to woh soodkhor tha. Jahaan tak us kuroop vyakti ki baat hai, jo aag jalaakar uske aas-paas ghoom raha tha, to woh Jahannam ka daroga tha. Jahaan tak bageeche mein maujood lanbe aadmi ki baat hai, to woh ibraaheem -alaihissalaam- the aur jo bachche unke aas-paas maujood the, we woh saare bachche the, jinki mrityu fitrat par hui thi." Burkaani ki riwayat mein hai : "Jo fitrat par paida hue the." Yeh sun kuchh musalmaanon ne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Anekeshvarvaadiyon ke bachchon ka kya hoga? To Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne uttar diya : "Anekeshvarvaadiyon ke bachche bhi. Jahaan tak un logon ki baat hai, jinka aadha bhaag khoobsoorat aur aadha bhaag badsoorat tha, to ye we log the, jinke kuchh kaam achchhe the to kuchh bure. Atah, Allah ne unhen kshama kar diya."
Ek any riwayat mein hai : “Mainne aaj raat do aadmi ko dekha, jo mere paas aye aur mujhe pawitr bhoomi lekar gae." Phir shesh hadees bayaan karte hue farmaya : “Ham tandoor jaisi ek gufa ke paas aye, jiska oopri bhaag tang tha aur nichla bhaag chaura tha aur uske neeche aag jal rahi thi. Jab aag oopar ki taraf uthti, to log oopar ki or uthne lagte aur aisa prateet hota ki we nikal pareng. Lekin jab aag bujhne lagti, to we usmen waapas chale jaate. Usmen nange purush tatha mahilayen maujood theen." Usmen aage hai : “Yahaan tak ki ham khoon ki ek nahar ke paas aye." Is riwayat mein shak ka zikr nahin hai. Aage hai : “Ek vyakti nahar ke beech mein khara tha aur ek vyakti nahar ke kinaare khara tha, jiske saamne bahut-se patthar rakhe the. Nahar ke beech mein khara vyakti jab aage barhta aur nikalna chaahta, to kinaare mein khara vyakti uske munh mein ek patthar maar deta aur use waheen lauta deta, jahaan pahle tha. Isi tarah jab-jab woh nikalne ke liye aage barhta, woh uske munh par ek patthar maar deta aur woh waheen laut jaata, jahaan pahle tha." Usmen aage hai : "Donon farishte mujhe lekar per par charh gae aur mujhe ek aise ghar mein daakhil kiya, jisse sundar ghar mainne kabhi nahin dekha tha. Usmen bahut-se boorhe aur jawaan maujood the." Usmen aur aage hai : “Jise aapne is awastha mein dekha tha ki uske jabre ko phaara ja raha tha, to woh ek jhootha vyakti tha, jo jhoothi baat bol deta tha, jo usse nikalkar chaaron dishaaon mein phail jaati thi. Aapne uske saath jo kuchh hote dekha hai, woh uske saath qayaamat ke din tak hota rahega." Usmen aur aage hai : “Jisko aapne is awastha mein dekha tha ki uske sir ko phora ja raha hai, to woh aisa vyakti tha, jise Allah ne Qur'an sikhaya tha, lekin woh raat ko usse nishchet hokar sota raha aur din mein bhi uspar amal nahin kiya. Atah, jo aapne uske saath hote dekha, woh qayaamat ke din tak jaari rahega. Isi tarah pahla ghar, jismen aap prawesh kiye the, woh saadhaaran eemaan waalon ka dhar hai aur yeh ghar shaheedon ka ghar hai. Main jibreel hoon aur yeh meekaaeel hai. Ab aap apna sir oopar karke dekhen. Mainne sir oopar karke dekha, to mujhe apne oopar baadal ki tarah nazar aya. Donon ne kaha : Yeh aapka ghar hai. Mainne kaha : Mujhe apne ghar mein prawesh karne do. Un donon ne kaha : Abhi aapki kuchh ayu shesh hai, jo poori nahin hui hai. Yadi woh poori ho gai hoti, to aap apne ghar mein prawesh kar sakte the.
"
6610: Amr bin absa ke Islam laane ki ghatna aur Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka unhen namaz aur wazu sikhaane ka warnan.

Amr bin absa -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki main jaahiliyat kaal mein yeh samajhta tha ki log gumraah hain aur we kisi sahi path par nahin hain. Log murtiyon ki pooja kiya karte the. Isi beech mainne suna ki ek vyakti makka mein kuchh baaten bata raha hai. Atah, apni sawaari par baithkar uske paas pahunch gaya. Woh vyakti Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- the, jo apnon ke atyaachaar ke kaaran chhupkar daawat de rahe the. Main chupke se makka mein aapke paas aya aur kaha : Aap kaun hain? Farmaya : “Main Nabi hoon." Mainne kaha : Nabi kya hota hai? Farmaya : “Mujhe Allah ne bheja hai." Mainne kaha : Kya dekar bheja hai? Farmaya : “Sage-sanbandhiyon par upaakar karne, buton ko torne tatha ek Allah ko maanne aur uske saath kisi ko saajhi na banaane ka aadesh dekar bheja hai." Mainne kaha : Ismen kaun log aap ke saath hain? Farmaya : “Er aazaad aur ek gulaam." Us samay aapke saath abu bakr aur bilaal the. Mainne kaha : Main bhi aapka anusran karna chaahta hoon. Farmaya : “Aaj tum iski kshamta nahin rakhte. Kya tum nahin dekh rahe ho ki mere saath logon ka kya aachran hai? Lekin apne ghar laut jaao aur jab suno ki main khuleaam prachaar karne laga hoon, to mere paas a jaana." Woh kahte hain ki main apne ghar waapas a gaya aur Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- madeena padhaare aur mere ghar ke kuchh log bhi madeena pahunche. Mainne unse poochha ki madeena aane waale vyakti ka kya samaachaar hai? Un logon ne kaha : Log bari jaldi se unke paas a rahe hain. Unke samuday ne unhen qatl karna chaaha tha, lekin qatl nahin kar sake. Phir main madeena aya aur aapke paas jaakar kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, kya aap mujhe pahchaante hain? Farmaya : “Haan, tum hi to ho na, jo mujhse makka mein mile the?" Kahte hain ki mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, aap mujhe woh cheeze batayen, jo Allah ne aapko sikhaya hai aur main nahin jaanta hoon. Mujhe namaz ke baare mein batayen. Farmaya : “Subah ki namaz parho aur phir namaz na parho, yahaan tak ki soory ek bhaala ke baraabar ho jaye; kyonki soory shaitaan ki do seengon ke beech nikalta hai aur us samay kaafir use sajda karte hain. Phir namaz parho, kyonki namaz ke samay farishte upasthit hote hain aur likhte hain, yahaan tak ki kshaya bhaale ke saath khari ho jaye, to phir namaz se ruk jaao; kyonki us samay Jahannam ki agni bharkaai jaati hai. Phir jab kshaya aage barh jaye, to namaz parho; kyonki farishte upasthit hokar likhte hain aur uski gawaahi bhi denge. Aisa asr ki namaz parhne tak karte raho. Phir -jab asr ki namaz parh lo- to soory ast hone tak namaz na parho; kyonki soory shaitaan ki do seengon ke beech ast hota hai aur us samay kaafir use sajda karte hain. Woh kahte hain mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Nabi, mujhe wazu ke baare mein batayen. Farmaya : “Tummen se jo bhi wazu ka paani paas leta hai aur kulli karta hai tatha naak mein paani daalkar naak jhaarta hai, to uske chehre ke paap daarhi ke kinaaron se paani ke saath jhar jaate hain. Phir jab donon haathon ko kohni sahit dhota hai, to uske donon haathon ke paap paani ke saath ungliyon ke poron se jhar jaate hain. Phir jab sir ka masah karta hai, to uske sir ke paap baalon ke kinaaron se paani ke saath gir jaate hain. Phir jab donon pairon ko takhnon samet dhota hai, to uske pairon ke paap paani ke saath ungliyon ke poron se jhar jaate hain. Ab agar woh namaz parhne khara hota hai aur Allah ki prashansa karta hai aur uski baraai bayaan karta hai, jiska woh adhikaari hai, tatha apne dil ko Allah se jor leta hai, to woh paapon se is tarah nikal aata hai, jaise us din hota hai, jis din uski maan ne jana ho." Jab amr bin absa ne yeh hadees Allah ke Rasool –sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke sahaabi abu umaama –radiyallahu anhu- ko bataai, to abu umaama ne kaha : Ai amr bin absa, dekh lo tum kya kah rahe ho! Ek hi sthaan par is vyakti ko itni nekiyaan di ja rahi hain! To amr ne kaha : Ai abu umaama! Meri ayu adhik ho chuki hai, meri haddiyaan kamzor ho gai hain, maut ka samay bhi sameep ho chuka hai aur is awastha mein mujhe Allah taaala evn uske Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- par jhooth bolne ki koi aawashyakta nahin hai!
