Yadi mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se ise ek, do, teen baar -unhonne saat baar tak gina diya- bhi suna na hota, to main kabhi nahin bataata, lekin mainne isse bhi adhik baar suna hai.
6611: Jo bhi sona ya chaandi rakhne waala vyakti apne us dhan ka haq (zakat) ada nahin karta, uske liye qayaamat ke din aag ki takhtiyaan taiyaar ki jayengi

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jo bhi sona ya chaandi rakhne waala vyakti apne us dhan ka haq (zakat) ada nahin karta, uske liye qayaamat ke din aag ki takhtiyaan taiyaar ki jayengi aur unhen Jahannam ki aag mein tapaya jayega, phir unse uske pahlu, uski peshaani aur peeth ko daaga jayega. Jab-jab takhtiyaan thandi ho jayengi, unhen dobaara garmaya jayega. Yeh azaab ek aise din mein hoga, jiski avdhi pachaas hazaar saal ke baraabar hogi. (Yeh silsila jaari rahega) yahaan tak ki bandon ke darmiyaan faisla kar diya jaye aur (azaab mein giraftaar vyakti) Jannat ya Jahannam ki or jaane waale apne raaste ko dekh le." Poochha gaya : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Oonton ka kya hukm hai? Aapne farmaya : "Jo vyakti oonton ka maalik ho aur unka haq (zakat) ada na karta ho, jabki unka haq yeh bhi hai ki unko paani pilaane ke din (zarooratmandon evn yaatriyon ke liye) unka doodh dooha jaye, to qayaamat ke din ek bare samtal maidaan mein use oonton ke saamne munh ke bal aundha daal diya jayega aur uske saare oont pahle se bhi adhik mote hokar wahaan upasthi honge. Oont ka ek bachcha tak anupasthit nahin hoga. Yeh oont apne khuron se us vyakti ko raundenge aur apne munh se use kaatenge. Jab antim oont (use raundte hue) guzar jayega, to pahle oont ko dobaara lauta diya jayeg. Yeh azaab aise din mein hoga, jiski avdhi pachaas hazaar saal hogi. (Yeh silsila jaari rahega) yahaan tak ki bandon ke darmiyaan faisla kar diya jaye aur woh Jannat ya Jahannam ki or jaane waala apna raasta dekh le." Poochha gaya : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Gayon aur bakriyon ka kya hukm hai? Aapne farmay : "Jo vyakti gayon aur bakriyon ka maalik ho aur unka haq (zakat) ada na karta ho, qayaamat ke din use ek bare samtal maidaan mein uski gayon evn bakriyon ke saamne aundhe munh daal diya jayega. Ek bhi gay ya bakri kam nahin dikhegi. Kisi ka seeng na mura hoga, na toota hoga aur na koi bina seeng ki hogi. Woh apni seengon se use maarengi aur apne khuron se use raundengi. Jab antim gay ya bakri raundkar guzar jayegi, to pahli gay ko dobaara lauta diya jayeg. Yeh azaab aise din mein hoga, jiski avdhi pachaas hazaar saal hogi. (Yeh silsila jaari rahega) yahaan tak ki logon ke darmiyaan faisla kar diya jaye aur woh vyakti Jannat ya Jahannam ki or jaane waala apna raasta dekh le." Poochha gaya : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Ghoron ke baare mein kya hukm hai? Aapne faramyaaा : 'Ghore teen prakaar ke hote hain. Ek to woh ghore jo insaan ke liye bojh (gunaah ka sabab) hote hain, doosre woh ghore jo insaan ke liye parda hote hain aur teesre woh ghore jo insaan ke liye sawaab ka sabab bante hain. Jo ghore insaan ke liye gunaah ka sabab hua karte hain, woh aise ghore hain, jinhen woh logon ko dikhaane, abhimaan aur musalmaanon ka muqaabla karne ke liye rakhta hai. Is prakaar ke ghore insaan ke liye gunaah ka sabab hua karte hain. Jo ghore insaan ke liye parda bante hain, woh aise ghore hain, jinhen insaan Allah ke raaste mein jihaad ke liye paalta hai aur unki peeth aur gardanon ke baare mein Allah ke haq ko nahin bhoolta. Is prakaar ke ghore insaan ke liye parda hua karte hain. Jo ghore insaan ke liye neki ka sabab hua karte hain, woh aise ghore hain, jinhen aadmi Allah ke maarg mein jihaad ke uddeshy se musalmaanon ke liye charaagaah ya baag mein baandhkar rakhe. Woh ghore us charaagaah ya baag mein jo kuchh bhi khaate hain, unke parimaan mein uske liye nekiyaan likhi jaati hain aur unki leed evn peshaab ke parimaan mein bhi uske haq mein nekiyaan likhi jaati hain. Agar woh apni rassi torkar ek teele ya do teelon par daurkar charh jayen, to is dauraan unke paanv ke parne waale nishaanon aur unki girne waali leed ke parimaan mein bhi Allah uske liye nekiyaan likh deta hai. Agar unka maalik unhen le kar kisi nadi par se guzre aur woh uska paani pi len, haalaanki uska unhen paani pilaane ka iraada na bhi ho, tab bhi woh jitna paani peete hain, uske anusaar Allah uske liye nekiyaan likh deta hai.'"

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne wibhinn prakaar ke dhan tatha unki zakat ada na karne waale ko qayaamat ke din hone waali saza ka zikr kiya hai. Maslan :

1- sona, chaandi tatha unke jaise any dhan evn tijaarat ke saamaan. Inpar agar zakat waajib ho jaye aur zakat ada na ki jaye, to qayaamat ke din inko pighlaakar pahle takhtiyon ke roop mein dhaala jayega aur uske baad un takhtiyon ko Jahannam ki aag mein tapaakar unke maalik ko azaab diya jayega, atah unse uske pahlu, peshaani aur peeth ko daaga jayega, jab-jab woh thandi par jayengi, unhen dobaara tapaya jayega.  Qayaamat ke din azaab ka yeh silsila din bhar jaari rahega. Woh din bhi pachaas hazaar saal ka hoga. Thamega usi samay jab logon ke beech Allah faisla kar dega aur yeh tay ho jayega ki woh Jannat jaane waalon mein se hai ya Jahannam ki taraph jaane waalon mein se hai.

2- oont ka jo maalik farz zakat aur uska haq ada na karta ho, maslan uska doodh ghareebon aur nirdhanon ko na pilaata ho, to qayaamat ke din kisi ek bhi oont ko chhore bina uske saare oonton ko mota-taaza banaakar laya jayega, phir unke maalik ko unke saamne ek samtal evn wistrit bhoomi mein lita diya jayega, uske baad woh oont use apne pairon se raundenge aur apne daanton se kaatenge. Jab antim oont bhi guzar jayega, to pahle oont se phir se yeh silsila shuru kar diya jayega. Azaab ka yeh silsila qayaamat ke roz din bhar jaari rahega aur woh din bhi pachaas hazaar warsh ka hoga. Thamega usi samay jab saare logon ke beech Allah nirnay kar dega aur yeh tay ho jayega ki woh Jannat jaane waalon mein se hai ya Jahannam ki taraph jaane waalon mein se hai..

3- gay aur bakri ka jo maalik unki farz zakat na deta ho, qayaamat ke din unki poori sankhya ke saath is tarah laya jayega ki ek gay ya bakri bhi idhar-udhar na hogi. Sab jaanvar bilkul sahi-saalim honge. Na kisi ka seeng mura hoga, na kisi ka seeng toota hoga aur na koi jaanvar bina seeng ka hoga. Phir unke maalik ko ek bare evn samtal maidaan mein unke saamne lita diya jayega. Phir ye gayen aur bakriyaan use apne seengon se maarengi aur apne pairon se kuchlengi. Jab antim gay evn bakri bhi guzar jayegi, to pahli gay ya bakri se phir se yeh silsila shuru kar diya jayega. Azaab ka yeh silsila qayaamat ke roz din bhar jaari rahega aur woh din bhi pachaas hazaar warsh ka hoga. Thamega usi samay jab saare logon ke beech Allah nirnay kar dega to woh ya to Jannat waalon mein se hoga ya Jahannam waalon mein se hoga.

4- ghora paalne waala. Daraasal ghore teen prakaar ke hua karte hain :

1- aisa ghora jo maalik ke liye gunaah ka kaaran bane. Isse muraad aisa ghora hai, jise prasiddhi, abhimaan evn musalmaanon se yuddh ke liye paala jaye.

2- aisa ghora jo insaan ke liye parde ka kaaran ho. Isse muraad aisa ghora hai, jise Allah ki raah mein jihaad ke liye rakha jaye aur phir uske saath achchha vyavhaar karte hue use khilaane-pilaane aur uski dekhbhaal ki behtar vyawastha ki jaye, aur isi ke antargat nar ghore ko maada ghori ke paas jaane dena hai.

3- aisa ghora jo sawaab ka kaaran bane. Isse muraad aisa ghora hai, jise Allah ki raah mein jihaad ke liye rakha jaye. Is prakaar ke ghore jab kisi charaagaah ya baagh mein hote hain, to us charaagaah ya baagh mein jo kuchh bhi khaate hain, usi parimaan mein unke maalik ke liye nekiyaan likhi jaati hain, tatha unki leed aur mootr ke parimaan mein bhi uske liye nekiyaan likh di jaati hain. Agar woh rassi torkar ek teele ya do teelon par daurkar charh jayen, to unke pairon ke nishaanon aur is dauraan girne waali leed ke samaan Allah taaala uske liye nekiyaan likh deta hai. Agar unka maalik unhen kisi nahar par le jaye aur wo unka paani pi len, chaahe unka maalik unhen wahaan paani pilaane ka iraada na bhi rakhta ho, tab bhi wo jitna paani peete hain, uske pirmaan mein Allah unke liye nekiyaan likh deta hai.

Uske baad Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se gadhon ke baare mein poochha gaya ki kya is wishay mein gadhon ka hukm ghoron ki tarah hai?

Aapne uttar diya ki mere paas gadhon ke baare mein koi nirdesh nahin aya hai. Albatta, yeh adbhut evn saargarbhit ayat maujood hai, jiske dayre mein har prakaar ki nekiyaan aur gunaah a jaate hain, ayat ka arth hai : Jisne kan bhar bhi neki ki hogi, woh usko dekh lega, tatha jisne kan bhar bhi buraai ki hogi, woh use dekh lega. [soora zalazla : 8] yaani jisne achchhe iraade se gadha paala hoga, woh uska sawaab saamne dekhega aur jisne bure iraade se gadha paala hoga, woh uski saza saamne dekhega. Is ayat ke dayre mein har prakaar ke kaary a jaate hain.

Zakat dena waajib hai. Zakat rokne waale ko bari sakht chetaavni di gai hai.
Susti ke kaaran zakat na dene waala kaafir to nahin hai, lekin bare khatre ke dahaane par hua karta hai.
Insaan jab kisi neki ke kaam ka iraada karke use kar daalta hai, to use us kaary ke wiwarnon ka bhi sawaab milta hai, chaahe unki neeyat na bhi ki ho.
Dhan mein zakat ke atirikt aur bhi haq hua karte hain.
Oont ka ek haq yeh hai ki jab use paani pilaane ke liye ghaat mein le jaya jaye, to wahaan maujood ghareebon ko bhi uska doodh dohkar pilaya jaye, taaki zarooratmandon ko ghar-ghar na jaana pare aur jaanavron ke liye bhi achchha ho. Ibn-e-battaal kahte hain : Dhan par do prakaar ke haq hain :Vyaktigat aniwaaryata evn uske siwa. Jaanvar ka doodh dohkar ghareebon ko pilaana aniwaary haq ke dayre mein to nahin aata, lekin naitikta ka taqaaza hai.
Oont, bail evn bakre se jura hua ek haq yeh hai ki jab unhen kisi maada jaanvar ko gaabhin karne ke liye chhorne ko kaha jaye, to chhor diya jaye.
Gadhon aur un tamaam cheezon ka, jinke baare mein shareeyat ka koi spasht disha-nirdesh maujood na ho, hukm yeh hai ki woh Qur'an ki is ayat ki vyaapakta ke dayre mein aati hain : {jisne kan bhar bhi neki ki hogi, woh use dekh lega aur jisne kan bhar bhi buraai ki hogi, woh use dekh lega.}
Is ayat mein nek kaam karne ki prerna di gai hai, chaahe thora hi kyon na ho. Isi tarah bure kaam se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai, chaahe maamooli hi kyon na ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
6612: Abu talha -Allah unse prasann ho- ka ek putr beemaar tha. Abu talha kaheen baahar gae, to uski mrityu ho gai.

Anas -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki abu talha -Allah unse prasann ho- ka ek putr beemaar tha. Abu talha kaheen baahar gae, to uski mrityu ho gai. Jab woh lautkar aye, to kaha : Mere bete ka kya hua? Bachche ki maan umme sulaim ne kaha : Woh pahle se adhik aaraam mein hai. Phir unhonne unke saamne khaana rakh diya, to unhonne raat ka khaana khaya. Uske baad patni se sahvaas bhi kiya. Jab woh yeh sab kuchh kar chuke, to unki patni ne kaha : Logon ne bachche ko dafan kar diya hai. Subah hui, to abu talha Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aye aur sab kuchh bataya. Aapne unse poochha : “Kya tumne aaj raat ko sahvaas kiya hai?” unhonne uttar diya : Haan. Farmayaah “Ai Allah in donon mein barkat de!” chunaanche unke yahaan bachcha paida hua, to abu talha ne mujhse kaha ki use Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas le jaao. Unhonne saath mein kuchh khajooren bhi bhejeen. Jab ham wahaan pahunche, to aapne poochha : “Kya iske saath kuchh hai?” mainne kaha : Haan kuchh khajooren hain. To Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unhen lekar apne munh mein rakhkar chabaya, fir use apne munh se nikaalkar bachche ke munh mein daal diya aur uska naam abdullah rakha.
Ek riwayat mein hai : Ibne uyayna pharmaate hain : Ek ansaari ne kaha : Mainne nau bachche dekhe. Pratyek bachcha Qur'an parhne waala tha. Yaani us navjaat abdullah ki santaan-santti mein se.
Ek aur riwayat mein hai : Abu talha ka ek beta mar gaya, to umme sulaim ne apne ghar waalon se kaha ki abu talha ko mujhse pahle koi is sanbandh mein na bataye. Jab abu talha ghar aye, to umme sulaim ne raat ka khaana saamne rakha aur unhonne kha-pi liya. Phir umme sulaim ne abu talha ke liye usi tarah behatreen andaaz mein banaav singaar kiya, jaise woh pahle kiya karti theen aur abu talha ne unse sahvaas kar liya. Jab umme sulaim ne dekha ki abu talha aasooda ho chuke hain aur sahvaas bhi kar chuke hain, to kahne lageen : Ai abu talha! Aapka kya khayaal hai, yadi kuchh log kisi ghar waale ko koi saamaan prayog karne ke liye den aur phir we unse waapas maange, to kya prayog ke liye lene waale use rok sakte hain? Abu talha ne kaha : Nahin. Umme sulaim ne kaha : Samajh lo ki woh saamaan tumhaara beta hi hai. Anas –radiyallahu anhu- ka kahna hai ki ispar abu talha naaraaz ho gae aur bole : Tumne mujhe chhore rakha, yahaan tak ki jab main naapaak ho gaya, to mujhe mere bete ki soochna di! Phir woh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aye aur poori ghatna bataai, to aapne farmaya : “Allah tumhaari raat mein barkat de. Anas –radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain : Chunaanche woh garbhavti ho gaeen. Anas –radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ek yaatra mein the aur umme sulaim bhi unke saath theen. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab yaatra se madeena aate, to raat ke samay madeene mein daakhil nahin hote the. Chunaanche jab we madeene ke nikat aye, to umme sulaim ko prasav peera aaranbh ho gai. Atah, unki dekhbhaal ke liye abu talha ko rukna para. Jabki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- chal pare. Anas –radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain : Ais mein, abu talha ne kaha : Ai mere rab! Tu jaanta hai ki jis tarah mujhe Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath nikalna pasand hai, usi tarah aapke saath waapas hona bhi pasand hai. Aur ab mujhe jis kaaran se rukna par raha hai, use tu dekh raha hai! Chunaanche umme sulaim ne kaha : Mujhe jo prasav peera mahsoos ho rahi thi, woh ab mahsoos nahin ho rahi hai. Atah, ab chalo, chalte hain. Chunaanche ham chal pare. Jab donon madeena pahunch gae, to unko ek beta paida hua. Meri maan ne mujhse kaha : Ai anas! Ise koi doodh na pilaye, yahaan tak ki tum ise subah Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas le jaao. Subah hui, to main use Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas le gaya. … phir unhonne poori hadees bayaan ki.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6613: Mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki aawaaz durbal suni hai, jisse mahsoos ho raha hai ki aap bhookhe hain. Kya tumhaare paas kuchh hai?

Anas -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki abu talha –radiyallahu anhu- ne umme sulaim –radiyallahu anha- se kaha : Mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki aawaaz durbal suni hai, jisse mahsoos ho raha hai ki aap bhookhe hain. Kya tumhaare paas kuchh hai? Unhonne kaha : Haan! Phir unhonne jau ki rotiyon ke kuchh tukre nikaale, unhen apne dupatte ke ek bhaag mein lapeta, phir use mere kapre ke andar chhipaya aur shesh bhaag ko mere oopar daal diya, phir mujhe Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas bhej diya. Main pahuncha, to dekha ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- masjid mein baithe hue hain aur aapke saath kuchh log bhi maujood hain. Atah, main logon ke paas khara ho gaya. Yeh dekh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne mujhse kaha : “Kya abu talha ne tumhen bheza hai?” mainne kaha : Haan. Farmaya : “Khaane ke liye?” mainne kahaah haan. Tab Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Chalo, sab log chalte hain. Chunaanche, log chalne lage aur main bhi unke aage-aage chal para. Yahaan tak ki mainne abu talha ke paas aakar sab kuchh bataya, to abu talha ne kaha : Umme sulaim, Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- logon ke saath a rahe hain aur hamaare paas unhen khilaane ke liye paryaapt khaana nahin hai. Yeh sun umme sulaim ne kaha : Allah aur uske Rasool adhik jaante hain. Abu talha chalkar Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se mile, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- unke saath padhaare aur donon ghar mein daakhil hue. Ab Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Ai umme sulaim, tumhaare paas jo kuchh hai, woh le aao. Unhonne wahi roti ke tukre haazir kiye, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke aadesh se unhen tukre-tukre kiya gaya aur umme sulaim ne uske oopar ghi ki kuppi nichorkar saalan ki vyawastha kar di. Phir Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne usmen, jo Allah ne chaaha, parha aur farmaya : “Das logon ko bulaao. Unhen anumti di gai, to unhonne aasooda hokar khaana khaya aur phir nikal gae. Fir farmaya : “Das logon ko bulaao. Unhen anumti mili, to unhonne bhi aasooda hokar khaana khaya aur nikal gae. Yahaan tak ki sab logon ne bhar pet khaana kha liya. Jabki unki sankhya sattar athva assi thi. Saheeh Bukhari tatha Muslim. Jabki ek riwayat mein hai : Lagaataar das-das log daakhil hote gae aur das-das log nikalte rahe, yahaan tak ki sab log andar aye aur sabne bharpet khaana khaya. Phir shesh khaane ko ekatr kiya gaya, to pata chala ki utna hi bacha hua hai, jitna us samay tha, jab khaana shuru kiya gaya tha. Ek aur riwayat mein hai : Das-das log khaate rahe, yahaan tak ki assi logon ne khaana khaya. Phir uske baad Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aur ghar waalon ne khaana khaya tatha kuchh bacha hua khaana chhor bhi diya. Ek aur riwayat mein hai : Phir itna khaana bacha diya ki parosiyon ko bheja gaya. Ek any riwayat mein anas –radiyallahu anhu- pharmaate hain : Main Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aya, to aap masjid mein kuchh logon ke saath baithe hue the aur aapke pet par ek patti bandhi hui thi. Mainne kisi sahaabi se poochha ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apne pet par patti kyon baandhe hue hain? To uttar mila : Bhookh ke kaaran. So, main abu talha, jo umme sulaim bint milhaan ke pati the, ke paas gaya aur kaha : Ai mere abbu jaan! Mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko dekha hai ki aap apne pet par patti baandhe hue hain. Kuchh logon se poochha, to unhonne bataya ki aapne aisa bhookh ke kaaran kiya hai. Atah, abu talha meri maata ke paas gae aur baale : Tumhaare paas kuchh hai? Unhonne uttar diya : Haan! Mere paas roti ke kuchh tukre aur kuchh khajoor hain. Yadi Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- akele ayen, to ham aapko aasooda kar sakte hain. Parantu, yadi doosre log bhi a gae, to kam par jayenge. … phir poori hadees bayaan ki.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6614: Tum jaydaad mat banaao, anyatha duniya ki chaahat mein par jaaoge.

Abdullah bin masaood -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Tum jaydaad mat banaao, anyatha duniya ki chaahat mein par jaaoge."
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne jaydaad, baagh aur khet rakhne se mana kiya hai, kyonki yeh cheezen insaan ko aakhirat se hataakar duniya mein leen karne ka kaaran banti hain.

Duniya itna ekatr karne ki manaahi ki aakhirat se wimukhta ka kaaran ban jaye.
Is hadees mein jeewika kamaane ke saadhan apnaane se nahin, balki is duniya mein leen hokar aakhirat ko bhool jaane se mana kiya gaya hai.
Sindhi kahte hain : Is hadees ka matlab hai : Tum jaydaad banaane mein itna magn mat ho jaao ki aakhirat ko yaad karna hi bhool jaao.
[hasan li-ghairihi (any sandon athva riwayton ke saath milkar hasan)]
[ise tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
6615: ''Tummen se har ek ke saath Allah baat karega, is tarah ki uske aur uske rab ke beech koi anuwaadak na hoga.

Adi bin haatim radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : ''Tummen se har ek ke saath Allah baat karega, is tarah ki uske aur uske rab ke beech koi anuwaadak na hoga. Woh apne dayeen or dekhega to apne bheje hue amal ko dekhega aur bayeen or dekhega to apne aage bheje hue amal ko payega aur apne saamne dekhega to aag hi aag payega. Aag se daro, chaahe ek khajoor ke tukre dvaara kyon na ho.''

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam hamen bata rahe hain ki qayaamat ke din har momin sarvashaktimaan Allah ke saamne akela khara hoga aur Allah usse seedhe baat karega. Donon ke beech anuwaad karne ke liye koi anuwaadak nahin hoga. Woh ghabraahat mein bayen aur dayen dekhega ki shayad apne saamne maujood Jahannam mukti ka koi raasta mil jaye. Parantu yadi woh dayen dekhega, to use apne dvaara bheje gae achchhe karmon ke atirikt kuchh bhi dikhaai nahin dega. Aur jab bayen dekhega, to use apne dvaara aage bheje gae bure karmon ke alaawa kuchh bhi dikhaai nahin dega. Jab woh apne saamne dekhega, to use aag ke siwa kuchh nahin dikhega, aur woh usse bach bhi nahin payega, kyonki use pul-siraat se guzarna hi hoga. Iske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Daan aur achchhe karmon dvaara apne aur narak ke beech ek baadha banaao." Bhale hi daan chhota jaise aadha khajoor hi kyon na ho.

Daan dene, achchhe naitik moolyon aur aadton ko apnaane tatha doosron ke saath dayaaluta aur namrataapoorn vyavhaar karne ke liye protsaahan, chaahe woh kitna bhi chhota kyon na hon.
Qayaamat ke din Allah apne bande ke itne kareeb hoga ki un donon ke beech koi parda, koi madhyasth aur koi anuwaadak nahin hoga. Isliye, momin ko apne rab ke aadesh ka ullanghan karne se bachna chahiye.
Insaan ko kisi bhi daan ko kam nahin jaanna chahiye. Chaahe woh maamooli hi kyon na ho. Kyonki sadqa aag se suraksha ka zariya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
6636: Jab tum apne sadhaye hue kutte ko chhoro aur Allah ka naam lo, to use khaao jo woh tumhaare liye rokkar rakhe.

Adi bin haatim (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, main sadhaye hue kutton (ko shikaar ke peechhe) chhorta hoon, jo mere liye shikaar ko rokkar rakhte hain aur (unhen chhorte samay) Allah ka naam bhi leta hoon (to uske baare mein kya nirdesh hai)? Aapne farmayaah "Jab tum apne sadhaye hue kutte ko chhoro aur Allah ka naam lo, to use khaao jo woh tumhaare liye rok kar rakhe." Mainne kahaah agar sadhaye hue kutte jaan se maar den, to bhi? Aapne kahaah "Agar sadhaye hue kutte jaan se maar den, to bhi khaao, jab tak koi any kutta unke saath shaamil na ho jaye." Mainne kahaah main shikaar ki or nukeeli laathi chalaata hoon aur shikaar kar leta hoon (to uske baare mein kya nirdesh hai)? Aapne farmayaah "Jab tum neze se maaro aur woh use phaar de, to khaao aur agar chauraai mein lage, to na khaao."
Shaabi ne bhi adi bin haatim (radiyallahu anhu) se isi prakaar ki hadees riwayat ki hai. Usmen yeh izaafa bhi haih "Yeh aur baat hai ki kutta kha le. Agar woh khud kha le, to mat khaao; kyonki mujhe is baat ka bhay hai ki kaheen usne apne liye shikaar na kiya ho. Aur agar uske saath any kutte shikaar karne mein shareek ho jayen, to na khaao; kyonki tumne apne kutte ko chhorte hue Allah ka naam liya hai, kisi aur kutte ko chhorte samay nahin."
Tatha usi mein haih "Jab apne sadhaye hue kutte ko chhoro, to Allah ka naam lo. Yadi woh tumhaare liye pakarkar rakhe aur use zinda paao, to zabah karo. Aur agar mara hua paao aur kutte ne usmen se kuchh na khaya ho, to use khaao, kyonki kutte ka pakarna hi uska zibah karna hai."
Usi mein yeh bhi haih "Jab teer chalaao, to Allah ka naam lo."
Tatha usi mein haih "Yadi shikaar tumhen ek ya do din (tatha ek riwayat ke anusaar do evn teen din) na mile aur uske shareer mein tum apne teer ke nishaan ke atirikt koi nishaan na paao, to agar chaaho to khaao. Aur agar use paani mein dooba hua paao, to mat khaao; kyonki tum nahin jaante ki uski maut paani mein doobne se hui hai ya tumhaara teer lagne se?"

Adi bin haatim (radiyallahu anhu) ne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se sadhaye hue kutton, jinhen unke maalik ne shikaar karna sikha rakha ho, se shikaar karne ke baare mein poochha, to aapne unse kahaah jab unhen chhorte samay Allah ka naam le lo, to woh jo shikaar pakarkar layen, use khaao, jab tak unke saath tumhen koi doosra kutta na mile. Yadi unke saath koi doosra kutta mile, to na khaao, kyonki tumne apne kutte ko chhorte samay Allah ka naam liya tha, kisi aur ke kutte ko chhorte samay nahin. Isi tarah jab tum shikaar ki or neza phenko aur woh shikaar ke shareer mein dhans jaye aur rakt baha de, to use khaao. Shart yeh hai ki Allah ka naam liya ho. Parantu yadi neza chauraai mein lage aur shikaar mar jaye, to mat khaao. Kyonki woh chot lagne se mara hai, isliye girkar marne aur chot lagne se marne waale jaanvar ke hukm mein hoga. Phir jab aadmi apna kutta chhore aur shikaar ko zinda paye aur kutte ne use maara na ho, to use zabah karna zaroori hoga aur aisi sthiti mein shikaar halaal hoga, chaahe any kutte bhi kyon na shareek ho gae hon. Unhonne aapse teer se shikaar karne ke baare mein poochha, jab teer chalaate samay Allah ka naam le liya gaya ho, to aapne unhen aadesh diya ki usse kiye hue shikaar ko khaye. Phir yadi shikaar ek ya do din ghayab rah jaye aur usmen apne teer ke nishaan ke atirikt koi aur nishaan na paye, to woh use kha sakta hai. Lekin yadi paani mein dooba hua mile, to na khaye, kyonki yeh nahin pata ki shikaar paani mein doobne ke kaaran mara hai ya teer lagne se.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6637: Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne makka se haathi waalon ko rok diya tha aur usne apne Rasool tatha mominon ko uspar wijay pradaan kiya hai. Dekho, yeh na to mujhse pahle kisi ke liye halaal hua tha aur na mere baad kisi ke liye halaal hoga. Yeh mere liye bhi kewal din ki ek ghari ke liye halaal hua tha aur is samay haraam hai.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki jab Allah taaala ne apne Rasool ko makka par wijay pradaan ki, to khuzaaa qabeele ne banu lais qabeele ke ek vyakti ko, apne ek vyakti ke badle mein qatl kar diya, jo jaahiliyat kaal mein qatl hua tha. Aise mein Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- khare hue aur farmayaah "Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne makka se haathi waalon ko rok diya tha aur usne apne Rasool tatha mominon ko uspar wijay pradaan ki hai. Dekho, yeh na to mujhse pahle kisi ke liye halaal hua tha aur na mere baad kisi ke liye halaal hoga. Yeh mere liye bhi kewal din ki ek ghari ke liye halaal hua tha aur is samay haraam hai. Na uska per kaata ja sakta hai, na uski taaza ghaas ko kaata ja sakta hai, na uske kaante ko kaata ja sakta hai aur na uske gire hue saamaan ko uthaya ja sakta hai. Haan, yadi koi elaan karne ke liye uthaye, to aur baat hai. Tatha jiske kisi vyakti ko maar diya jaye, use do baaton mein se jo behtar lage, karne ka akhtiyaar hoga; ya to qatl kare ya diyat (woh dhan jo kisi ko maar daalne ya ang bhang karne ke badle mein diya jaye) le." Itne mein yaman ka abu shaah naami ek vyakti khara hua aur kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, mere liye likh deejiye. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Abu shaah ke liye likh do." Phir abbaas - radiyallahu anhu- khare hue aur kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, hamen izkhir naamak paudhe ko kaatne ki anumti deejiye, kyonki ham use apne gharon aur qabron mein daalte hain. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Haan, izkhir paudhe ko kaatne ki anumti hai."

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) bata rahe hain ki jab makka par wijay praapt hui, to khuzaaa qabeele ke ek vyakti ne huzail qabeele ke ek vyakti ka, apne ek vyakti ke badle mein, jo jaahiliyat kaal mein maara gaya tha, wadh kar diya. Yeh dekh Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) khare hue aur khutbe mein woh saari baaten kaheen, jinka zikr hadees mein hai. Chunaanche makka ki hurmat bayaan ki aur yeh bataya ki Allah ne usse haathi waalon ko rok diya tha aur apne Nabi ke liye din ke kuchh samay ke liye halaal kiya tha. Widit ho ki is hadees mein ullikhit shabd '‎الساعة' se aashay uska aam arth yaani ek ghanta nahin, balki usse aashay wijay diwas ka kuchh bhaag hai. Kyonki us din subah se asr tak aapke liye yuddh karna halaal kiya gaya tha. Aapne yeh bhi bataya ki uske baad phir uski hurmat laut aai. Saath hi yeh bhi bataya ki uske kaante ko kaata nahin ja sakta, uske per ko nahin kaata ja sakta aur izkhir ke siwa haram ki seemaaon ke andar ugne waali kisi ghaas ko kaata nahin ja sakta aur wahaan pare hue kisi saamaan ko uthaya nahin ja sakta. Yeh aur baat hai ki koi elaan karne ke liye uthaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6760: Us zaat ki qasam, jiske haath mein mere praan hain, main tumhaare beech Allah ki pustak ke anusaar hi nirnay karoonga. Daasi aur bakriyaan tumhen waapas milengi. Tumhaare bete ko sau kore lagenge aur use ek saal ka desh nikaala diya jayega. Ai unais (aslam qabeele ka ek vyakti), tum iski patni ke paas jaao. Yadi woh sveekaar kar le, to use sangsaar (islaami dharmashaastr ke anusaar ek prakaar ka praandand jismen apraadhi ko zameen mein kamar tak gaarkar uske sir par pattharon ki warsha karke maar diya jaata hai) kar do.

Abu huraira aur zaid bin khaalid juhni -radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki ek dehaati Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aakar bolaah ai Allah ke Rasool, main aapko Allah ki qasam dekar kahta hoon ki aap hamaare beech kewal Allah ki pustak ke anusaar nirnay karenge. Doosre vyakti ne, (jo pahle ki tulna mein adhik samajhdaar tha) kahaah theek hai, aap hamaare beech Allah ki kitaab ke anusaar nirnay kar den aur mujhe bolne ki anumti den. Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Theek hai, kaho." Usne kahaah mera beta is aadmi ke yahaan kaam karta tha aur usne iski patni se vyabhichaar kar liya. Mujhe bataya gaya hai ki mere bete ko sangsaar kiya jaana hai. Atah mainne uski gardan chhuraane ke liye sau bakri aur ek daasi de di. Phir mainne jaankaaron se poochha, to bataya ki mere bete ko sau kore lagaane hain aur ek saal desh nikaala dena hai, jabki uski patni ko sangsaar kiya jaana hai. Yeh sunkar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Us zaat ki qasam, jiske haath mein mere praan hain, main tumhaare beech Allah ki pustak ke anusaar hi nirnay karoonga. Daasi aur bakriyaan tumhen waapas milengi. Tumhaare bete ko sau kore lagenge aur use ek saal ka desh nikaala diya jayega. Ai unais (aslam qabeele ka ek vyakti), tum iski patni ke paas jaao. Yadi woh sveekaar kar le, to use sangsaar (islaami dharmashaastr ke anusaar ek prakaar ka praandand jismen apraadhi ko zameen mein kamar tak gaarkar uske sir par pattharon ki warsha karke maar diya jaata hai) kar do." Chunaanche unais -radiyallahu anhu- uske paas gae aur usne sveekaar kar liya, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke aadesh par use sangsaar kar diya gaya.

Is hadees mein bataya gaya hai ki ek vyakti doosre ke yahaan kaam karta tha aur uski patni se vyabhichaar kar liya. Vyabhichaar karne waale ke pita ne sun rakha tha ki har vyabhichaari ka sangsaar hona hai, isliye gardan chhuraane ke liye us stri ke pati ko sau bakri aur ek daasi de di. Uske baad kuchh jaankaar logon se poochha, to pata chala ki sangsaar uske bete ka nahin, balki us stri ka hona hai. Jabki uske bete ko sau kor lagne hain aur ek warsh ke liye desh se nikaalna hai. Atah, vyabhichaarini ka pati aur vyabhichaari ka pita, donon Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aye, taaki aap unke beech Allah ki kitaab ke anusaar nirnay kar den. Chunaanche aapne sau bakriyaan aur daasi vyabhichaari ke pita ko lauta di aur use bataya ki uske bete ko sau kore lagne hain aur ek warsh ke liye desh se nikaalna hai, kyonki woh shaadeeshuda nahin hai. Phir aapne vyabhichaarini se poochhtaachh ka aadesh diya aur jab usne apraadh sveekaar kar liya, to use sangsaar kar diya, kyonki woh shaadeeshuda thi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6761: Kisi oont ke gale mein koi taant athva any koi wastu bandhi mile, to use rahne na diya jaye, balki kaat diya jaye.

Abu basheer ansaari radiyallahu anhu kahte hain : Ek yaatra mein woh Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath the. Unka kahna hai ki jab log apne sone ki jaghon mein the, to aapne ek vyakti ko bheja ki kisi oont ke gale mein koi taant athva any koi wastu bandhi mile, to use rahne na diya jaye, balki kaat diya jaye.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ek yaatra mein the aur log apne-apne tanbuon ke andar sone ki jaghon mein maujood the. Isi dauraan aapne ek vyakti ko is aadesh ke saath bhej diya ki log apne oonton ke galon mein bandhi hui cheezon ko kaat den, chaahe wo taant aadi hon ya ghanti tatha joota aadi. Kyonki we yeh cheezen apne jaanavron ko buri nazar se bachaane ke liye baandha karte the. In cheezon ko hata dene ka aadesh isliye diya ki yeh cheezen oonton ko kisi cheez se bacha nahin sakteen. Laabh tatha haani kewal Allah ke haath mein hai. Kisi aur ke haath mein nahin.

Laabh praapt karne tatha nuqsaan se bachne ke liye taant aadi latkaana haraam hai. Kyonki yeh shirk hai.
Oont ke gale mein taant ke alaawa koi cheez agar shobha, jaanvar ko haankne ya use baandhne ke liye baandhi jaye, to koi harj nahin hai.
Apni kshamta anusaar ghalat cheez ka khandan karna zaroori hai.
Dil ka sanbandh kewal Allah se hona chahiye. Kisi aur se nahin.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
6763: Jisne koi wastu latkaai, use usi ke hawaale kar diya jaata hai.
Abdullah bin ukaim -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Jisne koi wastu latkaai, use usi ke hawaale kar diya jaata hai."

Jiska dil ya kaary athva donon kisi cheez se sanbaddh ho gae aur woh usi se laabh ki aasha tatha haani se suraksha ki ummeed karne lage, Allah use usi ke hawaale kar deta hai. Chunaanche jisne Allah se sanpark sthaapit kiya Allah uske liye kaafi hota hai aur uske har kathin kaary ko aasaan kar deta hai, tatha jisne uske siwa kisi aur se sanpark jora, Allah use usi ke hawaale karke akela chhor deta hai, aur apmaanit karta hai.

Allah ke alaawa kisi aur sanbandh jorne ki manaahi.
Sabhi maamlon mein Allah se sanbandh jorne ki aniwaaryata.
Shirk ke nuqsaan tatha uske bure anjaam ka warnan.
Allah ki or se pratiphal insaan ke karm hi ke warg ka diya jaata hai.
Amal, chaahe achchha ho ki bura, uska parinaam amal karne waale ki or lautta hai.
Allah se munh pherkar kisi aur se hiteksha karne waale ki naakaami.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6764: Ai ruwaife, ho sakta hai ki tumhen lanbi ayu mile. Logon ko bata dena ki jo apni daarhi mein girah lagayega, taant gale mein daalega ya kisi pashu ke gobar athva haddi se istinja karega, Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) usse bari hain.

Ruwaife kahte hain ki mujhse Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Ai ruwaife, ho sakta hai ki tumhen lanbi ayu mile. Logon ko bata dena ki jo apni daarhi mein girah lagayega, taant gale mein daalega ya kisi pashu ke gobar athva haddi se istinja karega, Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) usse bari hain."

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne yeh soochna di hai ki is sahaabi ko lanbi ayu milegi aur woh aise logon ko dekhenge, jo daarhi ke saath, jise barhaane tatha sammaan dene ka aadesh hai, gair arab athva wilaasita aur taralta ke logon ka anusran karte hue khilvaar karenge.
Ya shirk ke saadhnon ka prayog karke aqeeda-e-tauheed ko haani pahunchayenge aur pareshaani se bachne ke liye apne galon mein taant pahnenge athva apne jaanavron ko pahnayenge.
Ya phir chaupayon ke gobar aur haddiyon se istinja (pawitrata praapt) karenge, jisse Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne mana kiya hai.
Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne us sahaabi ko waseeyat ki ki logon ko yeh baat pahuncha den ki aapne is tarah ke logon se khud ke bezaar hone ka elaan kiya hai.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6765: Jisne 'la ilaaha illallah' ka iqraar kiya aur Allah ke atirikt pooji jaane waali any wastuon ka inkaar kar diya, uska dhan tatha praan surakshit ho jayega aur uska hisaab Allah ke hawaale hoga.

Taariq bin ashyam ashjai radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Jisne 'la ilaaha illallah' ka iqraar kiya aur Allah ke atirikt pooji jaane waali any wastuon ka inkaar kar diya, uska dhan tatha praan surakshit ho jayega aur uska hisaab Allah ke hawaale hoga."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jisne apni zabaan se kaha tatha gawaahi di ki Allah ke siwa koi sachcha poojy nahin hai aur Allah ke siwa any pooji jaane waali wastuon ka inkaar kar diya tatha Islam ke atirikt any sabhi dharmon se sanbandh wichchhed kar liya, uska dhan tatha rakt musalmaanon par haraam ho gaya. Ham kewal uske zaahiri amal ko dekhenge. Atah uske dhan ko chheena tatha uske rakt ko bahaya nahin ja sakta. Haan, agar woh koi aisa apraadh kar baithta hai, jiski wajah se islaami disha-nirdeshon ke anusaar aisa kiya ja sakta ho, to baat alag hai.

Aise mein uska hisaab qayaamat ke din Allah lega. Sachcha hoga, to sawaab dega aur jhootha hoga, to azaab dega.

La ilaaha illallah bolna tatha Allah ke atirikt pooji jaane waali saari cheezon ka inkaar karna Islam mein prawesh karne ke liye shart hai.
La ilaaha illallah ka arth hai Allah ke atirikt pooji jaane waali saari cheezon, jaise buton evn qabron aadi ka inkaar karna aur kewal ek Allah ki ibaadat karna.
Jisne Allah ke ek hone ka iqraar kiya aur zaahiri taur par Allah ki shareeyat ka paalan kiya, use chherne se bachna zaroori hai, jab tak koi aisa kaam na kare, jo is dharm ke wipreet jaata ho.
Naahaq kisi musalmaan ke dhan, rakt tatha maan-sammaan par haath daalna haraam hai.
Duniya mein nirnay zaahir ke anusaar liya jayega, jabki aakhirat mein neeyton aur uddeshyon ko dekha jayega.
6820: Allah us vyakti ko khush wa aabaad rakhe, jisne mujhse koi baat suni aur use usi prakaar doosron tak pahuncha diya, jis prakaar mujhse suni thi. Kyonki bahut baar sunne waale se woh vyakti adhik yaad rakhta hai (ya adhik samajhdaar hota hai) jis tak baat pahunchaai gai ho.

Abdullah bin masaood -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Allah us vyakti ko khush wa aabaad rakhe, jisne mujhse koi baat suni aur use usi prakaar doosron tak pahuncha diya, jis prakaar mujhse suni thi. Kyonki bahut baar sunne waale se woh vyakti adhik yaad rakhta hai (ya adhik samajhdaar hota hai) jis tak baat pahunchaai gai ho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aise vyakti ko duniya mein hare-bhare tatha sundar jeewan evn aakhirat mein Jannat ki shaadaabi tatha nemton ki praapti ki dua di hai, jo aapki hadees sune, use yaad rakhe aur doosron ko pahuncha de. Kyonki kai baar aisa hota hai ki hadees naqal karne waale ki tulna mein naqal karne waale se praapt karne waala hi kaheen zyaada yaad rakhne waala, samajhne waala aur usse masayal nikaalne ki salaahiyat rakhne waala hota hai. Is tarah pahla vyakti yaad rakhne aur naqal karne ka kaam behtar andaaz mein karta hai tatha doosra samajhne tatha masayal nikaalne ka kaam behtar andaaz mein karta hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki sunnat ko yaad karne aur use logon tak pahunchaane ke liye protsaahan.
Ahl-e-hadees tatha hadees ka jnaan praapt karne waalon ki fazeelat tatha pratishtha ka bayaan.
Hadees ko samajhne aur usse masayal nikaalne ki kshamta rakhne waale ulema ki fazeelat.
Sahaaba radiyallahu anhum ki fazeelat, jinhonne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki hadees suni aur use ham tak pahunchaya.
Munaawi kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki hadees ke warnankarta ke liye faqeeh hona shart nahin hai. Uske liye shart yaad rakhna hai. Samajhne aur ghaur wa fikr karne ka kaam faqeeh ka hai.
Ibn-e-uyaina kahte hain : Hadees ke widdhaarthi ke chehre se hamesha taazgi jhalakti hai.
Muhaddison ke yahaan yaad rakhne ke do prakaar hain : Seene mein surakshit rakhna aur likhit roop se surakshit rakhna. Donon prakaar se yaad rakhna is hadees mein shaamil hai.
Logon ki samajh alag-alag hua karti hai. Kyonki bahut-se sunne waale se seekhne waale log sunne waale se adhik yaad rakhne waale hua karte hain, aur bahut-se fiqh ki saamagri apne paas rakhne waale log faqeeh nahin hua karte.
[ise tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
6821: Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kuchh rekhayen kheencheen aur farmaya : "Yeh insaan hai aur yeh uski maut hai. Insaan isi awastha mein rahta hai ki nikatmat rekha pahunch jaati hai."

Anas -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kuchh rekhayen kheencheen aur farmaya : "Yeh insaan hai aur yeh uski maut hai. Insaan isi awastha mein rahta hai ki nikatmat rekha pahunch jaati hai."
Ibne masaood -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek wargaakaar rekha kheenchi aur uske beechobeech se baahar nikalti hui ek rekha kheenchi. Uske bada beech waali rekha ke us bhaag mein, jo wargaakaar rekha ke andar tha, chho-chhoti bahut-si rekhayen kheencheen aur farmaya : "Yeh insaan hai, yeh uski maut hai jo use chaaron or se ghere hue hai, yeh nikli hui rekha uski aasha hai aur ye chhoti-chhoti rekhayen durghatnayen hain. Insaan jab ek durghatna se bachkar nikalta hai, to doosri mein phans jaata hai aur jab doosri se bachkar nikalta hai, to teesri mein phans jaata hai."
6828: Qayaamat ke din Qur'an aur Qur'an waalon ko laya jayega, jo duniya mein uspar amal kiya karte the.

Navvaas bin samaaan -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko farmaate hue suna hai : "Qayaamat ke din Qur'an aur Qur'an waalon ko laya jayega, jo duniya mein uspar amal kiya karte the. Qur'an ke aage-aage soora baqra tatha soora aal-e-imraan hogi, jo apne parhne waalon ki or se tark-witark karegi."
6829: Woh zamaana qareeb hai, jab musalmaan ka behatreen maal bakriyaan hongi, jinko lekar woh pahaaron ki chotiyon ki or nikal jayega.

Abu saeed khudri -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, unhonne kaha ki rasoolullah - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Woh zamaana qareeb hai, jab musalmaan ka behatreen maal bakriyaan hongi, jinko lekar woh pahaaron ki chotiyon aur baarish ke sthaanon ki taraph apne deen ko bachaane ke liye nikal jayega."

Is hadees mein fitne ke dinon mein logon se alag-thalag rahne ki fazeelat bayaan ki gai hai. Lekin yadi aadmi aisa ho ki uske andar fitne ko khatm karne ki kshamta ho, to use aawashyak roop se use khatm karne ka prayaas karna chahiye. Paristhiti evn sanbhaavna ke anuroop yeh kabhi farz-e-ain hota hai aur kabhi farz-e-kifaya. Jahaan tak fitnon ke dinon ko chhor saadhaaran dinon ki baat hai, to unmen alag-thalag rahna achchha hai ya miljulkar rahna, is baat mein ulema ka matbhed hai. Lekin sahi baat yeh hai ki yadi gunaah mein parne ki prabal sanbhaavna na ho, to miljulkar rahna hi uttam hai.
"Apne dharm ko bachaane ke liye nikal jayega" Yaani is dar se bhaag khara hoga ki kaheen uska dharm fitne ka shikaar na ho jaye. Isi baat ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue insaan ko shirk ke kshetr se Islam ke kshetr ki or evn gunaah ke kshetr se dharm ke anupaalan ke kshetr ki or hijrat karne ka aadesh diya gaya hai. Bilkul isi tarah jab log aur samay badal jaye, to alag-thalag rahna hi uttam hai.
6967: Main soya hua tha ki isne meri talvaar mujhpar utha li. Meri aankh khuli, to talvaar uske haath mein chamak rahi thi. Usne mujhse kaha : Tumhen mujhes kaun bachayega? Mainne kaha : Allah –teen baar-!

Jaabir -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki unhonne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath nazd ki or ek yuddh mein bhaag liya. Jab Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- waapas laute, to woh bhi saath mein waapas laute. Isi beech ek kaantedaar peron waali ghaati mein dophar ke khaane ke baad wishraam ka samay ho gaya. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- sawaari se utre aur sahaaba per ki chhaya ki talaash mein idhar-udhar phail gae. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ek babool ke per ke neeche utre aur usmen apni talvaar latka di. Hamen thori-si neend a gai. Achaanak hamne suna ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hamen pukaar rahe hain aur phir hamne dekha ki aapke paas ek dehaati khara hai. Aapne farmaya : “Main soya hua tha ki isne meri talvaar mujhpar utha li. Meri aankh khuli, to talvaar uske haath mein chamak rahi thi. Usne mujhse kaha : Tumhen mujhes kaun bachayega? Mainne kaha : Allah –teen baar-!” aapne use koi dand nahin diya aur phir aap baith gae. Saheeh Bukhari tatha saheeh Muslim.
Ek any riwayat mein hai : Jaabir -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain : Ham zaat ar-riqa yuddh ke avsar par Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath the. Jab ham kisi sayaadaar per ke paas aate, to use Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke liye chhor dete. Allah ke Rasool –sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki talvaar per mein latak rahi thi ki ek bahudevvaadi aya aur use aappar kheenchte hue kaha : Tum mujhse darte ho? Aapne uttar diya : “Nahin!” woh bola : Tumhen mujhse kaun bachayega? Farmaya : “Allah!”
Jabki abu bakr ismaaeeli ne apni ‘saheeh’ mein riwayat kiya hai ki usne kaha : Tumhen mujhse kaun bachayega? Farmaya : “Allah!” jaabir kahte hain ki itna sunte hi uske haath se talvaar gir gai aur Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne talvaar sanbhaalne ke baad farmaya : “Tujhe mujhse kaun bachayega?” usne kahaah aap uttam talvaar pakarne waale banen. Tab aapne kaha : “Tum gawaahi dete ho ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur main Allah ka Rasool hoon?” usne uttar diya : Nahin! Lekin main wachan deta hoon ki kabhi aapse yuddh nahin karunga aur aapse yuddh karne waale kisi samuday ka saath bhi nahin doonga. Ispar aapne use jaane jiya. Jab woh apne saathiyon ke paas pahuncha, to bola : Main sabse behtar vyakti ke paas se hokar tumhaare paas aya hoon.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6973: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko soochna mili ki amr bin auf ke beton ke beech laraai ho gai hai. Atah, Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- kuchh logon ke saath unke beech sulah karaane pahunche.

Sahl bin saad saaidi -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko soochna mili ki amr bin auf ke beton ke beech laraai ho gai hai. Atah, Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- kuchh logon ke saath unke beech sulah karaane pahunche. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko waapsi mein kuchh der ho gai aur namaz ka samay nikat a gaya, to bilaal –Allah unse prasann ho- abu bakr -Allah unse prasann ho- ke paas aye aur bole : Ai abu bakr, Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko wahaan der ho gai aur namaz ka samay bhi nikat a gaya hai. Aise mein kya aap logon ki imaamat kar sakte hain? Farmayaah haan, yadi tum chaaho. Chunaanche, bilaal –Allah unse prasann ho- ne iqaamat kahi aur abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu- aage barhe aur takbeer kahi tatha logon ne bhi takbeer kahi. Isi beech Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- saphon ke darmiyaan chalte hue a gae aur saf mein khare ho gae. Aapko dekh, log taali bajaane lage. Abu bakr –radiyallahu anhu- choonki namaz mein idhar-udhar nazar nahin daalte the, isliye unhen kuchh pata na chal saka. Jab log zyaada taali bajaane lage, to abu bakr –radiyallahu anhu- ne nazar daali aur dekha ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- a gae hain. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ishaare se unhen namaz parhaane ko kaha. Lekin unhonne haath uthaya, Allah ki prashansa ki aur peechhe ki or hatte hue saf mein khare ho gae. Yeh dekh, Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aage barhe aur logon ko namaz parhaai. Jab namaz khatm hui, to aapne logon ki or munh karke farmaya : “Ai logon, kya baat hai ki jab namaz mein koi baat hoti hai, to tum taali bajaane lagte ho? Suno, taali mahilaaon ke liye hai. Jise namaz mein koi baat pesh aye, woh subhaan Allah kahe. Kyonki jo bhi kisi ko subhaan Allah kahte hue sunega, woh mutvajjeh hoga. Ai abu bakar, tumhen kis cheez ne mere ishaara karne ke baavjood namaz parhaane se roka?” abu bakr ne kaha : Abu quhaafa ke bete ko shobha nahin deta ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki upasthiti mein logon ko namaz parhaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6979: Sabse bara jhoot yeh hai ki insaan apni aankhon ko aisi cheez dikhaye, jo unhonne na dekhi hon.

Ibne umar -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki rasoolullah -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmaya : "Sabse bara jhoot yeh hai ki insaan apni aankhon ko aisi cheez dikhaye, jo unhonne na dekhi hon."
6980: Ham log jab apne baadshaahon ke paas jaate hain, to aisi baaten karte hain, jo baaten wahaan se nikalne ke baad nahin karte. Unhonne uttar diya : Ham ise Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke yug mein nifaaq -paakhand tatha rhong- samajhte the.

Muhammad bin zaid kahte hain ki kuchh logon ne unke daada abdullah bin umar -Allah unse prasann ho- se kaha : Ham log jab apne baadshaahon ke paas jaate hain, to aisi baaten karte hain, jo baaten wahaan se nikalne ke baad nahin karte. Unhonne uttar diya : Ham ise Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke yug mein nifaaq -paakhand tatha rhong- samajhte the.
6982: Jo vyakti mere hawaale se koi baat bataye aur use lagta ho ki woh jhooth hai, to woh jhoothon mein se ek hai.

Samura bin jundub aur mughbeera bin shoba radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, donon kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jo vyakti mere hawaale se koi baat bataye aur use lagta ho ki woh jhooth hai, to woh jhoothon mein se ek hai."

Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jo vyakti aapke hawaale se koi hadees bayaan kare aur woh jaanta ho ya use lagta ho ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki or is hadees ki nisbat jhoothi hai, to bayaan karne waala bhi is jhooth mein ise pahli baar bolne waale ka shareek hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se naqal ki gai hadeeson ki chhaanbeen karna aur unhen riwayat karne se pahle unke saheeh hone ke baare mein aashvast ho jaana zaroori hai.
Jhooth bolne waale ke saath-saath use naqal karne aur phailaane waala bhi jhootha hai.
Kisi hadees ke managrhat hone ka jnaan ya prabal gumaan hone ke baavjood use naqal karna haraam hai. Haan, usse saavdhaan karne ke liye naqal kiya jaye, to baat alag hai.
[is hadees ko Muslim ne apne muqaddame (prastaavna) mein riwayat kiya hai]
6983: Na di hui cheez ko zaahir karne waala aisa hai, jaise kisi ne jhooth ka jora pahan rakha ho.

Asma -radiyallahu anha- se riwayat hai ki ek aurat ne rasoolullah -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Meri ek sautan hai. Agar main uska dil jalaane ke liye uske saamne kisi cheez ke milne ka izhaar karoon, jo mere pati ne mujhe nahin di hai, to kya mujhe gunaah hoga? To rasoolullah -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmaya : "Na di hui cheez ko zaahir karne waala aisa hai, jaise kisi ne jhooth ka jora pahan rakha ho."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6984: Kisi sachche aadmi ko yeh shobha nahin deta ki woh atyadhik laanat karne waala ho.
Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki rasoolullah -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmaya : "Kisi sachche aadmi ko yeh shobha nahin deta ki woh atyadhik laanat karne waala ho."
6985: Tum ek-doosre ke liye na Allah ki laanat ki baddua karo, na uske krodh ki baddua karo aur na Jahannam ki baddua karo.
Samura bin jundub -Allah unse prasann ho- se marfooan warnit hai : "Tum ek-doosre ke liye na Allah ki laanat ki baddua karo, na uske krodh ki baddua karo aur na Jahannam ki baddua karo."
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6986: Jab koi banda kisi wastu par dhikkaar karta hai, to dhikkaar aakaash ki or chal deta hai, lekin uske liye aakaash ke dvaar band kar diye jaate hain. Atah, woh dharti ki or utarne lagta hai, lekin dharti ke dvaar bhi uske liye band kar diye jaate hain. Phir woh dayen-bayen jaane ka prayaas karta hai, lekin jab kaheen koi jagah nahin milti, to uski or lautta hai, jispar dhikkaar kiya gaya hai. Yadi woh uske yogy hai, to theek. Anyatha, dhikkaar karne waale ki or laut jaata hai.

Abu darda -Allah unse prasann ho- se marfooan warnit hai : "Jab koi banda kisi wastu par dhikkaar karta hai, to dhikkaar aakaash ki or chal deta hai, lekin uske liye aakaash ke dvaar band kar diye jaate hain. Atah, woh dharti ki or utarne lagta hai, lekin dharti ke dvaar bhi uske liye band kar diye jaate hain. Phir woh dayen-bayen jaane ka prayaas karta hai, lekin jab kaheen koi jagah nahin milti, to uski or lautta hai, jispar dhikkaar kiya gaya hai. Yadi woh uske yogy hai, to theek. Anyatha, dhikkaar karne waale ki or laut jaata hai."

Jab banda kisi cheez par apni zabaan se laanat karta hai, to uski yeh laanat aakaash ki or charhti hai. Lekin aakaash ke dvaar uske liye band hote hain. Atah woh dharti ki or lautne lagti hai. Magar dharti ke dvaar bhi uske liye band ho jaate hain aur woh usmen prawesh nahin kar paati. Phir woh dayen-bayen jaati hai. Yadi use koi maarg ya sthaan nahin milta, to us cheez ki or laut jaati hai, jispar laanat ki gai hai. Ab yadi woh cheez laanat ki adhikaari hai, to uske paas rah jaati hai aur agar nahin hai, to laanat karne waale ki or laut jaati hai aur usi se chipak jaati hai.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
6987: Uspar jo kuchh hai, use le lo aur use chhor do, kyonki uspar laanat kar di gai hai.

Imraan bin husain -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ek yaatra mein the aur ek ansaari mahila apni oontni par sawaar thi. Isi beech oontni bidak gai, to unhonne uspar laanat kar di, jise Allah ke Rasool -sallallalaahu alaihi wa sallam- ne sun liya. Atah, aapne farmaya : "Uspar jo kuchh hai, use le lo aur use chhor do, kyonki uspar laanat kar di gai hai." Imraan kahte hain : Goya ki main use dekh raha hoon ki woh logon ke darmiyaan chal rahi hai, lekin koi usse chherchhaar nahin karta.
6988: Hamaare saath aisi oontni nahin chalegi, jispar laanat ki gai hai.

Abu barza nazla bin ubaid asalmi -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki ek larki oontni par baithi thi aur uspar logon ke kuchh saamaan the. Isi beech usne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko dekha. Us samay log parvat ke tang maarg se guzar rahe the. Atah, usne apni oontni se kaha : Ari chal! Ai Allah! Ispar laanat kar! Yeh sun Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Hamaare saath aisi oontni nahin chalegi, jispar laanat ki gai hai."
7041: God mein kewal teen logon ne hi baat ki hai.

Abu huraira -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah god mein kewal teen logon ne hi baat ki hai : Eesa bin maryam ne aur juraij ke maamle se sanbandhit bachche ne. Daraasal, juraij ek aabid tha. Woh ek aashram banaakar useemen rahta tha. Ek din woh namaz parh raha tha ki uski maan aai aur boli : Ai juraij! To usne kaha : Ai mere rab, ek or meri maan hai aur ek or meri namaz! Phir woh namaz mein vyast ho gaya. Atah, uski maan waapas laut gai. Doosre din phir aai, to phir woh namaz mein vyast tha. Usne aawaaz di : Ai jooraij! To juraij ne kaha : Ai mer rab! Ek or meri maan hai, to ek or meri namaz! Chunaanche usne namaz parhna jaari rakha. Phir woh teesre din aai, to aaj bhi woh namaz mein vyasth tha. Usne kaha : Ai juraij! To juraij kaha : Ai mere rab! Ek or meri maan aur ek or meri namaz. Phir woh namaz mein vyast ho gaya. Isse wichlit hokar uski maan ne kaha : Ai Allah! Tu ise us samay tak mrityu na dena, jab tak woh vyabhichaar mein lipt striyon ka munh na dekh le. Chunaanche banu israaeel mein juraij aur uski ibaadat ke charche hone lage. Un dinon, ek khoobsoorat vyabhichaari stri bhi maujood thi, jiski sundarta ki misaal di jaati thi. Usne kaha : Yadi tum log chaaho, to main use fitne mein daal sakti hoon. Chunaanche usne use rijhaane ki koshish ki, lekin usne uspar dhyaan nahin diya. Atah, woh ek charvaahe ke paas gai, jiska juraij ke aashram mein aana-jaana tha. Phir usse vyabhichaar karaya aur woh garbhavti ho gai. Jab bachcha paida hua, to kahne lagi ki yeh juraij ka bachcha hai. Atah, log juraij ke paas aye aur use aashram se nikaalkar aashram ko dhaha diya tatha use maarne lage. Yeh dekh, usne kaha : Tum log mujhe maar kyon rahe ho? Logon ne uttar diya : Tumne is vyabhichaarini se munh kaala kiya hai aur usne tumhaare bachche ko janm diya hai. Usne kaha : Bachcha kahaan hai? Chunaanche logon ne bachche ko haazir kar diya. Ab usne kaha : Mujhe namaz parhne do. Jab namaz poori ho gai, to bachche ke paas aya aur uske pet mein ungli se chot karte hue bola : Ai bachcha, tera pita kaun hai? Bachche ne uttar diya : Amuk charvaaha. Yeh dekh, log juraij ko choomne aur uske haath-paanv chhoone lage aur kahne lage : Ham tumhaara aashram sone ka bana denge. Lekin usne kaha : Uski aawashyakta nahin hai. Use pahle ki tarah mitti se bana do. Chunaanche logon ne usi tarah ka aashram bana diya. Ek bachcha apni maan ka doodh pi raha tha ki ek vyakti ek shaandaar evn sundar ghore par sawaar hokar guzra. Use dekh, uski maan ne kaha : Ai Allah, mere bachche ko isi ke jaisa bana de. Ispar us bachche ne doodh chhorkar us aadmi ki or dekha aur kaha : Ai Allah, mujhe iske na banaana. Iske baad woh doodh peene laga. Warnanakta kahte hain : Maano main aaj bhi Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko, apni tarjani ko munh mein rakhkar tatha use chooskar us bachche ke doodh peene ki kaifiyat bayaan karte hue dekh raha hoon. Phir aage farmaya : “Phir log ek daasi ko lekar guzre, jise we maarte jaate the aur kahte jaate the : Tumne vyabhichaar kiya hai, tumne chori ki hai. Jabki woh kah rahi thi : Mere liye Allah hi kaafi hai aur wahi behatreen sahayak hai. Yeh dekh, uski maan ne kaha : Ai Allah mere bete ko iske jaisa na banaana. Lekin usne doodh peena chhorkar uski or dekha aur kaha : Ai Allah mujhe useeke jaisa banaana. Yahaan donon maan-bete ne aapas mein baat ki. Maan ne kaha : Ek sundar vyakti guzra, to mainne kaha ki ai Allah, mere bete ko isi jaisa bana de, lekin tumne kah diya ki ai Allah, mujhe iske jaisa na banaana. Phir kuchh log ek daasi ko lekar guzre, jo use maarte ja rahe the aur kah rahe the ki umne vyabhichaar kiya hai aur chori ki hai, to mainne kaha ki ai Allah, mere bete ko iske jaisa na banaana, lekin tumne kah diya ki ai Allah mujhe isi ke jaisa banaana. Aakhir iska kaaran kya hai? To bachche ne kaha : Woh vyakti atyaachaari tha. Atah, mainne kaha ki ai Allah, mujhe uske jaisa na banaana, jabki jis stri ke baare mein log kah rahe the ki umne vyabhichaar tatha chori ki hai, usne na vyabhichaar kiya tha aur na hi chori ki thi. Iseeliye mainne kaha ki ai Allah, mujhe uske jaisa banaana.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
7185: "Ai Allah, sir mundvaane waalon par daya kar." Logon ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, baal chhote karvaane waalon par? Farmayaah "Ai Allah, sir mundvaane waalon par daya kar." Logon ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, baal chhote karvaane waalon par? Farmayaah "Ai Allah, sir mundvaane waalon par daya kar." Logon ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, baal chhote karvaane waalon par? Farmayaah "Baal chhote karvaane waalon par bhi."

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se warnan karte hain ki aapne farmayaah "Ai Allah, sir mundvaane waalon par daya kar." Logon ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, baal chhote karvaane waalon par? Farmayaah "Ai Allah, sir mundvaane waalon par daya kar." Logon ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, baal chhote karvaane waalon par? Farmayaah "Ai Allah, sir mundvaane waalon par daya kar." Logon ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, baal chhote karvaane waalon par? Farmayaah "Baal chhote karvaane waalon par bhi."

Sar munrvaana tatha baal chhote karvaana Hajj aur Umrah ke manaasik (kriya-kalaapon) mein se hai aur baal munrvaana, chhote karvaane ki tulna mein uttam hai; kyonki Allah taaala ki aajnaapaalan mein sar ke baalon ko poore taur par hata dene mein adhik samarpan hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne sar munrvaane waale ke liye teen baar rahmat ki dua ki, jabki upasthit log aapko baal chhote karvaane waale ki yaad dilaate rahe. Phir teesri ya chauthi baar baal chhote karvaane waalon ko unke saath shaamil kiya. Yeh, is baat ka pramaan hai ki purushon ke haq mein munrvaana hi uttam hai.
Parantu, yadi samay 'tamatto' ke Umrah ka ho aur waqt itna kam ho ki Hajj ke mundan ke liye baal nikal na sakte hon, to aise mein chhote karvaana hi uttam hai. Kyonki use iske baad to mundan karvaana hi hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
7187: Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne maghrib aur isha ki namaz ek saath is prakaar parhi ki pratyek namaz ke liye iqaamat kahi. Na donon ke beech mein koi nafal namaz parhi aur na donon mein se kisi ek ke baad.

Abdallah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne maghrib aur isha ki namaz ek saath is prakaar parhi ki pratyek namaz ke liye iqaamat kahi. Na donon ke beech mein koi nafal namaz parhi aur na donon mein se kisi ek ke baad.

Jab arfa ke din sooryaast hua, to Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) wahaan se muzadlifa ke liye nikal pare aur wahaan maghrib ki namaz ko wilanb karke maghrib evn isha ki namaz ek saath parhi. Donon namaazon ke liye alag-alag iqaamat kahi gai. Aapne donon namaazon ke beech nafal nahin parhi, taaki ekatr karne ka arth siddh ho sake aur un donon ke pashchaat bhi koi nafal nahin parhi, taaki Hajj ke shesh kaamon ki taiyaari ke taur par kuchh wishraam kar saken.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
7188: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne hamen kisi jang mein bhay ki namaz parhaai. Ek jamaat aapke saath khari ho gai aur ek jamaat shatru ke saamne khari rahi. Jo log aapke saath the, unhen aapne ek rakaat parhaai. Phir woh log chale gae aur doosre log aye. Aapne unhen bhi ek rakaat parhaai. Phir donon girohon ne baad mein ek-ek rakaat parh li.

Abdullah bin umar bin khattaab -radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne hamen kisi jang mein bhay ki namaz parhaai. Ek jamaat aapke saath khari ho gai aur ek jamaat shatru ke saamne khari rahi. Jo log aapke saath the, unhen aapne ek rakaat parhaai. Phir woh log chale gae aur doosre log aye. Aapne unhen bhi ek rakaat parhaai. Phir donon girohon ne baad mein ek-ek rakaat parh li.

Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne, sahaaba ko bahudevvaadiyon ke wiruddh kiye gae kisi yuddh mein, bhay ki namaz parhaai, jab musalmaanon ko apne kaafir shatruon ka saamna tha aur is baat ka bhay tha ki kaheen kaafir unhen namaz parhte dekh unpar dhaawa na bol den. Choonki dushman qible ki disha mein nahin the, isliye Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apne saathiyon ko do bhaagon mein baant diya; ek bhaag aapke saath namaz mein khara ho gaya aur doosra bhaag dushman ke saamne khara hokar namaaziyon ki pahredaari karta raha.
Chunaanche aapne apne saath khare logon ko ek rakaat parhaai. Phir we jaakar dushman ke saamne khare ho gae aur namaz mein hi rahe. Phir doosra giroh aya, jo namaz mein shaamil nahin tha tatha aapne unhen ek rakaat parhaakar salaam pher diya. Ab baad mein aapke saath shaamil hone waala giroh khara hua aur shesh ek rakaat parhkar pahredaari ke liye chala gaya aur pahle giroh ne bhi shesh ek rakaat parh li.
Yeh bhay ki namaz ka ek tareeqa hai. Iska uddeshy abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ke mutaabik kuchh is prakaar haih saare log namaz mein rahe, lekin ek-doosre ki pahredaari karte rahe.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
7191: Yadi namaazi ke saamne se guzarne waala jaan le ki uspar kitna gunaah hai, to namaazi ke saamne se guzarne ki tulna mein, chaalees tak thahre rahna uske liye uttam hoga. Abu nazr kahte hain : Mujhe nahin pata ki aapne chaalees din farmaya hai athva maheena athva saal.

Abu juhaim bin haaris bin simma ansaari (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Yadi namaazi ke saamne se guzarne waala jaan le ki uspar kitna gunaah hai, to namaazi ke saamne se guzarne ki tulna mein, chaalees tak thahre rahna uske liye uttam hoga." Abu nazr kahte hain : Mujhe nahin pata ki aapne chaalees din farmaya hai athva maheena athva saal.

Namaazi apne rab ke saamne khare hokar usse praarthana karta hai aur use pukaarta hai. Atah, is haal mein yadi koi uske saamne se guzarta hai, to woh is praarthana mein rukaawat khari karta hai aur uski ibaadat mein khalal daalta hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki namaazi ke saamne se guzar kar uski namaz mein khalal daalne waala Allah ke yahaan bara paapi hai.
Chunaanche Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne bataataah yadi namaazi ke saamne se guzarne waala yeh jaan le ki uske is kaary ka kitna gunaah hai, to uske saamne se guzarne ki tulna mein apne sthaan mein chaalees tak thahre rahne ko tarjeeh dega. Isse andaaza hota hai ki is kaam se bachna aur door rahna kitna zaroori hai. Jnaat ho ki raawi ko is baat mein shak hai ki yahaan chaalees se aashay chaalees din hain ya maheene ya phir saal? Lekin ek baat dhyaan mein rahe ki yahaan ullikhit sankhya se muraad din, maheena ya saal bataana nahin hai, balki muraad manaahi mein taakeed aur paida karna hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
7200: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen aadesh diya ki ham donon eedon mein kunwaari tatha pardaansheen striyon ko le jayen. Tatha maasik dharm waali striyon ko aadesh diya ki we musalmaanon ki eedgaah se alag rahen.

Umm-e-atiyya nusaiba ansaariya (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen aadesh diya ki ham donon eedon mein kunwaari tatha pardaansheen striyon ko le jayen. Tatha maasik dharm waali striyon ko aadesh diya ki we musalmaanon ki eedgaah se alag rahen.
Tatha ek riwayat ke shabd hain : Hamen aadesh diya jaata tha ki ham eed ke din svayn niklen aur kunwaari striyon ko bhi nikaalen, balki maasik dharm waali striyaan bhi niklen aur aam logon ki tarah takbeer kahen aur unki tarah dua karen, jo us din ki barkat aur pawitrata ki ummeed rakhte hain.

Eed al-fitr aur eed al-azha ke din, do shreth din hain, jinmen islaam ki shaan wa shaukat zaahir hoti hai aur musalmaanon ke jamaavre se unke bandhutv ke darshan hote hain. Har nagar aur qasbe ke log apni ekta, aapsi prem aur sadbhaag, islaam ki sahayta ke liye ekjutta, Allah ke dharm ki pratishtha aur Allah ke dharm-prateekon ke warchasv ke pradarshan hetu ek hi sthaan mein jagah hote hain.
Yahi kaaran hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne saari striyon, yahaan tak ki apne gharon ke andar parde mein rahne waali yuvtiyon aur ritu waali striyon ko bhi nikalne ka aadesh diya. Albatta, ritu waali striyaan namaz mein shareek logon se alag rahengi. Unhen shaamil hone ka aadesh isliye diya, taaki bhalaai tatha musalmaanon ki dua mein shaamil ho saken aur us sabha ki bhalaai, uski barkat, Allah ki rahmat aur uski prasannata praapt kar saken aur Allah ki daya ki chhaanv pa saken.
Donon eed ki namaz farz-e-kifaya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
7201: Tummen se koi ek kapre mein is tarah namaz na parhe ki uske donon kandhon par kapre ka koi bhaag na ho.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Tummen se koi ek kapre mein is tarah namaz na parhe ki uske donon kandhon par kapre ka koi bhaag na ho."

Aadmi ko chahiye ki namaz parhne ke liye achchhi haalat mein aye; kyonki Allah taaa़la ka farmaan haih "يا بني آدم خُذُوا زِينَتَكُمْ عِنْدَ كل مَسجدٍ" (Ai aadam ki santaan, pratyek namaz ke samay apni shobha dhaaran karo.) doosri baat yeh hai ki jab baadshaahon aur bare logon se mulaaqaat ke liye bhi insaan achchhe kapron aur saath-suthra hokar jaata hai, to baadshon ke baadshaah aur sardaaron ke sardaar ke aage use kaise upasthit hona chahiye?
Yahi kaaran hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne is baat par ubhaara hai ki aadmi is haal mein namaz na parhe ki uske donon kandhe khule hue hon, jabki uske paas donon kandhon athva ek kandhe ko dhaanpne ke liye kapra maujood ho. Aapne mana kiya ki aadmi apne rab se baat karne ke liye is tarah khara na ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8262: Kya Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne aapke liye kshamayaachna ki hai? Unhonne kaha : Haan, aur tumhaare liye bhi! Phir yeh ayat parhi : {apne gunaahon ki kshamayaachna keejiye tatha momin mardon aur momin striyon ke liye bhi.}

Aasim ahval ka warnan hai ki abdullah bin sarjis (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, Allah aapko kshama kare! Yeh sun aapne farmaya : "Aur tumhen bhi." Aasim kahte hain ki mainne abdullah (radiyallahu anhu) se kaha : Kya Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne aapke liye kshamayaachna ki hai? Unhonne kaha : Haan, aur tumhaare liye bhi! Phir yeh ayat parhi : {apne gunaahon ki kshamayaachna keejiye tatha momin mardon aur momin striyon ke liye bhi.}
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8264: Farishte noor se paida kiye gae hain, jin dhadhakti aag se paida kiye gae hain aur aadam (alaihissalaam) us cheez se paida kiye gae hain, jiske baare mein tumhen bataya gaya hai.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Farishte noor se paida kiye gae hain, jin dhadhakti aag se paida kiye gae hain aur aadam (alaihissalaam) us cheez se paida kiye gae hain, jiske baare mein tumhen bataya gaya hai.”

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne rachna ke aaranbh ke baare mein bataate hue kaha hai ki farishte noor se paida kiye gae hain. Yahi kaaran hai ki koi bhi farishta Allah ki awajna aur uski ibaadat se abhimaan nahin karta. Jinn aag se paida kiye gae hain. Atah unmen se bahuton ke andar krodh, ashishtata aur sarakshi paai jaati hai. Jabki aadam us cheez se paida kiye gae hain, jiska ullekh tumhaare liye kar diya gaya hai. Yaani khanakhnaati theekri jaise sookhe gaare se. Kyonki mitti gaara bani aur gaara theekra. Usi se aadam -alaihissalaam- paida kiye gae.
8265: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka charitr Qur'an tha.

Saad bin hishaam bin aamir jab aaisha radiyallahu anha ke paas gae, to unse kaha : Ai mominon ki maata! Aap mujhe Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke charitr ke baare mein bataaiye. Yeh sun unhonne poochha : Kya tum Qur'an nahin parhte? Unka kahna hai ki mainne uttar diya : Parhta to awashy hoon. Uttar sunne ke baad aaisha radiyallahu anha ne kaha :  Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka charitr Qur'an tha.

Mominon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha se jab Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke charitr ke baare mein poochha gaya,  to unhonne bare hi saargarbhit shabdon mein uttar diya aur poochhne waale ko Qur'an-e-kareem ka hawaala diya, jiske andar poornata ke tamaam gun samaahit hain. Unhonne bataya ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Qur'an ke naitik moolyon ka paalan karte the. Qur'an ne jin baaton ka aadesh diya hai, unko karte the aur jin baaton se mana kiya hai, unse bachte the. Is tarah aapke aachran ka saar yeh hai ki aap Qur'an par amal karte the, uski bataai hui seemaaon par ruk jaate the, uske shishtaachaaron ka paalan karte the aur uske dvaara prastut kiye gae udaaharnon evn kahaaniyon se shiksha grahan karte the.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke padchihnon par chalte hue Qur'an ki naitik shikshaaon ka paalan karne ki prerna.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke aachran ki taareef aur is baat ka ullekh ki aapke aachran ka srot Qur'an tha.
Qur'an sabhi naitik baaton ka mool srot hai.
Islam ke andar aachran mein poora deen aur sabhi aadeshon ka paalan karna aur mana ki hui baaton se door rahna samaahit hai.
[ise Muslim ne ek lanbi hadees ke antargat riwayat kiya hai]
8266: Jo Allah se milna pasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna pasand karta hai aur jo Allah se milna naapsand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna naapsand karta hai.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se riwayat hai, woh kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Jo Allah se milna pasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna pasand karta hai aur jo Allah se milna naapsand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna naapsand karta hai.” mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya isse abhipray maut ko naapsand karna hai? Waise to ham sab log maut ko naapsand karte hain! Aapne uttar diya : “Matlab yeh nahin hai, balki matlab yeh hai ki momin ko jab Allah ki rahmat, uski prasannata aur uski Jannat ki khushkhabri di jaati hai, to woh Allah se milna pasand karta hai aur Allah bhi usse milna pasand karta hai. Lekin kaafir ko jab Allah ke azaab aur uske prakop ki soochna di jaati hai, to woh Allah se milna naapsand karta hai aur Allah bhi usse milna naapsand karta hai.”
8267: Main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath hunain ke din upasthit tha. Main aur abu sufyaan bin haaris bin abdul muttalib Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath rahe aur aapse alag nahin hue.

Abul fajl abbaas bin abdul muttalib (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath hunain ke din upasthit tha. Main aur abu sufyaan bin haaris bin abdul muttalib Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath rahe aur aapse alag nahin hue. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne ek safed khachchar par sawaar the. Jab yuddh aaranbh hua to musalmaan peeth dikhaakar bhaag khare hue, lekin Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne khachchar ko kaafiron ki or barhaate rahe. Main khachchar ki lagaam pakre hua tha aur use tez chalne se rok raha tha aur abu sufyaan aapki sawaari ki rakaab pakre hue the. Itne mein Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Ai abbaas! Samura waalon (per ke neeche baiat karne waalon) ko pukaaro.” abbaas oonchi aawaaz waale the. Woh kahte hain ki mainne tez aawaaz se kaha : Samura waale kahaan hain? Allah ki qasam! Jab un logon ne meri aawaaz suni, to is tarah tezi se palte jis tarah gay apne bachhre ki or palatti hai aur kahne lage : Ham yahaan hain, ham yahaan hain! Phir we kaafiron se yuddh karne lage. Phir ansaar ko aawaaj di gai. Log kahne lage : Ai ansaariyo! Ai ansaariyo! Sabse ant mein bani haaris bin khazraj ko aawaaz di gai. Ab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne, jo apne khachchar par sawaar the, munh uthaakar unke yuddh ko dekha aur farmaya : “Ab zor ka ran para hai!” phir kuchh kankron ko lekar kaafiron ke chehron par maara aur farmaya : “Mohammad ke rab ki qasam, we haar gae.” main dekhne gaya (ki jang ki kya dasha hai) to dekha jang waisi hi thi, lekin jaise hi aapne unki or kankar fenke, to dekha ki we durbal ho gae aur bhaagne lage.
8268: Aamu (Oxus), sir (Jaxartes), faraat aur neel, yeh sab Jannat ki nadiyaan haiैn.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Aamu (Oxus), sir (Jaxartes), faraat aur neel, yeh sab Jannat ki nadiyaan haiैn.”
8272: Zikr ki mazlison ki fazeelat se sanbandhit hadeesen

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Allah ke kuchh farishte hain ,jo raaston mein ghoomte rahte hain aur zikr karne waalon ko talaashte rahte hain. Jaise hi kaheen zikr karne waalon ko paate hain, ek-doosre ko aawaaz dekar bulaate hue kahte hain ki aao, yahaan tumhaare matlab ki cheez hai. Phir we unhen apne paron se aasmaan tak gher lete hain. Us samay unse unka rab poochhta hai, jabki woh svayn sab kuchh jaanta hai : Mere bande kya kah rahe hain? Farishte jawaab dete hain : We teri pawitrata bayaan kar rahe hain tatha teri prashansa aur baraai ka warnan kar rahe hain. Tab Allah taaala pharmaata hai : Kya unhonne mujhe dekha hai? Farishte kahte hain : Nahin, Allah ki qasam! Unhonne tujhe dekha nahin hai. Allah farmaata hai : Yadi we dekh lete to kya hota? Farishte kahte hain : Yadi dekh lete to isse bhi adhik teri ibaadat karte aur isse bhi zyaada teri baraai tatha pawitrata bayaan karte. Phir Allah taaala farmaata hai : Mere ye bande kya maang rahe hain? Farishte kahte hain : We tujhse Jannat maang rahe hain. Allah kahta hai : Kya un logon ne Jannat dekhi hai? Farishte kahte hain : Nahin, Allah ki qasam! Nahin dekhi hai. Allah farmaata hai : Yadi dekh lete to kya hota? Farmaya : Farishte kahte hain : Yadi dekh lete to isse bhi adhik uski khvaahish karte aur isse bhi zyaada use haasil karne ki koshish karte aur uske prati unki roochi aur adhik barh jaati. Allah farmaata hai : We kis cheez se sharan maang rahe hai? Farishte kahte hain : Jahannam se sharan maang rahe hain. Allah taaala farmaata hai : Kya unhonne Jahannam dekha hai? Farishte kahte hain : Nahin, Allah ki qasam! Unhonne Jahannam ko nahin dekha hai. Allah taaala farmaata hai : Yadi we Jahannam ko dekh lete to kya hota? Farishte kahte hain : Yadi we Jahannam ko dekh lete to isse bhi adhik usse bhaagte aur bhay karte. Allah taaala farmaata hai : Main tumhen saakshi banaata hoon ki mainne inhen kshama kar diya hai. Farmaya : Ek farishta kahta hai : Unmen amuk bhi hai, jo unmen se nahin hai, balki kisi zaroorat ke tahat aya hai. Allah taaala farmaata hai : Ye aise saath baithne waale log hain ki unke saath baithne waale log bhi wanchit nahin rahte.
Ek doosri riwayat mein hai : Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Allah ke kuchh chalte-firte farishte hain, jo zikr ki majlisen talaashte rahte hain. Jaise hi koi zikr ki majlis milti hai, logon ke saath baith jaate hain aur apne paron se un sabko dhaanp lete hain, yahaan tak ki unke aur aasmaan ke beech ki jagah bhar jaati hai. Jab majlis khatm ho jaati hai aur log bikhar jaate hain, to we aasmaan par chale jaate hain. Tab Allah taaala unse poochhta hai (haalaanki woh unse zyaada jaanne waala hai) ki tum log kahaan se a rahe ho? Farishte kahte hain ki ham zameen par maujood tere kuchh bandon ke paas se a rahe hain jo teri pawitrata, baraai aur prashansa bayaan kar rahe hain aur tujhse maang rahe hain. Allah kahta hai : We kya maang rahe hain? Farishte kahte hain : We tujhse teri Jannat maang rahe hain. Allah kahta hai : Kya unhonne meri Jannat dekhi hai? Farishte kahte hain : Nahin ai rab. Allah kahta hai : Yadi we meri Jannat dekh lete to kya hota!! Farishte kahte hain : We teri sharan maang rahe hain. Allah kahta hai : We kis cheez se meri sharan maang rahe hain? Farishte kahte hain : Teri Jahannam ki aag se, ai rab. Allah kahta hai : Kya unhonne mere Jahannam ki aag dekhi hai? Farishte kahte hain : Nahin. Allah farmaata hai : Yadi we mere Jahannam ki aag dekh lete to kya hota!! Farishte kahte hain : We tujhse kshama maang rahe hain. Allah taaala farmaata hai : Mainne unhen kshama kar diya aur we jo maang rahe hain, mainne unhen woh de diya aur jis cheez se sharan maang rahe hain us cheez se unhen sharan pradaan kiya. Farmaya : Tab farishte kahte hain : Ai rab, unmen amuk bhi tha, jo ek gunaahgaar banda hai. Yoon hi wahaan se guzar raha tha, to unke saath baith gaya. Allah taaala farmaata hai : Mainne use bhi kshama kar diya ,kyonki yeh woh log hain, jinke saath baithne waale bhi wanchit nahin rahte.”

Is hadees mein zikr ki majlison (baithkon) ke mahatv ke prateekon mein se ek prateek ka ullekh hai. Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya:
"Allah ke kuchh farishte hain ,jo raaston mein ghoomte rahte hain aur zikr karne waalon ko talaashte rahte hain" Yaani Allah ne insaan ki suraksha par niyukt farishton ke atirikt farishton ke ek samooh ko yeh zimmedaari de rakhi hai ki dharti mein ghoomte rahen, musalmaanon ki aabaadi waale raaston, unki masjidon aur gharon ka chakkar lagaate rahen, taaki zikr ki majlison ko dhoondh nikaalen, wahaan upasthit rahen aur zikr kar rahe logon ko sunen. Haafiz ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Behtar yeh lagta hai ki ise tasbeeh aadi ki majlison ke saath khaas rakha jaye.
"Jaise hi kaheen zikr karne waalon ko paate hain" Saheeh Muslim ki ek riwayat mein hai : "Jaise hi unko koi majlis milti hai, jismen Allah ka zikr ho raha ho, to ek-doosre ko aawaaz dete hain" Yaani ek-doosre ko bulaate hain aur kahte hain ki "Aao, yahaan tumhaare matlab ki cheez hai."
