Jabki ek riwayat mein hai ki yahaan woh cheez hai, jise tum dhoondh rahe ho. Yaani zikr ki un majlison ki or aao, jinhen tum dhoondh rahe ho aur jin tak tum pahunchna chaahte ho, taaki tum unhen dekh sako aur unmen ho rahe zikr ko sun sako.
Farishte jab zikr ki majlison mein hote hain, to unki haalat ka ullekh karte hue Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne, kaha hai : "We unko gher lete hain." Yaani we unko usi tarah chaaron or se gher lete hain, jis tarah kangan kalaai ko ghere rahta hai.
"We unko apne paron se gher lete hain" Yaani unke chaaron or apne paron ke sahaare chakkar lagaate rahte hain. "Aakaash tak" Yaani kuchh isi tarah ghere hue aakaash tak pahunch jaate hain.
Phir Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne woh waartaalaap bayaan ki, jo sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah aur uske sammaanit farishton ke beech hoti hai. Farmaya :
"Us samay unse unka rab poochhta hai, jabki woh svayn sab kuchh jaanta hai" Yaani woh zikr karne waalon ki haalat se unse adhik avgat hota hai, lekin poochhta isliye hai, taaki nikatvarti farishton ko unki pratishtha se ru-ba-ru kar sake aur farishton ko unpar abhimaan ho.
" Mere bande kya kah rahe hain? Farishte jawaab dete hain : We teri pawitrata bayaan kar rahe hain tatha teri prashansa aur baraai bayaan ka ra rahe hain." Yaani farishte kahte hain ki ye zikr karne waale subhaan Allah, al-hamdu lillah, la ilaaha illallah aur Allahu akbar kah rahe hain. Yahaan aye hue shabd "يمجدونك" Se muraad hai, we la ilaaha illah kah rahe hain. Kyonki usmen tauheed-e-uloohiyat ke bakhaan ke maadhyam se Allah ki baraai evn mahaanta ka bayaan hai.
Yeh sun sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah kahta hai : "Kya unhonne mujhe dekha hai? Farishte uttar dete hain : Nahin, Allah ki qasam! Unhonne tujhe dekha nahin hai. Allah farmaata hai : Yadi we dekh lete to kya hota? Farishte uttar dete hain : Yadi dekh lete to isse bhi adhik teri ibaadat karte aur isse bhi zyaada teri baraai tatha pawitrata bayaan karte." Kyonki insaan Allah ki ibaadat usi parimaan mein karta hai, jis parimaan mein woh usse avgat hota hai.
Ispar sarvashaktimaan Allah kahta hai : "Mere ye bande mujhse kya maang rahe hain?" Yaani mujhse we kya chahaate hain? Farishte uttar dete hain : "We tujhse Jannat maang rahe hain." Yaani we teri Jannat ki chaahat mein tera zikr aur teri ibaadat kar rahe hain. "Allah kahta hai : Kya un logon ne Jannat dekhi hai? Farishte uttar dete hain : Nahin, Allah ki qasam! Nahin dekhi hai. Allah farmaata hai : Yadi dekh lete to kya hota?" To farishte uttar dete hain : "Yadi dekh lete to isse bhi adhik uski khvaahish karte." Yaani use praapt karne ka aur adhik prayatn karte, kyonki suni hui cheez dekhi hui cheez ki tarah nahin hoti.
Phir sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah kahta hai : "We kis cheez se sharan maang rahe hai?" Farishte uttar dete hain : "Jahannam se." Yaani we apne paalanhaar ka zikr aur uski ibaadat Jahannam ke bhay se kar rahe hain aur Allah se usse surakshit rakhne ki dua kar rahe hain. "Allah taaala farmaata hai : Yadi we Jahannam ko dekh lete to kya hota? Farishte uttar dete hain : Yadi we Jahannam ko dekh lete to isse bhi adhik usse bhaagte." Yaani we apne aapko satkarmon mein aur adhik khapaate, jo ki Jahannam se mukti ka sabab hai.
Ispar sarvashaktimaan Allah kahta hai : "Main tumhen saakshi banaata hoon ki mainne inhen kshama kar diya." Yaani unke saare gunaah maaf kar diye.
Yeh sun ek farishta kahta hai : "Unmen amuk vyakti bhi hai, jo unmen se nahin hai, balki kisi zaroorat ke tahat aya hai?" Yaani in zikr karne waalon ke beech amuk vyakti bhi hai, jo zikr karne waalon mein shaamil nahin hai. Woh kisi kaam se aya tha aur unke saath baith gaya, to kya use bhi kshama kar diya jayega? Allah taaala uttar deta hai : Ye aise saath baithne waale log hain ki unke saath baithne waale log bhi wanchit nahin rahte.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8280: Ai Allah! Mainne jo pahle kiya aur jo baad mein kiya, jo chhipaakar kiya tatha jo dikhaakar kiya aur jismen mainne ati ki aur jisko tu mujhse bhi behtar jaanne waala hai, un sabhi gunaahon ko maaf kar de. Tu hi aadeshpaalan ka saamarthy dekar aage karta hai aur tu hi awajna ke kaaran peechhe karta hai. Tere siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai.

Ali bin abu taalib (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab namaz ke liye khare hote, to yeh dua parhteh «وجَّهت وجْهي للذي فَطَر السَّماوات والأرض حَنيفا، وما أنا من المشركين، إن صلاتي، ونُسُكي، ومَحْيَاي، ومَمَاتِي لله ربِّ العالمين، لا شريك له، وبذلك أُمِرت وأنا من المسلمين، اللهُمَّ أنت الملك لا إله إلا أنت أنت ربِّي، وأنا عَبدُك، ظَلمت نفسي، واعترفت بِذنبي، فاغفر لي ذُنوبي جميعا، إنه لا يَغفر الذُّنوب إلا أنت، واهدِنِي لأحْسَن الأخلاق لا يَهدي لأحْسَنِها إلا أنت، واصرف عَنِّي سيِّئها لا يصرف عني سيِّئها إلا أنت، لبَّيك وسَعديك والخير كلُّه في يَديك، والشَرُّ ليس إليك، أنا بِك وإليك، تَبَاركت وتَعاليت، أستغفرك وأتوب إليك» (mainne ekaagr hokar apna mukh uski or kar liya hai, jisne aakaashon aur dharti ki rachna ki hai, aur main saajhi thahraane waalon mein se nahin hoon. Meri namaz, meri qurbaani, mera jeena aur mera marna, sab Allah ke liye hai, jo samast sansaar ka rab hai. Uska koi saajhi nahin. Mujhe isi ka aadesh diya gaya hai aur main musalmaanon mein se hoon. Ai Allah! Tu hi baadshaah hai. Tere siwa koi saty poojy nahin. Tu mera rab hai aur main tera banda. Mainne apne oopar zulm kiya hai aur apne paapon ka iqraar karta hoon. Atah, mere samast paapon ko kshama kar de, kyonki paapon ko kshama karne waala tere siwa koi nahin. Tu mujhe achchhe aachran ka maarg dikha, kyonki achchhe aachran ka maarg kewal tu hi dikhaata hai. Aur bure aachran se mujhe door rakh, kyonki bure aachran se mujhe door kewal tu hi rakh sakta hai. Main tere aage upasthit hoon, tera aajnaakaari hoon tatha samast prakaar ki bhalaai tere hi haathon mein hai, aur buraai ki nisbat teri or nahin ki ja sakti. Meri taupheeq teri taraf se hai aur meri iltija bhi tujhse hai. Tu barkat waala tatha buland hai. Main tujh hi se kshama maangta hoon tatha tere hi saamne tauba karta hoon.) aur jab rooku karte, to kahteh «اللهُمَّ لك رَكَعت، وبِك آمَنت، ولك أسْلَمت، خَشع لك سَمعي، وبَصري، ومُخِّي، وعَظمي، وعَصَبي» (ai Allah! Mainne tere hi liye ruku kiya, main tujhpar eemaan laya aur tera aajnaakaari bana. Tere liye mere kaan, meri aankh, mere dimaag, meri haddi tatha mere puththe ne winamrata dikhaai.) aur jab ruku se sar uthaate, to kahteh «اللهُمَّ ربَّنا لك الحَمد مِلْءَ السماوات، و مِلْءَ الأرض، ومِلْءَ ما بينهما، ومِلْءَ ما شئت من شيء بعد» (ai Allah! Tere liye aakaash bhar, dharti bhar, aur jo kuchh in donon ke beech hai, utni aur uske pashchaat jitni tu chaahe, utni prashansa hai.) aur jab sajda karte, to kahteh «اللهُمَّ لك سَجدت، وبك آمَنت، ولك أسْلَمت، سجد وجْهِي للذي خَلَقه، وصَوَّره، وشَقَّ سَمعه وبَصره، تبارك الله أحْسَن الخَالقِين» (ai Allah! Mainne tere liye sajda kiya, main tujhpar eemaan laya aur tera aajnaakaari hua. Mere chehre ne uske liye sajda kiya, jisne uski rachna ki hai aur uska chitran kiya hai, tatha kaan aur aankh ko cheera hai. Allah taaala bari barkat waala hai aur sabhi banaane waalon se achchha banaane waala hai.) phir sabse ant mein tashahhud aur salaam pherne ke beech yeh dua parhteh «اللهُم اغْفِر لي ما قَدَّمت وما أخَّرت، وما أسْرَرْت وما أعْلَنت، وما أَسْرَفْتُ، وما أنت أعْلَم به مِنِّي، أنت المُقَدِّم وأنت الْمُؤَخِّر، لا إله إلا أنت» (ai Allah! Mainne jo pahle kiya aur jo baad mein kiya, jo chhipaakar kiya tatha jo dikhaakar kiya aur jismen mainne ati ki aur jisko tu mujhse bhi behtar jaanne waala hai, un sabhi gunaahon ko maaf kar de. Tu hi aadeshpaalan ka saamarthy dekar aage karta hai aur tu hi awajna ke kaaran peechhe karta hai. Tere siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai.)
8281: Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath ek raat tahajjud ki namaz parhi. Aap khare hue aur soora baqra parhi. Jab rahmat ki ayat se guzarte, to rukkar (Allah se uski daya) maangte aur jab azaab ki ayat se guzarte, to rukkar (usse Allah ki) sharan maangte.

Auf bin maalik ashjai (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath ek raat tahajjud ki namaz parhi. Aap khare hue aur soora baqra parhi. Jab rahmat ki ayat se guzarte, to rukkar (Allah se uski daya) maangte aur jab azaab ki ayat se guzarte, to rukkar (usse Allah ki) sharan maangte. Woh kahte hain : Aap jitni der khare rahe, utni hi der ruku mein bhi rahe. Ruku mein kah rahe the : “Subhaana zil-jabrooti wal-malkooti wal-kibriyaai wal-azamti.” phir aapne qayaam ke baraabar hi sajda kiya aur sajde mein bhi wahi dua parhi. Phir khare hue aur soora aale imraan parhi. Phir ek-ek soora parhi.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8282: Mere rab ne mujhe wachan diya hai ki woh meri ummat ke sattar hazaar logon ko bina kisi hisaab-kitaab aur azaab ke Jannat mein daakhil karega. Unmen se pratyek hazaar ke saath aur sattar hazaar tatha mere rab ke lap se teen lap bhar log honge.

Abu umaama (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Mere rab ne mujhe wachan diya hai ki woh meri ummat ke sattar hazaar logon ko bina kisi hisaab-kitaab aur azaab ke Jannat mein daakhil karega. Unmen se pratyek hazaar ke saath aur sattar hazaar tatha mere rab ke lap se teen lap bhar log honge.”

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hamen bata rahe hain ki sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah is ummat ke sattar hazaar logon ko bina hisaab-kitaab aur yaatna ke Jannat mein prawesh karne ka saubhaagy pradaan karega. Phir in sattar hazaar mein se har hazaar ke saath atirikt sattar hazaar logon ko daakhil karega. Phir Allah apne sammaanit haath se teen lap bhar logon ko lega aur Jannat mein daakhil kar dega.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8284: Kya tu is baat se prasann nahin hai ki jo tujhe jore, main use joroon aur tujhe kaate mein use kaatoon?

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Allah ne srishtiyon ki rachna ki. Jab usne is kaary ko poora kar liya, to rahim (rishta) khara hua aur rahmaan ke tahband baandne ke sthaan ko pakar liya. Allah ne usse kahaah yeh kya hai? Usne kaha : Yeh sanbandh wichchhed karne waale se teri sharan maangne waale ka khara hona hai. Allah ne kaha : Kya tu is baat se prasann nahin hai ki jo tujhe jore, main use joroon aur tujhe kaate mein use kaatoon? Usne kaha : Awashy hi, ai mere rab. Allah ne kaha : “To aisa hi hoga.” Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne (aage) farmaya : Yadi tum chaaho, to yeh ayat parh sakte ho : “Phir yadi tum wimukh ho gae, to door nahin ki tum dharti mein upadrav karoge tatha apne rishton ko toroge.” Bukhari ki ek riwayat mein hai : Allah ne farmaya : “Jisne tujhe jora, mainne use jo़r diya aur jisne tujhe tora, mainne use tor diya."

"Allah ne srishtiyon ki rachna ki. Jab usne is kaary ko poora kar liya" Yaani srishtiyon ki rachna ka kaary sanpann ho gaya. Yeh is baat ka pramaan hai ki srishtiyon ki rachna ka kaary ek nirdhaarit samay mein sanpann ho gaya. Yeh saty hai ki Allah ke paas aseem kshamta hai aur ek kaary mein vyastata use doosre kaary se nahin rokti, lekin usne apni hikmat ke tahat ise ek nirdhaarit samay seema ke andar sanpann kar liya. Isse pramaanit hota hai ki Allah ke kaary uski chaahat aur iraade se jure hue hain. Jab woh kisi kaary ke karne ka iraada karta hai, to kar daalta hai.
Aapke shabd "Poora kar liya" Ka yeh arth nahin hai ki usne saari cheezon ki rachna ka kaary sanpann kar liya. Kyonki uski srishtiyaan ek ke baad ek wajood mein aati rahti hain. Yeh alag baat hai ki woh unse pahle se avgat hota hai, unse sanbandhit wiwarnon ka nirdhaaran kar diya hota hai aur unhen likh chuka hota hai. Phir jab woh chaahta hai, to unka astitv saamne aata hai.
Aapne farmaya : "To rahim (khooni rishta) khara hua aur rahmaan ke tahband baandhne ke sthaan ko pakar liya. Allah ne usse kahaah yeh kya hai?" Yahaan rahim yaani khooni rishte se jo kaary sanbanddh kiye gae hain, jaise khara hona aur kahna aadi, hadees ke zaahir se andaaza hota hai ki unse unka waastawik arth hi muraad hai. Yahaan yeh kaha ja sakta hai ki khooni rishta arth ki drishti se logon se juri hui wastu hai, lekin uska uttar yeh hai ki Allah ke saamarthy ko insaani aql ke taraazu mein tola nahin ja sakta. Daraasal yeh hadees Allah ke gunon waali hadeeson mein se ek hai, jinke baare mein ulema ne spasht roop se kaha hai ki unhen usi tarah grahan kar liya jayega, jis tarah woh aai hui hain. Unhonne un logon ka khandan bhi kiya hai, jo inke aashay ko maanne se inkaar karte hain. Lekin is hadees ka yeh matlab bhi nahin hai ki Allah ke usi prakaar ke chamre, leenen aur kapaas aadi se bane hue tahband aur chaadar jaise kapre hua karte hain, jis prakaar ke kapre log pahante hain. Allah taaala ka farmaan hai : "Uske jaisi koi cheez nahin hai aur woh sunne waala aur dekhne waala hai."
Aapne farmaya ki khooni rishte ne kaha : "Yeh sanbandh wichchhed karne waale se teri sharan maangne waale ka khara hona hai." Yeh ek bahut bare uddeshy ke liye khara hona hai, aur sachchaai yeh hai ki jo Allah ki sharan mein chala gaya, woh sabse bare sharan dene waale ki sharan mein chala gaya. Yeh hadees rishtedaaron ke saath achchha vyavhaar karne ke mahatv ko darshaati hai aur rishtedaari ka lihaaz na karne ko ek bahut bare gunaah ke roop mein chihnit karti hai. Is hadees mein aye hue shabd 'القطيعة' ka arth hai, rishta jorkar na rakhna. Jabki rishta jorkar rakhne se muraad hai, rishtedaaron ke saath achchha vyavhaar karna, unse prem rakhna, unse nikatta banaye rakhna, unka sahyog karna, unhen kasht se bachaana aur unhen aisi cheezen dene ka prayaas karna jo unke liye duniya evn aakhirat mein laabhkaari hon.
Aapne farmaya : "Allah ne kaha : Kya tu is baat se prasann nahin hai ki jo tujhe jore, use main joroon aur tujhe kaate use main kaatoon? Usne kaha : Awashy hi, ai mere rab. Allah ne kaha : To aisa hi hoga." Atah jo apne rishtedaaron se sanbandh jorkar rakhega, Allah usse sanbandh rakhega aur jisse Allah sanbandh rakhega, woh duniya evn aakhirat ki har bhalaai tatha saubhaagy praapt karega aur use firdaus yaani Jannat ke sabse oopri bhaag mein apne paalanhaar ki nikatta praapt hogi. Kyonki jorne ka ant yaheen par aakar hoga aur use apne paalanhaar ke chehre ko dekhne ka shubh avsar praapt hoga. Iske wipreet jo apne rishtedaaron se sanbandh torkar rakhega, Allah usse sanbandh tor lega aur jisse Allah sanbandh tor le, woh Allah ke shtru tatha dhutkaare hue shaitaan ke saath har bhalaai evn saubhaagy se kata hua rahega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8285: Ai Allah! Mainne apne aapko tere hawaale kar diya, tujhpar eemaan laya, tujhpar bharosa kiya, teri madad se apne shatruon se jhagra kiya aur nirnay ko tere hawaale kar diya. Atah, mere un saare gunaahon ko kshama kar de, jo mainne pahle kiye aur jo main karne waala hoon aur jo mainne chhipaakar kiye aur jo dikhaakar kiye aur jinhen tu mujhse adhik jaanta hai. Tere siwa koi saty pujy nahin hai.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab raat ko tahajjud parhte, to yeh dua parhte : «اللهم ربَّنا لك الحمدُ، أنت قَيِّمُ السموات والأرض، ولك الحمدُ أنت ربُّ السموات والأرض ومَن فيهنَّ، ولك الحمدُ أنت نورُ السموات والأرض ومن فيهنَّ، أنت الحقُّ، وقولُك الحقُّ، ووعدُك الحقُّ، ولقاؤك الحقُّ، والجنةُ حقٌّ، والنارُ حقٌّ، والساعةُ حقٌّ، اللهم لك أسلمتُ، وبك آمنتُ، وعليك توكَّلتُ، وإليك خاصمتُ، وبك حاكمتُ، فاغفر لي ما قدَّمتُ وما أخَّرتُ، وأسررتُ وأعلنتُ، وما أنت أعلم به مني، لا إلهَ إلا أنت». (Ai Allah! Ai hamaare rab! Saari prashansa teri hai, tu aakaashon tatha dharti ka rakhvaala hai. Saari prashansa teri hai, tu aakaashon tatha dharti aur unki saari wastuon ka rab hai. Saari prashansa teri hai, tu hi aakaashon tatha dharti aur unki saari wastuon ka noor hai. Tu saty hai. Teri baat saty hai. Tera wachan saty hai. Tujhse milna saty hai. Jannat saty hai. Jahannam saty hai. Qayaamat saty hai. Ai Allah! Mainne apne aapko tere hawaale kar diya, tujhpar eemaan laya, tujhpar bharosa kiya, teri madad se apne shatruon se jhagra kiya aur nirnay ko tere hawaale kar diya. Atah, mere un saare gunaahon ko kshama kar de, jo mainne pahle kiye aur jo main karne waala hoon aur jo mainne chhipaakar kiye aur jo dikhaakar kiye aur jinhen tu mujhse adhik jaanta hai. Tere siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai.)
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8286: Iddat poori ho chuki hai. Ab tum use nae sire se nikaah ka sandesh bhejo.

Zubair bin avvaam (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki umm-e-kulsoom bint uqba unke nikaah mein theen. Woh garbhaawastha mein theen ki zubair (radiyallahu anhu) se boleen : Mujhe ek talaaq dekar mera dil khush kar do. So, zubair (radiyallahu anhu) ne unhen ek talaaq de diya. Phir namaz ke liye nikal pare. Jab waapas aye, to dekha ki bachche ka janm ho chuka hai. Yeh dekh unhonne kaha : Yeh kya hai? Isne mujhe dhokha diya hai, Allah ise dhokha de. Phir Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aye, to aapne farmaya : “Iddat poori ho chuki hai. Ab tum use nae sire se nikaah ka sandesh bhejo.”
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai .]
8287: Pul siraat ko Jahannam ke oopar rakha jayega, jispar aise kaante lage honge, jaise saadaan paudhe mein hote hain. Phir log usse hokar guzrenge, to koi sahi-salaamat najaat pa jayega, koi kharonch ke saath paar ho jayega aur koi rok diya jayega aur munh ke bal Jahannam mein gira diya jayega.

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Pul siraat ko Jahannam ke oopar rakha jayega, jispar aise kaante lage honge, jaise saadaan paudhe mein hote hain. Phir log usse hokar guzrenge, to koi sahi-salaamat najaat pa jayega, koi kharonch ke saath paar ho jayega aur koi rok diya jayega aur munh ke bal Jahannam mein gira diya jayega. Phir jab Allah sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah bandon ke beech nirnay se faarigh ho jayega, to eemaan waale kuchh aise logon ko nahin payenge, jo duniya mein unke saath rahte the aur unki tarah namaz parhte the, unki tarah zakat dete the, unki tarah roze rakhte the aur unki tarah hi Hajj tatha jihaad karte the. Yeh dekh we kahenge : Ai hamaare rab! Tere kuchh bande, jo duniya mein hamaare saath the aur hamaari tarah namaz parhte the, hamaari tarah zakat dete the, hamaari tarah roza rakhte evn hamaari hi tarah Hajj aur jihaad karte the, kya baat hai ki aaj ham unhen dekh nahin pa rahe hain? Allah farmayega : Jahannam jaakar dekho, unmen se jo tumhen wahaan dikhen, unhen nikaal laao. Farmaya : Chunaanche we unhen dekhenge ki apne karmon ke mutaabiq aag mein hain. Kisi ke qadmon tak aag hai to kisi ki aadhi pindli tak. Kisi ke ghutnon tak hai to kisi ki chhaati tak. Kisi ki kamar tak hai to kisi ki gardan tak aur abhi chehron tak nahin pahunchi hai. Chunaanche we unhen wahaan se nikaal layenge aur phir unhen aab-e-hayaat mein daala jayega.” kisi ne poochhaaा : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Hayaat kya hai? Aapne farmaya : “Jannat waalon ka snaan, jiske baad we aise ug ayenge, jaise paudhe ug aate hain.” aur ek baar farmaya : “Usmen we aise ug ayenge, jaise sailaab ke jhaag mein ghaas ugti hai. Phir nabeegan har us vyakti ke liye sifaarish karenge, jo shuddh man se yeh gawaahi deta tha ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur unhen wahaan se nikaal layenge.” Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Phir Allah Jahannam waalon par daya karega aur jiske dil mein ray ke daane ke baraabar bhi eemaan hoga, use usse nikaal lega.”

Qayaamat ke din sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah Jahannam ke beechon-beech pulsiraat ko rakh dega. Pulsiraat par bare kathor kaante lage honge. Phir logon ko uske oopar se guzarne ka aadesh diya jayega, to kuchh log usse sahi-salaamat guzar jayenge aur unhen aag chhooegi tak nahin, aur zakhmi hokar hi sahi, magar paar nikal jayenge, jabki kuchh Jahannam mein ja girenge.
Jab sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ki or se bandon ka hisaab lene ka kaam poora ho jayega aur Jannat ke haqdaar log Jannat mein tatha Jahannam ke haqdaar log Jahannam mein chale jayenge, to Jannat mein jaane waale mominon ko wahaan kuchh aise log dikhaai nahin denge, jo duniya mein unke saath namaz parhte the, zakat dete the, roza rakhte the, Hajj karte the aur jihaad karte the. Atah sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah se kahenge : Kya baat hai ki ham Jannat ke andar in logon ko apne saath nahin dekhte, jabki we duniya mein hamaare saath namaz parhte the, zakat dete the, roza rakhte the, Hajj karte the aur jihaad karte the? Allah unse kahega : Tum Jahannam chale jaao, yadi wahaan tumhen unmen se koi mile, to use wahaan se nikaal laao.
Jab wahaan jayenge, to unko apne-apne karm ke anusaar aag mein phanse hue payenge. Kisi ke donon qadmon tak aag hogi, kisi ki aadhi pindli tak aag hogi, kisi ke donon ghutnon tak aag hogi, kisi ke aadhe shareer tak aag hogi, kisi ki chhaati tak aagi hogi aur kisi ki gardan tak aag hogi. Lekin aag kisi ke chehre tak nahin pahunchegi. Tab yeh log unke baare mein sifaarish karenge. Atah unhen Jahannam se nikaala jayega aur us jeewandayi paani mein daala jayega, jismen dubki lagaane waala jeewit ho jaata hai. Atah we usi tarah ug uthenge, jaise us sthaan mein paudhe ug aate hain, jahaan se sailaab guzra ho.
Phir nabeegan, har us vyakti ke baare mein, jo sachche dil se Allah ke atirikt koi saty poojy na hone ki gawaahi deta tha, siphaarish karenge. Atah is prakaar ke logon ko bhi Jahannam se nikaal liya jayega. Phir Jahannam mein maujood logon par Allah ki daya hogi aur woh Jahannam se har us vyakti ko nikaal baahar karega, jiske dil mein kan bhar bhi eemaan hoga.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8288: Koi aisa din nahin, jismen Allah Jahannam se utne bandon ko mukt karta ho, jitne bandon ko arfa ke din mukt karta hai.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Koi aisa din nahin, jismen Allah Jahannam se utne bandon ko mukt karta ho, jitne bandon ko arfa ke din mukt karta hai. Woh nikat a jaata hai aur farishton ke saamne unpar garv karte hue kahta hai : Yeh log kya chaahte hain?”

Allah arfa ke din jitne logon ko Jahannam se mukti pradaan karta hai, utne kisi aur din nahin karta. Isi tarah Allah apne Hajj karne waale bandon ko apni waastawik nikatta pradaan karta hai, unpar farishton ke saamne abhimaan karta hai aur farishton par haajiyon ki fazeelat evn pratishtha ko prakat karta hai. Ahl-e-sunnat wa jamaat ka aqeeda hai ki sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah apne bandon se, apni mahaanta evn prataap ke anuroop, waastawik roop se nikat hai. Woh apne arsh ke oopar hai, apni srishti se alag hai, waastawik roop se bandon ke nikat evn qareeb aata hai. Allah kahta hai : Yeh log kya chaahte hain ki apne ghar-pariwaar ko chhore hue hain, apna dhan kharch kar rahe hain aur apne shareer ko thaka rahe hain? Yaani inka uddeshy kewal kshama, Allah ki prasannata, uski nikatta aur usse milne ka saubhaagy praapt karna hai. Atah unka uddeshy zaroor poora hoga aur unhen unki neeyton ke anuroop shreniyaan praapt hongi.
8289: Daya karne waalon par dayaawaan Allah daya karta hai. Tum zameen waalon par daya karo, aakaash waala tumpar daya karega.

Abdullah bin amr radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Daya karne waalon par dayaawaan Allah daya karta hai. Tum zameen waalon par daya karo, aakaash waala tumpar daya karega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jo log doosron par daya karte hain, unpar dayaawaan Allah daya karta hai, jiski daya ke dayre ke wistaar mein saari cheezen a jaati hain. Yeh waastav mein insaan ke liye uske karm ka poora-poora badla hai.

Phir Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is dharti ke oopar rahne waali sabhi cheezon, jaise insaanon, jaanavron aur pakshiyon aadi par daya karne ka aadesh diya hai. Iska phal yeh saamne ayega ki Allah tumpar aakaashon ke oopar se daya karega.

Islam daya ka dharm hai, jo Allah ke anusran aur srishti ke saath achchhe vyavhaar par aadhaarit hai.
Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah rahmat ke wisheshan ke saath wisheshit hai. Woh bara dayaalu aur atyant dayaawaan hai. Woh apne bandon par daya karta hai.
Insaan ko badla usi koti ka diya jaata hai, jis koti ka uska karm raha hota hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki Allah daya karne waalon par daya karta hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
8290: Nissandeh Allah hi cheezon ko mahanga aur sasta karne waala tatha rozi tang karne waala evn phailaane waala hai aur mujhe aasha hai ki Allah se meri bhent is haal mein hogi ki tummen se koi rakt evn dhan sanbandhit kisi prakaar ke zulm ka koi daawa mere wiruddh nahin rakhega

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : Logon ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Wastuon ke daam barh gae hain. Atah, hamaare liye wastuon ke mooly nirdhaarit kar deejiye. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Nissandeh Allah hi cheezon ko mahanga aur sasta karne waala tatha rozi tang karne waala evn phailaane waala hai aur mujhe aasha hai ki Allah se meri bhent is haal mein hogi ki tummen se koi rakt evn dhan sanbandhit kisi prakaar ke zulm ka koi daawa mere wiruddh nahin rakhega.”
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8291: (Qayaamat ke din) hamaara rab apni pindli kholega, to sabhi momin mard aur aurten sajde mein gir parenge. Lekin, har woh vyakti khara rah jayega, jo duniya mein dikhaawe aur shohrat ke liye sajda karta tha. Woh sajda karne jayega, to uski peeth ek hi haddi ki tarah sakht ban jayegi.

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “(Qayaamat ke din) hamaara rab apni pindli kholega, to sabhi momin mard aur aurten sajde mein gir parenge. Lekin, har woh vyakti khara rah jayega, jo duniya mein dikhaawe aur shohrat ke liye sajda karta tha. Woh sajda karne jayega, to uski peeth ek hi haddi ki tarah sakht ban jayegi.”

Pawitr evn uchch Allah qayaamat ke din apni sammaanit pindli khogela, to saare momin, purush hon ki stri, sajde mein gir parenge. Lekin munaafiq log, jo duniya mein logon ko dikhaane ke liye sajde kiya karte the, unhen sajde se rok diya jayega aur unki peeth ko reerh ki haddiyon ke wibhinn tukron mein se ek tukra bana diya jayega. We na jhuk sakenge aur na sajda kar sakenge. Kyonki duniya mein we Allah ke liye nahin, balki saansaarik uddeshyon ke tahat sajde kiya karte the. Jnaat ho ki yahaan pindli ka arth bheeshanta aur bechaini aadi bayaan karna uchit nahin hai. Use Allah ke ek gun ke roop mein, uski kaifiyat bayaan kiye bina, upma diye bina, uske arth ke saath chherchhaar kiye bina aur is sanbandh mein aye hue shabd ko arthawiheen banaye bina, maanna zaroori hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8292: Nissandeh sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah atyant haya waala tatha parda karne waala hai, jo haya tatha parda karne ko pasand karta hai. Atah, jab tummen se koi snaan kare, to parda kar le.

Yaala bin umayya (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek vyakti ko khule sthaan mein nanga hokar snaan karte dekha, to minbar par charhkar Allah ki prashansa aur uski baraai bayaan ki tatha uske baad farmaya : “Nissandeh sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah atyant haya waala tatha parda karne waala hai, jo haya tatha parda karne ko pasand karta hai. Atah, jab tummen se koi snaan kare, to parda kar le.”
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8293: Allah ne kaha : Jab mera banda mujhse ek baalisht nikat aata hai, to main usse ek haath nikat hota hoon aur jab woh mujhse ek haath nikat aata hai, to main usse donon haathon ke phailaav ke samaan nikat hota hoon aur jab woh mujhse donon haathon ke phailaav ke samaan nikat aata hai, to main uski or aur tezi se barhta hoon.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Allah ne kaha : Jab mera banda mujhse ek baalisht nikat aata hai, to main usse ek haath nikat hota hoon aur jab woh mujhse ek haath nikat aata hai, to main usse donon haathon ke phailaav ke samaan nikat hota hoon aur jab woh mujhse donon haathon ke phailaav ke samaan nikat aata hai, to main uski or aur tezi se barhta hoon."
8294: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab masjid mein prawesh karte, to farmaya karte :«أعوذ بالله العظيم، وبوجهه الكريم، وسلطانه القديم، من الشيطان الرَّجِيم» (main mahaan Allah ki, uske sammaanit chehre ki aur uski sanaatan satta ki sharan maangta hoon, dhikkaare hue shaitaan se.)

Abdullah bin amr bin aas radiyallahu anhuma se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab masjid mein prawesh karte, to farmaya karte :«أعوذ بالله العظيم، وبوجهه الكريم، وسلطانه القديم، من الشيطان الرَّجِيم» (main mahaan Allah ki, uske sammaanit chehre ki aur uski sanaatan satta ki sharan maangta hoon, dhikkaare hue shaitaan se.) poochha gaya : Bas itna hi ? Mainne kaha : Haan. Aapne farmaya : Jab (masjid mein prawesh karne waala) vyakti yeh dua parhta hai to shaitaan kahta hai : Aaj yeh saara din mujhse sukshit ho gaya.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab masjid mein prawesh karte, to kahte : Main Allah aur uski wisheshtaaon ki sharan mein aata hoon. Tatha uske daata chehre ki sharan mein aata hoon. Tatha uske prabhutv, shakti aur prakop ki sharan mein aata hoon, jo anaadi evn anant hai. Allah ki rahmat (daya) se door kiye gae aur nikaale gae shaitaan se. Arthaat : Ai Allah! Mujhe shaitaan ke dvaara daale gae bure khyaalon evn bhatkaane ke prayaason se surakshit rakh. Kyonki yahi insaan ki gumraahi ka sabab hain. Abdullah bin amr radiyallahu anhuma se poochha gaya : Itna hi? Yaani kya Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bas itna hi kaha hai? Uttar diya : Haan.

Jab masjid mein prawesh karne waala vyakti yeh dua parh leta hai, to shaitaan kahta hai : Is prawesh karne waale ne svayn ko mujhse dinbhar aur raatbhar ke liye surakshit kar liya.

Masjid mein prawesh karte samay is zikr ko parhne ki fazeelat. Is dua ko parh lene ke baad insaan dinbhar ke liye shaitaan se surakshit ho jaata hai.
Is hadees mein insaan ko shaitaan se sachet kiya gaya hai aur bataya gaya hai ki shaitaan musalmaan ko seedhe raaste se bhatkaane ke liye ghaat lagaakar baitha rahta hai.
Insaan ko shaitaan ke pathabhrasht karne ke prayaason se usi parimaan mein suraksha milti hai, jitna uske dil mein Allah par wishvaas, is dua ko parhte samay tanmayta aur iske badle mein Allah ki or se kiye gae waade par wishvaas hota hai.
[ise abu daawood ne riwayat kiya hai]
8295: Saari prashansa us Allah ki hai, jo saari aawaazon ko sunta hai. Khaula Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas apne pati ki shikayat lekar aaeen, to unki baat main sun nahin pa rahi theen.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se riwayat hai unhonne kaha : “Saari prashansa us Allah ki hai, jo saari aawaazon ko sunta hai. Khaula Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas apne pati ki shikayat lekar aaeen, to unki baat main sun nahin pa rahi theen. Tab sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne yeh ayten utaareen : {nissandeh Allah ne uski baat sun li hai, jo tumse apne pati ke baare mein jhagar rahi thi aur Allah ke saamne shikayat kar rahi thi aur Allah tum donon ki baaten sun raha tha.}
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8296: Kya tumhen saad ki ghairat par aashchary ho raha hai? Allah ki qasam! Main usse bhi adhik ghairat waala hoon aur Allah mujhse bhi adhik gairat waala hai. Allah ki ghairat ke kaaran hi usne ashleel kaamon ko haraam kiya hai. Jo dikhaakar kiye jayen unhen bhi aur jo chhipaakar kiye jayen unhen bhi. Allah se adhik ghairat waala koi nahin hai.

Mugheera bin shoba (radiyallahu anhu) se marfooan riwayat hai ki saad bin ubaada (radiyallahu anhu) ne kaha : Yadi mainne apni patni ke saath kisi ko dekh liya, to talvaar ki dhaar se fauran uski gardan ura doonga. Yeh baat Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko pahunchi, to aapne farmaya : “Kya tumhen saad ki ghairat par aashchary ho raha hai? Allah ki qasam! Main usse bhi adhik ghairat waala hoon aur Allah mujhse bhi adhik gairat waala hai. Allah ki ghairat ke kaaran hi usne ashleel kaamon ko haraam kiya hai. Jo dikhaakar kiye jayen unhen bhi aur jo chhipaakar kiye jayen unhen bhi. Allah se adhik ghairat waala koi nahin hai aur usse adhik kshamayaachna ko pasand karne waala koi nahin hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki Allah ne rasoolon ko shubh samaachaar dene waale aur saavdhaan karne waale banaakar bheja hai. Allah se adhik prashansa bhi kisi ko pasand nahin hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki usne Jannat ka wachan diya hai.”

Saad bin ubaada -radiyallahu anhu- ne farmaya ki yadi mainne kisi ko apni patni ke saath dekh liya, to talvaar ki dhaar se uski gardan ura doonga. Yaani awilanb uska wadh kar doonga. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bhi unki is baat ka maun samarthan kiya aur bataya ki aap saad se adhik ghairatmand hain aur Allah aapse bhi adhik ghairatmand hai. Yahaan yeh yaad rahe ki Allah ki ghairat uske any gunon hi ki tarah usi ke saath khaas hai. Uski ghairat srishti ki ghairat ki jaisi nahin, balki krodh evn prasannata jaise uske any gunon hi ki tarah, jinmen uska koi saajhi nahin hota, yeh uski mahaanta ke anuroop hai. Hadees mein aye hue 'شخص' shabd ka asal arth hai, ooncha hona aur zaahir hona. Choonki Allah har cheez se zaahir, mahaan aur bara hai, isliye is shabd ko Allah ke liye prayog karne mein ahl-e-sunnat ke yahaan, jo Allah aur uske Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke kathan ke anusaar chalte hain, koi buraai nahin hai.
Phir Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Allah ki ghairat ke kaaran hi usne ashleel kaamon ko haraam kiya hai. Jo dikhaakar kiye jayen unhen bhi aur jo chhipaakar kiye jayen unhen bhi." Yaani Allah ki isi ghairat ka prabhaav hai ki usne apne bandon ko ashleel kaamon ke nikat jaane se mana kiya hai. Ashleel kaamon se muraad aise kaam hain, jo kisi bhi pawitr aatma evn svasth wiwek par bhaari paren. Udaahran ke taur par vyabhichaar ko le sakte hain. Hadees mein aye hue shabd 'zaahir' se muraad woh kaary hai, jise khullam-khulla kiya jaye aur jo shareer ke angon dvaara kiya jaye, yadyapi chupke se hi kyon na ho. Jabki 'baatin' ke andar bhed aur dil ki baaten shaamil hain.
Phir farmaya : "Allah se adhik kshamayaachna ko pasand karne waala bhi koi nahin hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki Allah ne rasoolon ko shubh samaachaar dene waale aur saavdhaan karne waale banaakar bheja hai." Iska arth yeh hai ki Allah ne dandit karne se pahle rasoolon ko isliye preshit kiya, taaki apni srishti ko saavdhaan kar de aur bina chetaavni diye dand dene ke aarop se svayn ko bari kar le. Kuchh isi tarah ki baat is ayat mein bhi kahi gai hai : "Rasool shubh samaachaar dene waale aur sachet karne waale banaakar bheje gae hain, taaki rasoolon ke pashchaat logon ke paas Allah ke muqaable mein apne nirdosh hone ka koi tark na rahe."
Uske baad aapne farmaya : "Allah se adhik prashansa bhi kisi ko pasand nahin hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki usne Jannat ka wachan diya hai." Aisa uski aseem sanpoornata ke kaaran hai. Kyonki Allah is baat ko pasand karta hai ki uske bande uske anugrah evn uski daansheelta par uski prashansa karen. Isi ke liye usne bandon ko laabhaanvit hone ko har prakaar ki nemat di hai aur unki praapti par shukr ada karne se prasann bhi hota hai. Lekin we chaahe uski jitni bhi prashansa karen, uske gungaan ka haq ada nahin kar sakte. Yahi kaaran hai ki usne svayn apni prashansa ki hai aur Jannat ka wachan diya hai, taaki uske bande usse khoob maangen, uski prashansa karen aur is raah mein jahaan tak ho sake aage barhte rahen, kyonki Allah ka antim puraskaar Jannat hi hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8297: Ai Allah! Ayyaash bin abu rabeea, salma bin hishaam, waleed bin waleed aur durbal mominon ko mukti dila de. Ai Allah! Muzar par apni pakar sakht kar. Ai Allah! Unhen yoosuf (alaihissalaam) ke yug mein hone waale sookhe jaise sookhe se grast kar.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab antim rakaat mein ruku se sar uthaate, to kahte : “Ai Allah! Ayyaash bin abu rabeea, salma bin hishaam, waleed bin waleed aur durbal mominon ko mukti dila de. Ai Allah! Muzar par apni pakar sakht kar. Ai Allah! Unhen yoosuf (alaihissalaam) ke yug mein hone waale sookhe jaise sookhe se grast kar.” tatha Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne yeh bhi farmaya : “Allah qabeela ghifaar ko kshama kare aur qabeela aslam ko surakshit rakhe.” ibn abu zinaad apne pita se riwayat karte hain ki yeh sab subah ki namaz mein hota tha.

Abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) se marfooan riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke zamaane mein chaand ke do tukre hue, to pahaar ne ek tukre ko parde mein kar diya aur doosra tukra pahaa़r ke oopar tha.
