8299: Koi bhi vyakti athva koi bhi wastu Allah se adhik kisi aisi kashtadayak baat par sabr karne waali nahin hai, jo use sunaai de. Log Allah ki santaan hone ki baat karte hain, lekin iske baavjood Allah unhen sukh-shaanti aur rozi deta hai.

Abu moosa ashaari (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Koi bhi vyakti athva koi bhi wastu Allah se adhik kisi aisi kashtadayak baat par sabr karne waali nahin hai, jo use sunaai de. Log Allah ki santaan hone ki baat karte hain, lekin iske baavjood Allah unhen sukh-shaanti aur rozi deta hai.”

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Koi bhi vyakti Allah se adhik sabr karne waala athva koi bhi wastu Allah se adhik sabr karne waali nahin hai." Yaani Allah har kisi se zyaada sabr karne waala hai. Uska ek naam hai 'as-saboor' hai. Yaani aisi hasti jo awajnaakaariyon ko dandit karne mein jaldabaazi se kaam nahin leti. Yeh uske ek aur naam 'al-haleem' (sahansheel) ke arth se nikat hai. Lekin 'al-haleem' ke andar dand se suraksha ka arth adhik paya jaata hai.
Aapne aage farmaya : "Kisi kashtadayak baat par, jo use sunaai de." Yahaan prayukt shabd 'الأذى' ka arth hai aisi buraai aur apriy baat, jo bahut mahatv evn prabhaav na rakhti ho. Allah ne svayn kaha hai ki uske bande uski haani nahin kar sakte. Uska farmaan hai : "(He Nabi!) aapko we kaafir udaaseen na karen, jo kufr mein agrasar hain. We Allah ko koi haani nahin pahuncha sakenge." Tatha ek hadees-e-qudsi mein hai : "Ai mere bando! Tum meri haani karne ki sthiti mein nahin pahunch sakte ki meri haani karo aur mujhe laabh pahunchaane ki sthiti mein bhi nahin ja sakte ki mujhe laabh pahunchaao." Yahaan yeh spasht kar diya gaya hai ki srishti Allah ki haani nahin kar sakti, lekin use kasht de sakti hai.
Farmaya : "Log Allah ki santaan hone ki baat karte hain" Yaani aadam ki santaan Allah ko kasht dene ka kaam aisi baaton ko usse sanbaddh karne ke maadhyam se karti hai, jinse woh paak hai. Jaise uske beta, samkaksh evn upaasna mein saajhi hone ka daawa karna. Yeh aisi baaten hain, jinse woh pawitr hai.
Aage farmaya : "Lekin iske baavjood Allah unhen sukh-shaanti aur rozi deta hai." Yaani Allah kuvyavhaar ka badla upkaar se deta hai. Bande uske saath kuvyavhaar karte hue uski kami dikhaate hain, use bura-bhala kahte hain, uske baare mein aisi baat karte hain jisse woh pawitr hai, uske rasoolon ko jhuthlaate hain, uske aadesh ki mukhaalfat karte hain aur uski mana ki hui baaton mein sanlipt hote hain, lekin woh unke saath upkaar karte hue unhen svasth rakhta hai, beemaariyon se shifa deta hai, din-raat wipattiyon se surakshit rakhta hai aur aakaash evn dharti ki saari cheejo़n ki sewa lekar unhen rozi deta. Yeh uchchatam koti ka dhairy, sahansheelta aur upkaar hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8300: Allah ne sach kaha hai aur tere bhaai ka pet jhootha hai. Use shahad hi pilaao.

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki ek aadmi Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aakar kahne laga : Mere bhaai ko pet ki takleef hai. Aapne kaha : “Use shahad pilaao.” woh dobaara aya, to aapne kaha : “Use shahad pilaao.” woh teesri baar aya, to farmaya : “Use shahad pilaao.” woh phir aya aur kahne laga : Main shahad pila chuka hoon. Yeh sun aapne kaha : “Allah ne sach kaha hai aur tere bhaai ka pet jhootha hai. Use shahad hi pilaao.” chunaanche usne phir shahad pilaya, to woh theek ho gaya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8301: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya ham qayaamat ke din apne rab ko dekh sakenge? Aapne kaha : “Jab aasmaan saaph ho to kya sooraj aur chaand ko dekhne mein tumhen koi kathinaai hoti hai?”

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki hamne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya ham qayaamat ke din apne rab ko dekh sakenge? Aapne kaha : “Jab aasmaan saaph ho to kya sooraj aur chaand ko dekhne mein tumhen koi kathinaai hoti hai?” hamne kaha : Nahin. Aapne farmaya : “Us din tumhen apne rab ko dekhne mein isse adhik kathinaai nahin hogi.” phir farmaya : “Aawaaz dene waala aawaaz dega : Jo giroh (duniya mein) jiski ibaadat karta tha, woh usi ke saath jaye. Atah, saleeb waale apni saleeb ke saath, but parast apne buton ke saath aur (jhoothe) maaboodon waale apne maaboodon ke saath ho jayenge aur kewal wahi log shesh rah jayenge, jo Allah ki ibaadat karte the, chaahe we nek hon ya gunahgaar. Isi tarah kuchh bachekhuche kitaab waale bhi shesh rah jayenge. Phir Jahannam ko is haal mein laya jayega jaise ki woh saraab ho aur yahoodiyon se kaha jayega : Tum kiski ibaadat karte the? We kahenge : Ham Allah ke bete uzair ki pooja karte the. Unse kaha jayega : Tum jhooth bolte ho. Allah ki na to patni hai aur na putr. Achchha yeh bataao ki tum chaahte kya ho? We kahenge : Ham chaahte hain ki tu hamen paani pilaye. Kaha jayega : Pi lo. Chunaanche, jab we paani peene ke liye barhenge, to Jahannam mein gir parenge. Phir eesaaiyon se kaha jayega : Tum kiski ibaadat kiya karte the? Uttar denge : Ham Allah ke bete maseeh ki ibaadat karte the. Kaha jayega : Tum jhooth bolte ho. Allah ki na patni hai aur na beta. Achchha, ab tum kya chaahte ho? Uttar denge : Ham chaahte hain ki tu hamen paani pila de. Unse kaha jayega : Theek hai, pi lo. Lekin jab paani peene ke liye barhenge, to Jahannam mein gir parenge. Yahaan tak ki kewal Allah ki ibaadat karne waale nek aur gunahgaar log baaqi rah jayenge. Atah, unse kaha jayega : Tum yahaan kyon ruke hue ho, jabki sab log ja chuke hain? We kahenge : Ham unse us samay alag ho gae the, jab hamen unki aaj se kaheen adhik zaroorat thi. Hamne ek elaan karne waale ko yeh elaan karte suna ki jo giroh (duniya mein) jiski ibaadat karta tha, woh uske saath chala jaye aur is samay ham apne rab ki prateeksha mein hain. Aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : Tab sarvashaktimaan Allah unke saamne usse bhinn roop mein ayega, jis roop mein pahli baar un logon ne use dekha tha. Allah kahega : Main tumhaara rab hoon. We bhi kahenge : Awashy hi tu hamaara rab hai. Us samay usse kewal nabeegan hi baat karenge. Allah kahega : Kya tumhaare aur uske beech koi nishaani hai, jiske maadhyam se tum use pahchaan sako? We kahenge : Haan! Pindli. Tab woh apni pindli kholega, chunaanche saare momin sajde mein gir jayenge aur kewal wahi log shesh rah jayenge, jo (duniya mein) dikhaawe tatha shohrat ke sajda karte the. We bhi any logon ki tarah sajda karne jayenge, lekin unki peeth ek hi haddi ki tarah ban jayegi. Phir pulsiraat ko laya jayega aur Jahannam ke oopar rakha jayega.” hamne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Yeh pulsiraat kya hai? Aapne kaha : “Phisalne aur girne layaq ek pul, jismen ankush aur bare-bare aur mure hue kaante lage honge, jo najd ki saadaan jhaari ke kaanton ki tarah honge. Momin uspar se palak jhapakne ki tarah, bijli ki raftaar se, hawa ki chaal se, umda ghore ki raftaar se aur oont ki raftaar se guzar jayenge. Chunaanche, koi surakshit guzar jayega, koi kharonch ke saath paar ho jaaga aur koi Jahannam mein ja girega. Yahaan tak ki antim vyakti ghisatte hue paar hoga. Tum log aaj kisi haq ke liye jis tarah mujhse mutaalba karte ho, us din eemaan waale sarvashaktimaan Allah se usse bhi adhik zor-shor se mutaalba karenge. Phir jab dekhenge ki unko mukti mil gai hai, to apne bhaaiyon ke baare mein kahenge : Ai hamaare rab! Hamaare bhaaiyon ko mukti pradaan keejiye, jo hamaare saath namaz parhte the, hamaare saath roza rakhte the aur hamaare saath kaam karte the. Uchch evn mahaan Allah kahega : Jaao aur jiske dil mein raai ke daane ke baraabar bhi eemaan paao, use nikaal laao. Allah unke chehron ko Jahannam ki aag par haraam kar dega. We unke paas ayenge, to koi apne qadmon tak aag mein phansa hoga aur koi aadhi pindli tak. Jinhen we pahchaan payenge, unhen nikaal lenge. Phir lautkar jayenge, to Allah kahega : Phir jaao aur jiske dil mein raai ke daane ke samaan bhi eemaan paao, use nikaal lo. We jayenge aur jinhen pahaachan sakenge, unhen nikaal layenge.” abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain : Yadi tumhen meri baat sachchi na lage, to yeh ayat parho : {nissandeh Allah tanik bhi kisi par atyaachaar nahin karta tatha yadi koi neki hoti hai, to use Allah barhaata hai.} phir Nabi, pharishte aur momin sifaarish karenge tatha sarvashaktimaan Allah kahega : Ab meri sifaarish shesh rah gai hai. Chunaanche Jahannam se ek mutthi uthayega aur aise logon ko nikaalega, jo jal chuke honge. Phir unhen Jannat ke saamne waali nahar mein daala jayega, jise aab-e-hayaat kaha jaata hai. We uske donon kinaaron par is prakaar ug uthenge, jaise sailaab ke jhaag mein paudhe ug aate hain. Tumne kisi chattaan ke kinaare aur per ke kinaare paudhon ko ugte dekha hoga. Unka jo bhaag soory ki or hota hai, woh hara hota hai aur jo saye ki or hota hai, woh safed hota hai. Chunaanche we aise niklenge, jaise moti hon. Phir unki garadnon par muhren laga di jayengi aur we Jannat mein prawesh karenge. Unhen dekh Jannat waale kaheng : Ye dayaawaan Allah ke dvaara mukt kiye hue log hain. Allah ne inhen inke dvaara kiye gae kisi kaary aur inke dvaara aage bheji gai kisi bhalaai ke bina hi Jannat mein daakhil kiya hai. Unse kaha jayega : Tumhaare liye woh hai, jo tum dekh rahe ho aur uske saath uske samaan bhi."

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke kuchh saathiyon ne aapse poochha ki kya qayaamat ke din ham apne paalanhaar ko dekh sakenge? To aapne unko uttar diya ki haan, tum qayaamat ke din apne paalanhaar ko usi tarah dekh sakoge, jaise dophar ke samay sooraj ko aur chaudahveen ki raat mein chaand ko dekhte ho. Na bheer-bhaar hogi, na takraav. Yaad rahe ki yahaan tashbeeh spashtata tatha sandeh, kathinaai aur takraav na hone mein di gai hai. Yahaan samaanta ek dekhne ki doosre dekhne se bataai gai hai, ek dekhi jaane waali cheez ki doosri dekhi jaane waali cheez se nahin. Jnaat ho ki yeh dekhna us dekhne se bhinn hai, jiska saubhaagy Allah ke waliyon ko Jannat mein sammaan ke roop mein praapt hoga. Yeh daraasal is baat ka antar karne ke liye hai ki kisne Allah ki ibaadat ki aur kisne uske atirikt kisi aur ki ibaadat ki.
Phir Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya ki qayaamat ke din ek pukaarne waala pukaarega ki jo Allah ke atirikt kisi aur ki ibaadat karta tha, woh uske saath ho jaye. Ek any saheeh riwayat mein hai ki svayn pawitr Allah hi pukaarega. Atah jo log Allah ko chhor buton ki pooja karte the unhen ekatr kiya jayega aur Jahannam ki aag mein daal diya jayega. Ab kewal wahi log bachenge jo Allah ki ibaadat karte the, chaahe aajnaakaari hon ya awajnaakaari. Isi tarah bache-khuche yahoodi evn eesaai bhi rah jayenge. Jabki adhiktar, balki samooche yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon ko unke buton ke saath Jahannam mein daal diya jayega. Phir Jahannam ko logon ke saamne laya jayega, jo saraab (mareechika) ki tarah dikhaai degi. Chunaanche yahoodiyon ko laya jayega aur unse kaha jayega ki tum kiski ibaadat karte the? Uttar denge ki ham Allah ke bete uzair ki ibaadat karte the. Ispar unse kaha jayega : Tumhaari yeh baat jhoothi hai ki uzair Allah ke bete hain. Allah ki na to patni hai aur na santaan. Phir unse kaha jayega ki tum chaahte kya ho? Uttar denge ki ham paani peena chaahte hain. Us din itni bechainiyon evn bhayaawah kathinaaiyon ka saamna hoga ki unhen sabse pahle paani hi ki talab hogi. Choonki Jahannam ko unke saamne is tarah laya jayega ki woh paani ki tarah dikhaai paregi, isliye unse kaha jayega ki tum jise paani samajhte ho uske paas jaao aur pi lo. Jayenge, to unhen Jahannam milegi, jo itni tez jal rahi hogi aur usse itni bheeshan lapten uth rahi hongi ki maano uska ek bhaag doosre bhaag ko tor raha ho. Yahoodiyon ke baad isi tarah ki baat eesaaiyon se bhi ki jayegi.Yahaan tak ki jab kewal ek Allah ki ibaadat karne waale, aajnaakaari hon ki awajnaari, hi rah jayenge, to unse kaha jayega ki jab sab log ja chuke hain, to tum yahaan kyon khare ho? We uttar denge : Ham to logon se duniya hi mein alag ho gae the aur aaj unse alag hone ki zaroorat aur adhik hai. Un logon ne Allah ki awajna aur uske aadesh ki avhelna ki, to Allah ki prasannata ki praapti ke liye unse ghrina karte hue aur apne paalanhaar ke aajnaapaalan ko praathmikta dete hue hamne unse dushmani kar li. Is samay ham apne paalanhaar ki prateeksha mein hain, jiski ham duniya mein ibaadat kiya karte the. Chunaanche Allah unke saamne usse bhinn roop se ayega, jis roop mein un logon ne use pahli baar dekha tha.
Yahaan is baat ka spasht ullekh hai ki un logon ne Allah ko ek aise roop mein dekha tha, jis roop mein we use pahchaante the. Is roop ki galat-salat vyaakhya karna uchit nahin hai. Balki uski kaifiyat bataye bina, uski upma diye bina, uske arth ke saath chher-chhaar kiye bina aur prayukt shabd ko arthawiheen banaye bina uspar eemaan rakhna zaroori hai.
Jab Allah saamne ayega, to unse kahega : Main tumhaara paalanhaar hoon. Isse prasann hokar we kahenge : Sachmuch tum hamaare paalanhaar ho. Us samay pawitr Allah kewal nabiyon se baat karega. Unse kahega ki kya tumhaare aur uske beech koi nishaani nirdhaarit hai, jisse tum use pahchaan lo?
We uttar denge ki haan hai, aur woh nishaani pindli hai. Chunaanche pawitr Allah apni pindli kholega aur isse eemaan waale use pahchaan lenge tatha sajde mein gir parenge. Lekin iske wipreet munaafiq log jo Allah ki ibaadat dikhaane ke liye kiya karte the, sajde se rok diye jayenge. Unki peeth ko ek takhte ki bhaanti bana diya jayega tatha we jhukne evn Allah ki ibaadat karne ki kshamta kho denge. Unhen yeh saza isliye milegi ki we duniya mein sachche man se Allah ko sajda nahin karte the. Unka sajda saansaarik uddeshyon se prerit hota tha.
Is hadees mein Allah ki pindli hone ka ullekh hai. Daraasal yeh tatha is prakaar ki any hadeesen Allah taaala ke is farmaan ki tafseer hain : "Us din pindli kholi jayegi aur unhen sajda karne ko kaha jayega, lekin we sajda nahin kar sakenge." Jnaat ho ki yahaan pindli ka arth kathinaai evn bechaini ki bheeshanta bataana uchit nahin hai. Iske saath hi sunnat se bhi pindli ko saabit karna waajib hai aur ayat ke baare mein yahi kahna adhik uttam aur sahi hai ki isse muraad Allah ki pindli hi hai. Lekin ham uski na to kaifiyat bayaan karenge, na upma denge, na uske arth ke saath chher-chhaar karenge aur na prayukt shabd ko arthawiheen banayenge.
Phir pul-siraat ko laakar Jahannam ke beechon-beech rakh diya jayega. Ismen itni phislan hogi ki qadam sthir nahin rah sakenge. Is pul par ankush lage honge, taaki jise man ho, uchak liya ja sake. Ismen mote-mote aur bare-bare kaante bhi honge. Is pul se log apne eemaan evn karm ke anusaar guzrenge. Jiska eemaan sanpoorn evn karm saty tatha nishtha se paripoorn hoga, woh Jahannam ke oopar se palak jhapakte guzar jayega. Jabki jiska eemaan evn karm isse nimn star ka hoga, woh apne eemaan evn karm ke anusaar guzrega, jiska warnan hadees mein maujood hai. Hadees mein uska udaahran bijli tatha wayu aadi se diya gaya hai. Darsaal pul-siraat par guzarne waale log chaar prakaar ke honge :
Pahla : Aise log jinhen kisi prakaar ka kasht nahin hoga. Is prakaar ke log bhi uspar tezi se guzarne ke maamle mein alag-alag shreniyon mein wibhakt honge, jiska ullekh hadees mein hai.
Doosra : Aise log jo kharonch tatha halke zakhm ke saath use paar karne mein saphal ho jayenge. Yaani unhen Jahannam ki lapat ki tapish sahni hogi ya siraat par lage ankushon ke zakhm sahne parenge.
Teesra : Aise log jinhen taaqat se Jahannam mein phenk diya jayega.
Chautha : Aise log jo siraat se ghisatkar paar honge aur unke karm itne durbal honge ki unhen uthaane mein asmarth honge.
Phir Allah ke Rasool -salllahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Tum log aaj kisi haq ka jis tarah mujhse mutaalba karte ho, us din eemaan waale sarvashaktimaan Allah se usse bhi adhik zor-shor se mutaalba karenge." Yeh daraasal Allah ki aseem kripa evn ashesh daya ka ek namoona hai ki woh apne momin bandon ko apne un bhaaiyon ki kshama liye sifaarish karne ka avsar dega, jo apne un apraadhon ke kaaran Jahannam mein daal diye gae, jinke dvaara we apne paalanhaar se takraane ka prayaas karte the. Allah ki kripa dekhiye ki iske baavjood woh Jahannam ki yaatna tatha siraat ki bhayaawahta se mukti praapt karne waale eemaan waalon ke dilon mein yeh baat daal dega ki we unki kshama ka mutaalba karen aur unki sifaarish karen. Phir, unhen iski anumti bhi dega. Yeh pawitr evn uchch Allah ki kripa evn karuna ke atirikt kuchh aur nahin hai.
"We kahenge : Ai hamaare rab! Hamaare bhaaiyon ko mukti pradaan keejiye, jo hamaare saath namaz parhte the, hamaare saath roza rakhte the aur hamaare saath kaam karte the." Iska wipreet arth yeh hua ki jo log musalmaanon ke saath namaz nahin parhte aur unke saath roza nahin rakhte, we unki sifaarish nahin karenge aur apne paalanhaar se unki kshama ka mutaalba bhi nahin karenge. Isse pramaanit hota hai ki yahaan jin logon ki kshama mominon dvaara paak prabhu se maangi ja rahi hai, we momin evn ekeshvarvaadi the, kyonki we kah rahe hain : "Hamaare bhaaiyon ko mukti pradaan keejiye, jo hamaare saath namaz parhte the, hamaare saath roza rakhte the." Lekin we kuchh gunaahon mein sanlipt ho gae the, jinke kaaran unhen Jahannam jaana para tha. Isse is ummat ke do pathabhrasht sanpradayon -khawaaraj evn mutzila ka khandan hota hai, jo kahte hain ki jo vyakti Jahannam mein prawesh kar gaya, woh usse nikal nahin sakega aur kabeera gunaah karne waala vyakti Jahannam mein rahega.
Chunaanche unse Allah kahega : Jaao aur jiske dil mein deenaar ke baraabar bhi eemaan ho, use Jahannam se nikaal laao. Allah aag ko is baat ki anumti nahin dega ki unke chehron ko kha sake. Ye log unke paas jayenge, to dekhenge ki kisi ke qadmon tak aag hai aur kisi ki aadhi pindli tak aag hai. We jinko pahchaan sakenge, unhen nikaal lenge. Jab lautkar jayenge, to Allah unse kahega : Jaao aur jiske dil mein aadhe deenaar ke baraabar bhi eemaan ho, use bhi nikaal laao. We jayenge aur jise pahchaan sakenge, use nikaal layenge. Jab Allah ke paas pahunchege, to Allah kahega : Jaao aur jiske dil mein kan bhar bhi eemaan ho, use bhi nikaal laao. We jayenge aur jise pahchaan sakenge, use nikaal lenge. Itni hadees sunaane ke baad abu saeed khudri -radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha : Yadi tumhen meri baat sachchi na lag rahi ho, to yeh ayat parh lo : "Allah kan bhar bhi kisi par atyaachaar nahin karta, yadi kuchh bhalaai (kisi ne) ki ho, to (Allah) use adhik kar deta hai." Abu saeed khudri -radiyallahu anhu- ne is ayat ko pramaan ke taur par is roop mein prastut kiya hai ki bande ke dil mein yadi kan bhar bhi eemaan ho, to Allah use adhik karta hai aur uske sabab mukti pradaan karta hai.
Phir farmaya : "Phir Nabi, pharishte aur momin sifaarish karenge" Yeh is baat ka pramaan hai ki yeh teen prakaar ke log sifaarish karenge. Lekin yeh jaanna zaroori hai ki kisi bhi sifaarishkarta ki sifaarish usi samay ho payegi, jab Allah use sifaarish ki anumti dega, jaisa ki peechhe guzar chuka hai ki eemaan waale apne paalanhaar se apne bhaaiyon ki kshama maangenge, to Allah unhen anumti dega aur kahega ki jaao aur jiske dil mein ek deenaar ke baraabar bhi eemaan ho use nikaal laao.
Aapne kaha : "Tatha sarvashaktimaan Allah kahega : Ab meri sifaarish shesh rah gai hai. Chunaanche Jahannam se ek mutthi uthayega aur aise logon ko nikaalega, jo jal chuke honge." Yahaan Allah ki sifaarish se muraad uska in yaatnaagrast logon par daya karna hai. Aapke shabd : "Ek mutthi uthayega" Se Allah ki mutthi ki siddhi hoti hai. Allah ki kitaab aur uske Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki sunnat ke andar bahut-se spasht pramaan maujood hain, jinse Allah ke haath tatha mutthi ka saboot milta hai. Lekin galat arth nikaalne waale aur arth se chher-chhaar karne waale log in spasht pramaanon ko grahan nahin karte aur inpar eemaan nahin rakhte. Magar, ek samay ayega, jab unhen pata chal jayega ki Allah aur uske Rasool ki kahi hai baat hi saty hai aur is sandarbh mein we pathabhrashtata ke shikaar hue hain.
Allah Jahannam se ek mutthi uthayega aur aise logon ko nikaalega, jo jalkar koyla ho chuke the. Aapne farmaya : "Phir unhen Jannat ke saamne waali nahar mein daala jayega, jise aab-e-hayaat (jeewan jal) kaha jaata hai. We uske donon kinaaron par is prakaar ug uthenge." Yaani unhen Jannat ke aas-paas sthit ek nahar mein daala jayega, jiske paani aab-e-hayaat ke taur par jaana jayega. Yaani aisa paani jismen dubki lagaane waala jeewit ho jaye. Ismen daale jaane se in logon ke maans, aankhen aur haddiyaan jo aag mein jal chuki theen, is nadi ke kinaare ug ayengi, "Jaise sailaab mein aai hui matti mein paudhe ug aate hain. Tumne kisi chattaan ke kinaare aur per ke kinaare paudhon ko ugte dekha hoga. Unka jo bhaag soory ki or hota hai, woh hara hota hai aur jo saye ki or hota hai, woh safed hota hai." Isse taatyapary yeh hai ki unke maans tezi se nikal ayenge. Kyonki sailaab mein aai hui matti mein paudhe bari tezi se ugte hain. Yahi kaaran hai ki unka chhaanv ki or waala bhaag safed hota hai aur dhoop ki or waala bhaag hara hota hai. Kyonki woh kamzor tatha komal hota hai. Lekin isse yeh laazim nahin aata ki yeh log bhi isi prakaar ugenge aur uska Jannat ki or waala bhaag safed aur Jahannam ki or waala bhaag hara hoga. Balki yahaan muraad tezi se nikalne tatha komalta mein un logon ki ukt paudhon se samaanta dikhaana hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki aage farmaya : "Chunaanche we aise niklenge, jaise moti hon." Yaani unki tvacha moti ki tarah saaf-suthri aur sundar hogi.
Aage aapne kaha : "Phir unki garadnon par muhren laga di jayengi." Ek any riwayat ke anusaar in muhron mein likha rahega : "Dayaawaan Allah ke dvaara mukt kiye hue log"
Uske baad farmaya : "Aur we Jannat mein prawesh karenge. Unhen dekh Jannat waale kaheng : Ye dayaawaan Allah ke dvaara mukt kiye hue log hain. Allah ne inhen inke dvaara kiye gae kisi kaary aur inke dvaara aage bheji gai kisi bhalaai ke bina hi Jannat mein daakhil kiya hai." Yaani unhonne duniya mein koi satkarm nahin kiya tha. Unki ekmaatr poonji eemaan tha. Yaani is baat ki gawaahi dena ki Allah ke atirikt koi saty poojy nahin hai aur rasoolon par eemaan.
Aapne kaha ki phir unse kaha jayega : " Tumhaare liye woh hai, jo tum dekh rahe ho aur uske saath uske samaan bhi." Isse aisa prateet hota hai ki yeh log Jannat ke khaali sthaanon mein prawesh karenge, yahi kaaran hai ki inse yeh baat kahi jayegi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8303: Chikitsak to Allah hi hai. Tum kewal ek narm dil vyakti ho. Uska upchaarak wahi hai, jisne use paida kiya hai.

Abu ramsa (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki unhonne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se kaha : Yeh jo aapki peeth mein hai, use aap mujhe dikhayen, kyonki main ek chikitsak hoon. Yeh sun aapne farmaya : “Chikitsak to Allah hi hai. Tum kewal ek narm dil vyakti ho. Uska upchaarak wahi hai, jisne use paida kiya hai.”
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8304: Saeed bin jubair (rahimhullah) kahte hain ki mainne abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) se kaha : Nauf bakaali kahta hai ki yeh moosa (khazir ki kahaani mein jinka warnan hai) bani israaeel waale moosa nahin hain, balki ek aur moosa hain! Ispar unhonne kaha : Allah ke shatru ne jhooth kaha hai. Ubay bin kaab (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Allah ke Nabi moosa (alaihissalaam) ek din bani israaeel ko sanbodhit kar rahe the ki unse poochha gayaah aaj sabse bara jnaani kaun hai? Unhonne uttar diya : Main hi sabse bara jnaani hoon. Ispar Allah ne unse naaraazgi jataai, kyonki unhonne jnaan ko Allah ke hawaale nahin kiya tha. Atah, Allah ne unpar wahy utaari ki mera ek banda, jo do samudron ke milne ki jagah par rahta hai, woh tujhse adhik jnaan rakhta hai. Moosa (alaihissalaam) ne kaha : Ai Allah! Meri unse mulaaqaat kaise hogi? Aadesh hua ki ek machhli ko thaile mein rakh lo. Jahaan woh gum ho jaye, waheen woh mil jayega. Chunaanche moosa (alaihissalaam) apne khaadim yoosha bin noon ko saath lekar chal pare. Donon ne thaile mein ek machhli rakh li thi. Jab ek chattaan ke paas pahunche, to uspar apne sir rakhkar so gae. Is beech machhli thaile se nikalkar samudr mein apni raah banaati hui chali gai, jo moosa (alaihissalaam) aur unke sewak ke liye ek aashcharyajnak baat thi. Phir donon baaki raat aur din chalte rahe. Subah hui, to moosa (alaihissalaam) ne apne sewak se kaha ki naashta laao, ham apne is safar se thak gae hain. Daraasal, jab tak moosa (alaihissalaam) us jagah se aage nahin nikle the, jahaan jaane ka unhen aadesh hua tha, us samay tak unhen thakaawat ka ahsaas nahin hua tha. Ab, unke sewak ne unse kaha: Kya aapne dekha ki jab ham chattaan ke paas ruke the, to machhli (nikal bhaagi thi aur main uska zikr karna) bhool gaya tha aur yeh bhulaane ka kaam shaitaan hi ne kiya tha. Moosa (alaihissalaam) ne kaha : Ham to isi ki talaash mein the. Aakhir, donon apne pairon ke nishaan dekhte hue waapas hue. Jab us chattaan ke paas pahunche, to dekha ki ek aadmi kapra lapete hue ya apne kapron mein lipte hue maujood hai. Moosa (alaihissalaam) ne use salaam kiya, to khazir (alaihissalaam) ne kahaah tere mulk mein salaam kahaan se a gaya? Moosa (alaihissalaam) ne jawaab diya : (Main yahaan ka rahne waala nahin hoon, balki) main moosa hoon. Khazir ne kaha : Bani israaeel ka moosa? Uttar diya : Haan ! Phir moosa (alaihissalaam) ne kaha : Kya main is ummeed par aapke saath ho jaaoon ki hidayat aur maargadarshan ka jo jnaan aapko diya gaya hai, uska kuchh bhaag mujhe sikha den. Khazir ne kaha: Tum mere saath rahkar dhairy nahin rakh sakoge. Dekho, baat daraasal yeh hai ki mere paas kuchh jnaan hai, jo Allah ne mujhe diya hai aur woh tumhaare paas nahin hai. Isi tarah tumhaare paas kuchh jnaan hai, jo Allah ne tumhen pradaan kiya hai aur main usse anbhijn hoon. Moosa (alaihissalaam) ne kaha : In sha Allah aap mujhe dhairy rakhne waala payenge aur main kisi kaam mein aapki awajna nahin karoonga. Phir donon samudr ke kinaare-kinaare chal pare. Unke paas koi kashti nahin thi. Itne mein ek kashti unke paas se guzri. Unhonne kashti waale se kaha ki hamen sawaar kar lo. Kashti waalon ne khazir ko pahchaan liya aur bina kiraye ke sawaar kar liya. Itne mein ek goraiya aakar kashti ke kinaare baith gai aur samudr mein ek ya do baar chonch maara. Yeh dekh khazir ne kaha : Ai moosa! Mere aur tumhaare jnaan ne Allah ke jnaan ko kewal utna hi ghataya hai, jitna is goraiya ke chonch maarne se samudr ka paani kam hua hai. Phir khazir ne kashti ka ek takhta kheench liya. Yeh dekh moosa (alaihissalaam) bol uthe : In logon ne hamen baghair kiraye ke sawaar kiya aur aapne inki kashti mein chhed kar daala, taaki inhen duba den? Khazir ne kaha : Kya mainne nahin kaha tha ki tum mere saath rahkar dhairy nahin rakh sakoge? Moosa (alaihissalaam) ne jawaab diya: Mainne bhoolvash jo kaam kiya hai, uspar aap meri giraft na karen aur mujhe apne kaam ke pratiy mushkil mein na daalen. (Yeh moosa alaihissalaam ke dvaara bhoolvash kiya gaya pahla prashn tha.) phir donon (kashti se utarkar) chal pare. Itne mein ek larka mila, jo doosre larkon ke saath khel raha tha. Khazir ne oopar se uska sir pakarkar use apne haath se alag kar diya. Moosa (alaihissalaam) ne kaha : Kya aapne ek maasoom jaan ko naahaq qatl kar diya? Khazir ne kaha: Kya mainne tumse nahin kaha tha ki tum mere saath dhairy nahin rakh sakoge? (Ibn uyayna kahte hain : Ismen pahle se adhik taakeed hai.) phir donon chalne lage. Yahaan tak ki ek gaanv mein pahunche, to gaanv waalon se khaana maanga. Lekin gaanv waalon ne unki mehmaan nawaazi se inkaar kar diya. Isi dauraan unhen ek deewaar mili, jo girna hi chaahti thi. Khazir ne use apne haath ke ishaare se seedha kar diya. Ispar moosa (alaihissalaam) ne unse kaha : Yadi aap chaahte, to is kaam ki mazdoori le sakte the. Yeh sun khazir ne kaha : Yahaan se ab mere aur tumhaare beech judaai ho jaani hai. Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Allah moosa par raham kare. Hamaari ichchha thi ki woh dhairy rakhte, taaki un donon ki aur bhi baaten hamen maaloom ho jaateen.”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8307: Kya tum mujhe wishvaaspaatr nahin samajhte, jabki main uska wishvaaspaatr hoon, jo aakaash ke oopar hai tatha mere paas subah-shaam oopar ki soochna aati hai?

Tatha abu saeed khudri -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ali bin abu taalib -radiyallahu anhu- ne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas yaman se sone ka ek aprishodhit tukra bheja, jo charmashodhan ki prakriya se guzre hue ek chamre mein lipta hua tha. Warnankarta ka bayaan hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne use chaar vyaktiyon ke beech baant diya. Woh chaar vyakti the : Uyaina bin badr, aqra bin haabis, zaid al-khail aur chauthe vyakti the alaqma ya aamir bin tufail. Yeh dekhkar aapke ek saathi ne kaha : In logon ki tulna mein ham is dhan ke kaheen adhik haqdaar the. Warnankarta kahte hain ki jab iski soochna Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko mili to aapne farmaya : "Kya tum mujhe wishvaaspaatr nahin samajhte, jabki main uska wishvaaspaatr hoon, jo aakaash ke oopar hai tatha mere paas subah-shaam oopar ki soochna aati hai?" Warnankarta kahte hain ki itna sunne ke baad ek vyakti, jiski aankhen dhansi hui theen, gaalon ki haddiyaan ubhri hui theen, kapaal nikla hua tha, daarhi ghani thi, sir munda hua tha aur lungi takhnon se oopar thi, khara hokar bola : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aap Allah se dariye! Aapne kaha : "Tera bura ho, kya main dharti ke oopar Allah se sabse adhik darne waala vyakti nahin hoon?" Warnankarta ka kahna hai ki phir woh jaane laga to khaalid bin waleed -radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya main uski gardan na ura doon? Aapne farmaya : "Nahin, ho sakta hai ki woh namaz parhta ho." Khaalid -radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha : Bahut-se namaazi aise hain jo kahte kuchh hain aur dil mein kuchh aur rakhte hain. Aapne farmaya : "Mujhe logon ke dil cheer karke aur unke pet faar kar ke dekhne ka aadesh nahin diya gaya hai." Phir use jaata dekhkar farmaya : "Iski nasl se aise log niklenge jo Allah ki kitaab to pharraate se parhenge, lekin woh unke gale se neeche nahin utregi. Woh Islam se aise nikal jayenge jaise teer shikaar ko cheerte hue tezi se nikal jaata hai." Main samajhta hoon ki aapne yeh bhi kaha tha : "Agar wo log mujhe mil jayen, to main unhen usi tarah katl karoonga, jaise samood samuday ke log maare gae the."

Ali bin abu taalib -radiyallahu anhu- ne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas yaman se sone ka ek aprishodhit tukra bheja, jo charmashodhan ki prakriya se guzre hue ek chamre mein lipta hua tha. Warnankarta aage kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne use nimnalikhit chaar logon ke beech baant diya : Uyaina bin badr fazaari, aqra bin haabis hanzli, zaid al-khail nabhaani tatha alaqma bin ulaasa aamiri. Yeh dekh aapke saathiyon mein se ek vyakti ne kaha : Ham log in logon ki tulna mein is dhan ke adhik haqdaar the. Warnankarta ka kahna hai : Jab iski soochna Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko mili, to aapne kaha : "Kya tum mujhe wishvaaspaatr nahin samajhte, jabki main uska wishvaaspaatr hoon, jo aakaash mein hai tatha mere paas subah-shaam aakaash ki soochna aati hai?" Warnankarta ka kahna hai ki itna sunne ke baad ek vyakti, jiski aankhen  dhansi hui theen, gaalon ki haddiyaan ubhri hui theen, kapaal nikla hua tha, daarhi ghani thi aur adhik lanbi nahin thi, sir munda hua tha aur apni lungi ko uthaye hue tha, khara hokar bola : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aap Allah se dariye. Yeh sun aapne kaha : "Tera bura ho, kya main dharti ke oopar Allah se sabse adhik darne waala vyakti nahin hoon?" Warnankarta ka kahna hai ki phir woh vyakti jaane laga to khaalid bin waleed -radiyallahu anhu- kahne lage : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya main uski gardan na ura doon? Aapne farmaya : Nahin, aisa nahin karna hai. Ho sakta hai ki woh namaz parhta ho. Yeh sun khaalid -radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha : Bahut-se namaazi aise mil jayenge, jo kahte kuchh hain aur dil mein kuchh aur rakhte hain. Ispar aapne kaha : Mujhe logon ke dil cheer karke aur unke pet faar kar ke dekhne ka aadesh nahin diya gaya hai. Mujhe kewal unke pratyaksh vyavhaar ko dekhne ka aadesh diya gaya hai. Warnankarta kahte hain : Phir aapne use jaata hua dekhkar farmaya : Iski, iske saathiyon ki ya iske qabeele ki nasl se aise log niklenge, jo Allah ki kitaab to bahut mahaarat ke saath sundar aawaaz mein parhenge, unki zabaanen pawitr Qur'an ki tilaawat se hamesha tar rahengi, lekin Qur'an unke gale se neeche nahin utrega ki unke antraatma tak pahunchkar uska shuddhikran kare. Allah unke is karm ko na to oopar jaane dega aur na grahan karega. Woh log Islam se aise nikal jayenge jaise teer shikaar ko cheerte hue tezi ke saath aur chupke se nikal jaata hai. Mujhe to yeh bhi lagta hai ki aapne kaha tha : Agar mujhe we musalmaanon ke wiruddh talvaar lekar widroh karke nikalte hue mil gae, to main unki bheeshan hatya karoonga, jaise samood jaati ke saath kiya gaya tha.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- bare sahansheel the tatha kisi ke dvaara koi kashtadayak harkat kiye jaane par dhairy se kaam lete the.
Ismen is baat ka parmaan hai ki aap Allah ke Nabi the aur aapke paas jo kuchh tha, wahy ke maadhyam se mila hua tha.
Logon ke saath vyavhaar unke zaahir ke anusaar kiya jayega. Baatin ka maalik Allah hai.
Namaz ka mahatv tatha is baat ka ullekh ki namaz sthaapit karne waale ka qatl kisi islaami adhikaar ke bina nahin kiya ja sakta.
Khawaarij ka khatra tatha is baat ka ullekh ki yadi we yuddh karte hain, to unki haani se bachne ke liye unse yuddh karna jayaz hoga.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees mein khawaarij se yuddh karne ki prerna di gai hai aur ali -radiyallahu anhu- ki yeh fazeelat saabit hoti hai ki unhonne unse yuddh kiya.
Qur'an par ghaur karne, use samajhne, uspar amal karne aur use mazbooti se pakre rahne ka mahatv.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
8308: Allah se bhay karo aur apni patni ko apne paas roke rakho.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki zaid bin haarisa (radiyallahu anhu) shikayat lekar aye, to Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Allah se bhay karo aur apni patni ko apne paas roke rakho.” anas (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki yadi Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kuchh chhupaate, to is baat ko zaroor chhupaate. Kahte hain ki zainab (radiyallahu anha) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki doosri patniyon par yeh bolkar abhimaan karti theen ki tumhaari shaadi tumhaare ghar waalon ne karaai hai, jabki meri shaadi uchch evn mahaan Allah ne saat aasmaanon ke oopar se karaai hai. Saabit se riwayat hai ki yeh ayat : {aap apne dil mein woh baat chhupaate hain, jise Allah prakat karke rahega aur aap logon se bhay karte hain.} (soora al-ahzaabah 37) zainab (radiyallahu anha) tatha zaid bin haarisa (radiyallahu anhu) ke baare mein utri hai.
8310: Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dekha ki is ayat ko parhte samay apni do ungliyon ko (kaan aur aankh par) rakh rahe the.

Abu yoonus saleem bin jubair maula abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ko dekha ki unhonne yeh ayat : {nissandeh Allah tumhen is baat ka aadesh deta hai ki tum amaanton ko unke haqdaaron tak pahuncha do aur jab logon ke beech nirnay karo, to nyay ke saath nirnay karo. Allah tumhen achchhi baat ka nirdesh de raha hai. Nishchay Allah sab kuchh sunne dekhne waala hai.} [soora an-nisaah 58] parhi aur farmaya : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) dekha ki apne angoothe ko kaan par aur usse mili hui ungli ko apni aankh par rakha. Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain : Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dekha ki is ayat ko parhte samay apni do ungliyon ko (kaan aur aankh par) rakh rahe the.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8311: Ai Allah, ai jibraaeel, meekaaeel tatha israafeel ke rab! Aakaash tatha dharti ko banaane waale aur haazir aur ghayab ki khabar rakhne waale! Tu hi apne bandon ke matbhedon ka nirnay karne waala hai, mujhe apni anumti se jiske prati matbhed ho gaya hai, usmen saty ki raah dikha. Nishchay tu jise chaahta hai use sahi raasta dikhaata hai.

Abu salma bin abdur rahmaan bin auf kahte hain ki mainne ummul momineen aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se poochha ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab raat mein tahajjud ki namaz ke liye khare hote, to kya kahkar namaz praaranbh karte? Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne kaha : Aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab raat mein tahajjud ki namaz ke liye khare hote, to is dua ke saath apni namaz shuru karte the : “Ai Allah, ai jibraaeel, meekaaeel tatha israafeel ke rab! Aakaash tatha dharti ko banaane waale aur haazir aur ghayab ki khabar rakhne waale! Tu hi apne bandon ke matbhedon ka nirnay karne waala hai, mujhe apni anumti se jiske prati matbhed ho gaya hai, usmen saty ki raah dikha. Nishchay tu jise chaahta hai, use sahi raasta dikhaata hai.”
8312: Jahannam nirantar kahta rahega ki kya isse adhik hai? Yahaan tak ki sarvashaktimaan Allah usmen apna pair rakh dega, to kahega : Teri izjat ki qasam! Bas kaafi hai, bas kaafi hai! Phir Jahannam khud mein simat jayega.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Jahannam nirantar kahta rahega ki kya isse adhik hai? Yahaan tak ki sarvashaktimaan Allah usmen apna pair rakh dega, to kahega : Teri izjat ki qasam! Bas kaafi hai, bas kaafi hai! Phir Jahannam khud mein simat jayega.”

Is hadees-e-qudsi mein Allah ne bataya hai ki woh Jahannam se kahega ki kya tu bhar gai hai? Choonki Allah ne Jahannam ko wachan de rakha hai ki woh use jinnaat evn insaan se bhar dega. Atah woh jin logon ko chaahega, un logon ko usmen daalne ka aadesh deta jayega aur unhen usmen daala jaata rahega, aur woh kahti jayegi ki kya aur bhi daalne ke liye kuchh hai? Yeh silsila us samay thamega, jab Allah usmen apna qadam rakh dega aur woh kahegi ki yeh mere liye kaafi hai. Iske baad use samet diya jayega. Yaad rahe ki qadam ke baare mein yeh bataana ki isse muraad woh log hain, jinhen Allah pahle Jahannam ki or bhejega, ya phir iske atirikt any koi anuchit arth bataana jayaz nahin hai. Balki qadam ko Allah ki ek wisheshta ke roop mein uske arth ke saath chher-chhaar kiye bina, is shabd ko arthawiheen banaye bina, iski kaifiyat bataye bina aur upma diye bina maanna zaroori hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8313: Jahannam aur Jannat ke beech bahas wa takraar ho gai. Jahannam ne kaha : Mujhe tumhaare oopar yeh shreshthata praapt hai ki mere andar abhimaaniyon aur zaalimon ka niwaas hoga. Ispar Jannat ne kaha : Mera kya hai, mere andar to kewal kamzor, nimn star ke aur buddhiheen log hi daakhil honge.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Jahannam aur Jannat ke beech bahas wa takraar ho gai. Jahannam ne kaha : Mujhe tumhaare oopar yeh shreshthata praapt hai ki mere andar abhimaaniyon aur zaalimon ka niwaas hoga. Ispar Jannat ne kaha : Mera kya hai, mere andar to kewal kamzor, nimn star ke aur buddhiheen log hi daakhil honge. Tab Allah ne Jannat se kaha : Tu meri rahmat hai. Apne bandon mein se jispar chaahoonga, tere dvaara daya karoonga. Jabki Jahannam se kaha : Tu mera azaab hai. Main tere maadhyam se apne jin bandon ko chaahoonga, azaab doonga aur tum donon ko bhara jayega. Rahi baat Jahannam ki, to woh us waqt tak nahin bharega, jab tak Allah usmen apna pair nahin rakh dega. Us samay woh kahega : Ab bas ho gaya, ab bas ho gaya, ab bas ho gaya! Iske baad woh bhar jayega aur khud mein simat jayega. Aur haan, Allah apne kisi bande par zulm nahin karega. Lekin jahaan tak Jannat ki baat hai, to use bharne ke liye Allah ek nai srishti ki rachna karega.”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8314: Allah kahta hai : Jab mera banda kisi gunaah ka iraada kare, to use na likho, yahaan tak ki use kar daale. Yadi woh us gunaah ko kar daalta hai, to bas utna hi likho jitna usne kiya ho. Aur yadi mere (bhay ke) kaaran us gunaah ko chhor deta hai, to uske liye ek neki likh do.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Allah kahta hai : Jab mera banda kisi gunaah ka iraada kare, to use na likho, yahaan tak ki use kar daale. Yadi woh us gunaah ko kar daalta hai, to bas utna hi likho jitna usne kiya ho. Aur yadi mere (bhay ke) kaaran us gunaah ko chhor deta hai, to uske liye ek neki likh do. Isi prakaar yadi woh koi neki karne ka iraada kare, lekin use kar na daale, to uske liye ek neki likh do. Aur yadi woh us neki ko kar le, to use uske liye das guna se lekar saat sau guna tak likh do.”

Is hadees mein un farishton ko sanbodhit kiya gaya hai jo insaan ka karm likhne ke kaary par niyukt hain. Yeh hadees insaan par Allah ke anugrah aur uski kshama ko pradarshit karti hai. Aapne farmaya : "Jab mera banda kisi gunaah ka iraada kare, to use na likho, yahaan tak ki use kar daale." Amal se dil tatha shareer ke angon dvaara kiya jaane waala amal bhi muraad hota hai aur yahaan yahi muraad hai. Kyonki is baat ke pramaan maujood hain ki dil ke amal ki bhi pakar hoti hai aur insaan ko uska bhi badla diya jaata hai. Allah taaala ka farmaan hai : "Tatha jo usmen atyaachaar se adharm ka wichaar karega, ham use duhkhdayi yaatna chakhayenge." Tatha saheeh hadees mein hai : "Jab do musalmaan apni-apni talvaar lekar aapas mein bhir jaate hain, to wadh karne waala aur wadh kiya gaya vyakti, donon Jahannam mein prawesh karenge." Sahaaba ne poochha ki wadh karne waale ki baat to samajh mein aati hai, lekin wadh kiye hue vyakti ko Jahannam kyon jaana parega? To aapne kaha : "Isliye ki woh apne bhaai ki hatya ki ichchha rakhta tha." Qur'an evn hadees ke ye spasht ullekh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke shabd "Jab mera banda kisi gunaah ka iraada kare, to use na likho, yahaan tak ki use kar daale" Ki vyaapakta ko seemit karne ke liye kaafi hain. Phir yeh, gunaah ke iraade ke baare mein kahe hue aapke shabd "Use uspar likha nahin jaata hai" Ke wiruddh nahin hai, kyonki dil ka iraada evn pratijna bhi karm hai.
Aapne farmaya : "Yadi woh us gunaah ko kar daalta hai, to bas utna hi likho jitna usne kiya hai." Yaani ek hi gunaah. Allah taaala ka farmaan hai : "Jo (qayaamat ke din) ek satkarm lekar (Allah) se milega, use uske das guna pratiphal milega aur jo kukarm layega, to usko usi ke baraabar kuphal diya jayega tatha unpar atyaachaar nahin kiya jayega." Ek any sthaan mein uska farmaan hai : "Jisne dushkarm kiya, to use usi ke samaan pratikaar diya jayega tatha jo sukarm karega; nar athva naari mein se aur woh eemaan waala (ekeshvarvaadi) ho, to wahi prawesh karenge svarg mein. Jeewika diye jayenge usmen agnit."
Aapne kaha : "Aur yadi mere (bhay ke) kaaran us gunaah ko chhor deta hai, to uske liye ek neki likh do." Gunaah ko chhorne ke saath Allah ke bhay tatha uski haya ke kaaran chhorne ki shart rakhi gai hai. Yadi koi wiwash hone ke kaaran, srishti ke bhay se ya kisi any kaaran se chhorta hai, to uske liye ek neki nahin likhi jayegi, balki ho sakta hai ki uske khaate mein gunaah hi likha jaye.
Aapne farmaya : "Aur yadi woh koi neki karne ka iraada kare, lekin use na kare, to uske liye ek neki likh do..." Yeh daraasal dayaawaan evn upkaari Allah ka anugrah hai. Atah saari prashansa evn upkaar usi ka hai. Bhala isse barhkar upkaar kya ho sakta hai ki neki ka iraada karne par ek poori neki mile aur nek kaam karne par das se saat sau guna tak neki mile!
Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is kathan ki nisbat uchch evn mahaan Allah ki or yeh kahte hue ki : "Allah kahta hai : Jab mera banda iraada karta hai". Ismen aapne Allah ka yeh gun bayaan kiya hai. Yeh kathan us widhaan ka ansh hai, jismen Allah ka apne bandon se waada aur uska unpar upkaar hai. Yeh Qur'an ke atirikt hai aur srishti nahin hai. Atah Allah ki waani srishti nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8315: “Allah jahannamiyon mein sabse halka azaab paane waale vyakti se kahega : Yadi dharti mein maujood saari cheezen tumhaari hoteen, to kya tum is azaab se chhutkaara paane ke liye woh saari cheezen de dete? Woh aadmi kahega : Haan!

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : “Allah jahannamiyon mein sabse halka azaab paane waale vyakti se kahega : Yadi dharti mein maujood saari cheezen tumhaari hoteen, to kya tum is azaab se chhutkaara paane ke liye woh saari cheezen de dete? Woh aadmi kahega : Haan! Allah farmayega : Beshak jab tum aadam ki peeth mein the, to mainne tujhse isse aasaan cheez ki maang ki thi ki mera saajhi na banaana, parantu toone saajhi banaakar hi dam liya.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki Allah ek aise vyakti se kahega, jo Jahannam mein prawesh karne ke baad sabse nimn yaatna ka saamna kar raha hoga : Agar aaj tere paas duniya aur uski saari daulten a jayen, to kya is yaatna se jaan chhuraane ke liye unhen dega? Woh uttar dega : Awashy doonga. Yeh uttar sunne ke baad Allah kahega : Jab tum aadam ki peeth mein the aur tumse wachan liya gaya tha, to mainne tumse isse chhoti cheez maangi thi. Tumse bas itna kaha tha ki kisi ko mera saajhi na banaana. Lekin tumne meri ek na suni. Jab mainne tumko duniya mein bheja, to tum shirk ke maarg par chal pare.

Tauheed (ekeshvarvaad) ka mahatv tatha yeh ki tauheed ke maarg par chalna aasaan hai.
Allah ka saajhi banaana ek khatarna kaam hai aur iska anjaam bhi bara khatarnaak hoga.
Insaan jab aadam ki peeth mein tha, to Allah ne usse shirk na karne ka wachan liya tha.
Is hadees mein shirk se sachet kiya gaya hai aur bataya gaya hai ki qayaamat ke din duniya ki saari daulat bhi shirk karne waale ke kuchh kaam na a sakegi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
8316: Do jannaten aisi hain, jo chaandi ki hain. Unke bartan tatha unki saari wastuen chaandi ki hain. Jabki do jannaten aisi hain, jo sone ki hain. Unke bartan evn doosri saari wastuen sone ki hain. Adan naami Jannat mein logon aur unke rab ke darshan ke beech kewal Allah ke chahre par pari baraai ki chaadar ka parda hoga.

Abu moosa ashaari (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Do jannaten aisi hain, jo chaandi ki hain. Unke bartan tatha unki saari wastuen chaandi ki hain. Jabki do jannaten aisi hain, jo sone ki hain. Unke bartan evn doosri saari wastuen sone ki hain. Adan naami Jannat mein logon aur unke rab ke darshan ke beech kewal Allah ke chahre par pari baraai ki chaadar ka parda hoga.”

8317: Aadam tatha moosa (alaihimassalaam) ke beech tark-witark ho gaya. Moosa (alaihissalaam) ne aadam (alaihissalaam) se kaha : Ai aadam! Aap hamaare pita hain. Aapne hi hamen asfal kiya tatha Jannat se nikaala. Aadam (alaihissalaam) ne unse kaha : Ai moosa! Allah ne tujhe svayn apne se baat karne ke liye chuna aur apne haathon se tumhaare liye tauraat likhi. Kya tum mujhe ek aisi baat par dosh de rahe ho, jise Allah ne mujhe banaane se chaalees saal poorv hi likh diya tha? Is prakaar, aadam (alaihissalaam) ne moosa (alaihissalaam) ko paraast kar diya.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Aadam tatha moosa (alaihimassalaam) ke beech tark-witark ho gaya. Moosa (alaihissalaam) ne aadam (alaihissalaam) se kaha : Ai aadam! Aap hamaare pita hain. Aapne hi hamen asfal kiya tatha Jannat se nikaala. Aadam (alaihissalaam) ne unse kaha : Ai moosa! Allah ne tujhe svayn apne se baat karne ke liye chuna aur apne haathon se tumhaare liye tauraat likhi. Kya tum mujhe ek aisi baat par dosh de rahe ho, jise Allah ne mujhe banaane se chaalees saal poorv hi likh diya tha? Is prakaar, aadam (alaihissalaam) ne moosa (alaihissalaam) ko paraast kar diya.”

8318: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne bani israaeel ke ek vyakti ki ghatna sunaai, jisne bani israaeel ke ek any vyakti se ek hazaar deenaar qarz maange the.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne bani israaeel ke ek vyakti ki ghatna sunaai, jisne bani israaeel ke ek any vyakti se ek hazaar deenaar qarj ke roop mein maange the. Usne kaha : Kuchh gawaah le aao, jinhen main gawaah bana sakoon. Ispar us vyakti ne kaha : Allah ki gawaahi kaafi hai. Phir usne kaha : Koi zamaanatdaar le aao. Ispar usne kaha : Jamaanatdaar ke roop mein Allah hi kaafi hai. Ab usne kaha : Chalo theek hai. So usne ek nirdhaarit samay ke liye use ek hazaar deenaar de diye. Deenaar lekar woh samudri yaatra par nikal gaya aur apna kaam poor kar liya. Phir qarz ada karne ke samay par aana chaaha, lekin kashti dhoondhne ke baavjood na mili. Aise mein use ek lakri mili. Usne lakri ke andar chhed kiya aur usmen ek hazaar deenaar tatha udhaar waale ke naam ek chitthi rakhkar uske khaali sthaan ko baraabar kar diya aur samudr ke paas khara hokar bola : Ai Allah! Tu jaanta hai ki mainne amuk vyakti se ek hazaar deenaar qarz liya tha. Us samay usne gawaah maanga, to mainne kaha tha ki Allah ki gawaahi kaafi hai. Woh tere naam par raazi ho gaya. Phir usne zamaanatdaar maanga, to mainne kaha ki Allah ki zamaanat kaafi hai. Woh us samay bhi tere naam par taiyaar ho gaya. Ab mainne bari daur-bhaag ki ki koi kashti mil jaye aur main uske deenaar bhej sakoon, lekin mujhe koi kashti na mil saki. Atah ab main inhen tere hawaale karta hoon. Yeh kahkar usne lakri ko samudr mein daal diya aur lakri uske andar chali gai. Phir woh chal para, kintu isi firaak mein tha ki koi kashti mil jaye aur woh apna desh waapas ja sake. Udhar qarz dene waala yeh dekhne ke liye nikla ki shayad koi kashti uske dhan ke saath aai ho. Itne mein achaanak uski nazar usi lakri par pari, jismen uske deenaar the. Usne use jalaawan ke taur par utha liya. Jab use phaara, to uske andar se deenaar aur chitthi nikli. Doosri or qarz lene waala bhi a gaya aur ek hazaar deenaar prastut karte hue kaha : Allah ki qasam! Main aapka maal ada karne ke liye kashti dhoondhta raha, lekin isse pahle koi kashti na mil saki. Qarz dene waale ne kaha : Kya tumne mujhe kuchh bheja tha? Usne kaha : Mainne to tumhen abhi-abhi bataya ki mujhe isse pahle koi kashti na mil saki. Udhaar dene waale ne kaha : Allah ne tumhaara woh dhan pahuncha diya hai, jo tumne lakri ke andar rakhkar bheja tha. Atah, ab tum apne hazaar deenaar ke saath waapas ho jaao. Tumne wachan nibhaane ka saubhaagy praapt kar liya hai. ”

Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is hadees mein bayaan kiya hai ki bani israaeel ke ek vyakti ne apne hi samuday ke ek vyakti se hazaar deenaar qarz maanga. Usne kahaah koi gawaah laao, jo gawaahi de ki tumne mujhse hazaar deenaar liye hain. Qarz maangne waale ne kahaah mere tatha tumhaare beech gawaah banne ke liye Allah kaafi hai. Usne kahaah phir koi zamaanatdaar laao, jo tumhaari zamaanat de sake. Usne kahaah zamaanatdaar ke roop mein bhi tumhaare liye Allah kaafi hai. Usne kahaah chalo, theek hai. Chunaanche ek nirdhaarit samay ke liye hazaar deenaar de diye. Phir qarz lene waala vyakti deenaar lekar, vyavsay ke uddeshy se, samudri yaatra mein nikal para. Jab rin ada karne ka samay aya, to rin ada karne ko jaane ke liye sawaari dhoondhne laga, lekin use koi sawaari na mil saki. Atah usne ek lakri li, usmen chhed karke ek hazaar deenaar aur qarj dene waale ke naam par ek chitthi rakh di, jismen likha thaah yeh chitthi amuk vyakti ki or se amuk vyakti ke naam hai. Mainne aapke deenaar ek pratinidhi ke hawaale kar diye hain, jisne mera pratinidhitv karne ka zimmewaari le li hai. Phir chhed ko band karke theek-thaak kar diya aur use samudr ke paas aakar yeh kahte hue samudr ke hawaale kar diyaah ai Allah, tujhe pata hai ki mainne amuk se ek hazaar deenaar qarz liya tha. Us samay usne mujhse zamaanatdaar maanga tha, to mainne kaha tha ki zamaanatdaar ke taur par Allah hi kaafi hai, to woh teri zamaanat par santusht ho gaya tha. Usne mujhse gawaah maanga tha, to mainne kaha tha ki gawaahi ke liye Allah hi kaafi hai tatha woh santusht ho gaya tha. Ab mainne bara prayaas kiya ki koi kashti mil jaye aur main jaakar uska qarz utaar sakoon, parantu koi kashti na mil saki. Atah main uski amaanat tere hawaale karta hoon. Phir use samudr mein daal diya aur lakri paani ke andar chali gai. Uske baad woh waapas ho gaya, parantu nirantar kashti ki talaash mein raha, taaki jaakar doosri baar ek hazaar ada kar sake, kyonki use lag raha tha ki pahle ada karne ka jo upay usne apnaya tha, woh kaaphi nahi tha. Jahaan tak qarz dene waale ki baat hai, to woh samay par yeh dekhne ke liye nikla ki shayad koi kashti aai ho, jismen uska diya hua maal ho. Yaani usne kisi ke haath se bhejvaya ho ya khud lekar aya ho. Lekin use koi kashti dikhaai na di. Kintu use woh lakri nazar aai, jismen uske deenaar the. Usne use utha liya, taaki ghar mein jalaawan ke kaam a sake. Use pata nahin tha ki ismen uske deenaar hain. Parantu jab use aari se kaata, to uske deenaar aur uske naam se likhi chitthi mil gai. Isi beech qarz lene waala vyakti bhi a gaya aur qarz dene waale ko ek hazaar deenaar thamaate hue bolaah Allah ki qasam, mainne poora prayatn kiya ki koi kashti mil jaye, parantu jis kashti se main aya, usse pahle koi kashti na mil saki. Uski baat sunkar qarz dene waale ne kahaah kya tumne meri or kuchh bheja tha? Usne uttar diyaah main to bata raha hoon ki jis kashti se main aya hoon, usse pahle koi kashti na mil saki. Is par qarz dene waale ne kahaah Allah ne tere ek hazaar deenaar pahuncha diye hain, jo toone lakri ke andar rakhkar bheje the. Atah apne yeh hazaar deenaar waapas le jaao. Tumne apna wachan poora kar diya hai.
8341: ''Jab jannati Jannat mein prawesh kar jayenge, to ek pukaarne waala pukaar kar kahega : Tum sada svasth rahoge, kabhi beemaar nahin hoge. Tum sada jeewit rahoge tatha kabhi maroge nahin. Tum sada jawaan rahoge, kabhi boorhe nahin hoge. Tum sada sukh-suwidhaaon ke aanand mein rahoge, kabhi pareshaani ka saamna nahin karoge.''

Abu saeed khudri tatha abu huraira radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : ''Jab jannati Jannat mein prawesh kar jayenge, to ek pukaarne waala pukaar kar kahega : Tum sada svasth rahoge, kabhi beemaar nahin hoge. Tum sada jeewit rahoge tatha kabhi maroge nahin. Tum sada jawaan rahoge, kabhi boorhe nahin hoge. Tum sada sukh-suwidhaaon ke aanand mein rahoge, kabhi pareshaani ka saamna nahin karoge.'' Allah taaala ka pharmaan hai : {unhen pukaar kar kaha jayega : Yahi woh Jannat hai, jiske waaris tum uske kaaran banaye gae ho, jo tum kiya karte the.} [soora al-aaraaf : 43]

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- bata rahe hain ki jannati jab Jannat ki nemton ka aanand le rahe honge, to ek pukaarne waala pukaarkar kahega : Yahaan tumhaare liye yeh vyawastha hai ki tum sada svasth rahoge aur koi chhoti se chhoti beemaari bhi tumhaare nikat nahin ayegi, tum sada jeewit rahoge aur tumko kabhi maut nahin ayegi, neend bhi nahin, jo maut ka chhota roop hai. Tum sada jawaan rahoge aur burhaapa tumhaare paas se bhi nahin guzrega. Yahaan tum har prakaar ki nemton mein rahoge, na shok hoga aur na chinta hogi. Isi ka ullekh sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ke is farmaan mein hua hai : "Unhen pukaarkar kaha jayega: Yahi woh Jannat hai, jiske uttaraadhikaari tum un karmon ke kaaran banaye gae ho, jo tum kiya karte the." [soora aaraaph: 43]

Insaan jitna bhi khushhaal evn sukhi ho jaye, use mili hui saansaarik jeewan ki nemton ko chaar cheezen bemza kar deti hain : Beemaari, maut, purhaapa aur nirdhanta, dushman evn jang aadi ke bhay se utpann hone waali chinta.  Lekin in chaaron cheezon se jannati surakshit rahenge. Isliye unhen sanpoornatam nemat praapt hogi.
Jannat ki nemten duniya ki nemton se bhinn hain, isliye ki Jannat ki nemton ke baare mein koi bhi bhay nahin hoga, jabki duniya ki koi bhi nemat daymi nahin hoti aur yahaan pareshaaniyaan tatha beemaariyaan bhi lagi rahti hain.
Achchhe karm ki prerna, jiske dvaara Jannat ki nemton tak pahuncha ja sakta hai.
8342: Tumhaare liye wo saari cheezen hain, jinki tamanna tumne ki hai aur unke saath unke samaan aur bhi cheezen hain.''

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : ''Tum mein se jo sabse kam darje ka jannati hoga (wo bhi aisa hoga ki Allah) usse kahega : (Jo chaaho) tamanna karo. Chunaanche woh bahut saari cheezon ki tamanna karega. Phir Allah usse kahega : Kya tumne tamanna kar li? Woh kahega : Haan. Tab Allah usse farmayega : Tumhaare liye wo saari cheezen hain, jinki tamanna tumne ki hai aur unke saath unke samaan aur bhi cheezen hain.''

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- bata rahe hain ki Jannat ke andar prawesh karne waale logon mein sabse kam darje waale vyakti ki bhi yeh shaan hogi ki Allah usse tamanna karne ko kahega aur jab woh saari tamannayen saamne rakh dega aur uski koi aarzu baaqi nahin rahegi, to Allah usse poochhega : Toone saari tamannayen kar leen? Jawaab dega : Ji, kar li. Yeh sun Allah usse kahega : Tumhaare liye wo saari cheezen hain, jinki tamanna tumne ki hai aur unke saath unke samaan aur bhi cheezen hain.

Jannat waale alag-alag shreni ke honge.
Allah bara dayaalu evn daata hai.
Jannat ki nemton ki koi nirdhaarit seema nahin hai. Uske andar momin ki har tamanna aur har khvaahish poori hogi. Yeh sab Allah ki kripa aur anugrah ke kaaran hoga.
8343: “Allah taaala jannatiyon se farmayega : Ai Jannat waalo! Wo kahenge : Poore dhyaan se haazir hain ai hamaare rab aur sada teri meharbaani ke mohtaaj hain. Allah taaala farmayega : Ab tum raazi ho? Wo kahenge : Kya ab bhi khush na honge, jabki toone hamen aisi-aisi nemten pradaan ki hain, jo apni saari makhlooq mein se kisi aur ko nahin deen?

Abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : “Allah taaala jannatiyon se farmayega : Ai Jannat waalo! Wo kahenge : Poore dhyaan se haazir hain ai hamaare rab aur sada teri meharbaani ke mohtaaj hain. Allah taaala farmayega : Ab tum raazi ho? Wo kahenge : Kya ab bhi khush na honge, jabki toone hamen aisi-aisi nemten pradaan ki hain, jo apni saari makhlooq mein se kisi aur ko nahin deen? Phir Allah taaala irshaad farmayega : Kya main tumhen ek aisi cheez na doon, jo in sabse bhi barhkar hai? Wo kahenge : Ai Allah! Ab in sabse bhi barhkar aur kaun si cheez ho sakti hai? Tab Allah taaala farmayega : Main apni prasannata tumhen pradaan karta hoon. Ab kabhi main tumse naaraaz nahin hoonga.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallam ne bataya hai ki jannati log jab Jannat mein honge, to Allah unse kahega : Ai jannatiyo! We uttar denge : Ham upasthit hain ai hamaare paalanhaar! Saari bhalaaiyaan tere hi haathon mein hain. Allah unse poochhega : Kya ab tum khush ho? We jawaab denge : Ham bilkul khush hain. Bhala ham khush kyon na rahen, jabki toone hamen woh sab kuchh de diya hai, jo toone apni kisi bhi srishti ko nahin diya hai. Yeh jawaab sunkar Allah poochhega : Kya main tumhen isse behtar cheez na doon? Jannati jawaab denge : Ai mere paalanhaar! Isse behtar cheez bhala aur kya ho sakti hai? Allah kahega : Main tumhen apni shaashvat prasannata aur  razaamandi pradaan karta hoon. Iske baad main tumse kabhi naaraaz nahin hooonga.

Allah Jannat waasiyon se baat karega.
Jannat waasiyon ko Allah yeh susmaachaar suna dega ki woh unse hamesha raazi rahega, kabhi naaraaz nahin hoga aur yeh silsila hamesha jaari rahega.
Jannat mein maujood tamaam log alag-alag shreniyon ke hone ke baavjood apne-apne haal se santusht aur khu़sh honge. Kyonki sab log ek hi jawaab denge : Kahenge : "Toone hamen woh sab kuchh de diya hai, jo apni kisi bhi srishti ko nahin diya hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
8344: Jab jannati Jannat mein daakhil ho jayenge, to uchch evn barkat waala Allah kahega : Kya main tumhen aur bhi koi cheez doon?

Suhaib radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jab jannati Jannat mein daakhil ho jayenge, to uchch evn barkat waala Allah kahega : Kya main tumhen aur bhi koi cheez doon? We kahenge : Kya toone hamaare chehre raushan nahin kar diye? Kya toone hamen Jannat mein daakhil nahin kiya aur Jahannam se mukti nahin di? Tab Allah parda hata dega, to unhen aisa lagega ki unhen apne sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan rab ke darshan se uttam koi wastu di nahin gai hai."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- bata rahe hain ki jab jannati Jannat mein prawesh kar jayenge, to uchch evn mahaan Allah unse kahega :

Kya tum chaahte ho ki tumko kuchh aur nemten don?

Jawaab mein saare jannati kahenge : Kya tu ne hamaare chehre raushan nahin kar diye? Kya tu ne hamen Jannat mein daakhil nahin kar diya aur Jahannam se najaat nahin de di?

Jannatiyon ka jawaab sunne ke baad Allah parda hata dega. Yahaan yeh baat yaad rahe ki Allah ka parda noor hai. Chunaanche unko ab tak jitni bhi cheezen mili hongi, unmen unke mahaan aur shaktishaali rab ke darshan se adhik priy cheez kuchh na hogi.

Qayaamat ke din jannatiyon ke liye parde ko hata diya jayega to woh apne rab ka deedaar kar lenge. Jabki awishvaasi isse wanchit rah jayenge.
Eemaan waalon ko Jannat ke andar milne waali sabse bari nemat unke rab ka darshan hogi.
Sabhi jannati, chaahe jis shreni ke hon, apne rab ko awashy  dekhenge.
Eemaan waalon par Allah ka yeh anugrah ki unko Jannat mein daakhil karega.
Achchhe karm tatha Allah aur uske Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke anusran dvaara Jannat ki raah par tezi se aage barhne ka mahatv.
8345: Allah agle tatha pichhle sab logon ko ek bare tatha samtal maidaan mein jama karega, jahaan aawaaz dene waale ki aawaaz sab ko pahunch sakegi aur dekhne waala sab ko dekh sakega aur sooraj bahut nazdeek hoga. Logon ko asahneey kasht evn peera ka saamna hoga.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas maans laya gaya aur baazu ka maans uthaakar aapke saamne rakha gaya, kyonki baazu ka maans aapko pasand tha. Chunaanch aapne apne daant se kaatkar ek baar khaya aur uske baad farmaya : “Qayaamat ke din main logon ka sardaar rahoonga. Kya tum jaante ho aisa kyon hoga? Allah agle tatha pichhle sab logon ko ek bare tatha samtal maidaan mein jama karega, jahaan aawaaz dene waale ki aawaaz sab ko pahunch sakegi aur dekhne waala sab ko dekh sakega aur sooraj bahut nazdeek hoga. Logon ko asahneey kasht evn peera ka saamna hoga. Atah, log aapas mein kahenge : Kya tum nahin dekhte ki kaisi takleef mein par chuke ho? Tum kisi aise vyakti ki talaash kyon nahin karte, jo tumhaare rab ke saamne tumhaari sifaash kar sake? Phir aapas mein ek-doosre se kahenge ki aadam -alaihissalaam- ke paas chalo. Atah, we aadam -alaihissalaam- ke paas ayenge aur kahenge : Aap insaanon ke pita hain, Allah ne aapko apne haathon se banaya, phir aapke andar rooh phoonki, pharishton ko sajda karne ka aadesh diya, to unhonne aapko sajda kiya. Aap hamaare liye apne rab ke paas sifaarish kar den. Kya aap nahin dekhte ki ham kaisi takleef mein hain? Kya aap nahin dekhte ki hamaara kasht kitna barh chuka hai? Aadam -alaihissalaam- kahenge : Aaj mera rab bahut gusse mein hai. Aisa gussa na kabhi pahle kiya tha aur na baad mein karega. Mujhe usne ek per ke phal se mana kiya tha, lekin mainne kha liya tha. Mujhe apni chinta sata rahi hai. Mujhe apni chinta sata rahi hai. Mujhe apni chinta sata rahi hai. Tum kisi doosre ke paas jaao. Tum nooh -alaihissalaam- ke paas jaao. Log nooh -alaihissalaam- ke paas ayenge aur kahenge : Ai nooh, aap pratham Rasool bankar zameen par aye aur Allah ne aapko apna shukraguzaar banda kaha hai. Aap hamaare liye apne paalanhaar ke paas sifaarish kar den. Kya aap nahin dekhte ki ham kaisi takleef mein hain? Woh kahenge : Aaj mera rab bahut gusse mein hai. Na isse pahle kabhi aise gusse mein tha aur na baad mein kabhi aise gusse mein hoga. Daraasal, mujhe ek dua ka adhikaar tha, jo mainne apni jaati ke wiruddh kar daali hai. Mujhe apni chinta sata rahi hai. Mujhe apni chinta sata rahi hai. Mujhe apni chinta sata rahi hai. Mere siwa tum kisi aur ke paas jaao. Tum ibraaheem -alaihissalaam- ke paas jaao. Yeh sunkar sab log ibraaheem -alaihissalaam- ke paas ayenge aur kahenge : Ai ibraaheem! Aap Allah ke Nabi aur tamaam ahle zameen mein se uske dost hain. Aap rab ke paas hamaari siphaarish karen. Kya aap nahin dekhte ki hamen kaisi takleef ho rahi hai? Lekin woh bhi unse kahenge : Aaj mera rab bahut gusse mein hai. Na isse pahle kabhi itna gussa hua aur na baad mein hoga. Mainne (duniya mein) teen jhoothi baaten kahi theen. Mujhe apni chinta sata rahi hai. Mujhe apni chinta sata rahi hai. Mujhe apni chinta sata rahi hai. Mere siwa tum kisi aur ke paas jaao. Achchha, tum moosa -alaihissalaam- ke paas jaao. Phir log moosa -alaihissalaam- ke paas jayenge aur kahenge : Ai moosa ! Aap Allah ke Rasool hain. Allah ne aapko, apne saath baat karne ka saubhaagy pradaan karke aur Rasool banaakar, any logon ki tulna mein shreshthata pradaan ki hai. Aaj aap Allah ke saamne hamaari sifaarish karen. Kya aap nahin dekhte ki ham kis prakaar ke kasht mein hain? Moosa -alaihissalaam- kahenge : Aaj to mera rab bahut gusse mein hai. Itna gussa na kabhi hua tha aur na kabhi hoga. Daraasal, mainne ek aise vyakti ka wadh kar diya tha, jiske wadh ka mujhe aadesh na tha. Mujhe apni chinta sata rahi hai. Mujhe apni chinta sata rahi hai. Mujhe apni chinta sata rahi hai. Tum kisi aur ke paas jaao. Tum eesa -alaihissalaam- ke paas jaao. Chunaanche sab log eesa -alaihissalaam- ke paas jayenge aur kahenge : Ai eesa! Aap Allah ke Rasool aur woh shabd hain, jo usne maryam -alaihissalaam- ki taraf bheja tha. Aap uski or se preshit rooh hain aur aapne god mein logon se baat ki thi. Aap hamaare liye siphaarish karen. Aap dekhen ki ham kis museebat mein hain? Eesa -alaihissalaam- kahenge ki aaj mera parvardigaar bahut gusse mein hai. Itna gussa woh na kabhi hua tha aur na kabhi mein hoga. Eesa -alaihissalaam- kisi gunaah ka zikr nahin karenge. Albatta, yeh zaroor kahenge : Mujhe apni chinta sata rahi hai. Mujhe apni chinta sata rahi hai. Mujhe apni chinta sata rahi hai. Mere alaawa kisi aur ke paas jaao. Tum log Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas jaao. Log Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas jayenge aur kahenge : Ai Muhammad! Aap Allah ke Rasool aur antim Nabi hain. Allah ne aapke agle tatha pichhle sab gunaah maaf kar diye hain. Aap Allah se hamaari siphaarish pharmayen. Kya aap nahin dekhte ki ham kaise kasht mein hain? Atah main chal paroonga aur arsh ke neeche jaakar apne sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan rab ke saamne sajde mein gir jaaoonga. Phir Allah apni prashansa tatha stuti ki aisi-aisi baaten mere dil me daal dega, jo mujhse pahle kisi ke dil mein daali nahin gai hongi. Chunaanche main usi ke anusaar Allah ki prashansa wa stuti karoonga. Phir kaha jayega : Ai Muhammad! Apna sar uthaao. Tum maango, tumhen diya jayega tatha sifaarish karo, tumhaari sifaarish grahan ki jayegi. Atah, main sar uthaaoonga aur kahoonga : Ai mere rab! Meri ummat par raham farma. Ai mere rab! Meri ummat par raham farma. Ai mere rab! Meri ummat par raham farma. Chunaanche kaha jayega : Ai Muhammad! Apni ummat ke un logon ko, jinka hisaab nahin hoga, Jannat ke dayen darvaaze se daakhil karo. Jabki we any logon ke saath, doosre darvaazon se bhi Jannat mein prawesh kar sakte hain.” phir aapne pharmaya : “Qasam hai us zaat ki jiske haath mein meri jaan hai! Jannat ke darvaazon ke do paaton ke beech ki doori makka aur himyar -ya makka aur busra- ke beech ki doori ke baraabar hai.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apne saathiyon ke saath ek nimantran mein shareek hue. Wahaan aapke saath bakri ka baazu rakha gaya. Kyonki aapko bakri ke baazu ka maans bahut pasand tha. Chunaanche aapne apne daant se ek baar use kaatkar khaya aur uske baad farmaya : Main qayaamat ke din aadam ki santaanon ka sardaar rahoonga. Aapne yeh baat Allah ke anugrah ka aabhaar vyakt karne ke liye kahi. Uske baad poochha : Kya tum jaante ho ki yeh kaise hoga? Farmaya : Qayaamat ke din sabhi log ek wishaal, sapaat bhoomi par ekatr kiye jayenge. Log is tarah ekatr honge ki ek pukaarne waala sab ko apni aawaaz suna sakega. Arthaat, koi baat kare, to sab tak aawaaz pahunch jayegi. Bhoomi itni sapaat hogi ki ek dekhne waala sab ko dekh sakega. Koi uski nazar se chhupa nahin rahega. Doosre shabdon mein kahen to koi aisi wastu nahin hogi, jo kisi ko dekhne waalon ki nazron se chhupa sake. Sooraj (ka haal yeh hoga ki) srishtiyon se ek meel nikat a jayega. Chunaanche logon ko asahneey kasht evn peera ka saamna hoga. Atah sifaarish dvaara usse chhutkaara paana chaahenge. Aise mein Allah eemaan waalon ke dilon mein yeh baat daalega ki we maanav pita aadam alaihissalaam ke paas jayen. Chunaanche log unke paas jayenge aur unki fazeelat bayaan karenge, taaki woh Allah ke yahaan unke liye sifaarish kar den. Log unse kahenge : Aap maanav pita hain. Allah ne aapko apne haath se paida kiya hai, apne farishton se sajda karaya hai, har wastu ka naam sikhaya hai aur aapke andar apni or se rooh phoonki hai. Lekin woh asmarthata vyakt kar denge aur kahenge : Mera paalanhaar aaj itna krodhit hai ki na isse pahle kabhi itna krodhit tha aur na iske baad rahega. Phir woh unse hone waale gunaah ka zikr karenge. Gunaah yeh tha ki Allah ne unhen ek per ke phal ko khaane se mana kiya tha, lekin unhonne kha liya tha. Woh kahenge : Khud mujhe hi sifaarish ki aawashyakta hai. Tum kisi aur ke paas chale jaao. Tum nooh alaihissalaam ke paas chale jaao. Chunaanche log nooh alaihissalaam ke paas jayenge aur kahenge : Aap is dhara par basne waalon ki or Allah ke bheje hue pahle Rasool hain. Allah ne aapko aabhaari bande ka naam diya hai. Lekin woh bhi asmarthata vyakt kar denge aur kahenge : Mera paalanhaar aaj itna krodhit hai ki na isse pahle kabhi itna krodhit tha aur na iske baad rahega. Daraasal unhen ek dua karne ka adhikaar diya gaya tha, jo unhonne khud apni jaati ke wiruddh kar daali thi. Atah khud unhen hi sifaarish ki zaroorat hai. Woh kahenge ki tum kisi aur ke paas chale jaao. Tum ibraaheem alaihissalaam ke paas chale jaao. Chunaanche log ibraaheem alaihissalaam ke paas jayenge aur kahenge : Aap is dhara par Allah ke mitr hain. Atah apne paalanhaar ke yahaan hamaari sifaarish kar den. Kya aap dekhte nahin ki ham kis haal mein hain? Lekin ibraaheem alaihissalaam unse kahenge : Mera paalanhaar aaj itna krodhit hai ki na isse pahle kabhi utna krodhit tha aur na iske baad rahega. Daraasal mainne teen jhooth bole the. Teen jhooth se unki muraad ek baar 'main beemaar hoon kahna', ek baar 'yeh kaam unmen se sabse bare but ne kiya hai' kahna aur ek baar shaasak ke fitne se bachne ke liye apni patni saara se yeh kahna hai ki use bata dena ki main tumhaara bhaai hoon. Sachchaai yeh hai ki ye teenon waaky saanketik shabdon mein baat karne ki shreni mein aate hain, lekin choonki we dekhne mein jhooth jaise lagte the, isliye unhonne unke dar se khud ko sifaarish karne ke yogy nahin samjha. Kyonki jo Allah ke baare mein jnaan aur uski nikatta adhik rakhta hai, woh usse darta bhi zyaada hai. Woh kah denge ki mujhe khud hi sifaarish ki zaroorat hai, isliye tum kisi aur ke paas jaao. Tum moosa alaihissalaam ke paas jaao. Chunaanche log moosa alaihissalaam ke paas jayenge aur kahenge : Ai moosa! Aap Allah ke Rasool hain. Allah ne aapko Rasool banaane ke saath baat karne ka bhi sammaan pradaan kiya hai. Atah aap apne paalanhaar ke paas hamaare liye sifaarish kar den. Kya aap dekhte nahin ki ham kis awastha mein hain? Lekin woh kahenge : Mera paalanhaar aaj itna krodhit hai ki na isse pahle kabhi utna krodhit tha aur na iske baad rahega. Daraasal mainne ek vyakti ko maar daala tha, jise maarne ka aadesh mujhe praapt nahin tha. Khud mujhe hi kisi ki sifaarish ki zaroorat hai. Tum kisi aur ke paas chale jaao. Tum eesa bin maryam ke paas chale jaao. Chunaanche log eesa alaihissalaam ke paas jayenge aur kahenge : Aap Allah ke Rasool hain, uska shabd hain, jise usne maryam ki or bheja tha aur uski or se preshit aatma hain. Aapne maan ki god hi mein logon se baat ki thi. Kya aap nahin dekhte ki ham kis awastha mein hain? Lekin woh kahenge : Mera paalanhaar aaj itna krodhit hai ki na isse pahle kabhi utna krodhit tha aur na iske baad rahega. Woh kisi gunaah ka ullekh nahin karenge. Albatta kahenge ki khud mujhe hi kisi ki sifaarish ki zaroorat hai. Tum kisi aur ke paas chale jaao. Tum Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas chale jaao. Chunaanche log Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas jayenge aur kahenge : Aap Allah ke Rasool aur antim Nabi hain. Allah ne aapke agle tatha pichhle sabhi gunaah maaf kar diye hain. Isliye apne paalanhaar ke nikat hamaari sifaarish kar deejiye. Kya aap dekhte nahin ki ham kis awastha mein hain? Chunaanche main chal paroonga, arsh ke neeche pahunchoonga aur apne paalanhaar ke saamne sajde mein gir jaaoonga. Phir Allah mujhe apni prashansa evn stuti ke aise-aise shabd sikhayega, jo mujhse pahle kisi ko nahin sikhaye gae the. Phir kaha jayega : Ai Muhammad! Aap sar uthayen. Aap maangen, aapko diya jayega. Aap sifaarish karen, aapki sifaarish qabool ki jayegi. Chunaanche main sar uthaaoonga aur kahoonga : Ai mere paalanhaar! Meri ummat! Ai mere paalanhaar! Meri ummat! Ai mere paalanhaar! Meri ummat! Chunaanche aapki sifaarish qabool kar li jayegi. Tatha aapse kaha jayega : Ai Muhammad! Aap apni ummat ke aise logon ko Jannat ke dayen dvaar se andar daakhil karen, jinhen hisaab nahin dena hai. Jabki we doosre dvaaron se bhi logon ke saath andar ja sakte hain. Phir aapne kaha : Uski qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, Jannat ke do kiwaaron ke beech utna faasla hai, jitna makka tatha yaman ke sanaa ke beech hai ya jitna makka aur shaam ke busra yaani hooraan nagar ke beech hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki winamrata ki aap nimantran sveekaar kar lete aur apne aam saathiyon ke saath khaana kha liya karte the.
Hamaare Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam duniya ke sabse fazeelat waale insaan hain.
Qaazi a़yaaz kahte hain : Kaha gaya hai : 'Saiyad' aise vyakti ko kaha jaata hai, jo apne samaaj mein pramukh sthaan rakhta ho aur log kathin samay mein uski or rukh karte hon. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam duniya wa aakhirat donon jahaanon mein logon ke saiyad (sardaar) hain, lekin aapne yahaan wishesh roop se qayaamat ke din ka zikr isliye kiya hai ki us din aapki sardaari spasht roop se nazar ayegi, sab log use sveekaar karenge aur us din sabhi log aapke jhande ke neeche honge.
Allah logon ke dilon mein antim Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki bajay pahle aadam alaihissalaam aur unke baad ke nabiyon ke paas jaane aur unse sifaarish karne ki baat daalega, taaki aapki fazeelat khulkar saamne a jaye. Sach-much aap sabse oonche pad aur sanpoorn nikatta waale insaan honge.
Jo vyakti kisi insaan se kuchh lena chaahta ho, use pahle uske achchhe gunon ka warnan karke uski prashansa karni chahiye, taaki uski ichchha poori hone ki sanbhaavna barh jaye.
Jis vyakti se kuchh maanga jaye aur woh use dene ki shakti na rakhta ho, woh uchit tareeqe se asmarthata vyakt kar de. Kisi aise vyakti ke baare mein bata dena bhi musathab hai, jiske baare mein lage ki woh de sakta hai.
Qayaamat ke din ki bhayaawah sthiti aur kathor paristhitiyon ka warnan.
Nabiyon ki winamrata ki woh apne kaamon ko yaad karenge, taaki yeh ehsaas paida ho ki woh Allah ke saamne khare hone ke yogy nahin hain.
Qayaamat ke din ki mahaan sifaarish ki pushti, jo srishtiyon ke beech nirnay ke liye ki jayegi.
Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke liye waseela tatha maqaam-e-mahmood ka saboot.
Allah ki prashansa evn stuti ki koi seema nahin hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki Allah wahaan aapke dil prashansa evn stuti ke aise-aise shabd daalega, jo aapse pahle kisi ke dil mein daale nahin gae the.
Is baat ka bayaan ki Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki ummat sabse uttam ummat hai. Jannat mein prawesh se sanbandhit use kai wishishtatayen praapt hongi. Chunaanche is ummat ke jin logon ko hisaab ke marhale se guzarna nahin hoga, we ek khaas dvaar se prawesh karenge. Jabki doosre dvaaron se bhi any logon ke saath prawesh kar sakenge.
