8346: Ibraaheem -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apne doodh peete bachche ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- tatha unki maata ko saath lekar aye aur kaaba ke paas, ek bahut bare per ke nikat ek sthaan mein chhor gae, jo zamzam ke oopar aur masjid ke sabse oonche bhaag mein tha. Us samay makka mein koi nahin rahta tha tatha paani ki vyawastha bhi nahin thi.

Abdullah bin abbaas -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain : Ibraaheem -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apne doodh peete bachche ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- tatha unki maata ko saath lekar aye aur kaaba ke paas, ek bahut bare per ke nikat ek sthaan mein chhor gae, jo zamzam ke oopar aur masjid ke sabse oonche bhaag mein tha. Us samay makka mein koi nahin rahta tha tatha paani ki vyawastha bhi nahin thi. Unhen wahaan chhorte samay chamre ki thauli mein kuchh khajoor aur ek mashak paani de gae. Jab ibraaheem -alaihissalaam- waapas jaane lage, to ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- ki maata unke peechhe-peechhe chalne lageen aur kahne lageen : Ai ibraaheem, aap hamen is ghaati mein chhorkar kahaan ja rahe hain, jahaan na koi baat karne waala hai auk na koi zaroorat ka saamaan? Unhonne yeh baat kai baar dohraai, lekin ibraaheem -alaihissalaam- ne dhyaan nahin diya. Anttah, unhonne kaha : Kya Allah ne aapko yeh aadesh diya hai? Farmayaah haan. Ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- ki maata ne kaha : Tab to phir Allah hamen vyarth nahin karega. Phir woh waapas ho gaeen. Udhar ibraaheem -alaihissalaam- chalte rahe, yahaan tak ki jab saniyya ke paas pahunche, jahaan se log unhen dekh nahin sakte the, to kaaba ki or munh karke yeh dua ki : “Ai mere rab, mainne apni kuchh santaan ko, marusthal ki ek waadi mein, tere sammaanit ghar ke paas basa diya hai, taaki woh namaz ki sthaapna karen. Atah, logon ke dilon ko unki or aakarshit kar de aur unhen jeewika pradaan kar, taaki we kritajn hon. [soora ibraaheem : 37] ismaaeelas-alaihissalaam- ki maata unko doodh pilaati raheen aur mashak ka paani peeti raheen, yahaan tak ki jab mashak ka paani samaapt ho gaya, to unko tatha unke putr ko pyaas sataane lagi. Unki aankhon ke saamne unka beta pyaas ke maare dharti mein lotne laga. Jab unse dekha na ja saka, to wahaan se chal pareen aur nikattam pahaari safa par jaakar charh gaeen tatha ghaati ki or dekhne lageen ki koi nazar to nahin a raha? Jab koi nazar nahin aya, to safa se utarkar ghaati ki or barheen. Ghaati mein pahunchkar labaada ke kinaare ko utha liya aur sanktagrast vyakti ki tarah chalte hue ghaati ko paar kar gaeen. Phir marva pahaari par aaeen aur uske oopar charhkar dekhne lageen ki kya koi nazar a raha hai? Jab koi nazar nahin aya, to unhonne aisa saat baar kiya. Ibne abbaas -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Yahi kaaran hai ki log aaj bhi in donon paariyon ke beech daur lagaate hain. Woh aage kahte hain : Jab woh antim baar marva par aaeen, to ek aawaaz sunaai di. Unhonne svayn ko khaamosh rahne kaha aur dhyaanpoorvak sunne lageen. Jab phir bhi aawaaz sunaai di, to boleen : -ai woh vyakti, jiski aawaaz main sun rahi hoon!- tumne apni suna di hai. Ab yeh bataao ki kya tum meri kuchh madad kar sakte ho? Tab unhonne dekha ki zamzam ke paas ek farishta khara hai, jo apni eri –ya kaha ki apne par- se dharti ko khod raha hai, yahaan tak paani nikal aya. Yeh dekh woh apne haathon se baandh banaakar paani ko gherne lageen aur chullu bhar-bhar mashak bharne lageen. Jab-jab woh chullu se paani leteen, paani mein aur ubaal a jaata. Ek riwayat mein hai ki woh apne haath se jitna paani leteen, utna paani aur nikal aata. Ibne abbaas –radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah “Allah ismaaeel ki maata par daya kare, yadi woh zamzam ko chhor deteen –ya yeh farmaya ki yadi woh chullu se paani na nikaalteen-, to woh ek bahte hue jalasrot ka roop dhaaran kar leta. Woh aage kahte hain : Ab unhonne zamzam ka paani piya tatha apne bachche ko doodh pilaya. Phir farishte ne unse kaha : Tum nasht ho jaane ka bhay na karo. Yahaan Allah ka ek ghar hai, jiska nirmaan is larke tatha iske pita ke dvaara hoga tatha Allah apne logon ko kabhi nasht nahin hone deta. Allah ke ghar ka sthaan teele ki tarah ooncha tha. Sailaab aata, to uske dayen-bayen se guzar jaata tha. Woh isi tarah din guzaarti raheen, yahaan tak ki jurhum qabeele athva jurhum pariwaar ke kuchh log kada naami sthaan se aate hae unke paas se guzre aur nichle makka mein utre. Is beech, unhonne ek chiriya ko aakaash mein mandraate hue dekha, to kahne lage : Nishchit roop se yeh chiriya paani ke aas-paas mandra rahi hai. Ham is waadi ko pahle se jaante hain aur yahaan paani ka naam wa nishaan nahin tha. Phir unhonne ek athva do soochna laane waalon ko bheja. Jab we wahaan pahunche, to dekha ki wahaan paani maujood hai. Atah, waapas aakar shesh logon ko bataya, to sab log chal pare. Jab we pahunche, to ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- ki maata paani ke paas theen. In logon ne kaha : Kya aap hamen apne paas thaharne ki anumti dengi? Ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- ki maata ne kaha : Tumhen yahaan rahne ki anumti hai, lekin paani par tumhaara adhikaar nahin hoga. Un logon ne kaha : Hamen yeh shart manzoor hain. Abdullah bin abbaas kahte hain ki Nabi –sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : Ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- ki maata, jo logon ka saath chaahti theen, is paristhiti se bahut prasann hueen. Is tarah, jurhum qabeele ke log wahaan rahne lage. Phir unhonne apne pariwaar ke logon ko bula bheja aur woh bhi aakar rahne lage. Yahaan tak ki kai ghar bas gae. Ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- bare hote gae aur unse arbi seekhte gae. Jab woh bare hue, to unke prem tatha prashanka ke paatr ban gae. Phir jab sayaana hue, to un logon ne apni ek mahila se unki shaadi kar di. Phir ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- ki maata ki mrityu bhi ho gai. Ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- ke wiwaah ke baad ibraaheem –alaihissalaam- apne pariwaar ke logon ko, jinhen woh chhorkar gae the, dekhne aye. Lekin ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- nahin mile. Unki patni se unke baare poochha, to usne bataya ki woh hamaare liye rozi ki talaash mein tatha ek riwayat ke anusaar hamaare liye shikaar karne gae hain. Unhonne usse unke jeewanyaapan ke baare mein tatha haalchaal poochha, to bataya ki ham bahut buri sthiti mein hain aur tanghaali tatha kathinaai ka saamna kar rahe hain. Usne unke saamne aur bhi shikayten keen. Yeh sun ibraaheem –alaihissalaam- ne kaha : Jab tumhaara pati aye, to use mera salaam kahna aur kahna ki apne darvaaze ki chaukhat badal le. Jab ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- ghar aye, to unhen kuchh alag anubhooti hui. Atah, bole : Kya tumhaare paas koi aya tha? Uttar diya : Haan, ek boorha vyakti aya tha, jo kuchh aisa aur aisa tha. Usne mujhse tumhaare baare mein poochha, to mainne bataya. Usne mujhse yeh bhi poochha ki hamaara jeewan kaisa guzar raha hai, to mainne bataya ki ham pareshaani aur kathinaai mein hain. Ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- ne kaha : Kya usne tujhe kisi cheez ki waseeyat ki hai? Usne kaha : Haan, usne aadesh diya hai ki main tujhe salaam kahoon aur yeh bhi kaha hai ki tum apne darvaaze ki chaukhat badal lo. Ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- ne kaha : Woh mere pita the aur unhonne mujhe aadesh diya hai ki main tumko alag kar doon. Atah, tum apne ghar waalon ke paas chali jaao. Is tarah, unhonne use talaaq de di aur jurhum qabeele ki ek any stri se wiwaah kar liya. Phir jab tak allah ne chaaha, ibraaheem –alaihissalaam- unse alag rahe aur uske baad dobaara aye. Lekin, phir ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- nahin mile. Atah, unki patni ke paas aye aur unke baare mein poochha, to usne kaha ki woh rozi ki talaash mein gae hain. Ibraaheem –alaihissalaam- ne poochha ki tum log kaisai ho? Tatha unke jeewanyaapan ke baare mein evn haalchaal poochha, to bataya ki ham achchhe hain tatha khushhaal jeewan guzaar rahe hain. Usne Allah ki prashansa bhi ki. Ibraaheem –alaihissalaam- ne poochha : Aaj kya khaye ho? Uttar diya : Maans. Poochha : Kya piyo ho? Uttar diya : Paani. Yeh sab sunne ke ibraahi –alaihissalaam- ne kaha : Ai Allah, tu unke maans aur paani mein barkat de. Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : Un dinon unke yahaan anaaj nahin hota tha. Yadi anaaj hota, to unke haq mein anaaj mein barkat ki bhi dua karte. Abdullah bin abbaas –radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain : Makka ke siwa jahaan bhi kewal yahi do cheezen upyog mein hongi, insaan ki tabeeyat ke anukool nahin hongi.
Ek riwayat mein hai : Ibraaheem –alaihissalaam- aye aur bole : Ismaaeel kahaan hai?. Unki patni ne kaha : Shikaar ke liye gae hain. Phir usne kaha : Kya aap hamaare yahaan utarne ka kasht nahin karenge ki kuchh kha tatha pi lete? Ibraaheem –alaihissalaam- ne kaha : Tum kya khaate aur kya peete ho? Usne kaha : Ham maans khaate hain aur paani peete hain. Farmaya : Ai Allah, inke khaane aur peene ki cheezon mein barkat de. Abul qaasim -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : Ibraaheem –alaihissalaam- ki is dua ki barkat ham aaj bhi dekh rahe hain. Ibraaheem –alaihissalaam- ne kaha : Jab tumhaara pati aye, to use salaam kahna aur mera yeh aadesh pahuncha dena ki apne ghar ki chaukhat ko baraqraar rakhe. Jab ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- aye, to poochha ki kya koi aya tha? Unki patni ne kaha : Haan, ek khoobsoorat boorhe vyakti aye the. Phir usne unki prashansa ki aur bataya ki unhonne mujhse tumhaare baare mein poochha, to mainne bata diya. Phir hamaare jeewanyaapan ke baare mein poochha, to mainne kaha ki ham log achchhe hain. Ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- ne poochha ki unhonne kisi cheez ki waseeyat bhi ki hai, to usne uttar diya : Haan, unhonne tumko salaam kaha hai aur aadesh diya hai ki apne ghar ki chaukhat ko baraqraar rakho. Ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- ne kaha : Woh mere pita the aur tum hi chaukhat ho. Unhonne mujhe aadesh diya hai ki main tumhen apne saath rakhoon. Phir Allah ne jab tak chaaha, ibraaheem –alaihissalaam- unse alag rahe. Phir uske baad aye, to ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- zamzam ke paas ek bare-se per ke neeche teer theek kar rahe the. Jab unhen dekha, to unke paas gae aur ek pita apne bete se aur ek beta apne pita se jo karta hai, wahi kiya. Phir ibraaheem –alaihissalaam- ne kaha : Ai ismaaeel, Allah ne mujhe ek kaam ka aadesh diya hai. Ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- ne kaha : Aapke rab ne aapko jo aadesh diya hai, uska paalan keejiye. Farmaya : Tumhen meri sahayta karni hogi. Kaha : Main aapki sahayta karunga. Farmayaah Allah ne mujhe yahaan ek ghar banaane ka aadesh diya hai. Phir unhonne ek oonche teele ki or ishaara kiya aur waheen ghar ki buniyaad uthaani shuru ki. Ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- patthar laane lage aur ibraaheem –alaihissalaam- nirmaan kaary mein jut gae. Jab deewaar oonchi ho gai, to yeh patthar uthaakar laye aur unke liye rakh diya aur ibraaheem –alaihissalaam- uspar khare ho gae. Ibraaheem –alaihissalaam- nirmaan ka kaam kar rahe the aur ismaaeel patthar laakar de rahe the tatha donon baap-bete yeh dua parh rahe the : “Ai hamaare rab, hamaare is kaary ko grahan kar le. Nishchay tu sunne waala jaanne waala hai.” [soora al-baqra : 127]
Ek riwayat mein haih ibraaheem –alaihissalaam-, ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- tatha unki maata ko lekar nikle. Unke saath paani ka ek mashak tha. Ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- ki maata mashak ka paani peeti, to bachche ko khoob doodh mil jaata. Jab makka pahunche, to unko ek bare per ke neeche rakhkar ibraaheem –alaihissalaam- apne pariwaar ki or waapas lautne lage. Ismaaeel (alaihissalaam- ki maata bhi peechhe-peechhe chalne lageen. Jab we kada naami sthaan tak pahunche, to unhonne peechhe se aawaaz di : Ai ibraaheem, aap hamen kiske hawaale karke ja rahe hain? Unhonne uttar diya : Allah ke. Tab unhonne kaha : Main Allah ke hawaale kiye jaane se santusht hoon. Chunaanche woh laut gaeen. Mashak ka paani peeti raheen aur bachche ko bhi khoob doodh milta raha. Yahaan tak ki jab paani samaapt ho gaya, to unhonne socha : Zara chalkar dekhna chahiye, shayad kisi ka kuchh pata chal sake. Abdullah bin abbaas –radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain : Chunaanche woh jaakar safa par charh gaeen aur der tak dekhti raheen ki shayad kisi ka kuchh pata chal sake. Lekin kisi ka kuchh pata na chal saka. Phir jab ghaati tak pahuncheen, to daurne lageen, yahaan tak ki marva par charh gaeen. Is tarah unhonne donon ke beech kai chakkar lagaye. Phir socheen ki ab chalkar dekhna chahiye ki bachche ka kya hua. Jaakar dekha, to paya ki woh usi haalat mein hai. Goya ki woh maut ki siski le raha tha. Bachche ko dekhne ke baad unke dil ko qaraar na mil saka. Isliye socha ki phir jaakar dekhna chahiye, shayad kisi ka kuchh pata chal sake. Chunaanche jaakar safa par charh gaeen aur der tak idh-udar dekhti raheen. Lekin kisi ka kuchh pata na chal saka. Yahaan tak ki safa tatha marva ke beech saat chakkar poore ho gae. Phir dil mein aya ki jaakar dekhna chahiye ki bachche ka kya hua. Itne mein, ek aawaaz sunaai di. Atah, unhonne kaha : Yadi tumhaare paas koi bhalaai hai, to hamaari sahayta karo. Phir kya dekhti hain ki jibreel khare hain. Unhonne apni eri ko dharti ko is tarah maara. Yeh kahte hue abdullah bin abbaas –radiyallahu anhu- ne apni eri ko dharti par maarkar dikhaya. Chunaanche jalasrot bah nikla, jisse ismaaeel –alaihissalaam- ki maata ghabra gaeen aur chullu bhar-bharkar paani leni lageen. ... Phir poori hadees bayaan ki.
8349: Momin ke liye Jannat ke andar ek khokhle moti se bana ek tanbu hoga, jiski oonchaai saath meel hogi. Usmen momin ki patniyaan hongi, jinke paas woh aye-jayega aur woh patniyaan ek-doosre ko dekh nahin sakengi.

Abu moosa radiyallahu anhu Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se riwayat karte hain ki aapne farmaya hai : "Momin ke liye Jannat ke andar ek khokhle moti se bana ek tanbu hoga, jiski oonchaai saath meel hogi. Usmen momin ki patniyaan hongi, jinke paas woh aye-jayega aur woh patniyaan ek-doosre ko dekh nahin sakengi."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne yahaan Jannat ki kuchh nemton ke baare mein baat ki hai. Aapne bataya hai ki Jannat ke andar momin ko ek bahut bara aur wishaal khema milega, jo andar se khaali heere se bana hoga. Aakaash mein uski lanbaai aur chauraai 60 meel hogi. Uske chaaron konon mein kuchh patniyaan hongi, jo ek-doosre ko dekh nahin payengi. Woh momin unke beech ghoomta rahega.

Jannatiyon ko milne waali bari-bari nemton ka bayaan.
Jannaton ki nemton ka ullekh karke achchhe karm ke liye prerit karna.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
8350: Beshak Jannat mein ek per hai ki ek tez raftaar ghurasvaar sau saal tak chalta rahega, lekin use paar nahin kar payega.

Abu saeed khudri -Allah unse prasann ho- se warnit hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Beshak Jannat mein ek aisa per hai ki ek tez raftaar ghurasvaar sau saal tak chalta rahega, lekin use paar nahin kar payega.” ise bukhaari tatha muुslim ne abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se bhi riwayat kiya hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallalallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Sawaar uski chhaya mein sau saal tak chalta rahega, parantu uski doori tay nahin kar payega.”
[ise donon riwayton ke saath Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8351: Jannat waale apne se oopar ke logon ko aise dekhenge, jaise tum log aakaash mein poorab ya pashchim mein chamachmaate sitaare ko dekhte ho, yeh sab shreniyon mein antar hone ke kaaran hoga.

Abu saeed khudri -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Jannat waale apne se oopar ke logon ko aise dekhenge, jaise tum log aakaash mein poorab ya pashchim mein chamachmaate sitaare ko dekhte ho. Yeh sab shreniyon mein antar hone ke kaaran hoga.” logon ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Yeh to nabiyon ke maqaam hain. Unke maqaam tak koi doosra nahin pahunch sakta. Aapne pharmaya : “Kyon nahin. Us zaat ki qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, jo log Allah par eemaan laye aur rasoolon ki pushti ki (we yaqeenan us maqaam ko haasil karenge).”
Jannatiyon ke gharon mein, unki shreshthata ki shreni ke anusaar itna antar hoga ki oonchi shreniyon waale logon ko unse neechi shreniyon waale log sitaaron ki tarah dikhaai parenge.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8352: Jannat mein ek kamaan ke baraabar sthaan, un tamaam cheezon se behtar hai, jinpar sooraj nikalta athva doobta hai.

Abu huraira -Allah unse prasann ho- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Jannat mein ek kamaan ke baraabar sthaan, un tamaam cheezon se behtar hai, jinpar sooraj nikalta athva doobta hai.”

Is hadees mein Jannat ke andar momin ko praapt hone waale wishaal pratiphal aur duniya ki tuchchhata ka ullekh hai. Jannat itna svachchh tatha sundar evn aisa hamesha rahne ka sthaan hai ki uske andar ek kamaan ke baraabar sthaan duniya ki saari nemton se uttam hai. Allah hamen Jannat mein prawesh paane ka saubhaagy praapt karne waalon mein se banaye.
8353: “Jannat mein ek baazaar hai, jahaan jannati pratyek juma ko jayenge

Anas -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : “Jannat mein ek baazaar hai, jahaan jannati pratyek juma ko jayenge, us samay uttari hawa chalegi jo unke chehron tatha kapron par dhool daal degi, jisse we aur adhik khoobsoorat evn sundar ho jayenge aur jab apne pariwaar ke paas khoobsoorat hokar lautenge, to unke pariwaar waale kahenge : Allah ki qasam, tum log to hamaare baad aur adhik khoobsoorat tatha sundar ho gae ho. Ispar we kahenge : Allah ki qasam, hamaare baad, tum bhi adhik khoobsoorat evn sundar ho gae ho.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki Jannat mein ek sthaan hai, jahaan jannati ekatr honge. Wahaan khareed-bikri nahin hogi. Wahaan se jannati jo chaahen le sakenge. Wahaan we har saat din ke samaan samay par ayenge.  Isi beech uttari hawa chalegi aur unke chehre tatha kapre ko sparsh karegi , jisse unki sundarta aur nikhar jayegi. Atah jab we is barhi hui sundarta ke saath ghar waalon ke paas jayenge, to ghar waale unse kahenge : Allah ki qasam, tum hamaare (yahaan se jaane ke baad) aur adhik sundar ho gae ho. Chunaanche we kahenge : Allah ki qasam, tum bhi hamaare (jaane ke) baad aur adhik sundar ho gae ho.

Jannat waasiyon ke saundary mein wriddhi ho jayegi.
Yeh hadeesen insaan ko prerit karti hain ki wo achchhe kaary karen, jinke maadhyam se Jannat ka haqdaar ban saken.
Yahaan uttari hawa hi zikr isliye hua hai ki uttari hawa arbon ke yahaan sarvashreshth hawa thi, jo bhalaai aur baarish laati thi.
Allah ke or bulaane ka kaam, Jannat aur uski nemton ki or prerit karke karne ka protsaahan.
8354: Jannati apne se oopar ke niwaasasthaanon ko aise dekhenge, jaise tum log aakaash mein taaron ko dekhte ho.

Sahl bin saad -Allah unse prasann ho- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Jannati apne se oopar ke niwaasasthaanon ko aise dekhenge, jaise tum log aakaash mein taaron ko dekhte ho.”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8355: Samudr ka paani svayn paak hai evn doosron  ko paak karne waala hai aur uska mara hua jaanvar halaal hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ek vyakti ne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Ham samudri yaatra par nikalte hain aur hamaare saath thora-sa paani hota hai. Usse wazu kar len, to pyaase rah jayenge. Aise me kya ham samudr ke paani se wazu kar liya karen? Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne uttar diya : "Samudr ka paani svayn paak hai evn doosron  ko paak karne waala hai aur uska mara hua jaanvar halaal hai."

Ek vyakti ne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aakar kaha : Ham shikaar, vyavsay evn is prakaar ke doosre uddeshyon ke tahat kashtiyon par sawaar hokar samudr ka safar karte hain. Hamaare paas peene ka paani bas thora-sa hota hai. Agar ham uska prayog wazu evn snaan mein karenge, to woh khatm ho jayega aur peene ka paani nahin bachega. Aise mein kya hamaare liye samudr ke paani se wazu karan jayaz hoga.?

To Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne samudr ke paani ke baare mein farmaya : Uska paani khud bhi paak hai aur uske andar doosre ko paak karne ki kshamta bhi maujood hai. Usse wazu evn snaan jayaz hain. Usse nikalne waali machhliyon aadi ka khaana bhi jayaz hai, yadyapi woh mari hui awastha mein paani ke oopar tairti hui hi kyon na paai jayen, kisi ne unka shikaar na bhi kiya ho, tab bhi koi farq nahin parta.

Samudri jaanvar mari hui awastha mein bhi jayaz hain. Yaani aise jaanvar, jo samudr hi mein rahte hain, agar uske andar mar jayen, to unhen khaana jayaz hai.
Sawaal karne waale ko uske fayde ko dekhte hue sawaal se adhik jawaab dena.
Kisi paak cheez ke milne se paani ka svaad, rang ya gandh badal jaye, to woh paak hi rahta hai, bas shart yeh hai ki paani asli haalat par baaqi rahe, yadyapi woh sakht namkeen, sakht garm ya sakht thanda hi kyon na ho jaye.
Samudr ka paani chhoti aur bari naapaakiyon ko door kar deta hai aur kisi paak wastu, jaise shareer ya kapre aadi ki gandgi ko bhi usse door kiya ja sakta hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, nasai, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
8356: Paani pawitr tatha pawitr karne waala hai. Use koi wastu apvitr nahin karti.

Abu saeed khudri -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se kaha gaya : Kya ham boozaaa naami kuen se wazu karen, jismen maahvaaाri ke kapre aur kutte ke gosht tatha sari aur badboodaar cheezen daali jaati hain? Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Paani pawitr tatha pawitr karne waala hai. Use koi wastu apvitr nahin karti.”
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8357: Jab paani do qulla (do bare-bare gharon ke baraabar) ho jaye, to woh gandgi ko prabhaawi hone nahin deta.

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se us paani ke baare mein poochha gaya, jispar chaupaye aur darinde aate-jaate rahte hon. Atah aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne uttar diya : "Jab paani do qulla (do bare-bare gharon ke baraabar) ho jaye, to woh gandgi ko prabhaawi hone nahin deta."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha gaya ki woh paani paak hai ya nahin, jispar chaupaye aur darinde paani peene aadi ke liye aate-jaate rahte hon, to aapne jawaab diya ki jab paani do bare-bare gharon ke baraabar ho jaye, jo aaj ke hisaab se 210 leetar hota hai, to woh zyaada paani hai aur woh naapaak nahin hota. Yeh aur baat hai ki koi naapaak cheez milne ke kaaran uske rang ya svaad ya gandh mein se koi wisheshta badal jaye, to naapaak ho jayega.

Koi naapaak wastu milne ke kaaran paani ke rang ya svaad ya gandh mein se koi ek wisheshta badal jaye, to woh naapaak ho jaata hai. Is hadees mein jo baat kahi hai, woh aam haalaat ko dhyaan mein rakhkar kahi gai hai, koi nishchit baat nahin.
Ulema is baat par ekmat hain ki agar koi naapaak cheez paani ko badal de, to paani naapaak ho jayega, kam ho ki zyaada.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, nasai, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
8359: Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- maimoona- radiyallahu anha- ke snaan ke shesh paani se snaan kar liya karte the
Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- maimoona -radiyallahu anha- ke snaan ke shesh paani se snaan kar liya karte the.
8360: Abdullah bin abbaas -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki ek patni ne ek bare bartan ke paani se snaan kiya aur uske baad Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- usi paani se wazu athva snaan karne ke liye aye, to unhonne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, main apvitr thi! Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Paani naapaak nahin hota."

8361: Billi apvitr nahin hai. Yeh tumhaare aap-paas ghoomne-phirne waalon tatha ghoomne-phirne waaliyon mein se hai.

Kabsha bint kaab bin maalik -jinka wiwaah abu qataada ke bete ke sa hua tha- kahti hain ki abu qataada aye, to unhonne unke liye wazu ka paani nikaalkar diya. Itne mein ek billi aai aur wahi paani peene lagi. Yeh dekh unhonne bartan ko jhuka diya, yahaan tak ki usne achchhi tarah pi liya. Kabsha kahti hain : Unhonne mujhe apni or dekhte hue dekha, to farmaya : Ai meri bhateeji! Kya tujhe ispar aashchary ho raha hai? Mainne kaha : Haan. Tab farmaya : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : “Billi apvitr nahin hai. Yeh tumhaare aap-paas ghoomne-phirne waalon tatha ghoomne-phirne waaliyon mein se hai.”
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8362: Tumhaare liye do prakaar ke murde tatha do prakaar ke rakt halaal kiye gae hain. Jahaan tak do murdon ki baat hai to woh hain : Machhli aur tirdi. Aur jahaan tak do rakt ki baat hai, to woh hain : Jigar tatha tilli.

Abdullah bin umar -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmaya : “Tumhaare liye do prakaar ke murde tatha do prakaar ke rakt halaal kiye gae hain. Jahaan tak do murdon ki baat hai to woh hain : Machhli aur tirdi. Aur jahaan tak do rakt ki baat hai, to woh hain : Jigar tatha tilli.”

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kuchh cheezon ke halaal hone se sanbandhit ek sharai hukm bayaan kiya hai. Sabse pahle bataya hai ki mari hui tiddi evn machhli ko khaana jayaz hai aur aur uske baad bataya hai ki do prakaar ke rakt halaal hain. Ek jigar aur doosri tilli. Yeh donon hukm mare hue jaanvar aur rakt ko khaane ki manaahi se apvaad hain.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8363: Jab tummen se kisi ke pey padaarth mein makkhi gir jaye, to woh use usmen dubokar nikaal le, kyonki uske ek par mein rog hai aur doosre mein shifa.

Abu huraira -Allah unse prasann ho- se marfooan riwayat hai : “Jab tummen se kisi ke pey padaarth mein makkhi gir jaye, to woh use usmen dubokar nikaal le, kyonki uske ek par mein rog hai aur doosre mein shifa.”

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki yadi kisi peene ki cheez mein makkhi gir jaye, to woh use prabhaawit nahin karti. Is samay insaan ko chahiye ki use poorn roop se duba de. Kyonki uske ek pankh mein, jise woh paani mein dubaati hai, beemaari hoti hai aur doosre mein us beemaari se shifa hoti hai.
Aaj aadhunik chikitsa wijnaan ne bhi sadiyon pahle Islam dvaara pradaan ki gai is soochna ki satyata ko spasht kar diya hai. Ham Allah ka shukr ada karte aur uski prashansa karte hain ki usne hamen itna wishaal dharm pradaan kiya.
[ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8364: Jeewit jaanvar ke jis ansh ko kaat liya jaye, woh murda hai.

Abu waaqid laisi -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- madeena aye, to us samay madeene waale oonton ki kohaanen aur bakriyon ki raanen kaat liya karte the. Atah, aapne farmaya : “Jeewit jaanvar ke jis ansh ko kaat liya jaye, woh murda hai.”
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8365: Jo vyakti sone ya chaandi ke bartan mein peeta hai woh apne pet mein Jahannam ki aag bharta hai.

Umme salma -Allah unse prasann ho- kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Jo vyakti peeta hai” aur ek riwayat mein hai : “Jo khaata ya peeta hai” sone athva chaandi ke bartan mein, woh apne pet mein Jahannam ki aag bharta hai.”

Is hadees mein us vyakti ko bari kathor chetaavni di gai hai, jo sona evn chaandi se bane hue, unki paalish kiye hue ya unse alankrit bartanon ka prayog karta ho. Ismen bataya gaya hai ki jo is gunaah mein sanlipt hoga, uske pet mein Jahannam ki yaatna utarne ki bhayaanak tatha wikat aawaaz sunaai degi. Kyonki sona evn chaandi ke bartan mein khaana evn peena kaafiron ki mushaabhat ekhtiyaar karna, abhimaan prakat karna aur nirdhan logon ka dil torna hai. Saath hi yeh ki Islam musalmaan ko naitik patan evn bhog wilaas se surakshit rakhta hai. Sona evn chaandi ke bartan ke prayog se manaahi ka ek kaaran yeh bhi hai ki yeh donon cheezen nikat samay tak mudra ke roop mein prayog mein rahti aai hain. Atah bartan ke roop mein inka prayog inke vyaapaarik chalan par kuthaaraaghaat aur maanveey aawashyaktaaon ke moolyon ko vyarth karna hai. Jabki isse koi adhik mahatv waala hit bhi poora nahin hota.
Is hadees mein aai hui khaane evn peene ke bartan ke roop mein inke prayog ki manaahi, kisi bhi laabh ke liye inke prayog ki manaahi ko sammilit hai. Is manaahi se wahi prayog baahar hoga, jiski anumti shareeyat ne di hai. Jaise stri ka aabhooshan aadi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8366: Quraish ke kuchh log Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas se guzre, jo ek bakri ko gadhe ki tarah ghaseetkar le ja rahe the. Yeh dekh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Tum uska chamra hi utaar lete.” un logon ne kaha : Yeh to mari hui hai! Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Use paani aur qaraj -naami per ke patte- shuddh kar dete hain.”

Aaliya bint subaiy kahti hain ki uhud mein meri kuchh bakriyaan theen, jo marne lageen, to main Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki patni maimoona radiyallahu anha ke paas gai aur unke saamne iska zikr kiya. Maimoona -radiyallahu anha- ne mujhse kaha : Yadi tum unke chamre utaar leti, to unse fayda utha sakti thi. Woh kahti hain ki mainne kaha : Kya yeh halaal hain? Maimoona -radiyallahu anha- ne kaha : Haan. Quraish ke kuchh log Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas se guzre, jo ek bakri ko gadhe ki tarah ghaseetkar le ja rahe the. Yeh dekh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Tum uska chamra hi utaar lete.” un logon ne kaha : Yeh to mari hui hai! Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Use paani aur qaraj -naami per ke patte- shuddh kar dete hain.”
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8367: Ham log ek saphar mein Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath the. Ham raat bhar chalte rahe, yahaan tak ki raat ka antim pahar hua, to kuchh der ke liye so gae. Waise bhi, musaaphir ke liye sone se uttam koi wastu nahin hoti. Ham soe rahe, yahaan tak ki sooraj ki garmi se hi jaage. Sabse pahle jaagne waale vyakti amuk, phir amuk, phir amuk, phir umar ban khattaab the.

Imraan bin husain -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai, unhonne farmaya ki ham log ek saphar mein Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath the. Ham raat bhar chalte rahe, yahaan tak ki raat ka antim pahar hua, to kuchh der ke liye so gae. Waise bhi, musaaphir ke liye sone se uttam koi wastu nahin hoti. Ham soe rahe, yahaan tak ki sooraj ki garmi se hi jaage. Sabse pahle jaagne waale vyakti amuk, phir amuk, phir amuk, phir umar ban khattaab the. Hamaara maamool yeh tha ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab so jaate, to aapko jagaya nahin jaata, balki aap khud hi jaagte the. Kyonki ham nahin jaante the ki aapke saath neend mein kya kuchh ghatit ho raha hai? Jab umar -radiyallahu anhu- ne jaagkar logon ki haalat dekhi, to ek nidar vyakti hone ke naate, zor-zor se takbeer kahne lage. Woh lagaataar zor-zor se ‘Allahu akbar’ kahte rahe, yahaan tak ki unki aawaaz se Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jaag gae. Aapki neend tooti, to logon ne aapse us durghatna ki shikayat ki, jo unke saath ghati thi. Unki baat sun aapne farmaya : “Kuchh harj nahin -ya kaha ki usse kuchh nuksaan na hoga-, chalo ab kooch karo.” phir log wahaan se chal diye. Thore-se safar ke baad aap utre, wazu ke liye paani mangvaya, wazu kiya, namaz ke liye azaan di gai aur uske baad aapne logon ko namaz parhaai. Jab aapki namaz poori ho gai, to ek aadmi ko logon se alag dekha, jisne ham logon ke saath namaz nahin parhi thi. Aapne usse poochha : “Ai amuk vyakti! Tujhe logon ke saath namaz parhne se kis cheez ne roka?” usne uttar diya : Main naapaak ho gaya tha aur paani bhi maujood na tha. Aapne farmaya : “Tujhe mitti se tayammum karna chahiye tha. Woh tere liye kaaphi hota.” phir Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- chale, to logon ne aapse pyaas ki shikayat ki. Atah, aap sawaari se utre aur ali -radiyallahu anhu- tatha ek any vyakti ko bulaya aur pharmaya : “Tum donon jaao aur paani talaash karo.” donon rawaana hue, to raaste mein unhen ek stri mili, jo apne oont par paani ki do mashkon ke beech baithi hui thi. Unhonne usse kaha ki paani kahaan hai? Usne jawaab diya ki paani mujhe kal isi samay mila tha aur hamaare mard peechhe hain. Un donon ne usse kaha ki tum hamaare saath chalo. Usne kaha : Kahaan jaana hai? Unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas. Woh boli : Wahi, jise adharmi kaha jaata hai? Unhonne kaha : Haan wahi, jinhen tu aisa kahti hai. Achchha ab chalo. Aakhir donon use Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas le aye aur aapko saari ghatna kah sunaai. Imraan -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain : Logon ne use oont se utaara. Phir Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek bartan mangvaya aur donon mashkon ke munh usmen khol diye. Phir oopar ka munh band karke neeche ka munh khol diya. Uske baad logon ko khabar kar di gai ki khud bhi paani piyen aur jaanavron ko bhi pilayen. To jis ne chaaha khud piya aur jisne chaaha jaanavron ko pilaya. Phir ant mein us junbi vyakti ko bulaakar ek bartan paani de diya aur farmaya ki jaao, isse snaan kar lo. Woh aurat khari-khari sab dekhti rahi ki uske paani ka prayog kin-kin kaamon mein ho raha hai? Allah ki qasam! Jab donon mashkon se paani lena band kiya gaya, to hamen aisa lag raha tha ki we us samay se kaheen adhik bhare hue hain, jab paani lena aaranbh kiya gaya tha. Phir Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya ki is aurat ke liye kuchh jama karo. Atah, logon ne khajoor, aata aur sattu aadi jama karna shuru kiya aur achchhi-khaasi khaane ki cheejen ekatr kar leen. Phir unhen ek kapre mein baandhkar, us mahila ko oont par sawaar karne ke baad, uske aage rakh diya gaya. Uske baad aapne usse kaha : “Tum jaanti ho ki hamne tumhaara paani ghatne nahin diya hai. Balki hamen to Allah ne pilaya hai.” phir woh mahila apne ghar waalon ke paas gai. Choonki woh der se pahunchi thi, isliye unhonne poochha : Ai amuk stri! Tujhe kisne rok liya tha? Usne kaha : Mere saath to ek ajeeb ghatna ghati hai. Hua yeh ki raaste mein mujhe do aadmi mile, jo mujhe us aadmi ke paas le gae, jisko adharmi kaha jaata hai. Phir usne aisa aur aisa kiya. Allah ki qasam! Jitne log is (aakaash) ke aur is (dharti) ke beech mein hain, yeh kahte sasam usne apni beech waali aur shahaadat waali ungliyon ko uthaakar aasmaan aur zameen ki aur ishaara bhi kiya, un sabmen woh ya to sabse bara jaadoogar hai ya phir Allah ka sachcha Rasool hai. Phir musalmaanon ne yeh rawaiya apnaya ki uske aas-paas ke bahudevvaadiyon, lekin jis pariwaar se uska sanbandh tha, usse chherchhaar nahin karte the. Anttah, usne ek din apni qaum se kaha : Mere khayaal mein musalmaan tumhen jaan-boojhkar chhor hain. Kya tumhaare andar Islam ki koi chaahat hai? Ispar logon ne uski baat maan li aur sab log musalmaan ho gae.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8368: Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka pyaala toot gaya, to tootne ke sthaan par chaandi ka taar laga diya.
Anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka pyaala toot gaya, to tootne ke sthaan par chaandi ka taar laga diya.
8369: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se sharaab ke baare mein poochha gaya, jise sirka bana liya jaata hai, to aapne farmaya : “ Nahin ”
Anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se sharaab ke baare mein poochha gaya, jise sirka bana liya jaata hai, to aapne farmaya : “Nahin.”
8370: Beshak Allah ne har haq waale ko uska haq de diya hai aur waaris ke liye koi waseeyat nahin hai. Bistar waale ke liye bachcha hai aur vyabhichaari ke liye patthar hai. Jo pita ko chhorkar doosre se apne ko mansoob karta hai athva mukt karne waale ko chhorkar doosre ki or nisbat karta hai, uspar Allah ki laanat hai. Allah uski na farz ibaadat grahan karega, na nafal ibaadat.

Amr bin khaarija -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apni oontni par sawaar hokar khutba diya. Us samay main uski gardan ke neeche khara tha, woh jugaali kar rahi thi tatha uski laar mere kandhon ke beech gir rahi thi. Mainne aapko farmaate hue suna : “Beshak Allah ne har haq waale ko uska haq de diya hai aur waaris ke liye koi waseeyat nahin hai. Bistar waale ke liye bachcha hai aur vyabhichaari ke liye patthar hai. Jo pita ko chhorkar doosre se apne ko mansoob karta hai athva mukt karne waale ko chhorkar doosre ki or nisbat karta hai, uspar Allah ki laanat hai. Allah uski na farz ibaadat grahan karega, na nafal ibaadat.”
