8371: Larki ka peshaab dhoya jayega aur larke ke peshaab par chheente maare jayenge.

Abu samh kahte hain ki main Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki sewa karta tha. Jab aap snaan karna chaahte, to farmaate : “Meri or apni peeth kar lo.” chunaanche main aapki or apni peeth kar leta aur aapka parda karta. Ek baar hasan athva husain -radiyallahu anhuma- ko laya gaya. Unhonne aapke seene par peshaab kar diya. Main use dhone ke liye barha, to aapne farmaya : “Larki ka peshaab dhoya jayega aur larke ke peshaab par chheente maare jayenge.”
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8372: Woh use khurchegi, phir paani se ragarkar saaf karegi, phir dhoegi aur usi mein namaz parhegi.

Asma bint abu bakr -radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki ek stri Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aai aur boli ki batayen ki yadi hammen se kisi stri ke kapre mein maahvaari ka khoon lag jaye, to woh kya kare? Aapne farmaya : “Woh use khurchegi, phir paani se ragarkar saaf karegi, phir dhoegi aur usi mein namaz parhegi.”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8373: Khoon ko dho lena hi tujhe kaafi hai aur uska nishaan tere liye haanikaarak nahin.

Abu huraira -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki khaula bint yasaar -radiyallahu anha- Nabi -sallallalaahu alaihi wasallam- ke paas aaeen aur boleen : Ai Allah ke Rasool, mere paas ek hi kapra hai aur mujhe useemen maahvaari a jaati hai. Main kya karun? Aapne farmaya : “Jab tum pawitr ho jaao, to use dho lo. Phir usmen namaz parho.” ispar unhonne kaha : Yadi khoon poori tarah na saaf ho tab? Aapne farmaya : “Khoon ko dho lena hi tujhe kaafi hai aur uska nishaan tere liye haanikaarak nahin.”
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8374: Yadi meri ummat par kathin na hota, to main unhen aadesh deta ki pratyek wazu ke samay misvaak kar liya karen.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Yadi meri ummat par kathin na hota, to main unhen aadesh deta ki pratyek wazu ke samay misvaak kar liya karen.”

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki yadi aapko is baat ka bhay na hota ki aapki ummat evn anusrankaaryon ko kasht evn pareshaani ka saamna parega, to unhen har wazu ke samay aawashyak roop se misvaak karne ka aadesh dete. Aapne apni ummat par daya karte hue unpar ise farz qaraar nahin diya, balki sunnat rakha, jiska paalan karne waale ko puny milta hai aur chhorne waale ko dand nahin di jaati hai.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise maalik ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8375: Jise khushi ho ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka wazu seekhe, to woh jaan le ki aapka wazu isi tarah ka hua karta tha.

Abde khair kahte hain ki ali -radiyallahu anhu- hamaare paas aye aur paami mangvaya, jabki woh pahle hi namaz parh chuke the. Atah, hamne kaha ki jab woh namaz parh chuke hain, to wazu ka paani kya karenge? Nishchay hi woh hamen wazu ka tareeqa sikhaana chaahte hain. Chunaanche ek bartan mein paani tatha ek tasht laya gaya. Unhonne bartan se daahine haath par paani bahaya. Phir teen baar apne donon haathon ko dhoya. Phir teen baar kulli ki aur naak jhaari. Aap kulli karte aur usi chullu se aadha paani lekar naak jhaarte. Phir teen baar apna chehra dhoya. Phir apne daahine haath ko teen baar dhoya aur bayen haath ko bhi teen baar dhoya. Phir bartan mein haath daalkar ek baar sir ka masah kiya. Phir daahine pair ko teen baar dhoya aur phir bayen pair ko teen baar dhoya. Phir uske baad farmaya : “Jise khushi ho ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka wazu seekhe, to woh jaan le ki aapka wazu isi tarah ka hua karta tha.”
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8377: Jab tummen se koi neend se jaage, to teen baar apni naak mein paani daalkar jhaar le, kyonki shaitaan uski naak ke andar raat guzaarta hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jab tummen se koi neend se jaage, to teen baar apni naak mein paani daalkar jhaar le, kyonki shaitaan uski naak ke andar raat guzaarta hai."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- is baat ke liye prerit kar rahe hain ki jab koi vyakti neend se jaage, to teen baar naak mein paani daalkar jhaar le. Is hadees mein aye hue shabd "Al-istinsaar" Ka arth hai naak mein paani daalkar jhaarna. Yeh aadesh isliye diya gaya hai ki shaitaan insaan ki naak ke andar raat guzaarta hai.

Neend se jaagne waale har vyakti ke liye shaitaan ke prabhaav ko khatm karne ke liye naak jhaarne ka aadesh diya gaya hai. Agar wazu ka iraada ho, to naak jhaarne ki taakeed aur barh jaati hai.
Naak jhaarne se naak mein paani daalne ka fayda poore taur par haasil hota hai. Kyonki naak mein paani charhaane se naak ke androoni hisse ki safaai hoti hai aur naak jhaarne se andar ki gandgi paani ke saath baahar a jaati hai.
Is hadees mein jo baat kahi gai hai, woh raat mein sone ke saath khaas hai. Kyonki ismen aye hue shabd "Yabeetu" Ka prayog raat mein sone ke liye hi kiya jaata hai. Aur isliye bhi ki aam taur par raat ki neend lambi aur gahri hoti hai.
Yeh hadees is baat ki daleel hai ki shaitaan insaan ke saath rahta hai aur insaan ko iska ehsaas nahin hota.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
8378: Wazu sampoorn roop se karo aur ungliyon ke beech khilaal karo tatha yadi roze se na ho to naak mein paani daalkar achchhi tarah se naak jhaaro.

Laqeet bin sabira -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki main banu munatfiq ke pratinidhi ke roop –athva banu munatfiq ke pratinidhindal mein shaamil hokar- Allah Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aya tha. Unka bayaan hai ki jab ham Allah ke raslu -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke yahaan aye, to hamne aapko ghar mein nahin paya. Hamen mominon ki maata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- mileen. Woh kahte hain ki unhonne hamaare liye khazeera naami khaane ki wastu banaane ka aadesh diya, jo banaya gaya. Hamaare saamne ek thaali khajoor bhi laai gai. (Qutaiba ne khajoor ki thaali laane ki baat nahin kahi hai.) phir Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka aagman hua, to farmaya : “Kya tumhen kuchh mila hai? -athva tumhaare liye kisi cheez ka aadesh diya gaya hai?-” hamne kaha : Haan, ai Allah ke Rasool!
Woh kahte hain : Ham log Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath baithe hi hue the ki ek charvaaha apni bakriyon ko lekar baara ki taraf nikla. Uske saath ek chhota bachcha bhi tha, jo mimiya raha tha. Aapne usse poochha : “Ai amuk, kya paida hua hai?” usne uttar diya : Maada. Aapne kaha : Uski jagah par hamaare liye ek bakri zabah kar do.” phir farmaya : “Tum yeh na samjho ki hamne tumhaare kaaran zabah kiya hai, balki hamaare paas sau bakiryaan hain aur ham nahin chaahte ki usse zyaada hon, isliye jab koi bachcha paida hota hai, to ham uski jagah ek bakri zabah kar dete hain.
Woh kahte hain ki mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, meri patni badzubaan hai. To aapne kaha : “Use talaaq de do.” wahte hain ki mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, woh mere paas bahut dinon se hai aur usse mujhe bachche bhi hain? To farmaya : “Use samjhaao. Yadi usmen koi bhalaai hai, to samjhaane se sudhar jayegi. Dekha, apni patni ko us tarah na maarna, jis tarah daasi ko maarte ho.”
Mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, mujhe wazu ke baare mein bataaeeye. To farmaya : “Wazu sampoorn roop se karo aur ungliyon ke beech khilaal karo tatha yadi roze se na ho to naak mein paani daalkar achchhi tarah se naak jhaaro.”

[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8379: Mainne ammaar bin yaasir ko daarhi ka khilaal karte dekha to unse kaha gaya, athva yeh kaha ki mainne unse kaha : Kya aap daarhi ka khilaal karte hain? Unhonne kaha : “Kyon na karoon? Beshak mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko apni daarhi ka khilaal karte hue dekha hai.”

Hassaan bin bilaal kahte hain : Mainne ammaar bin yaasir ko daarhi ka khilaal karte dekha to unse kaha gaya, athva yeh kaha ki mainne unse kaha : Kya aap daarhi ka khilaal karte hain? Unhonne kaha : “Kyon na karoon? Beshak mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko apni daarhi ka khilaal karte hue dekha hai.”
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8381: Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne wazu kiya, to kulli ki, phir naak mein paani daalkar naak jhaara, phir teen baar chehre ko dhoya, daahine tatha bayen haath ko teen-teen baar dhoya, apne sir ka masah haath ke bache hue paani se nahin balki nae paani se kiya aur donon pairon ko saaf karke dhoya.

Abdullah bin zaid- radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko wazu karte hue dekha. Aapne kulli ki, phir naak mein paani daalkar naak jhaara, phir teen baar chehre ko dhoya, daahine tatha bayen haath ko teen-teen baar dhoya, apne sir ka masah haath ke bache hue paani se nahin balki nae paani se kiya aur donon pairon ko saaf karke dhoya.

Is hadees mein abdullah bin zaid -radiyallahu anhu- ne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke wazu ka tareeqa bayaan karte hue kaha hai ki aapne wazu kiya, to munh mein paani daala, phir use andar ghumaya aur uske baad kulli karke phenk diya. Phir naak mein paani daala aur baahar nikaal diya. Phir teen baar chehre ko dhoya. Phir teen baar dayen haath ko kohni tak dhoya. Phir teen baar bayen haath ko kohni tak dhoya. Phir nae paani se sar ka masah kiya aur phir donon pairon ko takhnon tak is tarah dhoya ki unmen lagi gandgiyaan saaf ho gaeen.
8382: Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne wazu karte samay apni peshaani, pagri tatha moze par masah kiya.
Mugheera bin shoba -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne wazu karte samay apni peshaani, pagri tatha moze par masah kiya.

Is hadees mein mugheera bin shoba -radiyallahu anhu- bayaan kar rahe hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apni peshaaneeा, yaani sar ke agle bhaag ke baalon ka masah kiya aur phir pagri par masah karte hue masah ko sanpoorn roop diya. Aapne sar ke kuchh bhaag ka masah karne par bas karne ke bajay pagri par masah kar sanpoorn roop se masah kiya. Aap mozon par bhi masah kiya karte the, jiska ullekh is hadees ke saath-saath any hadeeson mein bhi hai.
8384: Jiska wazu nahin, uski namaz nahin aur jisne wazu karne se pahle Allah ka naam nahin liya, uska wazu nahin.

Abu huraira -Allah unse prasann ho- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Jiska wazu nahin, uski namaz nahin aur jisne wazu karne se pahle Allah ka naam nahin liya, uska wazu nahin.”

Is hadees mein abu huraira - radiyallahu anhu - Allah ke Rasool - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam - ke hawaale se bata rahe hain ki aapne us vyakti ki namaz sahi na hone ki baat kahi hai, jisne wuzu nahin kiya aur isi tarah us vyakti ka wuzu sahi na hone ki baat kahi hai, jisne wuzu se pahle bismillah nahin kaha. Is tarah yeh hadees is baat ka spasht pramaan hai ki wuzu karte samay Allah ka naam lena zaroori hai. Jisne jaan-boojhkar bismillah chhor diya, to uska wuzu nahin hoga. Lekin yadi koi wuzu karte samay Allah ka naam lena bhool gaya ya sharai aadesh se anjaan hone ke kaaran Allah ka naam nahin liya, to uska wuzu sahi hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8386: Ek aadmi ne wazu kiya aur pair mein naakhoon ke baraabar jagah sookhi chhor di. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne use dekha, to farmaya : “Jaao aur achchhi tarah wazu kar lo.” atah, woh waapas gaya aur phir usne baad mein namaz parhi.

Jaabir radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki mujhe umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhu ne bataya hai : Ek aadmi ne wazu kiya aur pair mein naakhoon ke baraabar jagah sookhi chhor di. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne use dekha, to farmaya : “Jaao aur achchhi tarah wazu kar lo.” atah, woh waapas gaya aur phir usne baad mein namaz parhi.

Umar radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne dekha ki ek vyakti poora wazu kar chuka hai, lekin uske qadam par ek naakhoon ke baraabar jagah sookhi rah gai hai, jahaan wazu ka paani pahuncha nahin hai. Atah aapne wazu mein rah jaane waali kami ki or ishaara karte hue usse kaha ki waapas jaao, achchhi tarah aur sanpoorn roop se wazu karo aur wazu ke saare angon tak paani pahunchaao. To woh vyakti waapas gaya, sanpoorn roop se wazu kiya aur uske baad namaz parhi.

Aage barhkar achchhe kaam ka aadesh dene aur ajnaan evn nishchet vyakti ka maargadarshan karne ki aawashyakta. Khaas taur se us samay, jab ghalat kaam aisa ho ki insaan ki ibaadat ko nasht kar de.
Wazu ke angon ko poora-poora dhona zaroori hai. Jisne kisi ang ke thore-se bhaag ko bhi sookha rakh diya, uska wazu nahin hoga. Is awastha mein zyaada samay beet jaane par phir se wazu karna parega.
Wazu achchhi tarah karna chahiye. Yaani wazu ke angon ko sanpoorn roop se usi tarah dhona chahiye, jis tarah shareeyat ne aadesh diya hai.
Donon qadam bhi wazu ke ang hain. Inka masah kaafi nahin hai. Dhona zaroori hai.
Wazu ke angon ko lagaataar dhona zaroori hai. Har ang ko usse pahle waale ang ke sookhne se pahle dho liya jaye.
Ajnaanta evn bhool jaane ke kaaran kisi kaam ki aniwaaryata khatm nahin ho jaati. Itna zaroor hai ki gunaah nahin hota. Aap dekh sakte hain ki ajnaanta ke kaaran qadam ke ek bhaag ko sookha chhor dene waale is vyakti ke wazu ki aniwaaryata aap ne khatm nahin ki, balki dobaara wazu karne ka aadesh diya.
8387: “Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ek saa se paanch mud tak paani se snaan karte aur ek mud paani se wazu karte the.”
Anas radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : “Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ek saa se paanch mud tak paani se snaan karte aur ek mud paani se wazu karte the.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam janaabat ka snaan ek saa se paanch mud aur wazu ek mud paani se kar liya karte the. Saa chaar mud ka hota hai aur mud ek madhyam shareer waale insaan ki donon hatheliyon bhar ka hota hai.

Yeh hadees wazu tatha snaan karte samay paani bachaane aur zaroorat se adhik paani kharch karne se mana karti hai, chaahe paani uplabdh hi kyon na ho.
Wazu aur snaan karte samay aawashyakta anusaar aur kam se kam paani ka prayog karna musathab hai, aur yahi Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka tareeqa hai.
Is hadees ka uddeshy wazu aur snaan ki sunnaton tatha aadaab ka khyaal rakhte hue, paani ke istemaal mein fuzoolkharchi aur kanjoosi kiye bina, samay aur paani ki uplabdhata evn anuplabdhata ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue, wazu evn snaan karne ke kaary sanpoorn roop se sanpann karaana hai.
Arbi shabd janaabat ka prayog har us vyakti ke liye hota hai, jisne weery skhalan ya sanbhog kiya ho. Janaabat ko janaabat isliye kaha jaata hai ki is awastha mein insaan paak ho jaane tak namaz aur ibaadton se door rahta hai.
Sa ek prasiddh maapak paatr hai. Yahaan muraad sa-e-nabvi hai, jiska wazan utkrisht prakaar ke gehoon ka 480 misqaal aur leetar mein teen leetar hai.
Mud ek sharai maap ekaai hai. Isse muraad ek saamaany shareer waale insaan ki donon hatheliyon bhar cheez hai, jab unko poora phailaakar bhara jaye. Mud ek chauthaai saaa् hai, ispar saare faqeeh ekmat hain. Iski maatra 750 mileeleetar hoti hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
8388: “Jo musalmaan achchhi tarah wazu karta hai, phir khare hokar man tatha tan ke saath do rakaat namaz parhta hai, uske liye Jannat aniwaary ho jaati hai.”

Uqba bin aamir radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki hamaare zimme oont charaane ka kaam tha. Jab meri baari aai aur main shaam ko unhen waapas le aya, to dekha ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam khare hokar logon ko hadees suna rahe hain. Mainne suna, aap farma rahe the : “Jo musalmaan achchhi tarah wazu karta hai, phir khare hokar man tatha tan ke saath do rakaat namaz parhta hai, uske liye Jannat aniwaary ho jaati hai.” woh kahte hain ki mainne kaha : Kitni achchhi baaten hain. Yeh sunkar ek vyakti mere saamne se kahta hai : Isse pahle ki baaten isse bhi achchhi theen. Mainne dekha, to woh umar radiyallahu anhu the. Unhonne kaha : Mainne dekha hai ki tum abhi-abhi aye ho. Aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne -isse pahle- farmaya tha : “Tummen se jo bhi sampoorn tareeqe se wazu karta hai aur phir kahta hai : " أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُ اللهِ وَرَسُولُهُ" (Main is baat ki gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin aur Muhammad Allah ke bande tatha Rasool hain) uske liye Jannat ke aathon darvaaze khol diye jayenge. Woh jisse chaahega, prawesh karega.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne logon se baat karte hue do bari fazeelten bayaan ki hain :

1- jisne sunnat ke anusaar sanpoorn roop se wazu kiya aur har ang tak poore taur par paani pahunchaya, phir yeh dua parhi jiska arth hai : "Is baat ki gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad Allah ke bande aur Rasool hain, uske liye Jannat ke aathon dvaar khol diye jaate hain. Jis dvaar se chaahe, andar daakhil ho jaye."

2- jisne is tarah sanpoorn wazu kiya aur uske baad do rakaat namaz poori tawajjo, wishuddhata evn winamrata ke saath parhi aur apne shareer ke saare angon ko Allah ke saamne jhukaya, uske liye Jannat waajib ho jayegi.

Allah ka mahaan anugrah evn kripa ki woh thore amal ka bhi bara badla pradaan karta hai.
Achchhi tarah aur sanpoorn roop se wazu karne aur uske baad winamrata ke saath do rakaat namaz parhne ki prerna aur uske nateeje mein milne waale bare pratiphal ka bayaan.
Achchhi tarah wazu karna aur uske baad is zikr ko parhna, Jannat mein prawesh paane ka sabab hai.
Snaan karte samay bhi yeh zikr musathab hai.
Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke sahaaba  (saathi) bhalaai, jaise jnaan seekhne, use phailaane, is sanbandh mein tatha aajeewika se sannbandhit kaamon mein ek-doosre ka sahyog karne ke ichchhuk hua karte the.
Jis prakaar wazu se badan ki safaai hoti hai aur uski gandgiyaan door hoti hain, usi tarah wazu ke baad zikr se antraatma ki safaai hoti hai aur antraatma se shirk ki gandgi door hoti hai.
8390: Mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko moze ke oopri bhaag ka masah karte hue dekha hai.

Abd-e-khair, ali -radiyallahu anhu- se warnan karte hain ki unhonne kaha : Yadi dharm ka aadhaar ray hota, to moze ke oopri bhaag ke bajay nichle bhaga ka masah karna adhik uchit hota. Haalaanki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko moze ke oopri bhaag ka masah karte hue dekha hai.”

Ali -radiyallahu anhu- bata rahe hain ki yadi dharm ka aadhaar Allah ki waani evn uske Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki sunnat ke bajay aql hota, to moze ke oopri bhaag ke bajay nichle bhaag ka masah karna adhik uchit hota. Kyonki uske nichle bhaag ka sanpark dharti se rahta hai aur usmen gandgiyaan evn dhool-mitti aadi lagti hain. Atah wiwek yahi kahta hai ki masah usi ka hona chahiye. Lekin shareeyat ka aadesh isse bhinn hai. Atah amal usi par karna hai aur sunnat ke wipreet ray ko chhor dena hai. Ali -radiyallahu anhu- ne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko moze ke oopri bhaag ka masah karte dekha hai aur Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka amal ek any drishtikon se aql ke anuroop bhi hai. Kyonki paani se nichle bhaag ka masah usse najaasat ke chipakne ka sabab banega. Atah oopri bhaag ke masah ka aadesh diya gaya, taaki usse lagi hui dhool saaf ho jaye. Kyonki nazar to oopri bhaag hi aata hai. Atah masah bhi usi ka hona chahiye. Yaad rahe ki sharai aadesh evn nirdesh, saare ke saare, svasth wiwek ke anuroop hain. Lekin kabhi-kabhi yeh baat kuchh logon ki pahunch se baahar rah jaati hai.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8391: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek sena bheji, jinhen thandi lag gai. Jab we waapas aye, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unhen pagriyon tatha mozon par masah karne ka aadesh diya.

Saubaan -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain : “Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek sena bheji, jinhen thandi lag gai. Jab we waapas aye, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unhen pagriyon tatha mozon par masah karne ka aadesh diya.”
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8394: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke sahaaba aapke zamaane mein isha ki namaz ki prateeksha karte rahte the, yahaan tak ki unke sir neend ke kaaran jhukne lagte the, phir namaz parhte aur dobaara waju nahin karte the

Anas bin maalik( radiyallahu anhu) farmaate hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke sahaaba aapke zamaane mein isha ki namaz ki prateeksha karte rahte the, yahaan tak ki unke sir neend ke kaaran jhukne lagte the, phir namaz parhte aur dobaara waju nahin karte the.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8395: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apni kisi patni ka chunban liya, phir namaz ke liye gae aur wazu nahin kiya

Urva bin zubair, aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se marphooan riwayat karte hain ki : Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apni kisi patni ka chunban liya, phir namaz ke liye gae aur wazu nahin kiya. Urva kahte hain ki mainne (aaisha radiyallahu anha se) kaha: Woh aap hi hongi? To woh hans pareen.

Is hadees mein aaisha -radiyallahu anha- bataati hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apni kisi patni ka chunban liya aur phir wazu kiye bina hi namaz ke liye chal pare.
Is hadees ko aaisha -radiyallahu anha- se warnan karne waale warnankarta urva ko is baat ka andaaza ho gaya ki is hadees mein jis patni ka naam aspasht rakha gaya hai, woh svayn aaisha -radiyallahu anha- hi hain.
Atah, jab unhonne aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ko apne is anumaan ke baare mein bataya, to unhonne unke anumaan ki pushti ke roop mein hans diya.
"Aur wazu nahin kiya." Asal yahi hai ki pati ke patni ko chhoone ya uska chunban lene se wazu nahin tootta. Chaahe aisa kaam-waasna ke saath kiya jaye ya bina kaam waasna ke. Kyonki asal, wazu evn tahaarat ka surakshit rahna hai. Atah kisi bhi cheez se wazu tootne ki baat kahne ke liye aisi daleel chahiye, jiske muqaable mein any koi daleel na ho. Ab, choonki stri ko chhoone se wazu tootne ka koi wishvast pramaan nahin hai, isliye tahaarat baaki rahegi. Rahi baat Allah ke farmaan "أو لامستم النساء" Ki, to sahi baat yeh hai ki isse muraad sanbhog hai. Yahi haal iski ek any pathan-shaili "أو لمستم النساء" Ka bhi hai. Isse muraad bhi sanbhog hi hai. Yeh baat abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- aur widvaanon ke ek samooh ne kahi hai.
Choonki aam taur par aadmi apni patni ka chunban kaam-waasna ke saath hi leta hai, atah yeh is baat ka pramaan hai ki kaam-waasna ke saath patni ko sparsh karne se wazu nahin tootta hai, haan, yadi isse weery-skhalan ho jaye, to weery-skhalan ke kaaran wazu toot jayega.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8396: Woh to usi ka ek tukra hai

Talq bin ali (radiyallahu anha) kahte hain ki ham log Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aye, to ek dehaati vyakti aya aur kahne laga: Ai Allah ke Nabi! Us vyakti ke prati aapka kya aadesh hai jo wazu ke pashchaat apne guptaang ko chhu leta hai? Aapne farmaya: Woh to usi ka ek tukra hai. Ya yeh farmaya: Uska ek ang hai.

"Us vyakti ke baare mein aapka kya aadesh hai, jo wazu ke pashchaat apne ling ko chhu leta hai?" Yaani yadi koi vyakti wazu ke baad apne ling ko chhu leta hai, to uske baare mein shareeyat ka kya nirdesh hai? Kya use wazu karna hai?
Jabki musnad-e-ahmad ki ek riwayat mein hai : "Ek vyakti namaz ki awastha mein apne ling ko chhu leta hai, to kya use wazu karna hai? Aapne uttar diya : Nahin! Woh to tumhaare shareer hi ka ek ang hai."
Aapne farmaya : "Woh to usi ka ek tukra hai. Ya yeh farmaya: Usi ka ek ang hai." Yaani ling bhi shareer ke any angon ke samaan ek ang hai. Atah jab kisi wazu kiye hue vyakti ke apne haath, paanv, naak ya sar ko chhoone se wazu nahin tootta, to ling ke chhoone se bhi nahin tootega.
Yaad rahe hadees ya to nirast ho gai hai ya phir isse muraad is tarah ling ko chhoona hai ki beech mein koi wastu ho. Rahi baat bina kisi rukaawat ke haath se chhoone ki, to usse wazu toot jaata hai, jaisa ki any hadeeson mein iska spasht ullekh hai.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8397: Jo apne ling ko chhooe, woh wazu kare

Urva kahte hain ki main marvaan bin hakam ke paas gaya aur wazu kin wastuon ke kaaran kiya jaata hai, iska warnan kiya. Marvaan ne kaha: Jisne apna ling chhu liya ho - uske baare mein kya aadesh hai? Urva ne kaha: Mujhe iska jnaan nahin hai. Tab marvaan ne kaha: Mujhe busra putri safvaan ne bataya ki usne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue suna: Jo apne ling ko chhooe, woh wazu kare.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8399: Usne poochha: Kya main bakriyon ke baare mein namaz parhoon? Aapne farmaya: Haan. Usne poochha: Kya main oonton ke rahne ki jahag mein namaz parhoon? Aapne farmaya: Nahin.

Jaabir bin samur (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ek vyakti ne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se poochha: Kya main bakri ka maans khaane par wazu karun? Aapne farmaya: Yadi tum chaaho to wazu karo aur yadi na chaaho to na karo. Usne poochha: Kya main oont ka maans khaane par wazu karoon? Aapne farmaya: Haan, oont ka maans khaane ke par wazu karo. Usne phir poochha: Kya main bakriyon ke baare mein namaz parhoon? Aapne farmaya: Haan. Usne poochha: Kya main oonton ke rahne ki jagah mein namaz parhoon? Aapne farmaya: Nahin.
8400: Jo mrit vyakti ko snaan karaye woh svayn bhi snaan kare aur jo use uthaakar le jaye woh wazu kare

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Jo mrit vyakti ko snaan karaye, woh svayn bhi snaan kare aur jo use uthaakar le jaye woh wazu kare.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8401: Us patr mein, jo Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne amr bin hazm ko likha tha, yeh bhi tha : Qur'an ko pawitr vyakti hi chhooe
Abdullah bin abu bakr bin hazm kahte hain ki us patr mein jo Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne amr bin hazm ko likha tha, yeh bhi likha tha: Qur'an ko pawitr vyakti hi chhooe.
[ise maalik ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8402: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam sabhi haalton mein Allah ka zikr (gungaan) kiya karte the.
Aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam sabhi haalton mein Allah ka zikr (gungaan) kiya karte the.

Mominon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha kahti hain ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke zikr ke prati bahut zyaada utsuk raha karte the. Aap har samay, har sthaan aur har haalat mein Allah ka zikr kiya karte the.

Allah ke zikr ke liye chhoti aur bari naapaaki se paak hona shart nahin hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam paabandi se Allah ka zikr kiya karte the.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke padchihnon par chalte hue sabhi awasthaaon mein adhik se adhik Allah ka zikr karne ki prerna, un haalton ko chhorkar jin haalton mein  zikr karna mana hai. Jaise shauch karne ki haalat.
8407: Beshak mere haathon mootah ki jang mein nau talvaaren tooti hain, mere haath mein kewal ek yamni talvaar rah gai thi
Abu sulaimaan khaalid bin waleed (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain: Beshak mere haathon mootah ki jang mein nau talvaaren tooti hain. Mere haath mein kewal ek yamni talvaar rah gai thi.
8408: Bukhaar Jahannam ki bhaap se aata hai, atah use paani se thanda karo
Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Bukhaar Jahannam ki bhaap se aata hai, atah tum use paani se thanda karo.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8409: Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ka abdullah bin zubair (radiyallahu anhuma) se baat na karne tatha mannat maanne ka qissa

Auf bin maalik athva ibne haaris bin tufail kahte hain ki aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ko bataya gaya ki abdullah bin zubair (radiyallahu anhuma) kray- wikray athva tohfa, jo aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne diya tha, uske prati kaha hai: Allah ki qasam! Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) khud ruk jayen warna main unhen aisa karne se rok doonga. Is par aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne farmaya: Kya yeh baat usne kahi hai? Logon ne kaha: Haan. Aapne farmaya: Main Allah ke liye mannat maanti hoon ki zubair ke putr se kadaapi baat nahin karoongi aur na main qasam toroongi. Jab baat na karne ki avdhi lanbi ho gai to ibne zubair ne siphaarish ka raasta apnaya. Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne farmaya: Nahin, Allah ki qasam! Main kisi ki sifaarish sveekaar nahin karoongi aur mannat mein haanis (qasam bhang karna) nahin banoongi. Tab ibne zubair ne misvar bin makhrima aur abdurrahmaan bin asvad bin abde yagoos se baat ki aur kaha: Main tum donon ko Allah ki qasam dilaata hoon ki tum donon mujhe aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ke paas prawesh karaao. Unke liye mujh se rishta torne ki mannat jayaz nahin hai. Misvar bin makhrima aur abdurrahmaan donon chale aur aaisha se anumti maangi aur kaha: Assalaamu alaikum wa rahamtullahi wa barkaatuhu, kya ham andar a sakte hain? Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne farmaya: Prawesh karo. To unhonne kaha: Ham sab? Unhonne farmaya: Haan, tum sab aur unhen maaloom nahin tha ki unke saath zubair ka putr bhi hai . Jab daakhil hue, ibne zubair bhi daakhil ho gae aur aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ke gale lag gae aur ro ro kar Allah ki qasam khaane lage aur misvar tatha abdurrahmaan bhi Allah ki qasam dekar baat karne ki maang karne lage ki us se baat karen aur baat sun len aur kah rahe the ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne, jaisa ki aap ko jnaan hai ki baat- cheet band karne se mana kiya hai aur yeh ki Muslim ke liye jayaz nahin ki apne bhaai ko teen din se adhik chhore rakhe. Jab yeh log zyaada hi aagrah karne lage to woh bhi unhen naseehat karne lageen aur rone lageen aur kahne lageen: Mainne mannat maani hai aur mannat bhi kathor hai. Lekin donon aagrah karte rahe yahaan tak ki ibne zubair se baat ki aur mannat ke kaaran chaalees daas mukt kiye. Is ke pashchaat jab bhi is ghatna ko aaisha (radiyallahu anha) yaad kiya karti theen to roti theen, yahaan tak ki aansu se aapka dupatta bheeg jaya karta tha.
8410: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) uhad ke shaheedon ke paas gae aur aath saal pashchaat unke liye dua ki, jaise jeewit tatha mrit ko wida kar rahe hain aur unse widaai le rahe hain

Uqba bin aamir (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) uhad ke shaheedon ki qabron ke paas gae aur aath saal pashchaat unke liye dua ki, jaise jeewit tatha mrit ko wida kar rahe hain, phir menbar par charhe aur farmaya: Beshak main tum se poorv hi jaane waala hoon aur tumhaare prati saakshi hoon aur tumse hauz par bhent hogi aur beshak main isi sthaan se use dekh raha hoon. Suno, tumhaare prati mujhe is baat ka bhay nahin hai ki tum shirk karoge lekin mujhe is baat ka bhay hai ki tum duniya haasil karne ke liye ek doosre se muqaabla karoge. Kahte hain ki yahi Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saakshaat darshan the jab mainne aapko sanyan dekha tha. Ek riwayat mein hai: Lekin mujhe is baat ka bhay hai ki duniya paane ke liye ek doosre se muqaabla karoge aur aapas mein laroge aur tum bhi purkhon ki tarah halaak ho jaaoge. Uqba kahte hain ki isi baar mainne Allah ke Rasool (salllahu alaihi wa sallam) ko antim baar minbar par dekha tha. Ek aur riwayat mein hai : Beshak main tum se pahle hi jaane waala hoon aur tumhaare prati gawaah hoon aur qasam Allah ki! Main is samay mere hauz ko dekh raha hoon. Mujhe dharti ke khazaane ki kunji di gai hai. Tumhaare prati mujhe is baat ka bhay nahin hai ki tum shirk karoge, lekin mujhe is baat ka bhay awashy hai ki duniya paane ke liye tum aapas mein sparddha karoge.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8411: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen soochit kiya hai ki kya ho chuka hai aur kya hoga. Ab hammen adhik jaankaar hai jo un baaton ko sabse adhik yaad rakhta hai

Abu zaid amr bin akhtab ansaari (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen fajr ki namaz parhaai aur minbar par charh kar pravchan dene lage, yahaan tak ki zuhar ka samay ho gaya to utre aur namaz parhi, phir minbar par charhe aur updesh dete rahe yahaan tak ki asr ka samay ho gaya, tab aap utre aur namaz parhi, phir minbar par charhe aur updesh dete rahe yahaan tak ki soory ast ho gaya. Aapne hamen un prawachnon mein bataya ki kya hua aur kya hone waala hai. Ab ham mein sabse jnaani woh hai jo sabse adhik yaad rakhne waala hai.
8412: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne chhipakli ko maarne ka aadesh diya aur farmaya: Yeh ibraaheem (alaihissalaam) par phoonk maarti thi
Umme shareek (radiyallahu anha) farmaati hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne chhipakli ko maarne ka aadesh diya aur farmaya: Yeh ibraaheem (alaihissalaam) par phoonk maarti thi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8413: Jisne pahle hi waar mein kisi chhipakli ko maara, uske liye sau neki likh di jayegi aur doosre waar mein maarne par us se kam aur teesre waar mein maarne par usse bhi kam

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Jisne pahle hi waar mein kisi chhipakli ko maara, use itni neki milegi aur jisne doosre waar mein maara use itni neki milegi aur jisne teesre waar mein maara, use itni neki milegi. Ek riwayat mein hai: Jisne pahli waar mein chhipakli ko maar diya, uske liye sau neki likh di jayegi aur doosre waar mein maarne par us se kam aur teesre waar mein maarne par us se bhi kam.
8414: Ek vyakti ne kaha ki main sadqa karoonga, atah woh sadka lekar nikla aur use ek chor ko thama diya, to log kahne lage: Chor ko sadqa diya gaya hai

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Ek vyakti ne kaha ki main sadqa karunga, atah woh sadka lekar nikla aur use ek chor ko thama diya, to log kahne lage: Chor ko sadqa diya hai. Is par usne kaha: Ai Allah! Saari prashansa tere liye hai. Main aaj phir sadqa doonga. Phir woh apna sadqa lekar nikla to ab anjaane mein ek badkaar aurat ko de diya. Subah ke samay log phir baaten banaane lage ki guzri hui raat ek badkaar aurat ko khairaat de di gai, jis par us aadmi ne kaha: Ai mere Allah! Sab taareeph tere hi liye hai. Mera sadqa to badkaar aurat ke haath lag gaya. Achchha, main kuchh aur sadqa doonga. Woh ek baar phir sadqa lekar nikla to is baar (anjaane mein) ek dhani ke haath par rakh diya. Subah ke samay logon mein phir charcha hui ki ek ameer aadmi ko sadqa diya gaya hai. Us aadmi ne kaha: Ai mere upaasy! Taareeph sirph tere liye hai. Mera sadqa ek baar chor ko mila, phir ek vyabhichaarrini ko aur phir ek maaldaar aadmi ko chala gaya. Aakhir baat kya hai? Isliye use (sapne mein) koi aadmi mila. Usne bataya ki tumhaara sadqa qubool ho gaya hai. Jo sadqa chor ko mila to mumkin hai ki woh chori se ruk jaye, isi tarah badkaar aurat ko jo sadqa mila to shayad woh zina se ruk jaye aur maaldaar ko mumkin hai ki naseehat evn prerna haasil ho aur jo Allah ne use diya, usmen se woh kharch kare.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8842: Kya tujhe is jaanvar ke prati Allah ka bhay nahin hota, jiska tujhe Allah ne maalik banaya hai? Yeh mujh se shikayat kar raha hai ki tu use bhookha rakhta aur thakaata hai

Abu jaafar abdullah bin jaafar (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne mujhe ek din apni sawaari par apne peechhe bithaya aur mujhe aahista se ek baat bataai jo main kisi ko bataana nahin chaahta. Aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apni aawashyakta poori karne ke waqt jis cheez ke dvaara parda karna sabse zyaada pasand karte the, woh koi oonchi cheez ya koi baagheecha hota tha. To aapne ek ansaari vyakti ke baagh mein prawesh kiya aur usmen ek oont tha. Usne jab Allahu ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dekha, to chillaane laga aur uski aankhon se paani nikalne laga. Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) uske paas aye aur uske kohaan tatha kaan ke pichhle bhaag par haath phera, to woh chup ho gaya. Aap ne farmaya: Iska maalik kaun hai? Ek ansaari naujvaan aya aur kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Yeh mera hai. Aapne farmaya: Kya tujhe is jaanvar ke prati Allah ka bhay nahin hota, jiska tujhe Allah ne maalik banaya hai? Yeh mujh se shikayat kar raha hai ki tu use bhookha rakhta aur thakaata hai.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8844: Anas (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki jab ham kisi jagah par utarte to paalaan utaarne se pahle nafl namaz nahin parhte the
Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki jab ham kisi jagah par atarte to paalaan utaarne se pahle nafl namaz nahin parhte the.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8869: Tummen se pratyek vyakti ka Jahannam athva Jannat mein thikaana likh diya gaya hai

Ali (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ham log baqi-e- gharqad mein ek janaaze mein the, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hamaare paas aye aur baith gae aur ham log bhi aapke aas- paas baith gae. Us samay aapke haath mein ek chhari thi. Aap apna sar jhukaye usse mitti ko khurachne lage, phir farmaya: Tummen se pratyek vyakti ka Jahannam athva Jannat mein thikaana likh diya gaya hai. Logon ne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Tab ham apne bhaagy par nirbhar kyon na kar len? Aapne farmaya: Amal (karm) karte raho, kyonki jiske liye jo paida kiya gaya hai, wahi uske liye saral kar diya jaata hai. Iske baad poori hadees bayaan ki gai hai.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saatheegan unmen se kisi ke janaaze mein madeene waalon ki qabristaan mein upasthit the. Aap bhi unke beech baith gae. Us samay aapke haath mein ek chhari thi. Apna sar dharti ki or jhuka liya aur chhari se dharti ko khurachne lage. Aisa maaloom ho raha tha ki kuchh soch rahe hain aur chintit hain. Phir farmaya ki Allah ne logon ke bhaagy likh rakhe hain aur Jannat evn Jahannam mein unka thikaana bhi likh rakha hai.
Jab sahaaba -radiyallahu anhum- ne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki yeh baat suni, to kahne lage ki jab saare nirnay pahle hi ho chuke hain aur yeh tay ho chuka hai ki jo abhaaga hai woh abhaaga hi rahega aur jo bhaagyashaali hai woh bhaagyashaali hi rahega, isi tarah jise Jannat jaana hai woh Jannat hi jayega aur jise Jahannam jaana hai woh Jahannam hi jayega, to kya ham karm karna chhor na den? Kyonki karm ka koi fayda to hai nahin! Har cheez likhi hui aur nishchit hai!
Sahaaba ki in baaton ka uttar dete hue aapne kaha ki tum karm karte raho aur bhaagy mein likhi bhalaai evn buraai par bharosa karke baith na jaao. Tumhen jin baaton ka aadesh diya gaya hai, unka paalan karte raho aur jin kaamon se roka gaya hai, unse ruk jaao. Kyonki Jannat bhi karm se praapt hoti hai aur Jahannam bhi karm se praapt hoti hai. Jannat mein prawesh ka saubhaagy usi ko praapt hoga, jisne Jannat jaane yogy karm kiye honge aur Jahannam mein prawesh ki peera bhi usi ko jhelni paregi, jisne Jahannam ki or le jaane waale karm kiye honge. Har vyakti ke liye wahi aasaan kar diya jaata hai, jiske liye use paida kiya gaya hai. Bhalaai ho ki buraai. Jo bhaagyashaali hoga, Allah uske liye bhaagyashaali logon ka karm aasaan kare dega aur jo bhaagyaheen hoga Allah uske liye bhaagyaheen logon ka karm aasaan kar dega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8870: Jis Muslim vyakti ke baare mein chaar vyaktiyon ne bhalaai ki gawaahi di, Allah use Jannat mein daakhil kar dega

Abul asvad kahte hain ki main madeene aya to umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas baitha. Isi beech ek janaaza wahaan se guzra to us mritak ki prashansa ki gai. Umar ne kaha: Aniwaary ho gai. Phir doosra janaaza guzra to uski bhi prashansa ki gai. Umar ne kaha: Waajib ho gai. Phir teesra janaaza guzra to uski buraai ki gai. Umar ne kaha: Aniwaary ho gai. Mainne kaha: Ai ameerul momeneen! Kya waajib ho gai? Farmaya: Mainne wahi kaha hai, jo Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne kaha tha: Jis Muslim aadmi ke baare mein chaar vyaktiyon ne bhalaai ki gawaahi di, Allah use Jannat mein daakhil kar dega. Hamne kaha: Aur yadi teen log gawaahi den? Farmaya: Teen bhi. Hamne kaha: Aur agar do log gawaaheen den? Farmaya: Do bhi. Phir hamne ek ke gawaahi dene ke baare mein nahin poochha.
8871: Tummen se jis mahila ki teen santaanen mar jayen, woh uske liye Jahannam se aar ban jaati hain

Abu saeed khu़dari (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki ek mahila Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aai aur usne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mard log aapki hadees lekar chale gae. Isliye aap hamaare liye bhi ek din nirdhaarit kar den, jismen ham upasthit hon aur aap hamen woh cheez sikhayen jo aapko Allah ne sikhaai hai. Aap ne farmaya: Falaan falaan din tum log ekatrit ho jaao. Wayde ke mutaabik, aurten ekatrit ho gaeen aur Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) unke paas aye aur unhen Allah ki sikhaai hui baaton mein se kuchh sikhaya, phir farmaya: Tummen se jis mahila ki teen santaanen mar jayen, woh uske liye Jahannam se aar ban jaati hain. Is par ek mahila ne poochha: Aur yadi do maren to? Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Yadi do maren to bhi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8872: Abdullah bin abu aufa ne apni ek beti ke zanaaje par chaar takbeeren kaheen aur chauthi takbeer ke baad do takbeeron ke beech jitni avdhi hoti hai, uske samaan khare rahe aur uske liye kshama yaachna aur dua karte rahe, phir farmaya: Allahu ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aisa kiya karte the

Abdullah bin abu aufa ne apni ek beti ke zanaaje par chaar takbeeren kaheen aur chauthi takbeer ke baad do takbeeron ke beech jitni avdhi hoti hai, uske samaan khare rahe aur uske liye kshama yaachna ki aur dua karte rahe, phir farmaya: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aisa kiya karte the. Ek riwayat mein hai: Chauthi takbeer kahne ke baad itni der tak khare rahe yahaan tak ki ham sochne lage ki woh paanchveen takbeer bhi kahenge. Lekin phir daahine or salaam phera aur bayen or. Jab we mure, to hamne unse kaha: Yeh kya hai? Farmaya: Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko jaisa karte hue dekha hai, usse adhik tumhaare saath nahin karoonga athva yeh farmaya: Isi tarah Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) karte the.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise haakim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8873: Jis Muslim ke teen bachche mar jayen, use Jahannam ki aag kewal qasam poori karne bhar chhooegi

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Jis Muslim vyakti ke teen bachche mar jayen, use Jahannam ki aag kewal qasam poori karne bhar chhooegi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8875: Jis Muslim ke teen bachche baaligh hone se poorv hi mar jayen, use Allah taaala un bachchon par khaas daya karte hue Jannat mein daakhil kar dega

Anas (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Jis Muslim ke teen bachche baaligh hone se poorv hi mar jayen, use Allah taaala un bachchon par apni khaas daya karte hue Jannat mein daakhil kar dega.
8876: Iski tumne prashansa ki, to iske liye Jannat aniwaary ho gai aur iski tumne buraai ki, to iske liye Jahannam waajib ho gai, tum log waastav mein dharti par Allah ke gawaah ho

Anas (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki log ek janaaza lekar guzre to sahaaba ne uski taareeph ki . Is par Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Iske liye waajib ho gai. Uske baad doosra janaaza lekar guzre to sahaaba ne uski buraai ki to Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Iske liye aniwaary ho gai. Is par umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne kaha ki kya waajib ho gai? Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Iski tumne prashansa ki, to iske liye Jannat aniwaary ho gai aur uski tumne buraai ki, to uske liye Jahannam waajib ho gai. Waastav mein, tum log dharti par Allah ke gawaah ho.

Kuchh sahaaba ek janaaze ke paas se guzre aur uske liye bhalaai evn Allah ki shareeyat par mazbooti se amal karke duniya se jaane ki gawaahi di. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne jab unki prashansa suni, to farmaya : "Waajib ho gai." Phir doosre janaaze ke paas se guzre aur uske baare mein buraai ki gawaahi di. Ispar bhi Allah ke Rasool -salllahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Waajib ho gai." Yeh sun umar bin khattaab -radiyallahu anhu- ne poochha ki donon sthaanon mein 'waajib ho gai' ke kya mayne hain? Unke uttar mein Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : Jis vyakti ke baare mein tumne bhalaai, neki aur sudrirhta ki gawaahi di, uske liye Jannat waajib ho gai aur jiske baare mein tumne buraai ki gawaahi di, uske liye Jahannam waajib ho gai. Ho sakta hai ki woh nifaaq evn is tarah ki kisi aur cheez ke liye mashhoor raha ho.
Phir Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya ki jis vyakti ke baare mein satyawaadi, pratishthit aur satkarmi log Jannat athva Jahannam ke haqdaar hone ki gawaahi den, to woh sachmuch waisa hi hoga.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8877: Jab koi aadmi kahe: Log halaak wa barbaad ho gae, to woh sabse adhik halaak wa barbaad hone waala hai

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Jab koi aadmi kahe ki log halaak wa barbaad ho gae, to woh sabse adhik halaak wa barbaad hone waala hai.
8878: Do gaali dene waalon ki gaali ki laanat, aaranbh karne waale par hogi, jab tak ki peerit aatyaachaar na kare

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Do gaali dene waalon ki gaali ki laanat, aaranbh karne waale par hogi, jab tak ki peerit aatyaachaar na kare.
8879: Yadi tum musalmaanon ki chhupi hui kamiyon ki jaasoosi karte rahoge to unhen aur adhik bigaar doge ya bigarne ki kagaar par le aaoge

Muaawiya (rajiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue suna: Yadi tum musalmaanon ki chhupi hui kamiyon ki jaasoosi karte rahoge to unhen aur adhik bigaar doge ya unhen bigarne ki kagaar par le aaoge.

Agar tum musalmaanon ki gupt baaton, kamiyon aur aibon ko dhoondh-dhoondhkar nikaaloge aur unke peechhe parkar unki chhipi hui baaton ko ujaagar karoge aur is tarah unhen rusva karog, to unki haya kam ho jayegi aur we is tarah ke gunaah khulkar sab ke saamne karne lagenge. Haalaanki pahle we chhup-chhupaakar karte aur Allah ke atirikt koi nahin jaanta tha.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8880: Ek vyakti ko unke paas laya gaya aur un se kaha gaya: Yeh amuk aadmi hai, iski daarhi se sharaab tapak rahi hai. Yeh sun kar aapne farmaya: Hamen jaasoosi karne se mana kiya gaya hai, lekin yadi koi cheez zaahir ho to ham uski uske kaaran pakar karenge

Ibne masaood (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki ek vyakti ko laya gaya aur unse kaha gaya: Yeh amuk aadmi hai, iski daarhi se sharaab tapak rahi hai. To aapne farmaya : Hamen jaasoosi karne se mana kiya gaya hai, lekin yadi koi cheez zaahir ho to ham uski uske kaaran pakar karenge.

8882: Kisi Muslim ke liye jayaz nahin hai ki apne bhaai ko teen din se adhik chhore rakhe, jisne teen din se adhik chhore rakha aur isi dasha mein mar gaya to woh Jahannam mein daakhil hoga

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Kisi Muslim ke liye jayaz nahin hai ki apne bhaai ko teen din se adhik chhore rakhe. Jisne teen din se adhik chhore rakha aur isi dasha mein mar gaya to woh Jahannam mein daakhil hoga.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8883: Koi vyakti kisi vyakti par faasiq hone ka laanchhan na lagaye. Kaafir hone ka laanchhan bhi na lagaye. Kyonki agar woh aisa na hua, to yeh laanchhan usi ki or laut ayega.

Abu zar radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki unhonne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : "Koi vyakti kisi vyakti par faasiq hone ka laanchhan na lagaye. Kaafir hone ka laanchhan bhi na lagaye. Kyonki agar woh aisa na hua, to yeh laanchhan usi ki or laut ayega."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is baat se saavdhaan kiya hai ki koi vyakti doosre vyakti se kahe ki : Tum faasiq ho, ya tum kaafir ho. Kyonki agar saamne waala vyakti faasiq ya kaafir na hua, to kahne waala vyakti hi is wisheshan ka haqdaar ho jayega aur uski kahi hui baat usi ki or laut jayegi. Lekin, agar woh waisa hi ho jaisa ki usne kaha, to kahne waale ka koi nuqsaan nahin hoga kyonki uski baat durust hai.

Kisi sharai kaaran ke bina kisi ko kaafir ya faasiq kahna haraam hai.
Logon par koi hukm lagaane se pahle satyaapan waajib hai.
Ibn-e-daqeeq al-eed kahte hain : Kisi vyakti ko, jo sach-much kaafir na ho, kaafir kahne waalon ke liye yeh bahut bari chetaavni hai. Aur waastav mein yeh bare duwidha  ki baat hai.
Ibn-e-hajar asaqlaani kahte hain : Kisi ko kaafir ya faasiq kahne se uske kaafir ya faasiq na ho jaane se yeh laazim nahin aata ki kahne waala aisa kahne ke kaaran gunaahgaar nahin hoga. Daraasal iske baare mein tafseel hai. Agar saamne waale ka shubhchintan ya uska haal bataakar kisi aur ka shubhchintan uddeshy ho, to jayaz hai. Agar sharm dilaana, badnaam karna aur kasht dena uddeshy ho, to jayaz nahin hai. Kyonki shareeyat ne usko aadesh parda daalne, shiksha dene aur samjhaane-bujhaane ka diya hai aur yeh kaam narmi se ho jaye, to sakhti karna jayaz nahin hai. Balki sakhti karne se kabhi-kabhi insaan bharak jaata hai aur us kaam ko chhorne ke liye taiyaar nahin hota hai. Kyonki bahut-se log ahankaari hote hain aur unka ahankaar us samay wishesh roop se jaag uthta hai, jab bataane waala unse kamtar ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
8884: Jo kisi doosre ki patni athva daasi ko dhoka de athva bigaare, woh hammen se nahin hai
Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se marfooan riwayat hai: Jo kisi doosre ki patni ya daasi ko dhoka de ya bigaare, woh hammen se nahin hai.

Jo purush athva stri kisi ki patni ko uske khilaaf bharkaye aur is kaam ke liye uske saamne uske pati ki buraaiyaan aur kuvyavhaar ka bakhaan kuchh is tarah kare ki woh apne pati se ghrina karne lage, uski awajna karne lage aur khula evn talaak lekar usse alag hone ka prayaas karne lage, ya phir kisi ke daas ko uske maalik ke khilaaf is tarah bharka de aur uske saath kuchh aise kaary kare ki woh uske wiruddh widroh kar baithe aur uske saath bura vyavhaar karne lage, is hadees mein uske baare mein yeh bari chetaavni di gai hai, jo is baat ka pramaan hai ki yeh maha paap hai aur dhamki tatha chetaavni ke yogy hai.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8885: Jisne apne bhaai ko ek saal tak chhore rakha, maano usne uska khoon bahaya
Abu khiraash hadrad bin abu hadrad asalmi (radiyallahu anhu) se marfooan riwayat hai: Jisne apne bhaai ko ek saal tak chhore rakha, maano usne uska khoon bahaya.

Jisne apne bhaai se bina kisi sharai kaaran ke sanbandh tor liya aur is silsile ko ek warsh tak jaari rakha, woh usi prakaar dand ka haqdaar ban jaata hai, jis prakaar uski hatya kar dene se dand ka haqdaar banta hai. Yeh dand kya ho, iska nirnay qaazi yaani sharai nyayaadheesh apne avlokan ke aadhaar par karega. Dand ka uddeshy use is apraadh se rokna aur any logon ko sachet karna hai. Lekin yadi kisi ne kisi sharai uddeshy ke kaaran sanbandh tora, to bidaatiyon evn awajnaakaariyon se us samay tak sanbandh torkar rakhna chahiye, jab tak tauba na kar len evn saty ki or laut na ayen, chaahe yeh silsila jitna bhi lanba ho.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8886: Nissandeh shaitaan is baat se niraash ho chuka hai ki musalmaan arab prayadveep mein uski ibaadat karenge. Lekin uski aashayen musalmaanon ke beech phoot daalne ke sanbandh mein jeewit hain.

Jaabir radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko farmaate hue suna hai : "Nissandeh shaitaan is baat se niraash ho chuka hai ki musalmaan arab prayadveep mein uski ibaadat karenge. Lekin uski aashayen musalmaanon ke beech phoot daalne ke sanbandh mein jeewit hain."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki shaitaan is baat se niraash ho chuka hai ki namaz ki paabandi karne waale musalmaan arab prayadveep mein uski pooja aur buton ke aage sajda karenge. Lekin aaj bhi uski khvaahish ne dam nahin tori hai. Aaj bhi is baat ke liye uski koshish jaari hai ki unko uksaakar unke beech laraai, jhagra aur fitna wa fasaad aadi barpa kar diya jaye.

Shaitaan ki ibaadat but ki ibaadat hai,kyonki wahi iska aadesh deta aur iski or bulaata hai, iski daleel yeh hai ki mahaan Allah ne ibraaheem alaihissalaam ke baare mein yeh kaha hai : "Ai mere pita ji! Aap shaitaan ki ibaadat na karen."
Shaitaan musalmaanon ke beech dushmaniyaan, laraai-jhagre aur fitne barpa karne mein laga rahta hai.
Islam mein namaz ka ek laabh yeh hai ki yeh musalmaanon ke beech aapsi prem banaye rakhti hai aur unke beech bhaaeechaare ke bandhan ko majboot karti hai.
Do gawaahiyon ke baad, namaz is dharm mein sabse bari ibaadat hai, aur iseeliye is hadees mein musalmaanon ko "Musalliyon" (Namaz parhne waalon) ke roop mein warnit kiya gaya hai.
Arab prayadveep ki kuchh aisi wisheshtayen hain, jo any kshetron ki nahin hain.
Agar koi kahe ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- farma rahe hain : "Shaitaan is baat se niraash ho gaya hai ki arab prayadveep mein musalmaan uski ibaadat karenge." Parantu ham dekhte hain ki arab prayadveep ke kuchh hisson mein moortiyon ki pooja ki ja rahi hai! To iska jawaab yeh hai ki yeh hadees us niraasha ki baat kar rahi hai jo islaami wijay aur Islam ke andar logon ke samooh dar samooh prawesh karne ko dekhkar shaitaan ke andar paida hui thi. Daraasal yeh hadeese shaitaan ke gumaan aur ummeed ki baat kar hi hai. Lekin baad mein hua iske wipreet, jiske peechhe Allah ki koi masalhat hogi.
8887: Ai abu masaood! Jaan lo ki Allah tum par tumhaare is ghulaam par saamarthy se adhik saamarthy rakhta hai. To mainne kaha: Iske pashchaat main kabhi kisi daas ko nahin maarunga

Abu masaood badri (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki main apne ek daas ko maar raha tha. Usi wakt mainne peechhe se ek aawaaz suni: Ai abu masaood! Jaan lo. Lekin main maare krodh ke, aawaaz ko samajh nahin paya. Jab mujh se nazdeek hue to dekhta hoon ki woh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) hain aur farma rahe hain: Ai abu masaood! Jaan lo ki Allah tum par tumhaare is ghulaam par saamarthy se adhik saamarthy rakhta hai. To mainne kaha: Iske pashchaat main kabhi kisi daas ko nahin maaroonga. Ek riwayat mein hai: Aap ke bhay se haath se kora gir gaya. Ek riwayat mein hai: Mainne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Woh Allah ki prasannata praapt karne ke liye aazaad hai. Aapne farmaya: Yadi tum aisa nahin karte to tumhen Jahannam ke shole lapak lete ya kaha ki Jahannam ki aag apni lapet mein le leti.
8888: Beshak Allah taaala un logon ko -qayaamat ke din- yaatna dega jo duniya mein logon ko yaatna dete hain

Hishaam bin hakeem bin hizaam (radiyallahu anhuma) se warnit hai ki woh shaam mein kuchh nabtiyon ke paas se guzre, jinhen dhoop mein khara kiya gaya tha aur unke siron par tel daala gaya tha. To unhonne kaha: Yeh kya hai? Kaha gaya: Taiks na dene ke kaaran saza di ja rahi hai. To hishaam ne kaha: Main gawaahi deta hoon ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue suna hai: Beshak Allah taaala un logon ko -qayaamat ke din- yaatna dega jo duniya mein logon ko yaatna dete hain. Phir wahaan ke meyar ke paas gae aur unse baat ki, to usne unhen chhorne ka aadesh diya.
8889: Mainne tum logon ko aadesh diya tha ki amuk aur amuk ko jala do lekin Allah ke siwa koi aag se yaatna nahin de sakta, isliye yadi tum unhen paao to qatl kar do

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, unhonne kaha ki hamen Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne kisi lashkar (fauj) ke saath bheja aur hamse farmaya: Jab tum quraish ke amuk aur amuk aadmi ko paao to unhen aag mein jala dena. Aapne unka naam bhi liya tha. Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki phir ham saphar par jaane lage to aapne farmaya: Mainne tum logon ko aadesh diya tha ki falaan falaan ko jala do lekin Allah ke siwa koi aag se yaatna nahin de sakta, isliye yadi tum unhen paao to qatl kar do.
8890: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne jaanavron ko baandh kar teer se qatl karne se mana farmaya
Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne jaanavron ko baandh kar teer se qatl karne se mana farmaya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8891: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek gadha dekha, jiske chehre ko daagha gaya tha, to aapne ise naapsand kiya

Ibne abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) se marfooan warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek gadha dekha, jiske chehre ko daagha gaya tha, to aapne ise naapsand kiya. Ibne abbaas ko maaloom hua, to farmaya: Allah ki qasam! Main chehre ke sabse nichle bhaag mein daaga karoonga aur apne gadhe ke prati hukm diya aur uske pichhli raanon mein daagha gaya, to ibne abbaas sabse pahle raanon par daagne waale hain.
8892: Kisi ke liye upyukt nahin ki aag se saza de, siwaye aag ke rab ke

Ibne masaood (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ham log Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke sang ek yaatra mein the, to aap kisi aawashyakta ke liye gae. Hamne ek chiriya dekha, jiske do bachche the. Hamne uske bachche pakar liye, to chiriya aai aur unke oopar urne lagi. Isi beech Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aye aur farmaya: Kisne iske bachche lekar ise pareshaan kiya hai? Use uske chooze waapas kardo. Aur aapne cheentiyon ka gaavn dekha, jise hamne jala diya tha to aapne farmaya: Kisne ise jalaya hai? Hamne kaha: Hamne. Aapne farmaya: Kisi ke liye upyukt nahin ki aag se saza de siway aag ke rab ke.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8893: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne chehre par maarne aur usmen daaghne se mana farmaya hai

Ibne abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ke paas se ek gadha guzra, jiske chehre par daagha gaya tha. To aapne farmaya: Allah ki laanat ho us par, jisne ise daagha hai. Muslim ki ek riwayat mein aya hai: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne chehre par maarne tatha usmen daaghne se mana farmaya hai.

Is hadees mein kisi bhi jaandaar ke chehre par daagne aur isi tarah chehre par maarne se bari sakhti se mana kiya gaya hai. Ulema ne ise maha paapon mein shumaar kiya hai.
Ulema ne manaahi ka kaaran yeh bataya hai ki chehra komal tatha saari sundarta ka kendr hua karta hai. Isi tarah chehre ke ang ‏shreshth evn naazuk hote hain aur insaan ki adhiktar anubhooti inheen par nirbhar hai. Jabki chehre par maarne se yeh shakti kabhi to nasht ho jaati hai aur kabhi ghat jaati hai. Kabhi-kabhi to isse chehre kuroop bhi ho jaata hai. Isi tarah chehra hamesha saamne hota hai aur use chhupaya nahin ja sakta, jiski wajah se uska aib bara kharaab lagta hai aur uspar maarne se aam taur par aib paida ho hi jaata hai.
8894: Main bani muqarrin ka saatvaan vyakti tha. Hamaari ek daasi thi, jise sabse chhote bhaai ne ek thappar maar diya tha, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen use mukt karne ka aadesh diya

Abu ali suwaid bin muqarrin (radiyallahu anhu) farmaate hain ki main bani muqarrin ka saatvaan vyakti tha. Hamaari ek daasi thi, jise sabse chhote bhaai ne ek thappar maar diya tha, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen use mukt karne ka aadesh diya. Ek riwayat mein hai: Bhaaeeyon mein saatvaan tha.
8895: Jo apne daas ko bina kisi kaaran ke maarta hai, uska prayashchit yeh hai ki use mukt kar de

I्bane umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Jo apne daas ko bina kisi kaaran ke maarta hai, uska prayashchit yeh hai ki use aazaad kar de.
8896: Tumhaara raaston mein baithne se kya lena- dena hai? Raaston mein baithne se bacho

Abu talha zaid bin sahl (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ham gharon ke saamne ke baraamdon mein baithe hue baaten kar rahe the ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aye aur hamaare saamne khare hokar aapne farmaya: Tumhaara raaston mein baithne se kya lena- dena hai? Raaston mein baithne se bacho. Hamne kaha: Ham yahaan jayaz maqsad se baithe hain. Ham yahaan baithe hain taaki ham aapas mein waartaalaap aur achchhi baat- cheet karen. Aapne farmaya: Yadi baithna hi hai to raaste ka haq ada karo. Is tarah ki nigaahen jhuki rahen, salaam ka uttar do aur achchhi baat kaho.
8898: Maanav ke bhaagy mein zina likh diya gaya hai, jise woh karke rahega: Aankhon ka zina dekhna hai. Kaanon ka zina sunna hai aur zabaan ka zina gandi baat karni hai. Haathon ka zina pakarna hai aur pair ka zina chalkar jaana hai. Aur dil chaahta wa tamanna karta hai aur guptaang use sach kar dikhaata hai athva use jhuthla deta hai

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) warnan karte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Maanav ke bhaagy mein zina (vyaabhichaar) likh diya gaya hai, jise woh karke rahega: Aankhon ka zina dekhna hai. Kaanon ka zina sunna hai aur zabaan ka zina gandi baat karni hai. Haathon ka zina pakarna hai aur pair ka zina, chalkar jaana hai. Dil chaahta aur tamanna karta hai aur guptaang, use sach kar dikhaata hai athva use jhuthla deta hai.

Is hadees ka arth yeh hai ki insaan nishchit roop se vyabhichaar mein sanlipt ho hi jaata hai. Haan, yadi kisi ko Allah hi surakshit rakhe, to baat alag hai. Phir Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne iske kuchh udaahran prastut kiye hain :
"Aankh ka vyabhichaar dekhna hai" Yaani jab koi vyakti kisi aisi stri ko dekhta hai, jo un striyon mein se na ho jinke saath uska nikaah haraam hai, chaahe woh kaam waasna ke saath na bhi dekhta ho, to uska yeh dekhna ek prakaar ka vyabhichaar yaani aankh ka vyabhichaar hai.
"Donon kaanon ka vyabhichaar sunna hai" Yaani insaan kisi stri ki baat sunta ho aur uski aawaaz se lazzat leta ho, to yeh kaan ka vyabhichaar hai.
"Haath ka vyabhichaar pakarna hai" Yaani haath ka kaam jaise chhoona aadi.
"Aur pair ka vyabhichaar chalkar jaana hai." Yaani insaan udaahran ke taur par buraaiyon ke sthaanon ki or chalkar jaata hai, kisi stri ki aawaaz sunkar uske paas jaata hai ya kisi stri ko dekhkar uska peechha karta hai, to yeh bhi ek prakaar ka vyabhichaar hai.
"Dil chaahta aur tamanna karta hai" Yaani dil stri se sanbandh ki or jhukta hai, to yeh dil ka vyabhichaar hai.
"Aur guptaang use sach kar dikhaata hai ya use jhuthla deta hai." Yaani jab insaan guptaang se vyabhichaar karta hai, to shareer ke in angon ke vyabhichaar ko sach kar dikhaata hai. Lekin agar guptaang se vyabhichaar nahin karta aur svayn ko surakshit rakhta hai, to woh shareer ke in angon ke vyabhichaar ko jhuthla deta hai.
Yeh hadees insaan ko stri se kisi bhi prakaar ka sanbandh rakhne se saavdhaan karti hai. Chaahe woh uski aawaaz sune, use dekhe, use chhooe, uske paas jaye ya dil mein uski chaahat rakhe. Yeh saare kaary alag-alag prakaar ke vyabhichaar hain. Atah ek wiweki evn nishkalank charitr waale insaan ko apne shareer ke kisi bhi ang dvaara stri se sanbandh rakhne se bachna chahiye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8899: Qayaamat ke din sarvapratham jis vyakti ke baare mein nirnay liya jayega, woh duniya mein shaheed hua hoga. Use laya jayega, phir Allah taaala use apni neemton ka iqraar karayega, to woh un neemton ka iqraar kar lega. Tab (Allah taaala) kahega: Toone in neemton ka kaisa upyog kiya?. Woh vyakti kahega: Main tere liye jihaad karta raha, yahaan tak ki shaheed kar diya gaya

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue suna: Qayaamat ke din sarvapratham jis vyakti ke baare mein nirnay liya jayega, woh duniya mein shaheed hua hoga. Use laya jayega, phir Allah taaala use apni neemton ka iqraar karayega, to woh un neemton ka iqraar kar lega. Tab (Allah taaala) kahega: Toone in neemton ka kaisa upyog kiya? Woh kahega: Main tere liye jihaad karta raha, yahaan tak ki shaheed kar diya gaya. Allah kahega: Toone jhooth kaha. Sachchaai yeh hai ki tumne jang isliye ki, taaki tumhen weer kaha jaye aur yeh kaha ja chuka, phir uske prati aadesh diya jayega aur use chehre ke bal ghaseet kar Jahannam mein daal diya jayega. Isi prakaar, ek woh vyakti hoga, jisne jnaan seekha aur sikhaya aur Qur'an parha tha. Use laya jayega aur usse bhi neemton ki pahchaan karvaai jayegi, to woh pahchaan lega aur iqraar kar lega. Allah taaala kahega: Tumne unka kya kiya? Woh kahega : Mainne jnaan seekha aur sikhaya aur tere liye Qur'an parha. Tab Allah kahega: Toone jhooth kaha, balki toone jnaan isliye praapt kiya taaki tujhe jnaani kaha jaye aur quraaana is liye parha taaki Qur'an- waachak (qaari) kaha jaye aur yeh sab kaha ja chuka. Phir aadesh hoga, to use munh ke bal ghaseet kar Jahannam mein daal diya jayega. Ek aur vyakti ko laya jayega, jise Allah ne dhan bahut diya tha. Allah taaala use bhi apni neemton ki pahchaan karayega, to woh pahchaan lega. Allah kahega: Toone inka kya kiya? Woh kahega: Mainne pratyek woh kaary jismen tu kharch karna pasand karta hai, usmen kharch kiya. Allah kahega: Toone jhooth kaha, balki toone aisa isliye kiya taaki kaha jaye ki tu daanveer hai aur yeh sab kaha ja chuka. Phir aadesh hoga aur use bhi chehre ke bal ghaseet kar Jahannam mein daal diya jayega.
8900: Aapka kya khyaal hai us aadmi ke prati jo nek karm karta hai aur log uski us par prashansa karte hain? Aapne farmaya: Yeh momin ke liye jald milne waali shubh soochna hai

Abu zar (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se kaha gaya: Aapka kya khyaal hai us aadmi ke prati jo nek karm karta hai aur log uski uspar prashansa karte hain? Aapne farmaya: Yeh momin ke liye jald milne waali shubh soochna hai.
8901: Mujaahedeen ki patniyaan, jihaad mein na jaane waalon ke liye unki apni maataaon ke samaan haraam hain

Buraida (raziyalllahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Allah ke raaste mein jihaad mein jaane waalon ki patniyaan, jihaad mein na jaane waalon ke oopar unki apni maataaon ke samaan haraam hain. Jo bhi kisi mujaahid ke pariwaar ki dekh- bhaal ki zimmewaari leta hai aur phir dhokha karta hai, qayaamat ke din uske sammukh khara hoga aur uski neki leta rahega yahaan tak ki woh raazi ho jaye. Phir Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hamaari or mure aur farmaya: Tumhaara kya khyaal hai?
8902: Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se (aurat par) achaanak parne waali nazar ke baare mein poochha, to aapne mujhe nazar pher lene ka aadesh diya.

Jareer bin abdullah se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se (aurat par) achaanak parne waali nazar ke baare mein poochha, to aapne mujhe nazar pher lene ka aadesh diya.

Jareer bin abdullah radiyallahu anhu ne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochha ki agar kisi purush ki nazar achaanak kisi ajanbi mahila par bina ichchha ke par jaye to use kya karna chahiye? Aapne unse kaha ki jaise hi use yeh ehsaas ho, use turant apni nazren doosri or kar leni chahiye. Yadi woh aisa kar le, to use koi gunaah nahin hoga.

Nazar neeche rakhne ki prerna.
Yadi koi vyakti achaanak aur anjaane mein kisi aisi cheej par nazar daal le jise dekhna warjit hai, to use aage dekhte rah jaana warjit hai.
Is hadees se pata chalta hai ki sahaaba jaante the ki kisi ajanbi aurat ko dekhna haraam hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki jareer radiyallahu anhu ne anjaane mein dekhne ke baare mein poochha aur jaanne ka prayaas kiya ki kya jaanboojhkar dekhne par jo hukm laagu hota hai kya wahi hukm anjaane mein dekhne par bhi laagu hoga?
Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki shareeyat bandon ke hiton ka poora khyaal rakhti hai. Choonki aurton ko dekhne ke nateeje mein duniya evn aakhirat se sanbandhit kai buraaiyaan saamne aati hain, isliye shareeyat ne ise haraam kar diya hai.
Sahaaba Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aate aur jo baaten maaloom na hoteen aapse poochh liya karte the. Isliye aam logon ko bhi ulema ke paas jaana chahiye aur jo baaten samajh mein na ayen unse poochh leni chahiye.
8903: Mainne Jahannam ke do prakaar ke logon ko nahin dekha : Ek woh log jinke paas gay ki poonchh jaise kore honge aur woh logon ko usse maarenge. Doosre woh mahilayen jo wastr mein hokar bhi nangi hongi. Doosron ko apni or aakarshit karengi aur svayn doosron ki taraph aakarshit hongi.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Mainne Jahannam ke do prakaar ke logon ko nahin dekha : Ek woh log jinke paas gay ki poonchh jaise kore honge aur woh logon ko usse maarenge. Doosre woh mahilayen jo wastr mein hokar bhi nangi hongi. Doosron ko apni or aakarshit karengi aur svayn doosron ki taraph aakarshit hongi. Unke sir bukhti oont ke kohaanon ki tarah oonche honge. We Jannat awashy nahin jayengi aur na Jannat ki sugandh payengi, jabki uski sugandh itni aur itni doori se milti hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam do prakaar ke jahannami logon se saavdhaan kar rahe hain, jinko aapne dekha nahin hai aur jo aapke daur mein maujood nahin the. Donon prakaar ke log aapke baad saamne ayenge :

Pahla prakaar : Aise log jinke paas gay ki dum ki tarah lanbe-lanbe kore honge, jinse logon ki pitaai karenge. Daraasal muraad aise pulis waale aur atyaachaariyon ke anuyayi hain, jo logon ki naahaq pitaai karte hain.

Doosra prakaar : Aisi aurten, jo paakdaamni aur haya ka libaas utaar phenkengi, jo ek aurat ka praakritik zewar hai.

Aapne bataya ki woh aurten waise to kapre pahni hui hongi, lekin waastawik roop se nangi hongi. Kyonki kapre itne baareek honge ki shareer jhalak raha hoga. Saath hi woh shareer ke kuchh bhaag ko to dhaapengi, lekin apni sundarta ka pradarshan karne ke liye kuchh bhaag  ko khula chhor dengi. Woh apne pahnaawe aur chaal-dhaal se purushon ke aakarshan ka kendr ban jayengi, gardan aur kandhe matka-matka kar chalengi aur doosron ko usi bigaar aur pathabhrashtata ki or le jaana chaahengi, jismen woh khud pari hui hain. Unki ek wisheshta yeh hai ki unke sar oont ke jhuke hue kohaan ki tarah honge. Woh sar par pagri aadi baandhkar uske saaiz ko bara kar lengi. Yahaan bukhti oonton ke kohaanon se tashbeeh (samaanta) is liye di gai hai ki un aurton ke sar ke baal aur chootiyaan oont ke kohaanon ki tarah oopar uthi hui aur ek or jhuki hui hongi. Jin aurton ke andar yeh wisheshtayen paai jayengi, unke baare mein dhamki yeh di gai hai ki we Jannat mein prawesh nahin karengi, uski khushbu tak nahin pa sakengi aur uske nikat nahin ja sakengi. Jabki Jannat ki khushbu door se mahsoos ki ja sakti hai.

Logon ko bina kisi apraadh ke maarna ya kasht dena haraam hai.
Atyaachaar karne waalon ki unke atyaachaar par madad karna haraam hai.
Is hadees mein aurton ko beparda hokar baahar nikalne aur aise tang evn paardarshi kapre pahan kar baahar nikalne se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai, jisse shareer ke chhupaane yogy ang dikhte ya oonch-neech jhalakte hon.
Muslim aurat ko Allah ke aadeshon ka paalan karne aur aise kaaryon se door rahne ki prerna di gai hai, jo Allah ko naaraaz karte hon ya insaan ko aakhirat ke daymi azaab ka haqdaar bana dete hon.
Yeh hadees Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke Nabi hone ki ek daleel hai. Kyonki aapne ismen kuchh aisi cheezon ki soochna di hain, jo aapke zamaane mein maujood nahin theen aur baad mein hu-ba-hu usi tarah saamne a gaeen.
8904: Ek mard doosre mard ke guptaang aur ek mahila doosri mahila ke guptaang ko na dekhe

Abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Ek mard doosre mard ke guptaang aur ek mahila doosri mahila ke guptaang ko na dekhe aur na hi do mard ek hi kapre mein leten aur na do mahilayen ek kapre mein leten."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is baat se mana kiya hai ki koi mard kisi mard ke shareer chhipaane yogy bhaag ko dekhe ya koi aurat kisi aurat ke shareer ke chhupaane yogy bhaag ko dekhe.

Hadees mein aye hue shabd "العورة" Se muraad insaan ke shareer ka woh bhaag hai, jiske  khul jaane par haya aati ho. Purush ke shareer ka is tarah ka bhaag naaf se ghutne tak hai. Jabki aurat ka poora shareer ajanbi mardon ke liye chhupaane yogy hai. Albatta, ek aurat any aurton evn maharmon ke saamne shareer ke un angon ko khol sakti hai, jo ghar mein kaam karte samay aam taur par khul jaya karte hain.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is baat se mana kiya hai ki koi mard doosre mard ke saath nanga hokar ek kapre mein ya ek chaadar ke neeche rahe ya phir koi aurat doosri aurat ke saath ek kapre mein ya ek chaadar ke neeche nangi hokar rahe. Kyonki yeh ek-doosre ke guptaang ko chhoone ka sabab ban sakta hai aur chhoona bhi dekhne hi ki tarah mana hai. Balki uski manaahi kaheen adhik sakht hai, kyonki isse kaheen zyaada bari buraaiyaan saamne a sakti hain.

Kisi ke shareer ke chhupaane yogy hisse ko dekhne ki manaahi. Albatta, pati-patni isse apvaad hain.
Islam ek paak-saaf samaaj ke gathan aur behyaai ke sabhi raaston ko band kar dena chaahta hai.
Zaroorat ke samay, jaise chikitsa aadi ke liye, shareer ke chhupaane yogy bhaag ko dekhna jayaz hai. Lekin shart yeh hai ki shahvat ke saath na dekha jaye.
Ek musalmaan ko jahaan apne shareer ke chhupaane yogy bhaag ko chhupaye rakhne ka aadesh diya gaya hai, waheen doosre ke shareer ke chhupaane yogy bhaag ko na dekhne ka bhi aadesh diya gaya hai.
Yahaan wishesh roop se mard ko mard ke shareer ke aur aurat ko aurat ke shareer ke chhupaane yaagy bhaag ko dekhne se mana isliye kiya gaya hai ki yahaan nazar parne aur khulne ki sanbhaavna adhik rahti hai.
8905: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne aurat ka wastr pahanne waale mard par aur mard ka wastr pahanne waali aurat par laanat farmaai hai.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne aurat ka wastr pahanne waale mard par aur mard ka wastr pahanne waali aurat par laanat farmaai hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par aise purush ke liye Allah ki daya se dhutkaare aur door kar diye jaane ki bad-dua ki hai, jo mahilaaon ke saath wishesh wastron ko pahanne mein unki mushaabhat apnaye. Yeh mushaabhat chaahe kapre ki banaawat mein ho, rang mein ho, tareeqe mein ho ya pahanne aur shringaar ke tareeqe aadi mein ho. Isi tarah aapne har aisi mahila ke liye Allah ki daya se door kar diye jaane ki bad-dua ki hai, jo purushon ke wishesh wastr pahankar unki mushaabhat apnaye. Yeh daraasal bara gunaah hai.

Shaukaani kahte hain : Mahila ke liye purush ki aur purush ke liye mahila ki mushaabhat haraam hai. Kyonki laanat kisi haraam kaam par hi ki jaati hai.
Ibn-e-usaimeen kahte hain : Aise kapre pahanne mein koi buraai nahin hai jo purush aur mahilayen donon pahante hain, jaise ki ti-shart jo purush aur mahilayen donon pahante hain. Yaani, purush aur mahilayen donon inhen pahan sakte hain kyonki ye aam hain.
[ise nasai ne al-sunan al-kubra mein tatha ibn-e-maajah ne samaan arth mein evn ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
8906: Poore baal mundva lo athva poore ko chhor do

Ibne umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se warnit hai, kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek baalak ko dekha, jiske kuchh baal mundvaye hue the aur kuchh chhore hue the. Ispar aapne unhen aisa karne se mana kiya aur kaha: Poore baal mundva lo athva poore ko chhor do.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8907: Jab kisi ke joote ka pheeta toot jaye to doosre joote mein na chale, yahaan tak ki use theek kar le

Abu huraira (raziyallallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue suna: Jab tum mein se kisi ke joote ka pheeta toot jaye to doosre joote mein na chale yahaan tak ki use theek kar le.
8908: Yahoodi tatha eesaai daarhi nahin rangte, lekin tum log aisa karke unka wirodh karo
Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Beshak, yahoodi tatha eesaai daarhi nahin rangte. Lekin tum log aisa karke unka wirodh karo.

Is hadees mein abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- bata rahe hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unhen bataya hai ki yahoodi evn eesaai apne sar evn daarhi ke baalon ko rangne se gurez karte hain aur unhen apne haal par safed hi rahne dete hain. Atah aapne aadesh diya ki log unki mukhaalfat karen aur apne daarhi evn sar ke baalon ko rang liya karen.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8909: Ise badal do aur kaale khizaab se bacho

Jaabir (raziyalllahu anhu) kahte hain ki abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ke pita abu quhaafa (radiyallahu anhu) ko makka wijay ke din laya gaya, is haal mein ki unke sir aur daarhi ke baal ausaj naami paudhe ki tarah safed ho chuke the. Ispar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Ise badal do aur kaale khizaab se bacho.
8910: Aaj ke baad mere bhaai par roya na karo

Abdullah bin jaafar (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ne jaafar ke pariwaar ko teen din ki chhoot di. Phir aap aye aur farmaya: Aaj ke baad mere bhaai par roya na karo. Phir farmaya: Mere bhateejon ko bulaao. Atah hamen laya gaya. Us samay ham aise lag rahe the jaise ham chooze hon. Phir aapne farmaya: Naai ko bulaao. Phir aapne naai ko aadesh diya to usne hamaare sir moond diye.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8911: Saphed baal ko na ukhero, kyonki woh qayaamat ke din Muslim ka noor hoga

Amr bin shoeb apne pita ke hawaale se apne daada se riwayat karte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Saphed baal ko na ukhero, kyonki woh qayaamat ke din Muslim ka noor hoga.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8914: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne sar ke kuchh bhaag ke baalon ko moonrne aur kuchh bhaag ko chhor dene se mana kiya hai.
Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne sar ke kuchh bhaag ke baalon ko moonrne aur kuchh bhaag ko chhor dene se mana kiya hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne sar ke kuchh bhaag ke baalon ko moonrne aur kuchh ko chhor dene se mana kiya hai.

Is manaahi ke andar chhote aur bare sabhi log shaamil hain. Rahi baat aurat ki, to uske liye apne sar ke baalon ko moonrna sahi nahin hai.
Islaami shareeyat insaan ke zaahiri shakl-soorat par bhi tawajjo deti hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
8915: Israaeel ki santaanon ka winaash hua, jab unki mahilaaon ne ise apna liya

Humaid bin abdurrahmaan kahte hain ki unhonne muaawiya (radiyallahu anhu) ko Hajj ke saal minbar par farmaate hue suna, us samay unhonne baalon ka ek guchchha liya jo ek angrakshak ke haath mein tha aur farmaya: Ai madeena waasiyo! Tumhaare ulema kahaan chale gae hain?
