Mainne Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko isse rokte hue aur farmaate hue suna hai: Israaeel ki santaanon ka winaash hua, jab unki mahilaaon ne ise apna liya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8917: Jo bhi marta hai aur uspar rone waala kahta hai: He pahaar! He sardaar! Athva isi prakaar ki doosri baaten kahta hai, to do farishte us par laga diye jaate hain, jo uske seene par haath maar kar kahte hain: Kya tu aisa hi tha?

Abu moosa (radiyallahu anhu) se marfooan riwayat hai: Jo bhi marta hai aur uspar rone waala kahta hai: He pahaar! He sardaar! Athva is prakaar ki doosri baaten kahta hai, to do farishte uspar laga diye jaate hain, jo uske seene par haath maar kar kahte hain: Kya tu aisa hi tha?.
8918: Yeh sachchi baat woh hoti hai, jise jinn uchak leta hai aur use apne insaan dost ke kaan mein aisi aawaaz mein daal deta hai, jo murgi ke kurkuraane jaisi hoti hai, phir yeh log uske saath apni taraph se sau se adhik jhooth mila dete hain.

Aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Kuchh logon ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se kaahinon (ojhon) ke baare mein poochha to aapne farmaya : "In logon ki baaton mein koi sachchaai nahin hoti." Logon ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Yeh log kabhi-kabhi aisi baat bataate hain, jo sach ho jaya karti hai. Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Yeh sachchi baat woh hoti hai, jise jinn uchak leta hai aur use apne insaan dost ke kaan mein aisi aawaaz mein daal deta hai, jo murgi ke kurkuraane jaisi hoti hai, phir yeh log uske saath apni taraph se sau se adhik jhooth mila dete hain."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se aise logon ke baare mein poochha gaya, jo aane waale samay se sanbandhit ghaib ki baaten bataya karte hain, to aapne kaha ki unki parvaah mat karo, unki baat na suno aur unpar dhyaan mat do.

Yeh sun sahaaba ne kaha ki unki baaten kabhi-kabhi sahi saabit ho bhi jaati hain. Maslan agar unhonne bataya ki amuk maheene ki amuk taareekh ko koi baat hogi, to woh ho jaati hai.

Ispar Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Daraasal jinnaat aakaash ki jo thori-bahut soochnayen sun lete hain, unko we aane waale samay se sanbandhit ghaib ki baat bataane waale dost ko bata dete hain aur phir uska yeh dost usmen apni or se sau jhooth mila lete hain.

Aane waale samay se sanbandhit ghaib ki baat bataane waalon ko sach maanne ki manaahi aur is baat ka ullekh unki bataai hui baaten jhoothi hoti hain, chaahe kabhi-kabhaar ek-aadh sach saamne a bhi jaye.
Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke Nabi banne ke baad aakaash ko is baat se surakshit kar diya gaya hai ki shaitaan wahy aadi ko sun na sake. Haan, agar koi chori-chhupe kuchh sun le aur ulka se surakshit rah jaye, to baat alag hai.
Jinnaat kuchh insaanon ko apna dost bana lete hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
8925: Bartanon ko dhaanp do, mashqeezon ke mukh baandh do aur darvaaze band kar do tatha chiraagh bujha do, kyonki shaitaan mashkeezon ke bandhan khol nahin sakta aur na hi darvaaze khol sakta hai aur na bartan ka dhakkan hata sakta hai

Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) se marfooan warnit hai: Bartanon ko dhaanp do, mashkeezon ke mukh baandh do, darvaaze band kar do tatha chiraagh bujha do, kyonki shaitaan mashkeezon ke bandhan khol nahin sakta aur na hi darvaaze khol sakta hai aur na bartan ka dhakkan hata sakta hai. Yadi koi kuchh bhi na paye, to bartan par ek lakri hi rakh de aur Allah ka naam le le. (Chiraagh bujha diya kare) kyonki chooha ghar waalon ke ghar ko jala sakta hai.
8927: Abdullah bin rawaaha (radiyallahu anhu) behosh hue to unki bahan ro ro kar, he pahaar! Aadi baar- baar kahne lagi, to hosh mein aane ke pashchaat farmaya: Tumne jo kuchh kaha, mujhse kaha gaya ki kya tu aisa hi hai?

Noomaan bin basheer (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki abdullah bin rawaaha (radiyallahu anhu) behosh hue to unki bahan ro ro kar he pahaar! Aadi baar- baar kahne lagi, to hosh mein aane ke baad farmaya: Tumne jo kuchh kaha, mujhse kaha gaya ki kya tu aisa hi hai?
8928: Beshak Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apashgun nahin lete the
Buraida (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apashgun nahin lete the.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- kisi bhi cheez ka apashgun nahin lete the. Yaad rahe ki yahaan muraad aisa apashgun hai, jo insaan ko kisi kaam se rok de, jaisa ki ajnaan kaal mein hua karta tha. Islam ne apashgun lene, chiriya uraakar shagun maaloom karne aur teer ke dvaara kisi kaam ke karne yogy hone ya na hone ka pata lagaane jaisi cheezon se mana kiya hai aur inke badle mein istikhaara jaisi cheez pradaan ki hai.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8929: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamse jo nek wachan liye the ki ham unmen se kisi mein bhi aapki awajna na karen, we yeh the ki ham na chehre ko nochen aur na hi hay barbaadi! Hay barbaadi! Pukaaren aur na gareebaan phaaren aur na baalon ko nochen

Usaid bin abu usaid taabii, ek baiat karne waali sahaabiya se riwayat karte hain ki unhonne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamse jo nek wachan liye the aur aadesh diya tha ki ham unmen se kisi bhi wachan ka ullanghan na karen, unmen se yeh bhi tha ki ham (kisi ki maut ke gam mein) chehre ko na nochen aur na hi hay barbaadi, hay barbaadi! Pukaaren aur na gareebaan phaaren aur na baalon ko nochen ya baalon ko kholkar apne gam ka izhaar karen.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8930: Sote samay apne gharon mein aag jala kar na chhoro
Ibne umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se marfooan riwayat hai: Sote samay apne gharon mein aag jala kar na chhoro.
Hadees ka arth : Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apni ummat ko is baat se mana kar rahe hain ki we jalaai hui aag ko bujhaane se pahle so jayen.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8934: Ai logo! Jise kisi baat ka jnaan ho woh us baat ko kahe aur jise jnaan na ho woh kahe: Allah hi adhik jaanta hai, kyonki jise nahin jaanta uske baare mein yeh kahna ki Allah adhik jaanta hai, yeh bhi jnaan hai

Masrooq kahte hain ki ham log abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas gae, to unhonne farmaya: Ai logo! Jise kisi baat ka jnaan ho woh us baat ko kahe aur jise jnaan na ho woh kahe: Allah hi adhik jaanta hai, kyonki jise nahin jaanta uske baare mein yeh kahna ki Allah adhik jaanta hai, yeh bhi jnaan hai. Allah taaala ne apne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se kaha hai: Kaho, main tum se is par pratikaar nahin maangta aur na hi main takalluf (svaang) karne waal hoon.
8944: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne aadmi ko khare hokar joota pahanne se mana farmaya hai
Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne aadmi ko khare hokar joota pahanne se mana farmaya hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8945: Ham umar radiyallahu anhu ke paas maujood the ki isi dauraan unhonne kaha : "Hamen takalluf karne yaani bina zaroorat kasht uthaane se mana kiya gaya hai.

Anas radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ham umar radiyallahu anhu ke paas maujood the ki isi dauraan unhonne kaha : "Hamen takalluf karne yaani bina zaroorat kasht uthaane se mana kiya gaya hai."
Umar radiyallahu anhu bata rahe hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unko aisa kaam karne tatha aisi baat kahne se mana kiya hai, jiske liye bina zaroorat mashaqqat uthaani pare.

Is hadees mein jis takalluf se mana kiya gaya hai, usmen adhik prashn karna, aisa kaam karna jiski jaankaari na ho tatha kisi aisi sakhti mein parna ya daalna bhi shaamil hai, jismen na parne ya daalne ki Allah ne gunjaaish di hai.
Insaan ko apne vyaktitv mein udaarta rakhna chahiye aur khaane, peene, baat-cheet aur any cheezon mein anaawashyak kasht uthaane se bachna chahiye.
Islam ek saral  tatha aasaan dharm hai.
8946: Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Ghanti shaitaan ka bhajan hai.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- bata rahe hain ki jaanavron ke gale mein baandhi jaane waali ghantiyaan shaitaani upakran hain, jinmen logon mein vyast karke woh unhen unki rachna ke uddeshy se bhatkaye rakhna chaahta hai. Rahi baat soochna pradaan karne waali ghantiyon ki, to saoodi arab ki sthayi fatva kameti ne unke baare mein kaha hai : "Gharon evn shikshan sansthaanon mein istemaal mein aane waali ghantiyaan jayaz hain, jab tak unke andar koi awaidh wastu na paai jaye. Maslan unka eesaaiyon ke naaqoos ke jaisa hona ya sangeet ki tarah aawaaz dena aadi. Agar yeh baat paai jaye, to haraam hongi."
8947: Jo log yeh chitr banaate hain, unhen qayaamat ke din yaatna di jayegi aur unse kaha jayega: Jo tumne banaya hai, use jeewit karo

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Jo log yeh chitr banaate hain, unhen qayaamat ke din yaatna di jayegi aur unse kaha jayega: Jo tumne banaya hai, use jeewit karo.

Jo log kisi praan waali cheez, jaise insaan athva jaanvar ka chitr banaate hain, chaahe chitr taraashkar banayen, pent evn brash se banayen ya photograaph ke roop mein banayen, isi tarah chaahe chitr tuchchh ho ya na ho, unhen unke is karm ke badle mein qayaamat ke din yaatna di jayegi. Kyonki apne is kaam dvaara we Allah ki rachna ki baraabri karna chaahte hain. Tatha unse kaha jayega : "Use jeewit karo" Yaani jis prakaar tumne shareer banaya hai, usi prakaar usmen praan paida karo. "Jise tumne paida kiya hai" Yaani jiska tumne chitr banaya hai, jo Allah ki rachna ke samaan hai. Jab tumne Allah ke samaan srishti karne ka kaam kiya hai, to usmen praan daalkar dikhaao. Yeh daraasal ek prakaar ki dhamki evn daant-dapat hai.
Saheeh Bukhari evn saheeh Muslim mein abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- se warnit hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Jisne duniya mein koi chitr banaya, use qayaamat ke din usmen praan daalne ko kaha jayega aur woh aisa kar nahin sakega." Jabki saheeh Bukhari ki ek riwayat mein hai : "Jisne koi chitr banaya use Allah us samay tak yaatna deta rahega, jab tak usmen praan na daal de."
Imaam navvi kahte hain : "Ulema ne kaha hai : Kisi praani ka chitr banaana ek ghor awaidh kaary tatha maha-paap hai. Kyonki uske baare mein woh chetaavni di gai hai, jiska ullekh is hadees mein hai. Chaahe chitr kisi aisi cheez par banaya jaye jo tuchchh ho ya aisi cheez par banaya jaye jo tuchchh na ho. Use banaana har awastha mein haraam hai. Kyonki yeh ek prakaar se Allah ki rachna ki baraabri karna hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8948: Masjiden paakhaana- peshaab ke liye nahin hoti hain, balki Allah ke smaran tatha Qur'an ke pathan- paathan ke liye hoti hain

Anas (radiyallahu anhu) se marfooan riwayat hai ki masjiden paakhaana- peshaab ke liye nahin hoti hain, balki Allah ke smaran aur namaz tatha Qur'an ke pathan- paathan ke liye hoti hain, ya jis tarah Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya hai.
8949: Ek vyakti ne masjid mein kuchh dhoondhte hue kaha: Kaun laal oont ko pahchaanta hai. Ispar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Tumhen na mile, kyonki masjiden kewal un kaamon ke liye hoti hain jinke liye woh banaai gai hain.

Buraida (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki ek vyakti ne masjid mein kuchh dhoondhte hue kaha: Kaun laal oont ko pahchaanta hai. Ispar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Tumhen na mile, kyonki masjiden kewal un kaamon ke liye hoti hain jinke liye woh banaai gai hain.
8950: Farishte us ghar mein prawesh nahin karte jis ghar mein kutte aur chitr hon.
Abu talha radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Farishte us ghar mein prawesh nahin karte jis ghar mein kutte aur chitr hon."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki rahmat ke farishte us ghar mein prawesh nahin karte, jismen kutta tatha praan waali cheezon ki tasveer ho. Kyonki praan waali cheezon ki tasveer banaana ek bara gunaah, rachna kaary mein Allah ke samaan hone ka daawa aur shirk ka zariya hai. Kuchh tasveeren to un cheezon ki bhi hua karti hai, jinko Allah ko chhorkar pooja jaata hai. Jis ghar mein kutta ho, usmen farishte prawesh isliye nahin karte ki kutta gandi cheezen bahut zyaada khaata hai aur isliye ki kuchh kutton ko shaitaan bhi kaha jaata hai. Jabki farishte shaitaan ke wipreet hain. Teesri baat yeh hai ki kutte ke shareer se badbu aati hai aur farishton ko badbu se nafrat hai. Chauthi baat yeh hai ki kutta paalna mana hai, isliye kutta paalne waale ka dand yeh nirdhaarit kiya gaya hai ki rahmat ke farishte uske ghar mein prawesh nahin karenge, uske ghar ke dua nahin maanenge, uske liye kshama nahin maangenge, uske tatha uske ghar ke liye barkat ki dua nahin karenge aur use shaitaan ke dvaara diye gae kashton se bachaane ka kaam nahin karenge.

Kutta rakhne ki manaahi. Haan, magar shikaar karne, maweshi tatha kheti-baari ki suraksha ke liye kutta rakha ja sakta hai.
Tasveer rakhna un buraaiyon mein se ek hai, jinse farishte nafrat karte hain. Ghar mein tasveer rakhna daya se wanchit ho jaane ka kaaran hai. Isi tarah ghar mein kutta rakhna bhi daya se wanchit ho jaane ka kaaran hai.
Jo farishte kutte aur tasveer waale ghar mein prawesh nahin karte, woh rahmat ke farishte hain. Jahaan tak insaan ke karm likhne par niyukt aur doosri zimmewaariyaan nibhaane waale farishton, jaise maut ka farishta aadi, ki baat hai, to we har ghar mein prawesh karte hain.
Praan waali cheezon ki tasveeren deewaaron aadi par latkaana haraam hai.
Khattaabi kahte hain : Farishte aise ghar mein prawesh karne se gurez karte hain, jismen aisa kutta ho jise rakhna haraam hai, aur aisi tasveer ho jise banaana haraam hai. Jin kutton ka rakhna haaram nahin hai, jaise shikaari kutta aur kheti tatha maweshi ki dekhbhaal karne waala kutta aur jin tasveeron ka rakhna haraam nahin hai, jaise chaadar evn takiya aadi par bani hui rondi jaane waali tasveeren, to woh farishton ke prawesh mein rukaawat ka sabab nahin banteen.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
8951: Farishte un logon ke saath nahin hote, jinke saath kutta ya ghanti ho.
Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Farishte un logon ke saath nahin hote, jinke saath kutta ya ghanti ho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki farishte us qaafile ke saath nahin rahte, jiske saath kutta ya ghanti ho, jise jaanavron ke galon mein baandha jaata hai aur jo hilne par bajti hai.

Kutta paalne aur use saath rakhne ki manaahi. Lekin shikaari aur nigraani karne waala kutta isse apvaad hai.
Jo farishte is tarah ki paristhitiyon mein saath rahne se gurez karte hain, woh rahmat ke farishte hain. Insaan ke karm likhne par niyukt farishte yaatra evn thahraav mein hamesha saath rahte hain. Kabhi juda nahin hote.
Ghanti ki manaahi. Kyonki ghanti shaitaan ki baansuri aur eesaaiyon ke naaqoos jaisi cheez hai.
Ek musalmaan ko un sabhi cheezon se door rahne ka prayaas karna chahiye, jo farishton ko usse door karne ka kaam karti hain.
8952: Yadi tum donnon isi shahar ke hote to main tumhen kasht deta, tum Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki masjid mein aawaaz oonchi karte ho

Saaib bin yazeed (rajiyallahu anhu), jo ek sahaabi the, kahte hain ki main masjid-e- nabvi mein tha. Itne mein ek vyakti nen mujhe kankar maara. Mainne dekha to woh umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) hain. Unhonne mujh se farmaya: In donon ko mere paas le aao, to main unhen lekar aya. Aapne un donon se farmaya: Tum kahaan se aye ho? Un donon ne kaha: Taaif se. Aapne farmaya: Yadi tum donon isi shahar ke hote to main tumhen kasht deta. Tum Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki masjid mein aawaaz oonchi karte ho.

Saaib bin yazeed -radiyallahu anhuma- ek ghatna ke baare mein bata rahe hain, jo unki upasthiti mein ghati thi. Hua yoon ki umar -radiyallahu anhu- ke zamaane mein do vyakti Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki masjid mein aawaaz oonchi kiye hue the. Jab umar -radiyallahu anhu- ne unki aawaaz suni, to unhonne saaib bin yazeed ko ek kankar maarkar sachet kiya, aur aisa is liye kiya ki woh un donon ko umar -radiyallahu anhu- ke paas lekar ayen.
Saaib kahte hain ki main donon ko unke paas laya, to unse poochha ki tum kahaan se aye ho?
Donon ne uttar diya : Taaif se.
Ispar farmaya : Yadi tum madeene ke rahne waale hote, to main tumhen dandit karta. Tum Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki masjid mein aawaaz oonchi karte ho! Choonki donon madeene ke niwaasi nahin the, isliye unki anbhijnata ko aadhaar banaakar unko kshama kar diya. Kyonki aam taur par is prakaar ke logon ko shareeyat ki bahut-si baaten maaloom nahin hoteen.
8953: Ai logon! Tum yeh donon padaarth- pyaaz evn lahsun- khaate ho, main inko bura samajhta hoon

Umar bin khattaab (rajiyallahu anhu) ne juma ke pravchan mein farmaya: Ai logo! Tum yeh donon padaarth- pyaaz evn lahsun- khaate ho, parantu main inko bura samajhta hoon. Kaaran yeh hai ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dekha ki jab aap masjid mein kisi vyakti se iski durgandh paate to use baqi ki or nikaal dete. Jo use khaana chaahe, use paka kar khaye.

Umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ne juma ke din khutba mein upasthit logon ko sanbodhit karte hue kaha ki we do badbu waale paudhe yaani pyaaz evn lahsun khaate hain. Yahaan hadees mein aye hue shabd "خَبِيثَتَيْن" Mein الخُبث se muraad badboodaar hona hai. Arab ke log "الخبيث" Shabd ka prayog har dooshit evn apriy kathan, karm, dhan, bhojan athva vyakti ke liye karte hain.
Iska pramaan jaabir -radiyallahu anhu- ki yeh hadees hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Jo is badboodaar paudhe ko khaye, woh hamaari masjid ke nikat na aye." Ise imaam Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.
"Pyaaz tatha lahsun" Isi tarah har woh paudha, jisse apriy gandh aati ho, jaise mooli evn gandana aadi aur wishesh roop se tanbaaku aur sigret. Pyaaz evn lahsun ka ullekh isliye kiya gaya hai, kyonki khaane mein inka sewan adhik hota hai. Gandana ka ullekh saheeh musli ke andar jaabir -radiyallahu anhu- ki hadees mein maujood hai.
"Jab aap masjid mein kisi vyakti se in donon ki durgandh paate, to use nikaal baahar karne ka aadesh dete aur use baqi ki or nikaal diya jaata." Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- use kewal masjid se nikaalte hi nahin the, balki masjid se door bhejte hue baqi tak pahuncha dete the. Aisa uski saza ke taur par karte the. Kyonki isse logon ko to kasht hota hi hai, farishton ko bhi kasht hota hai, jaisa ki saheeh hadees mein ullikhit hai.
"Atah jo unhen khaana chaahe, woh unhen pakaakar khaye." Kyonki pakaane ke baad unki badbu khatm ho jaati hai. Phir jab badbu khatm ho jaye, to unhen khaane ke baad masjid mein prawesh karna jayaz hoga. Kyonki woh sabab hi nahin raha, jiski wajah se mana kiya gaya tha. Muaawiya bin qurra ne apne pita se aur unhonne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se riwayat kiya hai ki aapne farmaya : "Yadi tum in donon paudhon ko khaana chaahte hi ho, to inhen paka liya karo." Ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. Yaad rahe ki unhen pakaane ka aadesh us samay ke liye hai, jab aadmi namaz parhne ke liye ya kisi aur kaam ke liye masjid jaana chaahe. Yadi namaz ka samay na ho, to unhen kachcha khaane mein koi harj nahin hai. Kyonki unhen khaana jayaz hai aur pakaane ka aadesh kewal kasht se bachaane ke liye hai.
8954: Jis vyakti ke paas qurbaani ka jaanvar ho, jise woh zabah karne ka iraada rakhta ho, to jul-hijja ka chaand nikal aane ke baad woh qurbaani se pahle apne baalon aur naakhunon mein se kuchh na kaate.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki patni, musalmaanon ki maata umm-e-salma -radiyallahu anha- se riwayat hai, woh kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jis vyakti ke paas qurbaani ka jaanvar ho, jise woh zabah karne ka iraada rakhta ho, to jul-hijja ka chaand nikal aane ke baad woh qurbaani se pahle apne baalon aur naakhunon mein se kuchh na kaate."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne aadesh diya ki jo vyakti qurbaani karne ka iraada rakhta ho, woh zul-hijja ka chaand nikal jaane ke baad se qurbaani kar lene tak apne sar athva bagal ke baal ya moonchh tatha haath evn paanv ka naakhoon na kaate.

Jisne zul-hijja ke aaranbhik das din shuru hone ke baad qurbaani ki neeyat ki, woh neeyat karne ke baad se qurbaani karne tak oopar bayaan kiye gae kaaryon ko karne se bache.
Agar koi pahle din qurbaani na kare, to woh tashreeq ke us din tak oopar bayaan kiye gae kaaryon se bache, jis din qurbaani kare.
8955: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne juma ke din jabki imaam jume ka pravchan de raha ho, donon taangen khari karke chootar ke bal baithne se mana farmaya hai

Muaaz bin anas juhni (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne juma ke din jabki imaam pravchan de raha ho, donon taangen khari karke chootar ke bal baithne se mana farmaya hai.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8956: Ai Allah! Main tujhse iski bhalaai tatha jo bhalaai ismen rakhi gai hai aur jis bhalaai ke saath yeh bheji gai hai, ka sawaal karta hoon aur teri sharan maangta hoon, iski buraai se tatha us buraai se jo ismen rakhi gai hai aur us buraai se jis ke saath yeh bheji gai hai

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab tez hawayen chalteen to yeh dua parha karte the: «اللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أسْأَلُك خَيرها وخير ما فيها وخَير ما أُرسِلت به، وأعوذ بك من شرِّها وشرِّ ما فيها وشرِّ ما أُرسِلت به» arthaat, “Ai Allah ! Main tujhse iski bhalaai tatha jo bhalaai ismen rakhi gai hai aur jis bhalaai ke saath yeh bheji gai hai, ka sawaal karta hoon aur teri sharan maangta hoon, iski buraai se tatha us buraai se jo ismen mein rakhi gai hai aur us buraai se jis ke saath yeh bheji gai hai.”

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- bataati hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki aadat yeh thi ki jab aandhi aati, to yeh dua parhte : "Ai Allah ! Main tujhse iski bhalaai tatha jo bhalaai ismen rakhi gai hai aur jis bhalaai ke saath yeh bheji gai hai, ka sawaal karta hoon aur teri sharan maangta hoon, iski buraai se tatha us buraai se jo ismen mein rakhi gai hai aur us buraai se jiske saath yeh bheji gai hai." Allah ki paida ki gai wayu ke do prakaar hain :
Pahla : Saadhaaran wayu, jo daraavni na ho. Iske liye koi niyukt zikr nahin hai.
Doosra : Tez chalne waali wayu, jo daraavni ho. Kyonki Allah ne aad samuday ko baanjh aandhi dvaara halaak kar diya tha. Atah jab aandhi aye, to yeh dua parh liya karo, jo Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- parha karte the : "Ai Allah ! Main tujhse iski bhalaai tatha jo bhalaai ismen rakhi gai hai aur jis bhalaai ke saath yeh bheji gai hai, ka sawaal karta hoon." Iske maadhyam se Allah se is wayu ki bhalaai maango aur woh apne andar laabh ke roop mein jo bhalaai rakhti hai, use maango. Kyonki use kabhi to bhalaai ke saath bheja jaata hai aur kabhi buraai ke saath. Atah use jin baaton ke saath bheja gaya hai, unki bhalaai maango.
"Aur teri sharan maangta hoon, iski buraai se tatha us buraai se jo ismen mein rakhi gai hai aur us buraai se jiske saath yeh bheji gai hai." Yaani tum Allah ki sharan maangon uski buraai se, woh jo kuchh apne saath rakhti hai uski buraai se aur use jiske saath bheja gaya hai uski buraai se. Kyonki aandhi kabhi-kabhi kisi samuday ke liye yaatna ke roop mein aati hai, atah use uski buraai se Allah ki sharan maangni chahiye.
Jab insaan uski buाrai se, uske saath jo kuchh hai uski buraai se aur use jiske saath bheja gaya hai uski buraai se Allah ki sharan maangta hai, to use Allah uski buraai se bachaata hai aur uski bhalaai se laabhaanvit hone ka avsar deta hai.
8957: Hawa Allah ki rahmat hai aur rahmat aur yaatna donon lekar aati hai. To jab tum use dekho, gaali mat do, balki Allah se uski bhalaai maango aur uski buraai se Allah ki sharan maango

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue suna hai: Hawa Allah ki rahmat hai. Kabhi rahmat aur kabhi yaatna lekar aati hai. To jab tum use dekho, gaali mat do, balki Allah se uski bhalaai maango aur uski buraai se Allah ki sharan maango.

Wayu bandon par Allah ki ek anukanpa hai, jo kabhi anukanpa ke saath aati hai aur kabhi yaatna ke saath. Allah wayu ko apne bandon ke liye anukanpa ke roop mein bhejta hai aur uske zariye logon ko bhalaai evn barkat praapt hoti hai. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ka farmaan hai : "Aur hamne jalabhri wayuon ko bheja." Ek any sthaan par uska farmaan hai : "Allah hi hai, jo wayuon ko bhejta hai. Phir woh baadal uthaati hain. Phir woh use phailaata hai aakaash mein jaise chaahta hai, aur use ghanghor bana deta hai. To tum dekhte ho boondon ko nikalte uske beech se." Ek aur sthaan mein uska farmaan hai : "Aur wahi hai, jo apni daya (warsha) se pahle wayuon ko (warsha) ki shubh soochna dene ke liye bhejta hai aur jab we bhaari baadlon ko liye urti hain, to ham use kisi nirjeev dharti ko (jeewit) karne ke liye pahuncha dete hain, phir usse jal warsha kar, uske dvaara pratyek prakaar ke phal upja dete hain."
Jabki kabhi yaatna ke saath aati hai. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ka farmaan hai : "Antatah, hamne bhej di unpar prachand wayu, kuchh ashubh dinon mein. Taaki unhen apmaankaari yaatna ka svaad chakhayen saansaarik jeewan mein." Ek any sthaan mein uska farmaan hai : "Hamne bhej di unpar kari aandhi, ek nirantar ashubh din mein. Jo ukhaar rahi thi logon ko, jaise we khajoor ke khokhle tane hon." Ek aur sthaan mein uska farmaan hai : "Un logon ne kaha : Ye ek baadal hai, hampar barasne waala. Balki ye wahi hai, jiski tumne jaldi machaai hai. Ye aandhi hai, jismen dukhdayi yaatna hai."
Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Jab tum use dekho, to use gaali mat do." Atah kisi musalmaan ke liye wayu ko gaali dena jayaz nahin hai. Kyonki woh Allah ki ek srishti hai, uske aadesh se chalti hai aur uska apna koi prabhaav nahin hota. Allah ke aadesh ke bina na kisi ka laabh kar sakti hai, na haani. Atah use gaali dena daraasal uske srishtikarta evn sanchaalak yaani uchch evn mahaan Allah ko gaali dena hoga.
Aage farmaya : "Atah Allah se uski bhalaai maangon aur uski buraai se usi ki sharan maango." Wayu ko gaali dene se mana karne ke baad aapne apni ummat ko nirdesh diya ki Allah se uski bhalaai maangen aur uski buraai se uski sharan maangen.
Yaani Allah se dua karen ki wayu ke andar jo bhalaai hai, woh unko pradaan kare aur uske andar jo buraai hai, use unse door rakhe.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8958: Khareed- bikri mein adhik qasam khaane se bacho, kyonki kasam barha kar phir ghata deti hai

Abu qataada (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue suna: Khareed- bikri mein adhik qasam khaane se bacho, kyonki kasam saamaan bechvaakar munaafa saamyik roop se barha to deti hai magar phir ghata bhi deti hai.
8959: Buton tatha apne baap- daadaaon ki qasam mat khaao.
Abdur rahmaan bin samura radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Buton tatha apne baap- daadaaon ki qasam mat khaao."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam "Tawaaghi" Ki qasam khaane se mana farma rahe hain. "Tawaaghi" Bahuvchan hai, "Taaghiyah" Ka. Muraad aise but hain, jinki pooja Allah ko chhorkar mushrik log kiya karte the. Yahi but unki sarakshi evn awishvaas ka sabab the. Isi prakaar aap poorvajon ki qasam khaane se mana kar rahe hain. Kyonki Islam-poorv yug mein arbon mein apne baap daadaaon ki qasam khaakar garv aur sammaan ki bhaavna rakhne ka prachlan tha.

Qasam bas Allah aur uske naamon evn gunon ki khaana jayaz hai.
Allah ke sthaan par pooje waale jaane buton, apne poorvajon, saragnon, moortiyon aur is prakaar ki any asaty cheezon ki qasam khaana jayaz nahin hai.
Allah ke atirikt ki qasam khaana waise to chhota shirk hai, lekin dil mein uski Allah ke jaisa sammaan baith jaye ya use ibaadat ka haqdaar samajh liya jaye, to yeh bara shirk ho jaata hai.
8960: Murghe ko gaali mat do, kyonki woh namaz ke liye jagaata hai
Zaid bin khaalid juhni (radiyallahu anhu) se marfooan warnit hai: Murghe ko gaali mat do, kyonki woh namaz ke liye jagaata hai.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8961: Bukhaar ko gaali mat do, kyonki woh aadam ki santaan ke paapon ko usi prakaar khatm kar deta hai, jaise lohaar ki dhaunkni lohe ke zang ko khatm kar deti hai

Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam), umme saaib athva umme musaiyib (radiyallahu anha) ke paas gae aur farmaya: Ai umme saaib athva umme musaiyib! Kya baat hai, kaanp rahi ho? Unhonne kaha: Bukhaar hai, Allah usmen barkat na de. Aapne farmaya: Bukhaar ko gaali mat do, kyonki woh aadam ki santaan ke paapon ko usi prakaar khatm kar deta hai, jaise lohaar ki dhaunkni lohe ke zang ko khatm kar deti hai.
8962: Munaafiq ko saiyad (aaqa, sardaar) mat kaho, kyonki yadi woh saiyad hai, to tumne apne rab ko naaraaz kiya

Buraida (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Munaafiq ko saiyad (maalik, aaqa, sardaar) mat kaho, kyonki yadi woh saiyad hai, to tumne apne rab ko naaraaz kiya.

Is hadees ka arth yeh hai ki yadi munaafiq apni jaati ka sardaar ho aur tumne use 'saiyad' ke laqab se pukaara, to tumne Allah ko naaraaz kar diya. Kyonki is laqab se use pukaarne ka matlab uska sammaan karna hai aur munaafiq sammaan ka haqdaar nahin hai. Iske wipreet yadi woh apne jaati ka sardaar na ho aur tumne use 'saiyad' kaha, to tumne jhooth aur saty ke wipreet baat kahi. Atah donon paristhitiyon mein munaafiq ke liye 'saiyad' shabd bolna mana hai. Isi tarah kaafir, awajnaakaari aur bidaati ke liye bhi is shabd ka prayog mana hai. Yeh log is laqab ke haqdaar hain hi nahin. Is manaahi mein sahaaba bhi aate hain aur unke baad ke log bhi. Yaad rahe ki sahaaba ke zamaane mein munaafiq do prakaar ke the. Pahla : Aise munaafik, jinhen kewal Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aur aapke bhed se avgat sahaabi huzaifa -radiyallahu anhu- jaante the. Doosra : Aise munaafiq, jinke nifaaq se sahaaba gan avgat the. Jaise abdullah bin ubai aur us jaise log. Isi prakaar ke nifaaq par yeh hadees laagu hoti hai.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8963: Tummen se jo apne pariwaar ke prati qasam khaata hai aur uspar atal rahta hai, to woh prayashchit, jise Allah ne uspar farz kiya hai, use dene aur qasam na torne ke wipreet adhik paapi hai

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Tummen se jo apne pariwaar ke prati qasam khaata hai aur uspar atal rahta hai, to woh prayashchit, jise Allah ne uspar farz kiya hai, use dene aur qasam na torne ke muqaable mein adhik paapi hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
8964: Jisne amaanat ki qasam khaai, woh hammen se nahin hai.
Buraida radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jisne amaanat ki qasam khaai, woh hammen se nahin hai."
Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne amaanat ki qasam khaane se mana aur saavdhaan kiya hai tatha bataya hai ki aisa karne waala ham mein se nahin hai.

Allah ko chhor kisi aur ki qasam khaana haraam hai, jismen amaanat ki qasam khaana bhi hai. Amaanat ki qasam khaana chhota shirk hai.
Amaanat ke andar anusran, ibaadat, kisi ke paas suraksha ke liye rakha gaya saamaan, naqdi aur amaan dena aadi shaamil hain.
Qasam usi samay maany hogi, jab Allah ki, uske kisi naam ki ya uske kisi gun ki khaai jaye.
Khattaabi kahte hain : Yeh naapsandeedgi is bina par ho sakti hai ki shareeyat ne Allah aur uske gunon ki qasam khaane ka aadesh diya hai aur amaanat uska gun nahin, balki uska aadesh aur uski or se aniwaary kiya hua ek kaary hai. Atah isse mana kar diya gaya, kyonki yeh Allah ke aadeshon aur uske aniwaary kiye hue kaaryon ko uske naamon evn gunon ke samaan bataane jaisa hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
8965: Jisne qasam khaate hue kaha: Beshak main Islam se bari hoon, aur woh jhootha hai, to woh waisa hi hai, jaisa ki usne kaha hai aur yadi woh sachcha hai, to Islam mein surakshit nahin laut sakega

Buraida (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Jisne qasam khaate hue kaha: Main Islam se bari hoon, aur woh jhootha hai, to woh waisa hi hai, jaisa ki usne kaha hai aur yadi woh sachcha hai, to Islam mein surakshit nahin laut sakega.

Jisne qasam khaai aur kaha ki woh Islam se bari hai, ya phir kaha ki woh yahoodi, eesaai, kaafir ya naastik hai, to uski do awasthayen ho sakti hain :
Pahli awastha : Usne jis baat ki qasam khaai hai, usmen jhootha ho. Maslan qasam khaye ki yadi baat aisi aur aisi ho, to woh Islam se bari hai. Phir, woh apni bataai hui baat mein jhootha bhi ho. Maslan yadi usne bataya ki aaj zaid yaatra se waapas a gaya hai aur phir apni baat ki pushti ke liye Islam se bari hone ya yahoodi, eesaai athva mushrik hone ki qasam kha li, jabki use pata ho ki woh jhooth bol raha hai, to woh sachmuch apne kahe anusaar Islam se bari, yahoodi ya eesaai hai.
Doosri awastha : Woh apni baat mein sachcha ho. Maslan yadi Islam se bari hone ya yahoodi ya eesaai hone ki qasam khaakar bataya ki aaj zaid apni yaatra se waapas a gaya hai ya usne aisa kaam nahin kiya hai, phir woh apni baat mein sachcha bhi hai, to is awastha mein bhi woh Islam ki or surakshit waapas nahin hoga. Jaisa ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is hadees mein ullekh kiya hai. Balki hoga yeh ki is anuchit shabd ke uchchaaran ke kaaran uske Islam ki sanpoornata mein kami a jayegi.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10008: (Namaz) ki qaja nahin karegi. Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki beewiyaan nifaas ki dasha mein chaalees raat tak baithi rahteen, lekin Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) unhen nifaas ke samay ki chhooti hui namaazen parhne ka aadesh nahin dete the

Kaseer bin ziyaad kahte hain ki mujhe azdiya arthaat mussa ne bataya ki mainne tark kiya aur umme salma (radiyallahu anha) ke paas gai aur unse mainne kaha: Ai ummul momineen! Samura bin jundub mahilaaon ko maahvaari khoon ki dasha ki namaz ki kaza ka aadesh dete hain, to aapne kaha: (Namaz ki) qaja nahin karegi. Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki beewiyaan nifaas ki dasha mein chaalees raat tak baithi rahteen, lekin Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) unhen nifaas ke samay ki chhooti hui namaazen parhne ka aadesh nahin dete. Ek riwayat mein hai: Ham apne saron ko wars (ek paudhe ka naam) ke laal evn kaale rang se rang leti theen.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10010: Yeh ek aisi cheez hai, jise Allah ne aadam ki betiyon par likh di hai. Tum woh saare kaary karti jaao, jo doosre haaji karte hain. Haan, paak hone se pahle Allah ke ghar ka tawaaf (parikrama) mat karna

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki ham Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath nikle aur hamaare beech charcha ka wishay kewal Hajj tha. Jab ham 'sarif' naami sthaan par pahunche, to mujhe maahvaari a gai. (Isi beech) Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) mere paas aye to main ro rahi thi. Yeh dekhkar aapne kaha: Tumhen kya cheez rula rahi hai? Mainne kaha: Allah ki qasam! Mera dil kahta hai ki main is saal Hajj ke liye na nikli hoti to achchha hota. Aapne kaha: Baat kya hai? Shayad tumhaari maahvaari shuru ho gai hai? Mainne kaha: Ji haan. Aapne farmaya: Yeh ek aisi cheez hai jise Allah taaala ne aadam ki betiyon par likh diya hai. Tum woh saare kaary karti jaao jo doosre haaji karte hain. Haan, paak hone se pahle Allah ke ghar ka tawaaf (parikrama) na karna. Woh kahti hain: Jab main makka pahunchi to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apne saathiyon se kaha: Hajj ki neeyat ko badalkar Umrah kar lo. Isliye (Umrah ke kaary karne ke baad) saare log halaal ho gae, siway unke jo saath mein qurbaani ka jaanvar laye the. Woh kahti hain ki qurbaani ke jaanvar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam), abu bakr, umar aur dhanvaan sahaaba (radiyallahu anhum) ke saath the. Phir jab sab log (tarviya ke din mina ki or) chale to Hajj ka talbiya pukaarte hue chale. Woh kahti hain ki jab qurbaani ka din aya to main paak ho gai. Atah, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne mujhe aadesh diya aur mainne tawaaf-e-ifaaza (widaai parikrama) kar liya. Woh kahti hain ki (us din) hamen maans bheja gaya. Mainne kaha: Yeh kya hai? Logon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apni striyon ki or se gay ki qurbaani ki hai. Phir jab mina se nikalkar muhassab mein thaharne ki raat aai to mainne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Log Hajj aur Umrah karke lautenge aur main kewal Hajj karke lautoongi? Woh kahti hain ki tab aapne abdurrahmaan bin abu bakr ko aadesh diya aur unhonne apne oont par mujhe peechhe bitha liya. Unka kahna hai ki mujhe achchhi tarah yaad hai, main ek alpayu larki thi. Oonghne lagti aur mera sar kajaawe ke pichhle bhaag ki lakri se takra jaata. Ham tanaeem pahunche to hamne wahaan umre ka talbiya pukaara, us Umrah ke badle mein jo logon ne kiya tha.
10011: Ai aurto! Tum sadqa kiya karo, kyonki mainne Jahannam ke andar tumhaari sankhya adhik dekhi hai." Aurton ne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aisa kyon hai? Aapne uttar diya : "Tum laanat adhik karti ho aur pati ki naashukri karti ho. Mainne wiwek evn deen mein adhoori hone ke baavjood tum (aurton) se zyaada kisi ko bhi ek wiweksheel vyakti ke wiwek ko bhramit kar dene waala nahin dekha.

Abu saeed khu़dari radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- eed al-azha ya eed al-fitr ke din eedgaah ki or nikle aur is dauraan aurton ke nikat se guzre, to farmaya : "Ai aurto! Tum sadqa kiya karo, kyonki mainne Jahannam ke andar tumhaari sankhya adhik dekhi hai." Aurton ne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aisa kyon hai? Aapne uttar diya : "Tum laanat adhik karti ho aur pati ki naashukri karti ho. Mainne wiwek evn deen mein adhoori hone ke baavjood tum (aurton) se zyaada kisi ko bhi ek wiweksheel vyakti ke wiwek ko bhramit kar dene waala nahin dekha." Aurton ne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Hamaare deen aur hamaare wiwek ki kami kya hai? Aapne uttar diya : "Kya aurat ki gawaahi mard ki aadhi gawaahi ke baraabar nahin hai?" Unhonne kaha : Ji hai. Aapne kaha : "Yahi uske wiwek ki kami ko darshaata hai. Kya aisa nahin hai ki jab aurat maahvaari ki awastha mein hoti hai, to na namaz parh sakti hai, na roza rakh sakti hai?" Aurton ne kaha : Ji, aisa to hai. Aapne farmaya : "Yahi uske deen ki kami ko darshaata hai."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- eed ke din eedgaah ki or nikle. Choonki aapne mahilaaon se waada kar rakha tha ki unhen alag se deen ki baaten batayenge, isliye us din waada poora kar diya. Is dauraan aapne kaha : Ai aurto! Tum sadqa kiya karo aur adhik se adhik kshama maanga karo ki donon gunaahon ko mitaye jaane ke do mahatvapoorn saadhan hain. Kyonki mainne isra ki raat Jahannam mein tum hi ko sab se zyaada dekha hai.

Yeh sun ek buddhimaan evn shaant mahila ne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Jahannam mein hamaari sankhya adhik hone ka kaaran kya hai?

Aapne uttar diya : Iske kai kaaran hain : Tum bahut zyaada dhikkaar aur gaali galauj karti ho tatha pati ke adhikaar ka inkaar karti ho. Aapne unki wisheshta bayaan karte hue farmaya : Mainne wiwek evn deen mein adhoori hone ke baavjood tum (aurton) se zyaada kisi ko bhi ek wiweksheel, doordarshi evn dhairyawaan vyakti ke wiwek ko bhramit kar dene waala nahin dekha.

Us mahila ne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Hamaare wiwek aur hamaare deen ki kami kahaan se zaahir hoti hai?

Aapne uttar diya : Wiwek ki kami yahaan se zaahir hoti hai ki do striyon ki gawaahi ek purush ki gawaahi ke baraabar maani gai hai, jabki deen ki kami is taur par saamne aati hai ki uske achchhe karm kam hote hain. Woh is tarah ki woh maahvaari ke kaaran kai dinon tak namaz nahin parh paati aur Ramzan mein uske kai roze chhoot jaate hain. Parantu iske liye unhen na to doshi thahraya jaata hai aur na hi unse koi poochhtaachh ya pakar hogi; kyonki yeh unki mool rachna ka hissa hai. Theek usi tarah jaise manushy ko svabhaav se hi dhan se prem karne waala, apne maamlon mein jaldabaaz aur ajnaani... Wagairah banaya gaya hai. Lekin is baat par dhyaan isliye dilaya gaya hai taaki (purushon ko) unse hone waale moh ya phitne se saavdhaan kiya ja sake.

Aurton ka eed ki namaz ke liye nikalna aur unke liye eedgaah mein alag se deen ki baat sunaane ki vyawastha karna musathab hai.
Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki pati ki awajna karna maha paap hai, kyonki Jahannam ki dhamki isi shreni ke gunaah par hi di jaati hai.
Is hadees mein eemaan ke ghatne evn barhne ka bayaan hai. Jisne apni ibaadat ko barhaya, uske deen evn eemaan mein wriddhi hogi aur jisne apni ibaadat mein kami ki, uske deen mein kami hogi.
Navvi kahte hain : Aql mein kami-beshi ho sakti hai aur isi tarah eemaan mein bhi kami-beshi ho sakti hai. Dhyaan rahe ki aurton ke andar kami hone ki baat karne ka uddeshy unhen dosh dena nahin hai. Kyonki yeh kami unke andar praakritik roop se maujood hai. Yahaan use bayaan karne ka uddeshy unke fitne mein parne se sachet karna hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki dand ka aadhaar pati ki naashukri aadi ko bataya gaya hai, unke andar paai jaane waali kami ko nahin. Yahaan yeh bhi yaad rahe ki deen ki kami ka dayra unheen kaaryon tak seemit nahin hai, jinse gunaah hota hai, balki usmen isse kaheen adhik wistaar hai.
Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki agar baat ka matlab spasht na hota ho, to chhaatr apne shikshak se aur anuyayi  apne pathapradarshak se spasht karne ka aagrah kar sakta hai.
Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki aurat ki gawaahi mard ki tulna mein aadhi hai, kyonki uske andar sahi se yaad rakhne ki kshamta kam paai jaati hai.
Ibn-e-hajar asaqlaani Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke kathan : "Mainne tumse zyaada kisi ko dharm aur buddhi mein kami ke baavjood, samajhdaar vyakti ki buddhi ko nasht karne waala nahin paya." Ke baare mein likhte hain : Mujhe lagta hai ki Jahannam ke andar aurton ki bahulta ka ek kaaran yeh bhi hai. Kyonki jab we kisi wiweksheel vyakti ke buddhi ko nasht karne ka kaaran banti hain, jiske parinaamasvaroop we anuchit baaten kahte ya karte hain, to phir we bhi is paap mein bhaageedaar hain.
Aurat ke liye maahvaari ke dinon mein namaz parhna aur roza rakhna haraam hai. Yahi haal prasav ke baad ke raktasraav waali aurat ka bhi hai. Donon paak ho jaane ke baad roze ki qaza karengi, namaz ki nahin.
Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke aadarsh vyavhaar ki ek jhalak yeh hai ki aapne aurton ko daante ya phatkaare bina unke saare prashnon ke uttar diye.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Sadqa azaab ko door karta hai. Sadqa kabhi-kabhi insaanon ke beech hone waale gunaahon ko bhi mita deta hai.
Navvi kahte hain : Aurton ki deeni kami maahvaari ke dinon mein unke namaz evn roza chhorne ke kaaran hai. Kyonki jiski ibaadat adhik hoti hai, uske deen mein wriddhi ho jaati hai aur jiski ibaadat kam hoti hai, uske deen mein kami a jaati hai. Phir deeni kami kabhi to gunaah ka kaaran banti hai, jaise bina kisi sharai kaaran ke namaz evn roze jaisi aniwaary ibaadton ko chhorna, kabhi gunaah ka kaaran nahin bhi banti, jaise kisi aise vyakti ka juma evn jihaad aadi chhorna, jispar woh waajib na hon, jabki kabhi to insaan aisa karne ka paaband hota hai, jaise maahvaari ki haalat mein aurat ka namaz aur roza chhorna.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
10012: Woh Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hain ki aapne us vyakti ke baare mein, jo apni patni se maahvaari ke dinon mein sanbhog kare, farmaya: Woh ek deenaar ya aadha deenaar sadqa kare

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai, woh Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat karte hain ki aapne us vyakti ke baare mein, jo apni patni se maahvaari ke dinon mein sanbhog kare, farmaya: Woh ek deenaar ya aadha deenaar sadqa kare.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10013: Yahoodiyon ka maamla yeh tha ki jab unke beech kisi stri ko maahvaari aati, to na uske saath khaate- peete aur na gharon mein saath rahte the

Anas (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain: Yahoodiyon ka maamla yeh tha ki jab unke beech kisi stri ko maahvaari aati, to na uske saath khaate- peete aur na gharon mein saath rahte the. Atah, Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saathiyon ne aapse iske sanbandh mein poochha, to Allah taaala ne yeh ayat utaareeh {وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ ۖ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى فَاعْتَزِلُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي الْمَحِيضِ ۖ وَلَا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَطْهُرْنَ ۖ فَإِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِينَ وَيُحِبُّ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ} arthaat: Log aapse maahvaari ke baare mein poochhte hain. Aap kah den: Woh gandgi hai. Atah, maahvaari ke samay striyon se door raho aur unke nikat na jaao, yahaan tak ki we pawitr ho jayen. Phir, jab we achchhi tarah svachchh ho jayen, to unke paas usi tarah jaao, jaise Allah ne tumhen aadesh diya hai. Nishchay hi, Allah tauba karne waalon aur pawitr rahne waalon se prem karta hai [soora al-baqraah 222]. Atah, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Sanbhog ke atirikt sab kuchh karo. Iski soochna yahoodiyon ko mili, to kahne lage: Yeh aadmi to har maamle mein hamaare wirodh par tula hua hai. Atah, usaid bin huzair aur abbaad bin bishr (radiyallahu anhuma) Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aye aur kahne lage: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Yahoodi kuchh is- is tarah ki baaten kar rahe hain. Atah, kya ham (unke wirodh mein do qadam aur aage barhte hue) apni striyon se sanbhog na kar len? Yeh sunkar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke chehre ka rang badal gaya aur hamen aisa laga ki aap un donon se naaraaz ho gae hain. Phir woh donon wahaan se nikalkar chal diye. Isi beech Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas doodh ka uphaar aya, to aapne un donon ko bulvaakar doodh pilaya. Is tarah unhen santushti mili ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) unse naaraaz nahin hain.
10014: Ham (maasik dharm se) paak hone ke baad matmaile aur peele rang ke paani ko kuchh shumaar nahin karti theen.

Umm-e-atiyya radiyallahu anha, jinhonne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke haath par baiat ki thi, se riwayat hai, woh kahti hain : "Ham (maasik dharm se) paak hone ke baad matmaile aur peele rang ke paani ko kuchh shumaar nahin karti theen."

Sahaabiya umm-e-atiya radiyallahu anha bataati hain ki aurten Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke zamaane mein maahvaari se paak ho jaane ke baad yoni se nikalne waale halke kaale ya halke peele rang ke paani ko maahvaari ka khoon nahin samajhti theen aur iske kaaran namaz evn roza nahin chhorti theen.

Maahvaari se paak ho jaane ke baad aurat ki yoni se jo paani nikalta hai, woh maahvaari ka rakt nahin samjha jayega, agarche usmen rakt se praapt hone waala gadlaapan aur peelaapan hi kyon na ho.
Lekin agar maahvaari evn maamool ke dinon mein gadle aur peele rang ka paani nikle, to use maahvaari ka rakt hi samjha jayega, kyonki yeh apne samay par nikalne waala rakt hai. Yeh aur baat hai ki usmen paani ki milaawat hai.
Aurat paak ho jaane ke baad gadle aur peele rang ke paani ke kaaran namaz aur roza nahin chhoregi. Wazu karke namaz parh liya karegi.
[is hadees ko abu daawood ne in shabdon ke saath riwayat kiya hai. Jabki Bukhari ne (بعد الطهر, arthaat; pawitr ho jaane ke baad) ki wriddhi ke bina riwayat kiya hai]
10015: Tum utne din namaz se ruki raho, jitne din tumhaara maasik dharm tumhen namaz se rokta tha, phir snaan kar liya karo.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : "Abdurrahmaan bin auf ki patni umm-e-habeeba bint jahsh radiyallahu anha ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se (maasik dharm ke baad bhi) rakt jaari rahne ki shikayat ki, to aapne farmaya :  "Tum utne din namaz se ruki raho, jitne din tumhaara maasik dharm tumhen namaz se rokta tha, phir snaan kar liya karo." Isliye woh har namaz ke samay snaan karti theen.

Ek sahaabiya ne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aakar rakt jaari rahne ki shikayat ki. Tab Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unko aadesh diya ki yeh pareshaani shuru hone se pahle jitne din unki maahvaari unko namaz se roke rakhti thi, utne din woh namaz se ruki rahen aur uske baad snaan kar len aur phir namaz parhti rahen. Chunaanche woh nafli taur par har namaz ke liye snaan kar liya karti theen.

Istahaaza : Yeh hai ki aurat ko maahvaari ke niymit dinon ke baad bhi rakt aata rahe.
Istahaaza se grasit aurat khud ko utne dinon tak maahvaari mein samjhe, jitne dinon tak yeh pareshaani shuru hone se pahle use maahvaari ka khoon aya karta tha.
Phir jab maahvaari ke niymit dinon ke baraabar din guzar jayen, to khud ko maahvaari se paak samajhte hue maahvaari se paaki ka snaan kar le, chaahe istahaaza ka rakt jaari hi kyon na rahe.
Istahaaza se grasit aurat par har namaz ke liye snaan karna waajib nahin hai. Kyonki ukt sahaabiya har namaz ke liye snaan apne ijtihaad se kiya karti theen. Agar yeh amal waajib hota, to Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam unko bata dete.
Istahaaza se grasit aurat ko har namaz ke liye wazu karna hai. Kyonki uske wazu tootne ka kaary lagaataar jaari hai. Aisa har us vyakti ko bhi karna hai, jiska wazu tootne ka amal lagaataar jaari rahe. Maslan aisa vyakti jiska peshaab lagaataar nikalta rahe aur aisa vyakti jise nirantar roop se wayu nikalne ki beemaari ho.
Jab deen ka koi masla samajh mein na aye, to ulma se poochh lena chahiye. Ham dekhte hain ki us aurat ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aakar adhik khoon aane ki shikayat ki aur masla poochha.
10016: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Main ek aisi stri hoon, jise lanbe samay tak atyadhik maatra mein maasik dharm ka rakt aata hai. Atah, is sanbandh mein aapki kya ray hai? Isne mujhe namaz tatha roze se rok rakha hai. Aapne farmaya: Main tumhen rui prayog karne ki salaah deta hoon, isse rakt jaata rahega. Unhonne kaha: Rakt isse kaheen adhik aata hai

Hamna bint jahsh (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain: Mujhe lanbe samay tak tatha atyadhik maatra mein maasik dharm ka rakt aata tha. Atah, main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas fatva poochhne aur aapko isse avgat karne ke liye pahunchi. Aap mujhe meri bahan zainab bint jahsh (radiyallahu anha) ke ghar mein mil gae. Mainne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Main ek aisi stri hoon, jise lanbe samay tak atyadhik maatra mein maasik dharm ka rakt aata hai. Atah, is sanbandh mein aapki kya ray hai? Isne mujhe namaz tatha roze se rok rakha hai. Aapne farmaya: Main tumhen rui prayog karne ki salaah deta hoon, isse rakt jaata rahega. Unhonne kaha: Rakt isse kaheen adhik aata hai. Aapne farmaya: Phir kapra rakh lo. Unhonne kaha: Rakt isse bhi adhik aata hai. Daraasal woh bahe ja raha hai. Tab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Main tumhen do baaton ka aadesh deta hoon, inmen se jispar bhi amal kar lo, tumhaare liye kaafi hoga aur yadi donon kar sako to tum behtar jaanti ho (ki kya karna chahiye). Aapne unse kaha: Yeh daraasal shaitaan ka ek kachoka hai. Atah, Allah ke jnaan ke anusaar tum chhah athva saat din maahvaari ke din maan lo. Phir snaan kar lo. Yahaan tak ki jab dekho ki tum paak tatha svachchh ho gai ho to teees athva chaubees dinon tak namaz parho aur roze rakho. Yeh tumhaare liye kaafi hai. Tum har maheene aisa hi kiya karo. Bilkul usi tarah, jis tarah aam striyaan apne maasik dharm tatha paaki ke dinon mein maahvaari ke din guzaarti hain aur pawitr ho jaya karti hain. Aur agar aisa kar sako ki zuhar ki namaz ko wilanb kar lo aur asr ki namaz ko pahle kar lo aur snaan karke zuhar tatha asr ki namaz ko ek saath parho, (isi tarah) maghrib ki namaz ko wilanb kar lo aur isha ki namaz ko pahle kar lo aur snaan karke donon ko ek saath parho, tatha fajr ki namaz ke liye alag se snaan karo, to aisa kar liya karo aur roze rakha karo, yadi tumhaare paas iski shakti ho. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Aur yeh (baad waali baat) mujhe zyaada achchhi lagti hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10017: Subhaanallah! Yeh shaitaan ki or se hai. Woh ek tab mein baith jaye aur jab paani ke oopar peelaapan dekhe, to zuhar tatha asr ke liye ek snaan kare aur maghrib tatha isha ke liye ek snaan kare evn fajr ke liye ek snaan kare aur iske beech ki avdhi mein wazu karti rahe

Asma bint umais (radiyallahu anha) se warnit hai, woh kahti hain ki mainne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Faatima bint abu hubaish (itne aur itne dinon se) istihaaza (yaunik raktasraav jo maasik dharm ke siwa any dinon mein nazar aye) ki shikaar hain aur (is darmiyaan) namaz nahin parh saki hain. Yeh sunkar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Subhaanallah! Yeh shaitaan ki or se hai. Woh ek tab mein baith jaye aur jab paani ke oopar peelaapan dekhe, to zuhar tatha asr ke liye ek snaan kare aur maghrib tatha isha ke liye ek snaan kare evn fajr ke liye ek alag snaan kare aur iske beech ki avdhi mein wazu karti rahe.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10019: Inhonne use maar daala hai, Allah inka winaash kare! Jab inhen pata nahin tha, to inhonne kisi se poochh kyon nahin liya? Kyonki na jaanne ka ilaaj poochhna hi hai. Uske liye to bas itna kaafi tha ki tayammum kar leta aur apne zakhm par ek kapre ka tukra (ya patti) baandh leta aur phir uspar masah kar leta aur poore shareer ko dho leta

Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki ham ek yaatra mein nikle hue the ki hammen se ek vyakti ko ek patthar a laga aur uska sar zakhmi ho gaya. Phir use svapnadosh ho gaya. Aise mein, usne apne saathiyon se poochha ki kya tum mere liye tayammum karne ki chhoot paate ho? Unhonne uttar diya: Choonki tumhaare liye paani uplabdh hai, isliye ham tumhaare liye tayammum ki chhoot nahin paate. Atah, usne snaan kar liya aur mar gaya. Jab ham Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas pahunche aur aapko iske baare mein bataya gaya, to aapne farmaya: Inhonne use maar daala hai, Allah inka winaash kare! Jab inhen pata nahin tha, to inhonne kisi se poochh kyon nahin liya? Kyonki na jaanne ka ilaaj poochhna hi hai. Uske liye to bas itna kaafi tha ki tayammum kar leta aur apne zakhm par ek kapre ka tukra (ya patti) baandh leta aur phir uspar masah kar leta aur poore shareer ko dho leta.
[hasan li-ghairihi (any sandon athva riwayton ke saath milkar hasan)]
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10022: Tumne sunnat ko pa liya aur tumhaari namaz tumhaare liye kaafi ho gai

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain: Do vyakti ek yaatra mein nikle. Namaz ka samay aya to unke saath paani nahin tha. Atah, pawitr mitti se tayammum karke namaz parh li. Phir namaz ke samay ke andar hi paani mil gaya, to donon mein se ek ne wazu karke namaz dohra li, jabki doosre ne namaz nahin dohraai. Phir donon Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aye aur poori ghatna sunaai, to namaz na dohraane waale se aapne kaha: Tumne sunnat ko pa liya aur tumhaari namaz tumhaare liye kaafi ho gai. Tatha jisne wazu karke namaz dohraai thi, usse kaha: Tumhen dohra sawaab milega.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10023: Pawitr mitti musalmaan ke liye wazu ka saadhan hai, chaahe das saal hi kyon na ho jaye. Phir jab tujhe paani mil jaye, to use apne shareer par baha le, kyonki yahi uttam hai

Abu zar jundub bin junaada (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas kuchh ghaneemat ka maal jama hua, to aapne farmaya: Inhen lekar dehaat ki or chale jaao. Phir main rabza chala aya. Yahaan main junbi (naapaak) hota to (paani uplabdh na hone ke kaaran) paanch chhah dinon tak isi awastha mein rah jaata. Isliye, main Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya, to aapne farmaya: "Aboozar!" Main khaamosh raha, to aapne farmaya: "Aboozar! Tujhpar teri maan roe! Teri maan ke liye kharaabi hai!" Phir aapne ek kaali-kalauti daasi ko bulaya, jo paani ka ek bara bartan laai. Usne ek kapre se mera parda kiya aur mainne sawaari ke peechhe jaakar snaan kar liya. Mujhe aisa laga, jaise mainne apne sar se pahaar utaar diya ho. Aapne farmaya: Pawitr mitti musalmaan ke liye wazu ka saadhan hai, chaahe das saal hi kyon na ho jaye. Phir jab tujhe paani mil jaye, to use apne shareer par baha le, kyonki yahi uttam hai.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10026: Hamen logon par teen baaton mein fazeelat di gai hai. Hamaari safon ko farishton ki safon ki tarah banaya gaya hai, hamaare liye poori zameen ko masjid banaya gaya hai tatha jab paani na mile to uski mitti ko hamaare liye pawitrata praapt karne ka saadhan banaya gaya hai

Huzaifa (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah hamen logon par teen baaton mein fazeelat di gai hai. Hamaari safon ko farishton ki safon ki tarah banaya gaya hai, hamaare liye poori zameen ko masjid banaya hai tatha jab paani na mile to uski mitti ko hamaare liye pawitrata praapt karne ka saadhan banaya gaya hai tatha aapne ek aur baat bataai.
10028: Main tatha Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ek hi bartan se janbaat (sanbhog ke baad) ka snaan kar lete the. Ham donon ke haath baari- baari usse paani lete the

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se riwayat hai, woh kahti hain: Main tatha Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ek hi bartan se janaabat (sanbhog ke baad) ka snaan kar lete the. Ham donon ke haath baari- baari usse paani lete the. Tatha ek riwayat mein hai: Hamaare haath aapas mein mil bhi jaate the.
[ise ibne hibbaan ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10030: Nahin, tumhaare liye bas itna kaafi hai ki apne sar par teen chullu paani daal lo aur phir apne shareer par paani baha lo, isse tum pawitr ho jaaogi

Umme salma (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki mainne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Main apne sar ke baalon ko mazbooti se baandhti hoon, to kya main janaabat [aur ek riwayat mein hai: Aur maahvaari se] snaan ke liye unhen kholoon? Aapne farmaya: Nahin, tumhaare liye bas itna kaafi hai ki apne sar par teen chullu paani daal lo aur phir apne shareer par paani baha lo. Isse tum pawitr ho jaaogi.
10031: Mainne Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke liye snaan ka paani rakha

Maimoona (radiyallahu anha) se warnit hai, woh kahti hain: Mainne Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke liye snaan ka paani rakha, to aapne apne dayen haath se bayen haath par paani undelkar donon haathon ko dhoya, phir apni sharmagaah ko dhoya, phir apne haath ko dharti par maara aur use mitti par ragra, phir use dhoya, phir kulli ki aur naak mein paani charhaya, phir apne chehre ko dhoya aur saare shareer par paani bahaya, phir apne sthaan se hatkar khare hue aur apne donon pairon ko dhoya, phir aapko ek roomaal diya gaya, to usse wazu ke ang nahin ponchhe.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10032: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab janaabat ka snaan karte to pahle donon haathon ko dhote, phir dayen haath se bayen haath par paani daalte aur apni sharmagaah ko dhote. Phir namaz ke wazu ki tarah wazu karte

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab janaabat (sanbhog ke baad) ka snaan karte to pahle donon haathon ko dhote, phir dayen haath se bayen haath par paani daalte aur apni sharmagaah ko dhote. Phir namaz ke wazu ki tarah wazu karte, phir paani lekar baalon ki jaron mein anguliyaan ghusaate, yahaan tak ki jab yaqeen ho jaata ki paani jaron tak pahoonch gaya hai, to apne sar par teen chullu paani bahaate, phir saare shareer par paani bahaate, phir donon pairon ko dhote.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke snaan ka tareeqa bayaan kar rahi hain ki jab aap janaabat ka snaan karte, to sabse pahle apne donon haathon ko dhote, taaki pawitrata praapt karne ke liye paani lene se pahle donon haath saaf ho jayen. Uske baad aapne namaz ke wazu ki tarah wazu karte.
Chunki aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke baal ghane the, isliye paani lekar donon haathon ki ungliyon ko baalon ki jaron mein ghusaate aur hilore dete, yahaan tak ki jab paani baalon ki jaron tak pahunch jaata aur tvacha bheeg jaati, to sar par teen baar paani bahaate aur uske baad baaqi shareer ko dhote aur ant mein donon pairon ko dhote.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10033: Jab tummen se koi apni patni se ek baar sanbhog karne ke baad dobaara karna chaahe, to donon ke beech wazu kar le

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Jab tummen se koi apni patni se ek baar sanbhog karne ke baad dobaara karna chaahe, to donon ke beech wazu kar le.
Haakim ki ek riwayat mein hai: Isse dobaara sanbhog karne ki prabal ichchhaashakti praapt hogi.

Yadi vyakti ek se adhik baar apni patni se sanbhog karna chaahe, to use kya karna hai? Yeh hadees isi baat ka ullekh karti hai. Aapne farmaya : "Yadi tummen se koi apni patni ke paas jaye aur phir dobaara jaana chaahe" Yaani koi vyakti apni patni se sanbhog kare aur phir doosri ya teesri baar sanbhog karna chaahe.
Uske baad aage nirdesh dete hue farmaya : "To donon ke beech wazu kar le." Yaani pahle sanbhog ke baad aur doosre sanbhog se pahle. Yahaan wazu se muraad namaz waala wazu hai. Kyonki wazu ka shabd jab saamaany roop se bola jaye, to usse muraad sharai wazu hi hua karta hai. Jabki ibn-e-khuzaima evn baihqi mein iska spasht ullekh bhi hai : "To namaz ke wazu ki tarah wazu kar lo." Yeh wazu musathab hai.
[ise haakim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10035: Jisne jume ke din wazu kiya, usne sunnat par amal kiya aur achchha kiya tatha jisne snaan kiya, uska yeh kaary usse behtar hai.

Samura bin jundub (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Jisne jume ke din wazu kiya, usne sunnat par amal kiya aur bahut achchha kiya tatha jisne snaan kiya, uska yeh kaary usse behtar hai.

"Jisne jume ke din wazu kiya" Isse muraad jume ki namaz ke liye wazu karna hai.
"فَبِهَا" Yaani usne sunnat evn shareeyat ki or se di jaane waali chhoot par amal kiya.
"Aur bahut achchha kiya" Yaani sunnat par amal karke bahut achchha kiya. Yeh daraasal uski prashansa hai.
"Tatha jisne snaan kiya, uska yeh kaary adhik uttam hai." Yaani jisne jume ki namaz ke liye wazu ke saath-saath snaan bhi kiya, to uska yeh kaary kewal wazu karne ki tulna mein adhik uttam hai.
Chaaron imaamon samet jamhoor ulema ne isi hadees par amal kiya hai. Unka ek any pramaan saheeh Muslim ki yeh hadees bhi hai : "Jisne wazu kiya aur achchhi tarah wazu kiya, phir jume ki namaz ke liye pahuncha aur chupchaap dhyaan se khutba suna, uske ek jume se doosre jume tak aur atirikt teen din ke gunaah kshama kar diye jaate hain."
