10036: Jume ke din har vyask vyakti par snaan karna aniwaary hai tatha yeh ki woh daatun kare aur mil sake to khushbu bhi lagaye.

Amr bin sulaim ansaari kahte hain : Main gawaahi deta hoon ki abu saeed ne kaha hai aur unhonne gawaahi di hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jume ke din har vyask vyakti par snaan karna aniwaary hai tatha yeh ki woh daatun kare aur mil sake to khushbu bhi lagaye."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jume ke din ka snaan har wayask musalmaan purush par, jispar jume ki namaz farz hai, apne andar waajib ki tarah taakeed rakhta hai. Us din misvaak aadi dvaara daant saaf kar lena chahiye. Khushbu laag leni chahiye.

Juma ke din har wayask musalmaan purush par snaan karna taakeed ke saath musathab hai.
Saaf-safaai evn durgandh ko door hataana shareeyat ki nazar mein waanchhit hai.
Jume ke din ka sammaan karna chahiye tatha uske liye taiyaari karni chahiye.
Jume ke liye misvaak karna taakeed ke saath mustahab hai.
Jume ki namaz ke liye jaane se pahle khushbu laga lena musathab hai.
Aurat jab namaz ya kisi doosre kaam ke liye ghar se nikle, to uska khushbu lagaana jayaz nahin hai. Kyonki sunnat iske haraam hone ko pramaanit karti hai.
Is hadees mein aye hue shabd "المحتلم" Se muraad wayask hai aur wayaskata ki kuchh nishaaniyaan hua karti hain. Unmen se teen nishaaniyaan purush evn mahila donon mein paai jaati hain : 1- pandrah warsh poore ho jaana. 2- sharmagaah ke aaspaas khuradre baalon ka ug aana. 3- svapnadosh ke kaaran ya kaam uttejna ke saath weery nikalne lagna. Jabki chauthi nishaani wishesh roop se aurton ke andar paai jaati hai. Yaani maahvaari ka khoon aana. Aurat ko maahvaari aane lage, to woh wayask hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
10039: Purush ka paani mota tatha safed hota hai aur stri ka paani patla tatha peela hota hai, donon mein se jo bhi prabhaawi rahe ya aage rahe, (bachche ke andar) usi ki samroopakta paai jaati hai

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain: Umme sulaim (radiyallahu anha) ne bataya ki unhonne Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se poochha ki yadi stri ko purushon ki tarah svapnadosh ho jaye, to woh kya kare? Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Jab paani dekhe to snaan kare. Umme sulaim (radiyallahu anha) ka kahna hai ki main isse sharma gai. Unhonne poochha: Kya aisa hota bhi hai? Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Haan! Nahin to phir samroopakta kahaan se aati hai. Purush ka paani mota tatha safed hota hai aur stri ka paani patla tatha peela hota hai. Donon mein se jo bhi prabhaawi rahe ya aage rahe, (bachche ke andar) usi ki samroopakta paai jaati hai.
10040: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapka us vyakti ke baare mein kya khyaal hai, jise uski patni se jaldi hata diya jaye aur uska weery na nikla ho, use kya karna hai? Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Snaan to kewal weery nikalne se karna hota hai

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath somvaar ke din quba ki or nikla. Jab ham bani saalim qabeele tak pahunche, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) itbaan (radiyallahu anhu) ke dvaar par ruk gae aur unhen aawaaz di. Woh tahband kheenchte hue nikle, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Hamne is vyakti ko jaldi mein daal diya hai. Itbaan ne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapka us vyakti ke baare mein kya khyaal hai, jise uski patni se jaldi hata diya jaye aur uska weery na nikla ho, use kya karna hai? Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Snaan to kewal weery nikalne se hi karna hota hai.
10046: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab shauch ke sthaan se nikalte, to kahte : "غُفْرَانَكَ" Arthaat, ai Allah! Main tujhse kshama ka praarthi hoon.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai ki : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab shauch ke sthaan se nikalte, to kahte : "غُفْرَانَكَ" Arthaat, ai Allah! Main tujhse kshama ka praarthi hoon.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab shauch karke nikalte, to kahte ki ai Allah! Main tujhse teri kshama maangta hoon.

Shauch ke sthaan se nikalne ke baad "Tujhse teri kshama maangta hoon." Kahna musathab hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam sabhi paristhitiyon mein Allah se kshama maanga karte the.
Shauch karne ke baad kshama maangne ka kaaran kya hai, iske baare mein kaha gaya hai ki kshama isliye maangi jaati hai ki bande se Allah ki beshumaar nemton ka shukr ada karne mein kotaahi hoti hai, jinmen se ek nemat insaan ke pet se kashtakar cheezon ka aasaani se nikal jaana bhi hai. Banda  isliye bhi Allah se kshama maangta hai ki shauch ke samay Allah ke zikr se door rahta hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
10048: Aapne hamen is baat se mana kiya hai ki ham paakhaana tatha peshaab ke samay qible ki or munh karen, dayen haath se istinja karen, teen se kam pattharon se istinja karen ya gobar athva haddi se istinja karen

Salmaan (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki unse (uphaas ke taur par) kaha gaya: Tumhaare Nabi ne tumhen sab kuchh sikhaya hai, yahaan tak ki paakhaana karna bhi! To unka kahna hai ki unhonne kaha: Haan! Aapne hamen is baat se mana kiya hai ki ham paakhaana tatha peshaab ke samay qible ki or munh karen, dayen haath se istinja karen, teen se kam pattharon se istinja karen ya gobar athva haddi se istinja karen.
10051: "Do laanat ke kaamon se bacho." Logon ne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Ye do laanat ke kaam kya hain? Aapne farmaya: Jo logon ke raaste ya unke saye mein paakhaana kare

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Do laanat ke kaamon se bacho. Logon ne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Ye do laanat ke kaam kya hain? Aapne farmaya: Jo logon ke raaste ya unke saye mein paakhaana kare.

Do aise kaaryon se bacho jo logon ki laanat ka kaaran hua karte hain aur unke karne waale ko saamaanyatya bura kaha jaata hai tatha uspar laanat ki jaati hai. Choonki yeh donon kaary laanat ka sabab hain, isliye laanat ki nisbat unki or hi kar di gai hai. Yeh donon kaary hain, logon ke raaste athva saye mein peshaab-paakhaana karna. Yeh hadees Allah taaala ke is kathan ki tarah hai : "Aur unhen bura na kaho, jin (moortiyon) ko we Allah ke siwa pukaarte hain. Anyatha, we log ajnaanta ke kaaran ati karke Allah ko bura kahenge." [soora al-anaaam, ayat sankhya : 108} yaani tumhaara unke dewi-devtaaon ko bura kahna is baat ka kaaran banega ki we Allah ko bura kahenge. Isi tarah ek any hadees mein hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is baat se mana kiya hai ki aadmi apne maata-pita ko gaali de. Yeh sun sahaaba ne kaha ki kya koi vyakti apne maata-pita ko gaali de sakta hai? Aapne uttar diya : "Haan, de sakta hai. Iski surat yeh hai ki woh kisi ke pita ko gaali de aur woh uske pratiuttar mein uske pita ko gaali de. Isi tarah woh kisi ki maata ko gaali de aur woh uske pratiuttar mein uski maata ko gaali de." Is tarah choonki wahi apne maata-pita ko gaali dilaane ka kaaran bana, isliye dekha jaye, to usi ne apne maata-pita ko gaali di.
Aapke shabd : "Jo logon ke raaste athva unki chhaavn ki jaghon mein paakhaana kare" Ka arth hai, aise sthaanon mein paakhaana athva peshaab kare, jahaan se logon ka aana-jaana hota ho. Yeh kaam haraam hai, ismen koi sandeh nahin hai. Chaahe aisa yaatra ki awastha mein kiya jaye ya thahraav ki awastha mein. Kaaran yeh hai ki isse logon ko kasht hota hai. Jabki uchch evn Allah ne kaha hai : "Aur jo duhkh dete hain eemaan waalon tatha eemaan waaliyon ko, bina kisi dosh ke, jo unhonne kiya ho, to unhonne laad liya aarop tatha khule paap ko." Haan, yadi raasta weeraan para ho aur usse kisi ka aana-jaana na hota ho, to usmen peshaab-paakhaana karne mein koi harj nahin hai. Kyonki is awastha mein woh kaaran hi na raha, jiski wajah se mana kiya gaya hai.
Saye mein pakhaana karne ki manaahi se muraad aise saye mein peshaab-paakhaana karna hai, jahaan logon ka uthna-baithna hota ho. Jahaan tak aise sthaan mein sthit chhaya ki baat hai, jahaan logon ka uthna-bethna na hota ho, to usmen peshaab-paakhaana karne mein koi harj nahin hai. Kyonki yahaan bhi woh kaaran na raha, jiski wajah se mana kiya gaya hai. Saath hi ek hadees mein bhi aya hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- khajoor ke ek jhund ke neeche shauch ke liye baith gae, jahaan saya tha.
10094: Ai abu huraira! Mere in do jooton ko lekar jaao aur is baag ke baahar jisse bhi bhent ho, jo dil ke yaqeen ke saath is baat ki gawaahi deta ho ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai, use Jannat ka shubh samaachaar suna do.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ham kuchh log Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke aas-paas baithe hue the, tatha hamaare saath abu bakr evn umar -radiyallahu anhuma- bhi upasthit the. Isi beech, Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hamaare beech se uthkar chale gae aur itni der kar di ki hamen bhay hone laga ki kaheen aap hamse rok diye gae na hon. Atah, ham ghabraakar uthe aur ham uth gae, sabse pahla vyakti main hi tha, jo ghabraya. Main Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki talaash mein nikal para, yahaan tak ki ansaar ke banu najjaar qabeele ke ek baag mein ja pahuncha, main dvaar ki talaash mein baag ke chaaron or chakkar lagaata raha, lekin dvaar na mil saka, achaanak ek chhoti-si naali dikhi, jo baahar ke ek kuen se baag ke andar ja rahi thi, atah, mainne apne shareer ko sameta aur (naali se andar prawesh karke) Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke yahaan ja pahuncha. (Mujhe dekhkar) aapne farmaya : "Abu huraira!" Mainne kaha : Haan, ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapne farmaya : "Yahaan kya kar rahe ho?" Mainne kaha : Aap hamaare beech upasthit the, isi beech aap nikal gae aur waapas aane mein der kar di, atah hamen bhay hua ki kaheen aapko hamse rok na liya gaya ho., ham ghabraakar uthe, sabse pahle mujhe hi ghabraahat hui thi, atah, main is baag ke paas pahunch gaya, yahaan (ek naali se) apne shareer ko is tarah sametkar andar aya, jaise lomri apne shareer ko sametti hai, aur log bhi mere peechhe-peechhe a rahe hain. Yeh sun aapne mujhe apne donon joote pradaan karte hue farmaya : "Ai abu huraira! Mere in do jooton ko lekar jaao aur is baag ke baahar jisse bhi bhent ho, jo dil ke yaqeen ke saath is baat ki gawaahi deta ho ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai, use Jannat ka shubh samaachaar suna do." (Main waapas hone laga,) to sabse pahle meri mulaaqaat umar se hui. Unhonne mujhse poochha : Ai abu huraira! Ye joote kaise hain? Mainne uttar diya : Ye donon joote Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke hain, mujhe aapne apne in donon jooton ke saath is kaam ke liye bheja hai ki jo vyakti mujhe haardik wishvaas ke saath is baat ki gawaahi deta hua mile ki Allah ke atirikt koi saty poojy nahin hai, use main Jannat ka susmaachaar suna doon. Yeh sun umar -radiyallahu anhu- ne mere seene par is zor se mukka maara ki main nitanb ke bal par gir para. Unhonne kaha : Abu huraira tum waapas jaao. Chunaanche main Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas waapas chala gaya. Main ghabraya hua aur rone jesi soorat banaakar khara ho gaya. Peechhe-peechhe umar bhi pahunch gae. (Mujhe dekh) aapne poochha "Abu huraira! Baat kya hai?" Mainne uttar diya : Meri mulaaqaat umar se hui aur mainne unhen woh baat sunaai, jiske saath aapne mujhe bheja tha, to unhonne mere seene par aisa mukka maar diya ki main nitanb ke bal ja gira. Uske baad unhonne mujhe laut jaane ke liye kaha. Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne poochha : "Ai umar! Tumne is tarah ka kaam kyon kiya?" Unhonne uttar diya : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapar mere maata-pita qurbaan hon, kya aapne abu huraira ko apne donon jooton ke saath is kaam ke liye bheja tha ki jo vyakti unhen haardik wishvaas ke saath is baat ki gawaahi dete hue mil jaye ki Allah ke atirikt koi saty poojy nahin hai, use woh Jannat ka susmaachaar suna den? Aapne uttar diya : "Haan!" Unhonne kaha : Aap aisa na karen. Kyonki mujhe dar hai ki log isi par bharosa karke baith jayenge. Aap unhen amal karne deejiye. Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Theek hai, unhen (apne haal par) rahne do."

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apne kuchh saathiyon ke saath baithe hue the. Sabha mein abu bakr aur umar -radiyallahu anhuma- jaise sahaaba bhi maujood the. Isi beech aap uthkar kaheen chale gae aur der tak waapas nahin aye, to sahaaba ke andar yeh aashanka paida ho gai ki kaheen aapke saath koi anhoni na ghat gai ho. Dushmanon ne aapko giraftaar na kar liya ho ya kuchh aur na ghatit hua ho. Aise mein sahaaba ghabraye aur idhar-udhar dhoondhne nikal pare. Sabse pahle abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu-ghabraye hue nikle. Woh dhoondhte hue banu najjaar ke ek baagh tak pahunche aur is aasha mein baagh ke chaaron or chakkar lagaane lage ki shayad koi khula dvaar mil jaye, dvaar to nahin mila, albatta ek chhoti-si naali mili, jisse paani andar jaata tha. Woh apne shareer ko sametkar naali se andar gae aur dekha ki wahaan Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- maujood hain. Unhen dekh aapne poochha : Abu huraira tum? Jawaab diya : Ji main. Poochha : Tum yahaan kya kar rahe ho? Jawaab diya : Aap hamaare saath maujood the. Phir nikal gae aur der tak waapas nahin aye, to hamen yeh aashanka sataane lagi ki kaheen aapko hamse rok na liya gaya ho aur hamaare andar dar paida hua. Isliye ham aapko dhoondhne nikal pare. Sabse pahle main hi dar kar nikla. Main is baagh ke paas aya aur laumri ki tarah shareer ko sametkar andar daakhil hua. Any log bhi mere peechhe-peechhe a rahe hain. Yeh sun Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unko unke sachche hone ki nishaani ke taur par apne donon joote de diye aur unse kah diya ki mere in donon jooton ko lekar jaao aur is baagh ke baahar jise bhi haardik wishvaas ke saath is baat ki gawaahi dete hue paao ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai, use jannati hone ka susmaachar suna do. Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- nikle, to sabse pahle umar -radiyallahu anhu- mile. Unhonne poochha : Abu huraira! Ye donon joote kaise hain? Uttar diya : Ye donon joote Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke hain. Aapne mujhe apne donon jooton ke saath is kaam ke liye bheja hai ki jo vyakti mujhe haardik wishvaas ke saath is baat ki gawaahi deta hua mile ki Allah ke atirikt koi saty poojy nahin hai, use main Jannat ka susmaachaar suna doon. Itna sunkar umar -radiyallahu anhu- ne abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ke seene par aisa mukka maara ki woh nitanb ke bal par ja gire. Saath hi unhonne waapas jaane ko bhi kah diya. Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka kahna hai ki unki baat sunkar main Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki taraph laut para. Main ghabraya hua tha, chehre ka rang badla hua tha, rone jaisa lag raha tha. Mere peechhe-peechhe umar -radiyallahu anhu- bhi chal pare. Mujhe dekh aapne poochha : Abu huraira, baat kya hai? Mainne kaha : Meri mulaaqaat umar -radiyallahu anhu- se hui aur mainne unko woh soochna di, jiske saath aapne mujhe bheja tha, to unhonne mujhe is tarah mukka raseed kar diya ki main nitanb ke bal gir para. Phir unhonne mujhe waapas laut jaane ko kaha. Yeh sun aapne umar -radiyallahu anhu- se poochha : Tumne is tarah ka kaam kyon kiya? Umar -radiyallahu anhu- ne jawaab diya : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mere maan baap aappar fida hon, kya aapne abu huraira ko apne donon joote dekar is kaam ke liye bheja tha ki jo vyakti haardik wishvaas ke saath is baat ki gawaahi de ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai, use woh Jannat ka susmaachaar suna den? Jawaab diya : Haan, mainne aisa kiya hai. Umar -radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha : Aap aisa na karen. Mujhe is baat ki aashanka hai ki log is waaky ko kahne bhar par svayn ko samet lenge aur amal par dhyaan nahin denge. Isliye logon ko amal karne den. Unki baat sun Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : Tab unhen amal karne do.

Sahaaba Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se athaah prem karte the aur we Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko har kasht se surakshit dekhna chaahte the.
Khushkhabri dena ek shareeyat sammat kaary hai.
Eemaan kathan, karm aur aastha ka naam hai.
Qaazi ayaaz aadi kahte hain : Umar -radiyallahu anhu- ka yeh rawaiya tatha unka Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saamne jaakar apni baat rakhna aappar etraaz aur aapke aadesh ka ullanghan nahin kahlayega. Kyonki aapne abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ko jo sandesh dekar bheja tha, uska uddeshy logon ko khushi pradaan karna aur susmaachaar dena bhar tha. Lekin umar -radiyallahu anhu- ko laga ki is susmaachaar ko chhupaakar rakhna hi behtar hai, aur is baat ke zyaada kareeb hai ki log bharosa karke baith nahi jayenge, tatha yeh unke liye is achchhi khabar ko jaldi phailaane se zyaada phaydemand hai. Unhonne jab apna yeh khyaal Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saamne rakha, to aapne use durust qaraar diya.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki jab koi shaasak ya bara aadmi koi baat soche aur uska koi anusrankaari uske wipreet soche, to anusrankaari ko apni baat shaasak ya bare aadmi ke saamne rakh deni chahiye, taaki woh uspar wichaar kare aur durust lagne par apni baat waapas le le aur durust na lagne par anusrankaari ko uske sandesh ka santoshajnak uttar de de.
Saarvajnik hit ko dekhte hue ya bura prabhaav parne ke bhay ke maddenzar aise jnaan ka prachaar-prasaar rokna jayaz hai, jo aawashyak na ho.
Is hadees mein ekeshvarvaadiyon ko ek bahut bara susmaachaar sunaya gaya hai ki jis vyakti ki mrityu sachche man se is baat ki gawaahi dete hue hui ki Allah ke atirikt koi ibaadat ka haqdaar nahin hai, uske liye Jannat hai.
Umar -radiyallahu anhu- ka sashakt wayaktitv, hikmat aur deen ki gahri samajh.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki insaan doosri ki sanpatti mein uski anumti ke bina prawesh kar sakta hai, agar use pata ho ki woh unke beech dosti ke kaaran ya kisi aur wajah se uske is kaam se raaji hoga.
10095: Allah apne bandon par usse kaheen zyaada meharbaan hai, jitna yeh apne bachche par meharbaan hai

Umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saamne kuchh qaidi laye gae. Achaanak dekha gaya ki qaidiyon mein se ek stri daur rahi hai. Itne mein qaidiyon mein use apna bachcha mil gaya, to use uthaakar apne pet se chimta liya aur doodh pilaane lagi. Yeh dekhkar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Kya tumko lagta hai ki yeh aurat apne bachche ko aag mein daal sakti hai? Hamne kaha: Nahin, Allah ki qasam! Ispar aapne farmaya: Allah apne bandon par usse kaheen zyaada meharbaan hai, jitna yeh apne bachche par meharbaan hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10098: Jis bande ne sachche dil se yeh gawaahi di ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke bande tatha uske Rasool hain, Allah use Jahannam par haraam kar dega

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne, jabki muaaz radiyallahu anhu sawaari par aapke peechhe baithe the, farmaya : "Ai muaaz bin jabal!" Unhonne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mainn upasthit hoon. Aapne phir kaha : "Ai muaaz bin jabal!" Unhonne dobaara kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, main upasthi hoon! Aapne phir kaha : "Ai muaaz bin jabal!" To unhonne teesri baar kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, main upasthit hoon! Teesri baar ke baad aapne farmaya : "Jis bande ne sachche dil se yeh gawaahi di ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke bande tatha uske Rasool hain, Allah use Jahannam par haraam kar dega." Unhonne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya main logon ko aapki yeh baat bata na doon ki we khush ho jayen? Aapne farmaya : "Tab to we isi par bharosa kar baithenge." Chunaanche mrityu ke samay muaaz radiyallahu anhu ne gunaah ke bhay se yeh hadees logon ko bata di.

Muaaz bin jabal radiyallahu anhu Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke peechhe sawaari par baithe hue the ki aapne unka naam lekar teen baar kaha : Ai muaaz! Aapke teen baar sanbodhit karne ka uddeshy aage kahi jaane waali baat ke mahatv ko darshaana tha.

Har baar muaaz raziyallah anhu ne uttar mein kaha : "لبيك يا رسول الله وسعديك" Ai Allah ke Rasool! Main aapki har aawaaz par khara hoon aur ise apne liye gaurav samajhta hoon.

Chunaanche Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unko bataya ki jis vyakti ne sachche dil se is baat ki gawaahi di ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur mumhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke Rasool hain tatha isi haalat mein mar gaya, to Allah Jahannam par use haraam kar dega.

Yeh sun muaaz radiyallahu anhu ne aapse is baat ki anumti maangi ki logon ko yeh bata den, taaki log khush ho jayen.

Lekin aapko is baat ka bhay hua ki kaheen log ispar bharosa na kar baithen aur amal ke kshetr mein sust na par jayen.

Is liye muaaz radiyallahu anhu ne yeh hadees kisi ko nahin sunaai. Parantu, maut se pahle suna gae, taaki jnaan chhupaane ke gunaah ka shikaar na hona pare.

Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka saada rahan-sahan ki muaaz radiyallahu anhu ko apne peechhe sawaari par bitha liya.
Yahaan Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke shiksha dene ka ek tareeqa saamne aata hai ki aapne muaaz bin jabal radiyallahu anhu ko ek se adhik baar pukaara, taaki woh aapki kahi hui baat ko bare dhyaan se sunen.
Allah ke siwa kisi ke sachcha poojy na hone tatha Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke Allah ke Rasool ke gawaahi dene ki ek shart yeh hai ki gawaahi dene waala sachche dil se gawaahi de raha ho. Woh na to jhootha ho aur na sandeh rakhta ho.
Allah ke ek hone ki gawaahi dene waale log Jahannam mein hamesha nahin rah sakte. Apne gunaahon ke sabab Jahannam chale bhi gae, to paak hone ke baad nikaal liye jayenge.
Sachche dil se Allah ke ekmaatr poojy hone tatha Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke Rasool hone ki gawaahi dene ki fazeelat.
Kuchh paristhitiyon mein kuchh hadeeson ko bayaan na karna bhi jayaz hai, jab unke bayaan karne se kisi nuqsaan ka dar ho.

10100: Ek kutta ek kuen ke chaaron or chakkar laga raha tha aur qareeb tha ki woh pyaas se halaak ho jaye ki use bani israaeel ki ek weshya ne dekh liya. Phir usne apna moza utaara aur uske zariye kutte ke liye paani nikaalkar use pilaya, to is puny ke kaaran use kshama kar diya gaya

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Ek vyakti kisi raaste se guzar raha tha ki use sakht pyaas lagi. Itne mein use ek kuaan mila, to usmen utarkar usne paani piya. Oopar aya to dekha ki ek kutta pyaas ke kaaran haanp raha hai aur keechar chaat raha hai. Isliye woh kuen mein utra, apne moze mein paani bhara aur use apne munh se pakarkar oopar aya tatha kutte ko paani pilaya. Allah ko uska yeh nek kaam itna pasand aya ki use kshama kar diya. Sahaaba ne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya hamen jaanavron ki sahayta karne mein bhi neki milti hai? Aapne kaha: Har zinda kaleje waale ki sahayta mein neki hai. Ek riwayat mein haih Allah ne uske is kaary ki qadr ki aur use kshama kar diya tatha Jannat mein daakhil hone ka saubhaagy pradaan kiya. 10101: Musalmaan woh hai, jiski zabaan aur haath se musalmaan surakshit rahen aur muhaajir woh hai, jo Allah ki mana ki hui cheezen chhor de.

Abdullah bin amr radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Musalmaan woh hai, jiski zabaan aur haath se musalmaan surakshit rahen aur muhaajir woh hai, jo Allah ki mana ki hui cheezen chhor de."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki poora musalmaan woh hai, jiski zabaan se musalmaan surakshit rahen ki woh kisi ko gaali na de, kisi par dhikkaar na kare, kisi ki gheebat na kare aur kisi ko bhaasha dvaara koi kasht na de. Isi tarah uske haath se musalmaan surakshit rahen. Maslan woh na kisi par atyaachaar kare aur na kisi ka maal harpe. Jabki asal hijrat karne waala woh hai, jo Allah ki haraam ki hui cheezen chhor de.

Poora musalmaan hone ke liye zaroori hai ki kisi ko kasht na de. Kasht bhautik ho ki naitik.
Wishesh roop se zabaan evn haath ka zikr isliye kiya gaya hai ki maanav shareer ke in donon angon se bahut-se ghalat kaam aur bahut-se logon ka nuqsaan hota hai. Zyaadaatar buraaiyaan inheen donon angon se hoti hain.
Gunaahon se bachne aur Allah ke aadeshon ka paalan karne ki prerna.
Sabse achchha musalmaan woh hai, jo Allah ke adhikaar evn musalmaanon ke adhikaar donon ada kare.
Atyaachaar ka sanbandh kabhi kathan se hota hai aur kabhi kaary se.
Poorn hijrat yeh hai ki insaan Allah ki haraam ki hui cheezen chhor de.

10103: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne (khaane ke baad) ungliyon tatha plet ko chaat lene ka aadesh diya hai tatha farmaya hai: Tum nahin jaante ki bhojan ke kis ansh mein barkat hai.

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne (khaane ke baad) ungliyon tatha plet ko chaat lene ka aadesh diya hai tatha farmaya hai: Tum nahin jaante ki bhojan ke kis ansh mein barkat hai.
Ek riwayat mein hai: Jab tummen se kisi ka niwaala gir jaye, to use utha le tatha usmen jo gandgi lagi ho, use saaf karke use kha le evn shaitaan ke liye na chhore, tatha ungliyon ko chaatne se pahle apne haath ko roomaal se na ponchhe, kyonki woh nahin jaanta ki bhojan ke kis ansh mein barkat hai.
Tatha ek riwayat mein hai: Shaitaan tumhaare har kaam ke samay tumhaare paas upasthit rahta hai, yahaan tak ki tumhaare khaane ke samay bhi tumhaare paas hota hai. Atah, jab tummen se kisi ka niwaala gir jaye, to usmen jo gandgi lagi ho, use saaf karke use kha le aur use shaitaan ke liye na chhore.
10104: Zamaana ghoomkar aaj phir usi haalat par a gaya hai, jo haalat us din thi, jis din Allah ne aasmaan wa zameen ko paida kiya tha. Saal ke baarah maheene hain, jinmen chaar maheene haraam hain: Teen lagaataar hain, yaani zul- qaada, zul- hijja, muharram aur muzar qabeele ka rajab.

Abu bakra (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Zamaana ghoomkar aaj phir usi haalat par a gaya hai, jo haalat us din thi, jis din Allah ne aasmaan wa zameen ko paida kiya tha. Saal ke baarah maheene hain, jinmen chaar maheene haraam (jinmen yuddh karna haraam hai) hain: Teen lagaataar hain, yaani zul- qaada, zul- hijja, muharram aur muzar qabeele ka rajab, jo antim jumaada aur shaabaan ke beech hai. Phir aapne farmaya: Yeh kaun- sa maheena hai? Hamne kaha: Allah aur uske Rasool hi behtar jaante hain. Yeh sunkar aap kuchh der khaamosh rahe. Hamen laga ki shayad aap usko koi naya naam denge. Phir farmaya: Kya yeh zul- hijja nahin hai? Hamne kaha: Awashy! Phir aapne kaha: Yeh kaun- sa shahar hai? Hamne kaha: Allah aur ulke Rasool behtar jaante hain! Yeh sunkar aap khaamosh ho gae. Hamen lagne laga ki shayad aap use koi naya naam denge. Phir farmaya: Kya yeh makka nagar nahin hai? Hamne kaha: Awashy! Phir aapne poochha: Aaj kaun- sa din hai? Hamne kaha ki Allah aur uske Rasool hi behtar jaante hain. Yeh sunkar aap khaamosh rahe, jisse hamen khyaal hua ki shayad aap use koi aur naam denge. Phir farmaya: Kya yeh qurbaani ka din nahin hai? Hamne kaha: Awashy! Aapne farmaya: To jaan rakho, tumhaara khoon, tumhaara maal aur tumhaari pratishtha tumhaare liye usi tarah haraam hai, jis tarah tumhaara yeh din, tumhaare is nagar aur tumhaare is maheene mein haraam hai. Yaad rakho, jald hi tumko apne rab ke saamne upasthit hona hai aur woh tumse tumhaare karmon ke baare mein poochhega. Sun lo, tum mere baad dobaara kaafir na ho jaana ki ek- doosre ki gardan uraane lago. Khabardaar! Har upasthit vyakti par laazim hai ki woh mera yeh paighaam un logon tak pahunchaye, jo yahaan upasthit nahin hain. Isliye ki bahut mumkin hai ki jiske paas meri baat (apratyaksh roop se) pahunche, woh aise kai kuchh logon se adhik yaad rakhne waala ho, jinhonne use (pratyaksh roop se mujhse) suna hai. Phir aapne farmaya: Suno, kya mainne pahuncha diya hai? Suno, kya mainne pahuncha diya hai? Hamne kaha: Haan! Aapne farmaya: Ai Allah! Tu gawaah rah!

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Kaafir jab koi achchha kaam karta hai, to uske badle mein use duniya mein rozi de di jaati hai, lekin jahaan tak momin ki baat hai, to uski nekiyon ko Allah uski aakhirat ke liye jama rakhta hai aur uske aajnaapaalan ka badla use duniya mein rozi bhi pradaan karta hai.
Ek any riwayat mein hai: Allah kisi momin ki kisi neki ki upeksha nahin karta. Use duniya mein bhi uska badla diya jaata hai aur aakhirat mein bhi uska badla diya jayega. Lekin jahaan tak kaafir ki baat hai, to jo achchhe kaam woh Allah ke liye karta hai, unke badle mein use duniya mein rozi de di jaati hai, yahaan tak ki jab woh aakhirat mein pahunchega, to uske paas koi neki nahin hogi ki uska badla use diya jaye.
10107: Jab Ramzan ka maheena aata hai, to Jannat ke dvaar khol diye jaate hain, Jahannam ke dvaar band kar diye jaate hain aur shaitaanon ko beriyon mein jakar diya jaata hai.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jab Ramzan ka maheena aata hai, to Jannat ke dvaar khol diye jaate hain, Jahannam ke dvaar band kar diye jaate hain aur shaitaanon ko beriyon mein jakar diya jaata hai."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki jab Ramzan ka maheena prawesh karta hai, to teen kaam hote hain : 1- Jannat ke dvaar khol diye jaate hain. Uska koi dvaar band nahin rahta. 2- Jahannam ke dvaar band kar diye jaate hain. Uska koi bhi dvaar khula nahin rahta. 3- shaitaanon aur sarkash jinnon ko zanjeeron se baandh diya jaata hai. Isliye we Ramzan ke maheene mein woh nahin kar paate jo any maheenon mein kar lete hain. Ye sab kuchh is maheene ke sammaan mein tatha Allah ke bandon ko namaz, sadqa, zikr aur Qur'an ki tilaawat aadi neki ke kaamon ki prerna dene tatha gunaahon evn awajnaakaariyon se door rahne ka waataavran banaane ke liye kiya jaata hai.

Ramzan maheene ki fazeelat.
Is maheene mein roza rakhne waalon ke liye yeh susmaachaar ki yeh mubaarak maheena ibaadat aur neki ka maheena hai.
Ramzan maheene mein shaitaanon ko zanjeeron se jakar diye jaane mein ek tarah se is baat ki or ishaara hai ki ab sharai aadeshon evn nishedhon ka paalan karne ke paaband vyakti ke liye heele-bahaane ki koi gunjaaish nahin rah gai hai. Ek tarah se yeh is baat ka elaan hai ki ab shaitaanon ko tumhen bahkaane se rok diya gaya hai. Isliye tum yeh uzr  aur bahaana nahin sakte ki ham shaitaan ke bahkaawe ke kaaran neki ka kaam nahin kar sake ya gunaah se bach nahin sake.
Qurtubi kahte hain : Ab agar yeh kaha jaye; ham Ramzan maheene mein bahut-si buraaiyaan aur gunaah hote hue kyon dekhte hain? Agar shaitaanon ko zanjeeron mein jakar diya gaya hai to aisa nahin hona chahiye tha? Iska jawaab yeh hai ki gunaah aise rozedaaron se kam hua karte hain, jo roze ki sharton tatha aadaab ka khyaal rakhte hue roza rakhte hain. Ek jawaab yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki zanjeeron mein saare shaitaanon ko nahin jakra jaata hai, balki kewal sarkash shaitaanon ko jakra jaata hai, jaisa ki kuchh riwayton mein peechhe guzar chuka hai. Ya uddeshy is maheene mein gunaahon ko  kam karna bhi ho sakta hai, jise ham mahsoos bhi kar sakte hain. Yeh ek sachchaai hai ki is maheene mein doosre maheenon ki tulna mein kam gunaah hua karte hain, kyonki  tamaam shaitaanon ko zanjeeron mein jakar diye jaane se yeh laazim nahin aata ki koi gunaah na ho, kyonki gunaah ashuddh aatmaaon, buri aadton aur insaanrupi shaitaanon ke kaaran bhi hua karte hain.

10109: Jab namaz ke liye azaan kahi jaati hai, to shaitaan hawa nikaalta hua peeth pherkar bhaag khara hota hai; taaki azaan ki aawaaz na sun sake

10112: Kya main tumhen, Qur'an ki mahaantam soora na sikhaaoon?

Abu saeed raafe bin mualla (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne mujhse farmaya: Kya main tumhen, tumhaare masjid se nikalne se pahle- pahle Qur'an ki mahaantam soora na sikhaaoon? Aapne mera haath pakar liya. Jab ham masjid se nikalne lage, to mainne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapne kaha tha ki aap hamen Qur'an ki mahaantam soora sikhayenge? To farmaya: Yeh soora hai: Al- hamdu lillahi rabbil- aalmeen, yeh sab-al-masaani (baar- baar dohraai jaane waali saat ayten) aur mahaan Qur'an ka saar hai, jo mujhe diya gaya hai.

Abu saeed raafe bin mualla -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne mujhse farmaya : "ألا", yeh shabd mukhaatab ka aakarshan baad mein aane waali baat ki or kendrit karne ke liye kaha jaata hai. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka kathan; "Kya main tumhen, tumhaare masjid se nikalne se pahle-pahle Qur'an ki mahaantam soora na sikhaaoon?", aapne unko seedha sikha dene ke bajay sikhaane se pahle yeh baat isliye kahi, taaki unka zehan use grahan karne ke liye poori tarah taiyaar ho jaye aur woh uski or achchhi tarah mutvajjeh ho jayen. "Aapne mera haath pakar liya." Yaani iske pashchaat ki aapne yeh baat kahi aur ham chal pare. "Jab ham masjid se nikalne lage, to mainne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapne kaha tha ki aap hamen Qur'an ki mahaantam soora sikhayenge? To farmaya: Yeh soora hai: Al- hamdu lillahi rabbil- aalmeen" Yaani soora faatiha. Ise Qur'an ki mahaantam soora isliye kaha gaya hai ki ismen Qur'an ke saare uddeshy samaahit hain. Isi bindu ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue ise umm al-Qur'an bhi kaha jaata hai. Phir aapne Qur'an ki us wisheshta ko chihnit kar diya, jiske kaaran woh Qur'an ki shesh sooron se bhinn hai. Farmaya : "Yeh saba-al-masaani (baar- baar dohraai jaane waali saat ayten) hai" Yaani iska naam sab-al-masaani hai. Ismen prayukt "المثاني" Shabd "مثناة" Ka bahuvchan hai, jo "التثنية" Se liya gaya hai. Is soora ko "Saba al-masaani" Isliye kaha jaata hai, kyonki yeh namaz ki har rakaat mein dohraai jaati hai. Ya phir isliye ki iske saath ek doosri soora milaai jaati hai. Ya phir isliye ki iske andar prashansa evn dua jaisi do prakaar ki cheezen hain. Ya phir isliye ki ismen prawaahsheel bhaasha evn sugam warnan shaili donon ekatr hain. Ya phir isliye ki ise us samay se aaj tak baar-baar dohraya ja raha hai aur yeh silsila tootta nahin hai tatha iska pathan-paathan kiya ja raha hai aur yeh khatm nahin hoti. Ya phir isliye ki samay ke saath iske nae-nae laabh saamne aate rahte hain, jiska koi ant nahin hai. Jabki aisa bhi ho sakta hai ki "المثاني" Shabd "مثناة" Ka bahuvchan ho, jo "الثناء" Se liya gaya hai. Aisa isliye ki yeh uchch evn mahaan Allah ki prashansa par aadhaarit hai. Goya yeh soora Allah ke sundar evn adbhut naamon evn gunon ke dvaara uski prashansa karti hai. Jabki aisa bhi sanbhav hai "الثنايا" Se liya gaya ho. Aisa isliye ki Allah ne ise apni ummat ke liye chun liya hai. Aapke shabd "Aur mahaan Qur'an hai." Yaani uska ek naam yeh bhi hai. Aapke shabd "Jo mujhe diya gaya hai." Yaani jo mujhe pradaan kiya hai. Is soora ko "Mahaan Qur'an" Ka naam isliye diya gaya hai ki iske andar lok evn parlok tatha ahkaam evn aqaaid aadi saari cheezon ka wivran maujood hai.
10113: Jo kuraan mein nipun hai, woh sammaanit aur nek raajdooton (pharishton) ke saath hoga, tatha jo atak-atak kar quraan parhta hai aur use quraan parhne mein kathinaai hoti hai, uske liye dohra sawaab hai.

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jo kuraan mein nipun hai, woh sammaanit aur nek raajdooton (pharishton) ke saath hoga, tatha jo atak-atak kar quraan parhta hai aur use quraan parhne mein kathinaai hoti hai, uske liye dohra sawaab hai."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki jo vyakti quraan parhta ho aur use quraan achchhi tarah yaad ho tatha achchhi tarah parhna bhi aata ho,  use pratiphal svaroop aakhirat mein un farishton ke saath sthaan milega, jo nek aur sammaanit hain tatha raajdoot ka kaam karte hain. Jabki aisa vyakti jo quraan parhta ho aur achchhi tarah yaad na hone ya theek se parh na paane ke kaaran atak-atak kar parhta hai aur parhne mein kathinaai hone ke baavjood parhta rahta hai, to uske liye doguna sawaab hai. Ek parhne ka sawaab aur doosra parhne mein hone waali kathinaai ka sawaab.

Sawaab praapt karne ke liye quraan ko achchhi tarah yaad karne aur adhik se adhik parhne ki prerna aur aisa karne waale ke uchch sthaan ka bayaan.
Qaazi kahte hain : Is hadees ka matlab yeh nahin hai ki atak-atkar parhne waale ko parhne mein nipun vyakti se adhik sawaab milega. Nipun vyakti adhik shreshth hai aur use adhik sawaab milega. Kyonki woh sammaanit evn shreshth farishton ke saath hoga tatha uske liye bahut adhik sawaab hai. Yeh baat aapne kisi aur ke liye nahin kahi hai. Uska martaba aisa vyakti kaise pa sakta hai, jisne Allah ki kitaab ko yaad karne, nipun hone, adhik se adhik parhne, seekhne aur samajhne mein uski tarah tawajjo nahin di ki woh bhi nipun ho jaata.
Ibn-e-baaz kahte hain : Aisa vyakti jo quraan parhta ho, usmen nipun ho aur use achchhi tarah parhta aur yaad rakhta ho, sammaanit farishton ke saath hoga, iska matlab yeh hai ki woh achchhi tilaawat ke saath-saath quraan ke aadeshon evn nirdeshon par amal bhi karta ho. Kewal tilaawat hi na karta ho. Jo achchhi tilaawat bhi karta ho aur uspar amal bhi karta ho wahi shabd aur arth donon etibaar se quraan par amal karne waala hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
10114: Kya tumhen maaloom nahin ki jo ayten aaj raat utri hain, un jaisi ayten kabhi nahin dekhi gaeen! Ye ayten hain: Qul aoozu bi-rabbil falaq aur qul aoozu bi-rabbinnaas

Uqba bin aamir (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Kya tumhen maaloom nahin ki jo ayten aaj raat utri hain, un jaisi ayten kabhi nahin dekhi gaeen! Ye ayten hain: Qul aoozu bi-rabbil falaq aur qul aoozu bi-rabbinnaas.

Uqba bin aamir -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "ألم تر" Yaani kya tum nahin jaante? Yeh hai to warnankarta ke liye wishesh sanbodhan, lekin isse muraad sabhi log hain. Yeh aashchary prakat karne waala shabd hai. Aage aapne aashchary ke kaaran ki or ishaara karte hue kaha : "لم ير مثلهن" Yaani Allah ki sharan maangne ke sanbandh mein inki jaisi koi soora dekhi nahin gai. Aapke dvaara prayukt shabd "قط" Inkaar ki pushti karne ke liye hai. Aapke shabd : "قل أعوذ برب الفلق و قل أعوذ برب الناس" Ka arth yeh hai ki jis tarah in donon sooron ki saari ayten paathak ko saari buraaiyon se Allah ki sharan pradaan karne ka kaam karti hai, us tarah kisi aur soora ki saari ayten nahin karteen. In donon sooron ke dvaara jo vyakti eemaan evn nishtha ke saath Allah ki sharan maangega, use sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah sharan dene ka kaam karega. Saaraansh yeh hai ki insaan ko in donon sooron ke dvaara Allah ki sharan maangni chahiye.
10115: Qayaamat ke din azaan dene waalon ki gardanen sabse oonchi hongi.

Muaawiya -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko yeh pharmaate hue suna hai : "Qayaamat ke din azaan dene waalon ki gardanen sabse oonchi hongi."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki azaan dene waale, apne is kaary ki mahatta, apni nekiyon tatha milne waale bare pratiphal ke kaaran qayaamat ke din sabse oonchi gardan waale honge.

Azaan ki fazeelat tatha uski prerna.
Azaan dene waalon ka maan-sammaan tatha qayaamat ke din unka uchch sthaan.
10118: Allah jnaan ko logon se chheenkar nahin uthayega, balki woh jnaan ko bandon se ulema ko maut dekar uthayega

Abdullah bin amr bin aas (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue suna hai: Allah jnaan ko logon se chheenkar nahin uthayega, balki woh jnaan ko bandon se ulema ko maut dekar uthayega. Yahaan tak ki jab koi aalim (jnaani) nahin bachega, to log jaahilon ko sardaar bana lenge. Phir unse dharm ke widhi- widhaan poochhe jayenge, to we jaankaari ke bina fatve denge aur is tarah khud bhi gumraah honge aur doosron ko bhi gumraah karenge.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10119: Allah taaala is kitaab ke zariye kuchh logon ko oopar uthaata hai to isi ke kaaran kuchh logon ko neeche gira deta hai

Umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Allah is kitaab ke zariye kuchh logon ko oopar uthaata hai to isi ke kaaran kuchh logon ko neeche gira deta hai.
10120: 'Isra' ki raat Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas do pyaale laye gae

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki 'isra' ki raat Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas sharaab tatha doodh ke do pyaale laye gae. Aapne donon ko dekha aur doodh ke pyaale ko le liya. Yeh dekhkar jibreel (alaihissalaam) ne kaha: Saari prashansa Allah ki hai, jisne aapka maargadarshan 'fitrat' ki or kiya. Yadi aapne sharaab ka pyaala uthaya hota, to aapki ummat gumraah ho jaati.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10121: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne aashoora ke din (muharram ki dasveen taareekh ko) roza rakha

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne aashoora ke din (muharram ki dasveen taareekh ko) roza rakha aur us din roza rakhne ka aadesh bhi diya.

Ulema is baat par ekmat hain ki dasven muharram ka roza waajib nahin, sunnat hai. Lekin is baat par unke mat alag-alag hain ki shuru mein jab is din ke roze ka aadesh diya gaya tha aur Ramzan ke roze farz nahin hue the, us samay uska hukm kya tha? Us samay woh waajib tha ya nahin? Yadi yeh saheeh hai ki shuru mein waajib tha, to uska wajoob kai saheeh hadeeson ke kaaran nirast ho chuka hai. Is tarah ki ek hadees aaisha -radiyallahu anha- se warnit hai ki quraish qabeele ke log ajnaan kaal mein dasven muharram ka roza rakha karte the. Phir Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne use rakhne ka aadesh diya, yahaan tak ki Ramzan ke roze farz ho gae. Tab Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Jo chaahe us din roza rakhe aur jo chaahe na rakhe." Is hadees ko imaam Bukhari (3/24 hadees sankhya : 1893) aur imaam Muslim (2/792 hadees sankhya : 1125) ne riwayat kiya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10404: Barkat waale evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : Mainne apne achchhe karm karne waale bandon ke liye woh cheezen taiyaar kar rakhi hain, jinhen na kisi aankh ne dekha hai, na kisi kaan ne suna hai aur na kisi insaan ke dil mein unka khayaal aya hai.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : Barkat waale evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : Mainne apne achchhe karm karne waale bandon ke liye woh cheezen taiyaar kar rakhi hain, jinhen na kisi aankh ne dekha hai, na kisi kaan ne suna hai aur na kisi insaan ke dil mein unka khayaal aya hai." Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha : Yadi tum chaaho, to yeh ayat parh lo : (Koi praani nahin jaanta ki hamne unke liye aankhen thandi karne waali kya-kya cheezen chhupa rakhi hain.) [soora sajda : 17]

Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa salmal ne bataya hai ki barkat waale tatha mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : Mainne Jannat ke andar apne sadaachaari bandon ke sammaan mein aisi-aisi cheezen taiyaar kar rakhi hain, jinhen na kisi aankh ne dekha hai, na kisi kaan ne unki wisheshtaaon ko suna hai aur na unki waastawikta ki kalpana kisi dil ne ki hai. Is hadees ko bayaan karne ke baad abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha ki yadi tum chaaho to yeh ayat parh lo :

"Koi praani nahin jaanta ki unke liye aankhen thandi karne waali kya-kya cheezen chhupaakar rakhi gai hain." [soora sajda : 17]

Yeh hadees un hadeeson mein se hai, jo Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne rab se riwayat karke kaha hai. Is tarah ki hadees ko hadees-e-qudsi ya hadees-e-ilaahi kaha jaata hai. Isse muraad woh hadees hai, jiske shabd tatha arth donon Allah ke hon. Haalaanki, ismen quraan ki we wisheshtayen nahin hain jo quraan ko doosron se alag karti hain, jaise ki quraan ki tilaawat ke maadhyam se ibaadat karna, iski tilaawat ke liye tahaarat  praapt karna, iska chamatkaari hona aur iske dvaara chunauti dena, aadi.
Neki ke kaam karne tatha gunaahon se door rahne ki prerna, taaki Allah ke dvaara sadaachaari bandon ke liye taiyaar ki gai nemten praapt ho saken.
Allah ne apni kitaab tatha apne Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki sunnat dvaara hamen Jannat ki saari nemton ke baare mein bataya nahin hai. Jannat ki jin nemton ko ham jaante hain, unse wo nemten kaheen adhik bari hain, jinhen ham nahin jaante.
Jannat ki saari nemten sanpoorn hongi aur jannatiyon ko milne waali prasannatayen har prakaar ke wighn se khaali hongi.
Saari ki saari cheezen fana ho jayengi aur aakhirat behtar tatha adhik sthayi hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
10405: Main us vyakti ko achchhi tarah jaanta hoon, jo ant mein Jahannam se niklega aur ant mein Jannat ke andar prawesh karega. Woh chootron ke bal ghisatta hua Jahannam se niklega. Sarvashaktimaan Allah usse kahega: Jaao aur Jannat mein prawesh kar jaao. Woh Jannat ke paas jayega, lekin use aisa lagega ki Jannat bhari hui hai. Atah laut ayega aur kahega: Ai mere rab! Mainne paya ki Jannat bhari hui hai

Mugheera bin shoba (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Moosa (alaihissalaam) ne apne rab se poochha: Jannat mein sabse nichle darje waala vyakti kaun hoga? Allah ne kaha: Woh aisa vyakti hoga, jo jannatiyon ke Jannat mein prawesh kar jaane ke baad ayega. Usse kaha jayega: Jannat mein prawesh kar jaao. Woh kahega: Main Jannat mein bhala kaise prawesh karoon, jabki logon ne apne- apne sthaan grahan kar liye hain aur apne- apne hisse ki neemten praapt kar li hain? Usse kaha jayega: Kya tum is baat par raazi ho ki tumhen duniya ke baadshaahon mein se kisi baadshaah ke baraabar praapt ho? Woh kahega: Ai mere rab! Main raazi ho gaya. Ab Allah kahega: Yeh to tere liye hai hi, lekin saath mein iske das guna bhi hai tatha tere liye woh sab kuchh hai, jiski tere dil mein ichchha jaage aur jo teri aankh ko achchha lage. Woh kahega: Ai mere rab! Main raazi ho gaya. Moosa (alaihissalaam) ne kaha: Ai mere rab! Phir sabse oonche darje ka jannati kaun hoga? Allah ne kaha: Sabse oonche darje ke jannati woh log honge, jinka chayan khud mainne kiya, jinke sammaan ka paudha mainne apne haathon se lagaya aur unke is sammaan ke oopar apni muhar laga di. Unhen aisi cheezen praapt hongi, jinhen na kisi aankh ne dekha hai, na kisi kaan ne suna hai aur na kisi insaan ke dil mein unka khyaal aya hai.
Tatha abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Main us vyakti ko achchhi tarah jaanta hoon, jo ant mein Jahannam se niklega aur ant mein Jannat ke andar prawesh karega. Woh chootron ke bal ghisatta hua Jahannam se niklega. Sarvashaktimaan Allah usse kahega: Jaao aur Jannat mein prawesh kar jaao. Woh Jannat ke paas jayega, lekin use aisa lagega ki Jannat bhari hui hai. Atah, laut ayega aur kahega: Ai mere rab! Mainne paya ki Jannat bhari hui hai. Sarvashaktimaan Allah kahega: Jaao aur Jannat mein daakhil ho jaao. Woh jayega, lekin use phir lagega ki Jannat bhari hui hai. Atah, phir laut ayega aur kahega: Ai mere rab! Mainne use bhara hua paya hai. Tab sarvashaktimaan Allah kahega: Jaao, Jannat mein prawesh kar jaao, tumhaare liye duniya ke jaisa aur uske das guna hai ya tumhaare liye duniya ke das guna hai. Woh kahega: Kya tu mere saath mazaaq kar raha hai ya meri hansi ura raha hai, jabki tu sachcha baadshaah hai? Warnankarta kahte hain: Mainne dekha ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hans pare, yahaan tak ki aapke daarh ke daant prakat ho gae. Tab aapne farmaya: Yeh sabse kam darje ka jannati hoga.

Allah ki daansheelta tatha apaar anukanpa ka warnan evn Jannat waalon ki pratishtha ka ullekh. Ismen bataya gaya hai ki Jannat ki nichli shreni mein sthaan paane waale vyakti ko bhi duniya ke kisi baadshaah se hazaaron guna adhik nemten praapt hongi.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10406: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne yaatri ke liye teen din teen raat aur thahre hue vyakti ke liye ek din ek raat nirdhaarit ki hai

Shuraih bin haani kahte hain ki main aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ke paas, unse mozon par masah karne ki avdhi poochhne ke liye aya, to unhonne bataya: Tum ali bin abu taalib (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas jaao aur unse poochho; kyonki woh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath safar kiya karte the. Hamne unse poochha, to bataya: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne yaatri ke liye teen din teen raat aur thahre hue vyakti ke liye ek din ek raat ki avdhi nirdhaarit ki hai.
10407: Kaho : السلام على أهل الديار من المؤمنين والمسلمين، ويرحم الله المستقدمين منا والمستأخرين، وإنا إن شاء الله بكم للاحقون arthaat, is sthaan mein niwaas karne waale mominon aur musalmaanon par salaamti ho! Allah hammen se pahle jaane waalon aur baad mein aane waalon par daya kare, Allah ne chaaha, to ham bhi tumse a milne waale hain

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se warnit hai ki unhonne kaha: Kya main tumhen apni aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki ek ghatna na sunaaoon? Hamne kaha: Awashy sunayen! Warnankarta ka kahna hai ki woh kahne lageen: Ek din meri baari mein Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) mere paas the. Isi beech aapne karvat badli, apni chaadar tatha jooton ko utaarkar apne pairon ke paas rakh liye aur apni lungi ke kinaare ko bistar par bichhaakar let gae. Bas itni der guzarne ke baad ki aapko laga ki main so chuki hoon, aapne dheere se apni chaadar li, dheere se joota pahna, dvaar kholkar nikle aur dheere se band kar diya. Yeh dekh mainne apni chaadar ko sar par daal liya, tahband pahan liya aur aapke peechhe- peechhe chal pari. Aap baqi qabristaan aakar khare ho gae aur der tak khare rahe. Phir teen baar apne haathon ko uthaya (tatha dua ki) aur waapas chal diye. Main bhi laut pari. Aap tez chalne lage, to main bhi tez chalne lagi. Aap daurne lage, to main bhi daurne lagi. Is tarah aap ghar pahunche, to main bhi pahunch gai. Parantu, main aapse pahle pahunchi aur ghar ke andar prawesh kar gai. Abhi main let hi paai thi ki aap bhi a gae. Aapne farmaya: Ai aaisha! Baat kya hai, tumhaari saans kyon phool rahi hai? Warnankarta ka kahna hai ki unhonne kaha: Kuchh nahin hai. Aapne farmaya: Tum mujhe bataaogi ya mujhe sookshmadarshi tatha sabki khabar rakhne waala Allah batayega? Woh kahti hain ki mainne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aap par mere maan- baap qurbaan hon! Phir mainne sab kuchh kah sunaya. Aapne farmaya: To tum hi woh parchhaani ho, jise main apne aage dekh raha tha? Mainne kaha: Haan. Ispar aapne mere seene pe aisa ghoonsa jamaya ki mujhe dard ka anubhav hua. Phir farmaya: Kya tumko lagta hai ki Allah aur uska Rasool tumhaara haq maar lenge? Unhonne kaha: Log chaahe jitna chhupayen, Allah to jaan hi leta hai. Aapne kahaah sach kahti ho. Daraasal, jibreel (alaihissalaam) mere paas aye the, jab tumne mujhe jaate dekha. Unhonne mujhe tumse chhipaate hue pukaara aur mainne tumse chhupaate hue uttar diya. Waise, woh tumhaare paas us samay nahin aate, jab tum kapre utaar deti ho. Mainne samjha ki tum so chuki ho, isliye mainne tumhen jagaana munaasib na jaana. Mujhe is baat ka bhi bhay tha ki tumhen akele mein dar mahsoos hoga. Phir jibreel ne kaha: Aapka rab aapko aadesh deta hai ki baqi waalon ke paas jayen aur unke liye kshama yaachna karen. Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ka kahna hai ki mainne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Main unke liye kin shabdon mein dua karoon? Aapne farmaya, kaho: السلام على أهل الديار من المؤمنين والمسلمين، ويرحم الله المستقدمين منا والمستأخرين، وإنا إن شاء الله بكم للاحقون arthaat, is sthaan mein niwaas karne waale mominon aur musalmaanon par salaamti ho, Allah hammen se pahle jaane waalon aur baad mein aane waalon par daya kare, Allah ne chaaha to ham bhi tumse a milne waale hain.
10408: Jab Allah ne aadam ko paida kiya, to unki peeth par haath phera aur unki peeth se woh saari roohen (aatmayen) nikal aaeen, jinhen Allah unki nasl se qayaamat tak paida karega

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Jab Allah ne aadam ko paida kiya, to unki peeth par haath phera aur unki peeth se woh saari roohen (aatmayen) nikal aaeen, jinhen Allah unki nasl se qayaamat tak paida karega tatha har insaan ki donon aankhon ke beech mein noor ki ek chamak rakh di. Phir unhen aadam (alaihissalaam) ke saamne rakha. Ispar aadam (alaihissalaam) ne kaha: Ai mere rab! Ye kaun log hain? Allah ne kaha: Ye sab teri santaanen hain. Aadam (alaihissalaam) ne unke beech ek vyakti ko dekha, jiske donon aankhon ke beech ki chamak unhen bari achchhi lagi, to bole: Ai mere rab! Yeh kaun hai? Allah ne kaha: Yeh teri nasl ki antim jaatiyon mein paida hone waala ek vyakti hai, jise daaood kaha jayega. Unhonne kaha: Ai mere rab! Uski ayu toone kitni nirdhaarit ki hai? Allah ne kaha: Saath saal. Unhonne kaha: Ai mere rab! Meri ayu se chaalees saal kaatkar use de de. Phir jab aadam (alaihissalaam) ki ayu samaapt ho gai, to maut ke farishte ne unse kaha: Kya meri ayu ke chaalees warsh shesh nahin rah gae hain? Farishte ne uttar diya: Kya aapne woh chaalees saal apne bete daaood (alaihissalaam) ko nahin de diye the? Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) farmaate hain: Aadam ne inkaar kiya, to unki santaan bhi inkaar karne waali ban gai, aadam bhool gae, to unki santaan bhi bhoolne waali ban gai aur aadam ne ghalti ki, to unki santaan bhi ghalti karne waali ban gai.
10409: Har woh maal, jo mainne apne bande ko diya hai, woh uske liye halaal hai, mainne apne saare bandon ko ek Allah ki wandna karne waala banaakar paida kiya hai, phir shaitaan unke paas aye aur unhen unke dharm se bahkaane lage

Iyaaz bin himaar mujaashii (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki ek din Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apne sanbodhan mein farmaya: Sun lo, mere rab ne mujhe aadesh diya hai ki usne aaj mujhe jo baaten sikhaai hain, unmen se woh baaten main tumhen bata doon, jo tum nahin jaante. (Allah taaala ka farmaan hai) har woh maal, jo mainne apne bande ko diya hai, woh uske liye halaal hai. Mainne apne saare bandon ko ek Allah ki wandna karne waala banaakar paida kiya hai. Phir shaitaan unke paas aye aur unhen unke dharm se bahkaane lage. Unpar woh cheezen haraam kar deen, jo mainne unke liye halaal ki theen. Unhen aadesh diya ki un cheezon ko mera saajhi thahrayen, jinke saajhi hone ki koi daleel mainne nahin utaari hai. Allah ne dharti ki or dekha, to kuchh bache- khuche ahle kitaab (yahoodi aur eesaai) ko chhorkar unke arab tatha ghairaarab sabse naaraaz hua tatha farmaya: Mainne tumhen isliye bheja hai, taaki tumhen aazmaaoon aur tumhaare dvaara any logon ko bhi. Mainne tumpar ek aisi kitaab utaari hai, jise paani dho nahin sakta. Tum use sote- jaagte parhte ho. Allah ne mujhe aadesh diya hai ki main quraish ko jala daaloon. Mainne kaha: Ai mere rab! Tab to we mere sar ko kuchalkar roti bana denge. Allah ne kaha: Unhen nikaalo, jaise unhonne tumhen nikaala, unse yuddh karo, ham tumhen yuddh karne ki shakti pradaan karenge, kharch karo, ham tumpar kharch karenge, tum sena bhejo, ham us jaisi paanch senayen bhejenge tatha apne maanne waalon ko saath lekar un logon se yuddh karo, jo nahin maante. Allah ne kaha: Jannati teen prakaar ke log honge: Nyaykaari, sadqa karne waala aur Allah ki or se saty par chalne ka saamarthy praapt kiya hua baadshaah, sabhi rishtedaaron tatha musalmaanon ke liye narm dil tatha dayaalu vyakti evn paakdaaman aur maangne se bachne waala pariwaar waala. Allah ne kaha: Jahannam mein paanch prakaar ke log daakhil honge: Buddhiheen kamzor jo tumhaare adheen ho aur pariwaar tatha dhan ki chaahat na rakhta ho, aisa chhal karne waala, jiska laalach chhupa nahin rahta, chhoti se chhoti cheez ke baare mein bhi chhal karne par utar aata ho aur aisa vyakti, jo tumhen subah wa shaam tumhaare pariwaar tatha dhan ke baare mein dhokha de. Tatha kanjoos athva jhoothe vyakti aur aise badachlan evn ashisht aadmi ka bhi zikr kiya, jo gandi tatha ashleel bhaasha prayog karta ho.
10410: Ai mere rab! Meri sahayta kar aur mere wiruddh sahayta na kar, mujhe wijay pradaan kar aur kisi ko mere wiruddh wijay pradaan na kar, mere haq mein yojna bana tatha mere wiruddh yojna mat bana, mujhe sachchaai ke raaste par chala aur sachchaai ke raaste par chalna mere liye aasaan kar tatha mere wiruddh wiplav karne waale par mujhe wijyi bana

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) yeh dua kiya karte theh «ربِّ أَعِنِّي ولا تُعِن عليَّ، وانصرني ولا تنصر عليَّ، وامكر لي ولا تمكر عليَّ، واهدني ويسِّر هُدايَ إليَّ، وانصرني على مَن بغى عليَّ، اللهم اجعلني لك شاكرًا، لك ذاكرًا، لك راهبًا، لك مِطواعًا، إليك مُخْبِتًا، أو مُنِيبا، رب تقبَّل توبتي، واغسل حَوْبتي، وأجب دعوتي، وثبِّت حُجَّتي، واهدِ قلبي، وسدِّد لساني، واسْلُلْ سَخِيمةَ قلبي». Arthaat, ai mere rab! Meri sahayta kar aur mere wiruddh sahayta na kar, mujhe wijay pradaan kar aur kisi ko mere wiruddh wijay pradaan na kar, mere haq mein yojna bana tatha mere wiruddh yojna mat bana, mujhe sachchaai ke raaste par chala aur sachchaai ke raaste par chalna mere liye aasaan kar tatha mere wiruddh wiplav karne waale par mujhe wijyi bana. Ai Allah! Mujhe apna shukr ada karne waala, apna zikr karne waala, apne se darne waala, apna anukran karne waala aur apne aage jhukne waala ya apni or lautne waala bana. Ai mere rab! Meri tauba qabool kar, mere gunaah dho de, meri dua qabool kar, meri daleel ko siddh kar, mere dil ko sachcha raasta dikha, meri zabaan ko durust rakh aur mere dil ke mail- kuchail ko nikaal de.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10411: Utne hi kaary kiya karo, jis (ko jaari rakhne) ki tum shakti rakhte ho, Allah ki qasam, Allah (pratiphal dene se) nahin uktayega, yahaan tak ki tum khud (use jaari rakhne se) ukta jaaoge

Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki patni aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ka warnan hai ki haula bint tuwait bin habeeb bin asad bin abdul uzza unke paas se guzreen. Us samay unke paas Allah ke Rasool maujood the. Atah, unhonne kaha: Yeh haula bint tuwait hain. Logon ka kahna hai ki yeh raat bhar nahin soteen. Yeh sun kar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Raat bhar nahin soti! (Dekho) utne hi kaary kiya karo, jis (ko jaari rakhne) ki tum shakti rakhte ho. Allah ki qasam! Allah (pratiphal dene se) nahin uktayega, yahaan tak ki tum khud (use jaari rakhne se) ukta jaaoge.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10412: Hamaara barkat waala tatha uchch rab har raat, jabki raat ka ek tihaai bhaag shesh rah jaata hai, duniya se nikat waale aasmaan par utarkar pharmaata hai

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Hamaara barkat waala tatha uchch rab har raat, jabki raat ka ek tihaai bhaag shesh rah jaata hai, duniya se nikat waale aasmaan par utarkar pharmaata hai : Kaun hai jo dua kare ki main use qabool karoon; kaun hai jo mujhse maange ki main use pradaan karoon, kaun hai jo mujhse kshama maange ki main use kshama kar doonॽ''

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki hamaara uchch evn mahaan rab har raat, jab raat ka antim tihaai bhaag shesh rah jaata hai, to duniya se nikattam aakaash mein utarta hai aur apne bandon ko dua karne ki prerna deta hai ki woh use pukaarne waale ki baat sunta hai, unhen apni-apni muraaden maangene ki prerna deta hai ki woh maangne waale ki jholi bhar deta hai aur gunaahon ki kshama maangne ko kahta hai ki woh apne momin bandon ko kshama kar deta hai.

Raat ke antim tihaai bhaag tatha usmen namaz parhne, dua karne aur kshama yaachna karne ki fazeelat.
Is hadees ko sunne ke baad insaan ko dua qabool hone ke samyon ka khoob laabh uthaana chahiye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
10413: Kya tumhen dophar ke samay sooraj ko dekhne mein, jabki woh baadlon mein na ho, koi kathinaai hoti hai? Unhonne uttar diya ki nahin! To aapne farmaya: Kya tumhen chaudahveen ki raat ko, chaand ko dekhne mein, jabki woh baadlon mein na ho, koi kathinaai hoti hai?

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki sahaaba ne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya qayaamat ke din ham apne rab ko dekh sakenge? Aapne farmaya: Kya tumhen dophar ke samay sooraj ko dekhne mein, jabki woh baadlon mein na ho, koi kathinaai hoti hai? Unhonne uttar diya ki nahin. To aapne farmaya: Kya tumhen chaudahveen ki raat ko, chaand ko dekhne mein, jabki woh baadlon mein na ho, koi kathinaai hoti hai? Unhonne uttar diya ki nahin. To aapne farmaya: Uski qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, tumhen apne rab ko dekhne mein koi kathinaai nahin hogi, jis tarah in donon mein se kisi ko dekhne mein koi kathinaai nahin hoti hai. Aapne kaha: Phir Allah bande se milega aur usse kahega: Ai falaan! Kya mainne tujhe maan- sammaan nahin diya tha, sardaari nahin di thi, shaadi nahin karaai thi, ghoron aur oonton ko tere kaam par nahin lagaya tha aur yeh avsar nahin diya tha ki sardaar bankar ghaneemat ke dhan ka chauthaai bhaag praapt kare? Woh kahega: Zaroor diya tha, ai mere rab! Allah kahega: Kya toone yeh socha tha ki tujhe mujhse milna hai? Woh kahega: Nahin. Allah kahega: Ja, main tujhe bhulaata hoon, jaise toone mujhe bhula rakha tha. Phir doosre se milega aur kahega: Ai falaan! Kya mainne tujhe maan- sammaan nahin diya tha, sardaari nahin di thi, shaadi nahin karaai thi, ghoron aur oonton ko tere kaam par nahin lagaya tha aur yeh avsar nahin diya tha ki sardaar bankar ghaneemat ke dhan ka chauthaai bhaag praapt kare? Woh kahega: Zaroor diya tha, ai mere rab! Allah kahega: Kya toone yeh socha tha ki tujhe mujhse milna hai? Woh kahega: Nahin. Allah kahega: Ja, main tujhe bhulaata hoon, jaise toone mujhe bhula rakha tha. Phir teesre se milega aur isi tarah ki baat kahega, to woh kahega: Ai mere rab! Main tujhpar, teri kitaab par aur rasoolon par eemaan laya, namaz parhi, roza rakha aur sadqa diya. Is tarah woh jahaan tak ho sakega, apni achchhaaiyaan bayaan karega. Tab Allah kahega: Yeh baat hai to zara yaheen thaharna. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Phir usse kaha jayega: Ab ham tere wiruddh apna gawaah laate hain. Woh dil hi dil mein sochta rahega ki kaun mere wiruddh gawaahi dega? Phir uske munh par muhar laga di jayegi aur uski raan, uske maans aur uski haddiyon se kaha jayega ki bolo. To uski raan, uska maans aur uski haddiyaan uske karmon ke baare mein bolne lagengi. Aisa isliye kiya jayega, taaki uska koi bahaana baaqi na rahe. Daraasal yeh vyakti munaafiq hoga, jisse Allah naaraaz hoga.

Kuchh sahaaba ne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha ki kya ham qayaamat ke din apne prabhu ko dekh sakenge? To aapne unse prashn kiya : "Kya tumhen dophar ke samay, jab sooraj baadlon mein na ho, use dekhne mein koi kathinaai hoti hai?" Yaani jab sooraj beech aakaash mein ho, uska prakaash chaaron or phaila hua ho aur aakaash mein kaheen koi baadal na ho, us samay tumhen logon ki bheer-bhaar ki wajah se sooraj ko dekhne mein koi kathinaai hoti hai? Sahaaba ne nahin mein iska uttar diya, to farmaya : "Kya tumhen chaudahveen ki raat ko, chaand ko dekhne mein, jabki woh baadlon mein na ho, koi kathinaai hoti hai?" Yaani kya poore chaand ki raat ko, jab chaand har taraf roshni bikher raha ho aur aakaash mein koi baadal bhi na ho, us samay tumhen logon ki bheer-bhaar ke kaaran use dekhne mein koi kasht hota hai? Iska uttar bhi jab sahaaba ne nahin mein diya, to farmaya : "Uski qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, tumhen apne rab ko dekhne mein koi kathinaai nahin hogi, jis tarah in donon mein se kisi ko dekhne mein koi kathinaai nahin hoti hai." Yaani use spasht roop se dekha ja sakega. Use dekhne mein na koi aapsi jhagra hoga aur na sandeh ki uske baare mein log ek-doosre ka wirodh karen aur ek-doosre ko jhuthlayen. Bilkul waise hi, jis tarah sooraj evn chaand ko dekhne mein koi sandeh nahin hota aur koi jhagra nahin hota. Is tarah yahaan samaanta spashtata ke drishtikon se dekhne mein dikhaai gai hai aur bataya gaya hai ki donon sthaanon mein dekhna sandeh ke dayre se baahar hai. Na saari kaifiyton mein koi sandeh hai aur na dekhi jaane waali wastu mein. Kyonki pawitr Allah srishti ki samaanta se paak hai.
Phir Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne aakhirat ke din ke ek drishy ke baare mein bataya hai. Drishy yeh hai ki Allah apne ek bande se milega aur usse apne nemton ka etraaf karaate hue kahega : Ai amuk bande! Kya mainne tujhe shreshthata pradaan nahin ki thi, apni jaati ka sardaar nahin banaya tha, tumhaari hi jaati ki patni pradaan nahin ki aur phir tumhen uspar praabaly pradaan nahin kiya, tumhaare aur unke beech prem, daya aur mohabbat nahin banaai, tumhaari sewa mein ghoron aur oonton ko nahin lagaya, tumhen apni jaati ka pradhaan banaakar ghaneemat ka ek chauthaai bhaag dene ka adhikaar nahin diya, jise ajnaan kaal ke raaja apne liye liya karte the? Jab banda in saari nemton ka etraaf karega, to Allah kahega : Kya tu jaanta tha ki tujhe mujhse milna hai? Woh nahin mein uttar dega, to uchch evn mahaan Allah farmayega : "Ja, main tujhe bhula deta hoon, jis tarah tu ne mujhe bhula rakha tha." Yaani aaj main tujhe apni anukanpa se wanchit karta hoon, jis tarah tu ne duniya mein meri ibaadat se gurez kiya tha. Yahaan bhulaane se muraad jaan-boojhkar chhorna hai. Jaisa ki uchch evn mahaan Allah ka farmaan hai : "Hamne (bhi) tumhen bhula diya hai. Chakho, sada ki yaatna."
Phir Allah doosre bande se milega. Phir Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne usi prakaar ke waartaalaap ka zikr kiya, jis prakaar ki waartaalaap pahle bande aur Allah ke beech hui thi.
Phir teesre bande se milega aur usse bhi isi prakaar ki baat kahega, to woh kahega ki ai mere paalanhaar! Main tujhpar, teri kitaab aur tere rasoolon par eemaan laya, namaz parhi, roza rakha aur sadqa kiya. Is tarah woh jahaan tak usse ban sakega apni prashansa karega. Ispar Allah kahega : "Yeh baat hai to zara yaheen thaharna." Yaani jab toone is prakaar apni prashansa ki hai, to yahaan ruke raho, taaki ham gawaah prastut kar tumhen tumhaare karm dikha saken. Phir usse kaha jayega : Ab ham tumhaare wiruddh gawaah saamne laane ja rahe hain. Aise mein banda apne man mein kahega ki bhala mere wiruddh gawaahi kaun de sakta hai? Ispar Allah uske munh par muhar laga dega aur uski raan, maans aur haddiyon se kaha jayega ki tum bolo. Atah uski raan, maans aur haddiyaan uske karmon ko ujaagar karne lagengi. "Aisa isliye kiya jayega, taaki uska koi bahaana baaqi na rahe." Yaani uske shareer ke angon ko bolne ki shakti isliye pradaan ki jayegi aur unse gunaahon ka etraaf isliye karvaya jayega, taaki uske paas koi bahaana na rahe. Yeh teesra banda munaafiq hai, jo Allah ke krodh ka adhikaari hai.
10415: Sarvashaktimaan Allah ne srishtiyon ki rachna andhere mein ki aur unke oopar apna kuchh prakaash daala. Atah, jise us noor ka kuchh ansh praapt hua, use seedha maarg mil gaya aur jise praapt na ho saka, woh bhatak gaya. Isi liye main kahta hoon: Qalam Allah ke jnaan par sookh gai hai

Abdullah bin amr (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue suna hai: Sarvashaktimaan Allah ne srishtiyon ki rachna andhere mein ki aur unke oopar apna kuchh prakaash daala. Atah, jise us noor ka kuchh ansh praapt hua, use seedha maarg mil gaya aur jise praapt na ho saka, woh bhatak gaya. Isi liye main kahta hoon: Qalam Allah ke jnaan par sookh gai hai.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10416: Allah ke ninyaanve, ek kam sau naam hain, jisne unhen yaad kar liya, woh Jannat mein prawesh karega, Allah ek hai aur woh wisham sankhya ko pasand karta hai

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Allah ke ninyaanve, ek kam sau naam hain, jisne unhen yaad kar liya, woh Jannat mein prawesh karega. Allah ek hai aur woh wisham sankhya ko pasand karta hai.

Allah ke ninyaanve naam aise hain ki jisne unhen yaad kar liya, woh Jannat mein prawesh karega. Yahaan yaad karne se muraad zabaani parhna hai. Jabki kuchh logon ka kahna hai ki iska arth hai, unpar wishvaas rakhna, unpar amal karna, har ek naam ke arth ka anusran karna aur Allah ko unke zariye pukaarna. Is hadees mein ninyaanve naamon ko siddh to kiya gaya hai, lekin inke atirikt any naamon ka inkaar nahin kiya gaya hai. Lekin wishesh roop se in naamon ka ullekh isliye kiya gaya hai ki yeh sabse mashhoor evn spasht arth waale naam hain. Yeh hadees waisi hi hai, jaise aap kahen ki zaid ke paas sau dirham hain, jinhen usne sadqa ke liye rakha hua hai. Is waaky ka matlab yeh nahin ho sakta ki zaid ke paas kul itne hi dirham hain. Balki iska matlab yeh hai ki usne sadqa ke liye jo dirham rakhe hue hain, woh itne hain. Is tafseer ka pramaan abdullah bin masaood -radiyallahu anhu- ki yeh hadees hai : "Main tujhse har us naam ke waaste se maangta hoon, jo tera hai. Use tu ne apne liye rakh liya hai, ya use apni kitaab mein utaara hai, ya apni kisi srishti ko sikhaya hai ya apne paas paroksh ke jnaan mein chhipa rakha hai." Is hadees mein is baat ka pramaan hai ki Allah ke kuchh achchhe naam aise bhi hain, jinhen usne apni kitaab mein utaara nahin hai aur jinhen apni srishti se chhipa rakha hai.
"Allah ek hai" Yaani woh ek hai aur uska koi saajhi nahin hai. "Aur woh wisham sankhya ko pasand karta hai." Yaani use bahut-se karmon aur bahut-si ibaadton par tarjeeh deta hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki Allah ne namaazen paanch farz ki hain, tawaaf saat banaye hain, adhiktar karmon ko teen baar karne ko puny waala bataya hai, aakaash saat paida kiye aur dharti bhi saat paida ki.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10417: Teen vyakti kaheen ja rahe the ki achaanak baarish a gai, we pahaar ki ek gupha mein ja chhipe, itne mein ek chattaan lurhak kar aai

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Teen vyakti kaheen ja rahe the ki achaanak baarish a gai. We pahaar ki ek gupha mein ja chhipe. Itne mein ek chattaan lurhak kar aai (aur gupha ke dvaar ko band kar diya). Aap kahte hain: Aise mein, unhonne ek- doosre se kaha: Allah se apne kiye hue sabse achchhe kaary ke dvaara dua maango. So, unmen se ek ne kaha: Ai Allah! Mere wayowriddh maata- pita the. Main bakri charaane jaata, waapas aakar doodh duhta aur doodh ka bartan lekar apne maata- pita ke paas jaata. Jab donon pi lete, to apne bachchon, ghar ke logon aur patni ko pilaata tha. Sanyogvash, ek raat mujhe der ho gai. Main pahuncha, to donon so chuke the. Woh kahte hain ki mujhe achchha na laga ki unhen jagaaoon. Bachche mere paanv ke paas bhookhe pare ro rahe the. Meri aur mere maata- pita ki yahi haalat thi ki subah ho gai. Ai Allah! Agar tu jaanta hai ki mainne yeh kaary teri prasannata praapt karne ke liye kiya hai, to chattaan ko itna hata de ki ham aakaash ke darshan kar saken. Aap farmaate hain: To chattaan kuchh hat gai. Ab doosre ne kaha: Ai Allah! Tu achchhi tarah jaanta hai ki main apni ek chacheri bahan se utna zyaada pyaar karta tha, jitna pyaar ek purush ek stri se kar sakta hai. Lekin usne kah diya ki tum mujhse apni waasna us samay tak poori nahin kar sakte, jab tak mujhe sau deenaar na de do. Isliye, mainne sau deenaar jama karne ka prayaas kiya aur jama kar liya. Jab main uske donon pairon ke beech baith gaya, to usne kaha: Allah se dar aur awaidh tareeqe se muhar ko na tor! Itna sunna tha ki main use chhor kar khara ho gaya. (Ai Allah!) agar tu jaanta hai ki mainne yeh kaary teri prasannata praapt karne ke liye kiya hai, to hamaare liye nikalne ka raasta bana de. Aap farmaate hain: To dvaar ka do tihaai bhaag khul gaya. Phir teesre ne kaha: Ai Allah! Tu jaanta hai ki mainne ek 'faraq' (ek paimaana, jo 16 paaund ka hota tha) makai ke paarishramik par ek mazdoor ko kaam par lagaya tha. Mainne use uski mazdoori di, to usne lene se inkaar kar diya. To mainne us ek 'faraq' makai ko boya aur usse charvaaha samet ek bail khareed liya. Kuchh kaalaantar baad woh aya aur bola: Ai Allah ke bande! Mujhe mera haq de. Mainne kaha: Jaao, dekho, woh bail aur uska charvaaha tumhaara hai. Usne kaha: Kya tum mera mazaaq ura rahe ho? Mainne kaha: Main tumhaara mazaaq nahin ura raha hoon. Woh sachmuch tumhaara hai. Ai Allah! Agar tu jaanta hai ki mainne yeh kaary teri prasannata praapt karne ke liye kiya hai, to is chattaan ko hamaare raaste se hata de. To chattaan ko unke raaste se hata diya gaya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10420: Ai abu aaisha! Teen baaten aisi hain ki jisne unmen se koi ek baat kahi, usne Allah par bahut bara jhooth baandha

Masrooq kahte hain ki main aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ke paas baitha tha ki unhonne kaha: Ai abu aaisha! Teen baaten aisi hain ki jisne unmen se koi ek baat kahi, usne Allah par bahut bara jhooth baandha. Mainne kaha: Yeh teen baaten kya hain? To unhonne kaha: Jisne yeh dhaarna rakhi ki Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apne rab ko dekha hai, usne Allah par bahut bara jhooth baandha. Masrooq kahte hain ki main tek lagaakar baitha tha, itna sunte hi main seedha baith gaya aur kaha: Ai mominon ki maata! Mujhe bolne ka avsar deejiye aur mere baare mein koi nirnay lene mein jaldi na keejiye. Kya (sarvashaktimaan) Allah ne nahin kaha haih {ولقد رآه بالأُفُق المُبين} arthaat, usne usko aakaash mein khule roop se dekha hai, [soora at-takveerah 23], {ولقد رآه نَزْلَةً أخرى} arthaat, usne use ek baar aur bhi utarte dekha hai, [soora an-najmah 13]? Unki baat sunkar aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne kaha: Main is ummat ka pratham vyakti hoon, jisne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se is sanbandh mein poochha tha. Aapka uttar tha: Woh to jibreel the. Mainne unko unke asli roop mein, jis par Allah ne unhen paida kiya hai, kewal yahi do baar dekha hai (jiska ullekh in donon ayton mein hai). Mainne unko aasmaan se is tarah utarte dekha ki unke shareer ki bhaari- bharkam banaawat ne aakaash tatha dharti ke beech ke khaali sthaan ko gher rakha tha. Phir aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne kaha: Kya tumne nahin suna hai ki Allah kahta haih {لا تُدْرِكه الأبصارُ وهو يُدْرِكُ الأبصارَ وهو اللطيفُ الخبيرُ} arthaat, aankhen use pa nahin sakteen aur woh aankhon ko pa leta hai tatha woh sookshmadarshi aur khabar rakhne waala hai [soora al-anaaamah 103]? Kya tumne nahin suna ki Allah kahta haih {وما كان لبشرٍ أن يُكلِّمه اللهُ إلا وحيًا أو من وراء حِجاب أو يُرسلُ رسولا فيوحيَ بإذنه ما يشاء إنَّه عَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ} "Kisi manushy ke liye sanbhav nahin hai ki Allah usse baat kare, parantu wahy dvaara athva parde ke peechhe se athva koi Rasool (farishta) bhej de, jo uski anumti se jo kuchh woh chaahta ho, wahy kare, beshak woh sabse ooncha aur hikmat waala hai" [soora ash-shooraah 51]? Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne (aage) kaha: Tatha jisne yeh dhaarna rakhi ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne Allah ki kitaab ka koi ansh chhupaya hai, usne Allah par bahut bara jhooth baandha; kyonki Allah kahta haih {يا أيها الرسول بَلِّغْ ما أُنزِل إليك من ربك وإن لم تفعلْ فما بلَّغتَ رسالتَه} arthaat, ai Rasool! Aapke paalanhaar ki or se aap par jo kuchh utaara gaya hai, use aap pahuncha den. Yadi aapne aisa nahin kiya, to aapne uska sandesh nahin pahunchaya [soora al-maaidaah 67] woh (aur aage) kahti hain: Tatha jisne yeh dhaarna rakhi ki aap kal jo kuchh hone waala hai, use bataate hain, usne Allah par bahut bara jhooth baandha; kyonki Allah kahta haih {قل لا يعلمُ مَنْ في السماوات والأرضَ الغيبَ إلَّا الله} arthaat, aap kah den ki aakaash aur dharti mein Allah ke siwa koi ghaib ki baat nahin jaanta [soora an- namlah 65].
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10421: Jibreel (alaihisaslaam) utre aur meri imaamat ki, to mainne unke peechhe namaz parhi, phir unke peechhe namaz parhi, phir unke peechhe namaz parhi, phir unke peechhe namaz parhi aur phir unke peechhe namaz parhi

Ibne shihaab kahte hain ki umar bin abdul azeez ne asr ki namaz mein kuchh wilanb kiya, to urva ne unse kaha: Suniye, jibreel utre aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke imaam ki haisiyat se namaz parhaai. Is par umar bin abdul azeez ne kaha: Ai urva! Aap jo kah rahe hain us par soch- wichaar kar leejiye. To urva ne kaha: Mainne basheer bin abu masaood ko kahte suna hai ki mainne abu masaood ko kahte hue suna hai ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue suna hai: Jibreel (alaihissalaam) utre aur meri imaamat ki, to mainne unke peechhe namaz parhi, phir unke peechhe namaz parhi, phir unke peechhe namaz parhi, phir unke peechhe namaz parhi aur phir unke peechhe namaz parhi. Aapne apni oongliyon se paanch namaazen ginkar dikhaaeen.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10543: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) (kabhi- kabhi) janaabat ki haalat mein paani chhooe bina so jaate the
Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) (kabhi- kabhi) janaabat ki haalat mein paani chhooe bina so jaate the.

Is hadees mein kaha gaya hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- sanbhog karne ke baad so jaate aur paani ko chhoote tak nahin the. Na wazu karte, na snaan karte aur na ling ko dhote. Kyonki hadees mein prayukt shabd "ماء" Arbi vyaakran ki drishti se nakira (jaatiwaachak sanjna) hai aur nakaaraatmak sandarbh mein aya hai. Atah usmen paani ka har tarah ka proyag shaamil hoga.
Jabki iska doosra arth yeh ho sakta hai ki aap wazu ka paani nahin, balki snaan ka paani nahin chhoote the. Is arth ki pushti saheeh Bukhari evn saheeh Muslim ki riwayat se hoti hai, jismen is baat ka spasht ullekh hai ki aap sanbhog ke baad apne ling ko dho lete the tatha sone ke liye, tatha khaane-peene aur sanbhog ke baad wazu kar liya karte the.
Is prakaar ki ek any hadees abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- se bhi warnit hai. Woh kahte hain ki umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya hammen se koi junbi hote hue bhi so sakta hai? Aapne uttar diya : "Haan! Jab wazu kar le." Ise imaam Bukhari evn imaam Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.
Tatha ammaar bin yaasir -radiyallahu anhuma- se warnit hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne junbi ko namaz ke wazu ki tarah wazu kar lene ke baad khaane, peene athva sone ki anumti di hai. Ise ahmad evn tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai.
Lekin ham jis hadees ki vyaakhya kar rahe hain, uski vyaapakta is arth ka khandan karti hai. Isliye yeh kahna behtar hoga ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apni ummat ki aasaani ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue kabhi-kabhi bilkul paani nahin chhoote the. Kyonki agar paabandi se ling ko dhone aur wazu karne ka kaam karte, to uske aniwaary hone ki bhraanti paida hoti.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10545: Main kaise chain se rah sakta hoon, jabki soor phoonkne par niyukt farishte ne soor ko munh se laga rakha hai aur (soor phoonkne ki taiyaari ke taur par) apni peshaani ko jhuka rakha hai aur aadesh ki prateeksha mein kaan laga rakha hai ki aadesh milte hi soor phoonk de

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Main kaise chain se rah sakta hoon, jabki soor phoonkne par niyukt farishte ne soor ko munh se laga rakha hai aur (soor phoonkne ki taiyaari ke taur par) apni peshaani ko jhuka rakha hai aur aadesh ki prateeksha mein kaan laga rakha hai ki aadesh milte hi soor phoonk de. Musalmaanon ne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aise mein ham kya kahen?
