To aapne farmaya: Tum kaha karoh حسبُنا اللهُ ونِعْمَ الوَكيلُ توكَّلنا على اللهِ ربِّنا" (Hamaare liye Allah kaafi hai aur woh achchha kaam banaane waala hai. Hamne Allah par bharosa kiya, jo hamaara rab hai.) kabhi- kabhi sufyaan "توكَّلنا على اللهِ" Ke sthaan par kahte theh "على الله توكَّلنا".
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10546: Mujhe is baat ki anumti di gai hai ki arsh ko uthaane waale farishton mein se ek farishte ke baare mein bataaoon, daraasal, uski karnapaali (kaan ki lau) se kandhe tak ki doori saat sau saal ki masaafat ke baraabar hai

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Mujhe is baat ki anumti di gai hai ki arsh ko uthaane waale farishton mein se ek farishte ke baare mein bataaoon. Daraasal, uski karnapaali (kaan ki lau) se kandhe tak ki doori saat sau saal ki masaafat ke baraabar hai.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10548: Kya main us vyakti se lajja na karoon, jisse farishte lajja karte hain?

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) mere ghar mein lete hue the aur aapki donon raanen ya pindliyaan khuli hui theen. Isi beech abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ne andar aane ki anumti maangi, to unko usi haal mein aane ki anumti de di aur unse baat ki. Phir umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne andar aane ki anumti maangi, to unko bhi usi haal mein aane ki anumti de di aur unse baat ki. Phir usmaan (radiyallahu anhu) ne andar aane ki anumti maangi, to aap uthkar baith gae aur kapre theek kar liye. (Muhammad kahte hain : Main yeh nahin kahta ki aisa ek hi din hua.) to woh andar aye aur baat ki. Jab woh chal diye, to aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne kaha: Abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) aye, lekin unke aane se na aap prasann hue aur na kuchh dhyaan diya, phir umar (radiyallahu anhu) aye, lekin unke aane se bhi na aap prasann hue aur na kuchh dhyaan diya, phir usmaan (radiyallahu anhu) aye, to aap uthkar baith gae aur apne kapre theek kar liye? To aapne farmaya: Kya main us vyakti se lajja na karoon, jisse farishte laaj karte hain?.
10551: Jume ke din farishte masjid ke dvaar par khare ho jaate hain aur silsilewaar masjid mein aane waalon ke naam likhte jaate hain

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Jume ke din farishte masjid ke dvaar par khare ho jaate hain aur silsilewaar masjid mein aane waalon ke naam likhte jaate hain. Sabse pahle masjid mein prawesh karne waale ki misaal us vyakti ki tarah hai, jisne oont ki qurbaani di ho, phir uski tarah jisne gay ki qurbaani di ho, phir mendhe ki, phir murgi ki aur phir ande ki. Jab imaam pravchan ke liye nikal aata hai, to we apne rajistar samet lete hain aur pravchan sunne lagte hain.

Farishte juma ke din masjid ke dvaar par khare ho jaate hain aur shuru se kramaanusaar masjid mein prawesh karne waalon ke naam likhte jaate hain. Sabse pahle masjid aane waale ko us vyakti ke jaisa pratiphal milta hai, jisne uchch evn mahaan Allah ki nikatta praapt karne ke liye oont zabah kiya ho. Uske baad aane waale ko us vyakti ke jaisa pratiphal milta hai, jisne Allah ki nikatta praapt karne ke liye gay zabah ki ho. Uske baad aane waale ko us vyakti ke jaisa pratiphal milta hai, jisne uchch evn mahaan Allah ki nikatta praapt karne ke liye mendha zabah kiya ho. Uske baad aane waale ko us vyakti ke jaisa pratiphal milta hai, jisne uchch evn mahaan Allah ki nikatta praapt karne ke liye murghi zabah ki ho. Phir uske baad aane waale ko us vyakti ke jaisa pratiphal milta hai, jisne Allah ki nikatta praapt karne ke liye anda daan kiya ho. Phir jab imaam baahar nikalta hai aur khutba shuru karne ke liye minbar par charh jaata hai, to farishte apne woh rajistar band kar lete hain, jinmen we kramaanusaar juma mein shareek hone waalon ke naam aur usi kram se unka pratiphal likh rahe hote hain aur phir baithkar logon ke saath khutba sunne lagte hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10552: Ek raat usaid bin huzair (radiyallahu anhu) apne khalihaan mein Qur'an parh rahe the ki unka ghora bidakne laga, unhonne phir parhna shuru kiya, to phir bidakne laga, unhoेnne ek aur baar parha, to is baar bhi bidakne laga, usaid (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain: Mujhe bhay hua ki kaheen yeh (mere putr) yahya ko kuchal na daale, main uske paas gaya, to dekha ki mere sar ke oopar baadal ki tarah koi cheez hai, jismen jaise chiraag jal rahe hon, woh oopar ki or charhti gai, yahaan tak ki nazron se ojhal ho gai

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki ek raat usaid bin huzair (radiyallahu anhu) apne khalihaan mein Qur'an parh rahe the ki unka ghora bidakne laga. Unhonne phir parhna shuru kiya, to phir bidakne laga. Unhoेnne ek aur baar parha, to is baar bhi bidakne laga. Usaid (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain: Mujhe bhay hua ki kaheen yeh (mere putr) yahya ko kuchal na daale. Main uske paas gaya, to dekha ki mere sar ke oopar baadal ki tarah koi cheez hai, jismen jaise chiraag jal rahe hon. Woh oopar ki or charhti gai, yahaan tak ki nazron se ojhal ho gai. Usaid (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki subah hui, to main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas gaya aur kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Pichhli raat main apne khalihaan mein Qur'an parh raha tha ki mera ghora bidakne laga. Yeh sun kar aapne kaha: Huzair ke bete! Tum parhna jaari rakho. Unhonne kaha ki mainne phir parha, to phir bidakne laga.Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Huzair ke bete! Tum parhna jaari rakho. Unhonne kaha: Mainne phir parha, to phir bidakne laga. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Huzair ke bete! Tum parhna jaari rakho. Unhonne kaha: Ab mainne parhna band kar diya; kyonki (mera beta) yahya uske paas hi (soya hua) tha. Mujhe bhay hua ki kaheen woh use kuchal na de. Phir mainne apne sar ke oopar baadal ki tarah koi cheez dekhi, jismen jaise chiraag jal rahe the. Woh oopar uthti gai, yahaan tak ki meri nazron se ojhal ho gai. Yeh sunkar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Woh farishte the, jo tumhen sun rahe the. Yadi tum parhte rahte, to we subah tak sunte rahte aur log unhen dekhte. We logon se nahin chhupte.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10553: Allah ke kuchh farishte hain, jo dharti mein ghoomte phirte hain, we mujhe meri ummat ka salaam pahunchaate hain

Abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Allah ke kuchh farishte hain, jo dharti mein ghoomte phirte hain. We mujhe meri ummat ka salaam pahunchaate hain.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10554: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka badr ke din yeh kahna ki "Yeh hain jibreel, apne ghore ka sar thaame hue aur yuddh ke astr- shastr se lais"

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne badr yuddh ke din farmaya: Yeh hain jibreel, apne ghore ka sar thaame hue aur yuddh ke astr- shastr se lais.
10555: Badr ke din Allah ke Rasool (sallallah alaihi wa sallam) ne mushrikon ki or dekha, jinki sankhya ek hazaar thi, jabki aapke saathi kewal teen sau unnees

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki badr ke din Allah ke Rasool (sallallah alaihi wa sallam) ne mushrikon ki or dekha, jinki sankhya ek hazaar thi, jabki aapke saathi kewal teen sau unnees. Isliye Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne qible ki or munh kiya, apne donon haath phailaye aur apne rab se fariyaad karne lage: Ai Allah! Toone mujhse jo waada kiya hai, use poora kar! Ai Allah! Toone mujhe jo dene ka waada kiya hai, woh pradaan kar! Ai Allah! Yadi Islam ke maanne waalon ka giroh ko halaak ho gaya, to dharti mein teri pooja nahin hogi. Aap qible ki or munh karke, donon haathon ko uthaakar zor- zor se dua karte rahe, yahaan tak ki aapke kandhon se chaadar gir gai. Tab abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) aye, aapki chaadar ko uthaya, use aapke kandhon par daala aur aapko peechhe se apne aagosh mein lete hue bole : Ai Allah ke Nabi! Bas aapki itni dua hi kaafi hai. Allah ne aapse jo waada kiya hai, use zaroor nibhayega. Ataeb, (sarvashaktimaan) Allah ne yeh ayat utaareeh {إذ تستغيثون ربَّكم فاستجاب لكم أنِّي مُمِدُّكم بألف من الملائكة مُرْدِفين} (jab tum apne paalanhaar se fariyaad kar rahe the, to usne tumhaari praarthana sun li, (aur kaha ki) main tumhaari sahayta ke liye lagaataar ek hazaar farishte bhej raha hoon). Is tarah, Allah ne farishton ke dvaara aapki sahayta ki. Abu zumail kahte hain ki mujhe abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ne bataya: Us din ek musalmaan ek mushrik ke peechhe daur raha tha, jo aage- aage bhaage ja raha tha. Isi beech achaanak oopar se kora chalne ki aawaaz suni aur ghurasvaar ko kahte hue suna : Haizoom, aage barho! Usne saamne mushrik ki or dekha, to woh chit gira hua tha. Usne (aur dhyaan se) dekha, to uski naak par nishaan tha aur uska chehra phat chuka tha. Jaise kisi ne kore se maara ho. Uska rang bhi hara ho gaya tha. Us ansaari sahaabi ne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aakar ghatna sunaai, to aapne kaha: Tum sach kahte ho, yeh teesre aakaash ki sahayta thi. Us din musalmaanon ne sattar mushrikon ka wadh kiya aur sattar ko bandi banaya tha. Abu zumail kahte hain ki abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ne farmaya: Jab we qaidiyon ko baandh chuke, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne abu bakr tatha umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se kaha: Tum in qaidiyon ke baare mein kya kahte ho? Abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ne kaha: Ai Allah ke Nabi! Ye hamaare chachere bhaai aur khaandaan ke log hain. Meri ray yeh hai ki aap inse fidya (muktidhan) len, taaki hamaare paas kaafiron ke muqaable mein kuchh shakti aye. Is baat ki bhi sanbhaavna hai ki Allah unhen Islam ka maargadarshan kar de. Iske baad Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Tum kya kahte ho, ai khattaab ke bete! (Woh kahte hain) ki mainne kaha: Nahin, Allah ki qasam! Meri ray woh nahin hai, jo abu bakr ki hai. Meri ray yeh hai ki aap inhen hamaare hawaale kar den ki ham inki garadnen maar den. Aap aqeel ko ali (radiyallahu anhuma) ke hawaale kar den ki woh uski gardan maar den. Mere amuk rishtedaar ko mere hawaale kar den ki main uski gardan ura doon, kyonki ye kufr ke saragna aur sardaar hain. (Umar radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki) Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ki ray pasand aai tatha meri ray pasand nahin aai. Doosre din main aya, to dekha ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) baithkar ro rahe hain. Mainne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe batayen ki aap aur aapke saathi kyon ro rahe hain? Yadi koi rone ki baat hogi, to main bhi rooonga aur yadi rone ki baat nahin hogi, to aapko rote dekh main bhi rone ki soorat bana loonga. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne faramya: Main is wajah se ro raha hoon ki Allah ne tumhaare un saathiyon ko azaab dene ki baat kahi hai, jinhonne qaidiyon se fidya (muktidhan) lene ki baat kahi thi. Mujhe unke ajaab ko is per (ek per ki or ishaara karte hue, jo aapke paas hi tha) se bhi nikat dikhaya gaya hai. Tatha (sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan) Allah ne yeh ayat utaari haih {مَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَن يَكُونَ لَهُ أَسْرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يُثْخِنَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ تُرِيدُونَ عَرَضَ الدُّنْيَا وَاللَّهُ يُرِيدُ الْآخِرَةَ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ ، لَّوْلَا كِتَابٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ سَبَقَ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِيمَا أَخَذْتُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ ، فَكُلُوا مِمَّا غَنِمْتُمْ حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ } arthaat, kisi Nabi ke liye yeh uchit na tha ki uske paas bandi hon, jab tak dharti (ran kshetr) mein achchhi tarah raktapaat na kar de. Tum saansaarik laabh chaahte ho aur Allah (tumhaare liye) aakhirat chaahta hai. Aur Allah prabhutvashaali hikmat waala hai. Yadi iske baare mein pahle se Allah ka nirnay na hota, to jo arthadand tumne liya hai, uske lene mein bari yaatna di jaati. To us ghaneemat mein se khaao, jo tumne praapt kiya hai. Woh svachchh (tatha) halaal hai. Tatha Allah ke aajnaakaari raho, waastav mein Allah ati kshama karne waala dayaawaan hai) [soora anfaalah 67-69]. Phir Allah ne musalmaanon ke liye ghaneemat ko halaal qaraar diya.
10556: Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab khandaq yuddh se laute aur hathiyaar utaarne ke baad snaan kar liya, to jibreel (alaihissalaam) aapke paas aye aur bole: Aapne hathiyaar utaar diya hai? Allah ki qasam! Hamne abhi tak nahin utaara hai! Aap unki or chalen

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab khandaq yuddh se laute aur hathiyaar utaarne ke baad snaan kar liya, to jibreel (alaihissalaam) aapke paas aye aur bole: Aapne hathiyaar utaar diya hai? Allah ki qasam! Hamne abhi tak nahin utaara hai! Aap unki or chalen! Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne poochha: Kidhar jaana hai? To unhonne banu quraiza ki or ishaara karte hue kaha ki udhar. Phir Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) banu quraiza ki or nikal pare.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10557: Aisa lagta hai ki aaj bhi main bani ghanam ki gali mein woh urti hui dhool dekh raha hoon, jo jibreel (salvaatullahi alaihi) ke qaafile se uthi thi, jab woh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath banu quraiza ki or chale the

Anas (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain: Aisa lagta hai ki aaj bhi main bani ghanam ki gali mein woh urti hui dhool dekh raha hoon, jo jibreel (salvaatullahi alaihi) ke qaafile se uthi thi, jab woh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath banu quraiza ki or chale the.
10558: Agar woh mere nikat aata, to farishte uski boti- boti uchak lete

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki abu jahl ne kaha: Kya Muhammad tumhaare saamne zameen par apna chehra rakhta hai? Warnankarta ka kahna hai ki usse kaha gaya: Haan. Ispar usne kaha: Laat tatha uzza ki qasam! Yadi mainne use aisa karte dekha, to uski gardan par paanv rakh doonga ya uske chehre ko mitti mein saan doonga. Warnankarta ka kahna hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) namaz parh rahe the ki woh aapke paas aya. Woh is bhram mein tha ki aapki gardan ko raundega. Warnanarta ka kahna hai: Lekin logon ne dekha ki woh achaanak peechhe hatne laga aur apne donon haathon se apna bachaav karne laga. Warnankarta kahta hai: Usse poochha gaya ki tumhaare saath kya hua? To usne kaha: Mere aur uske beech aag ki khaai, bhay tatha bahut-se par the. Ispar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Agar woh mere nikat aata, to farishte uski boti- boti uchak lete. Warnankarta ka kahna hai ki iske baad (sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan) Allah ne yeh ayten utaareen (ham nahin jaante ki yeh abu huraira ki riwayat mein hai ya kisi any srot se unke paas pahunchi hai): {كَلَّا إِنَّ الْإِنْسَانَ لَيَطْغَى، أَنْ رَآهُ اسْتَغْنَى، إِنَّ إِلَى رَبِّكَ الرُّجْعَى، أَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي يَنْهَى، عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّى، أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ عَلَى الْهُدَى، أَوْ أَمَرَ بِالتَّقْوَى، أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّى، أَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَرَى، كَلَّا لَئِنْ لَمْ يَنْتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًا بِالنَّاصِيَةِ، نَاصِيَةٍ كَاذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍ، فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُ، سَنَدْعُ الزَّبَانِيَةَ، كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ} arthaat, waastav mein, insaan sarakshi karta hai, kyonki woh khud ko dhanvaan samajhta hai. Nissandeh, phir tere paalanhaar ki or lautkar jaana hai. Kya tumne usko dekha, jo ek bande ko rokta hai, jab woh namaz parhta hai? Bhala dekho to, yadi woh seedhe maarg par ho ya Allah se darne ka aadesh deta ho? Aur dekho to yadi usne jhuthlaya aur munh phera ho? Kya woh nahin jaanta ki Allah use dekh raha hai? Nishchit taur par yadi woh nahin ruka, to ham use maathe ke bal ghaseetenge. Jhoothe aur paapi maathe ke bal. To woh apni sabha ko bula le. Ham bhi narak ke farishton ko bulayenge. (Ai mere bande!) hargiz uski baat na suno. [soora al-alqah 6-19] yahaan jhuthlaane aur munh pherne waale se aashay abu jahl hai. Is hadees ke ek warnankarta ubaidullah ne apni riwayat mein yeh izaafa kiya hai : Phir use aadesh diya, jo aadesh diya. Tatha ek aur warnankarta ibne abdul aala ne {فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُ} ka arth bataya hai ki woh apni jaati ko bulaye.
10559: Yahi woh sahaabi hain, jinke liye arsh hil utha, aakaash ke dvaar khole gae aur unke janaaze mein sattar hazaar farishte upasthit rahe, (iske baavjood) unhen qabr ke andar ek baar bheencha gaya aur phir chhor diya gaya

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne (saad bin muaaz radiyallahu anhu ke baare mein) farmaya: Yeh woh sahaabi hain, jinke liye arsh hil utha, aakaash ke dvaar khole gae aur unke janaaze mein sattar hazaar farishte upasthit rahe. (Iske baavjood) unhen qabr ke andar ek baar bheencha gaya aur phir chhor diya gaya.
10560: Madeene ki guzargaahon par pharishte niyukt hain, yahaan na taaoon prawesh kar sakta hai, na dajjaal

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Madeene ki guzargaahon par pharishte niyukt hain, yahaan na taaoon prawesh kar sakta hai, na dajjaal.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is hadees mein madeene ki ek fazeelat yeh bataai hai ki uske sabhi prawesh sthaanon evn maargon mein farishte upasthit rahte hain, jo uski pahredaari karte hain. Atah usmen taaoon, jo ek tezi se phailne waali sankraamak mahaamaari hai aur jiske kaaran bari sankhya mein mrityu hoti hai, prawesh nahin karta aur usmen kaana dajjaal bhi prawesh nahin karega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10561: Ham Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas rahkar charmapatron se Qur'an ekatr kar rahe the, isi beech aapne kaha: Shaam ki dharti dhany hai!

Zaid bin saabit (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki ham Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas rahkar charmapatron se Qur'an ekatr kar rahe the. Isi beech aapne kaha: Shaam ki dharti dhany hai! Hamne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapne aisa kyon kaha? To aapne farmaya: Kyonki dayaawaan (Allah) ke farishte uspar apne par phailaye hue hain.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10562: Jab sooraj ka kinaara dikhaai de, to namaz parhna band kar do, yahaan tak ki woh poore taur par zaahir ho jaye aur jab sooraj ka kinaara ghayab ho jaye, to namaz parhna band kar do, yahaan tak ki woh poore taur par doob jaye tatha sooraj doobne evn nikalne ka samay dekhkar hi namaz na parho; kyonki sooraj shaitaan ke do seengon ke beech mein nikalta hai

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Jab sooraj ka kinaara dikhaai de, to namaz parhna band kar do, yahaan tak ki woh poore taur par zaahir ho jaye aur jab sooraj ka kinaara ghayab ho jaye, to namaz parhna band kar do, yahaan tak ki woh poore taur par doob jaye. Tatha sooraj doobne evn nikalne ka samay dekhkar hi namaz na parho; kyonki sooraj shaitaan ki do seengon ke beech mein nikalta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10563: Mujhe kuchh patthar la do; unse mujhe istinja karna hai, magar haddi tatha gobar na laana

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki woh Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath wazu tatha istinja ke paani ka bartan lekar chalte the. Ek din woh saath mein the ki aapne farmaya: Yeh kaun hai? Unhonne kaha: Abu huraira. Aapne farmaya: Mujhe kuchh patthar la do; unse mujhe istinja karna hai. Magar haddi tatha gobar na laana. Isliye, main aapke paas kapre ke kinaare mein rakhkar kuchh patthar le gaya aur aapke nikat rakhkar chala aya. Jab aap apni zaroorat poori kar chuke, to main aapke paas gaya aur bola ki haddi tatha patthar mein aakhir kya baat hai? Aapne farmaya: Donon jinnon ka bhojan hain. Mere paas naseebeen ke jinnon ka ek pratinidhimandal aya, jo bare achchhe jinn the, tatha unhonne mujhse aahaar maanga, to mainne unke liye Allah se dua ki ki jab we kisi haddi tatha gobar ke nikat se guzren, to unhen usmen bhojan mil jaye.
10564: Ai umar! Shaitaan tum se darta hai, main baitha tha, to yeh daf bajaati rahi, abu bakr aye to bajaati rahi, ali aye to bajaati rahi, usmaan aye to bhi bajaati rahi, lekin ai umar! Jab tum aye to isne daf phenk diya

Buraida (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kisi yuddh mein nikle. Waapas aye to ek kaali- kalauti daasi aakar kahne lagi: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mainne mannat maani thi ki yadi Allah aapko surakshit waapas le aye, to main aapke saamne daf bajaaoongi aur gaaoongi. Yeh sunkar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne usse kaha: Yadi tumne sachmuch mannat maani thi, to bajaao, warna rahne do. To woh daf bajaane lagi. Isi beech abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) aye, to woh daf bajaati rahi. Phir ali (radiyallahu anhu) aye, to bhi bajaati rahi. Phir usmaan (radiyallahu anhu) aye, tab bhi bajaati rahi. Phir umar (radiyallahu anhu) aye, to daf ko chootar ke neeche rakhkar uske oopar baith gai. Ispar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Ai umar! Shaitaan tum se darta hai. Main baitha tha, to yeh daf bajaati rahi, abu bakr aye to bajaati rahi, ali aye to bajaati rahi, usmaan aye to bhi bajaati rahi, lekin ai umar! Jab tum aye to isne daf phenk diya.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10566: Uski qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, jab bhi shaitaan tumhen (ai umar!) kisi raaste par chalta hua dekhta hai, to tumhaara raasta chhor kar koi aur raasta apna leta hai

Saad bin abu waqqaas (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aane ki anumti maangi. Us samay aapke paas quraish ki kuchh striyaan maujood theen, jo aapse zor- zor se baaten kar rahi theen aur aapse adhik (tawajjo athva naan- nafqa) maang rahi theen. Parantu jaise hi umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne anumti talab ki, we uthkar tezi se parde ki or bhaag gaeen. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen andar aane ki anumti di. (Jab woh andar aye to) aap hans rahe the. Yeh dekhkar unhonne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Allah taaala aapko hamesha hansta muskuraata rakhe. Aapne farmaya: Mujhe in striyon par taajjub hai, jo mere paas maujood theen. Lekin tumhaari aawaz sunte hi tezi se parde ki or bhaag khari hueen. Umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aap is baat ke adhik haqdaar hain ki we aapse daren. Phir kaha: Ai apni jaan ki dushmano! Tum mujhse darti ho aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se nahin darteen? Un aurton ne kaha: Yeh sach hai; kyonki aap Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke muqaable mein kaheen adhik kare tatha sakht hain. Ispar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Uski qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, jab bhi shaitaan tumhen (ai umar!) kisi raaste par chalta hua dekhta hai, to tumhaara raasta chhor kar koi aur raasta apna leta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10567: Mere paas jinnon ki or se ek bulaane waala aya tha, atah, main uske saath gaya aur unhen Qur'an sunaya

Aamir kahte hain ki mainne alaqma se poochha: Kya abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) jinnon se mulaaqaat waali raat Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath maujood the? Unka kahna hai ki alaqma ne uttar diya: Khud mainne abdullah bin masaood se poochha tha ki kya jinnon waali raat aapmen se koi Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath maujood tha? To unhonne kaha tha: Nahin, parantu ham ek raat Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath the. Achaanak aap kho gae. Hamne aapko ghaatiyon aur pahaari raaston mein dhoondha. (Lekin aap na mil sake.) atah hamne kaha: Aapko ya to jinn ura le gae ya chupke se qatl kar diya gaya. Unka kahna hai ki hamne woh badatreen raat guzaari, jo koi qaum guzaar sakti hai. Subah hui, to dekha gaya ki aap hira parvat ki or se a rahe hain. Unka kahna hai ki hamne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Hamne aapko gum paya, to bahut dhoondha, lekin aap na mil sake. Phir hamne woh badatreen raat guzaari, jo koi qaum guzaar sakti hai. Yeh sunkar aapne farmaya: Mere paas jinnon ki or se ek bulaane waala aya tha. Atah, main uske saath gaya aur unhen Qur'an sunaya. Abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki aap hamen lekar gae aur unke tatha unki aag ke nishaan dikhaye. Unhonne aapse aahaar maanga, to aapne kaha: Tumhaare liye har woh haddi hai, jispar Allah ka naam liya gaya ho. Jaise hi woh tumhaare haath mein ayegi, usmen bharpoor maatra mein maans lag jayega. Tatha saari mengniyaan tumhaare pashuon ka chaara hain. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Atah, tum haddi tatha gobar se istinja na karo; kyonki ye tumhaare bhaaiyon ka bhojan hain.
10569: Iblees (shaitaan) apna sinhaasan paani par rakhta hai, phir apni senaaon ko bhejta hai, uske yahaan nikattam sthaan use praapt hota hai, jo sabse adhik upadrav karne waala hota hai

Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Iblees (shaitaan) apna sinhaasan paani par rakhta hai. Phir apni senaaon ko bhejta hai. Uske yahaan nikattam sthaan use praapt hota hai, jo sabse adhik upadrav machaane waala ho. Unmen ek aakar kahta hai: Mainne (aaj) aisa aur aisa kiya hai. Iblees kahta hai: Tumne kuchh nahin kiya. Phir koi aata hai aur kahta hai: Mainne amuk vyakti ko nahin chhora, yahaan tak ki uske tatha uski patni ke beech judaai daal di. Tab shaitaan use apne nikat karta hai aur kahta hai: Haan, tumne achchha kiya hai. Aamash kahte hain: Main samajhta hoon ki unhonne yeh bhi kaha tha: Phir woh use seene se laga leta hai.
10570: Banu zuraiq ke ek vyakti ne, jise labeed bin aasam kaha jaata tha, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) par jaadu kar diya tha, jiske kaaran aapko lagta tha ki aapne koi kaam kar liya hai, haalaanki woh kaam nahin kiya hota

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki banu zuraiq ke ek vyakti ne, jise labeed bin aasam kaha jaata tha, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) par jaadu kar diya tha, jiske kaaran aapko lagta tha ki aapne koi kaam kar liya hai, haalaanki woh kaam nahin kiya hota. Yahaan tak ki ek din ya ek raat ko aap mere paas the. Lekin, aapne bari der tak dua ki aur phir farmaya: Ai aaisha! Allah se mainne jo prashn poochha tha, usne mujhe uska uttar de diya hai. Mere paas do vyakti aye. Ek mere sar ke paas baitha aur doosra mere paanv ke paas. Donon mein se ek ne apne saathi se poochha: Is aadmi ko kaun- si beemaari hui hai? Doosre ne uttar diya: Ispar jaadu kar diya gaya hai. Pahle ne poochha: Kisne jaadu kiya hai? Doosre ne kaha: Labeed bin aasam ne. Pahle ne poochha: Kis cheez mein? Doosre ne uttar diya: Kanghe tatha sar ke baal mein, jo nar khajoor ke khoshe mein rakhe hue hain. Pahle ne kaha: Woh kahaan hai? Doosre ne kaha: Zarvaan kuen mein. Phir Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne kuchh saathiyon ke saath wahaan gae aur waapas aane ke baad bole: Ai aaisha! Uska paani aisa (laal) prateet ho raha tha, jaise menhdi ke patton ka ras ho ya uske peron ke sar aise lag rahe the, jaise shaitaanon ke sar hon. Mainne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapne use nikaala kyon nahin? Aapne farmaya: Choonki Allah ne mujhe svaasthy pradaan kar diya hai, isliye mainne is baat ko naapsand kiya ki logon ke andar koi buraai phailaaoon. Phir aapne kuen ko paat dene ka aadesh diya aur use paat diya gaya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10571: In shauch ke sthaanon mein shaitaan tatha jinn upasthit rahte hain, atah, jab tummen se koi shauch ke sthaan mein aye, to kahe: Main naapaak jinnon aur naapaak jinniyon se Allah ki sharan mein aata hoon

Zaid bin arqam (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: In shauch ke sthaanon mein shaitaan tatha jinn upasthit rahte hain. Atah, jab tummen se koi shauch ke sthaan mein aye, to yeh dua parhe: أعوذُ باللهِ مِنَ الخُبُثِ والخَبَائث arthaat, main naapaak jinnon aur naapaak jinniyon (ki buraaiyon se) se Allah ki sharan mein aata hoon.

Shauch ke sthaan mein jinn evn shaitaan upasthi rahte hain aur is prateeksha mein baithe rahte hain ki insaan ko kasht de saken aur uske andar bigaar paida kar saken. Kyonki yeh aisa sthaan hai, jahaan shareer ke gupt angon ko khola jaata hai aur usmen Allah ka naam bhi nahin liya jaata. Atah jab koi musalmaan shauch ke sthaan mein pahunche, to yeh dua parhe : "أعوذُ باللهِ مِنَ الخُبُثِ والخَبَائث" Yaani main tamaam shaitaanon, chaahe woh purush hon ya stri, ki buraai se Allah ki sharan evn raksha mein aata hoon.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10572: Jab aadam ki santaan sajde waali ayat parhti hai aur sajda karti hai, to shaitaan rota hua door hat jaata hai, woh kahta hai: Hay meri barbaadi! Aadam ki santaan ko sajde ka aadesh diya gaya aur usne sajda kiya, to uske liye Jannat hai, jabki mujhe sajde ka aadesh diya gaya, to mainne inkaar kar diya, atah mere liye Jahannam hai

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu् alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Jab aadam ki santaan sajde waali ayat parhti hai aur sajda karti hai, to shaitaan rota hua door hat jaata hai. Woh kahta hai: Hay meri barbaadi! Aadam ki santaan ko sajde ka aadesh diya gaya aur usne sajda kiya, to uske liye Jannat hai, jabki mujhe sajde ka aadesh diya gaya, to mainne inkaar kar diya, atah mere liye Jahannam hai.

Jab koi vyakti sajde ki ayton mein se koi ayat parhta hai, jismen sajde ka aadesh hota hai aur woh Allah ke aadesh ke paalan aur uske anusran ki chaahat mein sajda karta hai, to shaitaan Qur'an parhne waale us vyakti ke paas se bhaag jaata hai aur aadam ki santaan ko praapt hone waale sammaan par eershya ke kaaran woh jis prakaar sammaan se wanchit hua hai aur dhikkaar tatha naakaami ka haqdaar bana hai, uspar afsos karte hue kahta hai : "Hay meri barbaadi! Aadam ki santaan ko sajde ka aadesh diya gaya aur usne sajda kiya, to uske liye Jannat hai, jabki mujhe sajde ka aadesh diya gaya, to mainne inkaar kar diya." Yaani hay mera winaash! Allah ne aadam ki santaan ko sajde ka aadesh diya aur usne apne prabhu ke aadesh ka paalan karte hue sajda kiya, to uske liye Jannat hai, jabki mujhe sajde ka aadesh diya aur mainne abhimaan ke kaaran sajde se inkaar kar diya to mere liye Jahannam hai.
10574: Zaid bin saabit ansaari (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain, jo wahy likhne waalon mein shaamil the: Jab yamaama yuddh mein bahut- se sahaaba shaheed ho gae, to abu bakr ne mujhe bula bheja, (main pahuncha to) umar unke paas maujood the (radiyallahu anhuma)

Zaid bin saabit ansaari (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, jo wahy likhne waalon mein shaamil the, woh kahte hain ki jab yamaama yuddh mein bahut- se sahaaba maare gae, to abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ne mujhe bula bheja, (main pahuncha to) unke paas umar (radiyallahu anhu) bhi maujood the. Abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ne mujhse kaha: Umar (radiyallahu anhu) mere paas aye aur kahne lage ki yamaama ke din bahut- se sahaaba maare gae hain aur mujhe dar hai ki agar aapne Qur'an ko ekatr nahin kiya, to wibhinn yuddhon mein isi tarah 'Qur'an ke qaari' maare jaate rahenge aur bahut- saara Qur'an uth jayega. Isliye meri ray hai ki aap Qur'an ko ekatr kar len. Abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ne farmaya ki mainne umar (radiyallahu anhu) se kaha: Lekin, main woh kaam kaise kar sakta hoon, jise khud Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne nahin kiya? Ispar umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne kaha: Allah ki qasam! Yeh achchha kaam hai. Is tarah, umar (radiyallahu anhu) is wishay par nirantar mujhse baat karte rahe, yahaan tak ki Allah ne is kaam ke prati mere dil ko santusht kar diya aur main bhi wahi sochne laga, jo umar sochte hain. Zaid bin saabit (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki us samay unke paas umar (radiyallahu anhu) bhi maujood the, lekin chupchaap baithe the. Phir abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ne kaha: Tum ek jawaan tatha buddhimaan vyakti ho, hamen tumhaari sachchaai mein koi sandeh nahin hai aur tum Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke liye wahy likhne ka kaam bhi kar chuke ho, isliye Qur'an ko dhoondhkar ekatr karne ka kaam tum hi karo. (Zaid radiyallahu anhu kahte hain:) Allah ki qasam! Agar woh mujhe kisi parvat ko uske sthaan se hataane ka bhi aadesh dete, to mujhe utna bhaari na lagta, jitna Qur'an ko ekatr karne ka yeh aadesh bhaari laga. Mainne kaha: Lekin, aap donon woh kaam kaise kar sakte hain, jise khud Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne nahin kiya? Ispar abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ne kaha: Allah ki qasam! Yeh ek achchha kaam hai. Phir main unse lagaataar baat karta raha, yahaan tak ki Allah ne is kaam ke prati mere dil ko bhi santusht kar diya, jiske prati abu bakr tatha umar (radiyallahu anhuma) ke dil ko santusht kar diya tha. So main utha aur charmapatron, kapre ke tukron, kandhe ki haddiyon, khajoor ki shaakhaaon aur logon ke dilon se Qur'an ko dhoondhkar ekatr karne laga. Yahaan tak ki soora tauba ki yeh do ayten mujhe kewal khuzaima ansaari ke paas mileenh {لقد جاءكم رسولٌ من أنفسِكم عزيزٌ عليه ما عَنِتُّم حريصٌ عليكم} [soora at-taubaah 128-129] phir, woh saheefe, jinmen Qur'an jama kiye gae the, abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ki mrityu ke samay tak unheen ke paas rahe, phir umar (radiyallahu anhu) ki mrityu ke samay tak unke paas rahe aur phir hafsa binte umar (radiyallahu anhuma) ke paas rahe.
10575: Huzaifa bin yamaan (radiyallahu anhu), usmaan bin affaan (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas us samay pahunche, jab woh aarmeeniya aur azarbaaijaan ko jeetne ke liye seeriya tatha iraaq waalon ko taiyaari karaane mein jute the, huzaifa (radiyallahu anhu) ko Qur'an parhne ke sanbandh mein logon ke matbhed ne ghabraahat mein daal rakha tha

Ibne shihaab ka warnan hai ki anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) ne unhen bataya: Huzaifa bin yamaan (radiyallahu anhu) usmaan bin affaan (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas us samay pahunche, jab woh aarmeeniya aur azarbaaijaan ko jeetne ke liye seeriya tatha iraaq waalon ko taiyaari karaane mein jute the. Huzaifa (radiyallahu anhu) ko Qur'an parhne ke sanbandh mein logon ke matbhed ne ghabraahat mein daal rakha tha, isliye unhonne usmaan (radiyallahu anhu) se kaha: Ai ameerulmomineen! Is ummat ko sanbhaal leejiye, isse pahle ki we yahoodiyon tatha eesaaiyon ki tarah apni kitaab ke baare mein matbhed ke shikaar ho jayen. Isliye, usmaan (radiyallahu anhu) ne hafsa (radiyallahu anha) ke paas sandesh bheja ki hamaare paas woh saheefe bhej den, jo aapke paas hain, ham musahphon ke roop mein unki naqal taiyaar karvaane ke baad unhen aapko lauta denge. Phir hafsa (radiyallahu anha) ne unhen usmaan (radiyallahu anhu) ko bhej diya. Phir usmaan (radiyallahu anhu) ne zaid bin saabit, abdullah bin zubair, saeed bin aas aur abduुrrahmaan bin haaris bin hishaam ko adhikrit kiya aur unhonne un saheefon se naqal karke bahut-se mushaf taiyaar kar diye. Usmaan (radiyallahu anhu) mushaf taiyaar karne ke kaary par adhikrit teenon quraishi vyaktiyon se kah diya tha ki jab Qur'an se sanbandhit kisi baat par zaid bin saabit se, (jo ki is samiti ke ekmaatr ansaari sadasy the) tumhaara matbhed ho, to use quraish ki bhaasha mein likhna, kyonki Qur'an quraish hi ki bhaasha mein utra hai. Isliye, unhonne aisa hi kiya. Yahaan tak ki jab un saheefon se bahut- se mushaf taiyaar kar liye, to usmaan (radiyallahu anhu) ne saheefon ko hafsa (radiyallahu anha) ke hawaale kar diya tatha taiyaar kiye hue musahphon ki ek- ek prati har disha mein bhej di aur uske atirikt Qur'an ke tamaam saheefon ya musahfon ko jalaane ka aadesh de diya.
10576: Jisne kaha: أستغفر الله الذي لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم وأتوب إليه 'main Allah se kshama maangta hoon, jiske siwa koi saty poojy nahin, woh jeewit hai, saari kaynaat ko sanbhaalne waala hai aur main usi ki or lautta hoon', uske gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain, yadyapi woh yuddh ke maidaan se bhaaga ho

Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke mukt kiye hue daas zaid (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Jisne kaha: أستغفر الله الذي لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم وأتوب إليه arthaat,'main Allah se kshama maangta hoon, jiske siwa koi saty poojy nahin, woh jeewit hai, saari kaynaat ko sanbhaalne waala hai aur main usi ki or lautta hoon', uske gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain, yadyapi woh yuddh ke maidaan se bhaaga ho.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10596: Zuhar ka samay, sooraj dhalne se aadmi ka saya uske qad ke baraabar hone yaani asr ka samay prawesh karne tak rahta hai, asr ka samay sooraj mein peelaapan aane tak rahta hai, maghrib ki namaz ka samay kshitij se laalima ke door hone tak rahta hai, isha ki namaz ka samay aadhi raat tak rahta hai aur subah ki namaz ka samay fajr se sooraj nikalne tak rahta hai

Abdullah bin amr (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Juhar ka samay, sooraj ke dhalne se aadmi ka saya uske qad ke baraabar hone yaani asr ka samay prawesh karne tak rahta hai, asr ka samay sooraj mein peelaapan aane tak rahta hai, maghrib ki namaz ka samay kshitij se laalima ke door hone tak rahta hai, isha ki namaz ka samay aadhi raat tak rahta hai aur subah ki namaz ka samay fajr se sooraj nikalne tak rahta hai. Jab sooraj nikalne lage, to namaz se ruk jaao; kyonki woh shaitaan ki do seengon ke beech mein nikalta hai.
10599: Ham Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath magrib ki namaz parhte the aur jab hammen se koi waapas jaata (aur teer phainkta) to woh teer ke girne ki jaghon ko dekh leta

Raaphe bin khadeej (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki ham Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath maghrib ki namaz parhte the aur jab hammen se koi waapas jaata (aur teer chalaata) to woh teer ke girne ki jaghon ko dekh leta tha.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10600: Yahi is namaz ka uttam samay hai, yadi main apni ummat ko kathinaai mein na daal raha hota to

Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek raat isha ki namaz, jise atma kaha jaata hai, der se parhaai. Aap (namaz ke liye) nahin nikle, yahaan tak ki umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) ne kaha: Striyaan aur bachche so gae. (Jabki ek riwayat mein hai: Raat ka adhiktar bhaag beet gaya) phir Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) nikle aur masjid mein baithe hue logon ke paas aane ke baad kaha: Dharti par is namaz ki prateeksha abhi tumhaare siwa koi nahin kar raha hai. Jabki ek doosri riwayat mein hai: Yahi is namaz ka sahi samay hai, yadi main apni ummat ko kathinaai mein na daal raha hota to. Tatha ek any riwayat mein hai: Yadi meri ummat par kathin na hota to. (Warnankarta ka kahna hai ki) yeh logon ke andar Islam phailne se pahle ki ghatna hai. Ibne shihaab kahte hain: Mujhe yeh bhi bataya gaya hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Tumhaare liye yeh uchit nahin hai ki tum Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko namaz ke liye kaho. Daraasal, aapne yeh baat us samay kahi thi, jab umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne aapko oonchi aawaaz mein namaz ke liye tawajjo dilaai thi.
10601: Subah ki namaz subah hone ke baad hi parho; kyonki isse tumhen adhik neki milti hai, ya kaha ki isse neki adhik milti hai

Raafe bin khadeej (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Subah ki namaz subah hone ke baad hi parho; kyonki isse tumhen adhik neki milti hai, ya isse neki adhik milti hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10602: Jisne sooraj nikalne se pahle subah ki ek rakaat paai, usne subah ki namaz pa li aur jisne sooraj doobne se pahle asr ki ek rakat paai, usne asr ki namaz pa li

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Jisne sooraj nikalne se pahle subah ki ek rakaat paai, usne subah ki namaz pa li aur jisne soorab doobne se pahle asr ki ek rakaat paai, usne asr ki namaz pa li.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10603: Koi stri do din ki doori ke saphar par us samay tak na nikle, jab tak uske saath uska pati ya koi mahram (aisa rishtedaar jiske saath kabhi shaadi na ho sakti ho) na ho

Abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, jo Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath baarah dharmayuddhon mein shaamil hue the, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se chaar baaten suni hain, jo mujhe bari achchhi lagti hain. Aapne farmaya hai : "Koi stri do din ki doori ke saphar par us samay tak na nikle, jab tak uske saath uska pati ya koi mahram (aisa rishtedaar jiske saath kabhi shaadi na ho sakti ho) na ho, do dinon mein roza rakhna jayaz nahin hai ; eed-al-fitr ke din aur eed al-azha ke din, subah ki namaz ke baad sooraj nikalne tak tatha asr ki namaz ke baad sooraj doobne tak koi namaz nahin hai aur ibaadat ki neeyat se safar karke kewal teen masjidon ki or jaana jayaz hai ; masjid-e-haraam, masjid-e-aqsa aur meri yeh masjid."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne chaar baaton se mana kiya hai :

1- aurat ko do din ki doori apne shauhar ya kisi mahram ke baghair akele tay karne se mana kiya hai. Mahram se muraad beta, pita, bhateeja, chacha evn maama aadi aise rishtedaar hain, jinse hamesha ke liye shaadi haraam hai.

2- eed al-fitr aur eed al-azha ke din roza rakhne ki manaahi. Chaahe roza mannata ka ho, nafli ho ya kaffaara ka.

3- asr ki namaz ke baad sooraj doobne tak aur subah ki namaz ke baad sooraj nikalne tak nafal namaz ki manaahi.

4- hadees mein ullikhit teen masjidon ko chhor kisi any bhookhand ki yaatra karne, uski fazeelat ka wishvaas rakhne aur wahaan adhik sawaab milne ka yaqeen rakhne ki manaahi. In teen masjidon ko chhor kisi any sthaan ki yaatra, wahaan namaz parhne ke iraade se nahin ki jayegi. Kyonki in teen masjidon; masjid-e-haraam, masjid-e-nabvi aur masjid-e-aqsa ke atirikt kisi aur sthaan mein namaz parhne se namaz ka sawaab barhaakar diya nahin jaata.

Mahram ke bina aurat ka yaatra karna jayaz nahin hai.
Ek aurat yaatra mein doosri aurat ka mahram nahin ban sakti. Kyonki hadees ke shabd hain : "زوجُها أو ذو محرم" (Arthaat- uska pati athva koi any mahram rishtedaar).
Har woh doori jise tay karne ko safar kaha jaye, mahila ke liye pati ya mahram ke bina use tay karna warjit hai.
Mahram se muraad mahila ka pati ya aisa vyakti hai, jiske saath uski shaadi hamesha ke liye haraam ho. Haraam hone ka kaaran ya to khoon ka rishta hota hai, jaise pita, chacha aur maama, aur doodh ka rishta bhi hota hai, jaise doodh ke rishte ka pita aur doodh ke rishte ka chacha tatha sasuraali rishte ke kaaran bhi hota hai, jaise pati ka pita. Safar mein saath mein chalne waale mahram ka musalmaan, wayask, samajhdaar, bharosemand aur aisa vyakti hona zaroori hai ki khud usse koi khatra na ho. Kyonki mahram saath rakhne ka uddeshy aurat ki suraksha aur uske hiton ki raksha karna hai.
Islaami shareeyat ne aurat tatha uski suraksha ka khaas dhyaan rakha hai.
Fajr aur asr ki namaazon ke baad aam nafal namaazen durust nahin hain. Albatta chhooti hui farz namaz aur sabab waali namaazen, jaise tahiytul masjid aadi parhi ja sakti hain.
Sooraj nikalne ke fauran baad namaz parhna haraam hai. Itni der rukna zaroori hai ki sooraj ek neze ke baraabar oopar uth jaye, jismen lagbhag das se pandrah minat lagte hain.
Asr ka samay sooraj doobne tak rahta hai.
Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki in teenon masjidon ki or yaatra karke jaana jayaz hai.
Ullikhit teenon masjidon ka mahatv evn shreshthata.
Qabron ki ziyaarat ke liye yaatra jayaz nahin hai. Qabr chaahe Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki hi kyon na ho.  Albatta madeene ke andar rahne waale ya kisi shareeyat sammat ya waidh uddeshy se wahaan pahunchne waale ke liye uski ziyaarat jayaz hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
10604: Teen samay aise hain, jinmen Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hamen namaz parhne athva apne murdon ko dafnaane se mana karte the

Uqba bin aamir juhni -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Teen samay aise hain, jinmen Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hamen namaz parhne athva apne murdon ko dafnaane se mana karte the : Jab sooraj spasht roop se nikal raha ho, yahaan tak ki ooncha ho jaye, jab sooraj beech aasmaan mein ho, yahaan tak ki dhal jaye aur jab sooraj doobne lage, yahaan tak ki doob jaye.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne nimnalikhit teen samyon mein nafal namaz parhne ya murdon ko dafan karne se mana kiya hai : Pahla samay : Jab sooraj spasht roop se nikal raha ho. Nikalna shuru hone se ek neze ke baraabar ooncha hone tak. Yeh avdhi lagbhag pandrah minat ki hoti hai. Doosra samay : Jab sooraj beech aakaash mein ho. Poorab ya pashchim ki or uski chhaya na dikhti ho. Sooraj jab beech aakaash se dhal jaye, poorab ki or uski chhaya dikhaai dene lage aur zuhar ka samay shuru ho jaye, to manaahi khatm ho jaati hai. Yeh avdhi bari chhoti hoti hai. Lagbhag paanch minat. Teesra samay : Sooraj doobna aaranbh hone se lekar poore doob jaane tak ka samay.

Is hadees tatha is prakaar ki any hadeeson se nimnalikhit samyon mein namaz parhne ki manaahi saabit hoti hai : 1- fajr ki namaz ke baad se sooraj nikalne tak ka samay. 2- sooraj nikalna aaranbh hone se lekar uske ek neza ooncha hone tak ka samay. Yaani lagbhag pandrah minat. 3- jab sooraj beech aakaash mein ho yahaan tak ki dhal jaye. Aur yeh us samay hota hai ki jab dhup mein khare hone waale ki poorab ya pashchim ki or  chhaya na dikhti ho. Kuchh logon ne bataya hai ki yeh samay lagbhag paanch minat ka hota hai. 4- asr ki namaz ke baad se sooraj doobne tak ka samay. 5- sooraj peela ho jaane ke baad se doobne tak ka samay.
In paanch nishiddh samyon mein namaz parhne ki manaahi ke dayre se farz namaazen aur sabab waali namaazen baahar hain.
Is hadees mein ullikhit in teen sankeern samyon mein jaan-boojhkar murde ko dafan karna mana hai. Inko chhorkar raat evn din ke kisi bhi samay dafan karna jayaz hai.
In samyon mein namaz parhne ki manaahi ki hikmat : Waise asal yeh hai ki ek musalmaan Allah ke aadeshon ka paalan aur uski mana ki hui cheezon se door rahne ka kaam Allah ki ibaadat ke taur par kare. Allah ki ibaadat se ruka na rahe yahaan tak ki use aadeshon evn nishedhon ki hikmat maaloom ho jaye, balki uspar waajib hai ki woh har haal mein anusran evn anupaalan kare. Lekin kai hadeeson mein in samyon mein namaz parhne se mana karne ki hikamten bhi bataai gai hain, jo is prakaar hain : 1- sooraj dhalne se kuchh pahle theek dophar ke samay Jahannam ko khoob bharkaya jaata hai. 2- sooraj nikalte tatha doobte samay namaz parhne se manaahi ke peechhe ki hikmat yeh hai ki bahudevvaadi in donon samyon mein sooraj ko sajda karte hain, atah in donon samyon mein namaz parhna ek tarah se unke samroop banna hai. 3- fajr ki namaz ke baad se sooraj nikalne tak aur asr ki namaz ke baad se sooraj doobne tak namaz parhne se mana karne ka kaaran bahudevvaadiyon ki samroopta ke dvaar ko band karna hai, jo sooryoday evn sooryaast ke samay sooraj ko sajda karte hain.
10607: Kisi ko raat ya din ke jis bhaag mein chaahe, is ghar ka tawaaf (parikrama) karne ya ismen namaz parhne se na roko

Jubair bin mutaim (radiyallahu anhu) se marfooan warnit hai ki Allah ke Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Kisi ko raat ya din ke jis bhaag mein chaahe, is ghar ka tawaaf (parikrama) karne ya ismen namaz parhne se na roko.

[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10612: Tummen se jo log upasthit hain, we anupasthit logon ko yeh baat pahuncha den ki fajr ke baad do rakaaton ke siwa koi namaz na parho

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) ke mukt kiye hue daas yasaar ka warnan hai ki main fajr prakat hone ke baad namaz parh raha tha, to abdullah bin umar (razyallahu anhuma) ne mujhe dekha aur farmaya: Ai yasaar! Ham yahi namaz parh rahe the ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hamaare paas aye aur farmaya: Tummen se jo log upasthit hain, we anupasthit logon ko yeh baat pahuncha den ki fajr ke baad do rakaaton ke siwa koi namaz na parho.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10615: Yeh, Allah ne chaaha to, ek sachcha svapn hai, atah tum bilaal ke saath khare ho jaao aur jo kuchh dekha hai, use bataao, woh un shabdon dvaara azaan de, kyonki uski aawaaz tumse oonchi hai

Abdullah bin zaid (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne yeh aadesh diya ki logon ko namaz ke liye jama karne ke uddeshy se ghanti bajaai jaye, to mainne svapn mein dekha ki ek vyakti haath mein ghanti liye mere paas se guzar raha hai. Mainne kaha: Ai Allah ke bande! Kya tum is ghanti ko bechoge? Usne kaha: Tum iska kya karoge? Mainne kaha: Ham isse logon ko namaz ke liye bulayenge. Usne kaha: Kya main tumhen ek aisi cheez na bataaoon, jo isse achchhi hai? Mainne kaha: Awashy bataao. Usne kaha: Tum kaho: Allahu akbar Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar Allahu akbar, ashahdu al-la ilaaha illallah, ashahdu al-la ilaaha illallah, ashahdu anna muhammadar rasoolullah, ashahdu anna muhammadar rasoolullah, hayya alas-salaah, hayya alas-salaah, hayya alal-falaah, hayya alal-falaah, Allahu akbar Allahu akbar, la ilaaha illallah. (Allah sabse bara hai [chaar baar], main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai [do baar], main gawaahi deta hoon ki Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain [do baar], namaz ki taraf aao [do baar], saphalta ki or aao [do baar], Allah sabse bara hai [do baar], Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai {ek baar}) phir mujhse thora- sa door hatne ke baad kaha: Aur jab namaz khari karni ho, to kaho: Allahu akbar Allahu akbar, ashahdu al-la ilaaha illallah, ashahdu anna muhammadar rasoolullah, hayya alas-salaah, hayya alal-falaah, qad qaamtis-salaah, qad qaamtis-salaah, Allahu akbar Allahu akbar, la ilaaha illallah. (Allah sabse bara hai [do baar], main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai, main gawaahi deta hoon ki Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain, namaz ki or aao, saphalta ki or aao (sabko ek- ek baar), namaz khari ho gai hai [do baar], Allah sabse bara hai [do baar], Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai.) jab subah hui, to main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas pahuncha aur aapko jo kuchh dekha tha, bata diya. Sab kuchh sunne ke baad aapne farmaya: Yeh, Allah ne chaaha, to ek sachcha svapn hai. Atah, tum bilaal ke saath khare ho jaao aur jo kuchh dekha hai, use bataate jaao. Woh un shabdon dvaara azaan de, kyonki uski aawaaz tumse oonchi hai. Phir main bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) ke saath khare hokar unhen woh shabd bataata gaya aur woh unke dvaara azaan dete gae. Abdullah bin zaid kahte hain: Jab umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) ne, jo apne ghar mein the, ye shabd sune, to apni chaadar kheenchte hue nikle. Woh kahne lage: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Uski qasam, jisne aapko saty ke saath bheja hai, abdullah ne jo kuchh dekha hai, wahi kuchh mainne bhi dekha hai. Yeh sunkar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Saari prashansa Allah ki hai.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10618: Mainne bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) ko dekha ki abtah ki or nikle aur azaan di. Jab 'hayya alas-salaah', 'hayya alal-falaah' tak pahunche, to apni gardan ko dayen aur bayen mora tatha apne shareer ko nahin ghumaya

Abu juhaifa (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain: Mainne bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) ko dekha ki azaan de rahe the aur apne munh ko idhar- udhar ghuma rahe the tatha unki do ungliyaan unke donon kaanon mein theen. Us samay Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne ek laal tanbu mein the. (Mujhe lagta hai ki unhonne kaha tha ki tanbu chamre ka tha) phir bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) ek neza lekar aapke saamne aye aur use samtal bhoomi mein gaar diya. Uske baad Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne uski or munh karke namaz parhi aur aapke saamne se kutte aur gadhe guzarte rahe. Us samay aapke shareer par ek laal jora tha. Aisa mahsoos ho raha hai ki main (aaj bhi) aapki donon pindliyon ki chamak ko dekh raha hoon. Tatha ek riwayat mein hai: Mainne bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) ko dekha ki abtah ki or nikle aur azaan di. Jab 'hayya alas-salaah', 'hayya alal-falaah' tak pahunche, to apni gardan ko dayen tatha bayen mora aur shareer ko nahin ghumaya.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10620: Main eed ke din Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath namaz mein shareek raha, aapne khutbe (pravchan) se pahle bina azaan tatha iqaamat ke namaz parhi. Phir bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) ka sahaara lekar khare hue aur taqva ka aadesh diya, Allah ke anusran ki prerna di, logon ko updesh diye aur smaran karaya

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain: Main eed ke din Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath namaz mein shareek raha. Aapne khutbe (pravchan) se pahle bina azaan tatha iqaamat ke namaz parhi. Phir bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) ka sahaara lekar khare hue aur taqva ka aadesh diya, Allah ke anusran ki prerna di, logon ko updesh diye aur smaran karaya. Phir aage barhe aur mahilaaon ke paas aye tatha unhen updesh diye, smaran karaya tatha farmaya: Sadqa kiya karo, kyonki tummen se adhiktar Jahannam ka eendhan banengi. Yeh sunkar mahilaaon ke beech se ek stri, jiske gaalon mein dhabbe pare the, khari hui aur kahne lagi: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aisa kyon hai? Aapne farmaya: Kyonki tum shikva- shikayat adhik karti ho tatha pati ki naashukri (kritaghn) karti ho. Woh kahte hain ki ispar we apne gahne daan karne lageen. We bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) ke kapre mein apni baaliyaan aur angoothiyaan daale ja rahi theen.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10621: Tum aaj shaam aur raatbhar chaloge, to kal insha Allah paani ke sthaan tak pahunch jaaoge

Abu qataada (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen sanbodhit kiya aur kaha: Tum aaj shaam aur raatbhar chaloge, to kal insha Allah paani ke sthaan tak pahunch jaaoge. To log chal pare. Koi kisi ko murkar dekh nahin raha tha. Abu qataada kahte hain: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) chalte rahe, yahaan tak ki aadhi raat guzar gai. Main bhi aapke pahlu-ba- pahlu chal raha tha. Woh kahte hain: (Is beech aisa bhi hua ki) aapko oongh a gai tatha apni sawaari se ek or jhukne lage. So, mainne aakar aapko jagaye bina sahaara de diya, yahaan tak ki aap sawaari par theek se baith gae. Phir aap chalte rahe, yahaan tak ki jab aadhe se adhik raat guzar gai, to phir apni sawaari se ek or jhuk gae. Mainne phir aapko jagaye bina sahaara diya, yahaan tak ki apni sawaari par theek-se baith gae. Phir chale, yahaan tak ki jab subah hone ko thi, to ek or pichhli donon baar se adhik jhuk gae. Yahaan tak ki qareeb tha ki aap gir jaate. Atah, main phir aya aur sahaara diya, to aapne sar uthaya aur farmaya: Kaun? Mainne kaha: Abu qataada. Aapne farmaya: Kabse is tarah mere saath chal rahe ho? Mainne kaha: Aaj poori raat main isi tarah chal raha hoon. Farmaya: Allah tumhaari raksha kare, kyonki tumne uske Nabi ki raksha ki hai. Phir farmaya: Kya tumhen lagta hai ki ham logon se ojhal ho gae hain? Phir aage kaha: Kya tum kisi ko dekh pa rahe ho? Mainne kaha: Yeh ek sawaar hai. Phir mainne kaha: Yeh ek aur sawaar hai. Yahaan tak ki ham saat sawaar jama ho gae. Woh kahte hain: Phir Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) raaste se alag hue aur apne sar ko rakhte hue kaha: Hamaare liye hamaari namaz ka dhyaan rakhna. (Lekin, sab log so gae) aur sabse pahle Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hi ki aankh khuli, jab sooraj ki roshni aapki peeth par par chuki thi. Phir ham ghabraakar uthe. Tab aapne kaha: Sawaar ho jaao. Atah, ham sawaar hokar chal pare, yahaan tak ki jab sooraj ooncha ho gaya, to utre. Phir aapne woh wazu ka bartan mangvaya, jo mere paas tha aur usmen thora- sa paani tha. Phir usse halke andaaz mein wazu kiya aur usmen thora- bahut paani shesh rah gaya. Uske baad abu qataada (radiyallahu anhu) se kaha: Hamaare liye apne is wazu ke bartan ki hifaazat karo, iski ek khaas khabar hogi. Phir bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) ne namaz ke liye azaan di aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne do rakaaten parhne ke baad fajr ki namaz parhaai aur wahi kiya jo har roz karte the. Uske baad Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) sawaar ho gae aur ham bhi aapke saath sawaar ho gae. Is beech hammen se kuchh log aapas mein kaanaaphoosi karne lage ki hamne namaz mein jo kotaahi ki hai, uska kaffaara (prayashchit) kya ho sakta hai? Tab aapne farmaya: Kya tumhaare liye main aadarsh nahin hoon? Phir farmaya: Sun lo, neend mein koi kotaahi nahin hai. Kotaahi uski maani jaati hai, jo namaz na parhe aur doosri namaz ka samay a jaye. Atah jisse aisa hua (ki sone ke kaaran namaz chhoot gai), woh yaad aate hi namaz parh le. Phir agle roz use uske samay mein parhe. Phir farmaya: Tumhaare khayaal se logon ne kya kiya hoga? Phir aapne kahaah subah ko logon ne apne Nabi ko gum paya. Ispar abu bakr evn umar (radiyallahu anhuma) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) tumhaare baad honge. Aisa nahin ho sakta ki aap tumhen peechhe chhorkar aage barh jayen. Jabki logon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) tumhaare aage hain. Daraasal, agar we abu bakr tatha umar ki baat maan len, to sahi maarg praapt kar lenge. Woh kahte hain: Ham logon ke paas us samay pahunche jab din charh chuka tha aur har cheez tap chuki thi tatha log kah rahe the: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Ham pyaas se halaak ho gae. Yeh sunkar aapne kaha: Tum halaak nahin hoge. Phir farmaya: Mera pyaala laao. Uske baad wazu ka bartan mangvaya aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) wazu ke bartan se pyaale mein) paani undelkar dene lage aur abu qataada logon ko pilaane lage. Jaise hi logon ne wazu ke bartan mein paani dekha, uspar toot pare. Ispar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya: Achchha vyavhaar dikhaao. Saare log sairaab (tript) ho jayenge. Woh kahte hain: Phir logon ne aisa hi kiya. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) paani undelkar dete gae aur main pilaata gaya. Yahaan tak ki mere aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke siwa koi baaqi na raha. Woh kahte hain: Phir aapne mujhe undelkar diya aur kaha: Pi lo. Mainne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Jab tak aap na pi len, main pi nahin sakta. Aapne kaha: Logon ko pilaane waala ant mein peeta hai. Woh kahte hain: Phir mainne piya aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne bhi piya. Woh kahte hain: Phir log paani ke sthaan par pahunche, to sab log shaant aur tript the. Woh kahte hain ki abdullah bin rabaah ne kaha: Main is hadees ko jaama masjid mein bayaan kar raha tha ki imraan bin husain ne kaha: Ai jawaan! Zara dekh- bhaalkar hadees bayaan karo, kyonki main bhi us raat us qaafile mein shaamil tha. Woh kahte hain ki mainne kaha: Tab to aap is hadees ko adhik jaante hain. Phir unhonne kaha: Tum kis qabeele se ho? Mainne kaha: Ansaar se. Unhonne kaha: Tab tum bayaan karo, kyonki tum apni hadeeson ko zyaada jaante ho. Woh kahte hain: Phir mainne hi logon ko hadees sunaai, to imraan ne kaha: Main bhi us raat maujood tha. Lekin mujhe nahin lagta ki kisi ne is hadees ko us tarah se yaad rakha hoga, jis tarah tumne yaad rakha hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10622: Hajjatul- wida ke warnan se sanbandhit jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) ki hadees

Jaafar bin Muhammad apne pita se riwayat karte hain ki unhonne kahaah ham jaabir bin abdullah ke paas aye, to unhonne logon ke baare mein (jo unke paas aye the) poochhte hue mujh tak pahunche. Mainne kahaah main Muhammad bin ali bin husain hoon. Yeh sun mere sar par haath rakha aur mera oopar ka batan khola aur phir nichla batan khola. Phir meri hatheli mere seene par rakhi. Main us samay navyuwak larka tha. Unhonne kahaah ai mere bhateeje! Tumhaara yahaan svaagat hai. Jo chaaho poochho. Mainne unse kuchh baaten poochheen. Woh andhe ho chuke the. Is beech namaz ka samay ho gaya aur woh apni buni hui chaadar orhkar khare ho gae. Woh itni chhoti thi ki jab bhi woh use apne kandhon par daalte, uske donon kinaare unki or laut aate. Jabki unki (bari) chaadar unke bagal mein khoonti par thi. Isi awastha mein unhonne hamen namaz parhaai. Isliye mainne kahaah mujhe Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke Hajj ke baare mein batayen. Unhonne apne haath ke ishaare se nau tak gina aur kahaah Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) nau saal rahe aur Hajj nahin kiya. Phir dasven saal logon ke beech ailaan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) Hajj karne waale hain. Yeh sun bahut-se log madeene a gae. Sab chaahte the ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath chalen aur aapke amal ke anusaar amal karen. Ham aapke saath nikle, yahaan tak ki ham zul- hulaifa pahunche, to asma bint umais ne Muhammad bin abu bakr ko janm diya. Unhonne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko sandesh bheja ki ab main kya karoon? Aapne kahaah snaan karo aur patti baandhkar ehraam baandh lo. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne masjid mein namaz parhaai aur qasva naami (oontni) par sawaar ho gae. Aapki oontni baida naamak naam sthaan mein khari hui, to mainne apne saamne, jahaan tak nazar gai, sawaar aur paidal chalne waale dekhe. Jabki aapke dayen bhi isi tarah tha, aapke bayen bhi isi tarah tha aur aapke peechhe bhi isi tarah tha. Aap hamaare beech mein the aur aappar Qur'an utar raha tha, jiske arth se aap avgat the. Aap jo karte, ham bhi wahi karte. Aapne ekeshvarvaad par aadhaarit talbiya parhte hue kahaah main upasthit hoon, ai allah, main upasthit hoon. Tera koi saajhi nahin. Main upasthit hoon. Sab prashansa aur neemat teri hai aur raajy (bhi tera hai). Tera koi saajhi nahin hai. Aur log bhi yahi talbiya parhte rahe, jo (aaj bhi log) parhte hain. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen isse zara bhi nahin roka. Aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apna talbiya parhte rahe. Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hainh hamaara iraada kewal Hajj ka tha. Hamen umre ka pata nahin tha, yahaan tak ki ham aapke saath Allah ka ghar pahunche. Aapne (rukn) hajar-e-asvad ko bosa diya. Teen baar daure tatha chaar baar saadhaaran chaal chale (aur is tarah tawaaf poora kiya). Phir maqaam-e-ibraaheem ki or gae aur yeh ayat parheeh {maqaam-e-ibraaheem ko namaz ka sthaan banaao.} [al-baqraah 125] phir aapne maqaam-e-ibraaheem ko apne tatha kaaba ke beech rakha (aur namaz parhi). Jaafar kahte hain ki mere pita kaha karte the aur main samajhta hoon ki unhonne ise Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hi se naqal kiya hoga ki aap in do rakaaton mein 'qul huwallahu ahad' aur 'qul ya-ayyuhal- kaafiroon' parhte the. Phir aap rukn (hajar-e-asvad) ke paas gae aur use bosa diya. Phir dvaar se nikalkar safa ki or gae. Jab safa ke nikat aye, to yeh ayat parheeh {nishchay hi safa aur marva Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se hain.} [al-baqraah 158] (aur kaha) "Main waheen se aaranbh karta hoon, jahaan se Allah ne aaranbh kiya hai." Aapne safa se aaranbh kiya, uspar charhe, yahaan tak kaabe ko dekha, uski or chehra kiya, Allah ki ekatv ka warnan kiya, uski baraai bayaan ki aur kahaah "Allah ke siwa koi bandgi ke layaq nahin, woh akela hai, uska koi saajhi nahin, usi ka raajy hai, usi ki prashansa hai aur woh har cheez ki shakti rakhta hai. Allah ke siwa koi bandgi ke layaq nahin, jo akela hai, jisne apna waada poora kiya, apne bande ki madad ki aur akele saare girohon ko paraajit kiya." Phir iske beech aapne dua ki. Teen baar isi tarah kaha. Phir marva ki or utre. Yahaan tak ki jab aapke qadam ghaati ke nichle bhaag par pare, to daurne lage, yahaan tak jab aapke qadam charhaai par charhne lage, to chalne lage, yahaan tak ki aap marva par aye. Phir marva par usi tarah kiya, jaise safa par kiya tha. Yahaan tak ki jab marva par aapka antim chakkar tha, to farmayaah "Agar mainne pahle woh jaan liya hota, jo baad mein jaana, to qurbaani ka jaanvar saath mein na laata aur ise Umrah bana leta. Atah, tummen se jiske paas qurbaani ka jaanvar na ho, woh halaal ho jaye aur ise Umrah bana le." Ispar suraaqa bin maalik bin joshum khare hue aur kahne lageh ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya yeh hamaare isi warsh ke liye hai ya hamesha ke liye? Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apne ek haath ki ungliyaan doosre mein daaleen aur do baar kahaah "Hajj umre mein daakhil ho gaya." (Aage kaha) "Nahin, balki hamesha ke liye hai." Phir ali (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki qurbaani ke jaanvar lekar yaman se aye, to faatima (radiyallahu anha) ko un logon mein se paya, jo halaal ho chuke the. Woh rangeen kapra bhi pahan chuki theen aur surma bhi laga chuki theen. Unhonne faatima (radiyallahu anha) ke is kaary ko galta thahraya, to woh boleenh mere pita ne mujhe iska aadesh diya hai. Warnankarta kahte hainh ali (radiyallahu anhu) iraaq mein kaha karte theh main Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas faatima ki shikayat karne aur unhonne aapki or mansoob karke jo kuchh kaha tha, uske baare mein poochhne ke liye, gaya aur bataya ki mainne unke is kaary ko ghalat kaha hai. Aapne kahaah "Usne sach kaha, usne sach kaha. Tumne Hajj ki neeyat karte samay kya kaha tha?" Unhonne kaha ki mainne kaha thaah ai Allah, main usi ka talbiya parhta hoon, jiska talbiya tere Rasool ne parha hai. Aapne kahaah "Mere saath to qurbaani hai. Atah, tum halaal nahin ho sakte." Warnankarta kahte hain ki woh qurbaani ke jaanvar jo ali (radiyallahu anhu) yaman se laye the aur jo Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) laye the, unki kul sankhya ek sau thi. Warnankarta kahte hainh sab logon ne ehraam khol diye aur baal katva liye, siway Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur un logon ke, jo qurbaani saath laye the. Phir jab tarviya ka din aya, to sab log mina ki or chale aur sabne Hajj ka ehraam baandha. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) sawaar hue aur wahaan zuhar, asr, maghrib, isha aur fajr ki namaazen parheen. Phir kuchh der thahre, yahaan tak ki sooraj nikal aya. Aapke kahne par namira mein baalon se buna hua ek khaima aapke liye lagaya gaya. Phir aap chale. Quraish ko is baat mein koi sandeh nahin tha ki aap mashaar-e-haraam ke paas thahrenge, jaisa ki jaahiliyyat kaal mein we karte the. Lekin Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) wahaan guzarte hue arfa a gae. Dekha ki wahaan khaima laga hua hai, to waheen utar pare. Yahaan tak ki jab sooraj dhal gaya, to aapke aadesh se qasva oontni par paalaan daala gaya. To aap ghaati ke beech mein aye aur logon sanbodhit karte hue kahaah "Nishchay tumhaare rakt aur tumhaare dhan tumhaare liye sammaany hain, jis tarah tumhaara yeh din tumhaare is maheene aur tumhaare is nagar mein sammaany hai. Sun lo, jaahiliyyat ki har baat mere paanv ke neeche masal di gai hai aur jaahiliyyat kaal ke rakt ke daawe bhi nirast kiye jaate hain. Aur sabse pahle main apne rakt ke daawon mein se ibne rabeea bin haaris ke rakt ke daawe ko nirast karta hoon, jo banu saad ki ek mahila ka doodh pi raha tha ki huzail ne uska wadh kar diya. Main jaahiliyyat ke sood ko bhi nirast karta hoon. Pahla sood jise main nirast karta hoon, hamaara sood yaani abbaas bin abdul muttalib ka sood hai. Use poore taur par nirast kiya jaata hai. Tum striyon ke baare mein Allah se daro, kyonki tumne unko Allah ko wachan dekar liya hai aur Allah ke aadesh se unki sharmagaahon ko halaal kiya hai aur tumhaara unpar yeh haq hai ki tumhaare bistar par kisi ko aane na den ki tum use bura jaante ho. Yadi we aisa karen, to unhen maaro, lekin nishthurta se nahin. Tatha unka tumhaare oopar yeh haq hai ki unhen bhale tareeqe se khilaao aur pahnaao. Main tumhaare beech ek aisi wastu chhore ja raha hoon, yadi tum use pakre rahoge, to hargiz pathabhrasht nahin ho sakte arthaat, Allah ki kitaab. Tumse mere baare mein poochha jayega, to tum kya kahne waale ho?" Logon ne kahaah ham gawaahi denge ki aapne pahunchaya, apni zimmedaari ka nirvaah kiya aur shubhchintan se kaam liya. Aapne apni shahaadat ki ungli aakaash ki or uthaate hue aur logon ki or ishaara karte hue teen baar kahaah "Ai Allah, tu gawaah rah! Ai Allah, tu gawaah rah!" Phir aapne azaan dene tatha iqaamat kahne ko kaha aur zuhar ki namaz parhi. Phir iqaamat dene ka kaha aur asr ki namaz parhi. Donon ke beech mein koi namaz nahin parhi. Phir Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) sawaar hue, yahaan tak (muzadlifa mein) thaharne ke sthaan tak pahunche. Aapne apni oontni qasva ke seene ki rukh chattaanon ki or rakha, apne saamne chalne waalon ka raasta rakha aur qible ki or rukh kiya. Phir aap thahre rahe, yahaan tak ki sooraj doob gaya aur kuchh peelaapan khatm hua aur sooraj ki tikiya ghayab ho gai, to aapne usaama (radiyallahu anhu) ko sawaari ke peechhe bithaya aur chal pare. Aapne qasva (oontni) ki lagaam is tarah kheenchi ki qarib tha ki oontni ka sar kajaawe ke agle bhaag mein sthit paanv rakhne ke sthaan se a lage. Aap apne daahine haath se ishaara karte hue kahe ja rahe theh "Aaraam se logo, aaraam se!" Jab aap kisi teele ke paas pahunchte, to uski lagaam kuchh dheeli kar dete, yahaan tak ki woh usmen charh jaati. Yahaan tak aap muzadlifa pahunch gae aur wahaan maghrib tatha isha ki namaz ek azaan aur do iqaamat se parhi. Unke beech mein koi nafal namaz nahin parhi. Phir Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) let gae, yahaan tak fajr ho gai aur spasht roop se subah hone ke baad azaan tatha iqaamat ke saath fajr ki namaz parhi. Phir qasva par sawaar hue, yahaan tak ki mashaar-e-haraam aye, to qible ki or munh karke Allah se dua ki, uski baraai bayaan ki, la ilaaha illallahu kaha aur uske ekatv ka gungaan kiya. Phir waheen khare rahe, yahaan tak ki achchhi tarah sawera ho gaya, to sooraj nikalne se pahle chal pare. Fajl bin abbaas ko apne peechhe bitha liya. Woh ek sundar baal waale gore-chitte aur sundar vyakti the. Jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) chal pare, to kuchh striyaan aapke paas se tezi se chalti hui guzreen. Fazl unki or dekhne lage, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apna haath fazl ke chehre par rakh diya, to woh apna chehra doosri or ghumaakar dekhne lage. Aapne apne haath ko doosri or ghumaate hue unke chehre par rakh diya, lekin woh apna cheha doosri or pherkar dekhte rahe, yahaan tak ki muhassar ghaati a gae. Yahaan apni sawaari ko kuchh tez kiya aur darmiyaani raasta liya, jo al-jamra al-kubra par ja nikalta hai. Aap us jamra par pahunche, jo per ke paas hai. Aapne ghaati ke nitle bhaag se use saat chhote-chhote kankar maare. Har kankar ke saath aap Allahu akbar kahte the. Phir qurbaani karne ke sthaan ki or prasthaan kiya aur apne haath se qarbaani ke tirsath jaanvar zabah kiye. Phir ali (radiyallahu anhu) ko zimmedaari de di aur jo bach gae the, unhen unhonne zabah kiya. Aapne ali (radiyallahu anhu) ko apni qurbaani mein shareek kiya tha. Phir aapke aades se har qurbaani ka ek-ek bhaag handiya mein daala gaya aur pakaya gaya, to aap donon ne kuchh maans khaya aur kuchh shorba piya. Phir Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) sawaar hue Allah ke ghar (kaaba) ka tawaaf-e-ifaaza kiya tatha makke mein zuhar ki namaz parhi. Phir banu muttalib ke paas aye, jo zamzam par paani pila rahe the aur kahaah "Abdul muttalib ke bato, paani nikaalo. Agar mujhe paani pilaane ki tumhaari is sewa par any logon ke haawi ho jaane ka bhay na hota, to main bhi tumhaare saath paani niklaata." Phir unhonne aapko ek daal paani pesh kiya, to aapne usmen se piya.
10623: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne maghrib tatha isha ki namaz ko jama karte hue maghrib ki teen rakaat aur isha ki do rakaat ek hi azaan se parhi

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne maghrib tatha isha ki namaz ko jama karte hue maghrib ki teen rakaat aur isha ki do rakaat ek hi azaan se parhi.
10626: Tum unke imaam ho, unke sabse kamzor ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue namaz parhaao aur aisa muazzin niyukt karo, jo azaan dene ka mehantaana na leta ho

Usmaan bin abul aas (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki unhonne kaha: Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe meri qaum ka imaam bana den. Aapne farmaya: Tum unke imaam ho. Unke sabse kamzor vyakti ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue namaz parhaao aur aisa muazzin (azaan dene waala) niyukt karo, jo azaan dene ka mehantaana na leta ho.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10632: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka muazzin der karta aur iqaamat nahin kahta, yahaan tak ki jab dekh leta ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) nikal aye hain, to iqaamat kahta

Jaabir bin samurah (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka muazzin der karta aur iqaamat nahin kahta tha, yahaan tak ki jab dekh leta ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) nikal aye hain, to iqaamat kahta.
10635: ''Jisne azaan sunte samay yeh dua parhi : "Ai Allah! Is sanpoorn aahvaan tatha khari hone waali namaz ke rab! Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko waseela (Jannat ka sabse ooncha sthaan) aur shreshthatam darja pradaan kar aur unhen woh prashansneey sthaan pradaan kar, jiska toone unhen wachan diya hai." Uske liye qayaamat ke din meri sifaarish aniwaary ho jayegi.''

Jaabir bin abdullah radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : ''Jisne azaan sunte samay yeh dua parhi : "Ai Allah! Is sanpoorn aahvaan tatha khari hone waali namaz ke rab! Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko waseela (Jannat ka sabse ooncha sthaan) aur shreshthatam darja pradaan kar aur unhen woh prashansneey sthaan pradaan kar, jiska toone unhen wachan diya hai." Uske liye qayaamat ke din meri sifaarish aniwaary ho jayegi.''

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- bayaan farma rahe hain ki jisne muazzin ki azaan sunne ke baad yeh dua parhi :

Ai Allah! Is sanpoorn aahvaan ke paalanhaar! Yaani azaan ke in shabdon ke paalanhaar, jinke dvaara Allah ki ibaadat, ekeshvarvaad evn Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke Nabi hone ki or bulaya jaata hai aur sampoorn tatha khari hone waali namaz, jo hamesha parhi jaati rahegi, ke paalanhaar! Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko Jannat ka woh uchch sthaan pradaan kar, jiska aapke atirikt koi aur haqdaar nahin hai aur iske saath hi any logon ke pad se bara pad pradaan kar. Tatha unhen woh prashansneey sthaan pradaan kar, jiska toone unhen apne is kathan "Qareeb hai ki aapka paalanhaar aapko maqaame mahmood par khara kare" Dvaara wachan diya hai. Prashansneey sthaan se muraad qayaamat ke din ki bari sifaarish ka adhikaar hai.

Jisne yeh dua parhi, woh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki sifaarish ka haqdaar ban jayega aur uske liye aapki sifaarish qayaamat ke din waajib ho jayegi.

Muazzin ke dvaara kahe gae shabdon ko dohraane ke baad is dua ko parha jayega. Jisne azaan nahin suni, woh yeh dua nahin parhega.
Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki fazeelat ki aapko Jannat ka sabse ooncha sthaan, shreshthatam darja, prashansneey sthaan tatha logon ke beech nirnay kiye jaane ke liye sabse bari sifaarish karne ka adhikaar jaisi cheezen di gai hain.
Is hadees se saabit hota hai ki qayaamat ke din Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- sifaarish karenge. Kyonki aapke shabd hain : "Qayaamat ke din uske liye meri sifaarish waajib ho gai."
Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki sifaarish is baat ke liye hogi ki aapki ummat ke kabeera karne waale logon ko Jahannam na bheja jaye, ya jo log Jahannam chale gae hain unko wahaan se nikaal liya jaye, ya kuchh logon ko bina hisaab-kitaab Jannat bhej diya jaye ya Jannat jaane waale logon ka pad ooncha kiya jaye.
Imaam teebi kahte hain : (Azaan ke) shuru se lekar 'muhammadar rasoolallah' kahne tak ke bol 'daawat-e-taamma' (paripoorn pukaar) hain. Aur hayya alas-salaah aur hayya alal-falaah 'salaat-e-qayma' hai, jiska zikr (eeshvar ke) kathan  "We namaz kayam karte hain" Mein hai. Ismen ek sanbhaavna yeh hai ki yahaan 'salaat' se muraad 'dua' ho aur 'kayma' se muraad 'daaimi' (hamesha rahne waali) ho; yeh (arbi muhaavre) 'qaama ala ash-shay' se liya gaya hai, jab koi kisi kaam ko nirantar karta hai. Is arth ke anusaar, 'salaat-e-kayma' daraasal 'daawat-e-taamma' ka hi spashteekran hai. Ek aur sanbhaavna yeh hai ki 'salaat' se muraad woh 'wishisht namaz' hai jiski or us wakt bulaya ja raha hai, aur yahi arth zyaada spasht hai."
Muhallab kahte hain : Is hadees mein namaz ke samyon mein dua karne ke liye protsaahit kiya gaya hai. Kyonki in samyon mein dua qabool hone ki aasha rahti hai.
10637: Allah kisi yuvti ki namaz bina dupatte ke qabool nahin karta .
Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah “Allah kisi yuvti ki namaz bina dupatte ke qabool nahin karta.”

Kisi wayask evn aqlamand stri ke liye bina dupatta ke yaani sar evn gardan ko kholkar namaz parhna jayaz nahin hai. Yadi woh is tarah namaz parhti hai, to uski namaz amaany hogi. Kyonki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is hadees mein Allah ke grahan na karne ki baat kahi hai aur grahan na karne ka matlab hota hai saheeh evn maany na hona.
Yahaan "Maahvaari waali" Stri se muraad aisi wayask stri hai, jo maahvaari ki ayu ko pahunch chuki ho aur uske andar wayask hone ka koi bhi chihn dikhaai de gaya ho. Ye chihn hain, maahvaari aana, weery nikalna, peru ke baal nikalna ya pandrah warsh poore ho jaana. Aapne yahaan maahvaari ki baat isliye ki, kyonki yeh striyon ke saath khaas hai aur adhiktar isi se wayask stri ki pahchaan hoti hai. Isse muraad kadaapi aisi stri nahin hai jo maahvaari ki awastha mein ho. Kyonki maahvaari ke dinon mein namaz parhna mana hai. Iska spasht ullekh hadees mein bhi hai aur ispar ulema ka mataiky bhi hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10638: Kapra yadi chaura ho, to (use poore shareer par lapetne ke baad) dayen kinaare ko bayen kandhe par aur bayen kinaare ko dayen kandhe par daal lo, kintu yadi tang ho, to use apni kamar par baandh lo.

Saeed bin haaris kahte hain ki hamne jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) se ek hi kapre mein namaz parhne ke baare mein poochha, to unhonne kaha: Main Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath kisi yaatra mein nikla. Raatri ke samay kisi kaam se Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya, to aapko namaz parhte hue paya. Us samay mere paas ek hi kapra. Atah, mainne use apne shareer par lapet liya aur aapke bagal mein khare hokar namaz parhne laga. Jab aapne salaam phera, to farmayaah "Jaabir, raat mein aane ka kya kaaran hai?" Mainne aapko apna kaam bata diya. Jab main apni baat kah chuka, to aapne kaha: "Yeh tumne kaise kapra lapet rakha tha, jo abhi mainne dekha?" Mainne kahaah daraasal, kapra tang tha. Aapne kahaah "(Kapra) yadi chaura ho, to use orh lo, aur yadi tang ho, to usko tahband ki tarah baandh lo."
Muslim mein is tarah haih "Kapra yadi chaura ho, to (use poore shareer par lapetne ke baad) dayen kinaare ko bayen kandhe par aur bayen kinaare ko dayen kandhe par daal lo, kintu yadi tang ho, to use apni kamar par baandh lo."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10639: Tummen se koi bhi vyakti ek kapre mein is tarah namaz na parhe ki uske kandhe par kuchh bhi na ho.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Tummen se koi bhi vyakti ek kapre mein is tarah namaz na parhe ki uske kandhe par kuchh bhi na ho."
