Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek hi kapre mein namaz parhne waale ko is baat se mana kiya hai ki apne donon kandhon ko nanga chhor de aur unpar kuchh na rakhe. Kyonki donon kandhe yadyapi shareer ke un bhaagon mein se nahin hain, jinko chhupaye rakhna waajib hai, lekin unpar kapra rakh dene ke baad shareer ke un bhaagon ko chhupaane ka kaam behtar taur par sanpann hota hai, jinko chhupaane ka aadesh diya gaya hai aur isse Allah ke saamne khare hote samay uska sammaan bhi behtar taur par pradarshit hota hai.

Ek kapra pahankar namaz parhna jayaz hai, jab kapra shareer ke utne bhaag ko chhupa le, jitne bhaag ko chhupaana zaroori hai.
Do kapron mein namaz parhna jayaz hai, jab ek kapra shareer ke oopri bhaag ko chhupaye aur doosra nichle bhaag ko.
Namaz parhne ke liye ja rahe vyakt ki weshbhoosha achchhi honi chahiye.
Namaz parhte samay donon kandhon ya unmen se kisi ek ko dhaanpna aawashyak hai, jab saamarthy ho. Jabki kuchh logon ke anusaar is hadees mein aai hui manaahi halki hai (arthaat yahaan mana kiye hue kaam ko chhorna  aawashyak nahin hai).
Sahaaba ki nirdhanta ka haal ki unmen se bahuton ke paas do kapre bhi nahin hua karte the.
Navvi is hadees ka arth bayaan karte hue likhte hain : Iske peechhe rahasy yeh hai ki jab kisi vyakti ke paas ek hi chaadar ho aur use lungi ke taur istemaal kar le aur kandhe par kuchh na ho, to shareer ke un angon ke khul jaane ki sanbhaavna baaqi rah jaati hai, jinka chhupaana aawashyak hai. Jabki kandhe par kuchh hone ki sthiti mein iski sanbhaavna nahin rahti. Doosri baat yeh hai ki kandhe par kuchh na hone ki awastha mein aisa ho sakta hai ki neeche pahne hue chaadar ko ek haath ya donon haathon se pakarne ki zaroorat par jaye, jisse ek to namaz se tawajjo hategi aur doosra dayen haath ko bayen haath par seene ke neeche rakhne aur jahaan-jahaan donon haathon ko uthaana sunnat hai, wahaan-wahaan uthaane ki sunnat chhoot jayegi. Ek baat yeh bhi hai ki kandhe par kuchh na rakhna daraasal shareer ke oopri bhaag tatha shobha ke sthaan ko dhaanpne se gurez karna hai, jabki pawitr evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : "Har namaz ke samay uplabdh shobha dhaaran kar liya karo". [soora aaraaf : 31]
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
10641: Ham log Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath ek yaatra mein the. Raat andheri thi aur hamen pata na chal saka ki qibla kidhar hai. Atah, hammen se har vyakti ne apne wiwek ke anusaar qibla ka chayan kar namaz parh li. Subah jab hamne iska zikr Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se kiya, to aappar yeh ayat utri: {فأينما تولوا فثم وجه الله} [soora al-baqraah 115] (tum jis or bhi rukh karoge, udhar hi Allah ka mukh hai.)

Aamir bin rabeea (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki ham log Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath ek yaatra mein the. Raat andheri thi aur hamen pata na chal saka ki qibla kidhar hai. Atah, hammen se har vyakti ne apne wiwek ke anusaar qibla ka chayan kar namaz parh li. Subah jab hamne iska zikr Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se kiya, to aappar yeh ayat utri: {فأينما تولوا فثم وجه الله} [soora al-baqraah 115] (tum jis or bhi rukh karoge, udhar hi Allah ka mukh hai.)

10642: Poorab aur pashchim ke beech jo faasla hai, woh qibla hai.
Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Poorab aur pashchim ke beech jo faasla hai, woh qibla hai."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise maalik ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10643: Rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apni sawaari par nafal namaz parh lete the, chaahe woh jidhar ja rahi ho. Lekin, jab farz namaz parhne ka iraada farmaate, to utarkar qible ki or munh karke namaz parhte.

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apni sawaari par nafal namaz parh lete the, chaahe woh jidhar ja rahi ho. Lekin, jab farz namaz parhne ka iraada farmaate, to utarkar qible ki or munh karke namaz parhte.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- sawaari ke oopar se utarne ke bajay usi par baithkar namaz parh lete the. Aisa yaatra ke dauraan karte the. Iski pushti abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- aadi se warnit us hadees se hoti hai, jismen hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- yaatra mein hote samay apni sawaari par hi namaz parh lete the. Chaahe woh jidhar ja rahi ho. Ise imaam Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai. Atah jab insaan kisi sawaari par sawaar ho, to udhar hi munh karke namaz parh lega, jidhar uski sawaari ka munh ho. Isse koi farq nahin parta ki sawaari ka munh qible ki or hai ya nahin hai. Lekin yadi farz namaz yaani paanch waqt ki namaazon mein se koi namaz parhni ho, to insaan sawaari se utarkar qible ki or munh karke namaz parhega. Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ki hadees mein hai : "Lekin aap sawaari par sawaar hokar farz namaz nahin parhte the."
Atah farz namaz ko dharti par parhna zaroori hai. Haan, yadi koi sharai kaaran jaise warsha aur shatru ka bhay aadi ho, to farz namaz bhi sawaari par parhi ja sakti hai. Isi tarah yadi insaan beemaar ho, to chaarpaai par baithkar parh sakta hai. Wishesh roop se yadi namaz ka samay nikal jaane ka bhay ho, tab bhi sawaari par parh sakta hai. Iski pushti un tamaam ayton evn hadeeson se hoti hai, jinmen aasaani paida karna aur bojh halka karne ki baat kahi gai hai. Is prakaar ki ek ayat uchch evn mahaan Allah ka yeh farmaan hai : "Allah kisi praani par uski sakat (kshamta) se adhik (dayitv ka) bhaar nahin rakhta." Jabki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jab main tumhen kisi baat ka aadesh doon, to jahaan tak ho sake, uska paalan karo."
10644: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab yaatra kar rahe hote aur nafal namaz parhne ka iraada farmaate, to apni oontni ka rukh qibla ki or kar lete aur takbeer kahkar namaz parhne lagte, chaahe aapki sawaari aapko jidhar le ja rahi hoti.

Anas (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab yaatra kar rahe hote aur nafal namaz parhne ka iraada farmaate, to apni oontni ka rukh qibla ki or kar lete aur takbeer kahkar namaz parhne lagte, chaahe aapki sawaari aapko jidhar le ja rahi hoti.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab yaatra mein hote aur nafal namaz parhna chaahte, to takbeer-e-ehraam ke samay apne oont ka munh qibla ki or kar lete aur uske baad jidhar jaana hota, udhar ka munh karke hi namaz parhte jaate.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10645: Poori dharti masjid hai, siway qabragaah aur snaan ghar ke.
Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Poori dharti masjid hai, siway qabragaah aur snaan ghar ke."

Poori dharti namaz parhne ke liye upyukt hai, siway us sthaan ke jahaan murdon ko dafan kiya jaata hai, jiske antargat qabristaan ki chahaardeewaari ke andar ka poora kshetr shaamil hai aur siway us sthaan ke jahaan shifa haasil karne ke liye garm paani se snaan kiya jaata hai.
Navvi kahte hain : "Is masle mein saare islaamik widvaanon ka mataiky hai ki shaitaan ke rahne ki jaghon mein namaz parhna apriy hai. Jaise sharaab khaane, naait klab tatha utpaad kar wasooli kendr aadi aise sthaan jahaan khuleaam gunaah kiye jaate hon aur charch, yahoodiyon ke pooja sthal aur shauchaalay adi."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10647: “Qabron par mat baitho aur unki or munh karke namaz na parho.”
Abu marsad ghanvi radiyallahu anhu bayaan karte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : “Qabron par mat baitho aur unki or munh karke namaz na parho.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne qabron par baithne se mana kiya hai.

Isi tarah unki or munh karke is tarah namaz parhne se bhi mana kiya hai ki qabr namaazi ke qible ki disha mein ho. Mana karne ka kaaran yeh hai ki yeh cheez shirk ki or le jaane waali cheez hai.

Qabristaan mein, qabron ke beech ya qabron ki or munh karke namaz parhne ki manaahi. Parantu janaaze ki namaz is manaahi ke dayre se baahar hai, jaisa ki sunnat se saabit hai.
Qabron ki or munh karke namaz parhne se mana shirk ka dvaar band karne ke liye kiya gaya hai.
Islam ne qabron ke baare mein atishyokti se bhi mana kiya hai tatha unke asammaan karne se bhi mana kiya hai. Yahaan na to had se aage barhne ki anumti hai aur na kotaahi karne ki.
Musalmaan ka sammaan uski maut ke baad bhi baaqi rahta hai. Kyonki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Mare hue vyakti ki haddi torna jeewit vyakti ki haddi torne ke samaan hai."
10648: Jab tummen se koi masjid aye, to theek se dekh le. Yadi jooton mein gandgi ya naapaaki dikhaai de, to use ragarkar saaph kar le aur unhen pahankar namaz parh le.

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki ek baar Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne saathiyon ko namaz parha rahe the ki achaanak apne joote utaarkar apni baaeen or rakh diye. Jab logon ne aapko aisa karte dekha, to unhonne bhi apne joote utaar diye. Jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) namaz poori kar chuke, to farmayaah “Tumko kis cheej ne joota utaarne par aamaada kiya?" Logon ne jawaab diya ki hamne aapko joote utaarte hue dekha, to hamne bhi apne joote utaar diye. Ispar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Mere paas jibreel (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aye the tatha mujhe bataya tha ki donon jooton mein gandgi hai (ya kaha ki naapaaki hai).” tatha farmayaah “Jab tummen se koi masjid aye, to theek se dekh le. Yadi jooton mein gandgi ya naapaaki dikhaai de, to use ragarkar saaph kar le aur unhen pahankar namaz parh le.”
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10649: Jab koi vyakti apne jooton se gandi raunde, to unhen paak karne waali wastu mitti hai.
Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jab koi vyakti apne jooton se gandi raunde, to unhen paak karne waali wastu mitti hai."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10650: Yeh jo namaz hai, ismen logon ki aam baat-cheet sahi nahin hai. Ismen to bas tasbeeh, takbeer aur Qur'an ki tilaawat hoti hai.

Muaawiya bin hakam sulmi (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki main ek baar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath namaz parh raha tha ki achaanak hammen se ek aadmi ne chheenka aur mainne "Yarahmukallah" (Allah tujhpar raham kare) kah diya. Ispar log mujhe ghoorne lage, to mainne kahaah meri maan mujhe kho de! Aakhir kya baat hai ki tum log mujhe ghoor rahe ho? Yeh sun we apni jaanghon par haath maarne lage. Jab mainne dekha ki we mujhe chup karaana chaahte hain, to main chup ho gaya. Jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) namaz se faarigh hue, aappar mere maan-baap qurbaan hon, mainne na aapse pahle koi aapse uttam shikshak dekha na aapke baad, Allah ki qasam, na aapne mujhe daanta, na maara aur na gaali di, balki faramyaah “Yeh jo namaz hai, ismen logon ki aam baat-cheet sahi nahin hai. Ismen to bas tasbeeh, takbeer aur Qur'an ki tilaawat hoti hai.” ya kuchh isi tarah ki baat Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne kahi. Mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, mujhe jaahiliyat ke daur se alag hue kuchh zyaada din nahin hue hain aur ab Allah ne hamen islaam pradaan kar diya hai. Lekin, hammen se kuchh log kaahinon ke paas jaate hain! Aapne kahaah "Tum unke paas na jaao." Mainne kahaah hammen se kuchh log apashgun lete hain. Aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayah "Yeh ek cheez hai, jo we apne dilon mein paate hain. Parantu yeh unhen (kisi kaary se) na roke." (Ek warnankarta ibn sabbaah ne "Parantu yeh tumhen na roke" Kaha hai.) maine kahaah hammen se kuchh log (kaaghaz ya zameen par) lakeer kheenchte hain! To farmayaah "Ek Nabi bhi lakeer kheenchte the. Atah, yadi koi waisi hi lakeer kheenchta hai, to sahi hai." Woh kahte hainh mere paas ek daasi thi, jo uhud aur javvaaniya ki or meri bakriyaan charaati thi. Ek din mujhe pata chala ki bheriya ek bakri ko lekar chala gaya hai. Main aadam ki santaan mein se ek aadmi hoon. Mujhe bhi aam logon ki tarah ghussa aata hai. Atah mainne use ek thappar maara. Phir Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya, to aapne ise meri ek bari bhool bataya. Mainn kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, kya main usko aazaad na kar doon? Aapne kahaah "Use mere paas laao." Main use aapke paas le aya. Aapne usse poochhaah "Allah kahaan hai?" Usne kahaah aakaash mein. Aapne poochhaah "Main kaun hoon?" Usne uttar diyaah aap Allah ke Rasool hain. Tab aapne kahaah "Ise aazaad kar do. Yeh eemaan waali hai."
10652: Tasbeeh (subhaan Allah kahna) purushon ke liye hai aur taali bajaana striyon ki liye.
Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Tasbeeh (subhaan Allah kahna) purushon ke liye hai aur taali bajaana striyon ki liye.”

Hadees ka arth : "Tasbeeh (subhaanallah kahna) purushon ke liye hai aur taali bajaana striyon ki liye." Saheeh Muslim ki ek riwayat mein "Namaz ke andar" Shabd ki wriddhi hai. Is hadees ka matlab yeh hai ki jo vyakti namaz parh raha ho aur isi beech uske saamne koi aisi baat a jaye, jisse any logon ko soochit karna zaroori ho, jaise namaz mein koi truti ho jaye aur imaam ko usse soochit karna aawashyak ho, koi drishtiheen vyakti kuen mein girta hua dikhaai de, koi vyakti andar aane ki anumti maang raha ho ya phir khud namaz parhne waala vyakti kisi doosre vyakti ko koi soochna dena chaahta ho, to in paristhitiyon mein woh apni baat samjhaane ke liye 'subhaanallah' kahega. Lekin yeh purush ki baat hai. Jahaan tak stri ki baat hai, to yadi namaz ke dauraan uske saamne is prakaar ki koi baat a jaye, to woh taali bajayegi. Taali bajaane ka tareeqa yeh hai ki woh ek haath ko doosre haath par kisi bhi tareeqe se maaregi. Daraasal is prakaar ka aadesh isliye diya gaya hai, taaki namaz ko aise kathnon se surakshit rakha ja sake, jo usmen sammilit nahin hain. Kyonki yeh Allah ke saath waartaalaap ka sthaan hai. Atah jab baat karne ki aawashyakta ho, to aisi baat kahne ki anumti di jayegi, jo namaz ke azkaar ki shreni mein aati ho. Yaani tasbeeh parhne ki anumti hogi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10653: Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko namaz parhte samay dekha ki aapke seene se rone ke kaaran chakki ke chalne ki tarah aawaaz nikal rahi hai. Aappar Allah ki kripa ho aur shaanti ki dhaara barse.

Abdullah bin shikhkheer (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko namaz parhte samay dekha ki aapke seene se rone ke kaaran chakki ke chalne ki tarah aawaaz nikal rahi hai. Aappar Allah ki kripa ho aur shaanti ki dhaara barse.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10655: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) namaz parhne ki liye quba ki or nikle.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) namaz parhne ki liye quba ki or nikle. Woh (aage) kahte hain : Aap wahaan namaz parh rahe the ki ansaar aapke paas aye tatha unhonne aapko salaam kiya. Woh kahte hain : Mainne bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) se poochha ki jab we namaz ki awastha mein Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko salaam karte the, to aapne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kaise salaam ka jawaab dete hue dekha? Unhonne kaha : Is prakaar. Aisa kahte samay unhonne apni hatheli ko phailaya evn uske androoni bhaag ko neeche rakha aur baahri bhaag ko oopar.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10656: Mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dekha ki aap logon ko namaz parha rahe the aur umaama bint abul aas, jo Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki suputri zainab ki beti theen, aapke kandhe par theen. Jab aap ruku karte, to unko utaar dete aur jab sajde se uthte, to unko dobaara kandhe par utha lete.

Abu qataada ansaari (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dekha ki aap logon ko namaz parha rahe the aur umaama bint abul aas, jo Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki suputri zainab ki beti theen, aapke kandhe par theen. Jab aap ruku karte, to unko utaar dete aur jab sajde se uthte, to unko dobaara kandhe par utha lete.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10657: Do kaali wastuon ko namaz ki awastha mein bhi maar do : Saanp tatha bichchhu.
Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Do kaali wastuon ko namaz ki awastha mein bhi maar do : Saanp tatha bichchhu.”

[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10659: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne musaafir ke liye teen din tatha teen raat evn ghar par rahne waale ke liye ek din evn ek raat is baat ki chhoot di hai ki jab woh wazu karke mauze pahne, to unpar masah kar sakta hai.

Abu bakra nufai bin haaris saqphi (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne musaafir ke liye teen din tatha teen raat evn ghar par rahne waale ke liye ek din evn ek raat is baat ki chhoot di hai ki jab woh wazu karke mauze pahne, to unpar masah kar sakta hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise daarqutni ne riwayat kiya hai .]
10706: Bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) ne fajr hone se pahle hi azaan de di, to Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen aadesh diya ki jaakar yeh ailaan karen : "Log suno, banda so gaya tha. Logo suno, banda so gaya tha."

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se warnit hai ki bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) ne fajr hone se pahle hi azaan de di, to Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen aadesh diya ki jaakar yeh ailaan karen : "Log suno, banda so gaya tha. Logo suno, banda so gaya tha."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10834: Nissandeh yeh Qur'an wibhinn andaazon mein utra hai. Atah unmen se jo aasaan ho, parho.

Umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke zamaane mein hishaam bin hakeem (radiyallahu anhu) ko soora phurqaan parhte suna. Jab mainne unke parhne par ghaur kiya, to maaloom hua ki unke tilaawat karne ka andaaz usse kuchh alag tha, jo Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne mujhe sikhaya tha. Qareeb tha ki namaz hi mein main unko daboch loon. Lekin, mainne unki prateeksha ki. Jab woh salaam pher chuke, to mainne unko unki ya apni chaadar se pakar liya aur poochha ki tumhen yeh soora kisne parhaai hai? Unhonne kahaah mujhe Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne parhaya hai. Mainne kahaah tum jhooth bol rahe ho. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne khud mujhe yeh soora, jo tumne parhi, sikhaai hai. Phir main unhen kheenchkar rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas laya aur kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool! Mainne inhen soora furqaan aise andaaz mein parhte suna hai, jis andaaz mein aapne mujhe nahin parhaya tha. Haalaanki khud aapne hi mujhe yeh soora parhaai hai! Aapne kahaah "Ai umar! Ise chhor do. Ai hishaam! Tum parho." Unhonne aapke saamne bhi usi tarah parhi, jis tarah unko mainne parhte hue suna tha. Aapne farmayaah "Yeh soora isi tarah utri hai." Phir Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Ai umar! Ab tum parho." Mainne parhi, to farmayaah "Yeh soora is tarah bhi utri hai." Phir farmayaah “Nissandeh yeh Qur'an wibhinn andaazon mein utra hai. Atah unmen se jo aasaan ho, parho.”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10836: Ai jibreel, main ek anparh samuday ki or bheja gaya hoon, jismen boorhi striyaan, boorhe purush, bachche, bachchiyaan aur aise log hain, jinhonne kabhi koi kitaab nahin parhi hai.

Ubay bin kaab (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jibreel se mile tatha kahaah “Ai jibreel, main ek anparh samuday ki or bheja gaya hoon, jismen boorhi striyaan, boorhe purush, bachche, bachchiyaan aur aise log hain, jinhonne kabhi koi kitaab nahin parhi hai." Jibreel ne kaha : Ai Muhammad! “Waastawikta yeh hai ki yeh Qur'an saat wibhinn andaazon mein utaara gaya hai.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10837: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) makka mein terah warshon tak rahe, aappar Qur'an utarta raha, tatha madeene mein das warsh.
Aaisha tatha abdullah bin abbaas (raziyallaaु anhum) se warnit hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) makka mein terah warshon tak rahe, aappar Qur'an utarta raha, tatha madeene mein das warsh.
10838: Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) tatha muhammad bin hanphiya se poochha gaya ki kya Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne (aap logon ke liye) kuchh chhora hai? To donon ne uttar diya ki aapne uske siwa kuchh nahin chhora, jo do daftiyon ke beech hai.

Abdul azeez bin rufai kahte hain ki main tatha shaddaad bin maaqil abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ke paas aye aur shaddaad bin maaqil ne unse poochha : Kya Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne (aap logon ke liye) kuchh chhora hai? Unhonne uttar diya : Aapne uske siwa kuchh nahin chhora, jo do daftiyon ke beech hai. Woh aage kahte hain : Ham Muhammad bin hanfiya ke paas pahunche aur unse poochha, to unhonne bhi kaha : Aapne uske siwa kuchh nahin chhora, jo do daftiyon ke beech hai.
10840: Kabhi to mere paas wahy ghanti ke bajne ki tarah aati hai aur yeh haalat mujhpar sabse kathin guzarti hai. Jab yeh haalat chhathti hai, to mujhe farishte ki kahi hui baat yaad ho jaati hai. Jabki kabhi farishta insaan ke roop mein mere paas aakar mujhse baat karta hai aur jo kuchh woh kahta hai, use main yaad kar leta hoon.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se riwayat hai ki haaris bin hishaam (radiyallahu anhu) ne rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapke paas wahy kaise aati hai? Rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : “Kabhi to mere paas wahy ghanti ke bajne ki tarah aati hai aur yeh haalat mujhpar sabse kathin guzarti hai. Jab yeh haalat chhathti hai, to mujhe farishte ki kahi hui baat yaad ho jaati hai. Jabki kabhi farishta insaan ke roop mein mere paas aakar mujhse baat karta hai aur jo kuchh woh kahta hai, use main yaad kar leta hoon.” aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ka bayaan hai ki mainne sakht sardi ke dinon mein rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dekha ki aappar wahy utarti aur jab uska silsila band hota, to aapki peshaani se paseena tapak raha hota.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10841: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) par jab wahy utarti, to uske kaaran aap bechain ho jaate aur aapke chehre ka rang badal jaata.

Ubaada bin saamit (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) par jab wahy utarti, to uske kaaran aap bechain ho jaate aur aapke chehre ka rang badal jaata.
10842: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) par sardi ki subah ko bhi wahy utarti, to aapke lalaat par paseena bah parta.
Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se warnit hai, woh kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) par sardi ki subah ko bhi wahy utarti, to aapke lalaat par paseena bah parta.

Musalmaanon ki mata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- is hadees mein bata rahi hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- par thandi subah mein wahy aati, to aapki peshaani se bhaari maatra mein paseena bahne lagta. Aisa wahy ki teevrata ke kaaran hua karta tha.
10843: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) Qur'an utarte samay kathinaai ka anubhav karte aur apne honthon ko hilaate the.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) uchch evn mahaan Allah ke is farmaan : {لا تُحَرِّكْ به لسانَك} [soora al-qayaamah : 16] (arthaat ai Nabi, aap iske saath apni zabaan ko na hilayen.) ki tafseer ke wishay mein kahte hain : Daraasal, Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) Qur'an utarte samay kathinaai ka anubhav karte aur apne honthon ko hilaate the. (Warnankarta) kahte hain ki mujhse abdullah bin abbaas ne kaha ki main tumhen waise hi apne honth hilaakar bataata hoon, jis prakaar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne honthon ko hilaya karte the. Phir saeed ne kaha ki main bhi tumhen apne honthon ko waise hi ko hilaakar bataata hoon, jis prakaar abdullah bin abbaas hilaya karte the. Chunaanche unhonne apne honthon ko hilaakar dikhaya bhi. Isi sandarbh mein sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne yeh ayat utaari : {لا تُحَرِّكْ به لسانَك لِتَعْجَلَ به إنَّ علينا جَمْعَه وقُرآنَه} (arthaat ai Nabi, aap apni zabaan ko is Qur'an ke saath na hilayen, taaki ise jaldi yaad kar len. Nishchay use yaad karaane aur parhaane ka kaam hamaara hai.) [soora al-qiyaamah : 17] abdullah bin abbaas (is ayat ki tafseer karte hue) kahte hain : Usko aapke hriday mein ekatr karne ka kaam hamaara hai, jiske baad use aap parhte rahenge. {فإذا قرأناه فاتَّبِعْ قُرآنه} (atah, jab ham use parh len, to aap uske peechhe parhen.) [soora al-qiyaamah : 18] iski vyaakhya karte hue abdullah bin abbaas kahte hain : Use dhyaan se sunte rahen aur khaamosh rahen. Uske pashchaat usko parhaana hamaari zimmewaari hai. Abdullah bin abbaas kahte hain : (Iske baad se) Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas jab jibreel aate, to aap dhyaan se sunte. Tatha jab jibreel chale jaate, to aap use usi tarah parh lete, jaise jibreel ne aapko parhaya tha.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10844: Jo khushbu tumhaare badan mein lagi hui hai, use teen baar dho daalo aur shareer se kurta utaar do tatha Umrah mein bhi wahi karo, jo Hajj mein karte ho.

Safvaan ban yaala se riwayat hai ki yaala (radiyallahu anhu) ne umar (radiyallahu anhu) se kaha : Jis samay Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) par wahy utar rahi ho, to aap mujhe dikhayen. Warnankarta ka bayaan hai ki ek roz Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jiirraana mein the aur sahaaba (radiyallahu anhum) ka ek giroh bhi wahaan maujood tha ki ek aadmi ne aapke paas aakar poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aap us aadmi ke baare mein kya hukm dete hain, jisne Umrah ka ehraam to baandha, lekin woh khushbu lagaye hue hai? Ispar Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kuchh der chup rahe. Phir aappar wahy aai, to umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne yaala (radiyallahu anhu) ki or ishaara kiya. Jab woh aye, to us waqt rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke sir ke oopar ek kapra tha, jisse aappar saya kiya gaya tha. Unhonne apna sir us kapre ke andar kiya, to dekha ki rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke chehre ka rang laal hai aur aapki saans zor-zor se chal rahi hai. Dheere-dheere jab yeh haalat khatm hui, to pharmaya : “Woh aadmi kahaan hai, jisne Umrah ke baare mein poochha tha?” us aadmi ko saamne laya gaya, to farmaya : “Jo khushbu tumhaare badan mein lagi hui hai, use teen baar dho daalo aur shareer se kurta utaar do tatha Umrah mein bhi wahi karo, jo Hajj mein karte ho.“ Mainne ata se poochhaah jab aapne teen baar dhone ka aadesh diya, to kya isse aapka uddeshy saaf-safaai tha? Unhonne uttar diya : Haan.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10846: “Ai ansaariyo!” unhonne uttar diyaah ham upasthit hain ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapne kahaah “Tum log kahte ho ki is vyakti par apne watan ka prem haawi ho gaya hai?” unhonne uttar diyaah haan hamne aisa kaha hai. Aapne kahaah “Katai nahin! Main Allah ka banda tatha uska Rasool hoon. Mainne Allah ki or tatha tumhaari or hijrat ki hai. Ab hamaara jeena bhi tumhaare saath hai aur hamaara marna bhi tumhaare saath hai.“

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Ramzan mein muaawiya (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas kai pratinidhi mandal aye. Hammen se kuchh log doosre logon ke liye bhojan taiyaar karte the. Chunaanche abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) aksar hamen apne aawaas par bulaate the. Ek din mainne socha ki kyon na main khaana taiyaar karoon aur logon ko apne aawaas par bulaaoon? Atah, mainne bhojan taiyaar karne ka aadesh diya aur shaam ko abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se milkar kaha ki aaj raat mere yahaan daawat hai. Unhonne kahaah tumne to mujhpar baazi maar li. Mainne kahaah awashy! Phir mainne sabhi logon ko daawat di. (Jab sab log ekatr hue, to) abu huraira ne kahaah ai ansaariyo! Kya main tumhen tum logon se sanbandhit ek hadees na sunaaoon? Phir unhonne makka wijay ka ullekh karte hue kahaah Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) chal pare, yahaan tak ki makka pahunche, to zubair ko sena ke ek bhaag, khaalid ko uske doosre bhaag par tatha abu ubaida ko bina kawach waale sipaahiyon par niyukt kiya. We ghaati ke andar se aage barhne lage. Khud Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ek chhote-se daste mein the. Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki aapne nazar dauraai, to mujhe dekha. Phir farmayaah abu huraira? Mainne kahaah upasthit hoon ai Allah ke Rasool! Farmayaah mere paas kewal mere ansaar hi ayen! (Ek riwayat mein hai ki aapne kahaah mere liye ansaar ko pukaaro.) woh kahte hainh phir we aapke paas ikatthe ho gae. Udhar, quraish ne bhi wibhinn qabeele ke logon tatha apne anuyayiyon ko jama kar liya aur kaha ki ham inko aage karte hain. Yadi inhen kuchh mila, to ham bhi (use baantne ke liye) inke saath honge aur yadi inpar koi aafat aai, to hamse jo kuchh maanga jayega, ham de denge. Idhar, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Tum qaraish ki jamaaton tatha anuyayiyon ko dekhte ho." Phir aapne ek haath ko doosre par maarkar unke qatl ka ishaara karte hue farmayaah “Tum mujhse safa (pahaari) par milo.“ Abu huraira kahte hainh phir ham chal pare. Hammen se jisne jiska wadh karna chaaha uska wadh kar diya. Unmen se koi hamaara muqaabla na kar saka. Woh kahte hain ki yeh dekh abu sufyaan aye aur kahne lageh ai Allah ke Rasool! Quraish tabaah wa barbaad ho gaya. Aaj ke baad qaraish nahin rahega. Yeh sun aapne kahaah “Jo abu sufyaan ke ghar mein sharan le le, usko amaan hai.“ Yeh dekh ansaar ne ek-doosre se kahaah is vyakti par watan ki muhabbat haawi ho gai tatha yeh apne wansh ke saath sahaanubhooti ka shikaar ho gaya. Abu huraira kahte hainh isi beech aappar wahy utarne lagi. Aappar jab wahy utarti, to ham samajh jaate the. Jab wahy utarne lagti, to uske band hone tak koi apne andar aapki or dekhne ka saamarthy nahin paata. Jab wahy samaapt hui, to rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Ai ansaariyo!” unhonne uttar diyaah ham upasthit hain ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapne kahaah “Tum log kahte ho ki is vyakti par apne watan ka prem haawi ho gaya hai?” unhonne uttar diyaah haan hamne aisa kaha hai. Aapne kahaah “Katai nahin! Main Allah ka banda tatha uska Rasool hoon. Mainne Allah ki or tatha tumhaari or hijrat ki hai. Ab hamaara jeena bhi tumhaare saath hai aur hamaara marna bhi tumhaare saath hai.“ Yeh sun we aapki or rote hue barhe aur kahne lageh hamne jo bhi kaha tha, woh kewal Allah aur uske Rasool ki laalsa mein kaha tha. Ispar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Allah aur uske Rasool tumhen sachcha maante hain tatha tumhaari kshamayaachna sveekaar karte hain.“ Abu huraira kahte hainh iske baad log abu sufyaan ke ghar ki or aane lage tatha logon ne apne gharon ke darvaaze band kar liye. Woh kahte hainh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aage barhte rahe, yahaan tak ki hajar-e-asvad ke paas aye, usko chooma, phir kaaba ka tawaaf kiya. Abu huraira kahte hainh phir aap ek but ke paas aye, jo kaaba ke paas rakha tha aur jiski log upaasna karte the. Unka kahna hai ki us samay rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke haath mein ek kamaan thi aur aap us kamaan ka ek kinaara pakre hue the. Jab aap moorti ke paas aye, to uski aankh mein chot karne lage aur yeh ayat parhne lageh {جاء الحقُّ وزَهَقَ الباطلُ} (saty a gaya aur asaty mit gaya) [soora al-israah 81]. Jab tawaaf poora kar chuke, to safa ki taraf aye aur uspar charh gae, yahaan tak ki kaaba ki or dekha aur donon haathon ko uthaakar Allah ki prashansa karne lage tatha jo chaaha woh maangne lage.
10847: Qur'an ko apni aawaaz ke dvaara sanwaarkar parho.
Bara bin aazib (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah “Qur'an ko apni aawaaz ke dvaara sanwaarkar parho.”

Qur'an parhte samay apni aawaaz ko sundar banaakar uski shobha barhaao. Kyonki sundar aawaaz se sundar waani ki sundarta evn shobha aur barh jaati hai. Is aadesh ka uddeshy Qur'an ke arth par achchhi tarah ghaur wa phikr karna tatha uski ayton mein nihit aadeshon, nishedhon, wachnon evn chetaavniyon ko samajhna hai. Kyonki achchhi aawaaz se prem insaan ki prakriti mein maujood hai. Phir jab aawaaz achchhi hoti hai, to insaan ka chintan idhar-udhar se hatkar usi par kendrit ho jaata hai, aur jab chintan kendrit ho jaata hai, to waanchhit wineeti evn winamrata bhi praapt ho jaati hai. Yaad rahe ki yahaan aawaaz sundar banaane se muraad aisi sundarta laana hai, jisse wineeti evn winamrata paida ho. Gaanon ki dhunon ki aawaaz nahin, jo qiraat ke dayre hi mein na aati ho.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10848: Tumne svapnaphal kuchh sahi bataya hai aur kuchh ghalat.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai, woh bayaan karte the ki ek vyakti Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya aur bola : Mainne raat ko svapn mein ek baadal dekha, jisse ghi evn madhu tapak raha tha. Mainne dekha ki log usmen se lap bhar-bhar kar le rahe the. Koi adhik le raha tha, to koi kam. Mainne yeh bhi dekha ki dharti se aakaash tak ek rassi tangi hui hai aur aap use pakarkar oopar charh gae. Phir ek vyakti ne usko thaama aur oopar charh gaya. Phir vyakti ne usko thaama aur oopar charh gaya. Phir ek vyakti ne usko thaama, to rassi toot gai. Parantu, phir jur gai tatha woh oopar chala gaya. (Svapn sunne ke baad) abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, mere maata-pita aappar qurbaan hon! Allah ki qasam! Aap mujhe is svapn ka svapnaphal bayaan karne denge. Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Theek hai, iska svapnaphal bayaan karo.“ Unhonne kahaah baadal ka woh tukra islaam hai aur ghi tatha madhu ke roop mein jo wastu tapak rahi thi, woh Qur'an hai. Qur'an ki mithaas tapak rahi hai. Koi uski is mithaas ka adhik rasaasvaadan kar raha hai, to koi kam. Jahaan tak aakaash se dharti tak latakne waali rassi ka taalluq hai, to usse muraad woh saty hai, jispar aap chal rahe hain. Aap use pakre rahenge, to Allah aapko oopar le jayega. Phir aapke baad ek vyakti use pakrega, to uske zariye oopar chala jayega. Uske baad ek aur vyakti use pakrega, to uske maadhyam se oopar chala jayega. Phir ek aur vyakti use thaamega, to woh kat jayegi. Lekin, phir use jor diya jayega, to woh oopar chala jayega. Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mere maan-baap aappar qurbaan hon! Mujhe batayen ki mainne sahi svapnaphal bataya ya ghalat? Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne batayaah “Tumne svapnaphal kuchh sahi bataya hai aur kuchh ghalat.” abu bakr ne kahaah Allah ki qasam! Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aap zaroor batayenge ki mujhse kahaan ghalti hui hai. Aapne kahaah “Qasam na khaao.”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10849: Meri baaton ko na likho aur jisne mujhse Qur'an ke siwa kuchh likha hai, woh use mita de aur meri or se bayaan karo tatha ismen koi harj nahin hai. Aur jisne mujhpar jaan-boojhkar jhooth bola, uska thikaana Jahannam hai.

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Meri baaton ko na likho aur jisne mujhse Qur'an ke siwa kuchh likha hai, woh use mita de aur meri or se bayaan karo tatha ismen koi harj nahin hai. Aur jisne mujhpar jaan-boojhkar jhooth bola, uska thikaana Jahannam hai.”

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne saathiyon ko apni koi baat likhne se mana kiya tha aur kah diya tha ki jo Qur'an ke atirikt koi baat likhe, use mita de. Albatta, is baat ki anumti di thi ki we aapki hadees ko bayaan kar sakte hain aur ismen koi harj nahin hai. Bas is baat ka dhyaan rahe ki aapse kuchh bhi naqal karte samay satyata ki pushti kar liya karen. Saath hi unhen is baat ki chetaavni de di ki jo vyakti jaan-boojhkar aapse koi jhoothi baat sanbaddh karega, uska pratiphal Jahannam ki aag hai.
Yaad rahe ki hadees likhne ki manaahi nirast ho chuki hai. Daraasal Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne shuru mein hadees likhne se mana kiya tha. Lekin hadeeson ki sankhya bahut adhik thi aur kewal yaaddaasht par bharosa karne se kuchh hadeeson ke nasht hone ka dar tha, isliye unhen likhne ki anumit de di. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne ek khutbe mein kaha tha : "Tum abu shaah ko kuchh hadeesen likhkar de do." Daraasal unhonne kuchh baaten likhkar dene ki maangi theen. Aapne abdullah bin amr -radiyallahu anhu- ko bhi hadees likhne ki anumti di thi. Isi tarah Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apni ummat ko aapki hadeesen doosron tak pahunchaane ka aadesh diya hai, jabki likh kar na rakhne ki sthiti mein jnaan ka yeh bhandaar nasht ho jayega. Kuchh logon ka kahna hai ki yeh manaahi daraasal hadees ko Qur'an ke saath milaakar ek hi sthaan mein likhne ki hai, taaki donon ek-doosre se is tarah mishrit na ho jayen ki ek aam insaan ke liye alag karna sanbhav na ho sake. Jabki kuchh any logon ka kahna hai ki yeh manaahi Qur'an ke awatran ke samay ke liye khaas thi, taaki Qur'an kisi aur cheez ke saath mishrit na ho jaye. Phir baad mein iski anumti de di gai.
In teenon maton mein se nirast hone ka mat hi zyaada sahi lagta hai.
10850: Kisi aadmi ka yeh kahna ki main amuk-amuk ayat bhool gaya hoon, naamunaasib baat hai. Balki woh bhula diya gaya hai. Qur'an ko lagaataar yaad karte raho, kyonki Qur'an (gaphlat baratne waale) logon ke seenon se nikal jaane ke maamle mein oonton se bhi zyaada tez hai.

Abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Kisi aadmi ka yeh kahna ki main amuk-amuk ayat bhool gaya hoon, naamunaasib baat hai. Balki woh bhula diya gaya hai. Qur'an ko lagaataar yaad karte raho, kyonki Qur'an (gaphlat baratne waale) logon ke seenon se nikal jaane ke maamle mein oonton se bhi zyaada tez hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10851: Qur'an parho; kyonki Qur'an qayaamat ke din apne parhne waalon ke liye sifaarishi bankar ayega.

Abu umaama baahili (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue suna : “Qur'an parho; kyonki Qur'an qayaamat ke din apne parhne waalon ke liye sifaarishi bankar ayega. Do chamakti hui soortenh soora baqra tatha soora aal-e- imraan parho; kyonki donon soorten qayaamat ke din is prakaar ayengi, jaise do baadal hon, ya do saybaan hon, ya panktibaddh chiriyon ke do jhund hon. Donon soorten parhne waalon ke bachaav mein bahas karengi. Soora baqra parho; kyonki ise lena barkat hai, ise chhorna hasrat hai aur jaadoogar iska muqaabla nahin kar sakte.”
10852: Qur'an us samay tak parho, jab tak tumhaare dil anukool rahen. Jab pratikoolta aane lage, to parhna chhor do.

Jundub bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmaya : “Qur'an us samay tak parho, jab tak tumhaare dil anukool rahen. Jab pratikoolta aane lage, to parhna chhor do.”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10853: Kya tumhen isi ka aadesh diya gaya hai? Athva kya tumhen iseeliye is dhara par bheja gaya hai ki ek ayat ka khandan doosri ayat se karo? Tumse poorv ki ummaten to inheen jaisi cheezon ke kaaran tabaah hui hain. Tumhaara in baaton se koi lena-dena nahin hai. Dekho ki tumhen kya aadesh diya gaya hai, to uspar amal karo aur kis baat se roka gaya hai, to usse ruk jaao.

Abdullah bin amr (radiyallahu anhuma) se warnit hai ki ek jamaat Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke dvaar ke paas baithi thi ki unmen se kisi ne kahaah kya Allah ne aisa-aisa nahin farmaya hai? Phir kisi ne kahaah kya Allah ne aisa-aisa nahin farmaya hai? Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne in baaton ko suna, to ghar se nikle. Aisa lag raha tha ki aapke chehre par anaar ka ras nichor diya gaya ho. Farmaya : “Kya tumhen isi ka aadesh diya gaya hai? Athva kya tumhen iseeliye is dhara par bheja gaya hai ki ek ayat ka khandan doosri ayat se karo? Tumse poorv ki ummaten to inheen jaisi cheezon ke kaaran tabaah hui hain. Tumhaara in baaton se koi lena-dena nahin hai. Dekho ki tumhen kya aadesh diya gaya hai, to uspar amal karo aur kis baat se roka gaya hai, to usse ruk jaao.“

Kuchh sahaaba -radiyallahu anhum- Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke dvaar ke paas baithe hue the. Is beech kisi masle par unka matbhed ho gaya. Kuchh riwayton mein hai ki unka matbhed bhaagy ke masle par hua tha. Unmen se kisi ne apne mat ke pramaan ke roop mein Allah ki kitaab ki koi ayat prastut ki, to kisi ne apni baat ko siddh karne ke liye koi any ayat saamne rakh di. Unki yeh baaten Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne suneen, to ghar se nikalkar unke paas aye. Aap krodhit the aur chehra bahut zyaada laal tha. Aisa maaloom hota tha ki aapke chehre par anaar ka ras nichor diya gaya ho. Aapne unse farmaya : Kya Qur'an ke baare mein yeh matbhed, bahas aur jhagra hi tumhaari rachna ka uddeshy hai? Ya phir Allah ne tumhen isi ka aadesh diya hai? Aap kahna yeh chaahte the ki donon mein se koi bhi baat nahin hai aur in bahson ki koi aawashyakta bhi nahin hai. Phir bataya ki pichhle samudayon ki gumraahi ka sabab yahi matbhed tha. Phir unhen unki bhalaai tatha laabh ki baat bataate hue farmaya : Jis baat ka aadesh tumhen Allah de, use karo aur jis baat se roke, usse ruk jaao. Isi ke liye Allah ne tumhaari rachna ki hai aur isi mein tumhaari bhalaai evn mukti hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10854: Kuraaan ke sanbandh mein waad-wiwaad na karo, kyonki iske wishay mein waad-wiwaad karna kufr hai.

Abdullah bin amr (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Kuraaan ke sanbandh mein waad-wiwaad na karo, kyonki iske wishay mein waad-wiwaad karna kufr hai.”

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne Qur'an ke baare mein waad-wiwaad karne se mana kiya hai, kyonki yeh kufr ki or le jaata hai. Iska kaaran yeh hai ki kabhi-kabhi insaan Qur'an ki koi ayat ya koi shabd sunaat hai, jiski jaankaari uske paas nahin hoti. Aise mein woh jaldabaazi se kaam lete hue use parhne waale ko galat thahra deta hai aur use Qur'an maanne se inkaar kar deta hai. Ya kisi se kisi aisi ayat ke baare mein bahas karta hai, jiske baare mein woh kuchh nahin jaanta aur iske baavjood use pathabhrasht kahta hai. Yeh waad-wiwaad kabhi-kabhi insaan ko saty se door kar deta hai, yadyapi use woh uchit dikhaai deta ho. Yahi kaaran hai ki ise haraam ghoshit kiya gaya aur kufr kaha gaya hai. Lekin yadi kisi insaan ke andar is tarah ki baaten na paai jayen, to uska waad-wiwaad karna waidh athva prashansneey hai. Jaise koi seekhne aur saty ko saamne laane ke liye poochhe. Isi ki or ishaara karte hue uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : "Aur unse aise dhang se waad-wiwaad karo, jo uttam ho."
[ise abu daaood tayaalisi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10860: Mere paanch naam hainh main muhammad aur ahmad hoon; main maahi (mitaane waala) hoon, jiske dvaara Allah kuphr ko mitayega; main haashir hoon, jiske baad logon ko qabron se uthaya jayega aur main aaqib hoon (jiske baad koi Nabi nahin hoga).

Jubair bin mutaim (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah “Mere paanch naam hainh main muhammad aur ahmad hoon; main maahi (mitaane waala) hoon, jiske dvaara Allah kuphr ko mitayega; main haashir hoon, jiske baad logon ko qabron se uthaya jayega aur main aaqib hoon (jiske baad koi Nabi nahin hoga).”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10861: Alllah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen apne kai naam bataye, jinmen se kuchh hamne yaad kar liye. Aapne faramyaah “Main muhammad, ahmad, muqaffi, haashir tatha Nabi-e-rahmat hoon." Yazeed kahte hainh "Aur Nabi-e-tauba tatha Nabi-e-malahma hoon."

Abu moosa (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki alllah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamen apne kai naam bataye, jinmen se kuchh hamne yaad kar liye. Aapne faramyaah “Main muhammad, ahmad, muqaffi, haashir tatha Nabi-e-rahmat hoon." Yazeed kahte hainh "Aur Nabi-e-tauba tatha Nabi-e-malahma hoon."
[ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10862: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) bachchon ke saath khel rahe the ki aapke paas jibreel (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aye aur aapko pakarkar chit lita diya tatha aapke seene ko cheerkar hriday nikaala, phir usmen se jame hue rakt ka ek lothra nikaala aur pharmayaah yeh aapke shareer mein shaitaan ka bhaag tha.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) warnan karte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) bachchon ke saath khel rahe the ki aapke paas jibreel (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aye aur aapko pakarkar chit lita diya tatha aapke seene ko cheerkar hriday nikaala, phir usmen se jame hue rakt ka ek lothra nikaala aur pharmayaah yeh aapke shareer mein shaitaan ka bhaag tha. Phir use sone ki tashtari mein rakhkar zamzam ke paani se dhokar dobaara apne sthaan par rakh diya. Udhar, bachche daurte hue aapki maata (yaani daai) ke paas aye aur bole : Muhammad ki hatya kar di gai hai. Log aapke paas aye, to paya ki aapke chehre ka rang badla hua hai. Anas (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hainh silaai ke us nishaan ko main aapke seene par dekha karta tha.
10868: Ham log namaz parhte aur hamaare aage se pashu gujarte rahte. Hamne iska ullekh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se kiya, to aapne pharamyaah "Kajaawe ke pichhle bhaag ki lakri ke samaan koi wastu apne saamne rakh lo, to saamne se guzarne waali koi cheez tumhen nuqsaan nahin pahunchayegi.

Talha bin ubaidullah (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain : Ham log namaz parhte aur hamaare aage se pashu gujarte rahte. Hamne iska ullekh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se kiya, to aapne faramyaah "Kajaawe ke pichhle bhaag ki lakri ke samaan koi wastu apne saamne rakh lo, to saamne se guzarne waali koi cheez tumhen nuqsaan nahin pahunchayegi."
10870: Jab tummen se koi namaz ke liye khara ho aur uske saamne kajaawe ke pichhle bhaag ki lakri ke samaan koi wastu ho, to woh uske liye ot ho jaati hai. Kintu, yadi uske saamne kajaawe ke pichhle bhaag ki lakri ke samaan koi wastu na ho, to uski namaz ko gadha, mahila tatha kaala kutta bhang kar dete hain.

Aboozar (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Jab tummen se koi namaz ke liye khara ho aur uske saamne kajaawe ke pichhle bhaag ki lakri ke samaan koi wastu ho, to woh uske liye ot ho jaati hai. Kintu, yadi uske saamne kajaawe ke pichhle bhaag ki lakri ke samaan koi wastu na ho, to uski namaz ko gadha, mahila tatha kaala kutta bhang kar dete hain." Mainne poochha : Ai aboozar kaale kutte tatha laal evn peele kutte mein kya antar hai? To unhonne uttar diya : Ai mere bhateeje! Mainne yahi prashn Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se kiya tha, jaise toomne mujhse kiya hai, to aapne uttar diya tha : "Kaala kutta shaitaan hai."
Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ki ek riwayat mein is prakaar haih "Maahvaari waali mahila tatha kutta namaz ko bhang kar dete hain."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10871: Jab tummen se koi sutra saamne rakhkar namaz parhe aur koi uske saamne se guzarna chaahe, to use roke. Yadi woh na ruke, to usse bhir jaye, isliye ki woh shaitaan hai.

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Jab tummen se koi sutra saamne rakhkar namaz parhe aur koi uske saamne se guzarna chaahe, to use roke. Yadi woh na ruke, to usse bhir jaye, isliye ki woh shaitaan hai."
Ek doosri riwayat mein is prakaar hainh "Jab tummen se koi namaz parh raha ho, to apne saamne se kisi ko na guzarne de. Yadi woh na ruke, to usse laraai kare; kyonki uske saag uska saathi (shaitaan) hai."

Jab kisi namaz parhne waale ne namaz shuru karne se pahle apne saamne sutra rakh liya ki woh logon ke liye aar ban jaye aur koi uske saamne se guzarkar uski namaz mein koi kami paida na kare aur phir woh apne rab se waartaalaap karne laga, to aise sthiti mein yadi koi uske saamne se guzarna chaahe, to woh use aasaani se rokne ki koshish kare. Lekin yadi woh aasaani se na ruke, to woh atyaachaari hai aur uske atyaachaar ko rokne ke liye haath ka prayog karne tatha usse larne ki anumti hai. Kyonki uska yeh kaam shaitaan ka kaam hai, jo logon ki ibaadton ko nasht karne aur unki namaz mein bhraanti utpann karne ki koshish mein rahta hai.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10874: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kokh par haath rakhkar namaz parhne se mana kiya hai.
Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kokh par haath rakhkar namaz parhne se mana kiya hai.
Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is baat se mana kiya hai ki koi vyakti pahlu par haath rakhkar namaz parhe.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10875: Aaisha (radiyallahu anh) se warnit hai ki woh is baat ko naapsand karti theen ki koi (namaz parhte samay) apne haath ko kokh par rakhe tatha kaha karti theen ki yahoodi aisa karte hain.

10878: Mainne rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se poochha : Namaz mein idhar udhar dekhna kaisa hai? To aapne uttar diya : "Yeh ek prakaar ki chori hai, jo shaitaan bande ki namaz mein karta hai."

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki mainne rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se poochha : Namaz mein idhar udhar dekhna kaisa hai? To aapne uttar diya : "Yeh ek prakaar ki chori hai, jo shaitaan bande ki namaz mein karta hai."
10880: Tummen se koi jab namaz mein khara hota hai, to woh apne rab se vyaktigat roop se baat kar raha hota hai ya uska rab uske aur qible ke beech hota hai. Isliye, tummen se koi (namaz ki haalat mein) qible ki or na thooke. Balki bayen taraf ya apne qadmon ke neeche thooke.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek baar (masjid ke andar) qible ki or thook dekha, to yeh aapko bahut bura laga aur iska prabhaav aapke chehre par dekha gaya. Chunaanche aap khare hue aur use apne haath se saaf kiya tatha farmaya : "Tummen se koi jab namaz mein khara hota hai, to woh apne rab se vyaktigat roop se baat kar raha hota hai ya uska rab uske aur qible ke beech hota hai. Isliye, tummen se koi (namaz ki haalat mein) qible ki or na thooke. Balki bayen taraf ya apne qadmon ke neeche thooke." Phir aapne apni chaadar ke ek kinaare ko pakarkar usmen thooka aur use aapas mein ragar diya aur kaha : "Ya phir is tarah kare."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne masjid ke qible ki or waali deewaar mein balgham laga dekha, to aapko bara bura laga, jiska prabhaav aapke chehre se jhalakne laga. Atah khud khare hue aur apni ummat ko sikhaane tatha apne prabhu ke saamne apni winamrata prakat karne ke liye evn uske ghar ke prem mein svayn apne haath se balgham ko saaf kar diya aur uske baad bataya ki jab banda namaz mein khara hota hai to Allah ke zikr, usse dua aur uski ayton ki tilaawat ke maadhyam se usse baat kar raha hota hai. Atah use chahiye ki woh is sthaan ka dhyaan rakhte hue winaypoorn tareeqe se namaz parhe aur us pawitr Allah ki mahaanta ko dhyaan mein rakhe jisse woh waartaalaap kar raha hai, dil se uski or mutvajjeh rahe aur koi aisa kaary na kare, jo Allah ke saath beadbi thahre. Isliye woh qible ki or na thooke. Phir aapne bataya ki yadi namaz ki haalat mein thookne ki zaroorat par jaye, to insaan ko kya karna chahiye. Bataya ki woh apni bayen or ya bayen qadam ke neeche thooke ya phir kapre mein thooke aur uske use masal de.
Namaz parh rahe vyakti ko hamesha zehan mein rakhna chahiye ki woh Allah ke saamne khara hai aur Allah uski or mutvajjeh hai. Yeh aur baat hai ki pawitr evn uchch Allah aakaash mein apne arsh ke oopar hai, lekin usne har cheez ko apne ghere mein le rakha hai. Allah taaala ka farmaan hai : "Uske jaisi koi cheez nahin hai tatha woh sunne waala dekhne waala hai." (Soora ash-shoora : 11) Allah ke namaazi ke saamne hone ka matlab yeh nahin hai ki woh logon ke beech rahta hai ya phir us sthaan mein hai jahaan koi vyakti namaz parh raha hota hai. Allah in saari baaton se ooncha hai. Allah namaazi evn pukaarne waale se nikat to hota hai, lekin yeh nikatta uske prataap ke anuroop hai. Yeh nikatta ek srishti ki doosri srishti se nikatta jaisi nahin hai. Balki yeh prataapi evn mahaan Allah ki, srishti se nikatta hai. Allah ki srishti se iska udaahran dena ho to sooraj ka udaahran de sakte hain, jo insaan se oopar hone ke baavjood nikalte tatha doobte samay uske saamne hota hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10881: Apne is parde ko hamaare saamne se hata do. Kyonki, iske chitr baraabar meri namaz mein vyavdhaan daal rahe hain.

Anas (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ke paas ek parda tha, jisse unhonne apne ghar ke ek bhaag ko dhaanp rakha tha. Lekin, Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Apne is parde ko hamaare saamne se hata do. Kyonki, iske chitr baraabar meri namaz mein vyavdhaan daal rahe hain."

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ke paas ek patla ooni kapra tha, jo kai rangon waala aur naqshedaar tha. Usse woh apne kamre ka ek chhed band rakhti thi. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unko use hata dene ka aadesh diya aur iska kaaran yeh bataya ki uske chamkeele rang aur naqshe namaz ke samay aapki aankhon ke saamne aate rahte hain. Atah aapko is baat ka bhay hua ki kaheen woh namaz mein aapki ekaagrata ko bhang na kar de aur aapko namaz ke azkaar evn tilaawat mein poori tawajjo lagaane se wanchit aur uske uddeshyon jaise wineeti evn winamrata aadi se door na kar de.
10882: Meri yeh chaadar abu jahm ko de do aur abu jahm se uski anbjaani chaadar (bina dhaariyon waali moti chaadar) le aao. Kyonki isne abhi namaz se mera dhyaan bhatkaane ka kaam kiya hai.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne wibhinn rangon ki rekhaaon waali ek chaadar mein namaz parhi. Chunaanche, uski rekhaaon par ek nazar daali aur jab poori kar chuke, to farmaya : "Meri yeh chaadar abu jahm ko de do aur abu jahm se uski anbjaani chaadar (bina dhaariyon waali moti chaadar) le aao. Kyonki isne abhi namaz se mera dhyaan bhatkaane ka kaam kiya hai."
Ek aur riwayat mein hai "Main namaz ki awastha mein uski dhaariyon ko dekh raha tha. Atah, mujhe bhay hai ki kaheen yeh mujhe wichlit na kar de."

Abu jahm (radiyallahu anhu) ne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko ek rangeen aur naqshon waali chaadar bhent ki. Choonki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) uchch aachran ke maalik the aur uphaar dene waale ka dil rakhne ke liye uphaar sveekaar karte the, isliye use grahan kar liya aur use pahankar namaz parhne lage. Chaadar bharakdaar thi aur usmen naqshe bane hue the tatha baar-baar usse nazar atak rahi thi, isliye usne aapka dhyaan kheencha aur namaz mein samarpan se rok diya. Atah, aapne aadesh diya ki is naqshedaar chaadar ko abu jahm ko lauta diya jaye aur unse ek saada aur bina naqshe waali chaadar laya jaye, taaki unke dil ko tasalli ho jaye aur uphaar lautaane ke kaaran unke dil mein koi naaraazgi paida na ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10883: Kuchh logon ko kya ho gaya hai ki we namaz mein apni nazren aakaash ki or uthaate hain?" Aapne iske baare mein bari sakht baat karte hue yahaan tak farma diya : "We isse zaroor ruk jayen, warna unki aankhen uchak li jayengi.

Anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Kuchh logon ko kya ho gaya hai ki we namaz mein apni nazren aakaash ki or uthaate hain?" Aapne iske baare mein bari sakht baat karte hue yahaan tak farma diya : "We isse zaroor ruk jayen, warna unki aankhen uchak li jayengi."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne namaz mein dua ke samay ya kisi aur samay mein apni nazron ko aakaash ki or uthaane waalon ko sachet kiya hai aur bare sakht andaaz mein saavdhaan karte hue kaha hai ki aapko is baat ka dar lag raha hai ki unki nigaahon ko tezi ke saath  uchak liya jaye aur iska ehsaas unhen dekhne ki nemat chhin jaane ke baad hi ho.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke aahvaan evn saty ko bayaan karne ka sundar tareeqa. Aapne ullanghan karne waale ka naam nahin bataya, kyonki asal uddeshy saty ko bayaan karna hai, jo poora ho gaya. Waise bhi ullanghankaari ka naam na bataane se baat ke maanne ki sanbhaavna adhik rahti hai.
Namaz mein aakaash ki or nazar uthaane ki kari manaahi tatha aisa karne waale ke liye bari sakht chetaavni.
Aun al-maabood ke lekhak ne likha hai : Is manaahi ka kaaran yeh hai ki jab insaan aakaash ki or nazar uthaata hai, to qibla ki disha se nikal jaata hai, qibla se hat jaata hai aur qibla se aur namaz ki haalat se palat jaata hai.
Aakaash ki or dekhna namaz namaz mein dil ke saath haazri ke wiruddh hai.
Namaz ka mahatv. Tatha  namaz parh rahe vyakti par aniwaary hai ki namaz mein sarvashaktimaan Allah ke saath sanpoorn shishtaachaar ka paalan kare.
10884: Namaz mein jamhaai lena shaitaan ki or se hota hai. Atah yadi kisi ko jamhaai aye to use saamarthy bhar roke.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Namaz mein jamhaai lena shaitaan ki or se hota hai. Atah yadi kisi ko jamhaai aye to use saamarthy bhar roke."

Namaz mein jamhaai shaitaan ki or se hai. Kyonki jamhaai us samay aati hai, jab shareer bhaari, dheela-dhaala aur bhara hua ho, susti chhaai hui ho aur neend a rahi ho. Jabki shaitaan hi is baat ki prerna deta hai ki insaan aakaankshaaon ke peechhe para rahe aur khoob khaata-peeta rahe. Atah jab kisi ko namaz ki haalat mein jamhaai aye, to woh jahaan tak ho sake use rokne ka prayaas kare aur iske liye jahaan tak sanbhav ho apne daanton evn honthon ko band rakhe. Taaki shaitaan uski shakl bigaarne, uske munh ke andar prawesh karne aur uspar hansne jaise apne uddeshyon mein saphal na ho sake. Lekin yadi woh jamhaai ko rok na paye, to munh par haath rakh le.
10885: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne mahallon mein masjiden banaane tatha unhen pawitr evn svachchh aur sugandhit rakhne ka aadesh diya hai.
Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne mahallon mein masjiden banaane tatha unhen pawitr evn svachchh aur sugandhit rakhne ka aadesh diya hai."

10887: We aise log hain ki un logon ke andar jab koi sadaachaari banda athva sadaachaari vyakti mar jaata, to uski kabr ke oopar masjid bana lete

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai ki umm-e-salma radiyallahu anha ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas habsha (ithiyopiya) mein dekhe hue maariya naami ek girjaaghar aur uske chitron ka warnan kiya, to aapne kaha : "We aise log hain ki un logon ke andar jab koi sadaachaari banda athva sadaachaari vyakti mar jaata, to uski kabr ke oopar masjid bana lete aur usmen wo chitr bana dete. We Allah ke nikat sabse bure log hain."

Musalmaanon ki maata umm-e-salma radiyallahu anha ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se bataya ki jab woh habsha mein theen, to unhonne wahaan maariya naam ka ek girjaaghar dekha tha, jismen bahut-se chitr aur naqsh wa nigaar (sajaawat se alankrit) the. Daraasal unhen in baaton par aashchary ho raha tha. Atah Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne in chitron ko girjaaghron mein rakhe jaane ka kaaran bata diya. Aapne kaha : Tum jin logon ka warnan kar rahi ho, jab unke samaaj ka koi sadaachaari vyakti mar jaata, to uski kabr par masjid banaakar usmen namaz parhte aur uske andar unke chitr rakh lete. Aapne aage bataya ki is tarah ka kaam karne waala vyakti Allah ki nazar mein sabse buri srishti hai. Kyonki uske is kaam se shirk ke dvaar khulte hain.

Qabron par masjid banaana, unke paas namaz parhna ya masjid ke andar kisi ko dafan karna haraam hai. Kyonki isse shirk ke dvaar khulte hain.
Qabron par masjid banaana aur usmen chitr lagaana yahoodiyon aur eesaaiyon ka amal hai. Jisne ye kaam kiye, woh unhi ke padchihnon par chalne waala hai.
Praan waali cheezon ke chitr rakhna haraam hai.
Jisne qabr par masjid banaai aur usmen chitr lagaya, woh Allah ki sabse buri srishtiyon mein shaamil hai.
Shareeyat ne is baat ka poora prabandh kiya hai ki ekeshvarvaad ki suraksha sunishchit rahe aur iske liye shirk ki or le jaane waale sabhi raaston ko band kar diya hai.
Allah ke sadaachaari bandon ke baare mein atishyokti ki manaahi, kyonki isse shirk ke dvaar khulte hain.

10888: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne najd ki or kuchh sawaar bheje, jo banu haneefa ke ek aadmi ko pakar laye. Us aadmi ka naam sumaama bin usaal tha. Logon ne use masjid ke ek khanbe se baandh diya.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne najd ki or kuchh sawaar bheje, jo banu haneefa ke ek aadmi ko pakar laye. Us aadmi ka naam sumaama bin usaal tha. Logon ne use masjid ke ek khanbe se baandh diya. Phir Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) uske paas tashreeph laye aur poochha : “Ai sumaama! Tujhe kya lagta hai ki main tere saath kya bartaav karoonga? Usne uttar diya : Ai Muhammad! Mujhe to achchha hi lagta hai. Agar aap mera wadh karenge, to aise vyakti ka wadh karenge, jiske khoon ka badla liya jayega aur agar mujhpar upkaar karenge, to aise vyakti par upkaar kareng, jo aabhaar prakat karne waala hai aur agar aapko dhan chahiye, tomaangiye; jitna maangenge, diya jayega. Yeh sun aapne use chhor diya. Phir ag din poochha : “Ai sumaama! Tujhe kya lagta hai ki main tere saath kya bartaav karoonga?” usne kaha : Mujhe wahi lagta hai, jo main bata chuka hoon. Agar aap mera wadh karenge, to aise vyakti ka wadh karenge, jiske khoon ka badla liya jayega aur agar mujhpar upkaar karenge, to aise vyakti par upkaar karenge, jo aabhaar prakat karne waala hai aur agar aapko dhan chahiye, to maangiye; jitna maangenge, diya jayega. Aapne phir use rahne diya aur teesre din poochha : “Ai sumaama! Tujhe kya lagta hai?” usne uttar diya : Wahi jo main aapko pahle bata chuka hoon. Agar aap mera wadh karenge, to aise vyakti ka wadh karenge, jiske khoon ka badla liya jayega aur agar mujhpar upkaar karenge, to aise vyakti par upkaar karenge, jo aabhaar prakat karne waala hai aur agar aapko dhan chahiye, to maangiye; jitna maangenge, diya jayega. Yeh sun aapne kaha : “Sumaama ko chhor do.“ Chhootne ke baad woh masjid ke paas hi sthit ek khajoor ke baag ke andar gae, snaan kiya aur phir masjid mein prawesh karne ke baad bole : Main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke alaawa koi sachcha poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) Allah ke Rasool hain. Ai Muhammad! Allah ki qasam khaakar kahta hoon ki mere nikat is dharti par aapke chehre se apriy koi chehra nahin tha. Lekin, ab aapka chehra mere nikat sabse priy chehra ban chuka hai. Allah ki qasam! Mujhe aapke dharm se barhkar koi dharm bura maaloom na hota tha. Lekin, ab aapka dharm mere nikat sabse achchha dharm ban chuka hai. Allah ki qasam! Mere nazdeek aapke shahar se zyaada koi shahar bura na tha. Parantu, ab aapka shahar mere nazdeek sab shahron se zyaada pyaara hai. Aapke sawaaron ne mujhe us samay giraftaar kiya tha, jab main Umrah ki neeyat se ja raha tha. Ab aap kya farmaate hain? Rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen susmaachaar sunaya aur Umrah karne ka aadesh diya. Chunaanche jab woh makka aye, to kisi ne unse kaha : Kya tu adharmi ho gaya hai? Unhonne uttar diya : Nahin, balki main Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath musalmaan ho gaya hoon. Allah ki qasam! Tumhaare paas ab rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki anumti ke bina yamaama se gehoon ka ek daana bhi nahin ayega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10889: Main aapko Allah ki qasam dekar poochhta hoon, kya aapne rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue suna hai ki : "Ai hassaan! Meri or se uttar do! Ai Allah! Pawitr aatma (jibreel) ke dvaara tu iski sahayta kar.?" To unhonne uttar diya : Main Allah ko gawaah banaakar kahta hoon ki haan, aapne aisa kaha tha.

Abu huraira se warnit hai ki umar (radiyallahu anhu) hassaan (radiyallahu anhu) ke nikat se guzre, jo masjid mein sher parh rahe the, to umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne unhen ghoorkar dekha. Ispar unhonne kaha : Main masjid ke andar unki upasthiti mein bhi sher parhta tha, jo aapse uttam the. Phir abu huraira ki or palte aur kahaah main aapko Allah ki qasam dekar poochhta hoon, kya aapne rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue suna hai ki : "Ai hassaan! Meri or se uttar do! Ai Allah! Pawitr aatma (jibreel) ke dvaara tu iski sahayta kar.?" To unhonne uttar diya : Main Allah ko gawaah banaakar kahta hoon ki haan, aapne aisa kaha tha.
10890: Jo kisi vyakti ko masjid mein khoe hue saamaan ko khojne ka ailaan karte hue sune, to kahe : Allah usko tumhen waapas na lautaye. Kyonki masjiden iske liye nahin bani hain.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmaya : “Jo kisi vyakti ko masjid mein khoe hue saamaan ko khojne ka ailaan karte hue sune, to kahe : Allah usko tumhen waapas na lautaye. Kyonki masjiden iske liye nahin bani hain.”
10891: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : Jab kisi vyakti ko masjid mein kray-wikray karte hue dekho, to kaho : Allah tumhaare vyaapaar mein laabh na de. Aur jab kisi ko masjid mein khoe hue saamaan ko khojne ka ailaan karte dekho, to kaho : Allah use tumhen waapas na kare.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Jab kisi vyakti ko masjid mein kray-wikray karte hue dekho, to kaho : Allah tumhaare vyaapaar mein laabh na de. Aur jab kisi ko masjid mein khoe hue saamaan ko khojne ka ailaan karte dekho, to kaho : Allah use tumhen waapas na kare."
10892: Masjidon mein na to had laagu ki jayegi aur unke andar qisaas liya jayega.
Hakeem bin hizaam (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Masjidon mein na to had laagu ki jayegi aur unke andar qisaas liya jayega."
