10893: Khandaq ke din saad (radiyallahu anhu) jakhmi ho gae the. Unko quraish ki banu maees bin aamir bin luai shaakha ke hibbaan bin qais naami ek vyakti ne, jise hibbaan bin ariqa kaha jaata tha, unke baazu ki rag mein teer maar diya tha. Chunaanche Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unke liye masjid mein ek khem laga diya tha, taaki nikat se unki dekhbhaal kar saken.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se warnit hai ki khandaq ke din saad (radiyallahu anhu) jakhmi ho gae the. Unko quraish ki banu maees bin aamir bin luai shaakha ke hibbaan bin qais naami ek vyakti ne, jise hibbaan bin ariqa kaha jaata tha, unke baazu ki rag mein teer maar diya tha. Chunaanche Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unke liye masjid mein ek khema laga diya tha, taaki nikat se unki dekhbhaal kar saken. Phir jab Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) khandaq se lautkar aye, to hathiyaar utaar diye tatha snaan kar liya. Itne mein aapke paas jibreel (alaihissalaam) apne sar se dhool jhaarte hue aye aur bole : Aapne apne hathiyaar utaar diye, jabki Allah ki qasam mainne apne hathiyaar ab tak nahin utaare hain. Aap unki or niklen. Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne poochhaah kidhar? To unhonne banu quraiza ki or ishaara kiya. Chunaanche, rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) unke paas aye aur un logon ne aapki sharton ko maankar hathiyaar daal diya. Aapne unke sanbandh mein nirnay karne ka adhikaar saad ko diya, to unhonne kaha ki main unke wishay mein yeh nirnay deta hoon ki unke larne yogy purooshon ka wadh kar diya jaye, tatha mahilaaon evn bachchon ko qaid kar liya jaye aur unke dhan ko baant diya jaye. Hishaam kahte hain : Mere pita ne mujhe aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ke hawaale se bataya hai ki saad ne farmaya : Ai Allah, tu bhali-bhaanti jaanta hai ki mere sameep isse adhik priy aur koi baat nahin thi ki tere raaste mein main us qaum se laroon, jisne tere Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko jhuthlaya aur unko (apne watan se) nikaala. Ai Allah, mujhe ab aisa prateet hota hai ki hamaare tatha unke beech yuddh samaapt ho chuka hai. Kintu, quraish se yadi abhi kisi bhi prakaar ki koi laraai baaqi hai, to mujhe tu jeewit rakh, yahaan tak ki main tere raaste mein un logon se jihaad kar loon aur yadi toone laraai ka silsila samaapt kar diya hai, to mere ghaav ko hara kar de, taaki isi kaaran meri mrityu ho jaye. Chunaanche, unke seene ka ghaav phir se hara ho gaya (tatha rakt bahne laga). Masjid mein banu ghiphaar ka bhi khema laga tha. Jab rakt bahkar unki taraph pahooncha, to bole : Ai khema waalo, yeh kya hai jo tumhaari or se bahkar a raha hai? Dekha, to saad (radiyallahu anhu) ke ghaav se rakt bah raha tha aur iseemen unki mrityu ho gai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10894: "Jaane bhi do abu bakr! Ye eed ke din hain." Maaloom rahe ki we mina ke din the.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se riwayat hai ki mina ke dinon mein abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) unke paas aye. Us samay unke yahaan do larkiyaan daf baja rahi theen tatha Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apne shareer ko ek kapre se dhaanpkar lete hue the. Abu bakr ne un donon ko daanta, to aapne chehre se kapra hataya aur farmayaah "Jaane bhi do abu bakr! Ye eed ke din hain." Maaloom rahe ki we mina ke din the. Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) (ek aur ghatna ko yaad karte hue) kahti hain : Mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dekha ki aap mujhe chhupaye hue hain aur main habshiyon ki or dekh rahi thi, jo masjid mein khel rahe the. Umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne unhen daanta, to aapne kaha : "Jaane bhi do! Banu arphida! Tum nishchint hokar khelo."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10895: Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain : Woh mere paas aakar baaten kiya karti thi aur jab bhi mere paas aati, yeh sher zaroor parhti. Kamarband ka din Allah ki ajeeb qudarton mein se hai. Usne mujhe kufr ke desh se mukti pradaan ki.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se warnit hai, woh kahti hain ki arab ke kisi qabeele ke paas ek kaali-kalauti daasi thi, jise unhonne aazaad kar diya tha, magar woh unke saath hi rahti thi. Woh kahti hai ki ek baar us qabeele ki ek bachchi baahar nikli. Uspar laal tasmon ka ek kamarband tha, jise usne utaarkar rakh diya ya woh svayn gir gaya. Itne mein ek cheel udhar se guzri, to usne use maans ka tukra samajhkar jhapat liya. Woh kahti hai ki qabeele waalon ne kamarband talaash kiya, magar na mila, to unhonne mujhpar chori ka aarop laga diya aur meri talaashi lene lage. Yahaan tak ki unhonne meri sharmagaah ko bhi na chhora. Itne mein wahi cheel aai aur usne woh kamarband phenk diya, jo unke beech mein a gira. Woh kahti hai ki mainne kaha : Tum iski chori ka aarop mujhpar lagaate the. Haalaanki main usse bari thi. Yeh dekho kamarband saamne hai. Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki phir woh daasi Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aai aur musalmaan ho gai. Uska khema ya jhonpra masjid mein tha. Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain : Woh mere paas aakar baaten kiya karti thi aur jab bhi mere paas aati, yeh sher zaroor parhti. Kamarband ka din Allah ki ajeeb qudarton mein se hai. Usne mujhe kufr ke desh se mukti pradaan ki.
Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki mainne kaha : Kya baat hai, jab bhi tum mere paas baithti ho, yeh sher zaroor parhti ho? Tab usne mujhe yeh daastaan sunaai.
10896: Masjid mein thookna paap hai aur uska kaffaara yeh hai ki use dafan kar diya jaye.
Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Masjid mein thookna paap hai aur uska kaffaara yeh hai ki use dafan kar diya jaye."

Masjid ki zameen ya deewaaron mein thookna gunaah hai. Aisa karne waala Allah ke yahaan dand ka haqdaar hai. Atah kisi musalmaan ke liye kisi bhi awastha mein masjid mein thookna jayaz nahin hai. Kyonki yeh Allah ke gharon ka apmaan aur unko naapaak karna hai. Jabki unhen har tarah ki naapaaki aur malinta se surakshit rakhna zaroori hai. Kyonki yeh Allah ke prateekon ke sammaan ke dayre mein aata hai. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ka farmaan hai : "Aur jo Allah ke nirdhaarit kiye pratibandhon ka aadar kare, to yeh uske liye uske paalanhaar ke paas achchha hai." [soora al-hajj : 30] lekin yadi koi apne kapre ya roomaal aadi mein thooke, to koi harj nahin hai. Kyonki ismen Allah ke ghar ko ganda karne jaisi koi baat nahin hai. Lekin yadi koi galti se masjid mein thook de, to yeh gunaah to hai, lekin uska gunaah maaf ho jayega. Yahaan ek baat yaad rahe ki is hadees ka arth yeh nahin hai ki koi jaan-boojhkar masjid mein thooke aur uske baad use dafan kar de. Kyonki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne masjid mein thookne hi ko gunaah kaha hai. Iski pushti saheeh bukhaari (hadees sankhya : 414) tatha saheeh Muslim (hadees sankhya :548) ki is hadees se hoti hai : "Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne masjid ki deewaar mein balgham laga hua dekha, to aapko bura laga. Atah uthe aur use apne haath se saaf kar diya." Jo vyakti bina iraade ke masjid mein thook de aur phir chaahe ki uska yeh gunaah maaf ho jaye, to awilanb use saaf kar de. Uski soorat yeh hai ki yadi masjid ki zameen kankar ki hai to use dafan kar de aur agar farsh bani hui hai to use khurach kar saaf kar de. Lekin yadi aisa karne ke bajay use chhor deta hai, to woh jab tak baaqi rehgi, uska gunaah use hota rahega. Abu zar -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Mere saamne meri ummat ke karm laye gae. Achchhe bhi aur bure bhi. Mainne uske achchhe karmon mein jo baaten paaeen, unmen uske dvaara raaste se hataai gai kashtadayak wastu bhi shaamil thi, jabki uske bure karmon mein jo baaten paaeen, unmen woh balgam bhi shaamil tha, jo masjid mein ho aur use dafan na kiya gaya ho." Ise imaam Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.
10897: Qayaamat us samay tak nahin ayegi, jab tak ki log masjidon ke baare mein garv na karne lagen.
Anas (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Qayaamat us samay tak nahin ayegi, jab tak ki log masjidon ke baare mein garv na karne lagen."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10898: Mujhe oonchi-oonchi masjiden nirmaan karne ka aadesh nahin diya gaya hai.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Mujhe oonchi-oonchi masjiden nirmaan karne ka aadesh nahin diya gaya hai." Abdullah bin abbaas kahte hain : Tum masjidon ko zaroor usi tarah sajaaoge, jaise yahoodiyon tatha eesaaiyon ne sajaya tha.

Yahaan "تشييد المساجد" Se muraad oonchi-oonchi masjiden banaana aur unhen sajaane-sanwaarne mein atishyokti karna hai. Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- ke kathnaanusaar masjidon ko sajaana-sanwaarna yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon ka kaam hai.
Rahi baat masjidon ko sajaye bina unhen mazboot banaane ki, to yadi abhimaan, dikhaawa aur shohrat ke liye na ho, to makrooh nahin hai. Kyonki usmaan bin affaan -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hadees mein hai : "Jisne Allah ke liye masjid banaai, Allah uske liye Jannat mein usi prakaar ka ghar banayega." Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki masjid kachchi eenton ki thi, uski chhat khajoor ki shaakhaaon ki bani hui thi aur uske khanbhe khajoor ke tanon ke the. Usmen abu bakr -razyallahu anhu- ne koi wriddhi nahin ki. Lekin jab umar bin khattaab -radiyallahu anhu- ke zamaane mein uski lakriyaan kamzor ho gaeen, to use uske pahle sthaan par dobaara banva diya aur lage haathon kuchh wriddhi bhi kar di. Phir usmaan bin affaan -radiyallahu anhu- ne apne zamaane mein usmen bahut zyaada wriddhi ki. Deewaaren patthar evn choone ki banva deen, khanbhe pattharon ke banva diye aur chhat saagvaan ki lakri ki banva di. Is tarah dekha jaye, to unhonne masjid ke nirmaan mein aisi cheezon ka istemaal kiya, jinse mazbooti aye aur sajaawat na ho. Jahaan tak khude hue pattharon ke prayog ki baat hai, to unhen unke aadesh se khuda nahin gaya tha, balki unhen khuda hua hi praapt kiya gaya tha aur jin sahaaba ne unka khandan kiya tha, unke paas unka prayog na karne ka ekmaatr pramaan yeh tha ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aur umar -radiyallahu anhu- ka anusran karte hue masjid ke nirmaan mein fajoolkharchi se kaam na liya jaye. Jabki yeh masjid ko mazboot banaane ki manaahi ya makrooh hone ka pramaan nahin ho sakta.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10901: Achchhe dhang se namaz na parhne waale ki hadees, rifaaa (radiyallahu anhu) ke warnan anusaar.

Rifaaa bin raaphe zurqi (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, jo Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saathiyon mein se the, woh kahte hain : Rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) masjid mein baithe hue the ki ek vyakti aya aur usne aapke nikat hi namaz parhi. Namaz poori karne ke baad woh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya aur salaam kiya, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Tum apni namaz ko lautaao, kyonki tumne namaz hi nahin parhi hai." Warnankarta kahte hain ki woh waapas gaya aur phir usi tarah namaz parhi, jaise pahle parhi thi. Phir Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya, to aapne phir kaha : "Tum apni namaz ko lautaao, kyonki tumne namaz hi nahin parhi hai." Yeh sun usne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, mujhe sikha deejiye ki main kaise namaz parhoon? Aapne farmaya : "Jab qibla ki or munh karo, to Allahu akbar kaho, phir soora faatiha parho, phir Qur'an ka jo bhaag chaaho parho, phir jab ruku karo to apni hatheliyon ko apne ghutnon par rakho tatha apni peeth ko phaila do aur achchhe dhang se ruku karo, phir jab ruku se sir uthaao to apni peeth seedhi kar lo, yahaan tak ki sabhi haddiyaan apne joron par laut jayen, phir jab sajda karo to khoob achchhe dhang se sajda karo, phir jab sir uthaao to apni baaeen raan par baith jaao. Phir har ruku aur sajda mein aisa hi karo."
Tatha ek riwayat mein hai : "Tummen se kisi ki namaz us samay tak poori nahin hoti, jab tak woh usi prakaar se achchhi tarah wajoo़ na kare, jis prakaar sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne aadesh diya hai. Atah, woh apne chehre ko aur haathon ko kohni tak dhoe, sir ka masah kare tatha paanv ko takhnon tak dhoe, phir sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ki baraai evn prashansa bayaan kare, phir Qur'an mein se jitna parhne ka aadesh diya gaya hai tatha jo uske liye saral ho woh parhe, phir Allahu akbar kahkar sajda kare tatha khoob achchhe dhang se apne chehre ko (tatha kabhi farmaya ki apni peshaani ko) zameen par tikaye, yahaan tak ki sabhi jor wishraam mudra mein chale jayen evn dheele ho jayen, phir takbeer (Allahu akbar) kahkar apne nitanb par seedha hokar baith jaye aur peeth ko seedha rakhe." Phir isi tarah ant tak chaaron rakaaton ka haal bayaan kiya. "Tummen se kisi ki namaz us samay tak poori nahin hogi, jab tak ki woh isi prakaar na parhe."
Tatha ek riwayat mein haih "Usi prakaar wazu karo, jis prakaar sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne aadesh diya hai, phir wazu ki dua parho, phir iqaamat kaho aur phir Allahu akbar kaho. Phir yadi Qur'an yaad ho, to use parho, anyatha al-hamdul lillah, Allahu akbar aur la ilaaha illallah kaho."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10905: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab raat mein uthte, to takbeer (Allahu akbar) kahte, phir yeh dua parhte : "سبحانك اللهم وبحمدك وتبارك اسمك، وتعالى جدك، ولا إله غيرك" (Ai Allah, tu pawitr hai apni prashansa samet, tera naam bari barkat waala hai, teri shaan bari buland hai aur tere siwa koi sachcha poojy nahin.)

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab raat mein uthte, to takbeer (Allahu akbar) kahte, phir yeh dua parhte : "سبحانك اللهم وبحمدك وتبارك اسمك، وتعالى جدك، ولا إله غيرك" (Ai Allah, tu pawitr hai apni prashansa samet, tera naam bari barkat waala hai, teri shaan bari buland hai aur tere siwa koi sachcha poojy nahin.) aisa teen baar kahte. Phir teen baar «لا إله إلا الله» (tere siwa koi poojy nahin.) kahte. Phir teen baar «الله أكبر كبيرا» (Allah sabse bara aur bahut bara hai.) kahte. Phir yeh dua parhte : «أعُوذُ بالله السَّميع العليم من الشَّيطان الرَّجيم من هَمْزِه، ونَفْخِه، ونَفْثِه» (ai Allah, main dhutkaare hue shaitaan se teri sharan chaahta hoon uske junoon se, uske ahankaar par ubhaarne se aur uske jaadu se.) phir Qur'an parhte.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10906: Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam namaz takbeer se aur Qur'an paath "Al-hamdu lillahi rabbil aalmeen

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam namaz takbeer se aur Qur'an paath "Al-hamdu lillahi rabbil aalmeen" Se aaranbh karte the. Jab aap rukooa karte, to apne sar ko na uthaye rakhte aur na bahut jhuka dete, balki in donon ke beech rakhte. Jab ruku se sar uthaate, to us samay tak sajda nahin karte, jab tak seedhe khare na ho jaate. Jab sajde se sar uthaate, to doosra sajda us samay tak nahin karte, jab tak theek se baith nahin jaate. Har do rakaat par "At-tahiyyaat" Parhte aur jab baithte, to apne bayen pair ko bichha dete aur dayen pair ko khara rakhte tatha shaitaan ki tarah baithne se mana farmaate. Aap is baat se bhi mana karte the ki aadmi apne donon baazuon ko darinde ki tarah bichha de. Aap namaz ka ant salaam se karte the.

Ummul momineen aaisha radiyallahu anha ne Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki namaz ke baare mein bataya ki aap apni namaz ka aaranbh takbeer-e-ehraam se karte aur kahte : "Allahu akbar" Aur qiraat ka aaranbh soora faatiha se karte aur kahte : "Al-hamdu lillahi rabbil aalmeen" (Saari prashansa Allah hi ke liye hai, jo saare sansaaron ka paalanhaar hai....) aur jab qiyaam ke baad ruku karte, to ruku ke dauraan apna sar na ooncha rakhte aur na bahut zyaada jhuka dete, balki bilkul seedha aur baraabar rakhte the. Aur jab ruku se apna sar uthaate, to sajda karne se pahle seedhe khare ho jaate, aur jab pahle sajde se sar uthaate, to tab tak doosra sajda nahin karte jab tak ki sthir hokar baith na jaate. Har do rakaat ke baad tashahhud ke liye baithte aur parhte : «attahiyyaatu lillahi wassalvaatu wattayyibaat...», tatha jab donon sajdon ke darmiyaan ya tashahhud ke liye baithte, to apne bayen pair ko bichhaakar uspar baithte aur dayen pair ko khara rakhte. Aap namaazi ko apni namaz mein shaitaan ki tarah baithne se mana karte the. Shaitaan ki tarah baithna is prakaar hai ki aadmi apne donon pairon ko zameen par bichha de aur apni eriyon par baithe, ya apne nitanbon ko zameen se chipka le aur apni pindliyon ko khara rakhe tatha apne haathon ko zameen par rakhe jaise kutta baithta hai, ya yeh ki namaazi sajde mein apni bhujaaon ko darindon ki tarah zameen par bichha de. Aap ek baar dayeen or aur doosri baar bayeen or «السلام عليكم ورحمة الله» kahkar apni namaz ka samaapan karte the.

Nabi alaihissalaatu wassalaam ki namaz ke tareeqe ka kuchh bayaan.
Takbeer-e-tahreema ka waajib hona, jo har us kathan aur karm ko haraam kar deti hai jo namaz ke kathnon aur kaaryon ke wipreet hon. Ek baat yaad rahe ki ki is wishisht shabd ke alaawa koi aur shabd namaz mein daakhil hone ke liye uska sthaan nahin le sakta.
Soora faatiha parhne ka waajib hona.
Ruku ka aniwaary hona. Uttam yeh hai ki ismen peeth bilkul seedhi rahe. Na oonchi aur na neechi.
Ruku se uthna, aur uske baad seedhe khara hona (e‘tidaal) waajib hai.
Sajda karna, usse sar uthaana, aur uske baad santulit ho kar seedhe baithna aniwaary hai.
Namaz mein baithne ki awastha mein bayen pair ko bichhaakar uspar baithna evn dayen pair ko khara rakhna shareeyat sammat hai, jabki maghrib evn isha jaisi do tashahhud waali namaazon ke antim tashahhud mein tawarruk karna shareeyat sammat hai. Is sanbandh mein any hadeesen warnit hain.
Shaitaan ke baithne ke tareeqe ki samroopta apnaane ki manaahi, jismen eriyon par baithkar pairon ko zameen par bichhaya jaata hai, ya unhen khara karke unke beech zameen par baitha jaata hai.
Darindon ki tarah baazuon ko zameen par phailaane se mana kiya gaya hai, kyonki yeh susti aur kamzori ki nishaani hai.
Shaitaan aur jaanavron ke kaaryon mein unki samroopta apnaane ki manaahi.
Salaam pherkar namaz samaapt karna aniwaary hai, jo namaaziyon tatha upasthit evn anupasthit sadaachaari bandon ke liye samast buraaiyon aur kamiyon se suraksha ki ek dua hai.
Namaz mein itmeenaan ki aniwaaryata.
10908: Rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab takbeer (Allahu akbar) kahte, to apne donon haathon ko kaanon ke baraabar uthaate aur jab ruku karte, to apne donon haathon ko kaanon tak uthaate.

Maalik bin huwairis (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) jab takbeer (Allahu akbar) kahte, to apne donon haathon ko kaanon ke baraabar uthaate aur jab ruku karte, to apne donon haathon ko kaanon tak uthaate. Aur jab ruku se sir uthaate, to kahte : «سَمع الله لِمَن حَمِده» (Allah ne uski sun li, jisne uski prashansa ki) aur usi prakaar karte.
10910: “Sanbhavtah tum log apne imaam ke peechhe parhte ho"? Hamne kaha : Haan, ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapne farmaya : "Aisa na karo. Haan, magar soora faatiha parh liya karo; kyonki jo use nahin parhta, uski namaz hi nahin hoti.”

Ubaada bin saamit (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki ham log Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke peechhe fajr ki namaz parh rahe the. Aapne tilaawat ki, to aapko tilaat karne mein bojhilpan ka ehsaas hua. Atah, jab namaz poori kar chuke, to farmaya : “Sanbhavtah tum log apne imaam ke peechhe parhte ho"? Hamne kaha : Haan, ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapne farmaya : "Aisa na karo. Haan, magar soora faatiha parh liya karo; kyonki jo use nahin parhta, uski namaz hi nahin hoti.”

Ubaada bin saamit -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai, woh kahte hain : "Ham log Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke peechhe fajr ki namaz parh rahe the. Aapne tilaawat ki, to aapko tilaawat karne mein bojhalpan ka ehsaas hua." Yaani tilaawat karne mein kathinaai mahsoos hui. "Atah, jab namaz poori kar chuke, to farmaya : “Sanbhavtah tum log apne imaam ke peechhe parhte ho?" "Sahaaba ne uttar diya : Haan, ai Allah ke Rasool!" Aisa prateet hota hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko Qur'an parhne mein kathinaai mahsoos hui, lekin pata na chal saka ki kaaran kya hai. Atah sahaaba se poochh daala. Iski pushti ek any riwayat mein aye hue aapke in shabdon se hoti hai : "Baat kya hai ki mujhe Qur'an parhne ke maamle kheench-taan ka saamna ho raha hai?" Is baat ki bhi sanbhaavna hai ki bojhalpan ka kaaran peechhe namaz parh rahe logon ka aapki tilaawat par bas na karna hai. Kyonki kabhi-kabhi peechhe ke logon ki truti ke kaaran bhi sanpoornata prabhaawit hoti hai.
Sunnat yeh hai ki imaam ke peechhe namaz parh rahe log is tarah dheere-dheere parhen ki har vyakti kewal apne aapko sunaye. Namaz mein soora faatiha parhna akele namaz parhne waale, imaam aur muqatdi har ek ke liye zaroori hai. Oonchi aawaaz se tilaawat waali namaazon mein bhi aur dheemi aawaaz se tilaawat waali namaazon mein bhi. Kyonki iske sahi evn wishisht pramaan maujood hain.
Phir Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne sahaaba ko soora faatiha parhne ka wishesh dhyaan rakhne ka aadesh dete hue farmaya : "Aisa na karo. Haan, magar soora faatiha parh liya karo; kyonki jo use nahin parhta, uski namaz hi nahin hoti." Aise mein ek sanbhaavna to yeh hai ki yahaan manaahi zor-zor se parhne ki hai. Jabki doosri sanbhaavna yeh hai ki manaahi faatiha ke baad kuchh aur parhne ki hai. Yeh aadesh isliye diya gaya hai ki imaam evn any namaaziyon ko tilaawat mein kathinaai na ho.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10911: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) tatha abu bakr evn umar (radiyallahu anhuma) namaz ka aaranbh "Al-hamdu lillahi rabbil aalmeen" Se karte the.

Anas (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) tatha abu bakr evn umar (radiyallahu anhuma) namaz ka aaranbh "Al-hamdu lillahi rabbil aalmeen" Se karte the.
Muslim mein yeh izaafa hai : We na qiraat ke aaranbh mein "Bismillahir rahmaanir raheem" Parhte the, na baad mein.
Tatha ahmad, nasaai evn ibn-e-khuzaima ki ek riwayat mein is prakaar hai : We "Bismillahir rahmaanir raheem" Zor se nahin parhte the.
Tatha ibn-e-khuzaima ki ek aur riwayat mein hai : We use dheere se parhte the.
[ise ibne khuzaima ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10915: Jahaan tak is aadmi ki baat hai, to isne apna haath bhalaai se bhar liya hai.

Abdullah bin abu aufa (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki ek vyakti Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya aur kahne laga : Main Qur'an se kuchh bhi yaad karne mein saksham nahin hoon. Atah, mujhe aisi cheez sikha deejiye, jo mere liye kaafi ho. Aapne farmaya : "Kaho : Subhaanallahi, wal-hamdu lillahi, wa la ilaaha illallahu, wallahu akbar, wa la haula wa la qoovvata illa billahil aleeyyil azeem. (Allah paak hai, samast prakaar ki prashansa usi ke liye hai, Allah ke siwa koi poojy nahin hai, Allah sabse bara hai, Allah ki taupheeq ke bina na to koi bhalaai karne ki taaqat hai na kisi buraai se bachne ka saamarthy, jo uchch tatha mahaan hai.)" Us vyakti ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, yeh to uchch evn mahaan Allah ke liye hai, mere liye kyo hai? Aapne farmaya : "Kaho : Allahummarhamni warzuqni wa aafini wahdini. (Ai Allah, tu mere oopar raham kar, mujhe rozi de, mujhe rogmukt kar aur mujhe saty ka maarg dikha.)" Jab woh khara hua, to usne apne haath se aise ishaara kiya. Yeh dekh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne faramya : "Jahaan tak is aadmi ki baat hai, to isne apna haath bhalaai se bhar liya hai."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10916: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) zuhar ki pahli do rakaaton mein soora faatiha aur do soorten parhte the aur baad ki do rakaaton mein sirf soora faatiha parhte the aur kabhi kabhi koi ayat hamen suna bhi dete the.

Abu qataada (radiyallahu anhu) riwayat karte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) zuhar ki pahli do rakaaton mein soora faatiha aur do soorten parhte the aur baad ki do rakaaton mein sirf soora faatiha parhte the aur kabhi kabhi koi ayat hamen suna bhi dete the tatha aap pahli rakaat ko doosri rakaat se lanba karte the. Aisa hi asr mein karte the aur aisa hi subah mein karte the.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10917: Ham log zuhar aur asr mein Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke qayaam (khare hone) ka anumaan lagaate the. Hamne anumaan lagaya ki aap zuhar ki pahli do rakaaton mein {الم تنزيل السجدة} (aliph laam meem tanzeen as-sajda) ke baraabar khare hote the, tatha hamne andaaza lagaya ki uski baad ki do rakaaton mein uske aadha khare hote the.

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki ham log zuhar aur asr mein Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke qayaam (khare hone) ka anumaan lagaate the. Hamne anumaan lagaya ki aap zuhar ki pahli do rakaaton mein {الم تنزيل السجدة} (aliph laam meem tanzeel as-sajda) ke baraabar khare hote the, tatha hamne andaaza lagaya ki uski baad ki do rakaaton mein uske aadha khare hote the. Aur hamne andaaza lagaya ki aap asr ki pahli do rakaaton mein zuhar ki antim do rakaaton ke samaan khare hot the aur baad ki do rakaaton mein uski pahli do rakaaton ke aadha khara hote the. Abu bakr ne apni riwayat mein {الم تنزيل} (aliph laam tanzeel) ka ullekh nahin kiya hai, balki kaha hai : Tees (30) ayton ke baraabar.
10918: Mainne amuk vyakti ke mukaable mein kisi ke bhi peechhe Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se adhik milti-julti namaz nahin parhi. Chunaanche hamne us vyakti ke peechhe namaz parhi aur paya ki woh zuhar ki pratham do rakaaton ko lanba karte the tatha antim do rakaaton ko halka karte the.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne amuk vyakti ke mukaable mein kisi ke bhi peechhe Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se adhik milti-julti namaz nahin parhi. Chunaanche hamne us vyakti ke peechhe namaz parhi aur paya ki woh zuhar ki pratham do rakaaton ko lanba karte the tatha antim do rakaaton ko halka karte the, tatha asr ki namaz halki parhte the, aur maghrib mein 'qisaar-e-mufassal' (soora al-hujuraat se lekar soora an-naas tak ki soorten) aur isha mein (والشمس وضحاها) aur uski jaisi soorten parha karte the, evn subah ki namaz ki donon rakaaton mein lanbi soorten parha karte the.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10919: Mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko maghrib ki namaz mein soora at-toor parhte suna. Jab aap is ayat par pahunche : (أم خُلِقُوا من غير شيء أم هم الخالقون، أم خَلَقُوا السموات والأرض بل لا يوقنون، أم عندهم خزائن ربك أم هم المسيطرون) (kya we bina kisi ke paida kiye hi paida ho gae hain ya we svayn paida karne waale hain? Ya unhonne hi utpatti ki hai aakaashon tatha dharti ki? Waastav mein we wishvaas hi nahin rakhte. Ya unke paas aapke paalanhaar ke koshaagaar hain ya wahi uske adhikaari hain?) to aisa lag raha tha ki mera dil ur jayega.

Jubair bin mutaim (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko maghrib ki namaz mein soora at-toor parhte suna. Jab aap is ayat par pahunche : (أم خُلِقُوا من غير شيء أم هم الخالقون، أم خَلَقُوا السموات والأرض بل لا يوقنون، أم عندهم خزائن ربك أم هم المسيطرون) (kya we bina kisi ke paida kiye hi paida ho gae hain ya we svayn paida karne waale hain? Ya unhonne hi utpatti ki hai aakaashon tatha dharti ki? Waastav mein we wishvaas hi nahin rakhte. Ya unke paas aapke paalanhaar ke koshaagaar hain ya wahi uske adhikaari hain?) to aisa lag raha tha ki mera dil ur jayega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10922: Ai logon, naboowat ke shubh sandeshon mein se ab kewal achchhe svapn hi rah gae hain, jis ko Muslim dekhta hai, ya us ke liye dekha jaata hai, sachet raho mujhe ruku tatha sajda mein Qur'an parhne se mana kiya gaya hai.

Ibne abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne parda hataya to dekha ki log abu bakar ke peechhe pankti mein khare hain, to aap ne pharmayaah( ai logon, naboowat ke shubh sandeshon mein se ab kewal achchhe svapn hi rah gae hain, jis ko Muslim dekhta hai, ya us ke liye dekha jaata hai, sachet raho! Mujhe ruku tatha sajda mein Qur'an parhne se mana kiya gaya hai. Jahaan tak rooku ki baat hai to us mein apne rab ki mahaanta ka bakhaan karo, rahi baat sajde ki to us make saath dua karo, kyonki us samay ki gai dua ke sveekaar hone ki prabal sanbhaavna rahti hai.
10924: Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki namaz, aur aap ka ruku, tatha jab aap ruku se sir uthaate (us ke baad ka samay), aur aap ka sajde tatha do sajdon ke madhy baithne ka samay, sabhi lag-bhag baraabar hote.

Hakam se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki koopha par ibne ashaas ke samay mein ek vyakti ka prabhutv ho gaya tha -jis ka naam unhonne bataya tha-, to ibne ashaas ne abu ubaida bin abdullah ko logon ko namaz parhaane ka aadesh diya, atah woh logon ko namaz parhaya karte the, jab woh ruku se sir uthaate to utne samay tak khare rahte jitne samay mein main (اللَّهُم ربَّنا لك الحَمد، مِلْءَ السَّماوات ومِلْءَ الأرض، ومِلْءَ ما شِئت من شَيء بعد، أهْل الثَّناء والمَجد، لا مانع لما أعْطَيت، ولا مُعْطِي لما مَنعت، ولا يَنفع ذَا الجَدِّ مِنْك الجَدِّ) ai Allah, tere liye aakaash bhar aur prithvi bhar tatha us ke siwa bhi jo tu chaahe utni, samast prakaar ki prashansa hai, tu prashansa tatha mahaanta ke yogy hai, jis ko tu de de use koi rokne waala nahin, aur jis se tu rok de use koi dene waala nahin, tere yahaan kisi ka waibhav kuchh bhi kaam nahin ayega. Hakam kahte hainh mainne iska ullekh abdurrahmaan bin abu laila se kiya, to unhonne kaha kih mainne bara bin aazib- radiyallahu anhu- ko pharmaate hue suna haih Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki namaz, aur aap ka ruku, tatha jab aap ruku se sir uthaate (us ke baad ka samay), aur aap ke sajde tatha do sajdon ke madhy baithne ka samay, sabhi lag-bhag baraabar hote. Shoaba kahte hain ki mainne is ka ullekh amr bin mu्rra se kiya to unhonne pharmayaah mainne ibne abu laila ko dekha hai, un ki namaz is prakaar ki nahin thi.
10925: Mujhe ‏shareer ke saat angon par sajda karne ka hukm diya gaya hai

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Mujhe ‏shareer ke saat angon par sajda karne ka hukm diya gaya hai: Peshaani par aur aapne apne haath se apni naak ki or ishaara kiya, donon haathon aur donon ghutnon tatha donon paawon ki ungliyon par aur yeh bhi hukm diya gaya ki ham kapron aur baalon ko na sameten."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki Allah ne aapko namaz parhte samay shareer ke saat angon par sajda karne ka aadesh diya hai. Shareer ke ye saat ang is prakaar hain :

1- peshaani. Naak evn donon aankhon ke oopar chehre ka bina baalon waala bhaag. Aapne chehre ka naam lete samay haath se naak ki or ishaara karke bataya naak evn chehra ek hi ang hain aur sajda karne waale ko apni naak ko zameen par rakhna chahiye.

2- 3- donon haath.

4- 5- donon ghutne.

6- 7- donon pairon ki ungliyaan.

Saath hi hamen is baat ka aadesh diya ki ham sajde ke samay apne baalon evn kapron ki suraksha ke liye unko na sameten. Balki unko zameen par girne den, taaki shareer ke angon ke saath unka bhi sajda ho jaye.

Namaz mein saat angon par sajda karna waajib hai.
Namaz ki awastha mein kapra tatha baal sametne ki manaahi.
Shaanti evn thahraav ke saath namaz parhna waajib hai. Sajde mein shaanti ki soorat yeh hogi ki sajde ke saaton angon ko zameen par rakh diya jaye aur thahraav ke saath usmen jo zikr parhna hota hai, use parha jaye.
Baalon ko sametne ki manaahi purushon ke saath khaas hai. Striyaan iske andar nahin aateen. Kyonki aurat ko parde ka khyaal rakhne ka aadesh hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
10927: Jab tum sajda karo, to apni hatheliyon ko zameen par rakh diya karo aur apni kohniyon ko oopar uthaye rakho.

Bara bin aazib radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jab tum sajda karo, to apni hatheliyon ko zameen par rakh diya karo aur apni kohniyon ko oopar uthaye rakho."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki namaz ke dauraan sajde ki haalat mein donon haathon ko kis tarah rakhna chahiye. Bataya ki donon hatheliyon ko zameen par achchhe se rakh diya jaye, ungliyaan aapas mein mili hui aur qibla ki or hon, donon kohniyaan zameen se alag uthi hui aur pahluon se hati hui hon.

(Sajde ki haalat mein) namaaji ko donon hatheliyon ko zameen par rakhna waajib hai. Daraasal donon hatheliyaan sajde ke saat angon mein se do ang hain.
Zameen se donon baazuon ko uthaye rakhna musathab aur unhen darindon ki tarah failaana makrooh hai.
Ibaadat mein phurteelaapan, shakti aur chaahat jhalakni chahiye.
Jab namaazi sajde ke saare angon ko zameen par rakh deta hai, to har ang ibaadat mein se apna hissa pa leta hai.
10929: Mainne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko aalti-paalti maar kar baithe hone ki dasha mein namaz parhte hue dekha.
Aysha- radiyallahu anha- kahti hain kih mainne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko aalti-paalti maar kar baithe hone ki dasha mein namaz parhte hue dekha.

Is hadees mein aye hue shabd "التربُّع" (Paalthi maarkar baithna) yeh hai insaan apne dayen qadam ke androoni bhaag ko bayen raan ke neeche aur bayen qadam ke androoni bhaag ko dayen raan ke neeche rakh de aur nitanb par baith jaye. Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is tarah baithkar namaz us samay parhi thi, jab ghore se gir gae the aur aapke qadam ka jor alag ho gaya tha.
Agar namaazi farz namaz mein khare hokar namaz parhne ki shakti na rakhta ho, to paalthi maarkar baithkar namaz parhega. Aisa musathab hai. Lekin is tarah kewal qayaam ke badle mein baithega. Rahi baat do sajdon ke beech mein tatha donon tashahhud ke beech mein baithne ki, to pahle tashahhud mein bayen qadam ko bichhaakar aur doosre tashahhud mein bayen paanv ko daaeen or nikaalkar apne nitanb ko dharti par rakhkar baithega.
Lekin in tareeqon se baithna kewal musathab evn uttam hai. Agar ukt tareekon ko chhor any tareekon se baithta hai, to namaz ho jayegi. Kyonki asal waanchhit wastu baithna hai aur baithne ke ye tareeqe aniwaaryata ke dayre se baahar ki cheezen hain.
10930: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam do sajdon ke beech mein yeh dua parhte the : "Ai Allah! Tu mujhe maaph kar de, mere oopar raham kar, mujhe aaphiyat (svaasthy ityaadi) de tatha mujhe rozi pradaan kar.

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam do sajdon ke beech mein yeh dua parhte the : "Ai Allah! Tu mujhe maaph kar de, mere oopar raham kar, mujhe aaphiyat (svaasthy ityaadi) de tatha mujhe rozi pradaan kar."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam namaz mein yeh paanch cheezen maanga karte the, jinki ek musalmaan ko bari zaroorat hoti hai aur jinke andar duniya evn aakhirat donon ki bhalaaiyaan simat aai hain. Aap Allah se gunaahon par parda daalne aur unhen maaf karne, apne oopar rahmat ki warsha barsaane tatha sandehon, ghalat aakaankshaaon evn beemaariyon se surakshit rakhne, saty ke maarg par chalaane aur uspar drirhta se qayam rakhne aur jnaan, achchha karm karne ka suyog evn halaal evn saaf-suthra dhan pradaan karne ki dua karte the.

Do sajdon ke beech ke baithak mein yeh dua parhni chahiye.
In duaaon ki fazeelat, jinmen duniya evn aakhirat ki bhalaaiyaan maujood hain.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
10931: Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab namaz ki ekal rakaaton mein hote to us waqt tak khare na hote jab tak seedhe baith na jaate.

Maalik bin huwairis laisi- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, unhonne Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko namaz parhte hue dekha . Aap jab namaz ki ekal rakaaton mein hote to us waqt tak khare na hote jab tak seedhe baith na jaate.
10932: Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek maas tak ruku ke baad qunoot (naazila) parha, (is mein) aap banu sulaim ke kuchh qabeelon- par baddua karte the.

Aasim se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne anas- radiyallahu anhu- se qunoot ke wishay mein poochha, to unhonne kaha kih yeh ruku ke poorv hai, to mainne kaha ki amook vyakti ka kathan hai ki aap kahte hain ki (qunoot) ruku ke pashchaat hai, to unhon ne kahaah usne jhooth kaha, phir unhonne ham se Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki hadees ka warnan kiya kih Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek maas tak ruku ke baad qunoot (naazila) parha, (is mein) aap banu sulaim ke kuchh qabeelon par baddua karte the. Aap ne sattar athva chaalees- un ko sanshay tha- ququraaan ke parhne waalon tatha dharm ke jnaata logon ko mushrikon ke kuchh logon ki or bheja tha, to yeh log unke aare aye tatha unko maar daala, jabki aap- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- tatha un logon ke beech samjhauta tha, mainne aap ko itna shokaakul kisi par bhi nahin dekha jitna aap ko in logon ke maare jaane par dekha.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10935: He mere pita, aap ne rasoolullah- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam, tatha abu bakar, umar, usmaan evn yahaan koopha mein ali- radiyallahu anhum- ke peechhe namaz parhi hai, kya wo log phajr mein (dua -e-) qunoot parhte the? Unhonne uttar dete hue kaha kih yeh bidaat hai.

Abu maalik ashjai saad bin taarik- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain kih mainne apne pita se kahaah he mere pita, aap ne rasoolullah- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- tatha abu bakar, umar, usmaan evn yahaan koopha mein ali- radiyallahu anhum- ke peechhe namaz parhi hai, kya we log phajr mein (dua -e-) qunoot parhte the? Unhonne uttar dete hue kaha kih yeh bidaat hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10938: Jab tum mein ka koi sajda kare to us prakaar se na baithe jaise oont baithta hai aur dhutne se purv apne haathon ko rakhe.
Abu huraira- radiyallahu anhu- se marphooan riwayat haih ((jab tum mein ka koi sajda kare to us prakaar se na baithe jaise oont baithta hai aur dhutne se purv apne haathon ko rakhe)).

Yeh hadees bataati hai ki sajde mein jaana kaise hai? Iska tareeqa yeh hai ki pahle donon haathon ko rakha jaye aur uske baad donon ghutnon ko. Lekin kuchh any hadeeson mein haathon se pahle ghutnon ko rakhne ki baat aai hai. Isliye donon tareeqe jayaz hain. Atah na ispar amal karne waale ko galat kaha jayega aur na uspar amal karne waale ko.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10941: Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab baithte the to dua kiya karte the, apne daahine haath ko apne daahine jaangh par rakha karte the tatha bayen haath ko bayen jaangh par rakha karte the, aur tarjani (shahaadat waali ) ungli se ishaara karte rahte the, tatha apne ungoothe ko madhyama (beech waali ungli) par rakhte the, aur apne bayen haath ka gola banaakar us se ghutne ko pakarte.

Abdulla ibne zubaur radiyallahu anhuma se riwayat hai kinbi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab baithte the to dua kiya karte the, apne daahine haath ko apne daahine jaangh par rakha karte the tatha bayen haath ko bayen jaangh par rakhte the, aur tarjani (shahaadat waali ) ungli se ishaara karte rahte the, tatha apne ungoothe ko madhyama (beech waali ungli) par rakhte the, aur apne bayen haath ka gola banaakar us se ghutne ko pakarte.
10943: Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hamen tashahhud sikhaate the, jis prakaar hamen Qur'an ki soora sikhaate the.

Ibne abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hamen tashahhud sikhaate the, jis prakaar hamen Qur'an ki soora sikhaate the. Aap kaha karte theh mubaarak bandgiyaan tatha paak salaaten kewal Allah hi ke liye hain, ai Nabi aap par salaamti aur Allah ki rahmat evn uski barkat utre, hamaare oopar tatha Allah ke nek bandon par salaamti ho, main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi saty pujy nahin aur Muhammad- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- Allah ke Rasool hain. Ibne rumh ki riwayat main (is prakaar) haih jaise hamen Qur'an sikhaate the.
10945: Mainne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath namaz parhi. Aap apni daaeen or "Assalaamu alaikum wa rahamtullahi wa bakarkaatuh" Aur baaeen or "Assalaamu alaikum wa rahamtullahi wa bakarkaatuh" Kahkar salaam pherte the.

Waail bin hujr radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Mainne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath namaz parhi. Aap apni daaeen or "Assalaamu alaikum wa rahamtullahi wa bakarkaatuh" Aur baaeen or "Assalaamu alaikum wa rahamtullahi wa bakarkaatuh" Kahkar salaam pherte the.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab apni namaz se nikalna chaahte the, to dayen evn bayen or salaam pherte the. Salaam pherne ka tareeqa yeh tha ki pahle apne chehre ko dayen or pherte hue "Assalaamu alaikum wa rahamtullahi wa bakarkaatuh" Kahte aur uske baad bayen or pherte hue "Assalaamu alaikum wa rahamtullah" Kahte.

Namaz mein do salaam hain. Aur salaam pherna namaz ka ek stanbh hai.
Salaam pherte samay kabhi-kabhi "Wa bakarkaatuh" Shabd barha lena musathab hai. Kyonki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- is shabd ka prayog hamesha nahin karte the.
Namaz mein donon salaamon ka uchchaaran ek stanbh evn aniwaary kaary hai. Lekin salaam ka uchchaaran karte hue munh pherna kewal musathab hai.
"Assalaamu alaikum warhamtullah" Salaam pherte samay kahna chahiye. Na usse pahle aur na uske baad.
[ise abu daawood ne riwayat kiya hai]
10947: Ai Allah! Tu hi shaanti waala hai aur teri or se hi shaanti hai. Tu barkat waala hai ai mahaanta aur sammaan waale

Saubaan radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab namaz samaapt karte, to teen baar Allah se kshama maangte aur yeh dua parhte : "Ai Allah! Tu hi shaanti waala hai aur teri or se hi shaanti hai. Tu barkat waala hai ai mahaanta aur sammaan waale!" Waleed kahte hain : Mainne auzaai se kaha : Kshama kaise maangi jaye? Unhonne uttar diya : Tum bas itna kaho : Main Allah se kshama maangta hoon, main Allah se kshama maangta hoon.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab namaz poori kar lete, to yeh dua parhte : "Ai Allah! Main tujhse kshama maangta hoon. Ai Allah! Main tujhse kshama maangta hoon."

Uske baad apne rab ki mahaanta bayaan karte hue kahte : "Ai Allah! Tu shaanti ka srot hai. Teri hi or se shaanti praapt hoti hai. Tu barkat waala, prataap evn sammaan waala hai." Allah apne tamaam gunon mein sanpann aur har kami se paak hai. Allah hi se duniya tatha aakhirat ki buraaiyon se suraksha maangi jayegi, kisi aur se nahin. Donon jahaanon mein Allah ki bhalaaiyaaan bahut zyaada hain. Woh bari mahaanta aur upkaar waala hai.

Namaz ke baad kshama yaachna karna aur is kaam ko hamesha karna musathab hai.
Ibaadat mein rah jaane waali kamiyon tatha kotaahiyon ko poora karne ke liye Allah se kshama maangna musathab hai.
10948: Jisne pratyek namaz ke pashchaat taintees baar subhaan Allah, taintees baar al-hamdu lillah aur taintees baar Allahu akbar kaha, jo ki kul ninyaanve baar hue, aur sau poora karne ke liye ''لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير'' (Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin, woh akela hai, uska koi saajhi nahin, usi ke liye baadshaahat hai, usi ke liye sab prashansayen hain, aur usko har cheez par saamarthy praapt hai) kaha, uske samast paap maaf kar diye jaate hain, yadyapi we samudr ke jhaag ke baraabar hi kyon na hon.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne pratyek namaz ke pashchaat taintees baar subhaan Allah, taintees baar al-hamdu lillah aur taintees baar Allahu akbar kaha, jo ki kul ninyaanve baar hue, aur sau poora karne ke liye ''لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير'' (Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin, woh akela hai, uska koi saajhi nahin, usi ke liye baadshaahat hai, usi ke liye sab prashansayen hain, aur usko har cheez par saamarthy praapt hai) kaha, uske samast paap maaf kar diye jaate hain, yadyapi we samudr ke jhaag ke baraabar hi kyon na hon."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki jisne farz namaz parh lene ke baad in azkaar ko parha :

"Subhaanallah" Taintees baar. In donon shabdon dvaara tamaam kamiyon se Allah ke paak hone ka elaan kiya jaata hai.

"Al-hamdu lillah" Taintees baar. In shabdon dvaara Allah se prem evn uske sammaan ke saath uske saare sanpoorn gunon se alankrit hone ka elaan kiya jaata hai.

"Allahu akbar" Taintees baar. In shabdon ka arth yeh hai ki Allah tamaam cheezon se mahaan aur adhik utkrisht hai.

Tatha "La ilaaha illallahu wahadhu la shareeka lahu, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huv ala kulli shaiin qadeer." Ise ek baar kahkar sau ki ginti poori kar li jaye. Iska arth yeh hai ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai, woh akela hai, uska koi saajhi nahin hai, bas wahi akele sanpoorn baadshaahat rakhta hai aur saari prashansaaon ka wahi haqdaar hai. Woh nitaant kshamta ka maalik hai. Use koi wiwash nahin kar sakta.

Jisne is zikr ko parha, uske gunaah kshama kar diye aur mita diye jaate hain, chaahe woh samudr mein maujen evn lahren uthte samay oopar dikhne waale jhaagon ke baraabar hi kyon na hon.

Farz namaazon ke baad is zikr ko parhna musathab hai.
Is zikr ko parhna gunhon ko mita diye jaane ka sabab hai.
Allah ka nitaant anugrah, kripa, daya evn kshama.
Yeh zikr gunaahon ki kshama ka sabab to hai, lekin kshama kewal chhote gunaahon ki mil sakti hai, bare gunaahon ke liye tauba zaroori hai.
10951: Khare hokar namaz parho, agar iski kshamta na ho to baithkar parho aur agar yeh bhi na ho sake to pahlu ke bal let kar namaz ada karo.

Imraan bin husain radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki mujhe bawaaseer tha. Atah mainne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se namaz ke baare mein poochha, to aapne kaha : "Khare hokar namaz parho, agar iski kshamta na ho to baithkar parho aur agar yeh bhi na ho sake to pahlu ke bal let kar namaz ada karo."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki asal yeh hai ki namaz khare hokar parhi jaye. Haan, agar khare hone ki kshamta na ho, to baithkar parhi jayegi. Aur agar baithkar namaz parhne ki bhi taaqat na ho, to pahlu ke bal letkar parhi jayegi.

Jab tak insaan ke andar hosh wa hawaas baaqi rahe, namaz maaf nahin hoti. Haan, kshamta anusaar ek haalat ki bajay doosri haalat mein parhni hoti hai.
Islam ek aasaan tatha saral dharm hai ki usne bande ko apni shakti ke anusaar namaz parhne ka aadesh diya hai.
10954: Hunain mein hamne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke sang ghazva (yuddh) kiya, jab shatru se hamaari muthbher hui to main ek teele par charh gaya, shatruon mein se ek aadmi mere saamne aya, to mainne usko teer maara kintu woh mujh se chhup gaya, phir mujhe pata nahin us ka kya hua.

Salma bin akva- radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki hunain mein hamne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke sang ghazva (yuddh) kiya, jab shatru se hamaari muthbher hui to main ek ghaati par charh gaya, shatruon mein se ek aadmi mere saamne aya, to mainne usko teer maara kintu woh mujh se chhup gaya, phir mujhe pata nahin us ka kya hua. Mainne logon ko dekha to wo doosri ghaati se nikle, aur un se tatha Nabi - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke sahaaba ke sang yuddh hua, kintu Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke sahaaba bhaag khare hue, main bhi paraajit ho kar lauta, aur main do chaadren pahna tha ek ko neeche pahne hue to doosre ko lapete hua tha, jab meri lungi khul gayi to mainne dono ko ekaththa kar liya tatha Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas se paraajit ho kar gujra jabki aap apne shahba naamak khachchar par the, to Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmayaah akva ke putr ne aatank dekha, phir shatruon ne jab rasoolullah- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko gher liya to aap apne khachchar se utre tatha ek muththi mi़tti liya phir us ko un logon ke munh par maara aur pharmayaah munh bigar gae, us ek muththi se un mein se koi bhi maanav nahin bacha jis ki aankh mein woh na chali gai ho, to woh peeth pher kar bhaage tatha Allah ne un logon ko shikast di, aur Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne un ka dhan musalmaanen ke madhy baant diya.
10955: Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apna haath mere mukh par phera tatha mere liye dua ki, to woh ek sau bees saal tak jeewit rahe aur un ke sir mein kewal kuchh hi baal saphed the.

Abu zaid bin akhtab- radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai, woh kahte hain kih Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apna haath mere mukh par phera tatha mere liye dua ki. Azrah kahte hainh woh ek sau bees saal tak jeewit rahe aur un ke sir mein kewal kuchh hi baal saphed the.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10961: Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hamaare paas aye tatha dophar ke samay hamaare yahaan hi so gae aur aap ke shareer se paseena nikalne laga to meri maata sheeshi lekar aaeen tatha us paseene ko sheeshi me jama karne lageen.

Anas bin maalik- radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai woh kahte hain ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hamaare paas aye tatha dophar ke samay hamaare yahaan hi so gae aur aap ke shareer se paseena nikalne laga to meri maata sheeshi lekar aaeen tatha us paseene ko sheeshi me jama karne lageen, Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jaage to farmayaah he umme sulaim! Yeh kya kar rahi ho? To unhonne jawaab diyaah yeh aap ka paseena hai jo ham apne itr mein milaate hain, aur yeh sabse achchhe itr mein se ek hai.
10962: Jab unhonne Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko snaan karaya to us cheej ki khoj shuru ki jo aam taur se mrit vyakti ke shareer se nikalti hai (arthaat paishaab paikhaana ityaadi) par unhonne kuchh bhi nahin paya to boleh aap par mere baap kurbaan jayen, aap jeewit the tab bhi paak the aur mrityupraapt hue tab bhi paak hain.

Ali bin abu taalib -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki jab unhonne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko snaan karaya to us cheej ki khoj shuru jo aam taur se mrit vyakti ke shareer se nikalti hai (arthaat paishaab paikhaana ityaadi) aur unhonne kuchh bhi nahin paya to boleh aap par mere baap kurbaan jayen, aap jeewit the tab bhi paak the aur mrityupraapt hue tab bhi paak hain.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai .]
10963: Ai Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ! Mera bhaanja beemaar hai, to aapne mere sir par haath phera aur mere liye barkat ki dua pharmayi . Phir aapne wuzu pharmaya aur mainne aapke wuzu ka bacha hua paani pi liya . Phir main aapki peeth ke peechhe khara hua aur naboowat ki mohar ko dekha jo aapke donon kandhon ke beech faakhta ke ande ki tarah thi.

Jaad se riwayat hai woh kahte hain ki mainne saaib bin yazeed radiyallahu anhu ko kahte hue suna hai, unhonne farmaya ki meri khaala mujhe Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas le gayeen aur kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ! Mera bhaanja beemaar hai, to aapne mere sar par haath phera aur mere liye barkat ki dua pharmayi . Phir aapne wuzu pharmaya aur mainne aapke wuzu ka bacha hua paani pi liya . Phir main aapki peeth ke peechhe khara hua aur naboowat ki mohar ko dekha jo aapke donon kandhon ke beech faakhta ke ande ki tarah thi .
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10965: Kya Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne aap ke liye kshama ki praarthana ki, farmayaah haan,aur main tumhaare liye bhi. Phir yeh ayat parheeh وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنْبِكَ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ( apne liye tatha momin mardon aur momin maheelaaaun ke paapon ke liye kshama ki praarthana karo).

Abdullah bin sarjis se warnit hai woh kahte hain ki mainne Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko dekha hai tatha aap ke saath roti wa maans ka sewan kiya hai athva kaha ki sareed (maaleeda). Woh kahte hain, mainne un se poochhaah kya Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne aap ke liye kshama ki praarthana ki, farmayaah haan,aur main tumhaare liye bhi. Phir yeh ayat parheeh وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنْبِكَ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ( apne tatha mominon aur momin maheelaaaun ke paapon ke liye kshama ki praarthana karo). Unhonne kahaah phir jab main peechhe ghooma to meri drishti aap ke kandhon ke beech bayen kandhe ke oopri bhaag par maujood muhar -e- naboovvat par pari jo ki band muththi ke aakaar ki thi jiske oopar masson ke samaan til tha.
10966: Mujhe Allah ki raah mein aisa daraya gaya ki aisa kisi ko nahin daraya gaya aur mujhe aisi kasht di gai jaisi takleeph kisi ko nahin di gai, mere oopar nirantar tees din wa raat guzar jaate tatha mere wa bilaal ke paas khaane ko kuchh nahin hota jise ek jaandaar (sajeev) khaata hai siway us tanik wastu ke jise bilaal- radiyallahu anhu- apne bagal mein chhupa kar laate the.

Anas- radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmayaah mujhe Allah ki raah mein aisa daraya gaya ki aisa kisi ko nahin daraya gaya aur mujhe aisi kasht di gai jaisi kasht kisi ko nahin di gai, mere oopar nirantar tees din wa raat guzar jaate tatha mere wa bilaal ke paas khaane ko kuchh nahin hota jise ek jaandaar ( sajeev) khaata hai siway us tik wastu ke, jise bilaal- radiyallahu anhu- apne bagal mein chhupa kar laate the.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10967: Ek raat Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne saari raat ek ayat ko hi nirantar parhte hue qyaam kiya.
Aysha- radiyallahu anha- se riwayat hai, unhonne pharmaya kih Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek baar saari raat ek ayat ko hi nirantar parhte hue qyaam kiya.
10968: Ek mahila ,jo boddhik roop se thori kamzor thi,ne kahaah he Allah ke Rasool, mujhe aap se kuchh kaam hai, to aap ne pharmayaah he umme phalaan (amook vyakti ki maata) tu bata kis gali mein milna chaahti hai, taaki main teri aawashyakta ki poorti kar sakoon.

Anas- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki ek mahila -jo boddhik roop se thori kamzor thi- ne kahaah he Allah ke Rasool mujhe aap se kuchh kaam hai, to aap ne pharmayaah he umme phalaan (amook vyakti ki maata) tu bata kis gali mein milna chaahti hai, taaki main teri aawashyakta ki poorti kar sakoon. To aap un ke sang kisi gali mein akele gae yahaan tak ki woh mahila apni jaroorat se phaarig ho gai.
10969: Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apni Hajj yaatra ek puraane zeen tatha maamooli chaadar par (aaranbh) ki jiska muly chaar dirham ke baraabar tha ya us se bhi kam tha, phir aap ne kahaah ai Allah, aisa Hajj wishuddh roop se kewal tere liye hai jis mein rhong wa paakhand ka koi ansh nahin hai.

Anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai woh kahte hain ki Nabi - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apni Hajj yaatra ek puraane zeen tatha maamooli chaadar par (aaranbh) ki jiska muly chaar dirham ke baraabar tha ya us se bhi kam tha, phir aap ne kahaah ai Allah, aisa Hajj wishuddh roop se kewal tere liye hai jis mein rhong wa paakhand ka koi ansh nahin hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai .]
10970: Un logon ke sameep Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se adhik priy koi bhi nahin tha, (iske baavjood) woh log aap ko dekh kar khare nahin hote the kyonki woh jaante the ki Allah ke Rasool (- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam-) is se ghrina karte hain.

Anas- radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai woh kahte hain ki un logon (sahaaba) ke sameep Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se adhik priy koi bhi nahin tha, (iske baavjood) woh log aap ko dekh kar khare nahin hote the kyonki woh jaante the ki Allah ke Rasool (-sallallahu alaihi wa sallam-) is se ghrina karte hain.

Is hadees mein anas -radiyallahu anhu- bata rahe hain ki sahaaba ke nikat Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se priy koi nahin tha. Lekin is atyaadhik prem ke baavjood jab we Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko aate hue dekhte to aapke svaagat mein khare nahin hote the. Kyonki unhen pata tha ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apne liye kisi ke khare hone ko apriy jaante hain.
10971: Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- meri dekhbhaal ke liye tashreeph laye . Na khachchar par sawaar the, aur na ghore par (balki paidal tashreeph laye) .

Jaabir- radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, unhonne pharmaya kih Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- meri dekhbhaal ke liye tashreeph laye . Na khachchar par sawaar the, aur na ghore par (balki paidal tashreeph laye) .
10974: Aap na to apshabd bolne waale the na hi ashleel baaten karne waale aur na hi baajaaron mein ja kar halla karne waale, aap buraai ka badla buraai se nahin dete the, balki aap maaph kar dete tatha najraandaaj kar dete.

Abu abdullah al jadli se warnit hai woh kahte hain kih mainne aysha- radiyallahu anha- se Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke svabhaav ke baare mein poochha to unhonne kaha kih aap na to apshabd bolne waale the na hi ashleel baaten karne waale aur na hi baajaaron mein ja kar halla karne waale, aap buraai ka badla buraai se nahin dete the, balki aap maaph kar dete tatha najraandaaj kar dete.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10975: Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko jab Nabi banaya gaya to aap ki ayu chaalees warsh thi, aap makka mein terah warsh tak rahe jahaan aap par wahy utarti rahi, phir aap ko hijrat (palayan) ka aadesh diya gaya, to aap ne hijrat ki jahaan (madeena mein) aap das saal tak rahe, aur jab aap ki mrityu hui us samay aap ki ayu tirsath (63) saal thi.

Ibne abbaas- radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai woh kahte hain ki Nabi- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko jab Nabi banaya gaya to aap ki ayu chaalees warsh thi, aap makka mein terah warsh tak rahe jahaan aap par wahy utarti rahi, phir aap ko hijrat (palayan) ka aadesh diya gaya to aap ne hijrat ki jahaan (madeena mein) aap das saal tak rahe, aur jab aap ki mrityu hui us samay aap ki ayu tirsath (63) saal thi.

Is hadees se maaloom hua ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- par pahli baar wahy 40 warsh ki ayu mein utri. Uske baad makka mein 13 warsh rahe. Is beech wahy ka silsila jaari raha. Phir Allah ne makka se madeena hijrat karne ka aadesh diya. Madeene mein aap 10 warsh rahe. Phir waheen mrityu ko praapt hue. Is tarah aapki ayu 63 warsh hoti hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10976: Sabse antim drishti jo mainne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki or daali thi woh yeh thi ki aap ne parda hataya jabki log abu bakar- radiyallahu anhu- ke peechhe panktiyon mein khare the.

Anas- radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai woh kahte hain ki sabse antim drishti jo mainne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki or daali thi woh yeh thi ki aap ne parda hataya jabki log abu bakar- radiyallahu anhu- ke peechhe panktiyon mein khare the, to abu bakar ne chaaha ki peechhe hat jayen, aap ne un ki or ishaara kiya ki apne sthaan par tike raho tatpashchaat aap ne parda gira diya, aap ki mrityu usi din din ke antim bhaag mein hui jo ki somvaar ka din tha.

Anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- ne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko antim baar us samay dekha tha, jab aapne apne kamre tatha masjid ke beech mein pare parde ko uthaya tha. Us samay aapne dekha ki log abu bakr -radiyallahu anhu- ke peechhe panktibaddh hokar namaz ada kar rahe hain. Abu -radiyallahu anhu- ne aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke aane ki aahat mahsoos ki aur socha ki shayad aap namaz ke liye nikalna chaahte hain. Atah unhone peechhe hatkar saf mein khara hona chaaha, taaki aap unke sthaan par aakar khud logon ko namaz parha saken. Lekin aapne logon ki or ishaara kiya ki sab log apni-apni jaghon par rahen aur namaz poori karen. Phir parde ko gira diya. Usi din shaam ke samay aap mrityu ko praapt ho gae. Woh somvaar ka din tha.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10979: Main kisi ki aasaan mrityu par rashk nahin karti thi jab se mainne Allah ke Rasool - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- par mrityu ki sakhti dekhi.
Aysha- radiyallahu anha- se riwayat hai, unhonne pharmaya, main kisi ki aasaan mrityu par rashk nahin karti thi jab se mainne Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- par mrityu ki sakhti dekhi.
10983: Jis din Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne madeene mein qadam rakha, to uski har cheez chamak uthi aur jis din aapki mrityu hui, uski har cheez par andhera chha gaya.

Anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki jis din Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne madeene mein qadam rakha, to uski har cheez chamak uthi aur jis din aapki mrityu hui, uski har cheez par andhera chha gaya. Jab hamne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko dafan karke haath jhaara, to ham khud apne dilon ko bhi pahchaan nahin pa rahe the.

10986: Mere waaris na deenaar taqseem karenge, na dirham. Jo kuchh main apni patniyon ke kharch aur apne liye kaam karne waale (khaleefa aadi ) ke kharch ke baad chhoroon, woh sadqa hai.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Mere waaris na deenaar taqseem karenge, na dirham. Jo kuchh main apni patniyon ke kharch aur apne liye kaam karne waale (khaleefa aadi ) ke kharch ke baad chhoroon, woh sadqa hai."

10987: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne na deenaar chhore, na dirham, na bakri, na oont aur na kisi cheez ki waseeyat ki.
Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai, woh kahti hainh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne na deenaar chhore, na dirham, na bakri, na oont aur na kisi cheez ki waseeyat ki.
10988: Kisi bhi Nabi ko jab uthaya gaya, to use Jannat mein uska thikaana dikha diya gaya aur phir use akhtiyaar diya gaya (ki chaahe to duniya mein rahe ya Jannat mein apna sthaan grahan kar le)." Phir jab aapki mrityu ka samay aya, to aap behosh ho gae. Us samay aapka sar meri jaangh par tha. Hosh aya, to ghar ki chhat ki or nazar uthaai aur farmayaah "Ai Allah, sabse ooncha mitr!"

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki Allah Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab svasth the, to kaha karte theh "Jab kisi Nabi ko uthaya gaya, to use Jannat mein uska thikaana dikha diya gaya aur phir use akhtiyaar diya gaya (ki chaahe to duniya mein rahe ya Jannat mein apna sthaan grahan kar le)." Phir jab aapki mrityu ka samay aya, to aap behosh ho gae. Us samay aapka sar meri jaangh par tha. Hosh aya, to ghar ki chhat ki or nazar uthaai aur farmayaah "Ai Allah, sabse ooncha mitr!" Yeh dekh mainne kahaah ab aap (aakhirat ko chhor kar) hamen nahin chunne waale. Usi samay mujhe us hadees ka jnaan hua jise aapne ham se bayaan kiya tha jab woh svasth the. Woh kahti hainh antim shabd jo aapki zubaan se nikle, yeh theh "Ai Allah, sabse ooncha mitr!"
