10992: Moosa -alaihissalaam- ek sharmeele vyakti the aur parde ka khaas khayaal rakhte the. Haya ke kaaran unke shareer ki tvacha ka koi ang nahin dikhta tha. Isi ko lekar bani israaeel ke kuchh logon ne unhen kasht diya.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Moosa -alaihissalaam- ek -sharmeele- vyakti the aur parde ka khaas khayaal rakhte the. Haya ke kaaran unke shareer ki tvacha ka koi ang nahin dikhta tha. Isi ko lekar bani israaeel ke kuchh logon ne unhen kasht diya. Kahne lageh yeh is qadar parda isliye karte hain ki unke shareer mein koi aib, jaise safed daagh, andkosh mein soojan ya aur koi beemaari hai. Aise mein Allah ki mansha hui ki moosa -alaihissalaam- ko logon ki in baaton se bari karke dikhaye. Chunaanche ek din woh akele mein the. Unhonne kapre utaarkar patthar par rakh diye aur nahaane lage. Jab nahaakar kapre ki or aane lage, to patthar unke kapre lekar bhaagne laga. Moosa -alaihissalaam- ne apni laathi uthaai aur patthar ka peechha kiya. Woh kahte ja rahe theh are o patthar, mere kapre to dete ja! Are o patthar, mere kapre to dete ja! Isi awastha mein woh bani israaeel ke kuchh logon ke paas pahunch gae. Logon ne unhen nirvastr awastha mein dekha aur paya ki woh Allah ki paida ki hui sundartam awastha mein hain. Is tarah Allah ne unhen logon ki teeka-tippani se mukt kar diya. Phir patthar ruka, unhonne kapra lekar pahan liya aur patthar ko apni laathi se maarne lage. Allah ki qasam, unke maarne ke kaaran patthar par teen, chaar ya paanch nishaan par gae. Isi ka zikr Allah ke is farmaan mein haih {يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ آذَوْا مُوسَى فَبَرَّأَهُ اللَّهُ مِمَّا قَالُوا وَكَانَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَجِيهًا} (arthaat ai eemaan waalo, un logon ki tarah na ho jaao, jinhon ne moosa ko kasht diya, to Allah ne unko unki kahi hui baat se bari kar diya. Daraasal woh Allah ke nikat ek sammaanit vyakti the.) [soora al-ahzaabah 69]"
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10993: Eesa bin maryam -alaihissalaam- ne ek vyakti ko chori karte dekha, to usse kahaah kya toone chori ki hai? Usne kahaah bilkul nahin, us Allah ki qasam, jiske siwa koi wandneey nahin hai. Is par eesa -alaihissalaam- ne kahaah main Allah par eemaan laya aur apni aankh ko jhuthlaya.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Eesa bin maryam -alaihissalaam- ne ek vyakti ko chori karte dekha, to usse kahaah kya toone chori ki hai? Usne kahaah bilkul nahin, us Allah ki qasam, jiske siwa koi wandneey nahin hai. Ispar eesa -alaihissalaam- ne kahaah main Allah par eemaan laya aur apni aankh ko jhuthlaya."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10994: Jab koi aadam ki santaan janm leti hai, to uske janm ke samay shaitaan use chhoota hai aur shaitaan ke chhoone ke kaaran woh cheekh parti hai. Albatta maryam aur unke bete ke saath aisa nahin hua.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue sunaah "Jab koi aadam ki santaan janm leti hai, to uske janm ke samay shaitaan chhoota hai aur shaitaan ke chhoone ke kaaran woh cheekh parti hai. Albatta maryam aur unke bete ke saath aisa nahin hua." Phir abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- yeh ayat parhte hainh {وإنِّي أُعِيذُها بك وذُرِّيَّتَها من الشَّيطان الرَّجِيمِ} (arthaat main use aur uski santaan ko dhikkaare hue shaitaan se teri sharan mein deti hoon.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
10995: Khazir ko khazir ka naam isliye diya gaya ki (ek baar) woh ek sookhe khet mein baithe, to dekhte hi dekhte unke peechhe hariyaali lahalhaane lagi.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Khazir ko khazir ka naam isliye diya gaya ki (ek baar) woh ek sookhe khet mein baithe, to dekhte hi dekhte unke peechhe hariyaali lahalhaane lagi."
10996: Wasvayn shreshth, shreshth ke putr, shreshth ke pote, shreshth ke padpote yoosuf bin yaaqoob bin ishaaq bin ibraaheem -alaihimussalaam.

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Svayn shreshth, shreshth ke putr, shreshth ke pote, shreshth ke padpote yoosuf bin yaaqoob bin ishaaq bin ibraaheem -alaihimussalaam- hain."
10997: Kisi bande ke liye yeh kahna uchit nahin hai ki main yoonus bin matta se uttam hoon.

Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Kisi bande ke liye yeh kahna uchit nahin hai ki main yoonus bin matta se uttam hoon." Is hadees mein aapne yoonus -alaihissalaam- ko unke pita ki or mansoob kiya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11000: ''Mere sahaaba ko bura-bhala mat kaho. Tummen se koi yadi uhud parvat ke baraabar sona kharch kar de, tab bhi unke ek ya aadha mud kharch karne ke baraabar neki praapt nahin kar sakta.

Abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : ''Mere sahaaba ko bura-bhala mat kaho. Tummen se koi yadi uhud parvat ke baraabar sona kharch kar de, tab bhi unke ek ya aadha mud kharch karne ke baraabar neki praapt nahin kar sakta."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne sahaaba ko gaali dene  se mana kiya hai. Khaas taur se sabse pahle Islam grahan karne waale muhaajiron aur ansaar ko. Aapne aage bataya ki agar koi vyakti uhud parvat ke baraabar bhi sona kharch kar de, to utna sawaab praapt nahin kar sakega, jitna kisi sahaabi ko ek mud ya aadha mud kharch karne par mil jaya karta tha. Yaad rahe ki mud madhyam shareer waale insaan ke ek lap bhar ko kahte hain. Sahaaba ko itna bara sawaab unki nishtha, sachchi neeyat aur makka wijay se pahle aise samay mein kharch karne tatha yuddh mein shaamil hone ke kaaran mila, jab uski bahut zyaada zaroorat thi.
Sahaaba ko gaali dena haraam tatha kabeera gunaah hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
11152: Ai Allah, ansaar ko kshama kar de, ansaar ke putron ko kshama kar de tatha ansaar ke putron ke putron ko kshama kar de.

Zaid bin arqam -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Ai Allah, ansaar ko kshama kar de, ansaar ke putron ko kshama kar de tatha ansaar ke putron ke putron ko kshama kar de."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11159: Mainne abdullah bin amr -radiyallahu anhuma- se poochha ki mushrikon ka Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath kathortam vyavhaar kya tha? To unhonne kahaah mainne dekha ki jis samay Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam namaz parh rahe the us samay uqba bin abi mueet aaap ke paas aya tatha usne apni chaadar aapki gardan mein daali aur zor se aapka gala ghontne laga.

Urva bin zubair kahte hain ki mainne abdullah bin amr -radiyallahu anhuma- se poochha ki mushrikon ka Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath kathortam vyavhaar kya tha? To unhonne kahaah mainne dekha ki jis samay Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam namaz parh rahe the us samay uqba bin abi mueet aaap ke paas aya tatha usne apni chaadar aapki gardan mein daali aur zor se aapka gala ghontne laga. Itne mein abu bakr -radiyallahu anhu- aye aur use dhakka dekar aapse door kiya aur farmayaah {أَتَقْتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَنْ يَقُولَ رَبِّيَ اللَّهُ وَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ} (kya tum ek vyakti ko is bina par qatl kar doge ki woh kahta hai ki mera rab Allah hai, jabik woh tumhaare paas tumhaare rab ki or khuli nishaaniyon ke saath aya hai?) [soora ghaafirah 28]
11161: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne abu bakr aur umar radiyallahu anhuma se farmaya : "Yeh donon nabiyon aur rasoolon ko chhor tamaam agle aur pichhle adher umr jannatiyon ke sardaar hain.

Anas radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne abu bakr aur umar radiyallahu anhuma se farmaya : "Yeh donon nabiyon aur rasoolon ko chhor tamaam agle aur pichhle adher umr jannatiyon ke sardaar hain."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki abu bakr aur umar radiyallahu anhuma nabiyon ke baad sabse shreshth insaan aur nabiyon tatha rasoolon ke baad Jannat jaane waale sabse shreshth vyakti hain.

Abu bakr aur umar radiyallahu anhuma nabiyon aur rasoolon ke baad sabse shreshth insaan hain.
Jannat mein koi adher nahin hoga. Usmen prawesh karne waala har vyakti taintees saal ka hoga. Is hadees ka matlab yeh hai ki donon duniya mein adher ayu mein mrityu ko praapt hone waale logon ke sardaar honge. Aisa bhi ho sakta hai ki yahaan is hadees ke Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke munh se nikalte samay duniya mein maujood logon ki umr ka etbaar kiya gaya hai.
11164: Allah ne saty ko umar ki zubaan aur dil mein rakh diya hai.

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Allah ne saty ko umar ki zubaan aur dil mein rakh diya hai." Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma -kahte hainh jab bhi logon ke saamne koi maamla aata aur log uske baare mein ray dete tatha umar -radiyallahu anhu- bhi ray dete, to us maamle mein umar -radiyallahu anhu- ki ray ke anuroop hi Qur'an utarta.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11168: Faatima mera ang hai, jisne use naaraaz kiya, usne mujhe naaraaz kiya.
Misvar bin makharma -radiyallahu anhuma- Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se riwayat karte hain ki aapne farmayaah "Faatima mera ang hai, jisne use naaraaz kiya, usne mujhe naaraaz kiya."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11169: Hasan aur husain Jannat ke jawaanon ke sardaar hain.
Abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Hasan aur husain Jannat ke jawaanon ke sardaar hain."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki aapke donon nawaase hasan aur husain radiyallahu anhuma, jo ali bin abu taalib radiyallahu anhu tatha Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki beti faatima radiyallahu anha ke bete hain, martaba aur shreshthata ke aitbaar se, jawaani ki awastha mein mrityu ko praapt hone waale aur Jannat mein prawesh karne waale tamaam logon ke sardaar honge. Iska ek matlab yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki donon nabiyon aur khulfa-e-raashideen ko chhorkar tamaam jannati jawaanon ke sardaar honge.

Hasan tatha husain radiyallahu anhuma ki ek spasht fazeelat.
Is hadees ke kai arth bataye gae hain. Ek yeh ki donon Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke munh se us kathan ke nikalte samay us zamaane mein maujood Jannat jaane waale tamaam jawaanon ke sardaar honge. Doosra yeh ki donon nabiyon evn khaleefon ko chhor un tamaam logon se uttam hain, jinki koi aam fazeelat saabit na ho. Teesra yeh ki donon aise logon ko sardaar honge, jinke andar dileri, udaarta evn bahaaduri aadi jawaanon ke gun hon. Yaani muraad jawaani nahin hai. Kyonki hasan evn husain radiyallahu anhuma ki mrityu adher umr mein hui thi.
[ise tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
11170: Ise dekho, mujhse machchhar ko maarne ke baare mein poochh raha hai, jabki inheen logon ne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke nawaase ka wadh kiya hai. Haalaanki khud mainne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte suna haih "Hasan aur husain donon duniya mein mere pushp hain."

Ibn abu nuam kahte hain ki main abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ke paas upasthit tha. Ek vyakti ne unse machchhar ko maarne ke baare mein poochh liya, to abdullah -radiyallahu anhu- ne usse kahaah tum kahaan ke rahne waale ho? Usne kahaah iraaq ka. Farmayaah ise dekho, mujhse machchhar ko maarne ke baare mein poochh raha hai, jabki inheen logon ne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke nawaase ka wadh kiya hai. Haalaanki ki khud mainne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte suna haih "Hasan aur husain donon duniya mein mere pushp hain."
11171: Ai Allah, main isse muhabbat karta hoon, tu bhi isse muhabbat kar aur har us vyakti se muhabbat kar, jo isse muhabbat kare.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki main madeene ke kisi baazaar mein Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath tha. Aap waapas hue, to main bhi waapas ho gaya. Aap (faatima radiyallahu anhu ka ghar pahunche aur) boleh "Bachcha kahaan hai? -aapne yeh baat teen baar kahi- hasan bin ali ko bulaao." Hasan bin ali -radiyallahu anhuma- uthe aur aapki or aye. Us samay unke gale mein ek sugandhit (mankon ya laung ka) haar tha. Nabi -sallallahualaihi wa sallam- ne apne haath phailaye aur hasan -radiyallahu anhu- ne bhi apne haath phaila diye. Phir aapne unhen gale lagaakar kahaah "Ai Allah, main isse muhabbat karta hoon, tu bhi isse muhabbat kar aur har us vyakti se muhabbat kar, jo isse muhabbat kare." Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hainh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki yeh baat sunne ke baad mere nikat koi bhi vyakti hasan bin ali -radiyallahu anhuma- se adhik priy na raha.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11172: Ek din Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hasan -radiyallahu anhu- ko lekar baahar aye, unhen saath lekar minbar ke oopar gae aur farmayaah "Mera yeh beta sardaar hai. Ho sakta hai ki Allah iske dvaara do Muslim girohon ke beech sulah kara de."

Abu bakra -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki ek din Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hasan -radiyallahu anhu- ko lekar baahar aye, unhen saath lekar minbar ke oopar gae aur farmayaah "Mera yeh beta sardaar hai. Ho sakta hai ki Allah iske dvaara do Muslim girohon ke beech sulah kara de."

Ek din Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hasan -radiyallahu anhu- ko, jo us samay chhote bachche the, apne saath masjid le aye. Phir unko lekar minbar par charh gae aur logon ko bataya ki unka beta hasan sardaar hai, sammaanit kul se hai, shisht nasab waala hai, dharti ke oopar paye jaane waale sabse utkrisht gharaane se sanbandh rakhta hai aur uchch evn mahaan Allah iske zariye musalmaanon ke do yuddharat samoohon ke beech sulah kara dega tatha in do samoohon mein sulah hone ke baad musalmaanon ko ek vyaapak bikhraav se mukti mil jayegi.
Is baat mein kisi sandeh ki gunjaaish nahin hai ki yeh hadees Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke Allah ke Nabi hone ki ek bari nishaani hai. Kyonki aapne apne nawaase hasan bin ali -radiyallahu anhu- ke dvaara musalmaanon ko ek pletphorm par laane, unke bigre hue rishton ko sudhaarne aur do bahut bare samoohon ke beech utpann jhagre ko khatm karne ka jo bara kaam baad mein hone waala tha, uski bhawishyawaani pahle hi kar di thi. Is mahatvapoorn bhawishyawaani ko dhara par utarte hue us samay dekha gaya, jab san 40 athva 41 hijri ko hasan -radiyallahu anhu- ne khud ko khilaafat se alag kar liya aur muaawiya -radiyallahu anhu- ko khilaafat saunp di, jo ek bahut bare bikhraav tatha raktapaat ki samaapti ka kaaran bana.
11173: Jisne hasan aur husain se muhabbat ki, usne mujhse muhabbat ki aur jisne un donon se dushmani ki, usne mujhse dushmani ki.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Jisne hasan aur husain se muhabbat ki, usne mujhse muhabbat ki aur jisne un donon se dushmani ki, usne mujhse dushmani ki."

Jisne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke nawaason hasan evn husain se prem rakha usne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se prem rakha aur jisne un donon se nafrat ki usne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se nafrat ki, atah yeh baat donon ke maratbe ko darshaati hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11175: Mujhe Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki patniyon mein se kewel khadeeja par ghairat aati thi. Haalaanki mere wiwaah se pahle hi unka nidhan ho chuka tha. Woh kahti hainh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab bakri zabah karte, to kahteh "Is mein se khadeeja ki saheliyon ko bhejo."

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki mujhe Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki patniyon mein se kewel khadeeja par ghairat aati thi. Haalaanki mere wiwaah se pahle hi unka nidhan ho chuka tha. Woh kahti hainh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab bakri zabah karte, to kahteh "Is mein se khadeeja ki saheliyon ko bhejo." Woh kahti hain ki mainne ek din aap ko naaraaj kardiya, aur mainne kaha: Khadeeja! To Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Mere andar uska prem racha-basa hai."
11176: Jab tak khadeeja -radiyallahu anha- jeewit raheen, Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne doosra nikaah nahin kiya.
Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki jab tak khadeeja -radiyallahu anha- jeewit raheen, Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne doosra nikaah nahin kiya..
11177: Jibreel ek hare rang ke reshmi kapre mein aaisha ka chitr lekar Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aye aur kahaah yeh duniya tatha aakhirat mein aapki patni hai.

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki jibreel ek hare rang ke reshmi kapre mein unka chitr lekar Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aye aur kahaah yeh duniya tatha aakhirat mein aapki patni hai.
11178: "Ai aaish! Yeh jibreel hain, jo tumhen salaam kahte hain." To mainne yoon jawaab diyaah "Wa alaihissalaam wa rahamtullahi wa barkaatuhu. Aap woh dekhte hain, jo main nahin dekhti."

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- se riwayat hai ki ek din Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unse pharmaya: "Ai aaish! Yeh jibreel hain, jo tumhen salaam kahte hain." To mainne yoon jawaab diyaah "Wa alaihissalaam wa rahamtullahi wa barkaatuhu. Aap woh dekhte hain, jo main nahin dekhti." Unhonne yeh -dekhne ki- baat Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke baare mein kahi thi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11179: Purushon mein se bahut-se log sanpoorn hue, lekin striyon mein se sanpoorn kewal firaaun ki patni aasiya aur maryam bint imraan hueen. Haan, saari striyon mein aaisha ka wahi sthaan hai, jo saare khaanon mein sareed ka hai.

Abu moosa -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Purushon mein se bahut-se log sanpoorn hue, lekin striyon mein se sanpoorn kewal firaaun ki patni aasiya aur maryam bint imraan hueen. Haan, saari striyon mein aaisha ka wahi sthaan hai, jo saare khaanon mein sareed ka hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11180: Main nishchit roop se jaanta hoon ki kab tum mujh se khush rahti ho aur kab mujh se naaraaz rahti ho.

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki mujhse Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmayaah "Main nishchit roop se jaanta hoon ki kab tum mujh se khush rahti ho aur kab mujh se naaraaz rahti ho." Mainne kahaah "Aap ko iska jnaan kaisaahota hai?" Aapne pharmaya: "Jab tum mujhse khush hoti ho, to baat karte samay kahti ho, nahin, Muhammad ke rab ki qasam! Aur jab tum mujhse khafa hoti ho, to kahti ho, nahin ibraaheem ke rab ki qasam!" Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki mainne kahaah haan, ai Allah ke Rasool, yeh to sahi hai, magar Allah ki qasam, main kewal aapka naam hi chhorti hoon.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11187: Mainne jaafar ko dekha ki Jannat main farishton ke saath ur rahe hain.
Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Mainne jaafar ko dekha ki Jannat main farishton ke saath ur rahe hain.
11188: Ibraaheem mera beta hai. Uski mrityu doodh peene ki awastha mein hui hai. Use do doodh pilaane waali daaeeyaan praapt hongi, jo Jannat mein use doodh pilaane ka kaary sanpann karengi.

Anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hainh mainne koi aisa vyakti nahin dekha, jo Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se adhik apne pariwaar par kripa karta ho. Woh kahte hainh -aapke putr- ibraaheem madeene ke nikat ki ek basti mein doodh pi rahe tha. Aap unhen dekhne jaate. Ham bhi aapke saath ho lete. Aap doodh pilaane waali ke ghar mein prawesh karte, to woh dhuen se bhara hota. Kyonki uska pati lohaar tha. Aap apne bete ko lekar bosa dete aur waapas ho jaate.
Amr kahte hainh jab (aapke putr) ibraaheem ka nidhan hua, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Ibraaheem mera beta hai. Uski mrityu doodh peene ki awastha mein hui hai. Use do doodh pilaane waali do daaeeyaan praapt hongi, jo Jannat mein use doodh pilaane ka kaary sanpann karengi."
11189: Jab ibraaheem -radiyallahu anhu- ki mrityu hui, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmayaah "Jannat mein uske liye ek doodh pilaane waali nirdhaarit kar di gai hai."

Bara bin aazib -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki jab ibraaheem -radiyallahu anhu- ki mrityu hui, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmayaah "Jannat mein uske liye ek doodh pilaane waali nirdhaarit kar di gai hai."
11190: Har ummat ka ek 'ameen' (jise amaanatdaari ke kaaran any logon ke muqaable mein adhit khyaati praapt ho) hota hai, aur hamaari is ummat ka 'ameen' abu ubaida bin jarraah (radiyallahu anhu) hai.

Anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se riwayat karte hue kahte hainh "Har ummat ka ek 'ameen' (jise amaanatdaari ke kaaran any logon ke muqaable mein adhit khyaati praapt ho) hota hai, aur hamaari is ummat ka 'ameen' abu ubaida bin jarraah (radiyallahu anhu) hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11191: Uhud yuddh ke din Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- do-do kawach pahne hue the. Aap ek chattaan par charhne ka prayaas kar rahe the, lekin charh nahin pa rahe the. Aise mein, Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne talha -radiyallahu anhu- ko apne neeche bithaya, unke oopar charhe aur chattaan par seedhe khare ho gae. Woh kahte hain ki mainne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte suna haih " Talha (Jannat ka haqdaar ban gaya."

Zubair bin avvaam -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki uhud yuddh ke din Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- do-do kawach pahne hue the. Aap ek chattaan par charhne ka prayaas kar rahe the, lekin charh nahin pa rahe the. Aise mein, Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne talha (radiyallahu anhu) ko apne neeche bithaya, unke oopar charhe aur chattaan par seedhe khare ho gae. Woh kahte hain ki mainne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte suna haih " Talha (Jannat ka) haqdaar ban gaya."
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11192: Har Nabi ka ek hawaari (nishthaawaan sahayak) hota hai aur mera hawaari zubair hai.

Jaabir -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ahzaab yuddh ke din pharmayaah "Mere paas dushman ki khabar kaun layega?" Zubair -radiyallahu anhu- ne kahaah main laaoonga. Aapne phir farmayaah "Mere paas dushman ki khabar kaun layega?" Zubair -radiyallahu anhu- ne phir kaha ki main laaoonga. Tab Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmayaah "Har Nabi ka ek hawaari (nishthaawaan sahayak) hota hai aur mera hawaari zubair hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11194: Saad -radiyallahu anhu- aye, to Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Yeh mere maama hain. Koi vyakti mujhe apna maama bhi dikhaye!."
Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki saad (radiyallahu anhu) aye, to Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Yeh mere maama hain. Koi vyakti mujhe apna maama bhi dikhaye!."
11195: Mainne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko nahin dekha ki saad -ke baad kisi par apne maan-baap ko nyochhaawar kiya ho. Mainne aapko kahte hue suna haih "Tum teer chalaao, tum par mere maan-baap fida hon."

Ali -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko nahin dekha ki saad ke baad kisi par apne maan-baap ko nyochhaawar kiya ho. Mainne aapko kahte hue suna haih "Tum teer chalaao, tum par mere maan-baap fida hon."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11196: Mere baad tumhaare guzar-basar ka masla un maslon mein se hai, jo mujhe pareshaan rakhte hain, tatha tumhaare guzar-basar ke prabandh ka bhaar wahi sahan kar sakenge, jo dhairy waale honge.

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- kaha karte theh "Mere baad tumhaare guzar-basar ka masla un maslon mein se hai, jo mujhe pareshaan rakhte hain tatha tumhaare guzar-basar ke prabandh ka bhaar wahi sahan kar sakenge, jo dhairy waale honge." Warnankarta (abu salma bin abdurrahmaan bin auf) kahte hain ki phir aaisha -radiyallahu anha- kahti theenh Allah tumhaare pita ko Jannat ki salasbeel naami nahar se paani pilaye. Unki muraad abdurrahmaan bin auf se thi, jinhonne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki patniyon ko ek maal bhent kiya tha, jiske baare mein kaha jaata hai ki chaalees hazaar mein becha gaya tha.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11197: Ai Allah, ise seedha raasta bataane waala aur seedhe raaste par chalne waala bana tatha iske zariye logon ko seedha raasta dikha.

Abdurrahmaan bin abi ameera, jinka shumaar Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke sahaaba mein hota hai, Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se riwayat karte hain ki aapne muaawiya -radiyallahu anhu- ke baare mein farmayaah "Ai Allah, ise seedha raasta bataane waala aur seedhe raaste par chalne waala bana tatha iske zariye logon ko seedha raasta dikha."
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11199: Ammaar ko jab bhi do baaton mein se ek ko chunne ka adhikaar diya gaya, to unhonne use chuna, jo saty se adhik nikat ho.

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Ammaar ko jab bhi do baaton mein se ek ko chunne ka adhikaar diya gaya, to usne use chuna, jo saty se adhik nikat ho."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11202: Jab Allah kisi bande ko kisi sthaan mein mrityu dena chaahta hai, to wahaan uski koi zaroorat rakh deta hai.

Abu azza huzli -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Jab Allah kisi bande ko kisi sthaan mein mrityu dena chaahta hai, to wahaan uski koi zaroorat rakh deta hai."
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood tayaalisi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11205: Qabr aakhirat ka pahla paraav hai. Yadi banda yahaan bach gaya, to baad ke paraav isse aasaan hain. Aur agar yahaan na bach saka, to baad ke paraav isse kathin hain.

Usmaan ke aazaad kiye hue ghulaam haani kahte hainh usmaan -radiyallahu anhu- jab kisi qabr ke paas khare hote, to itna rote ki unki daarhi bheeg jaati. Unse kaha gaya ki aap Jannat aur Jahannam ka zikr karte hain, to nahin rote, lekin isse rote hain? To farmayaah Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya haih "Qabr aakhirat ka pahla paraav hai. Yadi banda yahaan bach gaya, to baad ke paraav isse aasaan hain. Aur agar yahaan na bach saka, to baad ke paraav isse kathin hain."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11206: Donon ne sach kaha hai. In logon ko aisa azaab diya jaata hai ki saare chaupaye use sunte hain.

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki mere paas madeene ki do boorhi yahoodi mahilayen aaeen aur mujhse kahne lageen ki qabr waalon ko unki qabron mein azaab diya jaata hai. Mainne donon ko jhuthla diya aur unki pushti na kar saki. Donon chali bhi gaeen. Phir Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- mere paas aye, to mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, do boorhiyaan mere paas aaeen theen. Mainne aapko poori ghatna suna di. Aapne farmayaah "Donon ne sach kaha hai. Logon ko aisa azaab diya jaata hai ki saare chaupaye use sunte hain." Iske baad mainne dekha ki aap har namaz mein qabr ke azaab se Allah ki panaah maanga karte the.

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ke paas madeene ki do boorhi yahoodi mahilayen aaeen aur kahne lageen ki mare hue logon ko qabr ke andar azaab hota hai. Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ne un donon ko jhuthla diya aur unki pushti karna pasand nahin kiya. Kyonki yahoodiyon ke jhooth, dharm ke naam par jhoothi baaten gharne ki aadat aur Allah ki kitaab ke saath chher-chhaar se sab log parichit the. Chunaanche donon chali gaeen. Phir jab Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ke paas aye aur unhonne aapko donon yahoodi mahilaaon ki baat sunaai, to aapne kaha : Unki baat sahi hai. Mare hue logon ko qabr mein yaatna di jaati hai, jise saare chaupaye sunte hain. Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- bataati hain ki unhonne iske baad Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko jab bhi koi namaz parhte hue dekha, to aapne qabr ki yaatna se Allah ki sharan maangi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11207: Meri or wahy ki gai hai ki tumhen qabron mein kamo-besh dajjaal ki pareeksha ki bhaanti pareeksha ka saamna karna parega.

Asma bint abu bakr -radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- khare hue aur us pareeksha ka zikr kiya, jiska saamna insaan ko apni qabr mein karna hoga. Jab aapne us pareeksha ka zikr kiya, to musalmaan is qadar zor-zor se rone lage ki main Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki baat samajh na saki. Jab unke rone ki aawaaz thami, to mainne apne nikat ke ek vyakti se kahaah ai amuk, -Allah tujh mein barkat de- Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apni baat ke ant mein kya kaha hai? Usne kaha ki aapne farmaya haih "Meri or wahy ki gai hai ki tumhen qabron mein kamo-besh dajjaal ki pareeksha ki bhaanti pareeksha ka saamna karna parega."
[ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11208: Is ummat ko qabron ke andar aazmaya jaata hai. Agar tum dafan karna chhor na do, to main Allah se dua karoon ki tumhen bhi qabr ki woh yaatna sunaye, jo main sunta hoon.

Abu saeed khudri -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se sanbandhit is ghatna ko mainne apni aankhon se nahin dekha hai, lekin mujhe zaid bin saabi -radiyallahu anhu- ne sunaya hai. Woh kahte hainh Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ek khachchar par sawaar hokar bani najjaar ke ek baag se guzar rahe the aur ham aapke saath the ki achaanak aapka khachchar bidak gaya aur aisa lag raha tha ki aapko gira dega. Hamne dekha, to wahaan chhah ya paanch ya chaar qabren theen-warnitkaar ne kaha: Jareeri aisa hi kaha karte the, aapne kahaah "In qabron mein dafan logon ko kaun jaanta hai?" Ek vyakti ne kahaah main jaanta hoon. Aapne poochha: "Yeh log kab mare hain?" Usne uttar diyaah shirk ke zamaane mein. Aapne farmayaah "Is ummat ko qabron ke andar aazmaya jaata hai. Agar tum dafan karna chhor na do, to main Allah se dua karoon ki tumhen bhi qabr ki woh yaatna sunaye, jo main sunta hoon." Phir aap hamaari or drishti karte hue farmayaah "Jahannam ke azaab se Allah ki panaah maango." Sahaaba ne kahaah ham Jahannam ke azaab se Allah ki panaah maangte hain. Phir farmayaah "Qabr ke azaab se Allah ki panaah maango." Sahaaba ne kahaah ham qabr ke azaab se Allah ki panaah maangte hain. Farmayaah "Saare prakat tatha gupt fitnon se Allah ki panaah maango." Sahaaba ne kahaah ham saare prakat tatha gupt fitnon se Allah ki panaah maangte hain. Farmayaah "Dajjaal ke fitne se Allah ki panaah maango." Sahaaba ne kahaah dajjaal ke fitne se Allah ki panaah maangte hain.

Zaid bin saabit -radiyallahu anhu- bayaan karte hain ki ek din ham log ansaar ke qabeela banu najjaar ke ek baag mein Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath the. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apne khachchar par sawaar the. Achaanak aapka khachchar bidak kar raaste se hat gaya. Aisa lag raha tha ki woh aapko apni peeth se gira dega. Us jagah chaar ya paanch ya chhah qabren theen. Atah Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne poochha ki in qabron mein dafan logon ko kaun pahchaanta hai? Ek vyakti ne uttar diya ki unhen main pahchaanta hoon.Ispar aapne kaha ki yadi tum unhen pahchaante ho, to bataao ki unki mrityu kab hui hai? Usne kaha ki unki mrityu shirk ke zamaane mein hui hai. Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : Is ummat ke logon ki qabr mein pareeksha hoti hai aur iske baad ya to unhen nemten di jaati hain ya phir yaatna di jaati hai. Yadi mujhe is baat ka dar mahsoos na hota ki tum apne mare hue logon ko dafan karna chhor doge, to main Allah se dua karta ki qabr ki jo yaatna main sunta hoon, woh tumhen bhi suna de. Daraasal baat yeh hai ki yadi tumhen qabr ki yaatna sunaai dene lage, to is dar se ki kaheen murdon ki cheekh se tumhaare dil phat na jayen ya phir is bhay se mare hue vyakti ki haalat se avgat hone ke baad rishtedaaron mein apmaanit na hona pare, tum ek-doosre ko dafan karna hi chhor do. Phir apne saathiyon ki oेr munh karne ke baad farmaya : Allah se dua karo ki woh tumse aag ki yaatna ko hata de. Ispar unhonne kaha : Ham aag ki yaatna se Allah ki sharan mein aate hain. Phir aapne kaha : Allah se dua karo ki tumhen qabr ki yaatna se bachaye. Unhonne kaha : Ham qabr ki yaatna se Allah ki sharan mein aate hain. Phir aapne kaha : Allah se dua karo ki woh tumhen saare prakat evn gupt fitnon se bachaye. Unhonne kaha : Ham tamaam prakat evn gupt fitnon se Allah ki sharan mein aate hain. Aapne kaha : Allah se dua karo ki woh tumhen kaana dajjaal ke fitne se bachaye, jo ki sabse bara fitna hai. Kyonki woh kufr ka kaaran banta hai aur kufr insaan ko Jahannam ki na khatam hone waali yaatna ki or le jaata hai. Unhonne kaha : Ham dajjaal ke fitne se Allah ki sharan mein aate hain.
11209: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- sooraj doobne ke baad nikle, to ek aawaaz suni. Atah, aapne farmayaah "Yahoodiyon ko unki qabron mein azaab diya ja raha hai."

Abu ayyoob -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- sooraj doobne ke baad nikle, to ek aawaaz suni. Atah, aapne farmayaah "Yahoodiyon ko unki qabron mein azaab diya ja raha hai."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11210: Tummen se koi jab mar jaata hai, to subah-shaam use uska thikaana dikhaya jaata hai.

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Tummen se koi jab mar jaata hai, to subah-shaam use uska thikaana dikhaya jaata hai. Agar woh jannati hai, to Jannat waalon ka aur agar jahannami hai, to Jahannam waalon ka. Usse kaha jaata hai ki yahi tera thikaana hai, (jo tujhe us samay tak praapt nahin ho sakta) jab tak Allah qayaamat ke din tujhe dobaara na uthaye."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki jab koi banda mar jaata hai, to din ki shuruaat aur ant mein use Jannat aur Jahannam mein uska sthaan aur uske liye taiyaar ki gai vyawasthayen dikhaai jaati hain. Yadi woh Jannat waalon mein se hai to use uska sthaan Jannat mein dikhaya jaata hai aur yadi woh Jahannam waalon mein se hai to use uska sthaan Jahannam mein dikhaya jaata hai. Usse kaha jaata hai : Yahi tumhaara woh thikaana hai, jahaan tumko qayaamat ke din uthaakar bheja jayega. Aur aisa momin ko khushi pradaan karne aur kaafir ko yaatna dene ke liye kiya jaata hai.

Qabr ka azaab tatha uski nemat donon haq hain.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Is hadees se spasht hai ki dharmeesheel wishvaasi ke saamne Jannat tatha awishvaasi ke saamne Jahannam ko prastut kiya jayega. Lekin aise momin ka kya hoga, jo gunaah bhi kar leta ho? To ho sakta hai ki uske saamne bhi Jahannam ko prastut kiya jaye, jahaan use anttah pahunchna hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
11211: Qabr ki kuchh nemton aur yaatnaon ka zikr

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Jab murde ko -ya kaha:Tummen se kisi ko- qabr mein rakha jaata hai, to uske paas do kaale-neele farishte aate hain. Unmen se ek ko 'munkar' aur doosre ko 'nakeer' kaha jaata hai. Donon kahte hainh tum is vyakti ke baare mein kya kahte the? Woh wahi kahta hai, jo duniya mein kahta tha ki aap Allah ke bande aur uske Rasool hain. Main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin aur Muhammad uske bande aur Rasool hain. Donon kahte hainh ham jaante the ki tum yahi kahoge. Phir uski qabr ko uske liye sattar haath lanbaai mein aur sattar haath chauraai mein phaila diya jaata hai. Phir uske liye use raushan kar diya jaata hai. Phir usse kaha jaata haih so jaao. Woh kahta haih main apne pariwaar ke paas jaakar unhen soochna dena chaahta hoon. Donon kahte hainh us doolhahan ki tarah so jaao, jise uske sabse priy vyakti ke siwa koi nahin jagaata. (To woh so jaata hai ) yahaan tak use Allah uske sone ke sthaan se uthayega. Aur agar woh munaafiq ho, to kahta haih mainne logon ko kahte hue suna, to usi tarah kah diya. Mujhe waastawikta ka jnaan nahin hai. Donon kahte hainh ham jaante the ki tum isi tarah ki baat kaho ge. Chunaanche dharti se kaha jaata hai ki is par sikur jaao, to woh uspar sikur jaati hai, jisse uski ek taraf ki pasliyaan doosri taraf a jaati hain. Is tarah, woh nirantar qabr ke azaab mein rahega, yahaan tak ki use Allah uske us sone ke sthaan se jeewit karke uthayega."
11212: Bara bin aazib -radiyallahu anhu- ki hadees ke aalok mein qabr ki nemton aur yaatnaon ka warnan

Bara bin aazib -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki ham Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath ek ansaari ke janaaze mein nikle. Ham qabr ke paas pahunche. Abhi murde ko dafan karne ka kaary sanpann nahin hua tha. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- baith gae aur ham bhi aapke aas-paas baith gae. Aisa prateet ho raha tha, jaise hamaare saron par pakshi baithe hon. Aapke haath mein ek lakri thi, jisse aap dharti ko kured rahe the. Isi beech aapne apna sar uthaya aur farmayaah "Qabr ke azaab se Allah ki panaah maango." Aapne yeh baat do ya teen baar kahi.
Ek riwayat mein yeh izaafa haih "Murda, logon ke jooton ki aahat sunta hai, jab log wahaan se waapas chal dete hain auraus samay usse kaha jaata hai ki ai amuk, tera rab kaun hai, tera deen kya hai aur tera Nabi kaun hai?
Hannaad kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Uske paas do farishte aate hain, use bithaate hain aur usse kahte hainh tera rab kaun hai? Woh kahta haih mera rab Allah hai. Donon usse poochhte hainh tera dharm kya hai? Woh kahta haih mera dharm islaam hai. Phir donon usse poochhte hainh yeh kaun hain, jo tumhaare beech bheje gae the?" Aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- farmaate hain: "Woh kahta haih woh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- hain. Donon farishte kahte hainh tumhen kaise pata chala? Woh kahta haih mainne Allah ki kitaab parhi aur us par wishvaas kiya tatha uski pushti ki."
Jareer -radiyallahu anhu- ki hadees mein yeh izaafa haih isi ka zikr sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ke is farmaan mein haih {يُثَبِّتُ اللهُ الذين آمنوا} (Allah un logon ko, jo eemaan laye, sthirta pradaan karta hai.) [soora ibraaheemah 27]
(Phir donon ki riwayton ke shabd ek jaise hain) : Aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Tab ek aawaaz dene waala aakaash se aawaaz deta haih mere bande ne sach kaha hai. Atah, uske liye Jannat ka bichhauna bichha do, uske liye Jannat ki or ek dvaar khol do aur use Jannat ka wastr pahna do." Aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- farmaate hainh "Phir uske paas Jannat ki hawa aur uski khushbu aane lagti hai." Aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- farmaate hainh "Uski qabr ko wahaan tak phaila diya jaata hai, jahaan tak uski nazar jaye." Phir aapne kaafir ki mrityu ka zikr kiya aur farmayaah "Uski rooh ko uske shareer mein lautaya jaata hai aur uske paas do farishte aate hain tatha use uthaakar bithaate hain aur usse kahte hainh tera rab kaun hai? Woh kahta haih hay, hay! Main nahin jaanta. Donon kahte hainh tera dharm kiya hai? Woh kahta haih hay, hay,hay! Main nahin jaanta. Donon kahte hainh yeh vyakti kaun hain, jo tumhaare beech bheje gae the? Woh kahta haih hay, hay! Main nahin jaanta. Itne mein ek aawaaz dene waala aakaash se aawaaz deta haih isne jhuth kaha hai. Atah, iske liye aag ka bichhauna bichha do, ise aag ka wastr pahna do aur iske liye Jahannam ki or ek dvaar khol do." Aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- farmaate hainh "Iske baad uske paas Jahannam ki tapish aur uski garm hawa aati rahti hai." Aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- farmaate hainh "Tatha uski qabr ko uske oopar tang kar diya jaata hai, yahaan tak ki uski ek taraf ki pasliyaan doosri taraf a jaati hain."
Jareer -radiyallahu anhu- ki hadees mein yeh izaafa hai ki aapne farmayaah "Phir us par ek andhe tatha goonge farishte ko nirdhaarit kar diya jaata hai, jiske paas lohe ka ek hathora hota hai ki yadi use parvat par maara jaye, to woh mitti ban jaye." Aap farmaate hainh "Woh farishta us hathore se use aisi maar maarta hai ki jise poorab aur pashchim ke beech ki saari cheezen, insaan aur jinn ke siwa,sunti hain aur woh mitti ban jaata hai." Aap farmaate hainh "Phir usmen jaan lauta di jaati hai."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11213: Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne madeene ke ek qile ke oopar charhkar neeche ki or dekha aur farmayaah "Kya tum woh dekh rahe ho, jo main dekh raha hoon?" Sahaaba ne kahaah nahin! To farmayaah "Main dekh raha hoon ki tumhaare gharon ke beech fitne aise utar rahe hain, jaise (tez) baarish barasti ho."

Usaama bin zaid -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne madeene ke ek qile ke oopar charhkar neeche ki or dekha aur farmayaah "Kya tum woh dekh rahe ho, jo main dekh raha hoon?" Sahaaba ne kahaah nahin! To farmayaah "Main dekh raha hoon ki tumhaare gharon ke beech fitne aise utar rahe hain, jaise (tez) baarish barasti ho."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne madeene ke ek durg ke oopar ke ek oonche sthaan se dekha aur apne saathiyon se kaha : Kya tum woh dekh rahe ho, jo main dekh raha hoon? Main dekh raha hoon ki fitne tumhaare gharon ke beech is tarah utar rahe hain, jaise bheeshan warsha ho rahi ho. Iske zariye daraasal ishaara hai madeene mein hone waale yuddhon tatha wahaan saamne aane waale fitnon jaise usmaan -radiyallahu anhu- ki shahaadat ki ghatna aur harra ki ghatna aadi ki or.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11214: Qayaamat se pahle chhah nishaaniyaan saamne ayengi, unhen gin lo.

Auf bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki main tabook yuddh ke mauqe par Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke yahaan pahuncha. Us samay aap chamre ke ek kheme mein tashreeph pharma the. Aapne farmayaah "Qayaamat se pahle chhah nishaaniyaan saamne ayengi, unhen gin loh meri mrityu, phir baitul maqdis par wijay ki praapti, phir (mahaamaari ke kaaran) bari sankhya mein tumhaari mrityu jaise taaoon se bakriyon ki mrityu hoti hai, phir maal ki is had tak bahutayat ki ek vyakti ko sau deenaar bhi diye jayen to woh naaraaz ho jaye, phir aise fitne ka prakat hona ki arab ka koi ghar usse achhoota na rahe, phir ek sulah jo tumhaare aur roomiyon ke beech hogi, parantu we dhokha kar jayenge aur tumse yuddh ke liye assi jhandon ke neeche ekatr hokar ayenge, jinmen se har jhande ke neeche baarah hazaar sainik honge.
11215: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmayaah "Mujhe aur qayaamat ko is tarah bheja gaya hai." Yeh kahte samay aapne apni donon ungliyon ko phailaakar unse ishaara kiya.

Sahal bin saad -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmayaah "Mujhe aur qayaamat ko is tarah bheja gaya hai." Yeh kahte samay aapne apni donon ungliyon ko phailaakar unse ishaara kiya.

Yahaan Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne qayaamat ke nikat hone ki baat kahi hai. Kyonki aapka Nabi bankar aana tatha qayaamat ka din, donon ek-doosre se nikat hain, bilkul usi tarah, jis tarah aapki donon ungliyaan ek-doosre se nikat hain. Aisa bataate samay aapne apni donon ungliyon ko phailaakar dikhaya hai, taaki unhen any ungliyon se alag dikhaya ja sake.
Kuchh any hadeeson mein aya hai ki yeh donon ungliyaan tarjani evn madhyama theen. Hadees mein tarjani ke liye "Al-sabbaaba" Ka shabd aya hai, jisse muraad angootha evn madhyama ke beech ki ungli hai. Agar aap tarjani evn madhyama ko milaakar dekhen, to payenge ki donon ek-doosre se nikat hain aur unke beech doori bahut hi kam hai. Unke beech doori kewal naakhoon ke baraabar ya aadhe naakhoon ke baraabar hai. Yaad rahe ki arbi mein tarjani ko "Al-sabbaaba" Isliye kaha jaata hai ki insaan kisi ko gaali dete samay usi se ishaara karta hai. Waise, use "As-sabbaaha" Bhi kaha jaata hai. Kyonki insaan Allah ki mahaanta bayaan karte samay bhi usi ko uthaakar aakaash ki or ishaara karta hai. Is hadees ka matlab yeh hai ki duniya ka ant nikat hai, kuchh door nahin.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11216: Qayaamat us samay tak nahin ayegi, jab tak hijaaz ki bhoomi se aisi aag na nikle, jisse busra mein maujood oonton ki garadnen chamak uthen.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmayaah "Qayaamat us samay tak nahin ayegi, jab tak hijaaz ki bhoomi se aisi aag na nikle, jisse busra mein maujood oonton ki garadnen chamak uthen."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11218: Meri ummat ke antim zamaane mein ek khaleefa hoga, jo gine bina lap bhar-bharkar logon ko maal dega.

Abu nazra ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki ham jaabir bin abdullah -radiyallahu anhuma- ke paas baithe the ki unhonne kahaah sheeghr hi aisa hoga ki iraaq ke log ke paas qafeez aur dirham aana band hojaye . Hamne kahaah iska zimmewaar kaun hoga? Farmayaah aisa karne mein ghair-arbon ka haath hoga, we qafeez aur dirham rok lenge . Phir farmayaah sheeghr hi aisa hoga ki shaam ke log ke paas apne deenaar aur gallon ka aana band hojaye . Hamne kahaah iska zimmewaar kaun hoga? Farmayaah aisa roomiyon ki or se hoga. Phir kuchh der khaamosh rahe aur farmayaah Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka farmaan haih "Meri ummat ke antim zamaane mein ek khaleefa hoga, jo gine bina lap bhar-bharkar logon ko maal dega." Warnankarta kahte hainh mainne abu nazra aur abul-ala se poochha ki kya aap samajhte hain ki is khaleefa se muraad umar bin abdul azeez hain? Donon ne kahaah nahin!
11219: Tum arab upamhaadveep ke kaafiron se yuddh karoge aur Allah is kshetr mein tumhen wijay pradaan karega, phir faaras kshetr ke logon se yuddh karoge aur is kshetr mein bhi Allah wijay pradaan karega, phir tum room kshetr ke logon se yuddh karoge aur is kshetr ko bhi Allah tumhaare adheen kar dega aur phir tum dajjaal se yuddh karoge aur Allah use paraast karega.

Naafe bin utba -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hainh ham ek yuddh mein Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath the. Woh kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas pashchim ki or se kuchh log aye, jo ooni wastr dhaaran kiye hue the. We Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se ek teele ke paas aakar mile. We khare the aur Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- baithe hue the. Unka kahna hai ki mere dil ne mujhse kahaah unke paas jaao tatha unke evn aapke beech khare ho jaao taaki kaheen we aapko dhokhe se qatl na kar den. Woh kahte hainh phir mainne apne ji mein kahaah sanbhav hai ki aap unke saath kuchh gupt baaten kar rahe hon. Phir main wahaan chala gaya aur unke tatha aapke beech khara ho gaya. Woh kahte hain ki mainne aap se chaar baaten seekheen, jinhen main apne haath par ginta hoonh aapne farmayaah "Tum arab upamhaadveep ke kaafiron se yuddh karoge aur Allah is kshetr mein tumhen wijay pradaan karega, phir faaras kshetr ke logon se yuddh karoge aur is kshetr mein bhi Allah wijay pradaan karega, phir tum room kshetr ke logon se yuddh karoge aur is kshetr ko bhi Allah tumhaare adheen kar dega aur phir tum dajjaal se yuddh karoge aur Allah use paraast karega." Warnankarta kahte hain ki naafe ne kahaah ai jaabir, ham samajhte hain ki dajjaal rum-wijay ke baad hi niklega.
11221: Meri ummat ke do giroh aise hain, jinhen Allah ne aag se surakshit kar diya hai; ek giroh jo hind ki bhoomi par yuddh karega aur doosra giroh jo eesa bin maryam -alaihimassalaam- ka saath dega.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke mukt kiye hue daas saubaan -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki aapne farmayaah "Meri ummat ke do giroh aise hain, jinhen Allah ne aag se surakshit kar diya hai; ek giroh jo hind ki bhoomi par yuddh karega aur doosra giroh jo eesa bin maryam -alaihimassalaam- ka saath dega."
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11222: Qayaamat us samay tak nahin a sakti, jab tak tum turkon se yuddh na kar lo, jinki aankhen chhoti-chhoti, chehre laal aur naak chhoti tatha chipti hogi, tatha unke chehre aise maaloom honge jaise chamre charhi hui dhaalen hon. Tatha qayaamat us samay tak nahin ayegi, jab tak tum ek aise samuday se yuddh na kar lo, jinke joote baalon ke honge.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmayaah "Qayaamat us samay tak nahin a sakti, jab tak tum turkon se yuddh na kar lo, jinki aankhen chhoti-chhoti, chehre laal aur naak chhoti tatha chipti hogi, tatha unke chehre aise maaloom honge jaise chamre charhi hui dhaalen hon. Tatha qayaamat us samay tak nahin ayegi, jab tak tum ek aise samuday se yuddh na kar lo, jinke joote baalon ke honge."

11223: Qayaamat us samay tak nahin ayegi, jab tak tum khooz aur kirmaan ke ghairaarab logon se yuddh na kar lo, jinke chehre laal, naak chipti aur aankhen chhoti-chhoti hongi. Unke chehre chamre charhi hui dhaalon ki tarah prateet honge. Unke joote baalon se bane honge.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Qayaamat us samay tak nahin ayegi, jab tak tum khooz aur kirmaan ke ghairaarab logon se yuddh na kar lo, jinke chehre laal, naak chipti aur aankhen chhoti-chhoti hongi. Unke chehre chamre charhi hui dhaalon ki tarah prateet honge. Unke joote baalon se bane honge."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11227: \uski qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, logon par ek aisa samay ayega ki qatl karne waale ko pata nahin hoga ki usne kis baat par qatl kiya aur qatl hone waale ko pata nahin hoga ki use kis baat par qatl kiya gaya.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Uski qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, logon par ek aisa samay ayega ki qatl karne waale ko pata nahin hoga ki usne kis baat par qatl kiya aur qatl hone waale ko pata nahin hoga ki use kis baat par qatl kiya gaya."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne Allah ki qasam khaate hue, jo aapke praan ka maalik hai, kaha hai ki logon par ek samay aisa ayega ki kisi ka wadh karne waale ko pata nahin hoga ki usne wadh kyon kiya, aur jiska wadh kiya jayega use bhi pata nahin hoga ki uska wadh kyon kiya gaya. Aisa daraasal wadh ki ghatnayen bahut zyaada hone ki wajah se hoga.
11229: Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne zuhar athva asr ki namaz -Muhammad bin seereen kahte hain ki mujhe yahi lagta hai ki woh asr ki namaz thi- do rakaat parhi aur salaam pher diya. Uske baad masjid ke agle bhaag mein gari hui ek lakri ke paas gae aur us par apna haath rakha.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne juhar athva asr ki namaz -Muhammad bin seereen kahte hain ki mujhe yahi lagta hai ki woh asr ki namaz thi- do rakaat parhi aur salaam pher diya. Uske baad masjid ke agle bhaag mein gari hui ek lakri ke paas gae aur us par apna haath rakha. Logon ke beech abu bakr aur umar -radiyallahu anhuma- bhi upasthit the. Lekin, donon ne aapse baat karne mein bhay mahsoos kiya. Udhar, jaldabaaz log nikal gae aur kahne lage ki kya namaz kam kar di gai hai? Us samay ek vyakti, jise Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- 'zul-yadain' (do haath waale) kahkar pukaarte the, bhi maujood the . Unhonne kahaah (ai Allah ke Rasool) kya aap bhool gae hain ya namaz kam ho gai hai? Aapne uttar diyaah "Na main bhoola hoon aur na namaz kam ki gai hai." Unhonne kahaah nahin, aap zaroor bhoole hain. Tab aapne do rakaat parhi, phir salaam phera, phir takbeer kahi aur apne aam sajdon ke samaan ya unse lanba sajda kiya, phir apna sar uthaya, takbeer kahi, phir apna sar rakha, takbeer kahi aur apne aam sajdon ke samaan ya unse lanba sajda kiya, phir apna sar uthaya aur takbeer kahi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11231: Jab tummen se kisi ko namaz mein sandeh ho jaye aur yaad na rahe ki kitni rakaat parhi hai, teen athva chaar? To sandeh ko pare daal de aur jis par yaqeen ho, use aadhaar banaye. Phir salaam pherne se pahle do sajde kar le.

Abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jab tummen se kisi ko namaz mein sandeh ho jaye aur yaad na rahe ki kitni rakaat parhi hai, teen athva chaar? To sandeh ko pare daal de aur jis par yaqeen ho, use aadhaar banaye. Phir salaam pherne se pahle do sajde kar le. Aise mein, agar usne paanch rakaaten parh li hain, to do sajde uski namaz ko sam sankhya waali namaz bana denge aur agar usne poori chaar rakaat parhi hai, to donon sajde shaitaan ke apmaan ka saamaan ban jayenge."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jab kisi namaazi ko apni namaz ki rakaaton ke baare mein sandeh ho jaye aur pata na chal sake ki teen rakaat parhi hai ya chaar rakaat, to jis atirikt rakaat ke baare mein sandeh ho, use shumaar na kare. Maslan agar teen aur chaar ke baare mein sandeh ho, to teen rakaat yaqeeni hain, isliye chauthi rakaat parh le aur salaam pherne se pahle do sajde kar le.

Aise mein agar usne pahle hi chaar rakaaten parh li theen, to baad ki ek rakaat milaakar paanch rakaaten ho gaeen, aur sahv ke do sajde ek rakaat ke sthaan par ho gae. Is tarah rakaaten wisham nahin, sam ho gaeen. Iske wipreet agar atirikt rakaat ko milaakar chaar rakaat parhi hai, to usne theek utni rakaaten parh li hain, jitni parhni chahiye theen.

Aise sahv ke donon sajde shaitaan ki zillat wa rusvaai ka saamaan  aur use naakaam wa naamuraad waapas karne ki nishaani honge. Kyonki shaitaan ne namaz parh rahe vyakti ki namaz kharaab karne ki koshish to ki thi, lekin usne use usi sajde dvaara durust kar liya, jise karne se iblees ne inkaar kar diya tha, jab usne aadam ko sajda karne ke sanbandh mein Allah ke aadesh ka paalan karne se inkaar kar diya tha.

Namaz parh rahe vyakti ko jab namaz ki rakaaton ke baare mein sandeh ho jaye aur yaqeen ke saath nirnay na le sake ki kitni rakaat parhi hai, to sandeh ko door rakhkar yaqeen ke anusaar kaam kare. Yaani kam ko durust maankar namaz poori kare aur salaam pherne se pahle sahv ke sajde karke salaam phere.
Sahv ke donon sajde daraasal namaz ke andar a jaane waali kami ko door karne aur shaitaan ko naakaam wa naamuraad waapas karne ka zariya hain.
Is hadees mein jis sandeh ka zikr hai, usse muraad aisa shak hai, jismen koi rujhaan na paya jaye. Agar koi rujhaan paya jaye aur man ka jhukaav usi ki or ho, to usi par amal kiya jayega.
Shaitaan ki or se dil mein daale jaane waale bure khyaalon se larne aur shareeyat ke aadesh ka paalan karke unhen door hataane ki prerna.
11232: Agar namaz ke baare mein koi naya aadesh aya hota, to main tumhen zaroor bata deta. Lekin main bhi tumhaari tarah ek insaan hoon, jis tarah tum bhoolte ho, main bhi bhoolta hoon. Isliye jab main bhool jaaoon, to mujhe yaad dila diya karo. Aur tummen se jise apni namaz mein shak ho, woh sochkar yeh jaanne ka prayaas kare ki sahi mayne mein kitni rakaat parhi hai, phir usi ke anusaar apni namaz poori kare. Phir salaam phere aur do sajde kar le.

Abdullah bin masaood -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne namaz parhi. -ibraaheem kahte hainh mujhe nahin maaloom ki aapne namaz mein kuchh izaapha kar diya tha ya kami kar di thi.- jab salaam phera, to aapse kaha gayaah ai Allah ke Rasool, kya namaz ke baare mein koi naya aadesh aya hai? Aapne pharmayaah "Woh kya hai?" Sahaaba ne kahaah aapne itni-itni rakaat parhi hai! Yeh sun aapne apne donon pairon ko mora aur qible ki or munh karke do sajde kiye. Phir salaam phera aur hamaari taraf munh karke pharmayaah "Agar namaz ke baare mein koi naya aadesh aya hota, to main tumhen zaroor bata deta. Lekin main bhi tumhaari tarah ek insaan hoon, jis tarah tum bhoolte ho, main bhi bhoolta hoon. Isliye jab main bhool jaaoon, to mujhe yaad dila diya karo. Aur tummen se jise apni namaz mein shak ho, woh sochkar yeh jaanne ka prayaas kare ki sahi mayne mein kitni rakaat parhi hai, phir usi ke anusaar apni namaz poori kare. Phir salaam phere aur do sajde kar le."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11234: Hamen mugheera bin shoba ne namaz parhaai aur do rakaat ke baad khare ho gae. Hamne 'subhaanallah' kaha, to unhonne bhi 'subhaanallah' kaha aur namaz jaari rakhi. Jab namaz poori karke salaam pher chuke to, truti ke do sajde kar liye. Jab namaz se baahar a gae, to farmayaah mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko aisa hi karte dekha hai, jaisa mainne kiya hai.

Ziyaad bin alaaqa kahte hain ki hamen mugheera bin shoba ne namaz parhaai aur do rakaat ke baad khare ho gae. Hamne 'subhaanallah' kaha, to unhonne bhi 'subhaanallah' kaha aur namaz jaari rakhi. Jab namaz poori karke salaam pher chuke to, truti ke do sajde kar liye. Jab namaz se baahar a gae, to farmayaah mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko waisa hi karte dekha hai, jaisa mainne kiya hai.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11236: Har truti ke liye salaam pherne ke baad do sajde hain.
Saubaan -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Har truti ke liye salaam pherne ke baad do sajde hain."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11237: Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ne unhen namaz parhaate samay soora «إذا السماء انْشَقَّتْ» parhi aur tilaawat ka sajda kiya. Jab namaz parh chuke, to unhonne bataya ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bhi is soora mein sajda kiya hai.

Abu raafe ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ne unhen namaz parhaate samay soora «إذا السماء انْشَقَّتْ» parhi aur tilaawat ka sajda kiya. Jab namaz parh chuke, to unhonne bataya ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bhi is soora mein sajda kiya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11238: Soora “Saad” ka sajda un sajdon mein nahin hai jo aniwaary hain. Albatta mainne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko ismen sajda karte dekha hai.

Ibne abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki soora “Saad” ka sajda un sajdon mein nahin hai jo aniwaary hain. Albatta mainne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko ismen sajda karte dekha hai.
11240: Mainne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saamne soora 'najm' tilaawat ki, to aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne usmen sajda nahin kiya.

Zaid bin saabit -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saamne soora 'najm' tilaawat ki, to aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne usmen sajda nahin kiya.
11241: Mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha ki kya soora 'hajj' mein do sajde hain? To farmayaah "Haan, tatha jo donon sajde na karna chaahe, woh un donon ayton ko na parhe."

Uqba bin aamir -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha ki kya soora 'hajj' mein do sajde hain? To farmayaah "Haan, tatha jo donon sajde na karna chaahe, woh un donon ayton ko na parhe."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11242: Umar bin khattaab -radiyallahu anhu- ne jume ke din khutbe mein soora 'an-nahl' parhi. Jab sajde ki ayat mein aye, to neeche utre aur sajda kiya. Logon ne bhi aapke saath sajda kiya.

Rabeeya bin abdullah bin hudair taimi ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki umar bin khattaab -radiyallahu anhu- ne jume ke din khutbe mein soora 'an-nahl' parhi. Jab sajde ki ayat mein aye, to neeche utre aur sajda kiya. Logon ne bhi aapke saath sajda kiya. Phir jab agla juma aya, to wahi soora parhi. Parantu, jab sajde ki ayat mein pahuche, to farmayaah logo, ham sajde ki ayat se guzar rahe hain. Ab, jisne sajda kiya, usne achchha kiya aur jisne sajda nahin kiya, us par koi gunaah nahin hai. Tatha mar -radiyallahu anhu- ne sajda nahin kiya. Ek riwayat mein haih Allah ne sajda farz nahin kiya hai. Ham karna chaahen, to kar sakte hain.
11244: Jab aapke paas koi khushi ki baat aati ya aap ko koi khushkhabri di jaati, to Allah ke shukraane ke taur par sajde mein chal jaate.

Abu bakra -radiyallahu anhu- Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke baare mein kahte hain ki jab aapke paas koi khushi ki baat aati ya aapko koi khushkhabri di jaati , to Allah ke shukraane ke taur par sajde mein chal jaate.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11248: Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- fajr prakat hone ke baad do halki rakaaten parha karte the.

Hafsa -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- fajr prakat hone ke baad do halki rakaaten parha karte the. Ek any riwayat mein haih jamaat khari hone se pahle.

Is hadees mein hafsa -radiyallahu anha- ne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka haal bayaan kiya hai ki aap fajr prakat hone ke baad do rakaat namaz parhte the, jo fajr ki sunnat hua karti thi. Aap iske atirikt koi any namaz nahin parhte the. Kyonki saheeh Muslim mein hafsa -radiyallahu anha- se warnit hai ki unhonne farmaya : "Jab fajr ho jaati, to kewal do halki rakaaten parha karte the."
Is hadees mein aye hue "Halki" Shabd ka arth yeh hai ki aap qayaam, ruku aur sajda halke andaaz mein karte the. Donon rakaaten halki itni hoti theen ki saheeh Bukhari ki ek riwayat ke anusaar aaisha -radiyallahu anha- kahti theen : "Main is baat ka nirnay nahin kar paati ki aapne soora faatiha parhi bhi hai ya nahin?" Jabki muwatta ki ek riwayat mein hai : "Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- fajr ki do rakaaten itni halki parhte the ki main man mein kahti : Pata nahin aapne soora faatiha parhi bhi hai ya nahin?" Lekin iska matlab yeh nahin hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- itni jaldabaazi se kaam lete ki qayaam, ruku evn sajda aadi namaz ke stanbhon ko poorn roop se ada nahin karte, balki iska sahi arth yeh hai ki any nafal namaazon ki tulna mein, jinhen aapko lanba parhte dekha jaata tha, in do rakaaton ko halka parhte the.
"Fajr prakat hone ke baad" Yaani fajr hone ke baad hi awilanb inhen ada kar lete the. "Jamaat khari hone se pahle." Isse maaloom hota hai ki fajr ki do rakaaton ka samay fajr prakat hone se lekar subah ki namaz tak hai.
11249: Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- zuhar se pahle ki chaar rakaaten aur fajr se pahle ki do rakaaten nahin chhorte the.
Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai ki : Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- zuhar se pahle ki chaar rakaaten aur fajr se pahle ki do rakaaten nahin chhorte the.

Aaisha radiyallahu anha bataati hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- nimnalikhit do nafal namaazon ko paabandi se apne ghar mein parhte the aur inhen chhorte nahin the : Zuhar se pahle do salaam se chaar rakaat aur fajr ki namaz se pahle do rakaat.

Zuhar ki namaz se pahle chaar rakaat aur fajr ki namaz se pahle do rakaat namaz paabandi se parhna musathab hai.
Sabse uttam yeh hai ki rawaatib (muakkad sunnaton) ko ghar mein parha jaye. Yahi kaaran hai ki aaisha radiyallahu anha ne unke baare mein yeh soochna di hai.
11251: Jisne zuhar se pahle aur zuhar ke baad chaar-chaar rakaaten paabandi se parheen, Allah uspar Jahannam ki aag haraam kar dega.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki patni umm-e-habeeba radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : "Jisne zuhar se pahle aur zuhar ke baad chaar-chaar rakaaten paabandi se parheen, Allah uspar Jahannam ki aag haraam kar dega."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne zuhar ki namaz se pahle chaar rakaat tatha uske baad chaar rakaat nafal paabandi se parhne waale ko susmaachaar sunaya hai ki use Allah Jahannam par haraam kar dega.

Zuhar ki namaz se pahle chaar rakaat aur uske baad chaar rakaat paabandi se parhna musathab hai.
Farz namaz se pahle parhi jaane waali sunnaton ki kuchh hikamten hain, jinmen se ek yeh hai ki farz namaz shuru karne se pahle namaazi ka dil ibaadat ke liye taiyaar ho jaye. Jabki farz namaz ke baad parhi jaane waali sunnaton ki hikamton mein se ek hikmat yeh hai ki farz namaazon ke andar rah jaane waali kami tatha kotaahi ki poorti ho jaye.
Namaz se pahle aur baad mein parhi jaane waali sunnaton ke kai bare-bare fayde hain. Jaise nekiyon mein wriddhi, gunaahon ki maafi aur darjon mein bulandi.
Waadon par aadhaarit is prakaar ki hadeeson ke baare mein ahl-e-sunnat ka ka siddhaant yeh hai ki inka arth tauheed (ekeshvarvaad) ke saath mrityu ke roop mein ki jaye aur muraad Jahannam mein hamesha na rahna li jaye. Kyonki ekeshvarvaad awajnaakaari saza ka haqdaar to hai, lekin saza paane ki awastha mein Jahannam mein hamesha nahin rahega.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, nasai, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
11252: Allah us aadmi par raham kare, jisne asr se pahle chaar rakaat parhi.

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Allah us aadmi par raham kare, jisne asr se pahle chaar rakaat parhi."
Yeh hadees asr se pahle chaar rakaat nafal parhne ki fazeelat bayaan karti hai. Fazeelat yeh hai ki aapne uske liye rahmat ki dua ki hai.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11253: Maghrib se pahle do rakaat parho.

Abdullah bin mughaffal muzni -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Maghrib se pahle do rakaat parho." Phir farmayaah "Maghrib se pahle do rakaat parho. Yeh aadesh uske liye hai, jo svechchha se aisa karna chaahe." Aapne aisa is bhay se kaha ki kaheen log use sunnat na thahra len.
11256: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne fajr ki do rakaaton mein {قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ} aur {قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ} parhi.
Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne fajr ki do rakaaton mein {قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ} aur {قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ} parhi.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- fajr se pahle ki do rakaat sunnat ki pahli rakaat mein soora faatiha ke baad soora kaafiroon tatha doosri rakaat mein  soora ikhlaas parhna pasand karte the.

Fajr ki sunnat mein soora faatiha ke baad in donon soorton ko parhna mustahab hai.
In donon sooron ko soora ikhlaas kaha jaata hai. Kyonki soora kaafiroon mein Allah ke siwa pooji jaane waali tamaam cheezon se bari hone ka elaan kiya gaya hai aur bataya gaya hai ki mushrik Allah ke bande nahin hain, kyonki unka shirk unke karm ko nasht kar deta hai. Uchch evn mahaan Allah hi ibaadat ka haqdaar hai. Jabki soora ikhlaas ke andar ekeshvarvaad, bas ek Allah ki ibaadat aur Allah ke gunon ka bayaan hai.
11257: Jab muazzin fajr ki namaz ki azaan dekar khaamosh ho jaata, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- khare hote aur fajr ki namaz se pahle halki-halki do rakaaten parhte. Yeh fajr ka samay ho jaane ke baad ki baat hai. Phir baaeen karvat par let jaate, yahaan tak muazzin iqaamat ke liye aata.

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki jab muazzin fajr ki namaz ki azaan dekar khaamosh ho jaata, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- khare hote aur fajr ki namaz se pahle do halki-halki rakaaten parhte. Yeh fajr ka samay ho jaane ke baad ki baat hai. Phir baaeen karvat par let jaate, yahaan tak muazzin iqaamat ke liye aata.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11258: Jab tum mein se koi subah (fajr) se pahle do rakaaten parhe, to daaeen karvat par let jaye.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Jab tummen se koi subah se pahle do rakaaten parhe, to daaeen karvat par let jaye." Yeh sun marvaan ne kahaah kya hammen se kisi ka masjid chalkar jaana kaafi nahin hai ki use daaeen karvat par letna bhi hoga? Ubaidullah apni hadees mein kahte hain ki abu huraira -radiyallahu tummen - ne uttar diyaah nahin! Warnankarta kahte hain ki iski jaankaari abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ko mili, to unhonne kahaah abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ne apni jaan par adhik bojh daal liya hai. Warnankarta kahte hain ki ibne umar -radiyallahu anhuma- se poochha gayaah kya woh jo kuchh kahte hain usmen se aap kisi cheez ka inkaar bhi karte hain? To farmayaah nahin! Lekin baat yeh hai ki unhonne hosla dikhaya aur ham darte rah gae. Warnankarta kahte hain iski jaankaari abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ko mili, to farmayaah yadi mainne yaad rakha aur we bhool gae, to ismen mera kya gunaah hai?
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11259: Ek vyakti ne Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se, jab aap minbar par the, poochha : Raat ki namaz ke baare mein aap kya kahte hain? Aapne pharmaya : "Do-do rakaat parha karo

Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ek vyakti ne Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se, jab aap minbar par the, poochha : Raat ki namaz ke baare mein aap kya kahte hain? Aapne pharmaya : "Do-do rakaat parha karo, phir jab subah ho jaane ka dar ho to ek rakaat parh lo, yeh uski parhi hui namaz ko witr (wisham) bana degi." Aur aap farmaya karte the : "Apni antim namaz witr ko banaao," Kyonki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne iska aadesh diya hai.

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam minbar par khare hokar khutba de rahe the ki ek vyakti ne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe sikhaaiye ki main raat ki namaz kaise parhoon? To aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Tum do-do rakaat parho aur har do rakaat par salaam phero. Phir jab tumhen subah ho jaane ka dar ho, to ek rakaat parh lo, jo tumhaari pichhli namaz ko witr bana degi. Aur aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam witr ko raat ki aakhiri namaz banaane ki taakeed farmaate the.

Mool roop se, raat ki pratyek namaz mein witr ke alaawa, har do rakaat par salaam pherna hai.
Raat ki namaz kisi nishchit sankhya mein seemit nahin hai; kyonki iske shabd vyaapak hain.
Navvi kahte hain : "Raat aur din ki (nafl) namaz do-do rakaat hai.", is hadees mein uttam tareeqe ka bayaan hai, aur woh yeh hai ki har do rakaat par salaam phera jaye. Raat aur din donon ki nafl namaazon mein, yahi mustahab hai ki har do rakat par salaam phera jaye.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees mein is baat ki daleel hai ki sunnat yeh hai ki witr ko raat ki antim namaz banaya jaye aur uska samay fajr ke uday hone par samaapt ho jaata hai. Yahi hamaare mazhab ka mashhoor qaul (kathan) hai aur jamhoor ulma ka bhi yahi kahna hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
11260: Raat aur din ki namaz do-do rakaat hai.
Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmayaah "Raat aur din ki namaz do-do rakaat hai."

Is hadees ki asal saheeh Bukhari evn saheeh Muslim mein in shabdon ke saath hai : "Raat ki namaz do-do rakaat hai." Lekin kisi warnankarta ne yahaan "Din" Ka izaafa kar diya. Jabki yeh izaafa durbal hai. Iska arth hai, jo din athva raat mein nafal parhna chaahe, woh har do rakaat ke baad salaam pher de. Ise spasht roop se saheeh Muslim ki ek riwayat mein abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ne bayaan kar diya hai. Jab unse poochha gaya ki "Do-do rakaat ka kya matlab hai?" To unhonne uttar diya : "Iska matlab yeh hai ki tum har do rakaat ke baad salaam pher do."
Raat ki namaz ke baare mein adhiktar ulema ka yahi mat hai. Yaani raat ki namaz mein ek salaam se do rakaat se adhik parhna jayaz nahin hai. Haan, witr ki namaz ki baat alag hai. Usmen ek salaam se do rakaat se adhik parhi ja sakti hai. Kyonki aisa sunnat se saabit hai.
Rahi baat din ki namaz ki, to waise to do rakaat se zyaada parhne mein koi harj nahin hai, lekin do-do rakaat parhna hi shreshth hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11261: Ramzan ke baad sabse shreshth roze Allah ke maheene muharram ke roze hain tatha farz namaazon ke baad sabse uttam namaz raat ki namaz hai.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Ramzan ke baad sabse shreshth roze Allah ke maheene muharram ke roze hain tatha farz namaazon ke baad sabse uttam namaz raat ki namaz hai."

Muharram, jo ki hijri warsh ka pahla maheena hai, iske roze Ramzan ke rozon ke baad sabse shreshth roze hain. Kyonki yeh nae warsh ka aaranbhik bhaag hai, atah ise roze se shuru karna, jo ki prakaash hai, sabse shreshth kaary hai. Atah har musalmaan ko chahiye ki is maheene mein roza rakhne ki koshish kare aur ise bina kisi kaaran ke na chhore.
Is hadees mein ise Allah ka maheena kaha gaya hai, jo iske sammaan evn any maheenon se iski wishishtata ko pradarshit karta hai.
Isi tarah is hadees mein bataya gaya hai ki farz namaazon ke baad raat ki namaz sabse shreshth nafal hai. Kyonki raat ke samay hriday mein paida hone waali ekaagrata aur ekaant mein apne prabhu ko yaad karne ke phalasvaroop is namaz mein Allah ke bhay evn wismay ka bodh adhik teevr hota hai. Allah ka farmaan hai : "Nihsandeh raat ki ibaadat hriday mein adhik prabhaawi hoti hai aur baat ke liye adhik upyukt hoti hai." [soora al-muzzammil : 6] isi tarah raat aaraam tatha raahat ka samay hota hai. Atah is samay ko ibaadat mein lagaana choonki nafs par any samay ko ibaadat mein lagaane ki tulna mein adhik kathin hota hai aur isse shareer ko adhik thakaawat ka saamna karna parta hai, isliye ismen bandgi ka izhaar adhik hota hai aur yeh Allah ke nikat bhi adhik shreshth hai.
11262: Witr haq hai.Ab, jo chaahe saat rakaat ke saath witr banaye, jo chaahe paanch rakaat rakaat ke saath witr banaye, jo chaahe teen rakaat ke saath witr banaye aur jo chaahe ek rakaat ke saath witr banaye.

Abu ayyoob ansaari -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmayaah "Witr haq hai. Ab, jo chaahe saat rakaat ke saath witr banaye, jo chaahe paanch rakaat rakaat ke saath witr banaye, jo chaahe teen rakaat ke saath witr banaye aur jo chaahe ek rakaat ke saath witr banaye."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11263: Witr farz namaazon ki tarah aniwaary nahin hai. Lekin, yeh sunnat hai. Ise Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne sunnat qaraar diya hai.
Ali -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hainh witr farz namaazon ki tarah aniwaary nahin hai. Lekin, yeh sunnat hai. Ise Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne sunnat qaraar diya hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11268: Ai aaisha ! Meri aankhen to so jaati hain magar mera dil nahin sota.

Abu salma bin abdurrahmaan se riwayat hai, woh bataate hain ki unhonne aaisha -radiyallahu anha- se poochha ki Ramzan mein rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki namaz kaisi hoti thi? Unhonne farmaya : “Rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Ramzan mein aur Ramzan ke alaawa dinon mein gyaarah rakaat se zyaada nahin parhte the, pahli chaar rakaaten aisi parhte ki unki khoobsoorti aur lambaai ke baare mein na poochho aur phir aap chaar rakaaten aisi hi parhte ki unki khoobsoorti aur lambaai ki haalat mat poochho . Phir teen rakaat parhte the .” aaisha radiyallahu anha farmaati hain ki mainne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ! Kya aap witr parhne se pahle sote rahte hain ? To aapne farmaya : “Meri aankhen to so jaati hain magar mera dil nahin sota.”

Is baat se sab log avgat the ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- Ramzan ka maheena ho ki koi aur maheena, raat mein uthkar namaazen parha karte the. Yahi kaaran hai ki abu salma -radiyallahu anhu- ne Ramzan ki raaton mein parhi jaane waali namaz ke baare mein poochha ki Ramzan mein aapki raat ki namaz, raakton ki sankhya ke maamle mein any maheenon ki tarah hi hoti thi ya phir kuchh alag hoti thi?
Iska uttar aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ne yeh diya ki aapki Ramzan tatha any maheenon ki raat ki namaz ke beech koi antar nahin hai. Kyonki aap aam taur par gyaarah rakaat parha karte the aur isse adhik nahin parhte the.
Phir unhonne abu salma -radiyallahu anhu- ko aapki raat ki namaz ki kaifiyat bataate hue farmaya : "Pahle chaar rakaat parhte" Iska matlab yeh hai ki pahle do rakaat parhne ke baad salaam pher dete aur uske baad do rakaat parhkar salaam pherte. Kyonki svayn aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ne is hadees mein sankshipt roop se kahi gai baat ki vyaakhya apni ek any hadees mein kar di hai, jo saheeh Muslim mein maujood hai. Woh kahti hain : "Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- isha ki namaz parhne ke baad se fazr tak gyaarah rakaat parhte the. Is dauraan har do rakaat ke beech salaam pherte the aur ek rakaat witr parhte the." Jabki ek any hadees mein hai : "Raat ki namaz do-do rakaat hai." Yeh hadees saheeh Bukhari evn saheeh Muslim mein warnit hai.
"Tum unki sundarta tatha lambaai ke baare mein na poochho." Yaani unki kaifiyat mat poochho. Woh shresht qiraat tatha qayaam, ruku evn sajde ki lambaai mein bari hi sundar evn sanpoorn hua karti theen.
Isi tarah antim chaar rakaaton ko bhi do-do rakaat parha karte the aur shreshth qiraat tatha qayaam, ruku evn sajde ki lambaai mein unki sundarta adbhut hua karti thi.
"Phir teen rakaat parhte the." In shabdon ka zaahir yeh bataata hai ki aap teen rakaat lagaataar parhte the aur unke beech mein salaam nahin pherte the. Lekin aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ki doosri riwayat ne spasht kar diya hai ki aap do rakaat ke baad salaam pher dete the aur uske baad ek rakaat witr parhte the. Us riwayat ke shabd hain : "Aap har do rakaat ke baad salaam pherte aur ek rakaat witr parhte the." Yeh hadees is baat ka pramaan hai ki aap teen rakaat witr parhte samay beech mein salaam pherte the.
"Aaisha radiyallahu anha- farmaati hain ki mainne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam! Kya aap witr parhne se pahle sote hain?" Yaani aap witr parhne se pahle kaise sote hain?
"To aapne farmaya : Ai aaisha! Meri aankhen to so jaati hain, magar mera dil nahin sota." Iska arth yeh hai ki jis tarah aapki aankhen anupasthit ho jaati hain, us tarah aapka dil anusthit nahin hota. Aap sab kuchh anubhav tatha mahsoos karte hain. Maslan aapko sone ki awastha mein bhi samay ka dhyaan tatha uski pahchaan rahti thi. Yahi kaaran hai ki nabiyon ka svapn wahy hua karta tha.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11269: Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam raat ko terah rakaat namaz parhte the, unheen mein witr aur phajr ki do rakaaten (sunnat) bhi shaamil hoti theen.

Aaisha radiyallahu anha se riwayat hai, woh farmaati hain : “Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam raat ko terah rakaat namaz parhte the, unheen mein witr aur phajr ki do rakaaten (sunnat) bhi shaamil hoti theen .”

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- bata rahi hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- raat mein, Ramzan ho ki koi aur maheena, terah rakaat namaz paabandi ke saath parhte the, jismen witr bhi shaamil thi. Isi tarah aap fajr ki do rakaat sunnat bhi paabandi se parhte the. Jnaat ho ki yahaan paabandi se parhne se muraad adhiktar samay parhna hai. Kyonki ek riwayat mein hai ki jab Ramzan ke antim das din prawesh karte, to unke andar Allah ke Rasool -salllahu alaihi wa sallam- any dinon ki tulna mein kaheen adhik ibaadat karte the. Lekin iska arth yeh bataya gaya hai ki aap rakaat lanbi kar lete the, sankhya nahin barhaate the.
