Jabki kabhi aap terah rakaat parhte the, kabhi gyaarah rakaat parhte the aur kabhi isse kam bhi parhte the, is baat ke bhi pramaan hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11270: Ai abdullah ! Phalaan aadmi ki tarah na ho jaana ki woh raat ko utha karta tha, phir usne raat mein qayaam karna chhor diya .

Abdullah bin amr bin aas radiyallahu anhuma se riwayat hai, unhonne kaha ki rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne mujh se farmaya : “Ai abdullah! Phalaan aadmi ki tarah na ho jaana ki woh raat ko (namaz ke liye) utha karta tha, phir usne raat mein qayaam karna chhor diya .”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11271: Ai Qur'an waalo ! Witr parha karo, nishchit hi Allah witr (wisham) hai tatha witr ko pasand karta hai.

Ali bin abu taalib -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Ai Qur'an waalo ! Witr parha karo, nishchit hi Allah witr (wisham) hai tatha witr ko pasand karta hai.”
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11272: Ek raat mein do witr nahin hain.

Qais bin talq se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Ramzan ke din mein talq bin ali radiyallahu anhu ham se milne ke liye aye, tatha shaam ke samay hamaare paas rahe aur iftaar kiya, phir raat mein hamen (raat ki) namaz parhaai aur (ant mein) hamen witr ki namaz bhi parhaai, phir apni masjid ki or gae tatha apne saathiyon ko namaz parhaai, yahaan tak ki jab witr ki namaz baaki rah gai to ek vyakti ko aage barhaya aur farmaya :Apne saathiyon ko witr ki namaz parhaao, kyonki mainne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko farmaate hue suna hai :“Ek raat mein do witr nahin hain.”
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11275: Subah hone se pahle witr ki namaz parh lo.
Abu saeed khudri -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : “Subah hone se pahle witr ki namaz parh lo.”

Witr, raat ki namaz ka ek bhaag hai aur isi se raat ki namaz ka samaapan hota hai, jaise ki din ki namaz ka samaapan maghrib se hota hai. Yeh hadees baataati hai ki witr ka samay fajr-e-saadiq se pahle tak rahta hai.
11277: Jo soya rah jaye aur witr na parh sake, athva bhool jaye, to use chahiye ki jab yaad aye tab parh le.
Abu saeed khudri -radiyallahu anhu- se marphooan riwayat hai : “Jo soya rah jaye aur witr na parh sake, athva bhool jaye, to use chahiye ki jab yaad aye tab parh le.”
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11278: Jisko yeh dar ho ki woh raat ke antim bhaag mein nahin uth payega to use chahiye ki pratham bhaag mein hi witr parh le, aur jise gumaan ho ki woh antim bhaag mein uth jayega use chahiye ki raat ke antim bhaag mein hi witr parhe, kyonki raat ke antim bhaag mein namaz parhna (pharishton ityaadi ke) haajir hone ka samay hai, tatha yeh behtar hai.

Jaabir -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Jisko yeh dar ho ki woh raat ke antim bhaag mein nahin uth payega to use chahiye ki pratham bhaag mein hi witr parh le, aur jise gumaan ho ki woh antim bhaag mein uth jayega use chahiye ki raat ke antim bhaag mein hi witr parhe, kyonki raat ke antim bhaag mein namaz parhna (pharishton ityaadi ke) haajir hone ka samay hai, tatha yeh behtar hai.”

Yeh hadees bataati hai ki witr ki namaz raat ke pratham bhaag mein bhi parhi ja sakti hai. Balki jise raat ke antim bhaag mein jaag na paane ka bhay ho, uske haq mein pratham bhaag mein parh lena hi behtar hai. Lekin saadhaarnatya ise raat ke antim bhaag mein parhna hi shreshth hai, kyonki us samay farishte upasthit rahte hain.
11280: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- chaasht ki namaz chaar rakaat parha karte the, aur jitna Allah chaahta utna usmen jyaada karte.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) chaasht ki namaz chaar rakaat parha karte the, aur jitna Allah chaahta utna usmen jyaada karte.
11281: Kya Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- chaasht ki namaz parha karte the? Unhonne kaha : Nahin, siway tab jab aap kisi yaatra se laut kar aate.

Abdullah bin shaqeeq se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se poochha : “Kya Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- chaasht ki namaz parha karte the? Unhonne kaha : “Nahin, siway tab jab aap kisi yaatra se laut kar aate.”
11282: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko koi amal pasand hota, iske baavjood use is dar se chhor dete ki kaheen log uspar amal karne lagen aur unpar farz kar diya jaye.

Aaisha radiyallahu anha se riwayat hai, woh farmaati hain : “Raallah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko koi amal pasand hota, iske baavjood use is dar se chhor dete ki kaheen log uspar amal karne lagen aur unpar farz kar diya jaye. Chunaanche rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne chaasht ki namaz kabhi (lagaataar) nahin parhi, lekin main parhti hoon .”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11283: Avvaabeen (nek logon) ki namaz us samay hoti hai jab oont ke bachchon ke paanv jalne lagen.

Zaid bin arqam -radiyallahu anhu- warnan karte hain ki unhonne kuchh logon ko dekha ki we chaasht ki namaz parh rahe hain, to unhonne kaha : Yaad rahe, ye log jaan len ki is samay ke alaawa doosre samay mein namaz parhna behtar hai, nishchit hi Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Avvaabeen (nek logon) ki namaz us samay hoti hai jab oont ke bachchon ke paanv jalne lagen.”
11286: “Jamaat ke saath namaz akele ki namaz se sawaab mein pachchees darje zyaada hai aur raat din ke pharishte phajr ki namaz mein jama hote hain.”

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : “Jamaat ke saath namaz akele ki namaz se sawaab mein pachchees darje zyaada hai aur raat din ke pharishte phajr ki namaz mein jama hote hain.” phir abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain : Agar chaaho to yeh ayat parh lo : “Phajr mein quraan ki tilaawat par pharishte haazir hote hain.” [soora al-isra : 78]

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- bata rahe hain ki ek vyakti dvaara imaam ke saath jamaat mein parhi gai ek namaz ka sawaab evn pratiphal, ghar ya baazaar mein akele parhi gai pachchees namaazon ke sawaab tatha pratiphal se uttam hai. Iske baad Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya ki raat aur din ke farishte fajr ki namaz mein ekatr ho jaate hain. Phir abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ne iska pramaan prastut karte hue farmaya :

Agar tum chaaho, to yeh ayat parh lo : "Nihsandeh fajr ki namaz (farishton ki) upasthiti ka samay hai." [soora isra : 78] yaani fajr ki namaz ke samay raat ke farishte tatha din ke farishte donon maujood rahte hain.

Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Masjid mein jamaat ke saath parhi gai namaz ghar aur baazaar mein jamaat ke saath tatha akele parhi gai namaz se behtar hai,(phir kaha:) yeh baat ibne daqeeq al eed ne kahi hai.
Is hadees se fajr ki namaz ki fazeelat maaloom hoti hai, kyonki iski wisheshta yeh hai ki ismen raat evn din ke farishte ekatr hote hain.
Ibn-e-baaz kahte hain : Ek momin ko yeh bara sawaab praapt karne ke liye paabandi se jamaat ke saath namaz parhne ka prayaas karna chahiye, chaahe ghar door hi kyon na ho.
Navvi ne is aashay ki riwayton ki jamaat ke saath parhi gai namaz akele parhi gai namaz se pachchees guna uttam hai tatha is aashay ki riwayton ke beech ki sattaaees guna uttam hai, saamanjasy ke sanbandh mein kaha hai : Inke beech saamanjasy ke nimnalikhit teen tareeqe hain : 1- yahaan koi wirodhaabhaas nahin hai. Kyonki kam ka zikr adhik ka khandan nahin karta. Islaami nyayshaastr  ke siddhaantvidon (usool-e- fikh ke jnaaniyon) ke yahaan sankhya ka wipreetaarth maany nahin hai. 2- aisa ho sakta hai ki aapne pahle kam ke baare mein bataya aur phir jab adhik ke baare mein Allah ke dvaara avgat karaye gae, to uske baare mein bata diya. 3- sawaab namaaziyon evn namaz ki sthitiyon ke anusaar ghatta-barhta rahta hai. Kisi ko pachchees guna milta hai to kisi ko sattaaees guna. Aisa namaz ki sanpoornata, sunnat ke anusran, winaysheelta, jamaat ki bhavyata, jamaat mein shaamil logon ki fazeelat tatha sthaan ke maryaada aadi ke anusaar hua karta hai, aur zyaada Allah hi jaanta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
11287: Kya tum namaz ke liye pukaari jaane waali azaan ko sunte ho?” usne kaha : Haan, sunta hoon, to aap ne farmaya : “Phir to tum awashy usko grahan karo (arthaath; maaz parhne ke liye masjid aao).”

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas ek andha vyakti aya, tatha kahne laga : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mere paas koi aadmi nahin hai jo mujhe masjid le aye. Atah usne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se ghar mein namaz parhne ki chhoot maangi, to aapne (pahle to) use chhoot de di, lekin jab woh jaane laga, to use bulaya aur farmaya : “Kya tum namaz ke liye pukaari jaane waali azaan ko sunte ho?” usne kaha : Haan, sunta hoon, to aap ne farmaya : “Phir to tum awashy usko grahan karo (arthaath; maaz parhne ke liye masjid aao).”

Ek drishtiheen vyakti Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya aur kahne laga : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mere paas madad karne aur haath pakarkar paanch samyon ki farz namaazon ke liye masjid le jaane ke liye koi nahin hai. Daraasal woh chaahta yeh tha ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam use ghar mein namaz parhne ki anumti de den. Chunaanche aapne anumti de bhi di. Lekin jab woh jaane laga, use bulaya aur kaha : Kya tum namaz ki azaan sunte ho? Usne uttar diya : Ji, sunta hoon. Tab farmaya : Tab to tum ko namaz ke liye bulaane waale ke aahvaan ko sveekaar karna parega.

Jamaat ke saath namaz parhna waajib hai, kyonki chhoot kisi aisi cheez mein hi di jaati hai jo waajib evn laazim ho.
Hadees ke shabd “Phir to tum awashy use grahan karo (yaani namaz parhne ke liye masjid aao).” se maaloom hota hai ki azaan sunne waale par masjid mein upasthit hokar namaz parhna waajib hai. Kyonki aadesh mooltah waajib hone ko saabit karta hai.
11288: Jo azaan sune lekin namaz parhne ke liye (masjid) na aye, uski namaz nahin, siway tab jab ki uske paas koi uzr (majboori) ho.

Ibne abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai, woh Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se riwayat karte hain ki aapne farmaya : “Jo azaan sune lekin namaz parhne ke liye (masjid) na aye, uski namaz nahin, siway tab jab ki uske paas koi uzr (majboori) ho.”

Yeh hadees jamaat ke saath namaz parhne par tawajjo dene aur uska atyadhik khayaal rakhne ka aahvaan karti hai. Ismen Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki jo vyakti aisi jagah par ho, jahaan use jamaat ke saath namaz ki azaan sunaai deti ho, to uspar jamaat mein shareek hona zaroori hai. Agar woh jamaat mein shareek nahin hota, to uski namaz adhoori hai aur uska sawaab ghat jayega. Use namaz parhne waala to maana jayega, lekin bina kisi uchit kaaran ke jamaat mein sammilit na hone ka gunaah bhi hoga. Albatta yadi koi uchit kaaran, jaise beemaari, warsha athva jaan, maal ya santaan aadi ke bhay ki wajah se jamaat mein shareek na ho, to use koi gunaah nahin hoga.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai .]
11289: Aisa na karo, jab tum mein se koi apne ghar mein (farz) namaz parh chuka ho, phir woh imaam ko namaz parhaate hue paye , to use chahiye ki imaam ke saath namaz parh le, yeh namaz uske liye nafl ho jayegi.

Jaabir bin yazeed bin asvad se warnit hai, woh apne pita se warnan karte hain ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath namaz parhi, aur woh abhi navyoowak the, jab aapne namaz parh li to dekha ki do vyakti masjid ke kone mein hain jinhonne namaz nahin parhi thi,to aapne un donon ko bulaawaya, un donon ko laya gaya is haal mein ki unke kandhe kaanp rahe the, aapne poochha : “Tum donon ko kis cheez ne hamaare saath namaz parhne se roka?” un donon ne kaha ki hamne apne ghar mein namaz parh li thi, to aapne farmaya : “Aisa na karo, jab tum mein se koi apne ghar mein namaz parh chuka ho, phir woh imaam ko namaz parhaate hue paye, to use chahiye ki imaam ke saath namaz parh le, yeh namaz uske liye nafl ho jayegi.”
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11290: Ek dapha Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ghore par sawaar hue to usse gir gae, jis ke kaaran aapka dayaan pahlu jakhmi ho gaya.

Hajrat anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki ek dapha Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ghore par sawaar hue to usse gir gae jis ke kaaran aapka dayaan pahlu jakhmi ho gaya, to aapne koi ek namaz baith kar parhaai, ham ne bhi aap ke peechhe baith kar namaz parhi, jab aap ne salaam phera to farmaya : “Imaam isliye banaya gaya hai ki uska anusran kiya jaye, atah jab woh khare ho kar namaz parhe to tum bhi khare ho kar namaz parho, jab woh ruku kare to tum bhi rukuू karo, jab woh ruku se khara ho to tum bhi ruku se khare ho jaao, jab woh سمع الله لمن حمده (samiallahu liman hamidah) kahe to tumah ربنا ولك الحمد (rabbana wa lakal hamd) kaho, aur jab woh khare ho kar namaz parhe to tum bhi khare ho kar namaz parho tatha yadi woh baith kar namaz parhe to tum sab bhi baith kar namaz parho.”
11291: Aage barho tatha mera anusran karo, tatha tumhaara anusran tumhaare peechhe waale karen, (yaad rakho) log baraabar peechhe hatte rahte hain yahaan tak ki Allah bhi unhen peechhe kar deta hai.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne sahaaba (saathiyon) mein peechhe rahne ka amal dekha to farmaya : “Aage barho tatha mera anusran karo, tatha tumhaara anusran tumhaare peechhe waale karen, (yaad rakho) log baraabar peechhe hatte rahte hain yahaan tak ki Allah bhi unhen peechhe kar deta hai.”
11292: Ai logo ! Apne gharon mein namaz parha karo, kyonki manushy ki sarshreshth namaz us ke ghar mein hoti hai, siway pharz namaazon ke.

Zaid bin saabit -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne masjid mein chataai gher kar ek (kamra) bana liya, aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- us mein anek raaton tak namaz parhte rahe, yahaan tak ki kuchh log bhi jama hone lage, ek raat un logon ne aap (-sallallahu alaihi wa sallam-) ki aawaaz nahin suni to unhen laga ki aap so gae hain, atah kuchh log khankhaarne lage taaki aap baahar niklen, to aap ne farmaya : “Tum jo kar rahe the main us se avgat tha (kintu is liye nahin nikla ki) kaheen tum par yeh namaz pharz na kar di jaye, aur yadi tum par is ko pharz kar diya gaya, to tum is ko ada karne mein asmarth rahoge, atah ai logo ! Apne apne gharon mein (tahajjud athva taraaweeh ki) namaz parh liya karo, kyonki manushy ki sarshreshth namaz us ke ghar mein hoti hai, siway pharz namaazon ke.”

Is hadees mein bataya gaya hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne masjid ke ek bhaag mein apne liye chataai ka ek kamra bana liya. Aisa lagta hai ki aap etikaaf ki awastha mein the. Aap us kamre ke andar raat ki namaz parha karte the. Kuchh logon ne suna, to aye aur aapki imaamat mein namaz parhne lage. Lekin kuchh raaton ke baad unhen aapki aawaaz sunaai nahin di. Aise mein unhonne yeh samajh kar ki kaheen aap so na gae hon, jagaane ke liye kuchh aawaazen nikaalne lage. Yeh sun aap baahar aye aur logon se bataya ki aap soe nahin the, balki aapko is baat ka dar ho gaya ki kaheen logon par raat ki namaz farz na kar di jaye. Phir bataya ki agar farz kar di jaye, to log use ada nahin kar payenge. Saath hi yeh bhi bataya ki logon ki sabse achchhi nafal namaz woh hai, jo ghar mein parhi jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11294: Kya aap mujh se Allah ke -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke rog ke sanbandh mein nahin batayengeen? Unhonne kahaah kyon nahin, jab aap beemaar the to aap ne poochhaah kya logon ne namaz parh liya? Ham ne kahaah nahin, (balki) log aap ki prateeksha kar rahe hain.

Ubaidullah bin abdullah bin utba se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki main aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ke paas gaya aur kaha : Kya aap mujhe Allah ke -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki beemaari ke sanbandh mein nahin batayengeen? Unhonne kaha : Kyon nahin, jab aap sakht beemaar the to aap ne poochha : “Kya logon ne namaz parh li?” hamne kaha : Nahin, (balki) log aap ki prateeksha kar rahe hain. Aap ne aadesh diya : “Mere liye tasla mein paani laao”, woh kahti hain : Ham ne aisa hi kiya, aap ne snaan kiya tatha namaz parhaane ke liye aage barhe ki behosh (moorchhit) ho gae, jab aap hosh mein aye to poochha : “Kya logon ne namaz parh li?” ham ne kaha : Nahin, (balki) log aap ki prateeksha kar rahe hain, ai Allah ke Rasool. Aap ne aadesh diya : “Mere liye tasla mein paani laao”, woh kahti hain : Aap baith gae tatha snaan kiya, tatpashchaat namaz parhaane ke liye aage barhe ki behosh (moorchhit) ho gae, jab aap hosh mein aye ( chetna lauti) to phir poochha : “Kya logon ne namaz parh li?” ham ne kaha : Nahin, (balki) log aap ki prateeksha kar rahe hain, ai Allah ke Rasool. Aap ne phir aadesh diya : “Mere liye tasla mein paani laao”, aap baith gae tatha snaan kiya, ek baar punah aap namaz parhaane ke liye aage barhe ki behosh (moorchhit) ho gae, jab aap hosh mein aye ( chetna lauti) to poochha : “Kya logon ne namaz parh li?” ham ne kaha : Nahin, (balki) log aap ki prateeksha kar rahe hain, ai Allah ke Rasool . Log masjid mein baithe hue apne Nabi -alaihissalaam- ki prateeksha kar rahe hain taaki woh unko isha ki namaz parhayen, tab Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne abu bakar (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas aadesh bhijvaya ki woh logon ko namaz parhayen, atah doot yeh sandesh lekar abu bakar (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas aye aur kaha ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- aap ko aadesh de rahe hain ki aap logon ko namaz parhayen . Abu bakar radiyallahu anhu ne -jo ki ek sahriday vyakti the- kaha : Ai umar ! Aap logon ko namaz parhayen, umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne kaha : Aap iske adhik
Yogy hain . Aakhirkaar un dinon mein abu bakar (radiyallahu anhu) ne hi logon ko namaz parhaai, phir Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne man ko kuchh halka paya to do aadmiyon, jin mein se ek abbaas (radiyallahu anhu) the, ke sahaare ju़hr ki namaz ke liye nikle, abu bakar radiyallahu anhu logon ko namaz parha rahe the, jab abu bakar ne aap ko dekha to peechhe hatne lage, aap ne ishaare se kaha ki apne sthaan par bane raho aur un donon se kaha ki mujhe inke pahlu mein baitha do, un donon ne aap ko abu bakar ke pahlu mein baitha diya, (raawi) kahte hain : Abu bakar radiyallahu anhu logon ko namaz parhaane lage, woh Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka anusnan karte the tatha log abu bakar radiyallahu anhu ka anusran karte the, haalaanki aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- baithe hue the. Ubaidullah kahte hain : Main abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ke paas aya aur unse kaha : Kya main aap ke saamne woh baat na pesh karoon jo mujhse Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki beemaari ke sanbandh mein aaisha (radiyallahu taaala anha) ne warnan kiya hai? Unhonne kaha : Theek hai pesh karo, chunaanche mainne unke samaksh unki hadees ko byaan kiya, unhonne us mein se kisi bhi baat ka khandan nahin kiya, siway iske ki unhonne kaha : Kya unhonne (aaisha radiyallahu taaala anha ne) us doosre vyakti ka naam bataya jo abbaas ke saath the? Mainne kaha : Nahin, to unhonne kaha : Woh ali bin abu taalib radiyallahu anhu the.
11295: Ai logo ! Tum nafrat phaila rahe ho, jo logon ko namaz parhaye use chahiye ki halki namaz parhaye, un mein rogi bhi hote hain, kamzor bhi tatha zaroorat mand bhi.

Abu masaood ansaari radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, unhonne farmaya ki ek aadmi ne rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki khidmat mein haazir hokar arz kiya : Ai Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ! Mere liye namaz jamaaat se parhna mushkil ho gaya hai, kyonki phalaan aadmi namaz bahut lambi parhaate hain . Abu masaood ansaari radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki mainne Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko naseehat ke waqt us din se zyaada kabhi gusse mein nahin dekha . Aapne farmaya : “Logo ! Tum deen se nafrat dilaane waale ho . Dekho jo koi logon ko namaz parhaye use chahiye ki halki namaz parhaye, kyonki peechhe namaz parhne waalon mein beemaar, kamzor aur zarooratmand bhi hote hain .”
11296: Falaan namaz ko falaan samay mein parho aur falaan namaz ko falaan samay mein parho,jab namaz ka samay ho jaye to tum mein se ek vyakti azaan de tatha tum mein se jo Qur'an ka sabse zyaada yaad rakhta ho woh imaamat kare.

Ayyoob se warnit hai, woh abu qilaaba se warnan karte hain, woh amr bin salma radiyallahu anhu se riwayat karte hain, ayyoob kahte hain ki mujh se abu qilaaba ne kaha : Kyon nahin tum unse bhent kar ke unse poochhte ho -arthaat tum amr bin salma radiyallahu anhu se poochho-, woh kahte hain : Mainne unse bhent kiya tatha poochha to unhonne farmaya : Ham ek chashme par rahte the, jo logon ke liye aam raasta tha . Hamaari taraph se jo musaaphir sawaar guzarte, ham unse poochhte rahte ki ab logon ka kya haal hai ? Aur us aadmi ki kya haalat hai ? We log jawaab dete : Woh kahta hai ki Allah ne use Rasool banaakar bheja hai aur Allah uski taraph wahy utaarta hai . Ya yoon kaha ki Allah ne us par yeh wahy bheji hai . Amr bin salma radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki main wo kalaam khoob yaad kar liya karta . Goya koi use mere seene mein jama deta hai . Aur arab waale musalmaan hone ke liye phatah makka ke muntazir the . Aur kahte the ki Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur uski qaum ko chhor do . Agar Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) un par gaalib a gaye to wo Nabi barhaq hain . Phir jab makka phatah hua to har ek qaum ne chaaha ki wo pahle musalmaan ho jaye aur mere pita ne musalmaan hone mein apni qaum se bhi jaldi ki . Jab mere pita musalmaan hokar aye to unhonne apni qaum se kaha : Allah ki qasam ! Main Nabi barhaq se mulaaqaat karke tumhaare paas a raha hoon . Unhonne farmaya hai : “Falaan namaz falaan waqt parho aur falaan namaz falaan waqt aur jab namaz ka waqt a jaye to tum mein se ek aadmi azaan de aur jisko zyaada Qur'an yaad ho, wo namaz parhaye.” unhonne is par ghaur kiya to mujhse zyaada kisi ko Qur'an parhne waala na paya . Kyonki main musaaphir sawaaron se sun sun kar bahut yaad kar chuka tha . Lihaaza sabne mujhe imaam bana liya . Haalaanki main us waqt chhah saat baras ka tha . Sthiti yeh thi ki us waqt mere tan par sirph ek chaadar thi, wo bhi jab main sajda karta to sikur jaati. Qabeele ki ek aurat ne yeh manzar dekhkar kaha : Tum apne qaari ka pichhla hissa ham se kyon nahin chhipaate . Aakhirkaar unhonne ek kapra khareed kar mera kurta banaya, main jitna us kurte se khush hua, utna kisi cheez se kabhi khush nahin hua .
11297: Jo Qur'an ko sarvaadhik yaad rakhta ho woh logon ki imaamat kare.

Abu masaood ansaari -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Jo Qur'an ko sarvaadhik yaad rakhta ho woh logon ki imaamat kare, yadi saare log Qur'an ko yaad karne mein samaan hon to jo sarvaadhik sunnat ka jnaani ho (woh imaamat kare), yadi sabhi log sunnat ke jnaan mein bhi samaan hon to jisne sarvapratham hijrat ki ho woh imaamat kare, aur yadi hijrat karne mein bhi sabhi samaan hon to jisne sarvapratham Islam dharm apnaya ho woh imaamat kare, (aur yaad rahe) koi aadmi kisi aadmi ki hukoomat ki jagah mein jaakar imaamat na kare, aur uske ghar mein uske masnad par uski aajna ke bina na baithe.”
11299: ''Purushon ke liye sarvottam saf sabse pratham saph hai aur sabse buri saf sabse antim saf hai. Jabki mahilaaon ke liye sabse achchhi saf antim saf hai tatha sabse buri saf sabse pratham saf hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : ''Purushon ke liye sarvottam saf sabse pratham saph hai aur sabse buri saf sabse antim saf hai. Jabki mahilaaon ke liye sabse achchhi saf antim saf hai tatha sabse buri saf sabse pratham saf hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki namaz mein purushon ki sabse uttam, adhik sawaab aur fazeelat waali saf pahli saf hai. Kyonki pahli saf mein khare log imaam ke nikat hote hain, aasaani se uski qiraat sun sakte hain aur mahilaaon se door hote hain. Jabki purushon ki sabse buri, kam sawaab tatha kam fazeelat waali aur sharai uddeshyon se sabse doori waali saf antim saf hai. Iske wipreet mahilaaon ki sabse uttam saf antim saf hai. Kyonki yahaan unka parda adhik hota hai tatha purushon ke saath mel-jol, unko dekhne tatha unke fitne mein parne ki sanbhaavna sabas kam rahti hai. Jabki unki sabse buri saf pahli saf hai, jo purushon se qareeb hoti hai aur uske fitne mein parne ki sanbhaavna bhi rahti hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne purushon ko neki ke kaamon mein  aur namaz ki pahli safon mein jagah paane ke liye ek-doosre se aage barhne ki prerna di hai.
Mahilaaon ke liye masjidon mein purushon ke saath alag safon mein namaz parhna jayaz hai. Lekin parda aur haya ke saath.
Aurten agar namaz parhne ke liye masjid jayen, to bikhri rahne ki bajay woh bhi purushon ki tarah safbandi karengi, mil-milkar khari hongi aur khaali sthaanon ko bhar liya karengi.
Shareeyat ne mahilaaon ko purushon se alag rahne ki bharpoor prerna di hai. Yahaan tak ki ibaadat ki jaghon mein bhi.
Karmon ke anusaar logon ke alag-alag darje hua karte hain.
Navvi kahte hain : Jahaan tak purushon ki safon ki baat hai, to har haal mein unki pahli saf sabse uttam saf aur antim saf sabse buri saf hua karti hai. Lekin jahaan tak mahilaaon ki baat hai, to is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki mahilayen jab purushon ke saath namaz parh rahi hon, to unki sabse buri saf pahli saf aur sabse uttam saf antim saf hai. Lekin jab unki alag jamaat ho rahi ho, to woh purushon hi ki tarah hongi. Unki sabse uttam saf pahli saf aur sabse buri saf antim saf hogi.
Navvi kahte hain : Prashansneey pahli saf, jiski fazeelat aur jismen khare hone ki prerna se sanbandhit hadeesen aai hui hain, woh saf hai, jo imaam ke theek baad ho. Usmen khara hone waala vyakti chaahe pahle aye ya baad mein. Chaahe beech mein koi wishesh kamra aadi ho ya na ho.
11300: "Ai Allah! Mere dil mein noor rakh de, meri aankh mein noor rakh de, mere kaan mein noor rakh de, mere dayen noor rakh de, mere bayen noor rakh de, mere oopar noor rakh de, mere neeche noor rakh de, mere saamne noor rakh de, mere peechhe noor rakh de aur mere liye noor bana de."

Ibne abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- se warnit hai, woh riwayat karte hain ki mainne maimoona (radiyallahu anha) ke yahaan raat bitaai, to Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- (neend se uth kar) khare hue, apni aawashyakta ki poorti ki, apna mukh wa haath dhoya, phir aap so gae, phir aap (neend se uth kar) khare hue, mashkeeza ke paas aye, uska munh khola tatha munaasib tareeka se wujoo़ kiya ki bahut adhik paani ka prayog bhi nahin kiya aur wuzu bhi har tarah se sanpoorn tha, phir aap namaz parhne lage, mainne uthne mein der ki is baat ko apriy samajhte hue ki aap yeh samjhen ki main aap ko dekh raha tha, tatpashchaat mainne wujoo़ kiya, aap khare ho kar namaz parh rahe the, main aap ke bayen a kar khara ho gaya to aap ne mere kaan ko pakar kar mujhe ghumaate hue apne daaeen or khara kiya, aap -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kul terah rakaat namaz parhi, phir aap let gae yahaan tak ki so kar kharraate lene gae, aur aap ka haal ye tha ki jab aap sote to kharraata lete, yahaan tak ki bilaal ne a kar aap ko namaz ke baare mein bataya, to aap ne bina wuzu kiye hue namaz parhi, aur aap yeh dua kar rahe the : "Ai Allah! Mere dil mein noor rakh de, meri aankh mein noor rakh de, mere kaan mein noor rakh de, mere dayen noor rakh de, mere bayen noor rakh de, mere oopar noor rakh de, mere neeche noor rakh de, mere saamne noor rakh de, mere peechhe noor rakh de aur mere liye noor bana de."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11301: Mainne aur yateem ne, Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke peechhe apne ghar mein namaz parhi aur meri maan umme sulaim hamaare peechhe theen.

Anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai, woh kahte hain : “Mainne aur yateem ne, Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke peechhe apne ghar mein namaz parhi aur meri maan umme sulaim hamaare peechhe theen.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai aur shabd Bukhari ke hain.]
11302: Allah taaala tumhaare shauq (chaah, abhiruchi) mein wriddhi kare, lekin punah aisa na karna.

Hasan se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki abu bakra (radiyallahu anhu) us samay pahunche jab Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ruku mein the, to unhonne saph (pankti) mein pahunchne ke poorv hi ruku kar liya tatha usi haalat mein chalte hue saph mein pahoonche, jab Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- namaz se phaarigh hue to poochha : “Woh tummen se kaun tha jisne saph ke poorv hi ruku kar liya tha, phir waise hi chalte hue saph mein pahuncha?” abu bakra (radiyallahu anhu) ne kaha : Woh main tha, to Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Allah taaala tumhaare shauq (chaah, abhiruchi) mein wriddhi kare, lekin punah aisa na karna.”
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11303: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek vyakti ko saf ke peechhe akele namaz parhte hue dekha, to use namaz dohraane ka aadesh diya.
Waabisa radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek vyakti ko saf ke peechhe akele namaz parhte hue dekha, to use namaz dohraane ka aadesh diya.
Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek vyakti ko saf ke peechhe akele namaz parhte hue dekha, to use namaz dohraane ka aadesh diya. Kyonki is haalat mein uski namaz durust nahin hogi.

Jamaat ke saath namaz parhne ke liye jaldi jaane, ismen aage rahne aur is baat ki prerna ki koi vyakti saf ke peechhe akele namaz na parhe, taaki namaz nasht na ho jaye.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Jisne saf ke peechhe akele namaz shuru kar di aur phir ruku se uthne se pahle saf mein prawesh kar gaya, to use dohraana nahin parega, jaisa ki abu bakra ki is hadees mein hai. Agar aisa na ho sake, to waabisa ki hadees ke anusaar use dohraana hoga.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
11306: “Yeh do namaazen munaaphikon ke liye sarvaadhik kathin hain aur yadi woh jaan lete ki inmen kitna sawaab hai, to we awashy aate, chaahe (haath evn) ghutnon ke bal ghisatte hue hi kyon na ho.

Ubay bin kaab -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ek din hamen fajr ki namaz parhaai, phir poochha : “Kya amuk vyakti upasthit hai?” logon ne kaha : Nahin. Aapne punah poochha : “Kya amuk vyakti upasthit hai?” logon ne kaha : Nahin. Aapne farmaya : “Yeh do namaazen munaaphikon ke liye sarvaadhik kathin hain aur yadi woh jaan lete ki inmen kitna sawaab hai, to we awashy aate, chaahe (haath evn) ghutnon ke bal ghisatte hue hi kyon na ho. Pratham saph (pankti) pharishton ki saph ke samaan hai. Yadi tum iski phazeelat (mahatv) jaan lete, to iske liye jaldi karte. Ek aadmi ki namaz doosre aadmi ke saath akele namaz parhne se behtar hai aur do aadmiyon ke saath namaz parhna ek aadmi ke saath namaz parhne se behtar hai. Log (namaz mein) jitne adhik honge, namaz Allah taaala ke sameep utni adhik priy hogi.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ek din fajr ki namaz parhi aur uske baad poochha ki kya hamaari is namaz mein amuk vyakti hai? Sahaaba ne uttar diya : Nahin. Phir aapne ek aur vyakti ke baare mein poochha : Kya amuk vyakti maujood hai? Sahaaba ne jawaab diya : Nahin. To aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Nissandeh fajr evn isha ki namaazen munaafiqon par sabse bhaari hain, kyonki in donon samyon mein susti haawi rahti hai dikhaawe ki sanbhaavna kam rahti hai ki andhere ke kaaran koi dekh nahin sakta.

Ai momino! Agar tum jaan lo ki subah tatha isha ki namaz mein kitna atirikt sawaab hai, (kyonki sawaab mashaqqat ke anuroop mila karta hai) to tum in donon namaazon mein zaroor pahunchoge. Chaahe ghutnon aur haathon ke bal chalkar hi kyon na pahunchna pare.

Nishchay hi pahli saf usmen khare logon ke imaam se qareeb hone ke maamle mein farishton ki saf ke samaan hai Allah se nikat hone ke maamle mein. Agar eemaan waale pahli saf ki fazeelat se avgat ho jayen, to usmen jagah paane ke liye pratispardha karne lagenge. Ek vyakti ka doosre vyakti ke saath namaz parhna akele namaz parhne ki tulna mein adhik sawaab rakhta hai. Aur do vyakti ke saath namaz parhna ek vyakti ke saath namaz parhne se adhik sawaab rakhta hai. Jis namaz mein namaaziyon ki sankhya adhik ho, woh Allah ke nikat adhik priy evn uttam hai.

Masjid ke imaam ka muqatdiyon ke haalaat ka jayza lena aur jo namaazi ghayab hon, unke baare mein poochhna ek shareeyat sammat kaary hai.
Paabandi se jamaat ke saath namaz parhna, khaas taur se isha aur fajr ki namaz paabandi se jamaat ke saath parhna eemaan ki nishaani hai.
Is hadees se isha aur fajr ki namaz ke bare pratiphal ka pata chalta hai, kyonki in namaazon mein upasthit hone ke liye apne nafs se larna parta hai aur Allah ki ibaadat par adig rahna parta hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki in donon namaazon mein any namaazon ki tulna mein adhik sawaab milta hai.
Jamaat ki namaz do ya isse adhik logon se sahi ho jaati hai.
Pahli saf ki fazeelat ka bayaan aur aage barhkar  usmen shaamil  hone ki prerna.
Bari jamaat ki fazeelat. Log jitne zyaada honge, sawaab utna hi zyaada milega.
Achchhe karmon ki shreshthata mein antar tai hota hai slaami shareeat dvaara unhen di gai praathmikta ke anusaar tatha un paristhitiyon ke etbaar se jinmen inko kiya jaata hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, nasai aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
11307: Umme warqa binte abdullah bin haaris ansaari se warnit hai ki unhonne Qur'an hifz (kanthasth) kiya tha, (aur) Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unhen aadesh diya tha ki woh apne ghar waalon ki imaamat karen (unhen namaz parhayen).

Umme warqa binte abdullah bin haaris ansaari se warnit hai ki unhonne Qur'an hifz (kanthasth) kiya tha, (aur) Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unhen aadesh diya tha ki woh apne ghar waalon ki imaamat karen (unhen namaz parhayen), unke liye ek muazzin tha jo azaan deta tha aur woh apne ghar waalon ki imaamat karti theen (unhen namaz parhaati theen)
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11308: Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ibne umme maktoom ko apna khaleepha (uttaraadhikaari) banaya tha jo logon ki imaamat karte the, jabki woh andhe aadmi the.

Anas radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ibne umme maktoom (umme maktoom ke bete) ko apna khaleepha (uttaraadhikaari) banaya tha jo logon ki imaamat karte the, jabki woh andhe aadmi the.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
11310: Tummen se jo koi namaz parhne ke liye aye to use chahiye ki woh waisi hi awastha mein ho jaye jaisa imaam kar raha hai.

Ali bin abu taalib wa muaaz bin jabal -radiyallahu anhuma- se marphooan warnati hai : “Tummen se jo koi namaz parhne ke liye aye to use chahiye ki woh waisi hi awastha mein ho jaye jaisa imaam kar raha hai.”

Jab tummen se koi namaz parhne pahunche aur imaan qayaam, ruku, sajda ya baithak aadi kisi haalat mein ho, to imaam ko qayaam athva ruku aadi jis awastha mein paye, usi mein uske saath ho jaye aur uske khare hone ki prateeksha na kare, jaisa ki kuchh log karte hain.

Imaam ke saath baad mein namaz mein milne waale ko aadesh ki woh imaam ko jis awastha mein paye usi mein uske saath ho jaye. Isse koi farq nahin parta ki woh ruku mein hai ya sajde mein ya phir baithak mein.
Baad mein milne waala imaam ko jis rakaat mein paye, woh rakaat use uska ruku paane se mil jaati hai. Yeh baat any hadeeson se pramaanit hai.
58060: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne hamen khutba-e-haajat is tarah sikhaya

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne hamen khutba-e-haajat is tarah sikhaya : "إِنَّ الحَمْدَ للهِ، نَسْتَعِيْنُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهُ، وَنَعُوْذُ بِهِ مِنْ شُرُوْرِ أَنْفُسِنَا، مَنْ يَهْدِ اللهُ فَلَا مُضِلَّ لَهُ، وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا الله، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُوْلُهُ، {يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالًا كَثِيرًا وَنِسَاءً وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي تَسَاءَلُونَ بِهِ والأرحام إن الله كان عليكم رقيبا} [النساء: 1]، {يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِ وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ} [آل عمران: 102]، {يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا  يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا} [الأحزاب:70 - 71]." (Saari prashansa Allah ki hai. Ham usi se madad maangte hain, usi se kshama chaahte hain aur apne nafs ki buraaiyon se usi ki sharan maangte hain. Jise Allah raasta dikhaye, use koi raaste se bhatka nahin sakta aur jise raaste se bhatka de, use koi raasta dikha nahin sakta. Main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi sachcha poojy nahin hai aur main gawaahi deta hoon ki Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke Rasool hain. {ai logo ! Apne rab se daro, jisne tum sab ko (kewal) ek vyakti se paida kiya aur (woh is tarah ki) unheen se un ka jora (patni) paida kiya aur (phir kewal) unheen donon (pati-patni) se bahut se purushon wa mahilaaon ko (paida kar ke sansaar mein) phaila diya aur us Allah se daro jiske naam par tum aapas mein ek-doosre se sawaal karte ho aur rishton ko kaatne se bhi bacho. Nihsandeh Allah tumhaari nigraani karne waala hai.} [an-nisa : 1] {ai eemaan waalo! Allah se daro, jitna usse darne ka haq hai aur tum (deen-e-) Islam ke siwa kisi aur deen par kadaapi nahin marna.} [aal-e-imraan : 102] {ai eemaan waalo! Allah se darte raho aur (jab kaho to) uchit baat kaha karo,to (Allah) tumhaari kaamon ko satheek kar dega aur tumhaare paap dho dega aur jis vyakti ne Allah wa uske Rasool ka aajnaapaalan kiya, to usne bahut bari saphalta arjit kar li.} [al-ahzaab : 70-71]

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu bata rahe hain ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne sahaaba ko khutba-e-haajat sikhaya. Khutba-e-haajat se muraad daraasal woh shabd hain, jo bhaashnon evn zaroori kaamon ko aaranbh karne se pahle kahe jaate hain. Maslan khutba-e-nikaah evn khutba-e-juma aadi. Is khutbe ke andar kai bari-bari baaten maujood hain. Maslan Allah ka har prakaar ki prashansa ka haqdaar hona, kewal usi  se madad talab karna aur kshama yaachna karna tatha ismen kisi ko uska saajhi na thahraana evn nafs ki buraai tatha any saari buraaiyon se uski sharan maangna aadi.

Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki maargadarshan Allah ke haath mein hai. Jiska Allah maargadarshan kar de, use koi raah se bhatka nahin sakta aur jise Allah raah se bhatka de, use koi raah dikha nahin sakta.

Phir ekeshvarvaad ki gawaahi ka ullekh kiya aur bataya ki Allah ke siwa koi sachcha poojy nahin hai. Saath hi risaalat ki gawaahi ka ullekh karte hue bataya ki Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke bande aur uske Rasool hain.

Phir is khutbe ko teen ayton ke zariye samaapt kiya, jinmen sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah se darne ka aadesh diya gaya hai. Woh is tarah ki Allah ke aadeshon ka paalan kiya jaye aur uski mana ki hui cheezon se door raha jaye. Woh bhi, Allah ki prasannata praapt karne ke liye. In ayton mein bataya gaya hai ki jo yeh kaam kar lega, phalasvaroop uske karm tatha kathan durust ho jayenge, uske paap dho diye jayenge, use duniya mein sukhmay jeewan praapt hoga aur aakhirat mein Jannat naseeb hogi.

Nikaah evn juma aadi ke khutbon ka aaranbh is khutbe se karna musathab hai.
Khutbe ke andar Allah ki prashansa, donon gawaahiyaan aur kuchh quraaani ayten honi chahiye.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne saathiyon ko deen ki har zaroori baat sikhaai hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, nasai, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
58061: Jab tummen se koi kisi mahila ko nikaah ke liye paighaam de to yadi uske bas mein ho ki (us mein) us cheez ko dekh sake jo usko us se wiwaah ke or aakarshan kare, to use chahiye ki woh dekh le.

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Jab tummen se koi kisi mahila ko nikaah ke liye paighaam de to yadi uske bas mein ho ki (us mein) us cheez ko dekh sake jo usko us se wiwaah ke or aakarshan kareke, to use chahiye ki woh dekh le.” mainne ek yuvti ko wiwaah ka paighaam bheja aur main usko chhup kar dekhne ki koshish karta raha, yahaan tak ki jab mainne us yuvti ke andar aisi cheejen dekh leen jo mujhe us se wiwaah karne ke liye uchit lageen to mainne us se wiwaah kar liya.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58062: Jaao tatha usko dekh lo, yeh tum donon ke beech prem ko barhaane ke liye bahut hi upyukt hai.

Mugheera bin shoaba (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki main Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aya tatha ek mahila ka ullekh kiya jisko main wiwaah ka paighaam dene waala tha, to aap ne farmaya : “Jaao tatha usko dekh lo, yeh tum donon ke beech prem ko barhaane ke liye bahut hi upyukt hai.” atah main ansaar ki ek mahila ke paas aya aur mainne uske waalidain ke paas us se wiwaah ka sandesha bheja aur un donon ko Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka aadesh sunaya to aisa laga ki un donon ko woh baat apriy lagi ho, woh (mugheera) kahte hain ki yeh baat us yuvti ne bhi sun li jo apne ghar ke andar thi to woh boli : “Yadi Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne tujhe mujhe dekhne ka aadesh diya hai to aao aur mujhe dekh lo, warna main tum ko Allah ki qasam de doongi, maano us ne isko bahut bari baat samjha ho . Woh kahte hain : Mainne usko dekha tatha us se wiwaah kar liya . (Baad mein unhonne) jikr kiya ki woh bilkul unke liye uchit theen.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58063: Jab Allah taaala kisi purush ke hriday mein kisi mahila se wiwaah karne ka sandesha bhejne ki baat daal de to koi harj nahin hai ki woh us mahila ko dekh le.

Muhammad bin masalma (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne ek mahila se wiwaah karne ka sandesha bheja tatha usko chhup kar dekhne ka prayaas kiya yahaan tak ki mainne use uske ek baagh mein dekh liya. Un se kaha gaya : Aap aisa kar rahe hain jabki aap Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saathiyon mein se hain, to unhonne uttar diya ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko farmaate hue suna hai : “Jab Allah taaala kisi purush ke hriday mein kisi mahila se wiwaah karne ka sandesha bhejne ki baat daal de to koi harj nahin hai ki woh us mahila ko dekh le.”
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58066: Wali (abhibhaawak) ke bina nikaah (shaadi) nahin hai.
Abu moosa ashaari radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Wali (abhibhaawak) ke bina nikaah (shaadi) nahin hai."
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki stri ki shaadi sahi ho, iske liye zaroori hai ki koi wali (abhibhaawak) ho, jo nikaah karaye.

Nikaah ke sahi hone ke liye wali (abhibhaawak) ka hona shart hai. Agar wali ki anupasthiti mein nikaah ho jaye ya aurat khud hi shaadi kar le, to uski shaadi sahi nahin hogi.
Wali (abhibhaawak) se muraad stri ka sabse nikatvarti purush hai. Atah nikat ke wali ke hote hue door ka wali nikaah nahin kara sakta.
Wali ke liye mukallaf hona, purush hona, nikaah ke hiton ko samajhne ki ayu tak pahuncha hua hona aur wali tatha us vyakti ka dharm ek hona shart hai, jiska wali banna ho. Jiske andar yeh wisheshtayen paai nahin jayengi, woh nikaah ka wali banne ke yogy samjha nahin jayega.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
58067: Jo aurat apne wali gan (abhibhaavkon) ki anumti ke bina nikaah kare, uska nikaah baatil hai. (Nikaah baatil hone ki baat aapne teen baar kahi.) agar mard ne aisi aurat ke saath ekaant waas kiya hai, to jo kuchh usne aurat se paya hai uske badle mein aurat ke liye mahar hai. Agar waliyon ke beech matbhed ho jaye, to shaasak us aurat ka wali hai, jiska koi wali na ho.

Aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jo aurat apne wali gan (abhibhaavkon) ki anumti ke bina nikaah kare, uska nikaah baatil hai. (Nikaah baatil hone ki baat aapne teen baar kahi.) agar mard ne aisi aurat ke saath ekaant waas kiya hai, to jo kuchh usne aurat se paya hai uske badle mein aurat ke liye mahar hai. Agar waliyon ke beech matbhed ho jaye, to shaasak us aurat ka wali hai, jiska koi wali na ho."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is baat se saavdhaan kiya hai ki koi mahila apne waliyon (abhibhaavkon) ki anumti ke bina shaadi kar le. Aapne is prakaar ke nikaah ko baatil (awaidh) kaha hai aur is waaky ko teen baar dohraya hai. Goya yeh nikaah hua hi nahin.

Agar mahila se wali ki anumti ke bina nikaah karne waale vyakti ne uske saath ekaantvaas kar liya, to mahila ko poora mahar milega.
Atah yadi us vyakti ne us (stri) se sahvaas kar liya ho jisse usne uske 'wali' (abhibhaawak) ki anumti ke bina wiwaah kiya tha; to us (stri) ka poora 'mahar' (haq) hai, us shaareerik milan ke kaaran jo usne usse kiya hai.

Phir agar nikaah ka wali banne ke sannbandh mein waliyon ke beech matbhed ho jaye aur saare wali ek hi shreni ke hon, to us wali ka kiya hua nikaah durust hoga, jo pahle nikaah karaye, jab usne nikaah aurat ke hiton ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue karaya ho. Agar wali nikaah karaane se mana kar de, to yeh maana jayega ki us aurat ka koi wali nahin hai. Aise mein shaasak ya uski or se niyukt adhikaari, jaise qaazi aadi, uske wali honge. Isse alag prastithi mein wali ke hote hue shaasak ke paas wali banne ka adhikaar nahin hai.

Nikaah sahi hone ke liye wali ka hona shart hai. Ibn al-munzir se naqal kiya gaya hai ki kisi bhi sahaabi se isse alag naqal nahin kiya gaya hai.
Awaidh nikaah mein aurat mahar ki haqdaar hogi. Aisa isliye hai ki mard ne uske saath sanbhog kar liya hai.
Shaasak us aurat ka wali hai, jiska koi wali na ho.  Wali chaahe sach-much mein na ho ya phir wali shaadi karaane ke liye taiyaar na ho.
Wali na hone ya uske uplabdh na hone ki awastha mein shaasak wali hoga aur qaazi uske sthaan mein kaam karega, kyonki is prakaar ke maslon mein qaazi ke paas shaasak ke sthaan mein kaam karne ka adhikaar hua karta hai.
Kisi aurat ki shaadi karaane ke liye kisi ko wali banaane ka matlab yeh nahin hai ki aurat ke paas koi adhikaar nahin hai. Sachchaai yeh hai ki aurat ke paas bhi adhikaar hai. Uska wali uski anumti ke bina uski shaadi nahin kar sakta.
Sahi nikaah ki sharten : 1- ishaara dvaara, ya naam lekar ya wisheshtayen bataakar pati evn patni donon ko nirdhaarit kar dena. 2- pati evn patni donon ka aapas mein raazi hona. 3- aurat ka nikaah uske wali ke dvaara karaya jaana. 4- nikaah ke samay gawaah banaana.
Nikaah karaane waale wali ke andar nimnalikhit sharten honi chahiye : 1- aqalmand ho. 2- purush ho. 3- wayask ho. Wayask hone ka matlab yeh hai ki ayu pandrah warsh ho jaye ya svapnadosh hone lage. 4- dharm ek ho. Koi awishvaasi kisi musalmaan purush ya mahila ka wali nahin ban sakta. Isi tarah koi musalmaan kisi awishvaasi purush ya mahila ka wali nahin ban sakta. 5- wishvasneeyta jo fisq ke manaafi hai. Aur iske liye yeh prayaapt hai ki woh jis aurat ki shaadi kara ho uske hiton ka khyaal rakhne waala ho. 6- samajhdaar ho, naasmajh na ho. Yaani uske andar samaanta tatha nikaah ke hiton ko jaanne ki kshamta maujood ho.
Faqeehon ne shaadi karaane ke sanbandh mein aurat ke waliyon ka ek kram bana rakha hai. Atah door ke wali ko wali banne ka adhikaar usi samay praapt hoga, jab nikat ka wali maujood na ho ya uske andar wali banne ki sharten na paai jayen. Mahila ka wali uska pita hai, phir pita ki or se is kaary ke liye nirdhaarit vyakti hai, phir daada hai chaahe jitne oopar ka ho, phir beta hai, phir pote aur parpote hain chaahe jitne neeche ke hon, phir saga bhaai hai, phir pita sah-bhaai hai, phir donon ke bete, phir saga chaacha, phir pita sah-chaacha, phir donon ke bete, phir nikattam paariwaarik rishtedaar hain, jo wiraasat ke hakdaar hain. Iske baad musalmaan shaasak aur uske pratinidhi, jaise qaazi aadi, us vyakti ke abhibhaawak hote hain jiska koi abhibhaawak na ho.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
58068: Woh mahila jiska wiwaah ho chuka ho, to woh (doosre wiwaah ke samay) apne baare mein phaisla karne mein apne wali se adhik adhikaar rakhti hai aur kunwaari se aajna maangi jayegi, tatha uska chup rahna uski sveekriti samjhi jayegi.

Ibne abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Wiwaahit mahila apne baare mein phaisla karne mein apne wali se adhik adhikaar rakhti hai aur kunwaari se aajna maangi jayegi, tatha uska chup rahna uski sveekriti samjhi jayegi.”
58069: Koi mahila kisi mahila ka wiwaah sampann na karaye, na koi mahila svayn apna wiwaah kar le, aisi mahila jo svayn apna wiwaah kar leti hai woh zaaniya (duraachaari) hai.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Koi mahila kisi mahila ka wiwaah sampann na karaye, na koi mahila svayn apna wiwaah kar le, aisi mahila jo svayn apna wiwaah kar leti hai woh zaaniya (duraachaari) hai.”

Yeh hadees bataati hai ki stri nikaah mein wali nahin ban sakti. Na apne nikaah mein aur na kisi aur ke nikaah mein. Jis nikaah mein koi stri svayn apni shaadi karaye, woh awaidh nikaah hai. Jahaan tak is hadees ke shabd : "Aisi mahila jo svayn apna wiwaah kar leti hai woh zaaniya (duraachaari) hai" Ki baat hai, to ye shabd abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ke hain. Woh kahna yeh chaahte hain ki nikaah karaane ki zimmewaari kisi stri ka uthaana daraasal duraachaari mahila ka kaam hai. Wali ke bina nikaah hona hi nahin chahiye.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai .]
58070: Ek kunwaari yuvti Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aai tatha usne aap se kaha ki uske pita ne uska wiwaah kara diya hai jise woh naapsand karti hai, to Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne use (wiwaah baaki rakhne athva tor dene ka) ikhtiyaar diya.

Ibne abbaas (-radiyallahu anhuma-) warnan karte hain ki ek kunwaari yuvti Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aai tatha usne aap se kaha ki uske pita ne uska wiwaah kara diya hai jise woh naapsand karti hai, to Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne use (wiwaah baaki rakhne athva tor dene ka) ikhtiyaar diya.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58072: Jo daas apne maalik ki anumti ke bina nikaah kar le, woh vyabhichaari hai.
Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jo daas apne maalik ki anumti ke bina nikaah kar le, woh vyabhichaari hai."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58073: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne maimoona (radiyallahu anha) se nikaah kiya, to aap ehraam ki awastha mein the, jab unse aapka milan hua, to aap ehraam khol kar halaal ho chuke the aur unki mrityu sarif naami sthaan mein hui.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne maimoona (radiyallahu anha) se nikaah kiya, to aap ehraam ki awastha mein the, unse aapka milan hua, to aap ehraam khol chuke the aur unki mrityu sarif naami sthaan mein hui.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58074: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne jab unse nikaah kiya, to aap ehraam ki awastha mein nahin the.

Yazeed bin asam se warnit hai, woh kahte hainh mujhe maimoona bint haaris ne bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne jab unse nikaah kiya, to aap ehraam ki awastha mein nahin the. Yazeed kahte hain ki maimoona (radiyallahu anha) meri tatha abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ki khaala theen.
58075: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne autaas yuddh ke saal teen dinon ke liye mutaaa़ ki anumti di aur phir usse mana kar diya.)

Iyaas bin salma apne pita se riwayat karte hain, unhonne kaha kih Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne autaas yuddh ke saal teen dinon ke liye mutaaa़ ki anumti di aur phir usse mana kar diya.
58076: Allah taaala ne halaala karne waale aur halaala karvaane waale par laanat bheji hai.
Ali (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Allah taaala ne halaala karne waale aur halaala karvaane waale par laanat bheji hai."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58077: Kore khaya hua vyabhichaari apne jaisi stri hi se nikaah kar sakta hai.
Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Kore khaya hua vyabhichaari apne jaisi stri hi se nikaah kar sakta hai."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58078: Nahin, aisa us samay tak nahin ho sakta, jab tak pahle pati ki tarah doosra pati bhi uska maza na chakh le.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki ek vyakti ne apni stri ko teen talaaq de diya aur ek any vyakti ne usse nikaah kar liya. Parantu usne bhi uske saath sanbhog karne se pahle use talaaq de diya. Aise mein, uske pahle pati ne usse nikaah karne ki mansha jataai. Lekin jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se iske baare mein poochha gaya, to aapne farmayaah "Nahin, aisa us samay tak nahin ho sakta, jab tak pahle pati ki tarah doosra pati bhi uska maza na chakh le."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58080: Ai banu bayaaza, abu hind se apni betiyon ka nikaah karo aur uske yahaan apne purooshon ke liye nikaah ka sandesh bhejo.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki abu hind ne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke sir ke beech waale bhaag mein seengi lagaai, to Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Ai banu bayaaza, abu hind se apni betiyon ka nikaah karo aur uske yahaan apne purooshon ke liye nikaah ka sandesh bhejo." Tatha aapne yeh bhi kahaah "Tum jin cheezon ke dvaara ilaaj karte ho, yadi unmen se kisi cheez mein bhalaai hai, to woh seengi (pachhna) lagaana hai."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58081: 'Wala' (arthaat waaris banne ka adhikaar) uske liye hai, jisne mukt karne ka upkaar kiya ho.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ka warnan hai ki unhonne bareera (radiyallahu anha) ko kuchh ansaariyon se khareeda, to unhonne unke 'wala' (arthaat unke waaris banne ka adhikaar) apne paas rakhne ki shart laga di, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallallam) ne farmayaah " 'Wala' (arthaat waaris banne ka adhikaar) uske liye hai, jisne mukt karne ka upkaar kiya ho." Tatha unke pati daas the, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne (unke mukt ho jaane ke baad) unhen apne pati ke saath rahne ya na rahne ka akhtiyaar de diya. Tatha unhonne aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ko maans bheja, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne kahaah "Behtar hoga ki tum hamaare liye is maans ka kuchh bhaag pakaao." Ispar aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne kahaah yeh to bareera ko sadqa -daan- kiya gaya hai. Tab aapne farmayaah "Yeh uske liye daan hai, parantu hamaare liye bhent -hadiya- hai."

Is hadees se maaloom hua ki mominon ki maan aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne bareera (radiyallahu anha) ko khareedkar mukt kar diya, to unke poorv maalikon ne chaaha ki 'wala' (arthaat waaris banne ka adhikaar) unko praapt ho. Yeh dekh aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne bataya ki yeh shart sahi nahin hai. Waaris banne ka adhikaar usko praapt hoga, jisne aazaad kiya ho. Bareera (radiyallahu anha) mughees naami ek daas ke wiwaah mein theen. Jab woh aazaad ho gaeen aur apne nafs ki maalik ban gaeen, to aapne unhen akhtiyaar diya ki chaahen to unke wiwaah mein rahen aur chaahen to unse alag ho jayen, kyonki aazaad hone ke baad woh unse oonche darje ki ho chuki hain. Isi tarah unke paas kaheen se maans bheja gaya, to uska kuchh bhaag aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ko bhej diya. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne use khaane ki ichchha jataai, to aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne kaha ki woh bareera (razyallahu anha) ke paas daan svaroop aya hai aur aap sadqa nahin khaate. Yeh sun aapne bataya ki bareera (radiyallahu anha) sadqa ke maadhyam se uska maalik ban chuki hain aur ab woh Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas uphaar ke roop mein hastaantrit hoga. Isliye uska hukm badal jayega. Ab woh uphaar aur bhent qaraar payega. Atah aap tatha aapke pariwaar ke liye haraam nahin rahega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58082: Donon mein se jise chaaho, talaaq de do.

Jahhaak bin fairoz apne pita se riwayat karte hain, woh kahte hain ki mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, main musalmaan ho gaya hoon aur mere nikaah mein do sagi bahne hain? To aapne kahaah "Donon mein se jise chaaho, talaaq de do."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58083: Ghailaan bin salma saqfi musalmaan ho gae aur unke paas jaahiliyat kaal mein das striyaan theen, jo unke saath musalmaan ho gaeen, to Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen aadesh diya ki unmen se chaar ko chun len (tatha baaki ko talaak de den).

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki ghailaan bin salma saqfi musalmaan ho gae aur unke paas jaahiliyat kaal mein das striyaan theen, jo unke saath musalmaan ho gaeen, to Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen aadesh diya ki unmen se chaar ko chun len (tatha baaki ko talaak de den).
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58084: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apni beti zainab (radiyallahu anha) ko abul aas bin rabi (radiyallahu anhu) ke ghar chhah saal baad pahle nikaah ke aadhaar par hi bhej diya tha aur nae sire se nikaah nahin karaya tha.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apni beti zainab (radiyallahu anha) ko abul aas bin rabi (radiyallahu anhu) ke ghar chhah saal baad pahle nikaah ke aadhaar par hi bhej diya tha aur nae sire se nikaah nahin karaya tha.
[ise ibne khuzaima ne 'at-tauheed' mein riwayat kiya hai. - ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58090: Woh vyakti dhikkaar ka haqdaar hai, jisne apni aurat se uske maladvaar mein sanbhog kiya.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Woh vyakti dhikkaar ka haqdaar hai, jisne apni aurat se uske maladvaar mein sanbhog kiya."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- apni patni ke saath guda mein sanbhog karne ke sanbandh mein chetaavni dete hue kahte hain ki jo vyakti aisa karta hai use Allah ki daya se door kar diya jaata hai. Wastutah guda maithun ek bahut bara paap hai.

Stri ke guda (maladvaar) mein sanbhog karna haraam hai.
Apni patni ke guda ko chhor uske poore shareer se aanandit hona jayaz hai.
Ek musalmaan, Allah ke aadesh ka paalan karte hue, mahila ki yoni mein sanbhog karta hai. Uske guda mein nahin. Kyonki yeh maanav svabhaav ka ullanghan hai, maanav jaati ke winaash ka saadhan hai tatha svasth svabhaav ke wiruddh evn pati-patni ke liye atyant haanikaarak kaary hai.
[ise abu daawood ne tatha nasai ne al-kubra mein evn ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
58091: Allah us vyakti ki or (daya ki drishti se) nahin dekhega, jo kisi mard ya aurat ke maladvaar mein sanbhog kare.

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Allah us vyakti ki or (daya ki drishti se) nahin dekhega, jo kisi mard ya aurat ke maladvaar mein sanbhog kare."

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek bahut hi ganbheer chetaavni dete hue kaha ki Allah us vyakti ko daya ki drishti se nahin dekhega, jo kisi purush ke saath guda ya kisi mahila ke saath guda mein sanbhog karta hai. Yeh krity sabse bare paapon mein se ek hai.

Purush ka doosre purush ke saath sanbhog arthaat guda maithun maha paap hai.
Aurat ke saath guda maithun maha paap hai.
Is hadees mein aye hue shabdon "Allah nahin dekhega" Ka arth yeh hai ki Allah daya evn karuna ki nazar se nahin dekhega. Yahaan aam dekhna muraad nahin hai. Kyonki Allah ki nazar se duniya ki koi bhi cheez ojhal nahin rahti.
Ye krity waastav mein atyadhik anaitik aur maanavta ke liye bahut haanikaarak hain, kyonki inmen maanav svabhaav ki shuddh prakriti ka ullanghan karna, maanav wansh ki sankhya kam karna, wiwaahit jeewan ko nasht aur barbaad karna, ghrina aur dushmani ke beej bona aur gande sthaanon par jaana jaisi cheejen shaamil hain.
[ise tirmizi ne tatha nasai ne al-sunan al-kubra mein riwayat kiya hai]
58093: Mainne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Ham mein se kise ek ke oopar uski patni ke kiya adhikaar hain? Aapne uttar diya : "Jab tum khaao to use khilaao, jab tum pahno ya farmaya jab tum kamaao to use pahnaao, chehre par na maaro, bura-bhala na kaho aur use bistar se alag karke ghar ke siwa kaheen aur na rakho.

Muaawiya qushairi radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Mainne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Ham mein se kise ek ke oopar uski patni ke kiya adhikaar hain? Aapne uttar diya : "Jab tum khaao to use khilaao, jab tum pahno ya farmaya jab tum kamaao to use pahnaao, chehre par na maaro, bura-bhala na kaho aur use bistar se alag karke ghar ke siwa kaheen aur na rakho."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha gaya ki pati par patni ke kya adhikaar hain, to aapne uttar mein kuchh cheezen bataaeen, jaise :

1- use chhorkar khud na khaao. Jab-jab khaao, use bhi khilaao.

2- use chhorkar khud na pahno. Jab kamaao, saamarthy ho aur khud pahno, to use bhi pahnaao.

3- use bina kisi kaaran aur zaroorat ke na maaro. Agar adab sikhaane ke liye ya uski or se kuchh kartavyon ke nirvahan mein hone waali kotaahi ke kaaran maarne ki zaroorat par jaye, to maar kashtadayak nahin honi chahiye tatha chehre par nahin maara jaana chahiye. Kyonki chehra shareer ka sabse mahatvapoorn aur hamesha saamne dikhne waala bhaag aur usmen kai naazuk ang bhi hain.

4- gaali-galoj mat karo. Yeh mat kaho ki Allah tere chehre ko kuroop kar de. Koi aisi bad-dua na karo, jismen chehre ya shareer ke kisi bhaag ko kuroop karna shaamil ho. Kyonki insaan ke shareer evn chehre ki rachna Allah ne ki hai aur usi ne use sundar shakl evn soorat di hai, jabki rachna ko dosh dena daraasal rachyita ko dosh dena hai.

5-aurat ko jab alag karo to kewal bed-room mein uska bistar alag kar do aur use chhor kar kaheen aur na jaao , aur na hi use doosre ghar bhejo. Kyonki pati-patni ke beech aksar aisa hota hua dikh jaata hai.

Sahaaba aksar yeh jaanne ka prayaas kiya karte the ki unpar doosron ke kya adhikaar hain aur doosron par unke kya adhikaar hain.
Pati apni patni ke bhojan, kapre aur aawaas aadi ki vyawastha karne ke liye jimmedaar hai.
Naitik aur shaareeri donon etibaar se bura banaakar pesh karne ki manaahi.
Kisi se "Tum ek ghatiya qabeele ya ghatiya pariwaar se ho" Aadi kahna un baaton mein se hain jo kisi ko bura banaane ke antargat aate hain.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
58097: Yahoodi kaha karte the kih jab koi vyakti apni patni se peechhe ki or se (kintu yoni mein hi) sanbhog karega, to bachcha bhenga paida hoga. Ispar yeh ayat utreeh {نساؤكم حرث لكم فأتوا حرثكم أنى شئتم} {tumhaari striyaan tumhaari khetiyaan hain. Tumhen anumti hai ki apni khetiyon mein jidhar se chaaho, jaao.} [soora al-baqraah 223]

Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki yahoodi kahte theh jab koi vyakti apni patni se peechhe ki or se (kintu yoni mein hi) sanbhog karega, to bachcha bhenga paida hoga. Ispar yeh ayat utreeh {نساؤكم حرث لكم فأتوا حرثكم أنى شئتم} {tumhaari striyaan tumhaari khetiyaan hain. Tumhen anumti hai ki apni khetiyon mein jidhar se chaaho, jaao.} [soora al-baqraah 223]
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58098: Jab koi vyakti apni patni ko apne bistar par bulaye aur uske inkaar karne par woh naaraaz hokar raat guzaare, to farishte subah tak uspar laanat karte rahte hain.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jab koi vyakti apni patni ko apne bistar par bulaye aur uske inkaar karne par woh naaraaz hokar raat guzaare, to farishte subah tak uspar laanat karte rahte hain."

Is hadees mein bataya gaya hai ki jab stri ko uska pati sanbhog ke liye bulaye, to woh uski baat maan le, warna farishton ki laanat ki adhikaari ban jayegi. Lekin aisa us samay hoga, jab pati baat na maanne se naaraaz ho jaye, jaisa ki Bukhari ki riwayat mein ullikhit hai. Agar woh isse naaraaz nahin hota, to koi harj nahin hai. Isi tarah, yadi patni ke paas koi sharai kaaran ho, maslan beemaar ho aur sanbhog ke liye saksham na ho ya kisi any uchit kaaran ki wajah se bistar mein ja na sake, tab bhi koi harj nahin hai. Parantu, yadi is prakaar ki koi baat na ho, to uske paas jaana aur uski baat maanna zaroori hoga. Phir jab patni par pati ke adhikaar ke sanbandh mein is prakaar ki baat hai, to pati ko bhi chahiye ki jab patni ke andar sanbhog ki ichchha dekhe, to uski ichchha poori kare. Kyonki Allah taaala ka farmaan hai : "Tatha unke saath uchit vyavhaar karo."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58099: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kritrim baal jorne waali tatha jurvaane waali aur godne waali tatha gudvaane waali par laanat bheji hai.

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kritrim baal jorne waali tatha jurvaane waali aur godne waali tatha gudvaane waali par laanat bheji hai.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne nimnalikhit chaar prakaar ke logon ke liye Allah ki daya se dhutkaare jaane ki bad-dua ki hai : 1- apne ya kisi doosre ke baal mein kisi doosre ka baal jorne waali. 2- kisi se apne baal mein kisi doosre ka baal jor dene ka aagrah karne waali. 3- godne waali, jo shobha tatha sundarta ke liye chehre, hatheli ya seena aadi shareer ke kisi ang mein sooi chubhaakar wahaan surma aadi daal deti hai, taaki woh sthaan neela ya hara par jaye. 4- kisi doosre se godne ka aagrah karne waali. Ye saare kaary bare gunaahon ke dayre mein aate hain.

Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Mana baal mein baal jorna hai. Baal se baal ke siwa kapra aadi jorna mana nahin hai.
Kisi gunaah ke kaam par sahyog karna haraam hai.
Allah ki rachna mein pariwartan ki manaahi, kyonki yeh fareb evn dhokha hai.
Jin logon par Allah aur uske Rasool ne saamaany taur par laanat bheji ho, unpar laanat bhejna jayaz hai.
Is hadees ki ru se aaj ke zamaane ka wig pahanna bhi mana hai. Ghair-Muslim se mushaabhat aur dhokhe ke kaaran yeh haraam hai.
Khattaabi kahte hain : In cheezon ke baare mein is prakaar ki bari chetaavni isliye di gai hai ki inka istemaal logon ko dhokha evn fareb dena hai. Agar inmen se kisi cheez ke istemaal ki anumti di jaati, to yeh any prakaar ke dhokhon ki anumti dene ka sabab banta. Doosri baat yeh hai ki yeh cheezen Allah ki rachna mein pariwartan ka dyotak hain. Isi ki or ishaara karte hue abdullah bin masood ki hadees mein kaha gaya hai : "Allah ki rachna mein pariwartan karne waaliyaan", aur Allah hi adhik jaanta hai.
Navvi kahte hain : Godna aur gudvaana donon haraam hain. Jis sthaan ko goda jaye, woh naapaak ho jaata hai. Godi gai aakritiyon ko ilaaj se hataana sanbhav ho, to hataana waajib hoga. Agar hataane ke liye opreshan zaroori ho aur isse jaan jaane, kisi ang ke nasht ya bekaar ho jaane ya kisi zaahiri ang ke bahut zyaada badnuma ho jaane ka bhay ho, to hataana waajib nahin hoga. Aise mein, tauba kar li jaye, to gunaah nahin rah jaata. Lekin agar oopar bataai gai baaton mein se kisi baat ka bhay na ho, to hataana zaroori hoga, aur deri karne ki paristhiti mein gunaahgaar hoga.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
58100: Mainne bachche ko doodh pilaane ke dinon mein, patni se sanbhog karne se, mana karne ka iraada kar liya tha, lekin room tatha faaras waalon ko dekha ki we aisa karte hain aur isse unke bachchon ko kuchh nuqsaan nahin hota.

Ukkaasha (radiyallahu anhu) ki bahan juzaama bint wahab (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki main kuchh logon ke saath Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aai. Us samay aap kah rahe theh "Mainne bachche ko doodh pilaane ke dinon mein patni se sanbhog karne se mana karne ka iraada kar liya tha, lekin room tatha faaras waalon ko dekha ki we aisa karte hain aur isse unke bachchon ko kuchh nuqsaan nahin hota." Phir aapse azl (sanbhog ke samay weery skhalan se pahle ling ko yoni se nikaal lena) ke baare mein poochha gaya, to farmayaah "Yeh gupt roop se jeewit gaarna hai." Ubaidullah ne muqri se riwayat karte hue apni hadees mein yeh izaafa kiya haih tatha isi ka zikr is ayat mein haih {وَإِذَا الْمَوْءُودَةُ سُئِلَتْ} {tatha jab jeewit gaari hui bachchi se poochha jayega.} [soora at-takveerah 8]
58101: Yahoodi kahte hain ki azl jeewit dafan karne ki ek chhoti shakl hai. Aapne kahaah "Yahoodi jhooth bolte hain. Yadi Allah paida karna chaahe, to tum use rok nahin sakte."

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki ek vyakti ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, mere paas ek daasi hai. Main usse sanbhog karte samay azl (sanbhog ke samay weery skhalan se pahle ling ko yoni se nikaal lena) karta hoon. Main nahin chaahta ki woh garbhavti ho. Daraasal main bhi wahi chaahta hoon, jo aam purush chaahte hain. Jabki yahoodi kahte hain ki azl jeewit dafan karne ki ek chhoti shakl hai. Aapne kahaah "Yahoodi jhooth bolte hain. Yadi Allah paida karna chaahe, to tum use rok nahin sakte."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58102: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) (kabhi-kabhi) saari striyon ke paas jaane ke pashchaat ek hi dapha ant mein ghusl (snaan) karte the.
Anas (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) (kabhi-kabhi) saari striyon ke paas jaane ke pashchaat ek hi dapha ant mein ghusl (snaan) karte the.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58103: Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se poochha gaya ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki patniyon) ka mahar kitna hota tha? Unhonne kahaah aapki patniyon ke liye aapka mahar baarah ooqiya aur ek nashsh (aadha ooqiya) tha.

Abu salma bin abdur rahmaan kahte hainh mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki patni aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se poochha ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki patniyon) ka mahar kitna hota tha? Unhonne kahaah aapki patniyon ke liye aapka mahar baarah ooqiya aur ek nashsh tha. Unhonne kahaah kya jaante ho ki nashsh kya hai? Mainne kahaah nahin! To kahaah "Aadha ooqiya. Is tarah ye paanch sau dirham hue. Yahi Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) dvaara aapki patniyon ko diya gaya mahar hai".
58104: Ali (raziyallahu anhu) ne kahaah mainne faatima (radiyallahu anha) se shaadi ki aur kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, mujhe unke saath shaadeeshuda jeewan aaranbh karne den. To aapne kahaah "Use kuchh do." Mainne kahaah mere paas kuchh nahin hai. Aapne kahaah "Tumhaara woh hutmi kawach kahaan hai?"

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki ali (raziyallahu anhu) ne kahaah mainne faatima (radiyallahu anha) se shaadi ki aur kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, mujhe unke saath shaadeeshuda jeewan aaranbh karne den. To aapne kahaah "Use kuchh do." Mainne kahaah mere paas kuchh nahin hai. Aapne kahaah "Tumhaara woh hutmi kawach kahaan hai?" Mainne kahaah woh mere paas hai. Aapne kahaah "Use wahi de do."
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58106: Abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas ek vyakti ka maamla aya, jisne ek aurat se shaadi ki, kintu uska mahar nirdhaarit nahin kiya aur usse sanbhog karne se pahle hi mar gaya. Ispar abdullah (radiyallahu anhu) ne kahaah logon se poochho ki kya unke paas is sanbandh mein Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki koi hadees hai? Logon ne kahaah ai abu abdur rahmaan, hamen iske baare mein koi hadees nahin milti. Yeh sun unhonne kahaah main apni ray se kahoonga. Yadi sahi hua to Allah ki or se uski taupheeq ke kaaran hai.

Alaqma tatha asvad kahte hain ki abdullah bin masaood (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas ek vyakti ka maamla aya, jisne ek aurat se shaadi ki, kintu uska mahar nirdhaarit nahin kiya aur usse sanbhog karne se pahle hi mar gaya. Ispar abdullah (radiyallahu anhu) ne kahaah logon se poochho ki kya unke paas is sanbandh mein Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki koi hadees hai? Logon ne kahaah ai abu abdur rahmaan, hamen iske baare mein aapki koi hadees nahin milti. Yeh sun unhonne kahaah main apni ray se kahoonga. Yadi sahi hua to Allah ki or se uski taupheeq ke kaaran hai. Use uske pariwaar ki any striyon ke jaisa mahar milega. Na kam na zyaada. Saath hi use meeraas bhi milegi aur iddat bhi guzaarni hogi. Yeh sun, ashja qabeele ka ek vyakti khara hua aur kahne lagaah Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hamaare beech birva bint waasiq naami ek stri ke sanbandh mein isi tarah ka nirnay diya tha. Daraasal usne ek vyakti se shaadi ki thi, jo sanbhog se pahle hi mar gaya tha. Atah, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne nirnay diya ki use uske pariwaar ki striyon jaisa mahar milega tatha meeraas bhi milegi aur iddat bhi guzaarni hogi. Ispar abdullah (radiyallahu anhu) ne apne haath uthaye aur 'Allahu akbar' kaha.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58110: Sabse achchha nikaah woh hai, jo sabse aasaan ho.

Uqba bin aamir (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Sabse achchha nikaah woh hai, jo sabse aasaan ho." Tatha Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ek vyakti se kahaah "Kya tumhen yeh pasand hoga ki main amuk stri se tumhaara nikaah kar doon?" Usne kahaah haan! Aapne us mahila se bhi kahaah "Kya tumhen pasand hoga ki main amuk purush se tumhaara nikaah kar doon?" Usne bhi kahaah haan! To aapne donon ka nikaah mahar tay kiye bina hi kar diya. Phir usne waiwaahik jeewan aaranbh karte samay bhi apni patni ko kuchh nahin diya. Lekin, jab marne laga, to bolaah Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne amuk stri se mera nikaah karaya tha aur mainne use kuchh nahin diya tha. Atah, ab use khaibar ka apna hissa deta hoon. Chunaanche, uska khaibar ka jo hissa tha, use uski patni ne usse lekar becha, to uski qeemat ek laakh hui.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58112: Jab tummen se kisi ko daawat-e-waleema ke liye bulaya jaye, to usmen zaroor shareek ho.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah "Jab tummen se kisi ko daawat-e-waleema ke liye bulaya jaye, to usmen zaroor shareek ho."
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58113: Sabse bura khaana waleeme ka woh khaana hai, jismen dhanvaanon ko bulaya jaye aur nirdhanon ko chhor diya jaye aur jisne daawat chhor di, usne Allah aur uske Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki naafarmaani ki.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki unhonne kahaah sabse bura khaana waleeme ka woh khaana hai, jismen dhanvaanon ko bulaya jaye aur nirdhanon ko chhor diya jaye aur jisne daawat chhor di, usne Allah aur uske Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki naafarmaani ki.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58114: Jab tummen se kisi ko (waleeme ki daawat mein) bulaya jaye, to woh daawat qabool kare. Agar rozedaar ho, to dua de aur agar roze se na ho, to khaye.

Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jab tummen se kisi ko (waleeme ki daawat mein) bulaya jaye, to woh daawat qabool kare. Agar rozedaar ho, to dua de aur agar roze se na ho, to khaye."
58116: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apni ek patni ka waleema do mudd jau se kiya tha.
Saphiya bint shaiba (radiyallahu anha) se riwayat hai, woh kahti hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne apni ek patni ka waleema do mudd jau se kiya tha.
58117: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) madeene aur khaibar ke beech teen din ruke aur waheen safiya (radiyallahu anha) se (shaadi ke baad) waiwaahik sanbandh sthaapit kiya.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) madeene aur khaibar ke beech teen din ruke aur waheen safiya (radiyallahu anha) se (shaadi ke baad) waiwaahik sanbandh sthaapit kiya. Mainne musalmaanon ko aapke waleeme ke liye bulaya, to usmen na roti thi aur na maans. Kewal itna hua ki aapne bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) ko dastarkhaan bichhaane ka aadesh diya. Jab dastarkhaan bichha diya gaya, to us par khajoor, paneer aur ghi rakh diya gaya (aur sab logon ne khaya). Phir, musalmaan kahne lage ki safiya (radiyallahu anha) aapki patniyon mein se hain ya daasi? Phir khud hi kahne lage ki agar Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) unhen parde mein rakhte hain, to aapki patni hain aur agar parde mein nahin rakhte hain, to daasi. Jab aapne kooch farmaya, to safiya (radiyallahu anha) ke liye apne peechhe baithne ki jagah banaai aur uspar parda latka diya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai aur shabd Bukhari ke hain.]
58119: Abu juhaipha (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki main Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas tha ki aapne ek vyakti se, jo aapke nikat tha, farmayaah "Main tek lagaakar nahin khaata."

Is hadees mein abu juhaifa wahb bin abdullah suwaai -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka tareeqa yeh nahin tha ki tek lagaakar khaana khayen. Maslan apne ek pahlu ko takiya aadi par rakhkar uske sahaare baithen ya ek haath ko zameen par rakhkar uska sahaara len. Aap is tarah baithne se parhez karte the. Kyonki is tarah baithna adhik bhojan karne ka taqaaza karta hai, jo ki bhaareepan evn susti laata hai aur isse kai shaareerik nuqsaan bhi hote hain. Kyonki jab aadmi tek lagaye hue hota hai, to uske khaane ki nali seedhi rahne ki bajay ek or jhuki hui rahti hai aur apni praakritik awastha mein nahin hoti, jisse nuqsaan hone ki sanbhaavna rahti hai. Isi tarah khaana khaate samay tek lagaakar baithna insaan ke abhimaan ko pradarshit karta hai aur winamrata ke wipreet hai.
58120: Bachche, bismillah parh liya karo, daahine haath se khaya karo aur apne saamne se khaya karo.

Umar bin abu salma radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Main bachcha tha aur Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki dekh-rekh mein tha. (Khaana khaate samay) mera haath bartan mein chaaron or ghooma karta tha. Isliye Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne mujhse farmaya : "Bachche, bismillah parh liya karo, daahine haath se khaya karo aur apne saamne se khaya karo." Chunaanche uske baad hamesha main isi nirdesh ke anusaar khaana khaata raha.
