Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki patni umm-e-salma radiyallahu anha ke bete umar bin abu salma radiyallahu anhu, jo ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki paravrish mein the, woh kahte hain ki khaate samay unka haath bartan ke chaaron or ghooma karta tha aur jahaan-tahaan se khaana utha liya karta tha, isliye Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unko khaane ke teen aadaab sikhaye :

Pahla yeh ki khaane se pahle bismillah kahna chahiye.

Doosra yeh ki dayen haath se khaana chahiye.

Aur teesra yeh ki khaana saamne se khaana chahiye.

Khaane-peene ka ek adab yeh hai ki shuru mein bismillah kaha jaye.
Bachchon ko aadaab (shishtaachaar) sikhaana chahiye, khaas taur se un bachchon ko, jo aapki kifaalat mein hon.
Bachchon ko shiksha dene aur adab sikhaane ke sannbandh mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka narm vyavhaar aur udaarta.
Khaana khaane ka ek adab yeh hai ki saamne se khaya jaye. Haan, agar plate mein khaane ki alag-alag cheezen maujood hon, ismen koi harj nahin hai.
Sahaaba Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam dvaara sikhaye gae aadaab par paabandi se amal karte the. Aisa umar bin abu salma ke is kathan se maaloom hota hai : Chunaanche uske baad hamesha main isi nirdesh ke anusaar khaana khaata raha.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
58121: Barkat khaane ke beech mein utarti hai. Atah, uske donon kinaaron se khaao, beech se na khaao.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhama) kahte hain ki Nabi ( sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne pharmayaah "Barkat khaane ke beech mein utarti hai. Atah, uske donon kinaaron se khaao, beech se na khaao."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58122: Jab tummen se koi khaana khaye, to apne dayen haath se khaye aur tummen se koi kuchh piye to apne dayen haath se piye. Kyonki shaitaan apne bayen haath se khaata aur bayen haath se peeta hai.

Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jab tummen se koi khaana khaye, to apne dayen haath se khaye aur tummen se koi kuchh piye to apne dayen haath se piye. Kyonki shaitaan apne bayen haath se khaata aur bayen haath se peeta hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam is baat ka aadesh de rahe hain ki musalmaan apne dayen haath se khaye aur piye, jabki is baat se mana kar rahe hain ki koi apne bayen haath se khaye aur piye. Aisa isliye ki bayen haath se khaane aur peene ka kaam shaitaan karta hai.
Bayen haath se khaane ya peene ka kaam karke shaitaan ki samroopta apnaane ki manaahi.
58123: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne bartan mein saans lene ya phoonk maarne se mana kiya hai.
Ibne umar radiyallahu anhuma se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne bartan mein saans lene ya phoonk maarne se mana kiya hai.

Is hadees mein khaane-peene ke shishtaachaaron mein se ek shishtaataar ka bayaan hai. Woh hai, jis bartan mein khaana khaya ya piya ja raha ho, usmen saans lena ya phoonk maarna. Bartan mein saans lene se mana isliye kiya gaya hai ki iske kai nuqsaan hain. Jaise bartan ka ganda ho jaana aur ek vyakti ke saans lene ke baad doosre ko usse peene se ghin aana aadi. Jaisa ki ek hi samay saans lene aur peene se dam bhi ghut sakta hai. Atah kuchh peete samay bartan ke baahar teen baar saans lena chahiye. Yeh baat hadees mein aai hai aur yeh adhik achchha bhi hai. Is hadees mein khaane-peene ki cheezon mein phoonk maarne se bhi mana kiya gaya hai. Chaahe kaaran kuchh bhi ho. Jaise khaane ka garm hona ya koi wastu hataana aadi. Yeh manaahi isliye aai hai, taaki khaane-peene ki cheezon ko thook aur munh ki badbu aadi ki gandgi se bachaya ja sake.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58125: Jiski do patniyaan hon aur uska jhukaav kisi ek ki or ho, woh qayaamat ke din is awastha mein ayega ki uska ek pahlu jhuka hua hoga.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jiski do patniyaan hon aur uska jhukaav kisi ek ki or ho, woh qayaamat ke din is awastha mein ayega ki uska ek pahlu jhuka hua hoga."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- farma rahe hain ki jis vyakti ki ek se adhik patniyaan hon aur unke beech un baaton mein nyay na kare jinmen nyay kar sakta ho , maslan kharch, rahne-sahne ke liye ghar ki uplabdhata, wastr evn raat bitaane mein baraabri na kare, to qayaamat ke din uski saza yeh hogi ki uske shareer ka aadha bhaag jhuka hua hoga. Bilkul usi tarah, jaise apne vyavhaar mein ek or jhuka hua tha.

Do ya do se adhik patniyaan hone ki awastha mein unke beech nyay ke saath adhikaaron ka witran karna pati par aniwaary hai. Jin baaton mein nyay kar sakta hai to uske liye yeh haraam hai ki unmen kisi ek patni ki or jhuk jaye, chaahe kharch karne ke maamle mein ho, raat bitaane ke maamle mein ho ya achchhe vyavhaar aadi ke maamle mein.
Baari aur any aisi cheezon ka samaan witran, jo insaan ke niyantran mein hain. Jahaan tak prem aur dil ka jhukaav aadi ka prashn hai, jo insaan ke niyantran mein nahin hain, we is hadees ke antargat nahin aate. Isi baat ko is ayat mein bhi bayaan kiya gaya hai : "Tum chaaho to bhi aurton ke beech nyay nahin kar sakte." [soora nisa : 129]
Insaan ko pratiphal usi koti ka milega, jis koti ka uska amal raha hoga. Atah jo pati duniya mein ek patni ko chhorkar doosri patni ki or jhuk jaata hai, woh jab qayaamat ke din upasthit hoga, to uska shareer ek or jhuka hua hoga.
Bandon ke adhikaaron ka mahatv. Bandon ke adhikaar maaf nahin honge. Kyonki bande apne adhikaaron ko praapt karne ke liye prayaasrat raha karte hain.
Jab kisi purush ko yeh bhay ho ki woh apni patniyon ke beech nyay nahin kar payega, to uske liye ek hi patni rakhna musathab hai, taaki dharm ka ullanghan na ho. Allah taaala ka kathan hai : "Lekin yadi tumhen bhay ho ki tum nyay nahin kar paaoge, to ek hi patni kaafi hai." [an-nisa : 3]
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, nasai, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
58126: Sunnat yeh hai ki jab aadmi patni rahte hue kisi kunwaari se wiwaah kare, to uske paas saat din rahe aur uske baad baari lagaye tatha jab kisi ghairkunwaari se wiwaah kare, to uske paas teen din rahe aur uske baad baari lagaye.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hainh sunnat yeh hai ki jab aadmi patni rahte hue kisi kunwaari se wiwaah kare, to uske paas saat din rahe aur uske baad baari lagaye tatha jab kisi ghairkunwaari se wiwaah kare, to uske paas teen din rahe aur uske baad baari lagaye.
Abu qilaaba kahte hainh yadi main chaahoon, to kah sakta hoon ki anas (radiyallahu anhu) ne is hadees ko Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se riwayat kiya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58127: Tumhaare pati ke nikat tumhaare maan-sammaan mein koi kami nahin hai. Yadi tum chaaho, to main tumhaare paas saat din rahoonga. Aur agar tumhaare paas saat din rahoonga, to shesh striyon ke paas bhi saat din rahoonga.

Umme salma (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne jab unse nikaah kiya, to unke paas teen din rahe aur farmayaah "Tumhaare pati ke nikat tumhaare maan-sammaan mein koi kami nahin hai. Yadi tum chaaho, to main tumhaare paas saat din rahoonga. Aur agar tumhaare paas saat din rahoonga, to shesh striyon ke paas bhi saat din rahoonga."
58128: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) baari ka din baantte samay aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ko do din diya karte the. Unka din aur sauda (radiyallahu anha) ka din.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hainh mainne sauda (radiyallahu anha) ke atirikt kisi stri ko nahin dekha, jinke sthaan par mujhe khud hona sabse adhik pasand ho. Woh ek mazboot dil wa dimaagh ki maalik stri theen. Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki jab woh boorhi ho gaeen, to unhonne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se baari mein milne waala apna din aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ko de diya. Unhonne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, mainne aapse milne waala apni baari ka din aaisha ko de diya. Yahi kaaran hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) baari ka din baantte samay aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ko do din diya karte the. Unka din aur sauda (radiyallahu anha) ka din.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58129: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hamaare yahaan thaharne ke din baantte samay hamen ek-doosre par tarjeeh nahin dete the. Aksar aisa hota ki aap ham sabhon ke paas aate aur apni har patni ke nikat baithte. Haan, magar sanbhog na karte. Yahaan tak ki apni us patni ke paas pahunch jaate, jiski baari ka din hota aur uske paas raat guzaarte.

Urva kahte hain ki aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne farmayaah ai mere bhaanje, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hamaare yahaan thaharne ke din baantte samay hamen ek-doosre par tarjeeh nahin dete the. Aksar aisa hota ki aap ham sabhon ke paas aate aur apni har patni ke nikat baithte. Haan, magar sanbhog na karte. Yahaan tak ki apni us patni ke paas pahunch jaate, jiski baari ka din hota aur uske paas raat guzaarte. Jab sauda bint zamaa (radiyallahu anha) wriddh ho gaeen aur darne lageen ki kaheen Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) unhen chhor na den, to boleenh ai Allah ke Rasool, meri baari ka din aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ke liye hai. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unki is peshkash ko grahan kar liya. Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hainh ham kaha karte the ki Allah taaala ne isi ke sanbandh mein ya isi jaisi cheezon ke sanbandh mein yeh ayat utaari haih {وإن امرأة خافت من بعلها نشوزًا} (soora an-nisaah 128) (arthaat, yadi kisi stri ko apne pati ki or s durvyavhaar ya berukhi ka bhay ho, -to ismen unke liye koi dosh nahin ki we donon aapas mein mel-milaap ki koi raah nikaal len-.)
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58130: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) meethi cheezen aur madhu pasand karte the. Saamaanyatah jab asr ki namaz parh lete, to ek-ek kar apni patniyon ke paas jaate aur unke paas baithte. (Ek din) aap hafsa (radiyallahu anha) ke paas gae aur unke yahaan saamaany se adhik ruk gae.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) meethi cheezen aur madhu pasand karte the. Saamaanyatah jab asr ki namaz parh lete, to ek-ek kar apni patniyon ke paas jaate aur unke paas baithte. (Ek din) aap hafsa (radiyallahu anha) ke paas gae aur unke yahaan saamaany se adhik ruk gae. Mainne iske baare mein jaankaari praapt ki, to mujhse kaha gaya ki hafsa (radiyallahu anha) ko unki qaum ki kisi stri ne ek dibba madhu bhent kiya hai aur unhonne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko madhu se bana hua pey pilaya hai. Yeh sun mainne apne man mein kahaah Allah ki qasam, ham aapke liye zaroor koi chaal chalenge. Mainne sauda (radiyallahu anha) ke saamne iska zikr kiya aur kahaah jab aap tumhaare paas ayen aur tumhaare nikat baith jayen, to aapse kahnaah ai Allah ke Rasool, kya aapne maghaafeer (ek badboodaar gond) khaya hai? Aapka uttar hoga ki nahin! To kahnaah phir yeh badbu kaisi hai? Daraasal, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko yeh baat naapsand thi ki aapse koi durgandh mahsoos ho. Aise mein aap tumse kahengeh mujhe hafsa ne madhu ka pey pilaya hai. Atah, tum aapse kahnaah madhumakkhi ne urfut per ka ras choosa hoga. Main bhi yahi baat aapse kahoongi aur ai safiya, tum bhi yahi kahna. Sauda radiyallahu anha (aaisha radiyallahu anha ke saamne is ghatna ka ullekh karte hue) kaha karti theen ki uski qasam jiske atirikt koi poojy nahin hai, abhi aap dvaar tak hi pahunche the ki mainne tumhaare bhay se iraada kar liya ki woh baat kah doon, jo tumne mujhse kahi thi. Jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) unke nikat pahunche, to unhonne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, kya aapne maghaafeer khaya hai? Aapne uttar diyaah "Nahin" Unhonne kahaah phir yeh badbu kaisi hai? Aapne kahaah "Mujhe hafsa ne madhu ka pey pilaya hai." Unhonne kahaah madhumakkhi ne urfut per ka ras choosa hoga. Uske baad jab aap mere paas aye to mainne aapse isi tarah ki baat kahi. Phir safiya ke paas gae, to unhonne bhi kuchh aisa hi kaha. Uske pashchaat jab aap hafsa (radiyallahu anha) ke paas aye, to unhonne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, kya main aapko woh madhu na pilaaoon? Aapne kahaah "Mujhe uski aawashyakta nahin hai." Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki sauda (radiyallahu anha) kahne lageenh Allah ki qasam, hamne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko rok liya hai. Unka kahna hai ki mainne unse kahaah chup raho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58131: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apni us beemaari ke dinon mein, jismen aapki mrityu hui, poochhte theh "Main kal kahaan rahoonga? Main kal kahaan rahoonga?" Daraasal, aap aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ke yahaan thaharna chaahte the. Atah, aapki patniyon ne aapko jahaan chaahen, wahaan thaharne ki anumti de di.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) apni us beemaari ke dinon mein, jismen aapki mrityu hui, poochhte theh "Main kal kahaan rahoonga? Main kal kahaan rahoonga?" Daraasal, aap aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ke yahaan thaharna chaahte the. Atah, aapki patniyon ne aapko jahaan chaahen, wahaan thaharne ki anumti de di. Is tarah aap aaisha (radiyallahu anha) hi ke ghar mein rahe aur unheen ke yahaan praan tyaaga. Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hainh aapki mrityu meri baari ke din aur mere ghar mein hui. Allah ne aapko uthaya, to aapka sar meri gardan aur mere pet ke beech mein tha aur aapka luaab mere luaab se mishrit ho chuka tha. Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) phir kahti hainh abdurrahmaan bin abu-bakar ek misvaak lekar misvaak karte hue aye, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unki or dekha. Atah, mainne unse kahaah ai abdurrahmaan, mujhe yeh misvaak de do. Unhonne mujhe misvaak de di, to mainne use kaata, apne daanton se chabaakar naram kiya aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko barha diya. So, aapne usse misvaak kiya. Us samay aap mere seene par tek lagaye hue the.

58132: Jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kisi yaatra mein nikalne ka iraada karte, to apni patniyon ke beech quraa andaazi karte aur jiska naam nikalta use saath lekar yaatra mein nikalte.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain ki jab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kisi yaatra mein nikalne ka iraada karte, to apni patniyon ke beech quraa andaazi karte aur jiska naam nikalta use saath lekar yaatra mein nikalte. Ek yuddh mein quraa andaazi ki, to mera naam nikla aur main Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath gai. Yeh parda ka aadesh aane ke baad ki baat hai.

58133: Baag grahan kar lo aur use ek talaaq de do.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki saabit bin qais (radiyallahu anhu) ki patni Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aaeen aur kahne lageenh ai Allah ke Rasool, main saabit bin qais ke vyavhaar aur deen mein koi kami nahin paati, lekin mujhe Islam ke dayre mein rahte hue kufr (pati ki awajna) karna pasand nahin hai. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Kya tum use uska baag lauta dogi?" Unhonne kahaah haan! To Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne (saabit bin qais se) farmayaah "Baag grahan kar lo aur use ek talaaq de do."

58138: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ke zamaane mein tatha umar (radiyallahu anhu) ke khaleefa rahne ke (aaranbh ke) do saalon mein (ek majlis) ke teen talaaq ek hi shumaar hote the.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) aur abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ke zamaane mein tatha umar (radiyallahu anhu) ke khaleefa rahne ke (aaranbh ke) do saalon mein (ek majlis) ke teen talaaq ek hi shumaar hote the. 58140: (Rukaana aur unke bhaaiyon ke pita) abd-e-yazeed ne rukaana ki maata ko talaaq dekar muzaina qabeele ki ek stri se nikaah kar liya. Phir, woh stri Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aakar kahne lageeh woh mujhe utna hi santusht kar paate hain, jitna ki yeh baal.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai ki (rukaana aur unke bhaaiyon ke pita) abd-e-yazeed ne rukaana ki maata ko talaaq dekar muzaina qabeele ki ek stri se nikaah kar liya. Phir, woh stri Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aakar kahne lageeh woh mujhe utna hi santusht kar paate hain, jitna ki yeh baal. Unhonne apne sar ke ek baal ko pakarkar dikhaate hue aisa kaha. Atah, aap mujhe unse alag kar deejiye. Yeh sun Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko krodh a gaya. Aapne rukaana aur unke bhaaiyon ko bulaya aur apne paas baithe hue logon se kahaah "Kya tum nahin dekhte ki amuk ki yeh aur yeh cheezen abd-e-yazeed ki jaisi hain aur amuk ki yeh yeh cheezen abd-e-yazeed ki jaisi hain?" Logon ne kahaah awashy! Aapne abd-e-yazeed se farmayaah "Use talaaq de do." Unhonne use talaaq de diya, to phir farmayaah "Apni pahli patni arthaat rukaana aur uske bhaaiyon ki maan ko lauta lo." Unhonne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, mainne use teen talaaq de diya hai! To farmayaah "Mujhe pata hai. Jaao, use lauta lo." Phir aapne yeh ayat parheeh {يا أيها النبي إذا طلقتم النساء فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ} (arthaat ai Nabi, jab tum log apni striyon ko talaaq do, to unhen talaaq unki iddat ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue do.) (soora at-talaaqah 1)

58144: Allah ne meri ummat ki woh baaten maaf kar rakhi hain, jo uske dilon mein ayen, jab tak amal na kare athva zubaan se na bole.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Allah ne meri ummat ki woh baaten maaf kar rakhi hain, jo uske dilon mein ayen, jab tak amal na kare athva zubaan se na bole."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki ek musalmaan ke dil mein aane waale bure khyaalon ki bina par us samay tak uski pakar nahin hogi, jab tak unpar amal na kiya jaye ya unko zabaan par na laya jaye. Kyonki is prakaar ke khyaalaat  maaf hain. Yeh Allah ka anugrah hai ki Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke ummati ke zehan mein tairne waale aur uske dil mein paida hone waale khyaalon ko us samay tak pakar ke layaq qaraar nahin diya hai, jab tak dil ke andar baith na jayen aur dil unse santusht na ho jaye. Agar ahankaar, ghamand aur nifaaq aadi bure khyaalaat dil mein baith jayen, aur insaan apne shareer ke angon dvaara unpar amal kar le ya zabaan se unka izhaar kar de, to pakar ke yogy honge.

Allah ne un khyaalon ko maaf kar diya hai, jo dil mein paida hote hain. Yaani jinke baare mein insaan dil mein sochta hai aur jo insaan ke dil mein guzarte hain.
Agar insaan ke zehan mein talaaq ka khyaal aye, lekin woh zabaan se na bole aur qalam se na likhe, to uska apne dil mein talaaq ke baare mein sochna talaaq shumaar nahin hoga.
Dil mein aane waale khyaalaat chaahe jitne bare hon, unpar us samay tak pakar nahin hogi, jab tak dil ke andar baith na jayen aur unpar insaan amal na kare ya zabaan par na laye.
Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki ummat ki ek bahut bari wisheshta yeh hai ki dil mein aane waale khyaalon ke kaaran uski pakar nahin hogi, jabki pahle ki tamaam ummaton ke saath aisa hota tha.

58145: Jab koi vyakti apni patni ko apne oopar haraam kar le, to use kuchh nahin maana jayega. Woh yeh ayat bhi parhte theh {لقد كان لكم في رسول الله أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ} (arthaat tumhaare liye Allah ke Rasool mein uttam aadarsh hai.)

Woh yeh ayat bhi parhte theh {لقد كان لكم في رسول الله أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ} (arthaat tumhaare liye Allah ke Rasool mein uttam aadarsh hai.) [al-ahzaabah 21]
58147: Aadam ki santaan ko aisi wastu ki mannat maanne ka adhikaar nahin, jiska woh maalik na ho, aise daas ko mukt karne ka adhikaar nahin jiska woh svaami na ho aur aisi stri ko talaaq dene ka adhikaar nahin jo uske nikaah mein na ho.

Amr bin shoaib apne pita aur woh apne daada se riwayat karte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Aadam ki santaan ko aisi wastu ki mannat maanne ka adhikaar nahin, jiska woh maalik na ho, aise daas ko mukt karne ka adhikaar nahin jiska woh svaami na ho aur aisi stri ko talaaq dene ka adhikaar nahin jo uske nikaah mein na ho."

58148: Teen prakaar ke logon se qalam utha li gai hai; soe hue vyakti se, jab tak jaag na jaye; bachche se, jab tak wayask na ho jaye aur paagal se, jab tak uski chetna evn wiwek laut na aye.

Ali radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Teen prakaar ke logon se qalam utha li gai hai; soe hue vyakti se, jab tak jaag na jaye; bachche se, jab tak wayask na ho jaye aur paagal se, jab tak uski chetna evn wiwek laut na aye."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki teen vyaktiyon ko chhorkar saare log sharai aadeshon evn nishedhon ka paalan karne ke paaband hain. Yeh teen vyakti is prakaar hain :

Chhota bachcha, bara aur wayask hone tak.

Aisa paagal vyakti jo apni aql kho chuka ho, jab tak uski aql waapas na aye.

Soya hua insaan jab tak jaag na jaye.

Ye teenon log sharai aadeshon evn nishedhon ka paalan karne ke paaband nahin hain. Inse koi ghalat kaam ho jaye, to inke khaate mein gunaah nahin likha jaata. Albatta, chhote bachche ke khaate mein neki likhi jaati hai. Lekin paagal aur soe hue insaan ke khaate mein woh bhi nahin likhi jaati. Kyonki shaoor na hone ke kaaran donon is yogy hi nahin hote ki unki ibaadat sahi ho.

Insaan apni yogyata se ya to neend ke kaaran wanchit hota hai, ki is awastha mein uske paas apni zimmewaariyon ko ada karne ke liye chetna nahin hoti, ya ayu kam hone ke kaaran ki is haalat mein uske paas yogyata nahin rahti, ya paagalpan ke kaaran ki is awastha mein uski aql kaam karna band kar deti hai, ya phir iske samaan any cheezon jaise nasha aadi ke kaaran. Atah jis vyakti ke andar bhale-bure ke beech antar karne ya sahi kalpana  karne ki shakti maujood na ho, uske andar in teen kaarnon mein se kisi ek kaaran ki wajah se yogyata samaapt ho jaati hai. Aise vyakti se agar uchch evn mahaan Allah ke adhikaar kshetr se sanbandhit koi kami-beshi ho jaye, to Allah apne nyay evn kripa se kaam lete hue use kshama kar deta hai.
In teenon ke khaate mein gunaah likhe na jaane ka matlab yeh nahin hai ki unpar kuchh saansaarik prawaadhaan saabit nahin honge. Misaal ke taur par koi paagal vyakti agar kisi ka qatl kar de, to use qisaas ke taur par qatl nahin kiya jayega aur kaffaara nahin dena hoga, lekin uske pariwaar ko diyat deni hogi.
Wayask hone ki teen nishaaniyaan hain : Svapnadosh aadi dvaara weery skhalan, ya jaghan baal ug jaana, ya pandrah warsh poore ho jaana. Stri ke andar ek chauthi nishaani bhi paai jaati hai. Woh hai, maahvaari aana.
Subki kahte hain : Hadees mein aye hue shabd 'sabi' ka arth hai bachcha. Any logon ne kaha hai : Bachcha jab maan ke pet mein hota hai, to use arbi mein 'janeen' kaha jaata hai. Jab paida ho jaye, to 'sabi' kahlaata hai. Doodh peene ka samay guzarne ke baad se saat saal tak 'ghulaam' kahlaata hai. Uske baad das saal tak 'yaaphi' kahlaata hai. Phir pandrah saal tak 'hazoor'  kahlaata hai. Lekin ek baat nishchit hai ki use in tamaam paristhitiyon mein 'sabi' kaha jayega. Yeh baat suyooti ne kahi hai.
[ise abu daawood ne, tirmizi ne tatha nasai ne al-kubra mein isi prakaar ibn-e-maajah ne aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
58149: Tumne ghair-sunnat tareeqe se talaaq di aur ghair-sunnat tareeqe se lautaya. Use talaaq dete samay gawaah banaao aur lautaate samay gawaah banaao tatha aisa kaam dobaara na karo.

Imraan bin husain ka warnan hai ki unse ek vyakti ke baare mein poochha gaya, jo apni patni ko talaaq de de aur phir usse sanbhog kar le aur use talaaq dete samay aur lautaate samay gawaah na banaye, to unhonne kahaah tumne ghair-sunnat tareeqe se talaaq di aur ghair-sunnat tareeqe se lautaya. Use talaaq dete samay gawaah banaao aur lautaate samay gawaah banaao tatha aisa kaam dobaara na karo.

58151: (Eela -kisi kaaran apni patni ke paas na jaane ki qasam kha lena- ke pashchaat) jab chaar maheene beet jayen, to pati ko roka jayega, yahaan tak ki talaaq de de aur talaaq us samay tak nahin paregi, jab tak pati talaaq na de.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hainh (eela -kisi kaaran apni patni ke paas na jaane ki qasam kha lena- ke pashchaat) jab chaar maheene beet jayen, to pati ko roka jayega, yahaan tak ki talaaq de de aur talaaq us samay tak nahin paregi, jab tak pati talaaq na de.
58154: Ek vyakti Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya. Usne apni patni se 'zihaar' karne ke baad usse sanbhog kar liya tha.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) se warnit hai, woh kahte hainh ek vyakti Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya. Usne apni patni se 'zihaar' karne ke baad usse sanbhog kar liya tha. Usne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, mainne apni patni se zihaar kiya aur kaffaara ada karne se pahle usse sanbhog kar liya hai. Aapne poochhaah "Tujhpar Allah daya kare, tumne aisa kyon kiya?" Usne kahaah mainne chaand ki roshni mein uske paazeb ko dekha (aur khud par qaabu na rakh saka). Aapne kahaah "Ab uske nikat us kaam ko karne se pahle na jaana, jiska aadesh Allah ne tujhe diya hai."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58155: 'Zihaar' ke baare mein salma bin sakhr ki hadees

Salma bin sakhr (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hainh main ek aisa vyakti tha, jo any logon ki tulna mein patni se adhik sanbhog kiya karta tha. Yahi kaaran hai ki jab Ramzan ka maheena aya, to mujhe dar mahsoos hua ki kaheen apni patni se sanbhog karte hue subah na kar doon. Atah, Ramzan maas samaapt hone tak ke liye usse 'zehaar' kar liya. Parantu, woh ek din raat ke samay meri sewa kar rahi thi ki achaanak uske shareer ka koi ang khul gaya aur main usse sanbandh banaye bina na rah saka. Jab subah hui, to apni qaum ke paas aya aur unhen saari ghatna sunaai tatha unhen mere saath Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas chalne ko kaha. Lekin unhonne kahaah Allah ki qasam, ham nahin chalne waale. Atah, main akele hi Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas pahunch gaya aur sab kuchh kah sunaya. Aapne kahaah "Tumne yeh kaam kiya hai, ai abu salma?" Mainne kahaah haan, ai Allah ke Rasool, mujhse hi yeh ghalti hui hai! (Yeh sawaal wa jawaab do baar hua.) main Allah ke aadesh ka paalan karne ko taiyaar hoon. Atah, aap mere baare mein woh nirnay karen, jo Allah aapko sujhaye. Aapne kahaah "Ek gardan aazaad kar do." Mainne apni gardan par haath rakhte hue kahaah uski qasam, jisne aapko saty ke saath bheja hai, main iske siwa kisi gardan ka maalik nahin hoon. Aapne kahaah "To lagaataar do maheene roze rakh lo." Mainne kahaah main jis museebat mein phansa hoon, woh roze hi ke kaaran to hai? Aapne kahaah "To phir saath miskeenon ko saath saaa़ khajoor khila do." Mainne kahaah uski qasam, jisne aapko saty ke saath bheja hai, ham donon ne bhookhe pet raat guzaari hai. Hamaare paas khaane ko kuchh nahin tha. Aapne kahaah "Banu zuraiq ke sadqe waale ke paas jaao, woh tumhen is parimaan mein khajoor de denge. Atah, saath saaa़ khajoor saath miskeenon ko khila dena aur jo bach jaye use khud kha lena aur apne baal-bachchon ko khila dena." Iske baad main apni qaum ke paas aya aur bolaah mujhe tumhaare yahaan tangi aur bura wichaar mila, jabki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas gunjaaish aur achchha wichaar mila. Aapne mujhe tumhaara sadqa diye jaane ka aadesh diya hai|
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58156: Uski patni par nazar rakho, agar woh gora-chitta, seedhe baalon aur laal aankhon waala bachcha janti hai, to woh hilaal bin umayya ka hai aur agar surmai aankhon, ghunghraale baalon aur patli pindliyon waala bachcha janti hai, to woh shareek bin sahma ka hai.

Hilaal bin umayya ne apni patni par shareek bin sahma ke saath vyabhichaar ka aarop lagaya. Hilaal bin umayya bara bin maalik ke maan shareek bhaai the aur 'leaan' karne waale pahle musalmaan the. Warnankarta kahte hainh unhonne apni patni se 'leaan' kar liya, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Uski patni par nazar rakho, agar woh gora-chitta, seedhe baalon aur laal aankhon waala bachcha janti hai, to woh hilaal bin umayya ka hai aur agar surmai aankhon, ghunghraale baalon aur patli pindliyon waala bachcha janti hai, to woh shareek bin sahma ka hai." Warnankarta kahte hainh baad mein mujhe bataya gaya ki usne surmai aankhon, ghunghraale baalon aur patli pindliyon waala bachcha jana tha.
58157: Uwaimir ajlaani, aasim bin adi ansaari ke paas aye aur unse kahaah ai aasim, aap us vyakti ke baare mein kya kahte hain, jo apni patni ke saath kisi ko paye? Kya woh uska wadh kar de to aap log bhi uska wadh kar denge ya woh aur kya kare? Ai aasim, is sanbandh mein aap mere liye Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se poochhen.

Ibne shihaab se riwayat hai ki sahl bin saad saaidi (radiyallahu anhu) ne unhen batayaah uwaimir ajlaani aasim bin adi ansaari ke paas aye aur unse kahaah ai aasim, aap us vyakti ke baare mein kya kahte hain, jo apni patni ke saath kisi ko paye? Kya woh uska wadh kar de to aap log bhi uska wadh kar denge ya woh aur kya kare? Ai aasim, is sanbandh mein aap mere liye Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se poochhen. Atah, aasim (radiyallahu anhu) ne is sanbandh mein Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se poochha, to aapne is tarah ke prashnon ko naapsand kiya aur iski itni buraai ki ki aasim (radiyallahu anhu) par aapki baat bhaari pari. Jab aasim ghar laute, to uwaimir unke paas aye aur kaha ki ai aasim, Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne aapse kya kaha? Aasim ne uwaimir se kahaah tum mere paas koi achchhi baat lekar nahin aye. Mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se jo prashn kiya, aapne use naapsand kiya. Uwaimir ne kahaah Allah ki qasam, main aapse is sanbandh mein poochhe bina dam nahin loonga. Uwaimir (radiyallahu anhu) chal pare aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas a gae. Us samay aap logon ke beech the. Unhonne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, aap us vyakti ke baare mein kya kahte hain, jo apni patni ke saath kisi ko paye? Kya woh uska wadh kar de to aap log bhi uska wadh kar denge ya woh aur kya kare? Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Tumhaare tatha tumhaari patni ke baare mein ayat utaari gai hai. Atah, jaao aur use le aao." Sahl (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hainh phir donon ne 'leaan' kiya. Us samay main bhi logon ke saath Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke nikat maujood tha. Jab donon 'leaan' kar chuke, to uwaimir ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, agar mainne use rakh liya, to goya mainne jhooth kaha hai. So, unhonne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke aadesh se pahle hi teen talaaq de diye. Ibne shihaab kahte hainh yahi tareeqa baad mein 'leaan' karne waalon ke liye prachlit ho gaya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58158: Ek vyakti ne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aakar kahaah meri patni yadi koi use chhoona chaahe, to aapatti nahin karti (arthaat: Woh purushon ke saath baat-cheet karne se nahin bachti hai, na unse teek se parda karti hai, chunaanche woh usse musaaphha karlete hain ya use chhoolete hain, to iski parvaah nahi karti hai). Aapne kahaah "Use talaaq dekar alag kar do." Usne kahaah mujhe bhay hai ki kaheen mera dil usmen atka na rahe. Farmayaah "Tab usse laabh uthaate raho."

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki ek vyakti ne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aakar kahaah meri patni yadi koi use chhoona chaahe, to aapatti nahin karti (arthaat: Woh purushon ke saath baat-cheet karne se nahin bachti hai, na unse theek se parda karti hai, chunaanche woh usse musaaphha karlete hain ya use chhoolete hain, to iski parvaah nahi karti hai). Aapne kahaah "Use talaaq dekar alag kar do." Usne kahaah mujhe bhay hai ki kaheen mera dil usmen atka na rahe. Farmayaah "Tab usse laabh uthaate raho."
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58161: Bareera (radiyallahu anha) ko aadesh diya gaya tha ki teen maahvaari tak iddat guzaaren.
Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se warnit hai ki unhonne kahaah bareera (radiyallahu anha) ko aadesh diya gaya tha ki teen maahvaari tak iddat guzaaren.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai .]
58163: Tum apne baag ke khajoor awashy toro. Ho sakta hai ki tum sadqa karo ya koi aur bhalaai ka kaary karo.

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhuma) kahte hain ki meri khaala ko talaaq de di gai. (Iddat ke dauraan) unhonne apne khajoor ke baag ke phal torne ka iraada kiya, to ek vyakti ne unhen ghar se nikalne par daant diya. Aise mein woh Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas pahuncheen, to aapne farmayaah "Tum apne baag ke khajoor awashy toro. Ho sakta hai ki tum sadqa karo ya koi aur bhalaai ka kaary karo."
58164: "Tum iddat poori hone tak apne usi ghar mein raho." Unka kahna hai ki phir mainne waheen iddat ke chaar maheene das din guzaare.

Furaia bint maalik bin sinaan (radiyallahu anha), jo abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) ki bahan hain, ka warnan hai ki woh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas yeh poochhne ke liye gaeen ki kya woh (iddat ke dauraan) apne ghar waalon ki or laut sakti hain, jinka sanbandh bani khadura qabeele se hai? Daraasal unke pati apne kuchh bhaage hue daason ki talaash mein nikle the. Jab woh qadoom kshetr ki seema mein pahunchkar unse ja mile, to un logon ne unhen maar daala. Aise mein, furaia (radiyallahu anha) ne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se poochha ki main apne ghar waalon ke yahaan jaana chaahti hoon. Kyonki mere pati ne mujhe jis ghar mein chhora hai, woh unka apna nahin hai tatha unki or se mere guzaare ka bhi koi prabandh nahin hai. Furaia (radiyallahu anha) ka kahna hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unhen (apne ghar waalon ke yahaan jaane ki anumti pradaan karte hue) farmayaah "Theek hai!" Woh kahti hain ki itna sun main nikal pari. Jab (Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki kisi patni ke) kamre ya masjid tak pahunchi, to aapne mujhe bulaya ya bulaane ka aadesh diya aur main bulaai gai. Ab aapne farmayaah "Tumne kya kaha tha?" Mainne apne pati ki jo ghatna sunaai thi, use dobaara bayaan kar diya, to farmayaah "Tum iddat poori hone tak apne usi ghar mein raho." Unka kahna hai ki phir mainne waheen iddat ke chaar maheene das din guzaare. Jab usmaan bin affaan ka shaasankaal aya, to unhonne mujhe bulaakar is sanbandh mein poochha. Mainne unhen poori baat bataai, to unhonne uska anusran kiya aur usi ke anusaar nirnay diya.

[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58165: Faatima bint qais (radiyallahu anha) ka yeh kahna ki ai Allah ke Rasool, mere pati ne mujhe teen talaaq de diye hain aur mujhe bhay hai ki koi mere yahaan zabardasti ghus na aye. To aapke aadesh se unhonne jagah badal liya.

Faatima bint qais (radiyallahu anha) se warnit hai, woh kahti hain ki mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, mere pati ne mujhe teen talaaq de diye hain aur mujhe bhay hai ki koi mere yahaan zabardasti ghus na aye. To aapke aadesh se unhonne jagah badal liya.
58166: Tum log hamen Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki sunnat ke baare mein sandeh mein na daalo. Umme walad (woh daasi jo apne maalik ki santaan ki maan ban jaye) ki iddat chaar maheene das din hai.

Amr bin aas (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hainh tum log hamen Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki sunnat ke baare mein sandeh mein na daalo. Umme walad (woh daasi jo apne maalik ki santaan ki maan ban jaye) ki iddat chaar maheene das din hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise maalik ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58167: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki patni aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne hafsa bint abdurrahmaan bin abu bakr siddeeq (radiyallahu anha) ko, jab unki teesri maahvaari shuru hui, ghar badalva diya.

Urva bin zubair ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki patni aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne hafsa bint abdurrahmaan bin abu bakr siddeeq (radiyallahu anha) ko, jab unki teesri maahvaari shuru hui, ghar badalva diya. Ibne shehaab kahte hain ki urva ki is hadees ka zikr amra bint abdur rahmaan se kiya gaya, to unhonne kahaah urva ne sahi kaha hai. (Unhonne yeh bhi bataya ki) is masle par kuchh logon ne aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se bahas bhi ki thi aur kaha tha ki Allah taaala apni kitaab mein kahta haih {ثَلاَثَةَ قُرُوءٍ} (arthaat talaaqshuda striyaan teen 'quru' tak apne aapko wiwaah se roki rakhen.) [al-baqraah 228] ispar aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ne kaha tha ki tum sach kahte ho, lekin kya tum jaante ho ki yeh 'quru' kya hain? Daraasal inse aashay teen paaki hi hain.
58172: Koi vyakti kisi shaadeeshuda stri ke paas hargiz raat na bitaye. Haan, yeh aur baat hai ki woh uski patni ho ya uski koi aisi rishtedaar ho, jisse hamesha ke liye nikaah jayaz nahin hai.

Jaabir bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Koi vyakti kisi shaadeeshuda stri ke paas hargiz raat na bitaye. Haan, yeh aur baat hai ki woh uski patni ho ya uski koi aisi rishtedaar ho, jisse hamesha ke liेe nikaah jayaz nahin hai."

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- is baat se mana kar rahe hain ki koi purush kisi ajanbi stri ke paas raat na bitaye aur raat ko na thahre. Aapne wishesh roop se shaadeeshuda stri ka zikr isliye kiya ki uske paas aam taur par purushon ka aana-jaana rahta hai. Jahaan tak kunwaari larkiyon ki baat hai, to we aam taur par surakshit rahti hain aur purushon se bahut door bhaagti hain. Saath hi yeh baat aasaani se samjhi ja sakti hai ki jab shaadeeshuda stri ke yahaan jaana mana hai, jismen log thori narmi se kaam lete hain, to kunwaari ke paas jaana to mana hoga hi.
Lekin isse kuchh logon ko alag rakha gaya hai. Jaise patni, aisi striyaan jinse khooni rishte ke kaaran nikaah haraam hota hai, maslan maata, beti aur bahan aadi, aisi striyaan jinse doodh ke rishte ke kaaran nikaah haraam hota hai, maslan doodh maan tatha aisi striyaan jinse sasuraali rishte ke kaaran nikaah haraam hota hai, jaise saas aadi.
Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke shabd : "Raat na bitaye" Ka yeh arth nahin hai ki kisi ajanbi stri ke saath din mein ekaant mein rah sakta hai, kyonki saheeh Bukhari mein manaahi vyaapak roop se aai hai aur usmen raat bitaane ki baat nahin hai.
Yahaan yeh yaad rahe ki yadi koi mahram (aisa purush jisse nikaah haraam ho) wishvaas ka paatr na ho, to usse ekaant mein milte samay bhi stri ke saath any striyon ka hona zaroori hai.
58173: Kisi garbhavti se sanbhog na kiya jaye jab tak prasav na ho jaye aur na kisi bina garbh waali se sanbhog kiya jaye jab tak use ek maahvaari na a jaye.

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne autaas yuddh mein praapt hone waali daasiyon ke sanbandh mein farmayaah "Kisi garbhavti se sanbhog na kiya jaye jab tak prasav na ho jaye aur na kisi bina garbh waali se sanbhog kiya jaye jab tak use ek maahvaari na a jaye."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58174: Ek do baar doodh peene se hurmat siddh nahin hoti.
Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Ek do baar doodh peene se hurmat siddh nahin hoti."
58175: Use doodh pila do, tum uspar haraam ho jaaogi aur abu huzaifa ke dil mein jo baat hai, woh khatm ho jayegi.

Aaisha (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki abu huzaifa ke 'maula' (arthaat unke mukt kiye hue daas) saalim abu huzaifa tatha unke pariwaar ke saath unheen ke ghar mein rahte the. Atah, abu huzaifa ki patni (jo suhail ki beti theen) Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aaeen aur kahne lageenh saalim ab vyask ho chuka hai aur woh baaten samajhne laga hai, jo vyask log samajhte hain tatha uska hamaare paas aana-jaana hota hai aur mujhe lagta hai abu huzaifa is baat ko naapsand karte hain. To Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne unse farmayaah "Use doodh pila do, tum uspar haraam ho jaaogi aur abu huzaifa ke dil mein jo baat hai, woh khatm ho jayegi." Woh (baad mein) Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas lautkar aaeen aur kahne lageenh mainne use doodh pila diya hai aur abu huzaifa ke dil mein jo naapsandeedgi thi, woh door ho gai hai.
58176: Qur'an ki jo ayten utaari gai theen, unmen se ek ayat theeh "Das baar doodh peene se, jo maaloom hon, hurmat saabit hoti hai." Phir yeh ayat mansookh (nirast) ho gai aur paanch baar doodh peene ki baat kahi gai, jo maaloom hon. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki jab mrityu hui, to ye shabd Qur'an mein maujood the aur parhe ja rahe the.

Aaish (radiyallahu anha) kahti hainh Qur'an ki jo ayten utaari gai theen, unmen se ek ayat theeh "Das baar doodh peene se, jo maaloom hon, hurmat saabit hoti hai." Phir yeh ayat mansookh (nirast) ho gai aur paanch baar doodh peene ki baat kahi gai, jo maaloom hon. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki jab mrityu hui, to ye shabd Qur'an mein maujood the aur parhe ja rahe the.
58177: Doodh peene se hurmat usi samay siddh hoti hai, jab doodh antriyon tak pahunche aur unhen sairaab karne ka kaary kare aur doodh pilaane ka kaary doodh chhuraane se pahle hua ho.

Umme salma kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Doodh peene se hurmat usi samay siddh hoti hai, jab doodh antriyon tak pahunche aur unhen sairaab karne ka kaary kare aur doodh pilaane ka kaary doodh chhuraane se pahle hua ho."
58181: Dene waale ka haath oopar hota hai. Aaranbh usse karo jiske oopar kharch karna tumhaare oopar waajib hai : Tumhaari maata, tumhaare pita, tumhaari bahan, tumhaare bhaai, phir sabse nikat ka sanbandhi aur uske baad sabse nikat ka sanbandhi.

Taariq al-muhaaribi se warnit hai, woh kahte hain : Ham log madeena pahunche to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- minbar par khare hokar khutba (bhaashan) de rahe the aur farma rahe the : “Dene waale ka haath oopar hota hai. Aaranbh usse karo jiske oopar kharch karna tumhaare oopar waajib hai : Tumhaari maata, tumhaare pita, tumhaari bahan, tumhaare bhaai, phir sabse nikat ka sanbandhi aur uske baad sabse nikat ka sanbandhi.”
58183: Kisi vyakti ke paapi (gunahgaar) hone ke liye bas itna kaaphi hai ki woh kisi aise vyakti ka raashan rok le, jiska raashan uske haath mein hai.

Khaisma se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki ham log abdullah bin amr -radiyallahu anhuma- ke saath baithe hue the ki isi beech unke ghar ki vyawastha se jura hua ek vyakti unke paas aya, to unhonne usse kaha : Kya tumne ghulaamon ko unka raashan de diya? Usne kaha : Nahin, to aapne farmaya : Jaao aur unko raashan de do. Phir bataya ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : “Kisi vyakti ke paapi (gunahgaar) hone ke liye bas itna kaaphi hai ki woh kisi aise vyakti ka raashan rok le, jiska raashan uske haath mein hai.”
58185: Sarvottam sadka woh hai jo apni aawashyakta ke baraabar dhan bachaakar rakhne ke baad kiya jaye, oopar waala haath neeche waale haath se uttam hai aur tummen se har vyakti ko chahiye ki usse aaranbh kare jiske oopar kharch karna uske oopar waajib hai.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Sarvottam sadka woh hai jo apni aawashyakta ke baraabar dhan bachaakar rakhne ke baad kiya jaye, oopar waala haath neeche waale haath se uttam hai aur tummen se har vyakti ko chahiye ki usse aaranbh kare jiske oopar kharch karna uske oopar waajib hai.” (kaheen aisa na ho ki) uski patni kahe : Mere oopar kharch karo, uski daasi jo uske bachche ki maan ban chuki ho, kahe : Tum mujhe kiske bharose chhor rahe ho? Aur uska ghulaam kahe ki mujhe khilaao tatha mujhse kaam lo.
[ise ibne hibbaan ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58188: Mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mere achchhe bartaav ka sabse zyaada haqdaar kaun hai? Aapne uttar diya : "Teri maan, phir teri maan, phir teri maan, phir tera baap, phir jo rishtte mein sabse nikat ho phir jo rishte mein sabse nikat hi.

Bahz bin hakeem apne pita se aur woh unke daada se warnan karte hain, kahte hain : Mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mere achchhe bartaav ka sabse zyaada haqdaar kaun hai? Aapne uttar diya : "Teri maan, phir teri maan, phir teri maan, phir tera baap, phir jo rishtte mein sabse nikat ho phir jo rishte mein sabse nikat hi."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki ek insaan ke achchhe vyavhaar, upkaar, behtar bartaav, utkrisht aachran aur saath rahne tatha jore rakhne  ka sabse zyaada haqdaar uski maan hai. Maan ke adhikaar ko any logon ke adhikaaron se prabal dikhaane ke liye aapne apni is baat ko teen baar dohraya, taaki is baat ko spasht kar diya jaye ki maan ka adhikaar any tamaam logon ke adhikaaron se oopar hai. Phir aapne achchhe bartaav ke maamle mein uske baad aane waale logon ka zikr karte hue bataya ki phir uske baad nambar pita ka hai. Phir nikatta ke anusaar any rishtedaaron ka. Har nikat ka rishtedaar door ke rishtedaar se achchhe vyavhaar ka adhik haqdaar hai.

Is hadees mein pahle maan ko rakha gaya hai, phir baap ko aur phir any rishtedaaron mein nikatta ke anusaar jo  sabse nikat ho phir jo sabse nikat ho.
Maata-pita aur khaas taur se maan ke adhikaaron ka bayaan.
Is hadees mein maan ke saath achchha vyavhaar karne ki baat teen baar isliye kahi gai hai ki bachchon par uske bare upkaar hua karte hain. Woh bachche ko janm dene aur doodh pilaane ke dinon mein bari kathinaaiyon aur kasht ka saamna karti hai. Ye wo kathinaaiyaan hain, jo woh akeli uthaati hai. Iske baad tarbiyat mein pita ki bhaageedaari saamne aati hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
58189: Tumhen ise apne paas rakhne ka haq adhik hai, jab tak doosri shaadi na kar lo.

Abdullah bin amr -radiyallahu anhuma- se warnit hai ki ek mahila ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mera yeh beta hai. Mera pet iske liye bartan tha, meri chhaati iske liye mashkeeza thi aur meri god iske liye jhoola thi. Lekin iske pita ne mujhe talaaq de diya hai aur ab woh ise mujhse chheenna chaahta hai! To Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne usse farmaya : “Tumhen ise apne paas rakhne ka haq adhik hai, jab tak doosri shaadi na kar lo.”
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58190: Yeh tumhaara pita hai tatha yeh tumhaari maata. Inmen se jiska chaaho haath pakar lo.

Abu maimoona salma, jo madeena ke kisi vyakti ke aazaad kiye hue ghulaam the tatha ek sachche aadmi the, se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki main abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas baitha tha ki unke paas ek phaarsi mahila aai, jiske saath uska beta tha. Uske pati ne use talaak de diya tha aur pati-patni donon uspar daawa kar rahe the. Us mahila ne kaha : Ai abu huraira! Phir aage phaarsi mein baat karte hue boli ki mera pati mere is bete ko le jaana chaahta hai! To abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ne usse faarsi hi mein kaha : Tum donon is larke ko apne paas rakhne ke sanbandh mein quraa andaazi kar lo. Yaani laki dra ke maadhyam se nirnay kar lo. Isi beech uska pati bhi a gaya tatha bola : Kaun mujhse mere bete ke sanbandh mein jhagra karega? To abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ne kaha : Main yeh baat isliye kah raha hoon, kyonki main Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas baitha hua tha ki ek aurat aapke paas aai aur boli : Mera pati mere is bete ko mujhse chheen lena chaahta hai, jabki yeh mujhe abu inba ke kuen se paani laakar pilaane laga hai aur mere kaam aane laga hai. Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Tum donon is larke ko apne paas rakhne ke sanbandh mein quraa andaazi kar lo.” ispar uska pati bola : Kaun mujhse mere bete ke sanbandh mein jhagra karega? Tab Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne us bachche se farmaya : “Yeh tumhaara pita hai tatha yeh tumhaari maata. Inmen se jiska chaaho haath pakar lo.” chunaanche, us bachche ne maan ka haath pakar liya, to woh use lekar chali gai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58191: Maata-pita ke beech Islam ke kaaran algaav ke samay bachche ko maan aur baap mein se kisi ek ko chunne ka wikalp dene ke sanbandh mein raaphe bin sinaan -radiyallahu anhu- ki hadees

Raaphe bin sinaan -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki unhonne Islam dharm apna liya, magar unki patni ne Islam apnaane se inkaar kar diya. Aise mein unki patni Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aai aur boli : Yeh meri beti hai, jisne abhi-abhi doodh chhora hai ya doodh chhorne ke kareeb hai. Jabki raafe ne bhi kaha ki yeh meri beti hai. Yeh sun Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unse kaha : “Ek kinaare mein baith jaao.” tatha unki patni se bhi kaha : “Tum bhi ek kinaare mein baith jaao.” woh kahte hain ki phir aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne bachchi ko donon ke beech mein bitha diya aur farmaya : “Tum donon use bulaao.” jab donon ne bulaya, to bachchi apni maan ki or mur gai. Yeh dekh Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne dua ki : “Ai Allah ! Ise sahi maarg dikha.” atah, bachchi apne baap ki or mur gai aur unhonne use le liya.
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58192: Jab tummen se kisi ka sewak uske saamne bhojan parose, to agar use apne saath na bitha sake, to use ek-do luqma ya ek-do niwaala zaroor de, kyonki usne use taiyaar karne ka kaam kiya hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh Nabi -sallallahu alaihi sallam- se warnan karte hain ki aapne farmaya : “Jab tummen se kisi ka sewak uske saamne bhojan parose, to agar use apne saath na bitha sake, to use ek-do luqma ya ek-do niwaala zaroor de, kyonki usne use taiyaar karne ka kaam kiya hai.”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]

58194: Koi musalmaan, jo is baat ki gawaahi deta ho ki Allah ke siwa koi sachcha maabood (upaasy) nahin aur Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- Allah ke Rasool hain, uska khoon kewal usi samay halaal hoga jab woh in teen logon mein se koi ek ho

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- se riwayat hai, woh kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Koi musalmaan, jo is baat ki gawaahi deta ho ki Allah ke siwa koi sachcha maabood (upaasy) nahin aur Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- Allah ke Rasool hain, uska khoon kewal usi samay halaal hoga jab woh in teen logon mein se koi ek ho : Aisa vyakti jo wiwaah ke pashchaat vyabhichaar kare, to use sangsaar kiya jayega; aisa vyakti jo Allah tatha uske Rasool se larne ke liye nikle (arthaat logon ko raaston par loote) to use katl kiya jayeg athva sooli par charhaya jayega ya phir tareepaar (mulk badar) kar diya jayega aur aisa vyakti jo kisi ko katl kar de, to use bhi katl kiya jayega.”

Yeh hadees is baat ka pramaan hai ki aise musalmaanon ka raktapaat haraam hai, jo gawaahi dete hon ki Allah ke atirikt koi saty poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- Allah ke Rasool hain, tatha unhonne koi aisa kaam bhi na kiya ho, jo in do gawaahiyon ke wiruddh ho aur insaan ko Islam ke dayre se nikaal baahar karta ho. Iska kaaran yeh hai ki widhi-nirmaata paak evn mahaan Allah ka ek lakshy jaan ki suraksha tatha use shaanti pradaan karna bhi hai. Usne apni shareeyat mein uski suraksha ka poora prabandh bhi kiya hai. Usne Allah ka saajhi banaane ke baad sabse bara gunaah kisi aise vyakti ke qatl ko hi qaraar diya hai, jise qatl karna usne haraam ghoshit kar rakha hai.
Yahaan usne aise musalmaan ke qatl ko haraam qaraar diya hai, jo Allah ke saty poojy hone aur Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke Rasool hone ki gawaahi deta ho, jab tak woh nimnaankit teen kaamon mein se kisi ek kaam mein sanlipt na ho jaye :
Pahla : Woh iske baad bhi vyabhichaar mein sanlipt ho jaye ki Allah ne use shaadeeshuda banaya aur maany nikaah ke dvaara uski sharmagaah ki suraksha ka prabandh kiya.
Doosra : Woh kisi nirdosh musalmaan ka naahaq qatl kar de. Is prakaar ke vyakti ke baare mein nyay evn samaanta ki baat yeh hai ki uske saath bhi wahi kiya jaye, jo usne doosre ke saath kiya hai, taaki saty ka bolbaala rahe aur atyaachaariyon ko atyaachaar se roka ja sake.
Teesra : Aisa vyakti jo musalmaanon ke wiruddh Allah aur uske Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se yuddh ke liye khara ho jaye tatha logon ka raasta rok kar loot-paat kare, bhaybheet kare aur fasaad machaye. Aise vyakti ko qatl kiya jayega, sooli di jayegi ya phir taareepaar kar diya jayega, taaki log uski buraai evn atyaachaar se surakshit rah saken.
In teen logon ko qatl kiya jayega ki inke qatl hi mein dharm, jaan evn maan-sammaan ki suraksha nihit hai.

58218: “Jo muslim shaasak ke aajnaapaalan se inkaar kare aur (musalmaanon ki) jamaat se nikal jaye, phir uski mrityu ho jaye to aisi mrityu jaahiliyat waali mrityu hai

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : “Jo muslim shaasak ke aajnaapaalan se inkaar kare aur (musalmaanon ki) jamaat se nikal jaye, phir uski mrityu ho jaye to aisi mrityu jaahiliyat waali mrityu hai. Jo aise jhande ke neeche laraai lare jiska uddeshy spasht na ho, apne gotr ke abhimaan ki raksha ke liye krodhit hota ho, apne gotr ke abhimaan ki raksha ke liye yuddh karne ka aahvaan karta ho, ya apne gotr ke abhimaan ki raksha ko samarthan deta ho, phir isi awastha mein maara jaye, to yeh jaahiliyat waali mrityu hai. Jo meri ummat ke wiruddh laraai ke liye nikle tatha ummat ke nek wa bure log sabhi ko maare, na momin ko chhore aur na ahd (sandhi) waale ke ahd (sandhi) ka khayaal kare, aisa vyakti mujhse nahin aur na main usse hoon.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jo vyakti shaaskon ke anusran ke dayre se baahar nikal gaya aur shaasak ke haath par ekmat hokar baiat karne waali musalmaanon ki jamaat ko chhorkar alag ho gaya tatha isi algaav ki awastha mein mar gaya, woh jaahiliyat ki maut mara, jo na kisi ameer ka anusran karte the aur na kisi ek jamaat se jure rahte the. Alag-alag toliyon mein batkar ek-doosre se yuddh kiya karte the.

Aapne aage bataya hai ki jisne kisi aise jhande ke neeche yuddh kiya, jiske baare mein yeh spasht na ho ki use saty ke liye uthaya gaya hai ya asaty ke liye, woh deen ya saty ki bajay apne samuday ya apne qabeele ke prati pakshapaatpoorn rawayya ke kaaran krodh mein aata ho aur isi pakshapaat ko charitaarth karne ke liye yuddh karta ho, aisa vyakti jab isi haalat mein maara jaye, to uska maara jaana jaahiliyat ke maare jaane ki tarah hoga.

Isi tarah jo vyakti Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki ummat se baghaawat (widroh) kar baithe, uske achchhe aur bure har aadmi ki gardan uraane lage, woh apne in ghalat kaamon ki koi parvaah na karta ho aur unke anjaam se darta na ho, ghair-muslimon tatha shaaskon ko diye gae wachnon ka paalan karne ki bajay khule aam unka ullanghan karta ho, to yeh kabeera (bara) gunaah hai aur aisa karne waala is bari sakht chetaavni ka haqdaar hai.

Shaasak jab tak kisi aise kaary ka aadesh na den, jisse Allah ki naafarmaani na hoti ho, to unke aadesh ka paalan karna waajib hai.
Is hadees mein imaam (shaasak) ke anusran se baahar nikalne aur musalmaanon ki jamaat se alag ho jaane se bahut zyaada saavdhaan kiya gaya hai. Agar koi vyakti is tarah ki haalat mein mar jaata hai, to jaahileeyat kaal ke logon ki maut marta hai.
Is hadees mein pakshapaat par aadhaarit yuddh se mana kiya gaya hai.
Wachan poora karna waajib hai.
Imaam (shaasak) aur jamaat se jure rahne ke bahut-se fayde hain. Isse shaanti evn sadbhaav ka maahaul rahta hai aur sab kuchh theek rahta hai.
Jaahileeyat kaal ke logon ke haalaat ki mushaabhat (samrupta) apnaane ki manaahi.
Musalmaanon ki jamaat se aniwaary roop se jure rahne ka aadesh.
58223: “Jo tumhaare paas is haal mein aye ki tum log kisi ko khaleefa maankar uska anusran kar rahe ho tatha woh tumhaari ekta ko bhang karna chaahe ya tumhaari jamaat mein bikhraav paida karna chaahe, to aise vyakti ko katl kar do.”

Arafja radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko yeh pharmaate hue suna hai : “Jo tumhaare paas is haal mein aye ki tum log kisi ko khaleefa maankar uska anusran kar rahe ho tatha woh tumhaari ekta ko bhang karna chaahe ya tumhaari jamaat mein bikhraav paida karna chaahe, to aise vyakti ko katl kar do.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jab musalmaan ekmat hokar kisi ko shaasak maan chuke hon aur ek jamaat ke roop mein rah rahe hon aur phir koi aakar shaasan ke maamle mein usse ulajhne lage aur musalmaanon ki jamaat mein phoot daalna chaahe, to uski buraai se bachne aur musalmaanon ko raktapaat se surakshit rakhne ke liye use rokna aur usse yuddh karna waajbi hoga.

Musalmaan shaasak jab tak kisi gunaah ke kaam ka aadesh na de, to uski baat sunna tatha uske aadesh ka paalan karna waajib aur uske khilaaf baghaawat karna haraam hoga.
Jo musalmaanon ke shaasak aur unki jamaat ke khilaaf widroh kare, usse yuddh karna waajib hoga, chaahe woh pad maan-sammaan aur hasab-nasab ke maamle mein kitna hi ooncha kyon na ho.
Ekjut rahne tatha wibhed ka shikaar na hone ki prerna.
58224: Jo apne dhan ki raksha karte hue maara jaye woh shaheed hai, jo apne ghar waalon ki raksha karte hue maara jaye woh shaheed hai, jo apni jaan ki raksha karte hue maara jaye woh bhi shaheed hai aur jo apne dharm ki raksha karte hue maara jaye woh bhi shaheed hai.

Saeed bin zaid -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Jo apne dhan ki raksha karte hue maara jaye woh shaheed hai, jo apne ghar waalon ki raksha karte hue maara jaye woh shaheed hai, jo apni jaan ki raksha karte hue maara jaye woh bhi shaheed hai aur jo apne dharm ki raksha karte hue maara jaye woh bhi shaheed hai.”

Yeh hadees bataati hai ki jiske saamne koi chor athva zabardasti chheenne waala a jaye aur taaqat ke bal par bina kisi sharai adhikaar ke uske dhan par qabza karna chaahe, to woh apne dhan ki raksha ke liye usse yuddh kare. Agar woh apne dhan ki raksha mein maara jaata hai, to woh Allah ke yahaan shaheed maana jayega aur use shaheed ka sawaab milega. Lekin iska matlab yeh nahin hai ki woh yuddh ke maidaan mein larte hue praan ki aahuti dene waale ki tarah shaheed hai aur use ghusl nahin diya jayega. Isi tarah jo apne praan ki raksha athva kisi aise vyakti se apni izzat ki raksha karte hue maara jaata hai, jo uski patni athav kisi any mahram stri ke saath buraai ka iraada rakhe, to use bhi shaheed ke baraabar sawaab milega. Yeh hadees utpeerankarta se bachaav ke sanbandh mein faqeehon ke yahaan ek aadhaar ki bhoomika ada karti hai.

58226: Jo svayn kisi kaary ko karne ke liye laalayit ho ham usko apne kisi kaary ke liye upyog nahin karte. Parantu ai abu moosa, athva ai abdullah bin qais (yeh abu moosa ashaari ka hi naam hai), tum yaman chale jaao.

Abu moosa (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki main Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aya. Mere saath ashaari qabeele ke do aadmi aur the. Ek mere dayeen or tha to doosra bayeen or. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- misvaak kar rahe the. Un donon ne aapse kuchh maanga, to aapne farmaya : “Ai abu moosa, athva ai abdullah bin qais.” woh kahte hain ki mainne kaha : Jis Allah ne aapko saty ke saath bheja hai, uski qasam! Inke dil mein kya hai yeh inhonne mujhe nahin bataya tha aur na hi mujhe yeh ehsaas ho saka ki yeh donon kaam maangne ke liye a rahe hain. Maano main aapke misvaak ki or dekh raha hoon jo aapke band honthon ke beech daba hua tha. Aapne farmaya : “Jo svayn kisi kaary ko karne ke liye laalayit ho ham usko apne kisi kaary ke liye upyog nahin karte. Parantu ai abu moosa, athva ai abdullah bin qais (yeh abu moosa ashaari ka hi naam hai), tum yaman chale jaao.” phir aapne unke peechhe muaaz bin jabal (radiyallahu anhu) ko yaman bhej diya. Atah jab woh yaman pahunche to unhonne unko (baithne ke liye) ek takiya diya aur kaha : Sawaari se utar kar wishraam karen. Itne mein unhonne ek vyakti ko bandha hua dekha, to poochha ki maamla kya hai? Unhonne uttar diya : Yeh pahle yahoodi tha, phir Islam dharm ko apnaya tatha ab phir dharm badalkar yahoodi ho gaya hai. Phir unse baithne ko kaha, to unhonne kaha ki main us samay tak nahin baith sakta jab tak ise katl na kar diya jaye. Yahi Allah aur uske Rasool ka phaisla hai. Unhonne yeh baat teen baar dohraai. Aakhirkaar unhonne uske qatl ka aadesh de diya tatha use katl kar diya gaya. Phir un donon ne raat mein parhi jaane waali nafal namaz ka ek-doosre se jikr kiya, to donon mein se ek ne kaha ki mera haal yeh hai ki main raat mein namaz bhi parhta hoon tatha sota bhi hoon aur jis sawaab wa puny ki ummeed namaz ko namaz parhte samay karta hoon usi sawaab ki ummeed sote samay bhi karta hoon.

58227: Allah ke azaab (aag) se kisi ko azaab na do.

Ikrima se warnit hai : Ali radiyallahu anhu ne kuchh logon ko aag mein jala diya, to yeh khabar jab ibne-e-abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) ko pahunchi to unhonne kaha : Agar main hota to unhen hargiz na jalaata, kyonki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Allah ke azaab (aag) se kisi ko azaab na do." Main unko qatl karva deta, jaisa ki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne pharmaya hai : "Jo shakhs apna deen badal le, use qatl kar do."

Ali bin abu taalib radiyallahu anhu ne apne ijtihaad (wiwek) se Islam se murtad hone waale kuchh zindeeqon (adharmiyon) ko aag se jala diya. Jab yeh baat abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma tak pahunchi, to unhonne unke qatl kiye jaane ki to taaeed ki; lekin unhen aag ke dvaara jalaane ka inkaar kiya. Unhonne kaha : Agar main unki jagah hota, to main unhen aag mein na jalaata; kyonki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne spasht kiya hai ki aag se kewal Allah hi azaab deta hai, jo aag ka rab hai. Balki unhen qatl kar dena hi kaafi hai, jaisa ki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne pharmaya hai : Jo Islam se phir jaye aur apna deen badalkar koi doosra deen apna le, use qatl kar do.

Widvaanon ki is baat par sarvasammati hai ki  Islam dharm ka parityaag karne waale ka qatl karna, uski sharton ke saath, aniwaary hai. Yaad rahe ki yeh kaam kewal imaam aur shaasak ka hai.
Aapka farmaan : "Jo koi apna deen badle, uski hatya kar do." Arthaat, jo Islam se phir jaye. Ismen purush evn stri donon shaamil hain.
Murtad (Islam ka parityaag karne waale) ko uske Islam parityaag par baaqi nahin rakha jayega, balki use Islam ki or bulaya jayega aur yadi woh sveekaar na kare, to use qatl kar diya jayega.
Is hadees mein aag se yaatna dene se mana kiya gaya hai, aur yeh bataya gaya hai ki nirdhaarit dand (hudood) aag ke dvaara nahin diye jayenge.
Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma ki fazeelat tatha Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki hadeeson ke sanbandh mein unka vyaapak jnaan aur gahri samajh.
Ismen wirodhi ka khandan karne ka shishtaachaar bayaan kiya gaya hai.
58229: Mujhse seekh lo, mujhse seekh lo. Allah ne unke liye raah nikaal di hai (yaani vyabhichaariyon ki samasya ka samaadhaan kar diya hai). Kunwaara yadi kunwaari ke saath vyabhichaar kare to usko sau kore maare jayenge tatha ek saal ke liye uske nagar se nikaal diya jayega aur wiwaahit purush yadi wiwaahita ke sang vyabhichaar kare to usko sau kore maare jayenge tatha sangsaar kiya jayega.

Ubaada bin saamit (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Mujhse seekh lo, mujhse seekh lo. Allah ne unke liye raah nikaal di hai (yaani vyabhichaariyon ki samasya ka samaadhaan kar diya hai). Kunwaara yadi kunwaari ke saath vyabhichaar kare to usko sau kore maare jayenge tatha ek saal ke liye uske nagar se nikaal diya jayega aur wiwaahit purush yadi wiwaahita ke sang vyabhichaar kare to usko sau kore maare jayenge tatha sangsaar kiya jayega.”
58230: Jab maaiz bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aye (tatha apne vyabhichaar wa dushkarm ka iqraar kiya) to aapne unse kaha : “Ho sakta hai tumne chunban liya ho athva usko chhua ho athva uski or dekha ho.” unhonne kaha : Nahin, ai Allah ke Rasool (aisi baat nahin hai). To aapne unse bina kisi laag-lapet ke poochha : “Kya tumne uske sang sanbhog kiya hai?” (jab unhonne iska iqraar kar liya to) aapne unko sangsaar karne ka aadesh diya.

Abdullaag bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki jab maaiz bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aye (tatha apne vyabhichaar wa dushkarm ka iqraar kiya) to aapne unse kaha : “Ho sakta hai tumne chunban liya ho athva usko chhua ho athva uski or dekha ho.” unhonne kaha : Nahin, ai Allah ke Rasool (aisi baat nahin hai). To aapne unse bina kisi laag-lapet ke poochha : “Kya tumne uske sang sanbhog kiya hai?” (jab unhonne iska iqraar kar liya to) aapne unko sangsaar karne ka aadesh diya.
58231: Nihsandeh Allah ne Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko saty ke saath bheja hai aur aapke oopar (kuraaan naamak) kitaab utaari hai. Aappar jo ayten utaari gaeen hain, unmen sangsaar (islaami dharmashaastr ke anusaar ek prakaar ka praandand jismen apraadhi ko zameen mein kamar tak gaarkar uske sir par pattharon ki warsha karke maar diya jaata hai) ki ayat bhi thi. Hamne usko parha hai, yaad kiya hai tatha samjha hai. Chunaanche Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne sangsaar kiya hai aur hamne bhi aapke baad sangsaar kiya hai.

Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- se warnit hai ki umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) ne farmaya, jabki woh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke minbar par baithe hue the : “Nihsandeh Allah ne Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko saty ke saath bheja hai aur aapke oopar (kuraaan naamak) kitaab utaari hai. Aappar jo ayten utaari gaeen hain, unmen sangsaar (islaami dharmashaastr ke anusaar ek prakaar ka praandand jismen apraadhi ko zameen mein kamar tak gaarkar uske sir par pattharon ki warsha karke maar diya jaata hai) ki ayat bhi thi. Hamne usko parha hai, yaad kiya hai tatha samjha hai. Chunaanche Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne sangsaar kiya hai aur hamne bhi aapke baad sangsaar kiya hai. Mujhe yeh bhay hai ki baad ke zamaane mein koi vyakti yeh na kahe ki ham Allah ki kitaab (kuraaan) mein sangsaar ka aadesh nahin paate hain (aur is tarah woh iska inkaar kar de) tatha Allah ke utaare hue ek pharz ko chhorkar gumraah wa pathabhrashat ho jaye. Yakeenan sangsaar ka hukm Allah ki kitaab se har aise shaadeeshuda purush evn mahila ke sanbandh mein saabit hai, jo dushkarm kare aur iska saboot mil jaye ya mahila ko garbh thahar jaye ya iqraar saamne a jaye.”

58242: Hilaal bin umaiya -radiyallahu anhu- ne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saamne apni patni par shareek bin sahma ke saath kukarm karne ka aarop lagaya, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Tum (chaar) gawaah pesh karo, warna tumhaari peeth par mithya aarop lagaane ki saza ke taur par kore lagaye jayenge.”

Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki hilaal bin umaiya -radiyallahu anhu- ne Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saamne apni patni par shareek bin sahma ke saath kukarm karne ka aarop lagaya, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Tum (chaar) gawaah pesh karo, warna tumhaari peeth par mithya aarop lagaane ki saza ke taur par kore lagaye jayenge.” unhonne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Agar hammen se koi apni beewi ke saath kisi ko bura kaam karte dekhe to kya woh gawaah talaash karta phire? Lekin aap yahi farmaate rahe : “(Chaar) gawaah pesh karo, warna tumhaari peeth par mithya aarop lagaane ki saza ke taur par kore lagaye jayenge.” sthiti dekh hilaal -radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Us Allah ki qasam, jisne aapko saty ke saath bheja hai, main sachcha hoon aur Allah kuraaan mein zaroor aisa hukm naazil karega, jisse meri saza tal jayegi. Phir jibreel -alaihissalaam- aye aur aappar yeh ayat utaari : {والذين يرمون أزواجهم} (woh log jo apni patniyon par vyabhichaar ka aarop lagaate hain...) [soora noor : 6] aur aage parhte hue yahaan tak pahunche : {إن كان من الصادقين} (agar woh sachche logon mein se hai.) [soora an-noor : 9] iske baad Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is masle par tawajjo di aur us aurat ko bula bheja. Hilaal -radiyallahu anhu- bhi a gae aur Allah ki qasam khaakar bataya ki woh sachche hain. Udhar Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- baar-baar kahte rahe : “Allah jaanta hai ki tum donon mein se ek zaroor jhootha hai. Lihaaza kya tummen se koi tauba karna chaahta hai?” phir woh aurat uthi aur usne bhi Allah ki qasam khaakar bataya ki uska pati jhootha hai. Jab woh paanchveen baar kahne lagi, to logon ne use roka aur bataya ki yadi woh jhoothi hai to yeh gawaahi Allah ke dand ka kaaran ban jayegi. Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- ka bayaan hai ki yeh sun woh hichkichaai aur jhijhki tatha hamen lagne laga ki shayad woh peechhe hat jaye. Lekin, phir boli : Main apni qaum ko hamesha ke liye rusva nahin karoongi. Phir paanchveen baar bhi kah di. Ispar Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Uspar nazar rakho, agar uske yahaan surmai aankhon waala, mote nitanbon waala aur bhari hui pindliyon waala bachcha paida hua to samjho ki woh shareek bin sahma ka hai.” chunaanche us aurat ke yahaan kuchh aisi hi shakl wa soorat ka bachcha paida hua. Yeh dekh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Agar kuraaan mein leaan ka hukm naazil na hua hota, to main use achchhi tarah saza deta.”

58247: Per mein latakte hue phal tatha khajoor ke per ka gooda -piththa- churaane par haath nahin kaata jayega.

Muhammad bin yahya bin hibbaan ka warnan hai ki ek daas ne ek vyakti ke baag se khajoor ka ek paudha chura liya aur apne maalik ke baag mein laga diya. Paudhe ka maalik use dhoondhte hue nikla aur use paudha mil bhi gaya. Usne us daas ke wiruddh marvaan bin hakam se madad maangi, jo un dinon madeena ke ameer the. Marvaan bin hakam ne us daas ko qaid kar liya aur uska haath kaatna chaaha. Aise mein, daas ka maalik raafe bin khadeej ke paas gaya aur unse is baare mein poochha, to unhonne bataya ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue suna haih " Per mein latakte hue phal tatha khajoor ke per ka gooda -piththa- churaane par haath nahin kaata jayega." Us vyakti ne kahaah marvaan ne mere daas ko qaid kar liya hai aur woh uska haath kaatna chaahte hain. Isliye main chaahta hoon ki aap mere saath unke paas jayen aur unhen woh hadees sunayen, jo aapne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se suni hai. Chunaanche, raafe bin khadeej uske saath chal pare. Jab marvaan ke paas pahunche, to unse kaha ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko kahte hue suna haih "Per mein latakte hue phal tatha khajoor ke per ka gooda -piththa- churaane par haath nahin kaata jayega." Chunaanche marvaan ke aadesh se us daas ko chhor diya gaya.
