Abdullah bin amr bin aas (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se per par lage hue phal ke baare mein poochha gaya, to aapne farmayaah "Jo kuchh kisi zarooratmand ne kha liya aur kapre mein nahin rakha (tatha baandhkar le nahin gaya) uspar jurmaana nahin hai aur jo vyakti kuchh lekar baahar nikla, use jurmaane ke taur par uska doguna dena hai aur dand bhi milna hai. Aur jisne use khaliyaan mein pahunchne ke baad churaya aur uska mooly ek dhaal ke baraabar ho, uska haath kaata jayega."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58252: Main ek kaale rang ki naqshedaar chaadar orhkar masjid mein soya hua tha, jiska mooly tees dirham tha. Itne mein ek vyakti aya aur mujhse uchak le gaya. Phir woh vyakti pakra gaya aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas laya gaya, to aapne uska haath kaatne ka aadesh diya.

Safvaan bin umayya kahte hain ki main ek kaale rang ki naqshedaar chaadar orhkar masjid mein soya hua tha, jiska mooly tees dirham tha. Itne mein ek vyakti aya aur mujhse uchak le gaya. Phir woh vyakti pakra gaya aur Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas laya gaya, to aapne uska haath kaatne ka aadesh diya. Safvaan bin umayya kahte hain ki yeh dekh main aapke paas pahuncha aur kahaah kya aap kewal tees dirham ke kaaran uska haath kaatenge? Main yeh chaadar use udhaar mein bech doonga. Yeh sun aapne kahaah "To phir aisa tumne ise mere paas laane se pahle kyon nahin kiya?"
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58254: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas ek vyakti ko laya gaya, jisne sharaab pi rakhi thi. Aapne use khajoor ki do shaakhaaon se lagbhag chaalees baar maara.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anha) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas ek vyakti ko laya gaya, jisne sharaab pi rakhi thi. Aapne use khajoor ki do shaakhaaon se lagbhag chaalees baar maara. Warnankarta kahte hain ki abu bakr (radiyallahu anhu) ne bhi isi par amal kiya. Phir jab umar (radiyallahu anhu) ka daur aya, to unhonne logon se mashvira kiya. Chunaanche abdur rahmaan bin auf ne kahaah sabse halki had chaalees kore hain. Atah, umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne usi ka aadesh de diya.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai aur shabd Muslim ke hain.]
58257: Jab tum mein se koi apne bhaai ko maare, to chehre par maarne se bache.
Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jab tum mein se koi apne bhaai ko maare, to chehre par maarne se bache."

Is hadees ka arth yeh hai ki jab tummen se koi kisi ko shisht banaane, dand dene, had laagu karne ya kisi jhagre aadi ke kaaran maare, to chehre par na maare aur isse har haal mein bache. Chaahe maamla sharai had laagu karne hi ka kyon na ho. Kyonki insaan ka chehra uske shareer ka sabse pratishthit ang hai aur usi se insaan kisi se aamne-saamne hota hai. Uspar maarne se uska koi ang nasht bhi ho sakta hai athva use koi bhi nuqsaan ho sakta hai. Isliye uspar maarne se bachna zaroori hai. Chehre par maarna haraam hai, chaahe maarna apne aap mein sahi ho ya ghalat.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58258: Jab Allah ne woh ayat utaari, jismen sharaab ko haraam qaraar diya hai, to us samay madeene mein prayog hone waali saari sharaaben khajoor ki hoti theen.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai ki unhonne kahaah jab Allah ne woh ayat utaari, jismen sharaab ko haraam qaraar diya hai, to us samay madeene mein prayog hone waali saari sharaaben khajoor ki hoti theen.

Is hadees mein anas -radiyallahu anhu- bata rahe hain ki jab sharaab ko haraam kiye jaane ki ayat utri, to madeene mein sharaab kewal khajoor hi ki banti thi, jo is baat ka pramaan hai ki sharaab ko haraam ghoshit karne ka kaaran uski maadakta (nasha aawar hona) hai, chaahe use kisi bhi cheez se banaya jaye.
58259: Har nashe waali wastu sharaab hai aur har nashe waali wastu haraam hai. Jisne duniya mein sharaab pi aur isi lat ke saath tauba kiye bina mar gaya, woh aakhirat mein usse wanchit rahega.

Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Har nashe waali wastu sharaab hai aur har nashe waali wastu haraam hai. Jisne duniya mein sharaab pi aur isi lat ke saath tauba kiye bina mar gaya, woh aakhirat mein usse wanchit rahega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaih wa sallam ne bataya hai ki maanav se uska wiwek chheen lene waali har cheez arbi bhaasha ke shabd "Khamr" Ke dayre mein ayegi, aur nasha laane waali cheez shumaar hogi. Chaahe use piya jaye, khaya jaye, soongha jaye ya kisi aur tarah se upyog mein laya jaye. Saath hi yeh ki nasha laane waali aur maanav wiwek ka haran karne waali har cheez ko Allah ne haraam qaraar diya hai, aur uske istemaal se mana kiya hai. Kam ho ya zyaada. Jisne kisi nasha laane waali cheez ka paabandi se upyog kiya aur usse tauba kiye bina duniya se chala gaya, woh Allah ki or se tayshuda is dand ka haqdaar ban gaya ki use Jannat ki sharaab se wanchit rakha jayega.

Sharaab ko haraam qaraar dene ka kaaran usmen nasha hona hai. Atah har nasha waali cheez haraam hai.
Allah ne sharaab ko haraam isliye qaraar diya ki usmen bare-bare nuqsaan aur buraaiyaan hain.
Svarg mein sharaab peena param sukh aur poorn aanand ka ek bhaag hai.
Jo duniya mein khud ko sharaab se door nahin rakhega, use Jannat ki sharaab se wanchit rakha jayega. Kyonki insaan ko pratiphal usi koti ka diya jaata hai, jis koti ka uska karm hota hai.
Mrity se pahle gunaahon se tauba kar lene mein jaldi karne ki prerna.
[ise Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai, jabki Bukhari ne iska antim waaky riwayat kiya hai]
58261: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke liye chamre ke bartan mein kishmish ki nabeez banaai jaati thi, jise aap us din tatha doosre aur teesre din peete the. Jab teesre din ki shaam hoti khud peete aur any logon ko pila dete. Phir bhi agar kuchh bach jaata, to baha dete the.

Abdullah bin abbaas (radiyallahu anhuma) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke liye chamre ke bartan mein kishmish ki nabeez banaai jaati thi, jise aap us din tatha doosre aur teesre din peete the. Jab teesre din ki shaam hoti khud peete aur any logon ko pila dete. Phir bhi agar kuchh bach jaata, to baha dete the.
58263: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se sharaab ke baare mein poochha gaya, to aapne unhen sharaab banaane se mana kiya (ya sharaab banaane ko naapsand kiya.) unhonne kahaah main to sharaab kewal dawa ke liye banaata hoon. Aapne kahaah "Yeh dawa nahin, balki khud beemaari hai."

Waail hazarmi ka warnan hai ki taariq bin suwaid joa़fi (radiyallahu anhu) ne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se sharaab ke baare mein poochha, to aapne unhen sharaab banaane se mana kiya (ya sharaab banaane ko naapsand kiya.) unhonne kahaah main to sharaab kewal dawa ke liye banaata hoon. Aapne kahaah "Yeh dawa nahin, balki khud beemaari hai."

Is hadees mein hai ki taariq bin suwaid -radiyallahu anhu- ne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se sharaab ke baare mein poochha, jise peene ke liye nahin, balki dawa ke liye banaya jaye, to aapne bataya ki woh svayn beemaari hai aur uske andar shifa jaisi koi wastu nahin hai. Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki sharaab haraam hai, beemaariyaan paida karti hai aur ismen koi laabh nahin hai. Atah ise nasht kar dena aur baha dena zaroori hai.
58264: Achchhe chaal-dhaal waale logon ki trutiyon ko kshama karo, siway sharai hadon ke.
Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Achchhe chaal-dhaal waale logon ki trutiyon ko kshama karo, siway sharai hadon ke."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
58265: Agar main kisi ko sharai had lagaaoon aur woh mar jaye, to mujhe koi afsos na hoga. Lekin agar sharaabi ko had lagaaoon aur woh mar jaye, to uski diyat (harjaana) doonga. Kyonki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne uske baare mein koi khaas had muqarrar nahin pharmaai hai.

Ali bin abi taalib (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai, unhonne farmaya ki agar main kisi ko sharai had lagaaoon aur woh mar jaye, to mujhe koi afsos na hoga. Lekin agar sharaabi ko had lagaaoon aur woh mar jaye, to uski diyat (harjaana) doonga. Kyonki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne uske baare mein koi khaas had muqarrar nahin pharmaai hai.
64597: Mushrikon se apni jaan, maal evn zabaan dvaara jihaad karo.
Anas radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Mushrikon se apni jaan, maal evn zabaan dvaara jihaad karo."

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kaafiron se jihaad karne aur unse har sanbhav tareeqe se larne ka aadesh diya hai, taaki Allah ke deen ki shaan barhe. Jihaad ke kuchh tareeqe is prakaar hain :

1- awishvaasiyon se jihaad ke liye dhan kharch karna, jaise hathiyaar khareedna aur mujaahidon par kharach karna aadi.

2- kaaphiron se larne aur unko rokne ke liye tan-man se nikal parna.

3- unhen maukhik roop se Islam ki or bulaana, saakshy sthaapit karna tatha unke tarkon aur daawon ka khandan karna.

Logon ko apni jaan, maal aur zabaan ka apni kshamta ke anusaar istemaal karte hue, mushrikon ke khilaaph jihaad mein shaamil hone ke liye protsaahit karna. Jihaad ka matlab sirf khud ke saath yuddh mein shaamil hona nahin hai.
Jihaad ka yeh aadesh aniwaaryata ke liye hai. Yeh aniwaaryata kabhi to vyaktigat hoti hai aur kabhi saamoohik.
Jihaad ke aadesh mein kai uddeshy nihit hain. Jaise : 1- shirk evn shirk ka paalan karne waalon ka muqaabla karna. Kyonki shirk kisi bhi haal mein Allah ke yahaan grahanyogy nahin hai. 2- Allah ki or aahvaan ki raah mein saamne aane waali rukaavton ko door karna. 3- aqeede ko usse takraane waali tamaam cheezon se surakshit rakhna. 4- musalmaanon, unke watnon, maan-sammaan tatha dhan-daulat ki suraksha karna.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, nasai aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
64598: Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha (radiyallahu anha) ka yeh kahna ki unhonne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se jihaad mein nikalne ki anumti maangi, to aapne farmayaah "Tumhaara jihaad Hajj hai."
Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki unhonne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) se jihaad mein nikalne ki anumti maangi, to aapne farmayaah "Tumhaara jihaad Hajj hai."

Mominon ki maata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai ki unhonne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se jihaad mein shareek hone ki anumti maangi, taaki jihaad ki fazeelat praapt kar saken. Chunaanche Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya ki yuddh karne aur shatruon se larne ki anumti striyon ko nahin hai. Kyonki unka shareer komal aur dil narm hota hai tatha unke andar khatron ka saamna karne ki yogyata bhi kam hoti hai. Lekin iska yeh matlab bhi nahin hai ki striyaan zakhmiyon ka ilaaj karne aur pyaason ko paani pilaane jaise kaam bhi nahin kar sakteen.
Kyonki saheeh hadees mein aya hai ki umm-e-atiyya kahti hain : Main Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath saat yuddhon mein shareek rahi. Main logon ke yuddh mein jaane ke baad unke thaharne ke sthaan mein rahti, unke liye khaana banaati, zakhmiyon ka upchaar karti aur beemaar logon ki dekh-bhaal karti thi.
Aapne aage kaha ki striyon ka jihaad Hajj hai. Hajj evn Umrah ko jihaad ke samaan isliye kaha gaya hai ki donon mein yaatra karni parti hai, ghar se door jaana parta hai, pariwaar ko chhorna parta hai, yaatraaon ke khatre jhelne parte hain, shareer ko thakaana parna hai aur dhan kharch karna parta hai.
Imaam Muslim ne anas -radiyallahu anhu- se warnan kiya hai ki hunain ke din umm-e-sulaim -radiyallahu anha- ne ek khanjar apne paas rakh liya aur Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se kaha ki mainne ise apne paas isliye rakh liya hai ki yadi koi mushrik mere paas aya, to main uska pet cheer daaloongi. Yeh hadees is baat ka pramaan hai ki striyon ko bhi yuddh ki anumti hai, yadyapi ismen is baat ka ishaara hai ki we apne bachaav ke liye hi yuddh karengi aur ismen is prakaar ka koi sanket nahin hai ki we dushman ki saf mein jaakar unse muqaabla ke liye saamne aane ka aahvaan karengi.
64599: Unke paas waapas jaao aur unse anumti maango. Yadi donon anumti de den, to jihaad mein shaamil ho, warna unki baat maano tatha unki sewa karo.

Abu saeed khudri (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki ek vyakti Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas yaman se hijrat karke aya. Aapne usse poochhaah "Kya yaman mein tera koi hai?" Usne kahaah mere maata-pita hain. Aapne kahaah donon ne tujhe anumti di hai? Usne kahaah nahin. Aapne farmayaah "Unke paas waapas jaao aur unse anumti maango. Yadi donon anumti de den, to jihaad mein shaamil ho, warna unki baat maano tatha unki sewa karo."

Is hadees mein hai ki ek vyakti yaman se aya ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se jihaad ki anumti talab kare. Aapne uske maata-pita ke baare mein poochha aur yeh jaanna chaaha ki usne unki anumti li hai ya nahin, to pata chala ki usne unki anumti nahin li hai. Atah aapne use aadesh diya ki apne maata-pita ke paas waapas chala jaye, unke saath achchha vyavhaar kare aur unki sewa kare. Is hadees se maaloom hua ki jihaad ke liye maata-pita ki anumti lena aawashyak hai.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64600: Main har us musalmaan se bari hoon, jo kaafiron ke beech mein rahta ho.

Jareer bin abdullah (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne khasaam qabeele ki or ek sainyadal bheja. (Yuddh ke dauraan) unmen se kuchh log bachaav ke liye sajde mein gir pare, lekin musalmaanon ne der kiye bina unhen qatl kar daala. Warnankarta ka kahna hai ki iski soochna Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko mili, to unke liye aadhi diyat ada karne ka aadesh diya aur farmayaah "Main har us musalmaan se bari hoon, jo kaafiron ke beech mein rahta ho." Logon ne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, aakhir kyon? Aapne farmayaah "Un donon ki aag ek-doosre ko nahin dikhni chahiye."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne khasaam qabeele ke ek samooh ki or jo ki kaafir tha ek sainyadal bheja,. Musalmaanon ko hamlaawar hote dekh unmen kuchh logon ne yeh dikhaane ke liye ki we musalmaan hain, sajda karne lage. Lekin musalmaanon ne jaldabaazi mein unka wadh kar diya. Kyonki musalmaan unhen mushrik samajh rahe the aur isliye bhi ki we rah bhi rahe the mushrikon ke beech. Lekin jab yeh achchhi tarah spasht ho gaya ki we musalmaan the, to Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unki diyat musalmaanon ki diyat se aadhi nirdhaarit ki. Aapne poori diyat isliye nirdhaarit nahin ki, kyonki is qatl ka kaaran svayn wahi the. Shareeyat ne kaafiron ke nagar mein rahne ko haraam qaraar diya hai. Atah donon ko ek-doosre ke saath nahin rahna chahiye aur unmen se ek ki aag doosre ko nahin dikhni chahiye. Yaani itna nikat ghar nahin banaana chahiye ki yadi donon mein se koi aag jalaye, to doosre ko dikh jaye. Aisa shareeyat ne awishvaas evn awishvaasiyon se bejaari ko rekhaankit karne ke liye kiya hai .
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64601: Hijrat us samay tak band nahin hogi, jab tak kaafiron se yuddh jaari rahega.

Abdullah bin waqdaan saadi (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, woh kahte hainh ham ek pratinidhi mandal ke saath Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas pahunche. Hammen se har ek apni zarurat lekar aya tha. Main sabse ant mein Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke nikat pahuncha. Mainne kahaah ai Allah ke Rasool, main apne peechhe aise logon ko chhorkar aya hoon, jo yeh samajhte hain ki hijrat band ho gai hai. Aapne farmayaah "Hijrat us samay tak band nahin hogi, jab tak kaafiron se yuddh jaari rahega."
[ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64603: Aksar aisa hota ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kisi yuddh mein nikalne ka iraada karte, to kisi aur disha mein nikalne ka sanket dete. Parantu tabook yuddh mein aisa nahin kiya.

Kaab bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki aksar aisa hota ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kisi yuddh mein nikalne ka iraada karte, to kisi aur disha mein nikalne ka sanket dete. Parantu tabook yuddh mein aisa nahin kiya. Yeh yuddh aapne sakht garmi ke mausam mein kiya, lambe safar tatha registaan ka saamna tha aur bhaari bharkam dushman ka muqaabla tha. Atah, musalmaanon ke saamne maamla spasht kar diya, taaki shatru se muqaable ki taiyaari kar len. Aapne bata diya tha ki aap kidhar ka iraada rakhte hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64605: Tum waapas jaao, main kisi mushrik ki madad harigaz nahin loonga.

Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ki patni aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) badr ki or nikle. Jab 'harra al-wabra' mein pahunche, to ek vyakti aapse mila, jiski jurrat aur bahaaduri ke khoob charche the. Use dekh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saathi bare prasann hue. Jab woh Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas aya, to aapse kahaah main aapke saath chalne aur aapke saath ghaneemat ka dhan praapt karne ke liye aya hoon. Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne usse poochhaah "Kya tum Allah aur uske Rasool par eemaan rakhte ho?" Usne uttar diya ki nahin! To aapne farmayaah "Tum waapas ho jaao. Main kisi mushrik ki madad hargiz nahin loonga." Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) kahti hain ki phir aap chal pare, yahaan tak ki jab ham 'al-shajra' ke sthaan par pahunche, to woh aadmi phir aapse mila aur wahi baat kahi, jo pahli baar kahi thi. Aapne bhi use wahi uttar diya, jo pahli baar diya tha. Aapne kahaah "Tum waapas jaao, main kisi mushrik ki madad harigaz nahin loonga." Warnankarta ka kahna hai ki phir woh 'al-baida' naami sthaan mein aapse mila, to aapne wahi sawaal jo pahli baar kiya tha, phir dohraya. Poochhaah "Kya tum Allah aur uske Rasool par eemaan rakhte ho?" Usne kahaah haan! Tab Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "To phir chalo."
64607: Ali bin abu taalib (radiyallahu anhu) ka yeh farmaan ki main pahla vyakti hoon, jo atyant kripaasheel Allah ke saamne jhagarne ke liye qayaamat ke din apne ghutnon ke bal baithega.

Ali bin abu taalib (radiyallahu anhu) se warnit hai, unhonne kahaah main pahla vyakti hoon, jo atyant kripaasheel Allah ke saamne jhagarne ke liye qayaamat ke din apne ghutnon ke bal baithega. Qais bin abbaad kahte hainh inheen logon ke baare mein yeh ayat utri haih (yeh do paksh hain, jo apne paalanhaar ke wishay mein jhagre.) [soora hajah 19] woh kahte hainh yahi log arthaat hamza, ali, ubaida athva abu ubaida bin haaris, shaiba bin rabeea, utba bin rabeea aur waleed bin utba hi hain, jo badr ke din muqaable ke liye aage nikalkar lare.
64614: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne do musalmaanon ko ek mushrik ke badle mein chhuraya.
Imraan bin husain (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne do musalmaanon ko ek mushrik ke badle mein chhuraya.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64620: Mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dekha ki safar ke aaranbh mein dushman par dhaawa bolne waalon ko,unke bhaag ke atirikt (khums nikaalne ke baad ghaneemat ke dhan ka) ek chauthaai bhaag diya aur safar se lautte samay dhaawa bolne waalon ko unke bhaag ke atirikt ek tihaai diya.

Habeeb bin masalma fehri kahte hainh mainne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko dekha ki safar ke aaranbh mein dushman par dhaawa bolne waalon ko,unke bhaag ke atirikt (khums nikaalne ke baad ghaneemat ke dhan ka) ek chauthaai bhaag diya aur safar se lautte samay dhaawa bolne waalon ko unke bhaag ke atirikt ek tihaai diya.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64621: Ham apni laraaiyon mein shahad aur angoor praapt karte, to use kha lete aur taqseem ke liye Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas bhejte nahin the.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki ham apni laraaiyon mein shahad aur angoor praapt karte, to use kha lete aur taqseem ke liye Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke paas bhejte nahin the.
64622: Hamne khaibar ke din khaane ki wastuen praapt keen, to (ek-ek) aadmi aata aur apni zaroorat bhar lekar waapas ho jaata.

Abdullah bin abu aufa se riwayat hai ki unse poochha gaya ki kya aap log Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke zamaane mein (khaane ki wastuon ka) paanchvaan bhaag nikaalte the? To unhonne kahaah hamne khaibar ke din khaane ki wastuen praapt keen, to (ek-ek) aadmi aata aur apni zaroorat bhar lekar waapas ho jaata.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64623: Jo Allah tatha aakhirat ke din par eemaan rakhta ho, woh musalmaanon ke fay (mushrikon se bina yuddh kiye praapt hone waala dhan) ke jaanvar par is tarah sawaar na ho ki jab use kamzor kar de, to use fay mein lauta de aur jo Allah tatha aakhirat ke din par eemaan rakhta ho, woh musalmaanon ke fay ke kisi kapre ko is tarah na pahne ki jab use puraana kar de, to waapas kar de.

Ruwaife bin saabit ansaari ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Jo Allah tatha aakhirat ke din par eemaan rakhta ho, woh musalmaanon ke fay (mushrikon se bina yuddh ke praapt hone waala dhan) ke jaanvar par is tarah sawaar na ho ki jab use kamzor kar de, to use fay lauta de aur jo Allah tatha aakhirat ke din par eemaan rakhta ho, woh musalmaanon ke fay ke kisi kapre ko is tarah na pahne ki jab use puraana kar de, to waapas kar de."
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64624: Musalmaan any logon ke muqaable mein ek haath ki tarah hain. Unka rakt aur unka dhan baraabar hai. Unke nimnatam vyakti ki di hui suraksha bhi is layaq hoti hai ki saare musalmaan uska sammaan karen aur musalmaan (ghaneemat ka dhan) apne sabse door mein rahne waale vyakti ko bhi lautaate hain."

Amr bin shuaib apne pita se aur woh apne daada se riwayat karte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Musalmaan any logon ke muqaable mein ek haath ki tarah hain. Unka rakt aur unka dhan baraabar hai. Unke nimnatam vyakti ki di hui suraksha bhi is layaq hoti hai ki saare musalmaan uska sammaan karen aur musalmaan (ghaneemat ka dhan) apne sabse door mein rahne waale vyakti ko bhi lautaate hain."
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64625: Main yahoodiyon aur eesaaiyon ko zaroor arab dveep se nikaal doonga, yahaan tak ki musalmaanon ke siwa kisi ko nahin chhoroonga.

Umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko farmaate hue sunaah "Main yahoodiyon aur eesaaiyon ko zaroor arab dveep se nikaal doonga, yahaan tak ki musalmaanon ke siwa kisi ko nahin chhoroonga."

Is hadees mein umar -radiyallahu anhu- bata rahe hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- arab dveep se yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon ko nikaal baahar karne ka iraada rakhte the, taaki wahaan do dharmon ka milaap na ho aur arab dveep ekeshvarvaad ki dhvani se goonjta rahe tatha usmen shirk ka koi prateek baaqi na rahe. Kyonki awishvaasiyon ke paros mein tatha unke saath rahna buri cheez hone ke saath-saath bahut-si buraaiyon ka kaaran bhi banta hai. Jaise seedhe-saade tatha kam samajh-boojh waale musalmaanon ka unki mushaabhat akhtiyaar kar lena, unki dhaarmik maanyataaon ko achchha samajhne lagna aur unki chaal chalne lagna. Atah zaroori hai ki musalmaan apne nagar mein alag se rahen tatha wipreet aqeedon waale logon ke mel-jol se khud ko door rakhen. Yahi kaaran hai ki yahoodiyon, eesaaiyon tatha majoosiyon aadi saare awishvaasi samudayon ko arab dveep se nikaalna zaroori ho gaya. Kyonki arab dveep musalmaanon ke liye khaas hai. Yaheen wahy utarti rahi hai aur kisi bhi awastha mein yahaan gairmuslimon ka rahna uchit nahin hai.
64627: Ham Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath khaibar yuddh mein shareek hue, jahaan hamen bakriyaan mileen, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne uska kuchh bhaag hamaare beech baant diya aur shesh ko maal-e-ghaneemat mein jama kar diya.

Abdur rahmaan bin ghanm kahte hainh ham shurahbeel bin simt ke saath qinnasreen nagar ki seemaaon mein tainaat the. Jab unhonne uspar wijay praapt ki, to wahaan bakriyaan aur gayen mileen, jiska kuchh bhaag hamaare beech baant diya aur shesh ko maal-e-ghaneemat mein jama kar diya. Phir mainne muaaz bin jabal (radiyallahu anhu) se mulaaqaat ki aur is ghatna ka zikr kiya, to muaaz (radiyallahu anhu) ne farmayaah ham Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke saath khaibar yuddh mein shareek hue, jahaan hamen bakriyaan mileen, to Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne uska kuchh bhaag hamaare beech baant diya aur shesh ko maal-e-ghaneemat mein jama kar diya.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64630: Hamaare paas umar bin khattaab ki mrityu se ek saal pahle unka patr aya ki un majoosi wiwaahon ko nirast kar do jo aise sanbandhiyon ke beech hue hain, jinke beech wiwaah uchit nahin hai.

Bajaala kahte hainh main ahnaf ke chacha jaz bin muaawiya ka lipik tha. Hamaare paas umar bin khattaab ki mrityu se ek saal pahle unka patr aya ki un majoosi wiwaahon ko nirast kar do, jo aise sanbandhiyon ke beech hue hain, jinke beech wiwaah uchit nahin hai. Tatha umar bin khattaab (radiyallahu anhu) ne majoosiyon se jizya nahin liya, yahaan tak ki abdur rahmaan bin auf ne gawaahi de di ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne hajar ke majoosiyon se jizya liya tha.
64631: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne khaalid bin waleed ko doomtal jandal ke sardaar ukaidir ki or bheja, jise giraftaar karke aapke paas laya gaya, to aapne uske rakt ko surakshit kar diya aur jizya lekar usse samjhauta kar liya.

Anas bin maalik (radiyallahu anhu) aur usmaan bin abu sulaimaan (radiyallahu anhu) ka warnan hai ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne khaalid bin waleed ko doomtal jandal ke sardaar ukaidir ki or bheja, jise giraftaar karke aapke paas laya gaya, to aapne uske rakt ko surakshit kar diya aur jizya lekar usse samjhauta kar liya.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64632: Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne jab unhen yaman bheja, to aadesh diya ki woh har tees gayon par ek ek warsheey bachhra ya bachhiya len

Muaaz radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai : Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne jab unhen yaman bheja, to aadesh diya ki woh har tees gayon par ek ek warsheey bachhra ya bachhiya len aur har chaalees gayon par ek do warsheey gay wasool karen, tatha har baaligh vyakti se ek deenaar ya uske baraabar maaafiri kapre, jo yaman mein bante hain, len.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne muaaz bin jabal radiyallahu anhu ko logon ko shiksha dene aur (Islam ki or) bulaane ke liye yaman bheja tha. Bhejte samay unhen jo aadesh diye, unmen se ek yeh tha ki woh musalmaanon se unki gayon ki zakat is tarah wasool karen ki har tees gayon par ek saal ka ek bachhra ya bachhiya (tabeea ya tabeea) len, aur har chaalees gayon par do saal ki ek gay (musinna) len. Isi tarah woh ahle kitaab yaani yahoodiyon aur eesaaiyon, ke har baaligh purush se ek deenaar jizya len, ya uske baraabar yaman ke 'maaafiri' naamak kapre len.

Jizya (suraksha kar) kewal wayask vyakti se hi liya jayega; kyonki jizya na lene ka maanak yeh hai ki yeh un logon se nahin liya jaata, jinhen bandi bana liye jaane ki sthiti mein qatl karna jayaz nahin hai, jaise ki bachche, mahilayen aur isi tarah ke doosre log.
Jizya ki maatra ka nirdhaaran imaam (shaasak) ke ijtihaad (wiwek) par nirbhar hai, kyonki yeh sthaan, kaal, ameeri tatha ghareebi ke anusaar alag-alag hota hai. Iska pramaan yeh hai ki khud Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam hi ne yaman waalon par ise nirdhaarit kiya tha aur aapne muaaz se kaha tha : “Har baaligh vyakti se ek deenaar lo”, jabki umar radiyallahu anhu ke nirdhaaran mein jizya ki maatra barh gai, jab unhonne ise shaam waalon par nirdhaarit kiya.
Zakat ikattha karne ka prabandh karna aur use ikattha karne waalon ko niyukt karna, shaasak ke kaaryon mein se hai.
Tabeea़ : Woh bachhra hai jo ek saal poora kar chuka ho aur doosre saal mein prawesh kar chuka ho. Use tabeea़ isliye kaha jaata hai, kyonki yeh abhi bhi apni maan ke peechhe chalta hai.
Deenaar : Ek svarn mudra hai. Islaami deenaar ka wazan sone ka sawa chaar graam (4.25 graam) hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, nasai, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
64637: Jo aadmi kisi 'muaahad' (woh ghairmuslim, jiske saath musalmaanon ka shaanti samjhauta ho) ko qatl karega, woh Jannat ki khushbu tak na payega, jabki Jannat ki khushbu chaalees baras ki doori tak pahunchti hai.

Abdullah bin amr radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jo aadmi kisi 'muaahad' (woh ghairmuslim, jiske saath musalmaanon ka shaanti samjhauta ho) ko qatl karega, woh Jannat ki khushbu tak na payega, jabki Jannat ki khushbu chaalees baras ki doori tak pahunchti hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam is baat ki sakht chetaavni de rahe hain ki jisne kisi muaahad -aisa vyakti jo shaanti evn suraksha ka parvaana lekar islaami desh mein prawesh kare- ko qatl kiya, woh Jannat ki sugandh tak nahin payega. Jabki uski sugandh chaalees saal ki doori se mahsoos ki ja sakti hai.

Muaahad, zimmi aur mustaamin vyakti ko qatl karna haraam tatha maha paap hai.
Muaahad : Muslim desh mein rahne waale us ghair-Muslim ko kahte hain, jisse is baat par samjhauta ho chuka ho ki na woh musalmaanon se yuddh karega aur na musalmaan usse yuddh karenge. Evn zimmi : Aisa ghair-Muslim vyakti jo jizya (wishesh kar) dekar kisi Muslim desh mein rahta ho. Mustaamin : Aisa ghair-Muslim vyakti jo nirdhaarit samay tak ke liye kisi samjhaute evn sandhi ke aadhaar par kisi Muslim desh mein prawesh kare.
Is hadees mein ghair-muslimon ko diye gae wachnon ko torne se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai.
64639: Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ghurdaur karaai aur paanch saal ke ghoron ko masaafat tay karne ke maamle mein tarjeeh di.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne ghurdaur karaai aur paanch saal ke ghoron ko masaafat tay karne ke maamle mein tarjeeh di.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64640: Puraskaar ke saath pratiyogita ki anumti kewal oontdaur, ghurdaur aur teerandaazi mein hai.
Abu huraira (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmayaah "Puraskaar ke saath pratiyogita ki anumti kewal oontdaur, ghurdaur aur teerandaazi mein hai."

Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki dhan athva is tarah kisi aur roop mein inaam lena kewal oontdaur, ghurdaur tatha is prakaar ke any muqaablon evn teerandaazi ki pratiyogita mein jayaz hai. Iska kaaran yeh hai ki is prakaar ki pratiyogitayen shatru se yuddh ki taiyaari ke antargat aati hain aur inmen inaam dena daraasal jihaad ke liye prerit karna aur uspar ubhaarna hai. Ghore ke arth mein khachchar evn gadha bhi aate hain. Kyonki teenon khur waale jaanvar hain aur unke tez chalne ki aawashyakta bhi hoti hai, kyonki yeh sena ka bojh dhone ka kaam karte hain aur uske saath yuddh mein shareek hote hain. Jnaat ho ki is hadees ke andar yuddh mein kaam aane waale woh saare astr-shastr daakhil hain, jo ukt wastuon ke arth mein hain.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64642: Sun lo, shakti se aashay teerandaazi hai. Sun lo, shakti se aashay teerandaazi hai. Sun lo, shakti se aashay teerandaazi hai.

Uqba bin aamir (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ko minbar par kahte hue suna haih (tatha tumse jahaan tak ho sake, unke liye shakti taiyaar rakho.) [soora al-anfaalah 60] sun lo, shakti se aashay teerandaazi hai. Sun lo, shakti se aashay teerandaazi hai. Sun lo, shakti se aashay teerandaazi hai."

Is hadees mein us shakti ki vyaakhya ki gai hai, jise shatruon evn kaafiron ka muqaabla karne ke liye apnaane ka aadesh diya gaya hai. Hadees mein kaha gaya hai ki usse muraad "Phenkna" Hai, jisse aaghaat bhi bara sakht hota hai aur shatruon ka khatra bhi bahut kam rahta hai. Yeh ayat jis samay utri thi, us samay teer phenk kar aakraman kiya jaata tha. Lekin is ayat ke waakpatu arth rakhne mein se hai ki ismen shakti shabd ka prayog kiya gaya hai, taaki uske antargat har zamaane evn har sthaan ki shakti a jaye. Isi tarah hadees ke waijnaanik chamatkaar ko yeh baat spasht karti hai ki usmen "Phenkne" Ka shabd prayukt hua hai, jiske andar har prakaar ka phenkna sammilit hai, chaahe hathiyaar koi bhi ho aur kisi bhi samay taiyaar hua ho.
64643: Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne har nukeele daant waale darinde aur naakhoon (se shikaar karne) waale parinde (ka maans khaane) se mana kiya hai.

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne har nukeele daant waale darinde aur naakhoon (se shikaar karne) waale parinde (ka maans khaane) se mana kiya hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne har aise cheer-phaar karne waale darinde ka maans khaane se mana kiya hai, jo apne nokeele daant se shikaar karta hai. Isi tarah har aise parinde ka maans khaane se mana kiya hai, jo apne naakhoon se pakarta evn kaatta hai.

Islam ki koshish yeh hai ki banda khaane-peene ki kewal paak cheezon hi ka prayog kare.
Khaane ki cheezon mein shareeat ka mool aadesh halaal hona hai. Haraam wahi cheez hai, jiske haraam hone ki koi daleel maujood ho.
64646: Kya lakarbaggha shikaar hai? To jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) ne uttar diyaah haan!

Ibne abu ammaar kahte hain ki mainne jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) se poochha ki kya lakraggha shikaar hai? To unhonne uttar diyaah haan! Woh kahte hain ki mainne kahaah kya main use kha sakta hoon? Unhonne kahaah haan! Unka kahna hai ki mainne unse kahaah kya aisa Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya hai? Unhonne kahaah haan!

[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise nasaai ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64648: Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne paakhaana khaane waale oont par sawaar hone aur uska doodh peene se mana kiya hai.

Abdullah bin umar (radiyallahu anhuma) se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne paakhaana khaane waale oont par sawaar hone aur uska doodh peene se mana kiya hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64650: Umme huphai़d -radiyallahu anha- ne, jo abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- ki khaala theen, Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko paneer, ghi aur kuchh saanre hadiya bheje, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne paneer aur ghi to kha liya, magar saanre ko naapsand karte hue chhor diya.

Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : “Umme huphai़d -radiyallahu anha- ne, jo abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- ki khaala theen, Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko paneer, ghi aur kuchh saanre hadiya bheje, to Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne paneer aur ghi to kha liya, magar saanre ko naapsand karte hue chhor diya.” abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- farmaate hain : “Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke dastarkhaan par saanra khaya gaya. Agar woh haraam hota, to Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke dastarkhaan par na khaya jaata.”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64652: Jab tum kisi shikaar par teer chalaao tatha woh tumhaari nazron se ojhal ho jaye aur phir use baad mein paao, to use khaao, jab tak usmen badbu na a jaye.

Abu saalba -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmaya : “Jab tum kisi shikaar par teer chalaao tatha woh tumhaari nazron se ojhal ho jaye aur phir use baad mein paao, to use khaao, jab tak usmen badbu na a jaye.”
64653: Kuchh logon ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Kuchh log hamaare paas maans laate hain, lekin hamen maaloom nahin hota ki unhonne zabah karte samay bismillah kaha hai ya nahin. Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Tum uspar bismillah kaho aur kha lo.”

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- se riwayat hai, woh kahti hain ki kuchh logon ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Kuchh log hamaare paas maans laate hain, lekin hamen maaloom nahin hota ki unhonne zabah karte samay bismillah kaha hai ya nahin. Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Tum uspar bismillah kaho aur kha lo.”
64654: Jisne aisa kiya hai uspar Allah ki laanat ho. Kisne kiya hai aisa? Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne uspar laanat bheji hai, jisne kisi aisi wastu ko nishaana banaane ke liye upyog kiya, jismen jaan ho.

Saeed bin jubair se riwayat hai ki abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ka ghuzar quraish ke kuchh yuvkon ke paas se hua, jinhonne ek chiriya ko baandh rakha tha tatha usko nishaana banaakar teer chalaane ka abhyaas kar rahe the aur nishaane se chookne waala har teer chiriya ke maalik ko dene ki baat tay kar rakhi thi. Lekin jab abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ko dekha, to idhar-udhar bhaag khare hue. Yeh dekh abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ne kaha : “Jisne aisa kiya hai uspar Allah ki laanat ho. Kisne kiya hai aisa? Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne uspar laanat bheji hai, jisne kisi aisi wastu ko nishaana banaane ke liye upyog kiya, jismen jaan ho.”
64655: Ek mahila ne ek bakri ko patthar se zabah kiya aur jab Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se uske baare mein poochha gaya, to aapne use khaane ka aadesh diya.

Kaab bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki ek mahila ne ek bakri ko patthar se zabah kiya aur jab Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se uske baare mein poochha gaya, to aapne use khaane ka aadesh diya.
64656: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kisi jaanvar ko qaid mein rakhkar maarne se mana kiya hai.
Jaabir bin abdullah -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kisi jaanvar ko qaid mein rakhkar maarne se mana kiya hai.
64657: Hamne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se jaanvar ke garbh ke baare mein poochha, to farmaya : “Yadi chaaho to use kha sakte ho. Kyonki uski maan ko zabah karna hi uske liye kaafi hai.”

Abu saeed -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki hamne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se jaanvar ke garbh ke baare mein poochha, to farmaya : “Yadi chaaho to use kha sakte ho. Kyonki uski maan ko zabah karna hi uske liye kaafi hai.”
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64660: Jo saamarthy hone ke baavjood qurbaani na kare, woh hamaari eedgaah ke qareeb bhi na aye.
Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Jo saamarthy hone ke baavjood qurbaani na kare, woh hamaari eedgaah ke qareeb bhi na aye.”
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64665: Hamne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath hudaibiya ke saal ek oont saat logon ki or se zabah kiya tatha ek gay saat logon ki or se zabah kiya.

Jaabir bin abdullah -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : “Hamne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath hudaibiya ke saal ek oont saat logon ki or se zabah kiya tatha ek gay saat logon ki or se zabah kiya.”
64666: Allah ke Rasool - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam - ne hasan aur husain -radiyallahu anhuma- ki or se (aqeeqa mein) ek-ek merha zabah kiya .
Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam - ne hasan aur husain -radiyallahu anhuma- ki or se (aqeeqa mein) ek-ek merha zabah kiya .

Is hadees mein abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhu- bata rahe hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne hasan aur husain -radiyallahu anhuma- mein se har ek ki or se do-do merha zabah kiya. Is tarah, yeh hadees navjaat shishu ki or se aqeeqa karne ka pramaan prastut karti hai.
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64667: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne logon ko aadesh diya ki larke ki or se ek jaisi do bakriyaan zabah karen tatha larki ki or se ek bakri.
Aaisha (radiyallahu anha) se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne logon ko aadesh diya ki larke ki or se ek jaisi do bakriyaan zabah karen tatha larki ki or se ek bakri.

Is hadees mein aaisha -radiyallahu anha- bata rahi hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unhen aadesh diya hai ki santaan janm lete samay bachche ki or se ayu, wazan evn ‏shreshthata mein do samaan bakriyaan zabah karen. Isi tarah bachchi ki or se ek bakri zabah karen.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64668: Pratyek bachcha apne aqeeke ke badle girvi hota hai. Uski or se saatven din jaanvar zabah kiya jayega tatha uska naam rakha jayega evn uske sar ke baal moonre jayenge.

Samura -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne pharmaya : “Pratyek bachcha apne aqeeke ke badle girvi hota hai. Uski or se saatven din jaanvar zabah kiya jayega tatha uska naam rakha jayega evn uske sar ke baal moonre jayenge.”

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- bata rahe hain ki paida hone waala bachcha apne aqeeqa ke badle mein girvi hota hai. Uski or se janm ke teesre din jaanvar zabah kiya jayega. Usi din bachche ka naam rakhna aur uske sir ke baal moonrna musathab hai. Jnaat ho ki sir ke baal moonrna bachche ke saath khaas hai aur ismen bachchi daakhil nahin hai.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise daarimi ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64672: Yeh ayat {لا يؤاخذكم الله باللغو في أيمانكم} (Allah tumhaari nirarthak qasmon par tumhaari pakar nahin karega.) [soora baqra : 225] logon ki is tarah ki baaton ke baare mein utri hai : Nahin Allah ki qasam tatha kyon nahin Allah ki qasam.

Aaisha -radiyallahu anha- se riwayat hai, woh kahti hain ki yeh ayat {لا يؤاخذكم الله باللغو في أيمانكم} (Allah tumhaari nirarthak qasmon par tumhaari pakar nahin karega.) [soora baqra : 225] logon ki is tarah ki baaton ke baare mein utri hai : Nahin Allah ki qasam tatha kyon nahin Allah ki qasam.
64673: Allah ke sau se ek kam ninyaanve naam hain. Jisne unko yaad kiya tatha unke taqaazon par amal kiya, woh Jannat mein daakhil hoga.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Allah ke sau se ek kam ninyaanve naam hain. Jisne unko yaad kiya tatha unke taqaazon par amal kiya, woh Jannat mein daakhil hoga.”

Is hadees mein is baat ka ullekh hai ki Allah ke sundar naamon mein ninyaanve naam aise hain, jo unko yaad karega, unpar wishvaas rakhega aur uske taqaazon par amal karega, uske liye Jannat hai. In naamon mein se kisi ki bhi qasam khaana jayaz hai aur in naamon ki qasam khaane se qasam sthaapit ho jaati hai. Chunaanche woh qasam, jise torne par kaffaara waajib hota hai, woh qasam hai, jo Allah ki, rahmaan evn raheem ki ya uske kisi gun, jaise uske chehre, mahaanta, prataap evn pratishtha ki khaai jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64675: “Mannat ka kaffaara, qasam ka kaffaara hi hai.”
Uqba bin aamir radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : “Mannat ka kaffaara, qasam ka kaffaara hi hai.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki anirdhaarit nazr ka kaffaara (prayashchit), jab use nirdhaarit na kiya gaya ho aur na uska naam liya gaya ho, qasam ka kaffaara (prayashchit) hai.

Nazr : Shareeyat ki paribhaasha mein : Sharai aadeshon evn nirdeshon ke paalan par baadhy vyakti ka apni ichchha se apne oopar kisi cheez ko Allah ke liye aniwaary kar lena.
Shapath ka kaffaara (prayashchit) : Das nirdhanon ko bhojan karaana, unhen kapre dena athva ek daas mukt karna. Yadi woh aisa na kar sake, to teen din ke roze rakhe.
Kaffaara ke andar hikmat yeh hai ki musalmaan mannat (nazr) ka sammaan kare, usmen dobaara na pare aur use apni zabaan par baar-baar na laye.
Nazr ke prakaar : 1. Nazr-e-mutlaq (saamaany nazr) : Jaise koi kahe : "Agar main svasth ho gaya to mujh par Allah ke liye ek nazr hai" Aur chup ho jaye tatha kisi wishesh nazr ki neeyat na kare, to svasth hone par uspar qasam ka kaffaara aniwaary hoga. 2. Nazr-e-lajaaj wa gazab (zid aur gusse ki nazr) : Yeh woh nazr hai jise kisi shart ke saath jora jaye, jiska uddeshy kisi kaam ko karne se rokna ho ya kisi kaam ko karne par majboor karna ho, jaise koi kahe : "Agar mainne tumse baat ki to mujhpar ek maheene ke roze hain." Iska hukm yeh hai ki woh ya to apne wachan ka paalan kare ya phir baat karta hai to qasam ka kaffaara de. 3. Nazr-e-mubaah (jayaz kaam ki nazr) : Jaise koi kahe : "Mujhpar Allah ke liye apne kapre pahanna aniwaary hai." Iska hukm yeh hai ki use kapre pahanne ya qasam ka kaffaara dene ke beech wikalp diya jayega. 4. Nazr-e-makrooh (naapsandeeda kaam ki nazr) : Jaise koi kahe : Mujhpar Allah ke liye apni patni ko talaaq dena aniwaary hai." Iska hukm yeh hai ki uske liye sunnat yeh hai ki woh qasam ka kaffaara de aur jo nazr maani hai use na kare. Yadi use kar leta hai to uspar koi kaffaara nahin hai. 5. Nazr-e-maasiyat (gunaah ke kaam ki nazr) : Jaise koi kahe : "Mujh par Allah ke liye chori karna aniwaary hai." Iska hukm yeh hai ki nazr ko poora karna haraam hai aur nazr maanne waala qasam ka kaffaara de. Yadi woh use kar leta hai to woh gunaahgaar hoga aur uspar koi kaffaara nahin hai. 6. Nazr-e-taaat (aajnaapaalan ki nazr): Jaise koi kahe : "Mujh par Allah ke liye itni namaz parhna aniwaary hai" Allah ka saameepy praapt karne ke iraade se, yadi woh ise kisi shart se jorta hai, jaise kisi beemaar ke theek hone se, to shart poori hone par use poora karna waajib hoga, aur yadi ise kisi shart se nahin jorta hai, to use har haal mein poora karna waajib hoga.
64681: Jald hi tum log imaarat aur sardaari ki laalach karoge. Jabki qayaamat ke din tumhen uski wajah se nadaamat aur sharmindgi hogi. Doodh pilaane waali achchhi hoti hai aur doodh chhuraane waali buri.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se bayaan karte hain ki aapne farmaya : “Jald hi tum log imaarat aur sardaari ki laalach karoge. Jabki qayaamat ke din tumhen uski wajah se nadaamat aur sharmindgi hogi. Doodh pilaane waali achchhi hoti hai aur doodh chhuraane waali buri."

Yeh hadees prashaasnik padon tatha sharai drishtikon se unke samaan samjhe jaane waale any padon, jaise nyayik zimmewaariyon ke mahatv tatha aakhirat mein saamne aane waali unke prabhaawon se avgat karti hai. Saath hi unhen talab karne aur unki ichchha rakhne se saavdhaan karti hai. Jnaat ho ki yeh chetaavni uske liye hai, jo in padon ki yogyata na rakhne ke baavjood inhen praapt karne ki ichchha rakhta ho aur apne prayaas se inhen praapt karta ho. Iske wipreet yadi koi inki yogyata rakhta ho, inhen praapt karne ke liye prayaas na karta ho aur inhen grahan karne ke baad nyay se kaam leta ho, to inhen sanbhaalne mein Allah ki or se uski sahayta ki jayegi, jaisa ki any hadeeson mein ullikhit hai. Is hadees mein prashaasnik pad ke baare mein kaha gaya hai ki woh achchhi doodh pilaane waali hai, kyonki usse dhan, pad evn aadesh laagu hone ke roop mein kai laabh hote hain aur buri doodh chhuraane waali hai, kyonki qayaamat ke din uske bare karve nateeje saamne ayenge aur uske kaaran insaan ko sharmindgiyon ka saamna karna parega.
64682: Jab koi nirnaykaari nirnay karte samay sahi nirnay tak pahunchne ka poora prayaas karta hai aur sahi nirnay dene mein saphal ho jaata hai, to use do nekiyaan milti hain aur jab nirnay dete samay sahi nirnay dene ka poora prayaas to karta hai, lekin asphal rahta hai, to use ek neki milti hai.

Amr bin aas radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : “Jab koi nirnaykaari nirnay karte samay sahi nirnay tak pahunchne ka poora prayaas karta hai aur sahi nirnay dene mein saphal ho jaata hai, to use do nekiyaan milti hain aur jab nirnay dete samay sahi nirnay dene ka poora prayaas to karta hai, lekin asphal rahta hai, to use ek neki milti hai.”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64687: Woh qaum kadaapi saphal nahin hogi, jisne apne maamle kisi aurat ko saunp diye hon.

Abu bakra radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Woh qaum kadaapi saphal nahin hogi, jisne apne maamle kisi aurat ko saunp diye hon."
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki woh qaum kabhi saphalta nahin payegi, jisne nyay, saamaany shaasan ya mantraalay jaise apne maamle kisi aurat ko saunp diye hon.

Mahilayen shaasan, logon ke beech nyay aur is tarah ke any saarvajnik pad nahin sanbhaalengi, albatta niji maamlon, jaise kisi waqf ya anaathon ki sanrakshakta, ya kisi madarse ka prabandhan aur is tarah ke any kaary sanbhaalne mein koi harj nahin haiै.
Stri ki shaareerik kami aur svaabhaawik nirbalta ke kaaran woh saarvajnik padon mein purush ki bhaageedaar nahin ho sakti aur uska aise padon ko sanbhaalna asphalta ka kaaran banta hai.
Allah ne mahila ki rachna ki aur use purush ki prakriti se bhinn prakriti pradaan ki, atah kuchh kaary aise hain, jinhen mahila ka karna uchit nahin hai; uski wishesh prakriti ke kaaran, aur isi prakaar kuchh kaary aise hain, jinhen purush ka karna uchit nahin hai; uski wishesh prakriti ke kaaran.
Nakaaraatmak saphalta : Shareeyat ki bhaasha mein falaah yaani saphalta ka arth duniya aur aakhirat ki bhalaai praapt karna hai. Yahaan yeh yaad rahe ki kisi raajy ki samriddhi is baat ki dyotak nahin hai ki wahaan rahne waale logon ko Allah ki prasannata praapt hogi hi. Jo samuday Allah ki aajnaakaari na ho, woh saphal nahin hai, chaahe dekhne mein saansaarik roop se behtar se behtar sthiti hi mein kyon na ho.
Is hadees mein mahila ke darje ko kam nahin kiya gaya hai, balki yeh uski kshamtaaon ka sahi aur uchit disha-nirdeshan hai.
64688: Jisko sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne musalmaanon ke maamlon ka zimmewaar banaya tatha woh unki aavyashyakta, zaroorat evn nirdhanta ke samay chhupa raha, to Allah bhi qayaamat ke din uski aavyashyakta, zaroorat aur mohtaaji ke samay saamne nahin ayega.

Abu maryam azdi se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki main muaawiya (radiyallahu anhu) ke paas pahuncha to unhonne kaha : Ai amuk ke pita! Aapka aana kya hi aanandyak hai! -yeh aisa waaky hai jiska prayog arab karte hain- to mainne kaha ki mainne ek hadees sun rakhi hai, use main aapko sunaana chaahta hoon. Mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko farmaate hue suna hai : “Jisko sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne musalmaanon ke maamlon ka zimmewaar banaya tatha woh unki aavyashyakta, zaroorat evn nirdhanta ke samay chhupa raha, to Allah bhi qayaamat ke din uski aavyashyakta, zaroorat aur mohtaaji ke samay saamne nahin ayega.” woh kahte hain ki iske baad muaawiya -radiyallahu anhu- ne logon ki zaroorten sunne ke liye ek vyakti ko niyukt kar diya.
[ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64689: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sall- ne kisi phaisle ke liye rishvat lene waale tatha dene waale donon ke oopar laanat bheji hai.
Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : "Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sall- ne kisi phaisle ke liye rishvat lene waale tatha dene waale donon ke oopar laanat bheji hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne rishvat dene aur lene waale ke haq mein Allah ki rahmat se dhutkaare aur door kiye jaane ki bad-dua ki hai.

Iske dayre mein nyayaadheeshon ko diya jaane waala woh ghoos bhi shaamil hai, jo unse ghalat tareeqe se kaam karvaane ke liye unko diya jaata hai.

Rishvat dena, lena, iske lene-dene mein madhyasth ki bhoomika nibhaana aur ismen madad karna haraam hai. Kyonki yeh ghalat kaary mein sahyog karan hai.
Rishvat dena aur lena kabeera gunaah hai, kyonki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne rishvat dene tatha lene waale par laanat ki hai.
Nyay tatha prashaasan se sanbandhit maamlon mein rishvat lena aur dena adhik bara apraadh evn paap hai. Kyonki yeh atyaachaar tatha Allah ki utaari hui shareeyat se hatkar nirnay dena hai.
[ise tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
64691: Kya main tumko na bataaoon ki sabse achchha gawaahi dene waala kaun hai? Woh vyakti jo poochhe jaane se pahle hi gawaahi de.

Zaid bin khaalid juhni (radiyallahu anhu) se riwayat hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Kya main tumko na bataaoon ki sabse achchha gawaahi dene waala kaun hai? Woh vyakti jo poochhe jaane se pahle hi gawaahi de.”
64693: Shahri ke liye dehaati ki gawaahi jayaz nahin.
Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko farmaate hue suna hai : “Shahri ke liye dehaati ki gawaahi jayaz nahin.”
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64695: Allah ke Rasool - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam - ne qasam tatha ek gawaah ke aadhaar par phai़sala farmaya.
Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool - sallallahu alaihi wa sallam - ne qasam tatha ek gawaah ke aadhaar par phai़sala farmaya.
64696: Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kuchh logon ko qasam khaane ko kaha, to sab log qasam khaane ki hor mein lag gae. Isliye aapne aadesh diya ki unke beech quraa andaazi ke dvaara tay kiya jaye ki kaun qasam khayega.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne kuchh logon ko qasam khaane ko kaha, to sab log qasam khaane ki hor mein lag gae. Isliye aapne aadesh diya ki unke beech quraa andaazi ke dvaara tay kiya jaye ki kaun qasam khayega.
64698: Jo vyakti mere is minbar ke paas koi jhoothi qasam khayega, chaahe ek hare misvaak ke liye hi kyon na ho, woh apna thikaana Jahannam mein bana le.

Jaabir bin abdullah -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Jo vyakti mere is minbar ke paas koi jhoothi qasam khayega, chaahe ek hare misvaak ke liye hi kyon na ho, woh apna thikaana Jahannam mein bana le ya uske liye Jahannam aniwaary ho gai.”
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise maalik ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64703: Jo shakhs kisi musalmaan ghulaam ko aazaad karega, to Allah aazaad kiye gae ghulaam ke shareer ke har ang ke badle uske shareer ka ek ang dozakh se aazaad karega.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Jo shakhs kisi musalmaan ghulaam ko aazaad karega, to Allah aazaad kiye gae ghulaam ke shareer ke har ang ke badle uske shareer ka ek ang dozakh se aazaad karega.”
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64706: Jo kisi mahram rishtedaar (daas) ka maalik ho, to woh (daas uske aazaad kiye bina) aazaad hai.
Samura -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Jo kisi mahram rishtedaar (daas) ka maalik ho, to woh (daas uske aazaad kiye bina) aazaad hai.”
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64708: Safeena -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki main umme salma -radiyallahu anha- ka ghulaam tha, to unhonne kaha : Main tujhko aazaad karti hoon is shart par ki tu jab tak jeewit rahega Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki sewa karta rahega.

Safeena -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki main umme salma -radiyallahu anha- ka ghulaam tha, to unhonne kaha : Main tujhko aazaad karti hoon is shart par ki tu jab tak jeewit rahega Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki sewa karta rahega. Mainne kaha : Yadi aap yeh shart nahin bhi lagaateen, to bhi main Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko jeewan bhar chhorne waala nahin hoon. So unhonne mujhe aazaad kar diya tatha yeh shart bhi rakhi.
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64709: Mukaatab (woh ghulaam jo apne maalik se yeh anubandh kar le ki kuchh paisa lekar woh usko aazaad kar dega) us samay tak ghulaam hai jab tak uske oopar us anubandh ka ek dirham bhi baaki hai.

Amr bin shuaib se riwayat hai, woh apne pita se tatha woh apne daada se riwayat karte hain ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Mukaatab (woh ghulaam jo apne maalik se yeh anubandh kar le ki kuchh paisa lekar woh usko aazaad kar dega) us samay tak ghulaam hai jab tak uske oopar us anubandh ka ek dirham bhi baaki hai.”
[ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64716: Muslim kaaphir ka waaris nahin ho sakta tatha kaaphir Muslim ka waaris nahin ho sakta.
Usaama bin zaid -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Muslim kaaphir ka waaris nahin ho sakta tatha kaaphir Muslim ka waaris nahin ho sakta.”

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki musalmaan evn kaafir ke beech uttaraadhikaar ka silsila nahin chalta. Iska kaaran yeh hai ki Islam ka sanbandh dharti ka sabse shaktishaali sanbandh hai. Atah jab nasbi rishtedaaron ke beech yeh pawitr sanbandh na rahe, to phir saare rishte chhinn-bhinn ho jaate hain. Aise mein khaandaani rishte ki shakti bhi vyarth ho jaati hai. Atah ek-doosre ke waaris banne ki koi gunjaaish nahin rahti, jo ki aapsi prem evn paraspar sahyog par aadhaarit hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64718: Do alag-alag dharmon ke log ek-doosre ke waaris nahin ban sakte.
Abdullah bin amr -radiyallahu anhuma- se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool- sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya :“Do alag-alag dharmon ke log ek-doosre ke waaris nahin ban sakte.”
[ise ibne maaja ne riwayat kiya hai . - ise abu daaood ne riwayat kiya hai. - ise ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai.]
64721: Jo vyakti koi bojh (karz athva aulaad ityaadi) chhor jaye, to woh Allah tatha uske Rasool ke zimme hai. Jabki jo vyakti koi maal chhor jaye, to woh uske waarison ke liye hai. Jiska koi waaris na ho, main uska waaris hoon. Main uski or se diyat ada karoonga tatha uska waaris banoonga. Maamoon uska waaris hai, jiska koi waaris na ho. Woh uski or se diyat ada karega tatha uska waaris banega.

Miqdaam -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Jo vyakti koi bojh (karz athva aulaad ityaadi) chhor jaye, to woh mere zimme hai.” aur kabhi farmaya : “Woh Allah tatha uske Rasool ke zimme hai. Jabki jo vyakti koi maal chhor jaye, to woh uske waarison ke liye hai. Jiska koi waaris na ho, main uska waaris hoon. Main uski or se diyat ada karoonga tatha uska waaris banoonga. Maamoon uska waaris hai, jiska koi waaris na ho. Woh uski or se diyat ada karega tatha uska waaris banega.”

64722: Jis bachche ne paida hote samay cheetkaar kiya, woh waaris banega.
Jaabir -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Jis bachche ne paida hote samay cheetkaar kiya, woh waaris banega.”

65000: Islam ki buniyaad paanch cheezon par qayam hai

Abdullah bin amar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Islam ki buniyaad paanch cheezon par qayam hai : Is baat ki gawaahi dena ki Allah ke atirikt koi saty poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke Rasool hain, namaz sthaapit karna, zakat dena, Hajj karna aur Ramzan maas ke roze rakhna."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne Islam ko paanch stanbhon par khare ek bhawan ke samaan darshaya hai. Yaad rahe ki Islam ke shesh kaam is bhawan ke poorak ki bhoomika rakhte hain. In paanch stanbhon mein se pahla stanbh is baat ki gawaahi dena hai ki Allah ke atirikt koi saty poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke Rasool hain. Yeh donon gawaahiyaan ek-doosre se juri hui hain aur ek hi stanbh ki haisiyat rakhti hain. Banda inka uchchaaran Allah ke ek hone aur bas usi ke ibaadat ka haqdaar hone ko sveekaar karte hue, unke taqaajon (maangon) par amal karte hue, Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke Rasool hone ka wishvaas rakhte hue aur aapka anusran karte hue karega. Doosra stanbh namaz sthaapit karna hai. Din aur raat mein paanch farz namaazen hain. Fajr, zuhar, asr, maghrib tatha isha. In paanch namaazon ko inki sharton, stanbhon aur aniwaary kaaryon ke saath ada kiya jayega. Teesra stanbh farz zakat nikaalna hai. Zakat ek aarthik ibaadat hai, jo shareeyat dvaara dhan ki ek nirdhaarit maatra par waajib hoti hai aur jise uske haqdaaron ko diya jaata hai. Chautha stanbh Hajj hai. Hajj kuchh nishchit kaaryo ko Allah ki ibaadat ke taur par karne ke liye makka jaane ka iraada karne ka naam hai. Paanchvaan stanbh Ramzan ke roze rakhna hai. Roza naam hai khaane, peene aur is tarah ki any roza torne waali cheezon se fajr prakat hone se lekar sooraj doobne tak Allah ki ibaadat ki neeyat se ruke rahne ka.

Donon gawaahiyaan ek-doosre ke saath aniwaary roop se juri hui hain. Inmen se ek ko chhor diya jaye, to doosri sahi nahin hogi. Isi liye donon ko ek stanbh banaya gaya hai.
Yeh donon gawaahiyaan deen ki buniyaad hain. Inke bina koi kathan athva kaary grahan yogy nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65001: Tummen se jo vyakti koi ghalat kaam dekhe, woh use apne haath se badal de. Agar haath se badal nahin sakta, to zabaan se badle. Agar zabaan se badal nahin sakta, to apne dil se bura jaane. Yeh eemaan ki sabse nichli shreni hai.

Abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki maiैnneे Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Tummen se jo vyakti koi ghalat kaam dekhe, woh use apne haath se badal de. Agar haath se badal nahin sakta, to zabaan se badle. Agar zabaan se badal nahin sakta, to apne dil se bura jaane. Yeh eemaan ki sabse nichli shreni hai."

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apni kshamta anusaar buraai ko badalne ka aadesh de rahe hain. Buraai se muraad har woh kaary hai, jisse Allah aur uske Rasool ne mana kiya hai. Agar insaan koi buraai dekhe aur uske paas use haath se badalne ki shakti ho, to uske oopar use haath se badalna waajib hai. Agar haath se badalne ki shakti na ho, to apni zabaan se badle. Iska tareeqa yeh hai ki use karne se mana kare, uska nuqsaan bataye aur uske badle mein kisi achchhe kaam ka updesh de. Agar zabaan kholne ki bhi shakti na ho, to apne dil se badle. Yaani us buraai ko bura jaane aur iraada rakhe ki agar use badalne ki shakti a jaye, to badal dega. Buraai ko badle ke sanbandh mein dil se badalna eemaan ki sab se nichli shreni hai.

Yeh hadees buraai ko badalne ke wibhinn staron ko bataati hai.
Is hadees mein buraai ko badalne ka kaam apni kshamta evn shakti anusaar karne ka aadesh diya gaya hai.
Buraai se rokna ek bahut bara kaam hai. Kisi ko bhi ise chhorne ki anumti nahin hai. Har musalmaan ko apni kshamta anusaar yeh kaam karna hai.
Bhalaai ka aadesh dena aur buraai se rokna eemaan ki shaakhaaon mein se ek shaakha hai. Eemaan ghatta tatha barhta hai.
Kisi bure kaam se rokne ke liye us kaam ke bura hone ka jnaan hona shart hai.
Buraai se rokne ki ek shart yeh hai ki rokne ke kaaran usse bari buraai saamne na aye.
Buraai se rokne ke kuchh niyam aur sharten hain. Ek musalmaan ko unhen seekh lena chahiye.
Buraai ke khandan ke liye sharai neeti, jnaan aur antardrishti ki aawashyakta hoti hai.
Dil se bhi khandan na karna eemaan ke kamzor hone ki daleel hai.
65002: Jisne Islam ki haalat mein achchhe kaam kiye hain, jaahiliyat ke gunaahon par uski pakar nahin hogi aur jo aadmi islaam ko tyaag kar dobaara kaaphir ho gaya, to pahle aur baad ke sabhi  gunaahon ki pakar hogi.

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain : Ek aadmi ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Hamne jo gunaah jaahiliyat ke zamaane mein kiye hain, kya unpar hamaari pakar hogi? Aapne pharmaya : "Jisne Islam ki haalat mein achchhe kaam kiye hain, jaahiliyat ke gunaahon par uski pakar nahin hogi aur jo aadmi islaam ko tyaag kar dobaara kaaphir ho gaya, to pahle aur baad ke sabhi  gunaahon ki pakar hogi."

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne Islam mein prawesh karne ki fazeelat bataai hai. Jisne Islam grahan kiya aur ek pakka-sachcha tatha achchha musalmaan ban gaya, uske jaahiliyat ke zamaane mein kiye hue gunaahon ki pakar nahin hogi. Iske wipreet jisne Islam grahan karne ke baad ise tyaag diya, maslan munaafiq raha ya apne deen ka parityaag kar diya, uske Islam laane ke baad ke gunaahon ke saath-saath pahle kiye hue gunaahon ki bhi pakar hogi.

Sahaaba un kaaryon ke baare mein dare hue rahte the, jo unse jaahiliyat ke zamaane mein hue the.
Ismen Islam par mazbooti ke saath jame rahne ki prerna di gai hai.
Islam grahan karne ka mahatv, evn yeh ki Islam pichhle gunaahon ko mita deta hai.
Islam grahan karne ke baad uska parityaag kar dene waale vyakti aur musalmaan hone ka dikhaawa karne tatha andar mein kufr chhupaakar rakhne waale vyakti se Islam grahan karne ke baad kiye hue gunaahon ke saath-saath usse pahle ke gunaahon ki bhi pakar hogi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65003: Is baare mein aapka kya kahna hai ki agar main paanch waqt ki farz namaazen parhoon, Ramzan maheene ke roze rakhoon tatha halaal ko halaal evn haraam ko haraam

Jaabir radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki : Ek vyakti ne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se prashn karte hue kaha : Is baare mein aapka kya kahna hai ki agar main paanch waqt ki farz namaazen parhoon, Ramzan maheene ke roze rakhoon tatha halaal ko halaal evn haraam ko haraam maankar chaloon aur isse adhik kuchh na karoon, to kya main Jannat mein prawesh kar sakoonga? Aapne uttar diya : "Haan." Ispar usne kaha : Allah ki qasam, main isse zyaada kuchh nahin karoonga.

Is hadees mein Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jisne paanch waqt ki farz namaazen parheen tatha nafal namaazen nahin parheen, Ramzan ke roze rakhe aur nafal roze nahin rakhe, halaal ko halaal maana aur uspar amal kiya tatha haraam ko haraam maana aur usse door raha, woh Jannat mein prawesh karega.

Ek musalmaan ko farz kaamon ko karna aur haraam kaamon se door rahna chahiye aur uska uddeshy Jannat mein prawesh karna hona chahiye.
Is hadees se halaal kaamon ko karne aur unke halaal hone ka wishvaas rakhne tatha haraam kaamon se door rahne aur unke haraam hone ka wishvaas rakhne ka mahatv maaloom hota hai.
Waajib (aniwaary) kaaryon ko karna aur haraam kaaryon se bachna Jannat mein prawesh praapt karne ka sabab hai.
65004: Pawitrata aadha eemaan hai, al-hamdu lillah taraazu ko bhar deta hai, subhaanallah aur al-hamdu lillah donon milkar aakaash evn dharti ke beech ke khaali sthaan ko bhar dete hain

Abu maalik ashaari radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Pawitrata aadha eemaan hai, al-hamdu lillah taraazu ko bhar deta hai, subhaanallah aur al-hamdu lillah donon milkar aakaash evn dharti ke beech ke khaali sthaan ko bhar dete hain, namaz noor hai, sadqa pramaan hai, dhairy prakaash hai aur Qur'an tumhaare liye ya tumhaare wiruddh pramaan hai. Pratyek vyakti jab rozi ki khoj mein subah nikalta hai, to apne nafs ko bechta hai. Chunaanche woh use aazaad karta hai ya uska winaash karta hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki zaahiri shareer ki tahaarat (pawitrata) wazu evn ghusl (snaan) ke dvaara praapt hoti hai. Tahaarat namaz ki ek shart hai. Al-hamdu lillah, jo ki Allah ki prashansa karna aur use sanpoornata par aadhaarit gunon se paripoorn maanna hai, ise kahna qayaamat ke din wazan kiya jayega aur yeh karmon ke taraazu ko bhar dega. Subhaanallah tatha al-hamdu lillah, jo ki daraasal Allah ko har kami se pawitr ghoshit karna aur use sanpoornata ke aise gunon se paripoorn maanna hai, jo uske prataap ke anuroop hain, in donon waakyon ko kahna aur saath mein Allah se prem tatha uska sammaan karna, aakaashon evn zameen ke beech ke sthaan ko bhar deta hai. Namaz bande ke liye noor hai, jo uske dil mein maujood rahta hai, uske chehre par prakat hota hai, uski qabr ko raushan rakhta hai aur dobaara jeewit hokar uthte samay uska saath dega. Sadqa bande ke sachche momin hone ka pramaan hai, aur uske munaafiq se alag hone ka pramaan hai, jo sadqa ke pratiphal par wishvaas na hone ke kaaran sadqa nahin karta. Sabr (dhairy) prakaash hai. Sabr, adheer hone aur naaraaz hone se bachne ka naam hai. Noor aise prakaash ko kahte hain, jismen garmi aur jalaane ki wisheshta hoti hai. Jaise sooraj ka prakaash. Sabr ko noor isliye kaha gaya hai ki sabr karna ek kathin kaary hai aur iske liye nafs se larne aur use uski pasand se rokne ki zaroorat hoti hai. Sabr karne waala insaan hamesha sachchaai ke aalokit maarg par chalta rahta hai. Yahaan sabr se muraad uske teenon prakaar yaani Allah ke aajnaapaalan par date rahna, uski awajna se bachte rahna aur museebton tatha duniya ke haadson (durghatnaaon) ka dhairy ke saath muqaabla karna hai. Qur'an ki tilaawat aur usmen likhi hui baaton ka anupaalan tumhaare liye daleel hai. Jabki Qur'an par amal na karna ya uski tilaawat na karna tumhaare wiruddh daleel hai. Phir Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki saare log jab neend se jaagte hain, wibhinn kaaryon ke liye apne  gharon nikal parte hain. Aise mein kuchh log Allah ki aajnaaon ka paalan karke khud ko aag se aazaad kar lete hain. Jabki kuchh log isse wichlit ho jaate hain, gunaahon mein par jaate hain aur aag mein prawesh karne ka saamaan karke khud ko winasht kar lete hain.

Tahaarat ke do prakaar hain. Ek zaahiri (pratyaksh) tahaarat, jo wazu evn snaan se praapt hoti hai aur doosra baatini (paroksh) tahaarat, jo tauheed (ekeshvarvaad), eemaan aur achchhe karm se praapt hoti hai.
Namaz ki paabandi karne ka mahatv. Kyonki namaz bande ke liye duniya mein tatha qayaamat ke din prakaash hai.
Sadqa sachche eemaan ka pramaan hai.
Qur'an par amal karne aur use sachchi kitaab maanne ka mahatv. Isse Qur'an insaan ke paksh mein pramaan ban jaata hai. Uske wiruddh nahin.
Nafs (aatma, man) agar Allah ke aajnaapaalan mein na lagaya jaye, woh insaan ko Allah ki awajna mein laga deta hai.
Har insaan koi na koi kaam zaroor karta hai. Kaam chaahe Allah ko raazi karne waala ho, jo use Jahannam se mukti pradaan karta hai ya use naaraaz karne waala, jo uska winaash kar deta hai.
Sabr ke liye sahan shakti tatha aatm moolyaankan ki zaroorat hoti hai, jo ki ek kathin kaary hai.
65005: Sun lo, woh samay aane hi waala hai ki ek vyakti ke paas meri hadees pahunchegi aur woh apne bistar par tek lagaakar baitha hoga. Hadees sunne ke baad woh kahega : Hamaare aur tumhaare beech Allah ki kitaab hai

Miqdaam bin maadeekrib radiyallahu anhu bayaan karte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Sun lo, woh samay aane hi waala hai ki ek vyakti ke paas meri hadees pahunchegi aur woh apne bistar par tek lagaakar baitha hoga. Hadees sunne ke baad woh kahega : Hamaare aur tumhaare beech Allah ki kitaab hai. Ismen ham jo halaal payenge use halaal jaanenge aur ismen jo haraam payenge use haraam jaanenge. Haalaanki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki haraam ki hui cheez bhi Allah ki haraam ki hui cheez ki tarah hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki woh samay nikat hai, jab ek prakaar ke log samaane ayenge, jinmen se ek vyakti apne bistar par tek lagaakar baitha hoga aur is awastha mein jab uske paas Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki koi hadees pahunchegi, to kahega : Hamaare aur tumhaare beech nirnay ke liye Allah ki kitaab hai, yahi hamaare liye kaafi hai. Ismen jo cheezen ham halaal payenge, ham unpar amal karenge aur ismen jo cheezen ham haraam payenge, unse door rahenge. Phir Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki aapne apni sunnat mein jin cheezon ko haraam kaha hai ya jin cheezon se mana kiya hai, woh saari cheezen daraasal Allah ki kitaab mein haraam ki hui cheezon ki hi tarah hain. Kyonki aapka kaam aapke rab ke sandesh ko pahunchaana hi tha.

Qur'an ki tarah hadees ka bhi sammaan kiya jaana chahiye aur uspar bhi amal kiya jaana chahiye.
Rasool ka aajnaapaalan daraasal Allah ka aajnaapaalan hai aur Rasool ki awajna Allah ki awajna hai.
Is hadees se sunnat ke pramaan hone ka soobat milta hai aur un logon ka khandan ho jaata hai, jo sunnat ko thukraate ya uska inkaar karte hain.
Jisne sunnat se munh phera aur kewal Qur'an par amal karne ka daawa kiya, usne daraasal donon se munh phera aur Qur'an ke anupaalan ka uska daawa jhootha hai.
Aapke Nabi hone ka ek pramaan yeh bhi hai ki aapne kisi baat ki bhawishyawaani ki aur woh baat saamne a bhi gai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi aur ibn-e-maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
65007: Bandon par Allah ka adhikaar yeh hai ki bande uski ibaadat karen aur kisi ko uska saajhi na banayen. Jabki Allah par bandon ka adhikaar yeh hai ki Allah kisi aise vyakti ko azaab na de, jo kisi ko uska saajhi na thahraata ho

Muaaz radiyallahu anhu kahte hain : Main Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke peechhe ek gadhe par baitha hua tha, jiska naam ufair tha. Isi dauraan aapne kaha : "Ai muaaz! Kya tum jaante ho ki bandon par Allah ka adhikaar kya hai aur Allah par bandon ka adhikaar kya hai?" Mainne kaha : Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain. Aapne kaha : "Bandon par Allah ka adhikaar yeh hai ki bande uski ibaadat karen aur kisi ko uska saajhi na banayen. Jabki Allah par bandon ka adhikaar yeh hai ki Allah kisi aise vyakti ko azaab na de, jo kisi ko uska saajhi na thahraata ho." Mainne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya main logon ko yeh susmaachaar suna na doon? Aapne uttar diya : "Yeh susmaachaar logon ko na sunaao, warna log bharosa karke baith jayenge."

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki bandon par Allah ka kya adhikaar hai aur Allah par bandon ka kya adhikaar hai. Aapne bataya ki bandon par Allah ka adhikaar yeh hai ki bande akele usi ki ibaadat karen aur kisi ko uska saajhi na banayen. Jabki Allah par bandon ka adhikaar yeh hai ki Allah aise ekeshvarvaadi logon ko azaab na de, jo kisi ko uska saajhi na banaate hon. Yeh sun muaaz raziyallah anhu ne kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Kya main logon ko yeh susmaachaar suna na doon, taaki we Allah ke is anugrah par khush ho jayen? Chunaanche Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is bhay ke dekhte hue unko aisa karne se mana kar diya ki kaheen log isi par bharosa karke baith na jayen.

Allah ke us adhikaar ka bayaan, jise usne apne bandon par waajib kiya. Woh adhikaar yeh hai ki bande kewal usi ki ibaadat karen aur kisi ko uska saajhi na banayen.
Allah par bandon ke us adhikaar ka bayaan, jise Allah ne apne anugrah se apne oopar waajib kar rakha hai. Woh adhikaar yeh hai ki Allah aise bandon ko Jannat pradaan kare tatha yaatna ka saamna karne na de, jo kisi ko uska saajhi na banaate hon.
Is hadees mein aise ekeshvarvaadi logon ke liye bahut bara susmaachaar hai, jo kisi ko Allah ka saajhi nahin banaate. Susmaachaar yeh hai ki Allah aise logon ko Jannat pradaan karega.
Muaaz radiyallahu anhu ne mrityu se pahle is bhay se yeh hadees bata di ki kaheen jnaan chhupaane ka gunaah na uthaana pare.
Yeh nirdesh ki kuchh hadeeson ko kuchh aise logon ko bataana nahin chahiye, jinke baare mein is baat ka dar ho ki woh uska matlab samajh nahin payenge. Lekin yeh baat un hadeeson par laagu hogi, jinke andar kisi amal ya kisi sharai dand ka zikr na ho.
Awajnaakaari ekeshvarvaadi log Allah ki ichchha ke adheen honge.  Woh chaahe to unko yaatna de aur chaahe to maaf kar de aur phir unka thikaana Jannat ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65008: Jo is haal mein mara ki kisi ko Allah ka saajhi nahin banaya, woh Jannat mein prawesh karega aur jo is haal mein mara ki kisi ko Allah ka saajhi banaata raha, woh Jahannam mein jayega.

Jaabir radiyallahu anhu kahte hain : Ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya aur poochha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Do waajib karne waali cheezen kya hain? Aapne uttar diya : "Jo is haal mein mara ki kisi ko Allah ka saajhi nahin banaya, woh Jannat mein prawesh karega aur jo is haal mein mara ki kisi ko Allah ka saajhi banaata raha, woh Jahannam mein jayega."

Ek vyakti ne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se do aisi baaton ke baare mein poochha, jo Jannat mein prawesh ya Jahannam mein prawesh ko aniwaary karti hain. Aapne uttar diya ki Jannat aniwaary karne waali baat yeh hai ki insaan is haalat mein mare ki kewal ek Allah ki ibaadat karta ho aur kisi ko uska saajhi na banaata ho. Jabki Jahannam mein prawesh ko aniwaary karne waali baat yeh hai ki insaan is haalat mein mare ki kisi ko poojy banaakar, paalanhaar samajhkar ya use Allah ke naam tatha wisheshtayen pradaan karke uska saajhi banaata ho.

Tauheed (ekeshvarvaad) ki fazeelat aur is baat ka spasht ullekh ki jo vyakti eemaan ki haalat mein is tarah marega ki kisi ko Allah ka saajhi nahin banayega, woh Jannat mein prawesh kerga.
Shirk ki bhayaawahta tatha is baat ka spasht ullekh ki jo vyakti kisi ko Allah ka saajhi banaate hue marega, woh Jahannam mein jayega.
Awajnaakaari ekeshvarvaadi log Allah ki ichchha ke adheen honge.  Allah agar chaahega, to unko azaab dega aur agar chaahega, to unko maaf kar dega aur phir unka thikaana Jannat hoga.
65009: Usne kabhi yeh nahin kaha : Ai mere rab! Pratiphal ke din mere gunaah maaf kar dena.

Aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Ibn-e-judaaan jaahiliyat ke zamaane mein rishte-naaton ka khyaal rakhta tha aur nirdhanon ko khaana khilaata tha. Kya yeh baaten uske liye laabhkaari siddh hongi? Aapne kaha : "In kaamon ka use koi laabh nahin milega. Usne kabhi yeh nahin kaha : Ai mere rab! Pratiphal ke din mere gunaah maaf kar dena."

Ibne-e-judaaan Islam se pahle quraish ka ek sardaar tha. Usne kai achchhe kaam kiye the. Jaise rishte-naaton ka khayaal rakhta tha aur nirdhanon ko khaana khilaata tha. Woh is tarah ke kai any kaam bhi kiya karta tha, jinki prerna khud Islam ne bhi di hai. Aapne uske baare mein bataya ki yeh kaam aakhirat mein uske liye kuchh laabhkaari nahin honge. Iska kaaran yeh hai ki uska Allah par wishvaas nahin tha aur usne kabhi nahin kaha tha ki ai mere rab! Qayaamat ke din mere gunaahon ko maaf kar dena.

Eemaan ki fazeelat ka bayaan tatha yeh ki eemaan karmon ko grahan yogy hone ke liye shart hai.
Kuphr (awishvaas) ke manhoos hone ka bayaan tatha yeh ki awishvaas insaan ke achchhe karmon ko nasht kar deta hai.
Awishvaasiyon ko aakhirat mein unke karmon ka koi laabh nahin milega. Kyonki we Allah aur aakhirat ke din par eemaan nahin rakhte.
Kufr ki haalat mein kiye gae insaan ke aamaal, uske Islam grahan kar lene ki awastha mein uske haq mein likhe jaate hain aur use unka pratiphal bhi diya jaata hai.
65010: Kya tumhen maaloom hai ki tumhaare rab ne kya kaha?” logon ne kaha : Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain. (Aapne farmaya ki Allah ne) farmaya : “Mere bandon mein se kuchh ne mujhpar eemaan laane waale aur kuchh ne kufr karne waale bankar subah ki
