Zaid bin khaalid juhni radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain : Hudaibiya mein raat mein baarish hone ke baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne hamen lekar fajr ki namaz ada ki. Salaam pherne ke baad logon ki or munh karke farmaya : “Kya tumhen maaloom hai ki tumhaare rab ne kya kaha?” logon ne kaha : Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain. (Aapne farmaya ki Allah ne) farmaya : “Mere bandon mein se kuchh ne mujhpar eemaan laane waale aur kuchh ne kufr karne waale bankar subah ki. Jisne kaha ki Allah ki kripa wa rahmat se hampar baarish hui to woh mujhpar eemaan laane waala aur nakshatron ko nakaarne waala hai aur jisne kaha ki amuk-amuk nakshatron ke kaaran hampar baarish hui to woh mere saath kufr karne waala aur nakshatron par eemaan laane waala thahra.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne hudaibiya ke sthaan par subah ki namaz parhi. Hudaibiya makka ke nikat ek basti ka naam hai. Us din raat ko baarish hui thi. Jab aapne namaz poori kar li aur salaam phera to logon ki or munh kiya aur unse poochha : Kya tum jaante ho ki tumhaare sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan rab ne kya kaha hai? Logon ne uttar diya : Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain. Yeh sun aapne kaha : Allah ne bataya hai ki warsha hote samay log do prakaar mein bant jaate hain. Kuchh log Allah par wishvaas rakhte hain aur kuchh log uske prati awishvaas vyakt karte hain. Aise mein jisne kaha ki hamen Allah ke anugrah aur uski daya se baarish mili aur is tarah usne baarish dene waala Allah ko maana, woh Allah par wishvaas rakhne waala hai aur nakshatron ke prati awishvaas vyakt karne waala hai. Iske wipreet jisne kaha ki hamen amuk nakshatr ke kaaran baarish mili, woh Allah ke prati awishvaas vyakt karne waala aur nakshatr par wishvaas rakhne waala hai. Yaad rahe ki is tarah se nakshatr ki or baarish ki nisbat karna chhota kufr hai, kyonki Allah ne nakshatr ko baarish ka sharai evn saansaarik sabab nahin banaya hai. Lekin jisne baarish hone aadi laukik ghatnaaon ka sanbandh yeh samajhkar nakshatron ke nikalne ya doobne ki se jora ki yahi waastawik kaarak hain, to woh bara kufr karne waala hai.

Baarish hone ke baad yeh kahna musathab hai ki hamen Allah ke anugrah aur uski rahmat se baarish mili.
Jisne baarish barsaane aadi ghatnaaon ka sanbandh nakshatron se jora aur unko in ghatnaaon ka kaarak maana, usne bara kufr kiya. Lekin agar use kewal sabab maana, to usne chhota shirk kiya, kyonki yeh na to sharai sabab hai aur na bhautik.
Nemat ki jab naashukri ho, to woh awishvaas ka sabab ban jaati hai aur jab uska shukr ada kiya jaye, to woh eemaan ka sabab ban jaati hai.
Yeh kahna mana hai ki hamen amuk nakshatr ke kaaran baarish mili, chaahe isse muraad samay hi kyon na liya gaya ho. Aisa daraasal shirk ka dvaar band karne ke liye kiya gaya hai.
Nemton ki praapti aur apriy cheezon se bachaav ke sanbandh mein dil ka sanbandh Allah se hona zaroori hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65011: Ham apne dilon mein aisi baaten paate hain, jinko bolna hamen bahut bara (gunaah) lagta hai. Yeh sun aapne kaha : "Kya tum sachmuch aisa mahsoos karte ho?" Unhonne kaha : Awashy mahsoos karte hain. Aapne kaha : "Yahi spasht eemaan hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke kuchh saathi aapke paas aye aur aapse poochha : Ham apne dilon mein aisi baaten paate hain, jinko bolna hamen bahut bara (gunaah) lagta hai. Yeh sun aapne kaha : "Kya tum sachmuch aisa mahsoos karte ho?" Unhonne kaha : Awashy mahsoos karte hain. Aapne kaha : "Yahi spasht eemaan hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saathiyon ka ek samooh aapke paas aya aur poochha ki we apne dilon mein kuchh aisi bhayaanak baaten paate hain, jo itni galat tatha ghrinit hoti hain ki we unhen bayaan nahin kar sakte. Yeh sunkar Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Tumhaare dil mein paai jaane waali yahi baat to spasht eemaan aur wishvaas hai, jo tumhen shaitaan dvaara dil ke andar daali gai baat ko na maanne aur use bolne se bachne ki prerna deta hai tatha usi ke kaaran tumhaare dilon mein yeh baat bahut bari maaloom hoti hai. Tumhaare andar is prakaar ke bhaav ka paya jaana is baat ka pramaan hai ki shaitaan tumpar haawi nahin hai. Agar woh tumpar haawi ho jaata, to tumhen is tarah ka khayaal wichlit na karta.

Eemaan waalon ke saamne shaitaan kamzor dikhaai parta hai aur dil ke andar bure khayaal daalne se aage nahin barh paata.
Dil ke andar bure khayaalon ki pushti aur unko sveekaar karne se bachna chahiye, kyonki is prakaar ke khayaal shaitaan ki or se dil mein daale jaate hain.
Shaitaan ke dvaara dil ke andar daale jaane waale bure khayaalon se eemaan waalon ko koi haani nahin hoti hai. Lekin iske baavjood use is tarah ke khayaalon se Allah ki sharan maangni chahiye aur is prakaar ki baaten sochne se bachna chahiye.
Ek musalmaan ko deen ke sanbandh mein aane waali kathinaaiyon ke baare mein khaamosh nahin rahna chahiye. Use is tarah ki cheezon ke baare mein poochh lena chahiye.
65012: Saari prashansa Allah ki hai, jisne shaitaan ke fareb ko bure khayaal ki or pher diya.

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma se warnit hai, woh kahte hain : Eki vyakti Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aya aur kahne laga : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Ham mein se ek vyakti apne dil mein aisi baaten paata hai (woh ishaare mein baat kar raha tha) ki koyla ban jaana unko bolne se adhik priy lagta hai. Yeh sun Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Allah sabse bara hai. Allah sabse bara hai. Saari prashansa Allah ki hai, jisne shaitaan ke fareb ko bure khayaal ki or pher diya."

Ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya aur kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Ham mein se kisi-kisi ke dil mein aisi baaten aajaati hain, jiske baare mein baat karna itna kathin hai ki raakh ban jaana use bolne se priy lagta hai. Yeh sun Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne do baar Allahu akbar kaha aur Allah ki prashansa ki ki usne shaitaan ke shadyantr ko bure khayaal tak hi seemit rakh diya.

Shaitaan ko jaise hi avsar milta hai, eemaan waalon ke dilon mein bure khayaal daal deta hai, taaki unko eemaan ke maarg se hataakar awishvaas ke maarg par laga sake.
Eemaan waalon ke saamne shaitaan kamzor par jaata hai. Woh dil ke andar bure khayaal daalne se aage nahin barh paata.
Momin ko shaitaan ke dvaara dil mein daale gae bure khayaalon ko asveekaar karna aur unka muqaabla karna chahiye.
Koi achchhi cheez nazar aane par ya kisi baat par aashchary hone par Allahu akbar kahna chahiye.
Ek musalmaan ko jo bhi baat samajh mein na aye, jaankaar logon se uske baare mein poochh lena chahiye.
[ise abu daawood ne tatha nasai ne al-kubra mein riwayat kiya hai]
65013: Shaitaan tum mein se kisi vyakti ke paas aata hai aur kahta hai : Is cheez ko kisne paida kiya? Is cheez ko kisne paida kiya? Yahaan tak ki woh kahta hai : Tere rab ko kisne paida kiya? Jab is had tak pahunch jaye, to Allah ki sharan maange aur is tarah ki baaten sochna band kar de.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu bayaan karte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Shaitaan tum mein se kisi vyakti ke paas aata hai aur kahta hai : Is cheez ko kisne paida kiya? Is cheez ko kisne paida kiya? Yahaan tak ki woh kahta hai : Tere rab ko kisne paida kiya? Jab is had tak pahunch jaye, to Allah ki sharan maange aur is tarah ki baaten sochna band kar de."

Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam un prashnon ka achook ilaaj bata rahe hain, jo shaitaan eemaan waalon ke dilon mein daalta hai. Maslan shaitaan kahta hai ki amuk cheez ko kisne banaya? Amuk cheez ko kisne banaya? Aakaash ko kisne banaya? Dharti ko kisne banaya? Jawaab mein ek eemaan waala vyakti deeni, praakritik aur taarkik jawaab dete hue kahega ki Allah. Lekin shaitaan itne tak hi nahin rukta, balki aage barhte hue kahta hai ki tumhaare rab ko kisne paida kiya? Jab shaitaan is had tak pahunch jaata hai, to ek eemaan waala vyakti isse bachaav ke liye teen kaary karta hai :

Allah par eemaan laana.

Shaitaan se Allah ki sharan maangna.

Is tarah ke bure khayaalon ko aane dene se bachna.

Shaitaan dvaara dil ke andar daale gae bure khayaalon ko upekshit karna, unpar dhiyaan na dena, aur Allah se unko door karne ki praarthana karna.
Insaan ke dil mein aane waale sabhi shareeyat wirodhi khayaalaat shaitaan ki or se daale jaate hain.
Allah ki zaat ke baare mein wichaar-wimarsh karne ki manaahi aur uski srishtiyon tatha nishaaniyon par wichaar-wimarsh karne ki prerna.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65015: Allah kisi momin ke dvaara kiye gae kisi achchhe kaam ke mahatv ko ghataata nahin hai. Momin ko uske achchhe kaam ke badle mein duniya mein nemten pradaan ki jaati hain aur aakhirat mein pratiphal diya jaata hai

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Allah kisi momin ke dvaara kiye gae kisi achchhe kaam ke mahatv ko ghataata nahin hai. Momin ko uske achchhe kaam ke badle mein duniya mein nemten pradaan ki jaati hain aur aakhirat mein pratiphal diya jaata hai. Jabki kaafir ko uske dvaara Allah ke liye kiye gae achchhe kaamon ke badle mein duniya mein aajeewika pradaan kar di jaati hai, yahaan tak ki jab woh aakhirat ki or prasthaan karta hai, uske paas koi achchha kaam nahin hota, jiska use badla diya jaye."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam eemaan waalon par Allah ke mahaan anugrah aur kaafiron ke saath uske nyay ko bayaan kar rahe hain. Jahaan tak momin ki baat hai, to uske achchhe karm ka sawaab dene mein koi kami nahin ki jaati, balki uske badle mein use duniya mein neki pradaan ki jaati hai aur aakhirat ke liye bhi pratiphal ekatr karke rakh diya jaata hai. Kabhi-kabhi aisa bhi hota hai ki poore badle ko aakhirat ke liye surakshit rakh diya jaata hai. Jabki iske wipreet kaafir ko uske dvaara kiye gae achchhe kaamon ka badla duniya hi mein de diya jaata hai. Yahaan tak ki jab aakhirat ke liye parasthaan karta hai to wahaan usko dene ke liye koi sawaab (pratiphal) nahin bachta hai. Kyonki kisi bhi achchhe kaary ke pratiphal ko donon lokon mein praapt karne ke liye eemaan waala hona aniwaary hai.
Jiski mrityu kufr ki awastha mein hui use kisi bhi achchhe amal ka koi laabh nahin milega.
65016: Tum apni pichhli nekiyon ke saath musalmaan hue ho.

Hakeem bin hizaam radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Jaahiliyat ke zamaane mein ibaadat ki neeyat se jo sadqa deta tha ya gulaam aazaad karta tha aur rishtedaaron ke saath achchha bartaav karta tha, aap batayen ki unka koi sawaab hoga? Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Tum apni pichhli nekiyon ke saath musalmaan hue ho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki kaafir jab musalmaan ho jaata hai, to Islam grahan karne se pahle kiye gae uske achchhe kaamon, jaise sadqa karna, gulaam aazaad karna aur rishtedaaron ke saath achchha bartaav karna aadi ka use badla diya jayega.
Duniya mein kiye hue kaafir ke achchhe karmon ka pratiphal use aakhirat mein nahin milega, agar woh kufr ki awastha mein mar jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65018: Mujhse Islam ke baare mein ek aisi baat kahen, jiske baare mein mujhe kisi aur se poochhne ki zaroorat na pare. Aapne farmaya : "Tum kaho ki main Allah par eemaan laya aur phir ispar mazbooti se qayam raho.

Sufyaan bin abdullah saqfi ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mujhse Islam ke baare mein ek aisi baat kahen, jiske baare mein mujhe kisi aur se poochhne ki zaroorat na pare. Aapne farmaya : "Tum kaho ki main Allah par eemaan laya aur phir ispar mazbooti se qayam raho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke ek saathi sufyaan bin abdullah ne aapse aagrah kiya ki aap unko ek aisi baat sikha den, jiske andar poore Islam ka nichor a jaye, taaki woh use mazbooti se pakar len aur uske baare mein kisi doosre se poochhne ki zaroorat na pare. Chunaanche aapne unse kaha : Tum bas itna kah do ki mainne Allah ko ek maana aur uske rab, poojy, srishtikarta aur akela ibaadat ke layaq hone par eemaan laya. Phir uske baad Allah ke bataye hue raaste par chalte hue jeewan vyateet karo, Allah ke dvaara aniwaary kaaryon ka paalan karo aur uski haraam ki hui cheezon se bacho.

Asal deen Allah ke rab evn poojy hone tatha uske naamon evn gunon par eemaan rakhna hai.
Eemaan ke baad Allah ke deen par qayam rahne aur nirantarta ke saath ibaadat karne ka mahatv.
Amal ke qabool hone ke liye eemaan shart hai.
Allah par eemaan ke andar eemaan se juri hui woh buniyaadi baaten, jinpar wishvaas rakhna zaroori hai aur unke antargat aane waale hriday ke aamaal tatha zaahiri evn baatini taur par samarpan aur anusran sab shaamil hain.
Hadees mein aye hue shabd "الاستقامةُ" Ka arth hai, aniwaary cheezon ka paalan karte hue aur mana ki hui cheezon se bachte hue seedhe raaste par chalte rahna.
[ise Muslim aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
65019: Munaafiq ki misaal do revron ke beech chakkar lagaane waali bakri ki jaisi hai, jo ek baar is rewar ki or jaati hai, to ek baar us rewar ki or.

Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Munaafiq ki misaal do revron ke beech chakkar lagaane waali bakri ki jaisi hai, jo ek baar is rewar ki or jaati hai, to ek baar us rewar ki or."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki munaafiq ka haal duwidha mein pari hui bakri ki tarah hai, jise pata na ho ki do revron mein se kiske saath rahna hai? Kabhi is rewar ki or jaati ho, to kabhi us rewar ki or. Bilkul isi tarah munaafiq eemaan aur kufr ke wishay mein duwidha mein pare hote hain. Na to eemaan waalon ke saath andar aur baahar donon tarah se hote hain aur na kaafiron ke saath andar aur baahar donon tarah se hote hain. Waise to zaahiri taur par eemaan waalon ke saath hote hain, lekin man mein asmanjas ki sthiti hoti hai. Kabhi musalmaanon ki or jhuk jaate hain aur kabhi kaafiron ki or.

Baat achchhi tarah samajh mein aye, iske liye Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam udaahran diya karte the.
Is hadees mein munaafiqon ki duwidha, sandeh aur asthirta ko bayaan kiya gaya hai.
Ismen munaafiq ke haal se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai aur zaahiri evn androoni taur par pakka-sachcha musalmaan banne ki shiksha di gai hai.
65021: Qayaamat ki nishaaniyon mein se kuchh nishaaniyaan yeh hain ki jnaan utha liya jaye, ajnaan adhik ho jaye, vyabhichaar adhik ho jaye, madira peene ka chalan adhik ho jaye, purush kam ho jayen aur striyaan itni adhik ho jayen ki pachaas-pachaas striyon ka ek hi abhibhaawak ho.

Anas radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Main tumko ek hadees sunaaoonga, jise mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se suna hai aur jise mere siwa koi tumhen bata nahin sakta. Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Qayaamat ki nishaaniyon mein se kuchh nishaaniyaan yeh hain ki jnaan utha liya jaye, ajnaan adhik ho jaye, vyabhichaar adhik ho jaye, madira peene ka chalan adhik ho jaye, purush kam ho jayen aur striyaan itni adhik ho jayen ki pachaas-pachaas striyon ka ek hi abhibhaawak ho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki qayaamat ke nikat hone ki ek nishaani yeh hai ki shareeyat ka jnaan utha liya jayega. Aisa ulema ki mrityu se hoga. Iske nateeje mein ajnaanta adhik ho jayegi, vyabhichaar tatha behyaai phail jayegi, madira peene ka chalan adhik ho jayega, purush ghat jayenge aur striyaan itni barh jayengi ki pachaas striyon ke abhibhaawak ke roop mein ek hi vyakti kaam karega.

Qayaamat ki kuchh alaamton ka bayaan.
Qayaamat ke samay ka jnaan un baaton mein se ek hai, jinka sanbandh ghaib se hai aur jinki jaankaari kewal Allah ke paas hai.
Sharai jnaan praapt karne ki prerna, isse pahle ki use utha liya jaye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65022: Qayaamat us samay tak qayam nahin hogi, jab tak is tarah ki haalat paida na ho jaye ki ek vyakti kisi ki qabr ke paas se guzre aur kahe ki kaash! Iske sthaan par main hota!

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Qayaamat us samay tak qayam nahin hogi, jab tak is tarah ki haalat paida na ho jaye ki ek vyakti kisi ki qabr ke paas se guzre aur kahe ki kaash! Iske sthaan par main hota!"

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki qayaamat us samay tak nahin ayegi, jab tak is tarah ka drishy dekhne ko na mile ki ek aadmi kisi qabr ke paas se guzre aur yeh kaamna kare ki kaash wahi is qabr mein dafan hota! Is prakaar ki kaamna ka kaaran is baat ka dar hoga ki kaheen asaty tatha uske maarg par chalne waale logon ke prabhutv, fitnon, gunaahon aur buraai ke prachlan ke kaaran deen se wanchit hone ki naubat na a jaye.

Is baat ka ishaara ki antim zamaane mein gunaah aur fitne saamne ayenge.
Saavdhaan rahne, eemaan tatha achchhe aamaal dvaara maut ki taiyaari karne aur fitnon evn aazmaaishon ki jaghon se door rahne ki prerna.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65023: Qayaamat us samay tak nahin ayegi, jab tak tum yahoodiyon se yuddh na kar lo aur yahaan tak ki jis patthar ke peechhe yahoodi chhupa ho woh na kahe ki e musalmaan! Yeh mere peechhe yahoodi chhupa hai, iski hatya kar do.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Qayaamat us samay tak nahin ayegi, jab tak tum yahoodiyon se yuddh na kar lo aur yahaan tak ki jis patthar ke peechhe yahoodi chhupa ho woh na kahe ki e musalmaan! Yeh mere peechhe yahoodi chhupa hai, iski hatya kar do."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki qayaamat us samay tak nahin ayegi, jab tak yahoodi aur musalmaan ek-doosre se yuddh na kar len. Aur yeh sthiti na paida ho jaye ki jab koi yahoodi musalmaanon se bachne ke liye kisi patthar ke peechhe ja chhupe to Allah patthar ko bolne ki shakti pradaan kar de aur woh musalmaan ko pukaar kar kahe ki uske peechhe ek yahoodi chhupa hai, taaki woh jaakar uska wadh kar de.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne Allah ki or se pradaan ki gai soochna ke anusaar ghaib ki kuchh baaten bataai hain, jo aane waale samay se sanbandh rakhti hain aur jo nishchit roop se saamne ayengi.
Antim kaal mein musalmaan yahoodiyon se yuddh karenge, jo ki qayaamat ki nishaaniyon mein se ek nishaani hai.
Islam dharm qayaamat tak baaqi rahega aur woh saare dharmon par ghaalib rahega.
Allah dushmanon ke wiruddh musalmaanon ki madad karta hai aur iska ek roop yeh hai ki woh antim kaal mein pattharon ko bolne ki shakti pradaan karega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65025: Us hasti ki qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, woh samay bahut hi nikat hai, jab tumhaare beech maryam ke bete nyaykaari shaasak ke roop mein utrenge. Woh saleeb tor denge, sooar ka wadh karenge, jizya (weshesh lagaan) hata denge aur dhan ki itni bahutayat ho jayegi ki koi use grahan nahin karega.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Us hasti ki qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, woh samay bahut hi nikat hai, jab tumhaare beech maryam ke bete nyaykaari shaasak ke roop mein utrenge. Woh saleeb tor denge, sooar ka wadh karenge, jizya (weshesh lagaan) hata denge aur dhan ki itni bahutayat ho jayegi ki koi use grahan nahin karega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam qasam khaakar bata rahe hain ki woh samay bahut hi nikat hai, jab maryam ke putr eesa alaihissalaam logon ke beech muhammadi shareeyat ke anusaar nyay ke saath shaasan chalaane ke liye utrenge. Woh saleeb tor denge, jiska eesaai sammaan karte hain, eesa alaihissalaam sooar ka wadh karenge, jizya hata denge aur saare logon ko Islam grahan karne par aamaada karenge. Us samay dhan ki itni bahutayat hogi, har aadmi ke paas itna paisa hoga aur itni barakten utrengi ki koi dhan grahan karne ke liye taiyaar nahin hoga.

Is baat ka saboot ki antim zamaane mein eesa alaihissalaam utrenge. Unka utarna qayaamat ki nishaaniyon mein se ek nishaani hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke laye hue widhaan ko koi doosra widhaan nirast nahin karega.
Antim zamaane mein dhan mein barakten utrengi lekin log is awastha mein honge ki unhen maal ki chaahat nahin hogi.
Yeh khushkhabri ki deen-e-Islam baaqi rahega aur antim zamaane mein eesa alaihissalaam usi ke anusaar shaasan chalayenge.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65026: Qayaamat us samay tak nahin ayegi, jab tak sooraj apne doobne ke sthaan se na nikle. Jab sooraj apne doobne ke sthaan se niklega aur log dekhenge, to sab log eemaan le ayenge

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Qayaamat us samay tak nahin ayegi, jab tak sooraj apne doobne ke sthaan se na nikle. Jab sooraj apne doobne ke sthaan se niklega aur log dekhenge, to sab log eemaan le ayenge. Aisa us samay hoga, jab : " Kisi praani ko uska eemaan laabh nahin dega, jo pahle eemaan na laya ho ya apne eemaan ki haalat mein koi satkarm na kiya ho." [soora al-anaaam : 158] qayaamat is tarah ayegi ki do logon ne apne beech kapre phaila rakhe honge, na uski khareed-bikri kar sakenge aur na use samet sakenge. Qayaamat is tarah ayegi ki aadmi apni oont ko dooh chuka hoga, lekin doodh pi nahin sakega. Qayaamat is tarah ayegi ki aadmi apne hauz ko theek kar raha hoga, lekin uska paani pi nahin sakega. Qayaamat is tarah ayegi ki aadmi niwaala munh tak utha chuka hoga, lekin use kha nahin sakega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki qayaamat ki nishaaniyon mein se ek bari nishaani yeh hai ki soorj poorab ki bajay pashchim se nikal aye. Is nishaani ko dekhne ke baad saare log eemaan le ayenge. Lekin us samay na to kaafir ko eemaan laane ka laabh milega aur na satkarm tatha tauba hi kuchh kaam ayegi. Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki qayaamat is tarah achaanak ayegi ki log apne-apne kaamon mein vyast honge aur koi apna kaam poora nahin kar sakega. Qayaamat is tarah achaanak ayegi ki khareedne waale ke liye bechne waale ne kapra saamne phaila rakha hoga, lekin na to sauda kar sakenge aur na use samet sakenge. Qayaamat is tarah achaanak ayegi ki aadmi doodh dene waali oontni ka doodh haath mein le liya hoga, lekin pi nahin sakega. Qayaamat is tarah achaanak ayegi ki aadmi paani ka taalaab theek kar chuka hoga, lekin uska paani peene ka avsar nahin milega. Samay itna kam hoga ki ek vyakti ne niwaala munh tak utha liya hoga, lekin kha nahin sakega.

Islam tatha tauba us samay tak grahan yogy hain, jab tak sooraj pashchim se nikal na aye.
Eemaan tatha satkarm dvaara qayaamat ki taiyaari ki prerna, kyonki qayaamat achaanak a jayegi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65028: Allah zameen ko apni mutthi mein le lega tatha aakaashon ko apne dayen haath mein lapet lega aur phir kahega : Main hi baadshaah hoon. Kahaan hain dharti ke baadshaah?

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Allah zameen ko apni mutthi mein le lega tatha aakaashon ko apne dayen haath mein lapet lega aur phir kahega : Main hi baadshaah hoon. Kahaan hain dharti ke baadshaah?"

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki qayaamat ke din Allah zameen ko samet kar apni mutthi mein le lega aur aakaashon ko apne dayen haath mein lapet lega evn unko ek dosre ke saath lapet dega aur unhen khatm tatha fana kar dega aur phir kahega : Main hi baadshaah hoon. Dharti ke baadshaah kahaan hain?

Is baat ka smaran ki Allah ki baadshaahat baaqi rahegi aur uske atirikt any sab ki baadshaahat khatm ho jayegi.
Allah ke prataap, uski mahaan shakti, adhikaar aur sanpoorn raajy ka ullekh.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65030: Mera taalaab itna bara hoga ki use paar karne ke liye ek maheene ka samay darkaar hoga. Uska paani doodh se zyaada safed hoga, uski khushbu kastoori se zyaada achchhi hogi

Abdullah bin amar radiyallahu anhuma se warnit hai, unhonne kaha ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Mera taalaab itna bara hoga ki use paar karne ke liye ek maheene ka samay darkaar hoga. Uska paani doodh se zyaada safed hoga, uski khushbu kastoori se zyaada achchhi hogi aur uske pyaale aasmaan ke taaron ke samaan honge. Jo uska paani pi lega, use kabhi pyaas nahin lagegi."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki aapko qayaamat ke din ek taalaab milega, jiski lanbaai aur chauraai itni zyaada hogi ki use paar karne ke liye ek maheene ka samay darkaar hoga. Uska paani doodh se zyaada safed hoga. Uski khushbu kastoori se adhik achchhi hogi. Uske pyaalon ki sankhya aakaash ke taaron ke samaan hogi. Jo us taalaab ka paani un pyaalon se pi lega, use kabhi pyaas nahin lagegi.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka taalaab daraasal paani ka ek bahut bara jalaashay hoga, jiska paani aapki ummat ke eemaan waale log qayaamat ke din pi sakenge.
Us taalaab ke paani ki wisheshta yeh hogi, jo use pi lega, use kabhi pyaas nahin lagegi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65031: Main hauz (taalaab) ke paas hi rahoonga, taaki dekh sakoon ki tummen se kaun-kaun mere paas paani peene aata hai. Kuchh logon ko mere paas aane se rok diya jayega, to main kahoonga ki ai mere rab! Ye mere tatha meri ummat ke log hain

Asma bint abu bakr radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Main hauz (taalaab) ke paas hi rahoonga, taaki dekh sakoon ki tummen se kaun-kaun mere paas paani peene aata hai. Kuchh logon ko mere paas aane se rok diya jayega, to main kahoonga ki ai mere rab! Ye mere tatha meri ummat ke log hain." Chunaanche kaha jayega : Kya tumhen maaloom hai ki in logon ne tumhaare baad kya amal kya hai? Allah ki qasam, ye log apni eriyon ke bal (aapke deen se) lautte rahe."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki qayaamat ke din aap apne hauz (taalaab) ke paas hi honge, taaki dekh saken ki aapki ummat ke kaun-kaun log aapke hauz par paani peene a rahe hain. Us din kuchh logon ko aapke paas aane se rok diya jayega. Yeh dekh aap kahenge ki ai mere rab! Ye mere aur meri ummat ke log hain. Ispar kaha jayega : Kya aap jaante hain ki in logon ne aapse juda hone ke baad kya kiya hai? Allah ki qasam, ye log lagaataar airiyon ke bal peechhe lautte rahe aur apne deen se door jaate rahe. Isliye ye na to aapke log hain aur na aapki ummat ke log.

Apni ummat par Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki kripa aur unko bachaane ke prati aapki tatparta.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki shikshaaon ki mukhaalfat karne ka nuqsaan.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki sunnat ko mazbooti se pakre rahne ki prerna.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65032: Us hasti ki qasam, jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, uske bartan aakaash ke taaron evn grahon se adhik honge

Abu zar radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai,  unhonne kaha : Mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Hauz (taalaab) ke bartanon ke baare mein aap kya kahenge? Aapne kaha : "Us hasti ki qasam, jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, uske bartan aakaash ke taaron evn grahon se adhik honge. Sun lo, main baat andhere tatha saaf aakaash waali raat ki kar raha hoon. Hauz ke bartan aise honge ki jo unse paani pi lega, use kabhi pyaas nahin lagegi. Us mein Jannat ke do parnaale gir rahe honge. Jo is hauz ka paani pi lega, use kabhi pyaas nahin lagegi. Uski chauraai uski lanbaai ke samaan hogi.(Aur yeh utna hoga jitna ki ) ammaan aur aila ke beech hai. Uska paani doodh se zyaada safed aur shahad se zyaada meetha hoga."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki qayaamat ke din aapko praapt hauz ke bartan aakaashon ke taaron evn grahon ki sankhya se adhik honge. Hauz (taalaab) ke bartanon ki sankhya un taaron evn grahon ki sankhya se adhik hogi, jo andheri raat mein dekhne ko milte hain, jab aakaash mein chaand nahin hota. Kyonki chaandni raat mein taare spasht roop se dikhaai nahin dete. Aisi andheri raat mein, jab aakaash mein baadal na ho. Kyonki baadal hone par taaron ko dekhne mein baadha utpann hoti hai. Jannat ke bartanon ki ek wisheshta yeh hogi, jo unse koi pey padaarth pi lega, use kabhi pyaas nahin lagegi. Aapke hauz (taalaab) mein Jannat ke do parnaale gir rahe honge tatha uski lanbaai evn chauraai samaan hogi. Uski lanbaai ammaan, jo shaam ke balqa kshetr ka ek nagar hai, se aila ke beech ki doori ke baraabar hogi, jo ki shaam ka ek mashhoor seemaawarti nagar hai. Hauz ke paani ka rang doodh se adhik safed aur uska svaad shahad se adhik meetha hoga.

Hauz tatha uski tarah-tarah ki nemton ka saboot.
Hauz ka wistaar, lanbaai, chauraai aur bari sankhya mein bartan.
65033: Allah qayaamat ke din meri ummat se ek vyakti ko chunkar saari srishtiyon ke saamne upasthit karega

Abdullah bin amr radiyallahu anhuma bayaan karte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Allah qayaamat ke din meri ummat se ek vyakti ko chunkar saari srishtiyon ke saamne upasthit karega aur uske saamne ninyaanve rajistaron ko kholkar rakh dega. Har rajistar wahaan tak phaila hoga, jahaan nazar jaati ho. Phir kahega : Kya tum inke andar likhi kisi baat se inkaar karte ho? Kya inko taiyaar karne par niyukt mere farishton ne tumpar koi atyaachaar kiya hai? Woh kahega : Nahin, ai mere rab! Phir Allah kahega : Kya tumhaare paas prastut karne ke liye koi kaaran hai? Woh kahega : Nahin, ai mere rab! Yeh sun Allah kahega : Hamaare paas tumhaari ek neki rakhi hai. Dekho, aaj tumpar koi atyaachaar nahin hoga. Chunaanche ek parchi nikaali jayegi, jismen likha hoga : Main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke atirikt koi saty poojy nahin hai aur main gawaahi deta hoon ki Muhammad Allah ke bande aur uske Rasool hain. Phir Allah usse kahega : Apne karmon ko tole jaane ka drishy dekho. Yeh sun woh kahega : In rajistaron ke saamne is ek parchi ki kya haisiyat hai? Lekin Allah kahega : Tumpar koi atyaachaar nahin hoga. Aapne kaha : Ek palre mein saare rajistar rakhe jayenge aur doosre palre mein us parchi ko rakha jayega. Chunaanche rajistar halke saabit honge aur pararchi bhaari siddh hogi, kyonki Allah ke naam se zyaada bhaari koi cheez nahin hai."

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki qayaamat ke din Allah aapki ummat ke ek vyakti ko chunkar saari srishtiyon ke saamne prastut karega, taaki uska hisaab-kitaab ho sake. Uske saamne ninyaanve rajistar rakh dega. Inmen uske woh bure kaary likhe honge, jo woh duniya mein kiya karta tha. Har rajistar ki lanbaai wahaan tak hogi, jahaan tak aankh pahunchti ho. Phir Allah us vyakti se kahega : Kya tum in rajistaron mein likhi kisi baat ka inkaar karte ho? Kya karm likhne waale mere farishton ne tumpar koi atyaachaar kiya hai? Yeh sun woh vyakti kahega : Nahin, ai mere rab! Ispar sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah kahega : Tumne duniya mein jo bure kaary kiye hain, kya unka auchity saabit karne ke liye tumhaare paas koi kaaran hai? Maslan yeh ki tumse woh kaary bhool-chook mein, ghalti se ya anjaane mein hue hain. Woh vyakti kahega : Nahin, ai mere rab! Mere paas prastut karne ke liye koi uchit kaaran nahin hai. Ispar Allah kahega : Dekho, mere paas tumhaari ek neki rakhi hai aur yaad rakho ki aaj tumpar koi atyaachaar nahin hoga. Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Iske baad Allah ek parchi nikaalega, jismen likha hoga : Main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai aur main gawaahi deta hoon ki Muhammad Allah ke bande aur uske Rasool hain. Phir Allah us vyakti se kahega : Ab apne karm ko wazan kiye jaane ka drishy dekho. Chunaanche aashcharyachkit hokar woh vyakti kahega : Ai mere rab! In rajistaron ke saamne is parchi ki kya haisiyat hai? Yeh sun sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah kahega : Dekho, aaj tumpar koi atyaachaar nahin hoga. Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aage farmaya : Un rajistaron  ko taraazu ke ek palre mein rakha jayega aur doosre palre mein us parchi ko rakha jayega, to parchi waala palra bhaari aur rajistaron waala palra halka ho jayega. Is tarah use Allah maaf kar dega.

Kalima-e-tauheed yaani Allah ke ekmaatr saty poojy hone ki gawaahi dene ka mahatv aur taraazu mein uska bhaari hona.
Kewal zubaan se la ilaaha illallah kah dena paryaapt nahin hai. Uske mayne ko jaanna aur uske taqaazon par amal karna bhi zaroori hai.
Wishuddh roop se Allah ke liye kaary karne ka jazba aur mazboot tauheed gunaahon ke mita diye jaane ka kaaran hai.
Dil mein Allah ke prati nishtha ke anusaar eemaan mein bhi kami-beshi hoti hai. Kyonki is kalima ko kahne waale kuchh logon ko bhi apne gunaahon ke anusaar azaab ka saamna karna parega.
[is hadees ko tirmizi aur ibn-e-maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
65034: Jab Allah ne Jannat evn Jahannam ko paida kiya, to jibreel alaihissalaam

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Jab Allah ne Jannat evn Jahannam ko paida kiya, to jibreel alaihissalaam ko Jannat ki or bheja aur farmaya : Jannat ko aur Jannat ke andar Jannat waasiyon ke liye mainne jo kuchh taiyaar kiya hai, use dekh aao. Chunaanche jibreel ne Jannat ko dekha, waapas aye aur kaha : Teri pratishtha ki qasam, Jannat ke baare mein jo bhi sunega, woh usmen daakhil ho hi jayega. Chunaanche Allah ne aadesh diya aur use apriy wastuon se gher diya gaya. Iske baad phir jibreel se kaha : Jannat ki or jaao aur use tatha uske andar Jannat waasiyon ke liye mainne jo kuchh taiyaar kiya hai, use dekh aao. Is baar dekha to paya ki use apriy wastuon se gher diya gaya hai. Atah unhonne kaha : Teri pratishtha ki qasam, mujhe is baat ka dar lag raha hai ki ismen koi daakhil hi nahin ho sakega. Iske baad Allah ne unse kaha : Jaao aur Jahannam ko tatha uske andar mainne Jahannam waasiyon ke liye jo kuchh taiyaar kiya hai, use dekh aao. Chunaanche unhonne dekha to paya ki Jahannam ka ek bhaag doosre bhaag par charhe ja raha hai. Atah woh laut aye aur bole : Teri pratishtha ki qasam, usmen koi daakhil hi nahin hoga. Chunaanche Allah ne aadesh diya aur use aakaankshaaon se gher diya gaya. Iske baad Allah ne kaha : Dobaara jaao aur use dekh lo. Unhonne is baar dekha to paya ki use aakaankshaaon se bhar diya gaya hai. Atah waapas hue aur bole : Teri pratishtha ki qasam, mujhe is baat ka dar hai ki usmen koi daakhil hone se bach hi nahin sakega."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jab Allah ne Jannat evn Jahannam ko paida kiya, to jibreel alaihissalaam se kaha : Jaao aur Jannat ko dekho. Chunaanche unhonne jaakar Jannat ko dekha, waapas aye aur kahne lage : Ai mere rab! Teri pratishtha ki qasam, Jannat tatha uske andar maujood nemton evn aananddayi cheezon ke baare mein jo bhi sunega, woh usmen daakhil hona chaahega aur iske liye kaam karega. Phir Allah ne Jannat ko apriy evn kathni cheezon, jaise aadeshon ka paalan karna evn mana ki hui cheezon se door rahna aadi se gher diya aur yeh aniwaary kar diya ki Jannat mein prawesh karne ki ichchha rakhne waale ko in cheezon se guzarna hoga. Uske baad Allah ne kaha : Ai jibreel! Jaao aur ab Jannat ko dekho. Chunaanche jibreel gae, sab kuchh dekha aur waapas aakar kaha ki ai mere rab ! Teri pratishtha ki qasam, mujhe Jannat mein prawesh ke raaste mein aane waali kathinaaiyon tatha pareshaaniyon ko dekhkar aisa lagta hai ki uske andar koi prawesh hi nahin kar sakega. Isi tarah jab Allah ne Jahannam ko paida kiya, to jibreel se kaha : Jaao aur use dekho. Chunaanche woh gae, use dekha aur phir waapas aakar kaha ki ai mere rab! Teri pratishtha ki qasam, Jahannam ki jo yaatnayen, sazayen، peera tatha duhkh hain, unke baare mein jo bhi sunega, woh usmen jaane se bachna chaahega aur uski or le jaane waali cheezon se door rahega. Iske baad Allah ne Jahannam ko chaaron taraf se ghar diya aur uski or pahunchne waale raaste ko khvaahishon evn man mohak cheezon se bhar diya aur phir jibreel se kaha ab use jaakar dekho. Chunaanche jibreel gae, dekha aur uske baad waapas aakar kaha ki ai mere rab! Teri pratishtha ki qasam, ab uske aas-paas itni aakaankshayen tatha man mohak jeezen rakh di gai hain ki mujhe dar hai ki koi usmen jaane se bach nahin sakega.

Is baat par eemaan ki is samay Jannat evn Jahannam donon maujood hain.
Ghaib tatha Allah aur uske Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki bataai hua har baat par eemaan rakhna waajib hai.
Apriy cheezon ke saamne aane par dhairy rakhne ka mahatv, kyonki inheen ko paar karke Jannat tak pahuncha ja sakta hai.
Haraam cheezon se bachne ka mahatv, kyonki inheen ka raasta Jahannam ki or le jaata hai.
Allah ne Jannat ko apriy cheezon tatha Jahannam ko khvaahishaat se gher diya hai aur yahi taqaaza hai duniya ke jeewan mein pareeksha tatha aazmaaish ka.
Jannat ka raasta mushkil hai aur iske liye dhairy tatha kathinaaiyon se guzarne ki zaroorat hoti hai, jabki Jahannam ka raasta khvaahishon evn man-mohak chaazon se ghira hua hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi aur nasai ne riwayat kiya hai]
65035: Qayaamat ke din maut ko ek chitkabre mendhe

Abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, unhonne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Qayaamat ke din maut ko ek chitkabre mendhe ke roop mein laya jayega. Phir ek aawaaz dene waala aawaaz dega : Ai Jannat waasiyo! Chunaanche we oopar nazar uthaakar dekhenge. Aawaaz dene waala kahega : Kya tum isko pahchaante ho? We kahenge: Haan. Yeh maut hai aur sab ne usko dekha hai. Phir woh aawaaz dega : Ai Jahannam waasiyo! Chunaanche woh bhi apni gardan uthaakar dekhenge. Phir woh kahega : Kya tum isko pahchaante ho? We kahenge : Haan. Sab ne use dekha hai. Phir us mendhe ko zabah kar diya jayega aur aawaaz dene waala kahega : Ai Jannat waasiyo! Tumhen hamesha yahaan rahna hai, ab kisi ko maut nahin ayegi . Ai Jahannam waasiyo! Tumhen bhi yahaan hamesha rahna hai, ab kisi ko maut nahin ayegi. Phir aapne yeh ayat tilaawat pharmaai : “Aur (ai Nabi!) aap unhen pachhtaawe ke din se darayen, jab har kaam ka phaisla kar diya jayega, aur we poori tarah se ghaflat mein hain aur we eemaan nahin laate." [soora maryam : 39]

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam is hadees mein bayaan kar rahe hain ki qayaamat ke din maut ko chitkabre rang ke mendhe ke roop mein laya jayega. Phir ek aawaaz lagaane waala aawaaz lagayega ki ai Jannat mein rahne waalo! Chunaanche we apni gardanon ko lanba karke aur apne saron ko uthaakar dekhenge. Iske baad aawaaz lagaane waala unse kahega ki kya tum ise pahchaan rahe ho? Log uttar denge ki haan ham ise pahchaan rahe hain. Yeh maut hai. Sab ne use dekh rakha tha. Isliye pahchaan lenge. Phir aawaaz dene waala aawaaz dega ki ai Jahannam mein rahne waalo! Chunaanche we apni gardanon ko lanba aur apne saron ko uthaakar dekhenge. Pukaarne waala kahega ki kya tum ise pahchaan rahe ho? We uttar denge ki haan, ham ise pahchaan rahe hain. Yeh maut hai. Daraasal sabne pahle use dekh rakha hoga. Iske baad maut ko zabah kar diya jayega. Phir aawaaz dene waala aawaaz dega : Ai Jannat waasiyo! Ab tum hamesha zinda rahoge. Tumko maut nahin ayegi. Ai Jahannam waasiyo! Ab tum hamesha zinda rahoge. Tumko maut nahin ayegi. Yeh ailaan isliye kiya jayega, taaki eemaan waale adhik aanand le saken aur eemaan na rakhne waalon ko kasht ka adhik ehsaas ho. Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne yeh ayat parhi : "Aur (ai Nabi!) aap unhen pachhtaawe ke din se darayen, jab har kaam ka phaisla kar diya jayega, aur we poori tarah se ghaflat mein hain aur we eemaan nahin laate." Qayaamat ke din jannatiyon evn jahannamiyon ke beech nirnay kar diya jayega aur har ek apne thikaane mein chala jayega, jahaan use hamesha rahna hai. Us din gunahgaar is baat par afsos karega ki woh duniya se neki ke kaam karke nahin aya hai. Isi tarah kotaahi karne waale ko bhi afsos hoga ki adhik neki karke kyon nahin aye.

Aakhirat mein insaan ka Jannat athva Jahannam ka thikaana anant kaal ke liye hoga.
Ismen qayaamat ke din ki khaufnaaki se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai, kyonki woh aakaanksha evn pashchaataap ka din hoga.
Is baat ka bayaan ki jannatiyon ko praapt hone waali khushiyaan hamesha rahengi aur jahannamiyon ko praapt hone waale duhkh bhi hamesha rahenge.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65036: Tumhaari aag Jahannam ki aag ke sattar bhaagon mein se ek bhaag hai

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Tumhaari aag Jahannam ki aag ke sattar bhaagon mein se ek bhaag hai." Kisi ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Yahi to kaafi thi. Aapne kaha : "Jahannam ki aag ko tumhaari aag par unhattar bhaag adhik kiya gayha hai. Har bhaag duniya ki aag ki tarah garm hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki duniya ki aag Jahannam ki aag ke sattar bhaag mein se ek bhaag hai. Chunaanche aakhirat ki aag ki garni duniya ki aag ki garmi se unhattar bhaag adhik hogi. Uske har bhaag ki garmi duniya ki aag ke baraabar hogi. Kisi ne kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Duniya ki aag hi to Jahannam jaane waalon ko yaatna dene ke liye paryaapt thi. To aapne kaha : Jahannam ki aag ko duniya ki aag se unhattar guna adhik garm banaya hai.

Ismen Jahannam se saawaadhaan kiya gaya hai, taaki log wahaan le jaane waale kaaryon se door rahen.
Jahannam ki aag bari bhayaanak aur bahut sakht garm hogi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65037: Hamen Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne, jo ki sachche the aur jinki sachchaai sarvamaany thi, bataya hai : Tummen se har vyakti ki srishti-saamagri uski maan ke pet mein chaalees dinon weery ke roop mein ekatr ki jaati hai

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai : "Hamen Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne, jo ki sachche the aur jinki sachchaai sarvamaany thi, bataya hai : Tummen se har vyakti ki srishti-saamagri uski maan ke pet mein chaalees dinon weery ke roop mein ekatr ki jaati hai. Phir itne hi samay mein woh jame hue rakt ka roop dhaaran kar leti hai. Phir itne hi dinon mein maans ka lauthra ban jaati hai. Phir uski or ek farishta bheja jaata hai, jise chaar baaton ka aadesh diya jaata hai. Use kaha jaata hai ki uski rozi (jeewika), uski ayu, uske karm tatha uske achchhe ya bure hone ko likh de. Phir woh usmen rooh (jaan) phoonk deta hai. Dekho, tummen se koi jannatiyon ke kaam karta rahta hai, yahaan tak ki uske aur Jannat ke beech kewal ek haath ki doori rah jaati hai ki itne mein uspar taqdeer ka likha ghaalib a jaata hai aur woh jahannamiyon ke kaam karne lagta hai tatha usmen prawesh kar jaata hai. Isi tarah, tummen se koi jahannamiyon ke kaam karta rahta hai, yahaan tak uske aur Jahannam ke beech kewal ek haath ki doori rah jaati hai ki itne mein uspar uspar taqdeer ka likha ghaalib a jaata hai aur woh jannatiyon ke kaam karne lagta hai tatha Jannat mein prawesh kar jaata hai."

Abdullah bin masaood kahte hain ki hamen Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai, jinki har baat sachchi hai aur jinko Allah taaala ne sachcha kaha hai. Aapne farmaya : Tummen se har vyakti ki srishti-samaagri ekatr ki jaati hai. Yaani jab koi vyakti apni patni ke saath sanbhog karta hai, to uska bikhra hua weery aurat ke garbhaashay mein chaalees dinon tak weery ke roop mein ekatr kiya jaata hai. Phir woh khoon ka lauthra yaani gaarha rakt ban jaata hai. Yeh kaam doosre chaalees dinon mein hota hai. Phir woh maans ka ek tukra ban jaata hai, jise ek baar mein chabaya ja sake. Yeh teesre chaalees dinon mein hota hai. Phir uski or Allah ek farishta bhejta hai, jo usmen teesre chaalees din samaapt hone ke baad rooh (jaan) phoonkta hai. Farishte ko aadesh diya jaata hai ki chaar baaten likh den. Pahli baat uski rozi (jeewika) hai. Yaani yeh likh de ki use jeewan mein kitni sukh-suwidhayen praapt hongi. Doosri baat uski ayu hai. Yaani yeh likh de ki woh duniya mein kitne din jeewit rahega. Tareesri baat uske karm hain. Yaani achchha kaam karne waala hoga yeh bura. Jabki chauthi baat yeh ki woh saubhaagyashaali hoga ya durbhaagyashaali? Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne qasam khaakar bataya ki ek vyakti jannatiyon ke kaam karta rahta hai aur uske kaam logon ko achchhe dikhaai parte hain, yahaan tak ki uske tatha Jannat tak pahunchne ke beech bas itni doori rah jaati hai, jaise kisi vyakti aur uske gantavy ke beech kewal ek haath ki doori rah gai ho, aise samay mein uspar Allah ka likha aur uska nirnay ghaalib a jaata hai aur woh jahannamiyon ke kaam karne lagta hai aur bure kaam par ant hone ki wajah se use Jahannam jaana parta hai. Kyonki amal qabool hone ke liye shart yeh hai ki insaan uspar qayam rahe aur uske sthaan par bura karne na lage. Jabki doosri or ek vyakti jahannamiyon ke kaam karta rahta hai, yahaan tak ki usmen daakhil hone ke nikat pahunch jaata hai, maano ki uske tatha Jahannam ke beech kewal ek haath ki doori rah gai ho, itne mein uspar Allah ka likha aur uska nirnay ghaalib a jaata hai aur woh jahannatiyon ke kaam karna shuru kar deta hai aur phalasvaroop Jannat mein prawesh karta hai.

Insaan ka anjaam ant mein jaakar wahi karta hai, jo taqdeer mein likha ho.
Ismen zaahiri aamaal ke dhokhe mein aane se mana kiya gaya hai. Kyonki aamaal ka daaromdaar (nirbharta) ant par hota hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65038: Allah ne srishtiyon ki taqdeeren aakaashon evn dharti ki rachna se pachaas hazaar warsh pahle likh di theen

Abdullah bin amr radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Allah ne srishtiyon ki taqdeeren aakaashon evn dharti ki rachna se pachaas hazaar warsh pahle likh di theen. Pharmaya : Us samay Allah ka arsh paani par tha."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki Allah ne srishtiyon se juri hui ghatnayen, jaise jeewan, mrityu evn jeewika aadi aakaashon evn dharti ki rachna se pachaas hazaar warsh pahle hi lauh-e-mahfooz mein likh di theen. Atah ye saari ghatnayen Allah ke liye hue nirnay ke anusaar hi saamne ayengi. Duniya mein hone waala har kaam Allah ke nirnay evn faisle ke anusaar hota hai. Atah jo kuchh bande ke hisse mein aya, woh usse door nahin ja sakta tha aur kuchh uske haath se nikal gaya, woh kabhi uske haath lag nahin sakta tha.

Allah ke nirnay tatha taqdeer par eemaan rakhna waajib hai.
Taqdeer se muraad hai, saari cheezon ke baare mein Allah ka jnaan, unka Allah ke dvaara likha jaana, iraada karna aur rachna karna.
Is baat par eemaan ki saari taqdeeren pahle se likhi hui hain, santushti tatha aatm samarpan pradaan karta hai.
Aakaashon evn dharti ki rachna se pahle Allah ka arsh paani par tha.
65039: Har cheez taqdeer ke anusaar saamne aati hai, yahaan tak ki akshamta tatha sakshamta bhi ya sakshamta tatha akshamta bhi.

Taaoos ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Mainne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke kuchh saathiyon ko paya, we kahte the ki har cheez taqdeer ke anusaar saamne aati hai. Taaoos kahte hain ki mainne abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma ko kahte hue suna hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Har cheez taqdeer ke anusaar saamne aati hai, yahaan tak ki akshamta tatha sakshamta bhi ya sakshamta tatha akshamta bhi."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki har cheez taqdeer mein likhe ke anusaar samaane aati hai. Yahaan tak ki "العجز" (Akshamta) yaani duniya evn aakhirat se sanbandhit zaroori kaamon ko na karna, unhen taalte rahna aur samay beet jaane dena bhi. Isi tarah "الْكَيْسُ" (Sakshamta) yaani duniya tatha aakhirat se sanbandhit kaamon mein chusti dikhaana aur mahaarat rakhna bhi. Allah ne akshamta tatha sakshamta aur isi tarah har cheez ko taqdeer (bhaagy) mein likh diya hai. Duniya mein jo bhi ghatna ghatti hai, woh Allah ki jaankaari aur uske iraade se ghatti hai.

Taqdeer ke baare mein sahaaba ke aqeede ka bayaan.
Har cheez Allah ki likhi taqdeer ke anusaar saamne aati hai, yahaan tak ki akshamta tatha sakshamta bhi.
Sahaaba Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki hadeeson ko naqal karne ke sanbandh mein poori saavdhaani baratte the aur chhaanbeen se kaam liya karte the.
Har bhali-buri taqdeer par eemaan.
65040: Jab Allah kisi bande ke baare mein nirnay karta hai ki woh kis  zameen mein mrityu payega, to wahaan uski zaroorat rakh deta hai.

Matar bin ukaamis radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jab Allah kisi bande ke baare mein nirnay karta hai ki woh kis  zameen mein mrityu payega, to wahaan uski zaroorat rakh deta hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jab Allah kisi ke baare mein nirnay kar deta hai ki woh kisi jagah mrityu payega, parantu woh wahaan upasthit nahin hota, to Allah wahaan uski zaroorat rakh deta hai to woh wahaan woh jaata hai aur wahaan uski jaan nikaali jaati hai.
Yeh hadees Qur'an ki is ayat ki pushti karti hai : "Kisi praani ko nahin pata ki uski mrityu kahaan honi hai."
65043: Jisne jaan-boojhkar mujhpar jhooth bola, woh apna thikaana Jahannam bana le.
Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jisne jaan-boojhkar mujhpar jhooth bola, woh apna thikaana Jahannam bana le."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jisne aappar jhooth bola, yaani kisi kathan ya kaary ka jhootha sanbandh aapki or kiya, use is jhooth ke badle mein aakhirat mein Jahannam mein sthaan pradaan kiya jayega.

Jaan-boojhkar Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par jhooth bolna Jahannam mein prawesh ka sabab hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par jhooth bolna any logon par jhooth bolne ki tarah nahin hai. Kyonki aappar bole jaane waale jhooth ke nateeje mein deen evn duniya ki bahut-si buraaiyaan saamne aati hain.
Poori chhaan-been aur Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki or sanbandh ke sahi hone ki pushti kiye bina hadeeson ko phailaane ki manaahi.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65044: Aur main saad bin abi bakr naami qabeele se taalluq rakhta hoon.

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Ek baar ham masjid mein Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath baithe hue the ki itne mein oont par sawaar hokar ek vyakti aya aur apne oont ko masjid mein bithaakar baandh diya, phir poochhne laga ki tummen se Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) kaun hain ? Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam us samay sahaaba kiraam radiyallahu anhum ke beech tek lagaakar baithe hue the . Hamne kaha : Yeh safed rang waale vyakti jo tek lagaakar baithe hue hain, Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) hain. Tab woh aapse kahne laga : Ai abdul muttalib ke bete! Ispar aapne farmaya : Jo kahna hai, kaho! Main tujhe jawaab deta hoon. Phir us aadmi ne aapse kaha ki main aapse kuchh poochhne waala hoon aur poochhne mein sakhti se kaam loonga. Aap dil mein mujhpar naaraaz na hon. Yeh sun aapne farmaya : Koi baat nahin jo poochhna hai, poochho.To usne kaha ki main aapko aapke rab aur aapse pahle waale logon ke rab ki qasam dekar poochhta hoon, kya Allah ne aapko tamaam insaanon ki taraf Nabi banaakar bheja hai? Aapne farmaya : Haan Allah gawaah hai. Phir usne kaha : Aapko Allah ki qasam dekar poochhta hoon kya Allah ne aapko din raat mein paanch namaazen parhne ka aadesh diya hai? Aapne farmaya : Haan Allah gawaah hai  phir usne kaha : Main aapko Allah ki qasam dekar poochhta hoon ki kya Allah ne saal bhar mein Ramzan ke roze rakhne ka aadesh diya hai? Aapne farmaya : Haan, Allah gawaah hai. Phir kahne laga : Main aapko Allah ki qasam dekar poochhta hoon ki kya Allah ne aapko aadesh diya hai ki aap hamaare maaldaaron se sadqa lekar hamaare nirdhanon mein baant den? Aapne farmaya : Haan Allah gawaah hai. Uske baad woh aadmi kahne laga : Main us (shareeyat) par eemaan laata hoon, jo aap laye hain. Main apni qaum ka pratinidhi bankar aapki sewa mein upasthit hua hoon, mera naam zimaam bin saalba hai aur main saad bin abi bakr naami qabeele se taalluq rakhta hoon.

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu bayaan kar rahe hain : Ek din sahaaba Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath masjid mein baithe hue the ki achaanak ek vyakti oont par sawaar hokar aya aur use masjid mein bithaakar baandh diya. Uske baad sahaaba se poochha ki tummen se kaun Muhammad hai? Us samay Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam logon ke beech tek lagaakar baithe hue the. Atah hamne kaha ki yeh tek lagaakar baithe hue gore vyakti Muhammad hain. Chunaanche us vyakti ne aapko sanbodhit karte hue kaha : Ai abdul muttalib ke bete! Uttar mein aapne kaha : Main tumhaari baat sun raha hoon. Tum poochho, main tumhaare sawaal ka jawaab doonga. Us vyakti ne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se kaha ki main aapse kuchh baaten poochhoonga aur zara sakhti se poochhoonga, isliye aap mujhpar naaraaz na hon. Yaani aap krodhit tatha wichlit na hon. Yeh sun aapne kaha : Jo poochhna hai, poochho. Us vyakti ne kaha : Main aapse aapke tatha aapse pahle logon ke rab ki qasam dekar poochhta hoon ki kya Allah ne aapko tamaam logon ki or Rasool banaakar bheja hai? Aapne uttar diya : Allah gawaah hai ki yeh baat saty hai. Aapne Allah ko gawaah apni baat ki satyata ko sthaapit karne ke liye kahi. Us vyakti ne kaha : Main aapse Allah ki qasam dekar poochhta hoon ki kya Allah ne aapko is baat ka aadesh diya hai ki ham din aur raat mein paanch waqt ki namaazen padhen? Aapne kaha : Main Allah ko gawaah banaakar kahta hoon ki yeh baat sachchi hai. Usne kaha : Main aapse Allah ki qasam dekar poochhta hoon ki kya Allah ne aapko aadesh diya hai ki ham saal mein is maheene yaani Ramzan maheene ke roze rakhen? Aapne kaha : Main Allah ko gawaah banaakar kahta hoon ki yeh baat sachchi hai. Us vyakti ne kaha : Main aapse Allah ki qasam dekar poochhta hoon ki kya Allah ne aapko is baat ka aadesh diya hai ki aap hamaare maaldaar logon se yeh zakat len aur hamaare ghareebon ke beech baant den? Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Main Allah ko gawaah banaakar kahta hoon ki yeh baat sachchi hai. Yeh sab kuchh sunne ke baad woh vyakti, jiska naam zimaam bin saalba tha, musalmaan ho gaya aur Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko bataya ki woh apni qaum ko Islam ki or bulayenge. Phir, bataya ki unka naam zimaam bin saalba hai aur woh banu saad bin bakr qabeele se hai.

Allah ke Nabi ki winamrata ki woh vyakti aapke tatha any sahaaba ke beech antar nahin kar saka.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka aadarsh aachran tatha sawaal poochhne waale ka jawaab dene mein narm andaaz. Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki sawaal ka achchhi tarah jawaab dena aahvaan ke qabool hone ka ek sabab hai.
Kisi vyakti ke parichay ke liye gora, laal, lanba aur chhota aadi wisheshtayen bayaan ki ja sakti hain, yadi uddeshy aib nikaalna na ho aur ise sannbandhit bura na jaane.
Koi zaroorat ho, to kaafir masjid mein prawesh kar sakta hai.
Is hadees mein Hajj ka zikr nahin hai, kyonki ho sakta hai ki us samay Hajj farz na hua ho.
Sahaaba gan Islam ki or bulaane ke liye hamesha tatpar raha karte the. Kyonki woh vyakti Islam laane ke baad hi apni qaum ko Islam ki or bulaane ki baat karne laga.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65045: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kisi cheez ka zikr kiya aur farmaya : "Yeh us samay hoga, jab jnaan chala jayega

Ziyaad bin labeed radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kisi cheez ka zikr kiya aur farmaya : "Yeh us samay hoga, jab jnaan chala jayega." Mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Jnaan kaise chala jayega, jabki ham Qur'an parh rahe hain, apne bachchon ko parha raha hai aur hamaare bachche apne bachchon ko qayaamat ke din tak parhaate rahenge? Aapne farmaya : "Ai ziyaad! Tumhaari maan tumpar roe. Main to tumko madeene ke sabse samajhdaar logon mein se samajhta tha. Kya ye yahoodi tatha eesaai tauraat tatha injeel ko parhte nahin hain, jabki doosri taraf haqeeqat yeh hai ke ye log in donon kitaabon ki shikshaaon par amal nahin karte?"

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apne saathiyon ke beech baithe hue the ki isi dauraan farmaya ki amuk baat us samay hogi, jab logon se jnaan chheen liya jayega, tatha use utha liya jayega. Isse ziyaad bin labeed ansaari ko aashchary hua to unhonne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochh liya. Jnaan hamse kaise chheena jaega tatha utha liya jayega, jabki hamne Qur'an ko parha aur yaad kar liya hai aur Allah ki qasam aage bhi parhte rahenge, phir ham use apni aurton aur bachchon ko bhi parhayenge aur hamaare bachche apne bachchon ko parhayenge? Ispar Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aashchary vyakt karte hue farmaya : Ai ziyaad! Tumhaari maan tumko gum kare, main to tumko madeene ke widvaanon mein ginta tha. Iske baad Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne spasht roop se bata diya jnaan ke uth jaane ka arth Qur'an ka uth jaana nahin hai. Apitu jnaan ke uth jaane ka arth Qur'an par amal ka khatm ho jaana hai. Kyonki yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon ke paas tauraat evn injeel maujood hai, lekin isse unko koi laabh na hua aur we uske asal uddeshy ko praapt nahin kar sake. Unhon apne jnaan ke anusaar amal nahin kiya.

Agar amal na ho, to saath mein mushaf (granth) evn kitaaben rahne ka koi fayda nahin hai.
Jnaan ko utha liye jaane ka kaary kai baaton ke maadhyam se hoga, jinmen Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki mrityu, ulema ki mrityu aur jnaan par amal na karna aadi shaamil hain.
Qayaamat ki nishaaniyon mein se ek nishaani jnaan ka chala jaana aur uspar amal na karna hai.
Seekhe hue jnaan par amal karne ki prerna, kyonki wahi asal uddeshy hai.
[saheeh li-ghairihi (any sandon athva riwayton se milkar saheeh)]
[ise ibne maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
65046: Ahl-e-kitaab ki na to pushti karo aur na unko jhuthlaao. Bas itna kaho : {ham Allah par eemaan laye aur uspar jo hamaari or utaara gaya.}

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha: Ahl-e-kitaab tauraat ibraani bhaasha mein parhte aur musalmaanon ke liye arbi bhaasha mein uski vyaakhya karte the. Is sandarbh mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Ahl-e-kitaab ki na to pushti karo aur na unko jhuthlaao. Bas itna kaho : {ham Allah par eemaan laye aur uspar jo hamaari or utaara gaya.}" [soora al-baqra : 136]

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apni ummat ko un baaton ke dhokhe mein aane se mana kiya hai, jo ahl-e-kitaab apni kitaabon ke hawaale se naqal karte hain. Kyonki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke zamaane mein ahl-kitaab ibraani zabaan mein, jo ki yahoodiyon ki zabaan hai, tauraat parhte the  aur uski vyaakhya arbi bhaasha mein karte the. Chunaaेche is sanbandh mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Ahl-e-kitaab ki na to pushti karo aur na unko jhuthlaao. Lekin yeh nirdesh un maslon ke baare mein hai, jinka sahi ya galat hona spasht na ho. Iska kaaran yeh hai ki Allah ne hamen aadesh diya hai ki ham apne oopar utarne waale Qur'an tatha ahl-e-kitaab par utarne waali kitaabon par eemaan rakhen, lekin yeh jaanne ka hamaare paas koi raasta nahin hai ki unki kitaabon ka kaun-sa bhaag surakshit hai aur kaun-sa bhaag surakshit nahin hai. Kyonki hamaari shareeyat ne un kitaabon mein likhi har baat ke baare mein yeh nirnay nahin diya hai ki woh sahi hai ya galat. Isliye ham kuchh bhi kahne se bachenge. Na to pushti karenge ki unke chher-chhaar ke amal mein unke bhaageedaar ban jayen aur na jhuthlayenge ki ho sakta hai ki woh sahi ho aur aise mein ham us cheez ko jhuthlaane waale ban jayen, jispar wishvaas rakhne ka hamen aadesh diya gaya hai. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne hamen yeh kahne ka aadesh diya hai : "Ham Allah par eemaan laye aur uspar jo hamaari or utaara gaya, aur jo ibraaheem aur ismaaeel aur ishaaq aur yaaqoob tatha unki santaan ki or utaara gaya, aur jo moosa evn eesa ko diya gaya tatha jo samast nabiyon ko unke rab ki or se diya gaya. Ham unmen se kisi ek ke beech antar nahin karte aur ham usi Allah ke aajnaakaari hain." [soora al-baqra : 136]

Ahl-e-kitaab jo kuchh bataate hain, uske teen bhaag hain : Pahla bhaag woh hai, jo Qur'an evn hadees ke anuroop ho. Is bhaag ki pushti ki jayegi. Doosra bhaag woh hai, jo Qur'an evn hadees ke wiruddh ho. Is bhaag ko jhuthlaya jayega. Teesra bhaag woh hai, jiske sachche ya jhoothe hone ki baat Qur'an evn hadees se maaloom na hoti ho. Is bhaag ko riwayat to kiya jayega, lekin iski na to pushti ki jayegi aur na ise jhuthlaya jayega.
65047: Jnaan isliye na arjit karo ki ulema se bahas kar sako aur ajnaan logon se jhagar sako

Jaabir bin abdullah radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jnaan isliye na arjit karo ki ulema se bahas kar sako aur ajnaan logon se jhagar sako. Iske dvaara sabhaaon mein shreshth sthaanon par qabza na karo. Jisne aisa kiya, uska thikna Jahannam hai, uska thikaana Jahannam hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is uddeshy se jnaan arjit karne se mana kiya hai ki ulema se bahas ki jaye aur bataya jaye ki main bhi tumhaare jaisa aalim hoon athva ajnaan tatha naadaan logon se bahas ki jaye. Is neeyat se bhi jnaan arjit karne se mana kiya hai ki sabhaaon mein aage baithne ka avsar mile. Jisne aisa kiya woh apni riyaakaari (dikhaawa) ke kaaran Jahannam ka haqdaar hoga.

Us vyakti ko Jahannam mein jaane ki chetaavni di gai hai, jo abhimaan karne, bahas karne aur sabhaaon mein aage baithne ki neeyat se jnaan praapt kare.
Jnaan seekhne tatha sikhaane ka kaam Allah ke liye karne ka mahatv.
Saare karmon ka aadhaar neeyat par hai aur usi ke anusaar pratiphal milta hai.
[ise ibne maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
65049: Allah ne ek udaahran diya hai. Ek seedha raasta hai

Navvaas bin samaaan ansaari radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Allah ne ek udaahran diya hai. Ek seedha raasta hai. Raaste ke donon or do deewaaren hain. Donon deewaaron mein kuchh dvaar khule hain. Un dvaaron par parde latke hue hain.  Raaste ke dvaar par pukaarne waala kah raha hai : Ai logo! Sab ke sab is raah mein daakhil jaao aur idhar-udhar na bhathko. Jabki ek aur pukaarne waala raaste ke oopar se pukaar raha hai. Jab koi banda un dvaaron mein se kisi dvaar ko kholna chaahta hai, to kahta hai : Tera bura ho, ise mat khol. Agar tu ise kholega, to ismen ghus jayega. Woh raast Islam hai, donon deewaaren Allah ki seemayen hain, khule hue dvaar Allah ki haraam ki hui cheezen hain, raaste ke ek sire par upasthit pukaarne waale Allah ki kitaab hai aur raaste ke oopar se pukaarne waala har musalmaan ke dil mein maujood Allah ka naseehat karne waala hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki Allah ne Islam ka udaahran ek aise seedhe raaste se diya hai, jismen kaheen koi terhaapan nahin hai, is raaste ke donon taraph do deewaaren hain, jo use donon taraf se gheri hui hain, in donon deewaaron se muraad Allah ki seemayen hain, in donon deewaaron par beech-beech mein khule dvaar hain, jinse muraad Allah ki haraam ki hui cheezen hain, un dvaaron par parde latke hue hain, jo raaste se guzarne waale ko pata hone nahin dete ki andar kya hai, raaste ke aaranbh mein ek pukaarne waala hai, jo logon ka maargadarshan karte hue kahta hai : Raaste par seedhe chalte raho aur idhar-udhar na bhatko. Yeh pukaarne waala Allah ki kitaab hai. Ek aur pukaarne waala raaste ke oopar niyukt hai. Raaste mein chalne waala jab bhi kisi dvaar par latke parde ko thora-bahut hataana chaahta hai, to yeh pukaarne waala use daantta hai aur kahta hai : Tera bura ho, ise na khol. Agar ise kholega, to ismen ghus jayega aur ismen prawesh karne se khud ko rok na sakega. Yeh pukaarne waala har musalmaan ke dil mein maujood Allah ka updesh dene waala hai.

Islam hi sachcha dharm hai. Yahi sahi raasta hai, jo hamen Jannat ki or le jaata hai.
Allah ki seemaaon tatha uski halaal evn haraam ki hui cheezon ka khyaal rakhna zaroori hai aur inke baare mein kotaahi karna winaash ka kaaran banta hai.
Qur'an ki fazeelat aur uspar amal karne ki prerna. Ismen hidayat, noor aur saphalta hai.
Apne bandon par Allah ki rahmat, yahi kaaran hai ki Allah ne apne momin bandon ke dilon mein ek aisi cheez rakh di hai, jo use winaash ki or jaane se rokti hai.
Yeh Allah ki rahmat hai ki usne apne bandon ke liye gunaahon mein parne ke maarg mein baadhayen utpann kar di hain.
Shiksha ka ek saadhan baat ko aasaani se samjhaane ke liye udaahran dena bhi hai.
[ise tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
65050: Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par chaalees saal ki umr mein

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma se warnit hai, unhonne kaha: Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par chaalees saal ki umr mein wahy utri. Phir aap terah saal tak makka mein rahe. Uske baad aapko hijrat (palayan) ka aadesh hua to aapne madeena ki taraph hijrat (palayan) kiya aur aap wahaan das baras rahe. Iske baad aapne mrityu paai.

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma bata rahe hain ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par jab pahli wahy utri aur aapko Nabi banaya gaya, to aapki umr chaalees saal thi. Pahli wahy utarne ke baad aap makka mein terah saal rahe. Phir madeene ki or palayan karke chale jaane ka aadesh hua, to aap madeena chale gae aur wahaan das saal rahe. Phir tirsath saal ki umr mein wafaat paai.
Sahaaba Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki seerat se khaas dilchaspi rakhte the.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65051: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ek soora khatm hokar doosra soora shuru hone ki baat jaan nahin paate, jab tak aappar "Bismillahir rahmaanir raheem" Na utarti.

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : "Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ek soora khatm hokar doosra soora shuru hone ki baat jaan nahin paate, jab tak aappar "Bismillahir rahmaanir raheem" Na utarti."

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma bata rahe hain ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par Qur'an ki soorten utarteen, to aap ek soora ke khatm hone tatha doosri soora ke shuru hone ki baat us samay tak jaan nahin paate, jab tak aappar "Bismillahir rahmaanir raheem" Na utarti. Jab bismillah utarti, to pata hota ki pahli soora khatm ho gai hai aur ek nai soora shuru ho gai hai.
Bismillah ke dvaara soorton ko ek-doosre se alag kiya jaata hai. Siway soora al-anfaal aur soora al-tauba ke.
[ise abu daawood ne riwayat kiya hai]
65053: Kya tummen se kisi ko yeh pasand hai ki jab woh apne pariwaar ki or laute, to wahaan teen bari-bari aur moti-moti gaabhin oontniyaan paye?

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, unhonne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Kya tummen se kisi ko yeh pasand hai ki jab woh apne pariwaar ki or laute, to wahaan teen bari-bari aur moti-moti gaabhin oontniyaan paye?" Hamne kaha : Awashy hi. Aapne kaha : "Apni namaz mein tummen se kisi ka teen ayten parhna, uske liye teen bari-bari aur moti-moti gaabhin oontniyon se behtar hai."
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki namaz mein teen ayton ka parhna is baat se uttam hai ki aadmi teen moti-moti aur bari-bari gaabhin oontniyaan apne ghar mein paye.

Namaz mein Qur'an parhne ki fazeelat ka bayaan.
Achchhe kaary duniya ki nashvar cheezon se uttam hain.
Yeh fazeelat (mahatv) kewal teen ayton ko parhne hi ke saath jura hua nahin hai. Insaan apni namaz mein jitni zyaada ayten parhega, uska sawaab utna hi barhta chala jayega.
65054: Qur'an parhne waale se kaha jayega ki parhte jaao aur charhte jaao. Saath hi tum usi tarah thahar-thahar kar parho, jis tarah duniya mein thahar-thahar kar parha karte the. Tumhaare dvaara parhi gai antim ayat ke sthaan par tumhen rahne ke liye jagah milegi.

Abdullah bin amr radiyallahu anhuma se warnit hai, unhonne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ne farmaya : "Qur'an parhne waale se kaha jayega ki parhte jaao aur charhte jaao. Saath hi tum usi tarah thahar-thahar kar parho, jis tarah duniya mein thahar-thahar kar parha karte the. Tumhaare dvaara parhi gai antim ayat ke sthaan par tumhen rahne ke liye jagah milegi."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki Qur'an parhne, uspar amal karne waale tatha use yaad karne aur uski tilaawat karne waale se, jab woh Jannat mein prawesh karega, kaha jayega ki Qur'an parhte jaao aur Jannat mein charhte jaao. Qur'an parhne ka kaam usi tarah thahar-thahar kar karo, jaise thahar-thahar kar aur sthirta ke saath kiya karte the. Tumhen rahne ke liye sthaan waheen milega, jahaan tum antim ayat parhoge.

Pratiphal karmon ke anusaar milega. Maatra mein bhi aur gunvatta mein bhi.
Qur'an ki tilaawat karne, use yaad karne, uspar soch-wichaar karne aur uspar amal karne ka mahatv.
Jannat mein bahut-si manzilen aur darje hain. Qur'an waale log uske sarvochch darje praapt karenge.
[ise abu daawood ne, tirmizi ne tatha nasai ne al-sunan al-kubra mein evn ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
65055: Khule taur par Qur'an parhne waala khule taur par sadqa karne waale ki tarah hai. Jabki chhupaakar Qur'an parhne waala chhupaakar sadqa karne waale ki tarah hai.

Uqba bin aamir juhni radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Khule taur par Qur'an parhne waala khule taur par sadqa karne waale ki tarah hai. Jabki chhupaakar Qur'an parhne waala chhupaakar sadqa karne waale ki tarah hai."

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki khule taur par Qur'an parhne waala khule taur par sadqa karne waale ki tarah hai. Jabki chhupaakar Qur'an parhne waala chhupaakar sadqa karne waale ki tarah hai.

Chhupaakar Qur'an parhna uttam hai, jaise ki chhupaakar sadqa karna uttam hai. Kyonki ismen ikhlaas (nishtha) hota hai aur riya tatha abhimaan se doori hoti hai. Haan, agar khule taur par karne ki zaroorat evn masalhat ho, jaise Qur'an ki shiksha dena aadi, to baat alag hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi aur nasai ne riwayat kiya hai]
65057: Tum Allah se darte rahna aur apne shaaskon ke aadesh sunna tatha maanna. Chaahe shaasak ek habshi ghulaam hi kyon na ho. Tum mere baad bahut zyaada matbhed dekhoge. Atah tum meri sunnat tatha nek aur saty ke maarg par chalne waale khaleefaagan ki sunnat par chalte rahna.

Irbaaz bin saariya se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Ek din Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam hamaare beech khare hue aur aisa prabhaavshaali waktavy rakha ki hamaare dil dahal gae aur aankhen bah pareen. Atah kisi ne kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Aapne hamen ek widaai ke samay sanbodhan karne waale ki tarah sanbodhit kiya hai. Atah aap hamen kuchh waseeyat karen. Tab aapne kaha : "Tum Allah se darte rahna aur apne shaaskon ke aadesh sunna tatha maanna. Chaahe shaasak ek habshi ghulaam hi kyon na ho. Tum mere baad bahut zyaada matbhed dekhoge. Atah tum meri sunnat tatha nek aur saty ke maarg par chalne waale khaleefaagan ki sunnat par chalte rahna. Ise daarhon se pakre rahna. Saath hi tum deen ke naam par saamne aane waali nai-nai cheezon se bhi bache rahna. Kyonki har bidaat (deen ke naam par saamne aane waali nai cheez) gumraahi hai.

Ek din Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne saathiyon ko sanbodhit kiya. Sanbodhan itna prabhaavshaali tha ki usse logon ke dil dahal gae aur aankhen bah pareen. Yeh dekh aapke saathiyon ne kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Aisa prateet hota hai ki yeh widaai ke samay ka sanbodhan hai. Kyonki unhonne dekha ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne sanbodhan ke samay apna dil nikaal kar rakh diya. Atah unhonne aapse kuchh waseeyat karne ko kaha, taaki aapke baad use mazbooti se pakre rahen. Chunaanche aapne kaha : Main tumko sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah se darne ki waseeyat karta hoon. Yahaan yeh yaad rahe ki Allah se darne ka matlab hai, uski aniwaary ki hui cheezon ka paalan karna aur uski haraam ki hui cheezon se door rahna. Isi tarah main tumko shaaskon ke aadesh sunne evn maanne ki waseeyat karta hoon. Chaahe tumhaara shaasak koi habshi gulaam hi kyon na ho. Yaani ek maamooli se maamooli insaan bhi agar tumhaara shaasak ban jaye, to tum usse door mat bhaago balki tum uski baat maano, taaki fitne sar na utha saken. Kyonki tummen se jo log jeewit rahenge, woh bahut saara matbhed dekhenge. Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne saathiyon ko is matbhed se nikalne ka raasta bataya. Woh yeh hai ki aapki sunnat tatha aapke baad shaasan sanbhaalne waale aur saty ke maarg par chalne waale khaleefaagan, abu bakr siddeeq, umar bin khattaab, usmaan bin affaan aur ali bin abu taalib radiyallahu anhum ki sunnat ko mazbooti se pakarkar rakha jaye. Aapne ise daarhon se pakarne ki baat kahi hai. Yaani har haal mein sunnat ka paalan kiya jaye aur use poori taaqat se pakarkar rakha jaye. Uske baad aapne unko deen ke naam par saamne aane waali nai cheezon se saavdhaan kiya. Kyonki deen ke naam par saamne aane waali har nai cheez gumraahi hai.

Sunnat ko mazbooti se pakarne aur uska anusran karne ka mahatv.
Updesh dene aur dilon ko narm karne par dhyaan.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke baad shaasan sanbhaalne waale aur saty ke maarg par chalne waale khaleefaagan yaani abu bakr siddeeq, umar faarooq, usmaan bin affaan aur ali bin abu taalib radiyallahu anhum ke anusran ka aadesh.
Deen ke naam par nai cheezen awishkaar karne ki manaahi aur yeh ki deen ke naam par saamne aane waali har nai cheez bidaat hai.
Musalmaanon ka shaasan sanbhaalne waale shaaskon ki baat sunna tatha maanna zaroori hai, jab tak we kisi gunaah ke kaam ka aadesh na den.
Har samay aur har haal mein Allah ka bhay rakhne ka mahatv.
Is ummat mein matbhed saamne aana hai aur jab matbhed saamne aye, to Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aur saty ke maarg par chalne waale khaleefaagan ki sunnat ki or lautna zaroori hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
65059: Allah ki qasam! Ai abul munzir! Tumko yeh jnaan mubaarak ho.

Ubay bin kaab radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Ai abul munzir! Kya tum jaanto ho ki tumhaare paas maujood Allah ki kitaab ki kaun-si ayat sabse mahaan hai?" Woh kahte hain ki mainne kaha : Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain. Aapne kaha : "Ai abul munzir! Kya tum jaanto ho ki tumhaare paas maujood Allah ki kitaab ki kaun-si ayat sabse mahaan hai?" Woh kahte hain ki mainne kaha : {اللهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ} [soora al-baqra : 255] woh kahte hain : Yeh sun aap ne mere seene par maara aur farmaya : "Allah ki qasam! Ai abul munzir! Tumko yeh jnaan mubaarak ho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ubay bin kaab radiyallahu anhu se poochha ki Qur'an ki kaun-si ayat sabse mahaan hai? Chunaanche ubay bin kaab ne pahle to iska uttar dene mein sankoch kiya, lekin phir bataya ki woh ayat al-kursi hai. Yaani {الله لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم}. Chunaanche Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unki pushti ki aur unke seene par is baat ka ishaara karte hue maara ki woh jnaan tatha hikmat se bhara hua hai. Saath hi aapne unke liye dua ki ki unko yeh jnaan mubaarak ho aur unke liye jnaan arjit karna aasaan ho jaye.

Ubay bin kaab ki bahut bari fazeelat.
Ayat al-kursi Qur'an ki sabse mahaan ayat hai. Isliye ise yaad karna, iske arth ko samajhna aur ispar amal karna chahiye.
65060: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab pratyek raat bistar mein jaate, to apni donon hatheliyon ko jama karte, phir unmen phoonkte aur unmen "Qul hu-wallahu ahad", "Qul aoozu bi-rabbil falaq" Aur "Qul aoozu bi-rabbin naas

Aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab pratyek raat bistar mein jaate, to apni donon hatheliyon ko jama karte, phir unmen phoonkte aur unmen "Qul hu-wallahu ahad", "Qul aoozu bi-rabbil falaq" Aur "Qul aoozu bi-rabbin naas" Teenon soorten parhte aur donon hatheliyon ko jahaan tak sanbhav hota apne shareer par pherte. Haath pherne ka aaranbh apne sar, chehre aur shareer ke agle bhaag se karte. Aisa teen baar karte.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka tareeqa yeh tha ki jab sone ke liye bistar par jaate, to donon hatheliyon ko jama karte, unko uthaate (jaisa dua karne waala karta hai), unmen apne munh se maamooli thook ke saath phoonk maarte aur teen soorten; "Qul hu-wallahu ahad", "Qul aoozu bi-rabbil falaq" Aur "Qul aoozu bi-rabbin naas" Parhte, phir jahaan tak ho paata, apni donon hatheliyon ko poore shareer par pherte. Iska aaranbh apne sar, chehre aur apne shareer ke agle bhaag se karte. Is amal ko teen baar dohraate.
Sone se pahle soora ikhlaas, soora falaq aur naas ko parhna, apni hatheliyon mein phoonkna aur jahaan tak ho sake, apne shareer par haath pherna musathab hai.
65061: Yahoodi woh log hain, jinpar Allah ka prakop hua aur eesaai woh log hain, jo gumraah hain.
Adi bin haatim radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Yahoodi woh log hain, jinpar Allah ka prakop hua aur eesaai woh log hain, jo gumraah hain."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki yahoodi ek aisa sanpraday hai, jise Allah ke prakop ka saamna karna para, kyonki unhonne haq ko jaante hue bhi uspar amal nahin kiya. Jabki eesaai ek gumraah sanpraday hai, jinhonne bina jnaan ke amal kiya.

Jnaan evn amal donon ka ek saath jama hona prakop ke shikaar hone waale aur gumraah logon ke raaste se mukti ka kaaran hai.
Ismen yahoodiyon evn eesaaiyon ke raaste se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai, aur seedhe raaste yaani Islam ko aniwaary roop se pakre rahne ki prerna di gai hai.
Yahoodi evn eesaai donon gumraah aur prakop ke shikaar log hain, lekin yahoodiyon ka sabse wishisht wisheshta prakop ka shikaar hona aur eesaaiyon ka sabse wishisht wisheshta gumraah ho jaana hai.
65062: Jab tum aise logon ko dekho, jo Qur'an ki sadrish ayton ka anusran karte hon, to jaan lo ki unheen ka naam Allah ne liya hai. Atah unse saavdhaan rahna

Aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne yeh ayat parhi : "(Ai Nabi!) wahi hai jisne aap par yeh pustak utaari, jismen se kuchh ayten muhkam hain, wahi pustak ka mool hain, tatha kuchh doosri (ayten) mutshaabeh hain. Phir jinke dilon mein terh hai, to we fitne ki talaash mein tatha uske asal aashay ki talaash ke uddeshy se, sadrish arthon waali ayton ka anusran karte hain. Haalaanki unka waastawik arth Allah ke siwa koi nahin jaanta. Tatha jo log jnaan mein pakke hain, we kahte hain ham uspar eemaan laye, sab hamaare rab ki or se hai. Aur shiksha wahi log grahan karte hain, jo buddhi waale hain." [soora aal-e-imraan : 7] unka kahna hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jab tum aise logon ko dekho, jo Qur'an ki sadrish ayton ka anusran karte hon, to jaan lo ki unheen ka naam Allah ne liya hai. Atah unse saavdhaan rahna."

Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne yeh ayat parhi : "(Ai Nabi!) wahi hai jisne aap par yeh pustak utaari, jismen se kuchh ayten muhkam hain, wahi pustak ka mool hain, tatha kuchh doosri ayten mutshaabeh hain. Phir jinke dilon mein terh hai, to we fitne ki talaash mein tatha uske asal aashay ki talaash ke uddeshy se, sadrish arthon waali ayton ka anusran karte hain. Haalaanki unka waastawik arth Allah ke siwa koi nahin jaanta. Tatha jo log jnaan mein pakke hain, we kahte hain ham uspar eemaan laye, sab hamaare rab ki aur se hai. Aur shiksha wahi log grahan karte hain, jo buddhi waale hain." Is ayat mein Allah paak ne bataya hai ki usi ne apne Nabi par Qur'an utaara hai, jiski kuchh ayton ka arth bilkul spasht hai aur yahi ayten Qur'an ka mool hain tatha wibhed ke samay inheen ki or lauta jayega. Jabki uski kuchh ayten ek se adhik maynon ki sanbhaavna rakhti hain, kuchh logon ke saamne unka arth spasht nahin ho paata ya aisa lagta hai ki unke tatha any ayton ke beech mein takraav hai. Phir Allah ne bataya ki in ayton ke baare mein logon ka rawaiya kaisa rahta hai? Jin logon ke dil saty se hate hue hain, we spasht arth waali ayton ko chhor kar ek se adhik arth ki sanbhaavna rakhne waali ayton ko lete hain. Isse unka uddeshy sandeh paida karna aur logon ko gumraah karna hota hai. We in ayton ka arth apni ichchha anusaar nikaalte hain.
