Iske wipreet gahre jnaan waale logon ko pata hota hai ki yeh ayten ek se adhik arth ki sanbhaavna waali hain, isliye we inki vyaakhya spasht arth waali ayton ke aalok mein karte hain aur is baat par wishvaas rakhte hain ki yeh saari ayten uchch evn pawitr Allah ki utaari hui hain, isliye inmen paraspar takraav nahin ho sakta. Lekin isse shiksha wahi log praapt kar sakte hain, jo svachchh wiwek rakhte hain. Phir Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne eemaan waalon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha se kaha ki jab tum aise logon ko dekho, jo Qur'an ki mutshaabeh ayton ke peechhe parte hon, to samajh jaao ki yahi woh log hain, jinka zikr Allah ne in shabdon mein kiya hai : "Phir jinke dilon mein terh hai." Atah in logon se sachet raho aur inki baat par dhyaan na do.

Qur'an ki muhkam ayton se muraad woh ayten hain, jinka arth spasht ho. Jabki mutshaabeh se muraad woh ayten hain, jinke ek se adhik mayne hone ki sanbhaavna ho aur jinmen ghaur wa fikr karne ki zaroorat ho.
Is hadees mein gumraahon, bidaatiyon aur logon ko gumraah karne aur sandeh mein daalne ke liye ulajhnen khari karne waalon ke saath uthne-baichhne se saavdhaan kiya hai.
Ayat ke ant mein "Aur shiksha wahi log grahan karte hain, jo buddhi waale hain" Kahkar gumraah logon ki bhartsana aur mazboot jnaan waale logon ki prashansa ki gai hai. Iska arth yeh hua ki jisne shiksha grahan nahin ki aur manmaani karta raha, woh buddhimaan nahin hai.
Mutshaabeh ayton ka anusran dil ki gumraahi ka kaaran hai.
Mutshaabeh ayton ko muhkam ayton ke aalok mein dekha evn samjha jaana zaroori hai.
Allah ne Qur'an ki kuchh ayton ko muhkam aur kuchh ayton ko mutshaabeh banaya hai, taaki is baat ki parakh ho sake ki kaun eemaan waala hai aur kaun eemaan waala nahin hai.
Qur'an ke andar mutshaabeh ayton ki upasthiti daraasal ulema ki ghair-ulema par utkrishtata ko pradarshit karti hai aur maanav wiwek ke seemit hone ko ingit karti hai. Taaki manushy apne paida karne waale ke aage natmastak hojaye, aur apni akshamta ko sveekaar kare.
Mazboot jnaan ki fazeelat tatha uspar jame rahne ki aawashyakta.
Allah ke kathan { وما يعلم تأويله إلا الله والراسخون في العلم } mein {الله} shabd par rukne ke sanbandh mein mufassiron ke do mat hain. Jo log {الله} shabd par rukte hain, unki nazar mein {تأويل} se muraad kisi cheez ki haqeeqat aur waastawikta tatha aisi baaton ko jaanna hai, jinko jaanna insaan ke liye sanbhav nahin hai, jaise aatma aur qayaamat aadi cheezen, jinka jnaan Allah ne apne paas rakha hai. Gahre jnaan waale log in cheezon par wishvaas rakhte hain aur inki haqeeqat ki jaankaari ko Allah ke hawaale kar dete hain. Doosri taraf jo log {الله} shabd par rukte nahin hain aur use aage se milaakar parhte hain, unki nazar mein {تأويل} se muraad tafseer evn vyaakhya hai. Unke mutaabik in ayton ki vyaakhya Allah ke saath-saath gahre jnaan waale log bhi jaante hain, jo muhkam ayton ke aalok mein unki vyaakhya karte hain aur unpar wishvaas rakhte hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65063: Koi bhi banda jab koi gunaah karta hai, phir khare hokar pawitrata arjan karta hai, phir namaz parhta hai, phir Allah se kshama yaachna karta hai, to Allah use kshama kar deta hai

Ali radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Main ek aisa vyakti tha ki jab Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se koi hadees sunta, to usse Allah mujhe jitna fayda pahunchaana chaahta, pahunchaata. Aur jab aapka koi saathi mujhe koi hadees sunaata, to main use qasam khaane ko kahta. Jab woh mere kahne par qasam kha leta, to main uski baat ki pushti karta. Mujhe abu bakr radiyallahu anhu ne bataya hai aur unhonne sach kaha hai ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Koi bhi banda jab koi gunaah karta hai, phir khare hokar pawitrata arjan karta hai, phir namaz parhta hai, phir Allah se kshama yaachna karta hai, to Allah use kshama kar deta hai." Phir aapne yeh ayat parhi : {وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُوا فَاحِشَةً أَوْ ظَلَمُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا اللهَ فَاسْتَغْفَرُوا لِذُنُوبِهِمْ} "Aur jab kabhi we koi bara paap kar jayen athva apne oopar atyaachaar kar len, to Allah ko yaad karte hain, phir apne paapon ke liye kshama maangte hain." [soora aal-e-imraan: 135]

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki jab koi banda koi gunaah karta hai, phir achchhi tarah wazu karta hai, phir khare hokar apne is gunaah se tauba karne ki neeyat se do rakaat namaz parhta hai aur phir Allah se kshama maangta hai, to Allah use kshama kar deta hai. Phir Allah ke Nabi salllalaahu alaihi wa sallam ne yeh ayat parhi : "Aur jab kabhi we koi bara paap kar jayen athva apne oopar atyaachaar kar len, to Allah ko yaad karte hain, phir apne paapon ke liye kshama maangte hain -tatha Allah ke siwa kaun hai, jo paapon ko kshama kare?- aur apne kiye par jaan-boojh kar are nahin rahte." [soora aal-e-imraan: 135]

Gunaah ho jaane ke baad namaz parhne aur Allah se kshama maangne ki prerna.
Allah bara kshamaasheel hai aur apne bande ki tauba tatha kshama yaachna grahan karta hai.
[ise abu daawood ne, tirmizi ne tatha nasai ne al-kubra mein isi prakaar ibn-e-maajah ne aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
65065: Unke dvaara ki gai tum se wishvaasghaat, awajna tatha tumse jhooth bolne aur tumhaare dvaara unko di gai saza ka hisaab hoga

Aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai : Ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saamne baitha aur bola : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mere kuchh ghulaam hain. Woh mujhse jhooth bolte hain, mere saath wishvaasghaat karte hain aur meri awajna karte hain. Jabki main unko gaali deta hoon aur maarta hoon. Unke saath mere is bartaav ke kaaran mera haal kya hoga?  Aapne kaha : "Unke dvaara ki gai tum se wishvaasghaat, awajna tatha tumse jhooth bolne aur tumhaare dvaara unko di gai saza ka hisaab hoga. Agar tumhaare dvaara unko di gai saza unke gunaahon ke baraabar hogi, to kaafi hogi. Na tumhaare haq mein jayegi aur na tumhaare wiruddh. Lekin agar tumhaare dvaara unko di gai saza unke gunaahon se kam hogi, to tumhaare haq mein jayegi. Jabki agar tumhaare dvaara unko di gai saza unke gunaahon se adhik hogi, to unko di gai adhik saza ka tumse qisaas liya jayega." Warnankarta kahte hain : Itna sunne ke baad woh vyakti zara hat ke zor-zor se rone laga. Yeh dekh Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Kya tumne Allah ki kitaab nahin parhi hai, jismen likha hai : "Aur ham qayaamat ke din nyay ke taraazu rakhenge. Phir kisi par kuchh bhi anyay nahin kiya jayega. Aur agar kisi ka koi karm raai ke ek daane ke baraabar bhi hoga, to ham use le ayenge. Aur ham hisaab lene waale kaafi hain." Ispar us vyakti ne kaha : Allah ki qasam, ai Allah ke Rasool! Main apne aur unke haq mein isse behtar kuchh nahin paata ki unko aazaad kar doon. Main aapko ghawaah banaakar kahta hoon ki we saare aazaad hain.

Ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya aur apne ghulaamon ki harakton ki shikayat karne laga. Kahne laga ki we usko ghalat soochna dete hain, uske saath  wishvaasghaat karte hain, len-den evn vyavhaar mein dhokha karte hain aur uske aadeshon ki avhelna karte hain, jabki woh unko gaali-galauj karta hai aur shisht banaane ke liye maarta bhi hai. Usne poochha ki apne gulaamon ke saath is bartaav ki wajah se qayaamat ke din uska kya haal hoga? Ispar Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Unke dvaara ki gai tumhaare saath wishvaasghaat, tumse bole gae jhooth aur unke dvaara ki gai tumhaari awajna tatha tumhaare dvaara unko diye gae dand ka hisaab hoga. Aise mein agar gunaah tatha dand donon baraabar honge, to maamla baraabri ka hoga. Na tumhaare haq mein jayega aur na tumhaare wiruddh. Jabki agar tumhaare dvaara di gai saza unke gunaah se kam hogi, to maamla tumhaare haq mein jayega aur tumko iska pratiphal milega. Iske wipreet agar tumhaare dvaara di gai saza unke gunaah se adhik hogi, to iski saza tumko bhugatni paregi. Yeh sun woh vyakti zara door hat gaya aur zor-zor se rone laga. Yeh dekh Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Kya tum Allah ki kitaab nahin parhte, jismen likha hai : "Aur ham qayaamat ke din nyay ke taraazu rakhenge. Phir kisi par kuchh bhi anyay nahin kiya jayega. Aur agar kisi ka koi karm raai ke ek daane ke baraabar bhi hoga, to ham use bhi le ayenge. Aur ham hisaab lene waale kaafi hain." Isse spasht hai ki qayaamat ke din kisi par kisi prakaar ka atyaachaar nahin hoga. Wahaan ka har faisla nyay par aadhaarit hoga. Yeh sun us vyakti ne kaha : Allah ki qasam, ai Allah ke Rasool! Main khud apne tatha unke haq mein isse uttam kuchh nahin paata ki unko khud se alag kar doon. Main aapko gawaah banaakar kahta hoon ki main unko Allah ke liye, hisaab tatha azaab ke bhay se, aazaad karta hoon.

Sahaabi ki sachchaai ki unhonne Allah ke azaab ke bhay se apne ghulaamon ko aazaad kar diya.
Zaalim se liya gaya badla agar zulm ke baraabar ya usse kam hoga, tab to jayaz hai, lekin agar zyaada ho gaya, to jayaz nahin hai.
Naukar-chaakar tatha kamzor logon ke saath achchha bartaav karne ki prerna.
65068: Jisne use duniya mein pairon par chalaya, kya woh qayaamat ke din use chehre ke bal chala nahin sakta?

Qataada se warnit hai, unhonne kaha : Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ne hamen bataya ki ek vyakti ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Nabi! Kaafir ko chehre ke bal kaise ekatr kiya jayega? Aapne uttar diya : "Jisne use duniya mein pairon par chalaya, kya woh qayaamat ke din use chehre ke bal chala nahin sakta?" Qataada kahte hain : Awashy chala sakta hai, hamaare rab ki pratishtha ki qasam.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochha gaya ki kaafir ko qayaamat ke din chehre ke bal kaise chalaya jayega? Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne uttar diya : Jisne use duniya mein pairon par chalaya, kya woh use qayaamat ke din chehre ke bal chala nahin sakta? Allah to har cheez ki kshamta rakhta hai.
Qayaamat ke din kaafir ke apmaan ka ek roop yeh hoga ki woh apne chehre ke bal chalega.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65069: Aap la ilaaha illallah kah den, main qayaamat ke din aapke liye iski gawaahi doonga

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, unhonne kaha : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne chacha se kaha : "Aap la ilaaha illallah kah den, main qayaamat ke din aapke liye iski gawaahi doonga."Yeh sun unhonne kaha : Agar quraish ke log mujhe yeh kahkar sharm na dilaate ki mainne ghabraakar aisa kiya hai, to main tumhaari baat maankar tumhaari aankh thandi kar deta. Isi paridrishy mein Allah ne yeh ayat utaari : "Nihsandeh aap use hidayat nahin de sakte jise aap chaahen, parantu Allah hidayat deta hai jise chaahta hai." [soora al-qasas : 56]

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne chacha abu taalib se, jab woh marnaasann the, aagrah kiya ki woh la ilaaha illallah kah den, taaki iske aadhaar par qayaamat ke din aap unke liye sifaarish kar saken aur unke musalmaan hone ki gawaahi de saken. Lekin abu taalib ne is bhay se aisa karne se inkaar kar diya kaheen quraish ke log unki ninda na karen aur yeh na kahen ki woh maut tatha kamzori ke bhay se musalmaan ho gae. Unhonne kaha : Agar is baat ka bhay na hota, to kalima-e-shahaadat parhkar tumhaare dil ko thanda kar deta aur tumhaari tamanna poori kar deta. Isi paridrishy mein woh ayat utri, jo bataati hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam kisi ko Islam grahan karne ka suyog pradaan karne ki kshamta nahin rakhte. Yeh suyog Allah jise chaahta hai, pradaan karta hai. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka kaam bas raah dikhaana aur saty ki or bulaana hai.

Saty ko logon ki aalochna ke bhay se chhora nahin ja sakta.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka kaam raasta dikhaana tha, Islam grahan karne ka suyog pradaan karna nahin.
Kisi kaafir beemaar ka haal jaanne ke liye jaya ja sakta hai, taaki use Islam ki or bulaya ja sake.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah deen ki or bulaane ke har avsar ka upyog karte the.
65071: Aap jo kuchh kah rahe hain aur jis baat ka aahvaan kar rahe hain, woh achchhi hai. Agar aap hamen bata den ki hamne jo paap kiye hain, unka koi prayashchit bhi hai, (to behtar ho).

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai : Kuchh mushrik, jinhonne bahut zyaada hatyayen ki theen aur bahut zyaada vyabhichaar kiya tha, Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aye aur kahne lage : Aap jo kuchh kah rahe hain aur jis baat ka aahvaan kar rahe hain, woh achchhi hai. Agar aap hamen bata den ki hamne jo paap kiye hain, unka koi prayashchit bhi hai, (to behtar ho). Chunaanche isi paridrishy mein yeh do ayten utreen : "Aur jo Allah ke saath kisi doosre poojy ko nahin pukaarte, aur na us praan ko qatl karte hain, jise Allah ne haraam thahraya hai parantu haq ke saath aur na vyabhichaar karte hain." [soora al-furqaan : 68] "(Ai Nabi!) aap mere un bandon se kah den, jinhonne apne oopar atyaachaar kiye hain ki tum Allah ki daya se niraash na ho." [soora al-zumar : 53]

Kuchh mushrik log, jinhonne bahut-si hatyayen ki theen aur bahut zyaada vyabhichaar kiya tha, Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aye aur kahne lage ki aap jis Islam aur uski shikshaaon ki or hamen bula rahe hain, woh achchhi cheezen hain. Lekin zara yeh batayen ki kya ab tak hamaari shirk aur any bare gunaahon mein sanliptata ka koi kaffaara (prayashchit) hai ya nahin hai?

Chunaanche yeh do ayten utreen aur Allah ne bataya ki insaan chaahe jitni sankhya mein aur jitne bhi bare-bare gunaah kar baithe, sachche dil se tauba karne par Allah uski tauba grahan zaroor karta hai. Agar aisa na hota, to log aage bhi awishvaas evn avhelna ke maarg par chalte rahte aur Islam grahan na karte.

Islam ki fazeelat, mahaanta tatha yeh ki Islam pichhle tamaam gunaahon ko mita deta hai.
Bandon par Allah ki daya evn kshama.
Shirk ka haraam hona, kisi ki awaidh hatya ka haraam hona, vyabhichaar ka haraam hona aur in gunaahon mein sanlipt hone waale ke liye chetaavni.
Nishchhal evn satkarmayukt sachchi tauba Allah ke prati kufr (awishvaas) sahit saare paap mita deti hai.
Allah paak ki daya se niraash hona haraam hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65073: Uske paas jaao aur use bata do ki woh jahannami nahin, balki jannati hai.

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ek din saabit bin qais ko anupasthit dekha aur unke baare mein poochha, to ek vyakti ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Main aapke paas unke baare mein jaankaari lekar aaoonga. Chunaanche woh unke paas gaya to dekha ki woh sar jhukaye apne ghar mein baithe hue hain. Yeh dekh unse poochha ki aap kaise hain? Unhonne jawaab diya ki unka haal bura hai. Unki aawaaz Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki aawaaz se oonchi ho jaya karti thi, isliye unke satkarm nasht ho gae aur ab woh jahannami hain. Chunaanche woh vyakti Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya aur unhonne jo kuchh kaha tha, woh bata diya. Atah woh dobaara ek bahut bari khushkhabri ke saath lauta. Usne aakar bataya ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kaha hai : "Uske paas jaao aur use bata do ki woh jahannami nahin, balki jannati hai."

Ek baar Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne saabit bin qais ko anupasthit paya aur unke baare mein poochha to ek vyakti ne kaha ki main jaakar pata lagaata hoon aur aapko bataata hai ki woh ghayab kyon hain. Chunaanche woh unke paas gaya, to dekha ki woh udaas hokar apne ghar mein sar jhukaye baithe hain. Us vyakti ne jab unse haal poochha, to unhonne woh peera bataai, jisse woh guzar rahe the. Unhonne bataya ki unki aawaaz Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki aawaaz se oonchi ho jaya karti thi aur Allah ne aisa karne waale vyakti ko yeh dhamki di hai ki uske karm nasht ho jayenge aur woh Jahannam mein jayega.

Chunaanche woh vyakti Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya aur aapko iski soochna di, to aapne aadesh diya ki woh dobaara saabit ke paas jaye aur unko bata de ki woh jahannami nahin, balki jannati hain. Aisa isliye ki unki aawaaz paidaaishi taur par oonchi thi tatha woh Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam evn ansaar ke wakta the.

Saabit bin qais ki fazeelat ke saath-saath is baat ka ullekh ki woh jannati hain.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam sahaaba ka khyaal rakha karte the tatha unki khabar maaloom karte rahte the.
Sahaaba is baat se bahut zyaada darte the ki kaheen unke karm nasht na ho jayen.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke jeewan kaal mein aapse baat karte samay adab ka dhyaan rakhna tatha aapki mrityu ke baad aapki sunnat ko sunte samay aawaaz dheemi rakhna waajib hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65074: Ai logo! Allah ne tumse jaahileeyat kaal ke abhimaan evn baap-daadaaon par fakhr (ghamand) karne ki prawritti ko door kar diya hai

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne makka wijay ke din logon ko sanbodhit karte hue kaha : "Ai logo! Allah ne tumse jaahileeyat kaal ke abhimaan evn baap-daadaaon par fakhr (ghamand) karne ki prawritti ko door kar diya hai. Atah ab log do prakaar ke hain. Ek, nek, parhezgaar aur Allah ke yahaan sammaanit evn doosra dusht, abhaaga tatha Allah ki nazar mein mahatvaheen vyakti. Saare log aadam ki santaan hain aur aadam ko Allah ne mitti se paida kiya hai. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : "Ai manushyo! Hamne tumhen ek nar aur ek maada se paida kiya tatha hamne tumhen jaatiyon aur qabeelon mein kar diya, taaki tum ek-doosre ko pahchaan sako. Nihsandeh Allah ke nikat tummen sabse adhik sammaan waala woh hai, jo tummen sabse adhik taqva (dharmaprayanta) waala hai. Nihsandeh Allah sab kuchh jaanne waala, poori khabar rakhne waala hai." [soora al-hujuraat : 13]

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne makka wijay ke din logon ko sanbodhit karte hue kaha : Ai logo! Allah ne tumhaare andar se jaahileeyat kaal ke abhimaan evn baap-daadaaon par ghamand karne ki beemaari ko door kar diya hai. Ab log do hi prakaar ke hain :

Ya to nek, parhezgaar, aajnaakaari aur Allah ki ibaadat karne waala momin hoga, jo Allah ki nazar mein sammaanit hai, chaahe logon ki nazar mein pratishthaawaan evn oonche khaandaan waala na bhi ho,

Ya phir dusht evn abhaaga awishvaasi hoga, jo ki Allah ki nazar mein tuchchh evn mahatvaheen hai, chaahe duniya ki nazar mein jitna bhi pratishthaawaan evn prabhaavshaali ho.

Yaad rahe ki saare log aadam ki santaan hain aur aadam ko Allah ne mitti se paida kiya hai, isliye mitti se paida hone waale ko abhimaan karna aur aatmamugdh hona shobha nahin deta. Iski pushti uchch evn mahaan Allah ke is kathan se bhi hoti hai : "Ai manushyo! Hamne tumhen ek nar aur ek maada se paida kiya tatha hamne tumhen jaatiyon aur qabeelon mein kar diya, taaki tum ek-doosre ko pahchaan sako. Nihsandeh Allah ke nikat tummen sabse adhik sammaan waala woh hai, jo tummen sabse adhik taqva (dharmaprayanta) waala hai. Nihsandeh Allah sab kuchh jaanne waala, poori khabar rakhne waala hai." [soora al-hujuraat : 13]
Hasab-nasab (wansh tatha gotr) par abhimaan karne ki manaahi.
[is hadees ko tirmizi aur ibn-e-hibbaan ne riwayat kiya hai]
65075: Zubair bin avvaam radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Jab yeh ayat : {ثُمَّ لَتُسْأَلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ النَّعِيمِ} (phir nishchay tum us din nemton ke baare mein awashy poochhe jaaoge.) [soora al-takaasur : 8] utri, to zubair radiyallahu anhu ne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Hamse kis nemat ke baare mein poochha jayega? Hamaare paas to do hi kaali cheezen hain. Khajoor tatha paani. Aapne uttar diya : "Dekho, tumse sawaal to kya hi jayega."

Jab yeh ayat utri : {ثم لتسألن يومئذ عن النعيم} yaani Allah ne tumko jo nemten de rakhi hain, tumse unka shukr ada karne ya na karne ke baare mein poochha jayega, to zubair bin avvaam radiyallahu anhu ne poochha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Ham logon se bhala kis nemat ke baare mein poochha jayega? Hamaare paas to do hi nemten hain, jo is layaq nahin hain ki unke baare mein poochha jaye? Hamaare paas to kewal khajoor evn paani hi hain?

Yeh sun Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Tum jis haalat mein ho, woh apni jagah par, lekin iske baavjood tumse nemton ke baare mein poochha jayega. Kyonki donon nemten bhi Allah ki do bari-bari nemten hain.

Allah ki nemton ka shukr ada karne ki taakeed.
Nemat chaahe chhoti ho ya bari, qayaamat ke din uske baare mein poochha jayega.
[is hadees ko tirmizi aur ibn-e-maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
65076: Meri ummat ke aakhir mein aise log paida ho jayenge, jo aisi baaten batayenge, jo na tumne suni hogi aur na tumhaare baap-daadaaon ne suni hogi. Atah tum unse bachkar evn saavdhaan rahna.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Meri ummat ke aakhir mein aise log paida ho jayenge, jo aisi baaten batayenge, jo na tumne suni hogi aur na tumhaare baap-daadaaon ne suni hogi. Atah tum unse bachkar evn saavdhaan rahna."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki aapki ummat ke aakhir mein aise log paida ho jayenge, jo Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke hawaale se garhkar jhoothi baaten batayenge aur aisi beeten kahenge, jo unse pahle kisi ne kahi nahin hogi. Woh sar-e-aam jhoothi hadeesen bayaan karte phirenge. Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aadesh diya hai ki ham is prakaar ke logon se door rahen, unke saath uthne-baithne se bachen aur unki baat na sunen ki kaheen aisa na ho ki unki baatai hui jhoothi baaten dilon mein baith jayen aur unse daaman chhuraya na ja sake.

Ismen Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke Nabi hone ki ek bahut bari nishaani bayaan ki gai hai. Aapne apni ummat ke andar saamne aane waali ek baat ki soochna di, jo usi tarah saamne a gai, jaise aapne bataai thi.
Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke hawaale se tatha deen-e-Islam ke baare mein koi jhoothi baat garhkar kahne waale se door rahna aur unki baat na sunna zaroori hai.
Ismen sahi tatha saabit hone ki pushti kiye bina hadeeson ko grahan karne tatha phailaane se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai.
65077: Tum likha karo. Us hasti ki qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, is (munh) se kewal saty hi nikalta hai.

Abdullah bin amr radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Main Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se suni hui har baat ko is iraade se likh liya karta tha ki woh surakshit rah jaye. Lekin mujhe isse quraish ne mana kar diya aur kaha ki kya tum Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se suni hui har baat ko likh liya karte ho, jabki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ek insaan hain, jo krodh tatha prasannata ki awastha mein baat karte hain? Atah mainne likhna band kar diya aur Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saamne iska zikr kiya to aapne apni ungli se apne munh ki or ishaara kiya aur farmaya : "Tum likha karo. Us hasti ki qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, is (munh) se kewal saty hi nikalta hai."

Abdullah bin amr radiyallahu anhu kahte hain : Main Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se suni hui har baat ko likh liya karta tha, taaki use likhit roop mein surakshit rakha ja sake. Lekin quraish ke kuchh logon ne mujhe isse mana kiya aur kaha ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ek insaan hain aur prasannata tatha krodh donon haalton mein baat karte hain. Ho sakta hai ki kabhi aap ghalti bhi kar baithte hon. (Isliye aapki har baat ko likha mat karo.) chunaanche mainne likhna band kar diya.

Phir mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saamne unki is baat ka zikr kiya, to aapne apne munh ki or ishaara karte hue kaha ki;  us hasti ki qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai! Is munh se har haal mein saty hi nikalta hai. Razaamandi ki awastha mein bhi aur krodh ki awastha mein bhi.

Khud Allah taaala ne apne Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke baare mein farmaya hai : "Aur na woh apni ichchha se bolta hai. Woh to kewal wahy hai, jo utaari jaati hai." [soora najm 3-4]

Is baat ki door-door tak bhi gunjaaish nahin hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se Allah ka sandesh pahunchaane mein koi ghalti ho. Na to prasannata ki awastha mein aur na krodh ki awastha mein.
Sahaaba ka poora prayaas rahta tha ki sunnat ki suraksha ki jaye aur use doosron tak pahunchaya jaye.
Kisi masalhat (achchhe parinaam) ke liye, jaise kisi baat mein taakeed paida karne ke liye, qasam ki maang ke bina bhi qasam khaai ja sakti hai.
Jnaan ko likh lena uski suraksha ka ek mahatvapoorn saadhan hai.
[ise abu daawood ne riwayat kiya hai]
65080: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam har namaz ke liye wazu kar liya karte the

Amr bin aamir ka warnan hai ki anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ne kaha hai : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam har namaz ke liye wazu kar liya karte the. Mainne poochha : Aap log kya karte the? Unhonne uttar diya : Hamaare liye wazu us samay tak kaafi ho jaata tha, jab tak wazu bhang na ho jaye.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam har farz namaz ke liye wazu kar liya karte the, chaahe wazu na bhi toote. Aisa aap sawaab tatha pratiphal praapt karne ke liye karte the.

Yeh alag baat hai ki jab tak wazu na toote insaan ek hi wazu se ek se adhik farz namaz parh sakta hai.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam adhiktar har namaz ke liye wazu kar liya karte the. Kyonki yahi sabse sanpoorn tareeqa hai.
Har namaz ke samay wazu karna musathab (waanchhit) hai.
Ek wazu se ek se adhik namaazen parhna jayaz hai.
65081:
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne (angon ko) 
 Ek-ek baar (dhokar) wazu kiya.

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne (angon ko) 
 Ek-ek baar (dhokar) wazu kiya.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam kabhi-kabhi wazu karte samay wazu ke saare angon ko ek-ek baar hi dhoya karte the. Chunaanche ek hi baar chehra dhote, (jismen kulli karna tatha naak mein paani daalkar naak jhaarna bhi shaamil hai) tatha donon haathon tatha donon pairon ko bhi ek-ek baar hi dhote. Daraasal waajib maatra itni hi hai.

Wazu ke angon ko ek-ek baar hi dhona waajib hai. Ek se adhik baar dhona musathab hai.
Wazu ke angon ko kabhi-kabhi ek-ek baar hi dhoya ja sakta hai.
Sar ka masah ek hi baar kiya jayega.
65082: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne wazu ke angon ko do-do baar dhoya.
Abdullah bin zaid radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne wazu ke angon ko do-do baar dhoya.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam wazu karte samay kabhi-kabhi wazu ke angon ko do-do baar dhoya karte the. Chunaanche apne chehre ko do baar dhote, jismen kulli karna aur naak mein paani daalkar naak jhaarna bhi shaamil hai) tatha apne haathon aur pairon ko bhi do-do baar dhote the.

Wazu ke angon ko ek-ek baar hi dhona waajib hai. Ek se adhik baar dhona musathab hai.
Wazu ke angon ko kabhi-kabhi do-do baar bhi dhoya ja sakta hai.
Sar ka masah ek hi baar kiya jayega.
65083: Jab tummen se koi apne pet mein koi cheez paye aur uske liye yeh nirnay lena kathin ho ki usse kuchh nikla hai ya nahin, to masjid se us samay tak hargiz na nikle, jab tak aawaaz sunaai na de ya badbu mahsoos na ho.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, unhonne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jab tummen se koi apne pet mein koi cheez paye aur uske liye yeh nirnay lena kathin ho ki usse kuchh nikla hai ya nahin, to masjid se us samay tak hargiz na nikle, jab tak aawaaz sunaai na de ya badbu mahsoos na ho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jab namaazi ke pet mein koi cheez idhar se udhar jaye aur woh is baat ko sunishchit na kar sake ki uske pet se kuchh nikla hai ya nahin, to dobaara wazu karne ke liye namaz chhorkar us samay tak baahar na jaye, jab tak yeh yaqeen na ho jaye ki wazu toot hi gaya hai. Maslan aawaaz na sun le ya badbu mahsoos na kar le. Kyonki yaqeen shak ke aadhaar par nasht nahin hota aur yahaan pawitrata haasil ki gai thi, yeh yaqeeni baat hai, jabki tooti hai ya nahin is baat mein sandeh hai.

Yeh hadees Islam ka ek siddhaant tatha fiqh ka ek usool prastut karti hai. Usool yeh hai ki yaqeen shak ke aadhaar par nasht nahin hota. Asal yeh hai ki jo jis awastha mein tha, woh usi awastha mein rahega, jab tak uske wipreet saabit na ho jaye.
Shak ka pawitrata (tahaarat) par koi prabhaawan nahin parta aur namaz parh raha vyakti apni pawitrata par baaqi rahega, jab tak is baat ka yaqeen na ho jaye ki wazu toot gaya hai.
65084: Har musalmaan par yeh aniwaary hai ki har saat din mein ek din snaan kare, jis din apne sar tatha shareer ko dhoe.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Har musalmaan par yeh aniwaary hai ki har saat din mein ek din snaan kare, jis din apne sar tatha shareer ko dhoe."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki har samajhdaar tatha wayask musalmaan par aniwaary hai ki woh saptaah ke har saat din mein ek din snaan kare aur is din apne sar evn shareer ko dhoe. Yeh aadesh daraasal pawitrata evn svachchhata ke uddeshy se diya gaya hai. In saat dinon mein snaan ke liye sabse uchit din juma ka din hai, jaisa ki kuchh riwayton se prateet hota hai. Yaad rahe ki juma ke din jume ki namaz se pahle snaan taakeed ke saath musathab hai, chaahe brihaspatiwaar ko snaan kiya ho tab bhi. Jume ke din snaan waajib na hone ka kaaran aaisha radiyallahu anha ka yeh kathan hai : "Log apne ghar ke kaam khud hi kiya karte the aur jab jume ke liye jaate, to usi haalat mein chale jaate the. Atah unse kaha gaya ki agar snaan kar lo, to behtar hai." (Is hadees ko imaam Bukhari ne riwayat kiya hai.) ek riwayat mein hai ki "Unke shareer se durgandh aati thi." Yaani paseene aadi ki durgandh. Lekin iske baavjood unse kaha gaya ki "Agar snaan kar lo, to behtar hai." Iska matlab yeh hai ki jinke shareer se paseene ki durgandh na aati ho, unke liye snaan na karne ki anumti to aur zyaada hai.

Svachchhata tatha pawitrata par Islam ka dhyaan.
Jume ke din jume ki namaz ke liye snaan karna taakeed ke saath musathab hai.
Yadyapi sar shareer mein shaamil hai, parantu iska ullekh yahaan uspar dhyaan dilaane ke liye kiya gaya hai.
Snaan karna har us vyakti par waajib hai, jiske shareer se badbu aati ho, jisse logon ko kasht ho.
Jis din ke snaan ki sabse zyaada taakeed hai, woh jume ka din hai. Aisa is din ki fazeelat ki wajah se hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65085: Main Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas Islam grahan karne ke liye aya, to aapne mujhe paani tatha ber ke patton se nahaane ka aadesh diya.

Qais bin aasim radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Main Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas Islam grahan karne ke liye aya, to aapne mujhe paani tatha ber ke patton se nahaane ka aadesh diya.

Qais bin aasim Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas Islam grahan karne ke liye aye, to aapne unko paani tatha ber ke patton se nahaane ka aadesh diya. Ber ke patton ka istemaal karne ka aadesh isliye diya ki ek to unka prayog saaf-safaai ke liye kiya jaata hai aur doosra usmen achchha gandh bhi hota hai.

Ghair-Muslim ke liye Islam mein prawesh karte samay nahaane ka shareeyat sammat hona.
Islam ki fazeelat tatha uska aatma evn shareer donon par dhyaan dena.
Paani ke saath paak cheezon ke milne se paani ke paak karne ki shakti khatm nahin hoti.
Aadhunik svachchhata pradaan karne waali cheezon, jaise saabun aadi ka prayog beri ke patton ke sthaan par kiya ja sakta hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi aur nasai ne riwayat kiya hai]
65086: Jab muazzin "اللهُ أَكْبَرُ اللهُ أَكْبَرُ" (Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar) kahta hai aur (uske uttar mein) tummen se koi "اللهُ أَكْبَرُ اللهُ أَكْبَرُ" (Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar) kahta hai

Umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : Jab muazzin "اللهُ أَكْبَرُ اللهُ أَكْبَرُ" (Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar) kahta hai aur (uske uttar mein) tummen se koi "اللهُ أَكْبَرُ اللهُ أَكْبَرُ" (Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar) kahta hai, phir muazzin "أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ" (Ashhadu al-laailaaha illallah) kahta hai aur woh "أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ" (Ashhadu al-laailaaha illallah) kahta hai, phir muazzin "أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللهِ" (Ashhadu anna muhammadar-rasoolullah) kahta hai aur woh "أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللهِ" (Ashhadu anna muhammadar-rasoolullah) kahta hai, phir muazzin "حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ" (Haiyya alasslaah) kahta hai aur woh "لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ" 
(La haula wala quvvata illa billah) kahta hai, phir muazzin "حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ" (Haiyya alal -phalaah) kahta hai aur woh "لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ" (La haula wala quvvata illa billah) kahta hai, phir muazzin "اللهُ أَكْبَرُ اللهُ أَكْبَرُ" (Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar) kahta hai aur woh "اللهُ أَكْبَرُ اللهُ أَكْبَرُ" (Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar) kahta hai, phir muazzin "لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ" (Laailaaha illallah) kahta hai aur woh sachche dil se "لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ" (Laailaaha illallah) kahta hai, to woh Jannat mein daakhil ho jaata hai.

Azaan namaz ka samay prawesh karne ka elaan hai. Azaan ke shabd waastav mein aqeeda-e-eemaan ko pradarshit karne waale vyaapak shabd hain.

Is hadees mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki azaan sunte samay kya karna chahiye. Sunne waale ko wahi kahna chahiye, jo muazzin kah raha ho. Jab muazzin "Allahu akbar" Kahe, to sunne waale ko "Allahu akbar" Kahna chahiye. Evn isi prakaar any waakyon ko bhi kahna chahiye. Lekin jab muazzin "Haiyya alassalaah" Tatha "Haiyya alalphalaah" Kahe, to sunne waale ko "La haula wala quvvata illa billah" Kahna chahiye.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jisne sachche dil se muazzin ke dvaara kahe gae shabdon ka uttar diya, woh Jannat mein prawesh karega.

Azaan ke shabdon ka arth : "الله أكبر"  (Allahu akbar) : Yaani pawitr evn mahaan Allah har cheez se bara, mahaan aur shaktishaali hai.

"أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله" (Ashhadu an-laailaaha illallah) : Main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke atirikt koi sachcha poojy nahin hai.

"أشهد أن محمّدًا رسول الله" (Ashhadu anna  muhammadar- rasoolullah) : Main zabaan aur dil se is baat ka iqraar karta aur gawaahi deta hoon ki Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke Rasool hain, jinko sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne bheja hai aur aapka anusran waajib hai.

"حيَّ على الصَّلاة" (Haiyya ala assalaah) : Namaz ki or aao. Jabki "لا حول ولا قوَّة إلّا بالله" (La haula wala quvvata illa billah) ka arth hai, Allah ke suyog ke bina namaz ki rukaavton se chhutkaara dilaane waali aur namaz ka saamarthy pradaan karne waali koi hasti nahin hai.

"حيَّ على الفلاح" (Haiyya alalphalaah) : Saphalta ke saadhan ki or aao. Yahaan safalta se muraad Jannat ki praapti tatha Jahannam se mukti hai.

Muazzin ka uttar dene ki fazeelat. "Haiyya alassalaah" Tatha "Haiyya alalphalaah" Ko chhor any saare shabdon ka uttar unheen shabdon dvaara diya jayega. Albatta, oopar waale donon waakyon ke uttar mein "La haula wala quvvata illa billah" Kaha jayega.
65087: Jab tum muazzin ko azaan dete hue suno, to usi tarah ke shabd kaho, jo muazzin kahta hai. Phir mujhpar darood bhejo

Abdullah bin amr bin aas radiyallahu anhuma se riwayat hai ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Jab tum muazzin ko azaan dete hue suno, to usi tarah ke shabd kaho, jo muazzin kahta hai. Phir mujhpar darood bhejo. Kyonki jisne mujhpar ek baar darood bheja, Allah farishton ke saamne das baar uski taareef karega. Phir mere liye waseela maango. Daraasal waseela Jannat ka ek sthaan hai, jo Allah ke bandon mein se kewal ek bande ko shobha dega aur mujhe aasha hai ki woh banda main hi rahoonga. Atah jisne mere liye waseela maanga, use meri sifaarish praapt hogi."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne yeh nirdesh diya hai ki jo muazzin ko namaz ke liye azaan dete hue sune, woh uske peechhe-peechhe uske dvaara kahe gae shabdon ko dohraye. Albatta "Hayya alassalaah" Tatha "Hayya allaflaah" Ki baat alag hai. In do waakyon ke jawaab mein "لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله" Kahe. Phir azaan poori ho jaane ke baad Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par darood bheje. Kyonki jisne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par  ek baar darood bheja, Allah uski prashansa farishton ke saame das baar karta hai.

Phir Allah se aapke liye waseela maangne ka aadesh diya. Yaad rahe ki waseela Jannat ka sabse ooncha sthaan hai, jo Allah ke kewal ek bande ko shobha dega tatha praapt hoga. Aapne bataya ki mujhe aasha hai ki Allah ka woh banda mujhe hi banne ka saubhaagy praapt hoga. Daraasal aapne waseela ke liye dua karne ki baat winamrata ke kaaran kahi hai, warna jab woh sthaan kewal Allah ke ek hi bande ko praapt hoga, to woh aap hi honge, kyonki aap sabse sarvashreshth insaan hain.

Phir aapne bataya ki jisne aapke liye waseela ki dua ki, use aapki sifaarish praapt hogi.

Muazzin ke dvaara kahe gae shabdon ko dohraane ki prerna.
Muazzin ka uttar dene ke baad Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par darood bhejne ki fazeelat.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par darood bhejne ke baad aapke liye waseela maangne ki fazeelat.
Waseela ke arth tatha uske is mahatv ka ullekh ki waseela naam ka sthaan Allah ke kewal ek bande ko shobha dega.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki fazeelat ka bayaan ki aapko woh ooncha sthaan praapt hoga.
Jo Allah se uske Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke liye waseela maangega, use aapki sifaarish praapt hogi.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki winamrata ki aapne apni ummat ko apne liye waseela ki dua karne ko kaha, jabki woh sthaan to aapko praapt hona hi hai.
Allah ka wishaal anugrah tatha daya ki woh neki ka badla das guna deta hai.
65088: Jo vyakti kisi namaz ko bhool jaye, to woh use us samay parh le, jab yaad a jaye. Iske siwa uska koi kaffaara (prayashchit) nahin hai

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jo vyakti kisi namaz ko bhool jaye, to woh use us samay parh le, jab yaad a jaye. Iske siwa uska koi kaffaara (prayashchit) nahin hai : {وَأَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ لِذِكْرِي} (tatha mere smaran (yaad) ke liye namaz sthaapit kar.) [soora taaha : 14] "

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jo vyakti koi namaz ko ada karna bhool jaye aur uska samay nikal jaye, to use yaad aate hi turant uski kaza kar leni chahiye. Namaz ko sasmay na parhne ke gunaah ko mitaane ka tareeqa iske atirikt kuchh aur nahin hai ki use yaad aate hi parh liya jaye. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ne Qur'an paak mein kaha hai : "Tatha meri yaad ke liye namaz sthaapit kar." [soora taaha : 14] arthaat bhooli hui namaz ko us samay parh lo, jab yaad a jaye.

Is baat ka bayaan ki Islam mein namaz ka bara mahatv hai. Ise ada karne tatha iski qaza karne mein susti nahin karni chahiye.
Kisi uchit kaaran ke bina namaz ko uske samay se taalna theek nahin hai.
Namaz ki qaza usi samay waajib hai, jab bhoolne ke kaaran namaz chhorne waale ko namaz yaad a jaye aur so jaane ke kaaran namaz chhorne waala vyakti jaag jaye.
Chhooti hui namaazon ki qaza fauran waajib hai, chaahe samay namaz ki manaahi ka hi kyon na ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65089: Jisne Allah ke liye koi ghar banaya, Allah Jannat mein uske liye usi jaisa ghar banayega.

Mahmood bin labeed radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki usmaan bin affaan radiyallahu anhu ne masjid-e-nabvi ke dobaara nirmaan ka iraada kiya, to logon ne ise naapsand kiya. Woh chaahte the ki use uski asal haalat par rahne diya jaye. Ispar unhonne kaha : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko farmaate hue suna hai : "Jisne Allah ke liye koi ghar banaya, Allah Jannat mein uske liye usi jaisa ghar banayega."

Usmaan bin affaan radiyallahu anhu ne pahle se behtar andaaz mein masjid-e-nabvi ke punarnirmaan ka iraada kiya, to logon ne unke is iraade ko naapsand kiya. Kyonki aisa karne se masjid us awastha mein nahin rah paati, jismen Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke zamaane mein thi. Aapke zamaane mein masjid kachchi eenton ki bani hui thi aur uski chhat khajoor ki shaakhaaon ki thi. Jabki usmaan radiyallahu anhu uska nirmaan patthar tatha choone se karna chaahte the. Chunaanche unhonne jab logon ki aprasannata ko dekha, to bataya ki unhonne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko farmaate hue suna hai : Jisne kewal Allah ki prasannata praapt karne ke liye masjid banaai aur uske is amal mein dikhaawa tatha shohrat talbi jaisi cheezon ka ansh bhi na raha, use Allah usi koti ka ek behatreen badla dega. Allah uske liye Jannat mein usi tarah ka ek ghar banayega.

Masjidon ke nirmaan ki prerna tatha uski fazeelat.
Masjid ka wistaar tatha punarnirmaan bhi masjid banaane ki fazeelat ke dayre mein aata hai.
Tamaam kaamon ko wishuddh roop se Allah ki prasannata praapt karne ke liye karne ka mahatv.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65090: Meri is masjid mein parhi gai ek namaz masjid-e-haraam ko chhor any masjidon mein parhi gai ek hazaar namaazon se behtar hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Meri is masjid mein parhi gai ek namaz masjid-e-haraam ko chhor any masjidon mein parhi gai ek hazaar namaazon se behtar hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne masjid-e-nabvi mein namaz parhne ki fazeelat bayaan ki hai. Aapne bataya ki aapki masjid mein parhi gai ek namaz masjid-e-haraam ko chhor doosri masjidon mein parhi gai ek hazaar namaz se behtar hai. Albatta, masjid-e-haraam mein namaz parhne ki fazeelat isse bhi zyaada hai.

Masjid-e-haraam tatha masjid-e-nabvi mein parhi gai namaz ka sawaab any masjidon mein parhi gai namaz se zyaada hai.
Masjid-e-haraam mein parhi gai ek namaz any masjidon mein parhi gai ek laakh namaazon se behtar hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65091: Jab tummen se koi masjid ke andar prawesh kare, to baithne se pahle do rakaaten parh le.
Abu qataada salmi radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jab tummen se koi masjid ke andar prawesh kare, to baithne se pahle do rakaaten parh le."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is baat ki prerna di hai ki jo vyakti kisi bhi samay aur kisi bhi uddeshy se masjid ke andar prawesh kare, woh baithne se pahle do rakaaten parh le. In donon rakaaton ko tahiyyatul masjid kaha jaata hai.

Masjid mein baithne se pahle tahiyyatul masjid ke taur par do rakaat parhna musathab hai.
Yeh aadesh us vyakti ke liye hai, jo baithna chaahe. Jo vyakti masjid mein prawesh kare aur baithne se pahle hi nikal jaye, woh is aadesh ke dayre mein nahin ayega.
Jab koi vyakti masjid mein prawesh kare aur us samay log namaz parh rahe hon aur woh unke saath jamaat mein shareek ho gaya, to in do rakaaton ki zaroorat nahin rah jaati.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65092: Jab tummen se koi masjid mein prawesh kare, to yeh dua parhe : "اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ" (Ai Allah! Mere liye apni rahmat ke dvaar khol de) aur jab masjid se nikle, to yeh dua parhe : "اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ" (Ai Allah! Main tujhse tera anugrah maangta hoon.)

Abu humaid ya abu usaid se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Jab tummen se koi masjid mein prawesh kare, to yeh dua parhe : "اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ" (Ai Allah! Mere liye apni rahmat ke dvaar khol de) aur jab masjid se nikle, to yeh dua parhe : "اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ" (Ai Allah! Main tujhse tera anugrah maangta hoon.)

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apni ummat ko masjid mein prawesh karne ki yeh dua sikhaai hai : "اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ" (Ai Allah! Mere liye apni rahmat ke dvaar khol de), jismen Allah se uski rahmat ke saadhan uplabdh karaane ki dua ki gai hai aur masjid se nikalne ki yeh dua sikhaai hai : "اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ" (Ai Allah! Main tujhse tera anugrah maangta hoon.), jismen Allah ka anugrah aur uska ehsaan, jaise halaal rozi aadi maangi gai hai.

Masjid mein prawesh karte aur masjid se nikalte samay in duaaon ko parhna musathab hai.
Masjid mein prawesh karte samay rahmat aur nikalte samay anugrah ka wishesh roop se ullekh isliye kiya gaya hai ki prawesh karne waala aise kaary mein vyast hone ja raha hai, jo use Allah aur uski Jannat se qareeb karne waala hai, isliye rahmat ka ullekh hi anukool hai, jabki nikalne waala rozi ki khoj mein dharti mein nikalne waala hai, isliye anugrah ka ullekh hi anukool hai.
In azkaar ko masjid mein daakhil hone aur masjid se nikalne ka iraada karte samay parha jayega.
65093: Aadmi ke beech tatha kufr evn shirk ke beech ki rekha namaz chhorna hai.

Jaabir radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko farmaate hue suna hai : "Aadmi ke beech tatha kufr evn shirk ke beech ki rekha namaz chhorna hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farz namaz chhorne se saavdhaan kiya hai aur bataya hai ki insaan tatha kufr evn shirk mein parne ke beech jo cheez khari hai, woh hai namaz chhorna. Namaz Islam ka doosra stanbh aur ek bahut hi mahatvapoorn fareeza (kartavy) hai. Jisne ise iski aniwaaryata ka inkaar karte hue chhor diya, woh kaafir ho gaya, is baat par saare musalmaan ekmat hain. Agar kisi ne susti ke kaaran bhi ise poore taur par chhor diya, to woh bhi kaafir hai. Is baat par sahaaba ka ijma (ekmat) naqal kiya gaya hai. Lekin agar kabhi chhor de aur kabhi parh le, to woh is sakht chetaavni ki zad mein hoga.

Namaz tatha uski paabandi karne ka mahatv. Kyonki yahi kufr evn eemaan ke beech antar karne waali cheez hai.
Namaz chhorne tatha use nasht karne par sakht chetaavni.
65094: Woh wachan, jo hamaare aur unke beech hai, namaz hai. Jisne ise chhor diya, usne kufr kiya.

Buraida radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Woh wachan, jo hamaare aur unke beech hai, namaz hai. Jisne ise chhor diya, usne kufr kiya."
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki musalmaanon aur doosron arthaath kaafiron aur munaafikon ke beech jo wachan hai, woh namaz hai. Jisne namaz chhor di, usne kufr kiya.

Namaz ka mahatv tatha yeh ki namaz momin tatha kaafir ke beech antar karne waali cheez hai.
Islam ke ahkaam insaan ke zaahiri haal se saabit honge, baatin se nahin.
[ise tirmizi, nasai, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
65095: Ai bilaal! Namaz qayam (khari) karo, hamen uske dvaara sukoon pahunchaao.

Saalim bin abu jaa्d se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Ek vyakti ne kaha ki kaash main namaz parhta aur sukoon haasil karta, to ek tarah se logon ne uske is kathan ko bura jaana, ispar usne kaha ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Ai bilaal! Namaz qayam (khari) karo, hamen uske dvaara sukoon pahunchaao."

Ek sahaabi ne kaha ki kaash main namaz parhta aur aaraam paata, to ek tarah se unke aas-paas maujood logon ne unki is baat ko bura samjha, ispar unhonne kaha ki mainne Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai ki ai bilaal! Namaz ke liye azaan do aur namaz qayam karo, taaki ham usse sukoon haasil karen. Kyonki namaz mein Allah se waartaalaap hota hai aur aatma tatha hriday ko sukoon milta hai.

Dil ka sukoon namaz se praapt hota hai, kyonki namaz mein Allah se waartaalaap hota hai.
Ibaadat mein susti karne waale ka khandan.
Jisne apne kartavy ka paalan karte hue us kaary ko kar liya, jo uspar waajbi (aniwaary) tha, to aaraam evn santosh ka bodh hota hai.
[ise abu daawood ne riwayat kiya hai]
65096: Logo! Mainne aisa isliye kiya, taaki tum mera anusran kar sako aur meri namaz seekh sako.

Abu haazim bin deenaar se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Kuchh log sahl bin saad saaidi ke paas aye. Unke beech is baat ko lekar bahas ho gai thi ki minbar ki lakri kis per ki thi? Un logon ne sahl se iske baare mein poochha, to unhonne kaha : Allah ki qasam, mujhe achchhi tarah maaloom hai ki uski lakri kis per ki thi. Mainne us din bhi use dekha jab use pahli baar rakha gaya aur us din bhi dekha jab uspar Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam pahli baar baithe. Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne amuk aurat -ek ansaari aurat jiska naam bhi sahl ne liya tha- ko kahla bheja : "Apne barhai daas se kaho ki mere liye lakri ka ek minbar bana de, jispar main logon se baat karte samay baith sakoon." Chunaanche unhonne apne daas ko iska aadesh diya aur usne jangal ke jhaau ke per se minbar taiyaar karke unko de diya. Chunaanche unhonne use Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas bhej diya aur Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke aadesh se use yahaan rakh diya gaya. Phir mainne dekha ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne uspar khare hokar namaz parhi. Aapne usi par khare hokar takbeer kahi aur usi par khare hokar ruku kiya, phir peechhe hatte hue minbar se utar gae aur minbar ke paas hi sajda kiya aur phir minbar par khare ho gae. Jab namaz poori ho gai, to logon ko sanbodhit karte hue kaha : "Logo! Mainne aisa isliye kiya, taaki tum mera anusran kar sako aur meri namaz seekh sako."

Ek vyakti ek sahaabi ke paas yeh poochhne ke liye aya ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne jo minbar banvaya tha, woh kis lakri ki thi? Daraasal hua yeh tha ki unke beech is sanbandh mein bahas ho gai thi. Chunaanche us sahaabi ne bataya ki aapne ek ansaari aurat ko, jiske paas ek barhai daas tha, kahla bheja ki apne daas se kaho ki mere liye ek minbar bana de, jispar baithkar main logon se baat kar sakoon. Us aurat ne aapke aadesh ka paalan karte hue apne daas ko aapke liye jhaau per ki lakri ka ek minbar banaane ka aadesh diya. Jab minbar bankar taiyaar ho gaya, to us aurat ne use Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas bhej diya. Phir aapke aadesh se use masjid ke andar uske sthaan par rakh diya gaya. Phir Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne uspar khare hokar namaz parhi. Takbeer usi par khare hokar kahi, phir ruku usi par khare hokar kiya, phir minbar se utarkar peechhe ki or chehra ghumaye bina gae, minbar ke paas sajda kiya aur phir minbar par a gae. Jab namaz poori ho gai, to logon ko sanbodhit karte hue kaha : Logo! Mainne aisa isliye kiya, taaki tum mera anusran kar sako aur meri namaz seekh sako.

Minbar rakhna aur uspar charhkar khutba dena musathab hai. Iska uddeshy hota hai, apni baat pahunchaana aur sunaana.
Sikhaane ke liye minbar par namaz parhna jayaz hai aur kisi zaroorat ke kaaran imaam ka muqatdi se oonchi jagah par khara hona bhi jayaz hai.
Musalmaanon ki zaroorat poori karne ke liye hunarmand logon se sahayta lena jayaz hai.
Aawashyaktaanusaar namaz mein thori-bahut harkat (gatiwidhi) karna jayaz hai.
Namaz ki haalat mein muqatdi ke liye namaz seekhne ke uddeshy se apne imaam ko dekhna jayaz hai. Aur yeh winaysheelta ke wiruddh nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65097: Jab tum namaz parho to apni safen satheek kar lo. Phir tummen se ek vyakti tumhaari imaamat kare. Phir jab woh takbeer kahe, to tum takbeer kaho

Hittaan bin abdullah raqqaashi kahte hain ki mainne abu moosa ashaari radiyallahu anhu ke saath ek namaz parhi. Jab woh qaa्da (baithak) mein the, to peechhe namaz parh rahe ek vyakti ne kaha : Namaz ko paropkaar evn zakat ke saath milaakar bayaan kiya gaya hai. Unka kahna hai ki jab abu moosa radiyallahu anhu ki namaz poori ho gai aur salaam pher chuke, to logon ki or munh karke baithe aur bole : Tummen se kisne yeh baat kahi hai? Jab kisi ne koi jawaab nahin diya, to unhonne phir poochha : Tummen se kisne yeh baat kahi hai? Phir jab kisi ne koi jawaab nahin diya, to bole : Ai hittaan! Shayad tumne kaha hai! Mujhe dar tha ki iske kaaran aap mujhe hi daantenge. Yeh sun wahaan maujood ek vyakti ne kaha : Yeh baat mainne kahi hai aur mera iraada achchha hi tha. Ispar abu moosa radiyallahu anhu ne kaha : Kya tum nahin jaante ki tumhen namaz mein kaise kya kahna hai? Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne hamen sanbodhit kiya aur hamen hamaari sunnat bataai tatha hamaari namaz sikhaai. Aapne kaha : "Jab tum namaz parho to apni safen satheek kar lo. Phir tummen se ek vyakti tumhaari imaamat kare. Phir jab woh takbeer kahe, to tum takbeer kaho aur jab woh {غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلا الضَّالِّينَ} [soora al-faatiha : 7] kahe, to tum aameen kaho, Allah tumhaari dua grahan karega. Phir jab takbeer kahe aur ruku kare, to tum bhi takbeer kaho aur ruku karo. Imaam tumse pahle ruku mein jayega aur tumse pahle ruku se uthega." Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Tumhaare ruku mein jaane mein jo kshan bhar ki der hogi, woh ruku se uthne mein hone waali kshan bhar ki der se poori ho jayegi. Tatha jab imaam "سَمِعَ اللهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ" Kahe, to tum "اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ" Kaho, Allah tumhaari dua ko sun lega. Tatha jab woh takbeer kahe aur sajde mein jaye, to tum bhi takbeer kaho aur sajde mein jaao. Imaam tumse pahle sajde mein jayega aur tumse pahle uthega. Iske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Tumhaare sajde mein jaane mein jo kshan bhar ki der hogi, woh sajde se uthne mein hone waali kshan bhar ki der se poori ho jayegi. Tatha jab jalse mein baithe, to sabse pahle yeh dua parhe : التَّحِيَّاتُ الطَّيِّبَاتُ الصَّلَوَاتُ لِلهِ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ"

Sahaabi abu moosa ashaari radiyallahu anhu ne ek namaz parhi. Jab woh us baithak mein the, jismen tashahhud parha jaata hai, to peechhe namaz parh rahe ek vyakti ne kaha ki namaz ka zikr Qur'an mein paropkaar tatha zakat ke saath kiya gaya hai. Jab namaz khatm ho gai, to logon ki or munh pherte hue unse poochha ki tummen se kisne kaha hai ki namaz ka zikr Qur'an mein paropkaar tatha zakat ke saath kiya gaya hai? Jab sab log khaamosh rahe aur kisi ne koi jawaab nahin diya, to sawaal dobaara kiya. Lekin jab phir bhi kisi ne koi uttar nahin diya, to abu moosa radiyallahu anhu ne kaha ki ai hittaan! Shayad tumne hi yeh baat kahi hai? Unhonne hittaan se yeh baat isliye kahi thi ki woh ek diler insaan the aur unse unke gahre sanbandh aur bari nikatta thi, jiske kaaran is baat ki sanbhaavna nahin thi ki woh is aarop se aahat hote. Saath hi iska uddeshy asal baat karne waale ko etraaf karne par ubhaarna bhi tha. Chunaanche hittaan ne isse mana kar diya aur kaha : Mujhe pahle hi se is baat ka dar tha ki yeh samajh kar aap mujhe daantenge ki maine yeh baat kahi hai. Yeh sun wahaan maujood ek vyakti ne kaha ki yeh baat mainne kahi hai aur mera uddeshy kuchh bura nahin tha. Ispar abu moosa radiyallahu anhu ne use shiksha dete hue farmaya ki kya tum nahin jaante tumhen apni namaz mein kya kuchh kahna hai aur kaise kahna hai? Yeh daraasal ek tarah se unka khandan tha. Phir abu moosa ashaari radiyallahu anhu ne bataya ki ek baar Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unko sanbodhit kiya aur unko unki shareeyat tatha namaz sikhaai. Chunaanche aapne bataya :

Jab tum namaz parho, to apni safen satheek tatha seedhi kar liya karo. Phir ek vyakti imaam bankar logon ko namaz parhaye. Chunaanche jab imaam takbeer-e-ehraam kahe, to tum bhi usi ki tarah takbeer-e-ehraam kaho aur jab woh soora faatiha parhte hue {غير المغضوب عليهم ولا الضالين} tak pahunche, to tum aameen kaho. Jab tum aisa karoge, to Allah tumhaari dua grahan karega. Phir jab imaam takbeer kahe aur ruku mein jaye, to tum bhi takbeer kaho aur ruku mein jaao. Imaam tumse pahle ruku mein jayega aur tumse baad mein ruku se uthega. Atah tum usse aage na barho. Tumhaare ruku mein jaane mein jo kshan bhar ki der hogi, woh tumhaare ruku se uthne mein hone waali kshan bhar ki der se poori ho jayegi aur is tarah tumhaare ruku ki lanbaai imaam ke ruku ki lanbaai ke baraabar ho jayegi. Phar jab imaam "سمع الله لمن حمده" Kahe, to tum "اللهم ربنا لك الحمد" Kaho. Jab namaazi aisa kahte hain, to Allah unki dua aur kathan ko sveekaar kar leta hai. Kyonki uchch evn mahaan Allah ne apne Nabi ki zabaani kaha ki Allah ne uski sun li, jisne uski prashansa ki. Phir jab imaam takbeer kahe aur sajde mein jae, to muqatdiyon ko bhi takbeer kahna aur sajde mein jaana hai. Imaam unse pahle sajde mein jayega aur unse pahle sajde se uthega. Is tarah unke sajde mein jaane mein jo kshan bhar ki der hogi, woh unke sajde se uthne mein hone waali kshan bhar ki der se poori ho jayegi aur is tarah unke sajde ki lanbaai imaam ke sajde ki lanbaai ke baraabar ho jayegi. Phir jab tashahhud ke liye baithe, to sabse pahle yeh dua parhe : "التحيات الطيبات الصلوات لله" Yaani raajy, nityata aur mahaanta, in saari cheezon ki yogyata Allah hi ke liye hai. Isi tarah paanchon namaazen Allah ke liye hain. "السلام عليك أيها النبي ورحمة الله وبركاته، السلام علينا وعلى عباد الله الصالحين" Phir Allah se har aib, kami aur buraai tatha fasaad se salaamti ki dua karo. Phir ham wishesh roop se Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko salaam bhejte hain. Phir apne aapko salaam bhejte hain. Phir Allah ke un nek bandon ko salaam bhejte hain, jo Allah aur uske bandon ke aniwaary adhikaaron ko ada karte hain. Phir ham is baat ki gawaahi dete hain ki Allah ke atirikt koi ibaadat ke yogy nahin hai aur Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke bande tatha Rasool hain.

Tashahhud ke taur par parhe jaane waale shabd samoohon mein se ek shabd samooh ka warnan.
Namaz ke sabhi kaaryon evn kathnon ka Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se saabit hona zaroori hai. Namaz mein koi aisa kaary athva kathan jayaz nahin hai, jo sunnat se saabit na ho.
Namaz mein na to imaam se aage barhna jayaz hai aur na usse peechhe rah jaana jayaz hai. Hona yeh chahiye ki imaam ka anusran kiya jaye.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ka sandesh logon ko pahunchaane aur apni ummat ko deen ke ahkaam sikhaane par wishesh dhyaan dete the.
Imaam muqatdiyon ka aadarsh hota hai. Isliye muqatdi namaz ke kaamon mein na imaam se aage barhega, na unhen uske saath-saath karega aur na usse peechhe rah jayega. Balki uska is taur par anusran karega ki jab use wishvaas ho jayega ki jo kaam woh karne ja raha hai, imaam usmen prawesh kar chuka hai, to woh use aaranbh karega. Yahi anusran sunnat hai.
Namaz mein safen seedhi evn satheek karne ki zaroorat.
65098: Us hasti ki qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main tumhaare beech Allah ke Rasool se sabse zyaada milti-julti namaz parhne waala vyakti hoon. Duniya chhorne tak aap isi tarah namaz parhte rahe.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki woh har namaz mein takbeer kaha karte the. Namaz farz ho ki nafal. Ramzan mein ho ki doosre maheenon mein. Woh khare hote samay takbeer kahte, phir ruku mein jaate samay takbeer kahte, phir "سَمِعَ اللهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ" Kahte, phir sajde mein jaane se pahle "رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ" Kahte, phir sajde ke liye jhukte samay takbeer kahte, phir sajde se sar uthaate samay takbeer kahte, phir sajde mein jaate samay takbeer kahte, phir sajde se sar uthaate samay takbeer kahte, phir do rakaat poori hone ke baad ki baithak se khare hote samay takbeer kahte aur aisa namaz poori hone tak har rakaat mein karte. Phir namaz poori karne ke baad kahte : Us hasti ki qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main tumhaare beech Allah ke Rasool se sabse zyaada milti-julti namaz parhne waala vyakti hoon. Duniya chhorne tak aap isi tarah namaz parhte rahe.

Yahaan abu huraira radiyallahu anhu Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki namaz ke tareeqa ka ek bhaag ka warnan kar rahe hain aur bata rahe hain ki jab aap namaz ke liye khare hote, to khare hote samay takbeer-e-ehraam kahte, phir ruku mein jaate samay, sajda karte samay, ruku se sar uthaate samay, doosre sajde mein jaate samay, doosre sajde se sar uthaate samay aur teen ya chaar rakaat waali namaazon mein pahle tashahhud ke liye baithne ke baad pahli do rakaaton se khare hote samay takbeer kahte, phir namaz poori hone tak poori namaz mein aisa hi karte. Jabki ruku se sar uthaate samay "سمع الله لمن حمده" Kahte aur uske baad "ربنا لك الحمد" Kahte.

Phir abu huraira radiyallahu anhu namaz poori karne ke baad kahte : Us hasti ki qasam, jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main tumhaare beech Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se sabse zyaada milti-julti namaz parhne waala vyakti hoon. Duniya chhorne tak aap isi tarah namaz parhte rahe.

Namaz mein har jhukne tatha uthne ke samay takbeer kahi jayegi. Albatta ruku se uthne ki baat isse alag hai. Is samay "سمع الله لمن حمده" Kaha jayega.
Sahaaba Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka anusran tatha aapki sunnat ki suraksha ke prati bare sajag the.

65099: Uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : Mainne namaz ko apne tatha apne bande ke beech aadha-aadha baant diya hai, tatha mere bande ke liye woh sab kuchh hai, jo woh maange

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki maiैnneे Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : Mainne namaz ko apne tatha apne bande ke beech aadha-aadha baant diya hai, tatha mere bande ke liye woh sab kuchh hai, jo woh maange. Jab banda {الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ} (har prakaar ki prashansa us Allah ke liye hai, jo saare sansaaron ka rab hai.) kahta hai, to uchch evn mahaan Allah kahta hai ki mere bande ne meri prashansa ki. Jab woh {الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ} (jo atyant dayaawaan, aseem daya waala hai.) kahta hai, to uchch evn mahaan Allah kahta hai ki mere bande ne meri taareef ki. Jab banda {مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ} (jo badle ke din ka maalik hai.) kahta hai, to Allah kahta hai ki mere bande ne meri baraai bayaan ki hai - kabhi-kabhi kahta hai : Mere bande ne apne saare kaamon ko mere hawaale kar diya hai.- jab banda {إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ} (ai Allah! Ham teri hi ibaadat karte hain aur tujhi se sahayta maangte hain. ) kahta hai, to Allah kahta hai ki yeh mere tatha mere bande ke beech hai aur mere bande ke liye woh sab kuchh hai, jo woh maange. Phir jab banda {اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ، صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلا الضَّالِّينَ} (hamen seedhe maarg par chala. Un logon ka maarg, jinpar toone anugrah kiya. Unka nahin, jinpar tera prakop hua aur na hi unka, jo gumraah hain.) kahta hai, to Allah kahta hai ki yeh mere liye hai aur mere bande ke liye woh sab kuchh hai, jo woh maange."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki uchch evn mahaan Allah ne hadees-e-qudsi mein kaha hai : Mainne namaz mein soora faatiha ko apne tatha apne bande ke beech aadha-aadha baant diya hai. Aadha mere liye hai aur aadha uske liye hai.

Uska pratham aadha bhaag Allah ki taareef, prashansa aur baraai ka bayaan hai. Use parhne par main bande ko uttam pratiphal deta hoon.

Jabki uska doosra aadha bhaag anunay-winay evn dua hai. Main ise bande ke liye grahan karta hoon aur use woh sab kuchh deta hoon, jo woh maange.

Jab namaz parh raha vyakti  {الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ} (har prakaar ki prashansa us Allah ke liye hai, jo saare sansaaron ka rab hai.) kahta hai, to uchch evn mahaan Allah kahta hai ki mere bande ne meri prashansa ki. Jab woh {الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ} (jo atyant dayaawaan, aseem daya waala hai.) kahta hai, to Allah kahta hai ki mere bande ne meri taareef ki aur is baat ka etraaf kiya ki mainne apni srishti par har prakaar ka upkaar kiya hai. Jab banda {مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ} (jo badle ke din ka maalik hai.) kahta hai, to Allah kahta hai ki mere bande ne mere prabhutv ka gun-gaan kiya. Aur yeh bahut bara sammaan hai.

Jab banda {إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ} ((ai Allah!) ham teri hi ibaadat karte hain aur tujhi se sahayta maangte hain. ) kahta hai, to Allah kahta hai ki yeh mere tatha mere bande ke beech hai.

Is ayat ka pahla aadha bhaag yaani {إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ} Allah ke liye hai. Yeh daraasal Allah ke ekmaatr poojy hone ka etraaf hai aur isi par pratham aadha bhaag samaapt ho jaata hai.

Ayat ka doosra bhaag,  {إياك نستعين}  bande ke liye hai, jismen Allah se sahayta maangi gai hai. Aur Allah ne sahayta karne ka waada kiya hai.

Phir jab banda {اهدنا الصراط المستقيم * صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم غير المغضوب عليهم ولا الضالين} kahta hai, to Allah kahta hai : Yeh mere bande ki or se anunay-winay tatha dua hai aur mere bande ke liye wahi hai, jo usne maanga aur mainne uski dua sun li.

Soora faatiha ka mahatv ki Allah ne use al-salaat yaani namaz kaha hai.
Apne bande par Allah ke anugrah ka warnan ki apni prashansa karne ke kaaran bande ki taareef karta hai aur usse is baat ka waada karta hai ki woh use woh sab kuchh dega, jo usne maanga.
Is pawitr soora mein Allah ki prashansa hai, dobaara uthaye jaane ka warnan hai, Allah se dua hai, wishuddh roop se usi ki ibaadat karne ki baat hai, seedha raasta dikhaane ka aagrah hai aur saath hi ismen ghalat raaston par chalne se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai.
Soora faatiha parhte samay namaazi agar is hadees ko apne man mein rakhe, to namaz mein uski winaysheelta barh jaati hai.
65101: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab ruku se peeth uthaate, to yeh dua parhte : "سَمِعَ اللهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، مِلْءَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الْأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدُ" (Allah ne uski sun li, jisne uski prashansa ki

Abdullah bin abu aufa radiyallahu anhu kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab ruku se peeth uthaate, to yeh dua parhte : "سَمِعَ اللهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، مِلْءَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الْأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدُ" (Allah ne uski sun li, jisne uski prashansa ki. Ai Allah! Hamaare rab! Teri hi prashansa hai aakaashon bhar, zameen bhar aur unke baad bhi tu jo chaahe, uske bhar.)

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab namaz mein ruku se sar uthaate, to farmaate : "سمع الله لِمَن حمده" Yaani jisne Allah ki prashansa ki, Allah uski prashansa ko grahan karta hai aur use sawaab deta hai. Phir in shabdon mein Allah ki prashansa karte : " اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، مِلْءَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الْأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدُ " Yaani aisi prashansa jo aakaashon, zameenon aur unke beech ke sthaan ko bhar de aur un tamaam cheezon ko bhar de, jo Allah chaahe.

Us zikr ka bayaan jo ruku se sar uthaate samay kahna musathab hai.
Ruku se uthne ke baad poore itmeenaan (shaanti evn sthirta) ke saath seedha khara hona zaroori hai. Kyonki is poore zikr ko usi samay parhna sanbhav hai, jab aadmi poore itmeenaan ke saath khara ho.
Is zikr ko har namaz mein parhna shareeyat sammat hai. Namaz chaahe farz ho ya nafal.
65102: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam har farz namaz ke baad yeh dua parha karte the

Mugheera bin shoba ke munshi warraad se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Mugheera bin shoba ne mujhse muaawiya ke naam bheje gae ek patr mein likhvaya : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam har farz namaz ke baad yeh dua parha karte the : "لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ" (Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai. Woh akela hai. Uska koi saajhedaar nahin hai. Usi ka raajy tatha usi ki prashansa hai. Woh har kaam ka saamarthy rakhta hai. Ai Allah! Tu jo kuchh de, use koi rokne waala nahin aur jo rok le, use koi dene waala nahin. Kisi dhanvaan ka dhan tere wiruddh uske kuchh kaam nahin a sakta.)

Woh akela hai. Uska koi saajhedaar nahin hai. Usi ka raajy tatha usi ki prashansa hai. Woh har kaam ka saamarthy rakhta hai. Ai Allah! Yaani main kalima-e-tauheed la ilaaha illallah ka iqraar evn etraaf karta hoon. Main sachchi ibaadat ko Allah ke liye siddh karta hoon aur kisi doosre ke liye use siddh karne ka khandan karta hoon. Kyonki Allah ke siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai. Main is baat ka iqraar karta hoon ki waastawik evn sanpoorn raajy Allah ka hai aur aakaashon evn dharti waalon ki saari prashansa ka haqdaar kewal Allah hai. Kyonki wahi har cheez par saksham hai. Woh kisi ko kuchh de ya kisi se kuchh rok le, to koi uske nirnay ko taal nahin sakta. Uske yahaan kisi dhanvaan vyakti ka dhan uske kuchh kaam nahin a sakta. Uske kaam a sakta hai, to uska satkarm.

Ekeshvarvaad evn Allah ki prashansa par aadhaarit is zikr ko namaazon ke baad parhna musathab hai.
Sunnat ke paalan evn use phailaane ke prati tatparta.

"رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي" Iske dvaara banda apne rab se is baat ka aagrah karta hai ki uske gunaah mita de aur uski kamiyon par parda daal de.

65105: Yeh ek shaitaan hai, jise khinzib kaha jaata hai. Jab tumhen uske vyavdhaan daalne ka aabhaas ho, to usse Allah ki sharan maango aur teen baar apne bayen or thutkaaro

Usmaan bin abul aas radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Woh Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aye aur kahne lage : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Shaitaan mere, meri namaz tatha meri tilaawat ke beech rukaawat bankar khara ho jaata hai. Mujhe uljhaane ke prayaas karta hai. Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Yeh ek shaitaan hai, jise khinzib kaha jaata hai. Jab tumhen uske vyavdhaan daalne ka aabhaas ho, to usse Allah ki sharan maango aur teen baar apne bayen or thutkaaro." Unka kahna hai ki mainne ispar amal karna shuru kiya, to Allah ne meri is pareshaani ko door kar diya.

Usmaan bin abul aas radiyallahu anhu Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aye aur kahne lage ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Shaitaan mere tatha meri namaz ke beech rukaawat bankar khara ho jaata hai, mujhe ekaagr hokar namaz parhne nahin deta aur meri tilaawat mein sandeh paida kar deta hai. Atah Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unse kaha : Yeh wahi shaitaan hai, jise khinzib kaha jaata hai. Jab tumhen aisa lage ki woh vyavdhaan daal raha hai, to usse Allah ki sharan maango aur teen baar apne bayen or thutkaaro. Usmaan radiyallahu anhu kahte hain : Jab mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke bataye hue is paddhati par amal karna shuru kar diya, to Allah ne meri is pareshaani ko door kar diya.

Winaysheel hokar tatha dil ko upasthit rakhkar namaz parhne ka mahatv. Saath hi yeh ki shaitaan namaz mein vyavdhaan daalne aur sandeh paida karne ke prayaas mein rahta hai.
Jab shaitaan namaz ke beech dil mein bura khyaal daale, to usse Allah ki sharan maangna aur bayen or teen baar thutkaarna musathab hai.
Sahaaba ke paas jab koi pareshaani aati, to Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas jaate aur use aapse hal karvaate.
Sahaaba ke dil zinda the aur unka uddeshy aakhirat tha.
65107: Allah grahan usi kaary ko karta hai, jo wishuddh roop se usi ke liye usi ki prasannata ki praapti ke liye kiya gaya ho.

Abu umaama baahili radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ek vyakti Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aya aur poochha : Aise vyakti ke baare mein aapki kya ray hai, jo jihaad mein pratiphal evn shohrat donon ki chaahat mein shareek hota hai? Use kya milega? Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne jawaab diya : "Use kuchh nahin milega." Usne apna sawaal teen baar dohraya aur Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne har baar kah diya ki "Use kuchh nahin milega." Phir farmaya :  "Allah grahan usi kaary ko karta hai, jo wishuddh roop se usi ke liye usi ki prasannata ki praapti ke liye kiya gaya ho."

Ek vyakti Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas kisi aise vyakti ke baare mein poochhne aya, jo jihaad mein Allah ke yahaan pritphal praapt karne aur logon ki prashansa batorne ke liye shaamil hota ho. Daraasal woh jaanna chaahta tha ki aise vyakti ko Allah ke yahaan pratiphal milega ya nahin? Chunaanche Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne uttar diya ki use Allah ke yahaan koi pratiphal nahin milega. Kyonki usne apni neeyat mein Allah ke siwa ko shaamil kar liya. Us vyakti ne apna yeh sawaal Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saamne teen baar rakha aur aapne har baar yahi jawaab diya ki use koi pratiphal nahin milega. Uske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne Allah ke yahaan kisi kaary ke grahan hone ya na hone ke sanbandh mein ek siddhaant bata diya. Siddhaant yeh hai ki Allah kewal usi kaary ko grahan karta hai, jise wishuddh roop se uske liye aur uski prasannata praapt karne ke liye kiya gaya ho tatha usmen kisi ko saajhi na banaya gaya ho.

Allah ke yahaan kewal wahi amal sveekaar hota hai, jo wishuddh roop se Allah ke liye aur uske Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke tareeqe ke mutaabiq kiya jaye.
Mufti ke uttar ki ek sundarta yeh honi chahiye ki woh prashn karne waale ke uddeshy ko na kewal poora karta ho, balki kuchh atirikt baaten bhi kah deta ho.
Kisi mahatvapoorn baat ki pushti ke liye uske baare mein baar-baar poochha ja sakta hai.
Sahi mayne mein mujaahid woh hai, jo sachchi neeyat ke saath Allah ke deen ko ooncha karne aur aakhirat mein milne waala pratiphal praapt karne ke liye jihaad mein shareek ho. Uska jihaad duniya praapt karne ke liye na ho.
65114: Allah sota nahin hai tatha sona uski mahaanta ke anuroop bhi nahin hai

Abu moosa radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Hamaare beech Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam khare hue aur paanch baaten farmaaeen : "Allah sota nahin hai tatha sona uski mahaanta ke anuroop bhi nahin hai, woh taraazu ko neeche tatha oopar karta hai, uski or raat ke karm din ke karmon se pahle aur din ke karm raat ke karmon se pahle prastut kiye jaate hain, uska parda noor hai -aur ek riwayat mein hai : Aag hai- yadi woh use khol de, to uske chehre ki chamak uski saari srishtiyon ko wahaan tak jala daalegi, jahaan tak uski nazar pahunchegi."

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apne sahaaba ke beech bhaashan dene ke liye khare hue aur unse paanch baaten kaheen, jo nimnalikhit hain : Pahli baat : Allah sota nahin hai. Doosri baat : Uske liye neend asanbhav hai; kyonki uski qayyoomiyat (har cheez ko sanbhaale rakhne ki poorn shakti) aur uski hayaat (poorn jeewan) mein koi kami nahin hai. Teesri baat : Allah taraazu ko jhukaata aur uthaata hai, bandon ke uski or charhne waale kaaryon aur dharti par utarne waali unki roziyon ke wazan ke anusaar. Atah, woh rozi jo har praani ka hissa aur bhaag hai, Allah use kabhi kam karke sankuchit kar deta hai, aur kabhi barhaakar vyaapak kar deta hai. Chauthi baat : Bandon ke raat ke kaary uske baad waale din se pahle aur din ke kaary uske baad waali raat se pahle Allah ke samaksh prastut kiye jaate hain. Chunaanche, sanrakshak farishte raat samaapt hone par din ke aaranbh mein raat ke kaaryon ko lekar oopar charhte hain aur din samaapt hone par raat ke aaranbh mein din ke kaaryon ko lekar oopar charhte hain. Paanchveen baat : Allah ka parda noor ya aag hai, jo use dekhne se rokta hai. Yadi woh use hata de, to uske chehre ka tejasv uski srishti mein se har us cheez ko jalaakar raakh kar de, jo uski nigaah ki seema tak mein parti ho; kyonki uske chehre ka tejasv hi uska noor, uska jalaal aur uska prataap hai. Bhaawaarth yeh hai ki yadi Allah apne darshan mein baadhak parde ko hata de aur apni srishti ke samaksh prakat ho jaye, to uske mukh ki jyotiyaan un saari srishtiyon ko jalkar raakh kar den, jahaan tak uski drishti pahunchti hai. Yaani saari srishtiyon ko jala den, kyonki Allah ki drishti saari kaynaat tak pahunchti hai.

Is baat ka bayaan ki Allah ke liye neend asanbhav hai; kyonki yeh ek prakaar ki kami hai aur Allah kamiyon se paak hai.
Allah jise chaahta hai sammaanit karta hai aur jise chaahta hai apmaanit karta hai tatha apne bandon mein se jise chaahta hai hidayat deta hai aur jise chaahta hai gumraah karta hai.
Karm har din aur har raat Allah ke yahaan pesh kiye jaate hain. Ismen bandon ke liye yeh prerna hai ki we raat aur din har samay Allah se darte rahen.
Yeh hadees Allah ke nyay aur srishti ke maamlon ki uttam vyawastha ki daleel hai. Ismen koi shak nahin ki yeh isse Allah ki sanpoornata prakat hoti hai.
Allah ke hijaab (parde) mein hone ka saboot. Uska parda noor hai, jo uske aur uski srishti ke beech ek aar hai. Yadi woh na hota, to srishtiyaan jalkar raakh ho jaateen.
Aajurri kahte hain : "Satyawaadi ulema sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ke wahi gun bayaan karte hain, jo khud Allah ne apne liye bayaan kiye hain, uske Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne uske liye bayaan kiye hain aur sahaaba radiyallahu anhum ne Allah ke liye bayaan kiye hain. Yahi sunnat ka anusran karne waale evn bidaat se daaman bachaane waale ulema ka tareeqa hai." Unka kathan samaapt hua. Ahl-e-sunnat sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ke unheen gunon ko saabit karte hain, jinhen khud Allah ne apne liye saabit kiya hai. We in gunon ko batlaane waale shabdon ke saath na to chherchhaar karte hain, na unhen arthaheen banaate hain, na un gunon ki misaal dete hain aur na unki kaifiyat bataate hain. Isi tarah we Allah ko un gunon se paak maante hain, jinse usne khud ko paak ghoshit kiya hai. Aur jahaan kuchh na ho, wahaan khaamosh rahte hain. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : {uske jaisi koi cheez nahin hai aur woh sab kuchh sunne waala sab kuchh dekhne waala hai.}
Woh noor jo paak Allah ka gun (sifat) hai, us noor se alag hai jisse usne parda kiya hai. Jis noor se usne parda kiya hai, woh ek makhlooq (srishti) noor hai. Atah, Allah ka noor ek aisa noor hai jo uski shaan aur uski zaat (hasti) ke yogy hai, uske jaisa kuchh bhi nahin hai. Yaad rahe ki jise Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne dekha tha, woh kewal wahi parda tha, jo Allah aur uske bandon ke beech para hua hai.
65116: Us vyakti ne eemaan ka maza chakh liya, jo santusht hua Allah se rab (utpattikaar, svaami, prabandhak) ke taur par, Islam se dharm tatha Muhammad se sandeshvaahak ke taur par.

Abbaas bin abdul muttalib radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki unhonne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Us vyakti ne eemaan ka maza chakh liya, jo santusht hua Allah se rab (utpattikaar, svaami, prabandhak) ke taur par, Islam se dharm tatha Muhammad se sandeshvaahak ke taur par."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki sachcha aur sudrirh wishvaas rakhne waala momin apne dil mein bari santushti, wistaar, prasannata, mithaas aur Allah ki nikatta ka sukh paata hai, agar nimnalikhit teen baaton se santusht ho :

1- woh Allah ko apna paalanhaar maankar santusht ho. Yaani apne paalanhaar ki di hui tamaam cheezon, jaise rozi aur jeewan ke utaar-charhaav ko saharsh sveekaar kare, uske dil mein in baaton ke sannbandh se Allah se aapatti jaisi koi baat na ho aur Allah ke atirikt kisi ko paalanhaar na banaye.

2- Islam ko apna deen grahan karke santusht ho, Islam dvaara daali gai zimmewaariyon ko saharsh sveekaar kare aur Islam ke maarg ko chhorkar koi any maarg na dhoondhe.

3- Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko Rasool maankar santusht ho. Aapki laai hui sabhi shikshaaon ko sar aankhon par rakhe. Dil mein sandeh na paida hone de aur jeewan bitaane ke aapke tareeqe ka paalan kare.

Eemaan ki bhi mithaas hoti hai, jise dilon dvaara chakha jaata hai, jis prakaar khaane-peene ki cheezon ki mithaas ko zabaan se chakha jaata hai.
Jis prakaar shareer khaane-peene ki cheezon ki mithaas (svaad) kewal svasth hone ki awastha hi mein mahsoos karta hai, usi prakaar dil bhi eemaan ki mithaas kewal pathabhrasht karne waali ichchhaaon aur haraam waasnaaon se surakshit hone ki awastha hi mein mahsoos karta hai.
Jab insaan kisi cheez se santusht ho aur use behtar jaane, to use woh cheez kathin nahin, balki aasaan lagti hai aur khushiyon ki saughaat nazar aati hai. Yahi haal momin ka hai. Jab uske dil mein eemaan baith jaata hai, to uske liye Allah ke aadeshon ka paalan karna aasaan ho jaata hai, uski bandgi mein maza aane lagta hai aur is raah mein aane waali pareshaaniyaan kathin nahin lagteen.
