Ibn-e-qaiyim kahte hain : Is hadees mein Allah ke paalanhaar evn poojy hone se santosh, uske Rasool se santosh aur Rasool ke anusran tatha uske deen se santosh aur uske deen ka anupaalan shaamil hai.
65121: Main tum sab se zyaada parhezgaar aur Allah ko jaanne waala hoon.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab sahaaba-e-kiraam radiyallahu anhum ko aadesh dete to unhi kaamon ka aadesh dete, jinko woh aasaani se kar sakte the . Unhonne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Hamaara haal aap jaisa nahin hai. Allah ne to aapki agli pichhli har kotaahi se darguzar farmaya hai!! Yeh sunkar aap itna naaraaz hue ki aapke chehre par ghusse ka asar zaahir hua, phir aapne farmaya : "Main tum sab se zyaada parhezgaar aur Allah ko jaanne waala hoon."

Mominon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha bataati hain ki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab logon ko kisi kaam ka aadesh dete, to unhen mushkil kaamon ke bajay aasaan kaamon ka aadesh dete the, is dar se ki kaheen we use hamesha jaari rakhne mein asmarth na ho jayen. Aur aap svayn bhi usi aasaani par amal karte the, jiska unhen aadesh dete the. Lekin unhonne aapse mushkil kaamon ka taqaaza kiya, kyonki unka maanna tha ki unhen, aapke wipreet, apne darje buland karne ke liye amal mein zyaada sakhti apnaane ki zaroorat hai. To we kahte hain : "Ai Allah ke Rasool! Hamaari dasha aapki tarah nahin hai, kyonki Allah ne aapke agle-pichhle saare gunaah kshama kar diye hain." Yeh sunkar aap krodhit ho jaate hain, yahaan tak ki aapke chehre par krodh ke bhaav spasht dikhne lage. Phir aap kahte hainh "Nishchay hi, tummen sabse adhik Allah se darne waala aur Allah ko sabse adhik jaanne waala main hoon. Atah, main tumhen jo aadesh doon, uska paalan karo.

Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Aapne unhen kewal wahi kaam karne ka aadesh diya jo unke liye aasaan hon, taaki we uspar hamesha amal karte rahen, jaisa ki doosri hadees mein aata hai : "Allah ko sabse priy amal woh hai, jo hamesha kiya jaye.
Nek vyakti ko apni neki par bharosa karke karm mein prayaas karna nahin chhorna chahiye.
Zaroorat parne par insaan apni fazeelat bayaan kar sakta hai, basharte ki dikhaawe aur abhimaan se surakshit rahe.
Ibaadat ka sabse uttam tareeqa santulan aur nirantarta banaye rakhna hai, na ki aisi atishyokti jo anttah tyaag tak pahuncha de.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Jab banda ibaadat aur uske parinaamon ke charam star tak pahunch jaata hai, to yeh sthiti use ibaadat par aur adhik drirh rahne ke liye prerit karti hai. Aisa woh praapt nemton ko banaye rakhne aur unke prati kritajnata (shukr) vyakt karke unmen wriddhi karne ke uddeshy se karta hai.
Shareeyat ke aadesh ka ullanghan hone par krodhit hona jayaz hai. Isi prakaar us saksham tatha samajhdaar vyakti par aapatti karna bhi uchit hai jo arth samajhne ki yogyata rakhne ke baavjood samajhne mein kotaahi kar jaye, taaki use sachet aur satark kiya ja sake.
Apni ummat par Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki daya, deen ka aasaan hona aur shareeyat ka saty par aadhaarit tatha wishaal hona.
Sahaaba radiyallahu anhum ibaadat ki gahri chaahat rakhthe the aur adhik se adhik bhalaai praapt karne ke ichchhuk hua karte the.
Shariyat dvaara nirdhaarit ki gai seemaaon—chaahe we aniwaary aadesh hon ya di gai chhoot—par adig rahna; aur yeh wishvaas rakhna ki shariyat ke anukool 'aasaan' maarg ko apnaana us 'kathin' maarg se behtar hai, jo shariyat ke mool uddeshy ke wiruddh ho.
65124: Chaar baaten jis vyakti ke andar hongi, woh shuddh munaafiq hoga. Jiske andar inmen se ek baat hogi, uske andar use chhor dene tak nifaaq ki ek baat hogi. Jab baat kare, tab jhooth bole, jab wachan de, to tor daale aur jab jhagre to bad-zabaani kare.

Abdullah bin amr radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Chaar baaten jis vyakti ke andar hongi, woh shuddh munaafiq hoga. Jiske andar inmen se ek baat hogi, uske andar use chhor dene tak nifaaq ki ek baat hogi. Jab baat kare, tab jhooth bole, jab wachan de, to tor daale aur jab jhagre to bad-zabaani kare."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne chaar aisi baaton se saavdhaan kiya hai ki jab wo kisi musalmaan ke andar jama ho jayen, to woh unke kaaran munaafiqon ke bahut zyaada samroop ho jaata hai. Aur yeh tab hoga, jab ye avgun uspar haawi ho jayen. Agar inmen se koi avgun bahut kam paya jaata ho, to woh ismen shaamil nahin hoga. Ye chaar baaten hain :

1- jab baat kare, to jaan-boojhkar jhooth bole aur sach bolne se kanni kaate.

2- jab koi wachan de to uska paalan na kare aur dhokha de daale.

3- jab koi waada kare, to use poora na kare aur uske ulta kare.

4- jab kisi ke saath jhagra kare, to bare sakht andaaz mein jhagra kare. Sahi-ghalat ka khyaal na rakhe, sahi ka khandan kare, use ghalat thahraye aur ghalat tatha jhooth bole.

Kyonki nifaaq naam hai dil mein kuchh rakhne tatha zaahir kuchh aur karne ka aur yeh gun ukt logon ke andar paya ja raha hai. Yahaan yeh yaad rahe ki ukt avgun rakhne waale vyakti ka nifaaq daraasal us vyakti ke haq mein hoga, jisne usse baat ki, waada kiya, uske paas amaanat rakhi aur jhagra kiya. Is hadees ka matlab yeh nahin hai ki woh Islam ke sannbandh mein munaafiq hai, atah musalmaan hone ka dikhaawa karta hai aur andar kufr chhupaye rakhta hai. Doosri baat yeh yaad rahe ki jis vyakti ke andar inmen se koi ek avgun hoga, uske andar nifaaq ka ek wisheshan hoga, jab tak use chhor na de.

Yahaan nifaaq ki kuchh nishaaniyaan bayaan kar di gai hain, taaki un mein parne se daraya aur saavdhaan kiya ja sake.
Is hadees ka arth yeh hai ki ye wisheshtayen nifaaq ki wisheshtayen hain aur jis vyakti mein ye wisheshtayen hoti hain, woh in wisheshtaaon mein munaafiqon jaisa hota hai aur unke aachran ko dhaaran karta hai. Iska matlab yeh nahin ki woh aisa munaafiq hai jo musalmaan hone ka dikhaawa karta hai aur apne dil mein kufr chhupaye rakhta hai. Kuchh log kahte hain ki yeh hadees us vyakti par laagu hoti hai jispar yeh wisheshtayen haawi ho jaati hain aur inke prati laaparvaah hota hai tatha inhen halke mein leta hai. Kyonki aisa vyakti aamtaur par bad-aqeeda bhi hota hai.
Ghazaali kahte hain : Waastav mein, dhaarmikta teen cheezon par nirbhar karti hai : Shabd, kaary aur iraade. Yahaan, Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne jhooth bolne ki baat kahkar waani mein bhrashtaachaar, wishvaasghaat karne ki baat kahkar kaary mein bhrashtaachaar, tatha waada torne ki baat kahkar neeyat mein bhrashtaachaar ki or ishaara kiya hai. Kyonki waada torna tabhi galat hai jab waada karte samay hi use poora na karne ka iraada kar liya gaya ho. Iske wipreet, yadi koi vyakti kisi waade ko poora karna chaahta ho, lekin koi baadha utpann ho jaye aur woh waada poora karne mein asmarth ho jaye, to uska yeh kaary nifaaq ke dayre mein nahin ayega.
Nifaaq ke do prakaar hain : Pahla aqeede ka nifaaq hai, jo insaan ko eemaan ke dayre se baahar nikaal deta hai. Aqeede ka nifaaq naam hai baahar se musalmaan hone ka daawa karne aur andar kufr chhupaye rakhne ka. Jabki doosra amal ka nifaaq hai, jo insaan ko eemaan ke dayre se baahar to nahin nikaalta, lekin hai kabeera gunaah.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Ulema ka is baat par ittefaaq hai ki jo vyakti apne dil se Islam ki pushti kare aur zabaan se musalmaan hone ka daawa kare tatha iske baavjood ye kaary kare, to use kaafir nahin maana jayega. Use aisa munaafiq bhi nahin samjha jayega, jiska sada ka thikaana Jahannam ho.
Navvi kahte hain : Ulema ka ek giroh kahta hai : Isse muraad Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke daur ke munaafiq hain, jinhonne momin hone ki baat kahkar jhooth bola, deen ki amaanat uthaai aur khayaanat ki, deen par qayam rahne aur uski madad karne ka waada karke use tor daala aur apne jhagron mein bad-zabaani ki.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65172: Ham antim ummat hain, aur sabse pahle hamaara hisaab-kitaab hoga

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Ham antim ummat hain, aur sabse pahle hamaara hisaab-kitaab hoga. Kaha jayega : Kahaan hai ummi ummat aur uske Nabi? To ham hi sabse antim aur sabse pahle hain."

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki unki ummat astitv aur samay ke hisaab se antim ummat hai, lekin qayaamat ke din sabse pahle isi ummat ka hisaab hoga. Chunaanche, qayaamat ke din kaha jayega : Ummi ummat aur uske Nabi kahaan hain? Yeh naam aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke ummi hone, yaani parh-likh na sakne, ko vyakt karta hai. Is tarah, unhen hisaab ke liye sabse pahle pukaara jayega. Atah ham zamaane aur astitv ke aadhaar par sabse antim samuday hain, magar qayaamat ke din hisaab mein aur Jannat mein daakhil hone mein sabse pahle rahenge.
Is ummat ki pichhli ummaton par shreshthata.
[ise ibne maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
65218: Ham Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath the aur ham wayask hone hi waale the. Hamne Qur'an seekhne se pahle eemaan seekha aur uske baad Qur'an seekha, to isse hamaara eemaan aur barh gaya.

Jundub bin abdullah radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ham Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath the aur ham wayask hone hi waale the. Hamne Qur'an seekhne se pahle eemaan seekha aur uske baad Qur'an seekha, to isse hamaara eemaan aur barh gaya.

Jundub bin abdullah radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki ham Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath the aur us samay ham wayask hone ke kareeb, shaktishaali aur balvaan naujvaan the. To hamne Qur'an seekhne se pahle Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se eemaan seekha aur uske baad Qur'an seekha, jisse hamaara eemaan aur barh gaya.

Eemaan ke barhne aur ghatne ka bayaan.
Bachchon ke paalan-poshan mein praathmikta ke aadhaar par krambaddh tareeqe se kaam karna tatha unhen eemaan se paripoorn karne ka dhyaan rakhna.
Qur'an eemaan ko barhaata hai, dil ko raushan karta hai aur seene ko khol deta hai.
[ise ibne maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
65231: Nabiyon mein se koi bhi Nabi aisa nahin hua, jise aise chamatkaar (nishaaniyaan) na diye gae hon jinhen dekhkar manushy eemaan le aye

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Nabiyon mein se koi bhi Nabi aisa nahin hua, jise aise chamatkaar (nishaaniyaan) na diye gae hon jinhen dekhkar manushy eemaan le aye, aur jo chamatkaar mujhe diya gaya, woh wahy hai jo Allah ne mujhpar awatrit ki hai. Isliye mujhe ummeed hai ki qayaamat ke din mere anusrankarta sabse adhik honge."

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki Allah ne sabhi nabiyon ki sahayta ki aur unhen aisi nishaaniyaan aur asaadhaaran chamatkaar pradaan kiye jo unke Nabi hone ka pramaan hote hain aur unhen dekhne waale ke liye unki sachchaai par eemaan laana aawashyak bana dete hain. Woh is chunauti ke saamne wiwash ho jaata hai aur uska khandan nahin kar paata. Haan, jhuthlaane aur hathdharmi ka maarg apna le to baat alag hai. Nihsandeh aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki nishaani aur chamatkaar woh Qur'an hai, jise Allah ne aap par wahy (prakaashna) ke roop mein awatrit kiya hai; kyonki woh ek spasht evn sthayi chamatkaar hai aur usmen anekon laabh evn sarvavyaapi fayde maujood hain. Choonki usmen aahvaan, daleel aur bhawishy mein hone waali ghatnaaon ki soochnayen maujood hain, isliye uska laabh un sab ke liye aam ho gaya, jo upasthit the aur jo anupasthit the, jo maujood the aur jo bhawishy mein ayenge. Phir aapne farmaya : 'To main ummeed karta hoon ki qayaamat ke din mere anuyayi sabse adhik honge.'

Nabiyon ki nishaaniyon ka saabit hona aur yeh daraasal ummaton par Allah ki daya aur unka anugrah hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke chamatkaar ki mahaanta ka bayaan.
Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke mahaan sthaan aur any nabiyon ke muqaable mein aapki shreshthata ka bayaan.
Ibn -e- hajar rahimhullah, Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ke is kathan : “Aur jo chamatkaar mujhe diya hai gaya woh wahy (Qur'an) hai” ke baare mein kahte hain : Iska matlab yeh nahin hai ki aapke chamatkaar kewal isi tak seemit hain, na hi yeh ki aapko pahle ke nabiyon jaise chamatkaar nahin mile. Balki matlab yeh hai ki yeh sabse bara chamatkaar hai, jo kewal aapko hi mila.
Navvi kahte hain Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke shabdon "(To main ummeed karta hoon ki main un sab mein sabse zyaada anuyayiyon waala hooonga) ke baare mein kahte hain : Yeh aapke Nabi hone ki nishaaniyon mein se ek nishaani hai, kyonki aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne yeh baat us samay bataai thi, jab musalmaanon ki sankhya bahut kam thi. Phir Allah taaala ne upkaar kiya, musalmaanon ko wijay pradaan ki aur unmen barkat di, yahaan tak ki musalmaanon ka wistaar us seema tak ho gaya, jise ham sab jaante hain. Ant mein saari prashansa Allah ki hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65245: Anas (radiyallahu anhu) se poochha gaya ki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki qiraat kaisi thi? To unhonne uttar diya : "Khoob kheenchkar parhte the.

Qataada se warnit hai, woh kahte hain : Anas (radiyallahu anhu) se poochha gaya ki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki qiraat kaisi thi? To unhonne uttar diya : "Khoob kheenchkar parhte the.", phir {bismillahirrahmaanirraheem} [soorah faatihaah 1] parhkar bataya ki bismillah, ar-rahmaan aur ar-raheem ko kheenchkar parha karte the.

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu se poochha gaya ki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Qur'an ki qiraat (paath) kaise karte the? To unhonne jawaab diya : Aap apni aawaaz ko kheenchkar qiraat karte the; aap lafz -e- jalaala (Allah) mein 'ha' se pahle 'laam' ko, 'ar-rahmaan' mein 'noon' se pahle 'meem' ko aur 'ar-raheem' mein 'ha' ko kheenchte the.

Madd, madd ke aksharon, yaani alif, waav aur ya, ko kheenchkar (lanba karke) parhna hai, jab we saakin hon aur unse pahle unke anukool harkat (svar) maujood ho.
Qur'an parhne ke wishay mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke tareeqe ka bayaan.
Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke parhne ke tareeqe ka vyaavhaarik namoona.
Sindhi kahte hain : "يمد صوته مدًا" Ka arth yeh hai ki aap kheenchne yogy aksharon ko lanba karte, taaki unhen chintan-manan karne aur naseehat haasil karne waalon ko naseehat dene mein madad mile.
Tajveed aur Qur'an se sanbandhit wijnaan ko jaanne ka mahatv.
Nusoos (dhaarmik granthon) ko samajhne ke liye ulema se sanpark kiya jayega, jaise ki anas radiyallahu anhu se sanpark kiya gaya, to unhonne masle ko spasht kar diya.
65252: Suno! Tummen se har koi apne rab se munaajaat (sargoshi) kar raha hai, isliye koi kisi ko takleef na pahunchaye

Abu saeed radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne masjid mein etikaaf kiya, to logon ko buland aawaaz se Qur'an parhte hue suna. Chunaanche, aapne parda hataya aur farmaya : "Suno! Tummen se har koi apne rab se munaajaat (sargoshi) kar raha hai, isliye koi kisi ko takleef na pahunchaye, aur koi Qur'an parhte hue apni aawaaz doosre se buland na kare", ya farmaya : "Namaz mein."

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ki nikatta praapt  karne ke liye apni masjid ke andar ek gunbadnuma kheme mein etikaaf mein the, to aapne apne sahaaba ko bahut oonchi aawaaz mein Qur'an paath karte hue suna, jiske kaaran we ek-doosre ko takleef pahuncha rahe the. Atah, aapne kheme se parda hataya aur aisa karne waale ko malaamat ki tatha daanta. Phir farmaya : Tummen se pratyek vyakti Qur'an parhkar apne rab se sanwaad kar raha hai. Atah, tummen se koi kisi doosre ko kasht na pahunchaye aur na hi Qur'an paath karte samay ya namaz mein ek-doosre ke saamne apni aawaaz oonchi kare.

Oonchi aawaaz mein Qur'an ki tilaawat karne se rukne ka aadesh, yadi usse kisi ko haani pahunchti ho.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka apne sahaaba ko Qur'an ki tilaawat ke aadaab sikhaana.
[ise abu daawood ne riwayat kiya hai]
65255: “Aadmi ke achchhe musalmaan hone ki ek nishaani yeh hai ki woh bematlab ki cheezon ko chhor de.”

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : “Aadmi ke achchhe musalmaan hone ki ek nishaani yeh hai ki woh bematlab ki cheezon ko chhor de.”

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bayaan farmaya hai ki ek musalmaan ke sanpoorn musalmaan tatha momin hone ka ek chihn yeh hai ki woh aisi baaton evn kaaryon se door rahe, jo usse sarokaar na rakhte hon, uske matlab ke na hon aur uske liye laabhdayak na hon. Ya phir aise saansaarik evn dhaarmik cheezon se door rahe, jo usse sarokaar na rakhte hon. Kyonki bina sarokaar ki cheezon mein vyastata sarokaar ki cheezon se door kar sakti hai ya aisi cheezon ki or le ja sakti hai, jinse bachna zaroori hai, kyonki qayaamat ke din insaan se uske apne karmon ke baare mein poochha jayega.

Logon ke beech Islam apnaane mein antar hua karta hai aur kuchh karmon se Islam ki sundarta mein wriddhi ho jaati hai.
Bekaar aur vyarth kaaryon aur shabdon se bachna ek vyakti ke poorn musalmaan hone ka pramaan hai.
Yahaan insaan ko aisi dhaarmik aur saansaarik gatiwidhiyon mein vyast hone ke liye protsaahit kiya gaya hai, jo usse sarokaar rakhti hon. Kyonki jab bina sarokaar ki gatiwidhiyon se door rahna ek achchhe musalmaan hone ka pramaan hai, to iska arth yeh hai ki ek achchhe musalmaan ko apne sarokaar ke kaaryon mein vyast rahna chahiye.
Ibn-e-qaiyim kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne dharmaprayanta ke saare roopon ko ek hi waaky mein ekatr kar diya hai. Aapne kaha hai : “Aadmi ke achchhe musalmaan hone ki ek nishaani yeh hai ki woh bematlab ki cheezon ko chhor de.” kyonki iske andar baat karna, dekhna, sunna, pakarna, chalna aur sochna aadi sabhi baahy evn aantrik gatiwidhiyaan shaamil hain, jo sarokaar ki na hon. Dharmaprayanta ke sannbandh mein yeh ek santoshajnak waaky hai.
Ibne rajab kahte hain; yeh hadees shishtaachaar ke aadhaaron mein se ek aadhaar hai.
Yeh hadees jnaan arjit karne ko protsaahit karti hai, kyonki kewal jnaan ke maadhyam se hi vyakti yeh jaan sakta hai ki kaun-sa kaam usse sanbandhit hai aur kaun-sa nahin.
Bhalaai ka aadesh dena, buraai se rokna aur shubhchintan karna insaan ke sarokaar ke kaamon mein se hain. Kyonki use in kaamon ka aadesh diya gaya hai.
Is hadees ke arth ki vyaapakta mein un sabhi bina sarokaar ki cheejon se door rahna shaamil hai, jinhen Allah taaala ne haraam thahraya hai aur Nabi kareem -sallallahu alaihi wasallam- ne naapsand kiya hai. Isi tarah paroksh se sanbandhit tathyon aur srishti wa aadesh ki wistrit hikamten aadi aakhirat se sanbandhit aisi baaten bhi ismen shaamil hain, jinki kisi musalmaan ko zaroorat nahin hoti, ismen un kaalpanik muddon par bahas aur khojbeen bhi shaamil hai, jo waastav mein ghatit nahin hue hon, jinke ghatit hone ki ummeed na ho, ya jinka ghatit hona asanbhav ho.
[allaama navvi rahimhullah kahte hain : Hadees hasan hai.]
[is hadees ko tirmizi aadi ne riwayat kiya hai]
65258: Rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam hamen har haal mein Qur'an parhaate the, siway janaabat (apvitrata) ki haalat ke.
Ali radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam hamen har haal mein Qur'an parhaate the, siway janaabat (apvitrata) ki haalat ke.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apne sahaaba ko har haal mein Qur'an sikhaate aur parhaate the, jab tak ki apni patni se sahvaas ke kaaran janaabat (ashuddhata) ki haalat mein na hote.

Jab tak junbi vyakti snaan na kar le, uske liye Qur'an parhna jayaz nahin hai.
Vyaavhaarik roop se shiksha dena.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, nasai, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
65261: Uski qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, yeh soora ek tihaai quraan ke samaan hai.

Tatha abu saeed khudri -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ek vyakti ne ek any vyakti ko "Qul huwallahu ahad" Parhte hue suna, jo use baar-baar dohraye ja raha tha. Subah hui to woh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas pahuncha aur iske baare mein bataya. Aisa prateet ho raha tha ki woh ise kam samajh raha hai. Atah Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Uski qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, yeh soora ek tihaai quraan ke samaan hai."

Abu sai khudri -radiyallahu anhu- bata rahe hain ki ek vyakti ne ek any vyakti ko dekha ki woh poori raat soora "Qul huwallahu ahad" Parhe ja raha hai. Isse aage kuchh nahin parhta. Subah hui, to woh Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas pahuncha aur iske baare mein bataya. Goya sawaal karne waala ise thora samajh raha tha. Atah Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apni baat par zor dene ke liye qasam khaate hue farmaya : Uski qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, yeh soora ek tihaai quraan ke baraabar hai.

Soora ikhlaas ki yeh fazeelat ki yeh soora ek tihaai quraan ke baraabar hai.
Tahajjud ki namaz mein chand ayton ko baar-baar parhna jayaz hai. Ise kam nahin samajhna chahiye.
Maaziri kahte hain : Kisi ne kaha hai : Is hadees ka arth yeh hai ki Qur'an ke andar teen prakaar ke wishay-wastu bayaan hue hain. Qisse, aadesh-nirdesh tatha uchch evn mahaan Allah ke gun. Choonki soora ikhlaas mein Allah ke gun bayaan hue hain, isliye yeh ek tihaai Qur'an hai. Jabki kisi ne kaha hai : Iska arth hai : Ise parhne ka sawaab barhaakar ek tihaai Qur'an parhne ke sawaab ke baraabar kar diya jayega.
65285: Balki kaho : Hamne suna aur hamne aajnaapaalan kiya. Ai hamaare paalanhaar! Ham teri kshama chaahte hain aur teri hi or lautna hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Jab rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par {لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِنْ تُبْدُوا مَا فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ يُحَاسِبْكُمْ بِهِ اللهُ فَيَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ} [البقرة: 284] ayat utri, to yeh baat rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke sahaaba par bahut bhaari guzri. We rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aye, phir ghutnon ke bal baith gae aur kahne lage : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Hampar aise kaaryon ka bhaar daala gaya hai, jinhen ham kar sakte hain; namaz, roza, jihaad aur sadqa. Aur aappar yeh jo ayat utri hai, yeh hamaare saamarthy se baahar hai. Rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne pharmaya : "Kya tum wahi kahna chaahte ho, jo tumse pahle ke do kitaabon waalon (yahood evn nasaara) ne kaha tha ki hamne suna aur hamne awajna ki? Balki kaho : Hamne suna aur hamne aajnaapaalan kiya. Ai hamaare paalanhaar! Ham teri kshama chaahte hain aur teri hi or lautna hai.", unhonne kaha : Hamne suna aur hamne aajnaapaalan kiya. Ai hamaare paalanhaar! Ham teri kshama chaahte hain aur teri hi or lautna hai. Jab logon ne ise parha, to unki zabaanen is par chal pareen, atah Allah ne iske baad yeh ayat utaari : {آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ المَصِيرُ} [البقرة: 285]. Jab unhonne aisa kiya, to Allah taaala ne use nirast kar diya, phir yeh ayat utaari : {لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا} [البقرة: 286] kaha : "Haan". {رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا} [البقرة: 286] kaha : "Haan". {رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ} [البقرة: 286] kaha : "Haan". {وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الكَافِرِينَ} [البقرة: 286] kaha : "Haan."

Jab Allah ne apne Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par apna yeh kathan utaara : {لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ} (aakaashon tatha dharti mein jo kuchh hai, sab Allah ka hai) rachna, svaamitv, niyantran aur prabandhan ki drishti se, {وَإِنْ تُبْدُوا} (aur yadi tum prakat karo) yaani use zaahir aur ghoshit karo {مَا فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ} (jo tumhaare dilon mein hai) aur seenon mein {أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ} (ya use chhipaao) yaani use gupt rakho aur apne dilon mein chhipa lo (يُحَاسِبْكُمْ بِهِ اللَّهُ} (Allah tumse uska hisaab lega) qayaamat ke din. {فَيَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ} (to woh jise chaahe, kshama kare) apne anugrah aur apni daya se, {وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ} (aur jise chaahe, dand de) apne nyay se, {وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ} (tatha Allah har cheez par sarvashaktimaan hai) koi cheez use wiwash nahin kar sakti. Jab sahaaba ne yeh suna, to yeh baat unpar bahut bhaari guzri; kyonki ismen dil mein aane waale khyaalon par bhi pakar ki baat thi. Atah, we Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aye, phir ghutnon ke bal baith gae aur kahne lage : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Isse pahle hampar aise shaareerik karm aniwaary kiye gae the, jinhen karne ki ham shakti rakhte the; jaise namaz, roza, jihaad aur sadqa. Lekin ab aappar yeh ayat naazil hui hai aur ham mein ise karne ki shakti nahin hai. To Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unse kaha : Kya tum waisa hi kahna chaahte ho jaisa yahoodiyon aur eesaaiyon ne kaha : {‌سَمِعْنَا وَعَصَيْنَا} ''hamne suna aur hamne awajna ki''? Balki kaho : {سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ المَصِيرُ} ''hamne suna aur hamne aajnaapaalan kiya. Ham teri kshama chaahte hain ai hamaare rab! Aur teri hi or lautkar jaana hai.'' sahaaba ne Allah aur uske Rasool ke aadesh ko sveekaar kiya, aur kaha : ''Hamne suna aur hamne aajnaapaalan kiya. Ham teri kshama chaahte hain ai hamaare rab! Aur teri hi or lautkar jaana hai.'' jab musalmaanon ne apni zubaanon se yeh kah diya aur unke dilon ne ise sveekaar kar liya; to Allah ne Nabi aur unki ummat ki prashansa mein yeh ayat utaari : {آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالمُؤْمِنُونَ} aur unki zubaanon aur dilon ne Allah ke aadesh ko sveekaar kar liya. ''Harek Allah aur uske farishton aur uski pustakon aur uske rasoolon par eemaan laya. (We kahte hain) ham uske rasoolon mein se kisi ek ke beech antar nahin karte.'' balki ham un sab par eemaan laate hain {aur unhonne kaha, hamne suna} aapki baat {aur hamne aajna ka paalan kiya} aapke aadesh ka, aur ham {teri kshama, ai hamaare paalanhaar} aur teri maafi maangte hain, {aur teri hi or lautna hai} aur (antim) thikaana us din hai, jab hisaab qayam hoga. To jab unhonne aisa kiya, aur Allah ke aadeshon ke prati sunne aur aajnaapaalan ko prakat karne ke liye woh kaha jiska unhen aadesh diya gaya tha; to Allah ne is ummat se (bhaar) halka kar diya aur us ayat ko apne is kathan se nirast kar diya: {Allah kisi praani par uski kshamta}, saamarthy, shakti aur prayaas se adhik bhaar nahin daalta. {usi ke liye} uska puny hai {jo usne kamaya} arthaat bhalaai ke kaary ka pratiphal hai, {aur usi par} uska dand hai {jo usne kamaya} arthaat paap aur gunaah ka dand hai. Aur Allah kisi ko doosre ke paap ke liye nahin pakarta, aur na hi uske liye jo uske man mein wasavsa (bura wichaar) aata hai. {ai hamaare paalanhaar! Hamaari pakar na kar} aur hamen saza na de {yadi ham bhool jayen} aur yaad na rakh saken, {ya hamse chook ho jaye} aur hamse anjaane mein sahi baat chhoot jaye, to Allah ne unki yeh dua qabool farmaai aur farmaya : Haan, mainne aisa kar diya hai. {ai hamaare paalanhaar! Aur hampar koi bhaari bojh na daal} yaani kathinaai aur bojh {jaise toone un logon par daala jo hamse pahle the} yaani bani israaeel aur unke alaawa doosron par, to Allah ne dua qabool ki aur farmaya : Haan, mainne aisa kar diya hai. {ai hamaare paalanhaar! Aur hampar woh bojh na daal, jise uthaane ki hamaare andar shakti na ho} arthaat aise dayitvon, pareekshaaon aur maamlon ka, jinhen uthaane mein ham asmarth hain. Allah ne kaha : Haan, mainne aisa kar diya, {aur hamaare paapon ki andekhi kar de} arthaat hamaare paapon ko hamse mita de, {hamen kshama kar de} arthaat hamaare paapon ko ham par chhipa de aur unhen andekha kar de, {tatha hampar daya kar} apni wistrit daya se, {tu hi hamaara svaami hai} aur hamaara sardaar hai; {atah hamaari sahayta kar} tark sthaapit karke aur prabhutv dekar {kaafiron ke wiruddh} unke saath yuddh aur jihaad mein. To Allah ne dua sveekaar kar li aur kaha : Haan, mainne aisa kar diya.

Apne Nabi (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ke kaaran is ummat par Allah taaala ki daya ka warnan, jinki shaan mein Allah taaala ne farmaya hai : {وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا ‌رَحْمَةً ‌لِلْعَالَمِينَ} (ai Nabi!) hamne aapko samast sansaaron ke liye daya banaakar bheja hai. [al-anbiya : 107].
Pawitr Qur'an ki kuchh ayton ke nirast hone ka saboot tatha is baat ka pramaan ki Qur'an ki kuchh ayten aisi hain, jinka paath to kiya jaata hai, lekin unka hukm nirast kar diya gaya hai. Atah unpar amal nahin kiya jaata.
Sahaaba radiyallahu anhum ki fazeelat, Allah ke aadesh ke prati unki aajnaakaarita wa samarpan, tatha uske Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke aadesh ka anupaalan.
Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko apni ummat ke baare mein bahut adhik bhay tha ki kaheen woh pichhli ummaton ke raaste par chalkar Allah ke aadeshon ko radd na kar de.
Allah ke aadesh ke saamne aatmasmarpan karna aur uspar aapatti jataane se saavdhaan rahna aniwaary hai, kyonki aapatti jataana poorvawarti granthon waale samudayon ka tareeqa hai.
Pichhli ummaton par is ummat ki shreshthata ka bayaan ki unhonne apne anbiya se kaha : Hamne suna aur hamne awajna ki, aur is ummat ne kaha : Hamne suna aur hamne aajnaapaalan kiya.
Is ummat ki yeh phazeelat (shreshthata) ki usse kathinaaiyon ko door kar diya gaya hai; bhool-chook aur anjaane mein hui galti par pakar na hone ki dua sveekaar kar li gai hai; un bhaari bojhon ko hata diya gaya hai jo unse pahle ke logon par the; aur unhen us cheez ka paaband nahin banaya gaya hai jise sahne ki unke andar shakti nahin hai.
Allah hampar us cheez ka bhaar nahin daalta, jise ham sahan na kar saken, aur woh ham par hamaari kshamta se adhik dayityon ka bojh nahin daalta. Tatha jo wasavse hamaare dilon mein aate hain, yadi ham unki or na jhuken, unpar santusht na hon aur unpar amal na karen, to we koi haani nahin pahunchaate.
Is dua ke baare mein Allah ne bataya hai ki yeh Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aur mominon ki dua hai, aur usne ise apni kitaab mein isliye rakha hai; taaki yeh Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aur sahaaba radiyallahu anhum ke baad aane waalon ke liye bhi ek dua ban jaye. Atah, yeh un duaaon mein se hai, jinhen yaad kar lena chahiye aur baaranbaar parhna chahiye.
65298: Aapki kitaab (Qur'an) mein ek aisi ayat hai, jise aap parhte rahte hain, agar woh ayat ham yahoodiyon par naazil hoti to ham us din ko eed ka din thahraate

Umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai : Ek yahoodi ne unse kaha : Ai mominon ke ameer! Aapki kitaab (Qur'an) mein ek aisi ayat hai, jise aap parhte rahte hain, agar woh ayat ham yahoodiyon par naazil hoti to ham us din ko eed ka din thahraate. Umar -radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha : Woh kaun-si ayat hai? Yahoodi bola yeh ayat : “Aaj mainne tumhaare liye tumhaara deen poora kar diya aur apna ehsaan bhi tum par tamaam kar diya aur deene Islam ko tumhaare liye pasand kiya.” umar -radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha ki ham us din aur us sthaan ko jaante hain, jismen yeh ayat rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par utri thi. Yeh ayat juma ke din utri thi, jab aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam arfa mein khare the .

Ek yahoodi ameerul momineen umar radiyallahu anhu ke paas aya aur unse kaha : Tumhaari kitaab Qur'an mein ek ayat hai, jise tum parhte ho. Agar woh ham yahoodiyon par hamaari kitaab tauraat mein naazil hoti, to ham us din ko eed ka din thahraate, jismen ham jashn manaate; is mahaan ayat ke utarne ki nemat ka shukr ada karne ke liye. Yeh sun umar radiyallahu anhu ne usse poochha : Woh kaunsi ayat hai? Usne uttar diya : {mainne aaj tumhaare liye tumhaare dharm ko sanpoorn kar diya hai tatha tum par apni nemat poori kar di hai, aur tumhaare liye Islam ko dharm svaroop pasand kar liya hai.} atah umar radiyallahu anhu ne kaha : Ham us din aur us sthaan ko jaante hain, jismen yeh mubaarak ayat utri thi. Yeh eed ke din, yaani juma ke din, Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par us samay utri thi, jab aap arfa mein khare the aur yeh donon hi din musalmaanon ke nazdeek mahaan din hain.

Is baat ka warnan ki umar radiyallahu anhu ayat ke utarne ke sthaan aur samay ka kitna dhyaan rakhte the.
Is ayat mein Allah ke us upkaar ka warnan hai, jo usne is ummat par kiya hai ki usne iske deen ko sanpoorn kar diya aur ispar apni nemten poori kar deen, jiske kaaran use deen ke maamle mein kisi wriddhi ki aawashyakta nahin hai. Atah, Allah dvaara use poora kar dene ke baad jo kuchh bhi naya paida hua, jiska koi pramaan usmen nahin hai, woh gumraah karne waali bidaat hai, jaisa ki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se pramaanit hai ki aapne farmaya : "Jisne hamaare is deen mein koi aisi nai cheez nikaali, jo ismen se nahin hai, to woh asveekaary hai."
Is hadees se yeh nishkarsh nikaala ja sakta hai ki eeden vyaktigat ray aur awishkaar par aadhaarit nahin hoteen, jaisa ki hamse pahle ke do kitaab waale karte the; balki we shareeyat aur anusran par aadhaarit hoti hain. Atah, jab is ayat mein deen ke poorn hone aur nemat ke poora hone ka zikr aya, to Allah ne ise ek aise din utaara, jise usne is ummat ke liye do pahluon se eed banaya hai : Pahla yeh ki woh saptaah ki eed ka din yaani juma ka din hai aur doosra yeh ki woh Hajj ke avsar par ekatr logon ki eed ka din hai, jo unke sabse bare jamaavre aur unke sabse mahaan paraav ka din hai.
Saadi ne pawitr Qur'an ki ayat {aaj mainne tumhaare liye tumhaare dharm ko sampoorn kar diya} ki tafseer karte hue kaha hai : Arthaat poori sahayta ke saath aur dharm ke pratyaksh tatha apratyaksh siddhaanton evn mool tatha up-widhaanon ko poora karke. Yahi kaaran hai ki kitaab aur sunnat, dharm ke aadeshon, uske mool siddhaanton aur up-niymon ke wishay mein poorn roop se paryaapt hain. Atah, har woh vyakti jo daawa karta hai ki logon ke liye apne aqeedon aur aadeshon ko jaanne ke liye kitaab aur sunnat ke jnaan ke alaawa doosre jnaanon, jaise ilm-e-kalaam aadi ki aawashyakta hai, to woh ajnaani aur apne daawe mein asaty par hai. Usne yeh daawa kiya hai ki dharm kewal usi cheez se poora hota hai, jo usne kahi hai aur jiski or usne bulaya hai. Jabki yeh Allah aur uske Rasool par sabse bara zulm aur unhen ajnaani thahraana hai. {tatha tumpar apni nemat poori kar di hai} pratyaksh tatha apratyaksh. {aur tumhaare liye Islam ko dharm svaroop chun liya hai} arthaat, mainne use tumhaare liye ek dharm ke roop mein chun liya aur pasand kiya, jaise ki mainne tumhen uske liye pasand kiya hai. Atah, apne rab ka shukr ada karte hue is (dharm) par qayam raho, aur us (Allah) ki prashansa karo jisne tumhen sabse uttam, sabse pratishthit aur sabse sanpoorn dharm pradaan kiya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65303: Abdullah bin umar radiyallahu anhuma se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Ghaib ki chaabiyaan paanch hain, {nihsandeh, Allah hi ke paas hai qayaamat ka jnaan, wahi utaarta hai warsha aur jaanta hai jo kuchh garbhaashyon mein hai aur nahin jaanta koi praani ki woh kya kamayega kal aur nahin jaanta koi praani ki kis dharti mein marega. Waastav mein, Allah hi sab kuchh jaanne waala, sabse soochit hai.}"

Ghaib Allah ke paas hai, use uske siwa koi nahin jaanta. Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki gaib ki chaabiyaan aur uske khajaane paanch hain : Pahla : Qayaamat kab ayegi, iske baare mein Allah ke alaawa koi nahin jaanta hai. Yeh aakhirat ke jnaan ki or ek sanket hai, kyonki qayaamat ka din uski pahli kari hai. Aur jab nikattam cheez ke jnaan ka hi khandan ho gaya, to uske baad ki cheezon ka jnaan to svatah hi khandit ho jaata hai. Doosra : Baarish kab ayegi, yeh Allah ke siwa koi nahin jaanta. Ismen oopri duniya ke maamlon ki or sanket hai. Baarish ka ullekh wishesh roop se isliye kiya gaya hai, kyonki yadyapi iske kuchh kaaran hote hain, jo aamtaur par iske hone ka sanket dete hain, lekin yeh sanket nishchit aur yaqeeni nahin hota. Teesra : Jo kuchh garbhaashyon mein hota hai; jaise nar ya maada, kaala ya gora, poorn ya apoorn, abhaaga ya bhaagyashaali ityaadi. Garbhaashay ka wishesh roop se ullekh isliye kiya gaya hai, kyonki adhiktar log saamaany anubhav ke aadhaar par iske baare mein jaante hain. Iske baavjood, is baat ka khandan kiya gaya hai ki koi uski waastawikta ko jaan sakta hai, to any cheezon ka jnaan hona to aur bhi door ki baat hai. Chautha : Kal kya hoga, yeh Allah ke siwa koi nahin jaanta. Ismen zamaane ke wibhinn dauron aur unmen ghatne waali ghatnaaon ki or ishaara hai. Yahaan "Kal" Shabd ka prayog isliye kiya gaya hai, kyonki woh sabse qareebi zamaana hai. Jab itna qareeb hone ke baavjood, aur kuchh sanketon aur lakshanon ki sanbhaavna ke hote hue bhi, yeh nahin jaana ja sakta ki usmen waastav mein kya hoga, to jo usse adhik door hai, uske baare mein to aur bhi nahin jaana ja sakta. Paanchvaan : Koi praani nahin jaanta ki uski mrityu kis dharti par hogi. Yeh nimn lok ke maamlon ki or ek sanket hai. Yadyapi saamaanyatah adhiktar log apne hi desh mein marte hain, lekin yeh koi atal saty nahin hai. Balki agar woh apne desh mein mar bhi jaye, to use yeh nahin pata hota ki use uske kis hisse mein dafnaya jayega, bhale hi wahaan uske poorvajon ka qabristaan hi kyon na ho. Waastav mein, Allah hi sab kuchh jaanne waala, sabse soochit hai. Woh pratyaksh aur apratyaksh, chhipi aur gupt cheezon tatha saare bhedon se poori tarah avgat hai. Is prakaar is ayat ne ghaib (paroksh) ke sabhi prakaaron ko ekatr kar diya hai aur sabhi jhoothe daawon ko samaapt kar diya hai.

Gaib ke un paanch khazaanon ka warnan, jinhen Allah ke siwa koi nahin jaanta.
Sindhi kahte hain : Hadees ke shabd 'ghaib ki chaabiyaan paanch hain' mein in paanch cheezon ko 'ghaib ki chaabiyaan' isliye kaha gaya hai, kyonki jiske paas yeh paanch cheezen hain, uske paas sanpoorn ghaib hai. Atah, yeh maano aisi cheezen ho gaeen, jinse ghaib ke khazaane khole jaate hain.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Ibn-e-abu jamra kahte hain : Sunne waale ko baat samjhaane ke liye 'kunjiyon' shabd ka prayog kiya hai; kyonki har woh cheez, jiske aur aapke beech koi parda ho, woh aapse chhupi hui hoti hai. Aur saamaanyatah us tak pahunchne ka zariya darvaaza hota hai. Phir jab darvaaza band ho, to kunji ki aawashyakta parti hai. To jab us kunji ka hi pata na ho, jo ghaib tak pahunchne ka zariya hai, to phir us ghaib ko kaise jaana ja sakta hai.
Ibn-e-abu jamra ne kaha hai : Inhen paanch rakhne ke peechhe ka rahasy is baat ki or ishaara karna hai ki samast jagat (sansaar) isi mein simte hue hain.
Allah apni kisi hikmat ke tahat rasoolon par ghaib ki kuchh baaten prakat kar deta hai.
Munajjimon (jyotishiyon) aur kaahinon (bhawishyawaktaaon) ke ghaib ka jnaan jaanne ke jhoothe daawon ka khandan, tatha yeh ki jisne bhi un cheezon mein se kisi ke jnaan ka daawa kiya, jinka jnaan Allah ne apne liye khaas rakha hai, usne Allah, uske Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aur mahaan Qur'an ko jhuthlaya.
65312: {kya tum haajiyon ko paani pilaane aur sammaanit masjid ki sewa ko, uske (eemaan ke) baraabar samajhte ho, jo Allah aur antim din par eemaan laya.} [soora tauba : 19] ayat ke ant tak.

Nomaan bin basheer radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Main rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke minbar ke paas tha, to ek vyakti ne kaha : Mujhe koi parvaah nahin ki main Islam ke baad haajiyon ko paani pilaane ke siwa koi aur kaam na karoon. Aur doosre ne kaha : Mujhe koi parvaah nahin ki main Islam ke baad sammaanit masjid (kaaba) ki sewa karne ke siwa koi aur kaam na karoon. Jabki ek any vyakti ne kaha : Allah ki raah mein jihaad karna tum donon ki kahi hui baaton se uttam hai. To umar (radiyallahu anhu) ne unhen daanta aur kaha : Rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke minbar ke paas apni aawaazen oonchi na karo. Daraasal woh jume ka din tha. Lekin jab main jume ki namaz parh loonga, to (andar jaakar) aapse us baat ke baare mein poochhoonga jismen tum logon ne matbhed kiya hai. Chunaanche isi sandarbh mein sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne yeh ayat utaari : {kya tum haajiyon ko paani pilaane aur sammaanit masjid ki sewa ko, uske (eemaan ke) baraabar samajhte ho, jo Allah aur antim din par eemaan laya.} [soora tauba : 19] ayat ke ant tak.

Naumaan bin basheer radiyallahu anhuma ne warnan kiya hai ki woh Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke minbar ke paas baithe hue the ki ek aadmi ko kahte hue suna : Mujhe koi parvaah nahin ki main Islam laane ke baad haajiyon ko paani pilaane ke siwa koi aur amal na karoon. Ek doosre vyakti ne kaha : Mujhe iski koi parvaah nahin ki Islam laane ke baad main koi aur kaam na karoon, siway iske ki main masjid-e-haraam ko aabaad rakhoon. Ek teesre vyakti ne kaha : Allah ke raaste mein jihaad karna tum donon ki kahi hui baaton se uttam hai. Atah umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhu ne unhen Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke minbar ke paas aawaaz buland karne par daanta. Yeh juma ke din ki subah thi. Umar radiyallahu anhu ne kaha : Lekin jab main juma ki namaz parh loonga to andar jaakar Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se us baare mein poochh loonga jismen tum logon ka ikhtilaaf hai. Chunaanche isi sandarbh mein sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne farmaya :

{kya tum haajiyon ko paani pilaane aur sammaanit masjid (kaaba) ki sewa ko, uske (eemaan ke) baraabar samajhte ho, jo Allah aur antim din par eemaan laya tatha Allah ki raah mein jihaad kiya? Allah ke sameep donon baraabar nahin hain tatha Allah atyaachaariyon ko supath nahin dikhaata.} [soora tauba : 19]

Kaaryon ke ajr aur sawaab mein bhinnata paai jaati hai.
Karmon ki shreshthata mein bhinnata shareeyat ke bayaan ke anusaar paai jaati hai, logon ke vyaktigat wichaaron ke anusaar nahin.
Allah tatha aakhirat ke din par eemaan ki shart ke saath Allah ke maarg mein jihaad ki fazeelat.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki juma ke din aur doosre dinon mein masjidon mein aawaaz buland nahin karni chahiye, aur jab log namaz ke liye ekatr hon, to jnaan ya kisi aur kaaran se bhi aawaaz buland nahin karni chahiye, kyonki isse namaz parhne waalon aur zikr karne waalon ko pareshaani hoti hai.
65371: Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ek saa paani se janaabat ka snaan aur ek mudd paani se wazu kar liya karte the.
Safeena radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ek saa paani se janaabat ka snaan aur ek mudd paani se wazu kar liya karte the.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam janaabat ka snaan ek saa aur wazu ek mudd paani se kar liya karte the. Saa chaar mudd ka hota hai aur mudd ki maatra ek madhyam shareer waale insaan ki donon hatheliyon bhar ki hoti hai.

Yeh hadees wazu tatha snaan karte samay paani bachaane aur zaroorat se adhik paani kharch na karne ki shiksha deti hai, chaahe paani aasaani se uplabdh kyon na ho jaata ho.
Wazu aur snaan karte samay aawashyakta anusaar aur kam se kam paani ka prayog karna mustahab hai aur yahi Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka tareeqa hai.
Is hadees ka uddeshy wazu aur snaan ki sunnaton tatha aadaab ka khyaal rakhte hue, paani ke istemaal mein fuzoolkharchi aur kanjoosi kiye bina, samay aur paani ki uplabdhata evn anuplabdhata ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue, wazu evn snaan karne ke kaary sanpoorn roop se sanpann karaana hai.
Arbi shabd janaabat ka prayog har us vyakti ke liye hota hai, jisne weery skhalan ya sanbhog kiya ho. Janaabat ko janaabat isliye kaha jaata hai kyonki is awastha mein insaan paak ho jaane tak namaz aur ibaadton se door rahta hai.
Saa ek prasiddh maapak paatr hai. Yahaan muraad sa-e-nabvi hai, jiska wazan utkrisht prakaar ke gehoon ka 480 misqaal aur leetar mein teen leetar hai.
Mudd ek sharai maap ikaai hai. Isse muraad ek saamaany shareer waale insaan ki donon hatheliyon bhar cheez hai, jab unko poora phailaakar bhara jaye. Mudd ek chauthaai saa hai, ispar saare faqeeh ekmat hain. Iski maatra 750 mileeleetar hoti hai.
65378: Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko dekha hai ki aapne peshaab kiya, phir wazu kiya aur apne mozon par masah kiya

Ibraaheem nakhai ka hammaam bin haaris se warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Jareer (radiyallahu anhu) ne peshaab kiya, phir wazu kiya aur apne mozon par masah kiya, to unse poochha gaya : Aap aisa karte hain? Unhonne kaha : Haan, mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko dekha hai ki aapne peshaab kiya, phir wazu kiya aur apne mozon par masah kiya. Aamash ne kaha ki ibraaheem kahte the : Logon ko yeh hadees bahut pasand thi; kyonki jareer (radiyallahu anhu) soora maaida ke utarne ke baad Islam laye the.

Jareer bin abdullah radiyallahu anhu ne peshaab kiya, phir wazu kiya aur apne pairon ko dhone ke bajay apne mozon par masah kar liya. Atah unke aas-paas ke logon ne unse poochha : Aap aisa karte hain?! Unhonne uttar diya : Haan, mainne Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko dekha hai ki aapne peshaab kiya, phir wazu kiya aur apne mozon par masah kar liya. Jareer (radiyallahu anhu) aakhir daur mein soora maaida ke naazil hone ke baad Islam laye the, jismen wazu ki ayat hai, jisse is baat ka sanket milta hai ki mozon par masah karna us ayat se mansookh nahin hua hai.

Sahaaba aur taabeeen Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki sunnat ke anusran ke prati bare sajag the.
Navvi kahte hain : Wishvasneey widvaanon ki is baat par sarvasammati hai ki safar aur ghar, donon hi sthitiyon mein chamre ke mozon par masah karna jayaz hai, chaahe iski koi zaroorat ho ya na ho. Yahaan tak ki yeh us mahila ke liye bhi jayaz hai jo har samay ghar mein rahti ho aur us apaahij vyakti ke liye bhi jo chal-phir na sakta ho.
Jareer bin abdullah radiyallahu anhu ki fazeelat ki woh bare sahansheel the, apne chhaatron ki aapattiyon ko dhairy se sunte the, bhale hi we is maamle mein ghalti par hote.
Mozon par masah ka inkaar karne aur use nirast bataane waalon ka khandan; kyonki jareer radiyallahu anhu ki hadees wazu ki ayat ke baad ki hai.
Is baat ka bayaan ki jis vyakti ki kisi baat ka khandan kiya jaye, aur woh use sahi maanta ho, to uske liye uchit hai ki woh us vyakti par krodhit na ho jo apni dhaarna ke anusaar uska khandan karta aur usse charcha karta hai, apitu woh uttam reeti se uske saamne apni daleel spasht kar de.
Aawashyakta parne par itihaas se daleel lena.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65411: Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab fajr ki namaz parh lete, to apni namaz ki jagah par baithe rahte, yahaan tak ki sooraj achchhi tarah nikal aata

Jaabir bin samura radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki : Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam jab fajr ki namaz parh lete, to apni namaz ki jagah par baithe rahte, yahaan tak ki sooraj achchhi tarah nikal aata, aur (warnankarta ne) kaha : Aap apni us jagah se jahaan subah ki namaz parhte the, sooraj nikalne tak nahin uthte the. Jab sooraj nikal aata, to uth jaate. Sahaaba baat karte hue ajnaanta kaal ki baaton ko chher dete aur hanste to aap muskura dete.

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki sunnat yeh hai ki jab aap fajr ki namaz parh lete, to apni namaz ki jagah par sooraj ke buland hone tak baithe rahte the. Aap apni us namaz ki jagah se, jahaan aap fajr ki namaz parhte the, sooraj nikalne tak nahin uthte the. Phir jab sooraj nikal aata, to khare ho jaate. Sahaaba baat karte hue Islam se pahle ke apne kuchh maamlon ka zikr karne lagte, to aap khaamosh rahte. Jab we hanste to kabhi-kabhi aap bhi unke saath muskura dete.

Subah ke baad sooraj nikalne tak zikr karna, aur bina kisi uzr (uchit kaaran) ke apni jagah par baithe rahna musathab hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke uttam aachran aur komal svabhaav ka bayaan ki aap apne saathiyon ke saath baithte the, unki baaten aur qisse sunte the aur kabhi-kabhi muskuraate bhi dete the.
Masjid mein baat karna aur ajnaanta kaal ki baaton ka zikr karna jayaz hai.
Hansna aur muskuraana jayaz hai; kyonki mana to zyaada hansna hai.
65416: Allah ki bandiyon ko Allah ki masjidon se na roko, lekin we bina sugandh lagaye niklen.
Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Allah ki bandiyon ko Allah ki masjidon se na roko, lekin we bina sugandh lagaye niklen."

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aurat ke saraprast aur abhibhaawak ko aurton ko masjidon mein jaane se rokne se mana kiya hai aur aurton ko aadesh diya hai ki we khushbu lagaakar aur banaav-singaar karke baahar na niklen; taaki purushon ke liye fitne ka kaaran na banen.

Aurat ko masjid mein namaz parhne ki anumti hai, yadi fitne ka dar na ho aur woh bina shringaar aur khushbu ke nikle.
Isse yeh pramaanit hota hai ki aurat apne pati ke ghar se uski anumti ke bina baahar nahin nikal sakti, kyonki anumti dene ka aadesh patiyon ko diya gaya hai.
Islam aurton ka dhyaan rakhta hai aur unhen aise kaamon se nahin rokna chaahta jinmen unke liye bhalaai ho, jaise jnaan praapt karne ke liye baahar nikalna aadi.
Purush ka stri par sanrakshak hone tatha uski dekh-bhaal karne ka saboot.
[ise abu daawood ne riwayat kiya hai]
65418: Jab tummen se koi masjid mein prawesh kare, to Nabi par salaam bheje aur yeh dua parhe : اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jab tummen se koi masjid mein prawesh kare, to Nabi par salaam bheje aur yeh dua parhe : اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ (ai Allah! Mere liye apni rahmat ke dvaar khol de), aur jab nikle, to Nabi par salaam bheje aur yeh dua parhe : اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنْ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ (ai Allah! Dhikkaarit shaitaan se meri raksha kar)", aur haakim ki riwayat mein hai : "Aur jab nikle, to Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par salaam bheje aur yeh dua parhe : اللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ (ai Allah! Mujhe dhikkaarit shaitaan se sharan de)."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ek musalmaan ko yeh maargadarshan diya hai ki jab woh masjid mein prawesh karna chaahe, to Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par yeh kahkar salaam bheje : "اللهم صل وسلم على محمد" (Ai Allah, Muhammad par daya aur shaanti bhej), phir yeh kahe : "(اللهم افتح لي أبواب رحمتك)" (Ai Allah! Mere liye apni rahmat ke dvaar khol de). Aur jab nikle, to Nabi par salaam bheje aur kahe : (اللهم اعصمني من الشيطان الرجيم) (ai Allah! Mujhe dhikkaare hue shaitaan se bacha). Aur haakim ki ek riwayat mein hai ki woh kahe : (اللهم أجرني من الشيطان الرجيم) (ai Allah! Mujhe dhikkaare hue shaitaan se panaah de).

Masjid mein prawesh karte aur masjid se nikalte samay in duaaon ko parhna mustahab hai.
Yeh zikr sabhi masjidon mein prawesh karne ke liye hai, yahaan tak ki masjid-e-haraam ke liye bhi.
Prawesh karte samay rahmat aur nikalte samay shaitaan se suraksha ka wishesh roop se ullekh isliye kiya gaya hai, kyonki prawesh karne waala aise kaary mein vyast hone ja raha hai, jo use Allah aur uski Jannat se qareeb karne waala hai, isliye rahmat ka ullekh hi anukool hai, jabki nikalne waala duniya mein un cheezon ki or ja raha hai, jo dhyaan bhatkaane waali aur vyast rakhne waali hain, isliye shaitaan se Allah ki suraksha aur hifaazat maangna hi anukool hai.
[ise ibne maajah aur haakim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65426: Jo hamaari namaz ki tarah namaz parhe aur hamaare qible ki taraph munh kare aur hamaara qurbaan kiya hua jaanvar khaye to woh aisa musalmaan hai, jise Allah aur uske Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki panaah haasil hai . Lihaaza Allah ki panaah mein khayaanat (dhokha) na karo.

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jo hamaari namaz ki tarah namaz parhe aur hamaare qible ki taraph munh kare aur hamaara qurbaan kiya hua jaanvar khaye to woh aisa musalmaan hai, jise Allah aur uske Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki panaah haasil hai . Lihaaza Allah ki panaah mein khayaanat (dhokha) na karo."

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jo vyakti deen ke zaahiri ahkaam (pratyaksh widhi-widhaanon) ka paalan karte hue hamaari tarah namaz parhe, hamaare qible (kaaba) ki or munh kare aur hamaare zabeeha ko halaal samajhkar khaye, to woh aisa musalmaan hai jise Allah aur uske Rasool ki amaanat aur unka wachan haasil hai. Lihaaza uske baare mein Allah ki amaanat aur wachan ko na toro.

Ibn-e-rajab ne kaha hai : Yeh hadees is baat ka pramaan hai ki kewal shahaadtain (do gawaahiyon) ka iqraar kar lene se rakt surakshit nahin ho jaata, jab tak ki unke huqooq ada na kiye jayen. Aur unke huqooq mein sabse mahatvapoorn haq namaz hai; iseeliye uska wishesh roop se ullekh kiya gaya hai. Tatha ek doosri hadees mein namaz ke saath zakat ko bhi jora gaya hai.
Logon ke maamle unke zaahir ke anusaar tay kiye jayenge, baatin ke anusaar nahin. Atah, jo vyakti jis deen ke shiaar (prateek) ko zaahir kare, uspar usi dharm ke maanne waalon ke ahkaam jaari kiye jayenge, jab tak ki usse iske wipreet kuchh zaahir na ho.
Ibn-e-rajab kahte hain : Qible ki or munh karne ka ullekh is baat ki or ishaara hai ki musalmaanon ki us namaz ko ada karna aniwaary hai, jo unke Nabi par utaari gai jo unki kitaab mein bataai gai hai aur woh kaaba ki or munh karke parhi jaane waali namaz hai. Anyatha, jo koi uske nirast ho jaane ke baad yahoodiyon ki tarah baitul maqdis ki or munh karke namaz parhe, ya eesaaiyon ki tarah poorab ki or, to woh musalmaan nahin hai, bhale hi woh tauheed (ekeshvarvaad) ki gawaahi kyon na de.
Yeh namaz mein qibla ki or munh karne ke bare mahatv ko darshaata hai, kyonki ismen namaz ki any sharton, jaise tahaarat (pawitrata) waghairah, ka ullekh nahin kiya gaya hai.
Ibn -e- rajab kahte hain : Musalmaanon ka zabah kiya hua jaanvar khaane ke zikr mein is baat ki or ishaara hai ki Islam ke sabhi zaahiri ahkaam ka paalan karna zaroori hai, aur unmen sabse mahaan hai musalmaanon ka zabah kiya hua jaanvar khaana aur zabah ke maamle mein unka saath dena. Lihaaza, jo isse parhez kare, woh musalmaan nahin hai.
65463: Main Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko daaeen aur baaeen or salaam pherte hue dekhta tha, yahaan tak ki main aapke gaal ka ujlaapan dekh leta.

Saad radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Main Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko daaeen aur baaeen or salaam pherte hue dekhta tha, yahaan tak ki main aapke gaal ka ujlaapan dekh leta.

Saad bin abu waqqaas radiyallahu anhu ne bataya hai ki jab Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apni namaz mein salaam pherte, to pahle salaam ke liye daaeen jaanib aur doosre ke liye baaeen jaanib itna adhik murte ki woh aapke gaal ki saphedi dekh lete the.

Daaeen tatha baaeen or bahut zyaada murne ka shareeyat sammat hona.
Daaeen aur baaeen or do salaam pherna shareeyat-sammat hai.
Navvi kahte hain : Yadi koi donon salaam apni daaeen or ya apni baaeen or ya apne chehre ke saamne pher de, ya pahla salaam baaeen or aur doosra daaeen or phere, to uski namaz sahi ho jayegi aur donon salaam bhi ada ho jayenge, lekin un donon salaam ke tareeqe ki fazeelat haasil nahin hogi.
65479: Har do azaanon ke beech mein namaz hai. Har do azaanon ke beech mein namaz hai." Phir teesri baar farmaya : "Uske liye, jo parhna chaahe.

Abdullah bin mughaphfal radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Har do azaanon ke beech mein namaz hai. Har do azaanon ke beech mein namaz hai." Phir teesri baar farmaya : "Uske liye, jo parhna chaahe."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bayaan farmaya ki har azaan wa iqaamat ke beech mein nafal namaz hai. Is waaky ko aapne teen baar dohraya aur teesri baar farmaya ki yeh namaz uske liye musathab hai, jo parhna chaahe.

Azaan aur iqaamat ke beech mein namaz parhna musathab hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam baat ko dohra diya karte the, taaki sunne waale ichchhi tarah sun len aur kahi gai baat ke mahatv par zor diya ja sake.
"Azaanain" (Do azaanon) se muraad : Azaan aur iqaamat hai. Aur in donon ke liye azaan ka naam 'taghleeb' (pradhaanta dene ke niyam) ke taur par laagu kiya gaya hai, jaise 'qamrain' (do chaand) se muraad sooraj aur chaand hote hain, aur 'umrain' (do umar) se muraad abu bakr aur umar hote hain.
Azaan samay ke prawesh karne ka elaan hai aur iqaamat namaz ki upasthit ki soochna hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65546: Mar rahe logon ko "La ilaaha illallah" Parhne ke liye prerit karo.
Abu saeed khudri radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Mar rahe logon ko "La ilaaha illallah" Parhne ke liye prerit karo."

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam taakeed karte hain ki ham marnaasann vyakti ke paas tauheed ke kalima "La ilaaha illallah" Ko kahen aur dohrayen, taaki woh use kah le aur wahi uski zabaan se nikalne waale antim shabd hon.

Mrityu ke nikat pahunch chuke vyakti ko kalima parhne ki prerna dena mustahab hai.
Marnaasann vyakti ko bahut zyaada talqeen karna, aur jab use parh le ya usse yeh samajh liya jaye, to us par zid karna makrooh hai; taaki woh tang aakar koi anuchit baat na kah baithe.
Navvi kahte hain : Aur jab woh use ek baar kah le, to use baar-baar na dohraya jaye, lekin agar woh uske baad koi doosri baat kare, to use phir se yaad dilaya jaye, taaki yahi uski antim baat ho.
Is hadees mein marnaasann vyakti ke paas upasthit rahne, use yaad dihaani karaane, use saantvana dene, uski aankhen band karne aur uske huqooq ada karne ka warnan hai.
Maut ke baad aur dafan ke pashchaat qabr par talqeen karna shareeyat sammat kaary nahin hai, kyonki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aisa nahin kiya hai.
65553: Apne kapron mein se safed kapre pahna karo. Ye tumhaare sabse achchhe kapron mein se hain. Tatha inheen mein apne murdon ko dafan kiya karo.

Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Apne kapron mein se safed kapre pahna karo. Ye tumhaare sabse achchhe kapron mein se hain. Tatha inheen mein apne murdon ko dafan kiya karo."
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam purushon ko safed kapre pahanne tatha apne murdon ko safed kapre mein kafnaane ka nirdesh de rahe hain. Kyonki safed kapre utkrisht kapron mein se hain.

Safed kapra pahanna musathab hai. Haalaanki doosre rang ke kapre pahanna bhi jayaz hai.
Murdon ko safed kapre mein kafnaana musathab hai.
Shaukaani kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki safed kapra pahanna tatha murdon ko safed kapre mein kafnaana shareeyat sammat kaary hai, kyonki woh adhik paakeeza tatha adhik utkrisht hai. Jahaan tak adhik utkrisht hone ki baat hai to yeh spasht hai, lekin jahaan tak adhik paakeeza hone ki baat hai, to iska kaaran yeh hai ki safed kapre mein zara-sa bhi mail hone par dikhaai parne lagta hai, isi kaaran ise praathmikta di jaati hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi aur ibn-e-maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
65566: ''Jab koi vyakti mar jaata hai, to uske karmon ka silsila ruk jaata hai, siway teen cheezon ke : Sadqa jaariya (anavrat chalne waala daan), aisi widya chhorkar jaana jisse log laabhaanwit hon athva aisi nek (sadaachaari) santaan, jo uske liye (marne ke baad) dua kare.''

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai: ''Jab koi vyakti mar jaata hai, to uske karmon ka silsila ruk jaata hai, siway teen cheezon ke : Sadqa jaariya (anavrat chalne waala daan), aisi widya chhorkar jaana jisse log laabhaanwit hon athva aisi nek (sadaachaari) santaan, jo uske liye (marne ke baad) dua kare.''

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne yahaan bataya hai ki insaan ki mrityu ke saath uske amal ka silsila ruk jaata hai. Use maut ke baad sawaab kewal teen cheezon ka milta hai, kyonki wahi inka kaaran hota hai. Yeh teen cheezen is prakaar hain :

1- aisa sadqa jiska sawaab nirantar jaari rahta hai. Kabhi band nahin hota. Jaise waqf, masjid ka nirmaan evn kuaan khudvaana aadi.

2- insaan ka chhora hua aisa jnaan jisse baad mein bhi log laabhaanvit hote rahen. Jaise widvataapoorn kitaaben likhna ya kisi vyakti ko jnaan sikha dena, jo use any logon ko sikhaane ka kaam kare.

3- momin aur sadaachaari santaan, jo apne maata-pita ke liye dua karti rahe.

Muslim widvaanon ka ijma hai ki insaan ko maut ke baad jin cheezon ka sawaab milta rahta hai, unmen sadqa-e-jaariya, laabhdayak jnaan evn dua shaamil hain. Kuchh hadeeson mein Hajj ka bhi zikr hua hai.
In teen cheezon ka zikr khaas taur se isliye kiya gaya hai ki yeh cheezen achchhi cheezon ki buniyaad ki haisiyat rakhti hain aur aam taur par nek log chaahte hain ki yeh cheezen unke baad baaqi rahen.
Waise to har laabhdayak jnaan ka pratiphal milta hai, lekin is maamle mein shareeyat ka jnaan aur uski praapti mein sahayak jnaan sabse oopar hain.
In teen cheezon mein bhi sabse laabhkaari cheez shareeyat ka jnaan hai. Kyonki use seekhne waala to usse laabhaanvit hota hi hai, lekin iske saath-saath shareeyat ki raksha ho jaati hai aur saari srishti fayda uthaati hai. Jnaan ki ek bari wisheshta yeh hai ki usse aapke daur ke logon ke saath-saath aapke baad ke log bhi laabhaanvit ho sakte hain.
Bachchon ki achchhi tarbiyat ki prerna. Kyonki nek santaan apne maata-pita ko aakhirat mein fayda puhanchaati hai. Is fayda pahunchaane ka ek roop yeh hai ki nek santaan apne maata-pita ke liye dua karti hai.
Maata-pita ki mrityu ke pashchaat bhi unke saath achchhe bartaav ki prerna. Jo ki dhaarmikta ka ek roop hai, jisse bachche ko laabh hota hai.
Waise to santaan ke siwa koi aur kare, tab bhi mare hue vyakti ko laabh milta hai, lekin aapne wishesh roop se santaan ka zikr isliye kiya hai ki kisi bhi vyakti ke liye uski santaan hi antim saans tak dua karti rahti hai.
65613: He Allah ke Rasool! Saad ki maata mrityu ko praapt ho chuki hai. Aise mein kaun-sa sadqa sarvashreshth hai? Farmaya : "Paani." Kahte hain ki unhonne ek kuaan khudva diya aur kah diya ki yeh kuaan saad ki maata ke liye hai.

Saad bin ubaada radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki unhonne kaha : He Allah ke Rasool! Saad ki maata mrityu ko praapt ho chuki hai. Aise mein kaun-sa sadqa sarvashreshth hai? Farmaya : "Paani." Kahte hain ki unhonne ek kuaan khudva diya aur kah diya ki yeh kuaan saad ki maata ke liye hai.

Saad bin ubaada radiyallahu anhu ki maata ki mrityu ho gai, to unhonne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochha ki unki maata ki or se kaun-sa sadqa sabse achchha rahega? Tab Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne uttar diya ki sabse uttam sadqa paani ka prabandh karna hai. Atah unhonne ek kuaan khudva diya aur use apni maata ke liye sadqa kar diya.

Paani ki vyawastha karna sabse uttam sadqon mein se hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne saad radiyallahu anhu ko paani sadqa karne ka nirdesh diya. Kyonki ek to paani saansaarik tatha dhaarmik donon maamlon mein laabhkaari hai aur doosra yeh (arab mein) garmi bari sakht parti hai, paani ki bari zaroorat rahti hai aur paani bahut kam paya jaata hai.
Sadqon ka sawaab mare hue logon ko pahunchta hai.
Saad bin ubaada radiyallahu anhu ka apni maata radiyallahu anha ke saath achchha vyavhaar.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, nasai aur ibn-e-maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
65620: Yadi tum donon chaaho, to main tumhen de deta hoon, lekin ismen kisi dhani aur kisi kamaane waale shaktishaali vyakti ka koi hissa nahin hai.

Ubaidullah bin adi bin al-khiyaar ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Do aadmiyon ne mujhe bataya ki we donon hajjatul wada ke avsar par us samay Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aye, jab aap sadqa baant rahe the. Chunaanche un donon ne usmen se maanga. Ispar aapne hamen oopar se neeche tak dekha, to hamen hatta-katta paya. Phir farmaya : "Yadi tum donon chaaho, to main tumhen de deta hoon, lekin ismen kisi dhani aur kisi kamaane waale shaktishaali vyakti ka koi hissa nahin hai."

Hajjatul wada ke avsar par do vyakti Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas us samay aye, jab aap sadqa baant rahe the. Un donon ne bhi usmen se kuchh maanga, to aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam unki haalat jaanne ke liye unhen baar-baar dekhne lage ki kya un donon ke liye sadqa jayaz hai ya nahin. To aap llallahu alaihi wa sallam ne un donon ko shaktishaali paya, atah kaha : Yadi tum donon chaaho, to main tumhen sadqe mein se de doonga, lekin ismen us vyakti ka koi hissa nahin hai, jiske paas apni zaroorat bhar ka maal ho, aur na hi us vyakti ka koi hissa hai, jo mehnat-mashaqqat karke maal kamaane par saksham ho, bhale hi uske paas aisa maal na ho, jisse use maaldaar samjha jaye.

Dhani vyakti athva kamaane ki shakti rakhne waale vyakti ka maangna haraam hai.
Jis vyakti ke paas maal hone ka jnaan na ho, woh mool roop se nirdhan aur daan ka haqdaar hai.
Kewal shakti ka hona kisi ko sadqa ke ayogy nahin banaata, balki uske saath kamaane ki kshamta ka hona bhi aawashyak hai.
Jo vyakti apni zaroorat bhar kamaane mein saksham ho, uske liye aniwaary sadqa lena jayaz nahin hai; kyonki woh apni kamaai ke kaaran aatmanirbhar hai, theek usi tarah, jaise ek dhanvaan vyakti apne dhan ke kaaran aatmanirbhar hota hai.
Muslim vyaktitv ko aatm-sammaan aur lene, maangne tatha aalasy ke bajay dene ki mahaan nabvi shiksha.
[ise abu daawood tatha nasai ne riwayat kiya hai]
65738: Agli saf ko poora karo, phir uske baad waali ko, aur yadi (namaaziyon ki sankhya kam hone ke kaaran) saf mein koi kami rah jaye, to woh sabse pichhli saf mein honi chahiye.

Anas radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Agli saf ko poora karo, phir uske baad waali ko, aur yadi (namaaziyon ki sankhya kam hone ke kaaran) saf mein koi kami rah jaye, to woh sabse pichhli saf mein honi chahiye."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne jamaat ke saath namaz parhne waale purushon ko aadesh diya ki sarvapratham pahli saf ko poora karen, phir uske baad waali saf ko, aur isi tarah aage bhi. Agar kisi saf mein koi kami rah jaye, to yeh kami antim saf mein rahe.

Safon ko seedha karne ki sunnat ka bayaan.
Namaaziyon ko aage ki safon mein kami nahin chhorni chahiye, balki kami aakhiri saf mein honi chahiye.
[ise abu daawood tatha nasai ne riwayat kiya hai]
65739: Jab namaz khari ho jaye, to farz namaz ke siwa koi namaz hi nahin.
Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jab namaz khari ho jaye, to farz namaz ke siwa koi namaz hi nahin."
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne masjid mein farz namaz ki iqaamat ho jaane ke baad nafal namaz shuru karne se mana kiya hai.

Farz namaz ke liye iqaamat ho jaane par masjid mein nafal namaz parhne ki manaahi.
Namaz ki iqaamat ke baad nafal namaz shuru karne se mana kiya gaya hai, chaahe woh sunnat-e-raatiba ho, jaise fajr aur zuhr ki sunnat, ya koi aur sunnat.
Jab namaz khari ho jaye aur aadmi nafal namaz mein ho; to agar uski ek rakaat se kam namaz bachi ho, to use halki karke poori kar le, warna tor de, taaki takbeer-e-tahreema ki fazeelat pa sake.
65772: ''Jab kisi musalmaan ko koi dukh pahunchta hai, aur woh yeh duayen parhta hai, jinka Allah ne aadesh diya hai :  (Ham sab Allah ke hain aur hamen usi ki or lautkar jaana hai.) [soora al-baqra : 156], (he Allah! Mujhe mere duhkh ka pratiphal de aur uska behtar badal de.), to Allah use pichhle ki jagah par pichhle se achchha badal pradaan karta hai.''

Musalmaanon ki maata umm-e-salma -radiyallahu anha- se warnit hai, woh kahti hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko farmaate hue sana hai : ''Jab kisi musalmaan ko koi dukh pahunchta hai, aur woh yeh duayen parhta hai, jinka Allah ne aadesh diya hai :  (Ham sab Allah ke hain aur hamen usi ki or lautkar jaana hai.) [soora al-baqra : 156], (he Allah! Mujhe mere duhkh ka pratiphal de aur uska behtar badal de.), to Allah use pichhle ki jagah par pichhle se achchha badal pradaan karta hai.'' woh kahti hain : Jab abu salma ki maut ho gai, to mainne socha ki kaun-sa musalmaan abu salma se achchha ho sakta hai? Unka pariwaar pahla pariwaar tha, jisne Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki or hijrat kiya! Phir mainne yeh duayen parheen, to Allah ne unke badle mujhe apne Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko pradaan kiya.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- kahti hain ki unhonne ek din Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : Jab kisi musalmaan par koi museebat aati hai aur woh kahta hai yeh waaky jo Allah ne uske liye pasand kiya hai : {ham Allah hi ke hain aur hamen usi ki or lautkar jaana hai.} [soora baqra : 156], ai Allah! Mujhe is museebat par sabr karne ka pratiphal pradaan kar aur iska mujhe behtar badla de, to Allah use behtar badla pradaan karta hai. Unka kahna hai ki jab unke pati abu salma ki mrityu ho gai, to mainne apne dil mein kaha ki abu salma se behtar bhala kaun-sa musalmaan ho sakta hai? Unka ghar Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki or hijrat karne waala pahla ghar tha. Tab Allah ne meri madad ki aur main ne yeh waaky kah diya, to Allah ne abu salma ke sthaan par mujhe Allah ke Rasool ko de diya, jo nishchit roop se unse behtar the.

Is hadees mein museebat ke samay dhairy na khone aur sabr se kaam lene ka aadesh diya gaya hai.
Museebat ke samay Allah se dua karni chahiye, kyonki uske paas har cheez ka badal maujood hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke aadesh ka paalan karna zaroori hai, yadyapi uski hikmat samajh mein na bhi aye.
Saari bhalaai Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke aadesh ke anupaalan mein hai.
65783: Ise chhor do, kyonki yeh ek badboodaar cheez hai.

Jaabir bin abdullah radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ham ek ghazva mein the ki muhaajireen mein se ek vyakti ne ek ansaari vyakti ko peechhe se maar diya. Ispar ansaari ne pukaara : Ai ansaariyo! Aur muhaajir ne pukaara : Ai muhaajireen! Allah ne yeh baat apne Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko sunva di, to aapne poochha : "Yeh kya hai?" Logon ne bataya muhaajireen mein se ek vyakti ne ek ansaari ko peechhe se maar diya, to ansaari ne pukaara : Ai ansaariyo! Aur muhaajir ne pukaara : Ai muhaajireen! Yeh sunkar Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Ise chhor do, kyonki yeh ek badboodaar cheez hai." Jaabir (radiyallahu anhu) kahte hain ki jab Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam (madeena) aye the, to ansaar ki sankhya adhik thi, phir baad mein muhaajireen ki sankhya barh gai. Yeh sunkar abdullah bin ubaii ne kaha : Kya unhonne aisa kar hi diya? Allah ki qasam! Agar ham madeena waapas laute, to izzat waala wahaan se zaleel ko zaroor nikaal dega. Yeh sunkar umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhu ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe ijaazat den ki main is munaafiq ki gardan ura doon. Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Ise chhor do, taaki log yeh na kahen ki Muhammad apne saathiyon ko qatl karte hain."

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ek yuddh ke liye apne sahaaba, muhaajireen aur ansaar (radiyallahu anhum) ke saath yaatra par the. Isi beech, ek muhaajir ne ek ansaari ke putthe par haath se maar diya. Chunaanche ansaari ne pukaara : Ai ansaariyo, meri madad karo! Aur muhaajir ne pukaara : Ai muhaajiro, meri madad karo! Jab Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne yeh suna, to farmaya : Yeh kya hai? To logon ne bataya ki ek muhaajir ne ek ansaari ke putthe par haath se maara, to ansaari ne ansaariyon ko aawaaz di, aur muhaajir ne muhaajiron ko pukaara. To Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne pharmaya : Is ajnaanta kaal ki aadat ko chhor do, kyonki yeh ghinauni, naapsandeeda aur takleefdeh hai; yaani jab kisi aadmi par uska wirodhi haawi ho jaata hai, to woh apni qaum ko pukaarta hai aur we apni jahaalat aur pakshapaat ke kaaran uski madad ke liye daur parte hain, chaahe woh zaalim ho ya mazloom. Jaabir radiyallahu anhu ne pharmaya ki jab Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam hijrat karke madeena tashreeph laye the, to ansaar adhik the, phir baad mein muhaajiron ki sankhya barh gai. To munaafiqon ke sardaar abdullah bin ubaii bin salool ne kaha : Kya maamla is had tak pahunch gaya hai?! Allah ki qasam, agar ham madeena lautkar gae to sammaanit log -yaani woh svayn aur uske saathi- madeena se apmaanit logon ko -arthaat Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aur unke saathiyon ko- nikaal baahar karenge. To umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhu ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool, mujhe is munaafiq ki gardan maarne deejiye. Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Use chhor do, taaki log yeh na kahen ki Muhammad apne saathiyon ko qatl karte hain, bhale hi woh kewal zaahir mein unka saathi ho.

Islam ne Islam-poorv yug ki nindneey prathaaon aur paranpraaon se, chaahe we kathan ke roop mein hon ya karm ke roop mein, roka hai, kyonki woh logon ko in sab se door karne aur unhen us cheez ki or maargadarshan dene ke liye aya hai, jo unke liye sahi aur saty hai.
Anuchit gutbandi se usi prakaar saavdhaan rahne ki chetaavni di gai hai, jis prakaar ek durgandhyukt evn ghinauni wastu se saavdhaan raha jaata hai.
Shatruta aur dvesh paida karne waali har cheez ki manaahi.
Navvi kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka ise ajnaanta kaal ki pukaar kahna yeh darshaata hai ki aap ise naapsand karte the, kyonki yeh ajnaanta kaal ki un prathaaon mein se tha, jiske tahat we saansaarik maamlon aur usse sanbandhit cheezon mein qabeelon ke aadhaar par ek-doosre ka samarthan karte the. Ajnaanta kaal ke log qabeelaai pakshapaat aur qabeelon ke bal par apne adhikaar praapt karte the. Phir Islam ne aakar ise samaapt kar diya aur maamlon ka faisla sharai praavdhaanon ke anusaar kiya. Atah, jab koi vyakti doosre par zyaadti karta hai, to qaazi unke beech faisla karta hai aur use uski zyaadti ka zimmedaar thahraata hai, jaisa ki Islam ke siddhaanton mein sthaapit hai.
Sindhi kahte hain : Isse yeh spasht hua ki kewal apne qabeele ka hone ke kaaran kisi ka samarthan karna, jaisa ki ajnaanta kaal ke zamaane ke logon ka tareeqa tha, baatil hai. Atah, har vyakti ke liye apne qabeele ko pukaarne ka koi auchity nahin hai. Rahi baat haq ke samarthan ki, to woh har momin par aniwaary hai, chaahe woh uske qabeele ka ho ya na ho.
Munaafiqon ki bad-zubaani (abhadr bhaasha ka prayog) aur Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aur unke sahaaba radiyallahu anhum ke prati unke dussaahas ka warnan.
Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bare sahansheel the tatha munaafikon ki or se pahunchne waale kashton par dhairy se kaam lete the.
Yahaan har us kaam se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai, jo logon ko Islam mein prawesh karne se wimukh karta ho. Iseeliye Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne munaafiqon ki hatya karne se parhez kiya, taaki log yeh na kahne lagen ki Muhammad apne saathiyon ki hatya karte hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65789: Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kisra, qaisar, najaashi aur har bare shaasak ko uchch evn mahaan Allah ki or bulaate hue patr likha

Anas radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne kisra, qaisar, najaashi aur har bare shaasak ko uchch evn mahaan Allah ki or bulaate hue patr likha, aur yeh woh najaashi nahin the, jinki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne janaaze ki namaz parhi thi.

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu bata rahe hain ki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apni mrityu se pahle apne aas-paas ki qaumon ke baadshaahon ko Islam ki daawat dete hue khat likhe; to aapne kisra ko likha, tatha kisra faaras ke har baadshaah ka laqab (padvi) hai, aur qaisar ko likha, jo room ke har baadshaah ka laqab hai, aur najaashi ko likha, jo habsha ke baadshaahon ka laqab hai. Aur aapne logon par atyaachaar karne waale har zaalim baadshaah ko bhi khat likha, tatha anas radiyallahu anhu ne yeh spasht kiya ki jis najaashi ko khat likha gaya, yeh woh najaashi nahin the, jo musalmaan hue the tatha jab unhonne mrityu paai to Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne un par ghaybaana namaz-e-janaaza (anupasthiti mein janaaje ki namaz) parhi.

Gair-muslimon ko Islam ki or bulaane ki waidhta, jismen unke raaja aur shaasak bhi shaamil hain.
Kitaabon aur patron par amal karne ki waidhta.
65812: Ai Allah! Main to bas ek manushy hoon. Atah, jis kisi musalmaan ko mainne bura-bhala kaha ho, uspar laanat bheji ho ya use kore maare hon, to tu ise uske liye shuddhi aur daya bana de.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Ai Allah! Main to bas ek manushy hoon. Atah, jis kisi musalmaan ko mainne bura-bhala kaha ho, uspar laanat bheji ho ya use kore maare hon, to tu ise uske liye shuddhi aur daya bana de."

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne dua karte hue farmaya: "Ai Allah, main bhi ek insaan hoon, main bhi usi tarah krodhit hota hoon, jaise aam insaan hote hain. To jis kisi momin ko mainne takleef di ho, ya use bura-bhala kaha ho, ya us par laanat bheji ho aur use teri rahmat se door hone ki bad-dua (abhishaap) di ho, ya use kore maare hon ya peeta ho, to tu use uske liye shuddhi, (apni) nikatta, pawitrata, (paapon ka) prayashchit aur rahmat bana de, jiske dvaara tu us par raham kare.

Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka mahaan charitr.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Is hadees mein aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki apni ummat par karuna ki poornata, aapke sundar aachran aur aapki mahaanta ka warnan hai, jismen aapne svayn se hui bhool ka badla kshatipoorti aur sammaan ke saath dene ka iraada kiya.
Navvi kahte hain : Agar yeh sawaal kiya jaye ki aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam kisi aise vyakti ko kaise bad-dua (shaap) de sakte hain, use bura-bhala kah sakte hain ya uspar laanat bhej sakte hain, jo uska haqdaar na ho? To iska uttar wahi hai jo widvaanon ne diya hai. Sankshep mein, iske do uttar hain : Pahla : Iska matlab yeh hai ki woh vyakti Allah ke nikat aur waastav mein uska haqdaar nahin hota, lekin zaahiri taur par woh uska haqdaar hota hai. To aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke liye kisi sharai nishaani ke aadhaar par uska haqdaar hona zaahir hota hai, jabki waastav mein woh uska haqdaar nahin hota. Aur aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko zaahiri haalat ke anusaar faisla karne ka aadesh diya gaya hai, aur dilon ke bhedon ko to Allah hi jaanta hai. Doosra yeh hai ki aapka kisi ko bura-bhala kahna ya bad-dua dena aadi jaan-boojhkar nahin hota tha, balki yeh arbon ki aadat ke anusaar hota tha, jo bina kisi iraade ke apni baat ko jaari rakhne ke liye aise shabd istemaal karte the. Jaise unka kahna : Taribat yameenuk (tere haath mitti mein milen), aur 'aqra halqa' (baanjh aur kate gale waali). Aur is hadees mein hai : (Teri umr na barhe), aur muaawiya (radiyallahu anhu) ki hadees mein hai : 'Allah tera pet kabhi na bhare', aur is tarah ke any waaky. In sab baaton se unka asal maqsad bad-dua dena nahin hota tha. To aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko dar hua ki kaheen inmen se koi baat Allah ke yahaan qabool na ho jaye, isliye aapne apne paalanhaar, jo pawitr evn mahaan hai, se dua ki aur usse aagrah kiya ki woh in baaton ko us vyakti ke liye daya, gunaahon ka kaffaara, (Allah se) nikatta ka saadhan, pawitrata aur puny bana de. Aur aisa aapse kabhi-kabhaar hi hota tha. Aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam na to ashleel baat karne waale the aur na hi ashleel baat kahne ka prayaas karne waale the, na hi laanat bhejne waale the aur na hi apne liye badla lene waale the.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65815: Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke ghar waalon ne ek din mein kabhi do baar pet bharkar bhojan nahin kiya, parantu unmen se ek baar ka bhojan aniwaary roop se khajoor hota tha.

Mominon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke ghar waalon ne ek din mein kabhi do baar pet bharkar bhojan nahin kiya, parantu unmen se ek baar ka bhojan aniwaary roop se khajoor hota tha.

Ummul momineen aaisha radiyallahu anha bataati hain ki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke ghar waalon ne ek hi din mein kabhi bhi do samay ka aisa bhojan nahin kiya jismen se ek samay ka bhojan khajoor na raha ho.

Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aur aapke ghar waalon ka saada rahan-sahan ki unhen din mein kabhi-kabhi sirf ek waqt ka khaana hi mil paata tha.
Khajoor unke liye any cheezon se adhik sulabh tha.
Zuhd aur thore par santosh karne ki fazeelat. Yeh nabiyon ka akhlaaq aur rasoolon ke sardaar ki seerat hai.
