Ek din mein do baar bhojan karna ek jayaz aur anumat kaary hai. Yeh arbon ki ek prasiddh aadat thi. We din mein do bhojan karte the : Dophar ka bhojan aur raat ka bhojan.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65816: Jab se rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam madeena tashreeph laye, aapke ghar waalon ne teen din tak lagaataar kabhi gehoon ki roti pet bharkar nahin khaai. Yahaan tak ki aap duniya se chale gae.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Jab se rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam madeena tashreeph laye, aapke ghar waalon ne teen din tak lagaataar kabhi gehoon ki roti pet bharkar nahin khaai. Yahaan tak ki aap duniya se chale gae.

Ummul momineen aaisha radiyallahu anha bataati hain ki jab se Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke ghar waale madeena aye, unhonne lagaataar teen din tak gehoon ki roti pet bharkar nahin khaai, yahaan tak ki aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam mrityu ko praapt ho gae.

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aur aapke ghar waalon ki tangdasti ka bayaan. Kyonki asal jeewan to aakhirat ka jeewan hai.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Zaahir baat yeh hai ki zyaadaatar unke pet na bharne ka kaaran unke paas cheezon ki kami thi. Haalaanki, kabhi-kabhi unhen kuchh mil bhi jaata tha, lekin we apne oopar doosron ko tarjeeh dete the.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65820: Rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka bistar chamre ka tha aur uski bharaai khajoor ki chhaal ki thi

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha radiyallahu anha ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka bistar chamre ka tha aur uski bharaai khajoor ki chhaal ki thi. Jabki Muslim ki riwayat mein hai : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka takiya, jis par aap tek lagaate the, chamre ka tha, jiski bharaai khajoor ki chhaal thi.

Ummul momineen aaisha radiyallahu anha ne bataya ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka bistar pakaye hue (Tanned) chamre ka tha aur khajoor ki chhaal se bhara hua tha. Aapka woh takiya bhi isi prakaar ka tha, jispar aap tek lagaate the.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke zuhd aur duniya ke sukhon se wimukh rahne ka bayaan, jabki Allah ne aapko itni kshamta de rakhi thi ki yadi aap chaahte to uska aanand le sakte the.
Bichhaunon aur takiyon ka istemaal karne, unpar sone aur unpar tek lagaane ka waidh hona.
Ek musalmaan ko chahiye ki woh apni haalat aur jeewan ko apne Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki haalat ke prakaash mein dekhe, kyonki wahi uttam aadarsh hain. Jo unka anusran karega, woh hidayat payega aur duniya tatha aakhirat mein saphal hoga.
Aakhirat ki taiyaari karne ki prerna, aur is baat ki prerna ki momin duniya se kewal utna hi le jo Allah ki aajnaakaarita mein sahayak ho, aur usmen zyaada se zyaada jama karne mein vyast na ho. Allah ne ek qaum ki ninda karte hue farmaya hai : {tumhen adhik (dhan) ke lobh ne magan kar diya. Yahaan tak ki tum qabristaan ja pahunche.} [attakaasurah 1-2].
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65821: Rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apni mrityu ke samay na koi dirham chhora, na deenaar, na koi ghulaam aur na laundi, aur na koi cheez, siway apne saphed khachchar, apne hathiyaar aur ek zameen ke, jise aap sadqa kar chuke the.

Amr bin haaris, jo rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saale aur ummul momineen juwairiya binte haaris ke bhaai hain, -radiyallahu anhum- ka warnan hai, : Rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apni mrityu ke samay na koi dirham chhora, na deenaar, na koi ghulaam aur na laundi, aur na koi cheez, siway apne saphed khachchar, apne hathiyaar aur ek zameen ke, jise aap sadqa kar chuke the.

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki wafaat hui to aapne na chaandi ka koi dirham chhora, na sone ka koi deenaar, na koi laundi ghulaam (daasi evn daas), na koi bakri aur na koi oont, aur na koi any prakaar ka dhan. Chhora to bas apna safed khachchar, jis par aap sawaar hote the, apne hathiyaar, aur ek zameen, jise apni sehatmandi mein musaafiron ke liye waqf kar diya tha.

Nabeegan kisi ko waaris nahin banaate.
Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apni maut ke baad jo kuchh chhora, uska warnan.
Aap (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) ka dehaant ho gaya tatha apni udaarta, daansheelta aur paropkaar ke kaaran aapne apne peechhe koi mahatvapoorn wastu nahin chhori.
Kirmaani kahte hain : Hadees ke shabd (وجعلها) mein zameer (sarvanaam) teenon, yaani khachchar, hathiyaar aur zameen ki or lautta hai, na ki kewal zameen ki or.
Arbi shabd (وجعلها) ka arth hai : Patni ka bhaai. Jabki (الأختان) ka arth hai : Sasuraali sanbandhi.
65849: Ai bilaal, mujhe bataao ki tumne Islam mein sabse aasha dilaane waala kaun-sa amal kiya hai

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bilaal (radiyallahu anhu) se fajr ki namaz ke samay kaha : "Ai bilaal, mujhe bataao ki tumne Islam mein sabse aasha dilaane waala kaun-sa amal kiya hai, kyonki mainne Jannat mein apne aage-aage tumhaare jooton ki aahat suni hai?" Unhonne uttar diya : Mainne sabse zyaada aasha dilaane waala jo kaam kiya hai, woh yeh hai ki mainne raat ya din ke samay jab bhi wazu kiya hai, us wuzu se jitni namaz mere naseeb mein likhi hoti hai, zaroor parhi hai.

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne sapne mein dekha ki aap svarg mein hain, atah, aapne bilaal bin rabaah (radiyallahu anhu) se kaha : Mujhe Islam mein kiye gae sabse ummeed bhare svaichchhik kaary ke baare mein bataao? Mainne svarg mein mere saamne chalte samay tumhaare joote ki aawaaz suni hai. Atah bilaal radiyallahu anhu ne uttar diya : Mainne isse adhik aasha waala kaam kuchh nahin kiya hai ki din ho ya raat, jab bhi mera wazu toota, mainne wazu kar liya, phir us wazu se utni nafal namaz parhi, jitni mere naseeb mein likhi thi.

Bilaal radiyallahu anhu dvaara bataye gae is amal ki fazeelat ki jab koi wazu kare to namaz parhe. Yeh amal sabse zyaada aasha dilaane waale karmon mein se aur Jannat mein prawesh ka kaaran hai.
Har wazu ke baad namaz parhna mustahab hai.
Aadarsh ya shikshak ka apne shishy ke karm ke baare mein poochhna, taaki yadi achchha ho, to uspar drirh rahne ke liye protsaahit kare, anyatha usse roke.
Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki or se is baat ki gawaahi ki bilaal radiyallahu anhu jannati hain.
Yeh prashn fajr ki namaz ke samay kiya gaya, jismen is baat ki or sanket hai ki yeh aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke ek svapn mein hua tha, aur anbiya ke svapn sachche hote hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65868: Aakhiri zamaane mein aise log paida ho jayenge, jo kam umr aur maansik roop se apripakv honge. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki achchhi baat kahenge. Islam se aise nikal jayenge jaise teer shikaar se nikal jaata hai.

Ali -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain : Jab main tumse Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke hawaale se baat karoon, to aakaash se gir jaana mujhe is baat se adhik priy hai ki aapke hawaale se jhooth boloon. Aur jab tumse apne aur tumhaare beech baat karoon, to jaan lo ki yuddh dhokha hai. Mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte suna hai : "Aakhiri zamaane mein aise log paida ho jayenge, jo kam umr aur maansik roop se apripakv honge. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki achchhi baat kahenge. Islam se aise nikal jayenge jaise teer shikaar se nikal jaata hai. Unka eemaan unke gale se neeche nahin jaaाega. Is tarah ke log jahaan mil jayen, qatl kar do. Inka qatl qayaamat ke din qatl karne waale ke liye sawaab banega."

Ameer al-momineen ali bin abu taalib -radiyallahu anhu- bata rahe hain ki jab tum log mujhe Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki hadees bayaan karte hue sunoge, to main bilkul spasht andaaz mein baat karoonga. Na gol-mol baat karoonga, na kuchh kahkar kuchh muraad loonga aur na chhupaaoonga. Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke hawaale se jhooth bolne ki tulna mein aakaash se gir jaana mere liye kaheen adhik aasaan aur halka hai. Lekin jab main baat apne tatha logon ke beech ki karoon, to yuddh dhokha hai, atah main  gol-mol baat karoonga, aur kuchh kahkar kuchh aur muraad loonga. Tatha mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : Aakhiri zamaane mein kuchh kam umr tatha kam aql naujvaan paida ho jayenge, jo quraan bahut zyaada parhenge aur uske hawaale se baat karenge. We Islam aur uski seema se usi prakaar nikal jayenge, jis prakaar teer shikaar se nikal jaata hai. Unka eemaan unke gale se neeche nahin jayega. Ye log jahaan mil jayen, unka qatl kar do. Kyonki qayaamat ke din inka qatl karna qatl karne waale ke liye sawaab ka kaaran hoga.

Is hadees mein khawaarij ki kuchh wisheshtayen bayaan ki gai hain.
Is hadees mein Muhammad -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke Nabi hone ki ek bahut bari nishaani maujood hai. Aapne apni ummat ke andar saamne aane waali ek baat ki soochna di thi, jo usi tarah saamne a gai, jaise aapne bataai thi.
Yuddh mein aspasht aur apratyaksh bhaasha ka prayog karna jayaz hai. Yuddh mein dhokha aspasht bhaasha ka prayog tatha ghaat lagaakar hamla karne aadi ke maadhyam se kiya ja sakta hai, samjhaute aur suraksha ki gaaranti ke ullanghan ke maadhyam se nahin, kyonki aisa karne se mana kiya gaya hai.
Navvi hadees ke shabdon "يقولون من خير قول البرية" Ke baare mein kahte hain : Iska arth hai : We baaten bazaahir bari achchhi karenge. Jaise- unka yeh kahna ki nirnay kewal Allah ka chalega ya phir unka Allah ki kitaab ki or bulaana aadi.
Ibn-e-hajar hadees ke shabdon "لاَ يُجَاوِزُ إِيمَانُهُمْ حَنَاجِرَهُمْ" Ke baare mein kahte hain : Iska matlab yeh hai ki eemaan unke dilon mein baitha nahin hai. Kyonki jo cheez gale mein ruk jaye aur aage na barhe woh dil tak nahin pahunchti.
Qaazi kahte hain : Ulema is baat par ekmat hain jab khawaarij tatha in jaise bidaati evn sarkash log imaam ke wiruddh baghaawat kar baithen aur aam musalmaanon ki mukhaalfat par utar ayen, to unhen saavdhaan karne tatha samjhaane-bujhaane ke baad unse yuddh karna zaroori hoga.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
65869: Momin taana dene waala, laanat karne waala, badzubaan aur anargal bakne waala nahin hota.

Abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Momin taana dene waala, laanat karne waala, badzubaan aur anargal bakne waala nahin hota."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne yahaan bataya hai ki ek sanpoorn eemaan waale momin ko shobha nahin deta ki kisi ki nasl par laanchhan lagaye, bahut zyaada gaali-galauj aur laanat kare tatha haya-sharm utaar phenkkar bad-zubaani karta phire.

Kisi quraaani ayat ya kisi hadees mein kisi kaam ke karne ya kisi kaam ko chhorne par eemaan na hone ki baat usi samay kahi jaati hai, jab kiya gaya kaam haraam ya chhora huा kaam waajib ho.
Shareer ke angon aur khaas taur se zabaan ko buri baaton se surakshit rakhne ki prerna.
Sindhi kahte hain : 'Taa् aan' tatha 'laa् aan' ke atishyokti waale shabd yeh bataate hain ki laan-taan ke kisi haqdaar vyakti ko thori-bahut laanat karne se ahl-e-eemaan hone ke gun ka nuqsaan nahin hota.
65978: Tumhaare naamon mein Allah ke nikat sabse priy naam abdullah aur abdur rahmaan hain.

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Tumhaare naamon mein Allah ke nikat sabse priy naam abdullah aur abdur rahmaan hain."
Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- bata rahe hain ki Allah ke yahaan sabse priy naam abdullah ya abdur rahmaan hai.

Qurtubi kahte hain : In donon naamon ke saath in jaise saare naam, jaise abdur raheem, abdul malik aur abdus samad aadi jur jayenge. Ye naam Allah ke yahaan sabse priy isliye hain ki inke andar Allah ka uchit sthaan, bande ka uchit sthaan aur bande ka kartavy bataya gaya hai aur bande ka kartavy Allah ki bandgi karna hai. Yahaan bande ko uske paalanhaar ke saath waastawik andaaz mein jora gaya hai, jiske nateeje mein in naamon waale log in naamon ki pushti karte hain aur apne paalanhaar se jurne ka gaurav praapt karte hain. Kisi aur ne kaha hai : Kewal inheen do naamon ko zikr karne ka kaaran yeh hai ki pawitr quraan mein Allah evn rahmaan ke atirikt Allah ki kisi aur naam se bande ko jora nahin gaya hai. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : "Aur yeh ki jab Allah ka banda uski ibaadat ke liye khara hua." Tatha ek any sthaan mein kaha hai : "Aur rahmaan ke bande", iski pushti is ayat se bhi hoti hai : "Kaho, tum sab Allah ko pukaaro ya rahmaan ko pukaaro."
66034: Sun lo! Sharaab haraam kar di gai hai.

Anas radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Main abu talha ke ghar mein logon ko sharaab pila raha tha aur un dinon unki sharaab fazeekh naami sharaab hua karti thi, ki isi beech Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ek vyakti ko yeh aawaaz lagaane ka aadesh diya :  Sun lo! Sharaab haraam kar di gai hai. Unka kahna hai ki (yeh aawaaz sunte hi) abu talha ne mujhse kaha : Baahar jaao aur ise baha do. Chunaanche main baahar gaya aur use baha diya. Dekhte hi dekhte madeene ki galiyon se sharaab bahne lagi. Aise mein kisi ne kaha : Kuchh log qatl kar diye gae aur unke pet mein sharaab maujood thi. Chunaanche Allah ne yeh ayat utaari : (Eemaan laane aur achchhe amal karne waalon par un cheezon ka koi gunaah nahin hai, jo we kha chuke.) [al-maaida : 93]

Anas bin maalik radiyallahu anhu bata rahe hain ki woh apni maata ke pati abu talha ke ghar mein upasthit logon ko sharaab pila rahe the aur us din log paki hui evn adhapki khajooron se bani sharaab pi rahe the ki isi beech Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki or se bheje hue ek vyakti ne ailaan kar diya : Sun lo! Sharaab haraam kar di gai hai, unka kahna hai ki ailaan sunne ke baad abu talha ne mujhse kaha : Baahar jaao aur sharaab ko baha do. Chunaanche main baahar gaya aur use baha diya. Phir dekhte hi dekhte madeene ki galiyon mein sharaab bahne lagi. Aise mein kisi ne kaha : Kuchh sahaaba sharaab haraam hone se pahle is awastha mein maar diye gae ki unke pet mein sharaab maujood thi. Chunaanche Allah ne yeh ayat utaari :

{eemaan laane aur achchhe amal karne waalon par un cheezon ka koi gunaah nahin hai, jo we kha chuke.} [al-maaida : 93] yaani eemaan waalon ne sharaab ka nishedh utarne se pahle jo kuchh khaya aur piya, unhen uska gunaah nahin hoga.

Abu talha aur sahaaba radiyallahu anhum ki yeh khoobi hai ki unhonne bina kisi sankoch ke Allah ke aadesh ko turant maan liya. Yahi ek sachche musalmaan ka kartavy hai.
Khamr : Ek saargarbhit shabd jiske dayre mein saare nasheele padaarth a jaate hain.
Fazeekh : Paki evn adhapki khajooron se aag mein pakaye bina banne waali sharaab. Busr : Adhapki khajoor.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Muhallab ne kaha hai : Sharaab ko raaste mein isliye baha diya gaya, taaki use thukra dene aur chhor dene ki baat har taraf phail jaye. Waise, sarak par sharaab daalne se logon ko kasht ho sakta hai, lekin oopar bataai gai masalhat is kasht se kaheen adhik mahatvoorn hai.
Bandon par Allah ke anugrah ka bayaan aur yeh ki aadesh utarne se pahle kiye gae kisi kaary ki pakar nahin hogi.
Allah ne sharaab ko isliye haraam kar diya hai ki isse wiwek evn dhan ko hone waali kshati ke kaaran kai buraaiyaan saamne aati hain aur wiwek chhin jaane ke kaaran insaan sharaab peekar bahut-se gunaah ke kaam karne lagta hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66036: Jis cheez ki adhik maatra nasha laye, uski kam maatra bhi haraam hai.

Jaabir -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh bayaan karte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jis cheez ki adhik maatra nasha laye, uski kam maatra bhi haraam hai."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki khaane-peene ki har woh cheez, jo adhik maatra mein liye jaane se insaan ki aql ko le urti hai, uski kam maatra lena bhi haraam hai. Chaahe aql na bhi le jaye.

Shareeyat insaan ki aql ki raksha karti hai.
Buraai ke raaste ko rokne ke siddhaant ke etibaar ka saheeh hona,  aisa un sabhi cheezon ko band karke kiya jaata hai jo un buraaiyon ki or le jaati hain..
Nasha laane waali cheezon ki kam maatra bhi haraam hai. Kyonki isi raaste par chalkar insaan nasha ka aadi ban jaata hai.
Jis cheez ki kam evn adhik maatra donon nasha na laye, woh haraam nahin hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
66049: Hamaare liye moonchh kaatne, naakhoon kaatne, bagal ke baal ukhaarne, aur jaghan baal kaatne ki avdhi nirdhaarit ki gai hai ki inhen ham chaalees raaton se adhik na chhoren.

Anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : "Hamaare liye moonchh kaatne, naakhoon kaatne, bagal ke baal ukhaarne, aur jaghan baal kaatne ki avdhi nirdhaarit ki gai hai ki inhen ham chaalees raaton se adhik na chhoren."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne moonchh kaatne, haath tatha paanv ke naakhoon kaatne, bagal ke baal ukhaarne aur jaghan baal kaatne ki seema nirdhaarit kar di hai ki inhen chaalees din se adhik na chhora jaye.

Shaukaani kahte hain : Behtar yeh hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- dvaara nirdhaarit is samay seema ka paalan kiya jaye. Isse aage barhna jayaz nahin hai. Agar chaalees din poore hone se pahle yeh cheejen lanbi ho jayen aur inhen na kaata jaye, to yeh sunnat ki mukhaalfat nahin hai.
Ibn hubaira kahte hain : Yeh hadees antim samay seema ka nirdhaaran karti hai. Behtar yeh hai ki is seema tak pahunchne se pahle hi kaat liya jaye.
Islam svachchhata evn shobha par dhyaan deta hai.
Moonchh kaatne ka matlab hai, oopar waale honth par uge hue baalon ko kaatna.
Bagal ke baal ukherne ka arth hai, bagal mein uge hue baalon ko saaf karna. Bagal se muraad woh sthaan hai, jo kandhe mein baazu ke neeche hua karta hai.
Jaghan baal se muraad hai, purush tatha stri ki agli sharmagaah ke chaaron or uge hue baal.
66163: Allah taaala farmaata hai : Teen aadmi aise hain ki qayaamat ke din main unka dushman hooonga

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Allah taaala farmaata hai : Teen aadmi aise hain ki qayaamat ke din main unka dushman hooonga. Woh aadmi jo mera naam lekar waada kare, phir use tor daale, doosra woh aadmi jo kisi aazaad aadmi ko bech karke uski qeemat kha jaye, teesra woh aadmi jo kisi mazdoor ko mazdoori par rakhe, usse poora kaam le, lekin use mazdoori na de."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki Allah taaala ne pharmaya hai : Teen qism ke log aise hain ki qayaamat ke din main unka dushman hooonga, aur jiska main dushman hua, use hara doonga aur uspar ghaalib a jaaoonga : Pahla : Woh jo Allah ki qasam khaakar koi sandhi kare, phir use bhang kar de aur wishvaasghaat kare. Doosra : Jisne kisi aazaad vyakti ko daas bataakar bech diya aur uski qeemat kha gaya tatha use apne upyog mein le liya. Teesra : Jisne kisi mazdoor ko kaam par rakha, usse poora kaam le liya aur use uska paarishramik nahin diya.

Yeh hadees un hadeeson mein se hai, jo Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne rab se riwayat karke bayaan ki hai. Is tarah ki hadees ko hadees-e-qudsi ya hadees-e-ilaahi kaha jaata hai. Isse abhipray woh hadees hai, jiske shabd tatha arth donon Allah ke hon. Albatta iske andar Qur'an ki wisheshtayen, jaise uski tilaawat ka ibaadat hona, uske liye tahaarat praapt karna tatha uska chamatkaar (ejaaz) hona aadi, nahin paai jaati.
Sindhi kahte hain : Kaha gaya hai ki in teenon ka ullekh inhen wishisht bataane ke liye nahin hai, kyonki Allah taaala to sabhi zaalimon ka wirodhi hai, balki in teenon ke maamle mein sakhti bayaan karne ke liye hai.
Ibn al-jauzi kahte hain : Svatantr vyakti Allah ka banda hai. Atah, jo uspar zulm karta hai, uska wirodhi svayn uska maalik, Allah hai.
Khattaabi kahte hain : Kisi aazaad vyakti ko ghulaam banaana do tarah se hota hai : Ek yeh ki use aazaad kar de aur phir is baat ko chhipa le ya uska inkaar kar de. Aur doosra yeh ki aazaad karne ke baad usse zabardasti kaam le. In donon mein pahli sthiti adhik ganbheer hai. Main kahta hoon : Aur is adhyay ki hadees isse bhi adhik ganbheer hai; kyonki ismen aazaadi ko chhipaane ya uska inkaar karne ke saath-saath use bechkar uski qeemat kha lene ka amal bhi hai. Iseeliye is par di gai chetaavni adhik sakht hai.
66184: Agar wo us aag mein ghus jaate to qayaamat tak usse nikal na paate. Anusran kewal shareeat sammat kaaryon mein kiya jayega.

Ali radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain : Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ek sena bheji, uska senaapti ek ansaari vyakti ko niyukt kiya tatha logon ko aadesh diya ki uska anusran karen. (Ek baar senaapti ko) ghussa a gaya. Usne logon se poochha : Kya Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne tumhen mera anusran karne ka aadesh nahin diya hai? Logon ne uttar diya : Awashy diya hai. Usne kaha : Tum mere liye lakriyaan jama karo. Logon ne (lakriyaan) jama kar deen. Usne kaha : Aag sulgaao. Logon ne aag sulga di. Phir usne kaha : Usmen kood jaao. Logon ne koodne ka iraada kar liya, lekin phir ek-doosre ko rokne lage aur kahne lage : Ham to aag se hi bhaagkar Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke paas aye hain. We isi kashamkash mein the ki aag bujh gai aur uska gussa bhi thanda par gaya. Phir jab Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam tak yeh baat pahunchi, to aapne farmaya : "Agar wo us aag mein ghus jaate to qayaamat tak usse nikal na paate. Anusran kewal shareeat sammat kaaryon mein kiya jayega."

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne ek sena bheji, ek ansaari vyakti ko uska senaapti niyukt kar diya aur sabhi ko uska anusran karne ka aadesh diya. Ek baar senaapti ko unpar ghussa a gaya. Ghusse mein unse kaha : Kya Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne tumhen mera anusran karne ka aadesh nahin diya hai? Sabhi ne kaha : Awashy diya hai. Usne kaha : Main tumhen aadesh deta hoon ki lakriyaan jama karo, aag jalaao aur phir usmen kood jaao. Chunaanche, unhonne lakriyaan jama keen aur aag jalaai. Phir jab usmen prawesh karna chaaha, to ek-doosre ko dekhne lage. Kahne lage : Hamne Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka anusran to kewal isi aag se bachne ke liye kiya hai. Aise mein kya hamen ismen koodna chahiye? We yahi soch rahe the ki aag ke shole bujh gae aur senaapti ka ghussa thanda ho gaya. Iski soochna jab Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko mili, to farmaya : Yadi we senaapti ki aajna ka paalan karte aur uske dvaara jalaai gai aag mein kood jaate, to we wahi yaatna sahte rahte aur duniya ke ant tak usse baahar nikal nahin paate. Srishtikarta ki awajna waale kaaryon mein kisi srishti ki aajna ka paalan nahin kiya jayega. Aajna ka paalan to kewal neki ke kaamon mein karna hai, gunaah ke kaamon mein nahin.

Is baat ka bayaan ki anusran kewal neki mein hota hai, awajna mein nahin, bhale hi aadesh dene waala koi aisa vyakti ho, jiska anusran karna waajib hai.
Awajnaakaari ekeshvarvaadi ko aag ki chetaavni di gai hai, jabki Allah chaahe to use maaf bhi kar sakta hai.
Ghazva mein, aur isi tarah yaatra mein, ameer (netritvakarta) niyukt karne ka shareeyat sammat hona.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66196: Main aurton se musaafha nahin karta. Mera ek aurat se baat karna ek sau aurton se baat karne ki tarah hai.

Umaima bint ruqaiqa -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Main Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas kuchh ansaari aurton ke saath aapse baiat karne ke liye aai. Hamne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! : Ham aapse is baat par baiat karte hain ki ham kisi cheez ko Allah ka saajhi nahin banayenge, chori nahin karenge, vyabhichaar mein lipt nahin honge, koi aisa aarop nahin layenge jise hamne apne haathon evn pairon ke aage garh liya hon aur kisi bhale kaam mein awajna nahin karenge. Aapne kaha : "Tum apni shakti evn saamarthy ke anusaar ye kaary karna.", woh kahti hain: Ham ne kaha; Allah aur uske Rasool ham par zyaada daya karne waale hain, ai Allah ke Rasool! Aaiye, ham aapse baiat karte hain. Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Main aurton se musaafha nahin karta. Mera ek aurat se baat karna ek sau aurton se baat karne ki tarah hai."

Umaima bint ruqaiqa bayaan karti hain ki woh kuchh ansaari aurton ke saath Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas aapse is baat par baiat karne ke liye pahunchi ki woh kisi ko Allah ka saajhi nahin banayengi, chori nahin karengi, vyabhichaar nahin karengi, koi aisa aarop nahin layengi jise unhonne apne haathon evn pairon ke aage garh liya ho aur aap ki kisi bhale kaam mein awajna nahin karengi. Atah Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : Tum apni shakti evn saamarthy ke anusaar ye kaary karna. Hamne kaha : Allah aur uska Rasool hampar kaheen adhik daya karne waala hai. Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aaiye ham aapse usi tarah haath milaakar baiat karte hain, jis tarah purush kiya karte hain. To Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : Main aurton se musaafha nahin karta. Mera sau aurton se baat karna aur baiat karna ek aurat se baat karne ki tarah hi hai.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke aurton se baiat karne ke tareeqa ka wivran.
Ghair-mahram aurton se musaafha karna haraam hai.
Sharai zimmedaariyon ka paalan shakti evn saamarthy se juri hua hai.
[ise tirmizi, nasai aur ibn-e-maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
66205: Ukl evn uraina qabeelon ke kuchh log (madeena) aye aur madeene ki aab wa hawa raas na aane ke kaaran beemaar ho gae.

Anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ukl evn uraina qabeelon ke kuchh log (madeena) aye aur madeene ki aab wa hawa raas na aane ke kaaran beemaar ho gae. Atah Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unko oonton ke rewar ke paas jaane aur unka peshaab tatha doodh peene ka aadesh diya. We chal pare. Lekin jab svasth ho gae, to Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki or se niyukt charvaahe ko maar diya aur oonton ko haankte hue lekar chale gae. Iski soochna subah-subah pahunchi aur aapne unka peechha karne ke liye log bhej diye. Din charhne ke baad unko laya gaya, to aapke aadesh se unke haath evn paanv kaat diye gae,  aankhon par salaai pher di gai aur unko harra (laawa) ke maidaan mein phenk diya gaya. Paani maangte rahe, lekin paani diya nahin gaya. Abu qilaaba kahte hain : In logon ne chaari ki thi, qatl kiya tha, eemaan laane ke baad kaafir ho gae the aur Allah evn uske Rasool se yuddh kiya tha.

Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas 'ukl' aur 'uraina' qabeelon ke kuchh log musalmaan hokar aye. To unhen ek beemaari aur rog lag gaya, jisse unke pet phool gae. Aur isi kaaran unhonne madeena mein rahna naapsand kiya, kyonki wahaan ka khaan-paan aur aabohva unhen raas nahin aai. Atah Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne unko zakat ke oonton ke paas jaakar rahne aur unka peshaab evn doodh peene ka aadesh diya. We chale bhi gae. Lekin jab svasth aur khoob mote-taaze ho gae, to Allah ke Rasool ki or se niyukt charvaahe ko maar diya aur oonton ko haankkar chal diye. Iski soochna aapke paas subah-subah pahunchi, to unko dhoondhne ke liye log bhej diye. We dhoondh bhi liye gae. Din charhne ke baad unko qaid karke aapke saamne laya gaya, to aapne unke haath-paanv kaat daalne aur aankhen phor dene ka aadesh diya. Kyonki charvaahe ke saath unhonne yahi kiya tha. Phir unhen harra (laawa) ke maidaan mein phenk diya gaya. Paani maangte rahe, lekin paani nahin diya gaya, yahaan tak ki mar gae. Abu qilaaba kahte hain: In logon ne chori ki thi, qatl kiya tha, eemaan ke baad kufr ki raah apnaai thi aur Allah evn uske Rasool se yuddh kiya tha.

Jin jaanavron ka maans khaya jaata hai, unka peshaab paak hai.
Oont ke doodh evn peshaab dvaara ilaaj shareeyat sammat hai.
Qisaas mein samaanta ek sharai siddhaant hai. Jabki shareer ke ang kaatne ki manaahi us samay ke liye hai, jab badle ya qisaas ke taur par na kaate jayen.
Ek vyakti ke badle mein ek samooh ko qatl kiya jayega. Chaahe samooh ne qatl dhokhe se kiya ho ya aamne-saamne hokar.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66210: Tum log mujhse is baat par baiat karo ki tum kisi ko Allah ka saajhi nahin banaaoge, chori nahin karoge, vyabhichaar nahin karoge

Ubaada bin saamit -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, jo badr yuddh mein shareek the aur aqba ki raat aguwa (naqeeb) niyukt kiye gae logon mein se ek the, ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya, jabki aapke aas-paas aapke saathiyon mein se kai log maujood the : "Tum log mujhse is baat par baiat karo ki tum kisi ko Allah ka saajhi nahin banaaoge, chori nahin karoge, vyabhichaar nahin karoge, apni santaan ka wadh nahin karoge, koi aisa aarop (kalank) nahin lagaaoge jise tum apne haathon evn pairon se garh liye ho aur kisi bhale kaam mein awajna nahin karenge. Jo apne diye hue in wachnon ko poora karega, use Allah ke yahaan pratiphal milega aur jo inmen se kisi cheez mein sanlipt hoga aur use duniya mein dand mil gaya, to yeh uske liye kaffaara hai. Aur jo inmen se kisi cheez mein sanlipt hua aur Allah ne parda daal diya, to woh Allah ke hawaale hai. Chaahe to kshama kar de aur chaahe to dand de." Chunaanche hamne in baaton par aapse baiat ki.

Ubaada bin saamit radiyallahu anhu, jo mahaan badr yuddh mein shaamil hue the aur Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke madeena hijrat karne se pahle makka mein maujoodgi ke dauraan aqba ki raat mina mein aapke sahyog ki pratijna lene waale pratinidhi mandal ke sardaar the, bataate hain ki Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apne sahaaba ke beech baithe hue the ki unse nimnalikhit baaton par baiat karne ko kaha : 1- Allah ki ibaadat mein kisi ko saajhi nahin banayenge. 2- chori nahin karenge. 3- vyabhichaar mein sanlipt nahin honge. 4- apne bachchon ki hatya nahin karenge. Ghareebi ke dar se bachchon ki aur sharm ke dar se bachchiyon ki. 5- aisa jhooth saamne nahin bolenge, jise unhonne haathon aur pairon ke darmiyaan garh liya ho. Kyonki adhiktar gunaah unheen ke dvaara hote hain, yadyapi doosre ang bhi gunaah mein shaamil ho jayen. 6- kisi neki ke kaam mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki awajna nahin karenge. Baiat karne waalon mein se jo is baiat ka paalan karega, uska pratiphal dena Allah ka kaam hai. Aur jo oopar bayaan kiye gae gunaahon mein se shirk ko chhorkar kisi any gunaah mein sanlipt hoga, aur duniya mein use uska sharai dand mil gaya, to yeh dand uske liye prayashchit ban jayega aur phalasvaroop woh paak-saaf ho jayega. Iske wipreet jo vyakti inmen se kisi gunaah mein sanlipt hoga aur uske baad Allah ne uske gunaah par parda daal diya, to phir maamla Allah ke haath mein rahega. Chaahe to maaf kar de aur chaahe to dand de. Chunaanche upasthit sabhi logon ne aapke haath par in baaton ki pratijna li.

Aqaaba ki pahli baiat ki wishayvastu ka wivran, jo makka mein jihaad aniwaary hone se pahle ki gai thi.
Sindhi kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke kathan "Achchhe kaam mein" : Zaahir si baat hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saare hi aadesh achchhe kaam ke hain. Isse pare ki kalpana bhi nahin ki ja sakti. Atah aapke shabd "Achchhe kaam mein" Anusran ke aniwaary hone ka kaaran bataane aur yeh spasht karne ke liye hain ki kisi srishti ka anusran bure kaam mein nahin kiya jayega. Saath hi yeh ki baiat ke samay achchhe kaam mein anusran ki shart rakhni chahiye. Sanpoorn anusran ki baiat nahin honi chahiye.
Muhammad bin ismaaeel taimi aadi kahte hain : Yahaan santaan ki hatya ki baat wishesh roop se isliye kahi gai hai ki yeh hatya bhi hai aur sanbandh-wirodhi kaary bhi. Isliye isse mana karne ki adhik zaroorat thi. Doosri baat yeh hai ki arbon mein larkiyon ko zinda dafan karna aur ghareebi ke bhay se bachchon ki hatya karna ek saadhaaran baat thi. Teesri baat yeh hai ki bachchon ka zikr isliye bhi hua hai ki bachche is awastha mein nahin hote ki apni raksha kar saken.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees ki vyaapakta Allah ke nimnalikhit kathan dvaara seemit kar di gai hai : {nissandeh Allah kshama nahin karega ki us ke saath kisi ko saajhi banaya jaye. } isliye agar Islam dharm ka parityaag karne waale vyakti ko uske is apraadh ke kaaran (islaami hukoomat dvaara) mrityu dand diya jaata hai, to yeh mrityu dand uske liye kaffaara nahin banega.
Qaazi ayaaz kahte hain : Adhiktar ulema ka mat yeh hai ki sharai dand kaffaara ban jaya karte hain.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66211: Jisne khud ko sharai dand ka haqdaar bana liya aur use duniya mein dand de diya gaya, to Allah ka nyay is baat ki anumti nahin deta ki apne bande ko aakhirat mein dobaara dand de.

Ali -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jisne khud ko sharai dand ka haqdaar bana liya aur use duniya mein dand de diya gaya, to Allah ka nyay is baat ki anumti nahin deta ki apne bande ko aakhirat mein dobaara dand de. Tatha jisne khud ko sharai dand ka haqdaar bana liya aur Allah ne uske is krity par parda daal diya tatha kshama kar diya, to Allah ki udaarta is baat ki anumti nahin deti ki kshama ki hui kisi cheez ki or laute."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki jisne sharai dand waajib karne waala koi gunaah, jaise vyabhichaar aur chori aadi kiya aur duniya mein use sharai dand de diya gaya, to yeh dand uske us gunaah ko mita deta aur aakhirat mein milne waali uski saza ko khatm kar deta hai. Kyonki Allah ka nyay evn daya is baat ki anumti nahin deti ki bande ko do-do sazayen de. Isi tarah jis bande par Allah ne duniya mein parda daal diya au use us gunaah par saza nahin diya tatha uske gunaah ko maaf kar diya, to Allah ka anugrah is baat ki anumti nahin deta hai ki apne maaf kiye hue bande ko dobaara saza de.

Allah ka nyay, udaarta aur daya mahaan hai.
Duniya mein kisi gunaah par diya jaane waala sharai dand us gunaah ka prayashchit ho jaata hai.
Jisne koi aisa gunaah kiya, jiska sharai dand nirdhaarit ho aur Allah ne uspar parda daal rakha ho, to use bhi apne gunaah par parda daale rakhna aur Allah se sachchi tauba karni chahiye.
[is hadees ko tirmizi aur ibn-e-maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
66214: Uspar laanat na bhejo, Allah ki qasam! Mujhe maaloom hai ki woh Allah aur uske Rasool se prem karta hai.

Umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai: Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke zamaane mein ek aadmi tha jiska naam abdullah tha, aur use himaar ka laqab diya gaya tha. Woh rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko hansaya karta tha, aur Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne use sharaab peene par saza di thi. Phir ek din use laya gaya aur aapke hukm par use kore maare gae, to qaum mein se ek aadmi ne kaha : Ai Allah, ispar laanat kar, ise kitni baar laya ja chuka hai? Tab Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne pharmaya : "Uspar laanat na bhejo, Allah ki qasam! Mujhe maaloom hai ki woh Allah aur uske Rasool se prem karta hai."

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke zamaane mein abdullah naam ka ek aadmi tha, jise himaar ka laqab diya gaya tha. Woh apni kuchh baaton se Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko hansaya karta tha aur aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne use sharaab peene par kore bhi maare the. Phir ek din use sharaab peene ki haalat mein laya gaya to aapke hukm par use kore maare gae. Isi darmiyaan upasthit logon mein se ek ne use bura-bhala kaha aur bola : Ispar Allah ki laanat ho! Ise kitni baar sharaab peene ki sthiti mein laya ja chuka hai?! To aap sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne pharmaya : Ise Allah ki rahmat se door hone ki bad-dua na do, kyonki Allah ki qasam, main to bas yahi jaanta hoon ki yeh Allah aur uske Rasool se prem karta hai.

Kisi nishiddh kaary ko kar baithne aur use karne waale ke dil mein Allah aur uske Rasool ke prem ke maujood hone ke beech koi takraav nahin hai. Kyonki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki ullikhit vyakti, usse woh gunaah ho jaane ke baavjood, Allah aur uske Rasool se prem karta hai.
Bara gunaah (kabeera gunaah) karne waala yadi apne kisi gunaah par are rahkar mar jaye, to woh Allah ki ichchha ke adheen hai; Allah chaahe to use kshama kar de aur chaahe to use yaatna de, aur ahle-Islam mein se koi bhi Jahannam mein sadaiv nahin rahega.
Sharaab peene waale kisi nishchit vyakti par laanat karna makrooh hai; kyonki is baat ki sanbhaavna hai ki koi rukaawat us tak laanat ke pahunchne mein baadha ban jaye; aur isliye bhi ki kisi wishesh vyakti par laanat karna aur uske wiruddh bad-dua karna use apni sarakshi par are rahne par uksa sakta hai, ya use tauba ki sveekriti se niraash kar sakta hai.
Is avgun waale anirdisht vyakti par laanat bhejna jayaz hai.
66219: Islam ki shurooaat ek ajanbi dharm ke roop mein hui aur sheeghr hi woh pahle ke samaan ajanbi ban jayega. Aise mein, shubh soochna hai ajanbiyon ke liye.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Islam ki shurooaat ek ajanbi dharm ke roop mein hui aur sheeghr hi woh pahle ke samaan ajanbi ban jayega. Aise mein, shubh soochna hai ajanbiyon ke liye."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki Islam ka aaranbh ikka-dukka logon ke saath ajanbeepan bhare maahaul mein hua tha aur phir ek samay ayega jab woh dobaara ajanbi ban jayega tatha uska paalan karne waalon ki sankhya ghat jayegi. Isliye bahut khoob hain is prakaar ke ajanbi log. Unhen bari khushi aur aankhon ki thandak milne waali hai.

Is hadees mein is baat ki soochna di gai hai ki Islam phailne tatha prachlit ho jaane ke baad phir se ajanbi ban jayega.
Yeh hadees Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke sachche Nabi hone ki ek bari nishaani hai. Kyonki ismen ki gai aapki ek bhawishyawaani sach ho chuki hai.
Islam ke liye desh tatha pariwaar ko chhorne ki fazeelat. Aise vyakti ke liye Jannat hai.
Ghurba, woh log hain, jo logon mein bigaar paida ho jaane ke baad sudhaar kaary karte hain. Logon mein vyaapt bigaar ko sudhaarte hain.
66221: Boorhe vyakti ka dil hamesha do cheezon mein jawaan rahta hai. Duniya se prem aur lambi-lambi aashaaon mein.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : "Boorhe vyakti ka dil hamesha do cheezon mein jawaan rahta hai. Duniya se prem aur lambi-lambi aashaaon mein."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki insaan boorha ho jaata hai aur uska shareer kamzor ho jaata hai, lekin uska dil do cheezon ki mohabbat mein jawaan rahta hai : 1- duniya ki mohabbat adhik se adhik dhan daulat ki chaahat karke. 2- lanba jeewan, lanbi umr aur aashayen.

Maanav svabhaav ka bayaan ki woh duniya ki mohabbat mein rahta hai aur lanbi-lanbi aashayen rakhta hai.
Lanbi-lanbi ummeeden paalne aur dhan ekatr karne ke laalach ki buraai ki or ishaara. Jisse yeh jnaat hota hai ki insaan ko maut ki taiyaari karni chahiye, dhani hai to sadqa karna chahiye aur nirdhan hai to kisi ke saamne haath phailaane se bachna chahiye.
Insaan ki sabse priy wastu svayn wahi hai. Atah uski chaahat hoti hai ki woh baaqi rahe. Isi liye woh lanbi umr chaahta hai. Woh dhan bhi chaahta hai ki dhan svaasthy evn suwidha ka ek mahatvapoorn saadhan hai. Atah jaise-jaise use in donon cheezon ke samaapt hone ke samay ke nikat hone ka ehsaas hota jaata hai, waise-waise inke liye uska prem evn inhen baaqi rakhne ki ichchha prabal hoti jaati hai.
66232: Aanand ko samaapt karne waali cheez ka zikr adhik se adhik karo." Yaani maut ka.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Aanand ko samaapt karne waali cheez ka zikr adhik se adhik karo." Yaani maut ka.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne adhik se adhik maut ka zikr karne ki prerna di hai, jiska zikr aakhirat ki yaad dilaata hai aur aakhirat ki yaad insaan ke dil se duniya ke aanand ko nikaal phenkti hai. Khaas taur se haraam tareeqe se praapt kiye gae aanand ko.

Maut duniya ki mauj-mastiyon ko samaapt kar deti hai, parantu ek momin ko aakhirat tatha Jannat ke aanand ki or le jaati hai aur us mahaan bhalaai ki or jo Jannat mein praapt hine waali hai.
Maut aur uske baad kya hota hai, yeh yaad rakhna tauba karne, paap chhorne aur agle jeewan ke liye taiyaari karne ke kaarnon mein se ek hai.
[ise tirmizi, nasai aur ibn-e-maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
66234: Saat prakaar ke log aise hain, jinko Allah us din apne arsh ke neeche chhaya dega, jis din uski chhaya ke atirikt koi chhaya nahin hogi

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Saat prakaar ke log aise hain, jinko Allah us din apne arsh ke neeche chhaya dega, jis din uski chhaya ke atirikt koi chhaya nahin hogi : Nyaykaari shaasankarta, Allah ki ibaadat mein palne waala jawaan, aisa vyakti jiska dil masjid mein atka hua ho, do aise vyakti jo ek-doosre se Allah ke liye prem rakhte hon, isi ko saamne rakhte hue milte hon aur isi ko saamne rakhte hue juda hote hon, ek vyakti jise koi pratishthit evn sundar mahila bulaye aur woh kah de ki main Allah se darta hoon, ek woh vyakti jo is tarah chhupaakar sadqa kare ki uske bayen haath ko khabar na ho ki dayen haath ne kya kharch kiya hai aur ek woh vyakti jo Allah ko ekaant mein yaad kare aur uski aankhen bhar ayen."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne saat prakaar ke mominon ko susmaachaar sunaya hai ki unko Allah us din apne arsh ki chhaya mein jagah dega, jis din uski chhaya ke atirikt koi chhaya nahin hogi : 1- ek aisa imaam jo aajnaakaari ho, awajnaakaari na ho, janta ke beech nyay karta ho, atyaachaar na karta ho. Yahaan imaam se muraad islaami shaasak hai aur yeh fazeelat har us vyakti ko praapt hogi, jise musalmaanon ki koi zimmewaari sonpi jaye aur woh nyay ke saath kaam kare. 2- aisa yuwak jo Allah ki ibaadat mein pala-barha aur jisne apni jawaani aur gatiwidhiyon ko apne jeewan ke ant tak Allah ki ibaadat par hi kendrit rakha. 3- aisa vyakti jiska dil masjid par atka hua ho. Masjid se itna lagaav evn prem ho ki wahaan se nikalne ke baad dobaara jaane ke liye pareshaan rahe. Koi shaareerik pareshaani a jaye aur masjid se baahar rahe, tab bhi dil waheen atka rahe. 4- do aise log jo Allah ke liye ek-doosre se prem karte hon aur isi deeni prem ko poore man se nibhaate hon tatha kisi saansaarik baadha ke kaaran ismen daraar parne na den. Chaahe is duniya mein ek-doosre se mil payen ya mil na bhi payen aur mrityu unke beech judaai daal de. 5- ek aisa vyakti jise koi khaandaani, sundar, pratishthit pariwaar ki evn dhanvaan mahila kukarm ki or bulaye aur woh yeh kahkar thukra de ki main Allah se darta hoon. 6- ek aisa vyakti jisne sadqa kiya, sadqa chaahe chhota ho ya bara, aur dikhaawa karne ki bajay itna chhupaakar rakha ki bayen haath ko bhi pata na chal saka ki dayen haath ne kya kharch kiya. 7- ek aisa vyakti jisne ekaant mein dil se ya zabaan se Allah ko yaad kiya aur Allah ke bhay aur sammaan mein uski aankhon se aansu bah pare.

Is hadees mein bayaan kiye gae logon ki fazeelat aur unke padchihnon par chalne ki prerna.
Ibn-e-hajar hadees ke shabdon "Uski chhaanv mein hoga" Ke baare mein kahte hain : Yahaan muraad arsh ka saya hai, jiska pramaan sunan saeed bin mansoor mein hasan sanad se warnit salmaan ki yeh hadees hai : "Saat logon ko Allah apne arsh ke saye mein jagah dega."
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Is hadees mein aye hue shabd 'aadil' ki jitni bhi vyaakhyayen ki gai hain, unmen sabse behtar vyaakhya yeh hai ki isse muraad aisa vyakti hai, jo Allah ke aadesh ka paalan karte hue har wastu ko uske asal sthaan par rakhta ho aur ati evn kotaahi ka shikaar na hota ho. Phir, uska zikr sabse pahle isliye farmaya ki usse laabhaanvit hone waalon ki sankhya bari vyaapak hua karti hai.
Ek namaz ke baad doosri namaz ki prateeksha karne ki fazeelat.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees mein ek-doosre se Allah ke liye mohabbat karne ki prerna di gai hai aur iska mahatv bataya gaya hai.
Yahaan wishesh roop se pratishtha evn sundarta ka zikr isliye kiya gaya hai ki log in donon ki or aakarshit ho jaate hain aur inhen praapt karna kathin hota hai.
Behtar yeh hai ki sadqa chhupaakar kiya jaye. Ismen dikhaawa ki sanbhaavna kam rahti hai. Lekin, dikhaakar sadqa karna aur zakat dena bhi jayaz hai. Shart yeh hai ki riyaakaari ka andesha na ho aur uddeshy doosre logon ko kharch karne ke liye protsaahit karna tatha islaami prateekon ka izhaar karna ho.
Is hadees mein bayaan kiye gae saat logon ko yeh nemat Allah ke prati unki nishtha tatha ichchhaaon evn aakaankshaaon ke wipreet kaam karne ke kaaran praapt hogi.
Hadees ke shabdon "Saat prakaar ke vyakti jinhen Allah chhaya pradaan karega" Se muraad Allah ke arsh ke neeche jagah paane waale logon ko uparyukt sankhya mein seemit karna nahin hai, balki hadees mein any logon ke bhi arsh ke neeche jagah paane ka zikr milta hai.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Is hadees mein purushon ke ullekh ka arth yeh nahin hai ki mahilayen yeh fazeelat praapt nahin kar sakteen. Is hadees mein bayaan kiye gae kaaryon mein mahilayen bhi purushon ke saath shaamil hongi. Lekin agar imaamat se muraad sabse bari imaamat yaani shaasan ho, to usmen mahilayen shaamil nahin hongi. Albatta, agar imaamat se muraad shaasan nahin hai, to usmen mahilayen daakhil ho sakti hain. Maslan jab kisi mahila ke bachche hon aur woh bachchon ke beech nyay se kaam le, to use yeh fazeelat haasil hogi. Albatta, masjid se dil atke rahne waali baat se mahila baahar rahegi. Kyonki mahila ka masjid ki tulna me ghar mein namaz parhna adhik uttam hai. Baaqi baaton mein mahilayen purushon ke saath shaamil rahengi. Yahaan tak ki purush ko mahila ki or se kukarm ke liye aamantrit kiye jaane ki baat mahila ke baare mein bhi sochi ja sakti hai, jise koi sundar vyakti kukarm ke liye aamantrit kare aur woh apni zaroorat ke baavjood Allah ke dar se inkaar kar de.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66236: Allah tumhaare liye teen baaton ko pasand karta hai aur tumhaare liye teen baaton ko naapsand karta hai.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Allah tumhaare liye teen baaton ko pasand karta hai aur tumhaare liye teen baaton ko naapsand karta hai. Use tumhaare liye pasand hai ki: Tum kewal usi ki ibaadat karo, kisi ko uska saajhi na banaao aur sab milkar Allah ki rassi ko mazbooti se pakar lo aur bikhraav ka shikaar hone se bacho. Jabki use tumhaare liye naapsand hai: Bekaar ki baaten karna, bahut zyaada prashn karan aur dhan barbaad karan."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki Allah bandon ki teen aadton ko pasand karta hai aur teen aadton ko naapsand. Jin teen aadton ko pasand karta hai, woh is prakaar hain : Bande kewal usi ki ibaadat karen aur kisi ko uska saajhi na banayen, sab milkar Allah ke wachan, quraan evn sunnat ko mazbooti se pakre rahen tatha musalmaanon ki jamaat se alag na hon. Aur jin teen aadton ko naapsand karta hai, woh hain, aisi baaten karna jinka koi fayda na ho, jo baaten saamne na aai hon unke baare mein poochhna ya logon se unka dhan, unke paas maujood cheezen aur aisi wastuen maangna jinhen maangna aawashyak na ho aur maal barbaad karna aur ghair-sharai kaaryon mein kharch karna aur maal ko barbaadi ke hawaale karna.

Allah ibaadat mein nishtha ko pasand karta hai aur awishvaas se nafrat karta hai.
Allah ki rassi ko mazbooti se pakre rahne ki prerna ki isse ekta evn aapsi prem paida hota hai.
Jamaat ke saath rahne ki prerna tatha jamaat se jure rahne evn use ekjut rakhne ka aadesh, jabki iski wipreet disha mein chalte hue bikhraav ke shikaar hone aur aapsi kalah mein phansne ki manaahi.
Aisi cheezon ke baare mein bahut zyaada baat karne ki manaahi, jinse insaan ka koi sarokaar na ho. Kyonki baat agar jayaz cheezon ke baare mein ho rahi hai, to bina matlab samay barbaad ho raha hai aur agar haraam cheezon ke baare mein ho rahi hai, to gunaah ka pahaar khara ho raha hai.
Logon ke toh mein rahne tatha unki baaton evn kaaryon ki naqal utaarne ki manaahi.
Logon se unka dhan bahut zyaada maangne ki manaahi.
Dhan nasht karna haraam hai. Is hadees mein dhan ko laabhkaari kaaryon mein kharch karne ki prerna di gai hai.
66246: Tummen se koi vyakti apne bhaai ki or hathiyaar se ishaara na kare. Kyonki use nahin pata ki shayad shaitaan uske haath mein maujood hathiyaar ko harkat de de aur phalasvaroop woh Jahannam ke garhe mein ja gire.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Tummen se koi vyakti apne bhaai ki or hathiyaar se ishaara na kare. Kyonki use nahin pata ki shayad shaitaan uske haath mein maujood hathiyaar ko harkat de de aur phalasvaroop woh Jahannam ke garhe mein ja gire."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne is baat se saavdhaan kiya hai ki koi musalmaan apne bhaai ki or kisi hathiyaar se ishaara kare. Kyonki is baat ki sanbhaavna to rahti hi hai ki shaitaan use uske haath mein maujood hathiyaar ko chalaane par uksa de aur woh apne bhaai ki hatya ya use zakhmi kar de aur is tarah gunaah mein sanlipt hokar Jahannam ke garhe mein ja gire.

Musalmaan ke khoon ke haraam hone ka bayaan.
Musalmaan ka sammaan karna waajib hai. Use apne kathan evn kaary dvaara kasht dene se bachna chahiye. Kasht dene mein lohe ya hathiyaar se ishaara karna bhi shaamil hai. Mazaaq hi mein kyon na ho. Kyonki ho sakta hai ki shaitaan ke bahkaawe mein aakar maar de ya bina chaahe hathiyaar uske haath se gir jaye aur uske bhaai ka nuqsaan ho jaye.
Shareeyat ne nishiddh kaaryon ki or le jaane waali cheezon se mana karke ghalat kaam ke raaste band karne ka tareeqa apnaya hai.
Shareeyat chaahti hai ki samaaj ka taana-baana svasth rahe, logon ke sanbandh surakshit rahen, unhen bhaybheet na kiya jaye, ishaare aur dhamki hi se kyon na ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66252: Kya main tumhen us cheez ke baare mein na bataaoon, jo shreni mein roza, namaz aur sadqa se bhi uttam hai?

Abu darda radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Kya main tumhen us cheez ke baare mein na bataaoon, jo shreni mein roza, namaz aur sadqa se bhi uttam hai?" Sahaaba ne kaha : Awashy. To  aapne farmaya : "Aapsi maamlon ka sudhaar, aur yaad rakho ki aapsi maamlon mein bigaar hi dharm ko jar se ukhaar phenkne waali wastu hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne sahaaba se poochha : Kya main tumhen adhik nafal roze, namaz aur sadqa ke sawaab se bhi uttam baat na bataaoon? Unhonne uttar diya : Ji haan. Aapne kaha : Jhagarne waalon ke beech sulah karaana, kyonki dushmani logon ke beech phoot, algaav, aapsi dvesh aur ek-doosre se munh morne ko janm deti hai. Waastav mein, aapsi maamlon mein bigaar se paida hone waali nafrat hi woh wastu hai jo dharm aur duniya ko nasht kar deti hai aur use jar se ukhaar phenkti hai, jaise ustara baalon ko jar se moond deta hai.

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka sahaaba se sawaal karne aur unhen jawaab jaanne ke liye prerit karne ka tareeqa.
Teebi kahte hain : Ismen aapsi maamlon ke sudhaar aur unke bigaar se bachne ki prerna hai; kyonki sudhaar, Allah ki rassi ko mazbooti se thaamne aur musalmaanon ke beech phoot na parne ka kaaran banta hai, jabki aapsi maamlon ka bigaar dharm mein sendh ke samaan hai. Atah, jo vyakti unke sudhaar ka kaary karta hai aur unke bigaar ko door karta hai, uska darja us roze rakhne waale aur namaz parhne waale se bhi barh jaata hai, jo kewal apni vyaktigat ibaadat mein vyast rahta hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood aur tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai]
66254: Kya main tumhen yeh na bataaoon ki tummen se achchha kaun hai aur bura kaun?

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam kuchh baithe hue logon ke paas khare hue, to farmaya : "Kya main tumhen yeh na bataaoon ki tummen se achchha kaun hai aur bura kaun?" Yeh sunkar log chup rahe, to aapne yeh baat teen baar kahi. Phir ek vyakti ne kaha : Awashy, ai Allah ke Rasool! Hamen bataaiye ki hammen se achchha kaun hai aur bura kaun. To farmaya : "Tummen sabse achchha woh hai, jisse bhalaai ki aasha ki jaye aur jiski buraai se log surakshit rahen, aur tummen sabse bura woh hai, jisse bhalaai ki aasha na ki jaye aur jiski buraai se log surakshit na rahen."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam apne kuchh baithe hue saathiyon ke paas aakar khare hue aur unse poochha : Kya main tumhen yeh na bataaoon ki tummen sabse achchha kaun hai aur sabse bura kaun hai? Lekin unke paas achchhe aur bure ki pahchaan ne hone aur rusvaai ke bhay se unhonne na to kuchh kaha aur na hi koi jawaab diya. Atah Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unse teen baar yahi prashn dohraya, to unmen se ek vyakti ne jawaab diya : Ji haan, ai Allah ke Rasool! Hamen hamaare achchhe aur bure logon ke baare mein bataaiye. Chunaanche Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne unhen bataya : Tummen sabse achchha vyakti woh hai, jisse uski bhalaai, upkaar aur neki ki ummeed ki jaati ho aur jiski buraai se surakshit raha jaata ho, atah uske atyaachaar, durvyavhaar aur zulm ka dar na ho. Aur tummen sabse bura vyakti woh hai, jisse uski bhalaai, upkaar aur neki ki koi ummeed na ki jaati ho aur jiski buraai se surakshit na raha jaata ho, balki uske atyaachaar, durvyavhaar aur zulm ka dar laga rahe.

Sabse achchhe aur sabse bure logon ka bayaan.
Doosron tak pahunchne waala laabh aur nuqsaan, svayn vyakti tak seemit laabh aur nuqsaan se barhkar hai.
Sadaachaar aur logon ke saath achchhe vyavhaar ki prerna tatha zulm, buraai aur atyaachaar se chetaavni.
66255: Jo logon ka shukr ada nahin karta, woh Allah ka shukr ada nahin kar sakta.
Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jo logon ka shukr ada nahin karta, woh Allah ka shukr ada nahin kar sakta."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki jo vyakti logon dvaara kiye gae upkaar aur bhalaai par unka shukr ada nahin karta, woh aam taur par Allah ka bhi shukr ada nahin karta. Aisa isliye hai, kyonki ye donon maamle ek-doosre se jure hue hain. Atah, jiski prakriti aur aadat mein logon ki nemat ki naashukri karna aur unka shukr ada karna chhor dena shaamil ho, uski aadat mein Allah ki nemat ki naashukri karna aur uska shukr ada karne mein kotaahi karna bhi shaamil ho jayega.

Upkaar par logon ka shukriya ada karne ka mahatv.
Waastawik anugrahkarta Allah hai aur srishti to kewal ek maadhyam hai jise Allah jiske liye chaahta hai, niyukt kar deta hai, iseeliye logon ka shukr ada karna Allah ke shukr mein se hi hai.
Logon ke upkaar ka shukriya ada karna uttam charitr ki daleel hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood, tirmizi aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
66268: “Allah ki qasam! Woh vyakti momin nahin hai, Allah ki qasam! Woh vyakti momin nahin hai, Allah ki qasam! Woh vyakti momin nahin hai.” poochha gaya ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Yeh baat aap kiske baare mein kah rahe hain? Aapne uttar diya : “Jiska parosi uske kasht se surakshit nahin rahta.”

Abu shuraih -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : “Allah ki qasam! Woh vyakti momin nahin hai, Allah ki qasam! Woh vyakti momin nahin hai, Allah ki qasam! Woh vyakti momin nahin hai.” poochha gaya ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Yeh baat aap kiske baare mein kah rahe hain? Aapne uttar diya : “Jiska parosi uske kasht se surakshit nahin rahta.”

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne qasam khaakar aur apni baat mein zor dene ke liye teen baar qasam khaakar farmaya ki Allah ki qasam woh vyakti momin nahin ho sakta, Allah ki qasam woh vyakti momin nahin ho sakta, Allah ki qasam woh vyakti momin nahin ho sakta. Yeh sun sahaaba ne poochha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Woh vyakti kaun hai jo momin nahin ho sakta? Aapne uttar diya : Aisa vyakti, jiske fareb, atyaachaar aur buraai se uska parosi surakshit na rahe.

Jiske atyaachaar evn buraai se uska parosi surakshit na rahe, uske andar eemaan na hone ki baat kahna is baat ka pramaan hai ki aisa karna kabeera gunaah aur aisa karne waale ke andar eemaan ki kami hoti hai.
Parosi ke saath achchha vyavhaar karne aur use apni baat evn karm dvaara kasht na dene ki taakeed.
66271: Jis vyakti ne apne bhaai se 'ai kaafir' kaha, uske dvaara prayog kiye gae is shabd ka haqdaar un donon mein se ek ban gaya. Agar uski baat sahi hai, to theek hai. Agar sahi nahin hai, to uski kahi hui baat usi ki or laut ayegi.

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Jis vyakti ne apne bhaai se 'ai kaafir' kaha, uske dvaara prayog kiye gae is shabd ka haqdaar un donon mein se ek ban gaya. Agar uski baat sahi hai, to theek hai. Agar sahi nahin hai, to uski kahi hui baat usi ki or laut ayegi."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is baat se saavdhaan kiya hai ki koi musalmaan apne bhaai ko 'ai kaafir' kahe. Kyonki aisa kahne par is shabd ka haqdaar donon mein se ek ban jaata hai. Agar saamne waala vyakti is shabd ka haqdaar hai, to theek hai. Agar haqdaar nahin hai, to yeh shabd khud kahne waale ki or laut jayega.

Is hadees mein ek musalmaan ko is baat se saavdhaan kiya gaya hai ki woh apne bhaai ko kufr evn fisq aadi aise wisheshnon se wisheshit na kare, jo uske andar maujood na hon.
Is prakaar ki buri baat se saavdhaan karna. Apne bhaai ko is tarah ki baat kahne waala bare khatre mein hai. Isliye, apni zabaan par kaabu rakhna chahiye aur poori samajhdaari se hi use kholna chahiye.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66272: Beshak mujhe laanat karne waala banaakar nahin bheja gaya, balki mujhe daya banaakar bheja gaya hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki kaha gaya : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mushrikon ke wiruddh bad-dua keejiye. To aapne farmaya : "Beshak mujhe laanat karne waala banaakar nahin bheja gaya, balki mujhe daya banaakar bheja gaya hai."

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se mushrikon ke liye bad-dua karne ko kaha gaya, to aapne farmaya : "Mujhe Allah ki or se laanat karne waala banaakar nahin bheja gaya hai ki main logon ko Allah ki rahmat se door aur nishkaasit hone ki bad-dua doon aur unhen bhalaai se wanchit kar doon. Main is kaam ke liye nahin bheja gaya hoon. Balki main to sabhi logon ke liye aam taur par, aur mominon ke liye khaas taur par, bhalaai aur rahmat ka zariya banaakar bheja gaya hoon.

Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka adbhut aachran.
Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka anusran karte hue, zabaan ko gaali-galauj aur laanat se pawitr rakhne ka mahatv.
Ismen laanat karne ki manaahi hai.
Logon par daya karne ki prerna hai.
66273: Tummen se kisi vyakti ko logon ka bhay haq baat bolne se hargiz na roke, jab woh use dekh raha ho ya jaanta ho.

Abu saeed khudri -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Tummen se kisi vyakti ko logon ka bhay haq baat bolne se hargiz na roke, jab woh use dekh raha ho ya jaanta ho."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne sahaaba ko sanbodhit kiya aur is dauraan ek baat taakeed ke saath yeh kahi ki kisi musalmaan ko logon ka bhay aur unka prabhaav haq bolne ya uska aadesh dene se na roke, jab woh use dekh raha ho ya jaanta ho.

Is hadees mein is baat ki prerna di gai hai ki logon ke bhay se haq baat ko chhora na jaye tatha use chhupaya na jaye.
Haq baat bolne ka matlab yeh nahin hai ki bolne ka andaaz shaaleen na ho, hikmat se kaam na liya jaye aur apni baat achchhe se na rakhi jaye.
Ghalat cheez ka khandan karna aur Allah ka haq jab bandon ke hiton se takraata ho, to Allah ke haq ko aage rakhna aniwaary hai.
[ise tirmizi, ibn-e-maajah aur ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai]
66284: Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : "Aadam ki santaan mujhe kasht deti hai. Woh zamaane ko gaali deti hai. Jabki main hi zamaane (ka maalik) hoon. Maamla mere haath mein hai, main hi raat aur din ko palatta hoon.

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : "Aadam ki santaan mujhe kasht deti hai. Woh zamaane ko gaali deti hai. Jabki main hi zamaane (ka maalik) hoon. Maamla mere haath mein hai, main hi raat aur din ko palatta hoon."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki uchch evn mahaan Allah ek hadees-e-qudsi mein kahta hai : Jab koi vyakti wipattiyon aur apriy ghatnaaon ke ghatit hone par samay ko kosta hai, to woh mujhe dukh pahunchaata hai aur mera apmaan karta hai. Kyonki Allah hi is brahmaand ka rachyita aur ismen ghatit hone waali sabhi ghatnaaon ka nirmaata hai. Samay bhi usi ke wash mein hai aur ismen ghatit hone waali sabhi ghatnayen Allah ke aadesh se hi hoti hain. Isliye, samay ko kosna Allah ko kosne ke samaan hai.

Yeh hadees un hadeeson mein se ek hai, jinko Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne pawitr paalanhaar se riwayat kiya hai. Is prakaar ki hadees ko hadees-e-qudsi ya hadees-e-ilaahi kaha jaata hai. Isse muraad aisi hadees hai, jiske shabd evn arth donon Allah paak ke hon. Haalaanki, ismen quraan ki we wisheshtayen nahin hain jo quraan ko doosron se alag karti hain, jaise ki quraan ki tilaawat ke maadhyam se ibaadat karna, iski tilaawat ke liye tahaarat  praapt karna, iska chamatkaari hona aur iske dvaara chunauti dena, aadi.
Allah ke saath baat evn wishvaas mein adab ka lihaaz rakhna chahiye.
Allah ki likhi taqdeer aur uske nirnayon par eemaan rakhna aur dhairy ke saath unka saamna karna zaroori hai.
Kasht hona alag cheez hai aur nuqsaan hona alag cheez. Insaan ko buri baat sunkar ya dekhkar kasht hota hai, lekin isse uski koi haani nahin hoti. Isi tarah use badboodaar cheezon, jaise pyaaz evn lahsun aadi se kasht hota hai, haani nahin hoti.
Allah ko bandon ke kuchh bure kaaryon se kasht hota hai, lekin isse uski koi haani nahin hoti. Uchch evn mahaan Allah ne ek hadees-e-qudsi mein kaha hai : "Ai mere bando! Tum log hargiz mere nuqsaan tak nahin pahunch sakte ki mera nuqsaan kar sako aur tum log hargiz mere laabh tak nahin pahunch sakte ki mera laabh kar sako."
Zamaane ko gaali dene aur bura-bhala kahne ke teen prakaar hain : 1- zamaane ko yeh sochkar gaali dena ki wahi kaarak hai aur wahi cheezon ko achchha ya bura karta hai. Aisa karna bara shirk hai. Kyonki aisa karne waala Allah ke saath-saath kisi aur ko rachyita maanta hai aur ghatnaaon ki rachna ko ghairullah ke saath jorta hai. 2- zamaane ko gaali use kaarak samajhkar na de, balki kaarak Allah ko maane, lekin zamaane ko gaali yeh samajhkar de ki usi mein woh kaary hua hai, jo use naapsand hai. Aisa karna bhi haraam hai. 3- uska uddeshy bas soochna dena ho, bura-bhala kahna nahin. Yeh jayaz hai. Loot alaihissalaam ka yeh kathan isi prakaar ka hai :  (Aur kaha : Yeh to bara kathor din hai.)
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66294: Tum aise logon ke gharon mein rote hue prawesh karo, jinhonne apne oopar atyaachaar kiye hain. Kaheen aisa na ho ki tumhen bhi usi prakaar ke azaab ka saamna karna par jaye, jis prakaar ke azaab ka saamna unhen karna para hai.

Abdullah bin umar -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ham log Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke saath hijr se guzre, to Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ham logon se farmaya : "Tum aise logon ke gharon mein rote hue prawesh karo, jinhonne apne oopar atyaachaar kiye hain. Kaheen aisa na ho ki tumhen bhi usi prakaar ke azaab ka saamna karna par jaye, jis prakaar ke azaab ka saamna unhen karna para hai." Phir apni sawaari ko jhirka, tez haanka aur use peechhe chhor diya.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- jab samood jaati ki basti se guzre to farmaya ki Allah ke azaab ke shikaar hone waale logon, jinhonne apne oopar atyaachaar kiye the, ki basti mein prawesh karna ya jaana ho, to rote hue aur unke ant se shiksha grahan karte hue hi jaao. Is dar se ki kaheen aisa na ho ki tumhen bhi usi prakaar ke azaab ka saamna karna na pare, jis prakaar ke azaab ka shikaar unko hona para tha. Phir aapne apni sawaari ko jhirka, tez bhagaya aur wahaan se guzar gae.

Jin qaumon ko Allah ne winasht kar diya hai unke haalaat par wichaar karna chahiye, unke kartooton se saavdhaan rahna chahiye aur nishaaniyon par ghaur karne ki upeksha karne se bachna chahiye.
In halaak hone waali jaatiyon ki bastiyon mein unke baad niwaas nahin kiya jayega aur na hi unhen watan banya jayega, kyonki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne in bastiyon mein rote hue hi prawesh karne ka aadesh diya hai aur wahaan niwaas karne waale ke liye hamesha rote rahna sanbhav nahin hai.
Navvi kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki atyaachaari qaumon ki bastiyon aur azaab ka saamna karne waale sthaanon se guzarte samay insaan ko aatm chintan karna chahiye. Isi tarah, muhassir waadi, jahaan abarha ki sena halaak hui thi, se guzarte samay tez chalna chahiye. Is prakaar ke tamaam sthaanon se guzarte samay aatm chintna karna chahiye, darna chahiye, rona chahiye, shiksha grahan karna chahiye aur Allah ki sharan maangni chahiye.
Is manaahi evn chetaavni ke dayre mein samood basti ke saath un tamaam jaatiyon ki bastiyaan shaamil hain, jinhen Allah ke azaab ka saamna karna para tha.
In sthaanon ko paryatan evn manoranjan aadi ke liye upyog karna mana hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66303: Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- par wahy ki shurooaat sachche khvaabon ki shakl mein hui.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- ka warnan hai, woh kahti hain : Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- par wahy ki shurooaat sachche khvaabon ki shakl mein hui. Aap jo kuchh khvaab mein dekhte, woh subah ki roshni ki tarah prakat hota. Phir aapko tanhaai pasand ho gai. Phir aap ghaar-e-hira mein tanhaai ikhtiyaar farmaate aur kai-kai raat ghar tashreef laye baghair ibaadat mein lage rahte. Aap khaane-peene ka saamaan ghar se le jaakar wahaan kuchh roz guzaarte, phir khadeeja (radiyallahu anha) ke paas waapas aate aur takreeban itne hi dinon ke liye phir kuchh khaane-peene ka saamaan le jaate. Ek roz aap hira mein the ki itne mein aapke paas hak a gaya aur farishte ne aakar aapse kaha : Parho! Aapne farmaya : Main parha hua nahin hoon. Aap kahte hain ki ispar farishte ne mujhe pakarkar khoob dabaya, yahaan tak ki meri sahan shakti jawaab dene lagi. Phir usne mujhe chhor diya aur kaha : Parho! Phir main ne kaha : Main to parha hua nahin hoon. Usne dobaara mujhe pakarkar dabocha, yahaan tak ki meri sahan shakti jawaab dene lagi. Phir chhorkar kaha : Parho! Mainne phir kaha ki main parha hua nahin hoon. Usne teesri baar mujhe pakarkar dabaya, phir chhor kar kaha : {parho apne rab ke naam se jisne paida kiya, jisne insaan ko khoon ke lothre se paida kiya, parho aur tumhaara rab to nihayat kareem hai.} [soora al-alaq :1-3] Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- in ayton ko lekar waapas aye. Us samay aapka dil dharak raha tha. Tab aap (apni beewi) khadeeja binte khuwailid radiyallahu anha ke paas tashreef laye aur farmaya : “Mujhe chaadar orha do, mujhe chaadar orha do.” unhonne aapko chaadar orha di, yahaan tak ki dar ki haalat khatm ho gai. Phir aapne khadeeja radiyallahu anha ko is ghatna ki soochna dete hue farmaya : “Mujhe apni jaan ka dar raha hai.” khadeeja radiyallahu anha ne kaha : Bilkul nahin, Allah ki qasam! Allah aapko kabhi zaleel nahin karega. Aap rishte jorte hain, kamzoron ka bojh uthaate hain, faqeeron wa mohtaajon ko kharch dete hain, mehmaanon ki khaatirdaari karte hain aur hak ke silsile mein pesh aane waali takleephon mein madad karte hain. Phir khadeeja radiyallahu anha, Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko saath lekar apne chachere bhaai warqa bin naufal bin asad bin abdul uzza ke paas aaeen. Warqa jihaalat ke zamaane mein eesaai ho gae the aur ibraani (hibru) zabaan bhi likhna jaante the. Chunaanche ibraani zabaan mein jitna Allah ko manzoor hota, injeel likhte the. Warqa bahut boorhe aur andhe ho chuke the. Unse khadeeja -radiyallahu anha- ne kaha : He mere chacha ke larke! Aap apne bhateeje ki baat sunen. Warqa ne poochha : Bhateeje kya dekhte ho? Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne jo kuchh dekha tha, woh bayaan kar diya. Ispar warqa ne aapse kaha : Yeh to wahi naamoos (wahy laane waala farishta) hai, jise Allah ne moosa -alaihissalaam- par utaara tha. Kaash main taaqatvar hota, kaash main us waqt tak zinda rahoon, jab aapki qaum aapko nikaal degi. Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : Achchha to kya woh log mujhe nikaal denge? Warqa ne kaha : Haan! Jab bhi koi aadmi is tarah ka paighaam laya, jaisa aap laye hain to usse zaroor dushmani ki gai aur agar mujhe aapka zamaana naseeb hua, to main aapki bharpoor madad karoonga. Phir kuchh hi samay baad warqa ki mrityu ho gai aur wahy ka silsila band ho gaya.

Musalmaanon ki maata aaisha -radiyallahu anha- bata rahi hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- par wahy aane ka aaranbh is prakaar hua ki pahle neend ki awastha mein sachche sapne aate the. Jab koi sapna dekhte, woh subah ke prakaash ke samaan saaph-saaf prakat ho jaata. Phir aap ekaant priy ban gae. Aap hira naami gupha mein ekaant mein raha karte the. Wahaan kai-kai raaton tak ibaadat mein raha karte. Khaane-peene ki cheezen bhi saath le jaate. Jab khaane-peene ki cheezen khatm ho jaateen, to musalmaanon ki maata khadeeja -radiyallahu anha- ke paas waapas aate aur dobaara kai raaton ke liye khaane-peene ki cheezen saath le jaate. Yeh silsila jaari tha ki aappar hira gupha ke andar hi saty a gaya. Aapke paas jibreel naami farishta aya aur bola ki aap parhiye. Uttar mein aapne kaha ki mujhe parhna nahin aata. Aapka kahna hai ki ispar usne mujhe pakarkar is tarah dabocha ki meri sahan-shakti jawaab dene lagi. Phir usne mujhe chhor diya aur dobaara parhne ke liye kaha. Mainne phir uttar diya ki mujhe parhna nahin aata, to dobaara pakarkar is tarah dabocha ki meri sahan-shakti jawaab dene lagi. Phir chhor diya aur parhne ke liye kaha. Mainne phir uttar diya ki mujhe parhna nahin aata, to teesri baar pakarkar dabocha aur uske baad kaha : "Apne rab ke naam se parh, jisne paida kiya. Jisne manushy ko rakt ke lothre se paida kiya. Parh, aur tera rab bara daya waala hai." [soora alaq : 1-3] iske baad Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- in ayton ke saath ghar laute. Aapka dil maut ke dar se dharak raha tha. Musalmaanon ki maata khadeeza binte khuwailid -radiyallahu anha- ke paas pahunche aur farmaya : Mujhe kapre orha do. Mujhe kapre orha do. Chunaanche aapko kapra orha diya gaya aur bhay door ho gaya. Atah jo kuchh hua tha, khadeeja -radiyallahu anha- ko bataya aur kaha : Mujhe apni jaan ka dar lag raha hai. Yeh sun khadeeja -radiyallahu anha- ne kaha : Aisa hargiz nahin ho sakta. Allah ki qasam, Allah aapko kabhi zaleel kar nahin sakta. Aap rishte jorte hain, aise kamzor logon ka bojh uthaate hain jo khud apna bojh utha nahin sakte, faqeeron evn nirdhanon ko jinka koi sahaara nahin hota kharch  dete hain, mehmaanon ki khaatirdaari karte hain aur hak ke silsile mein pesh aane waali takleephon mein madad karte hain. Iske baad khadeeja -radiyallahu anha- aapko lekar warqa bin naufal bin abdul uzza ke paas pahuncheen. Warqa unke chachere bhaai the. Woh jaahileeyat (arab ke mushrikeen ka raasta) chhorkar eesaai ban chuke the. Injeel ka kuchh bhaag ibraani bhaasha mein likha karte the. Bahut boorhe ho chuke the. Dekhne ki kshamta bhi kho chuke the. Khadeeja ne unse kaha : Ai mere chachere bhaai! Apne bhateeje ki baat sun len. Yeh sun warqa ne aapse poochha : Bhateeje, bataaiye, baat kya hai? Chunaanche Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne jo kuchh dekha tha, sab kuchh bata diya. Sab kuchh sunne ke baad warqa ne kaha : Yeh wahi Jibreel farishta hai, jise Allah ne moosa -alaihissalaam- par utaara tha. Kaash main us samay taaqatvar hota, kaash main us samay jeewit rahta, jab aapki qaum aapko nikaal baahar karegi. Yeh sun Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne poochha : Kya log mujhe nikaal baahar karenge? Unhonne uttar diya : Haan. Jab bhi koi vyakti us tarah ka sandesh laya jo aap laye hain, use kasht diya gaya aur log uske dushman hogae. Agar mujhe aapka woh din mil saka, to main aapki bharpoor madad karoonga. Iske kuchh samay baad hi warqa ki mrityu ho gai aur kuchh samay ke liye wahy aane ka silsila band ho gaya.

Yahaan yeh bataya gaya hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- par wahy aane ka aaranbh kaise hua.
Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke dvaara dekhe gae sapne bhi wahy ke dayre mein aate hain.
Saath mein khaane-peene ki cheezen rakhna shareeyat sammat hai tatha Allah par bharose ke wipreet nahin hai. Kyonki Allah par bharosa karne waalon ke sardaar Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne aisa kiya hai.
Uchch aur mahaan Allah ka bara upkaar ki apne bandon ko woh baaten sikhaeen, jo we jaante nahin the tatha unko ajnaanta ke andhkaar se nikaal kar jnaan ke ujaale tak pahuncha diya.
Likhna seekhne ki fazeelat ki iske anginat bare-bare fayde hain. Isi ke dvaara jnaan-wijnaan ko sanklit kiya jaata hai, hikmat ki baaten surakshit ki jaati hain, pichhle samudayon se sanbandhit soochnayen ekatr rakhi jaati hain, Allah ke utaare hue granth surakshit kiye jaate hain aur deen evn duniya ke saare kaam suchaaru roop se chalte hain.
Quraan ki sabse pahle utarne waali ayat "Allah ke naam se parh, jisne paida kiya" [soora alaq : 1] hai.
Uchch naitikta evn achchhe gun insaan ko tarah-tarah ki kashtakar aur naapsandeeda cheezon se bachaate hain. Jiske andar achchhaaiyaan adhik hongi, uska anjaam achchha hoga aur uske deen evn duniya ke surakshit rahne ki aasha ki ja sakti hai.
Kisi masaltah ke madde-nazar insaan ke saamne uski prashansa ki ja sakti hai.
Dare hue vyakti ke dhaarhas baandhna, use susmaachaar sunaana tatha yeh bataana chahiye ki woh surakshit rahega aur uske yeh aur yeh kaaran hain.
Yeh hadees is baat ka sabse bara pramaan hai ki khadeeja -radiyallahu anhu- ek guni, wiweki aur drirh aatm-shakti tatha deen ki achchhi samajh rakhne waali mahila theen. Kyonki unhonne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke gun bataate hue tamaam maulik naitiktaaon ka ullekh kar diya hai. Kyonki upkaar ya to rishtedaaron par kiya jaata hai ya phir ajanbiyon par. Ya to shareer dvaara kiya jaata hai ya phir dhan dvaara. Ya to aise vyakti par kiya jaata hai, jo apna bojh uthaane mein saksham ho ya phir aise vyakti par jo apna bojh uthaane mein saksham na ho. Ek aise sthaan par jahaan wistaar se baat rakhni thi, unhonne wistaar se baat rakhi hai.
Museebat aane par kisi aise vyakti ko bataana chahiye, jiske shubhchintan evn sahi ray par bharosa ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66304: (Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam farmaate hain ki) "Main chal raha tha ki mainne aasmaan se ek aawaaz suni. Sar uthaya to dekha ki wahi farishta jo mere paas hira mein aya tha

Abu salma bin abdurrahmaan se riwayat hai ki jaabir bin abdullah ansaari radiyallahu anhuma ne wahy ke ruk jaane ke baare mein bayaan karte hue apni hadees mein kaha hai : (Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam farmaate hain ki) "Main chal raha tha ki mainne aasmaan se ek aawaaz suni. Sar uthaya to dekha ki wahi farishta jo mere paas hira mein aya tha aasmaan aur zameen ke beech ek kursi par baitha hua hai. Main use dekhkar dar gaya. Phir (ghar) waapas a gaya aur kaha : Mujhe chaadar orha do. Us samay mahaan Allah ne yeh wahy utaari : {ai chaadar orhne waale! Utho, saavdhaan karo, apne rab ki baraai ka ailaan karo, apne kapre paak rakho aur malinta ko tyaag do.} [soora muddassir : 2-5] phir wahy ke utarne mein tezi a gai aur wahy lagaataar utarne lagi."

Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne Nabi banne ke baad ke aaranbhik dinon mein wahy ke ruk jaane aur uske utarne mein wilanb hone ke baare mein bataate hue farmaya hai : Ek roz main makka ki galiyon mein chal raha tha ki achaanak mujhe aasmaan se ek aawaaz sunaai di. Mainne sar uthaya, to dekha ki wahi farishta jibreel jo mere paas ghaar-e-hira mein aya tha, aasmaan aur zameen ke beech ek kursi par baitha hua hai. Main use dekhkar  bhaybheet ho gaya. Phir main apne ghar waalon ke paas laut aya aur bola : Mujhe koi kapra orha do. To usi samay Allah ne yeh ayten utaareen : {ai chaadar orhne waale!} yaani apne kapre mein lipte hue, {utho} aahvaan ke saath, {aur saavdhaan karo} un logon ko jo aapke Rasool bankar aane par wishvaas nahin karte. {tatha apne paalanhaar} aur apne upaasy Allah {ki mahima ka warnan karo}, tatha uski prashansa karo aur uski baraai bayaan karo. {tatha apne kapron ko pawitr rakho} yaani apne wastron ko naapaakiyon se paak rakho, {tatha malinta ko tyaag do} arthaat moortiyon aur pratimaaon ki pooja chhor do. Iske baad wahy aane ka silsila tez ho gaya aur wahy nirantar roop se aane lagi.

Allah taaala ke is kathan {parho} ke utarne ke baad Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par kuchh samay ke liye wahy aane ka silsila band ho gaya tha.
Allah taaala ka shukriya ada karne ke liye, wipattiyon ke door ho jaane ke baad unka warnan karna jayaz hai.
{apne paalanhaar ke naam se parh, jisne paida kiya} ke utarne ke baad sabse pahle Allah taaala ka yeh kathan {ai chaadar orhne waale!} utra.
Allah ka apne Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam par anugrah ki aap par wahy utarne ka silsila bina ruke jaari raha, yahaan tak ki aap is duniya se wida ho gae.
Allah taaala ki or bulaane, wimukhon ko chetaavni dene tatha aajnaakaariyon ko shubh soochna dene ki prerna.
Namaz ke liye kapron ka pawitr hona aniwaary hai. Ulema ne ispar Allah taaala ke is kathan se daleel pakri hai : {tatha apne kapron ko pawitr rakho}.
Farishton par aur un kaaryon par eemaan laana waajib hai jinki Allah ne unhen shakti di hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66359: Namaz tatha apne maathat kaam kar rahe logon ka khyaal rakhna.

Anas -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Jab Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki mrityu ka samay a gaya, to aapne sabse zyaada jis baat ki waseeyat ki, woh yeh thi : "Namaz tatha apne maathat kaam kar rahe logon ka khyaal rakhna. Namaz tatha apne maathat kaam kar rahe logon ka khyaal rakhna." Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- in shabdon ko dohraate rahe, yahaan ki ye aapke gale mein aakar phansne lage aur zabaan se sahi tareeqe se ada na ho sake.

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne maut se pahle tatha apne jeewan ki antim ghariyon mein apni ummat ko jis baat ki sabse adhik taakeed ki, woh yeh thi : Tum namaz awashy hi paabandi se ada karna aur uski upeksha na karna aur apne maathat daason, daasiyon ke adhikaar tatha unke saath achchha vyavhaar karna. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam in shabdon ko lagaataar dohraate rahe, yahaan tak ki aawaaz gale mein phansne lagi aur aapki baat samajhni mushkil ho gai.

Namaz ka mahatv tatha daas-daasiyon ke adhikaaron ki ahmiyat. Kyonki in donon ke baare mein Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bilkul antim samay mein waseeyat ki thi.
Namaz, bandon par Allah ke sabse bare adhikaaron mein se ek adhikaar hai. Jabki srishtiyon aur wishesh roop se kamzor logon yaani apne baal bachchon ke atirikt any maatahton ke adhikaaron ko ada karna srishtiyon ke sabse bare adhikaaron mein se ek adhikaar hai.
[ise nasai ne al-kubra mein tatha ibn-e-maajah ne riwayat kiya hai]
66370: Tum mein sabse uttam log mere zamaane ke log hain, phir we jo unke baad ayenge aur phir we jo unke baad ayenge.

Imraan bin husain -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Tum mein sabse uttam log mere zamaane ke log hain, phir we jo unke baad ayenge aur phir we jo unke baad ayenge." Imraan kahte hain : Mujhe nahin pata ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne baad mein do zamaane ke logon ka zikr kiya ya teen zamaane ke logon ka. Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya : "Tumhaare baad aise log ayenge, jo khayaanat karenge aur bharose ke paatr samjhe nahin jayenge, gawaahi dene ke liye bulaye nahin jayenge phir bhi gawaahi denge, mannat maankar use poora nahin karenge aur unke andar motaapa aam ho jayega."

Allah ke Nabi salllalaahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki kisi ek yug mein jeewan bitaane waale logon ka sabse uttam giroh logon ka woh warg hai, jismen Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aur aapke sahaaba maujood the.
