Uske baad eemaan waalon ka woh warg hai, jisne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi ko to nahin, lekin sahaaba kiraam ko paya. Uske baad ka warg taba-taabeeen ka warg hai. Is heedas mein sahaabi ko iske baad ke warg yaani chauthe warg ke baare mein sankoch hai. Uske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Nissandeh unke baad aise log saamne ayenge, jo khayaanat karenge, jiske kaaran log unpar bharosa nahin kar payenge. Unhen gawaahi dene ke liye kaha jaye, isse pahle hi gawaahi dene ke taiyaar ho jayenge, mannat maanenge lekin mannat poori nahin karenge, khaane-peene ke itne rasiya honge ki khoob mote nazar ayenge.

Yeh duniya jabse aabaad hai, tabse ismen basne waale logon ka sabse uttam warg woh warg hai, jismen Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aur aapke sahaaba maujood the. Saheeh Bukhari ki ek hadees mein hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Aadam alaihissalaam ki aulaad mein se jitne bhi behatreen daur (yug) aye, yug-yugaantar mein Allah ne mujhe unmen se sabse achchhe yug mein chunkar bheja; yahaan tak ki main isi daur mein paida hua jismen main hoon.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Is hadees se maaloom hota hai ki sahaaba taabeeen se afzal the aur taabeeen taba-taabeeen se afzal. Lekin yeh utkrishtata saamoohik roop se hai ya vyaktigat roop se, yeh shodh ka wishay hai. Aur doosra mat jamhoor ka hai.
Is baat ka ishaara ki Islam ke aaranbhit teen tabqon ka anusran zaroori hai. Kyonki jin logon ka zamaana allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke yug se nikat tha, we jnaan, pratishtha tatha Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki sunnat ke anusran mein kaheen aage the.
Nazr : Sharai aadeshon evn nishedhon ko maanne ke paaband vyakti ka apne oopar neki ka koi aisa kaam aniwaary kar lena, jise shareeyat ne aniwaary na kiya ho, kisi aise kathan dvaara jo iska sanket deta ho.
Khayaanat, mannat poori na karne aur duniya se dil lagaye rahne ki ninda.
Gawaahi ke niwedan ke bina gawaahi dena us samay nindneey hai, jab haq waale ko pata ho ki amuk vyakti ke paas mujhse jure hue maamle ki jaankaari hai. Agar use pata na ho, to bina anurodh ke di gai gawaahi is hadees mein dayre mein ayegi : "Kya main tumhen na bataaoon ki sabse achchha gawaah kaun hai? Woh vyakti jo gawaahi dene ke anurodh se pahle gawaahi de." Is hadees ko imaam Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66382: Fitne dilon par chataai ki teeliyon ki tarah ek ke baad ek aate rahte hain

Huzaifa -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ham log umar -radiyallahu anhu- ke paas maujood the ki isi dauraan unhonne poochha : Aapmen se kisne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko fitnon ka zikr karte hue suna hai? Kai logon ne kaha : Hamne aapko aisa kahte hue suna hai. Umar -radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha : Shayad aap log pariwaar aur parosi ka fitna samajh rahe hain? Sahaaba ne kaha : Ji haan. Umar -radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha : Is tarah ke fitne ko namaz, roza aur sadqa mita deta hai. Aapmen se kisne Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko us fitne ka zikr karte hue suna hai, jo samudr ki lahron ki tarah uthega? Huzaifa -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain : Unki yeh baat sun sab log khaamosh rah gae. Tab mainne kaha : Mainne suna hai. Umar -radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha : Shaabaash, buhat khoob. Ab huzaifa -radiyallahu anhu- ne kaha ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : "Fitne dilon par chataai ki teeliyon ki tarah ek ke baad ek aate rahte hain. Aise mein jo dil unhen avshoshit kar leta hai usmen ek kaala nishaan daal diya jaata hai aur jo dil unhen asveekaar kar deta hai, usmen ek safed nishaan daal diya jaata hai. Is tarah dil do prakaar ke ho jaate hain. Ek chikne patthar ki tarah safed dil, jise aakaashon tatha dharti ke rahte tak koi fitna haani nahin pahuncha sakta aur doosra kaala aur badrang dil, jo ulta rakhe hue lote ki bhaanti ho,
Woh na to achchhaai ko pahchaanta hai aur na hi buraai ka khandan karta hai, siway uske jo usne apni ichchhaaon se grahan kiya hai." Huzaifa kahte hain : Tatha mainne umar radiyallahu anhu ko bataya ki aapke aur un fitnon ke beech ek band dvaar hai, jo tor diya jaane hi waala hai. Umar ne poochha : Kya tor diya jayega, tera pita na ho? Kyonki agar khol diya gaya to ho sakta hai ki dobaara band ho jaye. Mainne kaha :  Khola nahin balki tor diya jayega. Tatha mainne unko bataya ki woh dvaar ek vyakti hai, jo jald hi maar diya jayega ya mar jayega. Yeh koi bhraanti nahin hai. Abu khaalid kahte hain : Mainne saad se poochha : Ai abu maalik! (Is hadees mein aye hue shabd) 'asvad murbaadd' ka kya arth hai? Unhonne uttar diya : Kaale rang mein sakht safed rang. Mainne poochha : 'Al-koozu mukhajjiyan' ka kya arth hai? Unhonne uttar diya : Ulta rakha hua.

Khaleefa umar -radiyallahu anhu- apni sabha mein the aur unke saath kuchh sahaaba maujood the. Isi beech umar -radiyallahu anhu- ne unse poochha : Aapmen se kisne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko fitnon ka zikr karte hue suna hai? Kuchh sahaaba ne kaha : Hamne aapko fitnon ka zikr karte hue suna hai. Yeh sun umar radiyallahu anhu ne kaha : Shayad tum beewi-bachchon ke kaaran saamne aane waali pareeksha tatha fitna muraad le rahe ho. Jaise unka atyadhik prem, unke hiton ki raksha ki teevr ichchha, unmen vyastata ke kaaran bahut-si bhalaaiyon ko nazar andaaz kar dena ya unke adhikaaron ko ada karne, unhen sanskaar evn shiksha dene mein kotaahi karna tatha isi tarah apne parosi aadi ka fitna. Kya tumhaari muraad ye fitne hain? Unhonne uttar diya : Nishchit roop se hamaari muraad yahi hai. Umar radiyallahu anhu ne kaha : Ye aise fitne hain, jo aatmachintan ka taqaaza karte hain. Inmen se kuchh gunaah aise bhi hain, jinhen nekiyon, jaise namaz, roze aur sadqe se mita diye jaane ki aasha hai. Lekin yeh bataao ki tummen se kisne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko aise fitnon ka zikr karte hue suna hai, jo itne bhayaawah evn vyaapak honge ki logon ko samudr ki lahron ki tarah hilaakar rakh denge. Unka prashn sunkar sab log khaamosh ho gae, lekin huzaifa bin yamaan radiyallahu anhu ne farmaya : Mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko is tarah ke fitnon ka zikr karte hue suna hai. Isse umar radiyallahu anhu khush ho gae aur farmaya : Tere pita ke kya kahne ki usne tujh jaise santaan ko janm diya. Zara bataao ki tumne kya suna hai? Huzaifa ne kaha : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : Fitne prakat hote rahte hain aur maanav hriday se is tarah chipak jaate hain, jis tarah chataai sone waale ke pahlu mein chipak jaati hai. Fitnon ka is tarah chipakna hriday ko prabhaawit karta hai. Ye fitne ek ke baad hote rahte hain. Aise mein fitne jis hriday ke andar prawesh kar gae aur paani ki tarah avshoshit ho gae, usmen ek kaala nishaan par jaata hai aur jis hriday ne unhen thukra diya, usmen ek safed nishaan par jaata hai. Phalasvaroop hriday do prakaar ke ho jaate hain : Aisa hriday jo eemaan ka lihaaz rakhne, har prakaar ke dosh se surakshit rahne aur fitnon ki chapet mein na aane ke kaaran bilkul safed hota hai, maano jaise ek chikna patthar ho jismen kuchh laga hua na ho. Aise hriday ko fitne nuqsaan nahin pahuncha sakte, yahaan tak ki Allah se ja mile. Doosra aisa hriday ki fitnon ke kaaran uska rang badalkar kaala ho gaya ho aur woh jhuke hue ya ulte rakhe hue lote ki tarah ho ki usmen kuchh tikta na ho. Uspar na koi achchhi baat asar karti ho aur na hikmat apna prabhaav chhorti ho. Woh na sahi ka samarthan kare aur na ghalat ka khandan kare. Siway uske jise uski aatma pasand kare aur chaahe. Huzaifa radiyallahu anhu ne umar radiyallahu anhu se kaha : Ye fitne aapke jeewan kaal mein prakat nahin honge. Inke tatha aapke beech ek band dvaar hai, jo bahut jald tor diya jayega. Umar radiyallahu anhu ne poochha : Kya use tor hi diya jayega? Kyonki agar khol diya jaata to band kar diye jaane ki sanbhaavna rahti. Huzaifa radiyallahu anhu ne uttar diya : Use khola nahin, balki tor diya jayega. Aur woh dvaar daraasal ek vyakti hai, jise maar diya jayega ya jo mar jayega. Ek baat yeh bhi yaad rahe ki mainne jo soochna di hai, woh ek sachchi evn pusht soochna hai. Yeh ahl-e-kitaab ki kitaabon se li hui soochna nahin aur na hi kisi ray rakhne waale ki apni soch hai, balki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki hadees hai.

Saarvajnik fitnon ki sangeeni, jinke nateeje mein raktapaat hota hai, dhan-sampattiyaan nasht hoti hain tatha shaanti bhang hoti hai.
Khaas fitne agar deen se sanbandhit hon, to fitne ka shikaar vyakti doshi hai. Kyonki, ye fitne ya to bidaat ke roop mein honge ya phir gunaah ke roop mein. Aur agar ye saansaarik maamlon se sanbandhit hon, to sanbandhit vyakti ke liye pareeksha hain aur use dhairy rakhne ki zaroorat hai.
Insaan ka hriday jeewan mein aane waale fitnon se prabhaawit hota hai. Surakshit kewal wahi rahta hai, jise Allah saty ke maarg par qayam rahne ki kshamta pradaan karta hai.
Navvi kahte hain : Al-tahreer naami pustak ke lekhak ne kaha hai : Is hadees ka arth yeh hai ki insaan jab ichchhaaon ke peechhe chalta hai aur gunaah mein sanlipt hota hai, to uske dvaara kiye gae har gunaah ke saath uske hriday mein andhkaar prawesh kar jaata hai aur iske baad woh fitne ka shikaar ho jaata hai aur usse eemaan ka noor jaata rahta hai. Hriday daraasal lote ki tarah hai ki jab use ulta rakh diya jaye, to uske andar ki cheezen baahar nikal jaati hain aur kuchh andar ja nahin paata.
Umar radiyallahu anhu ke shabdon "لا أبا لك" Ka arth hai : Is kaam ko poori lagan ke saath karo, kamar kas lo aur us vyakti ki tarah prayaas karo, jiska koi sahyogi na ho.
Umar radiyallahu anhu ki fazeelat jo logon aur fitnon ke beech band dvaar the.
66383: Nishchay hi bahut-se fitne saamne ayenge. Sun lo, phir ek fitna aisa saamne ayega ki uske prakat hone ke baad baitha hua vyakti usmen chalne waale se behtar hoga aur chalne waala vyakti uski or daurne waale se behtar hoga.

Usmaan shahhaam ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Main aur farqad sabkhi, Muslim bin abu bakra ke paas unke desh gae. Hamne unke yahaan prawesh kiya aur unse poochha : Kya aapne apne pita ko fitnon ke baare mein koi hadees bayaan karte hue suna hai? Unhonne uttar diya : Haan, mainne abu bakra ko yeh hadees bayaan karte hue suna hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Nishchay hi bahut-se fitne saamne ayenge. Sun lo, phir ek fitna aisa saamne ayega ki uske prakat hone ke baad baitha hua vyakti usmen chalne waale se behtar hoga aur chalne waala vyakti uski or daurne waale se behtar hoga. Sun lo, jab woh fitna saamne a jaye, to jiske paas oont hon, woh apne oonton mein vyast ho jaye, jiske paas bakriyaan hon, woh apni bakriyon mein vyast ho jaye aur jiske paas khet ho, woh apne khet mein vyast ho jaye." Warnankarta ka kahna hai ki yeh sun ek vyakti ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aap aise vyakti ko kya nirdesh denge, jiske paas na oont hon, na bakriyaan hon aur na khet? Aapne uske uttar mein kaha : "Woh apni talvaar le, kisi patthar se uski dhaar ko nasht kar de aur ho sake, to wahaan se nikal jaye. Ai Allah! Kya mainne pahuncha diya? Ai Allah! Kya mainne pahuncha diya? Ai Allah! Kya mainne pahuncha diya?" Warnankarta ka kahna hai ki ek vyakti ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Agar mujhko majboor karke donon panktiyon mein se kisi ek pankti ya donon dalon mein se kisi ek dal mein shaamil kar liya gaya aur kisi ne mujhe talvaar maar di ya koi teer aakar mera wadh kar de, to mera kya hoga? Aapne uttar diya : "Woh apne aur tere gunaah ka bojh uthayega aur Jahannam jayega."

Usmaan shahhaam evn farqad sabkhi ne ek bare sahaabi abu bakra -radiyallahu anhu- ke bet Muslim se poochha ki kya unhonne apne pita se fitnon evn musalmaanon ke beech hone waale yuddh ke baare mein Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ki koi hadees suni hai? Unhonne uttar diya ki haan, Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki aapki mrityu ke baad bahut-se fitne saamne ayenge. In fitnon ke samay inse bekhbar hokar baitha rahne waala vyakti chalne waale vyakti se achchha hoga, jo unki khabar lene ka prayaas na kare aur paidal chalne waala vyakti unki or daurne waale vyakti se behtar hoga, jo uski khabar bhi le aur usmen shaamil bhi ho. Uske baad Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya ki jis vyakti ke zamaane mein fitna saamne a jaye, agar uske paas koi sharan lene ka sthaan ho, to wahaan sharan le le. Jaise charaane ke liye oont hon, to oont charaane lage. Bakriyaan hon, to bakriyaan charaane lage. Kheti karne ke liye khet ho, to kheti karne lage. Yeh sun ek vyakti ne poochha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Agar kisi ke paas is prakaar ki koi vyastata na ho, jaise oont, bakriyaan ya khet na ho, to woh kya kare? Aapne uttar diya : Woh apna hathiyaar tor de aur ho sake to apne baal-bachchon ko lekar wahaan se bhaag nikle. Uske baad Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne teen baar gawaah banaate hue farmaya : Ai Allah! Kya mainne pahuncha diya hai? Ai Allah! Kya mainne pahuncha diya hai? Ai Allah! Kya mainne pahuncha diya hai? In sab ke baad ek vyakti ne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Agar mujhko majboor karke kisi ek pankti ya dal mein shaamil kar liya gaya aur phir kisi ne mujhpar talvaar chala di ya koi teer aakar mujhe lag gaya aur meri mrityu ho gai, to mera kya hoga? Aapne uttar diya : Apne gunaah ka bojh aur jiska wadh kiya hai uske gunaah ka bojh uthayega aur kayaamat ke din Jahannam jaane waalon mein shaamil ho jayega.

Is hadees mein fitne prakat hone ki soochna di gai hai, taaki log saavdhaan evn maansik roop se taiyaar rahen, fitnon mein shaamil na hon aur Allah se saty ke maarg par mazbooti se qayam rahne aur mukti ke maarg par chalte rahne ki dua maangen.
Navvi kahte hain : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke shabd "Phitne ke yug mein baitha hua vyakti khare vyakti se uttam hoga." Uparyukt fitne ke khatre ka warnan karte hain, usse door rahne evn bhaagne ke liye protsaahit karte hain aur yeh bataate hain ki har vyakti ka daaman us fitne mein uski sanliptata ke anusaar daaghdaar hoga.
Navvi kahte hain : Yadi kisi ko yuddh ke maidaan mein upasthit hone ke liye majboor kiya jaata hai, to uspar koi gunaah nahin hai, lekin uske liye laraai mein shaamil hona jayaz nahin hai. Yadi woh shaamil hota hai, to yeh gunaah hai, ispar saare ulema ekmat hain.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain : Doosre logon ne kaha hai : Jab koi giroh imaam (shaasak) ke wiruddh baghaawat kar de, apni zimmawaariyaan ada na kare aur yuddh ka ailaan kar de, to usse yuddh karna aniwaary hoga. Isi prakaar jab do giroh aapas mein yuddh kar rahe hon, to har saksham vyakti par ghalat paksh ka haath pakarna aur sahi paksh ka saath dena aniwaary hoga. Yeh jamhoor ka mat hai. Jabki any logon ne wistaar se kaam liya hai. Unka kahna hai ki jahaan koi imaam (shaasak) na ho, wahaan do Muslim samoohon ke beech hone waala har yuddh nishiddh hai aur is adhyay tatha any adhyay mein aai hui hadeesen isi baat ko saamne rakhkar samjhi jayengi.
Navvi kahte hain : Fitne ke samay yuddh mein shaamil hona jayaz hai ya nahin, is masle mein ulema ka matbhed hai. Ulema ke ek giroh ne kaha hai : Musalmaan jab fitne ke daur se guzar rahe hon, to yuddh mein bhaag nahin liya jayega. Fitne mein shaamil log ghar mein prawesh kar jayen aur hatya karna chaahen, tab bhi apni raksha ke liye hathiyaar nahin uthaya ja sakta. Kyonki yahaan khoon bahaane ka prayaas karne waala vyakti sharai uddharnon ka apne anusaar arth nikaalkar yeh kaam kar raha hai. Yeh abu bakra radiyallahu anhu aadi ka mat hai. Jabki abdullah bin umar evn imraan bin husain ka mat yeh hai ki jang mein shaamil hona to jayaz nahin hai, lekin apni raksha ki jayegi. Ye donon mat Islam ke naam par prakat hone waale sabhi fitnon mein shaamil na hone par sahmat hain. Jabki iske wipreet adhiktar sahaaba, taabeeen aur islaami widvaanon ka mat yeh hai ki fitnon ke daur mein satyawaadi giroh ka sahyog kiya jayega aur baaghiyon se jang mein uska saath diya jayega. Kyonki, uchch evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai, jiska arth hai: (Tum atyaachaar kar rahe giroh se laro, yahaan tak ki woh Allah ke aadesh ki or laut aye.) yahi mat sahi hai aur shaamil na hone ka ishaara dene waali hadeeson ko aise vyakti ke baare mein rakhkar dekha jayega, jise pata na chal pa raha ho ki kaun-sa giroh satyawaadi hai, ya phir donon giroh atyaachaari hon aur kisi ke paas koi sharai pramaan na ho.
66385: Sona ke badle mein sona, chaandi ke badle mein chaandi, gehoon ke badle mein gehoon, jau ke badle mein jau, khajoor ke badle mein khajoor aur namak ke badle mein namak, baraabar baraabar aur  samaprimaan mein hona chahiye aur haathon haath aadaan-pradaan hona chahiye. Agar ye warg alag-alag hon aur khareed-bikri naqad ho, to tum jaise chaaho khareed-bikri kar sakte ho.

Ubaada bin saamit -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : Sona ke badle mein sona, chaandi ke badle mein chaandi, gehoon ke badle mein gehoon, jau ke badle mein jau, khajoor ke badle mein khajoor aur namak ke badle mein namak, baraabar baraabar aur  samaprimaan mein hona chahiye aur haathon haath aadaan-pradaan hona chahiye. Agar ye warg alag-alag hon aur khareed-bikri naqad ho, to tum jaise chaaho khareed-bikri kar sakte ho.

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne chhah sood waale wargon yaani sona, chaandi, gehoon, jau, khajoor aur namak ke kray-wikray ka sahi tareeqa bataya hai. Agar kray-wikray ek hi warg ki do cheezon, jaise sona ke badle mein sona aur chaandi ke badle mein chaandi bechi gai ho, to do sharton ka paya jaana zaroori hai : 1- woh cheez wazan ki jaane waali jaise sona evn chaandi ho to wazan baraabar ho aur maapi jaane waali jaise gehoon, jau, khajoor aur namak ho to maap baraabar ho. 2- khareedne aur bechne waale kray-wikray ke sthaan mein hi saamaan par qabza kar len. Agar ye warg alag-alag hon, jaise sone ko chaandi tatha khajoor ko gehoon ke badle mein becha jaye, to kray-wikray ek shart ke saath jayaz hai. Shart yeh hai ki khareedne aur bechne waale kray-wikray ke sthaan mein hi saamaan par qabza kar len. Agar aisa nahin hota, to kray-wikray amaany hoga aur khareedne tatha bechne waale donon soodi lenden karne waale maane jayenge.

Soodi saamaanon ka bayaan aur unke kray-wikray ka tareeqa.
Sood waale kray-wikray ki manaahi.
Sood ke maamle mein kaaghzi mudra par bhi sone aur chaandi ke samaan hi niyam laagu hote hain.
Soodi koti ke chhah saamaanon ke wikray-wikray ki nimnalikhit paristhitiyaan hain : 1- soodi saamaan ko usi koti ke soodi saamaan ke badle mein becha jaye. Jaise sone ko sone ke badle mein aur chaandi ko chaandi ke badle mein becha jaye. Is kray-wikray ke sahi hone ki do sharten hain : Wazan tatha maap baraabar ho evn kray-wikray sthal par hi qabza ho jaye. 2- soodi saamaan ko kisi soodi saamaan ke badle mein becha jaye, jo uski koti se na ho, lekin donon ke soodi hone ka kaaran ek ho. Jaise sone ko chaandi ke badle mein aur gehoon ko jau ke badle mein becha jaye. Iske sahi hone ke liye donon or se qabza ho jaana shart hai. Samaan hona nahin. 3- ek soodi saamaan ko doosre soodi saamaan ke badle mein becha jaye, jo us koti se na ho aur donon ke soodi hone ka kaaran bhi alag-alag ho. Jaise sone ko khajoor ke badle mein bechna. Iske liye na to donon or se qabza hona zaroori hai aur na samaan hona.
Jab kray-wiky ghair-soodi cheezon ke darmiyaan ho, ya phir ek or soodi cheez ho aur doosri or ghair-soodi cheez, jaise sone ke badle mein jaydaad bechi jaye, to na donon or qabza hona shart hai aur na samaan hona.
66386: Lungi ka jo bhaag takhnon se neeche latkega, woh Jahannam mein jayega.
Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Lungi ka jo bhaag takhnon se neeche latkega, woh Jahannam mein jayega."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne purushon ko shareer ke nichle aadhe bhaag ko dhaanpne waale kapron, jaise paajaama evn pent aadi ko takhnon se neeche latkaane se saavdhaan kiya hai. Aapne bataya hai ki takhnon ke neeche ke jitne bhaag par kapra latka hua rahega, woh hissa dand ke taur par aag mein rahega.

Purushon ke liye takhnon ke neeche kapra latkaane ki manaahi. Aisa karna kabeera (bara) gunaah hai.
Ibn-e-hajar kahte hain :Takhnon ke neeche lungi latkaane ke  dayre se kisi aawashyakta ke kaaran latkaana baahar rahega. Maslan woh vyakti jiske takhnon mein zakhm ho aur agar woh use apne nichle kapre se na dhake, to makkhiyaan use pareshaan karengi, kyonki use uske siwa  kuchh aur nahin mil paata.
Is heedas mein kahi gai baat purushon ke saath khaas hai. Kyonki mahilaaon ko takhnon ke neeche ek haath tak  kapra latkaye rakhne ka aadesh diya gaya hai.
66392: Eriyon ke liye aag ki yaatna hai. Poorn roop se wazu kiya karo.

Abdullah bin amr radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ham Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath makka se madeena laut rahe the. Raaste mein ek chashme tak pahunche, to asr ke samay kuchh logon ne bari jaldi dikhaai. Jaldi-jaldi wazu kar liya. Ham pahunche, to unki eriyaan chamak rahi theen. Unko paani ne chhua tak nahin tha. Yeh dekh Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Eriyon ke liye aag ki yaatna hai. Poorn roop se wazu kiya karo."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne makka se madeene ki yaatra ki. Saath mein aapke saathi bhi maujood the. Raaste mein paani mila, to kuchh sahaaba ne asr ki namaz ke liye jaldi mein is tarah wazu kar liya ki saaf dikh raha tha ki unki eriyon tak paani nahin pahuncha hai. Atah Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Aise logon ke liye aag ki yaatna tatha halaakat hai, jo wazu karte samay eriyon ko dhone mein kotaahi karte hain. Iske saath hi aapne unko sanpoorn tareeqe se wazu karne ka aadesh diya.

Wazu ke samay donon pairon ko dhona zaroori hai. Kyonki agar masah jayaz hota, to eri na dhone par aag ki yaatna ki dhamki na di jaati.
Dhoe jaane waale angon ko poore taur par dhona zaroori hai. Jisne jaan-boojhkar aur susti se thore-se bhaag ko bhi dhona chhor diya, uski namaz durust nahin hogi.
Ajnaan vyakti ko shiksha dene tatha uska maargadarshan karne ka mahatv.
Aalim ko farz evn sunnaton ko nasht karne ka khandan uchit andaaz mein karna chahiye.
Muhammad ishaaq dahalvi kahte hain : Poorn roop se wazu karne ke teen prakaar hain : 1- farz : Wazu ke angon ko ek-ek baar achchhi tarah dhona. 2- sunnat : Teen-teen baar dhona. 3- musathab : Teen-teen baar kuchh barhaakar dhona.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66510: Allah taaala ne kuchh cheezen farz ki hain; unhen nasht na karo, kuchh sharai dand nirdhaarit kiye hain; unka ullanghan na karo, kuchh cheezen haraam ki hain; unke nikat na jaao aur kuchh cheezon se jaan-boojhkar, tumhaare oopar dayaasvaroop khaamoshi barti hai; atah unhen mat kuredo.

Abu saalba khushni jursoom bin naashir radiyallahu anhu se riwayat hai ki rasoolullah sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne farmaya hai : "Allah taaala ne kuchh cheezen farz ki hain; unhen nasht na karo, kuchh sharai dand nirdhaarit kiye hain; unka ullanghan na karo, kuchh cheezen haraam ki hain; unke nikat na jaao aur kuchh cheezon se jaan-boojhkar, tumhaare oopar dayaasvaroop khaamoshi barti hai; atah unhen mat kuredo."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki Allah ne kuchh cheezen waajib aur kuchh cheezen farz ki hain. Atah unki paabandi karo aur unhen chhorne ya unke baare mein susti karne se bacho. Usne kuchh rukaavten aur avrodh nirdhaarit kiye hain, jo tumhen aisi cheezon se roqen jo use pasand na hon. Atah un sharai rukaavton mein koi wriddhi mat karo. Usne kuchh cheezen haraam ki hain. Atah tum unmen sanlipt hone tatha unke nikat jaane se bacho. Shesh cheezon ko usne apne bandon par daya karte hue aise hi rahne diya hai aur unke baare mein khaamoshi barti hai. Ye saari cheezen is siddhaant ke tahat ki mooltah saari cheezen halaal hain, halaal thahrengi. Atah inke baare mein sar mat khapaao.

Yeh hadees is baat ki daleel hai ki shareeyat nirdhaarit karna Allah ka kaam hai atah dhaarmik aadesh dena Allah hi ke haath mein hai.
Is hadees mein hukm (aadesh) evn  waidhta (mubaah) ke sanbandh mein sharai siddhaant bayaan kiye gae hain. Kyonki sharai hukm ya to khaamoshi ke parde mein raha karta hai ya phir ullikhit hua karta hai. Phir ullikhit hukm ya to aadesh ke roop mein hota hai, jo aniwaaryata ya pasandeedgi ka arth deta hai, ya nishedh ke roop mein hota hai, jo haraam hone ya makrooh hone ka arth deta hai, ya phir waidhta (mubaah) ke roop mein hota hai.
Allah ne jis cheez ke baare mein chup rahne ko apnaya  hai, yaani na use farz kiya hai, na use bayaan kiya hai aur na usse mana kiya hai, woh halaal hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki utkrisht warnan shaili ki is hadees mein ek spasht wibhaajan prastut kar diya hai.
Allah ke dvaara aniwaary kiye gae kaaryon ka anupaalan aawashyak hai.
Sharai dayron ka ullanghan haraam hai.
[allaama navvi rahimhullah kahte hain : Hadees hasan hai.]
[is hadees ko daaraaqutni ne apni sunan mein tatha any ne riwayat kiya hai]
66511: “Saare kaaryon ke pratiphal ka aadhaar neeyton par hai aur pratyek vyakti ko uski neeyat ke anuroop hi parinaam milega.

Ameerul momineen abu hafs umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : “Saare kaaryon ke pratiphal ka aadhaar neeyton par hai aur pratyek vyakti ko uski neeyat ke anuroop hi parinaam milega. Atah, jisne Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye hijrat ki, uski hijrat Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye hai aur jisne duniya praapt karne ya kisi stri se shaadi rachaane ke liye hijrat ki, use wahi milega jiske liye usne hijrat ki.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki saare karmon ka etbaar neeyat par hai. Yeh hukm ibaadaat tatha maamlaat roopi sabhi aamaal ke liye aam hai. Jo vyakti apne amal se kisi laabh ka iraada rakhega, use kewal woh laabh praapt hoga, sawaab nahin. Iske wipreet jo apne amal se Allah ki nikatta praapt karne ka iraada karega, use apne amal ka sawaab milega, chaahe woh amal khaane aur peene jaisa ek saadhaaram amal hi kyon na ho.

Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aamaal par neeyat ke prabhaav ko bayaan karne ke liye ek udaahran diya, jismen ham dekhte hain ki amal ka zaahiri roop ek hone ke baavjood pratiphal alag-alag hai. Aapne bataya ki jisne apni hijrat tatha maatribhoomi chhorne ke peechhe neeyat Allah ki prasannata ki praapti rakhi, uski hijrat (desh tyaag) dhaarmik hijrat hai aur use uski sahi neeyat ki wajah se sawaab milega. Iske wipreet jisne apni hijrat se saansaarik laabh jaise dhan, pad, vyavpaar aur shaadi aadi ka iraada rakha, use kewal wahi laabh praapt hoga, jise praapt karne ki usne neeyat ki thi. Achchha pratiphal tatha neki uske hisse mein nahin ayegi.

Ekhlaas ki prerna, kyonki Allah kewal usi amal ko grahan karta hai, jise uski prasannata praapt karne ke uddeshy se kiya gaya ho.
Jin aamaal ke dvaara sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ki nikatta praapt ki jaati hai, unko agar koi vyakti aadat ke taur par karta hai, use unka koi sawaab nahin milega. Unka sawaab usi samay milega, jab unko Allah ki nikatta praapt karne ke liye kiya jaye.
Neeyat hi ke aadhaar par ibaadton ke beech antar kiya jaata hai aur ibaadat ko aadat se alag kiya jaata hai.

[ise imaam abu abdullah muhammad bin ismaaeel bin ibraaheem bin mugheera bin bardizbah al-bukhaari (rahamtullah alaih) evn imaam abul hu़sain Muslim bin al-hajjaaj bin Muslim al-ku़shairi neeshaapoori (rahamtullah alaih) ne apni prasiddh pustakon, saheeh bukhaari tatha sa
66512: Islam ki buniyaad paanch cheezon par qayam hai

Abu abdur rahmaan abdullah bin umar bin khattaab radiyallahu anhuma kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Islam ki buniyaad paanch cheezon par qayam hai : Is baat ki gawaahi dena ki Allah ke atirikt koi saty poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke Rasool hain, namaz sthaapit karna, zakat dena, Hajj karna aur Ramzan maas ke roze rakhna."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne Islam ko paanch stanbhon par khare ek bhawan ke samaan darshaya hai. Yaad rahe ki Islam ke shesh kaam is bhawan ke poorak ki bhoomika rakhte hain. In paanch stanbhon mein se pahla stanbh is baat ki gawaahi dena hai ki Allah ke atirikt koi saty poojy nahin hai aur Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam Allah ke Rasool hain. Yeh donon gawaahiyaan ek-doosre se juri hui hain aur ek hi stanbh ki haisiyat rakhti hain. Banda inka uchchaaran Allah ke ek hone aur bas usi ke ibaadat ka haqdaar hone ko sveekaar karte hue, unke taqaajon (maangon) par amal karte hue, Muhammad sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke Rasool hone ka wishvaas rakhte hue aur aapka anusran karte hue karega. Doosra stanbh namaz sthaapit karna hai. Din aur raat mein paanch farz namaazen hain. Fajr, zuhar, asr, maghrib tatha isha. In paanch namaazon ko inki sharton, stanbhon aur aniwaary kaaryon ke saath ada kiya jayega. Teesra stanbh farz zakat nikaalna hai. Zakat ek aarthik ibaadat hai, jo shareeyat dvaara dhan ki ek nirdhaarit maatra par waajib hoti hai aur jise uske haqdaaron ko diya jaata hai. Chautha stanbh Hajj hai. Hajj kuchh nishchit kaaryo ko Allah ki ibaadat ke taur par karne ke liye makka jaane ka iraada karne ka naam hai. Paanchvaan stanbh Ramzan ke roze rakhna hai. Roza naam hai khaane, peene aur is tarah ki any roza torne waali cheezon se fajr prakat hone se lekar sooraj doobne tak Allah ki ibaadat ki neeyat se ruke rahne ka.

Donon gawaahiyaan ek-doosre ke saath aniwaary roop se juri hui hain. Inmen se ek ko chhor diya jaye, to doosri sahi nahin hogi. Isi liye donon ko ek stanbh banaya gaya hai.
Yeh donon gawaahiyaan deen ki buniyaad hain. Inke bina koi kathan athva kaary grahan yogy nahin hai.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66513: “Tummen se har vyakti ki srishti-saamagri uski maan ke pet mein chaalees dinon tak weery ke roop mein ekatr ki jaati hai

Abu abdurrahmaan abdullah bin masaood radiyallahu anhu kahte hain ki : Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne, jo ki sachche the aur jinki sachchaai sarvamaany thi, hamen bataya hai : “Tummen se har vyakti ki srishti-saamagri uski maan ke pet mein chaalees dinon tak weery ke roop mein ekatr ki jaati hai. Phir itne hi samay woh jame hue rakt ke roop mein rahti hai. Phir itne hi din woh maans ke lothre ke roop mein rahti. Phir uski or ek farishta bheja jaata hai, jo usmen rooh phoonkta hai. Phir use chaar baaton ka aadesh diya jaata hai; use kaha jaata hai ki uski rozi, uski maut, uske karm tatha uske achchhe ya bure hone ko likh de. Atah, us Allah ki qasam, jiske siwa koi saty poojy nahin hai, tummen se koi Jannat waalon ke kaam karta rahta hai, yahaan tak ki uske aur Jannat ke beech kewal ek haath ki doori rah jaati hai ki itne mein uspar taqdeer ka likha aage barh jaata hai aur woh Jahannam waalon ke kaam karne lagta hai aur usmen prawesh kar jaata hai. Isi tarah tummen se koi Jahannam waalon ke kaam karta rahta hai, yahaan tak uske aur Jahannam ke beech kewal ek haath ki doori rah jaati hai ki itne mein uspar taqdeer ka likha aage barh jaata hai aur woh Jannat waalon ke kaam karne lagta hai aur Jannat mein prawesh kar jaata hai.”

Abdullah bin masaood kahte hain ki hamen Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai, jinki har baat sachchi hai aur jinko Allah taaala ne sachcha kaha hai. Aapne farmaya : Tummen se har vyakti ki srishti-samaagri ekatr ki jaati hai. Yaani jab koi vyakti apni patni ke saath sanbhog karta hai, to uska bikhra hua weery aurat ke garbhaashay mein chaalees dinon tak weery ke roop mein ekatr kiya jaata hai. Phir woh khoon ka lauthra yaani gaarha rakt ban jaata hai. Yeh kaam doosre chaalees dinon mein hota hai. Phir woh maans ka ek tukra ban jaata hai, jise ek baar mein chabaya ja sake. Yeh teesre chaalees dinon mein hota hai. Phir uski or Allah ek farishta bhejta hai, jo usmen teesre chaalees din samaapt hone ke baad rooh (jaan) phoonkta hai. Farishte ko aadesh diya jaata hai ki chaar baaten likh den. Pahli baat uski rozi (jeewika) hai. Yaani yeh likh de ki use jeewan mein kitni sukh-suwidhayen praapt hongi. Doosri baat uski ayu hai. Yaani yeh likh de ki woh duniya mein kitne din jeewit rahega. Tareesri baat uske karm hain. Yaani achchha kaam karne waala hoga yeh bura. Jabki chauthi baat yeh ki woh saubhaagyashaali hoga ya durbhaagyashaali? Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne qasam khaakar bataya ki ek vyakti jannatiyon ke kaam karta rahta hai aur uske kaam logon ko achchhe dikhaai parte hain, yahaan tak ki uske tatha Jannat tak pahunchne ke beech bas itni doori rah jaati hai, jaise kisi vyakti aur uske gantavy ke beech kewal ek haath ki doori rah gai ho, aise samay mein uspar Allah ka likha aur uska nirnay ghaalib a jaata hai aur woh jahannamiyon ke kaam karne lagta hai aur bure kaam par ant hone ki wajah se use Jahannam jaana parta hai. Kyonki amal qabool hone ke liye shart yeh hai ki insaan uspar qayam rahe aur uske sthaan par bura karne na lage. Jabki doosri or ek vyakti jahannamiyon ke kaam karta rahta hai, yahaan tak ki usmen daakhil hone ke nikat pahunch jaata hai, maano ki uske tatha Jahannam ke beech kewal ek haath ki doori rah gai ho, itne mein uspar Allah ka likha aur uska nirnay ghaalib a jaata hai aur woh jahannatiyon ke kaam karna shuru kar deta hai aur phalasvaroop Jannat mein prawesh karta hai.

Maanav rachna ke wibhinn charnon ka bayaan.
Allah ke nirnayon aur uske likhe hue bhaagy par eemaan.
Insaan ka anjaam ant mein jaakar wahi karta hai, jo taqdeer mein likha ho.
Ismen zaahiri aamaal ke dhokhe mein aane se mana kiya gaya hai. Kyonki aamaal ka daaromdaar (nirbharta) ant par hota hai.
