66514: Jisne hamaare is dharm mein koi aisi cheez paida ki, jo dharm ka bhaag nahin hai, to woh amaany evn asveekrit hai

Mominon ki maata, umm-e-abdullah aaisha radiyallahu anha kahti hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Jisne hamaare is dharm mein koi aisi cheez paida ki, jo dharm ka bhaag nahin hai, to woh amaany evn asveekrit hai." Tatha Muslim ki ek riwayat mein hai : “Jisne koi aisa kaary kiya, jiske baare mein hamaara aadesh nahin hai, to woh grahanyogy nahin hai.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jisne deen ke andar koi nai cheez banaai ya aisa koi kaam kiya, jo Qur'an evn hadees se pramaanit na ho, to use usi ke munh par maar diya jayega aur woh Allah ke yahaan qabool nahin kiya jayega.

Ibaadton ka aadhaar Qur'an evn hadees hai. Atah ham Allah ki ibaadat Qur'an evn hadees ke bataye hue tareeqe ke mutaabiq hi karenge. Bidaaton aur ibaadat ke nit-nae roopon se har haal mein door rahenge.
Deen ka aadhaar mat evn achchha lagna nahin hai. Iska aadhaar Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka anusran hai.
Yeh hadees deen ke sanpoorn hone ki daleel hai.
Bidaat har us aastha, kathan ya amal ko kahte hain, jise deen ke ek ang ke roop mein banaya gaya ho aur woh Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aur aapke sahaaba ke zamaane mein maujood na raha ho.
Yeh hadees Islam ka ek mahatvapoorn siddhaant prastut karti hai. Yeh daraasal karmon ki kasauti ki haisiyat rakhti hai. Jis tarah jab kisi amal ka uddeshy Allah ki prasannata ki praapti na ho, to karne waale ko uska koi sawaab nahin milta, usi tarah jo amal Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ki shikshaaon ke anusaar na kiya jaye, use karne waale ke munh par maar diya jaata hai.
Yeh hadees deen ke naam par saamne aane waali nit-nai tatha ghalat cheezon ka khandan karne ke sanbandh ek siddhaant ki haisiyat rakhti hai.
Mana kewal un nai cheezon se kiya gaya hai, jinka sanbandh deen se ho, unse nahin, jinka sanbandh duniya se ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66515: Nissandeh, halaal spasht hai aur haraam bhi spasht hai

Abu abdullah nomaan bin basheer radiyallahu anhuma kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ko kahte hue suna hai : "Nissandeh, halaal spasht hai aur haraam bhi spasht hai tatha donon ke beech kuchh cheezen aspasht hain, jinhen bahut se log nahin jaante. Atah, jo aspasht cheezon se bacha, usne apne dharm aur pratishtha ki raksha kar li tatha jo aspasht cheezon mein par gaya, woh haraam mein par gaya. Jaise ek charvaaha surakshit charaagaah (pashuon ke charne ka sthaan) ke aas-paas jaanvar charaye, to sanbhaavna rahti hai ki jaanvar uske andar chale jayen. Sun lo, har baadshaah ki surakshit charaagaah hoti hai. Sun lo, Allah ki surakshit charaagaah uski haraam ki hui cheezen hain. Sun lo, shareer ke andar maans ka ek tukra hai, jab woh sahi rahega, to poora shareer sahi rahega aur jab woh bigrega to poora shareer bigrega. Sun lo, maans ka woh tukra, dil hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam cheezon ke baare mein ek saadhaaran siddhaant bata rahe hain. Siddhaant yeh hai ki cheezon ke teen prakaar hain. Spasht halaal cheezen, spasht haraam cheezen aur aisi cheezen jinka halaal ya haraam hona spasht na ho tatha wo halaal hain ya haraam is baat ko bahut-se log jaante na hon.

Aise mein, jisne aspasht cheezon ko chhor diya, to haraam cheezon mein parne se bachne ke kaaran uska deen surakshit rahega aur aspasht cheez mein lipt hone ki wajah se uspar jo logon ki ungliyaan uth sakti theen, usse uska sammaan bhi surakshit rahega. Iske wipreet jo aspasht cheezon se door nahin raha, usne khud ko ya to haraam mein parne ke liye ya logon ke laanchhan ka saamna karne ke liye aage kar diya. Iske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne aspasht cheezon mein parne waale ka ek udaahran diya. Farmaya ki aspasht cheezon mein parne waala us charvaahe ki tarah hai, jo apne jaanvar kisi surakshit charaagaah ke paas chara raha ho. Yahaan is baat ki sanbhaavna bani rahti hai ki uske jaanvar nikat hi mein sthit surakshit charaagaah mein jaakar charne lagen. Bilkul yahi haal sandeh waale kaam karne waale ka hai. Kyonki isse woh haraam kaam ke nikat pahunch jaata hai aur is baat ki sanbhaavna ban jaati hai ki woh haraam mein par jaye. Phir ant mein yeh bataya hai ki insaan ke shareer mein maans ka ek tukra hai. Jab woh sahi rahta hai, to poora shareer sahi rahta hai aur jab woh bigar jaata hai, to poora shareer bigar jaata hai. Maans ka woh tukra dil hai.

Yeh hadees sandehaaspad cheejon se bachne ke silsile mein ek siddhaant ki haisiyat rakhti hai.
Aspasht cheez, jiska halaal ya haraam hona spasht na ho, chhor dene ki prerna.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66516: Abu ruqaiya tameem bin aus daari radiyallahu anhu se warnit hai ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya hai : "Dharm, shubhchintan ka naam hai." Hamne kaha : Kiska? To farmaya : "Allah, uski kitaab, uske Rasool, musalmaanon ke maargadarshakon aur aam logon ka."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki deen ka aadhaar nishtha aur saty par hai. Har kaam bilkul usi tarah hona chahiye, jis tarah Allah ne waajib kiya hai. Koi kotaahi ya dhokha nahin hona chahiye. Chunaanche Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam se poochha gaya ki yeh nishta evn sachchaai kiske prati honi chahiye, to aapne kaha : 1- uchch evn mahaan Allah ke prati. Iska arth yeh hai ki kewal usi ki ibaadat ki jaye, kisi ko uska saajhi na banaya jaye, uske paalanhaar tatha poojy hone tatha uske naamon evn gunon par wishvaas rakha jaye, uske aadesh ka sammaan kiya jaye aur uspar eemaan laane ka aahvaan kiya jaye. 2- Allah ki kitaab pawitr Qur'an ke prati : Iska matlab yeh hai ki Qur'an ko Allah ki waani maana jaye, use Allah ki antim tatha pichhli tamaam shareeyton ko nirast karne waali kitaab maana jaye, use uchit sammaan diya jaye, uski tilaawat ki jaye, uski sudrirh ayton par amal kiya jaye, uski aspasht ayton ko sveekaar kiya jaye, uski ayton ka ghalat arth bataane waalon ki ghalat-bayaaniyon ko saamne laya jaye, uske updeshon se shiksha grahan ki jaye, usmen nihit jnaan-wijnaan ka prachaar-prasaar kiya jaye aur uska aahvaan kiya jaye. 3- Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke prati : Iska arth yeh hai ki aapke antim Rasool hone par wishvaas rakha jaye, aapki di hui shikshaaon ki pushti ki jaye, aapke aadeshon ka paalan kiya jaye, aapki mana ki hui cheezon se door raha jaye, aapke bataye hue tareeqe hi ke anusaar Allah ki ibaadat ki jaye, aapke adhikaar ko mahatv diya jaye, aapko sammaan diya jaye, aapke aahvaan ka prachaar-prasaar kiya jaye, aapki laai hui shareeyat ko phailaya jaye aur aappar lagaye jaane waale aaropon ka khandan kiya jaye. 4- Muslim shaaskon ke prati : Iska arth yeh hai ki sahi kaam par unka sahyog kiya jaye, shaaskeey maamlaat mein unse  wiwaad na kiya jaye aur Allah ki aajnaakaarita mein unki baat suni jaye aur unka paalan kiya jaye. 5- aam musalmaanon ke prati : Iska arth yeh hai ki unke saath achchha vyavhaar kiya jaye, unko achchhe kaamon ki or bulaya jaye, unko kasht dene se bacha jaye, unka bhala ho is baat se prem rakha jaye aur neki tatha dharm ke kaamon mein unka sahyog kiya jaye.

Sabhi ke liye shubhchintan ka aadesh.
Deen mein shubhchintan ka mahatv.
Deen ka aasthaaon, kathnon aur karmon par aadhaarit hona.
Shubhchintan ke andar nafs (man) ko apne bhaai ke saath dhokhe se paak karna aur uska bhala chaahna bhi shaamil hai.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke shiksha dene ki uttam paddhati ki pahle kisi cheez ko sankshipt roop mein bayaan karte hain aur uske baad uski vyaakhya karte hain.
Baat mahatv ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue kramvaar karni chahiye. Ham yahaan dekhte hain ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam pahle Allah ke shubhchintan ki baat karte hain, phir Allah ke Rasool, phir Muslim shaaskon aur phir aam musalmaanon ke shubhchintan ki.
66517: “Main tumhen jis cheez se rokoon, usse bacho aur jis cheez ka aadesh doon, use jahaan tak ho sake karo

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ko kahte hue suna hai : “Main tumhen jis cheez se rokoon, usse bacho aur jis cheez ka aadesh doon, use jahaan tak ho sake karo, kyonki tumse pahle ke logon ko unke adhik prashn poochhne ki prawritti aur nabiyon se ashamti ne halaak kiya hai.”

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne hamen bataya hai ki jab aap hamen kisi cheez se mana karen, to hamen bina kisi apvaad ke usse bachna hoga aur jab kisi cheez ka aadesh den, to use yathaasanbhav karna hoga. Phir aapne hamen sachet kiya ki ham pichhli kuchh ummaton ki tarah na ban jayen, jinhonne apne nabiyon se bahut adhik prashn poochhe aur unke aadeshon ka ullanghan kiya, to Allah ne unhen wibhinn prakaar ki tabaahi aur winaash se dandit kiya. Agar ham unki tarah hue to hamen bhi unki tarah halaakat evn winaash ka saamna karna parega.

Yeh hadees aadeshon ka paalan karne evn nishiddh cheezon se bachne ke kartavy ko spasht karne ke wishay mein ek siddhaant ki haisiyat rakhti hai.
Yahaan mana kiye hue kaaryon mein se kisi bhi kaary ko karne ki anumti nahin di gai hai, jabki aadeshon ka paalan karne ke saath saamarthy hone ki baat kahi gai hai. Aisa isliye ki chhorna insaan ke wash mein hota hai, jabki karne ke liye aadeshit kaary ko karne ka saamarthy hone ki zaroorat hoti hai.
Is hadees mein bahut zyaada sawaal karne se mana kiya gaya hai. Daraasal ulema ne prashn ke do prakaar bataye hain : Pahle prakaar mein deen ke zaroori masayal se jure hue aise prashn aate hain, jinka uddesh seekhna ho, is prakaar ka prashn karne ka aadesh diya gaya hai, aur sahaaba ke prashn isi prakaar ke hua karte the. Doosre prakaar mein aise prashn aate hain, jo baal ki khaal nikaalne ke liye kiye jaate hain. Is prakaar ka sawaal karna mana hai.
Is ummat ko saavdhaan kiya gaya hai ki woh pichhli ummaton ki tarah apne Nabi ki mukhaalfat na kare.
Mana kiye hue kaary ke dayre mein kam aur zyaada donon aate hain. Kyonki donon se bache bina bachna nahin kahlayega. Maslan aapne sood se mana kiya, to usmen sood ki kam tatha zyaada donon maatra shaamil hogi.
Haraam ki or le jaane waali cheezon se bachna bhi zaroori hai. Kyonki bachne ke arth mein yeh bhi shaamil hai.
Jab koi vyakti Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ka aadesh sune, to fauran uska paalan kare. Yeh na poochhe ki aadeshit kaary waajbi hai ya musathab? Kyonki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke shabd hain : "Use jahaan tak ho sake, karo."
Adhik prashn karna winaash ka kaaran banta hai, wisheshkar aisi baaton ke baare mein jinka jaan paana sanbhav na ho, jaise paroksh se sanbandhit baaten aur qayaamat ke din ke haalaat. Inke baare mein adhik sawaal na karo, warna winasht ho jaaoge aur tumhaara shumaar atishyokti karne waalon mein hoga.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66518: “Nissandeh, Allah pawitr hai aur kewal pawitr cheezon ko hi sveekaar karta hai. Allah ne eemaan waalon ko wahi aadesh diya hai, jo usne rasoolon ko diya tha.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Nishchay Allah pawitr hai aur kewal pawitr cheezon ko hi grahan karta hai. Usne eemaan waalon ko wahi aadesh diya hai, jo rasoolon ko diya hai. Usne (rasoolon se) kaha hai : (Ai rasoolo! Svachchh cheezen khaao aur achchhe kaary karo.) [soora al-mominoon : 51] tatha (eemaan waalon se) kahaah (ai eemaan waalo! Un svachchh cheezon mein se khaao, jo hamne tumhen pradaan ki hain.) [soora al-baqraah 172] phir Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne ek vyakti ka zikr kiya, jo lanbi yaatra mein hai, uske baal bikhre hue hain aur shareer dhool se ata hua hai. Woh aakaash ki or apne donon haathon ko phailaakar kahta hai : Ai mere rab! Ai mere rab! Lekin uska khaana haraam, uska peena haraam, uska wastr haraam aur uski paravrish haraam se hui hai. Aise mein bhala uski dua kaisi qabool ho sakti hai?"

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki Allah paak evn puneet hai, kamiyon evn doshon se mukt tatha har etbaar se paripoorn hai. Woh kewal unheen kaaryon, shabdon aur wishvaason ko sveekaar karta hai jo shuddh hon aur jo kewal Allah ki prasannata ke liye aur uske paiganbar ke tareeqe ke anusaar kiye gae hon. Allah ki nikatta kewal isi prakaar ki ibaadton ke dvaara praapt kiya jaana chahiye. Yaad rakhen ki apne karmon ko shuddh karne ka sabse mahatvapoorn saadhan halaal bhojan khaana hai. Halaal bhojan khaane se vyakti ke karm shuddh hote hain. Iseeliye jis prakaar Allah ne rasoolon ko halaal bhojan khaane aur achchhe karm karne ka aadesh diya, usi prakaar usne eemaan waalon ko bhi iska aadesh diya hai. Uska kathan hai : (Ai rasoolo! Halaal cheezen khaao aur nek amal karo. Nihsandeh main woh sab jaanta hoon jo tum karte ho.) [soora mominoon : 51] ek any sthaan mein usne kaha hai : (Ai eemaan waalo! Hamaari di hui halaal cheezen khaao.) [soora baqra : 172]

Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne haraam bhojan karne se saavdhaan kiya. Kyonki haraam bhojan karm ko nasht kar deta hai aur use Allah ke yahaan qabool hone nahin deta. Chaahe qabool hone ke zaahiri sabab jitne bhi paye jayen. Maslan :

1- kisi nek kaam, jaise Hajj, jihaad aur rishte ka haq ada karne aadi ke liye lanba safar karna.

2- insaan ka pareshaan haal hona. Jaise uske baal bikhre hue hon aur dhool mitti lagne ke kaaran uske shareer aur kapre ka rang badla hua ho. Yeh sab kuchh is baat ka pramaan hai ki aadmi bahut pareshaan hai.

3- dua ke liye aakaash ki or haath uthaana.

4- Allah ke naamon ko waseela banaana aur girgiraakar dua karna. Masnal ai mere rab ! Ai mere rab! Kahna.

Dua qabool hone ke in kaarnon ke paye jaane ke baavjood uski dua qabool nahin hoti. Kyonki uska khaana haraam ka, uska peena haraam ka, uska wastr haraam ka hai aur uska paalan-poshan haraam bhojan se hua hai. Aise mein uski dua qabool ho bhi to ho kaise?

Sarvashaktimaan Allah apni zaat, gunon, kaaryon aur aadeshon mein paripoorn hai.
Kewal Allah ki prasannata ki praapti ke liye tatha uske Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam dvaara bataye gae tareeqe ke anusaar kaary karne ka aadesh.
Aisi shaili apnaana jo amal ke liye utsaah aur prerna paida kare. Iska pramaan Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ka yeh kathan hai : "Allah ne eemaan waalon ko usi baat ka aadesh diya hai, jiska aadesh rasoolon ko diya hai." Kyonki jab eemaan waale ko yeh ehsaas hoga ki jo kaam woh karne ja raha hai, uska aadesh rasoolon ko bhi diya gaya tha, to uske man mein rasoolon ke padchinhon par chalte hue yeh kaam karne ki parbal ichchha paida hogi.
Dua ki sveekriti mein baadha daalne waali cheejon mein se ek hai haraam bhojan khaana.
Is hadees mein paanch cheezon ka zikr hai, jo dua ke qabool hone ka kaaran banti hain : 1- lanbi yaatra. Kyonki isse winamrata paida hoti hai, jo dua sveekaar hone ka ek pramukh kaaran hai. 2- pareshaani ki haalat. 3- haathon ko aasmaan ki or uthaana. 4. Baar-baar Allah ki rububeeyat (uske srashta, svaami aur prabandhak hone) ka hawaala dete hue aagrah ke saath dua karna. Dua ke qabool hone ka yeh bhi ek bara kaaran hai. 5- halaal cheezen khaana aur peena.
Halaal bhojan khaane se nek kaamon mein madad milti hai.
Qaazi kahte hain : Arbi shabd 'taiyib' isi bhaasha ke ek aur shabd 'khabees' ke wipreet hai. Jab shabd 'taiyib' Allah ki wisheshta ke roop mein aata hai, to iska arth yeh hai ki Allah sabhi kamiyon se paak hai aur sabhi buraaiyon se svachchh hai. Jab yeh kisi vyakti ke gun ke roop mein aata hai, to iska matlab yeh hai ki woh bure aachran aur bure karmon se door hai tatha achchhe aachran aur karmon se yukt hai. Jab yeh dhan ke wisheshan ke roop mein aye, to iska arth yeh hota hai ki dhan waidh aur utkrisht hai.
66519: “Sandeh mein daalne waali cheezon ko chhorkar sandeh mein na daalne waali cheezon ko apnaao.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke nawaase aur priy hasan bin ali bin abu taalib -radiyallahu anhuma- kahte hain ki mainne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se yeh baat yaad ki hai : “Sandeh mein daalne waali cheezon ko chhorkar sandeh mein na daalne waali cheezon ko apnaao."

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne aisi baaten kahne aur aise kaary karne se door rahne ka aadesh diya hai, jinke baare mein sandeh ho ki wo nishiddh hain ya nahin? Halaal hain ya haraam? Insaan ko aisi baaten aur aise  kaary karne chahiye, jinke achchhe aur halaal hone ka wishvaas ho.

Musalmaan par laazim hai ki apne tamaam maamlaat ki buniyaad yaqeen par rakhe aur soojh-boojh evn aaghi ke saath deen par amal kare.
Sandigdh cheezon mein parne ki manaahi.
Agar aap itmeenaan aur sukoon chaahte hain, to sandigdh cheezon se bachen.
Allah sarvashaktimaan apne bandon ke prati dayaalu aur kripaalu hai, kyonki usne unhen aise kaam karne ka aadesh diya hai jo man aur dil ko shaanti pradaan karte hain aur unhen aise kaam karne se mana kiya hai jo bechaini aur bhram ka kaaran bante hain.
[ise tirmizi evn nasai ne riwayat kiya hai]
66520: ''Tummen se koi vyakti us samay tak momin nahin ho sakta, jab tak ki apne bhaai ke liye wahi pasand na kare, jo apne liye pasand karta hai.''

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke sewak abu hamza anas bin maalik -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : ''Tummen se koi vyakti us samay tak momin nahin ho sakta, jab tak ki apne bhaai ke liye wahi pasand na kare, jo apne liye pasand karta hai.''

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki kisi vyakti ko sanpoorn eemaan ki daulat us samay tak naseeb nahin ho sakti, jab tak apne bhaai ke liye deen evn duniya ki wahi cheezen pasand na kare, jo apne liye pasand karta ho aur uske liye unheen cheezon ko naapsand na kare, jinhen apne liye naapsand karta ho. Agar apne bhaai ke andar deen ki koi kami dekhe, to use door karne ka prayaas kare aur koi achchhaai dekhe, to use aur barhaawa de aur usmen madad kare. Deen evn duniya se sanbandhit sabhi baaton mein uska shubhchintan kare.

Insaan par aniwaary hai ki apne bhaai ke liye wahi pasand kare, jo apne liye pasand karta ho. Kyonki jo  vyakit apne bhaai ke liye wahi pasand na karta ho jo apne liye pasand karta ho, usse eemaan ka inkaar karna, is baat ke aniwaary hone ki pushti karta hai.
Deeni bhaaichaara nasbi (rakt-sanbandhi) bhaaichaare se oopar hai, isliye iska adhikaar bhi adhik aniwaary hai.
Aise sabhi kathan evn kaary, jaise dhokha, gheebat, hasad aur musalmaanon ki jaan, maal ya izzat-aabru par aakraman aadi haraam hain, jo is bhaai-chaare ke wipreet hon.
Kisi kaary par ubhaarne waale shabdon ka prayog. Kyonki aapne "Apne bhaai ke liye" Shabd ka prayog kiya hai.
Kirmaani kahte hain : Eemaan ka taqaaza yeh bhi hai ki insaan apne bhaai ke liye wahi naapsand kare, jo apne liye naapsand karta ho. Lekin iska zikr aapne nahin kiya. Kyonki kisi cheez se muhabbat se uske wipreet se nafrat laazim aati hai. Isliye ise alag se bataane ki zaroorat nahin pari.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66521: “Allah ne har cheez mein achchhe bartaav ko aniwaary kiya hai.

Abu yaala shaddaad bin aus -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : “Allah ne har cheez mein achchhe bartaav ko aniwaary kiya hai. Atah, jab qatl karo, to achchhe andaaz mein qatl karo aur jab zabah karo, to achchhe andaaz mein zabah karo. Tum apni chhuri ko tez kar lo aur apne zabeehe ko aaraam pahunchaao."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki Allah ham par har kaam mein ehsaan ko farz kiya hai. Ehsaan ka arth hai, apne har kaary mein sadaiv Allah ka dhyaan rakhna. Allah ki ibaadat (upaasna) mein, bhala kaam karte samay, aur logon ko kasht se bachaate samay bhi. Wadh aur zabah karte samay ehsaan bhi isi ke sandarbh mein aata hai.

Atah qisaas (pratishodh) ke taur par wadh karte samay ehsaan yeh hai ki wadh karne ka sabse aasaan, halka aur jaldi jaan lene waala tareeqa apnaya jaye.

Jabki zabah karte samay ehsaan yeh hai ki jaanvar par raham karte hue hathiyaar ko tez kar liya jaye, jaanvar ki nazron ke saamne hathiyaar ko tez na kiya jaye aur doosre jaanavron ke saamne is tarah zabah na kiya jaye ki woh dekh rahe hon.

Srishti par sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ki daya tatha kripa.
Wadh aur zabah mein ehsaan yeh hai ki donon kaam sharai tareeqe se kiye jayen.
Shareeyat ki sanpoornata aur apne andar har bhalaai ko samete rakhna. Yahi kaaran hai ki woh jaanavron ke saath bhi daya karne ka aadesh deta hai.
Insaan ka wadh karne ke baad uske shareer ke angon ko kaatna mana hai.
Har woh kaam haraam hai, jo jaanvar ki yaatna ka kaaran bane.
66522: “Ai bachche! Main tumhen kuchh baaten bataata hoon (inhen yaad rakhna) : Allah (ke aadeshon aur nishedhon) ki raksha karo, Allah tumhaari raksha karega. Allah (ke aadeshon aur nishedhon) ki raksha karo, tum use apne saamne paaoge. Jab maango, to Allah se maango aur jab madad chaaho, to Allah se madad chaaho.

Abu abbaas abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Ek din main Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke peechhe sawaari par baitha hua tha ki aapne farmaya : “Ai bachche! Main tumhen kuchh baaten bataata hoon (inhen yaad rakhna) : Allah (ke aadeshon aur nishedhon) ki raksha karo, Allah tumhaari raksha karega. Allah (ke aadeshon aur nishedhon) ki raksha karo, tum use apne saamne paaoge. Jab maango, to Allah se maango aur jab madad chaaho, to Allah se madad chaaho. Tatha jaan lo, yadi sabhi log tumhen kuchh laabh pahunchaane ke liye ekatr ho jayen, to bhi tumhen usse adhik laabh nahin pahuncha sakte, jitna Allah ne tumhaare liye likh rakha hai. Tatha yadi sab log tumhen haani pahunchaane ke liye ekatr ho jayen, to bhi tumhaari usse adhik haani nahin kar sakte, jitni Allah ne tumhaare bhaagy mein likh rakhi hai. Kalam utha li gai hai aur pustaken sookh chuki hain." Tatha tirmizi ki riwayat ke alaawa ek any riwayat mein hai : "Allah (ke aadeshon aur nishedhon) ki raksha karo, Allah ko apne saamne paaoge. Khushhaali ke samay Allah ko pahchaano, pareshaani ke samay woh tumhen pahchaanega. Jaan lo, jo tumhen praapt nahin hua, woh tumhen milne waala nahin tha aur jo mil gaya woh tumhaare haath se jaane waala nahin tha. Jaan lo, madad sabr ke saath hai, kushaadgi takleef ke saath hai aur tangi ke saath aasaani hai."

Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma bata rahe hain ki woh chhote the aur ek din Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke peechhe sawaari par baithe hue the ki aapne kaha : Main tumhen kuchh baaten sikhaaoonga, jinse Allah tumhen fayda pahunchayega : Allah ke aadeshon ki raksha karke aur uski mana ki hui cheezon se door rahkar is tarah Allah ki raksha karo ki woh tumko neki aur Allah se nikat karne waale kaamon mein paye, awajnaakaariyon aur gunaahon mein na paye. Agar tum aisa karoge, to badle mein Allah duniya evn aakhirat ki apriy cheezon se tumhaari raksha karega aur tum jahaan bhi jaaoge, har kaam mein tumhaari madad karega. Jab kuchh maangna ho, to kewal Allah se maango. Kyonki wahi maangne waalon ki muraaden poori karta hai. Jab madad maangna ho, to kewal Allah se maango. Tumhaare dil mein is baat ka wishvaas hona chahiye ki agar dharti ke oopar maujood saare log tumhaara bhala karna chaahen, to utna hi kar sakte hain, jitna Allah ne tumhaare bhaagy mein likh rakha hai aur dharti par basne waale saare log tumhaara bura karna chaahen, to usse zyaada nahin kar sakte, jitna Allah ne tumhaare bhaagy mein likh rakha hai. In saari baaton ko Allah ne apni hikmat tatha jnaan ke taqaaze ke anusaar likh rakha hai aur Allah ke likhe mein koi badlaav sanbhav nahin hai. Jo Allah ki raksha karta hai, uske aadeshon ka paalan karke aur uski nishiddhataaon se bachkar, to paak evn pawitr Allah uske saamne hota hai, jaanta hai ki woh kis sthiti mein hai, tatha uski sahayta aur samarthan karta hai. Yadi manushy sukh ke samay mein Allah ki aajna ka paalan karta hai, to Allah kathinaai ke samay mein uske liye raahat aur nikaas ka maarg banaata hai. Atah har bande ko Allah dvaara nirdhaarit bhalaai aur buraai par santusht rahna chahiye. Kathinaaiyon evn pareekshaaon ke samay mein bande ko dhairy rakhna chahiye, kyonki dhairy hi raahat ki kunji hai, jab kathinaai barhti hai, to Allah ki or se saralta aati hai, aur jab pareshaani aati hai, to Allah uske baad aasaani laata hai.

Chhote bachchon ko tauheed tatha aadaab evn is prakaar ki deen ki any baaten sikhaane ka mahatv.
Allah bande ko pratiphal usi koti ka deta hai, jis koti ka uska amal rahta hai.
Kewal Allah par bharosa karne ka aadesh, kyonki wahi kaam banaane waala hai.
Allah ke nirnay tatha taqdeer par eemaan aur usse raazi rahna tatha is baat ka ullekh ki Allah ne saari cheezon ka nirnay pahle se le rakha hai.
Jo Allah ke aadeshon ko nasht karega, Allah use nasht kar dega aur uski raksha nahin karega.
Ek bara susmaachaar yeh ki jab insaan kathinaai mein para hua ho, to use aasaani ki prateeksha karni chahiye.
Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke shabdon : "Jaan lo, jo tumhen praapt nahin hua, woh tumhen milne waala nahin tha aur jo mil gaya woh tumhaare haath se jaane waala nahin tha." Mein aise vyakti ke liye saantvana hai, jispar koi museebaat aai hui ho ya jiske haath se koi priy wastu nikal gai ho. Yahaan pahla waaky kisi apriy ghatna ke ghatit hone par saantvana hai aur doosra waaky kisi priy wastu ke kho jaane par.
[is hadees ko tirmizi aadi ne riwayat kiya hai]
66523: Poorv ke nabiyon ki waaniyon mein se jo baaten logon ko praapt hueen, unmen se ek yeh hai ki jab tere andar sharm wa haya na rahe, to jo chaahe, kar.

Abu masaood ansaari badri -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Poorv ke nabiyon ki waaniyon mein se jo baaten logon ko praapt hueen, unmen se ek yeh hai ki jab tere andar sharm wa haya na rahe, to jo chaahe, kar."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki pichhle nabiyon ki ki hui jo waseeyten logon mein prachlit rahi hain aur nasl dar nasl hastaantrit hoti hui is ummat ki pahli nasl tak pahunchi hain, unmen se ek yeh hai ki jo kaam tum karna chaahte ho, use pahle dekh lo, kaam agar aisa ho ki use karne mein haya na ki jaati hai, to kar daalo. Lekin kaam agar aisa ho ki use karte hue haya ki jaati hai, to chhor do. Kyonki bure kaamon se rokne waali cheez haya hi hai. Jiske andar haya na ho, woh har ashleel aur ghalat kaam mein sanlipt ho jayega.

Haya achchhe aachran ki buniyaad hai.
Haya nabiyon ki wisheshta hai aur unheen se hastaantrit hokar aai hai.
Haya ek aisi cheez hai, jo ek musalmaan ko uske vyaktitv ko sundar banaane waale kaaryon par aamaada karti aur use kuroop banaane waali cheezon se door karti hai.
Navvi kahte hain : Yahaan jo aadesh aya hai, woh waidhta ka dyotak hai. Yaani jab tum koi kaam karne ka iraada karo, to kaam agar aisa ho ki use karte samay Allah aur logon se haya na aati ho, to kar daalo. Lekin agar haya aati ho, to mat karo. Isi par Islam ka daaromdaar hai. Is tarah samjhen ki jin waajib aur musathab kaamon ka aadesh aya ho, unhen chhorne mein haya ki jaati hai aur jin haraam aur makrooh cheezon se mana kiya gaya ho, unhen karne mein haya ki jaati hai. Jabki jayaz kaam ko karne mein haya karna bhi jayaz hai chhorne mein haya karna bhi jayaz hai. Is tarah is hadees ke dayre mein paanchon sharai praavdhaan a gae. Jabki kuchh log kahte hain ki is hadees mein diya gaya aadesh dhamki bhara hai aur iska arth yeh hai ki jab haya ki daulat tumse chheen li jaye to jo bhi tumhaare man mein aye, karo; Allah tumhen iski saza jaroor dega. Kuchh log yeh bhi kahte hain ki yahaan aadesh ka matlab soochna dena hai, arthaat jise haya na roke, woh jo chaahe, karta phirta hai.
66524: Mujhse Islam ke baare mein ek aisi baat kahen, jiske baare mein mujhe kisi aur se poochhne ki zaroorat na pare. Aapne farmaya : "Tum kaho ki main Allah par eemaan laya aur phir ispar mazbooti se qayam raho.

Abu amr tatha kuchh logon ke anusaar abu amra sufyaan bin abdullah -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain : Mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mujhse Islam ke baare mein ek aisi baat kahen, jiske baare mein mujhe kisi aur se poochhne ki zaroorat na pare. Aapne farmaya : "Tum kaho ki main Allah par eemaan laya aur phir ispar mazbooti se qayam raho."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke ek saathi sufyaan bin abdullah ne aapse aagrah kiya ki aap unko ek aisi baat sikha den, jiske andar poore Islam ka nichor a jaye, taaki woh use mazbooti se pakar len aur uske baare mein kisi doosre se poochhne ki zaroorat na pare. Chunaanche aapne unse kaha : Tum bas itna kah do ki mainne Allah ko ek maana aur uske rab, poojy, srishtikarta aur akela ibaadat ke layaq hone par eemaan laya. Phir uske baad Allah ke bataye hue raaste par chalte hue jeewan vyateet karo, Allah ke dvaara aniwaary kaaryon ka paalan karo aur uski haraam ki hui cheezon se bacho.

Asal deen Allah ke rab evn poojy hone tatha uske naamon evn gunon par eemaan rakhna hai.
Eemaan ke baad Allah ke deen par qayam rahne aur nirantarta ke saath ibaadat karne ka mahatv.
Amal ke qabool hone ke liye eemaan shart hai.
Allah par eemaan ke andar eemaan se juri hui woh buniyaadi baaten, jinpar wishvaas rakhna zaroori hai aur unke antargat aane waale hriday ke aamaal tatha zaahiri evn baatini taur par samarpan aur anusran sab shaamil hain.
Hadees mein aye hue shabd "الاستقامةُ" Ka arth hai, aniwaary cheezon ka paalan karte hue aur mana ki hui cheezon se bachte hue seedhe raaste par chalte rahna.
66525: Aapka kya khayaal hai ki agar main farz namaazen parhoon, Ramzan ke roze rakhoon aur halaal ko halaal jaanoon

Abu abdullah jaabir bin abdullah ansaari -radiyallahu anhuma- se riwayat hai ki ek vyakti ne Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- se poochha : Aapka kya khayaal hai ki agar main farz namaazen parhoon, Ramzan ke roze rakhoon aur halaal ko halaal jaanoon tatha haraam se bachoon aur isse adhik kuchh na karoon, to kya main Jannat mein prawesh kar sakoonga? Aapne uttar diya : “Haan!”

Is hadees mein Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki jisne paanch waqt ki farz namaazen parheen tatha nafal namaazen nahin parheen, Ramzan ke roze rakhe aur nafal roze nahin rakhe, halaal ko halaal maana aur uspar amal kiya tatha haraam ko haraam maana aur usse door raha, woh Jannat mein prawesh karega.

Ek musalmaan ko farz kaamon ko karna aur haraam kaamon se door rahna chahiye aur uska uddeshy Jannat mein prawesh karna hona chahiye.
Is hadees se halaal kaamon ko karne aur unke halaal hone ka wishvaas rakhne tatha haraam kaamon se door rahne aur unke haraam hone ka wishvaas rakhne ka mahatv maaloom hota hai.
Waajib (aniwaary) kaaryon ko karna aur haraam kaaryon se bachna Jannat mein prawesh praapt karne ka sabab hai.
66526: “Tahaarat (pawitrata) aadha eemaan hai. ‘al-hamdu lillah’ taraazu ko bhar dega. ‘subhaan Allah’ aur ‘al-hamdu lillah’ aakaash aur dharti ke beech ke khaali sthaanon ko bhar denge

Abu maalik ashaari -radiyallahu anhu- se riwayat hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : “Tahaarat (pawitrata) aadha eemaan hai. ‘al-hamdu lillah’ taraazu ko bhar dega. ‘subhaan Allah’ aur ‘al-hamdu lillah’ aakaash aur dharti ke beech ke khaali sthaanon ko bhar denge. Namaz prakaash hai. Sadqa pramaan hai. Qur'an tere haq mein athva tere wiruddh pramaan hai. Pratyek vyakti jab subah ko nikalta hai, to apne nafs ka sauda karta hai. Chunaanche ya to use aazaad karta hai ya use halaak karta hai.”

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki zaahiri shareer ki tahaarat (pawitrata) wazu evn ghusl (snaan) ke dvaara praapt hoti hai. Tahaarat namaz ki ek shart hai. Al-hamdu lillah, jo ki Allah ki prashansa karna aur use sanpoornata par aadhaarit gunon se paripoorn maanna hai, ise kahna qayaamat ke din wazan kiya jayega aur yeh karmon ke taraazu ko bhar dega. Subhaanallah tatha al-hamdu lillah, jo ki daraasal Allah ko har kami se pawitr ghoshit karna aur use sanpoornata ke aise gunon se paripoorn maanna hai, jo uske prataap ke anuroop hain, in donon waakyon ko kahna aur saath mein Allah se prem tatha uska sammaan karna, aakaashon evn zameen ke beech ke sthaan ko bhar deta hai. Namaz bande ke liye noor hai, jo uske dil mein maujood rahta hai, uske chehre par prakat hota hai, uski qabr ko raushan rakhta hai aur dobaara jeewit hokar uthte samay uska saath dega. Sadqa bande ke sachche momin hone ka pramaan hai, aur uske munaafiq se alag hone ka pramaan hai, jo sadqa ke pratiphal par wishvaas na hone ke kaaran sadqa nahin karta. Sabr (dhairy) prakaash hai. Sabr, adheer hone aur naaraaz hone se bachne ka naam hai. Noor aise prakaash ko kahte hain, jismen garmi aur jalaane ki wisheshta hoti hai. Jaise sooraj ka prakaash. Sabr ko noor isliye kaha gaya hai ki sabr karna ek kathin kaary hai aur iske liye nafs se larne aur use uski pasand se rokne ki zaroorat hoti hai. Sabr karne waala insaan hamesha sachchaai ke aalokit maarg par chalta rahta hai. Yahaan sabr se muraad uske teenon prakaar yaani Allah ke aajnaapaalan par date rahna, uski awajna se bachte rahna aur museebton tatha duniya ke haadson (durghatnaaon) ka dhairy ke saath muqaabla karna hai. Qur'an ki tilaawat aur usmen likhi hui baaton ka anupaalan tumhaare liye daleel hai. Jabki Qur'an par amal na karna ya uski tilaawat na karna tumhaare wiruddh daleel hai. Phir Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya ki saare log jab neend se jaagte hain, wibhinn kaaryon ke liye apne  gharon nikal parte hain. Aise mein kuchh log Allah ki aajnaaon ka paalan karke khud ko aag se aazaad kar lete hain. Jabki kuchh log isse wichlit ho jaate hain, gunaahon mein par jaate hain aur aag mein prawesh karne ka saamaan karke khud ko winasht kar lete hain.

Tahaarat ke do prakaar hain. Ek zaahiri (pratyaksh) tahaarat, jo wazu evn snaan se praapt hoti hai aur doosra baatini (paroksh) tahaarat, jo tauheed (ekeshvarvaad), eemaan aur achchhe karm se praapt hoti hai.
Namaz ki paabandi karne ka mahatv. Kyonki namaz bande ke liye duniya mein tatha qayaamat ke din prakaash hai.
Sadqa sachche eemaan ka pramaan hai.
Qur'an par amal karne aur use sachchi kitaab maanne ka mahatv. Isse Qur'an insaan ke paksh mein pramaan ban jaata hai. Uske wiruddh nahin.
Nafs (aatma, man) agar Allah ke aajnaapaalan mein na lagaya jaye, woh insaan ko Allah ki awajna mein laga deta hai.
Har insaan koi na koi kaam zaroor karta hai. Kaam chaahe Allah ko raazi karne waala ho, jo use Jahannam se mukti pradaan karta hai ya use naaraaz karne waala, jo uska winaash kar deta hai.
Sabr ke liye sahan shakti tatha aatm moolyaankan ki zaroorat hoti hai, jo ki ek kathin kaary hai.
66527: Aadmi ke har ek jor par, har roz jismen sooraj nikalta hai, sadqa hai.

Abu huraira radiyallahu anhu ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Farmayaah "Aadmi ke har jor par, har roz jismen sooraj nikalta hai, sadqa hai; tum do vyaktiyon ke beech nyay karo sadqa hai, kisi ko uske jaanvar par sawaar hone mein madad karo ya uspar uska saamaan laad do sadqa hai, achchhi baat sadqa hai, namaz ke liye jaate samay uthne waala har qadam sadqa hai aur raaste se kashtadayak wastu ko hataana sadqa hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki shareeyat ka paalan karne par baadhy har musalmaan ko pratyek din uski haddi ke har jor ke badle mein ek ek nafli sadqa is baat ke shukr ke taur par karna hai ki usne use svasth aakaar diya aur uski haddiyon ke jor banaye, jinke kaaran shareer ke angon ko phailaana aur sametna sanbhav ho saka. Yeh sadqa sabhi prakaar ke naki ke kaamon se ada ho sakta hai. Zaroori nahin hai ki dhan hi kharch kiya jaye. Jaise : Do jhagar rahe vyaktiyon ke beech nyay ke saath nirnay karna aur sulah kara dena sadqa hai. Kisi aise vyakti ko, jo sawaari par charh na pa raha ho, sawaari par charha dena ya uska saamaan laad dena sadqa hai. Achchhi baat, jaise zikr, dua aur salaam aadi sadqa hain. Namaz ke liye jaate samay uthne waala har qadam sadqa hai. Raaste se kisi kasht dene waali wastu ko hata dena sadqa hai.

Insaan ki haddiyon ka juraav aur unka svasth hona Allah ki ek bahut bari nemat hai. Isliye is nemat ke shukraane ke taur par har haddi ki or se wishesh sadqa kiya jaana chahiye.
Ye nemten nirantar roop se praapt rahen, iske liye har roz Allah ka shukr ada karne ki prerna.
Nirantar roop se har roz nafal kaary evn sadqe karte rahne ki prerna.
Logon ke beech sulah karaane ki mahatta.
Apne bhaai ki madad karne ki prerna. Kyonki apne bhaai ki madad karna bhi sadqa hai.
Jamaat ke saath namaz parhne, iske liye chalkar jaane aur masjid ko aabaad karne ki prerna.
Musalmaanon ke raaston ka sammaan zaroori hai. Raaston par koi aisa kaam na kiya jaye, jisse unko kasht ho.
[ise Bukhari evn Muslim ne riwayat kiya hai]
66529: Main tumhen Allah se darne tatha (apne shaasankarta ki) baat sunne aur maanne ki waseeyat karta hoon, chaahe tumhaara shaasak ek daas hi kyon na ho. Kyonki tummen se jo jeewit rahega, woh bahut saara matbhed aur takraav dekhega. Us samay tum meri sunnat aur saty ke maarg par chalne waale khaleefaagan ki sunnat ko seene se lagaye rahna

Abu nujaih irbaaz bin saariya -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne hamen aisa dil mein utarne waala updesh diya ki logon ke dil ghabra gae aur aankhen bah pareen. Hamne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Aisa prateet hota hai ki yeh antim updesh hai. Atah, hamen waseeyat farmayen! Aapne kaha : "Main tumhen Allah se darne tatha (apne shaasankarta ki) baat sunne aur maanne ki waseeyat karta hoon, chaahe tumhaara shaasak ek daas hi kyon na ho. Kyonki tummen se jo jeewit rahega, woh bahut saara matbhed aur takraav dekhega. Us samay tum meri sunnat aur saty ke maarg par chalne waale khaleefaagan ki sunnat ko seene se lagaye rahna aur mazbooti se thaame rahna. Tatha dharm ke naam par prachlan mein aane waali nai-nai cheezon (biddaton) se bachte rahna, kyonki har biddat gumraahi hai."

Ek din Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne saathiyon ko sanbodhit kiya. Sanbodhan itna prabhaavshaali tha ki usse logon ke dil dahal gae aur aankhen bah pareen. Yeh dekh aapke saathiyon ne kaha ki ai Allah ke Rasool! Aisa prateet hota hai ki yeh widaai ke samay ka sanbodhan hai. Kyonki unhonne dekha ki Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne sanbodhan ke samay apna dil nikaal kar rakh diya. Atah unhonne aapse kuchh waseeyat karne ko kaha, taaki aapke baad use mazbooti se pakre rahen. Chunaanche aapne kaha : Main tumko sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah se darne ki waseeyat karta hoon. Yahaan yeh yaad rahe ki Allah se darne ka matlab hai, uski aniwaary ki hui cheezon ka paalan karna aur uski haraam ki hui cheezon se door rahna. Isi tarah main tumko shaaskon ke aadesh sunne evn maanne ki waseeyat karta hoon. Chaahe tumhaara shaasak koi habshi gulaam hi kyon na ho. Yaani ek maamooli se maamooli insaan bhi agar tumhaara shaasak ban jaye, to tum usse door mat bhaago balki tum uski baat maano, taaki fitne sar na utha saken. Kyonki tummen se jo log jeewit rahenge, woh bahut saara matbhed dekhenge. Phir Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne saathiyon ko is matbhed se nikalne ka raasta bataya. Woh yeh hai ki aapki sunnat tatha aapke baad shaasan sanbhaalne waale aur saty ke maarg par chalne waale khaleefaagan, abu bakr siddeeq, umar bin khattaab, usmaan bin affaan aur ali bin abu taalib radiyallahu anhum ki sunnat ko mazbooti se pakarkar rakha jaye. Aapne ise daarhon se pakarne ki baat kahi hai. Yaani har haal mein sunnat ka paalan kiya jaye aur use poori taaqat se pakarkar rakha jaye. Uske baad aapne unko deen ke naam par saamne aane waali nai cheezon se saavdhaan kiya. Kyonki deen ke naam par saamne aane waali har nai cheez gumraahi hai.

Sunnat ko mazbooti se pakarne aur uska anusran karne ka mahatv.
Updesh dene aur dilon ko narm karne par dhyaan.
Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke baad shaasan sanbhaalne waale aur saty ke maarg par chalne waale khaleefaagan yaani abu bakr siddeeq, umar faarooq, usmaan bin affaan aur ali bin abu taalib radiyallahu anhum ke anusran ka aadesh.
Deen ke naam par nai cheezen awishkaar karne ki manaahi aur yeh ki deen ke naam par saamne aane waali har nai cheez bidaat hai.
Musalmaanon ka shaasan sanbhaalne waale shaaskon ki baat sunna tatha maanna zaroori hai, jab tak we kisi gunaah ke kaam ka aadesh na den.
Har samay aur har haal mein Allah ka bhay rakhne ka mahatv.
Is ummat mein matbhed saamne aana hai aur jab matbhed saamne aye, to Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam aur saty ke maarg par chalne waale khaleefaagan ki sunnat ki or lautna zaroori hai.
[is hadees ko abu daawood aur tirmizi ne riwayat kiya hai]
66530: Tumne ek bahut bari cheez ke baare mein poochha hai, parantu jiske liye Allah taaala aasaan kar de, uske liye yeh nishchay hi aasaan hai

Muaaz bin jabal -radiyallahu anhu- kahte hain ki mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe koi aisa kaary bataaiye, jo mujhe Jannat mein daakhil kar de aur Jahannam se door kar de. To aapne kaha : "Tumne ek bahut bari cheez ke baare mein poochha hai, parantu jiske liye Allah taaala aasaan kar de, uske liye yeh nishchay hi aasaan hai : Tum Allah ki ibaadat karo, kisi ko uska saajhi na banaao, namaz qayam karo, zakat do, Ramzan ke roze rakho aur Allah ke ghar kaaba ka Hajj karo." Phir farmayaah "Kya main tumhen bhalaai ke dvaar na bata hoon? Roza dhaal hai, sadqa gunaah ki aag ko bujha deta hai, jaise paani aag ko bujha deta hai tatha aadmi ka raat ke andhere mein namaz parhna." Phir yeh ayat parhi (jiska arth hai) : ((Unke pahlu bistaron se alag rahte hain. Woh apne rab ko bhay evn laalach ke saath pukaarte hain aur hamaari di hui cheezon mein se kharch karte rahte hain. Koi praani nahin jaanta ki hamne unke liye kya kuchh aankhon ki thandak chhipa rakhi hai, unke un karmon ke pratiphal ke taur par, jo we kiya karte the.)) phir farmaya : "Kya main tumhen is maamle ka sira, uska stanbh aur uski sabse oonti choti na bata doon?" Mainne kaha : Awashy, ai Allah ke Rasool! To farmaya : "Is maamle ka sira islaam hai, uska stanbh namaz hai aur uski sabse oonchi choti jihaad hai." Phir farmaya : "Kya main tumhen in tamaam wastuon ka saar na bata doon?" Mainne kaha : Awashy, ai Allah ke Rasool! To aapne apni zabaan ko pakarkar kaha : "Ise sanbhaalkar rakho." Mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Nabi, kya ham jo kuchh bolte hain, uspar bhi hamaari pakar hogi? To farmaya : "Tumhaari maan tumhen gum paye, bhala logon ko Jahannam ki aag mein unke chehron ke bal (ya kaha ki unke nathnon ke bal) zabaan ki tezi ke siwa aur kaun-si cheez daalegi?”

Muaaz radiyallahu anhu kahte hain : Main Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ke saath ek yaatra mein tha. Ek din subah ke samay chalte hue main aapke nikat pahunch gaya, to mainne kaha : Ai Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe ek aisa kaary bata deejiye, jo mujhe Jannat mein daakhil kar de aur Jahannam se door kar de. Aap sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne farmaya : Tumne mujhse ek bare kaary ke baare mein poochha hai, jiska paalan karna logon par bara bhaari hai, kintu yeh uspar aasaan hai jiske liye Allah ise aasaan bana de. Islam ke aniwaary kartavyon ka paalan karo :

Pahla kartavy : Kewal Allah ki ibaadat karo aur uske saath kisi ko bhi saajheedaar na banaao.

Doosra kartavy : Din aur raat mein paanch farz namaazen sthaapit karo. Yaani fajr, zuhar, asr, maghrib tatha isha ki namaz parho. In paanch namaazon ko inki sharton, stanbhon aur aniwaary kaaryon ke saath ada karo.

Teesra kartavy : Farz zakat nikaalo. Zakat ek aarthik ibaadat hai, jo shareeyat dvaara dhan ki ek nirdhaarit maatra par waajib hoti hai aur jise uske haqdaaron ko diya jaata hai.

Chautha kartavy  : Ramzan ke roze rakho. Roza naam hai khaane, peene aur is tarah ki any roza torne waali cheezon se fajr prakat hone se lekar sooraj doobne tak Allah ki ibaadat ki neeyat se ruke rahne ka.

Paanchvaan kartavy : Allah ki ibaadat ke liye makka jaakar hajj ke kaary sanpann karo.

Phir Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne farmaya : Kya main tumhen us maarg ke baare mein na bataaoon, jo bhalaai ke dvaaron tak pahunchaata hai? Woh hai, aniwaary kartavyon ke pashchaat nafal ibaadten karna, jo is prakaar hain :

Pahli nafal ibaadat : Nafal roza, jo paapon mein parne se rokta hai, kyonki roza ichchhaaon ko niyantrit karta hai tatha bal ko kamzor karta hai.

Doosri nafal ibaadat : Nafal sadqa, jo paap ko mita deta hai, use samaapt kar deta hai tatha uske prabhaav ko khatm kar deta hai.

Teesri nafal ibaadat : Raat ke antim tihaai bhaag mein raat ki namaz parhna. Uske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne yeh ayat parhi : (Unke pahlu door rahte hain sone ke sthaanon se. Woh apne rab  ko pukaarte hain) namaz, zikr, tilaawat aur dua dvaara (bhay evn aasha ke saath aur jo kuchh hamne unhen de rakha hai, usmen se kharch karte hain. Koi praani nahin jaanta ki hamne kis prakaar ki aankhon ki thandak unke liye chhupa rakhi hai), yaani log yeh nahin jaante ki hamne unke karmon ke badle mein qayaamat ke din aankhon ko thandi karne waali kya-kya cheejen aur Jannat mein kya-kya nemten paida kar rakhi hain  (yeh daraasal badla hai un karmon ka, jo we kiya karte the).

Iske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne poochha : Kya main tumko deen ki buniyaad, uska stanbh aur uska sheersh na bata doon?

Muaaz radiyallahu anhu ne uttar diya : Awashy, ai Allah ke Rasool!

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : Deen ki buniya Islam yaani donon gawaahiyaan hain. Inke maadhyam se insaan ke haath mein deen ka mool aadhaar a jaata hai. Uska mool stanbh namaz hai. Namaz ke bina Islam ka koi astitv nahin hai. Bilkul waise hi, jaise stanbh ke bina kisi ghar ka astitv nahin hota. Jo namaz ka paaband hai, uska deen mazboot tatha buland hai. 
Jabki Islam ka jhanda buland karne ka saadhan jihaad aur Allah ke shabd ko ooncha karne ke liye deen ke dushmanon se larna hai.

Iske baad Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne poochha : Kya main tumko ek aisi cheez na bataaoon, jisse ukt saari cheezen sudrirh aur sashakt ho jaati hain? Aapne apni zabaan pakar li aur farmaya : Ispar niyantran rakho aur anaawashyak baaten na karo. Muaaz radiyallahu anhu ne poochha : Kya hamaara paalanhaar hamaare dvaara kahi gai baaton par bhi hamaari pakar karega, hisaab lega aur saza dega?

Aapne uttar diya : Tumhaari maan tumko gum paye. Yaad rahe ki is waaky se muraad bad-dua nahin hoti. Arab ke log is waaky ka istemaal kisi vyakti ko kisi aisi baat ki soochna dete samay karte, jisse use avgat hona hi chahiye tha. Phir aapne farmaya: Logon ko unke munh ke bal kewal isliye ghaseeta jayega ki we apni zabaan se awishvaas par aadhaarit shabd nikaalte, gaali-galauj, chughli evn doshaaropan karte hain.

Sahaaba jnaan praapt karne ke bare utsuk hua karte the. Yahi kaaran hai ki woh aapse bahut zyaada prashn kiya karte the.
Sahaaba ki deeni samajh. Unko pata tha ki karm Jannat mein prawesh ka saadhan hai.
Muaaz radiyallahu anhu ne jo sawaal kiya tha, woh bahut bara sawaal hai. Kyonki wahi jeewan evn astitv ka rahasy hai. Isliye ki is duniya mein maujood har insaan aur jinn ka thikaana ya to Jannat hai ya phir Jahannam. Isi se is prashn ka mahatv spasht ho jaata hai.
Islam ke paanch stanbhon ka ada karne ka phal Jannat mein prawesh ke roop mein milega. Islam ke paanch stanbh hain : Donon gawaahiyaan, namaz, zakat, roza aur Hajj.
Islam ka mool aadhaar, sabse moolyawaan kaary aur sabse mahatvoorn kartavy yeh hai ki ek Allah ki ibaadat ki jaye aur kisi ko uska saajhi na banaya jaye.
Bandon par Allah ka ek anugrah yeh hai ki usne unke liye nekiyon ke dvaar khol diye, taaki achchhe pratiphal ki praapti aur gunaahon ki kshama ka kaam adhik se adhik kar saken.
Aniwaary kartavyon ka paalan karne ke baad nafal ibaadton dvaara Allah ki nikatta praapt karne ki fazeelat.
Islam mein namaz ka wahi mahatv hai, jo ek tanbu ke liye  khanbhe ka hai. Jis tarah  khanbha hat jaane se tanbu gir jaata hai, usi tarah namaz ghayab ho jaane se Islam rukhsat ho jaata hai.
Deen ko nuqsaan pahunchaane waali tamaam cheezon se zabaan ko surakshit rakhna zaroori hai.
Zabaan par niyantran rakhna har bhalaai ka mool aadhaar hai.
66531: “Na haani sveekaary hai, na kisi ki haani karna uchit hai.”

Abu saeed saad bin maalik bin sinaan al khudri -radiyallahu anhu- se warnit hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wasallam- ne farmaya hai : “Na haani sveekaary hai, na kisi ki haani karna uchit hai.”

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- bata rahe hain ki khud apne wajood aur doosre logon ki kisi bhi prakaar ki haani karne se bachna zaroori hai. Kisi ke liye bhi na to khud apne aapko kasht dena jayaaz hai aur na kisi doosre ko kasht dena jayaz hai. Donon baaten samaan roop se naazayaz hain. Aur uske liye yeh uchit nahin hai ki woh haani ka badla haani se de, kyonki haani ko haani se door nahin kiya ja sakta, siway qisaas (pratishodh) ke roop mein, woh bhi bina kisi atikraman ke.

Samaan se adhik badla lena jayaz nahin hai.
Allah ne bandon ko kisi aisi cheez ka aadesh nahin diya hai, jo unko haani pahunchaye.
Yeh hadees haani karne ke haraam hone ke sanbandh mein ek siddhaant prastut karti hai. Haani kathan dvaara kiya jaye, karm dvaara kiya jaye ya kuchh chhorkar.
Shareeyat ka ek siddhaant hai "Haani door ki jayegi". Shareeyat haani ko sveekaar nahin karti, uska hataane ka kaam karti hai.
[is hadees ko ibne maajah aur daaraaqutni aadi ne musnad riwayat kiya hai]
66532: Agar logon ko unke daawon ke aadhaar par de diya jaye to kuchh log, logon ki jaan aur maal tak ka daawa karne lagen. Lekin, daawa karne waale ko pramaan dena hai aur inkaar karne waale ko qasam khaani hai.

Abdullah bin abbaas radiyallahu anhuma ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne farmaya : "Agar logon ko unke daawon ke aadhaar par de diya jaye to kuchh log, logon ki jaan aur maal tak ka daawa karne lagen. Lekin, daawa karne waale ko pramaan dena hai aur inkaar karne waale ko qasam khaani hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne bataya hai ki agar logon ko pramaanon ki partaal kiye bina kewal unke daawe ke aadhaar par de diya jaane lage, to kuchh log logon ke dhan evn jaan tak ka daawa karne lagen. Isliye muddai ko apne daawe ki daleel prastut karni hogi. Agar uske paas daleel na ho, to daawe ko pratiwaadi ke saamne rakha jayega. Agar usne inkaar kar diya, to use qasam khaani hogi. Uske baad woh bari ho jayega.

Ibn-e-daqeeq al-eed kahte hain : Yeh hadees islaami widhaanon ke ek buniyaadi siddhaant aur matbhed ke samay  ek mahaan sandarbh ki haisiyat rakhti hai.
Islaami shareeyat ka ek buniyaadi uddeshy jaan wa maal ke saath khilvaar ki raah band karna evn jaan wa maal ko suraksha pradaan karna hai.
Qaazi apne jnaan ki roshni mein nahin, balki pramaanon ke aalok mein nirnay dega.
Jo koi bhi bina saboot ke daawa karega, use asveekaar kar diya jayega.. Daawa ka sanbandh chaahe adhikaaron evn maamlaat se ho ya eemaan evn ilm ke masayal se.
[ise baihqi aadi ne riwayat kiya hai, tatha iska kuchh bhaag saheehain (saheeh Bukhari aur saheeh Muslim) mein bhi hai.]
66533: Beshak Allah ne nekiyon aur gunaahon ko likh liya hai. "Phir uska wistaar karte hue farmaya

Abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne apne barkat waale aur mahaanrab se riwayat karte hue farmaya hai : "Beshak Allah ne nekiyon aur gunaahon ko likh liya hai. "Phir uska wistaar karte hue farmaya : "Jisne kisi satkarm ka iraada kiya aur use kar nahin saka, Allah use apne yahaan ek poori neki likh leta hai aur agar iraade ke anusaar use kar liya, to uske badle mein apne paas das se saat sau, balki usse bhi adhik nekiyaan likh deta hai. Aur agar kisi bure kaam ka iraada kiya, lekin use nahin kiya, to Allah use apne yahaan ek poori neki likh deta hai aur agar iraade ke anusaar use kar liya, to use kewal ek gunaah likhta hai."

Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam bata rahe hain ki Allah ne achchhe kaamon aur bure kaamon ka nirdhaaran kiya aur uske baad do farishton ko bataya ki unko kaise likhen :

Jisne koi achchha kaam karne ka iraada kiya aur use kar na saka, tab bhi uske liye ek neki likhi jaati hai. Agar use kar liya, to uske liye das se saat sau, balki usse bhi adhik nekiyaan likhi jaati hain. Neki mein yeh wri्ddhi dil ke andar maujood ekhlaas (nishtha) aur us kaary se doosron ko hone waale laabh aadi ke anusaar hoti hai.

Iske wipreet jisne koi bura kaam karne ka iraada kiya aur phir use Allah ke liye chhor diya, uske liye ek neki likhi jaati hai. Lekin agar use dilchaspi na hone ke kaaran chhora aur uske saadhnon par bhi haath na lagaya, to kuchh nahin likha jaata. Jabki agar saamarthy na hone ki wajah se chhora, to uski neeyat ko uske wiruddh likha jaata hai. Aur agar use kar liya, to uska ek gunaah likha jaata hai.

Is ummat par Allah ka bahut bara anugrah ki woh achchhe kaamon ka badla barhaakar deta aur apne paas likh rakhta hai. Jabki bure kaam ka badla barhaakar nahin likhta.
Insaan ke dvaara kiye gae kaaryon mein neeyat ka mahatv aur uska prabhaav.
Sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ka anugrah tatha upkaar ki woh aise vyakti ke liye, jisne kisi achchhe kaam ka iraada kiya aur use na kiya ho, uske liye ek neki likh deta hai.
[is hadees ko inheen shabdon ke saath Bukhari evn Muslim ne apni saheehain mein warnit kiya hai]
66534: “Allah taaala ka farmaan hai : Jisne mere kisi ‘wali’ se dushmani ki, usse meri or se yuddh ka ailaan hai. Mera banda jin cheezon ke dvaara meri nikatta praapt karta hai, unmen mujhe sabse adhik priy woh cheezen hain, jo mainne uspar farz ki hain

Abu huraira -radiyallahu anhu- bayaan karte hain ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : “Allah taaala ka farmaan hai : Jisne mere kisi ‘wali’ se dushmani ki, usse meri or se yuddh ka ailaan hai. Mera banda jin cheezon ke dvaara meri nikatta praapt karta hai, unmen mujhe sabse adhik priy woh cheezen hain, jo mainne uspar farz ki hain.Aur banda nafal ibaadton ke zariye meri nikatta praapt karta jaata hai, yahaan tak ki main usse prem karne lagta hoon. Phir, jab main usse prem karta hoon, to uska kaan ban jaata hoon, jisse woh sunta hai, uski aankh ban jaata hoon, jisse woh dekhta hai, uska haath ban jaata hoon, jisse woh pakarta hai aur uska paanv ban jaata hoon, jisse woh chalta hai. Aise mein agar woh mujhse maange, to main use zaroor deta hoon aur agar mujhse sharan maange, to main use zaroor sharan deta hoon.”

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne is hadees-e-qudsi mein bataya hai ki sarvashaktimaan evn mahaan Allah ne kaha hai : Jisne mere kisi wali ko kasht diya, naaraaz kiya aur usse dvesh rakha, uske liye meri or se dushmani ka elaan hai. Wali se muraad muttaqi momin hai. Jiske daaman mein eemaan aur taqva ka jitna bhaag hoga, woh Allah ka utna bara wali hoga. Ek musalmaan Allah ki nikatta jin cheezon se praapt karta hai, Allah ke nikat unmen sabse priy cheezen woh hain, jo Allah ne uspar farz ki hain. Ismen neki ke kaam karna aur haraam cheezon se bachna donon daakhil hain. Ek musalmaan Islam ke aniwaary kaaryon ke saath-saath nafal ibaadton dvaara Allah ki nikatta praapt karta jaata hai aur ek samay aisa aata hai jab Allah usse prem karne lagta hai. Jab Allah usse prem karne lagta hai, to uske shareer ke nimnalikhit chaar angon ko sahi disha de deta hai : Uske sunne ki shakti ko sahi disha de deta hai. Atah woh wahi sunta hai, jo Allah ko pasand ho. Uske dekhne ki shakti ko sahi disha de deta hai. Atah woh wahi dekhta hai, jo Allah ko pasand ho. Uske haath ke kaary ko sahi disha de deta hai. Woh apne haath se wahi kaam karta hai, jo Allah ko pasand ho. Uske paanv ke kaary ko sahi disha de deta hai. Woh usi or chalkar jaata hai, jo Allah ko pasand ho aur wahi kaam karta hai, jismen bhalaai ho. Saath hi agar woh Allah ke saamne kuchh maangta hai, to Allah uski maangi hui wastu ko use de deta hai.  Atah woh aisa banda ban jata hai jiski dua qabool ki jaati hai. Agar Allah ki sharan maangta hai, to Allah use apni sharan deta hai aur har bhay se mukti pradaan karta hai.

Yeh hadees un hadeeson mein se ek hai, jinhen Allah ke Rasool sallallahu alaihi wa sallam ne apne paak rab se riwayat kiya hai. Is tarah ki hadeeson ko hadees-e-qudsi ya hadees-e-ilaahi kaha jaata hai. Isse muraad woh hadees hai, jiske shabd evn arth donon Allah ke hon. Albatta, iske andar Qur'an ki wisheshtayen, jaise uski tilaawat ka ibaadat hona, uske liye tahaarat haasil karna, uska chamatkaar hona aur us jaisi waani prastut karne ki chunauti dena, aadi nahin paai jaateen.
Allah ke waliyon ko kasht dene ki manaahi tatha unse mohabbat rakhne aur unki fazeelat ko sveekaar karne ki prerna.
Allah ke dushmanon se dushmani rakhne ka aadesh aur unse dosti rakhne ki manaahi.
Jisne Allah ki shareeyat ka anusran kiye baghair uske wali hone ka daawa kiya, woh apne daawe mein jhootha hai.
Allah ke wali banne ka saubhaagy uske dvaara aniwaary kiye gae kaamon ko karne aur uski haraam ki hui cheezon ko chhorne ke baad praapt hota hai.
Allah ki mohabbat ki praapti aur uske yahaan dua grahan hone ka ek sabab Allah ke aniwaary kiye hue kaaryon ko karne aur uski haraam ki hui cheezon ko chhorne ke baad nafal ibaadten karna hai.
Waliyon ki shrashthata evn uchch sthaan ka ullekh.
66535: Tummen se koi us samay tak momin nahin ho sakta, jab tak uski ichchhayen meri laai hui shareeyat ki adheen na ho jayen.

Abu Muhammad abdullah bin abbaas -radiyallahu anhuma- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : "Tummen se koi us samay tak momin nahin ho sakta, jab tak uski ichchhayen meri laai hui shareeyat ki adheen na ho jayen."

Allah ke Nabi -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne bataya hai ki koi vyakti us samay tak poorn momin nahin ho sakta, jab tak uska prem Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke laye hue aadeshon evn nishedhon aadi ke adheen na ho jaye,  aur woh aisi cheezon se prem karne lage, jinka aapne aadesh diya hai aur aisi cheezon se nafrat  karne lage, jinse aapne mana kiya hai.

Yeh hadees shareeyat ke anupaalan ke sanbandh mein ek siddhaant prastut karti hai.
Aql ya aadat ko apne oopar haawi hone dene aur unhen Allah ki laai hui shareeyat se aage rakhne se bachna chahiye. Is hadees ke anusaar aisa karne waale ke andar eemaan hi nahin hota.
Shareeyat ko har cheez mein aur har jagah nirnayak maanna zaroori hai. Kyonki aapke shabd hain : "Jab tak uski ichchhayen meri laai hui shareeyat ki adheen na ho jayen."
Eemaan neki ke kaam se barhta aur gunaah ke kaam se ghatta hai.
[imaam navvi kahte hain : Yeh hadees saheeh hai.]
[ise hamaare liye "Al-hujjah" Naami pustak mein saheeh sanad ke saath riwayat kiya gaya hai]
66540: “Neki uttam aachran hai, tatha gunaah woh hai jo tumhaare hriday mein khatakta rahe aur tum yeh naapsand karo ki log use jaanen.”

Navvaas bin samaaan -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai ki Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne farmaya hai : “Neki uttam aachran hai, tatha gunaah woh hai jo tumhaare hriday mein khatakta rahe aur tum yeh naapsand karo ki log use jaanen.” waabisa bin maabad -radiyallahu anhu- ka warnan hai, woh kahte hain : Main Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ke paas pahuncha, to aapne kaha : "Tum neki aur gunaah ke baare mein poochhne aye ho?" Mainne kaha : Ji haan. Aapne kaha : Khud apne dil se fatva le (poochh) lo. Neki woh hai jisse aatma evn man santusht rahe aur gunaah woh hai, jo man mein khatke aur dil mein uske baare mein sandeh paida ho. Chaahe log uske paksh mein kitna hi fatva den.

Allah ke Rasool -sallallahu alaihi wa sallam- ne neki aur gunaah ke baare mein baat karte hue farmaya hai ki sabse bari neki achchha vyavhaar hai. Allah ke saath achchha vyavhaar yeh hai ki taqva apnaya jaye aur srishti ke saath achchha vyavhaar yeh hai ki uske dvaara diye gae kasht ko sahan kiya jaye, gussa kam kiya jaye, hanskar mila jaye, achchhi baat ki jaye, rishte-naaton ko nibhaya jaye, baron ki baat maani jaye, chhoton ke saath dayaapoorn vyavhaar kiya jaye, logon ke saath mil-julkar raha aur achchhe se jeewan bitaya jaye. Neki woh hai, jisse aatma evn man santusht rahe. Jabki gunaah aisi sandigdh cheez hai, jo dil mein khatke, dil usse santusht na ho, dil mein baar-baar yeh sandeh evn dar paida ho ki kaheen yeh gunaah to nahin hai aur use aap achchhe, nek aur sachche logon ke saamne zaahir na hone dena chaahen. Kyonki svaabhaawik roop se, maanav aatma chaahti hai ki log uske baare mein kewal achchhi baaten hi jaanen. Isliye, agar aapko kisi kaary se logon ka avgat ho jaana naapsand hai, to iska matlab hai ki woh gunaah hai aur usmen koi achchhaai nahin hai. Bhale hi log auchity ka phatva dete rahen, lekin jab tak aapke dil mein sandeh aur shankayen hain, tab tak unke fatve ko sveekaar na karen. Kyonki fatva sandeh ko door nahin karta, shart yeh hai ki sandeh sahi ho aur fatva dene waala vyakti bina jaankaari ke fatva de raha ho. Lekin agar fatva shariya pramaanon par aadhaarit hai, to fatva maangne waale vyakti ko use sveekaar karna hi hoga, bhale hi uska man santusht na ho raha ho.

Uchch naitikta se sushobhit hone ke liye protsaahan, kyonki achchha charitr sabse bare achchhaai ke kaaryon mein se ek maana jaata hai.
Ek momin ko saty aur asaty ke beech antar karne mein koi kathinaai nahin hoti. Kyonki woh apne hriday mein maujood prakaash ke kaaran saty ko pahchaanta hai aur jhooth se ghutan mahsoos karta tatha usse ghrina karta hai.
Gunaah ka ek lakshan yeh hai ki hriday bechain aur pareshaan rahe aur yeh achchha na lage ki log use jaan jayen.
Sindhi kahte hain : Is hadees mein jo baat kahi gai hai, uska sanbandh un aspasht cheezon se hai, jinke baare mein spasht pramaan na hone ke kaaran log nishchati roop se yeh nahin jaante ki woh neki ke kaam hain ya gunaah ke. Warna, sachchaai yeh hai ki shareeyat mein jin kaamon ka aadesh diya gaya hai, wo neki ke kaam hain aur jin kaamon se roka gaya hai, wo gunaah ke kaam hain. In donon ke baare mein dil se salaah lene aur aashvast hone ki aawashyakta nahin haiै.
Is hadees mein sanbodhan aise logon se hai, jo svachchh prakriti ke maali hon, wo log nahin, jinke hriday wikrit ho gae hon aur jo apni aakaankshaaon ke peechh bhaagte hon. Bhale-bure mein antar karne ki kshamta kho chuke hon.
Teebi kahte hain : Kaha gaya hai : Is hadees mein aye hue shabd 'al-birr' ki kai vyaakhyayen ki gai hain. Allah ke Nabi sallallahu alaihi wa sallam dvaara ki gai ek vyaakhya ke anusaar 'al-birr' se muraad aisa kaam hai, jisse antraatma santusht rahe. Doosri vyaakhya ke anusaar muraad eemaan hai. Teesri vyaakhya ke anusaar muraad aisi cheez hai, jo insaan ko Allah ke nikat le jaye aur chauthi vyaakhya ke anusaar muraad uttam aachran hai. Jabki uchchatam aachran ki vyaakhya sahansheelta, kam ghussa karne, muskura kar milne aur madhur waani se ki gai hai.  Waise, sachchaai yeh hai ki yeh saari vyaakhyayen ek-doosre se nikat hi hain.
[pahli hadees Muslim ne aur doosri hadees ahmad tatha daarimi ne riwayat ki hai]
